subject: Repeated transform failures on logistics pipeline sync
body:
We're seeing intermittent transform failures on our 'logistics-orders-sync' pipeline in Data Pipelines. Since Monday, roughly 1 in 15 runs fail at the JSON-to-Parquet transform step with a timeout after 90 seconds. The connector to our warehouse (connector ID conn-8841) looks fine on its end, but latency on the pipeline dashboard has climbed from ~2s to 11s average over the last 3 days.

This is affecting order sync freshness for our dispatch team. Can someone check if there's a backend resource issue on your side for pipeline run IDs run-55210 through run-55240?
answer:
Thanks for the detailed run IDs, that helps a lot. We can see elevated latency on the transform workers serving your region starting around the same window you reported, and we're currently correlating it with a resource contention issue on one of our processing clusters. We're rebalancing load now and will monitor run-55210 through run-55240 plus new runs to confirm the timeouts clear.

I'll follow up within a few hours with an update, and please let us know if the failure rate increases in the meantime so we can escalate priority.

subject: Slack alerts from Jira integration stopped firing
body:
Our Jira-to-Slack integration through Northwind stopped posting alerts as of this morning around 8:15am. We rely on this for our 23-person ops team to catch incident tickets in #ops-alerts. No error is showing in the integration dashboard, it just shows 'Last sync: 3 hours ago' and hasn't updated since.

We've checked the Slack app permissions and they look unchanged. This is blocking our team from seeing new Jira tickets in real time, which is critical during our travel booking peak hours. Can you help urgently?
answer:
We're on this right away given the impact to your alerting. We can see the sync job for your Jira-Slack connector queued but not completing since 08:12am, which points to a stuck webhook delivery on our side rather than a Slack permission issue. We're restarting the connector job now and will confirm delivery of a test alert to #ops-alerts within the next 15 minutes.

We'll keep this ticket open until we see live alerts flowing normally again and will send a summary once resolved.

subject: Duplicate email alerts from Notifications - need dedup option
body:
I'm getting duplicate email alerts for the same event triggers in Notifications, sometimes 2-3 copies of the identical alert within a minute. This has been happening for about a week and is cluttering our shared inbox that the whole 14-person team monitors for energy market data anomalies.

Is there a setting to deduplicate alerts, or a recommended way to configure alert rules to avoid this? I looked through the docs but couldn't find guidance on dedup windows.
answer:
Thanks for flagging this, duplicate alerts are disruptive especially on a shared inbox. Right now there isn't a built-in dedup window, but we do have a workaround using a suppression rule keyed on event ID that prevents re-sends within a configurable interval, and I'll send you the documentation link along with steps to set it up. We're also logging this as a feature request for native deduplication and will update this ticket once it's on the roadmap.

In the meantime, could you share one or two of the duplicated alert IDs so we can check if there's an underlying trigger misfire on our end too?

subject: Getting duplicate alert emails, need help stopping them
body:
We've noticed duplicate alert emails coming through Notifications over the past few days, usually landing within seconds of each other with identical subject lines about shipment delays. Our small ops team of 7 relies on these for energy logistics tracking, so the duplicates are causing confusion about which alert is current.

Could you point me to how to configure alert rules to avoid duplicates, or let me know if this is a known issue on your end?
answer: Thanks for the report. Sending duplicate alerts within seconds usually points to a retry loop on the trigger condition, and we'd like to check your alert rule configuration to confirm. Could you share the name or ID of the alert rule generating the shipment delay notifications? In the meantime, I'm attaching a guide on setting a minimum interval between repeated alerts for the same event, which should reduce duplicates while we investigate the root cause.

subject: Multiple card failures on renewal, need refund and plan info
body:
Our Pro plan renewal on account atlas-legal-01 failed twice this week with error 'card_declined - insufficient_funds' even though the card has sufficient limit, we confirmed with our bank. This has also triggered what looks like a duplicate charge attempt showing on invoice INV-88213 dated June 3rd.

Could someone review this invoice, process a refund for the duplicate attempt if confirmed, and let us know what documentation we need to update our payment method without disrupting our 123 seats? We'd also like to understand if downgrading seats temporarily is an option while we sort this out.
answer: Thank you for flagging this, and apologies for the confusion around INV-88213. We've located the duplicate authorization attempt and confirmed only one charge actually settled, so no funds were captured twice, but we understand the pending hold caused concern and we're issuing a courtesy release confirmation from our payment processor within 24 hours. I've attached documentation on updating your payment method and on adjusting seat counts, and a billing specialist will follow up shortly to walk through options that won't disrupt your current 123 seats.

subject: Question on SSO role mapping configuration for our IdP
body:
We're setting up role mapping for Identity and SSO with our IdP (Azure AD) and want to confirm the correct attribute name for mapping groups to Northwind roles like 'Admin' and 'Editor'. Currently all 25 of our users are landing in the default 'Viewer' role regardless of their AD group.

Is there documentation on the exact SAML attribute format Northwind expects, and is there a way to test the mapping before rolling it out to the whole org?
answer: Good question, and this is a common setup step. Northwind expects the group claim under the attribute name 'northwind_roles' with values matching your role names exactly (case-sensitive), and I'll send over our SSO role mapping guide which includes an example Azure AD claim configuration. There's also a test mode under SSO settings that lets you simulate a login with a specific group claim before applying it org-wide, which I'd recommend using with one test user first.

subject: SAML login broken for entire staff, cannot access accounts
body:
Starting this morning none of our 34 staff can log in via SAML SSO, everyone gets redirected back to the Northwind login page with 'Authentication failed, please contact your administrator.' This started right after we updated our IdP certificate yesterday evening at around 6pm.

Our academy runs entirely on Northwind for course scheduling and staff access, so this is blocking the whole team from starting their day. We need this fixed urgently.
answer: This is top priority for us given the full lockout. The 'Authentication failed' response typically indicates a certificate mismatch after an IdP update, and we suspect the new certificate wasn't yet reflected in your SSO configuration on our side. We're pulling up your SAML metadata now and will confirm the fingerprint match; please have your IdP admin ready to re-upload the metadata XML if needed. We'll update this ticket within the next 20 minutes with next steps to restore access.

subject: Best practice for paginating large API result sets
body:
I'm integrating with the API Platform and pulling transaction records via /v1/transactions, currently using offset-based pagination with limit=100. On larger date ranges (30+ days) I'm hitting rate limit errors (429) after around page 40, and total fetch time is slow.

Is cursor-based pagination available or planned, since offset pagination seems inefficient at this scale? Also wondering if there's a bulk export endpoint that would avoid pagination entirely for our reporting use case.
answer: Thanks for the detailed context, this is a good use case for our newer cursor-based pagination on /v1/transactions, which is available now via the 'next_cursor' parameter and avoids the 429s you're seeing from repeated offset scans. I'll send documentation on migrating from offset to cursor pagination, and note that offset-based pagination on this endpoint is planned for deprecation later this year. We also have a bulk export endpoint (/v1/exports/transactions) suited for reporting pulls over large date ranges, happy to share setup details if useful.

subject: Storage retention policy deleting files we need for audit
body:
We just discovered that files uploaded to Storage older than 90 days have been automatically removed under what appears to be a default retention policy we didn't set. We need these files for a financial audit due next week, specifically invoices and backup exports from Q1 covering January through March.

Can you confirm if these files are recoverable from backup, and how to adjust retention settings so this doesn't happen again? This is urgent given the audit deadline.
answer: I understand the urgency given your audit timeline, and I'm escalating this immediately to our storage team to check backup recovery options for the Q1 files. We do retain deleted objects in cold backup for a limited window, so there's a good chance we can restore the January through March invoices and export files; I'll confirm exact recoverability within a few hours. In parallel, I'll send steps to adjust your account's retention policy so future uploads aren't auto-purged at 90 days.

subject: Seat count on invoice doesn't match active users
body:
Our latest invoice shows billing for 115 seats, but when I check the admin panel we only have 98 active user accounts. This discrepancy has been there for at least two billing cycles now, invoices INV-77102 and INV-77340. I want to understand if we're being overcharged or if there's a seat reservation system I'm not aware of.

Could someone clarify how seat counts are calculated and whether we're eligible for an adjustment or refund on the difference for the past two cycles?
answer: Thanks for pointing this out with the specific invoice numbers, that makes it easy to check. Seat counts include both active users and pending invited seats that haven't yet completed setup, which can explain part of the gap, but a 17-seat difference across two cycles is worth a closer look. I'm pulling the seat history for INV-77102 and INV-77340 now and will confirm whether an adjustment or partial refund applies, and share the seat calculation breakdown so this is clear going forward.

subject: Duplicate entries in daily email digest
body:
Since Monday our shipment status digests have been arriving with the same alerts listed twice, sometimes even three times. We use these digests to brief the dispatch team each morning so duplicate line items are causing confusion about whether an issue is new or already resolved. This is happening across all 12 seats, not just one user's inbox.

Can you confirm if this is a known bug with the digest generator? We'd also like the option to filter which alert types appear in the digest if that's not already possible.
answer:
Thanks for flagging this, and sorry for the confusion it's causing your dispatch team. We've seen a related issue where the digest job re-queues alerts that were already batched, which produces duplicates - I'm escalating this as a bug against the notification digest service and will update you once we have a fix timeline. In the meantime, could you send us the timestamps of one duplicated digest so we can confirm it's the same root cause on our end?

On the filtering request, that's not currently available but I'll log it as a feature request for the digest configuration - I'll let you know if it gets scheduled.

subject: Zapier integration stopped triggering after Salesforce update
body:
Our Zapier connection to Salesforce has stopped firing new lead notifications into Slack since yesterday afternoon. We rely on this to alert our logistics coordinators when a new shipment request comes in from Salesforce, and right now nothing is coming through even though records are still being created on the Salesforce side.

I checked the Zapier task history and it shows the zap as "on" but with zero tasks run in the last 18 hours. We only have 4 seats so this is blocking a small team but it's our main workflow.
answer:
Thanks for the detailed report. This lines up with an issue we're tracking where a recent Salesforce field mapping change can cause the trigger step in Zapier to silently stop polling. Could you check in your Zapier dashboard whether the trigger step shows an authentication or field error when you hit "test trigger"? That will tell us whether we need to refresh the connection on our integration side or whether Salesforce needs a field remap.

We're treating this as an active incident on our side and will keep you posted as we investigate the polling failure.

subject: Transform stage failing repeatedly on manufacturing_orders pipeline
body:
Our transform stage for the manufacturing_orders pipeline has failed on the last 6 consecutive runs since October 3rd, always at the same aggregation step. The error shown in the pipeline log is "transform_error: null value in column 'batch_id' violates not-null constraint" even though the source connector data looks complete on our end.

This pipeline feeds our production dashboards for 133 users across three plants, so we've had stale data for two days now. We need to know if this is a connector-side issue with null batch_id fields or something in the transform logic, and how to get the backlog reprocessed once it's fixed.
answer:
Thank you for escalating this - given the scale of impact I'm marking it P1 and looping in a pipeline engineer right now. The null batch_id error typically points to a schema drift on the source connector where a recent field became nullable upstream; we'll check the connector's raw payloads for the affected run window to confirm.

Once we identify the root cause we'll walk you through reprocessing the backlog for the failed runs rather than waiting for the next scheduled sync. I'll follow up shortly with findings from the connector logs.

subject: Question on IP allowlist and audit log visibility
body:
I'm setting up the IP allowlist in Admin Console for our office and VPN ranges, and I want to confirm how deactivation works if an IP is removed from the list while a session is already active. Does that user get force logged out immediately, or only on their next login attempt?

Also, I noticed the audit log only shows allowlist changes going back 30 days - is there a way to export older entries for our quarterly access review? We're a small team of 4 so this isn't urgent, just want to plan our settings correctly.
answer:
Good questions. Removing an IP from the allowlist does not force an immediate logout of active sessions - the check happens on the next authentication or token refresh, so a user could remain active until their session naturally expires. If you need immediate revocation, pairing the allowlist change with a manual session deactivation in Admin Console is the recommended approach.

On audit log retention, 30 days is the default visible window in the console, but we can export a longer history on request - let me know the date range you need for your quarterly review and I'll generate that for you.

subject: Shared dashboard visible to users outside intended group
body:
I shared our Q4 media performance dashboard with just the marketing team group, but two people from finance who aren't in that group can also see it and edit the filters. I checked the sharing settings and it's set to "specific groups" with only marketing selected, so this shouldn't be happening.

This is a permissions issue affecting a dashboard with sensitive campaign spend data, so I'd like this locked down quickly. Can you also point me to documentation on how group-based sharing inheritance works, since I suspect that's part of the problem?
answer:
Thanks for catching this - unintended access to spend data is something we want to resolve quickly, so I've flagged this as P2. A common cause is that those users belong to a parent group that inherits dashboard access even when not explicitly selected; could you confirm whether finance sits under the same parent org unit as marketing in your workspace settings?

In the meantime, I'd recommend switching the dashboard to explicit user-level sharing as a temporary lockdown while we confirm the inheritance behavior. I'll also send over our documentation on group hierarchy and sharing rules so you can audit other dashboards.

subject: How to handle repeated card declines for subscription renewal
body:
We're integrating with the Billing API and want to build better handling for failed card charges on our end. Right now when a customer's card fails we just see a generic "payment_failed" webhook event, but no reason code, so we can't tell the user if it was insufficient funds, an expired card, or something else.

Is there a way to get the decline reason from the API response or webhook payload? We'd also like to know if Northwind automatically retries failed charges or if we need to trigger retries ourselves, and whether there's documentation on recommended retry intervals.
answer:
Good timing on this question - the payment_failed webhook payload does include a `decline_code` field alongside the event, which maps to standard reasons like insufficient_funds or expired_card; if you're not seeing it, double check you're parsing the full event object rather than just the top-level status.

On retries, Northwind automatically attempts up to 3 retries over 5 days for subscription renewals using smart retry timing, so you generally don't need to trigger retries yourself unless you want custom logic. I'll send over our billing webhook documentation which covers the decline codes and retry schedule in detail.

subject: sync issue
body:
WE HAVE BEEN USING THE SCHEDULED SYNC FEATURE FOR OUR STUDENT ENROLLMENT DATA FOR ABOUT TWO MONTHS NOW AND IT HAS GENERALLY WORKED FINE, WE SET IT UP TO RUN EVERY NIGHT AT 2AM AND FEED INTO OUR FINANCE REPORTING TABLES. WE HAVE FIVE PEOPLE ON OUR TEAM WHO RELY ON THIS FOR MONTHLY BILLING RECONCILIATION AND EVERYTHING HAS BEEN RUNNING SMOOTHLY UNTIL RECENTLY.

THE SYNC HAS NOT RUN AT ALL FOR THE PAST 4 DAYS, NO ERROR NO NOTIFICATION NOTHING, IT JUST SHOWS THE LAST SUCCESSFUL RUN AS OCTOBER 1ST AND NOTHING SINCE. OUR FINANCE TEAM CANNOT CLOSE OUT THE MONTH WITHOUT THIS DATA AND WE NEED THIS FIXED TODAY.
answer:
I understand the urgency given your month-end close depends on this data, and I'm escalating this as P1 right away. A sync that stops silently with no error usually points to a scheduler-level failure rather than a data issue, so we're checking whether the job got orphaned or deactivated on our backend after October 1st.

Can you confirm the exact pipeline name or connector ID so we can pull the scheduler logs directly? We'll update you as soon as we have a root cause and will manually trigger a catch-up run once the scheduling issue is resolved.

subject: Unauthorized data appearing in our sync output - possible breach
body:
URGENT - our scheduled sync for the media_reporting connector ran at 3:15 AM and pulled in records that do not belong to our account. We're seeing rows with a company identifier that isn't ours mixed into our destination table.

Log excerpt:
[2024-06-11 03:15:02] INFO sync_start connector_id=conn_8841
[2024-06-11 03:15:47] WARN row_count_mismatch expected=14200 actual=19875
[2024-06-11 03:16:03] ERROR foreign_tenant_id detected in batch: tenant=grn_foods_44
[2024-06-11 03:16:03] ERROR sync_aborted reason=tenant_isolation_violation
[2024-06-11 03:16:10] INFO partial_write_committed rows=19875

We need to know immediately if this is a tenant isolation bug on your side and whether other customers received our data too. This affects our finance reporting and we consider this a serious security concern.
answer:
Thank you for reporting this immediately - a tenant isolation violation is treated as a top-priority security incident and I've escalated this to our security team right now, this is P0. We are pulling the full incident logs for connector conn_8841 and the tenant grn_foods_44 reference to determine scope, including whether the partial write that committed 19,875 rows needs to be rolled back and whether any of your data was exposed elsewhere.

Please do not delete or modify the affected destination table until our security team confirms it's safe to do so - we'll have an initial update for you within the hour and will follow our incident disclosure process if this is confirmed as a breach.

subject: Dashboards taking 30+ seconds to load for our support team
body:
Our support team uses the ticket volume dashboard constantly throughout the day, and over the past week load times have gone from a couple seconds to 30+ seconds, sometimes timing out entirely on the export to CSV action. We have 24 seats and nearly everyone is affected, it's slowing down how fast we can respond to customer issues.

The dashboard has about 8 widgets pulling from our support ticket data source, nothing changed on our end configuration-wise recently. Sharing the dashboard link with new team members also seems slower than before. Can someone look into whether this is a backend performance issue?
answer:
Thanks for the detailed report - a jump from seconds to 30+ second loads across your whole team points to a backend performance issue rather than something in your dashboard config, so I'm marking this P1 and pulling in our performance team to check query times against your support ticket data source. We'll also check whether the CSV export timeouts are related to the same underlying slowdown or a separate export service issue.

While we investigate, could you tell us if the slowdown affects all 8 widgets equally or if one or two specific widgets are noticeably worse? That will help us narrow down whether it's a specific query or a broader load issue.

subject: URGENT: Storage quota exceeded, backups failing across environments
body:
We received an alert that our storage quota has been exceeded and as a result last night's automated backups failed for our production and staging environments. Our IT team manages storage for 4,872 seats across the organization and we cannot afford data loss if backups continue to fail.

We need immediate guidance on either increasing our quota or clearing space, and confirmation that no existing backup data has been deleted or corrupted as a result of hitting the limit. Please treat this as critical - we have compliance requirements that mandate nightly backups be completed without gaps.
answer:
This is being treated as a P0 incident given the backup failure and your compliance requirements - I've escalated it to our storage team immediately. First priority is confirming the integrity of your existing backup data: we are checking now whether any prior backups were deleted or corrupted when the quota limit was hit, and will confirm this to you as soon as we verify.

In parallel we can raise your storage quota on an emergency basis to unblock tonight's backup run - please confirm the environments (production and staging) and current usage you're seeing so we size the increase correctly, and we'll get this resolved before your next scheduled backup window.

subject: Change request: SAML attribute mapping for new department roles
body:
We're a fintech customer running SAML SSO with Northwind Identity for 151 seats. We just restructured our departments and need to add two new SAML attribute mappings (department="Compliance-EU" and department="Compliance-US") so provisioning assigns the correct roles automatically instead of defaulting everyone to "Standard User".

Can someone walk us through updating the attribute mapping in the SSO config without breaking existing logins? We'd like to test this on a staging IdP app first if that's supported, then roll to production. No rush, just want to schedule this properly.
answer:
Thanks for reaching out and for planning this as a staged change. You can add new attribute mappings under Identity > SSO Configuration > Attribute Mapping - I'd recommend cloning your current production SAML app into a staging instance first, adding the two new department mappings there, and testing with a couple of test accounts before promoting the change. This won't affect existing sessions or logins for other users.

I'll send over a short runbook for cloning the SSO app and a checklist for validating the new attribute values before cutover. Let me know a target date and we can have someone from the SSO team available if you want a second pair of eyes during the production switch.

subject: Doppelte Benachrichtigungen bei E-Mail-Alerts
body:
Seit dem 14. Juni erhalten mehrere unserer Nutzer jede E-Mail-Benachrichtigung aus Northwind Notifications zweimal, teilweise im Abstand von nur wenigen Sekunden. Betroffen sind mindestens 12 Postfächer, die wir bisher identifiziert haben. Wir haben keine Änderungen an unseren Alert-Regeln vorgenommen.

Gibt es aktuell ein bekanntes Problem mit dem Alerting-Dienst? Wir würden gerne wissen, ob es an unserer Konfiguration liegt oder ob es sich um ein serverseitiges Problem handelt, bevor wir unsere Nutzer weiter verunsichern.
answer:
Vielen Dank für die genaue Beschreibung mit Datum und Anzahl der betroffenen Postfächer. Uns sind vereinzelt ähnliche Meldungen zu doppelten E-Mail-Benachrichtigungen bekannt, die mit einem Retry-Mechanismus im Alerting-Dienst zusammenhängen könnten. Wir prüfen aktuell die Zustellprotokolle für Ihren Account im genannten Zeitraum.

Können Sie uns zwei oder drei konkrete Beispiel-E-Mails mit Zeitstempel und Empfängeradresse nennen? Damit können wir gezielt in den Logs nachvollziehen, ob es sich um einen serverseitigen Fehler handelt oder eine doppelte Regel-Zuordnung in Ihrer Konfiguration vorliegt.

subject: Incorrect refund applied for seat downgrade last week
body:
We processed a seat reduction on our Enterprise plan from 1719 to 1650 seats on June 3rd, and the refund credit that posted to our account is $2,140 short of what our contract calculator shows. Our finance team flagged this during reconciliation this morning.

Can someone from billing review invoice #INV-88213 and confirm whether the proration was calculated against the old renewal date or the new one? We need this resolved before our next payment run on the 20th.
answer:
Thanks for flagging this with the invoice number - that helps us investigate quickly. I can see invoice #INV-88213 and I'm reviewing the proration calculation now to check whether it used the correct renewal anchor date; a mismatch there is the most likely cause of the shortfall you're seeing.

I'll have a corrected calculation and, if needed, an adjustment credit ready before your payment run on the 20th. I'll follow up within one business day with the details.

subject: Need to restore deleted folder from backup snapshot
body:
One of our team members accidentally deleted a client documents folder in Northwind Storage yesterday afternoon, around 3:30pm. We're on the Starter plan with 22 seats and I believe our retention window covers this, but I'm not sure how to trigger a restore from our end.

Could you point me to the restore process, or do you need to do this on your side? The folder had roughly 40 files and we'd like it back before end of week if possible.
answer:
Sorry to hear about the accidental deletion - the good news is your Starter plan retention window covers a 7-day recovery period, so yesterday's snapshot should still be available. Self-service restore for individual folders isn't yet available on the Starter tier, so our team will need to trigger this from our side.

Could you confirm the exact folder path and approximate time of deletion? Once confirmed, we'll restore from the nearest snapshot before 3:30pm yesterday and let you know as soon as the files are back, typically within a few hours.

subject: How to set up Okta app integration for our team
body:
We're trying to connect our Okta tenant to Northwind so our 23 users can SSO in through the Okta dashboard alongside our existing Slack and Jira apps. I found the Salesforce integration guide but nothing specific for Okta as an app tile.

Is there a SAML app definition or SWA template we should use, or do we need to build a custom app integration in Okta manually? We'd also like to confirm this won't slow down login performance compared to our current setup.
answer:
Good question - we do have a pre-built Okta SAML app integration you can add directly from the Okta Application Network rather than building one manually. I'll send over the app name and the SSO metadata URL you'll need to complete the setup, along with the attribute mapping defaults we recommend.

On performance, SAML login through Okta typically adds negligible overhead compared to direct login, so you shouldn't notice any difference for your 23 users. Let me know once you've added the app and I can help verify the first test login.

subject: dashboards unusable
body: charts take 40+ sec to load, unacceptable, fix now
answer:
I'm sorry for the disruption - this is being treated as a high priority issue. Could you tell me which dashboard(s) are affected and roughly how many charts or data points each contains? In the meantime, I'm pulling performance logs for your account now to check for query timeouts or backend slowdowns on our end.

I'll update you within the hour with findings or a workaround such as reducing chart date ranges while we investigate the root cause.

subject: Mobile app crashing immediately on launch for all iOS users
body:
Starting this morning, our field teams report the Northwind mobile app crashes within a second of opening on iOS, both iPhone and iPad. This is affecting a large portion of our 1719 seats who rely on the app for offline itinerary checks and push notifications while traveling. Version installed is 4.12.0, downloaded from the App Store.

We haven't made any MDM policy changes recently. Can you confirm if this is a known issue with the latest release, and what workaround exists while a fix is prepared? Several teams are currently in transit with no access to itinerary data.

Device logs show 'Fatal Exception: NSInvalidArgumentException' immediately after splash screen on multiple devices.
answer:
Thank you for the detailed report and the exception trace - this matches an issue we're actively investigating with version 4.12.0 on iOS related to a crash during initial config load. We're treating this as high priority given the number of affected users and the operational impact on your traveling teams.

As an immediate workaround, please have affected users roll back to version 4.11.2 via TestFlight or reinstall from the previous build if available; this avoids the crash while we finalize a hotfix. I'll update you as soon as the fix is submitted, and will flag your account for priority notification once it's live.

subject: Change needed: connector timing causing late data arrival in pipeline
body:
We're integrating the Northwind Data Pipelines API for our manufacturing sensor feeds, and for the past three days our nightly sync job for the 'sensor-batch-3' connector has been landing data 6-8 hours late compared to its usual 2am UTC completion. This is now cascading into downstream reports that depend on same-day freshness.

We need a change to the connector's polling interval or a manual trigger option so we can force an on-demand sync when this happens. Right now we have no way to intervene besides waiting for the scheduled run.
answer:
Thanks for the clear timeline - a 6-8 hour delay on 'sensor-batch-3' is significant and I understand the downstream impact on same-day reporting. I'm escalating this to our pipeline team to check for throttling or upstream source delays on that connector, and in parallel I'll enable manual trigger access for your account so you can force an on-demand sync rather than waiting for the scheduled window.

I'll confirm once manual trigger is live on your account, likely within the next few hours, and will follow up separately with root cause findings for the delay itself.

subject: Large number of employees unable to complete MFA enrolment
body:
Since Monday we've had roughly 40 of our 137 users stuck at the MFA enrolment step during SSO login - they authenticate successfully against our identity provider but then get stuck on a blank enrolment screen with no QR code or setup option appearing. This is blocking them from accessing any Northwind products entirely.

Our IT team has confirmed this isn't a browser or network issue since it happens across Chrome, Edge, and Safari for affected users. We need this escalated quickly since it's blocking a large portion of our legal team from case management work today.
answer:
This is being escalated immediately given the number of blocked users and the access impact. We're looking into the MFA enrolment service now to check for a rendering or token issue affecting the QR code step - could you confirm the exact time the first reports came in on Monday and share one or two affected user identifiers (not passwords) so we can trace their enrolment attempts in our logs?

We'll keep you updated every couple of hours until this is resolved, and will prioritize a workaround such as temporary MFA bypass for critical users if the fix takes longer than expected.

subject: Incorrect line items on latest monthly invoice
body:
Our latest invoice (billing period May 1-31) shows charges for 267 seats plus a $450 line item labeled 'Feature Add-on - Advanced Reporting' that we never enabled or requested. We're on the Pro plan and haven't made any plan changes this cycle.

Can someone check invoice #INV-77410 and confirm whether this add-on was activated in error on our account, and if so, issue a corrected invoice or refund for that line item?
answer:
Thanks for flagging the specific line item and invoice number. I'm pulling up invoice #INV-77410 now to check the activation history for the Advanced Reporting add-on on your account - if it was enabled in error on our side, we'll remove it and issue a corrected invoice with the $450 charge credited back.

I'll have an update for you within one business day confirming whether this was an internal activation error and the timeline for the corrected invoice.

subject: SDK wirft massenhaft Fehler – Datenverlust bei API-Aufrufen
body: Seit heute 09:12 Uhr erhalten wir bei jedem zweiten Aufruf unseres Bestell-Sync über das Northwind SDK (Version 4.2.1) den Fehler „429 Too Many Requests“ gefolgt von „500 Internal Error“. Von ca. 1.800 Transaktionen der letzten Stunde sind mindestens 640 nicht in unserem System angekommen, die IDs 88342 bis 88981 fehlen komplett. Wir können nicht nachvollziehen, ob die Daten bei Northwind verworfen wurden oder nur verzögert sind. Da es sich um Bestelldaten aus unserem Media-Geschäft handelt, brauchen wir dringend Klarheit, ob Daten verloren gegangen sind.
answer: Wir haben Ihren Fall als P0 eingestuft und das Security- und Compliance-Team sowie das Plattform-Engineering sofort informiert. Bitte senden Sie uns die betroffenen Order-IDs (88342-88981) sowie die Request-IDs aus Ihren SDK-Logs, damit wir die Anfragen serverseitig nachverfolgen können. Wir melden uns innerhalb der nächsten 30 Minuten mit einem Zwischenstand, ob die Daten wiederherstellbar sind oder erneut gesendet werden müssen.

subject: Dashboards completely unusable - this is costing us billable hours
body:
Our dashboards have been taking over 45 seconds to load for the past three days, and exports are timing out entirely with a generic 'Export failed' message. We have 140 legal staff relying on these for client billing reports and right now nobody can pull data. Sharing links that used to load instantly for partners now just spin forever.

This is the third performance incident this quarter and we are seriously reconsidering renewing with Northwind if this isn't fixed today. We need an ETA, not a canned response.
answer: I understand the urgency and I'm sorry for the disruption this is causing your team. I've escalated this to our Performance engineering group as a P1 and we're pulling the query logs for your workspace right now to identify what changed in the last three days. I'll have an update within the hour, and in the meantime could you send one or two dashboard IDs that are timing out so we can reproduce the issue directly?

subject: Rate limit changes breaking our webhook retry logic
body:
We noticed our webhook delivery success rate dropped from 99% to about 82% starting last week, and our SDK logs show 429 responses on endpoints that used to be well under the limit. Looking at the changelog, it seems the /events endpoint rate limit was quietly reduced from 600/min to 300/min without a deprecation notice we could find.

Could you confirm if this was an intentional change? We'd also appreciate feedback on whether batching webhook payloads is the recommended path forward, since our SDK version (2.8.0) doesn't seem to expose a batching option yet.
answer: Thanks for flagging this - you're right that the /events endpoint limit was adjusted as part of a capacity change, and I apologize that it wasn't communicated clearly beforehand. I'll get a note added to our changelog and deprecation notices going forward. Batching support was added in SDK 3.0.0, and I'd recommend upgrading; in the meantime I can raise your account's limit back to 600/min temporarily while you migrate.

subject: Zapier integration for Slack and Jira notifications
body:
We're trying to set up a Zap that pushes Northwind billing alerts into a Slack channel and also creates a Jira ticket automatically, but the Zapier app only shows triggers for user events, not billing or invoice events. Is there a way to expose those triggers, or is this something on your roadmap?

We also couldn't find documentation covering the Zapier connector specifically - only the general API docs. A short guide would help our small team a lot since we don't have dedicated engineering resources for this.
answer: Billing and invoice triggers aren't currently available in our Zapier app, only account and user events, but I've logged this as a feature request with our integrations team since we've had a couple of similar asks recently. In the meantime, you could use our webhook endpoint for billing events combined with a Zapier 'Catch Hook' trigger to achieve the same result, and I'll send over a short setup guide for that workaround today.

subject: Dashboard loading slowly for shared reports
body:
Several of our attorneys have reported that shared dashboards, especially the ones with multiple filters and cross-tab views, take 20-30 seconds to render since the update earlier this week. It's not every dashboard - mainly the ones shared externally with read-only links to opposing counsel or clients.

Could you check if this is related to the recent sharing permissions update? We'd also like to request a feature to cache shared dashboard views since our external viewers don't need real-time data.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report - we did roll out a permissions check update to shared links this week, and it's likely adding overhead on dashboards with multiple filters. I'll have our engineering team look into optimizing that check, and I've also logged your caching request as it would help exactly this scenario. I'll follow up once we have a fix or workaround for the slow shared views.

subject: Question about Okta app provisioning to Salesforce
body:
We recently configured the Northwind Okta app and noticed that when new employees are provisioned through Okta, their Salesforce roles don't automatically sync the way we expected - they show up in Salesforce but without the correct profile assigned. Is this expected behavior, or should the Okta-to-Salesforce mapping handle profile assignment automatically?

Not urgent, just want to understand if we're missing a configuration step before we roll this out to more of our finance team.
answer: Good question - the Okta app currently handles account creation and group membership sync to Salesforce, but profile assignment needs to be mapped separately through the attribute mapping section in the Okta admin console. I'll send over our configuration guide that walks through setting that mapping so new users get the correct profile automatically going forward.

subject: Recurring card failures blocking API access for our customers
body:
We're seeing an increasing number of our end customers' payment methods failing when we process subscription renewals through the Northwind Billing API - specifically error code card_declined_generic on roughly 18 of our 86 seat accounts since Monday. The API returns a 402 with no additional detail, and our customers say their cards are valid and working elsewhere.

This is starting to block their access to our platform mid-cycle since we auto-suspend on failed payment. We need to know if this is a Northwind-side issue with the payment processor or something on our integration end.
answer: Thank you for the details, and I understand this is impacting your customers directly. We've had a few similar reports since Monday and are actively investigating a possible issue with our payment processor's decline handling. Could you send us three or four of the affected transaction IDs so we can trace them on our end? I'll keep this ticket open as high priority and update you within a few hours with findings.

subject: How to set custom retention policy for storage buckets
body:
We'd like to set our storage retention to 90 days instead of the default for our compliance archive bucket, but I can't find that setting anywhere in the storage admin panel. We're currently at about 78% of our quota and want to make sure old files roll off automatically instead of us manually deleting them.

Could you point me to where this is configured, or let me know if custom retention isn't available on our current plan? We'd also like to understand how this interacts with backups if a file gets deleted by the retention policy.
answer: Custom retention policies are available but not yet exposed in the self-serve admin panel for Starter plans - it currently requires a configuration change on our end. I can set your compliance archive bucket to a 90-day retention policy today; just confirm the bucket name and I'll apply it. Regarding backups, files removed by retention are excluded from new backup snapshots but remain in backups taken before the deletion for the standard 30-day backup retention window.

subject: Files disappeared after retention policy applied overnight
body:
This morning we found that roughly 340 files in our 'quarterly-reports' bucket are missing, and it looks like our retention policy triggered a cleanup last night at 2:14 AM even though we had set retention to 180 days, not 30. These files are needed for an audit due this week and we have no local copies. Our storage quota usage dropped from 61% to 38% overnight which matches the missing files.

We urgently need to know if these files can be restored from backup, and why the retention policy applied a shorter window than configured.
answer: I've escalated this immediately as a P0 data loss incident. Our team is checking backup snapshots for the 'quarterly-reports' bucket taken before 2:14 AM last night, and we'll begin a restore as soon as we confirm the snapshot integrity - I expect an update within the hour. I'm also having engineering pull the retention policy change history on your account to understand why a 30-day window was applied instead of the configured 180 days, and I'll share findings as soon as we have them.

subject: Salesforce sync missing records after Okta role change
body:
We updated several employee roles in Okta last week as part of a department restructuring, and since then our Salesforce sync integration has stopped pulling records for about 200 accounts that were reassigned. The sync log shows 'skipped: role mismatch' for those records starting March 4th. We rely on this sync for daily reporting across our retail operations, and this gap is now affecting our weekly Jira reporting pipeline that pulls from Salesforce data too.

Can someone from the integrations team confirm how the Okta role mapping affects sync eligibility, and help us backfill the missing 200 records?
answer: Thanks for the clear timeline - the role mismatch skips are likely tied to how the Okta-Salesforce field mapping validates role assignments before syncing, and a bulk role change can trigger this for affected records. I'm escalating this to our integrations team to review the mapping rules for your account and to backfill the ~200 skipped records from March 4th onward. I'll also loop in someone who can walk through the role mapping configuration with you so future restructuring doesn't cause the same gap.

subject: PDF export fails/truncates on large dashboards
body:
We rely on the Dashboards PDF export for weekly clinical ops reviews across our sites, and since last week exports of dashboards with more than 6 charts are timing out or coming back with blank pages where line charts should be. This is happening on our main Ops Overview dashboard (ID dash-88213) with 4359 seats depending on this rollup.

We've tried reducing the date range and it still hangs at roughly 45 seconds before failing with 'Export could not be completed.' This is blocking distribution to department heads who expect the PDF by end of day. Can you prioritize a fix or at least tell us if there's a size limit we're hitting?
answer:
Thanks for the detailed report — I can see this is affecting a business-critical export for your team, so I've flagged it P1 internally. We've had a few other reports of PDF export timeouts on dashboards with heavy chart counts and are looking at whether a recent rendering change is the cause; can you send us the exact dashboard link and a timestamp of a failed attempt so we can pull the render logs?

In the meantime, as a workaround, try exporting individual chart groups separately (under 4 charts each) which should complete successfully, and we'll stitch guidance for a permanent fix as soon as we confirm root cause.

subject: Biometric login crashing app on iOS after update
body:
Since updating to the latest Mobile App version yesterday, our attorneys can't log in using Face ID anymore — the app crashes immediately on the biometric prompt screen. This is happening on iPhone 13 and 14 devices across our 18 seats, tested it myself on two separate phones with the same result.

Password login still works but that defeats the point of biometric setup for our team. We need this resolved quickly since several staff are locked out during active case work this morning.
answer: This is impacting your whole team's login flow so we're treating it as P1. We've seen an isolated issue where a biometric token refresh introduced in the latest release can trigger a crash on certain iOS versions — could you confirm the exact iOS version and app build number on the affected devices? In the meantime, please have staff continue using password login, and we'll push guidance on a fix or rollback within the next few hours.

subject: Card declines on renewal - need docs on retry policy
body:
Our monthly renewal charge failed twice this week and I want to understand the retry schedule before I escalate to our finance team. Here's the error from the billing log:

2024-05-14 09:12:03 billing.charge.failed customer=pioneer-energy card_last4=4482 reason=do_not_honor
2024-05-14 09:12:04 billing.retry.scheduled attempt=1 next_attempt=2024-05-16
2024-05-16 08:55:11 billing.charge.failed customer=pioneer-energy card_last4=4482 reason=do_not_honor
2024-05-16 08:55:12 billing.retry.scheduled attempt=2 next_attempt=2024-05-19

Could you point me to documentation on how many retries happen before service is suspended, and whether we're at risk of losing access to reporting for our 200 seats?
answer: Thanks for pasting the log, that's helpful. Our standard retry policy is three attempts spaced roughly 48-72 hours apart before an account moves to a grace period with limited access, so based on the timestamps you're on attempt 2 of 3. I'll send you the link to our billing retry documentation, and in the meantime it would be worth updating the card on file to avoid a third decline — let me know if you'd like me to extend the grace period while that's sorted.

subject: Push notifications causing app crashes for field staff
body:
Starting this morning our production floor supervisors are reporting that the Mobile App crashes within seconds of receiving a push notification about shift updates. This is happening consistently across Android devices, roughly 30 of our 211 seats have reported it so far today.

The app was working fine yesterday and no one on our side changed device settings. This is disrupting our shift handoff process badly and we need a fix or workaround urgently since supervisors can't rely on the app right now.
answer: I'm sorry this is disrupting your shift operations — given the number of users affected we're escalating this as P1 right away. Can you confirm the Android OS version and app build for a couple of the affected devices, and whether the crash happens even with the app in the background versus foreground? As an immediate workaround, disabling push notifications in app settings should stop the crashes while we investigate; we'll follow up as soon as we have more on root cause.

subject: Need option to delay push notifications when offline
body:
Our field instructors often work in areas with no signal, and we've noticed the Mobile App tries to fire push notifications the moment connectivity returns, which is causing crashes on several devices. Here's the error we're seeing repeatedly:

FATAL EXCEPTION: main
Process: com.northwind.mobile, PID: 5521
java.lang.NullPointerException: Attempt to invoke virtual method on a null object reference
at com.northwind.push.NotificationHandler.onReconnect(NotificationHandler.java:142)
at com.northwind.mobile.MainActivity.onResume(MainActivity.java:88)

Can you fix the crash and also consider adding a setting to queue and throttle notifications instead of firing them all at once after reconnect? This affects most of our 18 seats regularly.
answer: Thanks for the log, that's very useful — the null reference on reconnect points to a bug in how queued notifications are being replayed, and we're logging this as P1 since it's affecting most of your team. We'll investigate the NotificationHandler crash directly and follow up with a fix timeline; I've also passed your throttling/queueing suggestion to product as a feature request tied to this ticket.

subject: Jira integration broken - links not syncing to tickets
body:
Our team uses the Jira integration to link support tickets to engineering issues, and since yesterday afternoon new links just aren't syncing — we create the link in Jira but nothing shows up on the Northwind side. We've tried disconnecting and reconnecting the integration under workspace settings with no change.

This is blocking our engineering handoff process for active incidents across our 128 seats. Can someone check if there's an outage on the Jira connector or if our auth token needs refreshing?
answer: Thanks for flagging this — we're treating it as P1 since it's blocking your incident handoff process. We've had reports of intermittent auth token expiry on the Jira connector in the last day, so that's likely what you're hitting; can you check under Integrations > Jira if the connection shows a 'reauthorize' prompt? If so, reconnecting should restore syncing immediately, and if not we'll dig into your workspace logs directly.

subject: How to restore a folder from backup after accidental deletion
body:
One of our paralegals accidentally deleted a client documents folder from Storage last Friday, and I'd like to restore it from backup rather than have everyone re-upload files. We're on the Pro plan with 279 seats and I believe we have some retention window for backups but I'm not sure how far back it goes.

Could you walk me through the restore process, or do it on your end if it needs elevated access? The folder was named 'Client_Intake_Archive' and was deleted around May 10th.
answer: Happy to help get this restored. Our standard backup retention window covers deletions within the last 30 days, so a folder deleted on May 10th should still be recoverable. Could you confirm the workspace name and, if possible, the folder ID or parent path so we can locate the correct backup snapshot and initiate the restore on our end — we'll confirm once it's back in place.

subject: URGENT: scheduled data pipeline syncs completely down
body:
All of our scheduled Data Pipeline syncs stopped running as of 2:15 AM today and none have executed since — we depend on these for nightly inventory reconciliation and our retail systems are now out of sync with no data flowing. We checked our API credentials and connector configuration and nothing has changed on our end.

This is a full outage for us with 8 seats and it's affecting our ability to process orders correctly this morning. We need immediate help identifying whether this is a platform-wide issue or something specific to our connector.
answer: I've escalated this to P0 immediately given the full sync outage and its impact on your order processing. We're checking connector health and platform status now — can you confirm the connector ID and the last successful sync timestamp you have on record? We'll keep you updated continuously as we investigate and will prioritize restoring sync execution as the top item right now.

subject: Request: field-level mapping options for Salesforce sync
body:
We're using the Salesforce integration to sync account and contact records, and it's working well overall, but we'd like the ability to map custom fields beyond the default set currently supported. Right now we can only sync standard fields like name, email, and account owner.

Is there documentation on any beta or upcoming support for custom field mapping? We manage this integration for 112 seats and this would let us avoid a manual export process we currently run weekly.
answer: Thanks for the detailed context — custom field mapping for Salesforce sync isn't generally available yet, but it is on our integrations roadmap and there's a limited beta we could potentially add your workspace to. I'll check on beta availability and send over any documentation we have so far, and will follow up within a few days with next steps.

subject: seat count doesnt match invoice - need help fixng
body:
hey we got our latest invocie and it shows 221 seats billed but when i check our admin panel we only have 205 active users right now. we removed a bunch of ppl last month after a re-org so not sure why the seat cout didnt go down.

can someone explain how seat counts get calculated and if we can get a refund/credit for the extra 16 seats we didnt use? also is there a way to see seat history so this doesnt happen again next billing cycle
answer: Thanks for flagging this, and sorry for the confusion around the seat count. Seat counts typically reflect the highest number of active users during the billing period rather than the count on invoice date, which may explain the discrepancy if the re-org happened partway through the cycle — I'll pull up your account's seat history so we can see exactly when those 16 seats were removed and determine if a partial credit applies. I'll also point you to the seat usage report in the admin panel so you can track this going forward, and will follow up shortly with the credit review.

subject: Pagination totally broken - webhooks missing data
body:
We've been using Northwind for our student records sync for about a year now and things have generally been fine until this month. We rely heavily on the API to pull enrollment data nightly and push it into our own reporting system, and this has worked reliably since we onboarded 25 seats last spring for our education programs team.

Now the actual problem: since Monday our pagination cursor (page_token) is returning duplicate records on page 3 onward for the /enrollments endpoint, and we're getting 429 rate limit errors way before we hit our documented quota of 600 req/min. We're only at ~200 req/min. This is corrupting our downstream reports and I've had to manually dedupe three nights in a row. This needs to be fixed NOW, we are seriously considering cancelling if this isn't resolved today.
answer: I understand how disruptive this is, especially with nightly reports depending on accurate data, and I'm treating this as a P1. We've seen an issue tied to a recent change in cursor expiry that can cause page_token reuse under certain request patterns, which would explain both the duplicates and the early rate-limit triggers. Could you send me one full response payload showing the repeated page_token along with the timestamp of the request? In the meantime, I'd recommend switching to the 'since_id' parameter instead of page_token as a temporary workaround while we investigate.

subject: URGENT: Cannot access Admin Console - all settings locked out
body:
As of 9:14 AM ET today, no one on our finance or IT team can access the Admin Console workspace settings page. We get an immediate redirect to a blank error screen with 'Access Denied - Session Invalid' and this is affecting all 217 seats across our legal teams. We cannot view or modify audit logs, deactivate accounts, or update security settings.

This is a serious problem because we have a compliance audit scheduled for tomorrow morning and need to pull audit log exports and confirm our SSO settings are correctly configured. We need someone to look at this immediately as this is impacting our entire organization's ability to operate.
answer: This has been escalated to our on-call engineering team immediately given the org-wide impact and your audit deadline. We're seeing this may be related to a session-token validation issue affecting a subset of workspaces provisioned under legacy security policy configs. I'll update you within 30 minutes with findings, and in the meantime, if any admin can log in via an incognito browser session, that data point would help us narrow down the cause faster.

subject: Audit log entries missing for last 3 days
body:
I noticed while pulling our monthly compliance report that audit log entries for our Admin Console are missing entirely for October 14th through 16th. We have 24 seats on our media team and typically see 40-60 logged events per day (login events, permission changes, etc.) but these three days show zero entries.

Our compliance lead needs this data by end of week for an internal review, and I want to make sure this isn't an ongoing logging failure. Can you confirm whether the events were actually captured but not displayed, or if they're permanently lost?
answer: Thanks for flagging this with the specific date range, that's very helpful for tracing the issue. We've identified a logging pipeline delay that affected several workspaces during that window, and the good news is the underlying events were captured but not indexed to the audit log UI. I'm escalating this to our data team to re-run the indexing job for your workspace and will confirm once the October 14-16 entries reappear, hopefully within the next few hours.

subject: Biometric login fails intermittently on Android
body:
A few of our field managers have reported that Face ID and fingerprint login on the Northwind mobile app occasionally fails and drops them back to the password screen. It happens maybe once every few days per user, not consistently, and mostly on Android devices (we've seen it on Pixel 6 and Samsung Galaxy S21). No crash log pops up, the app just resets to the login screen.

This isn't blocking anyone's work since password login still works fine, but it's an annoyance for our logistics team who are constantly in and out of the app on their phones. Wondering if this is a known issue or something on our end.
answer: Thanks for the detail on device models, that helps narrow things down. This does sound like a known intermittent issue with biometric token refresh on certain Android OS versions, particularly after the device has been idle for extended periods. It's on our radar as a low-priority fix, and in the meantime there's no data risk since it just falls back to password auth. I'll keep this ticket open and update you once the fix ships.

subject: Question on mapping SSO groups to custom roles
body:
We're setting up SAML-based SSO for our retail operations and want to confirm the correct way to map Azure AD groups to our custom Northwind roles (specifically 'Store Manager' and 'Regional Auditor'). Right now new users provisioned via SCIM are landing in the default 'Viewer' role instead of their mapped group role.

We have around 2,107 seats total across our retail locations, so getting this role mapping right before we scale up provisioning further is important. Is there a specific attribute name or claim format we need to use in the SAML assertion for role mapping to work correctly?
answer: Good question, and this is a common setup step to get right before scaling provisioning. Role mapping requires the 'group' claim in your SAML assertion to exactly match the role name configured in Admin Console under Identity > Role Mappings, including case sensitivity. I'd recommend checking your Azure AD group claim configuration against our SSO setup guide, and I'm also attaching a sample assertion payload so you can compare against what your IdP is currently sending.

subject: Late-arriving records in daily sync from ERP connector
body:
Our finance team relies on the nightly Data Pipelines sync from our ERP connector to reconcile transaction records, and for the past week we've noticed that roughly 5-8% of records each night arrive with timestamps showing they were generated the previous day but don't show up in the pipeline until 12-18 hours later.

It's not breaking anything critical since our reconciliation window has some buffer, but it is causing minor discrepancies in our daily close numbers that we have to manually adjust. Is this a known latency pattern with the connector, and is there a way to see connector-level lag metrics on our end?
answer: Thanks for the detailed percentage and timing breakdown, that's useful for diagnosing this. Some lag between record generation and pipeline ingestion is expected with the ERP connector due to batch processing windows on the source system side, but 12-18 hours is longer than typical. I'd suggest checking the connector's sync health dashboard under Pipelines > Connector Status, which shows per-run latency metrics, and I'll also loop in our connector team to see if there's a batching configuration on your end that could be tightened.

subject: Salesforce sync creating duplicate contact records
body:
Since we set up the Salesforce integration two weeks ago, we're seeing duplicate contact records appear in Salesforce every time a contact is updated in Northwind. We currently have just 3 seats on our Starter plan and are testing this integration before rolling it out further, so we've caught about 15 duplicate records so far in our sandbox.

The sync seems to trigger a new record instead of matching to the existing one, even when the email address matches exactly. Can you help us figure out if this is a config issue on our end or a bug in the sync logic?
answer: Thanks for catching this in your sandbox before a wider rollout. This behavior usually points to the contact matching key not being set correctly in the integration config, it should default to email match but can silently fall back to creating new records if the field mapping was altered during setup. Could you check under Integrations > Salesforce > Field Mapping to confirm the 'Match On' field is set to Email? If that's already correct, send me two of the duplicate record IDs from Salesforce and I'll trace the sync logs directly.

subject: Connector lag causing delayed data in dashboards
body:
Our legal ops team has noticed that data flowing through our Data Pipelines connector from our document management system is arriving 6-10 hours later than expected over the past four days, which is throwing off our daily dashboard refreshes. We have 122 seats and rely on same-day visibility into case document processing volumes.

This isn't a total outage since data does eventually sync, but the delay is significant enough that our morning stand-up numbers are consistently stale. Can someone check if there's a backlog or throttling happening on the connector side?
answer: Thanks for flagging this with the specific delay window, I'm looking into your connector's processing queue now. We are seeing elevated backlog on document-management connectors industry-wide over the past few days due to increased source-side batch sizes, and I want to get this resolved before it affects another day of your stand-ups. I'll update you within a few hours with either a fix or a clearer timeline, and in the meantime you may see partial catch-up as the queue processes.

subject: Jira issue links broken after integration update
body:
After the Jira integration update rolled out yesterday, none of our existing Jira issue links inside Northwind are resolving correctly, they just show 'Issue Not Found' even for tickets we linked weeks ago and that definitely still exist in our Jira instance. This is affecting all 24 seats on our manufacturing team since we use these links constantly to track engineering work tied to customer requests.

We tried unlinking and relinking one issue as a test and it worked, but we have well over 100 existing links that we can't manually redo. Can you tell us if this is a known issue with the update and whether there's a bulk fix coming?
answer: Thanks for testing the relink workaround, that confirms this is tied to the update changing how issue keys are referenced internally rather than a broader Jira connectivity problem. This is impacting other customers who updated at the same time, so we're treating it as a priority fix. I'll escalate to engineering for a bulk re-indexing script rather than asking you to manually relink over 100 issues, and I'll follow up as soon as we have a timeline for that fix.

subject: Need to switch SAML login to require MFA for all users
body:
We're updating our security policy and need to change our SAML SSO configuration so that MFA is enforced for all 20 seats on our workspace, not just admins as currently configured. We use Okta as our identity provider and want to confirm whether this needs to be set on the Okta side, the Northwind Admin Console side, or both.

Also wanted to flag that the current SSO setup documentation doesn't clearly explain the MFA enforcement toggle location, it took us a while to even find the current admin-only setting. Would appreciate a walkthrough or updated doc link.
answer: Happy to help with this change. MFA enforcement for SAML logins needs to be configured on both sides: Okta handles the actual MFA challenge policy, while Northwind's Admin Console under Identity > SSO Settings > Login Policy needs the 'Require MFA for all users' toggle enabled so it applies the requirement workspace-wide rather than just to admins. I'll also pass your documentation feedback to our content team since you're right that the current toggle location isn't clearly called out in the guide.

subject: Dashboards extremely slow across workspace since Monday
body: Since Monday our shared operations dashboards are taking 20-30 seconds to load, sometimes timing out entirely. We have around 40 dashboards used daily by plant managers across our manufacturing sites, and the export to PDF function now fails with a generic error after the long load time. This is affecting our morning production reviews at all 6 facilities. Can someone look into whether this is a platform-wide performance issue or specific to our workspace?
answer: Thank you for flagging this, and I'm sorry for the disruption to your production reviews. We're seeing elevated query times on dashboard rendering for several enterprise workspaces and are treating this as a P1. I'm escalating to our performance team now to check whether the slowness correlates with recent widget or sharing changes in your workspace, and I'll update you within the hour with findings and an ETA.

subject: Mapping AD groups to Northwind roles via SSO
body: We just finished SSO setup with our identity provider and need to map two AD groups to specific Northwind roles - one for admins and one for read-only users. Right now everyone who logs in via SSO lands on the default Viewer role regardless of their group membership. Is there a way to configure attribute or group-based role mapping, or do we need to assign roles manually after each SSO login?
answer: Good question - group-based role mapping is supported through SAML attribute assertions, so you shouldn't need to assign roles manually. I'll send you the attribute name Northwind expects (northwind_role) along with a short guide on configuring the group-to-attribute mapping on your IdP side. Once that's set, new SSO logins should pick up the correct role automatically without needing to re-invite users.

subject: App crashes immediately on launch for field technicians
body: Several of our field technicians report the mobile app crashing right after the splash screen since updating to the latest version yesterday. It happens consistently on Android devices, both on wifi and offline mode. We rely on this app for shift check-ins at our robotics floor, so about a dozen people currently can't log in at all. Restarting the phone or reinstalling didn't help.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report, and sorry for the disruption to your team's check-ins. This matches a crash we're investigating tied to the latest Android release affecting offline cache initialization. As a workaround, please have affected technicians clear the app's local storage under device settings before reopening it, which should restore launch behavior. We're preparing a hotfix and I'll update this ticket as soon as it's rolled out.

subject: How to route billing alerts to a different email group
body: Right now all our billing threshold alerts go to one shared inbox, but we need critical ones escalated to our finance manager's email while routine ones stay with the general team. I also noticed we're getting duplicate alerts for the same threshold breach sometimes twice within a minute. Can you walk me through setting up separate routing rules and help figure out why the duplicates are happening?
answer: Happy to help with both. Alert routing rules can be configured per severity level under Notifications > Alerting Rules, where you can set a separate recipient for critical thresholds versus routine ones - I'll send a quick walkthrough link. On the duplicates, that's usually caused by two overlapping rules matching the same event; if you can share a screenshot of your current rule list I can help identify which ones are conflicting.

subject: Push notifications not arriving for shift alerts
body: Our operations team relies on push notifications for shift change alerts through the mobile app, but since last week none of our 23 staff are receiving them, even though the app shows notifications enabled in settings.
