subject: Unsubscribe requests not being honored in Notifications
body:
We've had three customers report that they unsubscribed from our marketing email notifications through the link in the footer, but they're still receiving alerts a week later. This is a compliance concern for us given healthcare regulations around communication consent.

Can you confirm how the unsubscribe list syncs with the Notifications system, and whether there's a delay we should be aware of? We need this resolved quickly since it affects trust with our clients and we're getting close to needing to consider alternatives if this keeps happening.
answer:
I understand the urgency here, especially given the compliance implications. The unsubscribe list typically syncs within 15 minutes of a user clicking the link, but there have been isolated reports of sync delays when list updates coincide with scheduled batch sends. Could you share the specific recipient identifiers or timestamps for the three affected customers so we can trace exactly what happened in their cases?

We're treating this as a priority issue and will have an update for you within one business day. In the meantime, I'd recommend pausing any scheduled batch sends to affected segments until we confirm the sync is working correctly.

subject: Dashboards taking 20+ seconds to load for shared reports
body:
Our team has been experiencing significant slowdowns when loading shared dashboards, particularly ones with multiple chart widgets pulling from our healthcare claims data. A dashboard that used to load in 2-3 seconds is now taking upwards of 20 seconds, and exporting to PDF sometimes times out entirely.

This started roughly a week ago after we added a new chart type (stacked bar with drill-down). Is this a known performance issue with that chart type, or could it be related to the sharing permissions we set up for our four team members?
answer:
Thanks for the detailed report - stacked bar charts with drill-down enabled do carry a higher rendering cost, especially when combined with larger claims datasets, so that's a likely contributor. I'd like to take a closer look at the specific dashboard to confirm whether it's the chart type, the underlying query, or the sharing configuration causing the slowdown.

Could you share the dashboard name or ID so I can pull performance logs from the past week? In the meantime, you might try disabling drill-down temporarily on that chart to see if load times improve, which would help us confirm the cause.

subject: URGENT: API rate limit errors blocking all payment webhook calls
body:
Since about 9:15am today we've been getting 429 Too Many Requests errors on nearly every call to the API Platform for our payment webhook processing. Our fintech app can't confirm transactions and customers are seeing failed payment states even though charges are going through on our end.

We haven't changed our request volume or SDK version recently. Error response includes 'Retry-After: 60' but retrying after that window still fails. This is blocking live transactions for our customers right now and we need urgent help.
answer:
This is being escalated immediately given the impact on live payment processing. We're pulling your account's rate limit and traffic logs right now to determine whether this is an unexpected quota reduction or a traffic anomaly on our side. 

As an immediate mitigation, please pause any automated retry loops that might be compounding the 429 responses, since rapid retries can extend throttling windows. I'll update you within the next 15-20 minutes with findings and next steps - we're treating this as critical given the transaction impact.

subject: Jira integration link broken after recent update
body:
We use the Integrations module to sync tickets between our internal systems and Jira, alongside our existing Slack and Okta connections. Since the update rolled out last Thursday, the Jira link shows a connection error whenever we try to create a linked issue - the error just says 'Unable to establish link: 403'.

Our Slack and Okta integrations are still working fine, so it seems isolated to Jira. Can you help us figure out if this is an authentication token issue or something on your end? We need this working again for our finance team's ticket tracking workflow.
answer:
Thank you for the detailed report. A 403 error on the Jira link specifically, especially right after an update, often points to an expired or revoked OAuth token scope on the Jira side rather than a broader integration issue - this would explain why Slack and Okta are unaffected. Could you try disconnecting and reconnecting the Jira integration from the Integrations settings page to refresh the token?

If that doesn't resolve it, please send us the exact timestamp of a recent failed attempt so we can check our integration logs for more detail on what Jira's API is rejecting.

subject: Push notifications failing to deliver on Android after app goes offline
body:
We're seeing a critical issue across our Mobile App deployment where push notifications fail to deliver to Android devices after the app has been offline for more than a few hours, even after reconnecting. Users have to fully log out and log back in to start receiving pushes again, which is causing a wave of support escalations from our field teams who rely on real-time alerts.

This seems to have started after the last app update pushed on Monday. We have 4562 seats across our travel operations and this is affecting a large portion of our mobile users daily. Can we get this escalated - we need a fix or workaround urgently.
answer:
Thank you for escalating this - given the scale of impact on your field teams, we're prioritizing this immediately. This pattern strongly suggests the push token refresh logic isn't re-registering correctly after extended offline periods following Monday's update, which would explain why re-login resolves it temporarily. 

We're pulling device logs and the release notes from Monday's update now to identify the regression. In the meantime, could you confirm the Android OS versions most affected and roughly what percentage of your users are hitting this? We'll have an engineering update for you within a few hours given the severity.

subject: Transform step failures in data pipeline connector for logistics feed
body:
I've been troubleshooting a data pipeline that pulls shipment data from our logistics connector and applies a transform step to normalize timestamps before loading into our warehouse. Since last Tuesday, roughly 15% of pipeline runs fail at the transform stage with a generic 'transform execution error' and no further detail in the logs.

The source data itself looks fine when I spot-check it, so I'm not sure if this is a data quality issue upstream or a bug in the transform step. Is there a way to get more verbose error output, or documentation on common causes for transform failures with this connector?
answer:
Thanks for the detailed breakdown - a generic transform error with no further detail usually means the failure is happening in a step that's silently swallowing an exception, often due to unexpected null values or type mismatches in specific fields rather than a broader connector bug. You can enable verbose logging for a specific pipeline run by adding the debug flag in the run configuration panel, which should surface the exact field or row causing the failure.

If you can share the pipeline ID and a timestamp of one of the failed runs, I can pull the detailed execution trace on our end as well. I'll also point you to our transform troubleshooting guide, which covers the most common causes we see with timestamp normalization steps.

subject: Late-arriving records breaking downstream sync windows
body:
We're integrating the Data Pipelines API for our energy feed connector and noticed that records timestamped for 2024-05-14 are still trickling in as of 2024-05-16 08:00 UTC. Our sync job closes the window after 24 hours, so these late records get dropped entirely instead of appended to the next batch. We've counted at least 340 records missing from the last three days combined.

Can you confirm whether the connector has a configurable grace period, or if this is expected behavior we need to handle client-side? This is affecting our energy pricing reconciliation reports.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. Late-arriving data past your sync window is a known limitation with the current connector version, but we do support a configurable grace period on Pro plans that isn't enabled by default. I'm escalating this to our pipelines team to get grace period support enabled for your workspace and will confirm the exact window once it's applied, likely within one business day.

subject: Need Slack alerts for integration failures before contract renewal
body:
We're evaluating renewal options and one blocker is that our team has no visibility when a Slack integration fails silently. Last week our #alerts channel didn't receive any notification for two days even though three sync jobs failed upstream. As PM I need this fixed or at least a workaround before we commit to renewing at current seat count.

Could someone confirm whether real-time failure alerts to Slack are on the roadmap, and if there's a temporary email fallback we can enable now?
answer: Thank you for flagging this ahead of renewal, I understand the urgency. Slack failure alerts are actually supported today via the Integrations settings page, but silent failures can occur if the webhook token expired without triggering a re-auth notice, which matches what you're describing. I'm looping in our integrations specialist to check your workspace's webhook status directly and will also enable email fallback alerts for you within the hour as a stopgap.

subject: How to set up SCIM provisioning for new hires
body: As we grow our finance team, I'd like to automate user provisioning through SCIM instead of manually adding accounts each time someone joins. We currently have 24 seats and expect to add a handful more this quarter. Could you point me to documentation on setting up SCIM for our SSO provider, and let me know if this is available on the Starter plan or requires an upgrade?
answer: Great question, and happy to help you get this set up. SCIM provisioning is available starting on our Pro plan, so it would require an upgrade from Starter, but once enabled it works with most major identity providers including Okta and Azure AD. I'll send over our SCIM setup guide and can also connect you with our account team if you'd like to discuss upgrade options.

subject: Option to configure late data handling window
body: We've noticed our legal case data connector sometimes receives records a few hours after the expected sync window closes, and right now those late records just get silently skipped in the next run. As workspace admin I'd like to know if there's a setting to extend the acceptance window or reprocess late arrivals automatically, since we're currently on Starter and manually re-triggering syncs each time this happens.
answer: Thanks for reaching out about this. Currently the sync window is fixed at 12 hours on Starter plans without a self-service option to extend it, but I can log a feature request on your behalf for configurable grace periods. In the meantime, I'd recommend scheduling a daily reprocessing job via the API to catch any records that arrive just after the window closes.

subject: Jira link integration failing for all agents - tickets not syncing
body:
Since yesterday around 14:00 UTC, our Jira link integration has stopped syncing new support tickets into Jira issues. This is affecting our entire support engineering team of roughly 40 agents who rely on this for tracking bugs. The integration status page shows 'Connected' but no new issues have been created despite over 60 tickets logged since the outage started.

We rely on this heavily for our travel booking incident workflows, so this needs urgent attention.
answer: I'm sorry for the disruption this is causing your team. This matches an issue we're currently tracking with the Jira integration's issue-creation webhook returning delayed acknowledgments, and I'm escalating this to our integrations on-call engineer right now. I'll update you within the hour with either a fix or a manual workaround so your team can resume syncing tickets in the meantime.

subject: Biometric login causing app crashes for our team
body: Multiple people on our operations team have reported the mobile app crashing immediately after attempting biometric login (Face ID) on iOS since updating to the latest app version this week. The app opens, shows the fingerprint/face prompt, then closes without any error message. This is blocking access for at least 8 of our 19 seats and is disrupting our field operations that rely on offline mode access.
answer: Thank you for reporting this, I know how disruptive this is for your field teams. We've had a couple of similar reports tied to the latest iOS release and biometric session handling, and I'm escalating this immediately to our mobile engineering team as a priority issue. As a temporary workaround, please have affected users disable biometric login and use passcode entry instead while we investigate a fix.

subject: Audit log missing deactivation events from last week
body: While reviewing our admin console audit log for a compliance check, I noticed that deactivation events for three user accounts on 2024-05-10 don't appear in the log at all, even though the accounts show as deactivated in the admin panel. We have 2572 seats across the organization and rely on complete audit trails for our internal security reviews. Could you help clarify whether these events are logged elsewhere or if this is a gap in the audit log itself?
answer: Thanks for bringing this to our attention, complete audit trails are important and we want to get this right. Deactivation events are normally logged in real time, so a gap like this is unusual; I'm forwarding the specific account details and timestamps to our platform team to investigate whether this is a logging delay or a display issue in the console. I'll follow up with findings as soon as I hear back.

subject: Unsubscribe requests not being honored - duplicate emails going out
body: We've had several end customers report that after clicking unsubscribe on our Notifications-powered emails, they continue receiving the same alerts days later. I checked our suppression list and confirmed at least 12 addresses that unsubscribed on 2024-05-08 still received duplicate alert emails on 2024-05-11 and 2024-05-12. This is becoming a compliance concern for us and we need this resolved urgently since it affects our energy sector customers directly.
answer: This is a serious issue and I appreciate you flagging it right away. It sounds like the unsubscribe flag isn't propagating to the suppression list used by the alerting pipeline, which we're treating as a high priority bug. I'm escalating this to engineering now and will also manually verify the 12 addresses you mentioned are suppressed immediately while we fix the root cause.

subject: All file uploads failing - production down
body: Every file upload to Storage has been failing since about 09:20 UTC this morning, returning HTTP 503 errors across all our API calls. This is a complete outage for us since our fintech platform depends on document uploads for customer onboarding, and we currently have zero successful uploads going through. Error response body: {"error":"service_unavailable","request_id":"a83f-991c"}. We need immediate assistance as this is blocking all new customer signups.
answer: I'm very sorry for this disruption and understand this is critical for your onboarding flow. Please hold off on retrying uploads in a tight loop as it may add load to the affected service while we work on it.

subject: TRANSFORM JOBS FAILING REPEATEDLY SINCE THIS MORNING
body: OUR DATA PIPELINE TRANSFORM STEP HAS BEEN FAILING SINCE AROUND 07:00 UTC TODAY. EVERY RUN ERRORS OUT WITH TRANSFORM_EXECUTION_FAILED AND THE LOGS SHOW A NULL REFERENCE IN THE MAPPING STEP FOR OUR MEDIA CONTENT CONNECTOR. WE ARE LOOKING INTO THE TRANSFORM_EXECUTION_FAILED ERROR ON YOUR MEDIA CONNECTOR RIGHT NOW AND WILL CHECK IF A RECENT MAPPING SCHEMA CHANGE IS THE CAUSE. I WILL UPDATE YOU SHORTLY WITH FINDINGS OR A WORKAROUND TO GET YOUR RUNS PASSING AGAIN.

subject: Deactivated users still showing as active in workspace settings
body: I'm the product manager overseeing our Northwind rollout at Pioneer Retail. Yesterday we deactivated 4 users who left the district (IDs ending in 4471, 4488, 4502, 4519) through the Admin Console workspace settings page, but they still appear as active in the audit log and can still log in. This looks like a sync delay between the deactivation action and the audit log/allowlist evaluation, which we're treating as a bug rather than expected behavior. I'm escalating this to our Account and Access engineering team now and will update you within a few hours with either a fix or a manual workaround to force the deactivation to take effect before Monday.

subject: Frage zu Plan-Upgrade und Rechnung
body: Ich bin Support Engineer bei Quill Retail und wir nutzen aktuell den Pro-Plan mit 204 Sitzen. Wir möchten für zwei Teams ein Upgrade auf zusätzliche Sitzplätze durchführen, sind uns aber nicht sicher, ob dies automatisch auf der nächsten Rechnung erscheint oder ob wir eine separate Zahlung leisten müssen. Außerdem wollten wir wissen, ob eine Teilrückerstattung möglich ist, falls wir mitten im Abrechnungszyklus upgraden.
answer: Vielen Dank für Ihre Anfrage. Wenn Sie zusätzliche Sitzplätze zu Ihrem bestehenden Pro-Plan hinzufügen, wird der Differenzbetrag anteilig für den restlichen Abrechnungszeitraum auf Ihrer nächsten Rechnung berechnet, es ist keine separate Zahlung notwendig. Eine Rückerstattung ist bei einem Upgrade nicht vorgesehen, da die Kosten nur anteilig nachberechnet werden; gerne erläutere ich Ihnen den genauen Betrag, wenn Sie mir die gewünschte neue Sitzanzahl mitteilen.

subject: SSO-Sitzungen laufen nach wenigen Minuten ab
body: Seit heute Morgen werden unsere Mitarbeiter alle 5 bis 10 Minuten aus ihren SSO-Sitzungen abgemeldet, obwohl unsere Session-Timeout-Einstellung auf 8 Stunden konfiguriert ist. Das betrifft alle 20 Nutzer bei Pioneer Retail und macht die Arbeit mit dem Dashboard praktisch unmöglich. Wir haben nichts an der Identity-Provider-Konfiguration geändert.
answer: Das tut uns sehr leid, wir stufen dies als Vorfall mit hoher Priorität ein. Wir sehen bereits ungewöhnliche Token-Ablaufzeiten in den Logs Ihres Workspace und prüfen gerade, ob ein aktuelles Deployment die Session-Timeout-Werte überschrieben hat. Ich melde mich innerhalb der nächsten 30 Minuten mit einem Update, und wir werden die Einstellung notfalls manuell auf 8 Stunden zurücksetzen.

subject: Offline mode doesn't sync push notifications after reconnect
body: I've been testing offline mode on the mobile app ahead of rolling it out to our legal teams at Willow Partners. When a device goes offline and then reconnects, cached actions sync fine, but push notifications that should have fired during the offline window never arrive afterward. It's not a crash, just a gap in functionality we'd like understood before we tell 146 seats it's ready to use.
answer: Thanks for testing this thoroughly before rollout. This is expected current behavior — queued push notifications tied to offline actions are dropped rather than delivered late, since we don't currently backfill them after reconnect. I'll file this as a feature request for our mobile team to consider adding delayed-delivery support, and I'll let you know if it gets prioritized.

subject: urgent
body: We are unable to upload any files to Storage since around 9:15am today. Every attempt returns a timeout after roughly 30 seconds, and this is affecting all of our clinical document uploads across departments. We have nightly backups scheduled tonight and I'm worried about retention policy gaps if this isn't resolved before then, we have over 3200 seats depending on this system.

Our infrastructure team is already investigating elevated timeout rates on the storage upload path and I'll have a status update for you within the hour. We're also flagging your nightly backup window internally so we can prioritize a fix or a manual failover before it runs.

subject: SAML login failing intermittently for some users
body: As a data analyst at Cobalt Partners, I've noticed our SAML SSO login is failing for a subset of users, roughly 8 out of our 96 seats over the past two days. The error shown is 'SAML response signature validation failed' and it seems to happen more with users who were recently provisioned. answer: Thank you for narrowing this down to recently provisioned users — that detail is helpful. It's possible there's a mismatch between a newer signing certificate on your IdP side and the metadata cached on our end for those accounts. Could you confirm the exact provisioning date range for the affected users? In the meantime I'm escalating this to our SSO team to check certificate rotation logs on our side.

subject: Webhooks stopped firing after API deprecation notice
body: We received a deprecation notice last week about the v1 webhook endpoints, and since we migrated to v2 yesterday our webhooks for order status updates have completely stopped firing. We're only on 9 seats so this is a small team, but it's blocking our fulfillment workflow entirely. No errors show in our logs, events just never arrive at our endpoint anymore.
answer: Thanks for flagging this right after the migration — I know how disruptive a silent failure like this is. This sounds like the v2 webhook subscriptions may not have been recreated automatically during migration, which would explain the lack of errors on your end. I'm escalating to our API platform team now to check your subscription status and will confirm within a couple hours whether we need to manually re-register your endpoints.

subject: Duplicate alerts and wrong routing after notification update
body: Since yesterday's notification settings change, our alert routing has been sending duplicate emails, sometimes 3 copies of the same fraud alert, to our compliance team instead of routing to the on-call channel we configured. This is a fintech environment so duplicate or misrouted alerts are a real problem for us. We have 56 seats and all admins are seeing this behavior.

It sounds like the routing rule update may have created overlapping alert paths instead of replacing the old one — I'm pulling your account's alerting configuration now to check for duplicate rule entries. I'll follow up shortly with either a fix or a temporary rule cleanup to stop the duplicate emails immediately.

subject: Need IP allowlist increased and audit log visibility for new offices
body: We're opening two new manufacturing sites and need their office IP ranges added to our Admin Console allowlist before go-live next Tuesday. Separately, we've noticed the audit log doesn't show allowlist changes made in the last week, which is making it hard to confirm our settings are correct. We have 133 seats and this is blocking our access rollout timeline.

On the audit log gap, that's not expected behavior, so I'm flagging it to our platform team to investigate why allowlist changes aren't being logged; I'll update you once we know if this is a display issue or a logging bug.

subject: Transform step failing intermittently in production pipeline
body: Our main data pipeline connecting our EHR connector to the dashboard has been failing at the transform stage roughly every 3rd run over the past two days, with latency spiking to over 40 minutes before it errors out. This is affecting sync freshness for our operations team across 205 seats. The connector itself shows healthy, so it seems isolated to the transform logic or downstream resource limits.
answer: Thanks for the clear breakdown of the failure pattern — the fact that the connector stays healthy while the transform stage times out points us toward a resource or performance bottleneck in that stage specifically. I'm pulling the pipeline run logs from the last two days now to check for memory or throughput limits being hit, and I'll follow up today with findings and a plan to stabilize sync freshness.

subject: Deactivating users in Admin Console
body:
We've been onboarding new paralegals this quarter and I finally got around to cleaning up our user list this morning. Our contract with two former employees ended on March 1st, and I went into Admin Console to deactivate their accounts so they no longer count toward our 18 seats.

When I click Deactivate on either user I get this in the console log:

PUT /api/v2/users/4471/deactivate 500
{"error":"internal_error","trace_id":"a91f-cc02"}

Could you tell me the right way to deactivate someone, and whether it frees up the seat immediately or at renewal? Also it would help if there was a bulk deactivate option since we'll be doing this every few months.
answer: Thanks for flagging this, and sorry for the trouble during your cleanup. That 500 error looks like a backend issue tied to those specific accounts rather than a general Deactivate problem — I'm checking trace_id a91f-cc02 now and will confirm what's failing. In the meantime, deactivating a user does free the seat immediately, it's reflected on your next invoice rather than mid-cycle. I'll also pass the bulk-deactivate request along to our product team as a feature suggestion.

subject: App crashes when going offline mid-sync
body:
I'm integrating our field team's data collection app with the Northwind Mobile SDK and testing offline mode ahead of a rollout to 14 users. When the device loses connectivity while a sync is in progress, the app crashes instead of queuing the pending requests. This happens consistently on Android 13 in airplane-mode tests, roughly 8 out of 10 attempts.

Is there documentation on how offline mode is supposed to handle mid-sync connectivity loss? I don't see anything in the SDK docs about queuing behavior once a request is already in flight.
answer: Thanks for the detailed repro steps. This does sound like a gap in how the SDK handles interrupted in-flight requests rather than expected offline behavior — a crash shouldn't happen even if the queue can't sync immediately. Could you send us the crash log or stack trace from one of those Android 13 sessions? In parallel I'll point you to our internal doc on offline queuing that covers request retries, since the public SDK docs are indeed thin on that specific case.

subject: Customers getting unsubscribe emails they never sent
body:
We're seeing a serious issue where customers who unsubscribed from our transactional alerts weeks ago are suddenly receiving duplicate unsubscribe confirmation emails, sometimes 3-4 in a row within minutes. answer: This is escalated on our end immediately given the customer-facing impact. We're looking at the unsubscribe event pipeline for duplicate processing starting around your reported 9:15am timestamp, and will update you as soon as we identify the cause. We'll also confirm whether any suppression list entries were affected so we can advise on cleanup for the customers who received duplicate emails.

subject: Billing charging for 8 seats but we only have 3 users
body:
Our latest invoice shows a charge for 8 seats but we only have 3 active users on the account — myself and two dispatch coordinators. I checked Admin Console and it confirms only 3 users exist. I'll follow up shortly with the root cause once I've confirmed it.

subject: Slack alerts not firing for pipeline failures
body:
We set up the Slack integration a couple weeks ago to notify our #data-alerts channel when data pipeline jobs fail. subject: Refund never processed after plan downgrade credit
body:
I want to walk you through what happened so it's clear. Back in January we upgraded a subset of our manufacturing division to a higher plan tier temporarily for a project that wrapped up in February. At that point we downgraded back down and support confirmed via a prior ticket that we'd receive a prorated credit of $4,280 for the unused upgrade period across our 252 seats.

Finance is asking me for an explanation and I don't have one. Can someone check what happened to this credit and process it, since this amount is material for our reconciliation this quarter?

I'll update you directly once it's confirmed rather than leaving you to chase this again.

subject: Unsubscribe link sending duplicate confirmations plus a feature ask
body:
Let me give you some background first. We rolled out Notifications across our manufacturing floor teams last quarter for shift alerts, and it's mostly gone well across our 242 seats aside from one recurring complaint we keep hearing from plant supervisors.

subject: PDF export cutting off dashboard charts
body:
When I export our quarterly compliance dashboard to PDF, two of the bar charts get cut off at the page edge instead of scaling to fit. This happens every time regardless of which browser I use. I need to send this export to our legal team for a review next week and right now it's not usable as-is.

Is there a setting to control page orientation or chart scaling for PDF exports, or is this something that needs a fix on your end?
answer: Thanks for reporting this — chart clipping in PDF export shouldn't happen and it sounds like a rendering issue rather than a settings gap. There is a page orientation option under Export Settings that sometimes helps with wide charts, but I'll also file this as a bug for our dashboards team to review. I'll let you know if switching to landscape resolves it in the meantime so you have something usable before your legal team review.

subject: dashboards timing out
answer: Thanks for the report — a 504 on render for query_id q_2291 points to the query itself timing out rather than a general outage. We'll check that dashboard's data volume and query plan and follow up with findings; in the meantime try narrowing the date range on that widget as a temporary workaround.

subject: Need to restore deleted files from backup
body:
One of our department heads accidentally deleted a shared folder containing grading records for about 60 students on March 22nd, and we need to restore it from backup before the end of the grading period. I checked our Storage retention settings and it looks like we're on a 30-day backup window, so I believe it should still be recoverable.

Can you confirm the process for restoring a specific folder from a backup snapshot, and whether we can target the March 21st snapshot specifically rather than restoring the entire account? We'd also like to understand if there's a way to extend our retention window beyond 30 days given we're on the Pro plan.
answer: Thanks for the details — the March 21st snapshot should indeed be within your 30-day retention window, so this is recoverable. We can perform a targeted folder-level restore rather than a full account restore; I'll need the exact folder path and will coordinate the restore with our storage team, aiming to have it back within one business day. On extended retention, that's available as an add-on and I can get you pricing details if you'd like to move forward with it.

subject: SDK v3 deprecation warnings causing 429s in production
body: Since upgrading to northwind-sdk-python 3.2.0 last week we're seeing constant DeprecationWarning logs referencing the old /v1/rate endpoints, and now we're getting intermittent 429 Too Many Requests on calls that never hit limits before on 2.x. This is affecting our dispatch scheduling for about 24 users at Quill Energy. Can someone confirm whether the new SDK changed the default retry/backoff behavior or the rate limit bucket size? We need this fixed or a clear migration path before our next delivery batch runs tonight.
answer: Thanks for flagging this - I can see the SDK 3.x release did change the default client-side rate limiter to match our new tiered limits, which can trigger 429s if concurrent requests exceed the new per-second cap even though your account limit itself hasn't changed. I'm escalating this to our API platform team now given the production impact on your scheduling run, and I'll send you a temporary config override to raise the client-side threshold while we confirm the right long-term fix. Expect an update within the hour.

subject: Request: SAML attribute mapping docs for role provisioning
body: We're rolling out SAML SSO for our clinical support team and want to auto-provision roles based on an attribute we send called department. The current SSO setup guide covers NameID and email mapping but doesn't mention custom attribute-to-role mapping or how permissions get assigned during JIT provisioning. Could you point us to documentation covering this, or let us know if it's not yet supported for Pro plan tenants? We'd also appreciate feedback on whether this is planned since it would save our IT team a lot of manual work.
answer: Good question - custom attribute mapping for JIT role provisioning is available on Pro plans, but I agree our public docs don't cover it clearly yet, so thanks for the feedback. I'll send you our internal guide on configuring the department attribute against role groups in the SSO settings panel, and I've logged a request with our docs team to get this added to the public SSO setup page.

subject: Uploads failing - storage quota errors despite having space
body: Our integration hit a wall this morning: every upload to bucket vertex-legal-docs is failing with 'quota_exceeded: storage limit reached' even though our dashboard shows we're at 61% of our Pro plan quota. This started around 09:15 UTC today and is blocking document ingestion for 217 users across our legal review pipeline. We also can't trigger manual backups right now, which is a bigger concern given our retention policy requires daily snapshots. Can someone check if there's a regional or per-bucket cap we're hitting separately from the account-wide quota?
answer: I'm sorry for the disruption - this looks like it could be a per-bucket soft limit rather than your account-wide quota, since those are tracked separately and can be misconfigured after a plan change. I'm escalating this to our storage team immediately as a P1 given the impact on your ingestion pipeline and backup schedule, and we'll confirm within the hour whether this is a bucket-level cap we need to raise or a billing sync issue on our end.

subject: Need to bulk deactivate 40+ users before end of day
body: I'm trying to deactivate a batch of users who left the company last month but the Admin Console only lets me deactivate one account at a time under Settings > Users. With 223 seats on our Pro plan, doing this manually for 40+ accounts is not workable, especially since some of them are on an allowlist for a legacy integration we need to remove them from too. Is there a bulk deactivation option via CSV or API, and how do allowlist entries get cleared when a user is deactivated?
answer: Bulk deactivation is possible via the Admin API's users/batch-deactivate endpoint, or you can upload a CSV of user IDs directly from the Settings > Users > Bulk Actions panel - I'll walk you through both. On the allowlist question, deactivating a user does not automatically remove them from allowlist entries tied to integrations, so those need to be cleared separately; I'll send you the steps for that along with the bulk deactivation guide today given your deadline.

subject: Shared dashboard shows blank charts for viewer role
body: I shared one of our media performance dashboards with a colleague using the Viewer permission level, but when they open the link all charts show 'No data available' even though I can see full data as the owner. We're only on 12 seats so I've tested this with two different viewer accounts and get the same result. Is this a known permissions bug, or is there a setting I'm missing for sharing data-level access along with the dashboard itself?
answer: Thanks for the detailed testing on your end. This is a known issue where Viewer role sharing sometimes doesn't inherit the underlying data source permissions automatically, so the dashboard loads but the queries fail silently. I'll send you a workaround involving explicitly granting data source access alongside the dashboard share, and I'm passing this along as a bug report to our dashboards team since the export function has the same underlying dependency.

subject: Pagination cursor behaving oddly after API update
body: We noticed that our nightly sync job pulling transaction records via /v1/transactions?cursor= started returning duplicate records starting around October 3rd. Looking at the changelog, it seems the cursor format changed as part of a deprecation of the old offset-based pagination. Our SDK version is 2.4.1 - do we need to upgrade to handle the new cursor format, or is there a compatibility mode? We're a small team so this hasn't caused major issues yet, just some duplicate entries we're filtering manually.
answer: Thanks for catching this - yes, the pagination cursor format changed as part of the offset-based deprecation rolled out in late September, and SDK 2.4.1 predates that change so it's falling back to unstable behavior. Upgrading to SDK 2.6.0 or later will handle the new cursor format correctly; there's no compatibility mode planned since offset pagination is being fully retired next quarter, so I'd recommend scheduling that upgrade soon.

subject: Frage zu Plan-Upgrade und Rechnungsstellung
body: Wir möchten von unserem aktuellen Enterprise-Vertrag mit 3314 Sitzplätzen eine Erweiterung um weitere 200 Sitze vornehmen, sind uns aber unsicher, wie sich das auf unsere nächste Rechnung auswirkt. Wird die Erweiterung anteilig für den restlichen Abrechnungszeitraum berechnet, oder beginnt ein neuer Zyklus? Außerdem hatten wir letzten Monat eine Rückerstattung für nicht genutzte Testlizenzen besprochen, die noch nicht auf unserer Rechnung vom 1. Oktober erschienen ist.
answer: Vielen Dank für Ihre Anfrage. Eine Erweiterung um zusätzliche Sitzplätze wird anteilig (pro-rata) für den verbleibenden aktuellen Abrechnungszeitraum berechnet und erscheint als separate Position auf Ihrer nächsten Rechnung, der reguläre Abrechnungszyklus ändert sich dabei nicht. Ich prüfe gleichzeitig den Stand der besprochenen Rückerstattung für die Testlizenzen und melde mich mit einem Update, sobald ich die Buchung in unserem System bestätigt habe.

subject: Charts rendering broken after last dashboard update
body: Several of our operational dashboards are showing charts with misaligned axes and overlapping labels since sometime yesterday afternoon. It's affecting our shift-performance dashboard the most, where the bar chart legend now covers half the data. We haven't changed anything on our side, and it's happening for multiple team members across our 94-seat workspace, not just me. Screenshots available if needed - this is making it hard for our ops team to read data during handoffs.
answer: Thanks for the report and for confirming this is happening across multiple users - that helps us narrow it down to a rendering regression rather than a local issue. I'll get screenshots from you to attach to the bug ticket, and in the meantime you can try switching the affected dashboards to the legacy chart renderer under Dashboard Settings > Display as a temporary workaround while our engineering team investigates the layout bug.

subject: Requesting Okta integration setup for our Slack and Salesforce workflows
body: We're evaluating consolidating our identity provider to Okta and want to understand how Northwind's Okta app handles provisioning alongside our existing Slack, Salesforce, and Jira integrations. Specifically, does the Okta SCIM connector sync group memberships that then map to permissions in Northwind, and is there documentation on how this interacts with our other configured integrations? We have 171 users at Ember Foods and want to plan the rollout carefully before committing.
answer: This is a great question and good timing since we recently expanded our Okta SCIM connector's group sync capabilities. Yes, Okta group memberships can map directly to Northwind permission roles, and this runs independently alongside your Slack, Salesforce, and Jira integrations without conflicts. I'll send over our Okta integration guide along with a rollout checklist that covers sequencing the SCIM sync ahead of enabling SSO, and I'm happy to set up a call to walk through your specific setup before you commit.

subject: URGENT: hitting rate limits constantly, webhooks failing
body: Starting this morning around 07:30 our API calls to the orders endpoint are getting rate limited constantly - we're seeing 429 responses on nearly every third request, and our webhook delivery for order status updates has essentially stopped working. We're a small team on 9 seats and haven't changed our request volume at all recently. This is blocking our order processing entirely and we need this resolved today.
answer: I understand the urgency and I'm treating this as a P1 given the impact on your order processing. I'm checking your account's rate limit configuration now to see if there was an unexpected change to your tier or a recent SDK-side update affecting request batching, and I'll also verify webhook delivery status separately since sustained 429s can cause the delivery queue to back up. I'll have an update for you within the next 30 minutes.

subject: SSO sessions timing out after ~15 minutes for logistics team
body: We're seeing users on the SAML SSO integration getting logged out after roughly 15 minutes of inactivity, even though our IdP session policy is set to 8 hours. This started affecting our dispatch team last week and they're having to re-authenticate constantly during shift handoffs. Our Okta tenant is configured with the Northwind SSO app, and the SP-initiated flow works fine on login, it's just the session length that seems off. Can you confirm what controls the session timeout on Northwind's side versus the IdP?
answer: Thanks for the detail — this looks like the session lifetime on our side is defaulting to 15 minutes rather than honoring the SAML assertion's SessionNotOnOrAfter value from your IdP. I'm escalating this to our identity team to check the session config tied to your Granite Partners tenant, and I'll confirm within a day whether we can extend it to match your 8-hour IdP policy or if there's a setting on your app configuration we need to adjust.

subject: Offline mode caching not persisting after app restart
body: I'm integrating the Northwind Mobile SDK (v4.2) into our retail app and testing offline mode. When a user goes offline, product catalog data caches correctly and the app works fine, but if they force-close and reopen the app while still offline, all cached data is gone and we get a blank state instead of the cached payload. I've checked local storage and the SQLite cache table is empty on restart even though it had ~1200 rows before closing.
answer: Thanks for the clear repro steps. This sounds like the cache isn't being flushed to persistent storage before the app terminates — likely tied to how the SDK handles the app lifecycle event on Android/iOS. Could you let us know which platform and SDK build you're testing on? In the meantime, I'd suggest calling syncCache() explicitly on app background as a workaround while we look into whether this is a defect in the offline persistence layer.

subject: Okta integration app missing group attribute mapping
body: We're setting up the Northwind Okta integration for North Capital and need to map Okta groups to Northwind roles automatically on provisioning. Right now the app config only exposes a single 'department' attribute field, but we need at least two custom attributes (region and cost-center) passed through for our downstream Salesforce sync. Is there a way to add custom attribute mappings to the Okta app, or is this a limitation we need a workaround for?
answer: Good catch — the current Okta app template only supports one custom attribute out of the box, so this would require a change on our side to expose additional mapping fields. I'm logging this as a feature request with our integrations team and will follow up with a timeline. In the short term, you could handle the region and cost-center mapping via a post-provisioning webhook to Salesforce if that helps unblock you sooner.

subject: Dringend: Wiederherstellung aus Backup schlägt fehl - Datenverlust
body: Wir haben heute Morgen (10.03., 08:15 Uhr) versehentlich einen Ordner mit Schulungsunterlagen aus dem Storage-Bereich gelöscht, etwa 340 Dateien. Beim Versuch, das Backup vom Vortag wiederherzustellen, bricht der Wiederherstellungsprozess nach ca. 2 Minuten mit der Meldung 'restore job failed: snapshot unavailable' ab. Wir brauchen diese Dateien dringend für einen Kurs, der morgen startet. Bitte so schnell wie möglich helfen, das betrifft unsere gesamte Akademie.
answer: Vielen Dank für die schnelle Meldung, wir behandeln das als kritischen Vorfall. Unser Storage-Team prüft gerade, warum der Snapshot vom Vortag als nicht verfügbar markiert wird, und wir suchen parallel nach einem älteren funktionierenden Snapshot, um zumindest einen Teil der 340 Dateien wiederherzustellen. Wir melden uns innerhalb der nächsten Stunde mit einem Zwischenstand und bitten Sie, bis dahin keine weiteren Löschvorgänge im betroffenen Ordner vorzunehmen.

subject: PDF export cutting off table columns on wide dashboards
body: When I export our quarterly sales dashboard to PDF, the rightmost two columns of the revenue-by-region table get cut off in the output file. The dashboard displays fine in-browser with all 8 columns visible. This is happening consistently across three different dashboards that use wide tables, and I've tried both landscape and portrait export settings with the same result. Could we get a fix or a way to force the PDF to scale the table to fit the page width?
answer: Thanks for flagging this — table truncation on wide layouts during PDF export is a known limitation we're actively working on. As a workaround for now, try reducing the table's column count in the widget settings or exporting at a wider custom paper size, which should capture all 8 columns. I'll keep this ticket open and update you once the auto-scaling fix for wide tables ships.

subject: URGENT: Push notifications causing app crashes for our field team
body: Our field staff are reporting that the mobile app crashes immediately whenever a push notification arrives while the app is open, starting since yesterday's update. This is happening across both iOS and Android devices and is affecting our entire team of 23 people who rely on the app for shift alerts. We need this resolved quickly since it's disrupting daily operations at Summit Retail.
answer: I'm sorry for the disruption this is causing — I'm escalating this immediately as a P1 since it's affecting your whole team. Can you send us the crash logs or a screen recording if possible, along with the app version and device OS versions involved? We're checking whether this is tied to the notification payload format changed in yesterday's release and will prioritize a fix or rollback as soon as we confirm the cause.

subject: Abmelden von E-Mail-Benachrichtigungen funktioniert nicht
body: Seit gestern erhalten mehrere unserer Nutzer weiterhin tägliche Alert-E-Mails, obwohl sie sich über den Abmeldelink in der Notifications-Sektion abgemeldet haben. Ein Kollege hat sich dreimal abgemeldet und bekommt trotzdem doppelte E-Mails, teilweise sogar zwei identische Nachrichten innerhalb von Minuten. Das sorgt für viele Beschwerden im Team und wir bräuchten eine schnelle Lösung, da es unsere ganze Abteilung betrifft.
answer: Danke für die Meldung, das nehmen wir als P1 auf, da es mehrere Nutzer betrifft. Es klingt so, als würde die Abmeldung nicht korrekt in unserem Alerting-System synchronisiert, was auch die doppelten E-Mails erklären könnte. Können Sie uns die betroffenen Nutzerkonten mitteilen? Wir prüfen sofort, ob es ein Problem mit der Unsubscribe-Verarbeitung gibt und melden uns innerhalb der nächsten Stunden mit einem Update.

subject: Duplicate email digests being sent twice daily
body: Our workspace has been receiving two copies of the daily email digest every morning for the past four days, both sent within about 10 minutes of each other with identical content. I checked the notification settings and there's only one digest schedule configured for our 14-seat workspace. A few team members have already asked me why they're getting duplicates, so I'd like to understand if this is a known issue or something specific to our setup.
answer: Thanks for the report — duplicate digest sends usually point to a scheduling conflict where two jobs got queued for the same window. I'll check the digest schedule configuration on the Cobalt Analytics workspace to see if there's a leftover duplicate rule, and will confirm once it's cleared up. In the meantime, could you let us know the exact send times you're seeing so we can cross-reference against our job logs?

subject: Role mapping broken after SSO update - users getting wrong permissions
body: After the recent SSO configuration change, our role mapping from Okta groups to Northwind roles is assigning the wrong permission sets. Users in the 'ops-managers' group are now landing in the default viewer role instead of admin, affecting roughly 40 of our 267 users since this morning. This is blocking critical workflows for our operations team who can't access the admin panels they need. We haven't changed anything on our IdP side recently.
answer: This is a serious issue and we're treating it as P1 given the scope of affected users. We're pulling the recent changes to the role mapping configuration on North Labs' tenant to identify what shifted the ops-managers group assignment, and will provide an update within the hour. As an immediate workaround, we can manually reassign the affected users to the correct role while we fix the underlying mapping — please confirm if you'd like us to do that now.

subject: Alert routing sending all notifications to one channel instead of per-team
body: We configured alert routing rules to send billing alerts to our finance channel and API error alerts to our engineering channel, but since this morning all notifications, regardless of type, are landing in the single default channel. I checked our routing rules in the Notifications settings and they still show the correct conditions and destinations, so it looks like the routing logic itself isn't being applied. This is causing our engineering team to miss critical API alerts mixed in with unrelated billing notices.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report, I can see how this would create noise for your team quickly. This sounds like the routing engine may not be evaluating your rule conditions correctly, possibly due to a recent update on our notification service. I'm escalating this now given the impact on your alerting, and will ask our platform team to check whether routing rules for Quill Foods are being processed in the correct order — I'll update you as soon as we have a root cause.

subject: Help
body:
I'm trying to add our office IP range to the allowlist in Admin Console so only approved networks can reach the billing exports, but the save fails every time. Here's what I get:

POST /admin/security/ip-allowlist 422
{
  "error": "invalid_cidr_overlap",
  "range": "203.0.113.0/24",
  "conflict_with": "deactivated_rule_18"
}

It seems to be conflicting with an old rule that was supposedly deactivated months ago but still shows as active in the backend. Separately, could you add a feature to show allowlist changes in the audit log? Right now I can't tell who added the conflicting rule in the first place.
answer: Thanks for the detailed error, that's helpful. It looks like the old rule wasn't fully deactivated on our end, which is why the CIDR overlap check is blocking your new entry - I'm escalating this to our platform team to clear rule 18 properly. I'll also log your request to surface allowlist changes in the audit log as a feature request; in the meantime I can pull the change history manually if you need it for compliance purposes.

subject: need to restore files form backup, quota concern
body: Hi, one of our team acidentally deleted a folder of training material uploads from last quarter and we need it restored from backup if possible. It was in the 'Onboarding_2024' bucket, deleted aorund March 14th i think.
answer: Thanks for flagging this - restoring from backup is something we can help with as a scheduled change rather than an emergency fix, since it involves pulling from our nightly snapshots. Could you confirm the exact bucket name and, if possible, the approximate time of deletion so we target the right snapshot? I'll also check your current storage quota before the restore since re-adding that folder will count against it, and I'll flag our retention policy details so you know how far back we can go.

subject: Settings
body: I have spent THREE separate calls trying to get someone to explain why workspace settings keep resetting our default timezone and session length back to factory defaults every time we deactivate an inactive user. This has now happened four times this month and it's messing up scheduling across all 127 seats. Nobody has documented this behavior anywhere and support keeps telling me to 'check back later.' If this isn't fixed by next week we are going to seriously look at other vendors, this is unacceptable for a paid Pro plan.
answer: I completely understand the frustration, and I'm sorry this has dragged on across multiple calls without resolution. This does sound like a bug where the deactivation workflow is triggering a reset of workspace-level settings instead of just the user record, and I'm escalating it to engineering today with priority given the recurring impact. I'll follow up personally within one business day with root cause and a workaround so your timezone and session settings stop reverting in the meantime.

subject: Dashboard load times spiking on shared views
body: We've noticed our shared operations dashboard (the one with six charts pulling from the API) has been taking 15-20 seconds to render since Tuesday, versus the usual 2-3 seconds. It happens consistently when accessed via the share link, but loads fine when I open it directly from my own account. Nothing changed on our integration side that I'm aware of - same API calls, same data volume.
answer: Thanks for the clear comparison between direct and shared-link access, that narrows things down nicely. That pattern suggests the shared view might be re-fetching chart data without caching the way the authenticated view does - I'll check our dashboard service logs for your workspace around Tuesday's timeframe and see if there's a caching regression on shared links specifically. I'll update you with findings within a day or two since this isn't blocking your own dashboard access.

subject: API Rate Limits werden ständig erreicht
body: Seit letzter Woche stoßen wir regelmäßig an die Rate-Limits der API Platform, obwohl sich unser Traffic-Muster nicht verändert hat. Wir erhalten HTTP 429 auf /v2/reports/query mehrmals pro Stunde, was unsere Reporting-Pipeline blockiert. Könnten Sie uns die aktuellen Limits für unseren Enterprise-Vertrag bestätigen und ob es dokumentierte Burst-Kontingente gibt? Wir brauchen dringend eine Lösung, da mehrere Teams betroffen sind.
answer: Vielen Dank für die Meldung, das nehmen wir mit hoher Priorität auf, da es mehrere Teams betrifft. Wir prüfen sofort Ihre aktuellen Limit-Konfiguration und die 429-Antworten auf /v2/reports/query, um zu sehen ob hier ein Fehlkonfiguration oder eine Änderung an den Burst-Kontingenten vorliegt. Wir melden uns innerhalb der nächsten Stunden mit einer Zwischenupdate und den genauen Limit-Werten für Ihren Enterprise-Vertrag.

subject: Users getting logged out every few minutes via SSO
body: Since this morning, users across our workspace are being logged out of their SSO sessions after roughly 3-5 minutes of activity, forcing constant re-authentication through our identity provider. This is affecting all 14 of our seats and is making the platform nearly unusable during our morning reporting cycle. No recent changes were made to our SSO configuration on our end.
answer: This is impacting your whole team so we're treating it as high priority right now. Short session lengths like this usually point to a token refresh or clock-skew issue between our identity service and your IdP - we're pulling your SSO session logs now to check token expiry settings and recent auth events. I'll update you within the hour with findings and a temporary workaround if the fix takes longer than expected.

subject: WEBHOOKS EXPOSING CLIENT DATA AFTER TODAY'S DEPLOY
body: WE JUST NOTICED THAT OUR WEBHOOK ENDPOINT IS RECEIVING PAYLOADS INTENDED FOR A DIFFERENT WORKSPACE. THIS STARTED RIGHT AFTER THE API PLATFORM DEPLOY THIS MORNING AROUND 9AM. WE ARE A LEGAL FIRM AND THIS IS CLIENT CASE DATA BEING SENT TO OUR ENDPOINT THAT DOES NOT BELONG TO US. WE HAVE ALREADY DISABLED OUR WEBHOOK URL BUT NEED CONFIRMATION THIS IS CONTAINED AND WHO ELSE MIGHT BE RECEIVING OUR DATA.

We're pulling deploy logs from this morning's release to identify the webhook routing issue and confirm the scope of misdirected payloads, including whether your data was sent elsewhere. Please keep your endpoint disabled for now - our security team will contact you directly within the next 30 minutes with findings and next steps.

subject: Biometric login repeatedly failing on iOS after latest app update

I'll escalate to our mobile engineering team given the operational impact and follow up with a fix timeline or workaround as soon as we have one.

subject: Slack integration not posting alerts for failed jobs
body: We set up the Slack integration a couple weeks ago to post alerts to our #ops channel whenever a scheduled job fails, but it's stopped sending anything for the last several days even though jobs are still failing on our end. The Slack connection still shows as 'Active' in our integrations settings. We're not using Salesforce or Okta integrations currently, just wanted to flag in case they're related.
answer: Thanks for letting us know, and good to confirm you're not running other integrations that could be conflicting. We'll check the delivery logs for your Slack webhook connection over the past week to see if alerts are being generated but failing to send, or not being triggered at all. I'll follow up with what we find, likely within a day or two given this isn't blocking core functionality.

subject: Jira issue links not appearing on synced tickets
body: We use the Jira integration to link support tickets to engineering issues, but for the past week new links created from our side aren't showing up on the Jira issue's linked items panel, even though the sync confirms success on our end. This is making it hard for our engineering team to track which tickets map to which fixes across our various product lines.
answer: Thanks for the clear description - this sounds like a one-way sync gap where our system is confirming the link but Jira isn't rendering it on its side. We'll check the integration logs for your workspace over the past week to see if the link payloads are reaching Jira's API successfully and investigate from there. I'll update you once we've identified whether this is a formatting issue or a Jira-side display bug.

subject: Upgrading from Pro to Enterprise for 242 seats
body: I'm the support engineer handling our Northwind account at Granite Works. We're currently on the Pro plan with 242 seats and want to move to Enterprise to get SSO and priority support. Can you walk me through the upgrade process, and let me know if there's a prorated charge on our next invoice or if we get credit for the unused portion of our current billing cycle? I'll send over the Enterprise feature documentation and a formal upgrade quote for your 242 seats so you can confirm before we make the switch.

subject: Storage quota hit, uploads failing across the board
body: As of this morning our team at Ember Freight can't upload any new product images or backup files - every attempt returns a quota exceeded error. We're at 178 seats and this is blocking our retail catalog refresh scheduled for today. subject: Need higher rate limits for analytics pipeline
body: I'm a data analyst at Vertex Energy and we're hitting 429 responses on the /v2/reports endpoint roughly 40 times per hour during our nightly batch jobs. Our current limit seems to be 600 requests/minute but our pipeline needs sustained throughput closer to 1000/minute for about a 2-hour window each night. Is there a way to request a temporary or permanent increase, and does the Python SDK handle retry-after headers automatically?
answer: Thanks for the detailed breakdown - we can set up a temporary rate limit increase to 1000 requests/minute for your nightly window while we evaluate a permanent bump based on your usage pattern. Regarding the SDK, yes, the Python client respects Retry-After headers automatically starting from version 3.2, so if you're on an older version I'd suggest upgrading to reduce the manual backoff logic in your batch job.

subject: Push-Benachrichtigungen kommen nicht an bei Offline-Nutzern
body: Wir integrieren die Northwind Mobile App API bei Willow Labs und stellen fest, dass Push-Benachrichtigungen nicht zugestellt werden, wenn Nutzer länger als etwa 20 Minuten offline waren. Sobald die App wieder online ist, kommt keine Nachbenachrichtigung an, obwohl der Server laut Logs den Push erfolgreich abgesetzt hat. Das betrifft mehrere hundert Nutzer aus unserem Medienteam bei Testläufen diese Woche.

Wir prüfen aktuell die Logs für Willow Labs der letzten Woche und melden uns innerhalb der nächsten Stunden mit einer Einschätzung, ob ein Fix auf unserer Seite nötig ist oder ob eine Konfigurationsänderung im Client hilft.

subject: App crashes immediately on launch after update
body: Since updating to the latest version yesterday, the Northwind mobile app crashes within a second of opening on two of our five devices, both running Android 13. We've tried reinstalling and clearing cache but it crashes before we even get to the login screen. This is only affecting our team at Quill Works, not sure if it's device-specific or something with the update itself.

Could you send us the device models and Android build numbers for the two affected phones so we can try to reproduce it, and in the meantime you might try rolling back to the previous app version if it's still available in your device's update history.

subject: Connector authentication failing intermittently for our LMS sync
body: Our data pipeline connecting to the student LMS system at Blue Health has been failing authentication intermittently since Tuesday, throwing 'token refresh failed: invalid_grant' errors roughly every 3 hours. This is causing sync delays of up to 90 minutes and some records are arriving out of order. We have 1416 seats relying on this data for daily reporting, and the inconsistent latency is affecting data quality checks downstream.
answer: Thank you for flagging this with the specifics - intermittent invalid_grant errors usually point to a refresh token that's being invalidated on the LMS provider's side, possibly due to a credential rotation policy.
