subject: CREDIT AND REFUND QUESTION ON INVOICE
body: WE NEED TO UNDERSTAND HOW THE PRORATED CREDIT WAS CALCULATED ON OUR LAST INVOICE AFTER WE DOWNGRADED SEATS MID CYCLE. HERE IS THE RELEVANT SECTION FROM THE STATEMENT: INVOICE #INV-88231 LINE 1: PLAN CHARGE PRO 211 SEATS - $31,650.00 LINE 2: CREDIT ADJUSTMENT -$1,240.50 LINE 3: PRORATION NOTE: 14 DAYS REMAINING TOTAL DUE: $30,409.50 OUR FINANCE TEAM CANT RECONCILE THE $1,240.50 AGAINST THE SEAT REDUCTION WE MADE ON THE 3RD. CAN YOU EXPLAIN THE FORMULA USED OR SEND DOCUMENTATION ON HOW CREDITS ARE APPLIED.
answer: Happy to walk through this. The credit reflects the unused portion of the seats removed on the 3rd, calculated as (seats removed x daily rate x days remaining in the billing cycle), and the $1,240.50 corresponds to that mid-cycle adjustment rather than a flat refund. I'll send over our billing documentation page that breaks down the proration formula, and I can also generate a line-item export of this invoice if that helps your finance team reconcile it.

subject: digest
body: gettign duplicate daily digest emials, 3 copies evry morning since monday, pls fix
answer: Sorry about the duplicate digests - that's not expected behavior. Can you confirm the email address receiving the triplicate digests and whether you have more than one notification rule configured for daily summaries? In the meantime I'll check your account's notification settings for any duplicated escalation rules that might be triggering multiple sends.

subject: MFA enrollment broken for new hires, blocking access company-wide
body: We're in the middle of onboarding 40 new logistics analysts this week and none of them can complete MFA enrollment through Northwind Identity. The enrollment screen loads the QR code, but after scanning with an authenticator app and entering the six-digit code, we get 'ENROLLMENT_VERIFICATION_FAILED' every time, across multiple devices and multiple users. This started roughly two hours ago and is blocking all 255 seats from any new sign-ins, since existing sessions are also being forced to re-enroll after a policy sync we pushed this morning.
answer: This is now our top priority given the scale of impact. We're investigating the enrollment verification service immediately, and it looks like it may be related to a timing issue introduced by the policy sync you mentioned. I'll have an engineer confirm within 30 minutes whether we need to roll back that policy change, and will keep you updated continuously until enrollment is restored for all affected users.

subject: ROLE MAPPING COMPLETELY BROKEN AFTER SSO UPDATE
body: OUR IT TEAM RECENTLY WORKED WITH YOUR SUPPORT DESK TO SET UP SSO FOR OUR MEDIA DIVISION USING SAML ATTRIBUTES MAPPED TO NORTHWIND ROLES, AND EVERYTHING WAS WORKING FINE FOR ABOUT TWO WEEKS AFTER GO-LIVE. WE THEN MADE A SMALL CHANGE TO OUR IDP GROUP NAMES LAST FRIDAY TO ALIGN WITH A NEW ORG STRUCTURE. SINCE THAT CHANGE, EVERY USER LOGGING IN VIA SSO IS BEING ASSIGNED THE DEFAULT VIEWER ROLE INSTEAD OF THEIR ACTUAL ROLE, MEANING FINANCE AND ADMIN USERS CAN NO LONGER ACCESS BILLING OR ADMIN PANELS. THIS IS AFFECTING ALL 20 SEATS AND WE HAVE NO WAY TO MANUALLY OVERRIDE ROLES RIGHT NOW. PLEASE HELP URGENTLY.
answer: We understand the urgency and are treating this as a critical access issue. The role assignment failure is almost certainly tied to the IdP group name change breaking the attribute mapping rules on our side, so we're pulling your SAML configuration now to update the mappings to match the new group names. As an immediate workaround, we can temporarily grant admin role overrides to specific accounts while we fix the mapping - please send us the usernames that need elevated access right now and we'll action that within minutes.

subject: upgrade charged wrong, fix now
body: upgraded to add 5 seats last week, got billed for a full new plan instead, this is ridiculous fix it or we cancel
answer: I'm sorry for the frustration this has caused - that's not how the upgrade should have been billed. I'm pulling up your account now to review the charge and reverse the incorrect full-plan billing, applying only the prorated cost for the 5 additional seats. I'll confirm the corrected invoice with you shortly today.

subject: Storage quota hit unexpectedly, uploads blocked
body: Our app integrates with Northwind Storage to save user-uploaded media files, and as of this morning all upload requests are returning 'QUOTA_EXCEEDED' even though we're a small team on 4 seats and haven't uploaded anything unusually large. The bucket dashboard shows we're at 98% of allocated storage, which is odd since our usage graph was under 40% just three days ago. Can you check if there's a bug counting deleted files toward the quota, since we've removed several test uploads this week?
answer: That does sound like a quota calculation bug rather than genuine growth in stored data. We're checking your storage account now to see if deleted objects are being retained in a way that still counts against your quota total. I'll confirm the actual byte count on our backend and, if we find deleted files are being miscounted, will issue a manual quota recalculation to unblock your uploads today.

subject: Request to enable biometric login on mobile app
body: We'd like to enable Face ID and fingerprint login for our team on the Northwind mobile app instead of requiring password entry every session. Right now the app only prompts for username and password each time, even though our devices support biometric authentication. Is this a setting we can turn on ourselves in the admin console, or does it need to be enabled on Northwind's side for our account first?
answer: Biometric login is available on our mobile app but does need to be enabled at the account level before your team can turn it on locally. I'll enable the biometric authentication feature for your workspace now, after which each user will see the option to activate Face ID or fingerprint login from their app settings on next launch.

subject: Uploads failing for all users, urgent
body: Since around 9 AM today every file upload through Northwind Storage has been failing for our team, returning a generic 'Upload failed, please try again' message with no further detail. We tested with files ranging from 2MB to 50MB and across three different browsers, all with the same result. This is blocking our support workflows since we rely on Storage to attach diagnostic files to customer cases, and we currently have 18 pending cases stuck without attachments.
answer: We're treating this as a critical outage on our end and are checking the storage ingestion service logs now to identify why uploads are failing across all file sizes. Given the impact to your case workflows, I'll prioritize this and get back to you with either a fix or a workaround within the hour, and will keep you posted on progress as we investigate.

subject: Audit Log: IP-Allowlist für Exportfunktion fehlt
body:
Wir prüfen aktuell die Audit-Log-Funktion der Admin Console im Rahmen unseres Compliance-Reviews. Uns ist aufgefallen, dass sich der Export von Audit-Logs nicht auf bestimmte IP-Bereiche einschränken lässt. Für unsere Security-Richtlinien bräuchten wir eine Allowlist, damit nur Zugriffe aus unserem Firmennetz (z. B. 203.0.113.0/24) den Export durchführen können.

Gibt es dafür schon eine Roadmap oder einen Workaround, z. B. über API-Token-Restriktionen? Das betrifft aktuell 190 Nutzer bei uns.
answer:
Vielen Dank für den Hinweis. Aktuell unterstützt die Admin Console keine IP-basierte Allowlist speziell für den Audit-Log-Export, wir können das aber als Feature-Anfrage an unser Produktteam weiterleiten. Als Zwischenlösung empfehlen wir, den Export ausschließlich über API-Tokens mit eingeschränkten Scopes durchzuführen und diese Tokens regelmäßig zu rotieren; das schränkt zumindest den Nutzerkreis ein.

Wir melden uns, sobald wir Rückmeldung vom Produktteam zur Priorisierung dieser Anfrage haben.

subject: Late-arriving records breaking our daily aggregation window
body:
We run a nightly sync from our media analytics connector into Northwind Data Pipelines, scheduled at 2 AM UTC. Over the past week we've noticed records with timestamps up to 36 hours old arriving after the pipeline window closes, so they get dropped instead of merged into the correct day's aggregate. This is affecting our revenue reporting for at least 4 of the last 7 days.

Could you add a configurable grace period or late-arrival buffer to the connector settings? Right now we have no way to reprocess these records without a full manual backfill.
answer:
Thanks for flagging this — a missing late-arrival buffer is a known gap for several of our connectors, and it's actively causing you data quality issues so we're treating this as high priority. In the meantime, we can help you set up a manual backfill job for the affected days and walk you through a temporary widening of your aggregation window to catch stragglers.

We're also passing your request for a configurable grace period to the pipelines team as a near-term feature request, given the impact on your reporting accuracy.

subject: Offline mode not syncing expense entries after reconnect
body:
Several of our team members log travel expenses in the mobile app while offline during flights, then the entries don't sync once they're back online. I tested this myself yesterday on iOS: entered 3 expense records offline, reconnected to wifi, and none of them appeared in the dashboard even after 2 hours. Push notifications for approval requests also stopped coming through for me during this time.

Can you tell us whether offline entries are queued locally, and if there's a way to force a manual sync or re-login to trigger it?
answer:
Thanks for the detailed report. Offline entries should be queued locally and sync automatically on reconnect, so this behavior suggests the sync token may have expired during your offline session. As a first step, please try logging out and back in on the app to refresh the session, then check if the 3 pending expense entries appear — this often resolves stuck queues.

If they still don't sync after that, let us know the device model and app version and we'll escalate to check the sync logs on our end.

subject: Deactivated users still showing as active in Admin Console
body:
We deactivated 12 student accounts yesterday through the Admin Console's bulk deactivation tool after the semester ended, but this morning all 12 are still listed as active and can still log in to shared resources. I've tried deactivating them individually as well with no change. This is a problem for us since these are accounts that should have lost access immediately per our IT policy.

Can someone check why the deactivation isn't taking effect? We have 224 seats total and need this resolved before more accounts need to be processed at term end.
answer:
Thank you for reporting this — accounts remaining active after deactivation is not expected behavior, and we understand the urgency given your access policy. We're checking the deactivation queue on our side now to see if there's a processing delay or stuck job affecting your workspace, and will confirm the status of those 12 accounts shortly.

In the meantime, if immediate access removal is critical, we can manually force-revoke sessions for those specific accounts — just confirm and we'll proceed right away.

subject: Duplicate email digests being sent twice daily
body:
Our team started receiving two copies of the daily notification digest email each morning starting around March 3rd, both timestamped within a minute of each other. We haven't changed any digest settings recently. It's not urgent but it's cluttering inboxes for a lot of our users given our workspace size.

Could you check if there's a duplicate schedule or subscription somehow configured for our account?
answer: Thanks for letting us know. Duplicate digest sends usually point to two overlapping schedule configurations, sometimes left over from a settings change or a workspace migration. We're going to review the digest scheduler for your workspace to look for a duplicate entry and will clean it up on our end — no action needed from you for now, but let us know if the duplicates continue past tomorrow's send.

subject: Retention policy not purging files past 90-day quota
body:
We have a 90-day retention policy set on our manufacturing logs bucket in Storage, but I'm seeing files from as far back as November still present when I check via the console today, well past the retention window. This is starting to push us over our storage quota — we got a warning email this morning saying we're at 96% of allocated capacity. Our backup jobs are also failing intermittently with 'insufficient storage' errors since last night.

Can someone check whether the retention job is actually running for our account? This is impacting our backup pipeline directly.
answer: Thank you for the report — we're escalating this immediately given the impact on your backup jobs. We're checking whether the retention purge job has been running correctly for your bucket, since files persisting past a 90-day policy points to a stuck or skipped job. We'll follow up shortly with findings and will manually trigger a purge cycle if needed to relieve the quota pressure before it affects further backups.

subject: SAML login broken after IdP certificate rotation
body:
We rotated our IdP signing certificate yesterday and now none of our 5 users can log in via SSO — everyone gets 'SAML response validation failed' on the Northwind login page. I've already re-uploaded the new certificate metadata into the Identity and SSO settings but the error persists. This is blocking our entire team from accessing the platform right now.

We'd also like to request MFA enforcement be tied to our IdP going forward once this is fixed, instead of managed separately in Northwind.
answer:
We understand this is blocking your whole team and we're prioritizing it right away. Could you send us the exact SAML response error trace from a recent failed login attempt, along with the entity ID configured on your IdP side? Often after a certificate rotation the metadata needs a few minutes to propagate, but if it's been over an hour we'll want to check the signing certificate fingerprint currently cached on our side against what you uploaded.

We've also logged your request for tying MFA enforcement to the IdP and will follow up separately on that once login access is restored.

subject: Role mapping from IdP groups not reflecting correctly
body:
We use group-based role mapping through our IdP for SSO, and noticed that a few users assigned to our 'Manager' group in the IdP are landing in Northwind with only standard user permissions instead of manager-level access. This has been happening since we added two new groups last week. It's not blocking anyone critically since we can manually adjust roles, but it's inconsistent with what's documented.

Could you clarify how the role mapping refresh timing works, and whether new IdP groups need a separate manual sync?
answer: Good question — role mappings are typically refreshed at each SSO login, so new IdP groups should apply automatically the next time an affected user signs in. If it's still not reflecting after a fresh login, there may be a caching delay on the group attribute sync, which we can manually trigger from our side. We'll also flag this to our docs team since the current documentation doesn't clearly explain the refresh timing for newly added groups.

subject: Shared dashboard visible to users outside intended group
body:
One of our team members shared a retail sales dashboard intending it to be visible only to our 'Regional Managers' sharing group, but we've since found that users outside that group can also view it, including some in a completely unrelated department. The sharing settings page shows only the Regional Managers group listed under permissions, so this seems inconsistent with what's actually happening.

Could you check whether there's an inheritance issue from a parent folder's permissions? We'd like to understand the actual permission model before sharing anything else.
answer: Thanks for catching this and reporting it clearly. This does sound like a permission inheritance issue — dashboards nested under a folder often inherit that folder's sharing settings in addition to their own explicit group list, which can cause exactly this kind of unexpected visibility. We'll check the folder hierarchy for this specific dashboard and confirm what's inherited versus explicitly set, and will also point you to our documentation on dashboard permission inheritance so you can plan future sharing accordingly.

subject: App crashes immediately when opening offline mode after update
body:
Since updating to the latest mobile app version this morning, the app crashes within 2 seconds every time I try to open it while offline — this is happening for me and at least 6 other people on my finance team, all on Android. We rely on offline mode heavily for site visits with no signal, and this is now completely blocking our expense approval workflow. Push notifications for pending approvals also aren't coming through since the update.

We need this fixed urgently as approvals are backing up across our 211-seat team.
answer: Thank you for the urgent report — a crash on launch affecting multiple users is being treated as high priority. We're pulling crash logs for your account now to identify the cause tied to the latest update; in the meantime, could you confirm the exact app version and a couple of Android device models affected? As a temporary workaround, staying online during app launch before switching to offline mode may prevent the crash for some users while we investigate the root cause and prepare a fix.

subject: Mobile app crashes immediately on launch
body: I'm the finance manager here at Apex Media and since Monday our mobile app has been crashing right after the splash screen on my iPhone 13 running iOS 17.4. It never gets to the login screen, just closes back to the home screen. I tried deleting and reinstalling the app twice with no luck. Two of my colleagues on Android devices don't have this issue, so it seems iOS-specific.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. Could you confirm the exact app version shown in the App Store listing (Settings > General > iPhone Storage > Northwind app) and whether you're on a company-managed device with any MDM profile installed? In the meantime, please try toggling off Low Power Mode and confirm you have at least 500MB free storage, as that's a common cause of launch crashes we've seen on iOS 17.4.

subject: Widespread crash on app open affecting our team
body: We're seeing a significant number of our 243 seats unable to open the mobile app since yesterday afternoon. Reports are coming in from both iOS and Android users describing the app freezing on the login screen for a few seconds and then closing. It seems to correlate with a push notification arriving right as the app opens. Offline mode users are also affected, not just those with active connections.
answer: Thank you for flagging this, and I'm sorry for the disruption to your team. Given the scale and the push notification correlation, we're escalating this internally as a priority incident and will check for a recent push service update that may be triggering the crash on launch. Can you send us two or three device models and OS versions from affected users so we can try to reproduce it directly, and we'll update you within a few hours.

subject: STILL no proper Jira integration docs after months of asking
body: I've asked twice now about linking our Jira instance to Northwind Integrations and every time I get pointed to a generic help page that doesn't even mention Jira, only Slack. We need issues created from our Northwind alerts to sync into Jira automatically for our retail ops team, and right now we're stuck copy-pasting everything manually. If this isn't something Northwind actually supports, just tell us plainly so we can look elsewhere before renewal.
answer: I understand the frustration and I apologize that the documentation didn't address your Jira use case directly. To clarify, native Jira linking isn't currently available in the Starter plan's Integrations catalog, though Slack is. I'm passing your request to our product team as a feature ask and will follow up with a clear yes or no on Jira support timing before your renewal date so you have the information you need to decide.

subject: Feedback on adding Jira alongside Slack integration
body: Our team relies heavily on Jira for tracking API and billing issues, and right now we only see Slack listed under Integrations for our Starter account. Is a Jira connector planned, and if so what's the rough timeline? We'd want two-way sync so comments in Jira tickets reflect back into Northwind, similar to how the Slack integration posts updates. Happy to be a beta tester if that helps prioritize it.
answer: Thanks for the detailed feedback, this is genuinely useful for our roadmap discussions. Jira is on our integrations shortlist alongside Salesforce, though we don't have a committed release date yet. I've added your account as an interested beta tester and will loop back once we have a target quarter to share, along with any early access opportunities.

subject: SDK throwing deprecated method errors after recent update
body: After updating to SDK version 4.2.0 last week, our webhook handler started throwing 'DeprecationWarning: fetchAsync() will be removed in v5.0' repeatedly in our logs, even though we haven't changed our integration code. This is affecting our logistics dashboard sync for all 235 seats since the errors seem to be silently dropping some webhook payloads. Can you confirm the migration path and whether there's a workaround before v5.0 ships?
answer: Thanks for reporting this promptly. The fetchAsync() deprecation is expected in 4.2.0, but it should only log a warning, not drop payloads, so the payload loss is unexpected and we're looking into it as a possible regression. As a workaround, please switch to fetchSync() with the retry wrapper described in our migration guide, and send us three or four sample webhook event IDs that failed so we can trace where the drops are happening.

subject: Transform stage failing across multiple pipelines since last night
body: Starting around 11pm last night, our nightly ETL run for the retail-inventory-sync pipeline has failed at the transform stage with 'Error: schema mismatch on field unit_cost, expected FLOAT got STRING' across three connectors: Shopify, NetSuite, and our internal warehouse feed. This is blocking inventory reconciliation for all 178 seats this morning and downstream dashboards are showing stale data from two days ago. We need this resolved urgently as our ops team can't trust current numbers.
answer: This is now our top priority and I've escalated it to the pipelines on-call engineer. The schema mismatch pattern across three connectors suggests an upstream source change rather than something on your configuration side, so we're pulling recent source schema logs from Shopify and NetSuite to confirm. We'll update you within the hour with either a fix or a temporary bypass so your dashboards can reflect current data while we resolve the root cause.

subject: Refund discrepancy on last invoice credit
body: We received a $45 usage credit on our September invoice for downtime last month, but our October invoice shows the credit was applied twice, once as a line item credit and once as a reduced base charge, netting us $90 off instead of $45. We have 4 seats on the Starter plan, so this is a small amount but I want to flag it before it causes reconciliation issues on our end. Invoice numbers are INV-88213 and INV-88401.
answer: Thanks for catching this and reporting the invoice numbers directly, that helps us track it down quickly. It looks like a billing system bug applied the credit twice during the plan renewal cycle, and we'll issue a correction on your next invoice to recover the extra $45, along with a note in your account history for your records. No action needed on your end, we'll confirm once the adjustment posts.

subject: Unsubscribe link broken, users still getting emails after opting out
body: Multiple users across our 293 seats have reported clicking 'unsubscribe' in our notification emails and continuing to receive the same alerts days later. I tested it myself yesterday on a shipment-alert notification and got another duplicate email this morning despite confirming the unsubscribe page loaded successfully. This is becoming a compliance concern for us given the volume of emails going out daily, so we need this fixed urgently.
answer: This is a serious issue and we're treating it as high priority given the compliance implications you've raised. We're checking whether unsubscribe preferences are failing to sync to the notification dispatch queue, which would explain the delay between opting out and emails stopping. Please send us the timestamp of your test unsubscribe click along with the email address used, and we'll trace it through the pipeline while we work on a fix for all affected accounts.

subject: SDK webhook signature verification failing on all inbound events
body: We're integrating the Northwind API Platform SDK v3.1 into our booking system and since this morning every inbound webhook event fails signature verification with 'InvalidSignatureError: HMAC mismatch' even though we haven't rotated our webhook secret. This is blocking all booking confirmations from syncing, roughly 400 events queued and growing. Our secret in the dashboard matches what we have configured in code, so I suspect something changed on the signing side.
answer: Thank you for the clear error detail, this is being escalated immediately given the volume of blocked events. We did roll out a signing algorithm update overnight that may have affected HMAC generation for accounts still on SDK v3.1, so please try upgrading to v3.1.2 which should resolve the mismatch. If events are still failing after the upgrade, send us two or three failed event IDs and we'll manually inspect the signature generation on our side.

subject: SAML login failing for finance team since this morning
body: Starting around 8am today, several of us on the finance team can no longer log in via SAML SSO, getting redirected back to the login page with 'SSO Error: assertion expired or invalid' after entering our credentials through our identity provider. This is affecting at least 6 people so far that I know of on our 195-seat Pro account, and MFA prompts never even appear before the error hits. Provisioning for a new hire also failed this morning, which seems related.
answer: Thanks for the report and the timeline, that helps narrow things down. An 'assertion expired or invalid' error combined with failed provisioning suggests a clock skew or certificate mismatch between your identity provider and our SSO service, possibly from a recent IdP metadata update on your end. Could you confirm if your IT team rotated any SAML certificates or metadata recently, and in the meantime we're checking our SSO logs for the affected login attempts to pinpoint the exact assertion issue.

subject: Transform failures on Data Pipelines connector since Tuesday
body:
We're seeing repeated transform failures on our fintech-ledger connector in Data Pipelines. Since Tuesday around 09:00 UTC, roughly 15% of runs fail at the aggregation stage with a generic 'transform step failed' error and no further detail in the run log. Latency on successful runs has also crept up from ~4 min to 12+ min per batch.

Can someone check connector ID conn-lm-4471 and let us know if this is related to a recent schema change on our end or an issue on the pipeline side? We have 66 seats relying on these reports for daily reconciliation.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report and the connector ID. We're pulling the run logs for conn-lm-4471 now to check whether the failures correlate with a schema drift on the source side or an internal processing issue on our end, and we'll also look into the latency increase separately since that could point to resource contention on the connector's queue. We'll follow up within a few hours with findings, and in the meantime you can retry failed batches manually without risk of duplication.

subject: Need to update IP allowlist but changes aren't saving
body:
I'm trying to add our new office IP range to the Admin Console allowlist so our finance team can keep accessing billing exports, but when I click Save the page just reloads and the old list is still shown. This is blocking three of our team members from logging in today since our previous range expired.

We checked the audit log and it shows an entry for the attempted change but no confirmation it applied. Can you confirm the correct steps or push this update from your side? We're on a 24-seat Starter plan.
answer: Sorry for the disruption this is causing your team's access today. This looks like the allowlist update isn't persisting correctly, which we're treating as a priority issue given it's blocking logins. Could you confirm the exact IP range you're trying to add and the workspace ID? In the meantime we can manually apply the range on our side to restore access while we investigate why the Save action isn't sticking in the console.

subject: Biometric login crashes app after latest update
body:
After the last mobile app update, biometric login (Face ID) is crashing the app for multiple users on our legal team as soon as they try to authenticate. It happens both online and offline, and push notifications for approvals stop arriving until the app is force-closed and reopened.

We've reproduced this on iOS 17.4 with app version 4.12.0 across at least 8 devices so far. This is affecting a large chunk of our 122 seats since biometric login is the default sign-in method. Can you escalate this as it's blocking daily case access?
answer: Thank you for flagging this with the version and device details, that's very helpful for reproducing it quickly. A crash on biometric authentication affecting this many users is being treated as a priority issue on our side, and we're pulling crash logs for app version 4.12.0 now. As a temporary workaround, please have affected users switch to PIN login from the app settings so they can regain access while we investigate the Face ID crash.

subject: Audit log missing entries for deactivated users
body:
We deactivated four users from the Admin Console last week as part of an offboarding batch, but the audit log only shows two of those deactivation events. This is a problem for us since Willow Legal needs a complete audit trail for compliance reviews, and we're on a 265-seat Pro plan where this kind of gap is a real risk.

The missing entries are for user accounts tied to our contracts team, deactivated on the 14th. Can you confirm whether this is a logging bug or a display issue, and whether the events can be backfilled?
answer: We understand how critical a complete audit trail is for your compliance reviews, so we're escalating this as a priority issue. Could you send us the account identifiers or usernames for the two missing deactivation events so we can check backend logs directly rather than the console view? We'll confirm whether this is a display gap or an actual logging miss, and if it's the former we'll work on getting those entries backfilled into the visible log.

subject: Dashboards showing broken/blank charts after sharing
body:
Since this morning, several dashboards we've shared with external partners are rendering as blank charts instead of the actual data. Internally the same dashboards load fine, but shared links show a spinning loader that never resolves. We've confirmed this on at least 6 dashboards across our travel operations team.

This is affecting our 80-seat workspace's ability to share performance reports with partners today, so we consider this urgent. Can you check if something changed with the sharing/rendering pipeline recently?
answer: Thanks for confirming this affects the shared view specifically rather than internal access, that narrows things down quickly. We're treating this as a priority incident and checking whether a recent change to the shared-link rendering service is causing the charts to fail loading. We'll update you shortly with either a fix or a workaround, and in the meantime internal team members can still export chart images directly to send to partners if needed.

subject: Getting duplicate email alerts for same invoice event
body:
I've noticed our finance team is receiving duplicate notification emails for the same invoice escalation event, usually two identical emails within a minute or two of each other. It's not urgent since the information is correct, just a bit confusing when triaging escalations for our media accounts.

Could you let me know if there's a setting we can adjust to prevent the duplicate sends, or if this is something on your end that needs fixing? Happy to share example timestamps if useful.
answer: Thanks for the heads-up, and no worries, this isn't causing any data issues so we'll look into it at a normal pace. Duplicate sends like this are sometimes caused by overlapping notification rules or a retry on the delivery side, so if you can share a couple of example timestamps and the invoice IDs involved, that will help us pinpoint the cause. We'll also check your notification rule configuration in the meantime for any obvious overlap.

subject: Fragen zu Webhook-Rate-Limits und veraltetem SDK-Aufruf
body:
Wir nutzen die API Platform für Webhooks zu unseren Zahlungsereignissen und bekommen seit kurzem vermehrt HTTP 429 Antworten, obwohl sich unser Traffic nicht wesentlich verändert hat. Zusätzlich zeigt unser SDK-Client eine Deprecation-Warnung für die Methode registerWebhookListener(), die wir aktuell noch verwenden.

Können Sie uns sagen, wie das aktuelle Rate-Limit für Webhook-Endpunkte bei unserem Plan aussieht und welche SDK-Methode wir stattdessen verwenden sollten? Wir wollen sicherstellen, dass wir rechtzeitig migrieren, bevor die alte Methode entfernt wird.
answer: Danke für die genaue Beschreibung. Die 429-Antworten deuten darauf hin, dass Sie aktuell nahe am Rate-Limit für Webhook-Endpunkte liegen, wir prüfen die genauen Werte für Ihren Workspace und melden uns mit den exakten Limits zurück. Zur SDK-Deprecation: registerWebhookListener() wird durch subscribeWebhook() ersetzt, die Migration ist unkompliziert und wir schicken Ihnen gerne ein Codebeispiel, damit der Umstieg vor dem Entfernen der alten Methode reibungslos verläuft.

subject: Requesting fix and better docs for pipeline transform errors
body:
Our data pipeline transforms have been failing intermittently for the past two weeks, roughly 1 in 5 runs on our billing-sync connector, with errors just labeled 'transform_error_generic'. We've tried adjusting field mappings based on the existing docs but the failures continue at a similar rate.

Given this is currently blocking our reconciliation reports and we're a small 22-seat team without dedicated engineering support, could you both investigate the root cause and consider adding clearer error messages or documentation for troubleshooting transform failures going forward?
answer: We're sorry for the ongoing disruption this is causing to your reconciliation process, and given the recurring failure rate we're escalating this as a priority investigation. You can set an idempotency key per alert using the alert's unique ID in the routing config, which will suppress duplicate sends within a configurable window. I'll flag this to our docs team since dedup behavior isn't currently called out clearly in the routing guide.

Would it be possible to add a configurable watermark or delay tolerance to the pipeline API so late records get automatically picked up in the next run instead of requiring manual retriggers?
answer: This is a reasonable ask and something we've heard from a few API integrators dealing with similar upstream delays. I'm logging this as a feature request for a configurable watermark parameter in the pipeline API, and I'll share it with our product team for prioritization. In the meantime, I can walk you through a scripted retrigger approach using our API that could reduce the manual overhead until a native solution is available.

subject: Datenverzug bei Sync blockiert Berichte für gesamtes Team
body:
Seit heute Morgen bemerken wir, dass Daten aus unserer Zahlungsverarbeitungs-Quelle mit erheblicher Verzögerung ankommen - teilweise erst 5 Stunden nach dem geplanten Sync-Fenster. Dadurch fehlen in unseren aktuellen Berichten wichtige Transaktionen und unser gesamtes Team von 18 Nutzern kann die Tagesabschlüsse nicht verlässlich erstellen.

Das betrifft alle unsere Pipelines seit heute 06:00 Uhr und wir brauchen dringend eine Einschätzung, ob es sich um ein bekanntes Problem mit dem Connector handelt.
answer: Vielen Dank für die schnelle Meldung - eine Verzögerung von mehreren Stunden bei allen Pipelines ist ernst und wir behandeln dies als vorrangigen Vorfall. Unser Team prüft gerade den Status des Zahlungsverarbeitungs-Connectors sowie mögliche Engpässe seit 06:00 Uhr, und wir melden uns innerhalb der nächsten Stunde mit einem Zwischenstand sowie einem geschätzten Zeitplan für die Behebung.

subject: Need to change alert routing rules before rollout tomorrow
body:
We're rolling out a reorganized on-call structure tomorrow morning and need to update our alert routing rules in Notifications so that billing alerts go to the finance ops group instead of the current engineering group, and infrastructure alerts get split between two new subteams instead of one catch-all channel. With 268 seats across multiple departments, getting this wrong could mean critical alerts get missed or duplicated.

Can someone confirm the correct way to update routing rules without triggering duplicate notifications during the transition, and is there documentation on best practices for large org routing changes?
answer: Given the scale of your org and the timing before tomorrow's rollout, I want to make sure this goes smoothly. I'm sending over our documentation on routing rule changes for large organizations, which includes a recommended staged approach to avoid duplicate alerts during transitions. I'd also like to schedule a quick call today if possible so we can review your specific routing changes together before you go live.

subject: URGENT: Cannot deactivate terminated employee's account - active session still logged in
body:
We terminated an employee this morning and need to immediately deactivate their account in the Admin Console, but the deactivation button just spins and returns 'Error: unable to update user status' every time. Their session appears to still be active according to the audit log and I'm worried about continued access to sensitive systems given our small team of only 3 seats.

This is a security concern and I need this resolved right now - please advise on any way to force logout or deactivate this account immediately.
answer: I understand the urgency here and we're treating this as a critical security matter. As an immediate step, I'm forcing a session termination for that user account from our backend right now to cut off any active access while we resolve the deactivation error, and I'll confirm within the next few minutes once that's done. Our admin console team is investigating the 'unable to update user status' error simultaneously so we can complete the full deactivation and update the audit log accordingly.

subject: URGENT: Deactivated users can still log in - HIPAA exposure
body: We deactivated 6 former contractors from Admin Console this morning at 8:40am after their offboarding, but two of them (IDs u_2291 and u_2304) were able to authenticate into the patient records dashboard at 9:15am. The audit log shows the deactivation event succeeded, but access wasn't actually revoked. This is a healthcare compliance issue for us and we need it fixed immediately - we may have to report this as a breach if it's not resolved within the hour.
answer: I understand the severity here and have escalated this to our Security and Compliance on-call team as a P0 incident right now. We're pulling session logs for u_2291 and u_2304 to force-terminate any active tokens immediately while we investigate why the deactivation flag isn't propagating to the auth layer. I'll update you within 30 minutes with findings and confirmation that access has been fully revoked.

subject: SAML login intermittently failing for some users after IdP update
body: Since we updated our Okta IdP configuration last Tuesday, roughly 10-15 of our 174 users are getting an 'Invalid SAML Response' error when logging into Northwind. It seems to affect users in specific groups but not others - I've checked group mappings against our provisioning docs and they look correct. MFA-enabled accounts seem more likely to hit this. Can someone check our SSO configuration on your end for Granite Robotics?
answer: Thanks for the details - this pattern (MFA users specifically affected) suggests a possible clock skew or assertion timing issue between Okta and our SAML endpoint. I'm pulling the SSO logs for Granite Robotics now to check the failed assertions and will compare against your IdP metadata. I'll follow up today with specifics on which attribute or timestamp is causing the rejection.

subject: Question about unused credits after downgrading seats
body: We reduced our seat count from 20 to 14 last month and I noticed our invoice from March still shows a credit balance of $42.50 that hasn't been applied. I'm trying to reconcile our billing report for Quill Media and want to understand how credits get applied - is it automatic on the next invoice or do we need to request it? Also wondering if partial-month refunds apply when seats are removed mid-cycle.
answer: Great question - credits are applied automatically to your next invoice cycle, so the $42.50 should show up on your upcoming April bill rather than as an immediate refund. For seat reductions mid-cycle, we prorate the difference but don't issue cash refunds unless specifically requested within 14 days of the change. I can also send you a breakdown of exactly how that credit was calculated if that's helpful.

subject: Shared dashboards showing wrong data to viewer role users
body: We have 8 seats total and shared our patient volume dashboard with two viewer-role team members last week. Both are reporting they see stale data from two weeks ago even though the dashboard refreshes fine for editors. I've tried re-sharing the dashboard and removing/re-adding their permissions but the issue persists. This is blocking our weekly ops review meeting today.
answer: This sounds like a caching issue tied to viewer-role permission scoping rather than the refresh itself - I'm escalating this to our Product Support engineering team now given the impact on your meeting today. In the meantime, can you have the affected viewers try accessing the dashboard in an incognito window to rule out a stale local cache? I'll update you within the hour with root cause.

subject: Duplicate email digests being sent to same recipients
body: We're integrating the Notifications API and configured a daily digest job for our 242 users, but starting March 3rd several recipients report getting two identical digest emails within minutes of each other. Our API logs show only one POST to /v1/digests/send per user per day, so the duplication seems to be happening on Northwind's side. Can you check if there's a retry or delivery bug on your notification queue?
answer: Thanks for confirming your API logs only show single calls - that points to our delivery layer rather than your integration. We've seen a similar pattern related to a queue retry misfire when digest jobs take longer than 5 seconds to process. I'm escalating this to our alerting infrastructure team and will report back with confirmation once we identify whether retries are firing prematurely on your account.

subject: Scheduled sync jobs running hours late
body: Our nightly data pipeline sync from our POS connector is supposed to run at 2am but for the past four nights it's been completing anywhere from 6am to 9am instead. We only have 3 seats so this is easy to monitor closely, and I've confirmed our connector credentials haven't changed. The delay is pushing back our morning inventory reports and I'd like to understand if this is a queue backlog on Northwind's side.
answer: Thanks for flagging this with specific timestamps, that's helpful for diagnosis. We're checking whether your sync job is being queued behind larger jobs during a busy processing window - this can happen on shared infrastructure during peak load. I'll dig into the scheduler logs for your connector today and let you know if we need to move your job to a dedicated time slot.

subject: alerts
body: Alerts routing to wrong channel since yesterday.
answer: Sorry for the disruption - can you confirm which alert type and destination channel you configured, and whether this started after any recent changes to your routing rules? I'll check our alert routing logs for your account in the meantime to see if there's a misconfiguration or a bug on our end.

subject: Request for guidance on recurring SDK error in Python client
body: Our team keeps hitting a 'RateLimitExceeded' error using the Python SDK even though we're well under our documented request quota of 1000/hour - we're averaging about 300 calls/hour based on our own logging. This has happened three times this week. I'd like to request either a review of our account's actual rate limit settings or updated documentation clarifying how limits are calculated, since our usage doesn't match what we're seeing.
answer: Thanks for the detailed usage numbers - that discrepancy is worth investigating properly. I'm requesting a review of your account's API rate limit configuration to confirm it matches your Starter plan allocation, and will also check if burst limits (rather than hourly averages) might be triggering this. I'll follow up within two business days with findings and, if needed, documentation clarifications.

subject: How to properly deactivate users without losing audit history
body: I need to deactivate 3 former staff accounts in Admin Console but want to make sure their historical actions remain visible in our audit log for compliance reporting - we're in education and need records retained for at least a year. When I tested deactivating a test account last week, it seemed to remove that user's entries from the audit log view entirely. Can you confirm the correct process so we don't lose data on the real deactivations?
answer: Good question, and I understand the concern given your retention requirements. Deactivating a user should not remove their historical audit log entries - they should still appear when filtering by that user ID, though the user will no longer show in the active allowlist. If your test showed entries disappearing entirely, that's unexpected behavior and I'd like to look into your account's audit log settings before you proceed with the real deactivations.

subject: Request to add Slack and Jira as integration options alongside Zapier
body: We're currently using the Zapier integration to connect Northwind events to our workflows, but we'd like to explore native Slack and Jira integrations instead since Zapier adds an extra hop and occasional delay. Is there a roadmap for direct Slack/Jira connectors, or is Zapier the only supported path for triggering actions in those tools from Northwind events right now?
answer: Thanks for the feedback - native Slack and Jira integrations are on our roadmap but not yet available, so Zapier remains the supported path for now. I'll log this as a feature request tied to your account and let you know if there's an update on timing. In the meantime, happy to help optimize your current Zapier setup if the delay is causing issues.

subject: Plan upgrade failed mid-transaction, seats not applied and duplicate invoice generated
body: We initiated an upgrade from our current tier to the next tier this morning to add seats ahead of our regional rollout at Summit Foods. The upgrade wizard showed a spinning loader for about 4 minutes then errored with 'Transaction could not be completed - Ref: PLU-88213'. Our seat count still shows the old number, but we were charged twice on the card ending 4471 according to our finance team. We need this resolved today since we have 40 new store managers waiting on access.
answer: I'm sorry for the disruption this is causing during your rollout. I've escalated this to our billing engineering team with reference PLU-88213 - this looks like a known race condition between the seat provisioning service and the payment capture step. We're issuing an immediate refund for the duplicate charge and will manually apply the seat increase within the next hour so your store managers aren't blocked; I'll update you on this ticket as soon as it's confirmed.

subject: Question about push notification delivery delay on Android
body: One of our team members using the Northwind mobile app on an Android device mentioned that push notifications for approval requests sometimes arrive 10-15 minutes late. This isn't blocking work but we'd like to understand if there's a known delay on the Android side or a setting we should adjust on our end. We only have 22 seats so it's easy for us to test further if you need more detail.
answer: Thanks for flagging this - a short delay on Android push delivery can happen when the device enters battery optimization or Doze mode, which throttles background notification handling. Could you ask the affected team member to check that the Northwind app is excluded from battery optimization in their Android settings? If the delay continues after that change, let us know the device model and OS version and we'll dig into delivery logs on our end.

subject: Request to disable Face ID prompt after app returns from background
body: I've noticed that when the Northwind mobile app is backgrounded for even a few seconds and then reopened, it prompts for Face ID again, which is a bit disruptive during testing sessions. We'd like to request an option to extend the biometric session timeout, or at least surface a setting so we can configure it ourselves rather than re-authenticating so frequently.
answer: Thanks for the detailed feedback - this is a common request and we agree the current fixed timeout is aggressive for active testing sessions. I'll log this as a feature request with our mobile team to add a configurable biometric session timeout. In the meantime there isn't a workaround on our side, but I'll follow up here once we have a timeline for this being added to the roadmap.

subject: slack alerts down
body: slack intergration stoped workin since this am, no alerts comming thru at all for anyone, we rely on this for shipment delays pls help asap
answer: Thanks for the quick report - I understand how critical Slack alerts are for tracking shipment delays. We're investigating on a priority basis right now; can you confirm if you've made any recent changes to your Slack app permissions or the connected workspace? While we check the integration health on our end, please also verify the webhook status under Integrations > Slack in your admin console, and I'll update you within the hour.

subject: Storage retention question and urgent quota issue
body:
I wanted to give some background first - we've been using Northwind Storage since we onboarded last spring for archiving student assessment records, and we recently reviewed our documentation to understand default retention periods before our annual compliance audit. Our IT coordinator was going through the retention policy settings page and noticed the documentation doesn't clearly state what happens to files after the retention period expires versus what happens when we simply hit our storage quota.

The actual problem is that as of this morning uploads are failing with 'Quota exceeded' even though our dashboard shows we're only at 78% of our allotted quota, and we need to upload final semester records before end of day for the audit.
answer: Thank you for the detailed context, and I'm sorry this is coming up right before your audit deadline. The quota discrepancy you're seeing is likely due to a caching delay in the usage dashboard rather than an actual quota breach - I'm checking your account's real-time storage consumption now and will confirm the exact figure shortly. I'll also make sure our documentation team clarifies the retention-versus-quota behavior distinction you raised, and I'll prioritize getting your uploads unblocked before end of day.

subject: PDF export cutting off chart legends on multi-series dashboards
body: When exporting our quarterly revenue dashboard to PDF, any chart with more than 5 series in the legend gets cut off at the right edge of the page. This happens consistently across our 'Regional Performance' and 'Fleet Utilization' dashboards. We need to share these with our board next week, so it would help to know if there's a formatting workaround or if this is a known export bug.
answer: Thanks for the clear description - this is a known rendering issue with legend overflow on landscape PDF exports when there are more than 5 series, and our dashboards team is aware of it. As a workaround for your board deck, try switching the export orientation to landscape under Export Settings and reducing the legend font size slightly, which should keep everything within the page bounds. I'll also flag your account so you're notified when the underlying fix ships.

subject: Students unable to unsubscribe from weekly digest emails
body: Several of our instructors have reported that clicking 'unsubscribe' at the bottom of the weekly digest email leads to an error page saying 'Link expired or invalid', even on emails received today. This is now generating complaints because staff keep receiving digests for courses they've already left. We have only 8 seats total but this affects every one of them.
answer: I'm sorry for the trouble this is causing your instructors - an unsubscribe link failing immediately after send indicates a token generation issue on our end, and I'm treating this as high priority given it affects your whole team. I'm escalating to our notifications engineering team right now to identify why the token is being marked expired, and I'll follow up with a fix or manual unsubscribe on your account within the next few hours.

subject: Billing is charging us for seats we removed weeks ago - this is unacceptable
body: We removed 40 seats from our Willow Legal account back on March 3rd and confirmed the change in the admin panel, yet our invoice this month still bills for the full 265 seats. This is the second time in three months this has happened and no one has given us a straight answer. We are seriously considering canceling our contract if this isn't fixed and refunded properly this time.
answer: I completely understand your frustration, especially given this has happened before, and I want to get this corrected properly rather than just patching it again. I'm pulling up your seat change history now to confirm the March 3rd removal and will issue a credit for the overcharged seats on this invoice immediately once verified. I'm also flagging this account internally so we can identify why seat removals aren't syncing to billing and prevent a third occurrence.

subject: Feature request: alerting on late-arriving data in pipelines
body: We've noticed our nightly billing data connector occasionally delivers records 2-3 hours after the expected window, which throws off our end-of-day reconciliation reports. It would be helpful to have a configurable alert that fires when a scheduled pipeline run hasn't completed within a set time threshold, rather than us having to manually check the pipeline status page each morning.
answer: Thanks for the suggestion - this is a reasonable gap and we've had similar requests from a few other customers using scheduled connectors. I'm logging this as a feature request for a configurable SLA-based alert on pipeline completion times, and I'll link your account to the request so you're notified if it gets prioritized. In the meantime, you can set up a basic workaround using our webhook on pipeline status changes if that would help reduce manual checks.

subject: Duplicate email alerts being sent for every notification event
body: Since yesterday we've been receiving every notification email twice, sometimes within seconds of each other, across all alert types including payment failures and API error alerts. I checked our notification rules under Settings > Alerting and there's only one rule configured per event type, so this doesn't seem to be a configuration issue on our side. Log entry: event_id=ntf_7734f1, sent_at=2 timestamps 4 seconds apart, both status=delivered.
answer: Thanks for including the event ID and timestamps - that's very helpful for tracing this. A duplicate delivery within seconds of each other on the same event ID points to a retry being triggered incorrectly on our notification dispatch service rather than a rule misconfiguration on your end. I'm escalating this now as it's affecting all your alert types, and I'll update you once we've identified whether this is isolated to your account or a broader dispatch issue.

subject: Request to add allowlist feature for workspace settings
body: We're setting up our workspace for the legal team at Delta Energy and noticed the Admin Console doesn't let us restrict login to specific IP ranges. We'd like to request an IP allowlist option under workspace settings, similar to what we saw mentioned in the audit log documentation. Also, when we deactivate a user, the audit log entry doesn't show who performed the deactivation, only the timestamp. Could this be improved or is there a workaround?
answer: Thanks for the detailed feedback. IP allowlisting for workspace-level access isn't available yet, but I've logged this as a feature request with our product team and will update you when there's movement on it. Regarding the audit log, the actor field should populate for deactivation events — I'll check with engineering whether this is a display gap in your workspace and follow up shortly.

subject: SSO role mapping broken after IdP update - users getting wrong permissions
body: After we updated our identity provider's group attributes last night, role mapping in Identity and SSO stopped assigning the correct permissions to about 180 of our 255 users. Everyone is landing in the default viewer role instead of their mapped group (Ops, Finance, Admin). MFA still works fine, provisioning of new accounts succeeds, but the role assignment step seems to ignore the group claim entirely. This is blocking most of our logistics team from accessing their dashboards this morning.
answer: This is impacting a large portion of your workforce so we're treating it as high priority. It sounds like the group claim name or format may have changed on the IdP side and our role mapping rules no longer match — can you confirm the exact attribute name being sent in the SAML/OIDC assertion now versus before the update? In the meantime we're reviewing your tenant's mapping configuration on our end and will reach out within the hour with findings.

subject: Email digest frequency options and duplicate sends
body: A few of our managers at Delta Works have reported getting the same weekly notification digest twice on Mondays, once around 6am and again around 9am. Separately, we'd like to request an option to set digests to daily instead of weekly for certain teams since 303 seats across manufacturing shifts means weekly summaries are too sparse for some groups. Can you look into the duplicate sends and let us know if daily digest frequency is on the roadmap?
answer: Thanks for flagging both issues. The duplicate digest is likely caused by overlapping scheduled jobs on our side after a recent deploy — we're investigating and will confirm a fix timeline shortly. On the frequency request, daily digests aren't currently configurable but I'm passing this along as a feature request since it's a reasonable use case for shift-based teams.

subject: frage
body: Ich versuche, ein Backup von letzter Woche fuer unseren Storage-Bereich wiederherzustellen, aber der Wiederherstellungsvorgang bricht nach etwa 40% mit einer Quota-Fehlermeldung ab. Wir haben nur 13 Sitzplaetze im Starter-Plan, daher verstehe ich nicht, warum wir an ein Speicherlimit stossen, obwohl wir vorher problemlos hochladen konnten. Koennt ihr pruefen, ob das Retention-Limit oder die Upload-Quota das Problem verursacht?
answer: Danke fuer die Meldung. Der Quota-Fehler beim Restore deutet darauf hin, dass die wiederherzustellenden Daten temporaer zusaetzlichen Speicherplatz benoetigen, der Ihr aktuelles Starter-Kontingent uebersteigt. Wir pruefen jetzt Ihr Konto und die Backup-Groesse und melden uns mit einer Einschaetzung, ob eine temporaere Erhoehung der Quota fuer den Restore-Vorgang moeglich ist.

subject: Freigabeberechtigungen im Dashboard funktionieren nicht korrekt
body: Seit gestern koennen mehrere Teammitglieder freigegebene Dashboards nicht mehr oeffnen, obwohl die Freigabe laut Einstellungen aktiv ist. Bei einem Chart mit Patientendaten-Auswertung erhalten Nutzer die Meldung 'Zugriff verweigert', obwohl sie in der Freigabeliste stehen. Das betrifft mindestens drei Dashboards in unserem Enterprise-Workspace mit 1371 Sitzplaetzen. Koennt ihr das bitte pruefen, da unser Team dringend auf diese Auswertungen zugreifen muss?
answer: Vielen Dank fuer die genaue Beschreibung. Das klingt nach einem Problem mit der Synchronisierung der Freigabeberechtigungen nach einer aktuellen Aenderung an Ihren Nutzergruppen. Wir schauen uns die betroffenen Dashboards jetzt genauer an und melden uns zeitnah mit einem Zwischenstand, da dies mehrere Nutzer in Ihrem Workspace betrifft.

subject: Retention policy not applying to older backups
body: We set our storage retention policy to 90 days last month, but I'm still seeing backup snapshots in our account from 150+ days ago that haven't been purged. This is a compliance concern for our logistics operations since we need to demonstrate that data older than the retention window is actually deleted. Can you confirm whether the retention setting only applies going forward or should it also clean up existing older backups?
answer: Good catch, and thank you for raising this from a compliance angle. Retention policies should apply retroactively to existing backups, not just new ones, so what you're seeing suggests the cleanup job may not have run correctly for your account. We're checking the backend job logs for your workspace now and will let you know what we find and when the older snapshots will be purged.

subject: URGENT: Admin Console down, cannot access workspace settings at all
body: Our entire Admin Console is unreachable since about 15 minutes ago — every attempt to load workspace settings returns a blank white screen or a 500 error. We were in the middle of deactivating several offboarded employees and now we can't tell if those deactivations went through. With 243 seats and an active audit underway, we need this restored immediately as this is blocking critical access management work.
answer: We understand the urgency and are escalating this immediately as a full outage of the Admin Console. We'll keep you updated every 15 minutes until service is restored.

subject: How do I restore a specific file version from backup?
body: I need to restore a single file that was accidentally overwritten two days ago rather than doing a full account restore. Our retention window is set to 30 days so I believe the older version should still exist, but I can't find documentation on restoring individual files versus entire backup sets. Could you point me to the right steps or documentation for a selective restore in Storage?
answer: Selective file restore is supported — you can browse backup snapshots by date under the Storage restore panel and select individual files rather than the full set. I'll send over the documentation link that walks through this step by step, and let me know if the file doesn't appear in the snapshot list so we can check the retention window on our end.

subject: Multiple dashboard charts showing blank or broken after latest update
body: Since yesterday's platform update, several charts across our shared dashboards are rendering as blank white boxes instead of the expected bar and line charts. This is affecting dashboards used across multiple teams at Blue Labs, roughly 1258 seats company-wide, and sharing links to affected dashboards still show the broken charts to recipients. Browser console shows a repeated error: 'ChartRenderError: dataset undefined' for the affected widgets.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report and the console error, that's very helpful. This matches an issue we're tracking after yesterday's release related to chart data binding on certain widget types — we're prioritizing a fix given the number of affected dashboards. I'll update this ticket as soon as we have a patch deployed or a workaround for re-rendering the broken charts.

subject: issue
body: Our storage retention is set to 60 days but backups from over 90 days ago are still visible and counting against our quota. This is starting to affect upload performance since we're near our storage limit and can't upload new backups until space frees up. Can someone check why older backups aren't being cleaned up automatically?
answer: Thank you for reporting this. We're seeing that the retention cleanup job for your account may have stalled, which would explain both the older backups persisting and the quota pressure affecting new uploads. We're investigating the job status now and will manually trigger cleanup if needed to free up space while we identify the root cause.

subject: app keeps crashin on launch after update
body: hey we intergrating your API into our internal tool and since the last mobile app update (v4.2) the app crashes immediatly on launch for like half our test devices. happens right after the splash screen, before login even loads. we got 5 seats total and 3 of them cant get in at all now. this is blockin our rollout, can someone look into this asap? no error shown on screen just closes.
