subject: Session timeout duration question
body: We've noticed that user sessions across our SSO integration are timing out after roughly 45 minutes of inactivity, which is shorter than we'd like given how our legal teams work through long documents without much clicking. Is this timeout configurable at the workspace level, or is it a fixed platform setting? We'd like to extend it if possible, maybe to 2 hours.
answer: The session timeout is configurable at the workspace level under Identity Settings > Session Policy, and Pro plan accounts can set inactivity timeouts anywhere from 15 minutes up to 4 hours. I'd recommend testing with a modest increase first and monitoring for any conflicts with your MFA re-prompt settings, since those are tied to the same session token. Let us know if you'd like help adjusting the specific policy for your organization.

subject: Upgrade to next tier not reflecting correct seat pricing
body: We initiated an upgrade from our current Pro plan to add more seats last week (currently at 86 seats, requested to move to 110), but the invoice we received this morning still shows the old per-seat rate applied to only 86 seats, not the new count. Our finance team needs this corrected before the billing cycle closes on the 30th so we can reconcile properly.
answer: Thanks for catching this before the cycle closes — I can see the upgrade request went through in our system but the invoice generation ran before the seat count update propagated fully. I'm escalating this to billing operations now to issue a corrected invoice reflecting the 110 seats, and we'll have it to you within 1-2 business days, well ahead of the 30th deadline.

subject: quick question
body:
So we've been using Northwind for about eight months now across our retail operations team, and overall the platform has been solid for managing our workspace access and API workflows. Our team has slowly been expanding usage of the Integrations module to connect various internal tools as we scale up our retail vendor management processes.

The actual issue is with our Salesforce sync — records are syncing but there's a noticeable lag, sometimes 20-30 minutes, between when a record updates in Salesforce and when it reflects in Northwind. We also can't find documentation on the expected sync interval or how to configure it. Could you point us to that, or let us know if this delay is normal?
answer: Thanks for the detailed context. A 20-30 minute sync lag is longer than expected — our standard Salesforce sync interval runs every 5 minutes for Pro plan accounts. This could be related to batch size or an API rate limit being hit on the Salesforce side. I've linked our sync configuration docs below, and I'd also like to pull your integration logs to check for throttling errors; can you confirm the connected Salesforce org ID so I can investigate further?

subject: Salesforce sync failing with duplicate record errors
body: Our Salesforce integration has started throwing duplicate record errors during sync as of this morning around 6am. The sync job logs show error code SF_DUP_409 for roughly 340 records, all tied to our logistics account objects. This is affecting our operations team's visibility into shipment status updates since the records aren't reconciling correctly. We opened a Jira ticket internally (LOG-4471) to track impact on our side.
answer: Thank you for the detailed report and the Jira reference. The SF_DUP_409 error typically indicates a mismatch in the external ID mapping used for deduplication during sync — this can happen if a recent Salesforce field change altered the unique identifier field. We're pulling the sync logs for your account now to confirm root cause and will update you within a few hours with either a fix or a workaround to unblock the affected records.

subject: Request to document Salesforce sync field mapping for finance review
body: Our finance team is doing an internal audit of how customer billing data flows between Salesforce and Northwind, and we need clear documentation of which fields sync automatically versus which require manual mapping. Could you share the current field mapping reference, and let us know if there's a way to export a change log of sync configuration updates for compliance purposes?
answer: Happy to help with your audit. I've attached our current Salesforce field mapping guide, which covers both auto-synced fields and the ones requiring manual configuration. For the change log, workspace admins can export a configuration history from Integrations > Salesforce > Settings > Audit Log, which includes timestamps and the user who made each change — that should give your finance team what they need for compliance documentation.

subject: Duplicate alerts being sent to wrong escalation channel
body: We've noticed that some of our critical billing alerts are being duplicated and routed to both our primary Slack escalation channel and a secondary one that should only get informational notices. This has been happening intermittently over the past week, roughly 8-10 duplicate sends. It's not urgent but it's cluttering the channel and causing confusion about which alerts actually need action.
answer: Thanks for reporting this — duplicate routing to the wrong channel usually points to overlapping alert rules in the routing configuration. Can you share the names of the two channels involved and roughly when the duplicates started? I'll check your notification rules for any conditions that might be matching both the primary and secondary routes simultaneously and get this cleaned up.

subject: Offline mode not syncing data after reconnect, urgent for field team
body: Our field analysts use the mobile app offline mode extensively while at manufacturing sites with poor connectivity, and starting this week the app is not syncing captured data once the device reconnects to the network. Data entered offline just seems to vanish instead of uploading. We have people actively in the field right now who need this working. Can we get help today?
answer: I understand the urgency given your team is actively in the field — we're escalating this as a priority issue right now. Could you confirm the app version and whether the data disappears immediately or after some time post-reconnect? While we investigate, please advise your field team not to clear the app cache or reinstall, as the offline data may still be recoverable locally, and we don't want to risk losing it before we can pull diagnostics.

subject: Need to change alert routing setup before next release
body:
Our team has been using Northwind's notification system for a few months now to manage internal alerting across our energy monitoring products, and things have generally worked fine for our small team. We're planning a product change next sprint that will introduce a few new alert types.

The actual request is that we need to update our alert routing rules so that these new alert types go to a new dedicated channel instead of the default one, and we also noticed some duplicate alerts firing when routing rules overlap. Could you help us set up the new routing and clean up the duplicates?
answer: Thanks for the heads up on the upcoming release. To set up routing for the new alert types, you'll want to create a new rule under Notifications > Routing Rules and specify the alert type conditions before assigning the destination channel — I can walk you through this on a quick call if helpful. Regarding the duplicates, this is often caused by two rules matching the same alert type; if you can share your current rule list, I'll help identify the overlap and clean it up before your sprint launches.

subject: Clarifying dashboard sharing permission levels
body: As we roll out more dashboards across our manufacturing teams, I want to make sure we're setting sharing permissions correctly. Currently it seems like anyone with a link can view a shared dashboard regardless of workspace membership, which isn't quite what we expected. Could you clarify how view versus edit permissions work when sharing, and whether we can restrict access to workspace members only?
answer: Good question, and this is a common point of confusion. By default, dashboard sharing links use 'anyone with the link can view' unless you switch to 'restricted' sharing under the dashboard's Share settings, which limits access to specified workspace members only. Edit permissions are separate and must be granted explicitly per user or group — I'd recommend switching your key dashboards to restricted sharing if you want tighter control, and I'm happy to walk through the settings with you if needed.

subject: P0: SSO role mapping broken, thousands of staff locked into wrong access levels
body:
Since this morning's IdP metadata refresh, our SSO role mapping is assigning every user the default 'Viewer' role regardless of their actual group membership in Azure AD. We have 3256 seats and clinical staff cannot access patient scheduling modules they need right now. This started around 8:10am ET after we rotated our SAML certificate per your renewal notice. Group claims are still showing correctly in the SAML assertion but Northwind is not honoring the role_mapping rules we configured under SSO settings.

This is affecting our entire workforce across all facilities. We need this escalated immediately as clinical operations are impacted.
answer:
This has been escalated to our identity on-call team as a P0 - I understand the clinical impact and we're treating this as top priority. Initial check shows the certificate rotation may have invalidated the cached attribute mapping table; we're pushing a forced re-sync of your SSO role mapping configuration now and will confirm within 30 minutes whether roles are restoring correctly.

In the meantime, if you need immediate stopgap access for critical staff, we can issue temporary direct-login credentials outside SSO - let us know if you'd like us to set that up while we resolve the mapping issue.

subject: Getting 429s constantly since yesterday - rate limit changed?
body:
We're on the Starter plan and our integration has been hitting 429 Too Many Requests errors since yesterday afternoon, roughly starting at 2pm. Our webhook retry logic is now flooding our own queue because Northwind's API is rejecting nearly 40% of calls. We're only making about 200 requests per minute, which worked fine last week.

Did the rate limit tier change for Starter plans? Our legal document processing pipeline for 15 users is now stalled and we have court filing deadlines this week. Please advise if this is a policy change or an incident on your end.
answer:
Thanks for flagging this - we did roll out a reduced default rate limit for Starter-tier API keys as part of a platform change last week, dropping the burst allowance which is likely why you're now seeing 429s at request volumes that worked before. This wasn't communicated clearly enough on our end and I apologize for the disruption to your filing deadlines.

As an immediate fix, I'm applying a temporary rate limit override to your account to restore your previous throughput while we sort out a longer-term plan adjustment. You should see 429 errors drop within a few minutes - please let us know if they persist.

subject: URGENT - all transform jobs failing, pipeline down since 6am
body:
Every transform job in our data pipeline has been failing since approximately 6:00am today. We're getting error code TRANSFORM_EXEC_FAILED on all 8 of our scheduled jobs, including the daily revenue reconciliation feed that finance depends on for our media reporting close. No records have processed in over 5 hours.

This is a Starter plan account with 12 seats but this pipeline is business-critical for our month-end close happening this week. We have not changed any connector configs or transform logic recently. Please treat this as urgent - we may be looking at incomplete financial data if this isn't resolved today.
answer:
I've escalated this to our data pipelines on-call engineer as a P0 given the finance close impact. We're pulling logs for your account now to identify why TRANSFORM_EXEC_FAILED is triggering across all 8 jobs simultaneously - this pattern suggests a shared dependency or connector issue rather than individual job problems.

We'll have an initial diagnosis within the hour and will keep you updated continuously until resolved. If we identify any risk of data loss versus just delay, we'll flag that to you immediately.

subject: Duplicate email alerts going out to clients
body:
Our notification setup is sending duplicate alerts - clients are receiving the same billing reminder email twice within a few minutes of each other. I've confirmed this happening on at least 6 separate client accounts over the past two days, checked timestamps in the delivery log and they're identical content, just sent 3-4 minutes apart.

We only have one alert rule configured for this template so I'm not sure why it's firing twice. Can you help identify if this is a configuration issue on our end or something with the notification queue itself?
answer:
Thanks for the detailed timestamps - that's helpful. Duplicate sends within a short window like that often point to a retry being triggered because the original send was marked as slow-acknowledged rather than a true duplicate rule firing, but I want to check your account's delivery logs directly to confirm.

Can you send me the notification IDs for two or three of the affected duplicate pairs? Once I have those I can trace exactly what triggered the second send and get you a fix or workaround today.

subject: Scheduled syncs falling hours behind, data quality issues downstream
body:
Our nightly scheduled syncs for the case management connector have been running 3-4 hours late for the past three days, and when they do complete we're seeing missing records - yesterday's sync brought in 1,842 records when we normally get around 2,600. This is affecting reporting accuracy for our energy sector clients who rely on same-day data.

We checked the connector status page and it shows green, so this doesn't appear to be a known outage. We have 14 seats on Starter and need this escalated since it's now three consecutive days of degraded syncs with no resolution.
answer:
I'm escalating this to our data pipelines team given three consecutive days of degradation - that's beyond what we'd expect for a transient issue. The record count discrepancy alongside the delay suggests the sync may be timing out partway through rather than just running slow, which would explain both symptoms.

We're pulling the sync execution logs for the last three runs now to pinpoint where it's stalling. I'll follow up within a few hours with findings, and if we confirm a connector-side issue we'll prioritize a fix given the reporting impact you've described.

subject: Recurring sync inconsistencies - need guidance on scheduling and connector setup
body:
We've noticed our scheduled syncs across three retail data connectors are producing inconsistent row counts week over week, sometimes varying by as much as 8-10% with no clear pattern. This isn't a total failure, syncs complete successfully, but the data quality variance is causing headaches for our downstream reporting team who manage reconciliation across 4872 seats company-wide.

We'd like to understand best practices for connector configuration and sync frequency to reduce this variance, and whether there's a way to get alerts when row counts deviate significantly from historical averages. Also curious if there's documentation on how the sync engine handles partial failures.
answer:
This is a great question and something we can definitely help tune. Row count variance in the 8-10% range without outright failures usually points to either upstream source pagination timing or partial-page retries during the sync window - both are addressable through connector configuration.

I'll send over our connector tuning guide which covers recommended sync windows and retry settings, and I'll also loop in a solutions engineer to review your specific connector configs. On the alerting front, we do support threshold-based sync alerts for row count deviation - I'll include setup steps in my follow-up.

subject: CRITICAL: scheduled sync deleted records instead of updating, data loss
body:
Our scheduled sync that runs every night at 1am appears to have deleted approximately 3,400 student records instead of updating them during last night's run. We noticed this morning when our enrollment dashboard showed a massive drop in active records - our historical baseline is around 9,800 and it's now showing 6,400.

We have not touched the sync configuration recently and this has never happened in the 4 months we've used this pipeline. We are a small team (12 seats) but this data loss is severe for an education platform and we need immediate help recovering these records if at all possible.
answer:
I've flagged this as a P0 incident and looped in our data recovery team immediately given the scale of data loss described. Please stop any further scheduled or manual sync runs on this pipeline right now if you haven't already, to prevent additional overwrites while we investigate.

We're checking whether we have a pre-sync snapshot or backup from before last night's run that we can restore from - this is our first priority. I'll update you within the hour with what we find and next steps for recovery.

subject: charts not loading right need help asap-ish
body:
hey so basicaly we've been using the dashbord for tracking our shipment volums across teh logistics network for a while now and its been working fine, we recently added a couple new data sources last month for the west coast routes and everything seemed ok at first.

the actual problem is now like 3 of our charts (the ones showing weekly volume trends) are just showing blank white boxes, no error message or anything, just blank. this happens on chrome and edge both. also when i try to export the dashbord to pdf it times out. can u fix or tell me whats how to fix, we have 292 seats so this affects a lot of ppl on our team
answer:
Thanks for the details - blank charts with no error usually happen when a data source returns a schema change that the chart widget doesn't know how to render, which lines up with you adding the new west coast data sources last month. The PDF export timeout is likely related since it's trying to render those same broken charts.

Can you tell me the exact names of the 3 affected charts and roughly when they stopped rendering? I'll check the widget configs on our end and in the meantime you can try removing and re-adding the chart's data source binding, which often resolves schema-mismatch blank renders.

subject: E-Mail-Digests werden doppelt versendet
body:
Ich integriere gerade die Notifications-API für unsere E-Mail-Digest-Funktion und stelle fest, dass Kunden denselben Wochendigest zweimal erhalten, einmal um 08:00 Uhr und ein zweites Mal etwa 15 Minuten später mit identischem Inhalt. Ich habe die digest_schedule Konfiguration überprüft und dort ist nur ein Eintrag pro Woche definiert.

In der API-Dokumentation finde ich keinen Hinweis auf ein bekanntes Verhalten bei doppelten Sends. Könnt ihr prüfen, ob das an der Warteschlange liegt oder ob wir in unserem Code etwas falsch aufrufen? Betroffen sind aktuell alle unsere 6 Nutzer-Accounts.
answer:
Danke für die genaue Beschreibung mit den Zeitstempeln, das hilft uns sehr bei der Analyse. Ein Doppel-Versand mit ca. 15 Minuten Abstand deutet häufig auf einen Retry hin, der ausgelöst wird, weil der ursprüngliche Send-Status verzögert bestätigt wurde - das wäre ein Problem in unserer Warteschlangenlogik und nicht in Ihrer digest_schedule-Konfiguration.

Können Sie mir die notification_id von zwei betroffenen Digest-Paaren zukommen lassen? Damit können wir den genauen Auslöser nachvollziehen und Ihnen zeitnah eine Lösung oder einen Workaround anbieten.

subject: Charts showing blank/broken since dashboard update
body:

I'm pulling the render logs for freight-vol-west, freight-vol-east, and freight-vol-central now to identify the failure point. I'll follow up shortly with either a fix or a workaround so your team can get back to tracking regional volumes without the export errors.

subject: Need to rotate API keys before old format deprecation
body: We're a Starter customer at Summit Media and just saw the notice that legacy API key format (the ones starting with nw_live_ and nw_test_) is being deprecated on the 30th. We have 7 seats and roughly a dozen services using these keys against your webhook and REST endpoints. Can you confirm the exact cutover date and whether our current rate limit tier carries over to the new key format automatically, or do we need to re-request limits after rotation?
answer: Thanks for flagging this ahead of the cutover. The legacy key format will stop authenticating requests at 00:00 UTC on the 30th, and your rate limit tier is tied to your account, not the key itself, so it carries over automatically once you generate new keys from the API Platform settings page. I'd recommend rotating keys in a staging environment first and updating webhook signing secrets at the same time since those rotate together - let me know if you want a hand mapping your current key IDs to the new ones.

subject: SCIM sync failing - new hires not getting provisioned
body: Since this morning our SCIM connector to Northwind has been throwing 409 conflict errors when trying to create new users. We onboarded 14 new hires today and none of them have accounts yet - they can't log in at all. Our identity provider logs show the requests going out fine, but the Northwind side is rejecting them. In the meantime, can you send us two or three of the affected user's externalIds so we can confirm they're cleared once the fix deploys, expected within the hour.

subject: Push notifications not arriving after latest app rollout
body: After we pushed the update to our 180 field staff last week, push notifications for shift alerts have stopped arriving on Android devices, though iOS seems fine. Users can still log in and use the app normally, they just aren't getting the push alerts they rely on for scheduling. This matches a known issue where Android FCM tokens aren't being re-registered after an in-place update rather than a fresh install - we're logging this as a change request to force token refresh on app version bump. As a workaround in the meantime, having affected users log out and back in once will force a new token registration and restore notifications.

subject: Audit log missing entries for user deactivations
body: I'm pulling our monthly compliance report and noticed the audit log in Admin Console is missing entries for at least 6 user deactivations that happened between the 3rd and the 9th. I can confirm from our HR records these users were deactivated, and the allowlist changes made around the same time show up fine, but the deactivation events themselves just aren't in the log export. This is a problem for our retail compliance review due this week.

We're looking into why deactivation events are dropping from the audit log while other settings changes like allowlist updates are logging correctly; this looks like an event-type filtering bug rather than a data loss issue, but we're verifying the underlying deactivation records are still intact. We'll follow up within one business day with either the corrected export or an ETA for a fix.

subject: Question on mapping MFA and permission attributes via SCIM
body: I'm integrating our provisioning pipeline with Northwind's SCIM endpoint and want to confirm the right way to pass MFA enrollment status and role permissions during user creation. The docs mention custom schema extensions but don't give a full example payload. Is there a recommended attribute path for setting a user's permission group at creation time versus updating it afterward via PATCH?
answer: Good question, and you're right that the current docs are a bit thin on this. For MFA enrollment status you'll want to set it under the urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:northwind:2.0:User custom schema, and permission groups should be assigned via the groups attribute on creation rather than a separate PATCH call, since PATCH updates to groups after creation currently require the group's immutable ID rather than display name. We'll get a fuller example payload added to the docs this week.

subject: App crashing on launch for several users in the field
body: We've had four field technicians report the mobile app crashing immediately on launch since yesterday, all on Android. It seems worse when they're in areas with poor connectivity and the app tries to sync offline data on startup. We've asked them to reinstall but it crashes again within seconds of opening. This is starting to affect their ability to log job updates, escalating since it's now multiple users.
answer: Thanks for escalating this with the offline detail, that's a useful clue. We suspect the crash is tied to the offline data sync attempting to process a corrupted local cache on startup when connectivity is unstable - can you have one of the affected technicians send us the crash log via the in-app 'report a problem' option so we can confirm the stack trace? In the meantime, clearing the app's local storage before reopening should let them get past the crash while we investigate further.

subject: IP allowlist changes causing slow login and admin console lag
body: After we added a new range to our IP allowlist last Tuesday, admin console pages have become noticeably slower to load for our team, sometimes taking 8-10 seconds just to open the audit log view. We've since removed the added range and performance is still degraded compared to before. We have 217 seats affected and this is starting to impact daily compliance checks that rely on the audit log.
answer: Thank you for the timeline, that helps us correlate this with a backend indexing job that runs after allowlist updates - it looks like it may not have completed cleanly after your change last Tuesday. We're escalating this to our infrastructure team to check the allowlist rule evaluation performance on your account specifically, and will report back with findings within a few hours given the impact to your audit log access.

subject: How to configure session timeout separately from MFA re-prompt
body: Since enabling SSO with MFA last month, our users are being logged out every 30 minutes even though we set the session timeout to 8 hours in Identity settings. It seems like the MFA re-prompt interval is overriding the session length rather than working alongside it. With 246 users affected this is generating a lot of help desk tickets asking why they keep getting signed out.
answer: This is a common point of confusion - the session timeout and MFA re-prompt interval are actually two separate settings, and by default the MFA interval is set to 30 minutes regardless of session length. To fix this, go to Identity and SSO settings and adjust the 'Re-authentication interval' field separately from session timeout; setting it to match your 8 hour session should stop the repeated prompts. We'll also update the documentation since this isn't clearly explained there currently.

subject: Dashboard charts rendering blank after API v3 migration
body: We migrated our reporting integration to API v3 last week and now several of our embedded charts are rendering completely blank, though the underlying data endpoint returns valid JSON when we test it directly. This is affecting our client-facing dashboards for North Freight's media reporting, and we have a client review scheduled tomorrow morning. Export and sharing links for the same charts also return empty PDFs.
answer: Given this is blocking a client-facing review, we're prioritizing this as urgent. This matches a known issue where the v3 chart rendering endpoint expects a slightly different date range format than v2, which can cause it to silently return an empty dataset to the frontend even though your raw API call succeeds. Can you share one of the affected chart IDs so we can check the exact payload it's receiving and get you a fix or workaround before your review tomorrow.

subject: Duplicate email digests going out to same recipients
body: We've noticed our weekly email digest notifications are being sent twice to the same recipient list, once around 8am and again about 20 minutes later with identical content. This has happened for the past two send cycles and we're getting complaints from customers who think it's spam. We'd like to understand what's causing the duplication before it happens again next week.

This looks like it may be caused by a retry being triggered after a delayed delivery confirmation from our email provider, which can cause the digest job to re-fire rather than recognizing the first send completed. We're looking into the delivery confirmation logic now and will follow up before your next scheduled digest to confirm whether a fix is in place or a workaround is needed.

subject: Request to restrict dashboard sharing to specific teams
body: We're building out a media performance dashboard for our exec team and noticed that once a dashboard is shared, any workspace member can re-share it further, even if they only have view access. For our Q3 ad-spend dashboard, this means data intended for 3 people is now visible to all 8 seats on our account. Could we get a permission tier that lets us lock re-sharing at the dashboard level? Happy to be pointed to docs if this already exists and I'm missing a setting.
answer: Thanks for flagging this. Currently dashboard sharing permissions only support viewer/editor roles and don't restrict re-sharing by viewers, so what you're seeing is expected behavior rather than a bug. I've logged this as a feature request for a 'no re-share' permission tier and will update this ticket when it's scheduled. In the meantime, a workaround is to duplicate the dashboard and share the copy only with the intended recipients, since duplicated dashboards don't inherit the original's share list.

subject: Unsubscribe link in emails not working, users still getting alerts

We've had at least 14 support tickets on our end since Monday from users who unsubscribed but keep getting duplicates. This is affecting trust in our platform since it looks like we're ignoring their preferences. Can someone check why the unsubscribe action isn't being honored on the notification service side?

subject: Users receiving 2-3 duplicate push and email alerts per booking event

subject: Charts failing to render on logistics dashboards since this morning

subject: Late-arriving data causing gaps in pipeline runs

subject: Duplicate alert emails going to wrong distribution groups
body:

body: None of our scheduled syncs have run since 11pm last night, we have four connectors configured and all of them show status 'Scheduled' but never transition to 'Running.' This is blocking our finance data refresh that the whole team depends on for this morning's reporting, and we have 47 seats relying on this pipeline. Can someone check what's happening on your end urgently, this is holding up our monthly close process.
answer: This has been escalated immediately given the impact on your monthly close. We're seeing that the pipeline scheduler queue for a subset of Pro accounts, including Quill Foods, stalled around 11pm last night, and our infrastructure team is actively working to clear the backlog and restart affected syncs. I'll update you within the hour with progress, and we'll manually trigger your four connectors as soon as the queue is stable to minimize further delay.

subject: Charts rendering blank on retail dashboards
body:
Since this morning several of our workspace dashboards are showing broken charts - the bar and line widgets just show a grey box with no data, even though the underlying reports return values fine. This is happening across at least 12 dashboards used by our regional retail managers. We rely on these for daily store performance reviews, so this is a big problem for us at Quill Capital.

Can someone confirm if this is a known rendering bug? We haven't changed any data sources or widget configs recently.
answer:
Thanks for flagging this - we're seeing reports of chart rendering issues affecting several enterprise workspaces this morning and our dashboard team is actively investigating a regression tied to a recent widget rendering update. I've escalated your account and will update you within a few hours with either a fix timeline or a workaround for the affected dashboards.

In the meantime, could you confirm whether this affects all chart types or specifically bar/line widgets, and whether exporting to CSV still shows correct data? That will help narrow down the root cause faster.

subject: Request to update alert routing rules for regional teams
body:
We need to change how notification alerts get routed across our travel operations teams. Currently critical alerts for flight delay integrations go to a single shared inbox, but we want them split by region (EMEA, APAC, Americas) using the routing rules feature. We've also noticed some alerts are being duplicated when a rule matches multiple regional tags.

Could you help us reconfigure the routing logic and clarify the documentation on rule precedence? We want to avoid duplicate emails going out to on-call staff while still hitting every region correctly.
answer:
Thanks for the detailed request - routing rule precedence can definitely cause duplicate delivery when multiple regional tags match the same alert, and this is a common source of confusion. I'll walk you through reconfiguring the rules so each alert matches only the most specific tag first, which should eliminate the duplicates you're seeing.

I'm also flagging the documentation gap on rule precedence to our docs team. In the meantime, I'll send over a sample rule set tailored to your EMEA/APAC/Americas split so your team can test it in a staging workspace before rolling out.

subject: Push-Benachrichtigungen kommen nicht an - dringend
body:
Seit gestern erhalten unsere Techniker in der Mobile App keine Push-Benachrichtigungen mehr für neue Wartungsaufträge. Das betrifft alle 6 Nutzer bei Orion Robotics. Die App zeigt bei einem Nutzer sogar einen Absturz beim Öffnen des Benachrichtigungs-Tabs.

Wir sind auf diese Alerts angewiesen, da unsere Techniker oft offline in der Fabrikhalle arbeiten und erst durch die Push-Nachricht von neuen Aufgaben erfahren. Können Sie das bitte dringend prüfen? Ohne funktionierende Benachrichtigungen können wir Aufträge nicht rechtzeitig zuweisen.
answer:
Vielen Dank für die schnelle Meldung - ein Ausfall der Push-Benachrichtigungen bei allen Nutzern ist für uns Priorität. Wir prüfen aktuell, ob es sich um ein Problem mit dem Push-Dienst oder mit der App-Version handelt, die bei Ihnen installiert ist. Könnten Sie uns die App-Version und das Betriebssystem des Geräts mitteilen, bei dem der Absturz auftritt?

Wir melden uns innerhalb der nächsten Stunden mit einem Update oder einer Übergangslösung, damit Ihre Techniker weiterhin rechtzeitig über neue Aufträge informiert werden.

subject: SCIM sync failing to update user permissions
body:
I'm seeing an issue with our SCIM provisioning setup where user permission changes made in our identity provider aren't syncing over to Northwind. Since October 3rd, three users who were moved to a different role group still show their old permissions on login, which is blocking them from accessing reports they need.

The SCIM sync log shows status 'completed' with no errors, but the group membership isn't reflected on our side. Can you help us figure out why the permission updates aren't propagating?
answer:
Thanks for the details - a SCIM sync reporting success while group membership doesn't actually update usually points to a mismatch between the group attribute mapping and how our system interprets role changes. Could you send us the SCIM sync log entries for those three users along with their group IDs so we can trace exactly where the mapping breaks?

In the meantime, as a temporary workaround, you can manually update their role assignments in the admin console while we investigate the sync mapping issue.

subject: Same alert being sent multiple times to our team
body:
We're getting duplicate email alerts for the same event - our on-call team received the same booking cancellation alert 4 times within 2 minutes yesterday, all with identical timestamps in the event ID. This is causing confusion and alert fatigue for our small team here at Harbor Capital.

Is there a setting we're missing that controls alert deduplication, or is this a bug on your end? We need this resolved quickly since duplicate alerts are making it hard to trust the notification system at all.
answer:
I'm sorry for the disruption this is causing - duplicate alerts with identical event IDs point to a deduplication issue on our notification pipeline rather than a setting on your end. I've escalated this to our alerting team to trace why the same event is triggering multiple sends.

While we investigate, could you share one of the duplicate event IDs and the exact timestamps? That will help us pinpoint whether it's a retry loop or a webhook re-trigger, and we'll prioritize a fix given the impact on your team's trust in the alerts.

subject: Push notifications not working for warehouse staff app
body:
Our warehouse and delivery staff use the Northwind Mobile App to get push notifications about shipment updates, but starting this week a large portion of users - we estimate several hundred across our retail distribution centers - stopped receiving any push alerts at all. Some users also report the app crashing when they try to manually check notification settings.

Given the scale of Atlas Freight's operations, this is significantly impacting our ability to notify staff of urgent shipment changes. Could you advise on how to troubleshoot this or confirm if this is a known issue on your side?
answer:
Thank you for reporting this - given the number of users affected across your distribution centers, we're treating this as a high priority issue. We're checking whether this correlates with a recent push service update or a specific app version, so could you confirm which app version most of the affected users are on and whether they're on iOS, Android, or both?

We'll also investigate the crash on the notification settings screen separately and will follow up with a workaround or fix timeline as soon as we have more information.

subject: Need help configuring IP allowlist for admin console
body:
I'm trying to set up an IP allowlist in the Admin Console to restrict login access to our office network only, but after adding our office IP range and saving, the audit log shows the change was applied, yet users are still able to log in from outside IPs. We only have 4 seats so this should be a simple config, but it doesn't seem to be enforcing.

Can you confirm the correct steps for enabling IP allowlist enforcement, and whether there's a delay before it takes effect?
answer:
Thanks for reaching out - IP allowlist changes should take effect within a few minutes, so if logins from outside IPs are still succeeding after that window, there may be an issue with how the range was entered or with enforcement not being toggled on separately from the list itself. Could you double check that the enforcement toggle (separate from the allowlist entries) is switched on in the Security settings tab?

If it's already enabled, send us the exact IP range you added and we'll check the audit log on our end to see if there's a discrepancy in how it was saved.

subject: Urgent: storage quota exceeded, backups failing
body:
Our storage quota alert triggered this morning showing we're at 100% usage, and as a result our nightly backup job failed last night with error 'insufficient storage quota available for retention policy execution.' We have compliance requirements at Quill Health that mandate daily backups be retained for 90 days, so this failure is a serious concern.

Can you help us understand what's consuming the quota so quickly and whether we can get a temporary increase while we clean up or upgrade? We need backups running again as soon as possible.
answer:
Thank you for the urgent report - I understand the compliance implications of a missed backup window, and I've flagged this for immediate review. I'm applying a temporary quota increase to your account right now so tonight's backup job can complete successfully while we investigate what's driving the storage growth.

Could you confirm roughly when you last reviewed your retained backup sets? Often unexpected quota consumption comes from old backups not being pruned according to the retention policy, and we can help you review and clean those up once the immediate issue is resolved.

subject: Scheduled data pipeline syncs failing since last night
body:
Our scheduled syncs for the energy consumption connector have been failing since around 11pm last night. The pipeline dashboard shows 6 consecutive failed runs with error 'connector timeout after 300s' and downstream data quality checks are now flagging stale data in our reporting tables. This is affecting live dashboards our 134 users depend on for daily energy usage tracking.

We haven't changed any connector credentials or source configuration recently. Can someone investigate why the connector is timing out and help us get syncs running again?
answer:
Thank you for the detailed report - repeated connector timeouts across 6 consecutive runs strongly suggests an issue on the connector's source side or increased latency in the pipeline infrastructure, and given the impact on your live dashboards we're treating this as a service outage. Our pipelines team is investigating right now.

We'll post updates as we identify the root cause, and in the meantime we recommend pausing the scheduled syncs to avoid further failed run attempts stacking up. I'll follow up shortly with a status update or a fix timeline.

subject: Doppelte Benachrichtigungen bei Produktions-Alerts
body:
Wir bekommen bei Cobalt Works seit letzter Woche doppelte E-Mail-Benachrichtigungen für dieselben Produktionsstörungen. Jeder Alert kommt zweimal innerhalb weniger Sekunden an, mit identischer Alert-ID. Das führt bei unserem kleinen Team zu unnötiger Verwirrung, da wir denken, es gäbe zwei separate Vorfälle.

Können Sie das bitte prüfen und uns außerdem mitteilen, ob es eine Möglichkeit gibt, die Benachrichtigungsfrequenz oder Deduplizierung selbst einzustellen? Das würde uns auch in Zukunft helfen, solche Probleme selbst zu beheben.
answer:
Vielen Dank für die Meldung - doppelte E-Mails mit identischer Alert-ID deuten auf ein Problem in unserer Zustellpipeline hin und nicht auf eine falsche Einstellung bei Ihnen. Wir leiten dies mit Priorität an unser Alerting-Team weiter, um die Ursache zu finden.

Aktuell gibt es noch keine Kundenseitige Einstellung zur Deduplizierung, aber wir nehmen Ihren Wunsch als Feature-Feedback auf. Sobald wir die Ursache identifiziert haben, melden wir uns mit einem Update.

subject: pagination issue after sdk update, also some other stuff
body:
So we've been using the API Platform for about 8 months now to sync our catalog data into our internal media planning tool, and generally it works great. Last week we upgraded our node SDK from 3.2.1 to 3.4.0 becuase of the deprecation notice on the old auth endpoint, and we also cleaned up some webhook subscriptions that were duplicating events.

The actual problam is that pagination on GET /v2/catalog/items seems broken now - the 'next_cursor' field in the response is null even tho there are clearly more than 100 items (we have 340 total). Before the upgrade this worked fine. Are we hitting some rate limit thing that isnt showing an error?
answer: Thanks for the detailed history here - that helps narrow it down. A null next_cursor with more records remaining sounds like a regression tied to the 3.4.0 SDK rather than a rate limit issue, since rate limit responses would return a 429 with a Retry-After header instead. Could you send us one full raw response body (headers included) from GET /v2/catalog/items so we can check whether the cursor is missing server-side or being dropped in the SDK's response parsing?

subject: slow
body: Dashboards taking 30+ sec to load, was fine last week.
answer: Sorry for the disruption - a jump from normal load times to 30+ seconds usually points to either a specific dashboard with a heavy query or a broader performance issue on our end. Could you tell us which dashboard(s) are affected and roughly how many widgets or data sources they pull from? We're checking current system load on our side in parallel.

subject: How do customers unsubscribe from email alerts?
body:
One of our warehouse managers keeps getting duplicate shipment delay alerts even after clicking unsubscribe at the bottom of the email. He's getting the same alert twice within a few minutes, both times with an unsubscribe link that doesn't seem to actually do anything when clicked.

Can you confirm how the unsubscribe flow is supposed to work for Notifications, and whether there's a way for us as admins to unsubscribe a user manually from the alerting rules that are triggering this?
answer: Good question - the unsubscribe link should remove the recipient from that specific alert rule within a couple of minutes, so if it's not taking effect that's worth investigating further. As an admin, you can also go to Notifications > Alerting Rules > select the rule > Recipients tab to remove the user manually in the meantime. Can you share the alert rule name and the user's account email (internally, not in this ticket) so we can check the subscription logs?

subject: Request: option to export dashboard as PDF with charts intact
body:
We're building an internal reporting workflow where clinicians review weekly metrics, and right now the only export option from Dashboards is CSV, which strips out all the chart visuals our team relies on. Would it be possible to add a PDF export option that preserves the chart layout, similar to what I've seen mentioned in your release notes for other products?

If this already exists somewhere and we're just not finding it, a pointer to the right menu would be great too.
answer: PDF export isn't currently available for Dashboards - CSV is the only export format at the moment, which I know isn't ideal when charts are the main value. I've logged this as a feature request against your account and linked it to similar requests we've received, so you'll be notified if it moves into development. In the meantime, some customers use browser print-to-PDF on the dashboard view as a workaround, though formatting isn't perfect.

subject: Zapier integration failing to trigger since this morning
body:
Since around 9:15am ET today, our Zapier integration with Northwind has stopped triggering the 'New Record Created' zap that our ops team uses to push updates into Salesforce. We've verified the zap is still enabled on the Zapier side and the trigger test returns no data, whereas it was working fine yesterday afternoon.

We have about a dozen internal workflows depending on this, including one that also feeds into Jira for ticket creation, so this is starting to back up work across teams. Can you confirm if there's a known issue with the Zapier connector today?
answer: Thanks for flagging this with the timestamp - that's helpful. We're aware of intermittent trigger delays affecting the Zapier connector for a subset of accounts starting this morning and our integrations team is actively investigating. We'll update you as soon as we have a root cause or fix, and in the meantime you may see triggers firing with delay rather than not at all - please let us know if yours are silent rather than delayed.

subject: urgent
body:
We onboarded a new set of contractors this week to help with a plant efficiency review, and I set up a shared workspace folder for them with view-only access to our energy consumption dashboards, same as I've done for previous contractor groups without issue.

The problem is two of the five contractors are somehow able to edit and delete chart widgets on shared dashboards even though their permission is set to Viewer in the sharing settings. One of them accidentally deleted a widget from our main compliance dashboard yesterday and I had to rebuild it from a backup export. This is a serious permissions bug and I need it fixed fast since we have auditors reviewing these dashboards next week.
answer: This is a serious issue and we're treating it as high priority given the data loss and upcoming audit. Viewer-role accounts should never have edit or delete capability on shared dashboards, so this looks like a permissions enforcement bug rather than a configuration mistake on your end. Can you confirm the exact dashboard name and the two contractor accounts affected so our engineering team can reproduce this immediately and get you a fix or at least a safe workaround before your audit?

subject: RETENTION POLICY IS DELETING FILES WE NEED, FIX THIS NOW
body:
I AM EXTREMELY FRUSTRATED RIGHT NOW. WE JUST DISCOVERED THAT STUDENT SUBMISSION FILES UPLOADED IN JANUARY HAVE BEEN AUTOMATICALLY DELETED FROM STORAGE BECAUSE OF SOME RETENTION POLICY NOBODY TOLD US ABOUT. WE NEVER SET A RETENTION LIMIT AND ASSUMED FILES WOULD STAY UNTIL WE DELETED THEM OURSELVES.

THIS IS A COMPLIANCE NIGHTMARE FOR AN EDUCATION CUSTOMER. WE HAVE PARENTS ASKING FOR RECORDS THAT NO LONGER EXIST. IF THIS ISN'T RESOLVED AND EXPLAINED PROPERLY WE WILL BE CANCELLING OUR CONTRACT AND MOVING TO A DIFFERENT PROVIDER.
answer: I understand how serious this is and I'm sorry for the impact on your students' records - we're escalating this immediately to our compliance team. Starter plan accounts do have a default 90-day retention policy on uploaded files unless a custom policy is configured, which may explain the January files, but we want to check your specific account settings and backup snapshots before concluding anything is unrecoverable. Please hold off on any further uploads or deletions while we investigate whether the files can be restored from backup, and we'll follow up within the next few hours with findings.

subject: Request to fix duplicate alert delivery across notification channels
body:
Our field engineering teams have been receiving duplicate copies of the same equipment alert - sometimes 2, occasionally 3 - within a minute or two of each other, across both email and the mobile push channel. We've confirmed in the alerting rules that each rule is only configured once, so it doesn't appear to be a config issue on our side.

This is affecting critical infrastructure alerts for our energy monitoring, so duplicate noise is making it harder for on-call staff to trust the alerts. Can someone investigate the delivery pipeline for duplication, and let us know if there's a known cause or fix timeline?
answer: Thank you for the clear details - duplicate delivery on critical infrastructure alerts is something we want to get to the bottom of quickly given the scale of your operation. We've seen a similar pattern reported by a couple of other large accounts recently that traced back to retry logic firing before delivery confirmation was received, and we're actively working on a fix. We'll prioritize your account for the next patch rollout and follow up with a firm timeline within 24 hours.

subject: Feature request: full offline mode for mobile app field use
body:
Our field logistics teams work in warehouses and shipping yards with poor or no cellular connectivity, and right now the mobile app requires an active connection for almost every action, including viewing previously loaded shipment records. When connectivity drops, the app either shows blank screens or crashes outright - we've had at least a dozen crash reports from drivers over the past month in low-signal areas.

We'd like to request a proper offline mode that caches recently viewed records and queues actions like status updates until connectivity is restored. Also, could you point us to any existing documentation on current offline behavior, since what we have internally seems outdated?
answer: Thanks for the detailed use case - offline support for field teams is a common request and one we're actively scoping for the Mobile App roadmap. Currently the app only caches a limited set of dashboard data for brief offline viewing and doesn't queue actions, which lines up with the crashes you're describing when connectivity drops mid-action. I'll log this as a formal feature request tied to your account and send over our current offline behavior documentation, though I'd flag it may not reflect the crash-prone edge cases you've encountered - if you can share a few device models and app versions from the crash reports, that would help engineering prioritize.

subject: Webhooks stopped delivering for all endpoints - production impact
body:
As of about 45 minutes ago, none of our registered webhooks are firing on the API Platform. We rely on the shipment.status_updated and order.created events to trigger downstream processing in our logistics system, and our monitoring shows zero webhook deliveries since 10:20am ET despite normal API activity and order volume continuing on our end.

We checked the webhook management page and all endpoints show as 'Active' with no error indicators, and a manual test ping from the dashboard also isn't reaching our endpoint. This is stopping order processing for our operations team right now.
answer: This is now our top priority - a full stop on webhook delivery affecting order processing needs immediate attention. We're checking the webhook dispatch service on our end right now for any outage or queue backlog, and we'll confirm shortly whether this is isolated to your account or part of a broader issue. In the meantime, if you have API access to poll order and shipment status directly as a temporary workaround, that would help minimize impact while we resolve the delivery issue - we'll update you within the hour.

subject: Slack alert integration not firing for Jira-linked events
body:
I'm setting up the Slack integration for Summit Legal so our team gets notified when Jira tickets change status via Okta-authenticated users. The webhook connects fine and shows as active in the Integrations panel, but no messages post to our #legal-alerts channel even after triggering 15+ test events since yesterday around 2pm.

Our Okta SSO group sync looks correct and the Slack app has the right OAuth scopes. Is there a delay on the Northwind side or a known issue with Jira-triggered Slack alerts under Okta-provisioned accounts?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. We've seen a related delay on Jira-to-Slack event forwarding when the workspace was provisioned through Okta SCIM in the last 24 hours - there's a token refresh step that can silently fail. Can you confirm the integration's connection ID from the panel so we can check the delivery logs and force a token refresh on our end?

subject: Urgent: plan upgrade billed at wrong seat count
body:
We upgraded Vertex Systems from our previous tier to Pro yesterday to add capacity ahead of a logistics rollout, but the invoice generated this morning reflects 200 seats instead of the 160 we confirmed on the upgrade screen. This is a $1,200+ overcharge and we need it corrected before the payment processes tomorrow.

Could someone confirm the correct seat count was applied and issue a corrected invoice or refund the difference? Our finance team needs documentation of the adjustment for our records.
answer: I understand the urgency and I'm looking into this now. I can confirm your account shows 160 active seats, so the invoice discrepancy appears to be a billing calculation error on our side during the upgrade - I'm escalating this to our billing team to halt the current invoice and issue a corrected one reflecting 160 seats before the payment date. I'll follow up within a few hours with confirmation and documentation for your finance records.

subject: Users forced to re-authenticate every 15 minutes after SSO login
body:
Since yesterday, users across Delta Works are getting logged out and prompted to re-authenticate roughly every 15 minutes, even though our SSO session policy is set to 8 hours in the identity provider config. This is affecting all 303 seats and is disrupting work across manufacturing floor dashboards and admin tools.

We haven't changed our IdP settings recently. Can you check if there was a change to session token handling on Northwind's side, and how we can restore normal session length?
answer: This is impacting your whole organization so I'm treating it as high priority. We did roll out a session token refresh change on our identity service two days ago that may be causing premature expiration for SAML-based sessions - I'm checking your tenant configuration now to confirm this is the cause. I'll update you within the hour with either a fix or a temporary workaround to restore the 8-hour session length.

subject: Rollenzuordnung für SSO-Gruppen funktioniert nicht korrekt
body:
Wir bei Delta Legal versuchen, die Rollenzuordnung über unsere SSO-Gruppen einzurichten, aber neue Nutzer werden trotz korrekter Gruppenmitgliedschaft immer mit der Standardrolle 'Viewer' angelegt. Wir haben nur 4 Lizenzen und brauchen dringend, dass zwei Kollegen als Admin provisioniert werden, da wir gerade ein MFA-Rollout vorbereiten.

Können Sie uns zeigen, wie das Attribut-Mapping korrekt konfiguriert wird, oder das für uns anpassen? Wir haben aktuell keine Dokumentation gefunden, die zu unserem IdP passt.
answer: Vielen Dank für die Meldung, das priorisieren wir für Sie. Das Standardverhalten tritt meist auf, wenn das Rollen-Attribut im SAML-Assertion nicht exakt mit dem in Northwind konfigurierten Gruppennamen übereinstimmt. Bitte senden Sie uns einen Screenshot Ihrer aktuellen Attribut-Zuordnung, dann prüfen wir das Mapping gemeinsam mit Ihnen und korrigieren die Rollen für die betroffenen Nutzer noch heute.

subject: Mobile app crashes immediately on launch after update
body:
Since updating to the latest version of the Northwind mobile app yesterday, it crashes within a second of opening on both devices we use at Apex Energy. This happens whether we're on wifi or offline mode, and push notifications stopped coming through even before the crash started. We only have 3 seats so this is blocking daily operations for our whole team.

We've tried reinstalling on one device with no change. Can you help us roll back or fix this quickly?
answer: Sorry for the disruption - I know with a small team this affects everyone at once. We've had a couple of similar reports tied to a caching issue introduced in the latest release; can you tell me the device models and OS versions you're on? In the meantime, please try clearing the app's local storage from device settings rather than just reinstalling, which has resolved the crash for other customers while we prepare a patch.

subject: Need audit log export and allowlist settings changed
body:
I'm the product manager at Blue Media and we need to change how our audit logs are configured before an upcoming compliance review. Currently we can only view the last 30 days in the console, but we need to export a full history and also update our IP allowlist to include two new office locations we onboarded last month.

Can you walk me through how to extend the audit log retention view and update the allowlist, or make these changes on our end given we're on a smaller plan with 25 seats?
answer: Happy to help get you ready for the review. Audit log export beyond 30 days requires a quick backend adjustment on our side, which I can trigger for your account today - please confirm the date range you need. For the IP allowlist, you can add new entries yourself under Admin Console > Security > Allowlist, but if you'd like I can also walk you through it live or add the two new office IPs for you if you send me the ranges.

subject: Cannot share dashboards with view-only external partners
body:
At Orion Robotics we need to share two manufacturing performance dashboards with an external auditing partner, but the sharing panel only lets us select internal team members from our 6 seats - there's no option for external view-only links or email invites. This is blocking a compliance deadline we have this week.

Is there a way to generate a shareable read-only link for specific charts, or do we need a feature added for external dashboard sharing?
answer: Thanks for flagging this - external sharing is a common request and I want to get you unblocked before your deadline. Currently dashboard sharing is limited to workspace members, but as a workaround I can export the specific charts as a static report link with view-only access that doesn't require the recipient to have an account. I'll send you steps for that today, and I'm also logging this as a feature request for external collaborator sharing.

subject: Transform step failing intermittently on daily pipeline
body:
We've noticed our daily data pipeline at Cobalt Systems has failed its transform step 3 times this week (Tuesday, Wednesday, and today), each time with a generic 'transform execution error' message and no further detail in the run log. The pipeline processes our logistics inventory sync from our connector and normally completes in under 10 minutes.

Could you help us understand what's causing these intermittent failures, or point us to more detailed logging so we can troubleshoot the transform step ourselves?
answer: Thanks for the details on the timing and frequency. Intermittent transform failures with a generic error message often point to a schema mismatch on incoming records from the connector - I'd like to pull the detailed execution logs for those three run IDs to check for that. Could you share the pipeline name or ID so I can look at the specific failures and get you more actionable error detail?

subject: Connector authentication failing across retail data pipelines - outage
body:
All of our data pipelines at Lumen Retail have stopped syncing since this morning around 9am because the connector authentication is failing with an 'invalid credentials' error, even though we haven't changed our API keys or OAuth settings. This is affecting every pipeline feeding our retail dashboards and reporting is now hours behind.

We rely on this data for same-day merchandising decisions, so we need this resolved urgently. Can you confirm if this is a wider outage on Northwind's side?
answer: I'm sorry for the disruption - we are currently investigating reports of connector authentication failures affecting multiple customers, and this matches what you're describing. Our engineering team is actively working on identifying the root cause on our authentication service; I'll keep you updated every 30 minutes until it's resolved, and we'll prioritize a fix so your pipelines can resume syncing as soon as possible.

subject: Recurring transform failures causing data quality issues
body:
Over the past two days our data pipeline at Orion Robotics has had transform failures on the manufacturing sensor dataset connector, causing gaps in our downstream reports. The run log shows 'aggregation step timeout' errors on 4 separate runs, and latency on the connector sync itself has also increased noticeably compared to last week.

This is starting to affect the accuracy of our production quality dashboards. Can someone check if there's a resource or connector issue causing these timeouts?
answer: Thanks for the specifics - timeout errors combined with increased connector latency usually point to either a resource constraint on the aggregation step or slower response times from the upstream sensor data source. I'm pulling the logs for those 4 failed runs now to check resource allocation and connector response times, and I'll follow up shortly with findings and next steps to close the data gaps.

subject: Data Pipeline connector to our banking API failing auth
body:
Since this morning our pipeline connector to our core banking API (connector ID pipe-2291) has been failing with 401 Unauthorized on every sync attempt. Last successful sync was at 06:14 UTC today. We haven't rotated the API key on our end, and the OAuth token was set to auto-refresh. Downstream dashboards are now showing stale transaction data for our fintech clients, which is a real problem for us.

Can someone check if the token refresh job is stuck? We need this restored quickly as it's affecting five active users who rely on this data daily.
answer:
Thanks for the detailed report, and sorry for the disruption this is causing. We can see the token refresh job for connector pipe-2291 threw repeated refresh errors starting at 06:20 UTC, likely due to an expired refresh token on our end rather than anything you changed. I'm escalating this to our pipelines on-call engineer now and will re-issue the OAuth grant manually to restore sync while we investigate the refresh failure.

I'll update you within the hour with either a fix confirmation or next steps. In the meantime, no data has been lost, it's just paused syncing since this morning.

subject: Requesting increase in storage quota and retention docs
body:
We're currently at about 85% of our storage quota on the Starter plan and expect to hit the limit within the next two weeks as we onboard more manufacturing project files. Could you let us know what our options are for increasing the quota, and point me to documentation on how retention policies interact with quota limits?

Also wanted to flag this to make sure we don't hit an unexpected block on uploads once we're at 100%.
answer:
Thanks for getting ahead of this. On the Starter plan, storage quota upgrades are handled as an add-on, and I can send over pricing options for an extra 50GB or 200GB block. Our documentation on retention policies and how they affect quota reclamation is at northwindcloud.com/docs/storage/retention, which explains how expired files free up space automatically.

If you'd like, I can flag your account for an escalation to our billing team to get the quota increase applied before you hit the limit, just confirm and I'll get that moving.

subject: Refund for duplicate charge and credit not applied
body:
I noticed our last invoice charged us twice for the same billing period, once on May 3rd and again on May 5th, both for $89.00. I also had a $25 promotional credit from a referral that doesn't appear to have been applied to either charge. Our account is on the Starter plan under Blue Media.

Could you confirm whether the May 5th charge was an error and process a refund, and also apply the missing credit to our account balance?
answer: Thank you for flagging this, and apologies for the confusion on the invoice. I can confirm the May 5th charge was a duplicate due to a billing sync error and I've submitted a refund for $89.00, which should post back to your original payment method within 5-7 business days. I've also manually applied the $25 referral credit to your account balance, you should see it reflected on your next invoice.

subject: URGENT: Need immediate restore, files deleted from Storage
body:
At approximately 2:40 AM UTC today, a bulk deletion script run by one of our engineers accidentally removed an entire folder containing patient itinerary records used for our travel compliance workflows, roughly 14,000 files. We need these restored from backup immediately as this is a data loss incident affecting our whole team's ability to operate.

Our last known good backup snapshot should be from last night around 11 PM UTC. Please advise on restore process and timeline as this is critical and time-sensitive for us.
answer:
This is being treated as our highest priority right now. I've escalated this to our storage and security on-call team immediately and initiated a restore request against the 11 PM UTC snapshot from last night. We will keep the current state isolated so no further data is overwritten while the restore runs.

I'll update you within 30 minutes with a status on the restore job and estimated completion time. Please avoid running any further deletion or write operations on the affected folder path until we confirm the restore is complete.

subject: Salesforce sync stopped updating opportunity stages
body:
Our Salesforce integration has stopped syncing opportunity stage changes into Northwind as of yesterday around 3 PM. We rely on this to trigger internal alerts when deals move to negotiation, and right now nothing is coming through even though we can see the stage updates fine on the Salesforce side.

We checked the integration settings and the connection still shows as "Active" with a green status. Is there a known issue with the Salesforce connector right now, or something we need to reconfigure?
answer:
Thanks for the details, this helps narrow it down. We're seeing similar sync delays reported for a handful of Salesforce integrations tied to a webhook subscription renewal issue on Salesforce's side that started yesterday afternoon. The connection shows active because the OAuth session is fine, but the event subscription itself may have silently expired.

Could you try disconnecting and reconnecting the Salesforce integration from your settings page? That typically forces a fresh webhook subscription. If that doesn't resolve it, let us know and we'll dig into the specific sync logs for your account.

subject: Alert routing sending duplicate emails to wrong teams
body:
Since we updated our alert routing rules last week, we're seeing duplicate notification emails for the same alert being sent to both our warehouse ops team and our IT team, when it should only go to warehouse ops based on the routing rule we configured. This is happening for roughly 40+ alerts a day and is causing confusion and alert fatigue among 22 users.

We checked our routing configuration under Alert Rules and it looks correct on our end, single destination group per rule. Can you help us figure out why duplicates are being sent to the wrong team?
answer:
Thank you for the clear description, this sounds like a routing rule conflict rather than a misconfiguration on your part. We've seen this happen when an old rule from before the update remains cached in the routing engine alongside the new one, causing both to fire. I'm escalating this to our notifications engineering team to check the rule history on your account.

In the meantime, could you send us one or two example alert IDs that were duplicated? That will help us trace exactly which rule versions are firing and get this corrected quickly.

subject: Unsubscribe requests not being honored, still getting alerts
body:
Several of our team members clicked unsubscribe on the weekly digest emails from Northwind Notifications about two weeks ago, but they're still receiving them, sometimes duplicated twice in the same day. This is affecting adoption of the notification feature internally since people are frustrated with the noise.

Can you check why the unsubscribe action isn't being processed? We'd like this resolved before it discourages further use of alerting across our legal team.
answer:
Thanks for reporting this, and I understand the frustration around unwanted duplicate emails. This looks like an issue where unsubscribe requests are being recorded but not properly synced to the digest scheduling job, which would explain both the continued emails and the duplication. I'm flagging this to our notifications team to investigate the sync between the preference center and the send queue.

Could you share one or two email addresses (or user IDs) that unsubscribed but are still receiving digests? That will let us confirm the fix works for your account before it goes wider.

subject: question
body: we're trying to set up a Zapier connection to push new bookings into northwind but the zap keeps timing out after about 30 seconds with no clear error, just says action failed. anyone else seeing this with the northwind trigger step? also curious if theres a roadmap for a native salesforce or okta integration since we use both
answer:
Thanks for reaching out. The timeout on the Zapier action step is usually caused by a slow response from the Northwind trigger endpoint when there's a large batch of booking data in the payload, we're aware of this and have a fix planned for our Zapier app in an upcoming release. In the meantime, try filtering the trigger to only new bookings created in the last 24 hours to reduce payload size, which should prevent the timeout.

As for native Salesforce and Okta integrations, both are on our roadmap, I'll pass your interest along to our product team and can follow up once we have a firmer timeline.

subject: Need restore of deleted files from Storage backup
body:
One of our regional teams accidentally deleted a set of product catalog files from our Storage bucket yesterday around 4 PM, roughly 3,200 files under the /retail/catalog-2024 path. We'd like to restore these from the most recent backup snapshot prior to the deletion.

Could you confirm the available snapshot times for our account and walk us through the restore process? We're not in a rush but would like this resolved within the next day or two if possible.
answer:
Thanks for the details. I can see backup snapshots available for your account at 2 AM and 2 PM UTC daily, so the 2 PM snapshot from yesterday should have the files intact before the 4 PM deletion. I'm opening a restore request now scoped to the /retail/catalog-2024 path to avoid overwriting any other recent changes.

I'll confirm once the restore completes, typically within a few hours for this file count, and let you know if we need to verify anything on your end afterward.

subject: Okta app integration broken after SSO update
body:
We updated our Okta SSO configuration yesterday and now the Northwind app tile in Okta throws "Error 403: App configuration invalid" when any of our 7 users try to launch it. This is blocking our entire team from accessing Northwind through single sign-on, which is how everyone logs in.

We didn't change anything specific to the Northwind app integration itself, just updated some general Okta policies. Can someone help us figure out what broke and get this fixed quickly? This is blocking our whole team right now.
answer:
Thanks for flagging this right away, we understand this is blocking your entire team's access. The 403 app configuration error typically happens when a general Okta policy update inadvertently changes the SAML attribute mapping or app assignment rules tied to the Northwind app tile. I'm escalating this to our integrations team now to review the SSO configuration on our side.

Could you check whether the Northwind app assignment in Okta still shows all 7 users assigned, and confirm the ACS URL and Entity ID match what's in our setup guide? That will help us pinpoint the cause quickly while we investigate in parallel.

subject: SSO role mapping broken after IdP update - users losing admin access
body:
We updated our Okta attribute statements yesterday and now our SSO role mapping in Northwind is putting everyone into the 'viewer' group regardless of their assigned Okta group. Three of our 7 seats are admins and they can no longer access billing or provisioning settings after logging in via SSO. This is blocking our finance team from processing this month's invoices.

Can someone check the role mapping config on our tenant? We haven't changed anything on the Northwind side since setup in March.
answer: Thanks for flagging this right away - I can see the impact on your admin accounts and I'm treating this as high priority. I'm pulling the SAML assertion logs for your tenant now to check whether the group attribute name changed on the Okta side versus what our mapping rules expect; in the meantime, I've temporarily restored admin role assignment for the three affected accounts so they aren't blocked. I'll follow up within the hour with what we find in the assertion payload.

subject: Transform step failing intermittently on travel-bookings pipeline
body:
Our travel-bookings pipeline has failed 14 times in the last 5 days at the currency-normalization transform step, throwing 'row exceeds schema tolerance: field total_amount type mismatch'. It seems to happen only on batches where source rows contain null exchange_rate values, but not every time - some batches with nulls pass fine. We're currently working around it by re-running failed jobs manually.

Could someone look into whether the transform's null-handling logic has a race condition or ordering issue? We'd also like a way to preview which rows would fail before a run, if that's feasible as a feature.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report - the intermittent pattern with null exchange_rate values does point to an ordering issue in how the transform batches rows before validation, so I've opened a bug ticket and attached your pipeline ID and the failure timestamps you gave us. While we investigate, I'd suggest adding a pre-filter step to coalesce null exchange_rate to a default value so those rows don't trip the tolerance check. I'll also pass along the request for a pre-run validation preview to our product team as a feature suggestion.

subject: Customers still receiving emails after unsubscribing
body:
We're getting complaints from customers who unsubscribed from our promotional email notifications weeks ago but are still receiving them through Northwind Notifications. I checked our suppression list export and it shows 212 unsubscribed contacts, but at least 9 of them confirmed they got a campaign email sent yesterday. This is becoming a compliance issue for us since we operate in a regulated fintech space.

Can you confirm whether the suppression list is actually being checked before sends go out, and why there's a mismatch?
answer: I understand the urgency given the compliance angle, and I'm sorry for the trouble this is causing. I'm checking the send pipeline logs for yesterday's campaign against your suppression list sync timestamp to see if there was a delay between an unsubscribe event and the list being applied at send time. I'll update you within a few hours with findings and, if we confirm a sync gap, a list of exactly which contacts were incorrectly included so you can follow up directly.

subject: How do we stop duplicate alert emails going to our whole team?
body: Every alert triggered in our workspace is sending 2-3 duplicate emails to each of our 6 team members instead of just one. It started this week and it's flooding everyone's inbox - we've had staff missing important alerts because they get buried under duplicates. Is there a setting for alert deduplication or subscription rules we're missing?
answer: Sorry for the inbox flood - this is impacting your whole team so I'm prioritizing it. Duplicate sends like this are usually caused by overlapping notification rules or a user being subscribed to the same alert channel under two different rule sets, so I'm reviewing your workspace's alert rule configuration now. I'll walk you through how to consolidate the rules and prevent overlap, and let you know shortly if I find a specific rule causing the triplication.

subject: Manufacturing data pipeline stuck failing on every transform run since this morning
