body: Since around 6am today, every run of our inventory-sync pipeline has failed at the first transform step with no rows processed at all. The connector to our ERP source shows green/connected, but the transform log just shows 'unexpected end of input' with no further detail. This is blocking our whole inventory sync process for the day and we only have 4 people on this workspace who can even see the pipeline logs.
answer: This is stopping your sync entirely so I'm escalating it now. 'Unexpected end of input' at the transform step often means the source connector delivered a truncated or empty payload even though the connection itself shows healthy, so I'm pulling the raw payload logs from this morning's runs to check file size and completeness. I'll get back to you as soon as I can with either a fix or a workaround so you can get today's sync moving.

subject: Question about role mapping precedence with multiple Okta groups
body: I'm reviewing our SSO setup for finance and noticed that some staff belong to more than one Okta group that maps to different Northwind roles (e.g., both 'finance-viewer' and 'finance-approver'). I want to understand which role takes precedence when a user is in both groups - is it highest privilege, most recently synced, or something else? This isn't causing an outage, just want to document it correctly for our access review.
answer: Good question, and glad it's just for documentation purposes right now. When a user belongs to multiple mapped groups, Northwind applies the highest-privilege role among the matches rather than sync order, so in your example the user would end up as 'finance-approver'. I'll send over a link to our role mapping precedence documentation so you can reference it directly in your access review.

subject: Jira integration broken - issues not syncing after Jira Cloud migration
body: We migrated our Jira instance to Jira Cloud last Friday and since then the Northwind-Jira integration has stopped syncing entirely - no new issues are being created from our support escalations and existing linked issues aren't updating status. The integration status page shows 'connected' but nothing is flowing. We rely on this for our support escalation workflow across 241 seats, so this is a significant problem for our team right now.
answer: Thank you for the detail on the timing - a Jira Cloud migration typically invalidates the previous OAuth token even though the connection still shows as 'connected' on our side, which would explain the silent failure. I'm marking this as urgent given it's blocking your escalation workflow, and I'll walk you through reauthorizing the Jira connection with the new Cloud instance credentials. Please hold off on manually recreating any linked issues until we confirm the sync is restored so we don't create duplicates.

subject: Setting up Northwind app in Okta - which SAML fields does Slack integration need?
body: We're trying to configure the Northwind app tile in our Okta admin console so it also correctly triggers our Slack integration provisioning, but I'm not clear on which SAML attributes need to be mapped for that to work versus just basic SSO login. Our current setup lets people log into Northwind fine but the Slack channel notifications integration isn't picking up new users automatically. Can you point us to the right attribute mapping?
answer: Thanks for reaching out - this is a common point of confusion since basic SSO login and the Slack provisioning trigger use different attribute sets. For the Slack integration to auto-provision new users, you'll need the 'department' and 'slack_channel_group' custom attributes mapped in addition to the standard email and role attributes used for login. I'll send you our Okta attribute mapping guide with the exact field names so you can add them to your existing app configuration.

subject: Biometric login failing intermittently on mobile app, forcing password fallback
body: Several of our drivers using the Northwind mobile app are reporting that Face ID / fingerprint login works for a few days then suddenly stops, forcing them back to password entry every time they open the app. It's happened to at least 11 people out of our 174 seats so far this month, mostly on newer Android devices. No crash logs that we can see on our end, it just silently falls back to the password screen.
answer: Thanks for the detailed pattern - the fact that it's concentrated on newer Android devices suggests this may be tied to a biometric key invalidation issue after certain OS security updates. I'm requesting device model and OS version details for a few of the affected drivers so we can reproduce this on our end, and in the meantime the password fallback should continue working as a safe workaround. I'll keep you posted as we dig into the biometric session handling on Android.

subject: Workspace settings reverted overnight - allowlist and audit log config wiped
body: This morning I logged into the Admin Console and noticed our IP allowlist is empty and our audit log retention setting has reverted from 1 year back to the default 30 days. Neither of these were changed by anyone on our team as far as I can tell - I checked with our two other admins and nobody touched these settings yesterday. We need the allowlist restored urgently since it's part of our security controls for finance operations.
answer: I understand the urgency given this affects your security controls, and I'm escalating this immediately. I'm pulling the audit log history for your workspace now to identify exactly when and how the allowlist and retention settings changed, since an unprompted revert like this needs to be traced rather than just reset. I'll restore your IP allowlist and 1-year retention setting right away and follow up with what caused the change once I have the audit trail.

subject: ALL TRANSFORMS FAILING - PRODUCTION DOWN
body:
This is completely unacceptable. Every single transform job in our pipeline has been failing since 6:40am with error 'CONNECTOR_TIMEOUT: upstream latency exceeded 30000ms threshold'. We have 248 seats on this platform and NOTHING is syncing. Our education data feeds to partner institutions are stale and we're going to breach contractual SLAs by noon.

We've restarted the connectors three times, cleared cache, nothing works. Job IDs pipe-88213, pipe-88214, pipe-88215 all show status FAILED with the same latency error. This has been going on for almost 2 hours now with zero acknowledgement from your side. Fix this NOW or we're canceling our contract.
answer:
I understand the severity here and I'm escalating this to our data pipeline on-call team immediately as a P0 incident. We're pulling logs for pipe-88213 through 88215 right now to identify the root cause of the connector timeout - initial indicators point to a latency spike on one of our upstream sync nodes that's affecting a subset of Pro tier customers.

I'll post updates every 20 minutes in this ticket until resolved, and we'll follow up with a full root cause analysis once service is restored. Thank you for your patience while we work this urgently.

subject: webhoks completly down, no events comming thru
body:
hey we are seeing zero webhook deliverys since about 9am today, our order status updates rely on this and now nothing is syncin to our warehouse system. checked the dashbord and it shows all recent webhook attemps as 'failed - 503' for endpint /orders/status.

also noticed a banner about webhook SDK v1 depreciation, is that releated?? we didnt change anything on are side. this is affecting all 16 of our users, please help asap this is urgent for us, we ship orders daily and cant confirm anything right now.
answer:
Thanks for flagging this right away - I can see the 503 errors on your /orders/status endpoint starting around 09:04 UTC and this is currently affecting multiple accounts, so we've opened it as a P0 outage on our webhook delivery service. This is unrelated to the SDK v1 deprecation notice, which only affects client library support and has no bearing on webhook delivery itself.

Our platform team is actively working the fix and I'll update you as soon as deliveries resume; in the meantime, all failed webhook events are being queued and will be redelivered automatically once service is restored, so you shouldn't lose any order data.

subject: Connector authentication expiring frequently on NetSuite sync
body:
Our finance team relies on the NetSuite connector within Data Pipelines to pull invoice data nightly, but over the past week the connector authentication has expired three separate times (Jan 14, Jan 17, and Jan 19), each requiring a manual re-auth before the sync would resume. This is causing delays of several hours in our reporting each time it happens.

Could you let us know if there's a way to extend the token lifespan or set up a notification before the auth expires? We'd also appreciate any guidance on best practices for connector maintenance to avoid this going forward, since it's affecting sync latency for our 237 users across the finance and ops teams.
answer:
Thanks for the detailed history - repeated auth expiry on the NetSuite connector is usually caused by a refresh token rotation setting on the NetSuite side that's shorter than our default renewal window. I'm escalating this to our pipelines team to review your connector's token configuration and see if we can extend the renewal interval.

In the meantime, I'd recommend enabling the 'pre-expiry alert' option under Connector Settings > Notifications, which will email your admin 48 hours before a token lapses. We'll follow up within one business day with a permanent fix recommendation.

subject: Salesforce sync showing duplicate contacts
body:
I noticed our Salesforce integration has been creating duplicate contact records over the past few days - specifically for records updated in both Salesforce and Slack around the same time. We have 4 users on our workspace and this is a minor annoyance rather than blocking anything, but I'd like to understand why it's happening.

Can you check if there's a dedup setting we're missing on the sync configuration? Not urgent, just want to clean this up before it gets worse.
answer:
Thanks for reporting this - duplicate contact creation usually happens when the sync matches records by email only rather than a combination of email and external ID. I'd suggest checking Integrations > Salesforce > Field Mapping and enabling 'Match by External ID' if it isn't already active, which should prevent new duplicates going forward.

For the existing duplicates, I can send over a dedup script or walk you through a manual merge - let me know which you'd prefer and we'll get this cleaned up.

subject: SCIM provisioning not deactivating users, permissions stuck
body:
We're seeing an issue with SCIM provisioning where users deactivated in our identity provider aren't getting deactivated in Northwind - we found 6 accounts still showing as active status days after being removed on our side, including two with admin permissions. This is a real risk for us given MFA is tied to those accounts.

Can someone from your team look into why the SCIM deprovisioning calls aren't going through? We'd also like to know if this needs to be escalated internally given the security implications for our 80-seat org.
answer:
This is an important issue and I'm escalating it to our identity team right away given the permissions and MFA exposure you've described. Could you send us the SCIM request logs or timestamps for the 6 affected accounts, along with your IdP provider name, so we can trace whether the deprovisioning webhook calls are failing on send or on receipt?

In the meantime, as a precaution I'd recommend manually deactivating those 6 accounts, particularly the two with admin permissions, until we confirm the root cause. We'll keep this ticket open until we've verified provisioning is working correctly end to end.

subject: urgent
body:
WE HAVE BEEN USING NORTHWIND NOTIFICATIONS FOR OUR ALERT ROUTING SETUP FOR ABOUT 8 MONTHS NOW AND IT HAS GENERALLY WORKED FINE FOR OUR SMALL TEAM. WE SET UP CUSTOM ROUTING RULES LAST QUARTER TO SEND CRITICAL ALERTS TO OUR ON CALL ENGINEER AND EVERYTHING SEEMED STABLE UNTIL RECENTLY.

STARTING TWO DAYS AGO WE ARE GETTING EVERY SINGLE ALERT DUPLICATED THREE TO FOUR TIMES IN A ROW SENT TO THE SAME ON CALL PERSON, AND SOME ALERTS ARE ARRIVING 10 TO 15 MINUTES LATE. OUR ENGINEER IS GETTING FLOODED WITH DUPLICATE PAGES FOR THE SAME INCIDENT AND WE ARE WORRIED WE WILL MISS A REAL CRITICAL ALERT BECAUSE OF THE NOISE. THIS IS AFFECTING ALL 14 OF OUR USERS AND NEEDS TO BE FIXED FAST.
answer:
Thanks for the detailed report - duplicate and delayed alert delivery is a serious issue for on-call reliability, so I've escalated this as P1. Can you confirm the routing rule name(s) affected and roughly how many duplicate deliveries per alert you're seeing, along with a timestamp of one recent example?

In parallel, our team is checking for a known issue with alert queue retries that can cause duplicate sends under certain latency conditions - we'll have an update within a couple of hours and will notify you as soon as we identify the fix.

subject: Feature request: option to disable duplicate email digests
body:
Our finance team currently receives daily email digests from Notifications, but several team members are also subscribed to individual alert emails, resulting in the same information arriving twice - once in the digest and once as a standalone alert. It's not urgent, just a bit redundant for a team of our size across 1558 seats.

Would it be possible to add a setting that suppresses individual alert emails for items already included in a scheduled digest? This would help cut down on inbox clutter for our finance and ops teams.
answer:
This is a great suggestion and one we've heard from a few other Enterprise customers as well. I've logged this as a feature request with our Notifications product team - suppressing individually-sent alerts that are already covered by a scheduled digest would indeed reduce duplication.

In the meantime, as a workaround you could have affected users unsubscribe from individual alert types they've already covered via digest under Notification Preferences > Email, though I understand that's not a full fix. I'll update this ticket once we have news on the roadmap timing.

subject: Dashboard charts failing to render for entire operations team
body:
Since yesterday afternoon, several of our key dashboards have been showing broken charts - specifically the shipment volume and warehouse throughput widgets return a blank panel with 'Error loading chart data' instead of rendering. This is affecting our operations team across all our logistics locations and we rely on these dashboards for daily planning decisions.

The issue is consistent across multiple browsers and multiple team members, so it doesn't appear to be a local caching problem. We have around 1194 users who may be impacted once the rest of the team logs in this morning. Dashboard IDs affected include ops-warehouse-42 and ops-shipvol-17.
answer:
Thank you for flagging this with the specific dashboard IDs - I've escalated ops-warehouse-42 and ops-shipvol-17 to our dashboards engineering team as P1 given the operational impact across your team. Initial checks suggest this may be tied to a recent data source refresh issue affecting chart rendering for certain aggregated widgets.

We're actively investigating and I'll provide an update within the next hour. If you have any other dashboard IDs showing the same error, please send them over so we can confirm scope and check whether the issue is isolated to these two widgets or broader.

subject: Audit log completely inaccessible, need for compliance review
body:
We are in the middle of a compliance review and just discovered that the Admin Console audit log page is returning a blank screen with no data loading at all - this started sometime this morning. We need to pull deactivation records and allowlist changes for the past 90 days for an internal security audit due today, and right now we have zero visibility into any admin actions.

This is a critical gap for our compliance obligations. Can someone confirm whether this is a known outage and get the audit log restored as soon as possible? We have a 22-person team but this specifically affects our ability to complete a required security review.
answer:
I understand the urgency given your compliance deadline, and I've flagged this as a P0 to our Security and Compliance engineering team immediately. We're checking whether this is part of a broader audit log service disruption or isolated to your account, and will confirm scope within the next 30 minutes.

While we investigate, if you need the deactivation and allowlist change records urgently for today's review, let us know and we can have our team pull a manual export from backend logs to bridge the gap until the audit log UI is restored.

subject: Question about applying account credit toward next invoice
body:
We recently received a service credit note from a support case a few weeks back and I want to confirm how that credit will be applied - will it automatically offset our next invoice, or do we need to request it manually? We're currently on the Starter plan with a small team of 3 seats, and I just want to make sure our upcoming payment reflects the correct amount.

Also, could you clarify your refund policy in case we ever need to request one for an overcharge? Just want to have this documented for our records.
answer:
Thanks for reaching out - service credits are applied automatically to the next invoice generated after the credit is issued, so you should see it reflected as a line item deduction on your upcoming bill without needing to request anything manually. If for some reason it doesn't appear on your next invoice, just let us know and we'll apply it directly.

Regarding refunds, our policy allows for a full refund review on confirmed overcharges within 30 days of the billing date - I'm happy to send over the full policy documentation for your records if that would help.

subject: Old backup files not purged after retention period
body: I'm the finance manager here and I noticed our Storage retention policy is set to purge backups older than 90 days, but when I checked the backup console on March 4th, files from December 2023 are still sitting there. Our storage quota is now at 92% and I'm worried we'll hit the cap before next month's audit. Can someone check why the retention job isn't cleaning these up, and point me to documentation on how the purge schedule actually works?
answer: Thanks for flagging this, and I understand the quota pressure given your audit timeline. This looks like the retention purge job may have stalled on your account, so I'm opening an investigation into the job logs for Ember Analytics now and will confirm within one business day whether it's a one-off failure or a bug affecting the schedule. I'll also send over the retention policy documentation so you have a clear reference while we resolve this.

subject: Jira integration link fails during setup
body: I'm trying to connect our Jira instance under Integrations so billing tickets can sync automatically, but every time I click 'Connect' it redirects back with an error saying the OAuth callback URL doesn't match. This worked fine when we tested Slack a few weeks ago, so I don't think it's a firewall issue on our end. Can you check whether the Jira connector configuration changed recently?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. We did push an update to the Jira connector's OAuth callback handling last week, so it's possible the registered redirect URI needs to be refreshed on your integration record. I'm checking the connector logs for Granite Academy now and will let you know shortly whether we need to regenerate the connection on our side or if there's a config step needed in your Jira admin console.

subject: Transformationen schlagen bei mehreren Pipelines fehl
body: Seit dem 2. Mai brechen bei uns mehrere Data Pipelines während der Transform-Phase ab, betroffen sind vor allem die Sync-Jobs für unsere Lager-Connectoren. Die Fehlermeldung zeigt 'transform step exited with code 137', und die Latenz der letzten erfolgreichen Läufe ist auf über 40 Minuten gestiegen. Das betrifft mittlerweile rund 15 unserer 30 aktiven Pipelines und wirkt sich direkt auf unsere Bestandsdaten aus.
answer: Vielen Dank für die genaue Beschreibung, das klingt nach einem Speicherproblem im Transform-Container, der Exit-Code 137 deutet auf ein Out-of-Memory-Ereignis hin. Wir sehen uns die betroffenen Pipelines von Quill Retail jetzt vorrangig an und prüfen, ob eine aktuelle Connector-Version dafür verantwortlich ist. Wir melden uns innerhalb der nächsten Stunden mit einem Zwischenstand, da dies Priorität P1 hat.

subject: Storage quota hit, uploads failing across workspace
body: As of this morning our storage quota shows 100% used and every upload attempt returns 'Error: quota exceeded, contact support to increase limit.' This is blocking our product photo pipeline for retail listings that need to go live today. We haven't changed our retention settings recently, so I'm not sure why usage jumped so suddenly overnight.
answer: I'm sorry for the disruption this is causing right before your listings go live. I've escalated this to our storage team as a P1 issue given the outage impact, and we're pulling usage logs for Orion Travel to identify what drove the sudden spike, whether it's a retention misconfiguration or a bug in quota calculation. In the meantime we're applying a temporary quota increase so uploads can resume while we investigate the root cause.

subject: Need to restore deleted files from backup, urgent
body: We accidentally deleted a batch of shipment records from our storage bucket during a cleanup script run this morning, roughly 3,200 files under the /logistics/2024-manifests/ path. I can see backups listed from last night at 11:40 PM in the console, but I need help restoring specifically that folder rather than the entire bucket snapshot. This data feeds our daily reconciliation report due by end of day.
answer: Thanks for the precise path and timestamp, that will help us move quickly. I'm initiating a scoped restore from the 11:40 PM backup snapshot for the /logistics/2024-manifests/ folder on Harbor Systems' account now rather than a full bucket restore, and I'll confirm once the files are back in place. Given your end-of-day deadline, I'll keep this open as P1 and update you as soon as the restore job completes.

subject: Customizing push notification settings for mobile app
body: As the workspace admin, I'd like to know if there's a way to let individual users customize which push notifications they receive on the mobile app, right now it seems like everyone gets every alert type. A few of our field staff have mentioned the volume of notifications is distracting during shifts. Is per-category notification control something we could enable, or is it on the roadmap?
answer: Thanks for reaching out about this. Currently the mobile app sends all notification categories by default without granular per-user controls, but I can confirm this is a frequently requested feature and I'm logging it for our product team with your use case attached. In the meantime, users can mute notifications entirely from their device settings if the volume becomes too disruptive.

subject: Scheduled syncs not triggering at configured times
body: I've set up a scheduled sync in our Data Pipelines config to run every day at 6:00 AM UTC via the API, but looking at the run history it's firing inconsistently, sometimes at 6:00, sometimes not until 9:40 or later. The cron expression is '0 6 * * *' and I've double checked the timezone setting is UTC. This delay is pushing our downstream reporting jobs back by hours.
answer: Thanks for including the cron expression and timezone details, that helps narrow this down. We've seen a similar scheduling drift reported for a subset of accounts tied to a recent worker queue change, so I'm checking Delta Analytics' scheduler logs to confirm if you're affected by that issue or something specific to your configuration. I'll follow up with findings and a fix timeline shortly since this is impacting your downstream reporting.

subject: SCIM provisioning stopped syncing new and removed users
body: Our SCIM integration with our IdP appears to have stopped working sometime yesterday. New employees added to the relevant group aren't showing up in Northwind, and worse, three users we offboarded on Monday still have active accounts with full permissions. This is a serious access control gap for us and I need it fixed as soon as possible.
answer: I understand the urgency here, especially with offboarded users retaining active access, and I've escalated this to P1 with our identity team immediately. We're pulling the SCIM sync logs for Orion Travel now to identify where the sync is failing, and as an immediate mitigation I'd recommend manually deactivating those three accounts from the admin console while we resolve the root cause. I'll update you within the hour.

subject: OVERCHARGED AGAIN - seat count is WRONG
body: This is the second month in a row our invoice shows 27 seats billed when we only have 20 active users on the account, I've checked the admin panel three times and it clearly says 20. I already emailed about this last month and got a generic response with no fix and no refund for the overcharge. If this isn't corrected and refunded this time I'm cancelling our plan and moving to a competitor, we're done being patient.
answer: I completely understand your frustration, being billed incorrectly two months running with no resolution is not the experience we want for Pioneer Retail. I'm pulling your account's seat history right now to confirm the discrepancy between the 20 active users and the 27 billed, and I'm processing a refund adjustment for the overcharged amount on both invoices once confirmed. I'll have a resolution and confirmation to you within 24 hours, not another generic reply.

subject: SAML login failing after IdP metadata update
body: We updated our IdP's SAML metadata last week to rotate our signing certificate, and since then every user attempting SSO login gets redirected back to Northwind with 'SAML response validation failed.' I've re-uploaded the new metadata XML into our SSO configuration but the error persists. Only five of us use this account so it's blocking the whole team from logging in.
answer: Thanks for the details on the certificate rotation timing, that's a helpful clue. Sometimes the metadata upload doesn't fully refresh the cached signing certificate on our side, so I'm manually clearing and reloading the SAML configuration for Atlas Partners now. I'll confirm once that's done and ask you to test a login again, and if the validation error persists we'll dig into the SAML response trace directly.

subject: Scheduled syncs delayed 3+ hours across all connectors
body:
We're seeing scheduled syncs for our Salesforce and Postgres connectors running 3-4 hours behind schedule since yesterday, June 4th. Normally these sync every 30 minutes but our dashboard shows the last successful run at 06:15 UTC and nothing since. We have 6 pipelines affected, and downstream billing reports are now stale.

Can you check if there's a queue backlog on your end? This is impacting our fintech reconciliation process and we need latency back to normal ASAP.
answer: Thanks for flagging this, and I understand the urgency given the reconciliation impact. We can see elevated queue depth on the sync scheduler starting around 05:40 UTC today, likely tied to a backend worker scaling issue affecting multiple pipelines including yours. Our engineering team is actively working to clear the backlog and restore normal 30-minute intervals; I'll update you within the hour with progress and an ETA.

subject: Zapier integration failing to trigger from new Jira tickets
body:
Our Zap that creates a Northwind notification whenever a new Jira ticket is tagged 'urgent' stopped firing on June 2nd. I checked the Zap history and it shows 'Error: 401 Unauthorized' on the Northwind action step even though our API key hasn't changed. We use this to alert our Slack channel for travel booking escalations, so we're missing critical alerts.

Could someone check if our API key or OAuth token expired on the Northwind side? We haven't touched the Zapier config in months.
answer: Sorry for the disruption to your escalation workflow. Looking at your account, it appears the API key used by this Zap was rotated automatically on June 1st as part of a routine security refresh, which would explain the 401 errors. I've generated a fresh key for you and sent instructions on updating the Zapier connection - once you swap it in, the Zap should resume triggering normally. Let us know if you still see errors after updating it.

subject: Duplicate alerts being sent to same email routing rule
body:
We've noticed that alert routing rules for our 'Price Anomaly' notification type are sending duplicate emails - each triggered alert results in 2 identical emails to the same recipient group within seconds of each other. This started around May 28th after we added a second routing rule for our EU team, but it's happening for all 293 seats, not just EU.

Could you help us either fix the duplication or point us to a way to de-duplicate at the rule level? It's cluttering inboxes and causing confusion among our travel ops analysts.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report - duplicate delivery like this is usually caused by overlapping routing rule conditions matching the same alert event twice. I'd like to review your 'Price Anomaly' rule configuration and the new EU rule you added on May 28th to confirm that's the cause. In the meantime, as a workaround you could add an exclusion condition to the EU rule so it doesn't overlap with the global one; I'll follow up with specific rule changes once I've reviewed your setup.

subject: Connector auth token not refreshing for Shopify sync
body:
Our Shopify connector keeps failing with 'invalid_grant: token expired' every 3-4 days, requiring us to manually re-authenticate each time. This has happened four times now since May 20th, and each failure pauses our inventory sync pipeline for retail data until someone on our team notices and reconnects it.

Is there a way to enable automatic token refresh for this connector, or is this a known bug? We'd like a permanent fix rather than continuing to babysit the connection manually.
answer: This does sound like the refresh token isn't being renewed properly on our end for the Shopify connector - we've seen a similar issue reported for a few Pro accounts recently. I'm escalating this to our connector team to investigate why the auto-refresh cycle isn't triggering before expiration, and I'll also check your specific connector logs from the May 20th failure onward. I'll update you within 2 business days with findings and, if it's confirmed as a bug, a timeline for the fix.

subject: Dashboards taking 20+ seconds to load for our team
body:
Several of our dashboards, especially the 'Weekly Freight Volume' one, have been taking 20-30 seconds to load over the past week. We only have 12 seats so it's not a huge user base, but it's affecting daily standup where we walk through the numbers live. Export to PDF is also timing out for the same dashboard.

Is there a way to optimize load times, maybe by reducing widget count or changing date range defaults? Any guidance would help since this is becoming disruptive to our routine.
answer: Thanks for the details - slow-loading dashboards like this are often tied to widgets pulling large unfiltered date ranges or too many concurrent chart queries. I'd suggest starting by narrowing the default date range on the 'Weekly Freight Volume' dashboard and checking if any widgets are set to 'all time' rather than a rolling window, which tends to cause the export timeouts too. I'm also taking a look at your account's dashboard configs directly and will follow up with specific recommendations to speed things up.

subject: Charts showing no data after API integration update
body:
After updating our API integration yesterday to the latest endpoint version, all charts on our main operations dashboard are now showing blank/empty states with no error message. The underlying data still returns fine when I query the API directly - I tested with GET /v2/metrics/energy-usage and got a valid 200 response with data. This is affecting our whole team's ability to monitor energy metrics in real time.

We need this fixed urgently since our energy monitoring dashboards are core to daily operations. Please advise if this is a known issue with the new endpoint version.
answer: This is a priority for us given the impact on your live monitoring - thank you for including the API test details, that's very helpful. It sounds like the dashboard rendering layer may not be mapping the new endpoint's response schema correctly, which would explain why the API call succeeds but the chart shows no data. I'm escalating this immediately to our dashboards team and will keep you posted with updates as we investigate; in the meantime, if you have a previous integration version available, reverting temporarily may restore chart data while we resolve this.

subject: Request to add IP ranges to allowlist and review audit log
body:
We need to add three new office IP ranges to our admin allowlist ahead of a team move next week - 203.0.113.0/24, 198.51.100.0/24, and 192.0.2.0/24. When I tried adding the first range through the admin console yesterday, it accepted the entry but the change didn't appear in the audit log, and I'm not sure if it's actually active for our 622 seats.

Could you confirm whether the allowlist update took effect, and let us know if there's a way to see pending vs. active entries in the console? We also want to deactivate two old ranges that are no longer in use.
answer: Thanks for flagging this - allowlist changes should always appear in the audit log immediately, so the fact that yours didn't show up suggests the update may not have saved correctly. I'm checking your account configuration now to confirm the current active ranges and will verify whether the three new ranges you listed are actually enforced. I'll also walk you through deactivating the two old ranges once we've confirmed the allowlist state is accurate.

subject: Bar charts on finance dashboard rendering incorrectly
body:
The bar charts on our 'Monthly Spend' dashboard have been displaying incorrect values since Tuesday - the totals shown don't match what's in the underlying report when I export the same data to CSV. For example, the dashboard shows $84,200 for May but the CSV export shows $91,750 for the same period and filters.

Could someone take a look at why the chart rendering doesn't match the raw data? I need accurate numbers for a finance review this Friday.
answer: Thank you for catching this discrepancy and providing the specific numbers - that's very useful for tracking down the issue. A mismatch like this between the chart display and CSV export usually points to a caching or aggregation bug on the chart rendering side rather than the underlying data itself. I'm looking into your 'Monthly Spend' dashboard configuration now and will prioritize getting this resolved before your Friday review; I'll follow up as soon as I have an update.

subject: Dashboard load times critically slow after API update - blocking release
body:
Since integrating the latest Dashboards API version this morning, every dashboard in our environment takes 15+ seconds to render, and several with chart-heavy layouts are timing out entirely with 'Request timeout after 30000ms' errors. We rely on embedding these dashboards in our internal portal for 303 users and this is currently blocking our release scheduled for today.

We've confirmed the issue started right after the API update - our staging environment on the previous API version doesn't show this problem. Please treat this as urgent as it's affecting a company-wide rollout.
answer: I understand the urgency given your release timeline, and thank you for isolating this to the API version update - that's a critical clue. This matches a performance regression our team is currently tracking in the latest Dashboards API release related to chart query batching. I'm escalating this to P1 immediately and will loop in engineering directly; we'll provide either a hotfix or a recommended rollback path to the previous API version within the next few hours to unblock your release.

subject: Cannot restore files from backup - restore job stuck at 0%
body:
We triggered a restore from our May 30th backup snapshot after accidentally deleting a folder of shipment records this morning, but the restore job has been stuck at 0% progress for over an hour now. The job ID is restore-4471-a9. We're a small ops team and this data is needed for a compliance audit due tomorrow morning.

This is urgent - please help us get the restore moving or confirm whether the backup snapshot itself is intact. We can't afford to lose this data permanently.
answer: I completely understand the urgency here given the compliance deadline, and I want to reassure you that your May 30th snapshot is still intact on our storage systems. I'm escalating restore job restore-4471-a9 to our infrastructure team right now to investigate why it's stalled at 0% - this is likely a queue processing issue rather than data loss. I'll update you within the next 30 minutes with either a resolution or a manual restore path we can trigger on our end.

subject: SAML SSO login failing for all users - P1
body:
Since this morning around 9:15 AM, none of our 16 users can log in through SAML SSO. The login page redirects to our IdP, authenticates fine, but then bounces back to Northwind with error "SAML_RESPONSE_INVALID: signature mismatch". This is blocking our entire team from accessing dashboards and billing data ahead of a client review at noon.

We haven't changed anything on our IdP side recently. Can someone check if the SAML certificate on Northwind's end expired or rotated? We need this resolved urgently since it's affecting all 16 seats.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report - I can see the certificate rotation that went out to your tenant last night didn't sync correctly with your IdP metadata, which is causing the signature mismatch. I'm escalating this to our identity team right now and will push a fix to re-sync the certificate on our side within the hour. I'll update you as soon as logins are restored, and we'll follow up with root cause once resolved.

subject: Speicher-Retention löscht Backups zu früh
body:
Uns ist aufgefallen, dass unsere Backup-Dateien im Storage-Modul nach nur 7 Tagen gelöscht werden, obwohl wir die Aufbewahrungsfrist auf 30 Tage eingestellt haben. Betroffen sind mindestens 4 Backup-Sets vom 3., 5., 8. und 10. dieses Monats, die wir für die Buchhaltung benötigen.

Das Kontingent zeigt zwar noch freien Speicherplatz an, aber die älteren Dateien sind trotzdem verschwunden. Können Sie prüfen, ob es sich um einen Fehler in der Retention-Konfiguration handelt?
answer: Vielen Dank für die Meldung. Das klingt nach einem Fehler in der Retention-Engine, den wir uns sofort ansehen - es gab gestern ein Update, das die Ablaufberechnung bei einigen Starter-Konten falsch gesetzt hat. Wir prüfen, ob die gelöschten Backup-Sets vom 3., 5., 8. und 10. noch wiederherstellbar sind, und melden uns innerhalb der nächsten Stunden mit einem Status-Update.

subject: Customers still receiving emails after unsubscribing
body:
We've had a handful of customers report that they unsubscribed from our promotional email list through the Notifications preference center, but they're still receiving duplicate campaign emails a week later. One customer flagged that they clicked unsubscribe on March 4th and got the same newsletter again on March 11th and March 12th.

Could you confirm whether unsubscribe requests are actually being synced to the sending queue, or if there's a delay we should be aware of? This isn't urgent but we want to make sure we're not violating any compliance requirements.
answer: Thanks for flagging this - unsubscribe preferences should sync to the send queue within a few minutes, so a week-long delay isn't expected behavior. I'll pull the logs for the customer records you mentioned to see if their unsubscribe events were processed correctly or got stuck in a retry loop, and I'll follow up with findings and next steps.

subject: Push notifications not reaching iOS users on our team
body:
Our IT team has noticed that push notifications for approvals and mentions stopped arriving on iOS devices for about half our staff starting last week. Android users seem fine. We've confirmed notification permissions are enabled on the devices and the app is updated to the latest version from the App Store.

Could you look into whether there's an issue with APNs certificate delivery on Northwind's mobile backend? We'd also like to request the ability to configure notification categories separately for approvals vs. general mentions, since right now everything comes through as one type.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. We'll check the APNs delivery logs for your tenant to see if there's a certificate or token registration issue affecting iOS specifically - that's a solid lead given the Android/iOS split you're seeing. I'll also pass along your request for separate notification categories to our product team as a feature request and let you know once we have an update on the delivery issue.

subject: workspace settings page won't save
body: Settings page spins forever, never saves changes.
answer: Sorry for the trouble - could you tell me which specific setting you're trying to update and share a screenshot or the browser console error if one appears? In the meantime I'll check our logs for save failures on your workspace over the last 24 hours to see if this is a broader issue.

subject: Scheduled syncs from ERP connector delayed by hours
body:
Our nightly sync job pulling inventory data from our ERP connector has been running 3-5 hours late every day since last Tuesday. It's scheduled for 2:00 AM but logs show it kicking off closer to 6:00 AM or 7:00 AM, which is causing our morning reports to show stale data.

We checked the connector status and it shows "healthy" with no errors, but the latency is impacting our operations team's ability to make stock decisions before shift start. Job IDs from the past three runs are sync-88213, sync-88304, and sync-88391 if that helps you trace the issue.
answer: Thanks for the job IDs - that will help us trace this quickly. Delayed start times with a healthy connector status usually point to a scheduler queue backlog on our end rather than an issue with your ERP connection. I'm pulling the scheduler logs around 2:00 AM for the past week now and will update you with findings and an ETA for a fix within the next few hours.

subject: Question about MFA enrolment requirement for new hires
body:
We're onboarding a batch of new finance staff next month and I want to confirm how MFA enrolment works during provisioning. Does Northwind automatically require MFA setup on first login for new SSO users, or do we need to configure a specific enforcement policy in the admin console?

We currently have SSO provisioning set up through our IdP, and I want to avoid a situation where new accounts can access billing data without completing MFA. Is there documentation that walks through the enrolment flow and enforcement settings?
answer: Good question - MFA enrolment isn't automatically enforced by default, it depends on the enforcement policy set under Security settings in the admin console. I'll send over our documentation link that covers configuring mandatory MFA enrolment for SSO-provisioned users, including how to set a grace period before access is restricted. Let me know if you'd like a quick walkthrough on a call as well.

subject: Slack integration not posting alerts - urgent for our on-call team
body:
Our Slack alerts integration stopped posting incident notifications to our #ops-alerts channel starting yesterday afternoon around 3:30 PM. We rely on this for our on-call rotation and haven't received a single alert since, which means our team may have missed critical incidents overnight.

We haven't changed our Slack workspace permissions or the integration config recently. The integration status in the admin panel still shows "Connected" with a green checkmark, but nothing is coming through. This is urgent since we have production systems depending on these alerts.
answer: This is a priority for us given the on-call impact - I'm escalating immediately. A green "Connected" status while messages aren't posting usually points to a token or webhook issue on the Slack side that isn't being reflected in our health check. We're pulling the integration logs now to identify where the messages are failing and will have an update for you within the hour, along with a temporary workaround if needed.

subject: Pagination behavior change on /v2/records endpoint
body:
We noticed that the pagination cursor returned by the /v2/records endpoint changed behavior sometime after March 1st - previously the 'next_cursor' field would be null when we hit the last page, but now it returns an empty string instead. This broke our SDK's loop termination logic since we were checking for null explicitly.

Was this an intentional change? If so, it would be great to have this documented in the API changelog or deprecation notices going forward, since it caused a minor outage in our reporting pipeline until we patched around it.
answer: Thanks for catching this and sorry for the disruption to your reporting pipeline. This does look like an unintended side effect of a recent update to the pagination logic rather than an intentional change - I'll confirm with our API team and get this corrected or properly documented as a deprecation if it's meant to stay. I'll follow up with a timeline once I hear back from engineering.

subject: Mobile app crashes immediately on launch after update
body:
Since updating to the latest app version yesterday, the mobile app crashes within a second of opening for several of our users on both Android and iOS. It never gets past the splash screen. We've had at least 6 reports from our team so far, all on different device models.

Uninstalling and reinstalling doesn't fix it. Can you confirm if there's a known issue with the latest release, and whether we should roll back to a previous version in the meantime? We'd also appreciate updated documentation on how to check app version compatibility going forward.
answer: Thanks for reporting this with the device details - we've had a couple other reports of crash-on-launch behavior tied to the latest release, likely related to a config fetch failure on first load. We recommend holding off on updating further devices for now while we investigate, and I'll send you a rollback link for the previous stable version as a stopgap. I'll keep you posted on the fix timeline and will also flag the compatibility documentation gap to our docs team.

subject: Upload failures to Storage since last night - quota or retention issue?
body:
We're seeing repeated upload failures on our backup jobs into Northwind Storage starting around 22:40 UTC last night. The job for our travel-bookings-backup bucket fails with 'upload rejected: quota exceeded or retention policy conflict' even though our dashboard shows we're at 68% of quota. This is affecting 3 of our 12 scheduled backup jobs, job IDs BK-4471, BK-4472 and BK-4480.

We need to confirm whether a retention policy change on our end triggered this, since we updated our retention rules to 90 days on Tuesday. Can someone check if there's a quota calculation lag or a retention lock preventing new writes?
answer: Thanks for the detailed job IDs, that helps us narrow this down quickly. We can see a retention lock was applied to the affected bucket right after your policy update on Tuesday, and it's conflicting with new writes until the old objects age out of the previous 30-day retention window - this is a known edge case when shortening retention windows mid-cycle. We're clearing the lock manually on our side now and will confirm once BK-4471, 4472 and 4480 can write successfully, expect an update within the hour.

subject: SCIM provisioning stuck - new hires can't log in
body:
Our HR system pushed 6 new employee records through SCIM yesterday afternoon, but none of them show up in Northwind Identity as active users. When they try to log in via SSO they get 'account not found'. We rely on SCIM to auto-provision within minutes and this has never taken more than 15 minutes before.

This is blocking new hires from accessing any Northwind products including billing and dashboards. Can you check our SCIM sync logs? Our tenant is lumen-analytics-prod.
answer: This is impacting new employee access so we're treating it as urgent and have escalated to our identity engineering team right now. We've pulled the SCIM sync logs for lumen-analytics-prod and can see the last successful sync completed at 14:02 UTC yesterday with the 6 records queued but stuck in a retry loop due to a timeout on our provisioning worker - we're restarting the queue manually and will confirm once all 6 accounts show active, which should be within the next 30 minutes.

subject: Scheduled syncs skipping records from our EHR connector
body:
We've noticed our scheduled sync from the EHR connector (runs every 4 hours) has been silently dropping records over the past week. Comparing our source system counts to what lands in the pipeline, we're missing roughly 40-60 patient records per run without any error showing in the sync history.

The last sync at 09:00 today processed 2,140 records but our source had 2,196. This is a data quality concern for us given the healthcare context. Could you look into whether there's a pagination or timeout issue on the connector side, and let us know if there's a way to get alerted when record counts mismatch like this?
answer: Thank you for flagging the specific counts, that mismatch pattern is really helpful for diagnosis. We suspect this is related to a pagination limit on the EHR connector that can silently truncate results when the source API returns paged responses slower than expected - we're reviewing the connector logs for your last 5 sync runs now to confirm. In the meantime, we'll follow up with a fix timeline and will also pass along your request for mismatch alerting as a feature suggestion to our pipelines team.

subject: Requesting credit for double-charged invoice and seat adjustment
body:
Our March invoice (INV-88213) charged us for 115 seats, but we reduced our seat count to 98 on March 3rd after a team restructuring. I can see the seat reduction confirmed in our admin console, but the invoice still reflects the old count. We were charged $4,830 more than expected.

Could you issue a credit for the difference and confirm our April invoice will reflect the correct 98 seats? Happy to send a screenshot of the admin console seat count if useful.
answer: Thanks for including the invoice number, that let us verify this quickly on our end. You're right that the seat reduction on March 3rd wasn't reflected in the March billing cycle due to a sync delay between your admin console and our billing system - we've confirmed the overcharge and are issuing a credit of $4,830 to your account, which will appear on your April invoice. We've also corrected the seat count going forward so April will bill correctly at 98 seats.

subject: Push notifications causing app crashes on Android
body:
Since updating to the latest Northwind mobile app version (3.4.1), our field team has reported the app crashing whenever a push notification arrives while the app is in the background. This is happening on Android devices specifically, we've reproduced it on 4 different Samsung and Pixel phones.

The crash seems tied to shipment-alert notifications specifically, we get about 30-40 of these per day across our team. Is this a known issue with 3.4.1? We'd like to know if there's a workaround or if a fix is coming, since this is disrupting our logistics tracking workflow.
answer: Thanks for the reproduction details across multiple devices, that's very useful. We've seen a couple of similar reports tied to the 3.4.1 Android release and our mobile team is actively investigating a crash related to notification payload handling in the background state. We don't have a confirmed root cause yet, but we'll update this ticket as soon as we have a fix or a safe workaround, and recommend disabling background app refresh for shipment-alert notifications in the meantime as a temporary mitigation.

subject: Slack integration not posting alerts - all channels affected
body:
Our Slack integration for Northwind alerts stopped posting to any of our channels as of this morning around 8:15 AM. We use this to route API error alerts and billing notifications to our #ops-alerts channel, and nothing has come through in over 3 hours despite us seeing active alerts in the Northwind dashboard.

We haven't changed anything on the Slack app permissions or the Northwind integration settings recently. Can you check if there's an outage on the integration side? This is blocking our whole ops team from seeing critical alerts.
answer: We're sorry for the disruption to your ops workflow and are looking into this immediately. We've identified an issue with our Slack integration's webhook delivery service that started around 8:00 AM affecting a subset of customers, and our engineering team is actively working on a fix - we'll post updates here as we have them and expect resolution within the next hour. As a temporary workaround, you can check alert status directly in the Northwind dashboard until Slack delivery is restored.

subject: Slack alerts for API errors have stopped since yesterday
body:
Our integration between Northwind and Slack, which posts real-time alerts for API failures to our #eng-alerts channel, went silent starting yesterday at approximately 6:00 PM. We rely on this heavily since our team monitors payment API errors through Slack rather than logging into the dashboard constantly.

We checked our Slack app permissions and they look fine, and the integration still shows as 'connected' in our Northwind admin panel. Could you check the delivery logs on your end? We have about 15-20 critical alerts that should have posted but didn't.
answer: Thank you for confirming the integration shows as connected on your end, that helps us isolate this to the delivery pipeline rather than your Slack configuration. We're seeing the same webhook delivery issue reported by other customers starting around the same timeframe yesterday evening, and our engineering team is actively working on restoring delivery - we'll update you as soon as it's resolved and will confirm whether the missed 15-20 alerts can be resent retroactively.

subject: How to export dashboard to PDF via API
body:
I'm trying to automate PDF exports of our analytics dashboard through the Northwind API for a weekly report we send to stakeholders. I can trigger the export endpoint successfully and get a 200 response, but the returned PDF is consistently missing the chart visualizations, only the table data shows up.

I'm using POST /v1/dashboards/{id}/export with format=pdf. Is there a separate parameter needed to include charts, or is this a known limitation? Would appreciate a pointer to relevant documentation if it exists.
answer: Good question, and this is a common point of confusion. Chart rendering in PDF exports requires an additional include_visuals=true parameter in the request body, which isn't currently called out clearly in our API docs, so thanks for flagging that. We'll get the documentation updated, and in the meantime that parameter should get you the full export with charts included - let us know if you still see missing visuals after adding it.

subject: SSO sessions timing out much faster than configured
body:
We configured our SSO session timeout to 8 hours in the Identity admin panel, but our staff across multiple offices are being logged out after roughly 45-60 minutes of inactivity, sometimes even during active use. This started about a week ago and is affecting a large portion of our 2,572 users globally.

Our IT team has confirmed the timeout setting in the console still shows 8 hours, so this looks like a discrepancy between the configured value and what's actually being enforced. Could you check if there was a recent change to session handling on your side?
answer: Thank you for confirming the console setting still shows 8 hours, that's a helpful data point. We're aware of a recent backend change to our session token refresh logic that appears to have introduced a shorter effective timeout for some Enterprise tenants, and we're treating this as a priority given the scale of impact across your organization. We're rolling back the affected change now and will confirm once session durations match your configured 8-hour setting, with an update expected within a few hours.

subject: Late-arriving data causing gaps in daily pipeline reports
body:
Our data pipeline from our ad-serving platform frequently receives records 12-24 hours after they should have arrived, which causes gaps in our daily reports since the sync window has already closed by the time the data shows up. We're seeing this happen roughly 3-4 times per week over the past month.

Is there a way to configure the pipeline to reprocess or backfill late-arriving records automatically, or a setting to extend the sync window? Right now we're manually re-triggering syncs which isn't sustainable long term.
answer: Thanks for describing the pattern, late-arriving data from ad-serving platforms is a fairly common connector behavior and we do have options to help. We can enable a backfill window setting on your pipeline that allows records arriving up to 48 hours late to be automatically reprocessed into the correct reporting period, rather than requiring manual re-triggers. We'll get this configured on your connector and follow up to confirm it's picking up late records correctly on the next few sync cycles.

subject: Push notifications when app is offline?
body: I'm a data analyst at Lumen Analytics and our field team uses the Mobile App to check shipment statuses. A few drivers mentioned they don't get any push notification when they're offline and reconnect later, the alert just seems to vanish. Is there a way to queue push notifications so they show up once the device is back online? Would be great for our logistics use case since coverage gaps are common.
answer: Thanks for the detailed feedback. Currently push notifications that are triggered while a device is offline are not queued and will be dropped once the delivery window closes, so this is expected behavior rather than a bug. I've logged this as a feature request for offline notification queuing and will update you if it gets scheduled for development.

subject: Restoring files from backup after retention window
body: One of our teams at Vertex Partners accidentally deleted a batch of uploaded files from a manufacturing project folder on October 3rd. I checked the Storage backup settings and see our retention is set to 30 days, but I'm not sure how to actually trigger a restore from the backup snapshot rather than just browsing current files. Can you walk me through the restore process, or confirm if this needs to be done on your end?
answer: Restores currently require our team to pull the snapshot on the backend, there isn't a self-service restore button yet, though we're tracking that as a feature request. To proceed, please send me the exact folder path and the approximate deletion timestamp and I'll locate the nearest backup snapshot within your 30-day retention window and initiate the restore.

subject: PDF export broken

subject: Deactivated user still appears in allowlist

subject: Question about upcoming SDK deprecations

subject: Okta app for Northwind Integrations hub
body: We're standardizing our tool access through Okta and I noticed Northwind's Integrations hub only lists Jira, Slack and Salesforce as connectable apps but not an Okta SSO tile for the hub itself. subject: Webhook retries stopped working after last week's update
body:
I want to give some background first: our finance team relies on the API Platform to reconcile daily settlement files, and we've had this integration running smoothly for over a year with maybe 5-6 webhook endpoints subscribed to invoice.paid and payout.completed events. Everything has generally been stable and we rarely have to touch the configuration.

Since around October 1st though we've noticed our retry queue for failed webhook deliveries just stopped processing - deliveries that fail once never get retried anymore, they just sit as 'failed' permanently. I saw a note about deprecations in the changelog around the same date. Did something change with webhook retry behavior that we need to update on our end?
answer: Thanks for the detailed context. Yes, as part of the deprecation cycle we retired the legacy exponential backoff retry worker on October 1st in favor of a new scheduler, and there was a bug where endpoints created before that date weren't automatically migrated. I'm re-queuing your affected endpoints now and will confirm once retries resume; in the meantime you may want to manually resend the failed deliveries from the dashboard.

subject: SAML login redirect loop for new users
body: I'm setting up SAML SSO for our team and new users who I provision get stuck in a redirect loop between our IdP and Northwind's login page after entering credentials - it bounces back to the IdP without ever landing in the dashboard. Existing users who logged in before we enabled MFA don't have this issue. Is there a specific attribute mapping or NameID format required for provisioning to work correctly with MFA enabled?
answer: Thanks for the details - this pattern usually means the SAML assertion is missing the NameID format our service expects, which becomes a hard requirement once MFA is enforced. Could you check that your IdP is sending NameID as 'emailAddress' format and share your metadata XML with us? We'll review the mapping and get back to you with the exact attribute configuration needed.

subject: Jira link broken for all our support tickets
body: Our support team uses the Jira integration to auto-create linked issues from Northwind tickets, and as of this morning none of the new tickets are creating Jira issues at all - the link just shows a spinning icon and then times out. subject: Scheduled pipeline syncs missing 3 days of data
body: Our nightly scheduled sync from the Data Pipelines connector to our warehouse did not run successfully on October 12th, 13th, or 14th, and we only discovered this today when our finance close reports came back with zero new records. The connector status shows 'completed' for all three runs but the destination tables have no new rows for that window. We're pulling the connector run logs for October 12-14 to determine whether the source data was skipped or failed silently despite reporting 'completed', and we'll begin a backfill as soon as we confirm the source records are intact. I'll have an update for you within the next hour and will stay on this until your data is fully reconciled.

subject: Getting duplicate email alerts for the same event
body: Several of our team members are reporting that they receive the same notification email two or three times within a few minutes for a single event, like an invoice status change. This started happening after we added a few new alert rules last week. It's not blocking work but it's cluttering inboxes and causing confusion about whether something actually changed multiple times. Is there a way to check if we accidentally created overlapping alert rules?
answer: Thanks for flagging this - overlapping alert rules with similar trigger conditions is the most common cause of duplicate emails. Go to Notifications > Alert Rules and check if multiple rules are subscribed to the same event type with different names; merging or disabling the duplicates should stop the repeat sends. If you don't find any overlap on your end, send us the rule names and we'll check the delivery logs for a dedupe issue on our side.

subject: Duplicate alerts firing for entire workspace since yesterday
body: Starting yesterday afternoon, every alert rule in our workspace is triggering 3-4 duplicate notifications per event across email and Slack, affecting all 91 seats. This is generating a huge volume of noise and several team leads have already muted our alerting channel entirely, which means we're missing real notifications now. Nothing changed on our configuration side recently - no new rules were added this week.
answer: This is impacting your whole workspace so we're prioritizing it right now. We've identified a possible duplication issue in the alert dispatch queue that may be affecting multiple accounts and are checking whether a recent backend deploy is the cause. We'll pause outbound duplicate sends where possible on our end and update you within the hour with either a fix or a workaround.

subject: Mobile app crashes when reconnecting after offline mode
body: While testing our integration on the mobile SDK, I put the app into offline mode by disabling network access, made a few local changes, then re-enabled connectivity. The app crashes consistently within a couple seconds of reconnecting, before any sync confirmation appears. This happens on both iOS and Android test devices. Is there a known issue with the offline queue sync process, or a recommended way to handle reconnection in our own integration code?

Could you send us the crash logs or stack trace from either device? In the meantime, adding a short delay before triggering sync on reconnect may avoid the race condition while we investigate further.

subject: How to restrict dashboard sharing to specific teams
body: I'm trying to share a few dashboards with our legal team but restrict them so other departments can't view or duplicate them. Right now it looks like sharing is either fully public within the org or fully private to me. Is there a way to share a dashboard with a specific group or team rather than the whole workspace? If you don't see team-based groups available yet, let us know your workspace ID and we can confirm whether team grouping is enabled on your plan.

subject: Need higher webhook rate limits and deprecation timeline
body: We're scaling our webhook usage on the API Platform and currently hitting the rate limit of 100 events per minute per endpoint during peak transaction hours, causing some deliveries to queue and delay by several minutes. Also, I noticed in the docs that the v1 webhook signature format is marked deprecated - can you confirm the exact sunset date so we can plan the migration to v2 signatures alongside a rate limit increase request?

On the deprecation, v1 webhook signatures are scheduled to sunset in Q2 next year; we'll send over the migration guide for v2 so you can plan both changes together.

subject: Dashboard charts not rendering across logistics reports
body:

I'll escalate this to our engineering team right now and update you within the hour with either a fix timeline or a workaround for viewing the underlying data.

subject: API key rotation breaking webhook deliveries
body:
We rotated our API keys yesterday as part of routine security hygiene, and since then our webhook endpoint for shipment status updates has stopped receiving events entirely. The old key still shows as active in the dashboard even though we generated a new one. We're on SDK version 4.2.1.

Our rate limit dashboard shows normal usage, so it doesn't look like throttling. Can you confirm whether key rotation requires re-registering webhook subscriptions? This is impacting our media partner integrations that depend on real-time status.
answer: Thanks for flagging this. Key rotation does require webhook subscriptions to be re-verified under the new key if the old one is deactivated rather than just rotated in place — that's likely what's happening here. Please check under API Settings > Webhooks whether the subscription still references the old key ID, and if so, delete and recreate it with the new key. I'll also check on our end whether the deprecation notice for the old rotation flow was clear enough, since this has come up a couple of times this week.

subject: SSO role mapping not assigning correct permissions
body:
After our identity provider push last week, several analysts on our team are logging in via SSO but landing with viewer-only permissions instead of the analyst role they should have based on their IdP group membership. This is affecting about a dozen users out of our 86 seats. Role mapping rules in the SSO config still reference the same group names as before.

MFA and login itself work fine, it's specifically the role assignment that seems stale. Could this be a provisioning sync delay, or is something wrong with our attribute mapping?
answer: Thanks for the detailed context. This pattern usually points to a caching issue in the SCIM provisioning sync where group membership updates aren't being re-evaluated on login, especially if the IdP push happened close to a scheduled sync window. Could you send us the timestamp of the IdP push and one affected user's login so we can trace the provisioning logs and confirm whether it's a sync delay or an attribute mapping mismatch on our side?

subject: Need to upgrade plan and add seats before renewal
body:

subject: Connector authentication failing intermittently for healthcare data sync

subject: Question about API key rate limits and webhook retries

Webhook retries follow an exponential backoff schedule with up to 5 attempts over roughly 24 hours, which is documented in our API reference under Webhooks > Delivery Behavior — I'll also send you a link to the SDK deprecation timeline so you can confirm your current integration is on a supported version.

subject: Storage quota showing full despite deletions - Harbor Works

I'll follow up once confirmed and will also check why last night's backup job hit STG-409 to make sure tonight's run isn't affected.

subject: Need to restore Storage backup from before June 3rd data corruption

subject: Assistance needed configuring SAML for new subsidiary domain

subject: Connector authentication expired for our sales data source

subject: URGENT: Okta app integration broken, users locked out

subject: MFA enrollment stuck for multiple operations staff

subject: URGENT - retained data deleted before legal hold period ended

subject: Alert routing sending duplicate notifications to wrong teams

subject: Question about webhook retry behavior and deprecation notice
body:
I received a notice that the v1 webhook signing method is being deprecated in September, and I want to make sure our finance integrations won't break. We currently use webhooks for invoice.paid and subscription.updated events tied to our billing reconciliation process across 452 seats.

Could you clarify what changes on our end are needed to migrate to the new signing method, and whether the SDK we use (node-northwind-sdk v2.4) already supports it? Also curious if retry behavior on failed webhook deliveries is changing as part of this.

Retry behavior itself isn't changing as part of this deprecation; I'll send over our migration guide with code samples for invoice.paid and subscription.updated so your team can validate before the cutover.

subject: Can't change sharing permissions on shared dashboard

subject: SSO sessions timing out after 5 minutes for all users

I'm escalating this to our identity team as a priority fix and will update you within the hour with either a resolution or a temporary workaround.

subject: Connector auth failing intermittently for Salesforce source
body: We're integrating our Salesforce connector into a Northwind data pipeline (pipeline ID dp-8841) and getting intermittent 401 errors on the connector auth step, roughly 1 in 8 sync attempts. The OAuth token looks valid when I check it manually. This started around June 3rd and is adding noticeable latency to our nightly sync since it retries 3 times before failing. Any idea what's causing the auth to drop intermittently?
answer: Thanks for the details on pipeline dp-8841. Intermittent 401s like this are usually caused by token refresh timing colliding with our connector's cached credential check, especially under retry load. Can you confirm the refresh token TTL configured on the Salesforce connected app so we can rule that out, and in the meantime I'd recommend reducing the retry count to 1 to cut down on redundant auth calls while we investigate the timing issue.

subject: URGENT API KEYS EXPOSED IN PUBLIC REPO NEED IMMEDIATE REVOCATION
body: WE JUST FOUND OUT ONE OF OUR API KEYS FOR THE NORTHWIND API PLATFORM WAS COMMITTED TO A PUBLIC GITHUB REPO BY MISTAKE. THE KEY IS lh-api-key-77219 AND IT HAS FULL ACCESS TO OUR LUMEN HEALTH ACCOUNT. WE NEED THIS REVOKED RIGHT NOW AND NEED TO KNOW IF ANY UNAUTHORIZED CALLS WERE MADE SINCE MAY 28TH WHEN IT WAS PUSHED. THIS IS A LEGAL FIRM WITH CLIENT DATA, WE CANNOT HAVE A BREACH.
answer: We have revoked API key lh-api-key-77219 immediately and it is no longer valid for any requests. Our security team is now pulling the access logs for this key going back to May 28th to identify any unauthorized calls, and we will send you a full report as soon as that review completes. Please generate a replacement key from your dashboard when ready, and let us know if you need help rotating it into your integration.

subject: Biometric login causing app crashes on some devices
body: We rolled out the Northwind mobile app to our staff and a handful are reporting that enabling biometric login (Face ID) causes the app to crash immediately after the fingerprint/face prompt. This is happening on at least 4 of our 16 seats, all on iOS 17. Disabling biometric login and using password works fine. Can you look into what's causing the crash on the biometric step?
answer: Thanks for reporting this, we've seen a similar crash reported on iOS 17 tied to a biometric callback handling issue in the last app release. Could you have one of the affected users send us the crash log from their device (Settings > Privacy > Analytics > Analytics Data) so we can confirm it matches? In the meantime, staying on password login is the safest workaround until we ship a fix.

subject: Slack alerts from Integrations not firing for escalations
body: We set up the Slack integration to push alerts when certain dashboard thresholds are hit, and it's meant to escalate to a specific channel when severity is high. For the past week these escalation alerts just aren't showing up in Slack at all, though the lower-priority ones still come through fine. I checked our Slack app permissions and they look unchanged. Any idea why the high-severity escalation alerts specifically would be getting dropped?
answer: Thanks for the clear breakdown, that's helpful. High-severity escalation alerts route through a separate webhook channel than standard notifications, so this points to either a filter rule misconfiguration or an issue with that specific webhook endpoint. Can you send me the integration ID and the exact escalation rule name so I can check the delivery logs and confirm where the alerts are being dropped?

subject: Seat count discrepancy on our Pro plan invoice
body: Our latest invoice shows us being billed for 310 seats but we've only ever provisioned 292 active users across our workspace. This is a significant overcharge and I need this corrected before the next billing cycle runs in 5 days. Can someone review our actual seat usage against the invoice and issue a credit or refund for the difference? This has happened once before back in February as well.
answer: I'm sorry for the discrepancy, and I understand the urgency given your billing cycle date. I'm pulling your workspace's actual active seat count now to compare against the invoiced 310, and if we confirm the overcharge, we'll issue a credit to your account before the next cycle runs. I'll also flag the February incident so we can check whether there's a recurring sync issue between your provisioning and billing systems.

subject: NEED URGENT HELP MAPPING SSO ROLES TO PERMISSION GROUPS
body: WE ARE TRYING TO SET UP ROLE MAPPING SO THAT OUR SSO GROUPS FROM OKTA AUTOMATICALLY MAP TO THE CORRECT PERMISSION GROUPS IN NORTHWIND. RIGHT NOW EVERYONE WHO LOGS IN VIA SSO GETS DEFAULTED TO THE LOWEST PERMISSION TIER REGARDLESS OF THEIR OKTA GROUP MEMBERSHIP. WE HAVE 23 SEATS AND NEED THIS WORKING BEFORE WE ONBOARD A NEW TEAM NEXT WEEK. CAN SOMEONE WALK US THROUGH THE ATTRIBUTE MAPPING CONFIG OR JUST FIX IT ON YOUR END.
