I'll send over a step-by-step guide for configuring the Okta group claim and the corresponding attribute mapping in your Northwind SSO settings, and I can also hop on a call this week to walk through it live given your onboarding deadline next week.

subject: Requesting retention policy change for archived storage buckets
body: We need to update the retention policy on our Storage buckets to keep archived documents for 7 years instead of the current 3 years to meet a new compliance requirement for our legal clients. We have around 146 seats using shared storage and roughly 40TB across archived buckets. Can you confirm whether this change applies retroactively to existing files or only new uploads going forward, and whether there's a quota impact we should plan for?
answer: Thanks for reaching out about the retention update. Changing the policy to 7 years will apply to both existing and new files in the affected buckets going forward, existing files won't be deleted early under the new setting. Given your current 40TB footprint, extending retention will increase your storage usage over time, so I'd recommend reviewing your quota tier before we apply the change, and I can walk you through projected growth if that's helpful.

subject: Scheduled sync jobs silently failing since last week
body: Our scheduled sync for pipeline dp-2290 (runs every night at 1am) has been failing silently since June 5th, no error shown in the dashboard but the destination table just isn't getting updated. I checked the connector status page and it shows green. Manually triggering the sync works fine and completes successfully. This is a small pipeline, only 8 seats use it, but we rely on the fresh data every morning.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report on dp-2290. A silent failure with a green connector status but working manual triggers usually points to the scheduler job not actually kicking off rather than a connector-level failure. I'm pulling the scheduler execution logs for June 5th onward now to confirm whether the job is being skipped, and will follow up shortly with what we find and a fix or workaround to restore the nightly run.

subject: Transform step failing intermittently before nightly load
body: We're seeing our transform step in the Data Pipelines product fail intermittently, about 2-3 times a week, right before the nightly load into our warehouse. The error just says transform timed out, no other detail in the logs. We'd like to understand what's driving the timeouts and whether adjusting the transform schedule or batch size on our end would help, since this is delaying our morning reports for the ops team.
answer: Thanks for flagging this, intermittent transform timeouts right before load are often related to batch size spiking on nights with larger data volume. I'd suggest reducing your batch size or splitting the transform into smaller chunks as a first step, and in parallel I'll review the pipeline's execution history to see if there's a pattern tied to specific data volume or a resource constraint we should address on our end.

subject: Shared dashboard permissions not respecting group settings
body:
We have a fleet-tracking dashboard shared with our 'Regional Managers' group, but two managers in Denver can't see it while everyone else in the group can. I checked the sharing settings and they're listed as members with view access. This started after we rebuilt the dashboard from a template on Tuesday.

Can you check why permission inheritance isn't working for this group? We rely on this dashboard daily for load status charts.
answer: Thanks for the details. This looks like a caching issue with group membership on cloned dashboards — when a dashboard is rebuilt from a template, sharing sometimes references the old group snapshot instead of live membership. I'm re-syncing the group permissions for your dashboard now and will confirm once the two Denver managers regain access, likely within the hour.

subject: Email digests not sending to entire workspace since Monday
body:
Our daily email digest notifications stopped going out to most of our 115 users starting Monday morning. A handful of admins still received theirs, but the majority of staff say they got nothing, and there's no error shown in the notification settings panel. We depend on these digests for daily content approval alerts across our media team.

Can someone check the digest delivery queue? This is affecting a large portion of our workspace and approvals are backing up.
answer: I'm sorry for the disruption this is causing — I've escalated this immediately since it's affecting the majority of your workspace. Initial checks show a delivery queue backlog on our digest scheduler that started around the time you describe; our infrastructure team is actively working the fix. I'll update you within the next two hours with either a resolution or a firm ETA, and we'll confirm digest delivery is fully restored before closing this out.

subject: Need to restore files from backup after accidental bulk delete
body:
One of our warehouse technicians accidentally deleted a folder containing about 340 inspection reports from Storage this morning around 9:15 AM. I see the retention policy should keep backups for 30 days, but I can't find a restore option anywhere in the console. Can you point me to the right feature or trigger a restore from your side?

The folder was named 'QC_Reports_2024' under the Cobalt Works workspace. We need this back today if possible since inspections are due by end of week.
answer: Thanks for flagging this quickly — a same-day restore request is exactly what our retention window is designed for. I've located the 'QC_Reports_2024' folder in our backup snapshots and I'm initiating a restore to your workspace now. I'll confirm here once the files reappear, which should be within the next 30-60 minutes, and let you know if any file-level conflicts need your review.

subject: help
body:
App crashes immediately on launch for all 8 of our field staff since this morning update. Here's the log one of them sent me:

FATAL EXCEPTION: main
Process: com.northwind.mobile, PID: 4521
java.lang.NullPointerException: Attempt to invoke virtual method on a null object reference
  at com.northwind.mobile.auth.LoginActivity.onCreate(LoginActivity.java:88)

The stack trace points to a null reference in the login flow introduced by today's update; our mobile team is already reproducing it. In the meantime, please have staff try clearing app data and reinstalling from the store link I'll send shortly, as a temporary workaround while we prepare a hotfix.

subject: Requesting credit for double-charged invoice
body:
Our March invoice (INV-88213) shows two charges for the same billing period, both dated March 3rd, totaling roughly double what we normally pay for our 16 seats. I've attached our payment history showing the duplicate withdrawal from our card ending in 4471. Could you issue a refund or credit for the extra charge?

We need this resolved before our finance close on Friday, as it's currently showing as a discrepancy in our books.
answer: Thank you for catching this and for the invoice number — I can see the duplicate charge on INV-88213 in our billing system. I'm processing a refund for the duplicate transaction now, which should post back to your card within 3-5 business days, and I'll send you a corrected invoice reflecting the single charge before your Friday close so your books reconcile properly.

subject: Backup restore failing with quota exceeded error
body:
We're trying to restore a set of patient intake documents deleted last week, but every restore attempt fails with 'Error: destination quota exceeded' even though our storage dashboard shows we're only at 62% of our allocated quota. This has happened on three separate attempts today, each time on the same folder set.

This is urgent — we need these documents back for a compliance audit scheduled tomorrow morning.
answer: I understand the time pressure with your audit tomorrow — this has been escalated as urgent on our end. The quota error you're seeing looks like a miscalculation bug where restore operations are counting archived snapshots against your live quota; our storage team is investigating the discrepancy right now. I'll personally monitor this and get the restore completed manually within the next few hours if the automated retry doesn't clear first.

subject: Staff unable to complete MFA enrollment
body:
Several of our 12 users are stuck during MFA setup — after scanning the QR code with their authenticator app, the verification screen just says 'Invalid code' even when entering the current code shown. This is happening on at least 4 accounts that I've tested myself using different devices. We enabled mandatory MFA last week as part of our SSO rollout.

Can you confirm if there's a time sync issue on your end or something specific to how the QR codes are generated?
answer: Thanks for testing across multiple devices, that helps narrow it down. This pattern usually points to a clock drift issue between the authenticator app and our MFA server, or occasionally a QR code that was scanned before the enrollment session refreshed. Could you have one affected user try deleting the entry in their authenticator app and re-scanning a freshly generated code, and let me know if the same accounts still fail afterward?

subject: Frage zur Aufbewahrungsfrist für hochgeladene Dateien
body:
Ich bin Datenanalystin bei Lumen Freight und wollte fragen, wie lange hochgeladene Dateien im Storage-Bereich standardmäßig aufbewahrt werden, bevor sie automatisch gelöscht werden. Wir planen, ältere Reiseabrechnungsdaten zu archivieren, und müssen wissen, ob wir vorher ein manuelles Backup erstellen sollten.

Gibt es eine Möglichkeit, die Aufbewahrungsfrist für bestimmte Ordner individuell einzustellen, oder gilt für alle Ordner die gleiche Standardregel?
answer: Vielen Dank für Ihre Anfrage. Standardmäßig werden Dateien im Storage-Bereich 90 Tage nach dem letzten Zugriff aufbewahrt, bevor sie automatisch archiviert werden; eine endgültige Löschung erfolgt erst nach weiteren 12 Monaten. Sie können für einzelne Ordner abweichende Aufbewahrungsregeln festlegen – das geht über die Ordnereinstellungen unter 'Retention Policy'. Für Ihre Reiseabrechnungsdaten empfehlen wir trotzdem ein manuelles Backup vor der Archivierung, falls Sie auf Nummer sicher gehen möchten.

subject: How to enable offline mode for field teams
body:
We'd like to roll out offline mode in the Mobile App for our retail store managers who often work in areas with poor connectivity. I've seen the setting mentioned in a release note but can't find where to enable it for our workspace of 68 seats. Is this a per-user toggle or something an admin configures workspace-wide?

Also, does offline mode sync automatically once connectivity returns, or do users need to manually trigger a sync? Documentation on this would help us train our team properly.
answer: Great timing — offline mode is configured at the workspace level under Admin Settings > Mobile > Offline Access, where you can enable it for all users or specific roles. Once enabled, the app caches recent data automatically and syncs in the background as soon as connectivity is restored, though users can also pull down to force a manual sync. I'll send over our offline mode documentation guide, which covers training tips for field teams as well.

subject: Plan upgrade not reflecting new billing rate
body:
We upgraded from Starter to Pro last Thursday for Granite Foods, but our latest invoice still shows Starter-tier pricing for our 24 seats instead of the Pro rate we agreed to. I checked the account settings and it does show 'Pro' as our current plan, so this seems like a billing sync issue rather than the upgrade itself failing.

Could you correct the invoice or let us know when the next billing cycle will reflect the right rate?
answer: Thanks for flagging this discrepancy — you're right that the plan upgrade itself went through correctly, but it looks like the billing system didn't pick up the rate change for this cycle's invoice generation. I'm correcting the invoice manually now to reflect the Pro-tier rate for your 24 seats, and I'll confirm the fix is in place so future cycles bill correctly without manual intervention.

subject: Audit log entries missing for API-triggered deactivations
body: I'm integrating the Admin Console API for Orion Academy and noticed that when I deactivate a user via POST /v1/admin/users/{id}/deactivate, no corresponding entry shows up in the audit log UI. Manual deactivations from the console do show up fine. I'm on the Starter plan with 13 seats, testing against user id usr_4471. Is this expected behavior or a gap in logging coverage for API calls?
answer: Thanks for flagging this - API-initiated actions should be logged the same as console actions, so this does look like a gap rather than expected behavior. Could you send us the exact timestamp (UTC) of one of the deactivation calls that didn't appear, along with the request ID if you have it from the response headers? That will help us trace it through the logging pipeline and confirm whether it's isolated to your account or a broader issue.

subject: Recurring card decline errors for our Pro subscription
body: We've had three failed card charges this month for our North Labs billing account - on the 2nd, the 16th, and again yesterday, all with decline code 'do_not_honor' even though the same card works for other vendors. Our account has 267 seats and I'm worried about service interruption if this isn't resolved. Can someone check what's triggering these declines and whether we can get the late fees from the last failed attempt refunded?
answer: I'm sorry for the disruption this is causing - I've pulled up your account and can see the three failed attempts you mentioned. The decline code is coming from your card issuer's side, but it's sometimes triggered by mismatched billing address data or a temporary fraud flag on recurring charges, so it's worth calling your bank to whitelist Northwind as a merchant. In the meantime I've waived the late fee from the most recent failed charge and extended your grace period by 5 days so seats won't be interrupted while you sort this out with the bank.

subject: Biometric login fails after app update on iOS
body: One of our test users at Pioneer Foods reported that Face ID login stopped working after updating the mobile app to the latest version - the app just returns to the email/password screen without any error message. This happens consistently on iOS 17.4, iPhone 13. It works fine on Android for the same account. We only have 6 seats so it's easy for me to reproduce, happy to share device logs if useful.
answer: Thanks for the detailed repro info - a silent fallback to password login on iOS 17.4 after biometric auth suggests the secure enclave token might not be refreshing correctly post-update. Could you send us the device logs from a fresh reproduction along with the app build number shown in Settings > About? We'll check this against known issues from the latest release and get back to you shortly.

subject: WEBHOOK RATE LIMIT CHANGES - NEED CLARITY BEFORE WE BUILD
body: WE ARE PLANNING TO INTEGRATE NORTHWIND WEBHOOKS FOR HARBOR LEGAL AND WE NOTICED THE DOCS MENTION A DEPRECATION OF THE V1 WEBHOOK PAYLOAD FORMAT BUT THERE IS NO CLEAR DATE OR MIGRATION GUIDE. WE ARE ON STARTER WITH 12 SEATS AND NEED TO KNOW IF THE CURRENT RATE LIMIT OF 100 EVENTS PER MINUTE WILL CHANGE WHEN V2 LAUNCHES. WE CANNOT START BUILDING AGAINST AN ENDPOINT THAT MIGHT BREAK IN A FEW WEEKS. PLEASE ADVISE ASAP.
answer: Thanks for reaching out before building against this - the v1 webhook payload format is scheduled for deprecation but we don't have a hard cutoff date yet, so it's safe to build against v1 for now with at least 90 days notice guaranteed before removal. The rate limit is staying at 100 events per minute for both v1 and v2, and we'll publish a migration guide with field mapping before v2 goes live. I'll follow up with a link to the draft docs so your team can start planning the transition.

subject: Scheduled syncs failing across multiple pipelines since last night
body: Starting around 11:40 PM UTC last night, our scheduled data pipeline syncs for North Foods have been failing or running hours late. We're seeing this on at least 14 of our 22 active pipelines, all pulling from our warehouse feeds. Downstream dashboards are now showing stale inventory data from two days ago, which is a serious issue given our 3,460 seats depend on near-real-time numbers across regional teams. Pipeline IDs pl_20391, pl_20402, and pl_20415 are among the ones stuck in 'queued' status.
answer: This is being escalated immediately given the scope - stale data across that many pipelines for a customer of your size is a P1 for us. We're pulling logs for pl_20391, pl_20402, and pl_20415 right now to identify whether this is a scheduler backlog or an upstream connector issue, and will update you within the hour with root cause and an ETA for catching up the backlog.

subject: SCIM provisioning broken - new hires cannot log in
body: Since this morning, new users provisioned through our SCIM integration for Ember Labs aren't getting access - they're created in our identity provider but never show up in Northwind, so login fails with 'account not found.' This is affecting our entire onboarding pipeline; we have 6 new hires blocked right now out of 79 total seats. Can you confirm the exact timestamps for one or two of the blocked users so we can trace those specific payloads through our system while we investigate?

subject: Request: native Zapier trigger for new integration events
body: We're using the Zapier integration for Ember Retail to sync data into Salesforce and Okta, and it works well for basic triggers, but we'd like a native trigger for 'integration health status changed' so we can alert our team in Jira automatically when a sync fails. Right now we're polling the API every 15 minutes as a workaround, which feels inefficient across our 186 seats. Is this something on the roadmap, or could it be considered?
answer: Thanks for the detailed use case - a native 'integration health status changed' trigger for Zapier isn't currently available but it's a reasonable request, especially given the polling workaround you've built. I'll log this as a feature request with your account attached and share it with our integrations product team. In the meantime, if you can tell us your current polling interval and volume, we may be able to suggest a lighter-weight webhook-based alternative.

subject: PDF-Export im Dashboard bricht bei großen Charts ab
body: Seit gestern können wir bei Willow Legal den PDF-Export für unsere Finanz-Dashboards nicht mehr nutzen. Sobald ein Dashboard mehr als drei Diagramme mit Zeitreihendaten enthält, bricht der Export nach ein paar Sekunden mit der Meldung 'Export fehlgeschlagen, bitte erneut versuchen' ab. Das betrifft mehrere Kollegen bei uns, die die Monatsberichte für das Management vorbereiten müssen und aktuell komplett blockiert sind.
answer: Vielen Dank für die Meldung, das behandeln wir als P1, da es die Berichtserstellung Ihres Teams komplett blockiert. Wir vermuten ein Timeout-Problem beim Rendern mehrerer Zeitreihen-Charts und prüfen das umgehend anhand Ihrer Logs.

subject: Pagination bug exposing other tenant's data in API response
body: We just discovered something serious - while testing pagination on the /v1/records endpoint for Apex Energy, using cursor 'eyJvZmZzZXQiOjIwMH0=' with limit=50, the response returned records with tenant IDs that don't match ours. We only have 3 seats and this endpoint should be fully scoped to our account. We immediately stopped further calls and need to know if this is isolated to us or a broader issue, since this looks like a data isolation failure.
answer: Thank you for stopping the calls immediately and reporting this - we're treating this as a P0 security incident and have escalated to our security team right now. Please do not make further requests with that cursor value, and can you send us the exact request headers and API key ID used (not the secret itself) so we can trace this in our access logs? We'll have an update on scope and containment within the hour.

subject: Salesforce sync only pulling partial contact records
body: Our Salesforce integration for Ember Media has been syncing incomplete contact records since we set it up last week - custom fields like 'Account Tier' and 'Renewal Date' aren't coming through even though they're mapped in the field configuration. We only have 4 seats so this is a small setup, but it's making our Jira tickets and Slack alerts based on this data unreliable. Is there a mapping step we're missing, or a sync log we can check?
answer: Thanks for the details - missing custom field values while standard fields sync fine usually points to a field mapping or permission issue on the Salesforce API user's profile rather than something on our side. Could you check that the integration user in Salesforce has field-level security enabled for 'Account Tier' and 'Renewal Date'? If that's already correct, send us your integration ID and we'll pull the sync logs to see exactly what's being returned in the raw API response.

subject: Request to update storage upload documentation for retention policy
body:
I'm the PM overseeing our education content library on Storage. We've had a few instances where uploads over 2GB fail silently with no error shown in the UI, and our team only discovers it days later when the file isn't in the retention archive. The docs don't mention a hard file size limit or how it interacts with our backup retention window.

Could you update the documentation to clarify max upload size, quota thresholds, and how failed uploads are logged? We'd also like guidance on how to set up alerts for failed uploads so we can catch these before they affect our backup cycle.
answer: Thanks for flagging this gap in our documentation. Uploads over 2GB on the Starter tier are subject to a per-file limit that isn't currently surfaced clearly in the UI, which we agree needs fixing on our end. I'll file a documentation update ticket to cover max file size, quota interaction, and retention behavior for failed uploads, and will follow up here once it's published with guidance on setting up failure alerts.

subject: Push notifications not arriving on iOS after login
body:
We have 4 seats on the Mobile App and since last week our field team can't receive push notifications after logging in on iOS devices (iPhone 12 and 13, iOS 17.4). The app shows notifications are enabled in settings, but nothing comes through even for test alerts we send from the admin panel. Android devices on our team seem fine.

answer: Thank you for the details on device models and OS version. Please try logging out fully and back in on one affected device, and let us know if that restores notifications — if not, we'll pull the push token logs for your account to investigate further.

subject: Okta app integration slow to sync group assignments
body:
I'm integrating our Okta app with Northwind for SSO provisioning across our Pro account. Group assignments from Okta are taking upwards of 20 minutes to reflect in Northwind, which is causing delays when we onboard new hires who also need immediate Slack and Jira access provisioned through the same Okta flow.

Is this expected sync latency, or is there a webhook/polling setting we can adjust to speed this up? We have about 134 seats and this delay is becoming noticeable as we scale onboarding.

I'd like to check your integration's webhook configuration and recent sync logs to see if there's a backlog or misconfigured polling interval; could you confirm the Okta app instance name so I can pull the relevant logs?

subject: Unable to modify workspace settings after Admin Console outage
body:
Since this morning our Admin Console has been throwing errors whenever anyone tries to update workspace settings, including deactivating former employee accounts. We manage 1558 seats and this is now a compliance issue since we have several offboarding actions overdue and our audit log shows no entries for the attempted changes since 9:15 AM today.

The error message displayed is 'Settings update failed: internal error, please try again.' This is affecting our whole admin team, not just one person. We need this resolved urgently as we have contractual deadlines for account deactivation tied to security policy.
answer: This has been escalated immediately given the compliance impact. We're seeing elevated error rates on workspace settings updates across Enterprise accounts starting around 9:00 AM and our engineering team is actively investigating the internal error. I'll update you within the hour with root cause status, and in the meantime please use the emergency deactivation API endpoint if you need to process any deactivations that cannot wait — I can send those details right away if needed.

subject: Salesforce sync stopped updating contact records
body:
Our Salesforce sync integration stopped updating contact records as of this morning around 8:30 AM. New leads created in Salesforce aren't appearing in Northwind, and updates to existing contact fields aren't propagating either. We rely on this sync for our sales team's daily workflow across 128 seats, so this is blocking a lot of work right now.

We haven't changed any Salesforce or Northwind API credentials recently. Our integration logs show the last successful sync timestamp as 08:27 AM today, then nothing since. Can you check the connector status on your end?
answer: I understand this is blocking your sales team's workflow and we're treating it as high priority. I've checked our connector status page and see intermittent failures affecting Salesforce sync jobs starting around 08:25 AM, likely tied to a token refresh issue on our side. We're re-running the sync queue now and I'll confirm once contact records are catching up — expect an update within the next 30 minutes.

subject: Salesforce sync duplicating opportunity records
body:
As a data analyst here, I noticed our Salesforce sync has been creating duplicate opportunity records since yesterday's sync run at 6:00 PM. We're now seeing over 300 duplicate entries in our reporting dashboard, which is throwing off our quarterly forecasting numbers significantly. We only have 5 seats but this is a serious data integrity problem for our small team.

The duplicates all have the same external ID but different internal record IDs. Can someone help us identify why this is happening and how to clean up the duplicates safely?
answer: Thank you for catching this and providing the external ID detail, which helps narrow things down quickly. This pattern suggests the sync may have lost its record-matching key during a recent run, causing it to create new records instead of updating existing ones. I'm escalating this to our integrations team to identify the root cause and will follow up with a safe deduplication plan so we don't risk further data loss while cleaning up the 300 affected records.

subject: Late-arriving data breaking downstream pipeline aggregations
body:
We've noticed that data arriving more than 4 hours late in our Data Pipelines job is being dropped from daily aggregation windows instead of being reprocessed into the correct time bucket. This has happened three times in the past two weeks, most recently on the 14th, and it's causing our travel booking metrics dashboard to show incomplete totals for those days.

Is there a way to configure the pipeline to handle late-arriving records with a grace period, or do we need to manually trigger reprocessing each time this occurs? With 293 seats relying on these reports, manual fixes aren't sustainable long term.
answer: Thanks for the clear pattern description — this is a known limitation with the current fixed aggregation window, which doesn't yet support late-arrival grace periods out of the box. I'll open a request with our pipelines team to look at adding configurable watermarking for late data, and in the meantime I can walk you through setting up a scheduled backfill job that automatically reprocesses the previous 24 hours nightly to catch stragglers like the ones from the 14th.

subject: Need custom role mapping for SSO group claims
body:
I'm integrating our Identity and SSO setup and need to map incoming SAML group claims to specific Northwind roles beyond the default admin/member split. Our IdP sends a 'department' attribute and we'd like users in 'Editorial' to automatically get a custom role we've created, rather than defaulting to member.

The seat stays reserved until you explicitly remove the user, so deactivation alone won't free it up. I'll also send our offboarding documentation link for future reference.

subject: Clarification on API rate limit headers and retry logic
