Can someone please confirm the duplicate charge and process a refund for one of them as soon as possible? Our invoice numbers are INV-55210 and INV-55238.
answer: I'm sorry for the stress this has caused - I can confirm both invoices INV-55210 and INV-55238 show identical charges for the same billing cycle, which is clearly an error on our end. I've initiated a full refund for INV-55238 to your original payment method now; this typically posts within 3-5 business days, and I'll send confirmation as soon as the refund clears on our side.

subject: Question about upgrading plan tier via API
body:
I'm working on automating our account management and wanted to check if plan upgrades can be triggered through the Billing API rather than the dashboard UI. We're currently on the Pro plan with 293 seats and expect to need more seats next quarter, so I'd like to script the upgrade process ahead of time.

Could you point me to documentation on the relevant endpoint, and let me know if seat count changes and invoice generation happen automatically after the API call?
answer: Good question - yes, plan and seat changes can be managed via the Billing API's /account/subscription endpoint, which accepts a target seat count and returns a prorated invoice preview before committing the change. I'll send over the full API reference link for that endpoint, and to confirm: once the upgrade call is committed, seat limits update immediately and the prorated invoice generates automatically within the same billing cycle.

subject: Data pipeline transform step failing repeatedly
body:
Our transform step in the education records pipeline has failed for the past four runs, each time with a generic 'transform error' message and no further detail in the logs we can access. We only have 4 seats on this Starter plan so it's just myself and one colleague managing this pipeline, and we don't have visibility into what's actually breaking.

Could someone check the backend logs for pipeline ID EDU-PIPE-0472 and let us know what's causing the transform to fail? We need this data flowing again for our reporting cycle this week.
answer: Thanks for the pipeline ID - I checked the backend logs for EDU-PIPE-0472 and the transform is failing because an incoming field (student_id) is arriving as null in a portion of your source records, which the current transform schema doesn't allow. I'd recommend adding a null-handling rule in the transform step to either default or filter those rows, and I'm happy to walk through configuring that with you so your reporting data is flowing again before the end of the week.

subject: Confused about dashboard sharing permission levels
body:
I'm trying to share one of our travel operations dashboards with a partner agency contact who isn't part of our Northwind workspace, but I'm not sure what permission level they'll end up with. The sharing dialog mentions 'external viewer' but doesn't clarify whether they can export chart data or just view it on screen.

Could you clarify what external viewers can and can't do, particularly around exporting charts and underlying data? We want to make sure we're not accidentally sharing more than intended.
answer: Good question, and glad you checked before sharing. External viewers can see charts and interact with filters, but they cannot export underlying data or download chart images by default - that export capability is a separate permission you'd need to explicitly enable in the sharing settings under 'Allow data export'. Since it's off by default, your partner agency contact will only have view access unless you turn that toggle on.

subject: Charts not rendering on dashboard after API integration
body:
I'm integrating our manufacturing metrics into a Northwind dashboard via the API and since yesterday afternoon several charts just show a blank grey box instead of the line graph. This is happening on the 'Production Yield' and 'Downtime by Line' widgets specifically, both fed by the same custom API endpoint. Other widgets on the same dashboard render fine.

We have three people relying on this for a shift review tomorrow morning, so a fix or workaround would really help. Dashboard ID is dash-4471 if that's useful.
answer:
Thanks for the detailed report and the dashboard ID. We're seeing a rendering issue affecting chart widgets bound to custom API data sources when the payload includes null values in a time series, which matches what you're describing on those two widgets. I'm escalating this to our dashboard engineering team now and will update you within a few hours with either a fix or a workaround you can apply before your shift review.

In the meantime, as a temporary workaround you can try switching those two widgets to the 'table' view type, which pulls from the same data source and should display correctly while we resolve the chart rendering bug.

subject: Urgent: SDK v3 deprecation breaking checkout integration in production
body:
We received the deprecation notice for API SDK v2 endpoints but our production checkout flow is now returning 410 Gone responses on the /v2/payments/authorize endpoint as of this morning, affecting all storefronts across our retail network. We have 268 seats on the account and this is impacting live transactions right now.

We were told the migration window ran through end of next quarter, so this early cutoff is causing active order failures. We need either a temporary re-enable of the v2 endpoint or immediate migration guidance to v3 equivalents.
answer:
This is being treated as an incident on our end and I've flagged it to the API platform team immediately given the production impact on checkout. Our records show the v2 authorize endpoint was scheduled for sunset next quarter, so this early return of 410s is unexpected and looks like a deployment error on our side rather than an intentional early cutoff.

We're working to restore v2 availability as a stopgap within the hour, and I'll follow up with a root cause explanation plus a revised, confirmed timeline for the v3 migration so this doesn't catch your team off guard again.

subject: Multiple card failures on renewal, need refund and seat adjustment
body:
Our Pro plan renewal ran on the 3rd and the card on file was declined with error code 'insufficient_funds', but I see three separate retry attempts logged within the same hour which triggered duplicate failed charge notifications to our billing contact. We've since updated the card and the payment went through on the fourth attempt.

Can you confirm we were only charged once successfully, and also check our seat count shows 34 active seats correctly after this? We integrate via the billing API and want to make sure our internal seat sync isn't going to double-report this cycle.
answer:
Thanks for flagging this — I've checked your billing history and confirm only the fourth attempt on the updated card resulted in a successful charge; the three earlier declined attempts did not process any funds, so there's nothing to refund there. Your account correctly shows 34 active seats for this billing cycle, and the seat count reflected via the billing API should match what you're seeing on your end.

I'll also flag the duplicate notification issue on retries to our billing team, since ideally you'd only get one alert per renewal attempt rather than three.

subject: Recurring transform failures on legal document connector
body:
We've noticed that our data pipeline pulling contract metadata through the document management connector has failed transforms intermittently over the past two weeks, roughly 6 to 8 times, always with the same 'schema mismatch on field contract_date' error. The source connector hasn't changed on our end and the field has always been a standard date type.

This isn't blocking daily operations since we have manual fallback exports, but it's becoming a recurring nuisance for our data team and I'd like to understand if this is a known bug with the connector before we escalate internally.
answer:
Thank you for the detailed history on this — a schema mismatch specifically on contract_date does line up with a known issue in the document connector where date fields formatted with a two-digit year are occasionally misclassified as strings during ingestion. This has been logged as a bug with our pipelines team and a fix is in progress, though I don't have a firm release date yet.

In the meantime, I'd recommend adding an explicit type cast on contract_date in your transform step as a workaround, which should eliminate the intermittent failures until the underlying fix ships. I'll keep this ticket open and update you when the fix is released.

subject: URGENT - all users locked out, MFA enrollment broken
body:
None of our 8 users can complete MFA enrollment right now, the QR code screen just spins indefinitely and then shows 'enrollment session expired' after about 30 seconds. This started this morning and now nobody at Harbor Media can log into Northwind at all since MFA is enforced for our account. We handle fintech client data and being fully locked out is a serious problem for us.

We haven't changed any SSO or security policy settings recently. Please help urgently, this is blocking our entire team from working.
answer:
I understand the severity here and we're treating this as a top priority incident. We're aware of an issue affecting MFA enrollment sessions timing out prematurely for some accounts and our identity team is actively investigating right now — I'm escalating your account specifically given that this is a full lockout for all 8 users.

As an immediate mitigation, I can temporarily lift the MFA enforcement policy on your account so your team can log in while we resolve the underlying enrollment bug; please confirm you want me to proceed with that and I'll action it within minutes.

subject: Upload failing with quota error but we're nowhere near limit
body:
I'm getting upload failures through the Storage API on files larger than about 50MB, returning 'error: quota_exceeded' even though our dashboard shows we're only using 1.2GB of our allotted storage. This started happening yesterday when I tried uploading a batch of course video files for our education platform.

Smaller files under 50MB upload fine using the same endpoint and credentials. Can you check if there's a per-request size limit being misreported as a quota issue, or if something else is going on with our account's storage quota?
answer:
Thanks for the details, especially the file size threshold — that's a useful clue. This looks like it may be a per-upload size limit on the Starter plan being incorrectly surfaced as a quota_exceeded error rather than the more accurate 'file too large' message, since your account-level usage is well within limits at 1.2GB.

I'm confirming the exact per-request size cap for your plan tier now and will let you know shortly whether this is expected behavior with a clearer error message needed, or a genuine bug in how the limit is being enforced.

subject: Need to restore files from backup after accidental bulk delete
body:
One of our admins accidentally ran a cleanup script yesterday that deleted around 340 files from our Storage bucket that should have been excluded by the retention policy. We need to restore these from backup as soon as possible since some of these are compliance documents tied to active client accounts in our fintech operations.

Can you point me to the restore process, or do you need to action this from your end? I don't see a self-service restore option in the admin console and the documentation on retention snapshots doesn't cover this scenario clearly.
answer:
Sorry to hear about the accidental deletion — restoring from backup snapshots for bulk deletes like this does need to be actioned on our side rather than through the admin console, since it involves restoring from our retention snapshot layer rather than a simple undo. Could you confirm the approximate time window of the deletion and the bucket name or path prefix affected, so our storage team can locate the correct snapshot and begin the restore.

We'll treat this as time-sensitive given the compliance documents involved and will update you as soon as the restore process is underway.

subject: PDF export broken on financial dashboards - blank pages
body:
When I try to export our quarterly revenue dashboard to PDF, the file downloads fine but every page is completely blank except for the header and footer, no charts or tables at all. This is happening on three different dashboards I tested, all containing multiple chart widgets, and started sometime this week — I last successfully exported one about ten days ago.

I need to share these PDFs with our finance leadership by end of day and the export-then-share workflow is how our whole team distributes these reports, so this is a significant blocker for retail finance reporting right now.
answer:
Thanks for the specifics and for confirming this reproduces across multiple dashboards — that helps us narrow it down quickly. This matches a rendering regression we're currently investigating in the PDF export service where chart widgets fail to render into the export while table widgets and headers still populate correctly.

Our engineering team is actively working on a fix given the reporting impact; in the meantime, as a workaround you can export each chart widget individually as an image via the widget menu and assemble them manually, which should let you get something to leadership today while we resolve the export bug.

subject: Request to enforce MFA enrollment reminders and admin visibility
body:
We're rolling out mandatory MFA across our organization and while most of our users have enrolled, we have no visibility into which of our 3,314 seats have not yet completed enrollment. Right now I'm exporting user lists manually and cross-checking against login logs, which isn't scalable at our size.

Could you add a feature, or point me to an existing one, that shows MFA enrollment status per user in the admin console, and ideally supports automated reminder emails for users who haven't enrolled after a set number of days? This is a compliance priority for our security team this quarter.
answer:
This is a great use case and I want to make sure it gets proper visibility with our product team given your compliance timeline. Currently there isn't a built-in MFA enrollment status column in the admin console, but I can confirm this is on the near-term roadmap for enterprise identity features, and I'm submitting a formal feature request on your behalf referencing your account and use case to help prioritize it.

As an interim measure, our security team can generate a one-off enrollment status export for your full user base so you're not relying on manual log cross-checking in the meantime — let me know if you'd like me to arrange that.

subject: How do I set up weekly email digests instead of per-alert notifications
body:
Right now our finance team gets individual email notifications every time a budget threshold alert fires, and with 200 seats across our energy operations we're getting dozens of near-duplicate emails a day for related alerts. I'd like to switch to a weekly digest format instead but I can't find this option anywhere in the notification settings.

Is there a way to configure digest frequency at the account or team level, and if not, could this be added? Documentation only covers per-event notification setup, nothing about batching or digests.
answer:
Thanks for reaching out — digest-style batching for alerts isn't currently available as a self-service setting in the notification console, it's only per-event delivery today, so you're not missing a hidden option. I've logged this as a feature request on your account since digest frequency controls are something we've heard requested before, particularly for high-volume alerting like budget thresholds.

In the meantime, one workaround is to route these specific alerts through a filtered rule that consolidates duplicates within a shorter window, which won't give you a full weekly digest but should reduce the near-duplicate email volume your team is seeing. I'll update this ticket if digest support gets scheduled.

subject: Push notifications crashing Mobile App for our legal team
body: We've had four users on iOS report that the Northwind Mobile App crashes immediately after tapping a push notification about a new case update. It happens consistently on iOS 17.4 devices, app version 3.8.1. Notifications for document approvals seem fine, only the case-update ones trigger the crash. Can you check if this is a known bug?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. We're seeing a similar pattern from another customer tied to a malformed deep link in case-update notifications, and our mobile team is already investigating. Could you send us the exact notification text or a screenshot from one of the affected devices so we can confirm it matches, and in the meantime we'd recommend disabling push for case-update alerts as a workaround.

subject: Request to enable offline mode for field staff
body: Our drivers frequently lose signal during pickups and the Mobile App currently requires a live connection to log delivery confirmations. We'd like to switch on offline mode so they can queue updates locally and sync once back in range. Could you walk us through enabling this for our workspace and any limitations we should know about, like login token expiry while offline?
answer: Offline mode can be enabled from Workspace Settings > Mobile > Offline Sync, and once turned on, queued actions will sync automatically when connectivity returns. One thing to note is that login sessions still expire after 12 hours, so drivers should reauthenticate at the start of each shift to avoid queued actions failing to sync. Let us know if you'd like a short walkthrough call to set this up for your team.

body: unsubscribe links in our alert emails are broken, users click them and get an error page instead of being removed from the list. we're now sending duplicate daily alerts to over 300 recipients because the unsubscribe never processes, and support inboxes are getting flooded with complaints. this started around March 3rd after we updated our alert templates.
answer: Thank you for flagging this, we understand the urgency given the volume of duplicate sends. We've escalated this as a P1 and our notifications team is checking whether the template update broke the unsubscribe token generation; can you share one of the broken unsubscribe URLs so we can trace the exact failure. In the meantime, we recommend pausing the affected alert campaign to stop further duplicate sends until we confirm a fix.

subject: Rotating API keys and SDK deprecation timeline
body: We're planning to rotate our API keys next quarter and noticed a deprecation notice mentioning the v1 SDK will be sunset. Could you confirm the exact date v1 key authentication stops working and whether our existing webhooks tied to those keys need to be recreated, or if we can just update the key value in place?
answer: The v1 SDK and its associated key format are scheduled for sunset on June 30th, after which only v2 keys will authenticate successfully. You can update the key value in place for existing webhooks without recreating them, as long as you migrate before the cutoff date, and we'll send a reminder email two weeks prior with a migration checklist.

subject: Storage quota exceeded despite recent cleanup
body: We deleted about 40GB of old backup snapshots yesterday but our Storage dashboard still shows we're at 98% of quota and new uploads are failing with 'quota exceeded' errors. This is blocking our nightly backup job from completing since last night. Account ID is cobalt-sys-prod-01 if that helps locate the issue.
answer: Thanks for the account ID, we can see the deletion registered on our side but the quota counter appears stuck due to a delayed recalculation job. We're manually triggering a quota refresh now and will confirm once it reflects correctly, which should unblock your nightly backup within the next hour.

subject: SAML login failing for all users after IdP metadata update
body: We updated our IdP metadata this morning and now every SAML login attempt through Northwind Identity fails with 'invalid_signature' at the ACS endpoint. This is affecting our entire hospital network of roughly 3,200 staff who can't log in at all right now. We rolled back the metadata change on our end but the error persists.
answer: This is being treated as a critical incident given the full outage across your organization. We're pulling the current SAML metadata cache on our side now, since a rollback on your IdP won't take effect until our cache refreshes, and we're forcing that refresh manually. We'll update you within 30 minutes with confirmation once logins are restored, and please keep the rollback in place on your end.

subject: SEAT COUNT IS WRONG AND WE'RE BEING OVERCHARGED
body: THIS IS THE THIRD MONTH IN A ROW OUR INVOICE SHOWS 175 SEATS BILLED BUT WE ONLY HAVE 160 ACTIVE USERS. WE REMOVED 15 EMPLOYEES BACK IN JANUARY AND YOUR SYSTEM STILL COUNTS THEM. WE'VE ALREADY PAID FOR SEATS WE DON'T USE AND NO ONE HAS RESPONDED TO OUR LAST TWO EMAILS ABOUT A REFUND. IF THIS ISN'T FIXED THIS WEEK WE ARE CANCELING OUR CONTRACT.
answer: We're sorry for the delay and the frustration this has caused, and we're escalating this immediately to billing for review. Can you confirm the deactivation dates for the 15 removed users so we can verify the seat count discrepancy and process a corrected invoice along with a refund for the overcharged months. We'll have a resolution and refund confirmation to you within 2 business days.

subject: Scheduled syncs running hours late
body: Our nightly Data Pipelines sync from the inventory warehouse used to complete by 2am but for the past week it's finishing anywhere between 6am and 9am, which is delaying our morning reporting. The sync itself succeeds without errors, it just seems to be queued much longer than usual. Job ID is dp-vertex-inv-daily if that helps.
answer: Thanks for the job ID, that helps us pinpoint this quickly. We're seeing increased queue latency across several pipeline jobs in your region starting last Tuesday, likely tied to a scheduler capacity issue, and our data platform team is rebalancing worker allocation now. We'll monitor dp-vertex-inv-daily specifically and follow up once it's back to completing within its normal window.

subject: Need clarity on backup retention policy for compliance audit
body: We're preparing for an education-sector compliance audit and need to confirm how long Northwind Storage retains deleted backups before permanent purge. Our current documentation mentions 30 days but a colleague was told 90 days by support previously, and we need an accurate answer in writing since auditors will ask for our data retention policy this month.
answer: This is an important one to get right for your audit, so let me confirm: the default retention window for deleted backups on the Starter plan is 30 days, after which data is permanently purged and cannot be recovered. The 90-day figure may have referred to a different plan tier, and we'll send you a formal written confirmation of your current retention settings today for your compliance records.

subject: JIRA INTEGRATION BROKEN, TICKETS NOT SYNCING
body: OUR JIRA LINK STOPPED WORKING TWO DAYS AGO. NEW ISSUES CREATED IN JIRA ARE NOT SHOWING UP IN NORTHWIND ANYMORE AND OUR SUPPORT TEAM CAN'T TRACK THEM. WE ALSO USE SLACK AND OKTA INTEGRATIONS BUT THOSE STILL SEEM FINE, IT'S ONLY JIRA. WE HAVE 5 PEOPLE RELYING ON THIS DAILY AND WORK IS PILING UP.
answer: Thank you for reporting this, we know how disruptive a broken integration is for daily workflows. We're checking the Jira connector logs for your workspace now to see if the OAuth token expired or if there was a webhook failure on Jira's side, and we'll need you to reauthorize the Jira connection from Integrations settings as a first troubleshooting step. We'll follow up shortly with next steps if reauthorization doesn't resolve the sync.

subject: Mobile app crashes on launch after last update
body:
I'm on the Northwind Mobile App version 4.2.1 on Android, and since updating three days ago the app crashes immediately on launch, before even showing the login screen. I've tried reinstalling and clearing cache but it still crashes every time. This happens on two different devices in our logistics team, both running Android 13.

Is there a known issue with this version, or a rollback option available? Not urgent since we can still use the desktop dashboard in the meantime.
answer: Thanks for the details on the crash behavior. We've seen a small number of reports tied to version 4.2.1 on Android 13 and our mobile team is investigating a fix. In the meantime, could you try installing version 4.1.9 from our downloads page as a temporary workaround? I'll follow up here once the patch is confirmed and ready for release.

subject: Offline mode failing to sync and causing app crash
body:
We're integrating the Northwind API into our academy's field inspection workflow, and the Mobile App's offline mode is causing problems. When a device goes offline, logs data locally, then reconnects, the app crashes during sync roughly 1 in 3 times. We've reproduced this on 3 separate tablets since Monday.

The crash happens right after the login token refresh attempt post-reconnect. This is blocking our staff from submitting inspection reports reliably, affecting all 8 of our licensed users. Can someone look into this today?
answer: I'm sorry for the disruption this is causing your team. This looks related to a token refresh race condition during offline-to-online sync that we're aware of and actively working on. As a workaround, can you have users force-close and reopen the app after reconnecting rather than waiting for auto-sync? I'm escalating this to our mobile engineering team now and will update you within one business day with a fix timeline.

subject: Transform step failing intermittently in pipeline
body:
I'm building a data pipeline that pulls from our Salesforce connector into a transform step that aggregates order volumes by region. Since last week, the transform fails intermittently with an error referencing a null field value, even though the source records look complete when I check them manually. It's failed 4 out of the last 10 runs.

Could someone explain what triggers this specific failure, or point me to documentation on handling nulls in transform expressions? We'd like to add proper error handling so it doesn't just fail silently.
answer: Thanks for the clear description. Null handling in transform steps depends on how the field is typed upstream, and intermittent failures like this are often caused by occasional nulls slipping through the connector sync. I'd recommend adding a coalesce or default-value expression on that field, and I'm linking our transform documentation on null handling below. If the failures continue after that change, send us the run IDs and we'll dig into the connector side.

subject: Incorrect seat count reflected on latest invoice
body:
Our latest invoice from Northwind lists 240 seats billed, but we only have 224 active seats provisioned under our Pro plan for Atlas Academy. This discrepancy has appeared for the second consecutive billing cycle now, and it's affecting our internal budget reconciliation.

Can you confirm why the seat count is off and whether we're due a refund or credit adjustment for the overage? We need this resolved before our finance team closes this month's books.
answer: Thank you for flagging this, and I understand the urgency given your closing deadline. I'm pulling up your account now to compare the provisioned seat count against what was billed, and it does look like there may be a sync delay between seat deactivations and the billing system. I'll confirm the exact discrepancy and process a credit for the overage within the next two business days, and update you here as soon as it's applied.

subject: Unable to update workspace security settings
body:
As the IT administrator for Lumen Media, I'm trying to update our workspace allowlist settings in the Admin Console to restrict access to a new set of corporate IP ranges, but the changes aren't saving. Every time I click save, the page reloads and the old IP list is still shown. This started this morning after we tried adding a fourth IP range.

We need this in place before end of day since we're required to restrict access per our compliance review this week. Please advise urgently.
answer: Thank you for reporting this right away, I know the compliance deadline makes this time-sensitive. We're looking into why the allowlist save action is failing after a fourth entry, as this may be tied to a validation limit issue. As a temporary workaround, can you try saving with three IP ranges first and then adding the fourth in a separate save? I'll keep monitoring this ticket and update you as soon as we confirm the root cause.

subject: Audit log missing entries for admin deactivations
body:
I support the account for Vertex Energy, and while reviewing our Admin Console audit log for a security review, I noticed that several user deactivation events from October 3rd through October 5th are missing entirely. We deactivated 6 accounts during that window as part of an offboarding process, but only 2 show up in the log.

This is a compliance concern for us since the audit log is our source of truth for access reviews. Can you confirm whether this is a display issue or if the events were actually not logged?
answer: Thank you for bringing this to our attention, and I understand the compliance implications here. We're checking our backend logging pipeline now to determine whether this is a display filtering issue in the console or an actual gap in event capture for that date range. I'll provide an update within one business day, and if the events were not logged, we'll work with you on documenting this for your audit trail.

subject: Request for improved handling of transform failures and latency alerts
body:
I manage finance reporting for Willow Travel, and we rely on a Data Pipelines job that transforms booking data from our connector each night. Over the past two weeks we've had three transform failures related to data quality issues in currency fields, and the latency on the sync itself has increased from roughly 20 minutes to over an hour.

We'd like to request either better documentation on setting up data quality validation rules before the transform step, or a built-in feature for latency alerting so we're not discovering these issues the next morning. Happy to hop on a call if useful.
answer: Thank you for the thorough context, this is valuable feedback. We do have data quality validation rules available at the pre-transform stage, and I'll send over documentation on configuring currency field checks specifically. Latency alerting for pipeline runs is on our product roadmap, and I'm logging your request as a vote for that feature. In the meantime, I'd recommend setting a scheduled monitor on the pipeline run duration so you get notified before the next business day.

subject: How to export dashboard with multiple charts to PDF
body:
I'm a support engineer at Cobalt Health, and I'm trying to export one of our Dashboards views to PDF for a client report. The dashboard has 5 charts, and when I click export, only the first 2 charts render in the PDF while the rest appear blank. This has happened with two different dashboards this week.

Is there a size or chart-count limit for PDF export, or a setting I need to adjust? Any guidance on getting all charts to render correctly would help.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. There isn't a hard chart-count limit, but PDF exports can time out on rendering when charts include large datasets or heavy visualizations, which may explain the blank charts. Try reducing the date range on the slower-loading charts before exporting, or export in two batches if the issue persists. Let us know which specific chart types are affected and we can check if there's a rendering bug on our end.

subject: Zapier integration stopped triggering Slack notifications
body:
We use the Northwind Zapier integration to push new lead records into a Slack channel and also sync select fields to Salesforce. Since yesterday around 2pm, the Zap has stopped triggering entirely, even though new records are being created in our system as expected. We've checked the Zapier dashboard and it shows zero task history for the past 18 hours.

This is affecting our sales team's ability to follow up on new leads in real time. Could you check if something changed on the Northwind integration or webhook side?
answer: Thank you for flagging this promptly, I know real-time lead follow-up depends on this working. We're checking whether there was a webhook delivery issue or authentication token expiration on our integration side around the time you noticed the drop. Could you confirm the exact Zap name or ID so we can trace the trigger history on our end? I'm escalating this now given the business impact and will update you as soon as we find the cause.

subject: Refund not applied correctly after credit adjustment
body:
Our account for Harbor Robotics received a credit adjustment last month for an overbilling issue on our Pro plan, but the credit hasn't been reflected on our two most recent invoices. We were told it would offset $1,240 against future charges, but both invoices since then show full amounts due with no credit line item.

Can someone confirm the status of this credit and reissue the invoices with it properly applied? We have 208 seats on this account and need accurate billing for our internal cost allocation.
answer: I apologize for the trouble this has caused with your cost allocation process. I'm reviewing the credit adjustment record now to confirm whether it was applied to the correct account ledger, since it should have automatically offset your next invoices. I'll have a corrected status for you within one business day, and if the credit was misapplied, we'll reissue both invoices with the $1,240 properly reflected.

subject: SCIM provisioning failing - new hires not getting access
body:
We use SCIM provisioning from our IdP to Northwind for Delta Freight and since this morning new users are not being created. Our IdP shows the push as successful (200 response) but the users never appear in the Northwind admin console. We have 6 new employees who started today and none of them can log in.

This is affecting our whole onboarding flow. Can someone check the SCIM endpoint logs on your end? Our tenant ID is dfr-energy-01.
answer: Thanks for flagging this, I understand how disruptive this is for onboarding day. I'm escalating this to our identity engineering team right now as a P1 - we're seeing some anomalies in the SCIM ingestion queue for your tenant that align with the timeframe you mentioned. I'll update you within the hour with either a fix or a workaround so your new hires can get access today.

subject: Push-Benachrichtigungen kommen nicht zuverlässig an
body:
Uns ist aufgefallen, dass Push-Benachrichtigungen in der Mobile App seit letzter Woche unregelmäßig ankommen. Manche Mitarbeiter bekommen Meldungen erst mit mehreren Stunden Verspätung, andere gar nicht. Das betrifft vor allem Kollegen, die zwischendurch offline waren und die App später wieder öffnen.

Wir haben aktuell nur 4 Nutzer, aber gerade im Gesundheitswesen ist das für uns unpraktisch, da wichtige Hinweise zu spät kommen. Gibt es dafür eine bekannte Ursache?
answer: Vielen Dank für die genaue Beschreibung. Verzögerte Push-Benachrichtigungen nach Offline-Phasen können auftreten, wenn die App die Synchronisierung erst beim nächsten aktiven Start nachholt statt im Hintergrund. Wir prüfen das Verhalten für Ihr Konto und schauen uns die Zustellprotokolle der letzten Woche an. Da es sich um ein bekanntes, nicht kritisches Verhalten handeln könnte, melden wir uns mit einer Einschätzung und ggf. einem Workaround innerhalb der nächsten Tage.

subject: Hitting rate limits constantly after recent API changes, webhooks failing
body:
Since last week we've been consistently hitting 429 rate limit errors on the /v2/shipments endpoint, even though our request volume hasn't changed. We're making around 400 requests per minute which used to be fine. Our webhook consumer is also failing intermittently with timeout errors, which is causing us to miss delivery status updates for logistics tracking.

We read in the changelog that some endpoints were deprecated recently - is our rate limit tier affected by that? We need this resolved quickly since our operations team relies on real-time tracking data throughout the day.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. We did adjust rate limit tiers as part of the API v2 deprecation rollout last week, and it looks like your account may have been moved to a lower default tier during that migration. I'm escalating this as P1 since it's impacting your live tracking workflow - our platform team will review your account's tier assignment and webhook retry configuration today. In the meantime, adding exponential backoff on 429s should reduce webhook timeout cascades.

subject: Requesting refund for duplicate charge and credit clarification
body:
Our latest invoice shows we were charged twice for the same billing cycle - once on the 3rd and again on the 5th, both for $340. I also noticed we still have unused credits from a previous promotion that don't seem to have been applied to either charge.

Could someone review our account and process a refund for the duplicate charge? We'd also like clarification on how the promotional credits are supposed to be applied going forward, since this is causing confusion for our finance team at Apex Systems.
answer: Thank you for pointing this out, and I'm sorry for the confusion on your invoice. I can see the duplicate charge on your account and will initiate a refund for the second transaction right away - this should reflect within 3-5 business days. I'll also review how your promotional credits are being applied and follow up with a clear breakdown so this doesn't happen again.

subject: Need audit log export enabled for compliance review
body:
Our finance team at Apex Media is undergoing an internal compliance review and we need to export the full audit log from the Admin Console, including user deactivation events from the last 90 days. Right now the export option in the console is greyed out and clicking it does nothing.

We have a deadline with our auditors this Friday, so this is time sensitive. Can you either enable the export feature or provide the logs directly?
answer: I understand the urgency given your Friday deadline. I've checked your account and it looks like audit log export requires a permission flag that wasn't enabled on your workspace - I'm turning that on now, which should resolve the greyed-out button within a few minutes. If you still have trouble exporting after that, let me know immediately and I'll pull the deactivation events manually so you don't miss your deadline.

subject: Recurring card decline errors on invoice payments via API
body:
We're integrating billing status checks into our internal dashboard and noticed our production card has been declining for the past two billing attempts, on the 2nd and again on the 9th. The API response just returns error code card_declined with no further detail, but the same card works fine for other vendors.

Can you tell us what's triggering the decline on Northwind's end specifically? We have 122 seats on this account and don't want service interrupted for our legal team users.
answer: Thanks for the details, this helps narrow it down. Card declines with that generic code on our end are often triggered by the issuing bank's fraud filters reacting to recurring SaaS charges, rather than an issue with the card itself. I'd recommend contacting your bank to whitelist Northwind as a recurring merchant, and in the meantime I'll flag your account to pause any service restriction actions for 72 hours so your team isn't affected while you sort out the payment method.

subject: Need to restore storage data from backup after accidental deletion
body:
One of our team leads accidentally deleted a folder containing several months of compliance documents from Storage yesterday around 4pm. We need to restore this from backup as soon as possible since it's tied to an ongoing audit for Harbor Partners.

Could you confirm what retention window applies to our Enterprise plan and walk us through the restore process, or initiate the restore on your end if that's faster?
answer: I'm sorry to hear about the accidental deletion, and given the audit context I've flagged this for priority handling. Your Enterprise plan retains deleted storage objects for 30 days, so the folder should still be recoverable. I'm initiating a restore request now for the deleted folder and will confirm once the data is back in place, which should be within the next few hours.

subject: Uploads to Storage failing intermittently for large files
body:
Since early this week we've noticed uploads over roughly 500MB to Storage fail partway through with a generic 'upload interrupted' message, while smaller files upload fine. This is affecting our data team's ability to back up route planning datasets for Delta Travel on schedule.

We'd like to understand if this is a quota issue or something else, and whether there's a change we need to make to our retention or backup configuration to avoid this going forward.
answer: Thanks for reporting this with the file size detail, that's useful. Intermittent failures on larger uploads are usually caused by connection timeouts rather than quota limits, though I'll double check your current storage quota just to rule that out. I'll also review your retention and backup job configuration to see if a chunked upload setting would help avoid interruptions on larger files going forward.

subject: Urgent: bulk uploads to Storage failing, backups at risk
body:
We rely on nightly bulk uploads to Storage for backing up case files across Pioneer Legal, and for the past two nights the job has failed partway through with upload errors. Our retention policy assumes these backups complete successfully, so we're now missing two days of backup coverage across 223 seats.

We need this fixed urgently and would also appreciate documentation on how quota limits interact with bulk uploads so we can plan capacity going forward.
answer: I understand the urgency here given the backup coverage gap, and I'm treating this as high priority. I'm checking your bulk upload job logs for the past two nights now to identify the failure point, and will let you know shortly whether this is a quota threshold issue or something else. I'll also send over our documentation on quota and bulk upload interaction so you can plan capacity with more confidence.

subject: Scheduled data pipeline syncs running hours late
body:
Our nightly sync jobs in Data Pipelines, which pull data from our ERP connector into the reporting warehouse, have been running 3-4 hours later than scheduled for the past several days. The sync itself completes without errors, but the delay is causing our downstream dashboards to show stale data each morning for Vertex Partners.

Could you check if there's a queuing or latency issue on the scheduler side? We need the syncs running on time again since our manufacturing teams rely on morning data for planning.
answer: Thanks for the clear timeline on this. Delays of this pattern usually point to scheduler queue congestion rather than the connector itself, especially if the sync completes cleanly once it starts. I'm reviewing the scheduling logs for your pipeline now to identify where the delay is originating, and will follow up with findings and next steps so your morning data is reliable again.

subject: Seat count wrong on latest invoice
body: I'm working through our Northwind API integration for Blue Foods and pulled invoice INV-88213 to reconcile with our internal billing system. The invoice lists 25 seats but we only have 22 active users under our Starter plan. Can someone confirm whether this is a billing error or if there's a doc explaining how seat counts are calculated for mid-cycle changes? We need this cleared up before our finance team closes the month.
answer: Thanks for flagging this - a seat count mismatch on an invoice is definitely worth investigating rather than assuming it's correct. I've pulled INV-88213 and can see the discrepancy; it looks like three deactivated seats from earlier in the cycle weren't excluded from proration. I'm issuing a corrected invoice now and will send you a short doc link on how mid-cycle seat changes are calculated going forward.

subject: Offline mode support for API-driven mobile app
body: We're integrating the Northwind Mobile SDK into our Harbor Health app and need to understand current offline mode capabilities. Right now if a user loses connectivity mid-session, the app crashes with a null reference instead of falling back to cached data. We'd also like push notifications to queue locally and send once connectivity resumes rather than being dropped.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. Offline mode currently caches read-only data but doesn't yet gracefully handle session state loss, which explains the crash you're seeing - we have this logged as a known gap. I'm filing a feature request for queued push delivery on your behalf and will follow up with our mobile team's timeline for improved offline session handling.

subject: IP-Allowlist deaktiviert Zugriff unerwartet
body: Wir nutzen die Admin Console für Apex Energy und haben gestern eine neue IP zur Allowlist hinzugefügt. Seitdem werden zwei unserer drei API-Zugänge automatisch deaktiviert, sobald wir einen Request senden. Im Audit Log ist die Änderung selbst nicht sichtbar, nur die Deaktivierung der Keys. Das blockiert unsere Integration komplett seit heute Morgen.
answer: Danke für die genaue Beschreibung. Eine automatische Deaktivierung nach einer Allowlist-Änderung deutet auf einen Konflikt zwischen der neuen IP-Regel und einer bestehenden Sicherheitsrichtlinie hin - wir prüfen das gerade im Detail. Ich schaue mir parallel an, warum die Änderung nicht im Audit Log erscheint, und melde mich mit einem Update, sobald wir die Ursache eingegrenzt haben.

subject: quick question
body:
Trying to process a partial refund via the Billing API for Orion Health and getting a consistent failure. Here's what we get back:

{"error":"invalid_state","code":409,"message":"credit_note cannot be applied to invoice in status: paid"}
  at RefundService.apply (billing.js:142)
  at processRefund (handlers/refund.js:58)
  at async POST /v1/refunds

Invoice INV-77410 is marked paid, but we still need to issue a $40 credit for 2 unused seats last month. Is there a different endpoint for post-payment credits?
answer: Thanks for including the error trace, that helps a lot. The 409 you're hitting is expected behavior since credit notes can't be applied directly to invoices already marked paid - for that case you'll want the /v1/credits endpoint, which issues a standalone credit balance instead of modifying the paid invoice. I'll send over the credit endpoint docs and a sample payload for the seat adjustment scenario.

subject: Scheduled syncs failing across all connectors since last night
body: Since around 11pm last night, none of our scheduled syncs for Orion Academy have completed successfully. We have 6 connectors configured and all of them are showing 'sync failed' with retry attempts maxing out. This is affecting downstream reporting for our whole ops team and we can't tell if it's a config issue on our side or a platform problem, since nothing changed in our setup.
answer: This is being treated as a priority issue given it's affecting all your connectors simultaneously. We're seeing elevated error rates on the sync scheduler starting around the same time you reported, and our engineering team is actively investigating a likely backend regression. I'll update you within the hour with either a fix timeline or a workaround to manually trigger syncs in the meantime.

subject: Okta app provisioning errors and slow SSO response
body: We set up the Northwind Okta app for Summit Analytics last week and provisioning is inconsistent - two of our four users get 'assignment failed' errors in Okta's admin log, and successful logins take 8-10 seconds to redirect back. We're also hoping to eventually connect Slack, Jira and Salesforce through the same integration hub, so want to make sure the Okta piece is stable first.
answer: Thanks for the details on both issues. The assignment failures are usually tied to attribute mapping mismatches between Okta and our provisioning API, so I'd like to see the SCIM logs for the two affected users to pinpoint the exact field causing rejection. On the slow redirect, that's not typical behavior and we'll check our SSO response times on our end while we dig into the provisioning errors.

subject: Occasional SAML assertion timeout during peak login hours
body: We've noticed a small number of our 452 users hitting SAML assertion timeout errors during our 9am login peak, roughly 10-15 failed logins per day out of thousands. MFA and provisioning both seem fine otherwise. It's not urgent since users just retry successfully, but wanted to flag it in case it points to something on the SSO performance side worth tuning.
answer: Appreciate you flagging this even though it's low impact - patterns like this are worth understanding before they grow. We'll pull the SSO performance metrics around your peak login window to see if there's a correlation with assertion processing load, and I'll follow up with findings even if no immediate action is needed on your end.

subject: Jira issues not syncing back to Northwind after linking
body: We linked our Jira instance to Ember Works' workspace two weeks ago and initially it worked fine, but for the past few days new Jira issues created from Northwind tickets aren't syncing status updates back. We've confirmed the Jira webhook is still active on Jira's side. This is making it hard for our team to track ticket resolution without checking two systems manually.
answer: Thanks for confirming the webhook is active on the Jira side - that helps narrow things down to our integration layer. We're seeing a similar pattern reported for a handful of workspaces, likely tied to a token refresh issue on our Jira connector. I'm re-authenticating the connection for Ember Works now and will confirm once status sync is restored.

subject: Requesting minimum OS version update after crash reports
body: Several of our Willow Works employees on older Android versions are reporting the mobile app crashing immediately on launch, seemingly since the last update. We'd like to request either a fix for backward compatibility or clear documentation on the current minimum supported OS version so we can update our device policy accordingly.
answer: Thanks for raising this - we did tighten minimum OS requirements in the last release, which likely explains the launch crashes on older Android versions. I'll send you the updated compatibility documentation now, and I'm also passing your backward-compatibility request to the mobile team for consideration in a future release.

subject: Uploads failing for all users, quota shows available space
body: Starting this morning, uploads are failing for essentially all 66 users at Quill Legal with a generic 'upload could not be completed' error, even though our storage quota dashboard shows we're well under our limit. This is blocking document intake for our legal teams. We also need to confirm our retention and backup settings weren't affected, since this coincided with a policy change we made yesterday for a specific case folder.
answer: This is being escalated immediately given the scope of impact. We're checking whether yesterday's retention policy change on that case folder triggered a quota recalculation error that's blocking uploads platform-wide for your account, even though displayed quota looks normal. I'll have an update within 30 minutes and will separately confirm your backup integrity wasn't affected by the policy change.

subject: Feature request: Salesforce sync field mapping via Okta groups
body:
We're using the Salesforce connector under Integrations and it's working well for basic account sync, but we'd like the ability to map custom fields based on Okta group membership rather than a static profile. Right now every synced record uses the same field mapping regardless of which business unit the Salesforce user belongs to, and with 252 seats across three divisions this creates a lot of manual cleanup.

Could we get a way to define mapping rules per Okta group, or at least per Salesforce profile, so sync behaves differently for manufacturing vs. sales teams? Happy to share our current mapping config if useful.
answer: Thanks for the detailed writeup, this is a great use case. Per-group field mapping isn't available today, but it's a reasonable ask and I'm logging it as a feature request for the Integrations team with your Okta group structure noted as a motivating example. In the meantime, I can help you set up two separate sync profiles keyed on Salesforce profile IDs as a workaround if that would reduce the manual cleanup in the short term - let me know if you'd like a walkthrough.

subject: Duplicate email digests going out every hour instead of daily
body:
Since this morning our finance team has been getting the same weekly spend digest email over and over, roughly every hour, instead of the single daily summary we configured. I've counted at least 6 duplicate emails since 8am for the same reporting period ending yesterday.

This is flooding inboxes for our 23 users and some of them are asking if they should unsubscribe. Can you check what's triggering the repeat sends? We haven't changed any notification settings recently.
answer: Sorry for the disruption this is causing your team - I can see this is a real problem and we're treating it with urgency. We're looking into the digest scheduler now to identify why the same job is re-firing; in the meantime, please don't change your notification settings as that could complicate diagnosis. I'll update you within the hour with either a fix or a temporary pause on digest sends while we resolve it.

subject: Transform stage failing intermittently on booking pipeline
body:
Our booking-events pipeline has started failing at the transform stage several times a day since yesterday. The job log shows 'transform step timed out after 300s' for roughly 1 in 4 runs, and the affected records aren't retried automatically, so we're missing data in downstream reporting tables for a travel itinerary sync.

We run this pipeline on a 15-minute schedule and have noticed the failures cluster around peak booking hours. Can someone look at why the transform step is timing out now when it wasn't last week? We need this stable before our finance close on Friday.
answer: Thank you for flagging this with the timing details, that's very helpful. We can see elevated transform latency correlating with your peak-hour runs and are investigating whether a recent resource limit change on the transform workers is the cause. As an immediate mitigation we're increasing the timeout threshold on your pipeline to reduce failed runs while we root-cause the underlying latency issue, and we'll follow up before end of day with findings given your Friday close deadline.

subject: Request for cursor-based pagination on /shipments endpoint
body:
We're integrating the API Platform's /shipments endpoint into our logistics dashboard and currently rely on offset-based pagination, which is causing skipped and duplicate records when shipment volume shifts mid-page during high-throughput windows. With 267 seats pulling data continuously, this offset drift is becoming a real accuracy problem.

Could you add cursor-based pagination support for this endpoint, similar to what I've seen documented for /invoices? Also, is there a recommended rate limit pattern we should follow if we're polling every 30 seconds across multiple integrations?
answer: Thanks for the clear explanation of the offset drift issue - that's a known limitation of offset pagination under high write volume, and cursor-based support for /shipments is on our roadmap. I'll add your use case to that request to help with prioritization. On the polling question, our documented guidance is to stay under 60 requests per minute per integration with exponential backoff on 429s; I can send you the current rate limit table for /shipments specifically if that helps you plan the 30-second interval.

subject: Need audit log entries for account deactivation events
body:
I'm building an internal compliance report and need audit log entries in the Admin Console whenever a user account is deactivated, including who performed the deactivation and the timestamp. Right now the audit log shows login and settings changes but nothing for deactivation events - I checked logs for the past 30 days and found zero entries even though we deactivated 3 accounts in that window.

This is blocking a security review we're required to complete this week for our 22-seat workspace. Is this a gap in what's tracked, or is there a setting I need to enable to capture these events?
answer: You're right that deactivation events aren't currently captured in the audit log by default - this is a gap on our end rather than a setting you're missing, and I understand the urgency given your review timeline. I'm escalating this as a priority fix request and will also manually pull the deactivation records from our internal system logs for those 3 accounts so you have something concrete for this week's review; I'll send that over within the next few hours.

subject: Multiple card declines on renewal charge
body:
Our renewal charge failed twice this week with the message 'card declined - do not honor' even though the same card processed our previous three renewals without issue. We have 18 seats on the Starter plan and I want to avoid any service interruption while we sort out payment.

Can you tell me why it's being declined now, and is there a grace period before the workspace gets suspended? I'd also like to know if we can switch to a different card or get a refund reissued if we were double-charged during the retry attempts.
answer: Thanks for flagging this before it caused disruption. 'Do not honor' declines usually come from the issuing bank rather than our side, often triggered by a fraud flag or updated card verification requirements, so it's worth a quick call to your bank to confirm nothing's blocking the transaction. Your workspace has a 7-day grace period before any suspension, and I've checked your billing history - there's no duplicate charge from the retries, but I've added a card update link to your billing page so you can switch payment methods right away if needed.

subject: Offline mode not syncing captured orders after reconnect
body:
Our field team uses the mobile app in offline mode to log store visits and orders, and since last week the data captured offline isn't syncing back once the device reconnects to wifi. We've confirmed this on both iOS and Android across several devices - the app shows a 'sync pending' badge that never clears, even after leaving it connected overnight.

We have 142 users relying on this daily and right now anything logged offline is effectively stuck on the device. Can you help us understand what's blocking the sync and whether the queued data is at risk of being lost?
answer: This is a serious issue for your field operations and I want to reassure you first that offline-captured data is stored locally and not deleted even if sync is delayed, so it isn't at immediate risk of loss. We're actively investigating the stuck 'sync pending' state, which appears related to a background sync job change from last week's release, and I'll follow up shortly with either a fix or a manual sync workaround your team can use in the meantime given the number of affected users.

subject: Offline mode login prompt appears even when previously authenticated
body:
I've noticed that our operations team gets prompted to log in again when opening the mobile app in offline mode, even though they were already authenticated before losing connectivity. It seems to only happen after the app has been closed for a while, maybe a few hours, and then reopened without network access.

It's not blocking work since they can usually reconnect briefly to log in, but it's a bit odd behavior and we wanted to flag it in case it's a bug worth fixing rather than something we're doing wrong.
answer: Thanks for the report - this sounds like the offline session token expiring earlier than expected rather than something on your end. It shouldn't require reconnecting after a few hours if the device was already authenticated, so I'm logging this as a bug for the mobile team to investigate the token expiry logic in offline mode. It's low impact for now, but I'll update this ticket once we have more information on the root cause.

subject: URGENT - SSO login broken for all users, role mapping errors
body:
Since about 20 minutes ago none of our staff can log in through SSO - everyone gets 'access denied: role mapping not found' immediately after the identity provider redirect. This is affecting all 18 users at Atlas Health and nobody can get into the platform right now, including admins trying to troubleshoot.

We made no changes to our SSO configuration recently. Provisioning also seems affected - a new hire added this morning never got assigned the expected role group. This is a complete outage for us, please treat as highest priority.
answer: This is being treated as our highest priority right now - a full login outage is unacceptable and we have engineers actively investigating. We've identified that a recent update to our role mapping service may have dropped mapping configs for a subset of tenants including yours; we're working on restoring your mappings from backup and will have an update within 15 minutes. I'll stay on this ticket directly until access is restored for all your users.

subject: Incorrect seat count charged after plan upgrade
body:
We upgraded from 150 to 171 seats last week to onboard our new manufacturing shift, but this month's invoice shows a charge for 190 seats. I've double-checked our admin console user list and we're at 171 active seats, not 190, so either the upgrade proration or the seat count sync is off.

Could you review the invoice dated the 3rd and correct the discrepancy? We'd also like to understand whether this was a one-time billing glitch or something that could recur on future invoices.
answer: Thank you for catching this and providing the specific invoice date - I've pulled up your billing record and can confirm the seat count on the invoice doesn't match your active user list, which points to a proration calculation error during the upgrade rather than anything on your end. I'm issuing a corrected invoice for the difference along with a refund for the overcharge, and I'll flag this proration logic to our billing team to make sure it doesn't recur on future upgrades.

subject: Add PO number to invoices and update billing contact
body: Hi, I'm the workspace admin for Summit Travel. We'd like our invoices going forward to include our PO number (PO-55231), and I need to change the billing contact email that receives the monthly statements. Also, our last invoice (INV-08841) still shows our previous seat count before we trimmed down to 237 — can you confirm how refunds or credits work when seats are reduced mid-cycle?
answer: Thanks for reaching out — I can help with both. I've added a request to attach PO-55231 to all future invoices starting with next month's billing cycle, and I've sent you a link to update the billing contact email directly from the Billing Settings page. On seat reductions, we apply a prorated credit to the next invoice rather than a direct refund, so INV-08841 should reflect that adjustment once the new cycle generates — I'll double check that credit was applied correctly and follow up today.

subject: Offline mode failing to sync scanned data for field staff
body: We're seeing a serious issue with the mobile app's offline mode across our retail team. Techs scan inventory while offline in stores with no signal, but when they reconnect, roughly half the queued records never sync — no error shown, they just silently drop. This started after the last app update (v4.2.1) and is affecting all 9 of our users daily. Push notifications confirming sync completion also aren't arriving.
answer: This is impacting your whole team so I'm escalating it as high priority right away. Can you send us the device model and OS version for two or three affected phones, plus the local timestamp of a sync you know failed? While we investigate the drop issue in v4.2.1, please ask staff to keep the app open in the foreground for a minute after reconnecting rather than backgrounding it immediately, as that can help queued items flush before we push a fix.

subject: Restore from backup failing with quota error - need this resolved urgently
body: We triggered a restore from our nightly backup snapshot (2024-05-14) after a bad upload overwrote several folders, but the restore job fails every time with 'Error: destination quota exceeded (STG-409)' even though we have available space. This is blocking our compliance team from recovering records needed for an audit due this week. We've retried three times with the same result.
answer: I understand the urgency given the audit deadline, and I've flagged this as a P1 incident. The STG-409 error usually points to a stale quota calculation after large deletions rather than actual capacity — we're checking your account's quota ledger now and will run a manual recalculation on our end. I'll update you within the hour with either a fix or a manual restore path for the 2024-05-14 snapshot.

subject: Scheduled sync delays and unclear retry behavior
body: Our nightly sync from the accounting connector has been running 3-4 hours later than its scheduled window for the past week, sometimes finishing after our downstream reports are generated, so the numbers are stale. I looked through the docs but couldn't find a clear explanation of retry logic when a sync window is missed — does it just run at the next scheduled slot or attempt a catch-up immediately?
answer: Thanks for flagging this — a delayed sync window is usually caused by upstream connector throttling, and I can see some rate-limit warnings on your pipeline logs from this week. Our retry logic waits for the next scheduled slot rather than catching up immediately, which explains the lag you're seeing. I'll add a note to our documentation team about clarifying this behavior, and in the meantime I can adjust your sync window to a less congested time slot if that helps.

subject: Feedback on MFA enrolment flow and enforcement options
body: I'm setting up MFA enrolment for our finance team ahead of a security review, and I noticed there's no way to see which of our 18 users have completed enrolment versus who's still pending. It would be really helpful to have a simple status list, and ideally an option to enforce MFA only for admin roles first before rolling it out company-wide. Is either of these already possible, or planned?
answer: Good timing — an enrolment status view is something we're actively working on, though it's not available yet. As a workaround, you can check individual enrolment status under each user's Security tab in the admin console. Role-based MFA enforcement (admins-only first) also isn't supported today, but I'll log this as a feature request on your account since it's a common ask, and I'll let you know if it lands on our near-term roadmap.

subject: Connector-Authentifizierung läuft ständig ab
body: Bei unserem Logistik-Connector läuft das OAuth-Token alle paar Tage ab und wir müssen die Verbindung jedes Mal manuell neu autorisieren. In der Dokumentation steht nichts darüber, wie lange die Tokens gültig sind oder ob ein automatischer Refresh möglich ist. Können Sie uns erklären, wie wir das dauerhaft lösen können, ohne die Verbindung jede Woche neu einzurichten?
answer: Danke für die Rückmeldung. Aktuell unterstützt dieser Connector-Typ keinen automatischen Token-Refresh, weshalb die manuelle Neuautorisierung nötig ist – das werden wir in der Dokumentation ergänzen, da das offensichtlich fehlt. Ich leite Ihren Wunsch nach automatischem Refresh als Feature-Anfrage an unser Produktteam weiter und melde mich, sobald es dazu Neuigkeiten gibt.

subject: Dashboards showing blank charts for shared/external viewers
body: All of our shared dashboards are broken for external viewers as of this morning — charts render fine for internal team members but show a blank gray box with no error for anyone accessing via a shared link. This is affecting three dashboards we use with clients, and export to PDF also fails silently for those same dashboards. We have a client review call in two hours and need this working.
answer: I'm treating this as high priority given your call timing. This matches an issue we're currently investigating with permission propagation on shared-link dashboards after a recent chart-rendering update. Can you send me one of the affected dashboard links? While we work on a root-cause fix, a temporary workaround is regenerating the share link, which has restored rendering for other affected customers this morning.

subject: Sync latency causing incorrect financial reports - need urgent fix
body: Our scheduled sync from the ERP connector has been running with severe delays for three days now, sometimes 6+ hours behind schedule, and our end-of-month financial reports pulled data before the sync completed, giving us incorrect totals. This is a recurring issue we've seen before and it's now affecting numbers we're about to send to our board. We need this fixed and some way to be alerted when a sync falls behind schedule.
answer: I understand the pressure with board reporting on the line, so I'm marking this urgent. We're seeing elevated queue times on the ERP connector cluster and are working on rebalancing capacity right now — I'll update you within the next hour. I've also logged a feature request for sync-delay alerting, since that would clearly help here, and in the meantime I can manually notify you before your next scheduled run so you can confirm sync completion before pulling reports.

subject: Plan upgrade failed and we were billed for both old and new plan
body: We tried upgrading from our current Pro tier to add capacity for our 293 seats yesterday, and the upgrade shows as failed in the admin console, but our card was still charged an extra amount on top of our normal invoice. Our seat count and features haven't changed at all despite the charge. This needs to be corrected quickly since finance is asking about the duplicate charge already.
answer: Thank you for flagging this right away — a failed upgrade that still triggers a charge is a billing error on our end and I'm escalating it immediately. I can see the duplicate charge on your account and I'm initiating a refund for the erroneous amount now, which should post within 3-5 business days. I'll also manually reprocess the plan upgrade so your seat allocation and features reflect correctly, and I'll confirm both fixes with you by end of day.

subject: Need to extend storage retention period before we hit our quota
body: We're approaching our storage quota faster than expected across our logistics data pipelines, and I want to understand our options before we start losing older records. Can you tell me how to extend our retention window for archived shipment data past the current default, and whether there's a way to move older files to a lower-cost tier instead of deleting them outright? We're at 292 seats and this data volume keeps growing month over month.
answer: Thanks for getting ahead of this — extending retention is straightforward from the Storage Settings page under Retention Policy, where you can set a custom window per data category. We also support an archive tier for records older than your active retention window, which keeps them accessible but off your primary quota; I'll send you a short guide on configuring that now. Given how close you are to quota, I'd recommend setting the archive policy today so older shipment data starts moving over before you hit the limit.

subject: Biometric login failing on Mobile App after latest update
