subject: Rolling out MFA enrollment for staff, need setup guidance
body: We're preparing to enforce MFA for all 80 staff accounts under our SSO setup and want to confirm the recommended enrollment flow. Should we push enrollment via our IdP directly, or does Northwind's Identity product handle the MFA prompt post-SSO login? We're on a healthcare compliance deadline and need this configured correctly before our audit next Friday.
answer: Given the audit deadline, let's get this locked down quickly. Northwind's Identity layer can enforce MFA independently of your IdP — under Admin Console > Security > MFA Policy, set enforcement to 'Required' and users will be prompted to enroll a second factor on their next SSO login rather than needing IdP-side configuration. I'll send over our step-by-step provisioning guide today and can also set up a short call before Friday if you want us to verify the policy is applying correctly across all 80 accounts.

subject: SSO role mapping not applying correctly after IdP group update
body:
We updated our Okta groups last week to reflect a reorg, and now several managers who should be mapped to the "Plant Manager" role in Northwind are landing in the default "Viewer" role instead. This is affecting at least 30 of our 171 seats across two manufacturing sites. Role mapping config in the SSO admin panel still shows the old group names under Attribute Mappings, even though we saved changes on 2024-05-14.

Can someone confirm whether role mapping refreshes automatically on next login, or if we need to force a re-sync? We also can't find documentation on how the mapping precedence works when a user belongs to multiple groups.
answer:
Thanks for flagging this, and I understand the urgency given how many users are affected. Role mappings should refresh on next SSO login, but if the mapping config still shows stale group names after saving, that points to a caching issue on our side we need to look into directly. I'm escalating this to our identity team now and will also send over the mapping precedence documentation you asked about within the hour.

In the meantime, could you confirm the exact IdP group names involved and one or two affected user emails so we can trace the mapping logic on our end? We'll keep this at high priority until the role assignments are corrected.

subject: Biometric login stuck on loading spinner after iOS update
body:
Since our team updated to iOS 17.5 last week, three of our eight users can no longer log into the Northwind mobile app using Face ID. The app shows a spinner for about 10 seconds after the biometric prompt succeeds, then drops back to the password screen. Reinstalling the app didn't help for two of the three devices.

This is a small team but biometric login was one of the main reasons we adopted the mobile app for field staff. Is this a known issue with the latest iOS release, or something we need to reconfigure in device settings?
answer:
Thanks for the detailed report. We've had a couple of similar reports tied to iOS 17.5 and a token refresh timing issue after biometric authentication succeeds, so this is likely the same root cause rather than a device-specific problem. Our mobile team is already testing a fix and I'll update this ticket as soon as we have a rollout date.

As a workaround, if the affected users disable and re-enable Face ID login from within the app's security settings, several customers have reported the spinner issue resolves temporarily until the fix ships. Let me know if that helps in the meantime.

subject: Slack alerts from Northwind stopped firing for escalations
body:
Our escalation workflow relies on Northwind pushing alerts into our #ops-escalations Slack channel whenever a case is flagged, and this stopped working sometime after May 10th. We haven't changed the Slack app permissions or the webhook URL on our end. Jira tickets are still being created fine through the same integration, so it seems isolated to the Slack piece.

We have 243 seats relying on this for daily operations, and our team is currently escalating things manually through Okta group emails instead, which is slowing everyone down. Can you check whether something changed on the Slack connector side around that date?
answer:
Thanks for the clear breakdown, that helps narrow things down quickly. Since Jira notifications are still firing but Slack isn't, this does point to something specific in the Slack connector rather than a broader integration outage. We're checking whether a recent Slack API permission scope change on our side is affecting webhook delivery for existing connections.

Could you confirm the exact channel ID and whether the Slack app still shows as "Connected" under your Integrations settings? That will help us pinpoint whether this is a token expiration issue or a delivery filter problem, and we'll prioritize a fix given the operational impact you're describing.

subject: Recurring transform failures causing pipeline latency across multiple connectors
body:
Since May 8th we've seen a sharp rise in transform failures on our data pipelines, specifically on the connectors feeding our media asset metadata into the warehouse. Failure rate has gone from under 1% to around 14% over the past week, and retries are adding significant latency, sometimes over 40 minutes per batch. Error messages in the pipeline logs point to schema mismatch on the "asset_tags" field, but the source schema hasn't changed on our end.

Given we're running this at scale across 2202 seats and multiple downstream dashboards depend on this data being fresh, we need this escalated. We'd also like to request a feature to get proactive alerts when transform failure rates cross a threshold, rather than discovering this after the fact.
answer:
Thank you for the detailed context, this is being escalated to our data pipelines engineering team right away given the scale of impact. The schema mismatch on "asset_tags" suggests the transform step may be receiving an unexpected data type or null pattern from the connector rather than an actual source schema change, and we're pulling recent transform logs now to confirm.

We'll update you within the next few hours with findings and a mitigation plan to reduce the retry latency in the meantime. I've also logged your request for threshold-based failure alerting as a feature request with our product team, it's a reasonable ask and I'll note the urgency given your pipeline volume.

subject: Deactivated users still showing as active and retaining access
body:
We deactivated four users from the Admin Console yesterday afternoon as part of an offboarding process, but all four are still able to log in and access dashboards today. The audit log shows the deactivation events with timestamps around 3:40 PM, but the user status column still reads "Active" when I check their profiles.

This is a serious problem for us since two of those accounts belong to former contractors who shouldn't have any access at all. We need this resolved immediately and want to understand why deactivation isn't taking effect.
answer:
This has been escalated to our engineering team as a priority incident given the security implications of former contractors retaining access. We're investigating why the deactivation events recorded in the audit log aren't propagating to the active session and permission layer, this points to a sync issue between the console status and the session validation service.

As an immediate mitigation, we recommend resetting the passwords and revoking active sessions for those four accounts from the Security tab while we work on the underlying fix. I'll follow up within the hour with root cause details and confirmation once deactivation is fully effective.

subject: Occasional transform failures on Salesforce connector
body:
We've noticed intermittent transform failures on the Salesforce connector feeding our billing pipeline, happening maybe two or three times a week over the past month. The failures don't seem tied to any specific field, and re-running the job manually always succeeds. It's not urgent since our team has just been re-triggering failed jobs, but I wanted to flag the pattern in case it's a known issue.

Also curious if there's a way to see historical transform success rates per connector, right now we're just tracking this manually in a spreadsheet.
answer:
Appreciate you flagging this, intermittent failures that clear on retry are usually a sign of transient rate limiting or timeout on the source API side rather than a data quality issue. We'll pull the job logs for your Salesforce connector over the past month to check for a pattern in timing or payload size.

On the reporting question, we don't currently have a per-connector success rate view in the dashboard, but I've logged this as a feature request since it's a reasonable addition. I'll follow up once we've reviewed the connector logs.

subject: Audit log missing entries for deactivated accounts, need urgent review
body:
We're in the middle of a compliance review and discovered that our Admin Console audit log has no entries for three user deactivations that occurred in the past two weeks, even though the users themselves are correctly showing as deactivated. This is a serious gap for us since we rely on the audit log for our compliance documentation with only 18 seats total, every action needs to be traceable.

We need to understand why these deactivation events aren't being logged and whether this affects other action types too. Please escalate this, our compliance officer needs an answer by end of week.
answer:
I understand the urgency given your compliance timeline, and I've escalated this to our engineering team as a priority incident. Missing audit entries for confirmed actions is unusual and suggests a possible gap in event logging specifically around the deactivation workflow, rather than the audit system as a whole, but we're checking other action types now to rule that out.

We'll investigate the three specific deactivation events you mentioned and provide a root cause and remediation timeline well before end of week. If needed, we can also provide a written explanation of the gap for your compliance officer once we've confirmed the cause.

subject: Charged twice and refund credit never applied to account
body:
Our card was charged twice on May 12th for the same billing cycle, once for the normal invoice amount and once for a duplicate charge that shows the same invoice number. Support previously told us a refund credit would be applied to our account within 5 business days, but it's now been 9 days and our account balance still shows the full amount due with no credit applied.

This is causing real problems since we're a small team and that duplicate charge affected our cash flow. We need this fixed immediately and confirmation of when the credit will actually post.
answer:
I'm sorry for the delay and the impact this has had, this should not still be outstanding and I'm escalating it to our billing team right now as a priority issue. I can see the duplicate charge on your account and will personally confirm the refund credit is processed today rather than waiting on the standard queue.

I'll follow up with written confirmation once the credit posts, including the transaction reference, and will also flag the original 5-business-day estimate to our team since that clearly wasn't met here. Thank you for your patience while we get this corrected.

subject: cardd keeps failing on renewel, need help understandng why
body:
hey, our card keeps geting declined when the monthy renewel tries to run, its happend 3 times now since April. the bank says nothing is wrong on ther end and the card has plenty of funds avaliable. we only have 4 seats so its not a big invoice, just confusing why it keeps failing.

can you tell me exaclty what error is comming back from the payment processor? also would like to know if theres a way to see past invoices somewhere, and if theres documentaion on how billing retries work for failed payments.
answer:
Thanks for the details, and no worries, this kind of decline pattern is usually caused by the card issuer flagging recurring merchant charges for extra verification even when funds are available, rather than an actual account issue. I can pull the exact processor decline code from our end and share it with you shortly so you have something concrete to give your bank if it happens again.

You can find past invoices under Billing > Invoice History in your account settings, and I'll also send over our documentation on retry timing for failed payments. We generally retry three times over five days before the subscription is marked past due.

subject: Salesforce sync completely stopped, no records updating
body:
Our Salesforce integration stopped syncing records as of this morning, May 20th. Nothing has updated on either side since around 7 AM, and the integration status page shows "Connected" with no error indicator, which is misleading since clearly no data is flowing. We rely on this sync for lead handoff between our small sales team and operations, and right now everything is stuck.

We checked our Salesforce API limits and we're well under quota, so it doesn't seem to be a rate limiting issue on our end. Please look into this urgently since it's blocking our daily workflow.
answer:
Thank you for reporting this right away, I'm treating this as a priority incident given the sync is fully stopped for your team. A "Connected" status with no actual data movement usually points to a stalled sync job or an expired token that hasn't triggered the disconnect flag yet, and we're checking your integration logs now to confirm which it is.

I'll update you within the hour with findings, and if it turns out to be a token issue we can force a reauthorization on our end to get the sync running again without waiting for a full reconnect on your side.

subject: Missing invoice for March billing cycle
body: I administer our Northwind account for Quill Partners and I noticed our invoice for the March cycle never showed up in the Billing section. We're on the Starter plan with 4 seats and normally invoices post around the 3rd of each month. It's now the 9th and the page still shows February as the latest invoice. Could you check whether something failed on your end or resend the invoice so I can file it for our records?
answer: Thanks for flagging this. I can see our invoice generation job had a delay for a small batch of Starter accounts including yours, which is why March hasn't posted yet. I've manually triggered the invoice for Quill Partners and you should see it appear in the Billing section within the next hour, along with a copy sent to your billing contact. Let me know if it doesn't show up so I can escalate further.

subject: IP allowlist blocking our own office network
body: We updated our IP allowlist in the Admin Console yesterday to add our new office range, but since then every analyst on our team, 14 seats total, is getting locked out with an 'access denied by network policy' message even though the range looks correct in the settings. The audit log shows the change was saved at 14:02 UTC but no one has been able to log in since. This is blocking our whole team from working.
answer: This is impacting your entire team so we're treating it as urgent. I've pulled the audit log entry for the 14:02 UTC change and see the CIDR range was saved with an extra octet that's rejecting valid traffic from your office. I'm correcting the entry now and will confirm once access is restored, likely within the next 15-20 minutes, and I'll follow up with the audit trail for your records.

subject: Sitzplatzanzahl stimmt nicht mit Rechnung überein
body: Uns ist aufgefallen, dass unsere aktuelle Rechnung von 134 Sitzplätzen ausgeht, wir aber laut unserer internen Liste nur 128 aktive Nutzer im Pro-Plan haben. Das führt seit zwei Abrechnungszyklen zu einer Überzahlung. Können Sie die Sitzplatzanzahl in unserem Konto prüfen und gegebenenfalls eine Gutschrift oder Rückerstattung für die Differenz ausstellen?
answer: Vielen Dank für den Hinweis. Ich habe die Sitzplatzanzahl in Ihrem Konto überprüft und kann bestätigen, dass sechs deaktivierte Nutzer fälschlicherweise noch als aktiv gezählt wurden. Ich korrigiere die Anzahl auf 128 Sitzplätze und veranlasse eine Rückerstattung für die letzten zwei Abrechnungszyklen, die innerhalb von 5-7 Werktagen auf Ihrer Zahlungsmethode sichtbar sein sollte.

subject: URGENT: retention policy deleted backups before required window
body: We just discovered that our Storage retention policy purged backup snapshots after 7 days, but our compliance requirement is 90 days for financial records tied to logistics shipments. Backups from January and February are now gone and we have an audit next week. This looks like either a bug in how the retention setting was applied or a documentation gap, because we set the policy to 90 days back in December. We need to know if any of this data is recoverable immediately.
answer: I understand the severity here and I'm escalating this to our storage team right now as a P0. We're checking whether the January and February snapshots exist in our extended cold-tier archive that isn't exposed in the standard retention view, since a known display bug caused some accounts to show a shorter window than what was actually configured. I'll update you within the hour with findings and next steps, including recovery options if any snapshots remain.

subject: Kunden erhalten Abmelde-Bestätigung doppelt
body: Seit letzter Woche bekommen mehrere unserer Empfänger die Abmeldebestätigung für unseren Newsletter zweimal, einmal direkt nach dem Klick und dann noch einmal etwa 10 Minuten später. Das sorgt für Verwirrung bei unseren Kunden, die glauben, sie hätten sich nicht richtig abgemeldet. Wir haben das bei mindestens 15 verschiedenen Empfängern seit dem 4. beobachtet.
answer: Danke für die genaue Beschreibung. Das deutet auf ein Problem mit unserem Benachrichtigungsdienst hin, bei dem Abmeldeereignisse teilweise doppelt in die Warteschlange gelangen. Ich leite das an unser Notifications-Team weiter und werde die Zustellungslogs für die letzten Tage prüfen, um die doppelten Sendungen zu bestätigen. Ich melde mich innerhalb von 24 Stunden mit einem Update.

subject: Request to rename workspace and change default timezone
body: We'd like to rename our workspace from the old placeholder name to 'Pioneer Travel Ops' and also update the default timezone setting from UTC to Central European Time since most of our 190 users are based there. Is this something we can do ourselves in the Admin Console, or does it need to be done on your end?
answer: Both of these can be handled directly in the Admin Console under Workspace Settings, though the workspace name change requires admin-level permissions which you have. For the default timezone, go to General Settings > Regional and select Central European Time; this will apply to new users going forward but won't retroactively change individual user preferences already set. Let me know if you run into any permission errors while making these changes.

subject: Duplicate unsubscribe links in email footer template
body: We noticed our email notification templates for Apex Academy have two unsubscribe links in the footer, one from the default Northwind template and one we added ourselves. This is confusing for recipients and we'd like to remove the redundant link so only ours shows. Is there a setting to disable the default Northwind unsubscribe link when a custom one is present in the template?
answer: Good catch, and this is a straightforward fix. Under Notifications > Email Templates, there's a toggle called 'Include platform unsubscribe link' that you can disable once you've confirmed your custom link meets compliance requirements for one-click unsubscribe. I'd recommend testing with a sample send to your own address first to confirm only the custom link appears before rolling it out broadly.

subject: Configuring session timeout policies for different user groups
body: We need to set shorter session timeouts for our contract staff versus full-time employees within our SSO setup, since our legal team requires tighter security for external users. Right now it looks like the timeout setting applies globally to all 146 seats. Is there documentation on configuring group-based session policies, or is this a feature we'd need to request?
answer: Group-based session timeout policies are supported, though they're configured through SSO group mappings rather than the main timeout setting, which does remain global as you noticed. I'm sending you a link to our documentation on conditional session policies by group, which covers how to tag contract staff via your identity provider and apply a separate timeout rule. If after reviewing you still hit limitations for your legal team's requirements, let us know and we can look at a custom configuration.

subject: Late-arriving records causing gaps in daily pipeline sync
body: We're seeing an issue where transaction records that arrive more than 6 hours after their event timestamp are getting dropped from our daily pipeline sync instead of being merged into the correct day's batch. This has happened on at least 8 occasions in the past two weeks, mostly with records from our fintech partner feed that has variable latency. Is there a way to configure a longer late-arrival window or a reprocessing option to catch these?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. Currently our default late-arrival window is fixed at 6 hours, which explains the drops you're seeing with your partner feed's variable latency. This is a common ask so I'm logging it as a feature request for a configurable window, and in the meantime I can share a workaround using a manual backfill job you can schedule to catch records arriving up to 24 hours late. I'll follow up with setup steps for that shortly.

subject: restore old backup
body: Need to restore backup from last week, how?
answer: You can restore a backup from Storage > Backups by selecting the date you need and clicking 'Restore to new location' to avoid overwriting current data. If last week's backup isn't listed due to your current retention/quota settings, let me know the exact date and I'll check whether it's still available on our end.

subject: SCIM provisioning failing - new hires can't log in
body: Since this morning our SCIM sync from our identity provider to Northwind has been failing. We added 6 new users yesterday (Oct 3) and none of them can log in - they get 'account not provisioned' errors. The SCIM job log shows 'Error 409: user already exists' even though these are brand new accounts. This is blocking onboarding for our education team and we have staff starting today who cannot access anything.
answer: I'm sorry for the disruption this is causing during onboarding. A 409 on new users usually points to a stale SCIM cache entry or a duplicate external ID from a previous sync attempt - we're pulling your provisioning logs now to confirm which. In the meantime, please hold off on retrying the sync manually so we don't create further conflicts; we'll update you within the hour with either a fix or a manual provisioning workaround for the affected users.

subject: Question about SCIM group mapping documentation
body: We're setting up SCIM provisioning for our 20-seat account and want to map our identity provider groups to Northwind roles before we go live. I can't find documentation that explains how group attributes translate into MFA enforcement policies on our side. Is there a guide that covers this, or example SCIM payloads showing group-to-role mapping for the Starter plan?
answer: Thanks for checking before rolling this out - that's the right approach. We have a SCIM setup guide that covers group-to-role mapping and includes sample payloads, though the MFA enforcement piece isn't fully documented yet since it's tied to your identity provider's own policy rather than SCIM attributes directly. I'll send over the guide link and a short explanation of how MFA enforcement interacts with provisioned roles so you can plan the rollout.

subject: Need urgent change to retention policy before quota breach
body: Our storage usage has hit 92% of quota and I've traced it to old backup files that are past our intended retention window but not being purged. Our retention policy is set to 90 days but I'm seeing files from 5+ months ago still counting against quota. We need this fixed today or we'll start failing uploads for our media assets, which would affect all 14 seats on our team.
answer: Understood - a retention policy not enforcing the purge window can escalate fast, so I'm treating this as urgent. We're checking whether the retention job is stuck or misconfigured on your account; can you confirm the bucket or folder path where you're seeing the old backups so we can verify against the policy engine directly? We'll also give you a temporary quota buffer while we resolve this so uploads aren't interrupted.

subject: Offline mode requests from our field teams
body: Our field staff use the mobile app while traveling and frequently lose connectivity. Right now the app crashes or gets stuck on the login screen when it can't reach the server, instead of falling back to any cached data. We'd like to request proper offline mode support - at minimum, cached read access to recent records and a graceful retry on login instead of a crash.
answer: Thanks for the detailed feedback - offline resilience for field use is a common ask and I want to make sure it gets logged properly. I'm filing this as a feature request for cached data access and a non-crashing login retry, and I'll attach your account so we can notify you if it lands on a roadmap. In the meantime, I can share a workaround where the app caches the last successful session for a short window to reduce crash frequency.

subject: Requesting credit for overcharged invoice
body: Our invoice dated September 28 charged us for 7 seats at the Starter rate, but we downgraded from 10 seats on September 15 and should have been billed pro-rated. The invoice number is INV-88231 and shows the full 7-seat amount without any credit applied for the mid-cycle change. Could you review this and apply a credit or refund for the difference?
answer: Thanks for flagging the invoice number - that makes this easy to look into. I can see the downgrade on September 15 didn't get reflected in the September 28 billing run, which shouldn't happen, so I'm escalating this to our billing team to recalculate the pro-rated amount and issue a credit to your account. You should see the adjustment reflected within 2-3 business days, and I'll confirm here once it's applied.

subject: Audit log retention and export request
body: We need to review admin actions from the past 60 days for a compliance check, but I can only see the last 30 days of audit log entries in the console. Can we get an export of the full audit history, and separately, can Northwind add support for an IP allowlist so we can restrict admin console access to our office network? We also want to confirm deactivated accounts still show in historical audit records.
answer: Good timing on this - I can pull an extended audit log export covering the full 60-day window and send it over as a CSV within the next day. Deactivated accounts do remain visible in historical audit entries, so that data will be included. The IP allowlist feature isn't currently available for admin console access, but I'm logging it as a request and will let you know if it moves into development.

subject: webhook 429s
body:
Getting repeated 429s on webhook delivery:
HTTP 429 Too Many Requests
retry_after: 30
endpoint: /webhooks/deliver
count: 214 in 10 min
Why?
answer: Thanks for the log snippet - 214 deliveries in 10 minutes is above the default webhook rate ceiling for your tier, which is triggering the 429s and retry_after backoff. We can look at raising your limit or batching deliveries; can you confirm which webhook endpoint is generating this volume so we can check if it's expected traffic or a retry loop on our end?

subject: Planning ahead for API rate limit changes
body: We're evaluating whether our current API usage will hit rate limits as we scale our integrations this quarter. Our webhook consumers occasionally see throttling during month-end batch jobs, and I noticed a deprecation notice mentioned in your changelog about the v1 rate limit headers. Could you clarify the new rate limit structure and whether the SDK will be updated to handle the deprecated headers automatically?
answer: Good question, and glad you're planning ahead of the deprecation. The updated rate limit structure moves from fixed per-minute caps to a rolling token bucket, which should actually reduce throttling during bursty month-end jobs once it's in effect. The SDK update handling the new headers automatically is scheduled for the next minor release; I'll send you the migration notes and the exact date the v1 headers stop being supported so you can plan your batch job timing around it.

subject: Multiple customer cards declining at checkout
body: We're seeing a spike in failed card payments starting yesterday afternoon - at least 11 customers have reported declines on renewal invoices that previously processed fine. Error shown to customers is 'card_declined: do_not_honor' even on cards with sufficient funds. This is affecting our ability to process seat renewals for our Starter plan and customers are getting worried. Can you check if something changed on the payment processor side?
answer: This looks serious given the volume and timing, so I'm escalating it to our payments team right away. A sudden cluster of 'do_not_honor' declines across multiple cards often points to an issue on the processor's end rather than the individual cards, and we'll check for any processor incidents or recent changes to your account's payment routing. I'll update you as soon as we have a root cause, and we'll make sure no renewals are lost or duplicated while this is being investigated.

subject: Zapier integration changes needed for our workflow
body: We're restructuring how our Zapier integration connects to Slack, Salesforce, and Jira, and need to change the trigger event from 'record updated' to 'record created' across our existing Zaps. We have around 40 active Zaps built on the old trigger and want to confirm the best way to migrate them without breaking notifications to our Slack channels or Salesforce sync during the transition.
answer: Migrating 40 active Zaps without downtime is doable if we sequence it carefully. I'd recommend duplicating each Zap with the new 'record created' trigger, testing it in isolation against a non-production Slack channel and Salesforce sandbox if available, then disabling the old trigger Zaps in batches rather than all at once. I'll send over a step-by-step migration checklist and flag anything specific to your Jira-linked Zaps that might need extra attention.

subject: Unsubscribe not working
body: Users still get emails after clicking unsubscribe. Please fix ASAP.
answer: Thanks for flagging this—sorry for the trouble. Could you send one recipient email address and the notification template name so we can trace whether the unsubscribe link is pointing to the correct list? We've seen a duplicate list entry cause this before and want to confirm it's the same root cause here.

subject: Deactivated users still showing as active across workspace
body: We deactivated three former employees this morning through the Admin Console (IDs ending in 4471, 4488, 4502) but all three still appear as active in the member list and can still log in. This is a legal workspace so we need this locked down immediately, since one of them was let go for cause.
answer: This is a priority for us given the access risk—thank you for the account IDs. We're checking the deactivation queue now to see why the status isn't propagating; initial look suggests a delay in the session-revocation job. We'll force a manual revoke on all three accounts within the hour and confirm once their access is fully cut.

subject: Need bulk deactivation option with allowlist exception
body: As we offboard staff we want to deactivate multiple users at once through Admin Console, but we also need certain shared service accounts on an allowlist so they don't get caught in a bulk action by mistake. Right now we only see single-user deactivation and no way to mark accounts as exempt. Could you point us to any documentation on this, or let us know if it's on the roadmap?
answer: Good question—bulk deactivation with an allowlist exception isn't available in the console yet, but it's a common request we're tracking. In the meantime I can share our current step-by-step guide for single-user deactivation and a workaround using tagged accounts to reduce risk of accidental removal. I'll also log this as a feature request on your account.

subject: Deactivation process too slow for large offboarding batch
body: We're processing an offboarding batch of 22 employees this week and deactivating each one individually in the Admin Console takes far too long—each action takes several seconds to confirm and the audit log view lags badly when filtering by date. Given our seat count, we'd like a faster bulk workflow or at least a way to queue multiple deactivations without waiting on the UI each time.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report—performance on bulk-style deactivation is something we're actively improving. For this week's batch, I can provide a CSV-based deactivation script that runs through our API and avoids the UI lag entirely; I'll send setup instructions shortly. I've also flagged the audit log filtering slowdown to engineering for investigation.

subject: help
body: App crashes immediately on launch on iOS after the latest update, tested on three devices. No error shown, just closes to home screen. Started today around 9am, push notifications worked fine yesterday.
answer: Sorry for the disruption—could you tell us the app version and iOS version on the affected devices, and whether the crash happens even with push notifications disabled? We'll pull crash logs from our side in the meantime and get back to you with findings as soon as possible.

subject: PAGINATION BROKEN ON /V2/SHIPMENTS ENDPOINT
body: WE ARE GETTING DUPLICATE RECORDS WHEN PAGING THROUGH /V2/SHIPMENTS USING THE NEXT_CURSOR PARAMETER. SAME SHIPMENT IDS SHOW UP ON PAGE 2 AND PAGE 3, TESTED WITH LIMIT=50 AND LIMIT=100. THE SDK DOCS DON'T MENTION ANY CHANGE TO CURSOR BEHAVIOR. THIS IS AFFECTING OUR NIGHTLY SYNC JOB AND WE NEED A FIX OR WORKAROUND.
answer: Thanks for the report—duplicate records across cursor pages usually points to an unstable sort order on the underlying query. Could you confirm whether you're sorting by created_at or another field, and share one example next_cursor value that produced the repeat? We'll check the endpoint logs on our side and get a fix or workaround to you quickly.

subject: URGENT: Data Pipeline connector losing sync data due to auth failure
body: Our primary billing data connector has been failing authentication since 2:15am today, and the nightly sync that normally moves claims data into our warehouse did not complete. We're seeing 'ERROR: token refresh failed - invalid_grant' in the connector logs, and it looks like several hours of records may not have been captured at all. Given the compliance requirements around this data, we need immediate help confirming whether anything was lost and getting the connector reauthorized.
answer: We're treating this as critical and have escalated to our data pipeline and security teams immediately. We're pulling the connector's OAuth token history now to determine the exact window affected and whether source data is still retrievable for replay once auth is restored. We'll update you within the hour with findings and a reauthorization plan, and will confirm data integrity before closing this out.

subject: Users getting logged out every 15 minutes via SSO

subject: Recurring card failures on monthly invoice

subject: Uploads schlagen wegen Quota-Fehler fehl

subject: SSO-Sitzungen laufen zu schnell ab

subject: Deactivated users still show as active in audit log

subject: Unsubscribe endpoint returns 200 but doesn't update preferences

subject: Mobile app crashes when syncing after offline use
body: Our field agents use the Northwind mobile app in stores with poor signal, and when they go back online after working offline for a while the app crashes almost every time. Can you tell us the app version and a couple of affected device models? In the meantime, having users sync more frequently (every 10-15 minutes) rather than staying offline for long stretches should reduce crash frequency while we investigate.

subject: Konnektor-Authentifizierung schlägt fehl - Pipeline steht komplett

subject: Request: Biometric login fails and app crashes for our whole team

subject: Charts broken across multiple dashboards since this morning

subject: RATE LIMTS ON API - NEED INFO BEFOR DEPRECATION

subject: Freigabeberechtigungen für Dashboards funktionieren nicht korrekt

subject: API rate limit increase and deprecated header question

subject: Change connector auth method for retail POS sync

answer: Good news - you can migrate this connector in place. Go to the connector's Settings tab, choose 'Change authentication method', select OAuth2 Client Credentials, and paste your client ID and secret; the existing sync schedule and mappings will be preserved. We recommend pausing the connector for one cycle during the switch to avoid a partial sync overlap, then re-enabling it once the new credentials validate successfully.

subject: Charts not rendering across shared dashboards after this morning's update

subject: Fehlgeschlagene Kartenzahlung und fehlende Rechnung

subject: Upgrading from Starter to Pro plan

body: We're trying to connect our Northwind account to Zapier so new shipment alerts automatically create tasks in our Jira board. I've added the Northwind trigger app in Zapier but only see billing and user-provisioning triggers available, not the shipment or notification events we need. Is there a way to request additional trigger types or escalate this to your integrations team?
answer: Shipment and notification event triggers for Zapier are still on our roadmap and not yet exposed publicly, thank you for the specific use case, it helps us prioritize. I'm escalating this request to our integrations team with your account details attached, in the meantime we can set up a webhook-based workaround that posts shipment events directly to a Zapier catch hook if that would unblock your Jira automation sooner.

subject: Pagination returns fewer records than requested page_size
body: I'm pulling data from the /reports endpoint and noticed the max page size is 50 even though the docs mention up to 100. When I pass page_size=100 in the query string it silently returns 50 records anyway. Just want to confirm if this is expected behavior or a bug before I finalize my ingestion script.
answer: Good catch, the /reports endpoint currently caps at 50 records per page regardless of the page_size parameter, this is a known limit that hasn't been updated in the documentation yet, we'll correct that. For now please use the cursor-based next_page token to iterate through results rather than relying on a larger page_size value.

subject: MFA enrollment down
body: No one can enroll in MFA, all 13 users locked out. Urgent!
answer: We're treating this as a full outage and have engineers actively investigating right now. We'll post updates here as soon as we have a fix or workaround, and will notify you immediately once enrollment is restored for your workspace.

subject: Duplicate email digests going out to all recipients
body: We're integrating the Notifications API for our weekly summary digests and since the run on March 3rd, every subscriber on our energy dashboard list is getting the same digest email 3 times within a 10 minute window. Our webhook logs show only one POST to /v2/notifications/digests per user, so the duplication seems to be happening on your side. This is going out to roughly 190 seats and we're getting complaints already.
answer: Thanks for flagging this quickly, and sorry for the noise your users are seeing. We've reproduced duplicate sends on the digest dispatcher for accounts using scheduled batching and are escalating this to our notifications engineering team right now as a P1. We'll pause outbound digest batches for your account while we patch the dedup logic, and will update you within the hour with a fix ETA.

subject: SSO role mapping not assigning correct groups after login
body: After configuring our SAML role mapping last week, users authenticating through our identity provider are landing in the default viewer role instead of the admin or editor groups defined in our attribute mapping. We checked the SAML assertion and the groups attribute is populated correctly with values like 'legal-admins' and 'legal-editors', but Northwind Identity isn't applying the corresponding role. This is affecting new logins across our 282 seats since yesterday.
answer: Thank you for the detailed assertion info, that helps a lot. It sounds like the mapping rule may be matching on a case-sensitive string, so 'legal-admins' vs 'Legal-Admins' would fall through to default. Can you send us a screenshot of your current mapping rules from the SSO config page so we can confirm and correct the matching logic on our end?

subject: Mobile app crashes when syncing after offline mode
body: I'm testing the mobile app in airplane mode to validate our logistics field workflows, and when I reconnect and the app tries to sync cached scan data, it crashes consistently on both iOS and Android. This happens after roughly 40-50 offline entries have queued up. Our field teams rely on offline mode daily across our 1194 seats, so this is becoming a real blocker for warehouse staff who lose connectivity in loading docks.
answer: Thanks for the clear repro steps, that's very helpful for our mobile team. We suspect the crash is tied to a buffer overflow in the local sync queue when it exceeds a certain entry count, and we're pulling crash logs from your account now to confirm. In the meantime, could you have affected users sync more frequently (every 20-25 entries) as a workaround while we work on a permanent fix?

subject: Slack alert integration stopped posting to retail channels
body: Our Slack integration for retail inventory alerts has stopped posting to the #retail-alerts channel since Tuesday morning. We have this connected through our Integrations hub alongside Okta and Salesforce triggers, and the Jira ticket creation piece still works fine, so it seems isolated to the Slack webhook step. We rely on these alerts for real-time stock threshold notifications across 1629 seats, and the silence is causing missed reorders.
answer: We're sorry for the disruption to your alerting workflow. We can see the Slack webhook for your integration returned repeated 403 errors starting Tuesday, which usually indicates the Slack app token was revoked or the workspace permissions changed on Slack's side. We're escalating this to our integrations team to help re-authenticate the connection and will follow up with steps to reconnect it within the next couple of hours.

subject: Need updated webhook documentation before rate limit changes
body: I manage finance operations here and we just noticed a notice in the developer portal about upcoming rate limit changes to the webhooks endpoint, but the linked documentation still references the old payload format and doesn't mention the new deprecation date. We only have a small team building this integration and need clear guidance on what's changing so our billing reconciliation webhooks don't break next month.
answer: Thank you for catching this gap in our docs, and apologies for the confusion it caused. The webhook deprecation is scheduled for the 15th of next month, moving from the v1 payload to v2 with a new signature header; we're updating the documentation page today and will send you the direct link along with a migration checklist so your reconciliation flow keeps running smoothly.

subject: Urgent: need to deactivate former employee's workspace access
body: We had a developer leave our team yesterday and I need to deactivate their admin console access immediately along with removing them from our IP allowlist entries they had configured. I checked the admin console under workspace settings but the deactivation option seems grayed out for accounts with active API keys. We need this resolved today for compliance reasons since they had access to our audit logs.
answer: This is understood as urgent and we're prioritizing it right now. The deactivation option is disabled while API keys are active because revoking access requires the keys to be rotated first; we can do this for you immediately if you confirm the account's username, or walk you through revoking the keys yourself in under two minutes so the deactivation completes today.

subject: How to add multiple IP ranges to allowlist
body: I'd like to understand how the IP allowlist feature works in the admin console before we roll it out to our travel booking team. We have three office locations plus a couple of remote contractors on separate networks, and I want to know if we can add multiple CIDR ranges or if it's limited to single IP entries. Also curious if there's an audit trail showing when allowlist changes are made.
answer: Good question, and happy to walk you through it. The IP allowlist in the admin console does support CIDR notation, so you can add each office range as well as individual IPs for your remote contractors in the same list. All additions and removals are logged in the audit log with timestamp and the admin who made the change, which you can export from the security settings tab.

subject: Freigabeeinstellungen im Dashboard funktionieren nicht korrekt
body: Als Workspace-Admin habe ich versucht, ein Dashboard mit einem externen Berater zu teilen, aber die Freigabe zeigt weiterhin 'nur interne Nutzer' an, obwohl ich die Option auf 'extern' umgestellt habe. Das betrifft ein Chart-heavy Dashboard, das wir für einen Gesundheitsbericht exportieren wollten. Die Einstellung wird beim Speichern offenbar nicht übernommen.
answer: Vielen Dank für die genaue Beschreibung. Das klingt nach einem Anzeigefehler in den Freigabeeinstellungen, bei dem die Änderung zwar gespeichert, aber nicht korrekt im UI reflektiert wird. Bitte laden Sie die Dashboard-Seite einmal neu und prüfen Sie, ob die externe Freigabe dann aktiv ist; falls nicht, senden Sie uns bitte die Dashboard-ID, damit wir das gezielt nachvollziehen können.

subject: Biometric login fails intermittently on mobile app
body: I've been using Face ID to log into the mobile app on my phone for the past few weeks and starting this Monday it fails about half the time, falling back to password entry. There's no crash, just a generic 'authentication failed, try again' message. I checked with a colleague on our legal team and she's seeing the same intermittent issue on Android with fingerprint login.
answer: Thanks for reporting this, and sorry for the inconvenience. We've seen a similar report tied to a recent biometric session token refresh change, which can cause the fallback message you're describing. We're logging this for our mobile team to investigate further, and in the meantime re-enabling biometric login from the app's security settings screen should temporarily reduce the failure rate.

subject: Dashboards loading slowly for large chart sets
body: I'm building an integration that pulls dashboard data via the API, and I've noticed our main analytics dashboard with about 15 charts is taking 12-15 seconds to fully render, compared to under 3 seconds a couple of weeks ago. Nothing changed on our side that I can identify, and sharing this dashboard with other education admins on our team shows the same slowdown.
answer: Thanks for the details on load times, that's a helpful comparison. We've noticed increased query latency on dashboards with a high number of charts pulling from shared data sources, and we're looking into optimizing chart-level caching now. As a quick improvement, try splitting your 15-chart dashboard into two smaller ones, which should noticeably reduce render time while we work on the underlying performance fix.

subject: Dashboard sharing permissions not saving correctly
body: I'm setting up a shared dashboard for our travel booking metrics and every time I add a viewer-only permission for a colleague, it reverts to editor access after a few minutes. This is happening on the Q3 Bookings Overview dashboard with chart exports enabled. I've tried removing and re-adding the user twice with the same result. Also noticed the chart rendering feels slower than usual when multiple viewers are on it at once, around 8-10 seconds to load.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. This looks like a permission caching bug we've seen with dashboards that have export enabled alongside custom sharing rules. Could you confirm the exact dashboard ID and the role you're assigning so I can reproduce it on our end? In the meantime, try disabling export on that dashboard temporarily as a workaround while we investigate the permission reset issue.

subject: Mobile app crashes immediately on launch for most users
body: Since yesterday afternoon our field team has been unable to open the Northwind mobile app on Android devices. It crashes within a second of the splash screen, before login even loads. We've had reports from at least 40 users across our manufacturing floor teams so far. Push notifications also seem to have stopped coming through on the few devices where the app still opens.
answer: This is a serious issue and we're escalating it immediately as P1. Can you tell us which Android OS versions and app build number are affected, and whether this started after a recent app store update? We're checking crash logs on our side now and will follow up within the hour with either a fix or a workaround.

subject: Cannot deactivate former employee accounts in Admin Console
body: I'm trying to deactivate three accounts for employees who left our logistics team last week, but the deactivation button in the Admin Console just spins and eventually shows a generic error. This is a compliance concern since these accounts still have access to shipment data. I also can't find where to set up an IP allowlist for our office network, which we need configured before our next audit.
answer: Thank you for flagging this, we understand the urgency given the compliance angle. We're looking into the deactivation error right now and will prioritize a fix given active accounts are involved. For the IP allowlist, that setting lives under Admin Console > Security > Network Access, but since you're hitting an error there too, we'll walk you through it directly once the deactivation issue is resolved.

subject: Question about webhook retry behavior and rate limits
body: We're building out webhook handling for patient intake events and noticed that during a burst of about 200 events in one minute, several webhooks seem to have been dropped rather than retried. I don't see documentation on what the retry policy is or how it interacts with rate limits. Could you clarify the expected behavior, and is there an SDK method to check delivery status after the fact?
answer: Good question, and thanks for the specifics. Our webhook system retries failed deliveries up to 5 times with exponential backoff, but if you're hitting our rate limit of 100 requests per minute on the receiving endpoint side, some events may be queued rather than dropped. We'll send over the retry policy documentation and an SDK snippet for checking delivery status via the events endpoint.

subject: Feature request: Okta app for SSO provisioning
body: We're integrating Northwind into our identity stack and currently only see generic SAML setup instructions, not a dedicated Okta app in the catalog. We'd like automated user provisioning and deprovisioning through Okta rather than manual SAML configuration. We also use Slack and Jira heavily, so if there's any roadmap for native integrations there it would help our evaluation.
answer: Thanks for the feedback, this is a common request and I'll log it for our integrations team. We don't have a published Okta app yet, but our current SAML setup does support SCIM provisioning if configured correctly, so I can send you that guide as an interim solution. I'll also note your interest in Slack and Jira integrations for our roadmap discussions.

subject: Users receiving duplicate email alerts for every notification
body: Starting this morning, every notification we send through the platform is being delivered twice to recipients, sometimes with a delay of a few minutes between copies. We've confirmed this across at least 15 test sends to different email addresses. This is causing confusion among our retail store managers who think there's a system error on their end. We haven't changed any notification templates or settings recently.
answer: We're sorry for the disruption and are treating this as high priority. We've had similar reports this morning and suspect an issue with our notification delivery service retrying successful sends. We're pushing a fix now and will confirm once duplicate deliveries stop; in the meantime, please hold off on resending any notifications manually to avoid tripling the volume.

subject: Frage zu Gutschriften und Rückerstattung nach Sitzplatzänderung
body: Wir haben letzten Monat von 22 auf 18 Sitzplätze reduziert, aber auf der aktuellen Rechnung sehe ich keine Gutschrift für die nicht genutzten Plätze. Können Sie mir erklären, wie die Rückerstattung bei einer Plananpassung im Starter-Tarif berechnet wird? Es geht um einen kleinen Betrag, aber ich möchte das für unsere Buchhaltung nachvollziehen können.
answer: Vielen Dank für Ihre Anfrage. Bei einer Reduzierung der Sitzplätze im Starter-Tarif wird die Gutschrift anteilig für den verbleibenden Abrechnungszeitraum berechnet und automatisch mit der nächsten Rechnung verrechnet, erscheint also nicht sofort als separater Posten. Ich prüfe gerne Ihr Konto im Detail und sende Ihnen eine Aufschlüsselung der Berechnung.

subject: Request for offline login support after app crashes
body: Our field engineers frequently work in areas with no signal, and the mobile app currently crashes on launch if it can't reach the login server first. This has become a real problem during site visits. Could you add support for cached credentials so the app opens in a read-only offline mode instead of crashing? Push notifications queued during offline periods also don't seem to sync once we're back online.
answer: Thanks for laying this out clearly, it's a reasonable ask and one we've heard from other field-based teams. Offline login isn't currently supported, but I'll file this as a feature request with our mobile team along with the push notification sync issue you mentioned. In the meantime, a workaround is to keep the app open in the background before losing signal so the session token stays cached longer.

subject: sdk erros
body: hey we are getting weird errors from teh python sdk after updating to latest version, someting about a deprecated endpoint but the docs still show the old one as current. our engineers are confuse which version to use and its slowing down a client project. can someone clarfy whats actually deprecated and wheres the updated docs, also do we need to worry about rate limit changes in this version
answer: Thanks for flagging this, and sorry for the confusion between the SDK and docs. The /v1/legacy-auth endpoint was deprecated last month in favor of /v2/auth, but you're right that our docs site hadn't been fully updated, we're correcting that now. Rate limits haven't changed in this SDK version, only the auth flow, so once your team switches to the v2 endpoint the deprecation warnings should clear up.

subject: App keeps crashing, need this fixed for our rollout
body:
We've been planning our mobile rollout to teachers across our district for next month and have been testing the app on various devices to make sure everything works smoothly before we go live. During this testing phase we ran into a blocker that's stopping us from moving forward with the pilot group.

The app crashes on launch for anyone using an older Android device, right after the login screen appears. Here's the log from one of our test devices:

FATAL EXCEPTION: main
Process: com.northwind.mobile, PID: 4521
java.lang.NullPointerException: Attempt to invoke virtual method on a null object reference
	at com.northwind.mobile.auth.LoginActivity.onCreate(LoginActivity.java:142)
	at android.app.Activity.performCreate(Activity.java:8000)

Can you tell us if this is a known issue and whether there's a fix coming, since we need this resolved before our rollout starts?
answer: Thank you for including the crash log, that's very helpful. This looks like a known null reference issue affecting certain Android versions during the login initialization step, and our mobile team is currently working on a patch. Given your rollout timeline, I'll flag this for priority review and follow up with an estimated fix date, and in the meantime I'd recommend testing on the affected devices with the latest OS update applied, as that resolves it for some users.

subject: Late-arriving data breaking downstream aggregates
body:
We're seeing consistent delays in our Northwind Data Pipelines sync from our Snowflake connector. Records with event timestamps from Nov 3-4 are still trickling in as of this morning (Nov 6), which is throwing off our daily aggregation jobs that run at 2am UTC. Connector ID is pl-conn-8827. Latency seems to have crept up over the last week, from typical 15-20 min to now 6+ hours in some batches.

Can someone check if there's a backlog on the connector or an upstream throttling issue? We need to know if this is transient or if we should adjust our job schedules to account for a new baseline latency.
answer:
Thanks for the detailed report and the connector ID. We're pulling logs for pl-conn-8827 now to check for queue backlog or throttling on the Snowflake side. Initial look suggests there was elevated load on that connector pool starting around Nov 4, which lines up with the latency increase you're seeing.

We'll confirm root cause and expected resolution time within a few hours, and let you know whether this is a temporary backlog that will clear or something requiring a schedule adjustment on your end in the meantime.

subject: Guidance needed on upcoming API deprecations
body:
We received a note about deprecations affecting v2 of the API Platform but I want to get ahead of this for our engineering roadmap. Which endpoints are being sunset, and is there a firm date? We're currently on SDK version 3.4.1 and use the /v2/orders and /v2/inventory endpoints heavily.

Also wondering if there's a migration guide or timeline for rate limit changes tied to the new version, since we'll need to plan sprint work around this. Appreciate any documentation links you can point us to.
answer:
Good timing on reaching out. The v2 /orders and /inventory endpoints are scheduled for deprecation with a sunset date six months out; v3 equivalents are already live and stable. SDK 4.x supports both in parallel during the transition window, so you can migrate incrementally rather than all at once.

I'll send over our migration guide, which also covers the updated rate limit tiers under v3. Happy to set up a call with our API team if you want to walk through the endpoint mapping for your specific use case.

subject: help
body:
Managing API keys for our reporting team and running into an issue. We rotated our primary key last week (ending in 7f2a) and now our webhook subscriptions tied to the old key aren't firing anymore, even though the new key has the same scopes. We have around 40 webhooks configured for grade change notifications across our SIS integration.

Is there a way to re-associate existing webhooks with a new key without recreating all of them manually? Also noticed rate limit headers are missing from responses using the new key, which is different from before.
answer:
Thanks for flagging this. Webhook subscriptions are tied to the key that created them, so rotating the primary key does require re-registration, but we can bulk-migrate them on our end rather than you recreating all 40 manually. Please confirm the workspace ID and we'll run the migration script.

On the missing rate limit headers, that does sound like a bug tied to the new key's configuration. We're checking whether this is scoped to your account or a broader regression and will follow up shortly.

subject: Shared dashboard permissions not respecting group restrictions
body:
One of our practice groups reported that a dashboard I shared with 'view only' access to their team is letting some members edit and delete widgets. I set this up using the sharing panel on the Litigation Metrics dashboard (ID dash-4471) and restricted it to a specific user group, but two people outside that group can also see it in their sidebar.

This is a permissions issue that could expose sensitive case data to the wrong people, so I'd like this looked into fairly quickly. Can you confirm whether group-based sharing is currently working as expected?
answer:
Thank you for reporting this, and I understand the urgency given the sensitivity of the data involved. We're looking into dash-4471 now to check the group membership sync and permission inheritance for that share link. There have been some reports of stale group caching causing similar over-broad access, so we're checking if that's the case here.

In the meantime, I'd recommend temporarily disabling the share link for that dashboard until we confirm the scope of the issue. We'll update you within the day with findings and a fix timeline.

subject: unsubscribe link

answer:

The duplicate sends after unsubscribe usually happen when the unsubscribe token isn't being passed back correctly to /v1/notifications/subscriptions/{id}/unsubscribe, or when there's a cached subscription list being re-triggered downstream. subject: Incorrect seat count on latest invoice

Our October invoice shows billing for 1,720 seats, but our actual active user count in the admin console is 1,629. We haven't added new seats since our last true-up in August, and this discrepancy is going to cause problems getting the invoice approved internally. Invoice number is INV-88213-NF.

We'll have a corrected invoice or a clear explanation back to you well before Friday. If it turns out to be an overcharge, we'll process the adjustment immediately rather than waiting for the next billing cycle.

subject: Okta app integration failing SSO handoff
body:
We set up the Northwind Okta app last week for our operations team and initial login worked fine, but starting yesterday users are getting bounced back to the Okta dashboard with a generic 'sign-in error' instead of landing in Northwind. answer:

Could you send us a screenshot of the Okta system log entry for one of the failed sign-in attempts? That will help us pinpoint whether it's an assertion mismatch or a session handling issue.

subject: Deprecation warnings flooding our webhook logs
body:
We're getting repeated deprecation warnings in our webhook delivery logs and want to understand the timeline before it breaks anything. Pasting a snippet below:

```
2024-06-11T09:12:03Z WARN [webhook-dispatcher] endpoint /v2/bookings/status is deprecated, use /v3/bookings/status
2024-06-11T09:12:04Z WARN [webhook-dispatcher] field 'legacy_id' will be removed in next major version
2024-06-11T09:14:17Z WARN [webhook-dispatcher] rate limit header X-RateLimit-Remaining deprecated, use X-RateLimit-Remaining-V2
2024-06-11T09:15:02Z ERROR [webhook-dispatcher] payload validation failed for /v2/bookings/status: unknown field 'legacy_id'
```

The ERROR line is new as of this morning and is causing some webhook deliveries to fail outright. Can you clarify the migration path and whether documentation covers the 'legacy_id' field removal?
answer:
Thanks for pasting the log — the ERROR line confirms that /v2/bookings/status has started enforcing stricter payload validation ahead of the full v2 sunset, which is why legacy_id is now being rejected instead of just warned about. You'll want to migrate to /v3/bookings/status and drop legacy_id from your payloads to stop the failures immediately.

We're also updating the docs to call out this validation change more clearly since it clearly caught you off guard. I'll link the updated webhook migration guide and the new rate limit header reference in a follow-up shortly.

subject: question
body:
I was reviewing our workspace settings in the Admin Console and noticed the audit log doesn't seem to capture changes made to the IP allowlist. I updated our allowlist last Tuesday to add a new office range, but there's no corresponding entry in the audit log for that action, only for user deactivations and role changes.

Is this expected behavior or a gap in logging? We rely on the audit log for our internal compliance reviews, so if allowlist changes aren't tracked, that's something we'd need documented or fixed.
answer:
Thanks for pointing this out. Currently, IP allowlist changes are indeed not captured in the audit log by default — only user and role-related events are logged in this version of the console, which is a gap we're aware of and have logged as a feature request with our product team.

In the meantime, I'd recommend keeping a manual change record for allowlist updates for your compliance purposes. We'll follow up if allowlist audit logging gets added to the roadmap with a target date.

subject: Rolling out mandatory MFA enrollment across all users
body:
We're planning to enforce MFA for all 3,460 employees under our Identity and SSO setup and want to make sure we do this without locking anyone out. Currently MFA is optional and only about 40% of users have enrolled. We'd like to set a grace period where unenrolled users are prompted at login but not blocked, before making it mandatory in three weeks.

Can you confirm the correct provisioning flow for a staged rollout like this, and whether there's documentation on configuring the enrollment grace period and enforcement policy in the admin console?
answer:
This is a solid approach for a rollout at your scale. The staged enforcement policy can be configured under Identity and SSO settings by setting an enrollment grace period with a defined end date — users will see a mandatory prompt at login during that window but won't be blocked until the policy switches to full enforcement.

I'll send over our documentation covering the provisioning flow and policy configuration steps, including how to bulk-notify unenrolled users ahead of the deadline. Let us know if you'd like us to review your specific policy settings before you activate the grace period.

subject: Push notifications failing for offline field staff
body: I'm reviewing our renewal numbers for Blue Health and our clinical staff have flagged that push notifications aren't reaching devices that go offline during shifts, mostly in rural facility buildings. Several users report the app crashing on reopen after a missed notification, and this has come up in three support tickets from our nursing coordinators since Monday. subject: All API requests returning 429 - production down

subject: Offline mode crashes app on relogin

subject: Late-arriving records causing pipeline gaps
body: We're ingesting transaction data through the Ember Energy pipeline connector, and over the past week we've noticed records arriving 4-6 hours after their event timestamp, which causes gaps in our downstream fintech reconciliation reports. Our pipeline is set to a 1-hour window for late data, so anything beyond that gets dropped rather than reprocessed. Is there a documented way to configure a longer late-arrival window or trigger reprocessing without a full backfill?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report - late-arriving data beyond the configured window is a known limitation we're addressing. In the meantime, you can extend the late-arrival window up to 24 hours in the pipeline settings under Advanced > Windowing, which should capture most of the delayed records you're seeing. I'll also send over our documentation on triggering targeted backfills for the records already dropped this past week.

subject: Seat count discrepancy on latest invoice
body: Our latest invoice for Blue Labs shows billing for 1,258 seats, but our internal HR system shows we only have 1,190 active employees provisioned in Northwind as of this month. I'd like to understand how seat counts are calculated - whether deactivated accounts still count toward the total - and whether we can get documentation on the reconciliation process before our finance review next week.
answer: Happy to help clarify this before your review. Seat counts are based on all accounts with an active status at billing cycle close, including any pending deactivations that haven't fully processed yet - this can create a temporary gap versus your HR records. I'll pull your account's seat activity log for the last billing period and send it over along with our seat reconciliation guide so you can cross-check the numbers directly.

subject: MFA enrolment prompt not appearing for new users
body: We're rolling out SSO for Vertex Freight and noticed that a handful of newly provisioned users aren't being prompted to enroll in MFA on first login - they can access the dashboard without ever setting up a second factor. This has happened with three accounts created this week through our SCIM provisioning. Not urgent since our SSO IdP still requires its own MFA, but wanted to flag it as it seems like a gap on the Northwind side.
answer: Thanks for the heads up - this looks like an edge case where SCIM-provisioned users can bypass the MFA enrolment step if their first login happens through an SSO session rather than direct login. We're logging this as a bug for our identity team to review. In the meantime, you can manually enforce MFA enrolment for those three accounts from the Admin Console under Security > MFA Policy.

subject: Urgent: need IP allowlist updated before deployment window
body: We're changing our office egress IPs for Cobalt Energy this weekend and need the Admin Console IP allowlist updated before Saturday's maintenance window, or our support team will be locked out of the console entirely come Monday. Current allowlist has our old data center range; we need to add 203.0.113.0/24 and remove the deprecated 198.51.100.0/24 range. Also want to confirm this change gets captured in the audit log for our compliance review.
answer: We've prioritized this given your Saturday deadline. I've submitted the allowlist change to add 203.0.113.0/24 and remove 198.51.100.0/24, which will be live within a few hours and confirmed back to you once processed. This change, along with the timestamp and requesting admin, will be recorded in the audit log automatically for your compliance records.

subject: How to link Jira tickets to Northwind integration alerts
body: We're setting up integrations for Delta Health and already have Slack and Salesforce connected through Okta SSO. I'd like to also link our Jira instance so that integration failure alerts automatically create Jira tickets in our legal ops project, rather than us manually copying error details over. Is there a native connector for this, or would we need to build something through the API?
answer: Good news - there's a native Jira connector under Integrations > Add Connector that can create tickets automatically from alert events, and it works alongside your existing Okta and Salesforce setups. I'll send you our step-by-step guide for mapping alert types to specific Jira projects and fields so you can get it configured for your legal ops project.

subject: Webhook deliveries delayed and duplicated
body: I'm seeing webhook events for order updates arriving 10-15 minutes late over the past two days, and some events are being delivered twice with identical event IDs, which is throwing off our logistics reconciliation reports. We're subscribed to the order.updated and shipment.created events. Is there a known issue with the webhook delivery queue, or should we be implementing idempotency checks on our end regardless?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report - we're seeing some intermittent delays in the webhook delivery queue that our platform team is actively working through, which likely explains the 10-15 minute lag you're experiencing. The duplicate deliveries with identical event IDs are expected behavior under retry conditions, so we'd recommend implementing idempotency checks keyed on event ID as a best practice regardless of the current delay issue.

subject: app crash
body: Been fixing invoices all morning and now the app crashes every time on launch, nobody can log in.
answer: Sorry for the disruption - since this is blocking all logins we're treating it as high priority. Could you confirm the device type and app version, and whether this started after a recent update? We'll get a fix or workaround to you as quickly as possible.

subject: Mobile app crashes immediately on launch after v4.2.1 update
body:
We integrated the Northwind mobile SDK into our Vertex Travel app and pushed build 4.2.1 to the App Store yesterday. Since then, roughly 60% of our users on iOS 17 report the app crashing within a second of opening, before the splash screen even finishes. The crash log points to a null pointer in the offline cache initializer (NWOfflineStore.swift line 212). Android builds seem unaffected so far.

We have 241 seats depending on this app for field bookings and this is blocking agents from checking itineraries. Can someone confirm if this is related to a known regression in the offline caching feature?
answer:
Thanks for the detailed report and the crash log pointer. We've seen one other report matching this signature tied to a regression in the offline cache initializer shipped in SDK 4.2.1, and we're treating this as a P1 while we confirm scope. Can you send us the full crash log export and the exact SDK version string from your build config so we can validate against the fix candidate we're testing?

In the meantime, we recommend rolling back to SDK 4.1.9 for new builds to stop the crashes for your users while we finalize the patch. We'll follow up within a few hours with a build we'd like you to test.

subject: Scheduled syncs failing across all connectors since 03:10 UTC
body:
All of our scheduled data pipeline syncs for Willow Freight have failed since 03:10 UTC this morning. We have 14 connectors (Plaid, Stripe, and 12 internal SFTP feeds) and every single one is showing status 'failed: connection reset' in the pipeline dashboard. This is a fintech environment so any gap in reconciliation data is a compliance issue for us.

We suspect this may be a breach in expected data freshness SLAs since our downstream ledger jobs depend on hourly syncs and we're now 6 hours behind. Please escalate immediately - we need to know if data was lost or just delayed.
answer:
We understand the severity given your compliance requirements and have escalated this to P0 immediately. Our engineering team has identified a connector gateway outage that began at 03:07 UTC affecting all sync types; no data has been lost, syncs are queued and will replay in order once the gateway is restored. We expect resolution within the next 30-45 minutes and will push a status update as soon as syncs resume.

We will also run a manual verification pass on your 14 connectors once syncs complete to confirm no records were dropped, and will send you a data quality report for the affected window.

subject: Requesting storage quota increase and clarity on retention policy
body:
I'm a data analyst at Apex Capital and we're hitting our storage quota on the Starter plan - currently at 94% with backups for our travel booking datasets. I tried uploading a new dataset batch (about 3.2GB) yesterday and got a 'quota exceeded' error on upload.

Could you let us know what options we have to increase the quota, and also clarify how long backups are retained before they're purged? We want to make sure we're not losing older backup snapshots we might still need for audits.
answer:
Thanks for flagging this - on the Starter plan storage quotas are fixed, but we can walk you through options including a temporary quota bump or upgrading to Pro which includes significantly higher storage limits and configurable retention windows. For your current plan, backup snapshots are retained for 30 days by default before automatic purge.

To unblock your upload today, we can grant a one-time 10GB quota extension while you evaluate plan options - just confirm and we'll apply it within the hour.

subject: Frage zu API-Keys und anstehenden Deprecations
body:
Wir nutzen die Northwind API Platform für unsere interne Reporting-Anwendung bei Apex Travel. In der Dokumentation habe ich gesehen, dass der alte API-Key-Header 'X-Api-Key' als deprecated markiert ist, aber unser aktuelles SDK (Version 2.3) verwendet ihn noch. Wird das SDK automatisch aktualisiert oder müssen wir manuell auf den neuen Bearer-Token-Header umstellen?

Außerdem wäre hilfreich zu wissen, ob es dafür eine Übergangsfrist gibt, bevor der alte Header komplett abgeschaltet wird, da wir nur 8 Lizenzen haben und die Migration mit begrenzten Ressourcen planen müssen.
answer:
Danke für die Frage. Der 'X-Api-Key' Header wird nicht automatisch durch ein SDK-Update ersetzt - Sie müssen manuell auf den neuen Bearer-Token-Header umstellen, idealerweise mit SDK Version 3.x, das bereits beide Formate unterstützt. Die Übergangsfrist läuft noch bis Ende des Quartals, danach wird der alte Header endgültig deaktiviert.

Wir empfehlen, die Migration frühzeitig zu planen, auch bei einem kleineren Team - die Umstellung selbst betrifft meist nur wenige Zeilen Code. Die aktualisierte Dokumentation mit Beispielen für den Bearer-Token finden Sie im Abschnitt 'Authentication' im Developer Portal.

subject: Slack alerts stopped firing for pipeline failures
body:
Since Monday our Slack integration for Lumen Capital has stopped sending alerts when data pipeline jobs fail. We rely on this to notify our on-call rotation - the integration channel shows 'connected' status in the Integrations panel, but we haven't received a single notification in 3 days despite two known pipeline failures during that window.

We also have a Jira integration configured for the same events and that one is still working fine, so it seems isolated to Slack. Can you check if something changed on your end with the Slack webhook delivery?
answer:
Thanks for the report - since Jira alerts are still coming through, this does point to something specific to the Slack webhook delivery path. We're seeing a pattern of Slack token expiration issues affecting integrations that were set up before a recent OAuth scope update; can you check under Integrations > Slack > Connection whether it shows a reauthorization prompt?
