If you don't see that prompt, please send us the integration ID and we'll inspect the webhook delivery logs on our side to see why events aren't reaching Slack. We'll keep this at P2 and update you within a business day.

subject: SCIM provisioning delays affecting new user onboarding
body:
We're seeing significant delays in SCIM provisioning for Harbor Analytics - new users created in our Okta directory are taking anywhere from 20 minutes to 2 hours to appear in Northwind, when previously this was near-instant. We manage 3651 seats and this is causing real friction for our IT helpdesk during term start as students and staff can't log in with MFA until provisioning completes.

We checked our Okta SCIM logs and don't see errors on our side - pushes show status 200. Is this a known performance issue on the Northwind SCIM endpoint?
answer:
Thank you for the detailed report, especially the Okta-side confirmation of successful 200 responses - that helps narrow this down to our provisioning queue rather than the connection itself. We've identified increased processing latency in the SCIM ingestion service affecting several Enterprise tenants with high provisioning volume, and engineering is actively working on scaling the queue workers.

Given the scale of your term-start onboarding, we're prioritizing your tenant for a manual queue flush now, which should clear the current backlog within the hour. We'll monitor closely and follow up once provisioning times return to normal.

subject: URGENT: deprecated webhook format breaking our billing reconciliation
body:
Our finance team at Blue Capital relies on the API Platform webhooks to reconcile payment events, and today all incoming webhooks started arriving in a completely different JSON structure - fields like 'transaction_id' are now nested under 'data.attributes' instead of top level. Our parsing script is failing with KeyError on every event since around 9am.

I checked the changelog and found a deprecation notice for the old webhook payload format, but we never received direct notice that the cutover date was today. This is actively breaking our reconciliation process and we need either a rollback or urgent guidance on the new schema.
answer:
We're very sorry for the disruption and understand the urgency given this is affecting live reconciliation. The webhook payload migration was scheduled to complete today per the deprecation notice sent 60 days ago, but we recognize the transition caused an immediate break for you - we're escalating this to P1 and can temporarily re-enable the legacy payload format for your account while your team updates the parser.

We'll apply that override within the next 30 minutes and send you the updated schema documentation with a mapping guide from old to new field names so your team can migrate on your own timeline.

subject: Plan upgrade charged but seats not increased
body:
I upgraded Ember Robotics from our previous tier to Pro plan on the 14th and the payment went through successfully - I can see the charge on our card statement - but our seat count in the admin panel still shows the old limit of 100 instead of the 127 we should now have available. We have new hires waiting to be added and can't invite them past the old cap.

Could someone check the billing record on our account and manually sync the seat allocation? Account ID is on file under Ember Robotics.
answer:
Thanks for letting us know, and apologies for the mismatch between your payment confirmation and the seat allocation shown in the admin panel. This usually happens when the plan upgrade webhook doesn't complete the sync step - we can see the successful charge on our end and will manually apply the correct seat count of 127 to your account now.

This should reflect within the next 15 minutes; please refresh the admin panel and let us know if the new hires can be added successfully once it updates.

subject: SCIM sync broke SSO login for several users after permission change
body:
As the workspace admin for Ember Partners, I updated a group mapping in our SCIM provisioning config yesterday to adjust permissions for our finance team. Since then, 4 of our 11 users can no longer log in via SSO - they get 'access denied, contact your administrator' when authenticating through our identity provider, even though MFA passes fine.

I tried reverting the group mapping change but the affected users are still locked out. This is blocking their work and I'm not sure if this needs to be escalated further on your end.
answer:
Thanks for the clear timeline - this does sound like the group mapping change may have left stale permission entries even after reverting, which is causing the access denial despite successful MFA. We're escalating this to our identity team now as a P2 given the active login blocks.

Could you send us the usernames or user IDs of the 4 affected accounts so we can inspect their current permission state directly? In the meantime, we'll check whether a forced re-sync of the SCIM group mappings clears the stale entries without requiring a full reprovisioning.

subject: IP allowlist change locked out entire admin team
body:
We updated the IP allowlist in the Admin Console for Cobalt Media this morning to add our new office range, and immediately after saving, every admin including myself got logged out and now can't log back in - we get 'access restricted from this network' even though I can confirm our IP matches what we entered. All 267 seats are unaffected for regular login, this is specifically hitting admin console access.

We checked the audit log and can see the change was saved correctly at 10:42 AM, but something about how the range was applied seems to have deactivated access for everyone, including from IPs that should be permitted. We need this reversed urgently since we have no admin access to fix it ourselves.
answer:
This is being escalated immediately as P1 given your admin team has no console access to self-correct. We can see the allowlist change in the audit log you referenced and will apply an emergency override from our side to revert the IP allowlist to its previous state, restoring admin access without requiring you to be on an approved network.

We're processing this now and will confirm here as soon as access is restored, likely within 15 minutes - please do not make further allowlist changes until we confirm the rollback is complete.

subject: Audit log entries missing after deactivation events
body:
We rely on the Admin Console audit log to track user lifecycle changes for our travel operations team across 114 seats. Since September 3rd, deactivation events for users are not appearing in the audit log at all, even though the deactivation itself completes successfully in the Users tab. We've confirmed this for at least 12 accounts deactivated this week.

This is a compliance issue for us since our internal audits require a full trail of access changes. Can someone confirm whether logging is broken on the backend or if there's a settings toggle we're missing?
answer: Thanks for flagging this, and I understand the compliance urgency here. We're seeing reports of audit log gaps tied to a recent indexing change on our end, and I'm escalating this to our platform team as a P1 since it affects your full account. Can you send us the exact timestamps and user IDs for a few of the missing deactivation events so we can trace them in our raw logs while the fix is in progress?

subject: Request to add biometric login to mobile app
body:
Our clinical staff at Apex Foods have been asking for Face ID and fingerprint login support in the Northwind Mobile App instead of re-entering credentials every shift change. Right now users have to type their password each time the app is reopened, which is slow when they're moving between patient floors with 80 seats deployed across three facilities.

Could you let us know if biometric authentication is on the roadmap, and if so, what the expected timeline looks like? This would meaningfully improve adoption for our healthcare teams.
answer: Thanks for the detailed context, this is a great use case for us to prioritize. Biometric login (Face ID/Touch ID and Android biometric APIs) is currently being scoped for an upcoming mobile release, and I'll add your account as a strong data point for the healthcare segment. I don't have a firm ship date yet, but I'll follow up here once it moves into active development so you can plan rollout to your teams.

subject: Webhook delivery delays during peak load
body:
We noticed webhook deliveries for order status updates were delayed by 8-15 minutes yesterday between 14:00 and 16:30 UTC, affecting our logistics dashboards at Granite Media. Retries eventually caught up, but our SDK client logged several timeout warnings during that window.

Separately, I saw a deprecation notice mentioning the v1 webhook signing method is being phased out. Could you confirm the exact sunset date so we can plan the SDK upgrade across our integration team?
answer: Thanks for the report. We identified a transient queue backlog in one of our webhook dispatch regions during that window yesterday, and delivery times have returned to normal since 17:00 UTC. On the deprecation question, v1 webhook signing is scheduled to be retired in Q1 next year; we'll publish exact dates in the changelog soon, and I'll send you the migration guide for the updated SDK signing method in the meantime.

subject: Need cursor-based pagination before rate limit changes roll out
body:
We're preparing for the upcoming rate limit changes on the API Platform and realized our integration still uses offset-based pagination for order and inventory endpoints across 50 seats. With the new limits, our current approach is generating far too many redundant calls when paging through large result sets.

Can you confirm whether cursor-based pagination is available now or planned soon, and whether the SDK has built-in support for it? We'd like to migrate before the rate limit enforcement date to avoid disruption to our travel booking sync jobs.
answer: Good timing on reaching out. Cursor-based pagination is already available on the v2 endpoints for orders and inventory, and the latest SDK release (4.2+) includes native helper methods for iterating pages automatically. I'd recommend migrating ahead of the rate limit rollout since cursor pagination will significantly cut down your call volume; I can share a short migration checklist and flag your account so our team can review your usage pattern once you've switched over.

subject: Deactivated users still appearing as active in reports
body:
I deactivated three users in the Admin Console last week for North Freight, but they're still showing up as active in the weekly usage report export. The Users tab correctly shows their status as deactivated, but the discrepancy is confusing for our internal reporting on the 39-seat account.

Is this a caching issue on the reporting side, or does deactivation need an additional step to fully remove them from usage counts?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. This is typically caused by the usage report snapshot being generated on a rolling weekly cycle rather than pulling live status, so deactivated users can still show up in the report for the cycle they were active during. I've confirmed your three accounts are correctly marked deactivated in the system, and the next report generation should reflect the updated counts. Let me know if they still appear after the next cycle and we'll dig further.

subject: Mobile app crashing on launch for field technicians
body:
Starting this morning, the Northwind Mobile App is crashing immediately on launch for a growing number of our field technicians at Ember Robotics, roughly 20 of 127 seats so far. It happens right after the splash screen, before login even loads, on both iOS and Android devices.

We rely on this app for offline work order sync in manufacturing plants, so this is blocking technicians from starting their shifts. Can you help us identify whether this is a known issue with the latest app version?
answer: Thank you for flagging this quickly. We've seen a small number of similar crash reports tied to a corrupted local cache after the latest app update, and our mobile team is actively investigating. As a workaround, please have affected technicians uninstall and reinstall the app, which clears the local cache and should restore normal launch behavior; we're also verifying this issue doesn't affect offline sync data integrity and will update you within the day.

subject: Dashboard PDF export cutting off charts
body:
When I export a dashboard to PDF from Dashboards, the last chart on the page gets cut off halfway, even though it displays fully in the browser view. This happens consistently on our operations dashboard with four stacked charts, tested on both Chrome and Firefox.

We're a small team on the Starter plan integrating reporting into a shared client portal, so this export needs to look clean for sharing externally. Is there a workaround or a fix planned for the export renderer?
answer: Thanks for the clear description. This looks like a known rendering issue where the PDF export doesn't recalculate page breaks correctly for dashboards with more than three stacked charts. As a workaround, try splitting the dashboard into two shorter views for export, which should render cleanly. I'll log this with our reporting team to fix the page-break logic in the export renderer and update you when a permanent fix ships.

subject: URGENT: Users being logged out every few minutes, suspect SSO issue
body:
Since roughly 09:15 this morning, all users at Ember Systems are being forced to re-authenticate every 2-3 minutes across our SSO integration, disrupting every class session on our education platform. We have 22 seats and this is affecting everyone simultaneously, including admins trying to investigate.

We also noticed a spike in failed MFA challenges in the audit trail right before this started, and we're concerned this could be tied to unauthorized access attempts rather than a simple config issue. We need immediate help confirming whether this is a security incident.
answer: We're treating this as a P0 and have immediately escalated to our security and identity teams. Please do not disable SSO enforcement or MFA in the meantime; we're pulling your session and authentication logs now to determine whether the short session timeouts are linked to the failed MFA spike or a separate token configuration issue. A member of our security response team will be in direct contact within the next few minutes with initial findings and next steps.

subject: Requesting rollback or fix for app crash after recent update
body:
After the latest Mobile App update pushed on Tuesday, several of our staff at Pioneer Systems have reported the app crashing on launch immediately after entering login credentials. This is happening on a mix of iOS 17 devices, affecting maybe 15 of our 60 seats so far in our healthcare facility.

We'd like to request either a rollback to the previous stable version or an expedited fix, since login is the first thing users hit and they can't get past it. Push notifications for shift alerts are also not coming through for affected users, which compounds the problem.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report and the device information. We're aware of a login-related crash affecting a subset of iOS 17 users after Tuesday's release, and our mobile team is finalizing a hotfix now rather than rolling back, since the update also contains a security patch. In the meantime, please advise affected staff to clear the app cache via device settings, which resolves the crash for most users we've heard from; I'll notify you as soon as the hotfix is live.

subject: Workspace settings reset unexpectedly, allowlist entries gone
body:
This morning our Admin Console workspace settings for Orion Systems appear to have reset, and the IP allowlist entries we configured last month are now empty. We only have 3 seats on this account but the allowlist is critical since we restrict access to a single office network for compliance reasons.

The audit log shows a settings change event at 07:42 today but no user or admin on our side made that change. Can you help confirm what caused this and restore the allowlist entries before unauthorized access becomes a risk?
answer: Thank you for reporting this right away, we're treating it as a priority security and compliance issue. We're pulling the full audit trail around the 07:42 settings change event to identify whether it originated from an internal system process or an external actor, and we'll restore your previous allowlist configuration from backup in the meantime. We'll follow up shortly with our findings and confirmation once the allowlist is reinstated.

subject: Zapier zap to Salesforce/Slack stopped triggering after Okta SSO rollout
body:
We use the Northwind Zapier integration to push new user provisioning events into Salesforce and post alerts in Slack. Since we switched our workspace over to Okta SSO on Monday, the zap hasn't fired at all - the trigger history in Zapier shows zero events since then. This is blocking our onboarding workflow for new manufacturing plant accounts and our sales team has no visibility into new leads.

Can someone confirm whether the Okta migration changed the webhook or API scopes Zapier relies on? We need this fixed quickly since it's affecting the whole team's daily process.
answer: Thanks for flagging this - we can see that the Okta SSO cutover regenerated the API token that the Zapier trigger was using, which is why events stopped flowing. I'm reissuing a fresh integration token now and will confirm once it's live so you can reconnect the zap on your end; I'll also send the updated scope list so your Salesforce and Slack steps keep working without changes. I'll follow up within the hour with status.

subject: Retention policy not purging old backups, storage quota maxed out
body:
Our workspace is set to a 90-day retention policy on backup archives, but I'm seeing files from as far back as January still sitting in the storage console. We hit our quota limit yesterday and now new uploads from our logistics tracking jobs are failing with 'insufficient storage' errors. This is a Pro workspace with 267 seats and we rely on daily uploads continuing without interruption.

Can you check why retention cleanup hasn't run and help us clear the backlog so uploads resume? We can't have this recurring given how much data we push through daily.
answer: Apologies for the disruption - this looks like a bug where the retention job silently failed for your workspace starting around three weeks ago, which is why older backups never got purged. I'm manually triggering a cleanup run now to bring you back under quota, and I'll have engineering confirm the scheduled retention job is running correctly going forward. I'll update you within a few hours once the cleanup finishes and uploads should resume immediately after.

subject: SAML role mapping assigning wrong permissions after SSO login
body:
We've noticed that several users logging in through our SAML SSO integration are being assigned Admin-level roles in Northwind instead of the Analyst role their group membership should map to. This started after we updated our attribute mapping last week to add an MFA requirement group. At least 9 accounts in our fintech team now have elevated access they shouldn't have.

Can someone review our role mapping configuration and confirm whether provisioning is reading the correct group attribute? We need this corrected before it becomes a compliance issue.
answer: Thank you for catching this early - incorrect role assignment from SSO group attributes is a serious issue and we're treating it with priority. I've pulled your SAML attribute mapping and can see the group claim added for MFA is being read by the same rule that drives role assignment, which is causing the overlap. I'm correcting the mapping logic now and will also audit the 9 affected accounts to reset them to the correct role; I'll confirm each one individually once done.

subject: Frage zu Session-Timeout Einstellungen bei SSO
body:
Wir nutzen SSO für unser Starter-Workspace und einige Mitarbeiter aus dem Filialbetrieb werden nach etwa 15 Minuten Inaktivität automatisch abgemeldet. Das ist etwas kurz für unseren Anwendungsfall, da die Kollegen oft zwischen Aufgaben wechseln. Gibt es eine Möglichkeit, das Timeout individuell für bestimmte Rollen zu verlängern, ohne die MFA-Anforderung zu ändern?

Wir würden uns über eine kurze Anleitung freuen, wie und wo diese Einstellung in der Admin-Konsole zu finden ist.
answer: Vielen Dank für Ihre Anfrage. Die Sitzungsdauer lässt sich in der Admin-Konsole unter Sicherheit > SSO-Einstellungen pro Rolle anpassen, unabhängig von der MFA-Konfiguration. Ich sende Ihnen im Anschluss eine kurze Schritt-für-Schritt-Anleitung, mit der Sie das Timeout für die betroffenen Rollen auf einen längeren Wert setzen können.

subject: Scheduled sync latency increasing on hourly connector jobs
body:
I'm running scheduled syncs through the Data Pipelines connector pulling booking data from our travel CRM every hour. Over the past week the sync completion time has gone from about 3 minutes to over 20 minutes per run, and a few runs on Oct 14 and 15 timed out entirely before finishing. We're on a Starter plan so I'm not sure if there's a concurrency limit we're hitting.

Is there a way to see connector-level latency metrics, or any recommended settings to reduce this? Would also appreciate feedback on whether upgrading the sync frequency tier would help.
answer: Thanks for the detail - the timeouts on the 14th and 15th line up with a spike in queue depth on the connector cluster serving Starter-tier syncs, which explains the slowdown. I'd recommend reducing the sync frequency to every two hours temporarily while we look at load balancing on our side, and I can share latency graphs for your connector so you can track improvement. I'll also flag whether a plan tier change would give you dedicated throughput and get back to you with options.

subject: Push notifications not reaching field staff on mobile app
body:
Our operations team relies on push notifications in the Northwind mobile app to alert on-call staff about urgent healthcare scheduling changes, but since Tuesday almost none of our 96 users are receiving them, even when logged in and online. We've confirmed notification permissions are enabled on multiple devices. This is causing missed shift coverage across several clinics.

Can you check whether there's an issue on the push notification service? We need this restored today given the operational impact.
answer: I understand the urgency here given the impact on shift coverage - we're investigating this as a priority issue right now. Initial checks show a delay in the push delivery queue affecting a batch of workspaces since Tuesday morning, and we're working to clear the backlog and confirm delivery is flowing normally again. I'll update you as soon as we have confirmation, and in the meantime please have staff check in-app alerts as a temporary fallback.

subject: App crashes offline
body: Mobile app crashes every time we open it without signal.
answer: Thanks for the report - a crash on launch in offline mode is a serious issue and we're escalating it now. Could you confirm your app version and device OS so our mobile team can reproduce it immediately? We'll follow up as soon as we have a fix or workaround.

subject: Biometric login locking users out of mobile app entirely
body:
Since updating to the latest app version this morning, biometric login is failing for our whole workspace - users get a 'Face ID authentication failed, please try again' loop and there's no fallback to password login shown on screen. This is blocking access to the app completely for our 8-seat team, including during an active shift where staff needed to check schedules offline.

Can you push a fix or tell us how to force the password login screen so we're not locked out while this gets resolved?
answer: This is a serious issue and I'm escalating it to our mobile engineering team right now, since a broken fallback to password login shouldn't happen. As an immediate workaround, users can uninstall and reinstall the app which should reset the login flow to show the password option - I'd recommend trying that on one device first to confirm before rolling it out to the rest of your team. I'll update you within the hour with a permanent fix timeline.

subject: Mobile app crashing on biometric login attempts, slow even after restart
body:
Several of our legal team members are reporting that the mobile app crashes immediately after Face ID authentication succeeds, kicking them back to the home screen. Even when it doesn't crash, the app takes 15-20 seconds to load the dashboard afterward, which never happened before last week's update. This is affecting daily billing review workflows for our 54-seat workspace.

We've tried restarting devices and reinstalling on two phones with no improvement. Can you confirm if this is a known issue with the latest release?
answer: Thank you for the detailed report - we've had a few similar reports of crashes and slow load times following last week's release, and our mobile team is actively investigating a memory handling issue introduced in that update. I don't yet have a workaround beyond what you've tried, but I'll prioritize this as a high-impact bug and update you as soon as a patch is available, hopefully within the next couple of days.

subject: Incorrect charge after plan upgrade, need refund review
body:
We upgraded from Pro to Enterprise on our billing account last week to unlock additional API rate limits for our travel booking platform, but the invoice generated on Oct 18 charged us for the full Enterprise rate across all 4562 seats for the entire month, rather than prorating from the upgrade date. That's a significant discrepancy compared to what we expected based on the pricing page.

Can someone review the invoice and process a prorated refund for the difference? Happy to share the invoice ID if needed.
answer: Thanks for flagging this - a full-month charge without proration on a mid-cycle upgrade at your scale is definitely not expected behavior, so I'm pulling up the account now to review the Oct 18 invoice. If you can share the invoice ID that will help us move faster, but I've already started calculating the prorated adjustment and will get a refund or credit issued to your account once confirmed, likely within the next two business days.

subject: Dashboards loading slowly for finance team
body: Our finance team has been using the Quarterly Revenue and Cash Flow dashboards daily, but since last week they take close to 20-30 seconds to render, especially the bar charts with year-over-year comparisons. We have about 18 people on the account and everyone on the finance side is affected. Is there a way to speed this up, or documentation on optimizing chart queries?
answer: Thanks for the details. Dashboards with multiple stacked charts and long date ranges can slow down when the underlying query pulls more rows than needed. I'd suggest narrowing the default date filter and checking if any charts are set to 'no cache' mode. I'm attaching our performance tuning guide, and happy to review your specific dashboard config if you can share its name or ID.

subject: Doppelte Benachrichtigungen bei E-Mail-Alerts
body: Bei uns kommen seit einigen Tagen E-Mail-Benachrichtigungen doppelt an, teilweise sogar dreifach innerhalb von Minuten. Das betrifft mehrere Nutzer im Team, nicht nur einen einzelnen Account. Wir würden gerne wissen, ob es eine Einstellung gibt, um Duplikate zu unterdrücken, oder ob das an einer Fehlkonfiguration unserer Alert-Regeln liegt.
answer: Vielen Dank für den Hinweis. Doppelte Benachrichtigungen entstehen meist, wenn mehrere Alert-Regeln auf dasselbe Ereignis reagieren. Wir prüfen gerne Ihre aktuellen Regeln auf Überlappungen und können Ihnen zeigen, wie man eine Deduplizierungs-Regel einrichtet. Könnten Sie uns ein Beispiel mit Zeitstempel der doppelten Mails schicken, damit wir das nachvollziehen können?

subject: Sales connector delivering data 6+ hours late
body: Our ORION-SALES-01 connector is supposed to sync store transaction data every hour, but for the past three days records are arriving 6 to 8 hours late. This is causing our inventory dashboards to show stale numbers and our team keeps flagging incorrect stock levels. Last successful on-time sync was March 3rd around 14:00 UTC.
answer: Thanks for flagging this, and I understand the impact on your inventory reporting. We're seeing elevated processing times on that connector's queue and are investigating whether it's a throughput or upstream source issue. We'll prioritize this and update you within a few hours with root cause and an ETA for catching up the backlog.

subject: Bulk MFA enrolment via API for large user base
body: We're integrating Northwind's Identity API to onboard our workforce and need to enroll roughly 4,000 users into MFA programmatically rather than having each user set it up manually through the portal. I've looked at the /mfa/enroll endpoint but I'm getting a 403 permissions error even with an admin-scoped token. Is there a bulk enrolment flow or a specific scope we're missing?
answer: Good question, and bulk enrolment at that scale is definitely supported through our admin API, but it requires the 'mfa:admin:write' scope rather than the standard admin scope, which is likely why you're seeing the 403. I'll send over documentation for the batch enrolment endpoint along with a sample payload, and we can also set up a call to review your onboarding flow given the size of your rollout.

subject: Speicherquote fast erreicht - Uploads schlagen fehl
body: Seit heute Morgen bekommen mehrere Nutzer beim Hochladen von Dateien die Fehlermeldung 'Quota exceeded: 98% used'. Wir haben aktuell etwa 160 aktive Nutzer und wissen nicht genau, welche Abteilung so viel Speicher belegt. Können Sie uns sagen, wie wir die Nutzung aufschlüsseln können und ob wir kurzfristig mehr Speicherplatz bekommen können, da einige Uploads für ein laufendes Projekt kritisch sind.
answer: Danke für die schnelle Meldung. Wir sehen, dass Ihr Speicherkontingent tatsächlich fast ausgeschöpft ist. Wir können Ihnen eine Aufschlüsselung nach Ordnern und Abteilungen bereitstellen, und für die kurzfristige kritische Situation können wir Ihr Kontingent vorübergehend erhöhen, während wir gemeinsam eine dauerhafte Lösung planen. Ich melde mich in Kürze mit den Nutzungsdaten.

subject: App crashes immediately after opening on Android
body: Since updating to the latest version of the mobile app, it crashes within a second of launching on my Android phone. I've tried reinstalling twice and clearing cache, but it still closes immediately after the splash screen. A couple of colleagues on iOS say theirs works fine, so it might be Android-specific. Would like to know if there's a fix planned or a workaround for now.
answer: Thanks for reporting this, and sorry for the disruption. We've had a couple of similar reports tied to the latest Android build, likely related to a push notification permission check on launch. As a temporary workaround, try disabling notification permissions for the app before opening it, then re-enable once it loads. We're already working on a patch and will let you know once it's released.

subject: How to restore files from a specific backup snapshot
body: We need to restore a set of contract documents that were accidentally deleted from our storage last Thursday. I can see backup snapshots listed going back 30 days, but I'm not sure how to restore just a folder rather than the entire account. Could you walk me through the process, and confirm whether restoring will affect files created after the snapshot date?
answer: Happy to help with this. You can restore at the folder level by selecting the specific snapshot, then choosing 'Restore selected path' instead of the full account option, which will only overwrite files within that folder and won't touch anything created afterward. I'll include a short guide with screenshots, and let me know the exact folder path and snapshot date if you'd like us to run the restore on our side.

subject: Request to update backup retention before restore process change
body: We're planning to change how we handle backup restores internally and want to confirm our current retention window before doing so. Right now we believe backups are kept for 30 days, but a recent restore attempt for a folder from 35 days ago showed no available snapshot. Can you confirm the actual retention period and let us know if it can be extended for our plan.
answer: Thanks for checking before making changes on your end. Your current plan includes a 30-day backup retention window, so a snapshot from 35 days ago would no longer be available, which matches what you saw. We can discuss extending retention if that's something your team needs going forward, and I'll follow up with pricing details for an extended retention add-on.

subject: Unsubscribe links not working - users still getting emails
body: We're getting multiple complaints from our end users saying that clicking 'unsubscribe' on your notification emails does nothing, they land on a generic error page and continue receiving emails afterward. This is now a compliance concern for us since some of these are legal notices our clients explicitly opted out of. We've confirmed this on at least 15 separate accounts as of this morning.
answer: This is being treated as urgent given the compliance implications. We've reproduced the issue on our end and identified a fault in the unsubscribe link generation introduced in a recent deployment. Our engineering team is deploying a fix now, and in the meantime we're manually suppressing the affected recipients you've flagged to stop further sends. We'll update you within the hour with confirmation of the fix.

subject: Charts not rendering correctly after last update
body: Several of our dashboard charts are showing blank spaces or 'Error loading chart data' where the bar and line graphs should be, starting this morning. This is affecting the enrollment tracking dashboard we share with department heads weekly, and exports are coming out with the same blank sections. About half our team of 18 is seeing this on both Chrome and Firefox.
answer: Sorry for the trouble this is causing, especially with your weekly reporting cycle. We're seeing an issue on our end affecting chart rendering for a subset of dashboards created before a recent update, and we're actively working on a fix. In the meantime, try refreshing the dashboard cache under settings, which has resolved this for some other customers, and we'll confirm once the underlying issue is fully resolved.

subject: Invoice shows more seats than we actually have assigned
body: I'm reviewing our latest invoice (INV-88213) for North Labs and it lists 267 seats, but when I check the Admin Console under Users, I only count 241 active accounts. We haven't added anyone since last quarter. Can someone confirm how the seat count is calculated for billing purposes, and whether we're eligible for a partial refund or credit on the difference for this cycle?
answer: Thanks for flagging this, and good catch on the discrepancy. Seat counts on invoices reflect the highest number of active seats at any point during the billing period, not the count on the invoice date, so the gap is likely from deactivated users that haven't rolled off yet. I'll pull the seat history for your account and confirm the exact numbers, and if there's an overage we'll apply a credit to your next invoice.

subject: Salesforce sync completely stopped - records not updating
body:
Since this morning our Salesforce integration has stopped syncing lead updates into Northwind. We rely on this for our sales team's daily workflow and nothing has come through since around 8am. Here's what our integration log shows:

2024-05-14 08:12:03 ERROR sync.salesforce: connection refused (code=503)
2024-05-14 08:12:03 WARN retry attempt 1/5
2024-05-14 08:15:11 ERROR sync.salesforce: connection refused (code=503)
2024-05-14 08:15:11 WARN retry attempt 2/5
2024-05-14 08:22:47 ERROR sync.salesforce: max retries exceeded, sync aborted

We have 24 people on our team who depend on this data being current. Please escalate, this is blocking our sales operations.
answer: I'm sorry for the disruption, this is being escalated immediately as we can see the 503s originating from our Salesforce connector service. We're checking whether this is on our end or a Salesforce-side outage and will update you within the hour. In the meantime, any changes made directly in Salesforce will be queued and synced automatically once the connection is restored, so no data should be lost.

subject: Datenverlust durch fehlerhafte Pagination in der API
body: Wir nutzen die Northwind API Platform, um täglich Falldaten aus unserem System zu exportieren. Seit dem Update auf die neue Pagination-Methode am 12. Mai erhalten wir bei Anfragen mit dem 'next_cursor' Parameter nach der dritten Seite plötzlich leere Ergebnisse, obwohl laut Dashboard noch über 4.000 Datensätze vorhanden sein sollten. Das betrifft unseren automatisierten Nachtjob, der seit zwei Tagen unvollständige Daten in unsere Compliance-Ablage schreibt. Wir befürchten, dass bereits Daten verloren gegangen sind und benötigen dringend Unterstützung, da dies unsere gesetzliche Aufbewahrungspflicht als Kanzlei betrifft.
answer: Vielen Dank für die sofortige Meldung, wir haben dies als kritischen Vorfall eingestuft und das API-Team bereits eingebunden. Wir prüfen umgehend, ob die Cursor-Logik nach dem Update vom 12. Mai fehlerhafte Antworten liefert und ob dabei tatsächlich Daten verloren gegangen sind oder nur die Auslieferung betroffen ist. Wir melden uns innerhalb der nächsten Stunde mit einem Zwischenstand und einem Vorschlag, wie wir die fehlenden Datensätze für Ihre Compliance-Anforderungen wiederherstellen können.

subject: Workspace settings reverted after we updated allowlist
body: Yesterday I updated our IP allowlist in the Admin Console to add two new office locations, but this morning the workspace settings show the old allowlist again, and two team members who should still have access got deactivated automatically overnight. I checked the audit log and it shows a settings change at 2:47am that we didn't make. Can you help us figure out what happened and restore the correct configuration?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report, and I'm sorry for the access disruption this caused. We're looking into the audit log entry from 2:47am to determine whether this was triggered by a sync job or a configuration rollback issue on our side. In the meantime, please re-add the two locations to your allowlist and reactivate the affected accounts, and we'll follow up once we've identified the root cause so it doesn't recur.

subject: How to reduce seat count after offboarding two users
body: We recently offboarded two employees and I deactivated their accounts in the Admin Console, but our billing page still shows 18 seats and we're being charged for all of them. I expected the seat count to drop automatically once accounts are deactivated. Is there an extra step needed to actually remove them from the billing plan, or is this a bug?
answer: Deactivating a user in the Admin Console stops their access but doesn't automatically remove the seat from your billing plan, you'll need to go to Billing > Manage Seats and reduce the seat count separately, which will take effect on your next renewal date. I'll walk you through the exact steps if needed, and if the seat reduction should have applied automatically for your plan, I'll flag that as a product gap for our billing team to review.

subject: Restoring a folder from backup
body: One of our team members accidentally deleted a folder of product spec files from Storage last week, and I'd like to restore it from a backup if possible. We're a small team of three so this wasn't caught right away. Could you let me know how far back your backups go and whether I can request a restore myself, or if this needs to go through support each time?
answer: Happy to help with this, on the Starter plan backups are retained for 14 days, so as long as the deletion happened within that window we should be able to restore the folder. Restores currently need to go through support rather than being self-service, so if you can confirm the approximate deletion date and the folder name, I'll get the restore queued and let you know once it's complete.

subject: Charts not rendering correctly on logistics dashboard
body: Several of our operations dashboards have started showing broken or blank charts since last week, specifically the shipment volume and delay-tracking widgets. They load fine for a few seconds then show a gray box with no error message. This is affecting reporting for our logistics team across 235 seats, so we'd like guidance on whether this is a known issue and how to export the underlying data in the meantime while the charts are fixed.
answer: Thanks for the report, we've seen similar rendering issues tied to a recent widget update and are working on a fix for the shipment and delay-tracking chart types. As a workaround, you can export the underlying dataset directly from each widget's menu using the Export option, which should give your team access to the numbers while we resolve the display issue. I'll update you as soon as the fix is rolled out.

subject: PDF-Export von Dashboards liefert leere Seiten
body: Beim Export unseres Energieverbrauchs-Dashboards als PDF erhalten wir seit gestern nur leere oder halb gerenderte Seiten, obwohl die Charts in der Web-Ansicht korrekt angezeigt werden. Der Export läuft über die API mit dem Endpoint /dashboards/export, der Statuscode ist 200, aber die generierte Datei enthält nur das Layout ohne Diagramme. Das betrifft mehrere Dashboards, nicht nur eines, und wir brauchen die Reports für unser wöchentliches Reporting an unsere Kunden.
answer: Danke für die genaue Beschreibung, das hilft uns sehr bei der Eingrenzung. Es klingt nach einem Problem beim serverseitigen Rendering der Chart-Komponenten während des PDF-Exports, wir prüfen das gerade anhand der betroffenen Dashboard-IDs. Können Sie uns eine oder zwei Dashboard-IDs nennen, bei denen das reproduzierbar ist, damit wir das gezielt nachstellen können, während wir an einer Lösung arbeiten?

subject: help
body: Our team is getting logged out of Northwind roughly every 15 minutes even though our SSO session timeout is configured for 8 hours in the Identity console. This started happening after we updated our MFA provisioning rules last week. It's disrupting work for most of our 77 seats since people have to keep re-authenticating throughout the day. Please advise urgently as this is affecting productivity across the whole team.
answer: Sorry for the disruption this is causing across your team. This looks related to the MFA provisioning change interacting with the session timeout setting, possibly causing sessions to be re-validated more aggressively than intended. Could you confirm the exact date you updated the MFA rules and whether this affects all users or specific groups? In the meantime, we're reviewing your SSO configuration to identify why the 8-hour timeout isn't being honored.

subject: Connector authentication keeps expiring for our pipeline
body: Our data pipeline connector to our banking data source keeps losing authentication every few hours, requiring us to manually re-enter credentials each time. This started about a week ago and is causing sync delays of several hours, which is a problem since we rely on near real-time transaction data. We only have 6 seats on this account but this connector is critical to our daily reconciliation process. Can you help us set up a more stable auth method, like OAuth refresh tokens if supported?
answer: Thanks for the details, repeated auth expiration usually means the connector is using short-lived credentials instead of a refresh token flow. We do support OAuth-based authentication with automatic token refresh for this connector type, and I can help you switch over so you won't need to re-enter credentials manually. Could you confirm which connector configuration you're currently using so I can send you the correct setup steps?

subject: Transform stage failing repeatedly on inbound connector sync
body:
Since this morning our travel-inventory pipeline has been failing at the transform stage. The connector pulls data fine from the source but the transform job errors out with a timeout after roughly 90 seconds, and retries are just looping. We've had 6 failed runs since 08:15 UTC today, and downstream dashboards are now showing stale data from yesterday.

This is affecting all 8 seats on our account since everyone relies on this pipeline for daily reporting. Can someone look at the connector logs on your end? Pipeline ID is bp-travel-sync-04.
answer:
Thanks for the detailed report, and sorry for the disruption this is causing. We can see elevated transform latency on connector bp-travel-sync-04 starting at 08:12 UTC and are actively investigating a backend processing bottleneck affecting several pipelines in that region. We're escalating this internally now and will push a fix or failover shortly.

In the meantime, please pause any manual retries on your end to avoid queue buildup — we'll trigger a clean re-run once the root cause is resolved and will update you within the hour.

subject: Okta SAML app integration returning invalid_request on callback
body:
I'm setting up the Okta integration through your Integrations API so our team can SSO into Northwind from our Okta tenant. When I complete the SAML handshake, Okta redirects back and we get 'invalid_request: redirect_uri mismatch' even though the URI in our app config matches exactly what's in the Northwind integration settings.

We also have Slack and Jira connectors configured on the same integration hub and those work fine, so it seems isolated to the Okta app config. This is blocking our entire team of 4 from logging in via SSO — can someone check the redirect_uri validation logic on your side?
answer:
Thank you for the clear breakdown — this does sound like a bug in redirect_uri validation for Okta app configs rather than something on your end. We've reproduced a similar mismatch when the URI contains a trailing slash difference that isn't being normalized before comparison. We're treating this as a priority fix given it's blocking SSO login for your whole team.

Could you paste the exact redirect_uri string from your Okta app settings so we can confirm the normalization issue on our side? We'll follow up with either a config workaround or a patch within the next few hours.

subject: Push notifications not reaching mobile app when offline then reconnecting
body:
Our field team uses the mobile app to get alerts on shipment updates, but several of them have reported that push notifications don't arrive after their phone goes offline and reconnects to wifi or cellular. They only see the notifications once they manually open the app.

This has come up a few times over the past two weeks with different users, and it's becoming a real gap for us since timely alerts matter for approvals. Could you look into whether there's a known issue with notification delivery after reconnect, and is there a fix planned or a workaround we could use in the meantime?
answer:
Thanks for flagging this — we've had a few similar reports about push delivery after a connectivity gap, and our mobile team is looking at how notifications are queued versus delivered when a device comes back online. It looks like there's a delay in the token refresh handshake in that scenario rather than notifications being dropped entirely.

As a short-term workaround, having users force-close and reopen the app after reconnecting should trigger an immediate sync. We'll log this as a feature/fix request on our roadmap and update you once we have a timeline.

subject: Need to restore storage bucket from backup after accidental deletion
body:
One of our team members accidentally deleted a folder of uploaded shipment documents from our storage bucket yesterday around 3pm. We need to restore this from backup as soon as possible since it's needed for an active client audit.

We're on the Pro plan with 139 seats, and I know retention policy should cover recent backups. Can you confirm what backup snapshots are available for our account and initiate a restore for the 'logistics-docs' bucket? Happy to provide exact folder paths if needed.
answer:
Thanks for reaching out, and good news — your retention policy on Pro includes daily snapshots going back 30 days, so we should have a backup point from just before the deletion. We're checking the most recent snapshot for the 'logistics-docs' bucket now and will confirm the exact restore point available.

Could you send us the specific folder paths or file names affected so we can scope the restore precisely and avoid overwriting anything added since the deletion? We'll aim to have this resolved today given the audit deadline.

subject: URGENT: API keys exposed in public GitHub repo, need immediate rotation
body:
We just discovered that one of our developers accidentally committed a file containing two of our production API keys to a public GitHub repository. The repo has been public for at least 4 hours before we caught it. We need these keys revoked immediately and new ones issued — this is a critical security exposure.

The affected keys are used for our billing webhook integration and our main API/SDK access. Please confirm once they're revoked and let us know if you can see any suspicious usage on our account in the last few hours.
answer:
This has been escalated immediately as a security incident. We've revoked both affected API keys as of now and disabled the associated webhook endpoint to prevent further use. We're pulling access logs for the last 12 hours to check for any unauthorized calls and will share findings with you as soon as the review completes.

Please generate replacement keys from your dashboard and update your webhook and SDK configs — we recommend also rotating any secrets that may have referenced these keys elsewhere. We'll follow up shortly with the access log review and next steps.

subject: Question about storage quota calculation for our account
body:
I'm integrating file uploads through the Storage API and want to understand how our quota usage is calculated. Our dashboard shows 62% used, but when I sum the object sizes returned by the API for our bucket, I get a number that's noticeably lower than that percentage would suggest.

Is the quota counting older backup retention copies or deleted-but-not-purged objects toward the total? Just want to make sure we're not going to hit an unexpected cap during our upload batch next week.
answer:
Good question — the quota total does include backup retention copies and any soft-deleted objects still within their retention window, which is likely the discrepancy you're seeing versus the live object sizes from the API. These get purged automatically once the retention period expires, but they count toward usage in the meantime.

If you'd like, we can pull a breakdown of live versus retained storage for your account so you can plan your upload batch with an accurate margin. Let us know and we'll send that over.

subject: Feature request: allow MFA enrolment via API for provisioned users
body:
We're integrating our onboarding flow with the Identity and SSO API to auto-provision new employee accounts, but we've hit a gap: there's no way to trigger or pre-configure MFA enrolment programmatically. Right now each new user has to log in manually and go through the MFA setup screen themselves.

For our workflow, we'd like to either pre-seed an MFA method or at least force enrolment on first login via an API flag. Is this on your roadmap, and if not, could you point me to any documentation about MFA-related endpoints we might be missing?
answer:
Thanks for the detailed context — currently the provisioning API does support a 'force_mfa_on_login' flag that flags the account for mandatory enrolment at next sign-in, but you're right that there isn't yet an endpoint to pre-seed an MFA method directly. That's a reasonable gap and we'll pass it along to our product team as a feature request.

In the meantime, I'll send over the documentation section covering the force_mfa_on_login flag and login-flow behavior so you can at least streamline enforcement for new accounts.

subject: Scheduled sync jobs occasionally skip a run without error
body:
We've noticed our scheduled sync jobs for the enrollment-data connector sometimes just don't run at their scheduled time, with no error logged anywhere. Looking at our job history, this happened twice last week:

Job: sync-enrollment-nightly
Scheduled: 2024-05-14 02:00 UTC — Status: SKIPPED (no log entry)
Scheduled: 2024-05-17 02:00 UTC — Status: SKIPPED (no log entry)
Next successful run: 2024-05-18 02:00 UTC — Status: SUCCESS

Is this a known bug with the scheduler, or could there be a config issue on our end causing silent skips? Also, is there documentation on how the scheduler handles overlapping jobs or missed windows?
answer:
Thanks for the clear logs — a silent skip with no error entry does point to a scheduler-side issue rather than a config problem, most likely related to how missed windows are handled when a prior job run hasn't fully closed out. We're looking into the scheduler behavior for sync-enrollment-nightly around those dates to confirm.

We don't currently have detailed public docs on missed-window handling, so we'll put together a short explainer once we've confirmed the root cause, and we'll log this as a bug for the scheduling team to review.

subject: Getting duplicate email alerts for the same event
body:
Our team has been receiving duplicate email notifications for the same alert events — usually two identical emails within a minute of each other. This started about a week ago and is happening for several different alert types, not just one specific rule.

It's not urgent but it's creating some confusion since people think there's a new event each time. Could you check if there's a known issue with duplicate notification delivery, or a setting on our end that might be causing this? We'd appreciate a fix or at least a workaround.
answer:
Thanks for the report — we've seen a small number of similar cases recently tied to a notification queue retry that occasionally re-fires an alert before marking it as delivered, which would explain the near-identical timestamps you're seeing. This looks like a bug on our end rather than a setting issue.

We're logging this for our notifications team to investigate the retry logic, and we'll let you know once a fix is deployed. In the meantime, there isn't a reliable workaround, but the duplicates shouldn't affect any downstream automation tied to the alerts.

subject: Storage retention question / upload issue
body:
We've been using Northwind Storage for a few months now to back up our operational reports, mostly daily CSV exports and some scanned documents. Our team has grown a bit and we've started uploading larger batches recently, so I wanted to check in about how retention works for older files since we haven't needed to look at this before.

While digging into this, I tried to re-upload a batch of files from a folder we thought was still retained, and got the following:

PUT /v1/storage/upload/batch
Status: 409 Conflict
{"error": "quota_exceeded", "detail": "retention_window_expired for 214 objects", "bucket": "summit-ops-reports"}

So it looks like the files were purged already, which surprised us since we assumed retention was longer. Can you tell me what our current retention window is set to and whether there's any way to recover those 214 objects, or documentation explaining how retention and quota interact?
answer:
Thanks for the details, including the error payload — that's very helpful. On the Starter plan, retention for storage objects is set to 14 days by default, and once that window passes objects are purged and can't be recovered, which matches what you're seeing with the 409 for those 214 objects.

We're sorry those files are no longer retrievable. I'll send over our documentation on retention windows and quota behavior so you can plan uploads accordingly going forward, and happy to discuss extended retention options if that would help your workflow.

subject: Pagination cursor inconsistent after 429s, plus offset deprecation timeline
body: We're building against API Platform v3 using SDK 2.4.1 for our claims intake tool. When we hit rate limits on /v3/claims, the 429 response sometimes still includes a next_cursor value and sometimes returns null, which breaks our retry logic. The docs still reference the old offset param that the changelog marked deprecated last month, but the webhook payload schema hasn't been updated to match the new cursor format. Could you confirm the removal date for offset pagination and get the webhook docs aligned with the cursor-based responses? This is blocking a rollout across our 96-seat integration team.
answer: Thanks for flagging this, and good catch on the inconsistent cursor behavior after 429 responses - that's not expected and we'll get engineering to reproduce it against SDK 2.4.1. I've also pinged the docs team to reconcile the webhook payload schema with the cursor pagination model; I'll follow up with a firm offset-removal date once I have confirmation from the API team, likely within the next few business days.

subject: Question on upgrading from Pro to Enterprise mid-cycle
body: I'm on the support team at Ember Freight and we're evaluating moving from our current Pro plan to Enterprise before our next renewal. I couldn't find clear documentation on whether the upgrade is prorated immediately or takes effect at the next billing date. Also, when I clicked 'Preview Upgrade' in the billing console it showed a $0.00 total for the new plan, which seems like a display bug rather than the real price. Can you clarify the proration process and point me to the right doc?
answer: Good question - upgrades from Pro to Enterprise are prorated immediately, so you'd see a partial charge reflecting the remaining days in your current cycle rather than waiting until renewal. Thanks for catching the $0.00 preview issue, that does look like a display bug in the console and I'm passing it to engineering; in the meantime I can generate a manual upgrade quote for Ember Freight so you have accurate numbers before committing.

subject: Request: fallback PIN option when Face ID unavailable in Mobile App
body: I'm integrating the Mobile App SDK for a travel booking client and testing biometric login on iOS. When Face ID fails or the device has no biometric hardware enrolled, the app just shows a blank login screen instead of falling back to PIN or password. The documentation mentions a fallback flow but doesn't show how to configure it. Could you point me to a working example or update the docs with the actual config flag needed to enable PIN fallback?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. The PIN fallback should trigger automatically when biometric auth is unavailable, so the blank screen you're seeing points to a config issue rather than expected behavior. I've attached a sample config snippet showing the 'biometricFallback' flag usage, and I'll ask the docs team to add this example to the integration guide since it's clearly missing right now.

subject: Users receiving duplicate push and email alerts, up to 5x per event
body: We're seeing duplicate notifications fire for the same trigger event in our travel itinerary app. Since this morning around 9:15 AM UTC, several users have reported getting the same booking-confirmed alert 3 to 5 times within a minute, both via push and email. We checked our webhook logs and we're only firing one event per booking on our end, so it looks like it's happening on the Notifications side. This is affecting most of our active users right now and generating support complaints.
answer: This has been escalated immediately as a P1 - duplicate delivery affecting most active users is a serious issue and we're investigating the notification dispatch pipeline right now. We suspect a retry loop may be re-sending events that already succeeded; I'll update you within the hour with findings and a mitigation, and please let us know if the duplicate rate changes in the meantime.

subject: Need routing rules to prevent duplicate escalations across regions
body: We're integrating Notifications for our clinical alerting platform and need a way to define routing rules so that the same critical alert doesn't escalate to on-call teams in multiple regions simultaneously. Right now if an alert matches conditions in two region-based rule sets, both fire and page separate teams for the same incident, which is causing confusion during active incidents. Given our scale of 4359 seats across dozens of hospital sites, we need a way to dedupe or prioritize a single escalation path per alert.
answer: This is a significant gap for an environment of your scale, and I'm marking it P1 given the operational risk of duplicate pages during clinical incidents. I'm escalating this to the product team as a feature request for rule-priority and dedupe-by-alert-key logic in routing; in the meantime, I can help you configure a temporary workaround using tag-based suppression rules so only one region's rule set fires per alert.

subject: Invoice question
body:
I've been going through our quarterly reporting and reconciling our vendor spend across all the SaaS tools we use, and Northwind is one of the larger line items so I wanted to make sure everything lines up correctly before I submit the numbers to finance. We're on the Pro plan with 270 seats at Harbor Labs, and I was cross-checking the last three invoices against our seat count changes in March and April.

The actual problem is that our April invoice shows a charge for 310 seats, but we never added any seats that month - our admin console still shows 270 active seats. Can someone check where the discrepancy came from and issue a correction or refund for the overcharge?
answer: Thanks for catching this and for the detailed reconciliation - a 40-seat discrepancy on your April invoice is not something we want lingering, so I've flagged this as P1 for immediate review. I'm pulling the seat history logs for Harbor Labs now to identify where the extra count came from, and once confirmed we'll issue a corrected invoice or refund for the difference; I'll update you within one business day.

subject: PDF-Export für Dashboards fehlt
body: Als Workspace-Admin bei Pioneer Retail würde ich gerne unsere monatlichen Reporting-Dashboards direkt als PDF exportieren, um sie an unsere Schulleiter zu verschicken. Aktuell sehe ich nur die Option, einzelne Charts als PNG zu exportieren, aber keinen Export für das ganze Dashboard. Gibt es eine Möglichkeit, das komplette Dashboard inklusive Filteransicht als PDF herunterzuladen, oder ist das für die Zukunft geplant?
answer: Vielen Dank für die Anfrage. Aktuell unterstützt das Dashboard-Modul tatsächlich nur den Export einzelner Charts als PNG, ein vollständiger PDF-Export des gesamten Dashboards inklusive Filteransicht ist derzeit nicht verfügbar. Ich leite diesen Wunsch als Feature-Anfrage an unser Produktteam weiter und melde mich, sobald es dazu Neuigkeiten gibt.

subject: Dashboards taking 20+ seconds to load, blocking monthly close
body: Our finance team relies on the Dashboards product to pull energy consumption reports for month-end close, and starting this week every dashboard with more than two charts is taking 20-30 seconds to render, sometimes timing out entirely. We've confirmed it's not our network - other tools load fine. This is affecting all 180 seats in our org and we can't finish our close process on time if this continues. Can someone check the backend performance for our workspace?
answer: I'm sorry for the disruption to your close process - this is a P1 for us given it's blocking finance operations org-wide. We're pulling query performance logs for your workspace now to check for slow chart queries or a possible indexing issue affecting multi-chart dashboards; I'll have an update on root cause within a few hours and will prioritize a fix given the timing impact on your month-end work.

subject: Duplicate line items on this month's invoice
body: While reviewing our November billing statement for Quill Legal, I noticed two separate line items both charging for 66 seats on our Pro plan, effectively doubling our invoice total. I checked our admin console and we only have 66 active seats, no recent changes. This looks like a billing bug rather than an actual seat increase - can you confirm and correct the invoice before it's charged to our card on file?
answer: Thank you for catching this before the charge went through. A duplicate seat line item does sound like a billing system bug rather than a real usage change, and I've flagged it for our billing engineering team to investigate. I'm placing a hold on the automatic charge for this invoice while we correct it, and I'll send you a revised invoice reflecting the accurate 66-seat total within the next day.

subject: URGENT: Biometric login crashing app for all users on Android
body: Since our last app update rolled out this morning, every user attempting biometric login on Android is hitting an immediate crash instead of the fingerprint prompt. We're getting crash reports flooding in and users can't get past the login screen at all, even with PIN fallback since the crash happens before the fallback UI loads. This is a Starter-plan account with only 13 seats but all of them are affected right now and we need a fix or workaround urgently.
answer: This is being treated as P1 given the app is unusable for your entire team. Please have someone available to share the crash logs and affected Android OS versions/device models so we can pinpoint the trigger in the biometric module - in the meantime, we recommend disabling the biometric login feature flag from your admin console as an immediate workaround so users can log in via PIN while we investigate the crash.

subject: Mapping SSO groups to custom roles
body: We're rolling out SSO for our retail locations and I need to map incoming SAML groups to our custom Northwind roles instead of the default Member role. We have groups like store-managers and regional-admins in our IdP. Is there documentation on setting up attribute mapping for role assignment, and does MFA enforcement carry over from the IdP or does Northwind require its own MFA policy on top? We have 259 seats provisioning over the next two weeks so I'd like this settled before we push the group sync.
answer: Thanks for reaching out. You can map IdP groups to Northwind roles under Admin > Identity > Role Mapping, where you'll create rules matching SAML group attributes to specific roles - I'm attaching our setup guide which covers attribute mapping syntax and examples for nested groups. On MFA, if your IdP enforces it during the SSO flow Northwind will honor that session and won't prompt again, but you can still require step-up MFA for sensitive admin actions independently. Happy to walk through your specific group structure on a call if useful.

subject: MFA enrollment prompt loops during API token setup
body: I'm integrating our checkout service with Northwind's API and hit an issue while setting up a service account that needs MFA enrollment. When I try to enroll via the /auth/mfa/enroll endpoint, the response comes back 200 but the account still shows mfa_enrolled: false on the next GET /auth/me call. This happens consistently across three test accounts I created today. Not blocking since we're still in staging, just want to flag it before we go live next month.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. This looks like an eventual-consistency delay between the enrollment write and the read replica used by /auth/me - it typically resolves within a few seconds, but if it's persisting longer for you we'd like to check. Could you send the account IDs and approximate timestamps for the three test accounts so we can trace them in our logs?

subject: PDF export missing chart data
body: When I export our quarterly usage dashboard to PDF, the exported file only shows the title and legend but the actual chart area is blank. This started happening after we updated our dashboard last week to add two new widgets. I've tried exporting from Chrome and Edge with the same result. Our team relies on these PDFs for a monthly compliance report due in five days, so I need this fixed or a workaround soon.
answer: Sorry for the disruption this is causing ahead of your report deadline. Blank chart areas in PDF export are usually tied to a rendering timeout when dashboards have more than a couple of complex widgets - could you tell me which two widget types you added? In the meantime, try increasing the export timeout under Dashboard Settings > Export Options, or use the 'Export as Image' option per widget as a workaround while we investigate.

subject: 429 everywhere
body:
GET /v2/pipelines/runs
HTTP 429 Too Many Requests
x-ratelimit-remaining: 0
x-ratelimit-reset: 1712345678
All endpoints down since 09:14 UTC, nothing works
answer: We're treating this as an active outage and have escalated to our platform team immediately. Can you confirm whether this started right after any recent change on your side, such as a new deployment or scheduled job burst, so we can correlate with our rate-limiter logs? We'll update you within the hour with root cause and mitigation.

subject: Bulk uploads failing across multiple teams
body: Since this morning around 8:30 AM our teams across three warehouses have been unable to upload files larger than 50MB to Storage - the upload progress bar reaches about 90% then fails with a generic 'upload could not be completed' message. This is affecting roughly 40 users and is blocking our daily manifest uploads which are time-sensitive for logistics operations. We haven't changed our retention or quota settings recently, and our storage usage is well under our allocated limit.
answer: Thank you for the clear writeup - this is impacting a core workflow so we're prioritizing it as high severity. We're seeing some correlated latency on our storage ingestion service starting around the same time and are actively investigating; in the meantime, could you have affected teams try splitting uploads into smaller batches under 25MB as a temporary workaround? We'll follow up shortly with root cause and an ETA for full resolution.

subject: Can we make MFA enrollment optional for one account?
body: One of our analysts is running automated reports through a service login and MFA enrollment is now being enforced on that account, which breaks the scheduled job since there's no way to approve a push notification programmatically. Is there a way to exempt specific service accounts from MFA while keeping it required for human logins? We only have six seats total so this is a small but important exception for us.
answer: That's a reasonable request and one we support - service accounts can be flagged as non-interactive under Admin > Identity > Accounts, which exempts them from MFA enrollment while keeping your human users covered under your org policy. I'll walk you through flagging that specific account, or if you'd prefer, send me the account identifier and I can apply it directly.

subject: Slack alerts not firing for pipeline failures
body: We set up the Slack integration to notify our #ops channel whenever a data pipeline run fails, and it worked fine for the first two weeks but has stopped sending any alerts since last Tuesday. The integration still shows as 'Connected' in our settings and other Slack messages like weekly summaries still come through fine. Could you check if something changed with the failure-event trigger specifically? We'd also love the option to route different severity levels to different channels if that's on the roadmap.
answer: Thanks for flagging this - it sounds isolated to the failure-event trigger rather than the whole integration, which helps narrow it down. Could you confirm the pipeline ID of a recent failed run that didn't alert, so we can check the event delivery logs? On multi-channel routing by severity, that's actually planned - I'll add your vote and keep you posted on timing.

subject: REFUND NEEDED NOW - overcharged again
body: this is the SECOND time this qtr we been billed for seats we dont even have anymore, we downgraded to 19 seats back in march and invoice #INV-88213 still shows charges for 27!! i asked about this last month and got nothign back. we need a credit ASAP or we are cancelling the whole account, this is rediculous for a starter plan thats supposed to be simple billing not this mess
answer: I completely understand the frustration, especially after not hearing back last time - I'm escalating this to our billing team right now with priority so we can get invoice #INV-88213 corrected. Can you confirm the exact date your seat count changed to 19 so we issue the right prorated credit, and I'll personally follow up within 24 hours with a resolution rather than leaving you waiting again.

subject: Role mapping breaks after SAML assertion update
body:
After updating our IdP's SAML assertion to include a new custom attribute for department, our role mapping stopped working entirely and all 268 users are now defaulting to the base Member role instead of their assigned roles. Here's the error from our SSO debug log:

SAMLResponse validation: OK
AttributeMapping: ERROR - unexpected attribute schema, expected 'roles[]' got 'roles' (string)
UserProvisioning: fallback to default role applied
Timestamp: 2024-06-11T14:02:17Z

This is blocking managers from accessing admin features company-wide. We need this fixed urgently since it's affecting permissions for our whole retail staff.
answer: Thank you for including the debug log - it points clearly to a schema mismatch: our mapper expects roles as an array but your updated IdP is now sending it as a single string, which is triggering the fallback. As an immediate fix, you can either revert the IdP attribute to array format or update the mapping rule under Admin > Identity > Role Mapping to accept string input with a delimiter; we're escalating this as P1 given the company-wide impact and will confirm once your mapping is verified working again.

subject: Webhook-Ereignisse werden nicht mehr zugestellt
body: Seit gestern Nachmittag erhalten wir keine Webhook-Benachrichtigungen mehr für unsere konfigurierten Endpunkte, obwohl der Status im Dashboard weiterhin als 'Aktiv' angezeigt wird. Betroffen sind vor allem die Events order.updated und media.processed, die für unsere Redaktionsabläufe kritisch sind. Zusätzlich haben wir gesehen, dass in der Doku ein Hinweis auf eine anstehende Deprecation der v1 Webhook-Signaturen steht - betrifft uns das hier möglicherweise schon jetzt? Wir brauchen dringend eine Lösung, da mehrere Redaktionsteams blockiert sind.
answer: Vielen Dank für die genaue Beschreibung - da mehrere Teams blockiert sind, stufen wir dies als P1 ein und prüfen sofort die Zustellungslogs für Ihre Endpunkte, insbesondere für order.updated und media.processed. Zur v1-Signatur-Deprecation: das laufende Problem scheint unabhängig davon zu sein, aber wir prüfen zur Sicherheit auch, ob Ihr Account bereits auf v2-Signaturen migriert wurde. Wir melden uns in Kürze mit einem konkreten Status.

subject: SCIM sync assigning wrong permission groups to new hires
body: Our SCIM integration with Okta started mapping new employees into the wrong permission groups starting September 3rd. We've confirmed 14 new hires this week landed in the 'Read Only' group instead of their department groups. The admin log shows repeated entries for SCIM_GROUP_MAP_MISMATCH. This is blocking people from accessing case files they need for client work today.
answer: Thanks for flagging this, and I understand the urgency given the access impact. Could you send us your tenant ID and a couple of the affected user emails so our identity team can trace the group mapping logic? We're treating this as P1 and will have an update for you within a few hours while we investigate the SCIM_GROUP_MAP_MISMATCH errors.

subject: Webhook delivery delays and v1 deprecation questions
body: We've noticed webhook events to our /webhooks/subscribe endpoint arriving 10-15 minutes late over the past three days, and we're occasionally getting 429 responses when retrying failed deliveries. Separately, we got a deprecation notice on August 20th about the v1 events endpoint but no clear migration timeline. Can you clarify both issues since they're affecting our order-status automation?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. The delivery delays line up with elevated load on our webhook dispatch service that our engineers are currently tuning, and I'll follow up once we've confirmed a fix. On the v1 deprecation, I'll get you the migration guide and sunset date so you can plan the SDK update without disruption.

subject: Feature request: enforce MFA enrollment during SCIM provisioning
body: Right now when SCIM creates a new user account, they can log in immediately without ever being prompted to set up MFA, which is a compliance gap for our 255-seat deployment. We'd like an option to auto-send an MFA enrollment link at account creation, or better, block first login until MFA is configured. The current documentation doesn't cover this scenario at all.
answer: This is a great catch and a valid gap in our current provisioning flow. I'm logging this as a feature request with our identity team and marking it high priority given the compliance implications you've described. In the meantime, I can share a workaround using a conditional access policy that blocks unenrolled logins until MFA is set up.

subject: Need IP allowlist updated before Friday's compliance audit
body: We need to add a new office IP range to our admin console allowlist ahead of a compliance audit this Friday. Our audit log is showing several blocked login attempts from the new location since Monday, and our team can't get in from there yet. Can someone escalate this so it's applied today rather than waiting for the next batch update?
answer: Understood, we'll treat this as urgent given the audit deadline. Please send over the specific CIDR range you need added and I'll escalate directly to our security team for same-day processing. I'll confirm here once the allowlist update is live and the blocked attempts stop appearing in your audit log.

subject: All users being logged out every 5 minutes since this morning
body: Since around 9am today, every user across all 80 seats is being logged out of SSO roughly every 5 minutes and forced to re-authenticate, including a repeated MFA prompt each time. This started right after we noticed a session policy update in the admin console last night. It's severely disrupting clinical staff workflows right now.
answer: This is impacting your whole organization so we're escalating immediately as P1.
