Can you confirm which SSO provider you're using and whether anyone changed the session timeout setting in the admin console recently? We're pulling the session configuration logs now and will update you within the hour with findings.

subject: App crashes right after splash screen on iPhone
body: The mobile app crashes consistently right after the splash screen on my iPhone 13 running iOS 17.4, app version 5.2.1. It happens every time I try to log in, even after reinstalling. Not urgent since I can still use the desktop dashboard, but wanted to flag it since a few colleagues mentioned the same issue.
answer: Thanks for the details, that's helpful for narrowing this down. Could you send us the crash log from your device if you have one, or try logging in on a different iOS device to see if it reproduces? I'll pass this along to our mobile team as a known issue on iOS 17.4 with app version 5.2.1.

subject: URGENT: billing data pipeline 6 hours late, breaching SLA
body: Our billing dataset pipeline (pipe-8842) is running over 6 hours behind schedule as of this morning, which breaches our reporting SLA and has already caused incorrect figures to reach our finance dashboards. This needs immediate attention since our month-end close depends on this data being accurate and on time.
answer: We're escalating this immediately as a P0 incident. Our data pipeline team is investigating pipe-8842 right now and I'll set up a bridge line so we can share live updates with you while we identify the cause of the delay. We'll also confirm which downstream reports need to be corrected once the pipeline catches up.

subject: OAuth token refresh failing on Salesforce connector
body: Our Salesforce connector in Data Pipelines keeps failing with an 'invalid_grant' error roughly every 2 hours when it tries to refresh the OAuth token. This has broken 3 of our pipelines since last night and data hasn't synced since. Connector ID is conn-30217 if that helps track it down.
answer: Thanks for including the connector ID, that will speed things up. We're looking into the token refresh service now since 'invalid_grant' errors at that frequency suggest a token lifecycle issue on our end rather than your credentials. I'll update you shortly with either a fix or a temporary manual token workaround to get your 3 pipelines syncing again.

subject: Webhook-Zustellung verzögert und Deprecation-Hinweis erhalten
body: Seit einigen Tagen kommen unsere Webhook-Events mit deutlicher Verzögerung an, teilweise über 10 Minuten, und wir bekommen gelegentlich 429-Fehler beim erneuten Versuch. Zusätzlich haben wir eine Deprecation-Warnung für die v1 Events-Schnittstelle erhalten, aber keine klaren Informationen zur Migration. Können Sie uns sagen, ob es einen aktuellen SDK-Release gibt, der das v2 Format unterstützt?
answer: Danke für die ausführliche Beschreibung. Die Verzögerungen bei den Webhooks stehen im Zusammenhang mit erhöhter Last auf unserem Zustelldienst, an der unser Team aktuell arbeitet. Zur v1-Deprecation senden wir Ihnen den Migrationsleitfaden inklusive Enddatum sowie einen Link zum aktuellen SDK, das das v2-Format unterstützt.

subject: Dashboards laden sehr langsam bei großen Datensätzen
body: Unsere Dashboards benötigen aktuell über 30 Sekunden zum Laden, insbesondere beim Export von Charts mit größeren Datensätzen. Das betrifft mehrere Teams in unserer Enterprise-Umgebung mit 1558 Nutzern und wirkt sich zunehmend auf unsere täglichen Reports aus. Können Sie das Problem eskalieren und uns eine Einschätzung zur Ursache geben?
answer: Vielen Dank für den Hinweis, wir nehmen das ernst angesichts der Größe Ihrer Umgebung. Ich eskaliere den Fall an unser Dashboard-Team, damit die Ladezeiten bei großen Datensätzen und Chart-Exporten genauer analysiert werden. Wir melden uns zeitnah mit ersten Ergebnissen und möglichen Sofortmaßnahmen zur Verbesserung der Performance.

subject: Webhook event types deprecated in v3 API - migration guidance needed
body:
I'm integrating our reconciliation service with the Northwind API Platform and noticed the changelog mentions payment.updated and payment.settled webhook events are being deprecated in favor of payment.status_changed starting with API v3. We have several listeners keyed on the old event names in production.

Could you point me to migration documentation or an SDK version that supports both event schemas during a transition period? We're currently on webhook-sdk 2.4.1 and want to avoid breaking changes when v3 becomes mandatory.
answer: Thanks for flagging this ahead of time. The migration guide for the payment.* webhook consolidation is at docs.northwind.cloud/api/webhooks/migration-v3, and SDK versions 2.5.0 and above support dual-dispatch so you'll receive both the legacy and new event names until the sunset date on the old schema. I'd recommend upgrading to 2.5.x now and adding handling for payment.status_changed alongside your existing listeners so the cutover is a no-op when v3 becomes mandatory.

subject: SCIM provisioning completely broken, new hires cannot get access
body:
As of this morning our SCIM sync from our identity provider to Northwind stopped provisioning new users entirely. We onboarded 4 new analysts today and none of them received accounts despite the SCIM connector showing 'sync successful' in our IdP logs. Existing users are unaffected but nobody new can log in.

This is blocking our entire onboarding for the day and we have compliance deadlines tied to access reviews. Can someone look into this urgently - our tenant ID is apex-freight-prod.
answer: This is now our top priority and we're treating it as a full outage on our end - engineering is actively investigating the SCIM provisioning pipeline for tenant apex-freight-prod right now. Initial logs show a queue backlog affecting new user creation events specifically, and we'll have an update within 30 minutes with either a fix or a manual provisioning workaround for your 4 pending analysts so onboarding isn't blocked further.

subject: SDK throwing rate limit errors on every request after update
body:
We updated to northwind-sdk-python 4.2.0 last week and now every single call to the bookings endpoint returns a 429 even though we're nowhere near our documented rate limit. Our request volume is around 40 calls/minute, well under the 300/min limit for our plan.

The error body says 'rate_limit_exceeded: retry_after=60' but retrying after 60 seconds just triggers the same error again. This is affecting our nightly reporting job which processes booking data for all our travel partners and it's now failed three nights in a row.
answer: Thank you for the detailed report - a rate limit miscalculation was introduced in SDK 4.2.0 where burst detection incorrectly flags sequential pagination calls as exceeding the limit, even at low overall volume. We're pushing a hotfix as 4.2.1 today. In the meantime, please downgrade to 4.1.3 which doesn't have this regression, and that should immediately unblock your nightly reporting job.

subject: Deactivated users still showing as active in audit log
body:
I deactivated three former contractors in the Admin Console last Tuesday (March 4th) but when I pull the audit log to prepare for our quarterly access review, all three still show a status of 'active' even though they can no longer log in. This is causing confusion for our compliance team who rely on the audit log as the source of truth.

Is this a known display bug, or is there a separate step needed to sync deactivation status into the audit trail? We'd also like a way to bulk-deactivate users in future since we do this in batches each quarter.
answer: This looks like a display lag bug in the audit log rather than an access issue - the deactivation itself is enforced correctly, but the audit trail isn't picking up the status change event for another 24-48 hours in some cases. I've flagged this to engineering for a proper fix. On the bulk-deactivation request, that's not currently available but I'm logging it as a feature request and will update you if it gets scheduled.

subject: Late-arriving records from freight connector causing sync gaps
body:
We run a nightly sync from our freight tracking system through the Data Pipelines connector, and for the past two weeks we've noticed records with timestamps from 6-10 hours earlier than expected arriving after the pipeline has already closed the batch window. This causes those shipment updates to be dropped or picked up a full day late in our downstream dashboard.

Is there a way to configure a grace period or late-arrival window on the connector so these records get included in the correct batch instead of the next one? Our current sync window is set to close 15 minutes after midnight UTC.
answer: Good catch - the freight connector does support a configurable late-arrival buffer, it's just not enabled by default. Under Pipeline Settings > Sync Window you can set a 'grace period' of up to 4 hours, which would catch records arriving 6-10 hours late if we also shift your batch close time later. I'd suggest setting the grace period to 4 hours and moving your window close to 04:00 UTC as a starting point, and we can tune further based on your next week of sync logs.

subject: Zapier integration slow to trigger on new transactions
body:
We use the Zapier connector to push new transaction records from Northwind into our Slack channel for the finance team, and lately the notifications are arriving 10-15 minutes after the transaction actually posts. It's not urgent since we mainly use it for visibility, but it used to be near-instant a few weeks ago.

Just wanted to flag this in case there's a known performance issue on the Zapier trigger side. Not blocking anything critical for us right now.
answer: Thanks for the heads up, this is helpful feedback. We've seen a few reports of increased latency on the Zapier trigger polling interval and our integrations team is looking into whether this is on Zapier's side or ours. Since this isn't urgent for you, I'll follow up once we have a root cause, but in the meantime you could switch to a webhook-based Slack notification for near-instant delivery if that works better for your finance team.

subject: Invoice missing seat count breakdown, need itemized version urgently
body:
Our finance team is closing out Q1 books and the invoice we received for this billing cycle (INV-88213) just shows a single line total with no breakdown of seats or per-user charges. We have 257 seats across three departments and need to allocate costs internally, which we can't do without an itemized invoice.

Can you send a corrected invoice with a seat-level or department-level breakdown? This needs to happen before our books close on the 15th, so it's fairly time-sensitive for us.
answer: I understand the urgency given your close date - I'm escalating this to our billing team right now to generate a corrected itemized invoice for INV-88213 with the seat-level breakdown for your 257 seats. We'll aim to have this to you within 24 hours, well ahead of the 15th, and I'll also flag this as feedback since itemized breakdowns should ideally be included by default on invoices at your seat count.

subject: Cannot restore deleted files from backup - restore job stuck
body:
Yesterday one of our staff accidentally deleted a folder containing student enrollment records from our Storage bucket. I started a restore job from the backup dated two days prior (job ID rst-3391) but it's been showing 'in progress' for over 14 hours now with no completion. Normally these restores complete within an hour based on our past experience.

We need these files back today - our registrar's office is blocked from processing new enrollments without them. Please advise on the status of job rst-3391 or an alternative way to get these files restored quickly.
answer: I've escalated this immediately given the impact on your registrar's office. Restore job rst-3391 does appear to be stuck rather than legitimately processing - our storage team is manually inspecting the backup snapshot now and will either unblock the stuck job or trigger a fresh restore from the same snapshot within the next hour. I'll update you as soon as we have file-level confirmation the enrollment records are recovered.

subject: Question about configuring sync frequency for connector
body:
We're setting up our first scheduled sync in Data Pipelines to pull booking data from our travel partner API, and I want to understand our options before we commit to a schedule. Right now it looks like the minimum interval is hourly - is there any way to get a 15 or 30 minute interval on the Starter plan, or is hourly the floor regardless of plan?

Also curious if there's documentation on how the connector handles schema changes on the source side, since our partner occasionally adds new fields to their booking payload.
answer: On Starter, hourly is currently the minimum sync interval - 15 and 30 minute intervals are available starting on our Pro plan, so that would be the path if you need tighter freshness. For schema changes, the connector auto-detects new fields on the source side and adds them as nullable columns in your destination schema by default, without failing the sync; our docs page on 'Schema Drift Handling' under Data Pipelines walks through the specifics and configuration options.

subject: Charged for 12 seats but we only have 4 employees
body:
I just reviewed our latest billing statement and we were charged for 12 seats this cycle, but we only have 4 employees using Northwind Systems and have never had more than 4 active users on our account. This is a significant overcharge for a company our size and I need this corrected before the payment processes on the 10th.

Can you check our account and confirm the actual active seat count, and issue a credit or adjustment for the difference? This needs to be resolved before the payment date.
answer: I'm looking into your account right now given the payment date is close. Our records show 4 active users as well, so this looks like a seat-count sync error on the billing side rather than an actual usage discrepancy. I'll get a corrected charge for 4 seats processed before the 10th and issue a credit for the difference on this cycle - I'll confirm back here once that's completed.

subject: How do I link Northwind Integrations to Jira?
body: I'm setting up the Jira integration for our Orion Robotics workspace and I can't find where to authorize the connection. The Integrations page shows Slack, Salesforce, and Okta tiles but no Jira option under Available Integrations. We're on the Starter plan with 6 seats, so I want to confirm this isn't a plan limitation before I keep digging.
answer: Thanks for reaching out. Jira integration is available on all plans including Starter, but it's sometimes hidden if the workspace admin role hasn't enabled it under Settings > Integrations > Manage Available Apps. Could you check that toggle, or let me know your workspace ID so I can verify from our side and enable it if needed?

subject: SCIM provisioning failing for new hires
body: We use SCIM through our IdP to provision users into Northwind for Granite Labs, and since Monday new employees added in the IdP aren't showing up in Northwind's user list. The SCIM logs on our IdP side show a 200 response but nothing appears on our end within an hour. This is affecting at least 12 new hires who need SSO and MFA access today.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. A 200 on the IdP side with no matching user in Northwind usually points to a mapping mismatch on the externalId or a queued job that's stalled on our end. I'm escalating this to our provisioning team now and will pull the SCIM ingestion logs for your tenant to confirm where the records are getting dropped — I'll update you within a few hours.

subject: Scheduled data pipeline syncs completely down
body: Our scheduled syncs for Orion Media stopped running as of 2:15 AM this morning and none of our downstream billing reports have refreshed since. We rely on these syncs to reconcile claims data every 4 hours and finance is now blocked from closing the month. I checked the audit log and see the change was made at 3:14pm but the entry doesn't show which IP ranges were removed, only that 'settings updated' occurred. We need to restore access for these two users and would also like documentation on how audit log entries capture field-level changes going forward.

We're also passing along your feedback about audit log detail; field-level diffs for settings changes are on our roadmap, and in the meantime we can send you a walkthrough doc on how to configure allowlist changes more safely.

subject: Question about session timeout configuration for SSO users
body: We're setting up SSO for our legal team and want to confirm how session timeout interacts with our MFA policy. Currently users are being prompted to re-authenticate every 30 minutes even though we configured a 4-hour session in the SSO settings panel. Documentation mentions MFA re-prompt intervals but it's unclear if that overrides the session timeout setting. Could you clarify the expected behavior and point me to any docs on this?
answer: Good question - the 30-minute prompt you're seeing is likely coming from the MFA re-authentication policy, which is a separate control from session timeout and can override it for sensitive actions by default. I'll send over our doc on configuring MFA re-prompt intervals alongside session duration so you can align both to the 4-hour window you want for your legal team.

subject: How to work within API rate limits for batch invoice exports
body: Our finance team runs a monthly batch job pulling invoice data through the API for about 255 users worth of billing records. Last export on the 1st hit rate limit errors (429) after roughly 500 requests in under a minute, which stalled our reconciliation process for several hours. Is there a recommended batching pattern or SDK helper for pacing requests to avoid this, given our Pro plan limits?
answer: For Pro plan accounts the default limit is 300 req/min, so 500 requests in under a minute will trigger 429s as you saw. Our Python and Node SDKs include a built-in rate limiter you can enable with `client.enable_throttling()`, which paces requests automatically and queues excess calls instead of failing - that should let your monthly batch job complete without manual backoff logic.

subject: Need to restore storage bucket from backup after failed migration script

We need to restore the bucket to its state as of last night's backup (approx 11:00 PM UTC on the 22nd). To avoid overwriting current data during restore, we recommend restoring to a new bucket first for verification - we're starting that process now and will share access details along with an estimated completion time shortly.

subject: Questions about upcoming API v1 deprecation
body: We received a notice that API v1 endpoints will be deprecated for Blue Media in the coming months, and I want to make sure our integration is ready before that happens. Could you confirm which SDK version supports the v2 webhook payload format, and whether our existing webhook subscriptions will need to be recreated or if they migrate automatically? Any migration guide would be helpful since we only have one developer managing this.
answer: Good timing to ask—SDK versions 3.4 and above support the v2 webhook payload format, and unfortunately existing webhook subscriptions will need to be recreated under v2 since the signing scheme changes. I'll send over our migration guide which walks through updating endpoints and webhook registration step by step, and happy to jump on a call if it would help your developer plan the cutover.

subject: Urgent: need to restore deleted files from backup
body: One of our engineers accidentally deleted a batch of product image files from our Storage bucket at Ember Labs this morning around 9:15am, roughly 1,200 files under the /catalog/2024 path. I need to restore these from backup as soon as possible since our storefront is showing broken images. Can you confirm our retention window covers this and walk me through triggering a restore, or do it on your end if that's faster?
answer: This is treated as urgent given the customer-facing impact. Our retention policy on your plan covers snapshots going back 30 days, so the files from this morning should be recoverable. I'm initiating a restore for the /catalog/2024 path from the most recent snapshot now and will confirm once it completes, likely within the next 30 minutes—please avoid further writes to that path until you hear back from us.

subject: Salesforce sync completely stopped updating records
body: Our Salesforce integration for Orion Partners stopped syncing account records around 3am today. New leads created in Salesforce aren't appearing in Northwind, and updates to existing accounts aren't reflecting either. The integration status page shows it as 'connected' but the last successful sync timestamp is stuck at 03:02 UTC. This is affecting our entire operations team across 246 seats since we rely on this sync for daily reporting.
answer: This has been escalated to our integrations team immediately given the full sync outage. We're seeing an authentication token refresh failure on our end that's likely causing the stall—we're pushing a fix now and will re-trigger a full sync once resolved. I'll update you within the hour with confirmation that records are flowing again and a summary of what caused the stuck timestamp.

subject: RATE LIMITS ARE RUINING OUR INTEGRATION
body: We keep getting hit with 429 errors on the API even though were nowhere near what I thought our limit was. This has happend three times this week and its breaking our webhook retries completly. Nobody told us the rate limit changed after the last deprecation notice and now our SDK calls are just failing randomly. If this isnt fixed soon were going to cancel and move to a different vendor, this is unacceptable for a paid plan.
answer: I understand the frustration, especially with repeated failures affecting your integration—let's get this sorted quickly. The recent deprecation did lower the default rate limit tier for Starter plans, which wasn't communicated as clearly as it should have been, and I apologize for that. I'm reviewing your account's current limits now and will follow up today with either a temporary limit increase or SDK retry configuration guidance to stop the 429 errors from cascading.

subject: charts broken
body: chart on main dashbord not loading, jsut blank space, pls help asap
answer: Thanks for the quick heads-up—sorry about the disruption. Could you let me know which dashboard and chart type this is (bar, line, etc.) so I can check if it's a rendering issue or a data source problem? In the meantime, try refreshing the browser cache or opening the dashboard in an incognito window, as that resolves blank chart issues in some cases.

subject: Requesting storage quota increase and retention review
body: We're consistently hitting around 92% of our Storage quota at Vertex Energy and would like to request an increase before we start seeing upload failures. Separately, I noticed our backup retention is set to 14 days but I recall requesting 30 days when we upgraded to Pro—could you confirm the current retention setting and adjust if needed? No urgent issue, just want to get ahead of it before quarter-end reporting.
answer: Thanks for getting ahead of this—I've bumped your storage quota up by 25% effective immediately, which should give you comfortable headroom for quarter-end. I also checked your account and confirmed retention is currently set to 14 days rather than 30; I've corrected that to match your Pro plan entitlement, so backups going forward will be retained for the full 30-day window.

subject: Mobile app not working properly offline
body: Our field technicians at Lumen Systems use the Mobile App in areas with poor connectivity, and we've noticed the app crashes when switching from offline to online mode, usually right after login. Push notifications that should have been queued while offline also don't seem to arrive once the device reconnects. Could you clarify how offline mode is supposed to handle this transition, or point me to documentation on expected behavior?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report—offline mode is designed to queue actions locally and sync on reconnect, but the crash-on-reconnect behavior you're describing sounds like a bug rather than expected limitation. I'll send over our current offline mode documentation for reference, and could you share the app version and device OS your technicians are using so we can try to reproduce the crash and the missing push notifications?

subject: Data Pipeline sync running 3+ hours behind schedule
body:
Since yesterday around 14:00 UTC our Salesforce-to-warehouse connector (pipeline id gw-sf-prod-01) has been falling further behind. Current lag is at 3h42m and growing. We depend on this data for our overnight production scheduling reports that go out at 06:00 local time, and manufacturing floor supervisors are already asking why yesterday's numbers look stale.

We haven't changed any connector config or credentials recently. The pipeline shows status 'running' but the last successful watermark is stuck at 2024-06-11T14:03:00Z. Can someone check the connector health on your end? With 242 seats depending on these dashboards this is becoming urgent.
answer:
Thanks for flagging this, and I understand the urgency given how many teams depend on that data. We're pulling up the health metrics for gw-sf-prod-01 now and can already see elevated queue depth on the Salesforce connector cluster starting around the time you mentioned - this looks like a backend throughput issue on our side rather than anything in your config.

We're escalating this to our data pipeline on-call engineer immediately and will post an update within the hour with either a fix or a clearer ETA on catch-up. I'll keep this ticket updated as we work through the backlog.

subject: Duplicate emails in weekly digest notifications
body:
Our team started receiving the weekly notification digest twice on Monday, once around 8:03am and again at 8:17am, both with identical content and the same date range covered. This has happened for the last two weekly cycles now. We only have digests configured for the 'account activity' category under Notifications settings, nothing else is enabled that I can see.

Can you check if there's a known issue with the digest scheduler sending duplicate batches? It's confusing our team members who think something changed twice.
answer:
Thanks for the detailed timestamps, that helps a lot. We've seen a similar report where the digest scheduler can occasionally fire a retry job if the first send takes longer than expected to acknowledge, resulting in a near-duplicate send within minutes. We're checking your workspace's digest job logs for Monday to confirm that's what happened here.

In the meantime, there's no action needed on your end - your configuration looks correct. We'll follow up once we confirm the root cause and let you know if a fix has been deployed or if we need to adjust anything on our side.

subject: Requesting scoped/read-only API key support ahead of legacy key deprecation
body:
We saw the notice that legacy-format API keys will be deprecated on 2024-09-30, and we're planning our migration across roughly 1,558 seats. Before we roll out new keys broadly, we'd like to request that the new key format support read-only scopes, since right now every key we generate has full read/write access to billing and identity endpoints, which is a bigger blast radius than we want for our reporting service accounts.

Is scoped key generation on the roadmap, and if so what's the expected timeline? We need to plan our internal rollout around it and would appreciate any documentation you can share on the new key format in the meantime.
answer:
Thank you for raising this ahead of the deprecation date, and for the specific use case - scoped, read-only keys are indeed something we're actively building. I don't have a committed release date to share yet, but our platform team has this flagged as a priority given the upcoming legacy key sunset, and I'll pass your feedback along directly with your workspace as a reference case.

In the meantime, I'll send over the current documentation for the new key format so your team can start planning the migration for existing keys, and I'd recommend generating scoped keys manually via IP allowlisting as a partial mitigation until scope support ships.

subject: Unsubscribed users still receiving duplicate alert emails
body:
We're seeing an issue where several users who clicked 'unsubscribe' on our alerting emails last week are still getting duplicate copies of the same notification. I checked one specific case - user account with email ending in @pioneerhealth.com unsubscribed on June 8th, but received two identical 'payment failed' alerts on June 10th at 09:14 and 09:14 (same minute, same content).

The unsubscribe confirmation page did show success at the time. Is there a delay in propagating unsubscribe status to the alerting queue, or is this a bug in how duplicates get filtered? This is affecting trust in our alerts among our support staff.
answer:
Thanks for the specific timestamps and account detail, that's very helpful for tracing this. Duplicate sends at the exact same minute suggest the notification may have been queued twice before the unsubscribe status was applied, which points to a propagation delay in our suppression list sync rather than the unsubscribe action failing outright.

We're going to trace this specific alert event through our notification queue to confirm timing, and will also check whether other unsubscribed accounts in your workspace were similarly affected. I'll update you within a day with findings and whether a fix is needed on the suppression sync side.

subject: Biometric login not working after phone update
body: I updated my phone last week and now when I open the Northwind mobile app it asks me to log in with biometrics but just spins and then drops back to the password screen. Password login works fine, it's just Face ID that fails every time. I've tried turning biometric login off and back on in the app settings but it didn't help.
answer:
Thanks for letting us know, and glad password login is still working as a fallback in the meantime. This is usually caused by the biometric key pairing getting invalidated during a phone OS update, which the app doesn't always detect cleanly - could you try fully logging out and back in with your password once, then re-enabling Face ID from Settings > Security within the app? That typically re-establishes the pairing.

If Face ID still fails to save after that, let us know and we'll dig into your account's device registration logs to see what's happening.

subject: Requesting increase to storage retention/quota for compliance backups
body:
We're integrating with the Storage API to archive signed case documents for compliance purposes, and we're currently hitting our quota faster than expected. Our workspace is on the default retention tier and we're storing roughly 40GB/month of backups that legally need to be retained for 7 years per our industry regulations.

Could you let us know what the process is to request a retention policy change and an increased quota, and whether there's documentation on how quota is calculated when older backups roll off versus new ones being added? We want to make sure our compliance backups aren't at risk of being purged early.
answer:
Thanks for reaching out with the specifics on your retention needs. Quota increases and custom retention policies for compliance archiving are something we handle case by case with our Security and Compliance team, and 7-year retention is a common requirement we support for regulated industries like legal.

I'll send over our documentation on how quota is calculated (it's based on active storage at any point in time, not cumulative uploads, so older backups rolling off does free up space), and I'm looping in a compliance specialist to discuss the specific quota increase and retention tier upgrade for your workspace.

subject: Charts rendering broken/blank on several dashboard widgets
body:
We've had multiple support engineers report that certain chart widgets on our 'Course Engagement' dashboard render blank or show a broken image icon instead of the actual chart, starting sometime after yesterday's dashboard refresh. It's specifically the bar chart and stacked area chart widget types - line charts and tables on the same dashboard render fine.

Refreshing the page or clearing cache doesn't help. We also tried exporting one of the broken charts to PDF and the export came out blank too, which is a problem since our academic advisors rely on these exports weekly. Can you take a look?
answer:
Thanks for the clear breakdown of which chart types are affected - that narrows things down a lot. It sounds like it could be an issue with the rendering engine for bar/stacked area chart types specifically, possibly tied to a recent update, since line charts and tables going through a different render path would explain why those still work.

We're going to reproduce this on a test dashboard with the same widget types and check recent deployment logs for anything affecting chart rendering. I'll follow up with either a fix or a workaround for the PDF exports as soon as we've confirmed the cause.

subject: Alert routing sending duplicate emails to wrong team distribution list
body:
We're integrating the Notifications API to route infrastructure alerts to different team email distribution lists based on severity tag. Right now, 'critical' tagged alerts are correctly routing to our on-call list, but we're also seeing duplicates of those same critical alerts landing in our 'info' tier distribution list, which shouldn't be receiving them at all based on our routing rules config.

We checked our routing rule JSON and the 'info' list is only subscribed to alerts tagged 'info' or 'warning', not 'critical'. This is causing alert fatigue for the info-tier team who are getting paged for things that aren't theirs. Can you check if there's a bug in how tag-based routing rules are being evaluated?
answer:
Thanks for including your routing rule setup, that's exactly what we need to investigate. A critical-tagged alert landing on a list scoped to info/warning only suggests the routing evaluator might be matching on a broader condition than intended, possibly a fallback rule or overlapping tag inheritance we need to check on our end.

Since this is actively causing unnecessary paging for your info-tier team, we're treating this as high priority and pulling the routing evaluation logs for your workspace now. We'll follow up shortly with either a fix or a temporary workaround for your rule config to stop the duplicate sends while we investigate further.

subject: Cannot deactivate a workspace member due to allowlist setting conflict
body:
I'm trying to deactivate a former contractor's account in our Admin Console workspace settings, but every time I click 'Deactivate' I get an error saying 'User is protected by domain allowlist policy' even though this user's domain isn't listed anywhere in our allowlist configuration under Settings > Security. We only have 4 seats total so this should be simple, but I can't get past this error.

I've checked the allowlist entries twice and there's nothing referencing this user's email domain. Is this a bug in how the allowlist check is being applied, or is there some other setting I'm missing that's blocking deactivation?
answer:
Thanks for checking the allowlist entries already, that rules out the most obvious cause. This error can sometimes trigger if the user's account was originally provisioned via SSO with a domain-matching rule that's cached separately from the visible allowlist settings, which would explain why you don't see a matching entry directly.

Could you send us the account's user ID or the exact email domain in question? We'll check the backend provisioning record for that user and clear the stale allowlist flag if that's what's blocking the deactivation.

subject: Need guidance on new rate limit tiers and webhook retry behavior
body:
We got the notice about upcoming changes to API rate limits and want to make sure our integration doesn't break. Currently we're calling the /v2/shipments endpoint roughly 40 times per minute across our integration, and we use webhooks for status updates rather than polling everywhere. The deprecation notice mentioned the old rate limit headers (X-RateLimit-*) are going away in favor of a new format, but I couldn't find SDK documentation on how to parse the new headers.

Could you clarify what the new rate limit thresholds will be for our tier, whether our current call volume is safe, and point us to updated SDK docs or examples for handling the new header format and any changes to webhook retry/backoff behavior?
answer:
Thanks for reaching out proactively on this - with your current call volume of ~40 requests/minute on /v2/shipments, you should be comfortably within the new tier limits, but I'll get you the exact numbers for your plan to confirm. The new rate limit headers use a structured format (X-RateLimit-Policy) that our SDK v3 already parses automatically, so if you're on an older SDK version we'd recommend upgrading as part of this transition.

I'll send over the updated SDK documentation and a migration guide covering both the header format change and the revised webhook retry/backoff intervals, since those are shifting slightly as part of this rollout. Given this affects your integration's stability, we're prioritizing getting you these resources today.

subject: Feature request: SSO-based MFA enforcement per group
body:
We're using SAML SSO for Willow Legal's 265 seats and would like to enforce MFA at the identity provider level for specific groups rather than globally. Right now it looks like MFA settings in Northwind apply uniformly across all SSO-provisioned users. Could this be added as a per-group policy option tied to our SAML attribute mapping?

This isn't urgent, but it would help us roll out stricter controls to our finance team first before expanding company-wide.
answer: Thanks for the detailed suggestion. Per-group MFA enforcement tied to SAML attributes isn't currently supported, but I've logged this as a feature request with our identity product team and linked it to your account. I'll follow up here once there's a roadmap update or workaround using group-based SAML attribute mapping in the interim.

subject: How to set custom retention period for uploaded files
body:
We're on the Starter plan with 14 seats and need to configure retention policies for files uploaded to Storage. Our compliance team requires that media assets older than 90 days be automatically archived, but I can't find a retention setting in the admin console beyond the default 30-day window.

Can you point me to how to change this, or confirm if it's only available on higher tiers? We also want to make sure backups follow the same retention schedule.
answer: Good question — custom retention windows beyond the default 30 days are available starting on our Pro plan, so Starter accounts are currently capped at that setting. I can share documentation on how retention and backup policies interact once you're on a plan that supports custom windows, and I'm happy to loop in an account manager if you'd like to discuss an upgrade path for compliance purposes.

subject: Connector-Authentifizierung schlägt für Cobalt Foods Pipeline fehl
body:
Seit dem 6. März erhalten wir bei unserem Salesforce-Connector innerhalb der Data Pipelines wiederholt den Fehler 'AUTH_TOKEN_EXPIRED' bei jedem geplanten Sync. Die OAuth-Verbindung wurde vor drei Wochen erneuert und sollte laut Dashboard noch 60 Tage gültig sein.

Betroffen sind alle 12 Sync-Jobs unseres Teams, wodurch unsere täglichen Reports seit vier Tagen nicht mehr aktualisiert wurden. Wir brauchen dringend Unterstützung, da dies unsere Analysten bei der Reisedaten-Auswertung blockiert.
answer: Vielen Dank für die genaue Fehlerbeschreibung. Ein Token-Fehler trotz gültiger OAuth-Verbindung deutet auf ein Problem mit der Connector-Konfiguration oder einem Scope-Wechsel bei Salesforce hin — wir eskalieren dies sofort an unser Pipeline-Team, da mehrere Sync-Jobs betroffen sind. Wir melden uns innerhalb der nächsten Stunde mit einer Analyse der Token-Erneuerungslogs.

subject: SAML login failing for provisioned users after IdP update
body:
Since yesterday afternoon, about 30 of our finance staff at Ember Freight can't log in via SAML SSO — they get redirected back to the login page with 'Assertion validation failed' after entering credentials on our IdP side. We updated our IdP certificate on Tuesday and I suspect the metadata isn't syncing correctly with Northwind.

This is blocking access to billing approvals for our team, and MFA-enrolled users seem to be affected too. Can someone check our SAML metadata configuration?
answer: Thank you for flagging this — a certificate rotation on the IdP side is a common cause of assertion validation failures if the updated metadata wasn't re-uploaded to Northwind. I'd like to verify your current SAML metadata file against what's on file for your tenant; could you confirm the exact timestamp of the certificate change so we can cross-check the logs? In the meantime, I'll prioritize this given the number of affected users.

subject: Request to change how plan upgrade proration is displayed
body:
When our team upgraded from Pro to a higher tier last month, the invoice showed a proration credit but didn't break down which days were credited versus charged at the new rate. As a product manager reviewing this for internal budgeting, I'd like to request clearer line-item detail on upgrade invoices going forward.

This isn't blocking anything right now, just feedback on making billing changes easier to reconcile against our internal cost tracking for Pioneer Health.
answer: Thanks for the feedback — this is a great point, and better proration breakdowns on upgrade invoices is something we've heard from other customers too. I've added your request to our billing team's backlog for invoice formatting improvements. In the meantime, I can pull a detailed proration breakdown for your last upgrade manually if that helps with your reconciliation.

subject: URGENT: MFA enrollment broken, users locked out company-wide
body:
Starting this morning, none of our 8 users at Summit Energy can complete MFA enrollment during SSO login — the enrollment screen loads but clicking 'Verify' returns a generic 'Something went wrong' message and kicks users back to the start. This is affecting every single account, including admins, so nobody can access dashboards or notifications right now.

We need this fixed urgently as our whole team is locked out of Northwind during business hours.
answer: I understand this is blocking your entire team and we're treating it as urgent. We're checking our MFA enrollment service for errors right now — can you confirm whether this started after any recent browser update or if it's happening across all devices and browsers? I'll update you as soon as we identify the cause, and will provide a temporary bypass option for admins if needed while we investigate.

subject: Getting duplicate email alerts for same events
body:
Our team at Orion Analytics has been receiving 2-3 duplicate email notifications for the same pipeline completion events over the past week. For example, on March 11th I got three identical emails about job #4471 finishing, all within two minutes of each other. This is cluttering our inbox and making it hard to tell which alerts are new.

Can you check if there's a bug in the notification deduplication logic? We only have 10 seats but this is happening for every analyst on the team.
answer: Thanks for the specific example — job #4471 and the timing you provided will help us trace this. Duplicate alerts like this are usually caused by a retry mechanism firing multiple notification events for the same trigger, and we're looking into whether that's affecting your account specifically. I'll update you once we've confirmed the root cause and can give you a timeline for a fix.

subject: Request: biometric login support for offline mode in mobile app
body:
Several of our field managers at Granite Works have asked whether the Northwind mobile app can support biometric login (Face ID/fingerprint) when the device is offline, since they often work in areas with poor connectivity on our manufacturing floor. Currently it seems biometric auth requires an active connection to validate the session.

Could this be added as a feature? We have 242 seats and offline access is becoming a common request from our operations team.
answer: Thanks for the detailed use case — offline biometric login is a feature request we've received from a few manufacturing and field-service customers, so I've logged this with our mobile product team and tagged your account for updates. In the meantime, I can share our current documentation on offline mode limitations so your team knows what to expect until this ships.

subject: Need to change alert settings to stop duplicate emails
body:
We're getting duplicate email alerts for the same billing events at Summit Works — twice this week I received two identical emails about the same invoice reminder, about 5 minutes apart. As the finance manager here, I'd like to request a way to change our notification settings so each alert only fires once per event.

We only have 6 seats so it's a small team, but the duplicates are confusing when we're trying to track which invoices actually need action.
answer: Thanks for reporting this — duplicate invoice reminder emails shouldn't be happening, and I'd like to check your notification settings to see if there's a rule triggering the alert twice. Could you confirm the exact invoice number and both timestamps you received the duplicates? In the meantime, I can also walk you through adjusting your alert frequency settings to reduce noise while we investigate.

subject: Pagination behavior change on API Platform endpoints
body:
We noticed that as of March 5th, our /v2/records endpoint started returning a 'next_cursor' field instead of the old 'offset' parameter we've been using for pagination in North Health's integration. This changed our pagination logic without any prior notice in the changelog, and a few of our internal reports briefly showed incomplete data until we caught it.

Can you confirm if this is an intentional deprecation, and if so, is there a timeline for when the offset-based pagination will be fully removed?
answer: Thanks for flagging this — you're right that we're transitioning /v2/records to cursor-based pagination, and I apologize that this wasn't clearly communicated ahead of the change. Offset-based pagination is still supported for now but is deprecated; I'll get you the exact sunset date and make sure our changelog reflects this more clearly going forward.

subject: Intermittent SAML login failures for a handful of users
body: We're seeing intermittent SAML login failures for a small subset of users at Apex Analytics, maybe 15-20 out of our workspace over the past week. Most retry and get in on the second attempt, so it's not blocking anyone long-term, but it's happening enough that our helpdesk is starting to log tickets about it. The error shown is generic: "Authentication failed, please try again." This started around June 3rd as far as we can tell. Can you check if there's an issue on the IdP-side response validation?
answer: Thanks for flagging this and for the timeline detail. Intermittent SAML failures like this are usually caused by clock skew or an occasional assertion signature mismatch from the IdP side, so we'll pull the SAML response logs for the affected accounts starting June 3rd to see if there's a pattern. Since this is low-impact for now, we'll treat it as a P3 and update you within a couple of business days with findings, but please let us know if the failure rate increases.

subject: Role mapping broken after SSO metadata update - users losing admin access
body: After we updated our IdP metadata yesterday to rotate our signing certificate, role mapping from SAML groups to Northwind roles stopped working correctly. Several users who should be mapped to Admin are now landing as Viewer, and we have at least 30 people affected across our healthcare workspace. This is blocking our clinical ops team from approving records today. We didn't change any attribute names on our side, only the cert.
answer: This is a P1 for us and we're on it right now. A certificate rotation shouldn't affect attribute-to-role mapping directly, so we suspect the metadata refresh reset your group claim configuration on our end - we're pulling your SSO config history now to confirm and will restore correct mappings as quickly as possible. We'll follow up within the hour with either a fix or a workaround so your admins can regain access sooner.

subject: Duplicate escalation alerts being routed to wrong distribution list
body: Since this morning our escalation alerts for case deadline reminders are being sent twice, and one copy is going to our legal-ops distribution list instead of the assigned attorney's email. We rely on these alerts for court filing deadlines, so sending them to the wrong list is a real risk. This has affected at least 12 cases since 8am today. Can you check the alert routing rules for our workspace, I don't think we changed anything recently.
answer: Thank you for reporting this immediately, we understand the stakes with deadline alerts and are treating this as a P1. We're reviewing your routing rule configuration now to identify why duplicates are firing and why one copy is misrouted to the legal-ops list, and we'll push a fix or temporary rule correction as soon as we isolate the cause. In the meantime, please have your team manually verify deadline alerts against the case system until we confirm this is resolved.

subject: help
body:
We want to change how alert routing prioritizes duplicate suppression during high-volume windows. Right now we're getting flooded with repeated alerts during peak load and it's degrading dashboard performance for our ops team. Here's a sample from our logs:

2024-05-28T14:02:11Z ALERT dup_suppression_window=30s alert_id=88213 count=47
2024-05-28T14:02:41Z ALERT dup_suppression_window=30s alert_id=88213 count=52
2024-05-28T14:03:11Z ALERT dup_suppression_window=30s alert_id=88213 count=61
2024-05-28T14:03:41Z ALERT dup_suppression_window=30s alert_id=88213 count=58

We'd like the suppression window increased to at least 5 minutes for our energy monitoring alerts specifically. Can this be configured per alert type?
answer: Thanks for the log detail, that's helpful. Currently the suppression window is set at the workspace level rather than per alert type, but we can look into whether a per-alert-type override is feasible given your volume pattern. We'll open this as a change request, review the performance impact of extending the window to 5 minutes, and get back to you with a proposed rollout plan within a few business days.

subject: Feature request: dedupe alerts by resource ID not just alert type
body: We keep getting duplicate alerts when the same underlying issue triggers multiple alert types pointing at the same resource. For example a storage threshold breach on resource id vtx-store-04 generated 3 separate alerts within 2 minutes last week, all technically valid but redundant for our on-call team. It would help a lot if deduplication could be based on resource ID in addition to alert type. Is this something on your roadmap, or is there a workaround we're missing?
answer: This is great feedback, and you're right that resource-based deduplication isn't currently supported, only alert-type deduplication is. We'll log this as a feature request with your example included, since resource-level dedup would likely help a number of customers with similar setups. In the meantime, one workaround is to consolidate related alert rules into a single composite rule where possible, and we're happy to help you set that up if useful.

subject: Getting duplicate email alerts for every notification, need this fixed
body: Every notification we set up is sending us two emails instead of one, this has been happening for about three days now. We only have 19 people on our team so this is really noticeable and confusing everyone about which one to act on. I checked our notification settings and don't see anything configured twice. Is there documentation on how the email alert pipeline works so I can troubleshoot, or can someone look into why we're getting duplicates?
answer: Sorry for the confusion this is causing your team, we know duplicate alerts create real noise. We're marking this P1 given it's affecting every notification for your whole workspace, and we're checking your notification channel configuration now for a duplicate subscription or webhook retry loop. We'll also send over our email alert pipeline documentation so you have visibility into how routing works, and we'll follow up shortly with what we find.

subject: Credit applied but refund never processed for cancelled add-on seats
body: We cancelled 5 add-on seats last month and were told we'd get a prorated refund, but I only see a credit applied to our account balance, not an actual refund to our payment method. Our finance team needs this as a refund for reconciliation purposes, not a credit. Is there documentation on how Northwind handles refunds versus credits for seat downgrades? This is holding up our monthly close.
answer: Thanks for flagging this, and I understand the urgency with your monthly close. By default, seat downgrades apply as account credit rather than a direct refund unless specifically requested, but we can convert this credit to a refund to your original payment method if that's what was communicated to your team. I'm escalating this now to get the refund processed and will confirm once it's issued, along with sending our documentation on how credits versus refunds work for seat changes.

subject: Requesting seat count adjustment reflected correctly on next invoice
body: We added 8 new analysts last month bringing us to 94 seats, but our most recent invoice still reflects the old seat count from before the increase. I want to make sure the correct seat count is applied going forward and confirm whether we'll be billed retroactively for the gap or if it starts fresh next cycle. Could you also point me to where I can see historical seat count changes for our plan?
answer: Thanks for reaching out, this is a straightforward billing adjustment. We'll update your account to reflect 94 seats and the change will apply on a prorated basis starting from when the seats were added, so you may see a small adjustment on your next invoice rather than a full retroactive charge. You can view seat change history under the Plan and Usage section of your billing dashboard, and we'll confirm once the update is live on our side.

subject: Need ability to map custom SAML attributes to roles
body: We're setting up SSO for our small team and want to map a custom SAML attribute (department) to Northwind roles instead of using the default group claim. Right now it looks like only the standard group attribute is supported for role mapping. Is there a way to configure custom attribute mapping, or is this something you could add? We have specific role requirements tied to department rather than group membership.
answer: Thanks for the detail on your use case. Currently role mapping only supports the standard group claim attribute, custom attribute mapping like department-based roles isn't available yet. I'm logging this as a feature request on your behalf, and in the meantime, one workaround is to mirror your department structure using groups in your IdP so it maps to the standard claim. We'll let you know if custom attribute support gets added to the roadmap.

subject: Cursor-based pagination returning duplicate records across pages
body: I'm integrating with the /v2/records endpoint using cursor-based pagination and getting duplicate records showing up across consecutive pages when new records are being written concurrently. For example, requesting page with cursor abc123 returns record id 5521, then the next cursor also includes 5521 again. Is there a recommended way to handle pagination consistency during concurrent writes, or is there a stable sort parameter I should be passing that I'm missing in the docs?
answer: Thanks for the specific example, that helps narrow this down. This can happen if the sort key you're paginating on isn't unique enough during concurrent writes, and we recommend passing the sort=created_at,id parameter combination to ensure a stable tiebreaker across pages. We'll also update our pagination docs to call this out more clearly, and let us know if adding that parameter resolves the duplicate records you're seeing.

subject: How to handle unsubscribe requests in Notifications
body:
We're using the Notifications product to send booking confirmations and promo emails to our travel clients. A few customers have replied asking to be unsubscribed, but I can't find where to manage suppression lists in the console. Right now we're manually removing addresses from our send list, which isn't scalable at 80 seats worth of campaigns.

Could you point me to the correct workflow for handling unsubscribe requests, and whether Northwind maintains a global suppression list per workspace or per template?
answer:
Thanks for reaching out. Suppression lists in Notifications are managed per workspace, not per template, so once a recipient unsubscribes via the link in your emails they're automatically excluded from all future sends. You can view and manually add addresses under Notifications > Settings > Suppression List if you need to handle replies that come in outside the standard unsubscribe link.

I'll also flag this as feedback to our product team since a bulk-import option for suppression entries would help teams like yours managing manual requests.

subject: Urgent: need to deactivate 40+ terminated users immediately
body:
Our HR team just informed me that 43 employees were terminated last week as part of a restructuring, and their Northwind accounts are still active. I need to deactivate all of these users in the Admin Console today to stay compliant with our offboarding policy, but bulk deactivation seems to only let me select 10 rows at a time before the page freezes.

Can you either expedite a bulk deactivation on our end or tell me a faster method? We have 241 seats total and this is a compliance risk for us.
answer: This is being treated as a priority issue given the compliance exposure. Our team can run a bulk deactivation on your behalf right away if you send us the list of user emails or employee IDs tied to the terminations. In parallel, we're looking into the pagination freeze on bulk select in the Admin Console, since that shouldn't be capping you at 10 rows, and we'll follow up with a fix timeline.

subject: Storage quota exceeded, uploads failing in production
body:
Since around 14:20 UTC today, our integration has been receiving 507 Insufficient Storage errors when writing new objects to our Storage bucket 'cobalt-retail-orders'. We're at what looks like our quota limit but the dashboard still shows 82% usage, which doesn't match the rejected writes. This is blocking order confirmation uploads for our retail checkout flow.

Can someone check our actual quota consumption versus the displayed number, and let us know if there's a retention policy causing old objects to count against the limit longer than expected?
answer: We're escalating this now since it's actively blocking writes. Our initial check shows your account's effective usage is higher than the dashboard percentage due to a lag in how retention-expired objects are recalculated against quota, which we're correcting. We'll increase your temporary ceiling within the hour to unblock production writes and follow up with the root cause on the dashboard mismatch.

subject: Request to change Jira link in Integrations panel
body:
We connected our Jira instance to Northwind Integrations a while back, but the link now points to an old Jira project that's been archived. I'd like to update it to our current project key 'PIO-ENERGY' without having to disconnect and reconfigure the whole integration, since that also handles our Slack notifications for billing approvals.

Is there a way to just edit the project mapping, or do I need to remove and re-add the integration?
answer: You can update the Jira project mapping without removing the integration. Go to Integrations > Jira > Configuration and there's an 'Edit Project Key' option that lets you swap in PIO-ENERGY directly; this won't affect your existing Slack notification rules since those are tied to the integration connection itself, not the project mapping.

subject: Mobile app crashes on launch for some drivers
body:
Several of our field staff at Granite Freight have reported that the mobile app crashes immediately on launch after the latest update, specifically on Android devices running version 13. It happens before the login screen even loads, so we can't tell if it's related to cached credentials or something else. This is affecting route check-ins for our drivers.

Could you look into this and also let us know if there's a way to enable offline login as a fallback, since some of our routes have poor connectivity?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. Crashes before the login screen on Android 13 point to an issue we're currently investigating with a recent release, and we'll send a build fix as soon as it's confirmed. In the meantime, having affected drivers clear the app cache or reinstall often resolves the immediate crash. Offline login as a fallback isn't currently supported, but I'm logging it as a feature request given your connectivity constraints.

subject: SSO sessions timing out every few minutes for all users
body:
We integrated our Identity and SSO with our IdP two weeks ago, and since this morning all of our developers are getting logged out roughly every 5 minutes, forcing repeated re-authentication. Our IdP session lifetime is set to 8 hours, so this doesn't match our expectations. We're seeing 'session_expired' errors in the API responses even for tokens issued minutes earlier.

This is severely disrupting our team's ability to test integrations against your API. Can someone check if there's a session TTL misconfiguration on the Northwind side?
answer: This has been escalated to our identity team immediately given the impact on your whole developer team. We found that a recent token TTL default change on our side may have overridden your custom session length; we're reverting that now and will confirm once your sessions honor the 8-hour lifetime again. We'll update you within the hour with the fix status.

subject: Dashboard charts not rendering correctly
body:
Since yesterday, several of our energy usage charts in the Dashboards product are showing blank panels or stuck loading spinners, particularly the ones with line charts spanning more than 30 days. Bar charts and single-day views still work fine. We rely on these dashboards for our morning operations review, and this is affecting our whole team, small as it is.

Could you check if there's a known issue with long-range line chart rendering, and is there a fix planned soon?
answer: Thanks for flagging this. We're aware of an issue affecting line charts with date ranges over 30 days that started after a recent rendering update, and our team is actively working on a fix. As a temporary workaround, exporting the data and viewing it via CSV or splitting into shorter ranges should let you get your morning review data in the meantime. We'll notify you as soon as the fix is deployed.

subject: MFA enrollment broken, users locked out
body:
Starting this morning, none of our staff can complete MFA enrollment when logging into Northwind for the first time. The enrollment screen loads, but after scanning the QR code and entering the verification code, we get 'Invalid code, please try again' every single time, even with fresh codes. This is blocking our whole team of 16 from accessing any Northwind product today.

We need this resolved urgently since finance approvals are stuck until people can log in.
answer: We understand the urgency and have escalated this as a priority incident. This matches a known issue with time-based code validation for new enrollments that started earlier today; our team is deploying a fix now. In the meantime, if any users need immediate access, we can issue temporary bypass codes for your admin to distribute — let us know if you'd like us to proceed with that while the permanent fix rolls out.

subject: Offline mode not syncing data after reconnect
body:
Our field teams use the mobile app in offline mode frequently since we work with legal document reviews in areas with unreliable connectivity. Lately, when devices reconnect after being offline for more than an hour, the queued changes don't sync back and just disappear from the local cache, with no error shown to the user. We've confirmed this on both iOS and Android for a handful of users so far.

Can you check if there's a sync queue limit or timeout causing this data loss, and how we can prevent it going forward?
answer: Thank you for the clear report. We're looking into the sync queue behavior for offline sessions longer than an hour, as there's a chance a background timeout is clearing the local queue before it can flush to the server. Could you send us the device IDs or timestamps for the affected sync attempts so we can trace the exact failure point? We'll prioritize this given the data loss risk to your field teams.

subject: Data Pipeline transforms failing repeatedly
body:
Our nightly Data Pipeline job connecting our CRM connector to our reporting warehouse has failed for the last three runs, all with a transform error referencing a null value in the 'customer_region' field. Nothing has changed on our source data as far as we know. The connector sync itself completes, but the transform stage fails around minute 12 each time with increasing latency before failure.

Can you help us identify what's causing the transform step to reject these records, and whether this is related to a recent connector update?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. A null in a mapped required field like customer_region will cause the transform stage to reject the batch, and we did push a connector update recently that tightened null-handling validation, which is likely the cause here. We'll check your pipeline logs for the exact failing records and can advise whether to adjust the field mapping or add a default value rule to prevent this going forward.

subject: Storage quota approaching limit for energy dataset uploads
body: We're currently at around 87% of our storage quota on the Pro plan and uploading daily sensor readings from our energy monitoring devices. At this rate we'll hit the cap within 2-3 weeks. Can you tell us what our retention policy looks like for objects older than 12 months, and whether archiving older files would actually free up quota or just move them internally? We'd also like to know if there's a performance impact when we're near the limit, since our last few uploads on Oct 14 took noticeably longer than usual.
answer: Thanks for flagging this ahead of time. Storage quota is calculated on live object size regardless of age, so archiving to cold storage tier does free up your active quota, and objects past your retention window (currently set to 18 months for your workspace) can be purged automatically if you enable the retention policy in Storage settings. Slower uploads near capacity are a known pattern - once you're above 85% we throttle write throughput slightly to protect cluster stability, so freeing up space should resolve the slowdown too. I can walk you through setting a retention rule if you'd like, just let me know your preferred cutoff.

subject: Need to reconcile seat count on our invoice
body: I'm reviewing our latest invoice for Delta Foods and the seat count listed (293) doesn't match what I'm seeing in the admin console, which shows 287 active users. We added a batch of contractors in September and I want to make sure we're not being billed for seats that were deactivated. Could you clarify how the billing cycle counts seats - is it a snapshot on invoice date or an average over the month? Also, is there a way to export a seat usage report tied to invoice line items?
answer: Good question, and this is a common source of confusion. Seat billing on the Pro plan uses a peak-count snapshot taken on the last day of the billing cycle, not a daily average, so if you had a temporary spike from contractor onboarding in September that would explain the gap between your current 287 and the invoiced 293. You can pull a historical seat usage report under Billing > Usage Reports, filtered by date range, which will show daily active seat counts so you can match them against the invoice line item. Happy to review the September numbers with you directly if the discrepancy still looks off after that.

subject: Salesforce sync - request to also push updates into Slack channel
body: We have the Salesforce integration set up and syncing opportunity records into Northwind fine, but our sales team would like updates (new opportunity created, stage changed) to also post into a specific Slack channel automatically. Right now we're manually copying updates over. Is this something the Integrations module supports natively, or would we need a separate workflow/webhook setup between Salesforce and Slack? We're on the Pro plan with about 150 seats and would like this rolled out to the whole sales org if possible.
answer: Thanks for the detail - this isn't available as a one-click toggle yet, but it is achievable today using our Integrations workflow builder: you can create a rule that triggers on Salesforce opportunity events and forwards them to a Slack webhook you configure on your end. I'll send over a short guide with the exact trigger/action setup for opportunity-created and stage-changed events. I'm also logging this as a feature request for native Slack notifications from the Salesforce connector since a few other customers have asked for the same thing.

subject: Users still receiving emails after unsubscribing
body: Several of our staff unsubscribed from the weekly billing digest emails over the past two weeks, but they're continuing to receive them - including one today, Oct 18, despite unsubscribing on Oct 5. I'm getting complaints from the finance team about duplicate and unwanted emails. This is affecting at least 6 of our 25 seats so far. Can you check why the unsubscribe isn't taking effect and get this fixed quickly, as it's starting to look unprofessional to our staff?
answer: I'm sorry for the trouble this is causing your team - I've escalated this to our notifications engineering group since unsubscribe requests should suppress future sends immediately. Can you send me the exact email addresses (or user IDs) and the unsubscribe timestamps for the 6 affected accounts so we can trace whether the suppression list update is failing or delayed? In the meantime I'd recommend having affected users also disable the digest preference directly in their notification settings as a temporary workaround while we investigate the root cause.

subject: Mobile app not delivering push notifications after update
body: Since updating the Northwind mobile app last week, none of our 3 users are receiving push notifications for alerts anymore, even though notification settings show they're enabled. Two of us tested by logging out and back in, and one user also tried reinstalling, but the issue persists on both iOS and Android devices. We rely on these alerts for time-sensitive approvals, so this is becoming a real problem for our small team.
answer: Thanks for the detailed troubleshooting steps you've already tried - that helps narrow things down. This looks related to a push token registration issue we've seen crop up after app updates on certain device configurations. Could you confirm the app version and device OS versions for each of the 3 users, and whether any of them use offline mode regularly? I'll get our mobile team looking at this today given the impact on your approval workflow, and will follow up with either a fix or a workaround within 24 hours.

subject: Charts rendering broken on shared dashboard
body: One of our shared dashboards (the district energy usage report) is showing broken chart placeholders instead of the actual bar and line charts for about half our 248 users. It seems to happen specifically when the dashboard is accessed via the shared link rather than logged-in directly. Exporting the dashboard to PDF also fails silently - the download starts but the file is empty. This started sometime after our last data refresh on Oct 12. Can you look into whether this is a rendering bug tied to shared links specifically?
answer: Thanks for the clear description - the shared-link rendering path does use a different chart engine than the logged-in view, so this points to a rendering bug on that path rather than your data itself. The empty PDF export is likely related since it uses the same rendering pipeline. I've reproduced a similar issue internally and I'm passing this to engineering with your dashboard ID; in the meantime, logged-in access should continue to render correctly for your users as a workaround.

subject: Frage zur Aufbewahrungsfrist für Storage-Daten
body: Wir nutzen Northwind Storage im Starter-Plan und möchten unsere Aufbewahrungsrichtlinie für hochgeladene Mediendateien anpassen. Aktuell werden Dateien nach 90 Tagen automatisch gelöscht, aber für unsere Compliance-Anforderungen im Medienbereich müssen wir bestimmte Inhalte mindestens 12 Monate vorhalten. Gibt es eine Möglichkeit, die Aufbewahrungsfrist pro Ordner oder Projekt individuell einzustellen, statt global für den gesamten Workspace? Zusätzlich wüssten wir gern, ob sich das auf unser Speicherkontingent auswirkt.
answer: Vielen Dank für Ihre Anfrage. Im Starter-Plan ist die Aufbewahrungsfrist derzeit nur global für den gesamten Workspace einstellbar, ordnerspezifische Regeln stehen erst im Pro-Plan zur Verfügung. Wir können die globale Frist gerne für Sie auf 12 Monate anheben - das erhöht Ihren genutzten Speicherplatz entsprechend, da Dateien länger vorgehalten werden, wirkt sich aber nicht auf Ihr Kontingent-Limit selbst aus. Lassen Sie uns wissen, ob wir die Änderung direkt für Sie vornehmen sollen.

subject: URGENT: Dashboard PDF export completely broken for all users
body: As of this morning our entire team cannot export any dashboard to PDF - every attempt results in a spinning loader that never completes, then times out after about 90 seconds with 'Export failed, please try again.' This is blocking our weekly ops report that's due to go out to our leadership team today. We've tried on 3 different dashboards and 2 different browsers with the same result. This needs urgent attention as it's affecting our whole team of 12.
answer: I understand the urgency given your reporting deadline today - I'm escalating this immediately as a P1 issue. We're seeing elevated export failures across multiple accounts in the last hour, which suggests a service-side problem with the PDF rendering service rather than something specific to your dashboards. I'll update you within the hour with either a fix or a workaround (such as exporting via CSV/print-to-PDF in the meantime), and will keep this ticket open until export functionality is fully confirmed restored.

subject: Mobile app crashes immediately on launch, can't log in
body: Since this morning, the Northwind mobile app crashes within 1-2 seconds of opening it, before we even reach the login screen. This is happening on all 18 of our team's devices, both iOS and Android, and we've tried reinstalling on 3 of them with no change. We use the mobile app for on-site approvals and offline data entry, so our field team is completely blocked right now. This started right after we noticed an app update was pushed yesterday.
answer: This is a serious blocker and I'm treating it as P1 given it's affecting your entire field team. The timing right after yesterday's app update strongly suggests a regression in the new build - we've had one other report come in with similar symptoms in the last hour. Please hold off on further reinstall attempts for now; our mobile team is investigating the update immediately and I'll send you an update within the next couple of hours with either a hotfix or instructions to roll back to the previous version.

subject: Abmeldung von Benachrichtigungen funktioniert nicht
body: Mehrere Kollegen aus unserem Team haben sich vor über einer Woche von den täglichen Alert-E-Mails abgemeldet, erhalten diese aber weiterhin - teilweise sogar doppelt am selben Tag. Betroffen sind mindestens 4 unserer 25 Nutzer. Das führt zu Verwirrung und die Kollegen beschweren sich, da sie die Abmeldebestätigung erhalten haben, die E-Mails aber trotzdem weiter bekommen. Können Sie prüfen, woran das liegt?
answer: Vielen Dank für die Meldung, das nehmen wir ernst. Es klingt so, als ob die Abmeldung in unserer Unterdrückungsliste nicht korrekt greift, obwohl die Bestätigung verschickt wurde - das deuten auch die doppelten Zustellungen an. Könnten Sie uns die betroffenen Benutzerkonten sowie das ungefähre Datum der Abmeldung nennen? Wir leiten dies umgehend an unser Notifications-Team weiter und melden uns mit einem Update, sobald die Ursache gefunden ist.

subject: Feature request: Slack alert routing per channel
body:
We're using the Slack integration to push API downtime alerts, but right now everything lands in one channel. We'd like to route alerts by severity to different Slack channels (e.g. #alerts-critical vs #alerts-info). Is this on the roadmap, or is there a workaround using webhook filters?

We have 4 team members monitoring these alerts and the noise is making it hard to triage quickly.
answer: Thanks for the detailed request. Channel-based routing isn't available today, but you can approximate it by creating separate Slack webhook URLs per channel and mapping them to specific alert rules in your Integrations settings under Notification Rules. I'll also log this as a feature request with our product team and tag it to your account so we can update you if per-severity routing gets built.

subject: Speicherkontingent für Enterprise-Konto dringend erhöhen
body:
Wir stoßen seit gestern regelmäßig an unser Speicherkontingent im Storage-Produkt. Beim Hochladen großer Backup-Dateien (ca. 80 GB pro Nacht) erhalten wir die Fehlermeldung 'Quota exceeded: 429 storage_limit_reached'. Die automatischen Backups für unsere Energieanlagen-Daten laufen seit 03:00 Uhr nicht mehr durch.

Wir benötigen kurzfristig eine Erhöhung des Kontingents oder eine Anpassung der Retention-Policy, damit ältere Snapshots automatisch gelöscht werden. Bitte um schnelle Rückmeldung, da mehrere Teams auf die Backups angewiesen sind.
answer: Vielen Dank für die Meldung, das verstehen wir als dringend.
