Wir prüfen sofort Ihr aktuelles Kontingent und die Auslastung der letzten Backups und melden uns innerhalb der nächsten Stunde mit einer temporären Kontingenterhöhung. Parallel dazu schauen wir uns die Retention-Einstellungen an, damit ältere Snapshots automatisch bereinigt werden können, um das Problem langfristig zu lösen.

subject: Zapier-Integration: Dokumentation für Trigger gesucht
body:
Wir möchten die Zapier-Integration nutzen, um neue Kommentare aus unserem Dashboard automatisch in Slack zu posten. In der Hilfe finden wir aber keine vollständige Liste der verfügbaren Trigger und Actions für Zapier.

Könnt ihr uns einen Link zu einer aktuellen Dokumentation schicken oder uns kurz erklären, welche Trigger aktuell unterstützt werden? Das würde uns bei der Einrichtung sehr helfen.
answer: Danke für Ihre Anfrage. Aktuell unterstützt unsere Zapier-Integration die Trigger 'New Comment', 'New Task' und 'Dashboard Updated' sowie die Actions 'Create Task' und 'Send Notification'. Eine ausführliche Übersicht mit Beispielen finden Sie in unserem Hilfe-Center unter 'Integrations > Zapier'; ich schicke Ihnen den direkten Link per E-Mail und stehe für weitere Fragen gerne zur Verfügung.

subject: Urgent: Incorrect invoice amount and missing credit for downgrade
body:
Our latest invoice charged us for 622 seats at the Enterprise rate, but we downgraded 40 seats two weeks ago and were told a prorated credit would be applied. The credit never appeared, and the invoice total is off by roughly $9,400 compared to what our finance team expected.

This needs to be resolved before our internal audit closes on Friday. Can someone confirm the credit is being processed and issue a corrected invoice?
answer: I understand the urgency given your audit deadline, and I've escalated this to our billing team for immediate review. I can confirm the seat downgrade was logged on our end, but it looks like the prorated credit didn't sync correctly to this billing cycle. We'll issue a corrected invoice with the credit applied and send it to your admin contact within one business day.

subject: Late-arriving records in pipeline causing gaps in reports
body:
We've noticed that some records from our legal case management connector are arriving 2-3 hours after their event timestamp, which causes gaps in our daily aggregation reports. This happened again on the pipeline run at 06:00 UTC today, where 47 records with timestamps from the previous day showed up after the report had already been generated.

Is there a way to configure a grace period or watermark delay on this connector so late records get included before aggregation runs?
answer: Thanks for flagging this with the specific run and record count, that's very helpful. This connector currently uses a fixed 30-minute watermark, which isn't enough for your case here. We can manually extend the watermark window to 4 hours for your pipeline as a workaround, and I'll pass this along to our pipelines team as feedback since a configurable grace period would clearly help other customers with similar late-arrival patterns.

subject: Scheduled syncs stopped running after connector update
body:
Since yesterday's connector update, our scheduled syncs for the payments data pipeline have stopped triggering entirely. The last successful run was at 22:00 UTC two days ago, and nothing has run since despite the schedule being set to every 6 hours. We rely on this pipeline for daily reconciliation and can't afford to fall further behind.

We need this fixed today or a way to manually trigger the sync until it's resolved.
answer: This is a priority issue on our end and we're actively investigating why the connector update disrupted your schedule triggers. In the meantime, I've enabled a manual trigger option on your pipeline so you can run reconciliation syncs immediately rather than waiting for the fix. We'll update you within a few hours once we identify the root cause and restore automatic scheduling.

subject: Users receiving duplicate emails after unsubscribing
body:
Several of our team members unsubscribed from the weekly digest notifications last week, but they're still receiving duplicate copies of the same email each Monday. One user showed me their inbox with 3 identical emails timestamped within the same minute on Monday at 08:00.

Can you confirm whether the unsubscribe request is actually being processed, and how we can stop these duplicates from going out?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report, duplicate sends after unsubscribe definitely shouldn't happen. It looks like there may be a delay in how the unsubscribe status propagates to our notification queue, which could explain both the duplicates and continued delivery. We're looking into your account's notification logs now and will confirm within the day whether this is a queue sync issue or a suppression list bug.

subject: Need configurable delay window for late-arriving API data
body:
We're integrating our transaction data through the Data Pipelines API, and we're seeing records arrive with delays of up to 45 minutes past their event time due to upstream latency on our end. Right now the pipeline processes data as soon as it arrives, which means aggregations sometimes run before all records for a given window have landed.

Could we get support for a configurable delay window (similar to a watermark setting) on the API-based connector so we can buffer for late data before triggering downstream processing?
answer: This is a reasonable ask and something we've heard from a few API-based integration customers. Currently the connector doesn't expose a configurable watermark, but as a workaround you can delay your downstream trigger by calling the pipeline status endpoint before running aggregations. I'll log this as a change request to add a configurable delay window setting directly in the connector configuration.

subject: Okta app assignment not syncing correctly for our users
body:
We've set up the Okta app integration to provision access automatically, but two of our four users assigned to the app in Okta aren't showing up as active in Northwind. I checked the Okta admin console and both show 'Provisioning: Success', yet in Northwind their status still shows 'Pending Invite' from three days ago.

Could you check what's blocking the sync, or point me to documentation on troubleshooting SCIM provisioning issues for this app?
answer: Thanks for including the provisioning status details, that helps narrow things down. This pattern usually means the SCIM push from Okta succeeded but the account activation step on our side stalled, often due to a mismatched email domain or attribute mapping. I'll check the provisioning logs for your two pending users directly, and in the meantime our SCIM troubleshooting guide under Integrations > Okta > Provisioning covers the most common causes if you'd like to review it.

subject: Mobile app crashes immediately on launch for all users
body:
Since this morning, our mobile app crashes within a second of opening it, before the login screen even appears. This is happening on both iOS and Android devices across our team, and it started right after the app auto-updated overnight. We rely on the mobile app for field checks while traveling, so this is blocking work for our whole team right now.

We've tried reinstalling on two devices with no change. Can you confirm if this is a known issue with the latest release?
answer: Thank you for reporting this quickly, we're seeing similar crash-on-launch reports tied to the overnight release and are treating it as high priority. Our mobile team is investigating a likely issue with the startup initialization in the new build, and we'll push a hotfix as soon as it's verified. In the meantime, if any devices still have the previous version cached, please avoid updating until we confirm the fix is live.

subject: Duplicate email alerts from Notifications
body: We're seeing duplicate email alerts going out to our travel booking team - same alert ID firing twice within about 90 seconds, roughly 40 times over the last 3 days. It's not a huge volume but our agents are getting confused thinking there are two separate incidents. Anyone else seeing this or is there a known dedupe setting we're missing in the alert rules?
answer: Thanks for flagging this - duplicate sends like that usually point to a retry happening on our delivery layer before the original send confirmation is received. Could you send us two or three of the duplicated alert IDs with timestamps so we can trace them through the delivery pipeline? In the meantime, you can enable the dedupe window under Notification Rules > Advanced, which should suppress repeats within a configurable interval.

subject: Okta app integration not syncing group assignments
body: We set up the Northwind app in our Okta tenant last week to push group-based access for our 250 users, but new group assignments in Okta aren't showing up on the Northwind side. We've confirmed the SCIM provisioning is enabled and the app is active. Also, is there updated documentation for mapping Okta groups to Northwind roles? The current guide references an older admin UI.
answer: Thanks for the detail. This is often caused by the SCIM push interval or a mismatched attribute mapping between Okta groups and Northwind roles - can you confirm which Okta group is failing to sync and share a screenshot of your attribute mappings page? We're also aware the setup guide is out of date and have a refreshed version in review; I'll follow up with a link once it's published.

subject: Webhook deliveries failing since this morning
body: Our webhook endpoint has been rejecting nothing on our side, but since around 8:40am today we've stopped receiving any billing.updated events entirely - no retries, no failed delivery logs, nothing. We rely on these to reconcile invoices for our energy clients and this has now delayed today's billing run. Can someone check if there's an issue on the webhook dispatch side?
answer: We're treating this as a priority issue and are already reviewing the webhook dispatch queue for your account. Initial checks show a backlog starting around the time you mentioned - we're investigating whether this is tied to a recent SDK version deprecation on our end. We'll update you within the hour with either a fix or a manual event replay for the missed billing.updated events.

subject: Role mapping inconsistency after SSO login
body:
After our latest IdP update, some users are landing with the wrong role after SSO login. Here's the relevant log snippet from one affected user:

2024-05-14T09:12:03Z ERROR role_mapper: expected_role=admin actual_role=viewer user=user_88213
2024-05-14T09:12:03Z WARN provisioning: attribute 'department' missing in SAML assertion
2024-05-14T09:12:04Z INFO mfa_check: passed
2024-05-14T09:12:05Z INFO session_created: role=viewer

This is only affecting a handful of accounts so not urgent, but wanted to flag before it grows.
answer: Thanks for including the log - it looks like the SAML assertion from your IdP is missing the department attribute we use for role mapping, which causes the fallback to viewer. Could you confirm whether this attribute was recently removed or renamed in your IdP configuration? Once we know that, we can adjust the mapping rule on our side or guide you through restoring the attribute.

subject: Storage quota alerts triggering incorrectly
body: We're getting quota warning emails saying we're at 95% of our storage allocation, but our admin dashboard shows usage at only 61%. This started after our nightly backup job ran on the 12th. We need to confirm actual usage before we decide whether to purge old files, since some of this data falls under a 7-year retention requirement for compliance.
answer: Thank you for reporting this discrepancy - a mismatch like this can happen when backup snapshots are counted against quota before the dashboard cache refreshes. We're pulling your account's storage metering data now to confirm the real usage figure and will get back to you before you take any action on deleting files, especially given the retention requirement you mentioned.

subject: MFA enrolment stuck for several team members
body: Three of our seven team members can't complete MFA enrolment - the QR code loads fine but after scanning with their authenticator app, the verification code is always rejected with 'invalid code, please try again.' This started yesterday afternoon and is now blocking them from logging in at all. We need this resolved soon since it's affecting daily operations.
answer: Sorry for the disruption this is causing your team. This usually points to a time sync issue between the authenticator app and our verification server, but since it's affecting multiple users at once we want to rule out something on our end first. Can you confirm the exact error timestamp for one affected user so we can check the MFA verification logs, and in the meantime we can issue temporary bypass codes to get them back into their accounts.

subject: URGENT: All users locked out after MFA enrolment change
body: Every single one of our 22 users is now locked out after we rolled out mandatory MFA enrolment this morning. Nobody can get past the enrolment screen - it just spins and then returns 'enrollment session expired.' This is a total outage for us, no one can access Northwind at all. We need this fixed immediately, our whole team is blocked.
answer: We understand the severity and have escalated this to our on-call SSO team immediately. We're investigating the enrolment session expiry issue right now and will push a temporary workaround to restore access while we identify root cause. We'll update you within 15 minutes with either a fix or a way to temporarily disable mandatory MFA enrolment so your team can get back in.

subject: Storage quota exceeded, uploads blocked
body: Our team can no longer upload any new files - every upload attempt returns 'quota exceeded, please free up space or upgrade your plan.' We checked our dashboard and we're at 100% of our Starter plan allocation. We have client documents that need to go up today, and we also want to understand if our backup retention settings are contributing to this since we haven't manually added much new data recently.
answer: Thanks for reaching out, and sorry for the impact on your upload work today. We can see your account is at full quota - a large part of it does appear to be backup snapshots retained under your current policy. We can help you either adjust retention settings to free up space right away or walk you through a quick plan upgrade so uploads aren't blocked; let us know which you'd prefer and we'll action it immediately.

subject: Question about retention policy on archived files
body: We're trying to understand how retention actually works for files marked as archived in Storage. We have several files from a completed project last quarter that we expected to be purged after 90 days per our retention setting, but they're still showing up in the archive list today. Is there a delay in how purge jobs run, or do we need to trigger this manually somewhere?
answer: Good question - purge jobs for archived files run on a rolling nightly schedule rather than exactly at the 90-day mark, so there can be a short delay depending on when the file was archived relative to the job window. Could you share one of the file IDs still showing up so we can confirm whether it's just pending its next scheduled purge or something is misconfigured on the retention rule?

subject: Request: fix offline mode causing crashes before rollout
body: We're planning to roll out the updated Mobile App to our full team of 22 this week, but during testing we found that switching to offline mode while a push notification arrives consistently crashes the app on both iOS and Android. This is a blocker for us since our field staff rely on offline mode daily and we can't proceed with the wider rollout until this is addressed. Can this be prioritized before we escalate to our account team?
answer: Thank you for catching this before the wider rollout - crashes tied to push notification handling during offline mode are a serious issue and we're escalating this to our mobile engineering team right now. We'll need a quick screen recording or crash log from one of the affected devices to speed up diagnosis, and we'll keep you updated closely given your rollout timeline this week.

subject: Unsubscribe link missing from billing alert emails
body:
We've had three employees this month reply asking why they can't unsubscribe from the weekly billing digest emails. There's no unsubscribe link at the bottom like our other vendor emails have. Could you add a working unsubscribe option to the notification templates, or at least tell us how to manage recipient preferences from our side?

We're on 23 seats and this is generating duplicate support requests internally every week.
answer: Thanks for flagging this - you're right that the billing digest template currently doesn't expose a self-service unsubscribe link, only the general notification categories do. I've logged this as a feature request with our notifications team and will update you once it's scheduled. In the meantime, I can manually remove specific recipients from that digest list if you send me their names or roles.

subject: Push-Benachrichtigungen kommen nicht an nach Offline-Phase
body:
Bei mehreren Mitarbeitern stürzt die Northwind Mobile App ab, sobald das Gerät nach einer WLAN-Unterbrechung wieder online geht und eine Push-Benachrichtigung eintrifft. Das passiert seit dem Update auf Version 4.3.1 bei mindestens 6 von 25 Nutzern, hauptsächlich auf Android-Geräten.

Die App schließt sich sofort ohne Fehlermeldung für den Nutzer. Können Sie das prüfen? Wir brauchen die Push-Funktion für unsere Compliance-Erinnerungen.
answer: Danke für die genaue Beschreibung. Das klingt nach einem bekannten Problem mit dem Offline-Puffer für Push-Benachrichtigungen in Version 4.3.1 auf Android. Ich leite das an unser Mobile-Team weiter und bitte Sie, uns die Absturzprotokolle von zwei betroffenen Geräten zu senden, damit wir das Problem reproduzieren können. Als Übergangslösung empfehlen wir vorerst, Push-Benachrichtigungen für kritische Erinnerungen zusätzlich per E-Mail zu duplizieren.

subject: Alert emails routed to wrong on-call group since last night
body:
Since around 9pm last night, critical system alerts that should route to our on-call engineering distribution list are instead landing in the general billing notifications inbox. We caught it when a P1 database alert sat unread for 40 minutes. Our alert routing rules haven't changed on our end since March.

This is affecting all 20 seats on our account and is a real risk for incident response. Can you check if something changed on the routing engine side?
answer: This has been escalated to our notifications infrastructure team as a priority issue since misrouted alerts directly impact your incident response. Initial checks show a rule evaluation delay on the routing engine that may be causing the mismatch you're seeing. We're actively investigating and will update you within the next two hours with either a fix or a workaround for restoring correct routing.

subject: Users getting logged out every 10-15 minutes via SSO
body:
Since yesterday morning, our staff using SAML SSO to log into Northwind are getting kicked back to the login screen roughly every 10 to 15 minutes, even during active use. This is happening across our 22 seats and is disrupting work on the floor scheduling dashboard.

We haven't changed our identity provider configuration recently. Session duration was previously set to 8 hours in the admin console and still shows that value. Can you check if something changed on the session handling side?
answer: Thank you for the detailed report - a shortened session lifetime despite the configured 8-hour setting points to an issue on our session token refresh service, and we're checking whether other SSO customers are seeing the same behavior. Could you confirm which identity provider you're using and send us one affected user's login timestamp so we can trace the session in our logs? We'll keep you updated as we investigate.

subject: App crashes on launch for a few users after update
body:
A couple of our team members reported that the Northwind mobile app crashes immediately on launch after updating to the latest version last week. It seems isolated to two people so far out of our 24 seats, both on older iPhone models. Everyone else is fine.

Not urgent since it's not widespread, but wondering if this is a known issue with older iOS versions and whether there's a workaround like reinstalling or clearing cache before your next release.
answer: Thanks for letting us know, and good to hear it's limited to a couple of devices. This does line up with a minor compatibility issue we've seen on iOS 15 devices with the latest release - a fix is planned for the next patch. In the meantime, a full uninstall and reinstall usually resolves the crash, so it would be worth having those two users try that.

subject: Pagination broken on /v2/orders endpoint after webhook update
body:
Since the webhook and API changes rolled out this week, our integration pulling order data from /v2/orders has stopped paginating correctly. The 'next_cursor' field in the response is now returning null on the first page even though we have over 4,000 records, so our sync job only pulls the first 100 orders and stops.

This is affecting our entire order sync pipeline used by all 223 seats in our retail operations team. We need this fixed urgently as our inventory reconciliation depends on it.
answer: This is now our top priority - a broken pagination cursor affecting full sync would explain the incomplete order data you're seeing. Our API team has identified that the deprecation of the legacy cursor field last week may have introduced a regression in the /v2/orders response builder, and we're rolling out a hotfix now. I'll confirm within the hour once it's deployed and ask you to re-run a test sync to verify the cursor returns correctly.

subject: audit log
body: Audit log export button greyed out for compliance team, urgent.
answer: Thanks for the quick flag - can you confirm whether this is happening for all admins or just specific compliance team accounts? In the meantime I'm checking our admin console logs on our end for any export permission or settings issue tied to your workspace and will follow up shortly with next steps.

subject: SSO sessions dying constantly - MFA broken too, this is unacceptable
body:
Our entire legal team is getting logged out of Northwind every few minutes and now MFA prompts are failing outright with 'verification code expired' even when entered within seconds. This has been going on since Tuesday and IT has had to field over 30 tickets internally. We are on 140 seats and paying for Pro support - this should not be this broken.

If this isn't fixed today we are seriously going to review whether Northwind is worth renewing. Our attorneys cannot bill hours if they can't stay logged in.
answer: I understand how disruptive this is, especially with billable work at stake, and I'm escalating this to our identity engineering team as a priority incident right now. The combination of short session drops and MFA code expiry errors suggests a clock sync or token validation issue on our SSO service, and we're actively investigating server-side. I'll have an update for you within the hour, and please send us a screenshot of the exact MFA error text and the time it occurred to help speed up diagnosis.

subject: Transform failures blocking pipeline for a week, need connector fix
body:
Our data pipeline connecting to our energy usage database has been failing at the transform step for the past week, with roughly 15% of records erroring out each nightly run since October 3rd. The error references a type mismatch on the 'meter_reading' field, but the source schema hasn't changed on our end.

We're a small team on 7 seats and this is blocking our monthly billing reconciliation, which is now overdue. Could someone take a look at the connector configuration and let us know what's needed to fix it?
answer: I'm sorry for the disruption this is causing to your billing reconciliation - I've escalated this to our data pipelines team as high priority given the outage duration. The type mismatch on 'meter_reading' suggests the connector may be misreading a schema change further upstream even if your source table looks unchanged; we'll pull the failed run logs from October 3rd onward to confirm. We'll follow up within a few hours with either a corrected connector mapping or specific steps to resolve the transform errors.

subject: DASHBOARDS COMPLETELY UNUSABLE - THIS IS COSTING US MONEY
body:
OUR DASHBOARDS HAVE BEEN TAKING OVER 45 SECONDS TO LOAD FOR THE PAST THREE DAYS ACROSS THE ENTIRE ORGANIZATION. WE HAVE NEARLY 4000 SEATS AND EVERY SINGLE TEAM IS COMPLAINING. EXPORTS ARE TIMING OUT AND CHARTS FAIL TO RENDER AT ALL ON THE ENERGY CONSUMPTION REPORTS.

WE PAY FOR ENTERPRISE SUPPORT AND THIS IS UNACCEPTABLE. IF THIS ISN'T FIXED IMMEDIATELY WE WILL BE ESCALATING THIS TO OUR ACCOUNT TEAM AND REVIEWING OUR CONTRACT. FIX THIS NOW.
answer: We understand the severity of this and are treating it as a P1 incident affecting your full organization right now - our performance team is already investigating the dashboard rendering delays and export timeouts on the energy consumption reports specifically. We're pulling query performance logs from the past three days to identify the bottleneck and will have a dedicated engineer assigned within the next 30 minutes with a direct update channel for your team. We'll keep you continuously informed until this is resolved.

subject: Unsubscribe link missing from notification emails
body: We're getting compliance questions from our own clients because the transactional emails sent through Northwind Notifications don't include an unsubscribe or preference link. As a fintech we need to document opt-out handling for our audit trail. Can you confirm whether this is configurable on our end or if it needs to be added at the template level?
answer: Thanks for flagging this. Unsubscribe links can be added via the notification template editor under Settings > Notifications > Templates, and we also have a global footer option that appends a compliance-ready opt-out link to all outbound emails automatically. I'll send over the documentation link and a short guide on setting the preference center up so you have something concrete for your audit trail.

subject: URGENT: Need immediate restore from backup, files missing after migration
body: During our scheduled storage migration last night (Oct 14, around 11pm) we noticed that 3 of our shared drives totaling roughly 40GB of case files are no longer showing in Storage. Our team of 243 users relies on these daily and several partners are asking for documents this morning. We need a restore from the most recent backup point before the migration started.
answer: This is being escalated immediately as a P1. Our storage team is pulling the backup snapshot from prior to the migration window and beginning a restore to a recovery workspace so we don't overwrite anything further. I'll update you within the hour with an ETA and a list of affected folders so your team can verify contents once the restore completes.

subject: Terminated employee still has active access - need immediate deactivation
body: One of our contract attorneys was terminated this morning and legal compliance requires immediate revocation of all system access, but I'm unable to deactivate their account from the Admin Console - the deactivate button returns an error and the user still shows as active with valid login sessions. Given the nature of client data involved, this needs to be resolved right now.
answer: We've escalated this to our security team as a P0 and are force-terminating the user's active sessions and access tokens on our side immediately while we investigate the console error. You'll receive confirmation the moment access is fully revoked, and we'll also pull the audit log entries for that account so you have a record for your compliance file.

subject: Getting duplicate push notifications from API integration
body: I'm integrating the Notifications API for our booking confirmation flow and noticing that some users receive the same alert twice within a few seconds, roughly 1 in 20 calls based on our logs. I suspect it might be related to retry behavior when the initial response is slow. Is there documentation on idempotency keys or recommended retry handling for this endpoint?
answer: Good catch - this is a known pattern when a request times out client-side but actually succeeded server-side, triggering a retry that sends a second notification. We support an Idempotency-Key header on the notifications endpoint that will dedupe repeated calls within a 24 hour window; I'll link you to the API reference section covering this along with recommended timeout and retry settings.

subject: Request: route alerts by severity to different teams
body: Right now all our system alerts go to a single email distribution list, which means our on-call logistics team is getting flooded with low-priority notices mixed in with urgent ones. We'd like to set up routing rules so critical alerts go to one group and informational ones go to another. Is this something Notifications supports, or do we need a workaround?
answer: This is possible today through alert rules based on severity tags - you can create separate routing rules under Notifications > Alerting that match on priority level and direct them to different recipient groups. I'll pass along a setup guide, and I've also logged your feedback about wanting a more visual rule builder for the product team's roadmap review.

subject: Duplicate alerts flooding our booking team - need this fixed today
body: Our booking confirmation notifications are being sent 2-3 times per event since yesterday, and it's confusing customers who think their reservation duplicated. We have 13 team members relying on these alerts for daily operations and this is actively causing customer confusion right now. Can someone help us identify the cause and stop the duplicates?
answer: I understand the urgency here and we're treating this as high priority. Can you share one or two message IDs or timestamps from the duplicated alerts so we can trace them through our delivery logs? In the meantime, I'd recommend checking whether your webhook endpoint is configured to retry on any response other than a 2xx, as that's the most common cause of this exact symptom, and we'll confirm from our side as soon as we see the trace.

subject: How to handle late-arriving records in pipeline connector
body: We're pulling transaction data through the Data Pipelines connector from our core banking system, and roughly 5-8% of records arrive with timestamps up to 48 hours after their event time, which is causing gaps in our daily aggregation windows. Is there a way to configure a watermark or grace period on the connector so late records get reprocessed into the correct window instead of being dropped?
answer: Yes, this is supported - our connectors allow you to set a lateness watermark under the pipeline's advanced settings, which holds windows open for a configurable grace period before finalizing aggregations. Given your 48 hour late-arrival pattern I'd suggest starting with a 60 hour watermark and monitoring reprocessing volume; I'll share the configuration doc and flag your use case to our connector team as a good example for the upcoming late-data handling feature.

subject: Request: native Slack integration for critical alerts
body: We currently route Northwind alerts through email and it's slow for our ops team to notice critical issues. We'd like to set up a direct Slack integration so alerts post to specific channels, similar to how our Okta and Salesforce integrations already work with Slack. Does Northwind support this natively, or would we need to build a custom webhook?
answer: We do have a native Slack integration available under Integrations > Connected Apps that supports channel-specific routing rules by alert type, so you shouldn't need a custom webhook. I'll send setup instructions along with notes on scoping permissions similarly to how your Okta and Salesforce connections are configured, and I've noted your interest as feedback for expanding alert customization options.

subject: Uploads failing intermittently for patient record backups
body: Our team has been unable to complete uploads to Storage for the past two days - about 1 in 4 attempts fail partway through with a generic 'upload interrupted' message, even for files under 50MB. We use this for nightly backup of patient intake records and need reliable uploads given the compliance sensitivity of this data. Can you check if there's a quota or throttling issue on our account?
answer: Thank you for the detailed report - given the compliance-sensitive nature of this data we're prioritizing this. Initial checks show your account is under its storage quota, so we're now looking at whether there's throttling happening at the upload gateway level during your upload window. Can you confirm the approximate times of the last 2-3 failed uploads so we can match them against our logs and identify the root cause?

subject: Invoice shows more seats than we actually have active
body: Our latest invoice bills for 76 seats but when I check the Admin Console we only have 68 active users - the other 8 appear to be deactivated accounts that weren't removed from the billing count. Can you clarify how seat counts are calculated and whether we're eligible for a credit or refund on the difference for this billing cycle?
answer: Thanks for catching this - seat counts should sync based on active users only, so deactivated accounts remaining in the billed count does sound like a bug on our end. I'm looping in our billing team to review your account and recalculate based on the 68 active seats; if the discrepancy is confirmed we'll issue a credit for the difference on this cycle, and I'll follow up with documentation on how seat counts are meant to be calculated going forward.

subject: Dashboard sharing permissions not respecting group settings
body:
I'm trying to share our Q3 budget dashboard with the education team group but individual members outside that group can still view it after I export the share link. I set the permission to 'group only' under Sharing settings but it seems to default back to 'anyone with link' every time I re-open the dashboard editor. This is a compliance concern since the dashboard has enrollment data.

Can you confirm whether this is expected behavior or a bug? We have 99 seats on this workspace and need to lock this down before our board review next week.
answer: Thanks for flagging this. The reset-to-public behavior sounds like a known issue where the sharing scope reverts after certain edits are made post-save rather than a permanent setting. Could you confirm which browser and whether you're using the new dashboard editor beta? In the meantime, please re-apply the group-only restriction and use the 'lock permissions' toggle in the share panel, which should prevent it from reverting while we investigate on our end.

subject: Seat count mismatch causing billing discrepancy
body:
Our latest invoice shows charges for 285 seats but our actual active user count in the admin console is 273. I've checked our user list twice and deactivated a batch of contractors last month, so I'm not sure why the higher number is being billed. This is affecting our finance reconciliation for this cycle.

Can someone look into why the seat count on the invoice doesn't match what's shown in our workspace? We'd like this corrected or refunded for the difference before the payment is processed.
answer: Thank you for catching this discrepancy. Seat counts are typically calculated based on the peak active user count during the billing period, which may include seats deactivated partway through the cycle. I'm escalating this to our billing team to pull the historical seat log for your workspace and confirm the exact figures, and we'll issue an adjustment or refund for any overcharge once verified, likely within 3-5 business days.

subject: Large file uploads failing intermittently to Storage
body:
Since October 12th we've had multiple team members report that video asset uploads over 2GB to our Storage buckets are failing partway through with a generic 'upload interrupted' message. This is happening across different regions and browsers, and it's affecting our media retention workflow since these files need to be backed up before we can delete local copies.

We have around 622 seats on this workspace and this is becoming a real bottleneck for our content team. Is there a file size limit we're hitting, or is this related to a quota issue on our end?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. Uploads failing at that size range on Enterprise storage usually point to either a timeout on long-running transfers or an approaching quota threshold rather than a hard file size cap. I'm pulling the upload logs for your workspace now to check for quota warnings or timeout errors around October 12th, and will follow up shortly with findings and next steps, including whether a multipart upload setting adjustment would help.

subject: Storage quota reached, backups not running
body:
Our team just got an alert that our storage quota is at 98% and I noticed our nightly backup job failed last night as a result. We're only on the Starter plan with 3 seats so I understand the limits, but I wasn't expecting to hit the ceiling this fast since we only started uploading design files two weeks ago.

Could you tell me what our current quota actually is and whether there's a way to see a breakdown of what's using the most space? We'd rather clean up unnecessary files than upgrade right away if possible.
answer: Happy to help clarify this. Starter plan storage is capped at 50GB per workspace, and I can see your usage is currently sitting just under that limit, largely from a set of large design asset versions retained under the default backup policy. I'd recommend checking the storage breakdown page under Settings > Storage Usage, which shows per-folder size, and you can also adjust the backup retention window to reduce how many historical versions are kept if you want to free up space without upgrading.

subject: Offline mode improvements for mobile app
body:
Our field teams frequently work in areas with poor connectivity and we've noticed the mobile app currently caches very limited data when offline, mostly just the last viewed dashboard. When they reconnect, sometimes the app crashes on sync rather than merging changes cleanly. This isn't blocking work entirely but it's a recurring frustration across our regional offices.

Is there a roadmap item for expanding offline caching, or a recommended workaround in the meantime? We'd love to be able to pre-download more content before our teams head into low-signal areas.
answer: Thanks for the detailed feedback, this is genuinely useful for our product team. Expanded offline caching and more robust sync/merge handling are on our mobile roadmap, though I don't have a firm release date to share yet. In the meantime, a workaround some customers use is manually pre-loading key dashboards while on Wi-Fi, which reduces sync conflicts on reconnect. I'll log the crash-on-sync behavior you described as a bug report so our mobile team can investigate separately.

subject: Deactivated users still showing as active via API
body:
I'm integrating with the Admin Console API to sync user status with our internal HR system, and I've run into an issue where users deactivated through the API still return "status": "active" when queried via GET /v1/admin/users/{id} for up to 10-15 minutes afterward. This is causing our sync job to re-provision access incorrectly for a couple of employees who were offboarded yesterday.

Is this delay expected due to caching, and if so, is there a way to force an immediate status refresh or a webhook I can subscribe to instead of polling?
answer: Good catch, and thanks for the specific reproduction detail. There is a short propagation delay on user status changes due to caching on our end, typically under 15 minutes, but we agree that's not ideal for offboarding workflows where timing matters. We do have a user.deactivated webhook event available that fires immediately on the change, which would be a better fit than polling the GET endpoint. I'll send over the webhook documentation and setup steps for your integration.

subject: Duplicate alerts being routed to wrong channels
body:
We've configured alert routing so that billing-related notifications go to our finance Slack channel and system alerts go to engineering, but for the past few days both channels are receiving duplicate copies of every alert regardless of category. This started after we updated one of our routing rules on Tuesday to add a new email fallback recipient.

Can you help us figure out if the new fallback rule is causing the duplication, or if this is a broader issue with the alert routing engine? It's creating a lot of noise for our team.
answer: Thanks for the timeline, that's very helpful. Adding an email fallback recipient to an existing rule can sometimes cause the rule engine to evaluate both the original routing condition and the fallback path as separate matches, which would explain the duplicates. Could you share the exact rule configuration or a screenshot of the routing rule you edited on Tuesday? In the meantime, I'd suggest temporarily disabling the fallback recipient to confirm it stops the duplication while we dig into the routing logic.

subject: Users getting logged out too frequently via SSO
body:
Several of our team members have mentioned that they're being logged out of Northwind and prompted to re-authenticate through our SSO provider much more often than expected, sometimes within 20-30 minutes of signing in. We haven't changed our session timeout configuration on our identity provider side recently, so I wanted to check if something changed on Northwind's end.

This isn't blocking anyone's work but it is becoming a minor annoyance across the team, especially for people switching between the dashboard and billing sections.
answer: Thanks for reaching out about this. Session duration for SSO logins is generally controlled by the SAML assertion timeout set on your identity provider, but we did roll out a change to our session refresh handling recently that could be interacting with shorter-lived tokens unexpectedly. Could you let me know which identity provider you're using and roughly when the frequent logouts started? I'll also check our session logs for your workspace to see if there's a pattern worth flagging to engineering.

subject: Need to update IP allowlist for admin console access
body:
We're rolling out a new office location and need to add a range of IP addresses to our Admin Console allowlist so staff there can access admin settings. Currently only our headquarters IP range is allowlisted, and I want to make sure adding the new range doesn't temporarily lock out our current admins during the change.

Could you walk me through the safest way to update this, and also confirm whether allowlist changes are recorded in the audit log? We want to keep a clear record for our internal compliance review this quarter.
answer: Good question, and yes, all allowlist changes are automatically recorded in the audit log with a timestamp and the admin account that made the change, which should cover your compliance review needs. To avoid any lockout risk, I'd recommend adding the new IP range first and confirming it saves successfully before removing or modifying any existing entries, rather than replacing the list in one step. Let me know once you're ready to make the change and I can also walk through it live if that's easier.

subject: Urgent: need files restored from backup after accidental deletion
body:
One of our team members accidentally deleted an entire folder of financial reporting files from Storage this morning around 9:15am, roughly 40 files total including our Q3 close documents. I checked the trash/recovery section but it's already empty, and I need these restored from backup as soon as possible since our audit deadline is tomorrow.

We're on the Starter plan and I'm not sure what our backup retention window actually covers. Please advise urgently on how to get these files recovered.
answer: I understand the urgency and I'm escalating this immediately to our storage recovery team. Starter plan retains nightly backup snapshots for 7 days, and since the deletion happened this morning, we should have a snapshot from last night that predates it. I'll initiate a restore request for the affected folder right now and will follow up within the hour with a status update and expected recovery time.

subject: Salesforce sync missing opportunity updates
body:
We use the Integrations module to sync Salesforce opportunities into Northwind, and since Tuesday (June 3rd) the sync is missing updates on about 15 records. I checked the Salesforce side and the fields are updated there, but Northwind still shows stale data from last week. Our sync log shows last successful run at 09:12 AM and nothing since.

Can you confirm if this is a known issue with the connector or if we need to re-authenticate the Salesforce OAuth token? We'd also like to know if there's a way to get Slack notifications when a sync fails, similar to what we set up for Jira and Okta.
answer:
Thanks for the detailed report. This pattern matches an OAuth token refresh issue we've seen with a few Salesforce connectors after a permission change on the Salesforce side. I'm going to check your integration's token status and force a re-authentication on our end, then trigger a manual sync to backfill the missed records.

On the Slack notification request, that's not yet available for sync failures but I'll log it as a feature request tied to your account. I'll update this ticket once the backfill completes, expect that within the next few hours.

subject: Need accurate seat count reconciliation for invoicing
body:
Our last invoice shows 221 active seats billed but our internal HR system only lists 205 employees with active Northwind accounts. I pulled the admin console export and I'm seeing this discrepancy:

```
GET /api/v2/org/seats?status=active
200 OK
{"total_seats": 221, "billed_seats": 221, "deactivated_pending": 16}
```

It looks like 16 deactivated users are still counted as billed. Can you reconcile this and issue a credit for the overcount on our next invoice? We'd also like a way to auto-deactivate seats after 30 days of inactivity if that feature exists on the Pro plan.
answer:
Thanks for flagging this with the API output, that's very helpful. The 16 accounts showing as "deactivated_pending" are likely stuck in our offboarding queue instead of being fully removed from billing, which is a known edge case when deactivation happens mid-cycle. I'll have our billing team reconcile your seat count and apply a prorated credit for the overcounted seats on your next invoice.

Regarding auto-deactivation after inactivity, that feature is available on Pro plans under Admin > Seat Policies, I'll send you a quick setup guide separately so you can configure the 30-day threshold.

subject: Recurring card decline on monthly billing
body:
Our company card has failed twice now for the Northwind Starter subscription, once on May 28th and again on June 1st. Both times the decline reason listed was "insufficient funds" but our finance team confirms the account had sufficient balance both dates. We updated the card on file yesterday and want to confirm the next charge will go through.

Also wondering if there's a grace period before service is suspended when a payment fails, since we can't afford any downtime for our 25 users.
answer:
Thanks for letting us know and for updating the card already. I can see both failed attempts on our end and confirm the new card details were saved successfully yesterday; the next billing cycle will retry automatically and should process without issue.

To answer your question, we provide a 7-day grace period after a failed payment before any service restrictions apply, so your account is not at risk currently. I'll monitor the next charge attempt and follow up here once it clears.

subject: PDF export completely broken on all dashboards
body:
Since this morning, every dashboard export to PDF fails immediately with a generic "Export failed, please try again" message. I've tested this on three different dashboards including our main energy consumption report that leadership reviews weekly, and all three fail the same way. This started around 8:40 AM today and we have a board meeting in two hours where we need these exports.

We only have 7 seats so this is affecting our entire team simultaneously, not just one user. Please treat this as urgent.
answer:
I understand the urgency given your meeting timeline and I'm escalating this immediately as a P1. We've had one other report of PDF export failures in the last hour and our engineering team is actively investigating a possible issue with the export rendering service.

In the meantime, as a workaround you can try exporting the dashboard as CSV or PNG from the same export menu, which should still work. I'll update you within the next 30 minutes with a status, and will prioritize getting PDF export restored before your meeting if at all possible.

subject: Alert routing sending duplicate emails to wrong team
body:
I set up alert routing rules last week so that inventory threshold alerts go to our logistics team and pricing alerts go to our revenue team, but for the past three days both alert types are being sent to both teams, doubling our email volume. We're seeing roughly 40 duplicate alerts per day across the two distribution lists.

Could you walk me through how the routing conditions are supposed to be configured? I suspect I may have set an overlapping condition on the "category" field but I can't find documentation on how routing precedence works when two rules match.
answer:
Thanks for the detailed description, this is a common configuration issue. Routing rules are evaluated in the order they appear in your rule list, and if two rules both match a category field without an explicit exclusion, the alert gets sent to both destinations rather than the first match winning. I'd recommend adding a mutually exclusive condition (for example, category equals inventory AND NOT pricing) to each rule.

I'll send over our routing precedence guide and can also hop on a short call if you'd like help reviewing your specific rule set to eliminate the overlap.

subject: Slack-Benachrichtigungen für Eskalationen funktionieren nicht
body:
Wir haben letzte Woche die Slack-Integration eingerichtet, damit kritische Support-Eskalationen automatisch in unserem #urgent-Kanal gepostet werden. Seit heute Morgen kommen keine Nachrichten mehr an, obwohl im Northwind-Dashboard mehrere Eskalationen als "gesendet" markiert sind. Wir nutzen dieselbe Integration auch für Jira und Okta, dort funktioniert alles normal.

Das betrifft unser gesamtes Support-Team, da wir uns komplett auf diese Slack-Alerts verlassen, um schnell auf Kundenanfragen zu reagieren. Können Sie das bitte dringend prüfen?
answer:
Vielen Dank für die schnelle Meldung, das behandeln wir als P1. Es sieht so aus, als ob der Slack-Webhook-Token für Ihren Workspace möglicherweise abgelaufen oder widerrufen wurde, während die Jira- und Okta-Integrationen davon unabhängig sind. Ich prüfe gerade den Status Ihres Webhooks und werde die Verbindung neu autorisieren.

Ich melde mich innerhalb der nächsten Stunde mit einem Update und stelle sicher, dass die ausstehenden Eskalationsbenachrichtigungen nachträglich zugestellt werden, sobald die Verbindung wiederhergestellt ist.

subject: Urgent: need new API keys issued before rate limit deprecation
body:
We received a notice that our current API key format is being deprecated on June 15th and we need to migrate to the new key format before then. We have three production integrations pulling healthcare shipment data every 5 minutes using the old keys, and I need to understand the migration path so we don't hit downtime.

Can you confirm whether the new keys will have different rate limits than our current 600 requests/minute allowance? We also need the updated SDK version that supports the new key format, our current SDK is v2.3.1 and I don't see key rotation support in the changelog for that version.
answer:
Thanks for reaching out ahead of the deprecation date, this is exactly the right time to start migrating. The new key format keeps the same 600 requests/minute limit for your current tier, so no change there. You'll need SDK v3.0.0 or later for native support of the new key format and built-in rotation; v2.3.1 will continue working until June 15th but won't support the new keys.

I'm generating your new API keys now and will send migration instructions along with a checklist for rotating across your three production integrations with zero downtime. Given the deadline, I'm marking this P1 and will follow up within the day.

subject: Request to review transform failure handling in pipeline builder
body:
Our data pipelines occasionally hit transform failures when source connectors deliver malformed rows, and currently the entire pipeline run fails rather than skipping bad rows. Over the last month we've had this happen on 4 separate runs across our media analytics pipeline, each time requiring manual intervention to identify and remove the offending rows before re-running.

I'd like to propose adding a configurable option to route failed rows to a dead-letter queue instead of failing the whole run, similar to what some competitors offer. Is this something on the roadmap, and if not, could we get it considered as a feature request for the Pro plan?
answer:
Thanks for the well-documented use case, this is a request we've heard from a few other Pro customers running high-volume connectors. Dead-letter queue support for failed rows isn't currently on our near-term roadmap, but I'm logging this as a formal feature request tied to your account with the specifics you provided.

In the meantime, one partial workaround is to enable row-level validation rules on the connector config, which can catch some malformed data before it reaches the transform step and reduce (though not eliminate) full-run failures. I'll keep you updated if this feature gets prioritized.

subject: Plan upgrade stuck, still showing Starter limits
body:
I initiated an upgrade from Starter to Pro plan yesterday afternoon through the billing portal, the payment went through successfully and I received a confirmation email with a receipt, but our account is still enforcing Starter plan limits. Our team of 7 is blocked from adding two new users we need onboarded today because the system says we've hit our seat cap.

This is holding up onboarding for a new project starting this week. Please escalate, we need the Pro plan features active as soon as possible.
answer:
I'm sorry for the disruption this is causing, especially with onboarding pending. I can see your payment processed successfully but the plan upgrade didn't propagate to your account's feature flags, which happens occasionally when the billing and provisioning systems fall out of sync. I'm manually applying the Pro plan tier to your account right now.

This should take effect within the next 15 minutes; please try adding your new users again after that and let me know immediately if the seat cap is still showing Starter limits.

subject: Question on data retention policy and quota impact
body:
As workspace admin I'm trying to understand how Northwind's storage retention settings interact with our quota. We're currently at 78% of our storage quota and I want to set up automatic deletion of files older than 18 months, but I can't find where to configure retention rules per folder versus workspace-wide in the admin console.

Also, if we enable retention deletion, does that count against our backup snapshots too, or are backups retained separately regardless of the retention policy? We have about 241 users uploading files daily so I want to make sure we don't accidentally delete anything still needed.
answer:
Good questions, and I want to make sure retention is set up safely given your upload volume. Retention rules can be configured at both the workspace level and per-folder under Admin > Storage > Retention Policies; per-folder rules always override the workspace default when both are present, so you can exempt specific folders if needed.

On backups, retention deletion policies apply only to primary storage and do not automatically delete backup snapshots, those follow a separate 90-day backup retention cycle by default. I'd recommend testing your 18-month rule on a single low-risk folder first before applying it workspace-wide, happy to walk through the setup with you if useful.

subject: Fehlgeschlagene Uploads bei Compliance-Dokumenten
body:
Seit dem 12. dieses Monats schlagen bei uns wiederholt Uploads von Compliance-Dokumenten im Storage-Bereich fehl. Betroffen sind vor allem PDF-Dateien über 15 MB, die für unsere ISO-Zertifizierung archiviert werden müssen. Die Fehlermeldung lautet schlicht 'Upload fehlgeschlagen, bitte erneut versuchen', ein erneuter Versuch bringt aber keinen Erfolg.

Könnten Sie uns sagen, ob es eine Dateigrößenbeschränkung gibt und ob es möglich wäre, für Compliance-Dokumente eine höhere Grenze einzurichten? Eine kurze Dokumentation zu den aktuellen Limits wäre ebenfalls hilfreich.
answer:
Vielen Dank für die genaue Beschreibung. Aktuell liegt das Standardlimit für Einzeldateien im Storage-Bereich bei 10 MB, was die Fehlermeldung bei Ihren PDFs erklärt. Wir prüfen intern, ob für Compliance-Dokumente eine Ausnahme mit höherem Limit eingerichtet werden kann, und melden uns dazu innerhalb der nächsten zwei Werktage.

Bis dahin empfehlen wir, die betroffenen Dateien vorübergehend zu komprimieren oder in mehrere kleinere Dokumente aufzuteilen, damit die Archivierung nicht ins Stocken gerät.

subject: Webhook delivery breaking after SDK v3 deprecation notice
body:
We just saw the deprecation notice for SDK v2 webhook signing and need this resolved before the cutover on the 30th. Our integration listens on /webhooks/northwind and validates signatures using the v2 HMAC helper from the SDK, but the new v3 docs reference a different header name (X-Northwind-Signature-256 vs the old X-Northwind-Signature).

We have roughly 40 webhook consumers across our logistics dashboards relying on this, so a breaking change here will affect order status updates for all our customers. Can you confirm the exact migration steps and whether there's a grace period where both headers are sent?
answer:
Thanks for flagging this ahead of the cutover — this is a common point of confusion during the v2 to v3 migration. To confirm: during the transition window (until the 30th), we send both the legacy X-Northwind-Signature and the new X-Northwind-Signature-256 headers, so your existing validation won't break immediately, but you should switch to the new header and SHA-256 scheme before that date since v2 signing will be fully retired.

We'll send you a migration checklist and updated SDK snippet for the v3 signature verification within the hour so your team can update the 40 consumers with time to test before cutover.

subject: Zapier integration silently dropping records from Jira sync
body:
We use the Zapier integration to push patient intake form completions from Northwind into Jira tickets for our clinical operations team. Since last week, we've noticed that roughly 1 in 5 records simply don't create a Jira ticket at all, with no error shown in the Zap history — it just says 'Success' even though nothing appears in Jira.

Our Slack channel that mirrors these tickets is also missing the same entries, so this isn't a Jira-side filter issue. We've checked field mappings and they look unchanged since the integration was set up in March. Can someone help us figure out why records are being dropped?
answer:
Thank you for the detailed report — a silent drop with a false 'Success' status points to a likely timing or payload size issue on the trigger side rather than your field mappings. We're pulling the integration logs for your Zapier connection now to compare timestamps against the missing records you can identify.

Could you send us three or four specific record IDs or timestamps for entries that didn't sync? That will let us trace the exact webhook payloads and confirm whether this is a rate-limiting issue on our end or something in the Zapier queue.

subject: URGENT: Invoice shows 2400 seats, we only have 2107 active
body:
Our latest invoice, dated the 1st, bills us for 2400 seats at the Enterprise rate, but our actual active seat count in the admin console shows 2107. This is a significant overcharge and finance needs it corrected before the payment run goes out on Friday. We deactivated 293 seats back in early last month as part of a warehouse consolidation and expected the next invoice to reflect that.

We need either a corrected invoice or a credit applied immediately, and an explanation of why the seat count didn't sync after the deactivation. This is holding up our AP process.
answer:
We understand the urgency and are treating this as a priority billing incident. We can confirm from your account activity that the 293 seat deactivations were recorded on our side, so this looks like a sync issue between the seat management system and invoice generation for this billing cycle.

We're issuing a corrected invoice reflecting the 2107 active seats today and will apply a credit for the difference to your next statement if payment has already been scheduled. We'll follow up within a few hours with the corrected invoice number and credit confirmation.

subject: Need help enrolling team in MFA before audit deadline
body: We have a fintech compliance audit coming up and need all 6 of our seats enrolled in MFA through Northwind Identity by end of this week. Two of our team members tried the enrollment flow and got stuck after scanning the QR code — the app shows 'Verification pending' indefinitely and never confirms the code entry.
answer:
Given the audit deadline, we're prioritizing this right away. The 'Verification pending' stall usually happens when the authenticator app's time isn't synced with the server, so please ask the two affected users to check that their device's automatic time sync is enabled and try re-scanning a fresh QR code from their profile settings.

If that doesn't resolve it, send us the two usernames and we'll manually reset their MFA enrollment state so they can start clean. We're also happy to jump on a short call today to walk through enrolling all 6 seats before your deadline.

subject: Abmeldelink in Benachrichtigungs-E-Mails funktioniert nicht
body:
Mehrere Kollegen aus der Finanzabteilung haben sich über doppelte Benachrichtigungs-E-Mails beschwert, die trotz Klick auf 'Abbestellen' weiterhin ankommen. Der Abmeldelink führt zu einer Seite mit der Meldung 'Anfrage konnte nicht verarbeitet werden'. Das betrifft mindestens vier Personen in unserem Team seit letzter Woche.

Können Sie prüfen, ob es ein bekanntes Problem mit dem Unsubscribe-Mechanismus gibt, und uns eine Rückmeldung geben, wann eine Lösung zu erwarten ist? Es handelt sich nicht um einen dringenden Fall, aber es sollte behoben werden.
answer:
Vielen Dank für die Meldung. Wir sind uns eines Problems mit dem Abmeldelink bewusst, das bei bestimmten E-Mail-Vorlagen auftritt und derzeit von unserem Team untersucht wird. Als Zwischenlösung können wir die betroffenen vier Personen manuell aus der Benachrichtigungsliste entfernen, wenn Sie uns deren Benutzernamen mitteilen.

Wir melden uns, sobald der Fix für den Abmeldemechanismus ausgerollt wurde, damit zukünftige Abbestellungen automatisch funktionieren.

subject: Hitting rate limits on /events endpoint during batch imports
body:
We're running nightly batch imports of student engagement data through the /events endpoint and started hitting 429 responses consistently around the 8,000th request in a single run. Our current setup makes sequential calls with the Python SDK version 2.4, and we don't see clear guidance in the docs on what the per-minute limit actually is for our tier.

Could you clarify the exact rate limit thresholds and whether there's a batch or bulk-import endpoint we should be using instead? We'd also like to know if a webhook-based push model is available so we don't need to poll for these imports at all.
answer:
Thanks for the detailed context. On your current tier, the /events endpoint is limited to 600 requests per minute, so hitting 429s around request 8,000 lines up with a sustained burst well above that threshold — the SDK doesn't currently auto-throttle, which is worth noting in the docs.

For nightly batch jobs like yours, we'd recommend switching to the /events/bulk endpoint, which accepts up to 500 records per call and has a separate, higher limit. We'll also send you the webhook setup guide so you can move to a push-based model instead of polling, which should eliminate this bottleneck entirely.

subject: Workspace settings reverted and users deactivated overnight
body:
This morning we found that our workspace settings in the Admin Console had reverted to defaults — our custom timezone, approval workflow settings, and branding were all wiped. Additionally, three of our 18 users show as deactivated even though no one on our side made that change. This happened sometime between yesterday evening and this morning.

We need to know what caused this and get the settings and the three users restored as soon as possible, since it's affecting daily approval workflows for our finance team.
answer:
We're sorry for the disruption and are looking into this right away. We can see from the audit log that a configuration rollback event occurred on your workspace around 2 AM, which likely triggered both the settings reset and the deactivation of the three users — we're still confirming the root cause on our end.

We're restoring your custom timezone, approval workflow, and branding settings now, and reactivating the three affected users. We'll follow up with a full explanation of what caused the rollback once our engineering team confirms the trigger.

subject: UNSUBSCRIBE BUTTON DOES NOTHING - STILL GETTING SPAMMED
body: THIS IS THE THIRD TIME I AM WRITING ABOUT THIS. WE CLICK UNSUBSCRIBE ON THE ALERT EMAILS AND WE STILL GET THE SAME NOTIFICATION EVERY HOUR. OUR WHOLE TEAM OF 7 IS GETTING FLOODED WITH THE SAME LOW STORAGE ALERT SINCE TUESDAY. THE LINK JUST GOES TO A BLANK PAGE. THIS IS RIDICULOUS AND IF IT ISN'T FIXED TODAY WE WILL LOOK AT OTHER PROVIDERS.
answer:
We understand the frustration and apologize for the repeated issue — we're escalating this immediately as a bug in the unsubscribe flow rather than a one-off glitch. Please send us the exact alert type (looks like the low storage alert) and we'll manually suppress it for all 7 of your team's accounts within the hour while we fix the broken unsubscribe link.

We're also flagging this to engineering as a priority defect since it's clearly affecting more than one customer, and we'll confirm back to you today once the suppression is in place and the underlying link is patched.

subject: Confusion about API key rotation and deprecated header
body:
I'm reviewing our API integration ahead of a planned key rotation and noticed the docs still reference the X-Api-Key header as deprecated, but our current keys created last month still use that exact header format. We have two active keys tied to our logistics dashboard webhooks and want to rotate them without breaking anything.

Could someone confirm whether new keys generated today will use a different auth scheme, and if there's a recommended rotation process that avoids downtime for our webhook consumers?
answer:
Good question, and glad you're checking before rotating. New keys generated today still use the X-Api-Key header — the deprecation notice in the docs refers to a future change planned for next quarter, not something in effect yet, so your current format remains valid.

For a zero-downtime rotation, we recommend generating the new key first, updating your webhook consumers to use it, and only revoking the old key once you've confirmed traffic has shifted over. We'll also update the docs to clarify the deprecation timeline so this is less confusing going forward.

subject: Mobile app crashes on launch after latest build
body: We're integrating the Northwind API into our LMS and testing the companion mobile app on iOS 17.4. The app crashes immediately on launch for about 3 out of 10 test devices, right after the splash screen. We're on app version 4.2.1. Crash happens before any API calls are made, so I don't think it's on our end, but wanted to flag it since it's blocking our QA sign-off.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. A launch-time crash before any network calls suggests a local initialization issue, possibly tied to a device-specific cache or config file from a previous build. Could you send us the crash logs from one of the affected devices (Settings > Privacy > Analytics on iOS) along with the device models? We'll cross-check against known issues in 4.2.1 and follow up shortly.

subject: Scheduled syncs failing across multiple connectors since last night
body: Since around 11pm last night, our scheduled data pipeline syncs have been failing intermittently across three connectors (Salesforce, Postgres, and our S3 warehouse feed). We're seeing sync latency jump from the usual 5-10 minutes to over 2 hours, and two of the last six runs errored out entirely with 'connector timeout' messages. This is affecting downstream reporting for our clinical teams who rely on daily refreshed data. We have 273 seats on this and need this resolved quickly as it's a major disruption.
answer: We're sorry for the disruption and have escalated this to our pipeline infrastructure team as a P1 incident. We're seeing elevated latency on our connector layer that appears to correlate with a backend scaling event last night, and we're actively investigating the timeout errors on the affected connectors. We'll update you within the hour with either a fix or a mitigation plan, and in the meantime we recommend pausing non-critical scheduled syncs to reduce load.

subject: Duplicate push notifications being sent to end users
body: We're integrating the Notifications API and noticed that some of our retail customers are receiving the same alert 2-3 times within a few seconds. This started after we updated our webhook handler on the 14th. Our logs show only one API call per event on our side, so it looks like the duplication is happening upstream. Can you check if there's retry logic on your end that might be firing multiple times per event ID?
answer: Thanks for flagging this - duplicate deliveries are usually caused by our retry mechanism firing when it doesn't receive a 200 response quickly enough from the receiving webhook. Can you confirm the average response time of your webhook handler and share a couple of affected event IDs? We'll check our delivery logs against those IDs to see if retries are being triggered unnecessarily.

subject: Cannot share dashboards with specific team members - permission error
body: I'm trying to share several dashboards with our clinical analytics team but keep getting an error that says 'insufficient permissions' even though I'm the dashboard owner and have admin rights on our account. This is blocking our weekly reporting cycle since none of my team can access the updated charts. It started happening yesterday after I tried to update the sharing settings on our main KPI dashboard.
answer: Thanks for reporting this - a permissions error for a dashboard owner shouldn't happen, so we're treating this as a bug affecting sharing functionality. Could you send us the dashboard ID and the account emails you're trying to share with? We'll reproduce this on our end and prioritize a fix given the impact on your reporting workflow.

subject: Dashboard sharing broken for entire team - export also failing
body: As of this morning, none of our team members can access shared dashboards - they get a blank screen instead of the charts. On top of that, PDF exports from the logistics overview dashboard are timing out after about 30 seconds. This is blocking our morning ops review meeting which relies on these shared views. We have 5 seats on our account and this is affecting all of them.
answer: We understand this is disrupting your team's operations and have escalated this as a P1 incident. The blank screen on shared dashboards and export timeouts may be related to a rendering service issue we're currently investigating. We'll update you within the hour with progress, and in the meantime we recommend accessing dashboards directly via the owner's account as a temporary workaround.

subject: Storage quota reached unexpectedly, backups failing
body: Our storage usage jumped from around 340GB to over 500GB overnight even though we haven't changed our retention settings. This pushed us over our quota and now our nightly backup job is failing with a 'quota exceeded' error. We're integrating via the Storage API and haven't made any config changes on our side recently. Can you help us understand what's driving the increase and get backups running again?
answer: Thanks for the heads up - a sudden jump like that is unusual and we want to look into it before you hit further quota issues. Can you send us your account ID and the timestamp of the backup failure? We'll check for any retention policy changes or duplicate objects on our side that might explain the increase, and help get your quota adjusted temporarily so backups can resume.

subject: Deaktivierung von Nutzern funktioniert nicht korrekt
body: Wir versuchen seit letzter Woche mehrere ausgeschiedene Mitarbeiter über die Admin Console zu deaktivieren, aber im Audit Log erscheinen die Konten weiterhin als aktiv. Wir haben das bei drei verschiedenen Nutzerkonten getestet, zuletzt am 6. März. Können Sie uns sagen, ob es einen Bug bei der Deaktivierung gibt oder ob wir einen zusätzlichen Schritt übersehen haben? Für unsere Compliance-Prüfung benötigen wir eine verlässliche Bestätigung.
answer: Vielen Dank für die Meldung. Es könnte sich um eine Verzögerung bei der Synchronisierung des Audit Logs handeln, wir schließen aber einen Bug nicht aus. Könnten Sie uns die betroffenen Nutzer-IDs sowie die genauen Zeitstempel der Deaktivierungsversuche zusenden? Wir prüfen das umgehend und melden uns mit einer Lösung oder einem Workaround.

subject: URGENT: Unauthorized access detected via admin console allowlist bypass
body: We just discovered that our IP allowlist settings in the Admin Console appear to have been bypassed - we're seeing login activity from IP ranges outside our configured allowlist starting at 2:14am today. The audit log shows three admin accounts logging in from unrecognized locations, and one of those accounts made changes to security settings we didn't authorize. We need immediate help determining scope and locking this down.
answer: This has been escalated immediately as a P0 security incident and our security team is engaging right now. As an immediate step, please deactivate the three affected admin accounts and rotate their credentials while we investigate the allowlist bypass. We're pulling full audit logs for the affected time window and will be in direct contact within minutes with findings and containment steps.

subject: NEED SALESFORCE INTEGRATION FEATURE ASAP - SYNC KEEPS FAILING
body: WE ARE TRYING TO USE THE SALESFORCE INTEGRATION FOR OUR TRAVEL BOOKING WORKFLOW AND THE SYNC KEEPS DROPPING RECORDS. WE ALSO NEED SLACK AND JIRA CONNECTED FOR OUR OPS TEAM BUT THOSE OPTIONS AREN'T EVEN AVAILABLE ON OUR PLAN. THIS IS BLOCKING OUR TEAM FROM CLOSING BOOKINGS ON TIME. WE NEED THIS FIXED AND THE OTHER INTEGRATIONS ENABLED THIS WEEK.
answer: THANK YOU FOR FLAGGING THIS - WE UNDERSTAND THE URGENCY GIVEN THE IMPACT ON YOUR BOOKING WORKFLOW. CAN YOU SEND US A FEW RECORD IDS THAT FAILED TO SYNC SO WE CAN TRACE THE DROPPED RECORDS IN OUR SALESFORCE CONNECTOR LOGS? WE'LL ALSO CONNECT YOU WITH OUR ACCOUNT TEAM TO DISCUSS ENABLING SLACK AND JIRA INTEGRATIONS ON YOUR PLAN.

subject: PDF export failing on shared dashboard - urgent for exec review
body:
Our weekly exec dashboard export to PDF has been failing since this morning, right before our leadership review. Here's the error from the export log:

2024-06-11 08:42:03 ERROR ExportService: failed to render chart id=8841
Traceback: RenderTimeoutException at ChartRenderer.render(timeout=30000ms)
RenderTimeoutException: chart data payload exceeds 15MB, truncation failed
  at ExportWorker.process(job_id=9923)
2024-06-11 08:42:05 ERROR ExportJob: job 9923 marked as failed after 3 retries

This dashboard has 12 charts and was working fine last week. We need this fixed before 2pm today.
answer: Thanks for sending the log - this points to the chart renderer hitting a payload size limit, likely due to a recent increase in data volume on one of the underlying charts. We're escalating this now given your 2pm deadline. As a quick workaround, try removing or filtering chart id 8841 to a shorter date range and re-running the export while we investigate the size limit issue on our end.

subject: Storage upload failures hitting quota limit on backup jobs
body:
We're seeing repeated upload failures on our nightly backup jobs since Tuesday. The error returned is "STORAGE_QUOTA_EXCEEDED" even though our dashboard shows we're at 78% of allocated capacity. Job IDs bkp-9012 through bkp-9018 all failed between 02:00 and 03:15 UTC.

Could we get a review of our retention policy settings and possibly a temporary quota bump while we investigate? We have 282 seats on this workspace and this is affecting our compliance backup schedule for legal document retention.
answer: Thanks for flagging this, and I understand the urgency given the compliance backup schedule. I've pulled job logs for bkp-9012 through bkp-9018 and can see the quota calculation is including some stale snapshot data that hasn't been purged per your retention policy - this is likely why the reported usage doesn't match your dashboard. I'm applying a temporary quota increase now and opening a ticket with our storage team to fix the retention purge job; I'll update you within one business day.

subject: URGENT: IP allowlist not blocking unauthorized access attempts
body:
We configured an IP allowlist in the Admin Console yesterday restricting access to our office and VPN ranges only, but our audit log shows successful logins from IP addresses outside that list within the last hour, including 203.0.113.44 and 198.51.100.7. This is a serious security concern given we have 241 seats on this workspace and sensitive customer data in our account.

We need this locked down immediately. Please advise if the allowlist feature is malfunctioning or if we misconfigured something.
answer: This has been escalated to our security on-call team immediately given the active exposure.
