We're reviewing your allowlist configuration and the audit log entries you referenced right now - initial check suggests the allowlist rule may not have propagated to all regional edge nodes after your update yesterday, which would explain the bypass. As an immediate mitigation we're forcing a full config resync on your workspace; please monitor the audit log over the next 15 minutes and let us know if you see further unauthorized entries.

subject: Duplicate invoice charge needs refund
body:
I noticed our account was charged twice for the March invoice - once on March 1st for $340.00 and again on March 3rd for the same amount, both showing invoice number INV-88213 in the billing history. We're on the Starter plan with 14 seats so this is a meaningful overcharge for us.

Can you confirm this is a duplicate and process a refund for one of the charges? Also the billing page has been loading very slowly the past few days, sometimes timing out before showing invoice history.
answer: Thank you for catching this - I can confirm INV-88213 was processed twice due to a retry error on our payment gateway on March 3rd. I've initiated a refund for the duplicate $340.00 charge, which should appear on your statement within 5-7 business days. I'm also passing along the billing page performance issue to our platform team since that's a separate concern and shouldn't be happening; I'll follow up once I have more detail on the cause.

subject: Need higher rate limits and webhook retry config for API keys
body:
We're integrating your API into our manufacturing line monitoring tool and currently hitting the default rate limit of 100 requests/minute on our production key (key ID pk_live_4471). Our use case requires closer to 400 requests/minute during peak polling windows.

Also, could you point me to documentation on configuring webhook retry behavior? We noticed the deprecation notice for the v1 webhook payload format and want to make sure we migrate before it's sunset. We only have 3 seats but this integration is critical to our operations.
answer: Happy to help get this sorted. I've submitted a rate limit increase request for key pk_live_4471 to 400 requests/minute during peak windows - this typically takes 1-2 business days to take effect and I'll confirm once it's live. For webhook retry configuration, our current docs are at /docs/webhooks/retries, and regarding the v1 payload deprecation, the sunset date is set for June 30th, so I'd recommend planning the migration to v2 payloads in the next few weeks - let me know if you'd like a walkthrough.

subject: How to configure workspace settings and IP allowlist for new team members
body:
I'm setting up our workspace configuration and want to make sure new hires get added correctly. Could you walk me through how to set up an IP allowlist for our office network and also how deactivation works when an employee leaves - does it remove their audit log history or just disable login?

We're a small team of 20 seats on Starter so I want to get this right the first time. Any documentation links would be appreciated too.
answer: Great questions, and happy to clarify. For the IP allowlist, go to Admin Console > Security > Access Rules and add your office IP ranges in CIDR notation - changes typically propagate within a few minutes. For deactivation, disabling a user only revokes their login access; their audit log history is preserved indefinitely for compliance purposes and won't be deleted. I'll also send over our onboarding/offboarding guide which covers both topics in more detail.

subject: Recurring upload failures during monthly data export to Storage
body:
Our team runs a monthly batch upload of financial datasets to Storage, and for the past two cycles (Feb 28 and Mar 31) about 15-20% of files fail with a generic "upload interrupted" error, requiring manual retries. Files are typically 2-4GB CSV exports being pushed via the storage API.

Given we're on 265 seats and this is a recurring pattern now, could someone look into whether this is related to our quota limits, retention policy conflicts, or a backup process running concurrently? We'd also appreciate any feedback on best practices for large batch uploads to avoid this going forward.
answer: Thanks for the detailed pattern - two consecutive months pointing to the same failure rate is helpful for diagnosis. I've checked your storage logs for Feb 28 and Mar 31 and see the failures correlate with your scheduled backup retention sweep running concurrently with the uploads, which can cause connection resets on large file transfers. I'd recommend shifting your batch upload window to avoid overlap with the nightly retention job (currently scheduled 01:00-02:30 UTC), and I'm also flagging this to our engineering team to see if we can improve concurrency handling on our end.

subject: Question about unused credits after seat downgrade
body:
We recently reduced our seat count from 280 to 246 and I'm trying to understand how the prorated credit from that change gets applied. Our latest invoice doesn't seem to reflect any credit, and I want to make sure we're not missing a refund we're owed before we finalize our internal budget report.

Could someone explain how credits are calculated when seats are reduced mid-cycle, and confirm whether anything is pending on our account?
answer: Good question, and I've checked your account - the seat reduction from 280 to 246 was processed on the 12th, and prorated credits are typically applied to the next billing cycle rather than the current invoice, so you should see it reflected on your upcoming statement rather than the one you're looking at now. I can confirm there's a credit of $412.50 currently pending on your account, and I'll make a note so it's clearly itemized on next month's invoice for your records.

subject: SCIM provisioning failing for new user creation - blocking onboarding
body:
Our SCIM integration started failing yesterday when trying to provision new users into Northwind. We're getting a 400 response with body {"error":"invalid_schema","detail":"missing required attribute: urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User:name.familyName"} even though our IdP is sending that field correctly per our config export.

This is blocking onboarding for 4 new hires who need MFA and permission groups assigned before they can start work Monday. We only have 6 seats total so this is a significant portion of our team affected. Can someone check the SCIM endpoint logs on your end?
answer: I understand the urgency with new hires starting Monday, and I'm treating this as high priority. I've pulled the SCIM endpoint logs and can see the payloads from your IdP - it looks like the familyName attribute is being sent inside a nested extension object rather than the core schema namespace, which is why our validator is rejecting it as missing. I'm escalating to our identity engineering team now to check if we can relax the schema validation on our end as a same-day fix, and will update you within a few hours with either a resolution or a workaround for the four pending users.

subject: Request to disable biometric login for mobile app rollout
body:
We're planning a broader rollout of the mobile app to our field logistics teams and want to disable biometric login (Face ID/fingerprint) organization-wide for now, since several of our devices are shared between shift workers. Is this configurable at the workspace level, or does each user need to disable it individually in their app settings?

Separately, a few of our team members mentioned the app has been crashing when switching from offline mode back to online after a delivery route, so if that's a known issue any update would help us with rollout timing.
answer: Disabling biometric login organization-wide is possible - it's a setting under Admin Console > Mobile > Authentication Policy, and once toggled off there it will override individual device settings for all 267 seats on your workspace. Regarding the offline-to-online crash, we don't currently have an open issue matching that exact scenario, but I'd like to get a bit more detail - could you send us the app version and device OS versions affected so we can investigate before your rollout?

subject: MFA enrolment failing for users during API-based SSO flow
body:
We're integrating Northwind's Identity API for SSO into our legal document platform, and users attempting to enroll in MFA during the login flow are getting stuck - the enrollment QR code endpoint returns a 500 error intermittently, roughly 1 in 5 attempts, with no useful error message in the response body.

This is blocking a meaningful portion of our 223 seats from completing login since MFA enrollment is mandatory for our security policy. Is there a known issue with the enrollment endpoint, or documentation on retry handling we should implement on our side?
answer: Thanks for the report - a 1-in-5 intermittent failure rate on the enrollment endpoint affecting mandatory MFA is definitely something we need to resolve quickly given the login impact. I've checked our service metrics and see elevated error rates on the QR code generation service starting yesterday afternoon, which our platform team is now investigating as a priority. In the meantime, I'd recommend implementing exponential backoff retries (2-3 attempts) on your integration since most failures appear transient, and I'll update you as soon as we have a root cause or fix deployed.

subject: All connectors failing auth - production pipelines down
body:
Since about 40 minutes ago every connector in our energy-data pipeline is failing with 'AUTH_TOKEN_EXPIRED' even though we refreshed credentials last week. We have 14 sync jobs stuck in retry loops and downstream dashboards are showing stale data from 6:10am. This is affecting our entire operations team's ability to monitor field sensors right now.

We need this escalated immediately - our energy trading desk relies on these feeds being current within minutes, not hours.
answer: This has been escalated to our on-call pipeline engineering team as a P0 - I understand the impact this has on your trading desk's real-time monitoring. We're investigating the auth token refresh service now and suspect a regional token-issuer outage; I'll update you within 20 minutes with findings or a workaround. In the meantime, please don't manually re-trigger the stuck jobs as that could compound the retry backlog.

subject: Can we customize email digest frequency per team?
body:
Right now our weekly notification digests go out every Monday at 9am to all 237 seats, but our travel booking team wants daily digests while the finance team is happy with weekly. Is there a way to set digest frequency per group or per role instead of account-wide? I looked through the notification settings but only found one global toggle.

Also noticed we're getting duplicate digest emails on some Mondays - not urgent, just flagging it alongside the feature question.
answer: Thanks for flagging both of these. Per-group digest frequency isn't available yet - today it's account-wide only - but I've added your request to our feature backlog for notification granularity, which is gaining traction from other travel-sector customers too. On the duplicate emails, that's a known edge case tied to timezone recalculation on daylight-saving boundaries; can you confirm which Mondays you saw duplicates so I can check your account's send logs?

subject: Urgent: need files restored from backup after accidental deletion
body: Our billing coordinator accidentally deleted the contracts folder from Storage yesterday around 3pm, and it contained signed retainer agreements we need for month-end invoicing. We're on the Starter plan with 4 seats and I don't see a self-service restore option anywhere in the console. Our retention policy should have kept a backup copy - can someone restore this folder before end of day?

I'll follow up directly here as soon as the files are back.

subject: Shared dashboards showing 'access denied' for entire team
body:
As of this morning, roughly 20 of our 25 users are getting 'Access Denied - insufficient permissions' when opening dashboards that were shared with them last week for our education client review. This includes dashboards I personally shared and confirmed working on Friday. Nothing changed on our end in terms of roles or groups.

I'll have an update for you within the hour, well ahead of your presentation.

subject: Question on restore retention window via API
body: I'm building an automated restore-testing script against the Storage API and want to confirm the retention window for backup snapshots on our plan. The docs mention a 'restore_from_backup' endpoint but don't specify how far back snapshots are kept for Pro-tier accounts. Can you confirm the retention period and whether there's a way to query available snapshot dates programmatically before calling restore?
answer: Good question - Pro plan accounts retain daily snapshots for 30 days. You can list available restore points via a GET request to /v1/storage/snapshots which returns snapshot IDs and timestamps; from there you'd pass the snapshot_id into the restore_from_backup call. Let me know if you'd like a sample request/response pair for your testing script.

subject: Scheduled syncs stopped running after 12pm yesterday
body:
Our nightly and midday scheduled syncs for the robotics telemetry pipeline haven't run since yesterday at 12:04pm. We rely on this for our classroom robotics lab data feeding into reports for 12 seats.

We've tried disabling and re-enabling the schedule twice with no change. Can someone check if there's a stuck job on your end?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report - toggling the schedule is a good first troubleshooting step, and I can see from your account that there's a stuck job in the queue from yesterday's 12:04pm run that's blocking subsequent executions. I'm manually clearing that stuck job now and will monitor the next scheduled run to confirm syncs resume normally; I'll follow up here once I see a successful completion.

subject: Breaking changes in v2 API deprecation notice - need clarity
body:
We received a deprecation notice about the /v1/transactions endpoint sunsetting on March 15th, but our integration also uses three webhook event types (transaction.created, transaction.updated, transaction.failed) that aren't mentioned in the migration guide. Are these webhook events also being deprecated, or do they persist under v2? We have production payment reconciliation flows for 246 users depending on these and need to plan the SDK migration accordingly.

Also, will rate limits change under v2 - our current integration is tuned to the v1 limits.

Rate limits are increasing under v2 (from 100 to 250 requests/minute for your tier), and I'll get our docs team to add webhook event compatibility explicitly to the migration guide this week. I'd recommend starting your SDK migration in a staging environment now given the March 15th sunset date.

subject: Deactivated employee still has active sessions and API access
body: We deactivated a former employee's account in the Admin Console yesterday following their offboarding, but our security team just flagged that this person's API tokens are still generating successful authenticated requests as of this morning. This is a serious compliance concern for us given our logistics client contracts - we need all their access revoked immediately across all 255 seats' shared resources they had permissions on.

Deactivation in the Admin Console should automatically cascade to token revocation, so I'm also investigating why that didn't happen in this case to prevent recurrence. I'll confirm here once revocation is verified and share findings on the root cause.

subject: Okta app - support for provisioning custom attributes?
body: We're evaluating deeper Okta integration for our legal analytics platform and want to know if the Okta app supports pushing custom SCIM attributes beyond the standard set (name, email, department). Specifically we'd like to sync a 'practice_group' attribute for our 588 users to drive downstream permission mapping in Northwind. answer: Custom SCIM attribute mapping isn't currently supported in our Okta app integration - it's limited to the standard attribute set today. That said, this is a reasonable ask and I'm logging it as a feature request, since attribute-driven permission mapping comes up periodically with enterprise customers. As a workaround, you could use our Admin API to sync the practice_group value via a scheduled job after SCIM provisioning completes; happy to share endpoint details if that's useful.

subject: Need to upgrade plan but keep current billing cycle date
body: We want to move from Starter to Pro for our energy division's 22 seats, but our finance team specifically wants the upgrade to take effect without shifting our existing billing date of the 3rd of each month. When I tried initiating the upgrade in the console, it showed a prorated charge with a new cycle date starting immediately. Can we upgrade while keeping billing aligned to the 3rd?

subject: Request to extend storage retention window beyond 90 days
body: We're integrating with the Storage API for our manufacturing data pipeline and noticed uploaded objects are being purged after 90 days per the default retention policy. Our compliance team needs at least 180 days of retention for audit purposes. Is there a way to configure a longer retention period per bucket, or is this a hard limit on the Pro plan?

subject: SCIM sync failing - new hires not provisioned

subject: How to prevent duplicate email alerts from webhook retries
body: We're using the Notifications API to send transactional email alerts triggered by webhook events, and we're seeing some customers receive the same alert twice within a few seconds. I suspect our webhook retry logic combined with your delivery confirmation timing is causing this. Is there an idempotency key or dedup mechanism we should be using on our end?
answer: Yes, the Notifications API supports an idempotency key - if you include an `Idempotency-Key` header with a unique value per logical event, we'll dedupe any retries within a 24-hour window and only deliver once. I'd recommend generating this key from your source event ID rather than a timestamp to avoid accidental collisions. I'll also link you to our webhook retry documentation which covers recommended backoff settings.

subject: Push notification support for offline-queued events in mobile SDK
body: We're building on the Mobile App SDK for our field technicians who often work in areas with no connectivity. Right now push notifications triggered while a device is offline seem to get dropped instead of queued for delivery once the device reconnects. Is there a way to configure offline queuing for push events, or is this planned on the roadmap?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report - currently the SDK does drop push events sent while a device is offline rather than queuing them, since push delivery relies on the OS-level service being reachable. That said, offline event queuing is on our near-term roadmap for the mobile SDK, and in the meantime I'd suggest using our local notification fallback API to schedule reminders client-side when connectivity is detected as down. I'll add your use case to the feature request thread.

subject: SSO sessions timing out faster than expected
body: Our team has noticed that SSO sessions through our identity provider are timing out after roughly 20 minutes of inactivity, even though we configured a 4-hour session lifetime in our IdP settings. This is causing repeated re-authentication prompts that are frustrating our 18 users. Could you confirm what session timeout value Northwind enforces on top of the IdP setting?
answer: Good catch - Northwind applies its own session cap on top of whatever your IdP issues, and by default that's set to 20 minutes for Starter plan tenants regardless of the IdP token lifetime. I can raise this with our product team as feedback, but in the near term the workaround is to enable 'remember this device' in your SSO app config, which extends the effective session without re-prompting for MFA each time.

subject: Workspace settings reset and admins deactivated without warning
body: This morning our entire Cobalt Systems workspace settings got reset to defaults and two of our five admin accounts, including mine, were shown as deactivated when I logged in via the API. I can't currently push config changes through the Admin Console API - every PATCH to /workspaces/{id}/settings returns a 403 even though I still have owner-level credentials. I'll update you within the hour with findings and confirmation that access is restored.

subject: Pagination breaking on large API result sets after SDK update
body:
After updating to SDK version 4.2.0 this morning, our data pipeline that pulls records via GET /v2/records is failing when paginating past page 3. We're getting HTTP 500 errors with response body '{"error":"cursor_invalid"}' even though we're passing the exact next_cursor value returned in the prior response. This is blocking our nightly ETL job for 242 users relying on this data.

Stack trace snippet:
RecordsClient.fetch_page(cursor='eyJvZmZzZXQiOj...')
  -> HTTPError 500: cursor_invalid
  -> retry_count=3, all failed
answer: Thanks for the detailed report and stack trace - this matches a known regression introduced in SDK 4.2.0 related to cursor encoding for the /v2/records endpoint, which we're treating as a priority fix. As an immediate workaround, please pin back to SDK 4.1.3, which handles the legacy cursor format correctly, while our platform team ships a hotfix; I'll update this ticket as soon as the patched version is available, likely within 24 hours.

subject: help
body: getting 429 too many requests on almost every call to /v1/orders since this morning, our webhook subscription also stopped firing. we're only making about 40 requests a minute which used to be fine. did the rate limit change? this is blocking our order sync completely and we're on starter plan with 24 seats

I'm applying a temporary rate limit increase to your account now to unblock order sync, and I'm also checking why your webhook subscription stopped firing separately - will update shortly with findings on that.

subject: Storage quota exceeded errors during bulk backup upload
body: We're running a scheduled backup job through the Storage API that uploads roughly 40,000 objects nightly, and starting last night we began receiving 'quota_exceeded' errors partway through the batch, around object 28,000. Our dashboard still shows us at 82% of allocated quota, so this seems premature. Can you check if there's a per-request or burst limit being hit rather than total storage quota?
answer: Thanks for the detailed numbers - this does look like a burst write limit rather than your total storage quota, since large batch uploads within a short window can trigger a separate throughput cap even when overall usage is under 100%. I'm escalating this to our storage infrastructure team to review the burst threshold on your Enterprise account and raise it appropriately, and I'll follow up with confirmation once it's adjusted so your nightly backup job can complete without interruption.

subject: How to deactivate a user via the Admin API
body: We're wiring the Admin Console into our internal HR tool so we can deactivate users automatically when they leave Cobalt Works. I'm calling PATCH /users/{id} with status set to "inactive" using a key scoped as admin, but I keep getting a 403. Separately, does a deactivation show up in the audit log right away, or is there a delay? We have an offboarding batch scheduled for the 14th and want this working before then.
answer: Thanks for the details. The 403 usually means the API key needs the admin:users:write scope specifically, not just the general admin role - can you check the scopes on that key and retry? Once a deactivation succeeds it should appear in the audit log within a minute; if it still doesn't show up after a successful call, reply here with the request ID and we'll escalate to engineering.

subject: Scheduled sync sync-8841 stuck since 03:00 UTC

subject: Storage quota reached, uploads blocked
body:
Our Storage account hit its quota limit this morning and we're now unable to upload new files, including our nightly backup export which failed to complete. We're on a Pro plan with 66 seats and didn't get any warning email before this happened.

Can you tell us what our current retention policy is doing with old files, since we assumed those would be cleared automatically? We need this resolved quickly since our backup job runs again tonight and we don't want it to fail a second time.

I'm sorry for the disruption, this is a priority for us given the backup job risk. Looking at your account, your retention policy is currently set to keep all versions indefinitely rather than auto-purging older files, which is likely why the quota filled up faster than expected. I've temporarily raised your storage quota by 20% so tonight's backup can complete without failing.

In parallel, I'd recommend reviewing your retention settings under Storage > Policies to enable automatic cleanup of old backups past a certain age. I can walk you through that configuration on a call if that's easier, just let me know.

subject: urgent
body:
Our nightly transform jobs in Data Pipelines have been failing for the last two runs, on the 9th and 10th, both erroring out at the 'normalize_shipment_data' step with a timeout after 300 seconds. This is blocking our downstream sync to the warehouse connector and our ops team has no visibility into current shipment statuses now.

We only have 5 seats on this account but this pipeline feeds our core logistics tracking, so this is a big deal for us. Can someone escalate this today? We need either a fix or a manual way to trigger the sync again.
answer:
I understand the urgency here and I'm escalating this immediately to our pipeline engineering team as a P1. The timeout at the normalize_shipment_data step suggests either a data volume spike or a connector-side slowdown; we're pulling logs from both runs on the 9th and 10th now to confirm root cause.

As an interim step, I'll trigger a manual re-run of the failed sync once we've confirmed it's safe to do so, and will update you within the hour with findings or a workaround.

subject: Incorrect seat count on latest invoice
body:
Our invoice dated the 1st shows billing for 260 seats, but we only have 243 active seats on our Pro plan according to the admin console. This is the second month in a row this discrepancy has shown up, and it's causing headaches when reconciling our budget for finance approval.

Could someone review our account and issue a corrected invoice or credit for the overcharge? We also need to know if this affects our plan renewal terms coming up next quarter.
answer:
Thank you for flagging this, and I apologize for the repeated discrepancy. I'm pulling your seat activity logs now to compare against the invoiced count and will confirm the correct figure within the next business day. If we confirm an overcharge, we'll issue a credit against this invoice and correct the seat count going forward so it doesn't recur next cycle.

I'll also note this on your account ahead of the renewal discussion so the correct seat count carries over cleanly. I'll follow up here as soon as I have the reconciliation results.

subject: Need longer retention period for compliance records
body:
We're required to retain certain uploaded documents for a minimum of 7 years under education sector compliance rules, but our current Storage retention policy is set to purge files after 12 months. We're on the Starter plan with 18 seats and I don't see an option in the admin console to extend retention beyond a year.

Is there a way to set a custom retention period per folder or file type, or would we need to upgrade plans to unlock that? We'd also like to understand how this affects our current storage quota usage.
answer:
Thanks for reaching out about this, compliance retention requirements are important to get right. Custom retention periods beyond 12 months are available starting on our Pro plan, which lets you set folder-level retention rules including multi-year policies. On Starter, retention is currently capped at 12 months account-wide.

I'd recommend reviewing an upgrade to Pro if the 7-year requirement is a hard compliance need. In the meantime, I can share documentation on how folder-level retention rules work so you can plan the structure ahead of any upgrade.

subject: Seat count mismatch causing incorrect invoice charges
body:
We're seeing our Billing dashboard report 110 active seats, but our actual roster in the admin console only lists 96 users for our Pro plan. This mismatch has led to us being invoiced for 14 extra seats for the past two billing cycles, and I'd like to understand where the discrepancy is coming from before it happens again.

Could you check whether deactivated or pending users are still being counted as active seats? We'd like a refund for the overcharge on the last two invoices once this is confirmed.
answer:
Thanks for flagging this, seat count accuracy issues can definitely stem from deactivated or pending-invite users still being flagged as active in billing. I'm reviewing your account's seat history now to identify which users are contributing to the extra 14 seats and confirm whether they should have been excluded.

Once I've confirmed the discrepancy, I'll process a refund for the affected charges on the last two invoices and correct the seat sync going forward so this doesn't repeat next cycle.

subject: Workspace settings reverting after API update calls
body:
I'm integrating with the Admin Console API to update workspace settings programmatically, and every time I PATCH the allowlist field for a workspace, the change appears to save but reverts back to the previous value within a few minutes. This is affecting our ability to manage IP allowlisting across our 622-seat org consistently.

I've checked the audit log and it shows the update event followed shortly by an automatic rollback event with no clear trigger listed. Can someone look into why these settings aren't persisting? This is blocking a security rollout we're trying to finish this week.
answer:
Thanks for the detailed report, and I understand the time pressure given your rollout. An automatic rollback with no clear trigger in the audit log points to either a conflicting sync job or a stale cache issue on our end reverting the allowlist field after your PATCH call. I'm escalating this to our platform engineering team to trace the rollback event source.

In the meantime, could you share one or two workspace IDs where this occurred along with approximate timestamps? That will help us pinpoint the exact rollback trigger faster.

subject: Scheduled syncs not running in Data Pipelines
body:
Our scheduled sync job that's supposed to run daily at 2am hasn't executed for the past three days, the last successful run in the logs was on the 7th. We only have 3 seats on this account so it's just me managing this, and I haven't made any changes to the pipeline configuration recently.

This could be related to a scheduler service issue affecting a subset of accounts, so I want to confirm that before ruling anything else out.

I'll manually trigger the sync now so your inventory data is refreshed today, and will follow up with root cause and a fix for the recurring schedule.

subject: Uploads intermittently failing in Storage
body:
We've noticed that file uploads to Storage sometimes fail partway through, particularly for files over 50MB, with the upload progress bar just stalling at around 80% and then showing a generic 'upload failed' message. This has happened a handful of times over the past week, not every upload, and retrying usually works on the second or third attempt.

We're on the Starter plan and want to understand if this is a quota-related throttling issue or something else, since our usage is well under the quota limit currently. Any insight would help us plan around it.
answer:
Thanks for the detailed description. Since your account is well under quota, this is more likely related to upload timeout handling for larger files rather than throttling, particularly if your network connection has any variability during the upload window. I'd like to check the failed upload attempts on our end using approximate timestamps if you can share a couple from this past week.

In the meantime, breaking larger files into smaller chunks before upload, if your workflow allows it, tends to reduce these stalls. I'll dig into the logs and follow up with more specific findings.

subject: Request: route Slack alerts by Salesforce pipeline stage
body: We use the Salesforce integration to sync opportunity stages into Northwind, and right now every stage change fires into one generic #sales-alerts Slack channel. With 4562 seats across regions this is way too noisy. Can we get a way to route alerts to different Slack channels based on the Salesforce pipeline stage or region field? In the meantime, I can help you set up separate Slack integration instances filtered by stage using the existing rule builder as a workaround if that's useful.

subject: Email digests going out twice to same recipients
body: Since last week our weekly email digest notifications are being sent twice, about 10 minutes apart, to the same distribution list. We have 151 seats and this is generating a lot of confused replies asking why they got duplicate emails. Can you confirm if this is a known issue with the digest scheduler, and how do we get a single clean send going forward? This is affecting our whole ops team's trust in the alerts.

As a temporary step, I'd recommend disabling the digest schedule until we confirm the fix is deployed, and I'll update you within a few hours with status.

subject: CARDS DECLINING AND WE'RE BEING CHARGED ANYWAY - FIX THIS
body: Our corporate card was declined for our March invoice but we got charged twice on the retry attempts anyway - three separate charges showing on our statement for the same invoice number INV-88213. I can see the three charge attempts against invoice INV-88213 and I'm opening an escalation with billing operations now to reverse the duplicate charges and correct your account status, which should reflect within 1-2 business days once the refund posts. I'll personally follow up with confirmation once the reversals are processed and will also investigate why the retries triggered multiple successful charges instead of stopping after the first one.

subject: SDK throwing 429s and deprecation warnings on webhook calls
body: We're seeing intermittent 429 rate limit errors from the Python SDK (v3.4.1) when registering webhook subscriptions in bulk, roughly 15-20 failures out of 200 attempts during our morning batch job around 6am ET. Alongside that, the SDK console is logging a deprecation warning referencing an old webhook signing method that isn't documented anywhere I can find. Can you point us to updated docs and clarify the actual rate limit for webhook registration calls?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. The webhook registration endpoint currently caps at 60 requests per minute per API key, so a burst of 200 in a short window will trigger 429s, and I'd recommend adding exponential backoff in your batch job as a near-term fix. On the deprecation warning, that's referencing the legacy HMAC signing scheme being retired next quarter, I'll send you the updated signing documentation and migration guide, since it's currently missing a public-facing update on our docs site which I'll flag internally.

subject: dashboards super slow

subject: Storage quota errors during nightly upload batch

I'm checking your workspace's upload logs from last night now to confirm whether that's what happened, and will follow up shortly with either a quota adjustment or guidance on chunking the upload job to stay under the burst threshold.

subject: Webhooks stopped firing after SDK update
body: We upgraded to SDK v2.1.0 last Tuesday and our webhook subscriptions for invoice.paid events have stopped delivering entirely since then. subject: Need audit log export and role change tracking
body: As the workspace admin for our 139-seat account, I need to enable more detailed audit logging, specifically tracking when admins deactivate user accounts and change role permissions. Right now the audit log only shows login events. We had a situation last week where a user's admin role was removed and nobody could tell who did it or when. subject: Jira issue links not showing status updates in dashboard
body: We connected the Jira integration alongside our existing Slack and Salesforce setups a few weeks ago, and linked issues show up fine when created, but status changes in Jira (like moving to 'Done') aren't reflecting back in our Northwind dashboard view. subject: SDK v4 breaking on rate limit headers, blocking our integration launch
body: We're integrating the Node SDK v4.0.2 ahead of a launch scheduled this week, and calls to the /events endpoint are throwing 'Cannot read property retryAfter of undefined' whenever we hit a rate limit response. This is blocking our entire team of 25 from testing since every load test run crashes the process instead of backing off gracefully. A patched version, 4.0.3, is being fast-tracked for release, and in the meantime I can share a small wrapper snippet that catches the malformed response and applies a safe default backoff so your load tests can continue.

subject: Need rate limit increase and clarity on upcoming SDK deprecation
body: We're hitting 429 responses on our v3 API integration at roughly 4,800 requests/min during peak booking hours across our travel platform. subject: Feature request: biometric login for offline mode

In the meantime, a workaround is to extend the session token TTL in your admin console settings (under Mobile > Session Policy) so users stay authenticated longer between online refreshes, which should reduce password re-entry during offline shifts.

subject: Webhooks liefern keine Events mehr seit heute Morgen

subject: Biometric login crashes app on first launch after integration

subject: Transform step failing repeatedly on nightly sync pipeline

subject: Deprecated API fields causing errors in production integration

subject: How to fix chart not rendering on shared dashboard

If so, toggling it to allow shared-link access should resolve the blank render, and I'm happy to walk through it live if that doesn't fix it.

subject: Escalating: biometric login intermittently failing for field team

subject: Question about workspace settings for allowlisting and audit logs
body: I'm setting up our Admin Console for the first time and want to confirm how the IP allowlist feature interacts with our audit log retention. Audit log entries for deactivated users are retained for 90 days by default on your current plan, and deactivation itself doesn't remove any historical audit entries, it just prevents future login attempts. Let me know if you'd like help configuring the allowlist range.

subject: Request to add Okta integration alongside existing Salesforce/Jira setup

subject: Alert routing sending duplicate notifications to wrong teams

subject: JIRA LINK BROKEN AFTER API UPDATE - TICKETS NOT SYNCING

subject: Handling of late-arriving data in pipeline sync
