subject: Biometric login failing on Android after offline sync
body: We have several warehouse floor staff using the Northwind Mobile App with Face/Touch ID enabled. Since the 4.8.2 update rolled out on our fleet of Android tablets, biometric login fails with 'Authentication error, please use password' whenever the device has been offline for more than a few hours. It seems tied to the offline token cache not refreshing. This is affecting 3 of our seats daily and we've had to fall back to password entry, which defeats the purpose of biometric login for shared devices.
answer: Thanks for flagging this, it does sound like the offline token cache isn't revalidating biometric credentials after extended offline periods. Could you confirm the exact app build number and Android OS version on the affected tablets, and whether the issue clears immediately after reconnecting to Wi-Fi? I'm escalating this to our mobile team as a bug and will update you once we have a fix timeline or a workaround for shared devices.

subject: Need to raise storage quota ahead of compliance audit
body: We're preparing for an upcoming logistics compliance audit and need our Storage quota increased from the current Starter tier limit before month-end. Our current usage is at 92% of allotted capacity and we still need to upload roughly 40GB of retained shipment documentation covering the last 18 months of retention requirements. Could you advise on the process to increase the quota and confirm what retention policy documentation you can provide for our auditors?
answer: I understand the urgency given your audit timeline. I've submitted a request to increase your Storage quota and will confirm the new limit within one business day. In the meantime, I'm attaching our current retention policy documentation, which outlines default retention periods and deletion schedules; let me know if you need a signed compliance summary for the auditors and I'll get that generated for you.

subject: Push notifications not arriving on iOS after crash
body: We're seeing an issue where push notifications stop arriving for a subset of our mobile app users after the app crashes on iOS 17.4. Our team has logged around 60 crash reports since Tuesday, all pointing to the notification handler. Once a user experiences the crash, no further pushes come through even after reopening the app, until they fully reinstall. This is impacting shift alerts for our manufacturing floor supervisors.
answer: Thank you for the detailed report and crash counts, that's helpful. This pattern suggests the notification token isn't being re-registered after the crash recovery path runs, which would explain why reinstall temporarily resolves it. I'm opening this as an incident with our mobile engineering team and will need a couple of the crash logs or device identifiers from affected users to reproduce it faster, if you can send those over.

subject: Request to add retry logic to scheduled pipeline syncs
body: Our finance team relies on nightly scheduled syncs from our billing database into Northwind Data Pipelines, and we've noticed that when the source database is momentarily unreachable, the sync just fails silently instead of retrying. This has caused two missed syncs in the past week, both on Thursday nights, leading to stale data in downstream reports until someone manually triggers a rerun. We'd like to request configurable retry attempts with backoff for scheduled syncs, and ideally an alert when a sync fails outright.
answer: This is a reasonable request and one we've heard from a few Pro tier customers, so I've logged it as a feature request with our pipelines product team. In the meantime, as a workaround you can enable a failure webhook under sync settings that will notify a configured endpoint immediately when a run fails, which should at least reduce detection time until retry logic ships. I'll follow up once there's a target release for the retry feature.

subject: Refund not applied correctly after seat downgrade
body: We downgraded from 80 to 66 seats on our Pro plan on the 3rd of this month, and according to the proration terms we were expecting a credit of $412 to appear on our next invoice. Instead, invoice #INV-88213 shows a charge for the full 80 seats with no credit line at all. Our finance team needs this corrected before the payment is processed on the 15th, otherwise we'll have to dispute the charge with our bank.
answer: I'm sorry for the confusion and I understand the time pressure with your payment date approaching. I can see the seat downgrade was processed on the 3rd but the proration credit wasn't reflected on invoice #INV-88213, this looks like a billing sync error on our end. I'm escalating this now to have a corrected invoice with the $412 credit issued before the 15th, and I'll confirm here once it's generated.

subject: PDF export missing charts on dashboard
body: When I export our energy usage dashboard to PDF, two of the four charts show up blank in the exported file even though they display fine in the browser. This has happened the last three times I tried exporting, including today's export for our weekly ops review. It's not urgent since I can screenshot the charts as a workaround, but it would be great to get this fixed since we share these PDFs with our regional leads.
answer: Thanks for letting us know, and glad you have a workaround for now. This is likely related to how certain chart types render during PDF generation rather than in-browser, so I've logged a ticket with our dashboards team to investigate. I'll update you here once we identify which chart types are affected and have a fix scheduled.

subject: How to change frequency of email digest notifications
body: We currently receive Northwind email digests daily for our Notifications setup, but our team would prefer a weekly summary instead since daily digests are creating clutter in shared inboxes. I also noticed we're getting some duplicate digest emails on Mondays, seemingly two separate ones covering overlapping periods. Could you walk me through changing the digest frequency and let us know if the duplication is a known issue?
answer: Changing the digest frequency is straightforward: under Notifications settings, select the digest rule and change the 'Frequency' dropdown from Daily to Weekly, then save, it takes effect from the next scheduled run. Regarding the Monday duplicates, that does sound like a known edge case where a leftover daily digest overlaps with the weekend catch-up run, I'll check your account configuration and follow up shortly on how to resolve it.

subject: Uploads failing across the board, quota shows full
body: Since this morning all file uploads to Northwind Storage are failing for our workspace with the error 'Upload rejected: storage limit reached', but our usage dashboard shows only 78% of quota used. This is blocking our media team from backing up client assets ahead of a delivery deadline today. We haven't changed anything on our end and this started around 9am without warning.
answer: Thank you for the detailed report, I know this is time-critical with your delivery deadline. This mismatch between the usage dashboard and the enforced limit points to a quota calculation issue on our side, and I'm escalating this immediately as a priority incident. I'll update you within the hour with either a temporary quota override or confirmation of the fix so your uploads can resume.

subject: Transform step failing intermittently on nested JSON fields
body: I'm integrating with the Data Pipelines API and our transform step keeps failing intermittently when processing nested JSON fields from our payments source. About 1 in 20 runs throws 'TransformError: cannot flatten field path payment.metadata.tags[2]' even though the schema hasn't changed. This is adding noticeable latency to our sync since failed runs get retried from scratch. Can you help identify why array indexing in nested paths is inconsistent?
answer: Thanks for the specific error path, that's useful. Intermittent failures on array indexing inside nested JSON usually point to inconsistent array lengths across records that the transform engine doesn't handle gracefully, causing it to fail rather than skip or default the missing index. Could you send a sample of a record that triggered this so we can confirm, and in the meantime I'd suggest adding a flatten-safe default in your transform config to avoid the hard failure while we investigate the root cause.

subject: Best practice for deactivating users vs deleting them
body: We're cleaning up our Admin Console user list after some recent role changes and want to deactivate around a dozen accounts rather than delete them outright, mainly to preserve audit log history tied to those users. Can you confirm whether deactivated users still show up correctly in the audit log with their historical actions attached, and whether there's a bulk deactivation option instead of doing this one by one?
answer: Deactivating rather than deleting is the right approach here, deactivated users retain their full historical audit log entries and past actions remain attributed to them correctly. For bulk deactivation, you can select multiple users from the Admin Console user list and use the 'Deactivate selected' action under the bulk operations menu, which avoids doing this one account at a time.

subject: Feature request: better offline mode handling for mobile app
body:
I'm a support engineer at Ember Health and we've had several field staff report issues with the mobile app's offline mode. When connectivity drops mid-session, the app sometimes shows a blank screen instead of queuing actions, and there's no indicator showing users they're offline versus just slow. Could we get a status banner and clearer documentation on what actions are supported offline versus requiring a live connection?

Also, push notifications queued while offline seem to arrive all at once when reconnecting, which is confusing for users. Happy to share screen recordings if useful.
answer:
Thanks for the detailed writeup — this is great feedback and I've logged it as a product enhancement request under our mobile offline-mode backlog. I'll follow up once our mobile team reviews the offline banner and notification batching suggestions, and I'll also flag the documentation gap to our docs team so the supported offline actions are listed clearly.

In the meantime, if you can send over one of those screen recordings it would help us prioritize the notification queuing issue specifically.

subject: Salesforce sync broken for all users since this morning
body:
Our Salesforce integration stopped syncing records around 8:15 AM today. Contact and opportunity updates from Northwind are no longer appearing in Salesforce, and the integration dashboard shows a 'sync failed' status with error code SF-409. We rely on this sync for our entire sales team of 1558 seats, and this is now blocking pipeline reporting.

We also use Okta for SSO and Jira for ticket tracking, but those integrations appear unaffected. Can someone look into this urgently? We need the sync restored today.
answer:
I'm escalating this immediately as a P1 — a full sync outage affecting your whole org is top priority. We can see elevated SF-409 errors starting around 08:10 AM correlating with a Salesforce API token refresh issue on our end, and our integrations team is actively working a fix.

I'll update you within the hour with either a resolution or a manual re-sync workaround so your reporting isn't blocked longer than necessary.

subject: Requesting adjustable SSO session timeout settings
body:
I manage IT for Blue Media and our staff keep getting logged out of Northwind after what feels like 15 minutes of inactivity, even during active work sessions with our SSO provider. This is disrupting teachers and admin staff who navigate between tabs frequently. Is there a way to configure a longer session timeout, and if so, where in the admin console would I find that setting?

We'd also appreciate documentation on how session length interacts with our SSO provisioning rules, since we manage permissions centrally.
answer:
Thanks for flagging this — session timeout duration is configurable at the workspace level under Admin Console > Security > Session Policy, though on the Starter plan the minimum is currently fixed at 15 minutes. I can walk you through adjusting it to your provider's token lifetime if that helps reduce unexpected logouts.

I'll also send over our SSO and provisioning documentation so you can see how session policy interacts with your permission sync rules.

subject: Seat count on invoice doesn't match active users
body:
I'm a product manager at Summit Retail and our latest invoice bills us for 23 seats, but when I check the admin panel we only have 17 active user accounts. This has been the case for the last two billing cycles and I'd like to understand why we're being charged for seats we're not using, and whether we can get a refund adjustment or correction going forward.

Could someone also point me to documentation on how seat counts are calculated, since we may have deactivated users who weren't fully removed from billing.
answer:
Thanks for raising this — a seat count mismatch affecting billing is something we want to resolve quickly. I've pulled up your account and can see 6 deactivated users still flagged as billable seats due to a sync delay between user deactivation and the billing system; I'm correcting that now and will apply a prorated credit for the discrepancy across the last two cycles.

I'll also send you our seat-counting documentation so you have visibility into how deactivations should reflect on future invoices.

subject: Need to change retention policy for uploaded datasets
body:
I'm a data analyst at Apex Media and our storage retention is currently set to auto-delete files after 30 days, but we need certain uploaded datasets kept for at least 12 months for compliance reviews. Is there a way to set retention rules per folder or tag rather than account-wide? Right now everything uses the same default policy.

Separately, I noticed our storage quota usage jumped unexpectedly last week even though upload volume looked normal — wondering if backups are counting against the same quota.
answer:
Good question — per-folder retention overrides are supported on request, and I can help configure a 12-month exception for your compliance datasets rather than changing the account-wide default. I'll need the folder or tag names you want excluded from the 30-day policy.

On the quota jump, yes — automated backups do count toward your storage quota, which likely explains the unexpected increase. I'll check your recent backup schedule and confirm the numbers add up.

subject: Unsubscribed users still receiving duplicate emails via API
body:
I'm integrating the Notifications API for Vertex Media and we're seeing a serious bug: users who call the /unsubscribe endpoint and receive a 200 response are still getting duplicate marketing and alert emails, sometimes 2-3 copies of the same message within minutes. This is affecting a large portion of our 1371 seats and creating compliance concerns given we're in healthcare.

We've confirmed the unsubscribe records are showing correctly in our database via webhook confirmation, so the issue seems to be on the notification delivery side ignoring the suppression list.
answer:
This is a serious issue and I've marked it P1 given the compliance exposure — thank you for the clear reproduction details. It looks like there's a delay in our suppression list propagating to the email delivery queue in certain regions, which would explain duplicates going out after unsubscribe confirmation.

Our notifications engineering team is investigating the propagation delay right now, and I'll update you as soon as we have a fix or a temporary mitigation to stop duplicate sends.

subject: SAML login failing intermittently for finance team
body:
Several members of our finance team at Apex Analytics have been unable to log in via SAML SSO over the past two days — the browser redirects to Northwind then throws 'SAML response invalid, please contact your administrator.' It's not happening to everyone, maybe 1 in 5 login attempts, and MFA prompts sometimes appear before the failure and sometimes after.

We haven't changed our identity provider configuration recently. Given we're in retail finance with 4952 seats total, even intermittent SSO failures are a compliance concern for us.
answer:
Thank you for reporting this — intermittent SAML assertion failures with an MFA timing component point to a possible clock skew or assertion expiry issue between your IdP and our SSO service. I'm opening this as P2 given the compliance sensitivity and pulling recent SAML logs on our side to correlate with the failed attempts you've seen.

Could you confirm the exact timestamps of two or three recent failures so we can match them against our authentication logs directly?

subject: SCIM-Provisionierung schlägt fehl für neue Benutzer
body:
Ich bin IT-Administrator bei Granite Travel und seit gestern schlägt die SCIM-Provisionierung für alle neuen Benutzer fehl. Wenn wir einen Benutzer in unserem Identity Provider anlegen, kommt in Northwind die Fehlermeldung 'SCIM sync error: attribute mapping conflict' und der Benutzer wird nicht angelegt. Das betrifft mittlerweile 5 neue Mitarbeiter, die sich nicht einloggen können.

Wir haben in den letzten Tagen keine Änderungen an unserem Attribut-Mapping vorgenommen. Da wir nur 8 Lizenzen haben, ist das für unser kleines Team bereits ein großes Problem, da die neuen Kollegen komplett blockiert sind.
answer:
Vielen Dank für die genaue Fehlerbeschreibung — ein Ausfall der SCIM-Provisionierung, der neue Mitarbeiter komplett blockiert, wird von uns als P1 behandelt. Der Fehler 'attribute mapping conflict' deutet darauf hin, dass sich möglicherweise ein Pflichtfeld in Ihrem Identity Provider geändert hat, das nicht mehr mit unserem SCIM-Schema übereinstimmt; wir prüfen jetzt die letzten Sync-Logs auf Ihrem Account.

Wir melden uns in Kürze mit einer genauen Diagnose und, falls nötig, mit einer temporären manuellen Anlage der betroffenen 5 Benutzer, damit diese sofort arbeiten können.

subject: Question about session timeout defaults after recent login issue
body:
I'm an IT admin at Apex Foods and last week a few users got logged out mid-shift unexpectedly, which we initially thought was an incident, but after checking it seems to just be our default session timeout of 20 minutes kicking in during idle periods. No data was lost and it resolved itself once users logged back in.

I'd like documentation on how to adjust the timeout value and whether it's tied to our provisioning settings, since we want a longer window for clinical staff on shared workstations.
answer:
Glad to hear it turned out to be expected timeout behavior rather than an actual incident. Session timeout duration can be adjusted under Admin Console > Security > Session Policy, and it's independent of your provisioning rules, so changing it won't affect how users are created or synced.

I'll send over the documentation link covering timeout configuration and recommended settings for shared-workstation environments like clinical shifts.

subject: MFA enrollment stuck for new finance hires
body:
I'm a finance manager at Apex Capital and two new hires this week couldn't complete MFA enrollment — the setup screen loads the QR code but clicking 'confirm' just spins indefinitely and never completes. They're using the same authenticator app the rest of our 21-seat team uses without issue.

This isn't urgent since they can still work with a temporary admin bypass, but I'd like to get it fixed properly and understand if this needs escalation to your provisioning team.
answer:
Thanks for the details, and good to know a temporary bypass is in place so there's no immediate blocker. A stuck MFA confirmation screen usually points to a time-sync issue between the authenticator app and our verification server — could you ask the affected users to check their device clock is set to automatic/network time and retry enrollment?

If that doesn't resolve it, I'll escalate to our provisioning team for a closer look at the enrollment session logs for those two accounts.

subject: Question about credit application on refund INV-88213
body: We had a refund processed on invoice INV-88213 after we reduced seats mid-cycle, but the credit that landed on our account is showing as $4,120 instead of the $5,340 we calculated based on the prorated seat reduction. Can someone confirm how the credit amount was derived? We're not disputing it as an emergency, just want to understand the math before we report back to finance leadership.
answer: Thanks for flagging this - I can see invoice INV-88213 and the associated credit memo. The difference comes from the proration being calculated from the seat change date rather than the billing cycle start, which accounts for the gap you noticed. I'll have our billing team send over a line-item breakdown so you can reconcile it against your own numbers, and we're happy to adjust if we find a calculation error on our end.

subject: Migrating off offset pagination before deprecation date
body: We're currently using offset-based pagination on the /v2/transactions endpoint across several internal reporting jobs, and I saw the notice that this will be deprecated in favor of cursor-based pagination. Our team pulls roughly 50k records per batch daily, so I want to make sure we understand the migration path and whether the Python SDK already supports cursor pagination or if we need to handle it manually.
answer: Good timing - the Python SDK version 4.3 and above has native support for cursor-based pagination via the `list_transactions` iterator, so most of your batch jobs should only need a version bump and a small code change to switch from `offset` to `cursor` parameters. I'll link you to the migration guide with before/after code samples, and let me know if you'd like a call to walk through your specific reporting jobs before the cutover.

subject: Getting duplicate email alerts for every notification event
body: Since last week our staff have been receiving two to three copies of every email notification, including password reset alerts and course enrollment confirmations. This is happening for all 22 of our accounts, not just one, and it's causing confusion among our academy coordinators who think something has gone wrong on their end. Can this be fixed urgently since it's affecting daily operations?
answer: I'm sorry for the disruption this is causing - I've escalated this as a priority issue since it's impacting your whole organization. Initial checks show a possible duplicate subscription on the notification rules for your workspace, which we're correcting now; I'll confirm within a few hours once the fix is verified and will follow up with root cause details.

subject: How to handle SCIM group sync failures for contractor accounts
body: We're provisioning users via SCIM from our Okta tenant, and contractor accounts that belong to a group called 'temp-access' are failing to sync with a 400 error referencing 'invalid group mapping'. Full-time employee accounts sync fine. Is there a specific format required for group names or a limit on group name length we should check on our side?
answer: Group names with hyphens should be supported, so this is likely tied to how the group is mapped in your SCIM configuration rather than the name itself. Can you send us the exact SCIM payload for one failing user (with any sensitive values redacted) so we can check the mapping rules on our end? In the meantime, you can manually provision those contractor accounts as a workaround.

subject: Need guidance on pagination limits for reconciliation reports
body: Our finance team pulls monthly reconciliation data through the invoices endpoint, and we've started hitting a 429 rate limit error partway through the pagination loop when retrieving around 3,000 invoices. We currently use offset pagination with a page size of 100. Could you advise on best practices for pagination and rate limits so we can avoid interruptions during month-end close?
answer: Thanks for the details - at a page size of 100 with sequential requests you're likely exceeding the burst limit of 60 requests per minute on that endpoint, so adding a short delay or switching to a larger page size (up to 500) should resolve the 429s. I'd also recommend moving to cursor-based pagination since it's more efficient for large exports and is the direction the API is heading; I'll send over sample code for your finance team's script.

subject: Biometric login crashing app on Android devices - urgent
body: Our warehouse staff use the mobile app for shift check-ins, and since yesterday's update the app crashes immediately when trying to log in with fingerprint on Android. It works fine with password login. This is affecting most of our 18 users right now during active shifts, so we need this resolved quickly. Device models are a mix of Samsung and Pixel phones running Android 13 and 14.
answer: This is impacting your team's ability to check in, so we're treating it as urgent - thank you for the device details. We've identified a related crash report tied to the biometric SDK update and are pushing a hotfix; in the meantime, please have staff use password login to avoid disruption, and I'll update you as soon as the fix is live, hopefully within a few hours.

subject: Question on retention policy documentation for archived files
body: I'm trying to understand how long files stay in the 'archived' tier before they're permanently deleted under our current storage plan. The documentation mentions a default retention window but doesn't specify if that applies to archived files or only active uploads. Could you point me to the relevant policy details or clarify directly?
answer: Good question - the default retention window described in our docs applies to active storage only; archived files follow a separate 180-day retention period before deletion, which isn't currently called out clearly in the documentation. I'll flag this for our docs team to update, and in the meantime I've attached a quick reference table covering both tiers.

subject: Seat count discrepancy causing incorrect invoice charge
body: Our latest invoice shows a charge for 115 seats, but we currently have 101 active users in the admin console, and we removed 14 users back on the 3rd of last month. This is the second billing cycle where the seat count hasn't matched our actual usage, and I'd like this corrected along with a refund for the overcharge if applicable.
answer: Thanks for catching this and for the specific date - I can see the removal on the 3rd wasn't reflected in the seat sync that feeds billing, which explains the discrepancy across both cycles. I'm submitting a correction for your seat count now and will process a refund for the overcharged amount on both affected invoices; you should see the credit within 3-5 business days.

subject: Storage retention alert - files disappearing before expected date
body: We noticed several media assets that should have been retained for 90 days under our plan were removed after only about 45 days. This started happening around the 14th of this month for files in our 'projects' bucket, and it's affecting client deliverables we hadn't finished processing yet. We need this investigated as it's impacting active work.
answer: I understand the urgency given this affects active client work - we're looking into the retention job logs for the 'projects' bucket right now. Initial findings suggest a misconfigured retention rule may have been applied to that bucket around the date you mentioned; we're pausing any further deletions there immediately while we confirm and will update you within the next few hours with findings and next steps.

subject: seat count wrong on invoice pls help
body: so basicaly we have been using northwind for a while now and everything was fine untill this months invoice came in, we did a review last week of all our departments and travel teams because we are expanding and added some new offices, anyway the point is our admin console shows 1719 active users but the invoice we got charged for is for 1850 seats which is way more then what we actully have, this has never happend before and now finance is asking me why we got charged for seats we dont even have, can someone check this asap because the amount is quite big and we need this sorted before end of month
answer: Thanks for the detailed background, and sorry for the confusion this has caused with your finance team. We're pulling the seat sync logs now to compare against your admin console count of 1719 - this kind of mismatch is usually caused by a delayed deactivation not syncing to billing, and given the invoice amount involved we're treating this as high priority. We'll have a corrected invoice and refund figure for the difference to you within one business day.

subject: Crash
body:
Our legal team started reporting the Northwind mobile app crashing immediately on launch after updating to the latest version from the App Store yesterday. It happens on iOS 17 devices consistently - the splash screen shows for about a second then the app closes back to the home screen. About 15 of our 146 users have flagged this so far.

We rely on the mobile app for push notifications on case approvals, so this is blocking a chunk of our team from getting timely alerts. Can you confirm if this is a known issue with the latest build?
answer:
Thanks for flagging this - we've seen a handful of similar reports tied to the release that went out this week and are actively investigating a crash-on-launch issue affecting iOS 17 devices. Could you send us the exact app version number from the App Store listing and, if possible, a device log or crash report from one of the affected users? That will help us confirm whether you're hitting the same root cause.

In the meantime, if any users are on iOS 16 they should be unaffected, so that could be a temporary workaround for anyone who needs urgent access to push notifications.

subject: Dashboards taking 30+ seconds to load company-wide
body:
Our finance team's dashboards have become extremely slow over the past week - the main revenue reconciliation dashboard now takes 30 to 45 seconds to load, and some of the chart widgets time out entirely with a spinner that never resolves. This is affecting all 206 seats on our account, not just finance.

We use these dashboards daily for close processes and this delay is really disrupting our workflow. Could you look into what changed and give us a timeline for a fix? We'd also appreciate any guidance on optimizing widget queries if that's a contributing factor.
answer:
Thank you for the detailed report - a P1 for a company-wide slowdown gets our immediate attention. We're pulling performance metrics for your account now to see if this correlates with a recent data volume increase or a backend change on our end. We'll update you within a few hours with findings and, if it's on our side, a mitigation timeline.

In parallel, could you tell us which specific dashboard and widget names are timing out, and roughly how many data source connections each uses? That will help us narrow down whether this is a query optimization issue we can address on your end while we investigate further.

subject: Need help configuring SAML SSO for our IdP
body:
I'm setting up SAML-based SSO for Granite Travel and I'm stuck on the assertion consumer service URL configuration. Our IdP is expecting the ACS URL to match a specific format, but when I try to test the login flow I get "invalid_signature" errors on the Northwind side even though I've uploaded the correct certificate.

We have 8 seats and want all of them provisioned via SSO with MFA enforced through our IdP. Can someone walk me through the correct metadata exchange steps, or point me to documentation that covers this specific error?
answer:
Happy to help get SSO working correctly. The invalid_signature error usually means either the certificate uploaded doesn't match the one your IdP is actively signing with, or there's a mismatch in the metadata XML encoding. Could you send us the exact metadata file you uploaded (with any sensitive values redacted) and confirm which IdP you're using?

We'll walk through the ACS URL and certificate binding with you directly - this is a quick fix once we see the metadata, and we'll also confirm the MFA enforcement settings apply correctly once login is working for all 8 seats.

subject: IP allowlist blocking all admin console access
body:
We configured an IP allowlist in the Admin Console yesterday afternoon to restrict access to our office network, but this morning none of our 4 seats can log in - everyone gets "Access denied: IP not permitted" even from the same office network we allowlisted. We've double-checked the CIDR range we entered and it matches our current public IP.

This has locked our whole team out of admin functions including user management and audit logs. We need this resolved urgently since we can't deactivate or manage any accounts right now.
answer:
This is a priority issue for us since it's locking your whole team out - we're looking into it right now. Could you confirm the exact CIDR block you entered in the allowlist settings and the current public IP address your office is showing? It's possible there's a mismatch between what your network reports and what's stored, or a propagation delay on our end after the setting was saved.

As an immediate workaround, we can temporarily disable the allowlist restriction from our side if you confirm your account ID - that will restore access while we identify the root cause together.

subject: Audit log entries missing for admin actions over past 24 hours
body:
We noticed during a routine compliance check that our Admin Console audit log has no entries for any admin actions taken since yesterday around 14:00 UTC, including a role change and an allowlist update we know occurred. This is a serious problem for us since we're required to maintain a complete audit trail for our manufacturing compliance certification.

We have 18 seats and multiple admins have made changes in that window that should be logged. Can you escalate this to determine whether the logs are delayed, lost, or if there's a logging failure we need to report internally?
answer:
We're escalating this immediately given the compliance implications. A gap in audit logging is treated as a security incident on our end, so we're pulling backend logging service status now to determine if entries were delayed, dropped, or are simply not yet indexed for display. We'll confirm within the next few hours whether the actions were captured server-side even if not visible yet.

Can you list the specific admin actions and approximate timestamps you know occurred during that window? That will help us verify against our internal event stream and confirm whether this is a display delay or an actual logging failure that needs a formal incident report.

subject: Frage
body:
Uns ist aufgefallen, dass bei unserer Media-Analytics-Pipeline die Daten aus dem Werbeplattform-Connector seit dem 14. dieses Monats mit einer Verzögerung von 6 bis 9 Stunden ankommen, statt wie gewohnt innerhalb von 30 Minuten. Das betrifft mehrere unserer täglichen Reports, die auf aktuellen Daten basieren sollen.

Wir haben bereits die Connector-Konfiguration geprüft und keine Änderungen auf unserer Seite gefunden. Können Sie prüfen, ob es auf Seiten von Northwind ein Sync-Problem oder eine bekannte Latenz bei diesem Connector gibt?
answer:
Vielen Dank für die genaue Beschreibung. Wir sehen uns die Sync-Historie für Ihren Connector sofort an, um festzustellen, ob es sich um ein bekanntes Latenzproblem auf unserer Seite handelt oder ob es mit einer Änderung bei der Werbeplattform selbst zusammenhängt. Können Sie uns den genauen Connector-Namen und die betroffene Pipeline-ID nennen?

Wir melden uns innerhalb der nächsten Stunden mit einem Zwischenstand und, falls nötig, mit einer Schätzung, wann die Verzögerung behoben sein wird.

subject: Slack alert notifications stopped firing from Salesforce integration
body:
Since yesterday afternoon our Slack channel has stopped receiving any alerts from the Salesforce integration - we normally get notifications whenever a deal stage changes or a high-value opportunity is flagged, but nothing has come through since around 3pm. I checked the integration status page in Northwind and it shows "Connected" with no errors.

We have 237 seats relying on these alerts for sales coordination and this silent failure is a real problem since nobody realized it was broken until this morning. Can you check the integration logs on your end to see what's failing?
answer:
Thanks for the report - a silent notification failure affecting your whole sales team is something we're treating with urgency. We're pulling the integration logs for your Slack and Salesforce connection now to see where the delivery is breaking, since a "Connected" status doesn't always catch downstream delivery failures.

Could you confirm the Slack channel name and the Salesforce webhook or connected app you're using? We'll trace the last successful event and the first dropped one to identify exactly where the pipeline is failing and get alerts flowing again.

subject: Need help conecting our connector auth after credential rotaton
body:
hey we rotatd our API credentails on the source system last week and now the connecter for our data pipleine keeps failing auth with a 401 error. i tryed updating the credentails in the connecter settings but it still shows the old conection as "authenticated" even tho i changed everything.

we only have 13 seats so this is a small team but the pipleine feeds our energy usage reports and its been down since the rotaton. is there a way to force refresh the auth token or do we need to delete and recreate the connecter from scrach?
answer:
Thanks for reaching out - credential rotation issues like this are usually fixable without deleting the connector. There's often a cached auth token that doesn't refresh automatically when you update credentials in the settings UI; we can trigger a manual token refresh on our end if you confirm the connector name and pipeline ID.

If the manual refresh doesn't clear the 401, recreating the connector is the fallback, but let's try the refresh first since that will preserve your existing sync history and configuration.

subject: Best practices for connector auth with frequent credential rotation
body:
I'm integrating several data pipeline connectors on our end for Harbor Partners and want to understand the recommended approach for handling connector auth when our security policy requires credential rotation every 30 days. Right now each rotation seems to require manually updating the connector config, and I'd like to know if there's an API endpoint to automate token or credential updates rather than doing it through the console each time.

Also curious if there's documentation on how the connector handles auth failures mid-sync - does it retry, queue, or drop the batch? Any pointers to relevant docs would be appreciated.
answer:
Great question, and this is a common setup for enterprise customers with strict rotation policies. Yes, we have a connector credentials API endpoint that lets you push updated credentials programmatically without touching the console - I'll send over the documentation link covering the authentication update endpoint and required scopes.

On the auth failure behavior: mid-sync failures trigger a retry with exponential backoff for up to three attempts, and if all retries fail the batch is queued rather than dropped, so no data is lost - it resumes once valid credentials are detected. Let us know if you'd like a walkthrough of setting up automated rotation via the API.

subject: Frage zu Rechnungsformat und Positionen
body:
Wir integrieren gerade die Northwind API in unser internes Buchhaltungssystem und dabei ist mir aufgefallen, dass die über die API abgerufenen Rechnungen ein anderes Format haben als die PDF-Rechnungen im Kundenportal - insbesondere fehlen die einzelnen Positionsbeschreibungen bei den API-Rechnungen. Gibt es eine Möglichkeit, die detaillierten Rechnungspositionen ebenfalls über die API zu erhalten?

Wir würden das gerne in unserem System abbilden, bevor wir auf den nächsten Plan upgraden, daher wäre eine Antwort zur Dokumentation sehr hilfreich.
answer:
Vielen Dank für die Frage. Aktuell liefert der Standard-Rechnungs-Endpunkt nur die zusammengefassten Beträge, aber es gibt einen separaten Endpunkt für Line Items, der die detaillierten Positionsbeschreibungen inklusive Zeiträume und Mengen zurückgibt - ich sende Ihnen den entsprechenden Dokumentationslink dazu.

Falls Sie beide Endpunkte kombinieren möchten, empfehlen wir, die Rechnungs-ID als verbindenden Schlüssel zu verwenden. Gerne unterstützen wir Sie auch bei der Planung des Upgrades, sobald die Integration steht.

subject: Data Pipelines: records arriving hours late, breaking sync
body:
We run a nightly patient-intake connector from our EHR into Northwind Data Pipelines (pipeline ID pl-8842). Since Monday, records are landing 4-6 hours after their timestamp instead of within 30 minutes as configured. Downstream reports for our compliance team are showing incomplete data at the 8am cutoff. We checked the connector status page and it shows healthy, but the lag is growing each day.

This is affecting all 4 seats on our team since everyone relies on the same nightly sync for morning reporting. Can someone check if there's a backlog on the connector side or if this is a known issue with the healthcare source connector?
answer: Thank you for the detailed report - I can see pipeline pl-8842 on our end and confirm there's a queue backlog on the connector worker pool serving your source. We're actively draining it now and expect records to catch up within the next 2 hours; I'll update you once lag returns to under 30 minutes. In the meantime, I'd recommend flagging any reports pulled before 8am today as incomplete, and we'll follow up with root cause once the backlog clears since this looks like it may be a connector-side batching bug.

subject: SAML login failing for some users after IdP metadata update
body:
We updated our IdP metadata on our end last Thursday and since then about a third of our 114 users get 'SAML assertion validation failed' when trying to log into Northwind. Users who log in through the older cached metadata still work fine, but new sessions are failing. MFA-enrolled accounts seem hit harder than others.

We haven't changed anything on the Northwind SSO configuration page. Can you confirm whether Northwind's SP metadata cache updates automatically or if we need to manually push the new certificate?
answer: Thanks for flagging this - SAML metadata updates on your IdP side do need to be manually re-synced on our SSO configuration page since we cache the signing certificate for validation. I'd recommend going to Identity > SSO Configuration and clicking 'Refresh IdP Metadata' to pull the new certificate; that should resolve the assertion validation errors for affected users. Let us know once you've done that and if any users are still failing, we'll dig into session-level logs for those specific accounts.

subject: API key rotation breaking webhook signatures - urgent
body:
We're rotating our API keys ahead of a security review and after generating the new key pair, all our webhook deliveries started failing signature verification. Here's the error from our receiver logs:

2024-03-12T09:14:22Z ERROR webhook.verify: signature mismatch, expected=sha256:a1f3... got=sha256:9c02...
2024-03-12T09:14:22Z ERROR webhook.verify: signature mismatch, expected=sha256:a1f3... got=sha256:9c02...
2024-03-12T09:15:01Z ERROR webhook.verify: signature mismatch, expected=sha256:a1f3... got=sha256:9c02...
2024-03-12T09:15:01Z WARN webhook.retry: max retries exceeded, dropping event evt_88213

The SDK docs say the webhook secret should rotate along with the API key automatically but that doesn't seem to be happening - we're still seeing the old secret referenced. We have 273 users depending on downstream data from these webhooks, so this is blocking real work. Can you clarify the correct rotation sequence?
answer: Apologies for the disruption this is causing - the webhook signing secret is actually independent from your API key and does not rotate automatically, which is likely the gap here. You'll need to generate a new webhook secret separately from Settings > Webhooks > Signing Secret and update your receiver to use it; I'll flag the SDK documentation for a correction since it currently implies otherwise. In the meantime, could you confirm the timestamp of your key rotation so we can check if any events were dropped that need replaying?

subject: How to filter audit log by user and date range
body: I'm trying to pull an audit log report for one specific admin account over the last 30 days but the Admin Console audit log page only lets me filter by event type, not by user. We need this for an internal access review. Is there a way to filter by user email or ID, either in the UI or via export?
answer: Good question - user-level filtering isn't currently exposed in the Admin Console UI, but you can get this by exporting the full audit log as CSV from Settings > Audit Log > Export and then filtering by the 'actor_id' column locally. I'll pass along the request for a built-in user filter to our product team since it's a reasonable addition for access reviews like yours.

subject: IP allowlist blocking legitimate office traffic - all logins down
body:
We updated our IP allowlist in Admin Console this morning to add our new office range, and now nobody in the company can log in, including from the ranges that were already whitelisted. All 246 users are locked out. The settings page shows the new range saved correctly, but login attempts return 'access denied: IP not permitted' even for previously working addresses.

We need this resolved immediately since this is blocking all operational access company-wide. Can someone check if the allowlist update caused a full rule reset instead of an append?
answer: This is being treated as a P1 - I'm escalating immediately to our infra team to check the allowlist rule set for your workspace. It's possible the update replaced the full rule list instead of appending, which would explain the total lockout. While we investigate, I'm temporarily disabling IP allowlist enforcement for your workspace so your team can regain access; I'll confirm once that's live and follow up within the hour with root cause and the correct fix for re-enabling it.

subject: SAML login broken for finance team - can't access billing
body:
Our finance team of about 20 people can no longer log in via SSO as of this morning. The error shown is 'SAML response signature invalid' right after the IdP redirect. This is blocking us from accessing billing and invoicing data we need for month-end close today.

We haven't made any changes to our SSO configuration recently. Other departments seem unaffected, so this might be scoped to a specific group or role mapping. Can someone look into this urgently since it's holding up a financial deadline?
answer: I understand the urgency given your close deadline - I'm escalating this to P1 and pulling the SAML response logs for your finance group's role mapping now. Since only one group is affected, this points to a scoped issue rather than a full IdP outage, possibly a certificate mismatch tied to that group's assertion signing. I'll update you within the next 30 minutes with findings, and if needed we can temporarily grant manual access to unblock your month-end close while we fix the root cause.

subject: Late-arriving transaction data causing stale dashboards
body:
Our finance reporting pipeline pulls transaction data nightly, but for the past week the data has been arriving 3-5 hours after the expected window. This means our morning reconciliation reports are built on partial data, which is a problem for a fintech company like ours where accuracy matters. The pipeline dashboard shows 'completed' status even when data is clearly incomplete.

Can you help us understand if this is a source connector delay or something on the pipeline scheduling side? We'd also like the completion status to actually reflect partial vs full data if possible.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report - I'm looking into your pipeline's scheduling logs now to check whether the delay originates at the source connector or in queue processing on our side. I agree the 'completed' status showing on partial data is misleading, and I'll file that as a product issue for our pipeline status reporting. In the meantime, I'll follow up with specific timing data on the last week's runs so we can pinpoint where the 3-5 hour gap is being introduced.

subject: Slack alert integration completely stopped working
body:
Our Slack integration for incident alerts stopped posting messages entirely as of yesterday afternoon. We rely on this to notify our on-call engineers when something breaks, and right now we have zero visibility since alerts just silently fail. The integration still shows 'connected' status in the Integrations panel, but no messages are coming through to our #alerts channel.

We have 24 people across support and engineering depending on this for incident response, so this is a real gap in our monitoring right now. Can you check if something changed on the Slack app permissions or webhook side?
answer: This is a serious gap for incident response, so I'm marking it P1 and checking the webhook delivery logs for your Slack integration right now. A common cause of 'connected but silent' is a revoked or expired OAuth token on the Slack app side without the integration status catching it - I'll confirm whether that's the case here. I'll have an update for you within the hour, and if it is a token issue we'll walk you through re-authorizing the Slack app to restore alerts immediately.

subject: Need to update workspace default settings and permissions
body:
We're restructuring our teams and need to update several workspace settings in Admin Console - specifically the default timezone, the deactivation policy for inactive accounts, and who has escalation access for support tickets. I want to make sure these changes get logged properly in the audit log since we may need to show this during a compliance review later this year.

Could you confirm whether changes to deactivation policy and escalation roles are automatically captured in the audit log, or if we need to do anything extra to ensure they're tracked?
answer: Good news - all changes to deactivation policy, escalation roles, and workspace default settings are automatically captured in the Admin Console audit log with actor, timestamp, and before/after values, so no extra steps are needed on your end for compliance tracking. If you'd like, I can walk you through where to find the specific event types for these changes, or you're welcome to export the audit log after making the updates to confirm everything was captured correctly.

subject: dashbord PDF export cutting off charts on the right side
body:
hey we noticed when we expot our monthly dashbord to PDF the bar charts on the right side of the page get cut off, its missing like the last 2 columns of data. this happens on the 'Quarterly Overview' dashbord specificaly, other ones seem ok. we need to share these PDFs with clients so its kinda annoying that it looks broken.

also not urgent but woudl be nice if we could pick landscape vs portrait for export, right now its always portrait which doesnt fit wide charts well. thx
answer: Thanks for the report - the cut-off columns on 'Quarterly Overview' sound like a rendering issue with wide charts in portrait mode, and I've logged this as a bug for our dashboards team to fix. As a workaround for now, try reducing the number of visible series or resizing that chart widget slightly narrower before exporting, which should keep the full chart within the page bounds. I'll also pass along your landscape export request as a feature suggestion since that would help with wider charts generally.

subject: Unsubscribe link in alert emails not working
body: One of our compliance analysts clicked the unsubscribe link at the bottom of a Northwind billing alert email and got a blank page instead of a confirmation. She's still getting the same duplicate alert twice a day (transaction-threshold-exceeded) even though she unsubscribed three times this week. Can you check what's happening with the unsubscribe flow for notification group 'billing-alerts'?
answer: Thanks for flagging this. We're aware of an issue where the unsubscribe confirmation page can fail to load for certain notification groups, which leaves the subscription active on the backend even though the click is logged. I'll manually remove the analyst from the 'billing-alerts' group on our side and escalate the broken unsubscribe endpoint to engineering so it stops sending duplicates going forward.

subject: URGENT: All webhooks failing with 429 since this morning
body:
Since around 7:40am ET today every webhook delivery from our production integration has been rejected. Our logs show consistent 429 Too Many Requests responses even though our call volume hasn't changed from last week. This is blocking reconciliation for our overnight settlement batch and finance is waiting on the callback events.

We also noticed a banner in the dashboard mentioning webhook v1 endpoints are being deprecated - is that related? We're still on v1 and need this fixed immediately, we have 6 people who depend on this pipeline running today.
answer: This has been escalated to our on-call incident team as P0. We're seeing an elevated rate of 429s tied to a rollout of stricter rate limiting ahead of the v1 webhook deprecation, and it appears the new limits were applied more aggressively than intended for some Starter accounts. We're rolling back the limit change now and will confirm once your deliveries are flowing normally; we'll also follow up with a migration timeline for v2 so you're not caught by the deprecation.

subject: App crashes constantly when offline, students losing work
body:
Our students use the Northwind mobile app in classrooms with no wifi, and since the last app update the app crashes within a minute of losing connectivity. It happened on both Android and iOS devices during three separate classes this week. Students lose their in-progress quiz answers every time and have to restart.

The offline mode documentation says data should sync automatically once reconnected, but nothing syncs back - the crash seems to wipe the local cache. We have 8 staff accounts and this is affecting every class that doesn't have reliable internet, which is most of them.
answer: I'm sorry this is disrupting your classes - this is clearly a significant problem and I've flagged it as P1 with our mobile team. We had a recent report of the local cache being cleared on a crash during offline sessions, which matches what you're describing, and engineering is actively investigating a fix. In the meantime, please have staff avoid force-closing the app after a crash, as that seems to trigger the cache wipe; I'll update you as soon as we have a build with the fix or a workaround.

subject: Users logged out too frequently, session length question
body: We've had several employees complain that they're being logged out of Northwind after roughly 20 minutes of inactivity, even though they're actively working in another browser tab. Our SSO is configured through Azure AD and MFA is enforced for all 23 seats. I checked the session timeout setting in the admin console but it's greyed out and I can't find documentation on where the default value comes from or whether it's configurable on our Starter plan.
answer: Session timeout duration on the Starter plan is currently fixed at 20 minutes and isn't configurable from the admin console, which is why that setting appears greyed out - configurable session policies are a Pro and above feature. That said, tab-switching shouldn't count as inactivity if the session token is being refreshed correctly, so I'd like to check your Azure AD SSO logs for token refresh failures; can you send me a timestamp of one recent unexpected logout?

subject: Transform stage failing on all pipelines since last night
body:
Starting around 11pm last night, every transform stage in our fuel-cost reconciliation pipeline has been failing with a data quality error citing null values in a column that was never null before. This is blocking our month-end close because finance can't get the aggregated fuel spend numbers we need for the report due tomorrow morning.

We haven't changed the source connector or schema on our end. The pipeline run history shows 14 consecutive failed runs since the first failure last night. Can someone look at whether something changed on the connector side?
answer: I've escalated this to our data pipelines on-call engineer given the impact on your month-end close. We're pulling the run logs for your fuel-cost reconciliation pipeline now to check whether a recent connector schema update introduced the null values you're seeing. I'll update you within the hour with findings and, if needed, a way to roll back to the last known-good schema mapping so you can get a clean run before your deadline.

subject: Clarification on rate limit headers and SDK retry behavior
body: We're integrating the Northwind API using the Python SDK version 4.2 and want to understand the rate limit headers better. We're seeing X-RateLimit-Remaining drop faster than expected during batch patient-record syncs, and the SDK's built-in retry logic doesn't seem to respect Retry-After consistently - sometimes it retries immediately instead of waiting. Is there updated documentation on the current limits per endpoint, and is this retry behavior a known issue?
answer: Good question - the SDK's retry logic was updated in 4.1 to read Retry-After, but there's a known bug where it falls back to an immediate retry if the header is returned in delta-seconds format rather than an HTTP-date, which is likely what you're hitting. We'll get that fixed in the next SDK patch. For current per-endpoint limits, the rate limit documentation was updated last month to reflect the new tiered limits for Enterprise accounts - I'll send you the direct link along with a workaround for the retry issue in the meantime.

subject: Need to reduce seat count on our plan
body: We signed up for the Starter plan a few months back and were provisioned for more seats than we actually need - we're only using 3 active accounts but I believe we're being billed for more. Could someone review our account and adjust the seat count on our next invoice? I'd also like to know if a partial refund is possible for the seats we haven't been using since signup.
answer: Happy to help adjust this. I can see your account is currently provisioned above your active usage, and I'll reduce the seat count to match your 3 active users effective on your next billing cycle. Refunds for unused seats on prior invoices aren't standard, but let me check with billing on what we can offer given the gap between provisioned and active seats, and I'll follow up here with an answer.

subject: Duplicate daily email digests going out to finance team
body: For the past four days our finance team has been receiving two copies of the daily spending digest email, both timestamped within a minute of each other but with slightly different totals in the summary table. This is causing confusion when reconciling against our own records since the numbers don't always match between the two emails. We have 80 seats and it looks like everyone on the digest distribution list is affected, not just one person.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report - a discrepancy in the totals between the duplicate emails is an important clue, and points to the digest job running twice against slightly different data snapshots rather than just a delivery duplication. I'm opening this as a P2 with our notifications team to trace the duplicate job trigger and confirm which of the two totals is accurate; I'll update you as soon as we've identified the cause and stopped the second send.

subject: ALERT ROUTING SENDING DUPLICATE ALERTS TO WRONG TEAMS
body: THIS IS A SERIOUS BUG. OUR RISK ALERTS ARE BEING ROUTED TO THE COMPLIANCE TEAM AND THE OPERATIONS TEAM AT THE SAME TIME EVEN THOUGH WE ONLY CONFIGURED ROUTING RULES FOR COMPLIANCE. WE HAVE 231 SEATS AND EVERY SINGLE HIGH-PRIORITY ALERT SINCE MONDAY HAS GONE OUT DUPLICATED TO THE WRONG GROUP. OPERATIONS IS NOW GETTING FLOODED WITH ALERTS THAT AREN'T RELEVANT TO THEM AND PEOPLE ARE STARTING TO IGNORE ALL ALERTS BECAUSE OF THE NOISE. THIS NEEDS TO BE FIXED NOW.
answer: I understand the urgency and I'm sorry for the disruption this is causing your teams. This matches a known routing rule bug where a recently added condition can cause alerts to match multiple team rules simultaneously instead of just the intended one, and I'm escalating it to our notifications engineering team as a priority fix. In the meantime, I can help you add a temporary exclusion rule so operations stops receiving the compliance-tagged alerts while we resolve the underlying bug - can you confirm the exact rule name you set up for compliance routing?

subject: Request for push notification customization options
body: We'd like to send our staff and students more targeted push notifications from the Northwind mobile app, but right now it looks like we can only send one generic notification to everyone at once. Is there a way to segment push notifications by user group, or is that on the roadmap? We have 24 seats and different groups need different alerts - staff need admin updates, students need assignment reminders.
answer: Segmented push notifications by user group aren't available yet on the Starter plan, but this is a feature our product team has been actively scoping - group-based targeting is planned for an upcoming release. I'll log your request with the specifics you mentioned (staff vs. student groups) to help prioritize it, and I'll let you know as soon as we have a timeline to share.

subject: PDF export cutting off charts on quarterly dashboard
body:
I'm trying to export our Q3 budget dashboard to PDF so I can send it to our board members, but every export comes out with the bottom two charts completely cut off. I've tried it on three different dashboards now and get the same result. This is blocking our board meeting prep for tomorrow afternoon.

We're on the education plan with 18 seats if that matters. Can someone look into this urgently?
answer: Thank you for flagging this, and I understand the time pressure with your board meeting tomorrow. This looks like an issue with our PDF rendering engine truncating content on multi-chart dashboards, and we're escalating it to our engineering team as a P1 right now. As a workaround, could you try exporting the affected charts individually as a temporary measure while we investigate the full dashboard export? I'll update you within a few hours with progress.

subject: Mobile app crashes immediately on launch for all field techs
body:
Since yesterday morning our field technicians have not been able to open the Northwind mobile app at all - it crashes within a second of tapping the icon, before the login screen even loads. This is affecting technicians across multiple sites and is stopping them from logging offline inspection data. We've had at least 40 reports so far on both iOS and Android devices.

We need push notifications and offline sync to keep working reliably once this is fixed, as our teams rely on both daily. Please advise on a fix or workaround as soon as possible.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report, and I'm sorry for the disruption this is causing your field teams. A crash-on-launch issue affecting this many users is a top priority for us, and we're pulling crash logs from our monitoring now to identify the root cause. Can you confirm the app version and OS versions your technicians are running, and whether this started right after an app update? We'll keep offline sync and push notification stability in mind as we fix this and will update you shortly.

subject: Question about upload failures and file retention settings
body:
We've had a handful of file uploads fail in Storage over the past couple weeks, usually with larger PDF files over 50MB. It's not constant, maybe once every few days, but I'd like to understand what's causing it before it becomes a bigger issue for our small team of 6.

Separately, could someone point me to documentation on how retention periods work for uploaded files? We want to make sure old compliance documents aren't getting purged automatically before we're ready to archive them elsewhere.
answer: Thanks for reaching out. Intermittent upload failures on larger files are often related to network timeouts on our end during peak load windows, and we're happy to dig into your account logs to check for patterns - could you share a couple of the file names or approximate timestamps of the failed uploads? For retention, I'll send over our documentation link that covers default retention periods per plan and how to configure custom retention rules for compliance documents.

subject: Shared dashboard showing wrong permissions to team members
body:
We shared one of our client reporting dashboards with two colleagues last week, but one of them is seeing full edit access when they should only have view rights, and the other can't see the chart export button at all despite having the correct permission level set. I've double-checked the sharing settings twice and they look correct on our end.

We're a small team of 4 and this dashboard has sensitive client financial data, so getting permissions right matters a lot to us. Can you help clarify what's going on?
answer: Thank you for the clear description. This does sound like a sync issue between the sharing settings and the actual permission enforcement on dashboard exports, which we want to correct quickly given the sensitive data involved. Could you confirm the exact dashboard name and the two colleagues' roles as assigned in your workspace, so we can trace the permission mapping on our side? We'll investigate and get back to you with a fix or clear explanation within one business day.

subject: Need guidance on API key rotation and upcoming rate limit changes
body:
I'm setting up a key rotation process for our integration team and want to confirm the best practice for rotating API keys without causing downtime on our production webhooks. We currently have 6 active keys tied to different services across our healthcare platform.

Also, I noticed a note in the changelog about rate limit adjustments coming next quarter, and I saw a deprecation warning on one of our older webhook endpoints. Could you clarify what's changing and whether we need to update our integration before that happens?
answer: Good question, and it's great that you're planning key rotation proactively. Our recommended approach is to generate a new key first, update your services to use it, then revoke the old key after confirming no failed requests over a 24 to 48 hour window - this avoids any webhook downtime. Regarding the rate limit changes, I'll send you the detailed changelog entry, and yes, the older webhook endpoint you mentioned is being deprecated, so we'd recommend migrating to the newer endpoint format before the cutover date to avoid disruption.

subject: Zapier integration setup and connections to Salesforce, Jira, Slack
body:
We're evaluating expanding our Northwind usage across the team and want to connect Zapier so we can automate workflows between Northwind, Salesforce, Jira, and Slack. Right now none of these connections exist yet and I want to understand what's possible before we commit to expanding our seats.

We also use Okta for SSO across the company, so if there are any considerations for how Zapier authentication interacts with that, please let me know. Could someone from the team walk us through available triggers and actions, and point me to relevant documentation?
answer: Thanks for reaching out about expanding your integration setup. Our Zapier connector supports triggers and actions across dashboards, notifications, and identity events, and it works independently of your Okta SSO setup since Zapier authenticates via API key rather than through your SSO provider. I'll loop in our renewals team to schedule a walkthrough call covering the Salesforce, Jira, and Slack connections, along with documentation links to get your team started right away given the seat expansion you're considering.

subject: Configurable session timeout options for SSO users
body:
Our security team wants more granular control over session timeout durations for different user groups authenticating through SSO. Right now it seems like there's a single timeout value applied across the board, but we'd like certain roles, like our engineering leads with elevated permissions, to have shorter sessions while general staff can have longer ones.

We're also curious whether MFA re-prompting can be tied to specific session timeout events rather than just login. Is this something on your roadmap, or is there a way to configure this today across our provisioning setup?
answer: Thanks for the detailed request. Currently, session timeout is set at the workspace level and applies uniformly across all SSO users, so per-role timeout configuration isn't available yet, though I can confirm this has been raised by other enterprise customers and is under consideration for a future release. For MFA re-prompting tied to session events rather than just login, that's also not currently supported, but I'll pass both requests to our product team as feature considerations and keep you updated on any roadmap movement.

subject: App crashes right after opening on some team devices
body:
A couple of our team members are reporting that the mobile app crashes as soon as they open it, right after entering their login credentials. It happens consistently for them but not for everyone on our team of 10, so I'm not sure if it's device-specific. Both affected users are on Android.

Can you help us figure out what's causing this? We also use the app in offline mode occasionally during client visits, so I want to make sure that functionality isn't affected once this gets resolved.
answer: Thanks for the report. Since this seems isolated to specific Android devices rather than affecting your whole team, it's likely related to device OS version or app cache rather than a broader issue, but we'll investigate thoroughly. Could you ask the affected users for their Android version and app version, and have them try clearing the app cache or reinstalling as a first step? We'll also check that offline mode functionality remains stable once we identify the crash cause.

subject: Offline-Modus funktioniert nicht mehr, App stürzt ab
body:
Seit heute Morgen können unsere Vertriebsmitarbeiter die App nicht mehr im Offline-Modus nutzen. Sobald sie versuchen, gespeicherte Daten ohne Internetverbindung zu öffnen, stürzt die App sofort ab. Das betrifft mehrere Mitarbeiter, die gerade bei Kunden unterwegs sind und keine Bestellungen erfassen können.

Wir brauchen dringend eine Lösung, da dies unser Tagesgeschäft direkt beeinträchtigt. Bitte eskalieren Sie das intern, es betrifft unser gesamtes Vertriebsteam mit 8 Lizenzen.
answer: Vielen Dank für die schnelle Meldung, das eskalieren wir sofort intern als P1, da es Ihr gesamtes Vertriebsteam betrifft. Können Sie uns die App-Version sowie die Betriebssysteme der betroffenen Geräte mitteilen, damit wir das Absturzverhalten im Offline-Modus reproduzieren können? Wir melden uns innerhalb der nächsten Stunden mit einem Update oder einer möglichen Übergangslösung.

subject: IP allowlist not blocking access as expected
body:
We configured an IP allowlist last week in the Admin Console to restrict access to our office and VPN IP ranges only, but I just noticed in the audit log that a login occurred from an IP address outside our allowlisted ranges on October 14th. This defeats the purpose of the setting and is a security concern for our legal team's compliance requirements.

Can someone confirm whether the allowlist enforcement is actually active, and check why this login wasn't blocked or flagged? We have 279 seats and need this working correctly before our next compliance review.
answer: Thank you for catching this and reporting it promptly, this is a valid security concern and we're treating it as a priority issue. We'll investigate the queue processing times for your account and provide an update within a few hours, along with a mitigation plan if the delay continues.

subject: Duplicate unsubscribe requests not being honored

subject: Request to improve offline mode reliability in mobile app

subject: Need to update connector authentication for data pipeline
body: We're an IT team at Ember Freight and need to update the authentication method for our warehouse connector in Data Pipelines, since our vendor is rotating API keys on July 1st. Currently our sync jobs use an older OAuth token that will be invalidated, and we want to confirm the change process won't cause downtime or data quality issues during the cutover, since these pipelines feed our retail inventory dashboards daily.

I'd recommend scheduling the credential swap during a low-traffic window; let us know your preferred date and we can walk through the update with you to make sure the sync jobs pick up the new token without missing a run.

subject: Scheduled sync latency spiking on connector for hourly runs
body:
We run an hourly scheduled sync from our MES system into Northwind Data Pipelines (connector id conn-4471). Since Oct 3 the average run time went from ~4 minutes to 22-28 minutes, and two runs on Oct 5 timed out entirely at the 30 minute mark. Row counts look correct on the runs that complete, so this seems like a latency/performance issue rather than data loss.

Can you check if there's throttling on your side for this connector, or if we need to adjust batch size on our end? Our docs reference a max batch of 5000 rows but nothing about timeout thresholds.

In the meantime I'd hold off increasing batch size since that would add more pressure; I'll follow up here once we confirm the fix and share updated timeout guidance for the docs gap you flagged.

subject: Impact of upcoming API deprecations on our billing integration
body:
I manage billing operations for Cobalt Freight and received a notice that the v1 invoicing endpoints are being deprecated. We use these endpoints through a webhook that syncs invoice status into our finance system, and I want to understand what specifically changes and by when.

Could someone confirm the exact sunset date, whether our current webhook payloads will still validate, and if there's an SDK version we should pin to in the meantime? We're on 23 seats and can't afford a gap in invoice reconciliation.

For now I'd recommend pinning to SDK version 4.x, which supports both v1 and v2 concurrently so you can migrate your webhook handler without downtime.

subject: Question about scheduling flexibility for data pipeline syncs
body:
We currently run our Data Pipelines sync on a fixed hourly schedule, but for our booking data we'd really benefit from a finer-grained option, maybe every 10-15 minutes during peak booking hours and hourly otherwise. Is there a way to set variable schedules per connector, or is this only possible with cron expressions on higher tiers?

Also curious if there's a recommended way to reduce latency on our end without hammering the API - right now we just poll on the same interval as the sync.
answer: Good question - right now scheduling is limited to fixed intervals (15 min, hourly, daily) per connector, there isn't a time-of-day variable schedule yet, though it's a request we've heard before and I'll log it as feedback for the product team. As a workaround, you could set up two connectors pointing at the same source with different filters/time windows, one on a 15-minute schedule for your peak window and one hourly for the rest, which avoids extra polling overhead.

subject: Shared dashboard not visible to other staff accounts
body:
I created a dashboard called 'Enrollment Overview' and shared it with two other staff accounts at Harbor Academy using their emails, but they say it doesn't show up in their dashboard list. I tried re-sharing and also checked that their accounts are active. We only have 8 seats total so this is easy to reproduce on our end.

answer: Thanks for the clear description. This is usually caused by the dashboard's visibility being set to 'private to owner' by default even after individual shares are added - could you open the dashboard, go to Share settings, and confirm the toggle next to 'Restrict to owner' is switched off? That setting overrides individual user shares. Let me know if it's already off and I'll dig into your workspace's permission logs directly.

subject: Zapier integration failing for all users since this morning
body:

I'm reissuing the connection credentials on our end and will follow up within the hour with confirmation once it's resolved; in the meantime, reconnecting the Zapier app manually may temporarily restore the trigger.

subject: Need higher rate limits for checkout API during peak traffic
body:
We're integrating the Checkout and Inventory APIs across our retail platform and are consistently hitting 429 responses during flash sale events. Our current limit appears to be 1000 requests/minute per key, but during peak windows (like our event on Nov 18) we saw sustained traffic around 2800 req/min across our top 5 API keys combined.

Can we get a temporary or permanent rate limit increase for these specific keys, and is there an SDK-level backoff helper we should be using instead of our custom retry logic?
