We can provision a temporary rate limit increase to 5000 req/min across your top 5 keys ahead of any known peak events, and can discuss a permanent increase based on sustained usage patterns. Our SDK (v6+) includes a built-in exponential backoff handler for 429s that respects the Retry-After header, which should reduce dropped requests compared to custom retry logic - happy to share a code sample.

subject: Transform step repeatedly failing on numeric field parsing
body:
One of our data pipeline transforms, the one that normalizes fuel usage readings from field sensors, has been failing intermittently since last Thursday. The error shown in the run log is 'TransformError: cannot cast value to decimal at row 1442' but the failing row numbers change each run, and when we manually inspect the source data those rows look like valid numbers to us.

Could someone check if this is related to a recent connector update, and let us know if there's a way to get more detailed logging on which specific value is failing the cast?
answer: Thanks for reporting this - intermittent cast failures with shifting row numbers usually point to a locale/formatting mismatch (for example, comma vs period decimal separators) rather than the values themselves being invalid. We did push a connector update last Wednesday that changed how numeric locale is inferred from source headers, which likely explains the timing. I'm enabling verbose logging on your transform now so the next failed run will include the actual raw value that failed the cast, and I'll follow up once we have that detail.

subject: urgent

subject: Multiple transform failures across pipelines this morning - looks widespread

We're rolling back that change now and will re-run the affected pipelines automatically once it's confirmed reverted; I'll update this ticket as soon as that's done, expecting full resolution within the hour given the scope you've described.

subject: Request to update IP allowlist for new office location
body:
We're opening a second office and need to add its public IP range to our Admin Console allowlist alongside our existing headquarters range. Can you confirm the process for adding a second entry without disrupting access for our current 14 users, and whether changes take effect immediately or if there's a propagation delay?

Every allowlist change is automatically recorded in the Audit Log with the admin who made the change, timestamp, and the CIDR range added or removed, so you shouldn't need a separate compliance record for that specific action.

subject: Feature request: webhook retry configuration options
body:

Could you add support for per-endpoint retry configuration, or at least document the current retry/backoff behavior so we can plan our rate limiting accordingly? Happy to provide our webhook endpoint ID if useful.

Webhook retries currently use a fixed exponential backoff (5 attempts over roughly 24 hours) and aren't user-configurable yet, but per-endpoint retry settings are on our product roadmap. I've logged this as a feature request and linked it to your account so we can notify you if it ships. In the meantime, I can share the exact backoff schedule so you can plan your endpoint's rate limiting around it.

subject: URGENT: API rate limit throttling causing dropped webhook events for many users

subject: Question about upgrading from Pro to Enterprise mid-cycle
body: I'm looking into upgrading North Capital's plan from Pro to Enterprise before our renewal date in September. We currently have 80 seats and expect to add another 30 next quarter. Could you clarify how the billing works if we upgrade mid-cycle - will we be prorated for the remaining days on Pro, and does the seat increase get billed separately or bundled into the new plan rate?

When you upgrade mid-cycle, we prorate the unused portion of your current Pro subscription and apply it as a credit toward the new Enterprise invoice, so you're only charged the difference for the remaining billing period. Additional seats can be added at the same time and will be billed at the Enterprise per-seat rate, prorated the same way - I can generate a sample invoice showing the exact numbers for your 80 to 110 seat scenario if that would help with planning.

subject: Repeated upload failures for CSV files over 500MB

I'm escalating to engineering now given your end-of-week deadline and will update you with either a workaround (splitting the file or using our CLI upload tool, which handles large files more reliably) or a fix timeline within the day.

subject: Pagination broken - only returning first page of results across all endpoints

subject: Late-arriving records from retail connector causing minor sync gaps

subject: URGENT: Late-arriving data causing incorrect financial reconciliation reports company-wide

body: our scheduled syncs have been failing SILENTLY for THREE DAYS and nobody told us anything!! we only found out becuase a teacher reported missing enrollment data. this is unacceptable for a paying customer, we pay for 11 seats and expect this to actually WORK. if this isnt fixed today we are cancelling and moving to a competitor. the sync status page shows green even tho no data has come thru since monday, how is that even possible?? fix this NOW

subject: PDF export cuts off charts on the right side
body:
When I export a dashboard to PDF for Willow Energy, any chart wider than the default view gets cut off on the right edge instead of scaling to fit the page. Is there a setting to force the PDF to scale charts to page width, or is this a known bug we should expect a fix for?
answer: Thanks for the clear description - this is a known limitation with wide charts in PDF export, where the layout engine currently prioritizes the chart's native width over page scaling. There isn't a manual scale-to-fit setting yet, but I'll log this as a bug against the export renderer since it's clearly affecting readability. As a workaround in the meantime, try switching the chart to a vertical orientation or reducing categories per chart, which tends to render correctly within the page bounds.

subject: Request for granular dashboard sharing permissions across departments
body:
As we roll out dashboards across Orion Media's regional offices, we're finding the current sharing model only allows all-or-nothing access at the workspace level. With 4,359 seats spread across dozens of departments, we need the ability to share individual dashboards with specific teams or roles without giving them access to everything else in the workspace.

In the meantime, the closest workaround is creating separate sub-workspaces for compliance-sensitive dashboards so you can restrict visibility without full workspace segmentation. I'll follow up with a timeline once I hear back from the product team on the beta rollout.

subject: Connector-Authentifizierung schlägt fehl bei Google Drive Quelle
body:
Wir nutzen die Data Pipelines um Dateien aus Google Drive in unser Dashboard zu importieren. Seit dem 3. subject: Slack alerts completely stopped - critical for our incident escalation

subject: Duplicate email digests going out twice per day

subject: SCIM provisioning failing for new users with permission errors

subject: Getting duplicate alerts for every single event via API
body:

I've checked our code and we're only calling the endpoint once per event, confirmed via our own request logs which show a single 201 response each time.

We only have 3 seats on this Starter plan so it's easy to see this happening consistently, roughly 15-20 duplicate alerts today alone. Is there a known idempotency key parameter we should be using, and if so where's that documented?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report and for confirming it's a single request on your end. This does sound like it could be a delivery-side duplication rather than your integration, and we do support an Idempotency-Key header on the notifications endpoint which I'd recommend adding right away to prevent further duplicates while we investigate. I'm pulling the delivery logs for your account now to see where the second send is originating and will follow up shortly.

subject: Need working unsubscribe link for notification emails
body:
Several of our contacts have replied asking to unsubscribe from the weekly notification emails Northwind sends on our behalf, but the unsubscribe link at the bottom of the email leads to a 404 page. I've tested this myself with three different emails and get the same broken link every time, dated as recently as today.

As a legal firm we take opt-out compliance seriously and this is becoming a real liability for us with only 4 seats and a small client list to manage. Can you fix the unsubscribe flow urgently and let us know if there's a way to manually process opt-out requests in the meantime?
answer: I understand the urgency here given the compliance implications, and I'm sorry for the broken unsubscribe link. In the meantime, I can manually add specific email addresses to your suppression list if you send them to me, so those contacts stop receiving digests immediately while we fix the link itself. I'm escalating the broken unsubscribe flow to our notifications team now and will keep you posted on the timeline for a permanent fix.

subject: Scheduled syncs failing across multiple pipelines since this morning
body:
We have several scheduled data pipeline syncs running hourly against our SAP and Snowflake connectors, and starting around 6:40am UTC today all of them began failing with timeout errors. The error we're seeing repeatedly is "sync job exceeded max execution time of 900s, partial data committed" which is causing inconsistent row counts downstream.

Given our scale at 3975 seats, this is affecting energy trading data feeds that multiple teams rely on for daily reporting. We need to know if this is a platform-wide capacity issue or specific to our account, since partial commits are creating serious data quality problems in our warehouse right now.
answer: We're treating this as a high-priority outage given the data integrity impact and are actively investigating a timeout pattern affecting scheduled sync jobs across several connector types starting around the same window you reported. Our engineering team is looking at whether partial commits can be rolled back cleanly to avoid inconsistent state in your warehouse, and I'll have an update for you within the hour as we isolate whether this is capacity-related or connector-specific.

subject: upgrade broke, need help now
body: Tried upgrading plan, got charged twice, still shows old plan.

subject: Need to update SAML login configuration after IdP certificate rotation
body:
Our identity team rotated the signing certificate on our IdP side last week as part of routine security maintenance, and we now need to update the corresponding SAML configuration in Northwind to match the new certificate fingerprint. We have 4872 employees using SSO to log in daily, so we want to schedule this change carefully to avoid a login outage.

Could you walk us through the correct sequence for updating the SAML metadata without disrupting active sessions, and confirm whether MFA enrollment or existing permission mappings would be affected by this change? We'd like to plan this for a low-traffic window this weekend.
answer: Thanks for planning ahead on this given your scale - updating the SAML certificate is generally low-risk to existing sessions if done in the right order. The recommended sequence is to upload the new certificate to your SSO configuration alongside the old one first, verify a test login succeeds with the new cert, then remove the old certificate once confirmed; this avoids any login outage and won't affect MFA enrollment or existing permission mappings since those are tied to user identity, not the certificate. I've attached the documentation link for the exact steps and I'm happy to be on standby during your weekend maintenance window if you'd like.

subject: SDK throwing unexpected 429 errors well below documented rate limits
body:
We're using the Northwind Python SDK version 4.2 in our production integration and starting yesterday we began seeing frequent 429 responses even though our request volume is well under the documented rate limit of 600 requests per minute for our Pro tier. We also noticed a deprecation warning in the SDK console output referencing an older webhook signing method, and I'm wondering if that's related. This is affecting our production webhook processing for about 208 users on our team, so we'd appreciate a quick look at whether something changed on the rate limiting logic recently.
answer: Thanks for the detailed numbers - a 429 well under your documented limit suggests either a rate limit miscalculation on a specific endpoint or a burst pattern in your requests that isn't reflected in your per-minute average. I'll have our API platform team check if there's a recent change to the rate limiter for webhook-related endpoints, and separately confirm whether the deprecation warning you're seeing is unrelated noise or tied to this issue; I'll follow up with findings shortly.

subject: Need Jira link reconnected for Integrations before sprint planning

I'll also flag this pattern to our team so future cert rotations don't silently break the Jira token.

subject: Bulk uploads to Storage failing since this morning

I'll update you within the hour with either a fix or a manual quota refresh, and in the meantime please hold off on retrying uploads to avoid duplicate queuing.

subject: Offline mode causing crashes and login loops on mobile app

We'll aim to have a hotfix candidate within 24 hours given the compliance deadline you mentioned.

subject: Urgent - deactivated users still showing active acess in Admin Console
body: we deactivated about 40 users yestrday from teh Admin Console after a reorg but several of them are still able to log in and their names still show up as active in teh audit log. this is a big problem becuase some of these accounts are for contractors whose access shoud have ended immediatly. we also noticed the allowlist settings page is loading really slow, taking like 20-30 seconds to open. with 1558 seats we cant have this kind of lag on security settings, please advise asap.

In the meantime, please send me the specific user IDs still able to log in so we can force-terminate their sessions manually while we fix the root cause.

subject: How to stop duplicate email digests going out

It's not urgent, just annoying since we have to tell people to ignore the second one. Is there a setting to consolidate this, or is this a known bug with the alerting rules?
answer: Thanks for reporting this - duplicate digests usually happen when two alerting rules with overlapping recipient groups are both active, so I'd like to check your Notifications configuration for duplicate digest rules pointing to the same email list. Could you confirm the exact rule name shown under your digest settings? Once I see that I can either merge the rules or point you to the setting that consolidates recipients.

subject: Question about upcoming API deprecations affecting our rate limits
body: I saw the changelog note about the v1 booking endpoints being deprecated next quarter and wanted to understand how this affects our current rate limit tier before we plan our migration. We're currently on the older pagination scheme for search results and I want to confirm whether the new endpoints keep the same rate limits or if we need to request an increase. I'll send you the updated migration guide which covers the new pagination scheme and rate limit behavior, and I'd recommend testing against our sandbox environment before the cutover date to confirm your integration handles the new response format cleanly.

subject: help
body: our alert routing rules keep sending the same duplicate warning emails to our whole team instead of just escalating to the on-call person like they used to. this started after we added a new escalation rule last week and now everyone gets flooded. can we get this fixed or at least get a way to route by role instead of blasting everyone.

Can you share the name of the escalation rule you added last week so I can check the routing logic and get role-based escalation working correctly?

subject: Deactivation and allowlist issue
body:
I wanted to give some background first - we've been tightening our access controls this month as part of an internal security review ahead of an audit next week, and part of that involved reviewing our allowlist settings and updating escalation contacts in the Admin Console. We're investigating why the deactivation isn't invalidating active sessions immediately; in the meantime, please send me the three account identifiers so we can manually force-terminate their sessions right now while we trace the root cause in the deactivation workflow.

subject: SDK broken after webhook signature deprecation change
body: We updated our SDK to the latest version last week ahead of the announced webhook signature deprecation, but now our webhook receiver is rejecting all incoming events with 'signature verification failed' errors. We checked our secret key configuration and it matches what's shown in the API Platform dashboard, so I'm not sure what changed on the signing algorithm side. This is affecting all inbound webhook events for our manufacturing order pipeline since the update on the 14th.
answer: Thanks for the detailed timeline - the signature deprecation did change the hashing algorithm from SHA-1 to SHA-256 for webhook payloads, and if your SDK update pulled in the new verification logic but your receiver code still expects the old format, that would cause exactly this failure. Can you confirm which SDK version you're on now? I'll send over the migration notes with a code snippet for the updated verification method so you can get events flowing again.

subject: Pagination behavior question on API Platform
body: We're seeing inconsistent results when paginating through large result sets on the API Platform - specifically, the 'next_cursor' value sometimes points back to records we already retrieved, causing duplicate entries in our retail inventory sync. This has happened intermittently over the past two weeks, not on every request. We're on the current SDK version and haven't made changes on our end recently. Wondering if this relates to the pagination deprecation mentioned in recent release notes.
answer: Thanks for flagging this - intermittent cursor repetition usually points to a race condition when records are updated between pagination requests, which can be more noticeable with larger inventory datasets like yours. This isn't directly tied to the pagination deprecation, but I'll have our API team review your account's recent request logs to confirm the pattern, and I'll follow up with guidance on using timestamp-based filtering as a workaround in the meantime.

subject: Duplicate alerts being routed to wrong email channel

We're disabling the redundant rule on our end and will confirm once the duplicates stop, likely within the hour.

subject: URGENT: All users being logged out repeatedly - SSO sessions dying

subject: Dashboards loading slowly during business hours

subject: Role mapping not syncing correctly after SSO update

subject: How to restore files from backup after accidental deletion

subject: Feedback on upcoming webhook deprecation notice

subject: SAML login failures blocking finance team access

subject: Duplicate email alerts for invoice notifications

subject: Recurring card decline on monthly renewal

subject: Field mapping change needed for Salesforce sync

subject: Question on configuring custom retention policy for Storage
body:
We're trying to set up a custom retention policy for our Storage workspace to comply with a client's document retention requirement of 10 years for case files. Currently it looks like the longest preset option in the retention settings panel tops out at 5 years. With 257 seats across our legal teams, this is becoming urgent as we onboard a new client next week.

Is there a way to configure a custom retention period beyond the presets, either through the admin console or via API? If not directly supported, we'd appreciate guidance on a workaround, such as a manual archival process, since we need this in place before the new client's files start coming in.
answer: Thanks for reaching out, and I understand the urgency given your upcoming client onboarding. Custom retention periods beyond the 5-year preset aren't currently exposed in the admin console, but our Pro plan does support extended retention via the Storage API's retention-policy endpoint, which allows custom values up to 15 years. I'll send over the API documentation and a sample request so your team can configure this ahead of next week, and I'll also flag this as a feature request to have the UI support longer presets directly.

subject: PDF export from Dashboards producing corrupted files
body:
Our staff have been trying to export dashboards to PDF for a board meeting and the files are coming out corrupted or blank on about half the attempts. We have 18 seats and this is affecting multiple users across different dashboards, not just one chart type - both the enrollment trends bar chart and the budget line chart are affected.

When it does export, the PDF sometimes shows the chart legend overlapping the data, making it unreadable. We need reliable exports for a presentation in two days, so this needs urgent attention.
answer: Thank you for the clear description, and apologies for the timing given your upcoming presentation. This matches a known issue with our PDF export renderer for certain chart layouts that we're actively working to fix - I've marked this ticket P1 and linked it to the active bug. In the meantime, exporting as PNG per chart and assembling into a PDF should give you reliable output for the board meeting, and I'll update you as soon as the renderer fix is deployed.

subject: Seat count discrepancy on our last invoice
body:
Our IT team manages the Northwind account for North Travel and we noticed our latest invoice reflects 260 seats, but our actual active user count in the admin console is 243. We removed 17 employees in a reorg back in early March and it seems the deactivation didn't sync properly with billing.

Can you review our account and issue a corrected invoice or credit for the overcharge? We'd also like to understand why seat deactivations aren't automatically reflected in billing so this doesn't happen again next cycle.
answer: Thank you for catching this and providing the specific numbers. I've pulled up your account and can confirm the seat count discrepancy - it looks like a sync delay between the admin console deactivations and our billing system caused the mismatch. I'm processing a credit for the 17 excess seats on your next invoice and escalating the sync issue to engineering so this doesn't recur. You'll receive the corrected invoice within 2 business days.

subject: Uploads failing repeatedly for our media assets in Storage
body:
We've been getting consistent upload failures in Storage over the past two days, mostly with video files over 500MB. The error we see is "Upload interrupted: connection reset" and it happens on retry too, even on a stable connection. This is blocking our content team of 24 from getting new course footage into the platform ahead of a launch this week.

We also noticed our quota usage indicator seems stuck showing 78% even though we've deleted several large files since yesterday. Could you check both issues? The upload failures are the priority since we're on a tight deadline.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report - I understand the pressure with your launch this week. The upload interruptions on large files match an issue we're currently tracking related to timeout handling for files over 400MB, and our engineering team is deploying a fix today. As a workaround in the meantime, try splitting uploads into smaller chunks or using our desktop sync client, which handles large files more reliably. I'm also looking into the quota indicator discrepancy and will follow up separately once I have an answer.

subject: Biometric login intermittently failing on mobile app
body:
A few of our team members have reported that Face ID / fingerprint login on the Northwind mobile app occasionally fails and drops back to the password screen, even though biometric login is enabled in their device settings. It seems to happen more often after the app has been in the background for a while. Not a huge issue since password login still works fine, but wanted to flag it.

This has come up for maybe 5 or 6 of our 211 seats so far, mostly on newer Android devices. Not urgent, just wanted this on your radar in case it's a wider bug.
answer: Thanks for flagging this, even though it's low impact right now. We've had a couple of similar reports tied to biometric session tokens expiring after extended background time on certain Android versions. I'll log this for our mobile team to investigate further, and in the meantime password login remains a reliable fallback. I'll follow up here once we have more information on a fix.

subject: Upload failures during Storage service disruption today
body:
We're currently unable to upload any files to Storage - every attempt across our team of 114 seats fails with a generic "Upload failed, please try again" message. This started about 30 minutes ago and is affecting all file types and sizes we've tested, not just large ones. Our travel bookings documentation team relies on this daily and they're now completely blocked.

Is this a known outage on your end? We'd appreciate a status update and ETA for resolution since this is impacting active client work right now.
answer: Thanks for reporting this promptly. We're aware of a Storage service disruption affecting uploads for multiple customers starting around the same time you noticed it, and our infrastructure team is actively working on resolution. I'll keep this ticket open and post updates as we have them - current estimate for restoration is within the next hour, and we'll follow up immediately once uploads are confirmed working again.

subject: Feature request: quiet hours for mobile push notifications
body:
Our travel booking staff use the Northwind mobile app heavily and several have asked whether it's possible to set quiet hours for push notifications, so they don't get booking alerts outside of business hours. Right now it seems all-or-nothing - notifications are either fully on or fully off in the app settings.

With 293 seats across our finance and operations teams, this would be a nice quality-of-life improvement for staff who travel across time zones. Not urgent, just wanted to submit this as feedback for a future release.
answer: Thank you for the thoughtful suggestion - this is a great use case, especially for teams spanning multiple time zones. Quiet hours for push notifications isn't currently available, but I'm logging this as a feature request and passing it along to our mobile product team for consideration in an upcoming release. I'll keep this ticket noted so we can update you if it gets prioritized.

subject: Retention settings appear reset after outage
body:
Following a brief Storage outage on our end this morning, we noticed our retention policy for legal case archives has reverted to the default 30-day setting instead of our configured 3-year retention. We have 54 seats and rely on the longer retention for compliance with client contracts, so this is concerning.

Can you confirm whether any files were purged due to this reset, and restore our retention configuration to 3 years? We'd also like an explanation of what caused the setting to revert during the outage.
answer: Thank you for reporting this quickly - I understand the compliance concern here. I've confirmed no files have been purged yet since the default 30-day window hasn't elapsed, so your data is safe. I'm restoring your retention configuration to 3 years now and will investigate why the outage caused a reset of this setting, with a full explanation and prevention plan to follow within 24 hours.

subject: Refund not issued for double-charged invoice INV-30412
body: We were charged twice for our March subscription on Apex Media's account - invoice INV-30412 and INV-30413 both show $149.00 on March 3rd. I submitted a refund request through the billing portal on March 5th and got a confirmation email, but the second charge is still sitting on our card statement as of today. Our finance team needs this resolved before month-end close. Can someone manually process the credit?
answer: I'm sorry for the duplicate charge and the delay in getting this resolved before your close. I've located both invoices and confirmed INV-30413 was an erroneous duplicate - I'm issuing a full refund of $149.00 to your card on file now and you should see it post within 3-5 business days. I'll also flag this account so our team can review why the duplicate charge occurred and send you a written confirmation for your finance records.

subject: zapier
body:
SO WE'VE BEEN USING NORTHWIND FOR ABOUT EIGHT MONTHS NOW ACROSS OUR TRAVEL OPS AND SUPPORT TEAMS AND THINGS HAVE GENERALLY BEEN FINE. WE ALREADY HAVE SALESFORCE, OKTA AND JIRA CONNECTED THROUGH YOUR NATIVE INTEGRATIONS AND THOSE WORK GREAT FOR OUR WORKFLOWS.

WHAT I ACTUALLY WANTED TO ASK IS WHETHER THERE ARE PLANS TO ADD A ZAPIER INTEGRATION SO WE CAN BUILD SOME LIGHTER WEIGHT AUTOMATIONS WITHOUT WRITING CUSTOM CODE AGAINST THE API. IS THIS ON THE ROADMAP?
answer: Thanks for the detailed context, and glad to hear the Salesforce, Okta, and Jira integrations are working well for your team. A native Zapier integration isn't currently on our public roadmap, but I'll pass this along to our product team as a feature request since it comes up periodically. In the meantime, our REST API and webhooks can support custom Zapier triggers via webhook-based Zaps if you want a workaround in the short term.

subject: Duplicate email digests being sent twice daily
body: Our team started receiving the daily notification digest twice each morning starting last Tuesday - once around 6am and again around 6:15am with identical content. We only have digest frequency set to 'once daily' in the notification settings. This is generating confusion among our 5 users who think there are new alerts when it's just a resend. Can you check if this is a known issue with the digest scheduler?
answer: Thanks for flagging this - a duplicate digest send is not expected behavior. I checked our notification logs for your account and can confirm two digest jobs fired within 15 minutes of each other on the dates you mentioned. This looks like a scheduling glitch on our end rather than anything in your settings. I've reset your digest schedule and will monitor the next few sends to confirm it's back to a single daily email; I'll follow up once I've verified it's stable.

subject: Slack alert integration completely down - no notifications since this morning
body: Our Slack alerting integration stopped working around 8:30am today. None of our on-call channels have received any alert notifications despite multiple triggered events in our monitoring dashboards. We rely on this heavily across our logistics operations teams - this is our primary incident notification channel. We have not made any changes to our Slack workspace or Okta SSO config recently. Can someone investigate urgently, this is affecting our whole organization's incident response.
answer: This has been escalated to our on-call engineering team given the scale of impact on your incident response process. Initial investigation shows a token refresh failure between our Slack connector and your workspace starting at 8:22am today, which is preventing outbound alert delivery. We're working to re-authenticate the connection now and will update you within the hour with either a fix or a status update - in the meantime, please monitor your dashboards directly as a temporary fallback.

subject: Audit log missing entries for user deactivation events
body: I'm building an internal compliance report using the Admin Console audit log API and noticed that deactivation events for users are not appearing in the log at all. I deactivated three test accounts on April 2nd (user IDs ending in 4471, 4472, and 4473) and confirmed they show as inactive in the console, but querying /v2/audit-log with event_type=user.deactivated returns zero results for that date range. Our healthcare compliance team requires complete audit trails including all access changes - this gap is a significant problem for our upcoming audit.
answer: Thank you for the specific user IDs and timestamps - this is very helpful for tracing the issue. We've confirmed that deactivation events are being recorded internally but are not currently being surfaced through the audit log API endpoint due to a filtering bug on event_type mapping. Given the compliance implications, I'm escalating this to our engineering team as a priority fix and will provide you with a manual export of the missing deactivation records for your audit in the meantime, along with an ETA on the API fix.

subject: Request to change alert routing rules for duplicate performance alerts
body: We're seeing the same performance degradation alert routed to both our on-call email list and a secondary escalation list simultaneously, which creates duplicate tickets in our tracking system. I'd like to change the routing rule so that performance-category alerts only escalate to the secondary list if unacknowledged after 15 minutes, rather than firing both immediately. Can someone help me update this routing configuration or point me to where I can self-serve this change?
answer: Thanks for the clear description of what you're trying to achieve. You can actually configure tiered escalation delays yourself under Notifications > Alert Routing > Escalation Rules, where you can set a time-based condition before the secondary list is notified. I'd recommend setting the delay to 15 minutes as you described and testing with a low-priority alert first to confirm the timing behaves as expected - let me know if you'd like me to walk through the specific rule configuration with you.

subject: Cannot find audit log entries for allowlist changes made last week
body: I'm reviewing our security allowlist configuration and need to confirm who added two new IP ranges to our API allowlist on April 8th, since neither I nor our other admin remember making that change. The Admin Console audit log shows entries for login and permission changes around that date but nothing under settings or allowlist categories. This is concerning from a security standpoint since we don't know who authorized the change or whether it was intentional.
answer: I understand the urgency here given the security implications of an unexplained allowlist change. I've pulled the backend configuration history for your account and can confirm the allowlist was modified on April 8th at 2:47pm UTC by an account with admin role, though the audit log UI is currently not displaying settings-category events correctly - this is a known gap we're fixing. I'll send you the raw event details including the acting user identifier directly so you can verify whether this was authorized, and I'm treating this as high priority given the compliance queue.

subject: Invoice shows wrong seat count and feature tier
body: Our latest invoice (billing period March 1-31) lists 303 seats and includes a line item for a premium feature add-on that we never enabled. We're on the Enterprise plan but the invoice total is higher than expected because of this add-on charge. Can you review the invoice and confirm whether this was applied in error, and issue a corrected invoice if so?
answer: Thank you for catching this discrepancy. I've reviewed your account and confirmed the premium feature add-on was activated in error during a plan sync on March 12th and shouldn't have been billed to your account. I'm issuing a corrected invoice removing that line item and will process a credit for the difference on your next billing cycle - you should see the updated invoice in your billing portal within the next business day.

subject: Users getting logged out every 20 minutes despite SSO session settings
body: Since last week, our team members using SSO login are being logged out of the dashboard roughly every 20 minutes, even though our session timeout policy in Identity and SSO settings is configured for 8 hours. This is happening across multiple users on different browsers, not just one machine. I checked our IdP-side session settings and they look unchanged. This is significantly disrupting workflows for our analysts who have to re-authenticate constantly throughout the day.
answer: Thank you for the detailed report - a mismatch between the configured 8-hour timeout and the 20-minute behavior you're seeing points to a session token refresh issue rather than a policy problem. Can you confirm whether MFA is required at each login for the affected users, and share one or two user identifiers experiencing this? In the meantime, I'm reviewing our SSO session logs for your account to identify whether tokens are being invalidated prematurely on our end.

subject: Requesting higher webhook rate limits and retry visibility
body: We're integrating Northwind webhooks into our logistics tracking system and currently hitting the rate limit of 100 events per minute during peak shipment updates, causing some webhook deliveries to be dropped rather than queued. Is it possible to request a higher limit for our account, and separately, is there a way to view failed webhook delivery attempts and retry history through the API or dashboard? Our SDK version is 2.3.1 if that's relevant.
answer: Thanks for the details, including the SDK version. For the rate limit increase, I can submit a request on your behalf to raise your webhook throughput - can you share your typical peak events-per-minute so we size it correctly? On the retry visibility question, you can currently view failed delivery attempts and retry status under API Platform > Webhooks > Delivery Logs in the dashboard, and the same data is available via the /v2/webhooks/deliveries endpoint if you'd prefer to pull it programmatically.

subject: Mobile app crashing on launch for field staff after latest update
body:
Since the app update rolled out on our stores' tablets this week, we're seeing crashes on launch for about 30 of our 4045 users, mostly in locations with weak wifi. The app opens to a splash screen then closes immediately. It seems tied to offline mode syncing push notifications before login completes. We've had staff try reinstalling with no luck.

Can we get this escalated? It's disrupting shift check-ins at several retail locations.
answer: Thanks for flagging this and for the detail on the offline/push correlation, that's very helpful. We're opening an escalation now and will pull crash logs from the affected device IDs if you can share a few examples. In the meantime, ask affected users to clear the app cache and disable auto-sync until they have stable wifi, which should prevent the launch crash.

subject: Okta app integration failing for a subset of Salesforce/Jira users
body: We configured the Okta app for SSO into Northwind last month, and starting this morning several of our 22 users can't authenticate through to Salesforce or Jira from the Northwind dashboard. The Okta admin console shows successful SAML assertions, but Northwind returns a generic 'integration unavailable' error on the Slack notification step too. This is blocking three of our support engineers from their morning workflow.
answer: Sorry for the disruption this is causing your team. We're seeing some intermittent errors on our Okta connector's downstream calls to Salesforce and Jira and are actively investigating a performance issue on that integration path. We'll update this ticket within the hour with a fix or workaround, and in the meantime affected users can log in directly to Salesforce/Jira and use Northwind's dashboard view without the linked actions.

subject: Need clarity on upcoming API deprecations affecting our webhook integration
body: I'm integrating the API Platform for our media publishing workflow and just got a 410 Gone response on the /v1/webhooks/subscribe endpoint that worked fine last week. Checking the changelog, it looks like this was deprecated but our SDK version (2.3.1) doesn't reference the new endpoint anywhere in its docs. We're also hitting rate limit headers that don't match what's documented (X-RateLimit-Remaining shows negative values).
answer: Thanks for the report, and apologies for the documentation gap on the webhook endpoint migration. The correct replacement is /v2/webhooks/subscriptions, and we're updating the SDK docs and changelog today to reflect this along with corrected rate limit header behavior. I'll follow up with a direct link to the migration guide and flag the negative header issue to our API team as a separate bug.

subject: Question about transform failures in our travel booking pipeline
body: We've noticed intermittent transform failures in one of our data pipelines that syncs booking data from our reservation connector, happening a few times a week rather than consistently. The pipeline dashboard shows a data quality warning about null values in the currency_code field, but the source data looks complete when we check manually. We're not blocked, just trying to understand what's causing this before it scales with our booking volume.
answer: Thanks for reaching out, and good timing since we've seen a few similar reports tied to a recent connector update. The null currency_code issue likely stems from a timing mismatch where the transform runs before a late-arriving enrichment step completes. I'd recommend adding a short delay or retry condition on that transform node, and I'll share a configuration example along with best practices for reducing sync latency in your pipeline.

subject: Incorrect invoice amount charged this cycle
body: Our invoice for this billing cycle shows a charge of $412.00 but based on our seat count it should be $290.00 per our contract. This is the second time in three months we've seen a discrepancy like this. We need this corrected and a refund issued for the overcharge before our finance team closes the books on the 5th.
answer: I'm sorry for the trouble with your invoice, and I understand the urgency given your closing deadline. I've pulled up your account and can confirm a proration error on this cycle's invoice; I'm processing a correction and refund for the difference now, which should post within 2-3 business days. I'll also flag this billing cycle for review to prevent a recurrence next month.

subject: UPLOADS FAILING AGAIN - THIRD TIME THIS MONTH
body:
This is beyond frustrating. Our storage uploads have been failing intermittently for the third time this month and nobody has given us a real answer yet. Here's the log from this morning:

ERROR 2024-05-14T08:12:33Z storage-upload-svc: chunk upload failed after 3 retries
Request ID: 9f2a-77b1-4e3c
HTTP 503 Service Unavailable
Bucket: cobalt-media-assets
File size: 1.2GB
Retention policy: 90-day

We are seriously considering canceling our contract if this keeps happening. We need this fixed today.
answer: I hear your frustration, and I apologize for the repeat disruption to your uploads, especially with this being the third occurrence. I've escalated this immediately with the request ID you provided and confirmed our storage service is experiencing elevated 503s in the region tied to your bucket; our infrastructure team is actively working the incident right now. I will update you within the hour with root cause and expect uploads to be fully stable before end of day.

subject: Duplicate email digests being sent to entire staff list
body: Starting yesterday, our weekly email digest notifications are being sent twice to every recipient on our staff list, about 10 minutes apart. This is confusing our team and several people have already asked if something's wrong with their account. We haven't changed any notification settings on our end recently. Can you help stop the duplicates going out again this week?
answer: Thank you for the quick report, this is impacting your whole team so we're treating it as high priority. We've identified a duplicate trigger in our digest scheduler that's affecting a subset of accounts including yours, and we're deploying a fix now to stop the second send before your next scheduled digest goes out. I'll confirm here once it's resolved and monitor your account's next digest cycle directly.

subject: Urgent: card failures blocking seat renewal for our team
body: We're trying to add 5 more seats to our plan but the payment keeps failing with 'card declined - do not honor' even though the same card works fine for other services. This is blocking our new hires from getting access starting Monday. We also noticed our last invoice still shows a pending charge from a failed attempt that never got refunded. Can someone look into this today?
answer: Thanks for flagging this, and I understand the time pressure with new hires starting Monday. I can see the failed authorization attempts on your account and I'm refunding the pending charge from the earlier failed try now. For the seat addition, please try an alternate card or contact your bank about the decline code, and in the meantime I'm manually provisioning the 5 seats so your new hires aren't blocked while we sort out payment.

subject: Need bulk user deactivation endpoint with audit logging
body: I'm building an integration against the Admin Console API to deactivate users when they leave our fintech platform, but I only see a single-user DELETE endpoint. With just 6 seats today we're doing this manually, but we're onboarding more clients soon and need a way to deactivate multiple users in one call and confirm each action shows up in the audit log correctly. Is there a bulk endpoint on the roadmap, or a documented workaround?
answer: Thanks for the detailed request. There isn't a bulk deactivation endpoint yet, but you can loop the existing single-user DELETE endpoint with minimal rate limit impact at your current scale, and each call does write a corresponding audit log entry with actor and timestamp. I'm passing your request for a native bulk endpoint to our product team as we've had similar asks, and I'll update this ticket if it gets prioritized on the roadmap.

subject: Storage retention policy not deleting files past 90-day quota
body: We configured a 90-day retention policy on our backup storage bucket, but I'm seeing files from over 120 days ago still counting against our quota. This is pushing us close to our storage limit for our 242 seats. I checked the retention settings page and everything looks correctly configured with the 90-day rule applied to the right bucket.
answer: Thanks for the clear description, this helps narrow it down quickly. We've identified a bug where files uploaded via the legacy backup client bypass the retention policy's automatic cleanup job, which matches what you're seeing with files past 120 days. I'm running a manual cleanup on your bucket now to bring your quota back in line, and our engineering team is deploying a fix to the retention job so this doesn't recur.

subject: Transform step failing intermittently on JSON payloads
body: We're integrating with the Data Pipelines API and seeing our transform step fail intermittently on pipeline id dp-4471. About 1 in 20 runs throws a schema mismatch error even though the source JSON hasn't changed. This started around March 3rd. Could you point us to documentation on how the transform stage handles optional nested fields, since our current mapping might be too strict?
answer: Thanks for the details on pipeline dp-4471. Intermittent schema mismatches on otherwise stable payloads are usually caused by optional nested fields being present in some records and absent in others, which our transform engine treats strictly by default. I'll send over our documentation on configuring nullable field handling in the transform config, and I'd also recommend enabling schema drift logging on that pipeline so we can see the exact records that failed.

subject: URGENT: API pagination broken, all webhook consumers failing
body: Starting at 14:02 UTC today every paginated GET request to /v2/resources is returning duplicate items across pages, causing our webhook consumers to reprocess the same records repeatedly. This is affecting all 28 seats on our workspace and our downstream billing sync has now stopped entirely. We rely on cursor-based pagination and the 'next_cursor' field is returning the same value across three consecutive calls.
answer: We've identified this as a P0 outage impacting cursor pagination on the API Platform and our engineering team is actively working on a fix. As a temporary mitigation, please pause any automated jobs consuming the affected endpoint to avoid duplicate processing, and we'll notify you the moment cursors are resolving correctly. We'll keep this incident channel updated every 30 minutes until resolved.

subject: Upload issues
body:
We've been using Northwind Storage for about six months now to back up client transaction records as part of our fintech compliance requirements, and generally the retention policies have worked fine for our 18-seat workspace. Recently we noticed our nightly backup job logs showing completed status, but when we go to verify the files in the storage console, several folders from the last three days are empty.

The actual problem is that uploads larger than roughly 200MB seem to be silently failing without any error surfaced in the job log, and we're worried we're losing backup coverage. Can someone check quota limits on our account, since we're not seeing any quota warning either?
answer: Thanks for flagging this, and I understand the concern given your compliance requirements. Silent failures on large uploads without a quota warning suggest the job may be timing out rather than hitting a hard limit, so I'm escalating this to our storage team to review the upload logs for your workspace and confirm whether quota or timeout thresholds are being hit. In the meantime, could you send us the job IDs for the last three nights so we can trace exactly where the uploads are dropping?

subject: Jira integration broken - issues not syncing after Okta migration
body: Since our Okta migration completed on the 14th, the Jira integration link for our Enterprise workspace has stopped creating linked issues entirely. When a ticket is escalated on our side, the integration log shows a 403 response referencing an invalid service account token, even though the Okta service account was recreated with the same permissions. This is affecting escalation workflows for our entire support engineering team across 3975 seats.
answer: This is a significant issue and we're treating it as high priority given the scale of impact. The 403 on the service account token is consistent with the Jira integration credentials not being re-linked after the Okta identity migration, so our integrations team is regenerating the token pairing now and will need you to re-authorize the connection once we confirm it's ready. We'll follow up within the hour with steps to re-establish the link.

subject: Users getting logged out every few minutes after SSO login
body:
Our legal team started reporting session timeouts almost immediately after we rolled out SSO last week. Users authenticate via SSO successfully but get kicked back to the login screen within 3-5 minutes. Here's what our logs show:

2024-03-11T09:14:22Z session_id=8f3a token_refresh_failed reason="invalid_grant"
2024-03-11T09:14:23Z redirect_to=/login
2024-03-11T09:17:05Z session_id=b1c9 token_refresh_failed reason="invalid_grant"
2024-03-11T09:17:06Z redirect_to=/login

This is disrupting work for all 22 seats and MFA re-prompts are happening constantly too. Can someone look into why token refresh is failing so quickly?
answer: Thank you for including the logs, that's very helpful. The repeated 'invalid_grant' on token refresh points to a mismatch between your SSO session lifetime configuration and our token expiry settings, which would explain both the rapid logouts and the repeated MFA prompts. I'm escalating this now to our identity team to review your SSO app configuration and adjust the refresh token TTL; we'll update you within a few hours given this is affecting your whole team.

subject: Push notifications not arriving on Android for field staff
body: Our operations team has noticed that push notifications for shift updates aren't reaching several Android devices used by field staff, though iOS devices seem fine. This has been happening intermittently over the past couple of weeks. Notifications show as sent in the admin dashboard, but the devices don't receive them until the app is reopened manually.
answer: Thanks for the report. This pattern, where notifications show as sent but only appear after the app is reopened, is often related to how Android battery optimization or background restrictions handle push delivery on certain device manufacturers. Could you let us know which Android OS versions and device models are most affected? That will help us narrow down whether this is a delivery issue on our end or a device-level setting we can guide your field staff to adjust.

subject: Need SAML SSO configured with automatic role provisioning
body: We're rolling out Northwind across our manufacturing sites and want to move from manual account creation to SAML-based SSO with automatic role provisioning tied to our identity provider groups. We have 195 seats to migrate and need users assigned to the correct permission tiers automatically based on group membership at login, plus MFA enforcement for admin roles specifically. Can you walk us through the setup process and any limitations on group-to-role mapping?
answer: This is a great use case for our SAML SSO with attribute-based provisioning. We support mapping identity provider group claims directly to Northwind permission tiers, and MFA can be scoped specifically to admin-level roles as you described. I'll send over our SAML configuration guide along with a sample group mapping template, and we can schedule a call with our identity specialist to walk through the setup for your 195-seat rollout.

subject: Scheduled syncs stopped running since this morning
body: Our scheduled data pipeline syncs, which normally run every hour, haven't executed since 6am today. The dashboard shows the last successful run at 05:58 and every attempt since then is stuck in 'queued' status with no error message. This is affecting inventory reconciliation across our retail locations and we have 86 seats relying on this data being current.
answer: Thank you for reporting this promptly. Syncs stuck in 'queued' with no error usually indicates a scheduler backlog or a stalled worker on our end rather than an issue with your pipeline configuration. I'm escalating this to our pipelines on-call team right now to investigate why jobs aren't progressing past queued status, and we'll update you as soon as we have a root cause, given the impact on your inventory reconciliation.

subject: restore help
body: Need to restore a folder from backup, how far back can we go?
answer: For your current retention configuration, backups are available for restore going back 30 days. Let me know which folder and approximate date you'd like restored, and I can walk you through the restore steps or trigger it on our end.

subject: Biometric login intermittently fails then crashes app on iOS
body: We've had several reports from our media team that Face ID login on the mobile app works most of the time, but occasionally fails with a generic 'authentication error' message, and then the app crashes entirely when the user retries. This seems to happen more often when the device has been offline briefly before reopening the app. We have 243 seats using the mobile app and would like this addressed since it's disrupting login for field reporters working in low-connectivity areas.
answer: Thank you for the detailed report, this is helpful. The correlation with brief offline periods suggests the app may be failing to validate a cached biometric token against the server and mishandling that fallback, which leads to the crash on retry. We're prioritizing this for investigation given the impact on your field reporters, and we'll want to get crash logs from a couple of affected devices if you're able to share them, which will help us pinpoint the exact failure path.

subject: Request to adjust scheduled sync frequency and connector timeout
body: We run a nightly sync from our ERP connector into Data Pipelines at 2:00 AM, and lately the job takes almost 90 minutes when it used to finish in 25. We'd like to change the schedule to run twice daily (2 AM and 2 PM) and increase the connector timeout so it doesn't get cut off mid-run. Job ID is dp-sync-8842 if that helps. Also the docs on connector timeout settings don't match what we see in the UI anymore, would be great to get that updated.
answer: Thanks for flagging this, and for the job ID. The slowdown on dp-sync-8842 lines up with a schema change on the source connector we're aware of - we're working on an optimization to bring that back down. In the meantime I can help you set up the twice-daily schedule and raise the connector timeout ceiling for your workspace; I'll follow up shortly with the new limits and flag the doc mismatch to our content team.

subject: Shared dashboards broken for viewer role users - urgent
body: Since this morning several of our plant managers with viewer-only permissions are getting a blank chart area with 'You do not have access to this data source' when opening dashboards that were shared with them last week. This is affecting our production reporting for at least 30 users across three sites. Nothing changed on our end with sharing settings that we're aware of. Dashboard IDs include db-3391 and db-3402.
answer: This is impacting a lot of your team so I'm treating it as high priority. We found an issue where a recent permissions sync incorrectly revoked data source access for viewer-role shares created before last week - dashboards db-3391 and db-3402 match that pattern. We're pushing a fix to restore the correct permissions now and will confirm once it's verified on your workspace, likely within the next couple of hours.

subject: Question about extending backup retention period
body: We're currently on the default retention window for our Storage backups and need to keep financial records for at least 7 years per our compliance requirements. Can you tell me what retention options are available on our plan, and whether upgrading would let us set a custom retention policy instead of the current fixed window? We only have a small team here so want to understand the cost impact before committing.
answer: Good question - on the current plan, retention is fixed and doesn't support the long-term custom policy you're describing. Extending to a custom retention window, including the 7-year range you need for compliance, is available on our higher tier plans which also raise your storage quota. I'll send over the specific pricing difference for your seat count so you can evaluate the upgrade before deciding.

subject: Refund not applied to invoice - credits missing
body: We were promised a $1,200 service credit back in early October for the API outage that month, and it still hasn't shown up on any invoice since. Our latest invoice (INV-88213) charged us the full amount again with no adjustment. This has now come up in two internal budget reviews and we need it resolved before our finance team closes this quarter's books on the 30th.
answer: I'm sorry for the delay here - this should have been applied well before now. I've escalated this to our billing team with reference to INV-88213 and the October credit commitment, and I'm requesting it be processed as a priority given your quarter-end deadline. I'll follow up with confirmation once the credit is issued and will make sure it's reflected before the 30th.

subject: How to request credit for duplicate seat charge
body: When we upgraded a few users to admin roles last month, it looks like billing double-counted them and charged us for both the old and new seat assignments. We noticed the discrepancy on our latest statement showing more active seats than we actually have. Could you walk me through how to request a credit for the overcharge, and confirm the correct seat count going forward?
answer: Thanks for catching this - that does sound like a seat duplication bug we've seen occur during role upgrades. I can start a credit request on your behalf for the overcharged period once we confirm the correct seat count against your workspace roster; could you send over the list of affected user emails or roles so we can verify? Once confirmed, the credit typically posts within one billing cycle.

subject: Users unexpectedly logged out mid-session across SSO
body: Starting about an hour ago, our staff logging in through SSO are being signed out mid-session, sometimes within 10-15 minutes of logging in, across multiple store locations. This is disrupting checkout and inventory systems tied to Identity and SSO login. We haven't changed any session timeout settings on our identity provider side recently. This needs urgent attention as it's affecting all 250 seats.
answer: We're treating this as an active incident given the scope across your workspace. Our team is investigating a session token issue that may be related to a recent SSO configuration rollout on our end - we're checking whether that's the cause of the early expirations you're seeing. I'll update you within the hour with findings, and please let us know if the impact widens in the meantime.

subject: Duplicate email digests sending every 5 minutes
body: Since around 9 AM today, our team members are receiving the same weekly email digest from Notifications repeatedly, sometimes 5 or 6 copies within a short window. This has already triggered complaints from users across multiple factory floor teams who rely on these digests for shift alerts. It seems tied to a specific digest template ID (notif-tmpl-2217) but we can't confirm. Please escalate, this is generating a lot of noise for our teams.
answer: Thanks for the template ID, that's helpful for isolating this quickly. We've identified a retry loop bug affecting digest template notif-tmpl-2217 that's causing repeated sends instead of a single delivery, and we're deploying a fix now to stop the duplicate triggers. We'll also purge the queued duplicates so no further copies go out, and I'll confirm once it's resolved on our end.

subject: Storage quota exceeded, uploads failing in production
body: Our integration has been writing backup files to Storage via the API, and as of this morning every upload call returns a 507 Insufficient Storage error. We're on a small plan and didn't expect to hit quota this fast - looks like retention settings kept old backup versions we intended to be pruned automatically. This is blocking our nightly backup job entirely and we need a fix or a temporary quota bump today.
answer: Understood, we'll treat this as urgent since your backup job is currently blocked. Looking at your account, the retention policy wasn't pruning older versions as expected, which caused the quota to fill up - we're correcting that configuration now. In the meantime I'm applying a temporary quota increase so your uploads can resume immediately, and I'll send documentation on setting retention limits explicitly so this doesn't recur.

subject: PDF export cuts off chart legends
body: When exporting our monthly dashboard to PDF, the legends on our bar and line charts get cut off at the right edge of the page, even though they display fine in the browser view. This happens consistently across a few dashboards we use for board reporting, for example db-5510. It's not blocking us since we can still screenshot, but it would be great if this got fixed or if there's a workaround for wider legend rendering in exports.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report and the dashboard ID. This looks like a known rendering issue where legend width isn't scaling correctly for the PDF export layout on wider charts. There's no perfect workaround right now, but shrinking the chart width slightly before exporting sometimes prevents the cutoff. I've logged this against db-5510's export behavior for our product team to prioritize a proper fix.

subject: Pagination returning inconsistent page counts on API Platform
body: We're paginating through the /transactions endpoint using the cursor-based pagination as documented, but every third or fourth request seems to skip a page - we're missing records between cursor tokens that should be sequential. This isn't blocking us since we built in a reconciliation check, but it's causing extra load on our side and doesn't match what the docs describe about cursor stability. Could someone confirm expected behavior here?
answer: Thanks for the detailed description - cursor stability across paginated requests should be guaranteed as documented, so this does sound like unexpected behavior worth investigating. Could you share a couple of example cursor tokens and timestamps where you saw the skip occur? That'll help us trace whether this is a caching issue on our end or something specific to how the /transactions endpoint is generating cursors for your account.

subject: SSO role mapping not assigning correct permissions after login
body: Since this morning our finance team members logging in via SSO are being mapped to the default Viewer role instead of the Finance role we configured in the group-to-role mapping. I checked our IdP group attribute and it's still sending 'Finance-Team' exactly as before, but Northwind Identity is not honoring it. This is blocking 5 of our 13 users from approving invoices today.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report, and I'm sorry for the disruption to your finance team. This looks like a regression in role mapping evaluation, so I've opened this as a P1 incident and escalated it to our identity engineering team right now. Can you send me the exact SSO group attribute name and one affected user's login timestamp so we can trace it in the provisioning logs while the fix is investigated?

subject: Question about pagination on /v2/transactions endpoint
body: We're pulling transaction data nightly through the API and noticed the 'next_cursor' field sometimes repeats the same value across two consecutive pages, causing us to fetch duplicate rows. This isn't breaking anything critical since we dedupe on our end, but I wanted to check if this is expected behavior or something you're planning to fix in an upcoming version.
answer: Thanks for flagging this and for the workaround you've already got in place. The repeated cursor can happen when results at the page boundary share the same sort key, which is a known edge case rather than a bug, but we're evaluating a stricter cursor format in a future API revision. I'll note your account for updates when that ships, and in the meantime your dedup approach is the recommended workaround.

subject: Customers receiving duplicate booking confirmation emails
body: We integrated the Notifications API for booking confirmations and starting last night some customers are getting the same email twice within seconds, sometimes three times. Our logs show we only call the /v1/notifications/send endpoint once per booking with a unique idempotency key, so this looks like it's happening on your side. We've had over 300 duplicate sends since midnight and support tickets from angry customers are piling up.
answer: This is a serious issue and I understand the urgency given the volume of affected customers, so I'm escalating this immediately as P1. Our initial check shows a delivery retry mechanism may be firing even when the idempotency key already matched a sent record, which would explain the pattern you're seeing. Please send us three sample idempotency keys with timestamps from the duplicated sends so our engineering team can trace the exact retry path while we work on a fix.

subject: Dashboard charts showing blank after latest update
body: As of this morning all bar and line charts on our compliance dashboard are rendering completely blank, just white space where the visuals used to be. Tables and KPI cards on the same dashboard still load fine with correct data. This is affecting all 4 of our users and we need these charts for a compliance review meeting later today.
answer: I'm sorry for the timing on this given your compliance review. I've raised this as a P1 incident and our dashboard team is already checking whether this is related to a rendering update pushed overnight. While we investigate, could you tell us which browser and version you're using, and whether refreshing or clearing cache changes anything? We'll keep you updated as soon as we have a root cause.

subject: Dashboards taking over a minute to load, some timing out
body: Our main sales dashboard, which normally loads in a few seconds, has been taking 60 to 90 seconds to render since yesterday afternoon, and two of our analysts have had it time out completely with a 'request took too long' message. We have 22 users relying on this for daily reporting and the slowdown is affecting the whole team, not just one dashboard.
answer: Thanks for the clear details, this sounds like a widespread performance issue so I've marked it P1 and it's with our infrastructure team now. Can you confirm the name or ID of the dashboard that's timing out and roughly what time of day you see the worst slowdowns? That will help us correlate it with load patterns while we dig into the cause.

subject: Feature request: pre-aggregation option for large dashboards
body: Our legal team dashboards pull from datasets with millions of rows and load times have crept up over the past few months as our data grew, currently averaging 15-20 seconds per chart. It's not broken, just slow, and I'd like to know if there's a way to enable pre-aggregation or caching at the dataset level to speed this up, since we have 257 seats relying on these dashboards daily.
answer: Thanks for reaching out and for the context on your dataset size. We don't currently have a self-serve pre-aggregation toggle, but our product team is aware that large-dataset performance is a common ask and it's being evaluated for a future release. I'll log this as a feature request tied to your account, and in the meantime I can share some indexing and query-scoping tips that have helped other customers with similarly large datasets if that would help.

subject: Requesting offline mode support for mobile app
body: Our field staff often work in areas with poor or no connectivity, and currently the mobile app crashes or gets stuck on a blank login screen when there's no network available at launch. We'd like to request proper offline mode support so cached data can still be viewed, and at minimum a graceful error instead of a crash when there's no signal. This is a priority for us since it affects daily fieldwork for our team.
answer: Thank you for the detailed request and for describing the impact on your field team. The crash on launch without network is not expected behavior even without full offline support, so I'm flagging that part as a bug for our mobile team to investigate as P1. I'll also log the broader offline mode capability as a feature request tied to your account and update you once we have a timeline on either front.

subject: Need to generate a scoped API key with limited permissions
body: We're building an integration that only needs read access to the /v1/inventory endpoints, but when I generate a new API key in the console it defaults to full account access with no option to scope it down. Is there a way to create a read-only or endpoint-restricted key, either through the dashboard or via an API call? Our current rate limit is 600 requests per minute which is fine, we just need tighter scoping for security reasons.
answer: Good question, and this is a reasonable security requirement. Scoped API keys with endpoint-level restrictions aren't available in the console yet, but we do support creating restricted keys via our internal provisioning API on request. I'll open this as a feature request for self-serve scoping in the dashboard, and separately I can set up a read-only key for your /v1/inventory use case manually if you send me the specific endpoints you need.

subject: Push notifications not arriving on Android after offline period
body: We've noticed that when an Android device goes offline for more than roughly 30 minutes and then reconnects, push notifications that were sent during that window never arrive, even though the app shows as logged in and connected afterward. iOS devices seem to receive queued notifications fine in the same scenario. Can you confirm if this is expected on Android or if there's a setting we're missing?
answer: Thanks for the clear comparison between platforms, that's helpful. This does sound like an Android-specific gap in queued push delivery rather than expected behavior, so I'm logging it as a P2 issue for our mobile team to reproduce. Could you share the Android OS version and app build number you tested with, and roughly how many notifications you've seen dropped, so we can narrow down the reproduction steps?

subject: URGENT USER DEACTIVATION NOT WORKING VIA ADMIN API
body: WE ARE CALLING DELETE /V1/ADMIN/USERS/{ID}/DEACTIVATE FOR OFFBOARDED EMPLOYEES AND GETTING A 200 RESPONSE BUT THE USERS STILL SHOW AS ACTIVE IN THE ADMIN CONSOLE AND CAN STILL LOG IN. WE HAVE 14 USERS FROM YESTERDAY'S OFFBOARDING BATCH THAT ARE STILL ABLE TO ACCESS THE SYSTEM. THIS IS A MAJOR SECURITY AND COMPLIANCE ISSUE FOR US GIVEN OUR AUDIT REQUIREMENTS AND SEAT COUNT. PLEASE ESCALATE IMMEDIATELY.

THIS DISCREPANCY BETWEEN THE API RESPONSE AND ACTUAL ACCOUNT STATUS IS SERIOUS AND OUR SECURITY TEAM IS INVESTIGATING THE DEACTIVATION PIPELINE NOW. PLEASE SEND THE LIST OF THE 14 USER IDS FROM YESTERDAY'S BATCH SO WE CAN MANUALLY VERIFY AND FORCE-DEACTIVATE THEM ON OUR END WHILE WE IDENTIFY THE ROOT CAUSE.

subject: Feature request: Slack alerts for integration events (Okta/Salesforce/Jira)
body: I'm integrating the Northwind API for Harbor Capital and we route Okta login failures, Salesforce sync errors, and Jira ticket creation through your Integrations product. Right now the only notification channel is a daily email digest, which delayed our team by about 15 minutes during an Okta lockout incident last Tuesday. Can we get real-time Slack webhook support for these event types? With only 7 seats we need every alert to land immediately, not batched.
answer: Thanks for flagging this - real-time delivery matters a lot when you're this lean on seats. Slack alerting for Integrations events isn't GA yet, but we do have a webhook endpoint you can point at Slack's incoming webhook URL as a workaround; I'll send setup steps shortly. I'm also logging this as a feature request with our product team given the P1 impact on your incident response.

subject: Retention policy not purging backups past 90-day window
body: During a compliance audit at Atlas Legal we noticed that snapshots dated back to January 2024 are still present in our storage bucket, even though our retention policy is set to 90 days. Documentation states this should be enforced automatically on backup snapshots, but we're seeing files well outside that window. Given we're in fintech and under audit review this week, we need confirmation on whether the retention job is actually running.
answer: This is a serious finding for a compliance-driven account, so I've escalated it to our security and compliance engineering team for immediate review of the retention job logs on your account. We'll check whether the purge job silently failed or if there's a policy misconfiguration, and I'll update you within a few hours with findings and remediation steps.

subject: Old backup files not deleted despite 180-day retention policy
body: I administer storage for Apex Retail and configured a 180-day retention policy on our backup bucket 'apex-prod-backups'. When reviewing storage usage this morning I found objects dated as far back as last March that should have been purged months ago. The documentation mentions legal holds can override retention but we don't have any holds active that I'm aware of. Can someone check why the purge job isn't clearing these?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. I'll have our storage team pull the retention job history for 'apex-prod-backups' and check for any lingering legal hold flags that might be blocking deletion. We'll confirm whether this is a configuration issue on our end or something tied to your account settings and follow up with next steps.

subject: Salesforce sync broken since Oct 12 - blocking lead sync
body: We're integrating Northwind's Salesforce connector for Summit Analytics and new leads have stopped syncing into Salesforce since October 12. Every sync attempt throws SALESFORCE_SYNC_TIMEOUT in the integration log, and a Jira ticket gets auto-created but our Slack channel never gets notified. We have a renewal demo scheduled for this Friday and need contact data current in Salesforce before then.
answer: I understand the time pressure with your renewal demo coming up. I've pulled the sync logs and can see the repeated SALESFORCE_SYNC_TIMEOUT errors starting October 12 - this looks like an authentication token expiry on the Salesforce side. I'm escalating to our integrations engineers now to get sync restored today and will confirm once leads are flowing again.

body:
App keeps crashing when a push notification comes in while the phone is offline, and after the crash users can't log back in without reinstalling. This is happening across our team since yesterday.

FATAL EXCEPTION: main

java.lang.NullPointerException: Attempt to invoke virtual method on a null object reference
  at com.northwind.mobile.push.NotificationHandler.onReceive(NotificationHandler.java:142)

subject: SAML login failing for subset of users after MFA rollout
body: Since enabling MFA enforcement last week, a portion of our Vertex Labs users are unable to complete SAML login - they get bounced back to the IdP with an 'AuthnRequest signature validation failed' error. It's not everyone, roughly 6 out of 25 seats affected so far, and it started right after the MFA policy change went live on the 14th. I've opened escalation ticket VXL-2291 internally and need this looked at soon since it's blocking access for finance and compliance staff.
answer: Thanks for the detail, especially the timing tied to the MFA rollout. Signature validation failures like this usually point to a certificate mismatch triggered when the SAML config was touched during the MFA change - I'm pulling your SSO configuration history now to confirm. I'll loop in our identity team given the compliance-related users affected and update escalation VXL-2291 directly.

subject: Mobile app crashing on launch for all iOS users
body: Since updating to app version 4.3.2, the Northwind mobile app crashes immediately on launch for every iOS device on our team - it never gets past the splash screen.
