subject: Okta app setup help
body: Need SSO via Okta set up, where do I start?
answer: Happy to help get SSO configured. You'll want to start in Admin Settings > Integrations > Okta, where you can add the Northwind SAML app using the metadata we provide there. I'll also send over our step-by-step Okta setup guide so you have the full walkthrough, including how to map user roles during provisioning.

subject: Webhook delivery lag and deprecation notice conflict
body: I'm integrating the API Platform webhooks for our retail order pipeline at Atlas Robotics. Since around Sept 12 we're seeing delivery delays of 4-8 minutes on the order.updated event, versus the usual sub-10-second delivery. We also got a deprecation notice for the v1 webhook signature header (X-Northwind-Signature) but no clear migration timeline. Can you confirm if the v1 to v2 header change is related to the delay, and if there's a rate limit change coming that we should plan for?
answer: Thanks for flagging this - we can see elevated queue times on the webhook dispatcher for your account starting Sept 12, and we're investigating a backlog issue on one of our delivery workers, unrelated to the v1/v2 signature header deprecation. The header migration has its own 90-day window and won't affect delivery timing. I'll update this ticket once the backlog is cleared, and will follow up separately with the v2 migration guide and any rate limit changes planned for your tier.

subject: Slack alerts not firing after Okta SSO change
body: We use the Integrations module to push pipeline failure alerts from our data warehouse job into a Slack channel, and also have Salesforce and Jira connected for ticket sync. After our Okta admin updated our SSO group mappings last week, the Slack alert integration stopped posting - no errors shown in the integration log, it just silently stops. Jira and Salesforce syncs still work fine. Can someone check if the Okta change broke the Slack connector's auth token?
answer: Thank you for the detailed report. It sounds like the Slack connector's OAuth token may have been invalidated when the Okta group mapping changed, since Slack often relies on a service account scoped to specific groups. I'm escalating this to our integrations team to check the token status and connector logs on our side, and I'll confirm within the next business day whether a reauthorization of the Slack connector is needed.

subject: Mobile app crashes immediately on launch after update
body: Since updating to the latest Mobile App version yesterday, the app crashes within a second of opening on two of our support engineers' Android devices (Pixel 7 and Pixel 6a). It never reaches the login screen. Push notifications still seem to arrive even though the app won't open. We haven't seen this on iOS devices here at Orion Academy. Can you confirm if this is a known issue with the recent release?
answer: Sorry for the trouble this is causing your team. We have had a few similar reports tied to the latest Android release and our mobile team is actively investigating a crash-on-launch issue linked to a caching bug introduced in that build. In the meantime, could you have the affected users clear the app cache or reinstall the app, and let us know if the crash persists so we can gather crash logs directly from those devices?

subject: Request to change Slack alert routing rules
body: We'd like to change how our Slack alerts are routed through the Integrations module. Currently all Salesforce case updates and Jira ticket changes post into one shared #support-alerts channel, but we want Salesforce alerts routed to #sales-ops and Jira bug tickets routed to a separate #bugs channel instead. We tried editing the routing rules ourselves but the Jira filter keeps reverting to 'all issue types' even after saving specific bug-only filters.
answer: Thanks for the clear breakdown of what you need. The revert-to-default behavior on the Jira filter is a known bug in the routing rule editor when multiple conditions are saved at once - I've logged this for our integrations team. In the meantime, I can make the channel split changes for you manually if you send over the exact Salesforce and Jira filter criteria you'd like applied, and I'll confirm once it's live.

subject: Getting duplicate email alerts for the same billing event
body: Our finance team at Pioneer Works has been receiving duplicate notification emails for invoice payment confirmations - each one arrives twice, about 30 seconds apart, with identical invoice IDs (e.g. INV-88421 came in twice on Oct 3). This has been happening for about a week and is causing confusion in our reconciliation process. Is there a setting or a bug causing the Notifications service to double-send?
answer: Thank you for reporting this with the specific invoice ID, that helps a lot. We've seen a similar pattern where a retry mechanism in the notification queue re-sends an event if the acknowledgment is delayed slightly, resulting in duplicates rather than a true resend. I'm passing this to our platform team to check the queue logs around Oct 3 for your account, and will follow up once we've confirmed the cause and a fix timeline.

subject: How to handle SDK rate limit errors gracefully
body: We're using the Python SDK for the API Platform in our operations dashboard and started getting 429 errors labeled 'rate_limit_exceeded' during batch inventory syncs. The SDK doesn't seem to auto-retry with backoff by default. Is there a recommended pattern or config flag we should be using, and are these limits expected to change soon given the deprecation notices in the changelog for the older polling endpoints?
answer: Good question, and thanks for including the SDK details. The current Python SDK does support automatic retry with exponential backoff, but it needs to be enabled explicitly via the retry_config parameter when initializing the client - I'll send you a short code snippet showing the recommended settings for batch operations. Regarding rate limits, the polling endpoint deprecation won't change your current limits, but we do recommend migrating to webhooks for inventory updates going forward, and I can point you to that guide as well.

subject: URGENT - all Notification alerts routing to wrong team
body: Since this morning our alert routing for the Notifications module has been sending all critical system alerts to our general IT inbox instead of the on-call rotation email group we configured. We rely on this for our warehouse system uptime alerts and missed two incidents overnight because of it. Nothing changed on our end that we're aware of - can someone check the routing configuration for Harbor Foods urgently?
answer: I'm sorry for the impact this had overnight, we're treating this as a priority issue. I've pulled up your routing configuration and can see the on-call group mapping was reset during a backend update to our alerting service last night - our team is restoring the correct routing rules now and I'll confirm within the hour once it's verified live. We'll also follow up with root cause details once this is resolved.

subject: CRITICAL: Webhook events missing, possible data loss on order pipeline
body: We are seeing a major gap in webhook deliveries on the API Platform starting at approximately 02:15 UTC today. Our order.created and payment.completed events for the past 6 hours appear to be missing entirely, not just delayed - our downstream fulfillment system shows zero events received in that window while our internal order counts show over 3,000 orders placed at Ember Foods during that time. This is affecting our entire production order pipeline and we need immediate confirmation on whether these events can be recovered or replayed.
answer: This has been escalated immediately to our on-call engineering and security teams given the potential data loss - we are treating this as a P0 incident. We are checking our webhook dispatch logs now to determine whether events were queued but not delivered versus dropped entirely, which will determine if a replay is possible for the 02:15 UTC to present window. We will provide an update within 30 minutes with findings and next steps; please keep this ticket open for direct incident updates.

subject: Question on restoring data from Storage backup
body: I'm working on integrating our backup verification tooling with the Storage product's backup API and need to understand the restore process better before we build automated testing around it. Specifically, what's the retention window for daily snapshots, and can a restore be scoped to a specific bucket rather than the entire account? We're at Granite Works and want to document this properly for our internal runbook before our next audit.
answer: Happy to help clarify this for your runbook. Daily snapshots are retained for 30 days by default on the Pro tier, and yes, restores can be scoped to an individual bucket using the restore API's target_scope parameter rather than requiring a full account restore. I'll send over our detailed backup and restore documentation link, and if you'd like, we can also set up a call to walk through a test restore before your audit.

subject: Slack integration alerts stopped after Okta token expiry
body: Our Slack alert integration, which we use to notify finance on Salesforce deal-closed events, stopped posting messages as of this morning. I noticed our Okta admin console showed a token expiry warning for one of the connected apps yesterday. We also use Jira integration for expense approval tickets which still seems to be working fine. Given we have thousands of users across Delta Systems relying on these finance alerts, could you help us understand what's expected here and how to reconnect?
answer: Thank you for the context, and I understand the urgency given the number of users depending on these alerts. It does sound like the Slack connector's OAuth token expired, likely tied to the Okta warning you saw, while Jira uses a separate token that wasn't affected. I'll walk you through reauthorizing the Slack connector from the Integrations settings page, and can also set up a reminder alert before future token expirations so this doesn't recur.

subject: Restore from backup stuck at 62% - quota errors in logs
body:
We're restoring our storage bucket 'vertex-docs-prod' from the backup taken on March 3rd after an accidental bulk delete. The restore job (ID rst-88213) has been stuck at 62% for the last 40 minutes and the job log shows repeated 'QUOTA_EXCEEDED: upload target' errors. We have 241 seats on this workspace and about 30 agents can't access historical booking documents right now.

Can someone check if our storage quota needs a temporary bump to complete this restore? We'd rather not open a support call with customers waiting on file access.
answer: Thanks for flagging this - I can see restore job rst-88213 on your account and confirm it's hitting the quota ceiling on the target bucket, which is why it's stalled at 62%. I'm applying a temporary quota increase now so the remaining objects can write through; the job should resume automatically within a few minutes without needing to be restarted. I'll monitor it and update you once it reaches 100%, and we'll revert the quota back to your standard Pro limit afterward.

subject: Slack alert integration sending duplicate notifications for every event
body:
I'm setting up the Slack alerts integration to notify our #ops channel when API rate limits are approaching. Since enabling it yesterday around 2pm, every alert is being posted 3-4 times in a row within the same minute. I checked our webhook config and we only have one Slack integration connected under our workspace.

This is flooding our channel and making it impossible to tell which alert is current. We have 18 seats on Starter and this is blocking our team from trusting the alerting at all. Can you check if this is a known bug with the Slack connector?
answer: Sorry for the disruption this is causing - this matches an issue we're currently tracking where the Slack connector re-fires queued alerts on retry even after successful delivery, causing the duplicates you're seeing. I'm escalating this as a bug ticket to our integrations team right now given the impact on your alerting reliability. As a workaround, you can disable retry-on-timeout in the Slack integration settings under Notifications > Channels, which should stop the duplicate posts while we ship a fix.

subject: okta thing not working
body:
so we've been trying to get sso set up for a few weeks now, our it lead configured the okta app a while back and it worked fine for testing. we use it for about 22 people on the starter plan and everyone was fine loging in last week.

anyway today nobody can login through okta anymore, it just redirects back to the okta dashbord with no error mesage. i checked the app config in okta and nothing changed on our side. this startet happening this morning around 9am. can u check if somethng changed on northwind side with the okta integration?
answer: Thanks for the details - we did push an update to the Okta SAML integration overnight, and I suspect this is related to the silent redirect you're seeing. Can you confirm the exact error in your browser console when the redirect happens, and the app name shown in your Okta admin panel? I'm escalating this to our integrations team now since it's blocking all SSO logins for your organization, and will follow up shortly with next steps.

subject: Deprecated API key format - need migration guidance before webhook cutover
body:
We received a notice that legacy API keys (the ones prefixed nw_live_) will be deprecated on May 15th, and we're currently using this format for both our billing webhook receiver and our rate-limited reporting endpoint. As product manager, I need to understand the migration path before we roll out new keys to 186 seats worth of integrations.

Specifically: will existing webhook signatures still validate during the transition, and is there a grace period where both key formats work simultaneously? We can't afford a gap where webhooks silently fail.
answer: Good question, and this is time-sensitive given your webhook dependency. Both legacy and new-format keys will validate signatures identically during a 30-day overlap window starting from your first new key generation, so you can roll out incrementally without downtime. I'd recommend generating your new keys this week, updating the webhook receiver first since that's your highest-risk path, and testing signature validation in a staging environment before touching production - I can walk you through the rotation steps on a call if that's helpful.

subject: Intermittent upload failures on large media files - requesting retention policy review
body:
We're seeing intermittent upload failures for files over 2GB on our media storage buckets, roughly 15-20 failures per day out of several thousand uploads. Error returned is 'UPLOAD_TIMEOUT: connection reset' and retries usually succeed on the second or third attempt, which is workable but not sustainable at our volume of 2202 seats across multiple studios.

Separately, we'd like to request a review of our retention settings - we're currently auto-deleting raw footage after 90 days but need an exception for our archive tier project. Could someone from storage engineering look at both the timeout pattern and help us set up a custom retention rule?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report - the timeout pattern on large files points to connection handling on our upload proxy for objects over 2GB, and I'm looping in storage engineering to investigate the reset errors specifically, since 15-20 daily failures at your volume warrants a closer look. For the retention exception, I can set up a custom rule to exempt your archive tier project from the 90-day policy - can you send me the bucket path or project ID you'd like excluded so I can configure it today?

subject: STILL waiting on email digest fix - this is unacceptable
body:
This is the third time I'm writing about this. Our daily finance email digests have been arriving with completely wrong totals for TWO WEEKS now - numbers that don't match our dashboard at all. I reported this on the 4th and again on the 9th and got no real answer either time.

We have 2107 seats relying on these digests for daily reconciliation and my team is now manually pulling numbers instead of trusting the emails, which defeats the entire point of paying for this feature. I need someone to actually fix this or give me a real timeline, not another canned response. We are seriously considering canceling if this isn't resolved this week.
answer: I understand the frustration, and I'm sorry this has dragged on without a clear resolution - that's not the experience you should be having, especially with two weeks of unreliable numbers affecting daily reconciliation. I'm escalating this immediately to a senior engineer with priority status and requesting they investigate the digest calculation discrepancy today rather than queue it normally. I will personally follow up with you within 24 hours with either a fix or a concrete timeline, and I'm also flagging your account for direct engineering contact so this doesn't sit in a queue again.

subject: How to set up Zapier integration for new customer alerts
body:
We want to connect our Northwind account to Zapier so that new customer signups trigger a notification in our internal Slack and create a follow-up task in our CRM. I found the Zapier app listing but I'm not sure which trigger events are available for our plan - the docs mention 'customer.created' but I don't see that in the Zap editor when I search.

Could you point me to the current list of supported triggers for Starter plan accounts, or let me know if this event needs to be enabled somewhere first?
answer: Happy to help get this set up. On the Starter plan, the 'customer.created' trigger is available but needs to be enabled first under Settings > Integrations > Zapier Triggers - it's off by default for new connections. Once enabled it can take a few minutes to appear in the Zap editor's trigger search; if it still doesn't show up after that, disconnect and reconnect the Zapier app to refresh the trigger list.

subject: IP allowlist blocking legitimate office access after update
body:
I updated our IP allowlist yesterday in the Admin Console to add our new branch office range (203.0.113.0/24) alongside our existing HQ range, but this morning three of our 15 users are getting 'Access Denied - IP not permitted' when trying to log in from the branch office, even though the range I added should cover their addresses.

I checked the audit log and it confirms the allowlist entry was saved at 4:12pm yesterday, but the deactivation didn't seem to trigger any errors then. Could someone verify the range is actually active and check if there's a propagation delay we should know about?
answer: Thanks for including the audit log timestamp, that helps narrow this down. I checked your allowlist configuration and the range 203.0.113.0/24 is saved correctly, but I found it was added to a secondary policy that isn't yet linked to your primary login flow - that's likely why those three users are still being blocked. I've corrected the policy linkage now; access should work immediately, but please have those users try again and let me know if the denial persists.

subject: Mobile app crashes immediately on launch after latest update
body:
Since updating to the latest version of the Northwind mobile app yesterday, it crashes within 1-2 seconds of opening on multiple company devices - we've confirmed this on 6 different iPhones across our team of 294 seats. The app shows the splash screen briefly then closes with no error message visible to the user.

Users who haven't updated yet are fine, so this seems tied to the new release. Can you confirm if this is a known issue and whether there's a rollback option while a fix is prepared? We rely on the mobile app for approval workflows and this is blocking several managers today.
answer: Thanks for confirming this across multiple devices - we've had a few other reports of crash-on-launch tied to yesterday's release, likely related to a login token caching issue in the update. I'm flagging this for our mobile team to prioritize a fix. In the meantime, affected users can uninstall and reinstall the app, which clears the cached token and has resolved the crash for others reporting the same issue - I'll update you as soon as we have a proper patch timeline.

subject: Dashboard-Export als PDF für automatisierte Berichte gewünscht
body:
Wir binden die Dashboard-API in unser internes Reporting-Tool ein und möchten Dashboards automatisiert als PDF exportieren, um sie wöchentlich per E-Mail an unsere Kunden zu verschicken. Aktuell finde ich in der API-Dokumentation nur einen Export als PNG oder CSV, aber keinen Endpunkt für PDF.

Gibt es eine geplante Funktion oder einen Workaround, um komplette Dashboards inklusive mehrerer Charts als ein PDF-Dokument zu exportieren? Das wäre für unser Team mit 6 Plätzen sehr wichtig, da wir sonst manuell Screenshots zusammenfügen müssen.
answer: Danke für die Anfrage - aktuell gibt es tatsächlich noch keinen direkten PDF-Export-Endpunkt in der Dashboard-API, das ist korrekt. Ich leite dies als Feature-Request an unser Produktteam weiter, da PDF-Export für automatisierte Reports schon mehrfach angefragt wurde. Als Workaround könnt ihr aktuell den PNG-Export pro Chart nutzen und diese über eine PDF-Bibliothek eurer Wahl zusammenführen - ich melde mich, sobald es Neuigkeiten zum nativen PDF-Export gibt.

subject: Invoice line items don't match seat count
body: I'm reconciling our last two invoices against the billing API and the seat count on the September invoice shows 24 seats, but our /account/seats endpoint returned 21 active seats for that same billing period. We're on the Starter plan and haven't changed headcount recently. Can someone confirm which number is authoritative and whether a refund adjustment applies for the difference? Invoice numbers are INV-88213 and INV-89004.
answer: Thanks for flagging the discrepancy. Invoices are generated from the seat count snapshot taken on the billing cycle date, while the /account/seats endpoint reflects real-time state, so short-lived seat changes between snapshots can cause a mismatch. I'll pull the historical snapshot for INV-88213 and INV-89004 and confirm whether a credit is owed; I'll follow up within a day with the breakdown.

subject: Connector sync delayed 6+ hours, transactions arriving late
body: Our fintech data pipeline connector pulling from our payments provider has been landing records 6-8 hours late since yesterday around 14:00 UTC. This is a P1 for us because downstream reconciliation jobs depend on same-day data and we're now missing SLA commitments to our own customers. Pipeline ID is pl-4471-north, connector is 'payments-hourly-sync'. Last successful on-time run was 2024-05-13 09:00 UTC.
answer: I've escalated this immediately given the SLA impact. We're seeing elevated queue depth on the connector cluster serving pl-4471-north and are working to clear the backlog; I'll update you within the hour with either a resolution or an ETA. In the meantime, any records already synced are complete and accurate, this is purely a latency issue, not data loss.

subject: Need clarity on retention policy before archiving old datasets
body: I'm trying to figure out how long raw upload files are retained in Storage before they're purged, since I want to archive some 2022 retail transaction datasets before they disappear. Our quota dashboard shows we're at 82% of our Starter storage quota, and I can't find documentation on default retention windows for uploaded files versus processed outputs. Can you clarify the current policy?
answer: For Starter plan accounts, raw uploaded files are retained for 90 days by default, while processed/derived outputs are kept indefinitely unless manually deleted. Given you're at 82% quota, I'd recommend exporting the 2022 datasets you want to keep long-term to your own storage, since they'll age out soon if untouched. Let me know if you'd like me to check exact expiry dates for specific files.

subject: connector auth broken
body: ERP connector shows 'auth expired' since this morning, ops team blocked.
answer: Sorry for the disruption, we're looking into this now. Could you confirm the connector name and whether re-authenticating via the connector settings page (Connectors > Manage > Reconnect) resolves it, or if the reconnect button itself fails? That will help us tell if this is a token expiry issue on our side or a credential problem on the ERP source.

subject: Seat count reconciliation and billing adjustment request
body: We currently show 208 active seats on our Pro plan workspace, but our HR offboarding records indicate 14 of those users left the company between February and April and were never deactivated in Northwind. I'd like to request a seat count audit and a credit adjustment for the overage we've been billed for those inactive accounts over the last three billing cycles. Happy to provide the offboarding dates if needed.
answer: Thank you for bringing this forward. I've opened a seat reconciliation case for your workspace and will need the list of the 14 user identifiers along with their offboarding dates to verify against our billing snapshots. Once confirmed, we'll process a credit for the overbilled cycles; given the seat volume involved, I've prioritized this for review within the next two business days.

subject: Question on SSO session timeout configuration
body: We're rolling out SSO for our 2202-seat workspace and I want to understand how session timeout duration is configured on our end versus the identity provider side. Currently sessions seem to expire after 8 hours regardless of our IdP's configured session lifetime of 12 hours. Is there a Northwind-side setting overriding this, or is this expected behavior with SAML?
answer: Good question, this is expected behavior on our end: Northwind enforces a maximum session lifetime of 8 hours at the application layer regardless of the IdP's SAML assertion lifetime, as a security default. This isn't currently user-configurable, but I'll log this as a feature request for admin-configurable session limits and pass it to the product team, since it seems like it would be valuable at your scale.

subject: Retention question after failed backup
body: We've been building out our data governance process over the past quarter, reviewing how long various datasets need to be retained for compliance in the healthcare space, and mapping that against what Northwind Storage actually supports. As part of that review I tried restoring a backup snapshot from March 2024 to verify our retention assumptions, and the restore job failed with 'snapshot not found' even though our retention policy should have kept it for 12 months on the Pro plan. Can you confirm whether that snapshot still exists?
answer: Thanks for the detailed context. Pro plan backups are indeed retained for 12 months, so a March 2024 snapshot should still be available; a 'snapshot not found' error usually means the snapshot ID referenced is stale or the backup job that created it didn't complete successfully at the time. Could you send the exact snapshot ID or backup job name you're trying to restore so we can check its status directly?

subject: Audit-Log zeigt Deaktivierungen nicht an
body: Uns ist aufgefallen, dass im Audit-Log unseres Admin Console Workspace Benutzerdeaktivierungen seit dem 10. Mai nicht mehr protokolliert werden. Wir haben letzte Woche drei Mitarbeiter deaktiviert, aber es erscheint kein entsprechender Eintrag im Log, obwohl andere Ereignisse wie Login und Einstellungsänderungen weiterhin korrekt erscheinen. Können Sie das prüfen?
answer: Vielen Dank für den Hinweis. Wir prüfen, ob es sich um ein Problem mit der Kategorisierung von Deaktivierungs-Events im Audit-Log handelt, da andere Ereignistypen offenbar unbeeinflusst sind. Können Sie uns die genauen Benutzer-IDs der drei deaktivierten Konten sowie die Zeitstempel der Deaktivierung nennen, damit wir gezielt nachvollziehen können, ob die Einträge im Backend existieren, aber nur im UI fehlen?

subject: Deprecation warning in Python SDK v3.2
body: We're helping one of our customers debug their integration and noticed the Northwind Python SDK v3.2 throws a DeprecationWarning on every call to client.webhooks.list(): 'this method will be removed in v4.0, use client.webhooks.query() instead.' We can't find migration documentation for webhooks.query() covering pagination or filter parameters. Could you point us to updated docs or a migration guide for v4.0?
answer: Good catch, the webhooks.query() migration guide isn't linked from the deprecation warning yet, which we'll fix. In the meantime, query() supports the same filter parameters as list() plus a new 'cursor' param for pagination instead of 'offset'/'limit'. I'll send over a direct link to the migration guide and sample code for cursor-based pagination shortly.

subject: MFA enrollment stuck for new team member
body: One of our new hires is trying to enroll in MFA for the first time but gets stuck after scanning the QR code, the app shows 'verification failed' every time they enter the 6-digit code from their authenticator app. We've tried on two different devices with the same result. Is there a time sync issue or something specific to how our SSO setup handles MFA enrollment?
answer: This is usually caused by clock drift on the device generating the TOTP code, since codes are time-based and only valid within a narrow window. Could you have the new hire check that their phone's date/time is set to automatic/network time rather than manual, then try re-enrolling? If that doesn't resolve it, let us know and we'll check the enrollment logs on our side for that account.

subject: Rate limit change on API Platform breaking our media ingestion jobs
body:
We run a nightly media sync job against the API Platform and starting this week we're seeing HTTP 429 responses at a much lower threshold than before. Our SDK version is 4.2.1 and the docs still list the old limit of 600 requests/min, but we're getting throttled around 120 requests/min since Tuesday.

Can you confirm if the rate limits were changed or deprecated for Starter plans, and point us to updated documentation? We need to adjust our batching logic before our next content push on Friday.
answer: Thanks for flagging this - you're right that we rolled out an updated rate limit tier for Starter plans last week as part of a deprecation of the legacy limits, and the public docs hadn't been updated yet. I'm attaching the corrected limits table now and will get the docs page fixed today. In the meantime, our SDK 4.3.0 includes automatic backoff handling that should help smooth out the 429s until you can adjust your batching logic.

subject: Duplicate email alerts on escalation notifications
body:
We've noticed that when an alert escalates from warning to critical, our team gets two nearly identical emails within a minute of each other - one for the original alert and one for the escalation, but both reference the same incident ID. This has happened on at least four incidents over the past two weeks.

It's not urgent, but it's confusing for our on-call staff who think there are two separate issues. Is this expected behavior, or is there a setting we're missing to suppress the duplicate?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report - this is actually expected behavior right now since escalation emails are sent as a separate notification type rather than an update to the original, but I understand the confusion. I'll log this as a documentation gap and also pass it to our product team as a feature request to merge escalation emails into a single thread. In the meantime, the incident ID in the subject line can help your team recognize related alerts quickly.

subject: Restore from backup failing with quota error on manufacturing dataset
body:
I'm trying to restore a Storage backup from March 14th for our production-parts-catalog bucket, but the restore job fails after about 10 minutes with an error stating 'quota exceeded during restore operation'. Our actual storage usage is well under our allocated quota, so this seems like a bug in how the restore process calculates space.

We need this dataset back for a compliance audit by end of week. The backup ID is bkp-2984471-vp and the target bucket is parts-catalog-restore-temp.
answer: Thanks for the backup ID and details - this looks like an issue with how temporary staging space is calculated during restore for larger datasets, which can spike usage estimates well above actual quota. I'm escalating this to our storage engineering team now and will monitor the restore job manually to push it through given your audit deadline this week. I'll update you within a few hours with either a successful restore or a clear timeline.

subject: Plan upgrade via API returning payment error despite valid card
body:
We're trying to upgrade from Starter to a higher plan through the billing API endpoint /v1/billing/plan-change, and every attempt returns a 402 error with message 'payment method declined' even though our card is valid and has been used for our current subscription for months. This is blocking us from adding the extra seats we need for a new integration launching Monday.

We've tried three times today and get the same result each time. Our account ID is pf-7734-fintech if that helps.
answer: I'm sorry for the disruption this is causing right before your launch. I've pulled up account pf-7734-fintech and can see the declines are coming from our payment processor flagging the plan-change transaction type specifically, not an issue with your card itself. I'm manually processing the upgrade on our end right now and will confirm here once it's applied, likely within the next 30 minutes, so you won't need to keep retrying the API call.

subject: URGENT: SDK throwing auth failures across all webhook consumers - possible security issue
body:
Since approximately 02:15 UTC today, our production systems using the API Platform SDK (v6.1.0) are failing to validate incoming webhook signatures across all 1500+ endpoints. We're seeing errors like: 'SignatureVerificationError: HMAC mismatch, key rotation may be required' and our webhook consumers are silently dropping events as a result.

Given this is affecting signature verification at scale, we're concerned this could indicate a compromised key or an unannounced rotation on your end. We are treating this as a security incident until confirmed otherwise - all webhook processing is currently degraded across our entire platform.
answer: We're treating this as a P0 and have immediately engaged our security and platform teams. Initial investigation shows a signing key rotation was pushed at 02:00 UTC as part of a scheduled deprecation of legacy keys, but the rollout did not propagate correctly to all regions, causing the mismatch you're seeing - we have no indication of key compromise at this time. We are rolling back the rotation now and will follow up within the hour with confirmation and a full incident report.

subject: How to handle late-arriving data in pipeline windows
body:
Our data pipeline ingests transaction records from a fintech partner, and we occasionally get records that arrive 2-3 hours after their event timestamp due to their batch export schedule. Right now these late records seem to get dropped from our daily aggregation window rather than reprocessed.

Is there a way to configure a grace period or late-arrival window in Data Pipelines so these records get included in the correct daily bucket instead of being silently excluded? A pointer to relevant docs would be great.
answer: Good question - Data Pipelines does support a configurable late-arrival grace window on windowed aggregations, though it's not enabled by default for Starter plan pipelines. You can set it via the 'allowedLateness' parameter in your pipeline config, and I'd recommend starting with a 4-hour window given your partner's export schedule. I'll send over a link to the configuration guide and a sample config that matches your use case.

subject: Need help mapping SSO roles to internal permission groups
body:
We're rolling out SSO for our 115 seats and I'm trying to figure out the best way to map incoming SAML role attributes from our identity provider to our internal Northwind permission groups. Right now everyone who logs in via SSO lands in the default viewer role regardless of the role attribute we're sending.

We send a 'department' claim with values like 'editorial', 'legal', and 'ops' and want each to map to a different permission set. Is there a role mapping feature for this, or do we need to handle it entirely on our IdP side?
answer: Yes, Identity and SSO supports attribute-based role mapping - you can configure rules under Admin > SSO Settings > Role Mapping that match incoming SAML attributes like your 'department' claim to specific permission groups. It sounds like your SSO connection may currently be missing these mapping rules, which is why everyone defaults to viewer. I'll walk you through setting up the three mappings you mentioned and can hop on a call this week if that's easier.

subject: Webhook delivery delays impacting reconciliation across retail locations
body:
Our finance team relies on API Platform webhooks to trigger end-of-day reconciliation across our retail locations, and since Monday we've noticed delivery delays of 20-40 minutes on payment.completed events. With 1629 users depending on timely reconciliation data, this is causing our nightly close process to run significantly behind schedule.

We've checked our endpoint response times and they're consistently under 200ms, so the delay doesn't appear to be on our side. Can you check webhook queue processing on your end?
answer: Thank you for the clear detail on your endpoint response times - that helps rule out delivery issues on your side. We're seeing elevated queue processing times on our webhook infrastructure that's affecting a subset of enterprise accounts, and our team is actively working to clear the backlog. I've flagged your account for priority monitoring and will update you as soon as delivery times return to normal, which we expect within the next few hours.

subject: Connector authentication failing intermittently, causing sync delays
body:
Our media data connector in Data Pipelines has started failing authentication roughly every few hours since Tuesday, with the sync log showing 'token refresh failed: invalid_grant' before it eventually recovers on its own a few minutes later. Each failure causes a sync delay of about 15-20 minutes, which is throwing off our downstream reporting timing.

We haven't changed any credentials on our end. This is happening on the connector named 'media-source-primary' in our pipeline dashboard.
answer: Thanks for pinpointing the connector name and error message. The 'invalid_grant' pattern combined with intermittent recovery suggests the refresh token for media-source-primary may be hitting a race condition during concurrent sync attempts rather than an actual credential issue on your end. I'm going to reset the connector's token cache on our side and add extra logging so we can confirm the root cause if it recurs - I'll follow up once the fix is in place.

subject: Slack integration not posting alerts after Okta SSO migration
body:
We recently migrated our workspace login to Okta SSO and since then our Slack integration has stopped posting deployment alerts to our #alerts channel. The integration still shows as 'connected' in the Integrations dashboard, but no messages have come through since the migration on Tuesday.

We rely on these alerts for our small dev team to catch deploy issues quickly, and right now we have no visibility into failures. Is there a reauthorization step needed after an SSO change that we might have missed?
answer: Yes, that's likely the cause - Slack integration tokens can get invalidated when the workspace's underlying auth provider changes, since the integration was originally authorized under your previous login method. You'll need to disconnect and reauthorize the Slack integration from the Integrations dashboard now that Okta SSO is active; this should restore alert posting immediately. Let us know once you've reconnected it and we can confirm alerts are flowing again on our end.

subject: Duplicate invoice charge for October
body: I'm reviewing our billing history and noticed invoice INV-10432 for October was charged twice - once on Oct 1 and again on Oct 3, both for $149.00. We're on the Starter plan with 13 seats and this doubled charge doesn't match anything in our usage. Can someone confirm this is an error and process a refund for the duplicate?
answer: Thanks for flagging this - a duplicate charge shouldn't happen and I want to get it corrected quickly. I've pulled up account Willow Works and can confirm two identical charges posted for INV-10432; I'm escalating this to our billing team now to reverse the duplicate transaction and will update you within one business day once the refund is issued.

subject: Late-arriving retail sales data breaking daily aggregates
body: We've noticed that POS transaction data from our retail connector is arriving 4-6 hours after the expected sync window, which means our daily aggregate pipeline runs before the data lands and produces incomplete totals. This has happened on at least 5 of the last 10 days. We'd like to request either a configurable grace period on the pipeline scheduler or a late-data reconciliation option so downstream jobs don't need manual reruns.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report - that's a reasonable ask and I can see how the timing mismatch is causing incomplete aggregates. I'm logging this as a feature request for a configurable grace window on the scheduler, and in the meantime I can help set up a manual reconciliation trigger for your affected connector so you're not stuck rerunning jobs by hand. I'll follow up with our data pipelines team on timeline for the grace-period option.

subject: Incorrect seat count on invoice causing overbilling

This is on the Enterprise plan and the overcharge comes to roughly $2,800 based on our per-seat rate. We need this corrected and a refund issued for the difference, ideally before our finance team closes the month.
answer: I appreciate you catching this and the urgency around month-end close. I've checked our records and your active seat count does show 1,194, so the invoice discrepancy is on our end - I'm submitting a correction request now to adjust INV-88213 and initiate a refund for the overcharged amount. I'll confirm back to you within 24 hours with the corrected invoice and refund timeline.

subject: Options for enforcing MFA enrollment across workspace
body: We're rolling out stronger security policies and want to require MFA enrollment for all 294 users in our workspace. Right now it looks like MFA is optional per-user. Is there a way to set an org-wide policy that forces enrollment on next login, and can we exempt a small group of service accounts from this requirement?
answer: Good timing on tightening this up - we do support an org-wide MFA enforcement policy that prompts enrollment on next login, along with the ability to create exemption groups for service accounts. I'll send you a walkthrough of the admin settings under Identity and SSO where you can configure both the enforcement rule and the exemption list.

subject: Scheduled syncs failing across all pipelines since this morning
body: Starting around 8:40am today, every scheduled sync job in our account has been failing with timeout errors - we're seeing this across 6 different pipeline connectors that normally run every 15 minutes. Job IDs sync-77410 through sync-77439 all show status 'failed: exceeded max execution time'. This is blocking our production reporting and we need this looked at urgently.
answer: This is impacting your production reporting so we're treating it as top priority. I'll update you within the hour with findings and an ETA to restore normal sync operation.

subject: Mapping SSO groups to custom roles
body: We're setting up SSO for our 8-person team and want incoming groups from our identity provider to map automatically to specific roles in Northwind rather than defaulting everyone to a basic role. Is there a way to configure group-to-role mapping rules, and can we test this against a staging IdP connection before going live?
answer: Yes, group-to-role mapping is supported and you can define rules that map specific IdP group names to Northwind roles under the SSO configuration section. I'd recommend setting up a staging IdP connection first, which we can help you configure, so you can validate the mappings before switching your production login flow over.

subject: Offline mode for mobile app - data sync behavior
body: A few of our field staff use the mobile app in areas with poor connectivity and we're evaluating whether offline mode would help. Can you clarify what happens to actions taken while offline - are they queued and synced automatically once connection returns, or do users need to manually trigger a sync? Also curious if there's a limit on how long data can stay queued offline.
answer: Good questions - when offline mode is enabled, actions taken without connectivity are queued locally and sync automatically as soon as the device reconnects, no manual trigger needed. There's currently no hard time limit on queued data, though we recommend syncing within 48 hours to avoid conflicts with server-side changes. Let me know if you'd like help enabling this for your workspace.

subject: Request to add Face ID support for mobile login
body: Several of our users have asked why the mobile app only supports PIN-based login and not Face ID or fingerprint. Given we're in fintech and security expectations are high, we'd like to formally request biometric login as a feature. Would also be useful to know if this is already on a roadmap somewhere.
answer: Thanks for the feedback, this is a request we've heard from other fintech customers as well. Biometric login (Face ID and fingerprint) is currently under evaluation for the mobile app roadmap, and I'm adding your account's input to that feature request to help prioritize it. I'll reach out once we have a firmer timeline to share.

subject: Mobile app crashing immediately on launch for all users
body: As of this morning our entire team can't open the mobile app - it crashes within a second of tapping the icon, before even reaching the login screen. This is happening on both iOS and Android across all 11 of our devices. We rely on this app for warehouse check-ins and this is completely blocking that workflow right now.

In parallel I'm escalating this crash-on-launch report to our mobile engineering team to check for a recent release issue affecting all platforms.

subject: Push notifications not triggering for critical alerts

This is a healthcare workflow so missed alerts are a real concern. Can someone investigate why delivery is inconsistent and whether there's a fix or workaround?

We'll prioritize this and keep you updated as we investigate.

subject: MFA enrollment stuck at QR code step
body: I'm trying to enroll a new user in MFA under Identity and SSO, but after scanning the QR code with Google Authenticator the setup screen just spins and never confirms the pairing. I tried it on two different accounts on our Cobalt Legal tenant with the same result. Is there a known issue with TOTP enrollment right now, or do I need to whitelist something on our end?
answer: Thanks for flagging this. We haven't seen a wide-scale issue with TOTP enrollment, so this looks isolated to your tenant. Could you confirm the browser and whether any ad blockers or corporate proxies are active during enrollment? In the meantime, try enrolling from an incognito window so we can rule out cached session data.

subject: Offline mode not syncing after reconnect
body: On the mobile app, when a field rep loses connectivity and logs data offline, the queued changes don't sync once they're back online. We've confirmed this on three devices running the latest app version this week. The app shows a small sync icon spinning indefinitely but the pending records never post to the server, and the user has no way to force a retry.
answer: Sorry for the disruption this is causing your field team. We're looking into the sync queue handling for offline records right now — can you send the device models and OS versions for the three affected phones, plus one record ID that's stuck? That will help us trace whether the payload is failing validation or just not retrying.

subject: Unsubscribe link not removing users from alert emails
body: Multiple warehouse managers on our Harbor Retail account have clicked unsubscribe on shipment alert emails, but they're still receiving duplicate notifications daily. We're now getting complaints from over a dozen users across three regional teams, and it's undermining trust in the alerting system. This has been happening since at least last week and is affecting a large portion of our operations staff.

We're checking whether the unsubscribe preference is actually being written back to the notification service or just acknowledged client-side. Can you share two or three affected user emails so we can trace their preference records while we investigate the root cause?

subject: Upcoming API deprecation affecting our billing webhook integration
body: We received a notice that one of the API Platform endpoints our finance team relies on for invoice webhooks is being deprecated next quarter, but the migration guide linked in the changelog returns a 404. subject: Transform step failing intermittently in energy usage pipeline
body: Our data pipeline that aggregates energy usage from the connector into our warehouse has started failing at the transform stage roughly every third run since Tuesday. The job logs show a 'null reference in field mapping' error, and rows are being dropped silently rather than the whole job failing loudly. We need this stable before our weekly reporting cycle on Friday.

We'll pull the transform logs on our side to see whether the null reference is coming from a schema change upstream or a mapping config issue, and we'll prioritize this given your Friday reporting deadline.

subject: Doppelte Benachrichtigungen bei API Alerts

subject: SSO role mapping assigning wrong permissions after login
body: Since setting up SAML SSO with our identity provider, users logging in are being mapped to the 'Viewer' role instead of the department-specific roles we configured in the attribute mapping. This started after we updated our IdP group names last Thursday. Right now several analysts can't access the reports they need because their permissions reset on every login.
answer: This sounds like the attribute mapping is falling back to a default role because the group names no longer match what's configured in Northwind. Could you send us the current SAML attribute statement from your IdP metadata? We'll compare it against your SSO role mapping rules and get the correct group-to-role assignments restored as quickly as possible.

subject: Request to consolidate notification emails into daily digest
body: Right now our staff receive individual emails for every alert triggered, which has led to complaints about inbox overload across our 231 seats. We'd like to switch to a daily digest format that batches alerts by category instead of sending each one separately. Is this configurable at the account level, or does each user need to opt in individually?
answer: Good news — daily digest mode can be enabled at the account level so it applies to all users by default, though individuals can still override it in their personal notification settings. I'll walk you through enabling it from the admin console and share our digest configuration guide so you can group alerts by category before rolling it out.

subject: API key rate limit errors after recent key rotation
body: We rotated our API keys last week as part of routine security hygiene, and since then our integration is hitting 429 rate limit errors far more often than before, even though our request volume hasn't changed. We're on the Starter plan and wondering if the new keys were provisioned with a lower limit by mistake, or if something changed with the deprecation notice we received last month.
answer: Thanks for the details — key rotation shouldn't change your rate limit tier, so this does look like a provisioning issue on our end. Can you send us the key ID (not the secret) and a couple of timestamps where you saw the 429 responses? We'll check the limit configuration attached to the new keys and get it corrected.

subject: Charts rendering blank on shared dashboards
body: Several of our retail performance dashboards are showing blank chart areas when viewed via shared links, even though the same dashboards render fine when we're logged in directly. This is affecting the weekly export we send to store managers, and we'd like to know if there's a workaround while you look into a fix, plus whether better documentation on shared-link limitations could be added.
answer: Thanks for the clear description — this looks related to how chart data permissions resolve for shared-link viewers versus logged-in users. As a workaround, try enabling 'public data mode' on the specific charts so shared viewers can pull the underlying data directly. We'll also flag the documentation gap around shared-link behavior to our docs team.

subject: Late-arriving data breaking daily energy consumption rollups
body:
We run a nightly pipeline that aggregates energy usage data from our metering connector, and for the past 4 nights (Oct 14-17) records from our EU meters are arriving 6-9 hours late. The rollup job runs at 02:00 UTC but the meter connector sync now finishes around 08:00-11:00 UTC, so our finance close reports for Quill Foods are missing up to 18% of readings.

This is affecting our monthly energy cost reconciliation that goes to leadership. Can you check if something changed on the connector side or if we need to adjust our sync schedule? We need this resolved before our month-end close on the 20th.
answer:
Thanks for flagging this with the specific timestamps, that's very helpful. We can see increased latency on the EU metering connector starting Oct 14, likely tied to a batch size change upstream on the provider side; our engineering team is investigating the connector's polling window now and will push a fix or a documented workaround within 24 hours given your month-end deadline.

In the meantime, I'd recommend shifting your rollup job to run at 12:00 UTC instead of 02:00 as a temporary mitigation so it captures the delayed records. I'll update this ticket as soon as we have a root cause or fix deployed.

subject: Slack alerts not firing for Jira ticket sync
body:
We set up the Slack integration a few weeks ago to post alerts into our #incidents channel whenever a Jira ticket linked to Salesforce cases gets updated, but for the last week we're not receiving any notifications at all even though the Jira-Salesforce sync is still working fine on its own. We checked the Slack app permissions in our Okta-managed workspace and everything looks authorized.

Could someone look into why the Slack alert step isn't triggering? We rely on this for our 56-person support team to catch case escalations quickly.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. We've seen a few workspaces affected by a recent webhook delivery issue between the Jira connector and the Slack notification step, which can silently drop alerts without an error on your end. I'm escalating this to our integrations team to check your workspace's delivery logs specifically, and I'll confirm back within one business day with either a fix or next steps to re-authorize the Slack webhook.

subject: Paginierung gibt doppelte Einträge zurück
body:
Bei der Nutzung der API Platform mit unserem SDK (Version 3.2.1) stellen wir fest, dass die Paginierung über den Endpunkt /v1/patients doppelte Datensätze zurückgibt, wenn wir den next_cursor Parameter verwenden. Das passiert seit dem Update auf die neue API-Version letzte Woche.

Zusätzlich bekommen wir gelegentlich einen 429 Rate Limit Fehler, obwohl wir laut Dashboard weit unter unserem Limit liegen. Da wir im Starter-Plan mit nur 4 Sitzen sind, betrifft das direkt unser kleines Team und blockiert unsere tägliche Datenabfrage.
answer: Vielen Dank für die genaue Beschreibung. Das doppelte Auftreten von Datensätzen bei der Cursor-Paginierung ist uns bereits als Regressionsfehler aus dem letzten SDK-Update bekannt; ein Patch für Version 3.2.2 ist in Vorbereitung. Bezüglich der 429-Fehler prüfen wir aktuell, ob eine falsche Rate-Limit-Zuordnung bei Starter-Konten vorliegt, und melden uns innerhalb der nächsten zwei Werktage mit einem Update.

subject: Media pipeline sync delays affecting revenue attribution across regions
body:

I'll keep you updated with progress and an ETA within the next few hours, and will confirm once sync latency returns to baseline.

subject: Patient record connector delivering stale data intermittently

Our clinical ops team depends on near-real-time data for scheduling, so this delay is a real problem. Can you check whether the EHR connector's sync interval or queue is experiencing backlogs?
answer: Thank you for reporting this with the timeline. We're looking into the EHR connector queue now, as this pattern matches a known throughput issue affecting a subset of healthcare connectors since Oct 12. Our team is reviewing the queue depth and worker capacity for your connector instance, and we'll follow up shortly with either a fix or a documented workaround to reduce the delay while we resolve the root cause.

subject: Deactivated users still appearing as active in audit log
body:
We deactivated three former employees through Admin Console on Oct 18 (user IDs u_2291, u_3305, u_4410), but they still show as 'Active' in the Audit Log and one of them was able to log in again yesterday, which is a compliance concern for our fintech environment.

2024-10-19T08:12:44Z [WARN] auth.session.create user_id=u_3305 status=active session_id=sess_88a1
2024-10-19T08:12:44Z [INFO] admin.deactivation.confirmed user_id=u_3305 timestamp=2024-10-18T15:03:00Z
2024-10-19T08:15:02Z [ERROR] audit.sync.mismatch user_id=u_3305 expected=deactivated actual=active

subject: Email digests sending duplicate notifications to all users

As an immediate step, we've paused the digest job for your workspace to stop further duplicate sends, and we'll re-enable it once confirmed fixed, likely within the next hour.

subject: STOP SENDING DUPLICATE ALERTS TO WRONG TEAMS - THIS IS RIDICULOUS

subject: Duplicate daily digest emails going to whole team

We expect a fix deployed within the next day or two, and I'll update this ticket once it's resolved. In the meantime, I'm attaching our digest configuration guide which covers frequency and timing settings so your team can adjust delivery windows going forward.

subject: Question about seat count on our invoice
body:

subject: Offline mode logs out users on reconnect
