subject: Audit log missing deactivation events
body: While reviewing our Admin Console audit log for Ember Labs, I noticed that several user deactivation events from last week aren't showing up at all. We rely on this log for compliance reporting and need a complete record. Can you confirm whether this is a known gap or if there's a filter issue, and how we can get the missing entries? We also want to know if there's a way to set up an allowlist for future audit exports.
answer: Thank you for catching this, it's a serious gap for compliance so we're prioritizing it. We've confirmed a bug where deactivation events triggered via bulk actions weren't being written to the audit log correctly, and our team is working on backfilling the missing entries now. I'll follow up with a timeline for the backfill and separately with guidance on setting up an allowlist for your future exports.

subject: STILL BEING CHARGED FOR SEATS WE DON'T HAVE - FIX THIS NOW
body: This is the third time I'm writing about this. Apex Robotics is being invoiced for 1824 seats but we only have active users on about 1600 accounts, and this has been going on for two billing cycles now. I need a refund for the overage AND documentation showing how seat counts are calculated because your dashboard numbers don't match the invoice. If this isn't resolved by end of week we are seriously considering canceling our Enterprise contract.
answer: I understand your frustration and I'm escalating this to our billing team immediately as a priority case. I'm pulling the seat reconciliation report now to compare your active user count against what was invoiced, and I will personally follow up today with either a corrected invoice or a refund for the confirmed overage, along with documentation on how seat counts are calculated. You'll hear from me by end of day with concrete numbers, not just an apology.

subject: Question on SCIM group provisioning and MFA enforcement
body: We're setting up SCIM provisioning for Vertex Media and I want to confirm how group-based role permissions sync when a user is added via our IdP. Specifically, if MFA is enforced at the IdP level, does that satisfy Northwind's own MFA requirement, or do users need to re-enroll separately? Also curious if there are performance considerations when provisioning large batches, since we'll be syncing around 1371 seats initially.
answer: Good questions. When SCIM provisions a user with group membership mapped to a Northwind role, the role permissions apply immediately, and if your IdP enforces MFA on login, that satisfies our MFA requirement so users won't need to re-enroll separately. For an initial batch of your size, we recommend provisioning in chunks of a few hundred at a time to avoid rate limiting; happy to share more detailed guidance if you'd like to schedule a walkthrough.

subject: How to reduce latency on scheduled pipeline syncs
body: At Pioneer Academy we've set up a Data Pipelines connector that syncs every hour, but we're noticing sync latency has crept up to 20-25 minutes per run over the past week, and occasionally data quality checks flag stale records. Is there a way to see connector-level metrics to diagnose this, or a recommended sync frequency for our data volume? We'd also like to know if there's a feature to get alerted when latency crosses a threshold.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. You can check connector-level metrics under Pipelines > Connector Health, which shows per-run latency and record counts that should help pinpoint where the slowdown is happening. Given the creep you're describing, it may also help to reduce sync frequency slightly or stagger it with other jobs; we don't yet have threshold-based alerting for latency but it's on our roadmap, and I'll note your interest for that feature.

subject: Dringende Wiederherstellung aus Backup benötigt
body: Wir bei Orion Partners müssen dringend Dateien aus einem Backup wiederherstellen, das wir vor drei Wochen im Storage-Modul erstellt haben. Ein Mitarbeiter hat versehentlich einen ganzen Ordner mit Compliance-Dokumenten gelöscht und wir brauchen die Wiederherstellung noch heute, da eine Prüfung morgen beginnt. Können Sie uns den Prozess erklären und die Wiederherstellung beschleunigen?
answer: Vielen Dank für die schnelle Meldung, wir verstehen die Dringlichkeit angesichts der morgigen Prüfung. Ich leite die Wiederherstellungsanfrage jetzt mit hoher Priorität an unser Storage-Team weiter und wir beginnen sofort mit der Wiederherstellung des Backups vom angegebenen Datum. Sie erhalten innerhalb der nächsten Stunde eine Bestätigung, sobald die Dateien wieder verfügbar sind.

subject: help
body: Invoice shows 235 seats but we only have 210 active. Need this fixed fast.
answer: Thanks for flagging this - I'm escalating to our billing team right away since this affects your current invoice. Can you confirm the invoice number and the date range so we can reconcile seat counts and issue a credit or adjustment for the difference?

subject: Slack alerts not firing for API error webhooks
body:
We've configured the Slack integration to post alerts whenever our API integration hits a 5xx error, using the webhook URL generated in the Integrations panel. Since around March 4th, alerts have stopped appearing in our #alerts channel even though our logs show repeated 502s from the /v2/orders endpoint. We tested the webhook manually with curl and it returns a 200, so the issue seems to be on the trigger side.

Can you check if something changed with the Slack connector or rate limiting on our account (workspace ID starts with dc-19)?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. We're seeing a known issue where alert triggers tied to specific error-rate thresholds can silently stop firing if the underlying rule was edited after the connector was last re-authorized. I'm re-authorizing the Slack connector on our end and will confirm once test alerts come through - expect an update within a few hours.

subject: Question about last two invoices
body: Our last two invoices (Feb and March) both list 13 seats, but we downgraded to 10 seats on February 18th per our support ticket confirmation. Could someone check why the seat count wasn't updated and whether we're owed a partial credit for the difference?
answer: Thank you for pointing this out. I've pulled up your account and can confirm the seat reduction from February 18th wasn't reflected in the billing system in time for the Feb invoice cycle. I'm issuing a prorated credit for the difference on both invoices, which should appear on your account within 2-3 business days.

subject: Dashboard PDF export missing chart data
body: When I export our quarterly spend dashboard to PDF, the bar charts render but the line chart showing monthly trend is completely blank in the exported file, even though it displays fine on screen. This happens every time I try, regardless of browser (tested in both Chrome and Edge). I need this for a board report due Friday.
answer: Thanks for reporting this - I've been able to reproduce the issue with line charts dropping out during PDF export when they use a rolling date range filter. I'm filing this with our dashboards team as a priority fix, and in the meantime I'd suggest exporting that specific chart as a PNG separately to include in your report.

subject: Duplicate email digests being sent daily
body: For the past week, our finance team has been receiving two copies of the daily billing digest email, both timestamped within a minute of each other. We only have one notification rule configured under Notifications > Digests, so I'm not sure where the duplicate is coming from. This is causing confusion since some numbers look slightly different between the two copies.
answer: Thank you for flagging this - duplicate digests usually point to a stale notification schedule that wasn't cleared after a recent update. I'm checking your account's digest configuration now and will disable any duplicate scheduled job I find; I'll follow up shortly to confirm the fix and explain the discrepancy in numbers you noticed.

subject: Cannot export any dashboard to PDF - export button unresponsive
body: Since this morning, clicking 'Export to PDF' on any dashboard just spins and never produces a file, across every dashboard in our workspace. We rely on this for our weekly retail performance report that goes out to our regional managers today, and right now nobody on our 8-seat team can generate anything.
answer: I'm sorry for the disruption - this is affecting your team's ability to work, so I've marked it as high priority. Our engineering team is investigating the export service now; I'll update you within the hour with either a fix or a workaround so you can still get your report out today.

subject: SSO role mapping assigning wrong permissions after login
body: After our latest SSO configuration update, users logging in via our identity provider are being mapped to the 'Viewer' role instead of their assigned 'Editor' or 'Admin' roles from our IdP group attributes. This started after we updated our SAML assertion mapping on Monday. We've verified the group attributes are being sent correctly in the SAML response, but Northwind seems to be defaulting everyone to Viewer.
answer: Thanks for the detailed writeup. This matches a known issue where role mapping falls back to the default role when an attribute name casing mismatch occurs after a SAML config update. I'll review your SSO configuration and mapping rules directly and get back to you with the corrected mapping within the next few hours.

subject: Anfrage zur Deaktivierung von Nutzerkonten
body: Wir möchten mehrere ehemalige Mitarbeiter aus unserem Workspace deaktivieren, finden aber im Admin Console keine klare Option für eine Massendeaktivierung. Zusätzlich benötigen wir für unser Compliance-Audit einen Nachweis, dass die betroffenen Konten seit dem Ausscheiden keinen Zugriff mehr hatten. Können Sie uns die genauen Schritte nennen?
answer: Vielen Dank für Ihre Anfrage. Aktuell unterstützt die Admin Console eine Mehrfachauswahl über die Nutzerliste, mit der Sie mehrere Konten gleichzeitig deaktivieren können - ich sende Ihnen gerne eine kurze Anleitung dazu. Für den Compliance-Nachweis kann ich Ihnen zusätzlich einen Audit-Log-Export der betroffenen Konten bereitstellen, sobald Sie mir die entsprechenden Nutzernamen nennen.

subject: MFA enrollment broken
body: No staff can enroll in MFA since this morning, all get stuck on QR scan.
answer: This is affecting your whole team's ability to log in securely, so I'm treating it as urgent. Our identity team is investigating the QR enrollment flow now - can you confirm whether the error appears before or after scanning, and which authenticator app is being used, so we can pinpoint the failure point quickly?

subject: Multiple card decline erros on our account
body: we been getting card decline errors for the last 3 payments, our card is valid and has plenty of funds, we checked with our bank aswell. the erros just say 'payment failed' with no more detail. we have 109 seats on Pro plan and cant affor to have services interupted, can you tell us whats going on and if theres a way to retry manualy or use a diferent payment method for now?
answer: Sorry for the trouble this is causing - I can see the recent decline attempts on your account and will have our billing team investigate the specific failure code from the processor. In the meantime, I'd recommend adding a backup payment method under Billing > Payment Methods so we can retry the charge manually today and avoid any service interruption.

subject: Audit log slow to load and missing deactivation entries
body:
I'm a support engineer at Harbor Academy and I've been pulling audit logs from the Admin Console for a compliance review. The log view takes close to 30 seconds to render for the past 7 days, and when I filter by 'user deactivated' events, three deactivations I performed last week (Oct 2-4) don't show up at all even though the accounts are confirmed inactive.

Could you check whether audit log indexing is delayed for our workspace, and if there's a way to force a resync? We only have 8 seats so the data volume should be tiny.
answer: Thanks for flagging this - a 30-second render time for a workspace your size isn't expected, and missing deactivation events in the audit log is worth investigating directly. I'm checking our indexing pipeline for Harbor Academy's workspace now to see if there's a backlog or a stuck job, and I'll also confirm whether the three deactivations from Oct 2-4 were logged correctly on our end. I'll follow up shortly with what I find.

subject: UNSUBSCRIBE LINK IN OUR EMAILS IS BROKEN AND UNSUBSCRIBING EVERYONE
body:
WE JUST GOT A FLOOD OF SUPPORT TICKETS FROM OUR OWN CUSTOMERS BECAUSE THE UNSUBSCRIBE LINK IN OUR NOTIFICATION EMAILS IS UNSUBSCRIBING THEM FROM ALL ALERTS INCLUDING BOOKING CONFIRMATIONS NOT JUST MARKETING. THIS STARTED AROUND 9AM TODAY AND WE HAVE ALREADY LOST AT LEAST 40 SUBSCRIBERS ACROSS OUR TRAVEL ALERT LISTS. THE DOCS SAY THE LINK SHOULD ONLY OPT OUT OF THE SPECIFIC CATEGORY BUT IT IS CLEARLY GLOBAL NOW.

WE NEED THIS FIXED IMMEDIATELY OR RESTORED SUBSCRIBERS, THIS IS AFFECTING REAL CUSTOMERS WHO NEED BOOKING ALERTS.
answer: I understand this is urgent since it's impacting your customers' ability to receive booking alerts, and I'm escalating this as a P1 right now. We're looking into the unsubscribe link behavior to confirm whether category-level opt-outs are being applied globally, and I'll update you within the hour with findings and, if possible, a way to restore affected subscribers. In the meantime, if you can share one or two example unsubscribe links that were triggered today, that will help us pinpoint the issue faster.

subject: Workspace settings reverting after allowlist update, deactivated users still showing active
body:
I updated our IP allowlist in Admin Console yesterday afternoon to add two new office ranges, and this morning the entire allowlist had reverted to the previous configuration with no record of my change in the audit log. Separately, five users I deactivated last Tuesday are still appearing as 'Active' in the user list, even though they can't log in anymore.

This is concerning given we're a healthcare organization with 1371 seats and need accurate access controls for compliance. Can someone confirm whether this is a caching issue or a real settings rollback bug?
answer: This is a serious concern for an account of your size, especially with the allowlist and deactivation status inconsistencies, so I'm treating this as a P1 and looping in our platform team immediately. We'll check whether the allowlist change was actually persisted server-side or reverted due to a sync issue, and we'll also audit the deactivation status for those five accounts to confirm whether it's a display bug or an actual access problem. I'll update you as soon as we have root cause, likely within the next few hours.

subject: URGENT - storage quota exceeded, uploads and backups failing company-wide
body:
As of this morning our entire team can't upload files or run scheduled backups because Storage is reporting we've exceeded our quota, but we checked our usage dashboard last week and were at 68% capacity. Every backup job since 6am today has failed with a quota error, and our logistics dispatch system relies on these uploads to sync shipment documents.

We need this resolved immediately since operations are currently blocked - can you tell us why usage jumped so suddenly and get our uploads working again?
answer: I'm sorry for the disruption - blocked uploads and failed backups affecting your whole operation is a P0 for us and I've escalated it accordingly. We're pulling your account's storage usage history right now to identify what caused the sudden jump from 68% to over quota, and we'll temporarily lift the quota block so your backups and uploads can resume while we investigate. I'll update you within the next 30 minutes with both a root cause and confirmation that uploads are flowing again.

subject: Jira link integration failing to create issues from Northwind alerts
body:
I'm setting up the Jira integration for our manufacturing team and configured the link under Integrations to auto-create Jira tickets when API error-rate alerts fire. Since yesterday, every attempt fails with 'Unable to create issue: project key ROBO-INT not found' even though that project exists and is visible in our Jira instance.

We verified the API token has admin permissions on the project. This is blocking our on-call workflow for 127 engineers who rely on these tickets being auto-filed. Can someone check the connector logs on your end?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report - a broken Jira link blocking your on-call workflow for that many engineers is a priority for us, so I've marked this P1. We're pulling the connector logs on our side now to see why the project key lookup is failing despite the project existing and the token having proper permissions; this often points to a stale project cache on our connector. I'll follow up shortly with either a fix or a workaround to unblock issue creation.

subject: Question about upcoming API deprecations affecting our webhook setup
body:
I saw the notice about upcoming deprecations in the API Platform changelog and want to confirm which of our current integrations are affected. We're using the v2 webhook endpoints and the older SDK version (2.3) across our retail integrations for 250 seats, and I want to know if the deprecated rate-limit headers mentioned in the notice apply to our current webhook subscriptions.

Could you clarify the migration timeline and whether we need to update our SDK before the v2 endpoints are sunset?
answer: Good question, and glad you're getting ahead of this. The v2 webhook endpoints are on the deprecation list with a sunset date planned for early next quarter, and yes, SDK 2.3 uses the older rate-limit header format that will stop being supported at that time. I'd recommend upgrading to SDK 3.x when convenient, and I can send over our migration guide with specific steps for updating your webhook subscriptions to avoid disruption.

subject: Request to enable biometric login for our mobile app users
body:
Our team has been asking whether the Mobile App supports Face ID or fingerprint login instead of entering a password every time. We currently have 13 seats and most of our staff use the app on shift to check schedules, and re-entering credentials constantly is a friction point.

Is biometric login already available and just needs to be enabled somewhere, or is this a feature we'd need to request? If it exists, a quick how-to would be great.
answer: Thanks for reaching out - biometric login is available in the current version of the Mobile App, but it does need to be enabled per user under Settings > Security > Biometric Login after they've logged in with their password at least once. I'd recommend having your team update to the latest app version first, since biometric support was added in a recent release. I'll send over a short walkthrough your staff can follow to turn it on.

subject: Question about configuring custom retention policies for archived data
body:
We're reviewing our data retention setup in Storage and want to understand our options for setting different retention periods per data category - for example, keeping backup snapshots for 7 years for compliance but only 90 days for temporary upload logs. Right now it looks like retention is applied as one global setting across our workspace.

Given we're at 3651 seats with a fairly large volume of archived data, is granular per-category retention on the roadmap, or is there a current workaround using folder-level policies?
answer: This is a great question and one we hear often from larger customers. Per-category retention isn't available yet as a native setting, but I can confirm it's on our product roadmap for a future release. In the meantime, a workaround some Enterprise customers use is organizing data into separate folders or buckets with distinct retention tags applied at the folder level - I'm happy to walk through how to set that up for your backup snapshots versus upload logs.

subject: Slack alerts from Salesforce integration arriving 20+ minutes late or duplicated
body:
We integrated Slack alerts with our Salesforce sync in Integrations about two weeks ago, and starting yesterday the alerts are either arriving 20-30 minutes after the triggering event or showing up twice in the same channel. We checked our Slack workspace's rate limits and we're nowhere near them.

This is affecting our sales team's response time on lead updates for 86 seats. Can you check if there's a queue backlog on the integration side causing the delay and duplication?
answer: Thanks for the specifics on timing and duplication - that's helpful for tracking this down. We're checking the integration queue for delays or retry loops that could explain both the 20-30 minute lag and the duplicate deliveries; this pattern usually points to a stuck consumer or a retry firing before the original message is acknowledged. I'll update you once we've identified the cause, and in the meantime I'd suggest temporarily reducing alert frequency if the duplicates are causing confusion for your sales team.

subject: Charts in shared dashboard rendering blank for entire team
body:
Since this morning, three of our four dashboard charts in the 'Enrollment Trends' dashboard are rendering completely blank for everyone on my team, though the data tables underneath still populate correctly. I've tried refreshing, clearing cache, and viewing from a different browser with the same result.

This dashboard is used in a leadership meeting later today, so I'd appreciate a quick look. We're a small team of 8 seats at Harbor Academy so this is affecting essentially everyone who needs the report.
answer: Thanks for the heads up, and I know the timing with your leadership meeting makes this urgent, so I've prioritized this as P1. Blank charts with working data tables usually points to a rendering issue on our chart service rather than a data problem, and I'm checking the 'Enrollment Trends' dashboard on our end right now to reproduce it. I'll get back to you as soon as possible, ideally with a fix or workaround well before your meeting.

subject: SSO role mapping broken after IdP update - staff locked into wrong roles
body:
We updated our Okta group attributes yesterday and now new SSO logins at Quill Legal are mapping everyone to the default Viewer role instead of their assigned group role. We have 66 seats and at least a dozen paralegals and attorneys who logged in this morning got locked out of billing and case modules they need. The mapping rules under Identity > SSO > Attribute Mapping still show the correct group names on our side.

This is blocking our billing team from closing invoices today. Can someone check why the attribute mapping stopped applying group-to-role assignments?
answer: Thanks for flagging this, I understand this is blocking your billing close and I'm treating it as a priority incident. Can you send us the SAML response from one affected login (via your IdP's debug trace) along with the exact group attribute name you're passing - we suspect a casing or delimiter mismatch introduced by the Okta attribute update is causing the mapping engine to fall back to default role. In the meantime, I can manually reassign the affected users' roles if you send me their usernames so your team can keep working while we trace the root cause.

subject: Need to upgrade from Starter to Pro mid-cycle for API rate limits
body:
I'm integrating the Northwind API for Atlas Works and we're consistently hitting the 500 req/min cap on Starter, getting 429s during our nightly sync job. I want to upgrade to Pro but I need to know how proration works on our current invoice cycle and whether our existing 18 seats carry over automatically or if I need to re-provision API keys after the switch.

Also, is there a way to get a partial refund credit for the days already paid this month on Starter, or does it just apply as credit toward the new plan?
answer: Upgrading is straightforward and won't require new API keys - your existing keys and seats carry over automatically once the plan change takes effect. Proration is calculated automatically: the unused days on your current Starter invoice will be applied as a credit toward the Pro invoice rather than issued as a cash refund, and you'll see the adjusted line item on your next billing statement. I'll go ahead and flag your account so the upgrade takes effect immediately once you confirm in the billing portal, and higher rate limits should apply within a few minutes of the switch.

subject: Retention policy question for Storage - need longer than 90 days
body:
We're on Storage for Delta Academy and I noticed files uploaded to our travel-docs bucket are being purged after 90 days per the default retention policy. We need at least 180 days retention for compliance with our travel partner contracts, and I don't see an option in the admin panel to change this for our 22-seat account.

Also separately, our uploads have been slower than usual this week - a 200MB file that used to take under a minute now takes 4-5 minutes. Is this related to a quota or performance issue on your end?
answer: Retention period on Starter is fixed at 90 days by default, but I can manually extend your bucket's retention to 180 days on our end - please confirm the exact bucket name(s) you'd like this applied to. Regarding the upload slowness, we did see elevated latency in one storage region this week; I'll check whether Delta Academy's account is in that region and follow up with details, but if you can share a timestamp of a recent slow upload that will help us pinpoint the cause faster.

subject: Audit log missing deactivation events and export is capped
body:
As part of a compliance review for Pioneer Partners I'm pulling audit logs from Admin Console and noticed several user deactivation events from last week (around Oct 3-5) simply aren't appearing in the log, even though the users show as deactivated in the user list. We have 101 seats and need a complete trail for our quarterly audit.

Also, the CSV export tool caps at 1000 rows, which cuts off almost half our monthly log volume. Can you confirm if the missing deactivation events are a bug, and is there a way to get a full export without the row cap?
answer: Thank you for the detailed dates - missing deactivation events in the audit log is not expected behavior, and I'm escalating this to engineering as a data integrity bug since it affects your compliance reporting. In the meantime, I can pull a raw log extract from our backend covering October 3-5 so you have the deactivation records for your audit while we investigate. On the export cap, we're aware the 1000-row limit is restrictive for larger accounts; I'll request an unbounded export on your behalf and let you know once it's ready.

subject: SCIM-Provisionierung sehr langsam bei großen Gruppen
body:
Wir nutzen SCIM für die automatische Bereitstellung bei Harbor Analytics mit aktuell 3651 Lizenzen. Seit letzter Woche dauert die Synchronisation neuer Nutzergruppen aus unserem Azure AD deutlich länger als sonst - teilweise über 45 Minuten für eine Gruppe mit 200 Nutzern, vorher waren es wenige Minuten. Einige Nutzer können sich zwischenzeitlich nicht einloggen, weil ihr Konto noch nicht vollständig angelegt ist.

Können Sie prüfen, ob es aktuell Performance-Probleme auf der SCIM-Schnittstelle gibt? Das betrifft mehrere Fakultäten bei uns.
answer: Vielen Dank für die genaue Beschreibung. Wir sehen uns die aktuelle Performance der SCIM-Schnittstelle für Ihr Konto an und prüfen, ob es serverseitige Verzögerungen bei der Gruppenverarbeitung gibt - das kann durchaus mit dem hohen Nutzervolumen zusammenhängen. Können Sie uns eine der betroffenen Gruppen-IDs sowie den ungefähren Zeitpunkt der letzten Synchronisation nennen, damit wir die Logs gezielt durchsehen können? Wir melden uns zeitnah mit einem Zwischenstand.

subject: Offline mode docs unclear, app crashed when reconnecting
body:
I was testing the mobile app's offline mode for Apex Capital last week during a flight and when we landed and the app reconnected, it crashed twice trying to sync queued actions. It eventually recovered on the third attempt. I looked through the help docs but couldn't find any explanation of how sync conflicts are resolved when offline changes overlap with server updates.

This isn't blocking us since it's rare, but could you point me to any documentation on offline sync behavior, and is the reconnect crash something known?
answer: Thanks for the report - reconnect crashes after offline sync aren't something we've seen widely reported, but I'll pass this along to the mobile team with the detail about it taking three attempts to recover. We don't currently have public documentation specifically on offline sync conflict resolution, so I'll flag that as a documentation gap too. If you can share your app version and device OS, that would help us reproduce the crash on our end.

subject: Digest emails sending duplicates to finance team
body:
Our finance team at Vertex Robotics gets the weekly billing digest email twice every Monday morning, same content, about 3 minutes apart. This has been happening for the past three send cycles. We have 217 seats and it's mostly the finance distribution list affected, not individual users as far as I can tell.

Can you check the digest scheduler for our account? It's not urgent but it's cluttering inboxes and people keep asking if something's wrong.
answer: Thanks for reporting this - duplicate digest sends usually point to a scheduling job running twice for a given group, so I'll check the digest configuration tied to your finance distribution list specifically. Could you forward one pair of duplicate emails with headers so we can confirm the exact send timestamps? That will help us identify whether it's a retry issue or a duplicate subscription on the list.

subject: dup alerts
body: Getting same alert email twice, every time.
answer: Thanks for letting us know. Could you tell us which alert type this is happening for and forward one example of the duplicate pair so we can check whether it's a subscription or retry issue on our end? We'll get this sorted out for you.

subject: Alert routing sends escalation emails to wrong team distribution list
body:
We've set up alert routing rules for Ember Energy so that critical alerts go to our on-call engineering list and billing alerts go to finance, but for the past week critical alerts have also been duplicating to the finance list, which is causing confusion and unnecessary escalations on their end. Our 77 seats are split across three routing groups and only the critical-to-finance duplication seems affected.

Could you take a look at our routing configuration and see if there's a rule conflict causing alerts to match both groups? Happy to share our rule setup if that helps.
answer: Thanks for the clear breakdown - a critical alert also matching a finance rule usually means there's an overlapping condition between two routing rules, most often when a tag or severity filter is shared across groups. If you can export your current routing rule set (or just screenshot the critical and finance rules), we'll review the conditions and identify the overlap so you can either scope the rules more tightly or we can help adjust the matching logic.

subject: Deactivated users still showing as active in allowlist and audit log lag
body:
For Harbor Systems, our security team deactivated 14 users last Friday as part of an offboarding batch, but three of them are still appearing as active in the IP allowlist settings under Admin Console, meaning they could technically still access the API from their old locations. The audit log also shows the deactivation events with a delay of several hours compared to when we actually clicked deactivate.

Since we have 452 seats and this touches security compliance, I'd like this looked at soon - can you confirm whether allowlist entries are supposed to update automatically on deactivation?
answer: This is an important gap to close quickly given the access risk, so I'm prioritizing it. Allowlist entries should update automatically when a user is deactivated, so the three accounts still showing active access is unexpected - could you send me the usernames or user IDs for those three so I can manually revoke their allowlist entries right away while we investigate the sync delay? I'll also look into the audit log timestamp lag separately and report back on both root causes.

subject: REFUND NEVER PROCESSED - THIS IS RIDICULOUS
body: we canceled 8 seats back on March 2nd and were told a prorated credit would hit our next invoice. its now april 14th and INV-88213 shows full charge for 56 seats again with no credit applied. i have emailed twice already and nothign happened. we run a fintech ops team and cant keep chasing this every month, if this isnt fixed by friday we are looking at other vendors seriously.
answer: I'm sorry for the frustration this has caused, especially after two follow-ups without resolution. I've pulled up INV-88213 and can confirm the seat reduction wasn't reflected in that billing cycle due to a sync gap on our end. I'm issuing a credit for the difference now and will email confirmation once it posts to your account within 1-2 business days, and I'll personally verify the next invoice reflects the correct 48-seat count.

subject: Routing alerts to wrong distribution list
body: We have payment failure alerts set up to go to our billing distro list, but for the last week they've also been landing in our general ops inbox. I checked the routing rules under Notifications and don't see a duplicate rule, so I'm not sure if this is expected behavior or a config issue on our end. Can you clarify how routing rules apply when multiple teams are tagged on the same alert type?
answer: Thanks for flagging this - it sounds like the alert type may have two tags matching separate routing rules, which causes delivery to both destinations. Could you send me the exact alert name or ID you're seeing duplicated? In the meantime, you can scope a rule more tightly by adding a specific condition (like alert source) so it only matches one list.

subject: Salesforce connector auth failing for all pipelines
body: Since this morning around 7:40am our Salesforce connector has been failing with 'OAuth token invalid or expired' on every sync attempt across all 6 pipelines feeding our patient billing dashboard. We already tried re-authenticating through the connector settings page but it just loops back to the same error after granting permissions. This is blocking data refreshes for our clinical operations team who rely on same-day sync.
answer: This is affecting a critical workflow so I'm escalating to P1 now. The re-auth loop usually points to a stale refresh token on our connector service side rather than your Salesforce app permissions - our data pipelines team is checking the OAuth handshake logs for your account now. I'll update you within the hour with either a fix or a manual token reset you can apply.

subject: Recurring transform failures on order enrichment pipeline
body: Our order enrichment pipeline has failed intermittently over the past two weeks, roughly 4-6 times per week, always at the currency conversion transform step. The error references a null exchange rate field even though upstream source data looks complete when I spot-check it. We'd like documentation on how the transform step handles missing rate lookups, since our workaround of manual reruns isn't sustainable at our volume.
answer: Thanks for the detail - intermittent null exchange rate failures usually happen when the rate lookup table has a brief gap during the source refresh window, which the transform doesn't currently retry against. I'll send over our documentation on configurable retry and fallback behavior for lookup-based transforms, and I'd also recommend we review your pipeline's schedule offset against the rate provider's update window to reduce the overlap.

subject: Request to adjust retry logic on currency transform step
body: Following up on the transform failures we've seen - I'm integrating against the Data Pipelines API directly and want to add a retry-with-backoff wrapper around the currency conversion step rather than waiting on manual reruns. Does the API expose a way to set custom retry counts or delay intervals per transform node, or would this need to be handled entirely on our client side?
answer: Right now retry intervals per transform node aren't exposed as a configurable API parameter, so this would need to be handled client-side with your own backoff wrapper around the transform call. That said, we're evaluating adding per-node retry config in an upcoming release - I'll flag your use case to the product team and let you know if a beta becomes available.

subject: Urgent: card declines blocking our seat renewal
body: Our card on file has been declined twice this week when the system tried to auto-renew our 4-seat Starter plan, and we got a notice that seats will be suspended in 3 days if payment isn't resolved. We've updated the card details in billing settings already but the retry still shows failed with code 'do_not_honor' from the processor. We need this sorted before Thursday or our whole team loses access.
answer: I understand the urgency given the suspension deadline - I'm escalating this now. 'Do_not_honor' typically comes from the issuing bank rather than our system, so I'd suggest contacting your bank to confirm they're not flagging the recurring charge as suspicious. In parallel, I'm manually triggering a retry on our side now and will hold off any suspension action on your account until we confirm the payment clears.

subject: Need to restore storage bucket from last week's backup
body: We accidentally overwrote a large batch of processed manufacturing reports in our storage bucket on April 9th during a bulk upload job. I'd like to restore from the backup snapshot dated April 8th if possible, but I want to confirm the restore process won't affect newer files uploaded after that date or count against our monthly upload quota. We're at about 78% of our storage quota currently.
answer: Restoring from the April 8th snapshot will only affect the specific paths you select, so newer files uploaded after that date won't be touched unless they share the same path and get overwritten during restore. The restore itself doesn't count against your upload quota. I'd recommend restoring to a separate staging path first so you can verify contents before merging back into the live bucket - happy to walk through that process with you.

subject: Jira integration broken - issues not linking
body: Our Jira integration stopped creating linked issues yesterday when tickets are escalated from Northwind. Previously each escalation would auto-create a Jira ticket with the reference ID attached, but now nothing happens on the Jira side even though the escalation shows as sent in our activity log. We rely on this for tracking retail support cases with our 3-person team.
answer: Thanks for reporting this - since the escalation shows as sent but nothing appears in Jira, this points to the webhook delivery from our side failing silently rather than a Jira permissions issue. I'm checking the integration logs for your workspace now to see where the handoff is breaking, and I'll follow up shortly with either a fix or next steps if the Jira API credentials need re-linking.

subject: cant deactivate a former employees workspace access AND IPs still showing wrong
body: IVE BEEN TRYING TO DEACTIVATE A FORMER EMPLOYEES ACCOUNT FROM OUR WORKSPACE FOR TWO DAYS AND IT KEEPS SHOWING AS ACTIVE IN THE ADMIN CONSOLE EVEN AFTER I CLICK DEACTIVATE MULTIPLE TIMES. ALSO THE IP ALLOWLIST SETTINGS PAGE IS SHOWING RANGES WE NEVER ADDED. THIS IS A SECURITY ISSUE AND WE NEED IT FIXED NOW, THIS IS UNACCEPTABLE FOR A SECURITY PRODUCT.
answer: I understand the urgency of an account that won't deactivate combined with unexpected allowlist entries - this needs immediate attention and I'm treating it as such. I'm reviewing your workspace's admin console logs now to identify whether this is a UI refresh bug or an actual permissions issue, and I'll confirm within the hour whether the former employee's access is truly revoked at the backend level regardless of what the console displays.

subject: IP allowlist update urgently needed before audit
body: We have a compliance audit scheduled for next week and need to update our IP allowlist in Admin Console to remove three deprecated office IP ranges and add two new ones tied to our updated VPN. I also noticed the audit log isn't showing the allowlist change history from the last update we made in February, which our auditors will specifically ask about. Can someone confirm this can be resolved before the audit date?
answer: Given the audit timeline, I'm escalating this to our security team right away. For the allowlist update, I can walk you through the change now so it's confirmed live before your audit; for the missing February entries in the audit log, that looks like a logging gap we need to investigate on our end, and I'll get you a status update on that within 24 hours so you have it documented for the auditors.

subject: Duplicate email alerts for the same event
body:
We've noticed that our operations team has been getting duplicate email notifications for the same shipment delay alerts over the past week. For example, on March 4th we received the exact same alert twice within about 90 seconds for order batch DM-4471. It's not happening on every alert, maybe 1 in 5, but it's causing confusion on the floor since people think there are two separate issues.

Could you let us know if this is a known issue or if there's a setting on our end that controls alert deduplication? We'd like to fix this before it trains people to ignore alerts.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. Duplicate alerts like this are usually caused by overlapping notification rules or a retry from a webhook that timed out before confirming delivery, so this is likely something we can tune on our side or help you adjust in your rule configuration. Could you send us the notification rule name or ID tied to the shipment delay alerts, plus one or two of the duplicate message timestamps, so we can trace it through our delivery logs?

subject: Urgent: cannot update workspace settings after admin lockout
body:
Our IT team was reorganizing admin roles this morning and now none of the workspace admins, including myself, can access the Workspace Settings page in the Admin Console. It just spins and eventually shows a generic 'Something went wrong' message. This is blocking us from deactivating three former employee accounts that still have access to sensitive legal case files.

We have 217 seats on this workspace and need this resolved quickly since those accounts should have been deactivated yesterday. Please advise on next steps or a workaround to disable those accounts another way.
answer: I understand the urgency here given the pending deactivations, and I'm escalating this to our platform team right now as a P1. In the meantime, as a workaround, you can deactivate individual users directly from the User Management tab rather than Workspace Settings, which uses a separate service and should still be accessible. I'll follow up within the hour with an update on the root cause of the Workspace Settings error.

subject: How to export audit log for compliance review
body:
I'm putting together our quarterly compliance review and need to pull the audit log showing all admin actions from the last 90 days, specifically permission changes and login events. I can see the Audit Log tab in the Admin Console but I only see the last 30 days of entries and there's no obvious export button.

Could you tell me how to extend the date range and export this as a CSV or PDF for our records? We're a small team of 10 seats so I imagine this is a fairly standard request.
answer: Happy to help with this. On the Starter plan the Audit Log UI defaults to a 30 day view, but you can extend the range using the date picker at the top left, up to 90 days of history. For export, there's a small download icon next to the filter bar that generates a CSV of the currently filtered results, so setting your date range first and then clicking export should get you what you need for the compliance review.

subject: IP allowlist not blocking connections as expected
body:
I configured our IP allowlist in the Admin Console last week to restrict access to our office and VPN ranges only, but I just noticed a login from an IP address outside that list in the audit log, dated March 6th at 14:22 UTC. The user account is one of our data team members who was traveling and not on VPN.

I expected the allowlist to block this connection entirely, not just log it. Is there a setting I'm missing, or does the allowlist only apply to certain login methods? We're a fintech company so this is a real concern for us.
answer: Thanks for flagging this, and I understand the concern given your compliance requirements. The IP allowlist in the Admin Console currently applies to standard password logins but does not yet cover SSO sessions or long-lived API tokens, which may explain why that login went through. I'd like to confirm the login method used in that audit log entry so we can verify whether this is expected behavior or a gap we need to fix, and I'll follow up with our security team on the SSO coverage timeline.

subject: Slack alerts from API integration stopped working
body:
We set up the Slack integration through the API Platform about three weeks ago to post alerts into our #logistics channel whenever a shipment status webhook fires, and it worked fine until yesterday. Since around 9am on March 5th, no messages are coming through even though our webhook logs show 200 responses from Northwind's side.

We haven't changed our Slack app permissions or the integration config. Can you check if something changed on the integration side, or if there's a queue backlog for outbound Slack messages? This is affecting real-time visibility for our freight dispatch team.
answer: Thanks for the clear timeline, that helps narrow this down. We are seeing some delayed processing in the outbound Slack delivery queue starting around the time you mentioned, which looks like a backend issue on our side rather than anything in your integration config. I've flagged this to our integrations team for immediate investigation and will update you as soon as messages are flowing again or if we need any additional details from your webhook logs.

subject: Push notifications not delivering to iOS users, urgent
body:
Since yesterday morning, push notifications in our Mobile App have stopped reaching iOS users across our retail locations, roughly 195 staff accounts affected. Android devices seem fine. Users are missing shift alerts and inventory notifications, and several store managers have already escalated this to me directly.

We've confirmed notification permissions are enabled on affected devices and the app is up to date. Is there a known issue with the iOS push service or APNs certificate? We need this fixed today as it's disrupting store operations across multiple locations.
answer: This is being treated as a priority issue on our end given the scale of impact. I'll have an update for you within the next couple of hours, and in the meantime please have affected users confirm the app shows as connected under Settings > Notifications so we can rule out a client-side config issue.

subject: Question about API rate limits for SDK batch requests
body:
I'm using the Python SDK to pull analytics data in batches and keep hitting 429 responses after roughly 60 requests in a minute, even though I thought our Starter plan allowed more headroom. The error message just says 'rate limit exceeded, retry after 30s' without specifying the actual limit.

Could you point me to documentation on the exact rate limits for our plan, and whether the SDK has built-in retry/backoff handling or if I need to implement that myself? Trying to plan our batch job scheduling around this.
answer: Good question, and this is a common point of confusion. Starter plan API limits are 60 requests per minute per API key for the analytics endpoints, so what you're seeing lines up with expected behavior. The Python SDK does include automatic retry with exponential backoff for 429 responses, but it's disabled by default, you can enable it by passing retry_on_rate_limit=True when initializing the client, and I'll also send over the link to our rate limits documentation page for reference.

subject: Refund needed for duplicate charge, need this fixed fast
body:
We were charged twice for our monthly Northwind subscription this billing cycle, invoice numbers INV-88213 and INV-88240, both dated March 1st, same amount of $196.00. I'm the support engineer here handling this since our office manager is out, and finance needs this resolved before our internal books close on Friday.

I'll send confirmation once the refund is issued so you have documentation for your finance close.

subject: Seat count on invoice doesn't match actual active users
body:
Our latest invoice shows we're being billed for 282 seats, but when I check the Admin Console user list, we only have 268 active users, 14 of whom were offboarded last month and should have been removed from billing automatically. This has been happening for at least two billing cycles now.

We have seen an intermittent sync delay between user deactivation and seat billing updates, which can cause exactly this kind of discrepancy for a billing cycle or two. I'm opening an investigation into your account's seat sync history now, and once confirmed I'll arrange a credit for the extra seats billed and make sure the count corrects going forward.

subject: Dashboards taking a long time to load with large datasets
body:
Several of our shared dashboards have become noticeably slow to load over the past couple of weeks, especially the ones with multiple bar and line charts pulling from our energy usage dataset. Load times have gone from a few seconds to sometimes 20-30 seconds, and a few staff have mentioned charts occasionally timing out entirely before rendering.

We have 248 seats using these dashboards across our campuses, so this is affecting a lot of people daily. Is there a way to optimize chart queries or reduce load on shared dashboards, or is this something on Northwind's infrastructure side we should report as a performance issue?
answer: Thanks for the detailed description, this helps us narrow down where the slowdown is coming from. Dashboards with multiple charts pulling from large datasets can often be sped up by adding date range filters or aggregating at a coarser interval on the underlying queries, which reduces the data volume each chart has to render, and I'd recommend starting there for your energy usage dashboards. That said, given the scale of impact across your campuses, I'm also having our performance team review backend query times for your account in parallel to rule out any infrastructure-side bottleneck.

subject: api deprecation??
body: webhook v1 endpoint gonna be deprecated soon but no clear date given, we relie on it heavly for order sync
answer: Thanks for flagging this — the v1 webhook endpoint is scheduled for deprecation on 2025-03-31, with v2 already available as a drop-in replacement. I'll send over the migration guide and timeline so your team can plan the cutover before the sunset date.

subject: Request to restrict Admin Console access by IP allowlist
body: We need to lock down access to our Admin Console so that only requests originating from our corporate VPN range (203.0.113.0/24) are allowed. Could you enable IP allowlisting for our workspace and confirm whether existing sessions outside that range will be terminated automatically or need manual deactivation? Once active, sessions from outside the allowlisted range are flagged but not force-terminated automatically — you'll need to deactivate those sessions manually from the Access tab, and each action will be logged in the audit trail with timestamp and admin identity.

subject: Late-arriving records in daily sync pipeline
body: We've noticed that our nightly connector sync from our ERP occasionally includes records timestamped up to 18 hours after the pipeline run completed, meaning they show up a full day late in downstream tables. This happened on 2024-05-02 and again on 2024-05-06 with about 40-60 rows each time. Is there a recommended way to configure the pipeline to catch these late arrivals, or should we schedule a secondary reconciliation job?
answer: This is a known pattern with source systems that have delayed write-commit windows. I'd recommend enabling the late-arrival watermark setting on the connector config, which re-scans the last 24 hours on each run to catch stragglers like the ones you saw on 5/2 and 5/6. I'll also flag this to our connector team as feedback since a configurable watermark default could help other pipeline users avoid manual reconciliation.

subject: URGENT: hitting rate limits constantly, breaking production checkout
body:
Since this morning our checkout service is failing intermittently with 429s from the API Platform, way below what we'd expect given our limits. Log below:

I'm escalating to engineering now to check your account's current limit configuration and will follow up within the hour with either a temporary limit increase or a client-side batching fix.

subject: Storage issue

I'm escalating this as P1 right now — initial checks show your account's actual usage versus quota mismatch, which looks like a metering sync issue on our end rather than genuine overage. I'll update you within the hour once we've corrected the quota figure and confirmed your backups can resume.

subject: Dashboard sharing permissions not respecting team roles
body: We integrated the Dashboards API to programmatically share reports with specific teams, but we're seeing that viewers outside the intended team can still open dashboards shared via the /v1/dashboards/{id}/share endpoint. We tested this with dashboard id dash_88213 shared to team_finance only, and a user from team_ops was still able to load it directly via URL on 2024-06-09. Can you confirm whether share scope is enforced server-side or only in the UI?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report — this does sound like a permissions enforcement gap rather than expected behavior. In the meantime, I'd recommend also restricting access at the workspace level as a precaution for dash_88213 and similar shared reports.

subject: Question about SAML login with our identity provider
body: We're evaluating enabling SAML-based SSO for our team through Identity and SSO, and I wanted to check what's supported before we configure it. Does Northwind support just-in-time user provisioning on first SAML login, and can we enforce MFA at the identity provider level rather than through Northwind directly? We currently use a smaller IdP and want to confirm permission mapping works correctly before rolling this out.
answer: Good questions — SAML SSO does support just-in-time provisioning, so new users are created automatically on first successful login with role mapping based on SAML attributes you configure. MFA enforcement can be handled entirely at your IdP level; Northwind will simply honor the authenticated session, so as long as your IdP requires MFA before issuing the assertion, you're covered. Happy to walk through the attribute mapping setup with you if useful.

subject: question
body: We need to extend our storage retention period for uploaded financial documents from the default 90 days to at least 7 years to meet audit requirements. Is this configurable per workspace, and would it apply retroactively to files already uploaded, or only new uploads going forward? answer: Retention period is configurable per workspace under Storage Settings, and yes, you can set it up to 7 years or more for compliance needs. Changing the setting applies going forward for new uploads by default, but I can help extend retention retroactively on your existing document set as well — I'll follow up with the steps and confirm how this interacts with your backup schedule.

subject: Zapier integration setup for expense approvals
body: I'm looking to connect our expense approval workflow to Zapier so that approved invoices in Northwind automatically create records in our accounting system. I found the Integrations page but I'm not seeing Zapier listed as an available trigger source yet — is this supported currently, or is it still on the roadmap? subject: Workspace settings reset unexpectedly across our organization

This is affecting all 108 seats and we're concerned about a security gap since the allowlist is no longer enforced. As an immediate mitigation, please re-apply your IP allowlist and session timeout settings manually while we investigate, and I'll update you within the hour with findings and a fix to prevent recurrence.

subject: Feature request: automatic retry for failed card payments
body:
I'm the product manager overseeing billing operations at Pioneer Health. Over the last month we've seen 17 failed card transactions across our team, mostly due to insufficient funds or expired cards, and each one currently requires a manual retry from the admin console. Invoices #INV-88231 and #INV-88459 are two recent examples that sat unpaid for 5 days before anyone noticed.

Could you add an automatic retry mechanism with configurable intervals, plus an email alert to the billing contact when a card fails? This would help us reduce the manual follow-up across our 294 seats.

Automatic card retry with configurable intervals is on our billing roadmap, and I'll log this request against your account with a note about the alerting requirement as well. In the meantime, I can point you to the bulk-retry option under Billing > Failed Payments, which lets you re-trigger multiple failed charges at once rather than one at a time.

subject: Okta app users occasionally losing session on Northwind login
body:
We're using the Northwind Okta application for SSO across Cobalt Capital, and a handful of users have reported being bounced back to the Okta login page mid-session, roughly once every few days. On the attribute mapping question, our current Okta app doesn't yet support pushing custom attributes for Salesforce or Jira provisioning, but I'll share the relevant integration docs and flag the Slack notification request to our integrations team as feedback.

subject: DRINGEND: Ehemaliger Mitarbeiter hat noch Zugriff
body:

subject: Zapier trigger not firing for new bookings

subject: Seat count on invoice doesn't match active users

subject: Transform stage failing repeatedly on retail sales pipeline

subject: Workspace settings reverting after saving changes

subject: How to enable push notifications on mobile app for our team

subject: Upgrade from Starter charged wrong amount
body: I upgraded our Pioneer Retail workspace from Starter to Pro yesterday afternoon and the invoice that generated shows a full month charge instead of a prorated amount. subject: Webhook delivery lagging behind by several minutes

subject: Push notifications not arriving on Android after app crash

subject: urgent

subject: SDK throwing deprecated method errors after recent update
body: After updating the Northwind API SDK to the latest version this week, our integration is throwing 'DeprecatedMethodError: client.rateLimitStatus() will be removed in v4' warnings that are now blocking our build pipeline treating warnings as errors. subject: Salesforce sync pushing duplicate contact records

subject: URGENT: IP allowlist blocking all logins for our team

subject: Question about quota calculation and retention overlap

subject: How to route Slack alerts for Salesforce sync events

subject: App crashes when opening offline mode after sync

subject: Late-arriving data causing gaps in daily reports
body:
We've noticed our booking data pipeline regularly has records arriving 4-6 hours after the expected window, causing gaps in our morning reports. It seems tied to our connector pulling from a source system that batches updates overnight. This isn't urgent since it self-corrects by afternoon, but it's a recurring annoyance for our small team.

Is there a way to configure the pipeline to hold report generation until a certain data completeness threshold, or flag records as late-arriving so we can handle them differently downstream?
answer: Thanks for the context - late-arriving data windows are common with overnight batch sources like yours, and there are a couple of options here. You can configure a watermark delay on the pipeline so report generation waits for a set completeness window before running, or enable late-arrival flagging which tags records that land after the expected window so your downstream logic can treat them separately. I'll send over setup steps for both so you can decide which fits your reporting cadence best.

subject: Request to change Salesforce sync direction for opportunity records
body:
We currently have our Salesforce integration set to sync opportunity records bidirectionally, but we'd like to change this to Salesforce-to-Northwind only for opportunities, while keeping other objects like contacts bidirectional. This is to prevent our sales team's Northwind-side edits from overwriting Salesforce data during our renewal cycle.

Could someone confirm the steps to change sync direction at the object level, or if this requires a support-assisted config change on your end? We'd like to have this in place before our next renewal batch runs.

For opportunities specifically, switching to Salesforce-to-Northwind only will stop any Northwind-side edits from pushing back. I'll walk you through the exact toggle in the mapping screen, and since you mentioned a renewal batch coming up, let me know the timeline so we can make sure the change is in place beforehand.

subject: How to increase storage quota / adjust retention
body:
We're getting close to our storage quota limit on our account and I'd like to understand our options - either increasing the quota or adjusting our backup retention policy to free up space, since a lot of our usage seems to be old daily backups. We're a small team of 11 so I want to make sure we choose the right approach before we hit the limit.

Can you walk me through how retention settings affect quota, and what the process looks like to request a quota increase if that ends up being the better option?
answer: Happy to walk through this - your backup retention policy directly affects quota since older backups count against your total storage until they age out, so shortening retention from your current setting can free up space fairly quickly under Storage > Retention Settings. If you'd prefer to keep longer retention, a quota increase can be requested directly from your account settings and typically takes effect same-day. Let me know your current retention window and I can estimate how much space adjusting it would recover.

subject: Changing email digest frequency for notifications
body:
We'd like to change our notification digest settings from daily to weekly for our team - right now everyone is getting individual emails throughout the day plus a daily digest, which feels redundant. Some staff have also mentioned getting duplicate digest emails on the same day.

Could you help us switch the digest frequency to weekly, and also look into why duplicates might be happening? We're a small team of 11 so this is more of a cleanup request than urgent.

On the duplicates, that's often caused by overlapping notification rules triggering separate digest jobs, so I'll take a look at your current rule configuration and follow up with what I find.

subject: Speicher-Retention löscht Dateien viel zu früh – das ist inakzeptabel!
body:
Wir haben gerade festgestellt, dass Dateien aus unserem Storage-Bucket 'atlas-retail-docs' bereits nach 30 Tagen gelöscht wurden, obwohl unsere Retention-Policy auf 90 Tage eingestellt war. Das tut uns sehr leid, wir verstehen den Ernst der Lage und kümmern uns sofort darum. Bitte teilen Sie uns die genauen Bucket-Namen und, falls möglich, ein paar der betroffenen Dateinamen mit, damit wir in unseren Backup-Snapshots gezielt nach den Dokumenten suchen können – in vielen Fällen können wir Dateien aus den letzten 35 Tagen noch wiederherstellen.

Parallel prüfen wir, warum die Retention-Policy nicht wie konfiguriert (90 Tage) angewendet wurde, und melden uns innerhalb der nächsten zwei Stunden mit einem Zwischenstand.

subject: Duplicate alert emails for same incident
