Since this morning we can't upload any new documents to our Storage workspace — we get an error saying 'Quota exceeded: 100GB limit reached' when trying to add case files. We're a small legal team of 18 and didn't expect to hit this limit so soon; our last successful upload was yesterday around 4pm.

Can you confirm our current usage, and let us know options for either increasing quota or clearing up space? We also want to understand our retention settings so we don't run into this again, and whether older backups count against this same quota.
answer:
Thanks for the clear error message — I can confirm your workspace is currently at 100GB, which matches the Starter plan storage allocation, so uploads are being blocked as expected until space is freed or quota is increased. I'll send a breakdown of your usage by folder so you can see what's taking the most space, including whether older backups are contributing.

For a longer-term fix, we can walk through either archiving older case files to reduce active usage or discuss an upgrade path with more storage headroom. Let us know which direction you'd like to explore first.

subject: Users locked out during MFA enrollment rollout
body:
We rolled out mandatory MFA enrollment this morning for our 14 users and several of them are now completely locked out of the platform. The enrollment screen shows 'Verification failed: unable to link authenticator' and then redirects to a blank login page with no way to retry or skip. At least 6 of our team members can't get in right now, including two who need to file court documents today.

We need a way to either bypass MFA temporarily for these users or get enrollment working immediately.
answer:
This is urgent and we're prioritizing it right now. As an immediate step, we can temporarily disable the mandatory MFA requirement for your organization so the 6 locked-out users can log in normally while we investigate the authenticator linking error — please confirm and we'll apply that within minutes.

We're also pulling logs on the 'unable to link authenticator' error to identify what's breaking enrollment before you re-enable the requirement, and will follow up with next steps as soon as we have a fix.

subject: PDF export from dashboard cuts off charts
body:
When exporting our analytics dashboard to PDF, the last chart on the page gets cut off halfway, specifically the 'Weekly Engagement' widget on our media performance dashboard. This happens consistently whether I export via the dashboard toolbar or through the API export endpoint. I'm using the standard export template with no custom sizing.

Could you check if this is a known layout issue with the PDF export renderer? It's not blocking urgent work but it makes the reports we send to stakeholders look unfinished.
answer:
Thanks for the detailed description — this does sound like a known rendering issue with certain widget heights not being accounted for in the PDF page-break calculation. Could you share the dashboard ID or a screenshot of the export so we can confirm it's the same layout bug affecting the 'Weekly Engagement' widget specifically?

Once confirmed, we'll log it with our dashboards team for a fix, and in the meantime we can suggest a temporary workaround such as resizing that widget slightly to avoid the page-break cutoff.

subject: Push notifications not arriving on mobile app since update
body:
After the latest mobile app update, none of our 14 users are receiving push notifications for shipment status changes anymore. We've confirmed notifications are enabled in device settings on both iOS and Android test devices, and in-app notification settings look correct too. This started right after everyone updated to the newest app version two days ago and it's affecting our whole logistics coordination workflow.

We rely heavily on these alerts for time-sensitive pickups, so this is a serious problem for our operations right now.
answer:
I understand how disruptive this is given how central push alerts are to your pickup workflow, so we're treating this as high priority. Can you confirm the exact app version installed and whether this affects both iOS and Android devices equally, or just one platform? That will help us determine if it's a client-side regression from the update or a server-side delivery issue.

While we investigate, if any users can roll back to the previous app version that may temporarily restore notifications — we'll have an update for you within a few hours.

subject: biometric login BROKEN after update, drivers cant clock in!!
body:
we pushed the app update to our warehouse teams last week and now biometric login just spins and fails on like half our devices. drivers use this offline in the trucks with no signal and now they cant get past the fingerprint screen at all. this is costing us real time every morning shift.

ive got 40+ tickets from site leads already, this needs fixed today not next week. also push notifications for shift start seem delayed too, is that related??
answer:
I'm sorry for the disruption this is causing your drivers, especially during shift start. We're aware of an issue where biometric login fails to validate cached credentials when the device is offline for extended periods after an app update, and I'd like to get your affected device OS versions and app build number to confirm you're hitting that specific bug. Please have a site lead send a screen recording of the fingerprint screen hang along with two or three device IDs so we can pull logs.

On the push delay, that's likely a separate queueing issue we can check once we have your workspace ID. I'm marking this P2 and staying on it directly until drivers are back to normal login.

subject: Okta app for Slack integration missing group sync
body:
We're setting up SSO through Okta for our staff to reach Northwind's Slack integration, but the Okta app only supports user provisioning, not group push. We have three groups (teachers, admin, IT) that need different Slack channel access mapped automatically.

Can you confirm if group-based provisioning is on the roadmap, or if there's a workaround using SCIM attributes we're missing? We only have 10 licenses so manual assignment isn't a big deal short term, but we'd like a proper setup before the fall term.
answer:
Thanks for the detailed rundown. Group push for the Slack integration via the Okta app isn't currently supported, only individual user provisioning through SCIM, so there's no attribute-based workaround today. I've filed this as a feature request on your account and linked it to similar asks from other education customers, which helps prioritize it.

In the meantime, since you're at 10 seats, manual channel assignment through the Slack integration settings page is the recommended path, and I'm happy to walk you through the mapping so it's ready before your fall term starts.

subject: HOW DO I LINK JIRA TO NORTHWIND FOR ISSUE SYNC
body:
WE NEED TO CONNECT OUR JIRA INSTANCE TO NORTHWIND SO SUPPORT TICKETS CREATE LINKED ISSUES AUTOMATICALLY. WE ALREADY HAVE OKTA AND SLACK SET UP AND SALESFORCE PARTIALLY CONFIGURED. THE INTEGRATIONS PAGE SHOWS JIRA AS AVAILABLE BUT WHEN I CLICK CONNECT IT JUST SPINS AND NOTHING HAPPENS.

WE HAVE 265 SEATS AND OUR LEGAL OPS TEAM IS WAITING ON THIS BEFORE THEY START LOGGING CASES THROUGH THE PORTAL. PLEASE ADVISE STEPS OR IF THIS IS A KNOWN BUG.
answer:
Thanks for flagging this. A spinning Connect button on the Jira integration usually means the OAuth callback isn't completing, often because a browser popup blocker or a stale Salesforce connection is interfering with the handshake. Could you try the connection again in an incognito window and let me know if it still hangs?

If it does, send me your Jira Cloud site URL and the timestamp of the attempt so I can check our integration logs for a rejected callback. We'll get this sorted before your legal ops team needs to start logging cases.

subject: Urgent: SSO role mapping not applying correct permissions
body:
We configured SAML SSO last week and set up role mapping so users in our 'Dispatch' group get the Operator role and 'Finance' gets Billing Admin. Since this morning, new logins are landing with default Viewer permissions regardless of group, so several staff can't access the dashboards they need to do their jobs.

We have 25 seats total and this is blocking about a third of our team right now. Our IdP is Azure AD, attribute name is 'department', and it was working correctly as of Friday's test login.
answer:
This sounds like a break in the SAML attribute mapping rather than an IdP-side change, since it worked Friday. Can you confirm whether any group names or the department attribute value changed over the weekend, and send a fresh SAML response trace from one affected login? I'll check our side for a mapping cache issue in parallel.

Given this is blocking a third of your team from correct access, I'm treating this as P1 and will have an update for you within the hour while we trace the role assignment logic.

subject: Question about workspace-level audit log retention settings
body:
I'm reviewing our Admin Console setup ahead of an internal compliance check and want to confirm how long audit logs are retained at the workspace level, and whether that's configurable per workspace or set account-wide. We manage several workspaces across departments and some have different retention needs due to healthcare record policies.

Also, is there a way to export audit logs on a schedule rather than manually pulling them each time? A recurring export would help our compliance team a lot.
answer:
Good question, and timely for your compliance review. Audit log retention is currently set account-wide at 400 days and isn't yet configurable per individual workspace, though we do support exporting logs before that window closes if you need longer archival for specific departments.

Scheduled exports aren't available as a native feature yet, but I can add your account to the request list for that capability. In the meantime, I can walk you through setting up a manual export routine or point you to our API endpoint for pulling logs programmatically on your own schedule.

subject: Transform step failing intermittently on booking data pipeline
body:
Our travel booking pipeline has a transform step that's been failing on and off since Tuesday, usually 2-3 times a day. The error in the pipeline log just says 'transform_error: unexpected null in field departure_date' but the source connector data looks fine when I check it manually in the raw feed.

This is delaying our nightly reports by a few hours each time it happens, which is annoying for a small analyst team like ours trying to keep dashboards current. Pipeline ID is bk-pipeline-07 if that helps narrow it down.
answer:
Thanks for the pipeline ID, that helps a lot. A null in departure_date that doesn't show up in the raw feed usually points to a timing issue where the transform runs slightly before the connector finishes a partial batch write, which can happen with certain source connectors under load. I'm going to pull the run logs for bk-pipeline-07 around your failure windows to confirm.

While I dig in, you can add a null-check retry rule on that transform step as a temporary buffer, which should reduce the report delays. I'll follow up today with what I find in the logs.

subject: Need guidance on API key rotation and SDK version support
body:
We're planning to rotate our production API keys next month and want to understand the recommended process so we don't cause downtime for our own customers who hit our integration built on Northwind's API. Right now we're on SDK v2.3 and I noticed the changelog mentions v2.6 deprecates some auth headers we currently use.

Can you confirm the rotation window (does the old key stay valid during grace period?) and whether upgrading to v2.6 is required before rotating, or if they're independent?
answer:
Good timing to check this before your rotation. Old API keys remain valid for a 24-hour grace period after a new key is generated, so you can stage the swap without downtime as long as both keys are active during that window. The v2.6 auth header deprecation is a separate track, current keys work fine on v2.3 through the rotation, but we do recommend upgrading before the v2.3 SDK sunset later this year.

I'll send over our key rotation runbook and the v2.6 migration notes so you can plan both changes with minimal risk to your integration.

subject: SDK throwing 401 errors after recent auth header change
body:
Since this morning our integration built on the Northwind SDK v2.4 started returning 401 Unauthorized on every call, even though our API key hasn't changed and worked fine yesterday. Here's the error we're seeing:

AuthError: token validation failed
  at SDKClient.authenticate (client.js:112)
  at SDKClient.request (client.js:88)
  code: 'AUTH_HEADER_DEPRECATED'
  status: 401

This is blocking all API calls for our production integration, which our media clients depend on for content delivery right now. We need this resolved urgently.
answer:
Thank you for the exact error code, that confirms this is tied to the auth header deprecation that rolled out to production this morning ahead of the documented timeline, which is on us. The AUTH_HEADER_DEPRECATED response means your SDK v2.4 client is sending the old header format that's no longer accepted.

We're treating this as P1 and I'm escalating internally to see if we can extend the grace period while you upgrade. In parallel, please update to SDK v2.6 or later, which uses the new header format, and that should immediately restore your calls. I'll keep you updated within the hour on the grace period decision.

subject: Getting duplicate alert notifications across multiple channels
body:
Starting yesterday around 3pm, our team has been receiving every alert notification 2-3 times each, both in email and through our connected Slack channel. I checked our alert rules and nothing was changed on our end recently, we have around 40 active alert rules tied to shipment threshold breaches.

With 1194 seats and alerts going to multiple team leads, this is generating a lot of noise and some people are starting to mute the channel entirely, which defeats the purpose. Can you check if something changed on the notification delivery side?
answer:
Thanks for the clear timeline, that 3pm start point is useful. We're seeing reports from a few other accounts of duplicate deliveries beginning around the same window, which points to an issue in our notification dispatch service rather than anything in your alert rule configuration. I'm escalating this as P1 given the volume of alerts and users affected on your account.

While we investigate the dispatch service, I'd hold off on disabling channels since we expect to have a fix rolled out soon, and I don't want your team to miss a genuine shipment alert in the meantime. I'll update you as soon as we have a root cause.

subject: Zapier integration performance and documentation question
body:
We've had the Zapier integration running for a few months to sync workspace events into our internal tools, and lately the zaps seem to take longer to trigger, sometimes a few minutes delay compared to what felt closer to real-time before. Not urgent, but wanted to flag it.

Separately, I'm looking at consolidating our Okta and Zapier setups and couldn't find documentation on whether Zapier can read Okta group attributes directly or if we need an intermediary step. Any pointers to docs would be appreciated.
answer:
Thanks for the heads up on the trigger delay, we haven't seen a broad pattern yet but I'll note it on your account and check whether the Zapier webhook queue has had increased latency recently given your workspace size. Since this isn't blocking anything urgent, we'll follow up with findings rather than treat it as a live incident.

On the Okta and Zapier question, Zapier doesn't read Okta group attributes directly today, you'd need an intermediary step such as a webhook from Okta workflows or a scheduled sync job. I'll send over our integration documentation covering both pieces so your team has a reference while you plan the consolidation.

subject: Zapier integration failing to trigger on new order events
body: We use the Northwind Zapier integration to push new order records from Delta Retail into our Slack channel and a Jira automation. Since Tuesday (June 4th) the Zap has stopped triggering for roughly 40% of new orders - we've confirmed in the Northwind Integrations log that events are being generated, but the Zapier task history shows no corresponding runs for those IDs. Zap ID is DR-ORD-2291. Can you check if webhook delivery is being throttled or dropped on your end?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report and the Zap ID. We can see intermittent 429 responses being returned from our webhook dispatcher to Zapier's endpoint around the timestamps you flagged, which looks like a rate-limiting issue on our side rather than anything wrong with your Zap configuration. We're escalating this to our integrations engineering team to raise the throttle threshold for your account and will follow up within one business day with a fix or workaround.

subject: Push notifications not delivered when app relaunched offline
body: I'm integrating the Northwind Mobile SDK for Orion Media's iOS app and we're seeing push notifications silently fail after a device goes offline and the app is relaunched. The device re-registers for a token, but subsequent pushes from our backend via the Northwind API return 200 OK yet never arrive on the device. This is affecting a growing number of users across our healthcare client rollout, roughly 12% of test devices in the last week.
answer: Thank you for the reproduction steps. This pattern points to a stale token being retained in our push gateway cache after the app is relaunched offline, so the API accepts the send but routes to an invalid endpoint. We're treating this as an active incident and have engineers investigating token invalidation on reconnect; we'll update you within a few hours with findings or a mitigation you can apply on your end in the meantime.

subject: How to slow down Slack alert frequency for pipeline events
body: Quill Health has Slack alerts configured through Northwind Integrations to notify our #data-ops channel whenever a pipeline job completes. Right now we're getting a message for every single run, including minor sub-tasks, and it's flooding the channel with about 60 messages a day. Is there a way to filter or batch these alerts so we only get notified on failures or on the final job status?
answer: Good question - you can adjust this under Integrations > Slack > Alert Rules, where you can set the trigger to 'On Failure Only' or 'Final Status Only' instead of every sub-task event. I'd recommend the Final Status option for your use case; let me know once you've tried it and if the volume looks better after a day of testing.

subject: Need to upgrade from Starter to Pro plan and adjust seats
body: I handle billing analysis for Blue Legal and we currently have 4 seats on the Starter plan. We need to move to Pro to get access to advanced reporting, but I also want to understand how the mid-cycle upgrade will be prorated on our next invoice, and whether we can add 2 more seats at the same time. Our current renewal date is the 15th of this month.
answer: Happy to help with the upgrade. When you switch from Starter to Pro mid-cycle, we prorate the difference based on the days remaining in your current billing period, and the same proration applies to any seats added at the same time. I can process the upgrade to Pro with 6 seats now so it takes effect immediately, and your next invoice on the 15th will reflect the prorated charges - just confirm and I'll proceed.

subject: Push-Benachrichtigungen kommen nicht an nach Absturz der App
body: Wir nutzen die Northwind Mobile App für unsere Fahrer bei Willow Freight und seit gestern erhalten mehrere Nutzer keine Push-Benachrichtigungen mehr, nachdem die App im Hintergrund abgestürzt ist. Das betrifft aktuell mindestens 15 von unseren 56 Nutzern und ist kritisch, da wir darüber Versandstatus-Updates verschicken. Die App zeigt beim Neustart kurz einen weißen Bildschirm und dann eine Fehlermeldung 'Session ungültig'.
answer: Vielen Dank für die Meldung, das nehmen wir als P1 auf, da es einen kritischen Geschäftsprozess betrifft. Der Absturz mit anschließender 'Session ungültig'-Meldung deutet auf ein Problem mit der Token-Erneuerung nach einem Absturz hin - unser Mobile-Team untersucht das gerade aktiv. Bitte bitten Sie betroffene Nutzer, sich einmal komplett ab- und wieder anzumelden, das sollte die Push-Zustellung vorübergehend wiederherstellen, während wir an einer permanenten Lösung arbeiten.

subject: Need SCIM group provisioning support for automated onboarding
body: We're integrating North Freight's HR system with Northwind Identity via SCIM 2.0 to automate user provisioning, but we've hit a wall - the SCIM endpoint accepts user creation but returns a 501 Not Implemented when we try to PATCH group memberships. Our onboarding pipeline depends on assigning users to groups automatically at creation time, and this is blocking our rollout for 39 seats scheduled to go live this week.
answer: Thanks for flagging this - group membership PATCH operations via SCIM are on our roadmap but not yet enabled by default; we can turn on the beta group-provisioning endpoint for your tenant given the urgency. I'm escalating this to our identity team now to get it enabled within the next business day and will send you the updated SCIM schema reference for group operations once it's live.

subject: Requesting increased retention window for archived uploads
body: I work with data at Harbor Travel and we currently have uploads set to a 30-day retention period in Northwind Storage. For compliance in our energy sector audits, we need to extend retention to 90 days for our backup bucket specifically, without changing retention for our working uploads bucket. Can you confirm if this is something we can configure per-bucket, and if there's a quota impact given our Starter plan limits?
answer: Per-bucket retention overrides are supported, so you can set the backup bucket to 90 days while leaving your working uploads bucket at 30 days - this is done under Storage > Bucket Settings > Retention Policy. Note that on the Starter plan there's a combined storage quota across buckets, so extending retention on the backup bucket will count toward that same limit; let us know if you'd like an estimate of the added usage before you apply the change.

subject: PDF export from Dashboards broken for all users - blank pages
body: As of this morning, every dashboard export to PDF at Delta Partners is producing blank pages instead of the actual charts and tables. This is happening across all dashboards we've tested, affecting our entire team of 115 seats who rely on these exports for client reporting. We first noticed it around 9am when a scheduled export job to our shared drive came back empty, and manual exports show the same blank result.
answer: This is now a P1 for us and we're actively investigating - a recent rendering service update appears to have broken chart-to-PDF conversion across dashboards. Our engineering team is working on a rollback and we expect to have this resolved within the next couple of hours; I'll update this ticket as soon as exports are confirmed working again, and apologize for the disruption to your reporting workflow.

subject: Request to extend SSO session timeout duration
body: I administer identity settings for Orion Systems and our SSO sessions are currently timing out after 15 minutes of inactivity, which is disruptive for our small team of 3 seats doing long design review sessions. Is there a way to increase this to at least 60 minutes, or configure it per-user-group instead of applying the same timeout org-wide?
answer: You can adjust this under Identity and SSO > Session Policy, where the inactivity timeout is configurable up to 8 hours on the Starter plan, though per-group overrides are only available on Pro and above. I've gone ahead and increased your org-wide timeout to 60 minutes as requested - let me know if you'd like it set higher or want to discuss group-level policies as you grow.

subject: Card payments failing for all seats, billing page shows error
body: Since this morning, Quill Academy's payment card is being declined for our recurring Pro plan charge covering 285 seats, and the billing page in Northwind now shows a red banner saying 'Payment method failed - update required' even though our card has sufficient funds and hasn't expired. This is blocking access for several team members who are now seeing a 'billing hold' message when logging in.
answer: I'm sorry for the disruption - this is being treated as P1 given the account-wide impact. We're seeing the decline originating from our payment processor rather than your bank, so we're investigating on our end right now and will lift the billing hold on your account immediately so your team can keep working while we sort out the card processing issue. I'll follow up shortly with either a resolution or an alternate payment method option.

subject: Okta app integration failing intermittently for Delta Freight
body:
We set up the Northwind Okta app about two weeks ago and since Monday we've seen intermittent SSO failures when users try to launch Northwind from our Okta dashboard. About 1 in 5 attempts throws 'application misconfigured' before redirecting to a blank page. We haven't changed anything on the Okta side recently.

Can someone check whether there's a known issue with the Okta app config, or if this is related to a recent update on your end? This is affecting several of our 12 users trying to get into their dashboards.
answer: Thanks for flagging this, and sorry for the disruption to your team. We did push a minor update to the Okta app integration last week that changed a redirect URI validation rule, which may be causing the intermittent failures you're seeing. Can you confirm the exact app instance ID from your Okta admin panel so we can check the logs on our side and get this resolved quickly?

subject: Unsubscribe endpoint returning 500, users still getting emails
body:
I'm integrating the Notifications API and testing the unsubscribe flow. When I call POST /v1/notifications/unsubscribe with a valid subscriber_id, I get a 500 error about 40% of the time, but the request still seems to register since users report they keep receiving emails after unsubscribing. This started this morning around 9am UTC.

We have around 24 users on our team relying on this for a campaign going out today, and now we're getting complaints from recipients who unsubscribed days ago and are still getting emails. This needs urgent attention since it's a compliance issue for us.
answer: This is escalated to our engineering team right now given the compliance impact. We're seeing elevated error rates on the unsubscribe endpoint starting around the time you reported and are actively investigating a backend queue issue that may be delaying unsubscribe processing. In the meantime, please pause any active sends where possible, and we'll update you within the hour with root cause and an ETA for a fix.

subject: Question about extending data retention period
body:
I'm looking at our Storage settings and noticed our current retention policy purges data after 90 days. We'd like to keep raw pipeline exports for at least 180 days for audit purposes, but I don't see an option in the console to change this for our plan.

Is extending retention possible on our current tier, or would we need to manually export and archive the data ourselves each month? Just trying to figure out the best approach before Q3 reporting.
answer: Thanks for reaching out. On the Starter plan, retention is currently fixed at 90 days and isn't configurable in the console, so extending it would require manually exporting data before the retention window closes. I'll pass this along as a feature request for configurable retention, and in the meantime I can share our export API docs if that would help you set up a monthly archive job.

subject: Request to support SAML with per-group MFA enforcement
body:
We're rolling out SAML SSO for Vertex Capital and have it working for basic login, but we need MFA enforcement to differ by group. Our finance team needs mandatory hardware key MFA, while general staff just need TOTP. Right now it looks like the SAML config only supports one global MFA policy for the whole org.

Could you let us know if per-group MFA policy is on the roadmap, or if there's a workaround using SAML attributes to pass group info and trigger different MFA requirements on our IdP side?
answer: Good question, and this comes up often. Currently our SAML integration does apply MFA policy at the org level rather than per-group, so there isn't a native way to split enforcement by team today. A workaround some customers use is passing a group attribute in the SAML assertion and having your IdP enforce the stricter MFA requirement before the assertion reaches us. I'll log this as a feature request for group-level MFA policy and keep you posted on any movement.

subject: urgent
body:
Our security team flagged that the audit log in the Admin Console stopped recording deactivation events for user accounts starting sometime last week. We deactivated three former employees on the 14th and 15th, but none of those actions show up in the audit log export, even though the events should be captured under our compliance settings.

We need this fixed immediately since we're mid-audit and can't show a gap in the deactivation trail. Can you confirm whether this is a known bug and when logging will be restored?
answer: We understand the urgency given your active audit and have escalated this to our compliance engineering team immediately. We're investigating why deactivation events aren't appearing in the audit log export starting last week; this looks like it could be tied to a logging pipeline issue rather than the events themselves being lost. We'll follow up within a few hours with findings, and if needed we can pull the raw account activity records directly to help bridge the gap for your audit in the meantime.

subject: SAML login broken for subset of users after IdP metadata update
body:
We updated our IdP metadata last Thursday and since then about 15 of our 123 seats can no longer log in via SAML. They get 'invalid signature' errors on the Northwind login page, while everyone else logs in fine. Our IT team has confirmed the metadata was uploaded correctly and matches what's in our IdP console.

This is odd because it's not all-or-nothing, so it doesn't seem like a full config mismatch. Can someone look into why only certain accounts are affected?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. A signature validation error affecting only a subset of users often points to certificate rollover timing, where some sessions are still using a cached older certificate on our side or your IdP is issuing assertions with a mix of old and new certs during the transition. We're pulling logs for the affected accounts now to confirm which certificate is being presented, and we'll follow up shortly with next steps to get everyone back to consistent SAML login.

subject: PRODUCTION DOWN: pipeline transforms failing org-wide since 6am
body:
All of our data pipeline transform jobs have been failing since approximately 6:10am UTC today. Every job errors out with 'transform execution timeout exceeded' and we've had zero successful runs in over 3 hours. This is affecting all pipelines across our 292 seats and is blocking downstream reporting for our logistics operations teams globally.

We run roughly 40 scheduled transform jobs per hour normally and none are completing. This is a total outage for us and we need immediate escalation.
answer: This is being treated as a P0 outage and escalated to our data pipeline engineering team right now. We're seeing the elevated transform timeouts on our end as well and are actively investigating whether this is a capacity or scheduler issue affecting the transform execution layer. We'll provide an update within 30 minutes and will keep you posted continuously until all jobs are running normally again.

subject: Need urgent restore from backup, deleted files by mistake
body:
One of our team members accidentally deleted a folder containing about 4,200 client contract files from Storage yesterday around 3pm. We need to restore these from the most recent backup as soon as possible since our legal team needs access for a filing deadline this week.

Could someone confirm what backup snapshot is available and initiate a restore for the affected folder, or walk us through how to do it ourselves? We're on the Pro plan with 146 seats and this is time-sensitive.
answer: We can help get this restored quickly given the deadline. We have nightly backup snapshots retained for your account, so we should be able to restore the folder from the snapshot taken before the deletion occurred. Please send us the exact folder path and the approximate deletion time so we can locate the right snapshot, and we'll initiate the restore on our end and confirm once it's complete.

subject: How to bulk manage unsubscribe lists via API
body:
We're trying to reconcile our unsubscribe list across two email providers and want to pull the full list of unsubscribed addresses from Northwind Notifications via API rather than exporting from the dashboard each time. I see the /v1/notifications/subscribers endpoint but it's not clear if there's a filter for unsubscribed status only.

Could you point me to documentation on filtering by subscription status, or let me know if there's a dedicated endpoint for this? We'd like to automate this as part of our weekly data pipeline.
answer: Good news, this is supported. You can filter the /v1/notifications/subscribers endpoint using the query parameter status=unsubscribed to return only unsubscribed addresses, and it supports pagination for larger lists like yours. I'll send over a link to the relevant API docs section with example requests so you can wire this into your weekly pipeline job.

subject: Change request: increase upload timeout for large file transfers
body:
We've been seeing consistent upload failures in Storage when transferring files larger than roughly 2GB. The upload progresses to about 80% and then fails with a connection timeout, happening across multiple users and file types over the past week. Smaller files under 500MB upload without issue.

Could we request an increase to the upload timeout threshold for our account, or is there a recommended chunked upload method we should switch to instead? We need a reliable way to move these larger backup archives.
answer: Thanks for the clear breakdown. For files over 2GB, we'd recommend switching to our chunked upload API rather than requesting a timeout increase, since single-request uploads of that size are prone to exactly this kind of failure on longer network paths. I'll send over the chunked upload documentation and sample code, and we can also review your account's timeout settings in parallel to see if a modest increase makes sense as a stopgap.

subject: Mapping SAML group claims to Northwind roles
body: We're integrating Northwind Identity SSO for Quill Partners using SAML with our IdP. I can see the group claims coming through in the assertion, but I can't find a way to automatically map those groups to Northwind roles during provisioning - right now every new user lands with the default Viewer role and we have to change it manually. Is there a role-mapping feature or an API endpoint we can call at provisioning time to set this based on the SAML attribute?
answer: Thanks for the detailed description. Automatic role mapping from SAML group claims isn't available in the Starter tier yet, but you can approximate it today by calling the user update endpoint right after provisioning to set the role based on the group attribute in your IdP's assertion. I'll also flag this as a feature request for native group-to-role mapping and let you know if it lands on the roadmap.

subject: URGENT: card charges failing for all 3 seats, renewal blocked
body: Our renewal for Quill Robotics failed this morning and now the account shows a payment overdue banner. We tried updating the card on file twice and both attempts return 'card_declined - do_not_honor' even though the same card works fine elsewhere. Invoice INV-30217 is stuck unpaid and I'm worried the account will be suspended before we can sort this out with our bank. Can someone check what's happening on your end?
answer: I'm sorry for the disruption this is causing - I've flagged your account so it won't be suspended while we sort this out. The decline code you're seeing usually comes from the issuing bank rather than our processor, but I'm opening a ticket with our payments team to confirm nothing on our side is rejecting the charge. In the meantime, could you try adding a backup card so we can process the renewal and avoid any service interruption?

subject: Alerts routed to full company list instead of region groups
body: We noticed that alerts configured for our regional distribution lists are instead going out to the entire company list, duplicating notifications for everyone at Delta Media. This started after we reorganized our alert rules last week. It's not blocking anyone's work, but the volume of duplicate emails is generating complaints from staff who aren't part of the intended region.
answer: Thanks for flagging this - since there's a workaround (staff can filter or mute the extra emails for now) we've logged it as a lower-priority issue. We'll review your alert routing rules to see why the region groups aren't being respected and get back to you with findings before making any changes to your live configuration.

subject: Biometric login failing after latest app update
body: Since pushing the newest Northwind Mobile App update to our fleet of devices, a large number of Blue Retail warehouse staff report that Face ID and fingerprint login no longer works - it just spins and then drops back to the password screen. We're seeing this on both iOS 17 and recent Android builds. A handful of users also reported the app crashing right after a failed biometric attempt.
answer: Thanks for the report, this sounds like a regression tied to the latest release. Could you send us the exact app version and a couple of device models/OS versions affected, along with a crash log if you have one? We're treating this as a priority fix given the scale of your deployment and will keep you updated as we investigate.

subject: Charts showing blank after refresh on shared dashboards
body: Several of our shared dashboards at Orion Energy are rendering blank panels after a refresh, even though the underlying data source is fine when I query it directly. This is happening on the 'Weekly Ad Performance' dashboard specifically, and it's shared with three other team members who see the same empty charts. Reloading the page sometimes fixes it, sometimes not.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. This looks like it could be related to a caching issue on shared dashboard views rather than the data itself. Could you send us the dashboard ID for 'Weekly Ad Performance' and let us know roughly when the blank state occurs relative to the refresh? We'll dig into the caching layer for shared views in the meantime.

subject: Shared dashboard links returning 403 despite API permissions set
body: We're setting dashboard sharing permissions through the API for Pioneer Retail, granting view access to a group of external reviewers. The API call returns a success response, but when those reviewers open the share link they get a 403 error. Export via the API also fails with the same permission error even though our service account has the export scope enabled.
answer: Thanks for the clear repro details - this looks like the permission grant isn't propagating correctly to the share link layer, which would explain both the viewer 403s and the export failures. I'm escalating this to our dashboards engineering team now given it affects your shared reviewer access. Could you send the dashboard ID and the API request payload you're using so we can trace it directly?

subject: Plan upgrade to Pro failed but invoice was still generated
body: We tried upgrading Granite Energy from Starter to Pro this morning to add more seats, and the checkout completed with a confirmation invoice (INV-51190), but our account still shows Starter plan limits and we can't add the extra seats we need. Support access is blocking our team from onboarding two new hires today. This needs to be fixed as soon as possible.
answer: Apologies for the trouble this is causing - I'm escalating this immediately since it's blocking your team from onboarding. It looks like the plan change didn't sync after the invoice was generated. We're manually verifying the upgrade on our end now and will confirm once your account reflects the Pro plan and seat limit so you can add your new hires.

subject: Refund credit missing from invoice - CREDIT_REF_NOT_FOUND error
body:
We've been using Northwind Billing since March for our 7 seats on the Starter plan, and our finance team reconciles invoices monthly. Everything was fine until this cycle - we downgraded two seats mid-month and were told we'd receive a prorated credit.

Yesterday we got an email confirming a $184.50 credit, but it never appeared on our balance or the next invoice. When I tried to view the credit in the billing portal I got this:

Error: CreditApplicationFailed
  at applyCredit (billing-core.js:342)
  at processInvoice (invoice-service.js:118)
Code: CREDIT_REF_NOT_FOUND
Invoice: INV-88213
Timestamp: 2024-05-14T09:22:11Z

We need this fixed before our next billing cycle on the 20th since it affects our budget reporting.
answer: Thank you for including the error details, that's very helpful. The CREDIT_REF_NOT_FOUND error indicates the credit was generated but never linked to invoice INV-88213 correctly, which is why it's not showing in your portal. We're escalating this to billing engineering right away and will manually apply the $184.50 credit to your account so it's reflected before your cycle closes on the 20th.

subject: Daily digest emails being sent twice to all users
body: Starting Tuesday, our team at Delta Systems has been receiving every daily digest email twice, roughly 15 minutes apart, with identical content. This is happening across multiple teams and generating a lot of confusion and help desk tickets internally. We haven't changed any of our notification settings recently.
answer: Thanks for reporting this - given the scale of your organization we're treating the duplicate digest sends as a priority issue. It looks like a scheduling job may be firing twice for some digest groups. We're investigating the digest scheduler now and will update you as soon as we identify the cause and confirm a fix.

subject: Unsubscribe link not working - users still receiving emails after opt-out
body: Multiple users at Granite Retail have clicked the unsubscribe link in Northwind notification emails and confirmed the opt-out page, but they're still receiving alert emails days later. As a fintech company this is a compliance concern for us, and we need this fixed urgently since it affects trust with our own customers who rely on us to honor opt-outs.
answer: This is being treated as a high priority issue given the compliance impact. It sounds like the unsubscribe token may not be updating the notification preference correctly on our backend. We're escalating this to engineering right now to trace the opt-out flow and will follow up with a fix timeline as soon as we have one - in the meantime we can manually suppress the affected addresses if you can share a list.

subject: Charts not rendering correctly after PDF export
body:
I'm the product manager reviewing our weekly energy consumption dashboards and noticed that the line charts on the 'Regional Load' dashboard render fine on screen but appear blank or truncated when exported to PDF. This started around March 4th and affects all 6 charts on that dashboard, not just one. We rely on these exports for our Monday leadership meeting, so this is becoming a real bottleneck.

Could you also let us know if there's a way to control the export resolution? The screenshots we're getting are quite low quality compared to the live view.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. We've seen a rendering issue affecting PDF exports for line and area charts when a dashboard has more than 4 visualizations on one page, and your case matches that pattern. I'm escalating this to our dashboards engineering team as a P2 bug and will update you within 2 business days with a fix timeline or workaround. In the meantime, exporting each chart individually to PNG should give you higher resolution output for your meeting.

subject: App crashes repeatedly when switching to offline mode
body:
Our field staff use the mobile app to log inspection data while offline, but since the last update the app crashes almost immediately after we toggle airplane mode on. This is happening on both Android and iOS devices across our team of 6, and we've lost several hours of unsynced entries as a result. Push notifications also seem to fire twice once we reconnect.

We need this fixed urgently since our staff are in the field daily and can't rely on stable connectivity.
answer: I'm very sorry for the disruption this is causing your field team, and I understand the urgency given your reliance on offline logging. This matches a regression we're tracking related to local cache initialization when connectivity drops mid-session. I'm marking this P1 and looping in mobile engineering right now; we'll send a hotfix build or workaround steps within 24 hours, and I'll personally follow up with you once it's available.

subject: Unable to complete plan upgrade from Starter to Pro
body:
I've been trying to upgrade our account from the Starter plan to Pro since yesterday to add two more seats for our growing team, but every time I confirm the upgrade on the billing page it spins for a while and then shows 'Something went wrong processing your request.' No new invoice has been generated and our card hasn't been charged, but we're stuck on Starter and can't add the seats we need this week.

Can someone process this upgrade manually or tell us what's blocking it?
answer: Thanks for flagging this right away. We've identified an issue affecting upgrade attempts for a subset of Starter accounts tied to a billing sync delay, and your account is one of them. I'm processing the upgrade to Pro with the additional seats manually on our end now and will confirm once it's live, which should be within the next couple of hours. You'll receive a corrected invoice reflecting the new seat count once the change is applied.

subject: Scheduled sync from our SIS connector running hours late
body:
Our nightly sync pulling enrollment data through the SIS connector has been running 3-4 hours later than its scheduled 1am window since last Tuesday, and on two occasions it didn't complete at all before the next sync was queued. This is causing stale attendance data to show in downstream reports our department heads check each morning.

Could you check the connector logs on your end? Job IDs from the last three delayed runs are sync-88213, sync-88240, and sync-88266.
answer: Thank you for including those job IDs, that helps us narrow this down quickly. We're seeing elevated latency on that connector's upstream data source starting the same date you mentioned, which is likely causing the queue backlog and the skipped run. I've flagged this to our pipelines team as P2 and we're working on either increasing the timeout window or adding retry logic; I'll update this ticket once we have a fix or a recommended interim schedule change.

subject: Warnung wegen bevorstehender API-Deprecation betrifft unsere Integration
body:
Ich integriere gerade die Northwind API in unsere Lernplattform und habe heute Morgen eine Warnung im Dashboard gesehen, dass der Endpoint /v1/users/bulk zum 30. April abgeschaltet wird. Unser Sync-Service nutzt diesen Endpoint täglich für rund 22 Nutzerkonten, und ich finde in der aktuellen SDK-Dokumentation keinen klaren Hinweis auf den Ersatz-Endpoint.

Könnt ihr mir sagen, welcher Endpoint stattdessen verwendet werden soll und ob es einen Migrationsleitfaden für das SDK gibt?
answer: Danke für die Rückfrage und dafür, dass Sie das so früh ansprechen. Der Endpoint /v1/users/bulk wird durch /v2/users/batch ersetzt, der eine ähnliche Payload-Struktur nutzt, aber zusätzlich Pagination unterstützt. Ein Migrationsleitfaden inklusive Codebeispielen für das aktuelle SDK ist in Arbeit und wird diese Woche veröffentlicht; ich schicke Ihnen den Link, sobald er live ist, und stehe gerne für Fragen zur Migration zur Verfügung.

subject: help
body: We're rolling out MFA to all 204 seats but the enrollment link we send new users just spins on 'Verifying setup' and never completes. It's blocking about 40 people from logging in today. We need a fix or workaround fast since this is holding up onboarding for a whole regional team.
answer: I understand this is blocking onboarding for a large group and we're treating it as a priority issue. This looks related to a delay in the MFA verification service for bulk enrollments; as an immediate workaround, please have affected users retry enrollment using the authenticator app method instead of SMS, which is unaffected. I'm also checking the enrollment queue on our end for your account and will confirm once the SMS path is restored, likely within a few hours.

subject: Users getting logged out every 15 minutes since Tuesday
body:
I'm integrating our internal tools with Northwind SSO, and since Tuesday our users have been getting force-logged-out roughly every 15 minutes instead of the expected 8-hour session window we configured. This is happening across our org of 142 seats and is generating a steady stream of support requests internally. I checked our SSO app settings and the session timeout value still shows 480 minutes, so nothing changed on our side.

Can you check if something changed with session token expiry on your end recently?
answer: Thanks for the clear timeline, that lines up with a token expiry configuration issue we introduced during a recent SSO service update, which caused some tenants' session lifetimes to revert to a default value. I'm applying a fix to restore your configured 480-minute session window now and will confirm once it's verified against your tenant. Apologies for the disruption this caused across your team this week.

subject: Session timing out every few minutes after MFA login
body: Since this morning, whenever I log in with MFA I get kicked back to the login screen after only a couple of minutes of inactivity, even though I'm actively working in the billing section. This is happening on both Chrome and Firefox on my laptop. Our finance team only has 9 seats total, but this is slowing down our month-end close process significantly.
answer: I'm sorry for the interruption during your month-end close. This matches a known issue where MFA-authenticated sessions are picking up a shortened default timeout instead of your account's configured session length. I'm correcting the session policy on your tenant now and will ask you to log out and back in once complete so the new setting takes effect; I'll confirm here within the hour once it's resolved.

subject: Getting duplicate email alerts for the same shipment delay event
body:
Our dispatch team has been receiving two identical email notifications for every shipment delay alert since last week, both timestamped within a second of each other. We've confirmed there's only one alerting rule set up for this event type. This is causing confusion since some staff think there are two separate delays and start escalating unnecessarily.

Could you check why the notification is firing twice for a single trigger event?
answer: Thanks for the clear description, this helps a lot. We've identified a duplicate delivery issue affecting a subset of email notification channels where the retry mechanism resent alerts even after successful delivery, and it appears your account is affected. I'm applying a fix to deduplicate these sends and will monitor your account's alert delivery over the next 24 hours to confirm the issue is resolved.

subject: Best practice for rotating API keys without downtime
body:
I'm integrating our order management system with the Northwind API and need to rotate our production API key soon since it's been active for over a year. I don't see a clear process in the docs for rotating keys without causing a gap in service for our webhook listeners. We're processing a high volume of order events daily across our travel booking pipeline, so any downtime would be noticeable.

Is there a way to generate a second active key temporarily so we can switch traffic over gradually before revoking the old one?
answer: Good question, and yes, this is supported. You can generate a secondary API key from the API Platform settings page, which will run active in parallel with your existing key for up to 30 days. I'd recommend updating your webhook listener configuration to use the new key first, verifying event delivery for a day or two, and then revoking the old key from the same page. I'll also send over our key rotation guide, which covers rate limit behavior during the overlap period.

subject: Unauthorized access to workspace settings - possible breach
body:
We just noticed that our workspace settings for Quill Partners were changed overnight - the allowlist was wiped and two new admin accounts appeared that none of us created. This happened between 11pm and 3am last night. We need to know immediately if this is a breach on Northwind's side or if our account was compromised.

Our audit log shows changes from an IP address we don't recognize, 185.220.101.44, and the console has been sluggish since. Please treat this as urgent - we have student data tied to this workspace.
answer: This has been escalated to our security team immediately and we are treating it as a P0 incident. We've temporarily locked the workspace's admin permissions and are pulling the full audit trail for the IP address and time window you mentioned. We'll be in direct contact within the hour with findings and next steps to secure the account, including forcing password resets for all admins.

subject: Charts completely broken after last update - fix this
body:
Our revenue dashboards have been showing blank charts since yesterday's update and I've had three regional managers email me asking why the quarterly sales widgets are just empty boxes. We rely on these for our morning standups across 2,107 seats and this is completely unacceptable.

Exporting to PDF also throws an error now - 'Export failed: rendering timeout' - and sharing a dashboard link just shows a spinner forever. This is the third time in two months something like this has broken. If this isn't fixed soon we're going to seriously reconsider our contract with Northwind.
answer: I'm sorry for the disruption this is causing across your team. We're aware of a rendering regression affecting chart widgets and export functionality after the recent release, and our engineering team is actively working on a fix. As a workaround, switching the dashboard view to 'legacy render' in settings should restore visibility while we finalize the patch, and I'll update this ticket as soon as we have a confirmed timeline.

subject: Scheduled syncs failing for connector to warehouse
body:
Since Tuesday our nightly scheduled sync from the SQL connector to our data warehouse has been failing intermittently - out of 6 scheduled runs this week, 4 completed with partial data and 2 failed outright with a 'connector timeout after 300s' error. This is causing our energy consumption reports to be a day or two stale, which our operations team relies on for daily forecasting.

We have 91 seats connected to this pipeline and several downstream dashboards are now showing inconsistent numbers. Can someone check if there's a known issue with the connector or if we need to adjust our sync window?
answer: Thanks for flagging this with the specific run counts, that's very helpful. We're seeing elevated timeout rates on that connector type in your region starting Tuesday, likely tied to a backend capacity issue we're currently investigating as P1. In the meantime, I'd recommend narrowing your sync window or splitting the job into smaller batches to reduce timeout risk, and I'll follow up as soon as we have root cause confirmed.

subject: Audit log missing entries after admin deactivation
body:
We deactivated a former employee's admin account last Friday and now our audit log shows a gap - there are no entries at all between Friday 2pm and Monday 9am, even though we know at least two settings changes happened during that window based on our internal change tracker. This is a compliance problem for us since we need a complete audit trail.

We also can't find any option to re-enable logging retroactively or export what data we do have. Our workspace has 7 seats and this is the only admin console issue we've had, but it's a serious one given the missing records.
answer: Thank you for the detailed timeline - I understand why this gap is concerning from a compliance standpoint. We're treating this as a P1 issue and our engineering team is checking whether the logging service experienced a disruption during that window or if the deactivation process itself caused entries to be dropped. I'll update you within the day with findings, and in the meantime please avoid further admin changes on this account until we confirm the audit trail is intact.

subject: Chart rendering issues on legal case dashboards
body:
I'm a support engineer on our side and I've been getting reports from our legal team that several bar charts on the case-tracking dashboard are rendering with overlapping labels, making the data unreadable. This started after we added a new filter group last week, and it affects the export-to-CSV output too - the exported file has blank columns where the chart legend should map values.

We have 208 seats using this dashboard daily. Could someone take a look at whether this is a known rendering bug with filter groups, or if we've misconfigured something?
answer: Thanks for the detailed description - overlapping labels combined with blank export columns points to a known issue with how filter groups interact with chart legends in certain layouts. I'd like to take a look at the specific dashboard, so could you share the dashboard ID or a screenshot of the affected chart? In the meantime, removing the newest filter group and re-adding it individually has resolved this for other customers while we work on a permanent fix.

subject: Need help configuring Okta app for SSO with Slack and Jira
body:
I'm trying to set up the Okta integration so our team can single-sign-on into Northwind and have that same session carry over to our connected Slack and Jira apps, but I'm not finding clear documentation on whether Northwind's Okta app supports that kind of chained SSO. Right now users log into Okta, then still have to separately authenticate into Northwind's integrations panel.

We have 79 seats and are trying to streamline onboarding for new analysts. Is there a setting I'm missing, or is this simply not supported yet for the Salesforce and Jira connectors?
answer: Chained SSO across Slack and Jira through the Okta app isn't automatic out of the box, but it can be configured by setting Northwind as the identity provider for those connected apps within your Okta admin console rather than relying on Northwind to propagate the session. I'll send over a step-by-step guide for linking the Salesforce and Jira connectors to the same Okta app instance, which should eliminate the second login prompt for your analysts.

subject: Question about Okta app documentation for Jira connector
body:
I've been reviewing the integration docs for setting up our Okta app alongside the Jira connector and noticed the documentation references a 'scope mapping' step that doesn't match what I'm seeing in our admin panel - there's no scope mapping section under Integrations for us. We're a small team of 18 seats and I want to make sure I'm not missing a feature that's only available on higher plans.

Could you clarify whether scope mapping is a Starter-tier limitation or if the docs are just outdated?
answer: Good catch - the scope mapping step referenced in that doc section is actually specific to Enterprise-tier Okta configurations and isn't available on Starter plans, so the docs should have noted that distinction. I'll flag this to our documentation team to get it corrected, and in the meantime your Jira connector setup should work fine without that step since it defaults to standard OAuth scopes.

subject: Zapier integration not triggering Slack notifications
body:
Our Zapier zap that's supposed to post a Slack message whenever a new invoice is generated in Northwind has stopped triggering as of this morning. We rely on this to alert our finance team in real time, and it's been silent since around 8am today despite invoices clearly being created - I've confirmed three new invoices went out with no corresponding Slack posts.

We checked the Zapier dashboard and it shows the trigger step timing out with 'No response from Northwind webhook after 30s'. Our whole finance workflow across 66 seats depends on this, so we need this resolved quickly.
answer: This looks like it's related to a webhook delivery delay we're currently investigating on our end, and I'm escalating this to P1 given the impact on your finance workflow. As a temporary workaround, you can switch the Zapier trigger to polling mode instead of webhook mode, which should catch the missed invoices and resume near-real-time notifications while we resolve the underlying webhook issue. I'll update you as soon as we have a fix deployed.

subject: Biometric login crashing app on multiple devices
body:
Since updating the mobile app yesterday, biometric login is crashing the app immediately on both iOS and Android devices for our team - it worked fine before the update. The app opens, shows the fingerprint prompt, and then crashes to the home screen without any error message. We've had at least 6 staff members across our 20 seats report the same crash this morning.

Users can't get in at all since falling back to password login also seems to trigger the same crash on the same login screen. This is blocking our entire team from accessing the app during school hours, which is critical for us.
answer: I'm sorry for the disruption - this sounds like a serious regression tied to the latest app update, and I'm escalating it as P1 immediately. Our team is investigating the crash on the biometric and fallback login screens right now; in the meantime, could you have affected users try clearing the app cache and reinstalling the latest version, as some early reports suggest this restores login functionality. I'll update this ticket as soon as we have a confirmed fix or rollback.

subject: Fehlgeschlagene Kartenzahlungen und Frage zu Erstattungen
body:
Wir integrieren die Northwind Billing API in unser System und stellen seit letzter Woche gehäuft fehlgeschlagene Kartenzahlungen fest, obwohl die Karten laut unseren Kunden gültig sind. Der Fehlercode lautet meist 'card_declined_generic' bei etwa 40 Transaktionen seit dem 10. dieses Monats.

Zusätzlich möchte ich fragen, ob es eine API-Funktion gibt, um Teilerstattungen programmatisch auszulösen, da wir aktuell alles manuell im Dashboard machen müssen. Gibt es dafür bereits einen Endpoint oder ist das für die Zukunft geplant?
answer: Vielen Dank für die genauen Angaben zu den fehlgeschlagenen Transaktionen - wir prüfen aktuell, ob es ein Problem mit unserem Zahlungsabwickler gibt, das die generischen Ablehnungen seit dem 10. verursacht, und melden uns mit Details dazu zurück. Zur zweiten Frage: einen Endpoint für programmatische Teilerstattungen gibt es derzeit noch nicht, dies steht jedoch auf unserer Roadmap, und ich leite Ihr Interesse gerne an unser Produktteam weiter.

subject: Invoice showing wrong plan tier after API pull
body: We integrated the Billing API last week to sync invoice data into our internal ledger, and I noticed invoice INV-2024-1187 dated March 3 lists us on the Growth plan instead of Starter. That's inflating the total by roughly $60. We're only on 8 seats under Starter. Could you correct the invoice and issue a refund for the difference?
answer: Thanks for flagging this, we'll pull up INV-2024-1187 and verify the plan tier against your account settings. If it was mis-tagged during a recent sync, we'll correct the invoice and process a refund for the overcharge within 3-5 business days. I'll follow up here once that's confirmed.

subject: Deactivated users still showing
body: Deactivated 40 users last week, still active in audit log.
answer: Thanks for the heads up, this looks like a sync delay between the deactivation action and the audit log indexer. We're checking your account now to confirm which of the 40 accounts are still flagged as active and will push a manual refresh. We'll update you shortly with confirmation that access has been fully revoked.

subject: APP CRASHES IMMEDIATELY ON LAUNCH FOR ALL STUDENTS
body: THE MOBILE APP IS CRASHING ON LAUNCH FOR EVERY STUDENT DEVICE SINCE THIS MORNING. WE HAVE 25 SEATS AND NONE OF THEM CAN OPEN THE APP, EVEN IN OFFLINE MODE. PUSH NOTIFICATIONS ARE ALSO NOT COMING THROUGH. THIS IS BLOCKING OUR CLASSES RIGHT NOW, PLEASE ESCALATE THIS IMMEDIATELY.
answer: We understand this is blocking your classes and have escalated it to our mobile engineering team as a top priority. Can you confirm the app version and device OS versions affected? In the meantime, please try clearing the app cache and reinstalling, as this has resolved similar launch crashes tied to a recent push notification token update. We'll keep you posted as we investigate.

subject: How to adjust scheduled sync frequency for connectors
body: We currently run our retail inventory sync every 6 hours through the Salesforce connector, but we're seeing stale data during peak sales hours. Is there a way to set a custom sync interval per connector, or trigger syncs based on data volume thresholds instead of a fixed schedule? We manage 265 seats and this affects reporting accuracy across multiple stores.
answer: Good question, right now sync intervals are configurable per connector down to 15-minute increments from the pipeline settings page, though threshold-based triggers aren't available yet. I'd recommend tightening your Salesforce connector to a 30-minute interval during peak hours as a workaround. I've also logged your request for volume-based triggers with our product team for consideration in an upcoming release.

subject: Uploads schlagen fehl seit heute Morgen
body: Seit heute morgen bekomen wir bei fast jedem Upload einen Fehler 'quota exceeded', obwohl wir laut Dashbord noch unter unserem Limit sind. Wir haben ca. 40 Dateien versucht hochzuladen und nur 5 sind durchgegangen. Können sie bitte prüfen ob es ein Bug mit der Quota-Berechnung gibt? Wir brauchen auch info zur Aufbewahrungsfrist für ältere Dateien.
answer: Danke für die Meldung, das klingt nach einem Berechnungsfehler zwischen dem Dashboard-Anzeigewert und dem tatsächlichen Quota-Zähler. Wir prüfen gerade Ihr Konto und die letzten Upload-Versuche, um die Diskrepanz zu identifizieren. Zur Aufbewahrungsfrist senden wir Ihnen im Anschluss die aktuelle Dokumentation, sobald das Quota-Problem behoben ist.

subject: MFA enrollment stuck for new employees
body: We're rolling out MFA enforcement across our 293 seats, but several newly provisioned users are stuck at the enrollment screen with a 'verification code expired' message even when entering it within the time limit. This is happening on both the authenticator app and SMS methods. Can you check if there's a clock sync or provisioning delay causing this?
answer: Thanks for the details, this pattern usually points to a delay between account provisioning and MFA policy propagation, which can cause the enrollment token to expire before the user's session catches up. We're reviewing the affected accounts now and will send you a list of users who need re-provisioning. In the meantime, having them wait 5 minutes after account creation before enrolling should avoid the expired code issue.

subject: SAML login failing for finance team since this morning
body: Since around 8am today, several members of our finance team have been unable to log in via SAML SSO, getting an 'Invalid SAML Response' error right after redirect from our identity provider. This is affecting at least a dozen users out of our 134 seats and is blocking access to billing reports we need for month-end close. Nothing changed on our IdP configuration recently.
answer: Thank you for the report, we're treating this as an active incident and are checking recent changes on our SAML endpoint that could be causing the response validation to fail. Can you send us a timestamp and one affected user's identifier so we can trace the exact SAML assertion in our logs? We'll update you as soon as we have a root cause or workaround.

subject: Custom role mapping not syncing from IdP groups
body: We've set up group-based role mapping so that our IdP groups automatically assign the correct permission tiers in Northwind, but new members added to the 'Ops-Managers' group aren't getting the corresponding admin role after login. This is affecting a handful of users across our 178 seats. Is there a delay in the mapping sync, or do we need to reconfigure the attribute mapping?
answer: Thanks for flagging this, group-to-role mapping sync typically happens on next login, but if it's failing entirely there may be a mismatch in the attribute name expected versus what your IdP is sending. Could you share a screenshot of your current attribute mapping configuration? We'll compare it against the expected schema and get back to you with the fix or a corrected mapping template.

subject: URGENT RETENTION POLICY QUESTION BEFORE FILES ARE DELETED
body: WE JUST NOTICED OUR STORAGE RETENTION POLICY IS SET TO 30 DAYS AND WE HAVE FINANCIAL BACKUP FILES FROM LAST QUARTER THAT ARE ABOUT TO BE PURGED. WE NEED THESE FOR AN AUDIT NEXT WEEK. HOW DO WE EXTEND RETENTION OR PAUSE DELETION BEFORE IT HAPPENS? WE ARE ON THE STARTER PLAN WITH 9 SEATS AND CANNOT LOSE THESE FILES.
answer: We're treating this urgently. Please do not modify the retention settings yourself, as that can trigger an immediate policy re-evaluation. We're pausing the scheduled purge on your account right now while we confirm which files are at risk, and will follow up within the hour with steps to either extend retention or move the audit files into long-term storage before the window closes.

subject: Need to restrict admin console access to office IP range

subject: Duplicate unsubscribe entries in Notifications API
