subject: Need list of upcoming API deprecations affecting our integration
body:
I'm doing a review of our integration at Lumen Freight ahead of Q3 and want to make sure we're not relying on any endpoints or SDK methods that are being deprecated. We currently use the v2 webhook subscriptions endpoint and the Python SDK's legacy rate-limit headers for backoff logic.

Could you point us to the current deprecation timeline, and confirm whether the v2 webhook format will still be supported by end of year? We'd rather migrate proactively than get caught off guard.
answer: Glad you're planning ahead on this — the v2 webhook subscriptions endpoint is indeed on our deprecation roadmap, with a sunset planned for early next year, and legacy rate-limit headers are being replaced by the newer X-RateLimit-* set in SDK v3. I'll send over our current deprecation timeline doc which covers both, along with migration notes for the SDK's backoff logic, so your team can plan the cutover without disruption.

subject: Getting SDK error when calling webhook registration endpoint
body:
I'm using the Northwind Python SDK (version 3.4.0) to register a new webhook subscription, and calls to client.webhooks.create() are failing with 'AttributeError: module has no attribute WebhookConfig'. This started after I upgraded the SDK from 3.2.0 yesterday following the changelog notes.

I checked the docs page for webhook registration but it still references the old WebhookConfig class, so I'm not sure if this is a docs lag or an actual breaking change in 3.4.0 at North Systems.
answer: Thanks for including the version details — this does look like a naming change introduced in SDK 3.4.0 where WebhookConfig was renamed to WebhookSubscriptionConfig as part of our webhook API updates, and you're right that the docs page hasn't been updated to reflect it yet. We'll get that page corrected shortly; in the meantime, updating your import to use WebhookSubscriptionConfig should resolve the AttributeError.

subject: Storage quota
body: Hit our storage quota again, backups failing tonight. Please bump it up.
answer: Thanks for flagging this right away. I've temporarily raised the Lumen Works storage quota by 20% to unblock tonight's backups, and I'm looking into a longer-term quota increase or retention policy change for your account. I'll follow up within the hour with options.

subject: Dashboards taking 30+ seconds to load since Tuesday
body: Since Tuesday our main operations dashboard has been extremely slow to load, sometimes over 30 seconds, and chart exports are timing out entirely. We have around 40 people on the ops team relying on this daily and it's affecting our morning review meetings. The dashboard in question is the 'Regional Volume Overview' with about 12 charts pulling from three data sources. Sharing links to teammates also seem to hang on their end. Can someone take a look at what changed? We didn't add any new charts recently.
answer: Sorry for the disruption this is causing your team's daily reviews. We've identified a query bottleneck affecting dashboards with multiple chart sources like your Regional Volume Overview, and our engineering team is actively working on a fix. In the meantime, splitting the dashboard into two smaller views should reduce load times significantly — happy to help you set that up if useful. I'll update you within a few hours with progress.

subject: Audit log missing entries for user deactivations
body: We're reviewing our admin audit log ahead of a compliance check and noticed that several user deactivations from last week aren't showing up. Specifically, we deactivated three accounts on March 4th tied to our IP allowlist cleanup, but the audit log only shows two entries and neither has a timestamp matching what we expect. Can you confirm whether deactivation events are supposed to be logged automatically, and if there's a way to pull a complete history for our account?
answer: Good catch, and thanks for the specific dates. Deactivation events should log automatically, so a gap like this suggests either a display issue or an indexing delay on our end. I'm pulling the raw event history for your account now to reconcile the missing March 4th entries and will send you a corrected export along with an explanation of what happened.

subject: Pipeline sync delayed 6+ hours, connector may be stuck
body: Our legal-records pipeline connector (connector ID conn-8841) has been sending data 6+ hours late since this morning, and as of now we have zero new records synced since 03:15 UTC. This is a production issue for us since downstream case filings depend on same-day data availability, and we're already getting escalations internally. We haven't changed any credentials or endpoint configs on our side. Can someone check if the connector is stuck or if there's an upstream sync failure on Northwind's side?
answer: This is being treated as a P0 and I've escalated it to our pipeline on-call engineer immediately. Initial checks show connector conn-8841 is showing repeated retry failures starting at 03:15 UTC, consistent with what you're seeing. We're investigating the root cause now and will have an update with either a fix or a clear ETA within 30 minutes.

subject: IP allowlist not blocking outside addresses
body: We set up an IP allowlist in the Admin Console last week to restrict access to our office network only, but I just noticed a login from an IP outside that range in our access logs, dated this morning. We only have 3 seats on this account so it's easy to spot anomalies, and this one shouldn't have been allowed through. Can you check whether the allowlist is actually being enforced? I want to make sure this isn't a security gap before we rely on it further.
answer: Thank you for reporting this with the exact detail — this needs a closer look before we can rule out an enforcement issue. I'm reviewing your allowlist configuration and the specific login event now to determine whether the rule was misconfigured or if there's a bug on our side. I'll have a definitive answer for you within the next few hours given the security implications.

subject: Doppelte E-Mail-Digests werden verschickt
body: Seit letzter Woche erhalten mehrere unserer Nutzer die täglichen E-Mail-Digests doppelt, teilweise sogar dreifach innerhalb von wenigen Minuten. Das betrifft besonders die Kundenservice-Gruppe mit rund 40 Empfängern. Wir haben keine Änderungen an den Benachrichtigungseinstellungen vorgenommen. Könnt ihr prüfen, ob es ein Problem mit der Digest-Warteschlange gibt? Es ist kein kritisches Problem, aber es sorgt für Verwirrung bei den Nutzern.
answer: Danke für die Meldung. Das klingt nach einem Problem mit der Digest-Warteschlange, das zu doppelten Auslieferungen führt. Wir schauen uns die betroffene Nutzergruppe an und prüfen die Zustellprotokolle der letzten Woche, um die Ursache einzugrenzen. Da es sich nicht um ein kritisches Problem handelt, melden wir uns mit einem Update, sobald wir mehr wissen.

subject: Salesforce integration sync request and Slack notifications
body: We're setting up the Salesforce integration for our support team and want to confirm two things before rolling it out to all 273 seats. First, can sync frequency be set below the default 15-minute interval? Second, we'd like sync failure alerts to post to a Slack channel instead of just email — is that supported natively or would we need a workaround? Also, if there's updated documentation on field mapping between Salesforce cases and Northwind tickets, that would help our admin team a lot.
answer: Happy to help you get this configured properly before the wider rollout. Sync frequency can be adjusted down to 5-minute intervals in the integration settings, and Slack alerting for sync failures is supported via our webhook connector — I'll send you the setup guide for that shortly. I'm also attaching our current field-mapping documentation for Salesforce cases, and will flag your feedback about clearer defaults to our docs team.

subject: Mobile app crashes immediately on launch after update
body: Our mobile app started crashing on launch right after updating to the latest version last week. It happens on both iOS and Android for a few of our finance team members, though not everyone is affected. The app opens for about a second, shows the login screen, then closes without any error message. We rely on the offline expense approval feature while traveling, so this is becoming a real inconvenience for the team. Is this a known issue with the latest release?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. We've had a couple of similar reports tied to the latest release and are looking into whether it's related to cached login sessions or the offline data sync module. As a workaround, could you have the affected team members try clearing the app cache or reinstalling? I'll keep you posted once we confirm the root cause and have a fix timeline.

subject: API keys hitting rate limits after key rotation
body: We rotated our API keys on March 2nd as part of routine security hygiene, and since then we're seeing HTTP 429 responses much more frequently than before, even though our request volume hasn't changed. Our analytics pipeline calls the /v2/metrics endpoint roughly 4,000 times per hour, and we're now getting rate-limited around 2,800 requests in. Is there a different rate limit tier tied to the new keys, or could this be related to the API v1 deprecation notice we received? We'd like to understand before we scale further.
answer: Thanks for the specifics — that's helpful for tracing this quickly. New keys generated after March 1st are provisioned under our updated rate-limit tiers, which for Enterprise accounts should be higher, not lower, so this looks like a misconfiguration on our side rather than expected behavior. I'm checking your account's tier assignment now and will follow up with either a corrected limit or an explanation within the day.

subject: Widespread upload failures across the account
body: Starting around 9:40 AM today, uploads are failing account-wide with the error 'Upload rejected: storage allocation exceeded' even though our dashboard shows we're only at 78% of our storage quota. This is affecting all 282 seats and blocking document intake for our legal teams, which is a serious problem given case deadlines this week. Nothing changed on our end — no bulk uploads, no new retention policy edits. Can someone investigate urgently?
answer: This is being escalated immediately given the account-wide impact. The mismatch between your reported quota usage and the rejection error suggests a sync issue between our billing and storage services, and our infrastructure team is investigating now. We'll provide an update within the hour, and in the meantime we're working on a temporary override to unblock uploads for your legal teams.

subject: Slack alerts down
body: Slack integration stopped posting alerts today. Nothing since 9am.
answer: Thanks for flagging this — we're seeing reports of delayed Slack webhook delivery tied to a recent Okta token refresh issue. Our team is investigating now and we'll update this ticket within the hour with a fix or workaround.

subject: User deactivation not reflecting in audit log
body: I deactivated three users this morning (IDs ending 8841, 8842, and 8850) through the Admin Console after their contracts ended, but the audit log still shows them as active with no deactivation event recorded. This is a problem for our quarterly compliance review since we need a clean trail of access changes. Can someone confirm whether the deactivation actually took effect on the backend, even though the UI shows them as inactive now? I want to make sure they can't log in and that the audit log gets corrected.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. We can confirm the deactivation itself did take effect for those three accounts — this looks like a logging delay in the audit trail rather than an access issue. We're pushing a backfill for the missing entries and will confirm here once your audit log reflects the correct timestamps, likely within the next few hours.

subject: SCIM provisioning failing for new employees
body: Since yesterday, new employees added in our HR system aren't syncing over via SCIM into Northwind. We've had 4 new hires stuck without accounts since Monday, and two existing users lost their MFA settings after a sync attempt. The SCIM job logs show a 'permission mismatch' error but no further detail. Given we only have 7 seats total, this is blocking onboarding for over half our new team this week. Can you check the SCIM connector logs on your end to see what's failing?
answer: Sorry for the disruption this is causing — we're looking into the SCIM permission mismatch now. Initial checks show a recent change to your Okta app scope may have dropped a required attribute mapping, which would explain both the failed provisioning and the MFA resets. We'll have a diagnosis and next steps for you within the next couple of hours.

subject: Request: granular sharing permissions for dashboards
body: We'd like the ability to share individual dashboards with specific external stakeholders without giving them access to our entire workspace. Right now sharing seems to be all-or-nothing at the workspace level, which doesn't work for us since we have manufacturing partners who only need to see one production dashboard. Is there a way to set per-dashboard sharing permissions, or is this on the roadmap? We're a small team (4 seats) but this comes up often with client-facing reports.
answer: Thanks for the suggestion — per-dashboard sharing permissions aren't available yet, but it's a feature we're actively scoping for a future release. As a workaround today, you can create a filtered view and share it via a scoped link, which limits visibility to that single dashboard. I'll add your use case to the feature request so you're notified if it ships.

subject: URGENT: Late-arriving data causing gaps in compliance reports
body: We run a nightly pipeline that pulls transaction data from our connector, and as of last night's run, records timestamped after 11:45pm are missing entirely from downstream tables — not delayed, just gone. This is affecting our compliance reporting for an audit due tomorrow morning, and we cannot tell if the data is queued somewhere or lost. We need immediate confirmation on whether this data can be recovered and why late-arriving records aren't being captured by the sync window.
answer: This has been escalated immediately as a potential data loss incident given the compliance deadline. We're pulling the pipeline run logs now to determine whether the late-arriving records are stuck in a dead-letter queue or were dropped at the connector level — initial signs point to a sync window boundary issue rather than permanent loss. We'll have a status update for you within the next 30 minutes and will prioritize recovery before your audit deadline.

subject: Restore from backup not completing
body: I initiated a restore from our storage backup dated March 3rd to recover a folder that was accidentally deleted, but the restore job has been stuck at 'in progress' for over 6 hours with no error message. Our retention policy is set to 30 days and I want to confirm the backup itself is intact before I try again. Can you check the status of restore job ID rst-2291 on your end and let me know if it's actually running or stalled?
answer: Thanks for the job ID — we checked rst-2291 and it appears stalled due to a backend queue issue rather than a problem with the backup itself, which is confirmed intact. We're restarting the restore process manually now and will notify you as soon as it completes; if it doesn't finish within the next hour we'll escalate to the storage infrastructure team.

subject: Deactivated employees still able to log in
body: We deactivated 12 employees on Friday after a round of layoffs, and two of them were able to log into the platform again this morning. The Admin Console shows their status as 'Deactivated' but access clearly wasn't revoked at the session level. This is a serious security concern given the circumstances of their departure. We need this fixed immediately and confirmation that all 12 accounts are actually locked out, along with an explanation of why the deactivation didn't fully take effect.
answer: This is a serious issue and we're treating it with urgency. We've confirmed a session-invalidation bug affecting deactivated accounts that were logged in at the time of deactivation — we're force-terminating all active sessions for the 12 accounts right now and will verify each one is fully locked out. We'll send you a confirmation list within the hour and a root cause summary once the fix is deployed.

subject: deactivation error on allowlist blocked users
body: trying to deactivate a former contractor but getting this error repeatedly, user is still showing active in the audit log POST /admin/v2/users/4471/deactivate 403 Forbidden { "error": "allowlist_conflict", "detail": "User email domain matches active allowlist entry, deactivation blocked", "request_id": "req_88ab3f9e" } not sure why an allowlist entry would block deactivation, this doesnt make sense to me, can someone explain and help me get this user removed
answer: Thanks for including the error and request ID. This is a known conflict — the allowlist rule is currently designed to prevent removal of domains flagged as protected, but it shouldn't block individual user deactivation, so this looks like a bug in how the check is scoped. We're reproducing it now with your request ID and will either patch the check or manually deactivate the account for you today.

subject: SCIM sync STILL broken after your last 'fix'
body: this is the second time im writing about this. u told us last week the scim provisioning issue was resolved but new users still arent syncing correctly, one persons role got wiped and they lost mfa access entirely. we have only 4 seats and this is wasting so much of our time every single week. honestly considering just doing manual user management going forward if this keeps happening, its ridiculous for a starter plan to have this much friction. can someone actually fix this properly this time instead of just closing the ticket
answer: I understand the frustration, especially after being told this was resolved previously — that's not the experience we want you to have. We're reopening the investigation with a focus on the MFA role-wipe specifically, since that suggests the sync is overwriting attributes rather than just failing silently. We'll dig into the connector logs for your workspace and get back to you with a concrete fix, not just a status update, by end of day tomorrow.

subject: How do we link Jira issues to Northwind Integrations for billing tracking?
body: Our finance team wants to link specific Jira issues to integration events in Northwind so we can track costs tied to engineering work triggered by API or Slack integration failures. We currently have Okta and Slack connected but haven't set up Jira yet. Is there documentation on setting up the Jira integration, and does it support linking issues to specific integration events for reporting purposes? This is fairly time-sensitive as we're closing out this quarter's budget review.
answer: Thanks for reaching out — yes, the Jira integration supports linking issues to specific integration events, and it can sit alongside your existing Okta and Slack connections without conflict. I'm sending over our setup guide now, and given your quarter-end timeline, I'll also flag this for a same-day walkthrough call if you'd like one to get it configured quickly.

subject: URGENT: Need immediate restore from backup - possible data breach
body:
We detected unauthorized access attempts on our storage bucket this morning around 6:40 AM and have since locked down credentials. We need to restore our primary data store to the snapshot from last night (Oct 14, 11:00 PM UTC) before the suspected breach occurred. Our storage quota is also showing as exceeded at 98%, which is blocking the restore job from completing - error code STG-409 QuotaExceeded.

This is affecting all 274 users across our healthcare operations and we need this resolved immediately. Please advise on emergency quota increase and restore procedure.
answer: This has been escalated to our incident response team as P0 given the security and data integrity implications. We are temporarily lifting your storage quota cap right now to unblock the restore job, and a senior engineer will call you within 15 minutes to walk through the restore-from-snapshot process for the Oct 14 11:00 PM UTC backup. In parallel, please preserve any logs of the access attempts you mentioned so our security team can review them alongside the incident.

subject: How to route alerts to different email groups
body:
We're trying to set up alert routing so that billing notifications go to our finance team's email alias and system uptime alerts go to our IT alias instead of everything landing in one inbox. Right now it looks like all notification types are bundled into a single routing rule.

Is there documentation on setting up multiple routing rules by alert category? We have 22 seats total and just want a straightforward way to separate these two alert streams going forward.
answer: Thanks for reaching out - you can create separate routing rules per alert category under Notifications > Routing Rules, where each rule can target a distinct email alias based on alert type (billing, uptime, security, etc). I'll send over our step-by-step guide for configuring category-based routing, and note that any existing catch-all rule will need to be narrowed or disabled first to avoid duplicate deliveries once the new rules are active.

subject: Zapier integration broken after Okta SSO update - Salesforce sync down
body:
Since we updated our Okta SSO configuration on Tuesday, our Zapier integration connecting Northwind to Salesforce has stopped triggering zaps entirely. We rely on this for syncing customer records across our travel booking platform and this is affecting reporting for teams using it daily.

Our Jira ticket TRAVEL-4471 has more details from our side, and I've also posted in the shared Slack channel with our account team. Can you confirm whether the Okta change broke the OAuth token Zapier uses, and how we restore the connection? With 4562 seats depending on accurate data, we need this fixed quickly.
answer: Thank you for the details, including the Jira reference - I can see this lines up with a known issue where Okta SSO policy changes can invalidate the OAuth token Zapier uses for the Northwind connector. I'm escalating this to our integrations team now as P1 given the scale of impact, and we'll need you to re-authorize the Zapier connection under Integrations > Zapier > Reconnect once we confirm the token scope issue on our end. I'll update this ticket and the Slack thread within a few hours with next steps.

subject: Offline mode causing crashes and login loop on mobile app
body:
We've noticed that when users open the mobile app without connectivity, it frequently crashes on the dashboard screen after showing a brief loading spinner. When connectivity returns, several users get stuck in a login loop where they're prompted to re-authenticate even though their session should still be valid.

Additionally, push notifications queued while offline don't seem to deliver once the device reconnects. We'd like to request a change so cached data loads properly offline and queued notifications are delivered on reconnect. This is affecting media team members who work in low-connectivity environments across our 2202 seats.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report - the crash on the dashboard screen while offline and the subsequent login loop point to a session token refresh issue that we've seen with a small number of accounts and are actively investigating. I've logged this as a change request to improve offline data caching and push notification delivery on reconnect, and I'll follow up with a timeline once our mobile team scopes the fix. In the meantime, can you confirm which app version and device OS versions are affected so we can narrow down the crash logs?

subject: Charged twice after upgrading plan - need refund
body:
We upgraded from our previous plan to a higher tier on October 10th to support our growing logistics operations, but our latest invoice shows two separate charges for the upgrade - one for $1,240 and another for $1,240 again three days later. Invoice numbers are INV-88213 and INV-88251.

This looks like a billing system bug that double-charged us during the upgrade process. We need one of these charges refunded as soon as possible since it's affecting our monthly budget reconciliation for 174 seats. Please confirm the refund and let us know if there's documentation on how plan upgrades are supposed to be billed.
answer: Apologies for the confusion this has caused - a duplicate charge during plan upgrades is not expected behavior, and I'm flagging this to our billing systems team as a priority issue. I've initiated a refund for invoice INV-88251 since it appears to be the duplicate charge, which should post back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days. I'll also send over our documentation on how upgrade proration and billing cycles work so you have that for reference going forward.

subject: Question about Zapier trigger for Jira issue creation
body:
I'm setting up a Zapier automation to auto-create Jira tickets whenever certain Slack messages come in through our Northwind integration, but I'm not seeing an option to filter which Slack channels trigger the zap. Right now it looks like it pulls from all connected channels instead of just the #support channel we want.

Is this a bug or is there a filter setting I'm missing? Would appreciate guidance since we're trying to streamline our issue tracking workflow for the product team.
answer: Good question - this isn't a bug, the channel filtering happens on the Slack trigger step within Zapier rather than in the Northwind connector itself. You'll want to add a Filter by Zapier step right after the trigger and set the condition to only continue when the channel name matches #support. I'll send you a quick guide showing this setup with screenshots so you can replicate it for the Jira issue creation step as well.

subject: Jira link integration broken - not creating linked issues
body:
Our Jira link integration stopped creating linked issues from incoming support cases as of this morning around 8 AM. We use this to automatically link Salesforce cases to Jira tickets for our engineering team, and right now nothing is syncing - no linked issues are appearing in Jira even though the Salesforce cases are being created fine.

We posted about this in our internal Slack and multiple team members have confirmed it's affecting all new cases, not just isolated ones. Given we rely on this for our support workflow with 60 seats, could you check if something changed on the integration side?
answer: Thanks for flagging this quickly - I can see reports of Jira link creation failures affecting multiple customers this morning, which suggests an issue on our integration service side rather than your configuration. Our engineering team is already investigating and I've added your account to the affected list so you'll get updates as we identify root cause. I'll follow up within the hour with a status update or workaround if one becomes available.

subject: URGENT - Role mapping broken, users getting wrong permissions after SSO login
body:
Starting this morning, users logging in through our SSO are being mapped to incorrect roles - several clinical staff accounts that should have read-only access are now showing admin-level permissions, and some admins are being downgraded to basic user roles. This is a serious security and compliance concern given we're in healthcare and handle sensitive patient data.

We also noticed MFA prompts are being skipped for some of these misrouted accounts, which is compounding the issue. Login performance is also noticeably slower, taking 15-20 seconds per authentication. With 273 seats affected, we need this fixed immediately and need to understand the scope of the permission exposure.
answer: I'm escalating this immediately as P0 given the security exposure and compliance implications - a security engineer is being paged now to investigate the role mapping and MFA bypass issue. As an immediate mitigation, please consider temporarily disabling SSO-based auto-provisioning for new logins while we investigate, and we'll provide you with an audit log of affected accounts and their role changes within the hour so you can assess exposure. I'll stay on this ticket directly until we confirm the mapping logic is fixed and MFA enforcement is restored for all accounts.

subject: Feature request: alerting on late-arriving data in pipelines
body:
We've noticed that data from our media content connector sometimes arrives 4-6 hours later than expected, particularly on weekends, which throws off our downstream sync jobs and causes stale data to be used in reports. Currently there's no way to get notified when a specific pipeline run is significantly delayed versus its usual schedule.

Would it be possible to add a feature where we can set a latency threshold per connector and get an alert if data hasn't arrived within that window? This would really help us catch data quality issues before they affect our reporting for the small team here.
answer: This is a great suggestion and one we've heard from a few other customers as well - I'm logging this as a feature request for latency-based alerting per connector. In the meantime, as a partial workaround, you could set up a scheduled check using our API to query the last successful sync timestamp for the connector and trigger your own alert if it exceeds a threshold. I'll keep you posted here if this feature gets prioritized on our roadmap.

subject: Charts not loading correctly on shared dashboards
body:
Several of our finance dashboards are showing broken charts today - bar charts render as blank white boxes and the export to PDF function fails with a generic error message when I try to export our monthly spend report. This started happening after I shared a dashboard with a colleague yesterday afternoon.

We rely on these dashboards for our energy sector budget reviews and this is now blocking our month-end reporting. Can someone look into why the charts break specifically on shared dashboards and why exports are failing?
answer: Thank you for reporting this - broken chart rendering combined with export failures on shared dashboards suggests a rendering issue tied to permission scope when a dashboard is shared, and I'm treating this as P1 given the impact on your month-end reporting. Could you send me the dashboard ID and the exact error text from the export attempt? While we investigate, try refreshing the shared dashboard link or re-sharing it, as this has resolved similar rendering issues for other customers.

subject: SCIM group provisioning - custom attribute mapping
body:
We're rolling out SCIM provisioning for Atlas Freight's workspace and need to map a custom Okta attribute (department code) to a Northwind role automatically. Right now our SCIM connector only maps standard attributes like email and displayName. Is there documentation on extending the schema, or a way to request custom attribute support for role-based provisioning?

We have about 4872 seats across regional retail divisions and want provisioning to assign the correct permission set on first login without manual admin intervention.
answer: Thanks for reaching out. Custom attribute mapping for SCIM is supported via our extended schema endpoint - I'll send over the documentation link that covers adding non-standard attributes like department codes and mapping them to role groups. For provisioning at your scale, I'd also recommend setting up attribute-based group rules in your IdP so the mapping stays consistent across divisions. Let us know if you'd like a call to walk through the setup.

subject: Webhook retries hitting rate limit after SDK update
body:
After upgrading to SDK v4.2 last week, our webhook consumer started getting 429 responses on retry attempts that weren't happening before. We send about 3000 events/day and the retries seem to be firing in tighter bursts than the old SDK. Also noticed the changelog mentions the v1 webhook signing method is being deprecated - is there a migration guide for that?

This is affecting our reconciliation job that depends on webhook delivery for transaction status updates, so we're seeing delayed settlements.
answer: Sorry for the disruption to your reconciliation flow. The v4.2 SDK changed the retry backoff algorithm to be more aggressive, which is likely why you're hitting rate limits - we're tracking this as a bug and a fix is planned for the next patch release. In the meantime, I can bump your webhook rate limit temporarily and will send the v1-to-v2 signing migration guide so you can move off the deprecated method ahead of the sunset date.

subject: Salesforce sync - request for bi-directional field updates
body:
Currently our Salesforce integration only pushes data one way from Northwind into Salesforce, but we need updates made in Salesforce (like account status changes) to sync back into our dashboard. We're a small team of 12 and manually re-entering these changes daily is becoming unmanageable.

Is bi-directional sync on the roadmap, or is there a workaround using the API to poll for Salesforce changes in the meantime? Happy to share our current field mapping if that helps.
answer: Thanks for the detailed context. Bi-directional sync isn't currently available out of the box, but it is on our integrations roadmap - I don't have a firm date yet. As a workaround, you can use our API to poll Salesforce object changes on a schedule and push them into Northwind; I can share a sample script for account status fields specifically. I'll also log this as feedback for the product team with your use case attached.

subject: Salesforce sync completely stalled since this morning
body:
Our Salesforce sync job has not run since 6:40 AM today and we have 221 seats relying on updated account data for the sales team's morning standup. The sync status page shows 'queued' but nothing progresses. We also use Jira and Slack integrations that depend on this data flowing through correctly for our alert automations.

Can someone check the sync queue on your end? We need this resolved today as reports are already out of date and the sales team is escalating internally.
answer: I understand the urgency and I'm escalating this immediately. I can see your sync job queued since 6:40 AM and we're checking the connector logs now for a stuck job or upstream Salesforce API issue. I'll update you within the hour with either a fix or a manual re-trigger of the sync so your team can get current data as soon as possible.

subject: Offline mode not syncing expense entries after reconnect
body:
I've been logging expense approvals in the mobile app while offline during a site visit, but when I reconnect to wifi none of the 14 entries I made sync back to the dashboard. The app shows a spinning sync icon that never completes, and push notifications for pending approvals have stopped coming through entirely since yesterday.

This is blocking month-end close since I need those approvals reflected before Friday. Can you help figure out why the sync is stuck?
answer: This is a serious issue and I want to get it fixed before your Friday deadline. Can you confirm your app version and device OS, and whether you still have the app open with the pending entries visible? In the meantime, please don't clear the app cache or reinstall, as that could lose the offline entries - we'll work on recovering the sync queue directly and get back to you today with next steps.

subject: Transform failures on energy usage connector, need workaround
body:
Several of our transform jobs on the energy-usage-connector pipeline have been failing intermittently since yesterday afternoon, throwing 'timeout waiting for upstream response' errors. We're seeing failures roughly every 3rd run out of the last 20, and latency on successful runs has climbed from ~40s to over 3 minutes.

I understand Northwind keeps nightly backups - can someone help us restore this folder from the backup taken Oct 14? We need this for a compliance audit next week and don't have a local copy.
answer: We can help restore this - nightly backups for your bucket are retained for 30 days, so the Oct 14 snapshot should still be available. I'm starting the restore process for the deleted folder in cobalt-itin-2024 now and will confirm once the files are back in place, which should be within the next couple of hours. I'll let you know as soon as it's ready to verify.

subject: Scheduled sync silently dropping 15% of records
body: Our scheduled sync job (pipeline ID dp-4471) that runs every 6 hours to pull case records from our source database into Northwind has been silently dropping about 15% of records since Oct 10. The sync status shows 'completed' with no errors, but row counts in the destination table are consistently lower than the source. We need this fixed quickly since our compliance reports for Q4 depend on this data being complete.
answer: This needs immediate attention given the compliance dependency - I'm pulling the execution logs for pipeline dp-4471 since Oct 10 to identify where the row drop is occurring, likely during the transform or dedup stage. Could you confirm whether any schema changes happened on the source side around that date? I'll follow up shortly with findings and a plan to backfill the missing records once we isolate the cause.

subject: Role mapping not applying admin access via SSO
body: We recently updated our role mapping rules so that users in the 'Analytics-Admin' group get admin access automatically, but several users are still landing in the console with only viewer permissions after SSO login. The SCIM group sync shows they're in the right group on our IdP side. Can someone check why the role mapping isn't applying correctly for these users?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report - can you send me a couple of the affected user identifiers so I can trace their group claims through the SSO login flow? I want to check whether the role mapping rule is reading the correct group attribute name, since a mismatch there could explain why the SCIM sync looks correct but the console permissions aren't updating. I'll dig into this today and report back.

subject: Frage
body:
Wir nutzen die Northwind Mobile App bei Cobalt Partners seit rund acht Monaten für unsere Außendienstmitarbeiter im Gesundheitswesen. Etwa 90 Kollegen greifen damit täglich offline auf Patientendaten zu und füllen Formulare aus, bevor diese synchronisiert werden.

Seit dem Update auf Version 4.3.1 häufen sich Rückmeldungen, dass die biometrische Anmeldung (Face ID / Fingerabdruck) nicht mehr zuverlässig funktioniert. Mehrere Kollegen berichten, dass die App beim Versuch, sich per Fingerabdruck anzumelden, abstürzt – besonders wenn zuvor offline gearbeitet wurde und keine Netzwerkverbindung besteht. Zusätzlich gehen Push-Benachrichtigungen zum Sync-Status verloren, wenn die App neu gestartet werden muss. Können wir das analysieren lassen?
answer: Vielen Dank für die ausführliche Schilderung. Ein Absturz bei der biometrischen Anmeldung im Offline-Zustand deutet auf ein Problem im lokalen Token-Cache hin, das wir uns genauer ansehen möchten. Könnten Sie uns die Geräte- und OS-Versionen der betroffenen Kollegen sowie, falls vorhanden, die Absturzprotokolle aus den Geräteeinstellungen zusenden? Wir werden das Verhalten mit Version 4.3.1 parallel intern nachstellen und melden uns mit einem Zwischenstand.

subject: Salesforce sync configuration for multi-org setup
body: We're setting up the Salesforce integration for Apex Retail's two Salesforce orgs (US and EU) and want to confirm the recommended sync pattern before going live. Our internal Jira ticket APEX-4521 tracks this rollout, and we'd like sync events posted to our #integrations Slack channel once configured. We also use Okta for SSO across all Northwind products, so we want to confirm the Salesforce connector authenticates through the same Okta app or requires a separate one. Could you point us to documentation on multi-org sync mapping, or confirm whether this is supported yet?
answer: Thanks for the detailed setup context. Multi-org Salesforce sync currently requires a separate connector instance per org, each with its own OAuth credentials — it can still authenticate through your existing Okta app, no separate app needed there. I'll send over our multi-org mapping guide and a sample Slack webhook config for sync alerts. Happy to hop on a call if you'd like us to walk through the EU org setup together.

subject: Intermittent SDK timeout errors in webhook delivery
body: We've noticed intermittent timeout errors when our webhook consumers call back through the Northwind Python SDK (v3.2.0). Around 12 events out of roughly 4,000 daily failed on Oct 3 with 'ConnectionTimeout: read timed out after 30000ms' logged on our side. It doesn't seem tied to rate limiting since we're at about 40% of our quota. Low volume but consistent, so wanted to flag it in case there's a known issue with SDK retry/backoff behavior under load.
answer: Thanks for flagging this — a low but consistent timeout rate like that usually points to backoff timing under transient network jitter rather than throttling, which matches your quota numbers. Could you share a couple of the failing request or correlation IDs from Oct 3 so we can trace them server-side? We'll check whether the SDK's default 30s timeout is appropriate for your webhook payload sizes and follow up with findings.

subject: SDK authentication failures affecting all API integrations since this morning
body: Since approximately 08:15 UTC today, our production integrations using the Northwind Node SDK (v5.4.2) have started failing authentication with 'Error 401: invalid_client_credentials' on every request, even though our API keys haven't been rotated. This is blocking all outbound shipment tracking updates for Granite Media across our logistics network, affecting our full team of roughly 270 users. Our rate limit dashboard also shows throttling at a much lower threshold than our contracted limit. Please treat this as urgent — it's a full outage for our integration layer.
answer: We understand the urgency and are escalating this immediately given the scope of impact. A sudden 401 across all requests without key rotation on your side suggests a credential or scope issue on our end, and we're checking your account's client configuration and the rate-limit tier assignment right now. We'll update you within the hour with findings, and please let us know if the failures change in pattern in the meantime.

subject: Urgent: need Okta app configured before go-live tomorrow
body: We're onboarding Atlas Foods onto Northwind and need the Okta SAML app fully configured before our go-live tomorrow morning. Our current setup guide references fields (Audience URI, ACS URL) that don't match what we see in our Okta admin console, and we're not sure how this ties into our existing Salesforce and Slack SSO apps. We also have a Jira ticket (OPS-118) tracking this rollout that's due today. Can someone walk us through the exact Okta configuration or jump on a call, since we're a small 5-person team and can't afford delays?
answer: Thanks for the heads-up on the timeline — given the go-live tomorrow, I'm prioritizing this now. The field naming mismatch is likely due to an older version of our setup guide; I'm attaching the current Okta SAML configuration steps with correct Audience URI and ACS URL values, and this app is independent from your Salesforce/Slack SSO apps so no conflicts there. I can also offer a 20-minute call this afternoon to confirm the setup live before you go ahead — let me know a time that works.

subject: Offline mode not syncing data after reconnect, blocking field team
body: Our field analysts at Vertex Labs rely on the Northwind Mobile App's offline mode to log data during site visits with no connectivity. Since last week, when devices reconnect to Wi-Fi or cellular, the queued records aren't syncing — they just sit in a pending state indefinitely, and two analysts have lost a full day of entries after force-closing the app to try to fix it. This is currently blocking our entire 25-person team from submitting field reports on time.
answer: This sounds like a sync queue issue and given it's blocking your whole team, we're treating it as high priority. Could you tell us the app version and device OS versions affected, and whether force-closing happened before or after the pending sync attempt? In the meantime, please ask analysts not to force-close the app when records are pending, as that may be discarding the local queue — we'll investigate the sync trigger logic and follow up shortly with next steps.

subject: SDK throwing deprecation warnings but still hitting old rate limit tier
body: Since upgrading to Northwind Java SDK v6.0.0 last week, we're seeing repeated deprecation warnings in our logs referencing the old '/v2/webhooks/register' endpoint, even though our code only calls the documented v3 methods. More concerning, our webhook delivery performance has degraded — average latency went from ~200ms to over 900ms, and we're occasionally hitting 429 rate limit errors well below our usual threshold. This started right after the upgrade at Ember Freight and is affecting our order status webhook pipeline.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report — this matches a known issue in v6.0.0 where the SDK's internal webhook registration path still references the deprecated v2 endpoint under the hood, which can also affect rate limit bucket assignment. We recommend pinning to v5.9.3 temporarily while we prepare a patch release; I'll follow up with the exact patch timeline and confirm whether reverting resolves the latency spike on your end.

subject: Repeated upload failures to Storage causing missed backup window
body: Our nightly backup uploads to Northwind Storage failed for the third consecutive night at North Freight, each time with 'Error: quota exceeded, retry after 3600s' despite us being well under our allocated storage quota based on the usage dashboard. This is affecting our retention policy compliance since backups older than 30 days are being purged before new ones successfully land. Given this is now a recurring pattern rather than a one-off, we need this escalated and resolved quickly.
answer: Escalating this now given the retention compliance risk. A quota-exceeded error while your dashboard shows available headroom suggests a mismatch between billed quota and the enforcement check, possibly tied to a stale usage counter — we're pulling your account's storage metrics now to confirm. We'll also pause automatic purge of backups older than 30 days on your account temporarily while we investigate, to prevent further data loss.

subject: Users locked out during MFA enrolment rollout
body: We rolled out mandatory MFA enrolment for Summit Partners this morning and several employees are now stuck in a loop — after scanning the QR code and entering the TOTP code, they get 'Error: verification failed, code expired' even with a fresh code, and can't complete enrolment or access their accounts. Around 15 of our 86 seats are affected so far and it's growing as more people try to log in. We need guidance or a fix urgently since this is blocking daily operations.
answer: Thank you for the clear details — given this is actively locking out users, we're treating it as urgent. A 'code expired' error immediately after scanning usually points to a clock-sync issue between our MFA service and affected accounts' authenticator apps, so we're checking server-side timestamp validation now. In the meantime, please ask affected users to confirm their device time is set to automatic/network time, and we'll send an update within the hour along with a temporary bypass option for anyone still blocked.

subject: Doppelte Benachrichtigungen und falsches Alert-Routing seit heute Morgen
body: Seit heute Morgen erhalten mehrere Kollegen bei Cobalt Health doppelte E-Mail-Benachrichtigungen für dieselben Alerts, und einige kritische Warnmeldungen werden an die falsche Gruppe weitergeleitet statt an unser Redaktionsteam. Wir haben die Routing-Regeln seit Wochen nicht geändert, daher verstehen wir nicht, warum sich das Verhalten plötzlich geändert hat. Da es sich um zeitkritische Redaktionswarnungen handelt, brauchen wir schnell eine Lösung.
answer: Vielen Dank für die schnelle Meldung, wir behandeln das als dringend. Doppelte Zustellungen zusammen mit fehlerhaftem Routing deuten auf ein Problem im Regel-Cache unseres Benachrichtigungsdienstes hin, das wir uns sofort ansehen. Können Sie uns ein bis zwei Beispiel-Alerts mit Zeitstempel und betroffener Zielgruppe nennen, damit wir das Routing gezielt nachvollziehen können? Wir melden uns innerhalb der nächsten Stunde mit einem Zwischenstand.

subject: Request to update SAML attribute mapping for finance group
body: We're restructuring our finance department and need to update the SAML attribute mapping so that users in our new "Finance-EU" group get provisioned into the correct role automatically. Currently everyone lands in the default "Viewer" role after SSO login and we have to manually promote them. Could someone walk me through updating the attribute statements on our IdP side, or point me to documentation for Harbor Analytics' current SAML setup?
answer: Thanks for reaching out. I've attached our SAML attribute mapping guide, which covers how to add a custom group claim and map it to Northwind roles like Finance-EU. Since this is a configuration change rather than an outage, I'll also loop in provisioning specialist support to confirm your IdP metadata is set up correctly before you push the change live.

subject: Uploads failing across the board since this morning
body: Since around 8:15am today, every file upload to our storage bucket has been failing with a generic "upload error, please try again" message. This is affecting all 47 seats on our account and we can't get new energy usage reports into the system. We've tried different browsers and file sizes under 50MB with no luck.
answer: I'm sorry for the disruption this is causing your team. We're seeing elevated error rates on our storage ingestion service and have escalated this to our infrastructure team as a priority incident. I'll update you within the hour with root cause and an ETA for resolution, and please let me know if any uploads are time-sensitive so we can prioritize a manual workaround.

subject: Duplicate alerts being sent to wrong on-call channel
body: Our alert routing has been sending duplicate notifications to the wrong Slack channel for the past two days. We set up escalation rules so critical health-check alerts go to #ops-oncall, but they're also duplicating into #general, which is causing confusion for our travel booking support team. Can you help us fix the routing rule or point us to the escalation config docs?
answer: Thanks for flagging this - duplicate routing like this usually happens when two alerting rules overlap on the same trigger condition. Can you send us the rule IDs or a screenshot of your escalation policy so we can check for the overlap? In the meantime, I'd recommend temporarily disabling the #general channel binding to stop the duplicates while we investigate.

subject: Dashboards taking 20+ seconds to load with large datasets
body: We're integrating the API to pull case data into a custom dashboard, but several of our charts are taking upwards of 20 seconds to render, especially the ones with date-range filters over 90 days. This is impacting our legal team's daily review workflow. Is there a way to optimize chart queries or enable caching for dashboards with heavy filtering?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. Dashboards with wide date ranges and multiple filters can hit query timeouts on larger datasets, and we do have caching options that aren't enabled by default. I'm escalating this to our dashboard performance team to review your specific chart configs, and in the meantime I'd suggest narrowing default date ranges or pre-aggregating data where possible to reduce load times.

subject: Unsubscribe requests not being honored
body: Several of our contacts have used the unsubscribe link in our notification emails but continue to receive duplicate alerts days later. We manage a small education network and this is starting to generate complaints from partner schools who asked to opt out over a week ago. Can you confirm whether unsubscribe requests are actually being processed on your end?
answer: I'm sorry for the trouble this has caused with your partner schools. This looks like a sync delay between our unsubscribe list and the notification delivery service - I'm escalating this now so we can confirm which contacts are affected and manually suppress them while we investigate the root cause. I'll follow up within the day with a list of confirmed opt-outs and next steps.

subject: Members still getting emails after unsubscribing
body: As the workspace admin I've had three separate members report that they unsubscribed from weekly digest notifications but are still receiving them, sometimes twice in one day. This has been happening since last week and it's making us look bad to our media partners who are on these lists. Can you check why unsubscribes aren't sticking and why some emails are duplicated?
answer: Thanks for the report, and I understand the concern about how this reflects on your partner communications. We're looking into both the unsubscribe processing delay and the duplicate delivery issue together, as they may share a root cause in how the notification queue re-checks suppression status. I'll update you as soon as we have a fix or a workaround to stop the duplicates in the meantime.

subject: Invoice shows 25 seats but we only have 18 active users
body: Our latest invoice bills us for 25 seats, but when I check our admin panel we only have 18 active user accounts. This discrepancy has happened for two billing cycles now and it's overcharging us as a small fintech startup on the Starter plan. Can someone review our account and correct the seat count before the next invoice generates?
answer: Thank you for flagging this, and I apologize for the overcharge. I'm escalating this to our billing team right away to audit your seat history and reconcile the invoice against your actual active user count of 18. We'll issue a credit for any overbilled amount and make sure your next invoice reflects the corrected seat count.

subject: Question about storage quota and retention overlap
body: I'm trying to understand how our storage quota interacts with the retention policy. We're on the Starter plan with a fairly small quota, and I want to know if files that are past their retention period but not yet deleted still count against our quota. We're planning our upload schedule around this and don't want to hit unexpected limits.
answer: Good question - files past their retention period but still pending deletion do count against your quota until the cleanup job runs, which happens once every 24 hours. I've linked our documentation on quota and retention interaction below, and if you'd like we can also check your current usage breakdown to help you plan uploads more precisely.

subject: Restore from backup not returning all files
body: We initiated a restore from a backup snapshot dated last Tuesday for one of our retail data folders, but the restore completed with only about 70% of the expected files present. We have roughly 1258 seats across the org and this folder is used by several regional teams, so we want to understand if this is a quota limitation on the restore job or a bug before we try again.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. A partial restore like this is unusual and could point to either a quota cap on the restore job or an issue with how the snapshot indexed certain files. I'm opening an investigation with our storage team to review the specific snapshot and restore job logs, and I'll follow up with findings before you attempt another restore to avoid overwriting the current partial state.

subject: Jira integration link not connecting properly
body: I set up the Jira integration last week to sync tickets automatically, but when I try to link a new Jira project to our Northwind workspace, the connection test fails with a generic "link failed" message. I've double-checked our Jira API token and permissions and everything looks correct on that end. Any idea what might be causing this?
answer: Thanks for the details. A generic "link failed" message during project linking is often related to a mismatch between the Jira site URL format and what our integration expects, or an expired OAuth session on the Jira side. Could you send us the exact Jira site URL you're using and a timestamp of your last connection attempt so we can check the integration logs on our end?

subject: Deaktivierte Mitarbeiter erscheinen weiterhin im Audit Log als aktiv
body:
Wir haben am 3. Juni fünf Mitarbeiter über die Admin Console deaktiviert, die das Unternehmen verlassen haben (u.a. Nutzer-ID 88213 und 88240). Im Audit Log werden diese Konten aber weiterhin als 'aktiv' geführt und stehen auch noch in unserer IP-Allowlist. Das ist für unsere Compliance-Prüfung nächste Woche kritisch, da wir nachweisen müssen, dass der Zugriff sofort entzogen wurde.

Können Sie das prüfen und uns sagen, ob es sich um eine Anzeigeverzögerung handelt oder ob die Deaktivierung tatsächlich nicht vollständig durchgeführt wurde? Wir benötigen hierzu dringend eine Rückmeldung.
answer: Vielen Dank für die genaue Beschreibung. Ein verzögertes Audit-Log-Update nach Deaktivierung ist uns aus einzelnen Fällen bekannt und in der Regel ein Anzeigefehler, der den tatsächlichen Zugriffsstatus nicht beeinflusst - wir prüfen aber sofort anhand der genannten Nutzer-IDs, ob der Zugriff wirklich entzogen wurde. Wir melden uns innerhalb der nächsten Stunden mit einem Status-Update und stellen bei Bedarf eine schriftliche Bestätigung für Ihre Compliance-Unterlagen bereit.

subject: PDF export of dashboard cuts off charts on right side
body:
Since yesterday, exporting our 'Q3 Media Spend' dashboard to PDF produces a file where the two rightmost bar charts are cut off completely. This happens on both our shared and personal versions of the dashboard, tested in Chrome and Firefox. The dashboard has 6 charts total and was working fine last week when I shared it with our leadership team.

We need this for a board deck due Thursday, so any workaround would help in the meantime.
answer: Thanks for flagging this - we can reproduce the clipped chart issue on multi-column dashboard layouts during PDF export and are treating it as a rendering regression from a recent release. As a workaround, exporting the dashboard in landscape orientation from the export settings menu should include all 6 charts correctly. We're working on a fix and will update this ticket once it's deployed, hopefully before your Thursday deadline.

subject: SAML login failing with 'Response destination mismatch' error
body:
I'm integrating SSO for our workspace and every SAML login attempt from our IdP now fails with 'Response destination mismatch' on the Northwind login page. Our ACS URL is configured as https://app.northwindcloud.com/sso/acs/quillmedia and matches what's in the metadata we downloaded, but the error persists across three different test users.

This started after I updated our SAML app config in the identity provider this morning around 9am. Provisioning and MFA settings haven't been touched. Can someone check our SSO configuration on your end?
answer: Thanks for the detail - a destination mismatch usually means the SAML response Destination attribute doesn't exactly match the ACS URL registered on our side, even a trailing slash difference can trigger it. Could you send us the raw SAML response (base64 is fine) from one failed attempt so we can compare it against your workspace's registered endpoint? We'll prioritize this given it's blocking all login attempts.

subject: Users stuck in MFA enrollment loop after SSO login
body:
Several of our analysts, including myself, are stuck in a loop where after successful SSO login we're redirected to the MFA enrollment screen, but scanning the QR code and entering the code returns 'Invalid verification code' every time. This is happening for at least 15 users today, all trying to access the analytics workspace. We've confirmed device clocks are synced.

This is blocking access to reports we need for a client deliverable this afternoon. Can someone escalate this on the identity side?
answer: This has been escalated to our identity team given the number of users affected. In the meantime, could you confirm whether all affected accounts are using the same MFA app, and whether any of them successfully enrolled before today? We suspect a sync issue between our MFA service and your SSO session tokens, and we'll follow up shortly with either a fix or a temporary bypass for the affected accounts so your team isn't blocked this afternoon.

subject: How to bulk deactivate users and add exceptions to allowlist
body:
I need to deactivate a batch of about 8 users who are on a temporary leave, but I only see an option to deactivate one user at a time in the Admin Console. Is there a bulk action or CSV upload option for this? Also, is it possible to keep a deactivated user's IP address on our allowlist for API access even after their account is deactivated, since we have a service integration tied to one of these accounts.

Would appreciate a walkthrough or documentation link if this exists already.
answer: Right now bulk deactivation isn't available as a one-click action, but you can select multiple users from the Users tab and apply a status change in a single batch action, which we'll walk you through if it's not visible in your view. On the allowlist question, IP entries are tied to the workspace rather than individual users, so deactivating an account won't remove it - just make sure the service integration uses a dedicated API key rather than that user's personal credentials going forward.

subject: Need to upgrade plan and add seats before Monday
body:
We're currently on the Starter plan with 24 seats and need to upgrade to a higher tier and add 10 more seats before Monday when three new hires start. I tried doing this from the Billing section but got an error saying 'Plan change requires payment method verification' even though our card on file hasn't changed. Our invoice number for reference is INV-88452.

Can you walk me through the upgrade process or process this on your end? This is time-sensitive since the new hires need access Monday morning.
answer: Thanks for flagging the deadline - we can process this upgrade on our side to make sure it's ready before Monday. The verification error is usually triggered when a plan change also increases the billing amount significantly, so we'll manually confirm your payment method against invoice INV-88452 and apply the seat increase directly. You'll get a confirmation email once it's done, likely within a few hours today.

subject: URGENT: IP allowlist wiped, all staff locked out of admin console
body:
Our entire IP allowlist in the Admin Console was cleared sometime in the last hour and now all 237 seats are getting 'Access denied - IP not permitted' when trying to log in, including our own IT team. We did not make this change ourselves and no one on our side has permissions to wipe the full list, so we suspect either a bug or unauthorized access.

This is a full production outage for us right now - none of our staff can reach any Northwind product. Please treat this as critical, we need the allowlist restored immediately and an explanation of what happened, this could be a security breach.
answer: We're treating this as a critical incident and have escalated immediately to our security and platform teams. We're restoring your IP allowlist from the last known good configuration right now and will confirm once access is back for all users, and in parallel we're pulling the audit log to determine whether this was an internal change, a bug, or unauthorized activity. We'll update you within the hour with both a status on restoration and initial findings on cause.

subject: How to handle late-arriving records in daily sync pipeline
body:
We run a daily pipeline that pulls enrollment data from our student system into Northwind, but records for students who enroll late (sometimes 2-3 days after the event date) are getting dropped because our pipeline window only looks back 24 hours. Right now we're seeing about 5-10 records per week fall through this gap.

Is there a way to configure the pipeline to reprocess or catch late-arriving data automatically, or a recommended pattern for handling this without re-running the full historical load each time?
answer: This is a common pattern and there's a cleaner way to handle it than a full reload - you can configure a rolling lookback window on the pipeline's ingestion settings (e.g. 72 hours instead of 24) so late records get picked up on subsequent runs without duplicating already-processed rows, since we dedupe on your record ID. We'll send over a short guide on setting this up, and happy to review your current pipeline config if you'd like a second look at the window size.

subject: Question about sharing dashboards with view-only access
body:
I'd like to share a couple of our dashboards with a few external partners who shouldn't be able to edit anything, just view the charts. I see a general 'Share' option but I'm not sure if it defaults to edit access or view-only, and whether I can restrict sharing to specific dashboards rather than the whole workspace.

Could you clarify how sharing permissions work here, and if view-only external sharing is supported on our current plan?
answer: Good question - the Share option does let you set view-only access per dashboard, you just need to select 'Viewer' role in the permissions dropdown when adding the external partner's email rather than the default 'Editor' role. This is available on your current plan and is scoped to the individual dashboard you're sharing from, so your other dashboards stay private unless you explicitly share them too.

subject: PDF export broken for shared dashboards - urgent, client meeting today
body:
Our team shares several dashboards company-wide, and as of this morning the 'Export to PDF' button just spins and eventually shows 'Export failed, please try again' for every dashboard with more than 3 charts. This is affecting all 265 seats in our workspace, not just me, and we've confirmed it fails on multiple browsers.

We have a client review at 2pm today and need to send PDF versions of two dashboards beforehand. Please treat this as urgent, this is blocking a real deliverable.
answer: We understand the time pressure and are looking into this right now - initial checks suggest an issue with PDF rendering for dashboards above a certain chart count, which matches what you're describing. As an immediate workaround, try exporting one chart section at a time using the individual chart export option, which should let you assemble what you need before 2pm while we fix the full-dashboard export. We'll update this ticket as soon as we have a resolution.

subject: Backup retention issue after upload
body:
We've been using Northwind Storage for about six months now to back up our academy's enrollment records and financial documents. Our IT team recently reorganized the folder structure and set up a new nightly upload job that runs at 2 AM to push updated files to the storage bucket, which has been working fine for the most part.

The actual problem is that files we uploaded on Feb 3 and Feb 4 seem to have disappeared even though our retention policy is set to 90 days. When I check the bucket now, the earliest file listed is from Feb 5. We have 11 seats on this workspace and rely on this for compliance, so losing even two days of backups is concerning. Can you check why these were purged early?
answer: Thanks for the detailed background, and I understand the concern given your compliance requirements. We're looking into the retention policy enforcement on your workspace right now to see why files from Feb 3 and Feb 4 were removed ahead of the 90-day window; this looks like it could be tied to a policy recalculation issue we're aware of on Starter-tier buckets. I'll update you within a few hours with findings and, if the files are still recoverable from our replication layer, we'll restore them.

subject: How do users unsubscribe from alert emails?
body: One of our customers replied to an automated alert email asking to be removed from the notification list, but I can't find an unsubscribe link in the emails Northwind sends for our Notifications integration. Is there a way to manage unsubscribe preferences per recipient, or does this need to be handled entirely on our end through the API? We're only sending order-status alerts to about 40 external contacts right now.
answer: Good question — currently transactional alert emails sent through Notifications don't include a built-in unsubscribe link since they're treated as service messages, but you can manage recipient opt-outs on your end by calling the suppression list endpoint before sending. If you'd like, I can point you to the API docs section for managing suppression lists so your customer stops receiving these going forward.

subject: Okta app integration not syncing group assignments
body: We set up the Okta app integration for Atlas Works last week to manage access for our 18 seats, and initial provisioning worked fine. However, when I add a user to a new Okta group intended to grant them admin rights in Northwind, the change isn't reflected on our side even after 24 hours and a manual sync trigger from the Okta admin panel.
answer: Thanks for the details. Group-to-role sync delays like this are usually caused by a mismatch between the Okta group name and the mapping configured on our Integrations page, so I'd like to check your current mapping configuration against the group you're testing with. Could you confirm the exact Okta group name and the Northwind role it should map to so I can trace the sync logs on our end?

subject: SSO role mapping broken for entire sales team
body: After our identity provider update yesterday, everyone on the sales team who logs in via SSO is being assigned the default viewer role instead of the editor role their group should map to. This is affecting all 18 seats on our Vertex Works workspace and is blocking people from editing records they need for daily work.
answer: This is impacting your whole team so we're treating it as urgent. subject: Connector re-authentication needed for ERP data source
body:
Our ERP connector has been showing a yellow 'auth expiring soon' badge for the past two days, and I want to renew credentials before it actually breaks and disrupts our production data sync. The connector is set up under our manufacturing inventory pipeline, last successful sync was May 12 at 4:03 AM.

Can you point me to the re-authentication flow, and will re-authenticating cause any gaps in the historical data already pulled, or does it just refresh the token for future syncs?

Re-authenticating only refreshes the connector's access token going forward and won't touch or reprocess any historical data already synced, so there's no risk to what's already landed. You can trigger re-auth from the connector settings page under 'Credentials' - click 'Reconnect' and you'll be walked through the same OAuth flow used during initial setup.

subject: Scheduled sync interval options for data pipeline API
body: I'm building against the Data Pipelines API to set up scheduled syncs for our legal case management system, and the docs mention interval options of hourly, daily, and custom cron, but when I submit a custom cron expression like */15 * * * * via the API, I get a 400 error: 'schedule.interval: unsupported frequency for current plan.' Is sub-hourly scheduling gated by plan tier, or is this a bug in the API validation?
answer: Sub-hourly scheduling is currently restricted to Pro and above, which is why the API is rejecting your cron expression on a Starter plan - that error message is technically correct but I agree it's not very clear, so I'll flag that for the docs team to clarify. If you need sub-hourly syncs for this integration, I can walk you through the upgrade options, or alternatively you can stick with hourly and use incremental sync flags to reduce the practical lag.

subject: Workspace settings page not saving changes for sub-teams

I'm trying to update workspace settings for our logistics sub-team - specifically changing the default timezone and disabling self-service seat requests - but every time I click Save, the page reloads and reverts to the old values. I'm checking your account configuration now and will confirm within the next couple hours whether this is the cause or if there's a separate bug; in the meantime, avoid trying to deactivate those sub-teams so we don't compound the issue.

subject: Repeated card declines on account - need to update billing before service interruption

In the meantime, I'd recommend trying a different card if one is available, since the verification failure usually points to the issuing bank blocking the charge rather than an issue on our end - let me know once you've updated the payment method and I'll confirm it processed correctly.

subject: Storage quota alert incorrect - backups being deleted early

I've paused the automated purge job on your account while we investigate the discrepancy, so no further backups will be deleted in the meantime - I'll update you within the day with findings and confirm your retention settings are correctly applied going forward.

subject: Workspace allowlist changes not saving + need urgent deactivation
