subject: How to handle late-arriving data in scheduled pipeline runs
body:
We run a nightly pipeline that pulls case records from our legal data connector, but we've noticed records with timestamps up to 6 hours after the scheduled run get excluded and only show up in the next day's batch. This is causing gaps in our compliance reports.

Is there a way to configure a grace window or re-run window so late-arriving records get picked up in the same reporting period? We're using the standard connector sync schedule, currently set to run at 2 AM daily.
answer:
Good question - this is a common issue with connectors that have upstream write delays. You can configure a look-back window on the sync step (under pipeline settings > Sync Configuration > Late Data Handling) to reprocess a trailing window, typically 6-12 hours works well for cases like yours.

I'd recommend setting it to 8 hours to cover your observed 6-hour delay with some buffer, and switching the connector sync from a fixed 2 AM run to a rolling window if your data volume allows. Let me know if you'd like help configuring this on your current pipeline.

subject: Question about upgrading plan and seat count
body:
I manage our Northwind workspace for Summit Retail and we're looking to upgrade from our current plan since we're adding several new team members in Q2. We currently have 23 seats and may need up to 30.

Can you walk me through how the upgrade process affects our billing cycle - specifically whether we'd be prorated for the remainder of this month, and whether the new seats need to be purchased in a block or can be added individually as we onboard people?
answer:
Happy to help plan this out. When you upgrade or add seats mid-cycle, we prorate the difference based on days remaining in your current billing period, so you're only charged for partial usage rather than a full new month. Seats can be added individually as needed rather than in a fixed block, and each addition generates its own prorated line item on your next invoice.

If you'd like, I can generate a sample invoice preview showing costs for going from 23 to 30 seats so you have exact numbers before you commit to the upgrade.

subject: Biometric login support for offline mode in mobile SDK
body:
I'm integrating the Northwind Mobile SDK into our fintech app at Cobalt Energy and testing biometric login (Face ID / fingerprint) alongside offline access. When the device is offline and a user tries biometric login, we get a silent failure - the callback never fires and no error is returned.

Is biometric login expected to work fully offline once the initial token is cached, or does it require a network check first? We need this clarified since our users frequently work in low-connectivity environments.
answer:
Biometric login is designed to work offline once you've cached the initial refresh token locally via the SDK's secure storage - it shouldn't require a live network check for subsequent unlocks. The silent failure you're seeing sounds like the token cache isn't being initialized correctly; can you confirm you're calling `enableOfflineBiometric()` after the first successful online login?

If that's already in place, send us your SDK version and device OS version and we'll dig into the callback issue directly - this shouldn't be failing silently.

subject: RESTORE FAILING - patient data unavailable, this is unacceptable
body:
We have been trying to restore a backup snapshot from October 3rd for over 5 hours now and it keeps failing at 40% with error 'RESTORE_QUOTA_EXCEEDED'. We are a HEALTHCARE company and this data includes patient records our clinical team needs RIGHT NOW.

We pay for storage on this account and nowhere does it say restores count against upload quota. This is the second time this has happened this month and honestly we are looking at other vendors if this isn't fixed today.
answer:
I understand the urgency here and I'm treating this as a P1 - restores blocking access to clinical records is exactly the kind of issue we prioritize immediately. The RESTORE_QUOTA_EXCEEDED error does indicate your account's storage quota is currently full, which is blocking the temporary space needed during restore; I'm manually provisioning additional temporary capacity on our end right now so this doesn't require you to delete anything.

I'll have an update for you within 30 minutes on the restore status, and I'm also flagging this internally so we can review why quota is counted against restores without clearer warning - that's a fair point and I don't want this to hit you again.

subject: Guidance needed on upcoming API deprecations
body:
As IT admin for Harbor Retail, I saw the notice about v1 webhook endpoints being deprecated but I need more detail before we plan our migration. We have around 40 internal services and partner integrations relying on the current webhook format and rate limits.

Could you send documentation on the v2 webhook payload changes, the new rate limit tiers, and whether the SDK (we're on v3.2) has built-in support for the new format already, or if we need to upgrade the SDK as part of this migration?
answer:
Thanks for getting ahead of this - the v1 webhook deprecation is scheduled with a 90-day sunset window, and I'll send over our migration guide covering the v2 payload schema changes and updated rate limit tiers (which are notably higher for Pro-tier accounts like yours). SDK v3.2 does not yet include native v2 webhook handling, so you'll need to upgrade to v3.5+ as part of the migration.

Given you have around 40 dependent services, I'd also recommend scheduling a technical walkthrough with our integrations team - happy to set that up if useful.

subject: Transform failures blocking production data pipeline
body:
We're seeing repeated transform failures in our production pipeline integrated via the Northwind API at Blue Systems. Error log below:

```
[2024-05-14 09:22:11] ERROR TransformStep 'normalize_booking_data' failed
cause: SchemaValidationError - field 'departure_ts' expected ISO8601, got unix epoch int
retry attempt 3/3 failed
pipeline_id: pl_8842991
```

This started after we pushed a source schema change on our end two days ago, but the pipeline was working fine on the old schema for months. We need this unblocked today since it's feeding our live booking dashboards.
answer:
Thanks for including the log - this confirms the transform step is strictly expecting ISO8601 timestamps and your source schema change to unix epoch integers is triggering the SchemaValidationError. Since this is blocking your live booking dashboards, I've marked this P1 and our team is looking at pipeline pl_8842991 now.

As an immediate workaround, you can add a pre-transform step to cast 'departure_ts' back to ISO8601 format before it hits normalize_booking_data - I can share a sample transform snippet for this within the hour while we also evaluate adding native epoch support to the connector.

subject: chart
body: Revenue chart on dashboard shows no data since yesterday.
answer: Thanks for the heads up - could you let us know the dashboard name and whether other charts on the same dashboard are showing data normally? In the meantime we'll check for any known issues affecting revenue chart rendering.

subject: Frage zu Rechnungen und Rückerstattung
body:
Ich bin Product Manager bei Orion Freight und habe eine Frage zu unserer letzten Rechnung. Uns wurden 16 Sitzplätze berechnet, aber wir haben im letzten Monat für zwei Wochen nur 12 aktive Nutzer gehabt, da zwei Mitarbeiter das Unternehmen verlassen haben.

Gibt es eine Möglichkeit, für diesen Zeitraum eine teilweise Rückerstattung zu erhalten, und können Sie mir erklären, wie die Abrechnung bei Sitzplatzänderungen während des Monats funktioniert? Zusätzlich wäre es hilfreich, eine Dokumentation zum Rechnungsprozess zu erhalten.
answer:
Vielen Dank für Ihre Anfrage. Grundsätzlich werden Sitzplätze auf Basis der maximal aktiven Nutzer im Abrechnungszeitraum berechnet, nicht tagesgenau, daher wurde die Reduzierung auf 12 Nutzer in diesem Zyklus nicht automatisch angepasst. Ich kann jedoch prüfen, ob für die betroffenen zwei Wochen eine teilweise Gutschrift möglich ist, und melde mich dazu mit einer konkreten Rückmeldung.

Die Dokumentation zum Rechnungsprozess inklusive Details zu Sitzplatzänderungen während des Monats sende ich Ihnen im Anschluss per E-Mail zu.

subject: question
body:
We've been going through our year-end budget review and I was pulling together our vendor cost documentation for the audit team. While looking at our Storage usage under the travel division account, I noticed we have a lot of backup files from trips going back over three years that nobody seems to be actively using anymore.

My actual question is: what's our current retention policy for Storage, and is there a way to set an automatic expiration on backup uploads after a certain period? We'd like to reduce clutter and possibly lower our footprint, but I don't want to manually delete anything without knowing the rules. Would appreciate guidance or a feature to automate this.
answer:
Thanks for reaching out, and glad to help clarify this. On the Starter plan, Storage retention is currently set to keep backups indefinitely unless manually deleted, so nothing is being auto-purged on our end. We don't yet have a self-service automatic expiration/retention rule feature, but I've logged this as a feature request on your behalf and flagged it to our product team.

In the meantime, I can share a report of backup files older than a chosen date so your team can review and bulk-delete manually if that's helpful. Let me know if you'd like that generated.

subject: Late-arriving records breaking downstream sync windows
body:
We're seeing a recurring issue with our travel-data pipeline connector where records arriving more than 45 minutes after their event timestamp are getting dropped from the current sync window instead of being merged into the correct batch. This started around March 3rd and is affecting roughly 6-8% of bookings data daily.

Here's the relevant log snippet:

2024-03-05T02:14:11Z WARN pipeline.sync[connector-travel-07] late_arrival dropped record_id=8823192 delay=51m window_closed=true
2024-03-05T02:14:11Z WARN pipeline.sync[connector-travel-07] late_arrival dropped record_id=8823201 delay=63m window_closed=true
2024-03-05T02:15:02Z ERROR pipeline.sync watermark_violation batch=2024-03-05-02 lag_threshold_exceeded

Is there a way to extend the watermark window or reprocess these dropped records without a full backfill?
answer:
Thank you for the detailed log excerpt, that's very helpful for narrowing this down. It looks like your connector's watermark lag threshold is set to 45 minutes, which is causing legitimate late-arriving records to fall outside the active window and get dropped rather than merged. We can increase this threshold on our end for connector-travel-07, and I'd recommend setting it to at least 90 minutes given your current delay pattern.

While I make that adjustment, I'll also check whether the dropped records from March 3rd onward can be recovered via targeted reprocessing rather than a full backfill, and will follow up shortly with results.

subject: Dashboard PDF export failing for large logistics reports
body:
I'm integrating our logistics dashboards via the API and every attempt to export the fleet-tracking dashboard to PDF fails after about 30 seconds with a generic 'export failed, try again later' message. This dashboard has around 14 widgets and covers roughly 170 vehicles across our network. Smaller dashboards export fine, so it seems tied to size or complexity.

This is blocking us from sharing weekly reports with our logistics partners, who expect the PDF by end of week. Can someone look into whether there's a size limit or timeout on PDF exports?
answer:
Thanks for flagging this with the details on dashboard size. It does sound like you're hitting an export timeout tied to the number of widgets and data volume being rendered — we do have an internal timeout that can be too aggressive for dashboards in the 12+ widget range. I'm escalating this to our engineering team to check the export service logs for your account and see if we can extend the timeout or optimize rendering for this dashboard.

As a workaround in the meantime, try splitting the dashboard into two smaller views for export, which should stay under the current limit while we investigate a permanent fix.

subject: MFA enrollment locking out finance team ahead of payroll run
body:
As of this morning, none of our finance team members can complete MFA enrollment when logging into Northwind — the enrollment screen loads, we scan the QR code, enter the six-digit code, and it just returns 'verification failed' every time, even with fresh codes. This is affecting all 6 people in our finance group who need SSO access to process a payroll batch due today.

We haven't changed any settings on our end recently. This is urgent since it's blocking a time-sensitive financial process.
answer:
This has been escalated immediately given the impact on your payroll process. We're seeing reports consistent with a time-sync issue affecting MFA verification for a subset of accounts, and our identity team is actively investigating the enrollment failures right now. I'll update you within the hour with either a fix or a temporary bypass option for your finance group so today's payroll run isn't delayed further.

In the meantime, if any of the 6 users have a backup MFA method already configured, that path should still work — let me know if you'd like me to check enrollment status per account while we resolve the root cause.

subject: SDK throwing errors after webhook signature verification update
body:
After updating to SDK version 4.2.1 last week, our webhook handler started throwing signature verification errors on every incoming event: 'InvalidSignatureError: computed HMAC does not match header X-Northwind-Signature'. We haven't changed our webhook secret or endpoint. Rolling back to 4.1.8 fixes it immediately, so something changed in the signing logic between versions.

We need this resolved soon since we're on a Starter plan with limited engineering time and can't stay pinned to an old SDK version indefinitely, especially if it gets deprecated. Could you point us to updated documentation or a changelog explaining the signature change?
answer: Thanks for the clear reproduction steps — this is a known issue introduced in 4.2.1 where the payload encoding used for HMAC computation changed from UTF-8 to a raw byte stream, which breaks verification unless the handler is updated accordingly. We're treating this as high priority given the deprecation timeline for 4.1.x. I'll send over the updated verification code snippet and changelog entry right away, and we're also pushing a patch release (4.2.2) that restores backward-compatible signing behavior within the next day.

subject: Shared dashboards inaccessible to team members with view permissions
body:
We integrated dashboard sharing via the API last week, and since yesterday, team members who were granted 'view' permission on shared dashboards are getting a 403 error when trying to load them, even though the permission shows as active in the sharing settings panel. This is affecting all 5 of our media team members who need daily access to campaign performance dashboards.

Nothing changed on our side — no permission edits, no API calls to revoke access. This is blocking daily reporting for the whole team and needs urgent attention.
answer: Apologies for the disruption this is causing your team's daily reporting. This matches a permission-propagation bug we're currently investigating where view-level sharing grants aren't syncing correctly to the dashboard access layer after being set via API, even though the sharing record itself looks correct. I'm escalating this now and will update you as soon as we have a fix or workaround — likely re-issuing the sharing grants through a script on our end to force propagation.

subject: Repeated transform failures blocking pipeline runs
body:
Several of our data pipeline transforms have been failing consistently since Tuesday, specifically the connector feeding our legal case-management sync. The transform step errors out with 'schema mismatch: expected field case_id, found null' on roughly 40% of records, even though the source connector configuration hasn't changed. This is stopping downstream syncs from completing for our legal team across all 208 seats.

Can someone investigate whether there was a schema change on the connector side, or if this is related to a recent platform update? We need this resolved as it's holding up case data updates.
answer: Thank you for the detailed error message, it points us in the right direction. We did push a connector schema update on Monday that changed how null case_id values are handled upstream, which is likely the root cause of the mismatch you're seeing. I'm escalating this to our data pipelines team to confirm and get a fix or config adjustment out quickly, since this is impacting your legal sync across the whole account. I'll follow up with next steps within the next few hours.

subject: PAGINATION IS COMPLETELY BROKEN AND NO ONE HAS FIXED IT
body:
I've reported this THREE times now through different channels and nothing has changed. The API pagination for /v2/records is returning duplicate items across pages when using the cursor from the response — same record_id showing up in page 3 AND page 5. This makes it impossible to reliably paginate through large datasets without manually deduping everything on our side, which defeats the point of cursor pagination.

This has been broken since at least February and it's honestly ridiculous that a basic feature like this doesn't work correctly. If this isn't fixed soon we'll seriously reconsider whether Northwind is worth the integration effort.
answer: I understand the frustration, especially having raised this multiple times already — that's on us and I want to get this properly tracked and resolved. Duplicate records across cursor pages usually points to an issue with how the cursor is being generated when underlying records are updated between page fetches, but I want to confirm this against your specific /v2/records calls rather than guess. Could you share a couple of recent request examples with the cursor values used, so I can get this in front of engineering with concrete repro data and push for a fix?

subject: Bulk uploads failing across multiple campuses since this morning
body:
Starting around 9:15 AM today, file uploads to Storage have been failing for multiple university campuses on our account, returning 'upload failed: quota exceeded' even though we're well under our allocated storage limit based on the usage dashboard, which shows 62% utilization. This is affecting document uploads for at least 4 different campus admin teams.

We rely on this for daily coursework and record submissions across our 1598 seats, so this is a significant disruption. Can you confirm whether there's a quota calculation issue or an outage affecting Storage uploads?
answer: Thank you for reporting this with the usage percentage — that mismatch between actual utilization and the quota error strongly suggests a calculation or caching issue on our quota-check service rather than an actual limit being hit. I'm escalating this immediately as it's affecting multiple campuses and daily coursework submissions. We'll investigate the quota service logs for your account right away and update you as soon as we have a root cause or interim fix, likely within the next couple of hours given the scope of impact.

subject: Multiple card failures on Enterprise account billing
body:
I've been reviewing our billing reports and noticed that our payment card on file has failed for the last two billing cycles, on the 3rd and again this past week, with the error 'card declined - do not honor' shown in the billing history. I confirmed with our finance team that the card itself is active and has sufficient funds, so this doesn't seem to be an issue on our end.

We have 1824 seats on this account and I want to make sure we don't lose access to features or get suspended over a payment processing issue that isn't actually about the card. Can you check what's causing the declines and whether we're at risk of service interruption?
answer: Thanks for flagging this proactively and providing the specific decline dates. 'Do not honor' responses can sometimes come from the card issuer's side even when funds are available, often tied to fraud-prevention rules on large recurring charges, but I want to check our payment processor logs for your account specifically before concluding that. I can confirm your account is not currently at risk of suspension while this is being resolved, and I'll follow up with findings and, if needed, help coordinate an alternate payment method to avoid further disruption.

subject: Bar charts rendering blank after export, need sharing fix
body: We've noticed that several bar charts on our Energy Usage dashboard render blank when exported to PNG, even though they display fine in the browser. This started around June 3rd after we added a third data series. We'd also like to request the ability to share a dashboard snapshot via a public link, since right now we can only share internally with logged-in users.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. The blank export with a third series sounds like a rendering bug in our chart export pipeline, and I've logged it for our engineering team to reproduce. On the sharing side, I'll pass your request for public link snapshots along to product as a feature request and update this ticket once I have a status on both.

subject: IP allowlist blocking finance team logins, urgent
body: Since yesterday afternoon our finance team has been locked out of the Admin Console even though our office IP range is listed in the allowlist under Settings. The audit log shows repeated 'Access denied - IP not permitted' entries starting at 14:20 UTC. Nobody on our end changed the allowlist configuration, so this looks like it may be a bug. We have payroll approvals due today and need access restored quickly.
answer: This is a high priority issue and I'm escalating it now. We're checking whether a recent allowlist sync deployment caused the range to be dropped or misread, and I'll update you within the hour with either a fix or a temporary workaround so your finance team can regain access before your payroll deadline.

subject: Pagination cursor deprecation - need migration timeline and webhook support
body: We saw the notice that the offset-based pagination parameters on the /v2/records endpoint are being deprecated in favor of cursor-based pagination. We have several internal services and a partner integration relying on the current behavior, so we need a clear migration timeline and documentation. Separately, it would be very helpful if pagination state changes could trigger a webhook event so downstream systems can react without polling.
answer: Thank you for flagging this early. I'll get you the finalized deprecation date and a migration guide for cursor-based pagination this week, along with sample code for the transition. I've also logged your webhook suggestion as a feature request with our API platform team and will note your account as interested in early access if it gets prioritized.

subject: Retention policy not deleting old backups, storage quota nearly full
body: Our storage quota alert triggered this morning showing 97% usage, but our retention policy is set to delete backup files older than 90 days. When I checked the storage console, I found backup sets from January still present. Upload performance has also slowed noticeably over the past two days, likely tied to the near-full quota. We need the retention job investigated before we hit the hard limit and uploads start failing.
answer: I understand the urgency here and I'm opening this as a priority incident. I'm checking whether the retention cleanup job has stalled or is erroring silently on your account, and I'll also request a temporary quota buffer so uploads don't fail while we resolve the root cause. I'll follow up shortly with findings and next steps.

subject: Salesforce sync stopped pulling new opportunity records
body: Our Salesforce integration stopped pulling new opportunity records into our pipeline as of yesterday morning. The last successful sync timestamp shows June 10th at 08:15, and nothing has come through since despite new opportunities being created in Salesforce. We rely on this feed for weekly reporting, so this is affecting our ability to close out this week's numbers.
answer: Thanks for the report. I've checked the sync logs on our side and can see the connector job has been failing silently since the timestamp you mentioned, which we're now investigating further. I'll keep you posted as we work to restore the sync and will let you know once new records are flowing again.

subject: Requesting refund for duplicate charge and clarification on plan credits
body: We noticed our last invoice included a charge that appears duplicated from the prior billing cycle, and we'd like this refunded. Separately, we're trying to understand how unused seat credits from downgrading last month carry over, since we went from 8 seats to 5 but don't see any credit reflected. Could someone review our account and clarify both issues?
answer: Thank you for bringing this to our attention. I'm reviewing your billing history now to confirm the duplicate charge and will process a refund once verified. I'll also look into how the seat downgrade credit was calculated and follow up with a clear breakdown so you can see exactly how it applies to your next invoice.

subject: Need to change SSO role mapping for new department groups
body: We recently added two new departments in our identity provider and need the corresponding groups mapped to the right roles in Northwind so provisioning works correctly on first login. Right now users from these new groups are landing with default viewer permissions instead of the editor role they need. Could you help us update the role mapping configuration?
answer: Happy to help with this. Could you send over the exact group names from your identity provider along with the roles you'd like each mapped to? Once I have that, I'll update the mapping configuration on our side and confirm with a test login so new users get the correct permissions automatically.

subject: Incorrect seat count and missing line items on latest invoice
body: Our invoice for this billing period shows 130 seats billed, but our actual active user count is 112 based on the admin dashboard. There's also no line item breakdown for the add-on modules we're using, which makes it hard to reconcile against our internal cost tracking. Could someone review this and issue a corrected invoice or explain the discrepancy? We need this resolved before our finance team closes the books this week.
answer: Thanks for flagging this, and I understand the timing pressure with your books closing this week. I'm pulling the seat activity report now to reconcile the billed count against actual usage, and I'll also request an itemized breakdown of the add-on charges. I'll get a corrected invoice or a detailed explanation to you within the next day.

subject: Question about role mapping best practices for SSO
body: We're setting up role mapping for our SSO integration and want to make sure we're following best practices before rolling it out more broadly. Currently we have two roles mapped, admin and viewer, but I'm unsure whether we should also enable MFA enforcement at the identity provider level or leave it to Northwind's settings. Is there documentation that covers recommended provisioning patterns for a small team like ours?
answer: Great question. I'd recommend enforcing MFA at the identity provider level since it applies consistently across all your connected apps, while using Northwind's role mapping purely for permission provisioning. I'm attaching our SSO best practices guide which covers recommended group-to-role patterns for smaller teams, and I'm happy to review your specific configuration if you'd like a second set of eyes.

subject: Need role-based access control support in Identity API
body: I'm integrating our app with Northwind's Identity API and need to assign different roles to users based on their department during provisioning. Right now the API only lets me set a single default role at creation time, with no way to pass a custom role attribute in the request. We also require MFA to be enforced for admin-level roles specifically, not just account-wide. Is there a way to achieve this with current endpoints, or is this feature planned?
answer: Thanks for the detailed breakdown. Currently the provisioning endpoint only supports a single default role at creation, but you can update the role immediately after via the role-assignment endpoint using the user ID returned from the create call, which should let you set department-based roles right away. Role-specific MFA enforcement isn't available yet, so I've logged it as a feature request and will update you if it gets scheduled.

subject: PDF export missing dashboard branding and cutting off panels
body: I'm the workspace admin for Quill Labs and we need to send weekly compliance dashboards to our ISO auditor as PDFs. When I export our Production Overview dashboard to PDF, the last two panels on the right side are cut off and the company logo we uploaded doesn't appear in the header. This is happening on every export since yesterday, roughly 6 attempts. We need this fixed before Friday's audit review.
answer: Thanks for flagging this ahead of your audit deadline — I'm escalating this as P1 given the compliance timeline. Can you confirm whether the dashboard uses a custom layout with pinned widths, and share the dashboard ID so our team can reproduce the clipping issue? In the meantime, exporting at a wider print size (Letter Landscape instead of Portrait) has resolved similar clipping for other customers and may work as a stopgap for Friday.

subject: Request to change frequency of email digest notifications
body: Our team at Willow Analytics currently receives daily email digests for dashboard alerts, but with 3,314 seats across the org we're seeing a lot of duplicate content between the daily digest and the real-time escalation emails. We'd like to change our digest cadence to twice-weekly (Tuesday and Friday) instead of daily, and confirm this won't affect escalation alerts for critical thresholds. Can this be configured at the org level rather than per-user?
answer: Thanks for the detailed context. Org-level digest cadence is configurable through the Notifications settings under Admin > Digest Preferences, and setting it to twice-weekly will not affect your real-time escalation alerts, which remain on a separate delivery path. I'll follow up with step-by-step instructions for applying this at the org level so individual users don't need to update their own preferences.

subject: Alert routing sending duplicate emails to wrong distribution list
body: We're a 5-seat account and since Monday our payment-failure alerts have been routing to both our support distribution list and our finance team's list, when they should only go to finance. I checked the routing rules under Alerting and the rule for 'Payment Failures' still shows finance-only as the destination, but emails are duplicating to support@ as well. This is causing confusion internally and we need it fixed quickly since it's affecting real transactions.
answer: This is a priority for us given the impact on your payment alerting — I've opened a P1 investigation. Can you send us the alert ID or a timestamp from one duplicated email so we can trace the routing logic? It's possible a legacy rule referencing the support list wasn't fully removed when the finance-only rule was created, and we'll check for that on our end while waiting for your reply.

subject: Push notifications crashing app on Android after latest SDK update
body: I integrated the Northwind Mobile SDK v4.2.1 into our driver app for Pioneer Travel and since deploying to production last night, push notifications are causing the app to crash on Android devices when received while offline. We're seeing this across roughly 40% of our 190 users based on crash reports. Stack trace points to a NullPointerException in PushMessageHandler.onReceive when the device has no network connection at delivery time.
answer: Thank you for the detailed report — a crash affecting this many users is being treated as P1. This looks consistent with a known issue in v4.2.1 where offline message caching wasn't initialized before the handler fires; a fix is being fast-tracked. In the meantime, we recommend rolling back to SDK v4.1.8 to stop the crashes, and we'll notify you as soon as the patched version is available for testing.

subject: Scheduled syncs running hours late and skipping records
body: For the past week our nightly inventory sync pipeline at Orion Labs has been running 3-4 hours later than its scheduled 1am window, and yesterday's run appears to have skipped around 800 records from our warehouse connector. We have 133 users relying on this data for morning production planning. Is there a known issue with the scheduler, or a connector setting we should check on our end?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report — I understand the delay is impacting your morning planning. We've seen scheduler backlogs affect connectors during peak load windows, and I'd like to check the pipeline logs for your account to see if the 800 skipped records correlate with a timeout or retry failure. Could you share the pipeline ID and approximate timestamp of last night's run so we can pull the exact trace?

subject: Connector authentication failing for our ERP data source
body: Our ERP connector at Blue Freight has started failing authentication as of this morning, throwing 'invalid_grant: token expired' on every sync attempt. We rely on this connector for daily fuel cost reconciliation and haven't changed any credentials on our side. We're a 25-seat account and this is currently blocking all data syncs from that source, so we need help re-authenticating as soon as possible.
answer: This is being treated as P1 since it's blocking all syncs from your ERP source. The 'invalid_grant' error usually means the refresh token was revoked or expired on the source system's side rather than ours — can you confirm if anyone recently rotated API credentials or reset app permissions in your ERP admin panel? While we wait to hear back, we're also checking our connector logs from this morning to confirm nothing changed on our end.

subject: Getting duplicate email alerts for the same invoice event
body: I've noticed over the past couple of weeks that I'm receiving two identical email alerts for each overdue invoice notification, both arriving within a minute of each other. It's not urgent since the information is accurate, just annoying since I'm manually filtering them out. Happens for both invoice reminders and payment confirmation alerts. Wanted to flag this in case others are seeing the same thing.
answer: Thanks for reporting this, and no worries about the low urgency — duplicate alerts shouldn't happen so we'll look into it. Could you share one example of the duplicate pair, including the timestamps, so we can check whether this is tied to a specific alert rule or a delivery retry issue on our side? We'll keep you posted once we identify the cause.

subject: URGENT: All scheduled data syncs stopped and pipeline dashboard shows breach warning
body: As of about 40 minutes ago, every scheduled sync pipeline for Blue Analytics has stopped running, and our pipeline dashboard is now showing a red 'Security Breach Detected' banner across all connectors. We have 80 users depending on these pipelines for live operational reporting and everything is frozen right now. This looks serious and we need immediate assistance — nothing is syncing and we don't know if our data has been compromised.
answer: We understand the severity and this has been escalated immediately as P0 to our security and pipeline engineering teams. Please do not modify any connector credentials or pipeline configurations while we investigate, and we will update you within the next 15 minutes with findings. We're prioritizing determining whether the breach banner reflects an actual security event or a false-positive triggered by the pipeline outage.

subject: IP allowlist blocking our own office network from admin console
body: I added our office IP range to the Admin Console allowlist yesterday to restrict access, but now nobody on our 5-seat team can log into the console at all, including from the same office network I whitelisted. subject: Connector repeatedly losing auth after token refresh
body: Our healthcare data connector to the EHR system has started failing sync jobs intermittently since Tuesday, with the error 'invalid_grant: token expired' even though we refreshed credentials just last week. Out of the last 40 sync runs, 11 have failed with this error, and each failure seems to delay downstream reports by 2-3 hours. We're seeing data quality flags pop up on records that arrived after a failed-then-retried sync. Can someone check if there's an issue with how the connector is handling token refresh timing?
answer: Thanks for the detailed failure count, that's very useful. This pattern suggests the connector may be caching a refresh token that's rotating faster than expected on the EHR side, causing intermittent invalid_grant errors. We're going to trace the last 11 failed sync runs on our side and will follow up with findings, and in the meantime we'd recommend re-authenticating the connector once more to reset the token lifecycle.

subject: Export button broken on manufacturing KPI dashboard
body: Our team relies on the weekly KPI dashboard to export chart snapshots for leadership review, but since yesterday clicking Export on any chart just shows a generic 'Something went wrong' message. This is happening across all chart types, not just one specific widget, and it's affecting our only four seats equally. We need this working before Friday's review meeting.
answer: Thanks for flagging this ahead of your Friday review. We're seeing reports of export failures tied to a recent update to the chart rendering service and are treating it as a priority fix. We'll update you as soon as it's resolved, and if it's not fixed by Thursday we can walk you through a manual workaround using screenshot exports for the review.

subject: urgent
body: We have a P0 situation: our nightly sync connector for claims data has been silently falling behind since approximately 2am, and records that should have landed by 6am are still missing from the pipeline output as of 11am. This is causing incomplete data to be sent downstream to our reporting systems, and we suspect some records may not have been queued at all rather than just delayed. We need immediate confirmation on whether this is data loss or just severe latency, as we have regulatory reporting due today.
answer: We understand the urgency given your regulatory deadline and have escalated this to our on-call pipeline team immediately. Initial checks show the connector queue backed up starting at 2:07am due to an upstream latency spike, and we're currently verifying whether all records were captured but delayed versus dropped entirely; we'll have a definitive answer within the next 30 minutes and will stay on this until your data is fully reconciled.

subject: Shared dashboard permissions not respecting group restrictions
body: We have a client-billing dashboard shared with our Retail Ops group in Northwind Dashboards, but three users outside that group can still open it via the shared link. I checked the sharing settings under Manage Access and the group restriction shows as enabled, but access logs confirm views from accounts not in the group. This is a compliance issue for us since the dashboard contains client invoice data. We need this locked down today - can you confirm if this is a permissions bug on your end?
answer: Thanks for flagging this, and I understand the urgency given the client data involved. We've seen an issue where cached share links can bypass group-level restrictions if the link was generated before the restriction was applied - we're checking your workspace logs now to confirm that's what's happening here. In the meantime, please regenerate the share link and notify the three users to use the new one; I'll follow up within the hour with root cause and confirmation that access has been cut off.

subject: Cannot deactivate former employee, still shows as active
body: I'm trying to deactivate a user in the Admin Console who left the company on Monday but the account still shows Active status and they were able to log in yesterday. I went to Users, selected the account, clicked Deactivate, got a confirmation message, but the status reverted back to Active within a few minutes. We only have 10 seats on our plan so this is blocking us from adding a replacement hire.
answer: This is concerning and I want to get it resolved quickly - I'm escalating this to our technical team now since a deactivation reverting itself could indicate a sync issue with your identity provider or an SSO override. Can you confirm whether this account is provisioned through an external directory or created directly in Northwind? In the meantime, I'd recommend resetting the user's password and removing their session tokens manually under Security to cut off access while we investigate.

subject: Workspace settings changes not saving for allowlist update
body: We're trying to update the IP allowlist under Workspace Settings to add two new office locations, but every time we save, the settings page reloads and shows the old allowlist entries unchanged. This happened three times today with different admin accounts. We checked the audit log and it doesn't even show an attempted change was made, which is odd since we did submit the form each time.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. It sounds like the save request may be failing silently before it reaches the audit log, which would explain why no entry appears. Could you let us know which browser and admin role you were using for the attempts? While we investigate the save failure, you can try making the change via the Admin API directly as a workaround, and I'll update you as soon as we identify why the UI isn't persisting the update.

subject: Mobile app crashes immediately on launch for all users
body: Since yesterday afternoon our team has been unable to open the Northwind mobile app - it crashes within a second of tapping the icon, before even reaching the login screen. This is happening on both iOS and Android devices across our finance and operations staff, roughly 15 people so far have reported it to me. We haven't changed anything on our end and the app was working fine last week.
answer: I'm sorry for the disruption this is causing across your team - a crash before login on both platforms points to something on our end, and I'm escalating this to P1 immediately. Can you send me the exact app version numbers from a couple of affected devices? We're pulling crash logs now and will push a fix or workaround as soon as we identify the cause; I'll keep you updated every hour until this is resolved.

subject: Charts showing blank data on shared dashboard
body: We have a dashboard shared with our logistics partners that's supposed to show weekly shipment volume, but the bar chart has been rendering completely blank since Tuesday even though the underlying data source has records. Line charts on the same dashboard still work fine. I've tried refreshing and re-adding the chart widget but the bars just don't appear at all.
answer: Thanks for the details - it's helpful that the line charts are unaffected, which suggests this is isolated to the bar chart widget rendering rather than the data connection itself. Could you share the name of the affected dashboard and roughly when the data source was last updated? I'll take a look at the widget configuration on our side and get back to you with next steps shortly.

subject: Request to update default workspace session timeout
body: We'd like to change the default workspace session timeout setting from the current 24 hours down to 4 hours as part of a new internal security policy. I looked under Workspace Settings > Security but only see an option for password requirements, not session duration. Could you point me to where this is configured, or let me know if this needs to be done on your end?
answer: Happy to help with this. Session timeout for Pro plans is currently configured at the account level rather than in the self-serve Workspace Settings page, so I'll need to make this change on our side. Please confirm the exact timeout value you'd like applied (4 hours) and I'll update it and send you documentation on how session policies work across your workspace roles once it's live.

subject: Offline mode not syncing data once back online
body: I've been testing offline mode on the mobile app while traveling with limited connectivity, and any changes I make while offline - like updating a task status - don't sync once I reconnect to WiFi. The app shows a small sync icon spinning but it never completes, even after leaving it open for 20 minutes. This happened on two separate trips this week, both times with the same result.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report, this helps a lot. A sync icon that spins indefinitely usually means the queued changes are stuck rather than lost, so your offline edits should still be recoverable. Could you try force-closing the app and reopening it while on a stable connection, and let me know if the sync completes then? If not, please send me the approximate timestamps of your offline edits so we can check the sync queue on our end.

subject: Frage zur letzten Rechnung und Sitzplätzen
body: Ich habe die Rechnung für diesen Monat geprüft und bin mir nicht sicher, ob die Anzahl der berechneten Sitzplätze korrekt ist. Wir nutzen aktuell den Starter-Plan mit 14 Nutzern, aber auf der Rechnung stehen mehr Positionen als erwartet. Können Sie mir erklären, wie sich der Rechnungsbetrag zusammensetzt, und ob es eine Dokumentation zu den Abrechnungszyklen gibt?
answer: Vielen Dank für Ihre Nachricht. Ich werde die aktuelle Rechnung für Ihr Konto prüfen und mit der tatsächlichen Anzahl aktiver Sitzplätze vergleichen, um die Differenz zu klären. In der Zwischenzeit finden Sie eine Übersicht zu unseren Abrechnungszyklen und wie Sitzplätze berechnet werden im Hilfebereich unter Billing - ich melde mich innerhalb der nächsten Werktage mit einer detaillierten Aufschlüsselung.

subject: Zapier integration stopped triggering workflows
body: Our Zapier integration with Northwind has stopped triggering any zaps since this morning around 9am. We use it to push new contact records into our CRM automatically, and nothing has come through in the last four hours despite new records being created on our end. The Zapier task history shows no incoming triggers at all from Northwind during this time.
answer: Thanks for reporting this promptly - a complete stop in triggers points to either a webhook delivery issue on our side or an expired authentication token for the Zapier connection. Could you check under Integrations whether the Zapier connection shows as Active or if it's requesting reauthorization? While we investigate the webhook delivery logs, reconnecting the integration is worth trying as a quick first step.

subject: Dashboard charts rendering with missing data points
body: Several of our dashboards started showing charts with gaps in the data starting this morning - specifically the enrollment tracking chart is missing data points for the last three days even though our source system shows records for those dates. This is affecting dashboards shared with department heads across the district, so quite a few people are seeing incomplete reports right now.
answer: Thanks for the clear report - since this is affecting multiple shared dashboards and department heads are relying on this data, I'm marking this as high priority on our end. Can you confirm the exact dashboard name and data source connected to the enrollment tracking chart? We're checking our data pipeline processing for the last three days now and will update you as soon as we identify whether this is a sync delay or a rendering issue.

subject: Anpassung der Sitzplatzanzahl im Enterprise-Vertrag
body: Wir haben aktuell 452 Lizenzen im Enterprise-Plan für Harbor Systems gebucht. Durch die Übernahme unseres Standorts in Rotterdam brauchen wir ab dem 1. November voraussichtlich 40 weitere Sitzplätze. Können Sie mir sagen, wie der Prozess für die Anpassung der Sitzplatzanzahl aussieht und ob die Rechnung für November bereits die neue Anzahl berücksichtigen kann?
answer: Vielen Dank für die frühzeitige Information. Ich kann die Sitzplatzanzahl auf 492 anheben und die Änderung so einplanen, dass sie ab dem 1. November wirksam wird und in der November-Rechnung anteilig berücksichtigt wird. Ich sende Ihnen vorab eine Übersicht mit dem angepassten Betrag zur Freigabe, bevor die Rechnung erstellt wird.

subject: DASHBOARDS ARE UNUSABLE - THIS IS COSTING US CLIENTS
body:
Our operations dashboard has been taking over 45 seconds to load for the past three days and half the charts just spin forever before timing out. We have 160 seats on this plan and our whole logistics team relies on the shipment tracking dashboard every single day - right now it's basically dead weight. I've already had two account managers escalate this to me because they can't show clients live data.

This is completely unacceptable for a paid product. If this isn't fixed today we're going to seriously look at other vendors.
answer: I understand how disruptive this is and I'm treating this as a P1 right now. I've flagged your account to our dashboard performance team and we're pulling query logs for the shipment tracking dashboard to identify the bottleneck. I'll update you within the hour with findings, and in the meantime I'd appreciate the specific dashboard names or URLs that are slowest so we can prioritize those first.

subject: Question about last month's invoice and seat count
body: I'm reviewing our October invoice and it lists 148 active seats, but when I check our workspace admin panel it only shows 142 users. We're on the Pro plan for Ember Legal. Could you confirm whether the invoice is based on a different snapshot date, and if there's a way to get a partial refund for the difference if we were overbilled?
answer: Thanks for flagging this - invoices are generated based on a snapshot taken on the billing cycle date, which can occasionally differ slightly from your current admin panel count if seats were removed afterward. I've checked your account and confirmed 6 seats were deactivated on October 3rd, two days after the snapshot was taken. I'll process a prorated credit for those seats on your next invoice.

subject: Overcharged for seats we don't have
body: Our latest invoice charges us for 290 seats, but we've only ever provisioned 267 for North Labs under our Pro plan. This is the second billing cycle in a row where the count is off - last month it was 280 instead of 267. I checked our admin console and the active user list matches 267 exactly, so I'm not sure where the extra seats are being counted from.
answer: Thank you for catching this and providing the exact numbers. This looks like a syncing issue between your admin console and our billing system rather than an actual seat change on your end. I'm opening an internal ticket to reconcile both billing cycles and will issue a credit for the difference once confirmed, likely within 2 business days.

subject: Need to add office IP to allowlist
body: We're trying to restrict admin console access to our office network only. I went into Security settings and found the IP allowlist option, but when I add our static IP (203.0.113.44) and save, it reverts back to the default 'allow all' setting after refreshing the page. We only have 8 seats on the Starter plan so this should be a simple setup.
answer: Thanks for the detailed steps - the IP allowlist feature on the Starter plan does have a known display refresh issue where the toggle appears reset even though the rule is saved. Could you confirm from a different browser session whether access is actually restricted to that IP? If it isn't taking effect at all, I'll escalate to engineering with your workspace ID.

subject: Requesting change to transform retry logic
body: Over the past two weeks we've had 14 transform jobs fail on our 'booking-events' pipeline with errors like 'schema mismatch: expected field currency_code, got null'. Our upstream connector occasionally sends incomplete records, and right now a single bad row kills the whole batch. We'd like to request a change so failed rows get quarantined into a dead-letter table instead of failing the entire transform, so our travel booking sync doesn't stall for hours.
answer: That's a reasonable request and one we support for Pro plan pipelines. I can enable dead-letter routing on your 'booking-events' transform so malformed rows are isolated into a separate table while valid rows continue processing. I'll need to schedule a brief maintenance window to apply this config change - would tomorrow between 2 and 4 PM work for your team?

subject: Shared dashboards suddenly inaccessible to whole team
body: As of this morning, none of our 19 users can open the dashboards that were previously shared with the 'Support Team' group - everyone gets 'You don't have permission to view this dashboard' even though nothing changed on our side. This is blocking our entire support queue dashboard which we use to track ticket volumes hourly. Nothing in the sharing settings looks different from yesterday.
answer: This sounds like a permissions propagation issue and I'm escalating it as P1 given it's blocking your whole team. Could you send me the dashboard ID or share link for the queue dashboard so I can inspect the group ACL directly? In the meantime, I'll check if there was a recent change to group membership sync that could explain the sudden lockout.

subject: Card declines happening via API for multiple customers
body: We're integrating the Billing API to charge our end customers and since yesterday we're seeing a spike in failed charges with error code card_declined even for cards that worked fine last week. Out of about 40 charge attempts this morning, 11 failed with the same generic decline. We only have 14 seats on the Starter plan but this is affecting real customer transactions, so I need to know if this is on Northwind's end or the card networks.
answer: Thanks for the specifics - a spike like that pointing to one error code across multiple cards does suggest something on our processing side rather than individual card issues. I'm pulling the transaction logs for your account for this morning's attempts to check for a pattern with the processor, and I'll follow up within a few hours with findings and next steps.

subject: Critical pipeline failures blocking energy data sync
body: Since 6 AM this morning our main transform pipeline for meter-reading data has failed 22 consecutive times with the same error, halting all downstream syncs to our reporting systems. This is affecting our entire energy operations team of 180 seats who rely on near real-time meter data for grid balancing decisions. We need this resolved urgently as delayed data is a compliance risk for us.
answer: I've escalated this immediately as a P1 outage given the compliance impact. I'm pulling the pipeline execution logs now to identify what changed at 6 AM and will loop in our data engineering on-call team. I'll send you an update within 30 minutes with root cause status and an estimated time to restore the sync.

subject: How to configure Okta app for Northwind integration
body: I'm setting up SSO for our 20-seat Starter workspace and following the Okta integration guide, but the app I created in Okta doesn't have the SAML attribute mapping fields the docs describe. We're also planning to connect Slack and Jira later, so I want to make sure the Okta setup is correct first before adding those. Is there a current app template we should be importing from the Okta catalog instead of building it manually?
answer: Good catch - the manual SAML app setup in Okta can miss some default attribute fields, so we recommend importing our official app listing from the Okta Integration Network catalog instead, which comes pre-configured with the required attribute mappings. I'll send you a direct link to that catalog entry along with a short checklist for verifying the mapping before you move on to the Slack and Jira integrations.

subject: Users getting logged out too frequently via SSO
body:
We've had several employees report being logged out of Northwind Cloud every 20-30 minutes since yesterday, forcing them to re-authenticate through our SSO provider each time. This is happening across departments, not just one team. Our SSO session timeout is configured for 8 hours in the identity provider settings, so this doesn't match what we're seeing on the Northwind side.

Can you confirm what the session timeout policy is set to on our workspace and whether something changed recently? We have 20 seats affected and this is disrupting daily work.
answer: Thanks for flagging this - a shortened session timeout is not expected behavior. We recently rolled out a configuration update to session handling for SSO-enabled workspaces, and it looks like your workspace's timeout value got reset to a default of 30 minutes instead of inheriting your configured 8-hour setting. I'm correcting this now and will confirm once it's applied, which should take effect within 15 minutes without requiring any action on your end.

subject: Question about API key scopes for webhook subscriptions
body:
One of our engineers noticed that a newly generated API key isn't triggering our webhook subscriptions the way our older keys do. We checked the scopes and the new key has 'read' and 'write' permissions but webhooks still aren't firing for order.created events. We're not seeing any errors in our webhook delivery logs either, just silence.

Is there a separate scope needed for webhook events, like 'events:read' or something similar? Wanted to check before we escalate further since this is only affecting a test integration right now, not production.
answer: Good question - webhook event delivery does require a distinct scope called 'events:subscribe' in addition to standard read/write permissions, since it's treated as a separate resource type in our API key model. This is documented in the API Platform section under Authentication, but I agree it could be clearer alongside the webhooks docs, so I'll pass that feedback to our docs team. Once you regenerate the key with that scope included, webhook delivery should resume immediately.

subject: Duplicate digest emails going out to entire firm
body:
Starting this morning, our daily email digest is being sent twice to every recipient, about 4 minutes apart. We have 146 seats on this workspace and I'm getting complaints from multiple partners who thought it was a phishing attempt at first glance since the content is identical. This has happened for the last two digest cycles (today and yesterday).

Can someone look into why the digest job is firing twice? We need this resolved before tomorrow's send since it's affecting the whole firm's inbox and starting to look unprofessional to clients who are CC'd on some of these.
answer: I'm sorry for the disruption this is causing, especially with client-facing recipients involved. This matches a known issue where the digest scheduler can double-trigger under certain retry conditions, and I'm escalating this to our notifications team right now given the timing constraint before tomorrow's send. I'll update you within a few hours with either a fix confirmation or a temporary workaround to pause the second send while we patch the root cause.

subject: Getting 401 errors after rotating API key - deprecated auth header?
body:
I rotated our production API key today following the standard process, but now every request returns a 401 with the message: 'Authentication failed: legacy header format deprecated as of v3'. We were using the Authorization header format that worked fine with our previous key generated back in March.

Did something change in how API keys need to be passed? Our SDK version is 2.4.1 and I don't see anything in the changelog about this. This is blocking our staging deploy that's scheduled for later today, so any guidance on the correct header format would help.
answer: Thanks for the detailed error message, that helps pinpoint this. Keys generated after our v3 authentication update require the header format 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' rather than the older 'X-API-Key' scheme your March key was using - this rolled out gradually so older keys were grandfathered in until rotation. Updating to SDK version 2.6.0 or later will handle this automatically, or you can manually switch the header format in the meantime to unblock your staging deploy.

subject: Doppelte Warnmeldungen werden mehrfach verschickt
body:
Seit gestern erhalten mehrere Mitarbeiter dieselbe Warnmeldung zwei- oder dreimal innerhalb weniger Minuten. Es betrifft vor allem die Buchungsbenachrichtigungen, die an unser Reisebüro-Team gehen. Wir haben 22 Lizenzen im Workspace und mittlerweile beschweren sich fast alle Nutzer darüber.

Können Sie prüfen, ob es ein Problem mit der Alarmierungsregel gibt? Wir haben in den letzten Tagen keine Einstellungen geändert, soweit ich weiß. Es wäre gut, das schnell zu klären, da die Postfächer langsam unübersichtlich werden.
answer: Vielen Dank für die Meldung. Wir sehen uns die Konfiguration Ihrer Alarmierungsregeln umgehend an, da doppelte Zustellungen häufig auf ein Problem mit der Zustell-Warteschlange hindeuten. Ich melde mich innerhalb der nächsten Stunden mit einem Update, ob es sich um ein bekanntes Problem auf unserer Seite handelt oder ob wir gemeinsam die Regelkonfiguration überprüfen müssen.

subject: Dashboard load times causing delays in monthly close
body:
Our finance team relies on the quarterly revenue dashboard for the monthly close process, and for the past week it's been taking over 45 seconds to load, sometimes timing out entirely. We have several analysts trying to pull numbers today and this is directly delaying our reporting deadline. The dashboard has about 12 charts pulling from our billing data source.

Can someone look into whether there's a performance issue on your end, or if we need to restructure the dashboard? Given we're in the middle of month-end close with 1598 seats depending on accurate reporting across teams, we need this addressed quickly.
answer: I understand the urgency given your close timeline, and I'm escalating this to our performance team immediately as a P1. Dashboards with 10+ charts pulling from large billing datasets can sometimes hit query contention, and we'll check whether your specific dashboard is affected by a recent indexing issue we've seen on similarly sized data sources. I'll follow up within the hour with either a fix or a recommendation for splitting the dashboard to restore usable load times right away.

subject: How to add multiple IP ranges to allowlist
body:
I'm trying to set up our IP allowlist in the Admin Console so only our office and VPN ranges can access the workspace. I can add one CIDR range fine, but when I try to add a second range the form seems to overwrite the first entry instead of adding to a list. We only have 8 seats so this is low urgency, but I'd like to get it configured correctly.

Is there a way to add multiple ranges, or do I need to combine them into a single CIDR block somehow? Documentation I found only shows a single example range.
answer: Thanks for checking in on this - you should be able to add multiple CIDR ranges as separate entries, each on its own line in the allowlist field, rather than needing to combine them into one block. If the form is overwriting your first entry, that sounds like a UI issue we'd like to look into; could you let us know which browser you're using? In the meantime, I'll point you to our updated documentation which includes an example with multiple ranges listed.

subject: Critical alerts being routed to wrong distribution list
body:
We just discovered that critical system alerts meant for our IT staff distribution list have been routing to a general student announcements list instead for the past three days. This means over a hundred students received internal infrastructure alerts, and our actual IT team missed several important notifications about failed backup jobs.

We need this fixed immediately and need to understand how the routing got misconfigured, since none of our 34 admin accounts made this change recently. Please treat this as urgent - we're concerned about what else might be misrouted and need to audit our alert rules.
answer: This is being treated as a priority issue on our end given the scope of exposure. We're pulling the audit logs for your alert routing configuration right now to determine when and how this change occurred, since you've confirmed no admin-initiated change on your side - this could indicate a rule migration issue during a recent update. I'll have an update for you within the hour on both the immediate fix to restore correct routing and findings from the audit trail.

subject: API key showing as invalid despite being newly generated
body:
I generated a new API key yesterday for a small reporting integration and it worked fine for a few test calls, but today every request returns 'invalid_api_key' even though the key hasn't been regenerated or revoked on our end. We only have 5 seats and this is our only integration, so it's a small scope but it's completely blocking our automated report right now.

Is there an expiration policy on newly created keys that I might be missing? I didn't see anything about a 24-hour expiry in the key creation screen.
answer: Thanks for the details - there isn't a standard 24-hour expiry on API keys, so this sounds like something specific to your key or account state. Could you confirm the key prefix shown in your dashboard so I can check its status directly? In the meantime, I'd suggest generating a fresh key as a quick workaround to unblock your reporting job while I investigate why the original one was invalidated.

subject: Pagination breaking on large result sets - missing records
body:
We're pulling order data through the API using cursor-based pagination, and starting this morning we noticed our sync job is missing records between pages. When we compare total counts, we're getting roughly 1200 records when there should be around 1450 based on our internal tracking. The 'next_cursor' value in the response sometimes points to a page we've already processed, causing what looks like a skip further along.

This is breaking our nightly sync and affecting downstream reporting for our logistics dashboard. We need this fixed urgently since our operations team relies on this data being accurate every morning.
answer: This is a serious issue and we're escalating it immediately given the data integrity impact on your nightly sync. Cursor pointers repeating or skipping ahead suggests a problem with how cursors are being generated on our end for larger result sets, and we're pulling logs from your recent sync runs now to identify exactly where records are being dropped. I'll have an engineer looking at this within the hour and will update you as soon as we have a root cause or interim workaround to restore accurate counts for your dashboard.

subject: Duplicate push and email alerts for same event
body:
We've noticed that our shipment-status alerts are being sent twice - once as a push notification and once as an email - even though we only configured a single alert rule in the Notifications settings. This started around March 4th and is happening for roughly 40% of our alert rules, based on what our team has reported. It's confusing customers who think something went wrong twice.

Can you confirm whether this is expected behavior with a workaround, or if there's a bug causing the duplication? We'd like documentation on how alert channels are supposed to interact if that exists.
answer:
Thanks for the detailed report. This isn't expected behavior - when an alert rule has both push and email channels enabled but no channel-priority setting, some rule types can fire on both channels instead of respecting the primary channel selection. I've logged this as a bug and I'm also checking whether your account has any rules with overlapping trigger conditions, which could compound the issue.

In the meantime, as a workaround you can disable the email channel on the affected rules and rely on push only, or vice versa, until we ship a fix. I'll update this ticket with our documentation on channel interaction and a timeline once I hear back from engineering.

subject: Salesforce sync showing stale opportunity data
body:
Our Salesforce integration through Northwind has been pulling opportunity records that are a few days out of date. I noticed our finance dashboard on April 9th still showed deal stages from April 5th, even though Salesforce itself was updated. We have the sync set to run every few hours so this delay seems longer than expected.

We're not blocked on anything critical right now, just want to understand if there's a known lag or setting we should adjust.
answer:
Thanks for flagging this - a few days of lag is definitely more than we'd expect from the standard sync interval. Can you let me know which sync job name shows in your Integrations log for the Salesforce connector, and whether you've seen any error entries there? That will help me determine if the job is silently failing partway through rather than just running slow.

In the meantime I'd recommend triggering a manual sync from the Integrations page to refresh the current data while we investigate the root cause.

subject: Zapier integration failing across all workflows since this morning
body:
Since around 8:15am today, every Zap connected to our Northwind account has been failing at the trigger step with a timeout error. We have close to 30 active Zaps feeding data into Slack, our CRM, and internal dashboards, and all of them are affected - this is blocking notifications to our manufacturing floor leads about order status changes.

We checked Zapier's status page and it shows no incidents on their end, so this looks specific to our Northwind connection. This is impacting all 211 seats on our workspace since alerts have stopped flowing entirely.
answer:
This is a top priority for us given the scope - I'm escalating immediately to our integrations team. We're seeing elevated latency on the Zapier trigger endpoint on our side starting around 8:00am, and I suspect this is related to a backend service degradation we're currently investigating.

I'll post updates here every 30 minutes until this is resolved. As an immediate step, please avoid re-authenticating your Zapier connection since that won't resolve a backend timeout and could complicate our diagnosis.

subject: Email digests not sending - urgent for our team
body:
Our weekly email digest for Notifications has not gone out for the past two cycles, on March 3rd and March 10th. We rely on this digest to summarize alert activity for our finance team since we don't have time to check the dashboard daily, and now several people are asking why they haven't received anything.

I checked the digest settings and everything still shows as enabled with the correct recipient list of 19 users. Is there a delivery issue on your end, or did something change with how digests are triggered?
answer:
I'm sorry for the disruption this has caused your team - I understand the digest is a key part of your weekly workflow. I've confirmed on our end that digest generation jobs for your account failed silently for both March 3rd and March 10th due to an internal scheduling error, and I've escalated this to our notifications team for an immediate fix.

As a temporary measure, I'm manually triggering a digest send for this week's activity now, and I'll follow up here once the underlying scheduling issue is resolved so future digests go out automatically.

subject: Audit log missing entries for API-triggered actions
body:
I'm integrating with the Admin Console API and noticed that actions performed via the API - specifically user role changes made through the /admin/users endpoint - aren't showing up in the audit log at all, even though the same changes made through the UI do get logged. I tested this on March 12th with a role update for one test user and confirmed it succeeded (200 response) but nothing appeared in the audit log afterward.

Since we only have 3 seats, this is a small-scale test, but it matters a lot for our compliance tracking since we plan to automate role management via the API.
answer:
Thanks for the clear repro details - that's helpful. This does sound like a gap in audit logging specifically for API-originated admin actions, which shouldn't be the case since API and UI actions should log identically. I'm filing this as a bug with our platform team and will ask them to check whether other endpoints beyond /admin/users are affected as well.

I'll keep you posted on findings, and in the meantime I'd recommend keeping a local log of API-driven role changes as a temporary compliance safeguard until this is fixed.

subject: Request to change bulk deactivation workflow and add allowlist review
body:
We're restructuring how we handle user offboarding and want to change our current deactivation process in the Admin Console. Right now when we deactivate a user, their access to allowlisted IP ranges isn't automatically revoked, which our security team flagged during a recent audit. We deactivated 14 users last week and had to manually go clean up allowlist entries for each one.

Could we get this escalated to see if there's a setting to link deactivation with allowlist cleanup, or if this needs to become a feature request? We'd also like clarification on what shows up in the audit log versus the settings page for these actions.
answer:
Thanks for the detailed context, and I understand why this matters for your audit requirements. Currently, allowlist entries are managed independently from user deactivation status, so there isn't a built-in link between the two - I'm escalating this as a feature request to our product team given the security implications you've described.

On the audit log question, deactivation events are logged with timestamp and actor, but allowlist changes are logged separately under Settings history rather than the same audit trail. I'll follow up once I have feedback from product on the linking request.

subject: SCIM provisioning failing for new users - login blocked
body:
Our SCIM provisioning from Okta to Northwind has stopped creating new user accounts as of this morning. We tried provisioning 6 new employees for our energy trading desk and all 6 show as "pending" in Okta with an error referencing a 409 conflict response from Northwind's SCIM endpoint, even though these are new email addresses that shouldn't already exist in our system.

This is blocking these employees from logging in at all, and we need them onboarded today. Can someone look into this urgently?
answer:
I understand the urgency - blocking new hires from logging in is a real problem and we're prioritizing this now. A 409 conflict on SCIM user creation usually means our system thinks a matching user or externalId already exists, sometimes from a previous partial sync or a deactivated account with the same identifier.

Could you send me one of the affected usernames or externalIds so I can check our provisioning logs directly? In the meantime, if any of these users previously existed in Northwind under a different status, we may need to manually clear that record before SCIM can recreate it.

subject: How to schedule automatic deactivation for inactive users
body:
I'm trying to find a way to automatically deactivate users in the Admin Console after a period of inactivity, similar to a policy we had at a previous company. Right now we're manually reviewing our 77 seats every quarter and deactivating anyone who hasn't logged in, but it's time-consuming and we sometimes miss people.

Is there a setting for this, or a way to set up an alert instead if automatic deactivation isn't supported yet? Also curious how this would show up in the audit log if it is available.
answer:
Thanks for reaching out - automatic deactivation based on inactivity isn't currently available as a built-in setting, but it's a request we've heard from other admins managing similar seat counts, so I'll log this as feedback for our product team. In the meantime, the closest option we support is a scheduled report from the Admin Console showing last-login dates, which you could use to speed up your quarterly review.

If automatic deactivation is added in the future, it would generate the same audit log entries as manual deactivation, including timestamp and the policy that triggered it. I'll update you if this becomes available.

subject: Need to update unsubscribe handling for customer emails
body:
We need to change how unsubscribes work for our customer-facing Notifications emails. Currently when a customer unsubscribes from one type of alert, like promotional emails, it seems to unsubscribe them from all Northwind email categories, including order confirmations, which is causing real problems for our retail customers who still want transactional emails.

With 265 seats managing different email streams, we need category-level unsubscribe handling rather than a global opt-out. Is this something we can configure now, or does it require a change on your end?
answer:
This is an important distinction and I appreciate you flagging it clearly. Currently, unsubscribe preferences in Notifications are applied globally per recipient rather than per category, so there isn't a way to configure category-level opt-out on your end today. I'm submitting this as a change request to our notifications team given the impact on transactional email delivery for your customers.

As an interim step, I'd recommend reviewing whether your promotional and transactional emails are being sent through the same notification category, since separating them at the template level may reduce accidental unsubscribes in the short term.

subject: Question about upcoming API deprecations affecting our webhook integration
body:
I saw a note in the changelog about deprecations coming to the API Platform and wanted to clarify which endpoints are affected before we finalize our webhook integration. We're currently using the /v2/webhooks/register endpoint and the older SDK version 3.4, and I want to confirm whether these will still work after the deprecation date mentioned, or if we need to migrate to /v3 now.

Also, is there a recommended migration guide or timeline we should follow so we don't have to rework this twice?
answer:
Good timing to ask before finalizing your integration.
