The /v2/webhooks/register endpoint is included in the deprecation announcement and is scheduled to stop accepting new registrations in the coming release cycle, so I'd recommend building against /v3/webhooks/register directly rather than migrating later. SDK 3.4 will continue to receive security patches for now, but new webhook features will only be supported in SDK 4.x going forward.

I'll send over our migration guide link for the v2 to v3 webhook transition, and feel free to reply here with any specific payload differences you run into during testing.

subject: Webhook deliveries failing after SDK update - rate limit errors
body: We updated to the latest Northwind API SDK (v4.2) last week and since Tuesday our webhook endpoint for shipment.status_changed events is getting 429 responses intermittently. Around 30% of events for our 16-seat account are landing in the failed queue. We noticed the changelog mentions a deprecation of the old rate-limit headers but our retry logic seems to be misreading the new ones. Can you confirm the new rate limit threshold for webhook delivery and whether the SDK handles backoff automatically now?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report - this matches a known issue where the new rate-limit headers (X-RateLimit-Reset in epoch ms instead of seconds) can trip up older retry logic even on the updated SDK if a cached client instance was reused. Please upgrade to SDK 4.2.1 which fixes the header parsing, and in the meantime we've temporarily raised your webhook rate limit ceiling to reduce 429s while you deploy the fix. Let us know if failures continue after the update.

subject: Shared dashboard not showing updated chart data for viewer role
body: I'm integrating our energy usage dashboards via the API and set up a shared dashboard link for our operations viewers. When I export the dashboard as PDF it shows current data, but when a user with the 'viewer' sharing permission opens it in-browser, the main consumption chart is stuck showing data from three days ago. I checked the API response for the chart endpoint and it does return fresh data, so this seems isolated to the shared view rendering.
answer: Thanks for flagging this - it sounds like the shared view is serving a cached render rather than pulling live data on load. This is a known caching behavior for shared dashboard links tied to the chart component's refresh interval. Could you confirm the dashboard ID and the sharing link in question so we can check the cache TTL settings on our end and get you a fix or workaround?

subject: Salesforce sync stuck - contacts not updating since Monday
body: Our Salesforce integration through Northwind stopped syncing contact records on Monday. We use this to keep client records aligned between Vertex Legal's Salesforce org and our Northwind account for compliance tracking. The integration status page shows 'Connected' but the last successful sync timestamp is from three days ago, and no error notifications came through Slack where we usually get them.
answer: Sorry for the disruption to your sync - we can see the connection is authenticated but the sync job queue for your account appears to have stalled after a token refresh on our end. We're re-triggering the sync job manually now and will monitor to confirm contact records catch up. We'll also check why the Slack failure notification didn't fire, since that alerting should have flagged this immediately.

subject: SCIM provisioning failing for new employee accounts
body: Since this morning, new hires we add through our HR system aren't getting provisioned into Northwind via SCIM. The provisioning log shows a 'Permissions mismatch' error for the last 14 attempts, and none of these users can log in or complete MFA setup. This is affecting onboarding for our finance and travel booking teams across our 237-seat account, so we need this resolved quickly.
answer: This is a priority for us given the onboarding impact - the permissions mismatch error typically points to a role mapping change on the SCIM group configuration. We're pulling your provisioning logs now to identify which attribute is failing validation and will follow up within the hour with either a fix or a temporary manual provisioning workaround for the affected new hires.

subject: Plan upgrade added seats but billing didn't update correctly
body: I upgraded our Ember Labs account from our current plan to add more seats through the billing API last Thursday, and while the seat count updated in the admin panel, our next invoice preview still shows the old per-seat rate. I tried triggering a refresh via the /billing/plan endpoint but got a 500 error with no details. We just need the invoice to reflect the correct upgraded pricing before it generates on the 1st.
answer: Thanks for catching this before your invoice generates. The 500 error on the plan refresh endpoint suggests the pricing recalculation job didn't complete after your upgrade - we've manually triggered a resync on our end and your invoice preview should now reflect the correct per-seat rate. Please check within the next hour and let us know if the numbers still look off.

subject: Webhook delivery slow, taking several minutes
body: We've noticed webhook events for user.created and user.updated on our Atlas Works account are taking anywhere from 2 to 8 minutes to arrive rather than near-instant like before. Our integration relies on these for provisioning student accounts. Nothing has changed on our endpoint side that we're aware of - no recent SDK changes or config edits.
answer: Thanks for the report - delayed webhook delivery like this is usually caused by queue backlog rather than an endpoint issue on your side. We're checking our delivery infrastructure metrics for the affected time window now and will let you know what we find. In the meantime, delivery should eventually complete, just with the added latency you're seeing.

subject: Duplicate alert notifications going out to on-call team
body: Our on-call engineers have been getting duplicate copies of the same alert notification, sometimes 2-3 times within a minute, for critical severity alerts specifically. This started about a week ago and is causing alert fatigue on our team of 112 seats. We'd like to know if there's a way to configure deduplication rules, or if this is a bug on Northwind's side that needs escalation.
answer: Sorry for the noise this is causing your on-call team - duplicate critical alerts like this usually point to a retry mechanism firing when the initial delivery confirmation is delayed rather than lost. We're escalating this to our alerting infrastructure team to check delivery logs for your account, and in the meantime you can enable the deduplication window setting under Alert Rules to suppress repeats within a configurable timeframe.

subject: Requesting change to scheduled sync frequency for retail connector
body: We'd like to change our scheduled data pipeline sync for the retail sales connector from every 6 hours to hourly, since we're seeing noticeable latency in our reporting dashboards that rely on this data. Our current setup on the Starter plan syncs at 6-hour intervals and it's starting to affect our ability to react to daily sales trends.
answer: Thanks for the feedback on sync frequency - hourly syncs for the retail connector are supported, though please note this is generally available on higher-tier plans due to the increased pipeline load. We can walk you through upgrading if you'd like the hourly interval, or alternatively set you up on a 3-hour interval as a middle ground within your current plan. Let us know which direction you'd prefer.

subject: Biometric login fails after latest app update
body: After updating the Northwind mobile app last week, I can no longer log in using Face ID on my phone. It prompts for biometric authentication, then just returns me to the login screen without an error message. Password login still works fine. This is on iOS, and a couple of colleagues on our finance team mentioned the same thing happening to them after updating.
answer: Thanks for reporting this - a few other customers have flagged similar Face ID login issues after the recent iOS app update, which we're currently investigating as a session token handling bug post-biometric auth. As a workaround, please continue using password login for now, and we'll update this ticket as soon as a fix is available in the next app release.

subject: Need to change how critical alerts route to our team channels
body: We want to update our alert routing configuration so that critical severity notifications go to our escalation channel via email rather than the general notifications channel, since we've had a few critical alerts get buried among lower-priority ones. We're also seeing occasional duplicate alerts come through on the current routing setup, which adds to the confusion. Could someone help us reconfigure the routing rules for our account?
answer: Happy to help set up more precise alert routing for critical severity events. We can configure a routing rule that filters by severity level and sends critical alerts specifically to your designated escalation email, separate from your general notification stream. We'll also look into the duplicate alert reports you mentioned while we're making these changes - could you share one or two example alert IDs that came through duplicated so we can trace the cause?

subject: Storage retention policy deleted backups earlier than expected
body:
We're on the Starter plan and configured a 90-day retention policy on our storage bucket 'atlas-energy-prod' last month. This morning we noticed backups from March 2 through March 15 are gone, well before the 90-day window should have expired. Our last successful restore point is now March 16, which is a problem since our compliance team needs quarterly archives.

Can someone check the retention job logs for our account? We need to know if this is a quota issue or a bug in how retention is calculated on Starter tier.
answer: Thanks for flagging this, and I understand the urgency given your compliance requirements. I'm escalating this as a P1 since it involves unexpected data deletion. I've pulled the retention job logs for atlas-energy-prod and I can see a quota-triggered cleanup ran on March 15 that appears to have used a 14-day window instead of your configured 90-day policy. I'll confirm the root cause with engineering and let you know within a few hours whether any of the deleted backups are recoverable from our redundant storage layer.

subject: Deactivated user still shows in audit log as active
body: I deactivated a former employee's account (used to be under our legal-ops team) three days ago through the Admin Console, but when I pull up the audit log it still lists their last session as 'active' with no deactivation event recorded. I want to confirm this is just a display issue and not that the account is still actually live, since we handle healthcare records and need clean audit trails.
answer: Thanks for checking on this rather than assuming the worst. This is a known display quirk where the audit log entry for deactivation can lag up to 24-48 hours behind the actual account state change, even though access is revoked immediately. I've verified on our end that the account's session was terminated on the date you deactivated it. I'll also file feedback with our docs team to clarify this behavior so it's less confusing going forward.

subject: Users stuck at MFA enrollment screen during SSO login - can't complete provisioning
body:
We're rolling out SSO for 20 seats on Pioneer Retail's account and integrating via the Identity API. New users are being prompted to enroll in MFA on first login, but the enrollment screen just spins with 'Verifying...' and never completes. This is blocking every new hire we're trying to provision this week - about 6 users stuck so far.

We're calling the /v1/mfa/enroll endpoint from our onboarding flow and getting a 200 response back, but the UI never reflects the enrolled state. Is there a known issue with MFA enrollment sync for education-tier accounts?
answer: This sounds like a sync issue between the enrollment API response and session state, and since it's blocking all new user provisioning I'm treating this as P1. Can you send us one of the affected user IDs and the timestamp of a recent enroll attempt so we can trace it through our logs? In the meantime, as a workaround, users can try logging out completely and back in after the API call succeeds, which has resolved similar stuck states for other customers while we investigate the root cause.

subject: Request to change alert routing so duplicate emails stop going out
body:
Our notification setup is sending duplicate emails for the same alert event - we're seeing two identical emails for every billing threshold trigger, both hitting our ops distribution list. I've confirmed we only have one webhook and one email channel configured in the Notifications settings, so this doesn't look like a config mistake on our end.

Could you help us figure out the correct routing setup, or is this a known bug with how alert channels fan out? We'd like to move to a single consolidated email per event if possible.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. We have seen a handful of cases where alert routing fans out to duplicate channels when an event matches more than one rule condition, even if only one channel is visibly configured. Could you share the alert rule name and approximate timestamp of a duplicate pair so we can trace the routing logic? In the meantime, I'd recommend reviewing your rule conditions for overlap as a first check while we look into whether this is a bug on our side.

subject: How to restrict workspace settings changes to specific IP ranges
body: As part of a security review, we need to lock down who can modify workspace settings in the Admin Console - specifically we want to allowlist a set of corporate IP ranges so settings changes are only possible from our office network. I don't see an obvious option for this under Settings > Security. Is this supported on our Pro plan, and if so, where do we configure it?
answer: Good question, and this is supported on Pro. Under Settings > Security > Access Control, there's an IP Allowlist section that can be scoped specifically to admin actions rather than all logins, which sounds like what you need. I'll walk you through the CIDR format we expect and send a quick guide, and please let us know once it's configured so we can confirm the audit log is capturing the restriction correctly.

subject: Dashboard PDF export missing charts / timing out for large reports
body:
When exporting our quarterly energy usage dashboard to PDF, two of the six charts come out blank in the downloaded file - specifically the stacked bar chart and the trend line with the 12-month rolling average. Smaller dashboards export fine. This one has about 40k data points across the charts and the export sometimes just times out after a minute or two with no error message shown.

We need this export for a board meeting on Thursday, so any guidance on a workaround would help.
answer: Thanks for the details, and I understand the Thursday deadline. Larger charts with high data point counts can hit a rendering timeout during PDF generation, which likely explains both the blank charts and the timeouts you're seeing. As a workaround, try exporting the two problem charts individually or reducing the date range to under 6 months, which should keep them under the rendering limit while we look into raising the timeout threshold for Pro accounts.

subject: Users getting logged out every 10-15 minutes across the board
body:
Starting sometime yesterday afternoon, our whole team has been getting logged out of the Northwind dashboard every 10-15 minutes, forcing repeated re-logins with MFA each time. This is happening across different browsers and devices, not just one machine. We have 160 seats and this is seriously slowing down everyone's workflow right now.

Our session timeout setting has always been 8 hours and hasn't been changed recently on our end. Can you check if something changed on the identity service side?
answer: This is affecting your whole organization so we're treating it as P1 and looking into it right now. We've had a report from one other customer of unexpectedly short session lifetimes starting around the same timeframe, so this may be a broader issue on our identity service rather than something in your configuration. I'll update you as soon as we have a root cause, and in the meantime there's no local workaround other than re-authenticating, which I know isn't ideal - we'll move fast on this.

subject: Salesforce sync in Integrations not pulling new leads since last week
body:
We set up the Salesforce integration a few months ago to sync new leads into our pipeline automatically, and it's been working fine until last Tuesday. Since then, no new Salesforce leads are showing up on our side even though we've confirmed new records exist in Salesforce. The integration status page still shows 'Connected' with a green check.

We're not seeing any error notifications either. Is there a sync log we can check, or a known issue with the Salesforce connector this week?
answer: Thanks for the report - a sync showing 'Connected' while silently failing to pull new records is definitely something we want to dig into. Can you confirm the Salesforce object type you're syncing (Leads vs Contacts) and roughly how many records existed before last Tuesday's cutoff? I'll pull the sync job logs for your integration on our end in parallel to check for silent failures or rate-limit issues around that date.

subject: App crashes immediately on launch after last update
body: Since updating the mobile app a couple days ago, it crashes right on launch before I can even get to the login screen - happens every time on my Android phone. I tried reinstalling but it still crashes instantly. I mainly use the app to check freight dashboards while offline during warehouse rounds, so this is annoying but not blocking my main work since I can still use the desktop version.
answer: Sorry for the trouble with the crash, and thanks for confirming you've already tried a reinstall. Could you let us know your Android version and the app version number shown on the store listing, plus your device model? That will help us reproduce the crash on our end - in the meantime the desktop dashboard should work as a stopgap for your offline reference needs.

subject: Charts on our main dashboard rendering broken/blank today
body: Since this morning, several charts on our main travel bookings dashboard are showing up broken - some render as empty gray boxes, others show a partial axis with no data plotted. This is happening across the two dashboards our team uses daily for tracking booking volume, and it's affecting all 8 of our users, not just me. Refreshing the page and clearing cache didn't help.
answer: Thanks for reporting this quickly - since it's affecting your whole team's daily dashboards, I'm marking this P2 and looking into it now. Can you confirm whether this started right after any recent changes to the dashboard, such as adding a new chart or data source, and share one of the affected dashboard URLs? We'll check for any rendering service issues on our side in parallel while we wait for that detail.

subject: 429 errors spiking on API Platform since this morning
body:
We're seeing a sharp increase in 429 responses from the /v2/orders endpoint starting around 8:40am today. Our webhook consumer for inventory sync is failing roughly 60% of calls now, and retries are just hitting the same rate limit wall. We haven't changed our call volume - it's been steady at about 400 req/min for weeks.

Can someone confirm if there was a rate limit change pushed recently? This is blocking our nightly reconciliation job from Pioneer Retail and we need it resolved today.
answer: Thanks for flagging this, and sorry for the disruption. We did roll out a tightened rate limit tier on the /v2/orders endpoint late last night as part of a deprecation of the legacy quota model - it looks like your account wasn't migrated to the new higher-throughput tier before the change went live. I'm escalating this now to bump your account back to the appropriate limit and will confirm within the hour once it's applied.

subject: Charts not rendering on shared dashboard
body:
One of our shared dashboards (the Q3 Retail Performance one) is showing blank chart panels for a couple of teammates, though it renders fine on my end. Two colleagues report the bar chart and the trend line widget just show a loading spinner indefinitely, even after refreshing.

This isn't blocking anything critical since I can still export data manually, but it'd be good to get it fixed since we review this dashboard weekly with the wider Willow Foods team.
answer: Thanks for the details. This sounds like it could be a caching or permissions mismatch on the shared link rather than the dashboard itself. Could you confirm whether the affected teammates are viewing via a shared link or logged into their own accounts? In the meantime, try having them clear browser cache or open in an incognito window - I'll also check our logs for rendering errors tied to that dashboard ID.

subject: How to export dashboard with multiple charts to PDF
body:
I'm trying to export our monthly finance dashboard, which has five charts and two tables, into a single PDF for our leadership review. When I click Export, only the first chart shows up in the resulting PDF and the rest of the page is blank.

Is there a setting I'm missing, or a size limit on export? We need this working before our board meeting next week at Quill Foods.
answer: Good catch - PDF export currently has a rendering limit when a dashboard exceeds four widgets above the fold, which can cause the rest to be cut off. As a workaround, try resizing the dashboard layout to fit within a single page height before exporting, or export in landscape mode from the export settings menu. I'll also log this as a product improvement request so we can raise the widget threshold.

subject: Question about upload retry behavior and quota limits
body:
We've noticed intermittent upload failures on a few large batch jobs (around 2-4GB files) over the past week, with errors like 'upload interrupted, please retry.' Sometimes retrying works immediately, other times it fails three or four times before succeeding.

I wanted to ask about our current storage quota and whether we're close to any threshold that could be causing this, and also what the retention policy is for failed upload chunks - are those cleaned up automatically or do they count against our quota at Atlas Freight?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. Intermittent failures on large files are usually related to network timeout thresholds rather than quota, but I'll check your account's current usage against your allocated limit to rule that out. Failed upload chunks are automatically purged after 24 hours and do not count toward your quota - I'll follow up with your exact usage numbers and any retry-timeout settings we can adjust on our end.

subject: Users getting logged out every few minutes via SSO
body:
Since yesterday afternoon, our team members authenticating through SSO are being logged out roughly every 5-10 minutes, even during active use. This is happening across multiple browsers and affects users provisioned through our SAML integration. We haven't touched our IdP configuration recently.

This is severely disrupting work for our whole engineering team at Pioneer Works - people can't stay logged into the admin console long enough to finish tasks. Please treat this as urgent, we need a fix today.
answer: This is being treated as a P1 and we're investigating immediately. Initial logs show session tokens issued through your SAML integration expiring far earlier than the configured 8-hour window, which points to a possible misconfiguration introduced in a recent session-policy update on our side. We're rolling back that change now and will update you within the hour with confirmation and root cause.

subject: Clarifying retention policy for archived storage files
body:
I'm trying to understand how long files stay in Storage after they're moved to the archive tier. We have several compliance-related documents that need to be retrievable for at least 3 years, but our current documentation only mentions a 90-day default retention window before deletion.

Could you confirm whether archived files are exempt from that 90-day rule, or if we need to configure a custom retention policy for our Cobalt Freight account to avoid losing anything important?
answer: Good question, and important to get right given the compliance angle. Archived-tier files are not subject to the default 90-day deletion rule - that applies only to standard-tier storage. However, to guarantee the 3-year retention you need, I'd recommend setting an explicit custom retention policy on the archive folder rather than relying on defaults. I can walk you through configuring that policy on a quick call if helpful.

subject: Backup restore issue
body:
We've been using Northwind Storage for about eight months now to back up our internal document repository, and it's generally worked well for our compliance audits. Last quarter we even increased our backup frequency to daily snapshots after a recommendation from your team.

The actual problem is that when I tried to restore last Tuesday's snapshot today, the restore job completed but none of the files from that snapshot actually appeared in the target folder. I checked twice and the folder is empty, though the job status shows 'completed successfully.' We need those files back for an audit due Friday at Apex Capital.
answer: Thanks for the thorough context, and apologies for the trouble ahead of your audit deadline. A restore job showing 'completed' with no files present usually indicates the snapshot metadata pointed to an empty manifest, which can happen if the snapshot indexing lagged behind the actual backup. I'm pulling the logs for that specific snapshot now and will let you know within the day whether we can re-trigger the restore from a valid checkpoint.

subject: How do I set up Slack alerts for pipeline failures?
body:
We'd like to get Slack notifications whenever one of our data pipeline jobs fails, ideally posted to a dedicated #data-alerts channel. I see Integrations lists Slack as a connected app already for our Jira notifications, but I can't find where to configure alert rules specifically for pipeline events.

Is this something supported today, or would we need to build it through a webhook ourselves at Blue Robotics?
answer: Slack alerts for pipeline failures are supported natively - you'll want to go to Integrations > Slack > Alert Rules and add a new rule scoped to 'Data Pipeline' events, then select the failure severity and target channel. Since Slack is already connected for your Jira notifications, you shouldn't need to reauthorize anything. Let me know if the Alert Rules tab doesn't appear and I can check your integration permissions.

subject: App crashes when reconnecting after offline mode
body:
Our team has been testing the mobile app's offline mode ahead of rolling it out to field staff. When a device goes offline, makes a few local changes, then reconnects, the app crashes consistently on the sync screen. This happens on both iOS 17 and Android 14 test devices, about 8 out of 10 times.

We also noticed that after the crash, users are logged out and have to sign in again, which then triggers a re-sync that sometimes duplicates the offline changes. This is blocking our field rollout at Willow Freight and we need a fix soon.
answer: Thanks for the detailed reproduction steps, this is very helpful. A crash on sync followed by forced logout strongly suggests the local change queue is hitting a conflict resolution error that isn't being caught gracefully. We're prioritizing this and I'll need the app version and a device log from one of the crash instances if you can share it - that will let our mobile team pinpoint the exact sync step failing.

subject: Dashboards extremely slow to load since this morning
body:
Since around 9am today, every dashboard in our workspace is taking 30-60 seconds to load, when it's normally under 5 seconds. This is affecting all of our analysts here at Pioneer Systems, not just one dashboard - even simple single-chart views are lagging badly.

We rely on these dashboards for daily clinical operations reporting, so this is a significant disruption right now. Can someone look into this urgently?
answer: We're escalating this immediately as a P1 given the widespread impact. Our monitoring shows elevated query latency on the dashboard rendering service starting around 9:15am, which lines up with your report, and we're investigating whether this is tied to a backend scaling issue affecting multiple accounts. I'll update you within 30 minutes with progress or a mitigation.

subject: Refund not applied to invoice INV-88213
body:
We were issued a service credit of $1,840 on March 3rd after the outage last month, but our invoice INV-88213 dated March 31 still shows the full amount due. Our AP team is ready to pay but I need the credit reflected before we can process it. We have 273 seats on the Pro plan and this credit was confirmed by your billing team via case #55210.

Could someone apply the credit or issue a corrected invoice this week? Our payment run is scheduled for Friday and I'd rather not pay the full amount and wait for a refund.
answer: Thanks for flagging this, and apologies for the delay in getting the credit reflected on your invoice. I've located case #55210 and confirmed the $1,840 credit was approved but not synced to INV-88213 due to a processing gap on our end. I'm escalating this to our billing operations team now to issue a corrected invoice before your Friday payment run, and I'll update you here as soon as it's done, likely within one business day.

subject: Connector-Authentifizierung schlägt fehl
body:
Wir versuchen seit gestern, unseren neuen REST-Connector für die Energiedaten-Pipeline zu authentifizieren, aber jeder Versuch endet mit dem Fehler 'invalid_client: token exchange failed'. Der API-Key wurde erst letzte Woche neu generiert und ist laut Dashboard aktiv. Wir haben es mit drei verschiedenen Keys getestet, das Problem bleibt gleich.

Da unsere Pipeline für die tägliche Verbrauchsdatensynchronisierung davon abhängt und wir nur 4 Sitzplätze im Starter-Plan haben, brauchen wir das dringend gelöst, sonst verpassen wir den Reporting-Termin morgen früh.
answer: Vielen Dank für die genaue Fehlerbeschreibung. Der Fehler 'invalid_client: token exchange failed' deutet meist darauf hin, dass der Connector noch mit einem alten Client-Secret verknüpft ist, selbst wenn der Key im Dashboard aktiv aussieht. Ich prüfe gerade Ihr Konto und werde die Connector-Konfiguration manuell neu verknüpfen, damit die Synchronisierung heute noch läuft; ich melde mich innerhalb der nächsten Stunde mit einem Status-Update.

subject: Duplicate daily digest emails going to all staff
body:
Since yesterday morning our team has been receiving the daily inventory digest email twice, sometimes three times, each about 20 minutes apart. All three of our seats are getting duplicates, which is confusing our warehouse staff about which numbers are current. This started right after we updated the digest schedule to 7am instead of 6am on Tuesday.

Can you check if the schedule change created a second active job? We need this fixed before tomorrow's digest goes out again.
answer: Thank you for the report - this is impacting your whole team so I'm treating it as urgent. It looks like changing the schedule time created a duplicate digest job instead of updating the existing one, which is why you're seeing multiple sends. I'm removing the duplicate job now and will verify only one 7am digest is scheduled before tomorrow's run, and I'll confirm here once it's cleaned up.

subject: webhook retry config
body: Can we get configurable retry counts for webhooks? Need more than 3 attempts.
answer: Thanks for the request. Configurable retry counts aren't available yet, but I'm logging this as a feature request for our API Platform team and will let you know if it gets scheduled. In the meantime, I can manually increase your account's retry limit to 6 attempts if that helps unblock you now.

subject: SDK throwing 429 errors despite being under documented rate limit
body:
Our team supports Northwind integrations for several of our own client schools, and we're seeing the Python SDK (v4.2.1) throw HTTP 429 'rate limit exceeded' errors even though our request volume is well under the 1000 req/min documented for Enterprise. This started after we upgraded from v4.1.8 last Thursday. Here's a sample from our logs:

Traceback (most recent call last):
  File 'client.py', line 214, in request
    raise RateLimitError(response.json())
northwind.errors.RateLimitError: {'code': 429, 'message': 'rate limit exceeded', 'retry_after': 60}

We're only sending about 300 req/min across our 3651 seats, so this doesn't match documented limits. Is there a separate per-endpoint limit that changed with v4.2.1, or a deprecation we missed in the changelog?
answer: Thanks for the detailed logs, this is helpful. We did roll out a per-endpoint rate limit alongside the v4.2.1 SDK release that isn't yet reflected in the public docs, specifically on the webhook-subscriptions endpoint, which caps at 300 req/min regardless of account tier. I suspect that's what you're hitting; I'm updating the documentation now and will also check whether we can raise that specific limit for your account given your Enterprise volume, and will follow up within the day.

subject: Recurring transform failures on nightly booking sync
body:
Our nightly transform job that normalizes booking records from our travel connector has failed intermittently for the past week, roughly 2 to 3 times out of 7 runs. The pipeline logs show a 'schema mismatch: expected field currency_code, got null' error on a subset of records, which we think comes from a source system update on our end around October 14th.

We'd like guidance on how to configure a fallback or default value transform so these records don't fail the whole batch. Is there existing documentation on conditional field defaults within the transform builder?
answer: Thanks for the clear breakdown, that timing lines up with a likely upstream schema change. Yes, the transform builder supports conditional defaults - you can add a 'coalesce' step ahead of your mapping stage to substitute a default currency_code value when the source field is null, which should prevent the whole batch from failing. I'll send over a documentation link with a worked example and a short walkthrough tailored to your pipeline configuration.

subject: Biometric login stopped working on iOS after last update
body:
Since updating to the latest mobile app version last week, none of our workspace users on iOS can log in with Face ID anymore - it prompts once, fails silently, then falls back to password every time. Android users on our team don't seem affected. This is happening across multiple devices, not just one person's phone.

We manage the mobile access for our clinical staff, so having to re-enter passwords constantly is slowing down shift handoffs. Is this a known issue with the recent iOS release, and is there a workaround while it's being fixed?
answer: Thank you for reporting this - we've had a couple of similar reports of Face ID failing silently on iOS following last week's release, and our mobile team is actively investigating a regression in the biometric handshake introduced in that build. As a workaround, disabling and re-enabling biometric login under Settings > Security has resolved it for some users, though it may need to be repeated after the next update. I'll keep you posted on the fix timeline.

subject: Question about push notification settings for expense approvals
body:
I approve expense reports through the mobile app and would like to get a push notification only when an expense is pending my approval, not for every status change. Right now I get notified for submissions, approvals, and rejections, which is a lot of noise for our small team of 3.

Is there a way to filter push notification types, or is that something you're planning to add? Not urgent, just trying to reduce interruptions during the day.
answer: Good question, and thanks for the context. Right now push notifications for expense workflows are all-or-nothing, so there isn't a way to filter to just pending-approval alerts yet, but I'm passing this along to our mobile product team as a feature suggestion since it's a reasonable ask. In the meantime, you can mute notifications during specific hours in the app's Do Not Disturb setting to cut down on interruptions.

subject: Slack integration stopped posting alerts to our ops channel
body:
Our Slack integration for shipment exception alerts has been silent since Monday - no messages have posted to our #logistics-ops channel even though the source events are showing up fine in the Northwind dashboard. We haven't changed the Slack app permissions or the channel on our end. We have 160 seats and this integration is used heavily by our dispatch team throughout the day.

Could you check whether the Slack webhook token expired or if something changed on your side? We'd like to avoid missing exception alerts during peak shipping hours this week.
answer: Thanks for the report - I can see on our end that the Slack webhook associated with your #logistics-ops channel returned repeated 403 errors starting Monday, which suggests the OAuth token was revoked, likely during a Slack workspace permissions review on your end. I'd recommend reauthorizing the Slack integration from your Integrations settings page, which should regenerate a valid token; I'll stay on this ticket until you confirm alerts are flowing again.

subject: Users can't unsubscribe from weekly report emails
body:
Several of our analysts have clicked the unsubscribe link at the bottom of the weekly report digest email, but they keep receiving it anyway - one colleague has clicked it three separate times over the past two weeks with no change. We checked and their email preferences show 'unsubscribed' in the account settings page, so there's a mismatch somewhere between that setting and the actual send list.

We only have 22 seats, so this is affecting a good chunk of our team. Can you help figure out why unsubscribes aren't taking effect?
answer: Thanks for flagging this and for the specific example, that's very useful. This looks like a sync delay between the preference center and the digest mailing list, where unsubscribe status isn't propagating to the next scheduled send. I'm manually removing the affected users from the current send list now and investigating the sync job so this doesn't recur for the rest of your team; I'll confirm once it's resolved.

subject: Push notifications not arriving after app crash on Android
body: We've had reports from three of our store managers that push notifications stopped coming through on the Northwind mobile app after it crashed while switching networks (wifi to LTE). The app force-closes on login screen the first time after the crash, then reopens fine, but pushes never resume until the device is restarted. This has happened on two Pixel devices and one Samsung A54 since Monday. Is there a known issue with push token refresh after a crash, and is there a workaround we can tell staff to use in the meantime?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. This matches a known issue where the push token isn't re-registered after an abrupt app termination during a network switch, so notifications silently stop until the app is fully restarted rather than just reopened. As a workaround, please have affected staff force-quit and relaunch the app (not just bring it to foreground) after any crash, which should re-trigger token registration. We're tracking a permanent fix for the crash itself and will update this ticket once it's rolled out.

subject: Offline mode causing slow sync and duplicate push alerts
body: Since enabling offline mode for our field team last week, several users are seeing the app take 20-30 seconds to sync once connectivity returns, and during that window they get duplicate push notifications for the same transaction approval. We have 25 seats on the account and about 15 people use offline mode daily. Can you confirm whether sync batching is supposed to dedupe notifications, or is there a setting we're missing?
answer: Appreciate you flagging this — duplicate pushes during offline sync usually happen when the queued events are replayed before the server has deduplicated them against ones already delivered live. This isn't expected behavior and we'd like to look at your account's sync logs to confirm the root cause. Could you send us the device time and approximate timestamp of one recent duplicate so we can trace it? In the meantime, we recommend keeping offline sessions under 10 minutes where possible to reduce the queue size.

subject: Salesforce sync failing on custom field mapping
body: We're integrating Northwind with Salesforce for our student records pipeline and the sync job has been failing since yesterday with 'Field mapping error: custom__c field not found on target object' even though the field exists and is visible in our Salesforce sandbox. We followed the mapping guide in the docs but the UI only shows standard fields in the dropdown, not our custom ones. Can you clarify whether custom field sync requires a separate API scope or permission set in Salesforce?
answer: Thanks for the details — custom fields do require the 'Northwind Sync' permission set to be assigned to the integration user in Salesforce, otherwise they won't populate in our field mapping dropdown even if they're visible elsewhere. Could you confirm that permission set is assigned to the same user whose OAuth token we're using for the connection? If it's already assigned, send us the integration ID and we'll check the mapping cache on our end, since it can occasionally get stale after new fields are added.

subject: Users getting logged out every 15 minutes via SSO
body: Since we integrated Northwind SSO with our Okta tenant last week, users are being forced to re-authenticate roughly every 15 minutes, even during active use of the API dashboard. Our session timeout is configured for 8 hours on both the Okta side and in the Northwind admin settings. We're seeing 'session_expired' errors in our app logs tied to token refresh calls. This is disrupting work for our whole 18-person team and we need to understand if this is an MFA re-prompt issue or a token TTL mismatch.
answer: Sorry for the disruption this is causing your team. A 15-minute forced re-auth despite an 8-hour configured session usually points to the refresh token TTL being overridden by an MFA re-verification policy on the Okta side rather than our SSO config — could you check if 'Re-authentication frequency' or a similar MFA policy is set separately from the session lifetime in your Okta admin console? We'll also pull your tenant's SSO logs for the last 24 hours to confirm the token expiry values we're issuing match what you expect.

subject: Need PDF export option for shared dashboards
body: We'd like to export our operations dashboard to PDF so we can share weekly reports with our warehouse partners who don't have Northwind accounts. Right now I only see a CSV export option under the dashboard menu, no PDF. Is this feature available on our plan, or is there a way to enable it? Even a basic export with the chart images would be enough for our needs.
answer: PDF export for dashboards is currently available on Pro and Enterprise plans, so it isn't showing up in your dashboard menu on the Starter plan. If sharing with external partners is the main goal, one option in the meantime is using the public share link feature, which renders the dashboard as a read-only web view they can view without an account. I'll also pass your request for PDF export on Starter along to our product team as feedback.

subject: URGENT: Mobile app crashing on login for offline-mode users across all campuses
body: Starting this morning we have a widespread crash affecting students and staff trying to log into the mobile app when offline mode is enabled. The app crashes immediately on the login screen before the credential check even completes, across iOS and Android. This is affecting users at all of our 40+ campus locations and we're getting a flood of help desk tickets. Version is 4.12.3, and disabling offline mode in device settings does not help since it's enforced at the org policy level.
answer: This is being treated as a high priority incident given the scope of impact across your campuses. We've identified a regression in 4.12.3 related to the offline credential cache initializing before the login screen renders, causing the crash you're describing. We're pushing an emergency patch now and will also push a server-side flag to temporarily disable the offline credential pre-check for your org so users can log in normally while the patch rolls out — we'll confirm here within the hour once that's live.

subject: Request: route critical alerts to a different email than warnings
body: Right now all our Northwind alerts (API errors, quota warnings, deployment notices) go to the same distribution list. We'd like to route critical/severity-high alerts to our on-call email and keep lower-severity ones on the general list. Is there a way to configure alert routing rules by severity in the Notifications settings, or would we need to filter this on our end using webhooks?
answer: Thanks for the suggestion — severity-based routing rules aren't available yet in the Notifications settings; today all alerts for a given integration go to the configured address regardless of severity. The webhook approach is the right workaround for now: you can subscribe to our alerts webhook and filter by the 'severity' field in the payload to route critical ones to your on-call address. I've logged this as a feature request with our product team as well.

subject: Audit log missing entries after bulk user deactivation - need urgent review
body: We ran a bulk deactivation of 34 former contractor accounts yesterday through the Admin Console, but when I go to the audit log to verify the deactivation timestamps for our compliance review, only 12 of the 34 entries show up. The rest of the accounts are correctly showing as deactivated in the user list, but there's no corresponding audit trail. We have a compliance audit next week and need this resolved quickly. Also, can you confirm the allowlist settings weren't affected by this bulk action?
answer: Given the compliance deadline, we're escalating this immediately. Missing audit entries for a subset of a bulk action usually indicates a logging delay or batch write failure on our side rather than data loss on the account list, and we're pulling the raw event logs now to reconcile the missing 22 entries. We'll also verify your allowlist configuration wasn't touched by the bulk deactivation and report back within the next few hours with either the restored audit entries or a clear explanation of what happened.

subject: Dashboards taking 30+ seconds to load, blocking our review meeting prep
body: Our team dashboards have gone from loading in a few seconds to 30-40 seconds over the past week, particularly the ones with multiple line charts pulling from our energy usage datasets. We have a board review this Friday and need to share several of these dashboards live, so the slowness is a real risk. Is this a known performance issue with multi-chart dashboards, or something specific to our account we can fix before then?
answer: Thanks for raising this ahead of your Friday review — we're prioritizing it given the timeline. Dashboards with several line charts pulling from large datasets can slow down if the underlying queries aren't using cached aggregates, and we've seen this pattern before when data volume grows past a certain threshold. We're pulling the query performance logs for your account's dashboards now and will follow up today with either a fix or specific configuration changes you can make to speed things up before Friday.

subject: Charts rendering blank after API update to v3 dashboard endpoint
body: After migrating our integration to the v3 dashboards API last week, several of our charts are rendering completely blank on the embedded dashboard, even though the API response shows data in the payload when I check it directly. This started right after the migration and affects bar and line charts specifically, not tables. We also noticed the export-to-image option is now missing from the chart menu since the update. Can you help identify what changed in v3 that would cause this?
answer: Thanks for the specifics — this looks related to a schema change in v3 where chart rendering now expects the 'series' field to be explicitly typed rather than inferred, which would explain blank bar and line charts while tables render fine. Could you share one example payload from a blank chart so we can confirm the field types? On the missing export-to-image option, that's a known gap in the current v3 rollout and we expect it back within the next release cycle.

subject: Repeated upload failures to Storage since Nov 3
body:
I'm a data analyst on the compliance team at Delta Energy and I've been trying to upload our monthly legal archive batch (about 4,200 files, ~18GB total) into our Storage bucket since Monday. Roughly 1 in 5 uploads fails with a generic 'upload_failed' error and no retry happens automatically. I checked our quota dashboard and we're at 71% of our Starter allocation, so it shouldn't be a capacity issue.

Can you tell us whether this is a known bug with large batch uploads, and whether retention settings on our legal folder could be interfering? We need these files archived before end of week for a compliance deadline.
answer:
Thanks for the detailed report. Intermittent upload_failed errors on large batches are usually tied to a chunking timeout on our end rather than quota, but I want to rule out retention policy conflicts on your legal folder since those can silently block writes. Could you send me two or three of the failed file names or object keys plus timestamps so I can trace them in our upload logs?

In the meantime, try reducing the batch concurrency to see if the failure rate drops - that will help us confirm whether it's a throughput issue. I'll keep this ticket open at P2 and follow up once I've reviewed the logs.

subject: Credit balance not reflecting refunded API overage charge
body:
I'm integrating our billing sync with the Northwind Billing API for Granite Foods and noticed our account shows a refund of $340 processed on Oct 28 for an API overage charge, but our credit balance still shows $0 available. The refund appears in our invoice history as 'Refunded' but when I call GET /v1/account/credits it returns an empty array.

We need this credit applied correctly before our next billing cycle closes on the 15th, since we're expecting it to offset next month's invoice. Can someone check why the credit isn't syncing to the account balance endpoint?
answer:
Thank you for flagging this - a refund showing as processed but not reflected in the credits endpoint usually means the ledger entry didn't propagate to the balance service, which is a known sync delay we're actively tracking. I've pulled up your account and can confirm the $340 refund is recorded on our side; I'm escalating internally to force a manual balance recalculation.

I'll update you within one business day once the credit appears correctly in GET /v1/account/credits, and we'll make sure it applies before your cycle closes on the 15th.

subject: SSO login granting wrong roles to all users after IdP update
body:
This morning our IT team pushed an update to our Okta configuration and now every user logging into Northwind through SSO for Vertex Legal is being mapped to the 'Viewer' role instead of their assigned role, including admins. We have 6 seats and all of them are currently locked out of the permissions they need to do their jobs, including access to client case files.

This is a fintech environment and losing correct role mapping is a serious issue for us given audit requirements. Can someone urgently check the SAML attribute mapping on our tenant? We need this fixed today.
answer:
I understand the urgency and I'm treating this as a P0 given the access and compliance impact. I'm pulling up your SAML configuration now to check the attribute mapping between your Okta groups and our role assignments - this is often caused by a group claim name mismatch after an IdP-side change.

I'll have a status update for you within the next 30 minutes, and if we identify a mapping issue I can push a manual override to restore correct roles for your admins immediately while we fix the mapping permanently.

subject: Request to rotate API keys ahead of SDK v3 deprecation
body:
I'm a data analyst supporting our integration team at Lumen Travel, and we saw the notice that the v2 SDK and its associated webhook signing method will be deprecated next quarter. We currently have 14 active API keys across our media pipeline services and want to rotate them proactively to the new key format before the cutoff.

Could you confirm the rotation process for accounts our size, whether old and new keys can run in parallel during a transition window, and if there's a way to bulk-generate keys via the admin API instead of doing it one by one through the console?
answer:
Good timing on getting ahead of this - yes, old and new key formats can run in parallel for up to 90 days after rotation, so you won't have any downtime during the transition. For bulk generation, the admin API does support a batch key creation endpoint (POST /v1/admin/api-keys/batch) which is much faster than doing it through the console for 14 keys.

I'll send over the migration guide covering the webhook signing changes as well, since that's the part most teams miss when moving off v2. Let me know once you start the rotation and I can help verify the new keys are signing correctly.

subject: Push notifications not delivering to iOS users since update
body:
I support our mobile app users at Atlas Foods and since our app update went live Tuesday, push notifications for transaction alerts are not reaching any of our iOS users - we've confirmed this across all 5 of our internal test accounts and gotten reports from customers too. Android devices seem fine. Our app uses the Northwind Mobile SDK for push delivery and the notification logs show status 'sent' on your end but nothing arrives on device.

This is affecting a core feature for our fintech customers who rely on real-time alerts, so we need this resolved quickly. Can you check if something changed with the APNs configuration on your side?
answer:
Thanks for the clear reproduction details - this does sound like an APNs certificate or token issue on our delivery pipeline since Android is unaffected. I'm escalating this to our mobile infrastructure team right now to check the APNs configuration tied to your app's push credentials, since a 'sent' status with no device delivery usually points to a certificate expiry or environment mismatch (sandbox vs production).

I'll update you within a few hours with findings, and if it's on our end we'll prioritize a fix given the impact on your customers' transaction alerts.

subject: How to deactivate users while preserving audit log entries
body:
I'm integrating our provisioning workflow with the Admin Console API for Delta Media and need to deactivate about 30 users who left the company last month. When I call the deactivate endpoint, it works, but I noticed the audit log entries for those users seem to disappear from the console view after deactivation rather than just being marked inactive.

Is this expected behavior, or is there a setting to preserve historical audit log visibility for deactivated users? We need this for our manufacturing compliance records and want to make sure we're not losing history.
answer:
Good question, and this is expected but a bit confusing in the UI - deactivated users' audit log entries are filtered out of the default view but are not deleted; you can retrieve them by toggling 'Include inactive users' in the audit log filter panel or by passing include_inactive=true on the audit log API endpoint. Nothing is lost from a compliance standpoint.

I'd recommend adding that flag to your provisioning workflow's reporting step if you need consistent visibility going forward. Let me know if you'd like a walkthrough of the filter settings.

subject: Jira integration not creating linked issues from Slack
body:
I'm setting up the Integrations module for Orion Foods to connect Jira, Slack, and Okta for our legal team's ticket workflow. The Jira link works fine when triggered manually from the Northwind dashboard, but when I try to create a linked Jira issue from a Slack slash command, it times out after about 15 seconds with 'integration_error: jira_sync_failed' and no issue gets created.

We rely on this for tracking client requests quickly through Slack, and with 122 seats using this daily, the timeout is becoming a real bottleneck. Can someone check the Jira connector logs on your end for our workspace?
answer:
Thanks for the specifics - a 15 second timeout with jira_sync_failed on the Slack-triggered path but not the manual dashboard path suggests the Slack command is hitting a shorter timeout window than the Jira API call needs to complete. I'm pulling the connector logs for your workspace now to confirm whether it's a latency issue on the Jira side or a configuration mismatch in the Slack app's request timeout setting.

I'll follow up shortly with findings and a workaround if we can't resolve the root cause immediately, since I know this is blocking your daily workflow.

subject: Storage quota alert triggered but usage doesn't match dashboard
body:
I'm the product manager overseeing our retail catalog data at Harbor Foods, and we received a quota exceeded alert this morning blocking new uploads, but our Storage dashboard shows we're only at 68% of our Starter plan's allocated quota. This is stopping our merchandising team from uploading updated product images for a launch scheduled tomorrow.

Can someone verify our actual usage versus the quota limit and let me know if this is a display bug or if there's a retention policy holding onto deleted files that's inflating our real usage count? We need uploads unblocked as soon as possible.
answer:
Thanks for flagging this - a quota block with usage showing well under the limit on the dashboard often means there's a discrepancy between billed usage and the enforcement service, sometimes caused by retention holding deleted objects that haven't been purged yet. I'm checking your account's actual byte usage against the enforcement record now and will escalate to get uploads unblocked given your launch timeline tomorrow.

I'll have an update for you within a few hours, and if it's confirmed as a sync issue we can manually lift the block while we fix the underlying count.

subject: urgent
body:
our connector for the main sales data pipeline has been failing auth every single sync for the past two days and NOBODY on your team has responded to the two tickets we already filed. we have 243 seats depending on this data being fresh for daily reporting and right now everything is stale. the error just says 'connector_auth_failed: token_expired' but the refresh token flow is supposed to handle that automatically and clearly it's not.

this is not the first time this connector has had issues and honestly we are close to looking at other vendors if this keeps happening. fix it today.
answer:
I'm sorry for the delay and I understand the frustration - stale reporting for two days on a pipeline this size is not acceptable and I'm treating this as a priority fix right now. The token_expired error despite an automatic refresh flow points to either an expired refresh token itself or a scope change on the connector side; I'm pulling your connector's auth logs immediately to identify which.

I'll have a root cause and either a fix or a manual re-authentication workaround for you within the next couple of hours, and I'll personally follow up on this thread until sync is confirmed healthy again.

subject: Need to update workspace settings and access escalation path
body:
I'm the operations lead at Quill Travel and we need to update a few workspace settings in the Admin Console - specifically the default session timeout and the domain allowlist for our 25 seats, since we've onboarded a new department using a different email domain. I also want to confirm the correct process for escalating access issues in the future, since our current escalation contact left the company.

Could you walk me through where these workspace settings live in the console, and update our escalation contact info on file to be our IT operations mailbox instead?
answer:
Happy to help with both. Workspace-level settings like session timeout and the domain allowlist are under Admin Console > Workspace Settings > Security, and you'll need workspace admin permissions to edit them - I can walk you through adding the new domain there if you'd like to do it live on a call.

For the escalation contact update, I'll need that confirmed by an existing workspace admin for security reasons, so please have them send a quick confirmation and I'll update our records right away. Let me know if you'd like a step-by-step guide for the allowlist change in the meantime.

subject: SAML login failing for all users since this morning
body: Since around 8:40am today our SSO login via SAML has been failing for everyone at Orion Freight. Users get redirected back to the IdP and then land on an error page that says 'SAML response could not be validated'. We haven't changed our IdP config on our end recently. All 16 seats are affected and nobody can get into Northwind right now.
answer: Thanks for flagging this right away, this is being treated as a P1. Can you confirm whether your identity provider certificate was rotated in the last few days? We've seen this exact validation error tied to an expired or mismatched signing cert, and we're checking your tenant's SSO configuration on our side now while we wait to hear back.

subject: URGENT: IP allowlist change deleted all our API access and users are locked out
body: I updated our IP allowlist in the Admin Console about 20 minutes ago to add our new office range, and instead of adding the entry it replaced the entire allowlist and now every API request from any IP is being rejected with 403 Forbidden. Several team members are also showing as deactivated in the console even though we never touched user status. This is affecting all of Harbor Health's production integrations right now.
answer: This is a critical issue and we're escalating it immediately as a P0. Please do not make further changes to the allowlist or user settings while we investigate, since the deactivations you're seeing may be linked to the same bug. We'll update you within the hour with either a fix or a manual restore of your previous allowlist and account states.

subject: Webhook event type deprecated but still referenced in SDK docs
body: I'm working through our webhook integration and noticed the 'invoice.updated' event type returns a deprecation warning in the payload, but our Node SDK (v3.2) still lists it as a supported event in the reference docs. Could you clarify what the replacement event is and by when 'invoice.updated' will stop firing? We have three downstream reports depending on it.
answer: Good catch, thanks for reporting this. The replacement event is 'invoice.status_changed', which carries the same payload shape plus a new 'previous_status' field. 'invoice.updated' is scheduled for removal in Q3, and we'll get the SDK docs corrected this week so they no longer reference the deprecated event.

subject: Getting duplicate email alerts for the same billing event
body: For the past week I've been receiving two identical emails within a minute of each other whenever an invoice is generated. It's not a big deal but it's cluttering my inbox and I wanted to check if this is expected behavior or something I can turn off in the notification settings.
answer: Thanks for the heads up, and no worries, this isn't expected behavior. It looks like duplicate emails can happen if a notification rule is accidentally set up twice for the same event type. Could you check Settings > Notifications > Billing Alerts to see if there are two rules listed for invoice generation? If so, deleting one should resolve it, and I'm happy to check your account configuration directly if you'd rather I do it.

subject: App stürzt beim Start ab nach dem letzten Update
body: Seit dem Update auf Version 4.8 der Northwind Mobile App stürzt die App bei uns bei fast jedem Start sofort wieder ab, noch bevor der Login-Bildschirm erscheint. Betroffen sind mehrere Kollegen bei Vertex Energy mit Android-Geräten, iOS scheint bisher nicht betroffen zu sein. Das Problem begann gestern Nachmittag und blockiert aktuell unsere Außendienstteams bei der Nutzung der App im Feld.
answer: Vielen Dank für die schnelle Meldung, wir behandeln das als P1. Können Sie uns mitteilen, welche Android-Version und welche Gerätemodelle betroffen sind? Wir konnten den Absturz bereits mit einem fehlerhaften Cache-Eintrag nach dem Update in Verbindung bringen und arbeiten an einem Hotfix, den wir Ihnen sobald wie möglich zur Verfügung stellen.

subject: Wiederherstellung aus Backup schlägt fehl - dringend
body: Wir versuchen seit heute Morgen 09:15 Uhr, unseren Storage-Bereich aus dem letzten Backup vom 03.06. wiederherzustellen, nachdem versehentlich ein Ordner mit Kundendaten gelöscht wurde. Der Wiederherstellungsvorgang bricht jedes Mal nach etwa zwei Minuten mit der Meldung 'restore job failed: snapshot unavailable' ab. Wir haben aktuell keinen Zugriff auf die gelöschten Daten und das betrifft unser gesamtes Compliance-Reporting für Summit Media.
answer: Wir stufen diesen Vorfall als P0 ein und leiten ihn sofort an unser Storage-Team weiter. Bitte unternehmen Sie keine weiteren Wiederherstellungsversuche, damit der vorhandene Snapshot nicht beschädigt wird. Wir melden uns innerhalb der nächsten Stunde mit einem Status-Update zur Verfügbarkeit des Snapshots vom 03.06.

subject: Request to customize push notification categories for finance team
body: Our finance team at Apex Analytics currently receives every mobile push notification lumped into one category, including approvals, budget alerts, and system announcements. We'd like the ability to enable or disable push categories separately so people aren't missing approval requests among lower-priority alerts. Is this something the Mobile App supports or has planned?

In the meantime, users can mute the app's system announcement channel at the OS level to reduce noise, though that will affect all categories together. I'll log this as a feature request tied to your account and update you when category-level controls ship.

subject: Enabling biometric login for all workspace users
body: As the workspace admin for Granite Partners, I'd like to enable Face ID and fingerprint login by default for all 139 seats on the Mobile App instead of leaving it as an opt-in toggle per user. Is there an admin-level setting to enforce or pre-enable this, or does each person need to turn it on individually in their app settings?
answer: Currently biometric login is opt-in at the individual user level and there isn't an admin console toggle to enable it workspace-wide, though we understand the appeal for a large team. I'll pass this along as a feature request for admin-level biometric policy controls. In the meantime, we can share a short guide you can distribute to your team walking through the in-app steps to turn it on.

subject: Webhooks dropping events and hitting rate limits unexpectedly
body: Since yesterday our webhook endpoint has been receiving far fewer events than expected, roughly 40% of the usual volume for Summit Academy's account. Checking the API logs, I see repeated 429 responses with 'rate limit exceeded' even though our request volume hasn't changed. We also noticed the 'student.enrolled' event is flagged as deprecated in the response headers now, but we're still relying on it heavily. This is dropping real data from our downstream systems.
answer: Thank you for the detailed report, we're escalating this as a P1 since it's causing data loss downstream. We're checking whether a recent change to rate limit thresholds on webhook delivery is affecting your account specifically. Regarding 'student.enrolled', we'll confirm the deprecation timeline and recommended replacement event shortly so you can plan the migration alongside the rate limit fix.

subject: connecter auth BROKEN and nobody has helped me for 2 days!!!
body: im trying to set up oauth for our new data pipeline connecter to our postgres source and it keeps failing with 'token refresh failed: invalid_grant' every single sync, its been failing since monday and now our sync latency is like 6 hours behind and data quality checks are flaging tons of records as stale. i opened a ticket already and got no response for 2 days this is rediculous, we pay for Pro plan and cant even get a working connecter, if this isnt fixed today we are cancelling North Systems account.

subject: Scheduled sync issue

subject: Users getting logged out every few minutes

Can you confirm the timestamp of the first occurrence today and whether any IdP-side changes were made recently, even minor ones?

subject: API deprecation notice - need clarification on webhook changes
body: We received a notice that the v2 webhook payload format is being deprecated on March 15th, but our integration still relies on the 'event_type' field structure from the old format. We have three webhook endpoints configured and haven't seen migration docs specific to our SDK version (2.4.1). Can you confirm whether this will break our existing webhook consumers, and point us to the migration guide?

The v2 to v3 webhook change does restructure the event_type field into a nested 'event' object, so your existing consumers will need updates before March 15th. I'm sending you the migration guide link along with SDK 2.4.1 compatibility notes, and I'll flag your account so we can follow up before the cutover date.

subject: Biometric login broken after latest app update - urgent

The app either hangs on the biometric prompt or crashes back to the login screen. This started right after the update rolled out yesterday and is now generating a wave of support tickets on our end from staff who can't get into the app for class scheduling.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report and sorry for the disruption this is causing your users. We're escalating this internally as a priority issue since it affects a large share of your seats. Can you send us the exact app version number and device OS versions where this is happening, plus a crash log if your users can generate one, so our mobile team can reproduce and fix it quickly?

subject: Duplicate email digests being sent to same users

I checked our notification settings and there's only one digest schedule configured per user group. This is causing confusion among our 16 seat holders and some are asking if their account is broken.
answer: Thanks for reporting this, duplicate digests are definitely not expected behavior. We're looking into your notification delivery logs now to see if there's a retry or scheduling conflict causing the duplication. Given this is affecting multiple users, we're prioritizing this and will update you within the day with findings and a fix timeline.

subject: How to restore files from backup snapshot
body: We'd like to restore a set of files from a backup snapshot taken back in August, before we accidentally overwrote a batch of reports. I can see backup retention listed as 90 days in our storage settings but I'm not sure how to initiate a restore to a specific point in time versus just downloading current files. Is there a self-service restore option or does this need to go through support?
answer: Good news, you can self-serve this from the Storage console under the Backups tab, where you'll see snapshots listed by date going back through your 90-day retention window. Select the August snapshot you need, choose 'Restore to new location' so it doesn't overwrite current data, and it should complete within a few minutes depending on volume size. Let us know if you don't see the August snapshot listed and we'll check retention logs on our side.

subject: Restore from backup failing with quota error
body: I'm trying to restore a folder from our storage backup dated September 20th but every attempt fails with 'Restore blocked: destination quota exceeded' even though we have plenty of free space showing in our usage dashboard. We're only on the Starter plan with 5 seats, so I want to make sure this isn't a plan limitation rather than an actual quota issue.
answer: Thanks for the details. This error can sometimes appear even with available space if the restore process is calculating against a temporary staging quota rather than your final destination quota. Can you confirm the size of the folder you're restoring and the exact destination path? We'll check your account's quota allocation to see if this is a display bug or an actual limit tied to your current plan.

subject: Incorrect invoice charged for wrong number of seats

This has resulted in an overcharge on our card ending that we need corrected right away since it affects our monthly budget approval. Invoice number is INV-2024-08841, dated this week.

I'll follow up shortly with confirmation once the adjustment is issued.

subject: Request to update workspace settings and allowlist
body: As part of a security review, we need to update our workspace's IP allowlist to include two new office locations and also review who has admin-level access across our 162 seats. Could you point me to where these settings live in the Admin Console, and whether allowlist changes take effect immediately or require a propagation window?
answer: You can manage both of these under Admin Console > Security Settings. The IP allowlist section lets you add new ranges directly, and changes typically take effect within a few minutes though we recommend testing access from the new locations before removing old ranges. For the admin access review, the Audit Log tab will show role changes and login history across all 162 seats, which should help with your review.

subject: Scheduled sync failing intermittently, causing stale data
body: Our scheduled sync for the operations data pipeline has failed intermittently over the past three days, sometimes succeeding and sometimes throwing 'Connection timeout at source' after 30 seconds. answer: This kind of intermittent sync failure affecting your live dashboards is something we're prioritizing right away. Can you send us the pipeline ID and the timestamps of the last three failed runs so we can trace the timeout on our connector side? We'll also check for any recent load or throttling patterns on our end that could explain the inconsistency while we investigate.

subject: Pagination-Fehler bei API v2 Endpunkten
body:
Uns ist aufgefallen, dass die Pagination bei /v2/students seit heute Morgen fehlerhafte next_cursor Werte zurückgibt. subject: Zapier connector for Jira and Slack triggers

Is there a roadmap item for adding Jira issue creation and Slack notification triggers directly through Zapier, or do we need to build a custom webhook integration in the meantime?

In the meantime, our webhook API supports outbound events that you can wire into Zapier's generic webhook trigger to approximate this workflow — I can send over a sample payload and setup guide if that's helpful.

subject: Request to improve offline mode data sync
body:
Our field auditors use the Northwind mobile app in stores with poor connectivity, and right now any changes made while offline don't sync reliably once the connection returns. Could you look into making offline mode queue changes locally and retry sync automatically, rather than requiring a manual refresh? This is becoming a recurring complaint from our regional teams.
answer: Thank you for flagging this — data loss on reconnect is definitely not expected behavior and we want to get to the bottom of it. Could you send us the device models and app version affected, along with approximate timestamps for the three incidents? In parallel, I'm logging this as a feature request for improved offline queuing with automatic retry, which our mobile team is already evaluating for an upcoming release.

subject: Storage quota breach exposing customer files
body: We just discovered that our storage bucket exceeded its quota at 2:14 AM today, and instead of blocking new uploads the system appears to have allowed files to be written to a shared overflow area accessible by other tenant IDs. One of our analysts found a file listing that included filenames not belonging to Willow Energy. We have paused all uploads on our end as of 8:40 AM but need immediate confirmation this is contained.

Please keep uploads paused on your side until we confirm containment — we will update you within 30 minutes with initial findings and next steps, including whether any cross-tenant exposure occurred.

subject: Jira link showing wrong project after Okta re-auth
body: After our recent Okta session renewal, the Jira integration link in our Integrations panel now points to a project called 'DEMO-TEST' instead of our actual OPS project. This happened for all admins on our team, not just me, starting around October 3rd. Re-linking manually through the settings page doesn't stick — it reverts to DEMO-TEST after a few minutes.

We've reproduced a similar case internally and are pushing a fix to clear the stale mapping on your account. In the meantime, could you confirm the exact project key you expect (OPS) so we can manually restore the correct link while the fix rolls out?

subject: unacceptable

subject: Unsubscribe link not removing users from digest emails
body: We've had several employees click the unsubscribe link in the weekly digest notification email, but they keep receiving duplicate copies of the same email — sometimes two or three in one day. I checked our notification settings and the unsubscribe preference shows as saved, but the emails keep going out. Is there a known issue with the unsubscribe endpoint not properly updating downstream mailing lists?
