Could you share one or two affected email addresses so we can check the sync logs directly? In the meantime, I'll link our documentation on notification preferences so your team has a workaround for manually pausing digests at the group level.

subject: Biometric login crashing app on reconnect after offline use
body:
We're seeing a consistent crash on the mobile app when users try to log in with Face ID or fingerprint after the device has been offline for more than a few hours. The app force-closes immediately after the biometric prompt, and users then have to fall back to password login. This is affecting a large portion of our field staff who work in low-connectivity areas, and it's generating a steady stream of support tickets on our side.

Could your team confirm whether this is a known bug tied to the offline token refresh, and if there's a temporary workaround we can share with users while a fix is developed?
answer: Thank you for the detailed report — this matches a bug we're tracking related to biometric token validation failing silently when the offline-cached session has expired, which triggers the crash instead of a graceful fallback. As a workaround, please advise affected users to fully close and reopen the app once back online before attempting biometric login, which forces a fresh token refresh. We're treating this as high priority given the scale of impact and will update you with a fix timeline within 48 hours.

subject: SAML login setup for SSO with role-based permissions
body: I'm configuring SAML-based SSO for our organization and want to make sure our role mappings carry over correctly from our identity provider. We have several custom roles tied to MFA enforcement that need to map to specific permission groups in Northwind. Could you walk me through how attribute mapping works for SAML assertions, and whether MFA status from the IdP is respected on our end or needs to be enforced separately in Northwind?
answer: Happy to help with the SAML setup. Attribute mapping for roles works by matching SAML assertion attributes (typically a group or role claim) to permission groups you define in the Identity and SSO admin panel — I'll send over our step-by-step configuration guide. Regarding MFA, Northwind currently enforces its own MFA policy independently of the IdP's MFA status, so if you want a unified experience you'll need to configure MFA requirements on both sides, or set Northwind's policy to trust the IdP session for MFA-satisfied users, which I can help you enable.

subject: Frage zu Rate Limits und Dokumentation für Webhooks
body: Als Workspace-Admin verwalten wir mehrere interne Tools, die über die API Plattform laufen, und wir stoßen seit letzter Woche regelmäßig auf HTTP 429 Fehler bei Webhook-Registrierungen. Die aktuelle Dokumentation nennt ein Limit von 100 Requests pro Minute, aber wir sehen die Fehler schon bei deutlich weniger Aufrufen. Können Sie uns sagen, ob es ein separates, niedrigeres Limit für Webhook-Endpunkte gibt und ob es dazu ein aktuelles SDK oder Beispielcode gibt?
answer: Danke für den Hinweis. Tatsächlich gilt für Webhook-Registrierungs-Endpunkte ein separates, strengeres Limit von 20 Requests pro Minute, das aktuell noch nicht in der öffentlichen Dokumentation steht — wir aktualisieren das umgehend. Unser Team stellt Ihnen zusätzlich ein aktuelles SDK-Beispiel mit eingebautem Retry-Handling für 429-Antworten zur Verfügung, das Ihnen bei der Webhook-Verwaltung helfen sollte.

subject: MFA enrolment loop for SSO users via API
body: We're integrating Northwind Identity for Willow Labs using the SSO provisioning API, and a subset of users get stuck in an MFA enrolment loop after their first SAML login. The API returns enrollment_required:true even after the user completes TOTP setup through /v2/mfa/enroll. We've reproduced this with about 40 test accounts out of our 2202-seat org since yesterday. Can you check if there's a permissions scope missing on our SSO app that's causing the enrollment state to not persist?
answer: Thanks for the detailed repro steps. This looks like the enrollment state cache not syncing with your SSO app's assigned scopes — we've seen this when the identity.mfa.write scope is missing from the app registration. Could you confirm the scopes configured on your SSO app in the admin console, and send us two or three affected user IDs so we can trace their enrollment records directly?

subject: Routing Slack alerts to specific channels per Jira project
body: We use the Slack integration to get alerts from Northwind, but right now everything lands in one #alerts channel regardless of source. For Willow Legal's compliance workflow we need billing alerts routed to #finance-ops and API errors routed to #eng-alerts, ideally mapped by the Jira project tag on the underlying ticket. Is there a way to configure channel routing rules, or do we need to use separate webhook URLs per alert type?
answer: Right now channel routing is handled per webhook, so the cleanest approach is to create separate Slack webhook URLs for each alert category and assign them in the Integrations settings under Alert Routing. I'll also flag this to our product team since project-tag-based routing isn't natively supported yet, and I'll update this ticket once we have documentation on the multi-webhook setup ready for your team.

subject: Push notifications delayed for offline users on mobile app
body: At Quill Health we've noticed that push notifications for shift reminders aren't reaching staff who were offline when the notification was originally triggered. Once they reopen the app hours later, nothing appears even though the admin console shows the notification as 'delivered'. This is affecting roughly a third of our 16 users on iOS specifically. Can you look into whether offline queuing is supported for push, and if there's a setting we're missing?
answer: Thanks for flagging this — offline push delivery relies on the device re-registering with the push token on reconnect, and iOS can silently drop the token if the app was backgrounded for too long. Can you confirm which app version your affected users are on? In the meantime, we'd recommend enabling the 'retry on reconnect' setting under Mobile App > Notification Settings, which should reduce the drop rate while we investigate the delivery logs on our end.

subject: Unsubscribed users still receiving duplicate email alerts
body: Several users at North Freight who clicked unsubscribe last week are still getting duplicate copies of the same shipment alert emails, sometimes 2-3 times within minutes. We confirmed their unsubscribe status shows as 'opted out' in the Notifications admin panel, but the emails keep coming through our Pro plan account. This started around March 4th and is generating complaints from customers who thought they'd opted out.
answer: This is a priority issue for us and we're escalating it right now. It sounds like the unsubscribe flag isn't being checked by the retry queue that resends failed deliveries, which would explain both the duplicates and the continued sends after opt-out. Can you send us three or four affected recipient addresses and approximate timestamps so we can trace this through the notification queue immediately while we work on a fix?

subject: IP allowlist blocking legitimate admin logins
body: Since this morning our Admin Console at Blue Media has been rejecting logins from our office network, which is on the IP allowlist we configured last month. We're getting 'Access denied: IP not permitted' even though the address hasn't changed. Three of our admins are locked out right now and we can't manage any user accounts. In the meantime we're temporarily lifting the allowlist restriction on your account so your admins can regain access while we investigate why the existing entry stopped matching.

subject: How to restrict workspace settings changes to specific admins
body: At Apex Academy we have a few admins who shouldn't be able to modify workspace-wide settings like the IP allowlist or user deactivation policies, only manage day-to-day accounts. Is there a way to create a more limited admin role, or do we need to use the audit log to just monitor changes after the fact? We'd like a cleaner permissions model before our next semester rollout on the 34-seat plan.
answer: Currently the Admin Console offers a 'Standard Admin' role that excludes workspace-level settings like allowlist and deactivation policy changes, which should cover most of what you're describing. I'd recommend switching your day-to-day admins to that role and keeping workspace settings restricted to Super Admins; I'll also send over our documentation on audit log filtering so you can track any settings changes going forward.

subject: Recurring transform failures in nightly data pipeline sync
body: Our nightly sync pipeline for Granite Health has been failing intermittently on the transform step for the last four runs, throwing 'schema mismatch: expected decimal, got string' on the claims_amount field. We haven't changed our source schema recently. Is there a way to get more granular logging on which records are triggering this, since our current logs only show the batch ID and not row-level detail?
answer: Thanks for the specifics — schema mismatch errors like this often come from upstream source fields switching type mid-batch, which our current logging doesn't surface at row level by default. I can enable verbose transform logging for your pipeline ID so the next run captures row-level detail; could you confirm the pipeline ID and roughly what time the next scheduled run is so we can catch it live?

subject: Push notifications not resuming after app comes back online
body: I'm on the support team at Lumen Media and we've had a few customer reports that push notifications stop entirely after a device loses connectivity for more than a few minutes, even after reconnecting. Users have to log out and back in to get notifications working again. This seems specific to Android based on what we've seen so far. Do you have any documentation on expected reconnect behavior for push tokens so we can set expectations with our customers?
answer: This matches a known pattern where the push token isn't being refreshed automatically on reconnect for some Android OS versions. Could you let us know which Android versions are affected so we can prioritize a fix?

subject: Question about API rate limit changes and webhook deprecation notice
body: I received a notice that some webhook endpoints for the API Platform are being deprecated next quarter, and I want to understand how this affects our current rate limits before I forward this to our engineering team at Orion Capital. Are the rate limits per API key or per account across our 252 seats, and will the new webhook format count against the same limit?

The upcoming webhook format change won't introduce new limits itself, but I'll send over the deprecation timeline and migration guide so your engineering team has the details before the cutover.

subject: Bulk user deactivation feature for offboarding

Is there a bulk deactivation option, maybe via CSV upload or multi-select, and does deactivation automatically remove the user from the IP allowlist exceptions if they had one set? Deactivation does automatically revoke any individual allowlist exceptions tied to that user, and each action is logged in the audit trail with a timestamp and the initiating admin, so it should cover your compliance reporting needs.

subject: Mobile app crashes immediately on launch for most users

subject: Okta app integration slow / timing out for our team

subject: Question about upcoming API deprecations affecting webhooks

subject: Requesting export option for admin console audit log

subject: Deactivated user still able to access API resources

subject: ZAPIER INTEGRATION COMPLETLY BROKEN FOR EVERYONE
body:
WE HAVE BEEN TRYING TO USE THE ZAPIER CONNECTOR FOR THREE DAYS AND NOTHIGN WORKS. EVERY ZAP WE TRY TO RUN FAILS WITH A GENERIC ERROR AND NO DETAILS. WE USE THIS TO SYNC DATA INTO SLACK AND JIRA AND NOW NONE OF OUR TEAM CAN GET NOTIFICATIONS.

THIS IS REALY AFFECTING OUR WHOLE MEDIA TEAM OF 23 PEOPLE AND WE NEED THIS FIXED ASAP OR WE WILL HAVE TO LOOK AT OTHER TOOLS. PLEASE ESCALATE THIS RIGHT AWAY.
answer: I understand how disruptive this is for your whole team, and I'm escalating this immediately as a P1 issue. We're checking our Zapier connector logs now for any recent authentication or API errors that might explain the generic failures you're seeing. Could you share one specific Zap name and the approximate time of a recent failed run so we can trace it directly in our logs? We'll update you as soon as we have findings.

subject: Jira link integration down, blocking our workflow
body:
Our Jira integration link stopped syncing issues to Northwind this morning around 8am. We use this heavily to track billing-related tickets across our finance team, and now none of the updates from Jira are coming through to our dashboard at all.

We also noticed our Slack and Salesforce connectors seem unaffected, so it appears isolated to Jira specifically. Could someone look into this urgently? We have a finance review this afternoon that depends on this data being current.
answer: Thank you for the clear details, this helps us move quickly. We're treating this as a P1 issue given the time-sensitive review this afternoon, and we're checking the Jira connector's authentication token and sync logs on our end now. Could you confirm whether anyone recently changed permissions on the Jira app or regenerated an API token, as that's a common cause of a sudden isolated sync failure like this?

subject: Offline mode not syncing data once back online
body:
Our drivers use the mobile app in offline mode constantly since they lose signal in transit, but since last week the data they collect offline isn't syncing back once they reconnect. We've confirmed this on at least 12 devices across our 39-seat account, all showing the same behavior.

The app shows a 'sync pending' icon that just never clears, even after leaving it connected to wifi for over an hour. This is affecting our delivery logs for the past several days and we need this resolved quickly since it's holding up our reporting.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report, this is definitely something we want to resolve quickly given the operational impact. We're treating this as P1 and looking into recent changes to the offline sync queue on the mobile app. Could you confirm the app version on a couple of the affected devices, and whether any of the pending records are unusually large (attachments, photos, etc.)? That will help us narrow down whether this is a payload size issue or a broader sync bug.

subject: PDF export from dashboard cutting off charts
body:
When I export our monthly performance dashboard to PDF, several of the bar charts get cut off at the page edge and one chart is missing entirely from the exported file, even though it displays fine on screen. This has been happening for the last two export attempts, on 4/22 and 4/24.

We share these PDFs with leadership every month, so this is becoming a real problem. Is there a setting we're missing for page sizing, or is this a bug with the export feature itself?
answer: Thanks for the specifics, that's helpful for tracking this down. This sounds like a rendering issue with the PDF export rather than a setting on your end, especially since the chart is missing entirely in one case. Could you let us know which browser and dashboard layout (standard or custom grid) you're using, and if possible send over the exported PDF so we can compare it against the live dashboard? We'll treat this as a priority given your reporting deadline.

subject: Unexpected charges after upgrading plan via API
body:
I upgraded our account from Starter to a higher plan tier through the billing API on the 3rd, but our invoice this cycle shows charges for both the old and new plan overlapping for about 10 days. I'd expect the upgrade to prorate cleanly rather than double-bill us.

Could someone review invoice #INV-88213 and let us know if this is expected behavior or a billing calculation issue? We'd like a correction or refund for the overlap if it's an error on your end.
answer: Thank you for flagging this with the invoice number, that helps us investigate quickly. A clean proration shouldn't result in overlapping charges for both plan tiers, so this does look like it needs correction. We're reviewing invoice #INV-88213 now and will follow up within one business day with either an explanation of the charges or a corrected invoice and refund for the overlap.

subject: Late-arriving data in nightly connector sync
body: We run a nightly sync from our transaction connector (pipeline id pln-4471) into the reporting warehouse, and for the past two weeks about 6-8% of rows are landing 3-5 hours after the expected 02:00 UTC window. This is causing our reconciliation job to miss records that show up the next run instead. Is there a documented way to configure the pipeline to wait for late data or trigger a re-run automatically, or is this a known connector timing issue we should expect?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. Late-arriving records in connector syncs are usually caused by upstream batching on the source side rather than the pipeline itself, but 3-5 hours is longer than expected for pln-4471. We'll check the connector logs for that pipeline and confirm whether a watermark or late-data window setting is available to catch stragglers on the next run, and point you to the relevant docs section once confirmed.

subject: Getting duplicate alerts for the same equipment fault
body: Our floor team is getting two identical email alerts within about 90 seconds whenever a machine fault fires on the production line notification channel. Ticket IDs from this morning are ALRT-88213 and ALRT-88214, both tied to the same sensor event at 06:42 local time. This has been happening for the last few days and it's causing confusion since people think it's two separate faults. Is there a dedup or debounce setting we can enable on our end for this channel?
answer: Thanks for flagging this with the specific alert IDs, that helps a lot. Duplicate sends within a short window usually point to the channel's debounce interval being set too low or two overlapping trigger rules matching the same event. We'll review the notification channel config tied to your production line and check for an overlapping rule, and will also confirm the shortest supported debounce interval you can set to prevent this going forward.

subject: SCIM provisioning returning 400 errors, no users created
body: I'm integrating our HR system with Northwind SCIM provisioning and every POST to /scim/v2/Users is returning a 400 with 'invalidSyntax' since this morning around 9:15 AM. We haven't changed our payload format in weeks and it was working fine last Friday. This is blocking onboarding for our entire team since none of our 7 seats can be provisioned right now, and we need this resolved today.
answer: This is being treated as a priority issue since it's blocking all provisioning for your tenant. Could you send us the exact request payload (with any secrets redacted) along with the tenant ID so we can reproduce the 400 on our side? In the meantime we're checking whether there was a recent schema validation change on the SCIM endpoint that could explain the invalidSyntax error, and will update you as soon as we have a root cause.

subject: Charts not rendering after last API response change
body: Since yesterday afternoon, line and bar charts on our embedded dashboards are showing blank panels instead of data. The API call to /v1/dashboards/{id}/data still returns a 200 with the expected JSON, but the chart component just renders an empty box. This is affecting every chart type on our client-facing dashboard and we need this fixed urgently since customers are seeing broken pages right now.
answer: We understand this is customer-facing and urgent, so we're escalating it immediately. Could you share the dashboard ID and a sample of the API response payload that's returning correctly but not rendering? We suspect a change in the response shape may not match what the chart renderer expects, and we're pulling recent deploy logs on our end now to see if a recent release introduced this regression.

subject: Adding new office IP ranges to Admin Console allowlist
body: We're opening a second office and need to add its IP range (203.0.113.0/24) to our Admin Console IP allowlist alongside our existing entries. Before we make the change, I wanted to confirm whether adding a new range triggers any automatic session deactivation for users currently logged in from other allowed ranges, and whether this change gets logged in the audit log for our compliance review.
answer: Adding a new range to the allowlist only affects new session or login attempts, so existing active sessions from already-allowed IPs won't be interrupted. Any change to the allowlist is recorded in the audit log with the admin who made the change and a timestamp, so it will show up for your compliance review. Let us know once you're ready to add the range and we're happy to confirm it's applied correctly.

subject: Offline mode needed for field teams losing connectivity
body: Our field nurses use the mobile app in facilities with poor or no signal, and right now the app crashes rather than gracefully falling back when connectivity drops mid-session. We're seeing this reported by multiple regional teams over the last two weeks, and it's affecting patient record entry workflows across our organization. We'd like to escalate a request for proper offline caching and sync-on-reconnect support, since the current behavior is a real reliability concern for us at this scale.
answer: Thank you for escalating this, we understand how disruptive crashes are for field teams handling patient data. We're logging this as a priority feature request for offline caching with sync-on-reconnect, and in the parallel we'll investigate the specific crash behavior when connectivity drops, since that should at minimum degrade gracefully rather than crash. We'll follow up with crash log requests from a few affected devices to help narrow down the immediate fix.

subject: Freigabeproblem bei geteilten Dashboards
body: Wir nutzen Dashboards, um Berichte an mehrere Mandanten weiterzugeben, und seit letzter Woche funktioniert die Freigabe für Viewer-Nutzer nicht mehr richtig. Wenn ein Viewer versucht, den Export-Button auf einem geteilten Dashboard zu nutzen, bekommt er eine Fehlermeldung 'Zugriff verweigert', obwohl die Freigabe als 'Viewer mit Export' konfiguriert ist. Zusätzlich laden die Dashboards für diese Nutzer sehr langsam, teilweise über 20 Sekunden. Das betrifft mehrere unserer Mandanten und wir müssen das zeitnah lösen.
answer: Vielen Dank für die genaue Beschreibung. Ein 'Zugriff verweigert' bei aktivierter Export-Berechtigung deutet auf ein Problem mit der Rechteprüfung für die Viewer-Rolle hin, das wir uns sofort ansehen. Könnten Sie uns die Dashboard-ID sowie die Nutzer-ID eines betroffenen Viewers zusenden, damit wir die Berechtigungsprüfung nachvollziehen können? Die langsamen Ladezeiten prüfen wir parallel, da beides zusammenhängen könnte.

subject: Session timeout settings for SSO logins
body: We recently rolled out SSO across our logistics hubs and have been monitoring adoption closely over the past month, since most of our warehouse staff previously used shared terminal logins. Adoption has been smooth and we haven't had major complaints about the switch itself. The actual issue is that sessions are timing out after 15 minutes of inactivity even for roles that need to stay logged in on shared warehouse scanners for hours, and we can't find a setting to configure a longer timeout per role or group. This is now causing repeated re-authentication interruptions during shift work, and we need a way to extend or customize this before our next shift rotation.
answer: Thanks for the context, and apologies for the disruption this is causing during shifts. Currently session timeout is set at the workspace level rather than per-role, so we're checking internally whether a role-based or group-based override can be applied for your warehouse scanner accounts specifically. Given this is impacting active shift operations, we're treating it as urgent and will follow up shortly with either a configuration option or a temporary workaround while we confirm the permanent fix.

subject: Connector authentication expiring frequently on manufacturing feed
body: Our inventory connector to the manufacturing ERP has started requiring re-authentication every 2-3 days instead of staying connected for weeks like before. Each time it drops, the pipeline pauses until an admin manually re-authorizes it, which has happened four times in the last ten days and is affecting data freshness for our floor dashboards. Is there a change in token refresh behavior on this connector type, or a setting we're missing to keep the auth session alive longer?
answer: Thanks for flagging the pattern, four re-auths in ten days is more frequent than expected for that connector type. We'll check whether there was a recent change to the token refresh logic or expiry window for the ERP connector, and review your pipeline's auth logs to see exactly when and why the token is being invalidated. We'll follow up with either a fix or a recommended refresh configuration to reduce the manual re-authorization steps.

subject: Duplicate alert emails for the same query threshold breach
body: I'm getting two separate emails for a single alert whenever our revenue anomaly query crosses its threshold, both timestamped within a few seconds of each other and referencing the same alert rule ID (rule-3392). This has been happening consistently for about a week and is cluttering our team's inbox since we have several people subscribed to this alert. Is this a known issue with the alerting system, or is there a setting on our end causing the duplication?
answer: Thanks for including the rule ID, that will help us trace this quickly. Duplicate sends from a single rule usually point to either a webhook retry being incorrectly treated as a new trigger or an overlapping evaluation schedule on the rule. We'll review rule-3392's trigger history over the past week to identify the cause and will confirm whether this is a broader alerting bug or specific to your rule configuration.

subject: connecter auth keeps faling on travel feed
body: hey we run the travel bookings connecter in Data Pipelines and since monday its auth token keeps expireing every few hours, we get a re-auth prompt and the sync stops for like 20-30 min each time. seeing about 6 failures yesterday. downstream reports are showing stale data becouse of the gaps. connector id is trv-conn-4471 if that helps.
answer: Thanks for the details, the connector id is helpful. This looks like the OAuth refresh token for the travel feed is being invalidated earlier than expected rather than a full outage, so I've flagged it to the pipelines team to check the token TTL config on trv-conn-4471. In the meantime, could you confirm whether the re-auth prompt is manual or automatic on your end? That will help us narrow down whether this is a config issue or a provider-side change.

subject: Repeated card decline on our monthly invoice
body: Our card on file was declined for the last two billing cycles (invoice #INV-33210 and #INV-33298), even though the same card works fine for other subscriptions. We had to manually retry payment both times through the billing portal. Can we get a refund of the late fee that was applied on the second invoice, and is there any way to add automatic retry logic instead of us having to catch this manually?
answer: Sorry for the trouble this has caused with invoicing. I've reversed the late fee on invoice #INV-33298 and you should see that reflected within a day or two. On the automatic retry side, we do have a smart-retry feature in progress for card failures, and I'll add your account to the feedback list for that request so you're notified when it ships.

subject: External dashboard shares are throwing access denied
body: As of this morning, none of our externally shared dashboard links are loading for recipients outside our workspace, they get an access denied error instead of the dashboard. This is affecting client-facing reports we send out weekly, and we have a client review call in two hours that depends on one of these links. Nothing changed on our side in terms of sharing settings.
answer: This is being treated as urgent given the client call timing. We can see elevated errors on the dashboard sharing service starting around the same window you reported, and our team is actively investigating the permission check that's rejecting external viewers. I'll update you within the hour with either a fix or a workaround link you can send ahead of your meeting.

subject: Best practice for handling transform failures across pipelines
body: We're standardizing how our data team responds to transform step failures across several pipelines feeding our clinical reporting dashboards. Right now failures just sit in a failed state until someone notices them manually, sometimes a day later. We'd like documentation on recommended retry/backoff settings and whether there's a way to route failure notifications to a specific team channel instead of relying on the dashboard view.
answer: Good question, and this is a common setup request for larger pipeline footprints. We have a documentation page covering retry policies and backoff configuration per transform step, and I'll send that link along with a section on routing failure alerts to webhook or notification channels so your team gets notified in near real time instead of checking manually.

subject: Upgrade to Pro failed but we were charged and seats didn't change
body: I tried upgrading our workspace from Starter to Pro this morning to get more seats for the legal team, and the checkout showed a payment error, but our card was still charged according to our bank. Our seat count is still showing 22 and none of the Pro features are enabled. We need this resolved quickly since we have new hires starting this week who need access.
answer: Apologies for the confusion here, this shouldn't have charged you without completing the upgrade. I can see the failed transaction on our end and I'm processing a refund now, which should post back to your card within 3-5 business days. I'm also manually applying the Pro plan and seat increase to your workspace so your new hires aren't blocked, and you'll get a confirmation once that's active.

subject: Zahlung schlägt fehl und blockiert API-Integration
body: Wir integrieren gerade die Northwind API in unsere interne Verwaltungssoftware und die Kartenzahlung für unser Konto schlägt seit gestern ständig fehl. Dadurch werden neue Sitzplätze nicht freigeschaltet und unsere API-Aufrufe für Nutzerverwaltung liefern einen 402 Fehler zurück. Das blockiert aktuell die gesamte Einrichtung für unsere 10 Plätze, wir brauchen dringend eine Lösung.
answer: Danke für die schnelle Meldung, ein 402-Fehler durch eine fehlgeschlagene Zahlung kann tatsächlich die API-Berechtigungen für Sitzplätze blockieren. Wir prüfen gerade, warum die Kartenzahlung abgelehnt wird, und schalten Ihr Konto currently manuell frei, damit die API-Integration nicht länger blockiert ist. Bitte prüfen Sie parallel, ob die Kartendaten im Portal noch aktuell sind, damit die automatische Abbuchung beim nächsten Zyklus funktioniert.

subject: IP allowlist update not taking effect, users locked out
body: We added our new office IP range to the allowlist in Admin Console yesterday around 3pm, but several team members are still getting blocked from logging in with an 'IP not permitted' message. The audit log doesn't show the allowlist change we made at all, which is concerning. We need this fixed since half our media team can't access their dashboards right now.
answer: Thanks for flagging this, an allowlist change not appearing in the audit log points to the update possibly not saving correctly on our end. I'm escalating this now to check whether the IP range was actually committed to your workspace config, and I'll follow up shortly with either confirmation it's fixed or a temporary bypass so your team can get back in.

subject: DIGEST DOPPELT
body: E-MAIL DIGEST KOMMT ZWEIMAL TÄGLICH AN, BITTE FIXEN.
answer: Danke für die Meldung. Wir prüfen sofort, ob bei Ihrem Konto zwei Digest-Zeitpläne aktiv sind, das würde die doppelte Zustellung erklären, und melden uns kurzfristig mit einer Lösung.

subject: Need Okta SSO app configured before contract renewal
body: We're finalizing our renewal and our IT team requires SSO through Okta to be set up before they'll sign off. Right now we only see options for Salesforce, Slack, and Jira in the Integrations catalog, no Okta app listed. Can you confirm if Okta SSO is available for our plan and how we get it enabled, this is holding up our renewal decision.
answer: Thanks for raising this ahead of your renewal. Okta SSO is available as an integration, though it sometimes isn't visible in the catalog for Starter plans by default, so I'll get it enabled on your workspace and send you setup steps for connecting your Okta tenant. Let me know your target date so we can prioritize getting this live before your renewal deadline.

subject: Clarification needed on IP allowlist and account deactivation
body: We're documenting our internal access policy and need to confirm how the IP allowlist interacts with account deactivation in Admin Console. Specifically, if an admin is deactivated, does their IP allowlist entry get removed automatically, or does it stay active for other users on that same range? The current documentation doesn't cover this scenario and our security team needs this for a compliance review.
answer: Good question, and I can see why the current docs leave this ambiguous. IP allowlist entries are tied to the workspace, not to individual users, so deactivating an admin does not remove or affect the allowlist range itself, other users on that IP range remain unaffected. I'll pass this along to our documentation team to get that clarified explicitly for compliance purposes.

subject: Mobile app crashes immediately on launch - 146 users affected
body:
Since this morning our field team at Willow Partners has been unable to open the Northwind mobile app at all. It crashes within a second of tapping the icon on both iOS 17 and Android 14 devices. We tested on 6 different phones across the legal team and it happens every single time, even after reinstalling. This started right after the 2.8.1 update pushed yesterday around 4pm.

Our staff rely on this app for offline case notes and push alerts during client visits, so this is blocking a huge chunk of our 146 seats. Can you confirm if this is a known issue with the latest release and give us an ETA for a fix or rollback?
answer: Thank you for flagging this immediately, and I'm sorry for the disruption to your team. We've had a small number of similar reports tied to the 2.8.1 release and our mobile engineering team is actively investigating a crash-on-launch issue linked to the offline cache migration. As a temporary workaround, please have affected users clear the app's local storage via device settings (not just reinstall) before relaunching, which has resolved the crash in our internal tests. We'll follow up within the next few hours with a status update or a hotfix build.

subject: PDF export failing on shared dashboards - blocking weekly report
body:
We use the export to PDF feature every Monday to send our logistics KPI dashboard to regional managers, and since last week it's been failing consistently. The export button spins for about 30 seconds then returns 'Export failed - please try again later' with no further detail. This is happening on the 'Regional Volume Overview' dashboard with 8 charts, ID dash_4471.

We tried exporting a smaller dashboard with 2 charts and that worked fine, so it seems tied to size or complexity. This report goes to 101 people across our organization and the deadline is tomorrow morning, so we need this resolved urgently.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report and the dashboard ID, this is very helpful. We've confirmed a performance regression affecting PDF exports on dashboards with more than 6 charts, related to a rendering timeout introduced in last week's update. Our engineering team is deploying a fix to extend the timeout and optimize chart rendering, targeted for this afternoon. In the meantime, as a workaround you can export in two batches by temporarily hiding half the charts, and I'll personally confirm once the fix is live so you can retry the full export before your deadline.

subject: Need a way for recipients to unsubscribe from notification emails
body:
Several people at Lumen Academy have asked how they can unsubscribe from the daily digest emails sent through Northwind Notifications. Right now there's no unsubscribe link in the emails at all, and manually removing each recipient from the distribution list in the admin panel is tedious for our 24 seats. We're getting complaints from staff who no longer want these emails but keep receiving them.

Can you tell us if there's a built-in unsubscribe option we're missing, or if this needs to be added as a feature? This is becoming a recurring issue for our operations team and we'd like a proper self-service solution soon.
answer: Thanks for raising this, and I understand the frustration this is causing your team. Currently there isn't a self-service unsubscribe link on digest emails by default, but you can enable one under Notifications > Email Settings > Recipient Preferences, which adds an opt-out footer automatically to future sends. I've also logged your request for a more visible unsubscribe flow as feedback for our product team, since this is a common ask. Let me know once you've enabled the setting and I can confirm it's applying correctly to your templates.

subject: Offline mode losing cached data after app restart
body:
I'm a support engineer at Atlas Travel and we've noticed that when field agents use the mobile app in offline mode to log client updates, the cached entries disappear if the app is force-closed or the phone restarts before reconnecting to the network. This has happened on at least 5 devices in the last two weeks, all running app version 3.2.0.

We rely heavily on offline mode since our legal advisors often work in areas with poor connectivity, and losing entered data is a real problem for our 140 seats. Push notifications also seem delayed by several minutes once connectivity is restored. Is there a known fix or workaround for the data loss issue specifically?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report and device count, that helps us scope this. We're aware of an issue where the offline cache isn't being flushed to persistent storage quickly enough after data entry, which can cause loss on force-close or restart before the next sync cycle. We're working on a fix to write entries to disk immediately rather than holding them in memory, targeted for the next patch release. In the meantime, we recommend advising agents to wait a few seconds after entering data before closing the app fully, and I'll update this ticket once the fix ships.

subject: How to route alerts to different endpoints based on severity
body:
I'm integrating the Notifications API for Blue Media and I'd like to route alerts differently depending on severity - critical alerts to a Slack webhook, and low-priority ones to email only. Right now it looks like all our configured alert rules send to every endpoint regardless of the severity field we pass in the payload, which is causing duplicate low-priority emails on top of Slack pings.

Is there a way to filter routing by severity natively, or do we need to build that logic ourselves before calling the API? Any documentation on conditional routing rules would be helpful.
answer: Good question, and this is a common setup. Northwind Notifications does support conditional routing through the 'rules' array in the alert configuration endpoint, where you can specify a 'match' condition on the severity field to direct traffic to specific channels. I'll send over a link to our routing documentation with example payloads for severity-based rules, so you shouldn't need to build that filtering logic yourself. Once you've set that up, duplicate low-priority emails should stop since only matching rules will trigger.

subject: Upload failures for backup files exceeding quota warning
body:
We've been getting intermittent upload failures in Storage when our backup jobs run overnight for North Systems. The error message shown is 'Upload rejected: quota exceeded' even though our usage dashboard shows we're only at about 78% of our allocated quota. This has happened on 3 separate nights this week, always around 2am during the scheduled backup window.

Could you check if there's a discrepancy between the quota shown on our dashboard versus what's actually being enforced on the backend? We'd also appreciate documentation on how quota is calculated for backup versus regular file storage.
answer: Thanks for the specific timestamps, that's helpful for tracing this. We've seen a known issue where quota calculations can briefly show stale data on the dashboard due to a caching delay, which may explain the discrepancy you're seeing at the 78% mark. I'm having our team check your account's actual backend usage against the enforced limit now, and will also send over documentation clarifying how backup storage is counted separately from standard files. We'll follow up with findings within one business day.

subject: Data pipeline consistently arriving 3+ hours late from CRM connector
body:
Our nightly sync from the CRM connector into Data Pipelines has been arriving 3 to 4 hours later than scheduled for the past 4 days at North Media. The job is supposed to complete by 6am but has been finishing between 9:30am and 10am, which throws off our morning reporting for the whole team. Job IDs from the last two runs are pipe_run_88213 and pipe_run_88250.

We checked our source CRM and there's no unusual data volume increase on our end. This delay is now affecting downstream dashboards that our travel operations team depends on every morning, so we need to understand what's causing the lag.
answer: Thank you for the job IDs, that lets us dig in right away. Initial logs show the CRM connector is hitting rate limiting on the source API during the sync window, causing retries that stack up and delay completion by several hours. We're adjusting the connector's request pacing to stay under the rate limit threshold, and will also add alerting so you're notified proactively if a sync run is trending late. I'll update you as soon as we've confirmed today's run completes on schedule.

subject: Dashboards loading very slowly, need help optimizing
body:
Our energy sector dashboards at Summit Media have become quite slow to load over the past couple weeks, especially the 'Plant Output Trends' dashboard which now takes 15-20 seconds to render 5 charts. We only have 7 seats but the dashboard is shared externally with 3 partner companies, so the slow load time is affecting how we look to them.

We'd like some guidance on how to restructure the dashboard or the underlying queries to speed this up, since the data volume hasn't grown dramatically. Are there best practices for chart count or data range we should follow to improve performance?
answer: Thanks for reaching out, slow-loading shared dashboards are definitely worth optimizing. A few quick wins: reducing the default date range on charts to 30 days instead of 'all time,' consolidating charts that query the same underlying table, and enabling the dashboard cache setting under Sharing Options can often cut load times significantly. I'd recommend starting with the 'Plant Output Trends' dashboard since it's externally shared, and I'm happy to review its chart configuration with you directly if you can share the dashboard ID.

subject: Wiederholte Kartenfehler bei automatischer Abrechnung
body:
Bei Orion Works schlagen seit dem 3. dieses Monats mehrere Zahlungsversuche mit unserer hinterlegten Firmenkreditkarte fehl. Die Fehlermeldung im Abrechnungsportal lautet 'Payment declined - card issuer rejected transaction', obwohl die Karte bei anderen Anbietern problemlos funktioniert. Betroffen sind mindestens drei Rechnungen für unsere 1558 Lizenzen.

Können Sie prüfen, ob es sich um ein Problem auf Seiten von Northwind handelt, zum Beispiel bei der Zahlungsabwicklung, oder ob wir die Karte ersetzen müssen? Wir möchten außerdem wissen, ob es eine Möglichkeit gibt, eine zweite Zahlungsmethode als Backup zu hinterlegen, um solche Ausfälle künftig zu vermeiden.
answer: Vielen Dank für die genauen Angaben zu den betroffenen Rechnungen. Wir haben in unserem Zahlungsabwickler kurzzeitige Verarbeitungsfehler bei bestimmten Kartennetzwerken im fraglichen Zeitraum festgestellt, die vorrangig Unternehmenskarten betrafen - es liegt also wahrscheinlich nicht an Ihrer Karte selbst. Sie können bereits jetzt unter Abrechnung > Zahlungsmethoden eine zweite Zahlungsmethode als Backup hinterlegen, was wir angesichts Ihres Lizenzvolumens auch empfehlen würden. Wir veranlassen zudem eine erneute Verarbeitung der drei fehlgeschlagenen Rechnungen und melden uns mit dem Ergebnis.

subject: Question about credit applied to our account vs refund
body:
I'm reviewing our latest invoice for Vertex Energy and noticed a credit of $340 applied from last month, but I'm not clear on whether this was issued as an account credit toward future invoices or an actual refund to our card. Our records show no refund transaction on our end, so I want to confirm how this was processed.

Also, since we're planning to adjust our seat count next quarter, could you clarify how unused seat credits are typically handled, whether as automatic credit or refund? We'd like to understand this before making changes to our 112 seats.
answer: Thanks for reaching out, happy to clarify. The $340 was applied as an account credit toward your next invoice rather than a direct refund to your card, which is why you wouldn't see a separate refund transaction, it will show as a reduced balance due on your upcoming bill. Regarding seat adjustments, when you reduce seats mid-cycle, any unused prorated amount is issued as account credit by default, though refunds to your original payment method can be requested if preferred, just let us know when you're ready to make the change.

subject: Webhook deprecation notice - need migration steps
body: I received an email about the deprecation of the legacy webhook event format (v1) on the API Platform, but as the finance manager here I'm not the technical contact and our engineer is out this week. We rely on the payment.settled webhook for reconciling energy supplier invoices, and the notice says v1 payloads stop being sent after March 30. Can you tell me exactly what changes in the payload structure and point me to migration docs I can hand to our dev team so we don't lose invoice matching?

subject: quick question

answer:

By default, session tokens use a fixed 15-minute expiration regardless of activity, but you can configure sliding expiration under Identity settings > Session Policy, which extends the token lifetime on each authenticated API call. I'd recommend setting the sliding window to something like 30-60 minutes depending on your typical workflow length.

If you're calling the API directly rather than through our SDK, make sure you're also handling the refresh token flow correctly so the session extends automatically. Let me know if you'd like a walkthrough of the sliding expiration config for your specific setup.

subject: Webhook signature verification method being deprecated - need migration guidance

The legacy header will continue working for another 60 days based on our current deprecation timeline, so you have a bit of runway, but I'd recommend testing the new verification in a staging webhook endpoint first if you have one available.

We have 11 seats active and want to avoid any service interruption while we sort this out. Could someone check what decline code Northwind is receiving so we can pass that along to our bank? We'd also appreciate confirmation that our account won't be suspended while we resolve this.
answer: Thanks for reaching out, and I can confirm your account won't be suspended while we work through this together. I've pulled the decline details on our end and the code returned was a generic issuer decline, which your bank should be able to look up directly using the transaction timestamp from earlier today. I've also given your account a short grace period so your 11 seats remain uninterrupted in the meantime.

subject: Seat count on invoice does not match active users, overbilled significantly
body: Our latest Enterprise invoice bills us for 1,416 seats, but our internal HR system shows only 1,290 active employees currently provisioned in Northwind. This is a meaningful discrepancy and given our volume it's a substantial billing difference. I've cross-checked the admin console user list against our HR export dated this week and the counts don't reconcile. Can someone from billing review how the seat count is being calculated, and whether deactivated accounts from our recent restructuring are still being counted toward the total?
answer: Thank you for the detailed comparison, this is exactly the kind of discrepancy we want to catch quickly given the scale involved. I've opened an investigation with our billing team to compare your admin console records against our seat calculation logic, since deactivated accounts sometimes remain in a pending-removal state that can inflate counts. I'll follow up within one business day with findings and, if confirmed, we'll issue a credit for any overcounted seats on this invoice.

subject: Feedback on SSO session timeout behavior
body: Our product team has noticed that SSO sessions are timing out after roughly 30 minutes of inactivity, which is shorter than what we'd expect for a Pro workspace and is causing repeated MFA prompts throughout the day for our 101 users. This isn't blocking work, but it's a recurring annoyance that's come up in a few internal surveys. Would it be possible to expose session timeout duration as a configurable setting in the admin console, rather than a fixed default? We'd like to request this as a feature for a future release.
answer: Thanks for the feedback, this is a reasonable request and one we've heard from a few other Pro customers as well. Currently the 30 minute inactivity timeout is fixed at the plan tier, but I've logged this as a feature request for configurable session timeout settings and linked it to your account so we can notify you if it's scheduled for development. In the meantime there isn't a workaround to extend it beyond the default.

subject: Push notifications not arriving reliably on Android
body: We've noticed that push notifications for shipment status updates in the mobile app are arriving inconsistently on Android devices, sometimes with a delay of several hours or not at all. iOS devices on our team seem unaffected. This isn't breaking anything critical yet, but our drivers rely on timely alerts, so I wanted to flag it before it becomes a bigger issue for our 25 seats. Has anyone else reported this, and is there a known issue with the Android push service?
answer: Thanks for flagging this, delayed or missing push notifications on Android can sometimes be tied to background restrictions on certain device manufacturers, but I want to check whether this is broader than that. Could you share which Android versions and device models are affected? I'll log this with our mobile team for investigation and follow up once we know more, since it sounds like it's not urgent yet but worth tracking closely.

subject: Dashboard charts broken and not exporting, need this fixed before month-end close
body: Several of our finance dashboards are showing blank chart panels since this morning, specifically the revenue trend and expense breakdown widgets that our team relies on for month-end reporting. When I try to export the dashboard to PDF, the export completes but the charts appear as empty boxes in the file. This is affecting sharing with our leadership team ahead of our closing deadline this week. We have 22 seats on the Starter plan and this is blocking a time-sensitive report. Can someone escalate this quickly?
answer: I understand the urgency given your month-end deadline, and I'm escalating this to our dashboards team right now. Blank charts combined with broken exports usually point to a rendering issue on our end rather than something in your configuration, so could you confirm which browser you're using and send a screenshot of one affected chart panel? I'll keep this ticket marked high priority and update you as soon as we have a fix or workaround.

subject: Cannot access or download past invoices
body: I'm trying to pull our last three months of invoices for our internal audit and the billing history page in the admin console shows a blank list, even though I can see the charges reflected on our card statement. I've tried refreshing and logging out and back in with no change. We're on the Starter plan with 12 seats and need these documents fairly soon to close out our books. Can someone either fix the invoice history page or send me the PDFs directly for the last three billing cycles?
answer: Sorry for the trouble accessing your invoice history, I know this is time sensitive for your books. I've pulled your last three billing cycles from our records and will attach the PDFs directly to this ticket so you're not blocked while we investigate why the invoice history page is showing blank on your account. I'll follow up separately once we identify the root cause.

subject: Question about routing alerts to specific teams
body:
I'm setting up alert routing rules in Notifications for our retail ops teams and want to confirm the best approach. Right now all inventory threshold alerts go to a single distribution list, but I'd like to split them by region (Northeast, Midwest, West) based on a custom attribute we pass in the event payload.

Is there a way to route based on a payload field, or do I need to create separate webhook endpoints per region? Also noticed some duplicate emails coming through when a rule matches more than one condition group - is that expected behavior?
answer: Thanks for the detailed question. You can route based on a custom payload field by adding a condition group in the routing rule editor that matches on that attribute key/value, so you won't need separate webhooks per region - one rule set with three condition branches should work. On the duplicates: that happens when an event matches multiple active rules that each have their own delivery action, so if two condition groups overlap, the recipient gets two emails. I'd recommend adding mutually exclusive conditions or using a single rule with branching logic instead, and I'm happy to review your current rule config if you send me the rule IDs.

subject: Cannot upgrade plan - billing API returning 402 on every request
body:
We're trying to upgrade from Starter to Growth via the Billing API ahead of onboarding two new hires next week, but every call to POST /v1/billing/subscriptions/upgrade returns a 402 with body {"error":"payment_method_declined"}. Our card on file hasn't changed and works fine in the dashboard checkout flow.

This is blocking us from adding seats before Monday's start date. Account ID is LUM-4021. Can someone check what's failing on your end? We've retried six times since yesterday with the same result.
answer: Apologies for the disruption this is causing right before your new hires start. I've pulled up account LUM-4021 and see the payment gateway flagged the card for a velocity check after the repeated retries - that's why the API keeps declining even though the card is valid. I've manually cleared the flag and reprocessed the upgrade, so please try the API call again now; it should go through immediately. If it still fails, let me know and I'll upgrade the plan manually on our side today.

subject: URGENT: Pagination cursor returning duplicate and missing records in production
body:
Our production ingestion job started pulling duplicate records and skipping others starting around 03:15 UTC today. We use the cursor-based pagination on GET /v1/events with the next_cursor token from each response, but since this morning the same cursor value is being returned twice in a row, then jumping ahead by roughly 500 records.

This is actively corrupting our downstream analytics feed for the media dashboards we ship to clients. We've disabled the sync job for now but need this fixed today - can you confirm if something changed on the pagination implementation?
answer: This has been escalated to our platform engineering team as a P0 given the data integrity impact. We identified a regression in the cursor generation logic deployed at 02:50 UTC that caused stale cursors to be reused under high load, and a fix is being rolled out now. I'll follow up within the hour with confirmation once the fix is live and can help you identify the affected time window so you can safely resume and backfill your sync job.

subject: dashbords
body:
hey our team has ben seeing the main reporting dashbord take like 30-40 secondes to load evrytime we open it, specialy the revenu chart with the line graph. this started maybe last week and its geting worse. we have around 12 saved views and most of them are slow now not just one.

can someone look into why its so slow, our pm team uses this dailey for standups and its really anoying to wait that long every time

In the meantime, I'll check our performance logs for your account to see if there's a query pattern or widget type causing the slowdown, and I'll follow up with findings shortly.

subject: SCIM provisioning failing for new users with 'schema mismatch' error
body:
We're using SCIM provisioning to sync users from our HR system into Northwind, and since yesterday new user creation attempts are failing with an error in the SCIM logs: 'schema mismatch: urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User missing required attribute'. This is affecting about 15 new employees who need access this week.

Existing users provisioned before this week still sync fine for updates. Nothing changed in our SCIM connector config that we're aware of. Can you check if something changed on the schema validation side?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report - I can see the failed provisioning attempts in our logs for your tenant starting yesterday afternoon. It looks like a validation update on our end started strictly enforcing the 'name.familyName' attribute, which some of your incoming SCIM payloads are missing. As a workaround, please confirm your HR system is mapping that field, and in the meantime I can temporarily relax that validation rule for your tenant so the 15 pending users can provision while you update the mapping.

subject: Adding a global unsubscribe link to outbound notification emails
body:
We're getting complaints from end users who received appointment reminder emails from our platform and want a one-click unsubscribe option, since right now they have to email our support team to opt out. We're using the Notifications email templates with the standard footer, and I don't see an unsubscribe token variable available in the template editor.

Can you tell me if there's a built-in unsubscribe mechanism we can enable, or if this needs to be handled entirely on our side with a custom link and preference API?
answer: Good question, and this is a common request. Northwind Notifications does support an unsubscribe token - you can add {{unsubscribe_link}} to your email template footer, and it will automatically generate a per-recipient link that updates their preference record without any code on your side. I'll also pass along your feedback that this variable isn't currently surfaced in the template editor's variable picker, since that would make it much easier to discover.

subject: Push notifications not being delivered to Android devices after app update
body:
Since our fleet updated to Mobile App version 4.8.2 last week, drivers report they're no longer receiving push notifications for new dispatch assignments on Android devices. iOS devices seem unaffected. We have 101 devices enrolled and I'm estimating at least 60 have stopped receiving pushes based on support tickets from drivers.

We rely on these notifications for real-time dispatch and this is causing missed pickups. Is there a known issue with the Android push token registration in this version?
answer: This is a significant impact and we're treating it as high priority. We've had a couple of other reports of Android push token registration failing silently after updating to 4.8.2 due to a Firebase token refresh issue introduced in that release - our mobile team is preparing a hotfix now. In the meantime, can you check if affected devices show a valid push token under Settings > Notifications > Diagnostics in the app? That will help us confirm the scope while the fix is finalized, and I'll update you as soon as the patched version is available.

subject: SSO role mapping not assigning correct permissions after group sync
body:
We configured SAML role mapping so users in our 'Warehouse-Managers' IdP group get mapped to the Manager role in Northwind, but after our last group sync, several of these users ended up with the default Viewer role instead. The mapping rule in the SSO config still shows the correct group name and target role.

This started after we renamed the group from 'Warehouse Managers' to 'Warehouse-Managers' two days ago, but I'd expect the mapping to still work since we updated the rule name too. Can you check what's causing the mismatch?
answer: Thanks for the details - this helps narrow it down. It sounds like the role mapping rule may be matching on a cached group identifier rather than the current name, which can happen if the underlying group ID changed during the rename in your IdP even though the display name was updated in our config. Can you confirm whether your IdP treats a group rename as a new object with a new ID? If so, I'll walk you through re-linking the mapping rule to the correct group ID so future syncs assign the Manager role correctly.

subject: RESTORE FROM BACKUP STUCK AT 12% FOR OVER 3 HOURS
body:
WE TRIGGERED A RESTORE FROM OUR LAST NIGHTLY BACKUP AFTER ACCIDENTALLY DELETING A FOLDER WITH INVOICE DOCUMENTS THIS MORNING AROUND 9AM. THE RESTORE JOB ID IS RST-88213 AND IT HAS BEEN STUCK AT 12 PERCENT SINCE 9:40AM. WE ONLY HAVE 4 SEATS AND THIS IS BLOCKING OUR WHOLE TEAM FROM WORKING.

WE NEED THIS FILE BACK TODAY, CAN SOMEONE CHECK WHY THE RESTORE JOB IS STUCK AND NOT PROGRESSING PAST 12 PERCENT
answer: I understand this is urgent and I've escalated restore job RST-88213 to our storage team right now. Jobs stuck at a fixed percentage for this long usually indicate an issue with the backup snapshot indexing, and the team is actively investigating the job logs to identify where it's blocked. I'll update you within the next 30 minutes with either a resumed restore or a clear estimate, and please avoid retriggering the restore in the meantime since that could create a conflicting job.

subject: Repeated transform failures in data pipeline - need guidance on retry config
body:
We have a Data Pipeline connector syncing transaction records from our ledger system, and over the past three days we've had 22 transform failures with the error 'field type coercion failed: expected decimal, got string' on the amount_usd field. The source data hasn't changed format that we can tell.

Could you point me to documentation on configuring custom transform rules or retry/dead-letter handling for these failed records? We'd like to either fix the coercion or at least stop it from blocking the rest of the sync batch.
answer: Thanks for the clear error details - that coercion failure usually happens when a subset of source records has the amount field formatted with a currency symbol or comma separator that breaks strict decimal parsing. I'd suggest adding a custom transform rule with a regex strip step before the type cast, and I'm sending over our transform configuration guide which covers both custom rules and dead-letter queue setup so failed records won't block the rest of the batch going forward. Let me know if you'd like me to review your current transform config directly.

subject: Audit log missing deactivation entries
body: I'm reviewing our Admin Console audit log for Atlas Works ahead of an internal security check and noticed that three user deactivations from October 3rd don't appear in the log at all. I deactivated the accounts for two former contractors and one teacher account, but only one of the three shows up when I filter by event type 'Deactivation'. Our allowlist settings page shows the changes took effect, so the actions clearly happened. Can you confirm whether audit logging is dropping events or if there's a delay?
answer: Thanks for flagging this - missing audit entries for account deactivations is something we want to get to the bottom of quickly. Can you send us the exact usernames or account IDs for the two deactivations that aren't showing up, along with the timestamps you performed them? In the meantime we'll check our event pipeline for any gaps around October 3rd on your workspace.

subject: Feature request: Salesforce sync via Slack notifications
body: We're integrating Northwind's Salesforce connector for Lumen Legal and it's working well overall, but we'd like to get sync failure alerts posted to a Slack channel instead of just email. Right now when a record fails to sync (we saw a handful of 'duplicate external ID' errors last week) we only find out by checking the integration dashboard manually. We also use Okta for SSO if that's relevant to any webhook auth setup. Is a Slack notification option on your roadmap for this connector?
answer: Good question, and thanks for the context on your Okta setup. Slack notifications for sync failures aren't available yet on the Salesforce connector, but I've logged this as a feature request and attached your account to it so we can notify you if it ships. In the meantime, you could poll our sync status API endpoint and route failures into Slack yourself via a webhook - happy to share sample code if that's useful.

subject: Connector keeps losing auth to our accounting source
body: Our finance team at North Freight relies on the Data Pipelines connector pulling from our accounting platform every night, but for the past four days the connector has failed authentication around 2am and we've had to manually re-authorize it each morning. The error shown is 'token refresh failed - invalid_grant'. This is delaying our month-end close reporting and the data quality in our dashboards is now a day behind. Can you help us figure out why the token keeps expiring?
answer: Sorry for the disruption to your close process - a connector re-authenticating daily points to a refresh token issue on our end or a permissions change on the source system. Could you confirm the exact connector name and the account/workspace it's connected under? We'll check our token refresh logs for the invalid_grant errors and get a fix or workaround to you as soon as possible.

subject: SDK throwing rate limit errors on small batch calls
body: I'm testing the Python SDK for Apex Legal's workspace and getting 429 errors even when we're only sending about 20 requests per minute, well under what I thought our Starter plan allows. The error message is 'RateLimitExceeded: retry after 60s' but it happens consistently even after waiting. Is there a lower burst limit I'm missing, or a recommended way to configure retry/backoff in the SDK for this plan tier?
answer: Thanks for the detail. Starter plan API keys have a lower burst limit than the sustained rate, so short spikes of requests can trigger a 429 even if your average usage is low. The SDK has a built-in exponential backoff option you can enable via the client config's retry_policy parameter - I'll send over a short code snippet showing recommended settings for your plan tier.

subject: Bulk MFA enrollment for 279 users
body: We're rolling out mandatory MFA for all Granite Labs staff and need to enroll roughly 279 users in SSO-based MFA without asking each person to self-register individually. Is there a bulk provisioning option or CSV import for MFA enrollment through the Identity and SSO admin panel? answer: This is a common rollout pattern and we can help make it smoother. There's a bulk provisioning API that lets you pre-enroll users into MFA ahead of enforcement, and the admin panel supports setting an enforcement grace period per group. I'll send over the documentation for the bulk enrollment endpoint along with steps for configuring the grace period so staff on leave aren't locked out.

subject: URGENT: Connector auth failures blocking sync for all Blue Retail pipelines
body: Since approximately 6:40am UTC today, every Data Pipelines connector tied to our logistics data sources has been failing with 'authentication error: token expired, refresh unsuccessful'. answer: This has been escalated to P1 and our pipeline engineering team is actively investigating the authentication failures affecting your connectors. We're checking whether this is tied to a token issuer outage or a credential rotation issue on our side and will update you within the hour with findings and an ETA. In the meantime, please avoid manually re-triggering syncs as it may add load while we diagnose the root cause.

subject: All charts broken on main dashboard since this morning

While we investigate, try a hard refresh (Ctrl+Shift+R) as a first step, and we'll follow up shortly with next steps.

subject: Need to rotate API keys without breaking webhooks
body: I'm the workspace admin for North Analytics and we need to rotate our production API keys as part of a routine security review, but I'm concerned this will break our existing webhook integrations and SDK clients that are hardcoded with the current key. Is there a way to run old and new keys concurrently for a transition period? We have several internal services depending on the current key and can't afford downtime.
answer: Good news - our API supports issuing a new key while keeping the old one active for a grace period, so you can rotate keys without downtime. Generate the new key from the API Platform settings page, update your services incrementally, then revoke the old key once you've confirmed all webhooks and SDK clients are using the new one. Let us know if you'd like us to extend the default grace window for your rotation.

subject: Pagination returning duplicate and skipped records
body: We're using the API Platform's list endpoints to pull transaction records for Willow Freight's reconciliation process, and we're seeing pagination behave inconsistently. Some pages return records we already saw on the previous page, and other times we skip records entirely between page 4 and page 5 of a 12-page result set. We're using the cursor returned in the response body as documented. This is causing discrepancies in our finance reconciliation totals.
answer: Thanks for the clear description - inconsistent cursor pagination causing duplicate or skipped records shouldn't happen and we want to fix this promptly. Can you send us the endpoint you're calling along with a sample of the cursor values from pages 4 and 5 where the skip occurred? We'll check whether records are being modified between page fetches, which is a common cause of this kind of drift.

subject: CRITICAL: All scheduled syncs stopped and PHI data exposure concern
body: As of 3:15am today, all scheduled syncs across Harbor Works' Data Pipelines workspace stopped running entirely - none of our 273 seats' connectors have executed since then. subject: Late data again

subject: Duplicate alerts being routed to two channels

subject: Retail connector sync degraded, latency spiking and records out of order
body: Since this morning our scheduled sync for the store-inventory connector has been running 4x slower than normal, and we're seeing records arrive out of sequence in the destination table, causing duplicate SKU entries. answer: Thank you for the clear timeline - this matches a performance regression we're tracking on the store-inventory connector pool that started around the same window. I'm escalating this to our pipeline engineering team now to address both the latency and the out-of-order delivery causing the duplicate SKUs, and I'll share a status update with expected resolution time within the next 30 minutes.

subject: Request: enabling SAML SSO for our workspace
body: We'd like to set up SAML-based SSO for our Northwind workspace so our team can log in through our identity provider instead of individual passwords. subject: Question about API key scoping and rotation
body: We're setting up a new integration and want to confirm best practices around API key scoping - specifically whether we can create read-only keys limited to the reporting endpoints, and what your recommended rotation schedule is for production keys. Also curious if there's an SDK helper for automatic key rotation or if that has to be handled manually via the API.

You can create scoped keys limited to read-only access on reporting endpoints directly from the API Keys section in the console, and we recommend rotating production keys every 90 days. Our SDK doesn't yet have a built-in rotation helper, but you can automate it using the key-management endpoints - I can share a sample script that handles create-then-revoke rotation safely if that would help.

subject: Requesting fix for duplicate alert delivery on high-volume triggers
body: We've identified that alerts tied to high-frequency triggers (like failed login attempts) are sometimes being sent twice within a few seconds of each other, which is causing confusion for our on-call team. answer: Thanks for the thorough writeup - we've seen a few similar reports and agree this needs a proper fix rather than a workaround. I'm filing this as a product change request against the alert delivery service and will loop in engineering to investigate the duplicate-send window on high-frequency triggers. I'll keep you posted on the ticket as it moves through review.

subject: Feedback on tiered rate limits ahead of our Q3 scaling
body: As we plan to onboard several new business units onto the API Platform over the next two quarters, we wanted to raise feedback on the current rate limit tiers. Our integration team feels the jump between the current tier and the next one is too large relative to our actual growth curve, and we'd like to discuss a more graduated limit structure or a usage-based add-on rather than a hard tier upgrade.

Let me know a good time to review options together.

subject: Options for handling late-arriving data in scheduled pipelines
body: We regularly see upstream data from our field devices arrive 1-2 hours after our scheduled sync window closes, meaning that data gets picked up in the next run instead of the intended one. Is there a way to configure a grace period or late-arrival buffer on scheduled syncs so this data gets included automatically, rather than us manually re-triggering runs each time?
answer: Yes, this is a common pattern and we do support configuring a late-arrival grace window on scheduled pipelines - you can set a buffer of up to a few hours per sync in the pipeline settings under 'Schedule Tolerance'. I'll send over a short guide on setting this up for your field-device pipeline, and happy to help configure it directly if you'd prefer to walk through it together.

subject: Late-arriving data causing gaps in energy usage pipeline

I'm escalating to our data pipelines team to confirm the root cause and get the backlog cleared; I'll update you within a few hours with a timeline and whether a retry or reschedule of the aggregation window is needed in the meantime.

subject: Zapier integration failing to trigger on new API records
