subject: Dashboards taking 20+ seconds to load for retail team
body: Our retail analytics dashboards, especially the ones with multiple chart widgets pulling from the sales dataset, have gotten noticeably slower over the past week. Load times went from roughly 3-4 seconds to 20+ seconds, and a few users have reported timeouts when trying to export to CSV. This is affecting about 30 users on the merchandising team who rely on these dashboards daily. Nothing has changed on our end in terms of dataset size or sharing permissions recently.
answer: Appreciate the detailed timeline - a 5-6x slowdown like that points to something on our rendering or query layer rather than your dataset configuration. I'm checking the query performance logs for your workspace's dashboards now and will also verify whether the export timeouts are related. I'll get back to you shortly with findings and, if needed, a temporary workaround for the merchandising team.

subject: Recurring transform failures in energy data pipeline - need guidance
body: We've noticed our data pipeline transforms for the utility billing dataset fail about once a week with a schema mismatch error, usually tied to a null value in the meter_reading_type field. We've been manually re-running the transform each time as a workaround, but I'd like to understand the best practice for handling nullable fields in transform configs so we can set this up properly instead of firefighting. Could someone walk us through the recommended approach or point me to documentation?
answer: Good question, and this is a common pattern when source fields can be null intermittently. The recommended approach is to add a coalesce or default-value step in your transform config before the schema validation stage, which prevents the mismatch from halting the run. I'll send over our documentation on conditional field handling in transforms, and if you'd like, we can hop on a short call to review your specific pipeline config.

subject: Users landing with wrong permissions after SSO login
body: We rolled out SSO for our travel booking teams a few weeks back and things were fine initially, so I wanted to give some background before getting to the issue. Our identity provider sends a groups claim that we map to three Northwind roles: Admin, Editor, and Viewer, and this had been working correctly since setup. Starting this morning, though, several finance and ops managers who should be getting Editor access are instead landing as Viewer, which means they can't approve or edit bookings. We haven't changed our IdP group assignments or the role mapping config on our end. This is blocking approvals for our energy division travel budget cycle that closes today, so we need this resolved urgently.
answer: Thank you for the detailed context, and I understand the urgency given today's budget cycle deadline. This sounds like it could be an issue with how the groups claim is being parsed against your role mapping rules on our side, especially if a recent change affected claim ordering or casing. I'm escalating this to our identity engineering team immediately as a P1 and will update you within the hour with findings; in the meantime, if you can share one affected user's login timestamp, that will help us trace the exact claim payload.

subject: Uploads failing intermittently, need retention policy clarification
body: Since Tuesday we've seen file uploads to Storage fail intermittently for our legal document workflow, returning a generic 'upload could not be completed' message with no further detail, roughly 1 in 5 attempts. Separately, we're also trying to understand our current retention settings, since we need to confirm documents are kept for 7 years per compliance requirements and want to make sure that's configured correctly, not just assumed. Could you help with both the upload failures and confirming retention policy for our workspace?
answer: Thanks for reaching out - I'll look into the intermittent upload failures first since that's actively impacting your workflow; can you share one or two object keys or upload timestamps so I can trace them in our logs? On retention, I'll pull up your workspace's current policy configuration and confirm whether the 7-year setting is applied correctly, and send you a summary of both by end of day.

subject: PUSH NOTIFICATIONS COMPLETELY BROKEN AND YOUR DOCS ARE USELESS
body: ive spent 3 days tryin to get push notifcations workin on our mobile app integration and nothing works, the SDK just crashes on init with a null pointer everytime a user logs in offline mode. your documentaion says to call registerDevice() after login but that doesnt even exist in the version we downloaded. this is completely unacceptable for a paid product, we have 47 seats and if this isnt fixed fast we are cancelling and movin to a competitor.
answer: I'm sorry for the frustration this has caused, and I want to get this resolved quickly. The registerDevice() method was renamed in a recent SDK version, which explains the mismatch with the docs you're referencing - that's on us and I'll get the documentation corrected today. Can you tell me which SDK version you're on and share the crash log around the null pointer during offline login, so our mobile team can confirm the exact fix and get you working again as soon as possible?

subject: help
body: our charts on the main dashbord are all showing blank or broken since this mornign, no data displaying at all just a greyed out box wehre the chart shoud be. this is affectin all 22 of our users tryin to check daily stats, we cant export anything either it just spinns forever. pleae help asap this is urgent for our academy reporting
answer: Thank you for reporting this right away - a full outage on charts and export affecting all your users needs immediate attention, so I'm marking this P1 and escalating now. While our team investigates the rendering failure, could you tell me if this started after any browser update or if it's happening across all browsers and devices for your team? I'll follow up as soon as we have a fix or workaround.

subject: Cannot find where to configure IP allowlist in Admin Console
body: As part of a security review for our legal workspace, I need to restrict access to our Northwind account by IP range, but I can't locate an allowlist setting anywhere in the Admin Console settings tab. I also noticed the audit log doesn't seem to capture changes to workspace-level settings like SSO configuration or user role changes, only login events. Given we're a small team of 19 seats but handle sensitive legal client data, both of these gaps are a concern for our compliance requirements.
answer: Thanks for raising both points - IP allowlisting is available but currently lives under Workspace Settings > Network Access rather than the main Settings tab, which I agree is not intuitive, so I'll flag that for our docs team. On the audit log gap, you're right that settings and role changes aren't currently captured at the same level as login events; I'm logging this as a feature request with our product team and will let you know if there's a workaround in the meantime given your compliance timeline.

subject: jira
body: the jira link intergration stoped syncin issues from our salesforce cases about 2 hours ago, we rely on this heavily across our energy divison teams and now support tickets arent creating jira tickets automaticaly. checked our okta and slack connections and those still seem fine so it might just be the jira piece. this is affectin thousands of users so we need eyes on this asap, no error shown in the integration log just stopped updatin.
answer: Thank you for the quick report and for confirming your Okta and Slack connections are unaffected - that helps narrow this down to the Jira link specifically. Given the scale of impact across your teams, I'm escalating this as P1 right now; can you share the timestamp of the last successful sync and the Jira project key involved, so our integrations team can trace where the sync pipeline stopped without an error trigger?

subject: Audit log missing deactivation events for allowlisted admins
body:
I'm pulling our monthly access audit for Harbor Freight and noticed that admin deactivations from our IP allowlist settings aren't showing up in the Audit Log tab. I deactivated two admin accounts on 3/4 and 3/6 under Settings > Access Control, but neither event appears in the log even after refreshing and re-exporting to CSV.

This is a compliance issue for our fintech reporting cycle. Can you confirm whether allowlist-related deactivations are supposed to be logged, and if this is a known gap?
answer: Thanks for flagging this, and I understand the compliance urgency here. We've confirmed that deactivation events tied to allowlist changes are currently not being written to the Audit Log correctly, which is a bug on our side rather than expected behavior. I'm escalating this to our platform team now and will update you within 24 hours with either a fix timeline or a manual export of the missing entries for your records.

subject: Best way to paginate large result sets via API
body:
We're building a small internal reporting tool against the API Platform and currently pulling course enrollment records using offset-based pagination with limit=50. As our dataset grows past a few thousand rows, requests are getting slower and we've started hitting rate limit errors intermittently.

Is there a cursor-based pagination option we should switch to instead, and if offset pagination is being deprecated, could you point us to documentation on the recommended approach going forward?
answer: Good question, and yes, we do recommend moving to cursor-based pagination for anything beyond a few hundred records since it's more efficient and avoids the rate limit pressure you're seeing with large offsets. Offset-based pagination on this endpoint is planned for deprecation later this year, so I'll send over a link to our updated pagination guide with cursor examples, and happy to hop on a call if it'd help with the migration.

subject: Connector re-authentication causing delayed syncs
body:
Our Salesforce connector in Data Pipelines keeps dropping its auth token roughly every 36 hours, which forces a manual re-authentication and delays our finance sync by several hours each time. Over the past week this happened on Monday, Wednesday, and again this morning around 6am ET.

Once re-authenticated the sync catches up fine and data quality looks fine, so it's really the frequency of token expiration that's the concern. Is there a way to extend the token lifetime or set up an automatic refresh so we don't have to babysit this connector daily?
answer: Thanks for the detailed timeline, that's helpful. This connector should be using a refresh token flow that renews automatically, so seeing manual re-auth needed every 36 hours suggests the refresh isn't completing successfully on our end. I'm opening an investigation into the token refresh job for your Salesforce connector and will report back with findings, in the meantime you shouldn't need to do anything further manually if the current session is still active.

subject: App crashes when reconnecting after offline mode
body:
While testing the mobile app integration for Granite Retail, I found that if a user goes offline mid-session and then regains connectivity, the app crashes on relaunch about half the time. This happens after login, when cached data tries to sync back with push notifications pending.

I've reproduced this on iOS 17.4 using a test account with three queued push notifications. Crash logs show a null reference during the sync reconciliation step. Would love feedback on whether this is a known issue or something specific to our offline data setup.
answer: Thanks for the detailed repro steps, this is really helpful for our mobile team. A null reference during sync reconciliation with queued push notifications does sound like it could be an edge case in how cached state merges after reconnect, so I'd like to get your crash logs and the test account identifier to dig deeper. We'll treat this as a bug investigation and update you once we've reproduced it on our side.

subject: How to add multiple IP ranges to allowlist
body:
I'm setting up IP allowlisting in the Admin Console for Harbor Academy and need to add a few CIDR ranges for our campus network and a couple of remote staff VPNs. The settings page only seems to accept one IP or range at a time before requiring a save, and I want to confirm there's no bulk entry option I'm missing.

Could you walk me through the correct format for adding multiple ranges, and whether there's a limit on how many entries we can have active at once?
answer: You're right that the current UI takes entries one at a time, though there's no hard limit on the number of active ranges beyond a soft cap of 50 entries per workspace. Each entry should be in standard CIDR notation, like 203.0.113.0/24, and you can add your campus and VPN ranges sequentially under Settings > Access Control > IP Allowlist, saving after each addition.

subject: Shared dashboards visible to unauthorized users - urgent
body:
We just discovered that dashboards we marked as private are showing up for users outside the intended sharing group. Multiple employees at Lumen Robotics who should not have access are seeing revenue charts that were only meant for finance leads. This looks like it's affecting all dashboards created after our last sharing permissions update on Tuesday.

Given we're a fintech company this is a serious data exposure concern and needs immediate attention. Please advise on how to lock this down right now while you investigate.
answer: I understand the urgency and we're treating this as a high priority issue immediately. As an immediate mitigation, please go to each affected dashboard's Share settings and temporarily set visibility to 'Owner only' until we confirm the scope of the issue, and we're pulling logs now to identify exactly which dashboards and users were impacted since Tuesday's update. I'll follow up within the hour with findings and next steps.

subject: URGENT: pipeline outage causing missing late data across all connectors
body:
Our Data Pipelines instance for Atlas Energy has been failing to ingest late-arriving records since approximately 2:15am ET today. All four of our connectors (SAP, Snowflake, two custom REST sources) are showing sync status 'stalled' and our downstream finance dashboards are now several hours out of date.

This is blocking our end-of-day close process and we have a hard deadline at 5pm ET. We need immediate assistance to determine if data is being lost or just delayed, and how to recover the backlog once the underlying issue is fixed.
answer: This has been escalated to our on-call incident team as a P0 outage and we're actively investigating the root cause across all four connectors right now. Initial checks confirm the stalled data is being queued rather than dropped, so no data loss is expected, but we understand the urgency of your 5pm close deadline and will provide status updates every 30 minutes until this is resolved and backlog recovery is underway.

subject: Duplicate alert emails from Notifications - need routing change
body:
We've noticed that billing alert emails from Notifications are being sent twice to our finance team distribution list, once from the automated escalation rule and again from what looks like a legacy rule that should have been disabled. This has been happening for about a week and is creating confusion about which alert is current.

Could someone help us review our alert routing configuration and disable the duplicate rule? We'd like to keep only the escalation path active going forward.
answer: Thanks for reporting this, duplicate alerts are definitely something we want to clean up quickly. Could you send over the exact rule names or IDs from your Notifications settings page, or a screenshot of the Alert Routing tab? Once I can see both rules I'll help identify which one is the legacy duplicate and walk you through safely disabling it without affecting your active escalation path.

subject: Recurring transform failures on retail sales connector
body:
We're seeing repeated transform failures in Data Pipelines on our retail sales connector for Summit Foods, roughly 15-20 failed runs per week over the past month. The error summary just says 'transform step failed: schema mismatch' without specifying which fields are involved, which makes debugging painful across our 2000+ seat org with multiple teams relying on this data.

Could you help us get more detailed error output, or point us to where we can see field-level mismatch details? We'd also appreciate any feedback on best practices for handling schema drift from upstream retail POS systems.
answer: Thanks for the detailed frequency data, that's useful for us to prioritize. Right now the transform error summary is intentionally high-level, but you can get field-level mismatch details by enabling verbose logging on that connector under Pipeline Settings > Advanced > Debug Mode, which will show the specific columns causing the schema mismatch. I'll also share our guide on handling schema drift from POS sources, and I'd recommend setting up a schema validation step upstream to catch drift before it hits the transform stage.

subject: Need immediate fix: email digest sending duplicates to all workspace users
body:
Since this morning our Notifications email digests are going out twice to every user in the Summit Travel workspace, once around 7am and again around 7:45am with identical content. We have 237 seats and this is generating a flood of support questions internally asking which one is correct.

This needs to be fixed urgently as it's affecting our entire team's inbox and creating confusion about duplicate alerts. Can you disable the duplicate send or roll back to yesterday's digest schedule while this is investigated?
answer: I'm sorry for the disruption this is causing across your workspace, and I've flagged this as a high priority issue given it's affecting all 237 users. As an immediate step, I'm disabling the second digest send window on our end while we investigate why the schedule duplicated, and I'll confirm once that's stopped along with a root cause update within the next few hours.

subject: SDK throwing 429 errors after upgrading to v4.2 - production impact
body:
We upgraded the Northwind API SDK from v3.9 to v4.2 across our manufacturing ops portal last night and now roughly 40% of calls to /v2/inventory/sync are returning 429 Too Many Requests, even though our request volume hasn't changed. The changelog mentions the old retry-with-backoff helper was deprecated in v4.2, and it looks like the new client isn't respecting our configured rate limit tier of 500 req/min.

This is affecting order sync for 162 users on our floor systems. We need to know if we should roll back to v3.9 or if there's a config flag we're missing in v4.2 to restore the previous rate limit behavior.
answer: Thanks for flagging this quickly - I can see the elevated 429 rate on your account starting around the SDK upgrade window. This matches a known issue where v4.2 defaults new clients to the standard tier instead of reading your account's provisioned rate limit; we have a hotfix flag (RATE_LIMIT_OVERRIDE=account) you can set in your client init to restore correct behavior immediately. I'm escalating this to our SDK team to get the default fixed in v4.2.1, and will follow up within the hour with confirmation the override works on your side.

subject: Request to change audit log retention and export settings
body:
We'd like to adjust our audit log configuration in the Admin Console. Right now logs are retained for 30 days but our compliance team wants at least 90 days for login and deactivation events. Could you also confirm whether we can export audit logs as CSV on a scheduled basis rather than manually each week?

This isn't urgent, just want to get it sorted before our next internal audit review in about a month.
answer: Happy to help with this. For Starter plan accounts, audit log retention is currently fixed at 30 days, but I can submit a request to extend retention to 90 days for your account as a manual configuration change on our end. Scheduled CSV exports aren't available yet on Starter, though it's a frequently requested feature we're tracking - I'll add your account to that feedback list and let you know if it ships.

subject: Jira integration not showing linked issues in dashboard
body:
I've set up the Jira connector under Integrations for our legal ops workspace, and the initial sync completed fine (I can see the connection status as Active), but linked Jira issues aren't appearing on the associated project dashboard tiles. We use this alongside our Okta SSO and Slack integrations, which are both working normally.

Is this a known limitation with certain Jira project types, or do I need to re-map project keys somewhere in the integration settings?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. This is usually caused by the Jira project key mapping not being refreshed after the initial connector setup - could you check under Integrations > Jira > Project Mapping and confirm your legal ops project key is listed there? If it's missing, re-adding it should trigger a re-sync and the linked issues should populate on the dashboard within a few minutes. Let us know if that resolves it or if the mapping already looks correct.

subject: PDF export cutting off dashboard widgets
body: When I export our production metrics dashboard to PDF, the two widgets on the right side of the layout get cut off completely instead of wrapping to a second page. This happens consistently whether I export from the dashboard view directly or from the scheduled export menu. We're only on 4 seats here so it's just myself and one colleague affected, but it's still a problem for our weekly ops report.
answer: Thanks for the report - PDF export follows the on-screen grid layout, so widgets placed beyond the printable width can get clipped rather than reflowed. As a workaround, try switching the dashboard to the 'Print Layout' view before exporting, which stacks widgets vertically and should include everything. I'll also log this as feedback for our dashboards team to consider auto-pagination for wide layouts.

subject: Users locked out - MFA enrollment failing for entire team
body:
As of this morning none of our 4 users can complete MFA enrollment when logging into Identity and SSO - the QR code screen loads but scanning it in an authenticator app returns 'invalid setup code' every time. This started right after we enabled the mandatory MFA policy yesterday afternoon, and now nobody on the team can get past login, which is blocking all work.

We need this fixed urgently since it's affecting all active users at Ember Media, not just one account.
answer: This is a P1 for us and I'm escalating it right now. In the meantime, please have one admin log in via the emergency access URL (sent to your account owner's registered recovery email) to temporarily disable the mandatory MFA policy so your team can regain access while we investigate the QR code generation issue. I'll update you within 30 minutes with root cause and a permanent fix.

subject: Getting duplicate push and email alerts for same events
body:
Our ops team has been receiving duplicate notifications for the same system events since Tuesday - each alert triggers both a push notification and an email, and in several cases we're getting the email itself twice within a minute or two. We've checked our notification rules and only have one rule configured per event type, so this doesn't look like a config issue on our end.

With 4562 users across our travel platform, this duplication is generating a huge volume of noise and several team leads are asking us to just mute notifications entirely, which isn't a real fix.
answer: Thank you for the clear writeup - we've had a couple of other reports of duplicate email delivery starting this week and are actively investigating a possible issue in the notification dispatch queue that may be re-processing events. I don't yet have a root cause but I'm treating this as a priority bug given your user count, and will update you as soon as we identify the fix or a safe interim mitigation that doesn't require disabling notifications entirely.

subject: SCIM-Provisionierung erstellt keine neuen Benutzer mehr
body:
Seit heute Morgen funktioniert unsere SCIM-Provisionierung nicht mehr korrekt. Neue Mitarbeiter, die wir über unseren Identity Provider anlegen, werden nicht mehr automatisch in Northwind angelegt. Bestehende Benutzer und deren Berechtigungen scheinen unverändert, aber alle Neuanlagen seit gestern Abend fehlen komplett.

Wir haben 18 Lizenzen bei Cobalt Legal und können aktuell keine neuen Mitarbeiter für den Login freischalten. Das blockiert unser Onboarding für diese Woche vollständig. Bitte um dringende Prüfung, da SSO und MFA für bestehende Nutzer noch laufen.
answer: Vielen Dank für die Meldung, das behandeln wir als P1. Können Sie uns kurz mitteilen, ob im SCIM-Log Ihres Identity Providers Fehlercodes für die letzten Provisionierungsversuche angezeigt werden? Wir prüfen parallel auf unserer Seite, ob es einen Fehler im SCIM-Endpunkt gibt, und melden uns innerhalb der nächsten Stunde mit einem Update oder einer Sofortmaßnahme, damit Ihr Onboarding fortgesetzt werden kann.

subject: Incorrect refund applied - billing credits not matching invoice
body:
We requested a refund for an overcharge on our March invoice after being billed for 6 seats when we only had 4 active users at the time. Support confirmed the credit would be applied, but our latest invoice still shows the full original amount with no credit line item, and now we've been charged again for this cycle without the adjustment.

As a workspace admin at Vertex Legal I need this resolved before our finance team processes this month's payment. Can you confirm the credit status and correct invoice total?
answer: I'm sorry for the confusion and the delay in getting this reflected correctly. I can see the refund case was approved but it looks like the credit was never posted to your account ledger before the new invoice generated. I'm escalating this to billing now to apply the credit immediately and issue a corrected invoice - given the impact on your payment cycle, I'll treat this as urgent and follow up today with confirmed numbers.

subject: Need to change email digest frequency and stop duplicate sends
body:
We'd like to switch our team's email digest notifications from daily to weekly, but every time I change the setting under Notifications it seems to revert back to daily within a day, and in the meantime some users are getting both the daily and weekly digest on the same morning. This is a small team of 8 at Harbor Media so it's very noticeable when it happens.

Can you help us make the weekly setting actually stick, and clear up the duplicate sends in the meantime?
answer: Thanks for reporting this - a setting that reverts on its own points to a caching issue in the digest scheduler rather than something you're doing wrong, and I'm marking this P1 given it's affecting your whole team's notifications. Please try re-saving the weekly setting one more time so I can capture a fresh timestamp, and I'll trace it through our logs to see why it's reverting and stop the duplicate sends from recurring.

subject: Scheduled data pipeline syncs running hours late
body:
Our nightly scheduled sync from the media asset connector to our warehouse has been running 3-4 hours later than its configured 1am window for the past three nights (April 9, 10, 11). The sync eventually completes successfully with no error in the run logs, but the delay is pushing back our morning reporting jobs that depend on fresh data.

We have 14 seats on this Northwind account and only this one connector seems affected - our other two pipelines are running on schedule. Is there a known latency issue with this connector type right now?
answer: Thanks for the detailed timeline - that's helpful. We've seen some queuing delays on a subset of media asset connectors this week due to higher load on that connector pool, which would explain the consistent multi-hour lag while other pipelines stay unaffected. I'll check the current queue depth for your connector instance and see if we can prioritize your scheduled runs or move you to a less congested pool, and will update you shortly with next steps.

subject: PDF export missing chart legends on multi-page dashboards
body: We're exporting a 6-page dashboard to PDF from the Analytics Overview workspace and noticed that the chart legends are dropped on pages 3 through 6, though they render fine in-app. This started happening after we added the new cohort comparison widgets last week. Export job ID was exp-88213-pdf if that helps trace it.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report and the job ID. This looks related to a known rendering issue where legends get truncated when a dashboard exceeds a certain widget count per page during PDF rasterization. I'm logging this against exp-88213-pdf and will follow up with either a workaround (splitting the export into smaller sections) or an ETA once engineering confirms the fix scope.

subject: Alert routing sending duplicate emails to entire workspace instead of on-call group
body: Since yesterday our billing alert rules are firing correctly but every notification is going out to all 14 workspace members instead of just the on-call distribution list we configured under Notification Rules > Routing. We're getting flooded with duplicate emails for every threshold breach, sometimes 5-6 copies per alert. This needs to be fixed urgently since it's causing real alert fatigue and people are starting to ignore them entirely.
answer: This is affecting alert delivery for your whole team so we're treating it as a priority issue right now. We can see the routing rule for your workspace is misreading the on-call group as 'all members' after a recent sync of your escalation policy — we're pushing a fix to correct the group binding and will confirm once duplicates stop, likely within the next couple of hours. In the meantime, you can temporarily disable email channel on the affected rule and rely on the dashboard alert feed to avoid the flood.

subject: Need to restore Storage bucket from backup after accidental bulk delete
body: One of our scripts had a bad filter condition and deleted about 3,200 objects from our 'product-images-prod' bucket around 14:20 UTC today. We have daily backups enabled under the Storage retention policy and I need to restore from the snapshot taken last night before this happened. Can you point me to the restore endpoint or process for this, and confirm retention covers 24-hour rollbacks on the Pro plan?
answer: Sorry to hear about the accidental delete — the good news is your Pro plan retention includes nightly snapshots with a 7-day rollback window, so last night's snapshot should be intact. I'll open an escalation to have our storage team initiate a restore of 'product-images-prod' to the pre-14:20 UTC state; please avoid further writes to that bucket until we confirm the restore is complete, which we'll update you on shortly.

subject: pipline delayed data causing wrong billing totals
body: we noticed since monday that some usage events are arriving 4-6 hours late into the 'energy-usage-hourly' pipline, wich means our billing dashbord shows incorect totals for the current day untill the late data finaly lands. Its affecting about 15% of records based on our own logs. can someone check if theres a backlog or delay on the ingestion side for account vertex-energy-prod?
answer: Thanks for flagging this — we're seeing an ingestion delay on the energy-usage-hourly pipeline for your account, likely tied to a backlog in one of the upstream connectors we're currently investigating. This shouldn't cause data loss, just late arrival, but we understand it affects your billing totals until it catches up. We'll update you within the next few hours once we've cleared the backlog or have a firmer timeline.

subject: PDF exports are BROKEN and this is costing us client meetings
body:
This is the third time this month our dashboard PDF export has failed or produced a blank chart section right before a client review. Today's export for our Q3 compliance dashboard came out with two entire chart panels missing and the shared link version looks fine but the PDF does not match. We are paying for 66 seats and this feature should just work.

I need someone to actually look into this today, not just send a generic response. If this keeps happening we will be reevaluating whether Northwind is worth the cost for our team.
answer: I understand how frustrating it is to have this fail right before client meetings, and I'm sorry for the disruption. I've escalated this to our dashboard rendering team with priority given the repeated pattern — can you send me the export job ID or approximate timestamp of today's failed export so we can pull the exact render logs? We'll get a root cause and a fix or reliable workaround to you as quickly as possible.

subject: Discrepancy between invoiced amount and plan pricing shown in portal
body: Our latest invoice (INV-2024-08841) shows a total that's about $1,200 higher than what our Enterprise plan pricing page and contract terms indicate for 588 seats. I've compared line items and the seat-based charge seems to be calculated at a higher per-seat rate than what was quoted in our renewal agreement from March. Could someone review the invoice breakdown and confirm whether this is a billing system error or a rate change we weren't notified about?
answer: Thank you for flagging the discrepancy with clear reference to INV-2024-08841. I'm pulling up your account's contracted rate from the March renewal alongside the invoice line items now to compare — this does sound like it could be a rate mismatch on our end. I'll have a detailed breakdown and correction plan (or explanation) back to you within one business day.

subject: Question about upcoming API v1 deprecations affecting our webhooks
body: I saw the notice about API v1 endpoints being deprecated and wanted to understand the timeline better before we plan our migration. We currently rely on the v1 webhook payload format for order sync notifications, and I want to know if the rate limits on v2 webhooks are the same or different, and whether there's a migration guide available. We're a small team so want to plan this carefully rather than scramble later.
answer: Good timing to ask — v1 endpoints, including the webhook payload format you're using, are scheduled for sunset in about 90 days, with v2 already stable. Rate limits on v2 webhooks are slightly higher (600/min vs 300/min on v1), and we do have a migration guide covering payload schema changes; I'll send that link over along with a checklist so your team can plan the cutover without rushing.

subject: Biometric login crashes mobile app on all iOS devices since update
body: After updating to the latest Northwind mobile app version, every one of our 4 staff members using Face ID or Touch ID login gets an immediate crash on the authentication screen. The app closes completely with no error message shown, and this happens both online and in offline mode. This is blocking all our field staff from accessing patient scheduling data through the app right now.
answer: This is a serious issue since it's blocking your entire team's mobile access, so we're escalating immediately. We've had a couple of similar crash reports tied to the latest iOS build's biometric handler and engineering is actively investigating; in the meantime, please have your staff use password login as a temporary workaround while we work on a fix. We'll update you as soon as we have a patch or more specific guidance.

subject: Invoice shows charges for seats we don't have provisioned
body: Our latest invoice lists a charge for 25 seats but we only have 20 active users provisioned in the admin console under Pioneer Retail's workspace. I checked the user management page and there are exactly 20 accounts, none suspended or pending. Can someone check if this is a billing sync bug and issue a corrected invoice or credit for the difference?
answer: Thanks for catching this and confirming the exact count from your admin console. This looks like a sync lag between our seat provisioning service and the billing system rather than an intentional charge, so I'm opening an investigation into your account's seat count history. Once confirmed, we'll issue a corrected invoice or credit for the 5-seat difference.

subject: Rollenzuordnung nach SSO-Login funktioniert nicht korrekt
body: Wir haben SSO über unseren Identity Provider eingerichtet und die Rollenzuordnung (Role Mapping) für unsere 18 Nutzer konfiguriert, aber mehrere Mitarbeiter landen nach dem Login automatisch in der Rolle 'Viewer' statt in der zugewiesenen 'Admin'- oder 'Editor'-Rolle. Die Attribute im SAML-Response scheinen korrekt gesetzt zu sein, laut den Logs unseres IdP. Können Sie prüfen, ob das Mapping auf Northwind-Seite korrekt greift, besonders für Nutzer mit mehreren Gruppenattributen?
answer: Danke für die genaue Beschreibung. Das klingt nach einem Problem bei der Verarbeitung mehrerer Gruppenattribute im SAML-Response auf unserer Seite, da bei Nutzern mit nur einer Gruppe das Mapping vermutlich korrekt funktioniert. Wir prüfen jetzt die Rollen-Mapping-Konfiguration für Ihr Konto und die Verarbeitung mehrwertiger Attribute und melden uns mit einer Lösung oder einem Zwischenstatus innerhalb der nächsten Stunden.

subject: Dashboards taking 30+ seconds to load for finance team
body:
Our revenue dashboard has become nearly unusable over the past week. It used to load in a few seconds but now takes 30-45 seconds every time, and sometimes times out entirely. We have 25 people on the team relying on this for daily reporting, and three of them are on a shared dashboard link that's especially slow.

Can someone look into why this is happening? We haven't changed the underlying data sources recently, just added a couple of filters and a new pivot table widget last Tuesday.
answer:
Thanks for flagging this - a dashboard that takes 30+ seconds is definitely not expected behavior, and I understand how disruptive this is for daily reporting. I'm escalating this to our performance team right away to look at query load and widget rendering on your account; in the meantime, could you tell me the exact name of the dashboard and roughly what time of day you're seeing the worst slowdowns?

As a quick mitigation, removing the pivot table widget added last Tuesday may help since those can be heavier to render - I'll follow up within a few hours with findings from our investigation.

subject: Charts not rendering on shared dashboard
body:
We share a dashboard with our regional partners and since yesterday the bar charts on it just show blank white boxes instead of data. This happens both when I view it internally and when I check the shared external link. Line charts on the same dashboard still work fine, so it seems specific to the bar chart widget type.

Could someone help us figure out what's going on? We use this for a weekly ops sync and need it working before Thursday.
answer:
Thanks for the detailed description - that's helpful for narrowing this down. Since line charts render fine but bar charts show blank, this points to a widget-specific rendering issue rather than a data problem; could you send us the dashboard name and, if possible, a screenshot of the blank chart?

We'll investigate on our end and aim to have this resolved well before your Thursday sync. In the meantime, you could temporarily switch the bar chart widgets to a table view as a workaround if needed.

subject: Question about data retention policy for archived files
body: I'm trying to understand our current retention settings for archived storage buckets. We have some logistics documents from 2022 that I expected to be purged automatically after 24 months, but they're still showing up in our storage usage report. Is retention configured per-bucket or account-wide?
answer:
Good question - retention policies in Storage are set per-bucket, not account-wide, so it's possible the 2022 documents are sitting in a bucket with a different or no retention rule applied. Could you let us know the bucket name so we can check its current configuration and confirm whether the 24-month policy was actually applied there?

Once we confirm the setting, we can help you adjust it or manually purge the older files if that's what you're looking for.

subject: Request to add unsubscribe link to transactional alert emails
body:
We'd like to request a change to how unsubscribe works on our notification emails. Right now our transactional alerts (payment confirmations, billing reminders) don't include an unsubscribe link, but a few of our customers have asked to opt out of certain non-critical notices like weekly summaries.

Could we get a way to let recipients unsubscribe from the summary category specifically, without affecting critical payment alerts? Happy to discuss what's feasible on our plan.
answer:
Thanks for the detailed request - this is a reasonable ask and something other customers have asked about too. Currently unsubscribe preferences are managed at the notification-template level, so it is possible to add an opt-out link specifically to your weekly summary template while keeping critical payment alerts exempt from it.

I'll pass this along to our product team to confirm the exact configuration path for your account, and follow up with steps once I hear back.

subject: Getting duplicate emails after unsubscribing from alerts
body:
I unsubscribed from the weekly budget alert emails on March 3rd using the link in the footer, but I'm still receiving them - and now I'm getting two copies of each one instead of one. This started right after I clicked unsubscribe. My account email is tied to the finance manager role if that matters.

Can someone look into why the unsubscribe didn't take effect and why I'm now getting duplicates?
answer:
Sorry for the trouble this is causing - receiving duplicates after unsubscribing suggests your preference update may have created a conflicting subscription record instead of replacing the old one. I'm looking into your account's notification settings now to identify the duplicate entry and remove it properly.

I'll confirm once this is fixed and make sure you stop receiving the weekly budget alerts as intended - expect an update from me shortly.

subject: Seat count mismatch causing incorrect invoice charge
body:
Our latest invoice shows a charge for 140 seats, but we only have 133 active users according to our admin console. This is the second month in a row with a discrepancy - last month it was off by 4 seats and we got a partial credit. Could someone reconcile our actual seat count against billing and correct the invoice?

We need this resolved before our finance team closes the books this week.
answer:
Thanks for catching this and for the specifics on last month's discrepancy too - a 7-seat mismatch two months running suggests something isn't syncing correctly between your admin console and billing system. I'm opening an investigation now to compare your active user count against what billing has on record, and will work with our billing team to issue a correction on this invoice.

Given your timeline, I'll prioritize getting you an updated invoice or credit confirmation before your books close this week.

subject: Alerts being routed to wrong distribution list
body:
Since this morning, our critical price-movement alerts have been going to our general operations email list instead of the trading desk list they're supposed to route to. This means the people who need to act on these alerts immediately aren't seeing them, while the ops team is getting flooded with alerts that aren't relevant to them.

We have 7 seats on this account and configured the routing rule last week without issues - not sure what changed since then.
answer:
This is important to fix quickly given the time-sensitive nature of these alerts - thank you for the clear description. I'm checking your alert routing configuration now to see if the rule reverted or if there was a conflict introduced after last week's setup; could you confirm the exact name of the routing rule so I can pinpoint it faster?

I'll update you as soon as I've identified the cause and restored correct routing to the trading desk list.

subject: Upload failures when pushing files via Storage API
body:
I'm integrating our invoice processing pipeline with the Storage API and getting consistent failures on uploads over 50MB. Smaller files work fine. Here's the error I'm seeing:

```
POST /v1/storage/objects HTTP/1.1
HTTP/1.1 413 Request Entity Too Large
{
  "error": "payload_exceeds_limit",
  "max_size_mb": 50,
  "received_size_mb": 78
}
```

Is 50MB a hard limit on our plan, or is there a multipart upload endpoint we should be using instead for larger files?
answer:
Thanks for including the error details, that makes this easy to diagnose. Yes, 50MB is the current single-request upload limit on your plan, but we do support multipart/chunked uploads for larger files via the /v1/storage/objects/multipart endpoint, which should resolve the 413 errors you're seeing for your 78MB files.

I'll send over documentation links for the multipart flow, and let us know if you hit any issues implementing it - happy to help troubleshoot further.

subject: Need to update workspace settings and allowlist for new office
body:
We're opening a new office location and need to update our workspace settings to allow access from a new IP range for our admin console. Could you also confirm how the audit log tracks allowlist changes - we need this for an internal compliance review next month.

Additionally, one former employee's account still shows as active in the admin panel and needs to be deactivated; their access should have ended on the 15th.
answer:
Happy to help with all three items. For the allowlist update, please send over the new IP range or CIDR block and I'll add it to your workspace settings today; allowlist changes are automatically recorded in the audit log with timestamp and the admin who made the change, which should cover your compliance review.

I'll also deactivate the former employee's account now - can you confirm their username or user ID so I make sure we deactivate the correct one?

subject: Hitting rate limits unexpectedly on API v2 endpoints
body:
We're seeing 429 responses on our /v2/bookings endpoint starting yesterday, even though our request volume hasn't increased - we're averaging around 200 requests/minute which is well under the documented 500/minute limit for our plan. Our SDK version is 3.4.1. Has something changed with how rate limits are calculated on v2, or is there a deprecation happening that we missed?

This is affecting our booking confirmation flow for customers, so any insight would help.
answer:
Thanks for the specifics - 200 requests/minute hitting 429s when your limit should be 500/minute does sound like a bug rather than expected throttling. We recently made changes to how rate limits are tracked on v2 endpoints and it's possible burst traffic patterns are being counted differently than average throughput; I'm pulling your account's request logs now to check.

I'll also verify whether SDK 3.4.1 has any known issues with rate limit headers, since a mismatch there could explain what you're seeing. I'll follow up shortly with findings and a fix or workaround.

subject: Intermittent upload failures to Storage buckets
body: We manage a shared workspace bucket for North Capital (travel-docs-prod) and since Tuesday around 14 employees have reported failed uploads of PDF itineraries over 15MB. The error we see is 'Upload rejected: quota exceeded' even though our dashboard shows we're at 68% of our storage allocation. Retention policy on that bucket is set to 90 days, so I don't think old files are the cause. Can you check if there's a per-folder cap we're hitting?
answer: Thanks for the detail. This looks like a per-folder object cap rather than the account-level quota you see in the dashboard - some legacy buckets created before our Q1 update have a 50k object ceiling. I'm checking the object count on travel-docs-prod now and will confirm within a day whether we need to raise that ceiling or migrate the bucket to the new storage tier.

subject: URGENT: Production API keys returning 401 after rotation
body: We rotated our API keys this morning as part of routine security hygiene and now every webhook call from our billing integration is failing with 401 Unauthorized. This is affecting all 54 seats at Delta Health - claims processing is completely blocked. We generated the new key at 9:12am ET via the console (key ID ends in 7f3a) and revoked the old one five minutes later, but the new key doesn't seem to be propagating to our webhook endpoints.
answer: Escalating this immediately as a P1 - key propagation delays affecting all integrations is a known edge case we're actively investigating. Can you confirm the exact revocation timestamp for the old key and whether you're calling the webhook endpoint directly or through our SDK? In the meantime, please do not generate another new key, as that can compound the propagation issue; we're pushing a manual sync to your account now.

subject: Shared dashboard shows 'access denied' for viewer role
body: I'm integrating our Vertex Travel analytics into a customer-facing portal using the Dashboards API, and when I share a dashboard link with viewer-only permissions, the recipient gets 'Access Denied - insufficient permissions' even though the share settings clearly say Viewer. This happens specifically on dashboards containing exported chart widgets (tested with dashboard ID dash_88213). Dashboards without export-enabled charts share fine.
answer: That's a helpful reproduction case, thank you. It sounds like the export permission on individual chart widgets is overriding the dashboard-level viewer role - we've seen this with charts that have 'allow export' toggled on. Try disabling export on that specific widget as a workaround while we confirm the permission inheritance bug on our end, and I'll follow up once we have a fix timeline.

subject: Best practice for bulk deactivating users after layoffs
body: We had a restructuring at Ember Robotics and need to deactivate about 40 of our 127 seats by end of week. I know we can deactivate one at a time in Admin Console but that's slow and I want to make sure the audit log captures who performed each deactivation and when, since HR compliance will ask for that. Is there a bulk deactivation feature, or a CSV upload option, and does the audit log retain deactivation records permanently or does it roll off after some retention period?
answer: There is a bulk deactivation option under Admin Console > Users > Bulk Actions where you can upload a CSV of user emails or select multiple rows directly in the table. Every deactivation event is logged in the audit trail with the acting admin, timestamp, and reason field if you fill one in, and those records are retained for 400 days by default - let me know if you need an export before then for your HR file.

subject: Need more storage without upgrading plan
body: Our North Retail workspace is on the Starter plan with 7 seats and we're consistently hitting our storage quota warning at 85% used. We store energy audit reports and compliance backups that we're required to retain for 7 years, so deleting old files isn't really an option. Is there an add-on storage pack we can purchase without moving to a higher tier, and where can I find documentation on how retention policies interact with quota limits?
answer: Yes, we offer storage add-on packs in 50GB increments that can be applied to a Starter plan without a full upgrade - I'll send a link to purchase one from your billing settings. For the retention question, our documentation on quota and retention policy interaction is in the Storage guide under 'Long-term retention and quota planning', and I'd recommend setting a retention lock on your compliance folder so those files are excluded from any future cleanup automation.

subject: Falsche Sitzplatzanzahl auf unserer Rechnung
body: Bei der Überprüfung unserer letzten Rechnung für North Works ist mir aufgefallen, dass wir für 22 Sitzplätze berechnet wurden, obwohl wir laut unserem Admin-Bereich nur 16 aktive Nutzer haben. Das betrifft den Starter-Plan und ist bereits die zweite Rechnung mit dieser Abweichung. Können Sie das dringend prüfen, da wir sonst die nächste Zahlung zurückhalten müssen?
answer: Vielen Dank für den Hinweis, das prüfen wir sofort mit Priorität. Es kann sein, dass deaktivierte Nutzer aus einem früheren Abrechnungszeitraum noch mitgezählt wurden - wir gleichen die Zahlen aus Ihrem Admin-Bereich mit unserem Billing-System ab und melden uns innerhalb der nächsten 24 Stunden mit einer korrigierten Rechnung oder einer Erklärung der Abweichung.

subject: Digest emails sending duplicates every hour instead of daily
body: Since yesterday our team at Vertex Academy has been receiving the same weekly summary digest email 6-8 times per day instead of once a week. All 8 seats are affected. I checked our notification settings and the frequency is still set to 'Weekly - Mondays 8am' so nothing changed on our end. This is flooding inboxes and people are asking if it's a phishing attempt.
answer: I'm very sorry for the disruption this is causing - I'm escalating this now since it's affecting your entire workspace. This matches a digest scheduler issue we're tracking where the frequency setting isn't being read correctly for some accounts created before our recent notification service update. As an immediate step, please pause the weekly digest under Notification Settings while we push a fix, and I'll confirm once it's safe to re-enable.

subject: SCIM provisioning failing for new hires - urgent
body: We enabled SCIM provisioning for Orion Analytics about two weeks ago and it worked fine initially, but starting this Monday new users created in our identity provider are not appearing in Northwind at all. No error shows in our IdP logs, and our SCIM endpoint test in the Northwind console returns 'Connection OK' but no sync occurs. We have 3 new hires who can't log in and need access today for a client deadline.
answer: Understood - I'm treating this as high priority given the login impact. Can you send me the SCIM group mapping configuration and the timestamp of your most recent successful sync? A common cause is a stale sync token after an IdP-side attribute change; while we investigate, I can manually provision the 3 new hires so they're not blocked today.

subject: Biometrische anmeldung funktioniert nicht auf iOS
body: Wir testen die Mobile App bei Harbor Capital und seit dem Update letzte Woche könen unsere 7 Nutzer sich nicht mehr per Face ID einloggen. Die App fragt zwar nach Face ID, akzeptiert es aber nicht und zeigt dann 'Anmeldung fehlgeschlage, bitte Passwort verwenden'. Auf Android tritt das problem nicht auf. Könnt ihr das bitte pruefen, wir brauchen das für den Außendienst dringend.
answer: Danke für die Meldung, das behandeln wir mit hoher Priorität, da es alle iOS-Nutzer betrifft. Können Sie mir die iOS-Version und das Modell der betroffenen Geräte nennen? Vermutlich hängt es mit einem Berechtigungsproblem nach dem letzten App-Update zusammen - als Übergangslösung sollte die Passwort-Anmeldung weiterhin funktionieren, während wir den Face-ID-Fehler reproduzieren.

subject: Critical: financial data pipeline delayed 6+ hours, compliance deadline missed
body: Our nightly sync connector from our ERP into Northwind Data Pipelines for Pioneer Academy normally completes by 3am, but today's run is still showing 'in progress' as of 9am - over 6 hours late. This has caused our energy compliance report, due to regulators by 10am today, to contain stale data from two days ago. We need to know immediately if data was lost or is just delayed, since this affects our audit trail.
answer: This is being escalated to our incident team right now as a P0 given the compliance deadline impact. Initial checks show your connector queue is backed up but no data loss - records are queued, not dropped, and we're pushing to accelerate processing on your pipeline immediately. I'll update you within 30 minutes with a completion estimate and a written statement you can use for your regulatory filing if needed.

subject: Dashboards taking 20+ seconds to load for shared views
body:
Since Monday our main revenue dashboard has been loading very slowly for anyone accessing it via the shared link. Internally on my own account it loads in about 3 seconds, but the shared/exported version that our finance team uses takes 20-25 seconds consistently. We have around 40 people hitting this same dashboard every morning around 8am.

The dashboard has 6 charts pulling from our billing and API usage datasets. Nothing changed on our end configuration-wise this week. Can you check if this is a shared-link rendering issue or something on our workspace?
answer:
Thanks for the detailed report. Slow performance specific to shared/exported dashboard links usually points to caching not being applied the same way as for logged-in sessions, especially with concurrent access at peak hours like 8am. We're pulling the render logs for your workspace now to compare load times between direct and shared access.

In the meantime, could you confirm the exact dashboard ID or share link URL you're seeing this on? That will let us trace the specific render pipeline and rule out a dataset-size issue on the billing/API usage combination.

subject: Repeated card declines on our Starter plan invoice
body:
Our card on file was declined twice this week for the monthly Starter plan charge, on Oct 3 and again on Oct 5. I checked with our bank and there are no holds or blocks on the card, so I'm not sure why Northwind's system is rejecting it. We got an email saying payment failed with reference INV-88213.

Could someone look into why the charge keeps failing and whether we're at risk of losing access? We'd also like to know if a partial refund is possible for the days we may have been locked out.
answer:
Thanks for flagging this, and sorry for the inconvenience. I pulled up invoice INV-88213 and I can see two failed attempts with a generic "do_not_honor" response from the card network, which usually points to the issuing bank flagging it rather than an account restriction on our side. I'd recommend trying an alternate card or contacting your bank to confirm they're not blocking recurring merchant charges from Northwind.

I've paused any service interruption on your account while we sort this out, so you should not lose access in the meantime. Once the payment goes through I'll review the account for any downtime and follow up on the refund question.

subject: Need Slack alert routing changed for incident channel
body:
We're moving our on-call alerting from email to Slack and need to update the Slack integration so that critical API and pipeline alerts route to our #incident-response channel instead of the current #general-alerts channel. This is used by our whole support team of 123 seats, so getting this right matters.

We also want to confirm whether the existing Jira ticket auto-creation rule (currently tied to the old channel) will need to be recreated, or if it can just point to the new channel. Please let us know the steps or if this needs to be done on your end.
answer:
Thanks for the heads up on this change. You can update the Slack channel routing yourself from Integrations > Slack > Alert Routing, where you can pick the new destination channel per alert severity without breaking the Jira auto-creation rule, since that rule is tied to the alert type rather than the channel. I'd suggest testing with a low-severity alert first to confirm delivery before switching over the critical alerts.

Given this affects your whole incident workflow, let us know once you've made the change and we'll verify the Jira linkage on our side to make sure tickets are still generating correctly.

subject: Data pipeline showing delayed arrival for warehouse connector
body:
We've noticed our warehouse inventory connector has been arriving 2-4 hours later than usual over the past week, specifically on the nightly sync scheduled for 1am UTC. The data eventually shows up complete, just late, and it's throwing off our morning reports for the logistics team.

Is this a known issue with the connector's source polling interval, or could it be related to volume? We're syncing roughly 1.2 million rows nightly now, up from about 800k a month ago. Just trying to understand if we need to adjust our downstream schedule expectations.
answer:
Thanks for the detailed context, this is helpful. The delay you're seeing does correlate with the volume increase you mentioned; the connector's polling and batching logic can take longer to complete as row counts grow past the ~1M mark, which pushes back the completion timestamp even though the sync itself isn't failing.

We'd recommend adjusting your downstream job schedule to expect completion by 4-5am UTC rather than 1am for now, and we're also looking at whether a dedicated batch size setting could help tighten that window. I'll follow up once we have more detail on tuning options for higher-volume connectors.

subject: Storage quota reached, uploads failing
body:
Our workspace hit its storage quota this morning and now uploads are failing with "Error: storage limit exceeded" for any file over about 5MB. We have several teachers trying to upload course materials right now and it's blocking their work.

Could you tell us how much of our quota is backup/retention data versus actual uploaded files? We suspect old backups from last semester might be taking up space we could clear, but we don't see an easy way to check that breakdown from the admin panel.
answer:
Sorry for the disruption this is causing your teachers. I checked your workspace and you're currently at 98% of your storage quota, with roughly 60% of that made up of automated backups going back several months rather than active uploaded files. You can review and delete older backup snapshots from Storage > Backups > Retention Settings, which should free up space quickly.

If clearing old backups doesn't get you enough headroom, let us know and we can walk through options for adjusting the quota or retention period so uploads aren't blocked in the future.

subject: SSO role mapping broken - users landing with wrong permissions
body:
After our Okta group sync ran this morning, a large batch of users logged in and were mapped to the wrong roles. Several analysts who should have Viewer access are now showing as Admin, and at least one Admin got downgraded to Viewer. This is affecting people across multiple teams right now and we're worried about data exposure from the incorrect admin grants.

Our SSO config maps Okta groups to Northwind roles via the group-to-role rules set up last quarter. Nothing was changed on our end recently. Can someone look at this urgently, we need the correct permissions restored.
answer:
This is being treated as urgent given the permission exposure risk. We're pulling the SSO provisioning logs now to see what changed in the group-to-role mapping evaluation during this morning's sync, and as a precaution we'd recommend temporarily disabling auto-provisioning on new logins until we confirm the mapping is fixed.

Can you send us the Okta group names for the two users you mentioned (the downgraded admin and one of the incorrectly elevated analysts) so we can trace exactly where the mapping rule diverged? We'll keep you updated as we investigate and will prioritize restoring correct role assignments.

subject: Need to add feature to current plan - cards also failing
body:
We wanted to request an upgrade to add the advanced reporting feature to our plan, but while trying to update our billing details to process the change, our card was declined twice. This is odd since it's the same card we've used for months without issue.

We're a growing team and this is holding up a feature we need for a client deliverable this week. Could someone help expedite both the card issue and the feature add so we're not stuck waiting on the next billing cycle?
answer:
Thanks for reaching out, and apologies for the friction here. I can see the two declined attempts on your account; the response code suggests the bank flagged it as a possible fraud check rather than an account-level issue on our side, so it may be worth calling your bank to authorize a merchant charge from Northwind, or trying a backup card if you have one.

Given the time-sensitive deliverable, I'm going ahead and provisioning the advanced reporting feature on your account now so you're not blocked on the client work, and we'll finalize the billing update once the card issue clears. I'll follow up shortly to confirm the payment has gone through.

subject: Dashboard shared with team shows no data for other users
body:
I shared our quarterly expense dashboard with two other people on our finance team using the Sharing option, but when they open it they see an empty chart area with "No data available" instead of the actual figures I'm seeing. I've double-checked they were added with Viewer access.

We only have 5 seats on the account so this is a small team, but it's a bit concerning since we rely on this dashboard for our month-end review happening this week. Can you help figure out why the shared view isn't pulling data for them?
answer:
Thanks for the details, this sounds like a permissions mismatch on the underlying dataset rather than the dashboard share itself. Even with Viewer access to the dashboard, users also need at least read access to the data source it queries, and if that wasn't granted alongside the dashboard share, they'll see the empty state you described.

Could you check under Dashboard > Data Sources > Permissions to confirm both teammates have viewer access there as well? If they already do, let us know and we'll dig into the dashboard's query logs directly to see what's happening.

subject: How to set up role mapping for new SSO login flow
body:
We're setting up SSO for the first time and want to understand how role mapping works before we roll it out to our 14 users. Specifically, we want new users logging in via SSO to default to Viewer role unless they're in a specific admin group, and we'd like MFA to still apply even though authentication happens through the identity provider.

Is there documentation on how the group-to-role mapping rules work, and does enabling SSO affect our existing MFA requirement for admins?
answer:
Happy to help you get this set up correctly. You can configure default role mapping under Identity > SSO > Provisioning Rules, where you can set a fallback role (Viewer, in your case) for any user not matched to a specific group, and then create a rule mapping your admin group to the Admin role. I'll send over our SSO provisioning guide which covers group mapping syntax in detail.

On MFA: enabling SSO does not override your existing MFA policy for admin accounts by default, but depending on how your identity provider handles MFA, you may want to decide whether MFA is enforced at the IdP level or still separately within Northwind to avoid users being prompted twice.

subject: Dashboards extremely slow, blocking daily ops review
body:
Our operations dashboard has become nearly unusable over the past two days, taking upwards of 30 seconds to render each chart, sometimes timing out completely. We rely on this every morning for our shipment tracking review and today it failed to load twice before finally showing partial data.

The dashboard has about 8 charts sharing data with our team via the standard sharing link. We haven't added new charts recently. This is actively blocking our daily ops meeting so we need this looked at urgently.
answer:
I'm sorry this is disrupting your daily review, we're treating this as high priority. We're pulling render and query performance logs for your operations dashboard right now to identify whether this is a query timeout on one of the 8 charts or a broader rendering issue on shared links.

Can you tell us which chart tends to load last or fail first when you see the timeout? That will help us isolate the problem faster. We'll update you as soon as we have findings, and will treat this as urgent given it's blocking your team's daily meeting.

subject: Scheduled syncs skipping runs on Data Pipelines
body: Our nightly sync for the Salesforce connector (pipeline pln_8842) has skipped its 2:00 AM run three times this week - Oct 14, 16, and 17. The dashboard shows status 'Scheduled' but no run history is logged for those dates. This is causing our downstream reporting tables to be a full day behind, and our team relies on this for daily ops reviews. Can you check if something changed in the scheduler?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report - a missed scheduled sync with no run history is a priority issue for us and I'm escalating it to our pipelines engineering team now. Can you confirm the workspace timezone setting and whether any changes were made to the connector or schedule around Oct 13? We'll investigate the scheduler logs for pln_8842 and get back to you within a few hours with findings or a workaround.

subject: IP ALLOWLIST CHANGES NOT SAVING
body: WE TRIED TO UPDATE THE IP ALLOWLIST IN THE ADMIN CONSOLE TO ADD OUR NEW OFFICE RANGE 203.0.113.0/24 AND DEACTIVATE THE OLD RANGE FROM OUR FORMER DEPOT, BUT THE SETTINGS PAGE KEEPS REVERTING TO THE PREVIOUS LIST AFTER WE HIT SAVE. subject: OFFLINE MODE ISSUES ON MOBILE APP
body: OUR STORE STAFF USE THE MOBILE APP IN THE WAREHOUSE WHERE WIFI IS PATCHY.
