answer: Thanks for the detailed report - crashes on reconnect and dropped push notifications are definitely not expected behavior, so I'll log this as a bug for our mobile team alongside your feature request for proper offline caching. Could you tell us the app version and device models involved so we can try to reproduce the crash? We'll keep you posted on both the bug fix and whether offline sync improvements are on our near-term roadmap.

subject: Deactivated users still have active sessions - urgent
body: We deactivated 42 user accounts in the Admin Console this morning following a workforce reduction, but several of those users are still logged into active sessions and can access billing and API keys. Our security team flagged this at 9:15 AM CST. This is a serious exposure for us given the manufacturing floor system integrations tied to those accounts. We need this resolved immediately - can you force-terminate all sessions tied to deactivated accounts?
answer: This is being treated as a critical priority incident - I'm escalating immediately to our security on-call team to force-terminate all active sessions for the 42 deactivated accounts. While that's in progress, please send us the list of affected user IDs if you have it, as it will speed up verification. I'll update you within the hour with confirmation that sessions are terminated and a summary of what caused the delay in revocation.

subject: Question about SSO session timeout configuration
body: We're on SAML SSO with Okta for our 71 seats and want to shorten session timeout from the default 12 hours to 4 hours for compliance reasons. I don't see this setting in the Identity console under SSO settings - only MFA and provisioning options are there. Is this configurable per workspace, and is there documentation on how session timeout interacts with SCIM-provisioned permission groups?
answer: Session timeout for SAML SSO is actually configured at the workspace level under Identity > Security Policies rather than under SSO settings directly - it's easy to miss since it's grouped with password policies. I've linked our documentation covering that setting plus how it interacts with SCIM permission groups; let us know if you still don't see the option and we can check your workspace configuration directly.

subject: Retention policy deleting backups earlier than configured
body: We set our Storage retention policy to 90 days for the media-archive bucket, but files from August 2 and August 5 were purged after only 45 days - we confirmed this against our backup manifest. We're now missing footage that legal needs for an active case. This is affecting our entire 128-seat workspace and we need to know if this is a bug in the retention engine or a quota-driven early purge.
answer: I understand the urgency here given the legal need for that footage, and I'm escalating this to our storage engineering team right now as a high priority issue. Can you confirm the exact bucket name and whether you received any quota warning notifications around early August? We'll check whether this was a retention engine bug or a quota-triggered purge and report back with findings and, if possible, recovery options as soon as we have them.

subject: DUPLICATE EMAIL DIGESTS BEING SENT
body: OUR TEAM HAS STARTED RECEIVING THE DAILY DIGEST EMAIL TWICE, SOMETIMES THREE TIMES, SINCE MONDAY OCT 14. WE CHECKED NOTIFICATION SETTINGS AND ONLY ONE DIGEST SUBSCRIPTION IS CONFIGURED PER USER. THIS IS FLOODING OUR INBOXES AND SEVERAL STAFF ARE ASKING IF THEY SHOULD JUST UNSUBSCRIBE. CAN YOU ESCALATE THIS AND TELL US WHAT IS CAUSING THE DUPLICATES?
answer: Thanks for reporting this - duplicate digest delivery affecting your whole team is a priority issue and I'm escalating it to our notifications engineering team right now. Could you send us one example of a duplicated email including the timestamp and message ID from the headers if available? We'll investigate whether this is a delivery retry bug or a subscription duplication issue and update you as soon as we have a root cause.

subject: Connector auth failures on legal document pipeline
body: Our SharePoint connector (pipeline pln_5521) has started failing auth every few hours since yesterday, with the error 'token refresh failed: invalid_grant' in the run logs. Manual reconnection works temporarily but fails again after roughly 3-4 hours, causing sync latency of up to 6 hours for our legal document indexing. We have 217 seats relying on this pipeline for document search - can you check if something changed with the OAuth token lifecycle for this connector?
answer: Thanks for the detailed logs - an 'invalid_grant' error recurring every few hours points to a refresh token rotation issue, and I'm flagging this to our connectors team as a bug. Could you confirm the exact reconnection time and whether the SharePoint app registration has any recent conditional access or token lifetime policy changes on your end? We'll dig into the OAuth flow for pln_5521 and follow up with next steps to stabilize the connection.

subject: Transform step failures on Data Pipelines - request for better error detail
body: Our pipeline pln_3390 has been failing at the transform stage for the last four runs, with the error message just showing 'transform failed' and no row-level detail. We suspect a null value in the revenue column but can't confirm without more visibility. Could you help identify the exact failure cause, and also consider adding row-level error reporting to the transform step for future debugging?
answer: Thanks for flagging this - I'll look into the failure logs for pln_3390 on our end to identify the specific row or column causing the transform to fail, and I'll follow up with details once I have them. I've also passed along your request for row-level error detail in transform failures to our product team as a feature suggestion, since better visibility here would help a lot of customers.

subject: Plan-Upgrade schlägt fehl - Zahlung wird abgelehnt
body: Wir wollten heute von unserem aktuellen Pro-Plan auf den nächsthöheren Tarif upgraden, um zusätzliche Funktionen für unsere 195 Nutzer freizuschalten. Beim Bestätigen der Zahlung erhalten wir die Fehlermeldung 'payment_declined: issuer_error', obwohl die gleiche Kreditkarte für unsere letzte Rechnung problemlos funktioniert hat. Das Upgrade ist für unser Team dringend, da wir neue Funktionen für ein Projekt diese Woche benötigen.
answer: Vielen Dank für die Meldung - ein fehlgeschlagenes Upgrade mit 'issuer_error' behandeln wir als vorrangiges Problem und ich leite dies sofort an unser Billing-Team weiter. Können Sie uns bestätigen, ob die Kartendaten unverändert sind und ob eventuell ein neues Zahlungslimit oder eine Sperrung durch Ihre Bank vorliegen könnte? Wir prüfen parallel die Zahlungsprotokolle auf unserer Seite und melden uns umgehend mit einer Lösung.

subject: Storage quota reached on production bucket - uploads failing
body: We hit our storage quota this morning around 9:15 AM UTC and all uploads to our media bucket (wt-prod-media) are now failing with 'Error: QUOTA_EXCEEDED - 429'. This is blocking our booking confirmation PDFs from generating for customers checking in today. We're at 30 seats on the Pro plan and didn't get any warning email before hitting the limit. Can you either bump our quota temporarily or point me to how retention policies work so we can clear old backup files? We have about 40GB of backups from Q1 that could probably be purged if that helps free up space faster than a plan upgrade.
answer: Thanks for flagging this immediately - I've escalated this as a P1 since it's actively blocking uploads. I've applied a temporary 50GB quota increase to wt-prod-media effective now, which should resolve the QUOTA_EXCEEDED errors right away; please retry your upload pipeline and let me know if the 429s persist. For the longer term, I'm attaching our retention policy documentation which covers automated backup pruning rules - this can help avoid hitting quota again. I'll also flag internally that quota warning emails should have fired before this incident; we'll follow up separately on that gap.

subject: Webhook deliveries stopped after SDK update - academy enrollment sync broken
body: Since updating to API SDK v4.2.0 last Thursday, our webhook endpoint for enrollment.created events has stopped receiving any payloads. Our logs show zero incoming webhook hits since then, but the Northwind dashboard still shows the webhook as 'active' with a green status. We rely on this for syncing tuition payments across 224 staff accounts. I noticed the changelog mentions some webhook signing changes were deprecated in this version - is that related? We need this fixed quickly since finance reconciliation is due end of week and we're manually cross-checking enrollments right now.
answer: Apologies for the disruption - this does look related to the webhook signature verification changes rolled out in v4.2.0, where the older HMAC header format was deprecated in favor of the new signing scheme. I'm checking your endpoint configuration now to confirm whether the signature mismatch is silently dropping deliveries on our end. In the meantime, I'm re-sending the last 5 days of missed enrollment.created events to your endpoint so you can catch up on reconciliation. I'll follow up within the hour with the updated SDK migration guide and confirm once deliveries are flowing normally again.

subject: Jira integration not linking tickets to correct project
body: We set up the Jira integration two weeks ago to link support tickets to our LEGAL project board, but new tickets are being created under the default SUPPORT project instead. I checked the integration settings page and the project mapping still shows LEGAL selected, so this looks like a sync issue rather than a config mistake on our end. We have 140 seats using this and legal team members are missing ticket updates because they only watch the LEGAL board. Could you check if there's a known issue with the Jira connector, or point me to documentation on how project mapping is supposed to refresh?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. This matches a known caching issue where the Jira connector doesn't always pick up project mapping changes until the integration token is refreshed. I'm triggering a manual resync on your integration now, which should route new tickets to LEGAL going forward. I'd recommend checking the next 3-4 tickets created to confirm they land correctly, and I'll send over our Jira integration documentation which covers how to force a mapping refresh yourself if this happens again.

subject: Request to change frequency of email digest notifications
body: Our workspace is currently getting daily email digests for notifications, but with only 14 seats on the Starter plan, we'd like to switch this to a weekly summary instead since daily is too noisy for our small legal team. I looked through the notification settings but only see an on/off toggle, not a frequency option. Also worth flagging - we've noticed some digest emails arriving twice on the same day (once around 8 AM and again around 8 PM with identical content). Is that expected behavior or a bug?
answer: Good catch on both counts. Weekly digest frequency is available but currently only configurable through a workspace-level setting our team can enable for you - I've turned this on for your workspace now, so you should see weekly digests starting next Monday instead of daily. Regarding the duplicate emails, that does sound like a bug rather than expected behavior - I'm passing this to our notifications team to investigate the duplicate send trigger. I'll update this ticket once we identify the cause.

subject: IP allowlist blocking all admin console access - urgent
body: We updated our IP allowlist in the Admin Console at 2:40 PM today to add our new office range, but instead of adding it, the entire allowlist got wiped and now nobody can log into the admin console at all - we're getting 'Access Denied: IP not permitted' for all 186 users including our security team who need to fix this. This is a compliance-critical system for us in fintech and we need access restored immediately. The audit log shows the change event but doesn't show what caused the wipe.
answer: This is being treated as a P1 - I'm working on this right now. I've temporarily disabled IP allowlist enforcement on your workspace so your team can regain admin console access immediately; you should be able to log in again within the next few minutes. Once you confirm access is restored, I'll walk through the audit log with you to identify what triggered the wipe before we re-enable the allowlist with your correct IP ranges. Please reply as soon as you're back in so we can proceed carefully.

subject: Jira links in tickets pointing to wrong issue keys
body: I'm the support engineer here at Harbor Health and I've noticed that when our team links a Northwind ticket to a Jira issue, the link sometimes attaches to a completely different issue key than the one we selected. For example, ticket #4521 was linked to JIRA-892 but it's now showing as linked to JIRA-778, which belongs to a different project entirely. This has happened three times in the last week across our 18 seats. It's not blocking work but it's causing confusion when engineers click through and land on the wrong ticket. Wondering if this is a known bug with the Jira connector's search/select step.
answer: Thanks for the specific examples - that's helpful for tracking this down. This does sound like a bug in the Jira connector's issue search results, possibly a caching or index mismatch when multiple issues have similar key patterns across projects. I've logged this with the ticket numbers you provided (#4521 and the JIRA-892/778 mismatch) for our integrations team to reproduce. In the meantime, I'd suggest double-checking the linked issue key immediately after saving until we confirm a fix. I'll update this ticket once we have a root cause or a fix timeline.

subject: Need Jira integration reconfigured across Okta and Salesforce workflows
body: We're rolling out a unified workflow where Jira issues need to auto-link with both our Okta-provisioned user records and Salesforce case data, but the current Jira integration only supports linking to tickets, not to the broader Okta/Salesforce context. With 246 seats actively using this across teams, we need this escalated since our Q3 process rollout depends on it. Could someone from your integrations team reach out to scope what's possible? We're open to a call this week. Our current setup has Jira and Salesforce both connected already, and Okta is our SSO provider, so the pieces are there - we just need them linked together.
answer: Thanks for the detailed context - this is a great use case and I want to make sure it gets proper scoping given the scale of your rollout. I'm escalating this to our integrations team lead, who will reach out this week to discuss whether cross-linking Jira, Salesforce, and Okta data is currently supported or would need a custom workflow via our API. In the meantime, I'll send over our current Jira and Salesforce integration documentation so your team can review what's technically possible today while we schedule that call.

subject: Unsubscribe link in notification emails not working for large user base
body: We've had multiple reports from managers across our 4872 seats that clicking 'unsubscribe' at the bottom of Northwind notification emails redirects to a generic error page instead of actually unsubscribing them. This is generating a growing number of complaints and some managers are threatening to mark our emails as spam, which could hurt deliverability for the whole org. Given our size, even a small percentage of users hitting this is a meaningful volume - we're estimating at least 150-200 affected clicks based on helpdesk tickets so far. Can someone confirm if the unsubscribe endpoint is broken and give us an ETA on a fix?
answer: Thank you for flagging this at scale - I understand the deliverability risk this poses for an organization your size. I've confirmed with our notifications team that there's a known issue with the unsubscribe token validation endpoint returning errors for certain email templates; a fix is already in progress and targeted for release within the next 2 business days. In the interim, I can manually process unsubscribe requests for any users who've reported issues if you send me a list of affected email addresses via a secure channel, so we can reduce spam complaints while the fix rolls out. I'll update this ticket as soon as the fix is deployed.

subject: Multiple customer cards failing at checkout - need refund guidance
body: Since Tuesday we've had 6 customer payments fail during checkout with error 'card_declined: do_not_honor' even though customers confirm their cards are valid and have sufficient funds. Three of these customers were double-charged - one charge failed and then a second attempt went through, but the failed charge still shows as pending on their statement. We're on Starter plan with 19 seats and need to know how to process refunds for the pending failed charges, plus whether this is a known issue with the payment processor. This is affecting our ability to close bookings this week.
answer: I'm sorry for the disruption this is causing to your bookings - I've escalated this as P1 given the double-charge impact. The 'do_not_honor' decline paired with pending duplicate charges suggests a processor-side retry issue on our end rather than the customers' cards; I'm pulling the transaction logs for the affected charges now. For the pending failed charges, I can process refunds directly once you send me the transaction IDs or customer order references - these typically clear from statements within 3-5 business days after refund. I'll also loop in our payments team to investigate the root cause of the decline pattern and update you within 24 hours.

subject: SAML login redirect loop for one user
body: One of our analysts is stuck in a redirect loop when trying to log in via SAML SSO - it bounces between our identity provider and the Northwind login page about 3-4 times before landing on an error page that just says 'Authentication failed, please try again.' This started yesterday and only affects this one user; the rest of our 190 seats can log in fine. I checked and the user's account shows correct permissions and group membership on our IdP side. Not urgent since it's just one person, but wanted to get it looked at since they can't access dashboards for their reports this week.
answer: Thanks for the clear details - since this is isolated to one user, I'll treat it as lower priority but will still dig in promptly. Redirect loops like this are often caused by a stale SAML assertion or clock skew issue on the user's session; could you have them clear cookies for the Northwind login domain and attempt a fresh login, ideally in an incognito window? If that doesn't resolve it, please send me the exact timestamp of their next login attempt so I can pull the SAML assertion logs on our side and check for a mismatch in the NameID or attribute mapping.

subject: New IP allowlist rule deactivated existing entries
body:
I added a new IP range to our allowlist in Admin Console this morning (10.44.0.0/16) and noticed that two previously active entries got automatically set to inactive. Now several of our field staff on those older ranges can't log in at all. I didn't toggle those off myself and there's no note in the settings history about why they changed.

Can you confirm whether adding a new rule is supposed to deactivate others, and help me get the two entries reactivated?
answer: Thanks for flagging this — that's not expected behavior, adding a new allowlist entry should never deactivate existing ones. I've reactivated the two ranges you mentioned on our end so your field staff should be able to log in again; please confirm once they've tried. I'm also escalating this to engineering to check whether a recent settings change is causing new rules to override old ones.

subject: API keys rejected after SDK update, all requests failing
body:
Since updating to the latest version of the Northwind SDK (v4.2.0) this morning, our production key ending in 8841 is being rejected on every call to /v2/bookings with a 401 'invalid_api_key' error. We rolled back to v4.1.3 and the same key works fine, so it looks like the update is treating valid keys as deprecated.

This is blocking our nightly reporting job for Willow Retail and we've got about 50 analysts waiting on refreshed dashboards. Can someone confirm if key format or auth handling changed in this release?
answer: Sorry for the disruption — we're aware of an issue in SDK v4.2.0 where the auth header format changed and it's causing valid keys to be flagged as deprecated. Please stay on v4.1.3 for now while we push a patch release; I'll follow up here as soon as it's live, likely within a few hours. In the meantime your existing key ending in 8841 is fine and does not need to be rotated.

subject: Recurring card declines on renewal invoice, need credit and fix
body:
Our monthly renewal for Willow Partners has failed three times this week with 'card_declined' errors even though the card on file has sufficient funds and hasn't expired. We were charged a late fee of $45 on invoice INV-88213 because of this, and I need that reversed since the failure appears to be on Northwind's side, not ours.

Could you also let me know if there's a way to add a backup payment method so this doesn't happen again? We have 146 seats on this account and can't risk a service interruption.
answer: I'm sorry for the trouble this has caused — I can see the three failed attempts on your account and they do show a gateway-side decline code rather than an issue with your card, so I've reversed the $45 late fee on invoice INV-88213 now. I've also manually processed this month's renewal so your service won't be interrupted, and I'm enabling a backup payment method option on your account which you'll see under Billing > Payment Methods within the next few minutes.

subject: URGENT: All scheduled syncs stopped, patient data pipeline down
body:
As of 6:10 AM today all scheduled syncs for Vertex Media stopped running across every connector, including our main HL7 patient records feed. The pipeline dashboard shows the last successful run at 5:45 AM and every job since is stuck in 'queued' with no error output. Given this touches healthcare data, we need to know immediately whether any records were lost or partially written during the failure window.

We have 1,371 seats depending on this data being current for compliance reporting due today. Please treat this as critical.
answer: This is being treated as our highest priority right now — I've escalated to the pipelines on-call team and we're actively investigating the queue backup starting at 5:45 AM. Initial checks show no partial writes to your destination tables, but we're running a full integrity check on the HL7 connector runs from that window and will confirm data completeness before we close this out. I'll update you within 30 minutes with root cause and an ETA for restored syncing.

subject: Storage quota warning but usage looks lower than shown
body:
I got a notification that our Apex Partners storage is at 92% of quota, but when I check the usage breakdown in the dashboard the sum of listed folders only adds up to about 78%. This is making our nightly backup job fail with 'quota_exceeded' even though we should have headroom.

Could someone check what's actually consuming the extra 14% and confirm our real usage? Not urgent, just want to sort it before backups start failing regularly.
answer: Thanks for the details — this can happen when deleted files are still counted until the retention cleanup job runs, which could explain the gap you're seeing. I'm having our storage team pull the full breakdown for your account to confirm what's counted, and I'll get back to you with an accurate figure and whether a manual cleanup can free up space sooner.

subject: SAML login redirect loop for one test user
body:
I'm setting up SSO for Granite Legal and when testing with a new user account, login redirects back to our IdP login page twice before finally landing on the dashboard. It works, just takes an extra few seconds and two redirects instead of one. Other existing users don't seem to have this issue.

Is this a known quirk with SAML response caching, or something in our IdP config? Not blocking anyone, just want to understand if it's worth fixing before we roll SSO out further.
answer: Good catch, and thanks for the detail. This double redirect is usually caused by the IdP sending an unsolicited SAML response before the SP-initiated flow completes, so the session gets validated twice. It's not harmful but I'd recommend checking your IdP's binding settings against our SSO setup guide — I'll send over the relevant section on SP-initiated flows so you can compare configs.

subject: Connector auth token expiring earlier than expected, sync delays
body:
Our Salesforce connector in Data Pipelines has started re-authenticating every 6 hours instead of the usual 24, and each re-auth causes a sync delay of about 15-20 minutes while it waits for the token refresh. This has happened four times in the past two days across our Harbor Analytics workspace.

Nothing changed on our Salesforce admin side that we're aware of. Can you check if the token TTL setting changed on the connector side recently?
answer: Thanks for reporting this with the timing details — that pattern does suggest the connector's token refresh interval got reset, possibly during a recent connector library update. I'm having our integrations team check the OAuth token lifecycle for your Salesforce connector specifically, and will let you know whether this needs a manual re-authorization or a fix on our end.

subject: IP allowlist changes not appearing in audit log
body:
I'm reviewing our Admin Console audit trail for Harbor Legal and noticed that two IP allowlist rule changes made last Tuesday by our IT lead don't show up anywhere in the audit log, even though the rules themselves are correctly applied. Other settings changes from the same day are logged fine.

We need complete audit trails for a compliance review next week, so this gap is a problem. Can you confirm whether allowlist changes are supposed to be logged and help us recover the missing entries if possible?
answer: You're right that IP allowlist changes should be captured in the audit log the same as other settings, so this is a gap on our end. I've asked our platform team to check server-side logs from last Tuesday to reconstruct the missing entries for your compliance review, and I'll also file this as a logging bug so it doesn't happen with future allowlist changes.

subject: digests broken
body: OUR TEAM IS GETTING DUPLICATE EMAIL DIGESTS, SOME PEOPLE GOT THE SAME DAILY DIGEST FOUR TIMES THIS MORNING BETWEEN 6AM AND 6:45AM. WE HAVE 252 SEATS AND SUPPORT TICKETS ARE PILING UP FROM CONFUSED USERS ASKING WHY THEY GOT FOUR IDENTICAL EMAILS FOR ORION CAPITAL. THIS NEEDS TO BE FIXED FAST, PEOPLE ARE THINKING SOMETHING IS WRONG WITH THEIR ACCOUNTS. PLEASE ADVISE HOW TO STOP THIS RIGHT NOW.
answer: I understand the urgency, thanks for reporting this right away. We've identified a bug in the digest scheduler causing duplicate sends during the 6:00-6:45 AM window and are deploying a fix now to stop further duplicates from going out. In the meantime there's no action needed from your users, no accounts were affected, and I'll confirm here once the fix is fully live and digests are back to sending once per day.

subject: SCIM provisioning returning 500 errors, users can't be created
body:
We're integrating SCIM provisioning for Apex Freight and every POST to /scim/v2/Users has started failing this morning. Login for existing users is also broken now. Here's the log from our latest attempt:

2024-05-14T09:12:03Z POST /scim/v2/Users 500 Internal Server Error
response_body: {"error":"provisioning_failed","detail":"null reference in schema mapping"}
2024-05-14T09:12:04Z POST /scim/v2/Users 500 Internal Server Error

This is a full outage for us, no one can log in via SSO and we can't provision new accounts. We have 20 seats total and need this fixed immediately.
answer: This is being escalated immediately as a full outage. The 401 invalid_grant on your token requests combined with the schema mapping null reference suggests your SCIM client credentials may have been rotated or invalidated on our side during a recent config change — we're checking that now along with the provisioning endpoint error. I'll update you within the next 15 minutes with either a fix or a workaround to restore SSO login while we resolve the provisioning issue.

subject: alert routing sending dupilcate notifs to wrong team
body:
Hey, we noticed our alert rules in Notifications are sendin the same alert to both the ops-team and finance-team channels even tho we only routed it to ops. This has happend like 6 times since Monday (Oct 14). Its not urgent but its cluttering channels and finance keeps askin why theyre getting energy grid alerts.

Can someone check the routing rule for alert group ALRT-4021? Would also be nice if we could get an escalation path added so criticla ones go to on-call after 15 min if unacked.
answer: Thanks for flagging this - duplicate delivery on ALRT-4021 sounds like a rule overlap where two routing conditions both match the same alert group. I'll take a look at your routing config and confirm whether this is a config issue on our end or a rule conflict, and get back to you with a fix. I've also logged your request for an escalation/on-call timeout feature and will add it to the feature tracker.

subject: Deprecation notice for webhook signing algorithm - need timeline
body:
We received a notice that the legacy HMAC-SHA1 webhook signing method is being deprecated, but the email didn't specify a hard cutoff date. We have several integrations built on our SDK (v3.2) that rely on the old signature verification, and I need to plan a migration window for our engineering team.

Can you confirm the exact sunset date for SHA1 signing and whether the SDK will handle backward compatibility automatically, or if we need to update our webhook consumers manually? We'd like to avoid any surprise breakage for our logistics partners.
answer: Good timing to reach out - the SHA1 signing method is scheduled to be fully retired on March 1st, and after that date webhooks signed with the legacy method will fail verification. The SDK (v3.3+) supports both signing methods during the transition, so upgrading your SDK dependency now will let you validate against SHA256 without breaking existing consumers. I'd recommend testing the new signature header in a staging webhook endpoint before the cutoff, and I'm happy to set up a call with our integrations team if you want a closer look at the migration path.

subject: Cannot upload files - storage quota error blocking backups
body:
Since yesterday afternoon our team has been unable to upload any files to Storage. Every attempt returns 'Error: quota exceeded (Code 507)' even though our dashboard shows we're only at 68% of our allocated 50GB. This is blocking our nightly backup job for manufacturing compliance records, and we have an audit next week that requires these backups to be current.

Could you check why the quota check is failing incorrectly? We also need clarification on our data retention policy for these compliance backups since the documentation doesn't specify how long deleted files are recoverable.
answer: I'm sorry for the disruption to your backup schedule, especially with an audit coming up. This does sound like a quota calculation issue rather than an actual limit being hit at 68% usage - I'm escalating this to our storage team right now to investigate the discrepancy and will prioritize getting your uploads unblocked today. Regarding retention, I'll include our current policy documentation on deleted-file recovery windows in my next reply so you have it in writing for your audit.

subject: Mobile app crashes immediately on launch for iOS users
body:
A few of our field team members on iOS 17.4 are reporting that the mobile app crashes right on launch, before the splash screen even finishes. It started after they updated to app version 4.8.1 last week. Android users on our team haven't reported this issue.

We also noticed that offline mode doesn't seem to sync push notification preferences once connection is restored - separate issue but worth mentioning. Can you look into the launch crash first since it's affecting several people trying to log time-sensitive legal filings?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. The iOS launch crash on 4.8.1 matches a known issue we're tracking related to a startup config fetch on iOS 17.x - our mobile team has a fix in testing now. In the meantime, having affected users force-quit and reinstall the app sometimes resolves it temporarily, but I'll follow up as soon as the patched version is available. I've noted the offline push-preference sync issue separately for our mobile team to investigate.

subject: transfrom job keeps failing halfway thru - latency spiking
body:
Our nightly transform pipeline (job id px-8834) has failed 4 out of the last 5 runs, always around the 60% mark. The error just says 'transform timeout - upstream latency exceeded threshhold'. We rely on this for our media analytics dashbaord refresh each morning and its been stale for 3 days now.

We also noticed data quality issues in the partial runs that did complete - some rows have null values in fields that should never be null. Can someone take a look? This is startin to affect reporting for our exec team.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report on job px-8834 - a repeated timeout at the same completion point usually points to an upstream source slowing down mid-run rather than a config issue on our side. I'm escalating this to our pipeline team to check the source latency and will also have them look at the null values in the partial runs, since that's likely related to rows being cut off mid-transform. I'll update you within the day with findings and a plan to get your dashboard refresh back on schedule.

subject: Restore from backup returning corrupted files
body:
We attempted to restore a set of files from our Storage backup dated October 9th after an accidental deletion, but three of the restored files came back with 0 bytes while the rest restored fine. The file IDs are doc-2291, doc-2294, and doc-2295. We need these for a legal filing due this Friday.

Could someone check the backup snapshot integrity for our account and confirm whether these specific files are recoverable from a different snapshot?
answer: Thank you for the file IDs - that's very helpful. Zero-byte restores on specific files usually indicate a snapshot-level issue rather than account-wide corruption, so I'm checking whether an earlier snapshot has intact copies of doc-2291, doc-2294, and doc-2295. I'll have an update for you within a few hours given the Friday deadline, and will restore from the most recent clean snapshot we can find.

subject: Intermittent upload failures during business hours
body:
Our team has been experiencing upload failures to Storage roughly 3-4 times per day, always between 9am and 11am local time when usage is highest. The error message shown is 'upload interrupted, please retry' with no further detail, and retries usually work on the second or third attempt.

Could you check if this correlates with any regional load or quota threshold? We're also interested in whether there's a way to queue large batch uploads automatically instead of manual retries, and want to confirm our backup schedule isn't affected during these windows.
answer: Thanks for the pattern details - the 9-11am window strongly suggests a regional capacity issue during peak hours, and I'm checking our infrastructure logs for that timeframe now. I'll confirm whether your backup jobs during that window completed successfully or need to be re-run. On the queuing feature for batch uploads, that's not currently available but I'll pass the request to our product team as it's come up before.

subject: Dashboards loading very slowly for all staff
body:
Over the past week, our shared dashboards have become noticeably slower to load - what used to take 2-3 seconds now takes 15-20 seconds, especially the ones with multiple chart widgets. This is affecting all 224 seats across our campus, and faculty have started complaining during class demos.

We haven't made any changes to our dashboard configurations recently. Is this a known performance issue on your end, or is there something on our side we should check regarding sharing permissions or widget count?
answer: Thanks for reporting this - a jump from a few seconds to 15-20 seconds across all dashboards points to something on our platform side rather than your configuration, especially with no recent changes on your end. I'm checking our performance monitoring for any recent degradation affecting rendering or query times, and will also look at whether widget-heavy dashboards are hitting a specific bottleneck. I'll update you as soon as I have findings, likely within the next few hours given the impact to your team.

subject: All charts broken across Dashboards - showing blank widgets
body:
As of this morning, every chart widget on our Dashboards is rendering completely blank across all our dashboards - line charts, bar charts, and pie charts all show empty containers with no error message. This started right after we tried exporting a dashboard to PDF yesterday around 4pm. Our entire team relies on these for daily fintech reporting and right now we have nothing usable.

Can someone urgently investigate? We need this resolved today as our leadership review is at 3pm.
answer: I understand the urgency given your 3pm review - I'm escalating this immediately as a P1 since it's affecting all chart widgets account-wide. The timing right after the PDF export attempt is a useful clue, and I'm having our engineering team check for any rendering state issue tied to that export job. I'll stay on this ticket and update you the moment we have a fix or workaround, well ahead of your 3pm deadline if at all possible.

subject: Okta app integration - SCIM sync errors
body:
We're setting up the Okta app integration for provisioning and I'm hitting SCIM sync errors when pushing users over. Here's the log from our Okta admin console:

2024-01-15T09:22:14Z ERROR SCIM push failed for user id=usr_3391
  Response: 400 Bad Request
  Body: {"detail":"attribute 'department' not recognized"}
2024-01-15T09:22:15Z ERROR retrying push, attempt 2/3
2024-01-15T09:22:17Z ERROR SCIM push failed, max retries exceeded

We followed the setup docs but they don't mention custom attribute mapping. We also have Salesforce and Jira integrations planned next - does the same limitation apply there? This is slowing down our onboarding significantly since we only have 8 seats to configure but need it done properly.

For now, you can either remove the department attribute from the Okta mapping or map it to one of our supported custom fields, and I'll send you the list of accepted SCIM attributes shortly. Salesforce and Jira integrations use a similar attribute-mapping model, so I'd recommend checking supported fields before setup to avoid the same issue there.

subject: APP WONT OPEN
body: APP CRASHES ON LAUNCH FOR ALL OUR FIELD TEAM. 80 USERS AFFECTED. FIX NOW.
answer: Thank you for the report, and I'm sorry for the disruption this is causing your field team. We're treating this as a P1 incident and escalating immediately. Could you confirm the app version and device OS (iOS/Android) shown on the crash screen, and whether this started after a recent update? We'll follow up within the hour with next steps.

subject: Storage quota exceeded, uploads failing for pipeline exports
body: Since this morning our nightly pipeline exports to Storage have been failing with 'Error: quota exceeded (413)'. We're on the Pro plan and have never hit this limit before. Our usage dashboard shows we're at 98% of allocated capacity as of Oct 14, but we need at least 200GB more headroom to finish this week's manufacturing batch uploads. Can you either raise our quota temporarily or point us to retention settings we can adjust to free up space?
answer: Thanks for flagging this - I can see the quota threshold was hit on your account around 6:40am UTC today, which is blocking new uploads. I'm applying a temporary 250GB quota increase now so your batch uploads can complete, and I'll follow up with documentation on retention policies so you can configure automatic cleanup of older backup snapshots going forward. This should be resolved within the next 15 minutes; let us know once you've confirmed uploads are going through.

subject: SAML SSO login failures after IdP certificate rotation
body: We rotated our IdP signing certificate on Oct 12 and now roughly a third of our 2,202 users can't log in via SAML SSO - they get 'Invalid signature' errors on the Northwind login page. We updated the metadata XML in the SSO configuration panel but the error persists. This is blocking access for staff across three regional offices and we need this resolved urgently, along with confirmation on whether MFA enforcement settings are affected.
answer: This is being treated as a high priority issue given the scale of impact. Our identity team is reviewing the metadata you uploaded now - initial checks show the new certificate fingerprint isn't yet propagated to all SSO nodes, which explains the intermittent signature failures. We're pushing a manual refresh and will confirm once all regions show the updated cert; MFA enforcement settings are separate and unaffected by this rotation. We'll update you within 30 minutes.

subject: Alert routing sending notifications to wrong team distribution list
body: Our alert routing rules for infrastructure notifications have started sending critical alerts to the general staff mailing list instead of the on-call engineering group since yesterday. We have 11 seats total and this is causing confusion and duplicate emails going to everyone. We didn't change any routing configuration recently - can you check if something changed on your end with rule evaluation?
answer: Thank you for reporting this - we've confirmed a routing rule evaluation bug affected accounts using nested distribution groups, which explains why alerts fell back to the default list instead of your on-call group. Our team is deploying a fix now and will re-sync your routing rules once it's live, likely within the next couple of hours. In the meantime, I'd recommend pausing non-critical alert rules to reduce noise for your staff.

subject: Offline mode requests - need cached case files when connectivity drops
body: Several of our attorneys travel to locations with poor connectivity and the Mobile App currently requires an active connection to view case files they've already opened. Could you let us know if offline caching is planned, or if there's a setting we're missing that allows read access to recently viewed documents without network access? Documentation doesn't mention this capability currently.
answer: Good question - offline mode for previously viewed documents isn't available yet on the Mobile App, but it's on our product roadmap and I've added your account to the interest list for early access when it rolls out. In the meantime, some customers work around this by enabling 'download for reference' on individual case files before travel, which caches a read-only copy locally. I'll send updated documentation covering that workaround shortly.

subject: Exporting dashboard to PDF loses chart formatting
body: When I export our quarterly billing dashboard to PDF, the bar charts render as blank boxes and the legend text is cut off on the right margin. This happens consistently across three different dashboards I've tried. We're a small team of four and need clean PDF exports for client-facing reports - is there a setting to fix chart rendering during export?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. This looks related to a known rendering issue with certain chart themes during PDF export, particularly on dashboards using custom color palettes. Could you tell me which chart theme your dashboards use? In the meantime, switching to the default theme before export should resolve the blank chart boxes, and I'll send you documentation on export settings that avoid the legend cutoff.

subject: Webhook deprecation notice - need migration timeline
body: I received a notice that the legacy webhook event format (v1) is being deprecated. We only have a handful of webhook subscriptions set up for payment confirmation events on our Starter plan. Could you confirm the exact sunset date and whether we need to update our endpoint code, or if this is handled automatically? Also curious if rate limits change with the new format.
answer: Thanks for checking in - the v1 webhook format is scheduled to be retired on the date noted in your deprecation email, and existing subscriptions will need to be recreated using the v2 payload schema, as this isn't automatic. Rate limits remain the same between versions (100 requests/minute per endpoint). I'll send over the migration guide with sample payloads so your team can update the endpoint handler ahead of the sunset date.

subject: Okta integration showing app as unresponsive
body: Our Okta admin console shows the Northwind app tile as 'unresponsive' since this morning, though users report they can still log in fine via direct link. We use this integration alongside our Jira and Slack connectors for provisioning. Just want to confirm if this is a known issue on your side or something we need to reconfigure in the Okta app settings.
answer: Thanks for flagging this - this appears to be a health-check reporting issue on our integration status endpoint rather than an actual outage, since your users are authenticating successfully. We're pushing a fix to correct the status reporting; no action is needed on your Okta app configuration. I'll confirm once the tile shows healthy again, likely within the next few hours.

subject: Users receiving duplicate email alerts for same events
body: Since yesterday afternoon, our staff have been receiving 2-3 duplicate email notifications for the same alert events - same timestamp, same content, sent within seconds of each other. This is affecting notifications across our 175 seats and generating a lot of complaints. Nothing changed in our alert configuration recently. Can you check if there's an issue with the notification delivery service?

We're rolling back the faulty retry logic now and expect duplicates to stop within the hour. We'll also review whether any alerts sent in the last 24 hours need manual deduplication on our end and follow up with confirmation.

subject: Charts rendering broken after API data update
body: After pushing updated data through the API this morning, several dashboard charts are now showing 'Error: unable to render series' instead of the expected line and bar charts. This is happening across at least 5 dashboards that pull from the same data source. We're integrating this into our own customer-facing portal, so broken charts are visible to our end users right now. Can someone look into whether the data format changed on your end?
answer: Sorry to hear this is visible to your end users - we're looking into it right away. Initial investigation shows a schema validation change was deployed to the charting service this morning that's rejecting a data field format some API integrations still send in the older structure. We're rolling back that validation change now and will confirm once your dashboards render correctly again; I'll also send updated API documentation reflecting the correct field format going forward.

subject: Restore from backup failing for storage bucket dfoods-prod-01
body:
I'm trying to restore our storage bucket dfoods-prod-01 from the backup taken on March 3rd (backup ID bkp-88213) after a bad deploy overwrote about 40GB of traveler itinerary files. The restore job starts but fails at roughly 60% with status "RESTORE_FAILED: checksum mismatch on segment 14". This is blocking our travel booking pipeline since none of the current files are valid anymore.

We've retried three times with the same result. Can someone check if the backup snapshot itself is corrupted or if this is an issue on your end?
answer: Thanks for flagging this, I understand the urgency given the production impact. I've escalated this to our storage engineering team to inspect backup bkp-88213 for segment 14 integrity, and we're also pulling logs from your last three restore attempts on dfoods-prod-01 to see if the checksum failure is reproducible on a specific chunk range. I'll update you within the next few hours with findings or a workaround, such as restoring from the prior snapshot if this one is confirmed damaged.

subject: SAML login - need faster response and role mapping guidance
body:
We're integrating Northwind Identity with our internal healthcare portal using SAML 2.0, IdP-initiated flow. Login works but takes 4-6 seconds consistently, which is slow compared to our previous provider. Separately, we need to map SAML attribute groups to Northwind roles automatically so clinicians land in the correct permission tier without manual assignment.

Can you confirm if there's a way to speed up the SAML assertion validation step, and point me to docs on attribute-to-role mapping for MFA-enabled accounts? We have around 1371 users to onboard.
answer: Good question, and this is a common ask for larger SSO rollouts. The 4-6 second delay is usually tied to attribute lookup on our side during assertion validation; I'll have our identity team review your tenant's SAML config to see if we can trim that down. For attribute-to-role mapping, we do support automatic group-to-role assignment via SAML group claims combined with MFA policy enforcement - I'll send over the setup guide and a sample mapping config so your team can test with a subset of users before rolling out to all 1371.

subject: Storage quota exceeded and old files not purging per retention policy
body:
Our workspace hit its storage quota this morning and uploads are now being rejected with "Error: quota exceeded, contact administrator." We have a 90-day retention policy configured to auto-delete files older than that, but I'm seeing files from over 6 months ago still sitting in the bucket, which seems to be why we're maxed out.

This is blocking new backups from running for our 54-seat team. Can you check why retention isn't purging old files and help us clear space so uploads resume today?
answer: This is impacting your ability to run backups so we're treating it as high priority. I'm checking the retention policy engine logs for your workspace now to see why files past the 90-day mark weren't purged - this can sometimes happen if a legal hold or a failed deletion job silently stalled the cleanup cycle. In the meantime, I can manually trigger a retention sweep on your account to free up quota; I'll confirm once that's complete and share what caused the backlog.

subject: How to export audit logs and set up IP allowlist
body:
I'm setting up our Admin Console for Willow Academy and need two things: a way to export audit logs (ideally CSV or via API) covering login and permission change events, and documentation on configuring an IP allowlist for admin access. IP allowlisting for admin access is currently in limited rollout; I've added your workspace to the feature request list and will follow up once it's available for Starter tier accounts, or sooner if we open a beta.

subject: Feature request: offline mode improvements for mobile app
body:
I use the Northwind mobile app to review dashboard data while traveling between hospital sites, and offline mode currently only caches the last viewed screen. When I try to open a different report without connectivity, the app crashes with a generic "Something went wrong" message instead of showing a cached version or a friendly offline notice.

Would it be possible to expand offline caching to multiple recent reports, and fix the crash so it at least fails gracefully? This would help a lot for our field staff across our 3256-seat deployment.
answer: Thanks for the detailed feedback, this is genuinely useful for our roadmap planning. I've logged a feature request for expanded multi-report offline caching and separately filed a bug for the crash-instead-of-graceful-fallback behavior when opening uncached reports offline - our mobile team will investigate that crash specifically since it affects usability even without the caching improvement. I'll keep this ticket open and update you once either item has a target release.

subject: Need to unsubscribe finance team from billing alert emails

Our finance team keeps getting duplicate billing notification emails - we're receiving the same invoice alert twice within minutes, once from what looks like the standard notification and again from what seems like a retry. subject: Zapier integration completely broken - no data flowing to Slack or Jira
body:

subject: Customers receiving duplicate order alert emails
body:
We integrated the Notifications API to send order confirmation emails, and since yesterday customers are getting each alert twice, roughly 30 seconds apart. We've had at least 15 customer complaints about this since yesterday afternoon.

subject: Data pipeline transform step failing repeatedly on connector sync
body:
Our data pipeline connected to the legal case management connector has been failing at the transform stage for the past two sync cycles. In the meantime, I can help you add a null-handling rule in the transform step so those records pass through with a default value instead of failing the whole sync, and I'll report back on the connector schema question shortly.

subject: Jira link in Integrations panel showing wrong project
body:
In our Integrations settings, the Jira link is pointing to a project called "DEMO" instead of our actual project "QROB". This seems to have happened after we reconnected Okta last week. It's not urgent since we're not actively using the Jira integration yet, but I wanted to flag it before we set up Slack and Salesforce connections too.

Could you let me know how to reset the Jira project mapping?

I'd recommend double-checking the mapping again after you set up Slack and Salesforce in case the same reset behavior occurs.

subject: Alert routing rules - duplicate notifications to legal team

This has been happening since we added a second routing rule last week for our review workflow. Could you clarify how overlapping routing rules are supposed to behave? We'd also appreciate a doc link on best practices for avoiding duplicate matches when rules overlap.
answer: Thanks for flagging this - when two routing rules both match the same alert, the current behavior is to deliver it once per matching rule, which explains the duplicates you're seeing. I'll send over our routing rules guide which covers how to scope rules with exclusion conditions to prevent overlap, and I'm logging this as feedback since several customers have asked for a dedupe option at the routing layer.

subject: Question about seat count on our invoice
body: Our last invoice shows 255 seats billed, but when I check our admin panel under user management I only count 238 active users. Can someone confirm how the seat count is calculated - is it based on invited users, active users, or something else? answer: Good question - seat counts are based on all users who have accepted an invitation, including those marked inactive but not yet removed, which is likely the gap you're seeing. I'd recommend checking the 'pending removal' filter in user management to reconcile the difference, and happy to walk through the invoice line items with you if that doesn't close the gap.

subject: SAML login MFA requirement for API-provisioned users
body: I'm integrating our SSO setup via the API and provisioning users programmatically ahead of their first SAML login. I noticed that MFA enrollment isn't triggered automatically for API-created accounts the way it is for accounts created through the admin UI. Is there a flag we can set during provisioning to require MFA on first login, or is this something planned for a future release?

I've filed this as a feature request on your behalf since it's a reasonable gap, and in the meantime the workaround is to set an org-wide MFA policy that applies regardless of how the account was created.

subject: Slack integration not posting alerts after Okta sync
body: Since we connected Okta as our identity provider on Tuesday, our Slack integration has stopped posting deployment alerts to the #ops channel. Please try disconnecting and reconnecting the Slack integration from the integrations panel, which should refresh the token; if alerts still don't come through after that, send me the integration ID and I'll check the delivery logs directly.

subject: Duplicate email digests being sent twice daily

We only have digest scheduling set to once per day in the notification settings. This is creating confusion since people think there's new data in the second one. In the meantime you can ignore the second send since the content is identical.

subject: URGENT: Unsubscribe link not working, users still getting emails

We have 66 seats and at least a dozen people have reported this so far, several are frustrated and asking IT why it's not working. Can you send me one or two of the affected email addresses' unsubscribe timestamps so we can trace exactly where the request is failing in the pipeline? We'll keep you updated as we investigate.

subject: URGENT - API keys returning 401 after rotation, blocking billing exports

This is blocking our automated billing export job that runs every morning and feeds our finance reporting - it's failed twice now. Can someone escalate this, our finance team needs this data today.

A 401 right after rotation usually means the new key hasn't fully propagated or the old key reference is cached in your SDK client - can you confirm you reinitialized the SDK client object after rotating, not just swapped the key string? While we check on our end for propagation delays, I'll also verify there's no deprecation affecting v2 export endpoints on your account.

subject: Mobile app crashing on launch for iOS users
body: Since updating to the latest app version, several of our team members on iOS are unable to open the app at all - it crashes within a second of tapping the icon, before the login screen even appears. This started yesterday afternoon and is affecting people trying to review case files on the go. We have 18 seats and roughly a third of the team has reported this so far. Can you confirm the iOS versions affected and whether this is happening on both wifi and cellular? We're checking crash reports from our side now and will prioritize this given how many of your users are impacted.

subject: PDF export cutting off charts on multi-page dashboards
body: I'm integrating dashboard exports via the API for a client-facing report, and when I export a dashboard with more than four charts to PDF, the charts on page two are getting cut off at the bottom instead of flowing to a new page. This happens consistently with our 'Quarterly Overview' dashboard which has six charts. Is there a parameter I should be setting for page breaks, or is this a known limitation?
answer: This is a known limitation with how the PDF export currently handles page breaks for dashboards with more than four charts - there isn't a parameter to control pagination yet, so charts can get clipped rather than flowing naturally. I'm logging this as a feature request since it affects export quality, and in the meantime a workaround is to split the dashboard into two exports grouped by chart count.

subject: Request: SAML login with role-based permission mapping
body: We're evaluating expanding our SAML setup so that user roles and permissions are automatically mapped from attributes coming from our identity provider, rather than assigning permissions manually after each login. Right now our finance team members log in fine via SAML but someone has to manually set their permission level every time a new person joins. In the meantime, the closest workaround is using our provisioning API to set default permission levels at account creation based on a group identifier passed from your IdP, which at least reduces the manual step for new joiners.

subject: Push notification settings for offline/traveling users
body: We have field staff who travel constantly and often go offline for hours at a time. When they reconnect, they get hit with a flood of push notifications all at once, including old login alerts that aren't relevant anymore. Could we get a setting to choose which notification categories each user receives, and maybe have stale pushes expire after a set time instead of queuing forever? subject: Nightly transform job failing 3 nights in a row

This feeds our billing reconciliation dashboard, and finance is now a full day behind matching invoices. Could someone check the pipeline logs for job ID pl-88213 and let us know what's going wrong?

subject: App crash

subject: Pagination cursor breaks after 500 records on /v2/events
body:
We're paginating through the webhook events endpoint and the cursor stops working once we pass 500 records. Here's what we're seeing:

GET /v2/events?cursor=eyJvZmZzZXQiOjUwMH0
Response: 400 Bad Request
{"error":"invalid_cursor","message":"Cursor eyJvZmZzZXQiOjUwMH0 could not be decoded"}

This happens consistently at the same offset regardless of page size. Is there a limit on cursor lifetime or encoding we should know about? We need reliable pagination for our nightly sync job.
answer: Thanks for the clear repro details. That decode error usually means the cursor was generated with a different page_size parameter than the one used in the follow-up request - can you confirm you're keeping page_size consistent across calls? If it is consistent, this looks like a genuine bug on our end and I'll get it in front of the API team with your example cursor.

subject: Push notifications not arriving reliably on mobile
body: Several of our team members are missing push notifications for expense approvals - sometimes they arrive hours late, sometimes not at all. subject: PDF-Export von Dashboards schlägt fehl
body: Seit heute Morgen können unsere Mitarbeiter Dashboards mit mehreren Diagrammen nicht mehr als PDF exportieren. Der Export läuft eine Weile und bricht dann mit einem Timeout ab, betrifft aber nur Dashboards mit mehr als drei Charts.
