answer: Vielen Dank für die Meldung, das behandeln wir mit hoher Priorität. Können Sie uns ein Beispiel-Dashboard nennen, bei dem der Export fehlschlägt, sowie die ungefähre Uhrzeit des letzten Versuchs? Wir prüfen parallel, ob es einen aktuellen Vorfall mit dem Export-Dienst für Dashboards mit vielen Charts gibt, und melden uns zeitnah mit einem Update.

subject: Deactivated users still showing as active in audit log
body: We deactivated four employees in the Admin Console yesterday after they left the company, but the audit log still shows their last login sessions as active and they're not appearing on the deactivated users list. Two of them were also still able to trigger API calls this morning using their old tokens. This is a compliance concern for us since we need accurate deactivation records for our security reviews.
answer: Thank you for raising this - active sessions or API access after deactivation is something we take seriously, so I'm escalating this to our security team right away. Could you share the user IDs or emails on file for the four accounts and the exact deactivation timestamps? In the meantime, we recommend revoking any API tokens for those accounts manually as an extra precaution while we investigate.

subject: Intermittent rate limit errors from SDK despite low usage
body: Our integration team is seeing intermittent 429 errors from the Northwind SDK even though our call volume is well under the documented rate limit for our plan. It happens maybe once every hour or two, not tied to any obvious traffic spike on our side. We're using SDK version 3.4.1. Not blocking us currently since we have retry logic, but wanted to flag it as it seems like a bug.
answer: Thanks for reporting this and for including the SDK version - that's helpful. Intermittent 429s well under your limit sometimes point to a burst-limit counting issue rather than the overall quota, so I'll check our rate limiter logs for your account around the timestamps you've seen this. I'll follow up once we've identified whether this is a bug in the counting logic.

subject: Biometrie login gehtt nicht
body: biometrische login funktioniert nicht mer, app crasht sofort beim start
answer: Danke für die kurze Meldung, das schauen wir uns sofort an. Können Sie uns kurz mitteilen, welches Gerät und welche App-Version Sie verwenden? Wir prüfen parallel die Absturzprotokolle für biometrische Anmeldungen und melden uns zeitnah mit weiteren Schritten.

subject: Request to route Slack alerts to multiple channels
body: Right now our Slack integration only sends alerts to a single channel, but we'd like critical alerts routed to our on-call channel and lower-priority ones to a general ops channel. We're also evaluating adding Jira and Okta integrations down the line, so it would help to know if channel routing rules could eventually apply across those too. Can you tell us if multi-channel routing is on the roadmap or if there's a workaround today?
answer: Good question, and this is a common request. Multi-channel routing for Slack alerts isn't available yet, but you can currently set up two separate Slack integrations with different alert filters as a workaround until native routing ships. I'll add your feedback to the feature request for cross-integration routing rules and keep you posted as it progresses.

subject: SAML SSO login failing for entire organization since this morning
body:
Since around 8:15 AM EST today, employees across our organization have been unable to log in through our SAML SSO connection. Users are redirected back to the Northwind login page with a generic "Authentication failed" message instead of reaching their dashboards. This is affecting all 452 seats and is blocking our logistics coordinators from accessing shipment data.

We did not change our IdP configuration recently, and our last successful metadata sync was three days ago. Can someone check whether there was a change on the Northwind SSO side, and confirm if MFA enforcement settings are involved? We need this resolved urgently as our teams cannot work.
answer: Thank you for flagging this right away, and I understand the urgency given how many users are affected. We're escalating this to our identity engineering team immediately and pulling the SAML authentication logs for Harbor Systems to check for certificate or metadata mismatches on our end, including any recent MFA policy changes that could be interfering with assertion validation. I'll follow up within the hour with findings or a workaround, such as a temporary bypass for admin accounts if needed.

subject: Multiple dashboard charts showing blank or broken after latest update
body:
Since yesterday afternoon, several of our operational dashboards are showing blank chart widgets instead of the usual bar and line graphs. This is happening across at least six dashboards used by our warehouse teams, affecting roughly 267 users. The browser console shows a repeated error referencing "chart-render-timeout" when the page tries to load.

We rely on these dashboards for daily shift planning, so this is a significant disruption. Can you confirm if this is related to a recent platform update, and let us know what steps we can take to restore chart rendering?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report, this matches an issue we've seen tied to a rendering regression introduced in yesterday's dashboard release. We're actively working on a fix and have already identified the root cause in the chart-rendering service; in the meantime, refreshing the affected dashboards with a hard reload may temporarily resolve rendering for some users. I'll update you as soon as the fix is deployed, which we expect within the next few hours given the scope of impact.

subject: SDK v4 throwing 500 errors on all webhook signature calls
body:
We upgraded to the Northwind SDK v4.2.0 last week and since then every call to verifyWebhookSignature() is throwing an unhandled 500 error instead of returning a boolean. This is blocking our webhook processing pipeline entirely, so no incoming events are being validated or accepted right now.

We tried rolling back to v4.1.3 and the function works fine, so this seems isolated to v4.2.0. Are you aware of a regression in this release, and is there a hotfix planned? We have about 22 engineers depending on this integration daily.
answer: Thank you for the clear reproduction steps, this helps a lot. We can confirm a regression was introduced in SDK v4.2.0 affecting the webhook signature verification method, and our SDK team is preparing a patch release, v4.2.1, expected within the next day. In the meantime, please stay on v4.1.3 as you've already done, since that version is unaffected and fully supported.

subject: Webhook deliveries failing intermittently with 504 timeouts
body:
Over the past 48 hours we've noticed a growing number of webhook delivery failures on our production endpoint, with the Northwind dashboard showing 504 Gateway Timeout responses for roughly 15% of events. This is affecting order-status notifications for our travel booking flow and causing customer-facing delays.

We haven't changed our endpoint infrastructure, and our own server logs show no incoming requests during the failure windows, suggesting the timeouts are happening before reaching us. Retry attempts eventually succeed but sometimes take over 20 minutes. Can you check delivery performance on your end for our webhook subscription ID wh_8842f1?
answer: Thanks for including the subscription ID, that's very helpful for tracing this. We're seeing elevated latency in our webhook dispatch queue for several customers over the same window you described, and our infrastructure team is actively investigating a backlog issue affecting delivery workers. We'll prioritize your subscription for review and follow up shortly with either a resolution timeline or confirmation that retries are now completing within normal limits.

subject: Backups deleted early due to retention policy misconfiguration
body:
We discovered this morning that backup files older than 7 days have been deleted, even though our retention policy is set to 30 days. This affected our manufacturing plant's inventory backups stored in our Northwind Storage account, and we've lost access to snapshots from November 1st through November 8th that we needed for a compliance audit.

Our storage usage dashboard still shows the retention policy set correctly at 30 days, so this looks like an enforcement bug rather than a configuration mistake on our part. Given we only have 4 admin seats, this is a critical issue for our small team and we need to understand if the data is recoverable.
answer: I'm sorry to hear about this, and I understand how serious a compliance-related data loss is for your team. We're escalating this immediately as a potential retention enforcement bug and checking whether the deleted backup objects are still recoverable from our internal deletion buffer, which typically holds data for a short window after removal. I'll update you within a few hours with recovery status and a root-cause explanation for why the 30-day policy wasn't honored.

subject: Data pipeline showing hours-late records from our CRM connector
body:
Starting yesterday, data flowing through our CRM connector into the media-analytics pipeline is arriving 4 to 6 hours later than expected. Our scheduled 9 AM aggregation job is now missing a significant chunk of records that show up hours afterward, which is throwing off our reporting numbers for the 115 users relying on these dashboards.

The connector status page shows "Healthy" with no errors logged, so there's no obvious failure, just a growing delay. Can someone check the ingestion lag for connector ID conn_5521-crm and let us know if there's a backlog building up on your side?
answer: Thank you for the specific connector ID, that lets us look directly at the ingestion queue for conn_5521-crm. We can see a processing delay building up starting yesterday evening, likely due to increased load on the shared ingestion cluster, and we're working to clear the backlog now. I'll keep you posted with an updated estimate for when data will catch up to real-time, and we'll also review whether this connector needs a dedicated processing slot to prevent recurrence.

subject: Uploads failing for all users with quota error despite available space
body:
Since this morning, every file upload attempt in our Storage workspace fails with "Error: quota exceeded" even though our usage dashboard shows we're only at 40% of our allocated storage. This is affecting all of our team's document uploads for an active client project, and we can't proceed with deliverables.

We've tried uploading small files under 1MB and large files alike, both fail with the same error. Our workspace ID is aph-ws-1190 if that helps you check quota calculation. Given our small team of 19 seats, this is blocking essentially everyone right now.
answer: Thank you for the workspace ID, that helps us investigate quickly. This looks like a quota calculation discrepancy rather than an actual capacity issue, and we're seeing the same mismatch on our end for workspace aph-ws-1190. We're treating this as a priority issue given it's blocking all uploads, and our storage team is working to correct the quota figure now; I'll confirm as soon as uploads are restored.

subject: Requesting audit log export and retention settings documentation
body:
I'm setting up our Admin Console for the first time and need to configure audit logging for compliance purposes. Could you point me to documentation on how to export audit logs on a recurring basis, and clarify how long logs are retained by default before they're purged?

Also, we'd like to add a small allowlist of IP ranges for admin console access and possibly deactivate two inactive accounts from a previous contractor engagement. Any guidance on where these settings live would be appreciated, since our team is only 8 seats and we're still learning the console layout.
answer: Happy to help you get set up. Audit log export and retention settings can be found under Admin Console > Compliance > Audit Logs, where you can configure scheduled exports to a storage destination and see that logs are retained for 90 days by default on the Starter plan. For IP allowlisting and account deactivation, those live under Admin Console > Access Control; I'll also send over our setup guide covering all three areas so you have a reference while configuring.

subject: Webhook event latency increasing over past week
body:
We've noticed webhook delivery latency creeping up over the past week for our healthcare integration platform. Events that used to arrive within 1-2 seconds are now frequently taking 15-30 seconds, based on timestamps we log on receipt versus the event creation time in the payload. This is impacting near-real-time patient record sync workflows for a subset of our 1,371 users.

We haven't changed our endpoint or subscription configuration. Could you check if there's been a change in webhook dispatch infrastructure or increased load that might explain this latency increase? Our subscription ID is wh_vtx_2290.
answer: Thank you for the detailed timing comparison and subscription ID, that's very useful. We're reviewing dispatch metrics for wh_vtx_2290 and can already see a moderate increase in queue depth over the past week correlating with the latency you're describing. We're investigating whether this is due to overall platform load or something specific to your subscription's event volume, and will follow up with findings and next steps within a day or two.

subject: Upload failures and quota alerts on Storage account this week
body:
Our team has been getting repeated upload failures in Northwind Storage over the last few days, with an error message stating "upload rejected: retention policy conflict." This started after we adjusted our retention settings last week from 90 days to 365 days for compliance reasons. Only some files fail, mostly larger ones over 50MB.

We're a small team of 13 seats and rely on these uploads for travel itinerary documents that need to be retained long-term. Can you check if the retention change caused a quota recalculation issue, and whether this poses any compliance risk given the files that failed to upload?
answer: Thank you for the context on the retention policy change, that helps narrow this down. It's likely that extending retention from 90 to 365 days triggered a quota recalculation that's now conflicting with pending uploads, especially for larger files. We're looking into this as a security and compliance matter given the retention implications, and will confirm shortly whether any files were only partially uploaded or affected, along with steps to safely re-upload the failed documents.

subject: Push notifications crash the mobile app when offline
body:
I'm on the finance team at Granite Academy and I use the Northwind mobile app to approve invoices while traveling between our plant sites. The last two times I've been in areas with no signal, a push notification comes through and the app crashes immediately after I tap it. It's happened on both my iPhone 13 and a work iPad, both on the latest app version.

Could you confirm if this is a known issue with offline push handling? I'd also like to know if there's documentation on how offline notification queuing is supposed to work, since I can't find anything in the help center.
answer:
Thanks for the detailed report - crashing on tapping a push notification while offline is not expected behavior, and I want to get this fixed for you. Can you send me the exact app version and OS version for both devices, along with the approximate time of the last crash? That will help us pull the crash logs from our end.

In the meantime, I've linked our offline sync documentation below, though I agree it doesn't cover notification-triggered crashes specifically - I'll flag that gap to our docs team as well.

subject: Request: Slack alert integration for our API events
body:
I'm building out our internal tooling at North Media and want to send Slack alerts whenever certain API events happen, like failed webhook deliveries or rate limit warnings. I see Northwind has a Salesforce integration listed but nothing for Slack in the integrations catalog.

Is a native Slack integration on the roadmap, or is there a recommended way to route these events through an existing webhook to Slack ourselves? We're a small dev team so anything that saves us building a custom relay would help a lot.
answer:
Good question - we don't have a native Slack integration shipped yet, but it's an active item on our integrations roadmap given how often it comes up. In the meantime, the fastest path is to point your existing webhook subscriptions at a Slack Incoming Webhook URL; the payload structure is compatible with minimal transformation for most event types.

I'll add your account to the interest list for native Slack support so you're notified when it's available, and I can share a sample webhook-to-Slack config if that's useful.

subject: Mobile app crashing on launch for large number of users after login
body:
We're seeing widespread crashes on the Northwind mobile app immediately after login across our organization. Reports started coming in around 8:40 AM today and our helpdesk has logged over 60 tickets from field staff in the last two hours alone. The app opens, shows the splash screen, then closes right after the login redirect completes - this is happening on both iOS and Android.

Given Harbor Partners has field teams relying on this app for daily operations, this is a significant business impact. Can someone escalate this immediately? We need to know if this is related to a recent push notification or login service change.
answer:
Thank you for flagging this immediately - a crash on launch affecting this many users is being treated as a high priority incident on our side. We're pulling crash logs now and checking whether a recent login service or push token change correlates with the 8:40 AM start time you reported.

I'll update you within the hour with findings or a mitigation step. If you have crash logs or device details from a handful of affected users, please send them over as it will speed up diagnosis significantly.

subject: Question about IP allowlist and account deactivation behavior
body:
I'm setting up the IP allowlist feature in the Admin Console for Cobalt Freight and want to understand what happens if our office IP changes unexpectedly. Does exceeding the allowlist just block API calls, or can it trigger account deactivation for affected users?

Also, I noticed the settings page takes several seconds to save changes to the allowlist - is that expected performance, or a sign something's misconfigured? Documentation on this would be helpful since I couldn't find details on the deactivation behavior specifically.
answer:
Good questions - an IP outside the allowlist will only block API and console access for that IP; it does not trigger any user deactivation, that's a separate manual process controlled from the Users tab. The save delay you're seeing on the allowlist settings page is a known minor performance issue we're aware of and working to improve, but it shouldn't affect whether the change takes effect.

I'll follow up with a link to our allowlist documentation, and I've noted your feedback that the deactivation behavior isn't clearly documented - I'll pass that along to our docs team.

subject: Slack alerts integration down - no notifications coming through
body:
Our Slack alerts integration for Northwind stopped working sometime overnight. As workspace admin for Orion Academy, I rely on this to notify our on-call channel about account and billing events, and we haven't received a single alert since around 2 AM. I checked the integration status page in Admin Console and it still shows as connected.

We also use Okta for SSO and have Jira and Salesforce integrations active - none of those seem affected, just Slack. Can someone check if there's an outage on your end? This is urgent since we depend on these alerts for incident response.
answer:
Thanks for the quick report - we're seeing some intermittent delivery issues with Slack webhook alerts starting around the time you mentioned, and our team is actively investigating. Since your Okta, Jira, and Salesforce integrations are unaffected, this looks isolated to the Slack alert delivery path rather than a broader integration outage.

I'm escalating this now and will update you as soon as we have a root cause or fix deployed. In the meantime, if you need alerts urgently, I can help you set up a temporary email-based alert forward as a stopgap.

subject: Pagination question for API Platform
body:
We've been using the Northwind API Platform for about a year now to pull order and inventory data into our internal reporting tools, and it's generally worked well for us. Recently we started noticing our nightly sync jobs taking longer than usual, so we dug into our SDK usage and noticed we're still using the older offset-based pagination parameters (offset and limit) rather than the cursor-based approach mentioned in some of the newer SDK release notes.

Is offset-based pagination being deprecated? We want to plan a migration to cursor pagination if needed, but would like confirmation on the timeline and whether our current rate limits would change under the new approach.
answer:
Thanks for reaching out - offset-based pagination isn't deprecated yet, but cursor-based pagination is now the recommended approach and offers better performance on large result sets, which may explain the slowdown you're seeing on nightly syncs. We don't have a hard sunset date for offset pagination yet, but we'd encourage migrating when convenient.

Rate limits are the same regardless of pagination method, so switching shouldn't affect your quota. I'll share our SDK migration guide with code examples for switching to cursor-based requests.

subject: How to prevent app crash on launch when offline
body:
I'm a data analyst at Summit Media and I use the Northwind mobile app mainly to check dashboard notifications while commuting, often without a stable connection. The app has crashed on launch a few times when I open it with no signal, right after the login screen tries to refresh.

Is there a setting to make the app work better offline, or a recommended way to avoid this? I don't need real-time data, just want it to open without crashing when I'm on the subway.
answer:
Thanks for the details - this sounds like the app is trying to refresh your session on launch and failing ungracefully when there's no connection. There isn't a dedicated offline mode toggle currently, but as a workaround, opening the app once while connected before you head into low-signal areas usually keeps your session cached and avoids the crash.

I'll log this as feedback for our mobile team to improve offline handling on launch, and I'll follow up if a fix ships in an upcoming release.

subject: Deactivated users still showing as active in Admin Console
body:
We have a serious issue at Lumen Legal - our compliance team deactivated 14 users last week following an internal audit, but as of this morning all 14 still show as 'Active' in the Admin Console user list and, more concerning, two of them successfully logged in yesterday. This is a legal firm handling sensitive client data, so this is a compliance risk we need resolved urgently.

Can someone confirm whether the deactivation is failing silently, or if there's a sync delay between the console and the actual auth service? We need this fixed and confirmed today.
answer:
I understand the urgency here and I'm escalating this to our security engineering team immediately given the compliance exposure. A deactivation showing as complete in the console but not blocking login points to a possible sync issue between the console and auth service rather than a UI display bug, and we're treating this as a priority incident.

As an immediate mitigation, I'd recommend resetting credentials or revoking sessions for those specific 14 users while we investigate root cause. I'll update you within the hour with findings and confirmation that deactivation is enforced correctly going forward.

subject: help
body:
We just switched our SSO role mapping config for Quill Foods and now developers who should get the 'admin' role are getting mapped to 'viewer' instead. This started right after we updated our SAML attribute mapping this morning around 9 AM. Every new login is affected, roughly 20 engineers can't access API keys or webhook settings anymore because of the wrong permission level.

We need to know if this is a bug in how Northwind parses the role attribute or something wrong on our IdP side. Our team is blocked from doing any API work right now.
answer:
Thanks for flagging this right away - a mass role mismatch affecting 20 engineers is a priority for us to resolve quickly. Can you send the exact SAML attribute name and value you're sending for role, along with a screenshot of your current role mapping configuration in the Identity and SSO settings? That will let us quickly check whether the mapping rule is misreading the attribute or whether the IdP is sending an unexpected value format.

As an immediate workaround, affected users can be manually assigned the admin role from the Admin Console while we investigate, so your team isn't fully blocked in the meantime.

subject: Exporting dashboard to PDF loses chart formatting
body:
I'm the workspace admin at Harbor Energy and I've been trying to export our monthly usage dashboard to PDF to share with our leadership team. When I use the export to PDF option, the charts render but all the color coding and legends disappear, so the exported file is basically unreadable compared to what's on screen.

Is there a setting I'm missing, or a better way to share dashboards that preserves formatting? We only have a small team here so a simple sharing link would work too if that's an option instead of PDF export.
answer:
Thanks for the report - losing color coding and legends on PDF export is a known limitation with certain chart types, especially stacked and multi-series charts, and our product team is working on improving this. In the meantime, a simpler option would be generating a shareable dashboard link instead of exporting to PDF, which preserves full formatting and updates automatically for your leadership team.

I'll send over steps to set up a view-only share link, and I'll add your account to the notification list for when the improved PDF export ships.

subject: Deactivated user still able to log in via API token
body: We deactivated a former employee's account in Admin Console yesterday (user was on our manufacturing floor systems team) but noticed this morning that an API token tied to that account is still authenticating successfully against our integration endpoints. This is a compliance issue for us since we're mid-audit. Can you confirm whether deactivation should revoke associated tokens automatically, and if not, how we add this to our offboarding checklist?
answer: Thanks for flagging this. Deactivating a user in Admin Console does disable interactive login, but any API tokens or service credentials issued under that account need to be revoked separately from the API Keys section. I've escalated this to confirm the token in question is now revoked, and I'll send you a documentation link outlining the full offboarding steps, including the allowlist and audit log entries you should verify going forward.

subject: SCIM sync not deprovisioning users after HR system removal
body: We have SCIM provisioning configured between our HR system and Northwind Identity, and it's working fine for new user creation, but when we remove a user on the HR side, the corresponding Northwind account stays active instead of being deprovisioned. We've confirmed the SCIM group mapping looks correct. Only 4 seats total so it's easy to test, but this is blocking us from trusting the automation for offboarding.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. Deprovisioning via SCIM depends on the delete/deactivate operation being sent by your IdP rather than just a removal from a group, so I'd like to check your SCIM logs on our side against the timestamps of the HR removals you tested. Could you send me one or two example usernames and the approximate time you removed them so I can trace the SCIM requests we received?

subject: Question about default retention period for archived storage
body: I'm working on a data governance review and need to confirm the default retention policy applied to our Storage buckets under our current plan. We have several buckets holding energy usage datasets that are over a year old, and I want to know if Northwind automatically purges data after a certain period or if retention is fully manual. Could you point me to documentation covering this, and let me know if quota usage counts toward archived data too?
answer: Good question, and glad to clarify before you finalize the review. On the Pro plan, Storage does not auto-purge data by default; retention is manual unless you've explicitly configured a lifecycle rule on a bucket. Archived data does count toward your quota unless it's been exported and deleted, and I'm attaching our retention and backup documentation which covers how to set up automated lifecycle policies if you'd like to offload older datasets.

subject: Connector authentication failing across all pipelines since this morning
body: Since around 7:40am today, every Data Pipelines connector we have configured (5 total, feeding media asset metadata into our warehouse) has started failing with authentication errors. The error shown is 'connector_auth_failed: token refresh rejected by provider'. Nothing changed on our end that we're aware of, and this has stopped all sync jobs, so our dashboards are now showing stale data from yesterday.
answer: This is impacting all your connectors so we're treating it as high priority and looking into it right now. We've seen isolated token refresh issues tied to a credential rotation on our connector service and are checking whether that's affecting your pipelines specifically. I'll update you within the hour with either a fix or a workaround to re-authenticate the connectors manually in the meantime.

subject: URGENT: Storage bucket data missing after retention policy change
body: We updated a retention policy on one of our Storage buckets last night to shorten it from 180 to 90 days, and this morning we discovered that files uploaded between February and April are gone entirely, not just marked for deletion. These are backups of our travel booking transaction records and we cannot find them anywhere, including in any recycle or trash view. We need these restored immediately, this is a serious data loss situation for us.
answer: I understand the severity here and we're treating this as a critical incident right now. We're pulling the retention policy change logs and checking our backup snapshots taken prior to your policy update last night to attempt recovery of the affected files. I'll have someone from our data recovery team contact you within the next 30 minutes with status, and please do not make further retention changes on this bucket until we've completed the investigation.

subject: API v1 Deprecation betrifft unsere Rate-Limit-Konfiguration
body: Wir haben gerade die Ankündigung zur Deprecation von API v1 gelesen und sind uns nicht sicher, ob unsere aktuelle Rate-Limit-Konfiguration mit v2 kompatibel ist. Unser SDK ist noch auf die alte Version gepinnt und wir befürchten, dass nach der Umstellung Anfragen blockiert werden. Können Sie uns sagen, welche konkreten Endpunkte betroffen sind und bis wann wir umstellen müssen?
answer: Danke für Ihre Anfrage. Die Deprecation betrifft alle v1-Endpunkte inklusive der Rate-Limit-Header, die in v2 anders strukturiert sind, daher muss das SDK vor dem Stichtag aktualisiert werden. Ich sende Ihnen die Migrationsdokumentation sowie eine Liste der betroffenen Endpunkte, damit Ihr Team die Umstellung rechtzeitig planen kann.

subject: Zapier integration broken, blocking Salesforce lead sync for all reps
body: Our Zapier integration with Northwind that syncs new leads into Salesforce stopped working two days ago. Every zap run fails with 'authentication error: invalid_grant' when it tries to hit the Northwind Integrations endpoint. This is blocking our sales team from getting new leads into Salesforce, and we're a healthcare logistics company so timing on these leads matters a lot. We haven't changed any credentials on our end.
answer: I'm sorry for the disruption this is causing your sales team, and I'm escalating this immediately given the impact. The invalid_grant error usually points to an expired or revoked OAuth token on the Zapier connection, so I'm checking our integration logs now to see if there was a token revocation event on our side in the last two days. I'll follow up shortly with either a reconnection step or confirmation of a backend fix.

subject: Need to restore files from backup after accidental bulk delete
body: One of our team members accidentally ran a bulk delete script against a Storage folder containing travel itinerary documents for client bookings, and we lost around 340 files this afternoon. I saw that Northwind Storage has backup and retention features, but I'm not sure how to initiate a restore myself from the console. Is there a self-service option, or do we need to file this as a formal restore request?
answer: Sorry to hear about the accidental deletion. Restore requests currently need to go through our support team rather than self-service, so I've logged this as a restore case for the affected folder and will need the exact folder path and approximate deletion time to locate the correct backup snapshot. Once I have that, I'll initiate the restore and let you know the expected turnaround.

subject: How to route critical alerts to a different email than warnings
body: We're setting up Notifications for our manufacturing operations dashboard and currently all alerts, whether critical or just warnings, go to the same shared inbox. We'd like critical alerts to also go to our on-call operations email separately, while warnings stay in the general inbox. Is there a way to configure routing rules based on alert severity, or do we need separate notification channels for each severity level?
answer: Yes, this is possible. Under Notification Settings you can create separate routing rules keyed on alert severity, so you'd set up one rule for critical alerts pointing to your on-call address and leave the existing rule for warnings pointed at the shared inbox. I'll include a short how-to guide with screenshots so your team can set this up without needing to duplicate alert configurations.

subject: All users locked out - SAML login failing company-wide
body: Starting about 20 minutes ago, none of our 115 users can log in through SAML SSO. The error page shows 'SAML response validation failed: signature mismatch'. We did not make any changes to our identity provider configuration today. This is a complete production outage for us since every employee authenticates through SSO, including our media publishing team who need access right now for a live deployment.
answer: This is being treated as a critical, top-priority incident on our end right now. A signature mismatch typically points to a certificate rotation issue, and we're checking immediately whether your IdP's signing certificate was updated or if something changed on our metadata endpoint. I'll be your direct point of contact until this is resolved and will update you within 15 minutes with findings or a temporary workaround to restore access.

subject: SSO sessions timing out too quickly
body: Since last week our team keeps getting kicked back to the login screen after roughly 20 minutes of activity, even though we have MFA enabled and are actively using the dashboard. We're on the SAML integration with our IdP and haven't changed any settings on our end. Can you confirm the default session length for Starter and whether it's configurable per workspace? We have 14 seats and this is happening for most of them.
answer: Thanks for flagging this. On the Starter plan the default SSO session lifetime is fixed at 20 minutes for security reasons and isn't configurable per workspace, but I can escalate a request to have it extended for your account. In the meantime, could you confirm whether the timeout happens on both browser and mobile, and share one user's login timestamp so I can check the session logs on our side?

subject: Users receiving duplicate alert emails for same event
body: We're seeing duplicate notification emails going out for the same shipment status change, sometimes two or three copies within a minute of each other. This started around the 10th and is affecting multiple teams on our logistics dashboards. It's not blocking anyone but it's confusing our ops staff who think something changed twice. Can you check if there's a retry loop on the alerting side?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. Duplicate sends like this are usually caused by a retry firing before the original delivery confirmation is received, and we've seen a similar pattern in a recent alerting update. I'm opening an incident ticket to trace the delivery logs for your workspace around the 10th and will follow up with root cause and an ETA for a fix within one business day.

subject: URGENT: SDK throwing 500 errors, all API calls failing
body:
Every call through the Node SDK v4.2 has started returning 500 Internal Server Error since about 9am today, including basic auth token requests. Our production order pipeline is completely down as a result. Log excerpt:

Error: Request failed with status code 500
  at createError (axios/lib/core/createError.js:16)
  at settle (axios/lib/core/settle.js:17)
  at NorthwindClient.authenticate (sdk/dist/client.js:88)

We haven't changed our integration code recently. Please advise urgently, this is blocking all manufacturing orders.
answer: This has been escalated immediately as a P0. We're seeing reports of elevated 500s on the authentication endpoint used by the SDK and our platform team is actively investigating a likely deprecation issue in the token service. I'll update you within 30 minutes with status, and in the meantime please hold off on retry storms from your client to avoid further load on the affected endpoint.

subject: File uploads failing to Storage - quota or backup issue?
body: Several of our admins have been unable to upload files to Storage since yesterday afternoon, getting a generic 'upload failed' message with no error code. We're not sure if we've hit a quota limit or if this is related to the retention policy change we made last week. This is affecting document backups for our energy compliance team across roughly 180 users. Can someone check our account quota and confirm what's happening?
answer: Thank you for reporting this. I've pulled up your account and can see storage usage is at 94% of your Pro quota, which is likely triggering the upload failures rather than the retention policy change. I'd recommend clearing older backup snapshots or requesting a quota increase, and I'm also checking whether the retention update affected write permissions in the meantime - will confirm shortly.

subject: Requesting credit for duplicate charge on last invoice
body: Our last invoice shows two charges for the same billing cycle, one dated the 1st and another dated the 3rd for the same amount. I believe this is a billing system error rather than an actual double subscription. Could you review our account and issue a refund or credit for the duplicate charge? We'd also like to know if this could recur on future invoices given we're on 204 seats.
answer: Apologies for the trouble this has caused. I can confirm the duplicate charge on your account and have flagged it as a billing system bug rather than a legitimate second charge. I'm processing a credit for the duplicate amount now, which should appear within 3-5 business days, and I'll follow up once our billing team confirms the root cause so we can prevent it from recurring on future invoices.

subject: Shared dashboards showing wrong permissions to viewers
body: We're seeing a serious issue where dashboards shared with 'view only' links are letting external viewers edit widgets and change filters, which shouldn't be possible. This started after we updated our sharing settings last week and now affects at least three dashboards used by our travel analytics team. This is a real problem since clients outside our org have edit access to internal data.
answer: Thank you for reporting this right away - this is a significant permissions issue and I'm escalating it to our engineering team as P1. As an immediate mitigation, please revoke the affected share links and regenerate them, which should reset access to view-only while we investigate the root cause. I'll update you within a few hours with findings and a permanent fix.

subject: PDF export cutting off charts on wide dashboards
body: When our legal team exports dashboards to PDF, any chart wider than the default view gets cut off on the right side instead of scaling to fit the page. This happens consistently across our reporting dashboards and makes the exports unusable for client reports. We've tried both portrait and landscape export options with the same result. Is there a setting we're missing, or is this a known limitation?
answer: Thanks for the detailed description - this is a known rendering issue with wide charts in landscape PDF export and our product team is aware of it. As a workaround, resizing the chart widget to under 1200px width before exporting should prevent the cutoff. I'll also log your case against the existing feature request so you're notified when a permanent fix ships.

subject: SSO session timeout inconsistent across users
body: We're a support team troubleshooting our own users' complaints - some staff report being logged out after 15 minutes while others stay logged in for hours, all using the same SAML SSO configuration. We've checked our IdP session policy and it's set uniformly. Could this be a caching issue on Northwind's side, or is there per-user session handling we're not aware of? Documentation doesn't mention any variance here.
answer: Good catch - inconsistent session lengths like this usually point to a mix of cached tokens from before a recent SSO config change, rather than true per-user handling. Could you send us two or three affected user IDs along with their login timestamps? I'll check our session store directly and also flag the documentation gap to our docs team since this behavior should be clearer.

subject: Push notifications not arriving reliably on iOS
body: Our field ops team relies on push notifications from the mobile app for shipment alerts, but several users report notifications not arriving at all when the app is closed, especially on iOS. This has been going on for a couple weeks. We'd also like to request a feature to show a badge count on the app icon for unread alerts, since drivers often miss them entirely. Happy to share device details if helpful.
answer: Thanks for the report - missed background push notifications on iOS are often tied to notification permission settings or app refresh being disabled, so it would help to get a couple of affected device models and iOS versions. I've also logged the badge count request as a feature suggestion for our mobile team to review for an upcoming release.

subject: Salesforce sync not updating contact records
body: Our Salesforce integration stopped syncing updated contact fields as of last Tuesday - new leads come through fine but existing contact updates from Salesforce aren't reflecting in Northwind anymore. We rely on this for our energy account team to stay current on client status. Could someone check the sync logs on your end? We'd also be interested in similar integration support for Jira and Slack if that's on your roadmap.
answer: Thanks for flagging this - I'm checking the sync logs for your Salesforce connector now to see if field-level updates are being dropped or delayed. This looks like it may be related to a webhook subscription that needs re-authorization, so I'll confirm and walk you through re-linking if needed. I'll also note your interest in Jira and Slack integrations and pass it to our product team.

subject: Duplicate email alerts firing for same billing event
body: We're seeing duplicate notifications going out to our team for the same underlying event. This morning our accounts payable staff each got 4 identical emails for invoice INV-88213 between 09:02 and 09:04 UTC, and it's happened for at least 6 other events since yesterday. Our alert rules haven't changed in over a month. This is causing confusion and some staff are now ignoring alerts entirely, which is a real risk for us.
answer: Thanks for flagging this, and sorry for the noise it's causing your team. We've seen a related issue where the notification dispatcher can re-queue an event if the delivery acknowledgment is delayed, resulting in duplicate sends. We're pulling the delivery logs for INV-88213 and the other events you mentioned now to confirm the pattern and will push a fix or workaround on our side; we'll update you within a few hours given the operational impact.

subject: Charts not rendering on shared dashboards after export
body: Since yesterday afternoon, several of our clinical ops dashboards are showing blank chart panels for anyone who accesses them via a shared link, even though the same dashboards render fine when we're logged in directly. It affects at least 5 dashboards that our regional leads rely on daily, and it started right after we exported one of them to CSV. The panels just show a spinning loader that never resolves.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. This matches a bug we're tracking where a CSV export can leave a shared dashboard's chart cache in a bad state for external viewers. We're escalating this to our dashboards engineering team now given it affects your regional leads, and we'll ask you to confirm the exact dashboard IDs so we can restore the cache manually while a permanent fix is prepared.

subject: Storage quota nearing limit, backup job failing
body: Our storage usage is sitting at about 91% of quota and last night's scheduled backup job for our document retention bucket failed with a quota exceeded error. We're on the retention policy that keeps 7 years of case files, so we can't just delete older data ourselves. Could someone confirm whether the quota can be temporarily raised while we review our archive strategy, or point us to where usage is broken down by folder?
answer: Thanks for reaching out. We can see the backup failure on your account and confirm usage is at 91% of your current quota. We can apply a temporary quota increase while you review retention, and I've attached a usage breakdown by folder to help you identify what's driving growth. Let us know the amount you'd like us to raise it to and we'll get that applied today.

subject: Wrong seat count on latest invoice
body: Our latest invoice, INV-2024-0733, bills us for 42 seats on the Pro plan, but we've only had 30 active seats all month per our admin console. This is the second month in a row this has happened and it's throwing off our budget reconciliation. Could you check what's driving the discrepancy and issue a corrected invoice or refund for the overcharge?
answer: I'm sorry for the trouble this is causing your reconciliation process. I've pulled up INV-2024-0733 and confirmed your active seat count is 30, so this does look like a billing error on our side. I'm issuing a corrected invoice now and processing a refund for the overcharged difference for this billing cycle, and I'll also check last month's invoice to see if a refund is owed there as well.

subject: PDF export failing on large operational dashboards
body: Our operations team can no longer export the regional performance dashboards to PDF. Clicking export on any dashboard with more than 8 charts just hangs for a couple of minutes and then returns a generic 'Export failed' message. This started yesterday around 14:00 UTC and it's blocking our weekly reporting to plant managers across all sites, which normally goes out today.
answer: Thank you for the report, and I understand the timing pressure with your weekly reporting cycle. We've reproduced the export timeout on dashboards with a high chart count and are treating this as an urgent fix given the number of sites affected. In the meantime, I can generate the PDF exports manually on our end for the specific dashboards you need today — please send the dashboard names or IDs and we'll get them to you within the hour.

subject: Request for more granular dashboard sharing permissions
body: We'd like the ability to share dashboards with view-only access to certain external partners without giving them export or chart-editing rights. Right now sharing seems to be all-or-nothing at the dashboard level, which means we either lock partners out entirely or give them more access than we're comfortable with. Is there a way to configure this currently, or is it on the roadmap?
answer: This is a great use case and one we hear from other education customers as well. Currently sharing permissions are set at the dashboard level with edit/view toggles, but there isn't a way to separately restrict export or chart editing for view-only recipients. I'll log this as a feature request against our roadmap for granular sharing controls and follow up here once there's a timeline to share.

subject: Reviewing storage retention and quota settings for compliance
body: As part of our quarterly compliance review, we need to confirm our current storage retention policy and quota allocation align with our internal data governance requirements. We're currently allocated what looks like a shared quota across departments, and we'd like to change this to per-department quotas with a 5-year retention policy going forward. Could you advise on how to request this change and what documentation you can provide for our auditors?
answer: Thanks for reaching out ahead of your review. Per-department storage quotas are supported and I can help configure this along with a 5-year retention policy on your account — I'll need the department names and desired quota splits to set this up. I'll also send over our current documentation on storage retention and backup handling, which should cover most of what your auditors will need.

subject: Bitte um Hinzufügen von IP-Adressen zur Allowlist
body: Wir müssen für unsere neue Produktionsanlage eine zusätzliche IP-Adresse zur Allowlist im Admin Console hinzufügen, damit unsere Techniker sich von dort aus einloggen können. Im aktuellen Menü sehen wir nur die Option, bestehende Einträge zu deaktivieren, aber keine klare Möglichkeit neue hinzuzufügen. Können Sie uns kurz erklären, wo diese Einstellung zu finden ist, da wir das noch heute benötigen?
answer: Vielen Dank für Ihre Anfrage. Neue IP-Adressen können unter Admin Console > Sicherheit > Netzwerkzugriff über die Schaltfläche 'Neuen Eintrag hinzufügen' eingetragen werden, die aktuell nur bei bestehenden Admin-Rechten sichtbar ist. Da dies für Sie heute dringend ist, kann ich die IP-Adresse auch direkt für Sie hinzufügen, wenn Sie mir die genaue Adresse und den gewünschten Anzeigenamen des Eintrags mitteilen.

subject: Audit log missing entries for account deactivations
body: We're doing our monthly access review and noticed the audit log in Admin Console has no entries for three account deactivations we processed on the 12th, even though the accounts show as deactivated in the user list. This is a compliance issue for us since we rely on the audit log for our internal controls, and we need to know if this is a display bug or actual data loss.
answer: Thank you for catching this, and I understand the urgency given your compliance requirements. We're checking now whether this is a display issue with the audit log query or an ingestion gap for those specific events, and we'll confirm within the next few hours whether the underlying records exist. If it turns out to be a logging gap, we'll provide you with a reconstructed timeline from our internal systems for your review.

subject: URGENT: Users locked out during MFA enrollment, cannot log in company-wide
body: Starting about 20 minutes ago, none of our employees can complete MFA enrollment when logging in through SSO — the enrollment screen loads, but submitting the verification code returns 'Invalid session, please try again' and kicks them back to the login page. This is affecting our entire workforce and nobody can access any Northwind-connected systems right now. We need immediate help, this is a full outage for us.
answer: We understand this is a full company-wide outage and we're treating it as our highest priority right now. Our incident team is actively investigating the SSO session handling during MFA enrollment and we suspect a token expiry issue introduced in a recent deployment; we're working to roll this back immediately. We'll post updates here every 15 minutes until resolved and will notify you the moment login is restored.

subject: Request: allow biometric login retry when device is offline
body: We've rolled out the Northwind mobile app to our store associates and biometric login works fine on wifi, but when a device is offline (common in our back-of-store areas with poor signal), Face ID/Touch ID falls back straight to a full password prompt instead of retrying the cached biometric token. Can we get a change so biometric auth still works offline for a grace period, similar to how session tokens are cached? Right now it's causing extra help desk calls from store staff.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. Offline biometric auth currently requires a live token refresh, which is why it's falling back to password entry when connectivity drops. I'm logging this as a product change request with our mobile team to add a cached-token grace window for offline biometric retries, and I'll tag it against your account so we can notify you when it's scheduled. In the meantime, a workaround is to pre-authenticate devices while on wifi before shifts start.

subject: Deactivated users still showing active sessions in audit log
body: We deactivated three users in the Admin Console on March 4th (user IDs ending in 4471, 8820, and 9033) after they left the company, but our audit log still shows login events from those accounts as recent as March 6th. We need to confirm whether deactivation is actually revoking active sessions immediately or just blocking new logins going forward. This is part of our quarterly access review and we need to document the correct behavior.
answer: Good catch, and thanks for flagging the specific IDs. Deactivation in the Admin Console blocks new authentication immediately, but existing active sessions and issued tokens are only invalidated on their normal expiry unless 'force sign-out' is also triggered from the user's detail page. I'd recommend using that action going forward for offboarding, and I'll update our deactivation documentation since this isn't currently clear enough for compliance reviews like yours.

subject: How to true up seat count after reducing store staff
body: We're on the Pro plan with 265 seats but just went through a round of store closures and now only need about 210 active users. Can you walk me through how to reduce our seat count on the next billing cycle, and whether we'd get any prorated refund for the seats we drop mid-cycle? I want to make sure I do this the right way before our next invoice date.
answer: Happy to help with this. You can adjust seat count from Billing > Plan Details, and any reduction will take effect at your next renewal date rather than mid-cycle, so there's no prorated refund for the current period, but your next invoice will reflect the lower seat count automatically. If you'd like, I can also send you a quick guide on identifying inactive seats before you finalize the number.

subject: Unsubscribe link not removing users from weekly digest
body: A few of our faculty members clicked unsubscribe on the weekly analytics digest email but they're still getting it every Monday. I checked our notification settings and they show as unsubscribed in the list, yet the emails keep going out - we've had four duplicate complaints since February 19th. Is there a delay in how the unsubscribe status syncs with the send job, or is this a bug on your end?
answer: Thanks for reporting this with the specific dates. There is a known sync delay where unsubscribe status can take up to one send cycle to propagate to the digest job, but four duplicate sends after that window suggests something more is going on. Could you share the affected user emails or IDs so I can check their subscription records directly against the send logs?

subject: IP allowlist blocking legitimate warehouse office IPs after update
body: Since yesterday afternoon, staff at our main warehouse office (IP 203.0.113.44) are getting blocked from the Admin Console with 'Access denied: IP not allowlisted' even though that IP has been on our allowlist for months. We haven't changed our allowlist settings recently. This is stopping our security team from managing accounts and we need it fixed today since it's affecting our compliance checks.
answer: I'm sorry for the disruption, this looks like a bug rather than a config issue on your side since the IP was already allowlisted. I'm escalating this to our security engineering team right now to check for a recent regression in allowlist evaluation, and I'll update you within the hour with either a fix or a temporary workaround so your team can regain access.

subject: Requesting audit log export and longer retention on Starter plan
body: We're currently on Starter and only have 16 seats, but our security team wants to start pulling monthly audit log exports for review. Right now I can only view the last 30 days in the console with no export option. Is there a way to get a CSV export feature added, or do we need to upgrade plans to access longer retention and export capability?
answer: Thanks for reaching out. Audit log export and extended retention beyond 30 days are currently available on our Pro and Enterprise plans, so on Starter you're limited to the in-console 30-day view. I'll pass along your interest in export capability for smaller plans as product feedback, and if you'd like I can connect you with our billing team to discuss what a Pro upgrade would look like for your 16 seats.

subject: dashboards slow
body:
WE HAVE BEEN USING THE NORTHWIND DASHBOARD PRODUCT FOR OUR CLINICAL OPS TEAM FOR ABOUT EIGHT MONTHS NOW AND OVERALL IT HAS BEEN A GOOD FIT FOR SHARING METRICS ACROSS OUR SIXTY USERS. WE BUILT OUT A SET OF SHARED DASHBOARDS WITH MULTIPLE CHART WIDGETS FOR PATIENT INTAKE TRENDS THAT SEVERAL TEAMS RELY ON DAILY.

OVER THE PAST TWO WEEKS THE MAIN INTAKE DASHBOARD WITH ABOUT TWELVE CHARTS TAKES OVER 45 SECONDS TO LOAD, SOMETIMES TIMING OUT COMPLETELY. THIS STARTED AROUND FEBRUARY 20TH AND IS GETTING WORSE. CAN SOMEONE LOOK INTO WHY LOAD TIMES DEGRADED AND WHETHER WE SHOULD SPLIT THE DASHBOARD INTO SMALLER ONES?
answer: Thanks for the detailed background, and sorry for the frustration this is causing your team. Dashboards with 10+ chart widgets pulling from large date ranges can hit performance limits, and a load time over 45 seconds with timeouts suggests you're likely past the recommended threshold for a single dashboard. I'd recommend splitting the intake dashboard into two or three smaller ones grouped by chart type, and I'll also pull performance logs on our side for the last two weeks to see if there's a backend factor contributing to the slowdown.

subject: Charged for upgrade but still shows Pro plan features
body: I upgraded our workspace from Pro to the next tier yesterday and received an invoice charging us for the new plan rate across our 273 seats, but the console still shows Pro plan limits and none of the upgraded features are unlocked. Our finance team is asking why we were billed for an upgrade that hasn't actually taken effect. Invoice number is INV-88213 dated March 11th.
answer: Apologies for the confusion here, this looks like a case where the billing charge processed but the plan entitlement update didn't sync to your workspace. I'm escalating invoice INV-88213 to our billing systems team right now to manually trigger the entitlement refresh, and I'll confirm once your account shows the correct plan features unlocked, expecting this resolved within the next few hours given the impact on your team.

subject: URGENT: restore from backup failing, need data back today
body: We accidentally deleted a folder of transaction reconciliation files from Storage this morning and tried to restore from our last backup point (dated March 8th) but the restore job fails at 60% every time with 'restore_error: quota_exceeded' even though our usage dashboard shows we're under our storage quota. We're on Starter with only 6 seats and this data is needed for a compliance filing today. Please help urgently.
answer: This is being treated as urgent given the compliance deadline. The quota_exceeded error during restore usually relates to temporary staging space needed during the restore process rather than your standing quota, and I'm escalating this to our storage engineering team right now to run the restore manually from our end. I'll update you within the next 30 minutes with progress, and please avoid retrying the restore job yourself in the meantime to prevent further failures.

subject: Kreditkarte wird bei jeder Zahlung abgelehnt
body: Seit dem 5. März wird unsere Firmenkreditkarte bei jedem Abrechnungsversuch für unser Starter-Konto abgelehnt, obwohl die Karte bei anderen Anbietern problemlos funktioniert. Wir haben nur 3 Nutzer im Workspace, aber ohne funktionierende Zahlung droht uns eine Sperrung des Zugangs. Können Sie prüfen, ob es ein Problem auf Ihrer Seite gibt, oder uns eine alternative Zahlungsmethode vorschlagen?
answer: Vielen Dank für die Meldung. Ich sehe die fehlgeschlagenen Zahlungsversuche seit dem 5. März auf Ihrem Konto und werde das zunächst mit unserem Zahlungsanbieter prüfen, da es sich um ein Problem bei der Autorisierung handeln könnte. Als Übergangslösung können Sie in den Zahlungseinstellungen eine zweite Karte oder eine SEPA-Lastschrift hinterlegen, damit Ihr Zugang für die 3 Nutzer nicht unterbrochen wird, während wir die Ursache klären.

subject: Option to customize push notification categories
body:
We'd like to be able to turn off certain push notification categories in the Mobile App separately, like promotional pushes versus order status updates. Right now it seems to be all-or-nothing under Settings > Notifications. Our retail staff use the app on the floor and the extra pings are distracting during shift changes.

Could this be added as a granular toggle in a future release? Not urgent, just a nice-to-have for our team of 3.
answer: Thanks for the suggestion. Currently push notifications are managed as a single toggle in the Mobile App, but I understand the need for category-level control, especially for retail floor use. I've logged this as a feature request with our mobile product team and will update this ticket if it gets scheduled for a release.

subject: Scheduled sync to our manufacturing connector running increasingly late
body:
Our nightly sync to the inventory connector has been slipping later each day this week — it started at 2:10 AM on Monday and by Thursday it didn't kick off until 4:45 AM. We rely on this data being ready before our 6 AM shift planning, and the delay is now cutting it close.

We also noticed a few rows in the last sync had mismatched SKU counts compared to source, about 40 records out of 12,000. Can you check if the connector is under-provisioned or if there's a queue backlog on your end?
answer: Thanks for flagging this — a growing delay combined with data quality issues points to a resourcing or queue problem on the connector. I'm escalating to our pipelines team to check throughput and backlog for your account, and we'll also look into those 40 mismatched SKU records to see if they're related to the latency. I'll follow up within one business day with findings.

subject: Duplicate email alerts being sent for same event
body:
We've noticed that our billing threshold alerts are being sent twice, sometimes three times, for the same trigger event. Yesterday's alert for invoice #INV-88214 came through at 9:02 AM, 9:03 AM, and again at 9:17 AM, all identical content. This is happening across our finance team's inboxes, about 8 users affected.

Can you help us figure out if this is a configuration issue on our notification rules or something on your side? We'd also appreciate documentation on how the dedup logic is supposed to work so we can set expectations internally.
answer: Thank you for the detailed timestamps, that's very helpful. Duplicate sends like this are usually caused by overlapping notification rules or a retry mechanism firing before the first send is confirmed — we'll review your account's rule configuration and delivery logs around invoice #INV-88214 to pinpoint the cause. I'll also point you to our notification deduplication documentation once we confirm the root cause, so you can adjust rules if needed.

subject: Repeated card decline on billing account, need refund clarity
body:
Our company card was declined twice this month for the Starter plan renewal, on the 3rd and again on the 10th, with error 'card_declined - insufficient_funds' shown in the billing portal. We've since updated the card on file, but I noticed we were charged a late fee of $15 that I don't think should apply given the timing.

Could someone review the invoice and let me know if that late fee can be refunded? Also, is there documentation on how failed payments affect our 8 seat licenses in the interim?
answer: Thanks for letting us know, and glad the card on file is updated. I'll review the invoice from the 3rd and 10th and check whether the late fee should be waived given the payment history — I'll follow up with a resolution shortly. In the meantime, seat access isn't suspended during a grace period after a failed payment, so your 8 seats should remain unaffected while this is being resolved.

subject: Massenhafte Session-Timeouts bei SSO-Login – Produktionsausfall
body:
Seit heute Morgen gegen 08:15 Uhr werden Nutzer bei uns nach spätestens 2-3 Minuten aus ihrer SSO-Sitzung geworfen, obwohl das Token laut unserer IdP-Konfiguration 60 Minuten gültig sein sollte. Das betrifft praktisch alle 2107 Mitarbeiter, die sich über unseren Identity Provider einloggen. In den Logs sehen wir wiederholt 'invalid_token: expired' Fehler direkt nach erfolgreichem Login.

Das ist für uns ein Produktionsproblem, da niemand mehr zuverlässig arbeiten kann. Wir brauchen dringend Unterstützung, da wir gerade mitten im Tagesgeschäft stecken.
answer: Vielen Dank für die schnelle Meldung – das behandeln wir als P1-Vorfall. Wir prüfen sofort die Token-Ausstellung und -Validierung für Ihre SSO-Integration und schauen uns die 'invalid_token: expired' Fehler in unseren Logs seit 08:15 Uhr an, um festzustellen, ob es an einer fehlerhaften Token-Lebensdauer oder einem Sync-Problem mit Ihrem IdP liegt. Wir melden uns innerhalb der nächsten Stunde mit einem Zwischenstand.

subject: Storage quota hit unexpectedly, uploads blocked
body:
As of this morning our Storage usage hit what looks like a hard quota limit — new file uploads are failing with 'Error: storage_limit_exceeded' even though our dashboard showed only 78% usage yesterday. We're on the Starter plan with 21 seats and use Storage mainly for itinerary backups for our travel bookings.

This is blocking our team from uploading today's batch of client documents. Can you confirm our actual usage versus limit and help us get uploads working again while we sort out a longer-term retention plan?
answer: Thanks for the report — I can see this is currently blocking uploads for your team, so we're prioritizing it. I'm pulling your account's current storage usage now to confirm whether the 78% figure was stale or if there's a discrepancy in how usage is being calculated, and I'll get back to you shortly with either an increase or a fix so uploads can resume today.

subject: Requesting cursor-based pagination for large result sets
body:
We're integrating heavily with the API Platform and currently using offset-based pagination for endpoints returning large datasets (10,000+ records). As our healthcare data grows, we're seeing increased latency and occasional duplicate or skipped records when pages shift between requests.

Could you add cursor-based pagination support, similar to what's used in your webhook event listing? We'd also like to know if offset pagination is being deprecated so we can plan our migration timeline across our 205-seat deployment.
answer: Thanks for the detailed context — cursor-based pagination is indeed on our roadmap for the core API Platform endpoints, following the pattern already used in webhook event listings. I don't have a deprecation date for offset pagination yet, but I'll check with the API product team on timeline and share an update here so you can plan your migration accordingly.

subject: User deactivation not taking effect, deactivated accounts still active
body:
We deactivated three former employees from the Admin Console yesterday around 3 PM, but the audit log shows the deactivation event logged successfully while those users can still log in and access dashboards today. This is a serious concern given they no longer work here and shouldn't have any access.

We checked our allowlist settings and they look unchanged. Can someone urgently investigate why deactivation isn't propagating? We have 39 seats total and this affects our security posture significantly.
answer: This is a serious issue and we're treating it as high priority. I'm escalating immediately to our platform team to investigate why the deactivation events in your audit log aren't propagating to actual session and access revocation — as an immediate step, we recommend also revoking any active sessions for those three accounts manually if the option is available in your console while we trace the root cause. I'll update you within the hour.

subject: Offline mode support for Mobile App field use
body:
Our field teams often work in areas with poor connectivity, and right now the Mobile App seems to require an active connection for most actions, which causes crashes or blank screens when signal drops. We'd like to request an offline mode where users can queue actions locally and sync once connectivity returns.

This would be a big improvement for our 5-person team working across remote energy sites. Happy to share more detail on our typical usage patterns if that helps prioritize this.
answer: Thank you for this feedback and the context on your field team's connectivity challenges. Offline mode with local action queuing isn't currently available but is a request we've heard from other field-based customers as well, so I'm logging this with our mobile product team. I'll reach out if they'd like more detail on your usage patterns to help scope the feature.

subject: Feature request: configurable sync frequency for connectors
body:
We currently have scheduled syncs running on a fixed daily interval, but with 223 seats across multiple retail regions, we'd like the ability to configure sync frequency per connector — some data sources change hourly while others barely change weekly. Running everything on the same schedule wastes latency budget on the ones that don't need frequent updates.

Is there a roadmap item for per-connector scheduling, or a workaround using the current Data Pipelines configuration we might be missing?
answer: Thanks for the detailed use case — per-connector scheduling frequency is a common request and I want to make sure you have the best current option. Right now there isn't a built-in per-connector interval setting, but I'll check whether a workaround exists using separate pipeline configurations per data source, and I'll also pass this along as a feature request to our Data Pipelines product team for consideration on the roadmap.

subject: Audit log should capture allowlist and deactivation events

subject: Duplicate alerts and unclear routing rules for Notifications API
body: We're integrating the Notifications API and getting duplicate email alerts for the same event id, sometimes two or three copies within a minute. Our routing config sends critical alerts to a distribution list via /v1/notifications/route, but we can't find documentation on how routing rules resolve when multiple channels match the same event type. Event ids ntf-7723 and ntf-7724 both triggered triplicate emails this morning.
answer: Sorry for the noise this is causing on your end. Duplicate sends usually happen when more than one routing rule matches the same event without a dedupe key set, and we don't currently have this documented clearly, so I understand the confusion. I'm escalating the duplicate delivery bug to engineering and will also get our docs team to add a routing precedence section this week so you can configure a single matching rule going forward.

subject: SCIM provisioning question for permission groups
body: I'm reviewing our SSO setup and want to confirm how SCIM provisioning handles permission group assignment. When we provision a new user via SCIM, does Northwind map group membership automatically to existing role permissions, or do we need to set roles manually after provisioning? We also want to confirm whether MFA enforcement can be tied to specific provisioned groups rather than applied account-wide.
answer: Good question. SCIM provisioning maps group membership to roles automatically only if the group name matches an existing role name exactly, otherwise the user is provisioned without a role and needs manual assignment. For MFA, enforcement can be scoped to specific groups through the SSO policy settings, so you can require it only for the groups you specify rather than all users.

subject: Request to add biometric login to mobile app
body: Several of our field staff have asked whether the mobile app can support biometric login (Face ID / fingerprint) instead of re-entering credentials each time, especially when working offline between sync windows. Right now the app seems to require a full login after any period offline, which is disrupting workflows during site visits with limited connectivity. Is biometric authentication planned, and would it also help reduce repeated push notification prompts for re-auth?
answer: Thanks for the detailed use case. Biometric login for offline sessions is on our mobile roadmap but not yet available, so I'm logging this request with the product team along with the offline re-auth friction you described. I'll also flag the repeated push re-auth prompts separately since that's likely tied to the same session handling and worth fixing together.

subject: How to map SAML roles to app permission levels
body: We're setting up SSO for our retail integration and I need to confirm the correct way to map SAML assertion roles to Northwind permission levels. Our IdP sends a 'role' attribute with values like 'ops-manager' and 'store-lead', but I don't see documentation on the expected attribute name or mapping format for the Identity and SSO API. We also want MFA required only for ops-manager role logins.
answer: Thanks for the details. The role attribute name Northwind expects by default is 'northwind_role', so if your IdP is sending 'role' you'll need to either rename the attribute on the IdP side or configure a custom attribute mapping in the SSO settings under Role Mapping. For conditional MFA, you can set a policy scoped to the ops-manager role once the mapping is working, and I'm happy to review your SAML assertion if you want to paste a sample here.

subject: Duplicate email digests going out to same recipients
body: Our team started receiving two copies of the daily email digest each morning starting around March 3rd, both with identical content and timestamps a few seconds apart. We checked our Notifications settings and only have one digest schedule configured for our legal team distribution list. This is generating complaints from staff and we'd like it fixed or at least understood before it erodes trust in the alerts.
answer: Thanks for reporting this clearly, and sorry for the extra noise it's causing your team. Duplicate digests with near-identical timestamps usually point to a scheduling bug where the job trigger fires twice, and we've seen a similar report this week, so I'm linking your account to that investigation. I'll update you once we identify whether it's a scheduler issue or a delivery retry problem, and we'll suppress the duplicate as soon as we confirm the cause.

subject: question about pagiantion cursors and rate limits
body: hey we support alot of customers on north travel side and im trying to understand the new cursor based paginaton on the API platfrom. we curently use offset/limit on /v1/bookings and saw a note it might be depricated soon. does the SDK already support cursor pagination or do we need to handle it manualy? also want to know if rate limit headers change once we switch over.
answer: Thanks for checking in on this ahead of time. Cursor-based pagination is supported in SDK versions 4.2 and up, so if you're on an older version you'll want to upgrade before switching /v1/bookings over, since manual cursor handling is possible but not recommended. Rate limit headers stay the same format (X-RateLimit-Remaining and X-RateLimit-Reset), and offset/limit will keep working for now, but we'll give at least a 90-day deprecation notice before removing it.

subject: Pagination breaks after ~500 records on /v2/transactions
body:
We're pulling transaction data through the API Platform for month-end close and our integration stops returning results after page 500 even though the total count says there are over 12,000 records. The 'next_cursor' field in the response is coming back null when it shouldn't be. This is blocking our reconciliation for the finance team and we need it fixed or a workaround today.

We followed the SDK docs exactly (Python SDK v3.2), and the sample code in your documentation still references the old 'offset' param which throws a 400 error now. Can someone confirm the correct pagination pattern for the current API version?
answer: Thanks for flagging this, and I'm sorry for the disruption to your month-end close. We've confirmed a regression in cursor-based pagination for /v2/transactions where the cursor is dropped after the 500th record when a date filter is applied - this matches what you're seeing. Our engineers are deploying a fix now; in the meantime, please switch to fetching with a smaller page_size (100) combined with the 'created_after' filter as a workaround, which avoids the truncation. I'll also flag the outdated offset example in the docs for correction and update you as soon as the fix is live.

subject: Okta SSO app for Northwind failing since this morning - users locked out

subject: Digest emails sending duplicates for same alert window
