body:
we had an admin leave the company last week and i tryed to deactivate there acount from teh workspace settings page but it keeps geting stuck on 'processing' and never finishes. the acount still shows as active in the audit log and i can see they logged in again yesterday which is a big secuirty concern for us since we only have 3 seats total.

please help asap this need to be locked down now, i dont want unauthroized acess to continue
answer: I understand the urgency and we're treating this as a priority security matter. As an immediate step, please go to Admin Console > Users, select the account, and use 'Force Suspend' instead of standard deactivation - this immediately blocks login while we investigate why the deactivation process is stuck on your workspace. I'm also reviewing the audit log entry from yesterday now and will confirm within the hour whether that login needs further action on our end.

subject: Feedback: seat count adjustment process is confusing
body:
We recently reduced our team from 10 to 8 active users but our billing still reflects the higher seat count from last cycle. I went into the admin console and manually removed the two departed users, but the plan summary page still shows 10 seats reserved and I'm not sure if that's just a display lag or if we're actually still being billed for 10.

Could you clarify how seat adjustments are supposed to sync with billing, and whether there's a way to see this reflected in real time instead of waiting for the next cycle? Feedback: this would be a lot clearer with an in-app confirmation.
answer: Thanks for the feedback, and good question on the sync timing. What you're seeing is expected behavior on the Starter plan - seat reductions take effect at the start of the next billing cycle rather than immediately, so the plan summary showing 10 is accurate for the current cycle, and your next invoice will reflect 8. I've passed your suggestion about an in-app confirmation message along to our product team since this comes up fairly often.

subject: Recurring card decline on monthly billing despite valid card
body:
Our payment method has failed for the last two billing cycles (July 14 and Aug 14) with decline code 'do_not_honor' even though the same card works fine for other vendors and has sufficient funds. We're on the Pro plan with 190 seats, so a failed payment risks service interruption for a large chunk of our travel operations team.

We've tried re-entering the card details and also added a backup card, both giving the same decline. Is this a known issue on Northwind's payment processor side, or should we contact our bank directly?
answer: Thanks for flagging this with the specific decline code, that's helpful. 'do_not_honor' typically originates from the issuing bank rather than our processor, but since it's happening consistently across two different cards on the same account, I'm escalating to our payments team to check for anything unusual on our processing side for your account first. In parallel, I'd still recommend a quick call to your bank's fraud/authorization line mentioning recurring SaaS billing, as some banks flag automated recurring charges specifically - I'll update you within one business day with what we find.

subject: Workspace settings - deactivation and allowlist documentation
body:
I'm setting up workspace-level settings for Blue Labs in Admin Console and can't find clear documentation on how the deactivation workflow interacts with our domain allowlist. When we deactivate a user, they still appear able to log in via SSO for a short window - is there a delay before allowlist rules propagate? We have 1258 seats across multiple retail locations and need this documented for our compliance team.

Could you point me to the correct how-to guide, or clarify the expected behavior when a deactivated user's email domain is still on the allowlist?
answer: Thanks for flagging this - the behavior you're seeing is expected but not well documented yet, so I understand the confusion. Deactivation revokes account access immediately, but SSO session tokens can remain valid for up to 15 minutes due to caching on our identity layer, independent of allowlist status; the allowlist only controls new sign-ups/logins, not active sessions. I'll send you our internal admin settings guide covering this interaction and will also flag the documentation gap to our content team.

subject: Digest emails feature request
body:
We've been using Notifications for a few months now at Willow Partners and generally it's working well for our legal team's case update alerts. Our support engineers rely on the daily digest to catch anything that came in overnight, and most of the time it's fine.

The actual issue is that starting around March 3rd we started getting two copies of the same daily digest email, both timestamped within a minute of each other. It's not blocking anything but it's cluttering inboxes for our 146 users. Could you check if there's a duplicate schedule running on our account?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. Duplicate digest sends usually point to two active schedules on the same notification rule, which can happen if a rule was cloned during a settings update. I'm checking your account configuration now for overlapping digest schedules and will follow up shortly with what I find and how to consolidate them.

subject: help
body: WE ARE TRYING TO ENROLL OUR TEAM IN MFA AND KEEP GETTING STUCK. THE ENROLLMENT LINK SENT TO NEW USERS EXPIRES BEFORE THEY EVEN OPEN THE EMAIL. WE HAVE ONLY 15 SEATS BUT THIS IS BLOCKING THREE PEOPLE FROM LOGGING IN AT ALL SINCE MONDAY. IS THERE A WAY TO EXTEND THE LINK EXPIRY OR RESEND WITHOUT RESETTING THEIR WHOLE ACCOUNT.
answer: Thanks for reaching out, and sorry for the disruption to your team. MFA enrollment links currently expire after 24 hours, but if the delay is happening before the email is even opened, it's likely a delivery lag rather than the link itself - I'd like to check the enrollment timestamps for the three affected users. In the meantime, an admin can resend a fresh enrollment invite from the Identity and SSO panel without resetting the account, which should give a new 24-hour window.

subject: SCIM provisioning failing for new hires - group assignments not syncing
body:
We rely on SCIM provisioning through our identity provider to automatically create accounts and assign groups in Northwind for Pioneer Analytics. Since around September 10th, new users are being created successfully but their group memberships aren't syncing - everyone lands with no permissions assigned, so they can't access any product areas until we manually fix it.

We've had this happen for 6 new hires in the past week across our 86 seats. Our SCIM logs show a 200 response for the group PATCH but the membership doesn't reflect in the Northwind admin console. Can someone look into whether there's an issue on the provisioning endpoint?
answer: This sounds like it could be a mismatch between the group PATCH payload and how our SCIM endpoint is applying membership updates - a 200 response without the actual change taking effect points to a silent failure on our side. I'm escalating this to our provisioning team now to check the SCIM logs for your tenant around the affected timestamps, and I'll update you within the next few hours with findings. In the meantime, manual group assignment for new hires should continue to work as a workaround.

subject: Zapier integration completely broken - blocking renewal discussion
body:
Our Zapier integration for Delta Systems has stopped triggering entirely as of this morning. We have several Zaps that push data from Northwind events into our internal systems, and none of them have fired since roughly 6am. This is affecting workflows across our whole travel operations team of 4562 seats.

We have a renewal conversation scheduled with our account team this week and this outage is going to be a major point of concern if it's not resolved quickly. Can someone confirm whether this is a known issue on the Zapier connector side and give us a timeline?
answer: I understand the urgency, especially with your renewal discussion coming up - I'm treating this as a P1 and escalating immediately to our integrations team. We're aware of intermittent webhook delivery issues from the Zapier connector starting this morning and are actively investigating the root cause; I'll have an update for you within the hour, and I'm also looping in your account manager so they're aware ahead of your renewal call.

subject: Offline mode losing data after app crash
body:
I've been testing the Mobile App's offline mode for our field data collection team at Willow Labs, since a lot of our analysts work in areas with poor connectivity. Generally the offline caching works, but twice this week the app crashed while syncing cached entries back online, and in both cases the queued entries from that session were lost rather than retried.

This isn't blocking day-to-day work since it's a small number of records, but it's concerning for data integrity. Is there a way to recover queued offline data after a crash, or a log I can check to confirm what was lost?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report - losing queued entries on a sync crash shouldn't happen, since offline data is meant to persist locally until sync confirms success. I'd like to get the device logs from around the crash times if possible, as that will help us pinpoint whether the local cache was cleared prematurely. I'll also flag this to our mobile team as a data integrity concern so we can prioritize a fix.

subject: SDK returning 500 errors on all API calls - production down
body:
As of 14:20 UTC today every call through the Northwind API Platform SDK (Python, v3.4.1) is returning 500 errors for Quill Retail. This is affecting our production logistics tracking system entirely - no orders are syncing.

Error from our logs:
northwind.api.exceptions.ServerError: 500 Internal Server Error
Request ID: 8f2a-91cd-44e0
Endpoint: /v2/shipments/batch
Retry-After header not present, retried 6 times with exponential backoff, all failed

This started immediately after we deployed no changes on our end - it's fully affecting our operations right now. Please treat as urgent, we need this resolved immediately.
answer: This is now our top priority - I've escalated to our on-call API platform engineers as a P0 incident. We're checking the /v2/shipments/batch endpoint for server-side errors correlating with the 14:20 UTC start time you reported, and Request ID 8f2a-91cd-44e0 will help us trace this directly. I'll update you as soon as we have root cause or a mitigation, and will keep this thread open until service is confirmed restored.

subject: Dashboards taking 30+ seconds to load, blocking daily reporting
body:
Since Tuesday our main operations dashboard in Northwind has been taking 30 to 45 seconds to load, and sometimes times out entirely before rendering. We only have 4 seats but this dashboard is critical for our manufacturing floor reporting every morning at Lumen Systems.

The dashboard has around 12 widgets pulling from two connected data sources. It was working fine last week with load times under 5 seconds. We haven't changed the underlying data volume significantly. Can someone check if there's a performance issue on the backend or with our specific dashboard configuration?
answer: Sorry for the disruption to your morning reporting - a jump from 5 seconds to 30-45 seconds without a data volume change usually points to a query or caching issue on one of the connected data sources. I'm escalating this to our dashboards performance team now to check for slow queries or indexing problems on your account, and I'll ask them to prioritize this given it's blocking daily operational use. I'll follow up as soon as we have findings.

subject: Request to update SAML attribute mapping for login
body:
We need to change how our SAML login is configured for Ember Academy. Currently our identity provider sends the department attribute as 'dept' but Northwind's SSO setup expects 'department', so users are logging in successfully but landing without their correct group permissions assigned.

We only have 6 seats so this is easy to reproduce - I can log in with any of our test accounts and show the mismatch. Could someone update the attribute mapping on our SAML configuration, or let me know how to do it ourselves from the admin panel?
answer: Thanks for the clear description - this is a straightforward attribute mapping fix. You can update this yourself under Identity and SSO settings, in the SAML attribute mapping section, where you can add 'dept' as an accepted alias for the department claim or remap it directly. If you'd rather we make the change on our end, let me know and I can update the mapping for your tenant within the next business day.

subject: Scheduled sync delays on Data Pipelines connector
body:
Our nightly scheduled sync for North Partners has been running 2-3 hours later than configured for the past four days. It's set to run at 1am UTC but has been completing between 3:30am and 4am, which is pushing back our morning data quality checks before market open.

We use the standard connector for our core banking data source with 5 seats on the account. Nothing in our configuration has changed recently. Could you check if there's a queuing delay on the scheduler side, or advise if there's a way to set a higher priority for our sync window?
answer: Thanks for the details - a consistent 2-3 hour delay across four days does suggest a scheduler queuing issue rather than something on your configuration. I'm checking the sync queue for your tenant now to see if there's contention around the 1am UTC window, and I'll also look into whether we can set a priority flag for your sync to reduce delay before market open. I'll update you shortly with what I find.

subject: Charts rendering blank on shared dashboards
body:
We've got several dashboards used in weekly leadership reviews and since yesterday the bar and line charts are rendering blank on any dashboard that's shared via public link. Internally logged-in users still see the data fine, but the export-to-PDF also comes out with empty chart areas. This is affecting our 'Enrollment Trends' and 'Attendance' dashboards specifically, both built on the same chart template.

Can you confirm if this is a known issue with shared/exported views? We have a board meeting Thursday and need this fixed or a workaround before then.
answer: Thanks for flagging this, and sorry for the disruption ahead of your board meeting. We've seen a related issue where chart rendering in shared and exported views can fail when the underlying dashboard was built from an older chart template version - this matches what you're describing on the Enrollment Trends and Attendance dashboards. Our engineering team is investigating a fix now; in the meantime, try re-saving the chart panels from the editor view, which has resolved this for a few other customers. I'll update you within a few hours with either a permanent fix or a confirmed workaround.

subject: Zapier trigger not firing for new user events
body:
We use the Northwind Zapier integration to push new user provisioning events into our internal Slack channel and a Jira ticket queue for onboarding tracking. Since around March 4th, the 'New User Created' trigger has stopped firing entirely - no Zap runs are showing in the Zapier history even though we've had at least a dozen new users added through our Okta sync in that window.

We checked the connection in Zapier and it shows as connected with no errors. Is there a known issue on the Northwind side with this trigger, or has the webhook endpoint changed recently? This is blocking our onboarding workflow for new hires.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. We did push a webhook payload schema update on March 3rd for the 'New User Created' event, and it's possible that's causing Zapier to silently drop the trigger if it's still pointed at the old payload structure. Could you try disconnecting and reconnecting the Northwind trigger step in your Zap so it re-registers the webhook? If that doesn't resolve it, send us the Zap ID and we'll check the webhook delivery logs on our end directly.

subject: Need to add multiple IP ranges to admin allowlist and confirm old ones removed
body:
We're consolidating our office network infrastructure across three logistics hubs and need to update the IP allowlist in the Admin Console accordingly. Specifically, we need to add 203.0.113.0/24 and 198.51.100.0/24 as new allowed ranges, and remove the old range 192.0.2.0/24 that was tied to a facility we closed last month.

Could someone confirm once this change is made, and also let us know if there's a way to see a log of who last modified the allowlist? With 267 seats across multiple locations we want to make sure we're not accidentally locking anyone out during the transition.
answer: Happy to help with this. I've queued the addition of 203.0.113.0/24 and 198.51.100.0/24, and removal of 192.0.2.0/24, but before we push it live could you confirm the exact cutover date so we can time the change to avoid disrupting active sessions at the closing facility? Regarding audit visibility, the Admin Console does log allowlist changes under Settings > Activity Log, showing the admin account and timestamp for each modification - that history is available to org admins now.

subject: Question on refund for unused seats and applying credit
body:
We're on the Starter plan with 16 seats, but after a team restructuring we're only actively using 9 of those seats going forward. I'd like to understand our options: can we downgrade seat count mid-cycle and get a prorated credit, or does that only apply at renewal? We were also charged for an add-on feature last month that nobody on our team actually enabled or used.

Could you look into whether that add-on charge can be refunded or credited toward next month's invoice? Our next billing date is the 18th and I'd like this resolved before then.
answer: Thanks for reaching out. Seat downgrades on the Starter plan take effect at your next renewal date rather than mid-cycle, but I can apply a prorated credit for the difference if you'd like to reduce to 9 seats now - just confirm and I'll process it. On the add-on charge, I'm pulling up your account to check the activation history; if it wasn't enabled or used during the billing period, we'll issue a credit toward your invoice on the 18th.

subject: SAML login failing for new users after SSO setup
body:
We recently configured SAML SSO for our team and most existing users can log in fine, but the three new employees we provisioned this week are getting an 'Access Denied - Attribute Mapping Error' message when they try to sign in through our identity provider. Our IdP admin confirms the SAML assertion is being sent with the correct email and role attributes.

Could someone check whether new user provisioning through SAML requires an extra manual step on the Northwind side? With only 8 seats total, having 3 people locked out is a significant chunk of our team unable to work.
answer: Sorry for the trouble this is causing, especially with such a small team affected. New users provisioned via SAML do need to complete a first-time sync on our side before login attributes fully map - normally this happens automatically, but it can stall if the role attribute name doesn't exactly match what's configured in your Northwind SSO settings. Can you send us the exact attribute names from your IdP's assertion so we can compare against our mapping configuration and get these three users unblocked today?

subject: Uploads failing intermittently to Storage since this morning
body:
Starting around 9am today, we've had repeated upload failures when trying to push monthly reconciliation files to Storage. The error we're seeing is 'Upload interrupted - retry limit exceeded' after about the third retry attempt, and it's happening across multiple team members, not just one machine or connection.

These files are needed for our month-end close process which is due by end of day tomorrow. Is there a known outage affecting Storage uploads right now, and is there a safe way to confirm none of our partial uploads have corrupted existing backup files?
answer: Thank you for reporting this - we're aware of elevated error rates on Storage uploads starting around 9am and our infrastructure team is actively working on it. Partial or failed uploads do not overwrite or corrupt existing files, since we only commit a new version after the full upload completes successfully, so your existing backups are safe. I'll follow up as soon as we have a fix deployed, and given your month-end deadline I'm flagging this ticket as time-sensitive on our end.

subject: Änderung der Zeitpläne für Datensynchronisation erforderlich
body:
Wir müssen unsere geplanten Synchronisierungen in Data Pipelines von einem 6-Stunden-Intervall auf ein 2-Stunden-Intervall umstellen, da unsere Finanzberichte aktuellere Daten benötigen. Aktuell läuft die Pipeline 'Finance_Daily_Sync' viermal täglich, aber wir sehen in den letzten Läufen erhöhte Latenz von teilweise über 45 Minuten pro Sync.

Können Sie uns bestätigen, ob eine Erhöhung der Sync-Frequenz bei unserem aktuellen Starter-Plan möglich ist, und ob das die bestehende Latenz weiter verschlimmern würde? Wir würden die Änderung gerne noch diese Woche umsetzen.
answer: Vielen Dank für die Details zur 'Finance_Daily_Sync' Pipeline. Eine Erhöhung auf ein 2-Stunden-Intervall ist im Starter-Plan technisch möglich, allerdings könnte die bereits beobachtete Latenz von über 45 Minuten pro Lauf durch häufigere Syncs zunächst verstärkt werden, bis wir die Ursache der Verzögerung geklärt haben. Ich schaue mir die Connector-Logs der letzten Läufe an, um die Latenzquelle zu identifizieren, und melde mich innerhalb der nächsten Stunden mit einer Empfehlung, bevor wir die Frequenz umstellen.

subject: Transform-Schritt schlägt bei größeren Datensätzen fehl
body:
Ich integriere gerade die Data Pipelines API für unser Logistik-Reporting und stoße bei Datensätzen über etwa 50.000 Zeilen auf wiederholte Fehler im Transform-Schritt. Der Fehler lautet 'TransformExecutionError: memory limit exceeded at stage map_fields' und tritt bei der Pipeline 'inventory_transform_v2' auf, seit dem Update am 6. März.

Bei kleineren Testdatensätzen unter 10.000 Zeilen läuft alles problemlos durch. Können Sie prüfen, ob es aktuell eine Begrenzung für den Transform-Schritt gibt oder ob das mit dem März-Update zusammenhängt?
answer: Danke für die genaue Fehlerbeschreibung inklusive Pipeline-Name und Stage. Das Update vom 6. März hat tatsächlich das Speicherlimit für den map_fields-Stage bei Connectors auf dem Starter-Plan angepasst, was bei größeren Datensätzen zu diesem Fehler führen kann. Ich eskaliere das an unser Pipelines-Team, um zu prüfen, ob wir das Limit für 'inventory_transform_v2' temporär anheben können, während wir eine dauerhafte Lösung für Starter-Plan-Nutzer mit größeren Datenmengen evaluieren.

subject: Charged twice after upgrading plan and adding seats
body:
I upgraded our account from Starter to a higher tier last week and added 2 more seats, bringing us to 3 total. When I checked our card statement today, I see two separate charges from Northwind on the same day, one for what looks like the seat add-on and another for the full plan upgrade amount, which seems like double billing.

Can someone review our billing history and confirm whether this is expected proration or an actual duplicate charge? If it's a mistake, we'd like a refund for the extra amount as soon as possible.
answer: Thanks for flagging this, and I understand the concern with seeing two charges. I'm reviewing your billing history now to check whether this reflects prorated charges for the plan upgrade plus the seat addition processed separately, or an actual duplicate transaction. I'll confirm within the next few hours, and if it turns out to be a duplicate charge, we'll process a refund for the extra amount immediately.

subject: Upcoming SDK deprecation - need migration timeline
body:
I saw the notice in the developer changelog about the v2 REST endpoints being deprecated, but I'm integrating against the API right now using the Python SDK v3.2 and want to confirm the exact sunset date before I build against endpoints that might disappear. We're currently hitting /v2/events and /v2/webhooks fairly heavily as part of our logistics tracking integration.

Could you also clarify if the rate limit thresholds change under the new v3 endpoints, since our current integration is already close to the limit at peak hours? We'd rather plan the migration now than scramble later.
answer: Good timing to ask before building further on v2. The /v2/events and /v2/webhooks endpoints are scheduled for sunset on a rolling basis over the next quarter, with exact dates published per-endpoint in the changelog - I'll send you the specific dates for those two. On rate limits, the v3 endpoints use a slightly higher per-minute threshold with burst allowance, which should give you more headroom than v2 at peak hours, but I'd recommend reviewing the v3 migration guide's rate limit section before finalizing your integration timeline.

subject: Duplicate email digests going out for legal team
body:
For the past two weekly cycles (Oct 2 and Oct 9) our legal department has received the same notification digest twice within about 10 minutes of each other. Both copies list identical alert counts, so it looks like a sending bug rather than new data. We have 217 seats on this workspace and several partners have asked why they're getting duplicates.

Could you check whether the digest job is firing twice, and is there a way to add a per-recipient dedupe rule as a feature request?
answer: Thanks for flagging this - duplicate digest sends are not expected behavior. I've pulled up your workspace and can see two send events logged for both dates you mentioned, about 9 minutes apart, which points to the digest scheduler re-triggering rather than a data issue on your end. I'm opening a bug against the digest job and will also log your dedupe suggestion as a feature request; I'll update this ticket once we have a root cause.

subject: Pipeline data arriving 4+ hours late from MES connector
body:
Our MES connector feed into the manufacturing-line pipeline has been arriving 4 to 6 hours behind schedule since Monday, Oct 7. Normally records land within 15 minutes of the source timestamp, but yesterday's batch (run ID pl-8841) didn't complete until 22:10 UTC for data timestamped 17:45 UTC. This is causing our downstream shift-report dashboards to show stale numbers for the whole floor.

We've already restarted the connector twice with no change. Given we only have 10 seats and this pipeline feeds live production decisions, we need this escalated - can someone look at connector throughput or queue backlog on your side today?
answer: This is escalated to our data pipelines on-call team now given the production impact. Initial check on run pl-8841 shows a backlog on the ingestion queue for your connector that started building around 14:00 UTC Monday; we're investigating whether this is a throughput bottleneck or an upstream source delay. I'll have an update with root cause or a mitigation within the next couple of hours.

subject: SDK slowdown after switching to non-deprecated endpoint
body:
We migrated our billing lookup calls from the deprecated /v1/invoices/search endpoint to the recommended /v2/invoices/query endpoint ahead of the December sunset, using SDK version 4.3.1. Since the switch, average response time went from ~180ms to over 900ms for the same query patterns, and we're seeing occasional 200ms+ jitter spikes during peak hours.

Is there a known performance regression with /v2/invoices/query in this SDK version, or a pagination setting we should be adjusting? Our team of 5 relies on this for daily reconciliation and the slowdown is starting to affect our batch job windows.
answer: Thanks for the detailed comparison. We have seen reports of higher latency on /v2/invoices/query when the default page size is left at 500; reducing it to 100 and enabling the cursor-based pagination flag in SDK 4.3.1 has resolved similar cases. Can you confirm your current page size setting so we can verify that's the cause, and in the meantime I'd recommend that pagination change as a first test.

subject: Deprecated webhook signature format still breaking after migration
body:
We followed the deprecation notice to move our webhook consumers to the new HMAC-SHA256 signature scheme ahead of the /v1/webhooks/subscribe sunset, but as of this morning roughly 40% of incoming webhook events are still being signed with the old SHA1 header (X-Northwind-Signature-v1) even though our subscription shows sig_version=2. This is causing our verification middleware to reject those events outright, and we're losing order-status updates.

We're on Starter with only 5 seats but this webhook feed drives our order fulfillment flow, so it's effectively broken for the whole team right now. Can someone confirm whether the sig_version rollout is inconsistent on your end?
answer: Apologies for the disruption - this matches a known issue where a subset of webhook dispatch workers hadn't picked up the sig_version=2 config after the deprecation cutover. I'm escalating this to our platform team now as it's dropping real events for you. As a temporary workaround, please accept both signature headers for the next 24 hours while we force a full worker refresh; I'll confirm here as soon as all dispatchers are consistent.

subject: Recurring upload failures for large patient imaging batches
body:
Our operations team has been seeing intermittent upload failures when pushing imaging batch files over 2GB into Storage, specifically getting "upload session expired" errors after about 8 minutes on files from our radiology archive job. This has happened on at least 6 occasions over the last two weeks, most recently Oct 11 at 03:20 UTC, and we have to manually retry each time.

Given we're on a healthcare retention policy with strict backup windows, we'd like to understand if there's a way to extend the upload session timeout or increase chunk size, and whether quota is a factor here. A feature to auto-resume failed multipart uploads would also help a lot across our environment.
answer: Thank you for the detailed timeline - an 8-minute session expiry on large multipart uploads suggests the session TTL is timing out before all chunks complete, which can happen with slower or throttled network paths rather than a quota limit. I've checked your account and you're currently well under your storage quota, so that's not the cause here. I'll get engineering to review extending the multipart session timeout for your workspace, and I'm logging the auto-resume capability as a feature request given the retention constraints you described.

subject: Mobile app crashing when leaving offline mode
body:
Several of our staff have reported the Northwind mobile app crashing consistently when their device regains connectivity after using offline mode. It happens right as sync starts - the app freezes for a few seconds and then closes, and on reopening, some locally saved records from the offline session are missing. This has occurred on both iOS and Android in the past two days across our 11-seat workspace.

We also noticed push notifications stop arriving entirely after a crash like this until the app is force-restarted. Since our field staff rely on offline mode daily, this is blocking real work right now and we need help urgently.
answer: I understand this is blocking your field team and we're treating it as urgent. The crash-on-sync-resume pattern along with missing local records points to a sync conflict handler issue we're actively investigating; can you send us the device logs from one affected phone (Settings > Diagnostics > Export Logs) so we can pinpoint the exact failure point? In the meantime, please advise staff to manually export any pending offline entries before reconnecting, to avoid further data loss while we work on a fix.

subject: Need to restore deleted files from backup - retention question
body:
One of our warehouse ops teams accidentally deleted a shared folder containing shipment manifests on Oct 10 around 14:00 UTC, affecting roughly 3,200 files. We're on Enterprise with backup enabled, but I can't find a self-service restore option in the console - only individual file version history, which doesn't cover deleted folders.

Can you walk us through the process to restore the entire folder from backup, and confirm what our current retention window covers? With 1,194 seats depending on this data for daily logistics runs, we need this resolved quickly.
answer: I can help get this restored. For a full folder-level restore from backup, our team needs to run it on the backend rather than through self-service, since that only covers individual file versions as you noted. Your Enterprise retention window covers 35 days of daily backups, so the Oct 10 deletion is well within range - I'm submitting the restore request now for the folder and will confirm here once the 3,200 files are back in place, likely within the next few hours.

subject: Question about deactivated user still showing in audit log allowlist
body:
I deactivated a former contractor's account in Admin Console last week, but I noticed their entry is still appearing in our IP allowlist audit log as an active exception. I'd like to understand whether deactivation automatically removes allowlist entries or if that's a separate manual step we need to handle.

This isn't urgent, but with 2,202 seats and periodic compliance reviews, we'd appreciate clarification so we can update our offboarding checklist accordingly.
answer: Good question, and this comes up often. Deactivating a user account does not automatically remove associated IP allowlist entries - those are managed independently under Admin Console > Security > Allowlist, so it's a separate step your offboarding process should include. I'd suggest adding that as a checklist item, and happy to point you to our offboarding guide if useful.

subject: URGENT audit log access
body: Audit log shows unauthorized admin login, need help now.
answer: This has been escalated to our security on-call immediately given the potential unauthorized access. Please lock the affected admin account now via Admin Console > Users if you haven't already, and reply here with the account identifier and approximate login time so we can pull the full audit trail and take further containment steps within minutes.

subject: Okta integration broken - users can't SSO into Northwind
body:
Since this morning our Okta app integration for Northwind stopped working - users attempting SSO get redirected back to Okta with error "invalid_client" instead of landing in Northwind. This started around 08:30 UTC and none of our 4 seats can log in via SSO right now, so we're locked out entirely.

subject: API key rotation breaking webhook signatures after SDK update

body:
Our main ingestion pipeline has been failing at the transform stage since around 11pm last night. The pipeline dashboard shows 47 failed runs in a row, all with the same error: "transform_error: schema mismatch on field order_total, expected decimal got string". Nothing changed on our connector config recently that we're aware of.

We have 162 seats and this pipeline feeds our manufacturing order data into downstream reporting, so this is now affecting multiple teams who rely on that data being current. Can someone look into whether this is related to a source schema change or something on Northwind's side?
answer: Thanks for the specific error details, that's very helpful. A schema mismatch like this on order_total often points to an upstream source change, possibly the connector's source system emitting the field as a string rather than a decimal, but I'm pulling your pipeline logs now to confirm whether this started with a source-side change or a connector update on our end. I'll have an update for you within the hour given the number of failed runs, and will let you know if a manual reprocess will be needed once resolved.

subject: SDK returning data loss errors after recent update
body:
We updated to the latest Northwind API Platform SDK version yesterday and now several of our webhook handlers are throwing "payload_truncated: expected 12 fields, received 7" errors, meaning we're losing order and shipment fields on incoming webhook events. This started immediately after the SDK update and is affecting all webhook types we subscribe to.

We have 22 seats and this is causing data loss in our downstream systems since we can't reconstruct the missing fields. Given the SDK changelog mentioned deprecating some legacy fields, we suspect this is related but need urgent confirmation and a fix path since we're actively losing data right now.
answer: This has been escalated immediately given the active data loss. Your suspicion is likely correct, the SDK's recent release deprecated several legacy webhook payload fields, and it seems the truncation is happening because your handlers still expect the old schema. As an immediate mitigation, I'd recommend pinning back to the previous SDK version to stop further data loss while we confirm the migration path, and I'm pulling the full deprecation mapping now to send you a field-by-field guide for updating your handlers.

subject: SSO role mapping not assigning correct permissions
body:
We're seeing an issue where users provisioned through our SSO connection are landing in Northwind with the wrong role. Specifically, five users who should map to "Manager" based on their Okta group are instead getting the default "Viewer" role after login, which blocks them from accessing reports they need.

We have 24 seats total and our SSO/MFA setup hasn't changed recently. Can you check the role mapping configuration on our SSO connection to see why the group-to-role mapping isn't applying correctly for these five accounts?
answer: Thanks for the specifics, that narrows things down well. This usually happens when the group attribute sent in the SSO assertion doesn't exactly match the group name configured in your role mapping rules, sometimes due to casing or a trailing space. I'm reviewing your SSO connection's mapping configuration now and will check the raw assertion for one of the five affected accounts to see exactly what group value is coming through, then get back to you with the fix.

subject: Recurring transform failures across multiple pipelines
body:
We've noticed transform failures happening intermittently across three of our Data Pipelines over the past week, each throwing "connector_timeout: upstream response exceeded 30000ms" before failing the run. It's not constant, maybe 1 in 5 runs fail, but it's disrupting our sync schedule and causing gaps in our reporting data.

We have 24 seats and rely on these pipelines for daily media performance syncs. Could you check whether this is a latency issue on the connector side or something with how our pipelines are configured? We'd like to understand root cause rather than just retry manually each time.
answer: Thanks for the clear pattern description, intermittent timeouts like this often point to latency spikes on the upstream connector rather than your pipeline configuration itself. I'm pulling the connector performance metrics for your three affected pipelines over the past week to see if the timeouts correlate with specific time windows or data volume spikes, and I'll share what I find along with a recommendation on whether increasing the timeout threshold or adjusting sync frequency would help reduce the failure rate.

subject: How to deactivate an old IP allowlist entry without locking out admins
body:
I need to remove a stale IP range from our Admin Console allowlist (203.0.113.0/24, added when we had a branch office in Chicago that closed in March). I can't find a clear way to deactivate a single entry without disabling the whole allowlist feature temporarily, which would leave us exposed. Is there documentation on safely rotating allowlist entries one at a time?

Also, will removing an entry generate an audit log entry automatically, or do I need to log the change manually for our compliance review?
answer:
Thanks for reaching out. You can deactivate a single IP allowlist entry without disabling the feature globally - go to Admin Console > Settings > Allowlist, click the entry, and toggle it to Inactive rather than deleting it, which keeps the rest of the ranges enforced the whole time. Any activation or deactivation of an entry is automatically written to the Audit Log with the admin's identity and timestamp, so no manual logging is needed on your end.

I'll also send you our step-by-step allowlist rotation guide so this is easier for future changes.

subject: SCIM provisioning creating users without correct group permissions
body:
We use SCIM provisioning through our IdP to sync 151 employees into Northwind, and starting this week new users are being created successfully but landing with zero group memberships instead of inheriting the mapped roles from our IdP groups. I've confirmed the group mappings in Identity and SSO settings haven't changed since setup in January.

This is causing login failures for anyone provisioned after Monday - they authenticate via SSO fine but get an 'insufficient permissions' error on first access. So far it's affected 9 new hires that we know of.
answer:
Thanks for the detailed report - this sounds like a provisioning bug rather than a config issue on your side since the mappings haven't changed. Can you send us the SCIM request logs for two or three of the affected users (timestamps and user IDs are enough) so we can trace whether the group attribute is being dropped on our end during the sync?

In the meantime, as a workaround you can manually assign the correct groups to the 9 affected users from the Identity and SSO admin panel so they're unblocked while we investigate the root cause.

subject: API key rate limits hit unexpectedly, webhooks failing
body:
Since around 2pm UTC today our production API key (prefix nk_live_7f2a) started returning 429 Too Many Requests on roughly 40% of calls, even though our request volume hasn't changed from previous weeks. As a result, our webhook retries are piling up and we're seeing delayed order sync with our travel booking partners.

We're using the Node SDK v3.2.1. Can you confirm if there's been a rate limit change on Starter plan keys recently, or if our key got throttled by mistake?
answer:
Thanks for flagging this - we're looking into it now. We did roll out an adjusted rate-limiting policy this week for API keys on the Starter tier, and it looks like your key may have been placed under a stricter bucket than intended. I'm escalating this to our platform team to review your key's throttle configuration directly.

In the meantime, adding exponential backoff in your webhook retry logic should reduce the pileup, and I'll update you as soon as we've confirmed the fix on our side.

subject: Pagination returning duplicate records across pages
body:
We're pulling data through the API's /v1/records endpoint using cursor-based pagination in our internal sync tool, and starting last week we noticed duplicate records appearing across consecutive pages. For example, record ID rec_88213 showed up on both page 4 and page 5 of the same query run on Tuesday.

We're using the default page size of 50 and passing the next_cursor value exactly as returned. This is causing our nightly reconciliation job to overcount records by roughly 3-5% each run.
answer:
Thanks for the clear repro details. Duplicate records across pages usually points to the cursor not accounting for records with identical sort-key timestamps, which can happen if multiple records share the same created_at value. Could you confirm whether the duplicates involve records created within the same second, and send us one more example pair of duplicate IDs with page numbers?

We'll dig into the cursor logic on our end in parallel - this is a real issue worth tracking down given the impact on your reconciliation accuracy.

subject: Plan upgrade charged 24 seats but billing shows 45
body:
We upgraded from Starter to a higher tier yesterday afternoon and added seats to cover new hires, expecting to be billed for 24 seats total. Instead, our invoice preview today shows a charge for 45 seats at the higher rate, which doesn't match anything we selected in the upgrade flow.

This is urgent because our finance team is closing the month-end books tomorrow and needs an accurate invoice. Can someone confirm what happened and issue a corrected invoice or refund for the difference before end of day?
answer:
I understand the urgency given your month-end deadline, and I'm escalating this to our billing team right now for same-day review. This looks like a seat-count bug during the upgrade flow rather than anything you did - we've seen similar reports and are treating it as a priority fix.

We'll get a corrected invoice reflecting the 24 seats generated today, and if the higher charge has already been processed we'll issue a refund for the difference as soon as the correction is confirmed. I'll follow up within a few hours with a status update.

subject: Salesforce sync stopped updating contact records
body:
Our Salesforce integration has stopped syncing updated contact records since Sunday - any edits we make to contacts in Salesforce aren't reflecting in Northwind, and it's blocking our sales team from seeing current account status for active deals. We rely on this sync daily and it was working fine last week.

We checked the integration status page and it shows 'Connected' with no errors, but the last successful sync timestamp is stuck at Sunday 6:41am. Can someone escalate this - it's affecting our whole sales team's workflow.
answer:
This is impacting your whole team so I'm escalating it to our integrations engineer right now as a priority issue. A sync showing 'Connected' but stuck at a fixed timestamp usually points to a stalled sync job rather than an auth or config problem, so we'll check the job queue on our end first.

We'll update you within the next couple of hours with findings, and if we need to manually trigger a resync we'll coordinate the timing with you to avoid any duplicate updates.

subject: Request: documentation on push notification behavior when offline
body:
We're rolling out the mobile app more broadly across our campuses and want to update our internal training docs regarding push notifications. Specifically, we'd like to understand what happens to a push notification if a user's device is offline when it's sent - is it queued and delivered on reconnect, or dropped entirely?

Also, do offline periods longer than 24 hours affect delivery, and is there any documented crash behavior tied to notification handling we should be aware of for our support team?
answer:
Good questions - push notifications are queued by the platform-level push service (APNs/FCM) for up to 28 days when a device is offline, and delivered automatically once the device reconnects, so nothing should be dropped within that window. We're not aware of any crash issues tied specifically to notification handling in the current app version.

I'll send over a link to our mobile documentation section covering notification lifecycle and offline behavior so your team has something concrete for the training materials.

subject: Widespread 429 errors across production API keys since this morning
body:
Starting around 8:15am UTC today, multiple production API keys across our organization are getting rate-limited with 429 responses on endpoints that normally run well under our limits. This is affecting webhook delivery for order updates and several SDK-based integrations our manufacturing partners depend on in real time.

We haven't changed our request patterns or deployed anything new this week. Given the number of affected keys (at least 6 that we've checked), this looks like it could be a platform-wide issue rather than something specific to us.
answer:
Thank you for the detailed report - given the number of keys affected and the sudden onset, we're treating this as a potential platform-side rate-limiting issue and escalating to our infrastructure team immediately. We'll check whether a recent limit configuration change affected your account tier broadly rather than individual keys.

We'll keep you updated as we investigate, and please let us know if you see the issue worsen or affect additional keys in the meantime so we can prioritize accordingly.

subject: Recurring card failure on monthly invoice
body:
Our card on file was declined for this month's invoice (invoice #INV-10432), and I got a payment failure notification yesterday. I checked with our bank and the card itself is active with no holds, so I'm not sure why the charge failed on Northwind's end.

Could you let me know the decline reason code if one was logged, and whether I should just update the card or if there's something else causing it? We'd also like to know if a late fee applies if this isn't resolved by our next billing date.
answer:
Thanks for flagging this - I checked invoice #INV-10432 and the decline came back with code 'do_not_honor' from the card processor, which sometimes happens even when the bank shows no hold on their end, often due to how the transaction was flagged. I'd recommend re-entering the card details or trying an alternate card in your billing settings.

No late fee applies as long as payment is resolved before the next billing cycle starts, so you have some time - let us know once you've updated the card and we can manually retry the charge.

subject: Zapier integration not triggering on new record creation
body:
I'm integrating our workflow with Northwind through the Zapier connector, and the 'New Record Created' trigger isn't firing when records are added via our API. I've confirmed records are created successfully (I can see them in the dashboard immediately), but the connected Zap in Zapier hasn't run since I set it up three days ago.

I tested with a manual trigger in Zapier's dashboard and it pulled the correct sample data, so the connection itself seems fine. Is this a known limitation with API-created records versus UI-created ones?
answer:
Good catch - this is a known gap where the 'New Record Created' trigger currently only polls for records created through the dashboard UI and doesn't yet pick up records created directly via the API, since they go through a different internal event path. We have this documented as a limitation and it's on our roadmap to unify the triggers.

As a workaround for now, you could have your API integration also fire a webhook that Zapier's 'Catch Hook' trigger can consume, which would give you near-instant triggering until the native trigger is updated.

subject: Need to restore Storage bucket after accidental deletion
body: One of our team leads accidentally deleted a folder containing signed client contracts from our legal archive bucket (bucket: atlas-travel-legal-docs) around 2:15pm today. We need to restore the contents from a backup snapshot prior to that deletion. Can you confirm the most recent backup point we have before 2:15pm and walk me through the restore process for that bucket?
answer: Thanks for flagging this quickly. I can see snapshot history for atlas-travel-legal-docs, and there's a clean backup point from 1:40pm today, before the deletion occurred. I'm initiating a restore of that folder path now to a staging location so you can verify the contents before we overwrite the live bucket - I'll update you within the hour with a link to review.

subject: Restoring files from backup - unsure how far back we can go
body: We had some invoice files get overwritten last week by an automated sync job and need to pull an older version from backup. Our retention settings show 30 days, but I'm not sure which specific date the good version was saved. Could someone help me look at the version history for the folder named 'vendor-invoices-2024' and identify a restore point from before June 3rd?
answer: Happy to help track this down. I've pulled the snapshot history for vendor-invoices-2024 and there are restore points available from May 28th, June 1st, and June 2nd, all within your 30-day retention window. Let me know which date looks right and I'll initiate a restore to a separate folder so you can compare before replacing the current files.

subject: audit log
body: How do I export the admin audit log?
answer: You can export the audit log from the Admin Console under Settings > Audit Log by selecting a date range and clicking Export CSV. If you need a specific retention window or filtering by user/action type, let me know and I can point you to the relevant filter options or documentation.

subject: cant share dashbord with external users anymor
body: hey since yesterday when i try to share a dashbord with someone outside our workspace it just says permision denied even tho i am the owner of the dashbord. this is affecting like 15 of my colegues who need to send reports to outside partners for a board meeting tommorow. we didnt change any settings on our side that i know of. can someone check whats going on asap
answer: Sorry for the trouble ahead of your board meeting - I'm escalating this now since it's affecting multiple users. Can you confirm the workspace ID and one example dashboard URL that's failing? In the meantime I'm checking whether there was a recent change to external sharing policies on our side that might explain the permission denied error, and I'll follow up shortly.

subject: Storage quota nearing limit ahead of compliance audit
body: We're approaching our storage quota limit on the Apex Partners workspace and need to understand our options before our compliance audit next week. Current usage is showing 94% of allocated quota, and I want to confirm whether increasing the quota affects our existing retention policies or backup schedules for regulated documents. Can you also confirm the documented retention period for our current plan so I can reference it in the audit prep?
answer: Thanks for getting ahead of this before your audit. Increasing your storage quota will not affect existing retention policies or backup schedules - those are configured independently. Your current plan has a documented retention period of 90 days for backups; I'll send over the relevant documentation link and can also process a quota increase now if you'd like to avoid hitting the limit before your audit.

subject: Salesforce sync stopped updating records - urgent for our sales team
body: Our Salesforce integration through Northwind has stopped syncing updated account records since yesterday morning. Sales reps are seeing stale data across roughly 400 accounts, and this is blocking quarter-end reporting. We haven't changed any Okta or Salesforce connection settings on our end recently. Can someone check the sync job status and let us know if there's an outage or configuration issue?
answer: Thank you for the detailed report - this is impacting a large number of accounts so I'm marking it high priority. I'm checking the Salesforce sync job logs now to see if there's an authentication or connector error on our side; initial review shows a token refresh failure starting yesterday at 6am. I'll follow up within the next hour with either a fix or a clear timeline, and will keep you updated as we investigate.

subject: Getting duplicate email alerts for the same event
body: Several of our admins have noticed they're receiving two identical email notifications for the same alert trigger, usually within a few seconds of each other. This started about a week ago and happens for both threshold alerts and system status notifications. It's not urgent but it's cluttering inboxes and we'd like to understand if this is a known issue or something in our notification rules causing duplicates.
answer: Thanks for the report - this isn't something widely flagged yet, so I'll look into whether it's tied to a specific alert rule configuration or a delivery retry issue on our end. Could you share one or two example alert IDs or timestamps where the duplicates occurred? That will help me trace the notification logs and confirm whether it's a rule overlap or a backend delivery bug.

subject: Dashboards taking 20+ seconds to load for our ops team
body: Several of our dashboards, particularly the ones with multiple bar and line charts pulling from our shipping data source, have become noticeably slower over the past week. Load times have gone from around 3 seconds to over 20 seconds, and exporting to PDF times out entirely on the largest dashboard. This is making it hard for our ops team to review shipment metrics during daily standups.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report - a 3 to 20 second jump is significant and worth digging into right away. Can you share the name or ID of the slowest dashboard and roughly how many charts and data points it's pulling? I'll check query performance and export job logs on our side in parallel to see if there's a bottleneck in the underlying data source or a recent change affecting rendering.

subject: Recurring transform failures in nightly pipeline
body: Our nightly data pipeline job that transforms raw media engagement events has failed for the past three runs, each time erroring out around the same transform step that deduplicates viewer IDs. The failure log shows a 'schema mismatch' error referencing a field named viewer_region that wasn't present before. We haven't changed our source schema recently, so I'm not sure if this is on our end or a pipeline update on Northwind's side.
answer: Thanks for the detailed context - a schema mismatch on viewer_region after three consecutive failures suggests something changed upstream in either the source connector or the transform step itself. I'm pulling the pipeline run logs now to check whether a recent platform update introduced this field unexpectedly, and I'll confirm within the next few hours whether this needs a fix on our side or an update to your transform mapping.

subject: Employees unable to complete MFA enrollment after SSO login
body: Since this morning, a large number of our employees logging in through our SSO provider are getting stuck at the MFA enrollment screen - it loads but the QR code never appears, and the 'resend code' option just spins indefinitely. This is blocking access company-wide and we have several teams that can't log in at all right now. We haven't changed our SSO or MFA configuration recently.
answer: This is a top priority for us given the scale of impact - I'm escalating immediately. Can you confirm the SSO provider you're using and roughly when the first reports came in this morning? In the meantime I'm checking whether there's a known issue with QR code generation on our MFA enrollment service and will update you as soon as we have a root cause or workaround, ideally within the hour.

subject: All transform jobs failing since 6am - pipeline down
body: Our nightly transform pipeline (pipeline-id harbor-billing-etl) has failed every run since 06:12 UTC today with error 'Schema mismatch on column invoice_total: expected DECIMAL got STRING'. We have 14 failed runs in a row and no invoice data has landed in the warehouse since yesterday. This is blocking our month-end billing close for Harbor Legal and finance cannot generate client invoices right now.
answer: I've escalated this to our Data Pipelines on-call engineer as a P0 outage and we're actively investigating the schema mismatch on harbor-billing-etl. Initial checks show an upstream source field changed type in the last sync; we're rolling back to the last known-good schema mapping now and will push a fix within the hour. I'll update you as soon as jobs are re-running successfully and confirm no data was lost.

subject: Biometric login breaking after latest API update
body: We're integrating Northwind's mobile SDK for biometric login on our retail app and since updating to the newest API version, Face ID and fingerprint auth now fail with 'auth_challenge_expired' for roughly 40% of our test users. This started right after we pointed to the new /auth/biometric endpoint. Push notifications for re-auth prompts are also arriving late or not at all, and users are getting locked out when offline. We need this fixed quickly since we're planning to ship this to production users at Orion Health this week.
answer: Thanks for flagging this - we've reproduced the auth_challenge_expired error and it's tied to a token TTL regression introduced in the new biometric endpoint, which is also causing the delayed push prompts. We're treating this as a P1 and rolling out a fix to extend the challenge window and correct push delivery timing today. I'll follow up with the exact deployment time and a note on whether you need to update any client-side timeout values.

subject: Request to enable biometric login for our school accounts
body: We'd like to turn on biometric login (Face ID / fingerprint) for our staff accounts in the Northwind mobile app. Right now our 4 admin seats only see password login and a push-based MFA prompt. Is biometric login available on the Starter plan, and if so what do we need to configure on our end to enable it for Quill Partners' users?
answer: Biometric login is available on Starter plans and can be enabled per-organization from the Mobile App settings under Authentication Methods. Once you toggle it on, users will see the biometric option the next time they open the app and re-authenticate, provided their device has Face ID or fingerprint enrolled. Let us know if you'd like us to walk you through the setup on a quick call.

subject: SCIM provisioning outage - no new users syncing, logins failing
body: Since around 8am today our SCIM provisioning integration between our HR system and Northwind Identity has stopped syncing entirely. New employees can't be provisioned, MFA enrollment is failing for accounts mid-sync, and several existing users are now getting 'permission denied' errors on login they didn't have yesterday. This is affecting all 4 of our admin seats at Pioneer Media and we have no visibility into what's happening on your side - the SCIM sync logs just show timeout errors.
answer: I'm sorry for the disruption - this is now flagged P0 and our identity team is actively investigating the SCIM sync timeouts, which appear related to a provisioning service issue on our side starting around 08:00. We're working to restore sync and login access as fast as possible and will prioritize clearing the permission errors on affected accounts first. I'll send you an update within 30 minutes with status and next steps.

subject: Webhooks not firing - missing payment events
body: Our webhook endpoint has stopped receiving payment.succeeded events since yesterday afternoon. We checked our endpoint logs and nothing has come through since 3:47pm, though the Northwind dashboard shows the events as 'delivered'. We rely on these webhooks to reconcile client payments for Apex Travel and finance is now behind on matching transactions for two days' worth of bookings.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report - we can see delivery attempts logged as successful on our end, which suggests a possible mismatch between our delivery status and actual receipt, potentially tied to a recent SDK update on the webhook signing library. We're marking this P1 and pulling the raw delivery logs for your endpoint now to confirm whether payloads are reaching you or silently failing signature verification. We'll get back to you shortly with findings and a plan to replay any missed events.

subject: Push notifications not delivering to Android users after crash fix
body: After updating to the latest Mobile App SDK to fix a login crash, push notifications have become unreliable for our Android users - roughly 1 in 5 devices isn't receiving alerts at all, and offline queued notifications never arrive once the device reconnects. We're integrating this for Quill Analytics across our legal case management app and need push reliability restored before we roll this update out further. Can someone from escalation take a look at our integration logs?
answer: Thanks for the details - we'll get this escalated to our mobile platform team given the scale of your deployment. It sounds like the crash-fix SDK update may have altered the offline notification queue handling on Android; we'll need your app's bundle ID and a sample of affected device tokens to trace delivery failures. In the meantime we're reviewing recent SDK changelog items for related push regressions and will update you within one business day.

subject: Request: filter and export options for audit log
body: We'd like to request improvements to the Admin Console audit log for Harbor Freight - specifically the ability to filter by IP allowlist changes and permission edits, and to export results as CSV. Right now with 108 seats the log list is long and hard to search, and we're noticing it takes several seconds to load a full month of entries. This would really help our compliance reviews.
answer: Thanks for the suggestion - filtering by event type such as allowlist and permission changes, plus CSV export, is on our near-term roadmap for the Admin Console audit log. We'll also look into the load-time issue you're seeing with a full month of entries, as that may point to a pagination fix we can ship sooner. I'll log this as a feature request tied to your account and update you once we have a timeline.

subject: Intermittent 429s on API keys despite low usage
body: We're seeing intermittent 429 Too Many Requests errors on several of our API keys even though our usage dashboard shows we're well under the documented rate limit for our tier. This is affecting webhook retries and some SDK calls across our healthcare integrations at North Academy - we manage 3256 seats and this is causing delays in patient data sync jobs. Can you check if there's a limiting issue on specific keys, for example key ending in 7f3a?
answer: Thanks for flagging the key suffix - we're looking into key 7f3a and related keys now to check for a possible mismatch between your account's configured rate limit and what's being enforced at the gateway. This can sometimes happen after a tier or SDK version change; we'll confirm the actual limit being applied and correct it if it's misconfigured. We'll follow up with findings and, if needed, a temporary limit increase while we investigate further.

subject: Duplicate email digests being sent multiple times per day
body: Our team at Quill Health has been receiving the daily notification digest email 3-4 times each morning instead of once, starting Tuesday. Each copy has the same content and timestamp in the subject line, so it looks like a sending loop rather than new data. This is generating complaints from our 16 users and cluttering inboxes badly - can you check the digest scheduler on our account?
answer: Thanks for reporting this - duplicate digest sends usually point to a scheduler retry issue where the job isn't being marked complete after the first send. We're treating this as P1 given it's affecting your whole team daily, and we're checking your account's digest job history now to identify and stop the duplicate triggers. We'll confirm once the fix is applied and let you know if any pending duplicates need to be cleared manually.

subject: Changing audit log retention and adding IP allowlist entries
body: We'd like to update our Admin Console settings for Blue Analytics - specifically extend our audit log retention beyond the current 90 days if possible, and add two new office IP ranges to our allowlist since we're deactivating an old VPN range next week. Can you confirm what's configurable on our Pro plan and whether the allowlist change needs a maintenance window?
answer: On the Pro plan audit log retention is fixed at 90 days, though we can discuss extended retention options if that's something you need long-term. For the allowlist update, adding new IP ranges and deactivating the old VPN range can be done directly in Admin Console settings without any downtime or maintenance window - changes take effect within a few minutes. Let us know if you'd like a hand confirming the new ranges before you remove the old one.

subject: Webhook signature scheme deprecation timeline + rate limit increase request
body:
We're integrating Northwind webhooks across three of our internal apps at Pioneer Labs and noticed the deprecation notice for the SHA-1 signature header (X-Northwind-Signature) landing in the SDK changelog for v4.2. We need a firm sunset date so we can schedule the migration to the new HMAC-SHA256 scheme across our legal team's document workflow.

Separately, we're hitting the 100 req/min webhook retry limit during batch reprocessing after outages, which is throttling delivery to our 282 users. Can you confirm the deprecation cutover date and whether a temporary rate limit bump is possible while we migrate?
answer:
Thanks for flagging both items together. The SHA-1 signature header is officially deprecated as of next month, with full removal scheduled 90 days after that; we'll send the exact dates in the SDK migration guide we're finalizing this week, and v4.2 already supports dual-signature validation so you can migrate incrementally without downtime.

On the rate limit, I've raised your webhook retry ceiling temporarily to 250 req/min while you complete the migration - this should clear the throttling during batch reprocessing. I'll follow up with the SDK team's feedback form so your input on the new signature scheme gets included in the next release notes.

subject: Seat count reconciliation for renewal invoice
body: I'm reviewing our upcoming Enterprise renewal invoice and the seat count listed is 3,249, but our HR system shows 3,180 active employees with Northwind access as of this month. I want to confirm whether the discrepancy is due to pending deprovisioning or if we're being billed for seats that should have been removed after our last offboarding batch in October.
answer: Thanks for catching this before renewal - we'll reconcile the seat count against your admin console's active user list rather than the invoice snapshot. It looks like 69 deactivated accounts from your October offboarding batch weren't fully removed from billing sync; I'm correcting that now and will send an updated invoice reflecting 3,180 seats within one business day.

subject: Question on retention policy before increasing storage quota
body: I'm planning to request a storage quota increase for our healthcare data lake, but before doing that I want to understand how retention works on our Pro plan. Currently we have backups going back 18 months, and I need to know if there's an automatic deletion policy after a certain period, since we have to comply with a 7-year retention requirement for some patient-adjacent records.
answer: Good question to sort out first - on the Pro plan, default retention for backups is 24 months unless you've configured custom lifecycle rules, after which older backups are automatically purged. For your 7-year requirement, I'd recommend setting up a dedicated long-term retention bucket with a custom policy, which is available on Pro; I can walk you through the setup or point you to our retention configuration guide if that's easier.

subject: Card declined when trying to upgrade from Starter
body: I'm trying to upgrade our plan from Starter to Pro through the billing settings page so we can raise our API rate limits, but the upgrade fails every time with 'Payment method declined - please contact your bank.' I confirmed with our bank that the card is fine and has sufficient funds. This is blocking us from testing higher-volume endpoints we need live by Friday.
answer: Sorry for the trouble - this specific error usually points to our payment processor flagging the transaction as a plan-tier change rather than a standard recurring charge, which some banks auto-decline as unusual activity. answer: Thanks for the detail - full multi-panel PDF export is on our near-term roadmap, but I want to get you unblocked before Monday. In the meantime I can walk you through exporting each panel individually and combining them, or set you up with a scheduled report link that covers the whole dashboard; let me know which works better and I'll send steps today.

subject: Okta SSO app throwing invalid_client error on login
body: We configured the Northwind Okta app for SSO last week and it worked fine until this morning, when all three of our users started getting "invalid_client: The client credentials are invalid" when trying to log in through Okta. Nothing changed on our Okta side that we're aware of. We rely on this for daily access so any users who aren't logged in already are now locked out.
answer: Sorry for the lockout - that error usually points to a client secret rotation or mismatch between Okta and the app registration on our side. Can you confirm whether you or anyone on your team regenerated the Okta app credentials recently? I'll check our SSO configuration logs for your org in the meantime to see if anything changed on our end around this morning's timeframe.

subject: Salesforce-Sync zeigt veraltete Kontaktdaten an
body: Uns ist aufgefallen, dass die Salesforce-Integration Kontakte anzeigt, die seit über zwei Wochen nicht mehr synchronisiert wurden, obwohl der letzte Sync-Status als "erfolgreich" markiert ist. Wir haben 24 Nutzer, die auf diese Daten zugreifen, und einige Berichte enthalten dadurch falsche Ansprechpartner. Gibt es eine Möglichkeit, den Sync-Zeitstempel pro Objekt einzusehen, um das genauer nachzuvollziehen?
answer: Danke für den Hinweis - das klingt nach einem stillen Fehler bei der inkrementellen Synchronisierung, der den Status nicht korrekt widerspiegelt. Können Sie mir die betroffene Salesforce-Objekt-ID sowie den ungefähren Zeitraum nennen? Ich prüfe dann die Sync-Logs auf unserer Seite und melde mich mit einer Einschätzung, ob ein manueller Re-Sync nötig ist.

subject: Request to connect Northwind to Zapier for new lead alerts
body: We'd like to set up a Zapier connection so that new leads captured through our forms trigger a Slack notification and create a Salesforce record automatically. I saw Jira and Okta listed as supported apps in some docs but couldn't find clear steps for Zapier specifically. Could you point me to setup documentation or let me know if this integration is supported on our current plan?
answer: Good news - Zapier support is available and works alongside the Slack and Salesforce integrations you mentioned. I'll send over our step-by-step setup guide for connecting Zapier triggers to Northwind events, and flag the specific Slack and Salesforce actions you'll want for lead routing. Let me know once you've connected it if you run into any authentication prompts.

subject: Best practices for handling intermittent large file upload failures
body: We occasionally see upload failures for files over 2GB in Storage, usually during our nightly backup window between 1am and 3am UTC. The error we get back is a generic "upload interrupted" message without much detail. Given our retention policies and backup volume across 3651 seats, I wanted to ask if there are documented best practices or configuration settings to make large uploads more resilient during peak load.
answer: Thanks for reaching out proactively on this - large uploads during high-traffic windows can be more prone to interruption, and we do have documentation on chunked upload configuration and retry settings that helps significantly with files over 1GB. I'll send that guide along with our recommended retention and backup scheduling practices for accounts at your scale, and happy to review your current settings together if useful.

subject: Untitled
body: Our last two invoices for Vertex Systems show the wrong plan tier - they're billed as Starter instead of Pro, even though we've been on Pro for over a year with 160 seats. The invoice dated Jan 10 also shows a payment as "failed" in our billing portal, but our card was actually charged successfully according to our bank statement. This is causing confusion with our finance team reconciling the books.
answer: Sorry for the confusion this is causing your finance team - a plan mismatch on invoices combined with a payment status discrepancy suggests a sync issue between our billing and payment systems rather than an actual charge problem. I'm pulling up your account now to verify the correct plan tier and the Jan 10 transaction status, and I'll issue a corrected invoice once I confirm the details.

subject: Shared dashboard permissions broken after API update - clients locked out
body: After calling the /dashboards/{id}/share endpoint this morning to update permissions for a client rollout, all previously shared dashboard links returned 403 Forbidden for external viewers, even ones we hadn't touched. We have roughly 200 client accounts affected across our retail reporting dashboards, and several are asking why they can't access charts they had access to yesterday. This is actively affecting client-facing deliverables right now.
answer: This is escalated on our end given the client-facing impact - a permissions update cascading to unrelated shared links points to a possible issue in how the share endpoint recalculates access scopes. Please send me the dashboard IDs and the exact request payload you used this morning, and I'll get engineering looking at this immediately while we work out a way to restore the affected share links.

subject: Dashboards loading very slowly during peak hours
body: Our logistics dashboards have been taking 15-20 seconds to load since Monday, especially the shipment volume charts with the stacked bar view. We have 101 seats active and around 30 people hit the dashboards each morning between 7-9am. Exporting to CSV from the main freight dashboard now times out after about 45 seconds. Sharing a dashboard link to a colleague also seems to trigger a fresh slow reload for them instead of using cached data. Can someone look into whether this is a capacity issue on your end?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. We can see elevated query times on your dashboard workspace starting Monday morning, and we're checking whether this correlates with the chart complexity on the freight volume view or backend load during your peak window. We're escalating this to our performance team now and will update you within a few hours with findings, and in the meantime we'd suggest reducing the date range on the heaviest charts to see if that improves load times.

subject: Doppelte Benachrichtigungen bei E-Mail-Alerts
body: Seit letzter Woche erhalten mehrere Nutzer bei uns doppelte E-Mail-Benachrichtigungen für dieselben Alerts, teilweise im Abstand von wenigen Minuten. Das betrifft besonders die Reise-Buchungsbenachrichtigungen, die an unsere Kunden weitergeleitet werden. Können Sie uns sagen, ob es eine Einstellung gibt, um doppelte Zustellungen zu vermeiden, oder ob das ein bekanntes Problem ist? Wir würden uns über eine kurze Anleitung freuen, wie wir das selbst prüfen können.
answer: Vielen Dank für die Meldung.
