Doppelte Zustellungen können manchmal durch mehrere aktive Alert-Regeln für dieselbe Bedingung entstehen, daher empfehlen wir zunächst einen Blick in die Alerting-Konfiguration unter Einstellungen > Benachrichtigungen, um überlappende Regeln zu identifizieren. Wir prüfen parallel auf unserer Seite die Zustellprotokolle für Ihren Workspace und melden uns mit weiteren Details, sobald wir die Ursache eingegrenzt haben.

subject: Request to export dashboard as PDF with charts intact
body: I'm trying to export our quarterly risk dashboard to PDF for a board meeting, but the exported file cuts off two of the four charts and the layout looks nothing like the on-screen view. This is for a fintech reporting dashboard shared across our analyst team of 56 seats. Is there a way to get a cleaner PDF export, or is this feature still limited? Would also be great to know if scheduled PDF exports are on the roadmap.
answer: Thanks for flagging this. PDF export currently has some layout limitations with multi-chart dashboards, particularly when charts exceed a certain width, which explains the cut-off panels you're seeing. We'll log this as a feature enhancement request on your account, and in the meantime a workaround is to export each chart panel individually or resize the dashboard to a single-column layout before exporting for a cleaner result.

subject: Late-arriving data in nightly pipeline sync
body: We've noticed our nightly data pipeline sync from our legal case management connector has been arriving 3-4 hours later than scheduled over the past week, landing around 6am instead of the usual 2am. This is delaying our morning reports for the legal team. Nothing in the connector status page shows an error, just longer sync times. Could you help us understand if this is a known latency issue with this connector or something specific to our pipeline configuration?
answer: Thanks for the details. We're seeing some increased processing time on connectors of this type over the past week, likely tied to a backlog on the source system side rather than an error in your pipeline itself. We'll dig into the sync logs for your specific pipeline to confirm timing and see if we can tighten the schedule window, and we'll follow up with recommendations, including whether adjusting your sync window would help avoid the morning report delay.

subject: Push-Benachrichtigungen kommen im Offline-Modus nicht an
body: Seit dem letzten App-Update bekommen mehrere Kollegen aus unserem Finance-Team keine Push-Benachrichtigungen mehr, wenn das Handy kurz offline war und später wieder online geht. Die Benachrichtigungen scheinen einfach verloren zu gehen, statt nachträglich zugestellt zu werden. Das betrifft vor allem Reisende im Energiesektor, die oft schlechten Empfang haben. Können Sie uns sagen, ob das erwartetes Verhalten ist oder ein Fehler?
answer: Danke für die Rückmeldung. Aktuell werden Push-Benachrichtigungen nicht nachträglich zugestellt, wenn ein Gerät zum Zeitpunkt des Versands offline war, das ist derzeit eine bekannte Einschränkung und kein neues Verhalten seit dem letzten Update. Wir haben Ihr Feedback zur verbesserten Offline-Zustellung an unser Produktteam weitergegeben und melden uns, sobald es dazu Neuigkeiten gibt.

subject: help
body: WE WERE CHARGED TWICE FOR OUR STARTER PLAN THIS MONTH AND ALSO GOT A CREDIT LINE ON THE INVOICE THAT DOESNT MATCH ANYTHING WE DID. INVOICE NUMBER IS INV-88214. WE HAVE 5 SEATS AND HAVE NEVER ASKED FOR A REFUND OR CREDIT. PLEASE EXPLAIN WHAT HAPPENED BEFORE WE CANCEL THIS ACCOUNT.
answer: WE UNDERSTAND THE CONCERN AND ARE LOOKING INTO INVOICE INV-88214 RIGHT AWAY TO CONFIRM WHY A DUPLICATE CHARGE AND AN UNEXPECTED CREDIT LINE APPEAR TOGETHER. WE WILL REVIEW YOUR BILLING HISTORY FOR THIS MONTH AND FOLLOW UP WITHIN ONE BUSINESS DAY WITH A CORRECTED INVOICE OR REFUND CONFIRMATION, WHICHEVER APPLIES.

subject: Users getting logged out every 15 minutes via SSO
body: Since yesterday, a growing number of our 137 users are reporting session timeouts roughly every 15 minutes when logged in through our SSO integration, forcing them to re-authenticate and sometimes complete MFA again. This started after we rotated our identity provider's signing certificate on Tuesday. Provisioning of new users still works fine, but existing sessions seem unstable. Can you confirm if the short session length is tied to the certificate change on our end or a config issue on Northwind's side?
answer: Thanks for the clear timeline, that certificate rotation is a strong lead. We'll check whether the session token validation on our side is failing to refresh correctly against the new signing certificate, which could explain the shortened effective session length. We'll also review your SSO configuration for the token lifetime settings and get back to you shortly with either a fix or next steps to resync the certificate metadata.

subject: Unsubscribe requests not being honored across email alerts
body: We have a serious problem where customers who click unsubscribe on our transactional email alerts are still receiving notifications days later. Our support team has logged at least 40 complaints since Friday from users who unsubscribed but keep getting duplicate alerts for order and payment updates. This is affecting a large portion of our 186 users who manage these notification templates. We need to know if unsubscribe status is actually being respected on your end because this is becoming a compliance risk for us.
answer: This is being treated as a priority issue given the compliance impact. We're pulling the unsubscribe event logs for your account now to check whether suppression lists are syncing correctly with the alert delivery service, since a delay or failure there would explain users still receiving alerts after opting out. We'll have an initial update for you within the hour and will keep you posted as we work through this with our notifications team.

subject: Multiple card failures blocking payment processing
body: We're seeing repeated card failures on our enterprise billing account since this morning, affecting several of the payment methods on file across our 3460 seats. Transactions are failing with a generic decline message even on cards that have processed successfully for months. This is holding up invoice payments and we need to understand if this is on Northwind's payment processor side or something with our account. Please treat this urgently as it's affecting our ability to keep the account current.
answer: We understand the urgency and have escalated this immediately to our payments team, as we're also seeing an unusual pattern of declines starting this morning that may point to an issue on the processor side rather than your cards themselves. We'll update you within the hour with findings and, if needed, will apply a temporary grace period on your account so payment processing issues don't affect service continuity while we resolve this.

subject: Plan upgrade charged wrong amount and broke seat count
body: We just tried upgrading from Starter to a higher plan for our 18 seats and got charged an amount that doesn't match any published pricing, plus our seat count now shows 0 active seats in the admin panel even though everyone can still log in. The invoice generated shows the old plan name but the new charge amount. This happened about an hour ago and we need this fixed quickly since it's blocking us from adding two new hires today.
answer: Thank you for reporting this right away, this looks like a billing sync issue during the upgrade that mismatched your plan and seat records. We're escalating to our billing engineering team now to correct the seat count and verify the correct charge amount, and we'll issue an adjustment or refund if you were overcharged. We'll follow up shortly with confirmation once your account reflects the correct plan and seat total so you can proceed with adding the new hires.

subject: MFA enrolment stuck for several analysts
body:
We're rolling out MFA for our energy reporting team at Apex Legal and four of our 14 seats are stuck on the enrolment screen. After scanning the QR code in the authenticator app, the confirmation step just spins and then returns to the setup page without saving the device. This has happened for users on both Android and iOS authenticator apps since yesterday around 9am.

Can you check if there's a provisioning issue on our tenant? We need these analysts to log in for month-end reporting.
answer: Thanks for flagging this - a stuck MFA enrolment loop usually points to a token mismatch during device registration on our end. I'm pulling the enrolment logs for your tenant now to see what's happening for the affected users and will confirm whether this is isolated to specific accounts or a broader provisioning glitch. I'll update you within a few hours with findings or a workaround so your analysts can get back into their reports.

subject: Biometric login keeps failing after app update
body:
Since updating the Northwind mobile app last week, biometric login (Face ID) fails for several of our finance team at Apex Freight. The app prompts for Face ID, accepts it, then shows a generic error and drops back to the password screen. It's inconsistent - some days it works, other days not at all, even offline.

Could we get an option to disable biometric prompts entirely until this is fixed? Right now it's slowing down approvals for our 20-seat team.
answer: Sorry for the disruption this is causing your approval workflow. Biometric fallback failures after an app update are usually tied to a cached credential token that didn't refresh properly - we'll investigate whether this is affecting your account specifically. In the meantime, you can disable biometric login under Settings > Security > Login Method and use password-only login as a workaround while we look into a permanent fix.

subject: SSO totally broken - MFA enrolment blocking THOUSANDS of employees
body:
We've been trying to get our new hires onboarded through your SSO integration for the past two weeks and honestly I don't even know where to start with how badly this has gone. Our IT team spent days configuring the SAML connection, testing with pilot groups, documenting every step for our helpdesk, only to find that MFA enrolment silently fails for any user provisioned through SCIM after the initial batch.

The actual problem: 1629 seats and roughly 400 of our retail store managers cannot complete MFA enrolment - they get 'enrollment session expired' errors even on first attempt, and no admin override exists. This is blocking store openings for the new quarter and honestly if this isn't fixed by end of week we are going to seriously reconsider our contract with Northwind.
answer: I understand the urgency and I'm sorry this has escalated to this point during your rollout. This is being treated as a P1 - I'm looping in our identity engineering team immediately to investigate the SCIM-provisioned enrolment failures, since 'enrollment session expired' on first attempt for a specific provisioning batch suggests a token TTL misconfiguration on our side. I'll have an update with either a fix or a temporary admin bypass for your store managers within the next few hours, and will keep you posted continuously until this is resolved.

subject: Duplicate email alerts going to admin team
body:
Our IT team at Harbor Robotics has been getting duplicate copies of every system alert email for the past three days - each notification arrives twice within a minute of each other, identical subject and body. This is happening for security alerts, billing notices, and API status emails alike, across all 208 seats that have alert subscriptions enabled.

We haven't changed any notification rules recently. Is this a known issue with the alerting service?
answer: Thanks for the details - duplicate alerts across multiple notification types usually indicates a retry loop in the delivery queue rather than a rules misconfiguration on your end. I'm checking our notification service logs for your tenant around the timestamps you mentioned to confirm whether this is a broader delivery issue. I'll follow up shortly with what we find and, if needed, a fix to stop the duplicate sends.

subject: Urgent: duplicate alert storm flooding finance inboxes
body:
Starting this morning our finance team at Summit Health has received duplicate alerts for every billing and invoice notification - some messages have arrived 4 to 5 times within a 10 minute window. This is across our full 273-seat account and it's causing real confusion since people are opening tickets thinking invoices failed multiple times.

We need this stopped as soon as possible since it's actively disrupting our billing reconciliation process today.
answer: This has been escalated to our on-call notifications team as a P1 given the volume and impact on your billing workflow. We're seeing this may be related to a queue processing issue causing repeated dispatch of the same alert event, and we're actively working to identify and stop the duplicate sends across affected accounts. I'll update you as soon as we have containment, and will confirm once your account's alert stream is back to normal.

subject: SDK throwing deprecation errors after upgrade
body:
We upgraded to SDK version 4.2.0 for our fintech integration at Willow Robotics and now our API calls to the /v2/transactions endpoint throw 'DeprecatedFieldError: currency_code will be removed in v3' even though we're not using that field directly - it seems to be injected by the SDK's default request builder. We're also seeing intermittent 429 rate limit responses on batch calls that worked fine on SDK 3.x.

Can you confirm if this is a known SDK bug, and what the recommended migration path is before v2 sunsets?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report - the currency_code deprecation warning being triggered by the default request builder in 4.2.0 is a known issue we're tracking, it's injecting a legacy field even when your calls don't reference it. I'll send over the workaround (explicitly setting request options to skip the legacy builder) along with our current v2-to-v3 migration guide, and flag the rate limit regression to engineering since that shouldn't be happening on equivalent call volumes.

subject: Need clarity on webhook deprecation timeline
body:
I'm helping our team at Delta Academy plan for the upcoming API changes and I noticed the deprecation notice for the legacy webhook signing method (HMAC-SHA1) but no firm sunset date listed in the docs. We rely on webhooks heavily for booking sync and want to plan the migration to the new signing method without breaking our travel integration mid-season.

Could you confirm the exact sunset date and whether there's a way to test the new signature verification in a sandbox before switching over in production?
answer: Good timing to ask - the HMAC-SHA1 webhook signing method is scheduled for sunset in 90 days, and we'll be sending a formal notice with the exact date to all accounts still using it, including yours. You can test the new signature verification now using your sandbox environment's webhook settings page, which lets you toggle between signing methods without affecting production traffic - happy to walk through the migration steps if useful.

subject: Offline mode change needed for mobile push/login flow
body:
I'm integrating the Northwind mobile SDK for Cobalt Media's logistics app and we've hit a blocker with offline mode - when a driver's device loses connectivity, push notifications queue correctly but the login session doesn't persist, forcing a re-login once connection returns. This breaks our delivery confirmation flow for our 267-seat rollout since drivers are frequently offline in warehouses.

We need the SDK to support persisted auth sessions during offline periods, similar to how push queuing already works. Is this configurable now, or can it be added?
answer: This is a fair gap to flag, and given it affects your delivery confirmation flow for the whole rollout, I'm marking it P1 and passing it to our mobile SDK team as a change request. Currently persisted auth during offline periods isn't configurable, but there's a documented workaround using local token caching with a longer refresh window that should bridge the gap - I'll send the implementation notes and keep you updated on the native fix timeline.

subject: Deprecation of legacy rate limit headers - migration question
body:
Our team at Harbor Works is reviewing the API deprecation notices and noticed the legacy X-RateLimit-* headers are marked deprecated in favor of the new RateLimit-* standard headers. We have internal monitoring built around the old header names across several healthcare integration services.

Could you confirm the timeline for removal and whether both header sets will be sent simultaneously during a transition period so we can update our monitoring without a hard cutover?
answer: Good question - both header formats (legacy X-RateLimit-* and the new standard RateLimit-*) will be sent simultaneously for the next two release cycles, so you have a safe transition window to update your monitoring before the legacy headers are removed. I'll share the exact removal date once it's finalized on our public roadmap, and flag your account so you get direct notice ahead of the cutover.

subject: Jira integration link broken - tickets not syncing
body:
Our Jira integration at Apex Systems stopped syncing tickets as of this morning - new support tickets created in Northwind aren't creating linked Jira issues anymore, and the integration status page shows 'Connection Error: token invalid' even though we haven't changed our Jira credentials. We also use Slack and Salesforce integrations which seem unaffected so far.

Can someone check the Jira connector for our account? This is blocking our ops team from tracking issues properly.
answer: Thanks for reporting this - a sudden 'token invalid' error without a credential change on your side often means the OAuth token expired or was revoked on the Jira side unexpectedly. I'm checking our integration logs for your account now to confirm the exact cause and will guide you through re-authenticating the Jira connector if that's what's needed. I'll follow up shortly with next steps to get ticket syncing restored.

subject: Bulk MFA enrolment for new travel team hires
body:
We're onboarding 12 new employees in our travel operations team this month and need to enrol them all in MFA under Northwind Identity. Is there a bulk enrolment option or a way to send enrolment invites via CSV upload instead of doing each user manually through the console? We currently have 50 seats on the Pro plan and want to make MFA mandatory for this group going forward.

Also, could you point me to documentation on setting an enforcement policy so any new user added to the 'Travel Ops' group is automatically required to enrol MFA on first login?
answer:
Thanks for reaching out. Bulk MFA enrolment is supported through our admin console's group policy feature - you can set an MFA enforcement rule on the 'Travel Ops' group so any member added to it will be prompted to enrol on next login, rather than needing individual invites. I'll send you a link to the provisioning and MFA policy documentation, which also covers the CSV-based user import if you want to add all 12 accounts at once.

Let me know once you've reviewed it and I can walk through setting the enforcement rule with you if needed.

subject: one word
body:
Users keep getting emails from lists they already unsubscribed from. We have at least 6 confirmed cases this week where the unsubscribe link was clicked and confirmed, but the same daily alert digest still arrived the next morning.

Here's the log from our webhook receiver showing the unsubscribe event followed by a duplicate send:
2024-05-02T08:14:03Z unsubscribe.confirmed user_id=48210 list=daily_alerts
2024-05-03T08:00:11Z notification.sent user_id=48210 template=daily_digest
2024-05-03T08:00:12Z notification.sent user_id=48210 template=daily_digest
2024-05-04T08:00:09Z notification.sent user_id=48210 template=daily_digest

This is generating complaints from our shop floor staff. Please advise.
answer:
Thanks for the detailed log, that's very helpful for tracking this down. It looks like the unsubscribe confirmation isn't propagating to the digest scheduler in time, which is causing the duplicate sends you're seeing for user 48210 and others. We're pulling the affected list now to identify how many accounts are impacted and will suppress further digest sends to anyone with a confirmed unsubscribe event while we fix the sync issue.

I'll update you within the day with a root cause and an ETA for the fix, and we'll confirm once all affected users have stopped receiving duplicate emails.

subject: Mapping SSO groups to application roles
body:
We're rolling out SSO across our retail locations and need our identity provider groups to map cleanly to Northwind roles. Right now our 'Store Managers' group is only getting the default viewer role after SSO login, even though we've assigned them the manager role manually in the admin panel before enabling SSO.

Can you confirm how the role mapping attribute should be configured on our side, and whether Northwind expects a specific claim name from the SAML assertion? We have 259 seats and want this working before we extend SSO to the remaining regional teams.
answer:
Thanks for the details. Role mapping for SSO logins is driven by the 'roles' claim in the SAML assertion, so if your Store Managers group is landing as viewer by default, it's likely that claim isn't populated or named differently on the IdP side. Please double check that your identity provider is sending a 'roles' attribute with a value matching one of our configured role names exactly (case-sensitive).

If that's already set up correctly, send us a sample assertion (with sensitive values redacted) and we'll check our side of the mapping configuration for your tenant.

subject: Wrong plan shown on last two invoices
body:
Our last two invoices, dated April 1 and May 1, both list us as being on a plan with 10 seats, but we only have 4 seats active on Starter. This has resulted in an overcharge of roughly $180 across the two invoices. Invoice numbers are INV-88213 and INV-89012.

We need this corrected and a refund issued for the difference. This is starting to affect our budget reporting for the quarter, so I'd appreciate a quick resolution.
answer: I'm sorry about the discrepancy on invoices INV-88213 and INV-89012 - that shouldn't be happening on a 4-seat Starter plan. I've flagged both invoices for correction and requested a refund for the overcharged difference; you should see the credit reflected within 3-5 business days. I'll also check our billing system for why the seat count on your account got mismatched, so it doesn't recur on next month's invoice.

subject: Email digests not sending to any users since this morning
body:
As of approximately 6:00 AM UTC today, none of our daily email digests have gone out to any users across our organization. We rely on these digests for compliance alerts across our legal teams, and this is a significant gap for us given our size. Checking the admin dashboard, the digest job shows status 'completed' for today's run, but no emails were actually delivered - we've confirmed zero received across multiple test accounts.

We have 588 seats and this is affecting every single user who is subscribed to a digest. Please treat this as urgent, we need digests restored today.
answer: This has been escalated to our on-call engineering team immediately given the org-wide impact. We can confirm the digest job is reporting as completed but the delivery step is failing silently for your tenant - we're investigating the mail dispatch service now and will push a fix as soon as we identify the cause. I'll update you within the hour with progress, and we'll manually trigger a resend of today's digest once the issue is resolved.

subject: Request to customize digest email frequency
body:
We'd like to change our email digest frequency from daily to weekly for our small team, and also combine the alert and activity digests into a single email if that's possible. Right now we get two separate digest emails per day which feels like overkill for only 4 users.

Could you let us know if this is configurable from our end, or if it needs to be set up by your team? Documentation on digest settings would be helpful too if it exists.
answer: Good news - you can change the digest frequency yourself under Notification Settings > Digest Preferences, where there's a dropdown for daily/weekly/monthly cadence. Combining the alert and activity digests into a single email isn't currently supported, but it's a reasonable request and I'll log it as a feature suggestion for our product team. I'll also send over a link to our digest configuration documentation for reference.

subject: Question about seat-based charge on latest invoice
body: Looking at our latest invoice, there's a line item for 3 additional seats beyond our current 18, but we haven't added any new users recently. Could you clarify what triggered this charge? I want to understand whether this was an error or if seats were added on our end that I'm not aware of.
answer: Thanks for flagging this - let me check your account's seat history to see when those 3 additional seats were added and by whom. I'll get back to you shortly with the details, and if it turns out to be an error on our end we'll issue a correction on your next invoice.

subject: Salesforce sync stopped updating contact records
body:
Our Salesforce integration has stopped syncing updated contact fields since around May 6th. New contacts still come through fine, but any edits made to existing contacts in Salesforce - like updated phone numbers or account status - aren't reflecting in Northwind anymore. We checked the integration logs and the sync job shows 'success' each run, but the field-level updates just aren't landing.

We rely on this for our travel booking workflows across 237 seats, so it's causing our agents to work from stale customer data. Can you help us figure out what changed?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. A 'success' status with stale field updates usually points to the sync job not picking up modified timestamps correctly on the Salesforce side, which can happen if a recent Salesforce API version update changed how change-tracking fields are reported. I'll have our integrations team check the sync configuration and logs on your tenant to confirm what's happening with existing contact updates, and we'll follow up with next steps once we've identified the cause.

subject: Seat count discrepancy causing billing error
body:
Our account shows 30 active seats on this month's invoice, but we've actually deprovisioned down to 24 seats as of April 15th after a team restructure. This has resulted in an overcharge for 6 seats we're no longer using. Invoice number is INV-77410.

Could you please review our seat count, correct the invoice, and process a refund for the difference? We'd also like confirmation of our current active seat count going forward so this doesn't happen again next cycle.
answer: Thanks for letting us know - I've pulled up your account and can confirm the deprovisioning from April 15th, so the 30-seat charge on INV-77410 is incorrect. I'm processing a refund for the 6 seat difference now and correcting the seat count on file to 24. You'll receive a confirmation email once the refund is issued, and I'll double check that next month's invoice reflects the correct count.

subject: Payment card repeatedly failing, need urgent help
body:
Our card on file has been declined for the last three billing attempts starting April 28th, and we just got a notice that our account is at risk of suspension. I've confirmed with our bank that the card is active and has sufficient funds, so I suspect something is wrong on the processing side. We only have 12 seats but our team depends on daily access for freight scheduling, and suspension would be a major problem for us right now.

Can someone help resolve this today and confirm our account won't be suspended while we sort it out?
answer: I understand the urgency here, and I've placed a temporary hold on any account suspension while we investigate the failed charges. Repeated declines with a confirmed active card often point to an issue with how the payment gateway is passing card details, so I'm escalating this to our payments team to check the transaction logs from April 28th onward. In the meantime, could you try re-adding the card as a fresh payment method on file, and I'll follow up as soon as we have more information.

subject: Allowlist broken
body:
Can't save workspace settings.
500 Internal Server Error
PUT /admin/workspace/settings
answer: Thanks for the quick report — I can see the 500 on that PUT call and I'm escalating this now since it affects your ability to manage the allowlist. Can you confirm the exact timestamp of your last attempt so I can pull the matching server-side trace? I'll update you within the hour with root cause.

subject: Admin console deactivating accounts on its own, allowlist not applying
body:
As of this morning our Admin Console is showing 6 user accounts as deactivated that we never touched, and none of them can log in. At the same time, the IP allowlist we configured last week under Workspace Settings isn't being enforced — people outside our office network are still getting through. The audit log shows no entries for the deactivations at all, which is a compliance problem for us.

This is blocking finance staff from closing month-end reports and our security team wants an explanation immediately. Please escalate, this is affecting the whole workspace.
answer: This has been escalated to our platform reliability team as a P0 incident. We're seeing anomalous deactivation events tied to a settings sync job that ran against your workspace around 6am UTC, and we're rolling back the affected accounts now. I'll send a status update within 30 minutes, and we'll provide a full audit log reconciliation once accounts are restored, including confirmation that the allowlist enforcement bug is fixed.

subject: question about late arrivin data in pipline
body:
hey, we noticed that some records comming from our POS feed show up in the destination table 2-3 hours after the event actualy happend. its not breaking anything but it throws off our daily reconcilation reports since some rows land after the job already ran.

is there a way to configure the pipeline to wait longer before closing a batch, or some kind of late-arrival window setting? would also be nice to have this documented somewhere, couldnt find it in the docs.
answer: Good question — Data Pipelines supports a configurable late-arrival window on the destination step; you can set a grace period (default 15 minutes) under the pipeline's Advanced Settings > Watermark Delay. For a 2-3 hour lag I'd recommend setting it to at least 4 hours to be safe. I'll also flag this to our docs team since the watermark delay setting isn't currently covered in the pipeline guide.

subject: Need to restore a bucket from backup snapshot
body: We accidentally overwrote a set of contract PDFs in our storage bucket during a batch upload script run on our end. I'd like to restore the affected bucket to the snapshot from before yesterday's 3pm upload if possible. The bucket ID is legal-docs-prod-04. Can you confirm the available backup retention window and walk me through the restore process, or trigger it on your side?
answer: We can help with this — your bucket legal-docs-prod-04 has daily snapshots retained for 30 days, so the pre-3pm snapshot from yesterday is available. I'll need written confirmation from an account admin authorizing the restore since it will overwrite current contents; once we have that we can initiate the restore, which typically completes within 1-2 hours.

subject: Storage quota exceeded, uploads failing across workspace
body: All file uploads to Storage started failing this morning with 'quota exceeded' errors for every user in our workspace, not just one team. We're well within what we expected to be using based on our last usage report, so something seems off with how the quota is being calculated. This is blocking our operations team from uploading daily field reports.
answer: I'm treating this as a P1 since it's affecting all uploads workspace-wide. We're checking whether a stale usage calculation is causing the quota to report incorrectly rather than an actual capacity issue — initial logs suggest a metering job double-counted backup snapshots against your quota. I'll have a corrected quota figure and, if confirmed, a temporary limit increase in place within the next hour.

subject: SSO role mapping broken — all users landing without permissions
body: Since this morning, every user authenticating through our SSO is being provisioned with no roles assigned, even though our SAML assertion includes the correct group attributes and the role mapping rules haven't changed. Over 270 employees are affected and none of them can access anything beyond the login screen. This is a full outage for us and needs immediate attention.
answer: This is being handled as a P0 outage. We've identified that a recent update to the SSO provisioning service is failing to parse the group attribute claim correctly, which is why roles aren't being assigned on login. We're rolling back the provisioning service now and will confirm once a test login correctly maps roles — expect an update within 20 minutes.

subject: Best way to paginate large result sets from the API
body: We're pulling booking records through the API Platform and currently using offset-based pagination, but on larger result sets (50k+ records) we're seeing inconsistent ordering and occasional duplicate rows between pages. I saw a mention of cursor-based pagination in a changelog note but couldn't find documentation on how to implement it. Could you point us to the right endpoint parameters or an example, and let us know if offset pagination is being deprecated?
answer: Cursor-based pagination is available on the /v2/bookings endpoint using the 'next_cursor' field returned in each response — passing that value as the 'cursor' query parameter avoids the ordering issues you're seeing with offset pagination. Offset pagination isn't deprecated yet but we do recommend migrating, since it will eventually be limited to smaller result sets. I'll send over a documentation link with a full example.

subject: SAML
body: Wir nutzen SAML SSO seit letztem Quartal für unsere 2000+ Mitarbeiter und hatten bisher keine Probleme. Seit dem Update letzte Woche melden einige Nutzer aus der Marketingabteilung, dass der Login sehr langsam ist. Login schlägt nach Timeout fehl.
answer: Danke für die Meldung. Wir prüfen aktuell die SAML-Antwortzeiten auf unserer Seite, da ein Timeout beim Login meist auf eine verzögerte Assertion-Verarbeitung hindeutet. Können Sie uns mitteilen, ob nur bestimmte Nutzergruppen betroffen sind oder ob es zeitlich mit dem letzten Update zusammenfällt? Wir melden uns zeitnah mit weiteren Details.

subject: Charts cut off when exporting dashboard to PDF
body: When exporting our operations dashboard to PDF, the two rightmost charts get cut off at the page edge instead of scaling to fit. This happens consistently on the 'Fleet Utilization' dashboard, both from the export button in the dashboard view and via the scheduled export we have set up weekly. Other dashboards with fewer charts export fine.
answer: Thanks for the detail — this looks like a layout scaling issue that occurs specifically with dashboards containing more than 6 charts in the PDF export renderer. As a workaround, switching the export orientation to landscape under Export Settings should fit all charts on the page. I'll log this as a bug for the export renderer and follow up once a permanent fix is scheduled.

subject: Can't unsubscribe from duplicate billing alert notifications
body: I'm receiving the same invoice-due notification twice for every billing cycle, once through email and once through the in-app alert, and I've tried unsubscribing from the email version under Notification Settings but it keeps re-enabling itself after a day or two. This has been happening for the last three billing cycles now.
answer: Sorry for the duplicate alerts — this matches a known issue where a notification preference sync job resets unsubscribed settings if a related alert rule is updated. I'm manually disabling the email channel for the invoice-due alert on your account now, and we're working on a fix so unsubscribe preferences persist correctly going forward.

subject: Scheduled syncs stuck for 3+ hours on Retail Inventory pipeline
body:
We have a scheduled sync (pipeline ID pl-8823-inv) that runs every 2 hours to pull inventory counts from our POS system into Northwind. Since yesterday around 14:00 the sync is showing 'Running' status but no data lands in the destination table. Last successful run was at 13:58 with 4,200 rows processed; the last 4 scheduled attempts since then all show over 3 hours of runtime with no completion.

Our store managers rely on this for restocking decisions across 12 locations, so this is causing real operational delays. Can someone check why the syncs are hanging instead of failing or completing?
answer:
Thanks for the detailed report - I can see pipeline pl-8823-inv on your account showing the same stalled state on our end, and we're treating this as a P1 since it affects sync completion across all your scheduled runs. I'm escalating to our data pipeline engineering team right now to check for a stuck worker or queue backlog on that pipeline.

In the meantime, I'd recommend not manually retriggering the sync to avoid duplicate rows once it clears. I'll update you within the hour with findings or a fix timeline.

subject: Slack alerts from Salesforce integration stopped firing after Okta SSO update
body:
We updated our Okta SSO configuration this morning at 9:15 AM and since then our Salesforce-to-Slack alert integration has gone silent. Normally we get instant Slack notifications in #sales-alerts whenever a deal stage changes in Salesforce, but nothing has posted since 9:20 AM despite multiple test deal updates.

The integration status page in Northwind still shows 'Connected' for both Salesforce and Slack, but no events are flowing. This is affecting all 108 seats on our workspace since the whole sales team relies on these real-time alerts. Please investigate urgently as this looks tied to the Okta change.
answer:
This has been escalated to P1 given the workspace-wide impact on your sales alerting. It does sound like the Okta SSO update may have invalidated the service token our integration uses to authenticate with Salesforce, even though the connector still shows 'Connected' on the surface. We're pulling the integration logs from 9:15 AM onward now to confirm.

We'll likely need you to re-authorize the Salesforce connection under Integrations > Salesforce once we confirm the token issue, and we'll walk you through that step by step. I'll follow up shortly with our findings.

subject: Charts rendering blank on Patient Intake dashboard after last update
body:
Since our dashboard refresh yesterday, the bar charts on our 'Patient Intake Trends' dashboard are showing completely blank panels instead of data. The underlying data table still populates correctly when I export it, so it seems isolated to the chart rendering layer. This affects 3 of our 5 charts on that dashboard, all built on the same data source.

We use this dashboard in weekly reviews with clinical leads, so I'd like this fixed or at least understood before our review this Thursday. Can you confirm if this is a known bug or something specific to our config?
answer:
Thanks for flagging this with the export comparison - that's helpful for narrowing it down. We've seen a couple of similar reports of blank chart rendering following recent dashboard updates, so this may be a broader bug rather than something specific to your configuration, but we want to confirm before ruling anything out.

I'm escalating this to our dashboards product team with your dashboard ID and screenshots would help too if you can attach them. Given your Thursday review, we'll prioritize getting you an update by tomorrow at the latest.

subject: Unable to upgrade plan - checkout fails at payment step
body:
I'm trying to upgrade our account from Starter to a higher tier to get more seats for our upcoming semester rollout, but the checkout process fails every time I reach the payment confirmation step. I get a generic 'Something went wrong processing your request' message with no further detail, and no charge appears on our card statement.

I've tried this three times today (around 10:05 AM, 10:20 AM, and 11:00 AM) using two different browsers. We need this upgrade completed before next week when our new semester users are added, so I'd appreciate a quick resolution.
answer:
Sorry for the trouble getting your upgrade through - since this is blocking your seat expansion ahead of next week's rollout, I'm marking this P1 and looking into it right away. I've pulled up your account and can see the failed checkout attempts on our side as well; this looks like it may be tied to a billing validation issue rather than your card itself.

I'm looping in our billing team to process the plan upgrade manually on our end so you're not blocked by the checkout bug, and I'll confirm once your seats and plan tier are updated, likely within the next few hours.

subject: Need clarity on upcoming webhook API deprecation before our migration
body:
We received a notice that the /v1/webhooks/events endpoint is being deprecated on March 30th, and we currently have around 40 webhook subscriptions configured across our manufacturing sites using that endpoint for inventory alerts. The deprecation notice mentions a new rate limit of 100 requests per minute on the replacement endpoint, but doesn't specify if that's per webhook or account-wide.

Could someone clarify the rate limit scope and point me to migration documentation for moving our existing subscriptions to the new endpoint? We want to avoid disruption to our production alerting before the cutover date.
answer:
Good timing on reaching out ahead of the March 30th cutover. To clarify: the 100 requests/minute rate limit on the new /v2/webhooks/events endpoint is applied per account, not per individual webhook subscription, so with 40 subscriptions you'll want to review event volume to ensure you're comfortably under that ceiling.

I'm attaching our migration guide which covers subscription re-creation and payload schema changes between v1 and v2. Given you have production alerting on the line, I'd recommend starting migration in a staging environment first if available - happy to review your subscription list with you if you'd like a second pair of eyes.

subject: PDF export missing chart formatting on shared dashboard
body:
When I export our 'Client Billing Summary' dashboard to PDF, the exported file loses all chart color coding and legends that display correctly in the browser view. This has been happening for at least the past two export attempts, on both January 28th and today. The data values themselves are correct, just the visual formatting is stripped.

This dashboard gets shared externally with clients each month, so the formatting matters for readability. Not urgent, but wanted to flag it since it's a bit inconsistent with what we see on screen.
answer:
Thanks for the detailed description and the specific dates - that helps us reproduce this. This does sound like a rendering issue specific to the PDF export engine rather than your dashboard configuration, since the on-screen view is unaffected. I've logged this with our dashboards team for investigation.

Since this isn't blocking your monthly client shares immediately, we'll treat it as a lower-priority bug fix, but I'll update this ticket once we have a timeline or workaround, such as exporting via print-to-PDF as an interim option.

subject: Need webhook retry configuration and higher rate limit for order events
body:
We're integrating Northwind's API to receive real-time order status webhooks for our logistics dashboard, but we're hitting the default rate limit of 60 requests/minute during peak shipping hours, which causes dropped events. We also noticed there's no built-in retry mechanism if our endpoint returns a temporary 503, so failed deliveries are just lost.

Could you either raise our rate limit given our order volume, or point us to documentation on configuring webhook retries? We're a small team of 4 so this is blocking our ability to reliably track shipments right now.
answer:
Thanks for the specifics on your peak-hour volume - since this is actively blocking your shipment tracking, I'm marking this P1 and looking into a rate limit increase for your account today. I'll follow up once that's adjusted along with the new limit value.

On retries: our webhook system does support automatic retry with exponential backoff for 5xx responses, but it needs to be explicitly enabled per webhook subscription in your dashboard under Webhooks > Settings. I'll send over the documentation link and can walk through the configuration with you if needed.

subject: Intermittent upload failures to Storage - need quota increase workflow
body:
Several of our team members have reported failed uploads to Storage over the past week, with the error 'Upload failed: storage quota exceeded' even though our admin dashboard shows we're at 82% of our allocated quota. This seems to happen mostly with larger files over 500MB.

Could you clarify how the quota check works, and if there's a self-service way to request a temporary quota bump before we formally upgrade? We're not blocked entirely, but it's causing friction for a few users doing backup uploads.
answer:
Thanks for the detail on the 82% figure versus the error you're seeing - that mismatch suggests the quota check may be counting in-progress or failed upload chunks against your limit rather than only completed files, which we'll verify on our end. There isn't currently a fully self-service temporary bump, but as an admin you can request one through Account Settings > Storage > Request Increase, which routes to our team for same-day review in most cases.

I'll also flag the large-file upload behavior to our storage team to check if there's a chunking issue contributing to the false quota errors.

subject: How to bulk enroll users in MFA without individual setup emails
body:
We're rolling out MFA enforcement for our 18 seats and I'd like to know if there's a way to bulk-enroll users rather than having each person go through the individual enrollment flow with a setup email. Right now it looks like each user has to click a link and scan a QR code separately, which will take a while to chase down for our small team.

Is there a bulk enrollment option, or an admin-driven way to pre-configure MFA methods for users via CSV or API? Just trying to plan the rollout timeline.
answer:
Good question - currently MFA enrollment does require each user to complete their own setup via the emailed link and QR scan, since the TOTP secret needs to be generated and confirmed on their own device for security reasons. There isn't a bulk CSV or API method to pre-configure MFA secrets on a user's behalf.

What you can do as an admin is enforce an enrollment deadline under Identity > MFA Policy, which sends automated reminder emails and restricts access after the deadline, which tends to speed up completion for smaller teams. Happy to help you configure that policy if useful.

subject: Zapier integration not passing custom fields to Jira tickets
body:
We set up a Zap that creates a Jira ticket whenever a new lead comes in through our Northwind Salesforce integration, but the custom field 'Account Tier' isn't being passed through to the Jira ticket even though it's mapped correctly in the Zap editor. Standard fields like name and email map fine, just this one custom field shows blank on the Jira side.

We've re-mapped the field twice and tested with 5 different leads, same result each time. Wondering if this is a known limitation with custom field mapping between our Salesforce connector and Zapier, or something we're missing.
answer:
Thanks for testing across multiple leads before reaching out - that rules out a one-off mapping error. Custom fields from our Salesforce connector are exposed to Zapier as a nested object rather than a flat field, which is a common cause of this exact symptom where standard fields map fine but custom ones show blank downstream.

Could you check whether 'Account Tier' appears under a nested 'custom_fields' key in the Zap's test data pane? If so, you'll need to reference it as custom_fields.account_tier in the Jira step rather than the top-level field name. Let us know what you see and we can help adjust the mapping from there.

subject: Deactivated users still showing as active in Admin Console
body:
We deactivated 14 employees who left Ember Energy this week through the Admin Console, but 6 of them are still listed as active users and one just triggered a login alert this morning. This is a real problem for us given we're in fintech and need immediate offboarding compliance. Console also feels sluggish when I try to re-run the deactivation, taking 15-20 seconds per action.

Can someone confirm whether this is a sync delay or an actual bug? We need this resolved today given the security implications.
answer: Thank you for flagging this immediately - I understand the compliance urgency here and we're treating this as P1. I've escalated to our platform team to investigate the sync between the Admin Console deactivation action and the active session store; in the meantime, can you send me the user IDs for the 6 accounts still showing active so we can force-terminate their sessions manually? We'll update you within the hour with root cause.

subject: Refund not applied as account credit for October
body:
We were issued a refund for a billing error back on Oct 3rd (invoice #INV-20481, $840.00) but it never showed up as a credit on our November invoice. Our finance team reconciled it and the balance is still off by that exact amount. I checked the billing page under Cobalt Retail's workspace and there's no record of the credit at all, just the original charge.

Could someone check why the refund didn't post correctly and apply it to our current balance?
answer: Thanks for the detailed reconciliation - that helps a lot. I can see the refund was processed on our end on Oct 3rd but it looks like it was applied to the wrong billing entity due to a mapping issue, which is why it's not reflecting on your workspace invoice. I'm correcting this now and will apply the $840.00 credit to your November balance; you should see it reflected within 24 hours and I'll confirm once it's done.

subject: Repeated transform failures on legal-docs-sync pipeline
body:
Our pipeline 'legal-docs-sync' has failed on the transform step 9 times in the last 3 days, always at the same node that flattens nested JSON fields from the intake connector. The error shown is 'TransformError: unexpected null in field case_id at row 4821'. We've verified the source data doesn't actually have nulls there, so I suspect something changed in the transform logic itself.

This is affecting downstream reporting for two client accounts at Vertex Robotics and we need it fixed or at least a workaround for tomorrow's data refresh.
answer: Thanks for the specifics - the row number and field name are very helpful for tracing this. This matches a recent connector schema update that appears to be misreading a nested array as null when the source field is empty rather than missing. I'm escalating to our pipelines team now to patch the transform logic, and in the meantime I can help you add a temporary null-coalesce step before that node so tomorrow's refresh isn't blocked - let me know if you'd like me to configure that with you.

subject: Jira integration broken - no tickets syncing since yesterday
body:
The Jira link under Integrations stopped syncing new tickets as of yesterday around 2pm. We rely on this to auto-create Jira issues from Northwind support tickets for our internal dev queue, and nothing has come through for over 18 hours despite 7 new tickets being created on our side. The integration status page still shows 'Connected' with a green check, so there's no obvious error visible to us.

We're a small team at Summit Freight and this is blocking our whole workflow right now - can someone check the connection on your end?
answer: I'm sorry for the disruption to your workflow - I've pulled the integration logs for your Jira connection and can see the OAuth token refresh started failing yesterday at 1:47pm, which is why nothing has synced since despite the green status (that's a display bug we're also fixing). I'm reauthorizing the connection now on our side and will confirm once the backlog of 7 tickets has synced through, should be within the next 30 minutes.

subject: Salesforce sync creating duplicate contact records
body:
Since last week's update to the Salesforce integration, we're seeing duplicate contact records being created every time a Northwind account is updated. We've counted at least 40 duplicates across our Blue Health Salesforce org since Tuesday. Our team has cross-checked and the duplicates all have the same external ID field, so it looks like the matching logic changed.

We also noticed the Okta-linked SSO users aren't triggering the same issue, only Salesforce ones. Could someone confirm if this is a known bug and whether there's documentation on how matching is supposed to work now?
answer: Thank you for the detailed breakdown, especially noting the Okta vs Salesforce distinction - that's a useful clue. This matches a bug introduced in last week's connector release where the external ID matching started comparing against a stale cache instead of the live record, causing false negatives and duplicate creation. I'm opening an internal bug ticket now and will follow up with a fix timeline; in the meantime I'd recommend pausing the Salesforce sync job to avoid further duplicates, and I can send you a script to help de-duplicate the 40 existing records.

subject: Wrong seat count on invoice - overcharged for 292 seats
body:
Our latest invoice bills us for 292 seats but we reduced our headcount to 260 seats back on Nov 1st through the admin panel, which I confirmed was accepted at the time. This is a significant overcharge and we need it corrected before the payment processes on the 15th. I've attached nothing here but can send screenshots of the seat change confirmation if needed.

Please escalate this - Pioneer Capital's finance team is asking me for an explanation and I don't have one yet.
answer: I understand the urgency with your payment date approaching, and I've escalated this to our billing team right away. I can confirm on our end that the seat reduction to 260 was logged on Nov 1st but the invoice generation job ran against a stale seat count before that change propagated - this is a known sync timing issue we're correcting. I'm issuing a corrected invoice now reflecting 260 seats and will make sure it replaces the current one before the 15th.

subject: Feature request: custom Slack alert templates for API webhooks
body:
I'm setting up Slack alerts through the Integrations panel to notify our team when specific API webhook events fire, but right now the alert format is fixed and just dumps the raw payload into the channel. It would be great to have a way to customize the message template, similar to how Jira integration lets you map fields.

Not urgent, just wanted to flag this as feedback while I'm building out our Summit Retail alerting setup - is this on the roadmap at all?
answer: Thanks for the feedback and for the comparison to the Jira field mapping - that's a great reference point. Custom Slack message templates aren't available yet, but I've logged this as a feature request with our integrations team, and this kind of format flexibility does come up often enough that it's under consideration for a future release. I'll follow up here if it gets scheduled, and in the meantime I can share a workaround using a lightweight relay function if that would help your current setup.

subject: Need to change dashboard sharing permissions for finance team
body:
I need to update sharing permissions on our 'Q4 Revenue Overview' dashboard so that only the finance team (5 users) can view it, instead of the whole Willow Travel workspace which currently has view access. Right now I can only find an option to share with 'everyone' or specific individuals one at a time, which isn't practical for a growing team.

Is there a way to create a group-based sharing rule, or do I need to add each person manually every time? Also curious if this affects dashboard load performance with fewer viewers.
answer: Good question, and this is a common request - currently dashboard sharing is per-individual or workspace-wide, but we do support creating a saved viewer group that you can reuse across dashboards without adding people one by one each time. I can walk you through setting up a 'Finance' group for those 5 users right now if that works, and to your other question, viewer count doesn't meaningfully affect load performance since that's driven by the underlying chart query, not sharing scope.

subject: Deactivated users retain API access - urgent security concern
body:
We deactivated 3 user accounts through the Admin Console yesterday after an internal security review, but API tokens tied to those accounts are still authenticating successfully against our endpoints. I tested this directly - one of the deactivated accounts, user ID usr_88213, still returned a valid 200 response on a GET request to our /v1/reports endpoint at 9:14am today.

Given Orion Capital is in manufacturing with active vendor integrations, this is a serious exposure. We need documentation on whether deactivation is supposed to revoke API tokens automatically, and if not, how to force revocation.
answer: Thank you for testing this directly and providing the user ID and endpoint - that's extremely helpful and I'm treating this as P1 given the security exposure. Deactivation is supposed to immediately revoke associated API tokens, so this looks like a bug in the token revocation step rather than expected behavior; I've escalated to our security engineering team to force-revoke tokens for usr_88213 and the other two accounts right now. I'll follow up with root cause and documentation on the intended deactivation flow as soon as we confirm the fix.

subject: All file uploads failing since this morning
body:
Every file upload to Storage has been failing since around 8am today, we cant get any backups through and this is urgent since were on a tight budget and cant lose data. Here is the error we keep getting:

```
UploadError: quota exceeded for workspace ws_cr0192
HTTP 507 Insufficient Storage
retry_after: 3600
request_id: req_f83a1c9e
```

We checked our usage dashboard and it shows we're only at 62% of our storage quota, so this error doesnt make sense. This is blocking our daily backup job for Cobalt Robotics and we need this fixed today.
answer: Thank you for including the request ID, that lets us trace this precisely - I can see the discrepancy you're describing between the 507 error and your actual usage at 62% of quota, which points to a quota calculation bug rather than a real capacity issue. I'm escalating this to our storage team now to get your workspace's quota recalculated and uploads unblocked, and I'll update you as soon as it's resolved, expecting this within the next couple of hours given the impact to your backup job.

subject: URGENT: Deactivated employees still accessing systems
body: Yesterday at 4:15 PM we deactivated 14 user accounts through the Admin Console after our security team flagged them as part of a compromised credential incident. This morning our access logs show at least 3 of those accounts logged into the billing dashboard and one hit our API endpoints at 6:40 AM today. With 3249 seats on this account, we need confirmation that deactivation is actually revoking sessions and API tokens, not just disabling login. This looks like an active breach and we need it fixed now.
answer: This has been escalated to our security incident team immediately and treated as a P0. We are pulling session and token logs for the 14 accounts you listed to confirm whether deactivation is failing to revoke active tokens, and we are force-terminating all sessions for those users right now as a containment step. We will update you within the hour with root cause and confirmation that no further access is possible.

subject: SAML login broken for all users after IdP update
body: We updated our IdP metadata yesterday and now none of our 80 users can log in via SAML SSO into Northwind. The login redirect completes but Northwind returns 'Authentication failed: assertion signature validation error' before reaching MFA. This is blocking every user from accessing the platform since this morning. Can someone check our SP metadata configuration against the new IdP cert we uploaded?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report - this is affecting all users so we're treating it as P1. Signature validation errors after an IdP metadata change usually mean the SP-side certificate hasn't picked up the new signing cert yet; we're pulling your tenant's SAML config now to check the cert fingerprint against what your IdP is presenting. We'll follow up shortly with either a fix or specific steps to re-upload the metadata correctly.

subject: Offline mode not saving data on mobile app
body: Our field team uses the mobile app in areas with no signal, and we noticed that entries made while offline aren't syncing once connection returns - they just disappear from the queue. This has happened a handful of times over the past two weeks with our 14 users. Would also be great to get a status indicator showing pending offline items, since right now there's no way to tell if something is waiting to sync.
answer: Thanks for flagging this - losing queued offline entries is definitely not expected behavior. Could you send us the device model, app version, and roughly when one of these disappearing entries happened so we can trace it in the sync logs? We'll also pass along the request for a pending-sync indicator to our product team as a feature suggestion.

subject: Mobile app crashes immediately on launch after latest update
body: Since updating to the newest app version this morning, the app crashes within a second of opening on every device we've tested - three different Android phones. It gets past the splash screen and then closes immediately, before the login screen even appears. This is blocking our whole team of 13 from using the app for dispatch tracking during active trips.
answer: We're sorry for the disruption - this is now our top priority given it's blocking your entire team. Can you confirm the exact app version number and Android OS versions on the affected devices? We've seen one other report of a crash-on-launch tied to a push notification service initialization bug in the latest build, and we're pushing a hotfix candidate now; we'll update you as soon as it's available.

subject: Speicherkontingent falsch berechnet nach Backup
body: Uns wird seit gestern ein Speicherkontingent von 98% angezeigt, obwohl wir laut unserer eigenen Berechnung deutlich unter 70% liegen sollten. Wir haben vor drei Tagen ein automatisches Backup mit rund 40 GB durchgeführt und vermuten, dass alte Backup-Versionen nicht korrekt gelöscht wurden, obwohl unsere Aufbewahrungsrichtlinie auf 30 Tage eingestellt ist. Bei 285 Nutzern können wir es uns nicht leisten, dass Uploads bald blockiert werden.
answer: Danke für die genaue Beschreibung. Das klingt nach einem Fehler bei der automatischen Bereinigung alter Backup-Versionen gemäß Ihrer Aufbewahrungsrichtlinie. Wir prüfen jetzt die Speichernutzung Ihres Kontos im Detail und schauen, ob abgelaufene Backups fälschlicherweise noch mitgezählt werden. Wir melden uns kurzfristig mit einer Korrektur bzw. einer aktualisierten Kontingentanzeige.

subject: Question about upload retry behavior and storage tier documentation
body: I've been seeing intermittent upload failures on files over 500MB - roughly 1 in 10 large uploads times out and I have to retry manually. Before I file this as a bug, I wanted to ask if there's documentation on the automatic retry logic and whether upgrading to a higher storage tier changes timeout thresholds. We're evaluating whether to adjust our data pipeline batch sizes or just wait for a plan change.
answer: Good question - large file uploads currently rely on client-side retry rather than automatic server-side retry, which is likely why you're seeing manual retries needed. Storage tier changes don't affect timeout thresholds directly, but we do have documentation on recommended chunking for files over 250MB that should reduce failure rates significantly. I'll send that link over and loop in our renewals team since you mentioned considering a plan change.

subject: Need SSO session timeout extended for our workspace
body: Our users keep getting logged out of Northwind every 30 minutes even when actively working, which is disruptive given we're a small team of 4 relying on the dashboard throughout the day. Is there a setting to extend session timeout for SSO logins, or is this hardcoded per plan? We'd also appreciate documentation on how session length interacts with our MFA policy if we enable it later.
answer: Session timeout length is configurable per workspace rather than hardcoded, so we can help adjust this for you. Could you let us know your preferred session duration - we typically recommend something between 2 and 8 hours for active-use teams? We'll also send over documentation covering how session timeout settings interact with MFA enforcement so you have that ready when you enable it.

subject: Users can't unsubscribe - getting error instead
body:
Multiple users are reporting they can't unsubscribe from our weekly digest notifications. When they click the unsubscribe link in the email, they get this error on the page:

UnsubscribeError: token validation failed
  at validateUnsubscribeToken (notif-service.js:214)
  at handleUnsubscribeRequest (notif-service.js:88)
  at Router.handle (router.js:142)
Status: 400 Bad Request

We have 243 seats and this is generating a steady stream of complaints since Tuesday. Users are now just marking emails as spam instead, which is worse for us long term.
answer: Thank you for including the error trace - that's very helpful. A token validation failure like this usually points to an expired or malformed unsubscribe token, possibly from a recent notification template update on our end. We're escalating this as P1 given the spam-complaint risk you flagged, and we'll investigate the token generation logic and get back to you today with either a fix or a manual unsubscribe workaround for affected users.

subject: SAML login intermittently failing for some staff
body: Since Monday, about a third of our 34 users get an 'invalid SAML response' error when logging in through our IdP, while the rest log in fine. It seems random - the same user can fail once and succeed on a retry a few minutes later. We haven't changed our IdP configuration recently on our end. Could this be related to clock skew or certificate rotation on Northwind's side?
answer: Intermittent failures like this are often tied to clock skew tolerance or a certificate that's approaching rotation, so you're on the right track. We're checking our SAML service logs for the affected login attempts around the times you described to see if there's a pattern with specific IdP responses or timestamps. We'll follow up with findings and, if needed, adjust the clock skew tolerance on our end.

subject: Critical alerts being routed to wrong notification channel
body: We've noticed over the past two days that several critical system alerts that should go to our on-call email distribution are instead showing up only in the dashboard notification feed, which our on-call team doesn't monitor closely. This delayed our response to an API outage yesterday by nearly 40 minutes. With 2202 seats and multiple teams depending on correct alert routing, this needs to be looked at soon - can you check if our routing rules got reset or overwritten?
answer: This is a serious gap given how it affected your incident response time, so we're prioritizing this as P2 and looking into it now. We're reviewing your notification routing configuration to check whether the rules for critical alerts were altered or reset, possibly during a recent settings sync. We'll confirm the root cause and restore correct routing as quickly as possible, and let you know what changed.

subject: Offline mode not syncing after reconnect
body:
We have several field staff at Orion Academy using the mobile app in areas with no signal. When they reconnect after being offline for a few hours, the app sometimes shows a login prompt again and any notes entered offline seem to vanish instead of syncing. This has happened on at least 3 devices this week, all running the latest app version 4.12.1 on Android 13.

Can you confirm whether offline entries are cached locally before sync, and if there's a way to recover the lost notes?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. Offline entries are cached locally in an encrypted store before sync, so they shouldn't be lost outright, but a forced re-login can sometimes clear that cache if the session token expired while offline. Could you send us the device logs from one of the affected phones (Settings > Diagnostics > Export Log) so we can check whether the sync completed before the login prompt appeared? We'll also check for any known issue with token expiry during extended offline periods.

subject: App crashes immediately on launch after update
body:
Since the mobile app updated to version 5.3 on our managed devices, it crashes within a second of opening for a growing number of employees across our travel desks. I'm not technical but I've had at least 15 staff report this to me directly since Tuesday, and it's affecting expense approvals that need to go through the app.

Is there a way to roll back to the previous version while a fix is worked on, or a config change we can push out?
answer: Thank you for flagging this - we're aware of a crash-on-launch issue tied to version 5.3 on certain device configurations and are actively working on a patch. In the meantime, we recommend rolling back to version 5.2 through your MDM if possible, which should restore normal function. We'll follow up as soon as the fix is available and let you know the expected timeline.

subject: Shared dashboards showing 'access denied' for entire finance team
body:
As of this morning, every dashboard I previously shared with our finance team at Delta Partners is returning 'You don't have permission to view this dashboard' for all 18 members, even those who had edit access. This is blocking our month-end reporting review scheduled for today. Nothing changed on our side - no permission edits were made since last Friday.

We need this resolved urgently as the executive review meeting is in a few hours.
answer: We understand the urgency and have escalated this to our engineering team immediately given the impact on your reporting deadline. This matches a permissions sync issue we're actively investigating that appears to have affected sharing rules for several accounts overnight. We'll update you within the hour with either a fix or a workaround so your team can regain access before the meeting.

subject: Repeated card declines on monthly invoice
body:
Our monthly billing charge for Ember Systems has failed three times now - on the 3rd, 5th, and 7th of this month - with the message 'card declined by issuer.' We've confirmed with our bank that the card is active and has sufficient funds, so I suspect something on Northwind's end. Our account currently shows past due and I'm concerned about service interruption for our 22 seats.

Can you check what's causing the decline and let us know if we need to update payment details manually?
answer: Sorry for the trouble this has caused - a card decline that persists despite the bank confirming funds usually points to a mismatch in billing details on file, such as an outdated expiration date or zip code. Could you update the card details directly in Billing Settings and attempt the charge again? I'll also flag your account internally to prevent any suspension while we sort this out.

subject: Urgent: need to restore storage data from backup after accidental deletion
body:
One of our administrators accidentally deleted a shared folder containing production QA reports for Granite Works yesterday around 4pm, affecting roughly 340 files. We need to restore from the most recent backup snapshot before this becomes a compliance issue, since these reports are tied to an ISO audit due next week.

Our retention policy shows 30-day backups, so I'd expect a restore point from earlier this week to be available. Please advise on next steps as soon as possible.
answer: This has been escalated to our Security and Compliance team as a priority given the audit timeline. We can confirm backup snapshots exist for the affected folder, and we're preparing a restore to a recovery location so you can verify the files before we overwrite anything live. We'll be in touch within the next couple of hours with a restore point and confirmation steps.

subject: Users receiving duplicate email digests every day
body:
Since Monday, our team at Blue Systems has been getting the daily notification digest emailed twice within a few minutes of each other, every single day. This is happening for all 114 seats, not just a few users, and it's causing confusion since some think it means something changed twice. Digest settings haven't been touched on our end recently.

Can you check the notification pipeline for duplicate sends? This needs to stop before tomorrow's digest goes out.
answer: Thanks for the clear report - this matches a duplicate-trigger issue we're currently investigating in the digest scheduler that appears to affect a subset of workspaces. We're treating this as high priority and are working to disable the duplicate send before the next scheduled digest. We'll confirm once the fix is deployed and monitor tomorrow's send to make sure only one copy goes out.

subject: Frage zur Aufbewahrungsfrist von Speicherdaten
body: Wir möchten wissen, wie lange gelöschte Dateien im Storage-Bereich für Delta Academy tatsächlich aufbewahrt werden, bevor sie endgültig entfernt werden. In der Dokumentation steht 14 Tage, aber ein Kollege konnte eine vor 10 Tagen gelöschte Datei nicht mehr wiederherstellen. Können Sie das bitte klären, da wir unsere internen Richtlinien entsprechend anpassen müssen?
answer: Vielen Dank für Ihre Anfrage. Die Standardaufbewahrungsfrist für gelöschte Dateien im Starter-Plan beträgt tatsächlich 14 Tage, es kann jedoch vorkommen, dass Dateien aus bestimmten geteilten Ordnern kürzeren Regeln unterliegen. Wir prüfen den betroffenen Fall genauer und melden uns mit einer genauen Erklärung, warum die Datei nicht mehr wiederherstellbar war.

subject: PDF export broken
body: Charts cut off mid-page every time, blocking our client reports.
answer: Thanks for flagging this - we're prioritizing this given the impact on client deliverables. Could you share a sample dashboard link and the browser/version you're exporting from so we can reproduce the cutoff and get a fix out quickly?

subject: Biometric login locking users out of mobile app
body:
Starting this morning, biometric login (Face ID) on the mobile app is failing for a large number of our finance staff at Orion Capital, throwing them back to the password screen repeatedly and then locking the account after 3 failed attempts. This is affecting approvals that require mobile sign-off and we've had at least 40 lockouts reported in the last two hours.

We need this escalated immediately as it's blocking time-sensitive approval workflows across our manufacturing division.
answer: This has been escalated to our mobile platform team as a P1 given the scale of impact. We're seeing reports consistent with a biometric token validation issue introduced in a recent backend update and are working on an immediate fix. In the meantime, please advise affected users to log in with password only and avoid repeated biometric attempts to prevent further lockouts - we'll update you within the hour.

subject: Connector authentication expired, sync failing daily
body: The connector we use to pull data from our ERP system into Data Pipelines at Ember Analytics has been failing every sync since Tuesday, with the log showing 'auth token expired, refresh failed.' We haven't changed any credentials on our end. Could you walk us through the correct steps to re-authenticate the connector without breaking our existing pipeline mappings?
answer: Thanks for the detail - an expired refresh token usually needs to be re-authorized manually through the connector settings page rather than automatically renewing. I'll send over a step-by-step guide for re-authenticating without affecting your existing field mappings, and we'll verify the next sync completes cleanly once you've reconnected.

subject: Push notifications not reaching devices after offline period
body:
We're seeing an issue across our fleet of managed iOS and Android devices where push notifications stop arriving after a device has been offline for more than a few hours. Users have to fully log out and log back in to the Northwind Mobile App before notifications start working again. This has been happening since around March 4th and we've confirmed it on both platforms with at least 40 test devices in our IT lab.

Can you tell us whether this is related to token refresh on reconnect, or something on the APNs/FCM side? We'd like a fix that doesn't require re-login since that's disruptive for clinical staff.
answer:
Thanks for the detailed report and for testing across both platforms. This does sound like the push token isn't being refreshed correctly when the app regains connectivity after an extended offline period, rather than an issue with re-login itself. I'm escalating this to our mobile engineering team with your device counts and the March 4th onset date, and I'll ask them to check the token refresh logic on reconnect for both APNs and FCM paths.

In the meantime, could you send us the device OS versions and app build number you're testing with? That will help us reproduce the issue faster. We'll follow up within one business day with findings or a workaround.

subject: Weird push notification bug when phone was offline
body:
One of our editors noticed that after her phone was in airplane mode overnight, she logged into the Mobile App the next morning and got a flood of duplicate push notifications from the previous day all at once. It only happened once so far and we haven't been able to reproduce it since, but wanted to flag it in case it's a known issue.

Not urgent since it was just one user, but curious if this is something you've seen before.
answer:
