Thanks for flagging this - it's helpful even as a one-off report. This can happen when queued notifications are delivered in a batch after reconnecting, and in some cases the delivery dedup logic doesn't catch all duplicates if the offline window was long enough. We'll note this in our tracking for the push notification queue behavior.

If you see it recur or affect more users, please let us know the device model and app version so we can dig deeper, but for now no action is needed on your end.

subject: Shared dashboards showing 'access denied' for view-only users
body:
We have several dashboards shared with view-only permissions to our compliance team, but as of this week those users are getting 'Access Denied - insufficient permissions' when clicking the shared link, even though the sharing settings still show them listed as viewers. This started after we reorganized our workspace folders on Tuesday.

We rely on these shared dashboards for our weekly risk review meeting tomorrow, so we need this resolved before then. Can you check if the folder reorg broke the permission inheritance?
answer:
Thank you for the details, especially the timing around the folder reorg - that's a strong lead. Moving dashboards between folders can sometimes reset inherited sharing permissions if the destination folder has different default access rules, which would explain the sudden access denials for your compliance team.

I'm looking into your workspace now to check the permission inheritance on the affected dashboards and will re-apply the correct viewer access ahead of your review meeting tomorrow. I'll update you here as soon as it's fixed, and let you know if we need to adjust the folder-level defaults to prevent this from recurring.

subject: Transform step failing intermittently on inventory sync pipeline
body:
Our inventory sync pipeline has been failing at the transform stage roughly 2-3 times a day over the past week, always with the same error: 'Transform failed: field mapping mismatch on column sku_variant'. The connector pulls from our retail POS system and writes to our warehouse table. Re-running the pipeline manually usually succeeds on the second attempt, but this is adding manual overhead for our data team.

Could you help us understand why the mapping check is inconsistent, and whether there's documentation on how the transform validates schema changes from source connectors? We'd like to fix this permanently rather than keep re-running jobs.
answer:
Thanks for the clear description and the specific error message - that helps a lot. Intermittent field mapping mismatches on retries usually point to the source connector delivering slightly inconsistent schemas between sync runs, often when a nullable column occasionally arrives empty or with a different type. We'll review the transform validation logic against your connector's recent sync logs to see what's triggering the mismatch.

In the meantime, I'll send you our documentation on schema drift handling for transforms, which covers how to set tolerant mapping rules for fields like sku_variant. We'll also check if there's a pattern tied to specific sync times that might indicate a source-side issue.

subject: URGENT: IP allowlist change locked out multiple admin accounts
body:
We updated our IP allowlist in the Admin Console this morning to add our new VPN egress ranges, and immediately afterward several of our security team admins were locked out with 'Access blocked: IP not permitted' errors, even though the new ranges were entered correctly per our audit log. We need to restore access urgently since this is affecting our ability to review today's security alerts.

Our audit log shows the change was applied at 09:14 UTC. Can someone confirm whether allowlist changes require a propagation delay, or if there's a rollback we can trigger immediately?
answer:
I understand the urgency and I'm treating this as a priority incident right now. Allowlist changes can occasionally take a few minutes to propagate across all edge nodes, but if it's been longer than that, the more likely cause is a formatting issue in one of the new CIDR ranges that's rejecting the entire updated list. I'm pulling up your audit log entry from 09:14 UTC now to check the exact ranges submitted.

As an immediate step, I can revert the allowlist to the previous known-good configuration from our side to restore access while we investigate the new ranges - please confirm and I'll do that within the next few minutes.

subject: URGENT - files disappeared, retention policy may have deleted them early
body:
We just discovered that a batch of uploaded files from February that we needed for a client audit are gone from our Storage bucket. We had assumed our retention policy was set to 180 days, but it looks like they were purged after only 30 days. This is a serious problem because we cannot produce these files for tomorrow's audit deadline.

Can someone check immediately if these files are recoverable from backup, and confirm what our actual retention setting was configured as? Bucket name is willow-works-media-prod, files were uploaded between Feb 3-10.
answer:
I'm escalating this immediately as a critical data recovery incident given your audit deadline. I've flagged your bucket willow-works-media-prod and the Feb 3-10 upload window to our storage team to check backup snapshots and confirm the actual retention configuration versus what was expected - we take data loss reports extremely seriously and are treating this as top priority.

I'll be back in touch within the hour with what we find in backups and the exact retention policy history for your account, so we can determine what's recoverable before your deadline. Please stand by and let us know your most urgent time constraint so we can prioritize accordingly.

subject: Unsubscribe link in email notifications not working correctly
body:
We've had several customers report that clicking the unsubscribe link in our transactional email notifications sends them to a page saying 'Preferences updated' but they continue receiving the same notification category afterward. We tested this ourselves with two internal test accounts and confirmed the same behavior - the unsubscribe confirms but the notification setting doesn't actually change on the backend.

This is starting to generate complaints since we're a fintech company and unwanted emails are a compliance concern for us. Can you look into why the unsubscribe action isn't persisting the preference change?
answer:
Thank you for testing this yourselves and confirming it with internal accounts - that's very helpful for narrowing this down. It sounds like the unsubscribe confirmation page is rendering successfully but the underlying preference update isn't being committed, which points to an issue in how the notification service processes that request rather than the email template itself.

Given the compliance sensitivity you mentioned, I'm prioritizing this for our notifications team to investigate today. We'll check the preference update logs for your account's recent unsubscribe attempts and confirm whether this is affecting all notification categories or a specific one, and get back to you with a fix timeline shortly.

subject: Need help mapping SAML groups to correct roles after SSO migration
body:
We recently migrated our SSO configuration to a new SAML provider and now our group-to-role mappings aren't translating correctly. Users in our 'RetailOps-Managers' group are being provisioned with the default 'Viewer' role instead of 'Manager', which is blocking about 200 employees from their normal dashboard and admin access. We need to reconfigure the role mapping rules but the current documentation doesn't clearly explain how attribute assertions map to Northwind roles after a provider change.

Could someone walk us through the correct SAML attribute configuration, or review our current mapping setup directly? This is affecting daily operations for a large part of our retail management team.
answer:
Thanks for the clear breakdown of the impact - 200 users stuck on Viewer role is a significant operational issue, so I'm prioritizing this for our identity team today. This is a common gap after a SAML provider switch, usually because the group attribute name or format sent in the assertion differs from what our role mapping rules expect.

Could you share your current SAML attribute mapping configuration and a sample assertion (with values redacted) for one affected user? That will let us pinpoint the mismatch quickly. We'll also send over our updated role-mapping guide for multi-provider migrations so your team has a clearer reference going forward.

subject: Finance team receiving duplicate billing alert emails, sometimes 4-5 copies
body:
Our finance team has been getting duplicate copies of the same billing threshold alert emails for the past three days - some team members reported receiving the identical alert 4 to 5 times within a couple of minutes, all with the same timestamp and alert ID. This is causing confusion about whether multiple thresholds were actually triggered or if it's just a notification bug.

We rely on these alerts for real-time budget monitoring across our retail divisions, so the duplication is making it hard to trust the alerting system right now. Can you confirm if this is a known issue with the alert delivery pipeline?
answer:
Thank you for including the alert ID and timestamp detail - that confirms this is a delivery duplication issue rather than multiple genuine threshold triggers, which is good news for your budget monitoring accuracy. I'm escalating this to our notifications team right now given the impact on your finance team's trust in the alerts, and we'll check the alert delivery pipeline for retry or fanout logic that could be resending the same alert ID multiple times.

We'll have an update for you within a few hours on the root cause, and in the meantime please let us know if the duplication rate changes or if it starts affecting other alert types.

subject: Duplicate email notifications being sent for same alert events
body:
We've noticed that our system is sending out duplicate copies of alerting emails to end users, typically 2 identical emails per triggered event, arriving a few seconds apart. This has been happening intermittently since last week and we've confirmed it's not a client-side email rendering issue since the message IDs in the headers are actually different for each duplicate.

Is there a known issue with the notification delivery retry logic that could cause this? We'd like to understand root cause before our users start complaining more broadly.
answer:
Thanks for checking the message IDs and headers before reaching out - that rules out a client-side rendering issue and tells us the notification service is genuinely generating two separate sends per event. This pattern is consistent with a delivery retry firing even when the first send succeeded, rather than a true send failure triggering the retry.

We're reviewing the retry and acknowledgment logic in the alerting pipeline for your account now and will document the specific trigger condition once found. I'll update this ticket with findings and an estimated fix timeline, and will also let you know if there's a temporary mitigation we can apply on our end while the root cause is resolved.

subject: Push notifications delayed on Android after app resumes from background
body: I'm seeing an issue where push notifications for our Mobile App take 5-10 minutes to appear after a device wakes up from sleep on Android 13. On iOS the delay is much shorter, usually under 30 seconds. We noticed this while testing our weekly report alerts sent to 14 users on our team. Is there a known issue with Android background restrictions affecting delivery timing?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. This is a known behavior on some Android 13 devices where aggressive battery optimization can delay FCM delivery until the OS wakes the app process. Could you confirm whether the affected devices have battery optimization enabled for the app? In the meantime, we recommend guiding users to whitelist the app under battery settings, and we'll look into whether we can tune notification priority flags on our end to reduce delay.

subject: Late-arriving events causing gaps in daily aggregation pipeline
body: We're integrating with the Data Pipelines API to sync transaction events from our payment processor. Since October 3rd we've noticed events arriving 20-40 minutes after their timestamp, which is after our daily aggregation job at 02:00 UTC has already run. This is causing our reconciliation reports to be missing roughly 200-500 records per day. Is there a way to configure a watermark or delay buffer on the ingestion side so late events get included in the next run instead of being dropped?
answer: Thanks for flagging this — late-arriving data affecting reconciliation is high priority for us. Currently the pipeline doesn't auto-buffer for late events, but you can set a lateness window under Pipeline Settings > Windowing which will hold aggregation until the specified delay has passed. We'd suggest starting with a 45-minute window given what you're seeing, and we'll also check on our end why ingestion latency increased starting October 3rd.

subject: Connector delays causing incorrect month-end financial totals
body: Our finance team relies on the Data Pipelines connector pulling from our banking data source, and for the past week the data has been arriving 2-3 hours late compared to normal. This caused our month-end close report on the 1st to show incomplete totals for several accounts, off by what looks like 6 figures in transaction volume. We need to understand if this is a known sync issue with the connector or something on our source system's side.
answer: We're sorry for the disruption this caused to your month-end close. We've confirmed there was elevated latency on the banking connector cluster starting last week, and our engineering team is actively working to restore normal sync intervals. We'll follow up with a root cause summary once resolved, and in the meantime we recommend re-running the affected sync manually from the connector dashboard to pull the latest completed data.

subject: Storage quota exceeded, backups failing since this morning
body: Our Storage quota alert triggered at 6:40 AM today and since then our nightly backup jobs have been failing with a quota exceeded error. We only have 4 seats on the Starter plan and didn't expect to hit limits this fast, we're at 98GB of what I believe is a 100GB allocation. This is blocking our disaster recovery backups from completing, and we need either a temporary quota increase or guidance on what to purge to get backups running again today.
answer: Thanks for the urgent report — we're escalating this now since it's actively blocking your backups. We've applied a temporary quota increase of 20GB to your account to unblock backup jobs while you review retention settings. In parallel, please check Storage > Retention Policy, as old backup snapshots older than 30 days may be consuming a large share of your quota; we can also help you set an automated cleanup rule if that's useful.

subject: Request to route critical alerts to a dedicated on-call channel
body: We'd like to set up alert routing so that critical severity notifications from Northwind go to a dedicated on-call email distribution list instead of the general team inbox we currently use. Right now all alerts land in one shared inbox and we've had a few duplicate escalations because multiple engineers respond to the same alert. Can you point us to how to configure routing rules based on severity within Notifications settings?
answer: Good news, this is doable within the Notifications settings under Routing Rules, where you can create a rule that filters by severity tag and sends matching alerts to a separate distribution address. We'll send over a short guide on setting up the rule and suppressing duplicate escalations by enabling the dedupe window option, which should help reduce the double-response issue you described.

subject: Need offline queueing for push notifications plus crash fix on login screen
body: We'd like to request a change to how the Mobile App handles push notifications when a device is offline — right now notifications sent while a user is offline seem to be dropped instead of queued for delivery when connectivity returns. Separately, we've had two reports this week of the app crashing on the login screen right after a push notification banner is tapped while the user isn't authenticated. Both issues are affecting our field staff who often work in low-connectivity areas.
answer: Thanks for the detailed writeup, both issues are worth tracking closely. We've logged a feature request for offline push queueing and will update you on feasibility and timeline. For the login screen crash, that sounds like a bug where tapping a notification bypasses the auth check — could you share device models and app version so our mobile team can reproduce it and get a fix prioritized?

subject: Zapier integration failing to trigger Slack and Jira actions
body: Since yesterday afternoon our Zapier integration connected to Northwind has stopped triggering downstream actions in Slack and Jira. We use it to auto-create Jira tickets and post Slack alerts whenever a new record is flagged in our workflow, and normally this fires within seconds. Now zaps are showing as 'success' in Zapier's history but nothing appears in either Slack or Jira, and we've had zero notifications go through since around 3 PM yesterday.
answer: Thanks for reporting this — we're treating it as an active incident given the full stop in downstream delivery. We've confirmed a webhook payload formatting issue introduced in yesterday's release that's affecting the Zapier trigger integration for Slack and Jira actions specifically. Our team is deploying a fix now and we'll update this ticket as soon as delivery is restored, likely within the next couple of hours.

subject: Audit log missing deactivation events for allowlisted admin accounts
body: As workspace admin I rely on the Admin Console audit log to track all account deactivations across our organization of 1598 seats. Since last week, deactivation events for accounts on our IP allowlist are not appearing in the audit log at all, even though the deactivations themselves succeeded. This is a compliance concern for us given our education sector requirements, and we need to know if there's a filtering bug affecting allowlisted accounts specifically.
answer: This is a serious issue and we're escalating it immediately given the compliance implications. We've reproduced the problem on our side and confirmed that a recent audit log filtering update incorrectly excludes events tied to allowlisted IP ranges, including deactivations. Our engineering team is prioritizing a fix, and we'll provide you with a backfilled audit report for the affected period once the underlying data is corrected.

subject: Duplicate email digests being sent twice daily
body: Our team has been receiving two copies of the same daily email digest from Notifications every morning for the past four days, both with identical content and timestamps a few minutes apart. We have 24 seats and this is happening for every user subscribed to the digest, not just a few accounts. It's causing confusion and some users have already flagged it as spam-like behavior. Can you help identify why digests are duplicating?
answer: Thanks for the report, and sorry for the inbox clutter this is causing your whole team. This matches a known issue where digest scheduling jobs can double-fire if a retry occurs before the first job fully completes; we're deploying a fix to add proper job locking. In the meantime, we can manually disable the duplicate scheduled job on our end for your workspace today while the permanent fix rolls out.

subject: How do I set up alert routing rules for different teams?
body: I'm trying to configure Notifications so that billing alerts go to our finance team's email and system alerts go to our engineering team's email instead of everything landing in one inbox. I looked through the settings but couldn't find clear documentation on how routing rules work or whether they support filtering by alert category. Could you point me to the right steps or docs?
answer: Happy to help point you in the right direction. Under Notifications > Routing Rules, you can create separate rules filtered by alert category, each pointing to a different email address, and rules are evaluated in order so more specific categories should be placed above general catch-all rules. We'll send along a link to our step-by-step setup guide, and let us know if you'd like a hand configuring the first couple of rules.

subject: Plan upgrade broke invoice totals and slowed billing dashboard
body: We upgraded Pioneer Travel from Standard to Pro on March 3rd for our energy division (190 seats) and since then the billing dashboard takes 15-20 seconds to load invoices. Worse, the invoice generated for March shows the old per-seat rate for 40 seats and the new rate for the rest, so the total is wrong by about $1,800. answer: Thanks for flagging this, and I understand the urgency given the invoice discrepancy. Our sensor-data connector regularly receives records 2-4 hours after their event timestamp due to how our manufacturing floor equipment batches uploads. We're currently seeing gaps in our hourly aggregation dashboards because the pipeline processes on a fixed schedule and misses records that arrive after the window closes.

We'd like to change our pipeline configuration to account for this expected lateness rather than treating it as an error each time. Is there a recommended allowed-lateness or watermark setting we should apply, and would this affect how our downstream sync to the Dashboards product behaves?
answer: This is a common pattern for batched sensor uploads, so there's a good option here - you can configure an allowed-lateness window on the pipeline (under Pipeline Settings > Windowing) to hold aggregation until a set delay has passed, which should eliminate the gaps you're seeing. Setting this to around 4-5 hours based on your described delay should cover most late batches; note that downstream Dashboard syncs will also shift slightly later to match, so I'd recommend adjusting any scheduled refresh times accordingly. Let me know if you'd like help calculating the right watermark value from your recent data.

subject: Need Okta SSO app configured for Northwind integration
body: We're rolling out Okta as our SSO provider across Apex Energy and need the Northwind Cloud app added to our Okta tenant this week. Our current Slack and Salesforce integrations already route through Okta, and we'd like Northwind added the same way so our 3 users don't have separate logins. Do you have a SAML app already listed in the Okta catalog, or do we need to build a custom app? We also opened Jira ticket APEX-114 internally to track this rollout and need documentation on attribute mapping.
answer: Thanks for reaching out - Northwind Cloud does have a published SAML app in the Okta catalog under 'Northwind Cloud SSO'. I'm sending over our setup guide with the required attribute mappings (email, role, groups) so you can mirror what you've done for Slack and Salesforce. Given this is blocking your rollout, I'm marking this P1 and will follow up within the day to confirm the metadata exchange works on your end.

subject: Getting 429 errors after recent API update
body: Since yesterday our integration has started returning 429 Too Many Requests on the /v2/orders endpoint, even though our call volume hasn't changed. We also noticed a deprecation notice in the SDK changelog about webhook retry behavior changing - could that be related? We're only on 3 seats here at Orion Systems so our usage is low, this doesn't match expected rate limit thresholds.
answer: Thanks for flagging this - we did roll out a change to how webhook retries count against rate limits as part of the SDK v3 deprecation cycle, and it looks like retries are being double-counted for accounts still on the older SDK version. I'll escalate this to engineering to confirm and get a fix or workaround in place; in the meantime, reducing retry attempts on your webhook config should reduce the 429s temporarily.

subject: Slack-Benachrichtigungen kommen stark verzögert an
body: Seit Montag erhalten unsere Teams die Slack-Benachrichtigungen aus der Integration erst mit 15-20 Minuten Verzögerung, teilweise gar nicht. Das betrifft unsere gesamte Energieabteilung mit rund 200 Nutzern, die auf Echtzeit-Alarme aus der Okta- und Salesforce-Anbindung angewiesen sind. Wir haben bereits ein Jira-Ticket (PIO-882) erstellt, aber da es sich um eine kritische Betriebsfunktion handelt, brauchen wir schnell Unterstützung.
answer: Vielen Dank für die Meldung, das nehmen wir sehr ernst. Wir sehen bereits erhöhte Latenzen in der Slack-Integrationswarteschlange und untersuchen gerade, ob es an einem Rückstau bei der Verarbeitung der Salesforce-Trigger liegt. Da dies eure gesamte Organisation betrifft, stufen wir das als P1 ein und melden uns innerhalb der nächsten Stunde mit einem Zwischenstand.

subject: How to set up IP allowlist for Admin Console
body: We'd like to restrict access to our Admin Console so only our office IP ranges can log in, especially since we have 22 seats and want tighter control before our next audit. Is there a way to configure an IP allowlist directly in Settings, and does it apply to all users or can we exempt specific accounts? We'd also like to know if allowlist changes get recorded in the audit log automatically.
answer: You can configure IP allowlisting under Admin Console > Settings > Access Control, where you can add CIDR ranges and optionally exempt specific service accounts. All changes to the allowlist are automatically recorded in the audit log with timestamp and the admin who made the change. I'll also pass along your feedback about per-user exemptions to our product team, as that's a frequently requested refinement.

subject: Need to restore deleted files from backup
body: One of our teams accidentally deleted a folder containing contract templates from our legal workspace on Storage last Thursday, October 3rd. We have 217 seats and rely heavily on retention policies, but I don't see an obvious way to self-serve a restore from backup in the console. Can you confirm what our retention window is and whether we can restore just that folder rather than the entire account snapshot?
answer: Thanks for the details - your account's retention policy keeps daily backups for 30 days, so the October 3rd snapshot is still available. I've initiated a folder-level restore rather than a full account rollback, which should minimize disruption to other data created since then; you should see the restored folder back in your workspace within the next couple of hours, and I'll confirm once it completes.

subject: Biometrischer Login stürzt die App ab
body: Beim Testen der neuen Mobile-App-Version stürzt die App bei uns zuverlässig ab, sobald wir versuchen, uns per Face ID anzumelden. Das passiert auf mehreren iOS-Geräten in unserem Entwicklerteam bei Blue Freight. Der Absturz tritt direkt nach der biometrischen Bestätigung auf, noch bevor der Login-Bildschirm wechselt. Wir integrieren aktuell die API und brauchen den Login-Flow für unsere Tests.
answer: Danke für den Hinweis, das klingt nach einem reproduzierbaren Fehler im Biometrie-Handler der aktuellen Build. Können Sie uns die iOS-Version und das Gerätemodell schicken, sowie ob der Absturz auch ohne Face ID (z.B. mit Passcode) reproduzierbar ist? Wir priorisieren das als P2 und schauen uns die Crash-Logs parallel bei uns an.

subject: Audit log export needed for compliance review
body: Our compliance team needs to export the full admin audit log for the last quarter ahead of a regulatory review next week, but the export in Admin Console is timing out whenever we select a date range longer than 7 days. We're on 123 seats and need the complete log covering all user and settings changes, not just a partial export. This is time-sensitive given the review deadline.
answer: Understood, and given the deadline we're treating this as high priority. The timeout you're seeing is a known issue with large date-range exports that we're actively working around - in the meantime, I can generate the full quarter's audit log manually on our end and send it to you as a CSV within the next few hours so you're not blocked.

subject: Invoice question
body: We've been using Northwind for a few months now and generally things have gone smoothly with the API integration work we're doing. Our billing has mostly been straightforward too, aside from one thing I wanted to flag. Looking at our last two invoices, the seat count listed doesn't match what we actually have active - we're showing 14 seats in the admin console but the invoice charged us for 18. Can you clarify why there's a discrepancy and whether we're owed a refund for the difference?
answer: Thanks for pointing this out, and apologies for the confusion. It looks like two deactivated seats from last month weren't removed from the billing cycle before the invoice generated, which explains the mismatch. I'll issue a refund adjustment for the difference on your next invoice and double-check that your seat count is now correctly synced to 14 active seats.

subject: Push notifications not being delivered to any users
body: Since this morning around 8am, none of our field technicians are receiving push notifications on the mobile app - not for new assignments, not for status updates, nothing. We've confirmed devices are online and app permissions are enabled, tested on both iOS and Android. This is affecting all 16 of our active users at Granite Academy and is blocking our operations team from dispatching work orders.
answer: This is impacting your entire team so we're treating it as P1. We're seeing an issue with the push notification delivery service that started around the same time you reported, and our engineering team is actively working on restoring it. I'll update you as soon as delivery is confirmed working again, and in the meantime recommend having dispatchers use the in-app notification center as a fallback.

subject: Mobile App stürzt beim Start ab
body: Bei uns stürzt die Mobile App bei mehreren Nutzern direkt nach dem Öffnen ab, noch bevor der Login-Bildschirm erscheint. Wir haben es auf verschiedenen Android-Geräten getestet und der Absturz tritt konsistent auf, seit dem Update von letzter Woche. Bei einem Unternehmen mit über 4500 Lizenzen betrifft das potenziell sehr viele Mitarbeiter, die die App im Außendienst nutzen.
answer: Vielen Dank für die ausführliche Beschreibung. Wir haben bereits vereinzelte Meldungen zu Abstürzen nach dem letzten Android-Update erhalten und vermuten ein Problem mit der Initialisierung des Offline-Cache. Könnten Sie uns die genaue App-Version und ein oder zwei betroffene Gerätemodelle nennen? Wir stufen das angesichts der Nutzerzahl als P2 ein und priorisieren die Untersuchung entsprechend.

subject: Deprecation notice for /v2/events endpoint - migration timeline?
body:
We received a banner in the API Platform dashboard flagging /v2/events as deprecated, but I can't find a target sunset date anywhere in the docs. We use this endpoint in three internal reports pulling patient encounter metadata, and I need to plan the SDK upgrade with our engineering team before it breaks.

Could you confirm the exact retirement date and whether the v3 webhook payload schema is backward compatible, or if we need to rewrite our parsers? Also curious if the new rate limit tiers apply retroactively to existing API keys.
answer: Thanks for flagging this - the /v2/events endpoint is scheduled for retirement on the date listed in our deprecation changelog, currently six months out, and existing API keys keep their current rate limit tier through that window. The v3 payload adds a few nested fields but existing top-level keys are unchanged, so your parsers should work with minor SDK version bumps rather than a full rewrite. I'll send you the direct changelog link and flag this thread if you need engineering to review your webhook consumer code.

subject: Jira integration not linking tickets to Slack threads
body:
We set up the Jira link a couple weeks ago so that when a Slack message gets escalated it creates a Jira issue automatically, but the last four issues created show up with blank descriptions and no back-link to the original Slack thread. This is making it hard for finance to track which vendor invoice discussions turned into actual tickets.

We haven't touched the Salesforce integration settings, so I don't think that's related, but wanted to mention it in case it's relevant. Can you check our workspace configuration?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report - this sounds like the Slack-to-Jira mapping is missing the thread metadata field, which usually happens if the integration was reconnected after a Jira project key change. I'll check your workspace configuration on our end and confirm whether the description and back-link fields are populating correctly, and follow up with steps to re-sync the mapping if needed.

subject: Dashboards taking 20+ seconds to load charts since Monday
body:
Since Monday our main enrollment dashboard has been extremely slow, with bar and line charts taking 20 to 30 seconds to render for our operations team. We have about 15 users hitting it daily and it was fine last week. Nothing changed on our side that I'm aware of.

I tried clearing cache and switching browsers but the delay persists across Chrome and Firefox. Can you check if there's a performance issue on the backend or if our dataset size (roughly 40,000 rows) has crossed some threshold?
answer: Sorry for the slowdown you're seeing - we're looking into whether this is tied to a recent change in chart rendering for larger datasets, since 40,000 rows can push against a threshold where our default aggregation kicks in more slowly than expected. We're investigating on our end now and will follow up shortly with either a fix or a workaround, such as pre-aggregating the dataset, to get your dashboard back to normal load times.

subject: Deactivated user still appears in audit log as active
body:
I deactivated a former employee's account in the Admin Console on Tuesday after they left the firm, but the audit log still shows their last login timestamp as active status and they're not appearing on our allowlist review page as deactivated. This is a compliance concern since we're a legal firm and need clean records for our quarterly access review.

Can someone confirm whether the deactivation actually took effect on the backend, or if this is just a display bug in the audit log?
answer: This is a good catch and something we want to verify right away given the compliance implications. The deactivation itself typically takes effect immediately on the backend even if the audit log display lags, but I'm escalating this to confirm the account's actual access status and will get back to you within the next few hours with confirmation and, if needed, a corrected audit log entry.

subject: Unauthorized workspace settings change - possible breach
body:
We just noticed our Admin Console workspace settings were changed overnight, including the IP allowlist being wiped and a new admin user added that none of our team recognizes. This happened sometime between last night and this morning and we have no record of anyone on our media team making these changes.

We need this locked down immediately - please help us deactivate the unrecognized admin account and restore our allowlist before any more damage is done. This looks like a compromised account situation.
answer: This has been escalated to our security team immediately as a potential compromise. We are locking the workspace, disabling the unrecognized admin account, and reviewing the full audit trail for the affected window right now. Please stay available on this ticket for the next update - we'll confirm within the hour once we've secured the account and can walk you through restoring your allowlist and settings safely.

subject: Salesforce sync stopped updating contact records for all users
body:
Our Salesforce integration stopped syncing contact updates as of yesterday around 2pm. Every user on our team, all 13 seats, is seeing stale contact data in Salesforce even though we've made changes in Northwind. We also use Okta for SSO and I want to rule that out as a cause.

This is blocking our sales team from following up on leads with current information. Can you check the sync job status and let us know if there's a queue backup or an authentication token that expired?
answer: This is impacting your whole team so we're prioritizing it now. We're checking the sync job logs on our side to see if the Salesforce connection token expired or if there's a queue backup, and will also verify this isn't related to your Okta SSO setup. I'll update you within the next hour with findings and, if it's a token issue, steps to reauthorize the connection.

subject: SAML-Login schlägt für neue Mitarbeiter fehl
body:
Seit heute Morgen können neue Mitarbeiter, die über unser Provisioning-System angelegt wurden, sich nicht per SAML einloggen. Sie erhalten die Meldung 'Berechtigungsfehler - Benutzer nicht zugeordnet', obwohl sie in unserem Identity Provider korrekt angelegt sind. Betroffen sind mindestens 12 neue Konten aus dieser Woche.

Bestehende Mitarbeiter können sich weiterhin normal einloggen, das Problem betrifft nur neu angelegte Accounts. Können Sie uns sagen, ob sich an der SAML-Attribut-Zuordnung etwas geändert hat? Wir brauchen dringend eine Lösung, da neue Kollegen sonst nicht arbeiten können.
answer: Danke für die genaue Beschreibung. Das klingt nach einem Problem mit der Attribut-Zuordnung zwischen Ihrem Identity Provider und unserem SAML-Konfigurationsprofil, das speziell neu angelegte Konten betrifft. Wir prüfen jetzt die Provisioning-Logs der letzten 24 Stunden und melden uns kurzfristig mit einer Lösung oder einem Workaround, damit die betroffenen 12 Konten sich wieder anmelden können.

subject: Request to change alert routing rules for escalation emails
body:
We'd like to update our alert routing so that critical billing alerts go to our finance distribution list instead of the general support inbox, and duplicate alerts for the same incident get suppressed. Right now we're getting the same escalation email three or four times within a few minutes, which is causing confusion across our travel ops team.

Could you point me to documentation on configuring routing rules, or help set this up directly? We'd like this in place before our next billing cycle.
answer: Thanks for the details - duplicate alerting is a known pain point and we can definitely help reroute critical billing alerts to your finance list while suppressing repeat notifications for the same incident. I'll send over documentation on configuring custom routing rules and duplicate suppression windows, and can also schedule a quick session to set this up together before your next billing cycle if that's easier.

subject: Mobile app crashes immediately on launch after update
body:
Since updating the mobile app yesterday, it crashes within a second of opening on both iOS and Android devices for our operations team, about 25 seats affected. We rely on the app for approving transactions while away from desks, so this is a real problem for a fintech operation.

A couple of users mentioned they were offline when the crash first happened, so it might be related to cached data or offline mode. Push notifications still seem to be coming through even though the app won't open. Can you confirm if there's a known issue with the latest release?
answer: Thanks for reporting this with the offline detail, that's a useful clue - we've had a report of a crash tied to corrupted cached data from offline mode in the latest release. We're investigating now and will follow up shortly with either a hotfix timeline or steps to clear the local cache as a workaround so your team can get back to approving transactions.

subject: Getting duplicate email alerts for the same webhook event
body:
I'm integrating the Notifications API and noticing that every webhook event we receive triggers two identical email alerts to our team, sent about 10 seconds apart. This has been happening consistently for the last three days across all event types we've subscribed to, not just one endpoint.

Is there a deduplication setting we're missing on our side, or a known issue with the delivery pipeline? We'd like this fixed soon since it's flooding our legal team's inbox and causing them to miss real updates.
answer: Thanks for the clear reproduction details - duplicate delivery like this usually points to either a retry misconfiguration on our webhook delivery pipeline or a missing idempotency key on your endpoint, and since it's happening across all event types I suspect it's on our side. We're prioritizing this given the inbox impact on your team and will confirm the root cause shortly along with a fix or a deduplication setting you can enable in the meantime.

subject: Users being logged out every 15 minutes
body: Since Monday our team at North Systems has been getting kicked out of Northwind Cloud roughly every 15 minutes, even during active use. We're using SSO through our Okta provider and MFA is enabled for all 99 seats. This is disrupting our analytics work because dashboards reset mid-session and we lose unsaved filters. Is there a session timeout setting we can adjust on our side, or is this a bug on Northwind's end?
answer: Thanks for flagging this - a 15 minute timeout is well below our default session length, so this does look like a configuration issue rather than expected behavior. Can you confirm whether this started right after any changes to your Okta SSO app or MFA policy? In the meantime, please check Account > Security > Session Settings, since an admin may have set a custom idle timeout there. We'll also pull your tenant's auth logs to check for token refresh failures.

subject: Need to enable sharing of dashboards with view-only external users
body: We're building an integration for Willow Media that pulls data into Northwind Dashboards, and our fintech clients need to view specific dashboards without editing them. Right now the sharing panel only lets us grant access to users within our own workspace. Can you tell us how to generate a shareable read-only link, or if there's an API endpoint to manage external viewer permissions? We have around 290 internal seats and need this rolled out to client-facing dashboards this week.
answer: Great question, and this is a common need for teams sharing data externally. You can create read-only share links under Dashboard Settings > Share > External Link, which lets you set expiration dates and disable export options per link. For programmatic control, our API exposes a /dashboards/{id}/shares endpoint that supports creating and revoking external viewer tokens - I'll send over the relevant API docs section so your integration can automate this before your rollout deadline.

subject: Deactivated employees still showing as active users
body: I deactivated three former employees from the Admin Console last week at Quill Energy, but they still appear as active seats on our billing summary and can still log in. I've checked the user list twice and their status shows 'Deactivated' but access hasn't actually been revoked. We're on the Starter plan with only 24 seats total, so this is affecting our seat count and possibly our security. Can someone confirm why deactivation isn't taking effect?
answer: Thank you for the detailed report - this shouldn't happen, and I understand the seat count discrepancy is concerning on a Starter plan. It looks like there may be a sync delay between the deactivation action and our access control layer; we're checking your workspace's audit log now to see exactly when the deactivation events were recorded versus when access was actually revoked. We're treating this as a priority fix and will confirm within the next few hours whether a manual override is needed to force revocation.

subject: Switching biometric login requirement for all field staff
body: As workspace admin for Granite Robotics, I need to enforce biometric login (Face ID/fingerprint) on the mobile app for all 174 of our field technicians instead of the current PIN-based login. Many of our staff work in warehouses with intermittent connectivity, so I also want to confirm biometric login still works offline once initially set up. Can you walk me through enabling this policy at the workspace level and how it interacts with our push notification settings for shift alerts?
answer: Good news - biometric enforcement can be set workspace-wide under Admin Console > Mobile Policies > Authentication, and once a device has completed initial biometric setup while online, it will continue to work offline for subsequent logins, including in low-connectivity warehouse environments. Push notifications for shift alerts are handled independently and won't be affected by the authentication method change. I'd recommend rolling this out to a small group first since 174 users will need to re-enroll their biometrics on next login.

subject: Workspace settings reset overnight, allowlist gone
body: This morning our Quill Robotics workspace settings appear to have reverted - the IP allowlist we configured last month is completely empty, and two users we had deactivated are now listed as active again. We only have 3 seats on the Starter plan so this is a small team, but losing our access restrictions overnight is a serious problem. Nothing was changed by us; I checked the audit log and don't see any entries around the time this happened.
answer: This is a serious issue and I'm escalating it right away. A silent revert of allowlist and deactivation settings without a corresponding audit log entry points to a possible backend sync error rather than user action, and we're investigating your workspace immediately to restore the correct configuration. In the meantime, please avoid making further changes to settings so we can compare the current state against our backups without conflicting edits.

subject: Shared dashboards taking 20+ seconds to load for external viewers
body: We integrated Northwind Dashboards into our client portal for Granite Legal, and while internal users load charts quickly, dashboards shared externally via read-only links are taking 20-30 seconds to render, sometimes timing out entirely. We have around 243 seats and several shared dashboards with 5-6 charts each pulling from large datasets. This is affecting client-facing views specifically, not internal ones, and export to PDF from the shared link fails with a generic error.
answer: Thanks for the detailed breakdown - the fact that this is isolated to externally shared links versus internal views is a helpful clue, since shared dashboards route through a separate caching layer that may not be warming correctly for larger datasets. I'm escalating this to our performance team to check the render pipeline for external share tokens, and I'll also ask them to look into the PDF export failure separately since that error message needs more context from our logs. We'll update you within one business day with findings.

subject: Staff unable to complete MFA enrollment via SSO
body: Several of our team at Blue Analytics are stuck during MFA enrollment when logging in through our SSO provider - the app prompts for a QR code scan but then just spins and never confirms the pairing. This is happening for about a dozen of our 80 users so far, all trying to enroll for the first time this week. Others who enrolled before this week are unaffected. Any known issue with the MFA enrollment flow and SSO combination?
answer: Thanks for the report - we've seen a similar pattern reported by a couple of other SSO customers this week, so this may be a broader issue with the enrollment confirmation step rather than something specific to your configuration. Could you let us know which authenticator app your users are on (Google Authenticator, Authy, etc.) so we can narrow down whether it's app-specific? We're actively investigating the enrollment flow and will follow up with a fix timeline as soon as we have one.

subject: Dashboards taking forever to load, even simple ones
body: Our dashboards have gotten noticeably slower over the past week - even a simple dashboard with just two charts takes 8-10 seconds to load now for our small team at Summit Media. We're on the Starter plan with 7 seats so our data volume is pretty low, which makes the slowdown confusing. It happens consistently across different browsers and different team members' logins, not just mine.
answer: Thanks for letting us know, and I agree the slowdown is unexpected given your data volume. Since this is happening consistently across users and browsers, it points to something on our infrastructure side rather than a local caching issue. Could you share the name of one affected dashboard and roughly what time you noticed the slowness starting? We'll check our performance metrics for your workspace to pinpoint the cause.

subject: URGENT: Uploaded files missing after retention policy change
body: We are missing dozens of case files uploaded in the last two weeks to Atlas Travel's Storage workspace. Yesterday we adjusted our retention policy settings to extend retention from 30 to 90 days, and this morning files uploaded between June 10 and June 24 have disappeared entirely from the file browser, though our storage quota usage still shows the space as consumed. This is affecting active legal cases and we need these files recovered immediately.
answer: I understand the urgency and we're treating this as a critical incident right now. The fact that storage quota still reflects the missing files' size suggests the data itself is likely intact and this is a display or indexing issue tied to the retention policy change, not a deletion event, but we're verifying that immediately with our storage team. I'll update you within the hour with either a restoration timeline or confirmation the files are recoverable - please do not make further retention policy changes in the meantime.

subject: Refund needed for duplicate seat charges on last invoice
body: Our last invoice for Granite Media billed us for 273 seats, but we only actually have 250 active users - it looks like 23 deactivated accounts from a March offboarding never got removed from the billing count. I'd like to request a credit or refund for the overcharge on this invoice, and also understand whether there's a way to have seat counts sync automatically with deactivations going forward so this doesn't recur.
answer: Thanks for catching this and providing the specific numbers - a 23-seat discrepancy from deactivated accounts not syncing to billing is something we can resolve. I'm forwarding this to our billing team to issue a credit for the overcharge on your most recent invoice, and I'll also check whether your plan supports automatic seat reconciliation on deactivation so this doesn't happen again going forward. You should see confirmation of the credit within 2-3 business days.

subject: SSO session timeouts hitting operations team mid-shift
body:
We're seeing unexpected session timeouts across our operations team using Okta SSO into Northwind. Users report being logged out after roughly 10-12 minutes of activity, well below the 8-hour session we configured. This started around June 3rd and is affecting shift handoffs where agents lose context mid-task.

We've checked our IdP session lifetime settings and they look unchanged. Can you check if something changed on the Northwind side for tenant orion-works-prod? This is disruptive but agents can re-authenticate, so it's not a full outage.
answer:
Thanks for the detailed report. We can see elevated re-authentication events on the orion-works-prod tenant starting June 3rd, which lines up with a token refresh change we rolled out that day. We're investigating whether the refresh interval is being applied incorrectly to your SSO session policy and will update you within a few hours with a fix or workaround.

In the meantime, if you can share a couple of affected user IDs and timestamps, that will help us pinpoint the exact sessions and confirm the root cause faster.

subject: URGENT: Duplicate email digests going out to all our users
body:
Our nightly email digest job is sending duplicate emails to every subscribed user since last night's run. Each user got 3 copies of the same digest between 11:58pm and 12:04am UTC on June 5th. We're on the digest API endpoint /v1/notifications/digests and we didn't change our integration code recently.

We have 22 seats but our digest list includes over 4,000 external subscribers, so this is generating a lot of complaint replies. Please help us stop further duplicates and confirm what caused it.
answer:
This is a priority issue and we're on it right now. We've identified a retry-queue bug that caused digest jobs to be re-triggered when the delivery confirmation was delayed past 2 seconds, which explains the triplicate sends around midnight. We've paused the digest scheduler for your account to prevent further duplicates while we deploy a fix, expected within the next 2 hours.

We'll send confirmation once the fix is live and verified against your account, and we're happy to provide a summary you can share with your subscribers if needed.

subject: issue
body: we added a new IP range to our allowlist in the admin console yesterday and now the whole settings page takes over 30 seconds to load, sometimes it just times out. before this we had 6 ranges and it loaded instantly. we tried removing the new range but the page is still slow. this is on the security settings tab under org admin
answer:
Thanks for flagging this. A slowdown after adding an IP range points to a known issue where the allowlist validation re-checks every existing entry synchronously on page load, which can degrade badly past a certain number of ranges. We're logging this as a bug and will prioritize a fix so the check runs asynchronously instead.

As a workaround, try loading the settings page during lower-traffic hours or contact us directly and we can apply your allowlist change from our side to avoid the timeout. Let us know if the page continues to time out even after removing the new range, as that would indicate a caching issue we need to clear manually.

subject: Push notifications not arriving after app crash on Android
body:
Since updating to the latest Northwind mobile app version, several of our team members on Android devices stopped receiving push notifications for new case assignments. Two users also reported the app crashing on launch right after going from offline to online mode, requiring a force close and reopen.

This started this week for us at Cobalt Legal, affecting at least 5 of our 18 users. Notifications worked fine before the update. Can you check if this is a known issue with the offline-to-online transition handling?
answer:
Thanks for the report — we've had a couple of similar reports about push delivery and crashes tied to the offline reconnect flow in the latest release. We're escalating this to our mobile team to investigate the crash on the online/offline transition and the missed push notifications together, since they may share a root cause.

In the meantime, could you have affected users check that notification permissions are still enabled after the crash, since that setting sometimes resets? We'll follow up as soon as we have a fix timeline or a workaround to share.

subject: Uploads failing intermittently via Storage API, requesting retention config option
body:
We're integrating with the Storage API and seeing intermittent upload failures on PUT /v1/storage/objects, roughly 1 in 20 requests returning a 503 with no retry-after header. Object sizes range from 2MB to 40MB. This has been happening since we started load testing on June 2nd.

Separately, we'd like to request the ability to set custom retention periods per bucket rather than the account-wide default, since our travel booking documents need a 7-year retention while other files only need 90 days. Could you let us know if this is on the roadmap?
answer:
Thanks for the details on both fronts. On the upload failures, a 1-in-20 503 rate during load testing suggests you may be hitting a per-region concurrency limit; we're checking your account's throughput settings now and will follow up with either a limit increase or confirmation of expected behavior.

On the retention request, per-bucket retention isn't currently available, but it's a reasonable ask and we'll pass it to our product team as a feature request. We'll keep you posted on both items.

subject: Salesforce sync integration questions and setup help
body:
We're setting up the Salesforce integration and want to make sure our contact sync mapping is correct before going live. Right now custom fields like Account_Tier__c and Renewal_Date__c aren't showing up as sync options in the Northwind integration panel, even though they exist in our Salesforce org.

We'd also like to understand whether Slack and Jira notifications can be triggered from Salesforce sync events, since our team currently gets updates manually. Any documentation on this workflow would be appreciated, and if there's a call available to walk through configuration that would help us move faster.
answer:
Happy to help get this set up correctly. Custom fields need to be explicitly added via the field mapping API before they appear in the sync panel — I've attached a documentation link covering that step, and once mapped, Account_Tier__c and Renewal_Date__c should sync within the next scheduled run.

On Slack and Jira triggers from Salesforce sync events, that's supported through our integration webhooks, and the doc also covers example configurations for both. If you'd still like a walkthrough call, let us know your availability and we'll set one up this week.

subject: Need higher API rate limits for production rollout
body:
We're preparing to roll out our integration to all 140 users at Atlas Travel next month and our current rate limit of 600 requests/minute is going to be a bottleneck during peak booking hours. We're using the Python SDK and hitting 429 errors during our load tests when simulating expected peak traffic of around 900 requests/minute.

Can we get a rate limit increase before go-live, and is there updated SDK documentation on handling backoff for webhook delivery retries? We want to make sure our webhook consumers handle throttling gracefully.
answer:
Thanks for planning ahead on this — given your go-live timeline, we'll prioritize the rate limit review. Based on your projected 900 requests/minute, we recommend requesting an increase to 1200 requests/minute with burst headroom; please confirm and we'll get that provisioned within 2 business days.

For webhook backoff handling, our SDK docs cover exponential backoff configuration under the retries section, and I'll also send you a direct link to the webhook delivery retry guide so your consumers handle 429s and timeouts consistently before launch.

subject: Data pipeline showing hours-late data from our billing connector
body:
Our billing data pipeline connector has been delivering data 4-6 hours late since yesterday, June 4th, instead of the usual 15-minute sync interval. This is causing our downstream financial reports to show stale numbers, which is a real problem given we're a small finance team relying on same-day data.

The connector status shows 'active' with no errors logged, but the last successful sync timestamp keeps falling further behind. We need this resolved quickly since our team can't reconcile transactions with outdated data.
answer:
We understand the urgency given the financial reconciliation impact, and we're treating this as a priority incident. We've identified a backlog building up in the billing connector's queue that's causing the delay despite the connector showing active status, and our data pipelines team is working now to clear the backlog and restore the 15-minute sync interval.

We'll send an update within the hour with current backlog status and expected time to catch up to real-time sync. Apologies for the disruption to your reporting.

subject: Zapier integration stopped triggering Salesforce updates
body:
Our Zapier integration that pushes new Northwind case data into Salesforce stopped triggering as of yesterday afternoon. The Zap shows as 'on' with no errors in the task history, but no new records have been created in Salesforce since around 2pm on June 4th. We didn't change anything on our end.

We use this to keep our legal case tracking synced for the team, and a data analyst on our side usually monitors this daily, which is how we caught the gap. Can you check if something changed with the Northwind trigger for Zapier?
answer:
Thanks for catching this and providing the exact timestamp. We're seeing that our Zapier trigger webhook for case events had a delivery issue starting around 2pm on June 4th, likely related to a brief outage in our webhook dispatch service. We're verifying the fix now and will manually replay any missed events from that window so they populate in Salesforce.

We'll confirm once the replay is complete and double-check that new events are triggering normally going forward.

subject: Dashboard charts rendering broken after recent update, need export fix
body:
Several of our shared dashboards are showing broken charts since the update earlier this week — bar charts render as blank boxes and line charts show 'undefined' on the Y-axis labels. This is affecting dashboards shared across our media team, roughly 15 dashboards impacted so far.

We also need to export a few of these dashboards to PDF for a stakeholder review on Friday, but the export function fails silently when the charts are in this broken state. Could you advise on a fix or workaround before then, and any guidance on how sharing settings might be involved would help since only shared dashboards seem affected.
answer:
Thanks for the clear breakdown — the blank bar charts and undefined Y-axis labels on shared dashboards point to a rendering regression tied to shared-view caching from this week's update, and export failures are a downstream effect of the same issue. Our dashboards team is already investigating and we'll prioritize a fix given your Friday deadline.

As a workaround, try unsharing and re-sharing one of the affected dashboards, which has resolved the rendering issue for a few other customers; this should also allow the PDF export to work in the meantime. We'll follow up with a permanent fix status by tomorrow.

subject: IP allowlist change not taking effect
body: I added our new branch office IP (198.51.100.42) to the Admin Console IP allowlist yesterday afternoon, but two of our logistics coordinators are still getting blocked when they try to log in from that location. The audit log shows the allowlist entry was saved around 3:40pm, but the block is still happening as of this morning. Can you confirm whether allowlist changes need extra time to propagate, or if something else is going on?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. Allowlist updates in Admin Console normally propagate within a few minutes, so a block persisting overnight suggests the entry may not have saved correctly on our end. I'm pulling the audit log entry for that change now to verify the CIDR format and will confirm within the next update whether we need to re-apply it or if there's a caching issue on our side.

subject: Webhooks liefern doppelte und verzögerte Events
body: Seit dem 6. Juni bemerken wir, dass unsere Webhook-Endpunkte für Sendungsupdates teils doppelte Events erhalten und teils Events mit 10-15 Minuten Verzögerung eintreffen. Das betrifft mehrere unserer Logistik-Workflows, da wir Statusänderungen in Echtzeit an unser Lager weiterleiten müssen. Wir nutzen das Node SDK Version 4.2.1 laut Dokumentation, haben aber keine Änderungen an unserer Konfiguration vorgenommen. Können Sie prüfen, ob es aktuell Performance-Probleme auf der Webhook-Zustellung gibt? Das betrifft aktuell einen Großteil unserer 101 Nutzer, die auf diese Updates warten.
answer: Vielen Dank für die genaue Beschreibung. Wir sehen tatsächlich erhöhte Latenzen bei der Webhook-Zustellung seit dem 6. Juni und untersuchen aktuell einen Rückstau in der Zustell-Queue, der auch doppelte Events verursachen kann. Da dies mehrere Nutzer bei Ihnen betrifft, stufen wir das als P1 ein und meldet uns innerhalb der nächsten Stunde mit einem Zwischenstand, während unser Plattform-Team die Queue-Verarbeitung überprüft.

subject: PDF export cuts off bottom half of chart
body: When I export our quarterly shipment dashboard to PDF, the bar chart in the bottom-left panel gets cut off halfway down the page. This happens consistently whether I export from Chrome or Firefox, and it started after we added a third chart to that dashboard last week. The on-screen view looks fine, it's only the PDF export that's broken.
answer: Thanks for flagging this. It sounds like the PDF renderer isn't recalculating the page layout correctly when a third chart is added to a panel. Could you send me the dashboard name or ID so I can reproduce the export on our side and confirm whether this is a layout bug in the export engine?

subject: Urgent: need to deactivate departed employee accounts from workspace settings
body: We have 9 employees who left the firm this week and their accounts are still active in the Admin Console workspace settings. Our normal bulk deactivation flow under Users > Deactivate Selected is throwing a generic 'action failed' message every time we try to process more than one account at once. Deactivating them one by one works, but with 146 seats across multiple departments this is a serious access risk for a legal firm and we need it resolved today.
answer: I understand the urgency given the access risk here. We're treating this as P1 and looking into the bulk deactivation failure right now. In the meantime, please continue deactivating accounts individually since that path is working, and we'll update you as soon as we identify why the bulk action is failing for your workspace.

subject: Question about storage quota and retention settings
body: We're trying to understand how our storage quota is calculated for backups versus regular file uploads. Our dashboard shows we're at 82% of quota, but when I add up the files in our upload folders it doesn't come close to that number. I'm wondering if old backup snapshots are counting toward the same quota and whether there's a retention setting we could adjust to free up space without deleting active files.
answer: Good question, and this is a common point of confusion. Backup snapshots do count toward your total storage quota alongside regular uploads, and by default we retain the last 30 days of snapshots. You can adjust the retention window under Storage > Settings > Retention Policy to a shorter period, which should reduce your usage without touching active files, and I'm happy to walk through the numbers with you if the math still doesn't add up after that change.

subject: Push notifications not arriving, app crashes on relogin
body: Several of our store staff have reported that push notifications for new order alerts stopped arriving on their phones starting Tuesday. When they try to log out and back in to fix it, the app crashes immediately after entering their password on both iOS and Android. This is only affecting a handful of the 11 devices we have registered, not everyone.
answer: Thanks for reporting this. A crash on re-login combined with missing push notifications suggests the device token registration may be failing silently for those accounts. Could you send me the device models and app version for the affected phones so we can check the push registration logs and confirm whether we need to re-issue tokens for those specific devices?

subject: URGENT: retention policy deleted files before backup completed
body: Our retention policy triggered an automatic purge at 2:00am today and removed roughly 340 files from our clinical intake storage bucket before the scheduled nightly backup had finished running. We now have no backup copy of those files and the storage quota dashboard confirms the space was freed. This is a healthcare environment and we cannot lose this data, we need immediate help recovering it.
answer: This is being escalated immediately as a P0 incident. We're pulling our storage replication logs now to check whether the purged files exist in our short-term recovery snapshots, and our data team is joining this ticket within minutes. Please do not run any further storage operations on that bucket until we confirm recovery options, and we'll update you continuously until this is resolved.

subject: Slack alerts not firing for Jira escalations
body: We set up the Slack integration a few weeks ago to post alerts into our #ops-escalations channel whenever a Jira ticket gets escalated through our Salesforce case sync. Since Monday, none of those escalation alerts are showing up in Slack even though the Jira tickets are being created correctly. Our team is missing time-sensitive escalations because of this and we've had to manually check Jira all week.
answer: Thanks for the clear description. We're seeing that the Slack integration webhook for escalation events may have stopped receiving triggers from the Jira connector since Monday, and we're checking the integration logs now to pinpoint where the handoff is failing. We'll follow up shortly with either a fix or a workaround so your team isn't relying on manual checks in the meantime.

subject: URGENT - entire company locked out of SAML login
body: As of about 20 minutes ago, none of our staff can log in through our SAML identity provider, everyone is getting an error that says 'SAML response validation failed' right after entering credentials on the IdP side. This is affecting all 23 of our seats and we have staff who need access to patient billing records right now. Nothing has changed on our side that we're aware of.
answer: This is being treated as a P0 outage and I'm escalating to our identity team immediately. We're checking whether a recent certificate rotation on our side is causing the SAML response validation to fail, and we'll have someone confirm the root cause and a fix within the next short while. I'll keep this ticket updated continuously until access is restored for all your users.

subject: Unsubscribe link doesn't stop duplicate emails
body: One of our team members clicked unsubscribe on a billing notification email three times over the past week, but she's still receiving the same duplicate reminder twice a day. I checked the Notifications settings and her account shows as unsubscribed from that category, but the emails keep coming through anyway. Can you check if there's a bug in how the unsubscribe status syncs with the actual sending job?
answer: Thanks for reporting this. It does sound like the unsubscribe flag isn't being respected by the scheduled sending job for that notification category, which would explain the duplicates continuing after opting out. Could you confirm the account email address or user ID so we can check the notification logs and suppress the sends manually while we investigate the sync bug?

subject: IP allowlist entries not applying to new API keys
body: I'm integrating our backend with the Northwind API and added our office and VPN egress IPs to the allowlist under Admin Console > Settings > Allowlist. New API keys created after the update still seem to accept requests from outside those ranges, which is confusing since existing keys are correctly restricted. Could you clarify whether allowlist rules apply retroactively to new keys or if there's a propagation delay? We have 273 seats on the Pro plan and want to lock this down before rolling out more integrations.
answer: Thanks for flagging this - allowlist rules should apply to all keys, new and existing, within a few minutes of saving. It sounds like there may be a caching issue on our end for newly generated keys. Could you send me the key IDs (not the secrets) and the timestamps you tested so I can trace the propagation logs and confirm whether this is a delay or a bug?

subject: Deactivated users still showing as active in audit log
body: We deactivated four employees last week through Admin Console > Settings > Users after they left Granite Labs, but the audit log still lists their sessions as active as of this morning, and one of them was able to log in again yesterday. This is a real problem for us given we're in legal services and need clean deactivation records for compliance. Can you confirm whether the deactivation is actually taking effect or just cosmetic in the UI?
answer: This is concerning and I want to get it resolved quickly. It sounds like the deactivation flag may not be propagating to the session validation service, which would explain the login you saw. Can you share the user IDs or emails for the four accounts and the exact login timestamp you noticed? I'll escalate this to engineering as a potential deactivation bug and update you within the next few hours.

subject: Shared dashboards showing stale permissions after role change
body: We've had multiple staff report that dashboards shared with specific teams are still visible to users who were removed from those teams two days ago. This is affecting several of our analytics dashboards used across departments at Harbor Analytics, and with 3651 seats the exposure is significant since some of these dashboards contain enrollment and financial data. Export links generated from these dashboards also seem to inherit the same stale permissions.
answer: Thank you for reporting this promptly - given the scope of exposure I'm treating this as an active incident. We're checking whether the sharing permission cache is failing to invalidate on team membership changes, which would explain both the dashboard and export link behavior. Can you list a couple of affected dashboard IDs and the teams involved so we can verify and force a permission refresh while we investigate the root cause?

subject: offline mode losing cart data
