answer: Sorry for the trouble this is causing. Could you tell me which device and app version you're on, and roughly how much offline data was in progress when it crashed? That will help us reproduce the crash and prioritize a fix for offline data persistence.

subject: SSO sessions timing out much faster than configured
body: Our SSO sessions through Northwind Identity are timing out after roughly 15 minutes of inactivity, even though our session timeout policy is set to 4 hours in the Identity settings. This started around three days ago and is affecting multiple analysts who now have to re-authenticate constantly, which is disruptive during data pulls. We haven't changed our MFA or provisioning settings recently. Is there a known issue with session timeout configuration not being respected?
answer: Thanks for the details - a mismatch between configured timeout and actual session expiry usually points to a caching issue on the identity provider side or a misapplied policy override. Could you confirm which SSO protocol you're using (SAML or OIDC) and whether this affects all 14 seats or just some users? I'll check our session logs for your tenant to see when the shorter timeout started applying.

subject: Question about log retention
body: We've been reorganizing our team structure this month and going through our settings to make sure everything is documented properly before our next internal review, since we're a small team and want to keep things tidy. While going through Admin Console settings I also deactivated two former contractors' accounts last week without issues. The actual problem is that when I go to Admin Console > Audit Log to pull records for our review, entries older than 7 days seem to have disappeared entirely, even though I thought retention was longer on our plan.
answer: Thanks for the context - to clarify, audit log retention on the Starter plan is currently set to 7 days, which explains why older entries aren't visible. If you need longer retention for compliance reviews, we can look at options including exporting logs periodically or discussing a plan upgrade with longer retention. Let me know if you'd like documentation on setting up scheduled exports so you don't lose data going forward.

subject: URGENT: IP allowlist rule blocking all API traffic, need audit trail
body: We updated our IP allowlist in Admin Console this morning to add a new office range, and immediately after saving, all API traffic from our existing whitelisted range started returning 403 errors. This has knocked out our production integration for Quill Foods and we need to know exactly what changed - the audit log shows the update but not a clear diff of before/after rules. We have 47 seats and this is blocking critical energy data ingestion right now.
answer: This is being escalated immediately as a P1 security and access issue. It sounds like the allowlist update may have overwritten rather than appended to your existing rules, which would explain the sudden 403s. As a first step, can you revert to the previous allowlist configuration if you have it saved, or let me know the exact IP ranges you intended to keep so I can manually restore them while we investigate the audit log gap?

subject: Storage quota warning despite recent cleanup
body: We're seeing a quota warning banner in Storage saying we're at 95% of our allocated capacity, but we deleted roughly 40GB of old backup files last week specifically to free up space. The usage dashboard still shows the pre-cleanup number. Can you confirm if there's a delay in quota recalculation after deletions, or if our retention policy is retaining copies we can't see, so we know whether we actually need to escalate for more capacity?
answer: Good question - quota recalculation after bulk deletions can take up to 24 hours to reflect in the usage dashboard, and it's possible your retention policy kept versioned copies of the deleted backups temporarily. Can you tell me your current retention window setting? I'll also check your account's storage metrics directly to confirm whether the 40GB was actually released or is still held by retention.

subject: Request to adjust scheduled sync frequency and add data quality checks
body: We'd like to change our scheduled sync frequency for our travel booking connector from every 6 hours to every 2 hours, since our current setup is causing noticeable latency in downstream reporting for Pioneer Analytics. Separately, we've noticed a few sync runs completing successfully but with row counts that look too low compared to source data, and we'd like to request some basic data quality validation on sync completion if that's available as a feature.
answer: Thanks for the detailed request - increasing sync frequency to every 2 hours is straightforward and I can make that change on our end once you confirm which connector ID to update. Regarding data quality checks on row counts, that's not yet a built-in feature but I'll log it as a feature request and flag the low row count issue for our pipelines team to review, since that may point to a separate connector problem worth investigating alongside the frequency change.

subject: Push notifications not delivering to iOS devices after API integration
body: We integrated the Northwind push notification API into our mobile app last week for North Foods, and since then iOS users are not receiving push notifications at all, while Android delivery seems fine. Our device tokens are registering successfully according to the API response, but the notification dashboard shows a 0% delivery rate for iOS for the past four days. This is affecting a large portion of our 3460 seats who rely on transactional alerts.
answer: Thank you for the detailed report - a 0% iOS delivery rate with successful token registration usually points to an APNs certificate or configuration issue on our push service. Can you confirm whether you're using certificate-based or token-based (APNs auth key) authentication, and send a sample device token along with a notification ID that failed? I'll check our delivery logs for your integration and prioritize this given the scale of impact.

subject: Help
body:
We've been going through our quarterly license review here at Blue Energy, comparing internal HR headcount against what shows in the Northwind admin console. Our retail operations team had a lot of turnover this year with role changes and several departures across departments.

Thanks for flagging this - a discrepancy of that size over three billing cycles needs to be looked at right away, so I've escalated this to our billing team as a priority item. We'll pull the historical seat usage logs against your invoices from July through September and get back to you within one business day with a proposed credit amount.

In the meantime, I'll also check whether usage-threshold alerts are available on your plan and follow up with setup instructions once we confirm the refund.

subject: Feature request: offline data caching for mobile app
body:
Our field team at Lumen Robotics uses the Northwind mobile app to check transaction statuses while visiting client sites, and connectivity is often spotty. Right now the app crashes with a blank white screen whenever it loses network mid-sync instead of falling back to cached data.

Could you add proper offline mode support, or at least a graceful fallback that shows the last synced data instead of crashing? We'd also like push notifications to queue and deliver once connectivity is restored rather than being dropped entirely.
answer:
Thanks for the detailed feedback - offline caching and queued push delivery are both on our mobile roadmap, and I'm logging this request against your account so product can weigh it alongside similar asks. In the meantime, a workaround is to force a manual refresh once connectivity returns rather than waiting for auto-sync, which should reduce the crash frequency.

I'll update this ticket once there's a timeline to share for either feature.

subject: Duplicate charge on invoice INV-88213

subject: SDK wirft 429 Fehler bei Webhook-Registrierung

Seit heute Morgen erhalten wir bei der Registrierung neuer Webhooks ueber das Node.js SDK (Version 3.2.1) durchgehend Fehler 429 Too Many Requests, obwohl wir laut Dashboard weit unter unserem Rate-Limit liegen. Vielen Dank fuer die Meldung - das klingt nach einem Problem auf unserer Seite und wir behandeln es mit hoher Priorität. Wir melden uns innerhalb der naechsten Stunden mit einem Update, sobald wir die Ursache identifiziert haben.

subject: Dashboard sharing broken - error when granting external access
body:
We're trying to share a quarterly performance dashboard with an external auditor at Pioneer Travel, but every time I set permissions to view-only external, I get an error.

PermissionGrantError: target scope 'external_viewer' not allowed for workspace tier
  at grantAccess (dashboard-share.js:142)

Please try the share action again in about 15 minutes and let us know if the same error persists - if so, we'll jump on a call to resolve it before your deadline.

subject: Slack alerts not firing for integration errors

We'll check the webhook delivery logs on our end in parallel and get back to you shortly with what we find.

subject: Refund needed for overcharged seats on renewal

subject: Question about scheduled sync frequency for data pipeline connector
body:
I'm setting up a data pipeline connector at Delta Energy to pull records from our legal case management system into Northwind on a scheduled basis. Right now I have it configured to sync every 6 hours, but I'd like to understand if there's a minimum interval supported, and whether latency increases significantly if we schedule syncs every 15 minutes instead.

Also, is there documentation on how sync failures are retried, or do we need to build our own retry logic on top of the connector?
answer:
Good question - the minimum supported sync interval for scheduled connectors is currently 10 minutes, though we generally recommend 30 minutes or more to avoid unnecessary load, since latency does increase slightly with more frequent polling depending on data volume. Failed syncs are automatically retried up to 3 times with exponential backoff before being marked as failed in the activity log, so you shouldn't need custom retry logic for typical transient errors.

I'm attaching a link to our connector scheduling documentation in a follow-up message, which covers retry behavior and best practices in more detail.

subject: REFUND

Let us know once you've configured the attribute mappings and we can do a quick verification check on our end before you roll this out broadly.

subject: Push notifications not delivering to iOS devices after v2.3 update
body: We integrated the Northwind Mobile SDK for push notifications and since updating to v2.3 last Tuesday, roughly 30% of our iOS test devices stop receiving notifications after the app has been backgrounded for more than an hour. answer: Thanks for the detailed report. This matches an issue we've seen with APNs token refresh timing after extended background periods in SDK 2.3 — the relay can hold a stale token even though the send call returns 200. Can you confirm whether the affected devices reconnect after being foregrounded again, and send us a couple of device tokens that failed? We'll cross-reference them against our relay logs and follow up with a fix or workaround within the day.

subject: Salesforce sync failing for all accounts since this morning - urgent
body: Our Salesforce integration through Northwind has been failing since around 8am today. Please check if that service account had any recent changes, and in the meantime we're re-authenticating the connector from our side — you'll need to re-approve the OAuth prompt when it appears in the Integrations panel.

subject: Backup restore stuck at 0% for 3 hours
body: I kicked off a restore from our January 14th backup snapshot in the Storage console around 10am because we accidentally overwrote a folder of invoice PDFs, but the restore job has been sitting at 0% progress for over three hours now. We're on the Starter plan with a 500GB quota and only using about 60GB, so I don't think it's a space issue. Job ID is rst-88213-quill. This is time sensitive since our accounting team needs those files for month-end close. We'd really appreciate an update as soon as possible - happy to hop on a call if that helps move things along.
answer: I understand the urgency given your close deadline, and I've flagged this as high priority. Job rst-88213-quill shows it's queued behind a stuck worker process on our end rather than a quota problem — our infrastructure team is restarting that worker now. I'll personally monitor this restore and update you within the hour once it starts progressing, and will confirm as soon as your files are recovered.

subject: SCIM Provisionierung erstellt doppelte Benutzer
body: Seit letzter Woche bemerken wir, dass unsere SCIM-Provisionierung über Northwind Identity doppelte Benutzerkonten anlegt, wenn ein Mitarbeiter bereits manuell eingeladen wurde. Bei drei Kollegen aus der Rechtsabteilung sind jetzt jeweils zwei Accounts mit derselben E-Mail-Domain aber unterschiedlichen externen IDs vorhanden. Das führt dazu, dass sich manche Nutzer nicht mehr per SSO einloggen können, weil das System nicht weiß, welches Konto aktiv sein soll. Können Sie uns sagen, wie wir die doppelten Konten sauber zusammenführen können, ohne dass Zugriffsrechte verloren gehen?
answer: Danke für die genaue Beschreibung. Das Problem tritt auf, wenn der SCIM-Abgleich einen bereits bestehenden Benutzer nicht per E-Mail, sondern nur per externer ID erkennt. Wir können die doppelten Konten identifizieren und zusammenführen, benötigen dafür aber eine Liste der betroffenen Benutzer mit beiden Konto-IDs. Bitte senden Sie uns diese Liste, dann bereinigen wir die Duplikate serverseitig und stellen sicher, dass zukünftige SCIM-Updates bestehende Konten korrekt zuordnen.

subject: Scheduled pipeline syncs running 40+ minutes late
body: We have a Data Pipelines job (pipeline id lumen-retail-sync-04) configured to run every hour pulling inventory data from our warehouse system into Northwind. For the past two days it's been running 40 to 50 minutes behind schedule, and yesterday's 3pm run pulled in duplicate rows for about 200 SKUs. We depend on this for near-real-time pricing updates so the delay and data quality issue are both causing problems downstream.
answer: Thanks for flagging both issues together, they're likely related. We're seeing queue backlog on the pipeline scheduler affecting several jobs in your region since yesterday, which explains the delay, and the duplicate rows are consistent with a retry mechanism re-processing a batch that didn't complete cleanly. We're deploying a fix for the scheduler backlog now and will separately dedupe the affected 200 SKU rows from the 3pm run - I'll confirm once both are resolved, likely within a few hours.

subject: Best way to handle offline mode with local data caching?
body: I'm building offline support into our mobile app using the Northwind Mobile SDK and want to understand the recommended pattern for caching data locally when the device loses connectivity. Right now when the app goes offline mid-session, some screens crash on reconnect because the local cache tries to merge with a stale sync token. Is there documented guidance on handling sync token refresh after extended offline periods?
answer: Good question - offline sync token handling is a common source of that crash. The recommended pattern is to store the sync token alongside a timestamp and discard it if the offline period exceeds 24 hours, forcing a full resync instead of a delta merge. Our mobile SDK docs under 'Offline Mode > Sync Token Lifecycle' walk through this, but let us know if you'd like a short code sample for your specific setup since we know that section could be clearer.

subject: Need timeline on deprecated /v1/webhooks/legacy endpoint
body: We received a notice that the /v1/webhooks/legacy endpoint is being deprecated but the email didn't specify a hard cutoff date. We currently route about 40 webhook events per minute through it for booking confirmations. Can you confirm the exact sunset date and whether the new /v2/webhooks endpoint has the same rate limit of 100 requests per minute, or if that's changing too? We'd also appreciate updated documentation since the current migration guide still references the old payload schema.
answer: Thanks for checking in on this. The /v1/webhooks/legacy endpoint is scheduled to be fully retired on the last day of next month, and the new /v2/webhooks endpoint keeps the same 100 requests per minute limit per API key. You're right that the migration guide is out of date - we'll get the payload schema section corrected this week, and in the meantime I can send you the updated v2 payload examples directly so your migration isn't blocked.

subject: Alert routing sending duplicate emails to on-call group
body: We noticed our alert routing rule for critical severity notifications is sending each alert email twice to our on-call distribution list. This started after we added a second routing rule last week for our warehouse-east region. It's not urgent but it's creating noise - roughly 15 to 20 duplicate emails per day across our monitoring integrations. Rule IDs involved are route-alert-crit and route-alert-warehouse-east.
answer: Thanks for the report and the rule IDs, that helps a lot. It looks like both rules have overlapping match conditions on severity=critical, so alerts matching both are triggering two separate email actions. We'd recommend scoping route-alert-warehouse-east to only match your region-specific tag rather than severity alone, which should eliminate the duplicates - happy to walk through the rule config with you if useful.

subject: Request: bulk user deactivation with audit trail
body: As we manage seat allocation across our travel teams, we'd like to request a bulk deactivation feature in the Admin Console so we can deactivate multiple users at once instead of one at a time. Currently with 80 seats it's manageable but tedious, and we'd also want each deactivation to show up clearly in the audit log with a reason field, since we sometimes need to explain offboarding actions to compliance. Is this on the roadmap?
answer: This is a great suggestion and one we've heard from a few growing customers. Bulk deactivation with an optional reason field logged to the audit trail isn't currently available but is something our product team is evaluating for an upcoming Admin Console release. I'll pass your feedback along with the compliance use case, and I'd recommend keeping an eye on our release notes - I'll also flag your account so we can notify you directly if this ships.

subject: Billed for more seats than we actually have active
body: Our latest invoice charged us for 22 seats but we only have 18 active users on the Starter plan - we removed 4 people last month when they left the legal team. I checked the Admin Console user list and it confirms 18 active accounts. Can someone review our billing account and issue a correction or refund for the discrepancy? This is the second invoice cycle where the seat count hasn't matched.
answer: Thank you for catching this and for the details - a discrepancy across two invoice cycles definitely warrants a closer look. I'm pulling up your billing account now to compare the seat count history against your Admin Console user list; it's possible the deprovisioned users weren't fully removed from the billing sync when they were deactivated. I'll confirm the correct count and process a credit for the overcharged seats on both invoices once I've verified the numbers, likely within one business day.

subject: SSO sessions timing out after ~10 minutes for Ember Energy users
body:
Since this morning we've had multiple users report being kicked back to the login screen roughly every 10 minutes, even though they're actively using the dashboard. This started around 9am ET and affects users across at least three teams. We're on SAML SSO through our IdP and MFA is enforced for all 77 seats.

We checked our IdP session lifetime settings and nothing changed there recently. Can you confirm what the session timeout is set to on the Northwind side for our SSO integration and whether there was a recent config change?
answer:
Thanks for flagging this - a shortened session timeout affecting active users is disruptive, so I've opened this as an escalation. I can see your tenant's SSO session TTL was reset to a default value during a provisioning sync last night; I'm restoring it to your previous 8-hour setting now and will confirm once it's live.

I'll follow up within the hour to verify the fix has taken effect for your users and to check whether the provisioning sync needs any adjustment to prevent this recurring.

subject: app
body:
Our field reps use the mobile app in areas with spotty connectivity and offline mode has been broken since the last update. The app crashes on launch when there's no signal, and any data entered while offline doesn't sync once we're back online - we've lost at least two days of inspection notes from three different reps this week.

This is blocking our rollout to the rest of the team. We're on iOS 17 with the latest app version. Push notifications also stopped arriving for offline users once they reconnect.
answer:
I'm sorry about the data loss - this is a serious issue and I'm escalating it as P1 right now. Our mobile team has a known regression in the latest offline sync module that can cause the crash-on-launch behavior you're describing; we're pushing a hotfix build today.

In the meantime, please avoid closing the app fully while offline since that appears to trigger the data loss, and let us know the exact device models and app build number for your three affected reps so we can check if any of their queued data is recoverable server-side.

subject: slak alerts not showing channel name, need help setting up
body:
hey we are trying to get alerts from Northwind into our #legal-ops slak channel but the messages that come throu just say 'Alert triggered' with no context, no case name or client, nothing usefull. we followed the how-to doc but seems like the fields arent mapping right.

also is there a way to route diffrent alert types to diffrent channels? right now everything dumps into one channel and its getting noisy fast for our 12 person team.
answer:
Thanks for the details - this is a common setup issue with the Slack integration's field mapping template. It sounds like the alert payload template reverted to the default, which strips out custom fields like case name and client. I'll walk you through re-adding those fields in your integration settings, or I can apply the mapping for you if you send over one sample alert you'd like formatted correctly.

For routing to different channels, yes - you can create separate webhook connections per alert type under Integrations > Slack, and I'll include a quick guide with my next reply.

subject: Need Okta SAML app configured for our workspace before Monday launch
body:
We're rolling out Northwind to our full team on Monday and need the Okta SAML integration set up before then. I've created the app in our Okta admin console but I'm not seeing where to input the SP metadata URL or ACS URL on the Northwind side - the Integrations page only shows Salesforce and generic SAML options, not a dedicated Okta app tile.

We have 18 seats total and everyone needs to authenticate through Okta starting Monday morning. Can someone point me to the right setup flow or a metadata export we can use?
answer:
Happy to help get this ready before Monday. You'll want to use the generic SAML 2.0 option under Integrations rather than a dedicated Okta tile - I've attached our SP metadata XML and the ACS URL and Entity ID you'll need to enter into your Okta app configuration.

Once you've mapped those in Okta, send us the Okta IdP metadata URL and I'll finish the setup on our end and run a test login with you today so everything's confirmed working ahead of your Monday rollout.

subject: Late-arriving data causing revenue mismatch in monthly close
body:
During our monthly close process we noticed that transaction data from three of our regional store pipelines arrived 14-18 hours late on the 1st and 2nd of this month, which caused our revenue dashboard to show incomplete totals when we pulled the report for finance leadership. The pipeline logs show a 'delayed batch' status for job IDs 88213, 88240, and 88255.

We need to understand why these batches were delayed and whether there's a way to get an alert next time a batch is running behind schedule, since this directly affects our closing numbers.
answer:
Thanks for the job IDs - that's very helpful. Looking at 88213, 88240, and 88255, they were queued behind a larger backfill job that consumed available worker capacity in that window, which pushed their processing well past the normal SLA. This wasn't a data quality issue, just a scheduling contention problem, and the data itself is complete and accurate.

To prevent surprises like this during future close periods, I'd recommend setting up a pipeline SLA alert - I can configure one for your regional store pipelines that notifies your team if a batch runs more than 2 hours behind schedule. Let me know if you'd like me to set that up now.

subject: PDF export from dashboard cuts off charts and takes over 90 seconds
body:
We're integrating dashboard exports into our client reporting workflow via the API, and the PDF export endpoint is both very slow and producing broken output. Exports currently take 90+ seconds for a dashboard with 6 charts, and the resulting PDF cuts off the two rightmost charts entirely - they're just blank white space.

This is blocking our client delivery deadline this week since we promised automated PDF reports as part of our new offering. We're calling POST /v1/dashboards/{id}/export with format=pdf. Can this be fixed or is there a workaround we can use in the meantime?
answer:
Thanks for the clear repro details - this matches a known rendering issue where wide dashboards with more than 4 charts get truncated during PDF generation because the layout engine doesn't paginate correctly. I've filed this as a bug against the export endpoint and our team is prioritizing a fix given your deadline this week.

As a workaround in the meantime, try adding the parameter layout=stacked to your export call - this forces charts to render vertically instead of side-by-side and should prevent the cutoff while we work on a permanent fix for wide layouts.

subject: Confusing sharing permissions on dashboards - viewers can edit
body:
We've had a couple of instances where staff we intended to give view-only access to a dashboard were actually able to edit chart filters and save changes that affected other viewers. This happened twice this month with our enrollment dashboard, once affecting data that admissions staff were relying on for a report.

Looking at the sharing settings, the 'Viewer' role toggle seems to only restrict editing of the underlying data source, not the dashboard layout or filters. Could you clarify how the permission levels are supposed to work, and whether this is expected behavior or a bug?
answer:
Thanks for raising this, and I understand the concern given it affected real reporting data. This is actually expected behavior currently - the Viewer role restricts data source edits but does allow filter and layout changes, which we recognize is confusing and not aligned with what most customers expect from 'view-only' access.

I'm logging this as product feedback for our dashboards team since you're not the first to run into this. In the meantime, I'd recommend using the 'Restricted Viewer' role instead, which locks filters entirely - I can help apply that to your enrollment dashboard sharing settings if you'd like.

subject: Duplicate alert emails and wrong routing since yesterday's config change
body:
Since yesterday afternoon our on-call team has been getting every alert twice, and several critical infrastructure alerts that should route to our ops-alerts distribution list are instead going to our general notifications inbox. This started right after I updated our routing rules to add a new escalation tier for our 23 users.

We've had at least 40 duplicate emails overnight and two critical alerts that nearly got missed because they landed in the wrong inbox. Can someone help me figure out what's wrong with the routing rule config?
answer:
This is urgent given the risk of missed critical alerts, so I'm treating it as P1. It sounds like the new escalation tier you added created an overlapping rule with your existing routing logic, causing both rules to fire and send duplicates while the newer rule's destination override wasn't applied correctly to the older alert types.

Can you send me a screenshot of your current routing rules page? I want to review the rule order and destination mappings directly rather than guess, and I'll get this corrected today so your ops-alerts list is receiving critical alerts reliably again.

subject: Connector authentication failing intermittently, data sync gaps in pipeline
body:
Our main data connector has been failing authentication intermittently since Tuesday, resulting in sync gaps of 2-6 hours at a time. The error in our pipeline logs reads 'OAuth token refresh failed: invalid_grant' and it seems to recover on its own after a while, then fail again a few hours later.

This is causing real data quality issues downstream since our reports are missing records from the gap periods, and our team has had to manually reconcile data twice this week already. We need this stabilized quickly since it's affecting client-facing reports.

Connector ID is conn-warehouse-9931 if that helps narrow it down.
answer:
Thank you for including the connector ID and error text - that's very helpful and I'm escalating this immediately given the client-facing impact. The invalid_grant error on conn-warehouse-9931 typically indicates the refresh token is being invalidated, possibly due to a credential rotation on the source system's side that isn't being picked up cleanly by our connector.

I'm re-authenticating the connector now with a fresh token and adding closer monitoring on the refresh cycle. I'll confirm once it's stable and follow up with root cause details, and in the meantime I'd recommend flagging any reports covering this week's gap periods for reconciliation once we confirm the exact outage windows.

subject: Request: streamline MFA enrollment for new staff onboarding
body:
We're onboarding several hundred new staff each semester and our current MFA enrollment flow requires each person to complete setup manually on first login, which is creating a bottleneck for our IT helpdesk during peak onboarding weeks. We're using SSO with MFA enforced across all 3256 seats.

Is there a way to pre-enroll users in MFA via bulk provisioning, or set a grace period so new accounts can access core features before completing enrollment, reducing helpdesk tickets during our busiest onboarding windows?
answer:
This is a great use case and one we support - you can configure a grace period policy under Identity Settings > MFA Enforcement that allows new accounts a configurable window (commonly 3-7 days) to access core features before MFA becomes mandatory, which should ease the helpdesk load during peak onboarding.

For bulk pre-enrollment, we don't currently support pre-seeding MFA factors directly, but combining the grace period with your existing bulk provisioning via SCIM should get you most of the way there. I'll set up a short call with our identity specialist to help configure this ahead of your next onboarding wave if that's useful.

subject: Bar charts rendering blank on shared dashboards
body:
We have several dashboards in Vertex Capital's media analytics workspace where bar and line charts render as blank white boxes since this morning. The underlying data tables still show numbers correctly, and exporting to CSV works fine, but PNG/PDF export of the same dashboard produces an empty chart area. This is affecting the weekly investor report we send out every Friday.

I've tried refreshing the dashboard, clearing cache, and rebuilding the chart widget from scratch (widget id chart-88213), but the issue persists across Chrome and Firefox.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report — a blank chart with correct underlying data usually points to a rendering issue in our export pipeline rather than the data layer itself. I've escalated this to our dashboard engineering team with the widget id you provided and flagged the Friday report deadline. In the meantime, can you confirm whether this happens on all dashboards or just this one, and whether it started after any recent widget edits?

subject: Storage quota reached, can't upload new invoices
body:
Our finance team at Summit Works tried uploading this month's vendor invoices to the Storage module this morning and got an error saying we've hit our storage quota. We're only using 6 seats so I didn't expect to hit a limit this soon — we mostly store PDF invoices and a few backup exports.

Could you tell me what our current quota is and whether old backup files can be purged automatically to free up space? We need to upload three more invoice batches before end of day.
answer: I can see the quota error on your account and confirm you're currently at 98% of your allotted storage, largely from backup exports going back over a year. As a Starter plan customer you don't yet have automatic retention rules, but I can manually clear backups older than 12 months for you now if you confirm that's fine — that should free enough space for today's uploads.

subject: Quota errors slowing down uploads across legal team
body:
Since yesterday afternoon our workspace admin dashboard shows the storage quota nearly maxed out, and uploads that used to take a few seconds are now taking over a minute or timing out entirely for our legal document team (122 seats). We're getting intermittent "quota exceeded, retry later" messages even though the usage meter shows we're at 91%, not 100%.

We rely on this for case file uploads daily. Is there a way to see a breakdown of storage usage by department, and do you have documentation on setting retention policies so we stop hitting this ceiling every quarter?
answer: Thanks for flagging this — a 91% usage reading with hard quota errors suggests a discrepancy between the displayed and actual quota, which we're looking into on our end. In the meantime I've bumped your account's soft limit slightly to relieve the upload slowdowns while we investigate. I'll also send over our retention policy documentation so your team can set automated archiving rules to avoid hitting this ceiling each quarter.

subject: Hitting API rate limits on webhook retries
body:
We integrated Northwind's API Platform for our billing reconciliation workflow and started getting 429 errors on our webhook endpoint since Tuesday. Our finance system retries failed webhook deliveries automatically, but it looks like those retries are counting against our rate limit and causing a cascade of further 429s.

Can you tell us what the current rate limit is for webhook-triggered endpoints, and whether there's a recommended backoff strategy so retries don't compound the problem? We're on 22 seats and this is affecting our month-end close process.
answer: You're currently on a limit of 100 requests per minute per API key, and retries from your webhook consumer are indeed counted against that same bucket, which explains the cascading 429s. I'd recommend implementing exponential backoff with jitter on your retry logic, starting at 2 seconds — I'll send over our rate limit documentation with sample backoff code so you can adjust before month-end close.

subject: URGENT: storage quota blocking backup uploads, retention job failing
body:
Our nightly backup job to Northwind Storage has been failing since last night with quota exceeded errors, and we can't get new backups uploaded. This is a production issue for us because our retention policy deletes local copies after 24 hours, and we're now at risk of losing yesterday's data entirely if we can't get a successful backup uploaded today.

We're on Summit Retail's account, 23 seats, media vertical. Please help urgently — I need either a temporary quota increase or guidance on what to purge immediately.
answer: This is being treated as urgent given the risk to your retention window. I've applied a temporary quota increase to your storage account right now so your backup job can complete — please retry the upload and let me know if it succeeds. I'm also reviewing your usage to identify what's consuming space so we can set a permanent limit that fits your retention schedule.

subject: UNSUBSCRIBE LINKS BROKEN - USERS GETTING DUPLICATE EMAILS FOR WEEKS
body:
This is beyond frustrating. We integrated the Notifications API for our transactional emails and the unsubscribe endpoint has been silently broken for at least two weeks. Users click unsubscribe, get a 200 response, and then keep receiving duplicate emails anyway. Here's the log from our webhook handler:

```
[2024-05-14 09:12:03] POST /v1/notifications/unsubscribe status=200 user_id=88213
[2024-05-14 09:12:04] duplicate send triggered for user_id=88213 template=weekly_digest
[2024-05-14 10:03:11] POST /v1/notifications/unsubscribe status=200 user_id=90441
[2024-05-14 10:03:12] duplicate send triggered for user_id=90441 template=weekly_digest
```

We've had SEVEN complaints from clients this week about spam-like behavior and this is damaging our reputation. Your documentation says unsubscribe should be immediate and idempotent. If this isn't fixed in 48 hours we will be canceling our contract and moving to a competitor.
answer: I understand the seriousness here and I'm sorry for the impact on your client relationships — this has been escalated to our Notifications engineering team as a P1 immediately. From the log you shared, it looks like the unsubscribe flag is being set but not checked before the digest send job runs, which we're actively reproducing on our end. I'll follow up within a few hours with a root cause update and a fix timeline, and please let us know if any further duplicate sends occur in the meantime.

subject: Need guidance on upload failures and storage documentation
body: I'm a product manager at Orion Systems and our small team (3 seats) has been running into upload failures when trying to add product spec files to Storage — files over roughly 50MB seem to fail silently, no error message, just a stuck progress bar. We'd also like to request better documentation on what file size and quota limits apply to our plan, since we couldn't find clear numbers anywhere.
answer: Thanks for reaching out — on the Starter plan, individual file uploads are capped at 50MB, which explains the silent failure you're seeing; ideally we'd surface a clearer error message there and I've logged that as a product feedback item. I'll also send over our current storage limits documentation, and in the meantime you can split larger spec files or compress them to get under the cap.

subject: Feedback on rate limit tiers and upcoming API deprecations
body: As IT admin for Delta Partners I want to flag two things regarding the API Platform. First, our webhook consumers regularly hit rate limits during peak traffic (we're on 115 seats, Pro plan), and we'd like to understand if there's a higher tier or burst allowance available. Second, I noticed the changelog mentions the v1 webhook signature format is being deprecated — do you have a migration timeline and documentation for moving to v2 signatures?
answer: Good timing on both questions — for rate limits, Pro plan accounts can request a burst allowance increase, and I can submit that request for your account now if you'd like to try a higher ceiling during peak hours. On the v1 to v2 webhook signature deprecation, the migration window closes in about 90 days; I'll send over the migration guide and sample verification code so your team can update ahead of the deadline.

subject: Card declined repeatedly, need refund on failed retry charges
body: I'm handling this on behalf of Quill Labs's finance side since I noticed multiple failed payment attempts on our invoice history. Our card was declined three times between the 3rd and 6th of this month due to a bank-side issue that's now resolved, but I see we were still charged a small retry fee each time per invoice INV-33210. Could you confirm if those retry fees can be refunded now that the card issue is fixed and payment has gone through successfully?
answer: Thanks for the update, and glad to hear the card issue is resolved. I've pulled up invoice INV-33210 and can confirm three retry attempts were logged between the 3rd and 6th — I'll process a refund for the associated retry fees back to your card on file, which should appear within 5-7 business days. Let me know if you'd like me to also review your billing contact to prevent future retry notifications from being missed.

subject: Need to rotate API keys without breaking active webhooks
body: We're planning a scheduled API key rotation for North Energy's education platform integration (Pro plan, 248 seats) and want to confirm the correct process so our SDK and webhook subscriptions don't break mid-rotation. Currently we have two active keys tied to webhook endpoint wh-77204 and want to migrate to a new key while keeping delivery uninterrupted. Is there a grace period where both old and new keys are valid simultaneously, or do webhooks need to be manually re-registered under the new key?
answer: For key rotation without downtime, both old and new API keys remain valid for a 24-hour overlap window once the new key is generated, so webhook endpoint wh-77204 will continue delivering under either key during that period — no manual re-registration needed. Once you confirm the new key is working correctly in your SDK integration, you can revoke the old key from the dashboard and it'll stop accepting new requests immediately.

subject: Restore procedure for Storage bucket wa-media-archive-03
body:
We need to restore the wa-media-archive-03 bucket to its state as of March 14th before the retention job pruned a batch of assets we still needed for a client deliverable. Can you confirm the retention policy documentation we have on file (v2.1) still matches how restores are executed, and whether restores pull from the nightly snapshot or the continuous replication log?

We'd also like feedback on whether re-uploading the same files after restore could create duplicate versions, since we have roughly 40,000 objects in that bucket and want to avoid doubling storage costs.
answer: Thanks for the detailed context. For bucket wa-media-archive-03, restores are served from the nightly snapshot layer, not the continuous replication log, so the closest recovery point to March 14th would be the snapshot taken that night at 02:00 UTC. I'll open a change request to run the restore and will confirm the exact object count recovered before you re-upload anything, so we avoid version duplication on your end.

subject: Jira integration broken - issues not creating from Slack alerts
body:
Since yesterday our Jira link inside Northwind Integrations has stopped creating tickets when alerts come in from Slack. We rely on this to auto-file bugs from our on-call channel, and right now nothing is showing up in the Jira project even though the Slack messages are posting fine.

The integration status page shows Jira as 'connected' but the last successful sync timestamp is stuck at yesterday 9:14am. We only have 4 seats on this plan but this workflow is critical for our small support team - can someone look into this today?
answer: I understand this is blocking your on-call workflow, so I've escalated this to P1 and we're looking into it now. The stuck sync timestamp suggests the Jira OAuth token may have expired or the webhook delivery is failing silently on our side - I'll check the integration logs for your workspace and get back to you within the hour with findings or a fix.

subject: Update to IP allowlist for admin console access
body:
We're rolling out a new office location and need to add two additional IP ranges to our Admin Console allowlist. Could you point me to the current documentation on how allowlist changes propagate, and whether there's any performance impact on login when the list grows past 20 entries? We currently have 14 entries configured.

Also, we'd like to confirm that changes to the allowlist are captured in the audit log with the admin's identity and timestamp, since our security team reviews that monthly.
answer: Allowlist changes are recorded in the audit log with the acting admin's account and a UTC timestamp, so your monthly review process will capture these updates automatically. Adding entries beyond 20 doesn't introduce any measurable login latency in our testing - I've attached the current allowlist documentation link, and you're welcome to add the two new ranges yourself via Settings, or send them over and I can add them for you.

subject: SSO login failing for finance role after mapping change
body:
We updated our role mapping in Identity and SSO last week to route finance users into a new group, and now several of us are getting locked out at login. I'm getting this in the browser console when I try to sign in:

AuthError: role_mapping_conflict
  at SSOHandler.resolveRole (sso-core.js:212)
  at LoginFlow.authenticate (login.js:88)
  code: 409
  detail: "user matches multiple mapped roles"

This is blocking me and two other finance team members from accessing invoicing tools this morning. Can you help us fix the mapping so we're not stuck?
answer: Sorry for the disruption this morning - a 409 role_mapping_conflict means your SSO provider is sending group claims that match more than one mapped role simultaneously, likely a leftover overlap from the old mapping. I'm reviewing your tenant's role mapping configuration now and will either clean up the conflicting rule or give you the exact grouping to remove on your IdP side within the next hour so your finance team can get back in.

subject: Dashboards loading slowly since last week
body:
Our sales dashboards have been taking 15-20 seconds to load charts since around last Tuesday, compared to the usual 2-3 seconds. This is affecting about 40 managers who check these each morning. We haven't changed the underlying data sources recently, just added two new chart widgets to the main dashboard.

Could you look into whether the new widgets are causing the slowdown, and if there's a recommended limit on charts per dashboard? We'd also like feedback on whether exporting to PDF is contributing to the load time, since export usage has gone up this month too.
answer: Thanks for the details - two additional widgets combined with a busier export schedule can definitely add load, especially if any of the new charts are running unoptimized queries against large tables. I'll pull the query performance logs for your main dashboard to see which widget is the bottleneck, and I'll also check whether concurrent PDF exports are competing for the same rendering resources. I'll follow up with findings and a recommended chart limit shortly.

subject: Requesting Okta app integration for our workspace
body:
We'd like to set up the Okta app integration for our Northwind workspace so we can manage user provisioning centrally instead of adding people manually. Right now we're a small team of 12 and growing, and we also use Jira for issue tracking - it would be great if the Okta setup could eventually tie into that as well.

Can you let us know what's needed on our end to get the Okta app configured, and whether there's a setup guide we can follow ourselves?
answer: Happy to help get Okta set up for your workspace. You'll need admin access on both the Okta and Northwind sides to configure the SAML app and SCIM provisioning - I'll send over our setup guide which walks through both steps. Jira-Okta tie-in isn't automatic today since they're separate integrations, but once Okta provisioning is live we can look at how your Jira access rules could align with the same groups.

subject: SDK ERRORS BREAKING OUR PRODUCTION INTEGRATION
body:
WE STARTED SEEING SDK ERRORS THIS MORNING AROUND 7AM ON OUR NODE INTEGRATION. EVERY API CALL THROUGH THE SDK IS RETURNING A 429 EVEN THOUGH WE ARE WELL UNDER OUR NORMAL USAGE. THIS IS AFFECTING OUR ENERGY REPORTING FEED THAT RUNS EVERY 15 MINUTES AND IT HAS FAILED FOUR TIMES SO FAR TODAY.

WE UPDATED THE SDK TO VERSION 4.2.1 LAST WEEK, COULD THAT BE CAUSING THIS? WE NEED THIS FIXED SOON SINCE OUR REPORTING JOB IS FALLING BEHIND.
answer: Thanks for flagging this right away - a jump to 429s without a usage increase does point to something introduced in SDK 4.2.1, possibly a change in how retry backoff or request batching is handled. I'm checking the rate limit logs on your account now to see if requests are being sent more frequently than intended, and I'll also check known issues with that SDK version. I'll update you within the hour with either a config fix or a recommendation to roll back to 4.1.x in the meantime.

subject: Question about upcoming API deprecations
body:
I saw a note in the changelog about some API endpoints being deprecated next quarter, but I wasn't clear on which ones apply to our current integration. We're using the older v1 billing endpoints and the SDK version that shipped around a year ago, and I want to understand if we need to budget time for migration work.

Could you send a list of what's being deprecated and by what date, along with whether our current rate limits will change as part of this?
answer: Good timing to ask - the v1 billing endpoints are on the deprecation list with a sunset date at the end of next quarter, and the SDK version you're on will stop receiving updates around the same time. Rate limits themselves aren't changing, only the endpoint paths and a few response field names. I'll send over the full deprecation list with migration notes so your team can plan the SDK upgrade at a comfortable pace.

subject: Invoice amount doesn't match our seat count
body:
Our latest invoice charged us for 10 seats but we only have 8 active users on the account. I checked the admin panel and confirmed 8 seats are provisioned, no pending invites. This is the second invoice in a row with the mismatch, and it's causing issues with our internal expense approval since finance is asking why the numbers don't line up.

Can someone review our billing account and correct the invoice, or explain why the seat count differs from what we see in the panel?
answer: I'm sorry for the confusion this has caused with your expense approvals - I'm pulling up your billing account now to compare the invoiced seat count against your provisioning history. This looks like it may be a billing sync delay from a prior seat change that didn't get reconciled. I'll have a corrected explanation or an adjusted invoice for you within the next business day.

subject: Repeated transform failures in logistics sync pipeline
body:
Our main data pipeline that syncs shipment records from our warehouse connector has been failing at the transform stage intermittently over the past week, roughly 3-4 times a day. The failures don't show a consistent pattern - sometimes it's a batch of 500 records, sometimes 2,000. Latency on the connector itself looks normal in the dashboard.

We'd like to request either a way to see more detailed error output per failed transform step, or a retry mechanism that doesn't require us to manually rerun the whole pipeline each time. Right now we're losing time reprocessing full batches when only a subset actually failed.
answer: Thanks for the clear breakdown - inconsistent batch sizes failing at the transform stage while connector latency stays normal suggests the issue is likely in how records are being validated mid-transform rather than upstream. I'll pull the pipeline execution logs to identify what's triggering the failures, and I'll also log your request for per-step error detail and partial-batch retry as a feature request, since that would help a number of our pipeline customers.

subject: Duplicate email digests being sent to travel desk teams
body: We've noticed our weekly email digests from Notifications are arriving twice, sometimes three times, to the same recipients across our travel desk teams. This started around March 3rd and is affecting roughly 200 users based on internal reports. Could you also let us know if there's a way to customize the send time per region? Right now everyone gets the digest at 9am UTC regardless of timezone.
answer: Thanks for flagging this - duplicate digests are usually caused by overlapping schedule rules or a retry loop on our delivery worker. We're pulling delivery logs for your workspace since March 3rd to confirm the pattern and will follow up with root cause within one business day. On the timezone question, per-region send time customization isn't available today but I'll log it as a feature request with our product team.

subject: Urgent
body: Our IP allowlist settings in Admin Console got wiped this morning around 7:40am. We had 12 specific ranges configured for our manufacturing plant VPNs and now the list shows empty, which means anyone can access the admin console from any IP right now. This is a serious security exposure for us - please restore the previous configuration immediately or tell us how to lock down access manually until it's fixed.
answer: This is being escalated to our on-call incident team right now as a P0 security exposure. As an immediate mitigation, please re-add temporary allowlist entries manually from the Admin Console settings page while we investigate why your configured ranges were cleared - we'll have an engineer join within the next 15 minutes with findings and a restoration plan.

subject: Transform failures blocking retail inventory sync
body: Since yesterday afternoon our nightly transform jobs in Data Pipelines have been failing for the retail inventory connector. The job log shows "transform step 'normalize_sku' exceeded timeout after 300s" and we've had three consecutive failed runs now, meaning our downstream reporting is 24 hours behind. We rely on this data for daily reconciliation so this is blocking our finance close process.
answer: I'm sorry for the disruption to your reconciliation process - I've opened a P1 investigation into the normalize_sku timeout on your inventory connector. Initial logs suggest the transform step may be hitting a resource limit given increased row volume; we're checking whether a recent data spike is the cause and will push a fix or manual re-run within the next few hours, with updates as we progress.

subject: Plan upgrade charged but seats not updated
body: We upgraded from Starter to a higher tier last week to add more seats for our fintech team, and the payment went through per the invoice we received. However, our account still shows only 6 seats available and new team members can't be added - they get an error saying "seat limit reached." This is blocking onboarding for two new hires starting Monday.
answer: Thanks for the details - I can see the successful payment on your account but the seat count didn't sync after the upgrade, which is a known issue we're actively fixing. I'm manually updating your seat allocation now so your new hires can be added before Monday, and I'll confirm here once it's applied, likely within the next hour.

subject: Question on workspace settings and audit log retention
body: I'm reviewing our workspace settings in Admin Console ahead of an internal compliance review and wanted to check how long audit log entries are retained for our plan, since I can't find this documented anywhere. I'd also like to know if deactivated user accounts still appear in the allowlist configuration or if they're automatically removed.
answer: Good questions - for your current plan, audit log entries are retained for 90 days, and I'll flag this for our docs team since it's currently missing from the help center. Deactivated accounts remain visible in allowlist configuration but are marked inactive rather than being auto-removed, so you may want to clean those up manually as part of your review.

subject: Fehler bei Transformationsjobs in Data Pipelines
body: Uns ist aufgefallen, dass einige unserer Transformationsjobs in der Data Pipelines-Anwendung in den letzten Tagen mit Verzögerung laufen. Die Jobs benötigen teilweise über zwei Stunden statt der üblichen 20 Minuten. Können Sie uns erklären, woran das liegen könnte und ob es eine Möglichkeit gibt, die Priorität einzelner Connector-Jobs manuell zu erhöhen?
answer: Vielen Dank für Ihre Nachricht. Verzögerungen dieser Art treten meist auf, wenn mehrere Connector-Jobs gleichzeitig große Datenmengen verarbeiten und sich dadurch in der Warteschlange stauen. Aktuell gibt es keine Möglichkeit, die Priorität einzelner Jobs manuell zu setzen, wir haben dies aber als Feature-Wunsch an unser Produktteam weitergegeben. Wir prüfen zusätzlich die Warteschlangenauslastung Ihres Workspace und melden uns mit weiteren Details.

subject: Late-arriving data causing sync gaps in travel bookings pipeline
body: We've noticed that data from our booking connector is arriving up to 6 hours late in Data Pipelines, which causes gaps in our reconciliation reports for the previous day. This has happened on at least four occasions over the past two weeks, most recently on the 14th. Is there a way to configure the pipeline to hold report generation until all expected records land, or get an alert when data is running late?
answer: Thanks for the detailed timeline - late-arriving records from booking connectors are a common challenge, and right now Data Pipelines doesn't have a built-in hold-and-wait mechanism for report generation, though we do support configurable watermark delays that can reduce gaps. I'll walk you through setting a watermark delay for your connector and will also submit your alerting request to our product team as it's a reasonable gap in current functionality.

subject: PDF export failing for large retail dashboards
body: Multiple users across our retail analytics team are unable to export dashboards to PDF since yesterday. The export starts, shows a progress bar for about 30 seconds, then fails with "Export failed: rendering error." This is happening consistently on our largest dashboard with 14 charts, but smaller dashboards export fine. We have a board meeting tomorrow morning and need these reports.
answer: I understand the urgency given your meeting tomorrow - this looks like a rendering timeout tied to dashboards with a high chart count, and I've escalated it as P1. As a workaround in the meantime, try splitting the dashboard into two smaller views or exporting chart groups separately, which should avoid the timeout. Our engineering team is looking at the rendering pipeline now and I'll update you as soon as we have a fix or a firmer timeline.

subject: PDF EXPORT COMPLETELY BROKEN AND NO ONE IS HELPING
body: THIS IS THE THIRD DAY OUR PDF EXPORTS HAVE BEEN BROKEN AND WE HAVE CLIENTS WAITING ON REPORTS. EVERY TIME I CLICK EXPORT ON ANY DASHBOARD IT JUST SPINS FOREVER AND NEVER DOWNLOADS. I HAVE TRIED THREE DIFFERENT CHARTS AND DIFFERENT BROWSERS AND NOTHING WORKS. WE ARE A TINY TEAM AND THIS IS BLOCKING EVERYTHING WE DO. IF THIS ISN'T FIXED TODAY WE ARE CANCELLING OUR SUBSCRIPTION AND MOVING TO A COMPETITOR.
answer: I'm very sorry for the disruption this is causing your team and I've escalated this to P1 immediately. Can you confirm the exact dashboard name or ID and roughly what time you last attempted an export, so our engineers can pull the specific failure logs? We're actively investigating a known export rendering issue right now and I will personally follow up with you today with either a fix or a working export path.

subject: Connector authentication failing intermittently for healthcare data sync
body: Our connector to our patient records system in Data Pipelines has started failing authentication intermittently since Monday. About 1 in 5 sync attempts return "401 Unauthorized: token refresh failed" even though the credentials haven't changed on our end. This is causing gaps in our nightly sync and we need this resolved quickly since it affects data availability for our care coordination team.
answer: Thank you for the clear details - intermittent 401 errors with token refresh usually point to a race condition in how the connector renews its auth token during concurrent sync attempts, and given the healthcare context I've marked this P1. We're reviewing your connector's auth logs since Monday now and will follow up shortly with either a configuration fix or a patch, along with guidance on re-running the missed nightly syncs once resolved.

subject: Incorrect line items on latest invoice
body: Our October invoice (INV-88231) shows 94 seats billed at the Pro rate, but we downgraded 10 seats to view-only on Sept 18th per your billing portal. The line item total is $1,410 instead of the expected $1,260. This is the second month in a row this has happened - September's invoice had a similar discrepancy that support corrected manually. Can someone check why the seat downgrade isn't reflecting in invoice generation?
answer: Thanks for flagging this - I can see the mismatch between your seat downgrade date and the billing snapshot used for INV-88231. It looks like our plan sync job ran before your downgrade took effect, so it billed against the prior seat count. I'm issuing a credit adjustment for the difference and escalating the sync timing issue to engineering so it doesn't recur next cycle. You should see the corrected invoice within 2 business days.

subject: Requesting update to crash-on-launch troubleshooting doc
body: We've had three of our field reps report the Northwind mobile app crashing immediately on launch after updating to iOS 17.4, mostly when the device was offline at the time. The current help center article only covers Android crash steps. Could you update the troubleshooting guide to include an offline-mode workaround for iOS, or point me to internal steps I can share with our team while we wait on a fix?
answer: Good catch - the iOS offline crash scenario isn't documented yet, so I understand the confusion. In the meantime, have affected users force-quit the app, enable airplane mode off, then relaunch with a network connection active; this clears the cached session state causing the crash. I've submitted a request to add this workaround to the public doc and will follow up here once it's published.

subject: SCIM group provisioning returning slow response times
body: I'm integrating our HR system with Northwind's SCIM endpoint for user provisioning across 14 seats. Group PATCH requests to /scim/v2/Groups/{id} are taking 8-12 seconds on average, sometimes timing out our client at the 10s mark. This started roughly this week - earlier syncs in August were consistently under 1 second. Can you confirm if there's a known performance issue on the SCIM provisioning service right now?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report and timing data. We've had reports of elevated latency on the SCIM Groups endpoint tied to a backend index rebuild that started this week - engineering is aware and actively working on it. As a short-term mitigation, I'd recommend increasing your client timeout to 15s to avoid failed syncs, and I'll update this ticket as soon as we have confirmation the latency has returned to normal.

subject: Users unable to unsubscribe from notification emails - duplicates sent
body: Several of our staff clicked 'unsubscribe' on Northwind notification emails over the past two days but are still receiving duplicate alerts - one person got the same billing reminder four times this morning. The unsubscribe link takes them to a confirmation page saying they've been removed, but the emails keep coming. This is generating complaints internally and we need it resolved quickly since it looks like a compliance issue on our end.
answer: I understand the urgency here, especially with the compliance concern. This matches a known issue where the unsubscribe preference isn't propagating to our notification queue in time, causing duplicate sends from cached recipient lists. I'm escalating this to our notifications team as a priority fix and manually suppressing further sends to the affected addresses in the meantime - please send me the impacted email addresses or user IDs so I can confirm suppression on our end.

subject: Biometric login failing after last app update
body: After pushing the latest Northwind mobile app update to our 10 company devices, Face ID login is failing for everyone with a generic 'Authentication error, please try again' message. Password login still works fine. This started right after the update rolled out yesterday afternoon. Devices are a mix of iPhone 13 and 14, all on iOS 17.5. Can you confirm if this is a known regression?
answer: Thanks for reporting this with the device and OS details - we've had a couple of similar reports since yesterday's release, so this looks like a regression in the biometric auth module for iOS 17.5 devices specifically. I'm escalating to our mobile team now and will update you as soon as we have a fix timeline. In the meantime, password login remains the reliable fallback for your team.

subject: Pagination bricht bei großen API-Antworten ab
body: Seit heute Morgen (ca. 08:15 Uhr) bekommen wir bei Anfragen an /api/v2/content mit mehr als 500 Einträgen pro Seite einen Fehler 'invalid cursor token' zurück, sobald wir den next_cursor aus der vorherigen Antwort verwenden. Das betrifft unsere komplette Content-Synchronisation und alle 13 Nutzer sind aktuell blockiert, da unser Import-Job seit Stunden fehlschlägt. Wir haben nichts an unserer Integration geändert - läuft bei euch aktuell ein Deployment?
answer: Danke für die schnelle Meldung - das deckt sich mit einem Problem, das seit dem heutigen Deployment auf der Pagination-Schicht aufgetreten ist. Wir rollen die Änderung gerade zurück und ich halte Sie hier auf dem Laufenden, sobald der cursor token wieder normal funktioniert. Als Zwischenlösung können Sie die Seitengröße vorübergehend auf 100 reduzieren, das umgeht den Fehler bei den meisten Anfragen.

subject: Widespread card decline errors during checkout renewal
body: We're seeing a spike in failed card payments across our 293-seat account starting this morning - our billing team reports at least 15 employees unable to renew add-on licenses, all getting 'card declined - error code 51' even with valid cards that worked last cycle. This is blocking access for several teams who need those add-ons active today. Is there an issue with your payment processor right now?
answer: This is being treated as high priority given the scale of impact. We've confirmed an issue with our payment processor rejecting a subset of transactions with error code 51 starting around 6am today, and our billing engineering team is actively working with the processor to resolve it. I'll update you within the hour with status, and in the meantime I'm flagging your affected licenses so they aren't suspended while payments retry.

subject: Requesting itemized invoice breakdown by feature usage
body: For our internal cost reporting, I need our recent invoices to break down charges by feature (API calls, storage, notifications) rather than a single lump sum. Currently our invoices just show one line item for the Starter plan total across our 25 seats. Is it possible to get a more granular invoice format, or is there a usage report I can pull that maps to billing periods?
answer: Great question - currently the Starter plan invoices are generated as a single consolidated line item, but you can get the granular breakdown you're after through the Usage Reports section in the billing portal, which maps API, storage, and notification consumption to each billing cycle. I'll also pass your request for itemized invoice line items along to our product team as a feature suggestion since it's come up from a few customers recently.

subject: urgant - files disapearing before retention perido ends
body: hi we noticed that some uploaded files in our storage bucket are getting deleted way before the retention period we set (90 days). we set it up in august and now some docs from just 3 weeks ago are already gone, we checked the quota and were only at 60% so its not a capacity issue. this is a big problem for us bc some of these are financial recoreds we need for audits, can someone check whats going on asap
answer: Thank you for the detailed report, and I understand the urgency given these are financial records needed for audit purposes. This isn't expected behavior for a 90-day retention setting, so I'm escalating this immediately to our storage team to investigate whether files are being incorrectly flagged by an expiration job. In the meantime, please avoid making further retention policy changes on that bucket, and send me the exact file names or IDs that were deleted so we can check backup recovery options.

subject: SAML attribute mapping question for MFA enforcement
body: I'm setting up SAML SSO for our workspace and want to enforce MFA at the identity provider level rather than through Northwind directly. Does Northwind's SAML integration respect an AuthnContextClassRef attribute from our IdP to confirm MFA was completed, or do we need to configure MFA separately inside Northwind's admin settings as well? Trying to avoid duplicate MFA prompts for our 14 users.
answer: Good question - Northwind's SAML integration does read the AuthnContextClassRef attribute from your IdP assertion, so if your IdP enforces MFA and passes that context correctly, Northwind will honor it and won't prompt for MFA again on our side. Just make sure MFA enforcement is disabled in Northwind's admin security settings for SSO-authenticated users, otherwise you may still see a duplicate prompt during login.

subject: Webhook signing secret missing from API key docs
body: I'm setting up webhook verification for our billing exports and rotated our API key on Delta Capital's account this morning (key ending 7f2a). The documentation page for API Keys doesn't mention where to find the webhook signing secret, and the field isn't shown in the dashboard either. Could you point me to the right doc or confirm this is a gap that needs fixing?
answer: Thanks for flagging this - you're right that the webhook signing secret section was dropped from the last docs update. I've confirmed it's a documentation bug and I'm looping in the docs team to get it restored today. In the meantime, the signing secret is available under Settings > API Keys > Webhook Details; I'll send you a direct link once I verify it renders correctly for your account.

subject: help
body: we are seeing a massive spike in 429 rate limit errors since about 40 minutes ago across all our production API calls. at the same time we noticed authenticated requests coming from IP ranges we don't recognize using our production key. we're on an older SDK version (2.3.1) that i think got deprecated last month, not sure if that's related. need someone to look at this right now, this is affecting all 114 of our users.
answer: This has been escalated immediately to our security on-call team given the possibility of key compromise combined with the traffic spike. Please rotate your production API key right now from the dashboard and let us know once done so we can trace the unrecognized IP activity against your old key. We're also pulling logs on the deprecated SDK 2.3.1 endpoint to see if it's contributing to the rate limit spike, and will update you within the hour.

subject: SCIM group mapping and permission scopes for provisioning
body: We're configuring SCIM provisioning from Okta into Northwind for North Capital's 80 seats and want to map Okta groups to specific Northwind roles beyond just admin and member. The current setup guide only covers user creation and deactivation, not group-to-permission mapping. Could you point us to documentation on custom role mapping via SCIM, or confirm if this requires manual configuration per group?
answer: Custom role mapping via SCIM is supported, but it does require setting up attribute mappings on the Okta side that correspond to our role IDs, which isn't fully covered in the current setup guide - I'll get that updated. In the meantime, I'm sending you our internal reference for the role ID list and an example Okta attribute statement configuration so you can map groups to roles without waiting on the doc update.

subject: Storage quota showing full after deleting old backups
body: Our storage usage dashboard still shows 98% quota used even though our team deleted around 40GB of old backup files last week. New uploads for our monthly compliance reports are now failing with a quota exceeded message. Can you check if there's a delay in quota recalculation, or if the deleted files are still counted somewhere in the system?
answer: Storage quota recalculation typically runs within a few hours of deletion, so a full week's discrepancy suggests the deleted backups may still be sitting in a retention or trash state rather than fully purged. I'll check Atlas Legal's account to confirm whether those files are pending permanent deletion and get the quota figure corrected; I'll follow up with the updated number shortly.

subject: Users getting error after SAML redirect from IdP
body: Several of our support team members are reporting an error page after they authenticate through our IdP and get redirected back to Northwind - the message just says 'Login could not be completed.' It doesn't happen every time, and MFA is enforced on our IdP side. Is there a way to see more detail on what's failing during that final SAML assertion step?
answer: That generic error usually points to an assertion validation issue, often a clock skew or attribute mismatch between the IdP and Northwind's expected NameID format. I'll pull the SAML login logs for Summit Health for the affected timeframe so we can see the specific rejection reason, and I'll follow up with the exact attribute or timestamp discrepancy once I have it.

subject: Duplicate alert emails going out after routing change
body: Since yesterday's update to our alert routing rules, our ops team is receiving duplicate copies of the same pipeline failure alerts, sometimes 3 or 4 emails for a single event. We only have one routing rule configured for the 'pipeline-errors' tag, so I'm not sure why it's fanning out. This is causing confusion for the 24 people on our team trying to triage real issues.
answer: Thanks for the detail - duplicate deliveries after a routing rule change usually mean an old rule wasn't fully deactivated and is still matching alongside the new one. I'll check Quill Energy's alert routing configuration for any overlapping rules on the pipeline-errors tag and disable the duplicate, then confirm with you once a test alert comes through clean.

subject: PDF EXPORT IS RUINING OUR CLIENT MEETING
body: We've been using the Dashboards export feature for weekly client reports for months without issue. Last Tuesday we noticed export times getting longer, and this week it just stopped working entirely for our largest dashboard. Support Tags on our end show Sharing and Export both flagged as problems in our internal tracker before I even opened this ticket.
answer: I'm sorry for the disruption this is causing right before your client meeting - I'm escalating this to P1 immediately and pulling in the dashboards engineering team to investigate the export failure on your largest dashboard. Can you send us the dashboard ID or share link so we can reproduce the exact failure? We'll prioritize a fix or workaround today.

subject: Dashboards taking a long time to load charts
body: A few of our team's dashboards with multiple chart widgets have been noticeably slower to load over the past week, sometimes 8-10 seconds before charts render fully. It's not blocking work, just annoying during daily standups when we're switching between views. Wanted to flag it in case it's a known performance issue on your end.
answer: Thanks for the heads up - this isn't a widespread outage we're currently tracking, but chart-heavy dashboards can slow down as widget count grows. I'll take a look at the specific dashboards on Quill Health's account to see if there's a caching or query optimization we can apply, and I'll report back with findings.

subject: Custom SAML role mapping beyond admin/member
body: We'd like to map our IdP groups to more granular custom roles in Northwind rather than just admin or member, similar to what's possible with SCIM group mapping. Right now our SSO setup for Ember Works only lets us assign the two default roles at login, which is limiting for our billing and support sub-teams. Is custom role mapping via SAML attributes on your roadmap, or already configurable somehow?
answer: Custom role mapping via SAML attribute statements is something we support for select accounts through a configuration flag, though it's not yet exposed in the self-serve UI. I'll open a request on our end to enable it for Ember Works and send you the attribute naming convention we require so your IdP team can start mapping groups to specific roles.

subject: chnage slack alret channel for notifcations
body: hi we curently get all our slack alerts in the #general channl for our whole team and its getting to noisy, can we chnage it so billing alerts go to a seperate channel like #finance-alerts instead. we dont use okta or salesforce integraton much but jira is conected too if that matters. just need this switched before end of month if possible.
answer: No problem, this is a quick configuration change - I'll update the Slack integration for Blue Academy so billing alerts route to #finance-alerts while keeping the other notification types in #general. I'll confirm once it's live, well before end of month, and let you know if any Jira-related alerts need separate routing too.

subject: Webhook API v1 dead - no warning
body: Webhook API deprecated overnight, no warning. Fix now or we cancel.
answer: I'm sorry for the disruption this caused - escalating to P1 right now. Deprecations should always come with a migration window, and we're checking why that didn't happen here. Can you send the account ID and the specific endpoint or SDK version you were calling? In the meantime I'll get engineering to confirm whether a temporary rollback is possible while we sort out a migration path for you.

subject: Request to update IP allowlist for admin console
body: We're opening a new office location and need to update our IP allowlist in Admin Console. Can you confirm the process for adding CIDR 203.0.113.0/24 and removing the old range 198.51.100.0/24? We'd also like confirmation this change is captured in the audit log for our compliance review, and what the escalation path is if propagation takes longer than 24 hours.
answer: Thanks for the details - adding or removing ranges in Admin Console under Security > IP Allowlist will automatically create an audit log entry with the admin who made the change and a timestamp.
