Go ahead and add 203.0.113.0/24 first, then remove 198.51.100.0/24 once you've confirmed the new range works, so you don't lock yourselves out. If propagation exceeds 24 hours, reply here and we'll escalate to the security team directly.

subject: Slack alerts not firing for pipeline failures
body: We integrated Slack alerts through Northwind Integrations last week to notify our #data-eng channel on pipeline failures. Since Tuesday, no alerts have come through even though 6 pipeline runs failed. The integration status page shows 'Connected' and no errors logged. We also use Jira and Salesforce connectors, which seem unaffected.
answer: Thanks for the clear writeup. This sounds like a webhook delivery issue on the Slack side rather than a broken connector, since status still shows Connected. Can you confirm the Slack channel's webhook URL hasn't changed and check if your workspace admin revoked any app permissions recently? We'll also pull delivery logs for the last 6 failed runs on our end to see if requests were even sent.

subject: Upgrading to add more seats and features
body: We're evaluating an upgrade to accommodate 60 additional users across our logistics ops team. Could you send pricing for the next tier and confirm whether the upgraded plan includes priority invoicing terms? We'd like the new seats reflected on our next invoice cycle starting the 1st if possible.
answer: Happy to help with this. I'll have our billing team put together a quote for the additional 60 seats along with the next tier's feature and invoicing terms, and confirm the earliest date we can align the change with your billing cycle. You should have the quote and cycle confirmation within one business day.

subject: Salesforce sync lagging significantly
body: Our Salesforce integration has been syncing contact records with a growing delay - what used to take under 5 minutes now takes over 45 minutes as of this week. We have roughly 12,000 records syncing daily. Could someone review our sync configuration and let us know if adjusting sync frequency or batch size would help?
answer: Thanks for flagging this - a jump from 5 to 45 minutes at that record volume points to either a batch size limit or a rate-limit throttle kicking in on the Salesforce side. We're pulling your sync job logs now to check for retries or throttling events. In the meantime, could you confirm your current batch size setting so we can compare it against the recommended value for your record volume?

subject: Need to deactivate former employee accounts
body: Two employees left our company this month and we need their Northwind accounts deactivated immediately to keep our audit log clean ahead of an upcoming compliance review. Could you confirm the deactivation steps in Admin Console, or handle it directly for accounts under our workspace?
answer: Understood - I can walk you through it or handle it directly if you send the two account emails or user IDs. In Admin Console, go to Users, select each account, and choose Deactivate; this immediately revokes access and logs the action with a timestamp in your audit trail. Let me know if you'd like us to process the deactivations on our end instead.

subject: Scheduled sync running late every night
body: Our nightly scheduled sync job for the energy pricing feed has been running 2-3 hours later than its configured 1am start time for the past week. Downstream reports are stale until mid-morning. Is there a known issue with the scheduler, or could our connector configuration be causing the delay?
answer: Thanks for the details. We haven't seen a broader scheduler issue reported, so this is likely specific to your pipeline's queue or connector settings. Can you share the pipeline ID so we can check the run history and see whether it's queuing behind another job or waiting on an upstream data source? We'll get back to you with findings shortly.

subject: Dashboards laden sehr langsam
body: Unsere Dashboards laden seit einigen Tagen extrem langsam, teilweise über 20 Sekunden bis alle Widgets angezeigt werden. Wir nutzen aktuell vier Lizenzen und exportieren regelmäßig Berichte für unser Team. Gibt es eine Möglichkeit, die Ladezeit zu verbessern oder eine Funktion, um Dashboards vorab zu cachen?
answer: Danke für die Meldung. Ladezeiten von über 20 Sekunden sind ungewöhnlich, besonders bei eurer Lizenzgröße. Könnt ihr uns sagen, wie viele Widgets und Datenquellen in dem betroffenen Dashboard eingebunden sind? Aktuell gibt es keine automatische Vorab-Caching-Funktion, aber wir prüfen gerne, ob eine Optimierung der Abfragen oder eine reduzierte Aktualisierungsrate die Ladezeit verbessern kann.

subject: Audit log missing entries - urgent compliance issue
body: We rely on the Admin Console audit log for healthcare compliance reporting, and as of this morning entries from the past 6 hours are completely missing - roughly 400 admin actions across our 4,359 seat org aren't showing up. This is blocking our scheduled compliance export due today. Please advise immediately.
answer: This has been escalated to P1 immediately given the compliance deadline. We're pulling backend logs now to confirm whether the entries were lost or are simply delayed in indexing, and will update you within the hour with either a fix or a manual export of the missing window. Please hold off on submitting your compliance export until we confirm the data is complete.

subject: Biometric login crashing mobile app
body: Since updating to the latest Northwind mobile app version, biometric login (Face ID) crashes the app immediately on iOS for a large number of our retail store staff. We've confirmed this on at least 15 devices across three regions. Push notifications and offline mode still work fine, but staff can't log in without falling back to password, causing delays at store open.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report - we're treating this as a priority issue given the impact on store operations. Can you confirm the exact iOS version and app build number affected, and whether this happens on first login attempt or only after a certain number of tries? In the meantime, please advise your staff to use password login as a workaround while we investigate the Face ID crash.

subject: Deactivated users still showing as active in Admin Console
body:
We deactivated 6 users from the Ember Labs workspace last week after their offboarding, but they're still appearing as 'Active' in the Admin Console user list. Two of them were even able to log in yesterday, which is a compliance problem for us since we're a retail company with strict access policies. The audit log shows the deactivation event but the status flag doesn't seem to update.

Can someone check why the deactivation isn't propagating? This is affecting our monthly access review that's due Friday.
answer: Thanks for flagging this, and I understand the urgency given your access review deadline. This matches a known issue where the deactivation event writes to the audit log but a caching layer on the user status can lag behind, especially when deactivations happen in quick succession. I'm escalating this to our engineering team to force a refresh on the affected accounts and will confirm within a few hours that the 6 users show correctly as inactive and can no longer authenticate.

subject: SCIM provisioning delay for new legal team hires
body:
We use SCIM provisioning through our identity provider to sync new employees into Northwind for Vertex Robotics, currently around 217 seats. Over the last few days new hires added on our IdP side (about 8 users) aren't showing up in Northwind's user list even after 24+ hours. Existing user updates like permission changes seem to sync fine, it's specifically new user creation that's stuck.

Not urgent since these are onboarding for next week, but wanted to get ahead of it so MFA enrollment can happen in time.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report and the heads up on timing. New-user creation via SCIM can occasionally stall if the provisioning queue hits a schema validation mismatch on optional attributes - we'll check the sync logs for your tenant to see if that's what's happening with the 8 pending accounts. I'll follow up with findings and, if needed, manually trigger provisioning for those users so MFA enrollment isn't delayed for next week's start date.

subject: Zapier integration failing to trigger from Salesforce updates
body:
I'm a support engineer at Blue Freight and we rely on the Northwind Zapier integration to push Salesforce case updates into a Slack channel for our energy client accounts. Since Monday, the Zap hasn't triggered at all even though there were at least 15 Salesforce updates that should have fired it. The Zap history shows no runs, not even errors.

This is blocking our team's visibility into urgent client cases, so we need this fixed quickly. We also noticed the Northwind integration docs don't mention a Jira connector option, is that on the roadmap?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report, and I understand this is blocking visibility into active cases so we're treating it as high priority. Since the Zap history shows zero runs rather than failed runs, this points to the trigger connection between Northwind and Zapier not receiving the Salesforce webhook events - we're checking your integration's connection status now and will confirm whether it needs to be re-authorized. On the Jira connector question, that's currently not on our public roadmap, but I'll pass the request to our product team.

subject: Connector authentication failing for healthcare data source
body:
As IT admin for Pioneer Robotics, I manage several Data Pipelines connectors pulling records from our EHR-adjacent systems. Since yesterday, our main connector (source ID conn-8842) has been failing auth with 'token refresh rejected' errors every sync cycle, roughly every 4 hours. The connector previously worked fine for months and we haven't rotated any credentials on our end.

Could someone check if something changed on Northwind's side with OAuth token handling? We also want guidance on best practice for connector credential rotation going forward to avoid this in future.
answer: Thank you for the detailed report, including the connector ID. We did roll out an update to our OAuth token refresh handling for several connector types this week, and it's possible this introduced a regression affecting conn-8842. I'm having our data pipelines team review the token exchange logs for your connector now, and I'll also put together a short guide on recommended credential rotation practices once we've confirmed the root cause.

subject: Users getting logged out mid-session unexpectedly
body:
Our operations team at Delta Travel has been hit with random session timeouts throughout the day, users get kicked to the login screen mid-task and have to re-authenticate with MFA again. This started about three days ago and is happening across multiple people, not just one device or browser. We haven't changed any session timeout settings in our SSO configuration.

This is disrupting our logistics coordination workflows since people lose unsaved work. Can someone look into whether there's a session policy change on Northwind's end, or advise how we can extend timeout duration ourselves?
answer: Thanks for reporting this, I know unexpected mid-session logouts are disruptive for coordination work. We haven't pushed a global change to default session timeout behavior, but I want to check whether your workspace's SSO session policy was altered, possibly through an IdP-side token lifetime setting. I'm pulling the session logs for your affected users now to identify a pattern, and in the meantime I can walk you through where to adjust the session duration setting in your Identity and SSO configuration if you'd like more control over it.

subject: webhook not firing when API events happen
body:
hey we set up a webhook a few weeks ago on the api platfrom to notify us when new orders come thru but its been really flaky lately. sometimes it fires sometimes it just doesnt, no error in the logs on our side. we checked the webhook delivery history in northwind and see a bunch of 'pending' status that never resolve to success or fail.

can yall look into why these are stuck pending? also would be nice to have a retry button we can click ourselves instead of waiting, is that a feature request thing or does it exist already?
answer: Thanks for flagging this, stuck 'pending' deliveries usually point to an issue on our webhook dispatch queue rather than your endpoint, so I'll dig into your account's delivery logs to see where those events are getting stuck. On the manual retry button, that's not currently available in the dashboard, but I'll log it as a feature request since it's a reasonable ask - in the meantime I can manually trigger a retry on the pending events once we identify them.

subject: Need to upgrade plan and adjust seats urgently
body:
I'm the IT admin at Blue Capital and we need to upgrade from our current Starter plan to add more seats before end of week, we're onboarding a new energy client team of 15 people. When I tried the self-serve upgrade in the billing portal it just shows a spinning loader and never completes, no error message. I tried in two different browsers.

We also noticed our last invoice charged for 23 seats but we only have 20 active users right now, can someone clarify if there's a refund process for that discrepancy? This is time sensitive since the new team starts Monday.
answer: Thanks for reaching out, and given the Monday start date I'm marking this as urgent so we can get the upgrade sorted quickly. The stuck loader on plan upgrades is a known intermittent issue tied to a billing sync step, so I'm processing the upgrade to add seats for your new team manually on our end today. I'll also review the seat count discrepancy on your last invoice and follow up with either an adjustment or refund confirmation once I've confirmed the active user count.

subject: Role mappings not applying correctly after SSO login
body:
I'm a data analyst at Blue Analytics but I also help manage our SSO role mapping config since our admin is out this week. After our IdP sends the expected group attribute, users are landing in Northwind with default viewer permissions instead of the analyst or admin roles their groups should map to. This started after we updated one group name on the IdP side yesterday, but even the unaffected group mappings seem broken now too.

This is blocking about a dozen people from accessing dashboards they need for energy reporting today. Can someone urgently check the role mapping configuration for our tenant?
answer: Thanks for the clear writeup, and I understand this is blocking dashboard access for your reporting team today so I'm treating this as high priority. It's possible the group name change caused the mapping table to fall out of sync entirely rather than just for that one group, which would explain why unrelated mappings broke too. I'm pulling up your tenant's SSO role mapping configuration now to check the attribute matching and will reach out shortly with either a fix or a temporary manual role assignment for the affected dozen users while we resolve it.

subject: SAML login intermittently failing with certificate error
body:
I administer identity settings for Willow Works and occasionally when staff try to log in via SAML SSO they get an error saying 'Invalid signature on SAML response.' It doesn't happen every time, maybe once every 10-15 login attempts across our 13 seats. Re-trying usually works on the second attempt.

I checked our IdP's signing certificate and it's not expiring for another 8 months, so I'm not sure what's causing the intermittent failures. Any idea what to check next?
answer: Thanks for the detailed description. Intermittent 'invalid signature' errors that resolve on retry often point to clock skew between the IdP and our SAML validation service, or occasionally to a certificate rotation on the IdP side that hasn't fully propagated. Since this isn't blocking most logins, I'd like to pull the SAML response logs for a couple of the failed attempts on your tenant to check the timestamp and signature details, and I'll follow up with what we find.

subject: Session expiring too fast after SSO login
body:
I'm a data analyst at Pioneer Freight and noticed our SSO sessions are timing out after roughly 15 minutes of inactivity, which seems much shorter than before. I have to log back in through our identity provider multiple times a day while working with dashboards, and a couple other teammates mentioned the same thing this week.

We didn't change any session settings on our end that I'm aware of. Can someone confirm what the current session timeout is set to for our workspace and whether it changed recently?
answer: Thanks for reporting this, I know frequent re-logins are frustrating when you're in the middle of work. I'm checking your workspace's session timeout configuration now to see whether it changed recently, either on our default settings or through an SSO policy update, and will confirm the current value along with the cause. If it turns out to be an unintended default change, I'll get it reverted for your workspace.

subject: Feature request: Salesforce sync field mapping for custom objects
body: We've had our Salesforce integration running for about six months now and it's been solid for standard objects. As we scale our partner program, we'd like to sync a custom object (Partner_Account__c) into Northwind, but the current mapping UI only exposes standard fields like Account and Contact. Is there a roadmap item for custom object support, or a workaround using the API directly? We're also using Okta for SSO and Jira for our internal tracking, in case that context matters for any integration constraints.
answer: Thanks for the detailed context. Custom object mapping for Salesforce isn't available in the UI today, but you can achieve this through our Integrations API by defining a custom field map against any object exposed in your Salesforce schema - I'll send over the relevant endpoint docs. I've also logged this as a feature request for native custom object support and will update this ticket if it gets scheduled.

subject: Users getting logged out every 10 minutes
body: Since yesterday our team of 3 keeps getting kicked out of Northwind Cloud roughly every 10 minutes, even when actively working. It's forcing repeated MFA re-entry which is disrupting our order processing workflow. Nothing changed on our end that we're aware of - no new SSO config or password policy updates.
answer: Sorry for the disruption this is causing during active work hours. This kind of short session expiry usually points to a session timeout setting that got reset or a token refresh issue on our end - I'm checking your account's session policy configuration now and will confirm whether this is account-side or a broader issue within the hour.

subject: 429 errors spiking on /v2/students endpoint since this morning
body: Starting around 8:40am ET today, our nightly enrollment sync jobs against /v2/students began returning 429 Too Many Requests at a much higher rate than usual - we're seeing roughly 18% of calls throttled versus our typical sub-1% baseline. We haven't changed our call volume or concurrency settings recently. We're also on an older SDK version (2.3.1) and noticed a deprecation notice in the response headers - want to confirm that's unrelated before we start a migration.
answer: Thanks for flagging this with the specifics - a 18% throttle rate is well outside normal bounds for your tier. We're looking into whether a recent limit recalculation affected education-tier accounts; in the meantime the deprecation header is a separate, planned SDK 2.x sunset notice and not the cause of the throttling. I'll follow up shortly with findings and, if needed, a temporary limit increase while we investigate.

subject: Request: configurable SSO session length per role
body: We're rolling out Northwind across our support team and running into an issue where SSO sessions expire after a fixed period regardless of role, which is disruptive for agents who stay logged into a single dashboard view for long shifts. Could we get a way to set longer session durations for specific permission groups, like support engineers, versus admins? Right now it seems to be one global timeout setting.
answer: That's a reasonable ask and one we've heard from a few other education-tier customers with shift-based teams. Per-role session duration isn't configurable yet, but I've added your use case to our product team's backlog for SSO settings. In the meantime, I can share a workaround using a longer default timeout combined with IP-based re-auth triggers if that would help bridge the gap.

subject: Deactivated users still showing as active in audit log
body: We deactivated 14 users from our Admin Console last week as part of a retail location closure, but when I pulled the audit log for our March compliance review, several of those accounts still show status 'active' in the export even though the console UI correctly shows them as deactivated. This is causing a mismatch our compliance team is flagging. Can you confirm whether this is a reporting delay or an actual sync issue?
answer: Thanks for catching this before your compliance review went final - a mismatch between console status and audit export shouldn't happen. I'm pulling the export logs for those 14 accounts now to check whether this is a caching delay in the audit report generator or a deeper sync problem, and will update you within the day with either a corrected export or a root cause.

subject: Salesforce sync stuck, no records updated since Tuesday
body: Our Salesforce sync hasn't pushed any updated records since Tuesday morning - we run a small team of 4 and rely on this for lead handoff to our sales rep. The sync status in the integrations panel still shows 'Connected' with a green check, but the last successful sync timestamp is frozen at 03/11 9:14am. We also use Slack and Jira integrations which seem unaffected, and we're on Okta for login. Nothing in our Salesforce org's permission settings has changed.
answer: Apologies for the delay this has caused to your lead handoff - a green status with a stale sync timestamp usually indicates the sync job is silently failing rather than actually connected. I'm checking the integration logs for your account now to find why it stopped processing after 03/11 9:14am, and will restart the sync manually once I identify the blocking error. I'll update you shortly with what caused it.

subject: Slack alerts for invoice failures stopped arriving
body: We set up Slack alerts a few months back to notify our finance channel whenever an invoice payment fails, and they were working fine until last week. I haven't touched the Slack app connection or the Okta login for our workspace, and Jira notifications from the same integration hub still come through fine. Can you help figure out why only the billing-related Slack alerts stopped, since we rely on these to catch failed payments quickly?
answer: Thanks for the clear breakdown - since Jira notifications are still working, this looks isolated to the billing alert trigger rather than the Slack connection itself. I'm checking whether the invoice-failure webhook got disabled or reconfigured on our end during a recent notification settings update, and will re-enable it and confirm with a test alert to your finance channel.

subject: Charged for 12 seats but only have 5 active users
body: Our latest invoice shows a charge for 12 seats, but we only have 5 active users on our account and never added anyone beyond that. This is a meaningful overcharge for a startup team our size and we need it corrected before the next billing cycle processes. Can someone review our seat count and issue a refund for the difference on invoice #INV-88210?
answer: I understand the urgency here given the cycle timing - I'm escalating this to our billing team right now to audit the seat count on invoice #INV-88210 against your actual active users. We'll confirm the correct count and process a refund for the discrepancy before your next billing date, and I'll follow up here as soon as the audit is complete.

subject: Need workspace-level default settings applied across departments
body: We manage workspace settings for 282 users across multiple legal departments, and right now each department admin has to manually configure defaults like data retention and audit log visibility rather than inheriting them from a workspace-level template. With our upcoming compliance audit this quarter, we need a way to enforce consistent settings across all departments quickly rather than checking each one manually.
answer: Given your audit timeline, I want to get this moving quickly - workspace-level default templates that cascade to department admins aren't available as a self-serve feature yet, but our team can apply a consistent settings template manually across your departments as an interim step. I'm flagging this as high priority given the compliance deadline and will follow up today with next steps for the manual rollout.

subject: Can't share dashboard with view-only external partner
body: One of our logistics partners needs view-only access to a shipment tracking dashboard, but when I try to share it with their external email, the permissions screen only offers 'Editor' or 'Admin' roles for anyone outside our organization. This is blocking a delivery reporting handoff that's due today. We're a small team of 3 so we don't have another way to get them this data quickly.
answer: I understand the time pressure with today's handoff - external view-only sharing should be available, so this looks like a permissions bug rather than expected behavior. I'm reproducing this on our end right now and will follow up within the hour with either a fix or a workaround, such as generating a shareable export link, so your partner can get access today.

subject: Unsubscribe link missing from transactional alerts causing duplicate sends
body: We've had a spike in support tickets from our own customers who click 'unsubscribe' on Northwind-generated payment alerts and get a 404 on the link. Because they can't unsubscribe, they keep hitting reply-all and our team is manually suppressing them, which is creating duplicate notification rows in our audit log (we counted 412 duplicates since Monday). We need either a working unsubscribe endpoint or documentation on how to wire our own suppression list into the Notifications API before this escalates further, since it's affecting a large share of our 1558 seats.
answer: Thanks for flagging this, and I understand the urgency given the volume you're seeing. This matches a known issue where the unsubscribe token in transactional templates isn't resolving correctly for accounts on custom domains — we're pushing a fix to regenerate valid tokens today and will confirm once it's live. In the meantime I'm sending over the suppression-list API documentation so your team can enforce unsubscribes server-side and stop the duplicate sends immediately.

subject: Need urgent restore of deleted case files from backup - retention policy conflict
body: Yesterday at 3:40pm our records team accidentally bulk-deleted a folder containing 1,140 case files under the 'Litigation-2024' bucket. I went to restore from the nightly backup dated the same morning but the restore job fails with 'snapshot unavailable: retention window exceeded' even though our retention is set to 90 days and this snapshot is only 1 day old. This looks like a bug in how retention is being applied to upload-triggered snapshots, and we need these files back today for a compliance deadline.
answer: This has been escalated to our storage engineering team as a priority incident given the compliance deadline. We can see the snapshot from March referenced in your account and are investigating why the retention check is misreading it as expired - initial signs point to a metadata sync bug on upload-triggered snapshots rather than actual data loss. We'll have an update within the next 2 hours and will manually initiate the restore as soon as the snapshot is confirmed intact.

subject: API RATE LIMITS TOO LOW AFTER SDK UPGRADE, WEBHOOKS DROPPING
body: WE UPGRADED TO SDK VERSION 4.2 LAST WEEK AND NOW WE ARE HITTING 429 ERRORS CONSTANTLY EVEN THOUGH OUR TRAFFIC HASN'T CHANGED. OUR WEBHOOK RETRIES ARE PILING UP AND SOME ORDERS ARE NOT SYNCING TO OUR POS SYSTEM. THE OLD SDK 3.x NEVER HAD THIS ISSUE AND WE SAW IT IS BEING DEPRECATED NEXT MONTH SO WE CANT ROLL BACK. WE NEED TO KNOW IF THE RATE LIMIT CALCULATION CHANGED IN 4.2 OR IF THIS IS A BUG.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report - I can confirm SDK 4.2 changed how burst requests are counted, which is likely why you're seeing more 429s at the same traffic level. This is a known regression and a patch (4.2.1) is scheduled for release this week that restores the previous burst allowance; in the meantime I'd recommend adding exponential backoff around webhook retries to reduce dropped syncs. I'll follow up here as soon as 4.2.1 is confirmed live.

subject: Repeated SDK errors after Node client update, need guidance before deprecation deadline
body: Since updating to the Node SDK v6 last week, our integration is throwing 'InvalidTokenFormatError' on roughly 1 in 5 API calls, though the same requests worked fine on v5. I noticed v5 is being deprecated on May 30 so we need to move to v6, but the error doesn't give enough detail to know what's malformed in the token. Can someone confirm if this is a known issue with v6's token parsing, or point us to updated integration docs? We're a small team of 23 users so any downtime on API calls affects most of our staff directly.
answer: Thanks for reporting this - v6 introduced stricter token format validation and we've seen a few similar reports where legacy tokens issued before the update trigger this error intermittently. As a workaround, regenerating your API tokens from the admin console should resolve it immediately since new tokens are issued in the v6-compatible format. I'll also flag this to the SDK team so the error message can be made clearer, and I'll send you the updated v6 migration guide in a follow-up.

subject: Mobile app crashes immediately on launch for iOS users
body: Starting this morning, the mobile app crashes within a second of opening for our iOS users - we've confirmed this on iPhone 13 and 14 devices running iOS 17.4. The app worked fine yesterday and no one made changes to our account settings. Push notifications still seem to be arriving even though the app itself won't open, and users who were offline overnight can't log in at all now. This is affecting our field team of roughly 200 people who rely on the app for case updates, so we need this escalated urgently.
answer: This has been escalated to our mobile engineering team as a P1. We've had a couple of other reports of iOS crashes on launch tied to a recent push-notification handler update, and we're working to isolate whether that's the cause here. As an immediate workaround, please ask affected users to clear the app cache and reopen while we prepare a hotfix - we'll update this ticket as soon as we have a fix timeline.

subject: Cannot restrict workspace settings access or find audit log for recent changes
body: I'm trying to lock down who can edit workspace settings in the admin console - specifically I want to add an IP allowlist so only our office network can change settings, but the allowlist field in Settings > Security just doesn't save and reverts blank on refresh. Separately, someone on our 5-person team deactivated another user's account last week and I can't find any record of it in the audit log to confirm who did it or when. Can you help with both the allowlist bug and pointing me to where deactivation events should appear?
answer: Thanks for reporting both issues. The allowlist field not persisting is a known bug affecting Starter-tier workspaces that we're actively working on - I'll update you once it's resolved. For the deactivation event, audit logs for account changes are under Settings > Audit Log > filter by 'User Management', but if it's not showing there for a past week's action, that may be a related logging gap I'll ask engineering to check for your workspace specifically.

subject: unsubcribe button not working, ppl keep getting same email twice
body: hey we are getting alot of complaints from are subscriber list, ppl click unsubcribe on the weekly digest but they still get the email again next week. one customer got the SAME email 3 times in one day yesterday which is realy bad look for us since we only have 14 seats and this is a small team. can someone check whats going on with the unsubscribe flow becuase this is starting to hurt our reputaion with clients
answer: Sorry for the trouble this is causing with your subscribers. This sounds like the unsubscribe preference isn't syncing back to the sending queue in time, which can cause duplicate sends if a digest is already queued when someone opts out. I'm escalating this to our notifications team to check your account's processing logs and will report back with what's causing the duplicates and a fix timeline.

subject: Invoice shows wrong seat count after downgrade
body: We downgraded from 15 to 12 seats last month but our latest invoice, dated the 1st, still bills for 15 seats at $put the same rate as before. I also can't find where in the billing dashboard to see a breakdown of active vs. billed seats - it just shows one total number. Can someone correct this invoice and also let me know if there's a way to self-serve check seat counts going forward, since as a product manager I need this for planning?
answer: Thanks for catching this - it looks like the seat downgrade didn't sync to the billing engine in time for last month's invoice cycle. I'm issuing a corrected invoice reflecting 12 seats now and will apply a credit for the overcharge on your next billing cycle. For visibility going forward, the seat breakdown is available under Billing > Usage > Seat Detail, which shows active versus billed seats in real time.

subject: Request to consolidate duplicate weekly digest emails and add digest documentation
body: Several of our users are receiving two copies of the weekly email digest every Monday morning - we've confirmed this happens for at least 6 of our 18 accounts. I'd also like to request documentation on how digest frequency and content are configured, since right now I can't find anything explaining what triggers a digest to be sent versus a single alert. Any help resolving the duplicates and pointing me to relevant docs would be appreciated.
answer: Thanks for the report - duplicate digests like this are usually caused by a user being subscribed to two overlapping alert groups that both trigger a digest send. I'll check the affected accounts on your workspace to identify and merge any overlapping subscriptions. I'll also send over our digest configuration guide, which covers frequency settings and how content is aggregated, so you can review and adjust as needed.

subject: Need to change Slack channel for API failure alerts
body: We currently have Slack alerts for API and integration failures posting to our old #ops-legacy channel, but we've moved that workflow to a new #alerts-prod channel as part of consolidating our Slack, Jira, and Okta integrations this quarter. Can you help us repoint the Northwind Slack integration to the new channel? Also noticed the integration settings page still lists our old Salesforce webhook as active even though we disconnected Salesforce two weeks ago - that should probably be cleaned up too.
answer: Happy to help with both. To repoint Slack alerts, go to Integrations > Slack > Alert Routing and select the new channel from the dropdown - it should take effect immediately without needing to reauthorize the app. I've also flagged the stale Salesforce webhook entry for cleanup on our end since disconnecting the integration should have removed it automatically; I'll confirm once that's cleared from your settings page.

subject: Storage quota approaching limit - need retention policy guidance
body:
We're at 92% of our storage quota across our manufacturing document repositories and need to understand our options before we hit the cap. Can you confirm whether Northwind Storage supports automated retention policies that would archive or purge files older than 7 years per our compliance requirements? We have roughly 40,000 documents dating back to 2015 that could likely be archived.

We'd also like documentation on how quota is calculated - does it include versioned files and deleted-but-retained items? Our next quarterly upload batch is due in 10 days and we need to plan around this.
answer:
Thanks for flagging this ahead of your upload deadline. Quota is calculated on total stored bytes including all retained versions of a file, so version history and soft-deleted items (retained for 30 days by default) do count toward your limit. I'm attaching our retention policy documentation which covers how to set up automated archival rules by age or custom metadata tags.

Given your upcoming batch, I'd recommend we set up a call this week to configure a retention rule for pre-2015 documents so you have headroom before the upload. I'll follow up shortly with some available times.

subject: Shared dashboards showing 'access denied' for viewer role users
body:
Since yesterday, several of our analysts with Viewer permissions can't open dashboards that were previously shared with them. They get a red banner saying 'You do not have permission to view this resource' even though the sharing settings still list them as Viewers. This is affecting our weekly fintech risk reporting dashboard that 12 people rely on.

I checked the sharing panel and the permissions look correct - Viewer role, correct email groups assigned. Nothing was changed on our end recently. Can someone look into whether this is a permissions sync issue on your side?
answer:
Thank you for the detailed report - this does sound like a permissions propagation issue on our end rather than a config problem with your dashboard. We've seen a related bug affecting Viewer-role access after recent sharing service updates and are escalating this to our engineering team now given the number of users impacted.

In the meantime, as a workaround, try removing and re-adding one affected user to the share list - this has restored access for other customers hitting the same issue. I'll update you within a few hours with root cause findings and an ETA for a permanent fix.

subject: Request to enable extended audit log retention
body:
We'd like to increase our audit log retention period beyond the current default. Right now it looks like logs are only kept for 30 days, but for our compliance reviews we need at least 6 months of admin action history available.

Could you let us know if this is configurable in the Admin Console settings, or if it requires a plan change? Also, if there's documentation on what event types are captured in the audit log (login attempts, role changes, etc.) that would be helpful for our internal policy write-up.
answer:
Good question - audit log retention on the Starter plan is fixed at 30 days and isn't configurable from the Admin Console directly. Extending retention to 6 months would require upgrading to our Pro plan, which includes configurable retention up to 12 months.

I'm sending over our audit log documentation now, which lists all captured event types including authentication events, role and permission changes, and settings modifications. Let me know if you'd like to discuss upgrade options with our account team.

subject: Connector auth token expiring causes sync delays on retail data feed
body:
We noticed our Salesforce connector in Data Pipelines has been failing intermittently over the past week, with sync jobs delayed by 2-4 hours past their scheduled window. Checking the pipeline logs, it looks like the OAuth token is expiring and requiring re-authentication more frequently than expected - we've had to manually reconnect it 3 times since June 10th.

This is causing stale data in our downstream retail inventory dashboards. Is there a known issue with token refresh for this connector, or a setting we're missing to enable automatic renewal?
answer:
Thanks for the details - we're aware of an intermittent issue with token refresh timing on the Salesforce connector that a few customers have reported this month, and our data pipelines team is actively working on a fix. In the meantime, could you confirm which authentication scope your connector was set up with initially? Some legacy connections default to a shorter refresh window.

We'll monitor your pipeline for the next sync cycles and reach out if we see further failures. This has been logged with escalation tag for our engineering team's current sprint.

subject: Getting duplicate email alerts for same notification event
body:
Our team has been receiving duplicate notification emails for the same alert triggers over the past few days - specifically for our storage quota warning and user login alerts. Each event sends two identical emails about 5 minutes apart. This is causing some confusion among our 8 team members who think something is actually happening twice.

Could you help us figure out if this is a configuration issue with duplicate alert rules on our end, or something on the notification service side? We'd like this resolved before it becomes a bigger annoyance.
answer:
Thanks for reporting this - duplicate alerts like this are usually caused by having two overlapping alert rules configured for the same event type, which can happen if a rule was cloned during setup. Could you check under Notifications > Alert Rules whether you have more than one rule matching storage quota and login events?

If you don't find duplicates there, let us know and we'll check on our end for a delivery retry issue. I've attached our alerting documentation which covers how to review and consolidate rules to prevent this going forward.

subject: Scheduled pipeline syncs not running since this morning
body:
Our scheduled data pipeline syncs for our travel booking connector haven't run since 6 AM today. Normally we see hourly syncs complete successfully, but the last successful run in our history shows 5:00 AM, and every attempt since then shows status 'queued' without ever executing. We rely on this data feed for same-day pricing updates across our booking platform.

We haven't changed any schedule settings or connector credentials recently. Can someone check if there's a backend issue affecting scheduled sync execution? This is urgent as our team is now working with stale pricing data.
answer:
I'm escalating this immediately given the impact on your pricing data. We're seeing reports of scheduled syncs getting stuck in queued state for a subset of customers this morning, which points to an issue with our sync scheduler service rather than anything on your connector configuration.

Our infrastructure team is investigating now. As a temporary workaround, please try triggering an immediate manual sync from the connector page, which is bypassing the scheduler queue for other affected customers. I'll update you within the hour with status and will confirm once scheduled syncs are restored.

subject: Widespread upload failures hitting storage quota errors
body:
We're seeing upload failures across multiple departments this morning with the error 'Storage quota exceeded, contact your administrator.' Our storage dashboard shows we're at 98% capacity, but we have active clinical documentation uploads that cannot fail - this is affecting patient record intake for several care teams right now.

We need an emergency quota increase or guidance on immediate retention cleanup options. We also want to discuss setting up tiered retention policies going forward so we don't hit this wall again given our 1824 seat deployment.
answer:
This is a critical situation given the clinical documentation impact - I'm escalating immediately to get you emergency headroom. We can push through a temporary quota increase within the hour while we work on a longer-term plan; please confirm the amount of additional capacity you need to get through today's intake volume.

Once we've stabilized uploads, I'd like to schedule a call with our solutions team to set up tiered retention policies appropriate for your patient records workflow, so this doesn't recur. I'll follow up shortly with confirmation of the quota increase.

subject: Okta app integration broken - Slack and Jira SSO failing
body:
Since this morning our Okta integration with Northwind seems to be broken - users trying to SSO into Slack and Jira through the Okta app tile are getting stuck on a blank page after Northwind authentication, then redirected back to login. This is blocking our entire finance and ops teams from accessing either tool, about 24 people total.

Nothing changed in our Okta config that we're aware of. Can someone check if there was a recent update to the Okta integration that might have broken the SAML redirect for downstream apps?
answer:
Thanks for the quick report - this sounds like it could be related to a SAML assertion issue affecting downstream app redirects, which would explain both Slack and Jira failing at the same point. We're checking our integration logs now for your tenant to see if there's a misconfigured redirect URL or certificate mismatch following a recent update.

Given this is blocking your whole team, we're treating this as urgent - I'll have an update for you within the next hour, and in the meantime you may want to have affected users try direct login to Slack/Jira as a temporary workaround while we resolve the SSO path.

subject: Repeated upload failures - quota errors despite available space
body:
We're getting intermittent upload failures with this error showing in our admin logs:

```
2024-06-18T09:12:44Z ERROR StorageUpload: quota_exceeded_soft_limit
user: staff-uploads-service
file: transcripts_batch_0618.zip (2.3GB)
quota_used: 847GB / quota_limit: 900GB
retry_count: 3
status: failed_permanently
```

The odd part is our dashboard shows only 847GB used out of 900GB allocated, so we shouldn't be near the limit. This has been reported by three different departments trying to back up student transcript archives over the past two days. Can you check if there's a soft limit threshold that's differs from what's displayed?
answer:
Thank you for including the log details, that's very helpful. You're right that there's a discrepancy - we do have a soft limit threshold set at 90% of quota that triggers pre-emptive upload blocking to prevent hard failures, but this isn't currently reflected in the dashboard display, which is a documentation gap on our end.

Given you're hitting this soft limit and have active backup needs, I can raise your soft threshold temporarily while we look at either a quota increase or retention cleanup for older transcript archives. Let me know your preference and I'll process it today.

subject: How to set up OAuth for custom connector authentication?
body:
I'm building a custom connector for our Data Pipelines integration and need guidance on the OAuth2 flow Northwind expects. I've got a client_id and client_secret set up in our developer portal, but I'm unsure whether the redirect URI needs to match exactly what's registered or if wildcard subdomains are supported for our staging vs production environments.

Also, is there a way to test token refresh behavior without waiting for the full expiry window? Any example requests or a Postman collection would help speed up our integration work.
answer:
Happy to help get your connector integration moving. Redirect URIs must match exactly what's registered in the developer portal - we don't currently support wildcard subdomains, so you'll need to register separate URIs for staging and production. 

For testing token refresh without waiting for full expiry, you can pass a shortened TTL via the sandbox environment's token endpoint using the `test_expiry_seconds` parameter, documented in our API reference. I'll also send over our Postman collection with example auth flow requests to help you get started faster.

subject: Workspace settings not saving allowlist changes
body: I'm the ops lead at Apex Travel and I've tried updating our IP allowlist in Admin Console three times this week (last attempt Oct 14, 3:40pm) but the settings page reverts to the old list after a refresh. We also noticed the audit log doesn't show any entry for the change attempt at all, which is concerning since we rely on it for compliance reviews. Can you confirm if this is a known bug with the Starter tier settings page?
answer: Thanks for flagging this - a silent failure to save with no audit trail is definitely not expected behavior. Could you send us the exact IP ranges you tried to add and a screenshot of the settings page right after you click save? In the meantime, please avoid repeated attempts so we don't end up with conflicting cached states, and we'll investigate the audit log gap as part of the same fix.

subject: SAML login completely down - all users locked out
body: As of 9:15am this morning nobody at Quill Energy can log into Northwind through our SSO. Every attempt redirects back to our IdP and then throws 'SAML response validation failed' on the Northwind side. We have 24 people across logistics operations who are completely locked out right now, including our on-call dispatch team who need dashboard access.
answer: This is being treated as a P0 - we've escalated to our identity engineering team immediately. Can you confirm whether your IdP certificate was rotated or updated in the last 48 hours, and send us the raw SAML response if you have IdP-side logging enabled? We'll keep you updated every 30 minutes until access is restored, and in the meantime we can provision temporary password-based access for critical users if you send us their usernames.

subject: Seat upgrade not reflecting on invoice, blocking access for new hires
body: I support our Northwind account at Pioneer Academy and we upgraded from 22 to 30 seats on October 3rd through the billing portal, but the invoice generated on Oct 5th still shows 22 seats and the new users we added are getting 'seat limit reached' errors when trying to log in. This is blocking three new hires from starting their onboarding.
answer: Apologies for the disruption to your onboarding - this looks like a sync issue between the plan change and the seat allocation service. We're correcting the seat count on your account now and will issue a corrected invoice reflecting the 30 seats. You should see the new hires able to log in within the next hour, but please let us know immediately if the seat limit error persists.

subject: Getting 413 errors on large file uploads via Storage API
body: I'm integrating the Storage API for Lumen Travel and consistently get a 413 Payload Too Large response when uploading media files over roughly 4GB, even though I understood our Enterprise quota supports much larger files. This happens through both the REST endpoint and the SDK's multipart upload method. Is there a documented size limit I'm missing, or a specific header I need to set to enable chunked uploads for large media assets?
answer: Good question - for files over 5GB you'll need to use the multipart upload initiation endpoint rather than a single PUT, which handles chunking automatically and isn't subject to the same per-request size cap. I'll send over our multipart upload guide with code samples for the SDK; if you're already using the SDK's multipart method and still hitting 413s, could you share the exact endpoint and headers you're sending so we can check for a misconfiguration?

subject: Cannot restore files from backup - process stuck for 2 days
body: I'm an IT admin at Delta Energy and I initiated a restore from backup on our Storage account on October 10th to recover a folder of legal documents deleted by mistake. The restore job has been showing 'In Progress' for over 48 hours now with no completion, and I can't tell if it's actually processing or stuck. Our retention policy is set to 90 days, so I want to confirm the backup itself is still valid before we lose the window.
answer: Sorry for the anxiety this is causing - a restore job stuck at 'In Progress' for that long is not typical and we're looking into your account now. Can you share the restore job ID so we can check its status on our backend? We'll also confirm your retention window is intact so there's no risk of data loss while we resolve the stuck job.

subject: WEBHOOK ENDPOINT DEPRECATION BREAKING OUR INTEGRATION
body:
WE JUST GOT NOTIFIED THAT THE LEGACY WEBHOOK FORMAT IS BEING DEPRECATED NEXT MONTH AND OUR INTEGRATION IS THROWING ERRORS ALREADY. HERE IS THE LOG FROM OUR SERVER:

2024-10-14 08:12:03 ERROR webhook_handler: unexpected field 'event_type_v1' missing
2024-10-14 08:12:03 ERROR webhook_handler: payload schema mismatch, expected v2
2024-10-14 08:15:41 ERROR webhook_handler: retry limit exceeded, dropping event

WE HAVE 24 SEATS AND THIS IS AFFECTING OUR ORDER SYNC PIPELINE. WE NEED THE SDK UPDATED OR CLEAR DOCS ON THE V2 PAYLOAD FORMAT NOW.
answer: We hear you - dropped events on your order sync pipeline is a serious issue and we want to get this resolved quickly. The v2 webhook payload documentation and migration guide are linked in your dashboard under API Platform > Webhooks > Migration Notes, and the updated SDK version (4.2.0) supports both formats during the transition period. Please update to that SDK version as soon as possible; if events are still dropping after the update, send us your endpoint URL and we'll check delivery logs on our side.

subject: Request to update SAML role mapping for new department structure
body: We're reorganizing our IT department structure at Vertex Media and need to update how SAML attributes map to Northwind permission groups. Specifically we want users with the 'clinical-ops' attribute to map to our custom 'Read-Only Analyst' role instead of the default Viewer role. Can you walk us through whether this requires reconfiguring on the IdP side, the Northwind side, or both, and if there's a way to test the mapping before rolling it out to all 1371 seats?
answer: This is a straightforward change and we can definitely help you test before a full rollout. The attribute-to-role mapping is configured entirely on the Northwind side under Identity and SSO > Role Mapping, so no IdP changes are needed as long as the 'clinical-ops' attribute is already being sent in your assertions. We recommend creating a test group with a handful of users first - happy to set up a call to walk through the configuration together.

subject: Charts not rendering on shared dashboards since this morning
body: Since around 10am today, several of our shared operational dashboards at Harbor Works have started showing blank charts where bar and line graphs used to be - the widget boxes load but stay empty, and hovering shows no tooltip data. This is affecting dashboards shared with our clinical operations team across multiple departments, and it's been consistent across Chrome and Firefox for the last few hours.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report - we're seeing some reports of rendering issues with shared dashboards and are treating this as a priority investigation. Could you share the dashboard ID or share link for one of the affected dashboards so we can check whether it's a data source connection issue or a rendering bug specific to shared views? We'll keep you posted as we dig into this.

subject: Request for cursor-based pagination on large API collections
body: I'm the product manager overseeing our API usage at Granite Capital, and we're running into issues with the current offset-based pagination on the transactions endpoint when paging through datasets over 500k records - performance degrades significantly past offset 100000 and we occasionally see duplicate or skipped records under concurrent writes. Given our scale across 2572 seats, we'd like to know if cursor-based pagination is on the roadmap, or if there's a recommended workaround for large dataset traversal in the meantime.
answer: This is a common pain point at your scale, and I appreciate you raising it directly. Cursor-based pagination for high-volume endpoints is in active development and we can add you to the beta list if you'd like early access. In the meantime, a workaround is to paginate using a timestamp-based filter combined with a stable secondary sort key, which avoids the skip/duplicate issue under concurrent writes - I can send over a sample query pattern if that's helpful.

subject: issue
body: Users are getting the same email alert 3-4 times within a few minutes for a single event, mostly on payment status notifications. This has been happening for about a week and clients are asking why they got duplicate emails about the same invoice.
answer: Thanks for reporting this - duplicate delivery on payment status alerts points to a likely issue with our notification retry logic not properly deduplicating on event ID. Could you share one or two examples of the notification IDs or timestamps from the duplicate emails so we can trace them in our delivery logs? We'll investigate the retry behavior on our end and update you as soon as we have a root cause.

subject: Need Okta SAML app for Northwind Integrations - blocking rollout
body: We're trying to connect our Okta tenant to Northwind through the Integrations module so our media team can SSO into shared dashboards, but the Okta app config screen only shows Slack and Jira as prebuilt connectors. We need a Salesforce and Okta SAML app similar to what's listed for Jira, since our security team wants this live before next week's launch. Is there a way to request this app or get a custom SAML config added to our workspace now?
answer: Thanks for flagging this - a native Okta SAML app isn't in the current Integrations catalog alongside Jira and Slack, but we can get you unblocked with a custom SAML configuration on our end while the feature request is escalated internally. I'm looping in our integrations engineering team today given your launch timeline, and I'll send you the manual SAML metadata setup steps within the next few hours so your security team can proceed in parallel.

subject: PDF export from Dashboards failing for entire team
body: Since this morning none of our workspace users can export dashboards to PDF - clicking Export > PDF just spins for about 30 seconds and then shows 'Export failed, please try again.' This is happening on every dashboard we've tested, including the compliance summary we send to partners weekly. We have a legal filing deadline tomorrow and need working exports today.
answer: I'm sorry for the disruption, especially with your deadline tomorrow - I've reproduced the export failure on our end and confirmed it's affecting PDF rendering workspace-wide, not just your account, so I've escalated this to our platform team as a priority incident. In the meantime I can generate the specific dashboards you need manually and send them over as PDFs; please list the dashboard names or links and I'll turn them around within the hour.

subject: Question on granular sharing permissions for dashboards
body: I'd like to give certain teammates view-only access to a dashboard while letting others edit filters but not the underlying data model. Right now it looks like sharing is just 'can view' or 'can edit' at the whole-dashboard level. Is there any roadmap for more granular permission tiers, or documentation on a workaround using saved views?
answer: Good question - today sharing is limited to those two tiers you described, but a more granular permission model is on our product roadmap and I've added your use case to the feature request tracking it. As a workaround in the meantime, creating separate saved views per audience and sharing each with the appropriate access level is the closest option we support, and I can point you to our documentation on saved views if that helps.

subject: Offline mode for mobile app - how does data sync work?
body: I travel a lot for site visits and often lose signal, so I wanted to understand how offline mode behaves in the Northwind mobile app. Does it cache the last-loaded dashboard data so I can view it without connection, and will it queue up any changes I make until I'm back online? Also curious if push notifications get delayed or dropped entirely while offline.
answer: Good questions - offline mode currently caches the last dashboard views you had open so you can browse them without a connection, but any edits you make while offline are not queued yet and will be lost if you navigate away, so we recommend view-only use while offline for now. Push notifications are held server-side and delivered once your device reconnects rather than being dropped, though there can be a short delay depending on network conditions.

subject: Workspace settings page loading very slowly and audit log missing entries
body: Our workspace settings page has been taking 15-20 seconds to load for the past two days, and when I check the audit log to see who changed our SSO default role, several recent changes from Tuesday afternoon just aren't showing up at all. I need to confirm who deactivated two seats last week since it's affecting our seat count reconciliation.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report - the slow load time on workspace settings matches an issue our team is currently investigating on the admin console backend, and I've added your workspace to that ticket. For the missing audit log entries, I'm escalating separately since gaps in the audit trail need immediate attention; I'll pull the raw event logs for Tuesday afternoon on our side and get back to you with the deactivation details as soon as I can confirm them.

subject: Webhook retries and rate limit headers for API Platform
body: We're building webhook consumers for order events and want to confirm behavior: if our endpoint returns a 500, does Northwind retry with backoff, and how many attempts before it gives up? Also, our rate limit headers (X-RateLimit-Remaining) sometimes show inconsistent values between calls made a second apart, and we noticed the older webhook signing SDK method is marked deprecated in the changelog - what's the recommended replacement?
answer: For failed webhook deliveries, we retry up to 5 times with exponential backoff over roughly 24 hours before marking the event as failed, and you can see delivery attempts in the webhook logs panel. On rate limit headers, some inconsistency is expected under bursty traffic since counters are eventually consistent across nodes, and for signing we recommend migrating to the newer verifyWebhookSignature method in SDK v3, which replaces the deprecated legacy HMAC helper you're currently using.

subject: Invoice shows 20 seats but we only have 18 active users
body: Our last invoice billed us for 20 seats but when I check our admin console we only have 18 active users listed. I think two seats might have been left over from a contractor offboarding in March that didn't get removed properly. Can you confirm the discrepancy and let us know if we're owed a partial refund or credit for the overage?
answer: Thanks for catching this - I've pulled your seat history and can confirm two contractor seats from March were deactivated in the console but not removed from the billing count due to a sync delay on our end. I'll apply a credit to your account for the overage on your next invoice and make sure the seat count now reflects 18 active users going forward.

subject: Requesting change to late-arrival handling in Data Pipelines connector
body: Our energy metering connector regularly receives data 4-6 hours late from field devices, and right now our pipeline treats anything outside the 1-hour sync window as dropped rather than backfilled, causing daily gaps in our reporting dashboards. With 200 seats relying on these dashboards for operational decisions, we need the pipeline's late-arrival window extended or a backfill mechanism added so this data isn't silently lost.
answer: This is a reasonable and important change given your reporting dependency, so I've opened a change request to extend the late-arrival window for your metering connector and to enable automatic backfill for records arriving up to 8 hours late. I'll need to confirm this won't affect downstream sync performance for your other connectors, so I'm looping in our data pipelines engineering team and will follow up within two business days with an implementation timeline.

subject: SSO role mapping not assigning correct permissions after login
body: We configured role mapping in Identity and SSO so that users in our 'Managers' Okta group get admin-level permissions in Northwind, but after several test logins this week those users are still landing with default viewer access. The group attribute is being passed correctly in the SAML assertion based on what I can see in our Okta debugger, so the mapping rule itself seems to not be applying on our end.
answer: Thanks for confirming the assertion is passing the group attribute correctly - that helps narrow it down to the mapping rule configuration on our side. Can you send me a screenshot of your current role mapping rule setup along with one affected user's login timestamp? I'll trace that specific login through our provisioning logs to see exactly where the mapping is failing and get this corrected.

subject: Need smarter alert routing to reduce duplicate notifications
body: Our team is getting the same billing alert routed to both email and Slack for the same event, and separately our on-call engineers are receiving duplicate push notifications when an alert escalates through two rules at once. With 79 seats generating a lot of alert volume, this is creating noise and people are starting to mute channels entirely. Can we get a feature to dedupe notifications across channels and escalation rules?
answer: This is great feedback and something we've heard from a few growing teams - deduping notifications across channels and overlapping escalation rules isn't available yet, but I'm submitting this as a feature request tagged for our notifications team with your alert volume as a concrete example. In the short term, I'd suggest auditing your escalation rules for overlapping triggers, since consolidating those often reduces a meaningful chunk of the duplicate volume while we work on a proper dedupe mechanism.

subject: STORAGE QUOTA BLOCKING UPLOADS URGENT
body: WE ARE INTEGRATING THE STORAGE API FOR OUR RETAIL BACKUP PIPELINE AND SINCE THIS MORNING EVERY UPLOAD CALL RETURNS 507 INSUFFICIENT STORAGE. OUR BUCKET blue-energy-backups-prod SHOWS 98 PERCENT OF QUOTA USED BUT WE HAVE RETENTION SET TO 30 DAYS AND OLD FILES SHOULD HAVE BEEN PURGED. WE HAVE 40 STORES SENDING NIGHTLY BACKUPS AND THEY ARE ALL FAILING NOW. NEED THIS FIXED TODAY OR WE LOSE BACKUP COVERAGE FOR THE WEEKEND.
answer: I understand the urgency and I am escalating this now. Can you confirm the exact bucket name and the retention policy ID configured, since it looks like the automated purge job may not be running against your account. In the meantime I'm raising your quota temporarily so uploads are not blocked while we investigate why old objects are not being cleared.

subject: Request: customizable frequency for email digest notifications
body:
Our team relies on the daily email digests from Notifications to summarize system alerts across 150 seats, but right now we can only choose between daily and weekly with no option for a mid-day summary. Several department heads have asked for a twice-daily digest option so urgent items don't sit unnoticed until the next morning.

Could you add a configurable digest schedule, or at minimum let us set a custom cron-style interval? This would help us reduce missed alerts significantly and I'd like to know if this is already on your roadmap.
answer: Thanks for the detailed suggestion, this is helpful feedback. Custom digest intervals aren't currently configurable in the product, but I'm logging this as a feature request with our product team and will flag the twice-daily use case specifically since it seems common among admins managing larger teams. I'll follow up once I hear back on whether this can be prioritized.

subject: Late-arriving records causing gaps in daily sync reports
body:
We've noticed that data from our LMS connector regularly arrives 4-6 hours after the scheduled pipeline run, which means our daily reporting dashboard shows incomplete enrollment numbers for the previous day. This has happened on at least 8 of the last 14 days, and our academic team is starting to question the report accuracy.

Is there a way to configure the pipeline to wait for late data or trigger a re-run window, rather than closing the batch immediately at the scheduled time? Any guidance on watermarking or grace periods would help.
answer: Thanks for the clear description, this is a common challenge with connectors that have variable ingestion latency. Currently our pipelines don't support a watermark-based grace period natively, but you can configure a delayed trigger or a secondary reconciliation run a few hours after the primary sync to catch late-arriving records. I'll pass your watermarking request along to the product team as this would be a valuable addition for education customers with similar LMS integrations.

subject: API pagination broken - cursor tokens returning empty results across all endpoints
body: Since approximately 09:15 UTC today, every paginated GET request using a next_page_token from a previous response returns an empty data array with total_count still showing the correct non-zero value. This is affecting our production reporting jobs pulling transaction data from /v2/transactions and /v2/accounts endpoints. We have 128 analysts unable to pull complete datasets right now, and several downstream media reports are stalled.
answer: This is now our top priority and I've opened an internal incident. We've confirmed a regression in the pagination cursor service affecting multiple accounts and engineering is actively rolling back the change that shipped this morning. I'll update you within 30 minutes with either a fix confirmation or a workaround using offset-based pagination on the affected endpoints.

subject: Clarification needed on rate limit headers for webhook retries
body:
I'm reviewing our webhook retry logic and noticed the X-RateLimit-Remaining header sometimes shows a negative value after a burst of events, even though our dashboard says we're well under the 1000 requests/minute limit. This happened around 14:20 yesterday during a batch of 45 webhook deliveries.

Could you clarify how the rate limit counter is calculated for webhook-triggered requests versus standard API calls? Documentation link would be appreciated if this behavior is expected.
answer: Good question, and this is expected behavior in certain edge cases. Webhook-triggered requests are counted against a separate burst allowance that resets on a rolling 10-second window rather than the per-minute window shown on your dashboard, so the header can briefly go negative during rapid bursts even though your minute-level usage is fine. I've linked our rate limiting documentation below which covers this distinction in more detail, and I'm happy to walk through your specific logs if you'd like a closer look.

subject: Audit log entries missing for admin role changes
body:
We rely on the Admin Console audit log for compliance reviews across our 4562 seats, and we've found that role change events (admin promotions/demotions) performed between March 3rd and March 10th are missing entirely, even though the actions definitely occurred - we have internal tickets referencing them. Deactivation events from the same period do appear correctly logged.

This is a compliance concern for our upcoming audit. Can you investigate why role change events are not being captured and whether the data can be recovered from backend logs?
answer: Thank you for flagging this, I recognize the compliance impact and I'm escalating to our platform team immediately. We'll check backend event logs for the March 3-10 window to determine if the role change events were dropped at ingestion or simply not surfaced in the audit UI, and I'll report back within one business day with findings and, if possible, a backfill of the missing entries.

subject: All uploaded files disappeared after retention policy update
body: Yesterday I updated our retention policy from 90 days to 60 days in Storage settings, and this morning our entire file library is empty - not just files older than 60 days, everything is gone including files uploaded last week. We have 11 seats depending on these documents for daily operations and this has completely halted our team.
answer: I'm treating this as a critical incident and escalating immediately given the full data loss reported. Please stop making any further changes to retention or storage settings on your account right now while we investigate, and I'll confirm within the hour whether we can restore your files from our backend backups. I will update you as soon as I have more information.

subject: Recurring transform failures on inventory sync pipeline
body:
Our inventory sync pipeline has been failing at the transform stage roughly every other run over the past week, with the error 'field type mismatch: expected integer, got string' on the quantity_available field. The source connector hasn't changed on our end. We've had to manually rerun the pipeline 6 times since Monday to keep inventory data current.

Could someone check if this is related to a schema change on the connector side, and suggest whether we should add explicit type casting before the transform step?
answer: Thanks for the detailed error message, that's very helpful. This pattern matches a known issue where the source system occasionally sends quantity_available as a string during certain inventory update events, and I'd recommend adding a type-cast transform step as a workaround while we confirm with the connector team whether a permanent fix is planned. I'll also check your pipeline logs directly to confirm the exact failing runs and follow up with specifics.

subject: Feature request: retry logic for failed push notifications when device is offline
body:
Our operations team uses the mobile app to send time-sensitive alerts to field staff, and we've noticed that push notifications sent while a device is offline simply fail silently with no retry attempt once connectivity returns. Over the past month we estimate at least 15-20 alerts per week never reach the intended recipient because of this.

Could you add automatic retry or queuing for push notifications so they deliver once the device reconnects? This would meaningfully improve reliability for our field operations use case.
answer: Thank you for the detailed feedback, this is a great use case to share with our mobile team. Currently the app does not queue push notifications for offline devices, but I'm logging this as a feature request specifically noting the field-operations impact and the 15-20 weekly missed alerts you're seeing. In the meantime, a possible workaround is checking notification delivery status via our API and triggering a fallback SMS or email for alerts that fail to deliver within a set window.

subject: Notifications
body: We're seeing duplicate alert notifications sent for the same event ID through the Notifications API - each triggering webhook is firing 2-3 times within a few seconds, sending duplicate SMS and email alerts to end customers. This started around 06:00 this morning and is affecting alerts across our entire retail notification workflow, we've counted over 300 duplicate sends so far today.
answer: This is impacting your customers directly so I'm escalating right away. Can you share a few affected event IDs and approximate timestamps so our engineering team can trace the duplication in the delivery pipeline? In the meantime, if your integration can dedupe on event ID before sending downstream that would limit customer impact while we investigate the root cause.

subject: Session tokens expiring far earlier than configured TTL
body: We're integrating Northwind Identity via OIDC for our internal tools and set the access token TTL to 60 minutes in the tenant settings. In practice, sessions are getting invalidated after roughly 12-15 minutes, forcing users to re-authenticate constantly. We see repeated 401 responses with 'token_expired' from the /userinfo endpoint well before the configured expiry. This is affecting our engineering team's workflow since we call several internal APIs that rely on the session staying active.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. A 60-minute TTL not being honored points to either a mismatch between the access token and refresh token settings or a caching issue on our auth service side. Could you send us your tenant ID and the client ID used for this integration so we can pull the token issuance logs and compare the configured versus actual expiry? We'll dig into this today.

subject: Handling for late-arriving events in pipeline runs
body: Our media analytics pipeline pulls impression data from an ad-server connector, and we're consistently seeing 5-10% of events arrive 2-4 hours after the batch window closes. Right now those records get dropped from the aggregated output, which throws off our daily reporting numbers. Is there a way to configure a grace period or late-arrival watermark on the pipeline so these records get reprocessed into the correct window instead of discarded?
answer: This is a common issue with ad-server feeds and we do support configurable watermarking on pipeline stages to catch late data. I'll send over documentation on setting a grace window and reprocessing triggers for your connector type. In the meantime, could you tell us which connector and pipeline ID you're using so we can check if late-arrival handling is already enabled and just needs tuning?

subject: Alret routing to wrong teem, duplicates too
body: hi, we have several alret rules set up so billing alerts go to finance and system alerts go to IT, but lately evrything is landing in both channels. also getting duplicate emails for the same alert, sometimes 2-3 copies within a minute. can we get an option to set routing rules per alert type so this doesnt keep happening, its confusing our teams.
answer: Thanks for flagging this - duplicate alerts and routing crossing over usually points to overlapping rule conditions. We'll review your alert routing configuration and check for rule conflicts that could be causing the duplication. In the meantime, could you list the specific alert rule names you're seeing this on so we can trace them directly?

subject: SCIM PROVISIONING SETUP QUESTION
body:
WE'VE BEEN ROLLING OUT NORTHWIND ACROSS OUR MANUFACTURING TEAMS AND ARE PLANNING TO CONNECT OUR HR SYSTEM SO NEW HIRES GET ACCOUNTS AUTOMATICALLY. WE WENT THROUGH THE SSO SETUP LAST MONTH AND THAT'S WORKING FINE FOR LOGIN, MFA IS ALSO ENABLED FOR ALL USERS NOW.
