WHAT WE STILL NEED IS CLARITY ON HOW SCIM PROVISIONING WORKS WITH OUR STARTER PLAN. DOES SCIM SUPPORT AUTOMATIC DEACTIVATION WHEN SOMEONE LEAVES, OR DO WE NEED TO MANUALLY REMOVE THEM. WE COULDN'T FIND CLEAR DOCS ON THIS FOR OUR PLAN TIER.
answer: Thanks for the context on your rollout. SCIM provisioning, including automatic deactivation on offboarding, is available but the exact feature set does vary by plan tier. I'll confirm what's included for Starter and send over our SCIM setup guide with the deactivation workflow documented. If automatic deprovisioning isn't included at your tier, I can also share options for upgrading that capability.

subject: Invoice shows 20 seats but we only have 14 active users
body: Our latest invoice bills us for 20 seats on the Starter plan, but when I check the admin console we only have 14 active user accounts. This has been the case for at least two billing cycles now. Can someone review our account and either adjust our seat count going forward or issue a credit for the overage we've already been charged?
answer: I'm sorry for the discrepancy - let's get this corrected. I'll pull up your account and compare the billed seat count against active users for the last two cycles to confirm the overage. If we confirm the mismatch, we'll adjust your seat count immediately and process a credit for the difference on your next invoice.

subject: Zapier integration completely broken - this is unacceptable
body: Our Zapier integration with Northwind has been failing since Tuesday. Every zap that triggers off a new order event is erroring out with 'authentication failed' even though we haven't changed any credentials. This connects our order data to Slack notifications and our Salesforce pipeline, and right now none of it is working. We rely on this for daily operations across 195 seats and have had zero updates from support in over a day.
answer: I completely understand the frustration, especially with this affecting your daily operations - we're prioritizing this now. Authentication failures on an established Zapier connection usually indicate an expired or revoked API key on our end, so we're checking your integration's key status and recent auth logs immediately. We'll follow up within the hour with either a fix or a clear update on what's causing it.

subject: App-Absturz beim Start auf mehreren Geräten
body: Seit dem Update in dieser Woche stürzt unsere Mobile App direkt nach dem Start ab, noch bevor der Login-Bildschirm erscheint. Betroffen sind mehrere Android-Geräte in unserem Team, iOS scheint bisher nicht betroffen zu sein. Push-Benachrichtigungen kamen vorher normal an, jetzt können die Nutzer die App gar nicht mehr öffnen.
answer: Danke für die Meldung, das klingt nach einem ernsten Problem mit dem Android-Build. Können Sie uns die genauen Gerätemodelle und Android-Versionen sowie die App-Version aus den Einstellungen mitteilen? Wir prüfen den aktuellen Absturzbericht auf unserer Seite und melden uns so schnell wie möglich mit einer Lösung oder einem Workaround zurück.

subject: SCIM sync stopped deprovisioning users - urgent
body: Our SCIM integration has stopped deprovisioning users from Northwind when they're removed from our identity provider. We offboarded three employees last week and their accounts are still active and able to log in, which is a serious problem given we're in media and handle sensitive content. The SCIM sync log shows the last successful deprovisioning event was over a week ago, with no errors reported since, it just silently stopped processing those events.
answer: This needs immediate attention given the access risk - thank you for reporting it right away. Could you send us the tenant ID and the SCIM endpoint configuration so we can check the sync job status and see why deprovisioning events stopped processing? As an immediate workaround, please manually deactivate the three accounts you mentioned while we investigate the root cause.

subject: Help
body: One of our former employees can still log into the admin console two days after we deactivated their account. They're not on our IP allowlist anymore but somehow the session is still active and they have full access. Need this locked down immediately.
answer: This is being treated as urgent - a deactivated account retaining active access is a serious security concern. Please provide the account's user ID or email so we can force-terminate the session and confirm deactivation on our end right now, and we'll also pull the audit log to see how the session persisted past deactivation. We'll follow up within the next few minutes with findings.

subject: Mass session invalidation causing SSO login loop for all users
body: Starting around 9:40am today, our entire org (248 seats) is being logged out of SSO every few minutes and hitting a login loop - authenticate, land on dashboard, then bounced back to login within 2-3 minutes. Our API logs show tokens being marked invalid almost immediately after issuance, with 'session_revoked' errors appearing in bulk starting at that timestamp. This is blocking access for our whole team and looks like it started right after a config change we made to MFA enforcement settings.
answer: This is affecting your whole organization so we're escalating immediately. The timing alongside your MFA enforcement change strongly suggests a policy conflict causing mass session revocation - we're pulling the session logs from 9:40am onward now to confirm. Please hold off on further MFA config changes while we investigate, and we'll update you within the next 30 minutes with either a fix or a rollback recommendation.

subject: Route billing alerts to finance team instead of admin inbox
body:
We currently have all Notification alerts for payment failures and invoice generation going to our admin@ inbox, but as finance manager I need these routed to my team's shared inbox instead. Right now we're getting duplicate copies in both places, which is confusing during month-end close.

Could you set up a rule so billing-category alerts go only to finance-alerts@blueacademy.org? We'd also like to keep the admin inbox for system alerts only.
answer: Thanks for flagging this - I can help set up separate routing rules so billing alerts go exclusively to your finance-alerts address while admin alerts stay separate. Could you confirm the exact alert types you'd like classified as 'billing' (e.g. payment failure, invoice generated, refund issued) so I configure the rule precisely? I'll also check why duplicates are appearing in both inboxes in the meantime.

subject: Question on backup retention periods and configuring longer windows
body:
I'm trying to find documentation on how long Northwind Storage retains backup snapshots by default for our Pro plan. We're approaching our quota limit and want to understand whether increasing retention will affect that, and if there's a way to configure a custom retention window (e.g. 90 days instead of the default) for specific buckets.

We have about 3TB across 12 buckets right now and want to plan capacity before our fall semester starts.
answer: Good question - on the Pro plan, default backup retention is 30 days, but this is configurable per bucket up to 180 days from the Storage settings panel under 'Backup Policy'. Longer retention does count toward your storage quota, so with 3TB across 12 buckets, extending to 90 days would roughly double your backup footprint - I'll send over our capacity planning doc and a link to the retention documentation so you can estimate before the semester starts.

subject: Klärung zu Rate Limits und veraltetem Webhook-Endpunkt
body:
Wir nutzen die API Platform für unsere Logistikdaten und stoßen seit letzter Woche häufiger auf den Fehler 429 Too Many Requests, obwohl wir laut Dokumentation im Rahmen von 600 Requests/Minute bleiben sollten. Zusätzlich ist mir aufgefallen, dass der Webhook-Endpunkt /v1/events/legacy als deprecated markiert ist, aber wir haben keine offizielle Ankündigung dazu erhalten.

Können Sie uns die aktuellen Rate-Limit-Werte für den Pro-Plan bestätigen und mitteilen, bis wann der alte Webhook-Endpunkt noch unterstützt wird? Wir müssen unsere Migration planen.
answer: Vielen Dank für die Nachricht. Für den Pro-Plan liegt das aktuelle Limit bei 500 Requests/Minute pro API-Key, nicht 600 - das könnte die 429-Fehler erklären, die Sie sehen. Der Endpunkt /v1/events/legacy wird noch bis zum 30. November unterstützt; ich sende Ihnen die Migrationsanleitung zum neuen /v2/events-Endpunkt sowie die aktualisierte Rate-Limit-Dokumentation zu.

subject: urgent - uploads failing, quota shows wrong
body: Storage quota shows 40% used but uploads reject with quota exceeded since this morning.
answer: This is being escalated immediately given the scale of your account. We're investigating a possible mismatch between reported and enforced quota values on our backend - can you confirm the exact bucket name and a timestamp of a recent failed upload so our engineers can trace it in logs? We'll update you within the hour.

subject: Confused about credit balance and refund for canceled seat
body:
We removed one seat last month and were told we'd get a prorated credit, but our latest invoice doesn't show any credit applied - it charged us the full amount for 4 seats again. I also submitted a refund request on March 3rd for a duplicate charge and haven't heard back.

Can someone explain how credits are supposed to appear on invoices, and check the status of that refund request? Our reference number for the duplicate charge is INV-88213.
answer: I'm sorry for the confusion here - credits from seat changes should appear as a line item labeled 'Prorated Credit' on the following invoice, and it sounds like that didn't happen correctly for your account. I've located the refund request tied to INV-88213 and can confirm it's queued for processing; I'll personally follow up with billing to expedite both the missing credit and the refund and get back to you within two business days with confirmation.

subject: SDK throwing intermittent 500s on webhook signature verification
body:
We're using the Python SDK (v3.4.1) for the API Platform and occasionally get 500 errors when verifying incoming webhook signatures, roughly 1 in every 50 calls. It seems to happen mostly on our /shipments/updated webhook. Not blocking, since we retry successfully, but wanted to flag it in case it's a known SDK bug.

Also noticed the SDK docs still reference the deprecated verify_signature_legacy() method - might be worth updating that page.
answer: Thanks for reporting this - intermittent 500s on signature verification at that rate suggests a timing issue with clock skew tolerance in the SDK, which we've seen on a few other Pro accounts. I'll file a bug report referencing your account and webhook endpoint, and I'll also flag the outdated verify_signature_legacy() documentation to our docs team for correction.

subject: Manufacturing floor alerts duplicating and arriving 10+ min late
body:
Our operations team relies on Northwind Notifications to route equipment-down alerts to the right shift supervisors via email, but since yesterday we're seeing each alert delivered twice and with a noticeable delay - one alert at 2:14pm was still arriving at 2:26pm. This is causing confusion on the floor about whether an issue is new or already resolved.

Can you check if there's a backlog or misconfiguration in our alert routing rules? We have around 15 active routing rules across three plants.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report - a 10+ minute delay combined with duplicates points to a processing backlog in the notification queue rather than a routing rule issue, and we're looking into it now. I'll check your account's queue metrics for the affected time window and let you know within a few hours whether this was a transient delay spike or something tied to your specific routing setup.

subject: How to generate additional API keys with scoped permissions
body:
We're setting up a new integration with our inventory system and want to create a separate API key that only has read access to the Inventory endpoints, rather than reusing our main admin key. Is scoped key creation available on the Starter plan, or is that an Enterprise-only feature?

If it's not available, would love to submit this as a feature request since sharing our full-access key with a third-party vendor makes us nervous.
answer: Good question - scoped API keys with restricted endpoint permissions are currently a Pro and Enterprise feature, so it's not available on Starter today. I've logged your request as feedback for our product team, as this comes up fairly often; in the meantime, a workaround some Starter customers use is creating a dedicated key and manually restricting its use through your own proxy layer if that's feasible for your setup.

subject: URGENT: API keys returning 401 unauthorized after rotation, integration down
body:
We rotated our production API key this morning following the standard rotation process, but the new key is returning 401 Unauthorized on every request, including basic GET /v1/status calls. Our client-facing integration has been down for almost an hour now. Error message: {"error":"invalid_api_key","code":401}. We've double-checked the key was copied correctly and even regenerated it a second time with the same result.

This is affecting all API and webhook traffic for our legal document platform - we have active client deadlines today and need this resolved immediately.
answer: I understand the urgency and we're treating this as a P1 - escalating to our platform team right now. Can you send the key ID (not the secret) and the exact timestamp of the rotation, along with one full request/response pair? There's a known issue where key propagation across regions can lag by a few minutes after rotation, but if it's been an hour we suspect something else is blocking activation and will get engineering on this immediately.

subject: Invoice shows 12 seats but we only have 8 active users
body:
Our latest invoice charged us for 12 seats on the Starter plan, but when I check our admin panel we only have 8 active users listed. This is the second month in a row this discrepancy has shown up, and it's a meaningful overcharge for a company our size. Invoice number is INV-77042, dated this billing cycle.

I need this corrected and a refund issued for the excess seats charged, ideally before our books close this week. Please also explain why the seat count isn't syncing correctly with actual usage.
answer: I'm sorry for the trouble this is causing with your closing schedule - this is a priority for us to resolve. I'm pulling up INV-77042 now to compare the billed seat count against your active user list; if there's a sync discrepancy between seat allocation and usage, we'll correct the invoice and process a refund for the overcharged seats right away. I'll have an update for you within the next few hours given your close deadline this week.

subject: Duplicate charges on October invoices
body:
I'm reviewing our October billing export and found that invoice INV-88213 and INV-88214 both charge Blue Energy for the same billing period (Oct 1-31) at $14,320.00 each. This has happened for at least 6 other accounts under our org based on the CSV export I pulled this morning. Finance is asking whether we need to issue refunds before month-end close, which is in two days.

Can someone confirm whether this is a system-wide duplication bug in the invoicing job, and whether refunds will be processed automatically or if we need to request them manually per invoice?
answer: Thank you for flagging this with the specific invoice numbers, that's very helpful. We're seeing reports of duplicate invoice generation from a batch job that ran twice overnight, and we've escalated this to our billing engineering team as a P1 since it affects multiple accounts. We'll void the duplicate invoices and confirm no double payment capture occurred on your end within the next few hours, and will follow up with a full list of affected invoice IDs and refund status for Blue Energy before your month-end close deadline.

subject: Salesforce sync failing for all contact records since last night
body:
Our Salesforce integration stopped syncing contact and account records as of approximately 11:40 PM last night. The sync log in our admin console shows 'Error: OAuth token refresh failed - invalid_grant' repeating every 15 minutes. We have roughly 4,300 users across Orion Media relying on this sync for case updates, and our support teams are now working from stale Salesforce data.

We already tried disconnecting and reconnecting the Salesforce app in the integrations panel, but the reconnect flow just loops back to an error page. This is affecting our entire healthcare operations team.
answer: This is a priority issue for us given the scale of impact, and we're opening it as P1 immediately. The invalid_grant error typically indicates the Salesforce connected app's refresh token was revoked, possibly during a Salesforce-side security review or password policy change - can you confirm if anyone rotated credentials or updated IP restrictions on the Salesforce org recently? In the meantime, our integrations team is checking whether the OAuth handshake is failing on our side or Salesforce's, and we'll send reconnect instructions or a manual token reset as soon as we isolate the cause.

subject: Users can't unsubscribe from booking alerts
body:
Several of our team members clicked 'unsubscribe' on the booking confirmation emails and are still receiving duplicate alerts, sometimes two or three copies of the same notification within minutes. We only have 7 seats on this account so it's easy to spot the pattern - it started around September 18th after we set up a new alert rule for flight delay notifications.

Can you check why the unsubscribe link isn't updating preferences, and why the same alert is being sent multiple times to the same recipient?
answer: Thanks for the detailed timeline, that helps narrow this down. It sounds like the unsubscribe action is being recorded but not fully propagated to the notification rule you created on September 18th, which may be sending independently of the global preference setting. We're looking into both the duplicate delivery and the unsubscribe sync issue now and will update you within the day with a fix or a workaround for the affected alert rule.

subject: Request to reduce Salesforce sync frequency for performance
body:
We'd like to change our Salesforce sync interval from every 5 minutes to hourly. Our data team noticed the frequent sync jobs are creating noticeable lag in our Salesforce org during business hours, especially around 9-11 AM when our legal staff are actively updating case records. We have 66 seats on this integration and use it mainly for client intake data.

Is there a setting in the integration config to adjust polling frequency, or does this need to be changed on your end?
answer: You can adjust this yourself under Integrations > Salesforce > Sync Settings, where there's a polling interval dropdown that goes from 5 minutes up to daily. Changing it to hourly should reduce the load during your peak morning hours without affecting data freshness significantly for intake records. Let us know if you don't see that option and we can enable it on our side for your account.

subject: Okta app broken - no one can log in via SSO
body:
As of this morning, every attempt to log into Northwind through our Okta app tile fails with 'SAML response validation error - certificate mismatch.' This is blocking all 23 of our users from accessing the platform. We haven't changed anything in our Okta configuration recently, and this worked fine as of yesterday afternoon.

We need this resolved urgently since our media team relies on daily dashboard access for reporting.
answer: We're treating this as a P1 given it's blocking all SSO access for your team. A certificate mismatch usually means the SAML signing certificate was rotated on either the Okta side or ours without the metadata being re-synced - we're checking our identity provider logs now for any certificate updates pushed in the last 24 hours. We'll reach back out shortly with either a corrected metadata file for your Okta app or confirmation once we've resynced the certificate on our end.

subject: Okta app throwing errors after Salesforce integration update
body:
Since we updated our Salesforce integration settings yesterday, our Okta app connection has started intermittently failing with 'Assertion consumer service URL mismatch' errors for about a third of our 18 users. This seems to have started right after the Salesforce change, so I suspect something in that update affected the Okta SSO configuration.

Could someone check if there's a dependency between the two integrations that might explain this?
answer: Thanks for the context on the timing, that's a useful clue. Okta and Salesforce SSO configs shouldn't normally interact, but we've seen cases where updating one integration's redirect URLs inadvertently resets shared ACS URL settings if they were provisioned through the same identity template. We're escalating this internally to check the sequence of changes on your account and will confirm whether a config rollback or manual ACS URL correction is needed.

subject: Dashboard PDF exports timing out on large charts
body:
When exporting our quarterly enrollment dashboard to PDF, the export consistently fails after about 90 seconds with a generic 'Export failed, please try again' message. This dashboard has 14 charts and pulls data from roughly 3,600 institutions across our Enterprise account. Smaller dashboards with 3-4 charts export fine.

This has been happening since the dashboard grew past 10 charts a few weeks ago, and we need reliable exports for board reporting at the end of this month.
answer: Thanks for the detail on chart count and data scale, that lines up with a known performance ceiling on PDF rendering for dashboards with heavy chart counts and large underlying datasets. We're looking into whether we can increase the export timeout threshold or optimize rendering for your specific dashboard, and will also check if splitting the export into a paginated batch process could help in the meantime given your board reporting deadline.

subject: Requesting more frequent scheduled sync option
body:
Right now our data pipeline sync for our student records connector is only available on a daily schedule, but we'd like to run it every 2 hours instead to keep our reporting dashboards more current. We have 10 seats and use this mainly to pull enrollment data from our SIS connector into Northwind.

Is there a way to enable a shorter sync interval, or is this something that needs to be added as a feature for Starter plans?
answer: Currently, sub-daily sync scheduling is only available on our Pro and Enterprise tiers, so it's not something you can enable directly on the Starter plan today. I've logged this as a feature request on your behalf and will also loop in our account team to discuss whether a plan upgrade or a limited-time trial of more frequent syncs would work for your reporting needs.

subject: Storage quota alert but usage looks lower than shown
body:
We received a quota warning email saying we've used 92% of our storage allocation, but when I check the storage usage panel in the admin console it shows only 61% used. We need to know the accurate number because we're required to keep 7 years of transaction records for compliance and can't risk hitting a hard limit unexpectedly.

Could you confirm which figure is correct and whether backups count separately toward the quota shown in the console?
answer: Good question, and this discrepancy is likely because backup snapshots are counted toward your total quota usage in the billing system but aren't reflected in the live storage panel, which only shows active file storage. We'll pull the exact breakdown between active data and backup retention for your account and send it over shortly so you have an accurate number for your compliance planning.

subject: unsubscibe endpoint not working propely
body:
hey, im integrating the notifications API and the unsubscribe endpoint (POST /v1/notifications/unsubscribe) keeps returning 200 OK but the user still gets emails after. tested with test-user-4471 like 5 times today and they got 3 duplicate emails in the last hour even tho the resposne says succsess.

is there some delay before it takes effect or is this a bug? kinda blocking our launch tmrw so would appreciate a quick reply
answer: Thanks for the test details, that's helpful for tracking this down. A 200 response with continued delivery usually points to a caching issue where the unsubscribe flag isn't being checked by the notification dispatch service in time, and we're seeing similar reports today so we're treating this as a priority fix. We'll investigate the delay for test-user-4471 specifically and get back to you well before your launch tomorrow with either a fix or a workaround to suppress sends immediately after unsubscribe.

subject: Refund credit not applied to latest invoice
body:
I'm reviewing our October invoice (INV-88213) and we were promised a $340 credit back in September for the outage on the 12th, but it's not showing up anywhere on this statement. I checked our billing history and see the credit note (CN-4471) was issued but the balance still reflects the full amount due.

Can someone confirm whether this credit is meant to apply automatically or if we need to request it be applied manually? We'd like this resolved before the payment date on the 30th.
answer: Thanks for flagging this, I can see credit note CN-4471 for $340 was issued but not yet linked to invoice INV-88213 due to a sync delay between our credit and billing systems. I've manually applied it now, so your updated balance reflects the deduction, and you should see the corrected invoice in your billing portal within the hour. I'll also check for any other pending credits on your account to make sure nothing else is stuck.

subject: How to update SAML metadata for our IdP change
body:
We're migrating our identity provider from Okta to Azure AD and need to update the SAML configuration for our Northwind tenant. Currently we have SSO enabled for 21 users under Apex Capital, and I want to make sure we don't lock anyone out during the cutover.

Could you walk me through the steps to update the IdP metadata URL and certificate without disabling SSO login in the meantime? Also curious if there's a way to test the new config with a single test user before rolling it out to everyone.
answer: Good news, you can update your SAML metadata without any downtime for existing sessions. In the Identity admin console under SSO Configuration, there's an option to add a secondary IdP entry, which lets you test login with one designated user while the original Okta config stays active for everyone else. Once you've confirmed the Azure AD login works end to end, you can promote it to primary and remove the old entry. Let me know if you'd like me to walk through the certificate upload step live.

subject: Best practice for paginating large result sets via API
body:
We're pulling order records through the API Platform for our manufacturing dashboard and currently using offset-based pagination with limit=100. On some endpoints, particularly /v2/orders, we're seeing inconsistent results when new records are inserted between page requests, causing duplicate or skipped items.

Is cursor-based pagination available for this endpoint, or is there a recommended workaround? We're processing around 50,000 records per sync and want to avoid data integrity issues going forward.
answer: You're right that offset pagination can produce those inconsistencies under high write volume. The /v2/orders endpoint does support cursor-based pagination via the next_cursor field returned in each response, though it's not yet default behavior, so you'll need to pass cursor= instead of offset= in your requests. This should eliminate the skip/duplicate issue you're seeing at your record volume. I'll also flag this in our API docs backlog since the pagination guidance for this endpoint could be clearer.

subject: Unsubscribed users still receiving duplicate emails
body:
We have a serious issue where customers who unsubscribed from our notification list are still getting duplicate emails, sometimes 3-4 copies of the same alert within minutes. This started this morning around 9am and we've already had two clients email us asking why they're still subscribed after opting out days ago.

Our unsubscribe endpoint is returning 200 OK but the suppression list doesn't seem to be respected on the next send cycle. This is affecting all 6 of our team's outbound campaigns and we need this fixed urgently before it damages client trust.
answer: This is being treated as high priority right now. We've identified that the suppression list sync job that runs between the unsubscribe endpoint and the send pipeline has been failing silently since this morning, which explains why unsubscribes aren't being honored on subsequent sends. We're pausing all outbound sends from your account temporarily while we reprocess the suppression list and confirm it's applied correctly, and will update you within the hour with a fix timeline.

subject: Uploads failing across multiple warehouses since this morning
body:
Starting around 6:15am today, our warehouse teams across all US regions have been unable to upload delivery confirmation files to Storage. The upload UI shows 'Upload failed: quota exceeded' but our storage dashboard shows we're only at 62% of our 5TB Enterprise quota.

This is blocking close to 1,194 users across our logistics operations from confirming deliveries, and we're now behind on end-of-day reconciliation. We need this escalated immediately, this is a production-impacting incident for us.
answer: I understand the severity here and this has been escalated to our storage infrastructure team immediately. We're seeing a discrepancy between the quota calculation service and actual usage that's incorrectly triggering the block, and a fix is already being tested. In the meantime, I'd recommend having teams hold off retrying uploads since retries are adding load to the affected service, we'll notify you the moment uploads are re-enabled and will follow up with root cause details once resolved.

subject: Data pipeline sync delayed by hours, breaking downstream reports
body:
We're integrating Northwind's Data Pipelines to sync patient scheduling data into our analytics warehouse, and for the past two days records are arriving 4-6 hours late. Our connector config expects near-real-time sync (under 15 minutes), and this delay is now causing our downstream health reports to show stale data during business hours.

The connector logs show no errors, just increasing latency starting around June 3rd. Given we're a small team of 18 and rely on this for daily operational decisions, we need help identifying whether this is a connector issue or something on our source system.
answer: This is being treated as a priority incident given the operational impact. We're seeing elevated queue depth on the pipeline worker pool that processes your connector, which lines up with the latency starting June 3rd, and it appears unrelated to your source system. We're scaling up worker capacity now and will monitor sync latency over the next hour to confirm it returns to under 15 minutes; I'll update you as soon as we see normal throughput restored.

subject: Push notifications not appearing on iOS devices
body:
Our team started noticing that push notifications for new invoice approvals stopped showing up on iOS devices about three days ago, though they still work fine on Android. I tested this on my own device and confirmed notification permissions are enabled in settings, but nothing comes through even for test alerts sent from the admin panel.

We rely on these push alerts for approval workflows, and with only 25 seats on our team, several people have already missed time-sensitive approvals because of this. Could you help us figure out if this is an app-side bug or a config issue on our end?
answer: Thanks for the detailed testing you've already done, that helps narrow things down. We've seen a similar issue tied to an APNs certificate renewal that expired for a subset of accounts a few days ago, which would explain the iOS-only symptom. I'm checking your account's push configuration now and will renew the certificate on our end if that's the cause; I'll follow up shortly to confirm notifications are coming through again.

subject: Sitzplatzanzahl in Rechnung stimmt nicht
body:
Wir haben aktuell 11 aktive Nutzer in unserem Konto, aber die letzte Rechnung berechnet Gebühren für 15 Sitzplätze. Ich habe das im Admin-Bereich unter Benutzerverwaltung überprüft und dort werden korrekt 11 Personen angezeigt.

Können Sie das bitte prüfen und die Differenz von 4 Sitzplätzen korrigieren oder uns erklären, wie diese Zahl zustande kommt? Falls es sich um einen Fehler handelt, würden wir auch um eine entsprechende Gutschrift bitten.
answer: Vielen Dank für den Hinweis. Wir haben Ihr Konto überprüft und festgestellt, dass vier Einladungen an ehemalige Nutzer noch als 'ausstehend' im Abrechnungssystem gezählt wurden, obwohl diese nie aktiviert wurden. Wir haben diese Einträge entfernt und die Rechnung entsprechend auf 11 Sitzplätze korrigiert; eine Gutschrift für die Differenz wird innerhalb der nächsten zwei Werktage auf Ihrem Konto sichtbar sein.

subject: Invoice line items missing tax breakdown for API usage
body:
We're integrating with the Billing API to pull invoice data programmatically for our finance team, and I noticed that invoices returned from GET /v1/invoices/{id} don't include a tax breakdown by line item, only a single total_tax field. We need per-line tax detail to reconcile with our accounting system, especially since we operate across multiple regions with different VAT rates.

Is there a way to get itemized tax data through the API currently, or would this need to be added as a feature? Also separately, invoice INV-77291 seems to have a duplicate line item for the same billing period, could someone check that?
answer: Good catch on both counts. Currently the API only exposes total_tax at the invoice level, itemized per-line tax breakdown isn't available yet, so I've logged this as a feature request with our billing platform team given the multi-region VAT reconciliation need you described. On INV-77291, I checked and confirmed there is indeed a duplicate line item for the same period, we're issuing a corrected invoice and a refund for the duplicate charge, which should reflect on your account within a day or two.

subject: Question about offline push notification behavior
body:
I've been testing our mobile app setup and noticed that push notifications don't seem to queue when a user's device is offline, they just don't arrive at all once the device reconnects. Is this expected behavior for the current mobile app, or is there a setting we need to enable to support delayed delivery?

We have a small team of 8 and mostly use the app for daily report alerts, so missed notifications aren't critical, but I wanted to understand if there's documentation on how offline handling works before we build more workflows around it.
answer: That's expected behavior right now, push notifications sent while a device is offline aren't queued for redelivery on reconnect, they're only delivered if the device is online at send time. We don't have a setting to change this currently, but I've noted it as feedback for the mobile team since offline queuing comes up periodically. I'll also point you to our notifications documentation page, which covers delivery guarantees in more detail, so you can plan your workflows accordingly.

subject: Need to restrict workspace settings access + audit log question
body:
I'm integrating our internal tools with the Admin Console API and noticed any user with workspace admin role can change settings like allowlist entries without any secondary approval. We want to deactivate a workspace admin's ability to edit the IP allowlist directly and instead require escalation to our security team first.

Is there a way to restrict this via settings, or do we need to build our own gate on top of the API? Also, does the audit log capture allowlist changes with the actor's user ID? We're on North Media's Starter plan with 13 seats and need this locked down before our next travel client onboarding.
answer: Thanks for flagging this - on Starter, workspace settings changes (including allowlist edits) are tied to the admin role itself, so there's no built-in secondary-approval step yet; you'd need to gate this at your integration layer by checking role before allowing calls through. The audit log does record allowlist modifications with the acting user's ID and timestamp, viewable under Admin Console > Audit Log > filter by 'Settings'. I'll log this as a feature request for tiered approval on settings changes and update you if it lands on the roadmap.

subject: Dashboards extremely slow to load for finance team - impacting month-end close
body:
Since yesterday our shared revenue dashboards are taking 30-45 seconds to load, sometimes timing out completely. We have around a dozen finance users trying to pull month-end numbers right now and this is blocking our reporting deadline. The charts with retail sales-by-region breakdowns are the worst offenders.

Export to CSV is also failing intermittently with a generic 'export failed' message. This started after we added two new shared dashboards last week. Can someone look at this urgently - we're on Summit Partners' Pro plan and this is affecting the whole finance department.
answer: This has been escalated to our performance team as a P1 - we're seeing elevated query times on shared dashboards in your workspace and are actively investigating whether the two newly added dashboards introduced a heavy query pattern affecting others. In the meantime, could you send us the exact dashboard names/IDs for the slowest ones so we can isolate and optimize them first? We'll also check the export failures in parallel and post an update within the hour.

subject: Mobile app crashes right after opening on one device
body:
One of our operations staff has the Northwind mobile app crashing immediately on launch on her tablet - it shows the splash screen for about a second then closes back to the home screen. This has happened consistently for the past two days across four attempts. Other team members on their phones don't have this issue.

She's on an older Android tablet, app version should be whatever's current from the Play Store. Not urgent since it's just one device and she can use the web login in the meantime, but wanted to report it since we couldn't find anything in the docs about offline mode compatibility with older devices.
answer: Thanks for the details - crashes right at launch like this are often tied to device compatibility or a corrupted local cache. Could you have her try uninstalling and reinstalling the app, and if possible let us know the exact Android version and tablet model? We'll also check whether offline mode has any known issues with older OS versions and update our documentation accordingly since that's a gap you rightly pointed out.

subject: Urgent: need to rotate and manage API keys programmatically via SDK
body:
We're building automated key rotation into our finance reconciliation pipeline and need the ability to create, list, and revoke API keys through the SDK rather than the console UI. Right now our workaround involves manual rotation every 30 days which isn't sustainable given our compliance requirements as a fintech company.

Does the current API Platform SDK support key lifecycle management endpoints? If not, we need this escalated as it's blocking our automated security compliance process. Also want to confirm whether webhook notifications fire when a key is about to expire.
answer: I've escalated this to our API Platform team given the compliance timeline you mentioned. Key creation and revocation are supported via the /v1/api-keys endpoints, but listing keys with expiration metadata isn't yet exposed in the SDK - that's a gap our team is aware of and I've flagged your use case to prioritize it. On webhooks: we don't currently send expiration-warning events, but I'm submitting that as a feature request tied to this ticket and will follow up with a timeline.

subject: SCIM provisioning failing - new employees not getting accounts created
body:
Our SCIM integration with Northwind Identity stopped creating new user accounts as of this morning. We've had at least 15 new hires added to our HR system since 8am and none of them have Northwind accounts provisioned - they can't log in via SSO at all. Deprovisioning also seems affected since two terminated employees still show as active.

Our SCIM endpoint logs show 200 responses being returned from our side, so this looks like it's failing on Northwind's end during processing. With 243 seats across North Travel this is blocking a big chunk of our workforce from accessing any Northwind products today.
answer: This is now our top priority - I've escalated to our Identity engineering team as a P1 given the scale of impact. We're pulling SCIM sync logs from your tenant now to identify where processing is failing on our side despite the 200 responses from your endpoint. I'll update you within the next 30 minutes with findings, and in the meantime please hold off on manual account creation to avoid duplicate/conflicting records once we resolve the sync issue.

subject: Bulk user deactivation via API - need settings and audit trail
body:
We're integrating with the Admin Console API to automate offboarding when employees leave Pioneer Academy. I can deactivate individual users via the API, but I need to confirm the exact settings required to ensure deactivated users lose all session tokens immediately and that this shows up correctly in the audit log for our compliance reviews.

Could you point me to documentation covering bulk deactivation endpoints if they exist? Right now I'm looping through user IDs one at a time which works but I want to confirm there isn't a batch endpoint I'm missing, and I want to make sure audit log entries include timestamp and reason code for each deactivation.
answer: There isn't a dedicated bulk deactivation endpoint currently - looping through individual user IDs via the deactivate call is the correct approach for now, and I'll pass along the batch endpoint request to our product team since it's a common ask. Deactivation via the API does immediately revoke active session tokens, and audit log entries capture timestamp, actor, and target user ID; reason codes aren't currently a field but you can pass a custom note in the request body which does get logged.

subject: PDF export from dashboard cutting off charts and showing wrong data
body:
When I export our monthly spend dashboard to PDF, two of the four charts get cut off at the page edge and one bar chart shows completely different numbers than what's displayed on screen. This happened with exports on both Tuesday and again today when I retried.

I need clean PDF exports for our board meeting next week. Is this a known export rendering issue, or something specific to our fintech spend dashboard setup? Happy to share the dashboard name if that helps troubleshoot.
answer: Sorry for the trouble - this does sound like a known rendering issue with multi-chart layouts when exporting to PDF, where cached data can sometimes get pulled instead of the live view. Could you send over the dashboard name and roughly what time you ran the exports? In the meantime, exporting each chart individually as PNG or trying the export again after a hard refresh of the dashboard has worked around this for other customers while we fix the underlying rendering bug.

subject: Planned deprecation of legacy API key format - migration timeline?
body:
I saw the changelog mention that legacy-format API keys (the ones starting with 'nk_live_' without the versioned prefix) are being deprecated. We have around 40 keys in that format across our services at Granite Labs and want to plan the migration properly given our legal industry compliance review cycle.

Can you confirm the exact sunset date and whether there's a grace period where both formats work simultaneously? Also curious if the new key format supports the same webhook signing verification or if that changes too.
answer: Good timing on catching this - legacy-format keys are scheduled for sunset on the date noted in our changelog, with a 90-day overlap window where both old and new formats will authenticate successfully so you can migrate gradually. Webhook signing verification works the same way with new-format keys; the signing secret generation and HMAC validation logic is unchanged, only the key prefix differs. I'd recommend starting migration for non-critical services first and we're happy to review your rollout plan if useful.

subject: Dashboards unusably slow - need this fixed or we're evaluating alternatives
body:
Our team has been dealing with painfully slow dashboard load times for the past week, sometimes 20+ seconds just to render a single chart. We rely on these dashboards daily for financial reporting and this is now affecting how our finance team operates. Sharing dashboards with external stakeholders has also become unreliable since shared links time out before loading.

We need either a fix or a clear explanation of what's causing this. With only 18 seats on our Starter plan we don't have room to absorb this kind of productivity loss, and if this continues we'll need to reconsider whether Northwind is the right fit for Willow Robotics.
answer: I completely understand the frustration and I've marked this P1 given the daily impact on your reporting workflow. We're pulling performance diagnostics on your workspace's dashboards right now to identify whether this is query-level, rendering, or related to the shared-link timeout issue you mentioned - those often have a common root cause. I'll follow up today with specific findings and a remediation plan; in the meantime, if there are one or two dashboards causing the most pain, let us know so we can prioritize those first.

subject: Request: performance improvements for enterprise-scale dashboard sharing
body:
As we roll out Dashboards more broadly across Quill Analytics (588 seats), we're consistently seeing load times degrade significantly once a dashboard is shared with more than 20-30 users, particularly ones with multiple chart types and export-heavy usage patterns. This is becoming a blocker for our planned org-wide rollout next quarter.

We'd like to understand what's driving this degradation and whether there are architectural or configuration changes on our end that could help, or if this is something your team needs to address on the platform side. Given our Enterprise tier and rollout timeline, we'd appreciate a technical deep-dive call this week if possible.
answer: Thanks for raising this ahead of your rollout - this aligns with a known scaling pattern we're actively working on for high-share-count dashboards with heavy chart/export usage. I'm looping in our solutions architecture team to set up a technical deep-dive this week as requested; in the meantime, could you share two or three specific dashboard IDs showing the degradation so we can run diagnostics before the call and come with concrete findings rather than general recommendations?

subject: Dashboards taking 20+ seconds to load for shared views
body:
Since last week, our shared manufacturing KPI dashboard has been taking 15-25 seconds to render for anyone who opens it via the shared link. Direct owner access loads in about 3 seconds. We have 18 seats and roughly 6 people rely on this dashboard daily for shift reporting. The dashboard has 9 widgets pulling from two data sources.

Can you check if shared/public dashboard rendering is going through a different, slower path? This is affecting our morning shift handoff meetings.
answer:
Thanks for the detailed report. Shared dashboard links do route through an extra permissions-check layer, and we've seen recent latency spikes there tied to widget count on multi-source dashboards. I'm opening an investigation and will check the render logs for your workspace over the last week to pinpoint which widgets or queries are adding the delay.

In the meantime, as a workaround, try caching the dashboard with a scheduled refresh instead of live queries on the two heaviest widgets - that usually cuts load time significantly for shared viewers. I'll update you within one business day with findings.

subject: Cannot upload backup files - quota error but we have space
body:
We're getting upload failures on our monthly patient records backup (Storage product). The error says 'Quota exceeded: 92GB of 100GB used' but when I check the usage dashboard it shows only 61GB used. This has failed three times today, on Oct 14th, and we need this backup completed before end of week for compliance reasons.

We're on a small plan with 4 seats so I don't have a lot of technical staff to dig into this. Can someone check our account quota calculation? File is about 8GB, named patient_backup_1014.zip.
answer:
I understand the urgency given your compliance deadline - I'm escalating this now. A mismatch between displayed usage and the quota check usually points to stale cache in the quota service, which we've seen a few times this month after deleted-file cleanup jobs. I'm manually verifying your account's real consumption and will force a quota recalculation on our end.

I'll follow up within a few hours with confirmation that the upload will go through, and if the recalculation takes longer than expected I'll issue a temporary quota override so you don't miss your Friday deadline.

subject: Need IP allowlist configured for admin console access
body:
We're rolling out stricter access controls ahead of a client audit next month and need to restrict Admin Console login to our corporate office IP ranges. We have 122 seats across three offices (Chicago, Toronto, and a small remote team) and want to allowlist three /24 ranges while blocking all other IPs from reaching admin settings.

Could you confirm whether IP allowlisting is available on our Pro plan and walk us through enabling it? We'd also like to know how it interacts with our existing SSO deactivation policy for offboarded staff.
answer:
IP allowlisting for Admin Console is included on Pro plans, so you're all set there. I can enable the feature flag on your account now - once it's on, an account owner will see a new 'Network Access' panel under Admin Settings where you can add your three /24 ranges and set enforcement to either 'warn' or 'block'.

On the SSO interaction: allowlisting only gates console access, not the SSO deactivation workflow, so offboarded staff will still be deactivated correctly regardless of IP. I'll send over setup documentation and can join a call this week if you'd like help with the audit-prep configuration.

subject: Storage retention policy deleted files we needed
body:
We discovered this morning that several backup files uploaded in July were automatically removed under what looks like a 90-day retention policy we didn't know was active. We're an education customer with 12 seats and these were curriculum backups our compliance team needs to keep for a full academic year.

Can you tell us exactly what retention policy is applied to our Storage account by default, and whether there's any way to recover the deleted July uploads? We need to adjust the policy going forward so this doesn't happen again.
answer:
I'm sorry about the unexpected deletion - on Starter plans, Storage defaults to a 90-day retention window unless a custom policy is configured, which explains why the July uploads were purged. I'm checking our backend deletion logs now to see if the files are still in the recovery window, and will let you know within the next few hours whether restoration is possible.

For going forward, I can help you set a custom retention policy of 365 days on your account so this doesn't recur - just confirm and I'll apply it today.

subject: need new API key
body: old key expired, need replacement asap for billing integration
answer: Happy to help - I can generate a new API key for your billing integration right away. Could you confirm which environment (production or sandbox) the expired key was tied to, so I issue the replacement with matching scopes and avoid any webhook disruption?

subject: Mobile app offline mode losing local data on reconnect
body:
I'm integrating our Harbor Academy app with the Northwind mobile SDK, and I've found that when a device goes offline, makes several form submissions locally, then reconnects, about half the queued submissions get silently dropped instead of syncing. I tested this on Android 13 with 5 test submissions made offline - only 2 synced after reconnecting on Oct 9th.

Also noticed the app crashes occasionally right after reconnect with a null pointer in the sync handler. Is there a known issue with the offline queue in the current SDK version?
answer:
Thanks for the reproducible steps, that's very helpful. We have an open investigation into an offline-queue race condition on Android that can cause partial sync drops and a null pointer during the reconnect handler - your report matches that pattern closely. Could you share the SDK version and a crash log snippet if you have one, so I can confirm it's the same issue and get you on the fix list?

In the meantime, I'd recommend reducing batch sync size to 1-2 items per reconnect cycle as a temporary mitigation to limit data loss until the patch ships.

subject: deprecation notice question
body: got email about v1 API deprecation, need timeline and SDK impact
answer: Thanks for flagging this - the v1 API endpoints are scheduled for sunset on a rolling basis over the next two quarters, with the first cutoff affecting authentication endpoints. I'll send you the full deprecation timeline and a compatibility note on which SDK versions require updates so your team can plan the migration without disruption.

subject: Bulk document uploads failing intermittently since Tuesday
body:
Since Tuesday our legal document uploads to Storage have been failing intermittently - roughly 1 in 5 uploads returns a 500 error with no clear message. We're uploading case files in batches of 50-100 PDFs, average size 3-5MB each, and the failures seem random rather than tied to any specific file.

We're on the Pro plan with 175 seats and this is disrupting our discovery document workflow. Could you check server-side logs for our account around Oct 10-12 to identify the cause? We also want to confirm our retention settings weren't affected.
answer:
Thanks for the detailed timeframe - I'm pulling server-side upload logs for your account for Oct 10-12 now to trace the intermittent 500 errors. Random failures at that ratio during batch uploads often point to a transient timeout on our ingestion nodes rather than anything client-side, but I'll confirm once I have the trace IDs matched to your failed requests.

I've also checked your retention configuration and it remains unchanged at the current policy, so no data impact there. I'll update you within the day with root cause and, if needed, a batch-size recommendation to avoid further failures while we resolve it.

subject: MFA enrollment stuck for multiple users after SSO update
body:
After our recent SSO configuration update, a growing number of employees are unable to complete MFA enrollment - the enrollment screen loads, they scan the QR code, but the verification step returns 'Invalid code' even with correct codes. I've confirmed this affects at least 14 users so far across different departments as of this morning, all trying to enroll for the first time.

We have 162 seats on the Pro plan and this is blocking new logins for affected staff. Can you check if the SSO update caused a time-sync or provisioning issue with our MFA setup?
answer:
This looks like a clock-drift issue between our MFA verification service and your identity provider following the SSO update - TOTP codes are time-sensitive, so even a small sync gap causes 'Invalid code' errors during enrollment. I'm checking your provisioning logs now to confirm the timestamp deltas for the affected 14 users.

As an immediate step, please have affected users try enrollment again after confirming their device clock is set to automatic/network time - that resolves most cases. I'll also verify our server-side time sync for your SSO connector and report back shortly with a permanent fix if the issue is on our end.

subject: Salesforce sync stopped updating lead records
body:
Our Salesforce integration has stopped syncing new lead records into Northwind as of yesterday around 2pm. We rely on this for our admissions pipeline reporting and normally see 20-30 new leads synced daily, but nothing has come through since then. No error banners are showing in the integration settings page.

We're a 25-seat education account. Can you check whether the Salesforce connector token expired or if something changed on our sync configuration? This is disrupting our admissions team's daily follow-up workflow.
answer:
Thanks for the timestamp, that helps narrow things down. Stalled syncs with no visible error banner are usually caused by an expired or revoked OAuth token on the Salesforce side that our connector hasn't yet flagged in the UI - I'm checking your connector logs now for a token refresh failure around 2pm yesterday.

If that's confirmed, you'll need to re-authenticate the Salesforce connection from the Integrations settings page, and I can walk you through it live if useful. I'll have a definitive answer on the cause within the next couple of hours.

subject: Biometric login crashing app for all field staff
body:
Since this morning our field team at Ember Systems has been unable to log into the Mobile App using Face ID or fingerprint. The app crashes immediately after the biometric prompt on both iOS and Android devices. We have 22 seats and about 18 of them are affected right now, which is blocking attendance check-ins at three campuses.

We tried reinstalling the app and clearing cached credentials but the crash happens every time right after the biometric scan completes. Push notifications still come through fine, and offline mode seems unaffected, it's specifically the biometric unlock step that's broken.
answer:
Thanks for the detailed report, this sounds like a regression tied to a recent OS-level biometric API change and we're treating it as P1. Could you confirm the app build version shown in Settings > About, and whether the affected devices are on iOS 17.4+ or a specific Android version? In the meantime, staff can switch to PIN login under Settings > Security to unblock check-ins while we investigate.

We're pulling crash logs from your account now and will update this ticket within the next hour with findings or a hotfix timeline.

subject: Connector auth token expiring every few hours
body:
We run a nightly and hourly sync from our media asset system into Northwind Data Pipelines using the S3-compatible connector (connector ID conn-4471). Starting Tuesday, the connector auth token seems to expire every 4-6 hours instead of the usual 30 days, and each sync run after that fails with 'Error: 401 invalid_grant, refresh token rejected'.

We've had to manually re-authenticate the connector three times since Tuesday, and each failure delays our reporting dashboards by several hours since the sync backlog builds up. Data quality checks are also flagging stale records because of the gaps.
answer:
Thanks for flagging this, a 401 invalid_grant loop like that usually points to a token rotation issue on our side rather than your credentials. We can see conn-4471 in your account and are checking the refresh token lifecycle logs for the last 48 hours. Could you let us know the exact timestamps of the last two failures so we can correlate them precisely?

As a workaround, re-authenticating manually should keep syncs running while we investigate, and we'll follow up here once we identify the root cause.

subject: Question about how offline mode handles large route lists
body:
Our dispatch team at Granite Media relies on the Mobile App's offline mode when drivers lose signal in warehouse zones. We're curious how offline mode decides which route and delivery records to cache locally, since some drivers report that only their first 20-30 stops are available offline even though their full route can have 80+ stops.

This isn't blocking anyone today, but with 273 seats across our logistics teams we'd like to understand the caching limits so we can plan routes accordingly, and whether this is configurable.
answer:
Good question, and glad this isn't currently blocking your drivers. Offline mode currently caches the first 30 stops per route by design to limit local storage use, which explains what your team is seeing. This isn't user-configurable today, but we're logging your feedback as a feature request to raise or make that limit adjustable for logistics-heavy accounts.

We'll update this ticket if the caching limit changes in a future release.

subject: Slack alerts from billing integration not posting
body:
We configured the Slack integration a few weeks ago to post payment failure and invoice alerts into our #finance-ops channel, alongside our existing Jira and Okta integrations. Since October 3rd, none of the Slack alerts are coming through even though the integration still shows as 'Connected' in the Integrations dashboard.

We rely on these alerts to catch failed charges quickly across our 1,416 seats, and finance staff only noticed the gap when a declined card wasn't caught for five days. Salesforce and Jira integrations still seem to be working normally.
answer:
Thank you for the detailed timeline, that gap since October 3rd is helpful for narrowing this down. We're checking whether the Slack webhook for your workspace was invalidated during a recent token refresh, since Jira and Salesforce use separate auth paths which explains why those are unaffected. Could you confirm the Slack workspace name and channel ID you configured so we can verify the webhook status directly?

We'll prioritize this given the billing alert gap and follow up with next steps shortly.

subject: Need to restore storage snapshot from before recent upload errors
body:
We need to restore our Storage account to the backup snapshot from October 12th, before a batch upload script overwrote roughly 4,200 product image files with corrupted duplicates. Our current usage is close to our quota, so I want to confirm the restore process won't temporarily double our storage usage during the operation.

Can you also confirm whether this restore requires downtime for our team, since we have 206 seats actively uploading throughout the business day and would need to schedule this carefully.
answer:
Thanks for the clear details. Restoring the October 12th snapshot is possible and typically completes within a couple of hours; during the restore, usage may briefly increase by the size of the restored snapshot before old corrupted files are purged, so we'd recommend having some quota headroom or we can temporarily raise your limit for the operation. The restore itself does not require full downtime, but uploads to affected folders should pause during the window to avoid conflicts.

Let us know your preferred restore time and we'll schedule it with your account and confirm once complete.

subject: Enabling MFA enrolment for new hires automatically
body:
As we onboard new staff at Quill Analytics, we'd like MFA enrolment to be enforced automatically at first login rather than optional, since currently new accounts can skip setup and access billing and case data without it. We have 588 seats and legal compliance has flagged this as a gap during our recent internal audit.

Could you confirm whether there's a setting to require MFA enrolment during provisioning, and if not, whether this can be added as a feature request for enterprise accounts?
answer:
Thanks for raising this, mandatory MFA enrolment at provisioning is available on Enterprise plans and can be enabled under Identity and SSO > Security Policies > Require MFA at First Login. Once turned on, any new account created will be forced through enrolment before accessing billing or case data, and existing accounts without MFA will be prompted on next sign-in.

We're happy to walk through enabling this with your admin team if useful, just let us know a convenient time.

subject: Frage zu Plan-Upgrade und Sitzplätzen
body:
Wir möchten unseren aktuellen Pro-Plan bei Cobalt Media upgraden, da wir in den nächsten Wochen von 267 auf voraussichtlich rund 300 Sitzplätze wachsen. Können Sie uns erklären, wie sich ein Upgrade auf die laufende Rechnung auswirkt und ob zusätzliche Sitzplätze sofort oder erst zum nächsten Abrechnungszyklus berechnet werden?

Außerdem wollten wir fragen, ob ein Upgrade Auswirkungen auf die Performance der Logistik-Dashboards hat, da wir aktuell schon leichte Verzögerungen bei größeren Berichten bemerken.
answer:
Vielen Dank für Ihre Anfrage. Bei einem Upgrade werden zusätzliche Sitzplätze anteilig für den restlichen aktuellen Abrechnungszeitraum berechnet und erscheinen als separater Posten auf Ihrer nächsten Rechnung, danach läuft die Abrechnung regulär zum neuen Sitzplatzkontingent weiter. Ein Plan-Upgrade selbst hat keinen direkten Einfluss auf die Dashboard-Performance, die Verzögerungen bei größeren Berichten sind wahrscheinlich unabhängig davon und wir können das gerne separat prüfen.

Sagen Sie uns gerne Bescheid, wenn Sie das Upgrade einleiten möchten, dann bereiten wir das für Sie vor.

subject: URGENT: Biometric login broken, staff locked out of patient app
body:
Our clinical staff at Cobalt Partners cannot log into the Mobile App using fingerprint or Face ID since about 8am today. The app crashes right after the biometric prompt on every device we've tested, both iOS and Android. This is blocking access to patient schedules for our entire 96-seat workspace during business hours.

We've had staff try PIN fallback but several accounts don't have a PIN configured, so they're completely locked out. Push notifications for shift changes also seem delayed or not arriving. This is affecting patient care coordination and we need urgent help.
answer:
We understand the urgency and this is now escalated as P1. As an immediate workaround, staff without a PIN configured can log in via username and password on the web portal to access schedules while we resolve the mobile crash, and we can help set temporary PINs in bulk if that's faster for your admin team. We're pulling crash logs from your workspace now to identify the cause of the biometric crash and the delayed push notifications.

We'll update you within the hour with findings, and please let us know if any accounts remain completely inaccessible so we can prioritize those first.

subject: Files being deleted before retention period ends
body:
We've found that files uploaded to Storage under our custom 90-day retention policy are being deleted after roughly 30 days instead. We noticed this when a backup archive from September 2nd, expected to be retained until early December, was gone when a team member tried to access it on October 3rd.

This looks like a bug in how the retention policy is being applied, since our policy settings in the console still show 90 days configured correctly. We need this escalated since it affects compliance requirements for our 79-seat retail account and we're concerned other files may have been deleted early too.
answer:
Thank you for catching this, an early deletion under a configured 90-day retention policy is a serious issue and we're escalating it immediately. We're pulling deletion logs for your account now to determine the scope, including whether other files beyond the September 2nd archive were affected, and whether any can still be recovered from our internal recovery window.

We'll update this ticket as soon as we have scope and recovery details, and in the meantime we recommend pausing any scheduled deletions on your side until we confirm the retention logic is fixed.

subject: Request to configure IP allowlist for API access
body:
I'm integrating our internal tooling with the Northwind API and need to restrict access to a specific set of office and CI/CD IP ranges for security reasons. I don't see an IP allowlist option under our current Admin Console settings, only general API key management and audit log viewing.

Could you confirm whether IP allowlisting is available on our Starter plan, or if this is a feature we'd need to request? We'd also like to understand how allowlist changes get logged in the audit trail once set up, since we're a small 12-seat team but this API integration is critical for our education platform.
answer:
Thanks for reaching out. IP allowlisting for API access isn't currently available on the Starter plan, it's part of our higher-tier plans where it can be configured under Admin Console > Settings > Network Access, and any changes to the allowlist are automatically recorded in the audit log with the admin identity and timestamp. I'll log this as a feature interest note on your account in case Starter-tier allowlisting becomes available.

If securing this integration is time-sensitive, we can also discuss a plan upgrade path that includes this feature, just let us know.

subject: Push notifications not delivering to iOS devices after 2.4.1 update
body:
Since we pushed the mobile app update 2.4.1 to our clinical staff on Oct 3, push notifications for shift alerts are not arriving on iOS devices. Android devices seem fine. We've confirmed notification permissions are enabled and devices have connectivity. Affects roughly 30 of our 76 users based on our helpdesk tickets so far.

We also noticed a few crash reports in our MDM console referencing the notification service right after login on iOS 17.6. Can you confirm if this is a known regression tied to the update?
answer:
Thanks for the detailed report. We've seen a small number of similar cases tied to APNs token registration failing silently after the 2.4.1 update on iOS 17.6, and we're actively investigating with engineering. Could you send us the device console logs from one affected iPhone around the time of a failed notification, plus the exact build number from Settings > About?

In the meantime, having affected users force-quit and relaunch the app once (not just background refresh) has restored delivery for a few customers. We'll update this ticket as soon as we have root cause confirmation.

subject: URGENT: MFA enrolment loop locking out all API users, tokens invalidated
body:
We integrated the Identity API last week and today every one of our 3 seats got stuck in an MFA enrolment loop - the enrolment endpoint returns success but the session token is immediately invalidated on the next call. All existing refresh tokens for our tenant appear to have been revoked around 14:20 UTC. We can't authenticate any users into our retail app right now.

This is a total outage for us. We need this resolved immediately as customers can't check out.
answer:
This is being escalated to our security and identity on-call team right now as a P0. We're pulling the enrolment and token logs for your tenant to identify why refresh tokens were revoked at 14:20 UTC and why the MFA loop is occurring. Please do not attempt to re-enroll additional users until we confirm root cause, as that may worsen the token state.

We'll have an engineer join this ticket within the next 15 minutes with findings and a mitigation plan. We understand this is blocking checkout and are treating it as top priority.

subject: Warehouse ERP connector failing auth, pipeline data stale for 2 days
body:
Our finance team relies on the Data Pipelines connector to our ERP system for daily invoicing reconciliation, and since Monday the connector job has failed with 'authentication token expired, refresh failed' errors. Last successful sync was Oct 6 at 09:12. We've regenerated the API credentials in the ERP twice but the pipeline still can't re-authenticate.

We have 101 seats depending on this data for month-end close, which is in three days, so we need the connector working again and a backfill for the missed runs.
answer:
Thank you for flagging this - we can see the connector for your ERP source has been failing token refresh since Oct 6 and we're treating this as a high-priority bug given your month-end close deadline. Our pipelines team is reproducing the auth refresh failure now, as this looks like it may be affecting other customers on the same connector version.

Once we confirm the fix, we'll trigger a manual backfill for the missed sync windows so your reconciliation data is complete. We'll keep you updated with progress within the next few hours.

subject: Deprecation warning in Python SDK for webhook signature verification
body:
I'm getting a deprecation warning when calling verify_webhook_signature() in the Python SDK (version 4.2.0): 'DeprecationWarning: legacy_hmac_verify will be removed in v5.0, use verify_signature_v2'. We use this in our travel booking webhook handler for rate-limited event ingestion.

Could you point me to migration documentation for v2 verification, and let me know the timeline for when legacy_hmac_verify will actually be removed? Want to make sure we update before it breaks anything.
answer:
Good catch, and thanks for checking ahead of time. legacy_hmac_verify is scheduled for removal in SDK v5.0, targeted for release in Q2 next year, so you have some runway. The migration guide for verify_signature_v2 is here: docs.northwind.cloud/sdk/webhooks/migration-v2, the main change is passing the raw request body as bytes rather than a decoded string.

We'd also love your feedback on the new signature format once you've migrated - feel free to reply here with any friction points you hit.

subject: storage retention question
body: Can we set custom retention per folder instead of account-wide?
answer: Right now retention policies apply at the account level only, but per-folder retention is on our roadmap and I've added your request to that feature ticket. In the meantime, you can approximate this by using separate storage buckets with different account-level policies if that helps your workflow - happy to walk through setup if useful.

subject: Need help routing Slack alerts from Salesforce and Jira integrations
body:
We're trying to set up the Integrations module so that Salesforce case escalations and Jira ticket priority changes post to specific Slack channels, but alerts are all landing in the default #alerts channel regardless of the routing rules we configured. We followed the setup docs and mapped rules under Integrations > Routing, but it seems the channel override isn't being respected.

This is blocking our support team's on-call workflow across 50 seats, so we'd appreciate a quick call or walkthrough of the correct configuration.
answer:
Thanks for the clear writeup. This sounds like the routing rule priority order issue we've seen when multiple rules match the same event type - the default channel rule may be taking precedence over your custom mappings. Could you send a screenshot of your current routing rules list under Integrations > Routing so we can check the ordering?

Given this is impacting your on-call workflow, we'd like to get this sorted quickly - I can also set up a 20-minute screen-share this week if that's faster than back-and-forth here.

subject: Requesting upgrade from Starter to Pro and refund for double invoice
body: We'd like to upgrade our Granite Foods account from Starter to Pro to get higher API limits for our reporting team, but I noticed invoice INV-88213 charged us twice for September (once on the 1st and again on the 15th) for the same 24 seats. Can you process the plan upgrade and also refund the duplicate charge?
answer: Happy to help with both. I've reviewed invoice INV-88213 and can confirm the duplicate charge on the 15th - I'm processing a refund for that amount now, which should appear in 3-5 business days. I've also queued your upgrade from Starter to Pro; you'll see the updated limits reflected within the hour and a prorated charge on your next invoice.

subject: Deactivated users still showing active access, audit log gap
body:
We deactivated 14 departing employees in the Admin Console yesterday as part of an offboarding batch, but our security review this morning found 6 of them can still log in and access documents. The audit log shows the deactivation events but no corresponding access revocation entries for those 6 accounts. This is a serious exposure for us given we're a legal firm handling client data across 282 seats.

We need this locked down immediately - please advise if this is a known bug or if we need to manually revoke sessions.
answer:
This has been escalated immediately to our security team as a P0 given the potential access exposure. As an urgent mitigation, please go to Admin Console > Users > Sessions and manually revoke active sessions for those 6 accounts right now - deactivation should force this automatically, so we're investigating why the revocation step didn't fire for these specific users.

We're pulling backend logs for the deactivation batch now to identify the gap and will report back within the hour with root cause and confirmation that no further accounts are affected.

subject: How to filter Slack alerts by severity in Integrations settings
body: We have Slack connected via our Integrations module alongside Jira and Salesforce, and currently every Okta login anomaly alert posts to our main channel regardless of severity. Is there a way to filter so only high-severity alerts get posted to Slack, with the rest just logged? Documentation mentions severity filtering but I can't find the setting in our console.
answer: Severity filtering is available under Integrations > Slack > Alert Rules, but it's currently a separate toggle from the general Okta alert configuration, which might be why it's not showing where the docs suggest. Once there, you can set a minimum severity threshold per alert type. I'll also flag this to our docs team so the location is clearer in future updates.

subject: SSO sessions timing out every 15 minutes across our team
body:
Since last week, users authenticating via our SSO provider are being logged out and prompted to re-authenticate roughly every 15 minutes, instead of the 8-hour session we configured. This is happening for most of our 34 seats and is significantly disrupting work, especially for staff on longer booking workflows. We haven't changed our SSO or session settings on our end recently.

Can you check if something changed on the session timeout configuration or SSO integration on Northwind's side?
answer:
Thanks for reporting this - a 15-minute forced timeout instead of your configured 8-hour session points to the session token TTL not being honored correctly, and we want to get this fixed quickly given how many of your team it's affecting.
