Can you confirm which SSO provider you're using and whether this started after any change on your identity provider's side, such as a certificate rotation or app update?

We're checking our session management service logs for your tenant now to see if there was a configuration change or deployment on our end around when this started, and will update you shortly with findings.

subject: Request to improve offline mode stability in Mobile App
body:
We've rolled the Mobile App out to our warehouse teams and offline mode is causing problems. When staff go offline for more than 20 minutes, the app crashes on reconnect about 1 in 5 times, and push notifications that queued while offline get delivered twice once we're back online. Login sessions also seem to expire mid-sync, forcing re-authentication right after reconnecting.

Can we get this logged as a change request to improve the reconnect flow? We have 122 field staff relying on this daily and it's becoming a productivity drag.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report — this is helpful context for our mobile team. We're tracking duplicate push delivery and the reconnect crash as known issues in offline sync and will file this as a change request against the next offline-mode improvement sprint. In the meantime, having users force-close the app before reconnecting reduces the crash rate, and we'd recommend increasing session token lifetime slightly to avoid the mid-sync expiry. We'll update this ticket once we have a target release.

subject: Feature request: faster SAML assertion validation
body:
We're evaluating whether Northwind's SSO can handle our peak login volume during shift changes (around 400 logins in a 10 minute window). During load testing we hit intermittent delays and one failed assertion:

2024-05-14T09:12:03Z ERROR saml.validate: assertion expired
 at AssertionValidator.checkConditions (validator.go:88)
 at SAMLHandler.ProcessResponse (handler.go:142)
caused by: NotOnOrAfter condition failed, skew=185s

Is there a way to increase the allowed clock skew tolerance, or a roadmap item to improve throughput for large batch logins? We'd like this as a feature enhancement rather than an urgent fix since it only showed up under test load.
answer: Thanks for sharing the trace, that's a useful data point. The default clock skew tolerance is 120 seconds, but we can raise it to 300 seconds on your tenant if your IdP's clock drift is the cause — let us know if you'd like that applied. For the throughput question, we're logging this as a feature request for improved batch assertion handling and will follow up if it's picked up in a future roadmap review.

subject: Storage uploads failing as we approach quota limit
body:
Our backup jobs to Northwind Storage have started failing intermittently over the past week. We're currently at roughly 92% of our allocated quota, and large uploads (over 2GB) time out or return a 507 Insufficient Storage response before completing. This is affecting our nightly financial data backups.

Could we get a change made to either raise our quota threshold or add an early warning alert before we hit the ceiling? We'd rather avoid this becoming a recurring issue during month-end close.
answer: Thanks for flagging this — 92% utilization is right at the point where large uploads can get throttled before quota is actually exhausted. We can increase your storage allocation on request; let us know the target size and we'll process the change. We're also adding this to our list for quota-warning alerts, which would notify you at 80% and 90% thresholds going forward rather than only at failure time.

subject: Mobile App stürzt im Offline-Modus ab
body:
Seit dem Update auf die neueste Version der Mobile App stürzt die App bei mehreren Nutzern ab, sobald sie den Offline-Modus verlassen und wieder online gehen. Betroffen sind mindestens 6 Kollegen aus unserem Team. Zusätzlich kommen Push-Benachrichtigungen teilweise doppelt an, und einige Nutzer müssen sich nach dem Absturz erneut einloggen, weil die Sitzung ungültig wird.

Das beeinträchtigt unseren Tagesbetrieb im Außendienst erheblich. Können wir hier kurzfristig Unterstützung bekommen?
answer: Vielen Dank für die genaue Beschreibung. Wir sehen ähnliche Absturzmeldungen im Zusammenhang mit dem Sync beim Wiederverbinden nach dem Offline-Modus und geben das direkt an unser Mobile-Team weiter. Als Zwischenlösung hilft es oft, die App vor dem Wiederherstellen der Verbindung manuell zu schließen und neu zu starten, um den doppelten Sync-Vorgang zu vermeiden. Wir melden uns mit einem Update, sobald ein Fix in Vorbereitung ist.

subject: How to re-authenticate a connector after token expiry
body:
One of our Data Pipelines connectors (the accounting system sync) stopped pulling data three days ago. The pipeline dashboard shows the connector status as 'auth expired' but I can't find where to refresh the credentials without recreating the whole pipeline from scratch. We also noticed sync latency has crept up to almost 40 minutes on the connectors that are still working, versus the usual 5-10 minutes.

Could you walk me through re-authorizing an existing connector, and let us know if the latency increase is a known issue?
answer: You can re-authorize an expired connector without rebuilding the pipeline — go to Data Pipelines > Connectors, select the connector showing 'auth expired', and click Reconnect, which will walk you through re-entering credentials while keeping your existing pipeline configuration and history intact. On the latency increase, we're aware of elevated sync times this week on a subset of connectors and are investigating; we'll update this ticket once we have a root cause.

subject: Push notifications crashing app for offline field staff
body:
We're seeing the Mobile App crash consistently when a queued push notification is delivered right as a device comes back online after being offline. This is happening across our support team's devices, roughly 8-10 crashes a day, and it's disrupting our on-call rotation since techs miss follow-up alerts entirely when the app force-closes.

Is there a known fix or workaround for this, and do you have documentation on how offline push queuing is supposed to behave? We need this resolved quickly since it's affecting active incident response.
answer: This is on our radar as a priority issue — we've had a couple of similar reports of crashes tied to offline push queue delivery. We're escalating this to our mobile engineering team right now given the impact on your on-call workflow. In the meantime, disabling push notifications while offline and relying on manual refresh on reconnect will avoid the crash; we'll send documentation on the intended offline push behavior and follow up with a fix timeline shortly.

subject: settings wont save AGAIN and audit log missing entries
body: this is the third time this month our allowlist settings in the Admin Console just dont save, i add the IP ranges, hit save, refresh the page and its blank again. also checked the audit log to see if changes were even being recorded and theres nothing there either for the last two weeks. we are seriously considering canceling if this basic stuff keeps breaking, its wasting so much of my time.
answer: I'm sorry for the frustration this is causing — losing allowlist changes and missing audit log entries isn't expected behavior, and we're treating this as a priority fix. Can you confirm which browser and whether you're using any ad blockers or extensions, since we've seen a save issue linked to blocked requests on that page? We're also pulling your account logs on our end now to check why audit entries stopped recording, and will update you within the day.

subject: Duplicate email digests being sent to all users
body:
Starting this Monday, our team members have been receiving two identical copies of the weekly notification digest email, sent about 3 minutes apart. This is happening for all 223 seats on our account, and several employees have already flagged it as confusing since they think there are new updates in the second copy. We need this fixed as soon as possible since it's generating a lot of internal support questions for us.

Could you also point us to documentation on how digest scheduling and alerting rules are configured, in case this is something we can control on our end?
answer: Thank you for reporting this quickly — duplicate digest sends affecting your whole workspace is something we're treating as high priority. We're checking whether this is tied to a recent scheduling change on our notification service and will confirm findings within a few hours. I'll also send over our digest configuration documentation so you can review alerting rules on your side while we investigate the root cause.

subject: Mobile App offline mode broken, users can't log back in
body:
Several of our staff are getting stuck after using the Mobile App in offline mode. When they reconnect, the app either crashes outright or shows a login screen that rejects their correct credentials, forcing them to reinstall the app to get back in. Push notifications sent while they were offline never seem to arrive either. This has happened to at least 4 people on our 12-seat account so far this week.

Given how disruptive this is, can we escalate this for a closer look?
answer: Thanks for escalating this — a login failure after offline use combined with app crashes is a serious usability issue and we're prioritizing it. We're pulling device logs from the affected accounts now to identify the pattern; in the meantime, please have affected staff clear the app cache rather than reinstalling, as reinstalling can sometimes lose queued offline data. We'll follow up with next steps shortly and keep this open until we confirm a fix.

subject: Slack alerts not firing for Jira and Salesforce integration events
body:
Our Slack integration has stopped forwarding alerts for Jira ticket updates and Salesforce opportunity changes since sometime last week, even though the integration status page shows both connections as active. We rely on these alerts for our sales and support teams across 274 seats, so the silence has gone unnoticed for a few days and caused some missed follow-ups. Our Okta SSO login for the integrations admin panel is working fine, so I don't think it's an access issue.

Can you help us figure out why these specific alert types stopped triggering while others still work?
answer: Thanks for the detailed breakdown — that helps narrow things down. Since the integration shows as connected but specific event types have gone quiet, this looks like it could be a webhook subscription issue on the Jira or Salesforce side rather than the Slack connection itself. We're reviewing your integration logs now to check event delivery status for both sources and will report back with findings; if needed, we may ask you to re-authorize the Jira and Salesforce connectors to refresh the subscriptions.

subject: Backup uploads failing - storage quota exceeded
body: Our nightly backup job to Northwind Storage failed last night for the third time. The console shows we're at 100% of our quota and the upload for our 'energy-grid-backup-2024' bucket errors out with 'Insufficient storage quota' before completing. We haven't changed our backup size in months so this looks like a bug in how usage is being calculated. Can someone check our account, ref workspace bluecapital-prod?
answer: Thanks for flagging this - a sudden quota discrepancy without a change in backup size does point to a calculation issue on our side rather than genuine growth. I'm pulling the usage metering logs for bluecapital-prod now to compare reported vs actual bytes stored, and will also check if stale backup versions are being retained instead of rotated out. I'll update you within a few hours with findings and, if needed, a temporary quota bump so your backups aren't blocked in the meantime.

subject: Requesting configurable retry rate limit for webhooks
body: We're using Northwind API Platform webhooks to sync order events into our retail analytics pipeline, and right now the retry rate limit for failed webhook deliveries is fixed at what looks like 5 per minute. During peak sale periods we get delivery bursts and legitimate retries get throttled, causing us to lose events. Could we get the retry limit made configurable per endpoint, or at least raised for our workspace?
answer: This is a reasonable ask, and we do have configurable retry limits on our roadmap for the webhooks module. In the short term I can raise your workspace's retry ceiling manually so bursts during peak sale windows don't get throttled - can you confirm the endpoint IDs you'd like this applied to? I'll also log this as a feature request with our platform team and keep you posted on when per-endpoint configuration becomes generally available.

subject: charts broken
body:
Charts broken:
ChartRenderException: null
at renderChart (dashboard.js:112)
at load (app.js:45)
answer: Sorry for the disruption this is causing - a null ChartRenderException affecting dashboard loads is a high priority issue for us and I've escalated it to engineering immediately. Could you confirm which dashboard IDs are affected and whether this started after a specific action, like adding a new widget or sharing link? We'll keep you updated as we investigate and aim to have a fix or workaround within the next few hours.

subject: app crashs when opening on some phones
body: hey, we been testing the mobile app on a few staff phones befor rolling out to the rest of legal team and its crashing right on launch for two android users, one on a pixel and one on samsung. ios seems fine. no error shown just closes back to home screen. also wanted to ask if theres a way to get offline mode or push notifications for case updates, thats something our team really wants for the future.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report - launch crashes limited to specific Android devices usually point to a device or OS version compatibility issue, so could you send us the Android OS versions on the Pixel and Samsung devices along with the app version installed? On the offline mode and push notification requests, those are great suggestions and I've logged them as feature feedback for our mobile product team to consider for future releases.

subject: How to send push notifications from our integration
body: I'm integrating our fulfillment app with Northwind's Mobile SDK and want to trigger push notifications when a shipment status changes. I can see the notification payload structure in the docs but I'm not finding how to authenticate the server-side call to actually send the push - do we use the same API key as the REST API or a separate push credential? Also curious if there's a sandbox mode to test without hitting real devices.
answer: Good question - push sends use a separate push credential rather than your general REST API key, you'll find it under Mobile App settings > Push Credentials in the console. There is a sandbox mode you can enable per app that routes test sends to a mock endpoint instead of real devices, which is ideal for your integration testing before going live.

subject: Crash on app launch after latest update
body: After updating to the latest Mobile App release, our test devices are crashing immediately on launch before the login screen even appears. This is happening consistently across three different Android devices we use for QA. We haven't rolled this update out to our 252 field technicians yet, which is good, but we need this resolved before we can proceed with the wider deployment.
answer: Appreciate you catching this in QA before wider rollout. Could you share the exact app version and Android OS builds on the affected devices, plus whether you're on our latest SDK release from this week? We've had one other similar report and are actively investigating a launch-time crash tied to a recent update, so your device details will help us confirm it's the same root cause.

subject: Biometric login completely broken - users locked out
body: As of this morning biometric login on Northwind Mobile is failing for our entire team - every attempt with fingerprint or face ID returns 'Authentication failed, please try password' even though the biometric prompt itself succeeds on the device. We rely on this for field staff who often don't have connectivity to type long passwords, so this is blocking people from accessing the app right now across the company.
answer: This is impacting your whole team's access so we're treating it as urgent. We're seeing a bug in the biometric token validation step that surfaced after this morning's backend deployment, and our team is actively rolling back the affected change now. In the meantime, please have staff use standard password login as a fallback, and I'll update you as soon as biometric login is confirmed working again, expected within the hour.

subject: Users stuck mid-enrolment for MFA
body: We're seeing several employees get stuck partway through MFA enrolment in Northwind Identity - they scan the QR code, enter the six digit code, and get a spinning loader that never resolves. This started after we enabled the new MFA policy for our sales team yesterday. Around 12 of our 50 seats are affected so far and those users can't complete login until enrolment finishes.
answer: Thanks for the clear timeline - a spinning loader after code entry usually points to the enrolment confirmation callback timing out on our end. Can you send us one or two affected user emails or user IDs so we can trace their enrolment attempts in the logs? While we investigate, those users can be temporarily exempted from the MFA policy via the Identity admin panel so they aren't locked out of login.

subject: Audit log missing entries after deactivating users
body: I deactivated four user accounts in our Admin Console yesterday as part of an offboarding, but when I check the audit log today none of those deactivation events show up. This is a compliance concern for us since we need a full record for our logistics operations audits. The log shows other actions from the same day, just not these specific deactivations, and I need this fixed or explained urgently.
answer: I understand the urgency given your compliance requirements, and I've escalated this to our platform team right away. Missing deactivation events while other actions log correctly suggests a gap in event capture for that specific action type, and we're pulling backend records now to confirm whether the deactivations were processed correctly even though they're not visible in the log. I'll follow up within a few hours with either the recovered log entries or a clear explanation of what happened.

subject: Workspace settings not saving after allowlist update
body: I updated our IP allowlist under Workspace Settings in Admin Console this morning, added two new office IP ranges and removed an old one, but when I refresh the page the changes are gone and the old allowlist is still active. I've tried this three times now with the same result, using Chrome on our end. This is blocking our security team from finishing an access review scheduled for today.
answer: Thanks for the detailed steps - a settings change that reverts on refresh usually points to the save request failing silently, and we want to get your access review unblocked as soon as possible. Could you check your browser console for any errors when you click save, and let us know the exact IP ranges you're trying to add or remove? In the meantime I can apply the allowlist update manually on our end if you'd like to send me the ranges directly.

subject: SCIM-provisioned users missing correct group permissions
body: We've had four new hires added through our SCIM connector this week (Oct 3-6) and none of them landed in the correct permission groups - they can log in but can't see the legal matter workspaces they need. Their SCIM group attribute shows 'Legal-Reviewers' correctly in our IdP but Northwind shows them under 'Default'. Documentation says group mapping should sync automatically - is there a delay or do we need to remap something on our end?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report - this sounds like a group mapping sync issue rather than an access problem, so let's get it sorted quickly. Could you send us the SCIM user IDs (or emails) for the four affected accounts along with the exact provisioning timestamps? In the meantime we'll pull the sync logs on our side to see if the 'Legal-Reviewers' group mapping failed to apply during creation.

subject: Mobile app crashing immediately on launch for iOS users
body: Since the 4.2.1 iOS release went out Tuesday, we're getting reports from a large portion of our field staff that the app crashes immediately on launch, before they even reach the login screen. It seems tied to devices that have push notifications enabled - a few users who disabled push in device settings can get in fine. Around 180 of our field employees are affected, and this is blocking access to patient scheduling data in the field.
answer: This is a high priority issue for us and we're escalating it to the mobile engineering team right away. Could you have a couple of affected users send us their device model, iOS version, and the crash logs from the device (Settings > Privacy > Analytics Data)? We'll also check whether the push registration flow in 4.2.1 is the trigger and will update you within the next few hours.

subject: Push notifications not arriving for expense approval alerts
body: Our finance approvers rely on push notifications from the mobile app to know when expense reports need sign-off, but since Monday nobody on the finance team is getting these alerts on iOS or Android. The in-app notification center still shows the items when we open the app, so it seems to be a delivery-only problem. We've confirmed device notification settings are enabled. This is causing approval delays across our accounts payable team.
answer: Thanks for flagging this - we're seeing similar reports and are checking our push delivery service for any regional outages. Could you share two or three affected user IDs and the app version they're running so we can trace their specific notification queue? We'll keep you posted as we narrow down the cause.

subject: Deactivated users still showing as active in audit log
body: I deactivated three users from the Admin Console last Friday as part of a contractor offboarding, but when I pulled the audit log this morning for our quarterly compliance review, all three still show status 'Active' with login events from this week. Their accounts should have been locked immediately. Can you confirm whether deactivation is actually revoking access or just hiding them from the user list?
answer: That's not expected behavior and we want to confirm access has actually been revoked. Could you send us the three user IDs and the exact deactivation timestamps from your side? We'll check whether the deactivation event is propagating correctly to the authentication layer and follow up with findings today.

subject: SAML login failing with Invalid Assertion error
body: I'm integrating our IdP (Okta) with Northwind SSO via SAML and every login attempt from our test users returns 'Invalid Assertion: Response issue instant expired' even though our server clock is synced via NTP. This started after we uploaded the new metadata XML this morning around 9am. We only have a small team here so this is blocking all of our testing before go-live next week.
answer: Sorry for the disruption during your testing window - let's get this resolved quickly. Could you send us a sample SAML response (with sensitive values redacted) and the exact timestamp of a failed attempt? We'll check the clock skew tolerance configured on our side against the new metadata, since a mismatch there commonly causes this exact error.

subject: Question about restoring a specific backup snapshot
body: We need to restore our storage bucket 'bf-energy-logs' to the snapshot from September 15th ahead of an internal audit next month. Our retention policy is set to 90 days, so I want to confirm this snapshot is still available before we schedule the restore. Could you also point me to documentation on how partial restores work, since we only need the /compliance folder and not the full bucket?
answer: Good news - a September 15th snapshot for 'bf-energy-logs' falls well within your 90-day retention window, so it should still be available. We'll send over our documentation on partial/selective restores, which does support restoring individual folder paths like /compliance without affecting the rest of the bucket. Let us know a preferred date and we can help schedule it.

subject: Push notifications completely broken after latest update - need escalation
body: After updating to the latest app version this week, none of our 13 users are receiving push notifications on Android, and three users have also reported the app crashing when they try to open notification settings. This is critical since our editorial team relies on push alerts for breaking news assignments and we're missing deadlines. Please escalate - we need this fixed today.
answer: We understand the urgency and are escalating this to our mobile team immediately. Could you confirm the exact app version and Android OS versions on the affected devices, and have one of the users experiencing the settings crash send us the crash log if possible? We'll prioritize a fix and update you as soon as we have more information.

subject: SCIM-Provisionierung und MFA-Pflicht für neue Nutzer
body: Wir richten gerade die SCIM-Provisionierung für unser Team ein und möchten sicherstellen, dass neu angelegte Nutzer automatisch zur MFA-Pflicht hinzugefügt werden. In der aktuellen Dokumentation finde ich nur Hinweise zur Rollenzuweisung, aber nichts zu MFA-Attributen im SCIM-Schema. Können Sie mir sagen, welches Attribut wir im Payload setzen müssen, damit MFA automatisch aktiviert wird, und ob es dafür ein Beispiel-Skript gibt?
answer: Vielen Dank für die Anfrage. Für die MFA-Pflicht bei SCIM-provisionierten Nutzern setzen Sie im Payload das Attribut 'urn:northwind:params:scim:mfaRequired' auf 'true' innerhalb des Enterprise-Extension-Schemas. Wir stellen Ihnen gerne ein Beispiel-Payload sowie ein kurzes Skript zur Verfügung, das dies bei der Nutzeranlage automatisch mitsendet - wir schicken es Ihnen im nächsten Schritt zu.

subject: Role mapping assigning wrong permissions after SSO login
body: We noticed today that several users logging in via SSO are being mapped to the 'Store-Manager' role instead of 'Regional-Admin', even though their SAML assertion correctly includes the RegionalAdmin group attribute. This started after we updated our attribute mapping configuration on August 28th for our MFA enforcement rollout. It's affecting store operations dashboard permissions across multiple regions - could this be a mapping bug on Northwind's side?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report, this does look like it could be an issue with how the mapping engine is resolving the updated attribute configuration. Could you send us a sample SAML assertion (with identifying values redacted) along with two or three affected user IDs? We'll check whether the RegionalAdmin group attribute is being correctly parsed after the August 28th config change and follow up with a root cause today.

subject: PDF export cutting off charts on dashboard reports
body: When our team exports dashboards to PDF for board reporting, several charts get cut off at the page edge or split awkwardly across two pages, especially the wider bar charts on the enrollment trends dashboard. This has been happening for the last few export attempts this week. Is there a way to control page orientation or scaling for exports, or is this a known limitation we should work around?
answer: Thanks for the report - chart clipping on wider visualizations during PDF export is a known limitation we're actively working on. In the meantime, switching the export orientation to landscape from the export settings menu should resolve most of the cutoff issues for wide bar charts. We'll also log this as feedback for our product team to consider scaling improvements in a future release.

subject: Occasional transform failures on nightly retail sync pipeline
body: We run pipeline retail-sync-221 every night at 01:00 UTC to consolidate store inventory feeds. Over the last week we've noticed about 15-20 transform failures out of roughly 3,000 records each run, mostly tagged with error 'schema_mismatch_field:unit_price'. It doesn't seem to block the overall run, but I'd like to understand if there's a recommended way to auto-quarantine these bad rows instead of them just failing silently in the logs.
answer: Thanks for flagging this - since the pipeline is still completing successfully overall, this is more of a data-quality tuning question than an outage. You can set a quarantine rule on the transform step (Pipeline Settings > Error Handling > Route to dead-letter) so mismatched rows get isolated instead of just logged. I'll also send over our doc on schema validation rules so you can tighten the unit_price field type before ingestion.

subject: SCIM Provisioning funktioniert nicht für neue Nutzer
body: Seit dem Update unseres Identity Providers am 10. dieses Monats schlägt die SCIM-Provisionierung für neue Nutzerkonten fehl. Beim Anlegen eines Nutzers erhalten wir den Fehler 'HTTP 409 Conflict - user already exists', obwohl der Nutzer in Northwind noch nicht existiert. Betroffen sind bisher 9 von 25 Lizenzen, die Nutzer können sich nicht per SSO einloggen und MFA kann nicht zugewiesen werden. Wir brauchen dringend eine Lösung, da der Schulstart in wenigen Tagen ist.
answer: Vielen Dank für die genaue Beschreibung - das klingt nach einem Konflikt zwischen alten SCIM-IDs und den neuen IdP-Objekten nach Ihrem Update. Wir eskalieren das Ticket intern und prüfen die Provisioning-Logs für Ihren Tenant, um die betroffenen 9 Konten zu identifizieren. Wir melden uns innerhalb der nächsten Stunden mit einem Zwischenstand, da SSO und MFA für mehrere Nutzer blockiert sind.

subject: PDF export broken
body:
Export fails.
Error: Render timeout
Code: 504
Chart: Q3 revenue
answer: Sorry for the trouble - a 504 on PDF export usually means the chart render is timing out on large datasets. Could you confirm roughly how many data points are in the Q3 revenue chart? In the meantime, try exporting with a narrower date filter and we'll dig into why the render queue is timing out on your workspace.

subject: Customers receiving emails after unsubscribing
body: We've had four patients report they keep receiving appointment reminder emails from us even after clicking unsubscribe through the Northwind notification link. I checked the notification logs and their contact IDs still show status 'subscribed' even though the unsubscribe event was logged on our side around June 4th. This is a compliance concern for us given the healthcare context, so I'd appreciate a quick look at why the unsubscribe isn't syncing back to the subscriber list.
answer: Thank you for reporting this - I understand the urgency given the compliance angle. It looks like there may be a delay or duplicate contact record issue in the unsubscribe webhook processing. Could you send us two or three of the affected contact IDs so we can trace the event pipeline and confirm whether it's a sync lag or a duplicate-record bug? We'll prioritize this given patient-facing impact.

subject: Need to upgrade our plan and fix invoice discrepancy
body: We want to move from our current Starter plan to Pro to add more seats, but when I tried the upgrade in the billing portal it charged us for 18 seats at the old rate instead of prorating for the new tier. Our latest invoice (INV-88214) shows $612 which doesn't match what the upgrade page quoted us. We need this resolved quickly since our finance team is closing the books this week and needs the correct invoice amount.
answer: Thanks for catching this before month-end close - a proration mismatch like this usually means the upgrade didn't fully apply on the billing side. We're pulling up invoice INV-88214 now to compare it against the plan change timestamp and will issue a corrected invoice or credit adjustment today so your books reflect the right amount before your closing deadline.

subject: Entire office locked out after IP allowlist change
body: Our IT team updated the IP allowlist in Admin Console this morning to add our new VPN range, but now almost all 4,359 employees across our regional offices are getting 'Access denied - IP not permitted' errors when logging in, including from our original office IP that was already on the list. The audit log shows the allowlist update at 08:12 UTC but doesn't show the previous entries that were removed. We need this reverted immediately as staff cannot access any Northwind products.
answer: This is being treated as a top priority given the scale of impact. We're pulling the audit log around the 08:12 UTC change to identify what was overwritten and will restore the previous allowlist entries as a first step to unblock access. We'll update you within the hour with confirmation once access is restored company-wide, and provide a full breakdown of what changed.

subject: Workspace-Einstellungen lassen sich nicht speichern - Audit Log fehlt
body: Seit heute Morgen können wir die Workspace-Einstellungen im Admin Console nicht mehr speichern. Wenn ich auf 'Speichern' klicke, erscheint kurz eine Erfolgsmeldung, aber die Änderungen an der IP-Allowlist werden nicht übernommen. Zusätzlich fehlen im Audit Log alle Einträge seit dem 14. dieses Monats, obwohl mehrere Kollegen Änderungen vorgenommen haben. Das ist für unser anstehendes Security-Audit kritisch.
answer: Das nehmen wir sehr ernst, besonders im Hinblick auf Ihr Audit. Wir prüfen aktuell, ob die fehlenden Audit-Log-Einträge seit dem 14. mit dem Speicherproblem der Allowlist zusammenhängen, da beide Systeme dieselbe Konfigurationsschicht nutzen. Wir melden uns kurzfristig mit einem Status-Update und stellen sicher, dass keine Einstellungen dauerhaft verloren gehen.

subject: Storage quota exceeded - backups failing
body: Our nightly backup job to Northwind Storage has failed for the last two nights with 'Error: quota_exceeded - 98% of 500GB allocation used'. We're on the Starter plan and clearly need more headroom before tonight's backup window at 23:00 UTC, otherwise we risk losing backup coverage entirely for our 18-seat workspace. Can you help us get a quota increase or temporary buffer approved today?
answer: Thanks for the heads-up before tonight's window - we can process a quota increase for your workspace to avoid missing backup coverage. I'm escalating this to get temporary headroom applied within the next couple of hours, and we'll follow up with options for a permanent storage tier increase so this doesn't recur on future backup cycles.

subject: Clarification on API pagination cursor behavior
body: We're integrating with the API Platform's /v2/documents endpoint and noticed the 'next_cursor' field sometimes returns null even when there are clearly more than 22 records left, based on the total_count field. We're using the Python SDK version 3.4.1. Is this expected behavior for large result sets, or is there a deprecation happening with cursor-based pagination that we should plan our SDK migration around?
answer: Good question, and glad you brought this up early. There's currently a known edge case where the cursor can return null prematurely on result sets crossing certain page-size boundaries; it's not related to any pagination deprecation. We'll share a workaround using the 'page_token' parameter directly and will follow up once a fix ships in a future SDK release.

subject: Transform failures blocking all pipeline syncs since last night
body: Since around 22:30 UTC last night, every transform job in our media metadata pipeline (pipeline ID media-conn-08) has been failing with 'Error: connector_timeout - upstream source unreachable'. This is affecting all our scheduled syncs for our 8-seat workspace and we haven't had a successful run in over 12 hours. Latency on retries is also climbing past 90 seconds before failing outright.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report - a full sync outage like this is our top priority right now. We're checking the connector health for media-conn-08 and the upstream source connectivity to identify whether this is a timeout on our end or the source system. We'll keep you updated every 30 minutes until syncs are restored, and will confirm root cause once resolved.

subject: Okta app integration - Slack notification not firing on group changes
body: We've set up the Northwind Okta app for Lumen Systems and SSO works fine, but when we add or remove users from Okta groups, the corresponding Slack channel notification we configured doesn't fire. We're on 4 seats and only using this for our small IT team, so it's not urgent. Would be great to know if this is a known gap or if there's a setting we're missing on the Integrations page.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. Group membership change events aren't currently forwarded to Slack through the Okta app integration by default - only user provisioning/deprovisioning events trigger notifications right now. I've logged this as a feature request with our integrations team and will update this ticket if it gets scheduled. In the meantime, a workaround is to route those events through a scheduled sync check via the Okta admin console.

subject: Invoice shows 11 seats but we only have 10 active users
body: I was reviewing our latest invoice for Summit Academy and it lists 11 seats billed, but when I check the admin panel we only have 10 active user accounts. I think one of our former employees was deactivated last month but maybe not removed from billing. Can you help clarify how seat counts sync with invoicing so I can correct this going forward?
answer: Thanks for flagging this - seat billing is based on the highest number of active seats during the billing cycle, not just the count at invoice time, so a deactivated user from earlier in the month can still show up on that period's invoice. I've checked your account and confirmed the deactivation date; going forward your next invoice should reflect 10 seats as long as no one else is added. Let us know if the seat count still looks off after your next cycle.

subject: Storage uploads failing with 503 for large batch jobs
body: Since this morning we've been seeing intermittent 503 errors when uploading files larger than 500MB through the Storage API for Delta Works. Roughly 1 in 5 uploads fail with 'service temporarily unavailable' and retries don't consistently succeed. We're running batch jobs against the /v2/storage/objects endpoint and this is affecting our nightly manufacturing data sync across multiple plants.
answer: We're sorry for the disruption - we've identified elevated error rates on the storage ingestion layer affecting large object uploads and our infrastructure team is actively working on it. As a temporary mitigation, please reduce upload chunk sizes to under 250MB and add exponential backoff on retries, which should reduce failure rates. We'll update this ticket as soon as the underlying issue is resolved and will follow up with root cause details.

subject: Users getting logged out every 15 minutes via SSO
body: Since last week, several of our Ember Media staff using SSO through Northwind Identity have been getting logged out roughly every 15 minutes, even during active use. This is happening across different browsers. We haven't changed our SSO configuration or session policy settings recently, so I'm not sure what triggered it. Can you help us figure out if this is a setting change on our side or something on Northwind's end?
answer: Thanks for reporting this - a 15 minute logout pattern usually points to a session timeout policy or token refresh setting rather than a login failure. Can you confirm under Identity & SSO settings whether 'Session Idle Timeout' was recently changed, and also check if MFA re-prompt frequency was adjusted? We'll also review your tenant's session logs on our end to see if tokens are expiring prematurely and follow up shortly.

subject: URGENT: Duplicate and missing alerts across all notification channels
body: Starting this morning our alert routing for Quill Partners has completely broken - some critical alerts are being sent 3-4 times to the same email recipients while others aren't being delivered at all. This is affecting our entire staff of 4 and we rely on these alerts for time-sensitive academic scheduling issues. We haven't changed any routing rules recently.
answer: We understand the urgency and have escalated this immediately. Our team is investigating the notification routing service for duplicate and dropped deliveries and we've identified an issue in the alert deduplication layer that appears to be affecting multiple accounts. We're working on a fix now and will update you within the hour with progress - in the meantime, please hold off on modifying any routing rules so we can accurately trace the issue.

subject: Slack alerts from Integrations completely stopped for entire team
body: As of this morning, none of our Slack alert notifications from Northwind Integrations are coming through for Pioneer Capital, and this is affecting all 292 seats across our logistics operations team. We depend on these alerts for shipment exception handling and our team is currently blind to critical events. Nothing changed on our Slack workspace configuration that we're aware of.
answer: This has been escalated to our integrations on-call team as a priority incident given the scope of impact. We're seeing reports of Slack webhook delivery failures from several accounts and are actively investigating whether this is tied to a recent Slack API change or an issue on our delivery pipeline. We'll keep this ticket updated with progress every 30 minutes until resolved and apologize for the disruption to your operations.

subject: How to map SSO groups to specific roles in Northwind
body: We're setting up SSO for Harbor Legal and want our SAML groups from our identity provider to automatically map to specific Northwind roles - for example our 'Legal-Admins' group should map to Admin role and 'Legal-Reviewers' to a custom reviewer role. Right now everyone logging in via SSO gets the default role regardless of group membership. Could you walk us through the correct configuration steps?
answer: Happy to help set this up. Role mapping requires configuring attribute statements in your SAML assertion to pass group names, then defining matching rules under Identity & SSO > Role Mapping in the admin console where you map each incoming group value to a Northwind role. I'll send over our detailed SAML attribute mapping guide, and once you've configured the assertion on your IdP side, we can verify the mapping together on a quick call if needed.

subject: slow
body:
SEVERAL OF OUR DASHBOARDS TAKE OVER 30 SECONDS TO LOAD NOW FOR PIONEER PARTNERS, ESPECIALLY THE OPERATIONS OVERVIEW ONE WITH MULTIPLE CHART WIDGETS. WE WANT TO CHANGE THE REFRESH SETTINGS OR EXPORT SCHEDULE TO REDUCE LOAD BUT AREN'T SURE WHAT OPTIONS EXIST. HERE IS THE ERROR WE SEE IN BROWSER CONSOLE WHEN IT TIMES OUT:

GET /api/v3/dashboards/8841/widgets 504 (Gateway Timeout)
WidgetLoader.js:112 Failed to fetch widget data
DashboardRenderer.js:340 Uncaught (in promise) TimeoutError
Retry attempt 1 failed
Retry attempt 2 failed
answer: Thanks for sending the console log, that's very helpful. The 504 timeouts on widget fetches usually indicate the dashboard has too many live-refreshing widgets pulling large datasets simultaneously - we recommend reducing the auto-refresh interval or switching some charts to scheduled snapshot mode instead of live queries, which you can configure under Dashboard Settings > Refresh Behavior. We'll also review the specific dashboard ID 8841 on our end to check query performance and follow up with recommendations for widget-level optimization.

subject: API key rotation causing webhook failures
body: We rotated our API keys for Quill Systems yesterday following your rotation guide, but now our webhook endpoints are receiving 401 unauthorized errors even though we updated the new key in our SDK config. We're getting about 40 failed webhook deliveries per hour since the rotation. Is there a propagation delay after generating a new key, or did something go wrong on our end?
answer: There can be a short propagation delay of up to 10 minutes after key rotation before webhook signing fully switches over, but 401 errors persisting this long suggests the old key may still be cached somewhere in your SDK configuration or a secrets manager. Please double check that the webhook signature verification on your receiving endpoint is using the new key as well, since that's a common cause of this exact symptom - let us know the key ID you rotated to and we'll verify propagation status on our end.

subject: Pagination broken on API v2 - missing records between pages
body: We're seeing data loss with pagination on the Northwind API v2 endpoint for Apex Energy - when we page through /v2/shipments using the cursor returned in the response, some records are missing entirely between page 3 and page 4 of a 400-record dataset. This is breaking our nightly sync job and we need this resolved quickly since it affects our production reporting.
answer: This is a serious issue and we're prioritizing it immediately given the data integrity impact. We're aware of an edge case in cursor-based pagination on v2 that can drop records when items are modified between page requests, and our API team is actively working on a fix. As an immediate workaround, please switch to timestamp-based filtering with the 'updated_since' parameter instead of relying solely on cursor pagination, and we'll notify you as soon as the underlying pagination fix ships.

subject: Duplicate alert routing sending same alert to two channels
body:
We set up an alert rule last week to route billing anomaly notifications to our #finance-ops Slack channel, but every alert is also landing in the default email digest for all 5 seats. This means our team gets duplicate notifications for the same event through two channels even though the routing rule specifies Slack only.

Can you check why the routing rule isn't suppressing the default email channel? We'd like alerts to go to Slack exclusively for this rule.
answer: Thanks for flagging this - duplicate delivery across channels usually happens when a routing rule is set to 'additive' rather than 'exclusive' mode, so the default channel still fires alongside your custom Slack rule. I'm checking your account configuration now to confirm this is the cause, and will follow up with the exact steps to switch the rule to exclusive routing so only Slack receives these alerts going forward.

subject: Need Salesforce sync to support custom field mapping and Jira ticket creation
body:
We're running the Salesforce integration for our logistics ops across 71 seats and it currently only syncs standard fields like account name and status. We need to map three custom fields (Shipment_Region__c, Carrier_Tier__c, and SLA_Breach__c) into Northwind so our dispatch team can filter on them.

Separately, we'd like sync errors to automatically create a Jira ticket in our ops board instead of just logging silently in the integration console. Is custom field mapping and Jira auto-ticketing on your roadmap, or is there a workaround today?
answer: Custom field mapping for Salesforce is supported today through the integration's field mapping panel under Settings > Integrations > Salesforce > Field Mapping - you can add Shipment_Region__c, Carrier_Tier__c, and SLA_Breach__c there and they'll sync on the next run. Automatic Jira ticket creation on sync failure isn't built in yet, but you can achieve something close by routing sync-failure webhooks to a Jira Cloud automation rule; I'll send over the webhook payload schema and a sample Jira automation setup so your team can wire this up.

subject: SCIM provisioning question - group-based role assignment
body: We're rolling out SCIM provisioning for our 23-seat workspace and it's working well for creating and deactivating users automatically from our identity provider. My question is about permissions: can SCIM push group memberships so that users landing in our 'Dispatch' IdP group are automatically assigned the corresponding Northwind role, or do we still need to assign roles manually after provisioning?
answer: Good question - SCIM group push is supported and will map IdP groups to Northwind roles automatically once you enable group sync in Identity settings and create the corresponding role mapping table. I'll send you our SCIM group mapping guide which walks through configuring the 'Dispatch' group mapping step by step, including how MFA and login permissions inherit from the assigned role.

subject: Webhook signature verification changing - need SDK guidance
body: I saw the notice that legacy HMAC-SHA1 webhook signatures are being deprecated on March 31st in favor of SHA256. We currently verify incoming webhooks using our own custom code against the old signature header, and I want to confirm the new header name and whether the Node SDK (v3.2) already supports validating the new signature format, or if we need to update our verification logic manually before the cutoff.
answer: The new signature header is X-Northwind-Signature-256 and it's already supported in Node SDK v3.2 and later via the verifyWebhookSignature() helper, so no manual crypto changes are needed on your end if you're on that version or newer. If you're pinned to an earlier SDK version, please upgrade before March 31st since the legacy SHA1 header will stop being sent entirely after the cutoff, not just deprecated alongside the new one.

subject: How to stop duplicate alerts for the same incident
body: Our team of 16 keeps getting the same alert twice - once when a threshold is first breached and again a few minutes later when it re-evaluates, even though the underlying issue hasn't changed. Is there a way to configure a cooldown or suppression window so we only get notified once per incident until it resolves or a set time passes?
answer: Yes, this is exactly what the alert suppression window feature is for - under each alert rule's Advanced settings you can set a 'cooldown period' (we recommend starting with 15-30 minutes) that prevents the same triggered condition from re-notifying until it either resolves or the cooldown expires. I'll walk you through enabling this on your existing rules so you stop seeing repeat notifications for unchanged incidents.

subject: URGENT - Zapier integration stopped triggering for all zaps
body: As of this morning none of our Zapier automations are firing - we have zaps connected to Slack, Salesforce, and Jira that pull from Northwind triggers, and all of them across our 50-seat account have gone silent since roughly 8am. Zapier's dashboard shows the trigger polls returning empty even though we have new records in Northwind that should be matching. This is blocking our entire ops workflow that depends on these automations to notify teams and create records downstream.
answer: I'm treating this as high priority given it's affecting all your Zapier-connected workflows. We've identified that our Zapier trigger endpoint had an authentication token refresh issue starting around 8am that's causing polls to return empty results - our engineering team is deploying a fix now, and I'll update you within the hour once triggers are confirmed working again. In the meantime, no data has been lost; once the fix lands, Zapier's polling will pick up all pending records on its next cycle.

subject: Uploads failing intermittently - need quota clarity too
body: Several of our users have reported that file uploads to Storage fail partway through with a generic 'upload failed, please try again' message, particularly for files over 200MB. This has happened at least 6 times this week across different users. Separately, we're not clear on what our storage quota actually is on the Starter plan or how close we are to hitting it - the usage page doesn't show a clear limit.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report - large file upload failures over 200MB are often caused by a timeout on our resumable upload handshake, and I'm escalating this with the specific failure count you shared so our engineers can check server logs for those incidents this week. On the quota question, I'll get you exact current usage and limit numbers for your workspace shortly, and will also flag the dashboard clarity gap to our product team since you're right that it should be visible without contacting support.

subject: Email digest sending duplicate entries and missing new alert types
body: Since yesterday's digest run, our operations team of 91 has been receiving email digests with duplicate line items - the same anomaly alert appears two or three times in a single digest email with identical timestamps. On top of that, a new alert category we configured last week for grid load thresholds isn't appearing in the digest at all, even though the alerts are firing correctly in the dashboard.
answer: This sounds like a digest aggregation bug tied to yesterday's batch job rather than something on your configuration side - duplicate line items with identical timestamps point to the digest compiler double-counting entries from overlapping time windows. I'm escalating both issues together since the missing grid load category is likely related; our engineering team will investigate today and I'll update you as soon as we have a fix or a workaround for the duplicates.

subject: Question about session timeout configuration and MFA re-prompt
body: We're trying to understand how session timeout interacts with MFA on our workspace. Currently users get logged out after what seems like 30 minutes of inactivity and have to go through MFA again each time, which is disrupting workflows for our 25 seats. Is the timeout duration configurable, and is there a way to avoid re-triggering MFA on every re-login within the same day?
answer: Session timeout duration is configurable per workspace under Identity & SSO settings - you can extend it beyond the current 30 minute default up to 8 hours depending on your security policy. Regarding MFA, we do support a 'remember this device' option that avoids re-prompting for MFA within a configurable window (typically 12-24 hours) after the first successful verification; I'll send over the exact settings path so your admins can adjust both independently.

subject: Mobile app crashing on launch for field staff after latest update
body: Since updating to the latest Mobile App version, a growing number of our 180 users are reporting the app crashes immediately on launch, before even reaching the login screen. This is affecting field technicians who rely on offline mode and push notifications for job updates. We'd like to know if there's a known issue with this release and whether there's documentation on rolling back to a previous app version in the meantime.
answer: We're aware of an issue in the latest release affecting launch stability on certain device configurations, particularly related to the offline cache initialization step, and our mobile team is preparing a patch release. In the meantime, I'll send you our rollback documentation for reverting affected devices to the previous stable version, and I'd also recommend having impacted field staff clear the app's local cache first, which has resolved the crash for some users in similar reports.

subject: Shared dashboard visible to users outside their group
body:
We manage a travel operations dashboard shared with a specific team of 6 people, but I noticed today that two contractors outside that group can still view it. I checked the sharing settings under the dashboard 'Q3 Travel Ops' and the permission list only shows the intended 6 users, yet the contractors confirmed they can open the link and see live data.

This is affecting how we control access to sensitive supplier pricing. Can someone check if there's a caching issue with the permission list or a bug in how group membership is evaluated?
answer: Thanks for flagging this, it does sound like a permission propagation issue rather than a configuration mistake on your end. Can you confirm the exact dashboard ID or share link, and whether the contractors are accessing it via a direct URL or through a workspace listing? In the meantime we're pulling the access logs for that dashboard to see when the extra grants were applied, and will follow up shortly with findings.

subject: SSO role mapping not assigning correct groups after login
body:
We use SAML SSO for our 139 seats and recently updated our IdP to send an additional 'department' attribute for role mapping. Since the change, users logging in are being placed into the default 'Member' role instead of their mapped department role, even though the SAML assertion shows the attribute correctly (verified via IdP trace).

This started after our IdP update on Monday. We tried re-saving the role mapping rules in the Northwind admin console but the issue persists for all new logins. About 40 users are currently stuck with wrong permissions.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. This looks like it could be related to attribute name casing or a mismatch between the claim name and what our role mapping expects. Could you export one recent SAML assertion (with sensitive values redacted) and send it over so we can compare it against your mapping rules? We'll also check our side for any regression tied to the mapping engine update we shipped last week.

subject: App crashes when reopening after offline sync
body:
On our shop floor tablets we rely on offline mode heavily since connectivity is patchy in the manufacturing area. Several users have reported that when they go back online after being offline for more than an hour, the app crashes on reopening instead of syncing the queued inspection records.

This has happened on at least 5 different devices running Android 13. The crash happens right after the 'Syncing offline data' progress bar reaches about 80%. Restarting the app again usually works the second time, but we're losing confidence in the offline queue.
answer: Thank you for the detailed description, this is helpful for reproducing the issue. Could you let us know the exact app version shown in Settings > About, and whether the crash happens consistently at the same sync percentage across devices? We'll investigate the offline sync completion path for a possible race condition and follow up with next steps once we've reproduced it internally.

subject: Push notifications not delivered after offline queue flush - urgent
body:
We had a field incident today where technicians using the mobile app in offline mode did not receive push notifications for new work orders after their devices reconnected around 9:40 AM. Support tickets started piling up because the team assumed no new work orders existed. Logs on our side show the offline queue flushed successfully but the push trigger never fired.

We need this fixed quickly since we depend on push alerts for dispatching. Can you confirm if there's a known issue with push notifications tied to offline sync completion?
answer: We understand the urgency and are treating this as a priority issue. Can you share the device IDs or user accounts affected along with approximate reconnect timestamps so we can trace the push trigger events on our end? We're checking whether the notification dispatch service is missing the sync-completion event and will update you within the next few hours.

subject: Duplicate daily email digests being sent to all users
body:
Since Monday our team has been receiving two identical copies of the daily notification digest email, both timestamped within a minute of each other. This is happening for all 24 seats on our account, not just a few users. We haven't changed any notification settings recently.

Several employees are asking IT why they're getting duplicate emails and it's starting to look unprofessional. Could you check if there's a duplicate scheduling job running on the digest service?
answer: Thanks for reporting this, and apologies for the inbox clutter this is causing. This matches a pattern we're seeing with a scheduler issue affecting digest delivery for some accounts, and we're prioritizing a fix. We'll disable the duplicate job trigger on our side shortly and confirm once digests are back to a single send, likely within the next day.

subject: Scheduled sync jobs failing overnight for student records connector
body:
Our nightly sync from the student records system into Northwind pipelines has failed for the past two nights, first on the 14th and again last night. The pipeline dashboard shows status 'Failed' with the message 'Connector timeout after 300s' for the connector named 'student-records-prod'.

We rely on this sync to update attendance data each morning before classes start, and staff are currently working from stale data. Can someone check whether this is a connector-side timeout or an issue on Northwind's infrastructure?
answer: Thanks for the report, we're treating this as an active outage on our side until we confirm otherwise. We're checking the connector runtime logs for 'student-records-prod' around both failure windows now. We'll update you within the hour with either a fix or a manual trigger option so you can get this morning's attendance sync completed.

subject: Python SDK throwing deprecated method errors after upgrade
body:
We upgraded the Northwind Python SDK from 4.2.0 to 5.0.1 last week and now several calls to client.billing.get_invoice() throw 'DeprecationWarning: get_invoice() is deprecated, use fetch_invoice() instead' but fetch_invoice() isn't documented anywhere and doesn't seem to accept the same parameters.

We're integrating this into our internal billing reconciliation tool used across the legal team, so we need clear guidance on the new method signature or a temporary way to suppress the warning without breaking production calls.
answer: Thanks for flagging this gap, the migration guide for fetch_invoice() should have been published alongside 5.0.1 and clearly wasn't complete. We'll get you the correct parameter mapping for fetch_invoice() today, and in the meantime get_invoice() will keep working through the deprecation period so your production calls won't break. We're also updating the SDK docs to reflect this properly.

subject: Need configurable delay window for late-arriving data in pipelines
body:
We're seeing a recurring issue where our ad analytics connector receives data up to 6 hours late from the upstream source, and our current pipeline processes each batch immediately on arrival, causing incomplete daily aggregates. This has caused reporting discrepancies for the past week that our media clients have noticed.

We'd like to request a configurable delay window or late-arrival handling option for the 'ad-analytics-connector' pipeline so records arriving after the batch window can be reprocessed automatically. This is impacting client-facing reports across our 115-seat account, so we'd like to prioritize this change.
answer: This is a reasonable request and we've had similar feedback from other data pipeline customers dealing with delayed upstream feeds. We're going to escalate this to our pipelines product team as a feature request for configurable late-arrival windows, and in the short term we can help you set up a manual reprocessing job for 'ad-analytics-connector' to reduce the discrepancy while a permanent option is evaluated. We'll follow up with a timeline once we hear back from the product team.

I'll also flag your feedback about surfacing this more clearly in the changelog to our docs team.

body: For Willow Health we'd like to restrict admin console access to our office network only. Can you confirm where in the Admin Console we set up an IP allowlist, and whether this applies to all 21 seats or just admin-level accounts? We also want to make sure this change gets logged in the audit log for our compliance review next month.
answer: Happy to help set this up. IP allowlisting is available under Admin Console > Settings > Security, and you can scope it to apply either workspace-wide or just to admin roles, depending on your compliance needs. Any change made there is automatically recorded in the audit log with timestamp and the admin who made the change, so you'll have a clear record for your review.

subject: Need bulk user deactivation process for departed employees
body: As part of our quarterly access review at Cobalt Capital, our security team flagged 14 former employees who still have active accounts across our 128 seats. I'd like to deactivate all of them at once rather than one by one, and I need this reflected in the audit log with a clear timestamp for our compliance records. Is there a bulk deactivation option in the Admin Console, or do we need to do this individually?
answer: Thank you for flagging this, we understand the urgency for your compliance review. There is a bulk deactivation option under Admin Console > Users, where you can select multiple accounts and deactivate them in a single action, each logged individually in the audit log with timestamp and the admin performing the action. If you can share the list of the 14 accounts, we can also assist directly to make sure this is completed today.

subject: help
body: hey we're trying to set up salesforce sync thru the integrations api for quill academy and keep getting a 403 forbiden error when calling /v1/integrations/salesforce/sync even tho our okta token looks vald. we have 285 seats and this is blocking a big rollout for our sales team, can someone check what scope our api key is missing? also is slack integration affected by same auth issue or seperate
answer: Thanks for the details, and sorry for the trouble ahead of your rollout. The 403 on the Salesforce sync endpoint usually means the API key is missing the integrations.write scope even if the Okta token itself is valid, so we'll check your key's scopes and reissue if needed. Slack uses a separate auth flow from Salesforce, so it shouldn't be affected by this issue, but let us know if you see similar errors there too.

subject: Charts broken after export, missing data on shared dashboards
body:
We've got a recurring issue on the Northwind Dashboards product where bar and line charts render blank whenever they're exported to PDF. This started around March 4th and affects the fleet-utilization dashboard we share with our regional managers every Monday. The chart legend still shows but the actual plotted data is missing in the export.

Could we also get the ability to schedule exports directly to a shared folder? Right now our 23-seat team manually re-exports and re-shares every week, which is slow.
answer:
Thanks for the detailed report. This sounds like a rendering issue specific to the PDF export pipeline rather than the live dashboard, so I'll get our dashboards team to check the fleet-utilization dashboard export on your account. Can you send us the exact dashboard ID and one sample exported PDF so we can compare against the live view?

On the scheduled export-to-folder request, I'll log that as a feature request with our product team and update you once we have status.

subject: Uploads failing intermittently to Storage - backup jobs affected
body:
Our nightly backup job to Northwind Storage has failed three times this week (March 2, 4, and 6) with a timeout error partway through transfer. Files are around 2-4GB each and normally complete in under ten minutes, but lately they stall at roughly 60% and then fail. We're on a 10-seat plan and this is impacting our compliance backup schedule.

Can you check if we're hitting a quota or throughput limit? We'd also like a way to get an alert when a backup fails instead of finding out the next morning.
answer:
Thanks for flagging this - intermittent stalls partway through large transfers usually point to either a bandwidth throttle or an account-level quota threshold. I'm pulling the transfer logs for March 2, 4, and 6 on your account now to check for quota or throttling events during those windows.

We don't have automated failure alerts for backup jobs yet, but I'll note that as a feature request. In the meantime I'll follow up with findings on the failed transfers within one business day.

subject: Duplicate alerts being routed to wrong email distribution list
body:
We integrated Northwind Notifications last month to route API failure alerts to our on-call distribution list, but since March 5 we're seeing every alert delivered twice, and some are going to our billing-alerts list instead of ops-alerts. Our routing rule is configured to match on event type 'api.error.5xx' only.

This is causing confusion for our small 7-seat team since duplicate pages are triggering unnecessary escalations. Can you check the routing rule evaluation for our workspace?
answer:
Apologies for the disruption this is causing - duplicate delivery combined with cross-routing to the wrong list points to a rule-matching conflict on our end. I'm reviewing the routing configuration for your workspace now to see if two rules are overlapping on the 'api.error.5xx' event type.

I'll confirm once I find the conflicting rule and get the duplication and misrouting fixed; expect an update from me within a few hours given the escalation impact.

subject: Mobile app offline mode not syncing, users stuck logged out
body:
Since this morning, a large portion of our 96-seat team can't use offline mode in the Northwind Mobile App - the app shows a spinner on launch and then logs users out entirely when connectivity is restored, wiping any offline notes they had entered. Push notifications for shift updates have also stopped arriving for affected users. This is affecting clinical staff during active shifts, so it's urgent.

We're seeing this on both iOS and Android, app version 4.8.2. Can you escalate this as it's blocking daily operations across our healthcare team?
answer:
This is being treated as a high priority issue given the impact on active shifts - thank you for the clear details. We're escalating to the mobile engineering team right now to investigate the offline sync and logout behavior on app version 4.8.2 for both platforms, and we're also checking push delivery in parallel.

As a temporary mitigation, please advise affected staff to avoid entering critical data offline until we confirm a fix, since offline entries are being lost on reconnect. I'll update you again within the hour with findings.

subject: URGENT: Storage uploads failing account-wide, retention jobs backing up
body:
Since approximately 09:15 UTC today, all upload requests to Northwind Storage are failing for our entire workspace with a 503 response. Our automated backup and retention pipeline processes roughly 4,000 files per hour and has now queued over 12,000 failed jobs. We're on the Pro plan with 270 seats and this is affecting every team using our data pipeline.

We're also concerned about quota - error responses briefly mentioned 'quota exceeded' before switching to plain 503s. Given the volume of queued retries, we need this resolved fast before we hit retention deadlines for regulatory files.
answer:
We've received your report and are treating this as an active outage affecting your workspace - our storage infrastructure team has been paged and is investigating the 503 errors and the quota message you saw. Given the retry volume you're describing, we're prioritizing root cause identification to prevent further backlog before we address the queue.

I'll post updates here every 30 minutes until resolved. In the meantime, please pause any additional retry bursts if possible, since that may be compounding load on the affected service.

subject: Workspace deactivation setting reverting itself, allowlist not saving
body:
We manage workspace settings for 4,952 seats across multiple regional admin groups, and since yesterday, changes to our IP allowlist and auto-deactivation policy for inactive users are not persisting. I save the settings, get a success confirmation, but on refresh the old values are back. This also seems to be affecting audit log visibility - some entries from the past 24 hours aren't showing at all.

This is a serious concern for us given the compliance requirements tied to our allowlist and deactivation policies. Can someone investigate urgently?
answer:
Thank you for reporting this, and given the compliance implications we're escalating immediately. We're investigating why settings changes to your allowlist and deactivation policy aren't persisting, and separately checking the audit log gap you mentioned for the past 24 hours, as these may be related to the same underlying sync issue.

We'll have an engineer confirm findings within a few hours; in the meantime, please avoid repeated save attempts on the same settings page to keep the audit trail clean while we investigate.

subject: Question about retention policy defaults for Storage
body:
I'm trying to understand how retention periods work on Northwind Storage for our 99-seat education account. We have files uploaded over a year ago that we expected to be purged automatically based on a 12-month retention policy, but they're still showing in our quota usage. Is retention something we need to configure per-bucket, or is there a global default we should be setting?

Also curious if there's documentation on how retention interacts with backup snapshots, since we don't want to lose backups prematurely.
answer:
Good question - retention on Storage is configured per-bucket rather than applied globally by default, so if no policy was explicitly set on those buckets, files will persist indefinitely regardless of age. I'd recommend checking the bucket settings page for the buckets in question to confirm whether a retention rule was ever applied.

For how retention interacts with backup snapshots, our documentation covers this under the Storage guide's 'Retention and Backups' section - I'll send you the direct link, and happy to walk through configuring a 12-month policy if you'd like a hand setting it up.

subject: Okta integration app misconfigured - need change to SSO app settings
body:
We're rolling out SSO for our 18-seat legal team and set up the Northwind Okta app per your integration docs, but users assigned to the app are getting an 'invalid app configuration' error on login. We also noticed the Okta app doesn't seem to support pushing group-based role assignments the way our Salesforce and Jira Okta apps do, which is a gap for us.

We need this fixed soon since we're planning to disable direct login for our team by end of week and rely solely on Okta.
answer:
Thanks for the detailed context, and given your end-of-week timeline we're prioritizing this. The 'invalid app configuration' error usually stems from a mismatch in the SAML attribute mapping - can you send a screenshot of your current Okta app's attribute statements so we can compare against the expected configuration?

On group-based role assignment, that's not yet supported the same way it is for our Salesforce and Jira integrations, but I'll pass your feedback to the integrations team as we're seeing more requests for this parity.

subject: dup alerts
body: Getting duplicate billing alert emails daily, please fix routing.
answer: Thanks for the quick heads up - to fix the duplicate delivery I'd like to check your alert routing rules for overlapping conditions on billing alerts. Could you confirm the email address or distribution list receiving the duplicates so I can pull the exact routing configuration on our end?

subject: How to view audit log for deactivated user accounts?
body:
I'm trying to pull an audit trail for a batch of user deactivations we performed last week across our 1,824-seat healthcare workspace, but the Admin Console audit log only shows the most recent 500 entries and seems to load very slowly, sometimes timing out entirely. I need this for an internal compliance review.

Is there a way to export a larger date range, or filter specifically for deactivation and allowlist change events? Also wondering if audit log settings can be adjusted to retain longer history by default.
answer:
Thanks for reaching out - the audit log's default view is capped at 500 entries and can be slow to load for larger workspaces like yours, but you can filter by event type, including deactivation and allowlist changes, using the filter panel above the log table to narrow results before export. For pulling a full date range for your compliance review, I can request a manual export from our backend that isn't subject to the same pagination limits.

Regarding longer default retention, that's configurable at the workspace settings level under Audit Log Settings - I'll walk you through adjusting that if the current retention window is too short for your review needs.

subject: Okta app integration failing for Granite Partners - SSO broken for many users
body:
We use the Okta SAML app configured under Integrations to provision access for our 139 seats. Since this morning around 8:40am, users attempting SSO are getting stuck on a blank redirect after Okta auth, and our Okta system log shows a 'invalid_client' error being returned from Northwind's token endpoint. This is blocking most of our logistics team from logging in, including our dispatch supervisors.

We haven't changed anything on our Okta app config recently. Can someone check if the client secret or redirect URI registered on your side got rotated or invalidated? This is affecting a large chunk of our workforce right now.
answer: Thanks for flagging this immediately - we're treating this as a major incident affecting your Okta SSO integration. We can see irregular token requests failing on our end starting around the time you reported, and we're pulling the client configuration for your Integrations app now to check for a secret rotation or misconfiguration on our side. We'll follow up within the hour with findings, and in the meantime we recommend having admins log in via direct username/password as a temporary workaround if enabled.

subject: Adjusting scheduled sync frequency for large connector set
body:
We're running about 40 scheduled syncs across our Data Pipelines setup, mostly pulling from our SIS and LMS connectors. Right now everything runs on a fixed 6-hour interval, but a few of our high-volume connectors (particularly the enrollment data one) would benefit from running every 2 hours instead, while smaller reference tables could go down to once daily.

Is there a way to set per-connector sync schedules rather than one global interval, or do we need to split these into separate pipeline configs? We'd also like to know if there's documentation on how sync latency is calculated so we can validate freshness for downstream reporting.
answer: You can absolutely set per-connector schedules - each connector in a pipeline has its own schedule override under the connector settings tab, so you don't need separate pipeline configs for this. I'll link you to our docs page on sync scheduling and the latency calculation methodology, which explains how we measure time from source extraction to landing in your destination.
