Let us know once you've adjusted the intervals if you want us to double check the enrollment connector's throughput at the new 2-hour cadence.

subject: Need OAuth refresh token setup guidance for new connector
body: I'm setting up a new connector in Data Pipelines to pull from our ERP system, and the auth step is asking for an OAuth client ID/secret plus a refresh token, but our ERP vendor only gives us a short-lived access token through their portal. Is there a way to configure the connector to re-authenticate automatically, or do we need to manually refresh credentials on some interval?
answer: For connectors that only support short-lived tokens without a refresh flow, we recommend setting up the connector with the 'manual credential rotation' option, which will alert you via email a few days before the token expires so you can re-enter it. If your ERP vendor supports an OAuth2 client credentials grant instead, that would let us handle token renewal automatically - let us know the vendor name and we can check if we have a pre-built auth template for it.

subject: Webhook deliveries failing intermittently with 429s
body:
Since yesterday afternoon we've been seeing a growing number of webhook delivery failures in our API Platform dashboard, all returning 429 rate limit errors from our endpoint, even though our server logs show we're nowhere near capacity. Roughly 30% of events for order-status-updated are failing and going to retry, which is delaying our downstream billing reconciliation.

We're using the official SDK's webhook verification helper, and I don't see any recent changes to our endpoint. Can you check if Northwind's outbound webhook sender is batching or bursting requests in a way that's tripping our rate limiter?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. We looked at your webhook delivery logs and can confirm there was a burst pattern starting yesterday around 3pm where our sender retried a backlog of queued events in quick succession, which likely triggered your endpoint's own rate limiting rather than ours. We're adding jitter to the retry logic on our side to spread these out, and in the meantime we'd suggest raising your endpoint's rate limit threshold slightly or configuring a longer backoff window in your webhook settings to absorb bursts.

subject: Workspace settings page throwing errors, cannot update allowlist
body: I'm trying to update our IP allowlist under workspace settings in the Admin Console and every time I hit save I get a generic 'Something went wrong, please try again' message. This has happened on three separate attempts today, both from Chrome and Firefox. We need to add two new office IP ranges before our team can access the API from the new location tomorrow.
answer: Sorry for the trouble - we can reproduce a save failure on the allowlist section for workspace settings when more than one CIDR range is added at once, which looks like the bug you're hitting. As a workaround, try adding one IP range at a time and saving between each entry. We're escalating this as a bug fix on our side and will update you once it's resolved so batch edits work again.

subject: Audit log missing entries after deactivating users - urgent
body:
We deactivated 12 users this morning as part of an offboarding batch, and when I checked the audit log in Admin Console afterward, only 4 of those deactivation events show up. This is a compliance issue for us since we need a complete audit trail for our retail operations across 150 seats, and we have an internal review scheduled for tomorrow morning.

Can you confirm whether the missing events are a logging bug or if they're just delayed? We need this resolved before our review.
answer: This is a priority issue for us as well given your compliance timeline. We've confirmed on our end that there's a delay affecting audit log ingestion for bulk deactivation actions, and we're working to backfill the missing 8 entries now. We expect all events to appear within the next few hours, and we'll notify you directly once the backfill completes and the audit trail is confirmed complete.

subject: Requesting faster connector auth refresh for legal document connector
body:
Our legal document management connector in Data Pipelines currently re-authenticates every 24 hours, but we're seeing sync failures overnight when the token expires mid-sync, causing partial data loads that our compliance team has flagged twice this month. We need this connector's auth to refresh more proactively, ideally checking token validity before each sync run rather than on a fixed daily timer.

Given this connector feeds our matter management system and compliance depends on complete nightly syncs across our firm, we'd like this prioritized as it's currently a blocker for reliable overnight processing.
answer: Thanks for the detailed context - this is a reasonable ask and we're logging it as a feature request for proactive token validation before each sync run rather than the fixed 24-hour cycle. As an interim mitigation, we can adjust your connector's refresh timer to run 2 hours before your scheduled sync window, which should prevent the mid-sync expiry you're seeing. We'll set that up on our end today and follow up on the longer-term fix's timeline.

subject: Question about bulk user deactivation and audit log visibility
body:
As a workspace admin managing 1824 seats, I'm looking for a way to bulk deactivate users who haven't logged in for over 90 days, ideally with the resulting audit log entries clearly tagged as automated versus manual deactivations. Right now I only see an option to deactivate users one at a time from the Admin Console.

Is there a bulk action available, either via UI or API, and does the audit log distinguish between deactivation triggers?
answer: Bulk deactivation is available through our Admin API using the batch user update endpoint, which lets you pass a list of user IDs and a deactivation reason code - that reason code does get surfaced in the audit log so you can filter automated vs manual actions. We don't currently have a bulk deactivate button in the UI itself, but it's on our roadmap; I'll add your workspace to the list of customers interested in that feature.

subject: Storage quota reached, uploads failing
body:
We hit our storage quota limit on our Northwind Storage bucket this morning and now all upload requests from our backend service are returning a 507 insufficient storage error. I checked our usage dashboard and we're at 100% of allocated capacity, mostly from transaction backup files we've been retaining for the past 6 months.

Is there a way to see a breakdown of what's consuming the most space, and what's the process to either increase quota or clean up old backups without breaking our retention compliance requirements?
answer: You can get a storage breakdown by object prefix and age under the Storage usage tab, which should help identify which backup sets are taking the most space. For quota increases, we can bump your allocation on request - let us know the target size and we'll apply it today. On cleanup, if you have a retention policy configured we can help set up an automated lifecycle rule to archive older backups to cold storage instead of deleting them, which keeps you compliant while freeing up primary quota.

subject: Biometric login crashing app after latest update
body:
After updating to the latest Mobile App release, biometric login (Face ID) crashes the app immediately on launch for our test devices running iOS 17.4. It worked fine before the update. The crash happens before any UI loads, so I can't get a crash log from within the app, but I see it in our device console logs referencing LAContext authentication failure.

This is blocking our field technicians from logging in via the mobile app entirely, they're falling back to manual password entry which is slower for their workflow. Can you confirm if this is a known issue with the update?
answer: Thanks for reporting this with the device details. We've had one other similar report tied to the latest release on iOS 17.4 involving LAContext, and our mobile team is actively investigating a regression in the biometric flow. As a workaround, your technicians can disable biometric login in the app settings and use password entry until we ship a fix, which we're targeting within the next few days - we'll update this ticket as soon as it's resolved.

subject: Biometric login crashing Mobile App for our field staff
body:
Since this morning several of our agents at Cobalt Travel have been unable to log into the Mobile App using Face ID or fingerprint. The app crashes immediately after the biometric prompt on iOS 17 devices. We have 11 seats and at least 6 users are affected, mostly the ones who travel and rely on offline mode between flights.

A restart of the app doesn't help, and reinstalling only fixes it until the next app relaunch. This is blocking our ops team from checking in bookings while on the road.
answer:
Thanks for flagging this, this is a serious issue and we're treating it as P1. We've seen a similar biometric-login crash tied to a recent iOS 17 update and our mobile team is actively reproducing it now. As a temporary workaround, please have affected users switch to PIN login under Settings > Security until we push a fix, which we expect within the next release cycle.

We'll update this ticket as soon as we have a build ready for testing.

subject: Audit log missing entries after admin deactivation
body:
We noticed that the audit log in Admin Console for Blue Partners has a gap between 09:14 and 11:40 today, right after we deactivated a former employee's account. No login, permission change, or allowlist update events show up for that window, even though we know changes were made during that time.

This is concerning from a compliance standpoint since we need a complete trail for our 8-seat workspace. Can you confirm whether logs were lost or if this is a display issue?
answer:
We understand the urgency here and have escalated this to our security team immediately as a P0 issue. We're investigating the audit log pipeline for gaps around the timeframe you mentioned and will confirm whether this is a data loss issue or a delayed indexing problem within the next hour. In the meantime, please do not make further account changes so we can preserve the current state for investigation.

We'll follow up as soon as we have root cause confirmation.

subject: How to resolve recurring upload failures in Storage
body:
At Ember Partners we're seeing intermittent upload failures in Storage when our staff try to back up course materials larger than 500MB. The error message just says "Upload failed, please try again" with no further detail, and it happens for about 3 out of 10 attempts across our 11 seats.

We'd like to understand if this is a quota issue or something else, and whether there's a recommended way to batch large uploads for backup purposes going forward.
answer:
Thanks for the details. Intermittent failures on larger files are usually related to connection timeouts rather than quota limits, but we'll check your account's current usage against your Starter plan allowance to rule that out. In the meantime, we recommend splitting uploads over 500MB into smaller chunks or using our desktop sync client, which resumes automatically on failed transfers.

We'll follow up with quota details and any patterns we find in your upload logs.

subject: Need to restore Storage backup after accidental deletion
body:
Yesterday afternoon one of our staff at Delta Academy accidentally deleted a folder containing itinerary documents from Storage. We'd like to restore from the most recent backup snapshot, which should be from two days ago before the deletion happened. We have 22 seats and this folder is used by most of our operations team daily.

Could you let us know the process to restore, and whether restoring will affect our current storage quota?
answer: Thanks for reaching out, we can help get this restored. Our team can trigger a restore from the snapshot prior to the deletion, and this will not count against your quota since it's a recovery operation rather than new storage. Please confirm the exact folder path and the approximate deletion time so we can pinpoint the correct restore point, and we'll proceed within the next few hours.

subject: Duplicate email digests being sent to users
body:
We've configured daily email digests in Notifications for Orion Robotics and noticed that several team members are receiving the same digest twice, sometimes three times, within a 10-minute window. This started around three days ago and is affecting most of our 6 seats.

Our team relies on these digests to track production alerts, so duplicate emails are causing confusion about whether new alerts have actually come in. Can you look into why the digest job is firing multiple times?
answer: Thanks for reporting this, duplicate digest delivery is a known issue we're actively investigating on our notification scheduling service. It appears related to a retry mechanism that isn't properly detecting successful delivery. We're prioritizing a fix given the impact on your alerting workflow and will update you within 24 hours with either a resolution or a temporary mitigation to disable the retry behavior on your account.

subject: Workspace settings reverted after Admin Console update
body:
This morning at Summit Legal we found that several workspace settings in Admin Console, including our custom session timeout and default role assignments, had reverted to default values. This affects all 257 seats on our workspace and is causing confusion since users now have broader permissions than intended.

We didn't make any changes ourselves. The audit log shows a system update event at 03:12 today, right before the settings changed. Can you confirm if this is related to a recent platform update?
answer: Thank you for the detailed report, and apologies for the disruption to your workspace. We can confirm there was a platform-wide configuration migration overnight, and we're seeing a small number of accounts where settings weren't correctly re-applied afterward. We're prioritizing this as P1 and working on restoring your custom settings from your last known configuration; we expect this resolved within a few hours and will confirm once your session timeout and role defaults are back to your specified values.

subject: Broken charts in shared Dashboard
body:
We have a shared Dashboard at Delta Academy that several team leads use to track booking volume, but since last week two of the charts render blank when accessed via the shared link. The charts display fine when we're logged in directly, but the shared/public version just shows a loading spinner indefinitely.

Could you look into whether this is related to the sharing permissions or a rendering bug? We have 22 seats and multiple people relying on this view for weekly reports.
answer: Thanks for the report. This sounds like it could be related to a rendering issue we've seen recently with charts using date-range filters in shared dashboard links. Could you send us the shared link URL and the chart type in question so we can reproduce it directly on our end? We'll dig into whether this is a permissions issue or a bug in the shared-view renderer and get back to you with next steps.

subject: Mobile App crashes immediately on launch for finance team
body:
Several of us at Ember Labs have started experiencing crashes when opening the Mobile App on Android, right after the splash screen. This began after updating to the latest app version two days ago. It's affecting about 5 of our 79 seats so far, mostly finance team members who use the app to approve invoices while traveling.

We've tried clearing cache and reinstalling but the crash persists every time. Any known issue with the latest release on Android?
answer: Thanks for the report, and sorry for the trouble this is causing your finance team. We are aware of a crash-on-launch issue affecting certain Android devices after the latest update, related to a caching conflict on first load. As a workaround, please try uninstalling the app fully, clearing any residual app data via device settings, and reinstalling from the store. Our mobile team is finalizing a patch and we'll notify you once it's live.

subject: SCIM provisioning failing for new user groups
body:
We're integrating SCIM provisioning with Identity and SSO for Summit Health and running into an issue where new users created in our identity provider aren't syncing over correctly. Specifically, users assigned to the "Media-Editors" group get created in Northwind but show no group or permission mapping, so they land without access to any workspace resources.

We've confirmed the group mapping is configured correctly on our IdP side. This is affecting new hires across our 273-seat workspace who can't access anything after their account is provisioned. Any documentation on expected group attribute formatting would help too.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. This sounds like it could be related to how group attributes are being passed in the SCIM payload; we've seen similar issues when the group display name doesn't exactly match what's configured in Northwind's SSO settings. Could you share a sample SCIM request payload for one of the affected users so we can check the attribute mapping? We'll also send over our SCIM provisioning documentation with the expected group schema in the meantime.

subject: Users getting logged out constantly via SSO
body:
Since yesterday, users at Vertex Travel are being logged out of Northwind roughly every 15 minutes when accessing via SSO, even though our IdP session policy is set to 8 hours. This is affecting a large portion of our 241 seats and is disrupting work across multiple teams, especially those relying on MFA re-authentication each time, which is adding significant delay.

We haven't changed any SSO or MFA settings on our end recently. Can you check if there's a session timeout misconfiguration on Northwind's side for our workspace?
answer: Thank you for flagging this, we understand how disruptive frequent re-authentication is at this scale and are treating it as P1. We're reviewing your workspace's SSO session configuration now to check for a mismatch between your IdP's session lifetime and Northwind's session token expiry settings. We'll follow up shortly with findings and, if needed, apply a corrected timeout value on our side to restore your expected 8-hour session length.

subject: Jira link brokn after Okta reauth
body:
Hey, we set up the Jira intergration a few weeks ago thru the Integrations tab and it was fine untill our Okta session policy changed last week. Now when we try to link a new Jira issue from the Salesforce case panel we get "authorization required" even tho the connector shows connected in the settings page.

This is blocking our escalation workflow bc our reps cant attach tickets to Jira from Salesforce anymore. Can someone check the OAuth token status for our Jira connector, our org id is HRB-2291. We have about 15 agents hitting this daily.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. This looks like the Jira OAuth token was invalidated when the Okta session policy change forced a re-auth cycle - the connector UI can still show "connected" even though the underlying token is stale, which is a known gap we're tracking. I'll refresh the token on our end for org HRB-2291 and re-test the Salesforce-to-Jira link flow; I'll follow up shortly with confirmation and, if needed, a fix on your side to re-authorize.

subject: Getting duplicate alert emails for same outage event
body:
We're seeing duplicate notification emails for the same alert - specifically our dispatch monitoring alert fired twice within 2 minutes for the same event ID on March 4th, and again this morning around 8:15am for a different route. Each duplicate has the identical event timestamp and description, just sent twice to the same recipient list.

This is causing confusion for our small ops team since we only have 3 people watching these alerts and now we're double-checking everything. Can you look into why the notification system is sending these twice?
answer: Thanks for flagging this with the specific timestamps. We've seen an intermittent issue where retry logic on our notification delivery service can re-send an alert if the initial delivery acknowledgment is delayed, resulting in the duplicate you're describing. I'm escalating this to our alerting engineering team to check the delivery logs around March 4th and this morning's event, and will update you once we identify the root cause or have a fix timeline.

subject: Audit log missing entries and deactivated user still active
body:
We just discovered that a user we deactivated last Tuesday, still has active API access - we can see calls from their token as recently as an hour ago. When we went to check the audit log to confirm the deactivation timestamp, the entries for that day are completely missing from the admin console.

We rely on the allowlist and audit log for compliance reporting and this is a serious problem since we can't verify who has access right now. Please help urgently, we have 3 seats total so this affects a significant portion of our team's access.
answer: This has been escalated immediately as a P0 - active access from a deactivated account combined with missing audit entries needs urgent attention. We're revoking the token for that user right now on our side and pulling raw access logs independent of the console audit view to reconstruct what happened on that date. I'll be in direct contact within the hour with findings and confirmation that access has been fully cut off.

subject: Question on deactivation and allowlist docs
body:
I'm reviewing our offboarding process for compliance purposes and wanted to confirm the correct steps for deactivating a user in the Admin Console versus removing them from the allowlist entirely. Our documentation seems to show two separate flows and I want to make sure we're not leaving any residual access.

Also, is there an audit log entry generated automatically when a user is deactivated, or do we need to enable something first? Any pointers to the right doc pages would be appreciated.
answer: Good question - deactivation immediately revokes login and API access but keeps the user record for audit history, while removing someone from the allowlist additionally blocks any future SSO attempts even if the account is later reactivated by mistake. Audit log entries for deactivation are generated automatically with no extra setup needed. I'll send over links to our offboarding and allowlist documentation pages that walk through both flows side by side.

subject: Charts not rendering after latest export
body:
I'm integrating with the Dashboards API and noticed that after generating a scheduled export yesterday around 4pm, several of the bar charts on our shared dashboard now render blank when viewed by teammates I've shared the link with. The underlying data table still shows values correctly, just the visual chart component is empty.

This isn't blocking critical work but it's confusing for the team reviewing weekly metrics. Would appreciate a look when convenient - happy to share the dashboard ID if useful.
answer: Thanks for the report, and yes please send over the dashboard ID so we can inspect the chart rendering config directly. This sounds like it could be related to a caching issue between the export job and the chart renderer where stale data references cause a blank render even though the source table updates correctly - we'll investigate and let you know what we find, no urgent fix needed on your end in the meantime.

subject: Need to update connector auth for our pipeline
body:
We'd like to rotate the credentials on our retail POS data connector since our IT team is doing a routine security review. The connector has been syncing daily inventory counts fine, though we've noticed occasional latency spikes of 10-15 minutes on the Tuesday sync that we'd like flagged too.

Could you walk us through the steps to update the auth credentials without breaking the existing sync schedule? We don't want to lose historical sync data during the transition.
answer: Updating connector credentials is straightforward and won't affect historical sync data - you can update the auth fields directly in the connector settings without needing to recreate the pipeline, and the sync schedule will pick up right where it left off. Regarding the Tuesday latency spikes, we'll take a look at the sync logs for that connector to see if there's a pattern we should address separately.

subject: Uploads failing intermittently, quota unclear
body:
I'm integrating with the Storage API for our booking document uploads and starting yesterday around noon we've had roughly 1 in 5 upload requests fail with a 507 status and message "insufficient storage capacity". We're nowhere near what I'd expect our quota to be based on our plan, so I'm not sure if this is a quota issue or something else.

Can you confirm our current storage usage and quota limit, and let me know if there's a retention policy that might be auto-deleting old backups and causing space calculation issues? We need reliable uploads for compliance reasons.
answer: Thanks for the specifics - a 507 response usually does point to quota, but given you're seeing intermittent failures rather than consistent rejection, there may be a delay in usage recalculation after retention cleanup jobs run, which can temporarily misreport available space. I'm pulling your current usage and quota numbers now and will confirm whether you're actually near the limit or if this is a calculation lag, and will follow up with next steps to stabilize uploads.

subject: SCIM provisioning broken - new hires can't log in
body:
Our SCIM connector stopped provisioning new users as of this morning. We pushed 4 new employee accounts through our identity provider around 9am and none of them show up in Northwind's user list, so they can't log in at all - including one who needs MFA setup before their shift starts today.

Here's the error from our IdP provisioning logs:
SCIM POST /Users returned 400
{"detail":"schemas field missing required urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"}

This is blocking onboarding for our whole team today, we only have 11 seats so this is a big chunk of our workforce affected.
answer: This is being treated as high priority given the onboarding impact - the 400 error indicates the SCIM payload from your IdP is missing the required core schema URN, which suggests either a recent IdP-side template change or a mismatch with our SCIM endpoint's expected format. I'm pulling the raw request logs from our end now to confirm exactly what's being sent, and will get back to you within the hour with either a config fix or a workaround so your new hires can be provisioned today.

subject: Pipeline data arriving hours late, breaking downstream sync
body:
We're integrating with the Data Pipelines API for our fleet telemetry sync and over the past two days, data that should land within 15 minutes is showing up 3-4 hours late. This is causing our downstream inventory sync jobs to process stale data and triggering false alerts on our end.

We checked our source connector and it's pushing data on schedule based on our logs, so the delay seems to be on the pipeline processing side. Pipeline ID is GRB-pipe-0417 if that helps narrow it down. This is affecting all 174 seats on our account since the fleet dashboard depends on this data.
answer: Thanks for including the pipeline ID - we're escalating this now since a multi-hour delay affecting your whole fleet dashboard qualifies as a service disruption. We're checking the processing queue for GRB-pipe-0417 to see if there's a backlog or stuck stage causing the lag, and will update you as soon as we identify where the delay is occurring, along with an ETA for catching up the backlogged data.

subject: Connector auth failing intermittently, sync quality degraded
body:
Our legal document connector has started failing auth checks intermittently since Monday - roughly every third sync attempt returns an authentication error even though the credentials haven't changed. When syncs do succeed, we're noticing data quality issues where some records are missing fields that were present in prior successful syncs.

We have 10 seats and rely on this pipeline for daily compliance reporting, so the inconsistent syncs and incomplete records are becoming a real problem. Can you check if there's an issue on the connector or auth service side?
answer: Thanks for the detailed timeline - intermittent auth failures combined with incomplete records on successful syncs points to a possible token refresh race condition on the connector side rather than a credentials problem. We're pulling the auth and sync logs for your legal document connector since Monday to confirm the pattern and will let you know what we find, along with a fix or workaround to stabilize your daily compliance syncs.

subject: Late-arriving records in warehouse sync connector
body:
We've noticed that the logistics events connector feeding our warehouse sync consistently delivers around 8-12% of records 20-40 minutes after the batch window closes. This is manageable for now but it's starting to skew our end-of-day inventory reconciliation reports for the Blue Retail distribution centers.

Could you share whether there's a way to configure a grace period on the pipeline before it marks a batch complete, or a webhook that fires when late records land afterward? We'd like to build a small reconciliation step around it rather than treat it as a bug.
answer: Thanks for the detailed context. Late-arriving data is common with high-volume logistics connectors, and we do support a configurable grace/watermark window on batch pipelines that lets you delay the 'complete' marker by a set number of minutes. I'll send over the documentation link and a config snippet, and I'll also flag your request for a post-completion late-record webhook to our product team as a feature request since it isn't available yet.

subject: Dashboards taking 20+ seconds to load for our team
body:
Since Monday, several of our dashboards under the Legal Case Tracking workspace have been taking 20-30 seconds to render, sometimes timing out entirely with a blank panel. This is affecting about 6 of our 18 users daily. Export to CSV from the same dashboards is also failing intermittently with a generic 'export could not be completed' message.

Can someone take a look at whether this is a known performance issue, and is there documentation on optimizing dashboard queries for smaller workspaces like ours?
answer: Sorry for the disruption this is causing your team. We're seeing elevated query latency on a subset of dashboard workspaces and are actively investigating a possible cause tied to a recent indexing change; I've escalated your workspace specifically for review. In the meantime, I'll send you our dashboard optimization guide covering filter and widget best practices, and I'll follow up as soon as we have a root cause or fix timeline for the export failures.

subject: DUPLICATE EMAIL DIGESTS GOING OUT TO ALL OUR CLIENTS - FIX THIS NOW
body:
Our clients are getting the SAME weekly digest email sent 3-4 times each in the last hour, starting around 9:15am today. We have already had two clients reply asking if we've been hacked. This is Notifications for a legal firm, this is NOT okay, our reputation is on the line here.

We need this stopped immediately and an explanation. If this isn't resolved today we will be cancelling our Northwind subscription and moving digest notifications elsewhere. We only have 4 seats but this is affecting every single one of our client-facing accounts.
answer: I understand how serious this is and I'm escalating this to our on-call notifications team right now as a P1. We're pausing the digest queue for your account immediately to stop further duplicate sends while we identify the trigger — initial signs point to a retry loop on the digest scheduler. I'll update you within the hour with root cause and confirmation once sending is safe to resume, and we'll also review what went out so you have accurate information for your clients.

subject: Biometric login triggers crash on Android after offline sync
body:
We're seeing a pattern where field employees who use Face/Touch unlock on Android, after the app has been offline for a few hours syncing cached trip data, experience a crash on the login screen right after biometric authentication succeeds. It happens on roughly 15-20 devices per week according to our crash reports, mostly Pixel and Samsung models on Android 13/14.

Push notifications for trip updates also seem to stop arriving on affected devices until the app is manually reopened. Can someone confirm whether this is related to the offline sync queue interacting with the biometric session refresh?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report — this pattern is helpful. We've seen isolated reports of a session-token refresh conflict when biometric unlock coincides with offline queue flushing, which could also explain the push delivery gap since push registration re-runs on that same session refresh. I'm opening an investigation with our mobile team and will ask for device logs from a couple of the affected employees' devices to confirm the root cause and get you a fix timeline.

subject: SDK throwing errors on webhook signature verification
body: Our development team flagged that the API Platform SDK (v3.2) is throwing 'signature verification failed' errors on roughly 30% of incoming webhook calls since we upgraded last week. I'm reaching out on their behalf since I handle our vendor relationship. They mentioned the documentation for webhook secret rotation doesn't match the current SDK version's method signatures.
answer: Thank you for flagging this on behalf of your development team — a documentation mismatch after an SDK version bump is a known gap we're working to close. Could you have your developer share the exact SDK version, the webhook secret rotation method they're calling, and a sample of the failing signature payload (redacted)? That will let us confirm whether this is a doc issue or a genuine bug in v3.2's verification logic, and we'll prioritize a documentation update either way.

subject: App-Absturz beim Start nach letztem Update
body:
Seit dem letzten App-Update stürzt unsere Mobile App bei rund der Hälfte unserer Nutzer direkt beim Start ab, noch bevor der Login-Bildschirm erscheint. Betroffen sind sowohl iOS- als auch Android-Geräte. Wir würden gerne wissen, ob es eine Möglichkeit gibt, auf die vorherige Version zurückzukehren, während das Problem untersucht wird.

Zusätzlich möchten wir anfragen, ob Offline-Zugriff auf Kursmaterialien und Push-Benachrichtigungen für neue Kursinhalte in einer zukünftigen Version priorisiert werden könnten, da unsere 10 Nutzer regelmäßig ohne Internetverbindung arbeiten.
answer: Danke für die Meldung, ein Absturz direkt beim App-Start ist natürlich sehr unangenehm für Ihr Team. Wir empfehlen aktuell, betroffene Geräte auf die vorherige Version zurückzusetzen, bis wir die Ursache gefunden haben, und ich sende Ihnen gleich die Schritte dafür. Ihre Anfrage zu Offline-Zugriff auf Kursmaterialien und Push-Benachrichtigungen für neue Inhalte leite ich als Feature-Wunsch an unser Produktteam weiter.

subject: Pipeline data arriving hours late, blocking daily reports
body:
Since yesterday around 14:00 UTC, our energy usage data pipeline has been delivering records 3-5 hours after their timestamp, compared to the usual 10-15 minute lag. This is blocking our daily compliance report generation which runs at 6am and depends on the previous day's full dataset being complete. We've checked our source system and it's publishing on schedule, so the delay appears to be on the pipeline side.

Can someone confirm current pipeline health and let us know if there's a workaround, like a manual reprocessing trigger, we can use for today's report while this is investigated?
answer: Thanks for the clear timeline — that's very helpful. We're seeing elevated processing lag on the pipeline cluster serving your account starting around the same window you reported, and our infrastructure team is actively working on it as a P1. In the meantime, I can trigger a manual reprocessing run for yesterday's dataset so you can get your compliance report out; I'll start that now and send you a status update as soon as the underlying lag issue is resolved.

subject: Webhook retries not respecting exponential backoff config
body:
We're integrating the API Platform webhooks for order status updates across our energy trading endpoints, and noticed that failed webhook deliveries are retrying every 30 seconds flat instead of following the exponential backoff described in the docs (1m, 5m, 30m, 2h). This is causing our endpoint to get hammered during brief outages, roughly 40-60 retries within 10 minutes on a single failed event.

Is this a configuration issue on our end, or a bug in the retry scheduler? We'd also like to know if there's an SDK method to inspect delivery history programmatically rather than through the dashboard.
answer: Thanks for the precise numbers, that retry cadence does look off from the documented backoff schedule and points to a bug rather than a config issue on your side — I've filed this with our platform team for investigation. In the meantime, I'd recommend temporarily setting a higher failure threshold on your endpoint to reduce load. On the SDK side, there is a delivery-history method (getWebhookDeliveries) that isn't yet in the public docs; I'll send you a usage example.

subject: Urgent: biometric login change needed before rollout Monday
body:
We're finalizing our mobile rollout to field staff and need biometric login (Face ID/fingerprint) enabled as the default authentication method before Monday, replacing the current PIN-only flow. Right now enabling biometric login in settings causes the app to crash for 3 of our 7 test users, and push notifications for expense approvals stop working entirely afterward until reinstall.

Given our rollout deadline, can someone confirm whether this is a known issue and whether there's a fix or workaround we can apply before Monday?
answer: I understand the deadline pressure and I'm treating this as a P1 given the rollout timeline. This does match a known issue where enabling biometric login can leave the push registration token stale, causing both the crash and the notification failure — a fix is in our current release pipeline. I'll get you a workaround (a manual re-registration step after enabling biometrics) today so your test users can proceed, and I'll confirm the permanent fix timing before Monday.

subject: Intermittent upload failures with 413 errors on Storage API
body:
We're integrating file uploads to Storage for manufacturing spec sheets and CAD files, and starting last Tuesday we've been getting intermittent 413 'payload too large' errors on files under 50MB, which should be well within limits based on your documentation. This happens on roughly 1 in 10 upload attempts, seemingly at random rather than tied to a specific file size.

Here's a sample response:
HTTP/1.1 413 Payload Too Large
{'error': 'quota_exceeded', 'detail': 'storage bucket quota reached for org ember-robotics-prod'}

Is this actually a quota issue rather than a payload size issue? Our dashboard shows we're only at 62% of quota.
answer: Good catch on the mismatch — a 413 with a 'quota_exceeded' detail body pointing to bucket quota, despite your dashboard showing 62% usage, suggests the quota check may be hitting stale cached values rather than live usage. I'm escalating this to our storage infrastructure team to investigate the discrepancy, and in the meantime I'd like your bucket ID (from the org settings page) so we can check the underlying counters directly.

subject: All scheduled syncs stopped running since last night
body: None of our scheduled pipeline syncs have run since 23:40 UTC yesterday. We have 6 pipelines set to hourly cadence pulling from our energy metering connector into the warehouse, and the dashboard shows the last successful run 14 hours ago. No error is showing on the pipeline status page, jobs just aren't triggering at all. This is blocking our billing reconciliation team and we need this fixed immediately.
answer: Thank you for flagging this right away, I understand the urgency given the downstream billing impact. I'm escalating this to our pipelines on-call team now as a P0 and pulling the scheduler logs for your workspace to see why triggers stopped firing. I'll update you within the hour with findings and a fix timeline, and please let me know if any manual sync attempts also fail so I can factor that in.

subject: Biometric login fails intermittently on the mobile app
body: Several of our drivers are reporting that fingerprint login on the Northwind mobile app fails randomly, kicking them back to the password screen even though it worked the day before. This started around Tuesday and seems worse when the phone has been offline for a stretch, like during long hauls without signal. It's not blocking work since they can still type the password, but it's a hassle for the 22 of us using the app daily.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. This sounds like it could be related to how the biometric token cache handles extended offline periods before re-syncing with our auth service. Could you confirm the app version and device OS versions affected so I can check known issues and reproduce this on our end? In the meantime, having users fully log out and back in once they regain signal should reduce the frequency of the fallback prompts.

subject: Scheduled sync running much slower than usual
body: One of our nightly pipeline syncs, connecting our student enrollment database to the dashboard, has been taking over 3 hours to complete this week versus the usual 40 minutes. It still finishes successfully with no errors in the run log, just significantly delayed, which is pushing our morning reports past the 7am deadline our staff expects. We haven't changed the source data volume meaningfully in this period. Could you help us understand what's causing the slowdown?
answer: Thanks for the clear timeline on this. A jump from 40 minutes to 3+ hours without a data volume change usually points to either connector throttling on the source side or a queue backlog on our processing cluster. I'm pulling the run history for this pipeline now to check for retry patterns or resource contention, and will follow up with specifics and next steps shortly.

subject: Duplicate records appearing after scheduled sync
body: We're seeing duplicate rows in our destination table after the last three scheduled syncs from our transactions connector. Each run since Monday has added roughly 400 extra duplicate rows with identical transaction IDs, which is throwing off our reconciliation totals. The sync completes with a success status and no errors logged, so nothing on the surface indicates a problem. We're on a 15-minute sync interval and this is a fintech data set, so accuracy matters a lot here.
answer: This is helpful detail, thank you. Duplicate rows on a successful run typically point to an upsert key mismatch or a deduplication rule that isn't matching correctly on your transaction ID field. I'm reviewing the pipeline configuration and recent run logs on our side now to confirm where the dedup logic is breaking, and will get back to you with a corrective plan and guidance on cleaning up the existing duplicates.

subject: Webhook signature validation failing after key rotation
body: I rotated our API key last week following the docs, but now our webhook endpoint is rejecting incoming events with a signature mismatch error. The old key still appears active in the dashboard alongside the new one, so I suspect events might still be signed with the previous key in some cases. Is there a deprecation window I'm missing, or a header field that changed recently?
answer: Good question, and thanks for including the detail about both keys still showing active. There is a brief overlap window after rotation where either key can sign events, but it should not extend past 24 hours. Can you share the webhook event ID and timestamp of a failed delivery so I can trace which key was actually used to sign it and confirm whether this is a rotation timing issue or something else?

subject: Transform step failing on every pipeline run today
body: Since this morning our transform step has been failing on every run of our expense data pipeline, with the pipeline log showing a generic 'transform execution error' and no further detail. This is stopping our finance team from getting updated expense reports we need for a vendor payment review scheduled tomorrow. We haven't modified the transform logic recently.
answer: Thank you for the report, I know the timing with tomorrow's review makes this urgent. I'm pulling the detailed transform logs for your pipeline right now since the dashboard message alone won't show the root cause, and will follow up shortly with what's failing and how we can get a run through today. If it helps in the meantime, I can also check whether re-running with a smaller batch avoids the error as a temporary workaround.

subject: Users getting logged out every few minutes via SSO
body: Since this morning, employees signing in through our SSO provider are being logged out of Northwind roughly every 5 to 10 minutes and forced to re-authenticate. This is affecting most of our 28 seats and is seriously disrupting work across the team. Nothing has changed on our identity provider configuration that we're aware of, and this started without any change on our side around 9am today.
answer: I'm sorry for the disruption this is causing across your team, I'm treating this as high priority and looking into it immediately. Short session lifetimes like this usually trace back to a token refresh or session policy change on our SSO integration side, so I'm checking recent configuration changes and session logs for your workspace right now. I'll update you within the next 30 minutes with findings, and in the meantime please avoid making further SSO config changes so we can isolate the cause.

subject: Unable to upgrade plan, invoice generation fails
body: I'm trying to upgrade our workspace from the current plan to a higher tier through the billing settings, but the upgrade flow errors out at the payment confirmation step with 'invoice could not be generated' every time I try. This is blocking us from getting access to features we need for an integration we're building this week. We've tried with two different payment methods and get the same result.
answer: Thanks for trying both payment methods before reaching out, that helps narrow things down. An invoice generation failure at that step is usually on our billing system side rather than the payment method itself, so I'm escalating this to our billing team to check your account's invoicing configuration right now. I'll follow up as soon as I have a fix or a manual upgrade path so this doesn't hold up your integration work.

subject: Question about upcoming API key format change
body: I noticed a note in the changelog about API keys moving to a new prefixed format in an upcoming release, and I wanted to check what the migration timeline looks like for existing keys. We have a couple of scripts using our current keys directly in headers, and I want to make sure nothing breaks when the change rolls out. Is there a deprecation date set yet, and will old keys keep working during a transition period?
answer: Good question, and glad you're planning ahead for this. The new prefixed key format is being rolled out gradually, and existing keys will continue to work for a transition period of at least 90 days after general availability before any deprecation date is set. I'll share the official migration guide and exact timeline once it's published, but your current scripts should not need changes until we notify you of a firm cutover date.

subject: Request to update IP allowlist and get audit visibility
body: We'd like to add a new range of office IPs to our admin console allowlist ahead of a security review next month, and also wanted to ask whether allowlist changes are captured in the audit log automatically. Right now I can't tell from the console whether past changes were logged with who made them and when, which our compliance team will want to see. Could you confirm the current behavior and help with the update?
answer: Thanks for planning ahead of your review. Allowlist changes are captured in the audit log with the acting admin and timestamp, though I understand the console view could make this clearer, so I'll pass that along as feedback to our product team. Please send over the new IP ranges you'd like added and I'll get them applied, and I can also pull a recent audit export for your compliance team if that's useful.

subject: Offline mode does not sync push notifications after reconnect
body: We rely on the Mobile App for field staff across several campuses, and I've noticed that when a device goes offline and comes back online, queued push notifications from the last 24-48 hours never arrive. Login sessions stay valid, so that's not the issue. Could we get a feature to force a manual re-sync of missed pushes, or at least a status indicator showing pending notification count while offline? This affects our reporting workflows for attendance alerts.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. This matches a known gap where the push queue is cleared rather than flushed on reconnect, and I've logged it as a feature/bug request for our mobile team with your account attached for visibility. As a workaround in the meantime, users can pull-to-refresh the notification center after reconnecting to trigger a manual sync, which should surface most missed alerts within a minute or two.

subject: App crashes immediately when exiting offline mode
body: Since yesterday, our clinicians' devices crash within seconds of regaining network connection after being in offline mode. We've reproduced this on 4 different Android devices running app version 8.2.1. The crash happens right after the sync spinner appears - no error message, just a hard close. This is blocking care staff from logging visit notes that were saved offline.
answer: This is impacting patient-facing workflows so we're treating it as P1 and escalating to our mobile engineering team right now. Can you send us the device logs from one of the affected phones (Settings > About > Send Diagnostics) along with the exact timestamp of a recent crash? In the meantime, please advise staff to avoid force-closing the app while offline, as that seems to increase crash likelihood on reconnect based on similar reports.

subject: Workspace settings revert after deactivating a user
body: I deactivated a user from our workspace this morning and noticed our custom session timeout setting reset back to the default 30 minutes instead of the 4 hours we'd configured. Checking the audit log, there's no entry showing this setting was changed - it just silently reverted. This has happened twice now, both times right after a deactivation event.
answer: Thanks for flagging this - a silent settings revert tied to deactivation events sounds like a real bug rather than expected behavior. We're going to reproduce this on our side using a test workspace with a similar deactivation flow, and will check whether the audit log gap is related. I'll update you within one business day with findings and, if needed, a fix timeline.

subject: Shared dashboards showing stale data for viewers
body: We share several finance dashboards with viewer-level permissions across our logistics teams, and viewers are reporting charts that are 2-3 days out of date even though editors see current data. I've confirmed the underlying data source refreshes nightly, so this seems specific to how shared/viewer links cache dashboard content. Can you clarify how sharing permissions interact with refresh scheduling?
answer: Good catch - viewer-shared dashboard links can use a separate cache layer that doesn't always respect the same refresh schedule as the owner's view, especially under sharing permission settings. We're looking into your workspace configuration now; in the meantime, try re-sharing the dashboard link to force a fresh cache, and let us know if viewers still see stale data afterward.

subject: Request to disable biometric login fallback to PIN
body: We'd like to change our mobile app configuration so that if biometric login fails, users are not offered a PIN fallback and instead must re-authenticate with their Northwind credentials. Our compliance team flagged the PIN fallback as a weaker authentication path for our small energy sector team. Is this something that can be adjusted at the admin level, or does it require an app update?
answer: This is a supported configuration change - we can disable the PIN fallback for biometric login at the organization level from our side, no app update required. I'll apply this to your workspace and confirm once it's live; please allow up to 24 hours for the setting to propagate to all enrolled devices.

subject: Deactivated user still showing in audit log as active
body: I deactivated a former employee's account last week but the audit log still lists their status as active in the user history view, even though they can no longer log in. Just want to confirm this is a display issue and not something more serious given we're a small team and rely on that log for our quarterly review.
answer: Thanks for checking in on this - it does sound like a display-only issue in the audit log's status column rather than an actual access problem, since the account itself is correctly deactivated. We'll investigate why the log isn't refreshing that status field and follow up once we have a fix, but there's no security concern with the account access itself in the meantime.

subject: Need to update invoice billing contact and seat count reflected on invoices
body: Our finance team is closing out last quarter and I noticed our recent invoices still list an old billing contact and don't reflect the seat count change we made in September. Can you walk me through how to update the invoice template details, and will past invoices be reissued or just future ones going forward?
answer: Since this affects your financial records for the closed quarter, I'm marking this P1 and prioritizing it today. I can update the billing contact on your account right now, and going forward invoices will reflect the correct seat count automatically; for the specific invoices already issued with outdated seat data, I'll have our billing team review and reissue corrected copies within 2 business days.

subject: SAML login failing after IdP certificate rotation
body:
We rotated our IdP signing certificate last week and now SAML logins are failing for all our users trying to access Northwind via SSO. Here's the error our team is seeing:

SAMLResponse validation failed: Signature verification error
code: INVALID_SIGNATURE
timestamp: 2024-06-11T09:42:17Z
issuer: urn:idp:granite-academy
details: certificate fingerprint mismatch, expected SHA256:8f2a..., received SHA256:c91b...

We need to update our SAML config to match the new certificate but aren't sure where to do this in the admin console.
answer: Thanks for including the error details, that confirms it's exactly the certificate fingerprint mismatch you suspected. You can update the signing certificate under Identity and SSO > SAML Configuration > Identity Provider Settings by uploading the new IdP metadata XML or pasting the updated certificate directly; once saved it should take effect within a few minutes. Let us know once updated and we can help verify a test login on our end if needed.

subject: Allowlist setting not saving in workspace settings
body: I'm trying to add a new IP range to our workspace allowlist under Admin Console settings, but every time I save, the page reloads and the new entry is gone - only the original two entries remain. I've tried this in both Chrome and Firefox with the same result. No error message appears on save.
answer: Thanks for the clear repro steps. This looks like the allowlist form isn't persisting new entries correctly, possibly a validation issue silently rejecting the save. We'll test this in your workspace configuration and check the audit log for any rejected save attempts on our end, and get back to you with findings shortly.

subject: Connector auth token expiring mid-sync causing pipeline failures
body:
Our data pipeline connector to our internal warehouse has been failing intermittently over the past 3 days, always mid-sync rather than at startup. Here's what we're seeing in the connector logs:

[2024-06-10 14:22:03] INFO Sync started for connector id: conn_7841
[2024-06-10 14:31:47] ERROR Auth token expired during batch write, retry attempt 1/3
[2024-06-10 14:31:52] ERROR Auth token refresh failed: invalid_grant
[2024-06-10 14:31:52] FATAL Sync aborted, 42% of records written

This is causing partial data writes and increasing latency on downstream dashboards that depend on this connector.
answer: This is a significant issue since partial writes can lead to inconsistent downstream data, so I'm escalating this as P2 for immediate investigation. The invalid_grant error during refresh suggests the token lifetime configured on the connector may be shorter than your sync duration - can you confirm the auth method (OAuth2 client credentials vs refresh token) so we can check the expiry settings and also look into cleaning up the partial writes from the affected syncs?

subject: MFA-Einrichtung wirft Nutzer immer wieder zurück
body: Wir rollen aktuell MFA für alle 39 Nutzer bei North Freight aus. Einige Kolleg:innen berichten, dass sie beim Scannen des QR-Codes mit der Authenticator-App zwar den Code eingeben, aber danach wieder auf die Enrolment-Seite zurückgeschickt werden, ohne Fehlermeldung. Betroffen sind bisher 4 von 39 Konten, u.a. das Konto unseres Marketing-Leads. Gibt es bekannte Probleme mit der TOTP-Validierung oder liegt es an unseren SSO-Einstellungen?
answer: Danke für die genaue Beschreibung. Das Muster mit dem stillen Zurückspringen auf die Enrolment-Seite deutet meist auf eine Zeitabweichung zwischen Server und Authenticator-App hin, besonders wenn die betroffenen Geräte kürzlich neu gestartet wurden. Können Sie uns die Benutzer-IDs der vier betroffenen Konten senden, damit wir die Enrolment-Logs prüfen und sehen, ob es an der Zeitsynchronisation oder an einer SSO-Konfiguration liegt?

subject: Scheduled syncs stuck in pending since this morning
body: Since around 7:40 AM today, our nightly connector sync for the Quill Travel data warehouse feed hasn't run. The pipeline shows status 'pending' instead of 'completed', and this has now affected two consecutive scheduled runs (7:00 AM and 1:00 PM). We rely on this for our morning enrollment reports and the data is now 6 hours stale. Can you check why the scheduler isn't picking up the job for pipeline ID qt-sync-014?
answer: Thanks for flagging this, I can see pipeline qt-sync-014 is indeed stuck in a pending state on our end. This looks related to a scheduler queue backlog affecting a subset of accounts this morning. We're re-triggering the job manually now and will confirm once the sync completes; in the meantime I'd recommend holding off on manual re-runs to avoid duplicate loads.

subject: Pagination returning duplicate records across pages
body: We're paginating through the /v2/events endpoint using the cursor returned in the response header, and starting around page 14 we began seeing the same event IDs repeated on the following page. This happens consistently when the page_size param is set to 100. We're on SDK version 3.2.1. Is this a known issue with cursor stability during high write volume, since our energy monitoring dataset ingests roughly 50k events per hour?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. Cursor stability can be affected when new events are inserted between page fetches, since our cursors are currently based on insertion order rather than a fixed snapshot, so high-throughput writes like yours can cause overlap. We're evaluating a snapshot-based cursor for a future SDK release, but as a workaround you can dedupe by event ID client-side or filter on a timestamp boundary to avoid reprocessing.

subject: Offline mode not caching last synced data
body: I'm integrating the Northwind mobile SDK into our logistics app for Granite Partners, and I noticed that when the device loses connectivity, the app doesn't show the last successfully synced shipment data - it just displays a blank screen with a spinner. This happens on both iOS 17 and Android 14 test devices. I expected the SDK to serve cached data per the offline mode docs (section 4.2), but nothing renders until connection is restored.
answer: Thanks for the clear repro steps. This sounds like the local cache isn't being read on the offline fallback path, which shouldn't happen per the documented behavior. Could you share the SDK version you're using and a sample of the shipment data schema you're syncing? That will help us confirm whether it's a caching key mismatch or a rendering issue in your offline view.

subject: Refund issued but credits not reflected on account
body: We requested a refund for an overcharge on our March invoice for Willow Health, and I can see the refund confirmation email dated March 18th, but the credit never appeared on our account balance. Our next invoice, dated April 1st, still charged the full amount without applying the credit. Can someone check invoice #WH-3341 and confirm the credit was actually applied?
answer: I'm sorry for the confusion this caused with your billing. I've located invoice #WH-3341 and can confirm the refund was processed on our payment side, but it looks like the credit didn't sync back to your account balance correctly, which is why it wasn't applied to the April invoice. I'm manually applying the credit now and will follow up within one business day to confirm it's reflected and adjust your next invoice accordingly.

subject: Biometric login completely broken after latest app update
body: After updating the Northwind mobile app yesterday, none of our finance team at Willow Capital can log in using Face ID or fingerprint anymore. The app just crashes immediately after the biometric prompt appears, on both iPhone 14 and 15 devices. This is blocking our whole team from approving payments today since password login also seems to trigger the same crash on the payment approval screen.
answer: This is being treated as high priority since it's blocking your team's payment approvals. We've identified a crash related to the biometric authentication flow in the latest release and are pushing a fix now; in the meantime, please have your team try logging in via the web dashboard so approvals aren't delayed. I'll update you as soon as the patched app version is live, expected within the next few hours.

subject: Request to improve crash recovery on app launch
body: Our operations team at Apex Robotics has noticed that the mobile app occasionally crashes on launch after being idle for several hours, requiring a full restart to log back in. It's not happening to all 1824 users, maybe a few dozen reports a week across our facilities, but it's disruptive during shift handoffs. We'd like to request better handling so the app either recovers gracefully or preserves the login session instead of forcing a fresh login every time.
answer: Thank you for sharing this feedback, and I understand how disruptive this is during shift changes. We're logging this as a feature request to improve session persistence and crash recovery on launch. In the meantime, could you let us know which device models and OS versions are most commonly affected? That will help our mobile team prioritize and reproduce the issue while the improvement is evaluated.

subject: Multiple card declines when trying to update payment method
body: I'm trying to update our payment method for Vertex Legal's account after our previous card expired, but every attempt fails with 'Card declined - contact your bank' even though we've confirmed with our bank that the card is active and has no holds. We've tried two different cards now, both fail at the same step. Our account shows an overdue invoice and I'm worried about service interruption for our 6 users.
answer: I understand the urgency given the overdue invoice. This decline message can sometimes come from our payment processor rejecting the billing address format rather than the bank itself, so could you double check that the billing address on file matches exactly what's registered with the card issuer? In the meantime, I'm placing a temporary hold on any service interruption for your account while we sort out the payment method.

subject: Anfrage zu Connector-Authentifizierung für neue Datenquelle
body: Wir möchten für Apex Foods einen neuen Connector für unser Lieferantenportal einrichten, das OAuth2 mit Client-Credentials-Flow nutzt. In der aktuellen Connector-Liste sehen wir nur Support für Standard-OAuth mit Redirect-URI, was für unseren Anwendungsfall nicht passt. Gibt es Pläne, Client-Credentials-Authentifizierung für Custom-Connectors zu unterstützen, oder existiert bereits eine Workaround-Lösung?
answer: Vielen Dank für die Rückmeldung, das ist ein sehr nachvollziehbarer Anwendungsfall. Aktuell unterstützen unsere Custom-Connectors tatsächlich nur den Redirect-basierten OAuth-Flow, aber Client-Credentials steht auf unserer Roadmap für Server-zu-Server-Integrationen. Ich leite Ihre Anfrage an unser Produktteam weiter und melde mich, sobald es dazu Neuigkeiten gibt; als kurzfristige Alternative könnten wir gemeinsam prüfen, ob ein API-Token-basierter Ansatz über unsere generische REST-Connector-Option funktioniert.

subject: Charts rendering blank on quarterly finance dashboard
body: Since yesterday afternoon, three of our shared dashboards at Granite Media are showing blank chart areas where the revenue and cost trend visualizations used to be. The dashboard titled 'Q3 Finance Overview' loads fine but the bar chart widget just shows a grey box with 'Error loading data' in small text. This is affecting all 273 users who have access to this shared view, and we have a finance review meeting in two days that depends on this data.
answer: Thank you for reporting this, and I understand the time pressure with your finance review coming up. We're seeing reports of a rendering issue affecting bar chart widgets on shared dashboards after a recent update, and our engineering team is actively investigating. As a temporary workaround, try duplicating the affected widget or switching it to a line chart type, which several other customers have confirmed restores data rendering while we roll out the permanent fix.

subject: Sharing permissions for manufacturing dashboards
body:
We're rolling out a set of production-line dashboards to plant supervisors across three sites and need finer control over sharing. Right now it looks like any editor on a dashboard can re-share it with the whole workspace, which isn't ideal since some of these views contain cost-per-unit data. Is there a way to restrict sharing to specific groups or at least require admin approval before a dashboard gets shared beyond its original viewer list?

We have about 171 seats and roughly 40 dashboards already built, so we'd like a solution that doesn't require rebuilding each one by hand.
answer: Thanks for the detailed context. Dashboard sharing is currently workspace-wide once a viewer is promoted to editor, but we do have group-based sharing controls in the Pro tier that let you scope a dashboard to specific teams and lock down re-sharing rights. I'll walk you through setting that up on a couple of your existing dashboards and confirm it covers the cost-per-unit views before you roll it out further.

subject: Late-arriving records not being reprocessed in pipeline
body:
We have a pipeline pulling shipment data from a manufacturing partner's FTP connector, and about twice a week we get records timestamped up to 6 hours after their batch window closed. Right now those rows just get dropped because the window has already been finalized, and we have to manually backfill via CSV upload.

Is there a documented way to configure a grace period or late-arrival tolerance on the connector so these records get picked up automatically? We checked the connector docs but didn't see anything about handling out-of-order arrival.
answer: Good catch, and this is a known gap in the current connector docs. Late-arrival handling exists as a configurable watermark delay on the pipeline settings page, under Advanced > Windowing, but it's not yet documented for the FTP connector specifically. I'll send you the exact steps to set a 6-8 hour grace window and flag the doc gap to our content team so it's covered going forward.

subject: How to see current seat usage vs plan limit
body:
We're on the Starter plan with 13 seats and I want to confirm how many of those are actually active before we invite two more team members ahead of a trade show next week. I checked the admin panel but couldn't find a clear breakdown of used vs available seats, only a total user list.

Could you point me to where seat usage is shown, or let me know if that's something only visible on higher plans?
answer: Happy to help. Seat usage is visible under Admin > Billing > Plan Overview, which shows active seats against your 13-seat limit including any pending invites. If you don't see that tab, it may be a permissions issue on your admin role, in which case I can pull the current count for you directly, you're at 11 of 13 seats used as of this morning.

subject: jira intergration link brokenn - urgent
body:
Our jira link stoped working sometime yestrday, none of the tickets we create in Northwind are syncing over to Jira anymore. we use this to track billing disputes so its kinda urgent since finance team cant see new issues.

I tryed to reconect the integration under settings but it just spins and then says 'link failed, check permisions' even tho nothing changed on our end. we didnt touch okta or salesforce configs either so not sure whats going on.
answer: Sorry for the disruption, we're treating this as high priority since it's blocking your finance team's visibility. Can you confirm the exact error code shown alongside 'link failed, check permissions' and whether your Jira admin recently rotated an API token or changed OAuth app permissions? In the meantime I'm checking our integration logs on our end for failures tied to your workspace to narrow down whether this is a token expiry or a Jira-side permission change.

subject: Biometric login causing app crash on iOS
body:
Since this morning our drivers using the Northwind mobile app for delivery check-ins can't log in with Face ID, the app crashes immediately after the biometric prompt. This is affecting the whole logistics team, about a dozen people are stuck on the login screen right now and can't access offline route data they need for today's deliveries.

We're on iOS 17.4, app version shows as the latest from the App Store. Restarting the phones didn't help. This is blocking dispatch so we need this fixed quickly.
answer: This is being escalated immediately as it's blocking your dispatch operations. We've seen a similar crash reported this morning tied to a biometric session token issue after the latest iOS App Store release, and our mobile team is actively investigating. As a workaround, please have drivers use passcode login instead of Face ID for now, that path is unaffected, and I'll update you within the hour with a fix timeline.

subject: Jira integration broken after workspace migration
body:
We migrated our Northwind workspace to a new region last week and now the Jira link that used to sync incident tickets is showing as disconnected. I've tried removing and re-adding the integration through the admin console but it fails at the OAuth step with a generic 'authorization error' message.

We rely on this for escalation tracking across our energy operations teams, roughly 200 seats use the linked boards. Could someone check whether the migration affected our stored integration credentials?
answer: Thank you for flagging this, workspace region migrations can indeed invalidate stored OAuth tokens for third-party integrations like Jira, Slack, and Okta. I'm having our integrations team check whether your credentials need a manual re-issue on our side before you attempt reconnection again, since retrying without that step will likely keep failing at the OAuth handshake. I'll follow up shortly with either a fix or a re-authorization link.

subject: Duplicate email digests being sent daily
body:
Several of our team members are reporting that they're receiving two copies of the daily notification digest email every morning, both with identical content and timestamps about a minute apart. This started roughly a week ago and we haven't changed any notification rules on our end.

Could you check whether there's a duplicate subscription or a rule conflict causing this? It's a minor annoyance but a few people have asked if they can just get one, and it's making them question whether alerts are being missed elsewhere.
answer: Thanks for the report, and sorry for the inbox clutter. This matches a known issue where users subscribed to both a team-level and personal digest rule end up receiving two sends; I'll check your notification configuration to see if that's the cause here. If it is, I can merge the rules so only one digest goes out per user, and I'll also pass along feedback about surfacing duplicate rule warnings in the admin UI.

subject: Role mapping not syncing correctly from SSO groups
body:
We're seeing inconsistent role assignments after SSO login for a subset of users. Some employees who belong to our 'Logistics-Managers' Okta group are being provisioned into Northwind with the default viewer role instead of the manager role our SAML mapping specifies. This is affecting maybe 30-40 users out of 452 seats so far, mostly newer hires added in the last two weeks.

We checked the attribute mapping configuration and the group name matches exactly what's in Okta. Could someone review our SSO role mapping rules to see why provisioning isn't picking up the correct role for this group?
answer: Thanks for the detailed breakdown, that's helpful for narrowing this down. A common cause of this pattern is a case-sensitivity mismatch or a stale group claim cached from before a recent Okta group rename, so I'd like to confirm the exact claim value Okta is sending versus what's configured in your SAML role mapping rule. I'll also check our provisioning logs for the affected users' most recent login events to see what role claim we actually received on their side.

subject: Zapier integration failing on new Zaps for education workspace
body:
We're trying to set up a new Zap that triggers on Northwind form submissions and pushes them into our internal tracking sheet, but every test run fails with 'Error: unable to retrieve trigger sample, no data found' even though we have submissions from this week. This is blocking a workflow our team needs live before the start of next term.

We've confirmed the Zapier connection is authorized and other existing Zaps using Northwind data still work fine, so it seems specific to this new trigger type.
answer: Thanks for confirming the existing Zaps still work, that helps isolate this to the specific trigger. This error usually means the trigger endpoint isn't returning sample data for newly created Zaps even when live data exists, which can happen if the form submission trigger wasn't refreshed after a recent Zapier app update on our end. I'm escalating this now given your term-start deadline and will get you either a fix or a manual sample data workaround today.

subject: SSO role mapping broken, users getting wrong permissions after login
body:
We have a serious problem with role mapping after our SAML integration update yesterday. Multiple users across our manufacturing plants are logging in via SSO and landing with admin-level access instead of their assigned operator role, while others are locked out entirely with 'insufficient permissions' errors despite being in the correct Okta groups.

This is affecting a large chunk of our 242 seats and we've had to manually downgrade a few accounts that got unexpected admin rights, which is a security concern given MFA is also inconsistently enforced for these mis-mapped accounts. We need this resolved urgently before more users log in today.

Logs show repeated entries like: role_claim_mismatch: expected 'operator', received 'admin_default' for user session batch starting 09:14 UTC.
answer: This is being treated as urgent given the security implications of unintended admin access. The 'admin_default' claim you're seeing suggests your SAML assertion is falling back to a default role when the expected group claim isn't matching post-update, likely tied to the SAML integration change made yesterday. We're pulling the full session logs from 09:14 UTC onward now, and as an immediate mitigation I'd recommend temporarily disabling SSO-based role assignment and reverting affected users to manual role assignment until we confirm the mapping fix, I'll guide you through that in the next few minutes.

subject: Dashboard sharing permissions not saving correctly
body:
I'm trying to share our Q3 Travel Spend dashboard with three regional managers but the permission level keeps reverting to 'view only' even after I set it to 'edit'. This happens specifically on the chart titled 'Booking Trends by Region' - the rest of the dashboard shares fine. I've tried this on both Chrome and Edge with the same result.

Could you confirm if this is a known issue? I need the managers to be able to adjust date filters before our finance review on Friday.
answer:
Thanks for the detailed report. This does match a known bug affecting permission inheritance on individual chart widgets when a dashboard has mixed sharing levels - our engineering team is already tracking it. As a workaround, try removing the chart from the dashboard and re-adding it after setting the sharing permission at the dashboard level first, then adjust per-chart settings.

I'll flag this ticket to our documentation team as well since this scenario isn't currently covered in our sharing guide. I'll follow up once we have a permanent fix timeline.

subject: Repeated upload failures to Storage this morning
body:
Since around 8am today we've had four failed uploads when trying to back up student record archives to our Storage bucket. The error we get is 'Upload interrupted: quota check failed' even though our usage dashboard shows we're only at 61% of our allocated quota. Files are under 200MB each, well within our normal range.

We only have 4 seats on this account so this is affecting our entire backup process for the week. Could someone check if there's a quota calculation issue on your end?
answer:
Sorry for the disruption to your backup routine.
