We've seen a delay in quota recalculation after recent cleanup operations that can cause this false quota check failure - I'm checking your account's storage metrics now to confirm this is the same issue. In the meantime, could you try the upload again in about 15 minutes, as the cache should refresh?

If it fails again, please send me the exact timestamp and file name so I can trace the specific request in our logs.

subject: Refund needed for duplicate charge and incorrect plan credit
body:
Our last invoice (INV-88231) shows we were charged twice for the same billing cycle - once on the 2nd and again on the 4th, both for $148.00. We also had a $35 credit applied last month for a service outage that never appeared on this invoice. Our plan should reflect 22 seats but the invoice line item lists 24.

This is causing real problems for our monthly reconciliation and I need this resolved before our books close on the 15th. Can you process the refund for the duplicate charge and correct the seat count and missing credit?
answer:
I understand the urgency given your closing deadline, and I apologize for the billing errors. I'm escalating this immediately to our billing team to reverse the duplicate charge for INV-88231 and reissue the invoice with the corrected 22-seat count and the outstanding $35 outage credit applied. You should see the refund processed within 2-3 business days.

I'll send you a corrected invoice copy by end of day tomorrow along with confirmation of the refund transaction ID so you have documentation for your books.

subject: Dashboard charts rendering completely broken for entire team
body:
As of this morning none of our finance dashboards are displaying data correctly - charts are showing blank boxes or the wrong axis labels entirely. This is affecting all 25 of our seats, not just my account, and it's stopped our team from preparing the weekly spend report that's due to leadership today.

We haven't changed any settings recently. The 'Vendor Cost Breakdown' bar chart in particular just shows a grey rectangle with no legend. This needs urgent attention as our whole team is blocked.
answer:
Thank you for flagging this right away - I understand the whole team being blocked is urgent, so I'm escalating this to our engineering team now with priority status. Could you confirm the exact dashboard name and whether this started after any browser update or specific action, like exporting a chart or changing a date filter?

We're actively investigating a rendering issue affecting chart widgets and will update you within the next hour with either a fix or a workaround so you can get your report out.

subject: Request to adjust scheduled sync frequency for pipeline connectors
body:
We currently have three connectors pulling transaction data on a daily schedule, but with 231 seats now active across multiple regions, we're seeing our finance team need fresher data throughout the day. Is it possible to increase sync frequency to hourly for just the 'Payments Ledger' connector without affecting the other two?

We've also noticed sync latency creeping up over the past two weeks, sometimes taking 45 minutes to complete a run that used to finish in 15. Would appreciate guidance on both the frequency change and the latency increase.
answer:
Thanks for the detailed request. Increasing sync frequency to hourly for a single connector is supported - I can help you configure that for the Payments Ledger connector specifically, which won't impact the schedule of the other two. I'll send over the configuration steps shortly.

On the latency issue, that increase is worth investigating separately since 45 minutes for a run that previously took 15 suggests either a data volume spike or a connector-side bottleneck. Could you let me know approximately how much your source data volume has grown recently so I can check our pipeline logs for that window?

subject: Dashboards loading very slowly across the workspace
body:
Over the past week our dashboards have become noticeably slower to load, especially the shared ones with multiple charts. What used to take a couple seconds now takes 20-30 seconds, and exporting a dashboard to PDF times out entirely for our 'Regional Bookings Overview' dashboard, which has about 12 charts on it.

This is affecting all 54 seats on our account since most of our team relies on these dashboards daily for trip planning updates. Nothing has changed on our end recently in terms of usage patterns.
answer:
Thanks for reporting this - a jump from a couple seconds to 20-30 seconds, plus export timeouts, points to a performance regression on our end rather than something in your workspace configuration. I'm pulling the load metrics for your account now to check for query bottlenecks on dashboards with high chart counts like the Regional Bookings Overview.

In the meantime, could you try splitting that dashboard into two smaller ones as a temporary workaround for the export timeout? I'll update you within the next day with findings from our investigation.

subject: SAML login failing for new users after SSO setup
body:
We finished configuring SAML SSO with our identity provider last week, and while existing users can log in fine, any new user we provision gets stuck with an error saying 'SAML response missing required attribute: email'. We've double checked our IdP attribute mappings and email is definitely included in the assertion.

We only have 3 seats on this account so this is blocking us from onboarding our last team member. Any idea what attribute name Northwind expects on our end?
answer:
Thanks for the detailed description - this usually happens when the attribute name in the SAML assertion doesn't exactly match what Northwind expects, which is 'emailaddress' rather than 'email' by default unless a custom mapping was set. Could you check your IdP's attribute statement configuration and confirm the exact attribute name being sent?

If you can share a sanitized copy of the SAML response (with any sensitive values redacted), I can take a closer look and confirm the mismatch directly.

subject: Mobile app crashes when opening offline mode
body:
Our field analysts have started reporting that the mobile app crashes immediately when they try to switch to offline mode after syncing data. This started after updating to the latest app version yesterday. The crash happens consistently on both iOS and Android devices within our team, right after tapping 'Enable Offline Access' in settings.

This is a serious problem since several of our analysts work in areas with no connectivity and rely on offline mode daily for data collection. We need a fix or workaround urgently as this is blocking fieldwork today.
answer:
I'm sorry for the disruption to your fieldwork - a consistent crash on both platforms right after enabling offline mode sounds like a regression from the latest release, and I'm escalating this as high priority now. As an immediate workaround, could your analysts try enabling offline mode before syncing rather than after, and let me know if the crash still occurs?

Our mobile engineering team is investigating the release now, and I'll update you as soon as we have a hotfix or confirmed workaround, ideally within a few hours given the field impact.

subject: Urgent: dashboards extremely slow, blocking daily operations reporting
body:
Starting this morning our entire workspace of 200 seats has been experiencing severe dashboard slowness - load times of over a minute for dashboards that normally load instantly, and several charts are failing to render at all with a generic 'chart error' message. Exporting any dashboard to PDF or image is also failing consistently.

We rely on these dashboards for our energy trading floor operations reports throughout the day, and this outage is now affecting decision-making across multiple teams. We need this escalated immediately as it's a company-wide issue, not isolated to one user.
answer:
This is being escalated to our engineering team immediately given the company-wide impact on your operations reporting. We're pulling performance metrics for your workspace right now to identify whether this is related to a backend service degradation affecting dashboard rendering and export functions broadly.

I'll have a dedicated engineer join this ticket within the next 30 minutes, and I'll send you interim status updates every hour until we've restored normal load times and export functionality.

subject: Question about API key rotation and upcoming deprecation
body:
I noticed a banner in our developer portal mentioning that the v1 API keys will be deprecated soon, but I couldn't find specifics on the exact date or migration steps. We currently use two API keys for our billing reconciliation scripts and want to make sure we rotate them properly before anything breaks.

Also, does the new key format have different rate limits? We're a small team on 14 seats and want to plan this transition without disrupting our monthly reporting scripts.
answer:
Good question, and thanks for planning ahead on this. The v1 API keys are scheduled for deprecation on a rolling basis over the next quarter, with specific dates published in our API changelog - I'll send you the direct link along with the migration guide for moving to v2 keys.

On rate limits, the v2 keys do have a slightly higher default limit (1000 requests/hour versus 600 previously), so your reconciliation scripts shouldn't be affected negatively. Happy to walk through the key rotation steps with you if useful, just let me know a good time.

subject: SDK throwing intermittent 429s despite low request volume
body:
We integrated the Northwind API Platform SDK (v3.2.1, Node) into our logistics tracking tool last week. Since Monday we're seeing intermittent 'Error: Rate limit exceeded (429)' responses even though our request count per minute is well under 100, far below the documented limit for our tier. This is affecting our shipment status webhook handler and causing delayed updates to dispatchers.

We've retried with exponential backoff already built in, but the errors persist in bursts of 5-10 per hour. Can you check if there's a rate limit misconfiguration on our account (Quill Energy, org ID QE-2291)?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. A burst pattern like this often points to a per-endpoint limit rather than the account-wide cap, so I'm pulling the rate limit logs for org QE-2291 now to see which specific route is triggering the 429s. I'll also check whether a recent SDK update changed the retry-after handling on our side, and will follow up shortly with findings and next steps.

subject: IP allowlist blocking all API calls after update - urgent
body:
I updated the IP allowlist in Admin Console this morning to add our new office range (203.0.113.0/24) for Pioneer Retail, but now every API call from our existing production servers is being rejected with 'Forbidden: source IP not allowlisted', even though those IPs were already on the list before my change. Our checkout integration has been down for about 40 minutes now.

I checked the settings page and the old entries still appear to be listed, so I don't understand why they're being blocked. This is affecting all 20 of our users trying to process orders. Please advise urgently.
answer: This is a priority issue and I'm escalating it right now. It's possible the allowlist update triggered a propagation delay or a rule ordering conflict that's temporarily blocking previously-approved ranges - I'm checking the audit log for your account to confirm exactly what changed at the time of the edit. I'll update you within the next 15 minutes with either a fix or a rollback to the prior working configuration.

subject: Need webhook retries for failed billing events
body:
We're using API Platform webhooks to sync invoice status into our finance system for Willow Academy. Over the past two weeks we've noticed that when our endpoint returns a 500 (usually due to brief downtime on our side), Northwind doesn't seem to retry the delivery - the event is just marked failed and never resent, which means we lose billing events entirely.

Could you confirm whether there's a retry mechanism we're missing, or whether this needs to be added? We rely on these events for month-end reconciliation and missing even one causes real accounting discrepancies.
answer: Thanks for flagging this - webhook deliveries should retry automatically up to 5 times with exponential backoff over 24 hours for 5xx responses, so it sounds like something isn't behaving as expected on your endpoint's configuration. I'm reviewing the delivery logs for your webhook subscription now to see exactly what happened with the failed events from the past two weeks, and will follow up with findings plus a plan to recover any missed billing events.

subject: Offline mode not syncing after reconnect
body:
Our warehouse staff use the Northwind Mobile App in offline mode during inventory counts, and lately we've noticed that data entered offline doesn't always sync once the device reconnects to wifi. Out of about 30 devices at Willow Foods, roughly 4 or 5 seem affected each week. Nothing crashes, but counts entered offline just silently disappear rather than syncing.

This isn't blocking day-to-day work since staff can re-enter counts, but it's creating extra manual work and some confusion about which counts are accurate. Would appreciate guidance on what might be causing this.
answer: Thanks for the clear writeup. Silent sync failures like this are usually tied to local storage limits or a stale sync token on affected devices, so we'd like to gather device logs from two or three of the impacted units to pinpoint the pattern. I'll send over instructions for exporting the sync diagnostic log from the app, and we'll investigate from there - this isn't urgent for us to treat as a full incident, so expect an update within a couple of business days.

subject: Biometric login crashing app for large number of users
body:
Since yesterday's app update, biometric login (Face ID) on the Northwind Mobile App is crashing immediately for a large portion of our field staff at Ember Retail - we've had reports from at least 40 users so far. The app opens, shows the Face ID prompt, then closes without any error message. Falling back to password login works fine.

This is a serious problem for us because biometric login is required by our internal security policy for accessing client financial data in the field. We need this fixed as soon as possible since it's blocking a large chunk of our workforce from doing their jobs.
answer: I understand the urgency given your security policy requirements, and I'm treating this as a high-priority issue. We've seen one other report of a similar Face ID crash following the latest release, and our mobile team is already investigating a possible regression in the biometric library - I'm escalating your case directly to that team with your user count and device details. In the meantime, please advise affected staff to use password login, and I'll update you as soon as we have a fix timeline, likely within the next few hours.

subject: Slack alerts completely stopped firing for case updates
body:
Our Slack integration for case status updates has stopped sending any notifications since sometime yesterday afternoon at Lumen Legal. We use it to alert our legal team channel whenever a case record changes status in our system, and it's been silent for over 18 hours now despite multiple test updates on our end.

We checked the Slack app permissions and the integration still shows as 'Connected' in our settings, so nothing looks obviously broken from our side. This is a major issue since our team relies on these alerts to catch time-sensitive case changes, and 137 people across our firm are affected.
answer: Thank you for reporting this - a full outage of Slack notifications for that many users is something we're treating as high priority. I'm checking the integration logs on our end now to see if there was a delivery failure or an expired token on the Slack side that isn't reflected in your connection status. I'll follow up shortly with root cause and either a fix or a reconnection step you'll need to complete.

subject: Option to increase frequency of scheduled syncs
body:
We currently have our Data Pipelines connector for our booking system set to sync every 6 hours for Blue Partners, and we'd like to request the ability to schedule syncs more frequently, ideally every 30 minutes, for one specific connector feeding our travel itinerary data. The rest of our connectors can stay on the current schedule.

We don't need this urgently, but as we scale up our travel data volume it would help reduce latency in downstream reporting. Is this something that's configurable per-connector already, or would it require a plan change?
answer: Good question - per-connector sync frequency is available, but the minimum interval depends on your current plan tier, and 30-minute syncs typically require an upgrade from Starter. I'll check the exact options available for your account and send over the specifics, including any cost implications, so you can decide whether it's worth adjusting now or waiting until you scale further.

subject: Dashboards taking 20+ seconds to load for our team
body:
Several of our dashboards in the Northwind platform have become very slow to load over the past week, taking upwards of 20-30 seconds before charts render, for Blue Academy. This is happening across multiple dashboards, not just one, and affects all 10 of our seats. Exporting to CSV also seems slower than before.

We haven't changed anything on our end recently - no new data sources or chart types added. Could you check if there's a performance issue on Northwind's side, or advise on anything we could optimize in our dashboard configuration?
answer: Thanks for reporting this - dashboard load times of 20+ seconds across multiple boards suggests something beyond normal query load, so I'm checking our platform metrics for any recent performance degradation affecting your region or account. I'll also review your dashboard configurations for heavy chart types or large date ranges that might be contributing, and will get back to you with findings and any recommended optimizations.

subject: IP allowlist setup - how to add multiple ranges properly
body:
I'm trying to configure the IP allowlist in Admin Console for our production API access at Quill Retail, and I want to make sure I'm doing this correctly since we have multiple office locations and a VPN exit range to add. Right now I only see a single text field for entering IPs and I'm not sure if I should separate multiple CIDR ranges with commas, new lines, or add them one at a time.

Also, is there an audit log entry created each time someone edits this list? We need that for our internal security review process. Can you clarify the correct format and confirm the audit logging behavior?
answer: Happy to clarify - you can add multiple CIDR ranges by entering each one on a new line in that field, and the system will validate and save them as separate allowlist entries; commas aren't supported. Every addition, edit, or removal to the allowlist does generate an audit log entry with the admin's user ID and timestamp, which you can pull from the Audit Log section of Admin Console for your security review.

subject: PDF export request
body:
We've been using Northwind Dashboards for a few months now at Apex Partners, mostly for tracking logistics KPIs across our regional teams. Our workspace has grown to 255 seats and we now share dashboards pretty heavily across departments, using the sharing links feature daily. Recently we started trying to distribute weekly summary reports to stakeholders who don't have platform access.

The actual issue is that when we try to export a dashboard to PDF, the layout comes out completely broken - charts overlap and legends are cut off, especially on dashboards with more than 4 widgets. We need a reliable export option since not everyone we report to has a login. Is there a fix planned or a workaround for now?
answer: Thanks for the context, and sorry for the trouble this is causing with your stakeholder reporting. PDF export layout issues on dashboards with several widgets are a known limitation we're actively working to improve - in the meantime, a workaround is to export dashboards with 4 or fewer widgets per page, or use the shareable link with view-only access as an alternative for stakeholders who can accept a guest login. I'll flag your case to our product team as additional evidence for prioritizing the layout fix.

subject: Digest-E-Mails werden doppelt versendet
body: Wir binden die Notifications-API ein, um wöchentliche E-Mail-Digests an unsere Kanzleimitarbeiter zu senden. Seit dem Update auf die aktuelle API-Version bekommen einzelne Nutzer den gleichen Digest zwei- oder dreimal, zum Beispiel Request-ID ntf_88213 wurde dreimal an denselben Empfänger zugestellt. Gibt es einen Dedupe-Key oder eine Idempotenz-Option, die wir setzen müssen? Außerdem fehlt in der Doku eine Angabe zur maximalen Digest-Frequenz, das wäre als Feature hilfreich.
answer: Danke für die genaue Beschreibung. Das doppelte Zustellen deutet meist darauf hin, dass der Idempotency-Key im Header fehlt oder sich bei Retries ändert - können Sie uns die Header Ihrer letzten drei Digest-Requests zusenden, damit wir das nachvollziehen können? Den Wunsch nach einer klareren Dokumentation zur Digest-Frequenz und einer konfigurierbaren Option geben wir gerne als Feature-Request an unser Produktteam weiter.

subject: Invoice shows 8 seats but we only have 6 active users
body: Our latest invoice from Northwind Cloud bills us for 8 seats, but when I check the admin console under Users only 6 accounts are listed as active. We removed two contractors back in early March and expected the seat count to drop on the next billing cycle. Can someone confirm whether the seat count is pulled at invoice generation time or continuously, and adjust the current invoice accordingly?
answer: Thanks for flagging this - seat counts are captured at the start of each billing cycle, so removals made mid-cycle should reflect on the following invoice, but I want to check why yours didn't update. I'm escalating this to billing to review your account history and issue a corrected invoice or credit if the two seats were removed before the cycle closed; I'll follow up with the details within one business day.

subject: Getting 410 Gone on /v2/orders after deprecation deadline
body: We received the deprecation notice for the /v2/orders endpoint back in November with a cutover date of January 15th, and since that date our production integration is returning 410 Gone on every call. We're on SDK version 3.4.1 which the changelog says should support /v3/orders, but switching the base path alone isn't resolving it - we get 'unsupported_version' errors instead. Can you confirm the exact migration steps and whether we need a newer SDK release?
answer: Apologies for the disruption this is causing - the /v3/orders endpoint requires SDK 3.6.0 or later, since 3.4.1 still sends the legacy auth header format that the new endpoint rejects. Please upgrade the SDK and let us know if the 'unsupported_version' error persists; in the meantime I'm attaching our internal migration checklist so your team can verify each changed field mapping.

subject: Storage retention limits blocking uploads, need urgent increase
body: We're integrating the Storage API to back up media assets nightly, and starting yesterday our upload jobs are failing with 'quota_exceeded: retention window full' on the /v1/storage/objects endpoint. Our current retention is set to 30 days, but we need at least 90 days to comply with a client contract, and now uploads for two of our shows are stuck in a failed state. This is blocking our production backup pipeline entirely and we need a fix today.
answer: I understand this is blocking your nightly backups, so I've raised this as a priority item. We can extend your retention window to 90 days on the Storage plan, and I'm doing that now so new uploads should succeed immediately - please retry the failed jobs for the two shows and confirm they go through. I'll follow up shortly to make sure the quota increase is fully applied.

subject: URGENT: all webhook signature verification failing since this morning
body: Starting around 7:40am UTC today, every incoming webhook from Northwind is failing signature verification on our end - we get 'invalid_signature' for 100% of events, including payment confirmation webhooks that drive our reconciliation process. Nothing changed in our secret rotation, and this is affecting all 186 seats on our account. We suspect a key rotation issue on your side, this is a full outage for us and needs immediate attention.
answer: This is being treated as our top priority right now - we can see an issue with the webhook signing key rotation that rolled out this morning and are working to revert it immediately. Please hold off on rotating your own secret in the meantime; we'll post an update within the next 30 minutes and confirm once signatures are verifying correctly again.

subject: Pagination cursor skipping and duplicating records
body: We're using the SDK to page through /v1/records with a page_size of 200, and since upgrading to SDK 4.2.0 we're seeing inconsistent results - some pages repeat records from the previous page, and others skip records entirely. We reproduced this on three separate accounts, comparing cursor values in our logs shows the 'next_cursor' sometimes matches the current page's cursor exactly. The documentation still references the old cursor behavior from SDK 3.x, so we're not sure if this is expected or a regression.
answer: Thanks for the detailed repro steps - this does sound like a regression introduced in 4.2.0 around cursor generation when records are added or removed between page fetches. We're pulling the logs from the three accounts you mentioned to confirm, and in the meantime recommend pinning to SDK 4.1.x as a workaround. I'll update the ticket once engineering confirms the root cause and timeline for a fix.

subject: Request to add biometric login to mobile app
body: Our clinical staff use the Northwind mobile app throughout their shifts, and the current PIN-based login is causing complaints because they have to re-enter it constantly between patient visits. We'd like to request Face ID and fingerprint login support, along with better offline mode since our facilities have spotty connectivity. We've also had a handful of crash reports when the app is backgrounded for long periods - happy to share device logs if useful.
answer: Thanks for the feedback - biometric login and improved offline handling are both requests we're actively evaluating for the mobile roadmap, and I'm logging your use case with the healthcare context to help prioritize it. On the crashes when backgrounded, please send us the device logs and OS versions involved so we can investigate that separately as a possible bug.

subject: SSO sessions expiring after 5 minutes instead of 8 hours
body: We configured our SSO session timeout to 8 hours in the Identity console, but users are being logged out and re-prompted for MFA after roughly 5 minutes of inactivity, regardless of the setting. This is happening across our entire org integration and is a serious productivity issue given our size. Our SSO integration uses SAML with the standard Northwind connector, and we haven't changed anything on our identity provider side recently.
answer: This is a significant issue given the scale of your organization, so I'm escalating it as high priority. We've seen a similar report where a recent session-handling change caused the configured timeout to be overridden by a default value - we're checking your tenant configuration now and will push a fix or manual override as soon as we confirm the cause, likely within a few hours.

subject: BILLED FOR SEATS WE DONT HAVE - FIX THIS NOW
body: I have gone through our usage report and we are being charged for way more seats than we actually have active, this has apparently been going on for THREE billing cycles and nobody caught it until I ran the numbers myself. We removed several accounts months ago and the seat count never dropped. I want a refund for the overcharge and an explanation for why this wasnt flagged, if this isnt resolved quickly we will be canceling our plan and looking elsewhere.
answer: I completely understand the frustration, and I'm sorry this wasn't caught sooner. I'm pulling your account's seat history right now to identify exactly when the removed accounts stopped being active versus when they stopped being billed, and I'll calculate the overcharge across the affected cycles so we can process a refund. I'll have concrete numbers for you within one business day and will personally make sure this gets corrected.

subject: Unsubscribe endpoint not stopping emails, users getting duplicates
body: We integrated the /v1/notifications/unsubscribe endpoint so travelers can opt out of trip alerts, and it returns a 200 success response, but several users report still receiving the same alert twice a day afterward. We tested with three test accounts and confirmed the unsubscribe call succeeds and the API even shows their status as 'unsubscribed', yet notifications keep arriving. This is generating support complaints from our own customers and we need this fixed quickly since volume is growing daily.
answer: Thank you for the clear repro with the test accounts - a successful unsubscribe response while notifications still send points to a caching issue in the delivery pipeline not respecting the updated status in time. We're treating this as urgent given the growing volume, and I'm escalating to engineering now; in the meantime, could you send us the three test account identifiers so we can trace their delivery logs directly?

subject: Invoice billing for 15 seats, we only have 11
body: I'm reviewing invoice #CT-10432 for Cobalt Travel and we're being charged for 15 seats on the Starter plan when our admin console shows only 11 active users. This has happened on the last two billing cycles now, adding roughly $60 extra each month. Can someone check our account and issue a refund or credit for the overcharge? We need this resolved before our next payment date on the 28th.
answer: Thanks for flagging this, and I'm sorry for the extra charges. I'm pulling up your account now to compare the seat count in our billing system against your active user list, and I'll get a corrected invoice issued along with a credit for the overbilled amount from the last two cycles. I'll follow up within the next few hours with confirmation before your payment date.

subject: API Rate Limit Fehler bei Integration
body: Wir integrieren gerade die Northwind API in unser System und bekommen seit heute Morgen ständig 429 Too Many Requests Fehler, obwohl wir laut Dokumentation im Starter Plan 60 Requests pro Minute haben sollten. Bei uns bricht die Verbindung schon nach etwa 20 Requests ab. Zusätzlich würde ich gerne wissen, ob das aktuelle SDK v2.3 bald durch eine neue Version abgelöst wird, da wir ungern in eine veraltete Version investieren.
answer: Danke für die genaue Beschreibung. Das klingt nach einem Problem mit der Rate-Limit-Zählung auf unserer Seite, da der Starter Plan tatsächlich 60 Requests pro Minute erlauben sollte. Ich prüfe gerade die Logs für Ihren API-Key und melde mich mit einer Lösung. Zum SDK: v2.3 wird noch mindestens sechs Monate unterstützt, ein Deprecation-Hinweis würde vorher rechtzeitig kommuniziert.

subject: Seat count jumped after bulk import, billing overage triggered
body: We ran a bulk user import last night for North Labs to onboard our new warehouse team, and this morning our billing dashboard shows 291 seats used instead of the 267 we're contracted for on the Pro plan. It looks like some deactivated accounts from a previous import in March got reactivated during the process. This triggered an overage warning email and I want to make sure we're not charged incorrectly while we sort out which accounts should actually be active.
answer: Thanks for reporting this quickly. It does sound like the deactivated accounts were re-enabled during the import rather than being skipped, which is causing the inflated seat count. I'm putting a hold on any overage billing for your account while our team reviews the import logs and helps you identify which accounts should be deactivated again. I'll update you within the day with a corrected seat count.

subject: Webhooks completely stopped delivering - patient scheduling impacted
body: Our production webhooks from Northwind have not fired since 6:40 AM this morning, and Pioneer Robotics relies on these events to sync patient scheduling updates across our facilities. We've confirmed our endpoint is healthy and responding to test pings, but no real events have come through in over three hours. This is affecting live scheduling for all 76 seats on our account and we need this fixed immediately.
answer: This is being treated as our highest priority right now. I've escalated to our platform engineering team and they're actively investigating the webhook delivery pipeline for your account. I'll have a status update for you within 30 minutes, and in the meantime, if you can share a recent event ID or timestamp of an expected webhook that didn't arrive, that will help us pinpoint the failure faster.

subject: Charts and export issue
body:
We've been using Northwind Dashboards for a few months now to track inventory turnover and supplier performance across our retail locations for Granite Travel. Our team relies heavily on the weekly export feature to share summaries with store managers who don't have direct dashboard access, and this has worked well until recently.

Starting this week, three of our bar charts are rendering completely blank on the dashboard view, and when we try to export them to PDF, the export either fails silently or produces an empty page. This is on our main supplier performance dashboard, and we need it working again for our Monday review meeting.
answer: Thanks for the detailed context. Blank chart rendering combined with failed exports usually points to a data source refresh issue rather than the export tool itself, so I'm checking the underlying dataset connection for your supplier performance dashboard now. I'll have a fix or workaround ready before your Monday review, and I'll follow up here with details on what caused it.

subject: Bulk sharing permission update needed across dashboard rollout
body: We're rolling out Northwind Dashboards to all 1,416 seats at Blue Health as part of our new analytics initiative, and we need to change the default sharing permissions so that department heads can share dashboards externally with our education partners, which is currently restricted. The documentation only covers individual dashboard sharing settings, not organization-wide defaults, and some exports are failing when shared with external viewers due to permission mismatches. Can you help us set this up at scale before our rollout date next week?
answer: Thank you for the detailed request. Organization-wide sharing defaults for Enterprise accounts are configurable, but they do require our team to apply them at the admin level since it affects all dashboards simultaneously. I'll set up a call with our solutions team this week to walk through the configuration and get the external sharing permissions and export settings sorted ahead of your rollout date.

subject: Jira connection question
body:
Our engineering team at Quill Labs has been using Northwind's Integrations hub to connect Slack for incident alerts, which has worked really well for us over the past few months. As we've grown to 18 seats, we've started tracking more issues through Jira as well and want our billing and product teams to have visibility into linked tickets.

Could you let us know if Northwind supports a native Jira integration similar to the Slack one, or if this is something on your roadmap? We'd like to link invoice disputes directly to Jira tickets for internal tracking.
answer: Good question, and thanks for the context on your workflow. We do have a native Jira integration available on the Integrations hub, though it's currently limited to issue creation and status sync rather than deep billing linkage. I can walk you through enabling it for your account, and I'll also pass along your request about linking invoice disputes to Jira tickets as a feature suggestion to our product team.

subject: Notifications not coming through on mobile
body:
Our field teams at Pioneer Energy use the Northwind mobile app to get real-time alerts when equipment sensors go offline, which is critical since many of our sites have limited connectivity. Over the past two weeks we've been testing the app more heavily as we scale up to 200 seats across our regional teams.

The actual problem is that push notifications for offline device alerts have stopped arriving on iOS devices since around October 3rd, even though the same alerts show up correctly in the web dashboard. Several field supervisors have missed critical equipment downtime alerts because of this.
answer: Thank you for the thorough explanation, and I understand the urgency given the field impact. This looks like it could be related to a push notification token refresh issue on iOS specifically, so I'm escalating this to our mobile engineering team to investigate the October 3rd change. In the meantime, I'd recommend having supervisors check the web dashboard directly for critical alerts, and I'll update you as soon as we have a fix timeline.

subject: Question about data retention settings for Storage
body: I'm working on a compliance review for Atlas Partners and need to confirm how long uploaded files are retained in Northwind Storage on our Starter plan before automatic deletion kicks in. We have some student records uploaded back in January that we need to confirm are still recoverable, and we'd also like to know if retention periods can be extended for specific folders rather than account-wide.
answer: Happy to clarify this for you. On the Starter plan, uploaded files are retained for 12 months by default before automatic deletion, so files from January should still be well within that window and recoverable. Per-folder retention overrides aren't currently available on Starter, but I can escalate a request to have your account reviewed for a custom retention policy if that would help with your compliance needs.

subject: Users getting logged out too frequently
body: Since last week, several of our staff at Harbor Foods have reported being logged out of Northwind roughly every 15-20 minutes, even during active use, which is disrupting daily order processing. We haven't changed any SSO configuration recently and MFA is still set up the same way it's been for months. This is happening across multiple devices and browsers for at least half of our 11 seats.
answer: Thanks for reporting this, that session length is well below what should be configured for your account. I'm reviewing your SSO session timeout settings now to see if a recent policy sync reset the value unexpectedly, and I'll get this corrected and confirm the proper timeout duration is restored. I'll follow up shortly with what we find and next steps.

subject: Help
body: We had a storage node issue overnight and I need to restore our media asset bucket 'willow-prod-media' from the last good backup taken on March 3rd around 2am. The restore job I kicked off through the console has been stuck at 'queued' for over three hours with no progress, and I can't find any documentation on expected restore times for our tier. We're a media team and editors can't pull assets right now.
answer: I've escalated this to our storage team given the stalled restore job, and I can confirm your account is currently near its restore-queue quota which may be why the job isn't progressing. We're actively working the queue and will prioritize willow-prod-media; I'll update you within the hour with a new ETA and confirm once the restore completes.

subject: SSO role mapping broken after IdP group update
body: We updated our Okta groups last night and since then several users logging in via SSO are being mapped to the wrong Northwind role. Specifically, 14 users who should get the 'Analyst' role are landing as 'Viewer' with no access to shared dashboards. The mapping rules in our SSO config still reference the old group names, but the group IDs look correct on our end.
answer: Thanks for flagging this right away — incorrect role mapping after an IdP change is something we treat as high priority. I'm escalating to our identity engineering team to review your SSO attribute mappings against the new Okta group structure, and in the meantime I'd recommend temporarily granting affected users manual role overrides so they aren't blocked. I'll follow up shortly with findings on the mapping mismatch.

subject: Recurring card decline on our billing account
body: Our primary payment card has failed three times this month during the automated billing run, most recently on the 9th with error 'do_not_honor' from the processor. We have 267 seats on this account and I'm worried about service interruption if this isn't resolved. I've already confirmed with our bank that the card is active and has sufficient funds.
answer: I'm sorry for the trouble this is causing — I've pulled up the failed transaction logs on our end and see the same decline code you mentioned. This can sometimes happen when the bank flags recurring SaaS charges as suspicious even when funds are available, so I'd suggest asking your bank to whitelist Northwind Cloud as a merchant. I've also added a temporary grace period on your account so seats won't be affected while we sort out the payment method.

subject: Question about API pagination
body: I manage the finance side of our account but I've been asked to look into an issue our small dev team raised. They've been pulling invoice and usage data through the API for reporting, and everything worked fine until last week. Now when they request page 2 or beyond of the /usage endpoint using the cursor from the previous response, they get an empty result set even though we know there's more data, since the totals count doesn't match what's returned.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. This sounds like it could be related to a recent change in how cursor tokens expire on the /usage endpoint — they're now valid for only 15 minutes, which may be shorter than your team's current polling interval. Could you confirm how long typically passes between requesting consecutive pages? In the meantime, I'd recommend fetching pages back-to-back without delay as a workaround while we confirm the root cause.

subject: Shared dashboard not visible to invited teammate
body: I shared our 'Client Renewals' dashboard with a colleague using the share link and set their permission to 'Viewer,' but they report the dashboard shows as empty with no charts loading, just a blank grid. Other dashboards I've shared with the same person work fine. This one has about 12 charts pulling from our legal case management data source.
answer: Thank you for the details — a dashboard rendering blank for one recipient while others work normally often points to a permissions mismatch on one of the underlying data sources rather than the dashboard share itself. Could you check whether all 12 charts pull from data sources your colleague also has access to individually? I'll dig into the sharing logs for 'Client Renewals' on our side in parallel and follow up with what I find.

subject: Biometric login failing intermittently on mobile app
body: Several of our staff have reported that Face ID login on the Northwind mobile app works for a few days and then suddenly stops, forcing them back to password entry. Two people also said the app crashed right after a failed biometric attempt on iOS 17.4. This is disrupting our morning check-in routine at the academy since staff use the app on shared tablets between classes.
answer: Sorry to hear this is affecting your daily routine — biometric login dropping out and the crash you're seeing on iOS 17.4 sound related to a known issue with credential caching after app backgrounding. Could you have the affected staff try removing and re-enrolling Face ID in the app's security settings, and let us know if the crash still occurs afterward? I'll also flag this to our mobile team to check crash logs from around the time this started.

subject: Users getting logged out too frequently via SSO
body: Our team members signing in through SSO are being logged out roughly every 20 minutes, which is much shorter than the session length we'd expect. This started sometime in the last couple of weeks and is only affecting SSO logins, not the handful of local accounts we still have. It's mostly annoying rather than blocking work, but it's happening to most of our analysts daily.
answer: Thanks for reporting this — a 20-minute session length for SSO users is shorter than our default and suggests the session timeout setting on your identity provider connection may have been reset or misconfigured. Could you check the session lifetime value under your SSO configuration in the admin console and let me know what it's currently set to? I'll also review the connection logs on our side to see if there were any recent config changes.

subject: Plan upgrade charged incorrectly for seat count
body: We upgraded from our previous tier to Enterprise on the 5th to accommodate our growing seat count, but the invoice generated shows a charge based on 3651 seats at the old per-seat rate rather than the new Enterprise pricing. This resulted in an overcharge of several thousand dollars on invoice #INV-88213. We need this corrected before the payment processes on the 12th.
answer: Thank you for catching this before the payment date — I can see invoice #INV-88213 was generated with the incorrect rate applied during the plan transition. I'm escalating this to our billing team right now to issue a corrected invoice reflecting Enterprise pricing and will make sure the payment scheduled for the 12th is held until the correction is confirmed. I'll follow up today with the updated invoice.

subject: Webhooks not firing for payment.updated events
body: We rely on the payment.updated webhook to sync billing status into our internal finance tool, but since around August 2nd we've stopped receiving these events entirely while other event types like invoice.created still come through fine. Our endpoint hasn't changed and is returning 200 on the events it does receive. We're only on 9 seats but this gap is causing our records to fall out of sync with actual payment statuses.
answer: Thanks for the clear breakdown — a single event type silently stopping while others work normally suggests either a filtering issue on our webhook dispatcher or the event may have been affected by a recent deprecation we're rolling out for payment-related events. I'm checking our delivery logs for your endpoint now to confirm whether payment.updated events were generated but failed to send, and I'll update you shortly with what we find and next steps.

subject: Need Jira integration link restored before demo
body: We're integrating Northwind with our internal tools ahead of a customer demo on Thursday, and the Jira integration under Integrations > Connected Apps is showing 'Link failed' whenever we try to authorize it, right after entering our Jira site URL. Slack and Salesforce connections both work fine for us, so this seems specific to Jira. We really need this working before the demo since we're showcasing ticket sync live.
answer: Given your timeline, I'm treating this as urgent and looping in our integrations engineer right now. Could you send over the exact error message or screenshot from the 'Link failed' screen along with your Jira site type (Cloud or Server)? That will help us pinpoint whether this is an OAuth scope issue on the Jira side, and we'll prioritize getting this fixed well ahead of Thursday's demo.

subject: Storage retention policy for deleted files
body: We're preparing for our annual audit and I need to confirm how Northwind Storage handles file retention after deletion. Specifically, if a staff member deletes a file from our shared drive, how long is it kept in a recoverable state before permanent purge? We're currently using about 62GB of our 100GB quota and want to document this for our records retention policy.
answer: Thanks for reaching out ahead of your audit. Deleted files in Storage are held in a recoverable state for 30 days before permanent purge, and this applies regardless of plan tier. I can send you a link to our data retention documentation that outlines this in detail and includes wording you're welcome to cite in your audit materials - let me know if that would help.

subject: URGENT - Uploads failing, quota exceeded errors blocking whole team
body: Since this morning around 9:15 AM our team has been unable to upload new media assets to Storage. We're getting 'Quota exceeded' errors even though I thought we still had headroom left. This is blocking our entire production pipeline for all 14 editors right now, nothing is syncing and render jobs are failing. We have a broadcast deadline at 3 PM today and need this resolved urgently.
answer: I'm escalating this immediately as a P1 outage. I can see your storage usage is sitting right at the plan limit, which is triggering the upload blocks - we're applying a temporary quota increase to your workspace right now so uploads can resume within the next few minutes. I'll follow up as soon as the increase is confirmed and we'll work with you afterward on longer-term capacity so this doesn't recur before future deadlines.

subject: PDF export failing on all shared dashboards
body: Our weekly board report export from Dashboards has been failing since Monday. When I click 'Export to PDF' on our energy trading dashboard, the page spins for about 30 seconds then shows 'Export failed - please try again'. This is happening on all 6 of our shared dashboards, not just one. Our board meeting is tomorrow morning and we need these reports.
answer: Thank you for the details - I understand the time pressure with your board meeting tomorrow. This is being treated as a high priority issue and I'm pulling in our dashboards engineering team to investigate the export failures right now. As a workaround in the meantime, you can export the underlying data as CSV from each dashboard's menu, which should let you assemble the report manually if the PDF export isn't fixed in time. I'll update you as soon as we have a root cause.

subject: Anfrage zu Freigabeberechtigungen für Dashboards
body: Wir verwalten mehrere Dashboard-Ordner für unterschiedliche Fakultäten und benötigen die Möglichkeit, Freigabeberechtigungen auf Ordnerebene granularer zu steuern. Aktuell können wir nur ganze Arbeitsbereiche freigeben, was bei unserer Größe zu Performance-Problemen führt, wenn Hunderte von Nutzern gleichzeitig zugreifen. Können Sie uns sagen, ob rollenbasierte Freigaben für einzelne Dashboards geplant sind?
answer: Vielen Dank für Ihre Anfrage. Aktuell unterstützen wir Freigaben auf Workspace-Ebene, granularere rollenbasierte Berechtigungen für einzelne Dashboards befinden sich jedoch bereits in der Entwicklung und sollen in einem kommenden Release verfügbar sein. Ich leite Ihr Feedback zusätzlich an unser Produktteam weiter, da es die Priorisierung dieser Funktion unterstützt, und melde mich, sobald es dazu Neuigkeiten gibt.

subject: Deactivated accounts still showing as active
body: I tried to deactivate three former employees' accounts through the Admin Console workspace settings page yesterday, but two of them still show as 'Active' in our user list today. This is a concern since they had access to internal travel booking data. Can you confirm if there's a delay in deactivation syncing, or if I need to do something else to fully revoke access?
answer: Thanks for flagging this - given the access concern, I'm treating it as a priority issue. Deactivation should take effect within a few minutes, so accounts still showing active after a full day point to a sync issue on our end rather than something you missed in the console. I'm checking the status of those two accounts directly now and will confirm once access has been fully revoked, along with what caused the delay.

subject: Incorrect seat count on March invoice
body: Could someone review our March invoice? We were charged for 8 seats but we only have 6 active users on our Starter plan - it looks like two deactivated accounts weren't removed from the seat count before billing. Could we get this corrected or refunded for the difference? Also, would it be possible to get itemized seat usage on future invoices?
answer: Thanks for catching that - I've reviewed your account and confirmed the two deactivated seats were still included in the March billing cycle. I'm issuing a credit for the difference, which should appear on your account within a few business days. I've also passed along your request for itemized seat usage on invoices to our billing product team as a feature suggestion.

subject: Scheduled sync failing with missing records
body: Our nightly scheduled sync from our accounting connector to the reporting warehouse has been failing intermittently since last Thursday. Three out of the last five runs show 'Sync completed with errors' and the row counts don't match our source data - we're missing roughly 1,200 records from Tuesday's run. This is affecting our month-end close numbers. How can I get the connector to retry or backfill the missing data?
answer: This is impacting your month-end close so we're prioritizing it right away. Could you send us the pipeline ID for the affected sync so we can pull the error logs from Tuesday's run? In the meantime, we can trigger a manual backfill for the missing 1,200 records once we identify the failure point in the connector - I'll keep you updated as we dig into the root cause.

subject: Enabling biometric login in Mobile App for field technicians
body: We'd like to enable biometric login (Face ID/fingerprint) for our field technicians using the Mobile App, but I don't see this option in the current settings menu on iOS or Android. Is this feature available on the Pro plan, and if so, where can I find setup documentation? Also want to confirm biometric login still works properly in offline mode since our technicians often work without signal in the plant.
answer: Biometric login is available on the Pro plan and can be enabled per-user under Security settings in the Mobile App, though it does require an initial online authentication before it activates. I'll send you our setup documentation with step-by-step instructions, and to confirm - once enabled, biometric login works fully offline for returning sessions, so your technicians in low-signal areas shouldn't have issues after the first sign-in.

subject: dashbord permisions broken - nobody can see Q3 dashboard
body: So weve been using Northwind Dashbords for about 8 months now accross our retail finance team and its been mostly good, we have around 40 dashboards set up for different regions and store performance metrics. we recently reorganised our teams and needed to update sharing permisions for a bunch of ppl who moved departments. Yesterday I went in to update the permisions on our Q3 Sales dashboard and now NOBODY on the team can view it, not even people who had acess before. its showing 'permission denied' for everyone including me as the owner. We have a exec review in 2 hours and need this fixed asap, this is realy urgent.
answer: I'm escalating this to our engineering team right now given the time you have before the review. It sounds like the permission update may have reset the dashboard's sharing group entirely rather than just updating the moved users, which would explain why even the owner is locked out. Please send me the dashboard ID for the Q3 Sales dashboard so we can restore access directly on our end while we investigate why the update behaved this way - I'll update you within the next 15 minutes.

subject: API-driven PDF export failing for high-volume dashboard requests
body: We're integrating the Dashboards export endpoint into our internal reporting tool and calling /v1/dashboards/{id}/export/pdf programmatically for around 300 dashboards nightly across our healthcare regions. Since yesterday, roughly 40% of these calls return a 504 timeout after 60 seconds instead of the PDF binary, even for dashboards that exported fine last week. We need this resolved quickly since our regional compliance reports are due tomorrow and depend on this export pipeline.
answer: Thank you for the detailed report and the endpoint information - given the compliance deadline, I'm escalating this to our platform team immediately. The 504s at 60 seconds suggest the export job is timing out server-side for larger or more complex dashboards, and we're checking whether a recent change affected rendering time at your volume. As a short-term mitigation, we can raise your timeout threshold and stagger the export queue on our end to reduce concurrent load - I'll confirm once that's in place and follow up with root cause findings.

subject: Recurring card failures for two seats on Starter plan
body:
We've had two seats on our Starter plan get declined on the last billing cycle (Feb 3rd) with error code card_declined_insufficient_funds. Both cards were updated by the users themselves in the billing portal but the retry still failed on Feb 5th. We're at 10 seats total and want to make sure this doesn't lock those accounts out of the academy portal.

Could you confirm if there's a manual retry we can trigger, or do we need to wait for the automatic retry cycle?
answer:
Thanks for flagging this. Failed card charges on Starter don't suspend seat access immediately, so your users should still have portal access while payment is pending. I can see the two declined transactions on your account and have queued a manual retry for both right now rather than waiting for the automatic cycle.

If either retry fails again, the cardholders will need to update payment details directly, since insufficient funds declines can't be resolved from our side. I'll follow up once the retries complete.

subject: Scheduled sync jobs failing intermittently since yesterday
body:
Our nightly sync pipeline (media-assets-daily) has failed 4 out of the last 6 runs since yesterday at 02:00 UTC. The job log shows a timeout connecting to the destination connector after roughly 90 seconds, then the run is marked failed with no retry. We have 13 seats on this workspace and three team members depend on this data being fresh by 8am for reporting.

This is affecting our morning content reports and we need to know if this is a platform-side issue or something on our connector config.
answer:
Sorry for the disruption to your morning reporting. We're seeing elevated timeout rates on the destination connector pool starting around the same window you reported, and our pipelines team is actively investigating a capacity issue there. This looks to be platform-side rather than a config problem on your end.

As a workaround, I'd suggest manually triggering the sync once connectivity stabilizes, which I'll confirm within the next hour. I'm escalating this internally and will update this ticket as soon as we have a fix or timeline.

subject: Storage quota reached during backup upload
body:
I'm integrating the Storage API to push nightly backup archives for our logistics tracking app, and today's upload to bucket apex-media-backups failed with a 507 Insufficient Storage response. We're on the Starter plan with 3 seats, and I checked the console which shows we're at 98% of our quota.

Before I request an upgrade, I wanted to check whether old backup versions older than 30 days get auto-purged, or if we need to delete them manually via the API to free up space.
answer:
Thanks for the detailed report. Starter plan storage doesn't auto-purge old objects by default, so those backup versions will keep accumulating until you delete them manually or set a lifecycle rule via the API's DELETE /objects endpoint with an age filter.

If you'd like, I can point you to our lifecycle policy documentation, or if you'd rather increase capacity instead of pruning, I can walk you through the quota upgrade path. Let me know which direction you'd prefer.

subject: Shared dashboards showing wrong permissions for entire legal team
body:
As of this morning, dashboards shared with our legal team (roughly 40 users out of our 217 seats) are showing 'view only' access even for users who were explicitly granted edit permissions last week. Several attorneys can no longer add annotations to the case-tracking dashboard, which they need for a filing deadline today.

We didn't change any sharing settings on our end. Can someone confirm if there was a permissions rollback or sync issue affecting the Pro plan dashboard sharing feature?
answer:
This is being treated as a priority issue given the deadline you mentioned. We identified a permissions sync fault that reverted some dashboard sharing roles for a subset of Pro accounts overnight, and your legal team's dashboard is affected. Our engineering team is deploying a fix to restore the correct edit permissions now.

In the meantime, as a workaround, re-inviting the affected users with edit role through the sharing panel will temporarily restore access. I'll update you the moment the permissions rollback is fully resolved.

subject: Offline mode crashes when reopening app after sync
body:
Our staff have been testing the mobile app's offline mode for expense approvals while traveling, and several reported the app crashing immediately after reconnecting to wifi and syncing pending approvals. This happened on both iOS and Android devices this week, affecting about 5 people on our finance team out of our 34 seats.

It's not blocking daily work since it only affects the offline queue, but it's frustrating for staff who lose their draft approvals. Is there documentation on how offline data is cached that I could share with our team to set expectations?
answer:
Thanks for the detailed report, and sorry for the frustration this has caused your team. We're aware of an issue where the offline sync queue can trigger a crash on reconnect if there are more than a handful of queued approvals, and it's on our list for the next mobile release.

In the meantime, I'll send over our offline mode documentation covering how data is cached locally and synced, which should help set expectations for your team. If crashes cause repeated loss of drafts, having users sync in smaller batches should reduce the frequency until the fix ships.

subject: Webhook deliveries failing after SDK deprecation notice
body:
We received a deprecation notice last month about the v1 webhook signing method, and since updating to the v2 SDK, roughly 30% of our webhook deliveries are failing signature verification with 'invalid_signature' errors. We're running this across 204 seats and multiple warehouse integrations, so this is affecting order status updates in several regional systems.

We also noticed our rate limit dropped from 500/min to 200/min after the SDK update, which is causing queuing delays. Is this expected behavior with the new SDK version, or a configuration issue?
answer:
Thanks for reporting this, and apologies for the disruption to your warehouse integrations. The signature verification failures are a known issue with the v2 SDK when the old signing secret is cached client-side, we'll send you the migration steps to refresh that secret which should resolve the invalid_signature errors.

On the rate limit, 200/min is not expected for your plan tier, that looks like a misconfiguration rather than an intentional change, and I'm escalating that piece to our platform team to restore your correct limit. I'll follow up with both fixes shortly.

subject: Need to update IP allowlist for admin console access
body:
Our office recently switched ISPs and our static IP range changed, which now blocks our finance and admin staff from logging into the Admin Console. We have 5 seats on the Starter plan and currently only one range is allowlisted, which is now outdated.

Could you help us add the new range (203.0.113.0/24) and confirm whether this change gets logged in the audit log automatically, since we'll need that for our internal compliance review?
answer:
Thanks for letting us know about the ISP change. I've added the new range 203.0.113.0/24 to your account's IP allowlist, and removed the outdated one as requested so access should be restored for your team now.

To answer your question, yes, allowlist changes are automatically recorded in the audit log with timestamp and the admin account that made the change, so you'll have that available for your compliance review.

subject: Multiple dashboard charts rendering blank across manufacturing reports
body:
Since this morning, several charts on our production-metrics dashboard are rendering completely blank, showing only the chart title with no data, axes, or legend. This is happening across at least 6 different dashboards used by our manufacturing analytics team, out of 242 seats total. Export to PDF also fails with a generic 'export error' message when we try to grab last week's report for leadership.

We rely on these dashboards daily for shift performance tracking, so this is a significant disruption. Can you also point us to documentation on the chart rendering engine in case this is a caching issue we can troubleshoot ourselves?
answer:
This is being treated as high priority given how central these dashboards are to your daily operations. We're seeing a rendering service disruption affecting chart data population and PDF export for several Pro accounts, and our engineering team is actively working on restoring it.

While that's in progress, I'll send over the chart rendering documentation you asked for, though this particular blank-chart issue is on our end rather than a local caching problem. I'll update you as soon as rendering is restored and confirm once exports are working again.

subject: Geplante Synchronisierung schlägt seit heute Nacht komplett fehl
body:
Seit der Ausführung um 01:00 Uhr heute Nacht schlagen alle geplanten Syncs unserer Pipeline media-content-sync fehl. Der Fehler lautet 'connector_auth_expired' und betrifft alle drei Connectoren, die wir eingerichtet haben. Wir haben 24 Sitzplätze im Starter-Plan und unser gesamtes Redaktionsteam kann seit heute Morgen keine aktuellen Daten mehr im Dashboard sehen.

Wir haben in den letzten Tagen keine Zugangsdaten geändert, daher ist unklar, warum die Authentifizierung plötzlich abgelaufen ist. Können Sie das bitte dringend prüfen, da unser Team komplett blockiert ist?
answer:
Vielen Dank für die schnelle Meldung, das behandeln wir mit hoher Priorität. Wir sehen auf unserer Seite ein Problem mit der Token-Erneuerung, das gestern Abend mehrere Starter-Konten betroffen und zum abrupten Ablauf der Connector-Zugangsdaten geführt hat, obwohl Sie nichts geändert haben.

Unser Team arbeitet aktuell an einer Erneuerung der betroffenen Authentifizierungs-Token für Ihre drei Connectoren. Ich melde mich, sobald die Syncs wieder erfolgreich laufen, und werde den Status hier laufend aktualisieren.

subject: Anpassung der Abmeldefunktion für E-Mail-Benachrichtigungen gewünscht
body:
Wir möchten die Unsubscribe-Funktion für unsere Benachrichtigungs-E-Mails anpassen, da uns aufgefallen ist, dass Nutzer nach dem Abmelden weiterhin doppelte System-Benachrichtigungen zu Rechnungsereignissen erhalten. Das betrifft mehrere Nutzer aus unserem Energie-Team mit insgesamt 109 Sitzplätzen im Pro-Plan.

Können wir den Abmeldeprozess so ändern, dass er auch automatisierte Rechnungsbenachrichtigungen einschließt, oder ist das aktuell technisch getrennt von den Marketing-E-Mails?
answer:
Danke für die genaue Beschreibung. Aktuell sind automatisierte Rechnungsbenachrichtigungen technisch getrennt vom allgemeinen Abmelde-Mechanismus, da sie als transaktionale E-Mails eingestuft sind, das erklärt die doppelten Zustellungen, die Sie beobachtet haben.

Wir können das für Ihr Konto anpassen, sodass Nutzer beim Abmelden auch die Option erhalten, transaktionale Rechnungshinweise zu deaktivieren. Ich lege das als Änderungsanfrage an unser Notifications-Team weiter und melde mich mit einem Zeitrahmen für die Umsetzung.

subject: Rate limit errors on webhook endpoint - need clarity on limits
body:
We're integrating the Northwind API into our energy trading dashboard and started getting 429 responses on our webhook subscription endpoint around 2:15pm today. Our SDK version is 3.2.1. The docs mention a 100 req/min limit for the /webhooks/subscribe endpoint but we're only sending about 40 req/min from our side, so I'm confused why we're being throttled.

Could you also confirm if this endpoint is being deprecated? We saw a banner in the developer portal mentioning changes coming to webhook infrastructure and want to plan our integration accordingly before we scale up to more seats.
answer:
Thanks for flagging this - a P1 for rate limiting on webhooks gets priority review. We're checking your account's request logs now; in the meantime, can you confirm the API key you're using (last 4 characters) so we can pull the exact throttling reason? It's possible burst limits differ from sustained rate limits, which could explain the discrepancy even at 40 req/min.

Regarding deprecation: yes, the current webhook subscription endpoint is scheduled for sunset in Q3, with a new batched endpoint replacing it. I'll send over the migration guide and updated SDK version that supports the new rate limit headers so you can monitor usage proactively.

subject: Seat count mismatch on our Pro invoice
body:
I'm reviewing our latest invoice and it shows billing for 171 seats, but when I check our admin console under Users, we only have 164 active accounts. We removed 7 employees last month during a restructuring and I expected the seat count to adjust automatically at the next billing cycle on the 1st.

Can someone confirm whether seat counts sync automatically or if we need to manually update them each cycle? If we were overcharged for the difference, we'd also like to request a partial refund or credit applied to next month's invoice.
answer: Thanks for catching this - seat counts don't always sync in real time with user removals, so a manual reconciliation is sometimes needed before the billing cycle closes. I've pulled up your account and confirmed the 7-seat discrepancy matches your description. I'm processing a prorated credit for the difference, which will appear on your next invoice, and I'll also flag this for our billing team to review why the automatic sync didn't trigger this time.

subject: SAML login broken for all users since this morning
body:
Starting around 9am today, none of our 250 users can log in via SSO - they're getting redirected back to the login page after authenticating with our identity provider, with no error message displayed. This is blocking our entire retail team from accessing dashboards during peak morning hours.

We haven't made any changes to our SAML configuration recently. Our IT team checked the identity provider logs and the SAML response shows a successful assertion, but Northwind seems to reject it silently. This needs urgent escalation as it's affecting all provisioned accounts across the organization.
answer: This is escalated immediately given the scope - we understand this is blocking your entire team. Our SSO engineering team is reviewing your SAML configuration logs now; initial signs point to a possible certificate rotation mismatch on our end that may have occurred overnight. We'll update you within the hour with root cause and either a fix or a temporary workaround so your team can regain access while we resolve the underlying issue.

subject: BACKUP RESTORE STUCK AT 40 PERCENT FOR 6 HOURS
body:
I INITIATED A RESTORE FROM BACKUP FOR OUR TRAVEL BOOKING DATASET YESTERDAY AT 3PM AFTER A BAD UPLOAD OVERWROTE SOME FILES. THE RESTORE PROGRESS BAR HAS BEEN STUCK AT 40 PERCENT FOR OVER 6 HOURS NOW WITH NO ERROR MESSAGE. THE BACKUP ID IS BK-88213-TRV AND IT WAS TAKEN ON THE 12TH.

THIS ISN'T BLOCKING ANYTHING URGENT SINCE WE HAVE A SECONDARY COPY BUT I WOULD LIKE TO KNOW IF THE RESTORE JOB IS ACTUALLY STILL RUNNING OR IF IT FAILED SILENTLY. OUR RETENTION POLICY IS SET TO 30 DAYS SO I WANT TO MAKE SURE THIS DOESN'T EAT INTO OUR STORAGE QUOTA UNNECESSARILY.
answer: Thanks for the details, including the backup ID - that helps us look into this quickly. Since this isn't blocking active work, we've queued it as a standard investigation; a stalled restore job like this is usually caused by a large file segment taking longer to validate rather than an actual failure, but we'll check the job logs for BK-88213-TRV to confirm it's not stuck. We'll follow up with status and, if needed, restart the job cleanly without impacting your storage quota.

subject: Slack alerts not firing from integration
body:
We set up the Slack integration for Harbor Academy about two weeks ago to send alerts to our #it-alerts channel whenever there's a system notification, but we've noticed no messages have come through since last Thursday even though we can see corresponding events in the activity log. I tested the webhook URL manually and it does post successfully when triggered directly from Slack's test tool.

This is important for us since we rely on these alerts to catch access issues quickly across our 8 accounts. Is there a known issue with the integration connector, or do we need to reauthorize the Slack workspace connection?
answer: Sorry for the disruption to your alerting - this is being treated as high priority since it affects your team's visibility into access issues. A likely cause is an expired OAuth token on the Slack connector side, which can silently stop delivery without showing an error in the activity log. Could you try disconnecting and reconnecting the Slack integration from the Integrations settings page? If that doesn't resolve it, send us the integration ID and we'll check the delivery queue directly.

subject: URGENT: IP allowlist change locked out several admins
body:
We updated our IP allowlist in the Admin Console about 30 minutes ago to add our new office range, but instead of adding it, it appears to have replaced our entire existing allowlist. Now three of our workspace admins, including myself, are locked out and getting 'Access Denied - IP not permitted' errors when trying to log in.

We have 262 seats on this account and this is affecting our ability to manage anything else in the console right now. Can someone with backend access add our IPs back or temporarily disable the allowlist enforcement while we sort this out? Audit log shows the change was made by user ID admin-4471 at 14:02 UTC.
answer: This is being escalated right now as a full lockout scenario. Our access engineering team can temporarily disable IP allowlist enforcement on your account from the backend to restore admin access immediately - we're doing that now and will confirm once it's lifted, likely within the next few minutes. Once you're back in, we recommend reviewing the allowlist edit flow together with us, since a replace-instead-of-append bug matches what you're describing and we want to fix that before you re-add your ranges.

subject: Scheduled sync frequency options
body:
I've been setting up a data pipeline to pull our ad performance data into Northwind dashboards on a scheduled sync, currently running every 6 hours. I noticed the connector only offers hourly, 6-hour, and daily options - is there any way to get a 15 or 30 minute sync interval, even on our current plan?

Also, I've noticed occasional latency where a sync marked complete doesn't actually reflect new rows in the dashboard for another 10-15 minutes. Is this expected behavior or something we should report separately?
answer: Thanks for the detailed question - shorter sync intervals like 15 or 30 minutes are currently reserved for higher-tier plans, since they require dedicated connector capacity, but I can pass along interest in making this more flexible for Starter accounts. Regarding the latency you noticed, that's expected in most cases since dashboard indexing runs slightly behind sync completion, but a consistent 10-15 minute gap is longer than typical - if you can share a specific sync job ID where you saw this, we can check whether something's queuing incorrectly.

subject: Need to true up seat count and get invoice adjusted
body:
Our team at Vertex Capital has grown and I'm trying to figure out the right process to increase our seat count from 21 to 28 on our current plan. I looked through the billing documentation but couldn't find clear steps for adding seats mid-cycle versus waiting for renewal.

Also, our last invoice still reflects the old seat count even though we added 3 people two weeks ago through the admin panel - will this be corrected retroactively, or do we need to request a refund adjustment for the difference once the new invoice is generated?
answer: Happy to help clarify this - seats added mid-cycle are typically prorated and reflected on your next invoice rather than the current one, so the 3 seats added two weeks ago should show up as a prorated charge on your upcoming billing date rather than requiring a separate refund. For the full increase to 28 seats, you can adjust this directly in the admin panel under Plan & Billing, and I'll flag your account so our billing team can double check the proration calculation lands correctly on the next cycle.

subject: Unable to unsubscribe from duplicate notification emails
body:
Several of our staff at Summit Academy are receiving duplicate copies of the same system notification emails, sometimes 3 to 4 identical emails for a single event like a password reset alert. We tried using the unsubscribe link at the bottom of the email but it just redirects to a generic settings page and doesn't seem to actually stop the duplicates.

This is generating a lot of confused support requests from our own staff and we need this fixed quickly since we're an 11-seat account and everyone is affected. Can you tell us how to properly unsubscribe or disable duplicate delivery from the notification settings?
answer: Thanks for reporting this - duplicate delivery affecting your whole team is being treated as urgent. This pattern usually points to multiple notification rules or webhook subscriptions pointing to the same event type, which would explain why the unsubscribe link doesn't fully resolve it. Can you send us the exact subject line and timestamps of one duplicated email? In the meantime, we're checking your account's notification rule configuration for duplicate triggers and will follow up with a fix or clear disable steps shortly.

subject: Data pipeline transform failures exposing partial records to wrong destination
body:
We just discovered that our nightly data pipeline transform job, which processes client case data, has been failing intermittently since Tuesday and appears to have routed a partial batch of records to an incorrect destination table that another connected workspace has read access to.
