This is a serious concern for us given the sensitivity of legal case data involved.

We need this pipeline paused immediately and need to understand the scope of what was exposed. Can someone confirm which destination the mis-routed records landed in and whether we can get an audit trail of what was read or accessed from that table since Tuesday?
answer: We're treating this as a critical security incident and have paused the affected pipeline immediately. Our security and data engineering teams are pulling the full audit trail now to identify exactly which records were routed incorrectly, the destination table involved, and any read access that occurred since Tuesday. We'll have an initial scope assessment for you within the hour and will keep you updated continuously until this is fully contained and remediated.

subject: Duplicate email digests going out every 15 minutes
body:
Since this morning our production line supervisors have been getting the same daily email digest multiple times - one team lead counted 9 copies between 6am and 8am. Digest ID pattern looks like digest-2024-manufacturing-0614 repeating with different timestamps. This is flooding inboxes for all 162 users on our shift-report distribution list and people are starting to mute the notifications entirely.

Can someone check the digest scheduler? We rely on these for shift handoffs and the noise is making them useless.
answer: Thanks for flagging this quickly - we can see elevated digest send volume on your account starting around 05:50 UTC today and it matches a known issue with a retry loop in the digest scheduler that's re-queuing jobs instead of marking them complete. We're pushing a fix to stop the duplicate sends now and will follow up within the hour with confirmation once it's suppressed on your tenant, plus details on any cleanup needed for the queued duplicates.

subject: App crashes immediately on launch for iOS users
body:
We started getting reports around 9am today that the mobile app crashes instantly on open for a chunk of our iOS users - looks like it's tied to the 4.8.2 build we saw roll out this week. Our support team has logged at least 40 tickets from customers in the last two hours, mostly on iPhone 13 and 14 devices running iOS 17.5.

Users who had the app open before the crash cycle started seem fine, but anyone force-closing or reopening hits the crash immediately. This is blocking a big chunk of our customer base from checking balances, which is a serious problem for us as a fintech product.
answer: This matches reports we're getting from a handful of other customers tied to the 4.8.2 iOS build, and our mobile team has already isolated it to a crash in the push notification registration step on cold start. We're preparing an emergency patch build now and will push it through expedited App Store review; in the meantime we recommend advising affected users to disable push notifications in device settings as a temporary workaround since that path avoids the crash. I'll update this ticket with the patch timeline as soon as I have it.

subject: Feature request: two-way field sync with Salesforce
body:
Right now our Salesforce integration only pushes contact updates one direction from Northwind into Salesforce, but we'd like changes made directly in Salesforce (like account owner or region fields) to sync back into Northwind records. We're using this alongside our Okta provisioning and Jira ticket sync, and the one-way limitation means our sales ops team has to manually reconcile records every week.

Is two-way sync on the roadmap, or is there a workaround using the API we're missing? Happy to share our field mapping if that helps.
answer: Thanks for the detailed context - two-way sync isn't currently supported out of the box, but it's a request we've heard from a few other customers running similar Salesforce plus Okta setups. I'll log this as a feature request against the Integrations roadmap and include your field mapping example if you're able to send it over. In the meantime, the closest workaround is polling the Northwind API for changed records and writing a small sync job against the Salesforce REST API, though I understand that's more overhead than you're looking for.

subject: How to map custom SAML attribute to admin role
body:
I'm setting up SSO for our Starter account and need to map a custom SAML attribute called department_role to Northwind's built-in admin and member roles. Right now everyone logging in via SSO lands as a standard member regardless of their attribute value, and I only have 6 seats to test with so I want to get the mapping right before rolling it out further.

Could you point me to documentation on the exact attribute name Northwind expects, or let me know if role mapping requires an Enterprise plan? I saw some MFA and provisioning settings in the admin console but nothing specific to role mapping rules.
answer: Role mapping via SAML attributes is available on Starter plans, so you're in the right place - the issue is likely that Northwind expects the attribute name northwind_role by default unless you've configured a custom mapping under Identity Settings > Attribute Mapping. You can point that field to your department_role attribute and define value-to-role pairs there; I'll send over the relevant doc section and a sample XML snippet so you can verify the assertion is formatted correctly before testing with your 6 users.

subject: URGENT: API pagination broken, returning duplicate and missing records
body:
As of about 20 minutes ago our production integration started pulling duplicate transaction records on every paginated call to /v2/transactions, and some pages are missing records entirely compared to what we get from the dashboard. We rely on the cursor-based next_page_token for reconciliation, and right now tokens seem to be looping back to earlier pages instead of advancing.

This is affecting all API consumers on our account, including our nightly reconciliation job which just failed with mismatched totals. Given we're a fintech handling transaction data, this is a serious issue and we need this fixed immediately - please escalate.
answer: This is escalated to our platform on-call team right now given the data integrity impact. We've identified a regression in the pagination token generation that was deployed roughly 30 minutes ago and are rolling it back immediately; we'll confirm once the rollback is confirmed and provide guidance on which page ranges may need to be re-pulled for your reconciliation job. I'll update this ticket the moment the rollback completes, expect an update within 15 minutes.

subject: App crashes on launch for a couple of our reviewers
body:
Two of our legal reviewers have reported the mobile app crashing every time they try to open it, starting sometime yesterday afternoon. Both are on Android, one running a Pixel 7 and the other a Samsung Galaxy S22, and both mentioned they'd just updated the app from the Play Store before it started happening.

We only have 4 seats on this account so it's easy to isolate, but it's blocking two of our four users from reviewing documents on the go. Can you help figure out what's different about their setup versus the rest of the team who are unaffected?
answer: Thanks for the specifics - since it's isolated to two Android devices right after an app update, this sounds like it could be a corrupted local cache from the update rather than a broader crash issue. Could you have both users try clearing the app's storage/cache from Android settings (or fully uninstalling and reinstalling) and let us know if the crash persists? If it does, please grab the crash log from one device via Settings > About > Send Diagnostic Report so we can look at the stack trace directly.

subject: Role mapping not applying correctly after SSO login for admin group
body:
We manage SSO for 2202 employees and just noticed that users in our 'IT-Admins' Azure AD group are being provisioned as standard members instead of admins after logging in through SSO. This started after we updated our group claim configuration last week to add a new MFA enforcement policy for that group.

We need documentation on how the role mapping rules interact with MFA policy changes, since it seems like updating the MFA settings may have reset or overridden the role mapping rule for that group. This is affecting IT admin access across the organization and we need a fix or clear guidance quickly.
answer: Thank you for the detailed timeline - this is a known interaction where updating MFA enforcement policies on a group can inadvertently reset custom role mapping rules tied to that same group, since both are stored under the group's policy object. I'm escalating this to our identity team to confirm whether this is expected behavior or a bug, and in the meantime I'd recommend re-applying your role mapping rule for the IT-Admins group to restore admin access, which should not require touching the MFA policy again. I'll follow up with documentation on the correct order of operations for future policy changes.

subject: Invoice shows wrong seat count and incorrect plan tier
body:
Our latest invoice dated the 3rd lists 95 seats billed at what looks like a mid-tier rate, but we only have 86 active users on our Pro plan and haven't added seats recently. I checked the admin console user list and it confirms 86, so there's a mismatch of 9 seats somewhere between what we're being billed for and actual usage.

Can someone look into invoice #INV-88214 and let us know if this is a billing system error or if we're missing something on our end? We'd like this corrected before the payment processes.
answer: Thanks for catching this before payment processed - I'm pulling up invoice #INV-88214 now to compare the billed seat count against your account's usage snapshot from that billing cycle. It's possible there were seats that were deactivated after the snapshot was taken but before the invoice generated, which can cause a temporary mismatch, but I'll confirm the exact cause and issue a corrected invoice or credit if the discrepancy is on our end. I'll have an answer for you within one business day.

subject: Connector repeatedly failing auth against our booking system
body:
Our data pipeline connector for the booking system feed has been failing authentication intermittently since last Thursday, roughly every 6 to 8 hours, requiring a manual token refresh each time. We manage a large volume of nightly sync jobs across 4562 seats and this is starting to cause noticeable latency in our finance reporting dashboards since the affected connector feeds our revenue reconciliation pipeline.

Could you help us understand why the OAuth token isn't refreshing automatically? We followed the connector setup documentation but there's no mention of expected token lifetime or refresh behavior for this connector type.
answer: Thanks for the detailed timeline - intermittent auth failures every 6-8 hours usually point to the refresh token not being renewed before the access token's short lifetime expires, which can happen if the connector's refresh job isn't triggering correctly. I'll pull the connector logs for your booking system feed to confirm the exact failure pattern, and I'll also flag to our docs team that the token lifetime and refresh behavior needs to be documented more clearly for this connector type. In the meantime, I'd suggest checking whether the refresh token scope was set correctly during initial connector setup, as that's the most common cause we see.

subject: Late-arriving data causing gaps in daily sync reports
body:
I've noticed for the past week that our daily connector sync for the ad performance data source is consistently missing the last 2-3 hours of records when the sync runs at midnight, and those records only show up in the next day's sync instead. This is throwing off our daily reporting since numbers for 'yesterday' keep changing after the fact.

Is there a way to configure the sync window or add a buffer to account for late-arriving data, or is this expected behavior for this connector? Any guidance on best practices here would help since we're still fairly new to setting up these pipelines.
answer: This is a common pattern with connectors pulling from sources that have their own processing delay, and the good news is there's a configurable option for it - under your pipeline's sync settings you can enable a 'lookback window' which re-pulls the last few hours of data on each run to catch late arrivals. For your ad performance source, I'd recommend starting with a 4-hour lookback window given what you're seeing, and I'll share our doc page on tuning lookback settings so you can adjust it further if needed.

subject: Biometric login fails to re-enroll after app update
body:
We pushed the latest Northwind Mobile App update to our 34 seats at Apex Academy last week and now several instructors report that biometric login (Face ID on iOS) no longer works. It prompts them to re-enroll, but the enrollment screen just spins and then falls back to password login. This is happening on iOS 17.4 devices specifically.

Is there a documented flow for re-enrolling biometrics after an update? We'd also like to know if this affects offline login caching, since some instructors use the app in classrooms with no signal.
answer:
Thanks for flagging this - we've seen a small number of similar reports tied to the biometric key rotation that happens after major app updates. Could you have one affected instructor try fully logging out, clearing the app's cached credentials under Settings > Security, then logging back in with password once before re-enrolling biometrics? That should reset the local key pair.

We're also updating our help center article on biometric re-enrollment and offline login behavior to cover this update path more clearly. I'll follow up once I confirm whether offline cached logins are affected on your account.

subject: Charts rendering blank on export
body:
I'm building a monthly sales dashboard for Granite Travel and the bar and line charts render fine on screen, but when I export to PNG or PDF the charts come out completely blank - just white space where the chart should be. This happens on 3 different dashboards, all created this week. Export to CSV works fine, it's only the visual chart formats.

We share these exports with store managers every Monday morning, so this is starting to slow down our reporting workflow. Can you check what's causing the blank exports?
answer:
Thanks for the detailed report. This looks like it could be related to a rendering timing issue we've tracked with charts that use custom color themes - the export snapshot sometimes fires before the chart finishes drawing. Can you confirm whether the affected dashboards use a custom theme or just the default palette?

In the meantime, try switching the export format to PDF and increasing the chart's data range slightly before exporting, which has worked around this for other customers while we investigate the root cause on our side.

subject: MFA enrolment endpoint returning inconsistent state
body:
I'm integrating Northwind Identity's MFA enrollment flow for Atlas Labs via the API and running into an odd case: when a user starts enrollment via POST /v2/mfa/enroll and abandons it partway, the /v2/mfa/status endpoint sometimes still returns "pending" and sometimes "none" for the same user depending on which region endpoint we hit. We have 23 seats provisioned and this is affecting our test accounts during SSO rollout.

Is this expected behavior, or is there a caching delay between regions? Also, is there updated documentation on the recommended retry/cleanup flow for abandoned enrollments?
answer:
Good catch, and thanks for the specifics. There is a known propagation delay of up to 60 seconds between regional read replicas for MFA status right after an enrollment is abandoned, which explains the inconsistent responses you're seeing. It should self-resolve without any action needed on your side.

We don't currently have a dedicated doc page for cleanup of abandoned enrollments, but I'll pass this along as documentation feedback - it's a fair gap to close. For now, treat "pending" as authoritative if you see mixed responses within that window.

subject: PDF export broken for all shared dashboards - urgent
body:
Since this morning, every dashboard export to PDF at Lumen Legal is failing with a generic "Export failed, please try again" message. This is affecting all 137 seats across our legal teams who rely on these exports for client reporting deadlines today. I've tried on Chrome and Firefox, cleared cache, and tested three different dashboards - all fail the same way.

We have partner review meetings starting this afternoon and need working exports. Can someone escalate this immediately? This was working fine as of yesterday around 5pm.
answer:
I'm escalating this to our platform team right now as a P1 since it's affecting export functionality across your whole organization. We're seeing a related spike in export job failures starting around 2am UTC today and are actively investigating a possible issue with our PDF rendering service.

As a temporary workaround, exporting to PNG or CSV is currently unaffected, so you can use those formats for this afternoon's meetings if needed. I'll update you within the hour with root cause status and an ETA for the PDF export fix.

subject: Workspace settings not saving - allowlist changes reverting
body:
At Harbor Foods we tried updating our IP allowlist in the Admin Console workspace settings yesterday to add our new warehouse office IP range. The change appeared to save successfully, but this morning the allowlist is back to the old values and the new office can't access the console at all. This is blocking our warehouse team from logging in this morning.

We have 11 seats total and this is affecting 4 of them right now. Is there a known issue with settings not persisting, or do we need to do something differently when saving allowlist changes?
answer:
Sorry for the disruption this is causing your warehouse team. We're treating this as a P1 since it's actively blocking logins for part of your organization. This matches a known issue where allowlist changes made via the workspace settings UI aren't always persisting correctly on save, particularly for CIDR range entries.

As an immediate step, can you try re-adding the IP range and clicking Save, then refreshing the page to confirm it shows the updated range before navigating away? While you do that, I'm also checking the audit log on our end to see exactly when the revert happened so we can prevent it going forward.

subject: Frequent SSO session timeouts
body:
I'm on the finance team at Willow Labs and over the past week I keep getting logged out of Northwind roughly every 20-25 minutes, even while actively working in the billing module. Our SSO is set up through our corporate identity provider, and I don't recall this happening before - it started around the 10th of this month. It's mildly disruptive since I have to re-authenticate with MFA each time.

Is there a session timeout setting we can adjust on our end, or is this a change on Northwind's side? Not urgent, just want to understand what changed.
answer:
Thanks for the details - this does sound like a session token lifetime change rather than anything wrong with your SSO configuration. We did adjust default session duration for some Enterprise accounts as part of a security update, which may explain the timing you noticed.

Session length is configurable at the SSO integration level, so an admin on your identity provider side can extend it under the SAML session settings. If you'd like, I can loop in your workspace admin to walk through the recommended timeout values for a team your size.

subject: Jira integration not creating linked tickets
body:
We use the Northwind-Jira integration at Lumen Travel to auto-create Jira issues from support escalations, and since last Thursday no new Jira tickets are being created even though the escalation trigger fires correctly on our side (we can see it in the integration log with status "sent"). We also have Okta and Salesforce connected but those integrations seem unaffected. Our team of 622 seats relies on this for tracking customer escalations.

Can you check if something changed on the Jira connector side? We haven't touched our Jira project config recently.
answer:
Thanks for confirming the other integrations are working - that helps narrow this down to the Jira connector specifically. We've had a report of a similar issue tied to an API token permission change on Jira's side that some customers hit after Jira's recent security update, which can cause silent failures even when our log shows "sent."

Could you check whether the Jira service account token used for this integration still has "Create Issue" permission on the target project? If it looks fine on your end, send us the escalation ID from one failed attempt and we'll trace it through our connector logs.

subject: Push notifications not arriving on Android
body:
At Quill Partners we've noticed that push notifications for new assignment alerts aren't showing up on Android devices, though iOS devices seem to get them fine. This has been going on for about a week now across our small team of 4. Notifications work when the app is open but nothing comes through when it's in the background.

Is there a setting we're missing for Android background notifications, or is this a known bug? Not blocking day to day work, just want to get this sorted.
answer:
Thanks for the report - this sounds like it could be related to Android's battery optimization settings interfering with background push delivery rather than an app bug, though we'll double check. Could you confirm whether the affected devices have battery optimization enabled for the Northwind app specifically, under Android Settings > Apps > Battery?

If disabling that doesn't resolve it, let us know the Android OS versions in use and we'll dig into our push delivery logs for your account to see if messages are being dropped before reaching the device.

subject: Biometric login crashing app for most users
body:
Since yesterday's app update, biometric login is causing the Northwind Mobile App to crash immediately for a large portion of our 262 seats at Cobalt Foods. Users tap Face ID or fingerprint login and the app closes entirely instead of authenticating. Password login still works as a fallback, but this is disrupting daily field checks for our data team.

We've confirmed this on both iOS and Android across multiple device models. Crash started right after updating to the version released yesterday. Can you escalate this - it's affecting most of our active users.
answer:
Thank you for the clear report, and I'm sorry for the disruption to your field teams. Given the scope of impact across your organization, I'm escalating this immediately as a P1. We're already investigating a crash pattern tied to yesterday's release affecting biometric authentication on multiple device types.

In the meantime, please advise your team to use password login as a fallback, which you've confirmed is stable. I'll update you as soon as we have a fix timeline or a hotfix build ready, and will prioritize getting this resolved given the number of users affected.

subject: SDK throwing intermittent 429 errors on batch calls
body:
I'm integrating the Northwind API Platform Python SDK for Delta Analytics and getting intermittent errors when submitting batch webhook registrations. About 1 in 10 calls returns this:

northwind.exceptions.RateLimitError: 429 Too Many Requests
  retry_after: 2
  endpoint: /v3/webhooks/batch

We're only sending around 15 requests per minute, well under what I'd expect the documented rate limit to be. Is there a lower limit specifically for the batch webhook endpoint, or is the SDK's retry logic not honoring retry_after correctly? Would appreciate clarification on the documented limits for this endpoint.
answer:
Thanks for including the error details - that's helpful. The /v3/webhooks/batch endpoint does have a lower per-minute limit than our general API rate limit, since each batch call is weighted by the number of webhook registrations it contains rather than counted as a single request. At 15 calls per minute with multiple registrations per call, you may be exceeding that weighted threshold.

On the SDK side, retry_after should be honored automatically in versions 2.3 and above - can you confirm which SDK version you're on? If you're on an older version, upgrading should resolve the retry handling, and I'll also get the batch endpoint's specific limits added to our rate limit documentation.

subject: Deactivated user still showing as active in Admin Console
body: I deactivated an employee's account in the Admin Console yesterday afternoon after they left Quill Works, but they still appear as an active seat and were able to log into the API dashboard this morning. This is a compliance issue for us since we only run 5 seats and need to confirm access is actually revoked. Can someone check why the deactivation isn't propagating?
answer: Thanks for flagging this right away, this is exactly the kind of thing we treat as a priority. I've escalated your account to our security team to verify whether the deactivation event is stuck in a sync queue or reverted by an allowlist rule, and we'll lock the affected user's session tokens manually in the meantime. I'll update you within a few hours with root cause and confirmation that access has been fully revoked.

subject: Zapier integration stopped sending invoice data
body: Our Zapier zap that pushes new Northwind invoices into our accounting spreadsheet has been failing since Tuesday. The Zapier task history shows a 'Northwind Cloud connection error' on every trigger attempt, even though the connection tested fine when I reauthorized it. We rely on this for our weekly finance close and now have three days of invoices missing from the sheet.
answer: Sorry for the disruption to your finance workflow. This sounds like it may be related to a token expiry on our Zapier app integration rather than your zap configuration. Could you send me the exact error message text and the timestamp of a recent failed run? In the meantime, I'd recommend disconnecting and reconnecting the Northwind trigger step in Zapier, which often resolves stale-token issues.

subject: Mobile app crashes immediately when opening in offline mode
body: Since updating the Northwind mobile app on Monday, it crashes within a second of opening whenever I'm offline, which happens often since I do fieldwork with limited signal. It worked fine in offline mode two weeks ago. This is blocking my whole team's ability to review dashboards on-site, we have 18 seats and everyone on iOS is affected the same way.
answer: Thank you for the detailed report, and I'm sorry this is blocking your fieldwork. A crash affecting offline mode for your whole team is a high priority for us, so I'm escalating this to mobile engineering right now. Could you confirm your app version and iOS version, and whether you see any crash log pop-up? We'll get a fix or workaround to you as quickly as possible and keep you posted throughout.

subject: API-Schlüssel Rate-Limit-Fehler nach Webhook-Update
body: Wir verwenden mehrere API-Schlüssel für unsere Integrationen und seit dem letzten Webhook-Update erhalten wir gelegentlich 429-Fehler, obwohl unser Traffic sich nicht verändert hat. Zusätzlich taucht in der Dokumentation ein Hinweis auf, dass ein alter Endpunkt bald abgeschaltet wird, aber wir finden keine klare Migrationsanleitung. Können Sie uns sagen, ob unsere aktuellen Schlüssel von der Deprecation betroffen sind?
answer: Vielen Dank für die genaue Beschreibung. Die 429-Fehler könnten mit einer Anpassung der Rate-Limit-Berechnung beim letzten Webhook-Release zusammenhängen, wir prüfen das für Ihr Konto. Zur Deprecation: Ich sende Ihnen den Migrationsleitfaden für den betroffenen Endpunkt sowie eine Liste Ihrer aktiven API-Schlüssel, damit Sie sehen können, welche davon aktualisiert werden müssen.

subject: Scheduled data pipeline syncs running hours late
body: Our nightly scheduled syncs from the legal case management connector have been running 3 to 4 hours late since last Thursday, and yesterday's sync didn't complete until 11am instead of the usual 3am. We have 279 seats depending on this data being fresh for morning reporting, and the delay is now affecting data quality checks downstream. Pipeline ID is lp-27741 if that helps locate it.
answer: Thank you for including the pipeline ID, that will help us investigate quickly. We're seeing elevated latency on that connector cluster and are looking into whether a queuing backlog or upstream throttling is the cause. I've flagged this to our data pipeline team for immediate review given the impact on your reporting schedule, and I'll follow up with findings and an ETA for resolution as soon as I have them.

subject: Request to change how alert routing handles duplicate notifications
body: We'd like to change our alert routing setup so that duplicate notifications for the same event aren't sent to both email and Slack channels simultaneously. Right now our team gets double alerts for every billing anomaly, which is causing people to ignore them. Is there a way to configure routing rules so email only fires if Slack delivery fails?
answer: That's a great use case and one we hear often. Currently there isn't a built-in failover rule between channels, but you can set channel priority so only one delivers per event type under Notification Settings > Routing Rules. I'll also pass your fallback-on-failure idea to our product team as a feature request, since it would be a useful addition for teams managing multiple channels.

subject: Workspace settings reverted after recent update
body: After the platform update last week, several of our workspace settings in the Admin Console reset to default, including our custom session timeout and the allowlisted IP range we had configured for compliance. We have 273 seats across departments and need these settings restored, since our security team relies on the IP restriction for HIPAA-related access controls.
answer: Thank you for reporting this, and I understand the urgency given your compliance requirements. This looks like a settings rollback tied to the recent update rather than something you changed. I'm restoring your prior session timeout and IP allowlist configuration now and will confirm once it's back in place, along with a note on what caused the reset so we can prevent it going forward.

subject: Request to add new IP ranges to allowlist
body: We're expanding our office network and need to add two new IP ranges to our Admin Console allowlist for API and dashboard access. Could you confirm the process for adding these ourselves, or if it requires Northwind support to make the change? We'd also like to know if allowlist changes are recorded in the audit log automatically.
answer: You can add new IP ranges yourself under Admin Console > Security > Allowlist, no support ticket needed for that part. Every addition, edit, or removal is automatically recorded in the audit log with the admin's name and timestamp, so you'll have full visibility into the change history. Let me know if you'd like a walkthrough of the audit log filters for compliance reporting.

subject: Please add biometric login support for mobile app
body: Our team has been asking for Face ID or fingerprint login on the Northwind mobile app instead of entering our password every time, especially since several of us work offline in the field and re-authentication after connectivity drops is a hassle. We currently have 22 seats using the app daily. Is biometric login on the roadmap, and if so is there a timeline?
answer: Thanks for the request, biometric login is something we know matters for field teams re-authenticating after offline periods. It's currently being evaluated by our mobile product team, and I'm logging your account's interest along with the offline reconnection use case to help prioritize it. I don't have a committed release date yet, but I'll update this ticket as soon as there's a timeline to share.

subject: Mobile app unusable offline, crashes on login screen
body: Our entire manufacturing floor team relies on the Northwind mobile app offline, but since this week's update the app crashes immediately at the login screen when there's no connectivity. Push notifications also aren't coming through once devices reconnect. All 20 of our seats are affected and staff can't access anything on-site right now, this is stopping our shift handoffs.
answer: I'm very sorry for the impact this is having on your shift operations, this is a critical issue and I'm escalating it immediately to our mobile engineering team as a top priority. We're investigating the login crash tied to offline mode from the recent update and will also look into the push notification delay. I'll update you as soon as we have a fix or workaround, and will keep this ticket open until your team is fully operational again.

subject: Connector auth failing on production pipeline - HealthSync-01
body: Our HealthSync-01 connector to the EHR system started failing auth at 03:12 UTC today. The pipeline had been running fine for weeks, but now every sync attempt returns a 401 even though we haven't rotated the API key. We've retried the OAuth handshake three times and refreshed the token manually, same result. This is blocking patient record ingestion for our Pro workspace and downstream latency is now over 6 hours.
answer: Thanks for flagging this right away - I understand the impact on your ingestion pipeline. Can you confirm the connector ID and share the exact error payload from the last failed sync attempt? In the meantime we're checking whether there was a recent change to the OAuth scope requirements on our connector service, since a 401 with a previously valid token often points there. I'll follow up within the hour with findings.

subject: Dashboard sharing permissions not saving for viewer role
body: I'm trying to share our Q3 Production Metrics dashboard with two colleagues set to viewer-only access, but every time I save the sharing settings, it reverts to editor access for both of them. This has happened three times now with the same dashboard. Chart load times on that dashboard have also been noticeably slower this week, around 8-10 seconds per widget.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. We've seen a related issue where the sharing role selector doesn't persist correctly after a recent update, and I'll get this logged as a bug against the dashboard permissions module. Since this is a single-dashboard issue rather than account-wide, could you send the dashboard ID so we can reproduce it directly and also check the chart performance in parallel?

subject: Retention policy question and backup log errors
body:
We're reviewing our storage retention settings for compliance and ran into errors when trying to confirm our backup schedule. Here's what we got when checking backup status via the admin console:

[2024-03-11 09:44:12] ERROR: BackupJob#4471 failed - retention_policy_id not found
[2024-03-11 09:44:12] WARN: falling back to default 30-day retention
[2024-03-11 09:44:13] ERROR: BackupJob#4472 failed - retention_policy_id not found
[2024-03-11 09:44:13] INFO: retry scheduled in 15m

We need to know if our documents that should be under a 7-year retention policy are actually being purged after 30 days by mistake. Please advise urgently as this affects student records.
answer: This is a serious concern and I want to get you an accurate answer quickly. The error suggests your custom retention policy ID got disconnected from the backup job configuration, which would explain the fallback to the 30-day default. We're pulling your account's backup job history now to confirm whether any records were actually purged early, and I'll escalate to our compliance engineering team in parallel. I'll update you within the next few hours with findings and a fix timeline.

subject: Slack alert integration not posting for Jira-linked incidents
body: We configured the Slack integration to post alerts into our #it-ops channel whenever a Jira ticket tagged 'incident' is created, but nothing has posted since March 5th. Our Okta and Salesforce integrations in the same admin panel still show as connected and healthy. I checked the Slack app permissions and they look unchanged. Can you check if something broke on your end with the Jira-to-Slack bridge specifically?
answer: Thanks for the clear breakdown - that helps narrow it down. Since Okta and Salesforce integrations are unaffected, this does look isolated to the Jira-Slack alert bridge. Could you confirm the webhook URL configured in your integration settings still matches the one in Slack's app management page? We had a token refresh cycle run recently that occasionally requires re-authorizing individual bridges, and I'll check our integration logs for your workspace to see if that's what happened here.

subject: Dringende Anfrage: Aufbewahrungsfristen für Speicher anpassen
body: Wir benötigen für unsere Kanzlei eine Anpassung der Aufbewahrungsrichtlinien im Storage-Produkt. Aktuell werden Dokumente nach 90 Tagen automatisch gelöscht, wir brauchen aber für bestimmte Mandantenordner eine Frist von mindestens 10 Jahren aus rechtlichen Gründen. Das betrifft mehrere Teams und wir müssen das noch diese Woche umsetzen, da sonst wichtige Unterlagen verloren gehen könnten.
answer: Vielen Dank für die Meldung, das verstehen wir als dringend. Individuelle Aufbewahrungsfristen pro Ordner sind aktuell als Feature-Anfrage bei unserem Produktteam gelistet, aber wir können kurzfristig eine Ausnahmeregel für Ihre Mandantenordner konfigurieren, bis die Funktion allgemein verfügbar ist. Können Sie uns die betroffenen Ordner-IDs und die gewünschte Frist mitteilen, damit wir das noch diese Woche umsetzen können?

subject: URGENT: Users being logged out every 2 minutes company-wide - SSO broken
body: Starting about 40 minutes ago, all users across our organization are being force-logged-out roughly every 2 minutes, regardless of device or location. This is affecting our entire workforce across every region and is currently blocking access to critical systems during a live incident response. Our SSO session timeout is configured for 8 hours, not 2 minutes, and MFA re-prompts are now happening constantly too. This needs immediate attention - we suspect either a config rollback or a security issue on your end.
answer: We're treating this as our highest priority right now and have escalated to the identity platform on-call team immediately. This pattern of forced re-authentication across an entire org can indicate a session token validation issue on our side, and we're checking recent SSO configuration deployments for your tenant right now. I will update you within 15 minutes with status, and please let us know immediately if you see any signs of unauthorized access attempts during this window.

subject: Request to change scheduled sync time for finance pipeline
body: Our finance data pipeline currently runs its scheduled sync every night at 1:00 AM UTC, but we'd like to move it to 5:00 AM UTC to better align with our upstream ERP export schedule, which now finishes closer to 4:30 AM. Could you help us update this connector schedule, or point me to where in the settings I can adjust it myself? We want to avoid pulling incomplete data like we did on March 2nd.
answer: Happy to help with this. You can update the sync schedule yourself under Pipeline Settings > Schedule for the connector in question - just adjust the cron trigger time there and it takes effect on the next run cycle. If you'd rather we make the change directly to avoid any risk of misconfiguration, send us the pipeline ID and exact desired UTC time and we'll update it for you today.

subject: Salesforce sync showing stale records for two weeks
body: We noticed our Salesforce integration hasn't synced new opportunity records since around February 26th, even though the integration status shows 'connected' with no errors. Our team relies on this for weekly reporting, and right now we're seeing data that's clearly two weeks old. Jira and Slack integrations on the same admin panel appear to be syncing normally.
answer: Thanks for reporting this - a silent sync stall while status shows connected is a known pattern we want to look into. Could you confirm the last successful sync timestamp shown in your integration logs and roughly how many opportunity records are missing? We'll check the sync queue for your workspace to see if records are stuck rather than failing outright.

subject: Wiederholte Transform-Fehler in Datenpipeline blockieren Reporting
body: Seit letzter Woche schlagen mehrere Transform-Schritte in unserer Pipeline für Transaktionsdaten fehl, besonders bei der Feldbereinigung für Beträge in Fremdwährung. Die Fehlermeldung lautet meist 'invalid numeric format' obwohl die Quelldaten unverändert sind. Das blockiert unser wöchentliches Reporting an Compliance und wir bräuchten idealerweise eine Möglichkeit, fehlerhafte Datensätze automatisch zu isolieren statt die ganze Pipeline zu stoppen.
answer: Danke für die ausführliche Beschreibung. Der Fehler 'invalid numeric format' bei Fremdwährungsfeldern deutet oft auf ein Locale- oder Trennzeichen-Problem in den Quelldaten hin, auch wenn diese unverändert wirken - wir prüfen das für Ihre Pipeline genauer. Die gewünschte Funktion zum automatischen Isolieren fehlerhafter Datensätze statt Pipeline-Stopp geben wir als Feature-Wunsch an unser Produktteam weiter, da das aktuell noch nicht unterstützt wird.

subject: Feature request: fix duplicate entries in email digest notifications
body: Our finance team receives daily email digests summarizing invoice and payment notifications, but for the past week many entries are showing up duplicated two or three times within the same digest email. This is causing confusion when reconciling against actual transaction counts. We'd also like the option to customize which notification categories appear in the digest, since right now it includes several categories we don't need for finance reporting.
answer: Thanks for reporting the duplication issue - that's a bug on our end in how the digest aggregation window is deduplicating entries, and I'm logging it as high priority given it affects reconciliation accuracy. We'll investigate the specific overlap window causing repeats and follow up with a fix timeline. On the customization request, that's a great idea and I'll pass it to our product team as a feature request for category filtering in digest settings.

subject: Need to restore storage bucket from backup after accidental deletion
body: One of our operations team members accidentally deleted the 'travel-docs-2024' bucket this morning around 9:15 AM. We need to restore it from backup as it contained itinerary PDFs for active bookings. Can you tell me which retention window applies to our Starter plan and how far back we can restore? We're at 8 seats and I don't see a self-service restore option in the console.
answer: Thanks for flagging this quickly. On the Starter plan, backups are retained for 7 days, so we can still recover the bucket from this morning's snapshot. I'm initiating a restore now to a new bucket named 'travel-docs-2024-restored' so we don't overwrite anything, and I'll confirm once it's complete, typically within 30-60 minutes. In the meantime, I'd recommend reviewing our documentation on upload quotas so this bucket doesn't hit the storage cap again once restored.

subject: URGENT - cannot deactivate terminated employee, active session still open
body: We terminated an employee this morning and I need their account deactivated immediately in the Admin Console. When I click deactivate on their profile it spins and then throws 'Error: unable to update user state - conflict'. Their session is still showing as active in the audit log and they had access to patient billing records. This is a potential breach situation and I need this locked down now.
answer: This is being treated as a priority security incident. I'm force-terminating this user's active sessions and revoking their API tokens on our end right now while we resolve the deactivation error - you should see their access cut within the next few minutes regardless of the console error. I'll follow up within the hour with root cause on the 'conflict' error and confirmation that the audit log correctly reflects the deactivation, and I'm escalating this to our security team given the patient data exposure concern.

subject: Connector auth token expiring faster than documented
body: I'm integrating our Salesforce connector into a Data Pipeline job and noticed the OAuth token seems to expire every 45 minutes instead of the 24 hours mentioned in the docs. This is causing sync failures mid-run when processing our larger datasets (around 40k records). Is there a setting to extend token lifetime, or is this a known issue with the connector's refresh logic?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. This does look like a discrepancy - the 24 hour token lifetime is correct for most connectors, but the Salesforce connector has a separate refresh mechanism that can misfire under high load, which matches what you're seeing with the larger sync runs. I'll get our pipelines team to check the refresh logic and confirm whether this is affecting other customers, and I'll update you here once we have more detail on a fix or workaround.

subject: Best practice for bulk deactivating users after re-org
body: We're going through a department restructuring and need to deactivate around 40 users across two departments. I want to make sure we're doing this in a way that preserves audit log history and doesn't affect our IP allowlist settings tied to those accounts. Is there a bulk deactivation option, or do we need to go one by one through the console?
answer: Good question, and glad you're checking before making the change. Yes, there's a bulk deactivation option under Admin Console > User Management > Bulk Actions, where you can upload a CSV of user IDs - this preserves full audit log history for each deactivated account. Allowlist entries are tied to IP ranges rather than individual users, so deactivating these accounts won't affect your existing allowlist configuration.

subject: Need corrected invoices reflecting current seat count
body: Our last two invoices (dated March 1 and April 1) both show billing for 75 seats, but we reduced our team to 68 seats back in February after a contract renewal. Our finance team is asking for corrected invoices before they'll process payment. Can you also point me to documentation on how seat count changes get reflected in billing cycles, since this has caused confusion twice now?
answer: Apologies for the discrepancy and the impact on your payment processing - I understand this needs to be resolved quickly on your end. I'm pulling up your account now to confirm the February seat reduction and will issue corrected invoices for both March and April reflecting 68 seats, along with a credit or refund for the overage already billed. I'll also send over our billing documentation that explains how mid-cycle seat changes are prorated so this is clearer going forward.

subject: Push notifications not arriving when app is backgrounded
body: We're seeing an issue where push notifications for shipment status updates aren't arriving on iOS when the app has been in the background for more than a few minutes. Testers on our freight team have reported this across three different devices over the past week. Notifications work fine when the app is open. No crashes, just missing pushes - wondering if this is a known limitation or a bug on our end.
answer: Thanks for the clear writeup. This isn't expected behavior - background push delivery should work regardless of how long the app has been backgrounded, so this sounds like a bug rather than a limitation. Could you send us the device OS versions and app build number your testers are using? That'll help us reproduce it, and in the meantime it'd help to confirm notification permissions are still granted after backgrounding, since iOS occasionally revokes them silently on certain OS versions.

subject: Slack integration not posting alerts for critical Salesforce events
body: Our Slack integration stopped posting alerts for Salesforce opportunity changes as of yesterday around 3 PM. This is affecting our entire sales operations team who rely on these real-time alerts for deal tracking - we have over 2500 seats and this is a widely used workflow. The integration shows as 'connected' in settings but nothing is coming through to the #sales-alerts channel. No error messages visible anywhere.
answer: This is a significant disruption and we're prioritizing it now. Since the integration shows as connected but nothing is posting, this points to either a webhook delivery failure on our end or a silent permission change on the Slack app - I'm checking our integration logs for your workspace now to identify where the break is happening. I'll update you within the next couple of hours with findings, and if it's on our side we'll expedite a fix given the scale of teams affected.

subject: Late data question
body:
We've been running our energy consumption pipelines for about six months now with several connectors feeding hourly usage data from different regional meters. Overall the setup has worked well and we haven't had major complaints from the analytics team who consume this data downstream for reporting.

The actual issue is that data from our west region connector is consistently arriving 3-4 hours late compared to the other regions, which is causing our downstream sync jobs to run on incomplete datasets. Is there a way to configure the pipeline to wait for late-arriving data before triggering downstream syncs, or a way to flag and backfill these late records automatically?
answer: Thanks for the context - this is a common pattern with regional connector variance. Yes, you can configure a 'late arrival window' on the pipeline settings for that connector, which delays the downstream sync trigger until either the data arrives or the window expires (we'd suggest starting with a 5 hour buffer given your 3-4 hour lag). For the backfill piece, enabling the 'reconciliation pass' option will automatically detect and merge late records into already-completed sync runs, so you shouldn't need to manually rerun anything.

subject: PDF export broken - charts render blank in exported file
body: When exporting our logistics dashboard to PDF via the API endpoint /v1/dashboards/export, the resulting PDF has all chart widgets rendering as blank white boxes while table widgets export fine. This started happening after our last dashboard update on the 12th. We're at 1194 seats and this is used heavily for weekly ops reports that go out to leadership - export used to work correctly before that update. Sharing links to the dashboard still show charts fine in-browser.
answer: Thanks for pinpointing the timing - that's very helpful. This matches a rendering bug we're tracking related to how chart widgets get rasterized during PDF export after the recent dashboard engine update; browser rendering uses a different pipeline which is why it's unaffected. I'm escalating this as high priority given your leadership reporting dependency, and I'll follow up with either a hotfix timeline or a workaround (such as exporting charts as images separately) within the next few hours.

subject: Scheduled sync running twice on Tuesdays
body: I've noticed our scheduled data pipeline sync for our energy metering connector runs twice every Tuesday - once at the scheduled 6 AM time and again around 6:45 AM unprompted. This is creating duplicate records in our downstream table that we've had to manually deduplicate twice now. Other days of the week the sync runs fine, just once as scheduled. Any idea what's causing the Tuesday duplication?
answer: Thanks for narrowing this down to Tuesdays specifically, that's a useful clue. This could be related to a scheduling conflict if there's an overlapping job or a daylight-saving/timezone edge case affecting just that day's trigger - I'll check the scheduler logs for your workspace around both Tuesday timestamps to see what's firing the second run. I'll follow up with findings and, if needed, help you set up a dedup safeguard on the pipeline output in the meantime.

subject: Dashboard sharing permissions not respecting group roles
body:
We're rolling out a new finance dashboard to our regional managers and need to restrict edit access to just our ops team while allowing view-only for the rest. Right now when I set a viewer role on a shared dashboard, users can still export the underlying chart data via the CSV export button, which bypasses the permission entirely. We have 231 seats on this workspace and this is blocking our compliance sign-off for the rollout scheduled this week.

Could you confirm whether export permissions are meant to inherit from dashboard sharing roles, and if there's a way to lock this down today?
answer: Thanks for flagging this — you're right that export actions should inherit the same role restrictions as dashboard viewing, and it sounds like that inheritance is breaking for CSV exports specifically. I've escalated this to our dashboards engineering team as a priority bug given it affects your compliance rollout. In the meantime, as a workaround you can disable the export button at the dashboard level under Settings > Sharing > Export Controls, which will block it for all viewers until the permission bug is fixed. I'll update you within one business day with a timeline.

subject: Storage quota reached, backups failing
body:
Our workspace hit its storage quota yesterday and now our nightly backup job for media assets is failing with a quota exceeded error. We only have 8 seats on the Starter plan but our video review files are larger than expected this month. This is blocking our team from uploading new client review cuts, and the backup gap means we're at risk of losing yesterday's work if something happens today.

Can you help us either temporarily raise the quota or clear some space so backups resume tonight?
answer: Sorry for the disruption — I can see your workspace is at 100% of its Starter storage allocation, which is why both new uploads and the backup job are being rejected. I've applied a temporary 20GB buffer to your account so backups can run tonight while we sort out a longer-term plan. I'd also recommend reviewing your storage usage under Settings > Storage to identify older assets you can archive, and I can walk you through upgrading your plan if you expect this volume to continue.

subject: Users can't unsubscribe from duplicate alert emails
body:
Several of our workspace members are reporting they get the same alert email twice, and clicking unsubscribe doesn't stop it. Here's what one user got in their inbox headers:

X-Northwind-Alert-ID: alrt_88213
X-Northwind-Alert-ID: alrt_88213
Delivery-Attempt: 1 of 1
Unsubscribe-Status: processed

Despite the unsubscribe status showing processed, the same alert ID fired again this morning at 6:02am and 6:04am, two minutes apart. We've had five people escalate this to me in the last two days and it's starting to look bad since these are client-facing notifications.
answer: Thank you for including those headers, that's very helpful. It looks like the duplicate delivery is happening because the alert is being queued twice before the unsubscribe flag propagates, so the second send slips through. I've opened an internal ticket to trace alert alrt_88213 and check whether this is affecting other alert types in your workspace. In the meantime, could you send me the exact email addresses experiencing this so I can manually confirm their unsubscribe status is locked while we investigate?

subject: Push notifications not delivering when app is backgrounded
body:
We've noticed our mobile users aren't receiving push notifications for new document assignments when the app has been in the background for more than a few minutes. This is a big deal for our legal team since assignments are time-sensitive. We're on 66 seats and this affects both iOS and Android as far as we can tell.

Could your team confirm whether there's a known issue with background push delivery, and if there's a setting we're missing on our end to keep the notification service alive?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. We have seen intermittent background delivery delays on Android tied to aggressive battery optimization settings on certain device models, but iOS delivery should not be affected in the same way, so I want to dig deeper into your case specifically. Could you send me the app version and a couple of device models/OS versions where this is happening? I'll get our mobile team to check the push delivery logs for your workspace over the past week.

subject: Duplicate alert emails going out for same event
body:
Since yesterday morning we've had multiple support tickets from our own customers about receiving the same booking confirmation alert twice within a minute of each other. I checked our notification settings and nothing changed on our end recently. We're a small team on 16 seats so this is generating a lot of confused replies we have to manually clean up.

Can someone check if there's a known issue with alert deduplication right now, and do you have documentation on how the dedupe window is supposed to work so we can explain this to our customers in the meantime?
answer: Sorry for the trouble this is causing with your customers. We're aware of a dedupe window issue affecting some notification workspaces since yesterday and our team is actively working on a fix. I'll link our documentation on how the alert dedupe window normally operates so you have something to reference, and I'll notify you as soon as this is resolved — expecting that within the next business day. In the meantime, if you can share one or two affected alert timestamps, I can confirm they match the known pattern.

subject: Some charts rendering blank in shared dashboards
body:
Not urgent, but wanted to flag that a handful of our shared dashboards show blank chart panels for viewers, even though the same dashboard renders fine for the owner. It seems to happen mostly on charts with larger date ranges, maybe a performance timeout on render? We have 237 seats and use dashboard sharing heavily across our travel ops teams, so it'd be good to understand if this is a known limitation.

Also, is there documentation on export limits for large charts? We'd like to plan around it if there's a hard cutoff.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report, and good catch on the correlation with larger date ranges — that lines up with a known rendering timeout for viewers when a chart query exceeds a certain complexity threshold, which we're tracking as a low-priority performance issue. I'll send over our documentation on export and render limits for large charts so your team can plan accordingly. If you can share one or two dashboard names where this happens, I'll add them to the investigation for extra data points.

subject: Mobile app crashes immediately on launch after update
body: After the latest app update our team can no longer open the mobile app at all, it crashes within a second of tapping the icon. This started this morning across at least three of our devices. We only have 8 seats so it's a small team but it's blocking everyone from checking expense approvals while traveling. We need this fixed or a way to roll back to the previous version.
answer: I'm sorry for the disruption this is causing your team. Crashes immediately on launch after an update are usually tied to a corrupted local cache from the migration — could you try fully uninstalling and reinstalling the app on one device to confirm that resolves it? While you test that, I'm pulling crash logs tied to your workspace to see if this matches a broader issue we should escalate, and I'll follow up today with next steps or a rollback option if the reinstall doesn't help.

subject: Upload failures for large files since this morning
body:
Starting around 9am today our team started getting upload failed errors when trying to store files larger than 500MB, which we do regularly for our destination media library. Smaller files under that size seem to upload fine. We're on 30 seats and this is stopping three of our content editors from finishing today's uploads ahead of a campaign launch tomorrow.

Is this a known issue with large file handling, and do you have any guidance on retention settings we should check in case that's related?
answer: Thanks for the clear breakdown of the file size threshold, that's very useful. This does match a known issue affecting uploads over 500MB since this morning, related to a storage gateway change — our team is actively working on it and I expect a fix within a few hours. In the meantime, if it's urgent for tomorrow's launch, you can split the files into smaller chunks under 500MB as a temporary workaround. I'll update you as soon as this is resolved and will also check your retention settings aren't contributing to the issue.

subject: How to stop duplicate alert emails for same transaction
body: We've noticed our accounting team occasionally gets two identical alert emails for the same transaction flag, a few minutes apart. It's not blocking anything critical but it's confusing for our small team since we only have 5 seats. Is there a setting we can adjust ourselves, or documentation on how the alert deduplication window works so we can understand why this happens?
answer: Thanks for reaching out — this is a good question and not something urgent, so let's get you the right documentation. There's a dedupe window setting under Notification Settings > Alerting that controls how long the system waits before treating two similar alerts as duplicates versus separate events; a short gap between transactions can sometimes fall just outside that window. I'll send over our how-to guide on configuring this, and happy to help you tune the window if the current setting doesn't fit your transaction volume.

subject: SDK throwing deprecated method errors after recent update
body: After updating to the latest version of the API SDK, we're seeing repeated warnings in our logs about deprecated methods, specifically around webhook registration and rate limit handling. We have 246 seats and rely heavily on webhooks for our billing reconciliation flow, so we want to make sure we migrate before anything actually breaks. Is there a migration guide for the new webhook registration methods, and can you clarify the new rate limit thresholds since the docs still reference the old numbers?
answer: Thanks for getting ahead of this before it becomes a problem. The deprecation warnings you're seeing are expected as part of our SDK v3 migration — the old webhook registration methods will be fully removed in a few months, and I'll send you our updated migration guide covering the new registration flow. On rate limits, the documentation is indeed outdated; the new default is 600 requests/minute per API key with burst allowance, and I'll flag the docs discrepancy internally so it gets corrected. Let me know if you'd like a walkthrough of the webhook migration for your billing reconciliation flow specifically.

subject: Deprecation warning on API key rotation endpoint
body: We just noticed that our nightly key rotation job for the booking-sync integration is returning a deprecation header pointing to /v3/keys/rotate instead of the /v2/keys/rotate endpoint we've used for two years. The SDK version we're on (northwind-sdk 4.1.2) doesn't seem to support the new endpoint yet. Can you confirm the sunset date for v2 and whether an updated SDK is coming, since our webhook listeners also depend on the same key set for signature validation.
answer: Thanks for flagging this early. The v2 key rotation endpoint is scheduled to sunset on the 30th of next month, and SDK 4.2.0 with full v3 support ships this week - I'll email you the changelog link once it's live. In the meantime your webhook signature validation isn't affected, since the signing secret format is unchanged between v2 and v3.

subject: Push notifications not arriving on Android after SDK update
body: After updating to the latest Mobile SDK build, none of our Android test devices are receiving push notifications for order status changes. iOS devices are fine. We're calling the /v1/push/register endpoint successfully and getting a 200 with a token back, but nothing shows up on the device even after 20+ minutes. This started on the 14th, right after we integrated the new feedback-loop callback for delivery receipts.
answer: Sorry for the disruption - this looks related to a known issue with the delivery receipt callback on Android in the latest SDK build. Could you send us the FCM sender ID and one of the registration tokens that isn't receiving pushes? While we investigate, you can temporarily disable the feedback-loop callback, which should restore normal delivery for Android devices.

subject: SDK throwing rate limit errors far below documented threshold
body: Our workspace is seeing repeated 429 errors from the Python SDK (northwind-sdk-py 6.3.0) well before we hit the documented 5000 req/min limit for Enterprise tier. Logs show we're capping out around 1800 requests per minute across our three service accounts before the SDK starts throwing RateLimitExceeded. This is affecting our webhook retry logic and causing duplicate event processing downstream. Given our scale, we need this escalated - this is impacting production traffic for over 3000 users.
answer: I've escalated this to our platform engineering team given the scale impact you're describing. This pattern matches a bug we're tracking where rate limit counters aren't being properly partitioned across service accounts on Enterprise workspaces, causing premature throttling. We'll update you within a few hours with either a fix timeline or a temporary workaround for your webhook retry logic.

subject: Offline mode causing app crashes for clinical staff
body: We're getting reports from multiple clinics that the mobile app crashes when switching from offline to online mode after syncing patient intake forms. It happens consistently when there are more than 15 queued records waiting to sync. Staff are losing unsaved form data when this happens, which is a serious issue given our healthcare workflows. This has been going on since Monday and is now affecting several of our largest sites - we need to escalate this internally as well.
answer: Thank you for escalating this - crashes involving unsaved patient data are being treated as high priority on our end. We're pulling crash logs now to confirm the sync queue threshold issue you described. Can you send us the app version and device models from at least two affected clinics so we can reproduce the offline-to-online transition crash directly?

subject: URGENT: Storage quota breach exposing files across tenants
body: We just discovered that after hitting our storage quota this morning, new uploads from our tenant are being written into what appears to be another customer's bucket path - we can see filenames that don't belong to us in our upload confirmation responses. This started around 09:40 UTC today. We've paused all uploads on our end but need immediate confirmation this isn't a cross-tenant data exposure issue, given we're a legal services company with strict retention and confidentiality obligations.
answer: We understand the severity of this and have already opened a P0 security investigation. Please continue holding all uploads on your side - we're isolating the storage quota-handling code path right now and will confirm within the hour whether any cross-tenant exposure occurred. A member of our security team will follow up directly with findings and next steps for your compliance team.

subject: Push tokens invalid after login flow update
body: We recently updated our login flow to use refresh tokens, and now push notifications are failing for any user who re-authenticates. The registration call after login returns success, but our crash reporting shows InvalidDeviceToken errors when we try to send a test push a few minutes later. This is happening on both iOS and Android and is affecting new logins starting from this past weekend.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. This sounds like the device token isn't being refreshed correctly after your new login flow re-authenticates the session - the old token may still be cached client-side even though registration reports success. Could you check whether you're calling the push registration endpoint before or after the refresh token exchange completes? That ordering matters and is a common cause of this exact symptom.

subject: Need webhook retry and rate limit increase before outage repeat
body: During a partial outage last Tuesday, our webhook endpoint was down for about 40 minutes and Northwind's platform gave up retrying after only 3 attempts, so we lost roughly 200 events related to energy usage alerts. We'd like to request an increase to the retry count and backoff window, and also want to understand the new deprecation timeline for the legacy webhook signing method since we saw a notice about that too. This is fairly urgent as we can't risk missing critical alerts again.
answer: This is a reasonable ask given the impact, and I'm flagging it as high priority. We can increase your webhook retry attempts to 8 with extended exponential backoff - I'll get that configured on our end today. On the signing method deprecation, the legacy HMAC-SHA1 signing will be retired in 60 days; we recommend migrating to the SHA256 method now since both are supported in parallel until then.

subject: Duplicate alert emails being sent to same routing group
body: Our operations team has been getting duplicate copies of the same booking-delay alerts, sometimes 3 or 4 identical emails within a minute, all routed through the same alert group we set up last month. This is causing confusion among staff who think each duplicate is a new incident. It started after we added a second routing rule for the same alert category, and we haven't been able to find a way to suppress the duplicates ourselves.
answer: Thanks for the detailed description - this looks like an issue where overlapping routing rules for the same alert category are each independently triggering delivery instead of being deduplicated. As a workaround, could you temporarily disable one of the two overlapping rules while we investigate the deduplication logic? We'll also review your alert group configuration to confirm the exact overlap causing this.

subject: CRITICAL: Data pipeline sync 6+ hours behind, downstream reports stale
body: Our main retail transactions connector has been falling progressively further behind since around 2am UTC - it's now over 6 hours late and all downstream dashboards and reports built on this pipeline are showing stale data. We rely on this for near-real-time inventory decisions across our stores, and this delay is now materially affecting operations. The connector status shows 'running' but the latency metric keeps climbing instead of catching up.
answer: We're treating this as a full outage given the business impact and have engineers actively investigating the connector latency right now. Initial findings point to a backlog on the source-side change data capture stream rather than an issue on our processing layer, but we're validating that now. We'll post updates every 30 minutes until the backlog clears and latency returns to normal.

subject: Request: exportable audit logs and allowlist controls in Admin Console
body: We'd like to request two enhancements to the Admin Console for our workspace. First, the ability to export audit logs to CSV or send them to an external SIEM, since right now we can only view them in the dashboard and pagination makes it hard to review activity over a full month. Second, we'd like IP allowlist settings to apply per-role rather than workspace-wide, so we can restrict admin deactivation actions more tightly. Both would help us tighten our access review process this quarter.
answer: Thanks for the detailed request - both of these are on our near-term roadmap and your feedback helps prioritize them. CSV export for audit logs is planned for release within the next two months; per-role IP allowlisting is a larger change we're still scoping, so I don't have a firm date yet. I'll add your workspace to the beta notification list for both features so you hear as soon as they're available for testing.

subject: Unsubscribe link missing from alert emails causing duplicate opt-out requests
body:
We're seeing a growing number of paralegals emailing our team directly asking to be removed from Northwind alert notifications because the unsubscribe link in the footer just goes to a 404 page. This is generating duplicate tickets on our side since we have to manually track who asked to opt out.

Could you add a working one-click unsubscribe link to the alert email template, or point me to where I can configure this myself? We have 257 seats and the volume of alerts is only increasing, so this is becoming a real support burden.
answer: Thanks for flagging this - a broken unsubscribe link in transactional alert emails is definitely something we want to fix quickly. I've confirmed the footer link template has a stale routing parameter and I'm escalating this to our notifications team to patch it. In the meantime, I can manually suppress specific recipients on request if you send me the list of email addresses that have asked to opt out, so we can stop the duplicate tickets piling up on your end.

subject: How to change file retention period for uploaded documents
body:
We're a small team on the Starter plan and want to reduce our storage retention window from the default setting to 90 days to help manage our quota, since we're getting close to our limit with only 5 seats active. Right now old uploads from over a year ago are still sitting in storage.

Is retention configurable per workspace, or is it a fixed setting on our plan tier? If it's adjustable, can you walk me through where to set it or do we need to submit a request each time?
answer: Retention on the Starter plan is currently set at a fixed default, but we can apply a custom retention policy at the workspace level on request - this isn't yet self-serve in the admin console. I'll set your workspace to a 90-day rolling retention window and confirm once it's active; any files older than that threshold will be queued for cleanup within 24 hours, which should also free up a meaningful chunk of your quota.

subject: Incorrect seat counts on last three invoices - billing discrepancy
body:
I'm reviewing our last three monthly invoices (dated Feb 1, Mar 1, and Apr 1) and each one bills for 1,650 seats, but our actual active seat count has been 1,598 since January after we offboarded a cohort of contractors. This is a recurring overcharge across three billing cycles now and finance is asking for a resolution and refund calculation.

Can someone confirm the correct seat count on file and process a refund or credit for the 52-seat discrepancy on each invoice? We need this resolved before our next billing cycle closes.
answer: Thank you for the detailed breakdown - I can see the seat count mismatch on your account and I'm escalating this to our billing team as a priority item given it spans three cycles. I'll pull the seat activity logs to confirm the January offboarding date and calculate the exact credit owed for the 52-seat overage across all three invoices, and I'll follow up within one business day with the refund amount and timeline rather than waiting for the next billing cycle.

subject: Requesting credit for duplicate charge and clarification on refund policy
body:
We were double-billed for our March invoice - I can see two identical charges of the same amount posted two days apart on our card statement, both referencing our 146-seat Pro plan. I've already opened a dispute with our bank but wanted to flag it here first in case that causes complications on your end.

Separately, we'd like to understand Northwind's general refund policy for cases like this, since we may need to request credits again in future if seat counts fluctuate. Could someone confirm the duplicate charge and issue a refund for one of the two transactions?
answer: I'm sorry for the duplicate charge - I've located both transactions on your account and confirmed it was a processing error on our end, so I'm issuing a refund for the duplicate amount now; it should appear on your statement within 3-5 business days. Regarding a bank dispute, it would help if you could let us know once that's resolved so we don't end up processing two refunds for the same charge. As for our general policy, credits for billing errors like this are handled case by case and typically processed within 48 hours of confirmation, and I'm happy to send you the full policy documentation if useful.

subject: MFA enrollment completely broken for new hires - this is unacceptable
body:
We have 12 new hires who cannot complete MFA enrollment - they get stuck on a blank screen after scanning the QR code, and the login just hangs indefinitely. I've tried this myself on three different browsers and it's the same result every time. Your documentation says enrollment should take under a minute but we've had people stuck for over 20 minutes before giving up.

This is blocking people from doing their jobs and it's the second MFA issue we've had this month. If this isn't fixed today we're going to seriously reconsider whether Northwind is worth the cost for our 146 seats.
answer: I understand how disruptive this is, especially with new hires unable to get into their accounts, and I'm sorry for the frustration. I'm treating this as a priority issue and pulling the enrollment logs for the affected accounts right now to identify where the hang is occurring - our initial suspicion is a QR code generation timeout on our identity service, and I'll have an engineer look at this within the hour. I'll update you as soon as I have a root cause or a workaround, such as manual TOTP secret entry, so your new hires can get enrolled without further delay.

subject: Need SAML SSO setup guide with SCIM provisioning for our IdP
body:
I'm setting up SAML login for our Harbor Legal workspace and want to also enable SCIM-based user provisioning at the same time so new users get their permissions assigned automatically based on IdP groups. I've found the basic SAML metadata upload page but nothing that covers linking SCIM provisioning rules to specific role permissions.

Could you point me to documentation covering both SAML configuration and SCIM group-to-role mapping, or let me know if this needs to be set up manually on your side for a Starter plan account?
answer: Good news is SAML and SCIM provisioning are both supported, though full group-to-role mapping via SCIM is available starting on our Pro tier - on Starter you can configure SAML login and basic SCIM user creation, but role assignment based on IdP groups would need to be done manually or via API calls after provisioning.
