I'll send over our SAML configuration guide and the SCIM provisioning API docs, and if you're interested in the full group mapping feature I can also loop in our sales team to discuss upgrading.

subject: Admin console workspace settings not saving - allowlist changes reverting
body:
Since this morning around 9am our team has been unable to save any changes to workspace settings in the Admin Console. Specifically, I added three new IP ranges to our allowlist, clicked save, got a success message, but when I refresh the page the allowlist reverts to the old three entries. I've tried this in Chrome and Firefox with the same result.

This is affecting all admins on our 108-seat workspace, not just me, and it's blocking a network migration we're doing today. We need this fixed as soon as possible since our new office IPs can't currently reach the platform.
answer: Thanks for the clear repro steps - this looks like a caching issue on the settings save endpoint rather than a true rollback, since the save confirmation is returning successfully but the read path may be serving a stale cached response. I'm escalating this to engineering as high priority given it's blocking your network migration, and in the meantime I can manually apply the three IP ranges you need on the backend so your new office can connect while we fix the underlying save bug.

subject: Salesforce sync stopped updating records - integration silently failing
body:
Our Salesforce integration has stopped syncing account updates since last night around 11pm. New records created in Salesforce aren't appearing in Northwind, and updates to existing accounts on our side aren't reflecting either. No error banners are showing in the integrations dashboard, it just looks idle.

We rely on this sync for our fintech reporting pipeline and this is now affecting three downstream teams who pull data from Northwind. Can someone check the sync job status and let us know if there's a queued backlog or if we need to reauthorize the connection?
answer: I've checked the sync job for your Salesforce integration and can see the last successful run was at 10:47pm last night, followed by repeated authentication failures - it looks like the OAuth token expired and the automatic refresh didn't complete. I'm re-triggering the reauthorization flow now and will confirm once the connection is restored; I'll also check whether there's a backlog of missed records that needs to be manually resynced once the connection is back up, and update you within the hour.

subject: Question about SAML login redirect loop on one account
body:
One of our four users is running into a redirect loop when trying to log in via SAML - the browser bounces between our IdP login page and Northwind's callback URL about five times before landing on a generic error page. The other three of us can log in fine with SAML. This started sometime this week, not sure of the exact date.

Is this a known issue with a particular IdP configuration, or is there something specific to that one user's account we should check, like a stale session or duplicate NameID mapping?
answer: This pattern usually points to a stale or duplicate session on the IdP side, or occasionally a NameID that doesn't match cleanly between the IdP and our SAML configuration for that user - it's not something we're seeing broadly across other customers right now. Could you have that user clear cookies for both the IdP and Northwind domains and attempt login again? If the loop persists, send me their user ID and we'll check the SAML assertion logs on our end for any NameID mismatch or clock skew issue.

subject: Push notifications not arriving on iOS app for some users
body:
We've had reports from a handful of our travel agents that push notifications for booking confirmations aren't arriving on their iOS devices, though Android users seem fine. This has been happening for about a week now. The notifications show as sent in our dashboard, but nothing appears on the affected iOS phones, even with the app open in the background.

Could you check if there's an issue with APNs delivery on your end, or is this something we need to troubleshoot on our side with device tokens?
answer: Thanks for the detail - since Android is unaffected, this does point toward something on the APNs delivery side rather than a broader notification service issue. Could you send me one or two of the affected device tokens along with approximate timestamps of missed notifications? I'll check our APNs delivery logs for those tokens to see if we're getting a rejection or timeout response from Apple's push service, and we'll go from there to figure out whether it's a token expiry issue or a certificate problem on our end.

subject: URGENT - MFA enrollment LOCKED OUT entire company, this is a SECURITY INCIDENT
body: This is unacceptable. Since this morning ALL 128 of our users at Cobalt Capital cannot enroll in MFA - the enrollment screen just spins forever after scanning the QR code and then throws 'Error 500: enrollment_session_expired'. We are LOCKED OUT of our own identity system during a period where we NEED SSO working for compliance reasons. Fix this NOW or we are cancelling our contract and moving to another vendor. This is a breach waiting to happen if we have to disable MFA to get people working again.
answer: I understand how serious this is and I'm escalating this immediately to our security and identity engineering team as a P0 incident. We're pulling logs on the enrollment_session_expired error right now to identify whether this is tied to a token expiry misconfiguration on our end, and I will update you within 30 minutes with findings or a workaround so your team can enroll without disabling MFA. Please do not disable MFA org-wide in the meantime - we can issue temporary bypass codes for specific users if anyone is fully blocked from working.

subject: Jira link not syncing issue status back to dashboard
body: We set up the Jira integration a few weeks ago to link tickets from our support dashboard, and it mostly works, but when we change a Jira issue status from 'In Progress' to 'Done', that update never reflects back on our Northwind side. The linked card still shows 'In Progress' days later. We have about 40 linked issues right now and I've checked a handful manually against Jira - none of them sync the status change. Not urgent, just wanted to flag it since we rely on this for reporting.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. This sounds like the reverse-sync webhook from Jira isn't firing correctly for status transitions, which we've seen occasionally with certain Jira workflow schemes. Could you send me one specific Jira issue key that's out of sync so I can trace the webhook delivery logs on our end? We'll get this corrected and let you know if it needs a reconfiguration on the Jira automation rule side.

subject: Charts rendering broken after API integration update
body: After deploying our latest API integration changes on Oct 3, several dashboard charts in our logistics ops workspace are rendering blank or with a 'Failed to load series data' message. This affects roughly 15 of our 40 dashboards, mostly the ones pulling from the /v2/metrics endpoint. Other users can still view and share dashboards fine, just the chart bodies are broken. Refreshing or clearing cache doesn't help.
answer: Thanks for the specifics - the /v2/metrics endpoint detail is helpful. We've seen a schema change on that endpoint cause chart renderers to fail silently when a field type shifts unexpectedly, so we're checking whether your recent deploy is returning a different payload shape than before. Can you share one affected dashboard ID so we can inspect the exact query and response it's receiving? We'll follow up with findings shortly.

subject: Request to improve dashboard load times for large datasets
body: Our team at Lumen Labs has several dashboards pulling from datasets with 2-3 million rows, and load times have crept up to 15-20 seconds per view, which is becoming a real bottleneck for our clinical reporting team. We're not seeing errors, just consistently slow rendering, especially on dashboards with more than 4 chart panels. We'd like to understand if there are pagination, caching, or aggregation options we should be using, or if this needs a plan-level change to get better performance.
answer: Thanks for flagging this - dashboards with multiple panels over large row counts do benefit significantly from pre-aggregation and query caching, which are configurable per dashboard. I'll walk you through setting up scheduled data aggregation views so panels query summarized tables instead of raw rows, which typically cuts load time substantially. I'll also check whether your current plan tier includes the higher-performance query caching option and follow up with recommendations tailored to your dataset size.

subject: Email digests sending duplicate notifications to all users
body: Starting this past Monday, every user in our workspace has been receiving 2-3 duplicate copies of the same daily email digest, sometimes minutes apart. This is happening across our entire org of 25 seats and teachers are complaining it's flooding their inboxes. We haven't changed any notification settings recently. Can you help us figure out why this started and get it stopped?
answer: Thank you for the report - a digest sending duplicates to your whole workspace is high priority for us and we're looking into it right now. This pattern usually points to a stuck or duplicated scheduled job on our notification service, so we're checking your workspace's digest schedule configuration for any duplicate triggers. We'll update you within the next few hours with either a fix or a temporary pause on digests while we resolve the root cause.

subject: SAML login failing for subset of users after IdP metadata update
body: We updated our IdP metadata on our identity provider side last week, and since then a subset of our 54 users at Delta Health get 'SAML response validation failed: signature mismatch' when trying to log into Northwind via SSO. It seems to affect users in one particular group we recently added permissions for, while others log in fine. We've re-uploaded the metadata XML to Northwind twice with no change.
answer: Thanks for the clear breakdown - the fact that it's isolated to one permission group after a metadata update points to a certificate or attribute mapping mismatch tied to that group's role assertions. Can you confirm the exact certificate fingerprint currently active on your IdP side, and send us one full SAML response trace from an affected login attempt? We'll compare it against what we have configured and get this corrected quickly since it's blocking active users.

subject: Dashboards timing out and exports failing during business hours
body: Since yesterday afternoon, dashboards in our finance workspace are taking over a minute to load, and several team members report exports to CSV failing outright with 'Export timed out - please try again'. This is happening consistently between 9am and 5pm across multiple dashboards, including our main revenue tracking view used by 150 users at Orion Travel. It was fine last week.
answer: Thank you for reporting this - a sustained slowdown affecting your main revenue dashboard during business hours is something we're treating as high priority. We're currently checking for query load or resource contention issues on our backend for your workspace during that time window, and reviewing the export timeout logs to see what's failing at the export queue stage. We'll have an update for you within the next couple of hours.

subject: Data pipeline showing consistent delays for daily sync
body: Our data pipeline that syncs transaction records daily has started arriving 3-4 hours later than scheduled over the past week, usually completing around 6am instead of the expected 2am window. We noticed this because our downstream reports were showing stale data on two separate mornings, Oct 10 and Oct 12. The pipeline still completes successfully, it's just consistently late. We have 5 seats on this workspace and rely on the data being fresh by early morning for daily decisions. Can you help identify what's causing the delay?
answer: Thanks for including the specific dates - that helps us narrow down the window to check. Late-arriving but successfully completing syncs usually point to upstream source availability delays or queue contention on our ingestion side, so we're pulling the pipeline run logs for Oct 10 and Oct 12 now to see exactly where the extra time is being spent. We'll report back with the bottleneck stage and an estimate for getting your sync back to the 2am window.

subject: API keys suddenly returning 401 unauthorized on all requests
body: As of this morning, every API call we make using our production API key returns '401 Unauthorized: invalid or expired credentials', even though we haven't rotated or changed the key. This is blocking our billing reconciliation process which runs every morning at Ember Academy. We checked the API keys page and the key still shows as active. We only have one key in use across our small team of 6.
answer: This is a priority issue for us since it's blocking your billing reconciliation entirely. We're checking your account's key status and recent API platform changes right now, since an active-looking key returning 401 can sometimes result from a backend key-hash migration issue. I'll have an answer for you within the hour, and if needed we can issue a new key immediately as a temporary fix while we investigate the root cause.

subject: Request to fix duplicate alert emails and document alerting rules
body: Our finance team at Granite Robotics has been getting duplicate alert emails for the same billing threshold triggers, sometimes 3 copies of one alert within a few minutes. This has been going on for about two weeks across our 174-seat workspace. We'd also like better documentation on how alert deduplication is supposed to work, since we can't tell from the current docs whether this is expected behavior or a bug. Could you look into both the duplicate issue and point us to more detailed documentation?
answer: Thanks for flagging both issues - three copies of the same alert within minutes is not expected behavior, so we're treating the duplicate delivery as a bug and investigating your workspace's alert rule configuration for any duplicate trigger conditions. On documentation, our current alerting deduplication guide is admittedly thin, so I'll pass that feedback to our docs team and send you a more detailed internal explanation of the dedup logic in the meantime while we resolve the duplicate sends.

subject: Salesforce sync stopped pushing opportunity updates
body: Since yesterday around 9am ET, our Salesforce integration has stopped syncing opportunity stage changes back into Northwind. We rely on this for our sales ops dashboards and 208 seats are affected across the org. The integration status page shows "Connected" but the last successful sync timestamp is stuck at 08:52 AM. We also noticed our Okta-provisioned service account used for the connector shows a warning icon in the Integrations panel. Can someone check the connector logs on your end? We need this restored today as our EOD reports depend on it.
answer: Thanks for flagging this, and I understand the urgency given your reporting cycle. We're seeing the same stalled sync on our end and it appears related to a token refresh issue tied to the Okta service account credentials used by the Salesforce connector. We're escalating this to our integrations team now and will push a fix or manual re-auth within the next couple of hours. I'll update this ticket as soon as sync resumes and confirm the backlog has been processed.

subject: Transform step failing on every run since last week
body:
We're seeing repeated transform failures in our manufacturing data pipeline that ingests supplier cost data. It used to run fine but for the past 5 runs it's been erroring out before completion. Here's the log from this morning's run:

2024-05-14 06:02:11 ERROR pipeline.transform - Step 'normalize_currency' failed
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "transform.py", line 88, in run_step
    result = apply_rules(batch)
ValueError: could not convert string to float: 'N/A'
2024-05-14 06:02:11 INFO pipeline.transform - Retrying batch 3/3
2024-05-14 06:02:14 ERROR pipeline.transform - Max retries exceeded, aborting

Could you help us understand how to configure the transform to skip or flag rows with missing values instead of failing the whole batch? This is blocking our monthly cost reconciliation.
answer: Thanks for including the log, that pinpoints the issue clearly. The 'normalize_currency' step is failing because it can't parse non-numeric placeholders like 'N/A' in the cost column. There's a setting under the transform step's advanced options called 'on_invalid_value' that lets you route bad rows to a quarantine table instead of aborting the batch. I'll walk you through enabling that and, since this is blocking your monthly reconciliation, I'm marking this as high priority so we can get your pipeline running again today.

subject: Customer complaining they keep getting emails after unsubscribing
body: One of our end customers unsubscribed from our product update emails through the link in the footer about a week ago, but they just told us they received two more digest emails since then. I checked our Notifications settings and their contact is listed as 'Unsubscribed' in the suppression list, so this looks like a bug on the sending side rather than something we misconfigured. Could you check why suppressed contacts are still receiving sends?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. This does sound like the suppression list isn't being checked correctly at send time for scheduled digests specifically, rather than one-off sends. I'm logging this as a bug for our notifications team to investigate the digest send path, and in the meantime I'd recommend manually excluding this contact from the digest segment as a workaround. I'll update you once we identify the root cause.

subject: Request to add badge counts to mobile push notifications
body: Our team has been using the Northwind mobile app for approvals while traveling, and we'd like to request that push notifications include an app icon badge count showing how many pending items are waiting. Right now notifications arrive fine but the badge never updates, so people don't realize they have unread approvals until they open the app. This would really help adoption among our finance staff who check phones between meetings.
answer: Thanks for the suggestion, this is a reasonable gap to flag. Badge counts aren't currently supported in the mobile app's notification handling, but I've submitted this as a feature request to our mobile product team with your use case attached. I don't have a timeline to share yet, but I'll follow up here if it gets scheduled for a release.

subject: getting duplicate email digests every morning
body: hi, for the last few day's our whole IT team has bene getting two copies of the daily email digest, one arrives around 6am and then a duplicate comes about 10 minutes later. We have 279 seats so this is generating alot of noise and people are asking me to turn it off. I checked the Notifications settings and we only have one digest schedule configured under Alerting, so not sure why its doubling up. Can you help figure out whats causing this and how to stop it?
answer: Thanks for reporting this, and sorry for the extra noise it's causing your team. A single schedule sending duplicates usually points to a delivery retry issue on our side rather than a config problem, so you shouldn't need to change anything in your settings. I'm looking into your account's digest job logs now to confirm whether there's a duplicate trigger firing, and I'll update this ticket with findings and a fix timeline shortly.

subject: Need Salesforce sync to also update Jira and Slack on record changes
body: We're currently using the Salesforce integration to sync account records, and we'd like to request that changes there can also trigger updates in our connected Jira and Slack channels, similar to how some other integrations chain together. Right now we have to manually post updates to Slack when a Salesforce record changes, which our small team of 18 can't keep up with as we grow. Is this something on your roadmap, or is there a workaround using existing triggers?
answer: Thanks for the detailed request. Chaining Salesforce sync events into Jira and Slack notifications isn't natively supported yet, but it's a pattern we've heard from other customers, so I've added your use case to the feature request for cross-integration triggers. In the meantime, a workaround is possible using our webhook export from Salesforce sync combined with your own Slack/Jira automation, and I'm happy to help you set that up if useful.

subject: SCIM provisioning failing for all new users since this morning
body: Starting this morning, SCIM provisioning from our identity provider has stopped creating new user accounts in Northwind. We've had 6 new hires fail to get accounts and they're blocked from logging in, some of whom need MFA-enrolled access today for a client audit. The SCIM endpoint returns a 500 error when our IdP attempts the POST to /scim/v2/Users. This is affecting our whole team's onboarding and we need this fixed urgently.
answer: This is being treated as high priority given the onboarding blockage. We can confirm we're seeing 500 errors on SCIM user creation on our side starting around the same time you reported, and our identity team is actively investigating the root cause now. I'll update you within the hour with either a fix or a manual provisioning workaround for your pending hires so they aren't blocked from MFA setup.

subject: Workspace settings reverting after API updates
body: I'm integrating with the Admin Console API to manage workspace settings programmatically, and I've noticed that whenever I PATCH the workspace's default timezone and session timeout via the API, the changes apply momentarily but revert back to previous values within a minute or two. This is happening consistently across our workspace with 1629 seats, and it's now also causing some deactivated user accounts to appear reactivated in the admin UI, which is a serious concern for us given the scale. Can someone investigate urgently?
answer: Thank you for the clear reproduction details, and I understand the concern around the reactivated accounts given your workspace size. We're escalating this immediately as it points to a sync issue between the API layer and the settings cache that could also be affecting deactivation state. I'll keep you updated closely and would appreciate confirmation on which specific accounts appeared reactivated so we can verify their status manually while we fix the underlying issue.

subject: How do we adjust our seat count going forward
body: We currently have 11 seats on our Starter plan and we're about to onboard 3 more people next month. I'd like to understand how seat changes work, whether it's prorated mid-cycle, and if there's a way to see our current seat usage versus what we're paying for in the billing dashboard. Also, it would be great if the billing page showed a simple usage bar so we don't have to ask support each time.
answer: Happy to help clarify this. Seat additions are prorated for the remainder of your current billing cycle, so adding 3 seats mid-month will only charge the partial amount until renewal, after which it's included in your normal invoice. You can see current seat usage under Billing > Seats, and I've passed along your suggestion about a usage bar to our product team as a nice quality-of-life improvement.

subject: URGENT: SSO role mapping wiped, users losing admin access and MFA broken
body: We just discovered that our SSO role mapping configuration was reset sometime in the last hour, causing all our staff to be logged in with default viewer roles instead of their assigned admin/editor roles. Several admins have lost access to patient scheduling data views, and MFA enforcement for our compliance-required roles appears to have been disabled as a side effect. We have only 8 seats but this is healthcare data and we need immediate help before this becomes a compliance incident.
answer: We understand the severity of this given the compliance implications and are treating it as a P0 incident right now. Our security and identity teams have been paged immediately to investigate the role mapping reset and confirm whether MFA enforcement was actually disabled or is only misreporting in the UI. Please avoid making further changes to your SSO configuration in the meantime, and we'll be in direct contact within minutes with findings and remediation steps.

subject: Audit log entries missing after allowlist update
body:
We've been reviewing our security settings ahead of an internal compliance review scheduled for next week, and I wanted to make sure our documentation matches what's actually configured in the Admin Console. I went through the allowlist section first since we added three new IP ranges for our Lisbon office back on the 14th, and that all looked fine.

The actual issue is that when I went to pull the audit log to confirm the allowlist change was recorded, there's nothing there. The log shows entries up through the 13th and then just stops - no record of the change itself or anything after it, even though the settings page clearly shows the new ranges as active.
answer: Thanks for flagging this - a gap in the audit trail is something we take seriously, especially with your compliance review coming up. Can you confirm the exact timestamp (with timezone) of the allowlist change so we can check whether this is a logging delay versus a dropped event, and let us know if any other admin actions since the 13th are also missing from the log. In the meantime I'd suggest keeping a manual record of the allowlist change for your review.

subject: Jira integration broken - issues not syncing to any project
body:
Since this morning our Jira link inside Integrations has stopped creating issues entirely. We rely on this to auto-generate tickets from incoming alerts, and as of around 9:15am ET nothing is coming through on any of our four connected Jira projects. The connection status still shows 'Connected' in the settings page, so it's not obviously flagged as broken on our end.

We've got 257 users across legal teams depending on this workflow for case intake, and the backlog is piling up fast. Can someone take a look urgently? We haven't changed any Jira permissions or Okta config recently.
answer: This is escalated to our integrations team right now given the number of users affected. We're checking the Jira link's webhook delivery logs on our side first since a 'Connected' status with no issue creation usually points to a silent failure in the outbound sync job rather than an auth problem. We'll update you within the hour with findings, and in the meantime please hold off on reconnecting the integration so we don't lose diagnostic data.

subject: Need SAML login option for contractor accounts
body:
We currently have SAML SSO enforced for all Willow Foods employees through our identity provider, but we're bringing on a group of retail floor contractors who don't have accounts in our IdP and won't for at least another quarter. Right now they're locked out entirely since SSO is mandatory workspace-wide.

Could we get a way to allow specific users or a specific group to log in with a standard username/password instead of SAML, without disabling SSO enforcement for everyone else? We'd want this scoped narrowly, ideally by group or by individual account exception.
answer: This is a common ask and we do support per-group SSO exceptions on the Pro plan. I can walk you through setting up a bypass group in the Identity and SSO settings that lets designated accounts authenticate with a password while SAML stays enforced for everyone else. Send over the contractor group name or a list of the accounts you'd like exempted and I'll get the configuration set up on our end.

subject: Uploads failing across the board - Storage
body:
Starting around 7:40am today, file uploads to Storage are failing for essentially all of our clinical documentation workflows. Users are getting a generic 'Upload failed, please try again' message, and retries fail the same way regardless of file size or type. We've confirmed this affects multiple departments, not just one team.

We're at risk of missing our retention window for a batch of records that need to be archived by end of day. Can you check whether this is tied to a quota limit or a backend issue? Our storage usage dashboard hasn't shown any quota warnings, so this seems unexpected.
answer: I'm treating this as a major incident given the retention deadline and the number of users affected. We're pulling the upload service logs now to check for quota enforcement errors or backend timeouts on our end - can you send one specific object key or upload attempt timestamp so we can trace it precisely? We'll keep you updated every 30 minutes until this is resolved.

subject: Connector losing auth token intermittently
body:
Our energy usage data connector in Data Pipelines has started failing authentication roughly once a day over the past week, always requiring a manual re-auth to resume syncing. It's not a permanent failure - the connector reconnects fine when I manually refresh the credentials, but then drops again within 24 hours.

This is affecting the freshness of our downstream reporting since each drop causes a multi-hour sync gap. Is this a known issue with token refresh on this connector type, and is there a way to make the refresh automatic so we're not manually intervening daily?
answer: This does sound like a token refresh issue rather than a credentials problem, since manual re-auth is resolving it each time. We've seen this pattern before with certain OAuth-based connectors when the refresh token lifetime is shorter than expected - I'll check your connector's refresh configuration and confirm whether it needs to be reissued with a longer-lived token or switched to a service account credential.

subject: Can't share dashboard with finance team, permission error
body:
I'm trying to share our quarterly logistics cost dashboard with three colleagues on the finance team, but when I add their emails under sharing settings I get a message saying 'Insufficient permissions to grant access at this level.' I have edit access to the dashboard myself, so I wasn't expecting this.

Is there a separate sharing permission I need enabled, or does this need to come from a workspace admin? Not urgent, just trying to get this sorted before our end-of-month review.
answer: Good question - dashboard sharing at the 'edit' level actually requires a separate grant beyond regular dashboard edit access, which is why you're seeing that message even though you can edit the dashboard itself. A workspace admin will need to enable sharing permissions for your account, or they can share it directly with your finance colleagues. Let me know if you'd like me to reach out to your admin on your behalf.

subject: Transform jobs failing across multiple pipelines
body:
We're seeing widespread transform failures in Data Pipelines since roughly 2am today. Six of our nine active pipelines are erroring out at the transform stage with 'Unexpected schema mismatch' errors, even though the source schemas haven't changed on our end recently. This is affecting patient intake and billing reconciliation pipelines specifically.

Given the number of pipelines down and that this touches healthcare data reconciliation, we need this escalated immediately. Our data team of 273 users is currently blocked from running any downstream reports that depend on these transforms.
answer: Escalating this now as a P1 given the number of pipelines and the healthcare data reconciliation impact. Schema mismatch errors appearing simultaneously across six pipelines suggests a shared upstream dependency or a recent platform-side schema validation change - we're checking our transform service deployment history for anything that went out overnight. We'll have an update for you within the hour and will keep this thread updated continuously until resolved.

subject: Biometrische Anmeldung funktioniert nach Update nicht mehr zuverlässig
body:
Nach dem letzten App-Update versucht die Mobile App bei etwa jedem dritten Anmeldeversuch, obwohl Face ID erfolgreich erkannt wurde, trotzdem noch einmal das Passwort abzufragen. Das passiert bei mehreren Testgeräten in unserem Team, sowohl bei iOS 17 als auch bei neueren Versionen.

Es ist kein Blocker, da die Passwortabfrage funktioniert, aber es untergräbt den Zweck der biometrischen Anmeldung für unsere Außendienstmitarbeiter, die oft offline unterwegs sind. Können Sie prüfen, ob das ein bekanntes Problem mit dem aktuellen Release ist?
answer: Danke für die detaillierte Beschreibung. Das klingt nach einem Problem mit dem Sitzungs-Token-Refresh nach der biometrischen Bestätigung, das wir uns im aktuellen Release genauer ansehen sollten. Können Sie uns die genaue App-Version und die betroffenen Gerätemodelle mitteilen, damit wir das Verhalten gezielt reproduzieren können?

subject: Audit log shows unauthorized deactivation of admin account
body:
This morning we discovered that one of our two admin accounts was deactivated overnight, and the audit log entry for it just shows 'System' as the actor with no further detail. Nobody on our team performed this action, and we have no scheduled deactivations set up. We're a small operations team with only 7 seats total, so losing an admin account is a serious problem for us right now.

We need to know immediately whether this was triggered by an automated policy, a billing issue, or something else, and we need the account reactivated as soon as possible since it's blocking our billing reconciliation work today.
answer: We understand the urgency here and are treating this as a priority incident. We're checking whether this deactivation was tied to a billing sync event or an automated inactivity policy on our end, since 'System'-attributed actions typically come from one of those two sources rather than manual admin activity. We'll reactivate the account as soon as we confirm it's safe to do so and will follow up shortly with the root cause.

subject: SCIM provisioning - need custom attribute mapping for roles
body:
I'm setting up SCIM provisioning between our identity provider and Northwind's Identity and SSO for our legal team, and I need to map a custom attribute from our IdP (legalDepartmentRole) to a Northwind permission group, but the current SCIM schema only exposes standard attributes like displayName and email for mapping.

Is there a way to extend the SCIM attribute mapping to support custom fields, or would we need to handle role assignment separately via the API after provisioning? Just trying to plan the integration correctly before we roll this out to all 14 seats.
answer: Custom attribute mapping in SCIM isn't exposed in the UI yet, but you can achieve this by having your IdP send the custom attribute inside the SCIM 'urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:enterprise:2.0:User' extension, which our provisioning endpoint does read. Alternatively, since you're already integrating via API, you could handle role assignment as a follow-up call to our permissions endpoint right after the SCIM user creation event. Happy to share a sample payload for either approach.

subject: Unsubscribe requests not being honored - duplicate emails going out
body: We integrated the Notifications API last month and just discovered that recipients who click unsubscribe on our transactional emails are still receiving them. We have 6 confirmed cases since May 2nd where the same recipient got 3-4 duplicate sends of the same invoice-notice template after unsubscribing. Our compliance team is flagging this as urgent since it looks like an opt-out violation. Can you confirm whether the unsubscribe endpoint is actually suppressing future sends, or if there's a caching issue on your side?
answer: Thank you for flagging this, and I understand the urgency given the compliance implications. We're escalating this to our Notifications engineering team right now to check whether the suppression list is being applied at send time or only at queue time, since a delay there would explain the duplicates you're seeing. Could you send us the recipient identifiers and the exact timestamps for the 6 cases so we can trace them through our logs while we investigate?

subject: Request: sync additional custom fields from Salesforce
body: We currently have the Salesforce integration pulling standard account and contact fields into our dashboards, but we need two custom fields (Renewal_Risk_Score and Care_Team_Region) added to the sync as well. These fields were created on our Salesforce org back in March and are used heavily in our healthcare reporting. Is this something we can configure ourselves in the integration settings, or does it require a mapping change on your end?
answer: Custom field mapping for Salesforce is something you can add yourself under Integrations > Salesforce > Field Mapping, where you'll see an option to include additional source fields by API name. If Renewal_Risk_Score and Care_Team_Region aren't showing up in that picker, it usually means Salesforce hasn't marked them as accessible to the integration user, so it's worth checking field-level security on that profile first. Let us know if they still don't appear after that and we'll take a closer look at the connection.

subject: SCIM provisioning failing for new hires - users can't log in
body: Since our SCIM integration update on June 10th, new employees added in our identity provider are not being created in Northwind. We've had 14 new hires across manufacturing sites this week who cannot log in at all, getting an 'account not found' error. Our IT team confirmed the SCIM push shows a 201 success response on our IdP side, but the users never appear in the Northwind admin console. This is blocking onboarding for a large batch of employees and we need this resolved urgently.

answer:
Good question, and this is a common pattern for travel booking data. By default, our pipeline sync uses a fixed watermark and late records arriving after the window closes are logged but not automatically backfilled into completed syncs - they'll appear in the next scheduled run instead.

You can configure a grace period (we support up to 6 hours) under the pipeline's advanced settings to hold windows open longer before finalizing, which should capture most of your 2-4 hour delays. I'll share our documentation link on watermark configuration and best practices for handling late data in the next follow-up.

subject: Request to change scheduled sync frequency for Data Pipelines
body: We're a workspace admin at Vertex Labs and currently our nightly sync job (pipeline ID vtx-sync-014) runs at 2 AM UTC and pulls transaction data from our core banking API. We'd like to change this to run every 4 hours instead, since our finance team is seeing stale data delays of up to 20 hours before reports refresh. Can you help us adjust the schedule without breaking the existing downstream mappings into our reporting warehouse?
answer: Thanks for reaching out. We can update pipeline vtx-sync-014 to a 4-hour interval schedule while preserving your current field mappings and warehouse destination. Before we make the change, could you confirm which time zone you'd like the interval anchored to, and whether you want the first run to start immediately or at the next natural window? We'll apply the change and monitor the first two sync cycles to confirm data quality holds.

subject: Biometric login keeps failing after latest app update
body: Since updating the Northwind mobile app last week, several of our staff at Blue Academy can no longer log in using Face ID or fingerprint. The app just spins and then drops back to the password screen. This is affecting about half our 10 seats and it's slowing down our morning attendance check-ins. Could you look into why biometric login stopped working?
answer: Thanks for flagging this. This matches a known regression in the latest app build tied to biometric token refresh timing on certain devices. As a workaround, please have affected staff log out fully and log back in once with their password to re-establish the token, which should restore biometric login. We're rolling out a fix in the next release and will follow up here once it's confirmed for your account.

subject: Feedback on PDF export formatting from Dashboards
body: I've been exporting a few of our manufacturing throughput dashboards to PDF for our weekly ops review, and the charts consistently get cut off at the page edge when there are more than 4 data series. It's not urgent, but it would be great if the export could auto-scale charts to fit the page width. Just wanted to pass this along as feedback since it affects how shareable these reports are.
answer: Thank you for the detailed feedback, this is useful. Chart auto-scaling for PDF exports with multiple data series isn't currently supported, but I've logged this as a product enhancement request tied to your account. In the meantime, a workaround is to reduce the chart width setting slightly before exporting, which usually keeps series within the page bounds. We'll let you know if this makes it onto the roadmap.

subject: Duplicate email digests going out multiple times a day - this is unacceptable
body: Our customers at Harbor Media are getting the SAME weekly digest email 3-4 times a day for the past three days. I've had two clients email us asking if we're spamming them. This is a fintech product, people expect professionalism from us, not this mess. We need this fixed today or we're seriously reconsidering staying with Northwind.
answer: I completely understand the urgency here and I'm sorry for the impact this is having on your client relationships. We've identified a retry-loop bug in the digest scheduler that's causing repeated sends and are pushing a fix to stop new duplicates within the next few hours. We're also pausing your digest queue temporarily to prevent further sends while the fix rolls out, and we'll confirm here as soon as it's resolved.

subject: charts broken
body: all charts on dashbord blank since this morning cant fix pls help asap
answer: Sorry for the disruption, we're treating this as urgent. Could you tell us whether this affects all dashboards or specific ones, and share one dashboard ID or URL where charts are blank? In the meantime, please try a hard refresh and clearing cached dashboard data, as we're also checking backend rendering logs on our side right now for any related errors.

subject: Rollenzuordnung bei SSO funktioniert nicht korrekt
body: Wir sind gerade dabei, die Rollenzuordnung über SSO für Summit Foods einzurichten. Bei mehreren Testnutzern wird trotz korrekter Gruppenzugehörigkeit im Identity Provider die Standardrolle 'Viewer' statt der erwarteten Rolle 'Manager' zugewiesen. Das Mapping ist auf 'Manager' für die Gruppe 'store-managers-eu' konfiguriert, wird aber beim Login nicht übernommen. Können Sie prüfen, ob hier ein Fehler im Attribut-Mapping vorliegt?
answer: Vielen Dank für die genaue Beschreibung. Wir prüfen aktuell das Attribut-Mapping für die Gruppe 'store-managers-eu' und den zugehörigen SSO-Connector auf Ihrem Account. Können Sie uns kurz bestätigen, welches Attribut im SAML- oder OIDC-Token die Gruppenzugehörigkeit überträgt? Damit können wir gezielt nachvollziehen, warum die Rolle beim Login nicht korrekt übernommen wird.

subject: Workspace settings reverting after allowlist changes
body: I'm a product manager at Quill Works and every time we add a new IP range to our workspace allowlist under Admin Console settings, the change appears to save but reverts back to the previous list within a few minutes. This has happened three times this week, most recently on Tuesday around 3 PM. We rely on this allowlist for our security compliance reviews, so this is a real problem for us.
answer: Thank you for reporting this, and I understand why this matters for your compliance process. This looks like it could be related to a caching issue in the settings save flow rather than an actual permissions problem. We're escalating this to our security and compliance engineering team to investigate the revert behavior, and we'll also check your audit logs to confirm the exact timestamps of the reverts you've seen.

subject: Mobile app crashes immediately on launch after update
body: Since updating to the newest version of the Northwind mobile app on my iPhone, the app crashes right at the splash screen every time, before I can even log in. I've tried restarting the phone and reinstalling the app but it still crashes. I mainly use it to check billing approvals while traveling, so it's inconvenient but not blocking my core work since I can use the web dashboard instead.
answer: Thanks for letting us know, and sorry for the inconvenience. We've seen a small number of similar crash-on-launch reports tied to the latest iOS build and are investigating the root cause. In the meantime, using the web dashboard for billing approvals is a good workaround, and we'll follow up here as soon as we have an updated app build or a specific fix to test on your device.

subject: Webhook-Zustellung schlägt fehl mit 429 Fehlern seit heute Morgen
body: Wir integrieren die Northwind API für Willow Media und seit heute Morgen gegen 08:15 Uhr bekommen wir bei fast allen ausgehenden Webhook-Events 429 Rate-Limit-Fehler zurück, obwohl sich unser Trafficvolumen nicht verändert hat. Betroffen sind vor allem Events vom Typ payment.updated. Wir haben aktuell über 400 fehlgeschlagene Zustellversuche in der Warteschlange und unsere Kunden bekommen dadurch keine Statusupdates mehr. Können Sie kurzfristig prüfen, ob sich das Rate-Limit für Webhooks geändert hat?
answer: Vielen Dank für die Meldung, wir behandeln das als hohe Priorität. Wir prüfen gerade, ob es eine unangekündigte Änderung am Rate-Limit für Webhook-Zustellungen gab, da uns bereits ein weiterer Bericht mit ähnlichem Muster vorliegt. Bitte lassen Sie die fehlgeschlagenen Events vorerst in der Warteschlange, unser Team arbeitet aktiv an einer Lösung und wir melden uns kurzfristig mit einem Update.

subject: Request to add offline mode support in mobile app
body: As the workspace admin for North Partners, a few of our field staff have asked whether the Northwind mobile app can support offline mode, since they often lose signal while visiting client sites and currently can't view or update records until they're back online. Right now the app just shows a blank error screen when connectivity drops, which is frustrating for them. Is offline access something that's planned or available as a setting we're missing?
answer: Thanks for the detailed request. Offline mode isn't currently available in the mobile app, so the blank error screen on connectivity loss is expected behavior rather than a bug, though we agree it's not a great experience. I've logged this as a feature request tied to your account and will pass along the specific use case around field staff losing signal, since that's helpful context for prioritization.

subject: Feature request: self-service credits and refunds in Billing console
body: I'm the IT admin handling billing for Delta Health. Last month we were double-charged on invoice INV-88213 and it took three separate emails to Northwind support before the duplicate charge was credited back. With 54 seats on the Pro plan we expect this to come up again as we add legal teams, so I'd like to request a self-service option in the billing console to request credits or refunds directly instead of going through email escalation each time.
answer: Thanks for flagging this and for the detail on invoice INV-88213. I've logged a feature request with our billing product team for self-service credit and refund requests within the console, tagged as an escalation from an existing Pro customer. In the meantime, for any future duplicate charges you can email billing directly referencing the invoice number and we'll process the credit within 2 business days.

subject: Question
body: I shared our 'Q3 Billing Overview' dashboard with an external contractor using the Viewer role, but when they try to export any chart they get 'Access Denied - export permission required'. They can see the dashboard fine, just not export. Is chart export supposed to be tied to a separate permission from viewing, and if so how do I enable it for this one contractor without giving them edit rights?
answer: Yes, that's expected behavior - export permissions are managed separately from view access to prevent unintended data leaving the platform. You can grant export rights to that specific contractor by editing their share entry on the dashboard and toggling 'Allow Export' under Sharing Settings, without changing their role from Viewer.

subject: Locked out of admin console after IP allowlist update
body: We just added our new office range 203.0.113.0/24 to the IP allowlist in Admin Console and now every admin, including me, is getting '403 Forbidden - IP not allowed' when trying to log in. Our previous range 198.51.100.0/24 was removed automatically when we saved the change, so nobody can access settings, audit logs, or deactivate the update. This is blocking our travel booking integration team from any admin work right now.
answer: This is a P1 for us and we're on it immediately. It sounds like the allowlist save replaced rather than appended the previous range, which shouldn't happen - we're pulling your account's audit log now to confirm the change and will push a temporary override to restore access for your admins while we fix the underlying bug. I'll update you within the hour.

subject: Anfrage: Granulare Abmeldeoptionen für Benachrichtigungen
body: Wir bekommen von mehreren Kollegen Beschwerden, dass sie doppelte Warnmeldungen für dieselben Ereignisse per E-Mail erhalten und diese nicht einzeln abbestellen können. Aktuell gibt es nur eine globale Abmeldung für alle Benachrichtigungen. Könnten wir bitte eine Funktion bekommen, mit der Endnutzer bestimmte Alert-Typen abbestellen können, ohne alle Benachrichtigungen zu deaktivieren?
answer: Vielen Dank für die Rückmeldung. Wir haben das Problem mit den doppelten Warnmeldungen an unser Produktteam weitergeleitet und Ihre Anfrage für granulare Abmeldeoptionen pro Alert-Typ als Feature-Wunsch erfasst. Als Zwischenlösung können wir für Ihr Konto bestimmte Alert-Typen serverseitig deaktivieren, wenn Sie uns mitteilen, welche am häufigsten doppelt gesendet werden.

subject: Large dashboards taking 30+ seconds to load
body: Our 'Global Revenue Overview' dashboard has grown to around 40 charts and now regularly takes 30 to 40 seconds to fully render for our regional teams, some of whom are on slower connections. We're not seeing errors, just slow load times, and it's making it hard to use during live reviews. Is there documentation on best practices for structuring large dashboards, or settings we should adjust for performance?
answer: Thanks for the details - 40 charts on a single dashboard is on the high end and load time scales with chart count and query complexity. We have a performance guide covering pagination, lazy-loading widgets, and splitting dashboards by team that I'll send over, and I'd also recommend checking whether any charts are running unfiltered queries against large datasets, since those tend to be the biggest contributors to slow renders.

subject: Seat count discrepancy on latest invoice
body: Our latest billing statement shows 650 seats but our actual active user count in the admin console is 622, which matches what we've had all quarter. This overcharge has shown up for two billing cycles now and I'd like it corrected along with a refund adjustment for the difference already billed. Can someone reconcile our seat count against the invoice?
answer: Thank you for catching this - a 28-seat discrepancy across two cycles is worth investigating properly. I'm opening a reconciliation request with billing to compare your active user count against invoiced seats for both cycles, and if confirmed we'll apply a credit for the overcharged amount to your next invoice.

subject: Users receiving triplicate alert emails for same event
body: Several of our team members are reporting they receive the same alert email three times within about 2 minutes for a single triggering event, for example order-threshold alert #48291 on May 6th went out at 09:14, 09:15, and 09:16. This is happening across multiple alert types, not just one, and it's starting to cause people to ignore notifications altogether.
answer: This looks like a deduplication issue on our notification delivery pipeline rather than something specific to one alert type, and we're prioritizing it given the impact on your team. I've opened an investigation referencing event #48291 and the timestamps you provided, and will update you as soon as we identify whether this is a retry-queue bug or a config issue on our side.

subject: Deactivated employee still able to log in and access billing exports
body: We deactivated a former employee's account in the Admin Console on May 2nd and the audit log confirms the deactivation event, but that person was still able to log in yesterday and pull billing export reports. This is a serious concern for us given they no longer work here. Can you confirm why deactivation isn't actually blocking access and help us lock this down immediately?
answer: This is a P1 for us given the access and compliance risk. We're immediately forcing a global session invalidation for the affected account and reviewing why the deactivation on May 2nd didn't revoke active sessions - this appears to be a caching issue on our end. We'll confirm within the hour that the account can no longer authenticate and provide you an audit trail of the fix.

subject: Urgent: duplicate alert emails flooding on-call team
body: Our on-call engineers are getting duplicate copies of every critical alert email, sometimes 2 to 4 copies within a minute of each other, which is causing real alert fatigue during incidents. This started around May 4th and has affected every alert type we use, not just one integration. We need this fixed urgently since it's directly impacting our incident response times.
answer: Understood, and given the impact on incident response we're treating this as P1. We're pulling delivery logs from May 4th onward to identify where the duplication is happening in the alert pipeline, and as an immediate workaround we can enable a short dedup window on your account to suppress repeat sends within a configurable interval while we fix the root cause.

subject: Request for bulk user deactivation via CSV upload
body: For our quarterly access review we need to deactivate around 30 users at once in the Admin Console, and doing this one by one is slow and hard to audit properly. Could we get a bulk deactivation option via CSV upload, similar to how bulk invites work? We also need to confirm the audit log will capture each deactivation individually with timestamps for our compliance review.
answer: Bulk deactivation via CSV isn't available in the console today, but you can achieve this through our admin API by submitting a batch deactivation request with the user list, and each action will be recorded individually in the audit log with a timestamp and the initiating admin. I'll also pass your request for a native CSV upload option along to our product team as a compliance-driven feature request.

subject: Zapier trigger not firing for new user events
body: We use a Zap that watches for new user creation in our North Systems workspace and pushes onboarding tasks into Jira and a matching contact into Salesforce. Since October 12th the trigger just stops - Zap history shows 'No data found' for the last 40+ runs, even though we've onboarded at least 15 new staff through Okta since then. Nothing changed on our end that we're aware of. Can someone check if the webhook payload format changed recently?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report - a payload change on our side for user-creation events could definitely cause this. Could you send us the Zap ID and one of the failed run IDs from your history so we can trace the webhook delivery on our end? In the meantime, you can re-authorize the Zapier connection, which sometimes resets the trigger subscription while we investigate.

subject: Feature request - Zapier trigger for bulk deactivation events
body: We're setting up automation for offboarding at Delta Academy and would like a Zapier trigger that fires when multiple users are deactivated at once, ideally with a batch ID we could pass into Slack for notifications and Jira for ticket creation. Right now we only see a per-user 'user deactivated' trigger, which floods our Zap with dozens of individual runs when we do a term-end cleanup of 20+ accounts.
answer: Thanks for the suggestion - this comes up often around term breaks, so it's helpful to have a concrete use case. We don't currently have a batch-deactivation trigger in the Zapier app, but I'll log this as a feature request with our integrations team. As a workaround in the meantime, you could add a short delay step in your Zap to throttle the per-user notifications so they don't flood Slack.

subject: Files deleted before 90-day retention window expired
body: We just discovered that a batch of research datasets uploaded on July 3rd were purged from Storage on July 20th, well inside our configured 90-day retention policy. Our backup quota dashboard shows usage dropped from 8.2TB to 6.9TB overnight with no corresponding delete requests in our audit trail. We have 340 files missing that are needed for an active grant report due this week - this looks like a retention policy bug, not intentional deletion.
answer: This is being escalated immediately given the data loss involved. We're pulling the storage deletion logs for the July 19-20 window on Atlas Capital's account right now to determine whether the retention rule misfired, and we'll check our backup snapshots to see if the affected files can be restored. I'll update you within the hour with findings and next steps.

subject: Salesforce sync stopped updating records this morning
body: Our Salesforce integration has stopped syncing account updates since around 8am today. Records created in Northwind aren't reflecting in Salesforce, and we've got over 200 retail location records now out of sync. The integration status page shows the connection as active, but the last successful sync timestamp is stuck at 07:52. This is blocking our sales team from seeing current inventory data across all 268 seats.
answer: This is affecting a core workflow so we're treating it as high priority. Can you confirm whether any Salesforce API credentials or connected app permissions were changed today on your side? We're checking our sync worker logs now for errors around 07:52 and will follow up shortly with either a fix or a required action on your Salesforce org.

subject: Card keeps declining, invoice now overdue
body: Our card on file has been declined three times this week when Northwind tried to charge our Starter plan invoice, and we just got a notice that our account may be suspended in 48 hours. The card is valid and has sufficient funds - we've used it for other vendors without issue. Invoice number INV-88231 is the one failing. We need this resolved before service is interrupted for our 4 users.

Could you try updating the card details on file once more, and let us know the exact decline message you're seeing? In parallel I'm flagging invoice INV-88231 to pause any suspension timer while we investigate the payment gateway response.

subject: Seat count higher than actual active users after offboarding
body: We offboarded 12 employees last month but our billing dashboard still shows 190 active seats, matching our original count before the reduction. I checked the admin console and those 12 accounts are marked deactivated, but they don't seem to have released their seats. We'd like this corrected before our next billing cycle renews in 9 days, and ideally a refund adjustment for the seats we've been paying for since deactivation.
answer: Thanks for flagging this - deactivated accounts should release seats automatically, so this looks like a sync issue between account status and the billing seat counter. We're reviewing your account now to confirm the 12 deactivated users and will adjust the seat count before renewal. Once confirmed, we'll also look into a prorated credit for the affected billing period.

subject: SCIM Provisionierung schlägt fehl - neue Nutzer werden nicht angelegt
body: Seit heute Morgen werden neue Nutzer über unser SCIM-Provisioning nicht mehr in Northwind angelegt. Unser Identity Provider zeigt erfolgreiche PUSH-Anfragen, aber in der Admin-Konsole erscheinen keine neuen Konten. Betroffen sind mindestens 14 neue Mitarbeiter, die sich seit heute nicht einloggen können. Wir nutzen SSO mit MFA und benötigen dringend eine Lösung, da der Schulbetrieb sonst beeinträchtigt wird.
answer: Vielen Dank für die Meldung, das behandeln wir als hohe Priorität. Können Sie uns die SCIM-Request-IDs oder Zeitstempel der letzten fehlgeschlagenen Provisionierungsversuche zusenden? Wir prüfen parallel unsere SCIM-Endpunkt-Logs auf Fehler im Zusammenhang mit der Kontoerstellung und melden uns zeitnah mit einem Update.

subject: Feature request: audit log export via API
body: We're building an internal compliance dashboard and would like to pull audit log entries programmatically rather than exporting CSVs from the admin console manually each week. Right now I don't see an audit log endpoint in the API docs - is there a way to access settings changes, deactivations, and allowlist updates via API, or is this something planned? Happy to share more about our use case if it helps prioritize.

In the meantime, the scheduled CSV export from the admin console is the closest option, though I know that's not ideal for automated pipelines. I'll follow up if there's any update on API access timelines.

subject: Mobile app crashes immediately on launch for all users
body: Since this morning our mobile app crashes within a second of opening, before even reaching the login screen, on both iOS and Android devices across our team of 8. We haven't pushed any config changes recently. Two of our staff who were mid-session offline yesterday also lost unsaved data when the app crashed and wouldn't reopen. This is completely blocking us from using the mobile app at all.
answer: This is a serious issue and we're escalating it right away given the full crash-on-launch impact. Could you tell us the app version and device OS versions affected so we can try to reproduce it? We're also checking recent client-side releases for anything that might explain a launch-time failure and will update you as soon as we have a fix or workaround, including anything we can do about the lost offline session data.

subject: Audit log missing entries for admin role changes
body: We're reviewing our audit log for a compliance check and noticed that role change events for at least 6 admin accounts between August 1st and August 15th are missing entirely, even though we confirmed those changes happened via our change management tickets. Deactivation events for the same period are showing up fine, just not the permission/settings changes. This gap is a problem for our upcoming audit.
answer: Thank you for catching this - a gap specifically in role-change logging while deactivation events log correctly points to an issue in how those events are captured rather than a display problem. We're pulling the raw event records for August 1-15 on Apex Robotics' account to see if the data exists but isn't surfacing, or if it wasn't captured at all. We'll update you with findings as soon as possible given the audit timeline.

subject: Scheduled sync delays on legal document connector
body:
We've noticed our scheduled sync for the legal case management connector has been running 45-60 minutes late for the past three days (Oct 14-16). It's set to run at 6:00 AM UTC but the last three runs started at 6:52, 7:10, and 6:48 respectively. Downstream reports that depend on this data are now stale by the time our legal team reviews them each morning.

Can you confirm if there's a queue backlog on your end, or if this is something we need to adjust in our sync window configuration?
answer: Thanks for flagging this - I can see the delayed runs on your legal connector sync and we're looking into whether this is a queue congestion issue on our processing cluster. In the meantime, could you let us know if you have any other high-frequency syncs scheduled around that same 6 AM UTC window? That will help us narrow down if it's a scheduling collision versus a broader latency issue on our side.

subject: Need to adjust seat count on our Starter plan
body:
I'm managing our Northwind account for Harbor Travel and we currently have 7 seats provisioned, but two employees left the company last month and we never removed their access. I'd like to reduce our seat count to 5 and get a prorated credit or refund applied to our next invoice.

Can someone walk me through how to do this from the admin console, or do I need billing to make the change manually?
answer: Happy to help with this. You can remove the two inactive users from the Team Members page under Account Settings, which will automatically adjust your seat count for the next billing cycle. Since you're on a monthly plan, we don't prorate mid-cycle, but I've flagged your account so our billing team can review whether a partial credit applies given the timing - you should hear back within one business day.

subject: Scheduled data sync failing intermittently for education connector
body:
We manage the Northwind account for Atlas Capital and have noticed our nightly scheduled sync to the student records connector has failed 4 times in the last 10 days (Oct 5, 8, 11, 13). Each failure shows a generic 'sync incomplete' status in the dashboard with no further detail, and we have to manually retrigger it each time.

Given we have nearly 1600 seats relying on this data being current each morning, this is becoming a real operational concern. Could someone look into what's causing the intermittent failures and whether there's a way to get more detailed error logging surfaced to us?
answer: Thank you for the detailed timeline - intermittent sync failures without clear error detail are frustrating and I want to get to the bottom of this quickly. I'm escalating this to our pipelines team to pull the internal logs for those four failed runs and identify the root cause; we'll also look at exposing more granular error messages in the dashboard going forward. I'll follow up within one business day with findings or a workaround.

subject: Incorrect seat count on latest invoice - overcharged
body:
Our invoice dated October 1st shows 262 seats billed, but we only have 240 active users provisioned in the admin console as of this morning. This is the second consecutive month this discrepancy has shown up, and last month's support ticket said it was resolved. We need this corrected and a refund issued for the overage before we can process payment on our end.

Invoice number is INV-88213. This is impacting our ability to close our books for the month, so we need a quick turnaround.
answer: I'm sorry this has recurred - I understand the urgency given your month-end close. I've pulled invoice INV-88213 and confirmed the discrepancy between billed and active seats; I'm escalating this directly to billing to issue a corrected invoice and refund for the overage today. I'll also ask them to investigate why the seat sync from admin console to billing failed again so we can prevent a third occurrence.

subject: Feature request: real-time Salesforce sync for opportunity data
body:
Our sales ops team relies on the Salesforce integration to pull opportunity and account data into Northwind dashboards, but currently it only syncs every 4 hours. For a logistics business where deal velocity matters, this delay means our forecasting dashboards are often working off stale data during the day.

We'd like to request either a real-time sync option or at minimum a configurable sync interval down to 15-30 minutes. We're also integrated with Okta, Slack, and Jira and would love to see similar sync frequency improvements across those connectors if this is on the roadmap.
answer: Thanks for the detailed feedback - this is a great use case for prioritizing sync frequency improvements. Real-time sync for Salesforce isn't currently available, but configurable intervals down to 15 minutes are on our roadmap for this quarter. I'll log this request with our integrations product team and include your notes on Okta, Slack, and Jira as well, since we're evaluating sync frequency holistically across connectors.

subject: Requesting increased upload retry limit for large file batches
body:
We're integrating with the Storage API to upload batches of product images, and roughly 3-5% of our uploads fail with a 503 status after the default 2 retries when file sizes exceed 50MB. We'd like to request either a configurable retry count or exponential backoff parameter we can set per-request, since our current workaround is manually re-queuing failed uploads which adds latency to our catalog pipeline.

We're also curious whether increasing our storage quota would help, or if this is purely a transient throughput issue on the upload endpoint.
answer: Thanks for the detailed writeup. The 503s on larger files are typically transient throughput limits rather than a quota issue, so increasing your quota likely won't resolve this on its own. That said, a configurable retry/backoff parameter is a reasonable ask - I'm submitting this as a feature request to our API team, and in the meantime I'd recommend implementing client-side exponential backoff with 4-5 retries as a workaround for files over 50MB.

subject: Unable to restore files from backup - restore stuck at 0%
body:
I'm trying to restore a backup snapshot from September 28th after we accidentally deleted a folder of vendor contracts. The restore job has been sitting at 0% progress for over 3 hours now, and there's no error message, just a spinning status indicator in the dashboard.

We operate on a small team and this data is time-sensitive for a vendor renewal happening this week. Could someone check the status of restore job ID RST-4471 and let us know if it's actually processing or stuck?
answer: I understand the time pressure here and I'm looking into restore job RST-4471 right now. Initial check shows the job is registered in our queue but hasn't started processing, which suggests it may be stuck behind a backlog - I'm escalating this to our storage team to manually kick it off or diagnose the hang. I'll update you within the next hour with progress.

subject: Upload-Fehler bei Dateien über 20MB seit heute Morgen
body:
Seit heute Morgen (ca. 8:30 Uhr) schlagen bei uns Uploads von Dateien über 20MB fehl. Die Fehlermeldung im Dashboard zeigt 'Upload failed: quota exceeded', obwohl wir laut unserem Speicher-Dashboard erst bei 62% unseres Kontingents liegen. Betroffen sind mehrere Nutzer in unserem Team, nicht nur ein einzelner Account.

Da wir tägliche Backups über diesen Upload-Pfad laufen lassen, ist das für uns dringend. Können Sie prüfen, ob es ein Problem mit der Kontingentberechnung gibt?
answer: Vielen Dank für die genaue Beschreibung. Eine Fehlermeldung zur Kontingentüberschreitung bei tatsächlich nur 62% Auslastung deutet auf ein Problem bei der Berechnung des verfügbaren Speicherplatzes hin - wir eskalieren dies sofort an unser Storage-Team, da mehrere Nutzer betroffen sind und Ihre täglichen Backups blockiert werden. Wir melden uns innerhalb der nächsten Stunden mit einem Update oder einer vorübergehenden Kontingenterhöhung als Workaround.

subject: Shared dashboard permissions not respecting viewer-only role
body:
We recently shared a quarterly performance dashboard with a group of external viewers, but a few of them reported they can see and use the export button, even though their role is set to Viewer. I'd expect Viewer-level access to hide export and editing controls entirely based on our permissions documentation.

Can someone confirm whether this is expected behavior for the Pro plan sharing settings, or if there's a bug in how the Viewer role restricts chart export options?

subject: Okta app assignment not syncing new user groups

subject: quick question

subject: Dashboard charts broken across the workspace since this morning

subject: Alert routing sending duplicate emails to entire distribution lists

subject: PDF export issue

subject: Scheduled syncs failing intermittently with stale data downstream

subject: Bulk user deactivation via API not reflecting in Admin Console
body: We're integrating the Admin Console API to manage user lifecycle for our 178-seat retail workspace, and we've run into an issue where deactivating users via the DELETE /admin/users/{id} endpoint returns a 200 success but the user still shows as 'Active' in the console UI for up to 20 minutes afterward. subject: Need to upgrade plan and get partial refund applied correctly

I'll calculate the exact proration amount based on today's date and send it over for your approval before we process the plan change.

subject: Need clearer guidance on handling transform failures in pipeline retries
body: We're building an integration against the Data Pipelines API and running into transform step failures on about 5% of our records, mostly due to malformed date fields in source data. The API returns a generic 'transform_error' code without specifying which field or record caused it, making it hard to build proper error handling on our end. Is there a way to get more granular error output, and does the retry mechanism skip failed records or does it block the whole batch?
answer: Good questions - currently the retry mechanism will retry the entire batch by default, though you can set the 'skip_on_error' flag in your pipeline config to skip individual failed records and continue processing the rest. On granular error output, we don't currently return the specific field or record ID in the transform_error response, but I'm passing this along as a documentation gap and feature request since it would clearly help your integration.

subject: Need programmatic access to audit logs with IP allowlisting support
body: We're integrating with the Admin Console API for our 18-seat workspace and need to pull audit log entries (specifically user deactivation and settings change events) programmatically for compliance reporting. The GET /admin/audit-logs endpoint works, but we also need to restrict which IPs can call this endpoint - is there an allowlist feature for API access, or do we need to handle that restriction entirely on our end?
answer: The audit log endpoint you're using is the right one for pulling deactivation and settings change events. We don't currently have IP allowlisting at the API gateway level for Starter plan workspaces - that's available on higher tiers - so for now you'd need to handle IP restriction on your end, but I'll flag this as a feature request given the compliance use case you've described.

subject: Question about upgrading from Starter and seat pricing
body: I'm the workspace admin for Blue Freight and we're considering upgrading from our current Starter plan since we're approaching our 25-seat limit and want more headroom. Could you walk me through how seat-based pricing changes if we move to the next tier, and whether unused seats roll over or if we're billed for the full block regardless of actual usage? Also wondering if there's documentation comparing feature differences beyond just seat count.
answer: Happy to walk you through this - on the next tier up, seats are billed in blocks rather than individually, so you'd be charged for the full block regardless of exact usage, though this often works out cheaper per seat once you're near a limit like yours. I'll send over our plan comparison documentation which covers feature differences in detail, and we can set up a quick call if it's helpful to review pricing scenarios for your specific seat count.

subject: Webhook signature verification failing after v2 deprecation notice
body: We got the deprecation notice for the v1 webhook signing scheme and switched our verification code to the new HMAC header format last night. Since then, every webhook delivery to our /orders/callback endpoint fails signature checks with 'invalid_signature' even though we copied the sample code from the SDK docs (northwind-sdk v4.2.1). We're also seeing 429s on the retry attempts, which is compounding the issue. This is blocking order confirmations for Ember Freight retail partners right now.

Can you confirm which SDK method you're using to compute the signature (verifyWebhook vs manual HMAC)? In the meantime, we're escalating this as P1 and will send you a corrected code snippet within the hour so you can unblock order confirmations.

subject: Request to enable extended audit log retention and filtering
body: I'm reviewing our compliance requirements for Q3 and noticed the Admin Console audit log only retains 90 days of events, which is short of the 1-year window our fintech auditors expect. On the filtering performance, that slowdown on wide date ranges with the Deactivation filter is a known issue we're actively optimizing; I'll open a tracking ticket and update you once the fix ships.

subject: Need ability to scope API keys to specific endpoints
body: As the workspace admin for Summit Labs I'm setting up API access for our teaching assistants and noticed our current keys grant full account access with no way to restrict them to just the read-only /courses and /enrollments endpoints. This is a problem since students occasionally see these keys in shared notebooks. We generated key sk_live_7f2... last week and had to revoke it within a day because of this exact issue.

subject: Deactivated users still showing as active in allowlist

subject: Question about backup retention policy for Storage

subject: Need to require MFA enrollment for all users via SSO

I'd recommend giving your team a short grace period notice before turning this on, and I'm happy to walk through the rollout steps with you if needed.

subject: Need to restore storage bucket from backup after accidental deletion

subject: How do users unsubscribe from notification emails

subject: Dashboards taking 20+ seconds to load for our team
body:

This is happening consistently for our manufacturing metrics dashboard which has around 8 charts and is shared with 40+ users.
