answer: Thanks for reporting this - a crash right after triggering Face ID following the recent update points to a permissions or entitlement issue in that release, and I've flagged it as an active incident for our mobile team. In the meantime, please have your staff continue using password login, which you've confirmed works, while we investigate device logs from affected users. Could you send us the iOS versions and device models affected so we can reproduce it faster?

subject: Okta SSO app integration returning errors for new user provisioning
body: We're using the Northwind Okta app to manage SSO and SCIM provisioning for our 80 users across Apex Foods. Since last week, new users assigned in Okta fail to provision into Northwind with the error 'SCIM request failed: 400 invalid schema' logged in Okta's system log. Existing users can still log in fine, but we can't onboard new hires through the automated flow. We also noticed there's no way to sync group-based role assignments, which would be a helpful feature addition. Could you look into the provisioning error as a priority and let us know if group sync is on the roadmap?
answer: Thank you for the detailed report - the SCIM 400 invalid schema error on new user creation suggests a mismatch in the attribute mapping introduced in a recent update to our Okta app; we're treating this as a priority fix given it's blocking onboarding. I'll follow up with a workaround for provisioning new hires manually in the meantime, and I've also logged your request for group-based role sync as a feature request with our integrations product team.

subject: ROLE MAPPING SSO
body: NEED HELP MAPPING SSO GROUPS TO ROLES ASAP PLS ADVISE
answer: Thanks for reaching out. To map your SSO groups to Northwind roles, go to Identity > SSO > Attribute Mapping and add a rule that maps your IdP group claim to the desired role name. I can walk you through the exact claim format for Granite Travel's setup if you send me your current SAML assertion or OIDC group claim name.

subject: Workspace settings - need documentation on allowlist and deactivation order
body:
I'm trying to update our workspace settings to add an IP allowlist and also deactivate two former employees, but I got this when saving:

[2024-05-14 09:12:03] ERROR WorkspaceSettingsController: validation failed
code: ALLOWLIST_CONFLICT
message: "Cannot deactivate user while active session bound to unlisted IP"
user_id: usr_4471
ip: 203.0.113.44

Can you tell me whether I need to deactivate users first or set the allowlist first? Also, do you have documentation on the recommended order of operations for this?
answer: Good question, and thanks for pasting the log. The ALLOWLIST_CONFLICT error means the user's active session IP isn't yet on your allowlist, so the system blocks deactivation to avoid locking out a valid session. The recommended order is: add the IP allowlist entries first, save, then deactivate the users. I'll also send over our Admin Console settings guide, which covers this sequencing in detail.

subject: Transform step failing intermittently on retail-orders connector
body: Since May 10th our retail-orders pipeline has been failing on the transform step roughly 1 in 5 runs. The error shown in the run log is 'Transform timeout after 30000ms on batch 14/22' and the affected batches don't seem to have unusually large payloads, around 2MB each. We've retried manually each time and it eventually succeeds, but it's adding 20-30 minutes of latency daily.
answer: Thanks for the detail. Intermittent transform timeouts on batches that succeed on retry usually point to resource contention on our transform workers rather than payload size. I'm opening an investigation into worker load around your pipeline's schedule window and will check whether batch 14/22 correlates with a specific node. In the meantime, could you confirm the exact pipeline ID so I can pull execution traces for the last week?

subject: Request to add native Jira link to Integrations catalog
body: We currently rely on a manual Zapier bridge to sync Northwind incidents into Jira, and it's becoming unreliable for our operations team across 186 seats. Could you tell me if a native Jira integration is on the roadmap, similar to the existing Salesforce and Okta connectors? We'd like to link tickets bidirectionally with our Jira Service Management instance.
answer: Thanks for flagging this. A native Jira integration is currently in our product backlog alongside requests from a few other Pro customers, though I don't have a committed release date yet. I'll log Ember Retail's request with the details you gave and loop in our product team so you're notified as soon as it moves into active development.

subject: Need to change audit log retention and add escalation alerting
body: We'd like to change our audit log retention from the current default and set up an alert whenever a deactivation or allowlist change happens, since we only have 6 seats and want tighter oversight. Can you confirm what retention periods are available on our plan and how to configure escalation notifications for these specific event types?
answer: On the Starter plan, audit log retention is fixed at 90 days, but I can submit a request to extend it for Ember Academy if needed. For escalation alerts on deactivation and allowlist events, go to Admin Console > Audit Log > Alert Rules and create a rule filtered to those event types with your admin email as the recipient. Let me know once you've tried it and I'll confirm the alerts are firing correctly.

subject: pipeline issue
body: hey so we've been building out a new reporting setup for the media desk and its taken a while to get the connectors right, we finally got the source data flowing in properly last week which was a releif. anyway now that its running the actual problem is the transform step keeps failing wiht a schema mismatch error on the 'campaign_id' feild, it says expected string got integer, happens on every run since tuesday. can you tell us how to fix the mapping or is htis a bug on your side
answer: Thanks for the background, and sorry for the trouble. The schema mismatch on campaign_id is usually caused by a source connector change upstream that started sending integers instead of strings; this isn't a bug on our side but our transform step can be configured to coerce types automatically. Go to Data Pipelines > Transform > Schema Rules and add a type coercion rule for campaign_id to string, and that should clear the failures going forward. If it doesn't resolve after the next run, send me the pipeline ID and I'll dig into the connector logs.

subject: Offline mode not syncing after reconnect - affecting field teams
body: Since this morning's app update, our field agents using offline mode are losing queued data when they reconnect. The app shows 'Sync complete' but records created while offline (delivery confirmations, mostly) never appear in the dashboard. This is affecting a large portion of our 255-seat logistics team across multiple regions and is blocking end-of-day reporting.
answer: This is a serious issue and we're treating it as high priority. We're escalating to the mobile engineering team right now to investigate the sync confirmation logic in today's release, since a false 'Sync complete' state pointing to data loss needs immediate attention. Can you send the app version, device OS versions in use, and one or two affected record timestamps so we can trace exactly where the sync is dropping records?

subject: Deactivated user still able to log in and access billing data
body: I deactivated a former employee's account in Admin Console yesterday afternoon, but they were still able to log into the dashboard this morning and view invoice data. The audit log shows the deactivation event as completed, but the account status still reads 'Active' in the user list. This is a serious access control problem for us given the sensitive billing information involved.
answer: Thank you for reporting this immediately, this is being treated as a high-priority access control issue. We're confirming whether the deactivation event failed to propagate to the session layer, which would explain the mismatch between the audit log and the active status shown. As an immediate step, please force-expire that user's sessions from Admin Console > Users > Sessions while we investigate the root cause, and we'll update you within the next couple of hours.

subject: Charged for upgrade but seats not updated
body: I upgraded our plan on May 3rd to add more seats for our analytics team, and the invoice shows the higher charge, but the seat count in our account still shows the old limit. We're at 24 seats currently and need at least 4 more provisioned to onboard new analysts this week.
answer: Thanks for letting us know, and sorry for the mismatch. It sounds like the billing charge processed correctly but the seat provisioning step didn't sync afterward. I'll check the upgrade transaction from May 3rd and manually apply the correct seat count to your account, then confirm back to you once it's reflected so your new analysts can be onboarded.

subject: Okta SSO integration down - users cannot log in
body: Our Okta app integration for Northwind stopped working as of about an hour ago. Users attempting SSO login get redirected back to Okta with error 'invalid_client' and cannot access the dashboard at all. This is blocking our entire legal team from getting into their accounts and we need this resolved urgently.
answer: This has been escalated immediately as it's blocking all logins for your team. The invalid_client error typically means the client secret or redirect URI on our side became out of sync with your Okta app configuration. We're checking the integration record for Orion Analytics right now and will contact you within minutes with either a fix or a temporary workaround so your team can regain access.

subject: Mobile app crashes immediately on launch - iOS
body: Since this morning our field team at Cobalt Freight has been unable to open the Northwind mobile app on iOS. It crashes within a second of tapping the icon, before the login screen even appears. Tested on three different iPhones (iOS 17.4) and it happens every time. We rely on this app for daily route logs, so this is blocking about a dozen analysts right now.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. This matches a crash-on-launch issue we've seen tied to a corrupted local cache after the last iOS update. Could you have affected users delete and reinstall the app, and let me know if the crash persists on a fresh install? In the meantime I'm flagging this to our mobile team to check crash logs from your account.

subject: Storage retention policy deleting files before 30-day window
body: We've confirmed that files uploaded to Summit Works storage buckets are being purged after roughly 10 days instead of the 30-day retention we configured. Two backup archives from last week (upload IDs SW-8841 and SW-8842) are already gone, and we need them for a compliance audit. This is affecting all uploads across our workspace, not just one folder.
answer: This is a serious issue and we're treating it as an active incident. We're pulling the retention configuration logs for your workspace now to see why the policy isn't honoring the 30-day setting, and checking whether the deleted archives can be restored from our backend snapshots. I'll update you within the hour with findings and next steps.

subject: Biometric login failing intermittently on mobile app
body: Several store managers at Ember Freight are reporting that Face ID and fingerprint login on the mobile app randomly fails and drops them back to the password screen, even though biometrics work fine in other apps on the same device. It's happening across both Android and iOS, roughly 1 in 5 attempts. With 178 users depending on quick access during shift changes, this is becoming a real friction point.
answer: Thanks for flagging this, we know intermittent auth failures are disruptive during shift changes. Can you confirm the app version your teams are running and whether this started after a recent update? I'm escalating this to our mobile engineering team to review biometric session handling, and I'll follow up with a workaround for affected users in the meantime.

subject: question
body: We're looking to move a subset of our Summit Health teams from their current plan to a higher tier mid-cycle, but I want to understand how proration works and whether upgrading affects the billing date for the whole account or just the upgraded seats. We have 273 seats total and want to avoid disrupting invoicing for the rest of the org.
answer: Good question, and this is a common scenario. When you upgrade a subset of seats mid-cycle, we prorate the difference for just those seats and apply it to your next invoice, without shifting the billing date for the rest of the account. I can walk you through the exact numbers for your seat count if you tell me how many seats you're planning to upgrade.

subject: Connector authentication failing for Data Pipelines integration
body: Our main data pipeline connector to our CRM has started failing authentication as of this morning. The pipeline log shows 'auth token rejected: invalid_grant' on every run since 6:40am, and no data has synced in over 4 hours. We rely on this feed for daily reporting to leadership at Summit Capital, so this is urgent for us.
answer: I understand the urgency, especially with your reporting cadence. The invalid_grant error usually means the stored refresh token expired or was revoked on the CRM side. Can you check whether anyone recently rotated API credentials in your CRM admin panel? While you check, I'm also pulling the connector logs on our end to confirm timing and see if a manual token refresh will resolve it.

subject: Repeated card failures blocking seat renewal for Quill Partners
body: We've had three consecutive failed card charges this week when trying to renew our 4 seats, each returning a generic 'payment declined' message with no further detail. Our card is active and has sufficient funds according to our bank, so we suspect something on Northwind's side. We also noticed one invoice, INV-2291, shows as unpaid despite an earlier successful charge.
answer: Sorry for the trouble this is causing. Generic decline messages can sometimes come from a mismatch between the billing address on file and your card issuer's records, but I want to check invoice INV-2291 directly since that discrepancy shouldn't be happening. I'm looking into both issues now and will confirm whether a manual retry or a refund adjustment is needed.

subject: API rate limits hitting us far below documented threshold
body: We're getting 429 errors on our integration well before reaching the rate limit documented for our plan. Our dashboard shows we're averaging 340 requests per minute, but the docs state Pro tier allows 1000 req/min. This started two days ago and is affecting several webhook consumers across our energy monitoring systems at Blue Analytics.
answer: Thanks for the specifics, that gap between documented and actual limits shouldn't be happening. I'm escalating this to our API platform team to check if there's a misconfigured rate limit bucket on your account, possibly related to a recent SDK version change. Can you share which SDK version and endpoint paths are triggering the 429s so we can narrow it down faster?

subject: Speicherkontingent Problem
body: Wir haben seit letzte Woche immer wieder die Meldung 'Quota exceeded' beim Hochladen von Backup Dateien, obwohl unser Kontigent laut Dashbord noch nicht voll ist. Es betrift mehrere Abteilungen bei Pioneer Analytics und wir können grade keine neuen Backups mehr hochladen was für unsere Compliance Vorgaben kritisch ist. Bitte um schnelle Rückmeldung da wir ein Audit nächste Woche haben.
answer: Vielen Dank für die Meldung, das klingt nach einer Diskrepanz zwischen der angezeigten und der tatsächlich berechneten Speichernutzung. Wir prüfen jetzt die Kontingentberechnung für Ihr Konto und schauen, ob es sich um einen Anzeigefehler oder eine echte Grenze handelt. Angesichts des anstehenden Audits behandeln wir das mit hoher Priorität und melden uns schnellstmöglich mit einem Update.

subject: SDK throwing unexpected 500 errors after latest update
body: After updating to SDK version 4.2.1 last night, every call from our webhook handler now returns a 500 with the message 'internal_error: schema mismatch on payload.metadata'. This is blocking all our API Platform integrations at Summit Works, we've had zero successful webhook deliveries since the update. Rolling back to 4.1.9 temporarily fixed it, but we can't stay on the old version long term.
answer: This is helpful detail, thank you. A schema mismatch on payload.metadata suggests our 4.2.1 release may have introduced a breaking change to the webhook payload structure that wasn't properly documented. I'm escalating this to engineering as a likely SDK bug and will report back with either a hotfix timeline or a documented workaround so you can move off 4.1.9 safely.

subject: Duplicate charge needs immediate refund
body: Our card was charged twice for the same invoice this morning, once at 8:02am and again at 8:15am, both for the same amount tied to our 3-seat Starter plan renewal. Invoice numbers are INV-5510 and INV-5511. This is a small account but the double charge has put us over our operating cash buffer for the week, so we need this resolved and refunded urgently.
answer: I'm sorry for the inconvenience this has caused, especially with the cash flow impact. I can confirm the duplicate charge on INV-5511 and I'm processing a refund for that duplicate now, which should reflect back to your card within 3-5 business days. I'll send confirmation once the refund is issued and flag this pattern to our billing team to prevent recurrence.

subject: Connector auth failures on MES sync pipeline
body:
We're seeing repeated authentication failures on our manufacturing MES connector (pipeline id mes-sync-0417) since yesterday around 14:20 UTC. The pipeline retries every 10 minutes and fails with 'OAuth token refresh rejected: invalid_grant'. Data hasn't landed in the warehouse for about 18 hours now and our downstream quality dashboards are showing stale records.

We already re-authorized the connector once this morning but it failed again within an hour. Can someone check if there's an issue on the token refresh service, or if we need to fully re-create the connection?
answer: Thanks for flagging this - an invalid_grant error that recurs after re-auth usually points to a refresh token being revoked on the source system side, but we're also seeing a spike in refresh failures on our end for connectors created before March, so we're checking whether this is a broader issue. I've escalated pipeline mes-sync-0417 to our connector team and will update you within a few hours with either a fix or a workaround to get sync running again.

subject: Shared dashboards showing blank charts for all clinical staff
body:
Since this morning our shared dashboards (used by roughly 40 of our 60 users) are loading with blank chart panels - the legend and axis labels appear but no data renders. This is affecting the patient throughput and staffing dashboards that our clinical leads check every shift. I've confirmed it happens in Chrome and Edge, and clearing cache didn't help.

This started around 8am and is now blocking shift handover reporting. We need this resolved urgently since staff rely on these dashboards to make coverage decisions today.
answer: I understand the urgency given this affects shift handover across your team - I've raised this as a P1 incident. We've had a report from another Pro customer this morning of blank charts tied to a rendering regression in our dashboard service, and our engineering team is actively working a fix. I'll follow up as soon as we have confirmation charts are rendering again, and will let you know if there's an interim workaround such as exporting the underlying data.

subject: Charged for Pro plan but still shows Starter limits
body:
We upgraded from Starter to Pro two days ago on July 9th and the invoice shows we were charged the Pro rate, but our account still shows Starter-level API call limits and only 13 user seats available. Our team of 13 needs the additional seats and higher limits that came with the upgrade.

Can someone check our account and either apply the Pro plan correctly or refund the charge if this can't be fixed quickly? We're blocked from adding two new team members until this is sorted.
answer: Sorry for the mixup - it looks like the payment processed but the plan change didn't fully sync to your account entitlements, which is why you're still seeing Starter limits. I'm manually applying the Pro plan to your account now and will confirm once seat limits and API quotas reflect the upgrade, which should be within the next hour. If it's not resolved by then I'll process a refund while we investigate further.

subject: Clients receiving duplicate email notifications for every alert
body:
Our clients have been getting duplicate copies of every notification email since Monday - some are receiving the same case update alert 2 or 3 times within a minute. This is confusing for our legal clients who think something urgent changed multiple times. We have 14 seats and this is happening across every user's notification rules, not just one.

We haven't changed any notification templates or rules recently. Can you look into why duplicates are being sent and get this stopped as soon as possible?
answer: This is impacting your whole team's client communications so I'm treating it as high priority. Duplicate sends like this are usually caused by a retry loop misfiring on the notification service when the first delivery confirmation is delayed - I'm pulling your notification logs now to confirm the pattern and will push a fix or disable the faulty retry rule as a stopgap. I'll update you within the next few hours with either a resolution or a temporary mitigation.

subject: Request to link Jira issues directly from Integrations panel
body:
We'd like to request the ability to link Jira issues directly from the Integrations panel rather than only being able to trigger webhooks. Right now when an integration sync fails, we have to manually create a Jira ticket and paste in error details - with 292 seats and dozens of integrations running, this manual step is becoming a bottleneck for our logistics ops team.

Ideally we'd want a 'Create Jira issue' action tied to sync failure events, similar to how the Okta connector already supports provisioning triggers. Is this on the roadmap, or is there a workaround using the API?
answer: Thanks for the detailed request - native Jira issue creation from sync failure events isn't available yet, but it's a reasonable extension of what we already support for Okta provisioning triggers, so I'm logging this as a feature request for our integrations team to evaluate. In the meantime, you can achieve something similar today by routing sync failure webhooks to Jira's own incoming webhook endpoint - I can send over a sample payload mapping if that would help your team set it up.

subject: How to speed up dashboard load times with export instead
body:
Our energy operations dashboards with multiple chart panels are taking 15-20 seconds to load, especially the ones shared across our 109-seat team. Rather than waiting on a performance fix, I wanted to ask if there's a way to export the underlying data on a schedule so we can build lighter local views for daily standups.

Is there a supported export option (CSV or API) for dashboard chart data, and can it be scheduled automatically rather than triggered manually each time?
answer: Good question - you can export any chart's underlying data as CSV via the chart menu, and for automation there's a scheduled export option under Dashboard Settings > Exports that can push CSV files to an S3 bucket or email on a daily or hourly cadence. That said, I'd also like to look into why load times are at 15-20 seconds since that's higher than expected for Pro accounts - could you share the dashboard name or ID so I can check chart complexity and query performance on our end?

subject: SDK throwing errors after deprecated webhook fields removed
body:
After your recent API deprecation of the legacy webhook payload fields (event_type_v1 and source_id_legacy), our integration built with the Northwind SDK v3.2 started throwing 'KeyError: source_id_legacy' on every incoming webhook since Tuesday. We rely on these webhooks to sync billing events into our internal reporting for 80 users.

We saw the deprecation notice but the migration guide doesn't mention this field was removed rather than just deprecated. Can you confirm the correct replacement field and whether there's a grace period we can opt into?
answer: Apologies for the disruption - you're right that source_id_legacy was fully removed rather than left as deprecated-but-present, and the migration guide should have called that out more clearly, so I'll get that corrected. The replacement field is source_id in the new payload schema; in the meantime I can re-enable the legacy field on your webhook endpoint for a 14-day grace period while your team updates the SDK integration, just confirm which endpoint IDs need it re-enabled.

subject: SAML login broken for all users after IdP metadata update
body:
We updated our identity provider's SAML metadata yesterday and now none of our 23 users can log in via SSO - everyone gets 'SAML response validation failed: signature mismatch' on the Northwind login page. This is blocking our entire media team from accessing dashboards and billing this morning.

We followed the metadata re-upload steps in your docs but the error persists even after re-uploading the new certificate. Please help urgently as we have no other way in right now.
answer: This is urgent so I've escalated it immediately - a signature mismatch right after a metadata update almost always means the new certificate hasn't fully propagated on our side yet, or the metadata XML has a formatting issue. Can you send me the exact metadata file you uploaded (or a screenshot of the SSO config page) so I can verify it matches what's active on our identity service, and in the meantime I can generate a temporary bypass login link for your admin account so you're not fully locked out.

subject: Need guidance setting up Salesforce sync with Okta provisioning
body:
We're trying to set up the Salesforce integration alongside our existing Okta SSO so that new Salesforce contacts automatically provision matching records in Northwind, but the documentation only covers Salesforce sync in isolation. We have 96 seats across our healthcare team and want this live before our renewal review next month.

Could someone point us to documentation or a guide that covers combining Okta-based provisioning with Salesforce contact sync, or walk us through the recommended setup on a call?
answer: Happy to help get this configured ahead of your renewal review - combining Okta provisioning with Salesforce sync isn't fully covered in the public docs yet since it's a slightly less common setup, so I'll put together a step-by-step guide tailored to your configuration. I can also set up a short call this week with one of our integration specialists to walk through the field mappings and provisioning rules live if that's easier than working from docs alone.

subject: Push notifications not arriving on Android after app update
body: Since updating to the latest Mobile App version, push notifications for order status changes aren't arriving on Android devices for several of our retail team members, though iOS seems fine. Notification settings show as enabled in the app and in device settings. This isn't blocking work since email alerts still come through, but it's inconvenient for warehouse staff who rely on the push alerts while moving around.
answer: Thanks for the report - this looks related to a known issue with FCM token refresh on the latest Android build that we're already tracking. As a low-impact workaround, having affected users log out and back into the app usually forces a fresh token registration and restores push delivery. We expect a fix in the next app release and I'll update this ticket once it's live.

subject: Need to restore storage bucket from backup after accidental deletion
body: One of our warehouse staff accidentally deleted the 'invoices-2024' folder from our Storage container yesterday around 3pm. We need this restored from backup as soon as possible since it contains active vendor invoices we need for month-end close on the 5th. Container ID is stor-summit-7841. Can you confirm what restore points are available and how long a restore of roughly 40GB would take?
answer: Thanks for flagging this quickly. I can see backup snapshots for stor-summit-7841 taken daily at 1am UTC, so we have a clean point from before the deletion. I'm initiating a restore to a new folder path so we don't overwrite any files created since yesterday, and will confirm once it completes, typically within 1-2 hours for that volume. I'll update this ticket as soon as the restore job finishes.

subject: Intermittent upload failures with 413 errors on Storage API
body: We're integrating the Storage API for bulk product image uploads and starting this morning around 9:10am UTC we've been seeing intermittent 413 Payload Too Large errors on files well under our documented 100MB limit, some as small as 8MB. This started after we increased our batch size from 20 to 50 concurrent uploads. Roughly 1 in 15 requests fail. Our account ID is sp-86421. Can you check if there's a quota or rate limit tied to concurrent upload count rather than file size?
answer: Good catch - this does look related to concurrent request handling rather than individual file size. Looking at account sp-86421 I see your recent burst of 50 concurrent uploads is tripping a per-connection buffer limit that returns 413 instead of a clearer 429. I'd recommend capping concurrency at 30 for now while we push a fix to return the correct error code, and I'm also flagging your retention settings for review since I noticed some uploads are landing outside your configured window.

subject: SDK throwing deprecated method errors after upgrade
body: We updated to northwind-sdk v4.2.0 last week and now every call to client.webhooks.subscribe() throws 'Method subscribe() is deprecated, use registerWebhook() instead' as a hard error rather than a warning, which is breaking our booking confirmation flow. We're also hitting rate limit responses (429) more frequently than before, roughly 200 per hour versus the previous 20. Our app ID is lf-travel-203. Can you clarify if the rate limit thresholds changed with this SDK version?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. Version 4.2.0 did change subscribe() from a soft-deprecation warning to a thrown exception ahead of full removal next quarter, so switching to registerWebhook() will resolve that immediately. On the rate limits, app lf-travel-203 is on the standard tier which didn't change, but the new SDK batches webhook registration calls differently, which likely explains the increase - I'd suggest adding registerWebhook() calls in batches of 10 with a short delay to stay under the 429 threshold.

subject: URGENT: Connector authentication failure exposing patient data sync errors
body: Our EHR connector (connector-id cob-health-552) started failing authentication at 2:14am UTC today with 'invalid_grant: token expired or revoked' and has been retrying every 5 minutes since, but we've noticed several sync batches went through with stale credentials before failing, meaning some patient record updates may have synced to the wrong destination table. This is a healthcare data integrity concern and we need immediate confirmation on what data was affected.
answer: This has been escalated immediately given the potential data integrity impact. We've disabled connector cob-health-552 to stop further sync attempts and our security and data teams are pulling the sync logs from the last 24 hours to identify exactly which batches ran with the expired credential. We'll have an initial scope of affected records within the hour and will walk you through re-authentication and remediation steps as soon as we confirm the blast radius.

subject: audit log question
body: so we have been using northwind for a while now for our logistics team and everything has mostly been fine, we manage about 204 users across a few departments and recently our compliance team asked us to pull audit logs going back further then whats showing up in the console. we went to admin console audit log section and it only shows past 30 days of activty. is their a way to extend the retention window or export older logs, also the docs page for audit log settings seems to be missing the export button thats mentioned in the help article.
answer: Thanks for reaching out - on the Pro plan, audit logs are retained and viewable for 30 days by default, but you can request an extended export covering up to 12 months by submitting a request through Admin Console > Compliance > Data Requests. I'll also flag the documentation gap you mentioned about the missing export button so our docs team can update that article to match the current console layout.

subject: Files being deleted before our required retention period
body: We discovered today that client contract documents uploaded in January are already gone from our Storage account, even though as a legal firm we're required to retain these for at least 7 years. Our retention policy was set to '7 years' when we configured the account, but checking the folder 'client-contracts-2024' shows files from January and February missing entirely. This is a serious compliance issue for us given the nature of our business.
answer: I understand the urgency here given your compliance requirements, and I'm treating this as high priority. I'm pulling the audit trail for your storage account now to determine whether this was a policy misconfiguration or a deletion event, and I've already located a backup snapshot from January that appears to contain the missing files in client-contracts-2024. I'll confirm the root cause and begin restoration shortly, and will follow up with a full explanation once we've traced exactly what happened.

subject: Question about retention policy behavior on file versions
body: I noticed that when we update a file in our storage bucket, the older version seems to disappear immediately rather than following the 90-day retention policy we configured. We tested this by uploading a report, updating it twice, and checking version history - only the current version was listed. Is this expected behavior for overwritten files, or should prior versions be retained under our policy?
answer: Good question - retention policies apply to deletions but versioning on overwrite is a separate setting that needs to be explicitly enabled per bucket, which explains why you're not seeing prior versions retained. I can walk you through enabling version retention on your bucket so future overwrites keep historical copies for the 90-day window you've configured, just let me know the bucket name and I'll set it up with you.

subject: Widespread upload failures affecting multiple teams today
body: Since around 11am UTC today we've had reports from at least six different teams across our logistics operations that file uploads to Storage are timing out or failing with 'upload_failed: connection reset' errors, particularly for files over 200MB. This is affecting our shipment documentation workflow across multiple regions and we're getting escalations internally. Can someone confirm if there's a known issue on your end right now?
answer: We're aware of degraded performance on the Storage upload path affecting larger files and our infrastructure team is actively investigating an issue with connection handling on uploads over 150MB that began around 10:45am UTC. We're treating this as an active incident, will post updates as we identify root cause, and recommend temporarily chunking uploads under 150MB where possible as a workaround while we resolve it.

subject: SSO role mapping not applying correct permissions after group changes
body: We updated our SAML group mappings last week to route our 'Media-Editors' group to the Editor role instead of Viewer, but several users are still logging in with Viewer-level access even after re-authenticating and clearing sessions. We checked the identity provider side and the group assignment looks correct there. Can you check if role mapping changes need to propagate on your end, or if there's caching happening on our SSO configuration for account vc-media-21?
answer: Thanks for the detailed troubleshooting you've already done. Role mapping changes should apply on next login, but I can see account vc-media-21 has a cached mapping table that only refreshes every 24 hours unless manually triggered, which is likely why your users are still seeing Viewer access. I'm forcing a manual refresh now and will confirm once affected users show the correct Editor role.

subject: Requesting flexibility for scheduled sync frequency limits
body: Our data team wants to run our nightly Data Pipelines sync more frequently, ideally every 2 hours instead of once daily, to keep our retail inventory connector in sync with sales data across 265 seats. When we tried adjusting the schedule in the console, it capped us at daily frequency for our connector type. Is hourly or sub-daily scheduling available on our plan, and if so how do we enable it?
answer: Sub-daily scheduling is available starting at the tier above your current plan, and I'd be happy to help evaluate whether upgrading makes sense given your sync frequency needs. In the meantime, I can manually configure a 4-hour interval as an interim step within your current plan's limits if that would help bridge the gap - let me know your connector ID and I'll get that set up.

subject: Rate limit hit after rotating API key
body: Hey, we rotatd our production API key yestrday for Blue Media's integration and now we keep getting 429 errors even tho we're way under the 1000 req/min limit that shoud apply to Starter plan. Our SDK version is 2.3.1 and the old key worked fine for months. Error is 'rate_limit_exceeded' but our dashbord shows only 120 req/min. Can someone check if the new key got assigned to the wrong tier by mistake?
answer: Thanks for flagging this — a mismatch between key tier assignment and plan limits can definitely cause this kind of false rate limiting. Could you send us the last 6 characters of the new key ID and a timestamp of a recent 429 response so we can trace it in our logs? In the meantime, try reverting to the previous key if it's still active to keep your integration running while we investigate.

subject: Need to restore files, backup question
body:
I handle finance ops for Summit Legal and wanted to give some background first. We've been on Northwind Storage for about a year now and generally things have been smooth, we upload contract PDFs nightly through our internal tool and everything syncs fine. Last week we noticed our upload quota usage spiked unexpectedly which we're still investigating separately.

The actual issue is that yesterday one of our paralegals accidentally deleted a folder containing about 340 signed contracts from March 2024, and we need to restore it from the backup snapshot dated 2024-03-31. When I try to trigger a restore from the admin panel it just spins and then times out after a few minutes with no error message.
answer: I'm sorry to hear about the deleted folder — since this affects active case files I've escalated this to our storage recovery team as high priority. Restore timeouts on large folder sets sometimes occur due to a backend indexing delay; can you confirm the exact folder path and the account region, and we'll manually verify the March 31 snapshot integrity and initiate the restore from our side while we investigate the panel timeout.

subject: URGENT: exposed API key leaking transaction webhooks, possible data loss
body: We discovered this morning that one of Atlas Foods' production API keys was accidentally committed to a public repository three days ago. Since then we've seen webhook delivery logs showing payloads sent to an endpoint we don't recognize, and it looks like several transaction records may have been altered or deleted from our downstream system as a result. We need this key revoked immediately and need to understand what data was exposed via the SDK calls made with it.
answer: This has been escalated immediately to our security incident team as P0. We are revoking the affected API key right now and pulling the full access log for the past 72 hours to identify every request and webhook delivery made with it. Please avoid deleting any local logs on your end in the meantime, and we'll follow up within the hour with our findings and next steps for containment.

subject: Guidance needed on SSO role mapping for large rollout
body:
We're rolling out SSO across Granite Legal's full 243-seat account this quarter and need clarity on how role mapping works with our identity provider groups. Specifically, we have groups like 'Partners', 'Associates', and 'Paralegals' in our IdP and want each mapped to different Northwind admin roles automatically at provisioning time rather than assigning manually.

Could you point us to documentation on attribute-based role mapping and confirm whether MFA enforcement can be tied to specific mapped roles rather than applied account-wide?
answer: Great timing — we do support attribute-based role mapping via SAML group claims, and you can scope MFA enforcement per role group as well. I'll send over our SSO provisioning guide which covers the claim mapping syntax and role assignment rules, and I'd also like to set up a short call with our identity specialist to walk through your specific group structure before you roll this out broadly.

subject: Late-arriving records not reprocessed in pipeline
body: We're integrating our sensor data feed into a Data Pipeline connector for Willow Academy and noticed that records arriving more than 15 minutes after their event timestamp aren't being picked up in the daily aggregation job. For example, a batch timestamped 2024-05-10 09:00 that actually arrived at 09:22 was silently dropped from the 09:00 window's output. Is there a late-arrival tolerance setting we can configure, or is this expected connector behavior?
answer: Good question — by default our pipeline connectors use a fixed 10-minute lateness window before finalizing a batch, so records arriving after that get excluded rather than retried. We're adding a configurable lateness tolerance in an upcoming release, but for now I'd recommend widening your aggregation window or enabling the late-data reprocessing flag in the connector settings, which I can walk you through if helpful.

subject: Feature request: API key scoping before we hit deprecation deadline
body: Granite Robotics is planning our API key strategy ahead of the announced deprecation of the legacy key format on 2024-09-01. Right now we only have account-wide keys, but for our logistics integrations we really need per-warehouse scoped keys so a compromised key in one facility doesn't expose data from others. Is scoped key support planned before the deprecation cutoff, and if not, what's the recommended migration path for 174 seats using the old format?
answer: Thanks for raising this ahead of the deadline — scoped API keys are on our near-term roadmap, though they won't ship before the September 1 legacy format cutoff. For now, the recommended path is to generate separate keys per warehouse project as a workaround for isolation, and I'll add your account to the beta list for scoped keys once that feature is available so you can migrate cleanly.

subject: Upgrade options and refund for double invoice
body: I'm reviewing billing for Granite Travel and noticed we were charged twice this month, once on the 3rd and once on the 14th, both showing as the same invoice amount. We're also considering upgrading from Starter since we're bumping into seat limits with only 8 seats currently, but want to understand how prorating would work if we upgrade mid-cycle. Could you clarify the refund process for the duplicate charge and outline upgrade pricing tiers?
answer: Thanks for catching the duplicate charge — I can see both invoices on your account and will process a refund for the second one within 3-5 business days. For the upgrade, moving mid-cycle prorates the remaining days on your current plan against the new tier's cost, and I'll send over a comparison of the next tier's seat limits and pricing so you can decide before your next billing date.

subject: Dringend: Speicherplatz-Kontingent durch Retention-Fehler voll
body: Bei Cobalt Robotics stellen wir fest, dass unsere Speicherquote trotz aktivierter Aufbewahrungsrichtlinie von 90 Tagen nicht automatisch bereinigt wird. Dateien die eigentlich seit Wochen hätten gelöscht werden müssen, sind immer noch vorhanden und wir sind jetzt bei 98% unseres Kontingents. Die Performance beim Hochladen neuer Dateien hat sich dadurch stark verschlechtert, Uploads brauchen teilweise über eine Minute für kleine Dateien.
answer: Vielen Dank für die Meldung, das nehmen wir sofort auf, da es Ihren Betrieb aktiv beeinträchtigt. Wir prüfen gerade, ob der Retention-Job für Ihr Konto fehlerhaft konfiguriert ist oder ob es sich um einen Bug im Bereinigungsprozess handelt, und melden uns innerhalb der nächsten Stunden mit einem Update sowie einer manuellen Bereinigung falls nötig, um die Performance-Probleme zu entschärfen.

subject: Request to add biometric login option
body: I've been using the Ember Analytics mobile app daily to check dashboard summaries and would love to see Face ID or fingerprint login added as an option instead of typing our SSO password every time on mobile. Right now the session also seems to log out fairly quickly which makes this more annoying. Is biometric login something on the roadmap, and if so any rough timeline?
answer: Thanks for the suggestion — biometric login is actually in active development for the mobile app and we're targeting a release within the next couple of quarters. I'll add your feedback about the short session timeout to the related ticket as well, since that's a common pain point we're addressing alongside the biometric feature.

subject: Push notifications not arriving on some devices
body: Our team at North Media has noticed that push notifications from the Northwind mobile app stopped arriving on a handful of Android devices starting around last Tuesday, while iOS devices seem unaffected. Notification settings look correctly enabled on the devices in question and reinstalling the app didn't help. It's not blocking core work but it means people miss alerts unless they open the app manually.
answer: Thanks for the details — this sounds like it could be related to a recent change in our Android push provider configuration. Could you let us know the Android OS versions and app build numbers on the affected devices? We'll check our delivery logs for those device tokens and follow up with a fix or workaround.

subject: SCIM provisioning failing - new hires can't log in
body:
Since yesterday our SCIM sync from our directory to Northwind Identity has been failing. Three new hires we added this morning (including our new compliance analyst) are stuck at the login screen with 'user not provisioned' errors. The SCIM connector shows last successful sync at 08:12 UTC, and every attempt after that returns a 409 conflict on the /Users endpoint.

We have 8 seats total and can't afford to have people locked out during onboarding week. Can someone check our tenant's SCIM logs? This is blocking our team from getting work done.
answer:
Thanks for flagging this right away - I can see the 409 conflicts on your SCIM endpoint starting at 08:14 UTC and I'm escalating this to our identity team now since it's blocking active logins for your users. In the meantime, can you confirm whether any user attributes (like email or username) were recently changed in your directory, as that's the most common cause of that conflict error?

We'll keep you updated within the hour and will manually provision the three blocked accounts as a stopgap while we trace the root cause.

subject: Zapier integration - requesting support for custom triggers
body:
I'm building an integration between Northwind and our internal ops tools using the Zapier connector, and I need to trigger a Zap whenever a new API key is generated in our account. Right now the available triggers only cover user creation and billing events - there's no webhook trigger for API key lifecycle events.

We're also looking at connecting Slack and Jira through the same Zap for alerting. Is a trigger like this planned, or is there a workaround using the raw API and a custom webhook instead? Documentation on the current trigger list would help us plan this properly.
answer:
Good question - right now the Zapier app doesn't expose API key events as a native trigger, but you can achieve this today by having your key-generation flow call a custom webhook that posts to Zapier's 'Catch Hook' trigger, then branch into Slack and Jira from there. I'll link you to our webhook payload reference for API key events so you can map the fields correctly.

I've also passed your request for a native API key trigger to our integrations product team as a feature request - I'll update this ticket if it gets scheduled.

subject: Question about invoice line item breakdown
body:
I'm reviewing our March invoice for Ember Media and noticed the line items just show a single 'subscription charge' amount without breaking out what portion is base plan versus any add-ons. Our auditor is asking for a clearer split for our records.

Could you let me know if it's possible to get an itemized version of past invoices, or if this is something you can generate on request? Our account is on the Starter plan with 4 seats if that helps locate the invoice.
answer: Happy to help with this - itemized invoices aren't generated automatically on the Starter plan, but I can pull a detailed breakdown of your March charges manually and send it over as a PDF for your auditor. Give me a day to prepare it, and let me know if you'd like this itemization included on future invoices going forward, as we can flag your account for that.

subject: Hilfe
body:
wir haben heute morgen versucht die IP allowlist im Admin Console fuer unser Team zu aktualisieren und seitdem koennen sich mehrere Analysten nicht mehr einloggen. Es kommt die meldung 'Zugriff verweigert - IP nicht autorisiert' obwohl die IP in der liste steht die wir eingetragen haben.

Das betrifft aktuell 6 von 14 nutzern und wir brauchen dringend zugriff um unsere reports fertigzustellen. Koennt ihr bitte pruefen ob die allowlist korrekt gespeichert wurde? im audit log sehe ich keinen fehler eintrag dazu.
answer:
Danke fuer die schnelle Meldung, das klingt nach einem Problem mit der Propagierung der Allowlist-Aenderung. Ich sehe in unseren Logs, dass die Aktualisierung um 09:41 UTC gespeichert wurde, aber offenbar nicht an alle Zugriffsknoten weitergegeben wurde - das erklaert die Zugriffsverweigerung trotz korrekter Eintraege.

Wir arbeiten bereits daran, die Allowlist manuell neu zu synchronisieren und melden uns in Kuerze mit einem Status-Update. Bitte lassen Sie die betroffenen Nutzer in der Zwischenzeit einen erneuten Login-Versuch machen, sobald wir Bescheid geben.

subject: URGENT: All SSO sessions expiring after 2 minutes - company-wide outage
body:
Starting at approximately 14:20 UTC today, every user across our organization is getting logged out of Northwind within 2 minutes of signing in via SSO. This is affecting all 235 seats and is completely blocking our logistics team from accessing dashboards and the API console during peak operations.

We've checked our IdP configuration and nothing changed on our end. Session tokens seem to be expiring almost immediately after issuance - I'm seeing 'session_expired' errors in the browser console repeatedly. This is a full outage for us right now and we need immediate escalation.
answer:
I'm escalating this immediately as a P0 - we're seeing the same abnormal session expiration pattern on our end starting around 14:22 UTC and our infrastructure team is already investigating a token TTL misconfiguration that appears to be affecting SSO sessions broadly. I'll update you directly as soon as we have a fix deployed or a workaround for your users.

As a temporary measure, please have affected users avoid re-authenticating repeatedly since that may generate additional short-lived tokens - we're targeting a resolution within the hour and will confirm once sessions are stable again.

subject: Dashboards taking 30+ seconds to load with multiple charts
body:
Our team has noticed that dashboards with more than 5-6 charts are taking upwards of 30 seconds to render, especially the shared revenue dashboard we use for weekly reviews. It used to load in a few seconds a couple months ago. Exporting to PDF from that same dashboard now times out about half the time too.

This isn't blocking us entirely since we can still use smaller dashboards, but it's becoming annoying for our media reporting workflow. Any idea what's causing the slowdown or if there's a way to optimize chart-heavy dashboards?
answer:
Thanks for the detailed report - dashboard load times can degrade when there are several high-cardinality charts pulling from large datasets simultaneously, and it sounds like that's likely contributing here. I'd suggest splitting the revenue dashboard into two smaller views if possible, which often improves both load and export reliability significantly.

I'm also going to have our performance team take a look at your account's dashboard configuration to see if there's a specific query or chart type causing the timeout on export - I'll follow up once we've identified anything actionable.

subject: Okta app integration broken after recent update
body:
We use the Northwind Okta app to manage SSO for our legal team, and since an update pushed on our Okta side yesterday, the app is throwing 'invalid_client' errors whenever anyone tries to authenticate. This is affecting all 22 of our seats - nobody can get into Northwind right now through Okta.

I checked the client ID and secret in our Okta app configuration and they match what's shown in our Northwind admin console. Is there a known issue with the Okta app integration right now, or something specific we need to reconfigure after an Okta-side update?
answer:
Sorry for the disruption this is causing - 'invalid_client' after an Okta-side update usually means the redirect URI or client secret was regenerated during that update and no longer matches what's registered with Northwind. Could you confirm in your Okta app settings whether the secret was rotated as part of yesterday's push?

In the meantime, I'm flagging this as high priority given it's blocking all logins - if you can send us the exact timestamp of the Okta update, we'll cross-check our integration logs to pinpoint exactly where the mismatch occurred.

subject: Data pipeline showing records 12-18 hours late
body:
I'm the finance manager reviewing our billing reconciliation pipeline, and for the past week our nightly sync connector has been delivering records 12 to 18 hours later than expected. Data that should land by 6am is sometimes not showing up until 6pm the same day, which is throwing off our end-of-day reports.

The connector status shows 'active' with no errors logged, so it's not obviously broken, just consistently delayed. This has happened every day since around March 3rd. Can someone check if there's a backlog or throttling issue on the connector for our account?
answer:
Thanks for the detailed timeline - a consistent 12-18 hour delay with no error state usually points to a backlog building up in the ingestion queue rather than an outright failure, so your connector status showing 'active' makes sense here. I'm pulling up your pipeline metrics now to check queue depth and processing throughput since March 3rd.

I'll report back with findings and, if we confirm a backlog, we'll prioritize clearing it and look into whether a batch size or scheduling adjustment on the connector would prevent this recurring.

subject: Mobile app offline mode crashing on reopen
body:
Our field team uses the mobile app in offline mode a lot since we're often in low-signal areas, but for the last few days the app crashes as soon as we reconnect and it tries to sync. Here's what shows in the crash log we pulled from one of our devices:

SyncManager: attempting reconnect sync, queued_items=47
SyncError: NullPointerException at OfflineQueue.flush(line 212)
FATAL EXCEPTION: main
Process: com.northwind.mobile, PID: 8841
java.lang.NullPointerException: Attempt to invoke virtual method on null object reference

This is affecting at least 3 of our field staff and we're losing queued data every time it crashes. Push notifications also stopped coming through on the same devices.
answer:
Thank you for including the crash log, that's very helpful - the NullPointerException in OfflineQueue.flush suggests the sync process is hitting a null reference while trying to flush queued items, which would explain both the crash and potential data loss on reconnect. I'm escalating this to our mobile team now given the impact on field staff and queued data.

As a temporary workaround, please ask affected staff to manually sync in smaller batches (closing and reopening the app after every 10-15 queued items) rather than letting a large queue build up, which should reduce crash frequency while we investigate the root cause and push notification issue together.

subject: Recurring late-arriving data from our travel data connector
body:
We've noticed a pattern over the last month where data from one of our travel booking connectors consistently arrives 3-5 hours after the expected sync window, particularly on weekends. It doesn't fail outright, it just lags, and it's been happening enough that our team wants a permanent fix rather than working around it each time.

Given the volume we run across our organization, even a few hours of lag creates downstream reporting gaps for multiple teams. Could you investigate whether this is a scheduling or throttling issue on the connector side, and let us know if there's a way to adjust sync frequency or priority for this specific connector?
answer:
Thank you for the detailed pattern description - weekend-specific lag often points to resource contention during scheduled batch windows when multiple connectors compete for processing capacity, and given your account's scale that's a strong possibility here. I'm having our data pipelines team review the scheduling priority for this specific connector and check whether increasing its sync frequency or isolating its batch window would resolve the weekend lag.

Since this is an ongoing pattern rather than an active outage, we'll treat it as a priority investigation and get back to you with findings and any configuration changes within the next few business days.

subject: Biometric login not persisting after offline use
body:
We're rolling out the Mobile App to our field ops team at Orion Works and noticed that Face ID login stops working after a device has been offline for more than a day. Users are dropped back to password entry even though biometric login was enabled. This is happening on both iOS and Android builds we distributed last week.

Can you confirm whether biometric tokens are meant to refresh automatically once connectivity resumes, or is there a manual re-enroll step we should be documenting for our team?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. This matches a known behavior where the biometric token cache expires after 24 hours offline and requires one online authentication to refresh silently in the background - it shouldn't force a full password re-entry, so what you're seeing sounds like a bug rather than expected behavior. Could you send us the app version and a device log from one affected phone so we can confirm the token refresh isn't failing outright?

subject: Recurring card declines on monthly billing run
body:
Our monthly billing run on the 1st failed for 14 of our 99 seats with error code card_declined, even though these are the same cards that processed fine last month. I checked with a few of the affected staff and their cards are active with no reported issues on the bank side.

We need this resolved before we get locked out of any seats - can someone check if something changed on the payment processor side around this billing cycle?
answer: Thanks for flagging this - a subset of declines tied to a processor-side routing update went out around the same billing date, which lines up with what you're describing. We're re-running the affected charges now and will confirm which of the 14 seats clear automatically; for any that still decline we'll reach out with next steps rather than restrict access in the meantime.

subject: Push notifications not arriving after app crash
body:
A couple of our team members reported that after the mobile app crashed on login last week, push notifications stopped coming through entirely even after reopening the app and logging back in successfully. We only have 6 seats total so it's easy to track, and it's affecting 2 of them so far.

Not urgent since email alerts still work, but wanted to flag it in case it's related to a token not re-registering after the crash.
answer: Appreciate you including the detail about the crash preceding this - that's a helpful clue since push tokens can get orphaned if the app closes unexpectedly during registration. Could you have the two affected users log out fully and log back in once more, and let us know if notifications resume? If not, we'll pull device logs to check token registration status.

subject: Okta app integration broken - SSO login failing for all users
body:
Since this morning our Okta app tile for Northwind is throwing 'invalid_client' errors for every user trying to SSO in, and this is blocking our whole manufacturing team of 293 seats from accessing dashboards and integrations. We didn't change anything on our Okta side recently - the last config update was over a month ago.

We also have Salesforce and Slack integrations chained to this same SSO flow, so those are affected too. This needs urgent attention since nobody can log in right now.
answer: This is being escalated immediately given the login-wide impact. Invalid_client on Okta typically points to a client secret rotation or expiration on our side - we're checking the app registration for your tenant now and will confirm within the hour whether we need to reissue credentials. We'll update this ticket as soon as we have a fix or a workaround so your team can get back into SSO.

subject: Mobile app crashing immediately on launch for most users
body:
Starting this morning, the Northwind mobile app is crashing within a second of opening for the majority of our 290 seats at Willow Media. Users are seeing a splash screen then the app just closes - no error message shown. This is on both iOS 17 and recent Android versions, and it started right after our team updated to the latest app version yesterday.

This is blocking login entirely for most of our staff, including anyone relying on push alerts and offline mode for field work. We need this fixed urgently as it's affecting daily operations.
answer: Thank you for the clear timeline - this level of impact is being treated as high priority on our side. We're pulling crash logs tied to yesterday's release now to identify the fault; in the meantime, could you have a few affected users try reinstalling the previous app version as a temporary workaround while we investigate the launch crash? We'll follow up as soon as we isolate the cause.

subject: Request to extend Okta app to cover Jira and Slack provisioning
body:
Our finance team at Orion Works currently has the Okta app integrated with Salesforce for SSO, and we'd like to extend the same setup to cover Jira and Slack provisioning so access reviews are consistent across tools. We have an internal audit coming up and need this in place soon.

Could someone from the integrations team advise on the fastest path to add these apps under our existing Okta configuration, and whether this requires an escalation given our enterprise account size?
answer: Thanks for reaching out - extending your existing Okta integration to Jira and Slack is straightforward and can typically be done without disrupting your current Salesforce SSO setup. Given the audit timeline, we're escalating this internally so a specialist can walk through the provisioning config with your team this week; we'll follow up shortly to schedule that session.

subject: Data pipeline transform step failing repeatedly on retail feed
body:
Since yesterday around 3pm, our nightly transform job on the retail sales connector has been failing with error 'schema mismatch: expected column revenue_usd, got revenue'. This is affecting our reporting pipeline for all 23 seats since the dashboards downstream haven't refreshed in over 18 hours now.

We didn't change our source schema recently, so we're wondering if something changed on the connector side. Data quality checks are also flagging null counts spiking in the last two successful runs before this started.
answer: Thanks for the detailed error message - that's very helpful. This looks like a source-side column rename that the connector didn't pick up automatically, and we're checking the connector's schema mapping cache now to confirm. We'll get the transform step running again as a priority and let you know whether this needs a mapping update on our end or a fix on the source feed.

subject: Need faster MFA enrolment path for new hires
body:
We're onboarding several new staff at Blue Foods this week and the current MFA enrolment flow is taking each person 10-15 minutes due to repeated SMS code timeouts, which is holding up their access to core systems. With only 22 seats total, this is a noticeable drag on our onboarding day.

Is there a way to speed up enrolment, maybe via an authenticator app option instead of SMS, or a bulk enrolment path for admins to set up on behalf of new hires?
answer: Good news - authenticator app-based MFA enrolment is available and tends to be much faster than SMS since it avoids carrier delays; we can help enable that as the default option for your tenant. Given the urgency around this week's onboarding, we're prioritizing this and will send configuration steps shortly so your admins can set it up before the next batch of new hires arrives.

subject: Dashboards loading extremely slowly, some charts not rendering
body:
Since this morning our main sales dashboard at Pioneer Retail has been taking over 30 seconds to load, and two of the bar charts just show a blank space instead of rendering at all. Exporting to CSV also times out with a generic 'export failed' message. We rely on this dashboard for daily standups so this is a real problem right now.

We haven't changed any filters or shared views recently - this started happening across all users this morning without any config changes on our side.
answer: Thanks for the clear report - a widespread slowdown and blank charts across all users points to something on our rendering service rather than your configuration, and we're treating this as high priority. We're checking dashboard load times and export queue status for your tenant right now and will update you as soon as we have a fix or a clearer timeline.

subject: Users receiving duplicate notification alerts for every event
body:
Since yesterday, every notification we set up for account activity at Atlas Foods is being sent twice within a few seconds of each other, both by email and in-app. This is happening for all 5 of our seats and is causing confusion since people think something happened twice when it hasn't.

We haven't added any new notification rules recently, so this seems like a bug on the notification service rather than something we configured. Can you confirm and let us know if there's a quick fix?
answer: Thanks for flagging this clearly - duplicate delivery across all users points to an issue on our notification dispatch side rather than your rule configuration, and we're prioritizing a fix given the account-wide impact. We're checking your tenant's delivery logs now to confirm where the duplication is happening and will update you as soon as we have a resolution or workaround.

subject: Webhook retries hitting rate limit after SDK update to v4
body: We upgraded the Northwind API SDK to v4.2.1 on our manufacturing order pipeline last Tuesday and since then our webhook consumer for order.updated events is getting throttled. We're seeing HTTP 429 responses from our own endpoint being logged in your webhook delivery dashboard, roughly 300 per hour, and deliveries are queuing up with exponential backoff maxing out. The changelog mentions the retry policy changed in this version but doesn't specify the new default concurrency. Can you confirm if this is a client-side SDK regression or an intended deprecation of the old retry behavior?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. We've seen a couple of similar cases tied to the v4.2.1 SDK, which lowered the default concurrent-delivery cap from 20 to 5 as part of deprecating the legacy retry queue, and that's likely what's causing the backlog you're describing. As a workaround you can raise the concurrency limit explicitly in your webhook config via the API Platform settings page under Delivery Settings while we confirm whether this should have been called out more clearly in the migration notes. I'll follow up within one business day with confirmation from engineering.

subject: Allowlist changes not saving in workspace settings
body: I'm trying to update our IP allowlist in the Admin Console under Workspace Settings > Security, but when I add a new CIDR range and click Save, the page spins for a while and then reverts to the previous list. I checked the audit log and there's no entry recorded for the attempted change, so it seems the request isn't going through at all. This started happening after Monday's maintenance window. We only have 4 seats so it's blocking one of our two admins from accessing the console remotely right now.
answer: Sorry for the trouble this is causing your admin access. This matches a known issue introduced after Monday's maintenance where allowlist saves silently fail on workspaces with legacy settings schemas. Our team is deploying a fix, but in the meantime I can manually add the CIDR range you need on the backend if you send it over, so your admin isn't locked out while we resolve the save issue.

subject: SAML login broken for entire team since this morning
body: Since around 9am today, all 13 of our users are unable to log in via SAML SSO through our identity provider. Users are redirected back to the Northwind login page with the message 'SAML response validation failed' instead of reaching the dashboard. We haven't changed our IdP metadata or certificates recently. This is blocking our whole travel booking team from accessing the platform this morning, so we need this resolved quickly.
answer: I understand this is blocking your whole team and we're treating it as high priority. We're checking whether there was a certificate rotation on our identity provider integration side that could have invalidated the SAML assertion validation for your tenant, and I'll need the exact timestamp of a recent failed login attempt plus your SSO connection ID to trace it in our logs. I'll update you within the hour as we investigate.

subject: URGENT - Storage quota hit, backups failing, data at risk
body: Our storage quota was exceeded overnight and now our scheduled backup job for client case files failed with 'insufficient storage allocation' at 2:14am. We are a law firm and cannot afford to lose any document versions. Current usage shows 100% of our 18-seat plan allocation and no backups have completed since yesterday. We need immediate guidance on increasing quota or recovering backup capability before more data is at risk of not being retained per our compliance policy.
answer: This is being escalated immediately as a service outage given the backup failure risk. We're temporarily raising your storage quota now to restore backup functionality while we investigate why usage grew unexpectedly overnight, and we'll confirm once the next scheduled backup completes successfully. I'll stay on this ticket directly and update you within 30 minutes with quota status and root cause findings.

subject: Request to extend retention period for archived datasets
body: I'm analyzing our logistics shipment data and noticed our archived datasets are being purged after 90 days per the default retention policy, but we need at least 180 days for quarterly trend reporting. Is there a way to extend retention for specific storage buckets without upgrading our entire plan? We currently have around 40TB in cold storage across our Pro plan and would like to understand the cost implications before requesting a change.
answer: Good question, and this is doable without a full plan change. Retention periods can be configured per-bucket in Storage Settings, and extending cold storage to 180 days for your current 40TB footprint would incur an incremental retention fee rather than a plan upgrade. I'll send over a cost estimate based on your current usage and can walk you through applying the setting to just the buckets you need extended.

subject: How to configure OAuth refresh for connector auth in Data Pipelines
body: I'm setting up a connector for our travel booking data source in Data Pipelines and the initial OAuth handshake works, but the connector loses authentication after about an hour and sync jobs start failing with 'token expired, refresh required' in the logs. I don't see a clear setting for automatic token refresh in the connector config UI. Is there documentation on how refresh tokens should be configured for custom connectors, or is this something we need to handle in our own middleware?
answer: Good timing to ask, as automatic refresh for custom connectors does need to be explicitly configured rather than being automatic by default. There's a 'refresh_token_url' field in the advanced connector settings panel that, once set with your provider's token endpoint, will handle renewal transparently. I'll link you to our connector auth guide which covers the exact payload format expected, and happy to review your connector config if you share the connector ID.

subject: Mobile app crashes immediately on launch for all our users
body: Since yesterday's app store update, our finance team can't open the Northwind mobile app at all, it crashes within a second or two of launch on both iOS and Android devices. This is affecting all 23 of our users and is blocking approval workflows we normally handle on mobile while traveling. No error message appears, the app just closes back to the home screen.
