We rely on this for order status updates flowing between Northwind and Salesforce for our logistics ops team, and right now none of our 267 seats are seeing updated records. The integration status page in Admin shows 'Connected' but the last successful sync timestamp is stuck at 08:14 AM. We've already tried disconnecting and reconnecting the Salesforce OAuth token with no change. This is affecting order tracking for active shipments, so we need this restored urgently.
answer: This is impacting a core workflow for your team so we're escalating it to P1 immediately. We can see the sync job for your workspace queuing but failing silently after the OAuth reconnect, which suggests a token scope issue on our integration service rather than your Salesforce org config. Our integrations team is investigating now and I'll update you within the hour with either a fix or a manual sync trigger to unblock today's order data.

subject: SDK v4 upgrade wiped local cache and data appears lost
body: We upgraded the Node SDK from v3.8 to v4.0.2 this morning per the deprecation notice for v3, and immediately after the upgrade our local event cache used for offline queuing was cleared - about 1,800 unsynced records from the past 3 days are gone. Our app threw this on startup: Error: Cache schema mismatch (v3->v4) at CacheStore.migrate (cache.js:112) at SDKClient.init (client.js:44) Failed to migrate cache, purging store. We need to know if this data is recoverable or if it's permanently lost, this is affecting our production order queue.
answer: I understand the urgency here and we're treating this as a P0 given the data loss risk. The v4 migration path has a known issue where a schema mismatch triggers a cache purge instead of a safe migration - we've seen this reported since the release and a hotfix is being tested now. Can you confirm whether you have any server-side event logs or a database mirror of those 1,800 records? That's our best path to recovery, and I'll stay on this ticket with you until we've either restored the data or confirmed the safest next step.

subject: Slack alerts from Integrations arriving 20+ minutes delayed
body: Our Slack channel for pipeline alerts, which is fed through the Northwind Integrations Slack connector, has been receiving notifications with a consistent 20 to 25 minute delay since Monday. We use these alerts to catch data pipeline failures quickly, so the delay is causing us to miss the window for fast remediation. Our Jira and Salesforce integrations on the same workspace don't seem to have this lag, so it looks isolated to the Slack connector.
answer: Thanks for isolating that to the Slack connector specifically, that's helpful. We're seeing elevated queue times on the Slack notification worker for several workspaces since Monday, likely tied to a backlog from a recent Slack API rate adjustment on our side. We're working on clearing the backlog and adding capacity; I'll update this ticket once delivery times return to under a minute, and let you know if any alerts were dropped rather than delayed.

subject: Need consolidated invoice and refund for duplicate charge
body: We were double-charged for our September invoice - I see two charges of $2,140 on Sept 5th and Sept 6th on the card ending in the account's billing profile, both labeled invoice #INV-88213. I need one of these refunded and going forward would like our invoices consolidated into a single monthly statement rather than split by department, since we're now on 133 seats under one contract. Please confirm the refund timeline and let me know what's needed to set up consolidated billing.
answer: Thanks for catching this, and I'm sorry for the duplicate charge on invoice #INV-88213 - I can confirm both charges posted and we'll process a refund for the duplicate within 3-5 business days back to the original card. On consolidated billing, I can set that up on our end for your 133-seat contract; I just need confirmation of which department account should be the primary billing contact going forward and I'll merge the statements starting next cycle.

subject: Zapier integration failing to trigger on new records
body: Our Zapier connection for Northwind Integrations stopped triggering zaps when new records are created in our workspace, starting sometime yesterday afternoon. The Zap history in Zapier shows no incoming triggers at all since around 3 PM, even though we've created several test records to confirm. We haven't changed the connected app or reauthorized anything recently. This is holding up our lead notification workflow that the whole team relies on.
answer: Thanks for the detailed timeline, that helps narrow this down. We've had reports of the Zapier trigger webhook not firing for a subset of workspaces since yesterday afternoon, which lines up with what you're seeing. Our integrations team is investigating the trigger delivery service now; in the meantime, could you try disconnecting and reconnecting the Zapier app as a workaround while we work on the root cause, and let us know if that restores triggers on your end?

subject: MFA enrollment failing via SSO API for new users
body:
I'm integrating the Identity API to auto-enroll new employees into MFA when they're provisioned via SCIM. Users are created fine, but the POST to /v1/mfa/enroll returns 409 conflict even for accounts that have never enrolled before. I've tried it against three fresh test users today and get the same result each time.

Can you confirm whether MFA enrollment needs a separate activation step before the enroll endpoint accepts the request? Our onboarding flow for 6 seats is currently blocked on this.
answer: Thanks for the details. The 409 you're seeing usually means the user's identity record hasn't finished propagating from the SCIM provisioning step before the MFA enroll call fires — there's a short indexing delay on our side after user creation. Can you add a brief retry/backoff (a few seconds) between provisioning and the enroll call and let me know if the conflict persists? If it does, please send me one of the user IDs so I can check the account state directly.

subject: Need to upgrade billing plan before month end
body:
We need to move Harbor Freight from our current plan to a higher tier before our next billing cycle starts on the 1st, since we're onboarding additional teams and will exceed our current seat allowance. I tried initiating the upgrade from the billing console but it just spins on 'Processing' and never completes.

We have 108 seats active right now and expect to add roughly 40 more this quarter. Can someone process this upgrade manually or tell me what's blocking it? This is time-sensitive since our finance team needs the new invoice reflected before quarter close.
answer: I understand the urgency given your billing cycle timing. The stuck 'Processing' state is often caused by a pending payment method verification — I'm checking your account now to see if that's the case here. I'll process the plan upgrade manually on our end today and confirm once it's reflected in your billing console, and I'll follow up with the updated invoice details before your cycle renews.

subject: Requesting credit for billing discrepancy last cycle
body:
Our last invoice charged Willow Labs for 2,202 seats, but we ran a headcount reconciliation and only 2,140 were actually active during that billing period — the rest were deprovisioned mid-cycle but apparently still counted. This is a meaningful discrepancy given our scale and we'd like a credit applied for the difference.

Could you also clarify how seat counts are calculated during a billing cycle — is it a snapshot at renewal or prorated based on deprovisioning date? We want to avoid this recurring next quarter.
answer: Thank you for flagging this and for the specific numbers — I'll pull the seat activity log for your account to verify the deprovisioning dates against the invoice period. Seat counts are generally prorated based on when a user is deactivated, so if the log confirms your figures, we'll issue a credit for the difference on your next invoice. I'll also send you a short explanation of how the proration windows work so this is clearer going forward.

subject: Dashboard load times slow when exporting large datasets
body:
I'm building a shared dashboard for our energy usage reports and noticed that any dashboard with more than around 50k rows takes 15-20 seconds to render, and exporting to CSV from that same view times out entirely after about 30 seconds. This happens consistently on our production account regardless of which browser I use.

Is there a recommended row limit or pagination approach for large exports, or a setting we can adjust to improve load performance for these bigger dashboards?
answer: Thanks for the details — the render delay you're describing lines up with known performance limits on dashboards querying over ~40k rows without pagination applied. I'd recommend enabling server-side pagination on the widget and using scheduled exports for datasets that large rather than the on-demand CSV export, which should avoid the timeout. I'll also flag this as feedback for our dashboards team since export timeout thresholds are something we're actively reviewing.

subject: Request to adjust late-arrival handling in pipeline connector
body:
We're seeing data from our travel booking connector regularly arrive 2-3 hours after the expected sync window, which causes our downstream reports to show incomplete numbers for that day until the next sync catches up. This has been happening consistently for the past two weeks, not just occasionally.

Could we get the connector's late-arrival window extended, or is there a way to configure a grace period so records arriving within a few hours still get included in the correct day's batch? Documentation on this setting would help too.
answer: This is a reasonable ask and something we can configure — most pipeline connectors support a configurable late-arrival grace window, though it isn't currently documented clearly for your connector type. I'll get you the specific configuration steps to extend that window to cover the 2-3 hour delay you're seeing, and I'll also pass along a request to improve the documentation on this setting.

subject: Storage retention policy not matching our configured settings
body:
We configured our storage retention policy to purge objects after 90 days, but I just noticed files uploaded back in early January are still present and counting against our quota, well past that window. We're at 92% of our storage quota now and this is going to cause upload failures for our team soon if it's not resolved.

Can you check whether the retention job is actually running on our account? We rely on this to keep costs predictable and it hasn't been cleaning up as expected.
answer: Thanks for catching this — I'm checking the retention job logs for your account now to see whether the scheduled purge has been executing on the 90-day policy you set. Given you're close to quota, I'll prioritize this and let you know within the next few hours whether it's a configuration issue or a job failure, and get the cleanup triggered manually if needed to relieve the quota pressure in the meantime.

subject: Biometric login crashing mobile app for all users after latest update
body:
Since this morning, every user attempting to log in with Face ID or fingerprint on our mobile app is getting an immediate crash right after biometric confirmation — the app just closes and reopens to the login screen in a loop. This started right after the app update pushed yesterday and is affecting our entire team of 16, both iOS and Android.

We've had users try reinstalling with no change. This is blocking everyone from accessing the app at all since password fallback also seems disabled when biometrics is enabled.
answer: This is being treated as high priority given it's blocking your whole team. Our mobile team is already aware of a crash tied to yesterday's release affecting biometric login flows and is working on a fix now — in the meantime, please have your users go into device settings and disable biometric login for the app, which should restore password fallback access. I'll update you as soon as the fix is confirmed and let you know when it's safe to re-enable biometrics.

subject: Charged for seats we removed weeks ago
body:
Our latest invoice for Ember Academy charged us based on 11 seats, but we deactivated 5 of those employees back on the 3rd of last month and confirmed they were removed from the admin panel at the time. This overcharge is significant relative to our small plan and we need it corrected right away.

Can someone review the seat history on our account and issue a refund or credit for the difference? We can't keep operating with billing this far off from our actual headcount.
answer: I'm sorry for the frustration this has caused — I'm pulling up your account's seat deactivation history right now to confirm the removal dates you mentioned. If the records show the seats were deactivated when you describe, we'll issue a refund for the overcharged amount on this invoice and make sure your seat count is corrected going forward. I'll follow up today with the resolution.

subject: Best practice for paginating large API responses
body:
We're building a reporting integration against the API Platform and pulling case records that can return well over 10,000 results per query. Right now we're using offset-based pagination with limit and offset parameters, but response times get noticeably worse past page 50 or so, and we've seen a couple of duplicate records appear across page boundaries.

Is cursor-based pagination available or planned for this endpoint, and is offset pagination going to be deprecated? We'd like to build against whichever approach will be supported long term.
answer: Good question, and you're right that offset pagination degrades at higher page counts and can produce duplicates if records are inserted between page fetches. Cursor-based pagination is available on this endpoint via the 'next_cursor' field returned in the response — I'd recommend switching to that for stability at your data volume. Offset pagination isn't deprecated yet, but cursor-based is the supported long-term approach, so migrating now will save you a future rework.

subject: Alert notifications routing to wrong team and duplicating
body:
Since yesterday afternoon, critical alerts that should route to our data team's email group are instead going to our general support inbox, and several of them are arriving duplicated 3-4 times within a couple of minutes. This is causing real alerts to get buried and our team missed an important threshold breach notification this morning because of it.

We haven't changed our routing rules recently, so something seems to have shifted on the notification side. Can this be fixed urgently? We need alert routing to be reliable for our monitoring to be useful at all.
answer: I understand how critical this is for your monitoring workflow, and I'm escalating this immediately given the missed alert this morning. We're checking your notification routing configuration and delivery logs now to identify why messages are misrouting and duplicating — this looks like it could be a rule evaluation issue on our end rather than anything changed in your account. I'll update you within the hour with findings and a temporary workaround if the fix takes longer to deploy.

subject: IP allowlist blocking our own integration server after update
body:
We updated our Admin Console IP allowlist yesterday to add our new integration server (203.0.113.44) and remove a decommissioned one. Since then, our API integration is getting 403 Forbidden on every call, even though the new IP is listed correctly under Settings > Access Control. I've double-checked the CIDR notation and it matches exactly.

Can someone check if there's a propagation delay or caching issue on your end? We have 123 seats depending on this integration for order sync and it's been down since 9am today.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. This looks like a known caching issue where allowlist changes can take up to 15 minutes to propagate to the edge API gateways, but 403s persisting beyond that window point to something else. I'm pulling the access logs for your account now to check whether the new entry saved correctly on our side, and will confirm within the hour whether we need to force a manual refresh.

subject: Users can't unsubscribe from digest emails - getting duplicates
body:
Several people on our team have clicked 'unsubscribe' at the bottom of the daily digest notification emails, but they're still receiving them every morning. One user (a dispatcher on our logistics team) reported getting the same digest twice in one day, on both Nov 3rd and Nov 5th.

I checked our Notifications settings in the workspace admin panel and the unsubscribe requests aren't reflected in the subscriber list. Is this a known issue with the digest notification type specifically?
answer: Sorry for the inconvenience this is causing your team. Digest-type notifications do have a separate unsubscribe handler from transactional alerts, and we've seen a handful of reports where the preference update doesn't sync back to the workspace admin view even though it registers on our backend. Can you send me the specific user's account identifier and the timestamps of the duplicate emails so I can trace it through the notification queue and fix the sync issue?

subject: DASHBOARD SLOW
body: DASHBOARDS TAKING 45+ SECONDS TO LOAD, UNUSABLE RIGHT NOW
answer: I'm sorry you're seeing this - a 45+ second load time is well outside normal range and I'm treating this as high priority. Could you tell me which specific dashboard is affected and roughly how many charts or widgets it contains? In the meantime I'm checking our performance metrics for your workspace to see if there's a query bottleneck or a recent spike in data volume causing this.

subject: Speicherquote wird ständig erreicht - Backup schlägt fehl
body:
Seit letzter Woche bekommen wir beim automatischen Backup-Upload die Meldung, dass unser Storage-Kontingent erreicht ist. Wir haben aktuell etwa 40 GB an Backup-Dateien liegen, die laut unserer Aufbewahrungsrichtlinie eigentlich nach 30 Tagen gelöscht werden sollten. Es scheint, als würden alte Dateien nicht automatisch entfernt werden.

Können Sie uns erklären, wie die Retention-Regeln in Storage konfiguriert werden und ob wir das manuell nachstellen müssen, um wieder Platz zu schaffen?
answer: Vielen Dank für die genaue Beschreibung. Es kann vorkommen, dass die Retention-Regel nicht greift, wenn Dateien über eine andere Upload-Methode als die Standard-API hochgeladen wurden. Ich prüfe gerade Ihr Speicherkonto, um zu sehen, welche Dateien älter als 30 Tage sind und warum die automatische Bereinigung nicht ausgelöst wurde, und melde mich mit einer Anleitung zur manuellen Bereinigung sowie einer dauerhaften Lösung.

subject: Recurring card decline failures for multiple team invoices
body:
We've had three failed payment attempts this month on our billing account - Nov 2nd, Nov 9th, and Nov 15th - all with the same card ending in 4471. The error shown in the billing portal is 'card_declined: insufficient_funds' but we've confirmed with our bank that the card has sufficient limit and no blocks.

Could your team escalate this to check if there's an issue on the payment processor side? We'd like to avoid any service interruption for our 56 seats while we sort this out, and possibly get a temporary grace period.
answer: Thanks for flagging this proactively. Repeated insufficient_funds declines with a bank-confirmed available balance often point to a mismatch in the billing address or an issue with how the processor is routing the charge. I'm escalating this to our payments team to review the transaction details for those three dates, and I'll apply a short grace period on your account now so there's no service disruption while we investigate.

subject: URGENT: IP allowlist change removed all entries, admin console now open to any IP
body:
During a routine update to our IP allowlist about 20 minutes ago, all existing entries were wiped instead of just the one we intended to remove. The Admin Console access control now shows zero restrictions, meaning any IP can currently attempt to reach our admin endpoints. We have 250 seats and this is a serious compliance exposure for a retail company handling customer payment data.

We need this locked down immediately - can you either restore our previous allowlist from a backup or help us re-lock the console right now while we rebuild the list? We also need to know if any unauthorized access occurred in this window for our audit log.
answer: This is being treated as our highest priority right now. I'm escalating immediately to our security on-call team to restore your previous allowlist configuration from our last snapshot and lock down admin access while that's in progress. I'll also pull the audit log for the last 30 minutes to check for any access attempts during the exposure window and will update you within minutes, not hours.

subject: Anfrage: Automatische Deaktivierung ausgeschiedener Nutzer
body:
Wir möchten gerne einrichten, dass Nutzerkonten automatisch deaktiviert werden, sobald ein Mitarbeiter unser Unternehmen verlässt, idealerweise über eine Verknüpfung mit unserem HR-System oder zumindest über eine Bulk-Deaktivierungsfunktion im Admin Console. Aktuell müssen wir jeden Nutzer einzeln manuell deaktivieren, was bei 243 Lizenzen sehr zeitaufwändig ist und öfter zu verzögerten Deaktivierungen führt.

Gibt es bereits eine Funktion dafür oder ist das für die Roadmap geplant? Wir bräuchten außerdem einen Audit-Log-Eintrag für jede Deaktivierung aus Compliance-Gründen.
answer: Vielen Dank für die Anfrage. Aktuell unterstützt der Admin Console eine Bulk-Deaktivierung über CSV-Import, die ich Ihnen gerne per Anleitung zusende, allerdings gibt es noch keine direkte HR-System-Anbindung für automatische Deaktivierung. Jede Deaktivierung, ob einzeln oder als Bulk-Vorgang, wird bereits im Audit Log erfasst. Ich leite Ihren Wunsch nach einer HR-Integration als Feature-Anfrage an unser Produktteam weiter und halte Sie über den Fortschritt auf dem Laufenden.

subject: LATE ARRIVING DATA CAUSING FINANCIAL REPORTS TO BE WRONG
body:
OUR MANUFACTURING COST DATA CONNECTOR IS PULLING RECORDS 2-3 DAYS LATE, WHICH MEANS OUR MONTH END FINANCIAL CLOSE REPORTS ARE MISSING TRANSACTIONS FROM OCT 28-30. WE NOTICED THIS WHEN RECONCILING AGAINST OUR ERP SYSTEM AND FOUND A GAP OF ROUGHLY 1,400 RECORDS THAT SHOWED UP IN THE PIPELINE ONLY YESTERDAY, NOV 4TH.

THIS IS THE THIRD MONTH IN A ROW THIS HAS HAPPENED WITH THE SAME CONNECTOR (ERP_COST_SYNC_03). WE NEED TO KNOW WHY THE SYNC IS DELAYED AND HOW TO GET ALERTED WHEN THIS HAPPENS SO WE CAN HOLD OFF ON CLOSING THE BOOKS.
answer: I understand how disruptive this is for your month-end close, and I'm sorry this has recurred for a third month. I'm pulling the sync logs for connector ERP_COST_SYNC_03 now to identify why records from Oct 28-30 arrived 2-3 days late, and will check whether this is a source-side rate limit or a scheduling issue on our end. In the meantime, I'll also look into setting up a late-arrival alert so your finance team gets notified before the close process starts if a gap like this happens again.

subject: Question about audit logging for IP allowlist changes
body: We're setting up quarterly access reviews and I wanted to confirm exactly what gets logged when someone modifies the IP allowlist in Admin Console. Does the audit log capture the specific IP address added or removed, the admin who made the change, and a timestamp? We have 224 seats across multiple campus locations and want to make sure our compliance team can pull a clean report.
answer: Good question, and happy to confirm this for your compliance review. The audit log does capture the admin's account, a timestamp, and the specific IP or CIDR range added or removed for every allowlist change, and this data can be exported as CSV from the Audit Log section of Admin Console. If it would help, I can also share a sample export format so your team knows what to expect before running the quarterly review.

subject: SDK throwing rate limit errors after recent update, deprecation warning too
body: After updating to the latest API Platform SDK version (4.2.0) yesterday, we're getting intermittent 429 Too Many Requests errors on endpoints that never hit limits before, plus a new deprecation warning: 'DeprecationWarning: v3 auth token method will be removed in next major release.' We haven't changed our call volume, still around 15 requests/second average. Can you clarify if the rate limit thresholds changed with this SDK version, and point us to migration docs for the auth token deprecation? This is affecting our production order processing for 77 seats.
answer: Thanks for the specifics, that helps narrow this down quickly. SDK 4.2.0 did adjust how request batching counts against rate limits, which can cause bursts to hit 429s earlier than before even at similar overall volume - I'll send you the updated threshold documentation along with the migration guide for the v3 to v4 auth token change. I'm also checking your account's current rate limit tier now to see if a temporary increase would help while your team migrates.

subject: PDF export cuts off charts on wide dashboards
body: I'm trying to export our quarterly travel spend dashboard to PDF for our board deck, but any chart wider than about 8 columns gets cut off on the right side of the page. This happens on both the 'Regional Spend' and 'Vendor Breakdown' dashboards. It would help if the export could scale to fit the page width or offer a landscape option. Not urgent, just something we'd love to see improved.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. Landscape export and auto-scaling for wide charts aren't available yet, but I'm logging this as a feature request for our dashboard export team. In the meantime, a workaround is to temporarily hide a column or two before exporting, which keeps everything on the page. I'll update this ticket if we get a timeline for the fix.

subject: Audit log missing entries after user deactivation
body: We deactivated two users last week (May 14th) as part of a role cleanup, and I noticed the audit log doesn't show any entry for those deactivation events. We rely on this log for our quarterly access review, and gaps like this are a real problem for compliance. Can you confirm whether deactivation actions are supposed to be logged at all, and if so, why these two are missing?
answer: Deactivation events should always appear in the audit log, so this does look like a gap on our end. Could you send me the exact user IDs or emails for the two accounts and the approximate timestamps? I'll check our backend logging pipeline for those events and get back to you within one business day with either the missing entries or an explanation of what went wrong.

subject: card declined twice
body: Our card got declined twice this week for the API invoice. No idea why, it usually works fine.
answer: Sorry for the trouble with the failed charge. Can you confirm the last 4 digits of the card on file or the invoice number so I can pull up the transaction details and check the decline reason with our payment processor?

subject: APP CRASHES EVERY TIME ON LAUNCH - THIS IS UNACCEPTABLE
body: The mobile app has been crashing immediately on launch for our entire warehouse team since this morning, June 3rd. We are dead in the water because our field techs use this app to log inspections and now NONE of them can even get past the splash screen. This is the third outage in two months and honestly we are seriously considering canceling our contract. Fix this NOW, we have 22 people sitting idle.
answer: I completely understand the urgency and I'm escalating this to our mobile engineering team right now as a P1. Can you tell me which device OS versions your techs are on (iOS or Android, and version numbers) and whether this started right after an app update? While we investigate, please have affected users try a full reinstall, which has resolved similar launch crashes in the past. I'll keep you updated every 30 minutes until this is fixed.

subject: Incorrect tax amount on last invoice
body: Our May invoice shows a tax charge of $84.50 that doesn't match our region's rate, and it's the second month in a row this has happened. Our finance team needs this corrected before we can process payment on our end. Could someone review invoice #INV-33021 and issue a corrected version or credit note? We're on 6 seats under the Starter plan if that's relevant.
answer: Thank you for flagging this, I'll have our billing team review invoice #INV-33021 against your account's tax settings right away. If the rate was applied incorrectly, we'll issue a corrected invoice or credit note within 2 business days and make sure your region's tax setting is fixed going forward so this doesn't recur next month.

subject: Need to reduce seat count from 12 to 8 immediately
body: We just completed a restructuring and only need 8 active seats going forward instead of the 12 we're currently billed for on the Starter plan. This needs to take effect for our next billing cycle which starts June 1st. Please confirm the seat reduction and let us know if a partial refund applies for the current cycle since we're only 5 days in.
answer: I've submitted the seat reduction from 12 to 8 effective for your June 1st billing cycle. Since you're only 5 days into the current cycle, you're eligible for a prorated credit, which I'll apply to your next invoice automatically. You'll receive a confirmation email once the change is processed, typically within 24 hours.

subject: PDF exports taking over 2 minutes on large dashboards
body: Our operations dashboards with multiple charts and 127 users across plant locations are taking well over two minutes to export to PDF, and sometimes the export times out entirely. This is becoming a real bottleneck for our weekly shift reports. Is there a documented limit on dashboard complexity for exports, and are there any performance improvements planned? We'd also like to know if scheduled PDF exports are on the roadmap.
answer: Thanks for the detailed context. Large multi-chart dashboards can hit export timeouts around the 90-second mark currently, and I can confirm this is a known performance limitation we're actively working on. There isn't a hard documented limit, but we recommend splitting dashboards with more than 6-8 charts into separate views for now. Scheduled PDF exports are on our roadmap; I'll add your account to the interest list so you're notified when it ships.

subject: connecter auth keeps failing for our snowflake pipline
body:
we are trying to reconnect our snowflake connecter after rotating credentials and keep getting this error in the sync logs:

2024-06-02 14:12:03 ERROR ConnectorAuthException: unable to validate oauth token for connector_id=snfk_8841
2024-06-02 14:12:03 ERROR retry attempt 3/3 failed
2024-06-02 14:12:04 ERROR connector marked as DEGRADED

we rotated the key on our side yesterday and updated it in the connector settings but its still failing. can you tell us the correct steps to re-auth without losing the existing sync history? this is blocking several downstream dashbaords.
answer: Thanks for the log details, that's helpful. When rotating Snowflake credentials, the token needs to be re-authorized through the connector's OAuth flow rather than just updating the key field, otherwise the old token stays cached and keeps failing validation. Go to Data Pipelines > Connectors > snfk_8841 > Reauthorize, and your sync history will be preserved since it's tied to the connector ID, not the credential. Let me know once you've tried that and I'll confirm the connector status clears from DEGRADED.

subject: Scheduled syncs stopped running since yesterday
body: Our nightly scheduled syncs for the primary transactions connector haven't run since June 4th at 11pm, and downstream tables are now a full day stale. We depend on this data being fresh every morning for finance reporting, and the schedule shows as 'active' in the pipeline settings with no error indicated. Can someone check why the scheduler isn't triggering the job and whether the missed runs can be backfilled?
answer: I've escalated this immediately since it affects your daily reporting. This matches an issue we're seeing with a subset of schedulers not firing after a recent maintenance window; our engineering team is already investigating. I'll trigger a manual run of your missed syncs now to backfill the stale data and will follow up as soon as we have root cause and confirmation that nightly scheduling is fully restored.

subject: Doppelte Benachrichtigungen bei Alert-Routing
body: Uns fällt auf, dass bestimmte Alerts in den letzten Tagen doppelt an unser E-Mail-Team gesendet werden, obwohl nur eine Routing-Regel für diese Kategorie eingerichtet ist. Wir würden gerne die Möglichkeit haben, Alerts nach Schweregrad an unterschiedliche E-Mail-Verteiler weiterzuleiten, aktuell scheint es nur eine einzige Zielregel pro Kategorie zu unterstützen. Könnt ihr das prüfen und uns sagen, ob eine feinere Routing-Konfiguration geplant ist?
answer: Vielen Dank für den Hinweis. Die doppelten Benachrichtigungen deuten auf ein bekanntes Problem mit überlappenden Routing-Regeln hin, wir prüfen das für Ihr Konto genauer. Eine feinere Konfiguration mit mehreren Zielverteilern je Schweregrad ist als Feature für ein kommendes Release vorgesehen, ich trage Ihren Wunsch dafür ein und melde mich, sobald es Neuigkeiten dazu gibt.

subject: IP allowlist rule silently deactivated
body:
We noticed this morning that the IP allowlist rule covering our Chicago office subnet (203.0.113.0/24) in Admin Console is showing as disabled, though none of our admins made that change. The audit log shows an entry from Saturday at 2:14 AM with actor listed as 'system' rather than a named admin. Since then two staff members were able to log in from outside our approved ranges.

Can you confirm whether this is a known bug or if our account was affected by something on your end? We need this locked down again and want an explanation for the audit trail entry.
answer: Thanks for flagging this right away. subject: Need to restore data from backup - accidental deletion
