I can see in the retention settings that we keep 30 days of backups, but I'm not sure how to trigger a restore for a specific folder rather than the whole bucket. Could you walk me through the steps, and confirm whether restoring will count against our storage quota?
answer: You can restore a specific folder by going to Storage > Backups > Restore Point, selecting yesterday's snapshot before 4 PM, and choosing the folder path rather than the full bucket - this scopes the restore to just those files. Restored data does count toward your quota temporarily until you confirm and delete any duplicates, so let us know once you've reviewed the restored folder and we can help clean up if needed.

subject: SCIM provisioning failing for new hires - users not created
body: Since this morning, new employees added in our identity provider are not being provisioned into Northwind through SCIM. We've confirmed the SCIM endpoint and bearer token are unchanged, but the last three provisioning attempts show a 403 response in our IdP's SCIM logs. This is blocking two new hires from getting SSO and MFA access today.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report - a 403 on SCIM provisioning usually points to an expired or revoked SCIM token on our end, so I'm checking your tenant's provisioning configuration now as a P2. I'll confirm within the next couple of hours whether the token needs regenerating, and in the meantime you can manually invite the two blocked users so they aren't stuck without SSO access.

subject: Audit log missing entries for admin permission changes
body: We rely on the Admin Console audit log for compliance reviews, and I've noticed that permission changes made by admins since March 5 aren't appearing in the log at all, even though the changes took effect. This is a serious gap for us since we're due for a security review this month and need a complete record of who changed access settings and when.
answer: This is a significant issue and I'm escalating it to our security team immediately as P1. We're checking whether this is a logging pipeline gap or a display issue in the console, and I'll confirm within the next few hours whether the missing entries can be recovered or if we need to provide an alternate audit trail for your compliance review.

subject: STILL WAITING ON REFUND - THIS IS RIDICULOUS
body: I have emailed twice already about the duplicate charge on our February invoice - we were billed for 13 seats AND an extra 13 seat upgrade that we never approved, totaling almost double what we should owe. It has been over a week with no refund and no real answer, just generic replies. If this isn't resolved by end of week we are cancelling our plan and moving to a competitor. This is completely unacceptable for a Starter plan that's supposed to be simple.
answer: I'm sorry for the delay and the frustration this has caused - a duplicate seat charge should never take this long to resolve, and I'm taking ownership of this now. I've pulled up your February invoice and confirmed the duplicate 13-seat upgrade charge; I'm processing a full refund for that duplicate line today and you should see it reflected in your account within 3-5 business days, with a confirmation email once it's issued.

subject: Connecter auth keeps failing for our fintech data source
body: hey we are seeing our postgres connecter fail auth every few hours since monday, its throwing 'ERROR: password authentication failed for user pipeline_ro' even tho creds havent changed. sync latancy is now like 4hrs behind and our dashboards are stale. this is the 3rd time this week, we allready rotated the password once but didnt help. can someone check the connecter logs on your side, our pipeline id is wr-pg-0417
answer: Thanks for flagging this, I can see intermittent auth failures on connector wr-pg-0417 starting Monday and I'm digging into the connector logs now. This looks like it may be a stale credential cache issue on our side rather than your database creds being wrong, so please hold off rotating again until I confirm. I'll update you within a few hours with findings and a fix or workaround for the latency backlog.

subject: Slack alert routing for Salesforce integration
body: We'd like to set up Slack alerts whenever a Salesforce sync integration fails or completes, similar to how we already get Jira notifications. Right now we only find out about failed syncs when someone checks the integrations dashboard manually. Could you point me to how to configure this, or let me know if it's not yet supported for Salesforce connectors?
answer: Good question - Slack notifications for Salesforce sync events are supported, you can enable them under Integrations > Salesforce > Notification Settings and choose which event types (success, failure, or both) post to a channel. If you don't see that option on your integration yet, let me know the integration ID and I'll check the config on our end. Happy to walk through setup on a call if useful.

subject: Uploads failing intermittently to Storage buckets
body: We're integrating the Storage API for backup uploads and starting yesterday around 14:00 UTC we get intermittent 500 errors on PUT requests to /v1/storage/objects. Roughly 1 in 5 uploads fail with 'internal_error' and no further detail in the response body. Retrying usually works on the second attempt but this is affecting our nightly backup job for around 40GB of files. Bucket ID is bc-backup-01.
answer: Thanks for the details. I've pulled logs for bucket bc-backup-01 and can confirm a spike in 500s starting around the time you noticed, we're seeing elevated error rates on one of our storage nodes. We're rerouting traffic away from that node now and I'll monitor over the next hour to confirm the failure rate drops back to normal, will follow up with confirmation and any root cause once identified.

subject: help
body: Our SDK integration started throwing errors this morning on nearly every call. We're using the Python SDK v4.2.1 and getting 429 Too Many Requests even though our usage is well under the documented rate limit of 1000/min - we're averaging maybe 200/min. This is blocking our production ingestion pipeline for the legal document review tool, affecting all 15 users on our team.
answer: This is escalated as P1 given the production impact. We've identified that the rate limiter is misapplying limits for accounts on certain plan tiers, and your account appears to be affected - we're rolling out a fix now. In the meantime, please retry with exponential backoff on 429s and let us know if calls are still being throttled after the next 30 minutes, we'll confirm once the fix is fully deployed.

subject: SAML Login schlägt für alle Nutzer fehl
body: Seit heute Morgen ca. 08:15 Uhr können sich unsere Mitarbeiter nicht mehr über SAML SSO anmelden. Der Identity Provider zeigt 'SAML Response Validation Failed - Signature Mismatch' an. Wir haben über 4000 Lizenzen und praktisch alle Login-Versuche schlagen fehl, das Support-Team wird bereits mit Tickets überflutet. Wurde an unserer SAML-Konfiguration etwas geändert?
answer: Wir haben das Problem als P1 eingestuft und untersuchen es sofort. Es sieht so aus, als hätte sich das Signaturzertifikat bei einem routinemäßigen Rollout geändert, ohne dass Ihr IdP synchronisiert wurde. Wir stellen Ihnen in Kürze das aktualisierte Zertifikat zur Verfügung und melden uns, sobald der Login wieder funktioniert, voraussichtlich innerhalb der nächsten Stunde.

subject: Biometric login crashes app on Android 14
body: We're integrating the Mobile SDK for our legal client portal and biometric login (fingerprint) crashes the app immediately on Android 14 devices, specifically Pixel 8 running our test build. The crash log points to a null pointer in BiometricPromptCallback.onAuthenticationSucceeded. This works fine on Android 13. Could you check if there's a known compatibility issue with the latest SDK, and is there a fix planned or a workaround we can use?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. We're aware of a compatibility issue with BiometricPromptCallback on Android 14 introduced in SDK version 6.3, a fix is already in progress and should ship in the next patch release. In the meantime, a workaround is to catch the callback exception and fall back to PIN login, I can send you a small code snippet if that helps unblock your testing.

subject: Push notifications not showing when app is in background
body: Our team has noticed that push notifications for booking updates only show up when the app is actively open, but not when it's running in the background or closed. We're testing on iOS 17 with the latest app version. Is there a setting in the admin console we need to enable, or additional permission handling we're missing on our end?
answer: Thanks for reaching out. Background push delivery on iOS usually requires the 'remote-notification' background mode capability to be enabled in your app's build settings alongside the push certificate configuration in the admin console under Mobile > Push Settings. Could you confirm whether that capability is enabled in your build? If so, send over your app bundle ID and I'll check the certificate status on our side.

subject: URGENT NEED BULK USER DEACTIVATION FEATURE NOW
body:
WE HAVE 243 SEATS AND NEED TO DEACTIVATE 60 FORMER EMPLOYEES TODAY BUT THE ADMIN CONSOLE ONLY LETS US DEACTIVATE ONE USER AT A TIME. WE TRIED THE BULK IMPORT CSV BUT GOT THIS ERROR REPEATEDLY:
ERROR: BulkActionFailed code=400
reason: 'invalid_field: deactivation_date not in allowlist'
rows_processed: 0
rows_failed: 60
THIS IS BLOCKING OUR COMPLIANCE REQUIREMENT FOR OFFBOARDING AND WE NEED THIS FIXED TODAY.
answer: I understand the urgency given your compliance deadline and I'm treating this as P1. The bulk deactivation CSV error is caused by an outdated template field, 'deactivation_date' isn't part of the current allowlist - please remove that column and resubmit, or use the updated template I'm attaching to this ticket. I'll stay on this ticket until we confirm all 60 accounts are deactivated today.

subject: Plan upgrade not reflecting correct seat count on invoice
body: We upgraded from 180 to 224 seats last week through the billing portal, but our latest invoice dated this morning still shows charges for only 180 seats at the old rate. We need the corrected invoice and seat count updated urgently since we're onboarding new staff this week and want billing to match our actual usage before month-end close.
answer: Thanks for flagging this, I've confirmed the seat upgrade to 224 went through correctly in our system on your account but the invoice generation didn't pick up the change before it ran. I'm issuing a corrected invoice reflecting 224 seats now and will have it in your billing portal within the hour, along with a note ensuring next month's cycle reflects the update automatically.

subject: App crashes on launch after latest update
body: One of our team's devices started crashing the mobile app immediately on launch after updating to the latest version yesterday, it happens consistently on an iPhone 13 running iOS 16.5. Other team members on iOS 17 haven't seen the issue. Not urgent since it's just one device so far, but wanted to flag it in case it's a broader compatibility issue with older iOS versions.
answer: Thanks for the heads up, this is helpful to know. We haven't seen other reports of crashes on iOS 16.5 yet, but I'll check our crash reporting for that device profile and see if anything correlates with the latest release. If you can grab the crash log from the device (Settings > Privacy > Analytics > Analytics Data) and send it over, that would help us pinpoint the cause faster.

subject: Recurring upload failures to Storage buckets this week
body: Since Tuesday we've had at least 40 failed uploads to our retail-inventory bucket, mostly files over 2GB. The UI shows 'Upload interrupted: quota check failed' even though our dashboard says we're at 78% of allocation. This is blocking our nightly backup job for the analytics warehouse and I need to know if this is a real quota issue or a bug on your end.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report - a quota check error at 78% usage does sound off, so we're treating this as a backend issue rather than a true limit breach. We're pulling the upload logs for your bucket now to see what's triggering the false quota flag, and will also check if large-file uploads are hitting a timeout that's being misreported as quota. We'll follow up within one business day with findings and a fix or workaround for your backup job.

subject: Late-arriving records breaking downstream aggregation windows
body: We're integrating the Data Pipelines API for our claims processing feed, and we're seeing records arrive 20-45 minutes after their event timestamp, well outside our 15-minute aggregation window. Pipeline ID dp-7841-claims shows this happening on roughly 12% of records daily over the past week. Is there a way to configure a grace period or late-arrival buffer so these records get reprocessed into the correct window instead of being dropped?
answer: Good catch, and yes there is a way to handle this - Data Pipelines supports a configurable late-arrival watermark that can extend your aggregation window without reprocessing the whole batch. I'll send over the config parameter for pipeline dp-7841-claims along with recommended settings based on the 45-minute delay pattern you're seeing. In the meantime, we'll also check whether something upstream is causing the consistent 20-45 minute lag so we can address the root cause.

subject: SCIM group sync not applying correct role permissions
body: We use SCIM provisioning through our IdP to sync users into Northwind, and new members added to our 'Editors' group are landing with only viewer-level permissions instead of the mapped editor role. This started after we added MFA enforcement to the group last week. Only a handful of accounts are affected so far, but I want to confirm whether this is a known SCIM mapping bug before it spreads further.
answer: Thanks for flagging this - we have seen a small number of cases where enabling MFA enforcement on a synced group can interfere with role attribute mapping during SCIM provisioning. Since only a few accounts are impacted, this isn't urgent, but we'll investigate your group's mapping configuration and confirm whether it's the same known issue. We'll get back to you with either a config fix or an ETA for a permanent patch.

subject: Dashboard load times degrading across shared reports
body: Our operations dashboards, especially the shared production-metrics view used by shift leads across all facilities, have gone from loading in about 3 seconds to over 20 seconds this past week. We haven't changed chart counts or data sources. With 1824 seats depending on these views for real-time floor status, this slowdown is affecting a lot of people. We'd like to request a review of what changed and any recommended configuration adjustments to restore performance.
answer: Appreciate you bringing this to us given the scale of impact - a jump from 3 to 20+ seconds without changes on your end suggests something shifted on the rendering or query side. We're going to review recent changes to shared dashboard caching and query load for your workspace, and will also check if the production-metrics view has grown in underlying data volume. We'll propose configuration adjustments, such as caching or chart consolidation, once we've identified the cause.

subject: audit log missing
body: Audit log shows nothing since yesterday, need this fixed now.
answer: We're treating this as urgent given the audit log gap. Can you confirm the exact workspace name and the last timestamp you saw a logged event? We're checking our logging pipeline on our end right now for any outage affecting your account and will update you as soon as we identify the cause.

subject: Workspace settings changes not reflected in audit log
body: I updated our workspace allowlist to add three new IP ranges through the Admin Console API last Thursday, and the change took effect correctly, but the audit log shows no corresponding entry for that action. We rely on the audit log for compliance reviews, so I want to understand whether this is a display issue or if the event genuinely wasn't recorded.
answer: Thanks for the report - this isn't affecting many users so we've filed it as a lower-priority issue, but it's still worth tracking down for your compliance needs. We'll check whether allowlist updates made via the API are excluded from audit logging by design or if this is a gap in event capture, and confirm the correct behavior along with a timeline if a fix is needed.

subject: Dashboards timing out during shift-change hours
body: Every day between 6-7am and 2-3pm when shifts change, our production dashboards time out or take over a minute to load for our operations team. This is a small team of 28 seats but the dashboards are critical for handoff between shifts, and today three separate people couldn't pull up the line-status view during the 2pm handoff. We need this addressed quickly since it's disrupting daily operations, and we'd also like to request the option to pin frequently-used charts for faster loading.
answer: This is impacting your daily operations directly so we're prioritizing it. We're looking into whether concurrent access during your shift-change windows is causing query contention on the line-status view, and will have an initial finding within a few hours. We'll also log your request for pinned/cached charts as a feature suggestion and let you know if there's an existing workaround we can enable sooner.

subject: Mobile app offline mode not syncing after reconnect
body: Our field team uses the mobile app in areas with poor connectivity, and when offline mode kicks in, data entered while offline doesn't sync once the connection returns - it just sits there until the app is force-closed and reopened. We've confirmed this on both iOS and Android devices in the last two weeks. With only 4 seats on our team, this is manageable to test but it's slowing down our daily reporting.
answer: Thanks for the clear reproduction steps across both platforms - a sync that requires a force-close isn't expected behavior for offline mode. We'll pull the sync logs from your account to see where the queued data is getting stuck after reconnect, and will follow up with either a fix or a temporary workaround so your field team doesn't have to keep force-closing the app.

subject: Pagination cursor behaving inconsistently on /v2/events endpoint
body: We're paginating through the /v2/events endpoint using the next_cursor field, and about once every few hundred requests the cursor returns a 400 error with 'invalid_cursor: expired' even though we're requesting the next page within seconds of the previous response. We're also seeing a deprecation notice in the response headers mentioning cursor-based pagination will change soon - could you clarify what's replacing it so we can plan our integration accordingly?
answer: Thanks for reporting this - a cursor expiring within seconds isn't expected, so we'll investigate whether there's a race condition or a shorter-than-documented TTL on cursors for /v2/events. On the deprecation notice, we can confirm that cursor-based pagination is being replaced by a token-based scheme with longer validity; we'll send over the migration guide and timeline so you can plan the update without disruption.

subject: Request: Slack alert integration for renewal and account changes
body: As we're approaching our renewal discussion, we'd like to explore having Northwind's Slack integration push alerts for account-level events, such as usage thresholds or contract milestones, directly into our ops channel. We already have Salesforce, Okta, and Jira connected, and want to know if Slack alerting can be configured similarly or if it requires a separate setup given our Enterprise tier and 452 seats.
answer: Glad to hear you're already using our Salesforce, Okta, and Jira integrations - Slack alerting for account-level events can be configured similarly through the Integrations hub, and as an Enterprise customer you'd have access to the full event trigger set including usage thresholds and contract milestones. We'll loop in your account team to walk through setup options ahead of your renewal conversation and make sure the alerting maps to what your ops channel needs.

subject: Dashboards taking 15-20 seconds to load for our team
body:
Our main revenue dashboard has been really slow since last week - it used to load in 2-3 seconds and now it's taking 15-20 seconds every time, even for simple widgets. We have 11 seats on the workspace and everyone on the team is hitting this, not just me. Nothing changed on our end that I'm aware of, no new filters or shared views added recently.

Can you check if there's something on Northwind's side causing this? We rely on this dashboard every morning for our booking numbers and the delay is starting to disrupt our standup.
answer:
Thanks for the details - a jump from 2-3 seconds to 15-20 seconds across your whole team points to something specific rather than general load, so I'm looking into your workspace now. Could you confirm which dashboard (name or URL) is the slowest one, and whether it includes any exported or scheduled views? That will help me narrow down if this is a data volume issue or a caching problem on our end.

I'll update you within the next few hours with findings, and if needed we'll escalate to our dashboards engineering team.

subject: Duplicate invoice charge this billing cycle
body:
We noticed our October invoice (INV-88214) shows two charges of $312.00 instead of one for our 24 seats on the Starter plan. Our finance team caught this during reconciliation and flagged it to me since I handle the Northwind integration on our end. The charge dates are Oct 3 and Oct 4, both showing the same line items.

Can someone confirm whether this is a billing system glitch or if we're being double-billed for seats? We need this resolved before our next statement closes on the 15th.
answer:
Thanks for flagging this and including the invoice number - a duplicate charge on the same seat count is unusual and I want to get it corrected before your statement closes. I'm pulling up invoice INV-88214 now to check the charge log and will confirm within the day whether this was a processing duplicate on our end.

If confirmed, we'll issue a refund for the extra $312.00 charge and I'll follow up here with the reference number once it's processed.

subject: Requesting quota increase and clarification on retention policy
body:
We're at 92% of our storage quota across our Pro workspace (265 seats) and need to either increase the limit or understand our options before we hit the cap. Separately, I've noticed that files we marked for deletion under our 90-day retention policy are still showing up in backups after the retention window passed - specifically a batch from July that should have been purged by early October.

Can you help increase our quota and also confirm whether this retention/backup behavior is expected or a bug? We'd like to avoid manually auditing backups going forward.
answer:
Thanks for flagging both issues together. On the quota side, I can process an increase for your workspace - can you confirm the new limit you'd like to move to so I can get that scheduled? On the retention question, files persisting in backups past the 90-day window after deletion does sound like unexpected behavior rather than by design, so I'm opening an investigation with our storage team to check how retention policies interact with backup snapshots.

I'll report back with findings on the backup issue and confirm the quota change once it's live.

subject: How do credits get applied to refunds on our account?
body:
We had a partial refund issued last month for an overcharge on our Starter plan, and I noticed our account now shows a credit balance instead of the refund hitting our card directly. I want to understand how this works going forward - does Northwind default to account credits for refunds, or can we request the money back to our original payment method instead?

We have 22 seats and occasionally need actual refunds rather than credits for our accounting reconciliation, so any documentation on this would help.
answer:
Good question - by default, refunds under a certain threshold are issued as account credit that automatically applies to future invoices, but we can process a direct refund to your original payment method if that works better for your accounting process. Just let us know which past refund you'd like converted and I can arrange that.

I'll also send over our billing documentation page that covers credit vs. refund policies so your team has a reference for future cases.

subject: Scheduled sync to our booking connector has stopped running
body:
Our scheduled sync pulling data from our travel booking connector hasn't run since Tuesday, October 8th at 6am. Normally it runs every 4 hours and populates our reservations dashboard, but the sync history shows no runs at all after that timestamp - not even failed attempts logged. We have 13 seats and this pipeline feeds two other downstream reports that are now showing stale data going into a client presentation tomorrow morning.

This is urgent since the data is now 3 days old. Can someone check why the scheduler stopped triggering entirely?
answer:
This is escalated on our side immediately given the client deadline - a scheduler that stops triggering with zero logged attempts usually points to a connector auth or scheduling service issue, and I'm checking your pipeline configuration now. I'll have an update within the hour on root cause and a plan to get the sync running again before your presentation.

In the meantime, if you need a manual data pull to bridge the gap, let me know and I can trigger one on our end.

subject: Push notifications not delivering to iOS users - major issue
body:
Since yesterday around 2pm, push notifications on our mobile app have completely stopped reaching iOS users - we've confirmed this across multiple test devices and gotten feedback from field agents who rely on transaction alerts. Android seems unaffected. We have 186 seats and this is impacting real-time fraud alerts our team depends on throughout the day.

We also had one app crash report come in from a user who says it happened right after trying to open a notification, though that might be unrelated. Can someone look into the iOS push delivery issue urgently - this is a critical function for us.
answer:
I understand the urgency given this affects real-time fraud alerts - I'm escalating this immediately as a P1 to our mobile platform team. Since Android is unaffected, this points to something specific in the iOS push certificate or APNs configuration, and we're checking our notification service logs from yesterday afternoon onward right now.

Can you send us the crash report details separately so we can check if it's related? I'll update you as soon as we have root cause, and will keep this thread open until iOS delivery is confirmed working again.

subject: Scheduled data sync failing repeatedly with connector timeout errors
body:
I'm integrating our retail inventory connector and our scheduled sync has failed 14 times in the last 6 hours with the same error. Here's the log from the most recent attempt:

2024-10-11T09:42:03Z ERROR connector.sync: timeout after 30000ms
2024-10-11T09:42:03Z ERROR sync.retry: attempt 4/4 failed, marking job as failed
2024-10-11T09:42:03Z WARN sync.scheduler: next scheduled run in 15 min will proceed

We have 268 seats and this connector feeds our live inventory counts to three retail locations. Data has been stale since this morning and store managers are asking why counts aren't updating. Can someone look at this urgently?
answer:
Thanks for including the log output, that's very helpful. A consistent 30-second timeout across 14 attempts suggests either a connector-side rate limit or a network path issue rather than a random failure, and I'm escalating this as P1 given the impact to your store locations. I'm pulling the connector's health metrics now to check timing on our end.

I'll have a preliminary finding within the hour - in the meantime, if you can share the connector name/ID from your pipeline settings, that will speed up the diagnosis.

subject: Audit log missing entries for deactivated user accounts
body:
We're trying to reconcile our admin console audit log after deactivating 5 user accounts last week as part of an offboarding process, but none of the deactivation events show up in the audit log at all - only login and permission-change events are logged. We need these records for a compliance review due at the end of this month. We have 22 seats total.

Is this a known gap in what audit logs capture, or is something broken? We also noticed the audit log page takes noticeably longer to load than it did a few months ago - sometimes 8-10 seconds just to open the page.

Can you confirm whether deactivation events should be logged and help resolve both issues before our compliance deadline?
answer:
Thanks for flagging this, and given your compliance deadline I'm treating this as high priority. Deactivation events should absolutely appear in the audit log, so if they're missing entirely, that looks like a logging gap on our end rather than expected behavior - I'm escalating this to our platform team to check if there's a bug in how deactivation events are being captured or indexed.

On the page load slowness, I'll have that checked in parallel. I'll follow up with a timeline for both fixes as soon as I hear back, since I know your deadline is tight.

subject: Recurring card decline on our monthly invoice
body:
Our card on file has been declined twice now for our monthly Starter plan invoice - once on October 1st and again on the retry on October 4th. The card itself is active and has plenty of available balance, we checked with our bank. We have 18 seats and want to make sure our account doesn't get suspended over this while we sort out the payment method.

Could you tell us why the charge is failing on Northwind's end, or if we should just update to a different card to avoid further declines?
answer:
Thanks for reaching out, and no need to worry about suspension while we sort this out - I'll add a short grace period to your account. Card declines can sometimes happen due to how the billing descriptor or transaction type is flagged by the issuing bank even when funds are available, so updating to a different card is usually the fastest fix if your bank can't tell you the specific decline reason.

Let me know once you've updated the payment method and I'll manually retry the charge to confirm it goes through cleanly.

subject: Audit log API returning incomplete data after allowlist update
body:
I updated our IP allowlist yesterday via the admin console API and since then, calls to the audit log endpoint (/v1/admin/audit-logs) are returning truncated results - we're getting 50 records per page instead of the usual 200, and the pagination cursor in the response is null even though we know there are more records. This broke our compliance export script that runs nightly.

We have 18 seats and need this fixed quickly since our export job failed last night with no data captured. Is this related to the allowlist change or a separate bug?
answer:
Thanks for the specific detail on the endpoint and page size change - that's a strong lead. This does sound related to the allowlist update, possibly a rate-limiting or permission scope change tied to the new IP rules rather than a general outage, so I'm escalating this as P1 given your nightly export failed. I'm checking the audit-logs endpoint behavior against your allowlist config right now.

In the meantime, can you confirm the exact timestamp of your allowlist change? That will help us pinpoint whether it correlates directly with the pagination issue, and I'll update you as soon as I have a fix or workaround.

subject: Role mapping for SSO groups not applying correctly
body:
We use SSO with Okta for Lumen Systems and I noticed that two users assigned to the 'Manufacturing-Ops' group in our IdP are landing in the default Viewer role instead of Editor inside Northwind. I checked the role mapping rules under Identity settings and the group name matches exactly what's configured. This started after our last IdP metadata refresh on Tuesday.

Can you confirm whether role mapping re-evaluates on next login or only on initial provisioning? Not urgent, just want to understand the expected behavior so I can fix this for the affected accounts.
answer:
Thanks for the detailed report. Role mappings in Northwind Identity are evaluated at every login, not just initial provisioning, so a metadata refresh shouldn't have caused a stale assignment unless the group claim itself changed shape during that update. Could you send us the SAML assertion (or a screenshot of the group attribute) for one of the affected users so we can check it against your mapping rule?

In the meantime, you can force a re-evaluation by having the affected users log out and back in; if that doesn't correct the role, we'll dig into the attribute parsing on our side.

subject: Connector-Authentifizierung schlägt bei Snowflake-Quelle fehl
body:
Seit heute Morgen (gegen 08:15 Uhr) bekommen wir bei unserer Snowflake-Connector-Verbindung in der Data Pipeline 'energy-market-feed' den Fehler 'OAuth token refresh failed - invalid_grant'. Wir haben die Zugangsdaten nicht geändert und der Connector lief seit Wochen stabil. Aktuell stauen sich rund 40.000 Datensätze in der Warteschlange.

Könnt ihr bitte prüfen, ob es ein Problem mit dem OAuth-Refresh-Mechanismus auf eurer Seite gibt? Für uns ist das kritisch, da unsere Reporting-Pipelines auf diesen Feed angewiesen sind und die Latenz bereits über eine Stunde beträgt.
answer:
Vielen Dank für die genaue Fehlerbeschreibung. Ein 'invalid_grant' beim Token-Refresh deutet meist darauf hin, dass das OAuth-Refresh-Token abgelaufen oder widerrufen wurde, das kann auch bei unveränderten Zugangsdaten durch eine Richtlinienänderung auf Snowflake-Seite passieren. Wir prüfen jetzt die Connector-Logs für 'energy-market-feed' und melden uns in Kürze mit einer Einschätzung, ob eine erneute Autorisierung nötig ist.

Bitte versucht in der Zwischenzeit nicht, die Verbindung manuell neu zu verbinden, damit sich die Warteschlange nicht weiter aufbaut, während wir das Token-Handling prüfen.

subject: transforms failing, data exposed?
body: Transform job stopped, error mentions unmasked PII in output table.
answer: This is being escalated immediately as a potential exposure issue. Can you confirm the exact transform job name/ID and the output table so our security team can lock it down right now while we investigate the scope of exposure? We'll follow up within minutes with next steps.

subject: SAML login broken for entire legal team since this morning
body:
Starting around 9 AM today, users across Summit Legal are unable to log in via SAML SSO. The error shown is 'SAML response signature validation failed' on the Northwind login page. We haven't changed our IdP configuration or certificates recently. This is affecting roughly 250 people across our firm and is blocking access to case files and billing records.

We need this resolved quickly since our teams cannot work. Please advise if this is related to a certificate rotation on Northwind's side, as our IdP admin confirms nothing changed on our end.
answer:
We're treating this as high priority given the scope of impact. A signature validation failure like this is often tied to a certificate mismatch, and we did have a scheduled SSO certificate rotation window overnight - we're checking now whether your SAML metadata was updated to reflect the new signing certificate. Can you confirm the entity ID and ACS URL configured in your IdP so we can cross-check against what's on file?

We'll update you within the hour with either a fix confirmation or clear next steps to get your team back into login.

subject: API key rotation broke our integration
body:
I rotated one of our API keys yesterday through the console for our media publishing integration, and now all requests using the new key return 401 Unauthorized, even though I copied it directly from the dashboard. The old key still works but I know it's scheduled to be revoked in 48 hours per the rotation policy.

I also noticed a banner about API key format changes coming next quarter - does that affect how new keys need to be generated? Want to make sure I'm not hitting a deprecation issue rather than a bug.
answer:
Sorry for the disruption this caused. The 401 on newly rotated keys is usually due to a short propagation delay (up to 15 minutes) after generation, but if it's been longer than that we'll need to look at the key directly. Could you send us the key prefix (first 8 characters) and the timestamp of a failing request so we can trace it in our logs?

Regarding the upcoming format change, it's unrelated to this issue and will only apply to keys generated after the migration date - we'll send documentation ahead of time so nothing breaks on your end.

subject: Duplicate alerts and wrong routing on notification rules
body:
Our alert routing for Cobalt Legal has been sending duplicate emails for the same event, sometimes 3-4 copies of the identical alert within a minute. Additionally, alerts tagged for our 'Contracts' team are being routed to the general notifications inbox instead of the dedicated channel we configured last week.

This is causing real confusion for our team since people are missing important alerts buried in the duplicates, or not seeing them at all because they went to the wrong place. Can someone check our routing rule configuration for the Contracts category?
answer:
Thanks for flagging this, duplicate delivery combined with misrouting is clearly impacting your team's ability to act on alerts, so we're prioritizing this. Can you confirm the exact rule name or ID for the 'Contracts' routing and roughly when the duplicates started? We suspect there may be an overlapping rule matching the same event criteria, which would explain both symptoms.

We'll review your notification configuration now and get back to you shortly with either a fix or a workaround while we finalize it.

subject: Question about upcoming API deprecations
body:
I saw a note in the changelog about some v1 endpoints being deprecated next quarter, but I want to make sure I understand which ones affect our webhook integrations specifically. We're using the /v1/events and /v1/subscriptions endpoints for our healthcare reporting dashboard integration.

Could you point me to documentation that lists the exact replacement endpoints and timeline? We'd like to plan the migration properly rather than scramble later.
answer:
Good question, and glad you're planning ahead. The /v1/events endpoint is being replaced by /v2/events with the same payload structure plus additional webhook signature fields, while /v1/subscriptions will be merged into the new /v2/webhooks endpoint. Both v1 endpoints will continue working until the deprecation date listed in the changelog, giving you time to migrate.

We'll send over the migration guide with side-by-side endpoint mapping and sample payloads so your team can update the integration without guesswork.

subject: urgent api key stuff
body:
so basicaly we've been using the same api keys for our webhook setup since we started with northwind a few months ago and everything was fine, no isues at all untill this week. we integrated a new reporting tool last month and connected it thru the same keys becuase it seemed easier at the time and didnt think it would cause probelms.

anyway now our webhooks are just not firing at all, we get no events comming thru since yesterday and when i check the console it says key deprecated pls generate new one. this is blocking our whole reporting pipeline for pioneer media and we need this fixed today, customers are asking why dashboards are empty
answer:
Thanks for the details, and sorry for the disruption to your reporting pipeline. The 'key deprecated' message means that key was flagged as part of our scheduled rotation for keys older than the supported window, which is why webhooks stopped firing once it hit the cutoff. You'll need to generate a new API key from the console and update it in both your original integration and the new reporting tool since they're sharing the same credential.

Given this is blocking dashboards for your customers, please generate the new key now and send us the key prefix once done so we can confirm webhook delivery resumes on our end - we'll monitor it with you today.

subject: Offline-Modus der Mobile App funktioniert nicht mehr
body:
Seit dem letzten App-Update (Version von letzter Woche) stürzt unsere Mobile App bei Ember Media ab, sobald ein Nutzer offline geht und versucht, gespeicherte Formulare zu öffnen. Die App zeigt kurz einen weißen Bildschirm und schließt sich dann komplett. Das betrifft mehrere unserer Außendienstmitarbeiter, die regelmäßig ohne Verbindung arbeiten müssen.

Gibt es eine bekannte Lösung dafür oder können wir vorübergehend zu einer älteren App-Version zurückkehren? Wir brauchen eine Zwischenlösung, bis das behoben ist.
answer:
Danke für die genaue Beschreibung, das hilft uns sehr bei der Eingrenzung. Wir haben tatsächlich Berichte über Abstürze im Offline-Modus nach dem letzten Update erhalten, die mit dem lokalen Formular-Cache zusammenhängen. Könnt ihr uns das Gerätemodell und die Betriebssystemversion der betroffenen Außendienstmitarbeiter nennen, damit wir das gezielt reproduzieren können?

Als Zwischenlösung empfehlen wir, den lokalen App-Cache über die Einstellungen zu leeren, bevor Nutzer offline gehen - das hat in ähnlichen Fällen den Absturz verhindert, bis wir einen Fix ausliefern.

subject: Need bulk user deactivation with audit trail
body:
We're restructuring several logistics teams at Harbor Retail and need to deactivate around 40 user accounts in the Admin Console this month as roles get consolidated. Right now I can only deactivate users one at a time, which is slow and doesn't give me a clean audit record of who did the deactivation and when for our compliance review.

Is there a bulk deactivation feature, either via CSV upload or a multi-select option in the console, that also logs each action to the audit log? If not, we'd like to request this as it will affect our quarterly access review process.
answer:
Thanks for the request, this is a common need for organizations doing team restructuring at your scale. Currently the console supports multi-select deactivation from the Users list (select up to 50 at once), and each action is automatically written to the audit log with the initiating admin, timestamp, and affected user IDs - so that part of your compliance need is already covered.

CSV-based bulk deactivation isn't available yet, but I'm logging this as a feature request tied to your account since it would clearly help your quarterly access review workflow, and I'll update you if it gets prioritized on the roadmap.

subject: DASHBOARD CHARTS BROKEN ACROSS ALL REPORTS - URGENT
body: OUR QUARTERLY REVENUE DASHBOARD HAS BEEN SHOWING BLANK CHARTS SINCE THIS MORNING. WE HAVE 142 USERS WHO NEED THIS FOR A BOARD MEETING TOMORROW AT 9AM. THE BAR CHARTS AND PIE CHARTS JUST SHOW A GREY BOX AND THE EXPORT TO PDF BUTTON FAILS WITH 'RENDER ERROR 502'. SHARING LINKS ALSO RETURN A BLANK PAGE. THIS IS BLOCKING FINANCE REPORTING AND WE NEED THIS ESCALATED RIGHT NOW.
answer: I understand how critical this is with your board meeting coming up, and I've escalated this to our dashboards engineering team as a P1. Can you confirm which browser and whether this affects a specific dashboard ID or all of them? In the meantime, try disabling any custom chart themes on the affected dashboard, as we've seen render errors 502 tied to a recent theme rendering bug we're actively patching.

subject: Zapier integration failing intermittently
body: Since Tuesday around 2pm our Zapier zap that syncs new Northwind invoices into Salesforce has been failing on roughly 1 in 5 runs. The error in the Zapier task history shows 'Northwind API returned 429 Too Many Requests'. We also have a second zap pushing billing alerts to Slack that seems fine. Can you check if something changed on the API rate limits for our account?
answer: Thanks for the detail. We did roll out a rate limit adjustment last week for the billing endpoints used by Zapier triggers, which may be causing the 429s during your sync windows. I'm checking your account's current limits now and will follow up shortly with either a temporary limit increase or guidance on spacing out the zap runs.

subject: Timeouts
body:
we keep getting logged out of the SSO portal every 10-12 minutes even when actively working, this started after we enabled the new session policy last week for our 150 seats. here's what shows in the browser console when it happens:

ERROR: session_expired
code: AUTH_4402
message: "Session token expired before refresh"
at SSOClient.refreshToken (sso-client.js:214)
at SSOClient.validateSession (sso-client.js:88)

is there a setting we can adjust to extend this, or is this a bug?
answer: Thanks for the log snippet, that's helpful. The AUTH_4402 error usually means the refresh token TTL is shorter than the session timeout you configured, which can happen after a policy change. Can you confirm the exact timeout value you set under Identity > Session Policy? I'll check your tenant config and adjust the refresh window so it aligns properly.

subject: API key rotation causing 401 errors
body: We rotated our production API key on March 3rd following the migration guide, but our mobile SDK integration is still throwing 401 Unauthorized on about 30% of requests. Looking at the logs, it seems like some requests are still using the old key cached somewhere. We're on SDK version 4.2.1. Is there a caching layer on your end that needs to be cleared after rotation, or is this a client-side issue we're missing?
answer: Good catch - SDK versions before 4.3.0 cache the API key in memory for up to 15 minutes after rotation, which explains the intermittent 401s you're seeing. I'd recommend upgrading to 4.3.0 or later where this was fixed, or in the meantime force a fresh app restart after rotating keys. Let us know if the 401s persist after the update and we'll dig into your specific key ID.

subject: Alerts being routed to wrong distribution lists
body: For the past two days our critical inventory threshold alerts have been going to the general operations list instead of the on-call pharmacy team distribution list we configured. This is causing duplicate alerts in the general channel and missed alerts on-call. We have 274 users across multiple sites relying on correct routing, and this is a patient-facing operational risk for us.
answer: This sounds serious given the patient-facing impact, so I'm marking this P1 and looping in our alerting team immediately. Could you send us the alert rule ID or a screenshot of your routing configuration for the affected threshold alert? We want to check whether a recent update to routing rules reverted your custom distribution list mapping.

subject: Production data pipeline down - transform step failing
body: Our nightly data pipeline job (pipeline ID dp-8841) has failed for the third consecutive run starting last night at 1:12am, with the transform step erroring out before completion. This is blocking all downstream reporting and we suspect it may be tied to a schema change on our source table. We need this restored immediately as our compliance reports are due this morning and no data has moved since yesterday.
answer: I've escalated pipeline dp-8841 to our on-call data engineering team right now given the compliance deadline. We're pulling the transform step logs to identify the schema mismatch and will update you within the next 30 minutes with either a fix or a rollback to the last known good schema version to unblock your reports.

subject: Anfrage: Sitzungstimeout-Einstellungen für SSO
body: Wir betreuen die SSO-Integration für unsere 3314 Nutzer und möchten die aktuelle Sitzungstimeout-Zeit von 30 Minuten auf 8 Stunden erhöhen, da viele Mitarbeiter im Außendienst häufig abgemeldet werden. Zusätzlich wäre es hilfreich, wenn MFA-Wiederholungen nach Ablauf nicht jedes Mal einen neuen Provisioning-Check auslösen würden, das verlangsamt den Login spürbar. Können wir diese Einstellungen zentral für unseren Tenant anpassen?
answer: Vielen Dank für die genaue Beschreibung. Wir können die Sitzungstimeout-Dauer für Ihren Enterprise-Tenant zentral anpassen, das würde ich gerne mit Ihnen im Identity-Bereich konfigurieren. Zum MFA-Verhalten bei Provisioning-Checks leite ich Ihr Feedback an unser Produktteam weiter, da dies aktuell als Verbesserung geprüft wird - ich melde mich mit einem Update dazu.

subject: Unable to enroll in MFA - stuck on QR code screen
body: One of our analysts is trying to enroll in MFA for the first time and the QR code screen just spins indefinitely after scanning with Google Authenticator. We've tried on two different devices and browsers with the same result. This is blocking her from logging in at all since MFA enrollment is now mandatory for our account. We only have 5 seats total so this is affecting a significant portion of our team.
answer: I'm sorry for the disruption, especially with such a small team affected. This sounds like it could be a stuck provisioning session on our end. Could you have the analyst clear cookies for the login domain and try enrollment again, and let us know the exact time of the next attempt? I'm also checking your account's MFA enrollment logs now to see if there's a stuck session we can manually clear.

subject: Need to update Okta SAML app configuration for Northwind
body: We need to update our Okta SAML app integration for Northwind to add two new attribute mappings for department and cost center, since we're rolling out access controls tied to Salesforce and Jira permissions next week. Could you provide the updated metadata XML or confirm if we need to regenerate the app in Okta on our side? We also want to confirm this won't disrupt our existing Slack SSO connection during the change.
answer: Thanks for planning ahead on this. We can generate updated SAML metadata with the two new attribute mappings without needing you to recreate the Okta app from scratch, which should avoid any disruption to your Slack SSO connection. I'll send over the updated metadata XML along with the exact attribute names to map, and we can schedule the change for a low-traffic window if you'd like.

subject: App-Absturz beim Start auf Android
body: Ich teste gerade die Integration unserer Fintech-App mit der Northwind Mobile App und stelle fest, dass die App auf einem Android-Testgerät (Pixel 6, Android 13) beim Start sofort abstürzt, sobald Push-Benachrichtigungen aktiviert sind. Ohne Push funktioniert der Login normal. Das betrifft aktuell nur dieses eine Testgerät, ist also nicht dringend, aber ich wollte es trotzdem melden.
answer: Danke für die genaue Beschreibung und den Testfall. Das klingt nach einem bekannten Problem mit der Push-Registrierung auf bestimmten Android-13-Geräten, an dem unser Mobile-Team bereits arbeitet. Da es aktuell nur ein Testgerät betrifft, würde ich vorschlagen, Push vorübergehend zu deaktivieren, bis wir den Fix in einem kommenden Release ausliefern - ich halte Sie über den Fortschritt auf dem Laufenden.

subject: Workspace settings not saving after deactivating users
body: I'm the data analyst managing our Admin Console at Atlas Travel and I've hit a bug in the workspace settings page. When I deactivate a user and then try to update our allowlist entries in the same session, the settings page freezes for close to 30 seconds and then reverts to the old allowlist values. I checked the audit log and it shows the deactivation succeeded but the allowlist change was never recorded. This has happened three times today across different users on our 140-seat workspace.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. This matches a known issue where settings writes get blocked while a deactivation event is still processing in the background, causing the allowlist update to silently fail. I'm escalating this to engineering with your workspace ID and the timestamps from your audit log so we can confirm the race condition and get a fix scheduled. In the meantime, please wait about a minute after deactivating a user before editing the allowlist to avoid the conflict.

subject: Need native Zapier trigger for user provisioning events
body: I'm the IT admin at Vertex Labs and we're trying to connect our Okta provisioning workflow to Zapier so new hires automatically get added to specific Northwind groups. Right now the Zapier integration only exposes generic 'user created' triggers with no way to filter by Okta group membership, which means every new user fires the same Zap regardless of role. We need a trigger that includes the Okta group attribute so we can branch the workflow correctly.
answer: Thanks for laying this out clearly. Right now the Zapier connector doesn't pass through Okta group attributes on the user-created trigger, so I understand why you're stuck. I'm logging this as a feature request with our integrations team and flagging your account as an active use case, since this comes up with other Okta customers too. In the meantime, a workaround is to add a Filter step in Zapier after the trigger that queries the Northwind Identity API for group membership before continuing the workflow.

subject: Recurring upload failures once we near storage quota
body: I manage finance operations at Quill Labs and over the past week our nightly backup uploads to Storage have failed twice, on the 12th and the 14th, both times with a 'quota exceeded' message even though our dashboard shows we're at 82% usage. I'd like to understand how the quota threshold is calculated and whether there's a grace buffer, since we're planning to request a higher retention window for compliance backups soon.
answer: Thanks for flagging this. The quota check actually includes staged temporary files during upload, which can push usage over the visible dashboard number even when you're technically under your plan limit. I'll have our team review the two failed jobs from the 12th and 14th to confirm this was the cause. Since you're also considering a longer retention window, I'll loop in our account team so they can discuss quota and retention options that fit your compliance needs.

subject: How to configure retention policy before backup upload
body: I'm a support engineer at Quill Robotics and we need to set a specific retention period on our Storage backups before we start uploading customer data files, since we're subject to a 90-day compliance requirement. Right now uploads seem to default to indefinite retention and I can't find a setting to change that per-bucket. Can you walk me through how to configure this correctly before our upload failures continue?
answer: Good question, and good timing to sort this out before more uploads go through. Retention policies are set at the bucket level under Storage > Settings > Retention, where you can specify a fixed day count like 90 days and it will apply going forward to new uploads. For files already uploaded without a policy, you'll need to apply the retention setting manually via the bulk edit tool, and I'm happy to walk through that with you on a call if it's easier.

subject: Users being logged out mid-session across all sites
body: I'm a support engineer at Apex Robotics and since this morning our clinical staff have been reporting unexpected session timeouts in Northwind Identity and SSO, logging them out after roughly 10-12 minutes instead of our configured 8-hour session length. This is affecting multiple hospital locations simultaneously and is disrupting workflows during patient intake. We have 1824 seats provisioned and this seems to be impacting a large share of active users right now.
answer: This is being treated as urgent given the scale of impact across your locations. We've confirmed a regression in session token refresh handling that's causing premature expiry for SSO sessions, and engineering is actively working a fix. I'll update you within the hour with a timeline, and in the meantime we recommend asking affected users to re-authenticate rather than refresh, which should hold the session for the configured 8-hour window.

subject: Mobile app crashes immediately on launch after update
body: I'm the IT admin at Vertex Travel and after our field staff updated the mobile app yesterday, it now crashes within a second of opening on both iOS and Android devices. We've confirmed this on at least 15 devices across our 241 seats, all running the latest app version. Staff can't clock in or access offline schedules, which is blocking store operations this morning.
answer: Thank you for the quick report and the device details. We've had a few similar reports tied to the latest release and are treating this as a priority fix, since it affects core functionality like clock-in and offline access. As a temporary measure, please advise staff to roll back to the previous app version if their device still has it cached, and we'll send an update as soon as we confirm the root cause and a patched release timeline.

subject: Connector delivering data 4-6 hours late, breaking downstream syncs
body: I'm a support engineer at Ember Labs and our primary data pipeline connector has been delivering records 4 to 6 hours later than scheduled since Tuesday, which is causing our downstream dashboards to show stale numbers for most of the business day. We depend on this sync completing by 6am for our morning reporting and it's been finishing closer to 11am or noon instead. This is affecting all 79 seats on our team who rely on same-day data.
answer: Thank you for the clear timeline, this is impacting your whole team so we're prioritizing it. We're seeing elevated processing queue times on the connector cluster serving your pipeline starting Tuesday, and our data engineering team is actively working to clear the backlog and identify the root cause. I'll follow up within a few hours with an update on when sync times should return to the normal pre-6am schedule.

subject: Offline mode crashes app when reconnecting to network
body: I'm a developer integrating the Northwind API for Blue Capital and I've found that when the mobile app loses network connectivity and then reconnects, it crashes consistently rather than syncing the queued offline actions. This is happening in our test environment on every device we've tried, roughly 8 out of 8 attempts, and it's blocking our launch since field agents need offline mode for site visits with unreliable connectivity.
answer: Thanks for the reproducible steps, that's very helpful. This looks like a critical bug in the reconnect-sync path for offline mode, so we're escalating it immediately given it blocks your launch. Can you send us the app version and device OS versions you tested on, along with any crash logs from the device console, so our mobile team can pin down the exact failure point today.

subject: SSO sessions timing out mid-task, forcing repeated MFA prompts
body: I'm a data analyst at Willow Retail and for the past two days our team has been getting logged out of Northwind roughly every 15 minutes, each time requiring a full MFA re-authentication before we can continue working. This is happening across multiple users and is severely slowing down our reporting work since dashboards keep interrupting mid-session. We have 50 seats on this workspace and it seems to affect everyone using SSO login.
answer: Thank you for reporting this, we understand how disruptive repeated MFA prompts are to your team's workflow. We're seeing this is affecting your whole workspace, so we're prioritizing an investigation into the SSO session duration settings, which may have reverted unexpectedly. We'll check your identity provider configuration and session timeout policy on our end and follow up shortly with findings, likely within the next few hours given the impact.

subject: Request to add PDF export option for dashboards
body: I'm a data analyst at Atlas Robotics and I'd like to request the ability to export dashboards directly to PDF, since right now we can only export to CSV or image formats. Our leadership team wants polished PDF reports for monthly reviews across our 259-seat account, and manually converting screenshots to PDF each month is time-consuming. Is this on the roadmap, and if so, is there a timeline?
answer: Thanks for the suggestion, this is a request we hear fairly often and I can confirm PDF export is currently under consideration by our product team for an upcoming dashboard release. I don't have a firm date to share yet, but I'll add your account to the list of customers interested in this feature so you're notified as soon as it's available. In the meantime, some customers use the print-to-PDF browser function on the dashboard view as a temporary workaround for cleaner formatting than screenshots.

subject: Need to update SCIM attribute mapping for new store roles
body:
We just added three new retail store roles (Store Lead, Inventory Clerk, Returns Specialist) and need our SCIM provisioning setup to map these correctly to Northwind groups. Right now new users from our IdP land in the default group with no permissions until we manually fix them. We're syncing from Okta, tenant URL ends in /scim/v2, and this started happening after our last HR system export on June 3rd.

Can someone walk us through updating the attribute mappings so these roles map to the right permission sets automatically? We have about 18 users affected so far.
answer:
Thanks for the details. We can update the SCIM attribute mapping on our end to add custom group mappings for the three new roles, but we'll need you to confirm the exact group names as they appear in Okta so we match them precisely. In the meantime, I'd recommend pausing automatic provisioning for those three roles to avoid more users landing in the default group.

Once you send the mapping list, we'll apply it within one business day and re-sync the affected 18 accounts so their permissions correct themselves without manual edits.

subject: Charts not rendering on shared dashboard - request to fix and improve sharing
body:
Our Budget Overview dashboard has three bar charts that show blank white boxes instead of data whenever it's opened via the shared link we send to department heads. It works fine when I open it directly while logged in, so this seems tied to how the shared view renders. This has been happening since around June 10th.

Could we also get an option to set default date ranges for shared dashboards? Several of our 243 users keep asking why the shared version doesn't reflect the same filters we set internally.
answer:
Thank you for flagging this. Blank charts on shared links usually point to a caching or permission issue with the shared view snapshot rather than the dashboard itself. We'll investigate why the shared link isn't rendering the same data as your logged-in session and get back to you with findings.

Regarding default date ranges for shared views, that's a reasonable request and we'll log it as a feature suggestion for our product team to review for a future release.

subject: Pagination broken on /v2/orders endpoint after SDK update
body:
After upgrading to SDK version 4.2.1 yesterday, our nightly sync job started failing on the /v2/orders endpoint. The 'next_cursor' field in the response is now empty even when there are clearly more than 100 records, so our pagination loop exits early and we're missing orders. We confirmed this against three separate accounts and the issue is consistent.

Our workspace ID is sf-8841 and the failing requests all return status 200 with a truncated result set, no error message. This is affecting our order reconciliation for June 11th and 12th so we need a fix or workaround soon.
answer:
Thanks for the clear repro details, this looks like it's tied to a regression introduced in SDK 4.2.1's cursor handling rather than the API itself. As a workaround, please pin your SDK to version 4.1.9 while we investigate the cursor field issue on workspace sf-8841.

We're reproducing this now with your account and will follow up with either a hotfix or confirmation of the root cause within the next business day, along with guidance on backfilling the missed orders from June 11-12.

subject: unsubscribe link 404s
body: Unsubscribe link in our digest emails returns a 404 page. Using notifications API v3.
answer: Thanks for the quick report. Could you send us one example message ID or the unsubscribe URL that's failing so we can trace which template or link generation logic is misconfigured? We'll prioritize a fix once we can reproduce it on our end.

subject: Mobile app crashes on launch for two users, need doc for troubleshooting
body:
Two of our team members are seeing the Northwind mobile app crash immediately after the splash screen on their Android phones, both running Android 13. It happens every time they open the app, even after reinstalling. The rest of our 8 users on iOS are unaffected.

Is there a troubleshooting guide we can point them to, or logs they can send you? Not urgent since most of the team can still use the web dashboard in the meantime.
answer: Thanks for letting us know. We don't have a public troubleshooting doc for this specific crash yet, but I can walk your two affected users through generating a crash log from the app's diagnostics menu (Settings > About > Send Diagnostics). Once we have that, we'll be able to tell if it's a device-specific issue or something broader with the Android 13 build.

subject: Offline mode losing cached data and crashing app for most field users
body:
Our field analysts rely heavily on offline mode to review dashboards without signal, but since the app update on June 9th, opening any cached dashboard while offline causes an immediate crash. This is affecting roughly 60 of our 80 users who work in areas with poor connectivity daily.

We've confirmed this on both Android and iOS devices, different models, all fully updated. Cached data seems to load for a second before the crash, so it looks like something in the offline renderer is failing. This is severely disrupting our field operations and needs urgent attention.
answer:
This is being escalated immediately given the scope of impact on your field teams. We've identified a likely regression in the offline renderer tied to the June 9th release and are prioritizing a fix. In the meantime, please advise affected users to avoid opening cached dashboards offline until we confirm a resolution, as repeated attempts may corrupt the local cache further.

We'll update you within a few hours with either a hotfix timeline or a workaround, and will keep this ticket open until field access is fully restored.

subject: Need restore from backup and clarification on retention limits
body:
We've been integrating our document management system with Northwind Storage for the past few weeks, uploading contract PDFs nightly via the API for our legal team's archive. Everything was working fine until we noticed our automated cleanup script accidentally deleted a batch of files tagged 'contracts-2024' instead of the older 'contracts-2021' batch it was supposed to target.

We need to restore those files from a backup snapshot, ideally from June 8th before the deletion ran. Can you confirm what backup retention window applies to our Starter plan and whether we can trigger a restore ourselves via API or if this needs to go through support?
answer:
Sorry to hear about the accidental deletion. On the Starter plan, backup snapshots are retained for 7 days, so a June 8th restore point should still be available. Restores currently need to be initiated by our team rather than via API, so please confirm the exact bucket path and file prefix ('contracts-2024') and we'll begin the restore process right away.

Given this involves legal document recovery, we're routing this through our compliance-aware restore process to ensure proper audit logging, and will confirm once the files are back in place.

subject: Dashboards taking 20+ seconds to load after API integration
body:
Since integrating our case management data via the API two weeks ago, our main dashboard now takes over 20 seconds to load, sometimes timing out entirely when exporting to PDF. We're pulling in around 15,000 records daily through scheduled API syncs, and the slowdown seems to correlate with when that sync runs each morning around 6am.

Workspace ID is oa-1147. Exports that used to take a few seconds now frequently fail with a generic 'export timed out' message. This is affecting our ability to share weekly reports with partner firms.
answer:
Thanks for the detailed report. The timing correlation with your 6am sync strongly suggests the dashboard queries are competing with the ingestion job for the same underlying tables on workspace oa-1147. We're looking into query optimization and whether we can stagger the sync window to reduce contention.

As a short-term step, could you try scheduling your exports for later in the morning, after the sync completes, to see if that resolves the timeouts? We'll follow up with findings on the root cause within a couple of business days.

subject: Sharing permissions not saving correctly on dashboard
body:
When I set a dashboard to 'view only' for a specific external partner and share the link, they're still able to edit chart filters and save changes, which shouldn't be possible under view-only sharing. I've tested this twice with two different external accounts and both times the permission didn't stick after the link was regenerated.

subject: How to schedule Salesforce sync outside business hours

Your existing field mappings will remain untouched when you change the schedule. Let us know if you'd like us to walk through the recommended off-peak settings for your data volume.

subject: Linking Jira issues to Northwind API events

The most reliable path today is routing your API webhook through Zapier or a custom relay to Jira's REST API for issue creation. We'll pass this along as a feature request for native support and update you if that changes.

subject: Frage zur Aufbewahrungsfrist für gespeicherte Dateien

subject: Legacy API key deprecation breaking CI deploys
body: We're integrating the Northwind API into our robotics fleet management system for the assembly line dashboards. Since this morning our CI pipeline started failing with `DeprecatedKeyFormatError: API key nw_live_8f2c... uses legacy format, please migrate to key version v2` on every call to /v1/auth/token. This is blocking a production deploy scheduled for today. Can you confirm the migration path and how long the legacy format will still be accepted?
answer: Thanks for flagging this quickly. Legacy-format keys are being sunset in stages, and it looks like your project rolled onto the new validation tier ahead of the full cutover. To unblock your deploy right away, generate a v2 key from the API Platform console under Keys > Rotate, and swap it into your CI secrets - the SDK (v3.4+) handles the new format transparently. I'm also escalating this internally to confirm the exact sunset date for legacy keys so we can give you a firm timeline.

subject: Best way to rotate deprecated keys without breaking webhooks
body: We're planning ahead for the API key format deprecation mentioned in the changelog. Our integration uses webhook signing secrets tied to the same key pair, and I want to confirm whether rotating to the v2 key format will also invalidate our existing webhook signatures. We use the Node SDK version 2.9.1 for logistics tracking updates. Is there a recommended sequence for rotating both without downtime?
answer: Good question, and glad you're getting ahead of this. Webhook signing secrets are independent of the API key format, so rotating to v2 keys will not invalidate existing webhook signatures - you can rotate keys first, verify auth calls, then optionally rotate the signing secret separately if you want a clean cutover. The Node SDK 2.9.1 already supports v2 keys, so no code changes should be needed beyond swapping the key value.

subject: Request: group-based SCIM provisioning with MFA enforcement

Is there a way to map SCIM groups directly to permission sets and MFA policy at provisioning time?
answer: This is a common ask and we do support part of this today: SCIM group mappings can be tied to permission sets via the Provisioning Rules panel. MFA enforcement at creation time isn't automatic yet, but you can set an org-wide MFA policy that applies to all users including SCIM-provisioned ones, which achieves the same result without per-account setup. I'll log a feature request for group-level MFA policy mapping and update you if it lands on the roadmap.

body: WE HAVE AN INTERNAL SECURITY AUDIT NEXT WEEK AND NEED TO CLEAN UP OUR IP ALLOWLIST BEFORE THEN.
