We rely on this for tracking energy grid incident tickets, so we need this working again urgently.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report - we're treating this as an urgent incident since it affects your incident tracking workflow. We've identified that the Jira webhook listener on our end started silently dropping events after a token refresh cycle this morning; we're redeploying the listener now and will re-sync any issues created during the outage window automatically. I'll update you here once sync is confirmed working and issues have backfilled.

subject: Anfrage: Slack-Benachrichtigungen für neue Integrationen
body: Wir würden gerne Slack-Benachrichtigungen für Ereignisse aus unserer Integrations-Konfiguration bei Willow Systems einrichten, ähnlich wie es wohl schon für Jira und Salesforce möglich ist. Aktuell sehen wir in den Einstellungen nur Optionen für E-Mail-Alerts, aber keine Slack-Webhook-Option. Ist das als Feature bereits geplant oder gibt es einen Workaround über die API, den wir nutzen könnten?
answer: Vielen Dank für die Anfrage. Slack-Benachrichtigungen für Integrationsereignisse sind aktuell noch nicht direkt in den Einstellungen verfügbar, stehen aber auf unserer Feature-Roadmap für dieses Quartal. Als Workaround können Sie über unsere Webhook-API Ereignisse abgreifen und selbst an einen Slack-Incoming-Webhook weiterleiten - ich schicke Ihnen gerne ein kurzes Beispiel-Skript dafür zu, falls das hilfreich ist.

subject: Dashboards loading slowly - some feedback
body:
We've been using the ops dashboard suite to track our daily settlement volumes across our fintech partners. Our team pulls these up every morning during standup, and lately we've noticed the load times creeping up, which is a bit annoying but not blocking anything critical.

Here's what shows in the browser console when it happens:
GET /api/v2/dashboards/847291/widgets 200 OK 8412ms
GET /api/v2/dashboards/847291/export 200 OK 11203ms
[Warning] Widget render exceeded 5000ms threshold

The export function especially seems to time out or take forever, sometimes 10+ seconds. Just wanted to flag it since it's been consistent for about two weeks now, no rush on this.
answer:
Thanks for the detailed report and for including those timing logs - that's really helpful context. An 8-11 second load on widgets and exports is longer than we'd expect, so I'm going to check whether your dashboard 847291 has an unusually high widget count or complex filters that could be contributing.

Since this isn't blocking your team, I'll treat it as a performance investigation rather than urgent - I'll follow up within a couple of business days with findings or a fix, and let you know if we need any additional detail from your side.

subject: Need to change our Salesforce sync mapping for new region rollout
body:
We're rolling out a new APAC region next month and need to update how our Salesforce sync handles account ownership fields. Currently the integration maps our Northwind account owner directly to the Salesforce Owner field, but we need it to route through a custom lookup field instead so our regional sales ops team can triage leads properly.

Can you walk us through how to modify this mapping without breaking the existing sync for our US and EU accounts? We have about 40,000 account records syncing daily and can't afford a disruption. We'd also like to know if this needs to go through a change ticket on your end or if we can self-serve it from the integration settings panel.
answer:
This is a good use case for a staged mapping change rather than an in-place edit, since you want to avoid disrupting the US/EU sync. I'd recommend cloning your current Salesforce integration config, applying the new lookup-field mapping to the clone, and testing it against a sandbox environment before cutting over the APAC records - that way the existing 40k daily records stay untouched during validation.

I'm looping in our integrations specialist to walk through the exact field-mapping steps with you on a call this week, and we'll open an internal change record on our side to track the cutover date so we can monitor the sync closely during the transition.

subject: Storage retention policy deleted files we needed - urgent
body:
We discovered this morning that files uploaded to our storage bucket back in March have been purged, even though our retention policy is set to 180 days and those files are only about 75 days old. We use this data for compliance reporting tied to travel booking records, and losing early access to it is a real problem for our upcoming audit.

Our bucket ID is lf-storage-0092. We had roughly 340 files in the March batch and about 60% appear to be gone based on our last export check. Can someone confirm whether this was a policy misconfiguration or a bug, and whether these files are recoverable from backup?
answer:
I understand the urgency here, especially with an audit coming up - I've escalated this to our storage team immediately to check backup snapshots for bucket lf-storage-0092. We're pulling logs now to determine whether this was a retention policy misapplication or a separate issue, and we'll prioritize recovery from backup if the files are still within our snapshot window.

I'll update you within the next few hours with findings and next steps; in the meantime, please avoid making further changes to the retention settings on that bucket so we don't complicate the recovery.

subject: Rate limit errors on webhook endpoint since SDK update
body:
We updated to the latest API Platform SDK version (3.4.0) last week and since then our webhook consumer has been hitting 429 errors during our nightly batch reconciliation job, which processes tuition payment records. Previously we never came close to rate limits with the old SDK version 2.9.

Looking at our logs, we're seeing roughly 180 requests per minute during the batch window, which shouldn't be unusual for us, but the new SDK seems to be making more granular calls than before, possibly due to a change in how webhook retries are batched. Is there a deprecation note we missed about retry behavior changes in 3.4.0?
answer:
Thanks for flagging this - there was a behavior change in SDK 3.4.0 where webhook retry logic switched from batched retries to per-event retries, which would explain the jump in request volume you're seeing during your nightly job. This wasn't called out clearly enough in our deprecation notes, and I apologize for the confusion it's caused.

I'm escalating this to our platform team to see if we can either adjust your rate limit tier temporarily or provide a config flag to restore batched retry behavior. In the meantime, I'd recommend spacing out your batch job invocations slightly to stay under the 429 threshold while we sort out a permanent fix.

subject: Need custom role mapping for SSO groups - blocking rollout
body:
We're finishing our SSO rollout across all 195 seats and hit a wall with role mapping. Our identity provider sends group claims like 'plant-floor-managers' and 'finance-admins', but Northwind's SSO configuration only lets us map to three fixed role tiers (Admin, Member, Viewer). We need at least two more custom tiers to match our manufacturing org structure, particularly for MFA enforcement differences between floor staff and office staff.

This is currently blocking our go-live date since we can't correctly restrict access without proper role granularity. Is there a way to enable custom role mapping, or a workaround using group-based conditional access rules?
answer:
I hear you on the urgency given your go-live timeline. Custom role tiers beyond the three defaults aren't available in the standard SSO configuration, but we do support group-based conditional access rules that can approximate what you need - specifically, you can create scoped MFA policies tied to your IdP group claims even if the underlying role tier stays at Member or Viewer.

I'm bringing in our identity specialist today to help configure this with you directly, since getting your floor-staff and office-staff MFA rules separated correctly before go-live is the priority. Expect a follow-up from them within the next few hours.

subject: question about upcoming API deprecations
body: I saw a mention in the changelog about some endpoints being deprecated soon but wanted to check what specifically affects us. We're on the Starter plan and use the REST API mostly for pulling usage reports into our internal energy consumption tracker. Could you clarify which SDK version we should be on and whether our current integration will break?
answer:
Thanks for checking in proactively. The deprecation notice applies to the v1 usage-report endpoints, which are being phased out in favor of v2 - if you're on SDK version 2.x or earlier, you'll want to upgrade to 3.x before the sunset date to avoid disruption. Your current integration should keep working for now, but I'd recommend migrating within the next couple of months since v1 support ends soon.

Let me know if you'd like a quick checklist of the specific endpoint changes so your team can plan the SDK upgrade without any surprises.

subject: Urgent: need Salesforce sync fixed and Slack/Okta integration added before Q2 launch
body:
Our Salesforce sync has been dropping records intermittently for the past week, affecting our sales pipeline visibility across all regions, roughly 1,200 employees rely on this data daily. We've confirmed at least 340 lead records didn't sync yesterday by cross-checking Salesforce report exports against our Northwind integration logs.

Separately, we're planning a Q2 launch and need to add Slack notifications and Okta-based access control to our integration stack, ideally coordinated with a Jira ticket workflow for our IT team to track rollout tasks. Can we get both the sync issue and the new integration requests handled with some priority given the scale of our org?
answer:
Given the scale of impact here with 340+ lead records missing sync across your organization, I'm escalating the Salesforce sync issue to our integrations team as a priority investigation right now - we'll check the sync logs against your Salesforce API call history to pinpoint where records are dropping.

For the Slack and Okta integration requests tied to your Q2 launch, I'll get those logged as a formal feature request with our product team and can set up a planning call this week to map out the Jira-tracked rollout alongside the sync fix, so both efforts move in parallel rather than waiting on each other.

subject: Scheduled sync connector showing high latency and data quality issues
body:
Our scheduled data pipeline sync from our billing system connector has been running noticeably slower over the past few days, jobs that used to complete in under 10 minutes are now taking 40-50 minutes. We also noticed a handful of records with mismatched totals compared to the source system, roughly 15 out of about 2,000 records in yesterday's sync batch.

This is affecting our monthly reconciliation process since we rely on these numbers being accurate for client billing statements. Could someone look into whether this is a connector-side issue or something on our config?
answer:
Thanks for the detailed numbers - a jump from 10 minutes to 40-50 minutes along with those mismatched totals suggests something is off on the connector side rather than your config. I'm having our pipelines team pull the sync execution logs from the past few days to check for throttling or upstream schema drift that could explain both the latency and the 15 mismatched records.

We'll get back to you within a day with findings, and if it turns out to be a data quality issue at the source connector level, we'll walk through remediation steps for the affected records before your reconciliation deadline.

subject: API deprecation causing webhook failures in production
body:
We're seeing webhook delivery failures since the v1 event API was deprecated yesterday. Our integration listens for usage-threshold events to trigger customer notifications, and since the cutover we've had zero events delivered for about 14 hours now. Our SDK version is 2.7.3, which I believe is the one flagged in the deprecation notice we got last month, but we hadn't migrated yet since the sunset date wasn't fully clear to us.

Can you confirm the migration steps needed and whether there's a temporary way to restore delivery while we update our SDK to the supported version?
answer:
I'm sorry for the disruption this is causing - since your SDK 2.7.3 was flagged in last month's notice, the v1 event endpoints it relies on were indeed sunset yesterday, which explains the delivery gap. As a temporary bridge, we can enable a short-term compatibility shim on your account to restore event delivery for up to two weeks while your team migrates to SDK 3.x, which uses the v2 event endpoints.

I'll get that compatibility shim enabled on our end within the hour, and I'll send over the specific SDK 3.x migration steps for webhook event listeners so your team can complete the update well within that window.

subject: Data pipeline sync latency causing downstream reporting delays
body:
We're integrating with the Data Pipelines connector for our travel booking reconciliation feed, and over the last three sync cycles the job has been taking significantly longer than usual, average completion time jumped from about 12 minutes to over an hour. This is delaying our downstream reporting pipeline that depends on fresh sync data every few hours.

We also spotted a data quality discrepancy in the last run: about 40 booking records had null values in fields that are normally populated, specifically the currency_code and total_amount fields. Job ID for reference is dp-sync-88213. Any insight into what changed on the connector side would help us plan around this.
answer:
Thanks for including the job ID, that'll help us dig in quickly. A jump from 12 minutes to over an hour combined with null values appearing in currency_code and total_amount on job dp-sync-88213 does point to something changed upstream in the connector's data handling - I'm pulling the execution history for that job now to compare against prior successful runs.

Given the downstream reporting impact, we'll prioritize this investigation and get back to you today with either a root cause or a mitigation step you can take while we resolve it on the connector side.

subject: API key rotation breaking webhook signature validation
body: We rotated our production API key this morning (key id ending in 7f3a) as part of our quarterly security cycle, and now all incoming webhook deliveries are failing signature verification on our end. The SDK (node-sdk 4.2.1) throws 'signature mismatch: expected HMAC does not match payload' for every event since the rotation at 09:15 UTC. We've double-checked our secret is updated in the webhook config, but it seems the old key may still be signing some payloads. This is blocking order sync for our manufacturing plants.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. This looks like a caching issue on our webhook signer that can lag behind key rotations by a few minutes in rare cases - we're checking whether your rotation at 09:15 UTC triggered that. Can you confirm the exact key id you rotated to and paste one failing payload plus the signature header you received, so we can compare it against what our webhook service actually signed with?

subject: IP allowlist change locked out our own admins
body: We updated the IP allowlist in Admin Console yesterday afternoon to add our new office range (203.0.113.0/24) and remove a decommissioned VPN block. Since then, three of our workspace admins, including myself, are getting 'Access denied: IP not permitted' when trying to log in from what should be an allowed range. The audit log shows the change was saved successfully at 3:42pm, but something isn't matching correctly against actual client IPs.
answer: Sorry for the disruption this is causing your admin team. We're looking at the audit log entry from 3:42pm now to see exactly what ranges were saved versus what's being evaluated at login. As a temporary workaround, can one unaffected admin add a broader temporary range or use the emergency access bypass documented in the allowlist guide, while we trace whether the CIDR block was parsed correctly?

subject: Need urgent way to deactivate a bad allowlist entry blocking 40+ staff
body: One of our team leads accidentally added an overly narrow /32 entry to our IP allowlist instead of the intended /24 range, and it's now the only active rule, which has locked out roughly 40 warehouse dispatch staff from the Admin Console since 8am. We need a way to quickly deactivate that single entry without wiping the whole allowlist, but the deactivation toggle in Settings isn't responding when we click it - it just spins. The audit log confirms the entry was added at 7:58am.
answer: This is being treated as urgent given the number of affected staff. We can see the audit log entry you referenced and are working on why the deactivation toggle isn't completing - it may be stuck on a background validation check. In the meantime, we can manually disable that specific allowlist rule from our side if you confirm the entry's exact IP value and the workspace ID, which will restore access for your team while we fix the toggle issue.

subject: Staff can't complete MFA enrollment after SSO rollout
body: We rolled out SSO for our 11 seats last week, and now several staff members are stuck at the MFA enrollment screen after their first SSO login - the QR code loads but scanning it in an authenticator app gives 'invalid setup key' every time. Two people have tried on different phones with the same result. We need this resolved quickly since it's blocking daily login for a small team that can't get any work done in the meantime.
answer: Thanks for flagging this - a QR code that fails validation right after SSO login usually points to a timing mismatch between the enrollment session and the authenticator's clock sync, though it can also happen with certain identity provider configurations. Could you tell us which SSO provider you're using and whether the affected users are entering the setup key manually or scanning the code, so we can pinpoint whether it's a provisioning issue on our side?

subject: Planning for webhook v1 deprecation and rate limit increase request
body: We saw the notice about webhook API v1 being deprecated and want to plan our migration to v2 across our energy monitoring integrations, which currently send about 45,000 events per day across our sites. Separately, we're occasionally hitting 429 rate limit responses during peak morning readings (around 7-9am local time) even though we're well under our documented quota, and our SDK logs show retries backing off but still failing intermittently. Can you advise on the migration timeline and look into why we're seeing unexpected rate limiting?
answer: Good timing on reaching out - v1 webhook deprecation is scheduled for the end of next quarter, and we'll send a migration guide covering payload schema changes and the new retry semantics in v2. On the rate limiting, 429s during your documented quota window suggest a possible burst-limiting issue rather than a daily cap problem; can you share your account ID and a rough timestamp of a recent 429 so we can check the request logs for that window?

subject: Shared dashboard shows 'access restricted' for teammates with view permission
body: I built a dashboard tracking our media campaign metrics and shared it with three teammates using the 'can view' permission, but when they open the link they get 'You do not have access to this dashboard' instead of the charts. I've confirmed their accounts are active and listed under sharing settings. I also tried exporting the dashboard as a link versus inviting them directly by email, same result both ways.
answer: Thanks for the clear steps you've already tried. This sounds like a permission propagation issue where the sharing setting isn't syncing correctly to the viewer's session - can you confirm whether your teammates are logging in via SSO or standard email/password, and whether they're in the same workspace as the dashboard owner? That will help us narrow down whether this is a caching problem or a workspace-scoping bug.

subject: Mass card declines blocking invoice payments across our account
body: Starting this morning, we're seeing repeated payment failures on our primary corporate card for multiple department invoices - error code 'card_declined: do_not_honor' - even though the same card processed fine last billing cycle and has no issues with our bank. This is affecting invoices for several of our 4,359 seats across departments, and we're worried about service interruption if this isn't resolved before our renewal date in three days.
answer: We understand the urgency given your renewal timeline, and we're escalating this immediately. 'Do not honor' declines can sometimes originate from the card issuer's fraud filters rather than our payment processor, but since this is affecting multiple invoices simultaneously we're also checking whether there's an issue on our processing side. Can you send us the invoice numbers and approximate timestamps of the failed attempts so we can trace them directly with our payments team while you also confirm with your bank that no blocks were placed on the card?

subject: Okta app integration not syncing user provisioning
body: We set up the Northwind Okta app following the integration guide, but new users assigned in Okta aren't appearing in our Northwind workspace - it's been over 24 hours since we assigned two test users. The Okta app shows 'provisioning successful' on their end, but nothing shows up on our admin panel's user list. We also tried the Slack and Jira integrations around the same time and those worked fine, so we suspect it's specific to the Okta connector.
answer: Thanks for isolating this to the Okta connector specifically, that's helpful. A successful provisioning status in Okta with no corresponding user on our side usually points to a SCIM mapping mismatch or an attribute missing from the payload. Could you check whether the users have a primary email attribute mapped in the Okta app configuration, and send us the app instance ID so we can check the provisioning logs on our end?

subject: Duplicate email digests sent every morning
body: For the past four days, our team has been receiving two identical copies of the daily notification email digest, both timestamped within a minute of each other around 6am. We only have digest notifications enabled once per day in settings, and no one on our 4-person team has a second account or duplicate subscription set up. It's cluttering inboxes and making it harder to track which alerts are new.
answer: Thanks for reporting this with the timing details - duplicate digests sent within a minute of each other usually point to a scheduling job firing twice rather than a subscription issue on your end. We're checking the notification queue for your account around your 6am send window over the past few days to see if there's a retry or duplicate trigger, and will follow up once we identify the cause.

subject: Refund not showing on invoice
body: Requested refund 3 weeks ago, still not on my invoice. Can you check?
answer: Thanks for reaching out - we're looking into the status of your refund request now. Could you share the invoice number or the date you submitted the request so we can locate it and confirm where it stands?

subject: Duplicate email digests going out to all subscribers
body: Since this morning our weekly email digest has been sent twice to every subscriber on the Apex Travel media list - once at 6:02am and again at 6:47am with identical content. We're getting complaints from readers asking why they got the same newsletter twice. Can you confirm if this is a known issue with the digest scheduler and how we can stop the duplicate from going out again next week?
answer: Thanks for flagging this right away - we can see the double-send on our end and are treating it as an active incident. It looks like a scheduler retry fired a second job before the first one finished delivery confirmation; we're pausing your digest queue now so no further duplicates go out and will follow up within a few hours with a root cause and a fix before next week's run.

subject: Users getting logged out every 15 minutes after SSO login
body: Several of our 108 users on Harbor Freight's SSO integration are reporting they get kicked back to the login screen roughly every 15 minutes, even during active use. This started after we updated our IdP metadata last Thursday. Session timeout in the Northwind admin console is set to 8 hours, so this doesn't match our configuration. Can you check if the session token TTL is being overridden somewhere on your side?
answer: Thanks for the detail on the timing and the IdP metadata update - that's a useful clue. We'll check whether the new metadata changed the assertion lifetime being sent to us, since a shorter SAML session attribute would override your 8-hour console setting. We'll get back to you within the next few hours with what we find in the SSO logs for your tenant.

subject: Recurring card decline errors blocking billing for 231 seats
body: We're seeing repeated card failures on our Atlas Energy account with error code card_declined on nearly every retry attempt since October 3rd, despite the card having sufficient funds and working fine with other vendors. This is affecting invoicing for our full 231-seat Pro plan and we need this escalated - can someone from billing look into whether Northwind's payment processor is flagging our account incorrectly?
answer: We're escalating this to our billing team immediately given the scale of impact on your account. Initial review shows the declines are coming back from our processor with a generic risk-flag code rather than an insufficient-funds response, which suggests it may be on the processor side rather than your card itself. We'll update you within the day with either a resolution or a workaround so your invoicing isn't held up further.

subject: Request to add per-list unsubscribe preferences
body: Right now when a recipient unsubscribes from one of our notification lists on Cobalt Retail's account, it looks like they get unsubscribed from all Northwind email types at once. We'd like the option for customers to unsubscribe from, say, promotional digests but stay opted into order alerts. Is granular unsubscribe management on your roadmap, or is there a workaround using tags today?
answer: Good question, and this comes up often. Today unsubscribe is global per contact, but you can approximate granular control by using separate sender identities per notification category so recipients only unsubscribe from that specific stream. We'll pass your request for true per-list preferences to our product team as a feature request and update this ticket if it gets scheduled.

subject: Need help configuring Zapier trigger for new pipeline records
body: I'm setting up a Zapier integration for Cobalt Foods to trigger a Slack notification whenever a new record lands in our data pipeline via the Northwind API. The Zap connects fine but the trigger only fires on the first test event and then goes silent - no new triggers since Tuesday. We also plan to route the same event to Jira and Salesforce, so I want to confirm the trigger polling behavior before building those out.
answer: Thanks for the details - this sounds like the Zapier trigger may be stuck on a stale polling cursor rather than a webhook issue, which would explain why only the first test fired. We'll check the trigger subscription status on our integration platform for your account and confirm the correct polling interval so you can safely build out the Jira and Salesforce steps on top of it.

subject: How to let end users manage unsubscribe preferences at scale
body: We support a large deployment for Apex Robotics with 1,824 seats and are getting frequent tickets from our own end users who can't find a self-service way to unsubscribe from specific Northwind notification categories. Right now they have to email us and we manually update settings. Is there a documented API or admin setting we can use to let users manage their own subscription preferences, and can you point us to the relevant docs?
answer: Thanks for raising this - given your scale, self-service is definitely the right direction. There's a notification preferences endpoint in our API that lets end users update their own category subscriptions without going through your admin team; I'll send over the documentation link and a sample payload so your team can wire it into your existing user portal.

subject: Same billing digest emailed 3 times this morning to finance list
body: Our finance team at Quill Media received the same monthly billing digest email three separate times between 5:15am and 5:40am today, each with identical invoice totals attached. This is confusing our accounting staff who think three invoices were generated. Can someone check the digest job for our account and confirm no duplicate charges were actually created alongside the duplicate emails?
answer: We understand the concern, especially around anything that looks like duplicate billing - to be clear, this is an email delivery issue only and we've confirmed no duplicate charges were generated on your account. We're actively investigating why the digest job fired three times this morning and will have a fix in place before next month's send, with a follow-up once we've confirmed root cause.

subject: Need bulk user deactivation with audit trail
body: As we restructure teams at Summit Partners, we need to deactivate around 15 users at once in the Admin Console, but currently it looks like we can only deactivate one user at a time and the audit log doesn't clearly show who performed each deactivation. Is there a bulk action available, and can the audit log entry include the admin's role and timestamp? This would help us a lot for our upcoming compliance review.
answer: Bulk deactivation isn't available in the console today, only via one-by-one action, so we've logged this as a feature request on your behalf. In the meantime, each deactivation event is recorded in the audit log with timestamp and the performing admin's account ID, so you can export that log ahead of your compliance review while we look into adding bulk support and clearer role labeling.

subject: MOBILE APP OFFLINE MODE IS USLESS AND KEEPS CRASHIGN
body: im so done with this, the mobile app for Blue Capital crashes every single time i try to open it without wifi, it just closes back to the home screen instantly. we travel to sites with no signal all the time and cant even log in to check anythng offline. also push notifications never come through even when we do have signal again later. this is basically broken and if it doesnt get fixed soon we're cancelling our plan.
answer: I'm sorry for the frustration this is causing, especially when you're relying on the app at sites without signal - that's exactly when it should work reliably. Offline mode is intended to let you view previously synced data without a connection, so an immediate crash on launch is not expected behavior; please send your device model and app version so we can reproduce the crash, and we'll also check why push notifications aren't catching up once connectivity returns.

subject: Unsubscribe requests not being processed, users still getting emails
body: We're seeing an issue where employees at North Freight who click unsubscribe on our Northwind notification emails still receive the same alerts days later. I've confirmed at least 6 users who unsubscribed between October 1st and October 5th are still getting daily notification emails as of today. Can you check whether unsubscribe requests are actually being written to the suppression list?
answer: Thanks for the specific dates and user count, that helps us narrow this down quickly. This points to a possible delay or failure in syncing unsubscribe requests to the suppression list, so we're checking the processing queue for your account now and will confirm within a few hours whether those 6 users were correctly suppressed and get them removed from future sends immediately if not.

subject: Incorrect seat count on latest invoice
body: I'm reviewing our October invoice for Atlas Partners (account under education plan, 5 seats) and it lists 7 seats billed instead of 5. We haven't added any users since August 12th. Invoice number INV-88213 shows the discrepancy under line item 'Starter Plan Seats'. Could someone check the billing history and issue a corrected invoice or credit?
answer: Thanks for flagging this, and sorry for the confusion on INV-88213. I've pulled up your account and can confirm the seat count sync from July didn't reconcile properly after two users were deactivated. I'm issuing a credit for the two extra seats now and will regenerate the invoice with the correct 5-seat total within one business day.

subject: Zapier trigger for new user doesn't fire
body: We're trying to set up a Zap that creates a task in our project tool whenever a new user is added in Northwind Identity, but the 'New User Created' trigger in the Northwind Zapier app hasn't fired in the last three test runs since Monday. We also use Okta for SSO, so I'm not sure if that's related. Is this trigger supposed to work with SSO-provisioned users, or only ones added manually?
answer: Good question — currently the 'New User Created' trigger only fires for users added directly through the Northwind admin console or API, not for those provisioned via Okta SSO just-in-time provisioning. We're tracking this as a feature gap and I've added your account to the request list for SSO-triggered events. In the meantime, a workaround is polling the Users API on a schedule via a scheduled Zap.

subject: Urgent: v1 webhook signature deprecation breaking our integration
body: We just saw the notice that the v1 webhook signature scheme is being deprecated on November 15th, but our production integration for Ember Works still verifies signatures using the old HMAC-SHA1 method across 54 seats' worth of booking workflows. Our SDK version is northwind-sdk-python 3.2.1, and the docs for the new HMAC-SHA256 migration path return a 404 at /docs/webhooks/migration. We need the correct migration steps and a rate-limit exception while we roll this out, since we're processing around 40k webhook events daily.
answer: Thanks for the heads up on the broken docs link — that's been escalated internally and I'll get you a working link shortly. For the signature migration, you'll want SDK 4.0.0+ which supports dual verification (both HMAC-SHA1 and SHA256) during the transition window, so you can upgrade without downtime before the Nov 15 cutoff. I'm also flagging your account for a temporary rate-limit increase given your event volume; expect confirmation within a few hours given the urgency.

subject: Transform step failing on connector sync - blocking production
body: Our nightly pipeline job for Delta Capital has been failing at the transform stage since last night's run at 2:14 AM UTC. The connector pulling from our PostgreSQL source (connector ID pg-conn-4471) completes extraction fine, but the JSON-to-column mapping transform throws 'TypeError: cannot convert field contract_date to timestamp' repeatedly. This is blocking three downstream dashboards our legal ops team depends on daily, and we need this resolved today.
answer: I understand the urgency here since this is blocking your downstream dashboards. Looking at connector pg-conn-4471, it appears a recent source schema change altered contract_date from a date type to a string with mixed formats, which our transform mapping can't parse. I'm escalating this to our pipelines engineering team now to add a flexible date parser, and in the meantime I'll send you a config patch to explicitly cast that field so today's run can complete.

subject: Handling late-arriving records in daily connector sync
body: For Quill Energy's logistics data pipeline, we're pulling shipment records from our warehouse connector on a daily schedule, but a portion of records consistently arrive 12-18 hours after their event timestamp due to upstream carrier delays. Right now these late records get dropped from the daily aggregate since the window has already closed. Is there a way to configure a grace period or late-arrival window on the connector so these records get included in the correct day's rollup?

I'll walk you through the exact configuration steps in a follow-up message, but let me know your connector name and I can apply it directly if you'd prefer.

subject: Mobile app crashes immediately on launch for all users

subject: Question on file retention policy for uploaded documents
body: We're integrating Northwind Storage for Blue Academy's student document uploads and I want to confirm how retention works. Files uploaded through our API endpoint /v1/storage/upload get a default retention tag, but I can't find where to set a custom retention period per bucket. Our compliance policy requires we keep transcripts for 7 years but delete draft uploads after 90 days. Can retention be set at the folder level or only account-wide?
answer: Retention can be configured at the folder level, not just account-wide, so you can absolutely set different rules for transcripts versus draft uploads. You'll want to create two folders with distinct retention policies via the /v1/storage/folders endpoint, setting retention_days to 2555 for transcripts and 90 for drafts. I'll send over a short guide with example API calls for setting this up on your account.

subject: Files being deleted before retention period ends

answer: Thank you for reporting this, and I understand the compliance concern. We're looking into the specific bucket now, and this pattern matches a known issue where retention timers reset incorrectly after a folder rename operation, which we believe caused the early deletion for your itinerary backups. I'm escalating this to our storage engineering team to confirm root cause and will follow up with findings and any recovery options for the affected files.

subject: Question about storage quota and retention for backups
body: I handle billing for Willow Systems and noticed our storage usage dashboard shows we're at 82% of our quota, mostly from backup files retained under our legal document policy. I'd like to understand how retention settings affect quota calculation — do files pending deletion after their retention period still count against our quota until they're actually purged, or is there a grace period?
answer: Good question — files do continue to count against your quota until the retention period expires and the scheduled purge job runs, which happens nightly, so there can be up to a 24-hour lag between expiration and quota release. Given you're at 82%, I'd suggest reviewing your oldest backup sets to see if any are eligible for early cleanup, and I'm happy to send a breakdown by folder if that would help.

subject: Änderungsanfrage: Offline-Modus für Mobile App verbessern

subject: SDK throwing errors after recent update
body:
We updated the Northwind Python SDK to version 3.8.0 last night and now every API call throws 'RateLimitExceeded: quota exhausted' even though we're well under our usual request volume. This is blocking our entire data pipeline that pulls usage data for reporting - all 11 of our team members' scripts are failing with the same error.

Here's the traceback we're seeing:
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File 'sync_usage.py', line 42, in fetch_data
    response = client.get_records(page=1)
northwind.exceptions.RateLimitExceeded: quota exhausted (limit: 100/min, retry_after: 60)

This looks like a bug in 3.8.0 where the SDK's internal rate-limit counter isn't resetting correctly between calls, causing it to falsely report quota exhaustion. We're treating this as a priority fix given it's blocking your pipeline - in the meantime, staying on 3.7.2 as you've done is the right call. I'd also like to know if there's a way to export the dashboard as a scheduled PDF and share it with two external contractors who don't have Northwind logins.
answer: Thanks for reaching out - a few things can help with load times on larger dashboards, such as reducing the number of live widgets or switching some charts to cached refresh intervals, and I'm happy to walk through your specific dashboard configuration. For sharing with external contractors, Starter plan doesn't currently support external share links, but scheduled PDF export to email is available and I can send you setup steps for that.

subject: API-Deprecation betrifft unsere Webhook-Integration
body: Wir haben die Ankündigung zur Abschaltung der v1 Webhook-Endpunkte erhalten, die am 30. April erfolgen soll. Unsere Integration nutzt aktuell noch das alte SDK (Version 2.3) und mehrere Rate-Limit-Header, die im neuen v2 Schema anders benannt sind. Wir befürchten, dass unser Event-Processing für Zahlungsbenachrichtigungen komplett ausfällt, wenn wir nicht rechtzeitig migrieren können. Können Sie uns eine Übergangsfrist oder Migrationsleitfaden zur Verfügung stellen?
answer: Vielen Dank für die schnelle Rückmeldung - da dies produktionskritische Zahlungsbenachrichtigungen betrifft, stufen wir dies als hohe Priorität ein. Wir senden Ihnen umgehend den Migrationsleitfaden für v1 zu v2 inklusive der neuen Rate-Limit-Header-Namen und prüfen intern, ob für Ihr Konto eine kurze Übergangsfrist über den 30. April hinaus möglich ist.

subject: Need to adjust pipeline sync window for late-arriving vendor data
body: Our media asset connector regularly pulls in records from a third-party vendor that arrive 6-8 hours after the batch window closes, causing us to miss roughly 15% of daily records in the nightly sync. We'd like to change the sync schedule or add a late-arrival buffer so these records get picked up in the next run instead of being dropped. Can you point us to documentation on configuring watermark delays for connectors?
answer: This is a common pattern with vendor feeds that have variable latency, and there is a watermark delay setting for connectors that lets you extend the lookback window without re-processing the full batch. I'll send over the documentation link along with a recommended configuration based on your 6-8 hour delay pattern, and we can also set up a brief call if you'd like help tuning it.

subject: SAML SSO LOGIN COMPLETELY BROKEN FOR ALL USERS - URGENT
body:
WE ARE UNABLE TO LOG IN VIA SAML SINCE THIS MORNING, ALL 1629 SEATS ARE LOCKED OUT. THIS IS AFFECTING OUR ENTIRE FINANCE TEAM DURING MONTH END CLOSE. HERE IS THE ERROR FROM OUR IDP LOGS:

SAMLResponse validation failed: signature mismatch
cert_fingerprint: 4A:2B:9C:FF:11:00:AA:BB
expected_issuer: https://sso.northwind.com/saml/metadata
actual_issuer: https://sso.northwind.com/saml/metadata-v2
timestamp: 2024-06-11T08:14:22Z

WE NEED THIS FIXED IMMEDIATELY. IF THIS ISN'T RESOLVED TODAY WE WILL BE ESCALATING TO OUR ACCOUNT TEAM AND CONSIDERING OTHER PROVIDERS.
answer: We understand the urgency and this has been escalated to our identity team as a top priority incident given the full lockout. The issuer mismatch in your log suggests your IdP metadata may be pointing to a legacy endpoint that was rotated during a recent certificate update on our side - we are verifying this now and will push a fix or send you the corrected metadata URL within the hour, with continuous updates until access is restored.

subject: Question about webhook deprecation timeline for legacy event types
body: I saw in the changelog that the 'invoice.updated' webhook event is being deprecated in favor of 'invoice.status_changed', but our SDK integration (using the Python client v3.1) still references the old event name in a few places. Is there a hard cutoff date for the old event, and will the SDK auto-map to the new name or do we need to update our code manually?
answer: Good question - the 'invoice.updated' event is scheduled for removal on the date listed in the changelog, and unfortunately the SDK does not auto-map between the two event names since the payload structure changed slightly. I'd recommend updating your webhook handlers to listen for 'invoice.status_changed' ahead of the cutoff, and I can share a short code snippet showing the payload differences if that helps.

subject: Feature request: retry configuration for outgoing webhooks
body: We're currently receiving webhook events for our pipeline status updates, but when our endpoint is briefly unavailable (during deploys), we lose those events since there's no retry mechanism visible in the dashboard. Is there a way to configure retry attempts or a dead-letter queue for failed webhook deliveries? Even a basic exponential backoff with 3-4 retries would help a lot for our small setup.
answer: Thanks for the suggestion - configurable retry policies for webhooks aren't available yet in the dashboard, but I can confirm this is on our product team's radar as a frequently requested feature. In the meantime, I'd recommend having your endpoint return a 200 quickly and queue processing internally to reduce missed events during deploys, and I'll pass your specific use case along to the product team as additional feedback for prioritizing retry support.

subject: Dringend: Freigabe-Berechtigungen für Dashboards funktionieren nicht
body: Seit dem Update am Montag können mehrere Kollegen aus unserem Legal-Team keine geteilten Dashboards mehr öffnen, obwohl sie als Betrachter freigegeben wurden. Die Fehlermeldung lautet 'Zugriff verweigert' beim Öffnen des Links. Wir haben 588 Nutzer im Workspace und mindestens 40 Personen sind betroffen, die für ein wichtiges Mandanten-Reporting heute noch Zugriff brauchen. Zusätzlich laden die Charts bei den wenigen, die noch Zugriff haben, sehr langsam.
answer: Das nehmen wir sofort als hochpriorisierten Fall auf, da ein wichtiges Reporting heute betroffen ist. Wir prüfen gerade, ob das Update vom Montag die Freigabe-Rollen für Betrachter zurückgesetzt hat, und melden uns innerhalb kürzester Zeit mit einer Lösung sowie einer Einschätzung zu den langsamen Chart-Ladezeiten zurück.

subject: Session timeout duration for SSO users
body:
I'm a workspace admin at Delta Systems and we've had a few employees ask why their SSO sessions are timing out after what seems like 30 minutes of inactivity. We'd like to confirm the current session timeout policy for our workspace and understand whether this is configurable per-group, since our travel desk staff need longer sessions than back-office admin roles.

Could you point me to documentation on adjusting timeout and MFA re-prompt settings, and let us know if this requires escalation to have changed for specific permission groups?
answer:
Thanks for reaching out. Session timeout for SSO is configurable at the workspace level and, on Enterprise plans, can also be scoped per permission group, including separate MFA re-prompt intervals. I've attached our Identity and SSO admin guide covering these settings under Security > Session Policies.

If you'd like different timeout values for specific groups such as travel desk vs back-office, let me know the group names and desired durations and I can walk you through the configuration or escalate to our identity specialists if you'd prefer it done on our end.

subject: Dashboards extremely slow to load - affecting finance reporting
body:
Our finance team at North Academy has been unable to get monthly reporting dashboards to load in under 2-3 minutes since last Tuesday, October 8th. Previously these loaded in under 10 seconds. This is affecting close-of-month reporting for our healthcare billing division and multiple analysts across our 3256-seat account are impacted.

We've tried clearing cache and using a different browser with no improvement. Exporting to CSV from the same dashboards also times out with a generic error. Can someone investigate urgently as this is blocking our month-end deliverables?
answer:
I understand how disruptive this is heading into month-end close, and I'm escalating this to our performance engineering team right now as a P1. We've seen similar reports tied to a recent indexing change on large dashboard datasets, and we're checking whether your workspace is affected by that same issue.

In the meantime, could you send me the specific dashboard names or IDs that are slow along with a rough row/record count if you know it? That will help us pinpoint the bottleneck faster while we work on a fix for the export timeout as well.

subject: Mobile app crashes on launch after latest update
body:
Since updating the Northwind mobile app to the latest version last week, the app crashes immediately on launch on my iPhone 13 running iOS 17.5. I'm a data analyst at Atlas Travel and rely on the app for offline case review during client travel, so this is a real blocker for my workflow.

I've tried reinstalling the app twice and restarting the phone, but the crash happens every time right after the splash screen, before I even get to the login screen. Could you look into this or let me know if there's a known issue with push notification permissions causing this?
answer:
Thanks for the detailed report. We do have an open issue affecting app launch on iOS 17.5 tied to a push notification permission check introduced in the last release, and your description matches that pattern closely. Our mobile team is preparing a patch release to address this.

As a workaround, you can try disabling notifications for the app in iOS Settings before launching it, then re-enabling them once you're logged in, which has resolved the crash for other users in the meantime. I'll update this ticket as soon as the fix is live and let you know the version number to update to.

subject: Repeated card decline errors blocking API billing
body:
I'm integrating the Northwind API for Granite Robotics and our production account has had three consecutive card failures on our billing account since October 5th, each generating a decline with code 'card_declined: insufficient_funds' even though our card has sufficient limit per our bank. This has resulted in our API keys being throttled and two invoices marked unpaid.

We need this resolved quickly since our logistics tracking API calls are being rate-limited as a result. Can someone check the payment processor logs on your end and confirm whether this is a Northwind-side issue with the payment gateway rather than our card?
answer:
This is impacting your API access so I'm treating it as a priority incident and pulling the payment gateway logs for your account now. We've had isolated reports of false 'insufficient_funds' declines tied to a processor-side validation issue affecting some cards this week, and I want to rule that out before assuming it's on your bank's end.

I'm lifting the throttling on your API keys manually while we investigate so your logistics calls aren't blocked, and I'll follow up within a few hours with findings and next steps on the unpaid invoices, including a retry or manual charge option if needed.

subject: Refund needed for duplicate charge and unused seats
body:
I'm the operations lead at Blue Freight and noticed our October invoice charged us for 25 seats, but we downgraded to 15 seats back on September 20th through the admin console. On top of that, it looks like we were billed twice on October 1st for the same invoice amount of $412.50.

Could someone confirm the seat count reduction was applied correctly and process a refund for the duplicate charge and the extra seats we shouldn't have been billed for? Our invoice number is INV-88213.
answer:
Thanks for flagging this, and I'm sorry for the billing confusion. I'm looking into invoice INV-88213 now to confirm whether the seat downgrade from September 20th was reflected in this billing cycle, and I can see the duplicate charge you mentioned on our end as well.

I'll process a refund for the duplicate charge and adjust the invoice to reflect 15 seats rather than 25, then send you a corrected invoice and confirmation once it's done, which should be within the next business day.

subject: Audit log missing entries for deactivated users
body:
I'm a data analyst at Vertex Capital reviewing our admin console audit log for a compliance check, and I've noticed that user deactivation events from October 1st through October 6th are completely missing from the log, even though I can confirm three accounts were deactivated during that window based on our internal records. The allowlist changes we made around the same time also aren't showing up.

This is a serious gap for us since we need a complete audit trail for our media compliance review due this Friday. Can you check whether logging was interrupted on our workspace?
answer:
This is a significant gap and I've escalated it to our platform team immediately given the compliance deadline you mentioned. We're checking whether there was a logging pipeline interruption affecting audit events for your workspace during that window, including both deactivation and allowlist changes.

I'll update you within a few hours with what we find, and if the events truly weren't captured we'll work with you on reconstructing the trail from other system records to help meet your Friday review deadline.

subject: pdf export problem
body:
hey so we have been using the dashbords for a few months now for our monthy finance review and its been mostly fine, we share them with the ops team every week and everyone likes the charts especialy the revenu breakdown one. anyway last month someone asked if we could export the whole thing to pdf instead of just screenshoting it for the board deck.

so i tryed the export to pdf button on the main revenue dashbord and it only exports the first chart, the other 3 charts just dont show up in the pdf at all, its just blank space where they shoud be. is this a known issue or am i doing something wrong? would be nice to get this fixed or at least know a workaround since board meeting is next week.
answer:
Thanks for the detail, and no worries, this is a known limitation with multi-chart dashboards where charts below a certain scroll position sometimes don't render in the PDF export. Our product team is aware and it's on the roadmap for improvement.

As a workaround for your board deck next week, try exporting each chart individually using the per-chart export option (three-dot menu on each chart) and combining them, or resize the dashboard to a single-column layout before exporting, which has helped other customers get all charts to render. Let me know if you'd like a hand with either approach.

subject: Data pipeline connector delivering data hours late
body:
I'm a finance manager at Summit Health and our billing data connector, which normally syncs from our source system every 2 hours, has been delivering data with a delay of 6-8 hours since October 10th. This is causing our downstream billing dashboards to show stale numbers, which our media division leadership is starting to question during weekly reviews.

Can someone check the connector sync logs for our workspace and let us know if there's a backlog or a specific bottleneck causing the latency? We'd like this resolved or at least understand the timeline before our Thursday leadership review.
answer:
Thanks for the details, this is helpful for narrowing things down. I'm checking the sync logs for your billing connector now to see if there's a queue backlog or a source-side rate limit causing the delay, since a 6-8 hour lag from a normal 2-hour cadence usually points to one of those two causes.

I'll have an update for you by tomorrow with either a fix or a clear timeline so you have something concrete ahead of Thursday's review, and I'll flag this internally as a priority given the recurring visibility issue for your leadership team.

subject: Slack integration not sending alerts
body:
We've had our Slack integration set up for a while now to notify our ops channel whenever shipment status changes come through, and it's been working fine for months alongside our other integrations. Last week we also connected a Jira workflow for ticket creation, which seems to be working okay.

The actual problem is that since around October 9th, the Slack alerts for shipment status changes have just stopped coming through entirely, even though the events are still showing up correctly in our activity log. Nothing was changed on our Slack workspace side that we're aware of. Can you check if something changed with the Slack connector?
answer:
Thanks for laying out the timeline, that helps. Since the events are showing correctly in your activity log but not reaching Slack, this points to a delivery issue on the Slack connector side rather than your event source, possibly related to a token or webhook expiration around the time you mentioned.

Could you check in your Slack app settings whether the Northwind integration still shows as authorized? If it looks fine there, I'll pull our connector logs for your workspace to check for failed delivery attempts around October 9th and get back to you with what we find.

subject: URGENT: API pagination broken, all paginated requests returning duplicate/missing records
body:
As of this morning our production integration using the Northwind API Platform is returning broken pagination results. Requests to /v2/transactions with a page_size of 100 and cursor-based pagination are returning duplicate records across pages and skipping others entirely, meaning our reconciliation jobs are producing incorrect financial data. This started around 6:40 AM UTC today.

We are a fintech company and this is directly affecting our ability to reconcile client transactions accurately, which is a compliance concern for us. We need immediate confirmation this is a known outage and an ETA for resolution.
answer:
We've confirmed this is an active outage affecting cursor-based pagination on /v2/transactions and several other endpoints, starting around 6:40 AM UTC, and our engineering team is treating it as top priority with all hands engaged. The issue is related to a cursor invalidation bug introduced in a recent deploy, and we are working on a rollback now.

Given the reconciliation impact you described, I strongly recommend pausing any automated reconciliation jobs until we confirm resolution, as data pulled during this window cannot be trusted. I will post updates here every 30 minutes and notify you the moment the fix is deployed and verified.

subject: SSO role mapping not assigning correct groups
body:
We're using SAML SSO with our IdP for Summit Partners and I've set up group attribute mapping so users in "Retail-Managers" get the Manager role in Northwind. Since Tuesday, new logins are landing in the default Viewer role instead, even though the SAML assertion shows the correct group attribute. I checked three affected accounts and the attribute name matches what's configured in our role mapping rules.

Can you confirm whether something changed on the mapping evaluation order, or if there's a case-sensitivity issue with group names? This isn't blocking anyone since we can manually fix roles, but I'd like it resolved before we onboard more stores next month.
answer:
Thanks for the detailed report. Role mapping evaluation is case-sensitive on the group attribute value, and we did roll out a stricter validation check last week that may be surfacing a mismatch that was previously silently tolerated. Could you send me the exact group attribute string from a recent SAML assertion (via browser dev tools or your IdP logs) so I can compare it against your mapping rule configuration?

In the meantime, as a workaround you can duplicate the mapping rule with the alternate casing to cover both variants while we confirm root cause.

subject: Okta integration pushing duplicate users into Salesforce sync
body:
Since yesterday our Okta app integration with Northwind has started creating duplicate contact records in Salesforce every time a user's profile updates in Okta. We've counted at least 40 duplicate entries created between 9am and 2pm today. This is messing up our billing reconciliation reports because Salesforce now shows inflated account counts.

We have a Jira ticket open internally (QE-1142) tracking the downstream Salesforce cleanup, but I need to know if something changed on the Okta-to-Northwind sync side that's triggering repeated create events instead of updates. Please escalate if needed, this is affecting our finance close process this week.
answer:
Sorry for the disruption this is causing to your close process. We can see increased sync event volume from your Okta app connector starting yesterday around 8:45am, consistent with duplicate creates rather than updates being triggered. I'm escalating this to our integrations team now to identify whether the upsert key matching logic is failing on your instance.

While we investigate, I'd recommend pausing the Okta-to-Salesforce sync job if possible to prevent further duplicates, and I'll update you within a few hours with root cause and a plan to clean up the affected records.

subject: Offline mode crashes app on reconnect
body:
Our field staff use the Northwind mobile app in areas with poor signal, and since the last update offline mode is causing the app to crash whenever connectivity returns. Steps: open app with no signal, make a few edits to a work order, then walk back into coverage. The app freezes for about 10 seconds then closes completely. This happens on both iOS and Android devices, tested on 6 different phones.

We have 9 seats and all of our field team relies on this daily, so this is a serious problem for us right now. Edits made offline seem to be lost after the crash too, which is even worse. We need this fixed urgently as it's affecting today's operations.
answer:
I'm very sorry this is impacting your field team's operations today. Crashes on reconnect with data loss are a top priority for us and I'm flagging this as P1 immediately. Could you confirm your app version and OS versions for the affected devices, and let me know if you can reproduce this consistently on a single device so we can capture a diagnostic log?

In the meantime, please ask your team to avoid making offline edits until we confirm a fix, and sync data only when in a stable connectivity area to reduce the risk of losing work.

subject: Recurring transform failures in daily pipeline sync
body:
Our nightly data pipeline job that transforms inventory feeds from our warehouse system has failed three nights in a row now, Monday through Wednesday this week. The error log shows "transform stage: null reference in field mapping 'unit_cost' at row 14022" each time, but the source file looks fine on our end. Latency on the job also jumped from about 12 minutes to over 40 minutes before it fails.

With 200 seats across our energy operations teams relying on this data being fresh each morning, we need a fix or at least a workaround so downstream dashboards aren't stale. Can someone look into whether a recent schema change on our end could be causing this?
answer:
Thank you for the detailed error info. A null reference at a specific field mapping combined with increased latency suggests the transform stage may be hitting an unexpected null value in your source data that's also causing retries under the hood. Could you share a sample of rows around row 14022 from your source file (with sensitive values redacted) so we can confirm whether it's a data quality issue or a mapping configuration problem?

As a workaround, you can set the 'unit_cost' field mapping to allow nulls with a default fallback value temporarily, which should let the job complete while we investigate the root cause.

subject: Unsubscribed users still receiving duplicate emails
body:
We've had several customers reply saying they unsubscribed from our product update notifications through Northwind two weeks ago but are still getting duplicate emails, sometimes two copies of the same notification in one day. I checked our notification settings dashboard and it shows those users as unsubscribed, so something isn't syncing between the preference center and the actual send job.

This is damaging our credibility with retail media partners who are already annoyed. Can you check why the unsubscribe status isn't being honored by the sending pipeline? We need this fixed fast since it's generating angry replies daily.
answer:
I completely understand the urgency here given the impact on your partner relationships, and I'm treating this as P1. It sounds like there's a disconnect between the preference center status and the send job's suppression list check. Could you send me two or three specific recipient identifiers who unsubscribed but still received emails, along with the timestamps of the duplicate sends, so we can trace exactly where the suppression list lookup is failing?

We'll prioritize this investigation immediately and I'll follow up today with findings.

subject: urgent
body:
We've been rolling out SSO more broadly across our legal teams over the past month, and generally it's been going smoothly with provisioning and MFA enrollment for new hires. Our IT team has also been fine-tuning session policies to align with our compliance requirements for client data access.

The actual problem is that since Monday, users are getting logged out roughly every 15 minutes instead of our configured 8-hour session timeout, forcing them to re-authenticate with MFA repeatedly throughout the day. We have 208 seats affected and it's generating a high volume of help desk tickets internally. Can someone check if the session timeout configuration got reset or overridden somewhere?
answer:
Thanks for flagging this, and apologies for the disruption to your teams' workflows. A session timeout dropping from 8 hours to roughly 15 minutes suggests either a configuration override or a caching issue on our session policy service rather than something on your end. I'm escalating this now given the volume of re-authentication your users are experiencing.

Could you confirm the exact timestamp on Monday when you first noticed the shorter timeouts, and whether any changes were made to your SSO or MFA policies around that time? That will help us pinpoint whether this correlates with a deployment on our side.

subject: unacceptable
body:
OUR DASHBOARDS HAVE BEEN UNUSABLE FOR THREE DAYS NOW. EVERY CHART TAKES 30 TO 45 SECONDS TO LOAD, EXPORTS TIME OUT COMPLETELY, AND WE HAVE OVER A THOUSAND EMPLOYEES ACROSS RETAIL LOCATIONS RELYING ON THESE REPORTS DAILY. THIS IS COMPLETELY UNACCEPTABLE FOR AN ENTERPRISE ACCOUNT.

WE HAVE ESCALATED THIS INTERNALLY TWICE ALREADY AND GOTTEN NO REAL ANSWER. IF THIS ISN'T FIXED IMMEDIATELY WE WILL BE REVIEWING OUR CONTRACT AND LOOKING AT OTHER VENDORS. FIX THIS NOW.
answer:
I hear you, and I'm sorry for the extended disruption this has caused across your locations. This is being escalated to our performance engineering team right now as a P2 incident given the scale of impact, and I'm personally tracking it through to resolution. Can you tell me if the slowness affects all dashboards equally or specific ones with heavy chart counts or large date ranges, and roughly what time the degradation started three days ago?

We'll have an update for you within the next few hours, and I'll make sure this gets the priority it deserves given your account size.

subject: Request to restore storage bucket from backup snapshot
body:
I'm working on integrating our upload pipeline with the Northwind Storage API and need to restore one of our buckets to the snapshot from October 3rd before we ran a batch migration script that corrupted some file metadata. The bucket is prod-assets-eu and currently holds around 2.1TB of data.

Could you confirm the process for a point-in-time restore, expected downtime for uploads during the restore, and whether this counts against our monthly quota or retention limits? We'd like to schedule this for a low-traffic window this weekend if possible.
answer:
Thanks for the details. For a point-in-time restore on prod-assets-eu, we can trigger it from our side once you confirm the exact snapshot timestamp from October 3rd. Typically uploads to the bucket are paused during the restore window, which for 2.1TB usually takes between 1 and 3 hours depending on load, and the restore does not count against your monthly upload quota, though it will briefly use additional retention storage until we confirm the swap.

Let us know your preferred weekend window and we'll coordinate timing with our storage team and send you a confirmation before we proceed.

subject: INVOICE IS COMPLETELY WRONG AND NO ONE IS RESPONDING
body:
THIS IS THE THIRD TIME I AM WRITING ABOUT THIS. OUR LATEST INVOICE SHOWS CHARGES FOR 150 SEATS BUT WE ONLY HAVE 133 ACTIVE SEATS ON OUR PRO PLAN. I ALREADY SENT PROOF FROM OUR ADMIN CONSOLE LAST WEEK SHOWING THE CORRECT COUNT AND NOBODY HAS FIXED THE INVOICE OR PROCESSED A REFUND.

WE NEED THIS CORRECTED IMMEDIATELY AND A REFUND ISSUED FOR THE OVERCHARGE. IF THIS KEEPS HAPPENING WE WILL BE CANCELING OUR CONTRACT WITH NORTHWIND. THIS IS RIDICULOUS FOR A PAYING CUSTOMER.
answer:
I sincerely apologize for the delay and frustration this has caused, this should have been resolved when you first reached out. I've pulled up your account now and can confirm your seat count shows 133 active seats, which does not match the 150 billed on the latest invoice. I'm issuing a corrected invoice and processing a refund for the overcharged amount right away, and you should see confirmation of both within 24 hours.

I'm also flagging this internally to find out why your earlier proof wasn't acted on so we can prevent this from happening again.

subject: Intermittent transform failures across multiple pipelines
body:
Over the past two weeks we've noticed intermittent transform failures across several of our data pipelines, roughly 5 to 8 failures per week out of about 200 daily runs. The errors vary but most reference timeout or latency issues during the transform stage rather than actual data errors, and retries usually succeed on the second attempt.

Given the scale of our operations across 2202 seats, we'd like to understand if this is a capacity or scheduling issue on the pipeline infrastructure side, and whether there are recommended settings we should adjust for large media data volumes. Not urgent, but we'd appreciate guidance before volumes increase next quarter.
answer:
Thanks for the thorough breakdown, this is helpful context. Intermittent timeout-related failures that succeed on retry often point to transient resource contention during peak scheduling windows rather than a data quality problem, and this is common for accounts running high pipeline volumes like yours. I'll pull the run logs for the past two weeks to check for patterns around specific times or transform stages.

In the meantime, we can review your current concurrency and timeout settings together and suggest adjustments suited for your expected volume increase next quarter, happy to set up a call if that's easier than going back and forth over tickets.

subject: Deactivated user still shows as active and can log in
body: We deactivated a former warehouse supervisor's account in Admin Console yesterday (user ID U-88213) after his last day on 03/11, but he was able to log in again this morning at 8:14am. The audit log shows the deactivation event at 4:52pm yesterday, but there's no corresponding session-termination entry and his mobile session never got revoked. This is a compliance issue for us since he shouldn't have access to freight manifests anymore. Can someone check why deactivation isn't forcing logout across sessions?
answer: Thank you for flagging this immediately - we're treating it as a priority security issue and have opened an internal ticket to review session invalidation on deactivation for your workspace. As an immediate mitigation, please use the 'Force logout all sessions' option under that user's profile in Admin Console, which will terminate active tokens right away while we investigate the root cause. We'll update you within a few hours with findings on why the automatic revocation didn't trigger.

subject: Audit log export question
body:
Our team has been going through a routine access review this quarter since we're preparing for a retail vendor security audit next month. We've had a couple of deactivation events recently that needed manual double-checking against our internal HR records, and while doing that we noticed the audit log page only lets us view 90 days of history at a time in the UI.

The actual question: is there a way to export the full audit log history, including allowlist changes and deactivation events, as a CSV so we can archive it for compliance purposes going forward?
answer: Good question, and thanks for the context on the audit. Right now the Admin Console audit log UI is limited to 90-day rolling windows, but you can request a CSV export covering a custom date range by opening a request through Admin Console under Settings > Audit Log > Export, which we can also trigger manually on our end if you give us the date range you need. I'll follow up with instructions for setting up a recurring monthly export so this is easier for future audits.

subject: Restore from backup failing for legal-docs bucket
body: I'm trying to restore our legal-docs storage bucket to the snapshot from 09/14 after a bulk delete mistake last week, but the restore job in Storage keeps failing at around 60% with status 'restore_error: quota_exceeded'. Our storage quota shows we're well under the 500GB limit for our plan, so I'm not sure why it's flagging quota issues. The bucket contains roughly 14,000 files and the restore has failed three times now, each attempt taking about 40 minutes before erroring out.
answer: Thanks for the details - a restore quota error at that stage usually means the temporary staging area used during restore is counted separately from your primary bucket quota, and large restores like this one can briefly exceed it. I've bumped your temporary restore allowance and requeued the job for the 09/14 snapshot; you should see it running again within the next 15 minutes, and I'll monitor progress and let you know once it completes.

subject: Role mapping documentation for SSO groups
body: We're setting up role mapping for our SSO integration and want to map our Azure AD groups (Logistics-Managers, Logistics-Staff) to specific Northwind roles like Billing Admin and Read Only. The current documentation shows an example with only one group-to-role mapping and doesn't explain how to handle a user who belongs to multiple groups with conflicting role levels.
answer: Thanks for raising this - when a user belongs to multiple mapped groups, Northwind applies the highest-privilege role among the matches, so a user in both Logistics-Managers and Logistics-Staff would get Billing Admin. I'll pass along your feedback that the docs need an example covering multi-group precedence, and in the meantime I can share a short internal writeup with mapping examples if that would help your team get set up faster.

subject: Okta SCIM app not syncing group changes
body: We configured the Northwind Okta app for provisioning about two weeks ago and initial user sync worked fine, but group membership changes made in Okta since 09/18 aren't reflecting in Northwind Integrations. We moved 6 users from the 'Analysts' group to 'Senior Analysts' in Okta on 09/20, and they still show the old group and permissions on our end. The Okta provisioning logs show 'Push Group' tasks completing successfully with no errors.

subject: NEED IP ALLOWLIST CHANGE ASAP

subject: Mobile app crashing when switching to offline mode - urgent

We're aware of a regression introduced in 4.8.2 related to offline cache initialization and are working on a hotfix; in the meantime, please ask staff to enable 'Airplane mode workaround' under Settings > Sync before losing connectivity, which should prevent the crash while we finalize the fix.

subject: SCIM provisioning failing for entire workspace since this morning

subject: Push notifications not delivering via API for iOS users
body: I'm integrating Northwind's mobile push API into our internal app and push notifications are delivering fine on Android devices but failing silently on iOS. In the meantime, I'd recommend re-registering a couple of test device tokens in case the old certificate cached stale tokens.

subject: SSO role mapping broken after IdP update - all users locked out of admin roles

subject: IP allowlist locked out entire workspace
body: This morning at 8:15am our team added a new office IP range to the allowlist in Admin Console and saved the change. subject: APP WONT OPEN KEEPS CRASHING
body: THE MOBILE APP CRASHES IMMEDIATELY EVERY TIME I TRY TO OPEN IT SINCE THIS MORNING. I AM ON IOS AND I NEED TO PULL REPORTS FOR A MEETING IN 30 MINUTES. I TRIED LOGGING IN AGAIN AND REINSTALLING BUT IT STILL CRASHES ON THE SPLASH SCREEN BEFORE I EVEN SEE THE LOGIN PAGE. I ALSO GOT A PUSH NOTIFICATION RIGHT BEFORE THE CRASHES STARTED. subject: Question about offline mode capabilities
body: We're rolling out the mobile app to our legal team members who travel frequently and often lose connectivity during client visits. I wanted to understand what offline mode actually supports right now - can users view previously loaded case files and drafts, or does it only cache the login session? Also curious whether push notifications queue up and deliver once connection is restored, or if they're lost entirely while offline.
answer: Great question. Offline mode currently caches recently viewed documents and drafts for up to 72 hours, so your team can view and edit content without connectivity, and changes sync automatically once back online. Push notifications sent while offline are queued server-side and will deliver as soon as the device reconnects, though notifications older than 24 hours are dropped rather than delivered late. I'll also send over our how-to guide on configuring offline sync settings for your admin console.

subject: SAML SSO login broken for all users - urgent
body: Since around 9am today our SAML SSO integration has stopped working and all 18 users at Harbor Health are unable to log in. Users are being redirected to the identity provider, authenticating successfully, but then receiving 'SAML response validation failed' when redirected back to Northwind. answer: This is a priority issue and I'm looking into it right now.
