We'll send you the updated SDK migration guide along with a mapping of v2 to v3 parameters so your integration team can plan the transition before the cutover date.

subject: Okta app integration not passing group attributes
body: We configured the Okta integration through Northwind's app catalog last week, but user group memberships aren't syncing over, so everyone is landing in the default workspace role regardless of their Okta group assignment. This is affecting all 22 of our users since none of the group-based access rules are applying. We followed the setup documentation but something in the attribute mapping step seems off.
answer: Thanks for the detailed description. This sounds like the group attribute statement in your Okta app configuration may not be mapped to the field Northwind expects for role assignment. We'll walk through your current mapping with you and send a corrected configuration snippet, and in the meantime we'd suggest manually assigning roles for critical users so access isn't blocked while we sort this out.

subject: Push notifications not arriving on iOS after app update
body: Since updating to app version 4.8.2 on Tuesday, our field team stopped receiving push notifications for case assignments. I've confirmed notification permissions are enabled on three test devices and the accounts are logged in correctly. Push worked fine before the update on Nov 4. We rely on these alerts for time-sensitive filings, so this is affecting about 40 of our 257 users so far.
answer: Thanks for flagging this - a P2 incident affecting push delivery on iOS after 4.8.2 has been opened. Can you confirm whether these devices are on iOS 17.x and send us the device tokens or account IDs for the three test devices so we can trace them through our push gateway logs? In the meantime, pull-to-refresh in the app will still show new case assignments even if the push itself doesn't fire.

subject: Getting duplicate alert emails for the same threshold breach
body: We're seeing duplicate notifications whenever our energy usage threshold alert fires - each breach sends two identical emails about 90 seconds apart. This has been happening since last week on our 'Grid Load Warning' alert rule. I checked and there's only one rule configured, not a duplicate rule, so I'm not sure why it's firing twice. Can you help us figure out how to stop the duplicates without losing the alert entirely?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report - duplicate sends from a single rule usually point to a webhook retry or a delivery acknowledgment timeout on our end rather than a config issue on yours. Could you share the alert rule ID and one or two timestamps of the duplicate pair so we can pull the delivery logs? We'll also check whether your retry window setting needs adjusting while we investigate.

subject: Pagination change breaking our SDK integration - need clarity before deprecation date
body: We received a notice that cursor-based pagination is replacing offset pagination on the API Platform, and I want to understand the deprecation timeline before our finance reporting jobs break. We currently use the Python SDK (v2.3) with offset+limit params to pull invoice data nightly. If offset pagination is removed, our automated billing reconciliation script will fail, and that report goes to our executive team every Monday.
answer: Thanks for reaching out ahead of the change - offset pagination is being deprecated but not removed immediately; the cutoff is currently set for 60 days out, and both methods will work in parallel until then. We recommend upgrading to SDK v3.0, which handles cursor pagination automatically without code changes to your existing calls - I'll send over the migration guide and flag your account so we notify you directly before the offset endpoint is disabled.

subject: URGENT PAGINATION ISSUE BREAKING OUR NIGHTLY SYNC
body: OUR WEBHOOK INTEGRATION IS FAILING BECAUSE THE API IS RETURNING INCONSISTENT PAGE COUNTS SINCE MONDAY. WE ARE ON THE SDK VERSION 2.9 AND EVERY CALL TO /v2/orders WITH LIMIT 100 IS NOW RETURNING RANDOM PAGE TOTALS BETWEEN 3200 AND 4100 RECORDS WHEN WE KNOW THERE ARE EXACTLY 3850 ORDERS. THIS IS AFFECTING OUR ENTIRE RETAIL SYNC ACROSS 150 SEATS AND WE NEED THIS ESCALATED IMMEDIATELY.
answer: We understand the urgency and have escalated this as P1 given the impact across your sync process. Inconsistent page totals usually indicate a race condition between pagination and concurrent writes during your sync window - can you confirm the exact timestamps of a few failed runs and whether you're sorting by a mutable field like updated_at? We're pulling the rate-limit and request logs for your account now and will follow up within the hour with findings.

subject: Deactivated users still showing active access - urgent security concern
body: We deactivated two former employees in Admin Console yesterday at 3:40pm, but our audit log shows they both logged into the dashboard again this morning at 8:15am and 8:22am. This is a serious security issue since one of them had access to client legal files. We need to know immediately why deactivation isn't revoking session access and how to force logout on all active sessions right now.
answer: This has been escalated as P0 immediately - deactivated accounts retaining session access is a critical issue and we're treating it as such. As an immediate mitigation, please go to Admin Console > Security > Active Sessions and revoke all sessions for those two user IDs, which will force logout regardless of account status. Our engineering team is investigating why deactivation didn't automatically terminate their sessions and we'll update you within the hour with root cause and confirmation the gap is closed.

subject: Dashboard charts rendering blank after last release
body: Several of our revenue charts on the main dashboard are showing blank white boxes instead of the bar graphs since the update rolled out this Wednesday. It's happening on the 'Monthly Spend by Vendor' and 'Legal Case Volume' widgets specifically, across Chrome and Edge. Refreshing and clearing cache didn't help. We'd like this fixed or escalated since our leadership team reviews these charts every Friday morning.
answer: Thanks for the report - we've seen a couple of similar cases tied to the chart rendering update pushed Wednesday, likely related to a data format change in specific widget types. I'm escalating this to our dashboards team now and will need the dashboard ID and widget IDs for those two charts to reproduce it directly. We'll aim to have a fix or workaround in place before your Friday review.

subject: Question about adjusting SSO session timeout duration
body: We'd like to extend our current SSO session timeout from 30 minutes to something longer, like 2 hours, since our support engineers are getting logged out mid-ticket frequently and having to re-authenticate through MFA each time. Is this something we can configure ourselves in Identity settings, or does it require a change on Northwind's side? Just want to understand the process before we request it formally.
answer: Good news - session timeout duration is configurable on your end under Identity and SSO > Session Policy, where you can set the idle timeout up to 8 hours depending on your security requirements. Since you're on MFA-enforced provisioning, just note that extending the session window doesn't bypass MFA on new logins, only reduces how often existing sessions need to re-authenticate. Let us know if you'd like a hand walking through the settings.

subject: Need bulk unsubscribe option for notification emails - users complaining
body: Several of our workspace users have asked to unsubscribe from the weekly digest notifications but there's no visible unsubscribe link in the emails we're receiving, and the notification preferences page only lets us toggle settings one user at a time. With 94 seats, manually updating each person's preferences isn't practical. Can you add a bulk unsubscribe option or at minimum confirm the unsubscribe link is supposed to be present?
answer: You're right that the digest emails should include an unsubscribe footer link, so we're looking into why it's missing for your workspace as a priority since that's a compliance concern for email notifications generally. In the meantime, I can process a bulk opt-out for specific notification categories on our end if you send us the list of user emails or a CSV export - just let us know which notification types to disable.

subject: Webhooks failing to deliver intermittently since this morning
body: Starting around 9am today, roughly 30% of our payment-event webhooks are failing to reach our endpoint with no retry attempts logged on our side. We're on API Platform with the Node SDK, using the /v2/webhooks/subscriptions endpoint, and our endpoint has had no downtime according to our own monitoring. This is impacting reconciliation for our fintech billing pipeline across 294 seats, so we need visibility into whether this is a Northwind-side delivery or rate-limiting issue.
answer: Thanks for reporting this promptly - we're treating it as P1 given the payment reconciliation impact. Initial checks show elevated retry queue depth on webhook delivery starting around 9am, which may be tied to a rate-limit threshold on outbound delivery workers rather than your endpoint. We're pulling delivery logs for your subscription ID now and will share failure counts and next steps within the hour; in the meantime, polling the /v2/events endpoint as a fallback should catch missed events.

subject: Biometric login prompt not appearing on some Android devices
body: A few of our field engineers report that the Face/Touch unlock option isn't showing up on the mobile app login screen for their Android devices, even though biometrics are enabled in their phone settings. It works fine on iOS devices across our team. This isn't blocking anyone since password login still works, but it'd be good to understand if this is a known limitation on certain Android versions or something we can fix on our end.
answer: Thanks for the details - biometric prompt availability on Android does depend on device-level biometric API support, and we've seen this gap on a handful of Android versions below 10 or on devices with fingerprint-only sensors when the app expects BiometricPrompt class support. If you can share the specific device models and Android OS versions affected, we can confirm whether it's a known limitation or worth investigating further as a low-priority fix.

subject: SDK completely broken after your forced upgrade, webhooks failing everywhere
body: We updated to SDK v4.2.0 like your deprecation notice demanded and now EVERY webhook call throws 'signature mismatch: invalid HMAC' even though we didn't touch our secret. On top of that we're getting 429 Too Many Requests on endpoints that were fine yesterday, like the rate limit dropped without warning. This is blocking our production order sync for Pioneer Media and I have execs asking why nothing works. Fix this today or we're seriously evaluating other vendors.
answer: I'm sorry for the disruption this is causing, especially with production order sync affected. The SDK v4.2.0 release changed the HMAC signing order for webhook payloads, and we suspect the mismatch you're seeing is tied to that change rather than your secret. I'm escalating this to our API platform team right now and will also have someone check whether your account was mistakenly moved to the lower rate limit tier during the migration. I'll update you within the hour with either a hotfix or a workaround.

subject: Connector authentication failing intermittently on manufacturing data source
body: Our warehouse sensor connector (connector ID conn-9931-orion) has started failing auth every few hours since yesterday morning, throwing 'token refresh failed: invalid_grant' in the pipeline logs. When it does work, we're seeing duplicate rows and missing timestamps in the output table, which is affecting our downstream quality reports. This connector was stable for months, so something seems to have changed on the OAuth handshake side.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report and the connector ID, that helps us track this down quickly. The invalid_grant error pattern you're describing usually points to a refresh token being invalidated mid-cycle, which could also explain the duplicate rows if the pipeline retried a partial sync. I'm pulling the auth logs for conn-9931-orion now and will re-issue a fresh token pair while we investigate the root cause; expect an update from us within a few hours.

subject: Request to customize unsubscribe link text on notification emails
body: We'd like to update the unsubscribe footer on our notification emails so it reads in a way that matches our district's branding guidelines for Pioneer Retail. Right now it just says 'Unsubscribe from these emails' with a generic link, and our compliance office wants something more specific about which notification category it applies to. Is there documentation on how the unsubscribe text and link behavior can be configured per notification type?
answer: Good question, and this is a common customization request. Currently the unsubscribe footer text is templated per notification category rather than fully custom, but you can adjust the category label and preference center wording from Notifications > Settings > Email Templates. I'll send you a link to our documentation on preference center customization, and I've also logged your request for more granular footer text control as feedback for our product team.

subject: Question about webhook retry behavior and deprecated event types
body: We're planning a review of our webhook integrations across Harbor Partners' energy monitoring systems and want to confirm two things: first, what's the current retry schedule for failed webhook deliveries, and second, which event types are still on the deprecation list for removal this year. We saw a note about 'meter.updated' being replaced but want to confirm the timeline before we update our consumers.
answer: Happy to clarify both points. Webhook deliveries currently retry with exponential backoff for up to 24 hours, capped at 8 attempts, and you can see per-delivery retry history in the webhook logs panel. Regarding deprecation, 'meter.updated' is being replaced by 'meter.reading.updated' with a planned sunset six months out; I'll send you the full deprecation schedule and migration guide so your team can plan the consumer updates.

subject: Deactivated user still showing as active in audit log and allowlist
body: I deactivated a former contractor's account in Admin Console on the 14th, but the audit log still shows their last login as active status and their device is still listed on our IP allowlist. This is a compliance concern for us since the account should have been fully locked out. Can you confirm whether deactivation is supposed to automatically remove allowlist entries, and if not, where I should be doing that manually?
answer: Thank you for flagging this, and I understand the compliance urgency here. Deactivation does revoke session tokens and login access immediately, but it does not automatically remove allowlist entries tied to that user's devices, which is why you're still seeing the stale entry. I'd recommend removing it manually under Admin Console > Security > Allowlist, and I'm also logging a documentation gap since this behavior isn't currently spelled out clearly enough.

subject: Repeated card declines on our monthly invoice, need to update payment method
body: Our card on file has been declined three times now for our Summit Retail invoice dated the 3rd, and I'd like to update to a new card before we get suspended. Also, one of the earlier failed attempts still shows as a pending charge on our statement even though it never went through, so I'd like that cleared up or refunded if it actually processed twice.
answer: Thanks for letting us know, and I'll make sure your account isn't suspended while we sort this out. You can update your card under Billing > Payment Methods, and once the new card is saved I'll manually retry the failed invoice so there's no gap in service. I'm also checking the duplicate pending charge now and will issue a refund if it turns out to have actually settled on your end.

subject: Urgent: need to restore deleted storage bucket from backup
body: One of our engineers accidentally deleted the 'claims-archive-2023' bucket for Vertex Health around 2am this morning during a cleanup script run, and it contained roughly 40,000 patient claim documents. We need this restored from backup as soon as possible since our compliance team needs access to these files for an active audit due this week. Please advise on the fastest restore path available to us.
answer: This is being treated as urgent given the audit deadline. We do keep rolling backups of storage buckets, and I can see a snapshot for 'claims-archive-2023' from last night before the deletion occurred. I'm initiating a restore to that snapshot now; for a bucket this size it typically takes 30-60 minutes, and I'll confirm the moment it's back and verified.

subject: Alerts routing to wrong distribution list instead of analytics team
body: We configured alert routing in Notifications so that data quality alerts go to our analytics distribution list, but for the past week they've been landing in the general IT inbox instead. I checked the routing rules under Alerting and the condition still points to the correct tag, 'team:analytics', so I'm not sure why the emails are going elsewhere. Can you help confirm if something changed on the routing logic recently for Harbor Analytics?
answer: Thanks for the specifics on the tag condition, that narrows things down quickly. We did roll out an update to the alert routing engine last week that changed how nested tags are evaluated, which may be causing 'team:analytics' to fall through to the default rule. I'm checking your account configuration now and will either fix the rule match directly or walk you through re-saving the routing rule to force it to re-evaluate correctly.

subject: Dashboard charts showing blank or broken after this morning's refresh
body: Several of our revenue dashboards are showing completely blank charts since around 9am today, and the ones that do render show 'Error loading data series' where the bar charts should be. This is happening across our team, not just my account, and I need working charts for a board report due this afternoon for Summit Retail. Exporting to PDF also just produces empty pages where the charts should appear.
answer: I understand the time pressure with your board report this afternoon, and I'm treating this as high priority. This matches reports we're seeing of a data series rendering issue affecting dashboards refreshed since this morning, and our dashboards team is already investigating a fix. I'll keep you updated as we work on it, and if we can't resolve it in time I'll help you pull the underlying data directly so you have numbers for the report.

subject: Webhooks delivering duplicate events for the same transaction
body: We're seeing duplicate webhook deliveries for the same transaction ID coming through our 'payment.completed' endpoint, sometimes three or four times within a couple of minutes for the same event ID. Our reconciliation process for Pioneer Health is flagging these as inconsistencies since each delivery is being treated as a new event. Is this a known bug with the delivery system, or is there a dedupe mechanism we should be implementing on our end?
answer: Thanks for the clear description with the event ID pattern, that's very helpful. We're aware of an issue where our delivery worker can re-send events if the acknowledgment response is delayed past our timeout threshold, which would explain the multiple deliveries for the same event ID. In the meantime, I'd recommend dedupe logic keyed on event ID on your end, and I'll update you once our engineering team confirms the fix timeline for the underlying delivery bug.

subject: Restore from backup - retention policy question
body:
We need to restore a set of files from backup for a legal hold matter at Granite Labs. Our retention policy is set to 90 days but the last successful backup snapshot we can see in the console is from 34 days ago. Can you confirm the restore process for the /contracts-2024 bucket (about 1.2TB) and whether restoring will count against our storage quota temporarily during the operation?

We'd also like to understand expected performance impact on live uploads while the restore job runs, since our legal team is actively uploading discovery documents this week.
answer:
Thanks for reaching out - for a restore of that size we recommend scheduling it during off-peak hours since it can temporarily consume up to 15% additional I/O capacity, which may slow concurrent uploads slightly but won't block them. Restored data is staged in a temporary buffer that doesn't count against your quota until you confirm the restore, giving you a chance to review before it's finalized.

I'll open a restore job for the /contracts-2024 bucket now and send you a confirmation with the estimated completion time, typically 2-4 hours for that volume. I'll also flag this to our compliance team given the legal hold context so it's documented in the audit trail.

subject: App crashes immediately when opening on Android
body:
Since updating to the latest version of the Northwind mobile app, it crashes immediately on launch on my Android device (Pixel 6, Android 14). This started happening after I logged out and tried to log back in yesterday. A few other analysts on my team at Quill Systems have the same issue on their phones too.

Could you let us know if there's a known fix or a documentation page for troubleshooting this? We're not blocked on desktop but it would be nice to have mobile access back.
answer: Thanks for flagging this - we've seen a handful of similar reports tied to a caching issue introduced in the last release for Android devices. As a workaround, please try clearing the app's local storage/cache from your device settings and logging in again; this resolves the crash for most users. We're also publishing an updated troubleshooting article this week and will send you the link once it's live.

subject: Urgent: Workspace settings page unresponsive for entire team
body:
The workspace settings page in Admin Console has become extremely slow to load for everyone on our team at Ember Works - it's taking upwards of 30 seconds or timing out entirely. We need to update our IP allowlist and deactivate three former employees today, but the settings page won't let us save any changes right now.

This is blocking us from finishing an access audit that's due to compliance by end of day. Can someone look into the performance issue and confirm whether our allowlist changes actually saved from earlier attempts?
answer: I'm escalating this immediately given the audit deadline - we're seeing elevated load times on the workspace settings service affecting several accounts and our engineering team is actively investigating. I can confirm from our backend logs that your allowlist changes from this morning did not save successfully, so please hold off on retrying until we give the all-clear. I'll update you within the hour with either a fix or a manual workaround so you can complete the deactivations and allowlist update before your deadline.

subject: Duplicate email alerts being sent for same event
body:
Our team at Harbor Robotics has noticed that we're receiving duplicate email notifications for the same alert - specifically for failed login attempts and API rate limit warnings. Users are getting 2-3 identical emails within a few minutes for a single event, which is causing confusion and some staff are now ignoring alerts altogether.

Can you look into why this is happening? We'd also like to request a feature to configure notification frequency or batching so this doesn't happen again once the bug is fixed.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report - this matches a known issue where our alerting service occasionally re-triggers email delivery when retry logic misfires on rate-limit events. We're deploying a fix for the duplicate sends this week and I'll confirm once it's live on your account. I've also logged your request for configurable notification batching as a feature request with our product team, and will follow up with any updates on timeline.

subject: User deactivation not taking effect - former employee still has access
body:
We deactivated a former employee's account in Admin Console yesterday at 4:15pm following our standard offboarding process, but they were still able to log in and access customer data this morning. The audit log shows the deactivation event but the account status still shows as active in the user list. This is a serious security concern for us at Cobalt Energy given the fintech data involved.

We need this resolved immediately and need to understand how this happened so we can assess exposure.
answer: This has been escalated to our security team as a priority incident. We've forced a session termination on the account in question and confirmed the deactivation is now correctly reflected in the system - initial investigation shows a sync delay between the admin action and the session validation service. We're conducting a full review of the account's activity since yesterday and will send you a detailed report of any access that occurred during the delay window within the next few hours.

subject: Question about invoice line items and seat count
body:
I'm reviewing our latest invoice from Northwind for Delta Partners and I'm seeing a discrepancy - the invoice shows billing for 122 seats but we only have 115 active users listed in our admin console. Can you help clarify why there's a difference and how seat billing is calculated? We want to make sure we're not overpaying before our finance review next week.

Also, could you point me to documentation on how mid-cycle seat additions are prorated?
answer: Thanks for catching this - seat billing is based on the peak count during the billing cycle rather than the current count, so the 122 reflects a temporary spike from May 8-14 when some contractor accounts were added. I'll pull the detailed usage report for that period so you can verify against your records. For prorated mid-cycle additions, I've attached our billing documentation link, and I'm happy to walk through the calculation on a call if that's easier before your finance review.

subject: SSO role mapping not assigning correct permissions
body:
We configured SSO with our identity provider for Summit Media last week, and since then new users provisioned through SSO are being assigned the default 'viewer' role instead of the role mapped in our SAML attributes. I've checked our IdP config and the role attribute is being sent correctly (confirmed via the SAML trace), but Northwind doesn't seem to be reading it.

We have 3 new hires waiting on proper access. Can you check the role mapping configuration on your end and point us to documentation on the expected attribute name?
answer: Thanks for including the SAML trace details - that helps a lot. This usually happens when the attribute name in your IdP doesn't exactly match what our system expects (we look for 'northwind_role' by default, case-sensitive). Could you confirm the exact attribute name you're sending? In the meantime I'll send you our SSO role mapping documentation, and once we confirm the mismatch I can manually assign the correct roles to your 3 pending users so they're not blocked.

subject: Push notifications not working - urgent, affecting all students
body:
Push notifications have completely stopped working in our mobile app for Summit Labs since Monday. None of our students are receiving assignment reminders, and we've confirmed notification permissions are enabled on multiple test devices (iOS and Android). The app also crashes when trying to open the notification settings screen specifically.

This is affecting all 16 of our users during an active semester and we need this fixed as soon as possible. Is there a known outage or configuration issue we should check on our end?
answer: I'm sorry for the disruption this is causing during your semester - I can confirm we're seeing a broader issue with push notification delivery that started Monday, affecting multiple accounts, and our engineering team is treating it as a priority. The crash on the notification settings screen is a separate issue we're also investigating; as a temporary workaround, notifications can be managed through account settings on the web dashboard instead. I'll update you as soon as we have a fix deployed, and will follow up within a few hours with progress.

subject: SDK throwing errors after webhook setup
body:
Hi, wanted to give some context first - we're a small team at Ember Systems using the API Platform to sync student enrollment data with our LMS, and we recently set up webhooks to get real-time updates instead of polling. We followed the integration docs and everything seemed to work in testing last week.

Since yesterday morning though, our SDK client (Python, version 4.2.1) has been throwing errors whenever we try to process incoming webhook payloads - we're getting intermittent 429 responses and the SDK's retry logic seems to be failing silently, causing us to miss enrollment updates. We're not sure if this is a rate limit issue on our end or something changed on your side. Can someone help us figure out what's going on?
answer: Thanks for the context - the 429s you're seeing are tied to a rate limit threshold that was tightened for webhook-related endpoints on our end starting yesterday as part of a load-balancing change. I'd recommend upgrading to SDK version 4.3.0, which includes updated retry/backoff logic that handles this correctly, but I'll also request a temporary rate limit increase for your account while you're integrating. Can you confirm your current requests-per-minute so I can size the increase appropriately?

subject: Request: increase webhook rate limit and deprecation timeline
body:
I'm integrating the Northwind API for Ember Media and currently hitting the webhook rate limit of 100 events/min during peak sync windows, which is causing delayed processing on our end. Could we get this limit increased, or is there a recommended batching approach for high-volume webhook consumers?

Also, I noticed in the changelog that the v1 webhook payload format is marked as deprecated - could you confirm the timeline for when v1 will be fully retired so we can plan our migration to v2?
answer: Happy to help with both - I can request a rate limit increase to 300 events/min for your account given your sync volume; please confirm your API key ID so I can apply it. On the deprecation timeline, v1 webhook payloads are scheduled to be retired on March 31st, so I'd recommend starting the migration to v2 soon; our docs have a side-by-side field mapping guide that should make the transition straightforward, and I'm happy to review your v2 implementation once you're ready.

subject: Duplicate alerts being routed to entire finance distribution list
body: Since yesterday our billing threshold alerts in Notifications are being sent twice to the finance-alerts@ distribution list, and both copies are also escalating to our energy-ops on-call group which shouldn't be in that routing rule at all. We've counted 14 duplicate emails since 8am today. Can someone check the escalation policy tied to rule ID ALR-4471? We rely on this for invoice threshold breaches so this needs to get fixed quickly.
answer: Thanks for flagging this, and sorry for the noise it's causing on your finance team. We can see rule ALR-4471 has an overlapping escalation path that was introduced during a recent policy update, which explains both the duplication and the unexpected ops-group inclusion. We're correcting the routing config now and will confirm once the duplicate sends stop, likely within the hour.

subject: Jira issues not syncing after linking integration
body: We connected our Jira Cloud instance through the Integrations page last week and linked it to our Slack workspace for escalation notices, but new Jira tickets created from Northwind alerts aren't showing up on the Jira board at all. Our Okta SSO login for Jira works fine otherwise. I've tried relinking the integration twice with no change. Is there a known issue with the Jira connector right now, or a setting we're missing on our end?
answer: Thanks for the details. This sounds like the Jira project mapping may not have been set during the initial link, which would explain why alerts aren't creating visible issues even though the connection itself is authenticated via Okta. Could you check under Integrations > Jira > Project Mapping and confirm a project key is selected? If it's already set, send us the integration ID and we'll inspect the sync logs directly.

subject: Anfrage: Kürzere Session-Timeouts für SSO-Logins
body: Uns ist aufgefallen, dass sich Nutzer aktuell nach 12 Stunden Inaktivität noch nicht automatisch abmelden, obwohl wir für unsere Bildungseinrichtung eine strengere Sicherheitsrichtlinie benötigen. Wir möchten die Session-Timeout-Dauer auf 30 Minuten reduzieren und zusätzlich MFA bei jedem neuen Login erzwingen, nicht nur beim ersten Gerät. Gibt es dafür eine Einstellung in der Identity-Konsole oder muss das über den Support konfiguriert werden?
answer: Vielen Dank für die Anfrage. Aktuell lässt sich das Session-Timeout in der Identity-Konsole unter Sicherheitsrichtlinien anpassen, die Option für erzwungenes MFA bei jedem Login ist jedoch noch nicht selbstständig konfigurierbar und muss von unserem Team aktiviert werden. Wir setzen das für Ihr Konto auf 30 Minuten Timeout und aktivieren die strikte MFA-Regel, das sollte innerhalb der nächsten 24 Stunden wirksam sein.

subject: Question about configurable retention periods for Storage
body: We're currently on the default retention setting for our Storage buckets and I wanted to check whether it's possible to set a custom retention period per folder rather than account-wide. We have manufacturing spec files that need to be kept for 7 years while general upload logs only need 90 days. Right now everything seems to follow one global policy. Would appreciate hearing if this is on the roadmap or configurable already.
answer: Good question, and this is feedback we've heard from a few customers in regulated manufacturing environments. Right now retention policies are set at the account level only, so per-folder rules aren't yet available, but I'll log this as a feature request against our Storage roadmap. In the meantime, a workaround some customers use is separate storage buckets per retention requirement, which does let you apply different global settings per bucket.

subject: Role mapping broken after SSO update - users getting wrong permissions
body: After the SSO configuration update pushed this morning, several of our team members logged in and were mapped to the wrong roles - two analysts got admin-level access and one manager was dropped to read-only. This is affecting active users right now in our media workspace. The role mapping rules in the Identity console still show the correct group-to-role assignments, so I'm not sure why provisioning isn't respecting them.
answer: Thank you for reporting this right away. We're treating this as an active incident and are pulling the provisioning logs from this morning's SSO update to identify why role assignments aren't matching your configured mapping rules. As an immediate step, please avoid making further role changes in the console until we confirm the root cause, and we'll update you within the hour with findings and a fix timeline.

subject: Connector documentation and auth question
body: We've been rolling out several new data pipeline connectors across our healthcare workspace over the past month, mainly for lab result feeds and billing exports, and things have mostly gone smoothly aside from a few latency spikes we've separately reported. While setting up a new connector for our claims processing vendor, I couldn't find clear documentation on which OAuth scopes are required for the connector auth step - the setup wizard just times out with a generic 'authorization failed' message and doesn't say what permission is missing. Could you point me to documentation on required scopes for third-party connector setups, or clarify what's needed for claims-type connectors specifically?
answer: Thanks for the context, and glad the other connector rollouts have gone well aside from the latency issues you flagged separately. For claims-type connectors, the required OAuth scopes include read access to claims records and write access to the staging dataset, which isn't currently spelled out clearly in our public docs - I'll get that corrected. In the meantime, try re-authorizing the connector and explicitly granting both scopes when prompted, that should resolve the generic authorization failure.

subject: Sicherheitsvorfall: Geplante Syncs übertragen falsche Kundendaten
body: Seit dem 03.11. bemerken wir, dass unsere geplanten Data-Pipeline-Syncs für Transaktionsdaten teilweise Datensätze anderer Kunden enthalten, die nicht zu unserem Konto gehören sollten. Wir haben das in den letzten drei Sync-Läufen (07:00, 13:00 und 19:00 Uhr) bestätigt und sofort gestoppt. Das betrifft sensible Finanzdaten und wir müssen wissen, ob dies ein Datenleck auf Northwind-Seite ist. Bitte umgehend prüfen, das ist für uns höchste Priorität.
answer: Wir haben Ihre Meldung als Sicherheitsvorfall mit höchster Priorität eingestuft und unser Security-Team ist bereits dabei, die betroffenen Sync-Läufe vom 03.11. zu isolieren und zu analysieren. Bitte pausieren Sie bis auf Weiteres alle geplanten Syncs auf Ihrer Seite, wir melden uns innerhalb der nächsten Stunde mit einem ersten Befund und weiteren Schritten zur Eindämmung.

subject: urgent
body: we are getting the same alert email sent 5-6 times in a row for every single API error notification since this morning. our on call engineers are getting flooded and its making it impossible to tell which alerts are new. this started around 9am today and hasnt stopped. need this fixed asap its affecting our whole on call rotation
answer: Sorry for the disruption this is causing your on-call team. We're seeing an issue with the notification dedup logic that's causing repeat sends on the same alert trigger, and we're pushing a fix to stop the duplication now. As a temporary measure, you can mute the affected alert channel to reduce noise while we finish deploying the patch, which we expect within the next 30-60 minutes.

subject: SAML login completely down - all users locked out, possible data loss on last sync
body: As of 6:40am this morning no one in our organization can log in via SAML SSO - every attempt returns 'SAML response validation failed, invalid signature' and this is affecting all 112 seats across our retail teams. We also suspect the identity sync that ran at 6:00am dropped several MFA enrollment records and permission group assignments, since a handful of accounts that were provisioned last week no longer show up in the admin console at all. This is a full production outage for us right now, we need immediate escalation.
answer: This is being escalated immediately as a P0 outage. We've identified a certificate rotation issue on our SAML identity provider integration that's causing the signature validation failures, and we're rolling back the change now while we investigate the missing MFA and permission records from the 6:00am sync separately. We'll have an update within 30 minutes and will confirm once login access is restored account-wide.

subject: MFA enrollment records missing, unauthorized access suspected
body: We noticed this morning that several employee accounts show 'MFA not enrolled' in the admin console even though those users completed enrollment last week, and one account shows a login from an unrecognized IP address that bypassed MFA entirely around 4:15am. Given we're on a manufacturing account with sensitive supplier data, we're treating this as a potential breach and need immediate investigation into how MFA enrollment records were reset or bypassed.
answer: We're escalating this immediately as a potential security incident. Our security team is pulling authentication logs now to trace the unrecognized login at 4:15am and determine whether MFA enrollment data was altered or reset on our end. In the meantime, please force password resets for the affected accounts and we'll follow up within the hour with findings and containment steps.

subject: Feature request: scoped webhook secrets per API key
body: We manage 16 seats on the Starter plan and issue separate API keys per media project. Right now all our webhook signing secrets are tied to the account level rather than the individual key, so if one project's secret gets rotated it breaks the others. Could you add per-key webhook secrets? Also noticed we're hitting the rate limit (429s) faster than expected when multiple projects share a key - splitting secrets would help us isolate traffic too.
answer: Thanks for the detailed suggestion - this is a common ask and I've logged it as a feature request with our API Platform product team, referencing your account for context. In the meantime, a workaround is to create one API key per project even under the shared account, which will also help isolate the rate limit buckets you're seeing. I'll update this ticket once there's movement on per-key webhook secrets.

subject: Offline mode not syncing queued actions after reconnect
body: I'm integrating the mobile SDK for our legal team's app (19 seats) and testing offline mode. When a user submits a form while offline, the action is queued locally as expected, but after reconnecting to the network the queue never flushes - it just sits there until the app is force-closed and reopened. This is happening consistently on both iOS and Android test devices running SDK version 4.2.1. Push notifications also seem to stop arriving after this state occurs.
answer: Sorry for the trouble this is causing during integration testing. We've seen a similar sync-flush issue tied to SDK 4.2.1's connectivity listener not re-triggering the queue drain - can you confirm which push provider config you're using so we can check if it's related? We're treating this as a P2 while we reproduce it on our side; in the meantime, calling the manual sync() method after reconnect should force the queue to flush as a temporary workaround.

subject: URGENT: Users locked out during MFA enrolment rollout
body: We're rolling out mandatory MFA today for our 22 media seats and about a third of our team can't complete enrolment - the QR code screen loads but scanning it in an authenticator app returns 'invalid setup key' every time. A few users who did get through are now stuck in a login loop being asked to re-enrol on every session. This is blocking access to dashboards for our analytics team right now during a live reporting deadline.
answer: This is impacting login for a large portion of your workspace so we're escalating it immediately as P1. We're seeing a known issue where the setup key expires before scanning if enrolment is initiated from a cached SSO session - can you have affected users clear their browser session and re-initiate enrolment fresh? We're also investigating the re-enrolment loop on our end and will update you within the hour with either a fix or a temporary bypass for your admin team.

subject: Hitting rate limits despite documented quota increase
body: We're on the Enterprise plan with 622 seats and our integration has been getting 429 responses on the /v2/bookings endpoint since around 14:00 UTC yesterday, even though our account should have the higher Enterprise rate limit tier applied. The response headers show X-RateLimit-Limit: 1000 which matches our old Pro-tier limit, not the Enterprise quota we were told applies. Our webhook retries are also piling up because of this, and the SDK's built-in backoff isn't sufficient given our call volume.
answer: Thanks for flagging this with the header detail, that's very helpful. It looks like your account's rate limit tier wasn't correctly re-applied after the Enterprise upgrade, which explains the 1000/hr limit you're seeing instead of the expected quota. We're correcting this on our end now and will confirm once the new limit is live; in the meantime, please pause or throttle the webhook retry queue to avoid further backlog while we fix the tier assignment.

subject: Question about session timeout duration for SSO
body: Our finance team (23 seats on Starter) has noticed that SSO sessions seem to time out after about 20 minutes of inactivity, which is shorter than we expected and disrupts work when reviewing reports. Is this timeout configurable per workspace, or is it a fixed value on the Starter plan? Would also like to understand if MFA re-prompts are tied to the same timeout setting.
answer: Good question - on the Starter plan, session timeout is currently fixed at 20 minutes of inactivity and isn't configurable per workspace; that option becomes available on higher tiers. MFA re-prompts are tied to the same session expiry, so once the session times out users will need to re-authenticate including MFA if enabled. I'll note your interest in configurable timeouts as feedback for our product team.

subject: Okta app integration broken - provisioning fails for all new users
body: We use the Northwind Okta app to provision accounts for our legal team (217 seats on Pro), and since yesterday every new user assignment in Okta fails with 'SCIM provisioning error: unexpected response code 500' in the Okta system log. This is blocking onboarding for a batch of 15 new hires who start this week. We also noticed the Slack and Jira integrations tied to the same SSO setup have started throwing intermittent auth errors, which suggests something changed on the identity side.
answer: This is a serious blocker for your onboarding so we're treating it as P1 and looping in our integrations engineering team right now. The 500 error pattern you're describing matches a recent SCIM endpoint change - we're rolling back the affected configuration and will confirm once provisioning is restored. I'll also check whether the Slack and Jira auth errors are downstream of the same root cause and update you within the next couple of hours.

subject: invoice missing
body: Cant find last months invoice anywhere in billing tab.
answer: Sorry about that - I've pulled up your account and can see last month's invoice, it may not be displaying due to a caching issue on the billing tab. I'm emailing it over directly and also flagging the display bug to our billing team so it shows up correctly going forward.

subject: Uploads failing intermittently with quota errors
body: I'm a data analyst on our team (13 seats, Starter plan) and for the past two days about half of our file uploads to Storage have been failing with 'Error: storage quota exceeded' even though our usage dashboard shows we're only at 61% of our allotted quota. Retrying the same upload sometimes works on the second or third attempt. This is affecting our nightly backup job which normally uploads around 40 files and now only completes 15-20 before failing.
answer: Thanks for the specifics, that mismatch between the quota error and your actual usage points to a metering sync delay rather than an actual quota breach. We're looking into why the backup job is triggering false quota errors intermittently - in the meantime, adding a short retry delay (10-15 seconds) between failed upload attempts should improve your success rate while we investigate the root cause on our side.

subject: Push notifications not delivering after app update
body: Since updating the mobile app to the latest version last week, push notifications have stopped arriving for most of our 18 users at Atlas Health. The notification settings show as enabled on both device and in-app, and there's no error shown in the app itself, but nothing comes through even for critical alerts. A few users have also reported the app crashing on launch right after receiving what should have been a push notification, based on device logs.
answer: Thanks for reporting this, a delivery failure affecting most of your users is something we want to resolve quickly, so I've marked this P2 and escalated to our mobile team. Can you send us the device logs from the crash reports you mentioned along with the app version and OS versions affected? That will help us determine if this is tied to a push token registration issue introduced in the latest release.

subject: Question about upcoming API deprecations
body: I'm the IT administrator managing our Northwind account (12 seats, Starter) and saw a banner mentioning some API endpoints are being deprecated soon. Could you send me the specific list of deprecated endpoints and their sunset dates? We rely on a webhook integration built against the v1 endpoints and want to plan the migration before anything breaks, especially given our current rate limit settings.
answer: Happy to help you plan ahead for this. The v1 endpoints being deprecated include the legacy /v1/events and /v1/webhooks routes, with a sunset date of the end of next quarter - full details and migration guidance are in our deprecation notice in the documentation portal. Since your webhook integration is built on v1, I'd recommend starting the migration to v2 soon; let us know if you'd like a walkthrough of the endpoint mapping.

subject: Push notifications not arriving after device reconnects offline
body:
I'm integrating the Mobile App SDK for Vertex Labs and testing push notification delivery. When a device goes offline and then reconnects, queued push notifications don't seem to arrive at all - they just get dropped instead of delivered late. I checked the docs but couldn't find anything about offline queueing behavior for push, only for data sync.

Could you clarify if this is expected behavior or if there's a setting to enable delayed delivery? Also happy to share device logs if useful, this isn't urgent since it's still in our dev environment.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. Push notifications are not queued server-side when a device is offline by default on the Starter plan - they're sent once and expire if the device can't be reached, which explains the dropped notifications you're seeing. We're updating the documentation to make this clearer, and I'll include a link to the retry/TTL configuration options in case you want to extend the delivery window for your use case.

subject: Uploads to Storage failing repeatedly this week
body:
Since Monday I've had several file uploads to Storage fail partway through, mostly larger CSV exports around 400-600MB. The upload progress bar gets to about 80% and then resets with a generic 'upload failed, please try again' message. This has happened at least 6 times across two different browsers.

I'm not sure if this is related to our storage quota, since I recall getting a usage warning email last week. Can you check our account and let me know if we're close to the limit or if this is something else on your end?
answer: Thanks for flagging this - I checked your Storage usage and Orion Academy is currently at about 92% of the Starter plan quota, which is likely triggering the failures on larger uploads once temporary buffer space runs out. I'd recommend clearing out older files or reaching out about a quota increase, and in the meantime I'll monitor the account while you free up space so we can confirm uploads complete successfully.

subject: charts
body: All charts broken since update, please fix asap.
answer: Sorry for the disruption - this is impacting all dashboard users so we're treating it as high priority. Could you tell us which browser and dashboard IDs are affected so we can start reproducing immediately? We'll update you as soon as we have a root cause.

subject: Audit log missing account deactivation entries
body:
I'm reviewing our Admin Console audit log for a compliance check and noticed that several account deactivations from the past two weeks aren't showing up at all. We deactivated three former employee accounts on the allowlist on August 14th, but only one of those events appears in the audit log export.

This is a problem for us since we need a complete trail for our internal audit. Can you check why these events aren't being logged and whether there's a setting we're missing?
answer: Thank you for bringing this to our attention - a complete audit trail is important and we want to get this resolved. We're looking into whether deactivations triggered through the allowlist feature specifically are being logged correctly, since that could explain the gap you're seeing. I'll follow up shortly with findings and, if needed, escalate to engineering to backfill the missing entries.

subject: BIOMETRIC LOGIN CRASHES THE APP EVERY TIME
body:
I AM TESTING THE MOBILE APP BIOMETRIC LOGIN FEATURE FOR OUR ROLLOUT AND THE APP CRASHES IMMEDIATELY AFTER FACE ID IS CONFIRMED. THIS HAPPENS ON IPHONE 13 AND IPHONE 15 WITH THE LATEST APP VERSION 4.2.1. IT WORKED FINE LAST WEEK BEFORE THE UPDATE.

WE NEED THIS WORKING BEFORE WE CAN DEMO TO OUR CLINICAL TEAM NEXT WEEK. PLEASE ADVISE IF THIS IS A KNOWN BUG.
answer: Thanks for the report, and apologies for the disruption to your testing. We have seen a similar crash reported after the 4.2.1 update related to biometric session handling on iOS, and our team is actively investigating a fix. In the meantime, could you confirm whether disabling and re-enabling biometric login in device settings resolves the crash, and I'll keep you updated on the fix timeline ahead of your demo.

subject: Requesting storage quota increase and retention policy clarification
body:
Our team at Quill Retail is approaching the Storage quota limit on our Pro plan due to increased backup volume from our logistics data pipelines. We're currently retaining 90 days of backups and need to confirm this won't be affected if we hit the cap.

Could you let us know the process to request a quota increase, and also confirm how retention policies behave once storage is full - do older backups get purged automatically, or do uploads simply fail? This is important for our compliance reporting.
answer: Thanks for reaching out, and good timing given your compliance requirements. When Storage quota is reached, new uploads will fail rather than triggering automatic purges of older backups, so your existing retained data stays intact. I'm submitting a quota increase request for Quill Retail now and will follow up with confirmed new limits and timeline within the next business day.

subject: Slack alerts stopped firing after Okta integration update
body:
We recently updated our Okta integration settings and since then, Slack alerts from Northwind Integrations have stopped posting to our #alerts channel entirely. Salesforce sync notifications still seem to work fine, so it looks isolated to the Slack connector specifically.

I checked the integration status page and it shows Slack as 'connected' with no errors, but nothing has come through since August 19th. Can someone help us figure out if the Okta change broke the Slack webhook permissions?
answer: Thanks for the detailed context - it does sound like the Okta update may have affected the token scopes used by the Slack connector even though the status shows connected. Could you try disconnecting and reconnecting the Slack integration from the Integrations page to force a token refresh? If that doesn't restore alerts, we'll escalate to check the webhook delivery logs on our side.

subject: Sudden 429 rate limit errors breaking our webhook processing
body:
Starting this morning we've been getting 429 Too Many Requests errors on our API Platform calls that were working fine for months, well under our usual volume of about 200 requests per minute. This is now causing our webhook retry queue to back up badly, and we have around 40 pending webhook deliveries stuck.

I also noticed the docs mention a deprecated rate limit header format - is it possible our SDK version is using the old header and getting miscounted? We're on SDK version 3.4.0. This is blocking production traffic for us right now.
answer: Thanks for the urgent report - we're looking into this right away given the production impact. SDK 3.4.0 does use the older rate limit header format that was deprecated last month, and we suspect a recent backend change may be misreading those requests as exceeding limits. Please upgrade to SDK 3.6.0 or later if possible, and in the meantime we're manually clearing your stuck webhook queue and will confirm once normal throughput resumes.

subject: Rechnung enthält falsche Anzahl an Seats
body:
Beim Testen unserer API-Integration bin ich auf unsere letzte Rechnung gestoßen und mir ist aufgefallen, dass dort 30 Seats berechnet wurden, obwohl wir laut unserem Starter-Plan nur 23 aktive Nutzer haben. Die Rechnung vom 5. August hat die Nummer INV-88213.

Können Sie prüfen, ob hier ein Fehler vorliegt und gegebenenfalls eine Korrektur oder Rückerstattung veranlassen? Wir möchten das gerne klären, bevor die nächste Zahlung abgebucht wird.
answer: Vielen Dank für den Hinweis. Wir prüfen die Rechnung INV-88213 und gleichen die berechnete Seat-Anzahl mit den aktiven Nutzern in Ihrem Konto ab. Falls sich ein Fehler bestätigt, veranlassen wir eine Korrekturrechnung beziehungsweise Rückerstattung, bevor der nächste Zahlungslauf erfolgt, und melden uns in Kürze mit dem Ergebnis.

subject: Users getting logged out every few minutes via SSO
body:
Since yesterday afternoon our users have been getting logged out of Northwind roughly every 5-10 minutes when using SSO through our identity provider. MFA prompts are also triggering way more frequently than normal. This is affecting all 9 of our admin and staff accounts and is disrupting daily work.

Here's an excerpt from our IdP logs around one of the timeout events:

2024-06-11T14:22:03Z SAML_ASSERTION_EXPIRED session_id=sso-8841
2024-06-11T14:22:04Z REAUTH_REQUIRED reason=session_timeout
2024-06-11T14:22:09Z MFA_CHALLENGE_ISSUED user=admin
2024-06-11T14:26:41Z SAML_ASSERTION_EXPIRED session_id=sso-9027
2024-06-11T14:26:45Z MFA_CHALLENGE_ISSUED user=staff

We haven't changed our SSO configuration recently. Please help urgently as this is blocking work across the whole team.
answer: Thank you for the logs, this is very helpful and we're treating this as high priority given it's affecting your whole team. The repeated SAML_ASSERTION_EXPIRED entries suggest the session timeout value may have reverted to a much shorter default, possibly from a recent provisioning sync - we're checking your SSO configuration now to confirm the current session lifetime setting and will get a fix or workaround to you as quickly as possible.

subject: Duplicate alerts being sent for same event
body: We're seeing duplicate notifications firing for the same billing event across our fintech workspace. Since yesterday around 9am, every payment webhook alert is being sent twice within about 4 seconds, once via email and then a near-identical duplicate through the same channel. This is causing confusion for our finance team who think transactions are being processed twice. We've checked our webhook config and it only has one subscription active for this event type.
answer: Thanks for flagging this, and sorry for the disruption to your finance team. We've seen a similar pattern tied to a recent change in our alerting service that can cause duplicate dispatch when retries overlap with delivery confirmation delays - we're escalating this to our engineering team right now as a P1. Can you send us one or two of the duplicate message IDs from the affected emails so we can trace the exact dispatch path while we investigate?

subject: Okta app integration not syncing user roles correctly
body: We rolled out the Northwind Okta app to our legal teams last week and noticed that role assignments made in Okta aren't reflecting in Northwind for about 15 users so far. These users can log in fine via SSO but their permissions show as default viewer instead of the admin or editor roles assigned in Okta groups. We've double-checked the group-to-role mapping in the Okta app configuration and it looks correct on our end.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. This sounds like a sync delay or mapping mismatch between Okta group claims and our role provisioning service, which we've seen occasionally when group names contain special characters or extra whitespace. Could you share the exact Okta group names and the corresponding Northwind roles for a few of the affected users so we can check the mapping logs on our side?

subject: Unsubscribe link not working for one recipient
body: One of our attorneys tried to unsubscribe from case update notifications using the link in the email footer, but clicking it just loads a blank page and doesn't confirm the unsubscribe. She's still receiving the same notification twice a day even after trying three times over the past week. This is only happening for her account as far as we can tell, everyone else's unsubscribe links seem fine.
answer: Thanks for letting us know, and apologies for the inconvenience to your colleague. This looks like an isolated issue with the unsubscribe token for that specific recipient rather than a broader bug. Could you confirm her account email domain and roughly when she first noticed the duplicate emails starting, so we can check the notification preferences and token status on our end?

subject: How to configure IP allowlist for admin console access
body: We need to restrict access to the Northwind Admin Console to our corporate office IP ranges only, as part of a security review for our fintech compliance audit. I can see the IP allowlist section under workspace settings but I'm not sure whether entries need to be in CIDR notation or single IPs only, and whether this applies to API access as well as the console UI. We also want to confirm this action gets logged in the audit log for our records.
answer: Good question, and glad to help with your compliance prep. The IP allowlist field accepts both single IPs and CIDR ranges (for example 203.0.113.0/24), and it applies to both console login and API token authentication once enabled. Any changes to the allowlist are automatically recorded in the audit log with the admin's user ID and timestamp, so you'll have a full trail for your review.

subject: ALERT ROUTING IS COMPLETELY BROKEN AND SUPPORT HAS IGNORED ME
body: I've been trying to get alert routing rules to work correctly for THREE DAYS now and nothing is working. I set up a routing rule to send critical severity alerts to our on-call email group and low severity to a different address, but EVERYTHING is going to both addresses as duplicates every single time. I've read the docs twice and there's nothing explaining how the routing priority actually works when multiple conditions match. This is honestly ridiculous for a product we're paying for.
answer: I'm sorry for the frustration this has caused, especially after spending so much time trying to sort it out yourself. Routing rules are evaluated in order and the first matching rule wins by default, so if your severity conditions overlap (for example a rule catching both severities before the split), you'll get duplicates like you're describing. Could you paste your current rule set here so we can walk through exactly where the overlap is and get this fixed quickly?

subject: Slack alert integration completely down since this morning
body: Our Slack integration for Northwind alerts stopped posting to any of our channels starting around 7:15am today. We rely on this for logistics dispatch alerts across our warehouse teams and right now nobody is getting notified of shipment delays or system errors. The integration still shows as connected in the Integrations settings page, and I haven't made any changes to our Slack workspace or the Northwind app permissions recently. We tried disconnecting and reconnecting the Slack app once already but the issue persists.
answer: This is impacting your operations, so we're treating it as urgent and escalating immediately. Slack integrations occasionally break when Slack rotates OAuth tokens on their end without a corresponding refresh on ours, which would explain the connected status but silent failures. Please avoid reconnecting again for now while we check the token status and delivery logs on our side, and we'll update you within the hour.

subject: Alert-Routing sendet doppelte Benachrichtigungen an alle Nutzer
body: Seit dem Update von letzter Woche werden alle kritischen Alerts über unsere API-Integration doppelt an die konfigurierten E-Mail-Gruppen gesendet. Wir haben insgesamt 243 Nutzer in unserem Workspace und praktisch jeder in der IT-Abteilung bekommt aktuell jede Warnung zweimal innerhalb von wenigen Sekunden. Ich habe die Routing-Regeln überprüft, es gibt nur eine aktive Regel pro Alert-Typ, das Problem scheint also nicht an unserer Konfiguration zu liegen.
answer: Vielen Dank für die genaue Beschreibung, das behandeln wir sofort als P1, da es einen Großteil Ihrer Nutzer betrifft. Es könnte sein, dass ein Zustellungs-Retry fälschlicherweise als neue Nachricht gewertet wird, wir prüfen das gerade in den Zustellprotokollen. Könnten Sie uns die Alert-ID sowie den Zeitstempel einer der doppelten Benachrichtigungen zusenden, damit wir den Fehler gezielt nachvollziehen können?

subject: Frage zur Okta App Konfiguration für unseren Workspace
body: Wir möchten die Okta-App für unseren Workspace einrichten, sind uns aber nicht sicher, welche Attribute für das SCIM-Provisioning zwingend erforderlich sind. In der Dokumentation wird erwähnt, dass Rollen über Okta-Gruppen zugewiesen werden können, aber es ist unklar, ob dies auch für Gastnutzer im Gesundheitswesen-Kontext funktioniert, die keine feste Okta-Identität haben. Können Sie uns kurz erklären, wie die Zuordnung im Detail funktioniert?
answer: Vielen Dank für Ihre Anfrage. Für das SCIM-Provisioning sind die Attribute userName, email und die Gruppenzugehörigkeit erforderlich, damit Rollen korrekt zugewiesen werden können. Gastnutzer ohne feste Okta-Identität können derzeit nicht automatisch über SCIM verwaltet werden, sie müssten manuell im Admin Console angelegt werden - wir schicken Ihnen gerne eine kurze Anleitung dazu.

subject: Zapier integration failing with authentication error on trigger setup
body: I'm building a Zapier zap that should trigger on new user creation events from our Northwind workspace, but every time I try to test the trigger step, Zapier returns an authentication error even though the connection shows as valid in Zapier's account settings. I've regenerated the API key twice and reconnected the app three times with no change. Our media team has several workflows planned around this trigger and we need to confirm whether this is a known limitation with our workspace scale or an actual bug.
answer: Thanks for the thorough troubleshooting steps already taken. Given the size of your workspace, this is likely related to a rate-limiting or token-scope issue specific to the Zapier trigger endpoint rather than a general API problem, and we want to get this resolved for your team's planned workflows. Could you share the exact error text returned during the test step, along with the API key's creation timestamp, so we can trace it in our integration logs?

subject: Data retention settings not applying to uploaded files
body: We configured a 90-day retention policy for our Storage workspace last month, but I just noticed files from over 120 days ago are still present and haven't been auto-deleted. This is a concern for our fintech compliance requirements since we need old records purged on schedule. Our workspace only has a handful of admins, so I'm confident nobody manually disabled the retention rule, and the settings page still shows it as active with the correct 90-day value.
answer: Thank you for catching this, and I understand the compliance urgency here. We're treating this as a P1 since retention not applying correctly could affect your audit obligations, and we're escalating to our storage team to check whether the retention job is running as scheduled for your workspace. Could you confirm the exact file paths or upload dates of a few files that should have been purged, so we can trace the retention job history against them?

subject: Users getting logged out every 15 minutes via SSO
body:
We rolled out SSO for our finance team last week and staff are being kicked back to the login screen roughly every 15 minutes, even mid-transaction in the billing module. This is happening across our 12 seats regardless of browser (tested Chrome and Edge). Our IdP session is configured for 8 hours so I'd expect Northwind to honor that rather than forcing re-auth so frequently.

Can you tell us what controls the session length on the Northwind side and whether this is configurable? It's disrupting invoice approvals daily.
answer:
Thanks for flagging this, and I understand how disruptive constant re-authentication is for invoice approvals. This is usually caused by the session lifetime being set on the Northwind SSO app config independently from your IdP token lifetime, defaulting to a shorter window on Starter plan. I'm escalating this to our identity team now to review your tenant's session policy and will confirm the current setting and how to extend it within the next few hours.

In the meantime, could you confirm which IdP you're using (Okta, Azure AD, etc.) so we can check the SAML assertion timing as well?

subject: Duplicate email alerts firing for the same event
body:
We're seeing duplicate notification emails going out for single events on our logistics alert workflows - specifically shipment-delay triggers are sending 2 to 3 identical emails to the same recipient list within a minute of each other. I checked our webhook configs and there's only one active subscription per event type, so this looks like it's happening on Northwind's side.

Example: event ID evt_7f2a91 fired at 14:02 UTC on March 4th and generated 3 emails to our ops distribution list. This is causing confusion for our warehouse teams who think there are multiple delays. Can you check the alerting service logs for duplicate dispatch on our account?
answer:
Thanks for the detailed report and the event ID, that's very helpful. We've seen a similar pattern tied to retry logic in the notification dispatcher when the acknowledgment from the email provider is delayed, causing it to resend before confirming the first send succeeded. I'm pulling the dispatch logs for evt_7f2a91 now to confirm this is what happened on your account and will check whether other events in the past week show the same duplication.

I'll follow up with findings and, if this is the retry bug, a timeline for the fix, likely a dedupe window added to the dispatcher.

subject: Push notifications not arriving after latest app update
body:
Since our teams updated to the newest version of the mobile app last week, push notifications for shift changes have stopped arriving on Android devices. iOS seems fine. We've confirmed notification permissions are enabled on the affected phones and re-logged in, but nothing comes through even for test pushes sent from the admin console.

We rely on these for our manufacturing floor supervisors across 162 seats, so this is a real gap for shift handoffs. Can you look into whether the Android push token registration is failing after the update?
answer:

I'm opening a ticket with our mobile engineering team to reproduce this on our Android test devices.

As a workaround, could you have a couple of affected supervisors fully uninstall and reinstall the app rather than just logging out/in, and let us know if pushes resume? That will help us confirm the token registration theory while we investigate the update path.

subject: Scheduled data pipeline syncs running hours late

Our nightly sync jobs pulling data from our education records connector have been running 2-3 hours behind schedule for the past four days, starting March 1st.
