answer:
Thank you for including the sync job IDs, that lets us look at this directly. We're aware of increased load on the pipeline scheduler for connectors in the education data category over the past week, and it looks like your jobs are queuing behind a larger batch of concurrent syncs rather than failing outright. I'm checking sync_88213 and sync_88240 now to confirm queue wait time versus actual processing time.

We're working on rebalancing scheduler capacity for Enterprise accounts, and I'll update you today with an estimated timeline for when your nightly runs should return to the normal window.

subject: How to troubleshoot app crash on launch for some users
body:
A handful of our workspace users have reported the mobile app crashing immediately on launch, before they even reach the login screen. It seems to affect only a few people out of our 622 seats, mostly on older Android devices from what I can tell. I haven't been able to reproduce it myself on my own device.

Is there a recommended troubleshooting flow we should walk affected users through, like clearing cache or checking a minimum OS version? Also curious if there's a way for us to pull crash logs from our end to send you, since not everyone is comfortable doing a lot of technical steps.
answer:
Good question, and this is a common enough issue that we have a standard flow for it. First, have affected users confirm their Android OS version - we currently support Android 9 and above, so anything below that can cause launch crashes on the latest app build. If they're on a supported version, ask them to clear the app cache (not just data) from device settings and relaunch before reinstalling.

For crash logs, users can enable 'Send diagnostics' from the app's pre-login settings gear if it's accessible, or you can have them email us their device model and OS version and we'll cross-reference against known crash signatures for that hardware.

subject: Dashboards taking 30+ seconds to load during business hours
body:
Our team dashboards have become extremely slow over the past two weeks, specifically the ones with multiple chart widgets pulling from our healthcare claims dataset. Load times have gone from a couple seconds to 30-45 seconds during peak hours between 9 AM and noon, which is making it hard for operations staff to do their daily reviews.

We haven't changed the underlying data volume significantly, and export functionality on these same dashboards seems fine, just the initial render and chart refresh that's slow. Can someone look into whether this is a query performance issue on your side, since it's affecting multiple dashboards used across our 273 seats?
answer:
Thank you for the detailed timing and pattern, that narrows things down quickly. Slow renders isolated to chart-heavy dashboards while export stays fast points to query performance on the dashboard widget layer rather than the underlying data store, possibly related to how multiple chart queries are being batched during peak concurrent usage. I'm escalating this to our performance team as P1 given the impact on your daily operations review.

Could you send us the names or IDs of two or three of the slowest dashboards? That will let us pull query traces from the 9 AM to noon window today and identify the bottleneck faster.

subject: Webhook retry behavior and rate limit clarification
body:
We're integrating Northwind webhooks into our retail order system and running into some unclear behavior around retries. When our endpoint returns a 500 temporarily, we sometimes get the same webhook redelivered 4-5 times within a minute, which seems aggressive, and other times it just stops retrying after one attempt. We'd like to understand the actual retry schedule and backoff logic.

Also, is there a rate limit specifically on webhook deliveries per subscription? We're scaling up our order volume and want to make sure we're not going to hit a wall. Any SDK examples for handling idempotency on our end would help too.
answer:
Thanks for raising this, it's a fair point that our current documentation doesn't spell out the retry schedule clearly. Webhooks are retried with exponential backoff over roughly 5 attempts across 24 hours, but the inconsistent behavior you're describing (rapid redelivery vs. single attempt) sounds like it could be tied to how quickly your endpoint responds - if it times out rather than returning a 500 promptly, our system treats that differently in the retry queue.

On rate limits, webhook deliveries aren't separately capped beyond your overall API plan limits, but I'll get you exact numbers for your Pro tier. I'll also pass along the idempotency key pattern from our SDK examples, since including the delivery ID in your handler is the recommended dedupe approach.

subject: SAML login failing with certificate error for new users
body:
I'm trying to provision a few new analyst accounts through our SAML SSO setup and getting an error on login: 'SAML response signature validation failed' for these specific users, while existing users log in fine. I double checked the metadata XML we uploaded and it matches our IdP's current signing certificate.

Could this be related to how new user provisioning maps to the SAML assertion, or is there a caching issue on Northwind's side with an older certificate? We're on a small Starter plan setup with 23 seats and need these analysts working by end of week.
answer:
Thanks for the specific error text, that helps narrow this down. A signature validation failure affecting only new users while existing ones work fine usually means Northwind cached your previous signing certificate and hasn't picked up the updated metadata for newly provisioned accounts yet, rather than an issue with your IdP config. I'm checking your tenant's SSO configuration now to confirm which certificate version is currently active on our side.

If that's the cause, refreshing the metadata upload again (even re-uploading the same file) usually forces the cache to clear. I'll confirm within the next few hours and let you know if a manual refresh on our end is needed instead.

subject: Question about unused credits and refund process
body:
We recently downgraded a couple of unused add-ons on our account and I noticed we still have some credit balance showing on our last invoice that wasn't applied. I wanted to understand how Northwind handles refunds versus credit carryover for a small Starter plan account like ours - do unused credits roll over automatically or do we need to request a refund each time?

We're a small team of 8 seats so these amounts matter for our budgeting, and I want to make sure we're not losing credit balance unnecessarily going forward.
answer:
Thanks for checking in on this, it's a good question and one we're happy to clarify. Unused credits from add-on downgrades on Starter plans do roll over automatically and apply to your next invoice cycle rather than expiring, so you shouldn't be losing that balance. Refunds as actual payments back to your card are only issued in specific cases like billing errors or plan cancellations.

I can pull up your account's current credit balance and confirm exactly how much is queued for next cycle if that would help with your budgeting - just let me know and I'll send over the specifics.

I'd recommend switching to the `next_cursor` field returned in each response; our latest SDK release already supports this natively, so upgrading should minimize code changes on your side.

subject: Upload-Fehler bei großen Dateien im Storage

subject: PDF export completely broken - clients waiting on reports

subject: SAML login failing for newly provisioned users

subject: Request to adjust late-arriving data handling in pipelines
body: I'm a workspace admin at Blue Energy and we've noticed our data pipelines from the retail sales connector regularly receive records 4-6 hours after the expected sync window, causing gaps in our nightly aggregations. subject: Clarification needed on API key rate limits and deprecation
body: I'm a data analyst at Summit Partners and we're using several API keys across our reporting scripts. I noticed one of our keys is now returning HTTP 429 errors far more often than before, even though our request volume hasn't changed much - roughly 800 requests/hour. As for SDK v2 deprecation, existing API keys will continue to work, but we recommend migrating to the v3 SDK before the sunset date, and I can send you the migration guide if helpful.

subject: PDF export broken AGAIN and sharing links are useless
body:

I'm sorry for the trouble this is causing right before your board meeting - I understand how frustrating repeated export failures are. I'm escalating this now and pulling the export job logs for your account to find out why the PDF generation is timing out on the media performance report specifically, and I'll also check the rendering discrepancy on shared links separately since that sounds like a stale cache issue on the share view.

Can you send me the exact dashboard name/ID and a timestamp from one of the failed attempts? In the meantime, try exporting a smaller date range as a workaround while we investigate the root cause.

subject: Need higher API rate limits before month-end billing run
body:
We're on the Starter plan and consistently hitting 429 errors on our /invoices and /transactions endpoints during our nightly reconciliation job. Right now we're capped and it's causing our billing sync to fail partway through, leaving us with incomplete data for the finance close.

We'd like to understand what rate limit increase options exist, and separately, could webhook retries be configurable? Right now a single failed webhook delivery seems to just drop rather than retry with backoff, which makes debugging these limit issues harder. We're also using the Node SDK version 2.4.1 if that's relevant.
answer:
Thanks for the detailed report - I can see from your account logs that you're averaging around 340 requests/minute against a 200/minute Starter limit during your nightly job window, which lines up with the 429s you're seeing. I'll open a request to review a temporary or plan-based limit increase for your account given the billing-critical nature of this job.

On webhooks, you're right that retries aren't currently configurable per-endpoint, but I'm logging this as a feature request since it's a reasonable ask - I'll pass along an update once I hear from the API platform team. In the meantime, implementing exponential backoff client-side in your reconciliation script should reduce the 429 rate.

subject: Changing push notification behavior for login alerts
body:
We want to revisit how push notifications are configured for our mobile app users. Right now every login from a new device triggers a push notification, but our users are finding this excessive since many of them use shared devices across shifts. We'd like to change this so notifications only fire for logins from genuinely new devices, not repeat logins on already-recognized ones.

Could you walk me through what options exist in the current settings, and whether this is something we can adjust ourselves or if it needs a config change on your end?
answer:
Good question - the device recognition logic for push notifications is currently based on a 30-day rolling window per device fingerprint, so repeated logins from the same device within that window shouldn't be re-triggering alerts unless the device fingerprint is changing (which can happen with OS updates or app reinstalls). I'd like to check your account's notification settings directly to confirm what's currently configured.

This is adjustable on our end - I can walk you through the options in a quick call, or if you prefer, send me a couple of user IDs experiencing repeat alerts and I'll investigate the fingerprinting behavior for those specific cases.

subject: IP allowlist blocking legitimate office access
body:
Since this morning our admin console has been rejecting logins from our main office IP, which we added to the allowlist two weeks ago. Three of our admins are locked out entirely and getting "Access denied: IP not permitted" even though the address matches what's configured under Security settings.

We checked the audit log and it shows the allowlist entry as active, so this seems like an enforcement bug rather than a configuration issue on our side. Can someone look into why the allowlist isn't matching correctly?
answer:
Thanks for flagging this and for checking the audit log first - that's helpful. A mismatch between an active allowlist entry and enforcement usually points to a caching or propagation issue on our edge configuration rather than something wrong in your settings. I'm looking into your account now to confirm the exact IP range registered and compare it against what's being evaluated at login time.

As a quick workaround, could you have one of the locked-out admins try again in the next 15 minutes? If it's a propagation delay this may resolve on its own, but I'll follow up either way with root cause and, if needed, a manual fix.

subject: Duplicate email alerts going out to entire staff list
body:
Since yesterday morning our staff have been receiving duplicate notification emails - sometimes 3 or 4 copies of the same alert within a few minutes. This started around 9am on Tuesday and it's affecting essentially all 25 seats on our account. It's not one specific alert type either, we've seen it happen with schedule change notices and system maintenance notices both.

This is causing real confusion among our staff who think something urgent happened four times. Can someone investigate the alerting pipeline urgently? We need this resolved today if possible since it's actively disrupting our operations team.
answer:
I'm sorry for the disruption this is causing your team - duplicate deliveries at this scale point to an issue in the notification dispatch queue rather than anything on your configuration side, so I'm treating this as a priority investigation right now. I'm pulling delivery logs from Tuesday 9am onward to identify whether this is a retry-loop issue or a queue processing bug causing re-sends.

I'll update you within the next couple of hours with findings. In the meantime, if it's operationally helpful, I can temporarily pause non-critical alert categories for your account while we work the root cause - let me know if you'd like that.

subject: Recurring transform failures on media asset connector
body:
We've noticed intermittent transform failures on our data pipeline that syncs media metadata from our asset management connector - roughly 2-3% of records fail the transform step with a generic "schema mismatch" error, though the source schema hasn't changed on our end recently. This has been happening for a few weeks now, not urgent but we'd like to understand root cause.

Is there documentation on how the transform step validates incoming schemas, and whether there's a way to get more detail than just "schema mismatch" in the failure logs? Better error detail would help us debug on our side too.
answer:
Thanks for the detailed report - a 2-3% failure rate with a generic schema mismatch usually indicates a subset of records with an unexpected field type or null value that the transform step's validator is rejecting without surfacing specifics, which I agree isn't very actionable as-is. I'll check whether the underlying validator logs more granular detail internally that we can expose to you.

In terms of documentation, our transform schema validation guide covers the general rules, and I'll send you the link along with a request to our data pipelines team to consider adding field-level error detail to failure logs, since that's a reasonable improvement given your feedback.

subject: URGENT: files disappearing before retention period ends
body:
We're seeing files removed from Storage well before the retention period we configured. Several uploads from three weeks ago that should still be well within our 90-day retention window are now returning "Object not found" when our team tries to access them. This has happened to at least 14 files so far that we know of.

We need to know immediately whether these files are recoverable and why retention isn't being honored - this is affecting active projects and we can't move forward without these assets.
answer:
I understand the urgency here and I'm treating this as a high-priority incident. I'm pulling the storage logs for the affected object IDs right now to determine whether these files were deleted, moved, or if this is a retrieval/indexing issue rather than actual deletion - that distinction matters a lot for recoverability, and I'll know more shortly.

Can you send me the object IDs or file paths for as many of the 14 affected files as you have on hand? That will let me investigate the exact deletion timestamps and retention policy applied to each, and I'll follow up as soon as I have findings, likely within the hour given the severity.

subject: How to restore specific files from a prior backup snapshot
body:
One of our instructors accidentally overwrote a set of course material files in Storage last week, and we need to restore just those specific files from a backup snapshot rather than doing a full account restore. We're on the Starter plan so I want to check what backup granularity is available to us before I attempt anything.

Could you let me know what snapshot options exist for our account and whether selective file restore is possible, or if it would restore everything back to a point in time?
answer:
Good question, and glad you checked before attempting anything. On the Starter plan, backup snapshots are point-in-time for the full storage bucket, but selective file restore from within a snapshot is supported - you don't have to roll back everything. I can see your available snapshots go back 30 days, which should cover last week's incident.

If you can share the folder path and approximate names of the overwritten course files, I can identify the correct snapshot and either restore them directly or walk you through doing it from the console.

subject: SDK throwing repeated errors on webhook signature verification
body:
Since upgrading to SDK version 3.1.0 this morning, our integration is failing webhook signature verification for nearly every incoming event. We're getting "Invalid signature: HMAC mismatch" errors in our logs, and this is affecting order and shipment webhooks across our entire logistics workflow - roughly 200+ events have failed since 6am today.

We haven't changed our webhook secret or endpoint configuration recently, so this seems tied to the SDK upgrade itself. Given the volume of affected events for our 235 seats, we need this resolved urgently as our order processing is stuck behind these failures.
answer:
Thank you for the clear timeline - an SDK version upgrade correlating exactly with signature verification failures strongly suggests a change in how 3.1.0 constructs or encodes the payload before hashing, which would cause exactly this kind of HMAC mismatch. I'm escalating this to our API platform team immediately given the volume of failed events and the operational impact on your order processing.

As an immediate mitigation, I'd recommend rolling back to SDK 3.0.x if your deployment allows it, which should restore correct verification while we confirm the root cause in 3.1.0. I'll update you as soon as we have a fix timeline, and please send me a sample of the raw payload and signature header from one failed event if you're able to, as that will speed up diagnosis.

subject: Scheduled syncs running hours late or not at all
body:
Our nightly data pipeline sync, scheduled for 1am, has been running inconsistently over the past week - sometimes it kicks off at 4am or 5am, and twice it didn't run at all (Monday and Thursday last week). We rely on this sync feeding our travel booking data into downstream reports each morning, so the delays are causing our morning reports to be incomplete.

Is there a known issue with the scheduler right now, or documentation on how sync scheduling priority works, since we're wondering if this is a queuing delay tied to our plan tier?
answer:
Thanks for the specifics, especially the two missed run dates, which will help narrow this down. I'll check the scheduler logs for your pipeline around 1am for each of the affected days to see whether these were queuing delays or outright failures, since those have different causes and fixes. Starter plan pipelines are processed in a shared scheduling queue, so it's possible you're seeing contention during peak load windows, but I want to confirm that rather than assume.

I'll also send you our documentation on scheduling priority and queue behavior once I've reviewed your logs, and let you know if an adjustment to your scheduled time would help avoid the peak contention window.

subject: Transform step failing intermittently on travel-bookings pipeline
body: We're integrating with the Data Pipelines API for our travel-bookings feed and seeing transform failures roughly 1 in 20 runs. I'm escalating this to our pipelines team to investigate the mapping logic and the latency regression together, and I'll update you within one business day with findings or a workaround.

subject: Dashboard load times degraded across healthcare reporting views

subject: Billing data pipeline arriving hours late - impacting month-end close

subject: Audit log

subject: Requesting change to storage retention policy for media assets
body: We'd like to adjust our retention settings in Storage so that uploaded media files older than 90 days move to cold storage instead of being deleted, since we're currently hitting our quota faster than expected due to large video uploads. subject: Best way to speed up large dashboards and share filtered views
body: Our team manages dashboards with a lot of historical media performance data, and several of our larger charts take 10+ seconds to load, especially when filtered by region. For sharing, we do support shareable links that preserve active filters and refresh live rather than exporting a static snapshot - I'll send over setup steps and a short guide for both today.

subject: Slack alerts not firing after Okta re-authentication

subject: SAML login completely broken - all users locked out

subject: Transform failures causing sync gaps in fintech data pipeline
body: Our integration is hitting repeated transform failures on pipeline pl_9k2m1a since yesterday, with error "TypeError: cannot convert 'amount_cents' to integer, received string 'N/A'" on roughly 15% of incoming records. subject: Question about adjusting seat count on our plan
body: We're currently on the Starter plan and I want to confirm how seat counts work before we add two more team members next month. Do we get charged a prorated amount immediately when adding seats, or does it just reflect on the next invoice? Also wondering if there's a way to see our current seat usage versus our plan limit from the admin console.
answer: Good question - when you add seats mid-cycle on the Starter plan, you're charged a prorated amount for the remaining days in the current billing period, and the new seats then show at full price on your next invoice. You can view current seat usage versus your plan limit under Admin Console > Billing > Seats, which also shows how many are available before you'd need to upgrade or add more. Let me know if you'd like help walking through adding the two seats when you're ready.

subject: MFA

subject: Jira link keeps dropping after Okta sync
body: Since last Thursday our Jira integration disconnects roughly every 24 hours and we have to re-authenticate manually. subject: Request to change scheduled sync window for data pipeline

subject: Slack alerts missing severity tags from Jira issues

subject: Offline mode data retention settings for mobile app

I'll also flag this to our docs team since you're right that the current article doesn't cover retention specifics; I'll send you an updated link once it's live.

subject: Okta app integration broken, users can't SSO into Northwind

subject: Request for audit log export via API and allowlist clarification

subject: Jira-Verknüpfung wird nach Okta-Update nicht mehr synchronisiert
body: Nach der letzten Okta-Aktualisierung letzte Woche funktioniert unsere Jira-Verknüpfung nicht mehr richtig. subject: Need help configuring workspace settings and audit log access
body: As we prepare for an upcoming energy sector compliance review, I need to lock down our workspace settings: restrict admin console access to an IP allowlist, set up automatic deactivation for accounts inactive over 30 days, and confirm that audit logs capture settings changes with timestamps and actor identity. Could someone walk me through the correct configuration order so we don't lock ourselves out mid-setup?
answer: Happy to help you get this configured safely ahead of the review. The recommended order is: first confirm audit logging is enabled and capturing settings changes (it is, by default, with actor and timestamp), then set up the inactive-account deactivation policy, and only add the IP allowlist last, once you've verified your own admin IP is included, to avoid locking yourselves out. I'll send a checklist with screenshots for each step this afternoon.

subject: Charged for plan upgrade we never confirmed
body: We noticed an invoice dated this week charging us for an upgrade from Starter to a higher tier, but nobody on our team approved this change and we're still only using 4 seats. Our previous invoice was for the Starter plan pricing, and this new charge is significantly higher. Can you clarify how this upgrade happened and process a refund or downgrade back to Starter?
answer: I'm sorry for the confusion and unexpected charge—I'll look into how the upgrade was triggered on your account, since it doesn't sound like something you initiated. I'm pulling the billing history now to check for an accidental self-service upgrade or a system-side error, and I'll process a downgrade back to Starter along with a refund for the price difference once I confirm the cause, which should be within one business day.

subject: Charts rendering broken on shared dashboards
body:
We've noticed that several bar charts on our compliance dashboard are rendering blank for some users, while others see them fine. This started around Tuesday after we updated a data source connection. The line charts on the same dashboard are unaffected, just the bar chart widgets. We're on Pro plan with about 60 seats and this is impacting our weekly safety review meeting.

Could you help us understand what might be causing this inconsistency? Export to PDF still works but the chart images come out blank too.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. Blank bar charts that render inconsistently across users usually point to a caching issue tied to the data source refresh - can you confirm whether the affected users are on a specific browser or if this happens across all browsers? In the meantime, try clearing the dashboard cache via the widget's refresh icon, which often resolves rendering gaps after a data source change. We'll also check our logs for your account to see if there were any failed render jobs around the time of your update.

subject: Änderungswunsch: Diagrammexport für Freigabe-Links
body:
Wir möchten das Verhalten beim Export von Diagrammen aus geteilten Dashboards anpassen. Aktuell werden bei Freigabe-Links nur PNG-Vorschauen angezeigt, aber unsere Kunden benötigen den Export als PDF mit den Originaldaten. Das betrifft besonders die Umsatzdiagramme, die wir monatlich extern teilen.

Gibt es eine Möglichkeit, den Export-Button auch für externe Freigabe-Links zu aktivieren? Wir haben aktuell 267 Lizenzen im Pro-Plan und mehrere Teams sind davon betroffen.
answer: Vielen Dank für Ihre Anfrage. Aktuell ist der PDF-Export für extern geteilte Dashboards im Pro-Plan standardmäßig deaktiviert, da hierfür zusätzliche Berechtigungsprüfungen nötig sind. Wir leiten Ihren Wunsch als Feature-Anfrage an unser Produktteam weiter und prüfen, ob wir diese Option für Freigabe-Links freischalten können - wir melden uns mit einem Update, sobald wir mehr wissen.

subject: Deaktivierte Nutzer erscheinen weiterhin als aktiv im Audit Log
body:
Wir haben letzte Woche drei Nutzerkonten im Admin Console deaktiviert, da die Mitarbeiter das Unternehmen verlassen haben. Im Audit Log werden diese Konten jedoch weiterhin als 'aktiv' angezeigt und es gab sogar noch Login-Versuche von einer dieser Adressen am 14. März. Das ist für unsere Compliance-Prüfung problematisch, da wir in der Logistikbranche strenge Audit-Anforderungen haben.

Können Sie uns sagen, ob die Deaktivierung tatsächlich greift oder ob es hier einen Fehler in der Synchronisation gibt? Wir haben aktuell 204 Sitzplätze im Pro-Plan.
answer: Danke für die Meldung, das nehmen wir ernst. Es kann vorkommen, dass das Audit Log den Status verzögert aktualisiert, während die eigentliche Kontosperrung technisch bereits aktiv ist - wir prüfen dennoch sofort, ob die Login-Versuche vom 14. März tatsächlich erfolgreich waren oder nur Versuche blockierter Konten protokolliert wurden. Wir melden uns innerhalb der nächsten Stunden mit einer Analyse der betroffenen Konten.

subject: How to map SSO roles to admin permissions?
body:
We're setting up SSO for our small finance team and want to make sure that when new users log in via SSO, they automatically get the correct permission level based on their role attribute from our identity provider. Right now everyone who logs in gets the default Viewer role regardless of what's in the SAML assertion.

We only have 4 seats on the Starter plan, so this is a simple setup, but I want to get the role mapping right before we invite the rest of the team. Is there a guide for configuring attribute-based role mapping?
answer: Happy to help you get this set up correctly. Role mapping based on SAML attributes is available, though on the Starter plan the configuration is done manually rather than through an automated rules engine - you'll want to check that your identity provider is sending the role attribute with the exact name expected under SSO settings > Attribute Mapping. I'll send over our documentation link for attribute-based mapping so you can walk through the setup step by step.

subject: Need PDF exports to preserve chart interactivity settings
body:
Our team regularly exports dashboards to PDF for board meetings, and we've noticed that any drill-down filters we've applied to charts before exporting get reset in the final PDF - it shows the default unfiltered view instead. This has happened consistently over the last month across multiple dashboards, including our energy consumption trend charts.

We're on the Pro plan with 109 seats and this export is used weekly, so getting the filtered view to actually export correctly would save us a lot of manual screenshotting.
answer: Thanks for flagging this - you're right that PDF export currently captures the base dashboard state rather than any temporary filters or drill-downs applied in session. This is a known limitation we're actively working on for an upcoming release. In the meantime, saving your filtered view as a separate dashboard view before exporting will ensure the PDF reflects the correct data, and I can walk you through that workaround if helpful.

subject: Question about restoring files from backup
body:
We need to restore a folder of student records that were accidentally deleted from Storage last Thursday. I see we have backup retention enabled but I'm not sure how far back our restore points go on the Starter plan, or if this is something we can do ourselves or need your team to handle.

We have 25 seats and this folder contained files used for grading records, so we'd like to get this resolved this week if possible. Please let us know the process for initiating a restore.
answer: Thanks for reaching out. On the Starter plan, backup retention covers the last 7 days, so a deletion from last Thursday should still be within the restore window. Self-service restore isn't available on Starter, so I'll go ahead and initiate the restore request on our end for that folder - can you confirm the exact folder path or name so we can locate the correct backup point?

subject: SCIM provisioning setup questions
body:
We're trying to enable SCIM provisioning so that new hires get their accounts created automatically instead of us adding them manually in Admin Console. I've generated an API token but I'm not seeing clear documentation on which SCIM endpoint URL to use for our tenant, or whether group provisioning is supported alongside user provisioning.

We're a small team on the Starter plan with 21 seats, so this would mainly help our HR lead avoid manual account setup each time someone joins. Any guidance on the correct configuration steps would be appreciated.
answer: Great to hear you're setting up SCIM - I'll point you to the correct tenant-specific endpoint, which you can find under Identity settings > Provisioning once SCIM is enabled for your account. Group provisioning is supported alongside user provisioning, though on the Starter plan group-to-role mapping is limited to a single default role per group. I'll send over our SCIM setup guide with the exact header and token format required.

subject: Getting duplicate email alerts for the same event
body:
Several of our team members have been receiving two identical email notifications for the same document upload event, both arriving within a minute of each other. This has been happening consistently for about two weeks now across different notification types, not just uploads. We have 175 seats on the Pro plan and it's starting to clutter inboxes and cause confusion about whether an action actually needs attention.

Is there a setting we're missing that might be causing alerts to fire twice, or is this something on your end?
answer: Thanks for the report - duplicate alerts like this are usually caused by overlapping notification rules, such as having both a workspace-level and user-level subscription active for the same event type. Could you check under Notification settings whether any of the affected users have duplicate rules configured for the same event? If everything looks correct on your side, we'll dig into the delivery logs for your account to see if the duplication is happening on our end.

subject: Duplicate alert delivery for same ticket updates
body:
I'm seeing duplicate notification emails triggered for ticket status changes in our support queue integration. For example, on March 11th we received two separate emails at 09:42 and 09:43 for the exact same status change on ticket ref DH-2291. This is happening intermittently, maybe 1 in 10 notifications, not on every single one.

We have 54 seats on the Pro plan. It's not blocking work but it is creating noise for our support engineers who then double-check tickets that don't actually need re-review.
answer: Thanks for the specific example, that's helpful for tracing this. Intermittent duplicates like this are often caused by a retry mechanism firing when the initial delivery acknowledgment is delayed rather than lost - we'll check the delivery logs around March 11th 09:42-09:43 for ticket DH-2291 to confirm whether this was a retry event. We'll follow up once we've identified the pattern and whether a fix is needed on the notification retry logic.

subject: How to link Jira issues to Northwind records?
body:
We'd like to set up an integration so that when we create a Jira issue referencing a data pipeline error, it automatically links back to the relevant record in Northwind for our engineering team to review. I saw Salesforce and Slack integrations listed in our Integrations tab but no Jira option currently.

We're a small team with 28 seats on the Pro plan and mainly want a simple way to cross-reference issues without manually copying IDs. Is a native Jira integration available or planned, and if not, is there a workaround using existing integrations?
answer: Thanks for the question - a native Jira integration isn't currently available, though it's on our roadmap based on requests like yours. In the meantime, a workaround some customers use is triggering a Slack notification via our existing Slack integration that includes the record ID, then linking that into Jira through Slack's own Jira connector. I'll flag your interest in native Jira support to our product team as well.

subject: Salesforce sync failing since this morning
body: Our Salesforce integration stopped syncing contacts and opportunities as of around 8:15 AM today. We use this sync to keep our legal case records aligned with Salesforce accounts, and now our team of 6 is seeing stale data across all records. The integration dashboard shows the last successful sync timestamp as 08:14 AM, and every attempt since then errors out with 'sync job failed: connection timeout'. We've already tried disconnecting and reconnecting the Salesforce app under Integrations but the issue persists.
answer: Thanks for flagging this right away. We're seeing elevated timeout errors on the Salesforce connector affecting multiple accounts and our team is actively investigating the root cause on the connector service. In the meantime, could you confirm whether your Salesforce org had any recent API rate limit changes or IP allowlist updates? We'll update this ticket within the hour with a status.

subject: Data from our SIS connector is arriving 2+ days late
body: We rely on the nightly connector pulling enrollment data from our student information system, but for the past week records are showing up 2 to 3 days after the expected date. This is causing our attendance dashboards to be inaccurate for roughly 10 staff members who depend on same-day data. The connector logs show successful runs each night, but the actual row timestamps inside the pipeline output are lagging behind. We checked the documentation on late-arriving data handling but it doesn't cover this specific delay pattern.
answer: Thank you for the detailed report. Late-arriving data like this usually points to either a delay upstream at the source system or a watermark/window setting in the connector configuration that's not accounting for the lag. Can you send us the connector job ID for last night's run so we can trace the ingestion timestamps versus the source extraction time? We'll also review your current watermark settings and follow up with recommended adjustments.

subject: Need to change dashboard sharing permissions for external partners
body: We currently have several dashboards shared org-wide across our 285 seats, but we need to restrict a subset of energy usage dashboards to only specific partner groups rather than the whole company. When I try to edit sharing settings on the 'Regional Load Forecast' dashboard, the permission changes save but don't seem to apply on refresh, the shared users list reverts to the previous state. This is blocking us from safely sharing sensitive data externally.
answer: Thanks for the details on the permission reset issue. This looks like a caching problem on the sharing settings panel rather than a true permissions failure. Could you try clearing the dashboard cache via Settings > Dashboard > Refresh Cache and then reapplying the group restrictions? If the issue persists after that, please send us the dashboard ID and we'll check the permission sync logs on our end.

subject: URGENT: Webhooks not delivering, losing booking confirmation data
body: As of about 40 minutes ago, none of our webhook endpoints are receiving events from the API Platform. We use webhooks to trigger booking confirmation emails and inventory updates across our travel platform serving 114 seats, and right now confirmations are not going out at all. The webhook delivery log shows status 'failed: 504 gateway timeout' on every attempt since roughly 2:10 PM, and retries are also failing. We are actively losing customer booking data because our downstream systems have no fallback for missed events.
answer: This has been escalated to our on-call engineering team immediately given the active data loss. We're seeing the 504 errors on webhook delivery infrastructure and are working to identify the failing component right now. Please hold onto any booking events generated in the last hour on your side if possible, we will provide a mechanism to replay missed webhook deliveries once service is restored, and we'll update you within 30 minutes.

subject: Question about role mapping behavior after SSO login
body: I noticed that when new employees log in via SSO for the first time, their role mapping sometimes defaults to 'Viewer' instead of the role configured in our identity provider group. It's not blocking anyone since we can manually fix roles afterward, but I wanted to understand whether this is expected behavior or a bug. We have 34 seats and use group-based role mapping through our SSO provider. Could you clarify how the mapping priority works when a user belongs to multiple groups?
answer: Good question. When a user belongs to multiple SSO groups, role mapping is applied based on the highest-priority group as configured in your mapping rules, and if no explicit priority is set, the system defaults to the most restrictive role, which explains the 'Viewer' fallback. I'd recommend reviewing your group mapping order under Identity and SSO settings to set explicit priorities. Let us know if you'd like us to walk through your current configuration together.

subject: Plan upgrade not reflecting new feature access via API
body: We upgraded from Starter to a higher plan tier last week to unlock advanced billing features, but when I call the /billing/plan endpoint it still returns 'plan: starter' and the feature flags for advanced invoicing are still disabled. Our team of 11 needs this for a client demo tomorrow. I've tried refreshing our API token and re-authenticating but the response hasn't changed. Is there a propagation delay after upgrading, or do we need to trigger something manually?
answer: Thanks for reaching out, and sorry for the timing given your demo tomorrow. Plan upgrades typically propagate within a few minutes, so a week-long delay indicates the upgrade may not have fully applied on the billing backend. I'm checking your account configuration now and will manually sync the plan tier and feature flags today, you should see the updated response from /billing/plan shortly, and I'll confirm here once it's done.

subject: Transform step keeps failing on patient intake connector
body: We're integrating with the Data Pipelines API to process patient intake records, and our transform step has been failing intermittently over the past 3 days. Roughly 1 in 5 records fail with 'transform error: field mapping mismatch on column intake_date' even though the source schema hasn't changed on our end. We've reviewed our connector configuration and field mappings multiple times without finding the issue. Given this affects data quality for legal compliance records, we'd like guidance on how to debug this further or get connector-level logs.
answer: Thank you for the detailed context, this is important given the compliance sensitivity of the data. We'd like to pull the connector-level transform logs for the past 3 days to identify which specific records are failing and whether there's a schema drift issue on the intake_date field. Could you send us the connector ID and a couple of example record IDs that failed? We'll prioritize this and get back to you with findings within one business day.

subject: Seat count discrepancy on latest invoice
body: Our latest invoice shows charges for 16 seats, but when I check our workspace under Admin > Users, we only have 13 active users listed. We've had a few employees leave over the past two months and I believe their seats weren't deprovisioned properly. Could someone review our account and either adjust the seat count going forward or issue a credit for the 3 extra seats we've been charged for on the recent billing cycle?
answer: Thanks for catching this discrepancy. We'll review your workspace's user history and deprovisioning records to confirm when those 3 seats should have been removed, and we'll process an adjustment or credit on your account accordingly for the affected billing period. You should see the updated seat count reflected on your next invoice, and we'll follow up here once the credit has been applied.

subject: URGENT - SSO login failures blocking employee access company-wide
body: Starting about an hour ago, employees across our organization of 223 seats are unable to log in via SSO. The error returned is 'authentication failed: role mapping error - no matching role found' even for users who previously logged in successfully today. Our IT team hasn't made any changes to our identity provider group configuration recently. This is currently blocking a large portion of our staff from accessing their accounts during business hours.
answer: We understand the urgency and have escalated this to our identity platform team immediately given the scale of impact. This error pattern suggests a possible issue with role mapping rule evaluation on our side rather than your IdP configuration, and we're actively investigating. We'll provide an update within 20 minutes, and in the meantime, if any users have existing active sessions, please avoid forcing a re-login as that may trigger the same error.

subject: Okta app integration broken, SSO provisioning failing for finance team
body: Our Okta app connection for Northwind stopped provisioning new users correctly as of this morning. When I try to assign a new finance team member through Okta, the provisioning log shows 'error: attribute mapping failed for department field' and the user never appears in our Northwind workspace. This is affecting our ability to onboard two new hires who start this week and need billing system access. We have 108 seats total and haven't changed our Okta configuration recently.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report, we know onboarding timing is critical here. This attribute mapping error typically occurs when a custom field on the Okta side no longer matches the expected schema on our integration, and we're checking whether a recent update to our Okta app definition affected the department field mapping. We'll investigate immediately and get back to you today with either a fix or a manual provisioning workaround for your new hires in the meantime.

subject: Feature request: configurable retry backoff for webhook SDK
body: We're using the Northwind Node SDK (v4.2.1) to receive webhooks for booking.updated events, and we're hitting 429 rate limit responses during peak sync windows around 8-9am UTC. The SDK currently retries with a fixed 500ms delay regardless of the Retry-After header, which just re-triggers the limit. Could you add support for honoring the Retry-After header, or expose a config option for exponential backoff? Happy to test a beta build against our 86-seat workspace.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report and for pointing at the exact SDK version. You're right that the current retry logic ignores Retry-After - I've filed this as a feature request with our SDK team (ref includes your workspace ID) and tagged it as a bug since honoring that header is expected behavior. In the meantime, a workaround is to catch the 429 in your handler and apply your own backoff loop reading the Retry-After value directly from the response headers. I'll update this ticket once we have a release timeline.

subject: Getting duplicate email alerts for every event - 3x per trigger
body: Since integrating the Notifications API last week, every alert we configure fires 3 separate emails to the same recipient within seconds of each other. We have a rule set up for shipment.delayed events and our ops team is getting flooded - over 400 duplicate emails yesterday alone. Our webhook endpoint only logs one inbound POST per event on our side, so it seems like the duplication is happening on your end before delivery.
answer: I'm sorry for the flood this is causing your team - I understand this needs urgent attention. We're checking the notification delivery service for retry-loop issues that could cause triplicate sends even when only one event is received; can you share one of the affected event IDs and approximate UTC timestamps so we can trace it in the delivery logs? In the meantime, as a stopgap you can add an idempotency check on message ID in your recipient's mail rules, though we'll aim to have a root cause identified within a few hours given the volume you're seeing.

subject: Zapier integration stopped syncing Salesforce leads to Slack
body: Our Zapier connection between Northwind and Salesforce has been failing since yesterday afternoon - new leads aren't posting to our #sales-leads Slack channel or creating Jira tickets like they normally do. The Zap history shows the trigger step succeeding but the Slack action step erroring with 'Invalid auth token.' We haven't changed any credentials on our side. This is affecting lead follow-up for our whole healthcare sales team.
answer: Thanks for flagging this with the Zap history details. An 'Invalid auth token' error on the Slack action usually means the OAuth token Zapier is using to connect to your Northwind workspace has expired or was revoked - this can happen after a workspace permission change or token rotation. Could you check whether anyone on your team recently updated app permissions in the Admin Console, and then try reconnecting the Slack action step in Zapier? If reconnecting doesn't resolve it, send us the Zap ID and we'll check the integration token status on our side.

subject: Push notifications not arriving when devices go offline then reconnect
body: Our shift supervisors use the mobile app on the warehouse floor where signal is patchy, and we've noticed that push notifications for shift alerts don't come through once a device reconnects after being offline - they just seem to get dropped instead of delivered late. Testing on two Android devices (app version 3.1.4) confirms it: notification sent while offline never appears even minutes after reconnecting to wifi. This is affecting all 16 of our team's users.
answer: Thank you for the clear reproduction steps - that's very helpful. Push notifications queued during offline periods should be re-delivered on reconnect, so a total drop points to either a token refresh issue or a queue expiry setting on our push service. Could you confirm the approximate offline duration in your test and send us one affected device's push token or user ID? We'll investigate the delivery queue behavior for your workspace and follow up with findings.

subject: Shared dashboard shows 'access denied' for viewer-role teammate
body: I shared our Q3 Bookings dashboard with a teammate using the viewer role, but they get 'You don't have permission to view this chart' when opening any of the trend charts, even though the dashboard itself loads fine. I've double-checked their role in the sharing settings and it's set to Viewer, not Restricted. This is blocking our small team from reviewing quarterly numbers together.
answer: Thanks for the detailed description - this sounds like a permissions mismatch at the chart level rather than the dashboard level, since individual charts can sometimes inherit stricter data-source permissions than the dashboard wrapper. Can you confirm whether the underlying data source for those charts has its own separate sharing list? In the meantime, try removing and re-adding your teammate to the dashboard's share list, which often resets the inherited chart permissions - let us know if the error persists after that.

subject: Unsubscribe link in emails not working - users still getting alerts
body: We integrated the Notifications API for transactional alerts, and several recipients have reported that clicking the unsubscribe link in the email footer returns a 'link expired' page, then they keep receiving the same alerts afterward. I checked our template and we're using the {{unsubscribe_url}} variable exactly as documented. This is now generating complaints and we're worried about compliance exposure since some of these are patient-facing notifications.
answer: I understand the urgency here given the compliance concern, and we're escalating this immediately. The 'link expired' behavior suggests the unsubscribe token TTL may be misconfigured or the token is being regenerated before the email is opened - can you send us one full unsubscribe URL from a recent email (redacting the token itself if you prefer, just the domain and path structure) plus the send timestamp? We'll trace the token generation on our end and get back to you within the hour given the impact.

subject: Transform step failing intermittently on connector sync - data gaps
body: Our nightly pipeline that transforms enrollment data from our Postgres connector into the reporting warehouse has failed on 4 of the last 7 runs, each time with a generic 'transform step error' and no further detail in the run log. When it fails, that day's records simply don't appear downstream, which our reporting team only caught because totals looked low for two schools last week. We need to understand the pattern before our board reporting cycle next month.
answer: Thanks for flagging this with the run history detail - a generic transform error with silent data gaps is exactly the kind of issue we want to dig into before your reporting deadline. Could you share the pipeline ID and the run IDs for the 4 failed runs? We'll pull the detailed transform logs on our side, since the UI often truncates the underlying error, and check whether it correlates with specific record shapes or connector timeouts from the source database.

subject: IP ALLOWLIST FEATURE MISSING FROM ADMIN CONSOLE - SECURITY AUDIT BLOCKED
body: We are in the middle of a security audit and were told Northwind supports IP allowlisting for admin console access, but there is NO SUCH OPTION anywhere in our settings. I have looked under Security, under Settings, under Access Control - nothing. Our auditor needs this configured THIS WEEK or we fail the review. This is completely unacceptable for a product we pay for and if this isn't resolved fast we will be reviewing whether to stay on Northwind at all.
answer: I hear the urgency and I'm sorry this is putting your audit timeline at risk. IP allowlisting for the Admin Console is available on Pro plan and above, which is why it isn't showing in your Starter workspace settings - I'm escalating this ticket to get you options today, including a temporary plan adjustment path if that helps you pass the audit deadline. I'll follow up within a few hours with next steps and, if useful, documentation you can hand directly to your auditor describing our access control architecture.

subject: Late-arriving data from ERP connector causing wrong month-end totals
body: Our finance close process relies on the ERP connector pipeline syncing daily transaction data, but records from March 28-31 arrived 6 days late and landed in our April reporting window instead of March. This has thrown off our month-end reconciliation for a retail operation with over 4000 employees' worth of transaction volume feeding through this pipeline. We need to understand why the sync lagged and whether there's a way to backfill records into the correct reporting period.
answer: Thank you for the specific date range and impact detail - month-end reconciliation errors at this scale need prompt attention. Late-arriving syncs are usually caused by upstream ERP API throttling or a connector checkpoint lag; we're pulling the sync logs for your pipeline now to confirm the cause for March 28-31. For the reporting period issue, we can help you re-run a backfill job that reassigns records by their original transaction timestamp rather than sync timestamp - I'll confirm the backfill window and steps shortly.

subject: File uploads to Storage API failing with 500 error since this morning
body: We're getting consistent 500 Internal Server Error responses when uploading files over roughly 20MB to the Storage API endpoint since around 9am today - smaller files under 5MB still upload fine. This is blocking our order-document upload flow entirely for our small team. Error body just returns {"error":"internal_error","request_id":"req_8841ff"} with no further detail on our end.
answer: Thanks for the request ID and the size threshold detail - that's very useful for us to narrow this down quickly. We're treating this as an active outage affecting larger uploads and are checking whether it's related to a storage backend issue we're seeing on our side this morning; I'll pull the trace for req_8841ff now and report back as soon as we have a cause or a fix deployed. In the meantime, if it's urgent for order processing, splitting files under 5MB is a temporary workaround while we investigate.

subject: Fehler beim Plan-Upgrade über API - Zahlung akzeptiert aber Plan bleibt alt
body:
Wir integrieren die Billing-API für unser internes Provisioning-Tool und stoßen beim Upgrade eines Kundenaccounts auf ein Problem. Der Call an /v1/billing/subscriptions/upgrade liefert Status 200 und die Zahlung wird laut Stripe-Dashboard auch abgebucht, aber im Response bleibt "plan": "legacy-standard" stehen statt "enterprise-plus". Das ist bei der Account-ID acc_48213 am 14.03. um 09:40 Uhr aufgetreten.

Können Sie prüfen, ob hier ein Sync-Problem zwischen Payment-Provider und Billing-Service vorliegt? Wir brauchen außerdem eine korrigierte Rechnung, da dem Kunden der falsche Plan berechnet wurde.
answer: Vielen Dank für die genauen Angaben zu acc_48213. Das klingt nach einem bekannten Race-Condition-Problem zwischen der Zahlungsbestätigung und dem Plan-Wechsel-Service, das wir uns direkt ansehen. Wir gleichen den Vorgang mit unseren Billing-Logs ab und melden uns innerhalb der nächsten Stunden mit einem Status-Update sowie einer korrigierten Rechnung, falls tatsächlich der falsche Plan berechnet wurde.

subject: Question about scheduling flexibility for Salesforce sync
body: We currently run our Salesforce connector sync every 6 hours, but our finance team needs fresher data ahead of month-end close. Is there a way to set up a custom schedule, like every 2 hours during the last week of the month, without creating a separate pipeline just for that window?
answer: Good question — right now scheduled syncs support a single fixed interval per pipeline, but you can create a secondary pipeline pointing at the same connector with a tighter schedule and disable the base one during that window, or use our API to trigger on-demand syncs programmatically. I'll also flag this as a feature request for schedule overrides tied to calendar dates, since a few other customers have asked for the same thing.

subject: Request: native Jira link for issue tracking alongside Okta/Salesforce integrations
body: We've already got Okta SSO and Salesforce connected for our support workflows, and now we want to link Jira so that support tickets can auto-create linked issues for engineering. I don't see a Jira option in the Integrations tab, only a generic webhook. Is a native Jira integration on the roadmap, or is there a documented way to wire this up ourselves?
answer: Thanks for reaching out — native Jira linking isn't live yet, but it's on our near-term roadmap given the demand we've seen. In the meantime you can use the generic webhook plus our REST API to create linked Jira issues on ticket events; I can share a sample payload structure if that helps you get started sooner.

subject: Need clarity on upcoming API v1 deprecations affecting webhook payloads
body:
I'm reviewing the deprecation notice for API v1 sent last week and I'm trying to understand the exact impact on our webhook consumers. We rely on the `event.metadata.legacy_id` field in webhook payloads for reconciliation, and the changelog mentions it will be removed in v2 but doesn't say what replaces it.

Could you confirm the migration path for that field and whether the SDK (we're on v3.2 of the Python SDK) already supports the new format? We'd rather adjust our code once than patch twice.
answer: Good catch on that field — `event.metadata.legacy_id` is being replaced by `event.resource_id`, which is already available in webhook payloads today running alongside the deprecated field, so you can start migrating immediately without waiting for v2. The Python SDK v3.4, released last month, has full support for the new field; upgrading from 3.2 should be a drop-in change, but let us know if you hit any issues during testing.

subject: Duplicate email alerts being sent for same incident
body: Since Tuesday we've been getting duplicate notification emails for the same alert rule — specifically the "API error rate > 5%" alert fired twice within 3 minutes for the same incident window (10:12 and 10:15) on March 11th. This is confusing our on-call engineers who think there are two separate incidents. It's happened 4 times this week alone.
answer: Thanks for flagging this — duplicate alert emails for a single incident point to a deduplication issue on our end, and we're looking into it right now. Can you confirm whether all four occurrences involved the same alert rule, or if other rules were also affected? That will help us narrow down whether it's rule-specific or a broader notification service issue while we work on a fix.

subject: Option to combine multiple alert types into one daily digest email
body:
Right now we're getting separate emails for billing alerts, usage threshold alerts, and payment failures, sometimes five or six emails a day. As the finance manager I'd like a single daily digest instead of individual emails for each event type, similar to what I've seen mentioned in other SaaS tools' notification settings.

Is this something we can configure today, or is it a feature we'd need to request? Documentation only covers per-event settings as far as I can find.
answer: You're right that digest mode isn't currently exposed in the notification settings — today each alert type sends independently. I've logged this as a feature request on your account since a daily rollup is a common ask, and in the meantime I can share a documented workaround using our webhook + a lightweight aggregation script if that would help reduce inbox noise sooner.

subject: Large file uploads timing out intermittently
body: Over the past week we've had several uploads over 2GB fail partway through, usually around the 70-80% mark, with a generic "upload failed, please retry" message. This happened three times on March 9th and twice yesterday during our nightly backup job. Smaller files under 500MB seem fine. We're not seeing any quota warnings in the dashboard.
answer: Thanks for the details — failures consistently around 70-80% on large files often point to a connection timeout during multipart upload rather than a quota issue, which matches what you're seeing with smaller files succeeding. We'll pull the storage service logs for the timestamps you mentioned and check for timeout or throttling patterns; in the meantime, could you confirm which upload method your backup job uses (direct API vs. our storage SDK) so we can narrow it down further?

subject: Unsubscribed users still receiving weekly report emails
body: Several of our team members unsubscribed from the weekly usage report emails through the link in the footer over a month ago, but they're still receiving them every Monday. I confirmed with two colleagues who both clicked unsubscribe on Feb 3rd and got a confirmation page, yet emails kept arriving on Feb 10th, 17th, and 24th.
answer: This shouldn't be happening — an unsubscribe confirmation should immediately suppress future sends, so this looks like a bug in how the preference is being honored by the weekly report job specifically. Could you share the email addresses (or account emails) that unsubscribed so we can check the suppression list and trace why the report job isn't respecting it? We'll prioritize a fix once we confirm the scope.

subject: Zapier integration stopped triggering Slack notifications
body: Our Zapier zap that posts new ticket alerts to a Slack channel has been silent since yesterday around 3pm. The zap history in Zapier shows the trigger firing successfully on our end, but no corresponding Slack messages are appearing, even though the same zap worked fine for weeks. We haven't changed any zap configuration recently.
answer: Thanks for the detailed timeline — since the Zapier trigger is firing but the Slack step isn't completing, this looks like it could be an authorization or rate-limit issue on the Slack connector side rather than our integration itself. Could you check whether the Slack app connection in your Zapier account shows as still authorized, and let us know if you see any error codes in the zap's task history? We'll also check our integration logs for any changes around the 3pm timeframe you mentioned.

subject: SDK wirft Fehler nach API-Update, vermutlich Rate-Limit-Header betroffen
body:
Seit dem letzten SDK-Update auf Version 2.7.1 bekommen wir bei fast jedem zweiten Request folgenden Fehler:

Error: RateLimitExceeded: Retry-After header missing
  at parseRateLimitHeaders (client.js:142)
  at RequestHandler.handleResponse (client.js:88)
  at async ApiClient.request (client.js:45)

Das passiert seit heute Morgen bei unseren Webhook-Callback-Verarbeitungen, obwohl wir laut Dashboard weit unter dem Rate Limit liegen. Ist das mit der angekündigten Deprecation der alten Header-Namen verbunden?
answer: Danke für den Stack-Trace, das hilft uns sehr bei der Eingrenzung. Es sieht tatsächlich so aus, als hätte die Umstellung auf die neuen Rate-Limit-Header-Namen im Rahmen der Deprecation den alten `Retry-After`-Header entfernt, den SDK 2.7.1 noch erwartet. Wir empfehlen vorübergehend ein Downgrade auf 2.6.x oder ein Update auf den kommenden Patch, den wir noch heute veröffentlichen werden, und melden uns sofort, sobald dieser verfügbar ist.

subject: Mobile app crashes immediately on launch after latest update
body: We updated to the latest Northwind Mobile build (v4.3.1) on our test devices and now the app crashes within a second of opening, before the login screen even renders. This is happening on both Android 13 and iOS 17 devices. We're integrating the push notification and offline sync APIs for our manufacturing floor app, and this crash is blocking our QA cycle. Crash logs just show a null pointer in the SplashActivity init.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. A crash immediately on launch after 4.3.1 sounds like it could be related to a known SplashActivity init issue tied to cached push tokens on upgrade - can you have QA clear app data on one device and relaunch to confirm that resolves it? In parallel, please send us the full crash log or stack trace from device logs (adb logcat or Xcode console) so we can verify the root cause and get you a permanent fix or config change.

subject: SDK throwing deprecated method warnings after upgrade to v3
body: We recently upgraded our API SDK integration to version 3.2 and now our build logs are full of deprecation warnings for the `AuthClient.getTokenSync()` method, which we use in several places across our retail order pipeline. The documentation doesn't clearly state the recommended replacement or a migration timeline. Can you point us to updated docs or a migration guide so we can plan the refactor across our 268-seat deployment without breaking production calls?
answer: Thanks for flagging this - `getTokenSync()` is indeed deprecated as of SDK v3.0 in favor of the async `AuthClient.getToken()` method, which handles token refresh more reliably. We're updating the migration guide this week to include concrete before/after code samples; in the meantime I'll send you a direct link to the current deprecation notes and a rough timeline for when the sync method will be removed entirely so you can plan the refactor with confidence.

subject: Pipeline data arriving hours late, breaking downstream reports
body: Since Monday our nightly data pipeline sync (pipeline ID pl-8842) has been landing 3 to 5 hours later than scheduled, which is delaying our fintech reporting dashboards that finance relies on for the 7am close. Normally the sync completes by 2am; this week it's finishing between 6am and 8am. We haven't changed our source connectors or volume, so this seems to be on Northwind's side. Can someone check the pipeline queue for delays affecting our account?
answer: This has been escalated to our pipeline operations team as a P1 given the impact on your daily close reporting. We're seeing elevated queue latency across a subset of pipelines in your region starting Monday, likely tied to a backend scaling issue - we're actively working on a fix and will prioritize pipeline pl-8842 in the meantime. I'll update you within a few hours with either a resolution or a revised ETA.

subject: Need Slack alert routing changed for incident escalations
body: We'd like to change how our Slack integration routes alerts - right now everything from Jira and Okta goes into a single #alerts channel, but our travel ops team needs incident-priority alerts (P1/P2) split into a dedicated #escalations channel so they're not missed among routine notifications. This is becoming urgent since we had a missed escalation last week that delayed our response by over an hour. Can we get this reconfigured or guided through doing it ourselves?
answer: I understand the urgency here given the missed escalation - let's get this fixed quickly. You can create the routing split yourself under Integrations > Slack > Alert Rules by adding a filter on severity tags for Jira and Okta events, but since this is time-sensitive I'm also looping in one of our integration specialists to walk through the configuration with you today and make sure the #escalations channel is correctly capturing P1/P2 events going forward.

subject: API-Schlüssel funktionieren nicht mehr - Rate Limit Fehler seit heute Morgen
body: Seit heute Morgen erhalten wir bei allen Aufrufen über unseren API-Schlüssel den Fehler 429 Too Many Requests, obwohl wir laut unserem Starter-Plan deutlich unter dem üblichen Limit liegen. Unser Buchungssystem für Reisebranche ist dadurch komplett blockiert, da keine Anfragen mehr durchkommen. Wir haben den Schlüssel nicht geändert und auch keine neuen Integrationen hinzugefügt. Können Sie bitte prüfen, ob es ein Problem mit unserem Konto oder eine falsche Rate-Limit-Konfiguration gibt?
answer: Vielen Dank für die Meldung, das behandeln wir als P1 da Ihr Buchungssystem blockiert ist. Wir prüfen gerade, ob es eine fehlerhafte Rate-Limit-Zuordnung auf Kontoebene gibt, da 429-Fehler bei Starter-Konten unterhalb des üblichen Limits ungewöhnlich sind. Wir melden uns innerhalb der nächsten Stunde mit einem Update oder einer temporären Erhöhung des Limits, damit Ihr System wieder läuft.

subject: Question about push notification delivery delays on Android
body: We're integrating push notifications into our mobile app for internal team updates and noticed that notifications sometimes take 5-10 minutes to arrive on Android devices, even when the app is in the foreground. This isn't urgent since it's not blocking anything critical yet, but we'd like to understand if this is expected behavior with the current push service tier or if there's a configuration we're missing on our end.
answer: Good question - some delay on Android can be expected due to Firebase's battery optimization and doze mode handling, especially if the device isn't actively connected to your app's push channel. I'd recommend checking that you're using high-priority message flags for time-sensitive notifications, which bypasses most of that throttling. If delays persist even with high-priority set, let us know and we can dig into your specific app configuration.

subject: Documentation request: crash handling and offline mode setup
body: Our team is reviewing the Mobile App SDK before rolling it out more broadly across our legal firm's devices, and we noticed a recurring crash on launch for a few users when the app starts without network connectivity. We'd like to update our internal deployment guide to include proper offline handling and crash reporting setup steps. Could you point us to current documentation covering offline mode configuration and push notification fallback behavior?
answer: Thanks for reaching out proactively on this. I'll send over links to our current offline mode configuration guide and the push notification fallback documentation, both of which cover recommended handling for launch-time connectivity checks. If the crash-on-launch issue is still occurring for those specific users when documentation changes aren't enough, feel free to open a follow-up ticket with device details and we can investigate further.

subject: SSO role mapping not assigning correct permissions after login
body: I'm the finance manager here and after our recent SSO setup, a few of us are being logged in with default viewer permissions instead of the finance role we were assigned in the identity provider. This is only affecting 2 of our 3 seats so far. We use SAML-based SSO through our provider and the role attribute is mapped in the SSO configuration, but it doesn't seem to be applying correctly on login.
answer: Thanks for the details - this sounds like a role attribute mapping mismatch between your SAML assertion and the Northwind role names. Could you send us a sample SAML response (with sensitive values redacted) for one of the affected logins? That will let us confirm whether the attribute name or the role value itself isn't matching what's configured on our side, and we can get the correct mapping applied.

subject: Intermittent SDK errors when calling webhook subscription endpoint
body: We've noticed our data pipeline occasionally throws SDK errors when subscribing to webhook events via the API - specifically a `WebhookRegistrationError: invalid signature` that appears maybe 1 in 20 calls, seemingly at random. We're on SDK version 2.9.4. It doesn't seem to correlate with rate limits since we're well under our retail account's threshold. Wondering if this is a known bug or something on our signing key setup.
answer: This does look like a known intermittent issue in SDK 2.9.4 related to signature validation timing during webhook registration - we have a fix in 2.9.6 that addresses a race condition in the signing header generation. I'd recommend upgrading when you get a chance, but if you're not able to update immediately, let us know and we can share a workaround for retrying registration calls that hit that specific error.

subject: Card payment failing repeatedly on our billing account
body: We're trying to process our monthly Starter plan payment and the card on file keeps getting declined with error 'card_declined: do_not_honor' even though it's a valid corporate card with sufficient funds. This has failed 4 times now since yesterday and we're worried our account will get suspended since we're only a small legal team of 19 seats relying on this for API access. Can someone check what's causing this on your end or confirm if it's a bank-side issue?
answer: I understand the concern about service continuity here - I'm escalating this as P1 given the risk of suspension. The 'do_not_honor' response typically originates from the issuing bank rather than our payment processor, so I'd suggest contacting your card issuer to confirm no fraud block or vendor restriction is in place. In the meantime, I'm placing a temporary hold on any suspension actions for your account and can also send you a secure link to update payment details with an alternate card if that's faster.

subject: transfrom jobs failing on connector - urgent-ish
body:
Hi, we have several transform jobs in the Salesforce-to-warehouse pipeline that keep failing since yesterday around 14:00 UTC. Job ids pipe-4471 and pipe-4483 both error out with "schema mismatch on field opportunity_amount" but the source data looks fine to us. We've retried 6 times and same result each time.

Also noticing latancy on the connector sync step even when it does succeed, taking 20+ min instead of usual 4-5 min. Can someone check the connector health for our workspace? This is impacting our reporting for Atlas Legal's month end.
answer:
Thanks for the detailed report. The schema mismatch error on pipe-4471/4483 suggests the source field opportunity_amount changed type recently (likely a Salesforce field update on their side) - we're pulling the transform logs now to confirm and will send you the exact record causing the failure. On the latency, we see elevated processing times on your connector node starting around the same window; we're checking whether this is related to the schema issue causing retries under the hood.

We'll update this ticket within a few hours with findings and a fix or workaround so your month-end reporting isn't further delayed.

subject: Speicherkontingent - Frage zu Backup-Retention
body:
Guten Tag, wir nähern uns offenbar unserem Speicherkontingent im Storage-Produkt und ich wollte vorab klären, wie sich das auf unsere Backup-Retention auswirkt. Aktuell behalten wir Backups 90 Tage. Werden ältere Backups automatisch gelöscht, wenn das Kontingent erreicht ist, oder werden neue Uploads blockiert?

Es wäre hilfreich, eine Übersicht zu bekommen, wie viel Speicher aktuell von Backups vs. regulären Uploads belegt wird, damit wir intern planen können, bevor es zu Performance-Problemen kommt.
answer:
Guten Tag, vielen Dank für die Frage. Wenn das Speicherkontingent erreicht wird, blockieren wir standardmäßig neue Uploads statt ältere Backups automatisch zu löschen - Ihre bestehende 90-Tage-Retention bleibt davon unberührt, bis Sie manuell Speicher freigeben oder das Kontingent erhöhen.

Wir können Ihnen gerne eine Aufschlüsselung des aktuellen Verbrauchs nach Backups und regulären Uploads zusenden - ich lasse das intern erstellen und melde mich in Kürze mit den Zahlen.

subject: URGENT: Need immediate restore from backup - possible data loss
body:
We had a failed migration script run against our document storage last night around 23:40 UTC and it appears to have deleted or corrupted files in three folders under the /contracts/2024 path. We need to restore from the most recent clean backup as soon as possible - our compliance team needs these documents accessible for an audit review scheduled this week.

Can you confirm what backup snapshots are available for Cobalt Legal's workspace and the process to initiate a restore? We have 18 seats total and this affects our entire legal document repository. Please advise on retention window and documentation needed on our end to authorize this restore.
answer:
This has been escalated to our security and compliance team as a priority incident given the potential data loss on your contracts repository. We can confirm backup snapshots are retained per your plan's retention window and we're pulling the list of available restore points for Cobalt Legal's workspace right now - we'll share exact snapshot timestamps within the hour.

To authorize the restore we'll need a written confirmation from your IT administrator (this ticket qualifies) specifying the target snapshot and destination path; we'll walk you through it live once we have the snapshot list. We understand the audit timeline and are treating this as urgent.
