subject: Audit log missing entries for deactivated users
body:
I'm reviewing our admin console audit log to prepare a report on account access changes over the past month, and I've noticed that several user deactivation events are missing entirely. Specifically, two accounts we deactivated on March 3rd and March 11th don't show up in the log at all, even though the users no longer have access.

This is a problem for us since we rely on the audit log for compliance reporting at Orion Academy. Can you check if this is a known bug with deactivation events not being logged, and whether there's a way to backfill the missing entries?
answer:
Thank you for flagging this - missing deactivation events in the audit log is not expected behavior, so we're treating this as a bug and looping in our engineering team to investigate why those two events from March 3rd and 11th weren't captured. We'll need to check whether this is isolated to deactivation events specifically or affects other event types too.

We unfortunately can't guarantee a backfill of historical entries once they're missing, but we'll confirm that once we understand the root cause, and we'll let you know within a couple of business days what we find.

subject: SDK throwing errors on every webhook call - blocking our integration
body:
Our team is integrating the Northwind API Platform SDK (v2.4.1, node) and every webhook delivery attempt is failing with the same error: "WebhookSignatureError: unable to verify payload signature." This started after we upgraded from v2.3.0 yesterday. We've double checked our signing secret matches what's in the dashboard.

This is completely blocking our webhook-based integration for Quill Systems and we can't roll back easily since other SDK features we need are only in 2.4.1. Rate limit headers also look different in this version - is there a changelog we're missing? We need this resolved quickly as our production launch is this week.
answer:
Thanks for reporting this - we're aware v2.4.1 changed the webhook signature verification algorithm from SHA-1 to SHA-256, which would cause exactly this error if your signing secret handling wasn't updated to match. This is documented in the v2.4.1 changelog under "Breaking Changes" but we agree it should have been surfaced more prominently.

Given your launch timeline, we're marking this high priority: please update your signature verification to use HMAC-SHA256 with the same secret, and let us know if the error persists after that change. We can also get you on a call today if you need help walking through the code change.

subject: Frage zu Session-Timeouts bei SSO Login
body:
Ich integriere gerade unsere Anwendung mit der Northwind Identity and SSO API und stelle fest, dass Nutzer-Sessions nach etwa 15 Minuten Inaktivität ablaufen, obwohl wir in den Einstellungen ein Timeout von 60 Minuten konfiguriert haben. Das betrifft aktuell nur Test-Accounts bei Summit Labs, aber ich möchte verstehen, ob das erwartetes Verhalten ist.

Gibt es einen Unterschied zwischen dem Session-Timeout auf IdP-Seite und dem Timeout, den wir über die Admin-Konsole konfigurieren? Eine kurze Erklärung würde mir schon helfen, das richtig zu implementieren.
answer:
Vielen Dank für die Frage. Ja, es gibt tatsächlich zwei getrennte Timeout-Werte: den IdP-seitigen Session-Timeout (SAML/OIDC Provider) und den Applikations-Timeout, den Sie über die Admin-Konsole konfigurieren. Wenn der IdP-Timeout kürzer eingestellt ist als die 60 Minuten in Ihrer Konsole, greift der kürzere Wert zuerst - das erklärt vermutlich die 15 Minuten, die Sie beobachten.

Bitte prüfen Sie die Timeout-Einstellung direkt in Ihrer Identity Provider Konfiguration; falls Sie unsicher sind, wo das eingestellt wird, senden Sie uns gerne einen Screenshot Ihrer aktuellen SSO-Konfiguration und wir helfen beim Abgleich.

subject: Scheduled syncs stuck/failing for two days across multiple pipelines
body:
We have four scheduled data pipeline syncs (sync-8821, sync-8822, sync-8834, sync-8840) that have been failing or stuck in "running" state since Tuesday. This is affecting reporting for over 90 users at North Systems who depend on these dashboards being updated nightly. The sync logs show timeout errors after 45 minutes with no clear cause.

We've tried manually triggering the syncs multiple times with the same result. Given the number of users affected and how long this has been broken, we need this escalated - our leadership team is asking why data hasn't refreshed since Monday night.
answer:
This is being escalated immediately as a major incident given the scope of impact across your syncs and user base. We're pulling detailed logs for sync-8821, 8822, 8834, and 8840 right now to identify why they're timing out at the 45-minute mark - this pattern often points to a connector-side bottleneck or a stuck lock on the destination table, and we're checking both.

We'll have an initial update for you within the hour with either a fix or a clear root cause, and we'll keep this ticket updated continuously until all four syncs are running normally again.

subject: URGENT: Dashboard sharing broken - external partners can see internal financial data
body:
We just discovered that a dashboard we intended to share only with our internal finance team at Lumen Capital is also visible to external partner accounts that were added to a different, unrelated dashboard group. This dashboard contains sensitive Q1 financial projections and cost data for 134 seats worth of internal reporting.

We need this locked down immediately - please tell us how to audit exactly who has viewed this dashboard and revoke external access right now. This is a serious exposure and we need confirmation it's contained.
answer:
We understand the urgency and are treating this as a critical incident. As an immediate step, please go to the dashboard's sharing settings and remove the affected external partner group - this will cut off access instantly while we investigate how the permissions crossed over between dashboard groups. We're also pulling access logs on our end right now to identify exactly which external accounts viewed the dashboard and when.

We'll send you the access log within the next 30 minutes so you can assess exposure, and we're investigating the sharing permission bug that allowed this crossover so it doesn't recur. Please stay on this ticket for updates.

subject: Duplicate alert emails being sent to same routing group
body:
We've noticed that our alert routing setup for Ember Travel is sending duplicate notification emails - the same alert (e.g. "API error rate threshold exceeded") is arriving 2-3 times within a minute to the same distribution group. This has been happening for about a week and is causing some of our IT staff to mute the alerts entirely, which isn't great for the ones we actually need to catch.

Is there a known issue with the alert routing rules causing duplicates, or is this something in how we configured the routing group? Would appreciate a documentation link on best practices for routing group setup if that's the issue.
answer:
Thanks for flagging this - duplicate alert delivery is usually caused by having the same routing rule matched by more than one condition (for example, both a threshold rule and a keyword rule triggering on the same alert), which sends it twice through the same group. We'd like to take a look at your specific routing configuration to confirm that's what's happening here.

Could you share the name of the routing group in question? In the meantime, here's our documentation on routing rule precedence and de-duplication settings, which should help clarify how to avoid overlapping rules going forward.

subject: Hit storage quota, backups failing to complete
body:
We're running into our storage quota limit and as a result our nightly backup job has failed the last two nights (Feb 19 and Feb 20) with the error "insufficient storage quota to complete backup operation." We're on the Starter plan with 12 seats and I don't think we've been given clear guidance on what happens to retention when quota is exceeded.

Can someone clarify our current usage versus quota, and what our options are - upgrading, deleting old data, or adjusting retention settings? We need backups running again as soon as possible since we haven't had a successful backup in 2 days now.
answer:
Thanks for reaching out, and sorry for the disruption to your backup schedule. We can see your storage usage is right at the quota threshold, which is why the Feb 19 and Feb 20 backup jobs failed - unfortunately backups can't complete when there's insufficient free space, even though existing data isn't deleted automatically.

Your quickest paths to get backups running again are either freeing up space by removing older, non-essential files or reducing your retention window temporarily, or upgrading your plan for more quota. We can send you a breakdown of what's consuming the most space in your account if that would help you decide - let us know and we'll get that over today.

subject: Offline mode question for field drivers
body:
We have about 25 dispatch staff using the Northwind mobile app on Android tablets while out at fuel depots with poor signal. I want to confirm exactly what data gets cached when offline mode kicks in, and whether push notifications queue up and deliver once connectivity returns, or if they're just dropped.

Could you also let me know if there's a way to see how much local storage the offline cache is using per device? We're trying to plan for older tablets with limited storage.
answer:
Thanks for reaching out. When offline mode activates, the app caches the last synced dashboard views, assigned tasks, and any pending form submissions locally; push notifications that arrive while offline are queued on our servers and delivered as soon as the device reconnects, so nothing gets dropped. There isn't currently a per-device cache size indicator in the admin console, but I can pass that along as a feature request since it would be useful for capacity planning on older hardware.

Let me know if you'd like a walkthrough of the offline sync settings for your fleet.

subject: Seat count discrepancy on Enterprise plan
body:
Our workspace shows 3975 active seats billed this cycle, but when I run the user export from the admin panel I only count 3912 active accounts. I need to understand the gap before we approve the next invoice, since it looks like we may be paying for around 63 seats that aren't tied to any active user.

Can someone walk me through how seat counts are calculated versus deactivated or pending users? We'd also like to know if a refund adjustment is possible for the difference on last month's invoice.
answer: Thanks for flagging this. Seat counts typically include active users plus any pending invites and users deactivated within the last billing cycle, which can explain a gap like the one you're seeing. I'll have our billing team pull a detailed seat reconciliation report for Harbor Partners and check whether the last invoice needs an adjustment for the difference, and we'll follow up with the breakdown within a couple of business days.

subject: Connector authentication needs update for finance data source
body:
Our media billing connector in Data Pipelines has been failing nightly syncs since our finance system rotated its API credentials on the 3rd. The pipeline log shows repeated auth failures and the last successful sync was three days ago, which is starting to affect our end-of-month reconciliation reports for 115 users relying on that data.

I'd like to update the connector's stored credentials myself if possible, or get guidance on the proper way to re-authenticate without breaking existing pipeline mappings.
answer: Thanks for the detail — this is a straightforward fix. You can update the connector credentials yourself under Data Pipelines > Connectors > Finance Source > Edit Connection; re-entering the new API key there will re-authenticate without disrupting your existing field mappings or sync schedule. Once updated, trigger a manual sync to confirm the backlog clears, and let us know if the nightly job doesn't pick back up automatically within 24 hours.

subject: App won't open after latest update
body:
Since updating the Northwind mobile app yesterday, it crashes immediately on launch for our whole analytics team, about 23 people on Starter plan. We see a brief splash screen and then it closes with no error message on both iOS and Android devices.

This is blocking our team from checking dashboards while traveling for a media shoot this week. Is there a known issue with the latest release, or a way to roll back to the previous app version while we wait for a fix?
answer: I'm sorry for the disruption this is causing right before your travel. We're aware of a launch crash affecting a subset of devices after the latest release and a fix is already in progress; in the meantime, please try clearing the app cache and reinstalling, which has resolved the crash for most affected users. If reinstalling doesn't help, let me know your device models and OS versions so I can escalate this specific case while the permanent fix rolls out.

subject: Biometric login failing and causing app crashes
body:
Our product team has been testing biometric login on the Northwind mobile app ahead of a wider rollout to 231 fintech users, and Face ID authentication is crashing the app on iPhone 14 and 15 devices running iOS 17.4. The app closes immediately after the Face ID prompt appears, and this happens consistently, not just occasionally.

We were planning to enable this for all users next week, but given the crash rate we need this resolved first. Can you confirm if this is a known issue with the current app build and whether a patch is coming?
answer: Thank you for catching this before the wider rollout. We've identified a compatibility issue between Face ID authentication and iOS 17.4 in the current app build that's causing this exact crash, and a patched version is in final testing now. I'd recommend holding off on enabling biometric login broadly until the update ships, which we expect within the next few days, and I'll update this ticket as soon as it's live so you can move forward with your rollout.

subject: IP allowlist not blocking non-allowlisted addresses
body:
We configured an IP allowlist in the Admin Console last week to restrict access to our office and VPN ranges for our 54 legal staff, but I just noticed a login from an IP address outside those ranges succeeded without any block or alert. The allowlist shows as active under Security settings with three ranges listed.

Given we're in legal services, this is a compliance concern for us. Can you confirm whether the allowlist is actually being enforced, and whether there's a bug affecting deactivation of restricted IPs?
answer: Thank you for reporting this, and I understand the compliance sensitivity here. We're looking into whether enforcement is failing for your allowlist configuration specifically, since a correctly saved allowlist should block any IP outside the listed ranges. Could you share the timestamp and IP of the login that got through so our engineers can trace it against the enforcement logs, and in the meantime we'd recommend also monitoring login activity manually as a precaution.

subject: Requesting Slack alert integration for pipeline failures
body:
We'd like to set up Slack notifications for our Integrations workspace so our data team gets alerted when pipeline syncs fail or when integration connections with Jira and Salesforce drop. Right now we only find out about failures when someone manually checks the dashboard, which has caused delays in catching sync issues for our travel booking data feeds.

Is Slack alerting currently supported for Integrations, and if not, can this be added? We'd also appreciate documentation on setting up alert rules if this exists already.
answer: Thanks for the detailed request. Slack alerting for Integrations is currently available for connection failures, but pipeline-sync-specific alerts to Slack aren't supported yet — I'm logging this as a feature request on your behalf since it sounds like it would directly help your team catch sync issues faster. For the connection-failure alerts we do support today, I'll send over our setup documentation covering how to configure alert rules for Jira and Salesforce integrations.

subject: Need faster way to refresh connector credentials
body:
Our media data pipeline connector keeps losing its authentication token roughly every 10 days, and each time it happens our sync pauses for hours until someone on my team notices and manually re-authenticates. With only 22 seats on our Starter plan, we don't have anyone dedicated to monitoring this daily.

Could you add a feature to auto-refresh connector tokens before they expire, or at least send a proactive alert a day or two before expiration? Right now we're only finding out after the sync has already failed and data quality is suffering downstream.
answer: This is a great point, and I appreciate you flagging the impact on your data quality. Auto-refresh for connector tokens isn't currently available on our end for this connector type, but I'm submitting this as a feature request given how disruptive the manual re-auth cycle has been for your team. In the meantime, I can help set up a proactive expiration alert through our monitoring team so you get a heads-up a day or two before the token lapses, rather than discovering it after the sync fails.

subject: Salesforce sync completely stopped across organization
body:
Our Salesforce integration through Northwind stopped syncing this morning around 8:15am for our entire organization of 3651 users. Records created in Salesforce since then aren't appearing in our dashboards, and the integration status page shows a red error state with the message 'authentication token expired, manual re-link required.'

This is affecting every department that relies on Salesforce data feeding into our education reporting dashboards, so we need this restored as soon as possible. We haven't changed any credentials on our end recently.
answer: I understand the urgency given how many teams this is affecting, and I'm escalating this immediately. The 'authentication token expired' error usually means Salesforce invalidated the token independently of any changes on your side, which can happen after a Salesforce-side security policy update; our team is re-establishing the connection now and will need you to approve a re-authorization prompt that should appear in your admin console shortly. I'll stay on this ticket until sync is fully restored and will confirm once records start flowing again.

subject: Need biometric login enabled for large-scale rollout
body:
We're rolling out the Northwind mobile app to our full organization of 3651 users across multiple campuses and need biometric login enabled as a priority before deployment next week. Several department heads have specifically asked for Face ID and fingerprint support to speed up access for staff switching between shared devices.

Can you confirm this is available on our current setup, and if there are any admin-side configuration steps or documentation we should follow ahead of the rollout? We also want to understand how this interacts with offline mode for staff in areas with limited campus wifi.
answer: Thanks for planning ahead on this — biometric login is available and can be enabled from the Admin Console under Mobile App Settings > Authentication, with a toggle for Face ID and fingerprint support at the organization level. It works fine alongside offline mode, since biometric credentials are verified locally on-device rather than requiring a live connection, so staff in low-connectivity areas won't be blocked. Given the scale of your rollout, I'd suggest we schedule a short call this week to walk through the configuration and any edge cases with shared devices before you deploy next week.

subject: Slow load times on multi-chart dashboards
body: We've noticed that our main compliance dashboard with 8 charts is taking 12-15 seconds to fully render, especially the export to PDF function which sometimes times out. This has been happening since around March 3rd. Would it be possible to get lazy-loading for individual widgets, or at least a way to export only selected charts instead of the whole dashboard?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. Dashboard render time on widget-heavy views is a known pain point, and we're actively working on lazy-loading for individual charts along with a selective export option. I'll log this as a feature request tied to your account and update you when it ships to our roadmap board. In the meantime, splitting the dashboard into two smaller views can reduce load time noticeably.

subject: Feedback on Salesforce sync performance and Okta mapping
body: Our Salesforce sync has been running reliably, but we're seeing sync cycles take almost 40 minutes for around 15,000 records, which is slower than we'd like given we run this twice daily. Separately, we'd love to see Okta group mappings reflected automatically when we provision new Salesforce roles rather than needing manual remapping each time. Any plans to improve either of these?
answer: Thank you for the feedback, this is helpful for prioritizing our integration roadmap. Sync duration for large record sets is something our engineering team is actively optimizing, and we're evaluating batch-size tuning that should cut sync times significantly in an upcoming release. On the Okta side, automatic group-to-role mapping is on our radar as a feature request, and I've added your use case to that ticket for visibility.

subject: Jira integration not posting updates to linked Slack channel
body: Since yesterday around 9am, our Jira issue updates have stopped posting to the linked Slack channel #ops-incidents. We rely on this for tracking incident tickets across 273 users, and the silence is causing our team to miss status changes. The Jira-Northwind link still shows as 'Connected' in the integrations panel, but nothing is coming through. Can you check the webhook status on your end?
answer: Thanks for flagging this, we understand how disruptive silent integration failures can be. We're checking the webhook delivery logs for your Jira-Slack link now to see if there's a delivery failure or an expired token causing the drop. We'll follow up shortly with findings and, if needed, will reissue the webhook credentials to restore the connection.

subject: Charts rendering blank on shared dashboard link
body: One of our shared dashboards, the logistics KPI view we send to external partners, started showing blank chart placeholders instead of the actual bar and line charts as of this morning. Internally the same dashboard renders fine when I'm logged in, so it seems specific to the public share link. We have a partner review call tomorrow and would like this fixed or a workaround before then.
answer: Thanks for reporting this, we can see how this could impact your partner review. This looks like it may be related to a caching issue affecting public share links specifically rather than the underlying data. We're reproducing the issue now and will prioritize a fix given your timeline; in the meantime, regenerating a fresh share link may resolve the blank charts as a temporary workaround.

subject: Scheduled pipeline syncs missing daily runs
body: Our nightly data pipeline sync, scheduled for 2:00 AM UTC, has failed to run on three separate occasions this week (Monday, Wednesday, and today). We only noticed because our morning reports were showing stale data from four days ago. There's no error notification in our dashboard, just a missing run in the sync history log. Can you check why these scheduled jobs aren't triggering?
answer: Thank you for the detailed timeline, that's very useful for tracing this. Missing scheduled runs without an error notification usually points to an issue in the job scheduler queue rather than the pipeline itself, and we're pulling the execution logs for your account now to confirm. We'll also check why failure notifications weren't sent, since you should be alerted whenever a scheduled run doesn't complete.

subject: URGENT: All dashboard charts showing no data since this morning
body: As of about 8:30 AM today, every chart across all our dashboards is showing 'No data available' even though our underlying tables clearly have current records. This is affecting our entire team of 5 and we use these dashboards for daily operational decisions. We haven't changed any data sources or permissions recently. This needs immediate attention as we can't function without visibility into our metrics right now.
answer: We understand the urgency and have escalated this to our on-call engineering team immediately. This pattern, where data exists but charts show empty, typically indicates an issue in the query layer between the data source and dashboard rendering, and we're checking recent deployment logs for anything affecting your account specifically. We'll update you within the hour with root cause findings and a fix timeline.

subject: URGENT - connector authentication failing with 401 on all pipeline runs
body:
Starting about 20 minutes ago, every pipeline run using our custom API connector to pull inventory data is failing with a 401 Unauthorized error. Here's the relevant log:

Error: ConnectorAuthException
Status: 401
Message: 'Token validation failed - signature mismatch'
Connector: inventory-sync-connector-v2
Timestamp: 2024-06-11T14:22:03Z
Affected runs: 14

We haven't rotated our API keys recently, and this is blocking all inventory syncs into our healthcare compliance reports. Need urgent help since this affects all 80 users on our account.
answer: This has been escalated as a P0 immediately given the authentication failure is blocking all your pipeline runs. A signature mismatch on token validation often indicates a key rotation or clock-skew issue on our auth service side rather than your connector config, and we're checking our token signing service logs against your connector's timestamp now. We'll have an engineer confirm root cause and restore access within the next 30 minutes, and will keep you updated continuously until resolved.

subject: Data pipeline consistently delivering records 6+ hours late
body: I've noticed a recurring pattern over the past two weeks where our patient-intake pipeline data arrives 6 to 8 hours after the expected sync window instead of the usual 1-hour latency. This is affecting our downstream reporting since analysts are working with stale data during morning reviews. The sync status shows 'Completed' each time, just much later than scheduled. Can someone investigate what's causing this delay?
answer: Thank you for flagging this pattern, consistent multi-hour delays despite successful completion status suggest a queuing bottleneck upstream rather than a failure. We're reviewing the pipeline execution timestamps against the scheduler logs for the past two weeks to identify where the delay is being introduced, and will escalate to our data engineering team given the impact on your reporting workflows. We'll share findings and an expected resolution timeline shortly.

subject: SLACK ALERTS NOT WORKING
body: OUR SLACK INTEGRATION STOPPED SENDING ALERTS TWO DAYS AGO. WE USE THIS TO NOTIFY OUR TEAM ABOUT BOOKING SYSTEM ISSUES AND NOW WE ARE GETTING NOTHING. WE CHECKED THE SLACK CHANNEL SETTINGS AND THE WEBHOOK URL LOOKS THE SAME AS BEFORE. THERE IS NO ERROR SHOWN IN THE INTEGRATIONS PANEL EITHER, IT JUST SAYS ACTIVE. CAN SOMEONE PLEASE CHECK WHY THIS IS BROKEN.
answer: Thanks for reaching out, and apologies for the disruption this has caused. An integration showing 'Active' while alerts silently stop usually points to an expired token or a rate limit on the Slack side that isn't reflected in our status indicator yet. We're checking the delivery logs for your workspace now and will follow up with next steps to get alerts flowing again.

subject: Need to configure IP allowlist for admin console access
body: We need to restrict access to our Northwind admin console to only our corporate VPN IP ranges as part of a security review we're completing this week. I don't see an IP allowlist option under our current settings menu, only under audit log and deactivation controls. Can you confirm whether this feature is available on our plan, and if so, walk me through enabling it? We have 221 seats and need this locked down soon given the audit deadline.
answer: Thanks for reaching out about this, and given your audit deadline we're treating this as a priority request. IP allowlisting is available and should appear under Admin Console > Security Settings, but it sounds like this may need to be enabled on our end first for your account tier. I'm escalating this to our access management team now to get it activated, and will send you step-by-step configuration documentation as soon as it's live.

subject: Salesforce sync stopped pushing new leads
body: We use the Salesforce connector under Integrations to sync leads created in Northwind into our Salesforce org. Since yesterday around 3pm, new leads created in Northwind aren't showing up on the Salesforce side, though the sync log shows status 'completed' each run. We checked our Okta SSO session and Slack alert channel, nothing unusual there. Connector ID is sf-conn-4471 if that helps.
answer: Thanks for the details and the connector ID. This looks like it could be related to a field mapping change on the Salesforce side rather than an outage, since the sync is reporting success. We'll pull the logs for sf-conn-4471 and check the last successful record write timestamp, and follow up with what we find within the next business day.

subject: Request: link Jira tickets to Salesforce opportunities
body: Our sales and support teams want the Jira connector to automatically link Jira issues to the related Salesforce opportunity when a ticket is created from a Slack thread. Right now we have to do this manually for every escalation, and with 292 seats across regional offices it's becoming a bottleneck during renewal season. Could you confirm if this two-way linking is supported natively or if we need a custom workflow via Okta-authenticated API calls?
answer: Good question - native two-way linking between Jira issues and Salesforce opportunities isn't built in yet, but you can achieve it today using our Integrations API with a small automation that listens for Jira issue creation events and writes back the opportunity ID. I'll share a reference workflow and open a feature request on your behalf for native support, since this is a common ask from larger accounts.

subject: Dashboard PDF export broken for all shared reports
body: Since this morning our operations team cannot export any dashboard to PDF - clicking Export > PDF just spins for about 30 seconds then returns a blank file with zero KB. This is affecting every dashboard we've tried, including the weekly executive report we need distributed by noon today. We rely on scheduled PDF exports for sharing with external partners who don't have Northwind accounts, so this is blocking a time-sensitive deliverable across our whole media team.
answer: This is impacting a critical deliverable so we're treating it as high priority. We've confirmed a regression in the PDF rendering service affecting chart-heavy dashboards and engineering is already working on a fix; in the meantime, exporting to CSV or using the 'print to PDF' browser option should work as a stopgap for your noon deadline. We'll update you as soon as the rendering fix is deployed, likely within a few hours.

subject: Scheduled data pipeline syncs skipping records
body: I'm integrating our manufacturing sensor data through the Data Pipelines API and set up a scheduled sync every 15 minutes from our MES connector to Northwind storage. Over the past two days I've noticed the sync completes successfully each run, but roughly 5-10% of records per batch are missing compared to source counts. Batch job pipeline-8823 from this morning shows 940 records ingested when the source had 1,012. Is there a known issue with the connector dropping records during high-frequency syncs, or is there a setting to enable stricter data validation to catch this?
answer: Thanks for the batch ID, that's very helpful. This pattern of record drops on high-frequency syncs is usually caused by the connector's batch size hitting a rate limit and silently truncating the payload rather than erroring out, which we agree isn't ideal. We're going to review pipeline-8823's logs in detail and can also enable stricter validation mode on your pipeline so future truncations raise an alert instead of failing silently.

subject: Payment card repeatedly declining for subscription renewal
body: Our subscription card on file has failed for the past three billing attempts, most recently on the 14th, and we received a notice that our account may be downgraded if payment isn't resolved within 5 days. We've confirmed with our bank that the card has sufficient funds and no blocks on our end, so I suspect this is on Northwind's processing side. We need this resolved before any service disruption affects our 174 seats, and would also like to understand if a refund is owed for the failed attempt fees our bank charged us.
answer: I understand the urgency given the risk to your seats, and I've flagged this to our billing team as high priority given the active failure pattern. We're checking the payment processor logs for the declines on your account to determine if this is a gateway issue on our end, and we'll hold off on any downgrade action while this is under investigation. We'll also review your bank fee concern once we confirm the root cause, likely within the next few hours.

subject: App stürzt beim Start ab
body:
Seit dem Update auf Version 4.2 stürzt unsere mobile App direkt beim Start ab, betrifft alle Nutzer in unserem Team. Wir haben es auf drei verschiedenen Geräten getestet, gleiches Ergebnis.

FATAL EXCEPTION: main
Process: com.northwind.mobile, PID: 8842
java.lang.NullPointerException: Attempt to invoke virtual method on a null object reference
    at com.northwind.mobile.push.PushManager.onCreate(PushManager.java:112)
    at com.northwind.mobile.MainActivity.onCreate(MainActivity.java:58)
    at android.app.Activity.performCreate(Activity.java:8000)

Wir brauchen die App dringend für unsere Reisebüros, könnt ihr das schnell prüfen?
answer: Vielen Dank für den Absturzbericht mit Stacktrace, das hilft uns sehr. Es sieht so aus, als würde ein Fehler im Push-Notification-Modul bei Version 4.2 den Start blockieren - wir eskalieren das intern als hohe Priorität, da es alle Nutzer betrifft. Als schnellen Workaround empfehlen wir, die Push-Benachrichtigungen in den Geräteeinstellungen vorübergehend zu deaktivieren, während wir an einem Fix arbeiten.

subject: Jira-Salesforce link integration completely down
body: Our Jira link integration for tracking renewal opportunities stopped working this morning - every attempt to create a linked Jira issue from a Salesforce opportunity fails with 'authentication error: token expired' even though our Okta session is active. This is blocking our renewal team from tracking escalations tied to our upcoming contract discussion, and we've had no Slack alerts about scheduled maintenance.
answer: Thanks for flagging this right away, we know how critical this is heading into your renewal discussions. It looks like the OAuth token for the Jira connector expired without auto-refreshing correctly, which we're treating as an active incident. We're refreshing the token on our end now and will confirm once linking is restored, likely within the next hour, and we'll follow up with root cause details.

subject: SAML SSO login completely broken for all users
body: We integrated SAML SSO this week and this morning every login attempt via our identity provider fails with 'SAML response validation failed - signature mismatch' on the Northwind login page. None of our 8 seats can access the platform right now. We haven't changed our IdP certificate recently, and this started right after we tried enabling MFA enforcement in the admin console yesterday.
answer: This is urgent since it's blocking all logins, so we're escalating immediately. Enabling MFA enforcement alongside SAML can sometimes trigger a certificate re-validation that fails if the metadata wasn't refreshed - we're pulling your SSO configuration now to check the signing certificate match. We'll reach out within the hour with either a fix or a temporary bypass so your team can get back in.

subject: Storage uploads failing intermittently for our team
body: We've had roughly a dozen upload failures over the past two days on the Storage product, mostly for files larger than 200MB. The error shown is 'upload interrupted - retry limit exceeded' and it happens even on a stable connection. We're a small team of 4 so this is disrupting our manufacturing spec document backups, and we want to understand if this is related to retention policy changes or a performance issue on your end before we plan our workflow around it.
answer: Thanks for the specifics on file size and error message - that pattern points to a timeout on larger uploads rather than a retention or backup policy issue. We're reviewing performance metrics on the storage endpoint for your account over the past two days to confirm, and in the meantime, splitting files above 200MB or using our resumable upload option should avoid the retry limit. We'll follow up with findings and a permanent fix timeline.

subject: Discrepancy in credits applied after seat downgrade
body: We downgraded from 180 to 146 seats last month and were told we'd receive a prorated credit on our next invoice, but the invoice dated the 3rd shows no credit line item at all, just the full charge for 146 seats. We also have an outstanding refund request from a duplicate payment in the prior cycle that hasn't been reflected either. Could someone review our account and confirm both the credit and refund status?
answer: Thank you for the detailed timeline - I'll have our billing team pull your account history to verify both the seat downgrade credit and the duplicate payment refund status. It's possible the credit was queued for the next billing cycle rather than applied to the invoice dated the 3rd, but we'll confirm the exact figures and get you a corrected breakdown within two business days.

subject: Add unsubscribe link to alert emails
body: We're rolling out Notifications to our 20 staff accounts and noticed the alert emails don't include an unsubscribe or preference link at the bottom. A few teachers have asked how to opt out of the daily digest but there's no self-service way to do it. Can this be added, or is there a setting we're missing in the admin console?
answer: Thanks for flagging this. Currently unsubscribe links are only included on marketing-type notifications, not on the transactional alert digests, which is why your teachers aren't seeing one. I've logged this as a feature request to add a preference-center link to the alert templates and will update this ticket once it's scheduled. In the meantime, admins can mute specific alert categories per user from Notifications > Recipients.

subject: URGENT - deprecated webhook signing endpoint returning 401s across all integrations
body: As of this morning all of our outbound webhooks are failing with 401 Unauthorized. We got an email last month saying the legacy signing endpoint would be deprecated but our integration team never got a migration window scheduled. Every webhook consumer tied to our API Platform account (39 seats) is now down and we're losing event data. This is affecting our entire production pipeline for North Freight right now.
answer: This is being treated as a P0. We've confirmed the legacy signing endpoint was fully retired ahead of the announced date for a subset of accounts including yours, which caused the 401s. Our platform team is re-enabling the legacy signature verification temporarily for your account while we walk you through migrating to the new HMAC scheme - a security engineer will call you within the next 20 minutes with interim credentials and next steps.

subject: Salesforce sync stuck, records 6+ hours stale for all users
body: Our Salesforce integration hasn't synced new opportunity records since yesterday at 4:10pm. I checked the Integrations dashboard and the last successful run shows a timestamp of 2024-05-13 16:10, with subsequent runs failing silently - no error banner, just no data movement. This is affecting all 208 seats since our sales and legal teams rely on this sync for daily reporting, and Jira and Slack notifications tied to opportunity stage changes have also stopped firing.
answer: Thank you for the detailed timestamps, that helps us narrow this down quickly. We can see the sync job for your Salesforce connector has been queuing but timing out against the Salesforce API, likely due to a bulk API limit being hit on their side. We're re-running the sync in smaller batches now and will confirm once records and downstream Jira/Slack triggers are current again - expect an update within the hour.

subject: Okta app assignment not syncing to Integrations
body: I'm trying to connect our Okta app so that user group assignments automatically map to access in the Integrations module, but changes made in Okta (adding or removing users from the 'Analytics' group) aren't reflecting here after 24 hours. We also use this integration for Salesforce provisioning, so stale group data is causing incorrect access there too. Is there a manual sync trigger, or is this a known delay?
answer: There isn't currently a manual sync trigger exposed in the UI, but I can kick off a forced re-sync from our side, which I've just done for your Okta app connection. Group membership changes should now reflect within a few minutes - if the Salesforce provisioning mapping still shows stale data after that, let us know the affected user names and we'll check the mapping rules directly.

subject: Charts not rendering on main dashboard
body: Since yesterday our main operations dashboard shows blank spaces where the shipment volume and delay charts used to be. The page loads fine otherwise, and other widgets like the KPI tiles still display. We've tried refreshing and switching browsers (Chrome and Edge) with the same result. This is our primary view for tracking daily logistics performance across our 5 seats, so it's a real gap for our small team right now.
answer: Sorry for the trouble - this matches an issue we're tracking where chart widgets using the 'time series comparison' type failed to render after a recent rendering library update. We're pushing a fix today and will notify you once it's live; as a temporary workaround, recreating the affected charts with the standard line chart type should display correctly in the meantime.

subject: Question about backup retention period for Storage
body: We're setting up long-term backups in Storage for our training materials and I want to confirm the default retention policy before we upload our archive. Right now we see backups older than 30 days getting automatically purged, but we'd like to keep some files for a full year for compliance with our academy's record-keeping requirements. Is there a way to set a custom retention window per folder, or is 30 days fixed on our current plan?
answer: Good question - on your current plan, retention is fixed at 30 days for automated backups and isn't configurable per folder. To keep specific archive files longer, you'd need to move them into a regular Storage folder outside the backup rotation, which isn't subject to the purge policy. If long-term retention is a recurring need, we can also flag this for our product team as a potential plan upgrade path.

subject: Deactivated users still showing as active in allowlist
body: I deactivated four employees from the Admin Console last week after they left Summit Retail, but they're still appearing on our IP allowlist and can log in to certain integrations using their old credentials. I confirmed their status shows 'Deactivated' in the user list, but access clearly hasn't been revoked everywhere. Can you check why the deactivation isn't propagating to the allowlist settings?
answer: Thanks for reporting this - deactivation should immediately revoke session tokens and remove allowlist entries, so this points to a sync gap between the console and the allowlist service for your account. I've escalated this to our access team to investigate the four accounts you mentioned and will confirm once their access is fully revoked; in the meantime, as a precaution I'd recommend rotating any shared API keys those users had access to.

subject: Request: alert on late-arriving finance data before month-end close
body: Every month our finance connector for the ERP pipeline delivers a chunk of transaction records 1-2 days after the expected sync window, which throws off our close reporting since we don't notice until totals look off. This has happened three times in the last quarter, most recently on the 5th when about 1,800 records arrived a day late. Could Data Pipelines add a notification or SLA flag when a connector's data arrives outside its expected window?
answer: This is a great use case and one we've heard from other finance teams as well. There isn't a built-in late-arrival alert yet, but I've submitted this as a feature request to our data pipelines team with your example (1,800 records, one day late) attached for context. In the meantime, you can set up a scheduled data quality check that flags row-count anomalies against the prior period, and I'm happy to help configure that if useful.

subject: MFA enrolment stuck for new hires using SSO
body: We're seeing an issue where new employees provisioned through SSO are able to log in but get stuck on the MFA enrollment screen with a spinning loader that never completes. This has affected about 8 new hires across our 255 seats over the past two weeks. Re-sending the enrollment link doesn't help, and they end up locked out until we manually reset MFA from the admin side.
answer: Thanks for the clear repro details - this looks related to a known timing issue where the MFA enrollment session expires before the SSO-provisioned account finishes initial setup, causing the loader to hang. There's no fix required on your end beyond the manual reset you're already doing; I'll flag this ticket to be updated once our identity team ships the enrollment timeout fix, which is currently planned for an upcoming release.

subject: Best practice for SSO role mapping across business units
body: We're standardizing our SSO role mapping ahead of a broader rollout across Lumen Foods' business units and want to confirm the recommended approach for mapping SAML groups to Northwind roles. Currently we've hardcoded a few group-to-role mappings, but with over 4,000 seats and multiple regional IdPs, we'd like a scalable pattern - ideally using attribute-based mapping rather than static group names. Is there documentation on this, or examples from other large customers?
answer: For deployments at your scale, we generally recommend attribute-based role mapping using a custom SAML attribute (e.g. department or role) rather than group-name matching, since it scales better across multiple IdPs and avoids re-mapping every time group naming changes. I'll send over our enterprise SSO mapping guide, which includes a walkthrough for multi-IdP setups, and I'd also suggest a short call with our solutions team to review your specific attribute schema before rollout.

subject: Request to adjust SSO session timeout duration
body:
Our analytics team is getting logged out of Northwind every 30 minutes, which is disrupting long dashboard sessions. I'd like to request that our SSO session timeout be extended to at least 2 hours if that's configurable on our side. Currently we're on the standard SAML integration with our identity provider, and I don't see a timeout setting in the admin console.

Could you let me know if this is adjustable, and if so, where in the settings we'd find it?
answer: Thanks for the feedback. Session timeout for SSO-authenticated users is currently tied to the SAML assertion lifetime set by your identity provider, so it's not directly configurable in the Northwind admin console yet. I'll log this as a feature request for admin-level session timeout controls, and in the meantime I can walk you through adjusting the assertion lifetime on your IdP side if you'd like.

subject: sync jobs failing
body: hey our scheduled syncs for the video metadata pipline have been failing since this morning, we have like 40 jobs that run every 15 min and about half of them are erroring out. the connector is the s3 to warehouse one, getting timeout errors and some rows just missing after the sync completes. this is affecting reporting for our whole media team, can someone look asap, we need this fixed today
answer: I'm escalating this immediately given the scope of impact on your reporting pipeline. Can you send me the job IDs for a few of the failed runs and the exact timeout error text you're seeing? That will let our pipeline team check connector logs on our end while we also verify there isn't a broader S3-to-warehouse connector issue affecting other customers right now.

subject: SSO role mapping not assigning correct permissions
body:
We recently configured SSO for Cobalt Travel and mapped our IdP groups to Northwind roles, but several users who should be assigned the 'Manager' role are landing in the default 'Viewer' role instead. This started after our last IdP group restructure on the 14th.

I've checked the attribute mapping in the admin console and the group names match what's documented, but the mapping still isn't applying correctly for about 5 of our 11 users. Could someone review our SAML attribute configuration and confirm what might be misaligned?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. Role mapping issues after an IdP group restructure are usually caused by a mismatch between the group attribute name sent in the SAML assertion and what's configured in Northwind's mapping rules. Could you send me a sample SAML response (with sensitive values redacted) for one of the affected users, so I can compare the exact attribute names and values against your current mapping configuration?

subject: SDK throwing 401 errors after recent update
body:
We updated to the latest Northwind API SDK version (v4.2.1) yesterday and now all our authenticated calls are failing with 401 Unauthorized, even though our API keys haven't changed. This is blocking our production integration entirely since we can't fetch or push any data right now.

Error we're seeing: 'AuthenticationError: token validation failed - deprecated auth header format'. We were previously using the X-Api-Key header method. Did something change with authentication in this SDK version?
answer: Sorry for the disruption this is causing. SDK v4.2.1 does deprecate the legacy X-Api-Key header in favor of Bearer token authentication via the Authorization header — this was documented in the changelog but I understand it can break existing integrations without warning. As a quick fix, you can pin back to v4.1.x while you migrate, or update your client initialization to use the new auth method; I'll send you a code snippet showing the change right away since this is blocking production.

subject: Urgent: need to extend retention policy before data purge
body:
I'm working on a legal hold request and just realized our storage retention policy is set to purge files older than 90 days, with the next scheduled purge running tonight. We have several case-related documents in the 'legal-archive' bucket that need to be preserved indefinitely until the hold is lifted.

Can someone help us pause the purge or apply a retention exception to that bucket before it runs? We can't afford to lose this data given the active legal matter.
answer: This is flagged as high priority on our end. I'm pausing the scheduled purge for your 'legal-archive' bucket right now while we set up a formal retention exception — can you confirm the exact bucket name and whether the hold should apply account-wide or just to that bucket? I'll follow up within the hour to confirm the exception is fully in place before tonight's purge window.

subject: Need bulk MFA enrolment rollout for 1800+ users
body:
We're rolling out mandatory MFA across Apex Robotics ahead of a compliance deadline next week and need to enroll roughly 1824 users efficiently. Manually walking each employee through enrolment isn't feasible on this timeline, and we're required to have this in place for a security audit.

Is there a way to bulk-provision MFA enrolment links or force enrolment on next login via SCIM or an admin API? We also want a report showing enrolment completion status per department for the audit.
answer: Given your compliance deadline, I'd recommend using our admin API's forced-enrolment flag, which prompts MFA setup on next login for all users flagged in a bulk update — this avoids manual per-user configuration. I'll send over the API documentation and a sample payload for batch-updating users today, and I can also set up a scheduled enrolment status export so you have department-level completion data ready for your audit.

subject: Pipeline transform step failing repeatedly
body:
Our data pipeline for daily energy usage reports has had its transform step fail 6 times over the past 2 days, each time with error 'TransformError: schema mismatch on column consumption_kwh - expected float, got string'. The source connector is our weather-and-usage CSV feed, and nothing in the source format has changed on our side recently.

This is delaying our daily reports to stakeholders, so I'd appreciate a quick look at what's causing the schema mismatch and whether it's on Northwind's end.
answer: Thanks for flagging this — a schema mismatch appearing without source changes on your end often points to an upstream connector parsing issue, possibly related to a recent update on our CSV connector. I'm pulling the transform logs for your pipeline now to check exactly which rows are triggering the type mismatch, and I'll follow up shortly with either a fix or a workaround so your daily reports aren't further delayed.

subject: Charged for upgrade but still seeing old plan features
body:
We upgraded from Pro to the higher tier plan last week to unlock the advanced forecasting feature, and our invoice dated the 3rd shows the new charge of the upgraded rate. However, when I log in, the dashboard still shows Pro-tier limits and the forecasting feature is greyed out for all 91 of our seats.

Can someone check why the upgrade isn't reflected in our account despite being billed for it?
answer: Apologies for the confusion — it looks like the billing update processed correctly but the corresponding feature entitlement flag on your account didn't sync over. I'm manually applying the correct plan tier to your account now, which should unlock forecasting within the next few minutes; please refresh and let me know if the feature is still greyed out after that.

subject: Push notifications crashing app for all users
body:
Since yesterday, our team has been experiencing crashes on the Northwind mobile app whenever a push notification is received, on both iOS and Android. The app closes immediately and sometimes fails to reopen without a full device restart. We have 20 seats total and this is affecting nearly everyone who has notifications enabled.

We rely on these push alerts for shift updates, so this is a significant problem for our operations. Can you investigate what changed recently?
answer: This has been escalated to our mobile team immediately given the impact across your team. As a temporary workaround, could you have affected users disable push notifications in the app settings until we identify the cause? We suspect this may be related to a recent notification payload change on our end, and I'll update you as soon as we have a root cause or a fix ready to deploy.

subject: PDF export cutting off charts on large dashboards
body:
When exporting our operations dashboard to PDF, any chart wider than the default layout gets cut off at the page edge instead of scaling to fit. This happens consistently on our 'Fleet Utilization' dashboard which has several wide bar charts. We're using the export feature via the API (export endpoint /v2/dashboards/{id}/export) rather than the UI.

It's not urgent, but it'd be great to get this fixed or at least know if there's a parameter we can pass to force fit-to-page scaling.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. Currently the export endpoint doesn't have a fit-to-page parameter, which explains the cutoff on wider charts — this is a known limitation we're planning to address. In the meantime, a workaround is to pass a custom page_size parameter set to a wider dimension in your export request, which should prevent the chart truncation until fit-to-page scaling is available.

subject: Audit log entries missing after deactivation event
body:
We deactivated 14 users from Cobalt Media's workspace this morning as part of a routine offboarding batch, and none of those deactivation events show up in the Admin Console audit log. The log just stops at 08:41 UTC even though we know deactivations continued past 10am. We rely on this log for our logistics compliance audits and this gap is a real problem.

Can someone confirm whether audit log ingestion is broken workspace-wide? We have 267 seats and need this resolved before our internal audit review on Friday.
answer:
Thank you for flagging this, and I understand the urgency given your audit timeline. We're seeing reports of a delay in audit log indexing tied to a backend service issue that started this morning, and I've escalated this to our platform team as an active incident affecting deactivation and settings events specifically. I'll update you within the next two hours with either a fix ETA or confirmation that historical events will backfill correctly.

In the meantime, please hold off on running your compliance export so we don't capture an incomplete dataset. I'll keep this ticket updated as we get more detail from engineering.

subject: Dashboards feel sluggish during peak hours
body:
Our operations team at Vertex Systems has noticed that several of our logistics dashboards take 8-10 seconds to load between 9am and 11am when most of our 160 users are logged in. It's not breaking anything, just annoying when we're trying to check shipment status boards in real time.

Is there a way to optimize widget loading or is this just a capacity thing on your end? Would appreciate any tips on structuring dashboards for better performance, or if this is something on your roadmap.
answer:
Thanks for the detailed feedback. Peak-hour slowdowns are usually tied to the number of live widgets querying large datasets simultaneously, so a good first step is reducing auto-refresh frequency on heavier widgets and using filtered views instead of full dataset pulls where possible. I'll also pass this along to our product team as a data point for dashboard performance improvements, since we are actively working on caching enhancements for high-concurrency accounts.

If you can share which specific dashboards feel slowest, I can take a closer look at their query load and suggest targeted optimizations.

subject: app wont open
body: App crashes every time I open it since yesterday. Just closes immediately.
answer: Sorry for the trouble this is causing. Could you tell me your device model and OS version, and whether you've tried reinstalling the app or checked for a pending update? I'll also check our crash logs on our end for your account to see if we can spot the cause directly while you gather those details.

subject: Need to restore files from backup before retention expires
body:
I'm the product manager at Harbor Academy and I need to restore a set of course material files that were accidentally deleted from our Storage workspace last week. We're on the Starter plan with a fairly tight quota, so I want to confirm the restore process won't count against our current upload limits.

Could you walk me through how to trigger a restore from backup, and let me know how far back our retention window goes? We'd like these files back before the semester starts next Monday.
answer:
Happy to help get these files back before your deadline. For Starter plan accounts, backups are retained for 30 days, so files deleted last week should still be recoverable. Restored files are pulled from backup storage and do count toward your regular quota once restored, so let me know roughly how much data you're recovering and I can check your current usage headroom.

To start the restore, go to Storage settings, select Backup History, and choose the date just before the deletion occurred. If you'd rather I initiate it on our end, just confirm the folder name and approximate deletion date and I'll get it moving today.

subject: Team locked out - MFA enrollment stuck for all users
body:
We're trying to enroll our team at Ember Academy in MFA ahead of a compliance deadline this week, but every user who scans the QR code gets an "enrollment failed, please try again" error immediately after entering their verification code. This is happening for all 6 of our seats, not just one person.

We use SSO through our identity provider and MFA enrollment worked fine for one test user last month, so something seems to have changed recently. We need this fixed urgently since our finance systems require MFA to be active by Friday.
answer:
I understand the urgency here given your compliance deadline, and I've marked this as high priority. This error pattern usually points to a clock sync issue between the authenticator app and our MFA service, or occasionally a provisioning conflict when SSO and MFA enrollment overlap. Can you confirm which identity provider you're using and send a screenshot of the exact error along with a timestamp of a recent failed attempt?

While I dig into the provisioning logs on our side, please have affected users double check their device time is set to automatic rather than manual, as that resolves a good portion of these cases. I'll follow up shortly with next steps.

subject: Push notifications not arriving on mobile app
body:
Several of our staff at Orion Energy have mentioned they stopped receiving push notifications from the mobile app over the past few days, even for urgent items that used to trigger alerts immediately. Nothing crashes, they just don't get notified at all, on both iOS and Android devices as far as I can tell.

We have 23 seats and I'd guess maybe a third of the team is affected. Nothing changed in our settings that I'm aware of. Any idea what could cause this?
answer:
Thanks for the report. This pattern usually traces back to notification permissions being reset after an OS update, or occasionally a device token expiring without re-registering properly. Could you have one or two affected users check that notifications are still enabled in their device settings for the app, and try logging out and back in to force a token refresh?

If that doesn't resolve it for everyone, let me know which app version and OS versions are affected and I'll check our delivery logs for those accounts specifically.

subject: Billing seat count wildly inaccurate on latest invoice
body:
Our latest invoice for Lumen Freight shows charges for 19 seats but we currently only have 12 active users in the workspace, and we've had 12 seats since the plan started. This is a significant overcharge and we need it corrected immediately, as finance is asking questions about the discrepancy.

Can someone confirm what happened here and issue a corrected invoice or refund for the difference? We need this resolved before our payment is due in three days.
answer:
I'm sorry for the confusion and I understand the urgency given your payment deadline. This looks like a seat count sync issue between your workspace and billing records, and I'm escalating this immediately to have it corrected. I'll verify your actual active seat count against your workspace roster and issue a corrected invoice reflecting the accurate 12-seat charge, along with a credit for the overcharge.

I'll have an update for you within one business day, well ahead of your payment due date, and will confirm once the corrected invoice is issued.

subject: API pagination returning duplicate records across pages
body:
We're pulling transaction data through the API Platform for Pioneer Analytics and noticed our pagination loop is returning duplicate records between page 3 and page 4 when using the cursor-based endpoint /v2/transactions. Roughly 40 records appear twice, which is throwing off our finance reconciliation reports.

We're using the standard SDK with a page size of 100 and sorting by created_at descending. This started happening sometime in the last week; previous pulls looked correct. Can you check if something changed with cursor handling recently?
answer:
Thank you for the detailed report, this is helpful for narrowing things down. Duplicate records across cursor boundaries usually indicate an issue with how the cursor handles records that share an identical created_at timestamp, which can happen more often with descending sort on high-volume tables. I'm checking whether a recent change to cursor stability was deployed in the last week that could explain this.

In the meantime, as a workaround, adding a secondary sort key such as record id alongside created_at should eliminate the duplicates. I'll confirm back within the day on whether this is a platform-side bug or expected behavior given the sort configuration.

subject: Question about invoice line item breakdown
body:
I'm reviewing our latest invoice for Summit Travel and I'd like to understand the breakdown better. The total looks correct for our 237 seats on the Pro plan, but the line items don't clearly separate the base subscription cost from any add-on charges, and I need this detail for our internal cost allocation report.

Could someone walk me through how the current invoice is itemized, or point me to a more detailed statement? Not urgent, just need it before month end.
answer:
Thanks for reaching out, happy to help clarify this. Our standard invoices summarize base subscription and add-ons into a single line by default, but we can generate a detailed itemized statement that separates each charge category for internal reporting purposes. I'll have that detailed breakdown prepared and sent to you within the next couple of business days, well ahead of your month-end deadline.

If there are specific add-ons or charge types you want called out separately, let me know and I'll make sure they're itemized accordingly.

subject: Dashboards loading very slowly for whole team
body:
As IT admin for North Robotics, I've been getting complaints from several of our 24 users that dashboards are taking upwards of 15 seconds to load, sometimes timing out entirely when trying to export to PDF. This has been going on for about a week and seems worse when multiple people try to view or export the same shared dashboard simultaneously.

We rely on these for daily media performance reporting so this is becoming a real bottleneck. Could you look into whether this is a known issue or something specific to our account setup?
answer:
Thanks for the detailed report, this sounds disruptive and I want to get to the bottom of it. Simultaneous exports on shared dashboards can create contention that slows rendering for everyone viewing that dashboard, and combined with larger datasets this can explain the timeouts you're seeing on PDF exports specifically. I'm pulling performance logs for your workspace now to check load times and export queue behavior over the past week.

As a short-term step, try staggering export requests rather than triggering them simultaneously across users, which should reduce contention while I investigate the underlying cause. I'll follow up with findings and any account-specific recommendations shortly.

subject: Audit log missing deactivation events after allowlist update
body: We deactivated 14 user accounts on Oct 3rd as part of an IP allowlist policy change, but the audit log under Admin Console > Compliance shows no corresponding entries for these deactivations. We rely on this log for our SOC 2 evidence collection due this week. Can you confirm whether this is a logging gap or a display issue? Affected account IDs range from usr_88213 through usr_88227.
answer: Thank you for flagging this - a gap in deactivation logging is a serious issue for compliance purposes and we're treating this as high priority. We've opened an internal incident and are checking whether this is a backend logging delay or a genuine gap in the audit pipeline; we'll confirm within the next few hours whether the missing entries can be backfilled. In the meantime, please export whatever partial audit trail you have from the Admin Console for your evidence package and we'll follow up as soon as we have root cause.

subject: Webhook signature verification failing after deprecation notice
body: We received an email that the v1 webhook signature scheme is being deprecated on Nov 15, but our integration still uses HMAC-SHA1 per the documentation at docs.northwind.cloud/webhooks/v1. Since yesterday, some webhook deliveries are failing verification with "signature_mismatch" even though we haven't changed anything on our end. Is the v1 scheme already being phased out early, or is this a separate bug?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. We're checking whether the v1 signature scheme was inadvertently rolled forward ahead of the Nov 15 date on our side, as that would explain the sudden mismatches without any change on your end. We'll also review the documentation you linked to make sure it reflects the correct rollout timeline, and will update you within one business day with findings and, if needed, a temporary workaround.

subject: Deactivated employee still listed in API allowlist
body: We deactivated a former employee's account (user ID usr_44210) on Monday through the Admin Console, but their API key is still active and appears in our IP allowlist under Settings > Security. They were able to make API calls yesterday afternoon after their account showed as deactivated. This is a compliance concern for us since we handle vendor contracts through the API.
answer: We understand the urgency here given the compliance implications. As an immediate step, please revoke the API key manually from Settings > Security > API Keys while we investigate why deactivation isn't automatically removing allowlist entries and revoking keys for usr_44210. We're looking into whether this is a sync delay or a gap in the deactivation workflow and will update you shortly with findings.

subject: Invoice seat count doesn't match active users
body: Our October invoice bills for 172 seats, but when I check Admin Console > Users we only have 160 active accounts. This is the second month in a row this has happened - September was also off by 9 seats. Can someone check why the billing seat count and the actual user count aren't matching? Invoice number INV-88431.
answer: Apologies for the discrepancy - a mismatch between active users and billed seats across two consecutive invoices shouldn't happen and we'll dig into this right away. We're pulling the seat sync history for your account against invoice INV-88431 and the September invoice to identify where the counts diverged, and if we confirm an overbilling error we'll issue a credit accordingly. We'll have an update for you within two business days.

subject: Zapier-Integration mit Jira und Salesforce einrichten
body: Wir möchten unsere Northwind-Workspace über Zapier mit Jira und Salesforce verbinden, um bei neuen Support-Tickets automatisch Aufgaben zu erstellen. Zusätzlich nutzen wir Okta für SSO - gibt es dabei etwas Besonderes zu beachten, damit die Zapier-Trigger nicht durch unsere SSO-Konfiguration blockiert werden? Eine kurze Anleitung oder ein Link zur Dokumentation würde uns schon helfen.
answer: Vielen Dank für Ihre Anfrage. Grundsätzlich funktioniert die Zapier-Integration unabhängig von Ihrer Okta-SSO-Konfiguration, solange Sie für die Zapier-Verbindung ein dediziertes API-Token statt eines SSO-Logins verwenden - das vermeidet Konflikte mit der Session-Verwaltung. Eine Schritt-für-Schritt-Anleitung für die Verknüpfung mit Jira und Salesforce finden Sie unter Integrations > Zapier in Ihrem Admin Console; falls Sie dort nicht weiterkommen, senden wir Ihnen gerne eine detaillierte Anleitung per E-Mail.

subject: Wiederherstellung von Dateien aus Backup benötigt
body: Wir haben am 28.09. versehentlich einen Storage-Bucket mit Patientendokumenten gelöscht (ca. 3.200 Dateien, Bucket "granite-docs-prod"). Laut unserem Vertrag beträgt die Backup-Aufbewahrung 30 Tage - können Sie uns bei der Wiederherstellung auf den Stand vom 27.09. unterstützen? Es handelt sich um einen dringenden Fall, da wir gesetzliche Aufbewahrungspflichten einhalten müssen.
answer: Wir verstehen die Dringlichkeit und leiten die Wiederherstellung für den Bucket "granite-docs-prod" auf den Stand vom 27.09. umgehend an unser Storage-Team weiter. Da die 30-tägige Aufbewahrungsfrist eingehalten wird, sollte die Wiederherstellung möglich sein; wir melden uns innerhalb der nächsten Stunden mit einem Zeitplan und bestätigen, sobald die Dateien wieder verfügbar sind.

subject: SDK v2 deprecation breaking rate limit handling
body: After upgrading per the deprecation notice for SDK v2 (end of life Dec 1), our webhook retry logic is hitting HTTP 429 responses far more often than before - we're seeing about 40 rate-limit errors per hour since switching to SDK v3 on Monday. The migration guide doesn't mention any change to rate limit thresholds. Can someone confirm if limits changed with this release, or if there's a config issue on our end?
answer: Thanks for the detailed numbers - a jump to 40 rate-limit errors per hour right after the SDK v3 switch suggests something changed in how retries or backoff are handled in the new SDK, and we want to get this resolved quickly given your production dependency. We're checking whether the default retry/backoff behavior or rate limit tier changed between v2 and v3, and we'll follow up shortly with either a config fix or an update to the migration guide.

subject: Push notifications delayed after app reconnects offline
body: Our field technicians use the Northwind mobile app on tablets that frequently lose connectivity in our manufacturing plants. When the app reconnects after being offline, queued push notifications for shift approvals don't come through until the user manually reopens the app. Can this be changed so notifications are delivered reliably on reconnect? This is affecting all 20 of our field users daily.
answer: Thanks for the clear description - reliable delivery on reconnect is definitely something we want to improve for offline-heavy environments like yours. We're logging this as a change request for the mobile push queue behavior so notifications trigger automatically on reconnect rather than requiring the app to be reopened, and we'll loop in our mobile team to scope the fix. We'll keep you posted on timeline and will let you know if there's an interim workaround in the meantime.

subject: Dringend: API-Deprecation betrifft unsere Produktion
body: Wir haben die Ankündigung erhalten, dass die API v1 Endpunkte zum 30.11. abgeschaltet werden, inklusive der von uns genutzten Rate-Limit-Header. Unser gesamtes Abrechnungssystem läuft noch auf dem alten SDK v1 und wir haben aktuell keine Kapazität, kurzfristig auf v2 zu migrieren. Können Sie uns eine Übergangsfrist einräumen oder zumindest eine detaillierte Migrationsanleitung inklusive SDK-Beispielcode zusenden? Wir haben nur 6 Lizenzen und ein sehr kleines Entwicklerteam.
answer: Vielen Dank für Ihre Nachricht - da dies Ihre Produktionsumgebung betrifft, geben wir dem Anliegen höchste Priorität. Wir prüfen intern, ob für Kunden mit begrenzten Entwicklerkapazitäten eine verlängerte Übergangsfrist über den 30.11. hinaus möglich ist, und stellen Ihnen parallel eine ausführliche Migrationsanleitung mit SDK-v2-Codebeispielen zur Verfügung. Wir melden uns innerhalb der nächsten 24 Stunden mit einem konkreten Vorschlag.

subject: Performance regression after API v1 deprecation warning
body: I noticed the deprecation notice for API v1 endpoints and started testing our reporting scripts against v2 in a staging environment. Response times for the /analytics/query endpoint went from around 400ms average to over 2 seconds with the same payload size, and we're seeing occasional webhook retries logged as well. Wanted to flag this before we fully migrate - is this expected during the transition or a known issue with v2?
answer: Thanks for testing this ahead of the migration and reporting it - that's a helpful catch. A jump from 400ms to over 2 seconds on /analytics/query in v2 isn't expected behavior, so we'll investigate whether there's a query optimization or caching difference between the two versions. We'll follow up with findings and, if this turns out to be a known issue, we'll let you know if there's a workaround or fix timeline before your migration deadline.

subject: Push notifications not arriving after app is closed for a while
body:
We're rolling out the Mobile App to our 16 staff at Summit Labs and noticed push notifications stop arriving on Android devices once the app has been in the background for more than a couple of hours. Users have to reopen the app to get any updates. This is a training environment so timely notifications matter for our coordinators.

Could you confirm whether there's a background refresh setting we're missing, or if this is a known limitation? Happy to share device models if useful.
answer: Thanks for flagging this - background push delivery issues are usually tied to Android's battery optimization settings rather than a Northwind-side limitation. Could you check whether the affected devices have battery saver or 'restrict background activity' enabled for the Mobile App, and let us know the Android versions in use? In the meantime, I'll pull our push delivery logs for your workspace over the last week to see if we can spot any dropped notifications on our end.

subject: Need to add seats mid-cycle and understand proration
body:
Orion Energy is growing our team and we need to move from 23 seats to 30 seats on our Starter plan before end of month. I want to understand how proration works for the remaining days in this billing cycle and whether the new seats bill immediately or roll into next month's invoice.

This is somewhat urgent since we have new hires starting Monday who need access. Can someone walk me through the process or process the seat increase for us directly?
answer: Thanks for reaching out, and congratulations on the growth. When you add seats mid-cycle on the Starter plan, we prorate the additional seats for the remaining days in the current billing period, and that prorated amount appears on your next invoice along with the full charge for the new seat count going forward.
