I can process the increase to 30 seats on our end right now so your new hires have access Monday - just confirm and I'll action it today.

subject: Request to add additional IP ranges to allowlist
body: We're integrating our internal build servers with the Northwind API and need to add two new IP ranges to our Admin Console allowlist: 203.0.113.0/24 and 198.51.100.0/24. Currently only our office range is listed. Can you confirm the process for adding these, and whether changes take effect immediately or require a propagation window?
answer: Adding IP ranges is done directly from Admin Console under Settings > Security > IP Allowlist - you can add both CIDR ranges there and they typically take effect within a few minutes. If you'd rather have us apply the change on our side, send over the exact ranges and we'll add them and confirm once live, along with a note in the audit log for your records.

subject: Seat count mismatch - being charged for more than we use
body: Granite Freight is on the Starter plan and our last invoice shows 23 seats, but when I check our workspace only 18 people actually have active accounts. This is the second month this has happened and it's affecting our budget approval for next quarter. Can someone explain why the seat count isn't syncing with actual active users, and adjust our billing accordingly?
answer: I'm sorry for the discrepancy and the impact on your budgeting - let me look into this right away. Seat counts should reflect active users only, so a mismatch like this usually points to deactivated accounts still being counted or a sync delay between account status and billing. I'm pulling your workspace's user list against the last two invoices now and will follow up today with a corrected count and any credit adjustment needed.

subject: Migrating to cursor-based pagination before offset deprecation
body: We're preparing to migrate our reporting integration from offset-based pagination to cursor-based pagination ahead of the deprecation notice we received for the /v2/transactions endpoint. Our current SDK version (3.4.1) doesn't seem to expose a cursor parameter in its list methods - can you confirm which SDK version introduces this, and whether webhook payloads will also change format?
answer: Good timing - cursor-based pagination support for /v2/transactions was introduced in SDK version 3.6.0, so you'll want to upgrade from 3.4.1 to at least that release. Webhook payload structures are unaffected by this change, only the list endpoint response and request parameters differ. I'll also send over our migration guide with example requests so your team can validate the cutover before the offset method is fully retired.

subject: SAML login failing for entire org since this morning
body: Starting around 8:40am today, every user at Lumen Legal attempting SSO login gets redirected back to our identity provider with an error 'SAML response signature validation failed.' We haven't changed any certificates or metadata on our IdP side recently. This is blocking all 137 seats from accessing the platform, including our legal team who need to file documents by end of day.
answer: This is a critical issue and we're escalating it immediately. A signature validation failure like this usually points to a certificate rotation or metadata mismatch on either side - can you confirm the exact timestamp of your last IdP metadata update? In parallel, I'm checking our side for any certificate expiry on your SSO configuration and will update you within the hour with findings or a workaround so your team can log in.

subject: Recurring card decline - need refund process clarified
body: Our company card on file for Pioneer Partners was declined for last month's invoice, and we've since updated the payment method. The invoice was eventually paid via bank transfer but I noticed a small late fee was applied. Can you walk me through how refunds work for late fees when the delay was due to a card issue on our end, and confirm if there's documentation on this process?
answer: Thanks for the update, and for getting the payment sorted via bank transfer. Late fees tied to failed card charges can be reviewed case by case, especially for a first occurrence - I've flagged your account for a refund of the late fee and it should reflect within 3-5 business days. I'll also send you a link to our billing documentation that covers payment retry timing and fee policies for future reference.

subject: SSO users landing with wrong permission level
body: We set up SSO for North Retail last week and most of our 7 users are logging in fine, but two team members are getting mapped to a 'Viewer' role instead of the 'Editor' role they should have based on their IdP group membership. Their group attribute in the SAML assertion looks correct on our side when I checked the logs. Any guidance on troubleshooting role mapping in the Identity and SSO settings?
answer: Thanks for the detailed check on your end - since the assertion looks correct, this is likely a mapping rule issue in our Identity and SSO settings rather than your IdP config. Can you confirm the exact group attribute name and value being sent for those two users? I'll compare it against your configured role mapping rules in the console and let you know if the rule needs adjusting or if there's a case-sensitivity mismatch.

subject: Offline mode crashing app and losing entered data
body: Since yesterday, our analysts at Pioneer Foods have had the Mobile App crash whenever they try to sync data collected while offline. The app force-closes right at the sync step, and when we reopen it the offline entries from that session are gone. This has happened on three separate devices now and we've lost a full day of field data entries. We need this fixed urgently as our team relies on offline capture daily.
answer: I'm sorry to hear about the lost data, this is a serious issue and we're treating it as top priority. Can you send us the device models, OS versions, and approximate timestamps of the crashes so our mobile team can pull crash logs immediately? In the meantime, please ask your team to avoid clearing app data or reinstalling, as we may be able to recover unsynced entries from local cache once we identify the cause.

subject: Audit log missing entries for allowlist changes
body: While reviewing our security settings for Granite Academy, I noticed that changes made to the IP allowlist in Admin Console over the past week aren't showing up in the audit log at all. We made three updates - adding a range on the 3rd, removing one on the 5th, and adding another on the 7th - but the log only shows the removal. This is concerning for our compliance reporting.
answer: Thank you for catching this - missing audit entries for allowlist changes shouldn't happen, and we want to get to the bottom of it before it affects your compliance reporting. Can you confirm the exact account that made the two missing changes and roughly what time they occurred? I'll check our logging pipeline for gaps around those timestamps and follow up with either the recovered entries or a root cause explanation.

subject: Recurring card failures on our Starter plan invoice
body: I'm the data analyst here at Cobalt Travel and I've noticed our last two invoices show failed card charges on the 3rd and the 17th, both declined with code 'insufficient_funds' even though the card has a healthy balance. We have 11 seats on the Starter plan and want to avoid a service interruption. Could you check whether this is a processor issue on your end, and let us know if a refund is needed for any duplicate attempt?
answer: Thanks for flagging this - I checked your billing account and see the two declined attempts you mentioned; our processor logs show the issuing bank returned a soft decline both times, which can happen with velocity checks on repeated retries. I've cleared the retry lock on our end so the next charge attempt should go through cleanly, and no duplicate charge was made so no refund is needed. If the next attempt fails too, let us know and we'll update the card on file manually.

subject: Need to restrict dashboard sharing to specific teams
body: We're rolling out a production-line dashboard at Harbor Energy and right now anyone with the link can view it, including outside our 4-seat workspace. I need to restrict sharing so only our operations and quality teams can access it, ideally with view-only export rights for one manager. The current sharing panel only gives an on/off toggle for 'anyone with link' and doesn't let me pick groups.
answer: Thanks for the details - group-level sharing controls are available on our dashboard permissions panel, but it looks like the toggle you're seeing is the legacy link-sharing option. I'll enable the granular sharing feature for your workspace so you can assign view or export access by team, and I'll follow up within the next business day once it's live so you can configure the operations and quality groups.

subject: Scheduled sync connector exposing data to wrong workspace

subject: Bulk deactivation process for departing users
body:
We're onboarding a new HR system and need to deactivate around 40 user accounts from a store closure in our Orion Travel retail division. I'd like to understand the recommended workflow in the Admin Console for bulk deactivation versus doing it one by one, since we have 150 seats total and want to avoid errors.

Also curious if deactivated users show up differently in the audit log versus deleted users, since we need to keep records for compliance.
answer: Good question — for bulk operations like this, the Admin Console supports CSV upload under Users > Bulk Actions > Deactivate, which lets you deactivate up to 500 accounts in one pass. Deactivated users remain visible in the audit log with a status change event and retain their historical activity records, whereas deleted users are fully removed after the retention window, so deactivation is the right choice for compliance purposes here.

subject: PDF export missing chart labels and cut off on right side
body:
I'm building a dashboard for one of our Ember Partners clients and when I export it to PDF, the bar chart labels on the x-axis get truncated and the legend on the right side of the page is cut off entirely. This happens consistently on our quarterly enrollment dashboard, which has 6 charts and normally displays fine in-browser.

Could you point me to documentation on export formatting, or is there a setting to force landscape orientation? We need to share this report with a client by Friday.
answer: Thanks for the detailed description — this is a known issue with wide dashboards defaulting to portrait export. Under Export Settings, there's a Layout dropdown where you can select Landscape and also enable 'Fit to width,' which should resolve both the truncated labels and the cut-off legend. I've linked our export formatting guide in a follow-up email, and if the issue persists after switching orientation, please send us the dashboard ID so we can take a closer look.

subject: MFA enrollment fails with error during SSO setup
body:
I'm trying to enroll in MFA through our SSO login for Northwind and keep hitting an error that says 'Unable to verify device, please contact your administrator' right after scanning the QR code with our authenticator app. This started happening yesterday for me and one other analyst on our team, and we're both locked out of the Identity dashboard as a result.

Our admin didn't change any SSO configuration recently that I'm aware of. Can someone check our tenant settings for Orion Academy?
answer: Sorry for the trouble this is causing — I can see the enrollment failures on our end starting yesterday afternoon for your tenant. This looks related to a device trust policy that may have been toggled during a recent permissions update; I'm escalating this to our SSO team now to check your tenant configuration directly. In the meantime, I'll follow up within the next few hours with either a fix or a temporary bypass so you and your colleague can regain access.

subject: PLAN UPGRADE PROCESS AND INVOICE QUESTIONS
body:
WE NEED TO UPGRADE FROM OUR CURRENT ENTERPRISE PLAN TIER TO ADD MORE ADVANCED REPORTING FEATURES FOR OUR LEGAL TEAM. WE CURRENTLY HAVE 588 SEATS AND WANT TO KNOW IF UPGRADING MID-CYCLE WILL GENERATE A SEPARATE INVOICE OR GET ROLLED INTO OUR EXISTING BILLING DATE.

ALSO PLEASE CONFIRM WHETHER SEAT COUNT STAYS THE SAME DURING AN UPGRADE OR IF WE NEED TO RE-ADD USERS MANUALLY. WOULD APPRECIATE A CALL BACK OR DETAILED WRITE-UP.
answer: Thanks for reaching out about the upgrade — happy to clarify. Mid-cycle upgrades are prorated and rolled into your existing billing date rather than generating a separate invoice, so you'll simply see the adjusted amount on your next statement. Your seat count of 588 will carry over automatically with no need to re-add users; once you confirm you'd like to proceed, I can trigger the upgrade on our end and send a written summary of the new feature set included.

subject: Duplicate notification emails going to end users
body:
Several of our care coordinators have reported receiving the same appointment reminder notification twice within a few minutes of each other. We've confirmed this is happening across at least a dozen accounts over the past week, not just isolated cases, and it's causing confusion among staff about which reminder to act on.

We'd like to request a fix or at least understand what's triggering the duplication so we can advise our team on what to expect in the meantime.
answer: Thank you for flagging this and for the details on scope — duplicate sends like this are usually caused by a retry mechanism firing when the initial delivery confirmation is delayed rather than lost. I'm opening an investigation into your notification queue logs for the past week to confirm the pattern, and will follow up with either a resolution or a workaround for your team within a few business days.

subject: Request to extend SSO session timeout duration
body:
Our staff frequently get logged out mid-task due to the current session timeout on SSO logins, which seems to be set around 15 minutes of inactivity. With 3,651 seats across multiple campuses, this is generating a steady stream of helpdesk tickets from users re-authenticating throughout the day.

Could we get the timeout extended to something like 60 minutes, or better yet, have this be a configurable setting in our admin panel tied to specific permission groups?
answer: This is a reasonable request and one we can accommodate — session timeout duration is configurable at the tenant level, and I can adjust yours to 60 minutes on request. For more granular control tied to specific permission groups, that's on our roadmap but not yet available; I'll log your interest as a feature request and let you know when group-level session policies become available.

subject: Late-arriving data breaking downstream dashboards
body:
We're seeing a recurring issue where data from our media asset pipeline arrives 4-6 hours late compared to its expected window, which is causing our downstream dashboards to show incomplete numbers for the previous day until early afternoon. This has happened on at least 5 of the last 7 business days, and today's delay is currently sitting at over 5 hours for the pipeline feeding our content-performance reports.

This is actively affecting decisions our editorial team makes each morning, so we need to understand whether this is a Northwind-side processing delay or something upstream.
answer: Thank you for the detailed timeline, and I understand the urgency given the impact on your editorial workflow. I'm escalating this immediately to our pipeline operations team to check for processing backlogs or upstream ingestion delays on our end — we've seen intermittent queue congestion affecting a subset of pipelines this week. I'll update you within the next couple of hours with findings and an ETA for resolution.

subject: SAML login completely broken for all users since this morning
body:
Since around 8am today, every user attempting to log in via SAML SSO gets redirected back to our identity provider with an error stating 'invalid_signature' before reaching the Northwind dashboard. This is affecting our entire workforce of 3,314 seats across Willow Analytics and nobody can access the platform right now.

We haven't made any changes to our IdP configuration or certificates recently. This is blocking all of our teams from starting their workday and needs urgent attention.
answer: I understand the severity here and we're treating this as a critical incident. Invalid signature errors typically point to a certificate mismatch, and I can see your SAML metadata may have rotated on our side during a scheduled security update overnight — I'm escalating to our identity engineering team right now to verify and restore the correct certificate binding for your tenant. I'll update you within the next 30 minutes with either a fix or an interim workaround.

subject: Rollenzuordnung schlägt fehl – Sicherheitsvorfall bei API-Integration
body:
Wir binden gerade die Northwind Identity API in unser internes System ein und haben festgestellt, dass bei der Rollenzuordnung (Role Mapping) Benutzer mit der Rolle 'viewer' fälschlicherweise Admin-Berechtigungen erhalten. Das ist seit heute Morgen der Fall und betrifft alle 16 Nutzer unseres Orion Freight Tenants.

Da dies ein potenzielles Sicherheitsrisiko darstellt, benötigen wir dringend Hilfe. Können Sie uns sagen, ob dies an einer fehlerhaften Konfiguration unseres Provisioning-Endpunkts liegt oder ob es sich um einen Fehler auf Ihrer Seite handelt?
answer: Vielen Dank für die schnelle Meldung – wir behandeln dies als kritischen Sicherheitsvorfall mit höchster Priorität. Wir sperren vorübergehend die betroffenen Admin-Berechtigungen für Ihren Tenant, während unser Security-Team die Rollenzuordnungslogik in Ihrer Provisioning-Konfiguration überprüft. Wir melden uns innerhalb der nächsten 30 Minuten mit einem ersten Ergebnis und weiteren Schritten.

subject: Best practice for handling transform failures in pipeline
body:
We run a nightly transform on our inventory feed from the ERP connector, and about once a week a batch fails with a schema mismatch on the SKU field. I can see the failed run in the pipeline history but I'd like to understand the recommended way to set up a dead-letter path or retry rule so these records don't just silently drop.

Is there documentation on configuring data quality rules per connector step? We're on the manufacturing feed connector and would like to add validation before the transform stage rather than after.
answer: Thanks for reaching out. We have a guide on configuring pre-transform validation rules and dead-letter routing for connector steps that covers exactly this scenario - I'll send the link along with a short walkthrough for setting a retry policy on schema mismatches. For the SKU field specifically, adding a type-check rule before the transform stage should catch these before they fail downstream.

subject: Hitting rate limits on order webhook endpoint
body:
Since yesterday around 2pm we've been getting 429 responses on our /orders/webhook calls during peak checkout hours, roughly 40-50 failures per hour. We're on the retail integration syncing order status back to our POS system across 79 seats, and this is causing delayed status updates for store staff.

Can you confirm the current rate limit tier for our account and whether there's a documented way to request a temporary increase or batch these calls? Also noticed the webhook retry docs mention a deprecated endpoint version - want to make sure we're not still pointed at that.
answer: I'm sorry for the disruption this is causing during your peak hours. I've checked your account and confirmed you're on the standard Pro tier rate limit; I'm escalating a temporary increase request now and will follow up within a few hours with a decision. In the meantime, please check that your webhook URL is pointed at the current API version, since the older endpoint you mentioned is deprecated and has a lower ceiling - that could explain part of the throttling.

subject: Workspace settings not saving audit log allowlist
body:
I tried adding two new IP ranges to our workspace allowlist under Admin Console settings this morning, saved the change, but when I reopen the settings page the ranges aren't there. The audit log does show an entry for the update, so it seems like the write happened but the settings page isn't reflecting it.

This is on our finance workspace with 4 seats. Not urgent since we haven't deactivated the old ranges yet, but wanted to flag it before we rely on this for access control.
answer: Thank you for the detailed report - that's a helpful clue that the audit log shows the write while the settings view doesn't refresh. This looks like a display caching issue rather than a failed save. Could you try a hard refresh or a different browser to confirm the ranges are actually applied, and let us know the result so we can pass this to engineering with the audit log timestamp?

subject: Seat count wrong after plan upgrade
body:
We upgraded from Starter to add two more seats last week, and the invoice generated on the 14th still shows only 5 seats at the old rate instead of 7. I went through the upgrade flow in billing settings and got a confirmation screen, but the seat count in our account overview also still says 5.

Can someone check whether the upgrade actually went through on the backend? We need the invoice corrected before it's due.
answer: Thanks for flagging this - I can see the upgrade request was submitted on your account but it looks like it stalled before updating the seat count and invoice. I'm correcting the seat total to 7 now and will regenerate the invoice with the prorated amount; you should see the updated version within the next business day.

subject: Request to add offline mode support for field teams
body:
Our legal review teams often work in facilities with poor connectivity, and right now the mobile app just shows a blank screen or spinning loader when there's no signal. We'd like to request proper offline mode where cached documents and case notes stay accessible, with changes syncing once connectivity returns.

We're rolling this app out to 122 users and this is becoming a recurring complaint. Is offline support on the roadmap, and if so what's the expected timeline?
answer: Thank you for the detailed use case - this is genuinely useful for prioritization. Offline caching for documents and notes is on our roadmap, and I'll log your account's specific need (poor-connectivity field sites, 122 users) against that feature request so product can factor in the urgency. I don't have a firm date yet, but I'll update this ticket as soon as we have a timeline to share.

subject: Rollenzuordnung bei SSO-Login funktioniert nicht korrekt
body:
Wir haben SSO über unseren Identity Provider eingerichtet und versuchen, Benutzerrollen anhand von Gruppenattributen zuzuordnen. Leider werden neue Nutzer nach dem Login immer der Standardrolle zugewiesen, unabhängig von ihrer AD-Gruppe. Wir haben das Attribut-Mapping in den SSO-Einstellungen wie in der Anleitung beschrieben konfiguriert.

Können Sie uns helfen zu verstehen, ob das Rollen-Mapping zusätzliche MFA-Einstellungen benötigt oder ob es einen bekannten Fehler bei der Gruppenzuordnung gibt? Wir haben aktuell 108 Nutzer, die betroffen sein könnten.
answer: Vielen Dank für die genaue Beschreibung. Das Verhalten deutet darauf hin, dass das Gruppenattribut vom Identity Provider nicht im erwarteten Format übermittelt wird - können Sie uns einen Beispiel-SAML-Response-Ausschnitt oder die Attributnamen zusenden, die Ihr Provider sendet? Wir prüfen dann das Mapping auf unserer Seite und melden uns zeitnah, da dies mehrere Nutzer betrifft.

subject: PDF export from dashboard cutting off charts and timing out
body:
One of our large customer accounts is reporting that exporting their quarterly dashboard to PDF either times out after about 90 seconds or produces a PDF with the last two charts cut off entirely. This is on a dashboard with around 15 widgets, mostly time-series and bar charts, shared with external stakeholders.

This is affecting their board reporting cycle this week so I'm escalating on their behalf. Can someone look at export performance for large dashboards, or is there a workaround like exporting in sections?
answer: Thanks for escalating this - dashboards with that many widgets are known to strain our current export renderer, so this tracks with what we're seeing on our end. As an immediate workaround, splitting the dashboard into two export batches (say, the first 8 widgets and the rest) should avoid the timeout; I'm also flagging this internally as a performance issue given the reporting deadline this week and will update you once we have a permanent fix.

subject: Need to change retention policy before storage quota hits
body:
We're at 88% of our storage quota and most of it is old uploaded media files from over a year ago that we no longer need. I'd like to set up a retention rule to auto-delete or archive files older than 12 months, but I can't find where to configure retention periods per folder rather than account-wide.

We're uploading new content daily for our media library and don't want uploads to start failing. Can you help set this up or point me to the right settings, and let me know if this will impact upload performance while it processes?
answer: Thanks for getting ahead of this before you hit the quota. Retention policies currently apply at the account level rather than per folder, but I can help configure a 12-month auto-archive rule that targets media types matching your older uploads while your active content stays untouched. Running the initial archive pass may cause a brief slowdown on uploads during processing, so I'd recommend scheduling it outside your peak upload hours.

subject: URGENT: connector auth failing, sync completely down
body:
Our data pipeline connector to our fintech data warehouse started failing auth at 6:40am today with error 'invalid_grant: token expired or revoked' on every sync attempt since. We haven't rotated any credentials on our end. This has stopped all our nightly reconciliation syncs from running, and we have compliance reports due today that depend on this data being current.

Log snippet:
Connector: warehouse-sync-prod
Error: 401 invalid_grant
Retry attempts: 6, all failed
Last successful sync: yesterday 23:10 UTC

We need this fixed urgently, this is blocking downstream reporting for our whole team.
answer: This is being treated as urgent on our side given the impact to your compliance reporting. Token revocation like this usually points to an OAuth refresh token expiring or being invalidated upstream by the warehouse provider - we're checking the connector's token store now and will have you re-authenticate the connection if needed. I'll update this ticket within the hour with either a fix or next steps; please don't retry the sync manually in the meantime so we don't generate more failed attempts in the logs.

subject: Zapier-Integration synct keine Daten mehr zu Salesforce
body:
Seit gestern funktioniert unser Zap, der neue Tickets aus Northwind an Salesforce weiterleitet, nicht mehr. In Zapier sehe ich den Task als erfolgreich markiert, aber in Salesforce werden keine neuen Datensätze angelegt. Wir nutzen auch Verbindungen zu Slack und Jira, die scheinen aber normal zu funktionieren.

Wir haben in den letzten Tagen nichts an den Zap-Einstellungen geändert. Können Sie prüfen, ob es auf Northwind-Seite ein Problem mit der API-Antwort für den Zapier-Trigger gibt? Das betrifft aktuell unser gesamtes Team mit 39 Nutzern.
answer: Danke für den Hinweis. Da Zapier den Task als erfolgreich meldet, aber die Daten nicht in Salesforce ankommen, vermuten wir ein Problem in der Antwortstruktur unseres Trigger-Endpoints, das Zapier fälschlich als Erfolg interpretiert. Wir prüfen die Trigger-Logs der letzten 48 Stunden auf Ihrem Account und melden uns mit einem Zwischenstand, sobald wir die Ursache eingegrenzt haben.

subject: Deactivated user still showing as active in Admin Console
body: We deactivated a former employee (user ID ends in -7841) from the Admin Console yesterday around 3pm, but they still appear as active in the audit log and the allowlist still shows their device. I need to confirm they no longer have access before I report this to our security team. Can someone check if this is a caching issue on your side or if we missed a step in the settings?
answer: Thanks for flagging this - I've checked the account and confirmed the deactivation was processed correctly on our backend at 3:02pm, but I can see the audit log UI had a display delay that's now resolved. The allowlist entry tied to that device has also been cleared. Please refresh the console and let me know if the user still shows as active so we can escalate further.

subject: Multiple failed card charges this morning
body: Our billing card was declined three times today for our Starter plan renewal, and now I'm getting a banner saying our account is at risk of suspension. We have 8 seats active and can't afford downtime for our small team. The card is valid and has plenty of credit - can someone tell me why Northwind is rejecting it and how to avoid losing access?
answer: I'm sorry for the disruption - I can see the three declined attempts on our end, each returning a generic issuer decline code rather than an insufficient funds error, which suggests your bank may be blocking the charge as unrecognized. I've paused the suspension timer for 48 hours so your team keeps access, and I'd recommend contacting your card issuer to whitelist Northwind Cloud, or you can add a backup payment method under Billing > Payment Methods in the meantime.

subject: Requesting itemized invoices for last two quarters
body: For our internal accounting review, I need itemized invoices for our Starter plan covering the last two billing quarters. The summary invoices we download only show a single line total and our finance team needs a breakdown by seat and any add-ons. Could you point me to where I can get these, or generate them on your end?
answer: Happy to help - itemized invoices with per-seat breakdowns aren't available for self-download on the Starter plan currently, but I can generate the last two quarters manually and send them over within the next business day. I'll also pass along your feedback about adding this as a self-service option, since it's a reasonable request for accounting purposes.

subject: Best practice for extending SSO session timeout
body: Our analysts keep getting logged out of Identity and SSO every 30 minutes while working with large datasets in the dashboard, which interrupts long analysis sessions. I'd like to understand what session timeout options are configurable at the org level and whether there's documentation on adjusting idle timeout versus absolute session length for our 452 seats.
answer: Good question - session timeout settings are configurable under Identity and SSO > Session Policies, where you can set idle timeout separately from the absolute session lifetime. I'll send over our admin documentation link that walks through recommended values for analytics-heavy workflows, and note that changes here apply org-wide so you may want to test with a small group first.

subject: Biometric login failing for most mobile users since this morning
body: Starting around 8am today, biometric login on the mobile app has been failing for a large portion of our 265 users, forcing everyone back to password entry. Several people report the app freezes for a few seconds before the fallback prompt appears, and a few have lost access to offline documents they were mid-review on. Given we're a legal firm this is disrupting active casework - please escalate.
answer: This has been escalated to our mobile team as a priority incident given the scope of impact. We've identified a regression tied to a push notification token refresh introduced in the latest build that's interfering with biometric session validation, and a fix is being tested now. In the meantime, users can log in with password without losing offline document access, and we'll update you within a few hours with a rollout timeline.

subject: Audit log missing entries after settings change
body: We updated our deactivation policy settings last week to auto-deactivate users after 90 days of inactivity, and since then the audit log seems to be missing entries for at least four users who were auto-deactivated on October 3rd. We rely on this log for our compliance reporting, so gaps here are a real problem for our 114-seat workspace.
answer: Thank you for the detailed report - this looks like a logging gap specific to auto-deactivation events triggered by the new inactivity policy, rather than manual deactivations. I've opened a ticket with our platform team to backfill the missing entries for October 3rd and confirm the audit pipeline captures this event type going forward. I'll follow up once the backfill is complete.

subject: Need to restore files from backup after accidental bulk delete
body: One of our team members accidentally deleted a large batch of project files from Storage this afternoon, around 450 files total. I see we have backups enabled but I can't find a clear restore option in the current interface - only a quota usage graph. Can you walk me through the restore process, or restore this batch for us directly? This is affecting active client deliverables.
answer: I understand the urgency and I'm looking into this now. Restore from backup is available under Storage > Backups > Restore Point, where you can select the snapshot from before the deletion, but given the batch size I'd like to run this restore on our end to avoid any quota conflicts. I'll confirm within the hour once the restore is complete and verified.

subject: Alert routing sending duplicate emails to wrong distribution list
body: Since yesterday, our Notifications setup has been sending every alert twice, and both copies are going to a distribution list we retired last month instead of the current on-call list. We've configured routing rules correctly as far as I can tell, but something is still pulling the old list. This is causing confusion across our 16-seat team and we need it fixed quickly.
answer: Thanks for reporting this - we've found a stale routing rule cache that was still referencing the retired distribution list, which also explains the duplicate sends. I'm clearing the cache and re-validating your current routing configuration now, and I'll confirm with a test alert once it's resolved, likely within the next hour.

subject: STORAGE QUOTA BLOCKING UPLOADS AND NO ONE IS RESPONDING FAST ENOUGH
body: We are completely blocked. Our storage quota hit its limit two days ago and every upload attempt fails instantly with a quota exceeded error. We only have 4 seats on this Starter plan but our retention policy requires us to keep semester records and now we cannot upload anything. I have asked twice already and gotten no real answer, this is unacceptable for an education account depending on Northwind for compliance records.
answer: I apologize for the delay and the impact this is having on your compliance records. I've temporarily raised your storage quota by 20% right now so uploads can resume immediately while we review a longer-term plan adjustment given your retention requirements. Please try uploading again and let me know if you still see the quota exceeded error - I'll stay on this until it's fully resolved.

subject: Scheduled sync issue
body:
We've been running our data pipeline connectors for a few months now without major issues, mostly pulling case management records into our dashboard for reporting. Our team relies heavily on these nightly syncs to keep client billing data accurate across our 208-seat workspace, and we've recently added two new connectors for document management systems.

The actual problem is that three of our scheduled syncs failed silently over the last two nights - no error notification, no log entry, just missing data in the destination tables. We only noticed because a report showed stale numbers this morning. Can you help us figure out why these failures aren't being flagged and recover the missing sync data?
answer: Thank you for the detailed context - silent sync failures without alerting are a serious gap and I'm treating this as high priority. I'm pulling the connector logs for the last two nights now to identify why these three syncs didn't trigger failure notifications, and I'll also check whether the source data is still available for us to re-run the syncs and backfill the missing records. I'll update you within a few hours with findings and a recovery plan.

subject: Question
body: We use the Jira integration to auto-create tickets from Slack escalation alerts, but the 'Create Jira Issue' button in the Integrations panel just spins for a while and then loads a blank page. This started right after we rotated our Okta SSO certificate last Thursday. It's not blocking daily work but our escalation process for retail floor issues relies on it, so I'd like to get it sorted when you have time.
answer: Thanks for the details — the timing right after your Okta certificate rotation is a helpful clue, since the Jira link handshake also relies on that trust chain. Could you send us your workspace ID and a screenshot of the blank page (including the URL if possible)? We'll check the integration logs on our end and get back to you with next steps, no urgent risk expected but we'll confirm once we've looked.

subject: SCIM broken
body: SCIM sync stopped overnight, staff can't log in since 9am. Urgent.
answer: This is being treated as a P0 incident — we're paging our on-call identity team right now. Can you confirm your tenant ID and whether this affects all 79 seats or a subset? In the meantime, if any admins still have active sessions, please avoid making further SCIM config changes until we've isolated the cause. We'll update you within the next 15 minutes.

subject: Duplicate email digests being sent to legal team
body: Since Monday our weekly Notifications digest has been arriving twice for every user on our workspace — same subject line, same content, about 45 minutes apart. We have 208 seats across the legal team and several partners have flagged it as unprofessional given client-facing distribution lists are CC'd on some of these digests. Can you confirm if this is a known issue with the digest scheduler?
answer: Thanks for flagging this — we've seen a handful of similar reports tied to a scheduler retry bug affecting digest delivery for some Pro workspaces. We're actively working on a fix and will suppress duplicate sends in the interim; I'll follow up within 24 hours with a status update and confirm once dedup is active on your workspace.

subject: audit log missng entrys and allowlist erros
body:
hi, we noticed our admin audit log is missing entrys for user role changes made yesterday around 2pm, only login events are showing up. also when i try to add a new IP to the allowlist i get this in the console:

ERROR: allowlist_update_failed
code: 409
reason: conflict with existing rule id ow_4471
timestamp: 2024-06-11T14:32:09Z
request_id: req_88a2f1

not sure if these are related but wanted to report both, its kinda annoying since we only have 13 seats and need this for our energy compliance review.
answer: Thanks for the report and the error details — request ID req_88a2f1 is very helpful. The allowlist conflict looks like a stale rule (ow_4471) blocking updates, and it's possible that's also interfering with audit log writes for role changes. We're looking into both now and will follow up with a fix or workaround shortly, given the compliance review timing we'll prioritize this.

subject: Retention policy not deleting data past configured window
body: We configured a 90-day retention policy on our Storage buckets back in March, but we're seeing objects from January and February still present when we run an inventory export. This is a compliance issue for us since we're contractually required to purge shipment records after 90 days, and we're now over our storage quota partly because of this. Can someone confirm whether the retention job is actually running?
answer: This is a significant compliance concern so we're escalating it as P1 immediately. Can you share the exact bucket name(s) and the retention policy ID so we can check the job execution history? We suspect the retention worker may have silently failed for those buckets — we'll investigate right away and report back within a few hours with findings and a remediation plan for the affected objects.

subject: Transform stage failing intermittently on billing pipeline
body: Our nightly Data Pipelines job that transforms transaction records before loading into our warehouse has been failing intermittently since June 8th. The connector logs show 'transform_error: null value in required field mapped_amount' on roughly 12% of rows, even though those source records have valid amount fields. This is delaying our fintech reconciliation reports and we have 294 seats depending on this pipeline for downstream billing accuracy.
answer: This is being handled as P1 given the reconciliation impact. The null mapped_amount error suggests a schema mismatch introduced by a recent field mapping change on the connector — can you tell us which connector version you're on and share one or two failing record IDs? We're pulling the pipeline logs on our end now and will get back to you within the hour with either a fix or a workaround to unblock the nightly run.

subject: SAML redirect loop for a few analyst accounts
body: A couple of us on the analytics team are hitting a redirect loop when logging in via SAML SSO — it bounces between our IdP and Northwind's login page a few times before failing with 'session state mismatch.' Most of the 180 seats on our workspace are unaffected, just a handful of us who were recently added to a new permissions group. Not urgent, just want to understand why it's only affecting this subset.
answer: Thanks for the clear description — this pattern usually points to a stale SAML assertion tied to group membership changes. Could you list the affected usernames and confirm when they were added to the new permissions group? We'll check the SSO session logs for those accounts and follow up with findings; since it's isolated to a few users this isn't urgent, but we'll get it resolved for you.

subject: dashboards super slow
body: All our dashboards taking 20+ seconds to load today, exports timing out too.
answer: Sorry for the disruption — can you tell us which dashboard(s) are affected and roughly how many widgets or data sources they pull from? We're looking into performance on our end now; in the meantime, try reducing the date range on affected dashboards as a temporary workaround while we investigate the timeout on exports.

subject: MFA enrollment stuck at QR code screen for new hires
body: We're rolling out MFA enrollment for a batch of new employees this week and three of them are stuck at the QR code screen — scanning with an authenticator app just spins and never confirms enrollment. This is happening consistently across different devices and browsers. Not blocking existing staff, just the new accounts, so wanted to flag it before our next onboarding batch on Friday.
answer: Thanks for the heads up ahead of Friday's onboarding. This sounds like it could be a token expiry issue on the enrollment flow — could you share the account emails or user IDs for the three affected accounts? We'll check the enrollment logs and get back to you with a fix or a manual enrollment workaround well before your next batch.

subject: Alert routing sending duplicate notifications to wrong teams
body: We've noticed that alert routing rules in Notifications are sending duplicate copies of the same manufacturing floor alert to both the maintenance team and the operations team, even though the routing rule specifies only maintenance should receive it. This has been happening since we updated our routing rules last week and is generating noise for a large portion of our 252 seats. Can you help us understand why the rule isn't filtering correctly?

In the meantime we'd recommend migrating to 'next_cursor' as documented in our API changelog, and we'll update you once we've confirmed a fix timeline for the legacy parameter behavior.

subject: Multiple card payment failures this billing cycle
body: We've had three consecutive card payment failures on our account this month, and I noticed our latest invoice shows a failed charge dated the 14th with error code 'card_declined - do_not_honor' even though the same card works fine for other services. We have 270 seats and can't risk service interruption. Can you confirm if a retry is scheduled, and whether we're at risk of losing access?

Our system will automatically retry the charge in 48 hours, but given the 'do_not_honor' code, this is often flagged by the issuing bank rather than a real decline, so it may help to have your bank pre-authorize the transaction or update to an alternate card under Billing > Payment Methods to avoid further failures.

subject: SAML login failing for all users since this morning
body: Starting around 9am today, none of our 13 users can log in via SAML SSO. They're redirected to our identity provider, authenticate successfully, but then land on a Northwind error page reading 'SAML response validation failed: signature mismatch'. Could you check whether your identity provider recently renewed its signing certificate, even automatically? If so, the metadata on our end needs to be updated to match. In the meantime, please send us your current IdP metadata XML so we can compare it against what's configured in your SSO settings and get your team back in as quickly as possible.

subject: Need to reduce seat count on Starter plan

subject: Repeated card decline notifications for our account

subject: Data pipeline showing stale records for two days

The pipeline dashboard shows the last successful run as March 11th at 6:02 AM with a green status, which is confusing since no errors are showing but clearly nothing new has come through since.

We'll treat this as a data quality issue and update you once we identify where the ingestion stalled.

subject: Jira integration link broken after Okta re-authentication
body: We recently rotated our Okta credentials for SSO, and since then our Jira integration link inside Northwind has stopped syncing ticket statuses. When I try to reconnect it from the Integrations settings page, I get redirected back to the same screen without any confirmation or error message. subject: Plan upgrade charged incorrectly, missing prorated credit

subject: Need MFA enrolment reset for several users after SSO change

subject: SCIM provisioning - how to map custom attributes for MFA groups
body: I'm integrating our HR system with Northwind Identity via SCIM for Pioneer Retail's education org (20 seats). Users are provisioning fine, but I can't find how to map a custom attribute to trigger MFA enrollment group membership automatically. Is there a documented SCIM schema extension for this, or do we need to set group membership via a separate PATCH call after user creation?
answer: Thanks for reaching out. Northwind's SCIM implementation supports group membership via the standard PATCH operation on the Group resource, and you can include custom attributes in the enterprise extension schema to drive downstream logic, but MFA group assignment itself isn't triggered by attribute mapping directly - you'll need a follow-up PATCH call to add the user to the MFA-required group after provisioning. I'll send over our SCIM schema reference doc with example payloads for this exact flow.

subject: Duplicate alert emails flooding our ops inbox since this morning

We'll push a fix or mitigation and update you within the next couple of hours - in the meantime you may want to pause non-critical alert rules to reduce inbox noise.

subject: Webhook retries causing rate limit errors on our end

I'm logging this as a feature request with our API Platform team and will also share a workaround using a queuing endpoint on your side to absorb bursts in the meantime.

subject: Workspace settings reverted and admins deactivated overnight

We'll follow up within a few hours with findings and next steps.

subject: Charged for upgraded plan but still seeing old seat limit

subject: Doppelte E-Mail-Digests werden an alle Nutzer gesendet

subject: Bar chart cut off in PDF export

subject: Requesting change to backup retention period for storage buckets

We have roughly 4TB across our production buckets and want to confirm this won't push us over our storage quota before we make the change, since we're already at about 78% utilization.

Extending retention to 90 days will roughly triple your backup snapshot footprint, which at your current utilization would likely push you close to or over quota - I'd recommend either increasing your storage quota first or excluding lower-priority buckets from the extended retention policy. Let me know which buckets need the 90-day policy and I can help estimate the exact impact before you apply it.

subject: Push notifications not arriving on Android when app is closed

subject: SDK throwing deprecated endpoint errors across our integration

Treating this as our top priority given the production impact.

subject: Storage quota warning during backup upload
body:
We got a quota warning email this morning while our nightly backup job was uploading to Storage. The job for our energy-assets bucket (bucket id da-freight-backups-01) completed but flagged that we're at 91% of allocated quota. We're on the Starter plan and want to confirm what happens if we hit 100% mid-upload, and whether uploads get rejected or just queued.

Could you also point us to where we can see a breakdown of usage by bucket? We'd like to clean up old backup snapshots before we escalate this internally to our infra team.
answer:
Thanks for flagging this ahead of time. On the Starter plan, once you reach 100% of your Storage quota, new uploads are rejected with a 507 status until space is freed or the quota is increased - in-progress uploads that started before the limit was hit are allowed to complete. You can see a per-bucket usage breakdown under Storage > Usage in the console, which should help identify old backup snapshots to prune.

If you'd like, I can also send over guidance on setting up an automated retention policy so you don't have to manually clean up snapshots going forward.

subject: Transform stage failures on logistics sync pipeline
body:
Our nightly pipeline (pipeline id qe-logistics-sync-07) has failed at the transform stage for the last three runs, starting 2024-05-14. The connector pulling from our TMS is reporting successful extraction but the transform step throws 'schema mismatch on field eta_timestamp' and the run aborts. This is affecting downstream reporting for our dispatch team of 24 users.

We checked the source schema and nothing changed on our end recently. Latency on the extract stage also jumped from ~4 minutes to over 20 minutes right before the failures started. Can someone take a look at whether something changed on the connector side?
answer:
Thanks for the detailed report - a schema mismatch combined with the latency spike suggests the connector may have picked up an unexpected field type change from the source. I'm escalating this to our pipeline engineering team to check the connector logs around 2024-05-14 for your TMS source and pipeline qe-logistics-sync-07 specifically.

In the meantime, as a workaround you can pin the transform stage to the previous schema version under Pipeline Settings > Schema Lock to keep runs going while we investigate. I'll update you as soon as we have findings, likely within a few hours given the impact to your dispatch reporting.

subject: SDK throwing 429s and webhook signature errors after update
body:
After upgrading to SDK version 4.3.0 this morning, our order-processing service started throwing intermittent 429 Too Many Requests errors on calls that were well under our documented rate limit, plus a new error 'webhook signature verification failed' on about 15% of incoming webhook deliveries. This is affecting order sync for our entire retail platform with 204 seats.

We rolled back to SDK 4.2.1 on one instance and the webhook errors stopped, but the rate limit issue persists. We also noticed a deprecation notice in the SDK changelog mentioning the retry-after header format changed - could that be related? We need this resolved quickly as order processing is currently degraded for all users.
answer:
Thank you for the clear reproduction details - this matches an issue we're aware of with SDK 4.3.0 where the retry-after header format change caused the client's backoff logic to misfire, triggering premature 429s, and a separate signing key rotation caused webhook verification to fail for deliveries signed before the rotation propagated. I'm marking this P1 and looping in the API platform team right now.

As an immediate mitigation, please stay on SDK 4.2.1 across all instances until we ship 4.3.1, which we're targeting within the next few hours. I'll update this ticket as soon as the fix is available and confirm the webhook signing issue is fully resolved on our end.

subject: Request: two-way Jira link for Integrations
body:
We're evaluating the Jira integration for our Integrations product and noticed that issues created from Northwind only link one-way - updates made in Jira don't sync back to the originating record in our workspace. Thanks for the detailed context. Two-way Jira sync isn't currently available - today the integration only pushes from Northwind to Jira, as you've found. In the meantime, there's no workaround that fully replicates two-way sync, but some customers use a Jira webhook combined with our Slack integration to post status-change notifications into a shared channel as a partial substitute. I'll update you here once I have news from the product team.

subject: Need to restrict console access by IP allowlist
body:
I'm setting up an IP allowlist for our Admin Console under our energy division's compliance requirements and need to confirm how the feature behaves. We have 285 seats across three office locations plus remote staff, and I want to restrict console login to our corporate VPN ranges while still allowing mobile app access separately.

When I added our first CIDR block (203.0.113.0/24) and enabled the allowlist, it seems to have also blocked API token authentication for a service account we use for automated reporting. Is that expected, or is there a setting to exempt service accounts from the IP restriction?
answer:
Good question - by default, enabling the IP allowlist under Admin Console does apply to all authentication methods including API tokens tied to service accounts, since it's enforced at the network layer rather than per-login-type. To exempt your reporting service account, go to Settings > Allowlist > Exceptions and add the service account's client ID; this lets it authenticate from outside the allowed CIDR ranges while keeping the restriction on user console logins.

Let me know once you've added the exception and confirmed the automated reporting resumed - happy to double check the configuration on our end if needed.

subject: transform errors in pipeline - manufacturing feed
body:
Getting repeated failures on our manufacturing inventory pipeline over the last two days. Pulled the log from the last run:

2024-05-12T03:14:02Z ERROR transform_stage: null pointer at field quantity_on_hand
2024-05-12T03:14:02Z ERROR connector: retry attempt 3/3 exceeded
2024-05-12T03:14:03Z WARN sync_manager: falling back to last known good snapshot
2024-05-12T03:14:05Z ERROR pipeline_run_09f2: aborted, exit code 137
2024-05-12T03:14:05Z INFO scheduler: next run scheduled 03:14 UTC tomorrow

Our inventory numbers on the dashboard are now a day stale because of the fallback snapshot. Not urgent since we have a workaround, but wanted to flag it and get guidance on how to prevent the null pointer going forward.
answer:
Thanks for including the log - the exit code 137 combined with the null pointer on quantity_on_hand suggests the transform step is running out of memory when a batch contains unexpected nulls in that field, causing it to abort before it can handle them gracefully. As a low-priority fix, I'd recommend adding a default-value rule for quantity_on_hand in your transform config to prevent nulls from reaching that stage.

I'm also passing the log details to our pipelines team to look at improving how the connector handles this failure mode instead of aborting outright. Since you have a working snapshot fallback, this shouldn't be urgent, but I'll follow up once we have a recommendation on the config change.

subject: reqest: biometric login option for mobile app
