hey team, we've been getting alot of feedbak from our legal staff (279 seats) asking for fingerprint/face login on the mobile app instead of typing thier password every time, specially when their offline and cant recieve the push code. right now the app just crashs sometimes when they try to use the device passcode fallback after a failed biometric attept.

can we get biometric auth added as a proper login option? also if theres a crash log we shoud send over for the fallback issue let us know, happy to grab it from a few users devices
answer:
Thanks for passing along the feedback - biometric login (Face ID / fingerprint) as a primary authentication option isn't available yet on the mobile app, but it's a request we've heard from other customers too, so I'm logging it for our mobile product team to prioritize. The crash on the passcode fallback after a failed biometric attempt sounds like a separate bug, so please do send over device logs from a couple of affected users along with device model and OS version so we can investigate that specifically.

I'll keep this ticket open to track both the feature request and the crash report - once you send the logs we'll dig into the fallback issue right away.

subject: Deactivated users still appearing as active in audit log
body:
We deactivated 14 employees from our manufacturing division through the Admin Console yesterday following our offboarding checklist, but the audit log still shows their sessions as active and two of them were able to log into the mobile app this morning after deactivation. This is a compliance issue for us since we have 162 seats and need accurate deactivation records for our security review next week.

We followed the standard deactivation steps (Users > Select > Deactivate) and got the confirmation banner each time, but the audit log entries show status 'active' with a timestamp matching the login attempts, not the deactivation. Can you investigate urgently - we need to know if sessions are actually being terminated or not.
answer:
This is a serious issue and I'm escalating it to our security team immediately given the compliance implications. Deactivation should immediately revoke active sessions and tokens - the fact that two users could still log in after deactivation suggests session termination may not be propagating correctly, possibly due to a caching delay on the mobile auth token validation.

As an immediate step, please have those 14 accounts' sessions force-revoked manually via Users > Sessions > Revoke All while we investigate root cause, and let us know if any further logins occur after that. I'll follow up within the next few hours with findings and will make sure this is documented for your security review.

subject: Duplicate email alerts going out to all users - needs urgent fix
body:
Starting yesterday afternoon, our team has been getting duplicate email notifications for every alert - some users report receiving the same booking confirmation alert 3 or 4 times within a few minutes. This is happening across all 30 seats in our travel workspace and is causing confusion with our agents who think bookings are being duplicated when they're not.

We haven't changed any notification rules or added new integrations recently. Can you look into why alerts are firing multiple times? Our agents are starting to mute notifications entirely which defeats the purpose of the alerting system.
answer:
Thank you for reporting this - duplicate alert delivery affecting your whole team is a high priority for us and we're looking into it right now. This pattern often points to a retry loop in the notification queue where delivery confirmations aren't being acknowledged properly, causing the system to resend.

While we investigate, could you confirm whether the duplicates are happening on a specific alert type (e.g., booking confirmations only) or across all alert categories? That will help us narrow down the fix quickly, and I'll update you as soon as we identify the cause - we're treating this as urgent given the impact to your agents.

subject: Dashboards taking forever to load charts
body:
Our finance dashboard has been loading very slowly for the past week - charts that used to render in a couple seconds now take 15-20 seconds, sometimes timing out entirely with a blank chart area. We're a small team of 3 seats so it's not a huge volume issue, but it's slowing down our month-end reporting significantly.

The slowness seems worse on the revenue trend chart specifically, which pulls from our billing data. Other charts on the same dashboard load a bit faster but still slower than before. Is there something we can do on our end, or is this a known performance issue?
answer:
Sorry for the slowdown, especially with month-end reporting underway. Charts pulling from billing data can be affected by larger aggregation windows if the date range or grouping settings were recently changed, so I'd first suggest checking whether the revenue trend chart's date range has grown significantly - narrowing it can often improve load times immediately.

I'm also going to check on our end whether there's a broader performance issue affecting billing-sourced charts, since a jump from seconds to 15-20 seconds suggests something beyond normal load. I'll follow up shortly with findings and any additional steps to speed things up.

subject: charts brokn on logistics dashbord after export
body:
hey we noticed the bar charts on our Fleet Utilization dashbord are showing blank after we tryed to export to PDF yesterday around 3pm. this is happenin for like 5 of our regional managers, they cant see the data just white space where the chart shud be. we have 174 seats and this is kinda urgent since we need these for a monday review.

also the line chart on the delivery-times panel is stuck loading a spinner forever, refreshd twice no luck. can someone escalate this pls, its slowin down our whole ops team.
answer:
Thanks for flagging this, and sorry for the disruption to your team's reporting workflow. This looks related to a rendering issue we've seen tied to PDF export on dashboards with more than 4 chart widgets - I'm escalating this to our dashboards engineering team now and will update you within a few hours with either a fix or a workaround (exporting panels individually usually resolves the blank chart issue in the meantime).

Could you confirm the exact dashboard name and whether this happens in Chrome, Firefox, or both? That will help us reproduce it faster on our end.

subject: Unsubscribe endpoint returning duplicate confirmations
body:
We're integrating the Notifications API to handle transactional emails for our energy monitoring alerts, and we've noticed that when a user hits our unsubscribe link, the /v1/notifications/unsubscribe endpoint sometimes fires the confirmation email twice within a few seconds. This started around March 4th and we're seeing it on roughly 15-20% of unsubscribe requests based on our logs.

This is causing confusion for our customers who think their unsubscribe didn't go through the first time. Is there a known issue with idempotency on this endpoint, or should we be passing a request ID to dedupe on our side?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report - this matches a bug we're tracking where the unsubscribe endpoint doesn't properly check for an existing pending confirmation before triggering a new send. As a workaround, please pass a client-generated idempotency key in the X-Idempotency-Key header on unsubscribe calls; that will suppress duplicate sends on our side while we roll out a permanent fix, targeted for our next deploy this week. I'll follow up here once that ships.

subject: Best practice for rotating API keys ahead of SDK deprecation
body:
I saw the notice that the v1 SDK is being deprecated at the end of next quarter, and I want to make sure our key rotation plan lines up with that. Right now we have two active API keys tied to our analytics pipeline (one for staging, one for prod) and I'd like guidance on whether we should generate new keys under the v2 scheme now or wait until the SDK migration.

Also, could you confirm if webhook signing secrets are affected by this deprecation, or if those remain independent of the SDK version?
answer: Good question, and glad you're planning ahead. You can generate v2 API keys now and run them in parallel with your existing v1 keys - both will keep working until the v1 SDK sunset date, so there's no rush to cut over before you're ready. Webhook signing secrets are independent of SDK version and won't be affected by the deprecation, so no changes needed there. Let us know if you'd like a walkthrough of the v2 key scopes before you rotate.

subject: Widespread card decline errors blocking renewals - need urgent help
body:
We're seeing a spike in card failures on our Billing integration since yesterday morning - roughly 40 of our customer subscription renewals have failed with error code card_declined even though customers confirm their cards are valid and have sufficient funds. Our webhook logs show the charge attempts returning status 402 from the /v1/charges endpoint.

This is affecting subscription continuity for a large chunk of our customer base and we're getting support tickets ourselves as a result. We need this resolved quickly - can someone from billing look into whether this is on Northwind's processor side or something with our integration?
answer: This has been escalated to our billing infrastructure team as a P1 given the scale of impact. We identified a partial outage with one of our card processing partners starting yesterday around 9am UTC that's causing elevated false declines - a fix is being rolled out now and we expect retry attempts to succeed within the next few hours. I'd recommend queuing failed charges for automatic retry rather than notifying customers to update their cards, since this isn't an issue with the card details themselves. I'll update you as soon as we confirm the processor issue is fully resolved.

subject: Critical alerts not routing to on-call channel
body:
We integrated the Notifications API to route critical fraud alerts to our on-call Slack channel via webhook, and since this morning none of the alerts tagged priority:critical are reaching the channel - they're only showing up in the default email digest instead. Our routing rule config hasn't changed in weeks, and I confirmed the webhook URL still returns 200 when tested manually.

This is a serious problem for us since we're a fintech handling time-sensitive fraud flags with only 8 seats on our team - every missed alert is a real risk. Can someone check if something changed on the routing engine side?
answer: I understand the urgency here given the nature of your alerts, and I've escalated this to our on-call engineering team immediately. We're seeing a bug in the priority-based routing rules that was introduced in a config update pushed early this morning, which is causing critical-tagged alerts to fall back to default email routing instead of your custom webhook rule. We're rolling back that change now and will confirm once critical alerts are routing correctly again - expect an update within the hour.

subject: Duplicate daily digest emails being sent to team
body:
Our operations team has been receiving two copies of the daily email digest every morning for the past week, both with identical content and timestamps about 2 minutes apart. This is happening for all 91 of our seats, not just a few users, and it's cluttering inboxes and causing confusion about which one to act on.

Could you help us figure out if this is a configuration issue on our digest schedule settings, or a bug on Northwind's side? We'd also appreciate documentation on how digest frequency and dedupe logic is supposed to work so we can avoid this in the future.
answer: Thanks for reporting this - a duplicate send affecting all seats definitely warrants a closer look. This appears to be caused by two overlapping digest schedules that were both left active under your account (likely from a prior configuration change), rather than a platform-wide bug. I'll walk you through disabling the duplicate schedule in Settings > Notifications > Digest Rules, and I'm also attaching our documentation on digest scheduling and dedupe logic so your team has a reference going forward.

subject: SAML login redirect loop for a subset of users
body:
We're integrating SSO for our retail platform and a handful of users are stuck in a redirect loop after authenticating successfully through our IdP - they get bounced back to the SAML login page instead of landing in the app. This only affects users provisioned in the last two weeks, so I suspect it's related to how their group attributes are being mapped on Northwind's side.

Could someone check the SAML assertion handling for newly provisioned accounts? I can share a sample assertion if that helps troubleshoot.
answer: Thanks for the detailed context - a sample SAML assertion from one of the affected accounts would definitely help us pinpoint this faster, so please send that over when you can. In the meantime, this pattern (only newly provisioned users affected) often points to a missing group attribute mapping for accounts created after a recent IdP config change, so it would help to confirm which attributes your IdP is sending versus what's configured in our SSO settings. We'll dig into this once we have the assertion sample.

subject: Need to configure audit log retention and export settings
body:
I'm reviewing our compliance requirements and need to adjust how long audit logs are retained in the Admin Console, currently we're not sure if it's set to 30 or 90 days. We also want to set up an allowlist so only our finance and security leads can export audit logs, rather than all 80 seat holders having that access.

Could you point me to where these settings live, and whether there's documentation on what actions get logged versus what's excluded? We also want to deactivate audit log access for a few former admins whose accounts are still listed as active.
answer: Happy to help you get this configured correctly. Audit log retention and export permissions are both under Admin Console > Settings > Audit Log Configuration - retention is currently set to 30 days on your account, and you can extend it up to 1 year on your plan. For the allowlist, you can restrict export access to specific roles under the same settings page, and I'll send over our documentation on logged versus excluded actions. I'd also recommend deactivating the former admin accounts directly from the Users tab while you're in there, since that will also remove their standing audit log access.

subject: Recurring transform failures in nightly pipeline sync
body:
Our nightly data pipeline that syncs case management records into our reporting warehouse has been failing intermittently on the transform step for the past 4 nights. The pipeline run logs show the failure occurring at the 'normalize_dates' transform stage with roughly 200-400 records rejected each night, though the exact count varies.

This is causing our downstream reports to show stale data since the sync doesn't complete, and our legal team relies on same-day figures for case tracking. Could someone look into whether there's a schema mismatch or a recent change to the transform logic that's causing this?
answer: Thanks for flagging this with the specifics - the varying rejection counts point to a likely data quality issue upstream rather than a pipeline bug, possibly malformed or null date fields in a subset of source records. I'm pulling the failed run logs for the last four nights now to confirm the exact rejection pattern at the normalize_dates stage, and will follow up with either a source data fix recommendation or a pipeline-side adjustment. Given the impact on your reporting, we'll prioritize getting this resolved before tonight's scheduled run.

subject: Question about unused seat credits and refund policy
body:
We recently reduced our active user count and now have several unused seat licenses on our account. I want to understand how credits work in this situation - do unused seats roll over as credit toward the next billing cycle, or is there a refund process we should be requesting instead?

Could you also point me to documentation that explains how seat adjustments affect our next invoice, since I need to report this to our finance team accurately.
answer: Good question, and this is something we can clarify quickly. Unused seats don't automatically convert to credit or refund - seat count adjustments take effect at your next renewal date and your invoice will reflect the updated seat count going forward, rather than a mid-cycle refund. I'll send over our documentation on plan and seat management so you have the specifics for your finance team, and if you'd like to formally request a mid-cycle adjustment we can loop in our renewals team to review your options.

subject: Card declines when updating billing plan via API
body: We're integrating with the Billing API to manage our Cobalt Robotics workspace (currently Starter, 12 seats) and keep getting card failures when trying to add 3 seats for new interns. The response is 402 Payment Required with error code card_declined, even though the same card works fine in our own test dashboard. Invoice INV-88213 has failed three times since Monday. Our semester onboarding starts Friday and we can't add users until this is resolved.
answer: Thanks for the detailed error info. A 402 with card_declined on a card that otherwise works usually points to a mismatch in billing address or a temporary hold from the issuer on our processor's side. We're escalating INV-88213 now to check the raw gateway response, and will follow up within a few hours with either a fix or a workaround so you can add the new seats before Friday.

subject: Retention policy not purging data past 90-day window
body: We're seeing files in bucket quill-legal-archive-01 that should have been purged under our 90-day retention policy, but records from as far back as January 14th are still present. Our compliance team flagged this during an internal audit review, since Quill Analytics operates under strict legal-industry retention rules. Storage usage is now at 94% of our allocated quota, which is starting to block new uploads. Can you confirm whether retention jobs are running correctly on our Enterprise tier?
answer: Thank you for flagging this, we understand the compliance sensitivity here. We're pulling the retention job logs for quill-legal-archive-01 now to see why files past the 90-day window weren't purged, and will also temporarily raise your quota buffer so uploads aren't blocked while we investigate. We'll update you within one business day with findings and a remediation timeline.

subject: API Schlüssel funktionieren nicht mehr – Webhooks tot!
body: Seit dem Rotieren unserer API Keys heute Morgen bekommen alle unsere Webhooks nur noch 401 Unauthorized zurück! Wir haben bereits drei Produktionsintegrationen für Ember Robotics, die dadurch komplett stillstehen. Das ist jetzt schon das zweite Mal in diesem Monat, dass eure Key-Rotation ohne Vorwarnung alles zerschießt. Wenn das nicht sofort gelöst wird, prüfen wir ernsthaft einen Wechsel zu einem anderen Anbieter!
answer: Das tut uns wirklich leid, wir verstehen den Druck, den das auf eure Produktionsintegrationen ausübt. Wir prüfen sofort, ob die neuen Keys korrekt propagiert wurden und ob es ein Problem mit der Webhook-Signaturvalidierung nach der Rotation gibt. Wir melden uns innerhalb der nächsten Stunde mit einem Status-Update und, falls nötig, mit einem temporären Fallback-Key.

subject: Recurring card failures blocking monthly invoice
body: Our monthly invoice for Willow Robotics (Starter plan, 18 seats) failed to process again today, June 5th. The dashboard shows error insufficient_funds, but our finance team confirmed the card has sufficient balance and no holds. This is the second failed attempt this billing cycle, also failed on May 28th. Invoice ID is INV-70021 and we're worried about service suspension since we rely on the platform for daily reporting.
answer: Thanks for the details, we know this is urgent given your reliance on the platform. We're pulling the raw processor response for INV-70021 now to see why insufficient_funds is being returned despite available balance, since that error can sometimes be a misreported decline code from the bank. We'll manually attempt to reprocess the charge and confirm with you shortly, and will hold off on any suspension while we investigate.

subject: Charts rendering blank after export template change
body: After updating our dashboard export template last week, several bar charts in the 'Energy Usage Overview' dashboard render blank when shared externally via link. Internally the charts display fine, but shared or exported PDF versions show empty chart areas. This started around May 30th after we changed the export layout settings. Could you help confirm whether this is a caching or rendering issue on your end?
answer: Thanks for the clear timeline, that helps narrow it down. It sounds like the export renderer may be caching an older layout snapshot that doesn't match the updated template. Could you send us the dashboard ID for 'Energy Usage Overview'? We'll reproduce the export and check the rendering pipeline, and follow up with a fix or workaround within a couple of business days.

subject: Workspace settings reset and admin accounts deactivated
body: This morning our workspace settings for Blue Legal appear to have reset to default, and two of our four admin accounts were automatically deactivated without any action from us. The audit log shows an entry at 8:42 AM UTC labeled bulk_settings_update that we did not trigger. We can't access several configuration pages now and need this restored immediately since our small team relies on admin access for daily operations.
answer: This is being treated as high priority given the impact on your admin access. We're escalating internally to trace the bulk_settings_update event at 8:42 AM UTC and will restore your workspace settings and reactivate the two admin accounts as quickly as possible. We'll keep you updated every step of the way until access is fully restored.

subject: How to add new office IP to allowlist
body: We're moving to a new office next month and need to update our IP allowlist in the Admin Console for Atlas Works. Could you walk me through the steps to add the new IP range and remove our old one? Also wanted to confirm whether deactivating the old IP will log an entry in the audit log automatically or if we need to note it manually for our compliance records.
answer: Happy to help with the move. In the Admin Console, go to Security Settings > IP Allowlist, where you can add the new range and remove the old entry directly, both actions are logged automatically in the audit log with a timestamp and the admin who made the change. Let us know the new IP range whenever you're ready and we can double-check the configuration for you.

subject: Audit log missing entries for user deactivation
body: We deactivated a former employee's account in the Admin Console on June 2nd, but the audit log doesn't show any entry for that action. We rely on the audit log for our internal documentation and need accurate records of admin actions. Is there a delay in log population, or could this be a bug specific to deactivation events on the Starter plan?
answer: Thanks for reporting this, accurate audit records are important and we'll look into it right away. Log population is usually near-instant, so a missing deactivation entry from June 2nd suggests it may be a bug specific to that event type. We'll check our backend logs for that action and follow up with what we find, including whether the entry can be backfilled.

subject: Storage quota showing incorrect usage after backup job
body: After our nightly backup job ran on June 4th, our storage dashboard shows we're at 102% of quota for Delta Media, even though we haven't uploaded significantly more data recently. New uploads are now being rejected with quota_exceeded errors. Can you check whether the backup retention job duplicated files instead of overwriting the previous snapshot? Our workspace ID is delta-media-prod-01.
answer: Thanks for flagging this, that does sound like the backup job may have created duplicate snapshots rather than overwriting the prior one. We're checking the backup logs for delta-media-prod-01 now to confirm, and will clean up any duplicate data and adjust your reported quota usage once we identify the cause. We'll follow up with our findings shortly.

subject: Requesting alternate payment method options for failed cards
body: We've had recurring card failures on our Pro plan account for Orion Partners over the past two billing cycles, and our finance team wants to explore adding a backup payment method or enabling ACH/bank transfer as an alternative. With 246 seats on this account, a failed payment causing service disruption is a significant risk for us. Could you let us know what payment options are currently supported and how we can configure a backup method?
answer: Thanks for raising this proactively, that's a smart precaution given your account size. Currently we support credit card and ACH bank transfer as payment methods, and you can add a backup card or bank account under Billing Settings > Payment Methods, which will automatically be used if the primary method fails. We'll also flag your account for our billing team to review your recent failed charges and ensure no disruption going forward.

subject: Request to add Slack alerts for Jira and Salesforce events
body:
We're currently using the Slack integration for Okta login alerts and it's working well for our 30 seats here at Willow Travel. We'd like to expand this so that Jira ticket updates and Salesforce opportunity changes also post to our #ops-alerts channel. Is this something we can configure ourselves in the Integrations panel, or does it need to be set up on your end?

If self-service, could you point me to the setup docs for adding multiple event sources to one Slack channel?
answer: Thanks for reaching out. You can add both Jira and Salesforce as event sources to the same Slack channel from the Integrations panel under Notification Rules — each source has its own toggle and channel picker, so you don't need us to configure anything server-side. I'll send over the setup guide that walks through mapping Jira issue events and Salesforce opportunity stage changes to a shared channel, and flag your feedback about wanting a combined view to our product team as a nice enhancement for later.

subject: Charts not rendering after latest dashboard API update
body:
I'm integrating the Dashboards API for Harbor Legal and since yesterday our embedded bar and line charts are showing blank containers instead of data. The API calls return 200 with valid JSON payloads, so it looks like a front-end rendering issue rather than a data problem. This started after I updated our SDK version to match the new sharing endpoint docs.

Can you confirm if there's a known compatibility issue between the latest SDK release and the chart rendering library, and if there's a workaround while we wait on a fix?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. We're aware of a rendering regression introduced in the SDK release tied to the new sharing endpoints, where chart containers fail to initialize when the legacy config object is passed directly. As a workaround, wrapping your chart config in the new renderOptions object should restore rendering immediately — I'll send you a code snippet showing the change, and we're targeting a permanent fix in the next SDK patch.

subject: Urgent: need full restore from backup after failed migration
body:
We ran a storage migration last night for Ember Works and it corrupted roughly 4,200 files across our 'client-docs' bucket. Uploads since October 1st are showing as 0-byte placeholders, and our teams across 54 seats can't access anything created in the last three weeks. We need to restore from the most recent clean backup, which I believe is from September 30th.

Can someone confirm the restore process and timeline? This is blocking multiple client-facing teams right now.
answer: This is being escalated to our storage team immediately as a P1. We've located a clean snapshot from September 30th 11:58 PM UTC and are starting the restore process now — please avoid any new uploads to the client-docs bucket until we confirm the restore is complete, as this could complicate the rollback. I'll update you within the hour with a status and an estimated completion time.
