subject: Workspace settings reverting after allowlist update
body:
I'm working on updating our IP allowlist in the Admin Console for Granite Labs and noticed that every time I save the new allowlist entries, the workspace deactivation timeout setting silently resets to its default value. This has happened three times today across different browser sessions. Our security team relies on that timeout setting being set to 15 minutes for compliance reasons.

Could you confirm whether these two settings are linked on the backend, and how we can prevent this from happening while we finalize our allowlist changes this week?
answer: Thank you for flagging this — this does look like a bug where saving allowlist changes triggers a full settings object rewrite instead of a partial update, which is resetting your timeout value. Our engineering team is looking into it now; in the meantime, please re-check and re-save the deactivation timeout each time after an allowlist update as a temporary safeguard. We'll update this ticket once we have a fix scheduled.

subject: Pagination returning duplicate and missing records intermittently
body:
Since upgrading to SDK version 4.2 last week, our sync jobs against the Northwind API Platform are getting inconsistent results when paginating through the /orders endpoint. Some pages return duplicate order IDs from the previous page, and other times records are skipped entirely between page tokens. We're seeing this across all our automated pulls for North Retail, roughly 15-20% of requests affected.

We also noticed a deprecation warning in the response headers referencing the old cursor format — could that be related? This is currently blocking our nightly reconciliation job.
answer: This matches a known issue with the cursor-based pagination rollout — clients still sending the legacy page token format alongside the new cursor header can get inconsistent results exactly like you're describing. As an immediate fix, please update your SDK config to use only the new 'next_cursor' field and drop the legacy 'page' parameter entirely; this should resolve the duplicates and gaps. We're escalating internally as a P1 since this affects data integrity and will follow up with a timeline for deprecating the legacy format cleanly.

subject: Biometric login failing after mobile app update
body:
After updating the Northwind mobile app to the latest version, our users at Delta Energy are reporting that Face ID and fingerprint login no longer work — the app falls back to password entry every time even though biometric login was previously enabled on their devices. This is happening on both iOS and Android across several team members. I checked the documentation but it doesn't mention any changes to biometric enrollment in this release.

Is this a known issue with the latest update, and is there a way to re-enable biometric login without users having to fully log out and re-enroll?
answer: Thanks for the report — we've had a few similar reports since the latest release and are investigating a possible token refresh issue affecting the biometric session handshake. As a temporary workaround, having affected users log out fully and re-enroll biometrics does restore functionality, though we know that's not ideal at scale. I'll keep this ticket open and update you as soon as we have a root cause and a fix timeline.

subject: BILLED FOR SEATS WE DONT EVEN HAVE - FIX THIS NOW
body:
im so done with this, our invoice this month shows 14 seats billed but we only have 14 activated users and even before that we were being charged for seats we deactivated back in AUgust!! i went into the admin panel and it clearly shows 14 active but billing keeps saying we need to pay for extra seats. this has happned twice now and support just says 'well look into it' and nothign changes.

we are on the Starter plan and this is rediculous for a company our size, we need a refund for the overcharge and an explanation of why this keeps happenning or we're cancelling next renewal.
answer: I completely understand the frustration and I'm sorry this has recurred. I'm pulling up your account now to compare the seat count in the admin panel against what billing has on record — this looks like a sync issue between deactivated seats and the invoicing system rather than an actual usage discrepancy. I'm escalating this as a priority billing case and will have a corrected invoice and refund confirmation for the overcharge within one business day.

subject: Request for bulk export option on dashboard charts
body:
Our team at Atlas Freight has been experiencing slow load times on several of our larger dashboards, particularly the ones with over 20 charts pulling from live data sources — some take 15-20 seconds to fully render. Separately, we'd like to request a bulk export feature so we can export all charts on a dashboard to PDF or PNG at once, rather than exporting one chart at a time as it currently works.

Given our scale, both the performance and the export workflow are becoming real friction points for our reporting team. Any guidance on optimizing load times, and any roadmap visibility on bulk export, would be appreciated.
answer: Thanks for the detailed feedback. On performance, dashboards with 20+ live-data charts can benefit from switching a portion of them to scheduled snapshot refreshes instead of live queries, which typically cuts load time significantly — I'll send over guidance on configuring refresh intervals per chart. Bulk export isn't available today, but I'm logging this as a feature request with your use case attached, since it's a common ask from larger accounts like yours.

subject: Okta integration broken, users can't SSO into workspace
body:
Our Okta app integration for Pioneer Freight stopped working this morning — all 22 users are getting 'Invalid SAML response' errors when trying to log into the Northwind workspace through our Okta dashboard. Nothing has changed on our Okta configuration recently that we're aware of. We rely on this for daily access and no one can get in right now.

We also have Slack and Jira connected through the same SSO setup, so I'm not sure if those are affected too. Can someone look into this urgently?
answer: This is being treated as a P1 since it's blocking all workspace access. We're checking our SAML certificate and metadata configuration on our end first, since a certificate rotation on our side could produce exactly this error — I'll confirm within the next 30 minutes whether that's the cause. In the meantime, could you verify the timestamp of the last successful login so we can narrow down when the break occurred?

subject: Bulk user deactivation is timing out on our 160-seat workspace
body:
I'm trying to deactivate a batch of about 40 users who left our logistics team last week, and the Admin Console hangs after the first 8-10 accounts with a spinning loader that never resolves. When I refresh, some users show as deactivated and others still show active, so I can't trust the audit log to tell me what actually happened.

Can you confirm whether there's a supported way to bulk deactivate users, and if there's a size limit we're hitting? We need this cleaned up before our monthly access review on Friday.
answer:
Thanks for the detailed report - this looks like a known throttling issue when deactivating more than roughly 15 accounts in a single session, which can leave the audit log in an inconsistent state. I'm escalating this to our engineering team as P1 given the upcoming access review, and in the meantime I'd recommend deactivating in batches of 10 with a short pause between batches to avoid the hang.

I'll also send you a CSV export option we have in beta that lets you queue deactivations asynchronously, which should sidestep the timeout entirely. I'll follow up within a few hours with confirmation on the underlying fix timeline.

subject: Scheduled sync running consistently 45 min late
body:
We have a nightly connector sync configured to run at 2:00 AM UTC pulling booking data into our pipeline, and for the past four nights it's been kicking off around 2:45 AM instead. The delay itself isn't breaking anything critical yet, but it's pushing our downstream reporting jobs later than we'd like.

Connector ID is travel-bookings-sync-04. Is this a known latency issue on the scheduler side, or something we should adjust in our sync window configuration?
answer:
Thanks for flagging this with the connector ID - that's helpful. We've seen some scheduler queue congestion during that UTC window affecting a subset of Starter-tier syncs, and your job falling consistently ~45 minutes behind lines up with that pattern. It's not causing data loss, just delayed starts, so I've filed this as a low-priority queue optimization ticket on our end.

As a workaround, shifting your scheduled window to 1:15 AM or 3:30 AM UTC should avoid the peak congestion period. Let me know if you'd like help adjusting that in your pipeline settings.

subject: Transform step failing on incoming energy usage data
body:
Our transform stage in the pipeline connected to our energy billing connector has been failing since yesterday around 6 PM. The error shown in the run log is 'transform_error: unexpected null in field usage_kwh, row 1442' but our source file doesn't have any nulls in that column when I check it manually.

This has failed on the last three consecutive runs, so no new data has landed in our workspace since then. Connector is billed-usage-sync, workspace has 14 seats. Can someone take a look at what's actually happening in row 1442 on our end?
answer:
Sorry for the disruption this is causing - I can see the failed runs on billed-usage-sync and I'm pulling the raw payload for row 1442 now to compare against what the transform engine received. It's possible the source connector is sending a different value than what your file shows, such as an empty string being interpreted as null.

I'll have a root cause update for you within a couple of hours, and if it turns out to be a connector-side encoding issue we'll get a fix or workaround in place so your syncs can resume.

subject: Mobile app crashes immediately on launch after update
body:
Since updating to the latest version of the Northwind mobile app yesterday, it crashes within a second of opening for all of our staff, before they even reach the login screen. We've confirmed this on both iOS and Android devices across our retail team of 9 users.

We rely on the mobile app for store floor check-ins, so this is blocking daily operations right now. Is there a known issue with the latest release, and is there a way to roll back to the previous version while we wait for a fix?
answer:
Thank you for reporting this quickly - we've had a couple of similar reports come in this morning about crashes on launch tied to the newest release, and our mobile team is actively investigating. I'm marking this P1 given the impact to your store operations.

As an immediate workaround, please have your team uninstall and reinstall the app, which resolves the crash for most affected users while we finalize a patch. I'll update you as soon as we have a confirmed fix timeline, and I'll follow up directly once it's available.

subject: Multiple card declines on renewal charge
body:
Our corporate card on file was declined twice this week when Northwind tried to process our Pro plan renewal for our 108-seat workspace, even though there are sufficient funds and the same card works fine elsewhere. The invoice shows attempts on the 3rd and 5th, both failing with a generic 'payment method declined' message.

We'd like to update the payment method and also understand why we're not getting more detail on the decline reason so our finance team can troubleshoot faster next time.
answer:
Thanks for letting us know, and I'm sorry for the inconvenience with the renewal charge. I can see both failed attempts on your account, and generic decline messages like this are often triggered by the card issuer's fraud filters for recurring SaaS charges rather than an actual funds issue, but I've escalated to our billing team to get more specific detail from the processor.

In the meantime, please update your payment method in the billing settings and I'll manually retry the renewal charge once that's done so there's no interruption to your seats.

subject: Plan upgrade double-charged us and seat count is wrong
body:
We upgraded from our previous tier to Pro on the 2nd of this month, and our latest invoice shows two separate charges for the upgrade fee plus a seat count of 210 instead of the 186 we actually have active. This has inflated our bill by a noticeable amount and finance is asking me to get it resolved before month-end close.

Can someone review invoice INV-88210 and correct both the duplicate charge and the seat discrepancy? This needs to be fixed quickly since we report actuals in two days.
answer:
I understand the urgency here with your month-end close approaching, and I'm looking into invoice INV-88210 right now. I can already confirm the seat count listed doesn't match your active user list, which suggests a sync delay between the upgrade and billing systems, and I'm working with billing to identify why the upgrade fee posted twice.

I'll issue a credit for the duplicate charge and correct the seat count on the invoice today, and I'll send you a revised invoice PDF before your reporting deadline so you have accurate figures for close.

subject: Need help with pipeline setup
body:
We've been running our fintech data pipelines on Northwind for about eight months now across several teams, and overall the setup has worked well for our compliance reporting needs. Our operations team recently expanded the number of source connectors feeding into our main aggregation pipeline to cover a few new regional data feeds.

After adding these new sources last week, we started noticing that our transform jobs on the main pipeline are failing intermittently, roughly one in five runs, with errors referencing schema mismatches on fields that didn't exist in our original setup. The actual problem is that we need a way to version or stage schema changes before they hit production transforms, because right now any new connector schema seems to immediately affect the live pipeline and cause these failures without warning.
answer:
Thank you for the thorough context - it sounds like the intermittent schema mismatch failures started right when the new regional connectors were added, which tracks with schema changes propagating directly into your live transform without a staging step. This is a common pain point, and I want to flag that we do have a schema preview feature in limited rollout that lets you validate new connector fields before they affect production transforms.

I'll get you added to that preview and also pull the specific failed run logs from the past week so we can identify exactly which fields are triggering the mismatch in the meantime. I'll follow up with both the preview access and a short-term fix suggestion within the next day.

subject: Deactivated user still appears active in audit log and allowlist
body:
We deactivated a departing employee's account three days ago through the Admin Console, and the deactivation confirmation showed successfully, but the audit log still lists their last action as 'login' from yesterday, and their entry is still present on our IP allowlist exceptions list. This is a compliance concern for our legal workspace since we need accurate deactivation records for our quarterly access audit.

This affects account user ID lgl-4471. Can you confirm whether the account is actually deactivated on the backend, since the console UI and audit trail appear to disagree?
answer:
Thanks for catching this discrepancy, and I understand the urgency given your upcoming access audit. I've confirmed on our end that user ID lgl-4471 was deactivated at the system level three days ago as expected, but there's a known sync delay bug affecting the audit log and allowlist views for a subset of Pro workspaces that's causing them to show stale data.

I'm escalating this as P2 to our platform team to force a resync of your workspace's audit and allowlist data, and I'll send you a corrected audit export once that completes so you have accurate records for your quarterly review.

subject: SSO role mapping not applying correct permissions after group sync
body:
We use SAML SSO with group-based role mapping, and since our last identity provider group sync on Tuesday, a subset of users assigned to our 'Plant Operations' group are landing in Northwind with default viewer permissions instead of the operator role we've mapped for that group. This is affecting several hundred users across our energy division and is blocking them from accessing dashboards they need for daily operations.

Our SSO configuration hasn't changed on our side recently, so I suspect something changed in how group claims are being parsed. Can you check whether there's an issue with role mapping for group-to-role assignments, and what MFA or provisioning logs might show for this?
answer:
Thank you for flagging this with the specific group and timing details - that's very helpful for tracing the issue. Given the scale of impact across your energy division, I'm treating this as P2 and pulling the provisioning logs now to check whether the group claim parsing changed on our side around Tuesday's sync, since that timing strongly suggests a mapping regression rather than a config issue on your end.

As an interim step, we can manually apply the operator role to the affected users while we identify the root cause, so please send the list of impacted user IDs if you have them and I'll get that fix moving in parallel with the investigation.

subject: Need to update workspace allowlist and audit log retention settings
body:
As we're onboarding a few new staff this week, I need to add two new office IP ranges to our workspace allowlist and also extend our audit log retention from the default 30 days to something longer for compliance purposes, since our education board requires at least 90 days of access history. I can't find where to adjust the retention setting in the Admin Console - it only shows the allowlist editor.

Could you point me to where audit log retention is configured, or let me know if this requires a plan change? We need this in place before new staff start on Monday.
answer:
Thanks for reaching out, and happy to help get this sorted before Monday. I can add the two new IP ranges to your allowlist right away if you send over the CIDR blocks, and regarding audit log retention, that setting is currently tied to plan tier rather than being self-service in the console - Starter plans default to 30 days, while extended retention up to 90 days or more is available on higher tiers.

Given your compliance deadline, I'll flag this as a priority request to our account team to discuss options for extending your retention window without a full plan change, and I'll follow up today with next steps.

subject: Scheduled sync delays on hourly connector - Pioneer Energy
body:
We run an hourly scheduled sync from our SAP connector into the Data Pipelines product to feed our finance reporting. Since Oct 3rd the sync labeled 'sap-finance-hourly' has been finishing 25-40 minutes late most runs, and on Oct 6th it skipped the 14:00 run entirely with no error logged. Row counts also look off - yesterday's run pulled 8,412 records versus the usual ~14,000.

This is impacting our month-end close prep. Can you check the connector health for account ID PIO-2291 and let us know if there's a known issue with SAP connector latency this week?
answer:
Thanks for the detailed report. I've pulled the sync history for account PIO-2291 and can confirm the sap-finance-hourly job has had elevated queue times since Oct 3rd, and I see the skipped run on Oct 6th - it timed out silently rather than surfacing an error, which we'll fix in our alerting. I'm escalating this to our connector team to look at the row count discrepancy as well.

In the meantime, I'd recommend manually triggering the sync ahead of your close deadline rather than relying on the schedule. I'll update you within 2 business days with root cause.

subject: Dashboards loading very slowly for all users
body:
Starting this morning around 8am our team dashboards in Northwind are taking 20-30 seconds to load, and shared dashboard links sent to external partners are timing out completely. We have 18 users on Starter and everyone on the shop floor team is affected when trying to pull the production metrics dashboard.

Exporting to PDF also fails with a generic 'export could not be completed' message. This is affecting our daily production standup which relies on these dashboards. Can someone look into this today?
answer: Sorry for the disruption to your standup - I'm looking into this now. We've had a spike in dashboard render times across a subset of accounts this morning and I can see Apex Works is affected; our platform team is investigating the cause. I'll follow up as soon as I have an ETA, and in the meantime the export failures are likely tied to the same backend issue rather than a separate bug.

subject: Request: higher rate limits and webhook retry improvements for our integration
body:
We're integrating Northwind's API Platform into our student records system and are consistently hitting the 600 req/min limit on the /v2/students endpoint during peak enrollment windows, getting 429 responses that our retry logic can't fully absorb. With 1,416 seats this is becoming a recurring bottleneck each semester.

Separately, we noticed the webhook payload for enrollment.updated events still uses the deprecated v1 schema even though our SDK is on v2 - is there a timeline for when v1 webhook payloads will be retired? We'd like to plan our migration accordingly rather than get caught by a sudden deprecation.
answer: Thanks for flagging both issues. On rate limits, given your enrollment traffic patterns I can submit a request to raise your /v2/students limit for the Blue Health account - could you confirm your typical peak requests/min so we size it correctly? I'll also check with our webhooks team on the v1 payload retirement timeline and get back to you with a concrete date so you can plan the migration rather than be surprised by it.

subject: Need help rolling out MFA enrollment to all users
body:
We're onboarding all 23 of our Granite Freight users onto MFA in Identity and SSO and I want to confirm the correct process before pushing it live. Right now only our admin accounts have MFA enrolled, and I need to require it for the remaining standard users without locking anyone out mid-shift since our staff travel frequently and log in from different devices.

Can you walk me through how to set an enrollment grace period, and how to escalate a request if a user gets locked out while traveling and can't complete enrollment? We'd like to roll this out by next Friday.
answer: Happy to help get this rolled out smoothly before Friday. Under Identity and SSO > Security Policies, you can set MFA to 'required with grace period' and configure a grace window (we usually recommend 7 days) so traveling users have time to enroll without being locked out immediately. For lockouts, any admin on your account can issue a temporary bypass code from the user's profile, but if you need us to intervene directly, mark the ticket as urgent and reference the user's account ID and we'll escalate to our identity team same-day.

subject: duplicate alerts going to wrong team + escalation issue
body:
hey team, we've setup alert routing rules in Notifications so that warehouse delay alerts go to our ops team and billing alerts go to finance, but for the past week ops has been getting BOTH types duplicated, sometimes 3-4 copies of the same alert within a minute. its clogging thier inboxes badly.

also the escalation rule that should forward unacknowledged alerts to the on-call manager after 15 min doesnt seem to be triggering at all, we had a delay alert sit unactioned for 2 hours yesterday with no escalation. can someone check our routing config, we have 139 seats and this is becoming a real problem for the ops team
answer: Thanks for the detailed writeup, this sounds like two separate routing issues and I want to get them fixed quickly. I'm looking at the Granite Partners alert rules now to check for overlapping routing conditions that could cause the duplication, and I'll also check why the 15-minute escalation to on-call isn't firing - that's often caused by a misconfigured acknowledgment window. I'll follow up today with findings and a temporary fix while we investigate further.

subject: Charts rendering broken/blank after latest update
body:
Since yesterday's dashboard update, several of our charts in the Marketing Performance dashboard are rendering as blank white boxes instead of the bar and line charts we normally see. This is happening consistently across Chrome and Firefox for all 25 of our users, not just one browser.

When I try to export the dashboard to PDF, the exported file also shows the blank chart areas - so it's not just a rendering glitch on screen. Console shows a repeated error: 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading map) at ChartRenderer.js:214'. This is blocking our weekly stakeholder report due tomorrow morning.
answer: Thanks for including the console error, that's very helpful and points to a chart rendering regression from yesterday's release. I've reproduced a similar blank-chart issue on our end and I'm escalating this to engineering as a priority fix given your report deadline. As a workaround, try duplicating the affected chart widgets and re-adding the data source - this has resolved the blank rendering for a few other accounts while the underlying fix is deployed. I'll update you as soon as we have a patch out.

subject: Retention policy not deleting old backups
body:
We configured a 90-day retention policy on our Storage backups a few months back, but I just noticed backup files from as far back as January are still sitting in our bucket - the oldest one I can see is dated Jan 14th, well past the 90-day window. This raises a compliance concern for us since old customer data should have been purged.

We also noticed backup performance has degraded, with our nightly backup job now taking almost 3x longer than it did last month (from ~20 min to ~55 min). Can you confirm whether the retention job is actually running, and check if the slowdown is related?
answer: Thank you for flagging this - since it touches data retention I'm routing this through our security and compliance review process immediately. I'm checking the retention job logs for your Quill Systems storage bucket now to confirm whether purges have been executing as scheduled; if there's a backlog of data past the 90-day window we'll treat that as a priority remediation. I'll also have our storage team look at the backup duration increase in parallel, as it may be related to the same underlying job queue issue. Expect an update within the next few hours given the compliance implications.

subject: Email digest missing data / feature request
body:
I've noticed our weekly email digest from Notifications has been sending out with the 'Top Alerts' section empty for the last two weeks (Oct 2 and Oct 9), even though we had over 300 alerts logged in that period according to the dashboard. Is this a known bug?

Separately, it would be great if we could customize which alert categories show up in the digest - right now it seems to pull a fixed set and we'd like to filter out low-priority ones so the digest is more useful for our team.
answer: Thanks for reporting the empty Top Alerts section - that does sound like a bug rather than expected behavior, and I'll get our notifications team to check why the aggregation query returned no results for Oct 2 and Oct 9 despite the alert volume you're seeing. On the customization request, we don't currently support filtering digest categories, but I'll log this as a feature request on your behalf since it's a reasonable ask, and I'll let you know if it gets scheduled.

subject: Feedback on scheduled sync reliability + change request
body:
We've been running daily scheduled syncs through Data Pipelines from our logistics tracking system into our warehouse for about six months now, and overall it's been solid. Lately though we've noticed intermittent latency spikes on the connector - the 6am sync occasionally takes 45+ minutes instead of the usual 10, and a couple of times last week the data landed with duplicate rows that we had to manually dedupe.

We'd like to request a change to move the sync frequency from daily to every 4 hours to catch data quality issues faster, and wanted to flag the latency/duplicate pattern in case it's related to the connector itself rather than something on our end.
answer: Thanks for the feedback, this is helpful context. I've noted the request to move Vertex Systems' logistics sync from daily to a 4-hour interval - I'll get that scheduled and confirm once it's live so you can verify the new cadence. On the latency spikes and duplicate rows, that's worth investigating further; can you share one or two run IDs from last week where duplicates occurred so our connector team can trace whether it's an upstream data issue or something on the sync logic side?

subject: Users receiving duplicate alert notifications repeatedly
body:
Our team has been getting duplicate email alerts through Notifications for the same events - typically 2 exact copies arriving within seconds of each other, sometimes 3 for high-priority shipment delay alerts. This started roughly a week ago and is now affecting most of our 71 users, generating a lot of noise and support questions internally.

I checked our alert rules and don't see any obvious duplicate rules configured on our end. Could you check if there's a delivery issue on your side causing the email channel to re-send, and also point me to documentation on how alert deduplication is supposed to work so I can verify our config is correct?
answer: Thanks for the clear report - duplicate delivery affecting most of your users points to something on our email delivery pipeline rather than your rule configuration, so I'm escalating this to our notifications infrastructure team to check for retry or re-queue issues on Delta Travel's account. I'll also send over our deduplication documentation so you can double check your rule setup in parallel, but given the scope of impact I'd treat the root cause as likely on our end. I'll update you as soon as we identify the source of the duplicate sends.

subject: Connector auth failing intermittently on logistics feed
body: We have a Data Pipelines connector pulling shipment data from our logistics provider, and since Tuesday it drops the auth token about every 3-4 hours. The connector logs show 'token refresh failed: invalid_grant' and then the sync just stalls until we manually re-authorize. This is affecting our daily reporting for dispatch, and I'd like to know if there's a way to set a longer-lived token or auto-refresh so we don't have to babysit it. Connector ID is lp-conn-4471.
answer: Thanks for flagging this - a recurring invalid_grant on lp-conn-4471 usually points to a refresh token being invalidated server-side, often due to a scope or credential change on the source system. I'm escalating this to our connector team to check the token lifecycle on our end and will also send you steps to re-authorize with the correct scopes so it sticks. We'll update you within the day given the impact on your reporting.

subject: Invoice shows more seats than we actually have active
body: Our last invoice billed us for 22 seats, but when I check our user list in the admin console we only have 19 active accounts. Three people left the company back in March and I thought we removed their access then. Can you confirm how seat count is calculated and help us get the invoice corrected if we're being overcharged?
answer: Thanks for raising this - seat counts are based on accounts marked active at billing cycle close, so if those three users weren't fully deactivated (just disabled login, for example) they may still count. Please check under Admin Console > Users to confirm their status is 'Removed' rather than 'Suspended', and I'll review your last two invoices in parallel to see if a credit adjustment is warranted.

subject: Scheduled syncs not running since last night
body: Our nightly Data Pipelines syncs for the turbine sensor dataset stopped running around 11pm last night. The schedule is set for every 4 hours but the last successful run in the history log was 2024-06-11 22:03 UTC. We rely on this for morning reporting to plant operations and now we're missing 3 cycles of data. Nothing changed on our end - no pipeline edits, no credential updates.
answer: I understand the urgency given this feeds your morning operations reporting. I've pulled up the pipeline scheduler and can see the missed runs starting last night - we're checking whether this is tied to a scheduler service issue affecting other Enterprise pipelines or something specific to your dataset config. I'll have an update within the hour and will manually trigger a backfill for the missed cycles once we identify the cause.

subject: IP allowlist blocking legitimate office traffic after update
body: We updated our IP allowlist in Admin Console yesterday to add our new branch office range, and since then several staff at our original headquarters are getting blocked with 'Access denied - IP not permitted' when logging in. It seems like the update may have overwritten rather than appended the existing ranges. We need this fixed today as it's affecting close to 40 people across two offices.
answer: Apologies for the disruption this is causing your teams. It does sound like the allowlist save operation replaced the prior range set instead of merging it - I'm pulling the audit log now to see the exact ranges in place before and after the update so we can restore access quickly. Please hold off on making further allowlist changes until I confirm the fix, which I expect to have back to you within the next hour.

subject: URGENT: File uploads to Storage failing for all users
body: Starting around 8:15am today, every file upload to our Storage buckets is failing with 'Upload interrupted - retry limit exceeded'. This is blocking our warehouse team from uploading inventory scans, and we have a backup job scheduled for noon that will fail if this isn't resolved. We've tried three different files and two different browsers with the same result.
answer: This is being treated as high priority given the impact on your operations and upcoming backup job. We're checking storage ingest logs now for errors around 8:15am on our end and will confirm within 30 minutes whether this is a regional service issue. In the meantime, please avoid retrying repeatedly as that can compound rate-limit related failures - we'll update you as soon as we have root cause.

subject: Jira integration not creating linked tickets
body: We set up the Jira link under Integrations two weeks ago so that support cases automatically create linked Jira issues, but for the past several days nothing is syncing over. I checked our Jira project and no new issues have appeared since June 3rd even though we've logged at least 6 cases that should have triggered them. Can you check if the link is still active on your side?
answer: Thanks for the details - I can see the Jira integration on your account shows a connection error starting June 4th, likely due to an expired API token on the Jira side. Could you regenerate the token in your Jira admin settings and re-enter it under Integrations > Jira in Northwind? I'll also check on our end to see why the connection didn't alert you when it dropped.

subject: Audit log missing entries for admin setting changes
body: I'm trying to review who changed our billing notification settings last week for a compliance check, but the audit log in Admin Console only shows login events, not configuration changes. We need a complete record including who modified settings and when, especially for finance-related changes. Is there a setting we need to enable to capture this, or is this a gap in the current audit log feature?
answer: Good catch - configuration change logging is a separate toggle from login/access events. I'll walk you through enabling 'Detailed Settings Audit' under Admin Console > Security, but I want to flag that this only captures changes going forward, not retroactively. Given this is needed for a compliance review, let me know the specific date range you need and I'll check if we can pull anything from backend logs for that window.

subject: Question about deactivated user still showing in reports
body: I deactivated a former analyst's account in Admin Console last week, but she's still appearing as an active user in our monthly usage report. Not urgent, just want to understand if this is expected behavior or a display bug, and whether it affects our seat billing going forward.
answer: Good question - deactivated users can still appear in usage reports for the billing period in which they were active, since those reports reflect historical activity rather than current status. Going forward she should be excluded from seat counts starting next cycle. If you'd like, I can confirm the exact date her deactivation takes effect for billing purposes.

subject: Zapier integration broken - all zaps failing since this morning
body:
Every Zap connected to our Northwind API integration started failing this morning with error 'Authentication failed (401): invalid API key'. We haven't rotated any keys recently, and this is blocking our order sync between our manufacturing system and the rest of our stack. Here's the error from one of the failed tasks:

Task ID: zap-88213
Status: Error
Message: 401 invalid API key
Endpoint: /v2/integrations/trigger
Timestamp: 2024-06-12T07:41:02Z

We need this back up urgently since we have order data piling up unsynced.
answer: I'm sorry for the disruption - this looks consistent with an issue on our side affecting API key validation for Zapier-connected integrations this morning, and we're actively investigating. I've flagged your account (zap-88213 and related tasks) for priority review while our team checks recent auth service changes. I'll update you as soon as we have a fix or workaround, and we won't need you to rotate keys unless instructed.

subject: How to set up Okta app for Northwind SSO
body: We're trying to configure the Okta application for our Integrations setup so our support team can SSO into Northwind directly from Okta, but I'm not finding clear docs on which SAML attributes are required. Do we need to map group membership for role assignment, or does Northwind handle that separately after login? Any sample config would help.
answer: Happy to help get this set up. For the Okta app, you'll need to map at minimum the NameID (email) and a 'role' attribute if you want group-based role assignment to carry over automatically - otherwise users will default to a standard role on first login and you can adjust manually afterward. I'll send over our sample SAML attribute mapping and a short setup guide shortly.

subject: Gutschrift für ungenutzte Sitzplätze
body: Wir haben im Starter-Plan von Orion Freight vor drei Wochen zwei Sitzplätze gekündigt, aber auf der letzten Rechnung (Nr. INV-88213) wurden trotzdem 16 Plätze berechnet statt 14. Können Sie das prüfen und eine Gutschrift für die Differenz ausstellen? Zahlung erfolgte per Kreditkarte am 03.05.
answer: Vielen Dank für die Meldung. Ich habe die Rechnung INV-88213 geprüft und sehe tatsächlich eine Abweichung bei der Sitzplatzanzahl. Wir stellen eine Gutschrift über die Differenz von zwei Sitzplätzen aus, die auf Ihrer nächsten Rechnung verrechnet wird, und senden Ihnen zusätzlich eine Bestätigung per E-Mail.

subject: Update workspace name and default timezone
body: We need to rename our workspace from 'Orion Academy Test' to 'Orion Academy' and change the default timezone to CET so scheduled reports line up with our energy trading desk hours. Could you also confirm whether this change gets logged in the audit log automatically, since our compliance team wants a record.
answer: Happy to help with this. I can make the workspace name and timezone change on our end within the next business day, and yes, both updates will be recorded automatically in the audit log with a timestamp and the admin who requested it. I'll confirm once the change is live.

subject: question
body:
We've been running the manufacturing data pipeline for Orion Capital for about eight months now, syncing sensor readings from our plant floor connectors into the warehouse tables nightly. Most days everything lines up fine and the dashboards refresh without issue.

The problem is that a subset of sensor records from our older PLC gateways arrive up to 36 hours late due to intermittent factory network drops, and by the time they land the daily aggregation job has already closed that partition. Is there a way to configure the connector or sync job to handle late-arriving data, like a reopen window or watermark setting, instead of us manually backfilling every week?
answer: Thanks for the detailed context, this is a common challenge with edge-connected sensor data. Our Data Pipelines connectors do support a configurable watermark/lateness window on streaming sync jobs, which keeps a partition open for reprocessing for a set duration after the initial close. I'll send over documentation on setting this up for your connector type, and we can also review your specific gateway setup on a call if you'd like.

subject: IP allowlist blocking legitimate office access
body: Since this morning our analytics team has been locked out of the Admin Console from our Chicago office IP, which has been on the allowlist for months. We get 'Access denied - IP not permitted' even though nothing changed on our end. This is blocking three analysts from finishing month-end reporting for Summit Partners.
answer: I'm sorry for the disruption this is causing, especially during month-end. I can see the allowlist entry for your Chicago range but it appears a recent audit log cleanup may have deactivated it inadvertently. I'm re-enabling it now and will confirm within the hour once access is restored; please let us know immediately if the block persists.

subject: Need to restore storage from last week's backup
body: We accidentally overwrote a batch of itinerary files in our Storage bucket during a bulk upload test yesterday, and we need to restore the folder 'itineraries/2024-Q2' back to its state from June 3rd. Our retention policy shows backups going back 30 days, so I'm hoping this is straightforward. Please let me know what info you need from us to proceed.
answer: Thanks for flagging this quickly. We can restore the 'itineraries/2024-Q2' folder from the June 3rd snapshot, which is well within your 30-day retention window. To proceed, please confirm the exact timestamp of the overwrite and whether you'd like the restore to overwrite current files or create a separate versioned copy.

subject: Invoice shows wrong seat count for our team
body: Our latest invoice for Orion Robotics charged for 8 seats but we only have 6 active users listed in the admin panel. This has happened for two billing cycles in a row now and it's affecting our budget forecast. Can someone reconcile the seat count and issue a refund for the overcharge?
answer: Thank you for bringing this to our attention. I've compared your active user list against the billing record and confirm the discrepancy of 2 seats across both cycles. I'm processing a refund for the overage now and will also correct the seat count going forward so this doesn't recur; you should see the credit within 3-5 business days.

subject: Storage quota exceeded, uploads failing across team
body: Since around 2pm today, uploads to our Storage buckets have been failing with 'Quota exceeded - contact administrator' for Granite Retail, even though our documentation says we should have 5TB available on the Pro plan. We're at what our dashboard shows as 4.1TB used, so this doesn't match expected quota. Retention settings haven't changed recently. This is blocking our backup jobs from finishing.
answer: Apologies for the disruption to your backups. We're seeing a bug where quota calculations aren't accounting for deleted-but-not-yet-purged files still counted against your limit, which explains the mismatch with your dashboard figure. I'm manually clearing the phantom usage on our end now and will follow up within the hour to confirm uploads are working again.

subject: KOMPLETTER SSO AUSFALL - NIEMAND KANN SICH ANMELDEN
body: SEIT HEUTE MORGEN 08:15 UHR KÖNNEN SICH ALLE 211 MITARBEITER VON DELTA ANALYTICS NICHT MEHR ÜBER SAML ANMELDEN. WIR BEKOMMEN DIE FEHLERMELDUNG 'SAML RESPONSE INVALID - SIGNATURE MISMATCH' BEI JEDEM VERSUCH. WIR HABEN NICHTS AN UNSEREM IDENTITY PROVIDER GEÄNDERT. DAS GESAMTE UNTERNEHMEN STEHT STILL, BITTE SOFORT HELFEN.
answer: WIR VERSTEHEN DIE DRINGLICHKEIT UND HABEN DIESEN FALL SOFORT ALS P0 EINGESTUFT. UNSER TEAM PRÜFT GERADE DIE SIGNATURPRÜFUNG AUF UNSERER SEITE, DA ES GESTERN EIN ZERTIFIKATSUPDATE GAB, DAS URSÄCHLICH SEIN KÖNNTE. WIR MELDEN UNS INNERHALB DER NÄCHSTEN 15 MINUTEN MIT EINEM STATUSUPDATE UND ARBEITEN PARALLEL AN EINEM SOFORTIGEN ROLLBACK.

subject: How to filter audit log by admin role
body: I'm trying to review audit log entries for Granite Media but I only see a flat timestamped list with no way to filter by role or action type, like deactivations versus settings changes. Is there a documented way to export or filter this, or a how-to guide I might have missed? We have 273 seats so the log gets long fast.
answer: Good question, and thanks for the feedback on the flat view. Right now the audit log can be filtered by user and date range but not by action type directly in the UI, though the CSV export includes an action-type column you can filter after export. I'll share our how-to guide on exporting and also pass your feedback about in-app filtering to the product team.

subject: SSO role mapping not assigning correct permissions after login
body: After enabling SSO for Summit Analytics, all four of our users are logging in successfully but everyone is being mapped to the default 'Viewer' role instead of their assigned roles from our identity provider's group attributes. Our IdP sends the 'department' and 'role' claims correctly, we've checked the SAML assertion in the browser dev tools, but Northwind's role mapping rules in Identity and SSO don't seem to be matching. This is blocking our two admins from managing settings.
answer: Thanks for including the assertion details, that helps narrow this down quickly. This sounds like the role mapping rule is likely referencing the wrong claim name or a case-sensitive mismatch against your IdP's 'role' attribute; could you send us a redacted copy of the SAML assertion and your current mapping rule configuration? Given this is blocking admin access for your team, we're treating it as high priority and will investigate as soon as we receive those details.

subject: Duplicate alert emails flooding on-call inbox
body:
We've noticed that our on-call routing rule for the 'Line-3-Sensors' group is sending each alert twice, sometimes three times within a minute. This started around Feb 6th after we added a new routing condition for severity=critical. Our on-call team is getting duplicate pages for the same incident ID, which is causing confusion on the floor.

We have 10 seats on this account and only two active routing rules configured. Can you check if there's a bug in the rule evaluation causing the fan-out, or if we've misconfigured something on our end?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. Duplicate deliveries on the same incident ID usually point to overlapping routing rule matches, but given the timing right after your rule change we want to check server-side evaluation logs too. Could you send us the exact rule names and the incident ID of one duplicated alert so we can trace it end to end? We're treating this as high priority given the impact on your on-call process and will follow up within the hour with findings.

subject: Suggestion: allow time-of-day conditions in alert routing rules
body:
Our infrastructure team routes alerts differently depending on business hours versus overnight, and right now we have to manage two nearly identical rule sets with manual toggling by our regional admins. It would be great if the alert routing engine supported native time-of-day or business-hours conditions so we didn't need parallel rule sets.

This isn't blocking us today, just something that would simplify administration across our 2500+ seat deployment. Happy to share more details on our current workaround if useful for your product team.
answer: Thanks for the suggestion and the context on your workaround — this is a great use case for a feature we've had on our radar. I've logged this as a feature request for the alerting team with a note about the scale of your deployment and the dual rule-set overhead you're managing. We'll update this ticket if it gets scheduled, and feel free to add any additional scenarios you'd like supported.

subject: Biometric login broken for field staff, urgent for offline routes
body:
Several of our mobile users doing home health visits can no longer log in using Face ID or fingerprint since updating to the latest app version last week. The app shows 'Biometric authentication unavailable, please use password' even though biometrics work fine in other apps on the same device. This is a real problem because our staff work in low-connectivity areas and rely on biometric login to avoid re-entering credentials while offline.

We have 23 field staff affected across two regions. Can you escalate this and also point us to documentation on how biometric tokens are cached for offline use, in case that's related?
answer: I'm sorry this is disrupting your field visits — I've escalated this to our mobile engineering team as a priority issue given the offline dependency. Could you confirm the app version and device OS versions affected (iOS/Android and version numbers)? In the meantime, I'm attaching our documentation on offline token caching, which may explain the fallback behavior, and I'll update you as soon as we have a root cause or a fix timeline.

subject: Need IP allowlist management for admin console access
body:
We're rolling out stricter network controls and need to restrict admin console logins to our corporate VPN ranges only. I can see an IP allowlist field under Security settings but it only accepts a single CIDR block, and we need at least four separate ranges for our regional offices.

Could you confirm whether multiple CIDR entries are supported anywhere in the settings, and if not, point us to any documentation or roadmap for this? We'd also like to know how to deactivate the current single-range restriction while we finalize our list, without exposing the console in the meantime.
answer: Thanks for flagging this — the current allowlist field is indeed limited to one CIDR range per workspace in the standard settings UI, but multi-range support is available through our admin API for Pro-tier accounts. I'll send over the API documentation for managing allowlist entries, including how to safely stage new ranges before deactivating the old one. Given the security nature of this request I'm keeping this ticket with our Security and Compliance team until your rollout is complete.

subject: Workspace settings reverted after audit log export
body:
After one of our admins exported the audit log for our legal workspace yesterday, several workspace settings including the session timeout and IP allowlist reverted to default values. This deactivated the custom allowlist we had configured for our compliance team, and no one on our side made that change intentionally.

We have 208 seats and this workspace holds sensitive case data, so we need to understand whether this is a bug tied to the audit export action or something else. Can you check the audit log around 3:40 PM ET yesterday for any automated changes?
answer: Thank you for reporting this — settings reverting immediately after an audit export is unexpected and we want to get to the bottom of it quickly. We're pulling the audit trail around the timestamp you provided to look for any automated job or permission change tied to the export action. In the meantime, please re-apply your allowlist and session timeout settings as a precaution, and we'll follow up with findings on what triggered the reset.

subject: URGENT: Storage quota breach blocking all uploads, production down
body:
Since about 40 minutes ago every API call to our storage bucket 'lumen-prod-assets' returns 507 Insufficient Storage with error 'quota_exceeded: bucket limit reached'. We're on Starter tier and didn't get any warning email about approaching our quota. This is completely blocking our production upload pipeline and customers can't submit documents right now.

Can someone raise our quota immediately or tell us how to purge old objects fast? We're a 3-person team and have no fallback in place.
answer: This is being treated as a critical outage on our end — I'm escalating immediately to the storage team to review your quota and current usage on 'lumen-prod-assets'. While that's in progress, please avoid deleting objects until we confirm which are safe to purge, as we may be able to grant a temporary quota increase to unblock uploads right away. I'll update you within minutes with either an increased limit or clear guidance on retention cleanup.

subject: sso timeout to short pls help
body: our sso sessions log out after like 10 min way to fast for staff need it longer asap
answer: Thanks for reaching out — session timeout duration for SSO is configurable in the Identity settings under Session Policy. Could you confirm which SSO connection this applies to (SAML or OIDC) so I can point you to the exact setting and share our documentation on adjusting session and MFA timeout values? We'll get this extended for your team as soon as you confirm.

subject: Users stuck in MFA enrollment loop after SSO switch
body:
We recently enabled mandatory MFA for our SSO connection, and now three of our users get sent back to the enrollment screen every time they complete setup with an authenticator app. The error shown briefly is 'enrollment_incomplete: verification token expired' even though they scan the QR code and enter the code within seconds.

This is blocking those users from logging in at all. Can you check if there's an issue with token expiry timing on our SSO connection, tenant ID wsys-legal-01?
answer: Thanks for the details, including the tenant ID — that helps us investigate directly. A very short token expiry window combined with SSO redirect timing can sometimes cause this exact loop, so we're checking the enrollment token TTL configured on wsys-legal-01. I'll follow up shortly with either a config fix or a workaround so your three affected users can complete enrollment without hitting the expired token error.

subject: Jira integration link showing wrong project after Okta sync
body:
Our Jira integration for incident tracking was working fine, but after our latest Okta group sync last Tuesday, the linked Jira project in our Integrations tab now shows 'Media-Archive' instead of 'Media-Ops', which is the correct project we use for ticket creation. Nothing critical is broken since we can still manually pick the project when creating issues, but it's a bit confusing for the team.

Could you confirm whether Okta sync is supposed to affect Jira project mappings, and if there's documentation on how that link is determined?
answer: Thanks for flagging this — Okta group sync shouldn't normally change your Jira project mapping, so this looks like an unintended side effect worth investigating. I'll check how the mapping logic reads Okta attributes and confirm whether a recent sync change is responsible. In the meantime, I'll send over our documentation on how the Jira link determines project selection so your team has a clear reference while we look into the cause.

subject: Data pipeline connector lagging hours behind on late-arriving records
body:
Our reservations connector has been arriving 3-4 hours late for records with backdated timestamps, causing downstream dashboards to show incomplete daily totals. We first noticed this on Feb 10th when a batch of modified bookings from the previous day didn't sync until mid-afternoon. Our retry and watermark settings haven't changed recently.

This is affecting reporting accuracy across our travel operations team of 270 users. Can you check the connector logs for pipeline ID 'harbor-labs-reservations-01' and let us know if there's a watermark or windowing issue causing this delay?
answer: Thank you for the pipeline ID and the specific date — that will let us go straight to the connector logs for 'harbor-labs-reservations-01' and check the watermark windowing behavior around late-arriving records. This looks like it could be related to how the connector handles out-of-order timestamps rather than a retry issue, and we're treating it as high priority given the reporting impact across your team. We'll report back with findings and any adjustment needed to the windowing configuration shortly.

subject: How to route alerts to different email groups by department
body: We're rolling out Notifications more broadly across Atlas Academy and want alerts split by department instead of everyone getting the same email thread. Right now all 224 seats receive every alert, and we're seeing duplicate emails when multiple triggers fire on the same event. Is there a way to set up routing rules so IT alerts go to our helpdesk group and billing alerts go to finance, without duplicating notifications?
answer: Thanks for reaching out. Notifications supports routing rules based on alert category and tags, so you can map IT-related triggers to one distribution group and billing triggers to another. To stop the duplicate emails, check whether the same alert is subscribed under both a user-level and group-level rule, since that's the most common cause. I'll send over a short guide on setting up category-based routing so you can configure this yourself, and I'm happy to review your rule set once it's in place.

subject: Charts not rendering correctly on operations dashboard
body: Since yesterday morning our main operations dashboard has been showing blank chart areas where the weekly engagement graphs used to be. Refreshing the page sometimes brings back the bar chart but the line chart underneath stays empty. We also tried exporting to PDF and the export just shows white space where those charts should be.
answer: Sorry for the trouble this is causing your team. This looks like a rendering issue tied to the chart engine rather than your data, since the export is reflecting the same blank state. Could you tell us which browser and screen resolution you're using, and whether this happens on more than one dashboard? In the meantime, try clearing the dashboard cache from the settings menu, which resolves this in most cases while we dig into the underlying cause.

body: we noticed a refund that was suppose to go trough on the 14th for 3 seats we cancled but it never showed up on our invocie. our finance team is asking why the credit balance still shows zero and were getting charged for seats we dont have anymore. this is affecting our monthly reconciliation and we need this fixed asap
answer: Thank you for flagging this, and I understand the urgency for your reconciliation. I'm escalating this now to our billing team to trace the seat cancellation from the 14th and confirm why the credit wasn't applied to your account. We'll update you within a few hours with either the corrected invoice or an explanation of the discrepancy, and we'll make sure any owed credit is reflected before your next billing cycle.

subject: Dashboard charts broken across shared reports, blocking exec review
body: As of this morning, every shared dashboard we use for the leadership review is showing charts with missing data series, and export to PDF produces the same broken output. This is affecting dashboards shared with 243 seats across the organization, and our exec team meets in two hours expecting these reports. We've already tried refreshing and re-sharing the dashboards with no change.
answer: This has been escalated to our product support team immediately given the time sensitivity. We're investigating whether this is related to a recent change in the sharing or chart rendering pipeline, and we'll update you within the hour with findings. In the meantime, could you send us the dashboard IDs affected and confirm if this happens for all users or only certain roles, so we can narrow down the scope while the exec deadline approaches.

subject: Request to add native Jira linking to Integrations catalog
body: We're evaluating consolidating our incident workflow and need Northwind's Integrations to support linking tickets directly to Jira issues, similar to how we currently connect Slack and Okta. Right now we're manually copying identifiers between systems, which doesn't scale across our 293 seats. We already use Salesforce and Slack integrations successfully, so a native Jira link would complete our workflow and is a factor in our renewal decision this quarter.
answer: Thanks for the detailed context, and I've noted that this is a factor in your upcoming renewal. Native Jira linking is on our integrations roadmap, and I'm passing your request to our product team along with your use case around incident workflow consolidation. I'll loop in your account manager as well so we can discuss timelines during the renewal conversation and see what interim solution might bridge the gap.

subject: Retention policy question affecting backup quota
body: Our storage quota alerts have been firing for the past week even though we thought old backups were being purged automatically after 90 days per our retention setting. Looking at the storage console, I see backup files from over six months ago still counting against our quota. Can you clarify how retention is actually applied to backups versus regular file storage, and how we can free up space without losing recent data?
answer: Good question, and this is a common point of confusion. Retention policies for backups are configured separately from general file storage retention, so a 90-day setting on your main storage doesn't automatically apply to backup snapshots unless it's explicitly set there too. I'll walk you through checking your backup retention configuration and how to safely purge the older snapshots so your quota alerts clear up without affecting recent backups.

subject: Need to update billing contact and invoice format urgently
body: We're switching finance systems this month and need our invoices to include a PO number field starting with the next billing cycle, plus we need the billing contact updated since our previous admin left the company. Our current 13 seats are on the Starter plan and the last invoice was still sent to the old contact address, which is causing delays in our internal payment approval process.
answer: I've escalated this to our billing team given the timing with your next invoice cycle. We'll update the billing contact on file right away and add the PO number field to your invoice template going forward. Please send over the new contact details and the PO number format you need, and we'll confirm the change is reflected before your next invoice generates.

subject: Repeated transform failures in data pipeline connector
body: We're seeing consistent transform failures on our student records pipeline, roughly 40 to 60 records failing per sync out of about 12,000 total. The connector logs show validation errors on date fields that used to pass fine before our source system update last week. We'd like a way to flag and quarantine these failed records automatically instead of having the entire sync job show as failed, so downstream reports aren't blocked.
answer: Thanks for the detailed breakdown. This sounds like a schema mismatch introduced by your source system update, most likely a date format change that's tripping validation. We do support record-level quarantine so failed rows don't block the full sync, and I'll send you the configuration steps for enabling that on this connector. In parallel, please share a sample of the failing records so we can confirm the exact validation rule causing the mismatch.

subject: Langsame Dashboards bei großen Datensätzen
body: Unsere Dashboards mit den Patientenstatistiken laden seit einigen Tagen sehr langsam, teilweise über 20 Sekunden bis alle Diagramme angezeigt werden. Das betrifft vor allem die Ansichten mit mehreren Balkendiagrammen und dem Export als PDF, der teilweise ganz abbricht. Wir haben aktuell 4359 Sitze im Einsatz und mehrere Teams sind auf schnelle Zugriffszeiten angewiesen. Gibt es Möglichkeiten, die Ladezeiten zu verbessern oder Diagramme zu optimieren?
answer: Vielen Dank für die genaue Beschreibung. Bei großen Datensätzen mit mehreren Balkendiagrammen empfehlen wir, Filter auf Datumsbereiche zu setzen und einzelne Diagramme nach Bedarf zu laden statt alle gleichzeitig, das reduziert die Ladezeit deutlich. Wir prüfen zusätzlich, ob es bei Ihrem Konto spezifische Performance-Engpässe gibt, und melden uns mit weiteren Optimierungsvorschlägen für den PDF-Export.

subject: Understanding API rate limits and webhook retries
body: We're integrating our checkout system with the API Platform and keep hitting 429 rate limit errors during peak hours, even though our request volume seems modest for a Starter plan account. We're also unclear on how webhook retries work when our endpoint times out, since we've had a few missed delivery notifications this week. Could you point us to documentation on current rate limit thresholds and webhook retry behavior, and whether the SDK handles backoff automatically?
answer: Thanks for the details. Starter plan accounts have a lower default rate limit ceiling, which is likely what you're hitting during peak hours, and I'll send you the exact thresholds along with our documentation on rate limit headers you can monitor. For webhooks, retries happen automatically up to a few attempts with exponential backoff, and the SDK does handle this backoff logic for you, so I'll also share the webhook retry documentation so you can confirm the timing matches what you're seeing on your endpoint.

subject: Storage API upload failures - 413 and timeout errors since this morning
body: We're integrating the Storage API for our document management workflow and starting around 9:15 AM today, uploads to bucket 'nl-contracts-prod' began failing intermittently. About 40% of our PUT requests to /v2/storage/objects return 413 Payload Too Large even for files under 5MB, and the rest are timing out after 30s. We haven't changed our client code or file sizes recently. Can you check if there's a quota or retention policy change on our account that could be causing this?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report - we can see elevated 413s and timeouts on your storage bucket starting at 9:12 AM, which correlates with a backend node that was serving degraded capacity. We've rerouted traffic and are seeing error rates drop back to baseline; please retry your uploads now and let us know if you still see failures. We're also double-checking your quota settings to rule out any retention or backup policy conflict on our end.

subject: Request to switch invoice billing cycle to align with our fiscal quarter
body: Our finance team runs on a fiscal calendar that starts in February, and right now our Northwind invoices are generated on the 1st of each calendar month which makes reconciliation messy. Is it possible to shift our invoice date to align with our fiscal quarter start, or at least get a custom billing date? We're on the Pro plan and would like this to take effect from our next billing cycle if possible.
answer: Happy to help align this with your fiscal calendar. We can set a custom invoice date for your account, though the change will take effect starting with your next full billing cycle rather than retroactively. I'll coordinate with our billing operations team to configure this and will confirm the new invoice date once it's set, likely within 2-3 business days.

subject: Requesting fix for duplicate email alerts across our regional accounts
body: We manage notification settings for Atlas Freight across multiple regional sub-accounts, and since last week our warehouse ops team has been receiving duplicate copies of every shipment delay alert - sometimes 3 identical emails within a minute for the same event ID. This is happening across at least 6 of our 12 regional groups. Could you check our alert routing rules or point us to documentation on how alert deduplication is supposed to work so we can configure it correctly?
answer: Thanks for flagging this - duplicate alerts across regional sub-accounts usually point to overlapping notification rules or a webhook retry loop, and we want to get this resolved for your team given the scale involved. We're pulling the alert delivery logs for the affected regional groups now to identify the duplication source, and we'll also send over our documentation on alert deduplication and routing rule precedence so you can review the configuration in the meantime.

subject: How to request rate limit increase for our API integration
body: We're currently hitting 429 responses on our /v1/documents endpoint roughly 15-20 times per day during our peak media publishing window between 8-10 AM. Our current limit seems to be capped at 100 requests per minute which is tight for our workflow. Is there a way to request a higher limit, and do you have documentation on how rate limits are tiered by plan? We'd also like to know if there are webhook-based alternatives to reduce polling.
answer: Thanks for reaching out - the 429s you're seeing align with the default rate tier for your current plan, and we can look into a temporary or permanent limit increase for your account. I'll also share our rate limiting documentation which covers tier thresholds and includes a section on webhook subscriptions as an alternative to polling, which should help reduce your request volume during that peak window.

subject: Dringend: Deaktivierte Benutzer erscheinen weiterhin als aktiv im Audit Log
body: Wir integrieren die Admin Console API für unser Onboarding-System und haben heute Morgen versucht, 12 Mitarbeiterkonten über den Endpoint /v1/admin/users/{id}/deactivate zu deaktivieren. Die API gibt jeweils Status 200 zurück, aber im Audit Log erscheinen die Benutzer weiterhin als 'active' und sie können sich noch anmelden. Das ist bei uns mit 3249 Sitzen ein ernstes Sicherheitsproblem, da ausgeschiedene Mitarbeiter weiterhin Zugriff haben.
answer: Vielen Dank für die Meldung, wir verstehen die Dringlichkeit angesichts der Sicherheitsrelevanz. Wir sehen in unseren Systemen, dass die Deaktivierungsanfragen zwar verarbeitet wurden, aber ein Synchronisationsfehler zwischen dem Auth-Service und dem Audit Log vorliegt, wodurch der Status nicht korrekt aktualisiert wurde. Unser Team arbeitet mit höchster Priorität an einem Fix und wir deaktivieren die betroffenen 12 Konten währenddessen manuell auf Infrastrukturebene, um den Zugriff sofort zu sperren.

subject: SALESFORCE SYNC BROKEN - CONTACTS NOT UPDATING FOR 3 DAYS
body: OUR SALESFORCE INTEGRATION HAS NOT SYNCED ANY CONTACT UPDATES SINCE MONDAY. WE HAVE 11 SEATS AND EVERYONE IS COMPLAINING THAT LEAD STATUS CHANGES IN SALESFORCE ARE NOT SHOWING UP IN NORTHWIND. THE LAST SUCCESSFUL SYNC LOG SHOWS TIMESTAMP 09:42 AM ON MONDAY AND NOTHING SINCE. WE ALSO USE SLACK AND JIRA INTEGRATIONS BUT THOSE SEEM FINE. PLEASE CHECK OUR CONNECTION STATUS.
answer: THANKS FOR REPORTING THIS - WE CAN SEE YOUR SALESFORCE CONNECTOR SHOWS A FAILED AUTH TOKEN REFRESH STARTING MONDAY AT 09:45 AM, WHICH MATCHES THE TIMESTAMP YOU MENTIONED. WE ARE RE-AUTHENTICATING THE CONNECTION FROM OUR SIDE NOW AND WILL CONFIRM ONCE THE SYNC RESUMES, THIS SHOULD ALSO TRIGGER A CATCH-UP SYNC FOR THE CONTACTS THAT WERE MISSED DURING THE OUTAGE.

subject: Feature request: route critical alerts to a separate channel
body: Our ops team currently gets all Northwind notifications - from minor sync warnings to critical outage alerts - dumped into a single email inbox, which makes it hard to spot urgent issues quickly. We'd like the ability to set up alert routing rules based on severity, so critical alerts go to our on-call pager email and lower-priority ones go to a general inbox. Is this something on your roadmap, or is there a workaround using existing settings?
answer: This is great feedback and something we hear from other operations teams as well. Right now there isn't a built-in severity-based routing rule, but as a workaround you can create separate notification profiles filtered by alert type and assign different recipient addresses to each. I'll pass your request for native severity-based routing along to our product team as a feature request, since it sounds like it would significantly improve your workflow.

subject: IP allowlist changes not taking effect - locked out of admin console
body: This morning I updated our IP allowlist in Admin Console settings to add our new office IP range (203.0.113.0/24) and remove an old one, but now several of our finance team members including myself are getting blocked with 'Access Denied - IP not permitted' when trying to log in, even though our IP matches the new range. The audit log shows the change was saved at 10:03 AM but enforcement seems inconsistent. This is affecting our ability to process month-end approvals.
answer: This is a priority for us given the lockout impact - we can see your allowlist update from 10:03 AM in the audit log, but there appears to be a propagation delay causing some edge nodes to still enforce the old rule set. We're forcing a manual refresh of the allowlist cache across all regions now and will confirm once access is restored, which should be within the next 15-20 minutes; we'll follow up directly once it's clear.

subject: Duplicate email digest notifications sent twice this week
body: We're using the Notifications API to trigger weekly email digests for our billing alerts, and this week our subscribers each received two identical digest emails about 10 minutes apart, both timestamped July 8th around 7:00 AM. Our webhook logs show we only triggered the digest job once via /v1/notifications/digests. Is this a known issue on your end, or could our retry logic be the cause? Would appreciate any documentation on idempotency keys for this endpoint.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report - we're checking our digest delivery pipeline for July 8th around that timestamp to see if there was a duplicate dispatch on our side. In the meantime, I'd recommend passing an idempotency key with your digest trigger requests to prevent duplicate sends if a retry does occur on your end, and I'll send over our documentation covering idempotency key usage for the notifications endpoint.

subject: Question about alert routing setup for our support team
body: I'm setting up notification routing for our support engineers and want to make sure alerts about failed integrations go to our dedicated support inbox instead of the general admin email that's currently configured. I noticed some alerts seem to be arriving twice when I test routing changes - not sure if that's expected during testing or a bug. Could you point me to how-to documentation on configuring routing rules, or clarify the duplicate behavior?
answer: Happy to help with this - the duplicate alerts during testing are usually expected behavior if a previous routing rule hasn't finished propagating before you save a new one, so a short delay between changes should avoid that. I'll send over our how-to guide on configuring notification routing rules, which covers setting up dedicated recipient inboxes by alert type, and feel free to reach back out if you're still seeing duplicates after the rules settle.

subject: DEPRECATION DES API ENDPOINTS OHNE VORWARNUNG
body: WIR HABEN GERADE GESEHEN, DASS IHR DAS /V1/ORDERS ENDPOINT ZUM 15. NOVEMBER ABKÜNDIGT, OHNE UNS VORHER ZU INFORMIEREN. UNSER SDK VERSION 3.2 NUTZT GENAU DIESEN ENDPOINT UND DER RATE LIMIT HEADER X-RATELIMIT-REMAINING WIRD EBENFALLS ENTFERNT. DAS IST INAKZEPTABEL FÜR EINEN PRO KUNDEN MIT 86 SITZEN. WIR BRAUCHEN SOFORT EINE MIGRATIONSANLEITUNG UND MEHR VORLAUFZEIT, SONST ÜBERLEGEN WIR EINEN WECHSEL DES ANBIETERS.
answer: Vielen Dank für die deutliche Rückmeldung und Entschuldigung für die kurzfristige Ankündigung. Wir haben Ihr Feedback an das API-Team weitergeleitet und prüfen aktuell, ob die Übergangsfrist für Pro-Kunden verlängert werden kann. Ein Migrationsleitfaden für den Ersatz des /v1/orders Endpoints und den neuen Rate-Limit-Header folgt innerhalb der nächsten zwei Werktage per E-Mail an Ihr Team.

subject: Transform jobs failing on freight-rates connector since 06:40 UTC
body: Our nightly transform pipeline for the freight-rates connector has failed for the third run in a row, starting at 06:40 UTC today. The job log shows 'ERROR: schema mismatch on column carrier_id, expected INTEGER got VARCHAR' and the sync queue now has over 4,200 pending records. This is blocking our invoicing reconciliation for finance and we need it resolved today since downstream reports are already 12 hours late.
answer: Thanks for flagging this, we're treating it as a P1 and have escalated to the pipelines on-call engineer right now. We'll update you within the hour with a status.

subject: REFUND NOT PROCESSED AND SEAT COUNT STILL WRONG

subject: Duplicate charge on our 3-seat account, need refund

subject: Shared dashboard shows blank charts for viewer role

Could you confirm whether the affected viewers are external guest accounts or internal users on your workspace? In the meantime, I'd suggest re-sharing the dashboard once more with those three viewers, as this sometimes resets the chart-level permission cache.

subject: SSO users mapped to wrong roles after login, urgent
body: Since this morning, every user logging in through our SSO provider is being mapped to the default 'Viewer' role instead of the group-based roles we configured in the role mapping rules. We have all 4 seats affected and two of them are admins who now can't access billing or user management. This is blocking our team from working and we need this fixed as soon as possible.

As an immediate workaround, I can manually restore admin role assignments for your two admin accounts while we investigate the mapping configuration together. Please confirm the admin usernames so I can apply that fix right away.

subject: Card declined repeatedly, invoice still unpaid
body: Our card on file has been declined three times now for invoice INV-30987, even though the same card works fine for other services. We're on the Starter plan with 16 seats and I want to make sure our account doesn't get suspended while we sort out the payment method.
