subject: Alerts going to the wrong distribution list and duplicating
body: Our notification rules are set to send billing alerts only to the finance distribution list, but for the past few days every alert has also gone to the general operations list, and some alerts are arriving twice within a minute of each other. We changed nothing on our end recently. Can you check the routing configuration on our account and let us know why this started?
answer: Thanks for the clear report. This matches an issue we're tracking where alert routing rules can duplicate targets after a rule is edited without a full save cycle. I've reviewed your notification settings and see the operations list was indeed added unintentionally; I've removed it and reset the rule so alerts should only go to finance going forward. Please let us know if duplicates continue after your next alert cycle.

subject: Documents disappearing before retention period ends
body:
We're seeing files removed from storage well before the 90-day retention period we configured. Checking the job logs I found this:

2024-05-02 03:14:02 INFO retention-worker: evaluating bucket orion-legal-docs
2024-05-02 03:14:03 WARN retention-worker: policy mismatch, using default 30d instead of configured 90d
2024-05-02 03:14:03 INFO retention-worker: purged 214 objects from orion-legal-docs
2024-05-02 03:14:04 INFO retention-worker: purge complete, elapsed 1.02s

We've lost 214 files from a legal case folder that shouldn't have been touched for another two months.
answer: Thank you for sending the log excerpt, that helps a lot in tracing this. It looks like the retention policy for orion-legal-docs fell back to the 30-day default instead of your configured 90-day setting, which caused the early purge. We're checking our backup snapshots now to see what can be restored, and we'll also investigate why the policy override wasn't applied correctly. I'll follow up as soon as we know the recovery status.

subject: Question about offline mode behavior before mobile release
body: We're planning our next mobile rollout and want to confirm how offline mode will behave for our 128 users. Specifically, if a user opens the app without connectivity after a login token expires, does it show a login screen or a cached session error? We also want to know if any actions taken offline risk data loss or app crashes when reconnecting, since we had a crash report last month tied to offline sync.
answer: Good questions, and glad you're planning ahead for this rollout. When a login token expires offline, the app currently shows a cached session with limited read-only access rather than forcing a login screen, and any offline actions are queued locally and synced once connectivity returns without data loss in normal cases. Regarding the crash report, if you can share the device model and app version involved we can check whether it matches a known offline-sync edge case we're currently addressing.

subject: Connector auth failing repeatedly on Salesforce pipeline
body:
We have a Data Pipelines connector pulling from Salesforce that has failed OAuth re-authentication three times since yesterday (2/14 - 2/15). Error shown in the connector log is "token_refresh_failed: invalid_grant". This connector feeds our matter-management sync for 257 users, and the last successful sync was over 14 hours ago. We've already re-entered credentials twice via the admin console with no change.

Can someone check on our end whether the OAuth app registration expired or was revoked? This is blocking downstream reporting for our legal teams and we need it resolved today.
answer:
Thanks for flagging this and for the detail on the error code - invalid_grant on token refresh usually points to a revoked or expired OAuth app authorization on the Salesforce side, but I'm pulling the connector logs now to confirm whether the issue originated with us. I'll check the app registration status and the last successful handshake timestamp and get back to you within the hour given the sync impact.

In the meantime, please avoid re-entering credentials again as repeated attempts can trigger a temporary lockout on some Salesforce org configurations. I'll escalate this to our connector team immediately since it's affecting production sync for your organization.

subject: Webhook deprecation notice - need updated payload schema
body:
We received a notice that the v1 webhook payload format for subscription events is being deprecated, but the migration guide link in the email returned a 404 on your docs site. We currently have two webhook endpoints configured for enrollment.created and enrollment.updated events across our Starter plan integration.

Could you point us to the current documentation for the v2 payload structure, and let us know if there's a firm cutoff date? We want to make sure our small dev team has time to update the parsing logic before anything breaks.
answer:
Thanks for reporting the broken link - that's on us and I've flagged it to get the docs page fixed. In the meantime, here's a working reference to the v2 webhook payload documentation, which covers the updated field structure for enrollment.created and enrollment.updated events.

The v1 format is scheduled to stop being sent on April 30th, so you have a few weeks to update your parsing logic. Let me know if you'd like a sample payload sent to your test endpoint to make validation easier.

subject: Charts not rendering after dashboard share
body:
When I share a dashboard with another workspace member using the share link feature, several of the bar charts show up blank on their end even though they render fine for me. This is happening on our "Case Volume by Practice Area" dashboard specifically - the two line charts work but three of the bar charts just show a loading spinner indefinitely for the recipient.

I've tried re-sharing and also had the recipient clear their browser cache, but the issue persists. Could you help us figure out if this is a permissions issue or a rendering bug? We have 282 seats on this workspace and rely on shared dashboards for weekly reviews.
answer:
Thanks for the detailed description - this sounds like a permission scoping issue where the shared link grants dashboard access but not the underlying data source access needed for those specific bar charts. Could you confirm whether the three affected charts pull from a different data source than the two line charts that render correctly?

While I dig into whether this is a bug in how share permissions cascade to chart-level data sources, could you also send me the recipient's role in the workspace? I'll have an update for you within one business day.

subject: Dashboards taking 20+ seconds to load, need export while we wait
body:
Our team dashboard showing weekly ticket volume has been extremely slow to load over the past few days - it's taking upwards of 20-30 seconds just to render the first chart, and sometimes it times out entirely. We only have 8 seats on our plan but this dashboard pulls from about six months of historical data.

While you look into the performance issue, is there a way to export the underlying chart data to CSV so our team can at least work from a static file today? I don't see an export option on the chart itself, only on the full dashboard.
answer:
Sorry for the disruption this is causing your team - a load time of 20-30 seconds is well outside normal range and I want to get this fixed quickly. As a first step, could you tell me roughly how many charts are on that dashboard and whether the slowness started after any recent changes, like adding filters or new data sources?

On the export question, per-chart CSV export isn't currently available, only full dashboard export, but I'll pass that along as a feature request since it would help in situations like this. In the meantime I can walk you through triggering a full dashboard export so you have something usable today while we investigate the performance issue.

subject: SAML login redirect loop for a subset of users
body:
We're seeing an intermittent issue where a small number of users get caught in a redirect loop between our IdP and the Northwind login page after SAML authentication. It's not affecting everyone - out of roughly 4,562 seats, we've had about 30 reports over the past two weeks, mostly from users on our EU access group.

This isn't blocking most of our operations so it's not urgent, but I'd like to understand if this is a known issue with SAML assertion handling or something specific to our IdP configuration. Any documentation on troubleshooting redirect loops would be helpful too.
answer:
Thanks for the report and for the context on scope - since this is affecting a specific subset tied to your EU access group, it's likely related to how the SAML assertion's RelayState or NameID format is being handled for that group's configuration. I'll send over our SAML troubleshooting guide which covers common causes of redirect loops, including clock skew and assertion consumer URL mismatches.

Could you also share which IdP you're using and whether the EU access group has any distinct attribute mappings? That will help us narrow down whether this is configuration-specific or something we need to look at on our end.

subject: How do we stop duplicate unsubscribe emails going out
body:
Our users have been getting two separate unsubscribe confirmation emails whenever they opt out of a notification category, one right after the other within a few seconds. We only have 4 seats on our account and manage notification settings for maybe 50 external contacts, so this is a small volume issue but it looks unprofessional when contacts forward us screenshots asking why they got duplicates.

Can you tell us if there's a setting causing this duplication, or if it's something on your end we need a fix for?
answer:
Thanks for letting us know - duplicate unsubscribe confirmations are usually caused by a webhook retry firing before the first confirmation is marked as delivered, rather than a setting on your side. I'd like to check your notification category configuration to confirm this is what's happening rather than a client-side double-submit on the unsubscribe form.

Could you send me one example timestamp pair from a recent duplicate so I can trace it through our delivery logs? I'll follow up once I've confirmed the cause and let you know if any change is needed on our end.

subject: Request to enable MFA enrollment reminders for new staff
body:
As we onboard new finance staff each semester, we'd like a way to automatically prompt them to complete MFA enrollment within their first few days rather than relying on manual follow-up from our admin team. Right now we have 224 seats and it seems like enrollment status isn't visible anywhere until someone tries to log in and gets stuck.

Is there an existing feature for automated enrollment reminders or a provisioning report that shows which users haven't completed MFA setup yet? Even a simple dashboard view would help us track this each term.
answer:
This is a great use case and I want to make sure I point you to the right tools. We do have a provisioning report under Identity Admin > Reports that shows MFA enrollment status per user, which should let you filter for anyone who hasn't completed setup - I'll send you a walkthrough of where to find that.

Automated reminder emails for incomplete enrollment aren't available yet as a built-in feature, but I'll log this as a feature request on your behalf since it would clearly help with your onboarding cycle. In the meantime, the report should at least give your admin team visibility without needing to wait for a failed login.

subject: URGENT: backups deleted before retention period ended
body:
We just discovered that storage backups from January that were supposed to be retained for 90 days are no longer showing up in our backup list. Our retention policy is set to 90 days but backups dated Jan 3rd through Jan 10th are completely missing from the console as of this morning, even though we're only 45 days in.

We need these backups for a client audit next week and this is a serious problem for us - we're a small team of 21 seats and don't have a secondary backup source for that window. Please help us understand if this is a retention policy bug or if the backups can still be recovered.
answer:
I understand the urgency here and I'm escalating this immediately given the audit deadline you mentioned. I'm checking now whether this is a display issue in the console versus actual deletion from the storage backend, since a true early deletion within an active 90-day retention window would indicate a policy enforcement bug on our end.

Can you confirm the exact bucket or storage namespace these backups belong to? I'll have our storage team look at the underlying object logs directly to determine whether the January 3-10 backups still exist at the storage layer, and I'll update you as soon as I have findings, likely within a few hours given the priority.

subject: Jira-Verknüpfung erstellt falsche Tickets
body:
Wir nutzen die Jira-Integration, um automatisch Tickets aus unseren Slack-Kanälen zu erstellen, aber seit letzter Woche werden die Tickets im falschen Jira-Projekt angelegt. Wir haben nur 4 Lizenzen und die Integration war bisher korrekt mit unserem Projekt "EMB-ENERGY" verknüpft, jetzt landen neue Tickets stattdessen im Standardprojekt "TEST".

Wir haben die Verknüpfung in den Integrationseinstellungen überprüft und dort steht weiterhin das richtige Projekt. Können Sie uns sagen, ob es ein bekanntes Problem mit der Jira-Verknüpfung gibt oder ob wir etwas neu konfigurieren müssen?
answer:
Danke für die genaue Beschreibung. Es klingt, als ob die Projektzuordnung zwar in den Einstellungen korrekt angezeigt wird, aber im Hintergrund noch ein veralteter Cache-Wert für das Jira-Projekt verwendet wird - das kann nach einem Reconnect der Integration passieren. Könnten Sie uns das genaue Datum nennen, an dem die Tickets erstmals im falschen Projekt gelandet sind?

Wir schauen uns die Integrationslogs für Ihren Workspace an, um zu bestätigen, ob es sich um einen Cache-Fehler handelt. In der Zwischenzeit können Sie versuchen, die Jira-Verknüpfung einmal zu trennen und neu zu verbinden, das behebt das Problem in ähnlichen Fällen häufig sofort.

subject: App crashes when opening offline mode after sync
body:
Our field team uses the mobile app in offline mode to record survey data, but for the past two days the app crashes immediately after we tap "Enable Offline Mode" following a sync. answer:
Thank you for reporting this with the timing detail - a crash right after enabling offline mode following the recent update points to a likely regression in the sync-to-offline handoff, and I want to get this confirmed quickly since it affects your whole team's workflow. Could you send me the app version number showing in Settings > About, along with one device model and OS version from an affected phone?

While we investigate, rolling back to the previous app version is a reasonable interim step if it's available through your device management setup, and I'll confirm shortly whether we're already tracking this as a known issue with a fix in progress.

subject: SAML login fails with permission mismatch after IdP update

We'll follow up shortly with either a fix on our side or specific attribute changes needed in your IdP.

subject: PDF export returning blank pages on shared dashboards

As a workaround you can export to PNG per widget in the meantime, and we'll notify you as soon as PDF export is restored.

subject: Audit log missing entries for deactivated user accounts
body: We deactivated four staff accounts on October 3rd as part of our offboarding process, but none of those deactivation events appear in the Admin Console audit log. The documentation states deactivations should be logged with a timestamp and actor, but the log simply skips from October 2nd to October 5th with nothing in between.
answer: This is a significant gap for compliance tracking and we're treating it as high priority. We're pulling backend records to confirm whether the deactivation events were logged but not surfaced in the UI, or missing entirely, and will update you within the day. If the events are missing we'll also check whether other account changes from that window were affected.

subject: Getting duplicate billing alert notifications
body: For the past three invoice cycles I've been receiving the same billing alert twice within a few minutes, once for invoice INV-20481 on the 1st and again for INV-20482 on the 1st of this month. Both duplicates have identical amounts and timestamps down to the second. It's cluttering our finance inbox and causing confusion about whether payments actually failed.
answer: Thank you for flagging this - duplicate delivery on billing alerts points to a retry issue in our notification queue rather than duplicate charges, so your invoices themselves are unaffected. We're investigating why the same alert is firing twice for your account and will confirm once the dedupe logic is corrected. We'll also check your recent alert history to make sure nothing else was duplicated.

subject: Weekly email digest showing duplicated line items
body: Our weekly finance digest email sent every Monday has been listing several invoice line items twice since the September 25th digest. It's not a display issue on our end since forwarding the raw email to a colleague shows the same duplication. This is making it hard to reconcile totals against our accounting system.
answer: Thanks for the clear description - we've seen a similar report and it appears to be tied to a template change that rolled out around September 24th, causing certain line items to render twice in the digest build step. We're rolling back the affected template piece now and will confirm the fix takes effect with next Monday's digest, along with a corrected copy of the past two digests if needed.

subject: Question on upcoming API v1 deprecation timeline
body: We received a notice that several v1 endpoints, including /v1/webhooks/subscribe, are being deprecated but the email didn't specify a firm sunset date. Our team relies heavily on that webhook endpoint for order status updates and we need to plan the migration to v2 accordingly. Could you confirm the exact cutoff date and whether v2 webhook payloads are backward compatible?
answer: Good timing to ask - the current plan is a sunset date of January 15th for /v1/webhooks/subscribe, with v1 traffic starting to receive deprecation warning headers from December 1st. The v2 payload structure adds a few new fields but existing fields keep the same names and types, so your parsing logic should mostly carry over. We can send you the migration guide and a sandbox endpoint if you'd like to test ahead of the cutoff.

subject: Transform job failures causing downstream sync delays
body: Our pipeline pipe_7734 has been failing at the transform step intermittently since Monday, throwing 'schema validation error: field amount_cents expected int64, got string' on roughly 12% of records. This is causing a growing backlog and downstream syncs to our warehouse are now running over 6 hours behind schedule. We need this fixed or a workaround urgently since finance reporting depends on this data.
answer: We understand the urgency given the reporting impact - we're looking at pipe_7734 now and the schema error suggests an upstream source started sending amount_cents as a string rather than an integer, likely from a recent source-side change. We'll apply a temporary type-coercion rule to unblock the backlog immediately while we confirm the root cause with you, and will keep you updated on progress within the hour.

subject: Request to plan migration off deprecated API endpoints
body: I'm reviewing our API usage costs and noticed several deprecation notices for endpoints we still call heavily, including rate-limited calls to /v1/reports/export. Before we commit budget to updating our integration, I'd like to understand the new rate limits under v2, whether the updated SDK handles retries automatically, and if our existing webhooks will need reconfiguration.
answer: Happy to help you plan this out. The v2 rate limits are more generous for export endpoints, moving from 60 to 200 requests per minute per key, and the updated SDK (v3.2+) includes built-in exponential backoff so you shouldn't need custom retry logic. Webhooks will need to be re-registered against the v2 event schema, and we can send over a checklist so your team can scope the work before committing budget.

subject: Need help configuring SAML SSO with MFA enforcement
body: We're rolling out SSO for our workspace and need it configured so that SAML login is required alongside MFA enforcement for all 23 seats before we go live next week. I've uploaded our IdP metadata but I'm unsure how to map user provisioning so new accounts inherit the correct permission groups automatically. This is blocking our planned launch date.

To handle automatic provisioning with correct permission groups, we'll need your IdP's group claim attribute name so we can map it to our roles; once that's set up new users will inherit permissions on first login. Given your launch timeline, we're prioritizing this and will schedule a call today to walk through the metadata and mapping together.

subject: Bulk deactivation slow for departing employees
body: I manage user access for Blue Capital and need to deactivate 6 employees who left this week. When I go through Admin Console > Users > Deactivate, each action takes almost a minute to process and the page freezes briefly. With 23 seats this isn't a huge job but it's tedious. Is there a faster bulk deactivation option, or a CSV upload we could use for this instead of one-by-one clicks?
answer: Thanks for flagging this - bulk deactivation via CSV is available under Admin Console > Users > Import/Export, and you can select multiple users with the checkbox at the top of the list to deactivate them in one action rather than individually. The delay you're seeing sounds unusual for a 23-seat workspace, so we'll also check your account's performance logs to see if something else is slowing the page down.

subject: SAML login failing for all users - production impact
body: Starting around 9:10 AM today, none of our 162 employees can log into Northwind through our SSO. Users are getting 'SAML response validation failed' errors right after entering credentials on the identity provider side. We haven't changed our IdP configuration or certificates recently. In the meantime, admins can use direct username/password login as a temporary workaround if enabled on your account.

subject: Duplicate email alerts going to wrong distribution list
body: Since last week our billing alert notifications are being sent twice to our finance distribution list, and some system alerts meant for IT are also landing there instead. We have Notifications set up under Settings > Alert Routing with three rules, but it looks like two of them are overlapping. Could you send us a screenshot of your three rules under Settings > Alert Routing? We'll review the overlap and help you consolidate them so each alert only routes to the correct list going forward.

subject: Salesforce sync broken - records not updating for 242 users
body: Our Salesforce integration stopped syncing account records around 7 AM this morning. We rely on this for our manufacturing sales team of 242 seats to see updated customer data daily, and right now nothing has synced since yesterday. subject: Recurring card decline notifications - documentation request
body: I've noticed a pattern of card failures on our Northwind invoices over the past two billing cycles, specifically on the 3rd and 4th of each month. subject: Offline mode losing data when reconnecting

That will help us reproduce the sync failure and get a fix out as quickly as possible.

subject: Wiederholte Transformationsfehler in der Datenpipeline

subject: Frage zu fehlgeschlagenen Kartenzahlungen und Rechnung
body: Bei unserer letzten Abrechnung wurde die Zahlung mit unserer hinterlegten Firmenkreditkarte abgelehnt, obwohl das Kartenlimit ausreichend sein sollte. subject: Upcoming API deprecations affecting our integrations
body: We received a notice that the /v2/rate-limits endpoint is being deprecated next quarter, and I want to understand the full scope of affected endpoints for our API Platform usage. We have several internal services built on v2 across our logistics operations, and with 1194 seats relying on these integrations, we need a clear migration timeline. Could you share the deprecation schedule and any breaking change details?
answer: Thanks for reaching out ahead of the change - we're compiling a full deprecation guide for the v2 rate-limits endpoint and related v2 API changes, which we'll share with you this week. In the meantime, the main breaking change is a shift from header-based rate limit reporting to a new /v3/usage endpoint, and we recommend starting migration testing in a staging environment once the guide is available.

subject: Seat count on invoice doesn't match active users
body: Our latest invoice bills us for 94 seats, but when I check Admin Console > Users we only have 81 active accounts right now. We deactivated 13 employees over the past two months during a restructuring, and it seems those seats weren't removed from billing. Could you help reconcile this and let us know if we're owed a partial refund or credit for the extra seats charged?
answer: Thank you for catching this discrepancy - we're looking into your account now to confirm the active seat count versus what was billed. If the 13 deactivated users weren't properly removed from your billing cycle, we'll issue a prorated credit for the overcharge on your next invoice. We'll follow up within one business day with the reconciled numbers.

subject: Pagination cursor returns duplicate records after page 3
body:
I'm integrating the Northwind API to sync our product catalog and I'm seeing duplicate items when paging through /v1/products. Using the cursor from the response's next_page_token, pages 1-3 look fine but starting on page 4 I get several SKUs that already appeared on page 2. I'm requesting 100 records per page. Our catalog has about 4,700 items so this is breaking our sync job for Quill Foods.

The docs say cursors are stable for 24 hours but I'm hitting this within the same run, which takes about 6 minutes. Is there a known issue with cursor stability under concurrent writes?
answer:
Thanks for the detailed report. This matches a known edge case where pagination cursors can shift if records are updated between page fetches, since our cursor is currently based on last-modified ordering rather than a fixed snapshot. We're updating the documentation to call this out and looking at a snapshot-based cursor option for high-churn catalogs.

As a workaround, could you try adding the 'stable_sort=true' query param on your pagination calls? That pins the ordering to record creation time and should eliminate the duplicates while we investigate a longer-term fix. Let us know if that resolves it on your end.

subject: Need SCIM group sync to update roles automatically on user transfer
body:
We use SCIM provisioning from our HR system to manage Atlas Systems' 268 users in Northwind. When an employee moves departments in our HR tool, their SCIM group membership updates correctly, but their Northwind role/permission set doesn't change until someone manually triggers a re-sync from the admin console.

Can you add automatic role mapping updates when group membership changes via SCIM PATCH? Right now we're stuck doing manual reconciliation for every transfer, which is a compliance risk for us given how many role changes happen each month during our retail peak season staffing shifts.
answer:
Thanks for flagging this — automatic role remapping on SCIM group changes is on our roadmap but not yet live; today the platform only re-evaluates role mappings on full re-sync or explicit trigger, as you've found. I've logged a feature request tied to your account referencing the transfer/role-mapping gap.

In the meantime, I can share a script using our admin API that polls for SCIM group PATCH events and fires the re-sync automatically, which should reduce your manual work considerably. Would that help as an interim solution while the native feature is being built?

subject: Request: configurable lateness window for late-arriving transaction records
body:
We run daily aggregation pipelines over transaction data feeding our fintech reporting, and we're consistently seeing records arrive 18-30 hours after their event timestamp from one of our upstream connectors. Currently the pipeline closes the daily window at midnight UTC and anything arriving after that gets dropped from that day's aggregate, which causes reconciliation gaps we then have to fix manually.

Could we get a configurable lateness/grace window on the pipeline job settings, similar to watermarking in other stream processors? Even a simple 24-48 hour trailing window option would let us capture these late records without a full pipeline redesign on our end.
answer:
This is a great use case and one we've heard from a few enterprise pipeline customers processing high-volume connectors. Configurable watermark/grace windows aren't available yet in the pipeline job settings UI, but the underlying engine does support late-data handling that we can expose. I'm passing this along to our product team as a feature request tied to your account.

In the meantime, one option is to set up a secondary reconciliation job that reprocesses the prior day's window at T+36 hours to catch stragglers before final reporting locks. Happy to help configure that if useful.

subject: Late vendor invoice data missing from daily sync, need urgent fix or workaround
body:
Our logistics vendor feed connector is supposed to sync invoice line items nightly, but we're finding that invoices dated within the last day of the month consistently don't show up until 2-3 days later, after our finance close is already done. This happened again on the March 31 close and we had to manually re-run reports for Apex Energy.

With only 3 people on our finance team we can't keep manually re-checking every month-end. Can you either speed up the connector sync for late data or give us a way to flag/retry specific date ranges on demand?
answer:
I understand the pressure this puts on your month-end close, especially with a small team handling it manually. I've checked the connector logs for your account and confirmed the sync lag on late-arriving vendor records — this is affecting the specific connector job tied to your vendor feed, and we're prioritizing a fix given the close-date impact.

As an immediate workaround, I can set up a manual retry trigger for specific date ranges so you can re-pull the last few days of a month on demand rather than waiting for the nightly schedule. I'll follow up within one business day with steps to enable that on your account.

subject: Planning for upcoming API v1 deprecations - need timeline confirmation
body:
I'm coordinating our migration work ahead of the announced deprecations for the /v1/bookings and /v1/webhooks/subscribe endpoints. Our team supports a large integration footprint across Delta Systems' travel booking platform, and I want to confirm the exact sunset date before we schedule engineering resources.

The deprecation notice in the dashboard says 'Q3' but doesn't give a specific date, and we also need to know if the replacement /v2/webhooks endpoint has the same rate limit tier or if that changes for accounts of our size.
answer:
Thanks for reaching out early on this — planning ahead definitely helps for a footprint your size. The current sunset date for /v1/bookings and /v1/webhooks/subscribe is set for September 30, and we'll be sending a follow-up notice with the exact date locked into the dashboard banner within the next week.

On rate limits, /v2/webhooks uses the same tier structure as /v1 for enterprise accounts, so you shouldn't see a change there. I'm also flagging your account to our deprecations team so you get direct notice of any timeline adjustments.

subject: Transform step failing repeatedly on media asset metadata pipeline
body:
Since yesterday around 14:00 UTC, our transform stage for the media-metadata pipeline has been failing intermittently, with about 1 in 5 runs erroring out. The pipeline job ID is pipe-8837-transform and the error shown in the dashboard is 'transform step exited with code 137'. This is affecting metadata enrichment for Willow Analytics' content catalog updates across our 3,300+ seat org.

We haven't changed our transform script recently, and the failures seem to correlate with larger batch sizes. Can someone look into whether this is a resource limit issue on your end?
answer:
Exit code 137 typically indicates the transform container was OOM-killed, and the correlation with larger batch sizes you're seeing supports that. I've pulled the resource metrics for pipe-8837-transform and confirmed memory usage spikes above the allocated container limit on the larger runs starting yesterday afternoon.

As a quick mitigation, I'd recommend reducing your batch size by roughly 30% while we look at increasing the memory allocation tier for your transform jobs. I'm escalating this to our pipelines infrastructure team to get a permanent limit increase applied to your account this week.

subject: Getting 429s on API despite staying under documented rate limit
body:
We're integrating the API using the official Python SDK (v3.2.1) for our legal case management sync at Atlas Legal, and we're consistently hitting 429 Too Many Requests errors even though our request count is well under the documented 600 requests/minute limit for our tier. We're averaging around 380 req/min based on our own logging.

The error response doesn't include a Retry-After header either, which is making backoff handling harder on our end. Is there a burst limit that's separate from the per-minute limit that we're not accounting for?
answer:
Good catch on the missing Retry-After header — that's an SDK bug we're tracking for v3.2.1 and a fix is going out in the next patch release. On the 429s themselves, yes, there's a burst sub-limit of 50 requests per 10-second window that sits underneath the per-minute cap, which isn't currently documented clearly enough; I'm getting that added to the rate limits page.

In the meantime, spacing your requests to stay under roughly 45 per 10-second window should resolve the 429s even though your per-minute average looks fine. Let us know if you're still seeing throttling after adjusting.

subject: quota
body: Storage quota alert says we're at 92% but we haven't changed retention settings. Can you check?
answer: Thanks for flagging this — I checked your Delta Retail storage account and the quota increase looks like it's from accumulated backup snapshots rather than a retention setting change; retention policy on your account is still set to 90 days as before. I'll send over a breakdown of what's consuming the space and options to adjust the backup retention window if you'd like to free some up.

subject: How do we restore files from a previous backup snapshot?
body:
We had some project files accidentally overwritten last week in our North Robotics storage workspace and I'd like to restore from a backup snapshot taken before that happened, ideally from around March 18th. I can see backup snapshots listed in the dashboard but there's no obvious restore button, just view/download options.

Could you walk me through the restore process, or let me know if this needs to be done on your end for our workspace? Also curious if there's a limit to how many restores we can do on the Starter plan.
answer:
Happy to walk you through this. Restoring from a snapshot currently requires initiating it from the Storage > Backups tab — select the March 18th snapshot, then use the 'Restore to new folder' option under the three-dot menu rather than the download button, which only pulls a copy without restoring in place.

On Starter plans there's a limit of 3 restores per rolling 30-day period, so you should have plenty of room for this one. Let me know once you've located the snapshot and I can confirm it's the right one before you proceed.

subject: Slack alert integration completely down, no notifications since this morning
body:
Our Slack integration for incident alerts has stopped working entirely as of this morning around 8am. We rely on this for our small ops team at Harbor Energy to catch equipment monitoring alerts in real time, and right now nothing is coming through to our #alerts channel even though the integration shows as 'Connected' in the dashboard.

With only 4 people on our team we don't have anyone monitoring the dashboard directly, so this is a real risk for us if an equipment alert gets missed. Can someone look into this urgently?
answer:
I understand the urgency here given how small your ops team is and the risk of missing an equipment alert — escalating this now. I'm checking the Slack webhook status on our end for your workspace; initial logs show the webhook token may have been invalidated on Slack's side even though our dashboard still shows 'Connected,' which is a known display lag issue.

I'll have an update for you within the hour, and in the meantime please keep an eye on your email/dashboard notifications as a backup channel until we confirm the Slack webhook is reconnected.

subject: MFA enrollment stuck for new legal team hires
body: We onboarded 14 new attorneys this week and 6 of them are stuck at the MFA enrollment screen after SSO redirect from our IdP. They authenticate fine against Okta but Northwind shows "Enrollment required" in a loop and never presents the QR code. This is blocking access to case management dashboards. Affected users include jsmith-legal and dchen-legal accounts, tenant ID QUIL-588-LEGAL.
answer: Thanks for flagging this - a partial MFA enrollment loop affecting a subset of newly provisioned users points to a stale session token from the IdP handshake. Could you confirm whether these 6 accounts were provisioned via SCIM in the last 48 hours? In the meantime, please have them clear cookies for the Northwind login domain and retry, and we'll pull enrollment logs for tenant QUIL-588-LEGAL to check for a provisioning race condition on our side.

subject: Audit log missing entries for deactivated accounts
body: I was pulling our monthly compliance export from the Admin Console audit log and noticed that 3 user deactivations from last week (around Oct 3-4) don't appear anywhere in the log, even though the users themselves show as inactive in the directory view. We use this log for our quarterly access review, so the gap is a problem even though nobody is currently locked out.
answer: Thank you for the detailed report. Missing deactivation events in the audit trail while the directory state itself updated correctly suggests a logging pipeline delay rather than data loss. We're checking the audit event queue for your workspace around Oct 3-4 to confirm those entries were generated and will backfill the log view once located. I'll update you within one business day with findings.

subject: Zapier integration not triggering on new record creation
body: We set up a Zap connecting Northwind to our Slack workspace so finance gets notified when a new billing record is created, but it hasn't fired once since we activated it on Monday. The Zap history in Zapier shows "no data" for every check, even though I've manually created 3 test records since then. We were hoping to also eventually connect this to Jira but right now even the basic trigger isn't working.
answer: Sorry for the trouble getting this set up. Can you confirm which trigger event you selected in the Zap (record created vs record updated) and whether the Zapier connection shows as authenticated under your Northwind integration settings? A common cause is the webhook subscription not being re-registered after the initial test, so we'll check whether your account has an active webhook listener for that event type and follow up with next steps.

subject: Storage quota blocking uploads, need urgent fix
body: Our team can no longer upload delivery manifests to Storage as of this morning - every upload fails with "Quota exceeded, 100% used" even though we deleted about 8GB of old files yesterday to free up space. This is stopping our logistics team from processing today's shipments. We need either the quota recalculated or emergency headroom while we sort out retention settings.
answer: I understand this is blocking active operations, so we're treating it as high priority. Quota counters can lag behind deletions if the retention cleanup job hasn't run yet - we're triggering a manual recalculation on your account now and will confirm the freed 8GB is reflected within the hour. If uploads are still blocked after that, we'll temporarily raise your quota ceiling so your team isn't stalled.

subject: Bulk deactivation stuck at 40% for 1700+ users
body: We ran a bulk deactivation job through Admin Console this morning to offboard contractors after our travel season wound down, targeting around 1,720 accounts. The job progress bar has been stuck at 40% for over two hours and the audit log shows no new deactivation events since 9:14am. Meanwhile several already-processed accounts still have active sessions, which is a compliance concern for us.
answer: This is a priority issue given the scale and the security exposure of stalled sessions - we're escalating immediately. We're pulling the job queue status for your workspace to see whether it's hung or just running slowly under load, and we'll force-terminate active sessions for the accounts already marked deactivated as an interim step. Expect an update from us within the next 30 minutes.

subject: URGENT: Data Pipeline connector auth failures across all sources
body: All 12 of our Data Pipeline connectors started failing authentication at 2:47am UTC with "401 invalid_grant, token refresh failed" and none have recovered since. This is our entire ingestion layer for media analytics feeds and we've had zero new data land for over 6 hours. We suspect a token rotation issue on Northwind's side since nothing changed on our credentials or connector configs recently.
answer: We've confirmed a wide-scale token refresh failure affecting connector auth and have escalated to our pipeline engineering team as a P0 incident. Our current working theory is a regression in the OAuth token rotation service deployed overnight, and we're rolling back the change now. We'll post updates every 30 minutes on the status page and reach out directly once ingestion resumes for your connectors.

subject: Anpassung der Rate Limits für API Platform benötigt
body: Wir integrieren gerade unser Bestandssystem über die Northwind API und stoßen regelmäßig an das Rate Limit von 60 Requests pro Minute, besonders beim initialen Sync von Produktdaten. Können wir für unseren Account ein höheres Limit bekommen oder gibt es einen Batch-Endpoint, der weniger Requests benötigt? Ein SDK-Beispiel für Bulk-Operationen wäre auch hilfreich.
answer: Vielen Dank für die Anfrage. Für den initialen Sync empfehlen wir den Batch-Endpoint /v2/products/bulk, der bis zu 500 Objekte pro Aufruf verarbeitet und deutlich weniger Requests benötigt. Wir prüfen zusätzlich, ob für Ihren Account ein temporäres höheres Rate Limit während der Migrationsphase sinnvoll ist, und melden uns dazu kurzfristig mit einer Einschätzung.

subject: Mobile app crashes immediately when opened offline
body: Our field agents use the Northwind mobile app to log transactions while offline in areas with poor connectivity, but since the last update the app crashes on launch whenever there's no network connection. It gets past the splash screen then closes instantly - no error message shown. This is happening on both Android and iOS devices for our whole 5-person team, and it's blocking transaction logging during site visits.
answer: Thank you for the clear report - a crash on launch specifically in offline mode across both platforms points to a regression in the offline cache initialization from the recent release. We're marking this as high priority and reproducing it now on both Android and iOS. As a workaround, please have your team open the app once while on wifi or cellular before going offline, which should let the local cache initialize properly; we'll follow up as soon as we have a fix timeline.

subject: SAML login fails with signature validation error during integration
body: I'm integrating our identity provider with Northwind via SAML for our 6-person team and every login attempt returns "SAML Response signature validation failed" after redirect back from our IdP. I've double-checked the certificate uploaded in the SSO settings matches what our IdP is signing with, and the metadata XML looks correct on both ends. We need this working before we can roll SSO out to the rest of the team.
answer: Thanks for the detailed context - signature validation failures usually come down to a mismatch between the certificate fingerprint Northwind has on file and the one actively signing responses, even if the uploaded file looks identical. Could you send us the exact SAML response XML from a failed attempt (with any sensitive attribute values redacted) so we can compare signing algorithms and certificate thumbprints? We'll prioritize this given it's blocking your SSO rollout.

subject: Feature request: offline data sync scheduling for mobile app
body: Our field team uses the mobile app in warehouses with spotty wifi, and right now offline mode only syncs opportunistically whenever a connection appears. It would help our workflow if we could schedule sync windows or trigger a manual sync button so analysts know exactly when data has been uploaded rather than guessing. Would this be something you'd consider adding?
answer: This is a great suggestion and one we've heard from a few customers with similar warehouse or field environments. I'll log this as a feature request for a manual sync trigger and scheduled sync windows on the mobile app roadmap. I don't have a timeline to share yet, but I'll update this ticket if it gets prioritized for an upcoming release.

subject: Workspace-Einstellungen: Deaktivierung ehemaliger Mitarbeiter funktioniert nicht
body: Als Workspace-Admin bei Orion Freight versuche ich seit heute Morgen, drei ausgeschiedene Mitarbeiter über die Admin Console zu deaktivieren. Der Button 'Deaktivieren' lädt endlos, es erscheint keine Bestätigung und im Audit Log taucht auch kein Eintrag dazu auf. Wir haben nur 16 Lizenzen und müssen die Plätze dringend freigeben, da neue Kollegen warten. Außerdem finde ich die Option für die IP-Allowlist in den Einstellungen nicht mehr - ist die verschoben worden?
answer: Vielen Dank für die genaue Beschreibung. Das klingt nach einem Problem mit dem Deaktivierungs-Workflow, das wir uns sofort ansehen, da es die Lizenzverwaltung blockiert - wir stufen das als P1 ein. Bitte teilen Sie uns die betroffenen Benutzer-IDs mit, damit wir die Deaktivierung manuell auslösen können, während wir den Fehler im Audit Log und die verschwundene Allowlist-Option parallel untersuchen.

subject: CONNECTOR AUTH FAILING - ALL SYNCS DOWN SINCE THIS MORNING
body: OUR RETAIL CONNECTOR TO THE WAREHOUSE ERP HAS BEEN THROWING AUTH_TOKEN_EXPIRED SINCE 06:12 UTC. WE HAVE 14 PIPELINES DEPENDENT ON THIS CONNECTOR AND NONE OF THEM HAVE SYNCED IN OVER FIVE HOURS. DASHBOARDS ARE SHOWING STALE INVENTORY DATA ACROSS ALL 112 SEATS AND OUR OPS TEAM IS MAKING DECISIONS ON BAD NUMBERS RIGHT NOW. WE ALREADY REGENERATED THE OAUTH CREDENTIALS TWICE AND THE ERROR PERSISTS. THIS IS A P0 FOR US, PLEASE ESCALATE IMMEDIATELY.
answer: This has been escalated to our data pipelines on-call team as a P0 and we are actively investigating the auth failure on your connector right now. We can see the AUTH_TOKEN_EXPIRED errors correlating with an upstream credential rotation issue on our side, and we will push a fix and re-trigger the queued syncs as soon as it is confirmed resolved - we will update you within the hour with concrete progress.

subject: SCIM provisioning failing for new users, login and MFA blocked
body: We support Lumen Labs internally and since yesterday the SCIM push from our identity provider to Northwind is failing for any newly created user. The provisioning job returns a 409 with 'user already exists' even for brand new accounts, so these users cannot log in and MFA enrollment never triggers. This is currently affecting 11 new hires across two departments and is blocking their access to Northwind entirely.
answer: Thank you for flagging this, we understand new hires are locked out and are treating this as a P1. We are pulling the SCIM provisioning logs on our end to see why existing-user checks are matching new accounts, and will need one of the affected external IDs from your IdP to reproduce the 409 accurately. We will follow up shortly with findings and a temporary manual provisioning workaround if needed.

subject: Question about Jira link field mapping
body: I noticed that when we link a Northwind billing record to a Jira ticket, the amount field sometimes maps to the wrong custom field on the Jira side. It's not urgent since we can fix it manually, but I wanted to check if this is a known issue or if there's documentation on configuring the field mapping correctly for the Jira integration.
answer: Thanks for the detailed note. This isn't something we've seen widely reported, but field mapping mismatches can happen if the Jira custom field IDs changed after your integration was first configured. I'll share our integration documentation on remapping fields and will also log this as a minor improvement request for clearer default mapping behavior.

subject: Audit log entries missing for setting changes
body: We rely on the Admin Console audit log to track configuration changes, but I noticed that changes made to allowlist settings on October 3rd and 4th aren't showing up at all, even though we know two team members made edits. Other event types like login and role changes appear fine. This gap makes it hard to trace who changed the allowlist and when.
answer: Thank you for reporting this gap, it does look like allowlist configuration events are missing from a subset of audit log entries around those dates. We are looking into whether this is a logging bug specific to that event type and will confirm once we identify the root cause. In the meantime, if you can tell us the approximate change and team members involved, we can try to reconstruct the timeline from backend records.

subject: Scheduled syncs running hours late
body: Our nightly data pipeline sync is scheduled for 1:00 AM but for the past four nights it has started anywhere between 4:30 AM and 6:00 AM instead. This is pushing our morning reports past the 8:00 AM deadline our team relies on. There are no error messages in the pipeline logs, the sync just seems to sit queued for hours before running.
answer: Thanks for the clear timeline, a multi-hour scheduling delay with no errors points to a queuing issue rather than a pipeline failure, and we're treating this as P1 given the impact on your reporting deadline. We are checking the scheduler queue for your account to see if jobs are backing up behind other tasks, and will let you know what we find along with an estimate for when timing should return to normal.

subject: Invoice amount wrong
body: Last invoice charged us for 5 seats, we only have 3.
answer: Thanks for flagging this right away. We're looking into your account now to see why the invoice shows 5 seats instead of 3, and we'll issue a correction or refund for the difference as soon as we confirm the discrepancy. We'll follow up shortly with the details.

subject: Charts rendering blank after latest API update
body: Since updating our integration to the latest Northwind API version last week, several dashboard charts that pull from our custom data source now render completely blank instead of showing the line graphs they used to. The API calls return 200 with valid JSON when I test them manually, so the data seems fine, but the dashboard widget just shows an empty panel with no error. This is blocking us from demoing our energy usage reports to stakeholders.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report, and sorry this is affecting your upcoming demo. Since the API responses look valid but the widgets render blank, this points to a rendering regression tied to the recent API version change rather than a data issue on your end. We're prioritizing this as P1 and would appreciate a sample response payload from one of the affected charts so we can reproduce the rendering failure directly.

subject: CARD KEEPS GETTING DECLINED - NEED TO UPDATE PAYMENT METHOD
body: OUR CARD ON FILE HAS BEEN DECLINED THREE TIMES THIS MONTH EVEN THOUGH IT HAS PLENTY OF AVAILABLE CREDIT. WE HAVE 142 SEATS ON THE PRO PLAN AND CANNOT AFFORD A SERVICE INTERRUPTION. I WOULD LIKE TO UNDERSTAND THE PROCESS FOR UPDATING THE PAYMENT METHOD AND WHETHER THERE IS DOCUMENTATION ON HOW RETRIES ARE HANDLED SO WE CAN AVOID THIS GOING FORWARD.
answer: Thanks for reaching out about this. Repeated declines are usually caused by the issuing bank flagging recurring charges, so updating the payment method on file and enabling backup billing contact alerts should prevent future interruptions. I'll send over our documentation on the payment retry schedule and the steps to add a new card, and please let us know once it's updated so we can confirm the account is clear.

subject: Jira link integration stopped syncing tickets
body: We support Delta Energy and our Jira integration link that syncs incident tickets from Northwind to our Jira project has stopped working as of yesterday afternoon. New tickets created in Northwind are no longer appearing in Jira, and the integration status page shows 'last synced' timestamps frozen at around 2:15 PM yesterday. We haven't changed any Okta or Jira permissions on our side recently.
answer: Thank you for the details, a frozen sync timestamp with no recent permission changes suggests the connector token may have expired or the Jira webhook is failing silently. We're treating this as P1 since it affects your incident workflow, and we're checking the integration logs on our end now. Could you confirm whether any Jira admin recently rotated API tokens or app permissions, just so we can rule that out while we investigate?

subject: Storage quota reached on production bucket
body: I'm the data analyst managing our reporting exports at Blue Robotics and this morning our nightly upload job to Northwind Storage started failing with a 507 Insufficient Storage response. We're at 174 seats and our bucket 'br-mfg-reports' shows 98% quota used according to the dashboard. We need either a temporary quota bump or guidance on setting up an automated retention policy so old backups roll off before this happens again.
answer: Thanks for flagging this - I can see the br-mfg-reports bucket is indeed sitting at 98% of its allocated quota. I've applied a temporary 20% increase to unblock your nightly job right away, and I'd recommend setting up a retention rule under Storage > Policies to auto-expire backups older than 90 days so this doesn't recur. Let me know if you'd like help configuring that policy.

subject: URGENT: Biometric login broken for all mobile users after latest update
body: Since yesterday's app update, our field staff at Atlas Freight can no longer log in using Face ID or fingerprint on the Northwind mobile app - it just spins and then drops back to the PIN screen. This is affecting a huge number of our 4872 seats across warehouses that rely on quick biometric access during shift changes. Several regional managers have already escalated this to me and we're losing time on every clock-in.
answer: I'm sorry for the disruption this is causing across your warehouses - I'm escalating this to our mobile engineering team immediately as a major incident. We've had a couple of similar reports tied to the biometric token refresh in the latest build, and we're working on a hotfix; in the meantime, please have staff use PIN login as a fallback. I'll update you within a few hours with a fix timeline.

subject: Webhook deprecation notice and rate limits
body: I'm an IT admin at North Health and I received a notice that the v1 webhook event format is being deprecated. Can you confirm the exact sunset date and whether our existing endpoints will need re-registration under v2? Also, could you clarify the current rate limit per webhook subscription - we're seeing occasional 429 responses during peak hours and want to plan our SDK integration accordingly.
answer: Good timing on this question - the v1 webhook format is scheduled for sunset on the date shown in your account notice, typically 90 days out, and yes, endpoints will need to be re-registered under v2 with the updated payload schema. Current rate limits are 100 events per minute per subscription; if you're seeing 429s regularly, our SDK includes built-in backoff handling that should smooth that out. I'll send over the migration guide and SDK docs link shortly.

subject: Anfrage zur Salesforce-Synchronisation aktualisieren
body: Als Finanzmanagerin bei Lumen Academy möchte ich klären, ob wir die Synchronisationsfrequenz zwischen Northwind Integrations und unserem Salesforce-Konto von täglich auf stündlich umstellen können. Aktuell dauert der Abgleich unserer Rechnungsdaten zu lange und wir verpassen dadurch wichtige Reporting-Fenster. Gibt es dazu eine Dokumentation, die wir dem Team weitergeben können?
answer: Vielen Dank für Ihre Anfrage. Die Synchronisationsfrequenz lässt sich unter Integrations > Salesforce > Einstellungen von täglich auf stündlich ändern, wobei bei stündlicher Synchronisation etwas höhere API-Aufrufe pro Tag anfallen. Ich sende Ihnen gerne die passende Dokumentation sowie einen Link zu unserem Performance-Leitfaden, damit Ihr Team die Umstellung reibungslos vornehmen kann.

subject: Widespread upload failures blocking backup jobs across all regions
body: We're seeing upload failures across nearly every regional storage bucket at Atlas Freight since around 6am this morning. Our automated backup jobs are timing out with 'connection reset' errors before completing, and this is affecting retention compliance for our 4872-seat account. We need this treated urgently since backups haven't completed for over 10 hours now and our compliance window closes tonight.
answer: This has been escalated to our storage infrastructure team as a high-priority incident given the scale of impact. We've identified elevated error rates on the upload gateway serving several regions and are actively working a fix - I'll keep you updated every hour until backups are running normally again. In the meantime, I'd recommend holding off on retrying large batch jobs to avoid further timeouts while we resolve the underlying connection issue.

subject: Slack alerts not firing for billing events
body: I manage finance operations at Apex Travel and set up Slack notifications through Northwind Integrations to alert our channel when invoices are generated. The alerts worked fine last month but stopped appearing about a week ago even though the integration still shows as 'connected' in the dashboard. Could you help me figure out how to re-authorize or troubleshoot this?
answer: Thanks for the details - this is usually caused by the Slack OAuth token expiring silently even though the connection still shows as active. Could you try disconnecting and reconnecting the Slack integration under Integrations > Notifications? That should refresh the token and restore alert delivery. Let us know if the alerts still don't come through after reconnecting and we'll dig deeper on our end.

subject: Feature request: custom Slack alert thresholds
body: I'm a data analyst at Ember Media and we use Slack alerts through Northwind Integrations for our usage reports. Right now it seems alerts only fire on fixed thresholds, but we'd like the ability to set custom percentage triggers per project since we run several small energy-sector reports with different sensitivity needs. Is this something planned, and is it tied to our current plan?
answer: Thanks for the suggestion - custom per-project threshold configuration isn't available yet on our Starter tier, but it's on our roadmap for a future Integrations release. I've logged your feedback with our product team as a feature request. In the meantime, the closest workaround is setting up separate Slack channels per project with individually configured fixed thresholds.

subject: How to restore a specific folder from backup snapshot
body: I'm a support engineer at Apex Energy and need to restore a folder that was accidentally deleted from our storage account two days ago. I can see backup snapshots listed in the dashboard going back 30 days but I'm not sure how to restore just one subfolder instead of the entire snapshot. Could you point me to the right documentation or steps for a partial restore?
answer: Good news - partial restores are supported. From the Storage dashboard, select the snapshot dated two days ago, then use the 'Browse Snapshot' option to navigate into the specific folder and choose 'Restore Selected' rather than restoring the full snapshot. I'm also attaching our restore documentation which covers retention windows and quota considerations for partial restores.

subject: Backup restore stuck at 0% for over an hour - production impact
body: We're a support engineer team at Vertex Partners trying to restore a corrupted dataset from last night's backup snapshot, but the restore job has been stuck at 0% progress for over an hour now in the storage dashboard. Job ID is RST-88231. This is blocking our manufacturing line reporting that several teams depend on, and we need this moving again as soon as possible.
answer: Thank you for the job ID - I can see RST-88231 is indeed stalled, and we're treating this as a service outage given the production impact. Our storage team is investigating the restore queue now; initial signs point to a backend processing bottleneck rather than data corruption on your snapshot. We'll cancel and requeue the job on a priority lane and update you within the next 30 minutes.

subject: Users stuck during MFA enrolment step
body: I'm a data analyst at Blue Labs and we're rolling out mandatory MFA across our 1258-seat account this week. Several users report getting stuck on the enrolment screen after scanning the QR code - it just shows a spinning loader and never confirms the authenticator app pairing. This is happening across different browsers and we can't find clear documentation on troubleshooting failed enrolments.
answer: Thanks for the report - this is often caused by a time sync mismatch between the authenticator app and our server during the verification step. Could you have a couple of affected users check that their device clock is set to automatic network time and retry enrolment? I'm also sending over our MFA provisioning troubleshooting guide, which covers this and a few other common enrolment issues we see during larger rollouts.

subject: Duplicate shift-change alerts going to nursing staff
body: Since Monday our nursing teams have been getting duplicate push and email alerts for shift-change notifications through Northwind Notifications. Each alert is sent twice within about 90 seconds, timestamps 08:00:01 and 08:01:34 for example. We've had complaints from three different units at Harbor Works about alert fatigue this week. Can you check if this is a delivery retry issue or a config problem on our end?
answer: Thanks for flagging this, and sorry for the alert fatigue it's causing your care teams. This pattern usually points to a retry being triggered before the delivery receipt is confirmed, so we're pulling the delivery logs for your notification templates around those timestamps to confirm. We'll follow up within one business day with findings and, if needed, a fix or a workaround to suppress the duplicate send while we resolve it.

subject: Upgrading from Starter plan - a few questions
body: I'm looking at moving Apex Energy from the Starter plan to the next tier since we're adding two more users to our logistics team. Before I submit the change, I noticed the upgrade preview in the billing portal shows a proration amount that seems off - it's calculating as if we're already on 5 seats instead of our current 3. Can you confirm the correct proration before we proceed?
answer: Happy to help with the upgrade. It sounds like the proration preview may be pulling a cached seat count - we'll check your account and recalculate the correct amount based on your current 3 seats plus the 2 you're adding. I'll send over a corrected quote shortly so you can review it before confirming the plan change.

subject: Storage quota reached unexpectedly on media workspace
body: Our workspace admin dashboard is showing we've hit 100% of our storage quota, but our retention policy is set to purge assets older than 90 days automatically, and that job hasn't run in over two weeks based on the logs. Uploads for our production team are now failing with a quota exceeded error. We have around 2,200 users across Willow Labs relying on this daily, so I'd like to understand why retention cleanup stalled.
answer: Thank you for the detail. This looks consistent with a stalled retention job rather than genuine growth in usage, so we're checking the scheduler status for your workspace's automated purge task. In the meantime we can raise a temporary quota buffer so uploads aren't blocked while we investigate and get the retention job running again.

subject: Users getting logged out mid-session via SSO
body: For the past few days several finance team members at North Travel have been kicked out of their sessions after roughly 15-20 minutes, well short of our usual session length. They're prompted to re-authenticate through our SSO provider and sometimes get an MFA challenge again even though they just completed one. This is disrupting approvals in our billing workflows and it's happening to at least a dozen people so far.
answer: Thanks for the report - a session timeout that short is not expected behavior, so this looks like a session token or MFA re-validation issue on our side rather than your SSO configuration. We're reviewing the identity service logs for North Travel's tenant now and will confirm whether this is tied to a recent token lifetime change. We'll update you as soon as we have a root cause, and will prioritize a fix given the impact on your approval workflows.

subject: Email digests sending duplicate entries to all subscribers
body: We integrated the Notifications API to send daily email digests to our legal team, and since our last deploy on the 14th every digest contains each item duplicated twice in the body. I checked our payload and we're only calling the digest endpoint once per batch per the docs. This is going out to all 22 users at Delta Energy and it's making the digests unusable - can someone check the rendering pipeline on your end?
answer: Apologies for the disruption this is causing across your whole team. Duplicated content in the digest body while the API is only called once points to an issue in our template rendering step, so we're escalating this internally right now given it affects every recipient. We'll pause outbound digests for your account temporarily to stop the duplicate content going out while we push a fix, and will keep you posted within the hour.

subject: PIPELINE COMPLETELY BROKEN - data arriving hours late and support is useless
body:
This is the third time this month our pipeline sync has fallen behind and nobody has given us a straight answer. Our energy usage connector is supposed to sync every 15 minutes but data from yesterday only landed at 6am today. Here's the log we're seeing repeatedly:

[2024-05-21 05:58:12] ERROR connector.sync: timeout after 300000ms
[2024-05-21 05:58:12] WARN retry scheduled in 900s
[2024-05-21 06:13:20] ERROR connector.sync: timeout after 300000ms
[2024-05-21 06:28:45] INFO connector.sync: completed, rows=48213, delay=7h42m

We make decisions off this data every morning and it's consistently stale. Fix this or we're moving providers.
answer: I understand the frustration - repeated multi-hour delays on a connector that's supposed to run every 15 minutes is not acceptable and we're treating this as a priority issue. The timeout pattern in your log suggests the connector is hitting a resource limit on the source side before retrying, and we're pulling the connector run history for Atlas Labs right now to confirm. We'll get back to you today with either a fix or a concrete mitigation so your morning data is reliable again.

subject: Mobile app crashing immediately on launch for iOS users
body: Several of our field team members are reporting the mobile app crashes within a second of opening it on iOS 17 devices, right after the login screen appears. It started after the app updated itself yesterday. We've had 6 users at Cobalt Analytics affected so far, and reinstalling the app hasn't helped. Can you tell us if this is a known issue with the latest release, and if there's a way to roll back to the previous version in the meantime?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. We've seen a couple of similar crash reports tied to the latest iOS release, likely related to a login state check that's failing on launch, and we're investigating with our mobile team now. We don't currently support a manual rollback, but we'll send you a workaround or a hotfix build as soon as we confirm the cause, ideally within the next day.

subject: push notifications not working
body:
No push notifications since update. Log below:

E/FCM: registration token fetch failed, code=SERVICE_NOT_AVAILABLE
E/PushManager: retry limit exceeded, giving up after 5 attempts
answer: Thanks for sending the log - the registration token failure suggests our push service integration lost connectivity to the notification backend after the recent update. We're escalating this now as a priority issue since it blocks push delivery for all users, and will follow up shortly with either a fix or a temporary workaround for your team.

subject: Zugriff auf Audit-Log Funktionen für Compliance-Team
body: Wir bei Lumen Capital benötigen dringend erweiterten Zugriff auf die Audit-Log Funktion in der Admin Console, um Deaktivierungen von Nutzerkonten und Änderungen an der Allowlist nachvollziehen zu können. Aktuell sehen wir im Log nur die letzten 30 Tage, unser Compliance-Team braucht aber mindestens 12 Monate Historie für die anstehende Prüfung nächste Woche. Gibt es eine Möglichkeit, den Zeitraum zu erweitern oder einen Export bereitzustellen?
answer: Vielen Dank für die Anfrage und den Hinweis auf die anstehende Prüfung. Wir können für Ihr Konto einen erweiterten Audit-Log-Export mit bis zu 12 Monaten Historie bereitstellen, inklusive Deaktivierungen und Allowlist-Änderungen. Wir kümmern uns darum vorrangig und melden uns innerhalb der nächsten Stunden mit dem Export beziehungsweise den Schritten, um den Zeitraum dauerhaft zu erweitern.

subject: STORAGE QUOTA ISSUE URGENT
body: WE ARE GETTIN QUOTA EXCEDED ERORS WHEN TRYING TO UPLOAD BACKUP FILES SINCE YSTERDAY. OUR RETENTION SETTINGS SHOW WE SHOULD HAVE PLENTY OF SPACE LEFT BUT DASHBOARD SAYS 98% USED. THIS IS BLOKING OUR DAILY BACKUP JOB FOR SUMMIT CAPITAL AND WE ONLY HAVE 22 SEATS SO USAGE SHOULDNT BE THIS HIGH. PLEAS CHECK ASAP
answer: Thanks for reporting this - we understand a blocked daily backup job is disruptive and we're looking into your account's storage usage right away. A quota showing 98% for an account your size often points to old backup versions not being cleaned up as expected, so we're checking your retention settings and file history now. We'll follow up shortly with either a cleanup recommendation or a temporary quota increase so your backups can run.

subject: Duplicate charges on invoices #INV-4471 and #INV-4472
body: We were double-billed for our March invoice. Both INV-4471 and INV-4472 show the same amount of $6,240.00 charged to our card ending 0091 on March 3rd. Our finance team caught this during reconciliation and we need one of these reversed immediately since it's throwing off our AP close for the month. The billing portal is also loading invoice history extremely slowly right now, sometimes timing out after 30+ seconds.
answer: Thanks for flagging this right away - a duplicate charge is a P1 for us and we're pulling the transaction records for INV-4471 and INV-4472 now. If the charge is confirmed as a duplicate we'll process the refund to your card on file within 2-3 business days and send confirmation. We're also aware of the slow load times on the invoice history page and have engineering looking into it in parallel.

subject: Routing Slack alerts based on Salesforce and Okta events
body: We'd like to set up Slack notifications that fire when specific events happen in Salesforce (case escalations to Tier 2) and Okta (failed login lockouts for admin accounts). Right now we only have generic Northwind system alerts going to a #alerts channel and can't filter by source event type. Is there documentation on configuring event-based routing rules for Slack, or do we need to build this through webhooks on our end?
answer: Good news - you can set this up natively through our Integrations hub by creating separate alert rules per source connector, each mapped to its own Slack channel or thread. I'll send over our step-by-step guide for configuring event filters on the Salesforce and Okta connectors, and I'm happy to walk through the setup live if that's easier given your team size.

subject: Unsubscribed users still receiving duplicate notification emails
body: Several employees who unsubscribed from workspace notifications over the past week are still getting emails, and in some cases getting the same alert twice within minutes. We've had at least 40 staff members report this since Tuesday, and it's generating a lot of internal help desk tickets on our end. Can you check why the unsubscribe preference isn't being respected for our workspace?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report - this sounds like a sync issue between our preference store and the notification dispatcher. Could you send us 3-4 affected user IDs or emails so we can trace the delivery logs? In the meantime we're escalating this to engineering given the volume you're seeing, and we'll update you as soon as we identify the root cause.

subject: Mobile app crashes on launch after latest update
body: Since updating to the latest version on Monday, the mobile app crashes immediately on launch for most of our field technicians. It gets past the splash screen and then closes within a second or two, before login even loads. This is happening on both iOS and Android devices and is blocking about 60 people from clocking in job updates today.
answer: I'm sorry for the disruption this is causing your field team - we're treating this as a high priority issue. Could you confirm the app version and a couple of device models/OS versions affected? In the meantime, please have users try clearing the app cache or reinstalling, which has resolved similar launch crashes for other customers while we investigate the root cause.

subject: All scheduled pipeline syncs stopped running since Sunday
body: None of our scheduled data pipeline syncs have run since Sunday night. We have 14 pipelines feeding our reporting warehouse and all of them show 'last run: pending' with no error message. This is a hard outage for us since our downstream dashboards depend on this data being current every morning, and we're now two days behind.
answer: This is being treated as a service outage on our end and we've already escalated it to our pipeline infrastructure team. Could you share the pipeline IDs for at least a few of the affected syncs so we can check the scheduler logs directly? We'll keep you updated as we work through this and will confirm once syncs are running again.

subject: Transform step intermittently failing on legal document connector
body: We've noticed our transform step for the legal case intake connector fails about once every few days with a generic 'transform error' message, then succeeds on retry without any change on our end. It's not blocking us since retries work, but it would be useful to understand what's causing the intermittent failure, and whether a latency setting on our side might help.
answer: Thanks for the report, and glad it's not currently blocking your workflow. This pattern usually points to a timing issue between the source connector and the transform worker under load. We'll dig into the logs for your pipeline over the next few days and follow up with findings, and we'll also note this as a possible feature request for configurable retry/latency thresholds.

subject: Staff receiving duplicate alert notifications
body: Our staff have been getting duplicate copies of the same notification alerts, usually two emails within a minute or two of each other with identical content. This started about a week ago and is happening across multiple alert types, not just one. Could you look into whether there's a dedupe issue on the notification service, or let us know if there's a setting we're missing?
answer: Thanks for reporting this - duplicate delivery usually indicates a dedupe window issue on our end rather than a workspace setting. We're reviewing the notification service logs for your account to confirm the pattern and will follow up with a fix timeline. In the meantime we'll also log this as a feature request for a configurable dedupe interval.

subject: Slack alert integration down - Jira tickets and Okta SSO affected
body: Our Slack alert integration stopped posting Jira ticket updates as of this morning, and the Okta SSO connection tied to the same integration is also throwing an 'unauthorized' error when we try to reconnect. This is affecting alerting for our entire finance and IT ops teams across all 2,202 seats, and we rely on this for incident escalation. We need this restored urgently.
answer: I understand the urgency given how many teams depend on this - we're escalating this immediately as a P1. Can you confirm the exact error message and timestamp from the Okta reconnect attempt? We're checking our Slack and Jira connector logs on our side right now and will update you within the hour with findings or a workaround.

subject: IP-Allowlist blockiert Admin-Zugriff
body:
Wir nutzen Northwind seit über einem Jahr für unsere Buchhaltung und haben letzte Woche im Admin Console die IP-Allowlist-Funktion aktiviert, weil unser Audit-Team das für die Compliance-Prüfung verlangt hat. Zuerst lief alles normal, wir haben die Büro-IP eingetragen und alles getestet.

Seit heute Morgen kommt aber niemand mehr ins Admin Console, nicht einmal von der eingetragenen IP aus - wir bekommen nur 'Access denied' und das Audit Log zeigt gar keine Einträge mehr an. Das ist inakzeptabel, wir zahlen für 13 Lizenzen und können nicht mal mehr unsere eigenen Nutzer verwalten. Wenn das nicht heute gelöst wird, kündigen wir den Vertrag.
answer: Das tut mir sehr leid, ich verstehe die Frustration bei einem Zugriffsproblem dieser Art voll und ganz.
