Können Sie mir die genaue IP-Adresse nennen, die Sie hinterlegt haben, sowie die Uhrzeit des ersten 'Access denied' Fehlers? Wir prüfen sofort, ob die Allowlist-Konfiguration korrekt gespeichert wurde und melden uns umgehend mit einem Lösungsweg, damit der Zugriff schnellstmöglich wiederhergestellt wird.

subject: Pagination bug dropping records from webhook feed - data loss
body: We discovered that our webhook consumer has been missing records since yesterday due to a pagination bug in the API Platform's list endpoints. When paging through /v2/records with a cursor, page 3 of 5 returns duplicate items from page 2 and skips roughly 200 records entirely, which means those never fired webhook events downstream. We rely on this for patient record sync and this is causing active data loss for our production integration right now. We're also on the deprecated SDK v3 client, if that's relevant.
answer: This is being escalated immediately as a P0 given the active data loss on your patient record sync. Please pause your webhook consumer if possible while we investigate the cursor logic on the affected endpoint. We're pulling the request logs for your API key now to identify the exact skipped record range so we can help you backfill, and we'll update you within the hour, including guidance on migrating off SDK v3 to avoid this pagination issue going forward.

subject: Duplicate email digests being sent
body:
We're integrating the Notifications API to send weekly email digests to our case managers at Quill Legal. Since Monday, some recipients are getting the same digest twice within a few minutes, both with identical content and timestamps. I checked our webhook calls and we're only triggering the digest job once per user per day.

Can you confirm on your end whether the digest scheduler might be firing twice, or if there's a dedup window we should be aware of? Happy to share request IDs if useful.
answer:
Thanks for flagging this and for checking your own trigger logic first. We've seen a small number of duplicate digest sends tied to a retry in our delivery worker that doesn't always respect the idempotency key when a downstream email provider times out. Could you send us two or three of the duplicated message IDs or recipient addresses with timestamps so we can trace the exact retry event?

In the meantime this is cosmetic (no data issue), so no action needed on your side. We'll follow up here once we've confirmed the root cause and whether a fix or dedup patch is needed.

subject: WEBHOOKS COMPLETELY BROKEN - losing transactions
body:
This is unacceptable. Our webhook endpoint has been silently dropping events since 14:20 UTC today and we're a fintech company, this is order and payment data. Our SDK integration hasn't changed in weeks.

Here's what we're getting in our logs:

2024-06-11T14:22:01Z ERROR webhook.dispatch failed status=429 endpoint=/v2/webhooks/deliver
2024-06-11T14:22:03Z ERROR retry_exhausted event_id=evt_9f83ka attempts=5
2024-06-11T14:25:11Z ERROR webhook.dispatch failed status=429 endpoint=/v2/webhooks/deliver
2024-06-11T14:25:12Z ERROR retry_exhausted event_id=evt_9f83kb attempts=5

We are getting rate limited on OUR OWN webhook deliveries and nobody told us limits changed. We have 68 seats on this account and if this isn't fixed today we will be looking at other vendors.
answer:
We understand the severity here and have escalated this to our platform on-call team immediately. Our records show a rate limit threshold was adjusted on the webhook delivery service on June 10th that appears to be affecting accounts with high event volume more aggressively than intended; this matches the 429s you're seeing starting at 14:20 UTC.

We are rolling back the threshold change for your account right now and will confirm within the hour once deliveries resume normally. We'll also manually replay the events with the exhausted retries (evt_9f83ka, evt_9f83kb, and any others in that window) once the rollback is confirmed so no data is permanently lost.

subject: App crashes every time on launch, staff can't work
body:
Our mobile app has been crashing on launch since this morning for basically every field staff member using it, this is a serious problem. It gets past the splash screen and then closes immediately, no error message shown to the user. We have 24 seats and this is affecting warehouse staff trying to scan inventory offline.

We already tried reinstalling on two devices and it still crashes. This is costing us real time and money right now, we need this fixed today.
answer:
I'm sorry for the disruption this is causing your warehouse team, I know this is blocking real work right now. We're treating this as high priority and pulling crash logs from our side immediately. Could you tell us the device models and OS versions affected, and roughly what app version is installed (visible under Settings > About)?

While we investigate, if any devices are on a version older than the latest release, forcing an update through your device management tool may resolve it faster than waiting on our fix, since we had a related offline-cache issue patched last week. We'll update you within the hour.

subject: URGENT: IP allowlist change locked out entire admin team
body:
At 09:14 UTC we updated our IP allowlist in Admin Console to add our new office range, and immediately after saving, every admin at Lumen Travel lost access to the console, including via VPN. We have 622 seats and no one can currently manage user provisioning or security settings.

The error shown is "Access denied: your IP is not permitted for this account." We suspect the new CIDR range we entered overwrote the existing entries instead of appending to them. We need emergency access restored as this is blocking all admin operations company-wide.
answer:
This is being treated as an emergency and we've escalated to our infrastructure team right now. You're right that a saved allowlist update can replace the full list rather than append, which matches what you're describing. We are applying an emergency override on our side to restore access for your account's registered admin contacts immediately so you can get back into the console.

Once access is confirmed restored, please do not resave the allowlist field until we walk you through the correct append format, we'll follow up within minutes with steps to safely add the new range without removing existing entries.

subject: Repeated upload failures to Storage, need retention review
body:
We've been seeing intermittent upload failures to Storage over the past week, mostly on files over 500MB, affecting our logistics documentation workflow at Granite Partners. The error we see is "upload interrupted, please retry" and it sometimes takes 3-4 attempts to succeed.

Separately, we'd like to understand our current retention and backup settings, and whether there's a way to get quota usage alerts before we hit our limit, since we're close to capacity with 139 seats using the system daily.
answer:
Thanks for the detailed report. The intermittent failures on large files are likely related to a timeout on longer-running uploads rather than quota, but we'll check your account's upload logs from this past week to confirm and see if there's a pattern by time of day or file type.

On retention and backups, I can confirm your current policy and backup frequency, and we do support quota usage alert thresholds that can be configured per account. I'll send over your current settings and a short guide for setting up the alert so you have advance warning before hitting capacity.

subject: PDF export missing charts entirely
body:
I'm trying to export a dashboard to PDF for a board report due this week and the exported file only contains the text widgets, all three charts are just blank white boxes where they should be. This happens on every dashboard I try, not just one.

We're on the Starter plan with 25 seats at Quill Travel, in case that matters for feature availability. Is this a known limitation of PDF export or is something broken? I need a working export by Thursday if at all possible.
answer:
Thanks for the clear description, and apologies for the timing given your deadline. Chart rendering in PDF export can fail if a chart uses certain interactive elements (like drill-downs or live filters) that don't render in the static export path; this is a known limitation rather than a bug for those chart types, but it shouldn't affect standard bar or line charts.

Could you tell us which chart types are affected so we can confirm whether this is the limitation or an actual rendering bug? In the meantime, exporting individual charts as images and inserting them into your report is a reliable workaround before Thursday.

subject: Offline mode not syncing data after reconnect
body:
I use the mobile app to review student engagement data while traveling between campuses, often without signal. When offline mode is active I can view previously loaded reports, but after reconnecting to wifi the app doesn't seem to sync new data automatically, I have to force-close and reopen the app for updates to appear.

Also, I noticed push notifications for report updates stop coming through entirely once I've used offline mode that session. Is this expected behavior or a bug? We're a small team of 10 seats so this happens daily.
answer:
Thanks for the detailed description, this is helpful. The delayed sync on reconnect is a known behavior in the current app version, the sync check runs on an interval rather than triggering instantly on network change, so a manual refresh or restart does speed it up in the meantime.

The push notification drop-off after offline use sounds like a separate issue though, notifications shouldn't be affected by offline mode. Could you confirm your app version from Settings > About? We'd like to check if this is tied to a specific release.

subject: Need to upgrade plan and add seats before term renewal
body:
I manage IT for Ember Partners and we're currently on Starter with 11 seats, but we're onboarding two new departments next month and will need more seats plus features that I believe are only on the Pro plan, like advanced permission groups. Can you walk me through how to upgrade the plan and add seats, and whether this can be timed with our renewal to avoid a prorated charge mid-cycle?

Also, is there a way to preview Pro plan features before committing, even just documentation would help.
answer:
Thanks for planning ahead on this. Upgrading from Starter to Pro along with adding seats can be done anytime from your account's billing page, and yes, we can align the change with your renewal date so you avoid a prorated mid-cycle charge, just let us know your renewal date and we'll schedule it to take effect then.

For a preview of Pro features including advanced permission groups, I'll send over our plan comparison documentation now so you can review with your team before the switch goes live.

subject: SSO role mapping not assigning correct permissions
body:
We set up SSO for Granite Travel last week and configured role mapping so that users in our "Ops-Manager" group get admin-level permissions in Northwind, but new users logging in through SSO are landing with default viewer permissions instead. We've double checked the group name matches exactly what's in our identity provider.

We only have 8 seats so this is affecting most of our team right now, and it's forcing us to manually update permissions after every new login, which defeats the purpose of the mapping. Can you help us figure out what's misconfigured?
answer:
Thanks for the detailed setup info, that helps narrow this down. A common cause of this is the group attribute name or claim format not matching exactly what Northwind expects, even small differences like casing or an extra namespace prefix in the SAML/OIDC assertion can cause the mapping to silently fall back to the default role.

Could you send us a sample of the group claim as it appears in your IdP's assertion (screenshot or raw XML/JSON with any personal identifiers removed)? We'll compare it against your role mapping config and identify the mismatch.

subject: Role mapping broken again, this is the second time
body:
I'm integrating SSO role mapping for Granite Legal via the Identity API and it is STILL not working correctly, roles assigned through the API are not reflecting in the console permissions view for at least a dozen test users. We reported something similar to this two months ago and were told it was fixed.

The API call returns 200 with the role field set correctly in the response body, but the user shows up with no role assigned when I check the admin console afterward. This is blocking our security compliance review and I'm frankly frustrated we're dealing with this again with 243 seats on this account.
answer:
I hear your frustration, and I'm sorry this is resurfacing during your compliance review. A 200 response with the role field set but no reflection in the console usually points to a sync delay or a caching issue between the Identity API write path and the console read path, rather than the same root cause as before, but we're treating it as a priority regardless.

Can you send us two or three of the affected user IDs along with the exact API request and response payloads? We'll trace the write-through on our end and confirm whether this is a caching lag or a deeper regression, and update you with findings as soon as possible.

subject: Urgent
body: OUR PYTHON SDK STARTED THROWING ERRORS AROUND 8AM TODAY. WE GET NORTHWINDAPIERROR: WEBHOOK SIGNATURE VALIDATION FAILED ON EVERY INCOMING WEBHOOK CALL, AND SEPARATELY A 429 RATE LIMIT ERROR EVEN THOUGH WE ARE WELL UNDER OUR QUOTA. THIS IS BLOCKING OUR PRODUCTION ANALYTICS PIPELINE. WE ARE ON SDK VERSION 4.2.1 AND SAW A DEPRECATION NOTICE LAST WEEK ABOUT SDK 4.X, IS THAT RELATED? PLEASE HELP ASAP, THIS IS AFFECTING ALL OUR USERS.
answer: Thanks for flagging this, I understand how disruptive this is and I'm treating it as a P1. The webhook signature failures are likely tied to the SDK 4.x deprecation, the secret handling changed in 4.2.0, could you confirm which webhook secret rotation you last performed? In the meantime, can you send us the full stack trace and a sample request ID for the 429 errors so we can check if there's a rate limit misconfiguration on our end? We'll keep this open until both issues are resolved.

subject: Verspätete Daten in der Pipeline - Produktionsausfall
body: Seit heute Morgen um 06:15 Uhr laufen unsere täglichen Verkaufsdaten aus dem Pipeline-Job 'retail-sync-daily' mit über 4 Stunden Verzögerung ein. Normalerweise stehen die Daten um 07:00 Uhr zur Verfügung, aktuell zeigt der letzte erfolgreiche Sync einen Zeitstempel von gestern Abend 22:00 Uhr. Unsere Filialsysteme können ohne aktuelle Bestandsdaten nicht öffnen. Wir brauchen dringend Unterstützung, das betrifft alle unsere Standorte.
answer: Wir haben diesen Fall als P0 eingestuft und unser Engineering-Team ist bereits informiert. Können Sie uns die Job-ID von 'retail-sync-daily' sowie die betroffene Kontoregion bestätigen, damit wir die Verzögerung sofort nachvollziehen können? Wir melden uns innerhalb der nächsten 30 Minuten mit einem Status-Update, unabhängig vom Fortschritt.

subject: IP allowlist entry not blocking access as expected
body: I added our office IP range to the allowlist in Admin Console under Settings > Security last Tuesday, March 4th, but noticed in the audit log that a login from an IP outside that range succeeded yesterday. The allowlist toggle shows as enabled and the range is listed correctly. Can you confirm whether allowlisting is actually enforced for our account or if there's a delay in propagation?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. Allowlist changes should apply within a few minutes, so a successful login from outside the range after that window shouldn't happen. We'll pull the audit log entry you mentioned along with the enforcement status on our side and get back to you with findings. This is logged as low priority given no active risk was reported, but we'll confirm root cause as soon as we can.

subject: SCIM provisioning not creating new users automatically
body: We enabled SCIM provisioning from our Azure AD tenant two weeks ago to sync new hires into Northwind automatically. Three new employees added to our AD group on March 10th still don't show up in the Admin Console user list. The SCIM sync log in Azure shows a 200 response but no corresponding user creation on our side. Can you help us figure out why provisioning is silently failing?
answer: Thanks for the detail, that's a helpful starting point. A 200 response from Azure with no user created on our side usually points to a mapping mismatch, often around the userName or email attribute format. Could you share a sample payload from one of the failed provisioning attempts, with any sensitive values redacted, so we can check it against our SCIM schema requirements? We'll follow up with next steps once we see that.

subject: Need to restore deleted files from backup
body: One of our team members accidentally deleted the 'Q1-campaign-assets' folder from Storage yesterday around 3pm, roughly 40 files totaling 2.3GB. I can see in our retention settings that we keep 30-day backups. Could you restore this folder from the most recent backup point before the deletion? We'd like it back in the same location if possible.
answer: Thanks for the details, that gives us everything we need to locate the backup snapshot. We'll restore the 'Q1-campaign-assets' folder from the point closest to before the deletion yesterday afternoon and place it back in its original location. This typically takes a couple of hours to complete, we'll confirm here once it's done.

subject: Multiple API keys stopped working after rotation
body: We rotated our API keys yesterday following the guide in your docs, generating 3 new keys to replace the old ones for our reporting integration. Two of the three new keys return 401 Unauthorized on every request, while the third works fine. All three were created the same way through the Admin Console. This is blocking our nightly energy usage reports for several downstream teams.
answer: Sorry for the disruption this is causing to your reporting jobs. A 401 on newly rotated keys usually means the key wasn't fully activated or is missing the required scope, could you share the key IDs (not the secret values) for the two failing keys so we can check their status and permissions? We'll prioritize getting this resolved before your next scheduled run.

subject: Mobile app crashing immediately on launch for iOS users
body: Since the 6.3.0 update released yesterday, the Northwind mobile app crashes within a second of opening for most of our iOS users, roughly 40 people have reported this so far. Android users seem unaffected. We haven't changed anything on our end. This is stopping our field team from checking push notifications and offline reports during a critical event this week.
answer: This is escalated to our mobile engineering team as a P1 given the number of affected users and the timing. Could you tell us which iOS versions and device models are most commonly affected, and whether the crash happens before or after the splash screen? We'll also check if this correlates with the 6.3.0 rollout and update you as soon as we have a fix or workaround.

subject: Request to update Jira integration for new cloud instance
body: We recently migrated our Jira instance from server to cloud, our new URL is northsystems.atlassian.net, and our existing Northwind-Jira link is now pointing to the old server and failing to sync tickets. Could you walk us through reconfiguring the integration for the new Jira cloud instance, or is this something we need to redo from scratch in the Integrations settings?
answer: Good news, you won't need to rebuild the integration from scratch. You can update the existing Jira connection under Integrations by re-authenticating with your new cloud instance URL, this will refresh the project and issue-type mappings automatically. We'll send over a short walkthrough doc, and if anything doesn't sync correctly after reconnecting, let us know and we'll dig into the mapping config directly.

subject: Duplicate alerts being sent to wrong distribution list
body: Our billing threshold alerts are being routed to the wrong distribution list, and each alert is arriving twice. We set up the routing rule two weeks ago to send to our billing-alerts list, but they're going to our general operations list instead, duplicated. This is causing confusion among staff who don't need billing information.
answer: Thanks for reporting this, duplicate misrouted alerts are definitely not expected behavior. Could you send us the name of the routing rule and roughly when the duplicates started appearing? We suspect there may be an overlapping rule sending to both lists, we'll review your alert routing configuration and correct it once we confirm the cause.

subject: Question about dashboard sharing permissions
body: I'm trying to share our 'Monthly Energy Usage' dashboard with an external contractor who doesn't have a Northwind account. The share link option seems to only work for users within our organization. Is there a way to generate a public or view-only link for external stakeholders, or is that not supported on our current plan?
answer: Good question. External view-only sharing links are supported, but the option is enabled per-dashboard under Share settings rather than account-wide, so it's easy to miss if it's toggled off. Go to the dashboard's Share menu and check for 'Allow external viewers', if that toggle isn't visible on your account we'll confirm whether it needs to be enabled on our end for your plan.

subject: Documentation for credit/refund handling via API
body:
I'm integrating our billing flow with the Northwind API for Ember Partners and I need clarity on how prorated credits are represented when we issue a partial refund on an invoice. I can see a "credit_note" object appear in the payload but the docs don't explain how it nets against the next invoice total.

Could you point me to the reference page for this, or update the docs to include an example payload? We're on Starter and want to build this correctly before we scale usage.
answer: Thanks for flagging this - you're right that the credit_note object isn't well documented yet. When a partial refund is issued, the credit_note reduces the balance_due on the next invoice generated after the refund date, and it also appears as a separate line item under adjustments. I'll add a worked example to the billing API reference and link it here once published, likely within the next few days.

subject: need help setting up scim cant get groups to sync
body:
hi so we've been rolling out Northwind across the academy for a few weeks now and most staff logins are working fine through our IdP. we have about 34 seats on the Pro plan and departments are organised into groups on our side.

the actual problem is when i try to enable SCIM provisioning the users come in but their group memberships dont carry over, so everyone lands with no permisions assigned and i have to manually fix each one. is there a setting im missing or does scim just not support group push yet on our plan?
answer: Group push via SCIM is supported on Pro, so this is likely a configuration issue rather than a plan limitation. Can you confirm which IdP you're using and whether group filtering is enabled on your SCIM app config - some IdPs require you to explicitly map and enable the groups attribute before it gets pushed. In the meantime, check under Identity > Provisioning > Attribute Mapping in the Northwind admin console to confirm "groups" is included in the synced attributes list.

subject: Role mapping mismatch after SSO group update
body:
We noticed that after updating one of our Azure AD security groups last week, a subset of users retained their old Northwind role instead of picking up the new mapped role on next login. This affected roughly 40 users out of our workforce and self-resolved after about 6 hours, but I want to understand the caching behavior.

Can you confirm how long role mappings are cached after a group change on our side, and whether there's a way to force an immediate re-sync for a specific group without waiting for the next scheduled provisioning cycle?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. Role mappings derived from SSO group claims are cached for up to 4 hours by default to reduce load on the IdP during login, which explains the delay you saw. There isn't currently a self-service way to force an immediate re-sync for a single group, but our team can trigger a manual refresh on request - let us know the group name and we can push it through on our end if this happens again.

subject: Users getting wrong role after SSO login - mapping broken
body:
We updated our role mapping rules yesterday to add a new "Field Engineer" role tied to an AD group, and now several users are getting assigned Viewer instead regardless of their group membership. Here's the error from the provisioning log:

2024-05-14T09:12:03Z ERROR role_mapping.rule_eval: unable to resolve claim 'group_ids' for user id=8841
2024-05-14T09:12:03Z WARN role_mapping.fallback: applying default role 'Viewer' for user id=8841
2024-05-14T09:12:04Z ERROR role_mapping.rule_eval: unable to resolve claim 'group_ids' for user id=8842
2024-05-14T09:12:04Z WARN role_mapping.fallback: applying default role 'Viewer' for user id=8842

This is affecting most of our 23 users. Can you help identify what broke?
answer: This looks like the claim name in your rule doesn't match what your IdP is actually sending - the log shows the mapping engine can't find 'group_ids' in the token at all, which triggers the Viewer fallback. Can you check your IdP's token configuration to confirm the exact claim name (it may be 'groups' or a custom claim URI) and compare it against what's configured in Identity > Role Mapping > Rules? We're happy to review your current rule config directly if you can share a screenshot or export of it.

subject: MFA enrollment completely broken - nobody can log in
body:
Since this morning none of our analysts can complete MFA enrollment - the QR code screen loads but scanning it with an authenticator app returns "invalid setup key" every time, and the fallback SMS option isn't sending codes either. This is blocking all 13 of our seats from accessing Northwind entirely, including me.

We rely on this for a data delivery deadline today. Can someone look at this urgently? Started around 8:40am our time and has been consistent across three different devices and two different authenticator apps we tested.
answer: This is being treated as urgent given it's blocking all logins. We're checking whether there's an issue with our TOTP setup key generation or SMS delivery provider right now. In the meantime, can you confirm your account region and whether any of the affected users have an MFA method already enrolled from before today - if so we can temporarily issue a bypass code for critical access while we investigate the enrollment failure.

subject: Option to customize email digest frequency via API
body:
We're building a notification workflow for Pioneer Foods using the Notifications API and currently the daily email digest is hardcoded to send once every 24 hours. We'd like to offer our own customers a choice between daily, weekly, or an on-demand digest triggered by our own event, but I don't see a parameter for frequency in the /digests endpoint.

Is there a way to configure this per-recipient today, or is this something you're planning to add? Happy to test a beta parameter if one exists.
answer: There isn't a frequency parameter on the /digests endpoint yet - it's currently fixed to the 24-hour cycle you found. This is a reasonable ask though, and I'm logging it as a feature request for per-recipient digest scheduling. There's no beta flag available right now, but I'll update this ticket if a preview parameter becomes available so you can test it early.

subject: SCIM sync creating duplicate users after group rename
body:
We renamed one of our Okta groups last week from "Retail-Support" to "Store-Support" and since then SCIM provisioning has been creating brand new user entries in Northwind instead of updating the existing ones - we now have 14 duplicate accounts with slightly different emails (some with a +1 suffix) for staff who were already provisioned. Some of these duplicates have login and MFA issues since they're not tied to the original permission set.

Can you help us clean up the duplicates and figure out why the rename triggered new user creation instead of an update? We have 50 seats total so this is a meaningful chunk of our directory.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report - group renames in Okta can sometimes cause SCIM to treat the external ID mapping as changed if the group rename wasn't propagated correctly, which leads to the duplicate creation you're seeing. We can help identify and merge the duplicate accounts on our end to restore the original permissions and MFA settings; could you send us the list of affected usernames or the +1 suffixed emails so we can start reconciling them today?

subject: Need ability to restrict dashboard sharing to internal users only
body:
As we prepare quarterly reports, I noticed anyone with a dashboard link can view it even if they're outside Harbor Capital, since sharing currently defaults to "anyone with the link." I need a way to restrict sharing to only users within our domain or a specific internal group, especially for dashboards containing financial figures.

Is there a setting for domain-restricted sharing, or is this something we'd need to request as a feature? This is fairly urgent since we have external partners on some of the same email threads as our finance team.
answer: Domain-restricted sharing isn't available as a toggle yet, but there is a workaround: you can set individual dashboards to "restricted" mode and explicitly add only the internal users or groups who should have access, rather than using the link-sharing default. I'd recommend switching your financial dashboards to this mode right away given the sensitivity, and I'm also flagging the domain-restriction request to our product team as it's a common ask.

subject: Workspace allowlist settings not saving in Admin Console
body:
I'm trying to update our IP allowlist under workspace settings to add two new office locations, but every time I click save the page refreshes and reverts back to the old list of three entries. This has happened on three separate attempts today across both Chrome and Firefox. I also checked the audit log and I don't see any entry recording my attempted changes, which is concerning for our compliance review next week.

Can someone confirm whether this is a known issue and help us get the new IPs added before our audit deadline?
answer: Thanks for reporting this - a save failure that also doesn't leave an audit log entry is something we want to look into right away, since audit trail completeness matters for your compliance review. Can you send us the exact IP ranges you're trying to add along with a timestamp of your most recent attempt so we can check server-side logs for errors on our end? We'll prioritize getting this fixed or applying the change manually before your deadline.

subject: sync issue
body: Our Salesforce sync stopped pulling new opportunity records into Northwind sometime yesterday afternoon. The integration still shows as "Connected" in the settings page but the last successful sync timestamp is stuck at 2:15pm yesterday. We also use Slack and Jira integrations but those seem unaffected so far.
answer: Thanks for flagging this - since the connection still shows active but the sync timestamp is frozen, this is likely a token or field-mapping issue on the Salesforce side rather than a full disconnect. Could you check whether any custom fields or validation rules changed on your Salesforce opportunity object around that time? We'll also check our integration logs for your account to see if sync attempts are failing silently or simply not triggering.

subject: URGENT DUPLICATE ALERTS FLOODING OUR LEGAL TEAM INBOXES
body: WE ARE GETTING THE SAME NOTIFICATION SENT 4 TO 6 TIMES PER EVENT SINCE MONDAY. OUR COMPLIANCE TEAM HAS 588 SEATS AND EVERY MATTER-DEADLINE ALERT IS TRIGGERING MULTIPLE EMAILS WITHIN SECONDS OF EACH OTHER. WE HAVE COUNTED 6 COPIES OF THE SAME ALERT FOR CASE ID Q-88213 THIS MORNING ALONE. THIS IS CAUSING PEOPLE TO MISS REAL DEADLINES BECAUSE THEY ARE MUTING THE CHANNEL. WE NEED THIS FIXED TODAY OR WE WILL HAVE TO ESCALATE THIS TO OUR ACCOUNT MANAGER AND RECONSIDER THE RENEWAL.
answer: I understand how disruptive duplicate alerts are for a team relying on timely deadline notices, and I'm escalating this to our alerting engineers immediately as a P1. Could you confirm whether these duplicates are happening across all alert types or only matter-deadline alerts, and share one more affected case ID so we can trace the exact delivery path? We'll keep you updated within the hour as we investigate the root cause.

subject: Students unable to unsubscribe from digest emails, complaints rising
body: We've had a sharp spike in support tickets from students saying the unsubscribe link in our weekly digest notifications leads to a blank page and doesn't actually remove them from the list. This started after the notification template update rolled out last Thursday. We have 248 seats affected and several instructors have already emailed our team directly asking why they can't opt out.
answer: Thanks for flagging this quickly — an unsubscribe flow that doesn't work is a real trust issue, so we're treating it as P1. We've reproduced the blank-page behavior tied to last Thursday's template update and are rolling back the affected unsubscribe endpoint now; we'll confirm once it's verified working and will also suppress any digests queued in the meantime so no further complaints go out.

subject: Staff locked out during MFA enrolment rollout
body: We enabled mandatory MFA enrolment this morning for our 9 seats and three staff members are now stuck at the enrolment screen — it shows 'Verification code invalid' even though the code matches their authenticator app exactly. Two of them are store managers who need access to process today's transactions. We followed the enrolment guide step by step, so I'm not sure what's going wrong.
answer: Sorry for the disruption this is causing during business hours — I'm marking this P1 given the impact on your managers' access. Please have the affected users check that their device time is synced automatically, as clock drift is the most common cause of this exact error; in parallel, we're reviewing your tenant's MFA policy logs to confirm the enrolment requests are reaching our verification service correctly. I'll follow up shortly with next steps.

subject: Need offline mode support for field staff using mobile app
body: Our field team uses the mobile app in areas with no signal, and right now the app crashes whenever it loses connectivity mid-session rather than caching data locally. We'd like to request proper offline mode so staff can keep working and sync once they're back online. This is becoming a real blocker for our 25 field users who lose progress every time connection drops.
answer: Thanks for the detailed context — offline support is a frequent request and I want to make sure we route this correctly. I'm logging this as a P1 feature request given the operational impact on your field staff, and I'll pass along the crash details to our mobile team to see if there's a quicker fix for the connectivity-loss crash while the broader offline mode capability is evaluated.

subject: SDK throwing intermittent 429s not matching documented rate limits
body: We're integrating the Northwind API Platform Python SDK (v3.2.1) into our warehouse scanning tool and are seeing intermittent 429 Too Many Requests errors even though we're well under the 100 req/min limit stated in the docs. It seems to happen in bursts of 5-6 calls within a second during batch uploads. Could you clarify if there's a separate burst limit that isn't documented, and if the SDK has built-in retry/backoff we should be using instead of handling it ourselves?
answer: Good catch — there is an undocumented short burst limit of 10 requests per second in addition to the per-minute cap, which we'll get added to the docs. The SDK does include a retry-with-backoff helper (RateLimiter.wrap()) that handles this automatically; if you're calling the raw client methods directly it won't kick in, so switching to the wrapped client should resolve the bursts you're seeing.

subject: Requesting offline mode for mobile app - client feedback attached
body: Several of our on-site travel agents have reported that the mobile app becomes unusable in areas with poor connectivity, forcing them to log in again and losing their itinerary drafts. We'd like to formally request an offline mode where users can view and edit itineraries without a live connection, syncing changes once reconnected. Given we have 237 users relying on this app daily, even a partial offline read-only mode would meaningfully reduce login failures and lost work.
answer: Thank you for the clear write-up and the context on lost drafts — this maps to a growing set of similar requests, so I'm filing it as P1 given the scale of your team affected. I'll share your specifics (especially the interest in a partial read-only mode as an interim step) with our mobile product team and follow up once we have a timeline or workaround to share.

subject: Charts rendering blank on shared dashboards after export
body: Since yesterday, several of our dashboard charts show up blank when a dashboard is shared via link, even though they render fine when viewed directly in the editor. It's happening on our 'Enrollment Trends' and 'Attendance Summary' dashboards specifically. Exporting to PDF also produces the same blank chart areas where the bar graphs should be.
answer: Thanks for the specifics on which dashboards are affected — that helps narrow this down quickly. This looks like it could be related to a rendering issue with shared/export views specifically, so we're reproducing it now with your two dashboard names; we'll update you as soon as we identify whether it's a caching or rendering-engine issue on the export pipeline.

subject: Authentifizierungsproblem bei Connector für Datenpipelines
body: Wir nutzen den Salesforce-Connector in unserer Datenpipeline und stellen fest, dass die Authentifizierung alle paar Tage abläuft, sodass die Synchronisation stoppt und wir sie manuell neu autorisieren müssen. Das betrifft unser Team mit 96 Lizenzen und führt zu Datenlücken in den Berichten, wenn niemand rechtzeitig bemerkt, dass die Verbindung unterbrochen ist. Können Sie eine Funktion für automatische Token-Erneuerung oder zumindest eine Warnung bei Ablauf hinzufügen?
answer: Vielen Dank für die genaue Beschreibung — das ist ein bekanntes Verhalten bei OAuth-Tokens mit kurzer Lebensdauer, und wir verstehen, wie störend die dadurch entstehenden Datenlücken sind. Wir leiten Ihren Wunsch nach automatischer Token-Erneuerung sowie einer Ablauf-Warnung an unser Produktteam für Connectoren weiter und schauen zusätzlich, ob wir kurzfristig eine Benachrichtigung bei Ablauf der Verbindung einrichten können.

subject: Request: native Slack alert integration for incident notifications
body: We currently route incident notifications through a workaround using Jira webhooks into Slack, but it's clunky and delays alerting for our operations teams. We'd like to request a native Slack integration for Northwind alerts similar to the Okta integration we already use, so incidents post directly to the right channel without the Jira hop. This would help across our 1719 seats, especially the on-call teams.
answer: Thanks for the detailed feedback on your current workaround — a native Slack integration is on our integrations roadmap and requests like yours with concrete use cases help us prioritize it. I'll log this with the product team referencing your Jira/Okta setup as an example of the workflow we should support, and I'll let you know as soon as we have a beta or timeline to share.

subject: Change request: extend storage retention period for backups
body: We'd like to request a change to our storage retention setting — currently backups are purged after 30 days, but we need at least 90 days to meet a new internal audit requirement. We only have 7 seats but store fairly large media backup files, so we want to confirm this change won't unexpectedly push us over our storage quota before we make the switch.
answer: Thanks for checking in before making the change — extending retention to 90 days is something we can configure on our end. Based on your current backup volume, this would roughly triple your stored data footprint, so I'd recommend reviewing your quota usage first; I can pull your current usage numbers now so you can see exactly where you'd land before we apply the change.

subject: Feature request: audit log entry when deactivating a user
body: When I deactivate a user in the Admin Console, the action doesn't show up in the audit log under Settings. I deactivated a user named on our fintech team on March 3rd and checked the log an hour later, but there was no entry at all, just the login events from before. We have 5 seats total so I can track this manually for now, but it would help for compliance if deactivations were logged like other settings changes.
answer: Thanks for flagging this. You're right that deactivation events are currently not written to the audit log, which is a gap on our end rather than intended behavior. I've logged this as a feature request with our product team so audit logging covers user status changes going forward, and I'll update this ticket once there's a timeline.

subject: Pipeline data arriving 6+ hours late, breaking downstream reports
body: Since yesterday our main connector sync into Data Pipelines has been landing records 6-8 hours behind schedule instead of the usual near-real-time latency. This is affecting legal case tracking dashboards used by dozens of our 140 seats, and several teams have already asked why yesterday's filings aren't showing up. The connector status page shows 'Running' with no errors, but the last successful data timestamp is stuck at 03:12 UTC this morning.
answer: This is impacting a large portion of your workspace, so I'm escalating this immediately to our data pipeline on-call team. We're checking the connector queue for backlog or throttling issues on our side and will update you within the hour with findings. In the meantime, could you confirm which connector name this affects so we can pull exact processing logs?

subject: Email digest missing alerts that were in-app
body: Our daily notification digest for energy market alerts is dropping items. On March 5th I received an in-app alert about a price threshold breach at 09:14, but that same alert never appeared in the daily email digest sent at 8am the next morning. I checked the digest settings and everything looks enabled under Alerting. This has happened at least three times this week and we rely on these digests for morning reviews with the energy trading team.
answer: Thank you for the detailed timeline, that's helpful for tracking this down. It sounds like some alerts are being generated after the digest compilation window and then getting skipped rather than rolled into the next digest, which would explain the gap. I'm escalating this to our notifications team to investigate the digest generation logic and will follow up with root cause and a fix estimate.

subject: Dashboard charts not rendering after API update
body: All charts on our main manufacturing dashboard stopped rendering this morning, showing a blank gray box where the line chart used to be. I'm the developer who set up the API integration and nothing changed on our end since last week's deploy. Refreshing, clearing cache, and trying a different browser didn't help. This is blocking our production floor team from viewing shift metrics they check every hour.
answer: I'm sorry for the disruption this is causing to your floor operations. This is a high priority issue for us and I've flagged it to our dashboards engineering team right now to check for any recent chart rendering regressions on our side. Can you tell me which chart type and data source these dashboards use so we can reproduce it quickly?

subject: MFA enrollment stuck for finance team members
body: Several people on the finance team are unable to complete MFA enrollment when logging in through SSO. They get to the QR code screen, scan it with an authenticator app, but the verification step just spins and eventually times out with no error message. This started after our SSO provider update last week. We have 2202 seats company-wide but so far it seems isolated to about a dozen finance users trying to enroll for the first time.
answer: Thanks for the clear description, that timing lines up with a known interaction some customers have seen after SSO provider changes affecting MFA challenge callbacks. Could you send us the exact timestamp and user identifiers for two or three affected enrollments so we can trace the session logs? In the meantime, existing enrolled users should be unaffected, and we'll prioritize getting the finance team unblocked.

subject: Deprecated API endpoint still returning errors after migration
body: We migrated our webhook integration from the /v1/contracts endpoint to /v2/contracts ahead of the announced deprecation, but we're now getting intermittent 500 errors on webhook deliveries, roughly 15% of calls over the past two days. The error body just says 'internal_error' with no further detail. This is affecting contract status updates for our legal team's active matters, and we need this resolved quickly since the old endpoint sunsets in 9 days.
answer: Thank you for migrating ahead of the deprecation deadline, and I'm sorry you're hitting failures on the new endpoint. A 15% error rate on v2 webhook deliveries needs immediate attention, so I'm escalating this to our API platform team now. Please send us a sample of the failing webhook payload IDs and approximate timestamps so we can trace them server-side and get you a root cause.

subject: Duplicate email digests being sent every morning
body: Our workspace has been receiving duplicate copies of the daily notification digest every morning since Tuesday, two identical emails arriving about 3 minutes apart. This is confusing our team of 16 who think something new happened when it's just the same digest twice. I checked the Alerting settings and there's only one digest schedule configured, not two.
answer: Apologies for the duplicate emails, that's clearly a bug on our side rather than a configuration issue in your workspace. I'm escalating this to our notifications engineering team right away since it's affecting your whole team's daily workflow. As a temporary workaround, please don't change your digest schedule settings while we investigate, and we'll confirm once a fix is deployed.

subject: help
body: Workspace settings page in Admin Console is throwing an error whenever I try to update our IP allowlist. It says 'Failed to save settings, please try again' every time, even after refreshing and trying a different browser. This is blocking us from adding a new office IP range and we can't lock down access properly right now. Support team of 25 seats is affected since we can't finish our security review today.
answer: Thanks for reporting this, and I understand the urgency given the pending security review. We're checking the settings save endpoint for errors on the allowlist feature right now and will update you as soon as we identify the cause. Could you send us the exact IP range you're trying to add and a screenshot of the error, including the timestamp, so we can pull matching logs?

subject: Request to bulk deactivate former contractor accounts
body: We have 6 contractor accounts from a completed project that need to be deactivated in the Admin Console, but I only see an option to deactivate users one at a time. With 24 seats total on our plan, doing this individually isn't a big deal, but I wanted to flag it as feedback since a bulk deactivate option would save time for future offboarding rounds. Also noticed one account showed 'Active' status even though I deactivated it two days ago.
answer: Thanks for the feedback on bulk deactivation, I'll pass that along to our product team as a feature request since it would indeed streamline offboarding. On the account still showing Active two days after deactivation, that does sound like a display bug rather than expected behavior, so could you share the user's account identifier so we can check the status sync on our end?

subject: Multiple card payment failures this billing cycle
body: We've had three failed card payment attempts this month for our education org's subscription, most recently on the 4th with the error 'card_declined - insufficient funds' even though the card has sufficient balance according to our bank. This is affecting our 99 seats since we got a notice that access may be suspended in 5 days if payment isn't resolved. Can you check if this is an issue on Northwind's payment processor side rather than our card?
answer: Thank you for flagging this before the suspension date. Repeated declines with that message sometimes indicate a processor-side mismatch or a temporary hold flag rather than an actual funds issue, so we're pulling the transaction logs from our payment processor now to check. In the meantime, I'd also recommend trying an alternate card or contacting your bank to confirm there's no fraud block on international transactions from our billing system.

subject: Pagination broken on /v2/events - duplicate and skipped pages
body:
We're pulling event data through the API Platform for our nightly analytics job and since this morning's run our pagination is returning duplicate records on page 3 and then skipping straight to page 6. We use the cursor field returned in the response header exactly as documented. This is affecting our reporting pipeline for Quill Media and we can't trust the counts anymore.

We last saw this working correctly on the run from two days ago. Can someone confirm if the cursor logic changed recently?
answer:
Thanks for flagging this, and sorry for the disruption to your nightly pipeline. We did roll out a change to the cursor encoding on /v2/events earlier today and it looks like it introduced a regression for accounts still using the older SDK cursor format. We're rolling back that change now and will confirm once /v2/events is stable again, likely within the hour.

In the meantime, if you can pause the nightly job or expect to re-run it once we confirm the fix, that would avoid ingesting the duplicate rows. I'll update this ticket as soon as the rollback is complete.

subject: Plan upgrade charged wrong amount and seats not reflected in API
body:
We upgraded Orion Works from our previous tier to a higher seat allocation yesterday through the billing portal, and the invoice generated shows a charge that doesn't match the prorated amount we calculated (we expected around $18,400 for the remaining billing cycle, but were charged $31,900). On top of that, our integration calling /v1/account/seats still returns the old seat count of 1400 instead of 1558.

This is blocking our provisioning workflow since we gate new user creation on the seat count from that endpoint. We need this corrected quickly as we have onboarding scheduled for 40 new users this week.
answer:
Apologies for the billing discrepancy and the impact on your provisioning workflow. I've pulled the invoice and confirmed the proration calculation was applied incorrectly due to a mid-cycle plan change bug affecting Enterprise accounts upgrading seats mid-month; we're issuing a corrected invoice and a refund for the overcharge of roughly $13,500 today. I've also manually synced your seat count so /v1/account/seats should now return 1558.

We're escalating the proration bug to engineering since it likely affects other accounts upgrading this week. I'll follow up on this ticket once the refund posts, typically within 3-5 business days.

subject: Request to link Jira issues from within Northwind workspace
body:
As the workspace admin for Granite Health, we'd like to set up a Jira integration so our team can link tickets and incidents directly to Jira issues without switching tools. We already use Okta for SSO and have Slack connected for notifications, so ideally the Jira link would follow a similar OAuth flow.

Could you let us know what's needed on our end to enable this, and whether it supports linking multiple Jira projects to different teams within our workspace?
answer:
Thanks for reaching out. The Jira integration is available on the Pro plan and can be enabled from Settings > Integrations > Jira, where you'll authorize via OAuth using an admin account on your Jira instance. It does support mapping multiple Jira projects to different teams in your workspace, configurable per team under the same integrations page.

Let us know once you've connected it if you'd like a hand verifying the project mappings, and I can walk you through the setup on a quick call if useful.

subject: Users still receiving emails after unsubscribing
body:
We've had several complaints from our team at Pioneer Capital that people who click unsubscribe on our transactional digest emails are still getting duplicate notifications a day or two later. I checked three specific accounts and their unsubscribe status shows as confirmed in the notification settings, but the emails keep coming through the alerting workflow.

This is becoming a compliance concern for us given the volume of complaints, so we'd like this looked at soon. Happy to share the affected user IDs if that helps.
answer:
Thanks for the detailed report, and I understand the compliance concern here. This matches a known issue where unsubscribe status isn't being respected by one of the digest delivery workers when a user is on multiple notification lists. Please send over the affected user IDs so we can confirm they're hitting this specific path and manually suppress future sends while we deploy the fix.

We're prioritizing this given the escalation and will update you within one business day on the fix timeline.

subject: Repeated upload failures to Storage for patient record backups
body:
Our nightly backup job for Harbor Works has failed to upload to Storage three times this week, on the 3rd, 5th, and 6th, each time with a timeout after roughly 45 minutes. The files are around 2.3GB each, which is consistent with previous successful runs, so the size shouldn't be the issue.

Since these are our compliance backups with a 7-year retention requirement, we need this resolved quickly and would appreciate confirmation that no data was lost during the failed attempts.
answer:
Thank you for the details, and I understand the urgency given your retention requirements. We've confirmed the failed uploads did not create any partial or corrupted objects in your bucket, so there's no data loss to report from those three attempts. We're seeing elevated latency on the storage nodes serving your region during that window and are actively working with infrastructure to resolve it.

As a workaround, could you retry the backup job outside your usual window, ideally early morning UTC, while we address the underlying latency? I'll keep this ticket open and update you as soon as we have a fix deployed.

subject: Dashboard charts not rendering for entire team since this morning
body:
Starting around 8am today, none of the charts on our operations dashboards are loading for Pioneer Health, they just show a spinning loader indefinitely. This is affecting every shared dashboard we use to track claims processing, and our team relies on these throughout the day for status meetings.

We haven't changed any dashboard configs recently, and refreshing or clearing cache hasn't helped. This is a significant problem for us right now since we can't see any of our operational metrics.
answer:
Thank you for reporting this right away, we're treating this as high priority given the impact across your whole team. We're seeing an issue with the chart rendering service affecting several accounts since this morning and engineering is actively working on a fix. I'll update this ticket within the next 30 minutes with progress.

As a temporary workaround, exporting the underlying data views to CSV should still work if you need numbers for your meetings in the meantime.

subject: Audit log missing entries for admin console changes
body:
I'm reviewing our compliance audit for Ember Legal and noticed the audit log in Admin Console is missing entries for at least two permission changes we made last week, specifically adding a user to the finance allowlist on the 9th and removing another user's admin role on the 11th. Both actions happened and are reflected in current permissions, but neither shows up when I filter the audit log by date range.

We need complete audit trails for our upcoming compliance review, so I wanted to flag this before it becomes a bigger issue.
answer:
Thanks for catching this and for the specific dates, that's very helpful. We're looking into why those two allowlist and role change events weren't captured in the audit log export, this may be related to a known gap in logging for certain permission-change event types that we're currently patching. I'll confirm within a day whether we can backfill the missing entries or whether they need to be reconstructed from our internal records for your compliance review.

We'll prioritize getting you a clear answer given your review timeline, and I'll document the findings in this ticket.

subject: Deactivated users still showing as active in audit log and allowlist
body:
We deactivated about 30 users from Lumen Foods this week as part of an offboarding batch through Admin Console settings, but several of them still appear in the IP allowlist as active and the audit log doesn't show a deactivation event for at least 6 of them that I've checked so far. I'm concerned this is a security gap since these accounts should no longer have access.

Can you help us confirm which of the 30 deactivations actually completed and whether the allowlist entries need to be manually removed?
answer:
Thank you for flagging this, given the security implications we're looking into it right away. We can see the deactivation batch you ran, and it appears the allowlist sync process isn't reliably triggering for bulk deactivations, which explains the stale entries you're seeing. Could you send us the list of the 6 user accounts you've confirmed as problematic so we can verify their access has actually been revoked at the auth layer, separate from the allowlist display issue?

We'll also manually cross-check all 30 users from your batch and get back to you today with a full status report.

subject: Need higher rate limits for API Platform integration
body:
We're building out an integration for Lumen Health that pulls case data through the API on a schedule, and we keep hitting 429 responses once we exceed around 100 requests per minute, which is limiting how quickly we can sync our legal case records. Our current workflow needs closer to 300 requests per minute during our morning sync window.

Could you let us know if a rate limit increase is possible on our current plan, or if we'd need to adjust how we batch our SDK calls to work within existing limits?
answer:
Thanks for the details on your sync workflow. On the Starter plan, the current API rate limit is fixed at 100 requests per minute per account, so a limit increase would require moving to a higher tier plan that supports configurable limits up to 500 requests per minute. Alternatively, our SDK supports batch endpoints for case records that could let you fetch more data per request, which might get you within your sync window without needing a plan change.

Let me know which direction you'd like to explore and I can help with either the plan upgrade or pointing you to the relevant batch endpoint documentation.

subject: Duplicate email digests being sent to same users
body:
I've noticed our weekly email digests through Notifications are going out twice to the same recipients, about 10 minutes apart, for Cobalt Robotics. I checked our digest configuration and there's only one schedule set up, running every Monday at 9am, so I'm not sure why it's firing twice.

A few of our team members have mentioned it and it's starting to look unprofessional to the students and staff on our distribution list. Could you help us figure out what's causing the duplicate sends?
answer:
Thanks for the report, and I can see how that would look unprofessional to your recipients. We've seen a similar issue where a digest schedule gets duplicated in the backend queue if it was edited and re-saved without fully clearing the previous schedule entry. Could you check your digest settings and confirm if that schedule was edited recently, and in the meantime I'll check our logs on our end for duplicate schedule entries tied to your account.

I'll follow up shortly with what we find and a fix, hopefully before your next Monday send.

subject: Transform failing
body: Pipeline tf-142 keeps failing since 9am, all retail sync jobs stuck.
answer: Thanks for flagging this—I can see tf-142 has failed on all runs since 09:02 UTC today. We're escalating this to our pipeline engineering team as a P1 incident right now and will update you within 30 minutes with root cause. In the meantime, can you confirm if this is affecting all connectors or just the retail data source?

subject: Slack integration not posting alerts since this morning
body: Our Slack alert integration stopped posting since around 7:40am today. We rely on these for our travel booking anomaly alerts and our ops team has had zero notifications for 3 hours now. The integration status page shows connected but no messages are coming through to the #alerts-ops channel. We've checked our Slack app permissions and nothing has changed on our end. This is affecting all 86 seats since it's a shared channel workflow.
answer: We're sorry for the disruption and have opened a P1 incident for this—our team identified an issue with the Slack webhook delivery service that started around 07:30am UTC and is actively working on a fix. We'll post updates every 30 minutes on our status page and will notify you directly once alerts are flowing again; in the meantime consider checking your email notification fallback if configured.

subject: SDK throwing deprecation warning on webhook registration
body: I'm using the Node SDK v4.2.1 to register webhooks and getting a deprecation warning: 'registerWebhook() will be removed in v5, use createWebhookSubscription() instead.' The docs at /api-platform/webhooks still reference the old method though. Could you clarify the migration timeline and update the docs to match? Also curious if there's a rate limit difference between the two methods.
answer: Thanks for catching that—the docs page is indeed out of date and we've filed a ticket to get it updated this week. The old registerWebhook() method will be supported until our v5 SDK release planned for next quarter, and createWebhookSubscription() has the same rate limits (100 req/min) as the legacy method, so no changes needed there. Happy to share the migration guide draft if useful in the meantime.

subject: Question on object retention policy for backups
body: We're integrating the Storage API for nightly backup uploads and want to confirm the default retention period for objects tagged 'backup-daily'. Right now objects seem to be purging after 30 days but we need at least 90 days retention for compliance. Is this configurable per bucket or do we need to set a custom lifecycle policy via the API?
answer: Good question—default retention for the Starter plan is 30 days, but you can override this per bucket by setting a custom lifecycle rule via the PUT /storage/buckets/{id}/lifecycle endpoint with a retentionDays value up to 365. I'll send over a sample payload for a 90-day daily backup policy so you can apply it directly to your backup-daily bucket.

subject: SSO role mapping assigning wrong permissions
body: We've set up SAML SSO with our identity provider and noticed that several users logging in are being mapped to the 'Viewer' role instead of 'Analyst' despite having the correct group attribute in the SAML assertion. This started after we updated our group names last week. Can you help us verify the mapping configuration on our side?
answer: Thanks for the details—this is likely due to the role mapping rules still referencing the old group names in the SAML attribute mapping settings under Identity and SSO > Role Mappings. I'd recommend checking the group-to-role mapping table in your admin console and updating the source group values to match the renamed groups; happy to walk through it together on a call if that's easier.

subject: How to route Slack alerts to a specific channel per project
body: We currently have Slack alerts going to one general channel, but we'd like to route alerts by project so our analysts only see relevant notifications. Is there a way to configure channel routing rules within the Integrations settings, or would this require separate Slack app instances per project?
answer: You can absolutely do this without separate app instances—under Integrations > Slack, there's a routing rules section where you can map specific alert types or project tags to individual channels. I'll send you a quick guide on setting up project-based routing rules so your analysts only get notifications relevant to their work.

subject: Duplicate alerts flooding email inboxes
body: Since yesterday afternoon our team has been receiving duplicate copies of every alert notification, sometimes 3-4 copies of the same email within minutes. This is happening across all alert types and is causing real confusion for our small team trying to triage issues. We haven't changed any notification rules recently.
answer: Apologies for the noise this is causing—we've identified a routing configuration issue on our end that's causing duplicate dispatches and have escalated this as a P1 incident. Our engineering team is deploying a fix now and we expect alert delivery to return to normal within the next hour; we'll follow up once confirmed resolved.

subject: Audit log shows unauthorized access attempt
body: Our admin console audit log just flagged an access attempt from an IP address not on our allowlist, timestamped 14:32 today, attempting to modify user roles. We need immediate confirmation on whether this was blocked and guidance on locking down access right now given we're a small team of 5 with sensitive student data.
answer: This has been escalated immediately as a P0 security incident. Based on our initial log review the attempt was blocked by your existing IP allowlist and no role changes were made, but we're actively investigating the source and will share findings within the hour. In the meantime we recommend rotating any admin credentials as a precaution—our security team will be in direct contact with you shortly.

subject: Seat upgrade charged wrong amount and stuck in pending
body: We upgraded from 1400 to 1598 seats yesterday and the invoice shows a charge of $48,200 which doesn't match our expected prorated amount based on our contract terms. The payment has been stuck in 'pending' status for over 18 hours and our finance team needs this resolved before end of day for reporting purposes.
answer: I understand the urgency here and have escalated this to our billing team as a P1 issue given the reporting deadline. We're reviewing the proration calculation against your Enterprise contract terms now and will have a corrected invoice or explanation within the next few hours; if the charge is confirmed incorrect we'll process an adjustment or refund immediately and keep you updated at each step.

subject: SCIM provisioning not deprovisioning users on offboarding
body: We've noticed that when users are removed from our identity provider's assigned group, they're not being automatically deprovisioned in Northwind via SCIM—they remain active with full access. This has happened with three offboarded employees in the past two weeks. Is this expected behavior or a configuration issue on our SCIM sync settings?
answer: Thanks for reporting this—deprovisioning should trigger automatically on group removal, so this does sound like a configuration gap rather than expected behavior. Could you confirm whether your SCIM sync is set to 'push' or 'pull' mode under Identity and SSO > Provisioning settings? That will help us pinpoint whether it's a sync interval issue or a mapping problem on the deprovisioning trigger.

subject: Configurable session timeout for SSO logins
body:
We're rolling out Northwind to all 137 seats at Lumen Legal and our security team wants session timeouts to align with our internal policy of 30 minutes of inactivity. Right now it looks like sessions stay active for several hours regardless of activity, which our compliance team flagged during review.

Can we get a workspace-level setting to control SSO session duration and idle timeout separately? If this already exists somewhere in the admin console, please point me to it since I haven't found it under Identity settings.
answer:
Thanks for flagging this - configurable idle timeout for SSO sessions isn't yet exposed in the admin console, but it's on our roadmap for the Identity product. In the meantime, I can set a custom session timeout of 30 minutes for your workspace on the backend if that meets your compliance need; just confirm and I'll apply it within the next business day.

I'll also log this as a feature request tagged to your account so you're notified when self-service controls ship.

subject: dringend
body: WIR HABEN GERADE FESTGESTELLT DASS EIN EHEMALIGER MITARBEITER SEIT DREI WOCHEN NOCH ZUGRIFF AUF UNSEREN WORKSPACE HAT. ICH KANN IHN IM ADMIN CONSOLE NICHT DEAKTIVIEREN, DER BUTTON DEAKTIVIEREN REAGIERT NICHT UND ES GIBT KEINE FEHLERMELDUNG. WIR HABEN NUR 10 SEATS UND DAS IST EIN SICHERHEITSPROBLEM.
