Some views take 15-20 seconds to render now, and exporting to CSV times out entirely on our largest dashboard. This is making it hard to share reports with stakeholders during morning standups.
answer: Thanks for the details - performance and export timeouts on larger dashboards is definitely something we can dig into. Could you send us the name or ID of the dashboard that's timing out on export, along with roughly how many widgets/data sources it pulls from? We'll also review query performance on our end for your workspace to see if there's an underlying bottleneck we can address.

subject: Zapier integration failing on all triggers since this morning
body: Starting around 8am today, our Zapier integration with Northwind stopped triggering entirely. We use it to push new records into Salesforce, and none of our zaps have fired in over 4 hours - normally we see 30-40 runs by this point in the day. The Zapier task history just shows 'no data' when polling our Northwind trigger endpoint. This is a small team of 3 but it's blocking our entire lead sync process.
answer: This sounds like it's fully blocking your sync, so we're treating it as high priority. Can you confirm which trigger you're using (new record, updated record, etc.) and share the Zap ID or a screenshot of the Zapier run history? We're checking our integration webhook logs for your account right now to see if the polling requests are reaching us or failing upstream.

subject: Need itemized invoice breakdown for last billing cycle
body: I'm reconciling our accounts payable for Ember Robotics and the invoice we received for this cycle only shows a single line total with no breakdown by seat count or add-on usage. We have 127 seats across several departments and I need to allocate costs internally by department, so a lump sum doesn't work for our finance reporting. Can you provide an itemized version or point me to where I can pull one?
answer: Thanks for reaching out - we understand itemized cost allocation is important for your internal reporting. We're generating a detailed line-item breakdown for your last billing cycle now, including per-seat and add-on charges, and will send it over shortly. Going forward, we can also enable itemized invoices by default on your account if that's helpful, just let us know.

subject: Question about invoice date discrepancy
body: I noticed our latest invoice for Atlas Systems is dated the 3rd of this month, but our previous invoices were always issued on the 1st. Nothing seems wrong with the amount, I'm just trying to understand if our billing cycle date shifted for some reason, since we align our AP schedule to that date each month.
answer: Good question, and thanks for keeping an eye on the details. A small shift in invoice generation date can happen occasionally due to processing timing on our end, but it shouldn't affect your recurring billing cycle date going forward. We'll double check your account's billing schedule and confirm the next invoice date so you can plan your AP schedule accordingly.

subject: storage full, backups failing
body: Backups failing, quota maxed, need more space today.
answer: We're on this right away - a maxed-out quota blocking backups needs immediate attention. Can you confirm the exact quota usage figure or error message you're seeing? We're reviewing your storage allocation now and can apply a temporary quota increase while we sort out a permanent plan adjustment with you.

subject: Doppelte Benachrichtigungen bei Alert-Routing
body: Uns ist aufgefallen, dass bestimmte Alerts doppelt an unser E-Mail-Postfach zugestellt werden, obwohl nur eine Routing-Regel dafür konfiguriert ist. Das passiert seit ein paar Tagen bei etwa jedem dritten Alert. Es ist kein akutes Problem, aber es sorgt für Verwirrung im Team, da wir dachten, es gäbe doppelte Vorfälle.
answer: Danke für den Hinweis zu den doppelten Benachrichtigungen. Können Sie uns mitteilen, ob die doppelten Alerts immer denselben Alert-Typ betreffen oder zufällig verteilt auftreten? Wir schauen uns Ihre Routing-Konfiguration an, um zu prüfen, ob eventuell zwei Regeln überlappend greifen.

subject: Biometric login crashing the mobile app on iOS
body: Since updating to the latest app version, whenever I try to log in with Face ID the app crashes immediately back to the home screen. This is happening on my iPhone and two other admins have reported the same issue this week. Password login still works fine, but biometric login is completely unusable now, and we rely on it for quick access in the field.
answer: Sorry for the disruption this is causing your team in the field. Could you let us know the exact app version and iOS version you're on? We're escalating this to our mobile engineering team now since it's affecting multiple admins, and we'll follow up with either a fix timeline or a workaround for biometric login in the meantime.

subject: dashbords realy slow need urgent help
body: our dashbords have been extremly slow for the past 2 days, taking upto 30 secs to load and export to pdf just fails compleatly for our compliance team. we have 265 seats and alot of ppl relying on these reports daily, this is now effecting our audit prep and we need this fixed asap. also sharing links to other teams timesout sometimes too.
answer: We understand this is urgent given your audit prep timeline, and we're escalating this immediately. Can you share which specific dashboards are affected and the approximate time the slowness started? We're pulling performance logs for your workspace right now to identify the bottleneck behind both the load times and the PDF export failures.

subject: Requesting change to data retention policy for archived logs
body: We'd like to update our storage retention settings for archived pipeline logs. Currently they're set to purge after 90 days, but our compliance team wants to extend this to 180 days for a subset of data tied to media asset processing. Could you walk us through how to configure a retention exception for that specific data category, or whether this needs to be set up on your end given our account size?
answer: Thanks for reaching out about the retention change - extending retention for a specific data category is something we can help configure. Given the scale of your account, we'll coordinate with our data pipeline team to set up a retention exception for the media asset processing logs at 180 days, and we'll walk you through the configuration options so your team can manage similar exceptions going forward.

subject: Restore from backup returning partial data for bucket pe-archive-04
body:
I'm working on integrating our energy monitoring pipeline with the Storage API and triggered a restore from the backup snapshot dated 2024-06-02 for bucket pe-archive-04. The restore job (job id rst-88213) completed with status "success" but only 62% of the expected 40,000 objects were restored. No errors were logged in the job output.

Can someone check server-side whether the retention policy on this bucket is interfering with full restores? We need the complete dataset for a compliance audit due next week.
answer:
Thanks for flagging this, and good catch on the object count mismatch. We're pulling the logs for job rst-88213 now to check whether the retention policy on pe-archive-04 is excluding objects that were past their retention window at snapshot time. I'll update you within a few hours with findings and, if needed, a corrected restore job.

In the meantime, could you confirm the exact object count you expected versus what landed, and whether any of the missing objects were uploaded close to the retention cutoff date?

subject: Uploads failing across the board since this morning - urgent
body:
Since around 8:40am today, our team at Granite Labs has been unable to upload any documents through Storage. Every attempt returns a generic "upload failed, please retry" message, and retries don't help. We've confirmed this is happening for multiple users across different case folders, not just one account.

This is blocking discovery document intake for three active matters. We need this escalated immediately - can you tell us if this is a known outage or specific to our account?
answer:
I'm escalating this to our storage infrastructure team right now given the scope of impact across your team. Can you confirm the exact error code or response body you're seeing (if any appears in browser dev tools or API responses), and roughly how many concurrent upload attempts you've made in the last hour?

We'll keep you updated every 30 minutes until resolved. If you have a specific document ID or upload attempt timestamp, that will help us trace it faster in our logs.

subject: Dashboard charts rendering blank after API integration
body:
I integrated our booking data into a Northwind dashboard last week, and starting yesterday most of the line and bar charts are rendering completely blank - just empty containers with no error message. The underlying data source still returns valid JSON when I query it directly through the API, so the issue seems to be on the rendering side.

This is affecting 5 of our 7 dashboards, including the one we use to share weekly metrics with a client. Refreshing, clearing cache, and rebuilding the widgets from scratch hasn't fixed it.
answer:
Thanks for the detailed report. Since the underlying API data is confirmed valid but the charts render blank, this points to a rendering issue on our dashboard service rather than your data source. Could you share the dashboard ID and one affected chart's widget ID so we can inspect the render pipeline directly?

Given this is affecting client-facing dashboards, we're prioritizing this as a P1. We'll follow up shortly with either a fix or a workaround for the shared dashboard specifically.

subject: Requesting longer SSO session timeout for finance team
body:
Our finance team keeps getting logged out of Northwind every 30 minutes during month-end close, which is disrupting our workflow when reconciling invoices across multiple tabs. We're using SSO through our identity provider, and it seems the session timeout is fixed at a short interval regardless of activity.

Could we get this extended to at least 2 hours, or is there a setting we're missing on our end? We have 20 seats total and this is affecting most of the finance group daily.
answer:
Thanks for the detail - this is a common ask during high-activity periods like month-end close. Session timeout duration for SSO is currently configured at the account level rather than per-user, and I can help adjust it. Could you confirm which identity provider you're using and whether you'd like the change applied account-wide or just for the finance team's group?

Once confirmed, I'll coordinate the update and let you know the new timeout value once it's live.

subject: Plan upgrade charged twice on invoice
body:
I upgraded our Northwind account from Starter to the next tier on the 14th, and our latest invoice shows two separate charges for the upgrade - one for $89 and another for $89.50 dated a day apart. I only intended to upgrade once and didn't receive any confirmation of a second change.

Can someone review our billing history and refund the duplicate charge? Our invoice number is INV-20458 if that helps locate it faster.
answer:
Thank you for pointing this out, and apologies for the confusion on your invoice. I'm looking into INV-20458 now to see what triggered the second charge - this sometimes happens if an upgrade request is submitted twice due to a delayed confirmation page. I'll confirm the cause and process a refund for the duplicate amount within 1-2 business days.

I'll follow up here as soon as I have the details on which charge will be reversed.

subject: Mobile app crashes immediately on launch
body:
Since updating the Northwind mobile app yesterday, it crashes within a second of opening on my phone - I don't even get to the login screen. I've tried force-closing, restarting the phone, and reinstalling the app, but the crash happens every time. This is on an iPhone 13 running iOS 17.4.

A couple of colleagues on our finance team have reported the same issue after updating. We rely on the app for approving expense reports on the go, so this is becoming a problem for us.
answer:
Sorry for the trouble this is causing, especially with expense approvals affected. This sounds like it could be related to the recent app update - could you let us know the exact app version shown in your device's app store listing, and whether the crash happens before or after any splash screen appears?

In the meantime, expense approvals can still be done through the web dashboard as a workaround while we investigate the crash on our end.

subject: URGENT - restore from backup stuck, production data inaccessible
body:
We triggered a restore from backup at 3:12am after an accidental deletion in our production bucket bc-prod-01, and the restore job has been stuck at "in progress" for over 5 hours now with job id rst-77042. Our application is completely down because it depends on this bucket for reading configuration and asset files.

We have zero visibility into progress and no ETA. This is a full production outage affecting all our customers right now - we need this escalated immediately.
answer:
This has been escalated to our on-call infrastructure team as a P0 incident. We're investigating why job rst-77042 has stalled and will update you within the next 15-20 minutes with either progress or an alternative restore path. Please stand by and avoid triggering a new restore job on the same bucket in the meantime, as that could complicate recovery.

We understand the severity of this outage and will keep this channel open until service is restored.

subject: Storage quota exceeded errors despite available capacity
body:
Our API integration has started returning "quota_exceeded" errors on upload attempts since yesterday afternoon, error code STG-409, even though our usage dashboard shows we're only at 68% of our allocated storage quota. We're on 115 seats and haven't changed our upload volume recently - roughly 3,200 files per day, consistent with last month.

This is blocking our media asset pipeline from ingesting new content. Can someone check if there's a mismatch between our actual usage and what the quota system is reporting?
answer:
Thanks for the clear details, including the STG-409 error code and usage discrepancy. This looks like it could be a sync issue between our quota tracking service and the usage dashboard rather than an actual capacity problem. We're checking your account's quota allocation against real-time usage now and will get back to you shortly with a fix or manual quota reset if needed.

In the meantime, could you confirm if all failing uploads are going to the same bucket or spread across multiple buckets?

subject: Restore from backup missing files after retention policy change
body:
We updated our retention policy last week to 90 days, and today I attempted to restore from a backup snapshot taken before that change, expecting the original 180-day retained files. The restore (job id rst-63390) completed, but roughly 4,000 files that should have existed under the old policy are missing from the restored set.

Our legal team needs the complete file set for a case review by Friday. Can you confirm whether the retention policy change affected snapshots taken before it was applied, and if there's documentation on how retention changes interact with existing backups?
answer:
Thanks for the clear timeline on the policy change and restore attempt. Retention policy changes can, in some cases, retroactively apply pruning rules to older snapshots depending on when the backup index was last rebuilt - we're checking whether that happened with job rst-63390. We'll confirm within the next few hours whether the missing 4,000 files are recoverable from an earlier snapshot.

We'll also point you to our documentation on retention policy interactions with existing backups once we've confirmed the root cause, so this doesn't catch your team off guard again.

subject: How to unsubscribe from duplicate notification emails
body: I'm receiving the same weekly report notification email twice every Monday - once around 6am and again around 6:15am. I only need one copy and would like to unsubscribe from the duplicate without turning off the report entirely. Is there a setting in the notification preferences to manage this, or is this a known duplication issue?
answer:
Thanks for reaching out about the duplicate emails. This is sometimes caused by two separate notification rules pointing to the same report, rather than a bug. Could you check your Notification Preferences page under Weekly Reports to see if there are two entries listed for the same report? If so, disabling one should resolve the duplication.

If you only see one entry but still get two emails, let us know and we'll dig into your account's notification logs directly.

subject: MFA enrolment failing for new employees since this morning
body: We're seeing a widespread issue where employees trying to enroll in MFA get stuck after scanning the QR code. The app says 'verification failed, code mismatch' even when entered immediately. This started around 8am today and has affected at least 30 of our 80 seats so far, all through the SSO portal. We can't onboard three new hires who start this week because they can't complete their identity setup.
answer: Thank you for flagging this immediately, we understand this is blocking onboarding. We've reproduced a similar time-sync issue affecting TOTP-based enrolment for a subset of tenants and are treating this as a P1 incident. In the meantime, please have affected users try enrolling via the SMS or push-notification method as a workaround while our engineering team pushes a fix to the QR/TOTP flow, and we'll update you within the hour.

subject: Urgent: multiple deprecated endpoints returning errors ahead of sunset date
body: Our integration team noticed that several endpoints under /v1/patients and /v1/claims that were marked deprecated for removal on 2024-09-30 are already returning 410 Gone responses today, weeks early. This is breaking our production sync jobs for 205 seats across three hospital systems. Our SDK version is 4.2.1 and we haven't had time to migrate to the v2 equivalents yet since the original timeline gave us until end of September.
answer: Apologies for the disruption, this is not expected behavior and we're escalating it to the API platform team right now as a P1. We're checking whether a config change accidentally advanced the sunset date for your tenant, and we'll aim to have the affected endpoints restored to their deprecated-but-functional state within a few hours while we confirm the actual removal timeline with you.

subject: Jira integration not creating issues from Slack after reconnect
body: I reconfigured our Jira link inside the Integrations panel yesterday after our Jira instance moved to a new URL, and now none of the Slack commands (/northwind-jira create) are creating tickets. The Slack bot responds with 'Integration error: unable to reach Jira endpoint' every time. This is blocking our whole editorial team from filing bugs through Slack, which is our main workflow.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. It sounds like the stored Jira base URL didn't update correctly after the migration, which is likely causing the connection failure. We're marking this P1 since it's blocking your team's workflow, and we'll walk through re-authenticating the Jira connection with the new URL together, likely needing you to regenerate the OAuth token on the Jira side.

subject: Request to extend audit log retention and add export filters
body: We rely on the Admin Console audit log to track configuration changes across our 127 seats, but currently we can only see the last 30 days of activity and there's no way to filter by actor or action type before exporting. For our upcoming ISO audit we need at least 6 months of history and the ability to export filtered CSVs by user and date range.
answer: Thanks for the detailed feedback, this is a common request and I've logged it with our product team as a feature request tied to your account. In the short term, we can manually pull an extended audit export for your upcoming ISO audit if you let us know the exact date range and users you need covered, so you're not blocked while the filtering feature is being built.

subject: Webhooks silently stopped delivering events since last night
body: Our webhook endpoint hasn't received any events since around 11pm last night even though our subscription status shows 'active' in the dashboard. We checked our server logs and there are zero incoming requests, no retries, nothing. We're on Starter plan with 14 seats and use webhooks for order status updates, so our downstream billing system is now out of sync for any orders placed after that time.
answer: This has been escalated as a P1 since it's affecting production order updates. We're seeing an issue on our side with webhook dispatch for a subset of Starter tenants and are working on redelivering the missed events once the queue is cleared. We'll send you a list of affected event IDs so you can reconcile your billing system, and we'll confirm once delivery resumes normally.

subject: Dashboard export issue
body: We've been building out a new set of quarterly revenue dashboards for our travel operations team over the past two weeks, pulling in data from three different sources including our booking API and CSV uploads. Everything looked fine during setup and the initial preview rendered correctly with all the line charts showing booking trends by region.
answer: Thanks for the context, and sorry for the trouble with the export. Since the chart rendering breaks specifically on export rather than in the live view, this points to an issue in how the export renderer handles multi-source chart data. Could you send us the dashboard ID and a sample exported file so we can reproduce the exact failure and get a fix or workaround to you?

subject: help
body:
one of our connectors keeps failing auth every few hours, its the postgres source connector pulling from our production db. logs show:
ERROR: connection authentication failed for user pipeline_svc
Retry attempt 3/3 failed, backing off 300s
Sync paused: auth_token_expired

this has happened 6 times since yesterday and every time it happens we lose about 40 minutes of sync so our downstream tables are stale. we only have 4 seats on this plan so its just me and one other engineer trying to keep this running.
answer: Thanks for the log details, that's very helpful. The repeated auth_token_expired errors suggest the connector's credential rotation isn't being picked up correctly between syncs, which we're treating as a P1 given the recurring downstream staleness. We're going to check your connector's token refresh configuration now and will get back to you shortly with either a fix or a temporary workaround using a static service credential.

subject: STILL WAITING ON RESTORE - THIS IS UNACCEPTABLE
body: We requested a restore from backup for our legal-docs-2024 bucket THREE DAYS AGO after a bad sync overwrote 400+ files, and support keeps telling me it's 'in progress' with zero actual updates. We are a law firm, we cannot have client documents missing indefinitely, this is a compliance nightmare. If this isn't resolved by tomorrow we are seriously reconsidering our contract with Northwind entirely.
answer: I completely understand the urgency and I apologize for the lack of updates you've received. I'm escalating this directly to our storage and compliance team right now to get you a concrete status on the legal-docs-2024 restore, including the exact snapshot timestamp being used and an ETA. You will hear back from a named engineer within the hour with real progress, not a generic status update.

subject: Salesforce-Sync funktioniert nicht mehr korrekt
body: Seit letzter Woche werden unsere Salesforce-Kontakte nicht mehr korrekt mit Northwind synchronisiert. Mehrere Datensätze aus unserem Buchhaltungsteam fehlen komplett und die Slack-Benachrichtigungen über fehlgeschlagene Syncs kommen inzwischen alle paar Minuten. Wir haben nur 7 Lizenzen, aber das betrifft unsere gesamte Finanzabteilung bei der täglichen Abrechnung.
answer: Vielen Dank für die genaue Beschreibung, das behandeln wir als P1, da es Ihre gesamte Finanzabteilung betrifft. Wir prüfen aktuell die Verbindung zwischen Salesforce und Northwind auf abgelaufene Zugriffstoken, da dies die häufigste Ursache für fehlende Datensätze und wiederholte Fehlermeldungen ist, und melden uns in Kürze mit einem Zwischenstand.

subject: Need to reconcile seat count discrepancy on our Pro plan
body: Our latest invoice shows billing for 137 seats, but when I check the Admin Console user list we only have 129 active accounts. This has been the case for at least two billing cycles now, and I'd like to understand whether we're being overcharged and if a refund or credit is possible for the difference. Could someone review our account and confirm the correct seat count going forward?
answer: Thanks for bringing this to our attention. I'll have our billing team review your last two invoices against the Admin Console user count to confirm the discrepancy, and if you were overcharged for the extra seats we'll process a credit or refund accordingly. I'll follow up within two business days with the reconciled numbers and next steps.

subject: Mobile app crashes immediately on launch for some field staff
body:
We've had a handful of field techs report that the Northwind mobile app crashes right after the splash screen on Android 13 devices. It happens consistently on Pixel 6 and Samsung A14 phones, but our iOS users are unaffected. This started around March 4th and affects maybe 15-20 users out of our 200 seats.

Can you let us know if this is a known issue with the latest app version, and whether reinstalling would help? Not urgent since most people can still use the desktop dashboard in the meantime.
answer:
Thanks for flagging this, and good to know the desktop dashboard is available as a fallback in the meantime. We've seen a couple of similar reports tied to a caching issue introduced in the last Android release, so this may well be the same root cause your techs are hitting.

Could you have one affected user send us the crash log via Settings > Send Diagnostics, or just the device model and app version shown on the login screen? We'll investigate and follow up with either a fix timeline or a workaround.

subject: Need guidance on recurring transform failures in nightly pipeline
body:
I'm working on our nightly ETL pipeline that pulls from our S3 connector into the media-assets dataset, and for the past week we've seen intermittent transform-stage failures. The job log shows 'transform step 4 exited with non-zero status' roughly 2-3 times per week, usually affecting the dedup step. We have to manually rerun the job each time, which is delaying our morning reports by a couple hours.

We'd like guidance on best practices for making this transform more resilient, and whether there's a way to get alerted automatically when a step fails so we're not relying on someone checking dashboards manually.
answer:
Thanks for the detailed description. Intermittent failures at a specific transform step often point to a data quality issue upstream, like malformed records or schema drift in the source, rather than a pipeline bug, so it would help to see the full error payload from one failed run if you can pull it from the job history.

On the alerting side, you can configure failure notifications under Pipeline Settings > Alerts to send to Slack or email whenever a step fails, which should remove the need for manual dashboard checks. We're happy to review your transform config together if you'd like a second set of eyes on making it more resilient.

subject: Unexpected access from outside our configured IP allowlist
body:
We configured an IP allowlist in the Admin Console last month to restrict logins to our office network, but this morning our audit log shows a successful login from an IP address outside that range (203.0.113.44) at 8:14 AM. We only have 25 seats and this is concerning since we handle sensitive billing data for energy contracts.

Can you help us understand why the allowlist didn't block this, and confirm whether we need to deactivate the account involved while we investigate?
answer:
Thank you for reporting this right away. We're looking into your allowlist configuration and the audit log entry now to determine whether the login came through an API token or session that predates the allowlist rule, since those aren't always retroactively enforced.

As a precaution, we'd recommend deactivating the account tied to that session from Admin Console > Users while we confirm the cause, and we'll follow up shortly with findings and next steps to tighten the rule if needed.

subject: Urgent: new API rate limits breaking our integration for many clients
body:
Since the rate limit change rolled out on our account last week, our integration is hitting 429 responses far more often than before, especially on our /v2/orders and /v2/webhooks endpoints. This is affecting a large portion of our 223 users who rely on the API to sync order data throughout the day, and our support queue is filling up with complaints about delayed order updates.

We understand rate limits need to exist, but the new threshold seems much lower than what was documented before the change. Can someone confirm the current limits per endpoint and whether there's an exception process for accounts with legitimate high-volume needs like ours?
answer:
Apologies for the disruption this is causing across your client base. We can confirm the default rate limit for /v2/orders was reduced from 600 to 300 requests/minute as part of the recent update, which is likely what you're hitting, and this wasn't communicated clearly enough on our end.

We're escalating this internally to get you a temporary limit increase applied to your account today while we review a longer-term quota suited to your usage pattern. We'll also send over updated documentation reflecting the current per-endpoint limits so your team can plan around them going forward.

subject: urgent
body:
We've been migrating our booking integration over the past two weeks to prepare for the SDK v3 upgrade, testing each endpoint carefully against the deprecation notices you published back in January. Everything seemed fine in staging, and we pushed to production yesterday evening after our usual review process.

This morning our security team found unauthorized API calls originating from an old deprecated webhook endpoint that should have been disabled during the migration, and it looks like customer booking data including partial payment references was exposed to an external IP we don't recognize. We need immediate help determining scope and locking this down.
answer:
We're treating this as a critical security incident and have immediately disabled the deprecated webhook endpoint on your account to stop further exposure. Our security team is pulling access logs now to determine what data was reached and from which source, and we'll share preliminary findings within the hour.

In parallel, please rotate any API keys and webhook secrets tied to that endpoint if you haven't already, and forward us the external IP address you identified so we can cross-reference it against our own logs. We'll stay on this with you until scope is confirmed and the incident is fully contained.

subject: Best practices for configuring session timeout with SSO
body:
Our finance team uses SSO through Northwind Identity, and we're finding that sessions are timing out after roughly 15 minutes of inactivity, which is disrupting work on longer billing reconciliation tasks. We have 1719 seats total and this seems to apply company-wide since our SSO config was set up.

Could you point us to documentation on adjusting session timeout duration, and clarify whether this setting is controlled on our identity provider side or within Northwind's SSO configuration? We'd also like to understand how MFA re-prompt frequency interacts with this timeout.
answer:
Good question, and this is a common point of confusion. Session timeout duration for SSO logins is actually controlled within Northwind's Identity console under Settings > Session Policy, independent of your IdP's own session settings, so adjusting it there should resolve the 15-minute cutoff you're seeing.

MFA re-prompt frequency is a separate setting nearby in the same panel; by default it's tied to session expiry, but you can decouple them if you want MFA prompts less frequently than full re-authentication. I'll send over our SSO configuration guide which covers both settings in detail.

subject: Question about file retention period on Storage plan
body:
We upload delivery confirmation photos and scanned documents to Northwind Storage daily for our freight operations, and I noticed some files older than 90 days seem to have disappeared from a folder we needed for a compliance review last week. We're on a small setup with 23 users, and I want to understand what our actual retention policy is before this becomes a bigger issue.

Could someone confirm the default retention period for our storage tier and whether there's a way to extend it or set up automatic backups for files we need to keep longer than that?
answer:
Thanks for reaching out about this. On the Starter tier, the default retention window for stored files is 90 days before they're automatically purged, which matches what you're seeing with the missing folder contents, and unfortunately files past that window aren't recoverable on this plan.

If you need longer retention for compliance purposes, we'd recommend either upgrading to a plan with extended retention or setting up a scheduled export/backup job to move files to external storage before the 90-day mark. I'm happy to walk you through configuring that export job if useful.

subject: Need to restore several files from backup after accidental deletion
body:
One of our team members accidentally deleted a batch of configuration backups from our Storage bucket yesterday afternoon while cleaning up old folders, roughly 40 files under the /configs/archive path. We're on the Starter plan with 20 seats and don't have an automated backup job set up ourselves, so I'm hoping Northwind retains a recoverable snapshot.

Could you confirm whether these files can be restored from your side, and if so what the process and expected turnaround time would be?
answer:
Thanks for the details on the deleted path and timing. On the Starter plan we retain point-in-time snapshots for 7 days, so files deleted yesterday afternoon should still be recoverable; we'll need the exact folder path and approximate deletion timestamp to target the right snapshot.

Once we have that confirmed, the restore process typically takes a few hours to complete and we'll notify you when the /configs/archive files are back in place. Please reply with the deletion time as precisely as you can so we can start the restore.

subject: Connector losing authentication periodically overnight
body:
Our Salesforce connector in Data Pipelines has started dropping its authentication token overnight, causing our early morning sync jobs to fail with 'invalid_grant: token expired' errors on about 3 out of the last 7 nights. We're on 250 seats and this connector feeds our retail sales dashboard, so the data is stale by an hour or two until someone manually re-authenticates in the morning.

Could you help us figure out why the refresh token isn't renewing automatically, and whether there's a setting to extend the token lifetime or trigger re-auth automatically before it expires?
answer:
Thanks for the specifics on the error and frequency. This pattern usually indicates the refresh token itself is being invalidated on the Salesforce side, often due to a session policy or IP restriction change there, rather than an issue with our connector's renewal logic, so it's worth checking your Salesforce connected app settings for session timeout rules.

On our end, we can add a pre-emptive re-auth check that runs a few hours before typical expiry to reduce the impact while you investigate the Salesforce-side policy; let us know if you'd like us to enable that for this connector.

subject: Critical: cannot restore backup files needed for audit deadline
body:
We're trying to restore a set of financial statement backups from Storage ahead of an audit deadline tomorrow morning, and the restore job we started two hours ago is stuck showing 'processing' with no progress. The files are under /backups/statements/2024-q1 and total roughly 3.2 GB. This is blocking our compliance team from finalizing documentation and we're on a tight quota already at 88% usage.

We need this resolved today given the deadline, and would also appreciate clarity on our current retention settings so we don't hit this problem again next quarter.
answer:
We understand the urgency given your audit deadline and are escalating this restore job immediately. A stuck 'processing' state for a job this size after two hours suggests it may have hit a queue backlog on our end; our storage team is manually checking the job status right now and will push it through or restart it within the next 30 minutes.

We'll confirm as soon as the /backups/statements/2024-q1 files are accessible again, and separately we'll send documentation on your current retention window and quota usage so we can help you set up a recurring backup schedule that avoids this pressure next quarter.

subject: pipeline delay
body:
we run the nightly connector sync for our student enrollment data and noticed several records from our SIS connector are landing 6-8 hours after the source timestamp. this has happened on Oct 3, Oct 5 and Oct 9. our downstream dashboards show stale counts until the late records finally arrive.

log from the connector run:
2024-10-09T02:14:02Z sync_start connector=sis_v2 batch=8841
2024-10-09T02:14:55Z warn late_arrival record_ts=2024-10-08T18:02:00Z ingest_ts=2024-10-09T02:14:40Z drift=8h12m
2024-10-09T02:15:01Z sync_complete rows=4210 late_rows=37

is there a way to configure a watermark or grace window in the pipeline settings so late records get reprocessed automatically instead of us manually rerunning batches? Also would appreciate documentation on how late-arrival handling works for this connector.
answer: Thanks for the detailed logs. Right now the SIS connector doesn't have a configurable watermark, but we do support a lateness grace window on the pipeline destination side that will reprocess and merge late-arriving rows automatically rather than requiring a manual rerun. I'll share our internal doc on watermark configuration and log this as a feature request to expose grace-window settings directly in the connector UI, since currently it's only available via support-assisted config.

subject: Finance data pipeline showing stale numbers due to late transactions
body:
Our finance reporting pipeline pulls transaction data from our ERP connector every hour, and for the past three days (since Oct 14) we've seen a growing gap between transaction timestamps and when they actually show up downstream. Yesterday's close-of-day report was missing about 60 transactions that arrived nearly 5 hours late, which threw off our reconciliation.

This is affecting our month-end close process since finance relies on same-day totals. Can someone check whether the ERP connector sync interval or a queue backlog is causing this delay? We need this resolved quickly as our close is due Friday.
answer: I understand the urgency given your close deadline. I'm pulling the sync logs for your ERP connector now to check for queue backlog or throttling on our end — initial look shows increased latency starting Oct 14 that correlates with a connector-side retry loop we're investigating as a possible bug. I'll update you within a few hours with root cause and a mitigation, and in the meantime I'd recommend re-running the close-of-day report for the affected dates once we confirm the backlog has cleared.

subject: URGENT CARD ISSUE ON OUR ACCOUNT NEEDS ESCALATION
body:
SO WE'VE BEEN A CUSTOMER FOR OVER TWO YEARS NOW AND OUR ACCOUNT MANAGES BILLING FOR 246 SEATS ACROSS MULTIPLE TEAMS. WE'VE HAD A LOT OF CHANGES RECENTLY WITH OUR FINANCE TEAM AND SWITCHED CARDS ON FILE LAST MONTH BECAUSE OUR OLD CORPORATE CARD EXPIRED. WE UPDATED THE CARD IN THE BILLING PORTAL ON OCT 2 AND THOUGHT EVERYTHING WAS FINE.

THE ACTUAL PROBLEM IS THAT INVOICE INV-88213 FOR OCT 5 FAILED WITH ERROR 'DO_NOT_HONOR' AND NOW OUR ACCOUNT SHOWS PAST DUE WITH A WARNING BANNER. WE NEED THIS ESCALATED SINCE THIS AFFECTS OUR ENTIRE ORG'S ACCESS. PLEASE ADVISE HOW TO RETRY PAYMENT AND WHETHER WE'RE AT RISK OF A REFUND DELAY ON A DUPLICATE CHARGE WE ALSO SEE FOR INV-88190.
answer: Thanks for flagging this, and apologies for the disruption to your team. I've escalated invoice INV-88213 internally — the DO_NOT_HONOR response typically means the issuing bank is declining the transaction, so I'd recommend confirming with your bank that the new card is authorized for recurring charges of this size before we retry. I'm also checking the duplicate charge on INV-88190 now and will process a refund if confirmed; I'll follow up within the next business day with both items resolved.

subject: Deactivated user still appears active in audit log
body:
I deactivated a former contractor's account in the Admin Console on Oct 11 under Users > Deactivate, and the UI confirmed the status changed to Inactive. However, when I checked the audit log today, the entry still shows the account as 'Active' with no deactivation event recorded at all.

We also noticed this user is still listed on our IP allowlist settings page, which seems inconsistent with a deactivated account. Could you confirm whether deactivation is supposed to remove allowlist entries automatically, and why the audit log isn't reflecting the change?
answer: Thanks for the report — this does look like a display inconsistency rather than an actual access issue, since deactivation itself doesn't automatically strip allowlist entries (that's a separate manual step). I'm looking into why the audit log entry didn't record the deactivation event; could you send the exact user ID or email associated with the account so I can trace it in our internal logs?

subject: Audit log missing entries for bulk user deactivation
body:
We ran a bulk deactivation for 34 users through the Admin Console yesterday (Oct 16) as part of an offboarding cleanup for a former department. The action completed successfully in the UI, but when we exported the audit log for that date range, only 11 of the 34 deactivation events appear.

This is a compliance concern for us since legal requires a complete audit trail for all account changes. Can you confirm whether this is a logging bug or an export/pagination issue on our end? We need the full record before our internal audit review on Oct 22.
answer: This sounds like a logging gap rather than an export issue, and given your compliance deadline I'm treating this as a priority investigation. I'm pulling the raw event data on our backend for the Oct 16 bulk deactivation batch to see if all 34 events were recorded internally even if they didn't surface in the exported log, and will let you know within the next few hours along with a corrected export if needed.

body:
getting repeated sync failures between our Salesforce integration and Northwind, started this morning around 9am. affects lead records specifically - contact and account sync still work fine.

error from integration log:
2024-10-18T09:02:11Z ERROR salesforce_sync object=Lead action=upsert
INVALID_FIELD_FOR_INSERT_UPDATE: Custom__Lead_Score__c is not writable for this profile
2024-10-18T09:02:12Z retry attempt=1 status=failed
2024-10-18T09:05:00Z retry attempt=3 status=failed
sync_job aborted after 3 retries, 214 leads unsynced

we haven't changed any field permissions recently on our side. can someone check if something changed on the integration mapping for the Lead object?
answer: Thanks for sending the log — the INVALID_FIELD_FOR_INSERT_UPDATE error suggests the integration user's Salesforce profile lost write access to Custom__Lead_Score__c, which could happen from a permission set change or a Salesforce release update on your org. I'd recommend checking the integration user's field-level security for that field first, but I'm also reviewing our mapping config on our end in case something shifted there, and will follow up shortly with findings.

subject: Multiple SDK calls broken after recent API update
body:
We've been using the API Platform for our order tracking integration for about a year now, calling several endpoints daily via our internal SDK wrapper to sync order status with our warehouse system. Everything was stable until this week.

Starting Oct 17, we started getting failures on webhook delivery and a couple of SDK calls we rely on for order updates. Here's what we're seeing in our logs:

2024-10-17T14:22:03Z ERROR sdk_call endpoint=/v2/orders/status method=POST
response: 410 Gone - {'error': 'endpoint_deprecated', 'sunset_date': '2024-10-15', 'replacement': '/v3/orders/status'}
2024-10-17T14:22:05Z ERROR webhook_delivery event=order.updated status=failed reason=schema_mismatch

It seems like the v2 endpoint was deprecated without us catching the notice, and now our webhook payloads don't match what our system expects either. This is affecting real-time order updates for our whole operations team right now.
answer: Thanks for the detailed logs — you're right that /v2/orders/status was sunset on Oct 15 in favor of /v3/orders/status, and the webhook schema_mismatch is likely because the v3 payload structure changed field names for order status. I'd recommend migrating your SDK calls to the v3 endpoint as the fastest fix, and I'm attaching the updated webhook schema doc so you can adjust your parsing logic; given this is affecting live order updates, I'm marking this high priority on our side and will check in once you've confirmed the migration works.

subject: Freigabeeinstellungen für Dashboards anpassen
body:
Wir möchten die Freigabeberechtigungen für unsere Dashboards überarbeiten. Aktuell können alle 22 Nutzer in unserem Workspace jedes Dashboard sehen und exportieren, aber wir brauchen eine granularere Kontrolle, sodass nur bestimmte Teams Zugriff auf bestimmte Dashboards haben.

Gibt es eine Möglichkeit, Freigaben auf Team- oder Rollenebene statt nur auf Workspace-Ebene einzurichten? Falls das aktuell nicht möglich ist, würden wir das gerne als Feature-Wunsch einreichen, da dies für unsere Berichtsstruktur wichtig wäre.
answer: Vielen Dank für die Anfrage. Aktuell unterstützen wir Freigaben nur auf Workspace-Ebene, eine team- oder rollenbasierte Freigabe für einzelne Dashboards ist derzeit nicht verfügbar. Ich reiche das gerne als Feature-Wunsch an unser Produktteam weiter und halte Sie über den Status auf dem Laufenden.

subject: SCIM provisioning completely down - no new users can be created via SSO
body:
Our SCIM provisioning integration with Okta stopped working entirely as of this morning. All provisioning requests are returning 500 errors, and we have 12 new hires waiting on account access for onboarding today. Existing users can still log in via SSO, but no new accounts are being created or updated through SCIM at all.

This is blocking our entire onboarding process across the org and we need this fixed immediately - our HR and IT teams are stuck. Please treat this as top priority.
answer: This is being treated as our highest priority right now — I've escalated to our identity platform team immediately given this is blocking all new user provisioning org-wide. We're actively investigating the 500 errors on the SCIM endpoint and I'll provide an update within the next 30 minutes; in the meantime, if any of the 12 pending users need urgent access, we can walk you through manual provisioning as a temporary workaround.

subject: Salesforce integration completely broken, no sync since yesterday
body:
Our Salesforce sync stopped working entirely yesterday afternoon around 3pm and hasn't recovered since. No records are syncing in either direction - not leads, contacts, or opportunities. This is blocking our entire sales team from seeing updated data and we're a small team so everyone is affected.

I'll have an update for you shortly since I know this is blocking your whole sales team, and in the meantime please confirm if you've seen any recent login or permission prompts on the Salesforce side that might indicate an expired auth token.

subject: Dashboard sharing permissions not restricting access by role
body:
We manage a logistics dashboard suite shared across 204 seats and just noticed that a dashboard tagged 'Warehouse Ops - Restricted' is visible to all users regardless of the viewer role group we set up. I tested with three test accounts outside the 'Ops-Managers' group and they can still open and export the data. This looks like a permissions bug rather than user error since the sharing settings show 'Restricted to Ops-Managers' correctly in the UI.

Can you confirm whether role-based sharing is actually enforced server-side, and if there's a way to audit which dashboards currently have this leak? We need this locked down quickly given the sensitivity of the data involved.
answer:
Thanks for flagging this — a permissions bypass on restricted dashboards is a priority issue and we're escalating it to engineering right now. Can you send us the dashboard ID for 'Warehouse Ops - Restricted' and the account IDs of the test users who could view it, so we can reproduce the exact scope of the leak?

In the meantime, as a precaution we'd recommend temporarily unpublishing that dashboard until we confirm enforcement is working correctly. We'll update you within a few hours with root cause and a fix timeline, and we'll also review our sharing documentation since this clearly wasn't obvious from the UI.

subject: Uploads to Storage failing repeatedly since this morning
body:
Since around 8am today our scheduled uploads to Storage have been failing. We push daily CSV exports (roughly 2GB each) from our logistics tracking system and every attempt for the last 6 runs has errored out with 'upload interrupted: connection reset' after about 40% completion. We're on the Starter tier so I'm wondering if this is a quota issue, but our dashboard shows we're well under our storage allocation.

This is blocking our backup pipeline and we have no fresh data replicated since yesterday. Can someone check if there's an outage affecting uploads or if something changed on our account?
answer:
Sorry for the disruption — we're seeing elevated upload failures affecting Storage uploads in your region and our infrastructure team is already investigating a root cause on our end. This does not appear to be a quota problem on your account, so please don't resize anything for now.

We'll post updates here as we get more information, and we'll confirm once uploads are stable again so you can resume your backup schedule. If it's helpful, retrying with smaller chunked uploads (under 500MB) may succeed in the meantime while we work the underlying issue.

subject: Slack alerts from Integrations stopped firing after Okta re-auth
body:
We use the Slack integration to post alerts into our #ops-alerts channel whenever a shipment status changes, and it stopped working two days ago right after our team re-authenticated Okta SSO for all 16 seats. The integration still shows 'Connected' in the admin panel but no messages have come through since March 3rd around 2pm.

I checked the Slack app permissions and nothing looks revoked on that end. Is there a known conflict between Okta session refresh and the Slack webhook token? We rely on these alerts for floor staff so this needs a fix or workaround soon.
answer:
Thanks for the detailed timeline — that correlation with the Okta re-auth is useful. We've seen webhook tokens get silently invalidated when SSO sessions are refreshed in certain configurations, so we're checking your integration logs now to confirm that's what happened here.

As a quick workaround, disconnecting and reconnecting the Slack integration from the admin panel should regenerate the webhook and restore alerts immediately. We'll also update our integration documentation to call out this Okta interaction so it's clearer for other admins going forward.

subject: Deactivated users still appearing as active in Admin Console
body:
I deactivated four former employees from the Admin Console last week as part of our offboarding process, but two of them — including one whose account was flagged in our audit log export — still show as 'Active' under Users, and one was still able to log into billing tools yesterday. We have 108 seats on the Pro plan and need deactivation to actually revoke access immediately, especially for compliance reasons.

Can you check why these accounts didn't fully deactivate, and confirm whether our allowlist settings might be interfering with the deactivation process?
answer:
Thanks for reporting this — a deactivated user retaining active access is something we take seriously, so we're looking into your account configuration now. This can sometimes happen if the user's session token wasn't force-revoked or if an allowlist rule is re-granting access after deactivation, so we're checking both possibilities against the two accounts you mentioned.

Could you share the account identifiers for those two users so we can trace their session and audit log history directly? We'll get back to you with findings and make sure their access is fully cut off in the meantime.

subject: urgent
body:
Our team dashboard for energy consumption metrics has been taking 30-45 seconds to load charts since yesterday, up from the usual 3-4 seconds. We only have 13 seats so it's a small team, but this is now affecting every analyst who checks the dashboard each morning. The chart with the most data (daily consumption by site, about 90 days of history) is the worst offender.

Is there something wrong on our account or is this a broader performance issue? We'd like this escalated since it's slowing down our whole reporting workflow.
answer:
Thanks for the report — a jump from 3-4 seconds to 30-45 seconds is well outside normal range, so we're escalating this for investigation. Could you tell us the exact dashboard name and whether this slowdown affects all charts or just the 90-day consumption chart you mentioned?

We'll check for any recent changes to your account's data volume or indexing that might explain the regression, and we'll follow up with findings shortly. In the meantime, filtering the chart to a shorter date range (like 30 days) may help temporarily while we investigate.

subject: Audit log missing entries for recent settings changes
body:
We rely on the Admin Console audit log to track configuration changes across our small team of 5 seats, but I noticed today that changes made to our notification settings on February 27th and 28th aren't showing up in the log at all, even though two other admins confirmed they made those changes. The log just jumps from February 26th to March 1st with nothing in between.

We also deactivated a user during that window and want to confirm that action was actually logged. Can you help us figure out if this is a display issue or if entries are genuinely missing?
answer:
Thanks for catching this gap — missing audit entries for a two-day window is concerning and we want to get to the bottom of it quickly. We're checking backend logging for your account for February 27th-28th to see if this is a display/filtering issue or an actual data gap, including the deactivation event you mentioned.

We'll report back with what we find, and if entries are confirmed missing we'll let you know what data we can reconstruct from other system logs. In the meantime, please note the exact settings changed and the approximate times if you have them, as that will help us cross-reference faster.

subject: SSO role mapping assigning wrong permissions after group sync
body:
After our last Okta group sync on Monday, several team members were mapped to the wrong role under our SSO configuration. Two people who should have 'Viewer' access were granted 'Admin' permissions instead, and one manager who needs MFA-exempt admin access got dropped to a basic role with no access to key settings. We only have 4 seats so this is easy to notice but concerning since it affects permission boundaries directly.

Can you check our role mapping configuration to see why the group-to-role assignments got scrambled? We need this corrected quickly since two accounts currently have excessive access.
answer:
Thanks for catching this quickly — role mapping errors that grant excessive admin access are a priority for us to fix. We're pulling the sync logs from your last Okta group sync now to see exactly which group-to-role rules misfired and why.

In the meantime, we'd recommend manually reverting the two accounts with excessive admin permissions back to Viewer directly in the Admin Console as a precaution while we trace the root cause. We'll follow up shortly with what caused the scramble and confirm the correct mapping is restored for all affected accounts.

subject: Mobile app crashes immediately on launch for iOS users
body:
Since updating to the latest Mobile App version last week, three of our 10 seats on iOS have reported the app crashing right on launch, before even reaching the login screen. Android users on our team haven't seen this issue. The crash happens consistently, not intermittently, on iPhone 13 and 14 devices running iOS 17.

Could you let us know if this is a known issue with the latest release, and whether there's a fix planned or a previous version we can roll back to in the meantime?
answer:
Thanks for the report — a launch-time crash isolated to iOS after the recent update sounds like a platform-specific regression, and we'd like to look into it. Could you send us the exact app version number showing in the App Store listing and, if possible, a crash log from one of the affected devices via Settings > Privacy > Analytics?

We don't have a rollback build published publicly, but once we confirm the cause we'll let you know whether a hotfix or a temporary workaround is available.

subject: Mobile app offline mode losing data and crashing on reconnect
body:
Our field staff use the Mobile App in offline mode while traveling between sites with no signal, and since last week the app crashes as soon as connectivity returns and it tries to sync. We've had this happen on at least 4 different devices across our 21 seats, and in two cases the offline entries made during the outage were lost entirely after the crash.

This is a serious problem for us since offline reliability is core to how our field teams operate. Can you confirm if this is a known regression and what data recovery options exist for the entries that didn't sync?
answer:
Thank you for the detailed report — losing offline entries on reconnect sync is a serious issue and we're prioritizing this immediately. Could you confirm the app version and device OS versions involved, along with approximate timestamps for the two cases where data was lost, so our team can check server-side sync logs for any partial records we might be able to recover?

We're also investigating the crash-on-sync behavior as a likely regression from a recent release, and we'll update you as soon as we have a root cause and, hopefully, a path to recover the lost entries.

subject: Biometric login on Mobile App failing with generic error
body:
Face ID login on the Mobile App has stopped working for our whole team as of this morning — everyone gets 'Authentication failed, please try again' immediately after the Face ID prompt succeeds on the device side. Falling back to password login works fine, so this seems isolated to the biometric flow itself. We're on 4 seats and all of us are affected regardless of device model.

Is this a known outage with biometric auth, or do we need to reconfigure something on our end? This is disrupting our team's daily login routine.
answer:
Thanks for flagging this right away — a biometric login failure affecting your entire team points to a backend authentication issue rather than something on individual devices, so we're investigating urgently. Password login working as a fallback is helpful information and confirms this is isolated to the biometric token verification step.

We'll keep you updated as we dig into the authentication service logs, and we'll let you know as soon as biometric login is restored or if there's a temporary workaround available while we fix it.

subject: Duplicate alert routing to on-call team
body: We've noticed that since Tuesday our on-call nurses group is receiving every critical alert twice, about 30 seconds apart. I checked the routing rules under Notifications and only one rule targets that group. This is causing confusion during shift handoffs at Cobalt Freight and we need it fixed before it leads to alert fatigue.
answer: Thanks for flagging this, and I understand the urgency given the clinical context. We're looking into a known issue where routing rules with overlapping tag conditions can trigger duplicate dispatch, and I'll confirm whether that matches your setup by checking your rule configuration. I'll update you within a few hours with findings or a temporary workaround to suppress the duplicates.

subject: Getting 429s on webhook subscription endpoint
body: Our integration started returning 429 Too Many Requests on the /v1/webhooks/subscriptions endpoint starting this morning around 9:15am. We're only making about 40 calls per minute using the Node SDK, which is well under what I thought our limit was. This is blocking our billing reconciliation job from registering new webhook listeners.
answer: Thanks for the detail on timing and volume. A recent change lowered the burst limit on the webhook subscriptions endpoint specifically, separate from your general API rate limit, which is likely why you're hitting 429s despite low overall call volume. I'm escalating this to the platform team to confirm the correct limit for your account and will follow up with either a limit increase or guidance on batching your subscription calls.

subject: Enterprise dashboards taking 30+ seconds to load
body: Since last week, our main enrollment dashboard has been taking 30 to 45 seconds to render, and exports to CSV are timing out entirely for our larger data sets. We have around 40 shared dashboards across departments and several department heads have reported the same slowness when trying to view the weekly enrollment chart. This is affecting reporting for over a thousand users at Blue Health.
answer: I'm sorry for the disruption this is causing across your organization, especially with the export failures. This looks like it could be tied to query load on a specific dashboard view, and I'm escalating it to our performance team right now given the scale of impact. I'll be back in touch within a few hours with either a fix or a mitigation while we investigate the root cause further.

subject: PUSH
body: WE'VE BEEN WORKING ON OUR INTEGRATION FOR A FEW MONTHS NOW AND EVERYTHING WAS FINE UNTIL LAST WEEK. WE HAVE A LARGE USER BASE ACROSS MULTIPLE REGIONS AND OUR APP HANDLES BOTH ONLINE AND OFFLINE MODES FOR CONTENT SYNCING. answer: WE UNDERSTAND THE SEVERITY OF THIS ISSUE GIVEN THE SCALE OF DEVICES AFFECTED, AND WE ARE TREATING THIS AS A HIGH PRIORITY PROBLEM. OUR MOBILE TEAM IS REPRODUCING THE CRASH NOW USING A DEVICE THAT RECEIVES A PUSH NOTIFICATION WHILE OFFLINE, AND WE SUSPECT AN ISSUE IN HOW THE NOTIFICATION PAYLOAD IS CACHED LOCALLY BEFORE SYNC. WE WILL SEND AN UPDATE WITHIN THE HOUR WITH EITHER A HOTFIX TIMELINE OR A CLIENT-SIDE MITIGATION YOU CAN SHIP IN THE MEANTIME.

subject: App crashes immediately on launch for some users
body: We're getting reports from about a dozen users that the app crashes right on launch, before even reaching the login screen. It started after our update went live on the 14th. subject: Bulk MFA enrolment for new hires
body: We're onboarding a batch of 45 new employees next Monday and want to make sure they're all required to enroll in MFA on first login rather than getting a grace period. I'll send over a walkthrough for setting up the group-scoped policy so it's ready before Monday's onboarding.

subject: Widespread duplicate email alerts to customers
body: Starting this morning, our customers are receiving duplicate emails for every single alert we send through Notifications, sometimes three copies within a minute. subject: Salesforce sync stopped updating billing records
body: Our Salesforce integration hasn't synced invoice or payment status updates since Sunday night, and now our finance team is looking at stale records when reconciling this month's close. subject: How to adjust scheduled sync frequency for connector
body: We currently have our energy usage data connector set to sync every 6 hours, but we'd like to explore moving to hourly syncs for one specific pipeline feeding our dashboards. subject: api keys not working after update
body: hi we updated our SDK version yestrday and now none of our api keys are authenticating, getting 401 unauthroized on every call. we only have a few keys since were a small team but this is blocking everything including our webhook listeners. did somthing change with key format or deprication schedule? need this sorted asap since our whole team is stuck.
