I'll walk you through regenerating your keys now and confirm your webhook listeners will pick up the new credentials without additional downtime.

subject: Deprecation notice for /v1/webhooks endpoint - need migration timeline
body:
We just received a banner in the API dashboard saying /v1/webhooks/register is being deprecated, but we couldn't find a changelog entry with a firm sunset date. We have 273 seats on Summit Health's media integration relying on this endpoint for real-time content sync, and we're also hitting the rate limit of 600 req/min more often since we added retry logic.

Can you confirm the deprecation date and point us to the replacement endpoint? We need to plan a migration sprint before this breaks in production.
answer: Thanks for flagging this - the /v1/webhooks/register endpoint is scheduled for sunset on the date shown in the deprecation banner, with the new /v2/webhooks/subscriptions endpoint as the replacement (supports the same event types plus batch subscription). I'm attaching our migration guide and will also raise your rate limit ceiling temporarily while you test, since retry storms during migration can trip the 600 req/min cap. I'll follow up within one business day with a dedicated migration checklist for your integration.

subject: Best practice for deactivating users without losing audit history
body:
I'm setting up our offboarding process in Admin Console and want to make sure that when we deactivate a user, their past actions still show up correctly in the audit log. We're a small team (24 seats) but turnover has picked up in manufacturing ops roles.

Is there documentation on how deactivation affects historical audit entries, and whether deactivated users can be re-added to an allowlist later if they return?
answer: Good question, and glad you're thinking about this proactively. Deactivating a user in Admin Console never removes or alters their historical audit log entries - those remain fully attributed and searchable indefinitely. If someone returns, you can reactivate their account or add a new one and re-add them to any allowlist; I'll send over our documentation link covering the full deactivation and re-provisioning workflow.

subject: Audit log missing entries for settings changes last week
body:
I was reviewing the audit log in Admin Console to reconcile some settings changes made around October 3rd-5th for our finance approval workflow, but several entries seem to be missing - specifically changes to allowlist configuration that I know our IT contractor made. We only have 5 seats so it should be easy to track who did what.

Is there a delay in audit log population, or a filter setting I might be missing that's hiding these entries?
answer: Thanks for the details. Audit log entries typically appear within a few minutes of the action, so a multi-day gap suggests either a filter is narrowing your view or the changes were made under a different log category. Could you check whether you have the event type filter set to a specific category, and let me know the exact date range you're viewing? In the meantime I'll check our backend logs for allowlist changes in your workspace during that window.

subject: Duplicate email alerts for same order status change
body:
Our team is getting two identical email notifications every time an order status changes to 'delayed' - happened 14 times yesterday across our retail alerting rules. We have 86 seats and this is generating a lot of noise in Slack too since we forward these emails.

Could you help us figure out if we have overlapping alert rules, or if this is a known duplication issue with the Notifications product? A doc on how alert deduplication works would also help.
answer: Thanks for the report - duplicate sends like this usually come from two alert rules matching the same event condition, so I'd like to take a look at your rule configuration to check for overlap. Could you list the rule names tied to 'delayed' status changes? I'll also send over our documentation on how deduplication windows work, since there's a setting that can suppress repeat sends within a configurable time window.

subject: Need higher rate limit ceiling for SDK integration
body:
We're integrating the Northwind SDK (v2.4) into our internal tools and consistently hitting 429 errors after about 100 requests within a minute during batch operations. Our current plan seems capped lower than what our workflow needs, and the SDK docs don't clearly state what the retry-after header expects in seconds vs milliseconds.

Can someone clarify the current rate limit tier for our account and whether there's a documented backoff strategy the SDK handles automatically?
answer: Thanks for reaching out - I can see your account is on the Starter tier default limit of 100 requests/minute, which matches what you're hitting. The SDK's built-in retry handler does respect the Retry-After header and expects seconds, so if you're seeing mismatched behavior it may be worth checking your SDK version. I'll also flag your account for a temporary limit increase while we discuss whether an upgraded tier fits your integration needs long term.

subject: Need to change scheduled sync frequency and fix growing latency
body:
Our healthcare data pipeline connector (EHR-to-warehouse sync) has been running hourly for months, but over the past two weeks each run is taking noticeably longer - Tuesday's sync took 47 minutes versus the usual 12. We have 274 seats depending on this data being fresh for compliance reporting.

We'd like to change the schedule to run every 30 minutes to reduce batch size per run, but want to confirm this won't worsen the latency issue or affect data quality checks that run downstream.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. Increasing sync frequency to 30 minutes should actually help by reducing the batch size per run, and it won't interfere with the downstream data quality checks since those trigger independently per completed sync. That said, the growing run duration you're seeing suggests something upstream may be accumulating - I'd like to pull the connector logs for the past two weeks to check for row count growth or connection retries before we make the schedule change.

subject: URGENT: Storage uploads failing across all regions - backup jobs stalled
body:
Since approximately 2:15 AM UTC today, all file uploads to Storage are failing with a 503 error for our entire Delta Systems organization (4562 seats). Our nightly backup jobs across three regions have stalled, and we're now over 6 hours behind on retention policy compliance for finance records.

We need immediate escalation - this is affecting every team that depends on scheduled backups, and we're approaching a hard deadline for a regulatory retention checkpoint at end of day.
answer: This has been escalated to our Service Outages team as a P1 incident immediately. We're seeing elevated 503 rates on Storage uploads and engineering is actively investigating the root cause; I'll post updates here every 30 minutes until resolved. In the meantime, please hold off on retrying failed backup jobs in bulk to avoid additional load, and let us know your specific retention checkpoint deadline so we can prioritize recovery for your account accordingly.

subject: ALERTS GOING TO THE WRONG TEAM AND NOW WE'RE GETTING DUPLICATES TOO
body:
THIS IS THE THIRD TIME THIS MONTH our critical energy grid alerts have routed to the WRONG email distribution list instead of ops, and now on top of that we're getting DUPLICATE copies of the ones that DO route correctly. I've submitted feedback twice already with no real fix.

We have 25 seats and this is a SAFETY issue for us, not just annoying. If this isn't fixed properly this week we are seriously going to cancel and move to another vendor. Fix the routing rules or tell me exactly what's broken.
answer: I understand the urgency and I'm sorry this has recurred - misrouted safety alerts are unacceptable and I'm treating this as a priority issue right now. I'm pulling your alert routing configuration immediately to identify why entries are falling back to the wrong distribution list and why duplicates are being generated on the correctly-routed ones; I'll have a root cause and a fix timeline for you within a few hours, not days.

subject: Plan upgrade charged twice but seats still not increased
body:
We tried upgrading from Starter to Pro yesterday to add more seats beyond our current 4, and our card was charged twice - once for $49 and once for what looks like a duplicate $49 charge a few minutes later. Despite both charges going through, our account still shows Starter plan limits and we can't add the new team members we need for an urgent logistics contract starting Monday.

Can someone fix the duplicate charge and get our upgrade actually applied today? This is blocking a time-sensitive hire.
answer: I'm sorry for the trouble this has caused - I can see both charges on your account and I'm processing a refund for the duplicate one right now, which should post within 3-5 business days. I'm also manually applying the Pro plan upgrade to your account immediately so you're not blocked on adding seats for Monday; please refresh your billing page in about 15 minutes and let me know if the seat limits aren't updated.

subject: Need sync schedule changed to handle late-arriving source data
body:
Our retail data pipeline pulls from a supplier feed that's been arriving 2-3 hours later than expected for the past week, which means our current sync schedule (set to run at 6 AM) keeps processing incomplete or stale data. We only have 8 seats but this feed drives our daily inventory reporting.

We'd like to change the pipeline to either retry automatically if the source file isn't ready, or shift to a later trigger time - whichever you'd recommend. Can you walk us through how to set this up and confirm it'll take effect for tomorrow's run?
answer: Thanks for flagging this promptly - given the inconsistent arrival time, I'd recommend switching your connector to a file-presence trigger instead of a fixed time schedule, so the sync only fires once the source file lands rather than guessing a time. I'll walk you through the setup now and we can get this configured before tonight's cutoff so tomorrow's run picks up the correct data automatically.

subject: Files purged before retention period ends - urgent
body:
We noticed documents tagged with our 90-day legal-hold retention policy are being purged after only 30 days. This started right after the storage bucket migration on March 4th. We've already lost access to at least 47 files in our contracts folder that should still be under hold.

[2024-03-06 09:12:33] ERROR retention-worker: policy_id=legal-hold-90d applied=30d bucket=harbor-legal-docs
[2024-03-06 09:12:34] WARN quota-service: upload throttled, quota_pct=98
[2024-03-06 09:15:01] ERROR retention-worker: mismatch detected policy_days=90 actual_ttl=30
[2024-03-06 09:15:02] INFO backup-service: backup skipped, source deleted before snapshot

This affects legal hold compliance for all 208 seats on our workspace. Need this fixed today and confirmation on whether the purged files can be restored from backup.
answer: This is being treated as a P1 incident on our end - I've escalated it directly to the storage team given the compliance impact. Can you confirm the exact bucket name (harbor-legal-docs) and the earliest timestamp you noticed missing files? We're checking whether the March 4th migration altered the retention policy mapping, and we'll pull backup snapshots to attempt recovery of the 47 affected files while we investigate root cause.

subject: Push notifications not delivering on Android app
body: Since yesterday around 2pm, none of our field technicians are receiving push notifications for new work orders through the mobile app. Several also reported the app crashing on launch when they're offline and try to log in with cached credentials. This is happening on Android app version 4.8.2. We have over 100 techs relying on these alerts daily and it's disrupting our shift handoffs badly.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report - this is impacting a core workflow so we're treating it as P1 and pulling in our mobile team now. Could you send us a couple of device IDs or the crash logs from the affected phones so we can confirm whether this is the same push token issue we're seeing elsewhere? In the meantime, having techs force-close and reopen the app while online may temporarily restore notification delivery.

subject: Dashboards laden sehr langsam
body: Unsere Dashboards brauchen seit letzter Woche teilweise über 30 Sekunden zum Laden, besonders die mit mehreren Diagrammen. Der Export als PDF bricht bei einem der Charts sogar komplett ab und zeigt nur eine leere Seite. Wir sind ein kleines Team mit 3 Nutzern, daher fällt das sofort auf, wenn etwas nicht funktioniert.
answer: Vielen Dank für die Meldung. Wir prüfen aktuell, ob es sich um ein serverseitiges Performance-Problem beim Rendering größerer Dashboards handelt. Könnten Sie uns den Namen des betroffenen Dashboards und ein Beispiel für den fehlgeschlagenen Export senden? Wir melden uns mit einem Zwischenstand, sobald wir die Ursache eingegrenzt haben.

subject: Jira integration broken - blocking renewal decision
body: Our Jira link stopped syncing tickets three days ago and we're getting an authentication error every time we try to reconnect. This integration is critical for how our support team tracks issues, and we were planning to evaluate expanding usage before our renewal next month. Right now it's a dealbreaker if we can't get it working reliably.
answer: I understand the urgency given your renewal timeline, so I've flagged this as P1 and looped in our integrations engineering team directly. Can you share the exact error message you're seeing when reconnecting, along with the Jira instance URL? We'll get this resolved quickly and will also connect you with your account manager to discuss the renewal in parallel.

subject: Need to restore folder from backup
body: One of our team members accidentally deleted the 'Q1-Invoices' folder from Storage yesterday afternoon. We'd like to restore it from the most recent backup snapshot if possible - it contained around 60 files we need for an upcoming audit. Please let us know what information you need from us to proceed.
answer: Thanks for flagging this quickly - that helps a lot. Could you confirm the approximate deletion time and the workspace name so we can locate the correct backup snapshot? Once confirmed, we can typically restore a folder like this within a few hours, and we'll let you know as soon as the files are back in place.

subject: Intermittent transform failures in ETL pipeline
body: We're seeing intermittent failures on the transform step of our nightly pipeline that syncs transaction data from our core banking connector. Roughly 1 in 15 runs fails with a data quality validation error, but retrying the same run usually succeeds. Latency on the connector has also crept up over the past week, which may be related.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report - intermittent failures like this are often tied to upstream latency causing partial or malformed payloads before the transform step validates them. Could you share a run ID from one of the recent failures so we can pull the pipeline logs? We'll also check the connector's latency metrics for the same window to see if there's a correlation.

subject: Seat count discrepancy on invoice
body: Our latest invoice shows billing for 25 seats, but we only have 18 active users on our workspace right now. We've offboarded several contractors over the past two months and it looks like their seats weren't released. Could you help us correct this before the next billing cycle and let us know if we're due a partial refund for the overcharge?
answer: Thanks for catching this - we'll review your seat allocation right away and remove any inactive licenses tied to the offboarded contractors. Given the potential overcharge, we're prioritizing this and will have a corrected seat count along with a refund calculation for you within the next business day.

subject: Jira sync stopped working
body: Our Jira integration was working fine until this Monday, and now new tickets created in Northwind aren't showing up in the linked Jira project at all. There's no error message on our end, it just silently stops syncing. We rely on this to keep our small support team aligned, so any pointers would help.
answer: Sorry for the disruption - a silent sync failure usually points to an expired token or a permissions change on the Jira side. Could you check whether the Jira service account used for the integration still has project access, and let us know if you recently rotated any credentials? We'll also check our sync logs for your workspace to see where the process is stalling.

subject: Connector authentication expiring too frequently
body: Our warehouse connector keeps losing authentication every 24-48 hours, forcing us to manually re-authorize it through OAuth each time. This is causing sync gaps in our retail inventory pipeline and we're seeing data quality flags on the runs immediately after re-auth. We need a way to keep the token refresh stable since this is affecting a pipeline with 259 seats depending on accurate stock data.
answer: This sounds like the refresh token isn't being renewed correctly before expiry, which would explain both the frequent re-auth and the data quality flags right after. Could you confirm which connector version you're on and send us the timestamp of the last expiry? We'll check the token refresh logic for your connection and get a fix out as quickly as possible given the pipeline impact.

subject: Fehler beim Plan-Upgrade
body: Wir haben letzte Woche versucht, von Pro auf den nächsthöheren Plan zu upgraden, aber auf der neuen Rechnung werden weiterhin nur 115 Sitze zum alten Preis berechnet, während im Portal bereits die neuen Funktionen aktiv sind. Das führt zu einer Diskrepanz zwischen dem, was wir nutzen, und dem, was abgerechnet wird. Können Sie das bitte prüfen und die Rechnung korrigieren?
answer: Danke für den Hinweis. Das klingt nach einem Synchronisationsproblem zwischen Plan-Upgrade und Abrechnungssystem. Wir prüfen Ihr Konto und gleichen die aktive Sitzanzahl mit der aktuellen Rechnung ab. Falls eine Korrektur nötig ist, erhalten Sie von uns eine berichtigte Rechnung innerhalb der nächsten Tage.

subject: Okta app integration for Slack and Salesforce notifications
body:
I'm setting up our Okta app in the Integrations panel and want to confirm how role mapping works when we also connect Slack and Salesforce. We have 23 seats on the Starter plan and I'd like new hires provisioned through Okta to automatically land in the right Northwind role without manual assignment each time.

Could you point me to documentation on attribute mapping between Okta groups and Northwind roles? Also curious if there's a way to test the sync before rolling it out company-wide.
answer: Thanks for reaching out. Attribute mapping between Okta groups and Northwind roles is configured under Integrations > Okta > Group Mappings, and we do support a sandbox test user so you can validate the sync before enabling it for everyone. I'll send over our Okta setup guide which covers the Slack and Salesforce connector interplay as well, and I'm happy to review your mapping config if you share a screenshot once it's set up.

subject: n/a
body: WE WERE CHARGED TWICE FOR OUR MARCH INVOICE AND I NEED TO UNDERSTAND HOW CREDITS WORK BEFORE I FILE A DISPUTE WITH OUR BANK. WE HAVE 108 SEATS AND THE INVOICE SHOWS TWO PAYMENTS OF THE SAME AMOUNT ON MARCH 3RD AND MARCH 5TH. CAN SOMEONE EXPLAIN THE REFUND PROCESS AND WHETHER THIS GETS ISSUED AS A CREDIT OR AN ACTUAL REFUND TO OUR CARD.
answer: Thanks for flagging this, and no need to escalate to your bank just yet. I'm looking at your March invoice now and can confirm there was a duplicate charge on March 5th. Our standard process is to issue this as a refund to the original payment method rather than an account credit, and it typically posts within 5-7 business days. I'll process this today and send you a confirmation email once it's submitted.

subject: help
body:
our workspce settings page has been throwing errors since this morning and now none of our admins can acess the allowlist configuration. we run a public facing app and just noticed our api requests are getting blocked becuase the ip allowlist reverted to a default state we didnt set.

this is affecting live traffic right now, we're getting 403s across the board and cant fix it ourselves becuase the settings page wont load past the loading spinner. we need this fixed immediatly, this is a school system with active users.
answer: This has been escalated to our on-call security team immediately given the active traffic impact. We're investigating why the allowlist reverted and why the workspace settings page is failing to load, and we'll have an initial update for you within 30 minutes. In the meantime, if you have emergency access to your DNS or firewall layer, temporarily widening your own edge rules may reduce 403 impact while we work on a fix from our side.

subject: Transform failures in nightly pipeline runs
body:
Our nightly data pipeline that aggregates sensor readings from three connectors has failed for the last two runs, on the 14th and 15th. The transform step errors out with a data type mismatch on a field that previously worked fine, and we haven't changed our source schema on our end.

We rely on this pipeline for our morning ops dashboard and now our team is looking at stale data from the 13th. Can someone check if there was a recent change to the transform engine or connector version that might explain this?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. We did push a connector update on the 13th that changed how null values are typed in one of the aggregation steps, which likely explains the mismatch you're seeing. I'm having our data pipelines team verify this against your specific transform config now, and we'll either patch the type handling or provide a workaround for your schema within the next few hours so your dashboard can catch up on the missed runs.

subject: Charts rendering blank after latest dashboard update
body:
Since updating our integration last week, several charts on our main dashboard are rendering completely blank even though the underlying data queries return results fine when I check via the API. It's specifically the line and bar chart widgets, the table and export widgets still work normally.

I've tried refreshing, clearing cache, and rebuilding the widget from scratch but get the same blank result. Is this a known rendering issue, and is there a workaround while we wait for a fix?
answer: Thanks for the clear writeup. We've had a couple of similar reports tied to a rendering regression in the line and bar chart widget after last week's release, so this is likely the same issue rather than something specific to your setup. As a workaround, switching the widget to the legacy renderer under widget settings should restore the display while we roll out a fix, which is expected within the next few days.

subject: User deactivation not removing access to shared workspaces
body:
We deactivated a departing employee's account last Tuesday through the Admin Console, but I noticed today they still show up as having access to two shared workspaces under the collaboration tab. The audit log shows the deactivation event but no corresponding access revocation entry for those workspaces.

Could you confirm whether workspace access is supposed to be automatically revoked on deactivation, or if this is a manual step we're missing? We want to make sure this doesn't happen with future offboarding.
answer: Good catch, and thanks for including the audit log detail. Workspace access should be automatically revoked as part of deactivation, so the missing revocation entry points to a bug rather than a manual step you're missing. I've manually removed that user's access from both workspaces for now and I'm filing this with our engineering team so we can confirm the root cause and prevent it from recurring during future offboarding.

subject: zapier intergration completly broken again
body:
this is the THIRD time this month our zapier connection has just stoped working with no warning. our zaps that push data to slack and jira are all failing silently and we only found out becuase a customer complained nothing was updating.

we are a small team, only 6 seats, and we dont have time to keep checking if your integration decided to break today. the error in the zap history just says "authentication failed" but nothing changed on our end. fix this or we will be looking at other providers, this is rediculous.
answer: I hear your frustration, and repeated silent failures like this are not acceptable, especially without any alerting on our end. The "authentication failed" error usually points to an expired or rotated API token on our Zapier integration, and we've seen a token refresh bug affecting a small number of accounts this month. I'm regenerating your integration token right now and will confirm once it's active, and I'm also flagging the silent-failure alerting gap to our integrations team as a priority.

subject: Workspace-Einstellungen lassen sich nicht speichern
body:
Seit heute Vormittag können wir die Workspace-Einstellungen im Admin Console nicht mehr speichern. Wenn ich Änderungen an der Allowlist oder den allgemeinen Einstellungen vornehme und auf Speichern klicke, erscheint kurz eine Ladeanimation und dann bleibt alles beim alten Zustand, ohne Fehlermeldung.

Ich habe es mit zwei verschiedenen Admin-Konten und Browsern versucht, gleiches Ergebnis. Das Audit Log zeigt auch keinen Eintrag für den Speicherversuch. Können Sie das bitte prüfen?
answer: Vielen Dank für die genaue Beschreibung. Das klingt nach einem Problem beim Speichervorgang selbst, da ja auch kein Eintrag im Audit Log erscheint. Wir prüfen aktuell, ob es einen Vorfall mit dem Einstellungs-Service gibt, der mehrere Workspaces betrifft, und melden uns innerhalb der nächsten Stunde mit einem Update oder einer Lösung zurück.

subject: Feature request: MFA enforcement per SAML group
body:
We recently set up SAML login for our workspace and it's working well overall, but I'd like to enforce MFA only for specific SAML groups rather than the whole organization. Right now it looks like MFA settings apply uniformly across all users regardless of their SAML group membership.

Is this on the roadmap, or is there a workaround using provisioning rules? We have some contractor groups that don't need MFA enforcement while our core team does.
answer: Thanks for the suggestion, this is a common request and I want to give you an accurate answer. Per-group MFA enforcement isn't available yet, but it is on our roadmap for identity and SSO improvements. In the meantime, the closest workaround is using provisioning rules to route different SAML groups into separate workspaces with different MFA policies, though I understand that may not fit your current structure, and I'll pass your feedback along to the product team.

subject: Users unsubscribing but still receiving duplicate emails
body:
Several users have reported clicking unsubscribe on our transactional notification emails, confirming the unsubscribe page loads successfully, but then continuing to receive the same emails days later. One user showed me they got the same booking confirmation email twice on the same day, October 3rd, after unsubscribing on October 1st.

With 241 seats and a large customer base receiving these notifications, this is starting to generate support tickets on our end too. Can you check if unsubscribe preferences are actually syncing to the sending queue?
answer: Thank you for flagging this with specific dates, that's very helpful for tracing the issue. This looks consistent with a sync delay between the unsubscribe preference store and the notification queue, which could explain both the duplicate sends and the lag after opting out. I'm escalating this to our notifications team to check the queue sync job now, and I'll follow up with findings and an estimated fix time as soon as I have them.

subject: Zapier integration failing to trigger Slack/Jira actions
body: We use the Northwind Zapier connector to push new Salesforce leads into Slack and create Jira tickets automatically. Since Tuesday (June 3rd) the zap runs but the Slack and Jira steps silently fail with a generic 'Action could not be completed' error. I checked our Salesforce data and the trigger is firing fine, it's the downstream steps that break. We've had about 40 leads not get routed. Can someone check if the Northwind Zapier app had a recent update that changed the auth scope?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. We did push an update to the Zapier app's OAuth scopes last week which can cause downstream actions to fail silently if the connection wasn't re-authorized. Could you try disconnecting and reconnecting the Northwind account in your Zapier settings and re-testing the zap? If it still fails after reauthorization, send us the Zapier task history ID for one of the failed runs so we can trace it on our end.

subject: Need alert routing rules to avoid duplicate emails across teams
body: Our finance and ops teams are both getting duplicate copies of the same billing alerts because our alert routing rules overlap on the 'invoice.overdue' event type. We'd like a way to set priority or exclusivity between routing rules so only one team receives a given alert, or at least de-duplicate at the notification layer. Right now we're seeing roughly 150 duplicate emails a week across our 2,200+ seat org, which is generating a lot of noise and support tickets internally.
answer: Thanks for flagging this - duplicate delivery when multiple routing rules match the same event is a known gap and we're actively working on rule precedence controls. In the meantime, a workaround is to add mutually exclusive filter conditions (e.g. team tag) to each rule so only one rule matches per event. I'll open a tracking case on your account and update you as soon as native de-duplication or rule priority ships.

subject: ALERTS SENT TWICE AND NO DOCS ON ROUTING RULES
body: WE ARE GETTING EVERY ALERT TWICE, ONE FROM THE DEFAULT RULE AND ONE FROM A CUSTOM RULE WE SET UP LAST WEEK FOR OUR LEGAL TEAM. I TRIED TO FIND DOCUMENTATION ON HOW ROUTING PRIORITY WORKS BUT THE HELP CENTER PAGE FOR ALERT ROUTING IS EMPTY EXCEPT FOR A PLACEHOLDER. THIS IS CAUSING CONFUSION FOR OUR 14 USERS WHO THINK SOMETHING IS BROKEN EVERY TIME AN ALERT COMES IN TWICE. PLEASE HELP FIX THIS AND POINT ME TO REAL DOCS.
answer: I'm sorry for the frustration this is causing your team. Duplicate delivery happens when both a default rule and a custom rule match the same event without an exclusion filter - I can see this on your account and will help you configure the custom rule so it takes priority and suppresses the default one. I've also flagged the empty documentation page to our docs team; in the meantime I'll send you a short written walkthrough of routing priority directly on this ticket.

subject: URGENT: API keys revoked, all requests failing with 401, losing booking data
body: As of 09:14 UTC today all our API keys started returning 401 Unauthorized on every request, including our production booking sync. We rely on the API Platform SDK (v3.2.1) to push and pull travel itinerary data every 5 minutes, and right now we are losing incoming bookings because the sync jobs fail and don't retry successfully. Error from our logs: 'error: invalid_api_key, code: AUTH_401_REVOKED'. Nothing changed on our end - no rotation, no config changes. We need this fixed immediately, we're an energy sector client and this is affecting live customer bookings.
answer: This has been escalated to our on-call platform team immediately given the production impact. We're checking our key management service for any bulk revocation event around 09:14 UTC - initial logs show a possible issue with a scheduled key rotation job that may have affected your project. We'll update you within 30 minutes with either a fix or a temporary key to restore service, and we'll confirm whether any booking data was queued versus lost.

subject: Bar charts rendering blank on retail sales dashboard
body: Since yesterday afternoon, the bar chart widgets on our 'Weekly Sales by Region' dashboard show up completely blank - just the chart title and axis labels, no bars. Line charts and tables on the same dashboard are working fine. I've tried refreshing, clearing cache, and viewing in both Chrome and Firefox with the same result. This is affecting 6 dashboards used by our regional managers for Monday reporting.
answer: Thanks for the clear description - this matches a rendering issue we've seen with the bar chart component after a recent frontend update, specifically when a chart uses more than one grouped dimension. We're pushing a fix and will confirm once it's deployed. In the meantime, switching the chart type to 'stacked bar' and back to 'bar' sometimes forces a re-render that resolves the blank display - could you try that on one dashboard and let us know if it helps?

subject: Seat count in billing doesn't match actual active users, overcharged this invoice
body: Our latest invoice charged us for 217 seats, but when I query the admin API for active users on our account I only get 189 back. I'm integrating our internal HR sync with the Billing API and the seat count endpoint (/v1/billing/seats) is returning a number that doesn't reconcile with /v1/admin/users/active. This discrepancy has been present for at least two billing cycles now and is costing us for seats we don't have. Can someone check the seat calculation logic and issue a correction or refund for the overcharge?
answer: Thank you for the detailed comparison between the two endpoints - this looks like a real discrepancy and given the billing impact I'm prioritizing it. We're checking whether deactivated-but-not-fully-removed users are still being counted toward seats in the billing calculation. I'll have our billing team confirm the correct seat count for your account within one business day and process a credit for any confirmed overcharge across the affected cycles.

subject: Mobile app crashes when switching to offline mode mid-session
body: Our staff use the Northwind mobile app across 1,400+ users, many in the field with unreliable connectivity, and since the last app update the app crashes almost every time it tries to switch to offline mode after a connection drop. It happens on both iOS and Android and users are getting logged out and losing unsaved form entries. This is disrupting daily operations for our education program staff who rely on offline access.
answer: I'm sorry for the disruption this is causing, especially given how many of your staff rely on offline mode daily - I'm escalating this as a high priority issue to our mobile engineering team right now. Could you confirm the app version and whether this happens on a specific OS version, and send us a crash log or timestamp from an affected device if available? We'll keep you updated closely as we investigate, and will let you know if a rollback or hotfix is needed in the interim.

subject: Storage retention policy deleted files earlier than expected
body: I set our workspace retention policy to 90 days for uploaded documents last month, but I just noticed that files uploaded in early March are already gone - that's only about 60 days of retention, not 90. I checked the retention settings page and it still shows 90 days configured. We need those files back if possible and I need to understand why the policy isn't matching what's configured, since this affects compliance records for our 13-seat workspace.
answer: I understand the urgency here given the compliance implications, and I've escalated this to our storage team to investigate immediately. We're checking whether a legacy 60-day default policy was still active on your workspace before the 90-day setting was saved, which could explain the early deletion. We're also checking our backup snapshots to see if the March files can be restored - I'll update you within a few hours with recovery status and root cause.

subject: Requesting quota increase and clarity on upload performance
body: We're integrating our media asset pipeline with the Storage API and keep hitting our quota limit faster than expected - we're on the Starter tier with 13 seats, uploading roughly 50GB/week of video assets. Uploads are also noticeably slower than they were a month ago, sometimes taking 3x as long for the same file size. Could you let us know what quota increase options exist for our plan, and whether the slowdown is a known issue?
answer: Thanks for the details - for quota increases beyond the Starter tier limits, we'd typically recommend moving to a higher plan or adding a storage add-on, and I can get you pricing details if you'd like. Regarding the slowdown, we've had reports of increased upload latency in one of our storage regions over the past few weeks; can you confirm which region your account is provisioned in so we can check if you're affected and get a fix prioritized?

subject: Feature request: export and share broken charts issue plus performance
body: A few of our healthcare dashboard charts (specifically the patient throughput line charts) are rendering incorrectly with overlapping labels when there are more than 20 data points, making them hard to export cleanly to PDF. Separately, we'd love a feature to share a single chart via link without exposing the whole dashboard - right now we have to export screenshots manually for our care teams. Also noticed dashboard load times have gotten slower over the past couple of weeks, around 4-5 seconds now versus under 2 before.
answer: Thanks for combining all of this feedback - it's genuinely useful. The overlapping label issue on charts with 20+ data points is a bug we can reproduce and will fix in an upcoming release; I'll note your account for a heads-up when that ships. Single-chart sharing links aren't available yet but I've logged it as a feature request with your use case attached, and I'm also flagging the load time regression to our performance team to check against recent backend changes.

subject: Change request: session timeout and allowlist update
body: Hi team, we're opening a new office location and I'd like to update our workspace settings in Admin Console to extend the session timeout from 30 to 60 minutes and add our new office IP range (203.0.113.0/24) to the allowlist. Can you confirm this won't affect login performance for our 5 users? Also happy to hear any general feedback on best practices here.
answer: Thanks for the details. Extending the session timeout and adding an IP range to the allowlist won't have any measurable impact on login performance for a workspace your size. I've made the timeout change and added the range you specified - please have your users log out and back in once to pick it up, and let us know if you'd like any further adjustments.

subject: Deactivated user not showing in Audit Log
body: When I deactivate a user in Admin Console under Settings > Users, the deactivation event isn't appearing in the Audit Log. I deactivated employee ID 48213 on Oct 14, but the audit log still lists them as active as of today. This is a problem for our quarterly SOC2 review - is there a workaround to force the log to refresh, or is this a known bug?
answer: Thanks for flagging this - a missing deactivation event in the Audit Log shouldn't happen and we'll need to look into it. Could you confirm your workspace ID and the exact timestamp of the deactivation action so we can trace it in our backend logs? In the meantime, the user's access has been correctly revoked even though the audit entry is missing, so there's no security exposure while we investigate.

subject: URGENT: SSO login broken after Okta app update - all users locked out
body: We updated our Okta app integration for Northwind SSO yesterday and now none of our 8 users can log in via SSO - they get an 'invalid_client' error at the Okta redirect step. This is blocking our entire team from the platform. Our Slack and Jira integrations, which sync through the same SSO groups, are also failing now. Please escalate, we need this resolved today.

Could you send us the Okta app ID and the client ID shown in your Northwind Integrations settings, along with a screenshot of the invalid_client error? We're pulling the integration logs from the time of your update now and will follow up with next steps within the hour.

subject: Duplicate email alerts for CPU threshold rule
body: We're seeing duplicate email notifications for the same alert rule 'High CPU Threshold - Line 4' - each trigger sends two identical emails about 2 minutes apart to our ops distribution list. This started around Oct 10 and happens roughly 15-20 times a day given our alert volume. Not urgent, but it's cluttering inboxes for our team.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report - duplicate deliveries like this usually point to a dedup window issue on our alerting pipeline. Could you share the alert rule ID and one or two message IDs from the duplicate emails so we can trace the exact trigger events? We'll dig into the timing you gave us and update you once we've identified the cause.

subject: Pagination bricht bei /v2/students Endpunkt ab
body: Seit heute Morgen erhalten wir bei der Nutzung des /v2/students Endpunkts mit dem cursor Parameter keine vollständigen Ergebnisse mehr. Ab Seite 3 bricht die Pagination ab und liefert ein leeres data Array zurück, obwohl has_more:true anzeigt, dass weitere Datensätze vorhanden sein sollten. Wir nutzen dies für unser Webhook-basiertes Reporting und benötigen dringend eine Lösung, da unsere nächtlichen Reports fehlschlagen.
answer: Vielen Dank für die genaue Beschreibung, das behandeln wir als P2. Könnten Sie uns eine Beispielanfrage mit dem betroffenen cursor-Wert und einen Zeitstempel eines fehlgeschlagenen Aufrufs schicken? Wir prüfen parallel unsere Pagination-Logik für den /v2/students Endpunkt und melden uns so schnell wie möglich mit einem Update.

subject: How to let customers unsubscribe from just one notification type
body: One of our customers asked how to unsubscribe from just the weekly digest emails without opting out of all Northwind notifications entirely. Is there a way to manage notification categories separately, or would we need to build this ourselves via the API? Any documentation pointers would be appreciated.
answer: Good question - Northwind Notifications supports granular unsubscribe by category through the /v1/notifications/preferences endpoint, so customers can opt out of digests while keeping alerts or transactional emails active. I'll send over the documentation link with sample requests so your team can wire this into your customer-facing settings.

subject: Unsubscribed users still receiving alert emails
body: We integrated the /v1/notifications/unsubscribe endpoint last week and noticed some recipients who unsubscribe are still receiving alert emails 24-48 hours later. We've confirmed via the API that at least 12 email addresses show status 'unsubscribed', yet emails keep going out to them. This is causing complaints from our customers and needs to be escalated.
answer: Thanks for the clear writeup - this points to a sync delay between the unsubscribe status and our email delivery pipeline, and I'm escalating it as a P2. Could you send us three or four of the affected email addresses along with timestamps of the unwanted sends? We'll trace those through the delivery logs and get back to you with findings shortly.

subject: Locked out of platform after adding IP to allowlist
body: After adding a new IP range to our Admin Console allowlist this morning, all 4 of our users are now locked out, including admins. We get 'Access denied - IP not permitted' even though our current office IP is inside the range we added. This is blocking all work, please help urgently.
answer: I understand the urgency and we're treating this as a P1. Could you reply with the exact IP range you entered and your current public IP address? While we confirm the cause, we're reverting the allowlist entry on our end now to restore access for your team immediately.

subject: next_cursor sometimes null when has_more is true
body: I noticed the /v3/transactions endpoint's pagination behavior differs from the docs - the next_cursor field is sometimes null even when has_more is true, particularly on pages with exactly 500 records, which is our configured page_size. This has been happening since Oct 5. Not blocking critical work, but our SDK v2.3 wrapper throws an exception when it expects a cursor and receives null.
answer: Thanks for catching this edge case - it does sound like a pagination bug specific to pages that land exactly on the page_size boundary. Could you send us a sample response body from one of the affected requests along with the request ID? We'll reproduce it against your account and confirm whether this needs a fix on our end or a doc update for the SDK's expected behavior.

subject: OFFLINE MODE NOT SYNCING AFTER APP UPDATE
body: OUR FIELD TEAM OF ANALYSTS USES THE MOBILE APP OFFLINE MODE DURING CAMPUS VISITS WITH NO WIFI. SINCE THE LAST APP UPDATE (VERSION 4.8.2) OFFLINE MODE NO LONGER SYNCS DATA WHEN WE RECONNECT - ABOUT 40 USERS ARE AFFECTED AND SEVERAL DAYS OF FIELD NOTES ARE STUCK IN LOCAL STORAGE. WE ALSO CANNOT LOG IN AGAIN OFFLINE AFTER THE APP RESTARTS. PLEASE ADVISE HOW TO RECOVER THE UNSYNCED DATA.
answer: WE UNDERSTAND HOW DISRUPTIVE THIS IS WITH FIELD NOTES STUCK LOCALLY, AND WE ARE TREATING THIS AS A P2. PLEASE ASK AFFECTED USERS NOT TO CLEAR THE APP OR REINSTALL IT, SINCE THAT COULD WIPE THE UNSYNCED LOCAL DATA. COULD YOU SEND US THE DEVICE OS VERSIONS AND APP BUILD NUMBERS FOR A FEW AFFECTED DEVICES SO WE CAN REPRODUCE THE SYNC FAILURE AND ADVISE ON RECOVERING THE STORED NOTES AS SOON AS POSSIBLE.

subject: Late-arriving records in pipeline runs
body:
I'm integrating with the Data Pipelines API for our student engagement dataset. Since Feb 3rd we're seeing a chunk of events arrive 4-6 hours after their timestamp, mostly the ones tagged with source=lms_sync. Our downstream job closes the window after 2 hours so we lose about 6-9% of records each run.

Is there a documented late-arrival threshold or watermark setting we can configure on the pipeline? I couldn't find anything on this in the current docs.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. Late-arriving data is expected from the lms_sync connector because it batches upstream every few hours, but you can configure a watermark/allowed lateness window on the pipeline so downstream jobs wait before closing, which should recover most of that 6-9%. I'll send over the config reference and also flag this to our docs team since the watermark option isn't currently documented clearly.

subject: SSO role mapping not applying correct permissions
body:
We configured SAML role mapping for our support team so that the 'agent' group in our IdP maps to the 'Standard Agent' role in Northwind, but several users are landing with Admin-level permissions instead. This started after we updated our IdP group claims last Thursday. We've had to manually downgrade 4 accounts so far.

Can someone check our role mapping config? Our SSO connection ID is lumen-energy-prod.
answer: Thanks for flagging this, I can see the impact on your team's access control. This pattern usually happens when the IdP sends multiple group claims and our mapping picks the first match by priority order rather than most restrictive - I'll pull the logs for lumen-energy-prod to confirm which claim is winning. In the meantime, I'd recommend double-checking that users aren't in both the 'agent' and a broader admin group upstream, and I'll follow up within the day with findings.

subject: Request: configurable email digest frequency
body:
Our clinical ops team currently gets individual notification emails for every alert, which across our 3,256 seats is generating a huge volume of near-duplicate emails during shift changes. We'd like to switch to a daily digest option instead of per-event emails, similar to what's described in a webinar we attended but not in the current help docs.

Could you confirm whether digest scheduling exists today, and if not, whether it's on the roadmap? Reducing duplicate alerts is becoming a priority for our compliance reporting too.
answer: Good news - digest scheduling does exist for Notifications, it's just not surfaced in the main docs yet, so I understand the confusion. You can set digest frequency (hourly, daily, weekly) per notification category under Admin > Notifications > Digest Settings, which should cut down on the duplicate per-event emails you're seeing. I'll also pass your feedback about documentation visibility to our content team, and can walk your ops lead through configuring category-specific digests if helpful.

subject: Mobile app crashes on launch for field staff
body:
Since yesterday's update, our field technicians are reporting the mobile app crashes immediately on launch, before even reaching the login screen. This is affecting devices on both iOS and Android across our energy sites. We have around 15 users who've reported it so far out of our 3,975 seat deployment.

Several of these technicians work in offline mode with limited connectivity, so I'm not sure if that's related. Can you confirm if this is a known issue with the latest release?
answer: Thank you for reporting this - a launch crash affecting multiple devices is a priority for us to isolate. We've had a couple of similar reports tied to the offline cache initialization in the latest release, so that offline-mode detail is useful context. Could you have one affected technician send us the crash log or device console output via the app's feedback option, and let us know the app version and OS versions in use so we can reproduce and confirm a fix timeline.

subject: Offline mode losing data entry when reconnecting
body:
Our field analysts use the mobile app extensively in offline mode at remote well sites with no signal for hours at a time. Over the past week, at least 3 analysts have reported that data entered offline disappears after the app reconnects and syncs, rather than uploading. This is causing real data loss and rework for our team.

Given how central offline mode is to our field workflow, we need either a fix or a reliable workaround soon - this is blocking multiple people daily.
answer: I understand the urgency here, losing offline entries is a serious problem for field workflows and I'm escalating this as high priority. Can you tell me the app version and roughly how long devices stay offline before reconnecting, since we suspect this may relate to a sync conflict when the local cache exceeds a certain size or duration. In the meantime, I'd recommend having analysts manually export or screenshot entries before reconnecting as a safeguard while we investigate.

subject: Bulk user deactivation not reflecting in audit log
body:
I deactivated 6 users from our Admin Console last week after some role changes, and while their access was revoked correctly, none of these deactivations show up in the audit log under Account Activity. This makes it hard for us to track changes for internal review.

Can you confirm whether deactivation events are supposed to be logged, and if this is a known gap? Not urgent, just want it tracked properly going forward.
answer: Thanks for pointing this out. Deactivation events should be recorded in the audit log, so this does look like a gap on our end rather than expected behavior. I'll log this for our engineering team to investigate and get back to you with a timeline once I hear more - appreciate you flagging it even though it's not blocking your work day to day.

subject: IP-Allowlist für Admin Console einrichten
body:
Wir möchten den Zugriff auf die Admin Console auf bestimmte Bürostandort-IPs beschränken, da wir aktuell nur 3 Sitzplätze haben und die Sicherheit erhöhen wollen. In den Einstellungen finde ich eine Option für IP-Regeln, aber es ist unklar, ob diese nur für die Konsole oder auch für die API gilt.

Können Sie uns erklären, wie die Konfiguration korrekt vorgenommen wird und ob es dazu ein Audit-Log gibt, das blockierte Zugriffsversuche protokolliert?
answer: Vielen Dank für Ihre Anfrage. Die IP-Allowlist-Einstellung unter Admin Console > Security gilt sowohl für den Konsolenzugriff als auch für API-Aufrufe mit Ihren Zugangsdaten, sofern Sie beide Bereiche in der Konfiguration aktivieren. Blockierte Zugriffsversuche werden im Audit-Log unter 'Access Denied Events' erfasst - ich sende Ihnen gerne eine kurze Anleitung mit Screenshots, um die Einrichtung für Ihre drei Nutzer zu erleichtern.

subject: Mobile app login fails after offline mode incident
body:
We're evaluating the mobile app rollout for our field teams and hit an issue this morning: after using offline mode overnight, several test devices couldn't log back in when reconnecting to WiFi. The app shows a generic 'Session Expired' message and pressing retry just loops back to the same screen.

This happened on 4 out of 6 test devices we're piloting. Push notifications also stopped arriving on these devices after the failed login. Can you help us understand what's causing this before we expand the pilot to more users?
answer: Thanks for catching this during your pilot rather than after full rollout. The session expiry loop after extended offline periods is a known interaction issue when the refresh token expires while offline and the app can't silently renew it, which would also explain the push notifications stopping since they're tied to the active session. Please try a full logout and fresh login on the affected devices for now, and let us know the app version so we can confirm whether you're on the build with the pending fix for this.

subject: SCIM provisioning failing for new hires - urgent
body:
Our SCIM integration stopped correctly provisioning new users as of this morning. We've had 14 new hires added in our IdP that should sync automatically, but none of them have accounts in Northwind, and the SCIM logs show repeated 400 errors with message 'Invalid schema: urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:enterprise:2.0:User'. This is blocking onboarding for multiple teams today.

We haven't changed our SCIM config recently. Can someone urgently look into this since it's affecting new employee access company-wide?
answer: This is now our top priority and I've escalated it to our identity team immediately given the onboarding impact. The 400 error on the enterprise extension schema suggests either a recent schema validation change on our side or a mismatch in the payload your IdP is sending - we're checking recent deployment logs now to see if this correlates with a platform-side change. I'll update you within the hour with either a fix or a confirmed workaround so your new hires aren't blocked.

subject: Repeated card failures blocking payments - need help
body:
Our company card has failed on the last 3 billing attempts this month, even though it's valid and has sufficient funds - we double checked with our bank. Each time we get a generic 'payment declined' error with no further detail, which makes it hard to resolve on our end.

Given we're a small 7-seat team, losing access to Billing features because of unclear decline reasons is a real problem. Could you tell us the actual decline reason and also let us know if a grace period or retry option is available while we sort this out?
answer: I'm sorry for the trouble this is causing, especially with service access on the line - let's get this resolved quickly. I'm pulling the decline codes from our payment processor now to get you the actual reason rather than the generic message, and I'll apply a temporary grace period on your account so nothing is interrupted while we sort out the card issue. I'll follow up shortly with the specific decline details and next steps.

subject: Charts broken across all dashboards since this morning
body:
Since around 8am today, every dashboard in our Atlas Works workspace is showing blank or partially rendered charts. Bar and line charts load their axes but no data series appear, and pie charts just show a spinner that never resolves. This is affecting all 18 seats and both teachers and admins are seeing the same issue across Chrome and Firefox.

We haven't changed any data sources or filters recently. Can you check if there's a rendering issue on your end? This is blocking our morning reporting for staff.
answer: Thanks for flagging this quickly - we can see there was a regression in our charting library that shipped in last night's release, and we're rolling back now. This should restore normal rendering within the hour, and we'll post an update as soon as it's confirmed fixed on your workspace. Sorry for the disruption to your morning reporting.

subject: Ability to export dashboards to PDF with custom page size
body:
We regularly pull our board reporting dashboards for distribution to department heads, and right now the PDF export only supports letter size. Given our reporting decks are usually formatted for A3 to fit our print templates, it would help a lot if we could choose the page size and orientation before exporting.

Not urgent, just wanted to put this on your radar as a feature request since we export several dashboards weekly across our finance team.
answer: Thanks for the detailed suggestion - this is a great use case and we've logged it as a feature request for the dashboards export module. We don't have a page-size option today beyond letter format, but I'll pass this along to the product team with your use case attached. I'll update this ticket if it gets scheduled for development.

subject: help
body: We need to change how our Salesforce sync handles opportunity stage updates. Right now every time a deal moves to Closed Won in Salesforce, it's supposed to trigger an invoice creation task in Northwind, but since yesterday the sync is silently failing and none of our closed deals from the last two days have synced over. Our finance team can't reconcile revenue without this working. Can someone look at this today as it's blocking month-end close for Lumen Legal?
answer: I've escalated this to our integrations team given the impact on your month-end close. Initial logs show the Salesforce sync connector has been failing authentication token refresh since yesterday's Salesforce API update on their end - we're pushing a fix to our connector now. I'll update you within a few hours with a resolution or workaround for reprocessing the missed opportunity records.

subject: AUDIT LOG QUESTION - NEEDS ANSWER
body: WE ARE TRYING TO FIGURE OUT WHY THE ADMIN CONSOLE AUDIT LOG DOES NOT SHOW ALLOWLIST CHANGES FROM LAST WEEK. WE DEACTIVATED TWO USER ACCOUNTS ON TUESDAY AND ADDED THREE IP RANGES TO THE ALLOWLIST BUT NONE OF THIS SHOWS UP IN THE LOG EXPORT. WE NEED THIS FOR OUR COMPLIANCE REVIEW. IS THIS A KNOWN GAP IN THE PRO PLAN OR IS SOMETHING BROKEN ON OUR WORKSPACE FOR PIONEER ANALYTICS?
answer: Thanks for reaching out about this. Allowlist changes and account deactivations are logged, but on the Pro plan the audit log export only includes the last 30 days and certain admin actions are grouped under a general 'security settings' category rather than itemized individually - this is expected behavior, not a bug on your workspace. If you need itemized allowlist and deactivation events for compliance, our Enterprise plan includes a more granular audit trail, and I'm happy to share details on that if useful.

subject: Repeated transform failures in nightly pipeline
body:
Our nightly data pipeline job 'travel-bookings-etl' has failed 4 out of the last 6 runs this week, each time at the transform stage with a timeout after roughly 25 minutes. The pipeline processes about 40k booking records daily and previously completed in under 10 minutes, so something has changed with performance. We're seeing stale data in downstream dashboards as a result, with the last successful sync dated three days ago.

Could someone check if there's a resource constraint or a change in the transform step? We rely on this for daily reporting and the delay is now noticeable to our team.
answer: Thank you for the detailed report. We can see job travel-bookings-etl has been queuing behind a larger customer workload on the shared transform cluster, causing the timeouts you're seeing. We're rebalancing pipeline capacity now and will also increase your job's timeout threshold as a safeguard. We expect the next scheduled run tonight to complete normally, and I'll follow up to confirm once it does.

subject: SCIM provisioning stuck for new users
body:
We set up SCIM provisioning through our identity provider last month and it's been working fine, but starting yesterday new users created in our IdP aren't being provisioned into Northwind. We've had 3 new hires added on our end that never appeared as active users. The SCIM logs on our IdP side show a 200 response but nothing shows up here.

Can you check if something changed on the provisioning endpoint recently? We need these accounts active for onboarding this week.
answer: Thanks for the details, this helps us narrow it down quickly. We identified a delay in our SCIM processing queue that started yesterday affecting several workspaces, including yours - the 200 response you're seeing is accepted but queued rather than fully processed. We're clearing the backlog now and expect your three pending users to appear as active within the next hour; I'll confirm here once they show up.

subject: Urgent: file uploads failing to storage, need retention confirmation
body: Since yesterday afternoon, uploads to our storage buckets have been failing intermittently with error 'upload_incomplete: chunk verification failed' on files larger than 500MB. We use this storage for backups of student research data, and we need to confirm nothing was lost given our retention policy requires 7-year archival for compliance. Can someone check the integrity of uploads from the last 24 hours and confirm our quota isn't the cause?
answer: Given the compliance sensitivity here, we're treating this as high priority. Our initial check shows a chunked-upload service issue affecting large file transfers since yesterday, and we've confirmed no data loss occurred on already-completed uploads - failed attempts were rejected before storage, not partially written. We're deploying a fix for the chunk verification issue now and will run a full integrity check on your bucket's last 24 hours of activity, with results sent to you within the next few hours.

subject: Seat count showing wrong number on invoice
body: Our latest invoice charged us for 22 seats but we only have 16 active users on our Orion Freight workspace - we removed 6 users back in early September. The billing page under Admin still shows 16 as our current seat count, so the discrepancy seems to be only on the invoice generation side. Can you check this and issue a correction or refund for the extra 6 seats we were charged for this cycle?
answer: Thank you for flagging this - I can confirm your workspace currently shows 16 active seats, and I can see the invoice generator incorrectly pulled a seat count from before your September user removal. We'll issue a refund for the 6-seat difference on this cycle's invoice, which should post to your account within 3-5 business days, and I've flagged the invoicing discrepancy to our billing engineering team to prevent recurrence.

subject: Confusion over dashboard sharing permissions
body: One of our engineers shared a dashboard with 'view only' permissions to an external contractor, but the contractor was able to export the underlying data as CSV, which we didn't expect given the view-only setting. Is export supposed to be blocked under view-only sharing, or is that intentional behavior on the Starter plan? Just want to understand the permission model better before we share more dashboards externally at Atlas Labs.
answer: Good question, and thanks for checking before sharing more broadly. On the Starter plan, view-only sharing restricts editing and filtering but does still allow data export by design, since export permissions are managed separately from view/edit access. If you want to fully restrict export for external viewers, that granular control is available on our Pro and Enterprise plans - happy to share more details if that would help your use case.

subject: Zapier integration setup for support ticket workflow
body: We'd like to connect our Northwind account to Zapier so that new support tickets in our helpdesk automatically create tasks in Jira and post a notification to our Slack channel. I've found the Zapier app listing but I'm not clear on which trigger events are supported for the Integrations product, and whether Salesforce data can also feed into this same Zap. Could someone walk us through setup or point to documentation for Delta Retail's use case?
answer: Happy to help you get this set up. Our Zapier integration currently supports 'ticket created' and 'ticket status changed' as trigger events, both of which can feed into your Jira and Slack actions in the same Zap, and yes, Salesforce data can be pulled in as a separate trigger step if you're syncing account or opportunity fields. I'll send over our step-by-step Zapier setup guide, and we can schedule a short call if you'd like help configuring the multi-app workflow directly.

subject: API key rotation breaking webhook signature validation
body:
We rotated our API key for the logistics dashboard integration on March 3rd and now all incoming webhooks are failing signature validation with a 401. Our webhook endpoint hasn't changed, only the key. We have about 4 users on this account and this is blocking our shipment status updates from syncing.

Can you confirm if rotating the API key also invalidates the webhook secret, or if we need to update something separately? We'd like to avoid downtime on future rotations.
answer:
Thanks for flagging this - rotating your API key does regenerate the associated webhook signing secret automatically, so any endpoint validating against the old secret will start rejecting requests until it's updated. Please pull the new signing secret from the API Platform settings page under Webhooks and update your validation logic; that should resolve the 401s immediately.

For future rotations, we recommend using our key overlap window (both old and new keys remain valid for 24 hours) so you can update your webhook secret without any gap in delivery.

subject: Dashboard load times over 20 seconds on large datasets
body:
Several of our analysts have reported that the revenue reconciliation dashboard is taking 20-30 seconds to load, and sometimes times out entirely when we try to export to CSV. This started getting worse over the last two weeks, coinciding with our data volume growing to roughly 2.1M rows in the underlying dataset.

Can someone look into whether this is a query optimization issue on our end or a platform-side bottleneck? We have several dashboards shared across teams and this is affecting daily standups since people can't pull numbers in time.
answer:
Thanks for the detailed report - dashboards backed by datasets over ~1.5M rows can hit slower query paths if aggregations aren't pre-computed, and we've seen export timeouts specifically when the underlying query lacks an indexed date filter. We're pulling the query logs for your account now to see where the bottleneck is occurring.

In the meantime, try adding a fixed date range filter to the dashboard views rather than 'all time' - this often cuts load time significantly. We'll follow up within one business day with findings from our performance review.

subject: Incorrect line items on latest invoice
body:
I'm integrating our billing reconciliation API and noticed our invoice dated for this billing cycle shows a charge for 3,412 seats when our actual seat count under the Enterprise plan is 3,256. This is causing a mismatch in our internal finance reports and I need to understand where the discrepancy is coming from before we process payment.

Could someone check the invoice generation logic or confirm if there was a seat count sync issue on your end? We need this resolved before the payment due date.
answer:
Thank you for catching this before payment was processed. A discrepancy of that size usually points to a stale seat count snapshot at invoice generation time - we're checking your account's provisioning history now to see when the seat count last updated versus when the invoice was cut.

We'll issue a corrected invoice reflecting your actual 3,256 seats within one business day, and if the original was already partially processed we'll apply the difference as a credit rather than a refund to keep your reconciliation simpler. I'll follow up here once the corrected document is ready.

subject: Dashboard charts failing to render after API data update
body:
Since yesterday's data sync, the energy usage charts on our operations dashboard show blank panels instead of the line graphs we expect. The API calls to our data source are returning 200 with valid JSON when I test them directly, but the dashboard just shows a spinner that never resolves.

This is affecting the shared dashboard we use with our field teams, and they're asking why yesterday's numbers aren't visible. We haven't changed anything on our integration side recently.
answer:
Thanks for the report and for confirming your API responses look healthy - that helps narrow this down to the rendering layer. We're seeing a known issue affecting chart panels tied to data sources with recent schema changes, where the frontend cache holds an outdated field mapping and fails silently instead of erroring.

As a workaround, try removing and re-adding the affected chart panel, which forces a fresh schema pull. We're pushing a fix for the underlying caching bug and will update this ticket once it's deployed, likely within the next day.

subject: Request to disable biometric login requirement on mobile app
body:
A few of our field operations staff are using shared tablets rather than personal devices, and the mandatory biometric login on the mobile app is causing delays since fingerprints registered to one person block access for the next shift worker. We'd like the option to make biometric login optional rather than required, or at least have an admin toggle per device group.

Is this something on your roadmap, or is there a workaround we're missing for shared-device scenarios?
answer:
That's a reasonable use case and one we've heard from a few customers with shared-device deployments. Currently there isn't a way to disable biometric enforcement per device group, but you can turn off biometric login entirely at the account level under Mobile App settings, falling back to standard password login for all users.

I'll pass along the request for a more granular, per-device-group toggle to our product team as a feature request. It's not currently on the near-term roadmap, but I'll update this ticket if that changes.

subject: Need higher rate limit for API keys used in SDK batch jobs
body:
We're running nightly batch analytics jobs through the Python SDK that pull usage data across our manufacturing sensors, and we're consistently hitting 429 rate limit errors around 2am when the job processes roughly 15,000 records. Our current API key seems capped lower than what we need for this workload.

Could you let us know what rate limit tier we're currently on and whether we can request a temporary or permanent increase for this specific key? We'd rather not have to split the job into multiple smaller runs if avoidable.
answer:
Thanks for the details - your current API key is on the standard tier limit, which caps at 600 requests per minute, and a batch job pulling that volume of sensor records overnight would likely exceed that if requests aren't being paginated efficiently. We can raise this specific key to a higher tier temporarily to test whether that resolves the 429s.

Could you confirm the key's prefix (visible in your API Platform dashboard) so we apply the increase to the right one? Once confirmed we'll bump the limit and you can rerun tonight's job to verify.

subject: Connector authentication failing - pipeline down since this morning
body:
Our data pipeline connector to our travel booking source has been failing authentication since around 6am today. The connector logs show 'invalid_grant: token expired or revoked' even though we haven't touched the credentials. This is stopping all our nightly sync jobs from running and our finance reports depend on this data being current.

We have 16 users relying on this pipeline for daily reconciliation and right now everything downstream is stale. Please escalate - we need this connector reauthorized as soon as possible.
answer:
This is escalated to our pipeline team immediately given the full sync outage. An 'invalid_grant: token expired or revoked' error on a connector that wasn't manually changed usually means the OAuth refresh token was invalidated upstream, often due to a permissions change or expiry on the source system side.

We're reauthorizing the connector connection now - please check the Data Pipelines settings page in a few minutes for a prompt to reconnect and grant access again. Once reconnected, we'll manually trigger a backfill sync to catch you up on this morning's missed run and confirm data is current.

subject: How to update IP allowlist without locking out active sessions
body:
I need to update our IP allowlist in the Admin Console to add our new office subnet, but I'm concerned that saving changes might immediately terminate active sessions for our 282 users if their current IPs aren't yet included in the updated list. Is there a safe way to stage this change?

Also, does updating the allowlist get logged in the audit log automatically, or do we need to note it manually for our compliance records?
answer:
Good question, and yes, allowlist updates take effect immediately, so any active session from an IP not on the new list will be terminated on next request. To avoid disruption, add the new subnet alongside your existing entries first, confirm it's working for a test user, then remove any outdated ranges in a separate save afterward.

All allowlist changes are automatically captured in the audit log with the admin's identity, timestamp, and before/after values, so no manual note is needed for compliance purposes.

subject: Recurring card decline causing service interruption risk
body:
Our payment card on file has been declined twice now for this month's billing cycle, and I received a notice that our account may be downgraded if payment isn't resolved soon. I'd like to update our card details and also understand if we're eligible for any grace period given this is the first payment issue we've had.

Separately, could you point me to documentation on how seat-based billing adjustments work if we need to reduce our seat count next quarter?
answer:
Thanks for reaching out proactively. You can update your card under Billing settings, and once the new card is on file we'll immediately retry the failed charge rather than waiting for the next billing cycle. Given this is your first payment issue, we're happy to apply a short grace period so there's no service interruption while you update the card.

For seat-based billing adjustments, our documentation covering upgrades, downgrades, and mid-cycle proration is linked in the Billing help center under 'Managing Seats' - it walks through how reductions are reflected on your next invoice.

subject: URGENT: Audit log entries missing for admin deactivation actions
body:
We discovered that several admin account deactivation events from the past 48 hours are not appearing in our audit log at all, even though the deactivations did take effect. This is a serious compliance gap for us since we're required to log all access changes for our security review this week. We've confirmed at least 3 deactivation actions are missing entries.

We need to know immediately whether this is a display bug or if the events truly were not recorded, and whether other action types like allowlist changes might also be affected.
answer:
This has been escalated as P1 to our security and platform teams immediately given the compliance implications. We're investigating whether this is a logging pipeline issue affecting event capture versus a display-only bug in the audit log view, and checking other action types including allowlist changes as you flagged.

We'll provide an update within the next few hours with findings and, if events were genuinely not recorded, we'll work with you directly on reconstructing the record from backend system logs for your security review timeline.

subject: SCIM provisioning stopped syncing new users
body:
Since yesterday around 2pm our SCIM connector shows a green status but new hires added in our IdP are not appearing in Northwind. We added 6 new employees this morning and none of them show up under Users. The SCIM log shows a 200 response on the last sync at 09:14 but no user objects were created.

This is blocking onboarding for our media team and we need this fixed quickly since we rely on SCIM for all account creation. Can you check the provisioning endpoint on your end?
answer: Thanks for flagging this, I understand new hires can't get access which is urgent for onboarding. We're pulling the SCIM connector logs for your tenant now to check for silent failures on the create-user operation despite the 200 responses, this pattern usually points to a schema mismatch introduced by an IdP-side attribute change. I'll update you within the hour with findings and, if needed, a manual provisioning workaround so your 6 pending hires can get access today.

subject: URGENT: Storage quota exceeded, uploads failing and backups not running
body:
Our storage usage hit 100% of quota at approximately 3:40am today and now all file uploads are failing with 'Insufficient storage quota' errors across every department. Worse, our nightly backup job that runs at 1am appears to have failed silently last night, so we may have lost the prior day's backup snapshot.

We have 3651 seats depending on this for coursework submissions and we cannot have data loss. We need an emergency quota increase and confirmation on backup retention status immediately.
answer: This is being treated as a P0 outage on our end. I've escalated to our storage infrastructure team to apply an emergency quota increase to your account right now so uploads can resume, and I'm having our backup team verify the retention chain to confirm whether last night's snapshot completed or failed silently. I'll update you within 30 minutes with the quota increase confirmation and backup status, and we'll follow up with a root cause once uploads are stable again.

subject: Request to add unsubscribe link to transactional alerts
body:
We've had several customers reply asking how to stop receiving our daily settlement alerts, and right now there's no unsubscribe option on the notification emails sent through Northwind. Could we get an unsubscribe or preference link added to the footer of these emails, similar to what's on our marketing sends?
