We're getting duplicate complaints logged in two different tickets already this week, so I'd like to resolve this at the template level rather than case by case.
answer: Good catch, and thanks for consolidating this rather than letting it spread across multiple tickets. Transactional notification templates currently don't include unsubscribe links by default, but we do support adding a preference-center link via the notification template settings under Notifications > Templates. I'll send you the specific template variable to insert and can also flag this as a feature request to make it a default option for transactional alert templates.

subject: All users being logged out every few minutes - production impact
body:
Starting about an hour ago, all 4 of our users are being forcibly logged out of the dashboard every 3-5 minutes, even right after re-authenticating via SSO. We're in the middle of a live shipment tracking operation and this is causing us to lose in-progress work each time a session drops.

We haven't changed any session or SSO configuration on our side. This is affecting our entire team simultaneously and needs immediate attention as we may be losing unsaved data with each forced logout.
answer: I've escalated this to P0 immediately given the active data loss risk during your live operation. We're checking whether a session token lifetime setting was changed on our identity backend or if there's a token validation issue on your SSO integration causing premature expiry. In the meantime, please ask your team to save work frequently or export data where possible, and I'll have an update within 15 minutes on root cause and a fix or temporary session extension.

subject: Increasing storage quota via API for retention compliance
body:
I'm integrating our document retention workflow against the Storage API and need to programmatically raise our per-bucket quota ahead of a compliance audit. Right now calling PUT /v1/storage/quota returns a 403 with 'insufficient plan tier' even though our admin console shows available headroom.

Could you confirm whether quota changes are gated to console-only actions on our current plan, and if there's documentation on the retention policy fields so I can set the correct retention period alongside the quota update?
answer: Good question, on the Starter tier programmatic quota changes via the API are currently restricted and must go through the admin console, which is why you're seeing the 403 despite available headroom. I'll send over the documentation link covering the retention policy fields so you can configure retention correctly, and I'll also log an escalation to check whether API-based quota management could be enabled for your account ahead of your audit deadline.

subject: Request to export audit log with allowlist changes included
body:
We're preparing for an internal security review and need to export our admin console audit log for the last 90 days, specifically including entries for IP allowlist changes and user deactivation events. When I try to export from Settings > Audit Log, the CSV that downloads is missing the allowlist change entries entirely, though deactivation events do show up.

Could you let me know if this is a known gap or if there's a setting I need to enable to capture allowlist activity in the export?
answer: Thanks for the detail, this helps narrow it down. Allowlist change events are logged separately from the main audit trail in the current console version, which is why they're not appearing in your CSV export alongside deactivation events, it's a known gap rather than a setting issue. I'll file this as a product request to unify these into a single exportable log, and in the meantime I can pull the allowlist change history manually for your 90-day window if that helps with your security review timeline.

subject: Jira integration not syncing new issues to dashboard
body:
Our Jira link, connected under Integrations, stopped pulling new issues into our Northwind dashboard as of March 3rd. Issues created in Jira after that date don't appear, but ones from before still show correctly. We haven't touched our Okta or Salesforce integrations, and Slack notifications for the same Jira project are still working fine.

Can you check if something changed on the Jira webhook or OAuth token side? We have around 40 issues now missing from our reporting view.
answer: Thanks for the specific date, that's helpful for narrowing this down. Since Slack notifications from the same Jira project are still firing, this points to the dashboard sync webhook or OAuth token specifically rather than a broader Jira connectivity issue. I'm checking your integration's token expiry and webhook delivery logs now and will report back with findings, and if the token has expired we'll walk you through re-authorizing the Jira connection to backfill the missing 40 issues.

subject: Pipeline transform jobs failing intermittently since this morning
body:
Since around 7am today, our data pipeline transform stage has been failing on roughly 1 in 5 runs with the error below, causing downstream dashboard data to lag by several hours:

transform_stage_error: null pointer in field mapping 'client_id'
at TransformExecutor.run(step=42)
job_id: pl-88210-transform
retry_count: 3, all failed

This is affecting multiple client datasets in our legal case tracking pipeline and the latency is now noticeable to our internal users. Can someone look into why field mapping is intermittently failing?
answer: Thank you for including the job ID and error trace, this is being escalated to our pipeline engineering team right now as a P1 given the intermittent failures are affecting multiple datasets. The null pointer on 'client_id' suggests some incoming records may be missing that field or arriving with an unexpected type, we're checking job pl-88210-transform's input batches now to confirm. I'll update you shortly with findings and a mitigation, likely a temporary null-handling fix in the transform step, to stop the retries from failing and clear the current lag.

subject: Question about workspace settings for allowlist and audit log visibility
body:
I'm setting up our workspace configuration and want to confirm a couple of things: can I restrict admin console access to a specific IP allowlist while still allowing audit log exports from outside that range, and is there a setting to adjust how much detail appears in the audit log for settings changes? Right now it seems fairly high-level.

Not urgent, just trying to tighten our setup and would appreciate any guidance or docs you can point me to.
answer: Thanks for reaching out, happy to help you tighten this up. Yes, IP allowlisting for console access and audit log export access can be configured independently under Workspace Settings > Access Controls, so you can restrict login while still allowing exports from elsewhere. As for audit log detail, the current level is fixed for settings changes, but I'll pass along your feedback requesting more granular event data, and I'll send you our workspace configuration guide in the meantime.

subject: SAML login failing for one user with MFA enabled
body:
One of our finance team members can't log in via SAML SSO since enabling MFA on their account yesterday. They get redirected back to our login page with no error message after entering their MFA code. Other users without MFA enabled can still log in fine through the same SAML setup.

Could you help us figure out if this is an MFA-SAML compatibility issue or something with that specific user's provisioning? It's low urgency since it's just the one person for now.
answer: Thanks for the details, this sounds like it's isolated to that user's session rather than a broader SAML configuration issue since everyone else is unaffected. Could you have them clear cookies and retry, and let us know if the redirect loop persists? In the meantime I'll check their provisioning record and MFA enrollment status on our side to rule out a stale session token or attribute mismatch tied to the MFA enablement.

subject: Transform failures blocking nightly pipeline sync
body:
Since Monday our nightly ETL pipeline 'enrollment-sync' has been failing at the transform stage roughly 4 out of 7 runs, always around the join step where we merge student records with attendance data. The run log shows the job timing out after 20 minutes when it used to finish in under 6. We need this fixed or at least mitigated before our board reporting cycle starts Friday.

Can we get a connector-level performance review, or is there a setting we can adjust to reduce latency on this specific transform? This is affecting reporting for all 10 of our staff accounts.
answer: Thanks for the detailed timeline. We can see elevated latency on the enrollment-sync pipeline's join transform starting Monday and are pulling the execution traces now to identify whether this is a resource contention issue on our side or a data volume spike from your source connector. As a short-term mitigation, we'd recommend splitting the join into two smaller transforms to reduce memory pressure while we investigate — we'll follow up within a few hours with root cause and a permanent fix ahead of your Friday deadline.

subject: Biometric login not working on new Android devices
body:
We rolled out new Android phones to our drivers last week and several of them can't enable Face unlock or fingerprint login in the Northwind mobile app - the toggle in settings just spins and then reverts to off. This is happening on at least 6 of our 23 seats so far, all on Android 14. Regular password login still works fine.

Could you let us know if this is a known compatibility issue with newer Android versions, or if there's a setting on our end we're missing?
answer: Thanks for flagging this — we've seen a similar pattern reported with Android 14 devices where the biometric enrollment step fails silently due to a permissions handshake issue introduced in a recent OS update. Could you confirm the exact app version installed on the affected devices? In the meantime, having the drivers fully sign out and reinstall the app usually restores the biometric toggle, and we're tracking a permanent fix for the next release.

subject: Duplicate email digests being sent to same recipients
body:
We integrated the Notifications API to send daily shipment digest emails, and since October 3rd a subset of recipients are getting the same digest twice within a few minutes, timestamped 06:00 and 06:04 UTC. We're seeing this on roughly 40 out of 267 accounts. Our digest job only fires once per recipient per day based on our logs and idempotency keys, so it looks like it might be happening on Northwind's side during delivery.

Can someone check the delivery logs for template ID digest-shipment-v3 around those timestamps?
answer: Thank you for the precise timestamps and template ID — that's very helpful. We're seeing a retry storm in our delivery queue around 06:00-06:05 UTC that correlates with a delayed acknowledgment from the email provider, which likely triggered duplicate sends despite your idempotency keys being respected on our ingestion side. We're escalating this to our delivery infrastructure team now and will update you within the day with a fix and confirmation that affected recipients won't receive further duplicates.

subject: Question on routing alerts to a different email group
body:
We currently have billing alert notifications routing to our finance inbox, but I'd like to also route the same alerts to our controller's email without duplicating the alert setup entirely. Is there a way to add a secondary recipient group in the Notifications settings, or do we need to create a separate alert rule?

We're a small team (5 seats) so I want to avoid creating redundant rules that might cause duplicate alerts. Any guidance or documentation link would help.
answer: Good question — you can add a secondary recipient without duplicating the rule by going to Notifications > Alert Routing and adding an additional email under 'Also notify' for the existing billing alert rule, rather than creating a new rule from scratch. This avoids duplicate sends since it's the same underlying alert firing to multiple destinations. I've linked our routing documentation below which covers recipient groups in more detail.

subject: URGENT - possible breach via API rate limit bypass
body:
We noticed unusual traffic on our API key this morning that appears to be bypassing our configured rate limits entirely. Our logs show over 40,000 requests in 10 minutes from an IP range we don't recognize, and our own rate limit of 500 req/min was clearly not enforced.

2024-06-11T09:12:03Z key=nw_live_7f2a status=200 ip=185.220.101.44 path=/v2/matters
2024-06-11T09:12:03Z key=nw_live_7f2a status=200 ip=185.220.101.47 path=/v2/matters
2024-06-11T09:12:04Z key=nw_live_7f2a status=200 ip=185.220.101.53 path=/v2/matters/export
2024-06-11T09:12:04Z key=nw_live_7f2a status=200 ip=185.220.101.44 path=/v2/matters/export
ERROR rate_limit_check skipped - fallback_mode=true

We need to know immediately if our data was exfiltrated and want this key revoked now.
answer: We've revoked API key nw_live_7f2a immediately and are treating this as a P0 security incident. The 'fallback_mode=true' entry in your log indicates our rate limiter fell back to permissive mode during a brief upstream outage, which allowed the traffic spike through unfiltered — we are pulling full access logs for that key now to determine what data, if any, was retrieved by the unrecognized IP range. Our security team will contact you within the hour with findings and next steps for key rotation and credential review.

subject: Workspace settings reverted after admin console update
body:
After the console update rolled out yesterday, several of our workspace settings appear to have reverted to defaults - specifically our SSO enforcement toggle and the data retention window, which we had set to 180 days and is now showing 30 days. This is a compliance concern for our energy sector audits. Our audit log shows no change entry for this, just a gap between 14:02 and 14:05 yesterday.

Can you confirm whether this was a rollout bug and restore our settings from before the update?
answer: Thank you for catching this and including the audit log gap — that timing lines up with a known issue in yesterday's console rollout where a subset of workspace configs were not correctly migrated. We're restoring your SSO enforcement and 180-day retention settings from your pre-update backup now and will confirm once complete, along with an audit log entry documenting the restoration for your compliance records.

subject: SSO role mapping broken after directory sync - users losing access
body:
Since this morning's directory sync, a large number of our staff are being mapped to the wrong roles after SSO login - clinicians who should have 'Provider' role are landing in 'Viewer' and can't access patient scheduling. We counted at least 30 affected users out of 96 seats so far and it's growing as people log in throughout the day.

Our role mapping rules in the SSO config haven't changed on our end. Can someone check if there was a change to the SAML attribute mapping or group claims processing recently? This needs urgent attention since it's blocking clinical staff from doing their jobs.
answer: This is being escalated immediately given the clinical access impact. We can see a change in how group claims are being parsed from your SAML assertions since this morning's sync, which appears to be causing the role mapping mismatch you're describing — we're rolling back the claims processing change now and will manually verify a sample of affected accounts to confirm 'Provider' role is restored correctly. We'll update you within the next 30 minutes with confirmation and a count of remediated accounts.

subject: RATE LIMIT ERRORS BLOCKING ALL BOOKING REQUESTS
body:
WE ARE GETTING 429 TOO MANY REQUESTS ON EVERY SINGLE CALL TO /V2/BOOKINGS SINCE ABOUT 30 MINUTES AGO. NOTHING CHANGED ON OUR SIDE, WE HAVE NOT DEPLOYED ANYTHING NEW AND OUR REQUEST VOLUME IS THE SAME AS LAST WEEK. THIS IS BLOCKING ALL CUSTOMER BOOKINGS ON OUR PLATFORM RIGHT NOW.

OUR SDK VERSION IS 4.2.1 AND WE ARE ALSO SEEING A DEPRECATION WARNING IN THE RESPONSE HEADERS ABOUT WEBHOOK ENDPOINT V1 BEING SUNSET, IS THAT RELATED? WE NEED THIS FIXED IMMEDIATELY, EVERY MINUTE COSTS US MONEY.
answer: WE UNDERSTAND THE URGENCY AND ARE INVESTIGATING RIGHT NOW. Initial checks show your account's rate limit tier appears to have been misapplied during a backend config change about 35 minutes ago, which is unrelated to the webhook v1 deprecation notice — that's a separate, non-blocking heads-up about a future sunset date. We are correcting your rate limit tier now and will confirm restoration within minutes; please retry your /v2/bookings calls once we send confirmation.

subject: Need additional API keys with scoped rate limits for new integration
body:
We're building a new syndication feature that will call the Northwind API from a separate service, and I'd like to request additional API keys scoped specifically to read-only endpoints with their own rate limit bucket so it doesn't compete with our main application's quota. Right now we only have one active key and it's shared across everything.

Also, I noticed in the changelog that some endpoints we use (/v1/articles/search) are marked for deprecation next quarter - can you confirm the replacement endpoint and expected timeline so we can plan the migration alongside this key request?
answer: Happy to help with both. We can issue you a new scoped API key for read-only endpoints with an independent rate limit bucket — I'll need you to confirm which endpoint group (articles, media, or both) you want scoped access to, and we'll have the key ready within a day. On the deprecation, /v1/articles/search is being replaced by /v2/content/search, targeted for sunset in Q3; the v2 endpoint is already live so you can start migrating whenever convenient ahead of the deadline.

subject: Uploads failing intermittently to storage buckets
body:
Our team has been getting upload failures when backing up product images to our Northwind storage bucket, roughly 1 in 5 attempts fail with a generic 'upload could not complete' message and no retry option shown. This started around October 8th and affects files over 15MB specifically, smaller files upload fine.

We also wanted to ask - what's our current retention policy on the storage bucket, and is there a way to set up automatic backup verification so we catch failures like this sooner? With only 9 seats we don't have someone monitoring this daily.
answer: Thanks for narrowing this down to files over 15MB — that points to a chunked upload timeout we've seen on a subset of buckets since October 8th, and we're checking your bucket's configuration now to confirm and apply a fix. On retention, your current policy is set to 90 days by default on the Starter plan; we can also enable upload failure alerts so you're notified automatically instead of discovering issues manually, and I'll include setup steps for that in my next reply.

subject: Upgrading from Starter to Pro plan
body: I manage finance for Lumen Analytics and we need to move from our current Starter plan to Pro before our next billing cycle on the 1st. We currently have 14 seats and expect to add 6 more logistics coordinators next month. Can you confirm how the prorated invoice will be calculated and whether our existing payment method on file will be charged automatically, or do we need to approve a new invoice manually?
answer: Thanks for reaching out about the upgrade. I've flagged your account for the Starter-to-Pro transition and can confirm the change will be prorated for the remaining days in your current cycle, with the new seat count reflected on your next invoice. Your existing payment method on file will be charged automatically unless you'd prefer to switch to invoice billing, in which case let me know and I'll route that request to our billing team for approval.

subject: How do employees unsubscribe from digest emails
body: A few of our warehouse managers at Quill Retail are getting duplicate copies of the same shipment alert digest and want to unsubscribe from just that one notification type without losing other alerts. I looked in the admin console but couldn't find a per-notification unsubscribe option for individual users. Can you point me to where this is configured, or is this something only end users can manage from their own settings?
answer: Good question. Individual users can manage their own notification preferences from the bell icon in the top right of their dashboard, under Notification Settings, where they can toggle specific alert types off without affecting others. If the duplicates are a separate issue from preferences, let me know and I can take a closer look at whether there's a subscription rule creating the overlap.

subject: URGENT: paginated API responses returning other schools' student records
body: We just discovered that our integration pulling enrollment data via GET /v1/students?page=3 is returning records that don't belong to Apex Academy's tenant. Our operations team pulled a report this morning and found roughly 40 student rows from what looks like a different customer's account mixed into page 3 and page 4 of the response. We've paused all automated syncs immediately but need to know if this is isolated to us or a broader pagination bug affecting the webhook and SDK layers too.
answer: This has been escalated immediately to our security and platform teams as a P0 incident. We are pulling API access logs for your account right now to determine the scope of the cross-tenant exposure and will isolate the pagination cursor logic that may be causing this. Please keep your syncs paused until we confirm it's safe to resume, and we'll update you within the hour with findings and next steps.

subject: Okta SCIM provisioning not syncing new user groups
body: We're integrating Northwind's Okta app for Quill Capital and noticed that new group assignments created in Okta since October 3rd aren't propagating to Northwind roles. The SCIM sync shows a success status in Okta's logs, but users added to the 'Retail-Ops-Managers' group still show no role in Northwind after 20+ minutes. We've also seen intermittent slow response times from the /scim/v2/Groups endpoint, sometimes taking 8-10 seconds. Can someone check our tenant's provisioning logs?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. I'm pulling the provisioning logs for your tenant now to check whether the group mapping for 'Retail-Ops-Managers' is configured correctly on our end, and I'll also look into the /scim/v2/Groups latency you're seeing, since 8-10 seconds is well outside normal range. I'll follow up shortly with what we find and whether a resync is needed.

subject: Duplicate shipment alerts going out to entire team
body: Since yesterday afternoon, every shipment delay alert we configure is being sent twice to all 11 users on our Summit Academy account, about 90 seconds apart. This is causing confusion for our logistics coordinators who think there are two separate delays. We checked our alert rules and there's only one rule per event type, so this looks like it's happening on Northwind's side. Can this be fixed urgently since it's affecting our whole team's workflow?
answer: I'm sorry for the disruption this is causing your team. We've identified a known issue with the alert dispatch queue that can cause duplicate sends when retries are triggered unnecessarily, and we're treating this as a P1 while we deploy a fix. In the meantime, I'd recommend not adjusting your alert rules further, as the duplication is happening downstream of your configuration and should resolve once the fix is out, which we expect within the next few hours.

subject: Dashboard charts not rendering after latest update
body: Since this morning, none of our shared dashboards are loading charts correctly for Quill Travel staff. Bar and line charts just show a blank gray box with no error message, though the underlying data tables still export fine as CSV. This is affecting all 25 users in our account, not just one browser, since I've tested in both Chrome and Firefox. We rely on these dashboards daily for scheduling, so this needs urgent attention.
answer: Thanks for flagging this right away, and I understand how disruptive this is. We're seeing reports of chart rendering failures tied to a rollout earlier today, and our engineering team is actively working on a rollback for the affected accounts. I'll update you as soon as your dashboards are confirmed working again, which we expect to be within the next couple of hours.

subject: SAML login fails with 'invalid assertion' error
body: We're setting up SSO for Apex Systems and when users try to log in through our identity provider, they get redirected back to Northwind with an 'Invalid SAML Assertion: signature validation failed' error. Our IdP metadata was uploaded on the 12th and looked correct in the review screen. This is blocking about a third of our 20 users from accessing the platform at all, and I couldn't find clear documentation on certificate rotation requirements in your SSO setup guide.
answer: Sorry for the login trouble this is causing. Signature validation failures usually point to a mismatch between the certificate in your IdP metadata and what's stored on our side, often after a certificate rotation. Could you confirm the certificate fingerprint currently active in your IdP so we can compare it against what's on file, and I'll also send over our certificate rotation documentation since I agree the current guide could be clearer on that step.

subject: Mobile app crashes when switching to offline mode
body: Our field staff at Blue Academy rely on the mobile app to log attendance without wifi, but since updating to the latest version, the app crashes immediately whenever it detects no connection and tries to switch to offline mode. This is happening on both Android and iOS devices across our team of 10. We can't collect attendance data reliably right now, which is a serious problem during our current enrollment period.
answer: I'm sorry for the impact this is having on your enrollment period, and I've raised this as a P1 given it affects offline functionality entirely. Could you let me know the exact app version shown in your settings menu and one or two device models where you've reproduced the crash? In the meantime, our mobile team is investigating a reported issue with the offline mode transition introduced in the last release, and we'll prioritize a fix.

subject: Feedback on scheduled sync performance
body: I wanted to share some observations about our scheduled data pipeline syncs for Ember Freight. Our nightly sync from the retail inventory connector has been taking noticeably longer over the past two weeks, going from around 12 minutes to over 40 minutes most nights, though it still completes successfully with no errors. Data quality looks fine when I spot-check the output, but the added latency is starting to push our morning reports later than we'd like.
answer: Thanks for the detailed feedback, this is helpful. A 3x increase in sync duration without errors often points to growing data volume or connector-side throttling rather than a failure, so I'll have our data pipelines team review the connector logs for your account to see what's driving the slowdown. I'll follow up with findings and any recommended adjustments to keep your morning reports on schedule.

subject: Duplicate email digests sent to subscribers
body: We're using the Notifications API to send weekly email digests to our Lumen Travel subscriber lists, and starting Monday some recipients reported getting the same digest twice within a few minutes, both with identical content and timestamps in the payload. We're calling the /v1/digests/send endpoint once per batch per our logs, so I don't think it's a client-side retry. Is there a known issue with digest delivery duplication, and is there a way to add idempotency keys to this endpoint?
answer: Thanks for the clear details, that's very helpful for tracking this down. We're aware of an intermittent duplication issue affecting digest delivery for some accounts and our team is actively investigating the root cause. In the meantime, the /v1/digests/send endpoint does support an Idempotency-Key header, so I'd recommend adding a unique key per batch as a safeguard while we resolve the underlying issue on our end.

subject: How to restore files from a previous backup point
body: I'm a support engineer at Quill Partners and we need to restore a set of files that were accidentally overwritten in our Storage bucket on May 14th. I can see backup snapshots listed under Retention but I don't see an obvious restore action, only download links. We're on the Starter plan with 4 seats and want to know if restoring counts against our upload quota, and whether we can restore individual files rather than the entire snapshot.
answer: Thanks for reaching out. To restore, open the snapshot from May 14th under Retention, select the specific files you need (not the whole snapshot), and use the 'Restore to workspace' option rather than download — this writes directly back into your bucket without counting against your upload quota. If you don't see the restore button on individual files, let me know your workspace ID and I'll check whether that feature is enabled for your plan.

subject: Biometric login fails after app update
body: After updating the Northwind mobile app to the latest version, biometric login (Face ID) no longer works for several of our field staff at Atlas Foods. The app just returns to the password screen without any error message. This happens both online and offline. We have 5 seats on this account and it's affecting at least 3 users so far since yesterday's update.
answer: Sorry for the trouble this is causing your team. This looks related to a known issue where biometric credentials get invalidated after an app update on certain devices. Please have affected users go to Settings > Security within the app, disable and re-enable Face ID login once, which should re-register the biometric key — this should also work offline. Let us know if the issue persists after that so we can dig into device-specific logs.

subject: Need to add new office IP ranges to allowlist urgently
body: I'm integrating the API for Apex Legal and we just moved to a new office with a different egress IP range. Our old IP allowlist entries are still active but we need to add two new CIDR blocks (203.0.113.0/24 and 198.51.100.0/24) before end of day, since our current API calls are failing with 403 Forbidden from the new office. We have 14 seats on Starter and this is blocking our compliance team's integration testing.
answer: Thanks for flagging this — I've escalated it to our Security team given the deadline. To add the new CIDR blocks, go to Admin Console > Settings > Allowlist and submit both ranges; changes typically propagate within 15 minutes, but I'm also manually verifying the entries on our end to make sure the 403s clear immediately. I'll update this ticket as soon as it's confirmed live.

subject: Pagination breaking on large result sets since last API update
body: We're an IT team at Harbor Robotics and starting this week our integration is getting truncated results when paginating through /v2/documents. The 'next_cursor' field in the response is sometimes null even though we know there are more records — we've confirmed this against our internal count of 4,300 records where only 2,000 are returned. This is affecting our nightly sync jobs for 208 seats' worth of case data and several webhooks tied to document updates are now firing out of order.
answer: This is a priority issue and we're looking into it right now. We recently changed cursor generation for large result sets and there's a known regression affecting datasets over 2,000 records where the cursor can return null prematurely — a fix is being tested and we expect to deploy it within the next few hours. In the meantime, as a workaround you can pass the 'legacy_cursor=true' query parameter to restore the previous pagination behavior until the fix ships.

subject: Jira integration link stopped syncing tickets
body: As the workspace admin for Summit Retail, I noticed our Jira integration hasn't synced any new tickets since Tuesday. When I go to Integrations > Jira, the connection shows as 'Active' but issues created in Northwind aren't appearing in our Jira project, and the sync log shows no entries for the last 48 hours. We also use Slack and Salesforce integrations which both still seem to be working fine.
answer: Thanks for the details — this helps narrow it down. We're seeing that the Jira sync worker queue got stuck for several tenants including yours starting Tuesday; we're restarting the sync process for your workspace now and it should catch up on the missed tickets within the hour. I'll confirm once the backlog clears and let you know if any tickets need to be manually re-triggered.

subject: Request for offline error logging in mobile app
body: I'm a product manager at Pioneer Retail and we've had a few reports from teachers using the app in areas with poor connectivity where the app crashes on launch. It seems to happen mostly when the app tries to sync cached data on startup. Could you point me to any documentation on how offline mode and crash reporting work together, and whether there's a way for us to get crash logs from affected devices to share with you?
answer: Thanks for reaching out, and good question. Our documentation on offline sync behavior and crash diagnostics is at docs.northwind.com/mobile/offline-mode, which covers how cached data is queued and synced on reconnect. For crash logs, ask affected users to enable 'Send diagnostics' in the app's Help menu after a crash occurs — this uploads a report we can look up by device ID or timestamp, and I'm happy to review any once you have them.

subject: Users unable to unsubscribe from email notifications via API
body: I'm integrating the Notifications API for Apex Robotics and our unsubscribe endpoint (/v1/notifications/unsubscribe) is returning 200 OK but users still receive duplicate emails afterward. We tested with three separate user IDs on 2024-05-20 and all three received the same digest email again the next day despite a confirmed unsubscribe call. Given our size (1,824 seats) this is generating a growing number of complaints from end users who think they're being spammed.
answer: Thank you for the detailed report — I understand the urgency given your user base. It looks like the unsubscribe flag is being set correctly but our digest scheduler is reading from a cached preference list that refreshes only every 24 hours, which explains the delayed duplicate sends. We're pushing a fix to shorten that cache window today; in the meantime, I can manually clear the cache for the three test user IDs you mentioned so you can confirm the fix works before it's fully rolled out.

subject: SDK throwing deprecation errors after recent update
body: I manage finance operations at Ember Travel and our engineering team flagged that our webhook listener built with the Northwind SDK started throwing errors this week. The error message is 'DeprecationWarning: webhook.verifySignature() will be removed in v4, use webhook.verify() instead' followed by a hard failure on some payloads. We're on Pro with 175 seats and need to understand the timeline for this deprecation since it's affecting our billing reconciliation webhooks.
answer: Thanks for flagging this — verifySignature() is being deprecated but shouldn't hard-fail yet in the current SDK version; that suggests you may be on an older SDK build where the two methods aren't fully interoperable. We recommend updating to SDK v3.8 or later and switching to webhook.verify(), which resolves the failure and buys you time before the v4 removal (planned for Q4). I'll also flag this to our SDK team to check why it's erroring rather than just warning.

subject: Change digest frequency and fix duplicate sends
body: We're building on the Notifications API at Quill Works and would like to change our email digest frequency from daily to weekly for a specific notification template (ID: tmpl_8834). Separately, we've noticed some users are getting two copies of the same digest on Mondays, which looks like a bug rather than expected behavior. Can you help with both the frequency change and looking into the duplicates?
answer: Happy to help with both. For the frequency change, you can update template tmpl_8834's schedule under Notifications > Templates > Digest Settings, switching the cadence from daily to weekly — this takes effect on the next scheduling cycle. On the duplicate Monday sends, that does sound like a bug rather than a scheduling overlap on our end, so I'm opening an investigation and will follow up with what we find, likely related to timezone handling in the weekly batch job.

subject: Offline mode failing, app crashes and users can't log back in
body: I'm the operations lead at Cobalt Capital and starting this morning, our field teams using offline mode are reporting the app crashes when reconnecting to sync cached data. After the crash, several users are unable to log back in — the app just shows a spinner on the login screen indefinitely. This is affecting a large portion of our 128 seats during a critical reporting week and we need this fixed fast.
answer: I understand how disruptive this is during your reporting week and we're treating this as a high priority issue. We've identified a sync conflict that can occur when large amounts of offline data queue up before reconnecting, which is likely triggering both the crash and the subsequent login hang. As an immediate workaround, have affected users force-close the app, clear the app cache (not data) under device settings, and log in again — this should unblock login while we finalize a permanent fix, which we expect to ship within the next day.

subject: Request for credit review on duplicate March charge
body: Our March invoice shows a duplicate charge of $412 that hit our card on March 3rd and again on March 5th. We're on the Starter plan with 24 seats and dropped from 28 seats mid-cycle, so I also want to confirm the proration was calculated correctly. Could we get a credit applied to our next invoice rather than a refund back to the card on file?
answer: Thanks for flagging this - I can see the duplicate charge on your account and will get a credit of $412 applied to your next invoice rather than processing a card refund, which typically takes longer. I'll also double check the proration from your seat reduction (28 to 24) and confirm the corrected figures in a follow-up email within the next two business days.

subject: Error
body:
We're running transform jobs against our logistics shipment data and about 30% of them have started failing since yesterday around 14:00 UTC. Here's the log from job run 88213:

[2024-05-14 14:02:11] ERROR transform.stage.parse - SchemaMismatchError: field 'eta_timestamp' expected ISO8601, got 'null'
[2024-05-14 14:02:11] ERROR transform.pipeline - Stage 'normalize' failed after 3 retries
[2024-05-14 14:02:12] WARN transform.pipeline - Skipping record batch 4471-4502
[2024-05-14 14:02:15] ERROR transform.pipeline - Job 88213 aborted: too many stage failures

The docs say null values should be coerced to an empty string during normalize, but that's clearly not happening. This is blocking our nightly load into 14 downstream tables.
answer: Thanks for the detailed log - this looks like a regression in how the normalize stage handles null timestamp fields, which shouldn't be reaching the parse stage as raw nulls. I've escalated this to engineering as P1 given the impact on your nightly loads and we're reproducing with job 88213 now. I'll update you within a few hours with either a fix or a workaround for coercing eta_timestamp fields ahead of the transform.

subject: Deactivated users still showing as active and able to log in
body: We deactivated 12 users from our admin console yesterday afternoon as part of an offboarding batch, but this morning 5 of them are still listed as active and were able to log in successfully. As a fintech company this is a real compliance concern - deactivation needs to take effect immediately. Can you confirm whether there's a sync delay between the deactivation action and the allowlist cache?
answer: I understand the urgency here given your compliance requirements, and I've flagged this as P1 on our side. We're seeing indications of a delayed sync between the deactivation service and the session allowlist cache, and are working to force-refresh the affected accounts now. I'll confirm once all 5 users are fully deactivated and follow up with root cause details.

subject: Issue
body: Since this morning our integration using the Northwind Python SDK (v4.2.1) has been throwing 429 errors on nearly every call, even though we're sending only around 80 requests per minute against a documented limit of 500. Webhook deliveries for enrollment events have also stopped arriving since around 9:15am. This is affecting all of our 1598 users trying to access course materials right now.
answer: This is now our top priority - a mismatch in the rate limiter appears to be applying an incorrect threshold to your account, and we're also seeing a backlog in the webhook delivery queue tied to the same incident. Engineering is actively working the fix; I'll send an update within the hour and will confirm once both the 429 errors and webhook delivery are resolved.

subject: Allowlist changes not saving in workspace settings
body: We need to add three new office IP ranges to our workspace allowlist and change our automatic deactivation policy from 90 days of inactivity to 45 days, ahead of an internal audit next week. When I try to save the allowlist changes in the admin console, the page shows a spinner that never resolves and the changes don't persist. Can someone confirm what's blocking this, or make the changes on our behalf given the audit deadline?
answer: Given your audit timeline, I've marked this P1 and we're looking into the save failure on the allowlist section right now - it appears related to a validation step timing out on larger IP range lists. In the meantime, I can apply the allowlist and deactivation policy changes manually on our end today if you send over the three IP ranges and confirm the new 45-day threshold.

subject: Mobile app crashes when reconnecting after offline use
body: I use the Northwind mobile app to approve invoices while moving between warehouses, and I frequently lose signal. Over the past few days, when the app reconnects after being offline for more than a few minutes, it crashes instead of syncing the queued approvals. I've lost at least 6 pending approvals this week because of this. I'm on iOS 17.4, app version 3.8.2.
answer: Sorry for the disruption this is causing to your approval workflow. This matches a known issue with the offline sync queue not handling reconnection cleanly on iOS 17.4 - could you send us the crash log from the app's diagnostics screen so we can confirm it's the same root cause? In the meantime, try force-closing the app before reconnecting to a stable network, which should reduce the chance of losing queued approvals.

subject: Mobile app unusable - crashes on login for entire team
body: Our whole team of 18 relies on the Northwind mobile app to check case status while traveling, and since this morning nobody can log in - the app crashes immediately on the login screen, both offline and online. Push notifications for urgent case updates have also stopped coming through. This is severely affecting our ability to serve clients today, please treat as urgent.
answer: We're treating this as an active outage and have engineering paged right now. We're seeing crash reports tied to the login flow across multiple accounts and are working to isolate the cause alongside the push notification failure, which appears related. I'll send you an update within 30 minutes and will notify you as soon as login is restored for your team.

subject: Request to rotate and scope API keys ahead of deprecation
body: We saw the notice that legacy v1 API keys are being deprecated on July 1st. We currently have 4 active keys used across our manufacturing analytics pipeline, and I'd like to rotate them to the new key format while also adding scoped permissions so our reporting key can only hit read-only endpoints. Could you confirm the migration steps and whether webhook signing secrets need to be regenerated at the same time?
answer: Good timing on getting ahead of the July 1st deprecation. The migration involves generating new v2 keys from the API Platform settings page, assigning scopes per key (read-only is supported for reporting use cases), and updating your integration to use the new key headers - webhook signing secrets are independent and won't need to change unless you rotate the webhook endpoint itself. I can walk through the scope configuration for your 4 keys on a call if that's easier, just let me know a good time.

subject: Users getting logged out every 10 minutes after SSO login
body: Since yesterday, our team members are being forced to re-authenticate through our SSO provider roughly every 10 minutes, even though our session timeout policy is configured for 8 hours in the Identity console. This is happening across multiple browsers and for at least 20 of our 114 seats so far. Nobody on our side changed the SAML configuration recently, so I suspect something changed on Northwind's end.
answer: Thanks for the details - a shortened session lifetime like this pointing to a mismatch between the configured 8-hour policy and the token expiry being issued is a strong signal something changed on our side rather than your SAML config. I've escalated this as P1 and we're checking recent changes to the session service; I'll update you as soon as we identify why tokens are expiring early for your workspace.

subject: Dashboard-Freigaben funktionieren nicht mehr korrekt
body:
Seit dem Update am Montag können mehrere Kollegen aus unserem Logistik-Team nicht mehr auf freigegebene Dashboards zugreifen, obwohl die Freigabe-Einstellungen unverändert sind. Beim Versuch, das Dashboard 'Lieferkette Q2' zu öffnen, erhalten sie folgende Fehlermeldung:

[2024-06-11 09:12:44] ERROR sharing.permissions - AccessDeniedException: user_id 88213 not in shared_with list despite active grant
[2024-06-11 09:12:44] WARN sharing.cache - Stale permission cache detected for dashboard_id 5567
[2024-06-11 09:13:01] ERROR export.service - Export blocked: insufficient permissions

Auch der Export als PDF schlägt für betroffene Nutzer fehl. Das betrifft aktuell mindestens 15 Personen in unserem Team und blockiert unser wöchentliches Reporting.
answer: Vielen Dank für die detaillierte Fehlermeldung. Es sieht so aus, als ob nach dem Update vom Montag ein veralteter Permission-Cache für einzelne Dashboards nicht korrekt invalidiert wurde, was sowohl den Zugriff als auch den PDF-Export blockiert. Wir stufen dies als P1 ein und leeren den Cache für das Dashboard 'Lieferkette Q2' sowie die betroffenen 15 Nutzer manuell; wir melden uns innerhalb der nächsten Stunde mit einem Status-Update.

subject: Shared dashboards visible to entire org instead of selected group
body:
We manage patient-flow dashboards for Pioneer Robotics and this morning I set sharing on our Q3 Ops dashboard to a specific group of 12 clinical leads. Instead, the dashboard is now viewable by all 76 seats in our workspace, including contractors who shouldn't see PHI-adjacent metrics. I've tried removing and re-adding the group permission twice with no change.

This is a compliance issue for us given the healthcare context, so we need this locked down urgently. Can you confirm whether this is a known bug with the sharing permission model?
answer: Thank you for flagging this immediately, and I understand the compliance urgency here. We're seeing reports of a permission propagation bug affecting group-scoped dashboard shares released in our last update, and engineering is already investigating. As an immediate mitigation, please set the dashboard to Private and I'll manually verify and reapply your intended group ACL from our end within the hour so no unauthorized viewers retain access in the meantime.

subject: Deprecated webhook signature header breaking our order sync
body:
We integrate Northwind's API Platform into our order management pipeline at Willow Foods across 206 seats, and as of this week our webhook receiver started rejecting all incoming events. Logs show the signature header we validate against, X-Northwind-Signature, is no longer being sent - it looks like it was replaced with X-Northwind-Signature-256 without a deprecation notice reaching us.

Our SDK version is 4.2.1. We're now completely blind to order and inventory webhook events store-wide, which is halting our restocking automation. Please advise on the migration path and whether there's a grace period we can use while we update our verification code.
answer: Apologies for the disruption - this header rename was part of a signature algorithm upgrade and should have been flagged more clearly in the deprecation notice for SDK versions below 4.5.0. You can restore event delivery immediately by updating your verification logic to accept X-Northwind-Signature-256 (HMAC-SHA256 over the raw payload); in the meantime we've re-enabled dual-header delivery for your account for the next 72 hours so your existing code keeps working while you deploy the fix. I'll follow up with a direct link to the migration guide and sample code for your SDK version.

subject: Invoice charged for 22 seats but we only have 14 active users
body:
Our latest invoice for Cobalt Analytics bills us for 22 seats on the Starter plan, but we currently have only 14 active users in the admin console - I just exported the user list to confirm. We removed 8 users back in early March when two contractors rolled off and a small team was reorganized, but the seat count never seems to have adjusted on our account.

Can someone check our billing record against the actual seat count and issue a correction or refund for the overcharge? This has now happened on two consecutive invoices.
answer: Thanks for including the export, that makes this quick to verify. I can see the discrepancy on our side - the March seat removals weren't synced to your billing record, which is why you've been billed for 22 seats across the last two cycles. I'm correcting your seat count to 14 now and processing a prorated refund for the overcharged amount on both invoices; you should see the credit reflected within 3-5 business days.

subject: Intermittent upload failures on large backup files
body:
We're seeing occasional failures when uploading large backup archives (mostly 8-15GB) through Storage for our Blue Health environment. The upload progresses to around 90% and then fails with a generic 'upload could not be completed' message, roughly 1 in 10 attempts across our IT team. Retrying usually works but it's disruptive during our nightly backup window.

We're not near our storage quota (currently using about 60% of allocation), so I don't think it's a capacity issue. Could you check if there's a timeout or chunking setting we should adjust for large files, given we're running scheduled uploads across 1416 seats' worth of data sources?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. Intermittent failures near completion on large files are often caused by a client-side timeout during the final chunk commit rather than a quota issue, which lines up with what you're seeing. I'd recommend increasing your upload client's timeout threshold and enabling chunked multipart upload if it isn't already active - I'll send over our recommended settings for archives over 5GB, and we'll also review server-side logs from your recent failed attempts to see if there's a pattern we can address on our end.

subject: App crashes when syncing after extended offline use
body:
I'm a support engineer at Vertex Systems and we rely on the Mobile App's offline mode heavily since our field technicians work in warehouses with poor signal. When a device has been offline for more than a few hours and then reconnects, the app crashes consistently during the sync step - we've reproduced this on both iOS and Android across five test devices.

The crash happens right after the 'Syncing offline changes' progress bar appears. No changes get lost that we can tell, but techs have to force-restart the app and retry sync, sometimes multiple times. This is affecting our 160-seat rollout and slowing down daily route updates.
answer: Thank you for the clear reproduction steps - a crash specifically tied to sync duration after extended offline periods points to a likely issue in how the local change queue is being processed on reconnect. Could you send us device logs from one of the crash instances along with app version numbers for the affected iOS and Android builds? In the meantime, I'd suggest having technicians sync manually every hour or two when signal is briefly available to reduce queue size, which should lower the crash frequency while we investigate.

subject: Backup files being deleted before our retention period ends
body:
We configured a 90-day retention policy for our financial backup files in Storage, but I discovered this week that files uploaded on January 15th were already gone by April 10th - that's under 85 days. I checked three other batches from February and they were also missing several days early. This is affecting Orion Travel's compliance backups and we need those files intact for audit purposes.

We have not changed the retention setting since it was configured, and the admin console still shows '90 days' under our storage policy. Can you investigate why files are being purged early?
answer: This is a serious issue and I've escalated it to our storage team immediately given the compliance impact. Early purging despite a correctly configured 90-day policy suggests a bug in how the retention timer is calculated for certain upload batches, and we're pulling logs for the January 15th and February batches you mentioned to confirm the pattern. I'll update you within the next few hours with findings and whether any of the purged files can be recovered from our backend snapshots before they're permanently gone.

subject: Best practices for offline data caching in Mobile App
body:
I'm reviewing how our small team at Orion Health uses the Mobile App's offline mode for field data collection and I want to understand caching behavior better before we scale usage. Right now it seems like only the last 7 days of records sync for offline access - is that a fixed window or configurable?

Also, is there documentation on how push notifications behave when a device comes back online after being in offline mode for a while? We occasionally see duplicate notifications and I'd like to understand if that's expected or something we should report separately.
answer: Good questions - the 7-day offline sync window is currently a fixed default on the Starter plan and isn't user-configurable, though it's something we're evaluating for future plan tiers. On the push notification duplication, that can happen when queued notifications are re-delivered alongside newly triggered ones during the reconnect sync; I'll point you to our offline mode documentation section covering notification behavior, and if duplicates continue happening consistently please open a separate ticket with a couple of timestamps so we can look closer.

subject: Okta SSO integration failing for entire finance team since yesterday
body:
Since yesterday afternoon our finance team at Pioneer Travel (190 seats total) has been completely locked out of Northwind via our Okta integration. Users get redirected to Okta, authenticate successfully, but then land on a 'we could not complete your sign-in' error page back on Northwind's side. I confirmed the Okta app configuration hasn't changed on our end.

This is blocking month-end close activities and I need this resolved urgently. Can someone check if there was a change on Northwind's side to the Okta integration, possibly related to a recent update? I can provide our Okta app ID and recent SAML response logs if helpful.
answer: I'm sorry for the disruption to your month-end process, and I've flagged this as urgent given the full sign-in blockage. We did push an update to SAML assertion validation yesterday, and it's possible a stricter attribute check is now rejecting responses that previously passed - please send over your Okta app ID and a sample SAML response log and I'll get engineering looking at this within the hour. In the meantime, if any finance users have direct password-based accounts as a fallback, that would let them work while we resolve the SSO issue.

subject: Request to route billing alerts to a specific Slack channel
body:
We'd like to change how Northwind alerts reach our small team at Quill Robotics - right now integration and billing notifications go to individual emails, but we want them routed into our #ops-alerts Slack channel instead. We have the Slack integration connected already for other workflows, just not for these alert types.

Can you walk me through enabling this, or is it something that needs to be configured from your side given we're on the Starter plan? We only have 3 seats so I want to make sure this doesn't require an upgrade.
answer: Good news - routing alerts to a Slack channel is available on Starter and doesn't require a plan upgrade. Since you already have the Slack integration connected, you just need to go into Notification Settings, select the alert categories (billing, integration events, etc.), and choose your #ops-alerts channel as the delivery target instead of email. Let me know if you don't see that option in your admin panel and I'll check whether it needs to be enabled on our side first.

subject: URGENT: Files disappearing before retention window - production data at risk
body:
I'm integrating with the Storage API for Lumen Freight and just discovered that objects uploaded via our nightly backup job on March 1st are returning 404 when we try to retrieve them, well before the 60-day retention period we configured should expire. We rely on this for our production backup pipeline and this is the third time this month we've hit missing objects that should still be within retention.

Our API calls use the /v1/storage/objects endpoint with retention_days=60 explicitly set in the upload request. I have request IDs for the March 1st batch: req_8a3f2c and req_8a3f2d. This needs urgent investigation since we may be silently losing production backups without any error being surfaced to us.
answer: This is being treated as high priority given the potential data loss - thank you for including the request IDs. We're pulling logs for req_8a3f2c and req_8a3f2d right now to determine whether the retention_days parameter was correctly applied at upload time or if there's a purge job misconfiguration on our end affecting your account. I'll update you within a few hours with findings, and in parallel please pause the nightly job if possible until we confirm the objects currently in flight won't be affected by the same issue.

subject: Pagination returning duplicate records after webhook deprecation notice
body: We use the API Platform to sync student records into our LMS, and since the notice about the page-based pagination deprecation went out, our nightly job started pulling duplicate rows. We're on cursor pagination now using the 'next_cursor' field, but on the third page it seems to loop back and repeat records from page one instead of advancing. This happened on our last three sync runs (Oct 12, 13, 14). Can you confirm if there's a known issue with cursor pagination on the /v2/students endpoint?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. This looks like it could be related to a cursor invalidation edge case we've seen when a record set changes mid-page during the deprecation migration. Can you send us one of the affected request/response pairs (with cursor values) from the Oct 14 run so we can trace it in our logs? In the meantime, adding a small delay between page fetches or re-requesting the cursor from the last known-good response should reduce duplicates.

subject: Users stuck on MFA enrolment screen after SSO login
body: We rolled out mandatory MFA enrolment for our SSO users this week, and a growing number of employees are getting stuck on the enrolment screen after successful SSO authentication - the QR code loads but clicking 'Continue' just spins and eventually times out with a generic error. This is affecting roughly 30 of our 243 seats so far, mostly in the sales and support teams. Is there a known conflict between our SAML provisioning rules and the new MFA step?
answer: Thank you for flagging this - we can see reports of the enrolment step timing out for tenants that provisioned users via SAML JIT after the MFA update rolled out on Monday. We're actively investigating a race condition between provisioning and MFA state initialization. As a temporary workaround, ask affected users to log out completely, clear cookies for the identity domain, and retry - this has resolved it for most users while we finalize a fix.

subject: PDF export cuts off right side of dashboard
body: When I export our Q3 finance dashboard to PDF, the rightmost column of the revenue-by-region widget gets cut off in the downloaded file, even though it displays fine on screen. I've tried this from both Chrome and Edge with the same result. The dashboard is called 'Regional Revenue Overview' and I'm exporting via the share icon in the top right. It's not urgent, but I wanted to flag it since I use this report for our monthly board packet.
answer: Thanks for the clear description - PDF exports use a fixed page width that can clip wide widgets, and this is a known limitation with dashboards that have more than five columns in a single widget. As a workaround, try setting the widget to 'compact' layout before exporting, which usually fits everything on the page. We've logged this as feedback for our dashboard export team to consider a wider or landscape export option.

subject: Unsubscribed customers still getting duplicate alert emails
body: Several of our customers who clicked unsubscribe from our booking alert notifications are still receiving duplicate emails - two copies of the same alert, both after the unsubscribe date. I checked the notification logs for one customer (ref booking-8841) and it shows they unsubscribed on Oct 9, but they got duplicate emails on Oct 11 and Oct 12. We're sending these through the Alerting API with template 'booking_reminder_v3'. Can you help us understand why the unsubscribe isn't being honored?
answer: Thanks for including the reference ID - that helps a lot. It looks like unsubscribe status can lag behind if the alert is queued before the unsubscribe event is processed, which may explain the duplicates you're seeing. We're checking the processing order for booking-8841 specifically and will confirm whether this is a timing issue or a caching problem on our end within the next business day.

subject: URGENT
body: WE NEED TO RESTORE FILES FROM BACKUP THAT WERE DELETED YESTERDAY AND THE RESTORE OPTION IN THE STORAGE CONSOLE IS GRAYED OUT. WE ARE ON THE STARTER PLAN AND OUR RETENTION WINDOW SHOULD STILL COVER THIS BUT WE CANNOT FIND ANY BACKUP SNAPSHOTS LISTED FOR OUR WORKSPACE. THIS IS CLIENT CONTRACT DATA THAT WE NEED BACK TODAY. PLEASE HELP ASAP.
answer: We understand the urgency and are looking into this right now. Could you confirm the exact workspace ID and the approximate time the files were deleted? Starter plan retention snapshots are typically taken daily, so we want to check whether a snapshot exists for that window before the restore option becomes available again - we'll follow up as soon as we locate it.

subject: Connector auth token expiring mid-sync causing latency spikes
body:
Our Salesforce connector in the Data Pipeline keeps failing partway through the nightly sync with an auth error, and we've had to manually re-authenticate three times this week. Here's the relevant log snippet:

2024-06-11T02:14:22Z ERROR connector.salesforce: token refresh failed, status=401
2024-06-11T02:14:22Z WARN pipeline.run_8823: retrying in 30s
2024-06-11T02:14:52Z ERROR connector.salesforce: token refresh failed, status=401
2024-06-11T02:16:10Z INFO pipeline.run_8823: sync aborted after 3 retries

Could you look into why the refresh token isn't renewing automatically? We'd also like to request an option to get a Slack alert when this happens instead of finding out the next morning.
answer: Thanks for the log snippet, that's very helpful. It looks like the refresh token for your Salesforce connection may have been revoked or rotated on the Salesforce side, which would explain the repeated 401s rather than a bug in the renewal logic - could you check if anything changed with the connected app permissions around June 10? We'll also pass along your request for Slack alerting on connector failures to our product team as a feature request.

subject: app crashs on lauch for alot of our field staff
body: hi, we have alot of field staff useing the mobile app to log expenses and since the update on oct 3 the app crashs imediately on lauch for aprox 40 users, mostly on android. it works fine for ios users. some users say it happend right after a push notification came in. we need this fixed soon since our team relys on this daily for expense approvals and its becoming a big problem for us.
answer: Thank you for reporting this, and we're sorry for the disruption to your team's workflow. The crash-on-launch pattern tied to push notifications on Android after the Oct 3 update matches an issue we're currently investigating with a specific notification payload handler. Could you ask a few affected users to share their app version and Android OS version so we can confirm the scope, and in the meantime disabling push notifications temporarily in device settings should prevent the crash.

subject: SSO role mapping broken - users getting wrong permissions after login
body: Since this morning, employees logging in through our SAML SSO are being assigned the default 'viewer' role instead of their mapped role from our identity provider groups. We have finance and legal staff who now can't access billing or contract data they need for closing tasks today. Our role mapping configuration hasn't changed on our end - group 'Ember-Finance-Admins' should map to the 'admin' role but users in that group are landing as 'viewer'. This is affecting all 142 seats.
answer: This has been escalated to our identity team immediately given the scope of impact. We're checking whether a recent update to attribute mapping on our side is causing group claims to be dropped during the SAML assertion - can you confirm the exact IdP group attribute name you're sending so we can trace it against our mapping configuration? We'll keep you updated as we investigate and will notify you the moment we have a fix or workaround.

subject: Data pipeline dropping late-arriving records - revenue numbers wrong
body: We've discovered that our nightly ad revenue pipeline is silently dropping records that arrive more than 4 hours late from our ad exchange partner, and this has been happening since at least Oct 8 based on our reconciliation checks. Our finance team caught a discrepancy of roughly $180,000 in reported revenue for last week versus what our partner's records show. This is affecting our entire media reporting stack across all 243 seats and we need to know if the raw data is recoverable or permanently lost.
answer: We're treating this as a critical incident and have escalated it to our data pipeline on-call team right now. Late-arriving records outside the configured window are typically routed to a dead-letter store rather than deleted outright, so there is a strong chance the Oct 8 onward data can be recovered and reprocessed - we'll confirm retention status within the hour and will work with you directly on a reconciliation plan once we have it.

subject: Storage retention policy not deleting files past 90-day limit
body: We configured our workspace retention policy to automatically delete files older than 90 days back in July, but I just noticed files from March and April are still sitting in our storage and counting against our quota. We're now at 92% of our storage quota and getting warning banners, which is concerning since we're on Pro plan with 171 seats. Can someone check why the retention job isn't clearing these older files?
answer: Thanks for flagging this - we're looking into your workspace's retention job history to see why the cleanup task didn't run as expected for the March/April files. In the meantime, to avoid hitting your quota limit, you can manually archive or delete specific older folders from the storage console while we identify the root cause of the retention job failure. We'll update you shortly with findings.

subject: Duplicate email alerts being sent for same event
body: We're integrating the Notifications API for Atlas Systems and since yesterday we've seen duplicate alerts firing for the same trigger event. Order confirmation emails for order #A-88213 went out 3 times within 40 seconds to the same customer. Our webhook logs show only one POST from our system, so it looks like it's happening on Northwind's side. This is hitting a meaningful chunk of our 268 seats and customers are complaining about spam.
answer: Thanks for flagging this, and sorry for the disruption to your customers. We've seen a related issue with our alerting queue re-delivering events after a delayed ack, and we're actively investigating retry logic on our end. Can you send us the event IDs or timestamps for a few more duplicate cases so we can trace them against our dispatch logs? In the meantime we're prioritizing a fix given the customer-facing impact.

subject: Request to support multiple API keys per environment
body: As IT admin for Ember Retail, I'm setting up separate API keys for our staging and production webhook integrations, but it looks like we're limited to a single active key per account. We'd like the ability to generate multiple scoped keys so we can rotate credentials without downtime and separate permissions per environment. Is this on the roadmap, or is there a workaround available today?
answer: Good question, and this is feedback we hear often. Currently each account supports one active API key at a time, but we do have multi-key support with scoped permissions in our roadmap for the API Platform. As a workaround today, you can generate a new key and immediately update your webhook config, then revoke the old one, which minimizes downtime to a few minutes. I'll log your request with our product team as a vote for this feature.

subject: Duplicate entries appearing in weekly email digest
body: I'm a support engineer at Summit Legal and our weekly notification digest emails have started listing some case update items twice within the same digest. It's cosmetic rather than breaking anything, but it looks unprofessional going out to our clients. I noticed it in the digests sent on the last two Mondays for our legal team's shared inbox. Wanted to flag it as feedback rather than an urgent issue.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report, and I agree this shouldn't be happening even if it's low impact. We'll take a look at the digest aggregation logic to see why some items are being pulled in twice for the same period. I'll follow up once we've identified the cause, and feel free to send us a sample digest if you still have one so we can compare against our logs.

subject: App crashes immediately on launch for all our users
body: Since this morning the mobile app crashes right after the splash screen for everyone on our team at Blue Partners, we can't even get to the login screen. We're a small finance team and this is blocking our expense approvals which are time sensitive today. Could you also let us know if there's a way to get a crash notification pushed to admins when this happens, since we had no warning before it started affecting all 8 of our users?
answer: This is impacting your whole team so we're treating it as high priority. Can you tell us the device OS versions and app version you're running, and whether this started right after an update? In the meantime, try clearing the app cache or reinstalling, which has resolved similar launch crashes for other customers. We'll also log your request for a push notification alert to admins on crash events as a feature suggestion.

subject: Email digest showing duplicate rows and slow to arrive
body: I'm a data analyst at Atlas Partners and our daily email digest has two problems: some line items are duplicated within the same email, and the digest itself has been arriving 3-4 hours later than usual for the past week. We rely on this to spot data anomalies each morning so the delay is a real problem for our small team. Is there documentation on how the digest scheduling and dedup logic works so we can understand what changed?
answer: Thanks for reporting both issues together, this helps us investigate. We're looking into the delay first since that has the bigger operational impact, and will check whether it's related to the duplication in the same batch job. I don't have public documentation on the internal scheduling logic yet, but I'll get you a summary of how digests are generated and let you know as soon as we identify the root cause.

subject: SCIM provisioning failing, users cannot be created or deprovisioned
body: Our SCIM integration for Quill Robotics stopped working this morning, we cannot provision new users or deprovision offboarded ones through our identity provider. This is a security concern because we have a departing employee whose access needs to be revoked immediately and the SCIM deprovisioning call is returning errors. We only have 3 seats but this touches all of them and we need this resolved urgently.
answer: This is being treated as urgent given the security implications. Please manually revoke the departing employee's access directly in the admin console right now as a stopgap while we investigate the SCIM failure. Can you send us the error response your identity provider is receiving along with the timestamp of the failed calls? We're escalating this to our identity team immediately.

subject: Recurring card failures on monthly invoice
body: For the past two billing cycles our card payment for Pioneer Freight has failed on the first attempt and only gone through on retry a day later. It's not blocking anything critical since it eventually succeeds, but I wanted to ask if there's a way to see the decline reason in the billing dashboard, and whether we can add a backup payment method for our 22 seats in case this keeps happening.
answer: Thanks for the heads up, and glad it's resolving on retry so far. You can add a backup payment method under Billing > Payment Methods, and we'll automatically fall back to it if the primary card is declined. For decline reasons, check the invoice detail page which usually shows the code returned by the card processor; happy to help interpret it if it's unclear.

subject: SDK throwing intermittent errors on webhook signature verification
body: We're using the Northwind SDK (v4.2.1) for Atlas Legal and started seeing intermittent errors when verifying incoming webhook signatures. Roughly 1 in 10 requests fail with 'signature mismatch: invalid HMAC' even though the payload looks unchanged. This started after we upgraded the SDK last week. The documentation doesn't mention any changes to the signing algorithm, so we're not sure what's causing the mismatch.
answer: Thanks for the details, including the SDK version. There was a change in v4.2.0 around how raw request bodies are read before signature verification, which can cause mismatches if middleware is modifying the payload before it reaches the SDK. Can you confirm whether you're using any body-parsing middleware upstream of the verification call? We'll also update the docs since this change wasn't called out clearly.

subject: Users getting logged out mid-session more frequently
body: At Cobalt Systems we've noticed our team getting logged out and having to re-authenticate with MFA multiple times a day, sometimes after only 15-20 minutes of activity. This started roughly a week ago and is affecting all 5 of our seats. Is there a session timeout setting we can adjust, and is this related to any recent SSO configuration changes on your end?
answer: Sorry for the disruption this is causing your team. We haven't pushed any global session timeout changes recently, but there is a configurable session duration setting under Identity and SSO > Session Policy that may have been altered inadvertently. Can you check that setting and let us know the current value? We'll also review our SSO logs for your workspace around the timeframe you mentioned to see if there's a pattern in the forced logouts.

subject: Scheduled data pipeline syncs falling behind, need latency SLA guidance
body: As workspace admin for Quill Analytics, I've noticed our scheduled syncs for the legal case data pipeline have been running 45-90 minutes behind schedule over the past week, which is affecting downstream reporting for our 588 seats. Could you point us to documentation on expected sync latency and whether there's a way to configure priority or dedicated resources for enterprise scheduled jobs? We'd also like a feature to get alerted proactively when a sync falls behind a threshold.
answer: Thanks for flagging this, given the scale of your workspace we're prioritizing a review of your pipeline's scheduling queue to understand the delay. We do offer priority processing tiers for Enterprise accounts, and I'll get you documentation on latency expectations and how to request dedicated resourcing. I've also logged your request for proactive latency alerting as a feature suggestion for our data pipelines team.

subject: Slack alerts not firing for Integrations events
body:
We use the Slack integration to post alerts whenever a Jira ticket is linked from Northwind Integrations, but since Tuesday nothing is coming through in the #data-ops channel. I checked our Okta SSO session and the Slack app still shows as authorized under our workspace. No error banner appears in the Integrations settings page either, it just silently stops posting.

We rely on this for our compliance workflow with about 40 analysts watching that channel, so it would help to know if this is a known bug or something on our config side.
answer:
Thanks for the detailed report. We've seen a similar issue tied to a recent Slack webhook token rotation that can cause silent failures without surfacing an error in the UI. Can you confirm the exact date the alerts stopped and send us the integration ID from the Integrations settings page so we can check the delivery logs on our end?

In the meantime, try disconnecting and reconnecting the Slack app under Integrations > Slack to force a fresh token handshake, that has resolved this for other customers with the same symptom.

subject: Dashboard charts rendering blank across all workspaces
body:
