As of this morning our team dashboards are showing blank chart panels where bar and line charts used to render. This is affecting all 1194 seats company-wide, not just a few users. The export to PDF function also fails with a generic 'export failed, try again' message when we attempt to pull the weekly logistics report.

We use these dashboards for daily shift planning across our warehouses, so this is a significant operational problem. Can you escalate this and let us know if there's a known outage or a config change we need to make?
answer: This has been escalated to our engineering team as a P1 given the scope of impact. We're aware of a rendering regression affecting chart panels for a subset of accounts and are actively investigating; the export failures appear related to the same underlying issue. We'll update you within the hour with a status, and in the meantime you can try refreshing the dashboard cache under Settings > Performance, which has restored rendering for a few other affected accounts as a temporary workaround.

subject: Users getting logged out too frequently via SSO
body:
Our staff keep getting kicked back to the login screen after roughly 15 minutes of inactivity, even though we'd expect a longer idle timeout for our SSO setup. This is happening across our 54 seats regardless of role or permission level. We haven't changed anything in our identity provider configuration recently.

Is the session timeout controlled on Northwind's side or should we be adjusting something in our IdP? MFA prompts also seem to trigger again after each of these logouts, which is adding friction for our travel booking agents.
answer: Good question, the session timeout for SSO logins is configurable on the Northwind side under Admin Console > Identity > Session Settings, independent of your IdP's own session length. It sounds like your timeout may be set to a shorter default than expected. Could you check that setting and let us know the current value? If it's already set higher than 15 minutes, we'll dig into whether the MFA re-prompt is forcing an early session drop on our end.

subject: help
body: API rate limits dropped overnight, getting 429s everywhere.
answer: Sorry for the disruption, we're treating this as a P1 and looking into it right now. Can you share the API key prefix or client ID you're using along with a timestamp of a recent 429 response? That will let us check whether this is an account-specific throttle change or a broader platform issue affecting rate limit tiers.

subject: Requesting audit log change for admin deactivations
body:
I'm reviewing our compliance settings and noticed that when an admin deactivates a user account, the audit log entry doesn't capture which allowlist rule (if any) was affected. We need this for an upcoming audit review since we're on the Starter plan with only 7 seats but still subject to industry compliance checks.

Could you clarify how the Audit Log currently records deactivation events, and whether there's a way to enable more granular logging of allowlist and settings changes? A how-to doc would also help since our current admin is new to the console.
answer: Thanks for flagging this, currently the Audit Log records the deactivation action, actor, and timestamp, but allowlist rule associations aren't captured by default on the Starter plan. We can log this as a feature request on your behalf for more granular event capture. In the meantime, I'll send over our Admin Console audit documentation which walks through what's currently tracked and how to export logs for your compliance review.

subject: Duplicate email digests being sent multiple times daily
body:
Since Monday our team has been receiving the same daily notification digest email three or four times within the same hour, instead of once. This is happening for all 123 users on our Notifications setup. I checked the digest schedule settings and it's still configured for a single send at 8am.

Our compliance team is starting to flag this as noise in their inbox and asking why alerting rules seem duplicated. Can you look into whether this is a backend bug with the digest scheduler?
answer: This is being treated as a P1 given the volume of duplicate sends across your organization. We've identified a possible issue with the digest scheduler re-triggering queued jobs and are investigating now. As a temporary measure, you can pause the digest under Notifications > Digest Settings to stop the duplicate sends while we work on a fix, and we'll notify you as soon as it's safe to re-enable.

subject: SCIM provisioning request for automated deprovisioning
body:
We're currently provisioning users manually into Northwind and want to move to SCIM so that deactivations in our IdP automatically flow through to Northwind. We only have 11 seats on the Starter plan right now but expect to grow this quarter and want provisioning automated before that happens.

Could you confirm whether SCIM provisioning is available on our current plan, and if not, what the upgrade path looks like? We'd also like to understand how MFA and permission mappings are handled during SCIM sync.
answer: Thanks for reaching out about this. SCIM provisioning is available starting on our Pro plan, so you'd need to upgrade from Starter to enable it. Once enabled, user permission mappings and MFA enrollment status sync automatically based on the group attributes sent from your IdP. I'll follow up with a link to our SCIM setup guide and looped in our accounts team in case you'd like to discuss upgrade timing ahead of your growth this quarter.

subject: Users receiving duplicate alert notifications repeatedly
body:
We're seeing the same alert notification delivered two or three times to the same user within minutes of each other. This started yesterday and is affecting most of our 114 seats. I checked our alert rules configuration and there's only one rule matching each event type, so it doesn't look like a config issue on our side.

This is generating a lot of confusion and complaint tickets from our own customers who think something is broken. Can someone look into the alerting pipeline urgently?
answer: Thanks for the clear report, we're prioritizing this as a P1 given the customer-facing impact. This matches a pattern we're tracking where the alert dispatcher can re-send a notification if the acknowledgment callback times out. Can you share one or two specific alert IDs with timestamps so we can trace them through the pipeline while we work on a fix?

subject: Jira link integration broken after workspace update
body:
Our Jira link integration stopped syncing tickets into Northwind Integrations as of this morning, right after our Jira workspace was updated to a new instance URL. We only have 9 seats but our whole retail ops team relies on this link to track incidents automatically. The integration status page shows 'connected' but no new tickets are coming through.

Could someone check whether the integration needs to be reconnected with the new Jira URL, or if this is a bug on Northwind's end?
answer: Thanks for reporting this, given the operational impact we're treating it as a P1. It sounds like the integration is likely still pointing to the old Jira instance URL under the hood even though the status shows connected. Please try disconnecting and reconnecting the Jira integration under Integrations settings with the new workspace URL, and let us know if the sync resumes, if not we'll pull the integration logs on our side to check for a stale token issue.

subject: Dashboards extremely slow to load across the company
body:
Our dashboards have become progressively slower over the past week, with some pages taking over 20 seconds to load charts that used to render in 2-3 seconds. This is affecting all 273 seats and is now impacting daily operations planning for our logistics teams. Export to CSV is also timing out on larger reports.

We haven't added any new dashboards or data sources recently, so I don't think this is on our end. Can you escalate this and check if there's a performance issue on Northwind's backend?
answer: Escalating this now as a P1 given the company-wide slowdown. We'll check backend query performance and export job queues on our side for any recent degradation affecting your account. Could you send us the dashboard IDs or report names that are timing out, along with the approximate time you noticed the slowdown start, so we can pull the relevant performance logs?

subject: Alert routing sending critical alerts to wrong channel
body: We configured routing rules so that critical energy-usage alerts go to our on-call Slack channel and standard ones go to email, but since Tuesday all alerts (critical and standard) are landing in the general email distribution list. This means our on-call team is missing time-sensitive alerts and the whole ops group is getting flooded with noise. Can someone check why the routing rule for severity=critical isn't being honored? We have 23 analysts relying on this daily.
answer: Thanks for flagging this, I can see this is impacting your whole team's alerting workflow so I'm marking it P1 and escalating to our notifications engineering team right now. Can you send us the exact rule name or ID for the critical routing rule so we can trace it through the routing engine logs? In the meantime, as a workaround you could temporarily duplicate the critical rule with a higher priority weight so it evaluates first.

subject: Getting duplicate email alerts for same event
body: Since Monday our staff have been receiving 2-3 duplicate copies of the same alert email within a few minutes of each other, all with the identical event ID. This is happening across multiple alert types, not just one rule. We have 10 seats on the account and everyone is seeing this, it's making the alerts confusing since people think there are multiple incidents. Can you look into why the same event is triggering multiple sends?
answer: This sounds like a dedup issue on our notification dispatcher and given it's affecting your entire team I'm treating this as P1. We're pulling the delivery logs for your workspace now to check whether the alerts are being re-triggered by the source event or duplicated at send time. Could you share one of the duplicated event IDs and the approximate timestamps so we can trace it faster?

subject: Connector losing auth token intermittently
body: Our pipeline connector to the ERP source system has started failing auth roughly once a day since last week, returning 'invalid_grant: token expired or revoked' even though the refresh token should still be valid. The pipeline retries and usually succeeds on the second or third attempt, but this is adding 15-20 minutes of latency to our nightly manufacturing data loads. We're on connector version 4.2.1. Can you check if there's a token refresh timing issue on your end?
answer: Thanks for the details. An intermittent invalid_grant like this usually points to the token refresh happening too close to expiry, and we've seen a similar timing issue on connector 4.2.1 that we're currently patching. Can you confirm the timezone your pipeline scheduler runs in and send us one of the failed run IDs so we can check the exact refresh window against our OAuth logs?

subject: Request to increase storage quota alert threshold
body: We'd like to adjust the quota warning threshold for our workspace. Right now we get alerted at 90% of our storage limit but we'd prefer 75% so our admins have more runway to clean up old backups before we hit the cap. We're a small team of 16 and don't want to accidentally hit the hard limit during retention cleanup jobs. Is this something we can configure ourselves or does it need to be set on your side?
answer: Good question, and happy to help set this up. Quota warning thresholds aren't yet exposed in the self-service admin panel, but we can adjust it manually on our end for your workspace. I'll set it to 75% today and let you know once it's live; feel free to let us know if you'd like separate thresholds for backups versus general storage.

subject: Unsubscribe link in alert emails not working
body: One of our finance team members tried to unsubscribe from the weekly billing alert digest using the link at the bottom of the email, but clicking it just shows a blank page with no confirmation. She's still receiving the digest three days later. Could you check the unsubscribe flow for our workspace? This isn't urgent but we'd like it documented and fixed since a few other people have mentioned the same issue.
answer: Thank you for reporting this, I've logged it for our notifications team to review the unsubscribe link handling for digest emails. As a quick fix in the meantime, I can manually remove your colleague from the billing digest list if you send me her account email on file, and I'll follow up once we confirm the link issue is resolved.

subject: Mobile app crashes immediately on launch for all staff
body: Since this morning's update, our mobile app is crashing on launch for every device we've tested, both iOS and Android. Staff open the app, see the splash screen for about a second, and then it closes with no error message. We have 18 users who rely on this for store inventory checks and none of them can get past the splash screen right now. This is blocking our retail floor operations.
answer: I'm sorry for the disruption, this is clearly affecting your whole team so I've escalated this to P1 with our mobile engineering group immediately. Can you tell us the app version shown in your app store listing and whether anyone was able to log in before the update rolled out? We're also checking our crash reporting dashboard for your workspace right now to see if we can identify the failure point without needing device logs.

subject: Duplicate line items in email digest for finance team
body: Our weekly billing digest emails have started showing duplicate line items for the same invoice, sometimes listed three or four times in a row within the same email. This started with last Friday's digest and has continued for two send cycles now. It's confusing our finance reviewers since it looks like we're being billed multiple times for the same charge when we're not. With 115 people on this account relying on the digest for reconciliation, we need this fixed quickly.
answer: Thank you for the detailed report, this is impacting a large part of your team so I'm escalating it as P1 to our notifications team right away. It looks like a rendering issue in the digest template rather than an actual billing duplication, but we'll confirm that against your account ledger to be safe. Can you forward one of the affected digest emails so we can see exactly which invoice IDs are repeating?

subject: Backup retention policy not deleting old data past retention window
body: We noticed that files past our configured 90-day retention window are still present in storage and counting against our quota. Our workspace is now at 97% capacity and uploads are starting to fail with 'quota exceeded' errors for new backup jobs. This started roughly a week ago and is now blocking new backups entirely for our logistics operations team of 267. We need this resolved urgently since backups are failing in production right now.
answer: This is a critical issue and I'm escalating it immediately as P1 to our storage operations team since it's blocking production backups for your whole workspace. We're checking whether the retention job that should be purging data past 90 days has stalled or errored out, and will run a manual cleanup pass on our end to free up quota headroom while we investigate the root cause. I'll update you within the hour with findings.

subject: Requesting change to prevent duplicate alert emails
body: We've noticed our workspace occasionally sends two copies of the same alert email when a rule has both an email and webhook action configured. It's not happening on every alert, maybe 1 in 10, but it's enough that our team has started ignoring the second copy which isn't ideal. Could you look into a fix or workaround so we can safely rely on email delivery again, and maybe update the documentation to clarify expected behavior when multiple actions are set?
answer: Thanks for the clear writeup. This does sound like a known edge case where email and webhook actions on the same rule can occasionally both trigger a duplicate send under high load. We'll get this queued with engineering as a fix, and in the meantime I'll update our alerting documentation to call out this behavior explicitly so it's clearer for other admins.

subject: SAML login failing for subset of users after IdP update
body: After our identity provider pushed an update yesterday, some of our users are unable to log in via SAML SSO and get an error page saying 'SAML response signature validation failed'. Not everyone is affected, roughly 6 out of 24 users so far, and it seems to correlate with accounts that also have MFA enabled on the IdP side. We need this fixed soon since those users can't access their dashboards or reports today.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. A signature validation failure right after an IdP update usually means the SAML certificate or signing algorithm changed on their end and needs to be re-synced with your Northwind SSO configuration. Since this is currently blocking a subset of your users we're prioritizing it as P2; can you confirm whether your IdP rotated its signing certificate recently, and send us one affected user's login timestamp so we can check the exact SAML assertion in our logs?

subject: Alert routing not distributing notifications correctly
body: We've set up alert routing rules in Notifications so that critical alerts go to our admin group and low-priority ones go to a shared inbox, but for the past two days everything is landing in the same channel regardless of severity tag. This is affecting how our academy staff triage incoming system alerts during class hours. Could you check if something changed with the routing engine on your end? We have 10 seats configured and this is blocking our morning workflow.
answer: Thanks for flagging this, and I understand how disruptive this is to your morning workflow. We're seeing a known issue with the routing rules evaluation service that started rolling out yesterday, and our engineering team is already working on a fix. I'll escalate this as P1 on our side and update you within a few hours with either a fix timeline or a temporary workaround for severity-based routing.

subject: Need urgent restore from backup for storage bucket - compliance deadline
body: We accidentally overwrote a large batch of media assets in our production storage bucket (media-prod-eu-01) during a migration script run this morning around 09:40 UTC. We need to restore from the last known good backup, ideally the snapshot from yesterday at 22:00 UTC, before our compliance audit review tomorrow. Our current retention policy should have this snapshot available, but I don't see a restore option exposed in the API or console for our tier.
answer: This has been escalated to our compliance and storage engineering team given the audit deadline. Restore from backup for Enterprise accounts is available but requires our team to trigger it directly since it's not yet self-serve via API - we're locating the 22:00 UTC snapshot for media-prod-eu-01 now and will confirm the restore window shortly. I'll keep you updated every step given the time sensitivity here.

subject: Biometric login causing crashes on Android after latest update
body: Since the mobile app update rolled out last week, a significant number of our retail staff are reporting the app crashes immediately when they try to log in using fingerprint authentication on Android devices. It seems to happen most on devices running Android 13, and we're seeing this across multiple store locations. Push notifications also seem delayed for affected users after the crash, and some offline cached data isn't syncing properly once they finally get logged in.
answer: Thank you for the detailed report - this matches reports we've started receiving from other Android users and we've flagged it as a high priority issue with our mobile engineering team. We're prioritizing a hotfix for the biometric login crash on Android 13 devices, and I'll follow up with you directly once we have a build or workaround, likely within the next day. In the meantime, having affected staff use PIN or password login should avoid the crash.

subject: SSO role mapping broken - users getting wrong permissions after login
body: Starting this morning, users authenticating through our SSO provider are being assigned the wrong roles inside Northwind. Several staff who should have standard access are landing in admin groups, and others who need admin access are being denied entry to key dashboards. We haven't changed our SAML configuration or role mapping rules recently, so this seems to be happening on your side. This is a serious permissions issue affecting our whole workspace of 71 seats and needs immediate attention.
answer: I understand the urgency here given the permissions exposure this creates, and I've escalated this to our security and identity team as an active incident. We're reviewing recent changes to the SAML role mapping service to identify what triggered this shift, and in the meantime we strongly recommend temporarily disabling auto-provisioning for new logins to limit further incorrect role assignments. I'll update you within the hour with findings and a remediation plan.

subject: Wiederholte Fehler beim Hochladen großer Dateien
body: Seit letzter Woche bekomme ich beim Hochladen von Analysedateien über 2 GB regelmäßig einen Timeout-Fehler in der Storage-Konsole. Es betrifft hauptsächlich CSV-Exporte aus unserer Produktionsdatenbank, die wir wöchentlich sichern. Die Uploads brechen meist bei etwa 85 Prozent ab, und ich bin mir nicht sicher, ob das mit unserem aktuellen Speicherkontingent zusammenhängt oder ein allgemeines Problem ist.
answer: Danke für die genaue Beschreibung. Ein Timeout bei rund 85 Prozent deutet oft auf ein Verbindungsproblem bei größeren Dateien hin und nicht auf ein Kontingentlimit, aber wir prüfen das gerne für Ihr Konto. Können Sie uns die genaue Fehlermeldung sowie Datum und Uhrzeit eines betroffenen Uploads schicken, damit wir die Logs auf unserer Seite nachvollziehen können?

subject: SAML login broken after IdP metadata update - need fix or feature to auto-sync
body: We updated our identity provider's metadata last week and now SAML login through Northwind is failing for all users with an 'invalid signature' error. I've re-uploaded the metadata XML twice but the issue persists. Separately, we'd really like a feature where Northwind automatically pulls updated IdP metadata via URL rather than requiring manual re-uploads every time our certs rotate, since this keeps causing login outages for our team.
answer: Thanks for reporting this - a signature mismatch after an IdP metadata change usually means the certificate fingerprint wasn't fully refreshed on our end, so I'm escalating this to get your SAML config re-synced today given it's blocking all logins. I've also logged your request for metadata URL auto-sync as a feature request with our product team, as this is a common pain point we're actively considering for a future release.

subject: Upgrading from Starter to Pro plan - billing question
body: We're looking to upgrade from our current Starter plan to Pro to get more seats for our growing academy team, but when I try to change the plan in the billing settings, I get an error saying 'unable to process plan change at this time.' I also want to confirm whether we'd be prorated for the remainder of this billing cycle or charged the full new rate immediately.
answer: Happy to help with the upgrade! Plan changes are prorated based on your remaining billing cycle, so you'd only be charged the difference for the days left before your next renewal date. That error usually happens when there's a pending invoice on the account - I'm checking your billing status now and will follow up shortly with either a resolution or manual upgrade on our end.

subject: Incorrect seat count on latest invoice
body: Our invoice for this billing period shows charges for 92 seats, but we only have 79 active seats on our account according to the admin dashboard. This is the second month in a row with a discrepancy, and I need this corrected before we process payment since our finance team is asking questions. Can you review our account and issue a corrected invoice or refund for the overcharge?
answer: I'm sorry for the repeated billing discrepancy, that's not the experience we want for your finance team. I'm pulling up your account now to compare seat activity logs against the invoiced count for both billing periods, and if we confirm an overcharge we'll issue a corrected invoice along with a refund for the difference. I'll have an update for you within one business day.

subject: Okta app integration not provisioning users correctly
body: I'm setting up the Okta integration to provision users into Northwind automatically, but new users created in Okta aren't showing up in our Northwind workspace even after a manual sync trigger. The Okta app logs show a 200 response for the SCIM push, but nothing appears on our end. We also use Jira and Slack integrations already, and those are working fine, so I don't think it's a general connector issue.
answer: Thanks for the detailed troubleshooting - a 200 response from Okta with nothing appearing on our side usually points to a mapping mismatch in the SCIM schema for your app configuration. Could you send us the SCIM app ID and a sample payload from one of the failed provisioning attempts? Our integrations team will review it and get back to you with next steps.

subject: Need Slack alert integration set up before contract renewal review
body: We're integrating the Northwind API into our internal tools and want to route critical pipeline alerts directly into a Slack channel, similar to how we already send updates to Jira. This is a priority for us since our renewal review is coming up and we want to show the team the full integration setup working end to end, including Slack, Jira, and eventually Okta for provisioning. Can someone confirm the correct webhook endpoint and scopes needed for Slack alerting?
answer: Congrats on getting the full integration stack in motion - happy to help get Slack alerting working before your renewal review. For Slack alerts, you'll need to use our /integrations/slack/webhook endpoint with the alerts:write scope enabled on your API key; I'll send over a sample payload and setup guide today so your team has time to test it before the review.

subject: Push notifications causing crashes and login loop on mobile app
body: We're seeing a spike in crash reports tied to push notifications on the Northwind mobile app since yesterday around 2pm. Users tap the notification, the app opens, then crashes back to the login screen. This has hit at least 40 of our field staff across three regional offices so far. Device logs show the crash happening right after the push payload is processed, on both iOS and Android builds.
answer: Thanks for flagging this, we're treating it as a P2 incident given the number of affected users. Could you send us a couple of crash logs or device IDs from the affected staff so our mobile team can correlate them with our push service logs from yesterday afternoon? In the meantime, disabling rich push previews in app settings has helped some customers avoid the crash-to-login loop as a workaround.

subject: Fehler beim Upgrade des Abrechnungsplans - doppelte Abbuchung
body: Wir haben gestern versucht, unseren Starter-Plan auf einen höheren Tarif upzugraden, aber der Vorgang wurde offenbar zweimal verarbeitet. Auf unserer Kreditkartenabrechnung sehen wir jetzt zwei Buchungen für denselben Betrag vom 14. März. Die Rechnung Nr. INV-20441 zeigt weiterhin den alten Plan an, obwohl das Geld zweimal abgebucht wurde. Können Sie das bitte prüfen und eine der Buchungen erstatten?
answer: Danke für die Meldung, das tut uns leid. Wir sehen uns die Zahlungsprotokolle zu Rechnung INV-20441 sofort an und klären, ob es sich um eine doppelte Autorisierung oder eine tatsächliche doppelte Abbuchung handelt. Sobald wir das bestätigt haben, veranlassen wir die Rückerstattung des doppelten Betrags und aktualisieren Ihren Plan-Status entsprechend.

subject: File uploads failing for all users in Storage
body: Since this morning our staff can't upload any files larger than about 20MB to Storage, the progress bar stalls at around 80% and then shows 'upload failed, please retry'. We checked our quota and we're only using 3GB of our allotted space, so it doesn't look like a limit issue. This is blocking our teachers from submitting course materials before the term deadline tomorrow.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report, we're looking into this as a service issue affecting uploads over 20MB. Our team has identified elevated error rates on the storage ingestion service starting around 9am today and is actively working on a fix. We'll post an update here as soon as uploads are stable again, and we'll follow up directly once resolved so you can confirm on your end.

subject: PDF export from dashboard cuts off charts
body: When we export our operations dashboard to PDF, the bar charts on the right side of the page get cut off and the legend is missing entirely. This started happening after we added a third chart panel last week. We rely on these exports for our weekly leadership review, and right now the file is unusable since half the data isn't visible.
answer: Thank you for the details. This looks related to how the export renderer handles dashboards with three or more chart panels in a single row. As a workaround, try switching to the two-column layout before exporting, which should keep the charts and legends intact. We're logging this as a known export rendering issue and will update you once a permanent fix is available.

subject: help
body: Cant share dashboard w/ teammate, says no permission
answer: Sorry for the trouble, let's get this sorted. Can you confirm your teammate's role in the workspace and whether the dashboard was originally created by you or shared with you by someone else? In the meantime, check under Dashboard Settings > Sharing that 'Allow re-sharing' is enabled, as that's a common cause of this permission error.

subject: Urgent: need clarity on upcoming API v1 deprecations
body: We just received a notice that several v1 endpoints we depend on, including /v1/customers/list and /v1/webhooks/register, are being deprecated next month. Our integration team needs to know the exact sunset date and whether the v2 equivalents have the same rate limits, since we're currently making around 50,000 calls per day against these endpoints. This affects our production booking pipeline and we need to plan the migration this week.
answer: Thanks for reaching out, and I understand the urgency here. The sunset date for /v1/customers/list and /v1/webhooks/register is set for the 30th of next month, and the v2 equivalents carry the same default rate limit tier as your current plan. I'm attaching a link to our migration guide with side-by-side endpoint mappings, and I'll get one of our platform engineers to follow up directly today given the volume you're running through these endpoints.

subject: Offline mode crashing app for large portion of staff
body: Our field teams rely heavily on offline mode in the mobile app since many of our clinics have unreliable connectivity. Since the latest app update, switching into offline mode causes the app to crash immediately for a large number of users, we estimate over 300 reports across our clinics in the last two days. When connectivity returns and the app tries to sync, some users are also getting logged out entirely, which means they lose unsaved patient intake data.
answer: This is a serious issue and we're escalating it to P1 immediately given the scale and the data loss risk. Our mobile engineering team is already investigating a crash pattern tied to the offline sync module introduced in the latest release. Please avoid switching devices into offline mode until we confirm a fix, and if any staff have already lost intake data, let us know the approximate timestamps so we can check if a partial sync was captured server-side.

subject: Feature request: better offline mode indicators
body: Our drivers use the mobile app in areas with patchy signal, and it's often unclear whether the app is actually in offline mode or just struggling to connect. It would help a lot if there was a clear banner or icon showing offline status, plus a way to see which actions are queued for sync. Not urgent, just something that would improve daily usability for our dispatch team.
answer: Thanks for the suggestion, this is great feedback for our mobile product team. A clearer offline status indicator and a queued-actions view are both reasonable asks, and I'll pass this along to the roadmap discussion for offline mode improvements. I'll keep this ticket open and update you if we schedule this for an upcoming release.

subject: Deactivated users still showing as active in audit log
body: I deactivated around 60 users from our retail division in the Admin Console yesterday as part of a routine cleanup, but the audit log still shows them as 'active' and they're still appearing on our allowlist for API access. One of them, user ID U-88213, was able to generate an API token this morning after being deactivated, which is a serious access control problem for us given our size.
answer: Thank you for reporting this, we're treating it as a P1 given the access control implications. We've confirmed a delay between the deactivation flag and allowlist sync in the console, and are pushing a fix to close that gap now. In the meantime, please send us the full list of the 60 deactivated user IDs so we can manually verify and revoke any active tokens, including U-88213, right away.

subject: Hitting rate limits constantly on API Platform
body: We're on the Starter plan and our booking sync script keeps hitting 429 errors even though we're only making around 200 requests per hour, which seems well below what I'd expect for rate limits. The error message just says 'rate limit exceeded, try again later' with no indication of our current usage or reset time. Is there a way to see our actual quota and whether this is a bug on your end?
answer: Thanks for the report, 200 requests per hour shouldn't be triggering rate limit errors on the Starter tier, so this does sound like a bug rather than expected throttling. Could you share the API key prefix and a couple of timestamps where you saw the 429s? We'll check our rate limiter logs for irregular counting on your account and get back to you with the actual quota details in the meantime.

subject: Repeated transform failures in billing pipeline
body: I'm the finance manager at Vertex Systems and I've noticed our nightly transform job "billing-rollup-v3" has failed 14 times between March 3 and March 9. The error log shows "TransformError: null value in column 'invoice_total' violates not-null constraint" on rows coming from our ERP connector. This is delaying our month-end close and we need the sync to be reliable again. Could you also point us to documentation on how to configure retry/latency thresholds for this connector?
answer: Thanks for flagging this — we can see the failed runs on billing-rollup-v3 and are escalating to the pipelines team to trace the null invoice_total issue in the ERP connector mapping. In the meantime we'll send over the connector documentation covering retry and latency settings, and will update you once we've identified whether this is a source-side data quality issue or a mapping bug on our end.

subject: Biometric login intermittently failing on iOS app
body: We've had a couple of users at Summit Media report that Face ID login on the Northwind mobile app sometimes doesn't unlock the session and just returns to the password screen. It's not happening every time, maybe 1 in 5 attempts, and only on iOS 17 devices so far. Wanted to flag it for tracking even though it's not blocking anyone since password login still works fine.
answer: Thanks for the heads up — this sounds like an intermittent issue with the biometric token refresh on iOS 17 rather than a full outage, so we've logged it for our mobile team to investigate. Since password login is working as a fallback we'll treat this as low priority for now, but please let us know if the frequency increases or if it starts affecting more users.

subject: Okta integration broken - users can't SSO into Northwind
body: Our Okta app integration for Northwind stopped working this morning. Users clicking the Northwind tile in Okta get redirected to a blank page with "Error: invalid_client" in the URL. This is affecting all 267 seats at North Labs, we rely on this for daily access including Slack and Jira handoffs from our dashboards. We haven't changed anything on our Okta side recently. Please advise urgently, this is blocking our whole team from logging in.
answer: This is being escalated immediately given the scope of impact. The invalid_client error typically points to a mismatch or expiration on the client credentials configured in the Okta app — we're checking our SSO integration logs now to confirm whether the client secret was rotated on our end. We'll update you within the hour with either a fix or a workaround so your team can regain access.

subject: SAML login failing for some users after MFA
body: We're seeing an issue where users at Pioneer Partners who have MFA enabled get stuck after entering their SAML credentials — the login redirects back to our IdP with no error message, but Northwind never completes the session. It's affecting maybe 15-20 users out of 101 seats, mostly ones provisioned in the last two weeks. Users without MFA are logging in fine. Can you check if there's a permissions or provisioning issue on newly created accounts tied to MFA enforcement?
answer: Thanks for the detailed breakdown — the pattern with newly provisioned accounts and MFA suggests the SAML assertion for those users may be missing a required attribute mapping, which would explain the silent redirect loop. We're pulling the SSO logs for a sample of the affected accounts now and will confirm whether this is a provisioning timing issue or an attribute configuration gap, and follow up with next steps.

subject: How to route Slack alerts to specific channels
body: We'd like to change how our Slack integration routes alerts — currently everything from Northwind goes to one #alerts channel, but we want billing alerts and Jira sync notifications split into separate channels. Is this something we configure from the Integrations settings page, or does it require reconfiguring the Slack app itself? Documentation would be helpful if you have a guide on channel routing rules.
answer: You can set this up from the Integrations page under the Slack connector settings — there's a routing rules section where you can map alert categories (like billing or Jira sync) to specific channel IDs without touching the Slack app configuration itself. I'll attach our how-to guide on configuring routing rules, and happy to walk through it live if you'd like a quick call.

subject: Mobile app crashes immediately on launch for our team
body: Since yesterday, several people at Blue Legal have reported the Northwind mobile app crashing right after the splash screen, before the login page even loads. It's happening on both Android and iOS for at least 3 of our 4 users. We tried reinstalling the app twice with no change. This is blocking our team from checking notifications and dashboards on the go, so we'd appreciate a quick look.
answer: Sorry for the disruption this is causing — a crash before the login screen on both platforms points to something in the app's initial config fetch rather than a device-specific issue, so we're escalating this to our mobile engineering team now. Could you send us the app version numbers from each affected device and, if possible, a crash log from one iOS and one Android device? That will help us pinpoint the cause quickly.

subject: Storage quota exceeded during document upload
body: I'm integrating our document intake service with the Northwind Storage API and started getting "413 Quota Exceeded: storage limit reached for account" responses on uploads starting today around 9:40 AM. We're on the Pro plan and haven't been notified of approaching any limit. This is blocking our backup retention job for legal case files, which needs to run daily. Can you check our current usage against quota and let us know if this is a bug or an actual limit we've hit?
answer: Thanks for reporting this — we're checking your account's storage usage against the provisioned quota now to determine whether this is a genuine limit being hit or a metering issue on our side, given you weren't notified in advance. Since this affects your daily retention job, we're prioritizing this and will confirm within a few hours; in the meantime we'd recommend pausing the automated upload job to avoid partial writes until we've confirmed the root cause.

subject: Änderung der IP-Allowlist im Admin Console
body: Wir möchten die IP-Allowlist für unseren Workspace bei Vertex Capital anpassen, da sich unser Büro-Standort geändert hat. Aktuell sind nur zwei alte IP-Bereiche eingetragen und wir brauchen zusätzlich unseren neuen VPN-Ausgangsbereich. Können Sie uns sagen, ob diese Änderung im Audit Log sichtbar wird und ob bestehende Sessions davon betroffen sind, wenn wir die Einstellung speichern?
answer: Vielen Dank für die Anfrage — Sie können die IP-Allowlist selbst unter den Admin Console Einstellungen im Bereich Sicherheit anpassen, neue Bereiche hinzufügen ist sofort wirksam und wird im Audit Log mit Zeitstempel und ausführendem Benutzer protokolliert. Bestehende Sessions werden dadurch nicht automatisch beendet, neue Anmeldeversuche von nicht gelisteten IPs werden aber ab Speicherung blockiert, daher empfehlen wir den neuen VPN-Bereich vor dem Entfernen der alten Einträge zu testen.

subject: URGENT pipeline down - late arriving data breaking everything
body: we have a major problm rite now, our data pipline for shipment tracking has stoped procesing late-arriving records since aprox 2am and now we have over 40,000 rows stuck in the staging tabel not flowing to the warehoue. our ops team cant see any updated delivery statuses and this is a full outage for us, customers are calling asking wher there orders are. the connector status shows RED and last succesful run was 01:52am. please help asap this is costing us money every minute
answer: We understand the severity and have escalated this to P0 immediately — a member of our pipelines on-call team is actively investigating the connector failure that started at 01:52am and the backlog of staged records. We'll share an initial update within 30 minutes on root cause and a plan to reprocess the stuck rows once the connector is restored; we'll keep this ticket updated continuously until service is fully recovered.

subject: Dashboard charts showing broken/blank data
body: Several of our shared dashboards at Quill Energy have started showing blank chart areas instead of the usual bar and line charts since this morning. The dashboard titled "Fleet Utilization Overview" that we share with 24 users just shows a loading spinner that never resolves. Refreshing the page doesn't help and it's happening in both Chrome and Firefox. Can you check if this is a broader rendering issue?
answer: Thanks for reporting this — we're checking whether this is tied to a broader rendering issue affecting shared dashboards, since a spinner that never resolves usually points to a data query timeout rather than a display bug. We'll investigate the Fleet Utilization Overview dashboard specifically and get back to you shortly with either a fix or more details on what's causing the charts to fail to load.

subject: Biometric login not working offline on mobile app
body:
I'm the finance manager at Orion Partners and I use Face ID to log into the Northwind mobile app every morning before I have wifi on the train. For the past week, when I'm offline, the app crashes right after the biometric prompt instead of loading my dashboard. It works fine once I have a data connection again, so it seems tied to offline mode specifically.

Can you confirm whether biometric login is supposed to work without connectivity, or is that a limitation? Also curious if push notifications for approvals still queue up while offline.
answer:
Thanks for the detailed report. Biometric login is designed to work offline for cached sessions, so the crash you're seeing on the train isn't expected behavior — it sounds like the local session cache may be getting invalidated before the app can validate it against a stale token. Could you send us the app version and device OS from Settings > About so we can reproduce this on our side?

In the meantime, push notifications for approvals do queue locally and will sync once you're back online, so you shouldn't lose any of those. We'll follow up once we've narrowed down the offline crash.

subject: Incorrect line items on last two invoices
body:
I handle billing for Pioneer Robotics and noticed our invoices for September and October both show a charge for 76 seats plus an extra line labeled 'Overage - API calls' that we don't recognize. We haven't changed our seat count or usage patterns recently, and this is the first time we've seen this overage line appear.

Could someone check whether this was billed in error? We'd like a corrected invoice or a refund for the overage amount if it's not accurate, since it's affecting our monthly reconciliation.
answer: Thank you for flagging this — I understand this is holding up your reconciliation. I'm pulling up the billing history for Pioneer Robotics now to check what triggered the API overage line on the September and October invoices, since your seat count hasn't changed. I'll confirm within one business day whether this was billed correctly or needs to be reversed, and if it's an error we'll issue a refund and corrected invoices right away.

subject: Push notifications completely broken since this morning - all users affected
body:
I'm a support engineer at Summit Energy and starting around 8am today, none of our 8 users are receiving push notifications on the mobile app for new comments or assignments. We've confirmed notification permissions are enabled on all devices and the app is up to date on both iOS and Android.

This is blocking our editorial team from getting real-time alerts during a live event we're covering today. Can you escalate this urgently? We also noticed a login prompt appears randomly even when sessions should still be valid.
answer: This is escalated as high priority given the live event impact. We're seeing reports of a push delivery delay affecting a subset of accounts since this morning and our mobile team is actively investigating the notification service; we'll update you within the hour with a status. On the random login prompt, that may be a related session token issue — please let us know if it recurs after the notification fix lands, as it could be tied to the same root cause.

subject: Storage retention policy deleting files early
body:
I'm a support engineer at Summit Labs and we set our storage retention policy to 90 days, but files uploaded on July 10th were already purged as of yesterday, well short of that window. We've confirmed this with three separate files across two different projects, all showing 'deleted per retention policy' in the audit log dated August 20th.

This is a problem for us since we need those files for a compliance review next week. Can someone check our retention configuration and confirm whether this is a bug or a misconfiguration on our end?
answer: Thanks for the specific dates and audit log details, that's very helpful. This does sound like a retention calculation issue rather than a config problem on your end, since 90 days from July 10th would put deletion in October, not August. We're escalating this to our storage team now to check if there's a bug affecting retention windows, and we'll prioritize recovering the deleted files from our backup layer given your compliance deadline next week.

subject: Feature request: Slack notifications from Okta integration app
body:
I'm a data analyst at Atlas Retail and we recently set up the Northwind Okta app for SSO provisioning. It's working well, but we'd love the ability to route provisioning events (new user created, deprovisioned) into a Slack channel instead of just email, similar to how some other integrations handle it.

Is this on the roadmap? Right now we're manually checking the Okta admin logs weekly to catch changes, which isn't ideal for our compliance tracking.
answer: Thanks for the feedback and for the context on your compliance workflow — this is a reasonable ask and one we've heard from a few other customers using the Okta app. Slack routing for provisioning events isn't available today, but I'm logging this as a feature request with our integrations team. In the meantime, I'd recommend setting up an email-to-Slack forwarding rule as a workaround so you're not stuck checking logs manually each week.

subject: Users getting logged out every 15 minutes
body:
I'm a support engineer at Lumen Analytics and several of our team members are being logged out of the Northwind dashboard roughly every 15 minutes, even during active use. We haven't changed any SSO or session settings recently on our end. MFA prompts also seem to trigger again after each timeout, which is slowing everyone down.

Is there a session duration setting we can adjust, or documentation on how timeout and MFA re-prompting interact? Happy to share our current SSO config if useful.
answer: Thanks for reaching out — a 15 minute session length does sound shorter than our default, which is typically set to a few hours unless configured otherwise. This is likely tied to a session timeout value in your SSO configuration rather than a bug, so it would help to see your current settings. I'm attaching a link to our documentation on session and MFA re-prompt behavior, and once we see your config we can advise on the right value to extend session length.

subject: Duplicate alerts and wrong routing after Notifications API update
body:
I'm integrating the Notifications API for Delta Foods and since deploying against the latest API version last Thursday, every alert we send is being delivered twice to email recipients, and some alerts meant for our 'ops-critical' channel are routing to 'ops-general' instead. We're sending roughly 4,000 alerts a day across 293 seats, so this is generating a lot of noise and confusion for on-call staff.

Here's a sample of the routing config we're using for the ops-critical channel: {"channel": "ops-critical", "priority": "high", "dedupe": true}. Dedupe is enabled but clearly not working. Can you help urgently, this is affecting our production alerting?
answer: This is a serious issue given your alert volume and we're treating it as high priority. The duplicate delivery despite dedupe being enabled points to a possible regression in how the dedupe key is being generated after the recent API update, and the misrouting to ops-general suggests a channel mapping issue on the same deploy. Can you send us a sample payload and the request ID for one of the duplicated alerts so we can trace it through our logs immediately? We'll keep you updated as we investigate.

subject: Need higher rate limits for API Platform
body:
I'm the workspace admin for Cobalt Freight and we're consistently hitting 429 rate limit errors on our API integration, especially during our morning batch sync around 6am. We're on 23 seats and our current limit seems too low for the volume of shipment records we process daily.

Could you let us know what it would take to raise our rate limit, and also whether the older REST SDK we're using is being deprecated soon? We want to plan ahead if we need to migrate to a newer SDK version.
answer: Thanks for flagging both of these — I can see the 429s coming through around your 6am sync window in our logs. I'll get a rate limit increase request submitted for your account and follow up with the new limit once approved, likely within a day or two. On the SDK question, the older REST SDK is on a deprecation path with sunset planned for later this year, so I'd recommend starting to plan a migration; I'll send over our migration guide and timeline in a follow-up.

subject: Scheduled sync jobs failing intermittently for two connectors
body:
I'm the finance manager at Willow Systems and our nightly scheduled syncs for the Salesforce and NetSuite connectors have been failing intermittently since Tuesday. About 1 in 3 runs errors out with 'connection timeout after 300s' and the ones that do succeed are showing incomplete record counts compared to source, off by roughly 40-60 records each time.

We rely on these syncs for month-end close and this data quality issue is a real concern. Can someone look into why these two connectors specifically are having latency problems?
answer: Thank you for the specifics on the timeout errors and record count discrepancies — that's very useful for tracking this down. We're looking into whether there's a latency issue on the Salesforce and NetSuite connector endpoints specifically, since a timeout after 300s combined with partial record counts suggests the sync is being cut off mid-run rather than failing cleanly. Given your month-end close timeline, we're prioritizing this and will update you within the day with findings on the root cause.

subject: Guidance needed on restoring storage from backup for large dataset
body:
I'm a data analyst at Summit Foods and we need to restore a subset of our storage data from a backup taken on November 3rd after some files were overwritten by an automated job. Given our data volume across 2107 seats, I want to understand the process, expected restore time, and whether restoring will count against our storage quota temporarily during the operation.

Could you walk us through the steps or point us to documentation for enterprise-scale restores? We'd like to schedule this carefully to avoid disrupting other teams.
answer: Thanks for the clear details — restoring from a November 3rd backup at your scale is something our team can help coordinate directly rather than a fully self-serve flow, given the data volume involved. Restored data will temporarily count against your storage quota during the operation, though we can work with you to request a temporary quota increase if needed to avoid impacting other teams. I'll send over our enterprise restore documentation and set up a time to walk through scheduling this with minimal disruption.

subject: Need bulk MFA enrolment reset for 86 users before Monday rollout
body: We're rolling out mandatory MFA for all 86 seats at Pioneer Analytics starting Monday and about a third of our staff are stuck at the enrolment screen with 'Unable to generate QR code, error code AUTH-4471'. This is blocking our travel desk agents from logging in during peak booking hours. Can someone help us bulk-reset the enrolment state or push a temporary bypass while we investigate? We need this resolved before shift start tomorrow at 6am.
answer: Thanks for flagging this urgently - I'm escalating to our Identity team right now given the rollout deadline. AUTH-4471 usually points to a clock-drift issue between our MFA service and the client device, but with this many users affected simultaneously we'll check for a service-side cause first. In the meantime I can issue a 24-hour MFA grace-period bypass for the affected accounts so your agents aren't locked out - please confirm and send the list of affected usernames and I'll apply it immediately.

subject: Shared dashboards showing 'access denied' for viewer role users
body: I'm integrating our reporting into the Cobalt Health workspace and set up a dashboard shared with 'viewer' permissions to five colleagues. Since yesterday, three of the five get 'Error 403: You do not have permission to view this resource' when opening the link, even though their role hasn't changed in the admin panel. The dashboard itself loads fine for me as the owner and for the other two viewers. This is blocking our weekly media performance review this afternoon.
answer: Sorry for the disruption ahead of your review - this looks like a permission propagation issue on our end rather than something wrong with your sharing setup. Can you confirm the exact dashboard ID and the three affected user emails so I can check the permission sync logs? In the meantime, removing and re-adding those three viewers from the share list has resolved this for other customers as a quick workaround while we dig into the root cause.

subject: SCIM sync creating duplicate user records after last update
body: Since Tuesday our SCIM provisioning from Azure AD to Northwind has started creating duplicate accounts for the same employee - we now have 6 duplicated records showing different login emails (one with a trailing dot, one without). This is causing confusion in billing since we're only meant to have 22 seats and now Northwind shows 28 active users. Can you help us identify and merge these duplicates without losing existing role assignments?
answer: Thank you for the detailed report - duplicate SCIM records tied to email normalization is a known edge case we're looking into. I can manually merge the 6 duplicated accounts on our side once you confirm which of the two email formats should be treated as canonical for each user. I'll also flag your tenant so we can monitor the next scheduled sync and make sure it doesn't recreate the duplicates.

subject: Request to add page-size options for PDF dashboard exports
body: Our team at Orion Media regularly exports dashboards to PDF for board reporting, and right now the export only supports A4 sized output. For our healthcare compliance reports we need Letter and Legal sizing to match our other documentation templates. Could this be added as a configurable export option in a future release? We can work around it manually for now but it would save considerable formatting time each quarter.
answer: Thanks for the suggestion - this is a reasonable gap and I've logged it as a feature request with our Dashboards product team, referencing your account for context on the use case. There's no committed timeline yet, but I'll update this ticket when page-size options for PDF export move into active development. In the meantime, exporting to PNG and resizing in your document editor is the closest workaround available today.

subject: help
body: SAML login broken for all 285 users, getting stuck at redirect.
answer: This sounds serious given the number of users affected, so I'm treating it as high priority. Can you tell me what error appears at the redirect step - a blank page, a specific error code, or a loop back to the identity provider login? While I wait to hear back, I'm also pulling the SAML assertion logs for Quill Academy's tenant to check for a certificate or metadata mismatch on our end.

subject: Sessions expiring every few minutes across all admin accounts
body: Starting about an hour ago, every admin session at Harbor Capital is timing out after roughly 2-3 minutes of activity, forcing repeated re-logins. This started right after we noticed an unfamiliar login attempt from an unrecognized IP in our audit log at 14:12 UTC. We're worried this could be a security incident rather than a bug, and with only 7 seats this is affecting our entire admin team's ability to work. Please advise urgently.
answer: This has been escalated immediately to our Security and Compliance team given the potential security concern. As a precaution we're temporarily reducing session lifetimes and forcing re-authentication for all Harbor Capital accounts while we investigate the login attempt you flagged - this is likely the cause of the timeouts you're seeing, not a separate bug. I'll follow up within the hour with findings on that IP and next steps to secure the account.

subject: Approaching storage quota, need upload guidance
body: Our Storage usage at Apex Partners is sitting at 92% of our allocated quota and we still have this month's logistics backup batch to upload, roughly 40GB of shipment data. I'd like to understand our options before we hit the limit and uploads start failing - is there a way to see a breakdown of what's consuming the most space, and can we request a temporary quota increase while we clean up old files?
answer: Good timing to reach out before hitting the ceiling. You can see a per-folder breakdown of storage usage under Storage > Usage Report, which should help identify what's safe to archive or delete. I can also apply a temporary quota bump of 50GB for the next 30 days to cover this month's backup batch - let me know if that works and I'll have it applied within the next business day.

subject: Scheduled sync running an hour later than configured
body: We have a nightly scheduled sync configured for our legal document connector at Willow Systems, set to run at 01:00 UTC, but for the past four nights it's actually been kicking off closer to 02:00. Data eventually arrives correctly, so this isn't blocking us, but it's throwing off downstream jobs that depend on the timing. Wanted to flag it in case there's a scheduling delay on your end worth documenting.
answer: Thanks for flagging this - a consistent one-hour delay suggests a queueing issue during that time window rather than a one-off glitch. I'll check the pipeline scheduler logs for your connector over the past four nights to see what's causing the delay, and update the sync documentation if we find a broader pattern affecting other customers. I'll follow up with findings, though since it's not currently blocking your data delivery we'll treat this as lower priority.

subject: Dashboard load times over 20 seconds for retail team
body: Several dashboards used daily by our Atlas Systems retail analytics team have become noticeably slower over the past week, now taking 15-20 seconds to fully render charts that used to load in 2-3 seconds. This is impacting 268 seats worth of users during peak morning reporting hours. Could you help investigate whether this is a data volume issue on our end or a platform-side performance problem, and let us know if there are optimization options like chart-level caching we could enable?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report - with this many users impacted during peak hours I'm prioritizing this. Can you share one or two specific dashboard IDs that are worst affected so we can check query execution times and rendering logs? We do have optional chart-level caching that can be enabled per dashboard, which often helps significantly with repeated high-traffic views, and I'll walk you through enabling it once we've confirmed the underlying bottleneck.

subject: PDF export missing chart legends
body: When exporting our fintech overview dashboard to PDF this morning, the resulting file is missing the legends on two of the four charts, even though they display correctly on screen. This happened on our monthly report due to go out to stakeholders today, so we had to manually annotate the PDF as a workaround. Wanted to report this as it seems like a rendering bug specific to the PDF export path.
answer: Sorry this caused extra work right before your report deadline. This does sound like a rendering bug in the PDF export pipeline rather than anything on your end - could you let me know which two chart types were missing legends (bar, line, pie, etc.) so I can try to reproduce it? I'll log this as a bug for our Dashboards team and keep you posted on a fix timeline.

subject: Broken
body:
our marketing dashboards stopped rendering charts this morning around 8am. every bar and line chart is just a blank white box, the legends show up but no data. this is happening across all 22 seats, we use these dashboards daily to track campaign spend for our media team. exports are also failing with a generic error when i try to download as PNG.

i already tried clearing cache and switching browsers (chrome and edge) but same result. can someone check the dashboard rendering service on your end?
answer:
Thanks for the detailed report, and sorry for the disruption this is causing your team. We can see elevated error rates on the chart rendering service starting around 08:10 UTC and our engineers are actively working on a fix now. I'll update this ticket as soon as we have a resolution or a workaround for exports.

In the meantime, if any charts are still rendering with cached data that could help you get through the day, please let us know and we'll prioritize those dashboard IDs.

subject: Uploads failing intermittently to storage buckets
body:
We're seeing upload failures on our Storage buckets since yesterday afternoon. About 1 in 5 file uploads from our media processing job fail with a timeout error, and retries usually succeed on the second or third attempt. We're on the Starter plan with 14 seats and this is affecting our media asset pipeline for Willow Energy.

Can you tell us if there's a quota limit we're close to hitting, or if this is a known issue with the upload endpoint? We'd also like to know our current retention settings since we're not sure how long failed upload attempts are logged.
answer:
Thanks for flagging this. Intermittent upload timeouts like you're describing are sometimes tied to approaching storage quota thresholds, so I'm checking your account's current usage against the Starter plan limits now. I'll also pull the retention settings for your workspace and confirm those in my next reply.

In the meantime, could you share a couple of request IDs or timestamps from the failed uploads? That will help us pinpoint whether this is quota-related or an issue on our upload service side.

subject: Offline mode is completely useless and now login is broken too
body:
This is beyond frustrating. We rolled out the mobile app to our warehouse staff specifically because we were told offline mode would let them log freight scans without connectivity. It does NOT work - the app just spins and loses all scan data the second signal drops, we've lost three days of inventory counts already.

On top of that, half our drivers can't even log back in after the app crashes, they get stuck on the login screen indefinitely. We are seriously considering canceling our contract if this isn't fixed immediately, we have 12 seats and this is a core workflow for Summit Freight.
answer:
I completely understand the frustration, losing three days of scan data is a serious problem and I'm escalating this to our mobile engineering team as a P1 right now. To move fast, could you tell us the exact app version your devices are running and roughly how many users are hitting the login-after-crash issue?

We'll investigate the offline data loss and the login lockout together since they may be related, and I'll follow up with next steps within the next few hours rather than let this sit.

subject: Question about storage quota and backup retention
body:
We're approaching what looks like our storage quota limit on the Pro plan and I want to understand our options before we hit a hard wall. Currently showing around 92% usage according to the admin panel. We have automated backups running nightly for our legal document repository across 146 seats.

Could you clarify how backup retention interacts with quota - do older backup snapshots count against our total storage, and is there a way to adjust retention period to free up space without losing compliance-required history?
answer:
Good question, and glad you're checking this proactively. Yes, backup snapshots do count toward your total storage quota, so as retention windows grow the older snapshots can add up. For Pro plan accounts you can adjust the retention period from the Storage settings under Backup Policy, which will let you trim older snapshots while keeping recent ones intact.

If you need to retain history for compliance beyond what fits your quota, we can also discuss an add-on storage tier - let me know your target retention window and I'll put together the options.

subject: Transform step failures in logistics data pipeline
body:
We're seeing repeated failures in one of our Data Pipelines transform steps that aggregates shipment status updates from three connectors. Since Tuesday, roughly 15-20% of runs fail with a data type mismatch error on the 'eta_timestamp' field, even though the source schema hasn't changed on our end.

The pipeline ID is pipe-7734-transform-eta. Latency on successful runs has also crept up from ~4 minutes to over 20 minutes. This is affecting downstream reporting for our logistics ops team who rely on near-real-time ETA updates across 452 users.
answer:
Thanks for the specifics, pipeline pipe-7734-transform-eta and the eta_timestamp mismatch are enough for us to start digging into logs immediately. Type mismatches like this can occur when a connector silently changes timestamp formatting upstream, so we're checking the recent connector payloads alongside the transform logic.

We'll also look into the latency increase, since a shift from 4 to 20+ minutes suggests something in the pipeline's resource allocation or a queuing issue. I'll update you within the next few hours with findings on both.

subject: SAML login failures for subset of users
body:
We're seeing intermittent SAML SSO login failures affecting a subset of our users since this morning. Error shown to users is 'SAML response validation failed - assertion expired' even though their clocks and our IdP timestamps appear synced. This is impacting maybe 200-300 of our 1371 seats, not everyone, which is odd.

Our IdP is configured with the standard 5 minute assertion window. Can your team check if there's clock drift on Northwind's SSO service side, or if something changed with SAML assertion validation recently?
answer:
Thanks for the detailed error message, that helps a lot. An 'assertion expired' error affecting only a subset of users often points to load balancer or node-level clock drift on our end rather than your IdP, so we're checking timestamp sync across our SSO service instances now.

While we investigate, could you let us know if the affected users are concentrated on a particular region or login flow (browser vs mobile)? That will help us narrow down which service nodes to check first.

subject: Seat count adjustment needed before renewal
body:
I'm reviewing our upcoming invoice and need to reduce our seat count from 20 to 15 before the next billing cycle starts on the 1st. We had extra staff during a seasonal enrollment push for Pioneer Retail but that period has ended and we're now overpaying for unused seats.

Could you confirm how the seat reduction will be reflected on our next invoice, and whether we're eligible for any credit or refund for the seats that have gone unused since last month?
answer:
Thanks for reaching out ahead of your renewal date, that gives us time to process this properly. I've submitted a request to reduce your seat count from 20 to 15 effective your next billing cycle, and this will be reflected as an adjusted line item on your upcoming invoice.

Regarding a refund for unused seats from last month, since that period has already been invoiced I'll need to check with our billing team on eligibility for a partial credit and will follow up with you directly on that within one business day.

subject: Duplicate email alerts from notification routing
body:
Our team has noticed that certain alert notifications are being sent twice via email over the past week. It seems to happen specifically with alerts routed to our 'ops-critical' channel, where the same alert (identical timestamp and message) arrives in two separate emails a few seconds apart. Other channels seem fine.

This is a minor annoyance rather than urgent, but wanted to flag it since it's causing some confusion among our media team about whether an issue is new or a repeat. Happy to share screenshots of the duplicate emails if useful.
answer:
Thanks for the clear description, this is helpful. Duplicate deliveries limited to a single routing rule usually point to a misconfigured retry or a rule matching the same alert twice, so we'll take a close look at the 'ops-critical' channel routing config on your account.

Screenshots showing the timestamps would be great to confirm this isn't a display issue on your end. We'll investigate and get back to you with a fix or configuration correction shortly.

subject: Scheduled syncs falling hours behind, needs escalation
body:
I'm a support engineer on our side and need to escalate an ongoing issue with scheduled data pipeline syncs. Three of our nightly syncs (connector IDs conn-2291, conn-2294, conn-2310) have been running 4-6 hours late for the past four nights, causing our downstream healthcare reporting dashboards to show stale data each morning.

We've checked our own connector credentials and rate limits and everything looks normal on our side. Given this affects reporting across our 1371-seat deployment and is now a recurring pattern rather than a one-off, we need this escalated and investigated urgently.
answer:
Escalating this immediately given the recurring pattern across conn-2291, conn-2294, and conn-2310 over four consecutive nights. This has been flagged as P1 and assigned to our pipeline reliability team, who will begin by checking scheduler queue times and resource contention during your sync windows.

We'll provide an update within a few hours with initial findings, and in the meantime if you can share the exact scheduled start times versus actual start times for the last two nights, that will help speed up root cause analysis.

subject: PDF export broken on compliance dashboards
body:
Our compliance team is unable to export dashboards to PDF as of this morning, which is blocking a scheduled audit submission due today. Clicking export returns 'Export failed - rendering timeout' after about 30 seconds, tested on three different dashboards with charts that previously exported fine last week.

We're a small team of 6 seats at Vertex Legal but this is time-sensitive since the audit deadline is today at 5pm. Please advise on a workaround or fix as soon as possible.
answer:
Understood, given the audit deadline today we're treating this as urgent and looking into the export rendering timeout right now. We're checking whether this is tied to chart complexity or a broader issue with the PDF export service, and will confirm shortly.

As an immediate workaround, please try exporting each dashboard tab individually rather than the full multi-chart view, as this often bypasses the rendering timeout - let us know if that gets you unblocked while we investigate the root cause.

subject: Mobile app offline mode not syncing after reconnect
body:
We have 248 seats on the North Energy workspace and several field staff use the Northwind mobile app in offline mode at our training sites. Since last week, when devices reconnect to wifi the app shows a spinning sync icon indefinitely and cached data never uploads. Push notifications for sync completion never arrive either. Affected devices are iOS 17.4 and Android 14, app version 6.2.1.

Can you tell us if this is a known issue with the offline queue? Users are having to log out and back in to force a sync, which is disruptive during training sessions.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. We've seen a similar sync stall tied to the offline queue not clearing push tokens correctly after version 6.2.1, and our mobile team is actively investigating. As a workaround, forcing sync via pull-to-refresh on the home screen (rather than logging out) should trigger the upload without losing the session. I'll update this ticket as soon as we have a fix timeline, and please let me know if the workaround isn't resolving it for your team.

subject: Multiple card declines blocking Pro plan renewal - 242 seats affected
body:
Our Granite Works account is on the Pro plan with 242 seats and our renewal payment failed twice today, on the corporate Visa ending in the usual card we've used for two years. The dashboard shows error 'card_declined - insufficient_funds' but our finance team confirmed the card has plenty of available credit, so this looks like a processing issue on your end.

We need this resolved fast since our seat access could lapse. Please also send an updated invoice and confirm whether we need to request a refund on the failed attempt or if it was never actually charged.
answer: I'm sorry for the disruption this is causing - I've escalated this to our payments team immediately given the seat access risk. The declines appear to be linked to a temporary issue with our processor's fraud filter, not your card balance, and no funds were actually captured on either attempt so no refund is needed. I'm applying a 72-hour grace period to your account now to prevent any lapse in access while we retry the charge, and I'll follow up within a few hours with confirmation and an updated invoice.

subject: Best practice for cursor-based pagination on /v2/bookings
body:
I'm integrating with the /v2/bookings endpoint and want to confirm the recommended approach for pagination going forward. Right now we're using the offset and limit params, but I noticed the changelog mentions cursor-based pagination is being introduced. Is offset pagination being deprecated on this endpoint, and if so what's the timeline?

Also, could you point me to updated documentation covering the new 'next_cursor' field? The current docs page still only shows the offset example.
answer: Good timing to ask - offset pagination on /v2/bookings is being deprecated in favor of cursor-based pagination, with offset support planned to be removed in a future release (we'll announce the exact date via the changelog with at least 90 days notice). The docs page is being updated; in the meantime, the response already includes a next_cursor field you can pass as the cursor query param instead of offset/limit. I'll flag the documentation gap to our docs team so the example gets added.

subject: SCIM provisioning failing for new hires - users not appearing
body:
Our SCIM integration between Workday and Northwind Identity has stopped creating new user accounts. We onboarded three new hires yesterday and none of them show up in the Northwind admin console, even though the SCIM sync log on our side shows a 201 response for each POST request. MFA enrollment links we tried to send manually also bounce because the accounts don't exist yet.

This is blocking new employees from logging in on their first day. Can someone check the provisioning logs on your side for Willow Capital?
answer: Thanks for flagging this - I'm pulling the SCIM provisioning logs for your tenant now. A 201 on your side combined with missing users on ours often points to a mismatch in the SCIM schema mapping (commonly the externalId or a required attribute like a work email domain), which causes silent record rejection after acknowledgment.
