I'll have specifics for you within the hour, and in the meantime you can manually invite the three new hires from the admin console so they're not blocked today.

subject: PUSH NOTIFICATIONS BROKEN AGAIN AND NO ONE IS FIXING IT
body:
This is the third time this month push notifications just stop working on the mobile app for our warehouse team. Half our 10 users get nothing, the app crashes on Android when opening the notification settings screen, and offline mode doesn't even cache the missed alerts so they're gone forever. I've submitted logs before and got a generic reply.

We are seriously considering cancelling if this keeps happening. Push notifications are the entire reason we pay for this app - fix it or refund us.
answer: I hear your frustration and I'm sorry this keeps recurring - that's not the experience we want for your team. I'm escalating this to our mobile engineering team as a priority bug given the repeat pattern and the Android crash on the notification settings screen; can you send the crash logs or device model/OS version from the affected phones so they can reproduce it directly? I'll also review your account history to see what happened with prior reports so this doesn't get lost again.

subject: SCIM sync creating duplicate user records after HR system migration
body:
We migrated our HR platform last week and since then our SCIM provisioning to Northwind Identity has started creating duplicate accounts for existing employees - we're seeing double entries for at least 15 of our 80 seats. Login for affected users now shows 'multiple accounts found, contact administrator' and SSO fails entirely for them.

Could someone advise on how to safely deduplicate these in the admin console without breaking active sessions? Documentation on merging SCIM-provisioned identities would help too.
answer: Thanks for the clear breakdown - duplicate records after an HR migration usually happen when the new system sends a different externalId for the same user, so SCIM treats them as new identities rather than updates. Please don't merge accounts manually yet, as that can orphan active sessions; instead, send us the list of affected usernames and we'll run our dedup tool that reconciles by primary email while preserving login state. I'll also send our SCIM migration guide, which covers externalId mapping for exactly this scenario.

subject: help
body:
We issued a partial refund to a customer through the Billing API last Tuesday using the /v1/refunds endpoint, but the credit never applied to their account balance. The API response returned status 'succeeded' with refund id re_8834K, but our own ledger and the customer's dashboard still show the original charge with no credit line.

How do we reconcile this - is there a delay on credit application or do we need to manually adjust the balance on our end?
answer: Thanks for including the refund ID - I looked up re_8834K and confirmed the refund was processed successfully on our side, but there's a known delay of up to 24 hours before the credit reflects in the customer-facing balance and dashboard ledger due to an async reconciliation job. If it's still not showing after that window, send us the customer account ID and we'll manually trigger the ledger sync rather than have you adjust balances directly.

subject: Users getting logged out every 15 minutes despite session settings
body:
Several people on our finance team, myself included, are being logged out of the Northwind dashboard roughly every 15 minutes even though our SSO session timeout is configured for 8 hours in the Identity admin settings. This started after we updated our SAML provisioning rules last week to restrict access by department.

It's not blocking work entirely since re-login is quick, but it's a constant annoyance for the 140 seats on our Atlas Travel workspace. Could you check if the provisioning change affected session duration settings?
answer: Thanks for the context on the timing - it does sound related to the SAML provisioning update, since department-based access rules can sometimes reset the session token lifetime attribute if it wasn't explicitly carried over in the new rule set. I'll review your SSO configuration and provisioning rule changes from last week and get back to you with what's overriding the 8-hour timeout; this isn't urgent so I'll have an update within one business day.

subject: SDK throwing 429 errors and deprecated method warnings
body:
We're using the Northwind Node SDK (v4.3.0) for our API integration and started seeing intermittent 429 rate limit errors even though our usage is well under the documented 1000 req/min for our tier. Additionally the SDK logs a deprecation warning for 'client.legacyAuth()' on every call, though we haven't changed our auth setup.

Stack trace snippet:
Error: Request failed with status 429
  at SDKClient.request (client.js:142)
  at AuthModule.legacyAuth (auth.js:58) [deprecated]
  at Object.<anonymous> (index.js:22)

Can you confirm if legacyAuth is being sunset and whether that's contributing to the rate limiting?
answer: Thanks for including the stack trace - legacyAuth() is indeed being deprecated and routes through an older auth path with a much lower internal rate limit ceiling, which explains the 429s despite your usage being under the standard tier limit. I'd recommend migrating to client.authenticate() with API key rotation as described in our SDK v4 migration guide; this should resolve both the deprecation warning and the rate limiting. I'm marking this as high priority given the impact on your integration - let us know if you hit issues during the migration and we'll assist directly.

subject: Invoice shows 20 seats but we only have 13 active users
body:
Our latest invoice for Willow Works charges us for 20 seats on the Starter plan, but we currently only have 13 active users in the admin console - we removed 7 people last month when they left the company. This has happened on our last two invoices now and I need it corrected before it processes again.

Can someone review our seat count history and issue a credit for the overcharge, or adjust the current invoice? We're on a tight budget and this discrepancy is a real problem for us.
answer: I'm sorry for the overcharge and I understand the budget pressure this creates - I'm pulling your seat count history now to see why the removed users weren't reflected in billing, as that should happen automatically. I'll issue a credit for the seat discrepancy across both affected invoices once I confirm the exact overage, and I'm also correcting your current seat count to 13 so this doesn't repeat next cycle. Expect an update from me within one business day.

subject: Unsubscribed users still receiving emails - duplicate sends

This started around March 18th after we updated our notification templates. Our finance team is fielding complaints daily and this looks like a compliance issue for us since these are supposed to be opt-out respecting notifications.
answer: Thank you for flagging this - unsubscribe preferences not being honored alongside duplicate delivery is a serious issue and we're treating it as P1. Can you send us 2-3 recipient identifiers (email or user ID) along with timestamps of the duplicate sends so we can trace this through our notification pipeline? In the meantime we're checking whether a recent template deployment on our end broke the suppression list sync.

subject: Refund needed for duplicate charge on last invoice

I've reviewed our payment history and can't find a reason for the second line item. Could someone look into this and process a refund or credit for the duplicate amount?

Apologies for the extra charge, and let us know if you don't see the credit applied by end of week.

subject: Dashboards taking 20+ seconds to load with charts

This is happening specifically on shared dashboards that we distribute to other teams. Exporting to PDF from these same dashboards is also timing out. Could you share the specific dashboard name or URL that's affected so we can inspect the query load? We'll also check whether the shared-link rendering path is hitting a different cache tier than your private dashboards, which could explain the discrepancy.

subject: Getting duplicate alerts for the same event
body: Our team started getting duplicate notification alerts for the same triggered event starting this week - each alert fires twice within about 30 seconds of each other. This is happening across email and in-app notifications for our capital markets monitoring workflows. With only 22 seats we're a small team but this is causing confusion since people think there are two separate incidents when there's only one.

Can you share one or two specific alert IDs or timestamps where you saw the duplicate firing? We suspect this may be related to a recent change in our alert deduplication logic and want to confirm the pattern before rolling out a fix.

subject: Webhook deprecation breaking our integration ahead of schedule
body:
We received a deprecation notice for the v2 webhook payload format with a stated sunset date of June 30th, but our webhooks started failing today with the new format already being rejected. Our integration handles patient scheduling notifications for our travel health clinics and this is blocking real-time updates.

Here's the error we're seeing:
```
WebhookDeliveryError: schema validation failed
field 'event_type' expected enum, got string
field 'metadata.legacy_id' is required but missing
timestamp: 2024-05-14T09:22:11Z
endpoint: /webhooks/v2/appointments
status: 422 Unprocessable Entity
```
We also hit our rate limit twice while retrying failed deliveries. Can you confirm whether v2 was disabled early?
answer: Apologies for the disruption - this does look like the v2 schema enforcement rolled out earlier than the documented June 30th date, and we're escalating this internally right now. As a temporary workaround, please switch your webhook endpoint to the v3 payload format if possible, which is stable and documented; I'll follow up within the hour with confirmation on whether we can restore v2 compatibility until the original sunset date or need to expedite your migration.

subject: Help
body: our api integratoin stoped working today for all our webhook endpoints, getting 410 gone errors on evrything. we use the rate limit headers from the old api version and now the SDK is throwing errors too. this is affecting our energy monitoring dashboards for 180 users. checked the deprecation docs but they dont match what were seeing in production, need urgent help

We'll also check our deprecation timeline against what's live in production since it sounds like there's a mismatch.

subject: Transform pipeline changes needed after recent failures
body:
We've been running our data pipelines for a few months now connecting our media analytics sources to Northwind dashboards, and things had been stable until recently. Our team relies on the nightly sync to populate reporting for stakeholders across 273 seats, and we've built several downstream processes assuming consistent transform behavior.

subject: PUSH NOTIFICATIONS NOT DELIVERED TO OFFLINE DEVICES - URGENT
body:
WE ARE INTEGRATING THE MOBILE SDK FOR OUR IOS AND ANDROID APPS AND PUSH NOTIFICATIONS ARE NOT ARRIVING TO DEVICES THAT WERE OFFLINE WHEN THE MESSAGE WAS SENT. WE TESTED WITH 50 DEVICES, TOOK THEM OFFLINE FOR 10 MINUTES, SENT A NOTIFICATION VIA /v2/push/send, GOT 200 OK, BUT ONLY 12 DEVICES RECEIVED IT ONCE BACK ONLINE. THIS IS BLOCKING OUR LAUNCH SCHEDULED FOR NEXT WEEK.

THE DOCS SAY OFFLINE QUEUEING IS SUPPORTED BUT WE SEE NOTHING ABOUT TTL OR RETRY LIMITS. CAN SOMEONE ESCALATE THIS, WE HAVE 290 SEATS ON THIS ACCOUNT AND THIS IS A CRITICAL FEATURE FOR OUR FINTECH APP.
answer: Thanks for flagging this, I understand the launch timeline makes this urgent and I'm escalating it now. Offline-queued pushes do have a default TTL of 4 hours and a 3-attempt retry, but a drop from 50 to 12 devices is well outside expected behavior, so this looks like a bug in the queueing path rather than expiry. Can you send us the push IDs from your test batch and the exact SDK version you're using so our engineers can trace the delivery logs? I'll keep this ticket open as P1 and update you within a few hours.

subject: Bar charts showing wrong totals since yesterday
body:
Since yesterday afternoon our revenue-by-region bar chart on the Executive dashboard is showing totals that don't match our export data. For example the chart shows $84,200 for the Northeast region but the CSV export for the same date range shows $91,750. This is affecting the weekly review we run every Monday with clinical operations leadership.

I checked two other charts on the same dashboard (patient visits, claims processed) and they seem fine, so it looks isolated to this one bar chart widget. Can someone take a look?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report, that discrepancy definitely shouldn't happen. It sounds like the bar chart widget may be using a stale aggregation cache while the export pulls live data. I'm opening this as an incident on our end and will check the widget's refresh job for your workspace; in the meantime, the CSV export figures should be treated as accurate. I'll update you as soon as we identify the cause, likely within the day given your Monday review.

subject: How do drivers unsubscribe from delivery alert emails?
body:
We're setting up delivery status notifications for our driver team and I'd like to know if there's a self-serve unsubscribe link we can include, or if drivers need to email us directly to opt out. Right now we're manually removing people from the alert list when they ask, which isn't scalable for 11 users but will be an issue as we grow.

Also, a couple of drivers mentioned getting the same alert twice for one shipment update last week - is that a known duplicate-send issue or something on our template config?
answer: Good question - yes, every notification template includes an automatic unsubscribe footer link by default, so drivers can opt themselves out without you needing to manage the list manually. If you're not seeing that link, check the template settings under Notifications > Templates and make sure the footer block hasn't been removed. On the duplicate alert, that can happen if a shipment status is updated twice quickly and both triggers fire before deduplication catches up; if it keeps happening let us know the shipment ID and we'll dig into your specific trigger rules.

subject: Zapier integration - feature request and a small bug
body:
We've been using the Zapier integration to push new leads from Northwind into our Slack channel and it's been great, but I noticed the "New Contact" trigger only fires for contacts created through the API, not ones added via the dashboard UI. Is that expected? It would help our workflow if both paths triggered the Zap.

Separately, it would be great to have native connectors for Salesforce and Jira listed in the Zapier app directory instead of us having to build custom webhooks for those. Just feedback, not urgent.
answer: Thanks for the feedback, and good catch on the trigger behavior. You're right that the "New Contact" trigger currently only listens for API-created contacts; UI-created contacts don't fire the same webhook event yet, which is a gap we're aware of and have logged for our integrations team. On the Salesforce and Jira connector request, I'll pass that along to product as a feature request too - we don't have a timeline yet but it's good to know there's demand for it.

subject: Documentation gap: scheduled sync latency expectations
body:
I'm setting up a scheduled sync from our warehouse management system into a Data Pipeline connector and want to confirm expected latency before we build downstream reports around it. The docs mention "near real-time" for the connector but don't give a number. Our syncs are scheduled hourly and we're seeing data land anywhere from 8 to 40 minutes after the scheduled run time.

Could you clarify what latency range is normal for this connector, and whether there's a way to get alerted if a sync run falls outside that range? We'd like to document this properly for our analytics team before scaling to more pipelines.
answer: Good question, and you're right that our public docs are light on specifics here. For the warehouse connector, typical latency is 5-15 minutes post-schedule depending on payload size, so the 40-minute runs you saw are on the high end and worth investigating - could you share a run ID from one of those slower syncs? On alerting, we do support latency-based alert rules under Pipeline Settings > Monitoring, and I'll also flag the documentation gap to our docs team so the expected range gets published.

subject: API keys suddenly returning 401 for all requests
body:
As of this morning, every API call using our production key is returning 401 Unauthorized, including endpoints that were working fine yesterday. We haven't rotated or regenerated any keys recently. This is affecting our booking sync integration and our travel partners can't pull availability data right now, which is a major issue during our busy season.

We checked the key in the dashboard and it still shows as active with no expiration warning. Can someone check if there was a change on the platform side around 8am today?
answer: This is being treated as high priority given the impact on your booking sync. We are aware of a brief issue this morning affecting key validation for some accounts on the Starter tier, and we're actively checking whether your account was affected. Can you confirm the last 6 characters of the key showing the 401s and roughly what time you started seeing failures? I'll update you as soon as we have a root cause, and if this turns out to be platform-side we'll notify you the moment it's resolved.

subject: Seat count discrepancy on our invoice
body: Our latest invoice shows charges for 18 seats, but we only have 14 active users in our workspace - the rest were deactivated over two months ago when a few contractors rolled off the project. Could you check why the deactivated seats are still being billed and process a refund or credit for the difference?
answer: Thanks for raising this, and I'm sorry for the billing discrepancy. Deactivated users should drop off the billable seat count within one billing cycle, so if they're still showing up two months later that's a syncing issue on our end. I'll check your account's seat history against the deactivation dates and process a credit for the overbilled seats once confirmed - I'll follow up with the exact amount within a couple of business days.

subject: Salesforce sync stuck - records not updating for 6 hours
body:
Our Salesforce integration stopped syncing account updates around 3am today. We have 248 seats on this account and rely on this sync for our education partner records team to see updated enrollment status in real time. The integration status page shows "Connected" but the last successful sync timestamp is stuck at 03:12 AM.

We tried disconnecting and reconnecting the integration via the admin panel but it just re-authenticates and shows the same stale timestamp afterward. Nothing in our Slack error channel either. Need this fixed urgently since our team is manually updating records right now.
answer: Thank you for the detailed report, I know this is disrupting your enrollment team's workflow. A stuck sync timestamp with a "Connected" status usually points to a stalled job on our sync worker rather than an auth issue, which matches what you saw after reconnecting. I'm escalating this to our integrations on-call team right now to restart the sync job for your workspace and will confirm once records start flowing again - I'll update you within the hour.

subject: Dashboards extremely slow to load since this morning
body:
Since around 9am today, every dashboard in our workspace is taking 20-30 seconds to load, and some time out entirely with a generic error page. We have 66 seats and multiple attorneys need these dashboards for client case reviews happening this afternoon. Sharing a dashboard link with a colleague also fails to load on their end.

Exporting to PDF from the one dashboard that did load took over 3 minutes, which is far slower than usual. Nothing has changed on our side - no new charts or filters added recently. This is a critical issue for us right now.
answer: I'm sorry for the disruption, especially with case reviews scheduled this afternoon - I'm treating this as high priority. Widespread slowness and timeouts across all dashboards, including for shared links, points to a performance issue on our platform rather than anything in your workspace configuration. I'm escalating to our infrastructure team immediately to investigate load times for your account and will update you as soon as we have findings or a fix, checking back within the hour.

subject: Uploads schlagen fehl - Fehlermeldung beim Hochladen von Dateien
body:
Seit gestern Nachmittag schlagen mehrere Datei-Uploads in unserem Storage-Bereich fehl. Wir erhalten die Meldung "Upload failed - quota exceeded", obwohl unser Speicherkontingent laut Übersicht erst zu etwa 60 Prozent ausgeschöpft ist. Betroffen sind vor allem PDF-Dokumente über 15 MB, kleinere Dateien scheinen noch durchzugehen.

Wir nutzen den Storage-Bereich für Reisebuchungsunterlagen und benötigen tägliche Backups dieser Dateien. Können Sie prüfen, woran das liegt? Wir haben aktuell 18 Nutzer im Workspace.
answer: Vielen Dank für die genaue Beschreibung. Eine Quota-Fehlermeldung bei nur 60 Prozent Auslastung deutet darauf hin, dass hier ein Zähler falsch berechnet wird, statt dass Ihr Kontingent tatsächlich erreicht ist - das prüfen wir jetzt genauer. Können Sie uns den Namen oder die ID einer der fehlgeschlagenen PDF-Dateien sowie den ungefähren Zeitpunkt des letzten Fehlversuchs nennen? Damit können wir die Logs für Ihren Workspace gezielt durchsuchen und uns zeitnah mit einem Update melden.

subject: Late-arriving records breaking downstream aggregation windows
body:
We run the logistics-events connector (pipeline ID plc-8842) that feeds our hourly shipment aggregation job. Since Nov 3, roughly 12-18% of events are arriving 40-90 minutes after their event timestamp, which means our aggregation windows close before the data lands and we get undercounted shipment totals. This is affecting reporting for all 174 seats on our side since the dashboards downstream pull from these aggregates.

We've checked the source system and events are being emitted on time, so this looks like a sync/queue delay on Northwind's connector side. Can someone check the connector health for plc-8842 and let us know if there's a backlog?
answer:
Thanks for the detailed report - we can see elevated queue depth on plc-8842 starting around the timestamp you mentioned, consistent with a backlog on one of the ingestion workers. We're re-balancing the connector's consumer group now and expect the backlog to drain within the next hour; late records will backfill into existing aggregation windows automatically once the pipeline catches up.

We'll monitor lag on this connector for the next 24 hours and follow up here once we confirm throughput is back to normal and the affected aggregates have been recomputed.

subject: Webhook retry behavior and SDK support for event filtering
body:
I'm integrating the Northwind API into our media platform and have a couple of questions about webhooks. First, when a webhook delivery fails, what's the retry schedule and max attempt count - I'm seeing retries happen but couldn't find documented backoff intervals. Second, is there a way to filter which event types get delivered to a given endpoint without subscribing to everything and filtering client-side?

Also noticed the older webhook.v1 payload format is still referenced in some SDK examples even though the docs mention it's being phased out - wanted to flag that in case it needs updating.
answer:
Good questions. Webhook retries currently follow exponential backoff starting at 30 seconds, doubling up to a 1-hour cap, with a total of 8 attempts before the delivery is marked failed and logged in the console. For event filtering, you can scope subscriptions by event type when creating the webhook endpoint via the API - pass an event_types array instead of subscribing to the wildcard.

Thanks for flagging the outdated webhook.v1 reference in the SDK examples - I've filed that with our docs team for correction. Let me know if you'd like help setting up scoped subscriptions.

subject: Deactivated user still appears in allowlist and audit log shows wrong actor
body:
I deactivated a former employee's account in the Admin Console yesterday (workspace settings > Users), but they're still showing up in our IP allowlist configuration under one of our integration policies. When I try to remove them manually, the entry doesn't save and the page just refreshes back to the old state.

Also separately, the audit log entry for this deactivation lists my account as the actor for an action I didn't take around the same time - a permission change on a different user. Might be a display bug but wanted to report both issues together since they happened in the same session.
answer: Thanks for reporting this - it sounds like two separate issues in the workspace settings UI. For the allowlist entry not clearing after deactivation, that's likely a stale cache on the policy page; we're looking into why the removal isn't persisting and will follow up with a fix or workaround shortly. For the audit log misattribution, could you send us the exact timestamp of the entry in question so we can trace it in the backend logs? We want to confirm whether this is a display issue or something more concerning before closing this out.

subject: Push-Benachrichtigungen sollen bei Offline-Status verzögert werden
body:
Wir möchten das Verhalten der Push-Benachrichtigungen in der Mobile App ändern. Aktuell werden Benachrichtigungen auch dann sofort zugestellt, wenn ein Nutzer offline war und die App erst später wieder öffnet - das führt bei unseren 14 Nutzern zu einer Flut von veralteten Meldungen beim Neustart. Wir hätten gerne, dass nur die letzte relevante Benachrichtigung pro Kategorie angezeigt wird, sobald die App wieder online ist.

Gibt es dafür schon eine Einstellungsmöglichkeit oder wäre das ein Feature Request? Falls es das schon gibt, wo finden wir die Konfiguration dafür?
answer:
Vielen Dank für die Rückmeldung. Aktuell gibt es keine Einstellung, mit der Push-Benachrichtigungen nach Kategorie zusammengefasst oder beim erneuten Online-Gehen gefiltert werden - das Verhalten, das Sie beschreiben, wäre aktuell ein Feature Request. Ich habe das an unser Mobile-Produktteam weitergegeben und vermerke Ihre 14-Nutzer-Umgebung als Anwendungsfall.

Als Zwischenlösung könnten Sie serverseitig ältere Benachrichtigungen invalidieren, bevor die App wieder synchronisiert - falls gewünscht, kann ich Ihnen zeigen, wie das über die API funktioniert.

subject: Users getting logged out every 15 minutes
body:
Our finance team of 3 has been getting logged out of Northwind roughly every 15 minutes since Tuesday, even during active use. We haven't changed any SSO configuration on our end - we're using SAML with our identity provider and session settings were left at default. Each time this happens, users have to re-authenticate through MFA again, which is disrupting our month-end close work.

Can you check if there was a recent change to session timeout defaults for Starter accounts? This is happening across all three of our seats consistently.
answer: Sorry for the disruption this is causing during your close process. We did roll out a change to default session lifetime handling for SAML-based SSO sessions last week, and it looks like it may have reset your workspace's session timeout to a shorter default instead of preserving your prior setting. I'm escalating this to our identity team to confirm and get your session duration restored - in the meantime, could you confirm whether you'd like us to extend the timeout to your previous value or a specific duration?

subject: URGENT: Slack alerts from Salesforce integration stopped firing
body:
Our Slack integration that posts alerts from Salesforce opportunity changes has completely stopped working since this morning around 8:30am. This is a critical part of our sales ops workflow across all 139 seats - reps rely on these real-time alerts to follow up on deal changes and nothing has posted in over 3 hours.

We haven't changed anything on the Salesforce or Slack side. I checked the Integrations page in Northwind and the connection shows as Active but no events are coming through. We also use Jira and Okta integrations but those seem unaffected so far.
answer: Thanks for flagging this urgently - we're treating this as high priority given the impact on your sales workflow. We're checking the event delivery path between the Salesforce connector and the Slack integration now to see where events are stalling despite the connection showing Active; this can happen if the underlying webhook subscription silently expired on the Salesforce side. We'll update you within the hour with findings, and please let us know immediately if the Jira or Okta integrations show any changes as well.

subject: Bar chart totals don't match the export CSV
body:
I built a dashboard with a stacked bar chart showing monthly transaction volume, and when I export the same data as CSV, the totals in the export don't match what's shown in the chart - the chart shows a September total about 8% higher than the CSV export for the same date range. This is making me hesitant to share the dashboard with our exec team until we understand the discrepancy.

Could you help clarify whether the chart and export are supposed to use the same aggregation logic? We'd like to add a feature request too - it would help to have an option to view the raw numbers behind each bar segment on hover.
answer:
Thanks for catching this - chart totals and CSV exports should use identical aggregation, so an 8% mismatch suggests either a filter or timezone difference being applied inconsistently between the two views. Could you share the dashboard name and the exact date range filter you used for September so we can reproduce it on our end?

I've also logged your request for a hover tooltip showing raw segment values on stacked bar charts - that's a reasonable addition and I'll pass it to the dashboards product team for consideration.

subject: URGENT - storage quota hit, uploads failing, possible data exposure risk
body:
We just discovered that our storage bucket hit its quota limit at 2:14am and has been silently rejecting new uploads since then - our healthcare compliance backup job that runs nightly failed completely, and we have zero verified backups for the last 18 hours. Even more concerning, when checking the storage console we noticed a shared link for one of our folders appears to have broader access than intended, visible to more than our own workspace.

Given we're in healthcare with 274 seats and this touches both backup integrity and a possible access exposure, we need this treated as critical. Please advise immediately on both the quota increase and the sharing permissions issue.
answer:
This has been escalated immediately as a P0 given both the backup failure and the potential access exposure - we're treating the sharing permissions issue as a security priority and looking into it right now. We're raising your storage quota on an emergency basis so uploads can resume, and we'll confirm within the hour once that's applied so your backup job can be retried.

For the shared folder link, please do not delete or modify it yet - our security team needs to review the current permission scope and access logs first to determine if any external access occurred, and we'll be in direct contact with you within minutes on this specific point.

subject: Confused about upcoming API deprecation and rate limit changes
body:
We got a notice that the /v2/orders endpoint is being deprecated in favor of /v3/orders, but I'm having trouble understanding what changes for rate limits. Our current integration makes about 400 requests/hour against v2, and the deprecation email mentioned updated rate limit tiers without specifics. Are we going to hit lower limits on v3, and is there an SDK version that already supports the new endpoint?

We're a small team (9 seats) so we want to plan the migration properly rather than scramble when v2 gets shut off.
answer:
Happy to clarify. The v3 rate limits are actually more generous for accounts on your tier - you'd move from 500 requests/hour to 1,000 requests/hour, so your current 400/hour usage has comfortable headroom. The SDK already supports v3 as of version 4.2.0; you'll mainly need to update endpoint paths and a few renamed response fields documented in the migration guide.

We recommend starting the migration in a staging environment before the v2 sunset date; let us know if you'd like a walkthrough of the field mapping changes.

subject: Requesting timeline and webhook impact details for v2 API sunset
body:
I'm the support engineer handling our integration with Northwind and want to get ahead of the v2 API deprecation notice we received. Specifically, we rely heavily on webhooks for order status updates - will the webhook payload structure change when we move to v3, or is that independent of the endpoint version? We're also seeing occasional rate limit 429s on v2 already (maybe 5-10 times a week) and want to know if that improves or worsens with v3.

We're a small team (18 seats) so we'd like a clear migration checklist rather than piecing it together from changelog entries.
answer:
Good timing to plan ahead. Webhook payload structure is versioned separately from the REST endpoints, so your existing webhook integration won't need changes purely due to the v2-to-v3 endpoint migration - though we'd recommend confirming your payload parser handles any new optional fields we've added since your integration was built. Regarding the 429s, v3 rate limits are a higher tier for your account size, so you should see fewer throttling events after migrating.

I'll send over a step-by-step migration checklist covering endpoint paths, field renames, and a recommended testing sequence - should have that to you within a day.

subject: Transform step failing intermittently on inventory sync pipeline
body: We have a pipeline pulling inventory data from our ERP connector into Northwind Data Pipelines, and the transform step 'normalize-sku' has failed 6 times in the last 3 days with a generic 'transform execution error' message. The runs that succeed take noticeably longer than usual, around 12 minutes vs the normal 3. Pipeline ID is dp-8841-lumen. Not blocking us yet since it's a low-volume feed, but wanted to flag it before it gets worse.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report and the pipeline ID. We're seeing the same intermittent failures on dp-8841-lumen on our end and it looks tied to a connector timeout upstream of the transform step rather than the transform logic itself. We'll dig into the connector logs for those 6 failed runs and get back to you with findings; in the meantime the pipeline should keep retrying safely since it's low volume.

subject: URGENT - all transforms down, data missing for 18 schools
body:
Since 7:40am today every transform job in our student-records pipeline is failing and we are missing data for all 18 school sites. This is a live production issue affecting our entire org.

Log from the pipeline runner:
2024-06-12T07:41:02Z ERROR transform_stage[normalize_students] : connection reset by peer
2024-06-12T07:41:02Z ERROR job_id=pl-2291 retries=3 giving up
2024-06-12T07:44:15Z ERROR transform_stage[dedupe_records] : upstream schema mismatch, column 'enrollment_date' missing
2024-06-12T07:44:15Z FATAL pipeline dp-atlas-main marked DEGRADED

We need this fixed immediately, we have reporting due to the state education board today and this looks like actual data loss, not just a delay.
answer: We understand the urgency and have escalated this to our on-call pipeline team as a P0 outage affecting dp-atlas-main. Initial triage of the logs you shared shows a schema mismatch on 'enrollment_date' combined with connector connection resets; we're checking whether any completed runs before 7:40am wrote partial data so we can assess actual loss versus delayed processing. We'll update you within the hour with root cause and a plan to reprocess the affected school sites before your reporting deadline.

subject: Connector auth token expiring earlier than expected
body: Our Salesforce connector feeding the claims-data pipeline has started requiring re-authentication roughly every 36 hours instead of the usual 90 days we've seen historically. Pipeline ID dp-delta-claims-07. Each time it lapses we get a backlog of about 40 minutes of delayed records until someone notices and re-authorizes. Data quality once it catches up looks fine, this is just an operational annoyance for our team.
answer: Thanks for flagging this, we'll take a look at the OAuth token lifecycle for dp-delta-claims-07 to see why the refresh interval dropped from 90 days to roughly 36 hours. This isn't affecting data integrity so we've logged it as a lower priority item, but we'll investigate whether a recent Salesforce-side policy change or a token scope issue is causing the early expiry and follow up with findings.

subject: MFA enrollment enforcement rollout stuck at 40%
body:
We're rolling out mandatory MFA enrollment for 99 staff accounts ahead of our compliance audit next week, but the enforcement policy has stalled at 40% adoption for the last 2 days despite reminder emails going out. Several users report the enrollment link times out.

2024-06-10 14:02:11 [SSO] provisioning_error: user_id=usr_4471 policy=mfa_enforce_v2 status=timeout
2024-06-10 14:02:44 [SSO] provisioning_error: user_id=usr_4488 policy=mfa_enforce_v2 status=timeout
2024-06-10 14:03:01 [SSO] retry_exhausted policy=mfa_enforce_v2 affected=59

This is blocking our audit readiness and we need it resolved before Friday.
answer: We've escalated this given your audit deadline. The timeout pattern in your log points to the enrollment service failing to complete provisioning for the remaining 59 accounts under policy mfa_enforce_v2; we're checking whether this is capacity-related on our side or tied to a specific identity provider group. We'll push a fix or workaround today and confirm once enrollment resumes so you have time to reach full adoption before Friday.

subject: Mobile app crashing on launch for legal team iPads
body: Since yesterday's app update, the Northwind mobile app crashes immediately on launch for a growing number of our legal team's iPads, roughly 30 of 208 devices so far. Users see the splash screen for about a second then get returned to the home screen with no error message. Uninstalling and reinstalling hasn't helped. We need a fix or a way to roll back the update since our attorneys rely on the app for offline case file access in court.
answer: Thank you for the clear breakdown, a crash-on-launch affecting 30 devices and growing is a priority for us. We're pulling crash logs from our mobile crash reporting for your organization now to identify the common thread across the affected iPads, and will check whether the recent update introduced a regression with offline case file caching. We'll follow up shortly with either a hotfix timeline or a workaround so your legal team isn't blocked in court.

subject: Deactivated users still showing as active in Admin Console
body: We deactivated a batch of about 140 departing employees through the Admin Console bulk deactivation tool on Tuesday, but roughly 90 of them still show as 'Active' status and are apparently still able to log in. This is a serious problem for us given our size, over 3,300 seats, since access should have been revoked immediately per our offboarding policy. Can you confirm whether deactivation is actually propagating or if this is a display bug only?
answer: This is a priority issue and we're treating it as such given the potential access exposure. We're checking whether the deactivation status is failing to propagate to the login service or if it's purely a console display lag; either way we'll confirm within the next few hours whether the 90 accounts can actually still authenticate. In the meantime, if you need immediate assurance, we can help you force a session revoke on those specific accounts while we investigate the root cause.

subject: Zapier integration not triggering on new lead events
body: We set up a Zapier integration to fire whenever a new lead is created in our workspace, but it hasn't triggered a single time since we connected it 4 days ago even though we've added 9 test leads. The Zapier task history shows no incoming events at all. We also have Slack and Salesforce integrations configured separately and those seem to be working fine, so it seems isolated to this Zapier trigger.
answer: Thanks for the detailed context, especially confirming Slack and Salesforce are working since that helps narrow this down to the Zapier trigger configuration or webhook delivery specifically. Can you share the Zap's trigger event name and the workspace webhook URL it's pointed at? We'll check our outbound event logs for the last 4 days to see if the lead-created events were even attempted, and take it from there.

subject: Need retention period extended for archived storage buckets
body: We currently have our Storage retention policy set to 90 days, but our compliance team now requires us to keep archived media assets for at least 12 months. Can you let us know if extending retention is possible on our current plan, and whether it applies retroactively to files already past the 90-day mark or only to new uploads going forward? We have roughly 4TB currently sitting close to expiry.
answer: Extending retention is something we can help configure, though on the Starter plan the maximum retention window is currently capped and may require a plan adjustment to reach 12 months, we'll confirm the exact limit for your account. Regarding the 4TB nearing expiry, we can apply an extension retroactively as long as we act before those files pass their current 90-day expiry, so we'll prioritize getting that change in place this week.

subject: Customers getting duplicate emails after unsubscribing
body:
I wanted to give some background first: we recently migrated our shipment-alert templates to the new Notifications editor about two weeks ago, and generally the migration went smoothly with no complaints from our logistics customers about formatting or delivery timing. Our support team also didn't flag anything unusual in the first week after the switch.

However starting Monday we've had 14 customers report that after clicking 'unsubscribe' on our shipment alerts, they continue receiving duplicate copies of the same alert, sometimes 2-3 identical emails within minutes. This is generating complaints and a few threats to stop using our platform, so we need this resolved quickly since it's affecting how our own customers perceive us.
answer: Thank you for walking through the timeline, that helps us narrow this to something introduced around the template migration rather than an existing issue. We're treating the duplicate delivery after unsubscribe as a priority since it directly affects your customers' trust, and we're checking whether the unsubscribe flag is being correctly respected by the new alert templates or if there's a duplicate send trigger in the notification queue. We'll have an update for you within a few hours given the customer-facing impact.

subject: Need updated webhook documentation and SDK for deprecated event types
body: We're building out invoicing automation using the API Platform webhooks and noticed two event types we rely on, invoice.paid.legacy and payment.settled, are marked as deprecated in the changelog but still appear in our current integration. We'd like to migrate to the replacement events before they're removed, but the documentation page for the new event schema returns a 404. Could someone point us to current docs and confirm the SDK version that supports the new events?
answer: Thanks for flagging the broken documentation link, we'll get that fixed right away. In the meantime, the replacement events for invoice.paid.legacy and payment.settled are invoice.payment_completed and payment.settled.v2 respectively, both supported starting SDK version 4.3.0. We'll send over the correct documentation link and a short migration note once the page is restored so your finance automation isn't disrupted when the legacy events are removed.

subject: Request to change Jira link scope for Vertex Media workspace
body: We currently have the Jira integration linked at the workspace level, but our healthcare compliance team wants to restrict it to only two specific projects (CLM and BILL) instead of the whole Jira instance. Can you walk us through how to change the linked scope, or does this need to be reconfigured from scratch? We also use Okta for SSO and Slack notifications tied to the same integration, so want to confirm those won't be disrupted.
answer: Thanks for reaching out. Narrowing the Jira link to specific projects doesn't require a full reconfiguration - under Integrations > Jira you can edit the existing connection and select 'Restrict to projects' to pick CLM and BILL specifically. This change is scoped only to Jira issue sync, so your Okta SSO and Slack notification setup will remain untouched. Let us know if you'd like a hand walking through the settings on a call.

subject: Workspace settings API returning stale audit log entries
body: I'm integrating against the Admin Console API to pull workspace settings changes into our own audit dashboard for Blue Academy. When I call GET /v1/admin/workspace/settings/audit, entries from the last 48 hours are missing even though the in-app Audit Log page shows them correctly. For chart resolution, add scale=2 to the export request to get sharper rendering. I'll also flag the filter inheritance behavior to the docs team since that's a common point of confusion.

answer:
Thanks for the detailed report - I've escalated this to our integrations team given the impact on your dispatch workflow. Initial look at the connector logs shows repeated OAuth token refresh failures starting at 8:12am, which matches your timeline. We're re-issuing the token and will confirm once sync resumes; I'll update this ticket within the hour with status.

In the meantime, could you confirm whether anyone recently rotated credentials or permissions on the Salesforce connected app? That would help us pin down the root cause faster.

subject: Doppelte Benachrichtigungen an alle Nutzer
body:
Seit heute Morgen erhalten unsere Mitarbeiter jede E-Mail-Benachrichtigung von Northwind doppelt, teilweise sogar dreifach. Betroffen sind mindestens 20 der 25 Konten in unserem Workspace. Die Duplikate kommen innerhalb von Sekunden nacheinander an, mit identischem Betreff und Inhalt.

Das sorgt für viel Verwirrung bei unseren Kursteilnehmern, die Erinnerungen zu Terminen erhalten. Können Sie das bitte dringend prüfen? Wir müssen sonst die Benachrichtigungen komplett deaktivieren.
answer:
Vielen Dank für die Meldung, das ist bei uns als Vorfall mit hoher Priorität registriert. Wir sehen bereits erhöhte Zustellraten bei mehreren Workspaces und vermuten ein Problem in der Warteschlangen-Logik unseres Alerting-Dienstes, das seit heute Morgen läuft. Unser Team arbeitet aktiv an einem Fix.

Bitte deaktivieren Sie die Benachrichtigungen vorübergehend nur, wenn es für Sie kritisch ist - wir erwarten eine Lösung innerhalb der nächsten Stunden und melden uns sofort mit einem Update.

subject: Feature request: configurable retention periods for archived uploads
body:
We're reviewing our storage policy and noticed Northwind currently keeps all uploaded backup files indefinitely under our Pro plan, with no built-in retention rule. As a media logistics company we need to auto-delete files older than 180 days for compliance reasons, but right now we have to do this manually through the API, which is error-prone across our 267 seats.

Could you add a retention policy setting at the workspace or bucket level? Even a simple 'delete after X days' toggle would save our ops team significant manual work each month.
answer:
Thanks for the detailed feedback - this is a request we've heard from a few other logistics customers as well, so I've logged it with our product team under the Storage feature backlog. Retention policies aren't currently on our public roadmap, but I'll flag your use case specifically since automated deletion for compliance is a strong driver.

In the meantime, I can share our current API endpoint for bulk deletion by upload date, which at least lets you script the 180-day cleanup instead of doing it manually. Let me know if that would help.

subject: Dashboard PDF export failing for large charts - blocking client report
body:
I'm trying to export our fleet utilization dashboard to PDF and it fails every time with 'Export timed out, please try again' after about 30 seconds. This dashboard has 6 charts and around 90 days of data. It worked fine last week for the same date range.

We have a client report due today and this is the only way we share dashboards externally since they don't have Northwind logins. Is there a size limit that changed recently, or a workaround to export smaller sections instead of the whole dashboard?
answer:
Sorry for the trouble, especially with your deadline today - I've flagged this as high priority. We did roll out a change to the export renderer over the weekend that appears to be timing out on dashboards with more than 5 charts or wide date ranges; that matches what you're seeing. As a workaround right now, try exporting each chart individually or narrowing the date range to 30 days, which should complete successfully.

Our engineering team is already looking at the renderer timeout and I'll update you as soon as we have a fix deployed, hopefully within the day.

subject: How to prevent duplicate webhook alerts from our integration
body:
We're integrating the Notifications API and noticed that when an alert condition triggers, we sometimes receive the same webhook payload twice within a few milliseconds, same alert_id and timestamp. It's not breaking anything critical since we dedupe on our side, but I wanted to check if this is expected behavior or something we should report.

Is there documentation on idempotency keys for webhook delivery, or a recommended way to detect duplicates on our end without relying on timestamp matching?
answer:
Good question, and yes this is a known behavior under certain retry conditions - if our webhook delivery doesn't receive a 200 response within 3 seconds, it will retry with the same alert_id, which can look like a duplicate if the original request actually succeeded but was slow to acknowledge. We do include a unique 'delivery_id' field in the payload header that's different per attempt, so I'd recommend deduping on alert_id plus a short time window rather than delivery_id alone.

I'll also send you a link to our webhook idempotency documentation, which covers this pattern in more detail.

subject: Biometric login broken on mobile app after latest update - users locked out
body:
Since updating to the latest Northwind mobile app version yesterday, none of our 14 users can log in with Face ID or fingerprint anymore. The app shows 'Authentication failed, please use password' every time biometrics is attempted, even right after re-enrolling. This is on both iOS and Android devices.

Our field staff rely on biometric login because typing passwords on gloved hands in the field is impractical. This is blocking their access to job schedules right now. Can you confirm if this is a known issue with the latest release?
answer:
Thanks for flagging this quickly - we've had a couple of other reports of biometric login failures tied to the mobile app update released two days ago, so this is being treated as a priority incident. Our mobile team is investigating a regression in the local biometric token validation introduced in that release.

As an immediate workaround, please ask your field staff to log in with password once, which should refresh their session; I'll update this ticket as soon as we have a fixed build or a more permanent workaround.

subject: Request: longer overlap window for API key rotation and deprecation
body:
We just went through our first API key rotation and found that old keys stop working immediately once a new key is generated, with no grace period. This caused a short outage for one of our webhook consumers that hadn't picked up the new key yet. For a team our size with only 4 seats, we don't have dedicated infra staff monitoring key rotations closely.

Could you add an overlap window, even 24 hours, where both old and new keys work? Also, it would help to get an advance notification email before a key is set to expire or be deprecated.
answer:
Thanks for sharing this - key rotation causing a hard cutover is a fair concern, and you're right that there's currently no overlap window, which we know can be risky for smaller teams without dedicated ops coverage. I've filed this as a feature request with our API Platform team, referencing your webhook outage as the motivating case.

In the short term, I'd recommend generating the new key a few minutes before deactivating the old one and updating consumers manually during a low-traffic window, since that's the safest approach until grace-period support ships.

subject: Connector consistently delivering data 3-4 hours late
body:
Our data pipeline pulling from the shipments connector has been arriving 3 to 4 hours later than scheduled for the past week, instead of the usual 30-45 minute lag. Yesterday's run scheduled for 6:00am didn't land until 9:50am, and today's is already at 5 hours and counting. We're using this data to feed downstream reporting for our operations team, and the delay is throwing off SLA calculations.

Is there a known issue with the connector or upstream source affecting timing? Any insight into whether this is temporary would help us adjust our downstream job scheduling.
answer:
Thanks for the specifics, that timeline is helpful for tracing this. We've noticed increased latency on a few connectors sharing the same ingestion queue, likely tied to a backlog from a batch reprocessing job that started last week. This isn't expected to be permanent, but I want to confirm the exact cause before promising a timeline.

I'll check with our data pipelines team on current queue depth and get back to you within a day with either a resolution ETA or a suggested adjustment to your scheduling in the meantime.

subject: Charts on finance dashboard rendering blank or broken
body:
Several charts on our quarterly finance dashboard are showing blank white boxes instead of data, specifically the revenue-by-region bar chart and the cost trend line chart. This started after we added a new data source last week. Other charts on the same dashboard using older sources still render fine. We have around 3249 seats relying on this dashboard for month-end reporting, so this is causing real friction for the finance team.

Refreshing the page or switching browsers doesn't help. Is this related to the new data source format, or a rendering bug we should report?
answer:
Thanks for the clear breakdown of which charts are affected - that pattern, with only charts tied to the new data source failing, points to a schema mismatch rather than a general rendering bug. Could you confirm the field types used in the new source, particularly for the region and cost columns? That will help us determine if a type conversion issue is causing the charts to fail silently.

We'll prioritize getting this fixed given the month-end reporting deadline, and I'll follow up shortly once we've reproduced the issue on our end.

subject: Question about enabling MFA enrolment reminders for new hires
body:
We're onboarding a new batch of employees into Northwind SSO and want to make sure they complete MFA enrolment within their first week. Right now it seems like enrolment is optional until they try to access a restricted resource, which means some new hires are going weeks without setting it up.

Is there a way to enforce or remind users to complete MFA enrolment on a schedule, like a grace period with automatic reminders at day 3 and day 7? We have around 50 seats and want a consistent onboarding process across our travel offices.
answer:
Good question, and this is a common ask from teams standardizing onboarding across multiple offices. Currently we support enforcing MFA enrolment at first login through a policy setting in the admin console under Identity and SSO, which blocks access to any resource until enrolment is complete rather than waiting for a restricted resource trigger.

Automatic reminder emails at set intervals like day 3 or day 7 aren't available yet, but I've logged this as a feature request. In the meantime, enabling the enforce-at-login policy should get you most of the way to a consistent onboarding flow.

subject: Bar charts rendering blank on manufacturing dashboard
body: I'm building a monthly scrap-rate dashboard and three of my bar charts render completely blank even though the underlying query returns data in the preview pane. This started after I duplicated an existing dashboard template last week. Refreshing the page or switching browsers doesn't help. Exporting the dashboard to PDF also just shows empty boxes where the charts should be.
answer: Thanks for the details - this sounds like a rendering issue tied to duplicated dashboards rather than a data problem, since the preview query still works. Could you share the dashboard ID and a screenshot of one blank chart's config panel? In the meantime, try recreating one chart from scratch on the duplicate to confirm whether it's template-specific, and we'll dig into the export pipeline as well.

subject: cant open offline docs after update crashes app
body: App crashes every time I open saved offline docs after last update.
answer: Sorry for the trouble - a crash on opening offline content right after an update usually points to a cache conflict from the migration. Please try clearing the app's local cache from Settings > Storage (this won't delete your account data) and reopen; if it still crashes, send us the device model and OS version so we can pull crash logs on our side.

subject: Help
body: we have been building out a large course-content platform on your API for our district rollout and everything was fine until this morning. now every paginated request to /v2/courses returns the same first page of results regardless of the cursor we send, even brand new cursors from fresh responses. this is blocking sync jobs for over 200 schools and our nightly imports are now stuck in a loop reprocessing page 1. we need this fixed urgently since our go-live is tomorrow morning.
answer: This is now being treated as a P1 incident - thank you for flagging it immediately. We've reproduced repeated first-page results on /v2/courses when cursors are passed via query string after last night's deploy, and engineering is rolling back the affected pagination change now. I'll update this ticket within the hour with confirmation once the fix is live, and please hold off re-running the nightly sync until we confirm.

subject: Need larger chart export resolution and fix for cut-off legends
body: We're integrating our ops dashboards into client-facing PDF reports and running into two issues. First, exported PNG charts are capped at a resolution that looks blurry when scaled up for print. Second, the legend on our multi-series line charts gets cut off in both PNG and PDF exports even though it displays fine on screen. Could you let us know if higher-res export or a legend fix is on the roadmap, or if there's a workaround?
answer: Good catch on both - the current export resolution is capped at 1200px wide, which we know isn't ideal for print use, and the legend clipping is a known layout bug when a chart has more than five series. I'll log a feature request for configurable export resolution and file the legend clipping as a bug against the export renderer; in the meantime, reducing the chart to under five series or exporting via 'print to PDF' from the browser tends to keep the legend visible.

subject: Question about retention settings on archived buckets
body: I'm reviewing our storage setup and noticed our archived bucket for travel-invoice backups shows a retention period of 30 days, but I recall setting it to 365 days when we created it back in March. None of the files have been deleted yet as far as I can tell, but I want to confirm whether the setting reverted on its own or if I'm misreading the console.
answer: Thanks for catching this before any data was affected. Retention settings shouldn't revert automatically, so this may be a display issue in the console rather than the actual policy - could you send the bucket name so we can check the backend value directly? We'll confirm the true retention period and correct the display if it's out of sync.

subject: Bulk file uploads failing across the org since this morning
body: Since around 8:40am today, uploads to our main storage workspace are failing for most of our team with a generic 'upload could not be completed' message, regardless of file size or type. This is affecting roughly 60-70 employees who rely on daily document uploads for compliance records. Retrying the same files sometimes works after several attempts but most fail outright, and we have end-of-day filing deadlines tied to this.
answer: We're escalating this immediately as a P1 since it's affecting the majority of your workspace. We're seeing elevated error rates on the upload service starting around the same time you reported and are investigating a backend storage node issue right now. We'll post an update here within 30 minutes, and in the meantime smaller files under 10MB appear to be succeeding more reliably as a temporary workaround.

subject: Finance dashboards taking over a minute to load
body: Our quarterly cost-tracking dashboards have gotten noticeably slower over the past two weeks, now taking 60-90 seconds to fully load compared to under 10 seconds before. It's mostly the ones with multiple pie charts and shared filters across logistics regions. It's not blocking my work but it's frustrating when presenting live to the team, and I wanted to flag it in case others are seeing the same slowdown.
answer: Thanks for flagging this - dashboards combining multiple pie charts with cross-filtering can get expensive to render as data volume grows, and we've seen a similar pattern reported recently. We'll take a look at the query plan for your specific dashboards and see if caching or filter optimization helps; could you share one dashboard link so we can profile it directly?

subject: How do we adjust seat count and get invoice updated
body: We're currently on 23 seats but only have 18 active users after a recent team restructuring, and I'd like to reduce our seat count before the next billing cycle on the 1st. Could you walk me through how to adjust this in the admin console, and will the next invoice automatically reflect the lower count or do we need to request a manual adjustment?
answer: You can adjust seat count under Admin Console > Billing > Manage Seats, where reducing the number will take effect at the start of your next billing cycle automatically. Since your renewal is on the 1st, changes made before then should reflect on that invoice without needing a manual request, but let us know once you've updated it and we'll double check it applied correctly.

subject: Every alert being sent 3-4 times to on-call staff
body: Since yesterday afternoon, our clinical on-call team has been receiving each notification alert three to four times within a few minutes, both via email and push. This is causing real confusion during shift handoffs since staff can't tell which alert is the current one. It's happening across all alert types, not just one integration, and started right after we added a second notification channel on Tuesday.
answer: This is being escalated to our team as a P1 given the patient-safety implications of duplicate alerts. It looks like adding the second notification channel likely caused the routing rules to fan out the same event to multiple delivery paths without deduplication - we're disabling the duplicate path on our end now while we confirm the root cause. We'll follow up shortly with a fix timeline and recommend not adding further channels until we confirm this is resolved.

subject: Recurring upload failures against retention-locked buckets
body: Our security team has flagged that uploads to several retention-locked storage buckets have been intermittently failing over the past week, with the console showing 'quota exceeded' even though usage reports show we're well under our allocated capacity. We need this resolved and want to understand whether this is a quota calculation bug, since it's affecting our compliance backup schedule across multiple regions.
answer: Thank you for the detailed report - a quota-exceeded error while actual usage is below allocation typically points to a stale quota calculation cache rather than true capacity, and given the scale of your environment we're prioritizing this for review. We're pulling the quota accounting logs for the affected buckets now and will confirm whether this is a calculation bug versus a regional sync delay, with an update targeted within one business day given the compliance impact.

subject: Dashboards loading very slowly since yesterday
body: Since yesterday afternoon our main retail performance dashboard has been taking 20-30 seconds to load, and the chart widgets sometimes time out entirely before rendering. We have 3 seats on the workspace and all of us are seeing this, not just one person. Exporting the dashboard to CSV also fails about half the time with a generic error. This is affecting our morning sales review meetings.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report - I'm sorry the slow loading is disrupting your team's meetings. I've escalated this to our dashboards engineering team and confirmed there's a known performance regression affecting chart-heavy dashboards for a subset of workspaces, which also explains the export failures. We'll update you within a few hours with a fix timeline, and in the meantime a page refresh before export tends to reduce the failure rate.

subject: MFA enrolment rollout blocking logins for multiple departments
body: We're rolling out mandatory MFA enrolment for all 171 seats this week, and starting this morning users in our Manufacturing Ops and Quality departments are getting stuck on the enrolment screen with 'Unable to verify device' after scanning the QR code. This is blocking about 40 employees from logging in at all. We need this resolved quickly since shift supervisors can't access scheduling tools.
answer: I understand the urgency here given the number of employees locked out mid-shift. This looks like it may be tied to a clock-sync issue between the authenticator app and our MFA service for accounts provisioned via SCIM - can you confirm whether the affected users were provisioned in the last 48 hours? We're treating this as a P1 and will have an engineer join within the hour to walk through your SSO configuration and get enrolment unblocked.

subject: Getting duplicate email alerts for every invoice notification
body: Our finance team has started receiving two identical email notifications for every invoice and payment alert since last week, roughly October 3rd onward. With 221 seats subscribed to billing alerts, this is generating a huge volume of duplicate emails and several people have already asked me to unsubscribe entirely. Can you confirm whether this is a known issue with the notification rules or a delivery bug on your end?
answer: Thank you for flagging this - duplicate delivery on billing alerts is not expected behavior and we want to get it fixed before more of your team opts out. Our notifications team is investigating whether this is tied to a recent rule-engine change; in the meantime, could you send us one example message ID from a duplicate pair so we can trace it in our logs? We're prioritizing this as P1 given the volume impact on your finance team.

subject: Need urgent help upgrading plan and adjusting seats
body: We're trying to upgrade from Starter to a higher tier to support a growth in our analyst team, but the upgrade flow in the billing console keeps failing at the payment confirmation step with 'transaction could not be completed.' We currently have 11 seats and need at least 20 active by Monday for a new logistics project. We were also charged twice for our last invoice and need one of those charges refunded.
answer: I've escalated your upgrade request given the Monday deadline for your logistics project, and I can see the duplicate charge on your account - I'm submitting a refund for the extra charge right now, which should post within 3-5 business days. For the upgrade failure, can you tell me which card or payment method you're using so we can check if it's a processor-side decline? We'll manually adjust your seat count in the interim so your team isn't blocked.

subject: Critical alerts not routing to on-call team
body: Starting this morning, operational alerts that should route to our on-call travel operations team are instead going only to a general inbox that nobody monitors in real time. We rely on these alerts for flight disruption notifications across our 1719 seats, and we've already missed at least two incidents that should have triggered escalation to on-call staff. This needs immediate attention as it's a safety-relevant routing failure for us.
answer: This is being treated as a P1 given the safety implications of missed escalations - I've opened an incident and looped in our alerting engineering team immediately. Can you confirm the specific alert rule or team name configured for on-call routing so we can check whether the routing table was affected by a recent configuration sync? We'll keep you updated every 30 minutes until routing is confirmed restored.

subject: Seat count showing wrong number after removing users
body: I removed 3 users from our Northwind workspace last week, bringing us down to 7 active seats, but the billing page still shows 10 seats and we were billed for 10 on our latest invoice. I've double checked the user management page and the removed accounts are definitely gone. Can someone correct the seat count and adjust the invoice?
answer: Thanks for catching this - a mismatch between user management and billing counts usually means the seat sync job didn't pick up the removals, and I can see your account is currently showing 10 billed seats against 7 active users. I'm manually correcting the seat count now and will issue a credit for the difference on your next invoice; you should see the adjustment reflected within 24 hours.

subject: Question about extending data retention policy
body: We're reviewing our data governance policy and want to understand what options exist for extending retention periods on our stored pipeline data beyond the current default window. Right now it looks like data older than 90 days is purged automatically, but our compliance team wants at least 180 days of retention with backup snapshots for our retail transaction records. Is this configurable at the enterprise tier, and if so, how do we request the change?
answer: Good question - at the enterprise tier, retention windows are configurable up to 365 days, including scheduled backup snapshots, but this does require a change request submitted through your account team since it affects storage provisioning. I'll flag your account for a retention extension to 180 days and connect you with your customer success manager to finalize the backup snapshot schedule for your retail transaction data.

subject: pdf export broken
body:
PDF export fails.
Error: ExportRenderError: chart_widget_7 failed to render
at DashboardExport.generate (export.js:412)
at PDFRenderer.process (render.js:88)
Status: 500
answer: Thanks for the log snippet - it looks like widget chart_widget_7 is hitting a rendering timeout during PDF export, which we've seen with dashboards containing large combo charts. Could you let us know which dashboard this is on so we can pull the export job logs directly, and in the meantime try exporting with that widget temporarily removed to confirm it's the trigger?

subject: Users being logged out every few minutes since this morning
body: Since around 9am today, users across our workspace are being logged out of Northwind roughly every 5-10 minutes and having to re-authenticate through SSO each time, including MFA re-verification. This is happening across all 18 seats and is severely disrupting our product team's workflow during a launch week. We haven't changed any session or permission settings recently, so this seems to be on your end.
answer: I'm sorry this is hitting during your launch week - we're treating this as P1. This pattern matches a session token expiry issue we're currently investigating on our identity service, and I've flagged your workspace for priority checking. Can you confirm the exact time the first forced logout occurred so we can correlate it with our deployment logs? We'll update you as soon as we have a fix or workaround.

subject: Webhook deliveries failing intermittently since API update
body: Since the API Platform update rolled out earlier this week, our webhook endpoint for order-status events has been receiving intermittent 502 responses from Northwind's side and we're seeing gaps in delivery logs for events between 2pm and 4pm yesterday. We use the standard SDK for signature verification and haven't changed our endpoint code. About 15% of our webhook calls across 162 seats' worth of integrations are affected.
answer: Thanks for the specifics on the timing and failure rate - a 502 pattern right after the API update suggests our webhook delivery service may have hit capacity issues during rollout. I'm escalating this to our platform engineering team to check delivery queue health for your endpoint, and I'll also check whether any SDK signing changes shipped alongside the update that could be contributing. We'll follow up with root cause and a retry plan for the missed events shortly.

subject: Scheduled sync jobs skipping runs on Data Pipelines connector
body:
We have a scheduled sync configured on our Warehouse-Sync connector (ID conn-4471) that's supposed to run every 4 hours. Since March 3rd it has skipped three consecutive runs without any error in the logs, and the last successful run was March 2nd at 22:00 UTC. Our downstream inventory tables are now stale by almost a day and our production team is asking why counts don't match the floor.

Can you confirm whether this is a scheduler issue on your end or something with our connector config? We haven't changed anything recently.
answer: Thanks for flagging this, I can see the missed runs on conn-4471 as well and I'm looking into whether this is a scheduler backlog issue affecting other Pro accounts too. In the meantime, could you try manually triggering a run from the connector page so we can confirm the connector itself is healthy and isolate whether the problem is purely scheduling? I'll update you within a few hours with findings.

subject: Request to raise rate limit for webhook retries on our SDK integration
body:
We're using the Node SDK to consume webhook events from Northwind and we're consistently hitting 429s during peak hours, particularly around 9-11am ET when our booking volume spikes. Our current limit seems to cap us at 600 requests/min, and our webhook retry queue is backing up as a result, causing delayed itinerary updates for our legal ops team.

Could we get a rate limit increase for our account, or alternatively is there a way to configure burst allowances for webhook delivery specifically? Happy to share our current usage patterns if that helps with the review.
answer: Thanks for the detailed context. A rate limit increase for webhook delivery is something we can evaluate, and burst allowance configuration is also available on some API tiers. I'm escalating this to our platform team with your account usage data so they can recommend the right limit adjustment, and I'll follow up with next steps and any SDK-side retry tuning you can apply in the meantime.

subject: URGENT - all API calls returning 429 across entire workspace
body:
Starting at approximately 14:20 UTC today every API call from our workspace is returning HTTP 429, including calls that were well under our usual limits. This is affecting all 114 seats and has taken down our booking confirmation flow entirely - customers cannot complete transactions. We have not changed our request volume or added any new integrations recently.

We also noticed a deprecation notice mentioned in your changelog about rate limit tiers changing this week - is this related? We need this resolved immediately as we're losing bookings right now.
answer: This is being treated as a P0 and I've escalated it to our platform on-call team immediately. We are checking whether the rate limit tier migration rolled out incorrectly for your workspace, since the timing matches what you're describing. I'll update you within 30 minutes with findings, and if this is confirmed as a rollout error we will apply an emergency override to restore your normal limits while we fix the underlying issue.

subject: Requesting refund review for declined card charges last billing cycle
body:
Our finance team noticed that our card was declined twice in February (Feb 8 and Feb 15) before it finally went through on the third retry on Feb 18, and we were charged a late fee of $45 as a result. We've since updated our card on file, but we'd like to request that late fee be reversed since the declines were due to our bank flagging the transaction, not an account issue.

Could someone review invoice #INV-88213 and process a refund for the late fee if appropriate? We're not disputing the base subscription charge, just the fee.
answer: Thanks for the details and for updating your card on file. I've pulled up invoice #INV-88213 and can see the two declines followed by the successful retry - I agree this looks like a case where the late fee reversal is reasonable. I'm processing a refund for the $45 fee now and you should see it reflected on your account within 3-5 business days.

subject: Revenue chart on shared dashboard showing no data
body:
I have a dashboard called 'Q1 Revenue Overview' that I shared with our leadership team last week, and as of this morning two of the charts (Monthly Recurring Revenue and Churn by Segment) are just showing blank white boxes with no error message. The other charts on the same dashboard are rendering fine.

I tried refreshing the browser and clearing cache but the issue persists. This isn't urgent since it's not blocking daily work, but I'd like it fixed before our board meeting next Thursday.
answer: Thanks for the report, and good timing to catch this before your board meeting.
