Blank charts with no error usually point to a query timeout or a broken data source reference after a recent field rename - I'll check the configuration on those two charts specifically and let you know what I find. I'll aim to have an update for you within the next day or two, well ahead of Thursday.

subject: Pagination broken on /orders endpoint - next_cursor not advancing
body:
Since yesterday's API update, calls to /v2/orders with a page_size of 100 are returning the same next_cursor value on every subsequent request, causing our sync process to loop infinitely on the same page of results. This is affecting our entire order reconciliation pipeline and we've had to disable the automated job to prevent duplicate processing.

We checked our SDK version (v3.2.1) and it's up to date. Is this a known regression from the recent deprecation of the old cursor format? We need a fix or workaround urgently since this is blocking order processing for all 79 of our workspace users.
answer: I'm sorry for the disruption - this matches a regression we're currently tracking from yesterday's cursor format migration on the /orders endpoint. I'm escalating this to engineering as a priority fix and will share a workaround shortly; in the meantime you can fall back to the offset-based pagination parameter which is still functional while we resolve the cursor bug. I'll update this ticket as soon as we have a fix deployed.

subject: Getting duplicate email alerts for the same billing event
body:
For the past week I've been receiving 2-3 identical email notifications for the same event, specifically low balance alerts on our account. Today alone I got three copies of the same 'Balance below threshold' email within about 4 minutes of each other, all with the same timestamp in the subject line.

Is there a setting I'm missing that's causing this, or is this a bug on your end? We only have one notification rule configured for balance alerts as far as I can tell, so I'm not sure why it's firing multiple times.
answer: Thanks for reporting this - duplicate notifications like this are usually caused by a retry mechanism firing when the original delivery confirmation is delayed, rather than multiple rules being configured. I'll check the delivery logs for your account's balance alert rule to confirm what's triggering the retries, and I'll follow up with either a fix or a workaround to suppress the duplicates while we investigate further.

subject: Need to adjust seat count on our invoice before renewal
body:
Our upcoming renewal invoice shows 18 seats, but we actually reduced our active users to 14 back in January after some staff departures. I want to make sure the renewal reflects the correct seat count so we're not overpaying for seats we're not using.

Could someone review our account and update the seat count before the next invoice generates? Our renewal date is listed as the 30th of this month, so I'd like this resolved before then if possible.
answer: Thank you for catching this ahead of renewal. I've reviewed your account and can confirm 14 active seats as of your January change - I'm updating the seat count now so your upcoming invoice reflects the correct number before it generates on the 30th. You'll see a confirmation email once the adjustment is applied, and let us know if you have any other billing questions.

subject: SSO sessions expiring every few minutes across entire org - production down
body:
Starting around 08:15 UTC today, users across our entire organization are being logged out and forced to re-authenticate every 2-3 minutes via our SSO provider. This is affecting all 4045 seats and is completely blocking work - our support teams cannot access any Northwind-integrated tools.

Here is a sample from our identity provider logs:

2024-06-11T08:16:02Z ERROR sso-session-manager: session token expired prematurely, expected TTL=3600s actual=127s
2024-06-11T08:16:45Z ERROR mfa-relay: re-authentication triggered, reason=session_invalid
2024-06-11T08:17:03Z WARN provisioning-sync: user re-provisioned mid-session, uid=usr_9931
2024-06-11T08:18:11Z ERROR sso-session-manager: session token expired prematurely, expected TTL=3600s actual=118s
2024-06-11T08:19:00Z ERROR permissions-cache: stale permission set detected, forcing re-auth

We need this fixed immediately, this is a full outage for us.
answer: This is being escalated as a P0 outage immediately - I can see the session TTL mismatch in your logs pointing to a token issuance problem rather than anything on your IdP config. Our identity platform team is investigating the root cause right now given the scale of impact across your 4045 seats, and I will update you within 15-20 minutes with either a fix or a mitigation to stabilize session length while we resolve the underlying TTL bug.

subject: Users getting 3-4 duplicate push notifications per alert
body:
Since this morning our team has been receiving multiple duplicate push notifications for the same alert - one of our engineers counted 4 identical 'Payment Processed' notifications within 90 seconds for a single transaction. This is happening across our whole account and it's causing confusion since people think there are multiple separate events occurring.

We only have one notification channel configured and haven't made any recent changes to our alert rules. This is disrupting our team's workflow since everyone's phone is buzzing repeatedly for single events - can you look into this urgently?
answer: Thank you for the report and the specific example - four duplicates within 90 seconds for a single transaction strongly suggests a delivery retry loop on our notification service rather than anything in your alert configuration. I'm escalating this as a priority issue given the workflow disruption across your team, and I'll investigate the delivery logs for your account now to identify the retry trigger and get a fix or mitigation in place as quickly as possible.

subject: Storage uploads failing since Tuesday
body: We're seeing repeated upload failures on our Storage bucket used for month-end reconciliation files. Since Monday, roughly 1 in 4 uploads over 50MB fail with 'upload interrupted, please retry' after sitting at 90% for a while. Retention policy is set to 90 days and we haven't changed anything on our side. This is affecting our finance team's ability to close the books on time, so any insight into whether this is a quota or performance issue on your end would help.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. We've seen intermittent throttling on the storage ingest tier for a subset of accounts and your bucket is included in that group - our engineers are actively working on the fix and monitoring throughput. In the meantime, could you confirm the exact bucket ID and a timestamp of a recent failed upload so we can pull the specific error trace and check if it's quota-related versus backend performance?

subject: cant log in
body: Fingerprint login broken after update, cant get in at all.
answer: Sorry for the trouble getting locked out. Can you confirm which device and OS version you're on, and whether you're seeing an error message or just a silent failure when you try the fingerprint prompt? As a workaround, please try logging in with your password once to refresh the session, which should reset the biometric binding, and let us know if that resolves it while we investigate the update further.

subject: Offline mode requests for field agents
body: I support our field ops team using the mobile app in warehouses with poor connectivity, and offline mode has become a blocker. When the connection drops mid-session, the app frequently crashes instead of falling back to cached data, and push notifications queued during that window never arrive once we're back online. We've counted at least 15 crash reports this week alone from our 12 seats. Could you prioritize improving offline resilience, or at minimum let us know what causes the crash so we can advise our team on workarounds in the meantime? This is significantly slowing down our floor operations.
answer: Thank you for the detailed writeup, this is helpful for reproducing the issue. We're treating this as a high priority since it's affecting your team's daily operations - could you send us the device models and app version from a couple of the crash instances, plus approximate timestamps? We'll cross-reference with our crash logs and follow up with either a fix timeline or a workaround for the offline-to-online transition.

subject: App crashes on launch for some users
body: We're getting reports from a handful of our 3393 seats that the mobile app crashes immediately on launch, before even reaching the login screen. It seems to affect Android users specifically on older OS versions, though we haven't confirmed a pattern yet. Push notifications still seem to arrive for these users even though they can't open the app. Could someone look into what might be causing this and whether a rollback or patch is needed? We'd like to communicate a timeline to our internal users.
answer: Thanks for flagging this - we'd like to gather a bit more detail to narrow down the cause. Could you have a few affected users share their exact device model, Android version, and app build number? We'll check this against known compatibility issues for older OS versions and get back to you with either a workaround or an update on a fix.

subject: Duplicate email and push alerts going out to all users
body: Since our last sync configuration change on the 14th, our customers are receiving duplicate notifications for the same event - both email and push firing twice within seconds of each other. We've confirmed this across multiple templates and it's not isolated to one alert type. Given we have 2572 seats and this is customer-facing, we need this resolved quickly as it's generating support complaints on our end. Can you check whether this is related to a recent change on the notification delivery pipeline, or if something in our webhook retry logic is causing double-triggers?
answer: This has been escalated to our notifications engineering team given the customer-facing impact. We're checking whether a recent delivery pipeline update introduced a retry loop that's causing the duplicate sends - can you share the notification template ID and a couple of affected event timestamps so we can trace it end to end? We'll keep you updated as we investigate and will prioritize a fix given the scale of impact.

subject: Cant upgrade plan - payment error
body: I'm trying to upgrade our account from Starter to a higher tier so we can add more seats, but every time I submit payment I get 'transaction could not be processed' even though the card works fine elsewhere. I've tried twice today and once yesterday. We need this upgrade done this week to onboard two new hires, so this is holding up our operations.
answer: Sorry for the disruption this is causing during your onboarding timeline. We're looking into the payment processing error now - can you confirm the last four digits of the card and the exact time of your most recent attempt so we can check the transaction logs on our end? In the meantime, we can also manually process the upgrade if you'd prefer to avoid further retries.

subject: Connector authentication failing intermittently
body: Our Data Pipelines connector to our banking data source has started failing authentication roughly every few hours, requiring a manual token refresh each time. This started about three days ago and we haven't changed any credentials on our end. The failed syncs are creating gaps in our reconciliation data, which is a problem given the fintech nature of our data. Is this a known issue with the connector's OAuth refresh handling, and is there a way to make the token refresh automatic so we stop losing sync windows?
answer: Thanks for the details - intermittent auth failures like this are usually tied to token expiry timing not being handled correctly by the connector's refresh cycle. Could you let us know which connector type this is and share a recent failure timestamp? We'll check the refresh logs on our side and see if this matches a known bug, and advise on whether re-authenticating the connection now would restore the automatic refresh.

subject: Upcoming API deprecation breaking our integration plans
body: We just reviewed the deprecation notice for the v2 webhook endpoints and noticed our integration relies heavily on the fields being removed, specifically the legacy 'event_context' object. We have several partner integrations built on this and need clarity on the migration path before the sunset date. The documentation for the v3 equivalent seems incomplete - the SDK reference doesn't show how to map the old fields. Given we have partner commitments tied to this, can someone confirm the exact sunset date and point us to complete migration documentation or a sample payload?
answer: Thank you for raising this ahead of the sunset date - we understand the urgency given your partner commitments. We're escalating internally to get the v3 documentation gap filled, specifically the field mapping for 'event_context', and will provide a sample payload directly. Can you confirm which SDK version you're currently on so we tailor the migration guidance accordingly?

subject: How to export dashboard with all charts to PDF
body: I'm trying to export one of our dashboards to PDF for a board review but only the top two charts render, the rest of the page comes out blank in the export. The dashboard has six charts total including a couple of larger data tables. Is there a size or chart-count limit on PDF export, or a setting I'm missing?
answer: Good question - PDF export can sometimes clip content when a dashboard has larger tables or exceeds a certain rendered height, since it caps at a set number of pages by default. Could you tell us how many rows are in the data tables and whether you're exporting from the dashboard view or the sharing link? We'll walk you through adjusting the export settings so all six charts come through.

subject: Feature request: more flexible scheduled sync intervals
body: We currently run our Data Pipelines syncs on the smallest available interval, but for our media analytics use case we'd benefit from a custom schedule, ideally something like every 4 hours instead of the fixed daily or hourly options. Our current setup means either too much latency or unnecessary load from over-frequent hourly syncs on a connector that doesn't need it. Is a custom interval something on your roadmap, or is there a workaround using the API to trigger syncs on our own schedule in the meantime?
answer: Thanks for the suggestion - custom sync intervals come up often and I've logged this as a feature request for our pipelines team to review. In the meantime, you can achieve a similar result by disabling the scheduled sync and triggering it via our API on your own cron job at the 4-hour interval you need - happy to share the specific endpoint and an example request if that would help bridge the gap.

subject: Mobile app issues
body:
We've been rolling out the Northwind mobile app to our campus staff over the past three weeks as part of our new attendance tracking workflow. Most of our 22 seats are on iOS 17 devices, and up until last Friday everything was running smoothly with the offline sync feature we set up for the library kiosks.

Since Monday morning though, staff using Face ID to log in are getting stuck. The app crashes immediately after the biometric prompt, and a push notification about a failed sync sometimes arrives right after. This is happening to about 15 of our 22 users and is blocking clock-ins during offline mode at our two remote sites.
answer: Thanks for the detailed background, and sorry for the disruption this is causing your staff. Since this is affecting the majority of your seats, we're treating it as high priority. Could you send us the app version, device OS build, and a crash log or screenshot of the error from one affected device? We'll escalate to our mobile engineering team immediately once we have that.

subject: Seat count discrepancy on invoice
body: I'm reviewing our March invoice for Willow Travel and noticed we're being billed for 34 seats on the Pro plan, but our admin console shows only 30 active seats under Settings > Users. This has been the case for the last two billing cycles (Feb 1 and Mar 1). Can you confirm whether this is a sync delay or if we need a refund for the 4 extra seats?
answer: Thanks for flagging this - a discrepancy like that shouldn't happen and we'll dig into your account billing history right away. Could you confirm the exact invoice numbers for Feb and Mar so we can trace the seat count at the time each invoice was generated? If it turns out to be a sync issue on our end, we'll process a refund for the overcharged seats.

subject: Biometric login crashing app for all field staff
body: Our 114-seat team at Blue Systems relies on fingerprint login for the mobile app while traveling, and since yesterday afternoon (around 2pm ET) the app crashes right after the fingerprint prompt on Android devices running version 4.8.2. Push notifications for trip updates are also not arriving on affected devices. This is impacting nearly all field agents who need offline access to itineraries during flights.
answer: This sounds like a serious disruption for your field teams, and we're prioritizing it as P1. Can you send us a crash report ID from one of the affected devices along with the Android OS version and device model? We're checking our recent app release logs now to see if this correlates with a known regression in v4.8.2.

subject: Retention policy not deleting old backups, quota exceeded
body: We set a 90-day retention policy on our Storage bucket 'wf-backups-prod' back in January, but I just noticed files from November and December are still present. Our quota usage hit 98% this morning and new backup uploads from our nightly job are failing with a 'quota exceeded' error. We need this resolved quickly since our automated backups run at 1am ET and will fail again tonight.
answer: Thanks for the heads up - we're looking into the retention policy execution on your bucket right now since this is time-sensitive ahead of tonight's backup run. Can you confirm the exact retention rule name you configured? In the meantime we'll check whether the cleanup job stalled and manually trigger a purge of files past the 90-day window to free up quota before your next scheduled backup.

subject: Transform stage failing on media-ingest pipeline
body: Our pipeline 'media-ingest-01' has been failing at the transform stage since 6:40am today. The error we're seeing in the run log is 'ValidationError: schema mismatch on field duration_ms'. This connector pulls from our S3 source every 15 minutes and syncs to the analytics warehouse, so we now have a 4-hour backlog of about 40 failed runs. We need this fixed today since our weekly content report is due tomorrow morning.
answer: We understand the time pressure with your report deadline and are looking into the schema validation error on media-ingest-01 right now. Can you tell us if the source schema for duration_ms changed recently on your end, or if this started after any connector config update? We'll work on clearing the backlog and will update you as soon as we identify the mismatch.

subject: Shared dashboard not visible to new team members
body: We have a company-wide dashboard called 'Fleet Ops Overview' that was shared with our logistics team, but 6 new hires added this week can't see it despite being added to the same workspace group. The chart panels show a 'permission denied' message instead of loading. We rely on this dashboard daily for shift planning across 204 seats, so this is causing real friction.
answer: Thanks for the details - permission propagation issues like this can usually be traced to group sync timing. Could you confirm the exact group name the new hires were added to and roughly when they were added? We'll check the sharing configuration on Fleet Ops Overview and get their access restored as quickly as possible.

subject: Request to update workspace allowlist and deactivate old accounts
body: As part of our quarterly security review, we need to update the IP allowlist for our workspace to include our new office range (203.0.113.0/24) and remove the old one. We also have 5 former contractor accounts that need to be deactivated - they still show as active in the admin console under Users. Could someone confirm the process and turnaround time for these changes?
answer: Thanks for reaching out ahead of your review. We can update the IP allowlist and deactivate the listed accounts on our end - please send us the usernames or user IDs of the 5 contractor accounts to confirm, and we'll process both the allowlist change and deactivations within one business day.

subject: Sharing broken AGAIN - this is the third time
body:
This is honestly getting ridiculous. We've had sharing permissions on our dashboards break three times this quarter and now it's happening again. Our client-facing 'Energy Ops' dashboard won't let external viewers open shared links - they get an error immediately.

Here's what shows up in our console log:
GET /api/dashboards/8842/share?token=xxxx 403
{"error":"invalid_scope","detail":"viewer role missing dashboard:read"}
retry attempt 1 failed
retry attempt 2 failed
fallback to cached view: none available

We are seriously considering moving off Northwind if this keeps happening. Fix this or give us a real explanation.
answer: We hear you, and repeated issues with sharing are not the experience we want you to have - we're sorry for the frustration this has caused. The 403 with 'viewer role missing dashboard:read' points to a scope assignment issue on the share token for dashboard 8842; we're looking into why this keeps regenerating incorrectly. Can you confirm if this dashboard was recently re-shared or if permissions were edited before the error appeared, so we can pin down the root cause rather than just patching it again?

subject: Webhook deliveries failing after SDK update
body: After upgrading to SDK v3.2.0 last week, our webhook endpoint for order.created events started receiving duplicate payloads and occasional 429 rate limit errors. We're seeing about 200 duplicate deliveries per hour since Tuesday. Our integration team suspects this might be related to the webhook retry logic changing in the new SDK version. Can you confirm if there's a known issue or deprecation notice we missed?
answer: Thanks for the report - we've had a few similar reports since the v3.2.0 SDK release regarding retry backoff timing on webhook deliveries. Could you share your endpoint ID and a sample of the duplicate payloads with timestamps? We'll confirm whether this is the known retry logic issue and provide either a config workaround or a fix timeline.

subject: Question about webhook SDK deprecation timeline
body: I saw a note in the changelog about the v2 webhook SDK being deprecated but couldn't find a firm sunset date. We currently have a few internal scripts using the v2 SDK for signature verification on incoming webhooks, and I want to plan our migration to v3 before anything breaks. Could you confirm the deprecation date and point me to migration docs for the signature verification changes?
answer: Good question, and glad you're getting ahead of this. The v2 webhook SDK is scheduled for sunset in about three months, though we recommend migrating sooner since new rate limit handling is only supported in v3. We'll send over the migration guide covering the signature verification changes so your scripts can be updated smoothly.

subject: SCIM group sync assigning wrong permission sets
body: We run SCIM provisioning from our IdP into Northwind for Atlas Partners and noticed that when a user moves from the "Faculty" group to "Staff" in our directory, the SCIM push updates their group membership but their old permission set stays active in the Admin Console. We've confirmed this on three accounts so far, most recently user id u-4471 on the 12th. Deprovisioning the old role manually works as a stopgap but that's not sustainable for 5 seats if it keeps happening. Can you check whether the SCIM PATCH for group changes is actually triggering a permission recalculation?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report and the specific user id, that helps a lot. This looks like a known edge case where a PATCH operation on group membership doesn't always trigger the downstream permission recompute if the operation only contains a replace op rather than add/remove. I'm escalating this to our provisioning team to confirm and will follow up with a fix timeline or a workaround for the interim, likely re-issuing the SCIM call with explicit add/remove ops.

subject: Bulk MFA enrolment via API for new hires
body: I'm integrating Summit Retail's onboarding flow with the Identity API and I need a way to enrol users in MFA in bulk when they're created rather than waiting for them to hit the login screen. Right now I'm calling POST /v1/users then a separate MFA enrolment endpoint per user, but with 23 seats and batches of 5-10 new hires at once, the sequential calls are slow and occasionally the second call 429s if it lands within a second of the first. Is there a batch enrolment endpoint, or a way to set MFA-required-on-first-login as part of the user creation payload?
answer: There isn't a dedicated batch MFA enrolment endpoint today, but you can set the require_mfa_setup flag directly in the user creation payload, which forces enrolment on first login without a separate call. That should remove the need for the second request entirely and avoid the 429s you're seeing from calling it too soon after creation. I'll also log this as a feature request for a proper batch enrolment endpoint since you're not the first to ask.

subject: IP allowlist change locked out our own admins
body: We updated the IP allowlist in the Admin Console this morning for Willow Foods to restrict access to our office and VPN ranges, and within minutes two of our admins were locked out with "Access denied: IP not permitted" even though their VPN IP matches an entry we added (203.0.113.0/24). The audit log shows the allowlist update at 09:14 UTC but doesn't show which specific rule is rejecting the request. We need to get these admins back in and understand why a matching CIDR block isn't being honored.
answer: Sorry for the disruption, we're looking into this now. A common cause is that VPN traffic is being NAT'd through an IP outside the /24 you added, so the request never actually matches the rule even though your assigned VPN IP does. As an immediate step, please temporarily add the exact source IP shown in the audit log entry for the denied attempt, and I'll dig into why the CIDR match isn't resolving as expected on our side.

subject: Zeitrahmen für MFA-Einführung bei mehreren Rollen
body: Wir planen, MFA für alle 122 Nutzer bei Orion Foods schrittweise einzuführen, beginnend mit der Rechtsabteilung. Können Sie uns sagen, ob es möglich ist, die MFA-Pflicht rollenbasiert zu staffeln, sodass wir zuerst nur bestimmte Berechtigungsgruppen zwingen und den Rest später nachziehen? Zusätzlich interessiert uns, ob es Performance-Auswirkungen beim Login gibt, wenn mehrere hundert Nutzer gleichzeitig zur Einrichtung aufgefordert werden.
answer: Vielen Dank für die Anfrage. Ja, MFA kann rollenbasiert gestaffelt werden, indem Sie die Pflicht zunächst nur auf die gewünschte Berechtigungsgruppe anwenden und die übrigen Gruppen unverändert lassen, bis Sie bereit sind, sie hinzuzufügen. Bei der Login-Performance gibt es bei gestaffelter Einführung keine messbaren Auswirkungen, da die Einrichtung individuell beim ersten Login pro Nutzer erfolgt und nicht zentral gebündelt wird.

subject: Urgent: need retention extension before auto-delete on Friday
body: I'm a data analyst at Quill Works and I just realized our storage retention policy is set to 30 days, and a batch of pipeline exports from our energy usage models is scheduled to auto-delete this Friday, the 19th. We need at least 90 days retention on the /exports/energy-q3 folder to finish an audit, and the documentation doesn't make clear whether retention can be changed per-folder or only account-wide. This is time-sensitive since we can't afford to lose that batch before we've backed it up.
answer: Understood, this is time sensitive so I'm flagging it as urgent. Retention today is set account-wide rather than per-folder, but I can apply a temporary manual hold on the /exports/energy-q3 objects to prevent deletion while we sort out the longer-term policy change you need. I'll confirm the hold is in place before end of day and follow up with steps to extend your account-wide retention window if 90 days is what you'd like going forward.

subject: Slack alerts not firing for Jira and Salesforce events
body: We integrated Northwind's Slack alerting with Jira and Salesforce for Ember Legal a few weeks ago and it worked fine until sometime around the 8th. Now none of our Jira ticket-status-change alerts or Salesforce opportunity-stage alerts are reaching the #legal-ops channel, though the integration status page still shows both connections as healthy. I checked our webhook logs on our end and we're receiving 200 responses from Northwind, but nothing appears in Slack. This affects the whole team, roughly 140 people rely on these alerts daily.
answer: Thanks for flagging this, given the scope we're treating it as high priority. A 200 response with no Slack message usually points to the alert being accepted but failing silently at the routing stage to the Slack channel, possibly due to a channel ID mismatch after a workspace change on either side. I'm pulling the delivery logs for your integration now and will update you within the hour with findings and, if needed, a temporary re-authorization of the Slack connection to restore delivery.

subject: Slack notifications for renewal alerts stopped working
body: I manage renewals for Pioneer Robotics and we use Slack alerts tied to our Salesforce opportunity pipeline to flag upcoming contract renewals to the finance channel. Since last week those alerts have stopped appearing, though I can still see the underlying Salesforce records updating normally. We also have Jira and Okta connected but I haven't touched those. This is making it hard to track which renewals need attention before they lapse.
answer: Thank you for the details, I understand this is affecting your renewal tracking. I'll take a look at the Slack channel mapping tied to your Salesforce integration to see if the connection dropped or was reassigned, since Jira and Okta being unaffected suggests it's isolated to that specific alert rule rather than the whole integration. I'll update you shortly with what I find and get the renewal alerts flowing again.

subject: Email digests being sent 3-4 times to every recipient
body: Starting this morning our finance team at Vertex Media has been receiving the daily billing digest email 3 to 4 times each, all with identical content and timestamps within a minute of each other. With 1,371 seats on our account this is generating a huge volume of duplicate mail and several people have already flagged it as spam-like. This started right after the digest schedule was apparently updated on our end yesterday afternoon, but we didn't change the recipient list or frequency settings ourselves.
answer: This is a serious issue at your scale and we're treating it as priority one. It looks like a scheduling job may have been triggered multiple times concurrently after the digest configuration update, causing the duplicate sends rather than any change on your end. We're pausing the digest job right now to stop further duplicates while we identify and fix the trigger, and will confirm once digests are back to sending exactly once per recipient.

subject: Invoice shows 12 seats but we only have 8
body: I'm reviewing our latest invoice for Harbor Media and it lists 12 seats billed at the Starter rate, but we've only ever had 8 active users on the account. This has been the case for at least the last two billing cycles based on our records, so we may be owed a refund for the overage. Could someone check our seat count against billing and let me know how to proceed with a correction or refund for the extra charges?
answer: Thank you for catching this and providing the cycle details. I'll pull your account's seat history against the last two invoices to confirm the discrepancy, and if the overcharge is confirmed we'll process a refund for the difference and correct the seat count going forward. I'll follow up within a couple of business days with the findings and refund confirmation.

subject: DUPLICATE ALERTS EVERY TIME A DOCUMENT IS SHARED
body: EVERY TIME SOMEONE SHARES A DOCUMENT ON OUR WORKSPACE FOR PIONEER LABS WE ARE GETTING TWO OR THREE IDENTICAL EMAIL ALERTS WITHIN SECONDS OF EACH OTHER. THIS HAS BEEN GOING ON FOR ABOUT A WEEK NOW AND WITH 282 SEATS THE VOLUME OF DUPLICATE NOTIFICATIONS IS OVERWHELMING PEOPLES INBOXES. IS THERE A SETTING WE CAN CHANGE OR IS THIS A BUG ON YOUR SIDE. WE NEED THIS FIXED OR AT LEAST DOCUMENTED SO WE CAN TELL OUR TEAM WHAT TO EXPECT.
answer: Thanks for flagging this, and apologies for the inbox overload your team has been dealing with. Duplicate share alerts like this are usually caused by two overlapping notification rules both matching the same event, so I'm going to check your workspace's alerting configuration for redundant rules on document-share events. I'll follow up shortly with either a fix or clear steps to consolidate the rules so each share triggers only one alert.

subject: Charts rendering blank on shared dashboards
body: I'm building a monthly production report in Dashboards and three of the bar charts on the 'Plant Efficiency' dashboard have been rendering completely blank since Tuesday. It happens both when I view it directly and when I share the link with our ops team. Line charts on the same dashboard still work fine. I've tried Chrome and Edge, cleared cache, same result. Exporting to PNG also just gives a white box where the chart should be.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. Blank bar charts usually point to a rendering issue tied to a specific chart config, so we'd like to pull the dashboard's diagnostic logs to confirm. Could you send us the dashboard ID or share link for 'Plant Efficiency' so we can reproduce it on our end? In the meantime, duplicating the chart as a new widget sometimes resolves the rendering glitch.

subject: SCIM provisioning failing for new users
body: We're integrating Northwind SSO with our identity provider and SCIM provisioning has stopped creating new users as of this morning. The provisioning job returns a 400 with 'invalid schema: urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:enterprise:2.0:User' even though we haven't changed our mapping. We have 6 pending user records stuck in our IdP queue that never appear in Northwind's Admin Console. This is blocking onboarding for two new hires who can't log in yet.
answer: Sorry for the disruption this is causing. That schema error typically means an attribute mapping mismatch was introduced on our side during a recent SCIM schema update. Could you send us one of the failing SCIM payloads (with any sensitive values redacted) so we can pinpoint the mismatch? We'll prioritize this given it's blocking new user access and follow up within a few hours.

subject: Duplicate alerts flooding our team's inboxes
body: Starting around 9:15am today, our billing alert notifications have been sending duplicates - some team members got the same 'Invoice Approaching Due Date' email four times within 10 minutes. We have 18 people on this workspace and at least half have reported the same issue. This is causing real confusion since people think there are new invoices when there aren't. Can you tell us how to stop this immediately?
answer: We're treating this as a priority incident and are looking into it right now. It looks like a retry loop in the alert delivery service may be re-sending the same notification event multiple times. As an immediate step, we'd recommend muting the 'Invoice Approaching Due Date' alert rule temporarily while we trace the root cause, and we'll update you as soon as we have a fix or ETA.

subject: Webhook returning 401 after API key rotation
body: We rotated our API keys yesterday as part of routine security maintenance, and since then our billing webhook integration has been failing with 'Error 401: invalid_api_key' on every call. We're using SDK version 4.2.1 and the new key was generated through the Admin Console under the same project. The old key still works for read calls but the webhook endpoint rejects it entirely, which means invoice status updates aren't syncing to our ERP.
answer: Thanks for flagging this - a 401 right after rotation usually means the webhook signing secret wasn't regenerated along with the API key, since they're managed separately. Could you confirm whether you updated the webhook secret in the Developer settings page as well? If that's already in place, send us the request ID from one of the failing calls so we can check server-side logs.

subject: Alerts being routed to wrong channels and duplicated
body: Since we updated our alert routing rules on Monday, notifications meant for our 'critical-incidents' Slack channel are also landing in 'general' and sometimes arriving twice within seconds. We have 268 seats on this workspace and the noise is drowning out real alerts for our on-call engineers. Our routing config hasn't changed since the update, and the rule ordering in the console still shows 'critical-incidents' as the sole target.
answer: This is being escalated immediately as it's affecting alert reliability for your whole team. We suspect the routing rule cache didn't fully refresh after Monday's update, causing stale rule matches to fire in parallel with the new ones. We're pushing a cache invalidation for your workspace now and will confirm once routing is back to single-channel delivery, with a full update within the hour.

subject: Fehler bei Benutzerdeaktivierung im Admin Console
body: Wir versuchen, einen ehemaligen Mitarbeiter über die Admin Console zu deaktivieren, aber der Button 'Benutzer deaktivieren' reagiert nicht und es erscheint keine Fehlermeldung. Der Benutzer hat weiterhin aktiven Zugriff auf unsere API-Integration, was aus Compliance-Sicht ein Problem ist. Wir haben es über die API mit dem Endpoint /users/deactivate versucht und erhalten dort einen 500-Fehler. Das betrifft aktuell nur diesen einen Account, aber wir brauchen eine schnelle Lösung, da wir nur 4 Sitze haben und jeder Zugriff zählt.
answer: Vielen Dank für die Meldung, das nehmen wir sehr ernst, da es einen Compliance-relevanten Zugriff betrifft. Der 500-Fehler beim Endpoint /users/deactivate deutet auf ein Problem mit einer verknüpften Allowlist-Regel für diesen Benutzer hin. Können Sie uns die Benutzer-ID und den Zeitstempel des letzten Versuchs schicken? Wir kümmern uns umgehend darum und deaktivieren den Zugriff notfalls manuell von unserer Seite, bis der Bug behoben ist.

subject: Refund request for downgraded seats last billing cycle
body: We reduced our seat count from 90 to 71 on March 3rd but our invoice dated March 31st still reflects the higher seat count and charged us accordingly. Invoice number INV-88214 shows 90 seats billed at the Pro rate. We'd like a credit or refund for the difference for that billing period, and confirmation that future invoices will reflect the correct 71 seats going forward.
answer: Thanks for pointing this out. It looks like the seat downgrade on March 3rd wasn't picked up before the March billing cycle closed, which explains the discrepancy on INV-88214. We'll issue a prorated credit for the difference to your account and confirm the seat count is now correctly set at 71 for the next invoice. You should see the credit reflected within 3-5 business days.

subject: Mobile app crashes when enabling offline mode
body: On our team's iOS devices running app version 6.3.0, the Northwind mobile app crashes within a few seconds of toggling on offline mode from Settings. We've reproduced this on three separate iPhones (iOS 17.4) and it happens consistently, not just once. The app was working fine in offline mode before the 6.3.0 update. We have 12 seats and about half the team relies on offline access during client site visits, so this is impacting daily fieldwork.
answer: Thank you for the clear reproduction steps - that's very helpful. This matches a known issue introduced in 6.3.0 related to local cache initialization on offline toggle, which our mobile team is actively investigating. As a workaround, forcing a full app reinstall (not just update) has resolved the crash for other customers in the interim, and we'll notify you as soon as a patched version is available.

subject: Need workspace allowlist and audit log fix urgently
body: Our workspace allowlist settings aren't saving correctly - we add an IP range under Admin Console > Security, click save, and it reverts to the previous list within a minute. On top of that, our audit log shows no entries at all for the past three days even though we've had several admin changes made. With only 5 seats we rely heavily on these controls for compliance, and right now we have no record of who changed what.
answer: This is a serious gap and we're prioritizing it right away. The allowlist reverting on save suggests a sync conflict with a background policy job, and the missing audit log entries may be related to the same underlying issue. We're pulling backend logs for your workspace now to confirm what changes were actually applied during those three days, and will follow up with findings and a fix timeline shortly.

subject: PDF export failing on large dashboards
body: Exporting our 'Regional Freight Overview' dashboard to PDF has been timing out for the past two days - it spins for about 90 seconds then shows 'Export failed, please try again.' This dashboard has 14 widgets and used to export fine in under 20 seconds. Smaller dashboards export without issue. Our team of 139 seats relies on this weekly export for the leadership review, and the next one is due tomorrow morning.
answer: Thanks for the details and the timing context - we understand this is time-sensitive ahead of tomorrow's review. Fourteen widgets shouldn't cause a timeout, so this looks like a regression in the export rendering pipeline for larger dashboards. We're escalating this now to reproduce with the dashboard ID for 'Regional Freight Overview' and will prioritize a fix or a manual export workaround before your deadline.

subject: PDF export cuts off chart on right side
body:
I'm integrating the Dashboards API for our retail reporting and noticed that when I trigger a PDF export via /v2/dashboards/{id}/export, the rightmost bar chart on our 'Store Performance' dashboard gets clipped. It looks fine on screen and in PNG export, but the PDF cuts about 15% off the right edge every time, tested on 6 different dashboards with the same widget layout.

This is blocking a report we need to send to regional managers by Friday. Is this a known rendering issue with the export engine?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report — this matches a known issue with the PDF renderer when a dashboard has widgets anchored near the grid edge; the export engine miscalculates the page margin for landscape layouts. I'm escalating this to our rendering team and will follow up with a workaround (adjusting widget width by 2 columns) that should fix the clipping for your Friday deadline while we ship the permanent fix.

subject: How to link Jira issues from Slack alerts
body:
We're on the Integrations product and currently have Slack and Okta connected. Our team wants to set up the Jira link so that when an alert fires in Slack, we can create a linked Jira ticket directly without switching apps. I looked in the integrations settings but only see Jira listed as 'coming soon' under our current connections page.

Can you confirm if Jira linking is available for Starter plans, and if so, walk me through enabling it? We have about 4 people who'd use this daily.
answer: Jira linking is available on Starter plans, but it does need to be enabled from the Integrations tab under Admin Settings rather than the connections page you were viewing — that page only shows already-active connections. Go to Settings > Integrations > Add Integration > Jira, authenticate with your Jira instance URL, and once connected you'll see a 'Create Jira Issue' action inside any Slack alert thread. Let me know if you don't see that option after connecting and I'll check your account configuration.

subject: Need bulk unsubscribe for 200+ users receiving duplicate alerts
body:
Several teams are reporting duplicate email notifications for the same alert events — we're seeing this across roughly 180 of our 204 seats since early this week. Users want to unsubscribe from specific alert categories but the current unsubscribe link only lets them opt out of all notifications entirely, which isn't workable since they still need critical alerts.

Can you add a way for us to bulk-unsubscribe users from just the duplicate category, or at least confirm what's causing the duplication? This is affecting a large part of our workforce and generating a lot of help desk tickets on our end.
answer: This sounds like it could be tied to a notification rule overlap rather than a true duplicate-send bug, but given the scale you're describing I'm treating this as high priority. I'm pulling your notification configuration now to check for duplicate alert rules pointing to the same event trigger, and in parallel I'll get you a CSV-based bulk unsubscribe option for the specific alert category so your admins can manage this without waiting on individual opt-outs. I'll update you within a few hours with findings.

subject: Need help - IP allowlist question
body:
We've been rolling out stricter access controls this month across our finance and ops teams. As part of that, our security team asked me to lock down console access to a specific set of office IPs, and I started configuring this under Admin Console > Settings > Network.

When I added our new range and clicked save, I got this in the browser console:
```
PUT /v1/admin/allowlist 422
{"error":"invalid_cidr","detail":"range overlaps existing entry 203.0.113.0/24"}
```
The existing entry it's referencing was added a while back by a former admin who's no longer with us, and I can't find it listed anywhere in the current allowlist table to edit or remove it. Can you check what's stored on our account and help me either fix or delete that stale entry so I can proceed?
answer: Thanks for including the error detail — that stale CIDR entry is likely orphaned from a deactivated admin account and isn't rendering in the UI table due to a display filter bug we're aware of. I'll pull the raw allowlist config for Apex Capital from the backend, remove the orphaned 203.0.113.0/24 entry, and confirm once it's clear so you can add your new range without the overlap error. I'll also log an audit note so this shows up correctly going forward.

subject: THIRD failed card charge this month - fix your billing system
body:
This is the third time our card has been declined for no reason and now I'm getting threatening emails about service suspension. We checked with our bank and there is NOTHING wrong with the card, it has plenty of available credit. Your system charged a partial amount on Nov 3rd, failed again Nov 10th, and now failed again today Nov 17th with error "card_declined - do_not_honor".

I need someone to actually look into this instead of just telling me to update my card again. We are a 3 person team and this is taking way too much of my time. If this isn't fixed by end of week we're cancelling and moving to a competitor.
answer: I completely understand the frustration, and I'm sorry this has dragged on across three billing cycles. The "do_not_honor" response usually comes from the issuing bank flagging recurring SaaS charges rather than our side, but three consecutive failures on file warrants a deeper look, so I'm escalating this to our billing team right now to review the transaction logs and check if our processor is sending malformed requests. I'll personally follow up within 24 hours with either a resolution or a manual payment workaround so your service isn't interrupted while we sort this out.

subject: Large file uploads failing intermittently via Storage API
body:
We're seeing intermittent upload failures through the Storage API when pushing files larger than ~2GB from our backup pipeline. Since yesterday around 14:00 UTC, roughly 30% of our upload requests to /v3/storage/objects return a 503 after the multipart upload completes, even though smaller files under 500MB succeed consistently.

We rely on this for nightly backup jobs across our travel booking platform, and with 1719 seats worth of traveler data involved, any gap in backup coverage is a real risk. Can someone check the storage cluster health and whether there's a size-related throttling issue on multipart completes?
answer: Thank you for the timestamp and size threshold — that's very helpful. We're seeing elevated 503 rates on multipart completion for a specific storage cluster shard starting around the same window you reported, and our infrastructure team is actively investigating a capacity issue there. I'm escalating this as P1 given your backup dependency; in the meantime, please retry failed completions with exponential backoff, and I'll update you here as soon as we have a fix deployed or a more specific ETA.

subject: DRINGEND: Datenverlust durch Aufbewahrungsrichtlinie im Storage
body:
Wir haben heute morgen festgestellt, dass mehrere Ordner in unserem Storage-Bereich vollständig leer sind, obwohl dort seit Monaten Frachtdokumente lagern sollten. Nach Rücksprache mit unserem Team vermuten wir, dass eine automatische Aufbewahrungsrichtlinie (Retention Policy) mit einem falschen Ablaufdatum konfiguriert wurde und Dateien gelöscht hat, die eigentlich bis 2026 aufbewahrt werden sollten.

Betroffen sind mindestens vier Abteilungen mit insgesamt geschätzt 40.000 Dokumenten. Wir brauchen sofort Hilfe, um zu klären, ob diese Dateien wiederherstellbar sind und wie es zu diesem Löschvorgang kommen konnte.
answer: Wir verstehen den Ernst der Lage und behandeln dies als höchste Priorität. Unser Storage-Team prüft sofort die Backup-Snapshots und die Konfigurationshistorie Ihrer Retention Policy, um festzustellen, ob und wie das Ablaufdatum verändert wurde, sowie ob eine Wiederherstellung aus den letzten Snapshots möglich ist. Wir melden uns innerhalb der nächsten Stunde mit einem Zwischenstand und werden Sie durchgehend über den Fortschritt der Wiederherstellung informieren.

subject: unsubscribe
body: Stop the duplicate emails now, ridiculous.
answer: I'm sorry for the trouble — I've gone ahead and disabled the duplicate alert category on your workspace's notification settings so those emails should stop within the next few minutes. If you're still seeing duplicates after that, reply here and I'll dig into the specific rule causing it.

subject: Question about Okta app assignment for Salesforce and Slack
body:
I'm setting up our Okta app for the first time to manage access to Salesforce and Slack through Northwind's Integrations product. I added both apps under our Okta tile but only Slack shows up when I test SSO login as a regular user — Salesforce doesn't appear even though I assigned the same group to it.

Is there a separate step needed to sync Salesforce app visibility, or does it usually take some time to propagate after assignment? Just want to understand the expected behavior before we roll this out to the rest of the team.
answer: Good question — Salesforce app tiles in Okta typically require a separate provisioning sync step beyond group assignment, since it uses SCIM provisioning rather than just SSO tile visibility like Slack. Double-check under the Salesforce app's Provisioning tab that 'Enable' is toggled for the API integration, and give it 10-15 minutes to propagate after assignment. If it's still not showing after that, send me your Okta app ID and I'll check the sync logs on our end.

subject: Storage quota reached, uploads blocked
body:
Our storage quota alert triggered this morning and now new file uploads are being rejected with 'quota_exceeded' errors. We're currently at 98GB used out of our allotted amount, and it looks like a lot of that is coming from old dataset versions we no longer need going back over a year.

Can you help clarify how the retention settings interact with quota calculation, and whether there's a way to purge old versions in bulk instead of deleting files one by one? We have about a dozen analysts who need upload access restored soon.
answer: Thanks for flagging this — retained old versions do count against your quota unless a specific retention exception is set, which explains the buildup from last year's datasets. I can enable a bulk version-purge for objects older than a set date on your workspace so you don't have to delete them individually; just confirm a cutoff date you're comfortable with and I'll run that cleanup today to free up space and restore upload access for your team.

subject: SCIM provisioning creating duplicate users after group sync
body:
We're seeing SCIM provisioning create duplicate user records when a user belongs to two mapped groups in our IdP. This started around Oct 3rd after we added a second group mapping for our compliance team (14 users). It's not blocking anyone from logging in via SSO, but it's cluttering our user list and makes MFA enrollment reporting inaccurate.

Can you point me to documentation on how group-to-role mapping precedence works in SCIM, and whether there's a way to dedupe existing records without deleting access?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. Duplicate provisioning like this usually happens when overlapping group mappings both trigger a create call instead of an update, and we have a doc section on mapping precedence I'll link below along with a support article on safely merging duplicate SCIM-provisioned users without losing MFA state. Since this is low impact, I'll follow up within a couple of business days with the dedupe steps tailored to your group setup.

subject: Need rate limit increase before Black Friday - hitting 429s in prod
body:
We're integrating with the Orders and Inventory endpoints and started getting 429 responses today around 2pm ET during a load test simulating Black Friday traffic. Current limit seems to be 600 requests/min per key, and we need closer to 2500/min across our three production API keys for the November 24 peak.

This is time sensitive since our retail traffic ramps hard starting next week. Can someone confirm the current limit tier for Willow Foods and let us know what's needed to get a temporary or permanent increase approved before then?
answer: This is on our radar as high priority given the timeline. I've escalated to our platform team to review Willow Foods' current tier and pull actual usage from today's load test so we can size an appropriate temporary increase for Black Friday. Expect a follow-up within a few hours with a proposed limit and confirmation of what needs to change on your end (key rotation isn't required for this).

subject: Users getting logged out too frequently during long reports
body:
Several of our analysts are getting logged out mid-session while running longer reports, sometimes after only 15-20 minutes of activity. This is disruptive since re-authenticating means going through MFA again each time, and some reports take 30+ minutes to generate.

Is there a way to extend the session timeout for our workspace, or at least exempt active report generation from triggering a forced logout? We're a small team of 23 so this is affecting most of our analysts daily.
answer: Thanks for flagging this - a 15-20 minute timeout does sound shorter than our default session window, so I want to check your workspace's current SSO session policy configuration. In the meantime, we do support configurable session lifetimes on the identity settings page, and I can walk you through adjusting that so active report runs don't get interrupted. I'll follow up shortly with the specific setting to change.

subject: Rate limit headers inconsistent between SDK versions
body:
We're comparing rate limit behavior between the Python SDK v3.2 and v4.0 while analyzing throughput for our device telemetry ingestion pipeline. On v4.0, the X-RateLimit-Remaining header sometimes reports a higher value than what we're actually being allowed, and we hit 429s despite the header saying we had headroom.

We process roughly 40,000 requests/hour across our fleet integrations and need reliable header data to build backoff logic properly. Is this a known issue with the v4.0 SDK, and is v3.2 being deprecated soon since we may need to pin to it?
answer: Good catch, and thanks for the specifics on request volume. We've had one other report of rate limit header drift in SDK v4.0 tied to a caching layer change, and I'm confirming with engineering whether that's the root cause here. On the deprecation question, v3.2 is still supported for now but is on our sunset roadmap for next year, so I'd recommend planning a migration path even if you pin to it short term - I'll get you a firmer timeline shortly.

subject: Invoice problem
body:
I wanted to give some background first - we upgraded from a trial to Starter plan back in September and everything was fine for the first invoice. We've been using Northwind mainly for basic identity management across our 4-person team at Pioneer Media.

This month our invoice dated November 1st shows a charge of $340 instead of the expected $49 Starter plan rate, and our card was already charged that amount. There's no line item breakdown explaining the difference, just a flat total. Can someone tell me why this happened and get it corrected? This is a real problem for our small team's budget.
answer: I'm sorry for the trouble this is causing, especially given your team's size - I've flagged this as a priority billing issue. I can see the discrepancy you're describing and I'm pulling the itemized breakdown now to determine whether this was a proration error or a plan misclassification; either way we'll get this corrected and refund the difference. I'll have an update for you within the next few hours.

subject: Dashboards taking 30+ seconds to load with multiple charts
body:
Our main operations dashboard has 8 charts pulling from case volume and billing data, and it's been taking upwards of 30 seconds to fully render since last week. A few of our team members have started avoiding it and just exporting raw data instead, which defeats the purpose.

Is there guidance on optimizing dashboards with this many charts, or a way to see which specific chart or query is the bottleneck? We didn't change anything on our end recently that we're aware of.
answer: Thanks for the detailed description - 30 seconds for an 8-chart dashboard is well outside normal range, so let's dig into what's driving it. We have a performance guide covering chart-level query profiling that should help identify the bottleneck, and I'll also check on our end whether there's been any backend change affecting dashboard rendering for Harbor Robotics specifically. I'll follow up with findings and the optimization doc shortly.

subject: Refund issued but credit not reflected on account
body:
We were issued a refund for a duplicate charge back on October 20th, confirmed by your billing team via a case reference in our email thread. It's now been over two weeks and the credit still isn't showing up on our account balance or on the latest invoice we just received.

Can someone check what happened to this credit? We'd like to understand whether it's a processing delay or if the refund didn't actually go through on your end. This is starting to affect how we're reconciling our books for retail operations.
answer: Thanks for the follow-up, and apologies for the delay in getting this reflected. Two weeks is longer than our normal credit processing window, so I'm looking into whether this stalled on the payment processor side or in our internal ledger sync. I'll confirm the status of the refund and get the credit properly applied to your account, with an update by end of day tomorrow.

subject: Pagination breaking after page 50 - missing records and duplicate cursors
body:
We're paginating through the /v2/records endpoint using cursor-based pagination and consistently hit an issue after page 50 (5000 records at 100/page). The next_cursor value returned starts repeating the same cursor from page 49, causing us to loop indefinitely and skip records past that point.

This is blocking our nightly sync job that pulls the full dataset for our retail analytics pipeline, and we can't complete a full data pull right now. We're on SDK v2.8. Is this a known bug with large result sets, or are we missing a parameter?
answer: This sounds like a genuine bug in cursor generation rather than something on your end, especially given the exact page-50 repeat pattern you're describing. I'm escalating this to engineering right now since it's blocking your nightly sync, and I want to get a workaround to you quickly - possibly switching to offset-based pagination temporarily for the affected endpoint. I'll update you within a couple of hours with either a fix timeline or the workaround.

subject: Scheduled sync jobs failing silently since last night
body:
Our nightly data pipeline sync that pulls booking data from our travel CRM connector has failed for the past two runs, on November 11th and 12th, both scheduled for 1am. There's no error notification in our dashboard, we only noticed because downstream reports were showing stale data from November 10th.

Can someone check why these sync jobs aren't alerting us on failure, and get the pipeline running again? We have 270 users relying on this data being current each morning, so this needs attention soon.
answer: Thanks for catching this and for the specific run dates - I'm pulling logs for the November 11th and 12th 1am runs now to identify why the sync failed and, separately, why the failure notification didn't fire. Given the number of users depending on fresh data each morning, I'm treating this as urgent and will follow up shortly with root cause and a plan to get the pipeline current again.

subject: Need option to flag or handle late-arriving records in pipeline
body:
We've noticed that data arriving more than 24 hours after its original timestamp gets silently merged into our pipeline output without any flag, which throws off our downstream reporting since it looks like same-day data when it's actually backfilled. This happens fairly often with our manufacturing sensor data connector, roughly 5-10% of records each week.

We'd like to request a feature to either tag late-arriving records or let us configure a cutoff window for what counts as "on-time" data. This would help us build more accurate freshness metrics for our reporting team. Happy to share sample record IDs if useful.
answer: This is a great request and one we've heard from a few other data pipeline customers dealing with connector backfills, so I'm logging it as a feature request for our product team with high priority given the reporting impact you're describing. In the meantime, I'd like to take you up on sharing a few sample record IDs so we can confirm the exact merge behavior and see if there's an interim workaround using existing pipeline metadata fields. I'll follow up once I hear back from product on feasibility and timeline.

subject: Storage retention policy deleting files before 90-day window
body: We're on the Storage retention policy set to 90 days, but files uploaded on Feb 3rd for our energy client audit are already gone as of this morning. We checked the backup folder and quota dashboard shows 62% used, so it's not a space issue. This is affecting our compliance reporting deadline for a client audit due Friday and we need to know if these files are recoverable.
answer: Thank you for flagging this, I understand the urgency given your audit deadline. I've escalated this to our storage engineering team as a P1 incident and we're pulling logs for your workspace to check if this is a retention policy misconfiguration or a bug affecting early deletion. I'll update you within the next 2 hours with either a recovery path from backup snapshots or a root cause.

subject: Scheduled syncs failing silently across retail connectors since Monday
body: Our scheduled syncs for three retail POS connectors (store-inventory-01, store-inventory-02, and pricing-feed) have stopped running as of Monday's 6am window. The pipeline dashboard shows last successful run 3 days ago with no error message, just status 'pending' indefinitely. We have 268 seats relying on this data for daily pricing updates and store managers are now working off stale inventory counts.
answer: Apologies for the disruption this is causing to your daily pricing operations. We can see the affected connectors are stuck in a queued state and our pipeline team is investigating whether this is related to a scheduler backlog from Monday's deployment. We're treating this as P1 and will have an update within the hour on either a manual trigger to clear the queue or a fix timeline.

subject: Need to upgrade from Starter to Pro but seat count won't update
body: We're trying to upgrade our plan from Starter to Pro to support our growing team, currently at 18 seats but need room for 30. When I go through the upgrade flow in billing settings, it processes the payment but the invoice still shows Starter pricing and seat limit stays at 18. This happened twice now, on the 5th and again yesterday, and I have team members who can't get added because we're at seat cap. Can someone manually apply the Pro upgrade so we can add the new hires this week?
answer: Thanks for the details and I'm sorry for the trouble this has caused with your onboarding timeline. This looks like a sync issue between our billing processor and the seat provisioning system rather than a payment problem. I'm escalating this to our billing engineering team now to manually apply the Pro plan upgrade to your account and will confirm once your seat limit reflects 30, likely within a few hours today.

subject: Question on backup retention performance for large file sets
body: I'm trying to understand how our retention settings interact with backup performance. We have around 40,000 files in our manufacturing training library, retention set to 180 days, and noticed that backup completion times have grown from roughly 20 minutes to over 2 hours over the past month. Quota usage is at 71% of our Starter allocation. Is this slowdown expected as file count grows, or is there a configuration change we should make to improve backup speed?
answer: Good question, and this is a common pattern we see once file counts pass around 30,000 under a single retention policy. Backup jobs scan the full retained set each run, so completion time scales with file count rather than just data size. I'd recommend splitting your library into tiered folders with separate retention policies, which typically cuts backup time significantly. I can walk you through that configuration if helpful.

subject: How to troubleshoot recurring transform failures in our billing sync
body: Our finance team relies on a Data Pipelines job that transforms enrollment and payment data from our education CRM connector nightly. Over the past week, the transform step has failed intermittently, roughly 3 out of 7 nights, with the pipeline log showing 'field mapping mismatch on column tuition_amount'. Nothing changed on our end that I'm aware of. Could you help us understand what's causing this and how we can prevent it going forward?
answer: Thanks for the clear description. Intermittent field mapping errors like this usually indicate the source connector is occasionally sending a slightly different schema, such as a null or differently formatted tuition_amount field on certain nights. I'd suggest we review your connector's schema history together, and in the meantime I can set up a fallback rule so the transform skips and flags mismatched rows instead of failing the whole run. I'll follow up with steps for that this week.

subject: PDF export cutting off charts in shared dashboards
body: When exporting our travel booking dashboard to PDF, several bar charts and the revenue trend line get cut off at the page edge instead of scaling to fit. This started after we added two new chart widgets last week. We've tested with three different dashboards shared across our 86-seat workspace and the issue is consistent across Chrome and Firefox. Can you confirm if this is a known bug with the export renderer and if there's a workaround for now?
answer: Thanks for the detailed repro steps across browsers, that helps a lot. This matches a known issue with the PDF export renderer when dashboards exceed a certain widget count per row, which causes charts near the edge to clip instead of resize. As a workaround, reducing widgets to 3 per row before export should render correctly. Our engineering team is working on a proper fix and I'll update this ticket once it ships.

subject: Offline mode crashes when reopening app after sync
body: I've been testing offline mode on our legal team's tablets and noticed the app crashes on reopen after syncing cached data, specifically when there are more than 50 pending records queued. It happens consistently on both iOS and Android test devices. I also couldn't find documentation on the sync queue limits for offline mode, which would help us plan rollout to our 122 users. Is there a known limit we should be aware of, and any tips for avoiding this crash?
answer: Thanks for the thorough testing details, this is genuinely useful for us. We don't currently publish an official cap on offline queue size, but 50+ pending records does align with reports of memory pressure causing crashes on reopen. I'll pass this along to our mobile team as feedback for the offline sync engine, and in the meantime I'd recommend keeping sync intervals more frequent to avoid large queue buildups. I'll also flag the documentation gap so we can add guidance on this.

subject: Request to change SSO role mapping for finance group
body: We need to update our SSO role mapping so users in our identity provider's 'Finance-Admins' group get mapped to the Billing Admin role instead of the default Member role they're currently receiving. Right now all 8 of our seats come through as Member regardless of their IdP group, even though we configured group claims in our SAML setup last month. Can you help us fix the mapping or let us know if there's a config step we're missing?
answer: Happy to help get this sorted. This is usually caused by the group claim attribute name in your IdP not exactly matching what our SSO integration expects, or the role mapping rule not being saved on our end. I'll review your SAML configuration and current mapping rules and get back to you shortly with either the corrected mapping or the specific attribute name we need you to adjust in your IdP.

subject: Offline mode not syncing after reconnect, push notifications also missing
body: Since yesterday, our field technicians using offline mode on the mobile app aren't seeing their data sync back once they reconnect to wifi. Several also reported not receiving push notifications for new work orders, which used to come through instantly. We have 127 seats across our manufacturing floor teams and this is stalling several active jobs right now. Is there a known outage with sync or push, and what should our team do in the meantime?
answer: Thank you for reporting this, I know stalled work orders are a serious operational impact. We're seeing reports of a sync delay affecting offline-to-online reconciliation and are checking if it's related to a push notification service issue from earlier today. I've marked this P2 and our mobile infrastructure team is investigating now; in the meantime, please advise technicians to keep the app open and connected to wifi for a few minutes after reconnecting to force a manual sync retry. I'll update you as soon as we have more.

subject: Duplicate email alerts being sent for the same billing event
body: We've started receiving duplicate notification emails, sometimes 3 or 4 copies of the same invoice alert within a couple minutes, since Tuesday. This is happening for our whole 4-person finance team on Notifications for billing events specifically. It's cluttering our inboxes and we're worried we might miss an actual new alert buried among the duplicates. Can you look into why this is happening and get it stopped?
answer: Thanks for flagging this, and I'm sorry for the inbox clutter it's causing your team. This looks like a duplicate trigger issue in the alerting rules for billing event notifications, possibly from a retry mechanism firing multiple times. I'm marking this P2 and escalating to our notifications team to identify and stop the duplicate sends; I'll follow up shortly with confirmation once it's resolved.

subject: Question about upgrading from Pro plan tiers
body:
I'm looking at our billing dashboard and trying to understand what changes if we upgrade from our current Pro plan to a higher tier. We're at 285 seats now and expect to add another 40-50 analysts next quarter for a new energy trading desk.

Could someone walk me through how the invoice proration works mid-cycle, and whether performance limits (API call quotas, dashboard refresh rates) change with the upgrade? Just want to have accurate numbers before I take this to finance.
answer:
Thanks for reaching out! When you upgrade mid-cycle, we prorate the difference based on the days remaining in your current billing period, and the new invoice line will show the credit from your existing plan applied automatically. Higher tiers do raise API rate limits and dashboard refresh frequency - I can send you the exact numbers for the tier you're considering.

I'll follow up with a comparison sheet showing seat pricing, quota changes, and a sample prorated invoice so you and your finance team have concrete figures to review.

subject: Transform step failing intermittently on patient records pipeline
body:
We have a data pipeline pulling records from our EHR connector into the reporting warehouse, and since March 18th the transform step has been failing on roughly 1 in 5 runs with a timeout error. The connector itself shows healthy, but the transform stage seems to hang for 8-10 minutes before erroring out.

This is affecting our nightly load for about 180 users across care coordination teams. Job IDs pipe-8841 and pipe-8847 both failed last night around 2:15 AM UTC. Can you help us identify whether this is a latency issue on our connector config or something on your end?
answer:
Thanks for the detailed report and job IDs - we're looking into pipe-8841 and pipe-8847 now. Initial logs show elevated latency on the transform worker pool during your nightly window, which lines up with a resource contention issue we're investigating on our side.

We'll monitor tonight's run closely and update you within a few hours with root cause. In the meantime, if this is blocking a specific report deadline, let us know and we can prioritize a manual rerun once we've confirmed the fix.

subject: urgent
body:
Our API keys stopped working this morning without warning. We got a notice last week about SDK v2 deprecation but didn't expect existing keys to be invalidated already - all our webhook endpoints are returning 401 errors now and our client intake system is completely down. We only have 4 seats on the Starter plan so this is our entire legal team affected.

We need these keys reactivated or new ones issued immediately, this is blocking active client work.
answer:
I understand how urgent this is and I'm escalating immediately. It looks like your keys were caught in the SDK v2 deprecation rollout ahead of the documented cutoff date, which shouldn't have happened for accounts still on active integrations - we're treating this as an incident on our end.

I'm issuing you a temporary key right now that will restore webhook functionality within minutes, and our platform team is investigating why the deprecation hit your account early. I'll update you as soon as I have confirmation the underlying issue is resolved.

subject: app crashes offline
body:
ERROR: SIGABRT
Module: OfflineSyncManager
line 214: null reference in cache lookup
Crash occurs on launch when no network detected
iOS 17.4, build 3.2.1
answer:
This is a critical issue and we're treating it as a priority incident given the crash-on-launch impact. Our mobile team is reproducing this now on iOS 17.4 with build 3.2.1 - can you confirm whether this started after a recent app update, and roughly how many of your 6 users are affected?

We'll have a hotfix candidate for you to test within the next few hours since offline mode being completely unusable is blocking your team's work.

subject: Storage quota hit unexpectedly, blocking uploads and backups
body:
We hit our storage quota this morning and now can't upload new files or run scheduled backups - getting 'Quota Exceeded' errors across the board. This is affecting our retail operations team of 250 seats who rely on daily document uploads for compliance tracking.

We were nowhere near the limit last week according to our usage dashboard, so something seems off - either a bug in quota calculation or our retention settings are keeping old backups longer than expected. Can someone look into whether this is a display bug or an actual capacity issue, and help us get uploads working again today?
answer:
Thanks for flagging this right away - since this is blocking uploads and backups for your whole team, we're prioritizing it. We're checking whether your retention policy settings changed recently, which could be causing old backup snapshots to accumulate instead of rotating out as expected.

In the meantime, we're granting a temporary quota increase on your account so uploads and backups can resume immediately while we investigate the root cause. We'll follow up today with findings on whether this was a calculation bug or a retention config issue.

subject: Request to enable biometric login for mobile app users
body:
We'd like to enable Face ID / fingerprint login for our team on the mobile app instead of requiring password entry each session. Right now our 4 users on the Starter plan have to log in manually every time the app goes to background, which is slowing down field work when they're checking documents on the go.

Is biometric authentication available as a feature we can turn on, or is this planned for a future release? Also curious if it works with offline mode or requires a network connection to validate.
answer:
Biometric login is available on our mobile app and can be enabled from the admin console under Security Settings - I'll walk you through activating it for your workspace. It does work with offline mode once initially set up, since the biometric credential is validated locally after the first authenticated session.
