Let me know once you've toggled it on and I can confirm your users are seeing the Face ID/fingerprint prompt correctly on next login.

subject: need restore help
body:
ERROR: RestoreJobFailed
code: BACKUP_SNAPSHOT_CORRUPT
snapshot_id: snap-77291
date_requested: 2024-05-02
We need this restored asap for a client audit
answer:
Thanks for the snapshot ID - we're looking into snap-77291 now to determine if the corruption is recoverable or if we need to pull from an earlier snapshot. Given the audit deadline, we're prioritizing this investigation and will have an update on restore options within the next couple hours.

Can you confirm the target date range you need restored, in case we need to offer an alternate snapshot from a nearby date?

subject: Critical: API rate limit misconfiguration exposing internal endpoints
body:
During a security review this morning we discovered that our API rate limits appear to have been reset or misconfigured following last night's webhook deprecation rollout - several internal admin endpoints are now accepting far higher request volumes than configured, and we're seeing traffic patterns that suggest this may be exploitable. We have 588 seats across our legal teams and this affects our entire production API surface.

We need immediate confirmation on whether this is a broader platform issue and what containment steps are being taken. Our security team is treating this as a potential incident on our end and needs to know if data exposure occurred.
answer:
We're treating this as a P0 security incident and have escalated to our platform security team immediately. We're auditing the rate limit configuration changes from last night's deprecation rollout across all affected accounts to determine scope, and reviewing access logs on your admin endpoints for any anomalous traffic during the window in question.

We'll have an initial containment update for you within the hour, including whether this affected other customers and preliminary findings on any unauthorized access to your endpoints. A senior engineer will be your direct point of contact until this is resolved.

subject: Feedback on PDF export formatting for dashboards
body:
We've been using the PDF export feature on our media analytics dashboards and noticed the exported files sometimes cut off wide charts or misalign the legend text compared to what's shown on screen. It's not blocking us, but it's happened on about 3 of our last 10 exports.

Would it be possible to improve the export rendering to better match the on-screen layout, especially for dashboards with multiple side-by-side charts? Happy to share sample exports if that helps your team reproduce it.
answer:
Thanks for the feedback and for the specifics on frequency - that's helpful context. Rendering mismatches on wide, multi-chart layouts is a known area we're actively improving in the export engine, so I'd appreciate a couple of sample exports to help our team pinpoint exactly which layout patterns are triggering the misalignment.

I'll log this as a feature enhancement request and keep you posted as improvements roll out to PDF export rendering.

subject: Jira integration not linking issues correctly via API
body:
I'm integrating our internal tooling with Northwind's Jira connector through the Integrations API, and when creating linked issues via POST /integrations/jira/link, the response returns a 200 but the Jira issue never actually gets the Northwind reference attached. I've tested this against three different Jira projects and get the same result each time - link_status shows 'pending' indefinitely.

We're rolling this out across a large finance org (3460 seats) and need this working before we push to all teams next week. Can you confirm if this is a known issue with the link callback, or if I'm missing a required field in the payload?
answer:
Thanks for the detailed repro steps - a 200 response with link_status stuck on 'pending' points to an issue with the callback webhook not firing correctly on our end rather than a payload problem on yours. We're checking the Jira connector's callback service now to see if there's a delivery failure affecting linked issue creation.

Can you share one of the request payloads and the Jira project key you tested against? That'll help us trace the specific callback failure and get you a fix before your rollout next week.

subject: Ability to customize push notification categories
body: We'd like our travel approval reminders and expense alerts to come through as separate push notification categories in the Mobile App so employees can mute one without losing the other. Right now it looks like everything comes under a single "Northwind Alerts" toggle in device settings. Is there a way to split these, or is this on the roadmap for the Pro tier? We have 262 seats across our travel desk teams and this would cut down on complaints about notification fatigue.
answer: Thanks for the detailed suggestion. Today the Mobile App only exposes one push channel per platform, so category-level muting isn't possible yet, but I've logged this as a feature request under our mobile notifications backlog and tagged it with your account for updates. In the meantime, some admins reduce noise by narrowing the alert rules in workspace settings so fewer notification types fire in the first place - happy to walk through that configuration if useful.

subject: Storage quota hit mid-upload, uploads failing
body: Since this morning our nightly data upload job to Storage started failing with "quota exceeded" errors around 9:15 AM UTC. We're at 91 seats and have been steadily growing our raw sensor archive for energy load forecasting, but I don't see a clear breakdown anywhere of what's consuming the quota - raw files, processed outputs, or backups. Can someone confirm our current usage versus limit, and point me to documentation on retention settings so we can free up space without deleting data we need?
answer: Sorry for the disruption - I can see the failed upload jobs starting at 9:14 AM UTC and confirm your workspace is currently over its allocated storage quota. I'm pulling a usage breakdown by category (raw, processed, backups) now and will send it over shortly along with the retention documentation so you can identify what's safe to age out. As a short-term fix I can also apply a temporary quota bump while you sort out retention policy - let me know if you'd like that applied today.

subject: Cannot save allowlist changes in workspace settings
body: I'm trying to update our IP allowlist under Admin Console > Workspace Settings to add our new office range, but when I click Save the page just spins and then reverts to the old list with no error message. This is blocking our team from accessing the dashboard from the new location - we have 19 seats total and half of them are affected right now. Also, could this action be recorded in the audit log going forward? I don't see allowlist changes showing up there at all currently.
answer: Thank you for flagging this - a silent save failure on the allowlist form is not expected behavior and I'm escalating it as a bug right away given it's blocking access for roughly half your team. As a workaround, I can add the new IP range to your workspace on our end today so your team isn't stuck waiting on the fix. I've also noted your request to have allowlist changes appear in the audit log and passed that to engineering as a feature gap.

subject: SAML login failures for subset of users this morning
body: Starting around 7:40 AM today, a growing number of our 1194 users are hitting an error page after authenticating through our identity provider, with the SSO callback returning "invalid_response: assertion signature validation failed." It's not everyone - seems concentrated in our logistics operations group, roughly 300-400 people. We haven't changed our SAML metadata or certificates recently on our end. Can you check if anything changed on Northwind's side, and can we get an ETA since this is blocking a large chunk of our workforce from clocking into shift systems?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report - we're looking into this now given the scale of impact on your logistics group. We did roll out a certificate rotation on our SAML signing infrastructure last night, and it's possible your IdP is still validating against the previous certificate for a subset of sessions. Can you confirm which IdP you're using and whether you've refreshed the SP metadata recently? We'll keep you updated closely while we investigate and will treat this as a priority given the number of affected users.

subject: Need bulk deactivation option with audit trail
body: We're offboarding a batch of contractors this week and currently have to deactivate each of our 20 users one by one in Admin Console, which is slow and error-prone. Could we get a bulk deactivation feature, ideally with the ability to select multiple accounts and deactivate them in one action? We also want to confirm that deactivation events are fully logged in the audit log with timestamp and the admin who performed the action, since we're preparing for a compliance review next month.
answer: Good timing on this request - bulk deactivation isn't available in the console UI yet, but I can confirm every individual deactivation is already recorded in the audit log with timestamp, actor, and target account, which should satisfy your compliance review needs. I've filed a feature request for a multi-select bulk action, and in the meantime I can help you script this through our admin API if you'd like a faster path for this week's offboarding batch.

subject: Requesting restore of storage files from last week's backup
body: We accidentally overwrote a set of client report files in Storage yesterday afternoon during a batch upload, and we need to restore the previous versions from before the overwrite - ideally from the backup snapshot taken last Tuesday. This affects our reporting workflow for a handful of key files, not everything. Could someone confirm what backup retention window we have on the Starter plan and initiate a restore for that date? We'd rather not risk trying to manually reconstruct these.
answer: Thanks for the specifics - on the Starter plan we retain daily backup snapshots for 14 days, so last Tuesday's snapshot is available and we can restore from it. To avoid overwriting your current files again, we'll restore the affected files to a separate folder so your team can review and swap them in manually. Could you send the exact file paths or names affected so we can scope the restore precisely?

subject: Pipeline data arriving hours late, breaking downstream reports
body: Our energy usage connector has been delivering data 3-5 hours later than scheduled for the past two days, instead of the usual 30-minute lag. This is causing our morning dashboards to show stale numbers for our ops team of 8. Last successful on-time sync was two days ago at 6:02 AM; since then syncs are completing but timestamped well past our report generation window at 7:00 AM. Can someone check if there's a backlog or throttling issue on the connector side? We need this resolved before tomorrow morning's report run.
answer: This has been escalated to our data pipelines on-call team given the impact on your morning reporting deadline. We're seeing an elevated queue depth on the connector cluster that's processing your energy usage source, which lines up with the delays you're reporting starting two days ago. We're working to clear the backlog now and will prioritize getting your syncs back under the normal 30-minute lag before tomorrow's 7:00 AM run - I'll update you as soon as we have a fix confirmed.

subject: Salesforce sync stopped updating contact records
body: Our Salesforce integration has stopped syncing updated contact records into Northwind since sometime yesterday - new contacts still come through, but any field changes on existing records (like phone or account owner updates) aren't reflecting anymore. We rely on this for our healthcare client outreach tracking. Is there a known issue with the Salesforce connector right now, or a sync log we can check on our end to see what's failing?
answer: Thanks for reporting this - update-only syncs failing while creates still work usually points to a permissions or field-mapping issue triggered by a change on the Salesforce side, such as a modified field-level security setting. Can you check if any admin adjusted permissions on the fields you mentioned (phone, account owner) around yesterday? In the meantime I'm pulling your integration's sync logs to look for rejected update events and will share findings shortly.

subject: Users stuck unable to complete MFA enrollment
body: Since this morning, several of our 80 users are getting stuck on the MFA enrollment screen after login - they scan the QR code, enter the six-digit code, and get "verification failed, please try again" repeatedly even with a fresh code. This is blocking them from accessing anything post-login. We haven't changed our MFA policy recently. Can you help us figure out if this is a time-sync issue on our end or something on Northwind's side? We need this fixed quickly since it's affecting a good chunk of our team this morning.
answer: Thank you for the clear description - this pattern often points to a clock drift issue between the authenticator app device and our verification server, but since you're seeing it across multiple users simultaneously starting this morning, we're also checking our TOTP validation service for anything on our end. Could you confirm the exact time zone and current time shown on one affected device compared to your reference time? While we investigate, affected users can try re-syncing their authenticator app's time settings, which resolves this in many cases - I'll follow up shortly with root cause.

subject: Connector authentication keeps expiring, need reauth docs
body: Our data pipeline connector to our travel booking source keeps losing its authentication token roughly every 48 hours, forcing us to manually reauthorize through the connector settings each time. This is disruptive since we're a small team of 7 and no one is dedicated to watching this. Is there documentation on setting up a longer-lived token or refresh flow for this connector type? Also curious if this is expected behavior on the Starter plan or something we should escalate as a bug.
answer: Thanks for flagging this - a token expiring every 48 hours isn't expected behavior for that connector type, which should support automatic refresh once configured correctly, so this looks like a setup issue rather than a plan limitation. I'm attaching our connector authentication documentation that covers the refresh token flow, and I'd like to take a quick look at your current connector configuration to see why auto-refresh isn't kicking in - could you confirm the exact connector name and last successful reauth timestamp?

subject: Slack alerts not firing for Jira-linked integration events
body:
I'm integrating our Pioneer Partners workspace with Slack through the Integrations product, routing alerts for Jira ticket updates and Salesforce case changes into a #ops-alerts channel. Since yesterday around 14:00 UTC, the Jira-triggered alerts stopped posting to Slack entirely, while Salesforce alerts still come through fine. Our Okta SSO session shows no errors and the Slack app connection status is 'Active'.

I checked the integration logs and see events being received from Jira (status 200) but no corresponding outbound call to Slack's webhook. Can you confirm if there's a known issue with the Jira-to-Slack alert routing specifically?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. This matches a bug we're tracking where Jira-sourced events can get dropped from the Slack routing rule when the event payload includes a custom field mapping - it looks like your Jira alerts are hitting that path while Salesforce isn't. I'm escalating this to engineering with your workspace ID attached and will update you within a few hours with either a fix timeline or a workaround using a direct webhook rule.

subject: Requesting increase to backup retention window
body: We're on the Starter plan and currently our automated backups are only retained for 7 days. As we scale up our manufacturing document uploads, we'd like to extend retention to 30 days if that's available without upgrading our whole plan. Could you let me know what options exist for adjusting backup retention on Storage for a small team like ours?
answer: Good question - retention windows beyond the default 7 days on Starter do require moving to a higher tier plan, since extended retention consumes more storage quota. I can share a quick comparison of what Pro would offer for retention and pricing, or alternatively we can set up a manual export process so you can archive backups yourself past the 7-day window at no extra cost. Let me know which direction works better for your team.

subject: Pagination cursor returning duplicate records after v3 upgrade
body:
After migrating our integration to API Platform v3 endpoints last week, we've noticed our /orders listing calls using the 'next_cursor' token are returning overlapping records between pages. Specifically, page 2 and page 3 both include order ID ORD-88213 through ORD-88240, causing duplicate processing in our downstream system for Blue Robotics.

We're paginating with a page size of 100 and following the cursor exactly as documented. This started right after the v2 pagination deprecation notice took effect on our account. Is there a known regression here, or are we missing a required parameter change?
answer: Thanks for flagging this with the specific order range - that's very helpful. We've had one other report of cursor overlap tied to the v2-to-v3 pagination migration when the 'sort' parameter isn't explicitly set, which causes the cursor to be recalculated inconsistently between requests. Can you confirm whether you're passing an explicit sort parameter on your /orders calls? In the meantime I'd recommend deduplicating on order ID as a safeguard while we confirm the root cause.

subject: URGENT: Bulk uploads to Storage failing for entire team
body:
Starting this morning around 8:30 AM, every file upload attempt through the Storage dashboard is failing for our whole analytics team at Orion Travel. We get 'Upload failed: quota exceeded' even though our usage dashboard shows we're at 62% of our storage quota. This is blocking our nightly backup reconciliation job and we have a retail reporting deadline today.

We've tried uploading small test files under 1MB and they still fail with the same error. This is affecting all 150 seats on our account, not just one user.
answer: This is impacting your whole team so I've escalated it as high priority right now. The quota mismatch you're describing - failures despite showing 62% usage - suggests a sync issue between the billing quota service and the upload gateway, which we've seen intermittently after plan usage recalculations. I'm having engineering check your account's quota state directly and will update you within the hour; in the meantime, please hold off on retrying uploads repeatedly since that can add noise to the queue we're investigating.

subject: Best practice for handling webhook retries and ordering
body:
I'm working on our webhook consumer for API Platform events on behalf of Granite Capital, and I want to make sure we're handling retries correctly. Currently we receive webhook.payment.updated and webhook.payment.failed events, but occasionally they arrive out of order, which causes our reconciliation logic to mark a payment as failed after it already succeeded.

Does Northwind guarantee any ordering for webhook delivery, or should we be implementing our own sequence-based reconciliation using the event timestamp field? Also wondering if there's a way to increase the retry backoff window beyond the default.
answer: Good question, and this comes up often. Northwind does not guarantee strict delivery ordering for webhooks since retries and network conditions can cause reordering, so we recommend using the 'event_sequence' field included in each payload rather than arrival order for reconciliation logic. On retry backoff, the default schedule is fixed at the platform level currently, but I can log a feature request on your behalf for configurable backoff windows if that would help your reconciliation pipeline.

subject: Okta-App-Verbindung schlägt für alle Nutzer fehl
body:
Seit heute Morgen können sich unsere Mitarbeiter bei Quill Freight nicht mehr über die Okta-App-Integration bei Northwind anmelden. Der Single-Sign-On-Versuch bricht mit der Meldung 'SAML response invalid: signature mismatch' ab. Wir haben in den letzten Tagen keine Änderungen an unserer Okta-Konfiguration vorgenommen, soweit ich weiß.

Das betrifft aktuell alle Nutzer in unserem Workspace, nicht nur einzelne Konten. Da wir über 3000 Mitarbeiter haben, ist das ein massives Problem für den Zugriff auf Jira-, Slack- und Salesforce-Integrationen, die über dieses SSO laufen.
answer: Vielen Dank für die schnelle Meldung, das behandeln wir als hohe Priorität, da es Ihr gesamtes Team betrifft. Ein 'signature mismatch' deutet meist darauf hin, dass das SAML-Zertifikat auf der Okta-Seite abgelaufen ist oder rotiert wurde, ohne dass die neue Signatur in Ihrer Northwind-Konfiguration aktualisiert wurde. Bitte prüfen Sie in Okta das Ablaufdatum des aktuellen Zertifikats, und senden Sie uns die neue Metadaten-URL, damit wir sie umgehend auf unserer Seite aktualisieren können.

subject: Duplicate daily digest emails going to same recipients
body:
We've noticed that our email digests from Notifications are being sent twice to the same recipients each morning, roughly 3-4 minutes apart, for the past two days. This is happening across our whole Atlas Works workspace, affecting all 18 seats. The content of both emails is identical - same alert summary and timestamp range.

Could you help us figure out why duplicates are being triggered? We'd also appreciate documentation on how digest scheduling works internally so we can troubleshoot similar issues ourselves in the future.
answer: Thanks for reporting this with the timing detail - that 3-4 minute gap is a useful clue. This pattern usually happens when a digest job gets triggered by two overlapping schedule rules, which can occur if a digest configuration was edited recently and the old schedule wasn't fully deactivated. Could you check your digest settings for any duplicate or overlapping schedule entries? I'll also send over our digest scheduling documentation so you can review the rule logic directly.

subject: Charts not rendering + request for export and sharing improvements
body:
For the past two days, several of our dashboard charts at Orion Labs have been showing blank panels with a spinning loader that never resolves, particularly our manufacturing throughput and defect-rate charts. This is happening for most of our 133 seats, though a few users report the charts eventually load after 30+ seconds.

Separately, while we have your attention, we'd like to request better export options (CSV plus image export) and easier sharing links for dashboards with external auditors who don't have Northwind accounts. Happy to hop on a call if useful.
answer: I'm sorry for the disruption this is causing across your team - broken charts affecting most of your seats is something we want to resolve quickly, so I'm flagging this as high priority and checking whether there's a performance issue on the dashboard rendering service tied to large manufacturing datasets. On the export and sharing requests, those are great suggestions and I'm logging them as feature requests; I'll follow up once I have an update on the chart rendering issue and any timeline for the export improvements.

subject: Upload failures during compliance retention audit
body:
While preparing for a compliance retention audit at Atlas Robotics, we've hit repeated upload failures when trying to push archived retail transaction records into Storage. The error returned is 'upload rejected: object exceeds retention policy constraints' even though these files are well within our documented 90-day retention window.

This is blocking our audit evidence collection which has a hard deadline this week. We need to understand whether this is a quota issue, a retention policy misconfiguration, or a platform bug, since it's affecting every archival upload attempt across our team.
answer: Given the audit deadline and that this is blocking every archival upload, I'm treating this as high priority and looping in our security and compliance team directly. The error message suggests the retention policy engine may be evaluating an outdated or conflicting rule rather than your documented 90-day window, possibly from a legacy policy that wasn't fully retired. Can you send us one of the failing object IDs and the exact timestamp of a recent attempt so we can trace the policy evaluation logs?

subject: Question about restoring files from an old backup snapshot
body:
I'm trying to restore a set of files from a backup snapshot taken about three weeks ago for Apex Energy, but the restore option in the Storage dashboard only shows snapshots from the last 7 days. We're on a small team and don't need anything fancy, just want to recover a few logistics documents that got overwritten by mistake.

Is there a way to access older snapshots, or is 7 days the hard limit on our current plan? Also curious if there's a way to get notified before older snapshots roll off so this doesn't catch us off guard next time.
answer: Thanks for reaching out - on the Starter plan, snapshot retention is indeed capped at 7 days, so anything older than that isn't recoverable through self-service restore. If those documents are important, I'd recommend checking if you have a local or manual export copy from around that time; otherwise, upgrading to a higher plan would extend the retention window. I'll also pass along your suggestion about proactive notifications before snapshots expire, since that's a reasonable feature request for smaller teams.

subject: SDK completely broken after your deprecation - fix this NOW
body:
This is absolutely unacceptable. Our checkout integration has been throwing errors since last night after your SDK v4.2.0 update. Every call to createSession() now returns 410 Gone and our logistics platform can't process orders for 235 users. We are getting hammered with support tickets from our own customers.

I checked your changelog AFTER the fact and see v3 endpoints were deprecated with basically zero warning. We had webhooks configured against /v3/shipments and now they just silently fail. Rate limit errors are also popping up randomly with 429s even though we're nowhere near our quota. Fix this or we're cancelling our contract - this is costing us real money every hour.
answer:
I understand the urgency and I'm sorry for the disruption this is causing your operations - I've escalated this to P1 and our platform team is investigating the v3 endpoint deprecation impact right now. Can you send me the exact webhook endpoint URLs and a sample request ID from one of the 429 errors so we can check if there's a rate-limit bucket misconfiguration on our side?

In the meantime, please switch your integration to use the SDK v4 client with the new createCheckoutSession() method - this bypasses the deprecated v3 path entirely and should resolve the 410 errors immediately. I'll follow up within the hour with a root cause update on the 429s.

subject: transform pipeline keeps failing and support docs are useless
body:
Our nightly transform job for the logistics_orders connector has failed 4 nights in a row now, always around 2am UTC. The error just says 'transform step 3 failed: schema mismatch on field ship_date' but nothing in your docs explains what schema validation actually expects for date fields.

We've tried three different date formats and nothing works. This is really frustrating because we rely on this data being fresh every morning for our ops team, and right now they're working off stale data from last week. I've read through your connector documentation twice and it's genuinely not helpful for troubleshooting this specific error.
answer:
Sorry for the trouble this is causing your team - schema mismatch errors on date fields are usually caused by the connector expecting ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ) rather than a plain date string. Could you share a sample row from your source data for the ship_date column so I can confirm the exact format issue?

While we look into it, you can add a pre-transform step to cast ship_date to ISO format explicitly, which should unblock your nightly run. I'll also flag the documentation gap to our content team so the schema requirements are clearer for date-type fields.

subject: Retention policy deleted files earlier than expected
body:
We noticed that files uploaded to our legal-docs bucket in March were purged on day 60 instead of the 90-day retention period we configured. This is a problem because we need those documents for compliance purposes and now they're gone from active storage.

Can you confirm whether these files are recoverable from backup, and help us understand why the retention setting didn't apply correctly? Our bucket ID is ember-legal-docs-01 and the affected files were uploaded between March 3 and March 18.
answer:
Thank you for flagging this - I've opened an incident to investigate why the retention window on ember-legal-docs-01 didn't hold to the configured 90 days. I can confirm we do keep a rolling backup snapshot for 30 days past deletion, so files removed on day 60 should still be recoverable; I'm requesting a restore for the March 3-18 range now.

I'll update you within one business day with the restore status and a root cause explanation for the early purge so we can prevent it from happening again.

subject: Need custom role mapping for SSO groups
body:
We're setting up SSO for our firm and want to map our Azure AD groups to specific Northwind roles - specifically our Partners group should map to Admin and our Paralegals group to Viewer only. Right now it looks like everyone who logs in via SSO gets the default Member role regardless of group membership.

Could you point me to how to configure attribute-based role mapping, or let me know if this needs to be set up on your end? We only have 4 seats so I'd like to get this right before we invite the rest of the team.
answer:
Thanks for reaching out - role mapping based on SSO group claims is available on your plan and can be configured under Admin Settings > SSO > Attribute Mapping. You'll need to add a mapping rule that matches the group claim value (e.g. 'Partners') to the Northwind role, and our system will apply it on next login.

If you send me your IdP's group claim attribute name, I can double check the mapping syntax with you before you roll it out to the rest of the team.

subject: How long are deleted files kept before permanent removal?
body:
I'm trying to understand our storage retention settings before we finalize our backup process. When we delete a file from our workspace, is there a grace period before it's permanently gone, and can we adjust that window ourselves?

We're a small team (6 seats) and want to make sure we don't accidentally lose something important, but also don't want old files sitting around using up quota we're paying for.
answer:
Good question - on your current plan, deleted files sit in a recoverable trash state for 14 days before permanent removal, and this window isn't currently user-adjustable at your plan tier. Files in trash do still count against your storage quota until they're purged, so if you're close to your limit you can manually empty trash from the Storage settings page to free that up immediately.

Let me know if you'd like recommendations on setting up a lightweight backup routine given your team size.

subject: Users getting wrong permissions after SSO login
body:
We've been running Northwind for our travel operations for about a year now and generally SSO has worked fine across our 2572 seats. Recently we started restructuring our internal groups in Okta to better reflect our regional teams, and rolled that out last Tuesday.

Since then we've had escalations from three regional managers saying they can't access dashboards they used to see, and separately some analysts are somehow getting admin-level permissions they shouldn't have. Here's what shows up in our SSO debug log:

2024-05-14T09:12:03Z ERROR role_mapping: no matching rule for group 'APAC-Regional-Managers'
2024-05-14T09:12:03Z WARN fallback role applied: Admin
2024-05-14T09:14:51Z ERROR role_mapping: no matching rule for group 'EMEA-Analysts-L2'
2024-05-14T09:14:51Z WARN fallback role applied: Admin

It seems like your fallback behavior when a group isn't matched is defaulting to Admin instead of least privilege, which is a serious problem at our scale.
answer:
Thank you for including the debug log - that's very helpful and confirms the issue: when a group claim doesn't match a configured mapping rule, the system is falling back to Admin instead of a restricted default role, which is a bug on our end given the security implications at your scale. I'm escalating this immediately to our identity team.

As an urgent workaround, please add explicit mapping rules for 'APAC-Regional-Managers' and 'EMEA-Analysts-L2' (and any other newly renamed groups) - this will bypass the fallback entirely while we fix the default behavior. I'll follow up with a timeline for the permanent fix and recommend auditing any users who may have received the incorrect Admin fallback since your Okta changes went live.

subject: Customers still getting emails after unsubscribing
body:
A few of our clients have told us they clicked unsubscribe on our shipment notification emails but are still receiving them daily. I checked the notification settings and the unsubscribe link seems to go through but they keep getting duplicates of the same alert.

Can you tell me if there's a delay in how unsubscribe requests get processed, or if this is a bug? We only have a handful of these automated alerts going out but it's starting to look unprofessional to our customers.
answer:
Thanks for the details - unsubscribe requests should take effect within a few minutes, so receiving daily emails after that suggests either a caching issue on our end or the unsubscribe link isn't tied to the correct recipient record. Could you send me one of the affected email addresses (or a masked version) and the timestamp of when they unsubscribed?

I'll check our notification logs for that recipient to see whether the suppression flag was actually set, and get back to you with next steps.

subject: Request: improved offline mode for mobile app
body:
Our clinical staff frequently work in areas with poor connectivity, and we'd like to request enhancements to the offline mode in the Northwind mobile app. Currently when the app loses connection, cached data seems to expire after a short period and users have reported the app crashing when it tries to resync a large batch of queued actions.

Given that we have thousands of staff relying on this app across our facilities, could you share your roadmap for offline mode improvements, or any settings we can adjust now to increase cache duration and reduce crash frequency during resync?
answer:
Thank you for the detailed feedback, and I understand how disruptive crashes during resync can be for staff working in the field. There isn't a user-configurable setting to extend cache duration at the moment, but I'm logging this as a feature request with our mobile team given the scale of your deployment.

For the crashes, could you send me the app version and a rough estimate of the queue size (number of actions) when it typically crashes? That will help our engineers reproduce the resync issue and prioritize a fix.

subject: Constantly hitting rate limits, docs don't match actual behavior
body:
We're integrating with your API for our travel booking data sync and keep hitting 429 rate limit errors even though we're staying under the 100 requests/minute limit stated in your documentation. Our logs show we're averaging around 60 req/min but still getting throttled starting around 10am every day.

This is blocking our entire sync job which affects all 22 of our users since bookings aren't updating. Is the documented limit actually per-endpoint rather than account-wide? We'd appreciate clarity because right now we can't reliably plan our request volume.
answer:
I'm sorry for the disruption - this looks like it may be a per-endpoint limit rather than the account-wide limit our general docs describe, which would explain the discrepancy you're seeing. I'm escalating this now given the impact on your sync job, and I'll pull the actual rate limit configuration for your account to confirm the real ceiling per endpoint.

In the meantime, could you tell me which specific endpoints your sync job calls most frequently around 10am? That will help me identify if one endpoint has a tighter limit than the others and get you an accurate number today.

subject: Änderung der MFA-Registrierung für neue Mitarbeiter
body:
Wir möchten die MFA-Registrierung für unser Team anpassen. Aktuell müssen neue Mitarbeiter beim ersten Login manuell eine Authenticator-App einrichten, was für unsere kleinen Teams mit 11 Lizenzen zu Verzögerungen führt. Gibt es eine Möglichkeit, MFA-Enrolment über SSO-Provisioning zu automatisieren, sodass die Einrichtung direkt bei der Bereitstellung des Accounts erfolgt?

Außerdem ist uns aufgefallen, dass ein Nutzer trotz abgeschlossener MFA-Einrichtung bei jedem Login erneut zur Registrierung aufgefordert wird. Das könnte ein Bug in der Berechtigungsverwaltung sein.
answer:
Vielen Dank für die Anfrage. Eine automatisierte MFA-Registrierung über SSO-Provisioning ist grundsätzlich möglich, indem wir beim Provisioning-Flow ein Standard-MFA-Profil hinterlegen - ich sende Ihnen dazu gerne eine Anleitung zur Konfiguration für Ihr Setup.

Zum wiederholten Registrierungs-Prompt: Das deutet tatsächlich auf einen Fehler in der Verknüpfung zwischen Benutzerprofil und MFA-Status hin. Könnten Sie mir die betroffene Benutzerkennung mitteilen, damit wir das Konto genauer prüfen können?

subject: Duplicate email alerts for the same billing event
body: I'm a support engineer at Apex Freight. Since Tuesday we've been getting duplicate alert emails for the same billing threshold event - sometimes 3 or 4 copies within a minute. Event evt_8823910 fired 4 separate notifications for what should have been a single trigger. Our on-call inbox is getting flooded and it's now hard to tell which alerts are actually new. Can someone check the dedupe logic on the alerting service?
answer: Thanks for flagging this with the event ID, that helps a lot. We're seeing a known issue in the dedupe window for threshold-based alerts and are treating this as P1 given the impact on your on-call process. I'm escalating to engineering now and will update you within the next few hours with either a fix ETA or a temporary suppression rule you can apply.

subject: Extending audit log export beyond 30 days
body: I'm the operations lead at Pioneer Analytics. We need to review admin actions like account deactivations and allowlist changes going back about 120 days, but the audit log export in Admin Console only lets us pull 30-day windows at a time. Is there a setting to extend the retention range for export, or a way to request the older raw logs directly from support?
answer: Good question - the Admin Console UI currently caps exports at 30-day windows, but the underlying audit data is retained for 180 days on Pro plans. You can run multiple exports in 30-day increments and stitch them together, or I can generate a combined export for the full 120-day range on our end if that's easier. Let me know which you'd prefer.

subject: Cron syntax for scheduled syncs
body: I'm a workspace admin at Apex Legal. We're trying to set up a scheduled sync from our Postgres connector to run nightly at 2am UTC in Data Pipelines, but the docs page only shows the preset hourly and daily options - no custom cron syntax. Could you point me to documentation or an example config for setting a specific sync time?
answer: Custom sync schedules using cron expressions are supported, though it's a bit hidden in the connector settings under 'Advanced Schedule.' I'll send over a link to the connector scheduling guide which includes a sample cron string for a nightly 2am UTC run - let me know if you'd like help validating your specific expression before you save it.

subject: Exported dashboard PDF shows restricted rows
body: I'm a data analyst at Delta Works. When I share a dashboard with view-only permissions and the recipient exports it as a PDF, the export includes data from rows that should be hidden by their row-level permission settings. This is happening across several dashboards used by our manufacturing floor teams and looks like a real data exposure issue, not just a display glitch.
answer: Thank you for reporting this - a permission mismatch during PDF export is a serious issue and we're marking this P1. We're pulling the affected dashboard IDs on our side now to confirm scope and will disable PDF export for restricted dashboards as a temporary safeguard while engineering investigates the row-level filter bypass. I'll follow up shortly with findings and next steps.

subject: Routing specific alerts to a different inbox
body: I'm the workspace admin at Atlas Foods. We'd like failed payment alerts to go to our finance team's shared inbox instead of the default admin address, but I can't find an option in Notifications settings for per-alert-type routing beyond the global email field. Is there a way to set this up for our team without routing everything there?
answer: Right now Notifications routes by a single default email unless you set up alert-specific rules under 'Routing Rules' in the Notifications settings tab - it's a separate section from the main email field. I'll walk you through setting a rule so failed payment alerts go to your finance inbox while everything else stays on the default address.

subject: URGENT DEPRECATION QUESTION BREAKING WEBHOOKS
body: WE JUST GOT A DEPRECATION NOTICE FOR THE V2 WEBHOOK SIGNATURE HEADER AND OUR INTEGRATION HAS BEEN THROWING 401 ERRORS SINCE THIS MORNING. WE HAVE 80 USERS AT APEX FOODS RELYING ON THIS FOR ORDER NOTIFICATIONS AND EVERYTHING IS DOWN. THE DOCS PAGE STILL SHOWS THE OLD HEADER FORMAT SO WE DON'T KNOW WHAT CHANGED. WE ARE ALSO HITTING RATE LIMIT ERRORS ON RETRIES. WE NEED GUIDANCE IMMEDIATELY.
answer: We understand this is urgent and are treating it as P1. The v2 signature header was deprecated in favor of the new X-Northwind-Signature-v3 format, and the docs page you referenced is outdated - we're correcting that now. In the meantime, please update your webhook handler to validate against the v3 header and reduce retry frequency to avoid the rate limit errors; I'll send the updated spec and a code sample within the hour.

subject: DATA ARRIVING HOURS LATE IN PIPELINE
body: I AM THE FINANCE MANAGER AT WILLOW WORKS. OUR NIGHTLY SYNC FROM THE AD PLATFORM CONNECTOR IS SUPPOSED TO LAND BY 6AM BUT FOR THE LAST FIVE DAYS THE DATA HAS BEEN ARRIVING AROUND NOON INSTEAD. THIS IS DELAYING OUR MORNING REPORTING FOR OUR WHOLE TEAM. CAN YOU CHECK CONNECTOR SYNC_ID DP-4471 FOR LATENCY ISSUES?
answer: Thanks for including the sync ID, that helps us dig in quickly. We're seeing elevated processing times on the ad platform connector cluster over the last several days, likely tied to an upstream rate limit change - this is a P2 for us given the reporting delay it's causing. I'll keep monitoring DP-4471 and follow up with either a fix timeline or a workaround for triggering an earlier manual sync in the meantime.

subject: Unsubscribe endpoint not updating suppression list
body: I'm integrating the Notifications API for Cobalt Legal. When users click unsubscribe in our transactional emails, our POST to /v1/notifications/unsubscribe returns 200, but the suppression list doesn't actually get updated on your end. As a result we're sending duplicate emails to users who explicitly opted out, which is a compliance problem for us. Can you check what's happening with that endpoint?
answer: This is a serious issue and we're treating it as P1 given the compliance risk. We're pulling logs for your account's unsubscribe requests now to see whether the suppression write is silently failing or if there's a delay in propagation. Please pause any non-critical sends in the meantime, and we'll update you as soon as we identify the root cause.

subject: cant login with saml after update
body:
hey we jsut updated our SAML config for Harbor Foods and now nobody can login, getting the error below. we have 11 seat and this is blocking everyone this morning. plz help asap

Error: SAML Response validation failed: Signature verification failed
  at validateAssertion (saml/validator.js:142)
  at processResponse (saml/handler.js:88)
Code: SAML_SIG_INVALID
Timestamp: 2024-06-11T08:12:44Z
answer: Thanks for the log, that's very helpful - this is a P1 for us since it's blocking all logins. A signature verification failure like this usually means the IdP certificate in your SAML config doesn't match the one currently signing assertions, often after a cert rotation. Can you confirm if your IdP recently rotated its signing certificate, and re-upload the current metadata XML to your SSO settings so we can verify the fingerprint matches?

subject: Offline mode actions stuck after reconnecting
body: I'm the IT administrator at Orion Academy. When field staff use the mobile app in offline mode at our energy sites and then reconnect, pending actions just sit in a queue with a spinning sync icon instead of uploading. This happens on both iOS and Android across our team. Is there a manual sync trigger or a log I can pull to see why the queue isn't clearing?
answer: Thanks for the detail on both platforms being affected. There is a manual sync option under Settings > Sync Status in the app that forces a retry of the queue - could you try that on one device and let me know if it clears? If not, please send the device's sync log export from that same screen so we can see what's blocking the upload.

subject: Connector sync issue - some background on our setup
body:
We've been using Northwind Data Pipelines for about eight months now to feed our retail inventory data into our warehouse. Our team recently expanded to 221 seats and we've added several new connectors over the past quarter as part of our data modernization push, including a new Salesforce connector we set up last week.

The actual issue is that our main retail-inventory connector (conn-id: rtl-inv-8842) started failing auth checks yesterday around 3pm. Here's what we're seeing in the logs:

2024-05-14T15:02:11Z ERROR connector.auth token refresh failed: invalid_grant
2024-05-14T15:02:11Z ERROR connector.sync aborted: no valid credentials
2024-05-14T15:07:44Z WARN retry attempt 1/3 failed
2024-05-14T15:12:19Z ERROR connector.sync aborted: no valid credentials

We re-authenticated the connector this morning and it seems to have resolved itself, but wanted to flag it in case it's a broader token expiry issue on your end.
answer:
Thanks for the detailed writeup and the logs, that's really helpful. The invalid_grant error typically points to an expired or revoked OAuth refresh token on the source system side, and since re-authenticating fixed it, that confirms it. We'll check our token refresh scheduler for that connector type to see if there's a pattern worth investigating on our end.

Since this is resolved for now, I'll mark this as low priority, but please let us know if it recurs on rtl-inv-8842 or any other connectors so we can dig into whether there's a systemic token lifetime issue.

subject: Mobile app crashing when switching to offline mode
body:
Since updating to the latest version of the Northwind mobile app, several of our field staff are reporting crashes when the app tries to switch into offline mode after losing signal. It happens consistently on Android devices running version 14, and the app just closes without any error message shown to the user.

This is affecting our energy site inspection teams who rely on offline mode daily when working in areas with poor connectivity. Can you help us understand what's causing this and whether a fix is coming soon?
answer:
Thanks for flagging this, and sorry for the disruption to your field teams. We've had a couple of similar reports tied to the offline sync handler on Android 14 devices, so this may be a known regression from the latest release. Could you send us the device model and app build number for a couple of affected phones so we can confirm it's the same issue?

In the meantime, we'd recommend having affected users stay on the previous app version if possible while we investigate, and we'll update you as soon as we have a fix timeline.

subject: Slack alert integration stopped sending notifications
body:
Our Slack integration for Northwind alerts has stopped posting messages to our #it-alerts channel as of this morning. We rely on this for quick visibility into system events across our small IT team, and right now we have no notifications coming through at all.

We haven't changed anything on our Slack workspace side recently, and the integration shows as 'connected' in the Northwind admin panel. Can someone help us figure out why messages aren't going through?
answer:
Thanks for the report, we understand this is important for keeping your team informed. Since the integration still shows as connected but nothing is coming through, this could be a webhook token issue or a permissions change on the Slack app itself. Could you try disconnecting and reconnecting the Slack integration from the admin panel, and let us know if that restores the alerts?

We're also checking on our end for any recent issues affecting Slack webhook delivery, and we'll follow up shortly with what we find.

subject: Repeated card decline errors when charging customers via API
body:
We're integrating the Northwind Billing API to process payments for our fintech clients, and over the past two days we've seen a spike in card failures returning error code card_declined_generic even for cards that should have sufficient funds. This is happening across multiple customer accounts, not just one, and it's starting to affect our own revenue reconciliation.

We've verified the card details being sent are correct and match what's on file with the issuing banks. Can you check if something changed on the payment processor side recently, or if there's an issue with how declines are being reported back to us?
answer:
Thanks for the detailed report, this does sound like it could be related to a processor-side issue rather than anything wrong with your integration. We're pulling the transaction logs for the affected accounts now to see if there's a pattern in the decline codes coming back from the processor.

Can you send us a few of the transaction IDs from the failed charges so we can trace them directly? In the meantime, if this is impacting time-sensitive billing runs, let us know and we can prioritize accordingly.

subject: Biometric login completely broken - all users locked out
body:
As of this morning, none of our users can log into the Northwind mobile app using biometric login (Face ID or fingerprint). The app just shows a spinner for a few seconds and then kicks back to the password login screen with no error message. This is blocking our entire team from accessing time-sensitive account data through the app.

We've confirmed this is happening on both iOS and Android across multiple devices, and it started right after the app auto-updated overnight. This is urgent since our analysts rely on mobile access throughout the trading day.
answer:
This has been escalated to our mobile engineering team immediately given the impact to your whole team's access. We're aware of a biometric authentication issue tied to last night's app update and are actively working on a fix. As a workaround right now, please have your users log in with their password credentials directly, which should not be affected.

We'll update you within the hour with a fix timeline, and will notify you as soon as biometric login is restored.

subject: Incorrect line items appearing on recent invoices
body:
While reconciling our last two invoice cycles, we noticed several line items that don't match our actual usage. Specifically, our March invoice shows charges for 195 seats but our admin panel reflects a headcount closer to 180 after a round of offboarding we did in late February. We integrate with the Billing API to pull invoice data programmatically, and the discrepancy is showing up there too, not just in the UI.

Can someone check why the seat count used for billing hasn't updated to reflect our offboarding? We'd like this corrected before the next invoice cycle if possible.
answer:
Thanks for catching this and providing the specific numbers, that's very helpful. It sounds like there may be a delay in seat count syncing after offboarding actions, which can sometimes take a billing cycle to reflect depending on when the change was processed relative to your billing date.

We're looking into your account now to confirm the actual seat count as of late February and will issue a credit adjustment if the March invoice was indeed calculated incorrectly. We'll also flag this internally to see if the sync delay needs fixing to prevent this going forward.

subject: Need help configuring Okta app for Northwind Integrations
body:
We're trying to set up SSO for Northwind through our Okta tenant so our operations team can access integrations without separate credentials. We followed the setup guide but got stuck at the SAML assertion step, our test login keeps failing with an error saying the assertion is missing a required attribute.

Could you point us to more detailed documentation on the exact attribute mapping expected, or help us troubleshoot directly? We'd also like to eventually connect this with our Slack and Jira integrations if that's supported.
answer:
Thanks for reaching out, SAML attribute mapping issues are usually a quick fix once we know what's missing. The most common cause is the NameID format not matching what our SP expects, could you share a screenshot of your current Okta attribute statement configuration so we can compare it against our requirements?

Regarding Slack and Jira, yes, those are both supported once SSO is working, and we can walk you through connecting them afterward. We'll follow up with detailed attribute mapping documentation shortly.

subject: Request to change default dashboard sharing permissions org-wide
body:
As our workspace has grown to over 3000 seats, we're finding it increasingly difficult to manage dashboard sharing permissions manually. Right now, new dashboards default to 'private' and team leads have to manually grant access to each department, which is becoming unmanageable at our scale.

We'd like to request the ability to set a default sharing policy at the organization level, for example defaulting new dashboards to 'visible within department' rather than fully private. Is this something that's configurable currently, or could it be added as a feature?
answer:
Thanks for the detailed request, this is a common pain point for larger workspaces and we appreciate you outlining the scale you're dealing with. Currently, default sharing settings are configured per-dashboard rather than org-wide, but we do have an org-level default sharing policy feature in active development that matches what you're describing.

We'll flag your account as an interested customer for early access when that feature rolls out, and in the meantime, we can help set up a bulk permission update script for your existing dashboards if that would help in the interim.

subject: Need to update invoice details and question about seat-based refund
body:
We recently reduced our headcount from 140 to 122 seats mid-cycle, and I'm trying to figure out how that affects our next invoice. Looking at our last billing statement, it still reflects the higher seat count, and I'd like to know if we're eligible for a prorated credit or refund for the unused seats during this cycle.

Also, could someone update our billing contact details, we've had a change in our finance team and want to make sure future invoices go to the right person. Let me know what's needed on our end to process both of these changes.
answer:
Thanks for reaching out, and congratulations on the team change. Seat reductions mid-cycle are typically prorated on the following invoice rather than the current one, so you should see the adjustment reflected on your next billing statement rather than a separate refund, but I'll confirm the exact proration policy for your plan and follow up with specifics.

For the billing contact update, please reply with the new contact's role and preferred billing email and we'll get that updated on our end right away.

subject: Offline mode performance severely degraded across all stores - urgent
body:
Our retail locations rely heavily on the Northwind mobile app's offline mode for point-of-sale operations during connectivity outages, and over the past 24 hours we've seen severe slowdowns and crashes when the app tries to sync cached transactions back online. With over 4000 seats across our stores, this is affecting a huge number of staff and causing checkout delays for customers.

We need this addressed urgently since it's directly impacting store operations and revenue. Can someone look into this today and let us know what's causing the sync slowdowns?
answer:
Thank you for flagging this immediately, we understand the direct impact to your store operations and are treating this as a high priority issue. We're pulling sync performance logs from your account now to identify where the bottleneck is occurring during offline-to-online reconciliation.

We'll have an initial update for you within a few hours, and in the meantime, if any specific store locations are seeing worse crashes than others, please let us know so we can narrow down the root cause faster.

subject: URGENT: Storage quota exceeded, compliance retention uploads failing org-wide
body: Our main storage bucket (bucket ID wl-media-prod-01) hit 100% of its 50TB quota this morning at 6:40 AM. Uploads are failing with 'Insufficient Storage - Quota Exceeded' across all 2202 seats, including our legal hold and retention documents that must be archived within a 24-hour compliance window per our retention policy. We are now at risk of breaching that retention SLA and need this resolved immediately.
answer: This has been escalated to our Security and Compliance team as a P0 incident given the retention SLA risk. We are provisioning an emergency temporary quota increase on bucket wl-media-prod-01 right now and will confirm once uploads are unblocked. We'll follow up within the hour with root cause and a permanent quota adjustment plan for your account.

subject: Deactivated user can still log in hours later
body: I deactivated a former employee's account through the Admin Console yesterday afternoon and the audit log shows the deactivation event completed successfully. However, the user reported logging in again this morning, about 14 hours after deactivation. I need to know why access wasn't revoked immediately and whether our IP allowlist settings could be interfering.
answer: Thanks for flagging this - a delay between the deactivation event and session revocation isn't expected behavior. We're checking the audit log entry for that account and the session token expiry logic on our end. We'll also review your allowlist configuration to rule out any interaction, and update you within one business day.

subject: Rechnung mit falschem Betrag
body: Bei der Rechnung Nr. INV-88213 vom 03.05. stimmt der ausgewiesene Betrag nicht mit unserem aktuellen Pro-Tarif für 195 Sitzplätze überein. Es fehlt außerdem die Mehrwertsteuer in der Aufstellung. Wir bitten um eine korrigierte Rechnung oder alternativ eine Rückerstattung der Differenz von 340 Euro.
answer: Vielen Dank für den Hinweis. Wir prüfen die Rechnung INV-88213 und die MwSt.-Berechnung für Ihr Konto und melden uns innerhalb von zwei Werktagen mit einer korrigierten Rechnung. Falls eine Rückerstattung erforderlich ist, veranlassen wir diese im gleichen Schritt.

subject: Seat count mismatch causing incorrect billing on invoice #INV-4471
body: Our billing dashboard currently shows 310 active seats, but we only have 274 licensed seats under our Pro plan. This discrepancy resulted in an overage charge on invoice INV-4471 issued yesterday. Our renewal date is in five days and we need this corrected before it processes, as several deactivated healthcare staff accounts appear to still be counted as active.
answer: We understand the urgency given your renewal timeline and have escalated this as P1 to our billing engineering team. We're auditing the 36-seat discrepancy now to confirm which accounts are miscounted, and we'll place a hold on invoice INV-4471 until the correction is applied so you aren't overcharged at renewal.

subject: IP allowlist change locked out entire finance team
body: Yesterday I added our new office IP range to the Admin Console allowlist to replace an outdated one. Since then, all 22 users on our team get 'Access denied - IP not allowed' when trying to log in, even from the new range I just added. This is blocking our entire finance team from Northwind Cloud.
answer: Sorry for the disruption - we're looking into the allowlist configuration on your account right now to check why the new range isn't being recognized. As an immediate step we're enabling a temporary bypass for your team's login so you can regain access while we confirm the correct CIDR format and propagation status.

subject: Deactivated user still shows Active status in audit log
body: I deactivated an employee account through the Admin Console this morning and the audit log recorded the deactivation event with a timestamp, but the user's status field in the console still reads 'Active'. This is concerning for our compliance reporting since 142 seats rely on accurate status records.
answer: Thanks for reporting this - it sounds like a sync issue between the deactivation event and the status field display rather than an actual access problem, but we're verifying that access was in fact revoked. We'll investigate the status sync bug and update the audit log display, and confirm back to you once fixed.

subject: Request: automatic token refresh for connector authentication
body: Our data pipeline connector to our CRM system requires manual re-authentication every 60 days, and each expiry causes sync failures across our organization of 3256 seats. The last failure on the 12th showed '401 Unauthorized - token expired' and paused three downstream pipelines for six hours before we caught it. We'd like to request support for automatic token refresh or longer-lived credentials for this connector.
answer: This is a reasonable request and we're logging it as a feature enhancement for the connector auth framework. In the meantime, we can set up a proactive expiry alert 5 days before your token lapses so your team can re-authenticate before it impacts syncs. We'll follow up once the refresh-token feature is scoped with our product team.

subject: Charts missing when exporting dashboard to PDF
body: When I export our 'Weekly KPIs' dashboard to PDF, the chart visuals come out blank on the page while the titles and labels render fine. This happens consistently across three different charts and I've tested it twice this week. On screen everything displays correctly, so it seems specific to the PDF export.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report - this matches a known rendering issue affecting chart export to PDF that our team is currently working on. As a workaround, exporting the dashboard as PNG or sharing the live link will preserve the charts correctly for now. We'll let you know as soon as the PDF export fix ships.

subject: App crashing on biometric login for iOS users
body: Since the app update that went out on the 9th, Face ID login crashes the app immediately after the biometric prompt appears. This is affecting a large portion of our 160 seats on iOS and is blocking people from accessing their accounts entirely. Users have to force-close and log in with password instead, which isn't a sustainable workaround for our team.
answer: This is a significant issue and we're escalating it to our mobile engineering team as P1 immediately. As an interim measure, please advise your users to disable Face ID login in the app settings and use password login until we ship a hotfix, which we're targeting within 24-48 hours. We'll keep you updated on progress.

subject: How to add multiple IP ranges to allowlist
body: I'm trying to add several office IP ranges to our Admin Console allowlist but only the most recent entry seems to save - the previous ranges disappear. I also don't see any corresponding entries in the audit log when I make these changes. Could you clarify the correct way to add multiple ranges and confirm whether these changes should be logged?
answer: You can add multiple ranges by entering them as comma-separated CIDR blocks in a single allowlist field rather than saving them one at a time, which should resolve the overwrite issue. Allowlist changes are expected to appear in the audit log, so we're checking why those entries aren't showing for your account and will follow up shortly.

subject: Mobile app crashes when reconnecting after offline mode
body: We've had at least 6 reports from field staff at Pioneer Academy where the mobile app crashes right when the device comes back online after being in offline mode. It seems to happen consistently after more than 10 minutes offline - the app freezes for a few seconds then closes entirely. Users are on both iOS and Android, latest app version 4.2.1. This is disrupting our energy audit teams who rely on offline data entry in the field.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report - a crash on reconnect after extended offline periods sounds like a sync buffer issue we want to isolate quickly. Could you send us the device logs from one or two affected phones (Settings > Support > Export Logs in the app) along with approximate offline duration before the crash? In the meantime, ask field staff to sync more frequently if possible to reduce the offline window while we investigate.

subject: Getting duplicate push and email alerts for same event
body: Our team at North Partners has started receiving both an email and a push notification for the exact same billing alert, sometimes with two emails landing within a minute of each other. This started around March 3rd after we enabled the new alerting channel. With only 5 seats here it's a small team but it's already causing confusion about which alert is the current one.
answer: Thanks for flagging this - duplicate delivery across channels usually points to overlapping alert rules or a webhook retry issue on our end. Can you confirm which alert types are duplicating (all billing alerts or a specific one) and share a timestamp of a recent duplicate pair? We'll check the delivery logs on our side and get a fix or configuration adjustment to you shortly.

subject: SCIM provisioning failing for new user batch
body: We're rolling out SSO to our full Vertex Travel org and tried provisioning a batch of 40 new users via SCIM this morning. About 15 of them failed with a 409 conflict error even though these are brand new accounts that never existed in Northwind before. The SCIM logs show 'Resource already exists' but there's no matching user visible in our admin console. This is blocking our access rollout for the retail team ahead of our Monday deadline.
answer: That mismatch between the SCIM conflict error and what you see in the admin console suggests there may be soft-deleted or pending records still holding those usernames. Please send us the list of the 15 failing SCIM external IDs and we'll check server-side for orphaned records blocking the create calls. We'll aim to have this cleared before your Monday rollout.

subject: Need to update seat count on our invoice - urgent
body: We added 8 new employees at Blue Capital last week but our latest invoice still reflects the old seat count of 22 instead of 23 seats we're actually using now. Finance needs this corrected before the invoice is finalized on the 15th, otherwise we'll be underbilled and it'll create a reconciliation headache for us. Can someone adjust this on our account today?
answer: Thanks for catching this before the invoice finalizes - we'll get your seat count corrected to 23 right away and regenerate the draft invoice reflecting the change. You should see the updated invoice in your billing portal within the next few hours; let us know if the numbers don't match up once it posts.

subject: Question about upcoming webhook API changes
body: I saw in the changelog that some webhook event payloads are being deprecated next quarter, and I want to make sure our integration at Atlas Health won't break. We currently consume the 'invoice.updated' and 'usage.threshold' webhook events through your SDK v2.3. Is there a migration guide or timeline for when the old payload format stops being sent, and will there be a grace period with both formats supported?
answer: Good timing to ask - we're planning a 90-day dual-format window where both old and new payload structures will be sent before the deprecated fields are fully removed. We'll publish a migration guide covering the 'invoice.updated' and 'usage.threshold' changes within the next couple of weeks, and I'll make sure you're added to the notification list for the exact cutover date.

subject: Multiple failed card charges this billing cycle
body: We've seen 4 failed payment attempts on our Atlas Systems account in the past two weeks, all with the decline code 'insufficient_funds' even though our finance team confirms the card has adequate available credit. Each failure triggers a dunning email to our whole billing group which is now 268 seats, so it's creating unnecessary noise. Can you check what's actually being sent to the processor?
answer: Sorry for the repeated dunning noise - we'll pull the transaction details for those 4 attempts and check exactly what the processor is returning versus what your bank reports. In the meantime, could you confirm the last four digits of the card on file so we can match it against our logs? We'll also look at reducing dunning email frequency while this is being investigated.

subject: Unsubscribe link not removing users from all alert types
body: Several employees at Orion Labs clicked the unsubscribe link in a maintenance notification email, but they're still receiving other alert categories like billing and security notices. We assumed unsubscribe would apply globally per user, or at least give a clear preference center. Can you clarify how the unsubscribe mechanism is scoped, and whether there's a way for admins to manage this centrally for our 133 seats?
answer: That's expected behavior on our side - unsubscribe links are scoped to the specific alert category in the email rather than applying globally, since billing and security notices are considered essential communications. That said, we do have an admin-level notification preference center that lets you manage categories per user or in bulk; I'll send you a link to that documentation so your IT team can configure it centrally.

subject: Card declined but need to understand refund process too
body: Our card was declined on last month's charge for Ember Energy and we've since updated the payment method, but I noticed the retry also generated a small duplicate charge of $49 that shouldn't have gone through. Can you confirm the failed charge won't be retried again automatically, and let me know the process for getting that duplicate $49 refunded?
answer: Thanks for the heads up - we'll stop any further automatic retries on the original failed charge now that your payment method is updated. I've located the duplicate $49 charge and initiated a refund, which should post back to your account within 5-7 business days depending on your bank.

subject: Shared dashboard links showing stale permissions
body: We noticed that when we update sharing permissions on a dashboard - removing a viewer's access, for example - the change doesn't always take effect for users who already have the link bookmarked. One of our regional managers at Summit Foods could still view a dashboard with sensitive sales chart data three days after we revoked their access. We're a large org with over 2000 seats so this permission lag is a real concern for us.
answer: This is a valid concern and we appreciate you flagging the delay - permission revocations should propagate immediately, so a three-day lag points to a caching issue on shared link access tokens. We're logging this for our product team to investigate the cache invalidation path, and in the meantime, revoking access via the dashboard's share settings and also deleting the specific link should force an immediate cutoff.

subject: SAML login failures for subset of users
body: Since yesterday around 9am, a group of our Delta Retail employees - roughly 30 out of 274 - have been unable to log in via SAML SSO. They get redirected back to our identity provider and then land on a Northwind error page reading 'SAML response validation failed: signature mismatch.' Other users on the same IdP configuration are logging in fine, so it seems isolated to a specific subset, possibly tied to a recent group sync.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report - a signature mismatch affecting only a subset of users often points to a stale certificate or metadata cache for a specific group mapping rather than the whole SAML config. Can you share a couple of the affected usernames and the exact timestamp of a recent failed attempt? We'll cross-reference against our SAML assertion logs to pinpoint whether it's a certificate rotation issue tied to that group sync.

subject: Duplicate email alerts for the same incident
body: We've noticed that our on-call team is getting the same notification twice for certain alert rules, roughly 2-3 minutes apart. It's happening on our 'API Latency' and 'Billing Sync Failure' rules specifically, at least 8 times in the last week. Could you point me to documentation on how notification deduplication is supposed to work, or if there's a setting we're missing to prevent this?
answer: Thanks for flagging this - duplicate alerts are usually caused by two overlapping trigger conditions on the same rule set, or a webhook and email channel both firing independently without a shared dedupe window. I've pulled the delivery logs for your 'API Latency' and 'Billing Sync Failure' rules and can see the double-fire pattern you described. I'll send over our deduplication guide and also check whether your rule configuration has an unusually short cooldown window set.

subject: Unsubscribe link in emails is broken
body: Several of our staff tried to unsubscribe from the weekly digest notifications and the link just redirects to a generic Northwind login page instead of the preference center. This started after our last notification template update on the 14th. We're getting complaints from users who don't want these emails anymore and can't opt out themselves.
answer: Sorry for the trouble this is causing your team. This looks like the unsubscribe link is pointing to an outdated template URL after your recent update - we've seen this happen when a digest template is cloned without refreshing the preference-center token. We're checking your account's template configuration now and will confirm a fix or workaround within the next few hours so your users can opt out properly.

subject: Rollenzuordnung nach SSO-Login funktioniert nicht korrekt
body: Seit dem Wechsel auf unser neues Identity Provider Setup letzte Woche werden Benutzerrollen nach dem SSO-Login nicht mehr korrekt zugeordnet. Mitarbeiter aus der Gruppe 'Finance' landen teilweise in der Rolle 'Viewer' statt 'Editor', was bei über 30 Nutzern zu Problemen beim Zugriff auf Berichte führt. Das betrifft mehrere Teams gleichzeitig und blockiert aktuell wichtige Monatsabschlussarbeiten. Können Sie uns kurzfristig helfen, die Attribut-Zuordnung zu prüfen?
answer: Vielen Dank für die detaillierte Beschreibung, das nehmen wir sofort mit hoher Priorität auf. Fehlerhafte Rollenzuordnungen nach einer IdP-Umstellung deuten meist auf ein Mapping-Problem bei den Gruppenattributen im SAML-Assertion hin. Wir prüfen jetzt Ihre aktuelle Attribut-Konfiguration und melden uns innerhalb der nächsten Stunden mit konkreten Schritten, um die Zuordnung für die betroffenen Finance-Nutzer zu korrigieren.

subject: Need to change frequency of email digests
body: Our team currently gets daily digest emails for notification summaries, but we'd like to switch to weekly for our Starter plan account. When I tried changing this in the settings panel, the toggle reverts back to daily after saving. I also noticed we're sometimes getting two digest emails on the same day, which seems like a related bug.
answer: Thanks for reporting both issues together, they may well be connected. The digest frequency toggle reverting to daily after save is a known display bug we're tracking, and it could also explain the duplicate digest emails since the backend job may still be running on the old daily schedule. I'll manually update your account's digest frequency to weekly on our end and confirm once it's set correctly, then follow up on the duplicate delivery issue separately.

subject: Slack integration not posting alerts anymore
body: Our Slack channel #ops-alerts stopped receiving any notifications from Northwind as of yesterday around 9am. We use this integration to route Jira ticket updates and system alerts to the team in real time, and right now nobody is seeing anything. The integration still shows as 'Connected' in our settings page, but no messages are coming through at all.
answer: This is impacting your team's visibility so we're treating it as urgent. A 'Connected' status with no messages delivering usually points to an expired Slack OAuth token or a webhook that Slack silently revoked - we're checking your integration logs now for delivery failures around the 9am timestamp you mentioned. We'll update you shortly with either a fix or instructions to reauthorize the Slack connection.

subject: SAML login failing intermittently for new users
body: I'm integrating our SAML SSO setup and new users provisioned in the last two days are getting an 'Authentication failed - invalid assertion' error about 1 in 3 login attempts. Existing users seem unaffected. I checked our IdP metadata and it matches what's configured in Northwind, but the intermittent nature makes this hard to debug. Can someone look at our login logs for account ID org_4471 around the last 48 hours?
answer: Thanks for the details, including the org ID helps us dig in quickly. Intermittent invalid assertion errors that only affect newly provisioned users often point to a clock skew or a caching delay between your IdP and our SSO service picking up new user attributes.
