We're pulling the login logs for org_4471 now to check timestamps and assertion details on the failed attempts, and will follow up with findings shortly.

subject: Request to bulk manage unsubscribe preferences
body: We have 221 seats on our account and our compliance team wants the ability to bulk-unsubscribe specific user groups from certain notification categories rather than doing it one by one. Right now the unsubscribe management only supports individual user changes, which isn't scalable for us. Is there a bulk action feature planned, or an API endpoint we could use for this instead?
answer: That's a reasonable ask given your account size, and it's come up from a few other Pro customers managing larger teams. There isn't a bulk unsubscribe UI action yet, but we do have an API endpoint that supports batch preference updates per user group which should work for your compliance team's use case. I'll send over the endpoint documentation and an example payload so you can test it against a small group first.

subject: Okta app integration broken after recent update
body: Our Okta app tile for Northwind stopped provisioning new users correctly since yesterday's update on our end. We rely on this to sync employee access across Slack, Salesforce and Jira through Northwind's integration layer, and now new hires aren't getting access to any downstream tools automatically. This is affecting onboarding for our travel operations team this week.
answer: Thanks for the clear breakdown of what's affected. We're looking into whether yesterday's Okta app update changed the SCIM provisioning schema on their end in a way that's breaking the sync to Northwind - this would explain why downstream Slack, Salesforce and Jira access isn't propagating. We'll keep you posted as we test the provisioning flow and will prioritize a fix given the onboarding impact you've described.

subject: Unsubscribe requests not being honored, urgent for compliance
body: We're integrating the Notifications API and discovered that users who call the /unsubscribe endpoint are still receiving emails afterward, sometimes duplicated. This is a serious problem for us since we operate in healthcare and have compliance obligations around opt-outs. We've confirmed at least 15 user accounts affected in the last 3 days where the API returns a 200 success but emails keep sending, occasionally twice per event.
answer: This is a serious issue given your compliance requirements and we're escalating it immediately. A 200 response with emails still sending points to a disconnect between the unsubscribe preference write and the notification dispatch service reading a stale cache - we're investigating the 15 affected accounts you flagged right now. We'll provide an update within the next few hours and will confirm once opt-outs are being honored correctly, along with next steps for anyone who received emails in error.

subject: Question about IP allowlist settings in Admin Console
body: I'm setting up IP allowlisting for our admin console access and want to understand how it interacts with the audit log - specifically whether blocked login attempts from non-allowlisted IPs show up as failed access events. Also curious if there's a way to preview the allowlist changes before they take effect, since we don't want to accidentally lock out our own team.
answer: Good questions, and it's smart to check before rolling this out. Yes, any blocked attempt from an IP outside your allowlist does get logged as a failed access event in your audit log with the source IP recorded. There isn't a formal preview mode currently, but we recommend adding your own current IP first and testing with a second admin account before removing broader access, and I'm happy to walk through the settings with you if that helps.

subject: Alert routing sends duplicate emails to whole ops team
body: We've set up alert routing in Notifications so that shipment delay alerts go to our ops distribution list, but for the last week every alert is arriving twice within a few seconds. It's happening for all rules tagged 'delay' and 'customs-hold'. Could you check if there's a duplicate rule being triggered on our account, or point me to documentation on how routing rules are evaluated so I can fix it myself?
answer: Thanks for flagging this - duplicate alert delivery is usually caused by two overlapping routing rules matching the same event type. I'm checking your account configuration now and will confirm whether that's the case here; in the meantime I'll send over our routing rules documentation so you can review rule precedence. I'll follow up shortly with findings.

subject: Breaking Change bei API-Deprecation betrifft unser Webhook-SDK
body: Wir haben gerade festgestellt, dass die Deprecation-Ankündigung für die /v2/webhooks Endpoints unser Produktions-SDK bricht. Seit heute Morgen erhalten wir bei jedem SDK-Call den Fehler 'unsupported_version: v2 webhook signature format deprecated'. Das betrifft alle 86 Nutzer unseres Teams, die auf die Webhook-Integration angewiesen sind. Gibt es eine Übergangsfrist oder ein Migrationsguide, damit wir die Rate-Limits und Signaturprüfung anpassen können?
answer: Vielen Dank für die Meldung, das ist bei uns als P1 eingestuft, da es produktive Webhook-Verarbeitung betrifft. Die Signaturformat-Änderung für v2 wurde vorzeitig ausgerollt, was nicht so vorgesehen war - wir arbeiten aktuell daran, die alte Signaturprüfung temporär wieder zu aktivieren, während wir Ihnen den offiziellen Migrationsleitfaden inklusive SDK-Update zusenden. Wir melden uns innerhalb der nächsten Stunde mit einem Status-Update.

subject: Need granular sharing permissions for dashboards across plants
body: As we roll out Dashboards to all 242 seats across our manufacturing sites, we're hitting a real limitation: any user with edit access to a shared dashboard can also edit the underlying charts and export data, even if they should only view it. This is blocking our rollout to plant floor supervisors who need read-only access. We'd like to request granular permission levels (view/comment/edit) at the dashboard and chart level, and if there's a workaround in the meantime we'd appreciate it since this is holding up a scheduled go-live.
answer: Thank you for the detailed context - this is an important gap and I'm escalating it to our product team given the go-live timeline you mentioned. In the short term, the closest workaround is duplicating dashboards into a 'view-only' folder with export disabled at the folder level, and I can walk you through setting that up today. I'll also flag your account for priority updates once granular role-based sharing ships.

subject: Audit log missing entries for role changes since Oct 3
body: We rely on the Admin Console audit log for compliance reporting across our 3256 seats, and we've noticed that role change events (grant/revoke of admin rights) stopped appearing in the log after October 3rd, even though we confirmed the changes were applied. Deactivation and login events are still logging fine. This is affecting our monthly compliance export due this week.
answer: Thank you for the report - a gap in role-change audit logging is a serious issue for compliance and we're treating this as high priority. We're pulling the backend event pipeline logs now to confirm where role-change events are being dropped, and will let you know within the day whether we can backfill the missing entries before your export deadline.

subject: How to filter audit log by deactivated users?
body: I'm trying to pull a report from the audit log showing only accounts we deactivated in the last month, to confirm none of them are on our SSO allowlist anymore. I can see the audit log entries but I don't see a filter option for deactivation events specifically - is there a way to do this from the console, or do I need to export and filter manually?
answer: Good question - right now the audit log UI doesn't have a dedicated deactivation filter, but you can export the full log as CSV and filter by event type 'user.deactivated' in the exported file. I'll also pass along a note to our product team requesting a built-in filter, since this is a common compliance workflow.

subject: URGENT: Storage retention policy deleted files we need for active case
body: We just discovered that our Storage retention policy purged files from a client matter folder that should have been retained under legal hold - the files show as deleted as of last night's retention job, but this folder was explicitly excluded from the 90-day auto-delete rule. We have an active case deadline and need these files recovered immediately. This looks like a bug in how retention exclusions are being applied.
answer: I understand the urgency and we're treating this as a P0 - potential data loss combined with legal hold exclusion not being honored is critical. I've escalated to our storage engineering team to check backup snapshots from before last night's retention job and to investigate why the exclusion rule wasn't applied. I'll update you within the hour with recovery status and root cause.

subject: Request: bulk workspace settings update and audit visibility
body: With 3393 seats across our energy division, we need to update several workspace-level settings (session timeout, allowlisted domains) but currently have to do it one workspace at a time through Admin Console, which is error-prone. We also noticed that a setting change we made last week to the SSO domain allowlist isn't showing up in the audit log at all, even though the change took effect. Could you help with a bulk update option and confirm why that change wasn't logged?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. Bulk workspace settings management isn't currently available in the console, but I can pass this along as a feature request for your account given the scale involved. On the missing audit entry for the allowlist change, I'm checking with our engineering team since settings changes should always be logged - I'll confirm what happened and whether it needs a fix on our end.

subject: Audit log completely empty after deactivating 40 users this morning
body: We just ran a bulk deactivation of 40 inactive accounts through Admin Console as part of a security cleanup, and the audit log page has been showing zero entries since then - not just for the deactivations, but for everything including logins. This is affecting our whole team's visibility into account activity and we need this fixed quickly since we're mid-cleanup.
answer: This has been escalated as P1 given the audit log outage is affecting your entire team's visibility mid-cleanup. We're investigating whether the bulk deactivation job overloaded the audit indexing service, which could explain the blank log. I'll update you as soon as we identify the cause, and please hold off on further bulk actions until we confirm the log is stable again.

subject: SSO role mapping not assigning correct roles after group sync
body: We use SAML SSO with group-to-role mapping in Identity and SSO, and since our last IdP group sync, several users landing in the 'finance-approvers' group are being provisioned with only the base 'viewer' role instead of the mapped 'approver' role. This is blocking approval workflows for a large chunk of our 1558 seats. The mapping rule in the console still shows 'finance-approvers -> approver' correctly configured, so I'm not sure why it's not applying on login.
answer: Thank you for the clear description - this looks like the group-to-role mapping is failing to apply during provisioning even though the rule itself is correct, which we're treating as P1 given the approval workflow impact. We're checking whether a recent IdP group sync change altered the group claim format being sent, since that's the most common cause of this symptom. I'll update you shortly with findings and a workaround if we can identify one quickly.

subject: Restore from backup failing with quota exceeded error
body: I'm trying to restore a Storage backup from September 28th after we accidentally overwrote a dataset via the API, but the restore job fails every time with 'error: restore_quota_exceeded, available: 0GB'. We're on the Pro plan and haven't uploaded anywhere near what I'd expect our quota to be. This is blocking a production data pipeline that depends on that dataset.
answer: Thanks for reporting this - a restore blocked by an incorrect quota reading is high priority since it's affecting production. I'm checking your account's actual storage usage versus quota allocation now, as this looks like it could be a miscalculation rather than a real limit. I'll follow up shortly with either a manual restore trigger or a quota correction so you can get the dataset back.

subject: Mobile app crashes after returning from offline mode
body: We've been testing offline mode on the North Partners mobile app ahead of a wider rollout to our field agents. When a device reconnects after being offline for more than 10 minutes, the app crashes on the sync screen roughly 1 in 5 times, and pending push notifications never arrive afterward. This happens on both iOS 17 and Android 14 test devices. Could you confirm if this is a known issue and whether a fix is planned?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. This matches a known interaction between the offline sync queue and push notification delivery that our mobile team is actively working on; a fix is targeted for the next app release. In the meantime, having users force-close and reopen the app after reconnecting should prevent the crash and let queued notifications come through. I'll add your account to the notification list for the release.

subject: Late-arriving data breaking downstream SLAs
body: Several of our Lumen Works travel booking pipelines have been receiving source data 3-6 hours later than the documented arrival window over the past week, which is throwing off our nightly aggregation jobs. We rely on the pipeline SLA docs to plan downstream reporting, and right now three pipelines (booking-sync, fare-updates, loyalty-events) are consistently late. Is there a known upstream delay, and could the documentation be updated to reflect current expectations?
answer: Thanks for flagging this - we're seeing intermittent delays from one of our upstream ingestion partners that's affecting several pipelines, including the three you listed. We're working with them to restore normal timing and will update the SLA documentation once we confirm the new baseline. In the meantime, I'd recommend adding a short buffer to your downstream job schedules to avoid partial-data runs.

subject: Doppelte E-Mail-Digests seit letzter Woche
body: Seit dem 10. ist uns aufgefallen, dass unsere taeglichen E-Mail-Digests aus Notifications doppelt versendet werden - jeweils im Abstand von etwa zwei Minuten. Betroffen sind alle vier Nutzer bei Granite Energy. Die Inhalte sind identisch, nur der Zeitstempel unterscheidet sich leicht. Koennen Sie pruefen, ob es an unserer Alerting-Konfiguration liegt oder ob es sich um einen Fehler auf Ihrer Seite handelt?
answer: Danke fuer die genaue Beschreibung. Wir haben in den Logs tatsaechlich doppelte Zustellversuche fuer Ihren Digest-Job gefunden, die durch einen fehlerhaften Retry-Mechanismus ausgeloest wurden. Wir deaktivieren den betroffenen Retry vorueberegehend und pruefen aktuell, ob weitere Konten betroffen sind. Wir melden uns, sobald der Fix ausgerollt ist.

subject: Clarifying API key rotation and deprecated endpoints
body: We're planning to rotate our Orion Freight API keys ahead of migrating to the v2 SDK, and I want to confirm a few things first. The docs mention that keys created before March are tied to the deprecated /v1/webhooks endpoint - will rotating the key break existing webhook subscriptions, or do we need to recreate them separately? Also, we've noticed slightly higher latency (around 400ms vs the usual 150ms) on key validation calls this week.
answer: Rotating your API key won't automatically break existing webhook subscriptions, but since those subscriptions were created under the /v1 endpoint, we'd recommend recreating them under /v2 once you rotate, since /v1/webhooks is scheduled for removal next quarter. On the latency, we're seeing a minor slowdown tied to a validation service deployment earlier this week and are already rolling back the change; it should be back to normal shortly.

subject: Transform step failing intermittently in media pipeline
body: Our main Summit Energy content-ingestion pipeline has had its transform step fail roughly 4 times a day since Monday, always with a timeout after 30 seconds on the normalize-metadata connector. Retries usually succeed on the second attempt, but it's delaying our publishing dashboard by up to an hour each time. Pipeline ID is pipe-4471 if that helps narrow it down.
answer: Thanks for including the pipeline ID - we can see pipe-4471 hitting timeouts on the normalize-metadata connector, which lines up with increased load we've been monitoring on that connector pool. We're scaling up capacity for it now and adding a longer timeout threshold as a temporary mitigation. We'll follow up once we confirm the failure rate has dropped.

subject: SDK throwing 429s constantly after upgrade to v3.2
body: After upgrading the Cobalt Partners integration to API SDK v3.2 this morning, nearly all our calls to the /patients/search endpoint are failing with rate limit errors, even though our request volume hasn't changed. Error we're seeing repeatedly: RateLimitExceeded: quota exhausted for key ck_live_9a2f, retry after 60s. This is affecting clinical staff across all 96 seats and we need this resolved urgently since it's blocking patient lookups.
answer: This is a known regression introduced in SDK v3.2 where the client-side rate limiter miscalculates quota under concurrent requests, causing premature 429s. We're pushing a hotfix, v3.2.1, within the hour; in the meantime, downgrading to v3.1.4 will restore normal behavior. We're treating this as high priority given the impact on patient lookups and will update you as soon as the hotfix is live.

subject: Connector auth failing intermittently for data pipelines
body: Our IT team manages several data pipeline connectors for Atlas Health, and over the past two weeks one of our source connectors has been failing authentication roughly once a day with a token refresh error, then recovering on its own within a few minutes. It's not blocking us yet since retries succeed, but I'd like to understand the root cause before it becomes a bigger sync issue. Connector name is energy-meter-feed-01.
answer: Thanks for the heads up before this becomes a bigger issue. We looked at energy-meter-feed-01 and found the OAuth token refresh is occasionally racing with an expiring session on the source system's side, causing the brief auth failures you're seeing. We're working on a fix to refresh tokens earlier in the cycle, and I'll let you know once it's deployed so you can confirm the failures stop.

subject: MFA enrolment stuck for two Apex Energy users
body: I'm a support engineer on our side and I've got two users at Apex Energy who can't complete MFA enrolment - the QR code loads fine in the authenticator app, but when they enter the generated code, they get invalid code, please try again every time, even right after refreshing. This is blocking their login entirely since MFA is required. Usernames are jsmith and rpatel if that helps.
answer: Sorry for the trouble this is causing - since login is blocked for both users, we're treating this as urgent. This pattern usually points to a time-sync issue between the authenticator app and our server, or a stale enrolment session; we're resetting the MFA enrolment state for jsmith and rpatel now so they can re-enroll cleanly. Please have them try again in the next few minutes and let us know if the invalid code error persists.

subject: PDF-Export aus Dashboards schlaegt komplett fehl
body: Seit heute Morgen koennen alle Nutzer bei Apex Academy keine Dashboards mehr als PDF exportieren - der Export-Button laedt kurz und zeigt dann eine leere Seite oder einen Fehler an. Wir nutzen die Exportfunktion fuer unsere woechentlichen Berichte an die Schulleitung, die heute Nachmittag verschickt werden muessen. Betroffen sind mindestens drei verschiedene Dashboards mit groesseren Diagrammen, kleinere Dashboards scheinen noch zu funktionieren.
answer: Das tut uns leid, wir sehen die Dringlichkeit angesichts Ihres heutigen Berichtstermins. Wir konnten das Problem bereits nachstellen: Der PDF-Renderer haengt sich bei Dashboards mit groesseren Diagrammen auf, was zu dem leeren Export fuehrt, den Sie beschreiben. Unser Team arbeitet mit hoechster Prioritaet an einem Fix und wir melden uns innerhalb der naechsten Stunde mit einem Update, ob eine kurzfristige Loesung fuer Ihre heutigen Berichte moeglich ist.

subject: URGENT: Storage retention deleting data early, quota errors
body: We administer Storage for Lumen Capital and just discovered that files we configured to retain for 90 days are being deleted after roughly 30 days instead, affecting multiple buckets across our organization. On top of that, several users are now hitting quota exceeded errors even though our dashboard shows we're well under our allocated limit. This looks like a retention policy bug and is causing real data loss for us across all 134 seats.
answer: We understand the severity of this and have escalated it immediately as a potential data loss incident. We've identified a bug in the retention policy engine that is misapplying a 30-day default instead of your configured 90-day setting, and we're pausing all scheduled deletions across your organization right now while we investigate recoverability for already-deleted files. We'll also look into the quota discrepancy in parallel and will update you within the hour with findings and next steps.

subject: Repeated transform failures on manufacturing pipeline
body:
We're seeing repeated transform failures on our 'plant-metrics-agg' pipeline since this morning (around 08:15 UTC). The job fails at the aggregation step with a data quality error about null values in the sensor_reading column, even though our source connector shows the field populated. This has happened on 6 of the last 9 runs and is delaying our shift reports.

Pipeline ID is dp-4471-agg. Can someone check if this is related to the connector sync we saw flagged yesterday?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. We've pulled logs for dp-4471-agg and can confirm intermittent null coercion happening upstream of your transform, likely tied to a sync lag on the source connector that started around the same time. We're escalating this to our data pipeline engineering team now and will update you within a few hours with a root cause and a workaround so your shift reports aren't further delayed.

subject: How to link Jira issues from Salesforce integration
body:
We're trying to set up the Jira link inside our Salesforce integration so that support cases automatically create linked Jira tickets, but the link action in the integration panel is timing out after about 20 seconds with no error message. We've tried this on three separate cases today and it fails every time, even though the Jira connection test passes.

Can you confirm whether this is a known performance issue with the Jira linking feature, and if there's a workaround while it's investigated?
answer: Thanks for flagging this — we've seen a few reports of the Jira link action timing out when the linked Jira project has a large custom field set, which can slow down the handshake between Salesforce and Jira. Could you tell us which Jira project key you're linking to? In the meantime, creating the link from the Jira side (using the Salesforce case ID) should work as a temporary workaround while we investigate the timeout.

subject: Need to restore files from backup after accidental deletion
body: Yesterday one of our team members accidentally deleted a folder containing Q3 invoice scans from our Storage workspace. I can see in the activity log that the deletion happened around 3:40pm, but I don't see a way to restore from backup myself as a finance manager role. Could someone help restore this folder, or point me to where I can trigger a restore on our Starter plan?
answer: Sorry for the trouble, and thanks for the timestamp — that helps us locate the right backup snapshot. On the Starter plan, restores need to be initiated by our team rather than self-service, so we'll pull the folder from the nightly backup taken before 3:40pm and restore it to its original location. We'll confirm here once the restore completes, typically within a few hours.

subject: URGENT: Storage quota hit, backups failing, retention data possibly lost
body:
Our storage quota was exceeded overnight and it looks like our scheduled backup job silently failed as a result. Retention policy on our compliance archive is 7 years and I'm concerned we may have lost last night's snapshot entirely, since the backup dashboard shows no entry for today's date. This is a compliance issue for us given the manufacturing audit we have next week.

We need confirmation immediately on whether any archived data was actually deleted or just skipped in the backup run.
answer: We understand the urgency and are treating this as a P0 right now. Initial checks show no data was deleted — the backup job was skipped rather than run, so your existing retained snapshots remain intact, but we are verifying this against your full retention history before confirming fully. We're also raising your quota limit immediately to prevent further skipped backups and will follow up within the hour with written confirmation for your compliance records.

subject: Frequent upload failures and request for quota alerts
body:
Over the past week our team has hit repeated upload failures in Storage, mostly on files over 500MB, with the error 'upload interrupted, quota check failed' even though our dashboard shows we're at 78% of our quota. This is affecting several teams uploading project archives.

Separately, as a feature request, could we get proactive email alerts when we approach quota thresholds instead of discovering it through failed uploads? That would help us plan ahead across our 190 seats.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report — a quota check failing at 78% usage isn't expected, so we're looking into whether there's a miscalculation between your workspace's soft and hard limits for large file uploads. We'll follow up with findings shortly. We've also logged your request for proactive quota threshold alerts as product feedback, which is a popular ask and something our product team is actively considering for an upcoming release.

subject: Biometric login failing intermittently on mobile app
body:
Several of our team members, myself included, are having trouble with biometric login (Face ID) on the mobile app since updating to the latest version last week. The app either hangs on the fingerprint/face prompt or crashes back to the lock screen, forcing us to log in with password instead. This is happening on both iOS 17 devices we've tested.

Is this a known issue with the current release, and is there a fix planned?
answer: Thanks for reporting this — we're aware of an issue in the latest mobile release where biometric prompts can hang on certain iOS 17 devices, particularly after a recent OS update changed how Face ID sessions are handled. Our mobile team has a fix in testing now; in the meantime, password login remains reliable, and we'll notify you here as soon as the patch is released.

subject: Requesting changes to offline mode behavior in mobile app
body:
Our team uses the mobile app in areas with poor connectivity, and we'd like to request a change to how offline mode handles cached data. Currently it seems to clear cached content after about 15 minutes offline, which causes crashes when reconnecting and syncing, and we've had two crash reports this week from field staff. We'd like the cache retention extended or made configurable.

Could you let us know if this is something that can be adjusted or is planned for a future release?
answer: Thanks for the detailed context — extending offline cache retention is a reasonable request, and we can see how the current 15-minute window is causing sync-related crashes for your field staff. We're logging this as a change request for our mobile team to evaluate a configurable retention setting, and we'll also look into the specific crash-on-reconnect behavior you described in the meantime.

subject: Question about user deactivation and audit log entries
body: I deactivated a former employee's account in the Admin Console last week, but I noticed the audit log entry only shows 'user status changed' without specifying who performed the action or the exact timestamp beyond the date. For our compliance reviews we'd like more detail in these entries. Is this level of audit logging expected, or is there a setting to enable more granular logs?
answer: Good question — currently the audit log on the Starter plan records the action type and date but not the performing admin or precise timestamp, which is a limitation of that tier rather than a bug. We'll pass this along as feedback for more granular logging, and in the meantime, if you need a specific timestamp for a past deactivation, we can pull that from our internal system logs on request.

subject: Duplicate email alerts going out to customers - needs urgent fix
body:
We're seeing duplicate notification emails being sent to our customers for the same event — some are getting the same shipment alert twice within a minute. This started after we updated one of our alert rules on Tuesday. We've had 14 customer complaints so far today about this and it's affecting trust in our alerts across our fintech client base.

Can someone help identify why the duplicate is being triggered and how to stop it quickly?
answer: Thank you for flagging this immediately — duplicate alerts going out to your customers is high priority for us. We're checking whether the rule update on Tuesday created an overlapping trigger condition that's firing the same event twice, and we'll have a preliminary finding within the next couple of hours. In the meantime, if you're able to pause the specific alert rule you modified, that should stop new duplicates from going out while we investigate the root cause.

subject: Zapier integration failing to trigger from Salesforce events
body:
Our Zapier integration, which we use to sync Salesforce lead updates into Slack and Okta provisioning workflows, stopped triggering as of yesterday afternoon. The Zap history shows 'no data found' errors even though the Salesforce records were updated as expected. We've checked our Salesforce API connection and it seems fine.

This is affecting our onboarding process since new leads aren't reaching the right Slack channels for follow-up. Can you help escalate this?
answer: Thanks for the details — we're escalating this now since it's impacting your onboarding workflow. 'No data found' errors from Zapier usually point to a webhook or trigger field mismatch on the Salesforce side after a recent integration update, so we're checking whether that update affected your specific Zap configuration. We'll update you within the next few hours with findings and, if needed, help you reconfigure the trigger to restore the Slack notifications.

subject: Upload failures across Storage buckets since 03:10 UTC - retention jobs affected
body:
We're seeing widespread upload failures on our Storage buckets starting at 03:10 UTC today. About 40% of uploads from our retail POS sync jobs are returning 503 errors, and our nightly backup retention job (bucket vertex-retail-backup-01) failed completely at 04:00 UTC. This is blocking our compliance backup window and we need this escalated immediately since we have a 24-hour retention SLA to meet.

Error from our logs: "PUT object failed: 503 Service Unavailable, retry exhausted after 5 attempts". Object count affected so far: 2,314. Can someone confirm if this is a regional Storage incident?
answer: Thank you for flagging this immediately, this has been escalated to our Storage on-call team as a P1. We've confirmed elevated error rates on the storage cluster serving your region starting around 03:05 UTC and engineering is actively working a fix; we'll push an update within 30 minutes. In the meantime, please hold off retrying the backup job in a loop as it's adding load to the affected cluster - we'll notify you the moment uploads are stable again so you can re-run the retention job.

subject: How to set up fingerprint login on mobile app
body: I'd like to enable fingerprint or Face ID login on the Northwind mobile app for my team instead of typing our password every time. I looked through the app settings on my iPhone but I don't see a toggle for biometric login. Is this feature available on the Starter plan, and if so where do I turn it on?
answer: Biometric login is available on all plans including Starter, so you should be able to enable it. Go to Settings > Security within the app, then look for "Enable Face ID / Touch ID" - it only appears after you've logged in once with your password on that device. If it's still not showing up, let us know your app version (found under Settings > About) and we'll dig further.

subject: Duplicate and misrouted alerts going to wrong teams - urgent
body:
Since yesterday our production alerts through Notifications are being duplicated and sent to the wrong distribution lists. Our finance team is now receiving equipment-failure alerts meant for the floor operations group, and some critical machine-down alerts are arriving 3-4 times within a minute. We rely on correct routing to react to manufacturing line issues within minutes, so this is causing real delays on the shop floor.

We haven't changed any routing rules on our end recently. Can you check if something changed on the alert routing engine? This needs urgent attention as it's affecting all 174 seats across our sites.
answer: We're sorry for the disruption this is causing on your floor operations. This has been escalated to our alerting team as a P1 - we can see routing rule evaluation errors affecting your account starting last night, which is causing the duplicate delivery and misrouting to the wrong groups. We're rolling back to the last known-good routing configuration for your workspace now and will confirm once alerts are correctly targeted again, likely within the hour.

subject: Push notifications not arriving on Android - feature request for offline queue too
body:
Our field technicians using the Android mobile app have stopped receiving push notifications for new work orders since last week. We've confirmed notification permissions are enabled on the devices and reinstalled the app on a few test units with no improvement. Given we have over 3,000 field staff relying on this for dispatch, this is a significant operational issue.

Separately, we'd like to request a feature: when a device is offline, could notifications queue and deliver once connectivity returns, rather than being dropped entirely? Right now technicians in low-signal warehouse areas miss dispatch alerts completely.
answer: Thank you for the detailed report - given the scale of impact to your dispatch operations we're treating the push delivery issue as a P1. Our mobile team is investigating an Android push token registration bug that we believe started with last week's app update; we'll need the app version and a couple of affected device IDs to confirm the root cause. We've also logged your offline-queuing request as a feature request and will pass it to product for consideration, though it isn't part of the immediate fix.

subject: sync issue
body: We've been reviewing our retail data pipeline setup over the past few weeks as part of a broader audit of our reporting accuracy, and generally things have been fine except for one recurring hiccup with the scheduled syncs. Also could we get an option to change sync frequency per connector? Sync fails silently sometimes.
answer: Thanks for the context - we'd like to understand the silent failures better since that's the priority here. Could you share which connector this affects and roughly when it last failed silently (a timestamp or sync run ID would help)? On the feature request side, per-connector sync frequency is something we've heard before and I'll log it for our product team to evaluate.

subject: Scheduled sync latency spiking on legal document connector
body: Our nightly scheduled sync for the legal case management connector has been running increasingly slow over the past four days - it normally completes in about 20 minutes but has stretched to over 2 hours as of last night's run (sync ID sync-88213-lumen). No errors are showing in the run log, just long gaps between stage transitions. We haven't changed data volume significantly on our end.
answer: Thanks for the sync ID, that's helpful. We can see the run is spending most of its time in the transform stage rather than extraction, which points to a queue backlog on that connector type rather than an issue with your data. We're looking into throughput on our side and will also check if there's a documentation gap around expected sync windows for this connector - we'll update you within a day with findings.

subject: SSO role mapping not assigning correct permissions after group change
body: We recently restructured our Azure AD groups for the legal team and updated the SAML group claims accordingly, but several users who moved from "Associate" to "Partner" groups are still showing up with Associate-level permissions in Northwind after logging in via SSO. Re-triggering login doesn't seem to refresh the role mapping. Could you point us to documentation on how role mapping refresh timing works, and whether MFA re-enrollment is needed after a group change?
answer: Good question - role mapping is typically re-evaluated on every new SSO session, but cached sessions can hold onto the old role until they expire, which is likely what you're seeing. We'll send over our SSO role mapping documentation which covers claim refresh behavior and provisioning timing. To answer your other question, MFA enrollment is independent of group/role changes so no re-enrollment should be needed - if the issue persists after a fresh login for one affected user, let us know their username and we'll check the claim mapping on our end.

subject: Request: connector for accounting software sync with lower latency option
body: We're currently on the Starter plan and would like to know if there's a way to add a data pipeline connector for our accounting software so we can sync invoice data automatically instead of exporting CSVs manually every week. Also, is there a way to reduce sync latency, or is that tied to a higher plan tier?
answer: Thanks for reaching out. Connector availability does vary by plan, and I'd need to check whether the accounting connector you're referring to is included on Starter - could you let us know the specific software name? Regarding latency, faster sync intervals are generally available on our higher tiers, so I'll get you exact details once I know which connector you need.

subject: SCIM provisioning not creating users automatically
body: We set up SCIM provisioning last week to automatically create user accounts from our identity provider, but new employees added to the assigned group aren't showing up in Northwind's user list. We've confirmed the SCIM endpoint and bearer token are configured correctly and the test connection succeeded. Is there a delay before provisioning kicks in, or do we need to enable something else for automatic user creation on the Starter plan?
answer: Good news is your SCIM connection test succeeding means the endpoint itself is healthy. Automatic provisioning does require the "Enable auto-provisioning" toggle to be turned on separately from the connection setup - it's a common step that gets missed. Could you check under Identity settings > SCIM > Provisioning Rules and confirm that's enabled? If it is and users still aren't appearing, send us the SCIM sync log timestamp and we'll investigate further.

subject: Dashboard sharing permissions broken - shared users seeing stale data
body: We're seeing an issue where dashboards shared with view-only permissions to other departments are showing cached/stale data even after the underlying data refreshes, while the owner's view updates correctly. This started after we updated sharing settings on our "Production Line Efficiency" dashboard on Tuesday. We've also noticed export-to-PDF from shared views pulls the old stale data too, not the current numbers. This affects several dashboards shared across our 303 seats and is causing confusion in review meetings.
answer: Thanks for the clear writeup, this looks like a caching issue tied to the sharing permission layer rather than the underlying data refresh, which explains why owners see current data but shared viewers don't. We're marking this P2 and reproducing it now with a dashboard shared the same way - can you confirm whether the shared users are added individually or via a group/role, as that will help narrow down the caching path? We'll also check the PDF export pipeline since it appears to inherit the same stale cache.

subject: Storage retention policy not deleting old backups past 90-day quota
body: We have retention set to 90 days on our energy-data bucket (northhealth-prod), but I'm seeing backup files from March still present in storage as of today. This is pushing us close to our quota limit and upload speeds have degraded noticeably over the last two days, taking 3-4x longer than normal. Can someone check why the retention job isn't purging files older than the policy window?
answer: Thanks for flagging this - I can see your retention job for northhealth-prod has been failing silently since March 28th due to a lock conflict with a concurrent backup process. I've manually triggered a cleanup pass to purge eligible files and will monitor to confirm quota usage drops back to normal. I'll also fix the underlying scheduling conflict so this doesn't recur, and update you once the purge completes, likely within a few hours.

subject: Old API key still shows as active after rotation
body: I rotated our API key last week for billing exports but the old key still appears as active in the dashboard under API Platform. I'm not a developer so I just want to confirm whether I should manually revoke it or if it will expire on its own. We only have a handful of seats here so I want to make sure nothing breaks on our end before I touch anything.
answer: Good question - rotated keys don't auto-expire, they stay valid until manually revoked to avoid breaking any in-flight integrations. Since you've confirmed the new key is working, it's safe to revoke the old one from the API Platform settings page under Keys. Let me know if you'd like me to revoke it on our side instead so you don't have to touch the dashboard.

subject: SCIM sync not creating new user accounts
body: We added three new employees in our HR system yesterday and they were supposed to sync via SCIM into Granite Academy's workspace, but none of them appear in our user list today. Existing users are syncing fine for updates, it's just new user creation that seems stuck. Is there a doc on how SCIM handles new provisioning versus updates that I could check first?
answer: Thanks for the details - new user provisioning via SCIM does follow a slightly different flow than attribute updates, and I want to check your integration logs to see where the create requests are landing. In the meantime, here's our SCIM provisioning guide which covers the create-vs-update distinction: [docs link]. I'll dig into your specific sync logs and follow up with what I find.

subject: SESSION TIMEOUT SETTINGS NOT APPLYING ACROSS ORG
body: WE CHANGED THE SESSION TIMEOUT POLICY TO 30 MINUTES FOR ALL 1598 SEATS LAST WEEK BUT USERS ARE STILL BEING KEPT LOGGED IN FOR HOURS. THIS IS A COMPLIANCE REQUIREMENT FOR OUR AUDIT NEXT MONTH AND WE NEED THIS FIXED OR CONFIRMED WORKING SOON. CAN SOMEONE TELL US IF THIS IS A PROPAGATION DELAY OR IF THE SETTING ISN'T BEING APPLIED AT THE SSO LEVEL AT ALL.
answer: Understood, this is important for your compliance timeline. Session timeout policy changes at your scale can take up to 24 hours to fully propagate across all SSO nodes, but if it's been over a week that points to something not applying correctly rather than a delay. I'm escalating this to our identity team now to check whether the policy is actually being enforced at the SSO layer, and will update you within the day with findings.

subject: Webhooks failing intermittently since last night, affecting production
body: Since around 11pm last night our webhook deliveries for payment status updates have been failing intermittently, roughly 1 in 5 requests are timing out on our end with 504s. This is affecting real-time reconciliation for our fintech customers and we're having to fall back to polling, which isn't sustainable. We're on the standard rate limit tier and haven't changed anything on our side recently. Can you check if there's an issue on the webhook delivery service?
answer: Thank you for the detailed report - this matches a pattern we're seeing in our webhook delivery infrastructure since last night, likely related to increased latency in one of our delivery regions. I'm escalating this to our platform team as a P1 given the production impact on your reconciliation flow, and we'll investigate the 504 timeouts immediately. I'll update you within the hour with either a fix or a mitigation you can apply on your end in the meantime.

subject: Dashboards taking 30+ seconds to load charts
body: Our team dashboards have gotten really slow over the past week, charts that used to load in a couple seconds now take 30 seconds or more, especially the ones with weekly trend data. We have 22 seats and about 8 dashboards with multiple charts each. It's making our morning standup review painful since we're just staring at loading spinners. Nothing changed on our config that I know of.
answer: Sorry to hear the dashboards have slowed down that much - that's a significant regression from what you should be seeing. Can you tell me which specific dashboards or chart types are worst affected, and roughly how much data each chart is pulling (date range, number of data points)? I'll start looking at query performance on our end in parallel and will follow up with findings once I have more to go on.

subject: Document uploads failing with quota error despite having space
body: Several of our team members have been unable to upload contract PDFs since yesterday, getting an error that says storage quota exceeded. We checked our usage dashboard and we're only at about 40% of our allotted quota, so this doesn't make sense. It's blocking our contract review workflow which is time-sensitive for a few active deals. Uploads under 5MB seem to work but anything larger fails.
answer: That's odd given your actual usage is well under quota - this looks like it could be a stale quota calculation rather than a real limit issue, especially since it's correlating with file size rather than total usage. I'm looking into your account's quota tracking now to see if there's a caching problem causing incorrect enforcement. I'll follow up shortly with either a fix or a workaround so your team can get contracts uploaded today.

subject: Salesforce sync completely down, no records syncing since this morning
body: Our Salesforce integration stopped syncing records entirely as of around 8am today. We have 151 users depending on this for lead updates and nothing is coming through, not even manual trigger syncs work. I checked our integration logs and see repeated 'connection refused' errors when it tries to reach the Salesforce API endpoint. This is blocking our sales team completely, we need this resolved urgently.
answer: This is impacting your whole sales workflow so I'm treating it as a P1 and escalating immediately. The connection refused errors suggest either a credential or endpoint issue on our integration layer talking to Salesforce - can you confirm if you rotated any Salesforce API credentials recently on your end? I'm checking our integration service status now and will have an update for you within the next 30 minutes.

subject: Jira issue links not appearing after linking from Integrations panel
body: I've been trying to link Jira tickets to our Northwind integration records for the past two days but the links don't persist, they show up briefly then disappear after refreshing the page. I'm using the standard link workflow from the Integrations settings panel, nothing custom. This is slowing down our team's ability to track issues tied to specific integration events, would appreciate a look into why the links aren't sticking.
answer: Thanks for reporting this - a disappearing link after refresh usually points to the link not actually being persisted server-side, possibly a save confirmation issue in the panel. Could you send me one example Jira issue key and the corresponding integration record ID where you saw this happen? That'll help me trace whether it's failing silently on save or being overwritten on the next sync cycle.

subject: Need audit log export and IP allowlist settings for compliance review
body: We're preparing for an internal security review and need to export our full admin console audit log for the past 90 days, including login events and permission changes across our 250 seats. Separately, I also need to confirm our current IP allowlist settings are correctly configured since we recently deactivated a batch of contractor accounts. Could you point me to where I can export this and confirm the allowlist is applied correctly?
answer: Happy to help get you ready for the review. You can export the audit log from Admin Console under Settings > Audit Log > Export, which supports a 90-day range and includes login and permission change events. For the IP allowlist, I'll pull up your current configuration and confirm it reflects the recent contractor deactivations, and send you a summary so you have documentation for the review.

subject: Storage quota increase request for compliance backups
body: We're approaching our storage quota on the Pro plan at Ember Energy and need to plan ahead before our next backup cycle runs on the 15th. Our current usage sits at 892GB out of the 1TB allocation, mostly driven by retained transaction logs we keep for 7-year regulatory retention. Can you tell us what tiers are available above our current quota, and whether upgrading mid-cycle affects billing proration? We'd like to avoid any upload failures during our nightly backup jobs.
answer: Thanks for getting ahead of this. Your account can move to the next quota tier (2TB) with proration applied automatically to your current billing cycle, so there's no service interruption to your nightly backup jobs. I'll send over the upgrade link along with documentation on retention policy configuration in case you want to adjust log lifecycle rules to reduce growth going forward.

subject: Invoice shows wrong seat count after API integration setup
body: I'm integrating the Northwind Billing API for Lumen Freight and noticed our latest invoice (INV-88213) bills for 15 seats when we only have 12 active users configured in the admin console. I checked our API calls to the /seats endpoint and they consistently return count: 12. This discrepancy has now happened on two consecutive billing cycles and is affecting our monthly reconciliation.
answer: Thanks for flagging this with the specific invoice number. This looks like a sync issue between seat provisioning events and the billing service rather than an API reporting bug, since your /seats endpoint data is correct. I'm escalating this to our billing team to reconcile INV-88213 and issue a credit for the discrepancy, and I'll follow up within one business day with confirmation.

subject: PDF export completely broken on all dashboards - urgent
body: As of this morning none of our dashboards at Cobalt Analytics can export to PDF. Every attempt returns a blank white page instead of the chart data, tested across three different dashboards and two browsers. This is blocking our weekly media performance report that's due to a client by end of day. We have 14 seats and multiple team members hitting the same failure.
answer: I'm sorry for the disruption this is causing right before your client deadline. We've confirmed a rendering issue affecting PDF export across dashboards and our engineering team is actively working on a fix now. As a workaround, you can export the underlying chart data to CSV or use the 'Export as image' option per chart while we resolve the PDF renderer, and I'll update you as soon as it's fixed.

subject: Frage zur Deaktivierung von Nutzern im Admin Console
body: Wir müssen mehrere ehemalige Mitarbeiter im Admin Console deaktivieren, die unser Bildungsprogramm verlassen haben. Aktuell sehe ich nur die Option, Nutzer komplett zu löschen, aber wir möchten die Audit-Log-Einträge dieser Nutzer für unsere Compliance-Anforderungen behalten. Gibt es eine Möglichkeit, Nutzer zu deaktivieren, ohne ihre Historie zu verlieren, und wie wirkt sich das auf unsere Allowlist-Einstellungen aus?
answer: Vielen Dank für Ihre Anfrage. Sie können Nutzer über den Menüpunkt 'Nutzerverwaltung' deaktivieren, indem Sie auf den betreffenden Nutzer klicken und 'Deaktivieren' statt 'Löschen' auswählen – dabei bleiben alle Audit-Log-Einträge vollständig erhalten. Deaktivierte Nutzer werden automatisch aus aktiven Allowlist-Einträgen entfernt, behalten aber ihren historischen Zugriffsnachweis für Compliance-Zwecke.

subject: settings page won't save
body: Workspace settings page just spins, nothing saves.
answer: Sorry for the trouble - could you let me know which specific setting you're trying to change (e.g. allowlist, deactivation rules, or general workspace name/logo)? In the meantime, please try a hard refresh or a different browser, as this can sometimes clear a stuck save state. I'll also check our logs for your workspace to see if requests are failing server-side.

subject: Slack alerts stopped firing for all integrations
body: Since yesterday afternoon, none of our Slack alert integrations are sending notifications for Ember Media's dashboards, even though the integration shows as 'Connected' in settings. We rely on these alerts for daily energy usage anomaly detection across our 4-seat team, and missing even one alert cycle risks unnoticed spikes. We haven't changed anything on our Slack workspace or Okta configuration recently.
answer: Thank you for the detailed report, and I understand the urgency given your anomaly detection use case. We're seeing a broader issue with Slack webhook delivery that started yesterday and our integrations team is actively investigating; it appears unrelated to your Okta setup. I'll escalate this as high priority and update you within a few hours with either a fix or a workaround using email alerts as a temporary bridge.

subject: How do we set up Okta SSO for our team
body: We want to roll out Okta SSO for Apex Freight so our 20 users can log into Northwind through our existing Okta tenant instead of separate passwords. I found some Slack and Salesforce integration docs but nothing specific walking through the Okta app setup step by step. Could someone point me to the right guide or walk me through configuring the SAML app on our end?
answer: Happy to help get Okta SSO configured. I'm sending over our step-by-step SAML setup guide which covers creating the Northwind app in your Okta admin console, mapping attributes, and entering the resulting metadata into our Admin Console under Security settings. Since this affects login for your whole team, let me know once you've started the setup and I can walk through the final verification step with you live if needed.

subject: URGENT: possible data exposure via storage retention bug
body: We just discovered that files we marked for deletion under our 30-day retention policy at Harbor Capital are still accessible via direct upload links from over 90 days ago. A client-facing document that should have been purged in early October was just accessed by someone outside our organization. This is a serious compliance issue for us given the sensitive travel booking data involved and we need this addressed immediately.
answer: I've escalated this to our security team as a P0 incident immediately given the potential data exposure. We're disabling the affected upload links right now and auditing retention policy enforcement across your account to determine the scope and root cause. I will be your direct point of contact through this incident and will update you within the hour with findings and containment steps.

subject: Need itemized invoice breakdown for our accounting team
body: Our accounting team at Ember Retail needs a more detailed invoice breakdown for our last three billing cycles, showing the per-seat charges separately from add-on features across our 186 seats. The summary invoices we receive only show a single total, which makes it hard to reconcile against our internal cost allocation by department. Is there a way to get itemized invoices going forward, or an export option for historical billing data?
answer: Thanks for the request. We can enable itemized invoicing on your account which breaks out per-seat costs, add-ons, and any usage-based charges as separate line items starting with your next billing cycle. For the past three cycles, I can generate a detailed CSV export with the same breakdown and send it over within the next day for your accounting team's reconciliation.

subject: Repeated upload failures blocking daily backups
body: Uploads to Storage have been failing intermittently for Atlas Labs since Tuesday, with about 30% of our scheduled backup jobs erroring out. The failures show timeout errors even though we're well under our quota at 340GB of our allocation. This is affecting our 23-user team's ability to complete daily retention-compliant backups, and we're now two days behind on our backup schedule.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report - a 30% failure rate on backups is clearly impacting your retention compliance and we're treating this as high priority. We've identified elevated latency on part of our storage backend that matches your timeframe and are actively working on remediation; in the meantime, could you share one or two job IDs from failed uploads so we can trace them specifically? I'll keep you updated as we roll out the fix.

subject: Files being deleted before retention period ends
body: We've set our storage retention policy to 90 days for the media-archive bucket (policy ID ret-8842), but I'm seeing files from March 14th and 15th already purged after only about 40 days. This has happened for at least 12 files that our compliance team needs on hand. Can you check why the policy isn't being honored for this bucket?
answer: Thanks for flagging this, and I understand the compliance concern. This does sound like a retention policy bug rather than expected behavior, so I'm escalating it to our storage engineering team now with the bucket ID and file list you provided. In the meantime, please avoid modifying the policy on that bucket so we can trace exactly what triggered the early purge, and I'll update you within one business day.

subject: SCIM group sync not creating new group mappings

Currently the connector doesn't have a built-in grace period, but you can trigger a manual backfill sync for a specific date range via the pipeline's 'Reprocess Window' action, which will re-ingest and reconcile records without duplicating already-synced rows.

I'll also file a feature request on your behalf for a configurable late-arrival buffer at the connector level, since this would help avoid the manual step going forward. I'll update this ticket once there's movement on that request.
