subject: Seat count on invoice doesn't match our active users
body:
Our latest invoice bills us for 3,460 seats, but when I run the active users report from the admin console I only count 3,180 active accounts. This discrepancy has shown up on our last two billing cycles and I need to reconcile it before our audit next week.

Can someone confirm how seat counts are calculated, and whether deactivated users from March are still being counted?
answer: Thanks for flagging this ahead of your audit. Seat counts are typically based on a snapshot taken on the billing date, so deactivated accounts can sometimes still count if they were active at that moment. I'm pulling the seat history for your account now to compare against your March deactivation list, and will follow up with a breakdown and a corrected invoice if we find an error on our end.

subject: Okta SSO app throwing errors, blocking all logins
body:
We just set up the Okta integration for Northwind and users can't log in at all - every login attempt returns 'SAML response invalid, audience restriction mismatch'. This is blocking our entire team of 3 from accessing the platform, which is critical since we're mid-onboarding.

We followed the setup guide exactly, entity ID and ACS URL match what's in the Okta app config. Please advise urgently, we have a go-live scheduled for tomorrow.
answer: I understand the urgency with your go-live tomorrow, so I'm escalating this to our integrations team right now. The audience restriction mismatch usually means the SP Entity ID in Okta doesn't exactly match what Northwind expects, including trailing slashes or casing. Can you paste the exact Entity ID and ACS URL from your Okta app config here so we can verify against our side within the hour?

subject: Requesting credit for duplicate invoice charge and refund timeline
body: We were charged twice on invoice #INV-88421 for our March billing cycle, once on the 3rd and again on the 5th, both for the same amount. I've confirmed with our accounting team that only one payment should have gone through. Can you process a refund or credit for the duplicate charge, and let me know the expected timeline?
answer: Thank you for catching this and providing the invoice number. I've located both charges on invoice #INV-88421 and confirmed the duplicate. I'm submitting a refund request for the second charge now, which typically takes 5-7 business days to appear on your statement, and I'll send a confirmation once it's processed.

subject: Need to restrict dashboard sharing to internal domains only
body:
We're currently able to share dashboards via public link, but our security policy now requires that sharing be limited to users within our own domain. I'd like to change the default sharing permission setting across all workspaces so external links are disabled going forward, without breaking existing internal shares.

Is this a setting I can change myself in admin settings, or does it require a config change on your end?
answer: This is something you can manage directly from Admin Settings > Sharing Policies, where you can restrict link sharing to your verified domain and disable public links organization-wide. Existing internal shares within your domain won't be affected by this change. If you'd like, I can also walk through auditing currently active public links so you can revoke any that shouldn't remain.

subject: Duplicate alerts being sent to wrong on-call channel
body:
Our alert routing rules are sending duplicate notifications, and some are going to the wrong Slack channel entirely. Since yesterday around 9am, our billing anomaly alerts have been landing in the #ops-general channel instead of #billing-alerts, and each alert is arriving twice within a few minutes.

We have 19 people relying on these routes for incident response, so this is causing real confusion. Can you check our routing configuration?
answer: Sorry for the disruption to your incident response workflow. Duplicate delivery combined with misrouting suggests a conflict between two overlapping alert rules pointing to different channels. I'm reviewing your notification routing config now and will check for the overlap; in the meantime, could you confirm if any routing rules were edited or added around 9am yesterday so I can narrow down the cause faster?

subject: Feedback on SDK error handling and deprecation notice
body:
We're integrating the Northwind API Platform SDK (Node version) into our internal tooling and keep hitting unclear error messages when rate limits are hit, just a generic 'Error 429' with no retry-after guidance in the SDK's exception object. Separately, I noticed a deprecation warning in the changelog for the v2 client but no migration guide linked.

Could you point me to SDK error handling docs, and is there a timeline for the v2 deprecation migration guide?
answer: Thanks for the feedback, this is useful for our SDK team. Currently the Node SDK does pass through the Retry-After header in the response object, though I agree it's not surfaced clearly in the exception itself, so I'll file that as an improvement request. For the v2 deprecation, a migration guide is planned for release alongside the v2.1 SDK next month; I'll share the link here as soon as it's published.

subject: Unsubscribed users still receiving marketing notifications
body:
We have a serious problem where customers who clicked unsubscribe are still getting our weekly digest emails through Northwind Notifications. I've confirmed at least 40 contacts who unsubscribed over the past two weeks but received the digest sent yesterday at 8am. This is a compliance risk for us and needs urgent attention.

Can you check if the unsubscribe list sync is failing? We use the API to push suppression updates daily.
answer: Thank you for raising this immediately, I understand the compliance risk and I'm treating this as high priority. I'm checking our suppression list sync logs now for the past two weeks to see if there's a delay or failure in processing your API pushes. Can you send me two or three of the affected contact identifiers and the timestamps they unsubscribed, so I can trace exactly where the sync broke down?

subject: charts down
body: charts all broke since this am, blank panels evrywhere on prod dashbord, ppl cant see any data pls help asap
answer: Sorry for the disruption, I'm escalating this now as a priority issue. Can you confirm which dashboard or workspace is affected and roughly when this morning it started, and let me know if this is happening for all users or just some? I'll start checking on our end for any related incidents right away.

subject: Intermittent chart rendering failures on shared finance dashboard
body:
Over the past few days our shared finance dashboard has occasionally shown broken bar charts, they render as empty grey boxes with no error message, though refreshing the page usually fixes it temporarily. It's happened maybe 5 times this week, mostly for users viewing via a shared link rather than logged in directly.

It's not blocking our work but it looks unprofessional when it happens during reviews. Could you look into what's causing this?
answer: Thanks for the detailed pattern, that's helpful. The fact that it's mostly occurring on shared-link views rather than logged-in sessions suggests a caching issue with how chart data loads for unauthenticated viewers. I'll have our dashboards team investigate the shared-link rendering path and will follow up here with findings, though since this isn't currently blocking work I'll track it at standard priority unless the frequency increases.

subject: Invoice shows wrong seat count and blocked payment
body: We're integrating the Billing API and pulled invoice INV-20481 for this cycle, but it lists 8 seats when we only have 5 active licenses. The payment attempt failed with 'plan mismatch - seat count exceeds contract' and our card wasn't charged. This is holding up a compliance sign-off with our auditor who needs a clean invoice by end of week.
answer: Thanks for flagging this, and I understand the time pressure with your audit. I've escalated INV-20481 to our billing team to correct the seat count and reissue a matching invoice today so the payment can go through cleanly. I'll update you as soon as the corrected invoice is generated, likely within a few hours.

subject: PDF export missing charts on ops dashboard
body: I'm trying to export our weekly operations dashboard to PDF for a board meeting tomorrow, but the exported file comes out with blank spaces where the bar and line charts should be. Only the titles and table widgets render correctly. This happens every time I click Export > PDF, tested on both Chrome and Edge.
answer: Sorry for the trouble right before your board meeting - I'll get this looked at right away. Could you confirm the dashboard name and roughly what time you last tried the export? In the meantime, a workaround is to share the live dashboard link instead of a PDF, which should render the charts correctly while we investigate the export rendering issue.

subject: Billing alerts duplicating and reaching wrong recipients
body: Our finance team set up alert routing so invoice and payment notifications go only to the finance distribution list, but for the past week every alert is also being sent to the company-wide list, and often twice. We're getting duplicate emails for the same payment event, which is confusing staff outside finance.
answer: Thank you for reporting this - duplicate and misrouted alerts shouldn't happen and I want to get this resolved quickly. I'm reviewing your alert routing rules now to see why the company-wide list is being included and where the duplication is occurring. I'll follow up shortly with what we find and a fix timeline.

subject: App stürzt beim Start ab
body: Seit dem letzten Update stürzt unsere mobile App direkt nach dem Start ab, betroffen sind mehrere Außendienstteams auf iOS. Push-Benachrichtigungen kommen ebenfalls nicht mehr an, und der Offline-Modus lässt sich nicht mehr öffnen. Das betrifft aktuell einen Großteil unserer 76 Nutzer und blockiert die tägliche Arbeit im Feld.
answer: Vielen Dank für die schnelle Meldung, das nehmen wir sehr ernst, da es viele Nutzer betrifft. Wir prüfen aktuell die Absturzlogs zum letzten App-Update und die Push- sowie Offline-Funktionen parallel. Ich melde mich innerhalb der nächsten Stunden mit einem Zwischenstand oder einer Lösung.

subject: Question on mapping SCIM groups to roles
body: We're setting up SCIM provisioning from Azure AD and can sync users fine, but group membership isn't mapping to Northwind roles as expected. When we push a group with the 'roles' attribute, we get a 400 response with 'unsupported schema extension' in the SCIM log. Is group-to-role mapping supported yet, or do we need a workaround?
answer: Good question - group-to-role mapping via SCIM is supported but requires the enterprise extension schema enabled on your tenant, which isn't on by default. I'll send over the documentation link and the exact attribute path to use so your next sync should map roles correctly. Let us know if you'd like us to enable the extension on our side first.

subject: Scheduled syncs running hours late via Salesforce connector
body: Our nightly data pipeline syncs from the Salesforce connector used to finish in about 30 minutes but for the last five nights they've taken 4 to 6 hours, pushing our downstream analytics refresh past business open. Sync IDs sync-88213 through sync-88217 all show the same slowdown in the run history. Can you check if something changed on the connector side?
answer: Thanks for the detailed sync IDs, that will help us pinpoint this quickly. We've seen some connector-side latency reports recently and I'm pulling the run logs for sync-88213 through 88217 now to compare against normal baseline timing. I'll report back with findings and, if needed, a temporary schedule adjustment to protect your morning refresh.

subject: Request to update IP allowlist and audit log retention
body: We'd like to add a new office IP range, 203.0.113.0/24, to our workspace allowlist, and extend audit log retention from 30 to 90 days for compliance reviews. Also noticed the workspace settings page has been taking 8-10 seconds to load lately, which makes editing these settings slower than expected.
answer: Happy to help with both changes - I'll add the 203.0.113.0/24 range to your allowlist and update audit log retention to 90 days on our end today. I'll also pass along the settings page load time to our engineering team to check for performance issues, and let you know once everything is confirmed live.

subject: Backups older than 30 days missing from storage
body: I'm trying to understand our retention setup and noticed backups older than 30 days seem to have disappeared entirely from the storage console, even though I thought our policy kept them for 90 days. Can you clarify how retention is configured and help restore what should still be there if this is a bug?
answer: Thanks for raising this - losing expected backups is something we want to sort out quickly. I'm checking your current retention policy configuration and whether the 90-day setting is actually being applied to your storage bucket. If we confirm data was purged early, we'll look into recovery options and update you within the day.

subject: Deactivated users can still log in and access data
body: We offboarded 12 employees this morning and deactivated their accounts in the admin console, but several of them reported they can still log in and access customer data. This is a serious security issue for us given the sensitive nature of our retail data. We need this fixed and confirmed today.
answer: This is a priority for us and I'm escalating it immediately to our security and engineering teams. In the meantime, please send me the list of the 12 affected user accounts so we can force-terminate their active sessions manually while we investigate why deactivation isn't revoking access. I'll keep you updated as we work through this.

subject: Jira integration broken
body: Jira sync stopped this morning, tickets aren't linking anymore.
answer: Sorry for the disruption - I'm escalating this as high priority right away. Could you confirm your workspace ID or the Jira project key affected so we can check the connector logs immediately? We'll update you as soon as we identify the cause.

subject: Duplicate refund posted against invoice INV-88213
body: We processed a refund of $18,400 for our March overage credit on invoice INV-88213, but the same amount was refunded a second time on April 2nd, showing as REF-55021 and REF-55029 in the billing portal. This is now affecting our reconciliation for 4045 seats and our finance team needs it corrected before month-end close on the 5th. Can someone confirm which refund is valid and reverse the duplicate?
answer: Thanks for flagging this quickly, and I understand the urgency given your month-end close deadline. I've escalated to our billing operations team to verify both REF-55021 and REF-55029 against the original credit approval, and we'll reverse the duplicate entry and send you a corrected statement within the next few hours. I'll update this ticket as soon as the reversal is confirmed on our end.

subject: SAML login fails for all users after IdP metadata update
body: We updated our SAML IdP metadata in Okta yesterday and now nobody at Willow Systems can log into Northwind Cloud. Users are redirected back to the login page with 'SAML response validation failed' after entering credentials. We have 15 seats and this is blocking our whole legal team from accessing case dashboards this morning. Can someone walk us through re-syncing the metadata on the Northwind side?
answer: I'm sorry for the disruption this is causing your team. This usually happens when the signing certificate in the new IdP metadata doesn't match what's registered in your SSO app configuration. Please re-upload the updated metadata XML under Identity and SSO > SAML Configuration, and I'll refresh the certificate cache on our side right after so logins should resume within minutes. I'll stay on this ticket until you confirm access is restored.

subject: PDF EXPORT BROKEN
body: OUR CHARTS ARE GETTING CUT OFF WHEN WE EXPORT DASHBOARDS TO PDF. THE BAR CHART ON THE COMPLIANCE DASHBOARD IS MISSING THE RIGHT HALF OF THE LEGEND EVERY TIME WE EXPORT, EVEN AFTER RESIZING THE WIDGET. THIS IS HAPPENING ON THREE DIFFERENT DASHBOARDS SINCE YESTERDAY AND WE NEED TO SHARE THESE WITH AN AUDITOR TOMORROW.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report, and apologies for the trouble ahead of your audit deadline. This looks related to a rendering issue we've seen with wide legends on export - could you try switching the legend position to 'bottom' in the chart settings and re-exporting? I'm also flagging this to our dashboards team as a bug, and will follow up here with a permanent fix timeline.

subject: transform errors
body: TRANSFORM STEP 'normalize_shipment' FAILING SINCE 6AM UTC, NEED FIX
answer: Thanks for the alert - I'm pulling logs for the normalize_shipment transform now to identify the failure cause. Could you confirm the pipeline ID or job name so I can check the exact error trace? I'll update you within the hour with findings.

subject: SCIM Provisionierung funktioniert seit Wochen nicht richtig
body: Das ist jetzt das dritte Mal, dass ich mich melden muss, weil die SCIM-Provisionierung neue Mitarbeiter nicht korrekt anlegt. Bei North Health wurden letzte Woche vier neue Nutzer aus unserem Identity Provider synchronisiert, aber nur zwei sind tatsächlich in Northwind Cloud aufgetaucht, die anderen fehlen komplett. Wir zahlen für 180 Sitzplätze und können es uns nicht leisten, dass Mitarbeiter tagelang ohne Zugriff arbeiten. Wenn das nicht bald gelöst wird, prüfen wir ernsthaft einen Anbieterwechsel.
answer: Es tut mir sehr leid, dass Sie deswegen bereits mehrfach schreiben mussten - das nehmen wir sehr ernst. Ich prüfe sofort die SCIM-Synchronisationslogs der letzten Woche, um zu sehen, warum die beiden Nutzer nicht angelegt wurden, und melde mich noch heute mit einer Lösung und einer manuellen Nachbuchung der fehlenden Konten. Bitte teilen Sie mir die Namen oder E-Mail-Domains der betroffenen Nutzer mit, damit ich gezielt nachverfolgen kann.

subject: Data arriving 2 days late from Shopify connector
body: We've noticed our Shopify order data through the Data Pipelines connector is consistently arriving 2 days after the actual order date, rather than the expected same-day sync. This started around last Tuesday. It's not blocking anything critical yet since we're on a small team of 3, but our weekly reports are now inaccurate and I'd like to understand if this is a known sync delay issue or something misconfigured on our end.
answer: Thanks for the details - a 2-day lag is outside our normal sync window for that connector, so this is worth investigating. Could you share the connector ID and a sample order ID that arrived late so I can trace it through the pipeline logs? In the meantime, I'll check if there's a known backlog issue with the Shopify connector from last week.

subject: Need to add new office IP ranges to allowlist ASAP
body: We're rolling out a new office location for Vertex Legal this week and need to add two new IP ranges to our admin console allowlist before staff arrive Monday. Current documentation only shows how to add single IPs, not CIDR ranges, and I don't want to accidentally lock out our existing 6 users while making the change. Could someone confirm the correct format and whether changes take effect immediately?
answer: Happy to help get this sorted before Monday. You can add CIDR ranges directly in the Allowlist Rules panel under Admin Console > Security using the standard notation, e.g. 203.0.113.0/24, and changes apply within about a minute without affecting existing sessions. I'd recommend adding the new ranges first and testing access from one device before removing any temporary rules, just to be safe.

subject: Users with MFA enabled can't complete SAML login
body: We're seeing an issue where users with MFA enabled at Cobalt Capital get redirected to a blank page after entering their SAML credentials, while users without MFA log in fine. This started after we enforced MFA org-wide last week. It's affecting roughly a third of our 128 seats and support requests are piling up. Is there a known conflict between SAML SSO and our MFA enforcement setting?
answer: Thanks for the clear breakdown - this points to a session handoff issue between the SAML assertion and the MFA challenge step, which we've seen occur when MFA enforcement is toggled after SSO was already configured. Could you confirm which MFA method (authenticator app, SMS, or hardware key) is affected? I'll investigate the auth flow logs for a sample of the affected accounts and get back to you with a fix or workaround shortly.

subject: Dashboard load times over 20 seconds for large datasets
body: Our main analytics dashboard, which pulls from a dataset of about 2.3M rows, has been taking 20-30 seconds to load since we added a third filter widget last week. We're integrating via the API for automated report refreshes and the slow load is now causing our scheduled export jobs to time out around the 15-second mark. Is there a recommended way to optimize dashboard queries for datasets this size, or a way to increase the export timeout?
answer: Thanks for the detailed context - dashboards with multiple filter widgets on large datasets can hit query performance limits, especially combined with export timeouts. I'd suggest reducing to two active filters where possible and enabling result caching in the dashboard settings, which should cut load times significantly. I'll also check on our end whether we can extend the export timeout threshold for your account and follow up with next steps.

subject: Multiple customer cards failing during subscription renewal
body: We're integrating the Billing API for our subscription renewals and have noticed a spike in card decline errors over the past two billing cycles, specifically error code 'card_declined_generic' even for cards that were previously charged successfully. This is affecting renewals for Vertex Travel's 241-seat plan and we want to update our retry logic accordingly. Could you clarify what triggers this generic decline versus more specific decline codes, and whether there's a recommended retry window?
answer: Good question, and thanks for including the error code detail. 'card_declined_generic' typically comes directly from the issuing bank without a more specific reason code, which can happen with risk-based declines on repeat charges. We recommend a retry window of 24-72 hours before resubmitting, and implementing exponential backoff for repeated failures rather than immediate retries. I'll also send over our updated webhook payload reference so you can distinguish decline types more precisely going forward.

subject: API-Key Rotation schlägt fehl – Rate Limit Fehler
body: Wir versuchen seit heute Morgen (10.03.), unseren API-Key für die Produktionsumgebung zu rotieren, aber der neue Key liefert sofort HTTP 429 mit der Meldung 'rate_limit_exceeded' obwohl wir kaum Anfragen gesendet haben. Laut Doku sollte der alte Key noch 24 Stunden gültig sein, aber unser Webhook-Endpunkt bekommt jetzt gar keine Events mehr. Nutzen wir das veraltete SDK v2, das laut Deprecation-Hinweis Ende des Monats abgeschaltet wird? Wir brauchen eine Einschätzung, ob das zusammenhängt.
answer: Danke für die genaue Beschreibung. Das Verhalten deutet tatsächlich auf einen Konflikt zwischen dem alten und neuen Key während der Übergangsphase hin, da beide Keys aktuell demselben Rate-Limit-Kontingent zugeordnet werden. Wir prüfen das auf unserer Seite und melden uns innerhalb der nächsten Stunden mit einem Workaround, damit Ihre Webhooks wieder zuverlässig ankommen.

subject: Okta app SSO mapping not syncing group attributes
body: We configured the Northwind Okta app for SSO provisioning last week, and it authenticates fine, but the group attribute mapping to our Salesforce integration isn't syncing correctly. Users in the 'Sales-EMEA' group in Okta show up with no group assignment on the Northwind side. The documentation for the Okta app setup references an attribute statement format that doesn't match what we see in the actual admin console. Is this a known bug, or did the docs get updated recently? We'd like to know if there's a workaround before we open a wider rollout to more departments.
answer: Thanks for flagging this — we've seen a couple of reports of the attribute statement format in the docs being slightly out of date after a recent Okta app update. I'll confirm the current correct mapping syntax and send you a short guide today. In the meantime, you can manually verify group sync by checking the SCIM logs under Integrations > Okta > Sync History.

subject: MFA enrolment loop for provisioned users
body: Since our last SCIM provisioning batch on Tuesday, about a dozen new users are stuck in an MFA enrolment loop. They complete the enrolment with an authenticator app, get redirected to the login page, and are asked to enroll again instead of being logged in. This only affects users provisioned through our HR system feed, not manually created accounts. Could this be related to how the provisioning flow sets the initial MFA state? We'd like to understand the root cause before onboarding our next batch next week.
answer: Thank you for the detailed report. This sounds like an issue where the provisioning flow may be setting an MFA status flag that conflicts with the enrolment state check. Our team will pull the provisioning logs for the affected accounts and get back to you with findings before your next onboarding batch.

subject: KRITISCH: SDK-Deprecation verursacht Datenverlust in Produktions-Pipeline
body: Wir haben heute festgestellt, dass die von Northwind angekündigte Deprecation des REST-Endpunkts /v1/events bereits aktiv ist, obwohl der offizielle Termin laut Ankündigung erst nächste Woche war. Unsere Produktions-Pipeline nutzt diesen Endpunkt zur Erfassung von Nutzerereignissen, und seit ca. 14:00 Uhr heute gehen alle eingehenden Events verloren, da unser altes SDK v3 nur diesen Endpunkt kennt. Das betrifft alle 16 Nutzer unseres Workspace direkt, da keine Feedback-Daten mehr erfasst werden. Wir brauchen sofort eine Lösung oder einen Rollback, sonst verlieren wir unwiderruflich Daten von heute.
answer: Wir verstehen den Ernst der Lage und haben den Vorfall als P0 eskaliert. Unser Engineering-Team prüft gerade, ob die Abschaltung des Endpunkts vorzeitig ausgelöst wurde, und wir aktivieren übergangsweise wieder Zugriff auf /v1/events, um weiteren Datenverlust zu verhindern. Wir melden uns innerhalb der nächsten 30 Minuten mit einem Status-Update.

subject: Need to update webhook payload format
body: We've been running our legal document intake pipeline on Northwind for about eight months now, and it's been mostly stable aside from occasional latency during month-end reporting. Our team recently expanded the pipeline to also pull metadata for contract review workflows, which added a few new fields we need to track downstream. The actual issue is that our webhook consumer expects the old flat payload structure, but we want to migrate to the new nested 'event.data' format mentioned in your SDK changelog before it becomes mandatory. Can you confirm the exact rollout date and whether both formats will be supported simultaneously during a transition window?
answer: Good question, and thanks for planning ahead on this. Both the flat and nested payload formats will be supported in parallel for 60 days after the nested format becomes default, so you'll have time to migrate your consumer without interruption. I'll send over the exact cutover date along with a sample payload comparison to help with your migration.

subject: URGENT: Webhook delivery failures causing lost case updates
body: We are seeing widespread webhook delivery failures since approximately 09:15 UTC today across our production integration. Our logs show consistent HTTP 500 responses from your webhook dispatcher for events tied to case status changes, and we've confirmed at least 340 events were never delivered and are not recoverable from our side since we don't persist raw payloads. This is affecting all 243 seats in our organization as case status updates are core to our legal workflow platform. We need immediate confirmation on whether Northwind can replay these missed events from your side, and root cause on the 500 errors.
answer: This has been escalated to our on-call engineering team as a P0 incident. We can confirm webhook events are queued and retained on our side for 72 hours even on delivery failure, so we will begin a manual replay of the missed events for your account shortly. We'll provide a status update within the hour and will share root cause findings once identified.

subject: How to route alerts to different teams based on severity
body: We're trying to set up alert routing so that critical severity notifications go to our on-call security channel while lower severity alerts go to a general ops channel. Right now everything is going to the same webhook destination and we're getting duplicate alerts across both channels since we manually forward some of them. Is there a way within the Notifications product to configure routing rules based on severity or alert type, rather than a single destination per integration? A quick how-to or doc link would help us get this set up correctly.
answer: Yes, this is possible — under Notifications > Routing Rules you can create severity-based conditions that map to different destinations, which should eliminate the manual forwarding and duplicate alerts you're seeing. I'll send you a link to our routing rules guide along with a sample configuration matching a critical/general split similar to what you described.

subject: API deprecation notice affecting webhook rate limits
body: We received a deprecation notice about the /v2/webhooks/register endpoint being replaced by /v3/webhooks/register, and after testing the migration in staging, we noticed the new endpoint enforces a much stricter rate limit — we're hitting 429 errors after only 50 registration calls per minute, compared to 500 previously. Our provisioning system registers webhooks in bulk during onboarding of new business units, and this new limit will cause failures at our scale. Can you confirm if this rate limit change is intentional and permanent, or if there's a higher-tier limit we can request given our organization's size?
answer: Thanks for testing this ahead of the cutover. The stricter rate limit on /v3/webhooks/register is intentional but there is a higher bulk-registration tier available for enterprise accounts that we can enable on request. I'll get this configured for your workspace and confirm once the increased limit is active so you can re-test bulk provisioning.

subject: Feature request: customizable email digest frequency
body: Our teams currently receive daily email digests for notification summaries, but several department leads have asked whether we can configure this per-team, since some teams want weekly digests instead of daily to reduce inbox clutter. Right now the setting appears to be workspace-wide only, based on what we can see in the admin console and the documentation. We're also noticing some duplicate digest emails being sent on days when there's a system alert plus the scheduled digest covering the same time window. Could you clarify if per-team frequency settings are on the roadmap, and look into the duplicate digest issue?
answer: Thanks for the detailed feedback. Per-team digest frequency isn't currently supported since digests are configured at the workspace level, but I'm logging this as a feature request with our product team given the interest from your department leads. On the duplicate emails, that does sound like an overlap between the alert-triggered and scheduled digest windows — I'll investigate the timing logic and follow up with findings.

subject: URGENT: Storage quota exceeded, backups failing
body: Our storage quota alert triggered at 03:40 UTC this morning, and since then all scheduled backups for our production datasets have been failing with 'quota_exceeded' errors. We are well over our expected usage — the dashboard shows 98% of allocated quota consumed, which is unusual since our retention policy should be purging data older than 90 days automatically. This is a P1 for us since backups have not completed successfully in over 12 hours and we have compliance requirements around daily backup completion. We need an emergency quota increase or a fix to the retention purge job immediately.
answer: We've picked this up as a priority incident and are reviewing your retention purge job now, since a stalled purge would explain the unexpected quota consumption. As an immediate measure we're applying a temporary quota increase to your account to allow backups to resume while we identify why older data isn't being cleared. We'll update you within the hour with root cause and a permanent fix.

subject: Request: improve dashboard load times for shared reports
body: I'm the PM overseeing our retail analytics dashboards at Orion Travel and we've noticed load times creeping up over the last two weeks, especially on the shared "Regional Sales" dashboard with 8 charts. It now takes 12-15 seconds to render for our team of 150 seats. Could we get some documentation on best practices for structuring charts to improve performance, and also confirm if sharing settings affect load speed?
answer: Thanks for flagging this - dashboard render time can definitely be impacted by chart count and the underlying query complexity, and shared dashboards with many viewers can add extra load if caching isn't optimized. I'll send over our documentation on chart optimization and caching best practices, and in the meantime I'd like to take a look at the specific dashboard config to see if there's a quick win, like reducing overlapping date-range queries.

subject: SAML login failing for finance team after IdP update
body: We updated our identity provider configuration last night and now several finance team members at Blue Retail are getting "SAML response validation failed" errors when trying to log into Northwind. This is affecting around 40 users out of our 1194 seats. MFA prompts also seem to be triggering inconsistently for those who do get through. Can someone help us verify the SAML certificate and provisioning settings on your end?
answer: Sorry for the disruption this is causing your finance team. SAML validation failures right after an IdP change are often due to a certificate or metadata mismatch - we'll pull the recent SSO logs on our end to check the assertion signing and confirm what our system currently has on file for your metadata. Can you send us the exact timestamp of a failed login attempt and the entity ID from your IdP config so we can cross-reference quickly?

subject: Need SCIM provisioning support for automated group sync and MFA policy
body: We're rolling out Northwind to our full 2572-seat org at Granite Capital and want to move from manual user creation to SCIM provisioning so new hires and role changes sync automatically from our IdP. Specifically we need group-based provisioning to map to permission sets, and we'd like MFA enforcement to be tied to those groups as well. Is there a guide for setting this up, and does SCIM support deprovisioning on termination?
answer: This is a great use case for SCIM and yes, deprovisioning on termination is supported - when a user is removed or disabled in your IdP, the SCIM connector will deactivate their Northwind account automatically. I'll send over our SCIM setup guide covering group-to-permission mapping and MFA policy tie-ins, and given the scale of your rollout I'd also like to schedule a short call with our provisioning team to walk through the group mapping before you go live.

subject: SDK throwing 429 errors and deprecated method warnings
body: I'm a support engineer at Vertex Systems and we've started seeing our integration fail intermittently since upgrading to SDK version 4.2.1. We're getting HTTP 429 rate limit errors even though our call volume hasn't changed much, roughly 8,000 requests/hour across our logistics tracking service. answer: Thanks for the detailed report. SDK 4.2.1 didn't change the underlying rate limits, but it did add stricter client-side retry logic which can surface 429s that were previously being silently retried - I'd recommend checking your burst pattern around peak hours since our limits are still 10,000 requests/hour per key. I'll also send the migration guide for trackShipmentV2() since trackShipment() is slated for removal in a future release.

subject: Question about offline mode syncing on mobile app
body: I'm the finance manager at Orion Health and I use the mobile app to review invoices when traveling and often lose signal. When offline mode is on, changes I make don't seem to sync once I'm back online - I have to manually reopen the app. Is this expected behavior, or is there a setting I'm missing to enable automatic sync on reconnect?

Could you let us know your app version and whether background app refresh is enabled in your phone's settings? That will help us confirm whether this is expected behavior or something we need to look into further.

subject: Transform jobs failing repeatedly across multiple pipelines

answer: This is a high priority issue for us and we're investigating right now. A schema mismatch error appearing across multiple pipelines without a source change on your end suggests something may have shifted in how the transform stage is reading the source schema - we're checking our recent deployment logs for anything that touched schema inference around that timeframe. I'll update you within the hour with findings, and please let us know if the failure count grows beyond the current 6 pipelines.

subject: Mobile app crashing immediately on launch for legal team

subject: Webhook retry behavior and rate limit headers
body:
We're building out webhook consumers for shipment status events and want to confirm the retry policy before we finalize our SDK integration. Right now if our endpoint returns a 500, we're seeing retries at what looks like exponential backoff, but the docs don't specify the max retry count or total window.

Also, are the rate limit headers (X-RateLimit-Remaining etc.) present on webhook delivery attempts, or only on standard API calls? We want to make sure our monitoring accounts for both correctly.
answer: Good questions. Webhook deliveries retry up to 6 times over roughly 24 hours with exponential backoff, and after the final failed attempt the event is marked as dead and available via the events API for manual replay. Rate limit headers are only attached to standard REST API responses, not webhook delivery attempts, since those are pushed rather than pulled — I'd recommend tracking delivery success separately in your webhook receiver logs.

subject: URGENT: Hitting rate limits across all API keys, checkout integration down

subject: Push notification setup for mobile app - documentation request

subject: Frage zur Pagination in der API

Ich sende Ihnen gleich den Link zur aktualisierten API-Dokumentation mit Beispielen für die Umstellung, und stehe gerne für Rückfragen zur Migration zur Verfügung.

subject: Question about pagination limits on deprecated v2 endpoint

The v3 pagination endpoints support a higher default rate limit of 600 requests/minute per API key compared to v2's 300/minute, and page sizes can go up to 200 records versus v2's 100, so your 5,000-record runs should complete in roughly half the requests. I'd recommend reviewing our v3 SDK migration guide, which includes a section specifically on converting v2 offset-based pagination to v3 cursor-based pagination.
