subject: Hitting rate limits on webhook endpoint sooner than expected
body: We integrated the webhook subscription API last month and have been staying well under the documented rate limit of 100 requests per minute, but starting this week we're getting 429 responses at around 60 requests per minute. Our SDK version is 4.2.1. Did something change in how rate limits are calculated, or is this related to the deprecation notice we saw for the v3 webhook endpoints?
answer: Good catch - we did adjust rate limit calculation last week to count retries against the same limit bucket, which likely explains the earlier throttling you're seeing at lower request volumes. This wasn't tied to the v3 webhook deprecation. I'd recommend upgrading to SDK 4.3.0 which has improved backoff handling, and I'll also check whether we should better document this change - thanks for flagging it.

subject: SDK throwing deprecation errors after recent update
body: After updating to the latest SDK version this morning, our webhook handler is throwing errors referencing deprecated methods that used to work fine: 'WebhookClient.verify() is deprecated, use WebhookClient.verifySignature() instead' followed by a rate limit warning we've never seen before. This is affecting our production integration used across 127 seats and we need to know if this is a breaking change we missed in release notes.
answer: Apologies for the disruption - the verify() to verifySignature() rename was intended to be backward-compatible with a deprecation warning only, not a hard break, so if it's throwing rather than just warning that's a bug on our side. Can you share the exact SDK version and a snippet of the surrounding error output? We'll prioritize a patch release once we confirm the scope, and I'll follow up with a workaround in the meantime.

subject: CRITICAL: Backup restore failing, need data recovered immediately
body: We triggered a restore from our March 14th storage backup after detecting unauthorized access to one of our buckets, and the restore job has been stuck at 12% for over three hours with no progress. This is a potential breach situation and we need the restore completed and confirmation that our retention policy backups weren't also compromised. Please treat this as top priority - we have 294 users depending on this data.
answer: We're treating this as a P0 security and data incident and have escalated to our storage and security teams immediately. We're investigating why the restore job stalled at 12% and will get it moving or start a fresh restore from a verified backup point within the hour. In parallel we're auditing your retention-policy backups for any signs of compromise and will share findings as soon as we have them - I'll be your point of contact for continuous updates until this is fully resolved.

subject: SSO role mapping broken after IdP update - users landing in wrong groups
body:
We pushed an update to our Okta SAML assertions this morning and since then Northwind is mapping a large number of employees into the wrong roles. Several travel-desk managers were provisioned as read-only agents, and some contractors got admin rights on the Delta Systems workspace. This is affecting logins across multiple regional offices right now.

Our SSO connection ID is dl-sys-okta-01. Can someone confirm whether the role mapping rules changed on Northwind's side, or if this is purely from our attribute changes? We need this corrected quickly since incorrect admin access is a compliance issue for us.
answer:
Thanks for flagging this immediately - I understand the urgency given the access implications. We're pulling the audit log for connection dl-sys-okta-01 now to see exactly which attribute mappings changed and when, and we'll cross-reference against your IdP's assertion history for this morning. In the meantime, please have your admins temporarily disable auto-provisioning for new logins so we don't compound the incorrect assignments while we investigate.

We'll follow up within the hour with findings and a corrected mapping plan, and we'll flag this as a priority security item internally given the admin-rights exposure.

subject: Mobile app crashes immediately on launch for several staff
body:
Since yesterday, our mobile app users at Quill Analytics have been reporting the app crashing right at launch, before they even reach the login screen. This started for at least a dozen people across our legal teams on both iOS and Android. Reinstalling doesn't help and none of them can get past the splash screen.

This is starting to affect people trying to approve invoices on the go, so I'd like to get a sense of whether this is a known issue and what the timeline looks like for a fix.
answer:
Thank you for the detailed report. We've seen a small number of similar crash-on-launch reports over the past day and are actively investigating a possible issue tied to a recent app build. Could you confirm the app version and device OS versions for the affected users so we can match this to the right cohort?

In the meantime, if any users have push notifications enabled, having them temporarily disable notification permissions for the app before reopening has resolved the crash for a few other customers - it would help to know if that works for your team while we track down the root cause.

subject: SDK v3 changes breaking our integration - need migration guidance
body:
We just updated to the latest Northwind API SDK for our logistics tracking integration and started getting repeated errors like "deprecated endpoint /v2/shipments/status, use /v3/shipments/status instead" along with intermittent 429 rate limit responses we didn't see before. Our webhook consumers for shipment updates are now failing validation checks about 15% of the time.

We'd like clear documentation on the v2 to v3 migration path and whether the new rate limits are different from what we had under v2, since our current polling setup at Apex Partners was tuned for the old limits.
answer:
Thanks for the detailed breakdown - the /v2/shipments/status endpoint is indeed being sunset as part of the v3 migration, and the new SDK enforces the updated rate limits by default, which are lower per-key than v2 to encourage webhook-based updates instead of polling. I'll send over our v2-to-v3 migration guide, which includes the updated webhook payload schema and recommended backoff strategy for the 429s.

Given you're seeing validation failures on about 15% of webhook deliveries, could you share a sample failed payload? That will help us confirm whether it's a schema mismatch or a timing issue on your consumer side.

subject: Slack alerts from Salesforce integration delayed by 20+ minutes
body:
Our Slack notifications tied to the Salesforce integration have been arriving 20 to 30 minutes late since Tuesday. These alerts are supposed to notify our ops team in near real-time when high-value deals change stage, and the delay is causing us to miss time-sensitive follow-ups at Orion Partners.

We haven't changed anything on our Okta or Salesforce configuration recently. Is there a known performance issue on the integration layer, or a queue backlog on Northwind's side we should know about?
answer:
Thanks for reporting this - a delay of that length is unusual and not expected behavior for the Slack-Salesforce alert pipeline. We're checking the integration queue metrics for your workspace now to see if there's a backlog or throttling event affecting delivery times.

We'll update you shortly with what we find, and if it turns out to be a broader queue issue we'll let you know the scope and expected resolution time.

subject: Multiple card charges failing - customers locked out
body:
Starting this morning, our payment card on file has failed for renewal three times in a row with a decline message, and now several of our team members at Ember Analytics are seeing a warning banner saying our account will be suspended in 48 hours. We updated the card details yesterday and confirmed with our bank there are no issues on their end.

We need this resolved fast since losing access would stop our analytics dashboards from refreshing, which our manufacturing clients rely on daily. Can someone check why the charge is being declined and manually retry it?
answer:
I'm sorry for the disruption this is causing - I've flagged this as urgent given the suspension warning. I'm pulling up the billing record for Ember Analytics now to check the decline codes from the last three attempts and confirm the new card details were saved correctly on our end.

I'll manually trigger a retry once I've confirmed the card details match what your bank has on file, and I'll pause the suspension countdown while we sort this out so you don't lose dashboard access in the meantime.

subject: Refund and credit discrepancy on last invoice
body:
I'm reviewing our latest invoice from Northwind and noticed we were charged for 3256 seats, but a credit of $4,200 that was promised to us in a support conversation last month for unused API call overage isn't reflected anywhere on the statement. This is for North Academy's account, invoice number NA-88213.

Can someone confirm whether that credit was applied and just isn't showing on the PDF, or if it was missed entirely? We need this reconciled before our finance team closes the books this week.
answer:
Thanks for flagging the discrepancy on invoice NA-88213. I'm looking into the credit history on your account now to check whether the $4,200 API overage credit was applied to a different billing cycle or missed in processing.

I'll confirm the seat count and credit status by end of day so you have accurate numbers before your books close this week, and if the credit was missed we'll get it applied and issue a corrected statement promptly.

subject: URGENT - API outage after deprecated endpoint removal, all requests failing
body:
All of our production API calls to Northwind started failing about 15 minutes ago with 410 Gone errors. Our engineering team traced it to the /v1/media/publish endpoint being fully removed, which we were told would be deprecated but not removed until next quarter. This is a full outage for Willow Labs - our media publishing pipeline is completely down and we have scheduled content that isn't going out.

We need an emergency fix or rollback immediately, this is affecting our entire customer base right now.
answer:
This has been escalated to our on-call engineering team immediately as a full outage. We're confirming the removal of /v1/media/publish now against the published deprecation timeline - if this was removed ahead of the communicated schedule, we will work to restore the endpoint or provide an emergency compatibility shim as fast as possible.

We'll post updates here as we have them, and please stay on this ticket - we're treating this as our top priority until your publishing pipeline is restored.

subject: Push notifications not reaching Android devices reliably
body:
We've noticed that push notifications for shift updates aren't reaching about half of our Android users at Apex Systems, though iOS users seem fine. Some of the affected devices show the notification arriving hours late, and others don't get it at all even when the app is open in the background.

Could you help us troubleshoot the notification delivery settings, or let us know if there's a known issue with Android push on the current app version? We rely on these for shift change alerts on the manufacturing floor.
answer:
Thanks for the details - inconsistent Android push delivery like this is often tied to battery optimization settings or FCM token registration issues on specific device manufacturers. Could you let us know which Android device models and OS versions are most affected, and whether the app has battery optimization exemptions enabled for those users?

We'll also check our delivery logs for your workspace to see if there's a pattern in failed or delayed FCM deliveries on our end while you gather that device information.

subject: Feature request: customizable push notification categories
body:
It would be great if Northwind's mobile app let us set up separate push notification categories, like one for login alerts and another for account activity, so our team at Summit Capital could choose which ones to receive. Right now everything comes through as one type of push and a few people have just turned notifications off entirely because of the volume.

Not urgent, just wanted to put this on the radar since it would help engagement with the app for our small team.
answer:
Thanks for the suggestion - this is a reasonable request and we've heard similar feedback from other customers about wanting more granular control over push categories. I'll pass this along to our mobile product team as a feature request tied to your account.

In the meantime, if the volume is the main issue, some customers have had success adjusting notification frequency settings in the admin console - happy to walk through that if it would help while we consider the broader feature.

subject: Request to change email unsubscribe behavior
body:
We'd like to change how the unsubscribe link works on our outbound notification emails. Right now when one of our Delta Health staff unsubscribes, it seems to unsubscribe them from all notification types at once, including billing alerts they actually want to keep getting. Could this be changed to a granular per-category unsubscribe instead of an all-or-nothing one?

We've had a couple of people accidentally opt out of billing reminders this way and then miss invoice due dates, which caused some confusion on our end.
answer:
Thanks for raising this - a granular per-category unsubscribe is definitely a better experience, and I can see how the current all-or-nothing behavior would cause billing alerts to get missed unintentionally. I'll log this as a change request against your notification settings for Delta Health and check whether category-level unsubscribe is something we can enable on your plan currently.

In the meantime, I'd recommend having anyone who accidentally unsubscribed re-opt into billing alerts manually through their notification preferences so they don't miss upcoming due dates while we look into the longer-term fix.

subject: Request: PDF export for dashboards
body: We regularly present our energy usage dashboards to clients and right now we're taking screenshots to build PDFs manually, which looks unprofessional and takes forever. Could you add a native export-to-PDF option for dashboard views? Ideally it would preserve chart formatting and let us pick a date range before exporting. We'd also love multi-page support if a dashboard has more than 4-5 charts, since ours often have 8-10.
answer: Thanks for the detailed feature request. PDF export isn't available yet for Dashboards, but I've logged this with our product team along with your notes on multi-page and chart formatting needs. I'll update this ticket if it gets added to the roadmap, and in the meantime a print-to-PDF from the browser view is the closest workaround for preserving chart layout.

subject: Duplicate alerts being routed to wrong email groups
body: We're integrating the Notifications API to route manufacturing line alerts to specific team email groups, but we're seeing duplicate alerts sent to the wrong distribution list. Alert rule ID rule_88291 is configured to route only to ops-team, but for the past 3 days (since Oct 14) it's also delivering to the qa-team group and sending each alert twice. This is causing alert fatigue for 16 users across both teams and some critical line-down alerts are getting lost in the noise. We need this routing fixed quickly since it affects our whole floor monitoring setup.
answer: Thanks for flagging this, and I understand the urgency given it affects your whole floor monitoring setup. We're seeing the duplicate delivery on rule_88291 as well and it looks like a routing rule got a stale group binding during a recent config sync -- our engineering team is investigating now. I'll update you within the next few hours with either a fix or a manual workaround to stop the duplicate sends to the qa-team group in the meantime.

subject: issue
body: since the last app update biometric login keeps failing on ios devices for several of our warehouse staff. it prompts for face id then just shows a spinner and eventually kicks back to the pin screen. happens both online and when the device is in offline mode at the loading dock where wifi is patchy. not urgent since pin login still works as a fallback but wanted to report it. affects maybe 10-12 devices out of our 174 seat fleet so far.
answer: Thanks for the report. Since PIN login is working as a fallback this isn't blocking anyone, but I'd like to get more detail -- could you confirm the iOS version and app version on a couple of the affected devices? We've seen a similar biometric timeout issue tied to a recent app release and want to confirm it's the same root cause before we push a fix.

subject: Dashboard sharing permissions not respecting group settings
body: I set up a dashboard shared with our 'Legal Review' group with view-only access, but two people outside that group who shouldn't have access are able to open and edit it. I checked the sharing settings twice and they're definitely not listed as individual collaborators. This is a real problem for us since some of these dashboards contain client matter data that shouldn't be visible outside the assigned reviewers. Can someone look into why group-based permissions aren't being enforced? We have 4 seats total so it's easy to see exactly who has access, and this shouldn't be happening.
answer: Thank you for reporting this and for the clear details -- a permissions leak like this is something we take seriously. I've escalated this to our engineering team as a priority issue given the sensitivity of the data involved. Can you send me the dashboard ID and the names of the two users who have unexpected access so we can trace the exact permission path while we work on a fix?

subject: Audit log missing entries for user deactivations
body: I was reviewing our compliance records and noticed the Admin Console audit log doesn't show any entries for the 3 users we deactivated last month (around Sept 18-22). The log shows login events and settings changes fine, but deactivation actions seem to be completely missing. This is a problem for us since we're a legal services provider and need a full audit trail for our own compliance reviews. Can you confirm whether this is a bug or if deactivation events are logged somewhere else that I'm not seeing? We have 18 seats and only deactivate accounts occasionally, so this gap is easy to spot but concerning.
answer: Thanks for catching this -- deactivation events should appear in the audit log, so this does look like a logging gap on our end rather than a display issue. I've filed a bug report with the exact date range you mentioned so our engineers can check whether the events were dropped or just not surfaced correctly. I'll follow up as soon as we have a root cause, and let us know if you need a manual export of account status changes for your compliance review in the meantime.

subject: Duplicate alert emails going to wrong recipients
body: Our team has been getting duplicate booking-alert emails for the past week, sometimes 2-3 copies of the same alert within a minute. Worse, a few of these alerts meant for our travel desk team are showing up in our finance team's inbox instead, which shouldn't be happening based on our routing rules. We only have 7 seats so it's obvious something is misrouted. Can you check our alert routing configuration? This started around October 10th and is creating confusion about which bookings need urgent attention.
answer: Thank you for the detailed report and specific date -- that helps narrow things down. Misrouted alerts crossing team boundaries is a real concern, so I'm escalating this to our notifications team to review your routing rule configuration starting from October 10th. I'll follow up shortly with findings, and in the meantime it may help to double check that no rule was recently duplicated or edited around that date on your end as well.

subject: Need to restore files from backup after accidental bulk delete
body: One of our paralegals accidentally ran a bulk delete on a folder containing case documents for about 40 client matters this morning around 9:15am. We need to restore these from backup as soon as possible since some of these documents are needed for a filing deadline tomorrow. Can you walk me through the restore process for Storage, or handle it directly if that's faster? We're on the Pro plan with 140 seats and I want to make sure we're within our retention window before it's too late.
answer: I understand the urgency given your filing deadline -- we're treating this as high priority. Your retention window should cover this morning's deletion, so recovery should be possible; could you confirm the exact folder path or share the folder ID so we can locate the snapshot? Once confirmed, we can either walk you through the self-service restore in Storage settings or initiate the restore on our end if that's faster for your deadline.

subject: Need faster way to deactivate departing employee accounts
body: We just had an employee leave unexpectedly and I needed to deactivate their Admin Console account immediately to cut off access, but the process took several steps across three different screens and there's no bulk option even though we only have 3 seats. Can you either speed up the single-user deactivation flow or point me to a faster method? Ideally we'd like a way to deactivate a user and immediately see confirmation in the audit log without navigating through separate settings and allowlist pages. This is time-sensitive since access needs to be cut off right away for security reasons.
answer: This is understandably urgent, so let's get you unblocked right now -- you can deactivate a user immediately from Admin Console under Users > select user > Deactivate, which should cut off access instantly even though the confirmation and audit log entry live on separate pages. I've also logged your feedback about wanting a single streamlined flow with immediate audit log visibility, and I'll follow up once I confirm the account in question has been fully deactivated on our end.

subject: Offline mode losing cached data after app restart
body: We rolled out offline mode for field staff at several of our campus locations, and we're noticing that cached data (course rosters, attendance records) disappears if the app is force-closed or the device restarts while offline. Staff have to reconnect to wifi to reload everything, which defeats the purpose of offline mode in low-connectivity buildings. This isn't blocking daily operations since most locations have decent connectivity, but with 1598 seats across our institution it's a recurring annoyance worth fixing. Happy to provide device logs if useful.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report -- this sounds like the offline cache isn't persisting across app restarts as it should. It's helpful to know this isn't blocking daily operations, so we'll treat it as a standard priority fix, but device logs would definitely help us reproduce the issue faster. If you can share logs from one or two affected devices along with OS versions, we'll get this into our next investigation cycle.

subject: Biometric-Login stuerzt App bei Push-Benachrichtigung ab
body: Seit dem letzten Update stuerzt unsere Mobile App ab, wenn eine Push-Benachrichtigung eingeht waehrend der Nutzer gerade den Face-ID- oder Fingerabdruck-Login durchfuehrt. Das passiert auf mehreren Android-Geraeten in unserer Fertigung, betrifft aber nicht alle 211 Nutzer gleichzeitig, eher sporadisch mehrmals taeglich. Die Nutzer muessen die App danach neu starten und sich per PIN einloggen, was im Schichtbetrieb zu Verzoegerungen fuehrt. Koennen Sie pruefen, ob das an der neuen Push-Bibliothek liegt? Wir koennen bei Bedarf Absturzprotokolle bereitstellen.
answer: Vielen Dank fuer die genaue Beschreibung. Das klingt nach einem Konflikt zwischen dem biometrischen Login-Flow und der Push-Benachrichtigungsverarbeitung, den wir uns genauer ansehen sollten. Koennten Sie uns Absturzprotokolle von ein bis zwei betroffenen Android-Geraeten sowie die genauen Android-Versionen zusenden? Damit koennen wir das Problem gezielt reproduzieren und pruefen, ob es mit der neuen Push-Bibliothek zusammenhaengt.

subject: Dashboard sharing permissions not syncing with legal team roles
body:
I'm trying to share our Q3 budget dashboard with the legal team at Granite Labs but three users report they still can't view it even after I added them to the shared list yesterday. I've checked their role assignments and they show as Viewer under the dashboard's permission panel, but they get a blank screen when they click the link.

This isn't urgent since it's only affecting a handful of people, but it's slowing down our month-end review. Could you check if there's a caching issue on the sharing side?
answer: Thanks for the details. This sounds like a permission cache lag rather than a role misconfiguration - we've seen this happen when sharing updates are made in bulk. I've triggered a manual refresh on the affected dashboard's ACL for your workspace, so the three users should now see it correctly within a few minutes. If they're still blocked after that, let us know their user IDs and we'll dig into individual access logs.

subject: Workspace deactivation setting is re-enabling terminated users
body:
We had a security incident yesterday where a departing contractor's account was deactivated in the Admin Console, but this morning the audit log shows their session was active again at 08:14 UTC. We deactivated them again immediately, but this is the second time this week a deactivated user has appeared active without anyone re-enabling them manually.

Given Delta Legal is in media and handles sensitive client contracts, this is a serious compliance concern for us. We need to know if there's a bug in how deactivation propagates across workspace settings, and whether any allowlist rule might be overriding it.
answer: This has been escalated to our security engineering team immediately given the re-activation behavior you're describing. We're reviewing your workspace's audit log now to trace exactly what triggered the session reactivation - initial suspicion is a stale allowlist entry tied to an SSO group that's re-granting access on login attempt. In the meantime, please have that contractor's credentials rotated at the identity provider level as an extra precaution, and we'll follow up within the hour with findings.

subject: Late-arriving records breaking daily sync window for fintech connector
body:
Our Postgres-to-warehouse pipeline at Lumen Robotics has started missing records that arrive more than 15 minutes after the scheduled sync window closes. Since Monday we've had at least 340 transaction rows dated for the previous day show up empty in our downstream reports, and re-running the sync manually doesn't backfill them.

We rely on this connector for daily reconciliation, so this is blocking our finance team's close process. Is there a way to configure a grace period or trigger a late-data catch-up run without breaking the existing schedule?
answer: I understand how disruptive this is for your reconciliation process, and we're treating this as high priority. The late-arriving records issue is a known gap in how the connector handles watermark-based syncs when source data lands after the window closes - there isn't currently a grace period setting, but I'm escalating this to our pipeline team to add a manual backfill trigger for your workspace as an interim fix. I'll update you within a few hours with either a workaround or a timeline for the backfill option.

subject: Repeated upload failures hitting storage quota mid-transfer
body:
Since Tuesday our finance team at Vertex Partners has had large batch uploads fail partway through, usually around 4-5GB into a 12GB transfer, with the UI showing 'upload interrupted, please retry' but no specific error code. We've retried the same file three times and it fails at roughly the same point each time.

We're also wondering if this is related to our storage quota, since our usage dashboard shows we're at 91% capacity. Could you confirm whether we're hitting a soft limit during upload, and if there's a way to request a temporary quota increase while we sort out our retention policy?
answer: Thank you for flagging this - a failure at a consistent point in large uploads combined with your 91% quota usage strongly suggests you're hitting a soft threshold that interrupts in-progress transfers rather than blocking them upfront. I'm submitting a temporary quota increase for your workspace right now so you can complete these uploads without interruption, and I'll also loop in our retention specialist to help you review what's eligible for archival so this doesn't recur next cycle.

subject: Employees stuck at MFA enrollment screen after SSO login
body:
Several of our logistics coordinators at Delta Travel are getting stuck on the MFA enrollment page after logging in through our SSO provider. They authenticate fine through the identity provider, but then the enrollment screen just spins with 'preparing your authenticator setup' and never completes. This started for at least six users this week.

We need these accounts fully provisioned since they handle time-sensitive shipment approvals. Is there a known issue with MFA enrollment triggering after SSO redirect, or a permissions setting we might be missing on our end?
answer: Thanks for the clear description - this matches a pattern we've seen where the MFA enrollment step doesn't receive the session token correctly after an SSO redirect, particularly for accounts provisioned via SCIM. I'd like to check the specific error trace on our end for two or three of the affected users, so if you can share their usernames or user IDs, we'll investigate right away and get back to you with either a fix or a manual enrollment path so your coordinators aren't blocked.

subject: Webhook deliveries silently failing for order status events
body:
We've noticed that webhook events for order.status.updated stopped arriving at our endpoint sometime after 2pm yesterday, even though the API Platform dashboard still shows the subscription as active. Our endpoint returns 200 on test pings, and we haven't changed our SDK version or endpoint URL recently.

As product manager at Cobalt Legal, I need to understand whether this is a delivery issue on Northwind's side or something with our subscription config, since our travel booking partners depend on these events for confirmation status. Could someone check the delivery logs for our webhook ID wh_4521?
answer: Thanks for including the webhook ID - I've pulled the delivery logs for wh_4521 and can see a spike in failed delivery attempts starting around 2:10pm yesterday, with retries eventually being suppressed after repeated timeouts on our side rather than yours. This looks like an infrastructure issue on our webhook dispatch service, and I'm escalating it to the platform team now. We'll get deliveries flowing again and let you know once we've confirmed a fix, along with whether any missed events need to be replayed.

subject: Pagination cursor behaves inconsistently on /records endpoint
body:
I'm working through the /records endpoint in the API Platform and noticed the pagination cursor returned in the response sometimes points backward, causing our script to re-fetch the same 50 records twice before moving forward. This happens roughly 1 in 5 requests when paging through large result sets, and it's not consistent enough for us to just filter duplicates reliably.

We're using SDK version 3.2.1 for this. Is this a known bug, or is there a recommended pagination pattern we should switch to, maybe using created_at-based cursors instead of the default?
answer: Good catch - this does line up with a known inconsistency in cursor generation for /records when results are being written concurrently with the page being fetched, which SDK 3.2.1 doesn't fully account for. In the meantime, I'd recommend switching to the created_at-based cursor parameter, which is more stable for large or actively-updating result sets, and I'll pass this along to our API team as a documentation gap since this pattern isn't currently called out clearly for your use case.

subject: SAML login redirect loop for one staff account
body:
One of our teachers at Willow Academy can't log in via SAML SSO - after entering credentials at our identity provider, they get redirected back to the Northwind login page instead of landing in the dashboard, and this repeats in a loop. Other staff accounts are logging in fine, so it seems isolated to this one user.

I checked their SAML attributes on our IdP side and they look the same as a working account. Is there something on the Northwind side, like a stale session or provisioning mismatch, that could cause this for just one user?
answer: Thanks for narrowing this down to a single user - that's helpful. This is often caused by a mismatched or duplicate NameID mapping for that specific account on our side, sometimes left over from an earlier provisioning attempt. Could you send us that user's email as configured in your IdP so we can check their identity record and clear any stale session or mapping conflict? We'll follow up once we've confirmed the fix.

subject: Scheduled sync running an hour later than configured
body:
Our nightly inventory sync in Data Pipelines is set to run at 1:00am but for the past four nights it's actually kicked off closer to 2:00am, which is throwing off our morning stock reports at Summit Freight. The connector itself completes fine once it starts, just the trigger time seems off.

Nothing changed on our end with the schedule configuration that I can see. Is this a known delay with scheduled triggers, or could it be related to time zone handling on the pipeline scheduler?
answer: Thanks for the specific timestamps, that's helpful for tracking this down. A consistent one-hour delay like this is often a daylight saving time offset issue in the scheduler rather than a queueing delay, so I'd like to check whether your pipeline's configured time zone was set before or after the recent DST change in your region. I'll review your schedule configuration and get back to you shortly with either a corrected setting or confirmation this is a known scheduler bug we're tracking.

subject: Deactivated users still showing as active seats and can't be removed
body:
I deactivated two former employees through the Admin Console yesterday at Willow Robotics, but they're still counted in our active seat total and I can't find a way to remove them permanently from the allowlist. The audit log shows the deactivation event, but their accounts still appear under 'Active Users' with a green status indicator.

Since we're only on 18 seats, having two phantom active seats is a real problem for our billing and access control. Can you confirm whether this is a display bug or if the deactivation isn't actually completing on the backend?
answer: This is a priority issue given it affects both your seat count and access control, so I'm escalating it right away. Based on your description - audit log showing deactivation but the user still marked active with a green status - this points to a sync issue between the deactivation action and the seat status display rather than the deactivation itself failing, but I want to verify that against your account directly before confirming. I'll check the backend status of both accounts now and follow up within the hour with confirmation and next steps to correct the seat count if needed.

subject: API rate limit thresholds unclear for our billing integration
body:
I'm reviewing our API usage after noticing our nightly billing reconciliation job started returning 429 responses around 2:15am on the 12th. We're calling the /invoices and /usage-records endpoints roughly 4,000 times per hour during that window. The docs mention a 'burst limit' but don't specify the exact numbers per plan tier, so I can't tell if we're actually over the threshold or if this is a transient issue.

Could you confirm our current rate limit ceiling and whether there's a way to see our usage against it in the dashboard? We need to plan capacity for month-end close and can't afford repeated failures.
answer:
Thanks for flagging this — I can see the 429s in our logs starting at 02:14am on the 12th, correlating with a spike to just over 4,200 requests/hour against the /usage-records endpoint. Your current tier allows 3,000 requests/hour with a short burst allowance, so you were briefly over that ceiling. I'll send you a link to the usage panel in your admin dashboard where you can monitor this in near real-time going forward, and I'll also flag the documentation gap on burst limits to our docs team for clarification.

In the meantime, I'd recommend adding exponential backoff to the reconciliation job or batching those calls to stay under the hourly cap. Let me know if you'd like us to discuss a temporary limit increase for month-end processing.

subject: How to route pipeline alerts to a specific Slack channel
body:
We'd like to set up Slack notifications so that our data pipeline sync alerts go to a dedicated #data-alerts channel instead of the default workspace notification stream. Right now it looks like everything goes to one channel and it's getting noisy for our small team.

Can you walk me through how to configure channel-specific routing in the Integrations settings, or is this something that needs to be requested as a feature? We're only using this for a handful of scheduled Salesforce sync jobs right now.
answer:
Good news — channel-specific routing is already supported. In Integrations > Slack, you can edit the existing connection and add a routing rule that maps specific event types (like pipeline sync failures) to a chosen channel, separate from the default workspace stream. Since you're focused on Salesforce sync jobs, I'd suggest filtering by that connector's event tag when creating the rule.

I'll include a short walkthrough link in a follow-up email, but happy to jump on a quick call if you'd like a live walkthrough for your team.

subject: Getting 429 errors on webhook retries, SDK not backing off correctly
body:
We've been hitting API rate limits consistently since last Tuesday when processing incoming webhook retries through your Python SDK (version 3.2.1). Our logs show we're sending around 600 requests in a 10-minute window trying to reconcile failed payment webhooks, and roughly 15% are returning 429 Too Many Requests.

The SDK's built-in retry logic doesn't seem to respect the Retry-After header — it just retries immediately, which makes the problem worse. This is affecting our ability to process payment confirmations on time for client invoices. Is there a config option we're missing, or is this a known SDK issue?
answer:
Thanks for the detailed report — this does sound like a bug rather than expected behavior. The Python SDK should be honoring the Retry-After header on 429 responses, and immediate retries without backoff would definitely compound the rate limiting you're seeing. Can you confirm which retry strategy you have configured (default exponential backoff vs custom) so we can reproduce this against SDK 3.2.1?

In the meantime, I'd recommend setting max_retries lower and adding a manual delay wrapper around your webhook processing to reduce pressure while we investigate. I'm escalating this to our SDK team and will update you within one business day with findings.

subject: Users getting logged out every 15 minutes after SSO login
body:
Since yesterday morning, a large portion of our team has been reporting that they're being logged out of Northwind roughly every 15 minutes after signing in through our SSO provider. This is disrupting work across multiple departments — we're getting reports from logistics coordinators, dispatch, and finance all describing the same pattern.

We haven't changed our identity provider configuration recently. Session timeout used to be set to 8 hours based on our SSO policy. Can someone check whether something changed on Northwind's side with session token expiry? This is affecting close to 300 people and is becoming urgent.
answer:
This is a priority issue and I've escalated it to our identity engineering team immediately given the scale of impact. We're checking whether a recent session token configuration change on our side is overriding your IdP's 8-hour policy — initial logs show session tokens expiring at 15-minute intervals starting yesterday, which does not match your configured settings, so this looks like a defect on our end rather than your SSO setup.

We'll update you within the next hour with findings, and if a rollback or hotfix is needed we'll coordinate timing with you directly. Apologies for the disruption to your team.

subject: Connector sync delays causing stale data downstream, need SLA fix
body:
We're integrating with the Data Pipelines API and have noticed our warehouse connector has been delivering records 3-6 hours late over the past week, instead of the near-real-time sync we configured. Our downstream reporting depends on this data being fresh within 30 minutes, and the delay is now affecting customer-facing dashboards for our travel booking clients.

Looking at sync job logs, job ID sync-8841 completed at 14:02 but records weren't visible in the destination table until 19:47 the same day. This has happened on at least four separate jobs since Monday. We need this addressed as a priority since it's actively causing data quality complaints from our clients.
answer:
Thank you for the specific job ID and timestamps — that's very helpful. We're treating this as a high-priority issue given the customer-facing impact and are investigating the delay between connector completion and data visibility in the destination table. Initial review suggests a bottleneck in the transformation queue for warehouse connectors during that window, but we're confirming the root cause now.

We'll provide an update within a few hours, and if this requires a configuration change to your sync schedule or a queue priority adjustment, we'll walk you through it directly. Escalating internally in the meantime.

subject: Can't find unsubscribe option for billing notification emails
body:
I keep receiving daily billing summary emails from Northwind Notifications even though I don't think I need them for my role. I looked through the email footer and account settings but couldn't find a clear unsubscribe link — clicking the one link in the footer just takes me to a generic preferences page that doesn't list this specific notification type.

Could you point me to where I can turn off just the billing summary emails without affecting other notification types our team relies on? This isn't urgent, just want to clean up my inbox.
answer:
Thanks for reaching out, and no rush on this one. Billing summary emails are managed separately from general notification preferences — you'll find them under Notifications > Email Preferences > Billing & Invoicing, which is a section that isn't linked from the footer directly (something we're passing along as feedback to our docs team). Toggling that off should stop the daily summaries without affecting other alert types your team uses.

Let me know if it's still not showing up as an option on your account and I can check your notification settings directly.

subject: URGENT - duplicate alert emails flooding our team, need this stopped today
body:
Our workspace has been receiving duplicate notification emails for every single alert since Monday — each event triggers 2 to 3 identical emails within seconds of each other. We're getting swamped; one of our on-call engineers received 47 duplicate emails overnight for the same energy usage threshold alert.

This is creating serious alert fatigue and our team is starting to ignore notifications altogether, which is dangerous given what we monitor. We need this fixed as soon as possible — please advise on rollback or a fix, and let us know what caused this.
answer:
I completely understand the urgency here and I'm escalating this immediately as a priority issue. Duplicate alert delivery like this is not expected behavior, and receiving 47 copies overnight for a single threshold alert points to a likely issue with our notification dispatch service double-firing on event triggers — we're pulling logs for your workspace now to confirm.

As a temporary measure, I'd recommend having your team mute non-critical alert channels while we investigate, but we will not let this run into another night without a fix or clear update. I'll follow up within the next couple of hours with root cause findings or a mitigation step.

subject: SAML login failing for our team, error on Northwind side
body:
I'm a support engineer on our team and we've had several users unable to log in via SAML SSO since this morning. The error shown after redirecting back from our identity provider is 'SAML Response Validation Failed - Invalid Signature'. We haven't rotated our IdP certificate recently, and this was working fine as of last week.

We've confirmed the metadata XML in our IdP matches what's configured in Northwind's SSO settings. Can someone check on Northwind's side whether the SAML certificate or endpoint configuration changed recently? Around 6 of our 9 users are currently locked out.
answer:
Thanks for the detailed report and for confirming the metadata match on your end — that helps narrow things down. An 'Invalid Signature' error typically points to either a certificate mismatch or a clock skew issue between the IdP and our SAML validation service, so we're checking our side now for any recent certificate rotation or config changes on our SSO service that could explain this starting this morning.

Given the number of locked-out users, we're treating this as a priority. We'll update you shortly with findings, and if a temporary certificate reload or fallback login method is needed to unblock your team sooner, we'll walk you through it.

subject: SAML SSO broken for entire workspace, users cannot log in
body:
As of about an hour ago, no one in our organization can log in through SAML SSO. Every login attempt redirects back from our IdP and then shows a generic 'Something went wrong during authentication' page on Northwind's side. We have 452 seats and this is affecting all departments simultaneously — this is currently blocking our entire workforce from accessing Northwind.

We did not make any changes to our IdP configuration, certificates, or SSO settings today. Our IT team checked our identity provider logs and the SAML assertions are being sent successfully, so this appears to be failing on Northwind's side. We need an urgent fix as this is a full outage for us.
answer:
This has been escalated immediately as a full-outage priority incident given the organization-wide impact. We're pulling authentication service logs for your workspace right now to identify what's failing on our end after your IdP sends a successful assertion — a generic error page after a valid SAML response typically points to a problem in our service processing rather than your configuration, which matches what your IT team observed.

We will keep you updated every 30 minutes until this is resolved. If we identify a way to provide an emergency non-SSO login path for critical admin accounts in the meantime, we'll set that up and notify you right away.

subject: SCIM provisioning failing to deprovision users, security risk
body:
We've discovered that SCIM provisioning has stopped processing deprovisioning requests from our identity provider as of sometime yesterday. Users who were offboarded in our IdP over the past 24 hours — at least 30 that we've confirmed so far — still show as active in Northwind and retain full access including MFA-enrolled sessions.

Our IdP shows the SCIM DELETE requests were sent successfully with 200-level responses logged on our side, but the accounts remain active in Northwind's admin console. Given we manage access for 4,359 seats across a healthcare organization, this is a serious compliance and security exposure that needs immediate attention. Please treat this as urgent.
answer:
This is being treated as our highest priority right now given the security and compliance exposure involved. We're pulling SCIM endpoint logs immediately to determine why DELETE requests that your IdP logged as successful aren't resulting in deprovisioning on our side — this points to a processing failure in our SCIM service rather than an issue with your IdP configuration.

As an immediate mitigation, we can manually deprovision the confirmed 30 accounts on our end while we investigate root cause — please send the list of affected user identifiers and we'll process it right away. We'll have engineering on this continuously and will provide updates at least hourly until resolved.

subject: Audit log entries missing after console update
body:
We've been using the Admin Console audit log for our SOC2 evidence collection, and last week we onboarded three new finance approvers so we needed to review the access change history closely. Our compliance team pulled the export for October 1-15 to hand to our auditor this Friday.

When I went to double check the export against what I remembered seeing live in the console, I noticed that all entries between October 9 and October 12 are simply gone from both the UI and the CSV export. We have 160 seats and this is a fintech environment so every gap in the audit trail is a real problem for us. Can someone confirm whether this is a display bug or an actual data loss issue?
answer: Thank you for flagging this, and I understand the urgency given your audit deadline. We're treating this as a P1 incident and have escalated to our platform reliability team to determine whether the October 9-12 window is a rendering/export issue or a data retention problem on our side. I'll update you within a few hours with findings, and if it turns out to be data loss we'll provide a formal incident summary you can share with your auditor.

subject: Biometric login crashes app on iOS after last update
body:
Since updating to the latest version of the Northwind mobile app on iPhone, Face ID login fails intermittently and the app crashes right after the biometric prompt. It happens roughly 1 in 3 attempts on iOS 17.4, and the crash always occurs before the dashboard loads. Switching to password login works fine every time.

I'm on the analytics team here at Delta Foods and use the app daily to check pipeline status while traveling, so this is becoming disruptive. Are there known issues with Face ID on this build, and is there a fix planned?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. We've seen a small number of similar crash reports tied to the biometric handoff on iOS 17.4 and our mobile team is actively investigating a fix for the next release. In the meantime, password login is a safe workaround, and I'd also suggest toggling biometric login off and back on in Settings, which has resolved the crash for a few other users while we finalize the patch.

subject: API key rotation breaking webhook signature validation
body:
We rotated our API key yesterday after generating a new one in the dashboard, and now all incoming webhook deliveries are failing signature validation on our end with a mismatch error. We didn't change anything in our webhook handler code, only the key.

We're a small team integrating the API for a new partner payment flow, so this is blocking testing. Is the webhook signing secret tied to the API key and does it need to be regenerated separately, or is this a bug on your side?
answer: Good question, and this is a common point of confusion — the webhook signing secret is separate from your API key and doesn't rotate automatically when the key changes, so you'll need to regenerate it from the Webhooks section of your dashboard and update your handler with the new secret. If you've already done that and are still seeing mismatches, send us one of the failing payloads and headers and we'll take a closer look.

subject: Need OAuth support for new connector authentication
body:
We're setting up a new data pipeline connector for our media asset provider and it currently only supports basic auth with static credentials, which our security team has flagged as a blocker for production use. We'd like to request OAuth2 client credentials support for this connector type since our provider's API deprecated basic auth for new integrations.

This is holding up a launch we have scheduled for later this month, so any timeline on OAuth support would help us plan around it.
answer: Thanks for the detailed request, and I understand the time pressure with your launch date. I'm escalating this to our data pipelines product team as a feature request, since OAuth2 client credentials support isn't yet available for this connector type. I'll follow up within two business days with either a timeline for a native fix or a workaround approach we can help you configure in the interim to keep your launch on track.

subject: Fingerprint login not working offline in mobile app
body:
Our field staff use the mobile app to check equipment status while offline at remote sites, and several of them have reported that fingerprint login stopped working once the device loses network connection. The app just sits on the login screen with a spinner and never accepts the fingerprint.

This started happening this week for at least four of our five users. Is offline biometric login supported, or does it require a live connection to validate?
answer: Thanks for letting us know. Biometric login is intended to work offline since it authenticates locally against the device, so this does sound like a bug rather than expected behavior. Could you confirm the app version and device OS versions your team is running? That will help us reproduce the issue and get a fix prioritized.

subject: Question about invoice line items and seat charges
body:
I'm reviewing our latest invoice and trying to reconcile the seat count listed against what we actually have provisioned in the admin console. The invoice shows a charge that doesn't match our current headcount, and I want to understand how mid-cycle seat additions get prorated before I approve payment.

Could someone walk me through how the line items break down, or point me to documentation on proration rules for the Starter plan?
answer: Happy to help clarify this. Seat additions made mid-cycle are prorated based on the number of days remaining in your billing period, so if seats were added partway through the month you'd see a partial charge reflected as a separate line item on that invoice. I'll have our billing team pull your specific invoice breakdown and send it over with the calculation shown so you can verify it against your provisioning records.

subject: Slack integration stopped sending alerts to our channel
body:
We configured the Slack integration a few months ago to post notifications from our billing workspace into a dedicated channel, and it worked fine until last week. Now no alerts are coming through, even though the integration still shows as connected in the Northwind admin settings.

I checked our Slack workspace app permissions and nothing looks revoked. Can you help us figure out why messages stopped delivering, or point us to logs showing what's failing on your end?
answer: Thanks for the details. This can sometimes happen when Slack rotates the webhook token or the connected channel gets archived or renamed on the Slack side. Could you try disconnecting and reconnecting the Slack integration from the Integrations page, and let us know if alerts resume? If not, send us the integration ID and we'll check our delivery logs for failed attempts on our end.

subject: Charts rendering blank on shared dashboard links
body:
We built a dashboard with three bar charts pulling from our API usage data, and it displays correctly when we're logged in. But when we share the public link with a client, the charts render as empty boxes with no data or axis labels, even though the underlying data source is public.

This is happening consistently across Chrome and Safari for the shared link, not just intermittently. Is there a separate permission setting needed for shared/exported dashboard views?
answer: Thanks for reporting this. Shared dashboard links do require the underlying data source to be explicitly marked as shareable, which is separate from the dashboard's own sharing toggle — it's possible that setting wasn't enabled for your data source. Could you check under the data source's settings for a 'shareable' or 'public access' option, and let us know if that resolves the blank charts?

subject: Bulk workspace deactivation not reflecting in audit log
body:
We ran a bulk deactivation of about 40 stale workspaces last night through the admin console as part of our quarterly cleanup, and while the workspaces show as deactivated in the UI, the audit log for that time window shows no corresponding entries at all.

Given the scale of our environment we rely heavily on the audit log for internal compliance reviews, so missing entries for a bulk action like this is a real gap. Can you confirm whether bulk deactivations are supposed to be logged individually or as a single batch event?
answer: Thanks for flagging this. Bulk deactivations should generate individual audit log entries for each workspace affected, so this does look like a logging gap rather than expected behavior. Could you share the approximate timestamp range and the admin account that performed the action? We'll check our backend audit pipeline for that batch and confirm whether the entries exist but aren't surfacing, or were never written.

subject: Need to remap SSO roles after IdP group rename
body:
We recently renamed several groups in our identity provider as part of a directory cleanup, and now the role mappings in Northwind's SSO configuration no longer match, so a couple of users are logging in with default permissions instead of their assigned admin roles.

Could you help us update the role mapping rules to point to the renamed groups? We have four seats total, so it's a small change but it's affecting half our team's access right now.
answer: Thanks for letting us know, and I can help you get the mappings corrected. Could you send over the old and new group names from your IdP along with which Northwind roles each should map to? Once we have that we can update the SSO role mapping configuration on our side and confirm with you that the affected users are getting the correct permissions on their next login.

subject: SCIM provisioning - need group push feature
body:
We onboarded Northwind SSO for Pioneer Media about two months ago and it's been working fine for authentication across our 4 seats. Our IT setup is lean since we're a small manufacturing team, so I've been handling the identity config alongside my regular analyst work.

The actual issue: our SCIM connector only syncs user creation and deactivation, but it doesn't push group membership changes from our Okta instance. When I move someone between the Engineering and QA groups in Okta, Northwind still shows them in the old group days later. Can this be added, or is there a setting I'm missing under Provisioning Rules?
answer: Thanks for the detailed writeup. Group membership sync via SCIM is currently limited to the initial provisioning push in your tier, which is why changes made after account creation aren't reflected automatically. I'll log this as a feature request against our provisioning roadmap and escalate it to the identity team, and in the meantime I can share a manual re-sync workaround using the admin console's 'Force Resync' button under Provisioning Rules that should close the gap until an update ships.

subject: Audit log entries missing for deactivated accounts
body: We deactivated three user accounts on our admin console yesterday (Oct 14) as part of an offboarding round, but none of those deactivation events are showing up in the audit log. We rely on this log for our internal compliance review at Blue Capital, and right now there's a visible gap between 2:00pm and 5:30pm where nothing was recorded at all, even though other admin actions before and after that window logged fine.
answer: Thanks for flagging this, a logging gap like that is concerning and we're treating it as an active incident. We've confirmed on our end that a backend indexing delay affected audit log writes for a subset of accounts yesterday afternoon, and our engineers are backfilling the missing entries now. We'll update this ticket once the three deactivation events reappear in your log, which should be within the next few hours.

subject: SCIM sync failing - users not deprovisioned after termination
body: We have a critical gap in our SCIM integration: employees terminated in Workday on Oct 10th are still showing as active in Northwind with full SSO access, including MFA-enrolled sessions. Our security team flagged this during a routine access review of the 293 licensed seats. The SCIM job log shows a 403 error on the DELETE operation with message 'insufficient_scope: provisioning.write' even though our service account previously had full provisioning rights.
answer: This is a serious finding and we're prioritizing it immediately given the security exposure. It looks like a scope was inadvertently revoked on your provisioning service account during a recent token rotation, which is blocking the deprovisioning DELETE calls. We're restoring the correct scope now and will manually trigger a full deprovisioning sync for all pending terminations once access is confirmed, and we'll follow up with a list of affected accounts so your security team can verify session revocation.

subject: Storage quota errors blocking backup uploads
body: Our nightly backup job for patient billing records failed last night with error 'STORAGE_QUOTA_EXCEEDED: usage 998GB of 1TB allocated' even though we deleted about 150GB of old retention data last week. The dashboard still shows us at 99% usage despite those deletions. We need backups running again before tonight's job since we're on a strict 90-day retention policy for compliance in healthcare.
answer: Thanks for the report, and I understand the urgency given your retention requirements. It looks like the deleted files are still counted against your quota because they're sitting in a 7-day soft-delete buffer before permanent purge, which is why usage hasn't dropped yet. I'm expediting a manual purge of that buffer on our end now so your quota clears in time for tonight's backup window, and I'll confirm once usage numbers update.

subject: Dashboards taking 30+ seconds to load company-wide
body: Since Monday, every dashboard we open is taking 25-35 seconds to render, including simple ones with a single bar chart. This is affecting all 6 of our users at Pioneer Foods and it's slowing down our daily reconciliation process significantly. We haven't changed any data sources or added new widgets recently, so this seems to have started on Northwind's side.
answer: Thanks for the report, and given this is impacting your whole team's daily workflow we're treating it as high priority. We're seeing elevated query latency on the dashboard rendering service in your region and our engineers are already investigating; in the meantime, exporting to CSV instead of live-rendering may give you a faster path for today's reconciliation. We'll update you as soon as we have a fix or timeline.

subject: Multiple team members' cards declining for renewal
body: Three of our 11 seats at Willow Academy just had their linked payment cards decline during yesterday's renewal attempt, with the billing portal showing 'card_declined: do_not_honor' for all three. These are different cards from different banks, so it doesn't seem like an issue on our end. We need this resolved quickly since our academy's access is at risk of suspension if payment isn't processed within 48 hours.
answer: Thanks for flagging this quickly. A 'do_not_honor' response across multiple unrelated cards usually points to an issue on our payment processor's side rather than your banks, and we're currently seeing a similar pattern from other customers today. I've paused the suspension countdown on your account so there's no risk of interruption while we retry the charges, and I'll follow up within the next few hours once we confirm the fix with our processor.

subject: app is USELESS now - push notifications completely broken
body:
We've been using the Northwind mobile app for our 139 drivers at Granite Partners for over a year without major issues, and generally it's been solid for dispatch alerts and route updates during shifts. Our drivers depend on push notifications to know when new pickup assignments come in throughout the day.

Starting this morning NO push notifications are coming through on Android devices, version 4.2.1. Drivers are missing pickups because they don't know assignments exist until they open the app manually. We've already had two missed deliveries today and this is costing us real money. I've restarted the app, reinstalled it, checked notification permissions - nothing works. This needs to be fixed TODAY or we're going to seriously reconsider this contract.
answer: I completely understand the urgency here given the direct impact on your deliveries, and I'm escalating this to our mobile team as a P1 right now. We've had a small number of other reports of Android push failures tied to version 4.2.1 following a backend notification service update, and we're working on a fix; as an immediate workaround, enabling the in-app polling refresh under Settings > Notifications should surface new assignments within 60 seconds even without push. I'll keep you updated every step until this is fully resolved.

subject: Question about refund policy for unused credits
body: We purchased a credit bundle back in August for Delta Capital but ended up not using about 40% of them before our plan renewed last week. I noticed the credits didn't roll over and just expired. Is there a policy for partial refunds on unused credits, or a way to extend the expiration window next time we buy a bundle? Just trying to understand this before we plan our next purchase.
answer: Good question, and I can clarify our credit policy for you. Credit bundles are non-refundable and don't roll over past the billing cycle they're purchased in, which is documented in our billing terms, but I can offer a one-time courtesy extension of 30 days on your next bundle purchase as a workaround if that helps with planning. Let me know if you'd like me to note that on your account for the next purchase.

subject: Payment card failing on every renewal attempt this week
body: Our renewal payment for Harbor Energy has failed three times now since Monday, with the billing page showing 'insufficient_funds' each time. We've confirmed with our bank that the account has sufficient balance and there's no hold on the card, so we're not sure what's causing the repeated decline. We only have 4 seats on the account but we can't afford any service interruption given our operations schedule this week.
answer: Thanks for letting us know, and I can see the three failed attempts on our end. Since your bank confirms funds are available, this may be a temporary flag from our payment processor treating repeated retries as suspicious activity; I'd recommend waiting about 24 hours before the next retry, or alternatively you can add a backup card under Billing > Payment Methods so we can process the renewal manually today and avoid any risk of interruption.

subject: Unsubscribe link sends duplicate confirmation emails to all users
body: We rolled out a notification campaign to our 16 users at Granite Academy last week, and several employees clicked 'unsubscribe' but are now reporting they receive a duplicate confirmation email every time they open their inbox, sometimes 5-6 copies of the same message. This is generating support complaints from our own staff and making it look like our notifications are broken or spamming people.
answer: This is a significant issue and I'm escalating it as high priority right away. It sounds like the unsubscribe confirmation is being re-triggered by a retry loop in our email delivery service rather than actually completing the unsubscribe action, which explains both the duplicates and why users may still be subscribed. I'm disabling the automated confirmation email for your account now to stop the duplicates immediately, and our team is investigating the retry loop so we can confirm all affected users are properly unsubscribed.

subject: Retention policy not deleting objects past 90-day limit
body: We configured our Storage retention policy to purge objects older than 90 days, but I'm still seeing files from March in bucket orion-archive-01 that should have been deleted weeks ago. Our compliance team flagged this during an internal audit yesterday. We're at 91% of our storage quota and this is contributing to it. Can someone check why the retention job isn't running as scheduled?
answer: Thanks for flagging this, and I understand the compliance urgency. We can see the retention job for orion-archive-01 has been failing silently since early this month due to a backend indexing bug affecting a subset of accounts. I'm escalating this to our storage engineering team now and will confirm once the backlog purge has run and quota usage reflects correctly.

subject: Mobile app crashing on launch for iOS users after 4.2 update
body: Since pushing update 4.2 last Thursday, we're getting reports from several dispatch staff that the app crashes immediately on launch, before even reaching the login screen. This is happening on iOS 17 devices specifically. About 6 of our 14 users are affected so far, and it's blocking their offline route sync workflow. Can you confirm if this is a known issue with the latest release?
answer: Thank you for the detailed report. We've had a couple of other similar reports tied to the 4.2 build on iOS 17, and our mobile team is actively investigating a crash on startup related to the offline cache initializer. I'll keep this ticket updated with a fix timeline, and in the meantime a full app reinstall has resolved the crash for some affected users if you'd like to try that as a workaround.

subject: Workspace settings reverting and audit log missing entries
body: Our workspace settings for the allowlist keep reverting to a previous state within minutes of being saved, and when I check the audit log to see who or what changed them, there are no corresponding entries. This started happening after we deactivated two former employee accounts on Tuesday. With 79 seats affected, we can't trust our current security configuration and need this resolved quickly.
answer: This is a serious issue and we're treating it as high priority. It looks like the deactivation process may be triggering a settings rollback bug that also suppresses audit logging for that action. I've escalated this to engineering with the account deactivation timestamps you provided, and we'll update you within a few hours with findings and a mitigation step.

subject: Request to streamline MFA enrolment for new hires
body: We're onboarding a batch of 15 new analysts next month and our current MFA enrolment flow through Identity and SSO requires each person to complete setup manually with IT sitting alongside them, which doesn't scale. Is there a way to pre-provision MFA enrolment or send enrolment links in bulk so people can self-enroll before their start date? Right now the process is quite slow and manual for our team.
answer: Thanks for the feedback, this is a common ask and something we're actively working on. Currently there isn't a bulk pre-enrolment feature, but you can generate individual enrolment links via the admin API and distribute them ahead of start dates, which cuts out the need for IT to be present. I'll also log this as a feature request for streamlined bulk MFA provisioning and update you if it lands on our roadmap.

subject: SCIM provisioning not syncing permissions correctly
body: We use SCIM provisioning to sync users from our HR system into Northwind, but for the last two sync cycles, users are being created with correct group membership but their permissions aren't being applied. This is affecting new hires who can log in via SSO but can't access the resources their role should grant. Is there documentation on how permission mapping works with our SCIM setup?
answer: Thanks for the clear description. Permission mapping via SCIM depends on the group-to-role mapping configured in your Identity settings, and a recent change to attribute naming on some IdPs can cause this mismatch. I'm sending over our SCIM provisioning documentation which covers the mapping schema, and I'd also like to review your current group mapping configuration to confirm nothing changed on our end.

subject: Question on cursor-based pagination for large result sets
body: We're integrating with the API Platform's list endpoints and noticed that when paginating through results larger than 500 records, the cursor sometimes returns duplicate records on the next page. This isn't breaking anything critical yet, but it's causing minor data duplication in our sync logs. Is this expected behavior or is there a recommended way to handle pagination for large datasets?
answer: Thanks for reaching out. This can happen if records are being created or updated between page fetches, since the cursor is based on insertion order rather than a fixed snapshot. We recommend using the sort_by=updated_at parameter combined with the cursor for more stable pagination, and I'll flag your example to our API team as feedback for improving cursor stability under concurrent writes.

subject: Audit log not showing recent user deactivations
body: I deactivated two accounts in our Admin Console last week as part of an offboarding process, but neither action shows up in the audit log when I filter by event type deactivation. I need this for our internal compliance records. Is there a delay in audit log population, or is this something that isn't being logged at all right now?
answer: Good question, and apologies for the confusion this caused. subject: Upload failures across Storage for multiple teams since this morning

I'm disabling that fallback rule on our end right now to stop further exposure while we investigate the root cause, and will confirm once it's fully resolved.

subject: Deaktivierung von Nutzerkonten funktioniert nicht wie erwartet

subject: How to restore files from backup after accidental deletion
body: I accidentally deleted a folder containing quarterly report files from our Storage workspace on Tuesday around 3pm. Could you confirm the exact folder path and the approximate deletion time so we can locate the correct snapshot? Restored files will count toward your quota once they're back in the workspace, so let us know if you'd like us to check your current usage first.

subject: Uploads failing intermittently for several team members

Can you send us one of the exact error messages or a screenshot along with the file size and a timestamp of a recent failed attempt so we can trace it in our logs? We'll also check current retention and backup job load on our end in parallel.

subject: Clarification needed on API rate limits after recent changes

Was there a change to the rate limit tier for Starter plans, or is this related to the deprecation notice we received about the v1 endpoints?
answer: There was a minor adjustment to burst limits on a few endpoints last week as part of preparing for the v1 deprecation, which could explain the increase in 429s. For Starter plans, /v2/enrollments is currently capped at 30 requests per minute with short bursts allowed. We'd recommend adding exponential backoff in your SDK calls, and we're happy to review your integration pattern if you can share a short log snippet of the requests.

subject: Uploads failing for larger CSV files via API
body: I'm integrating our reporting pipeline with the Storage API and getting consistent failures when uploading CSV files over 50MB. We're checking the workspace configuration now and will update you within the day; in the meantime, splitting the export into smaller chunks under 20MB should keep your nightly job running.

subject: Okta integration broken, users locked out of Northwind apps

subject: SDK throwing unexpected errors after recent version bump

subject: Workspace settings

subject: Data pipeline transforms failing in production, blocking downstream jobs
body: Our transform stage in the Data Pipelines connector has been failing since around 6:30am with errors like 'ValidationError: schema mismatch on field publish_date, expected ISO8601 got null'. subject: Storage quota usage and retention question
body:
I'm reviewing our Northwind invoices for Quill Media and noticed our Storage usage is at 92% of quota (per the dashboard, 460GB of 500GB). Before we hit the cap, I wanted to check how backup retention factors into this number. Are backup snapshots counted against our quota, or just live files?

Also, is there a way to see a breakdown of usage by folder or media asset type? We're trying to figure out whether old campaign videos from 2022 are worth archiving elsewhere before we need to upgrade.
answer:
Thanks for flagging this ahead of time. Backup snapshots do count toward your total Storage quota, which is likely why the number looks higher than expected if you have retention enabled on older assets. You can see a per-folder breakdown under Storage > Usage Report, which lets you export a CSV sorted by size and last-modified date to help identify what's safe to archive.

If you'd like, I can also send over our retention policy guide so you can adjust how long backups are kept before they roll off automatically.

subject: Urgent: need to add new office IP ranges to allowlist before Monday cutover
body:
We're migrating Apex Partners' logistics dispatch systems to a new data center this weekend, and our current IP allowlist in the Admin Console only has our old office ranges. subject: help

for the past two weeks our finance team has been trying to get Slack alerts working for invoice approvals through the Northwind Integrations page. we followed the setup guide and connected our Slack workspace, tested the connection which showed green, but no alerts are actually posting to our #finance-approvals channel.

subject: Billing discrepancy - overcharged after seat reduction, need refund

subject: CHARTS ON DASHBOARD ARE COMPLETELY BROKEN AND EXPORT DOESNT WORK

I AM TRYING TO SHARE OUR Q1 SPEND DASHBOARD WITH THE ENERGY OPS TEAM AT APEX LEGAL AND EVERY BAR CHART IS SHOWING BLANK WHITE BOXES INSTEAD OF DATA. THIS HAPPENED RIGHT AFTER I TRIED TO EXPORT TO PDF YESTERDAY AROUND 3PM. THE PDF EXPORT ALSO JUST DOWNLOADS AN EMPTY FILE WITH NO CHARTS AT ALL.
