subject: Email digest showing duplicate entries for same alert
body:
Our ops team at Ember Energy relies on the daily email digest from Notifications to track overnight system alerts. For the past three days (June 10-12), the digest has been listing the same alert twice, once around midnight and again around 6am, even though the underlying event only fired once according to our activity log.

answer: Thanks for the clear timeline, that's helpful for tracking this down. Duplicate entries in the digest are usually caused by an alert being re-queued if the initial digest batch job times out partway through, which would explain the midnight and 6am pattern you're seeing. I'm opening a ticket with our notifications team to check the batch job logs for those three dates, and in the meantime you can deduplicate manually by cross-referencing the alert ID shown in each digest entry.

subject: Push notifications not arriving when app is in background
body:

We'd like this fixed or a workaround before we roll the app out to our full team of drivers, since they need alerts for route changes even when not actively looking at the app. Is there a config setting we're missing, or is this a known limitation?

Could you confirm whether the devices have 'Background App Refresh' enabled for our app (iOS) and whether battery optimization is disabled for the app (Android)? subject: Dashboard sharing permissions broken after export

subject: How to deactivate workspace users and keep audit trail

Let me know if you'd like me to walk through the CSV template format.

subject: URGENT: All users locked out of SAML SSO login

subject: Requesting change to push notification settings for admins

subject: Audit log entries missing after allowlist changes

body: We're in the middle of onboarding a new cohort of staff and the MFA enrollment flow is failing for anyone provisioned in the last 24 hours. Users get to the QR code screen, scan it, enter the code, and get an error 'Enrollment verification failed' with no further detail. This is affecting at least 30 new accounts out of our 1598 seats and is holding up first-day access for an entire department.
answer: This is now our top priority and I've escalated it to our identity team as P1 given the number of blocked users. Can you confirm whether these accounts are provisioned via SSO or created directly in Northwind, and send us two or three affected user IDs so we can trace the enrollment attempts server-side? We'll keep you updated closely as we work this.

subject: URGENT: All users locked out, MFA enrollment wiped
body: As of this morning every user in our workspace who had MFA enrolled is now being asked to re-enroll from scratch, and several report their enrollment data appears to have been deleted entirely. We have 273 seats and clinical staff cannot access patient scheduling data right now. This started around 7:40am and is affecting our entire organization with no workaround available.
answer: We understand the severity of this and have declared it a P0 incident — our on-call identity and infrastructure teams are engaged right now. We are actively investigating what caused the MFA enrollment records to reset and will prioritize restoring access for your organization immediately. Please hold off on asking users to re-enroll manually until we confirm root cause, as we may be able to recover existing enrollments; we'll update you within the hour.

subject: Biometric login crashing app for retail staff
body:
Our store associates use the Mobile App with Face ID/Touch ID to clock in and check inventory, and since the last app update on Oct 12 the app crashes immediately after biometric authentication on about half of our devices. It works fine with password login but crashes every time with biometrics, which is causing delays across our 265-seat retail team during shift changes.

We've tried reinstalling on two affected devices with no change. Can you confirm if this is a known issue with the recent release and if there's a fix or rollback available?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report — this matches reports we're seeing tied to the Oct 12 release, and we've escalated it as P1 given the operational impact on shift changes. As an immediate workaround, please have staff disable biometric login and use password login until we ship a patch, which we expect within the next day. I'll update this ticket as soon as the fix is available.

subject: Recurring upload failures for files over 500MB
body:
Our team has been hitting intermittent upload failures in Storage for files larger than 500MB over the past week — about 1 in 5 attempts fail with 'Upload interrupted, please retry' partway through. Retrying sometimes works, sometimes doesn't, and it's affecting our ability to archive monthly transaction reports on schedule.

We're not near our quota limit as far as we can tell. Is this a known issue with large file uploads, and is there a way to see failed upload logs on our end?
answer: Thanks for the details. We've seen a small number of similar reports involving large file uploads and are looking into whether it's related to a timeout on our upload service. Could you send us two or three specific timestamps of failed attempts along with the file sizes so we can pull the corresponding logs? In the meantime, breaking uploads into smaller chunks or retrying immediately after failure has worked around it for other customers.

subject: Zapier integration failing on new trigger setup
body:
I'm trying to set up a Zap that triggers on new records in Northwind and pushes them to our internal system, but the Zapier integration keeps returning 'Authentication failed: invalid scope' when I try to connect the account, even though I'm using a fresh API key with full permissions. I checked the docs and it doesn't specify which scopes the Zapier app actually requires.

Can you clarify what scopes are needed for the Zapier connector, or if there's a config step I'm missing?
answer: Thanks for reaching out. The Zapier integration requires the 'data.read' and 'webhooks.write' scopes specifically — a full-access key should cover this, but there's a known issue where keys generated before Oct 1 don't inherit new scope definitions correctly. Could you try regenerating your API key and reconnecting? I'll also flag the documentation gap to our docs team so the required scopes are listed explicitly.

subject: Storage uploads failing intermittently since yesterday
body: Starting yesterday afternoon we've noticed uploads to Storage failing roughly 1 in 10 times with a generic 'Something went wrong, try again' message, mostly for CSV exports around 50-100MB. This is affecting our media asset backup workflow across the team. No changes on our end, and quota usage looks normal at around 60% of our limit.
answer: Thanks for letting us know. We're seeing a small number of similar reports and are checking whether there's a regional issue with the upload service since yesterday. Could you share one or two timestamps and file names of failed uploads so we can trace them in our logs? We'll follow up as soon as we identify the cause.

subject: Dashboards taking 30+ seconds to load for shared reports
body:
Several of our shared dashboards, especially the ones with multiple filters and export options enabled, have become very slow to load over the past two weeks — often 30 seconds or more before data appears, compared to under 5 seconds previously. This is happening across our 122 seats regardless of who's viewing, and it's making it hard to review case metrics during client calls.

Is there a known performance issue with dashboard sharing or exports that could explain this slowdown?
answer: Thanks for the report. Dashboard load times can degrade when a shared dashboard has many stacked filters or is being queried by several concurrent viewers, and we've seen a rise in load times tied to export scheduling on shared dashboards recently. Could you send us the names of two or three of the slowest dashboards so we can check their query plans and see if this is specific to your workspace or a broader pattern we're tracking?

subject: Repeated card failures on our Starter plan invoice
body: We've had three failed payment attempts this week on our Starter plan account (8 seats) for Vertex Academy. The card on file is a corporate Visa ending in 4471 and it hasn't expired, but the last invoice (INV-88213) shows status 'payment failed' with error code card_declined. Our bank confirms no blocks on their end. Can you check what Northwind's payment processor is returning so we can fix this before our seats get suspended?
answer: Thanks for flagging this - I pulled up invoice INV-88213 and I can see the processor returned a 'do_not_honor' response from the issuing bank on all three attempts, which usually points to a fraud filter on the card issuer's side rather than anything wrong in our system. I'd recommend calling your bank to authorize charges from Northwind Cloud, and in the meantime I've extended your grace period by 5 days so your 8 seats won't be interrupted. Let me know once you've retried the card and I'll confirm the invoice clears.

subject: Push notifications not arriving on mobile app - urgent for finance team
body: Since yesterday morning, none of our 3 users at Lumen Partners are receiving push notifications on the Northwind mobile app for approval requests. We're on iOS and Android, both affected. The app doesn't crash but notifications just never show up even though the in-app inbox has the items. This is holding up invoice approvals that need to happen today.
answer: I'm sorry for the disruption this is causing your approval workflow. This matches an issue we're tracking with push delivery for a subset of accounts tied to a token refresh problem on our notification service - our mobile team is actively working on a fix. As a workaround, please have your users pull-to-refresh the inbox screen to see pending items in real time, and I'll update you as soon as push delivery is restored, expected within the next few hours.

subject: Connector-Authentifizierung schlägt gelegentlich fehl
body: Bei unserem Salesforce-Connector in der Data Pipelines Umgebung von Atlas Freight kommt es seit letzter Woche vereinzelt zu Authentifizierungsfehlern. Die Synchronisation läuft meist normal, aber etwa zweimal pro Tag bricht der Job mit einem Token-Fehler ab und muss manuell neu gestartet werden. Bei über 4872 Nutzern in unserer Enterprise-Umgebung möchten wir das gerne verstehen, bevor es zu einem größeren Problem wird.
answer: Vielen Dank für die detaillierte Beschreibung. Solche vereinzelten Token-Fehler bei Connectoren deuten meist auf ein knapp bemessenes OAuth-Refresh-Intervall hin, besonders bei hohem Sync-Volumen wie in Ihrer Umgebung. Ich habe die Logs des Connectors angefordert und werde prüfen, ob wir das Refresh-Fenster verlängern oder auf einen robusteren Retry-Mechanismus umstellen können - ich melde mich mit einer Einschätzung innerhalb der nächsten zwei Werktage.

subject: SDK throwing deprecation errors after update
body: We updated to the latest Northwind API SDK (v4.2.0) for our media integration and now every call to the batch upload endpoint throws 'MethodDeprecatedError: uploadBatchV1 will be removed in v5'. Our finance reporting scripts run nightly and this is blocking automated invoice exports. Could you point us to the migration guide for the replacement method, and let us know how much runway we have before v1 endpoints are actually shut off?
answer: Thanks for reporting this - uploadBatchV1 is indeed deprecated but still functional until it's fully retired on our end, so your nightly jobs should keep running for now despite the warning. The replacement is uploadBatchV2, which has a very similar signature; I'm attaching our migration guide which covers the parameter changes and rate limit differences. We're targeting v1 shutdown in about 90 days, so you'll have time to update your scripts comfortably before then.

subject: Audit log missing entries for deactivated accounts - compliance risk
body: We're conducting an internal security review at Ember Foods and noticed the Admin Console audit log has no entries for at least 6 user deactivations that happened between March 3rd and March 10th, even though we can confirm those accounts were disabled in the console. We have 171 seats and need complete audit trails for our upcoming compliance audit. This is a serious gap and we need it escalated immediately.
answer: I understand the urgency here and I've escalated this directly to our security and compliance engineering team as a priority incident. Missing deactivation events in the audit log is not expected behavior, and we're pulling backend records now to confirm whether this is a logging gap or a display issue in the console. I'll have an update for you within 24 hours with either the recovered entries or a clear explanation, and I'll keep this ticket open until your audit trail is fully reconciled.

subject: Need help configuring SAML login for our API integration
body: I'm setting up SSO for Ember Travel using SAML 2.0 so our 175 users can authenticate through our identity provider before hitting the Northwind API. I've configured the metadata but our test login redirects back with 'invalid_signature' and I can't find clear documentation on which certificate format Northwind expects for the IdP metadata upload. Could someone point me to the correct docs or example config, and confirm whether MFA enforcement conflicts with SAML-only login flows?
answer: Thanks for the detailed setup info - the invalid_signature error is almost always caused by uploading a PEM certificate with extra line breaks or the wrong encoding; our SSO config expects a base64 DER-encoded cert without header comments stripped out. I've sent over our SAML integration guide with a working example metadata file. As for MFA, if your IdP already enforces MFA upstream you can disable Northwind's own MFA prompt for SSO users under Identity settings to avoid a double challenge.

subject: MFA enrollment broken for all our users - can't log in
body: Starting this morning, none of our 3 users at Lumen Partners can complete MFA enrollment when logging into Northwind. The QR code loads but after scanning with Google Authenticator and entering the code, we get 'Invalid verification code, please try again' every single time, even with a fresh code. This is blocking our whole team from accessing billing and reporting.
answer: I'm sorry for the trouble this is causing - this sounds like a time-sync issue between our MFA service and the authenticator app rather than something wrong with your codes specifically. Could you confirm the device clocks on the phones being used are set to automatic network time? While you check that, I'm escalating this to our identity team to rule out any server-side clock drift, and I'll follow up shortly with either a fix or a temporary bypass code so your team isn't locked out longer than necessary.

subject: Question about MFA enrollment process for new hires
body: I'm trying to understand the correct MFA enrollment flow for new employees joining Delta Energy. When I provision a new account, the enrollment prompt sometimes skips straight to a backup code screen instead of showing the QR code for the authenticator app, which seems like a bug. Could you clarify the expected flow and whether this skip behavior is normal or something we should report?
answer: Good question - the QR code should always appear first for new accounts, so the backup code screen showing up immediately is not expected behavior and does sound like a bug worth reporting formally. In the meantime, if a user hits that screen, they can click 'Set up authenticator app instead' at the bottom to manually trigger the QR flow. I've logged this behavior for our identity team to investigate and will let you know what we find.

subject: Transform jobs failing repeatedly - blocking our reporting pipeline
body: Our nightly transform jobs in Data Pipelines have failed for the past 3 runs (March 12, 13, and 14) with error 'TransformExecutionError: null reference in stage aggregate_revenue'. We're on the Pro plan with 66 seats at Lumen Media and this feeds our fintech client dashboards - the delay is now affecting reporting we owe clients tomorrow morning. We haven't changed our transform logic recently, so we suspect something changed on Northwind's side.
answer: This is being treated as high priority given the client-facing deadline. I've pulled the transform logs for March 12-14 and can confirm there was a change in how null values are handled in the aggregate_revenue stage after a platform update - this looks like the likely cause. I'm escalating to our pipelines engineering team right now for an urgent fix or rollback, and I'll update you within a few hours with either a resolution or a workaround so you can get tonight's run through in time.

subject: How do I set up SAML SSO login for our workspace?
body: I'm the workspace admin for North Retail and we'd like to enable SAML-based SSO for our 7 users instead of individual passwords. I looked through the Identity settings but couldn't find where to upload our IdP metadata file or generate the SP entity ID. Could you walk me through the setup steps or point me to a step-by-step guide?
answer: Happy to help get SSO set up for your workspace. You'll find the SAML configuration under Admin Console > Identity > Single Sign-On, where you can upload your IdP metadata XML and Northwind will auto-generate your SP entity ID and ACS URL. I'm sending over our step-by-step SSO setup guide now, which also covers testing the connection before rolling it out to all 7 users - let me know if you hit any errors during the metadata upload and I can take a closer look.

subject: IP allowlist blocking finance team from Admin Console
body: Since yesterday afternoon three of us on the finance team have been locked out of the Admin Console with a 'your network is not authorized' message. We added our office IP range to the allowlist last week as part of a security review, but it looks like the range we entered may have missed our VPN exit node. Can someone check the audit log for allowlist changes around Nov 12 and confirm what's currently configured? We need this fixed before month-end close.
answer: Thank you for flagging this, I understand the timing is critical for month-end close. I've pulled the audit log for your Admin Console and can see the allowlist entry from Nov 12 only covers a /28 range that excludes your VPN exit IP. I'll add the correct range now and send you a confirmation once it's live, which should restore access for all three accounts within a few minutes.

subject: Jira link keeps dropping ticket sync after Okta re-auth
body: We use the Jira integration to sync support escalations into our engineering board, and every time our Okta session refreshes (roughly every 8 hours) the connection between Northwind and Jira drops silently. New tickets stop creating Jira issues until someone manually reconnects the integration from the settings page. This has happened four times this week and we're missing SLA tracking because of it. Is there a way to make the token refresh automatically instead of requiring manual reconnection?
answer: This sounds like the Jira OAuth token isn't being refreshed alongside your Okta session, which would explain the pattern you're seeing every ~8 hours. I'm escalating this to our integrations team to check the token lifecycle logic, and in the meantime I'd recommend switching the connection to use a service account rather than an individual Okta identity, which should prevent the drops. I'll follow up with a permanent fix timeline shortly.

subject: Need ability to restrict dashboard sharing to specific viewers
body: Right now when I share a dashboard in Northwind, anyone with the link can view it, but we need to restrict access to specific named users since some of our charts include unreleased campaign performance data. Our whole team of 8 relies on these dashboards daily, and without granular sharing permissions we've had to stop sharing entirely, which is blocking our weekly stakeholder reviews. Can you add per-user or per-group sharing controls, or point me to a workaround if one exists?
answer: I completely understand the urgency here since this is blocking your weekly reviews. Right now dashboard sharing is link-based only, but as a workaround you can restrict access at the workspace level by moving sensitive dashboards into a private folder and granting access only to specific members through workspace roles. I'm also logging this as a feature request for per-user sharing controls and will flag it as high priority given the impact on your team.

subject: Workspace-Einstellungen lassen sich nicht speichern
body: Seit heute Morgen kann ich die Workspace-Einstellungen im Admin Console nicht mehr speichern. Wenn ich die IP-Allowlist oder die Deaktivierungsregeln für ausgeschiedene Mitarbeiter ändern möchte, erscheint kurz eine Ladeanzeige und dann springt die Seite ohne Fehlermeldung zurück zu den alten Werten. Wir haben aktuell 7 Nutzer und müssen zwei ehemalige Mitarbeiter dringend deaktivieren, das Audit Log zeigt aber keine neuen Einträge dazu.
answer: Danke für die genaue Beschreibung. Das klingt nach einem Problem beim Speichern der Workspace-Einstellungen, das wir uns direkt ansehen. Können Sie mir die genaue Uhrzeit eines fehlgeschlagenen Speicherversuchs nennen, damit wir es im Server-Log nachvollziehen können? Bis zur Klärung deaktiviere ich die beiden ausgeschiedenen Mitarbeiter gerne manuell von unserer Seite, wenn Sie mir die Nutzernamen schicken.

subject: Question about invoice format and payment history
body: I'm putting together our quarterly expense report and need to download all Northwind invoices from this year in a single PDF batch rather than one at a time. I also noticed our last invoice, dated Oct 3, shows a different billing contact email than the one we currently use. Could you update that and let me know if there's a way to export invoice history in bulk?
answer: Happy to help with both of these. I've updated the billing contact on your account to the one you provided, which will apply starting with your next invoice. For bulk invoice downloads, there isn't a single-click batch export yet, but I can generate a combined PDF of this year's invoices on our end and send it over within the next business day.

subject: Push notifications not delivered when app was offline
body: I'm integrating push notifications into our mobile app via the Northwind Mobile SDK, and I've found that if a device is offline when a notification is sent, it never arrives once the device reconnects, even though your docs say notifications should queue for delivery. I tested this with device tokens on both iOS and Android, sending a test push, disabling network, waiting 5 minutes, then reconnecting, and nothing came through. Is this expected behavior or a bug in the queuing logic?
answer: Thanks for the detailed repro steps, that's very helpful. Based on what you describe this shouldn't be expected behavior, our push service is meant to hold undelivered notifications for up to 24 hours and retry on reconnect. I'm going to reproduce this on our end with the same token flow and will check whether there's an issue with the retry queue for your account specifically; I'll update you within a day with findings.

subject: PDF export from dashboards is timing out for all users
body: Starting this morning every attempt to export a dashboard to PDF fails with a generic 'export failed, please try again' message after about 30 seconds of loading. I've tested this across three different dashboards and with two different admin accounts, and the failure is consistent. Our team of 290 relies on these exports for client reporting, so this is affecting a lot of people right now.
answer: I'm sorry for the disruption this is causing, especially with client reporting depending on it. We're seeing elevated export failures on our end as well and our engineering team is already investigating a bottleneck in the PDF rendering service. I'll keep you updated as we work through this and will confirm as soon as exports are stable again.

subject: Escalating: PDF export failures affecting multiple client dashboards
body: I'm raising this on behalf of our internal team since several of us are hitting the same issue exporting dashboards to PDF. Charts with more than roughly 5000 data points fail to render in the export, returning a blank page instead of the chart, while the same dashboard displays fine in the browser. We've confirmed this on three separate dashboards over the past two days and need this resolved quickly since we escalate client reports weekly.
answer: Thank you for the clear reproduction details, that narrows things down significantly. It looks like large datasets are hitting a rendering limit specific to the PDF export pipeline rather than the live dashboard view. I'm escalating this to our dashboards engineering team with your account and dashboard IDs attached, and will prioritize it given your weekly reporting cadence; expect an update within 24 hours.

subject: Request to optimize dashboard load times for large datasets
body: We're integrating the Dashboards API into our internal reporting tool, and several dashboards pulling from our largest data source take over 15 seconds to render, which is causing timeouts in our automated report scheduler. This mostly affects dashboards with multiple stacked charts and shared filters across 293 seats. Is there a recommended way to restructure queries or enable caching to improve load performance for API-driven dashboard requests?
answer: Good question, and this is a common pattern as dashboard complexity grows. I'd recommend enabling result caching on your data source connection and reducing the number of live filter dependencies across stacked charts, since each shared filter currently triggers a fresh query per chart. I can also share our API pagination guidelines for large datasets which should help reduce the per-request payload size significantly.

subject: How to route Slack alerts based on Salesforce and Jira events
body: We currently have Slack notifications set up for Jira ticket updates, and I'd like to add a similar alert flow for specific Salesforce events, like when a deal moves to a certain stage, without flooding our main channel. Is there a way to route these to a dedicated Slack channel based on event type, and can I set up escalation rules so high-priority Salesforce changes get a different alert format than routine Jira updates?
answer: Yes, this is possible through our integration routing rules. You can create separate Slack channel mappings for Jira and Salesforce event sources under the Integrations settings, and within each mapping you can define conditions, like deal stage, to trigger different alert templates or escalation channels. I'll send over a short setup guide with example rules for prioritizing Salesforce stage changes over routine Jira updates.

subject: App stürzt beim Start ab
body: Seit dem Update von letzter Woche stürzt die Northwind Mobile App auf meinem iPhone sofort nach dem Öffnen ab, noch bevor der Login-Bildschirm erscheint. Ich habe die App bereits zweimal neu installiert, das Problem bleibt bestehen. Zwei Kollegen aus unserem Team haben das gleiche Verhalten, alle mit iOS 17. Wir nutzen die App auch offline für Reisebelege, das funktioniert aktuell also gar nicht mehr.
answer: Vielen Dank für die genaue Beschreibung. Das klingt nach einem bekannten Problem mit dem letzten Release auf iOS 17, wir sehen ähnliche Abstürze bereits bei anderen Kunden. Könnten Sie uns die Geräte-ID und die App-Version aus den Einstellungen unter 'Über die App' zusenden, damit wir den Crash-Log gezielt prüfen können? Als Sofortmaßnahme empfehlen wir vorübergehend die Web-Version zu nutzen, während wir den Fehler weiter eingrenzen.

subject: Biometric login broken for all users after latest release
body: Since yesterday's mobile app update, none of our 452 users can log in using Face ID or fingerprint. The app just shows a spinning wheel and then falls back to password entry every time. This is a serious issue for our warehouse staff who rely on biometric login for quick clock-ins throughout their shift. We've had at least 40 tickets internally in the last two hours about this. Push notifications also seem delayed for the same users.
answer: Thank you for flagging this, we understand the urgency given the number of affected users. We've escalated this to our mobile engineering team as a P1 and are actively investigating a regression tied to the biometric authentication module in the latest build. We'll update you within the next two hours with either a hotfix timeline or a workaround, and in the meantime users can continue logging in with their password without any data loss risk.

subject: How to enforce MFA enrolment for new employee group
body: We're rolling out a new manufacturing floor employee group in our Northwind Identity workspace and want all 60 new accounts to be forced into MFA enrolment on first login. I've looked through the admin console but can't find a way to scope this policy to a specific group rather than the whole organization. Is there a supported way to do this via the SSO admin settings or does it require the provisioning API?
answer: Good question, this is supported through group-scoped MFA policies in the Identity admin console under Security > MFA Policies, where you can attach a policy to a specific group rather than the organization default. If the group doesn't exist yet, you can create it via the provisioning API and then link the policy afterward. Let us know if you'd like a walkthrough of the API calls involved.

subject: API keys returning 401 after rotation
body: We rotated our API keys yesterday through the admin console for our Harbor Robotics workspace, and since then several of our integrations are getting 401 Unauthorized errors even though we updated the key in our config. We have three services calling the Northwind API Platform and only two of them picked up the new key correctly. The third is our webhook receiver, which is now missing incoming events since around 3pm yesterday.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. A common cause here is a cached key on our webhook delivery service side, which can take a few minutes to refresh after rotation, but 24+ hours suggests something else is stuck. Could you send us the key prefix (not the full secret) and the affected webhook endpoint ID so we can check delivery logs and confirm whether the old key is still being referenced anywhere in our routing config?

subject: Need biometric login option for mobile expense approvals
body: Our finance team approves expense reports on the go using the Northwind mobile app, and right now everyone has to type in their password each time, which is slow and a bit of a security concern on shared devices during travel. Could we get biometric login (Face ID or fingerprint) added as an option for our workspace? We'd want this rolled out before our next quarterly close since approval volume triples then.
answer: Thanks for the request, and this is very timely as biometric login is already part of our Mobile App feature set for Pro plans. It sits under Settings > Security in the app once enabled by a workspace admin. If you're not seeing the option, it may need to be turned on centrally first; happy to walk you through enabling it before your quarterly close if you'd like to set up a quick call.

subject: Duplicate invoices charged this month
body: We were charged twice for our Ember Freight account this billing cycle, once on the 1st and again on the 3rd, both for the same 178-seat Pro plan invoice amount. Our finance system flagged the duplicate payment immediately since it came out of the same corporate card. Invoice numbers are INV-88213 and INV-88240. We need one of these reversed as soon as possible since it's affecting our cash flow reconciliation this week.
answer: I'm sorry for the trouble this has caused with your reconciliation. I've pulled up both invoices and can confirm INV-88240 was indeed a duplicate charge triggered by a billing sync error on our end. I'm processing a refund for that amount back to your original payment method now, which should reflect within 3-5 business days, and I'll follow up here with the confirmation once it clears.

subject: SDK wirft Fehler nach Deprecation alter Endpoints
body: Wir nutzen das Python SDK für die Northwind API Platform und bekommen seit dem 12. dieses Monats durchgehend Fehler vom Typ DeprecatedEndpointError beim Aufruf von client.get_shipments(). In der Dokumentation steht nichts darüber, welcher Endpoint als Ersatz dienen soll. Wir verarbeiten darüber täglich mehrere tausend Sendungsdatensätze für unsere Logistikkunden, daher brauchen wir dringend eine Lösung oder zumindest eine klare Migrationsanleitung.
answer: Vielen Dank für den Hinweis, das betrifft tatsächlich einen Endpoint, der im letzten Release als deprecated markiert wurde, die Dokumentation dazu wurde leider noch nicht aktualisiert. Der Ersatz ist der neue /v2/shipments Endpoint, der im SDK über client.get_shipments_v2() verfügbar ist. Wir kümmern uns umgehend darum, die Dokumentation zu aktualisieren, und melden uns zusätzlich mit einem Migrationsleitfaden für die betroffenen Aufrufe.

subject: Cannot restore storage bucket from backup, urgent
body: I'm trying to restore our production storage bucket 'vertex-prod-data' from the backup dated March 14th after we accidentally overwrote a large batch of files during a failed migration script run. The restore job in the console just sits at 'Pending' for over 40 minutes now and never progresses. We have close to 2TB of retail transaction data that needs to be back online today for our reporting pipeline.
answer: This has been escalated immediately given the data at risk. We're checking the restore job queue for 'vertex-prod-data' right now to see why it's stuck at Pending, this is sometimes caused by a quota lock on the destination bucket during large restores. We'll update you within the hour with either progress on the restore or a manual intervention plan, and please avoid running any further write operations on that bucket in the meantime.

subject: Duplicate email alerts for same event
body: We're integrating the Notifications API for our energy monitoring dashboards and noticed that certain alert events are triggering two identical emails within a few seconds of each other. It's happening for the 'threshold_exceeded' event type specifically, roughly one in every ten alerts. It's not urgent but it's causing some confusion among our on-call engineers who think there are two separate incidents.
answer: Thanks for reporting this, duplicate delivery on 'threshold_exceeded' events has come up before and is usually tied to retry logic firing when the webhook acknowledgment is slightly delayed rather than a true duplicate event. Could you share one or two event IDs where this happened so we can trace the delivery logs and confirm the cause? We'll also look into tightening the retry window to reduce this going forward.

subject: Dashboard PDF export missing charts for large datasets
body: When exporting our media performance dashboard to PDF, any chart pulling from datasets larger than about 50,000 rows comes out blank in the exported file, even though it renders fine on screen. This is happening consistently across our team, and we rely on these PDF exports for weekly stakeholder reports going out every Monday. We've tried exporting from both Chrome and Edge with the same result.
answer: Thanks for the detailed steps to reproduce, this looks like it's related to a rendering timeout that kicks in for large datasets during PDF generation rather than a browser issue. We're escalating this to our dashboards engineering team given the impact on your reporting cadence, and in the meantime a workaround is to apply a date range filter to bring the chart under roughly 50,000 rows before exporting. We'll update you as soon as we have a permanent fix timeline.

subject: Workspace settings reverted overnight - allowlist and deactivations gone
body:
Sometime between last night and this morning our Admin Console workspace settings rolled back. The IP allowlist we configured for our finance team is empty again, and two contractors we deactivated on Tuesday (Sept 3) are showing as active again. The audit log shows no entries for these changes at all, which is concerning since we rely on it for our media compliance reviews.

We have 8 seats on this workspace and need to know if this is a sync issue or something else. Can you check what happened around 2am UTC?
answer:
Thank you for flagging this - a settings rollback with no audit trail is something we're treating as high priority. We're pulling the workspace configuration history now to see what triggered the reversion and will restore your allowlist and deactivation states as soon as we confirm the correct values.

We'll follow up within the next few hours with root cause and confirmation that the settings are locked in. In the meantime, please avoid making further changes to the allowlist or user status so we don't complicate the investigation.

subject: SCIM provisioning failing for new users with MFA enabled
body:
We're integrating SCIM for user provisioning and running into an issue where any user we push who has MFA enforced on our side fails to provision with a 409 error, even though the user doesn't exist yet in Northwind Identity. Users without MFA requirements provision fine through the same endpoint.

This is blocking us from onboarding our next batch of 4 seats this week. Is there a known conflict between MFA policy and SCIM user creation, or a permissions scope we're missing on the provisioning token?
answer:
Thanks for the detailed report. A 409 on SCIM creation for MFA-enforced users usually points to a stale shadow record left from a previous provisioning attempt - we'll check your tenant for orphaned user objects that might be colliding with the new SCIM payload. Can you send us one of the failing external IDs so we can trace it directly?

We'll also verify your provisioning token has the correct permissions scope for MFA policy assignment, since that's a separate grant from basic user creation.

subject: Duplicate alert emails going to escalation group
body:
I noticed our escalation group is receiving duplicate copies of the same alert - specifically the 'payment processing delay' notification we set up. On Monday we got 3 identical emails within 2 minutes for the same incident ID. The routing rule only lists the escalation group once as a recipient, so I'm not sure why it's duplicating.

This isn't blocking anything critical right now, just noisy for the on-call team. Would like to understand if this is a known behavior with alert routing before we build more rules on top of it.
answer:
Thanks for the report, and good catch on the incident ID matching across the duplicates. This can happen when an alert rule is evaluated against overlapping trigger conditions, which sometimes causes the same event to fire twice before de-duplication kicks in. We'll review the routing rule configuration for the payment processing delay alert and check the evaluation logs around Monday's timestamps.

We'll get back to you with findings and, if needed, a fix or a recommended rule adjustment to prevent the duplicate sends.

subject: Urgent: API key deprecation impacting production integrations
body:
We received a notice that our legacy API keys are being deprecated on October 15th, but we have several production webhook integrations across our finance systems still using these keys and haven't received clear migration steps. We're at 3460 seats and this touches payment reconciliation workflows that run daily.

We also hit unexpected rate limit errors (429s) on the new key format when we tested it in staging yesterday - roughly 40% of requests failed during a bulk sync test. We need this resolved before the deprecation date or our finance operations will be disrupted.
answer:
We understand the urgency given the deprecation timeline and the scale of your integrations - we're escalating this to our API platform team right now. For the 429 errors on the new key format, that's likely a rate limit tier mismatch that didn't carry over correctly during key rotation; we'll check your account's configured limits against what's being applied.

We'll have a migration plan with adjusted rate limits and a dedicated contact for your finance integrations within the next few hours, well ahead of the October 15th cutoff.

subject: SSO role mapping not applying correct permissions after login
body:
Users authenticating through our SAML SSO are landing in the platform with default permissions instead of the roles mapped from their SAML groups. We have a mapping configured for 'Engineering-Admin' to map to the Admin role, but users in that group are getting Viewer access instead. This started after we updated our IdP group names last week to align with our new org structure.

We have 231 seats affected potentially since this touches all SSO logins. MFA prompts are working fine, it's specifically the role assignment post-login that's broken. Can someone check our role mapping configuration urgently?
answer:
This is being treated as urgent given it affects role assignment across your whole SSO user base. Our first suspicion is that the IdP group name changes broke the mapping since role assignments are typically matched by exact group name string, not group ID - so a rename on your IdP side would silently fall through to default Viewer access.

We're checking your SSO configuration now to confirm the mapping table against your updated group names, and will get the corrected mapping applied as soon as we verify. We'll update you within the hour.

subject: Duplicate email alerts for the same shipment delay event
body:
We're seeing duplicate notification emails for shipment delay alerts - our ops team got 2 copies of the same alert for shipment ID SHP-88213 on Sept 12, both timestamped within 30 seconds of each other. This has happened on at least 4 other shipment alerts this week too, always in pairs.

Could you take a look at whether there's a config issue on our notification rules causing this, or if it's happening on your end? We'd like a fix or at least a clear explanation since it's causing confusion among our 71 users receiving these alerts.
answer:
Thanks for sending the shipment ID and timestamps - that pattern of near-simultaneous duplicates across multiple alerts suggests a rule re-trigger issue rather than a one-off glitch. We're pulling the notification delivery logs for SHP-88213 and the other affected shipments this week to see if the same rule is firing twice per event.

We'll follow up with findings and a recommended fix for your notification rule configuration, likely within the next day.

subject: Storage quota reached, need to free up space or increase limit
body:
Our team hit our storage quota this morning and uploads are now failing with a 'quota exceeded' error. We have a lot of backup files from our education content archives taking up space that we thought were set to auto-expire, but they're still there. We're at 99 seats and this is blocking our instructors from uploading new course materials.

Can you help us either clear out the old backups that should have expired, or point us to documentation on how to manage retention policies so this doesn't happen again?
answer:
Sorry for the disruption to your instructors - we'll take a look at your storage account to see why the backup files didn't expire as configured, since that's likely the fastest way to free up space. In the meantime, we can also apply a temporary quota increase so uploads aren't blocked while we sort out the retention issue.

We'll send you a link to our retention policy documentation as well, which covers how to set and verify auto-expiration rules so this doesn't recur.

subject: Need to update unsubscribe behavior for notification emails
body:
We've had a few customer complaints that clicking unsubscribe on our alert emails unsubscribes users from all notification categories at once, instead of just the specific alert type they clicked from. We'd like this changed so unsubscribe is scoped per category - we have separate categories for billing alerts, usage alerts, and system alerts.

Can you let us know if this is configurable on our end already, or if it requires a change from Northwind's side? We're getting duplicate complaints about this weekly and want to resolve it properly.
answer:
Good question - granular unsubscribe by category is partially configurable, but the default unsubscribe link behavior does apply globally unless category-specific links are set up in your notification templates. We'll check your current template configuration to see what's in place now.

We'll follow up with steps to set up per-category unsubscribe links, or if that's not fully supported yet for your setup, we'll log this as a feature request and let you know the status.

subject: Data pipeline connector delivering data hours late, affecting reconciliation
body:
Our finance reconciliation pipeline has been receiving data 4-6 hours later than expected for the past two days (Sept 10-11). The connector pulling from our logistics vendor system is supposed to sync every 30 minutes but we're seeing gaps - the last successful sync before a 5 hour gap was at 09:15 UTC on Sept 11, then nothing until 14:20 UTC.

This is causing our daily close process to run with stale numbers. We only have 11 seats on this workspace so we don't have much room to manually patch data. Can someone check the connector health urgently?
answer:
We're escalating this immediately given the impact on your daily close process. We're checking the connector's sync logs now to identify what's causing the multi-hour gaps between 09:15 and 14:20 UTC on Sept 11 - this could be a rate limit issue on the vendor source or a stuck job in the pipeline queue.

We'll have a status update for you shortly, including whether we can trigger a manual backfill for the missed sync windows to get your reconciliation numbers current.

subject: Feature request: digest option for email notifications
body:
We're integrating the Notifications API for our retail dashboard alerts and getting a lot of feedback that individual emails per alert are too noisy - users want a daily digest option instead. Right now it looks like each triggered alert sends its own email, and we're seeing duplicate-feeling notifications when multiple alerts fire within the same hour for the same account.

Is there a way to configure digest batching through the API, or is this something we'd need to build ourselves on top of the webhook events? We have 221 seats' worth of users who'd benefit from this.
answer:
Thanks for the detailed context - digest batching isn't currently exposed as a native API option, so right now individual alert emails are the only built-in delivery mode. Your workaround of consuming webhook events and batching them yourself is the right approach today, and it would give you full control over the digest window and grouping logic.

We'll log this as a feature request for API-level digest support since it's a common ask, and we'll let you know if it gets prioritized on our roadmap.

subject: Rotating API key triggered rate limit errors on webhook calls
body: I'm the finance manager here and I generated a new API key yesterday (key ending in x4f2) to replace one we thought was compromised. After swapping it into our billing reconciliation script, we started getting 429 responses on our webhook endpoint calls, roughly 40 failures between 9am and 11am today. The old key still worked fine before we deactivated it. Is there a propagation delay when rotating keys, or did we hit a rate limit tied to account tier?
answer: Thanks for flagging this. New API keys can take a few minutes to fully propagate across our edge nodes, and if the old key was deactivated before that finished, you may have briefly hit default rate limits assigned to unrecognized keys. Could you confirm the exact timestamps of the 429s so we can check the logs on our end and verify your new key's rate limit tier matches your Starter plan allocation?

subject: Push notifications not delivered when app is backgrounded on Android
body: I'm integrating the Mobile App SDK for our patient reminder feature and we're seeing push notifications silently fail to arrive when the Android app is in the background or the device is offline and reconnects later. iOS seems fine. We also had two crash reports (stack trace pointing to NotificationReceiver.onReceive) on Android 13 devices in the last week. Can you confirm if offline queuing for push is supported, and if there's a known issue with the Android receiver?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. We do support offline queuing for push on Android, but there's a known edge case where notifications sent while a device is unreachable can get dropped if the retry window expires before reconnection, which may explain what you're seeing. Please send us the full crash log and the SDK version you're on so we can check whether the NotificationReceiver crash is related to a bug we're currently tracking for the next patch release.

subject: Dashboards taking 30+ seconds to load for entire team
body: Since this morning our operations dashboards have been extremely slow, some charts take over 30 seconds to render or time out entirely with a spinner that never resolves. This is affecting our whole 25-seat team and we rely on these dashboards for daily transaction monitoring. Nothing changed on our side, no new data sources or filters added. This started around 8:30am today and is still ongoing.
answer: Thank you for the report, and I understand how critical this is for your daily operations. We're seeing elevated load on the dashboard rendering service and are actively investigating; this has been escalated to our infrastructure team as a priority issue. I'll follow up within the hour with an update, and in the meantime, exporting data via CSV should still work as a temporary workaround for your monitoring needs.

subject: Users being logged out every 10-15 minutes after MFA setup
body: We rolled out mandatory MFA for our workspace last week and since then a large number of our 66 users are getting logged out every 10 to 15 minutes, forcing them to re-authenticate and complete MFA again each time. This is happening across Chrome and Safari, on both SSO and direct login. Session timeout was previously set to 8 hours in our admin settings and hasn't been changed. This is severely disrupting work for our legal staff who need continuous access to case files.
answer: This sounds like a session token issue tied to the MFA rollout rather than your timeout configuration, and I'm sorry for the disruption to your team. We're treating this as a high priority problem and looking into whether MFA re-verification is incorrectly invalidating session cookies. Could you confirm whether this affects users provisioned via SSO, direct login, or both, and send us one or two affected user identifiers so we can trace their session logs?

subject: INVOICE IS WRONG PLEASE FIX
body: WE GOT INVOICE #GT-2291 AND IT CHARGES US FOR 12 SEATS BUT WE ONLY HAVE 8 SEATS ON OUR ACCOUNT. THIS HAS HAPPENNED BEFORE LAST MONTH TOO AND NOBODY FIXD IT. WE NEED A REFUND FOR THE EXTRA SEATS ASAP OR WE WILL HAVE TO LOOK AT OTHER PROVIDRES. PLEASE RESPOND QUICK THIS IS AFFECTING OUR BUDGET FOR THE QUARTER.
answer: I'm sorry for the frustration this billing discrepancy has caused, especially after it happened last month too. I'm escalating invoice GT-2291 to our billing team right now to verify the seat count discrepancy and issue a refund for the overcharged amount if confirmed. I'll personally follow up with you within one business day with the corrected invoice and refund status.

subject: Multiple card decline errors on renewal charges
body: Our monthly Pro plan renewal for Blue Systems failed twice this week with card decline errors, first on the 12th and again on retry on the 14th, both showing 'card_declined - insufficient_funds' even though we confirmed with our bank that funds and limits are fine. We have 114 seats active and don't want service interrupted. Can you tell us what's triggering these declines and whether there's a way to manually retry the charge or update the payment method without waiting for the next billing cycle?
answer: Thanks for letting us know, and I want to reassure you your service won't be interrupted while we sort this out. Card decline codes like insufficient_funds sometimes come from the issuing bank's fraud filters flagging recurring merchant charges rather than an actual balance issue. You can update your payment method or manually retry the charge right now from the Billing section of your admin console, and I'd also recommend asking your bank to whitelist Northwind Cloud as a recurring merchant to prevent future declines.

subject: Salesforce integration stopped syncing contact updates
body: Our Salesforce integration has stopped syncing updated contact records since Tuesday. New records still come through fine, but any edits made to existing contacts in Salesforce aren't reflecting in Northwind after several hours, when previously sync happened within minutes. We haven't changed any field mappings or permissions on our Salesforce or Okta side recently. This is impacting how our legal team tracks client status updates.
answer: Thank you for reporting this, I know timely contact sync is important for your team's workflow. This looks like it could be related to a sync job queue delay rather than a mapping issue, so we're checking whether your integration's incremental sync job is stuck or throttled. Could you confirm the exact time the last successful update sync occurred so we can trace it in our integration logs?

subject: Critical: transform jobs failing repeatedly, downstream data stale
body: Our logistics data pipeline transform jobs have been failing intermittently since yesterday, with roughly 30% of scheduled runs erroring out with 'transform step timeout exceeded' before completing. This is causing our downstream shipment tracking dashboards to show data that's over 18 hours stale, affecting decisions across our 101-seat team. We've already tried re-running the failed jobs manually twice with the same result. We need this resolved urgently as it's impacting live logistics decisions.
answer: I understand the urgency here given the impact on live shipment tracking decisions, and I'm escalating this immediately to our data pipelines engineering team as a P1. Timeout errors at this frequency suggest a resource contention issue on the transform step, and we're pulling job logs from the last 48 hours now to identify the root cause. I'll update you within two hours with findings and an interim mitigation while we work on a permanent fix.

subject: Request: ability to export dashboards to PDF with embedded charts
body: I'm a support engineer here and several of our internal teams have asked for a way to export dashboards directly to PDF, including all charts and filters currently applied, rather than just raw data as CSV. Right now we're manually screenshotting dashboards to share with stakeholders who don't have Northwind accounts, which is clunky and loses interactivity context. Is PDF export on the roadmap, and if not, could this be logged as a feature request from our 268-seat account?
answer: Thanks for the detailed feedback, this is a request we've heard from several other customers as well. PDF export with embedded charts and applied filters isn't currently available, but I'm logging this as a formal feature request tied to your account and will pass it along to our product team for prioritization. In the meantime, some customers have had success using the shareable dashboard link feature to give stakeholders view-only access without needing a full account.

subject: Need invoice adjustment reflecting new seat count and payment terms
body: We just added 40 new seats bringing our total to 248, and I need our next invoice to reflect the updated seat count along with our newly negotiated annual payment terms instead of monthly billing. Our current invoice cycle renews in 5 days and I want to make sure the seat increase and billing frequency change both apply before that renewal generates, otherwise we'll be billed incorrectly for another full monthly cycle at the wrong seat count.
answer: Thank you for flagging this ahead of your renewal date, we'll prioritize getting this corrected before the cycle generates. I'm forwarding your account to our billing team right now to apply the updated 248 seat count and switch your billing frequency to annual terms; given the 5-day window, we're treating this as urgent and will confirm the updated invoice preview with you within 24 hours.

subject: Unable to upgrade from Starter plan - payment error
body: I'm trying to upgrade our Harbor Academy workspace from Starter to a higher tier so we can add more seats for next semester, but every time I submit the upgrade form I get 'Payment method declined - error code PM_4021' even though the same card works fine for our current invoices. I've tried twice today, March 4th, with no luck. Can someone check what's blocking this on your end?
answer: Thanks for reporting this - error PM_4021 usually points to a mismatch between the billing address on file and the card issuer's records, but since your existing invoices are processing fine I suspect this is tied to the upgrade flow specifically. I'm escalating to our billing engineering team to check your account and will follow up within one business day with either a fix or a manual upgrade path.

subject: storage retention
body:
hey, im setting up the storage api for vertex labs and i cant find anywhere in the docs how long objects are kept before they get purged. we need to keep transaction backups for atleast 7 years for compliance reasons and right now im seeing objects dissapear after what looks like 90 days on our test bucket. is there a retention setting i can configure or is 90 days a hard limit on starter plan?

also quota shows were at 80% used already which seems weird for a test bucket, can someone explain both issues
answer: The 90-day default retention you're seeing is indeed tied to the Starter plan tier, and it's not currently configurable from the dashboard - custom retention policies require an upgrade to a plan with extended storage controls. On the quota question, I'd like to check your bucket directly; can you send me the bucket ID so I can see what's consuming that 80%, since test data typically shouldn't approach that level.

subject: Late-arriving records causing gaps in downstream aggregates
body:
We're running a North Freight pipeline that ingests ad-impression events from a third-party connector, and we're seeing a consistent pattern where roughly 3-5% of records arrive 2-6 hours after their event timestamp. This causes our hourly aggregation jobs to close windows before those records land, so downstream dashboards show slightly undercounted totals that only self-correct the next day.

Is there a recommended way to configure a grace period or late-data watermark on the connector side, or should we be handling this with a reprocessing job on our end? Would appreciate any guidance on best practices here since this seems like a common scenario.
answer: This is a common pattern with third-party ad connectors, and the good news is you can configure a watermark delay directly on the pipeline's windowing settings - under the connector config there's a 'late arrival tolerance' field where you can set a buffer (we typically see customers use 4-8 hours for ad data). This lets the aggregation window stay open longer before finalizing, which should catch most of that 3-5% without needing a separate reprocessing job. I'll also flag your connector configuration to our data team for review in case there's a source-side delay we can help diagnose.

subject: Need bulk deactivation with IP allowlist restriction
body: We're building an internal tool against the Admin Console API to automate offboarding for Summit Travel, and we need to deactivate users in bulk when they leave the company. Currently I can only find single-user deactivation endpoints. Additionally, our security team requires that any automation hitting these endpoints only work from our office IP ranges - is there a way to configure an IP allowlist scoped specifically to the admin API, separate from general account access?
answer: Bulk deactivation isn't yet exposed as a single batch endpoint, but you can achieve this today by looping the existing single-user deactivation call, which supports up to 50 requests per minute - I'll share a documentation link with a sample script. On the IP allowlist, we do support scoping restrictions to specific API scopes including admin actions; I'll get you the settings path and confirm with our security team whether it needs to be enabled on our side for your workspace.

subject: Offline mode crashes app when syncing after reconnect
body:
We support end users at Quill Travel who rely heavily on offline mode during field visits with no signal. Multiple users have reported that when the app comes back online after being offline for more than a few hours, it crashes on the sync screen instead of completing the queued uploads. This has happened on both iOS and Android versions of the app in the past week.

Users then have to force-close and reopen, and sometimes lose the queued offline entries entirely. Can you help us understand what's triggering this and whether there's a workaround while we wait for a permanent fix?
answer: Thank you for the detailed report - a sync crash after extended offline periods that also risks data loss is something we want to address quickly. As a workaround, ask affected users to reconnect to wifi briefly every 1-2 hours if possible, since shorter offline windows before sync appear less likely to trigger the crash. Could you send us device models and OS versions for the affected users, along with approximate offline duration before the crash, so our mobile team can reproduce this?

subject: SEAT COUNT IS WRONG AND WE'RE BEING OVERCHARGED
body:
This is the third time I'm writing about this. Our Harbor Freight invoice shows 108 seats but we deactivated 15 employees back in January and your system is STILL billing us for all 108. I've opened two tickets already with no real resolution, just generic responses telling me to 'check the admin console' which I've done multiple times and the seat count there matches what we actually have, not what's on the invoice.

We are paying for licenses that don't exist and if this isn't fixed by our next billing cycle we are cancelling our contract and moving to a competitor. This is unacceptable for a fintech company that needs accurate billing.
answer: I understand the frustration, and I apologize this hasn't been resolved after two prior tickets - that's not the experience we want for you. I'm pulling up your account now to compare the admin console seat count against what's syncing to billing, since a mismatch like this usually points to a sync delay between deactivation events and the invoicing system. I'm marking this as priority and will have a definitive answer with either a credit or a fix confirmed before your next billing cycle closes.

subject: Dashboard sharing permissions broken for entire org
body: As of this morning, no one at Quill Capital can share dashboards with colleagues outside their immediate team - the share dialog opens, we select a user or group, click confirm, and get 'Permission update failed, try again later.' This is affecting our retail analytics team of over 200 people who rely on cross-team dashboard sharing daily for reporting. Nothing changed on our side; this started around 8am today without any config changes we're aware of.
answer: Thank you for flagging this immediately - a sharing failure affecting this many users is a top priority for us. We're investigating now and have identified a permissions-service issue impacting cross-group sharing that started this morning; our engineering team is actively working a fix. I'll update you within the hour with progress, and please let me know if you're seeing any other symptoms beyond the share dialog error.

subject: Frage zu Audit-Log Einstellungen im Admin Console
body: Wir bei Delta Retail überprüfen gerade unsere Compliance-Einstellungen im Admin Console und mir ist aufgefallen, dass der Audit-Log für deaktivierte Benutzerkonten keine Einträge mehr anzeigt, seit wir letzte Woche unsere IP-Allowlist aktualisiert haben. Ist das ein bekanntes Verhalten oder müssen wir eine Einstellung ändern, damit Deaktivierungs-Ereignisse wieder protokolliert werden? Für unsere Gesundheitsbranche-Audits benötigen wir vollständige Nachweise.
answer: Vielen Dank für den Hinweis. Das klingt nicht nach einem erwarteten Verhalten - Deaktivierungs-Ereignisse sollten unabhängig von Allowlist-Änderungen weiterhin protokolliert werden. Ich prüfe Ihr Konto und die Audit-Log-Konfiguration im Detail und melde mich mit einer Erklärung sowie gegebenenfalls den fehlenden Einträgen zurück, sobald ich mehr weiß.

subject: Biometric login crashes app on company phones
body: I manage finance for Blue Legal and use the mobile app to approve invoices while traveling. Since updating my phone last week, whenever I try to log in with Face ID the app crashes immediately and returns to the home screen. I have to use my password every time now, which is fine as a workaround, but I wanted to flag this since a couple other people in our office reported the same issue on their phones this week.
answer: Thanks for letting us know, and glad the password workaround is holding you over for now. Could you tell us the phone model and OS version you and your colleagues are on, along with the app version shown in your account settings? That will help our mobile team narrow down whether this is tied to a specific OS update or device type, and I'll follow up once we have more information.

subject: Salesforce integration completely stopped syncing
body: Our Salesforce sync integration for Harbor Legal has been down since approximately 6am this morning - no contact or opportunity records are updating in either direction. We rely on this for our sales team's daily workflow and right now Salesforce and Northwind are completely out of sync. The integration status page shows 'Connected' with no errors, but a full day's worth of changes have not propagated. We need this fixed urgently as our team is working blind.
answer: This is being treated as an urgent issue given the full sync outage affecting your sales team. I'm escalating immediately to our integrations engineering team to check the connector's job queue and authentication token status, since a 'Connected' status with no actual data flow usually points to a stalled sync job on our backend. I'll update you within the next 30 minutes with findings and next steps.

subject: Mobile app crashes immediately on launch for several staff
body:
Since yesterday morning several of our operations staff have had the Northwind mobile app crash within a second of opening it, right after the splash screen. It happens on both iOS and Android, affecting at least 6 of our 22 seats. Reinstalling didn't help. We rely on this app for offline job check-ins in the field, so this is causing real delays.

Can you tell us if there's a known issue with the latest build, or if there's a config we should roll back?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. We've seen a small number of similar crash-on-launch reports tied to a corrupted local cache after the last app update, and we're verifying whether that's what's happening here. Could you have one affected user send us the crash log from Settings > Diagnostics > Export Log, and confirm the app version shown on the login screen? In the meantime, having them clear app data or fully reinstall after a device restart has resolved it for other customers.

subject: sync
body: Our scheduled syncs from the manufacturing ERP connector have been running 3-4 hours late every day since Monday. They're set to run at 2am but the last three runs completed around 6am, 5:40am and 6:15am. This is pushing back our morning inventory reports and our team is starting to notice. We have 10 seats on this and only one pipeline configured, so it should not be under heavy load.
answer: Thanks for flagging this, and sorry for the disruption to your morning reports. We're seeing elevated queue latency on the connector pool serving your region starting Monday, and we're actively investigating the root cause with our pipeline infra team. As a workaround, could you try shifting your schedule to 1am for the next few days while we resolve the backlog? We'll update this ticket as soon as we have a fix or a firmer timeline.

subject: Okta integration broken, users locked out of Northwind apps
body: Our Okta app integration for Northwind stopped provisioning correctly this morning. New logins are failing with 'access denied - application not assigned' even though users show as assigned in Okta. We also use this integration to push identity to our Slack and Jira connectors, and both have stopped syncing since around 9am. answer: This is now our top priority and we're treating it as a live incident. We've confirmed reports of Okta SAML assertion failures affecting several customers this morning and our identity team is already investigating the provisioning service. Please hold off on reassigning or removing users in Okta for now to avoid compounding the sync issue, and we'll post updates here as soon as we have a fix or workaround.

subject: ZAPIER
body: WE WOULD LIKE TO REQUEST A NATIVE ZAPIER TRIGGER FOR NEW SALESFORCE LEADS SYNCED THROUGH NORTHWIND INTEGRATIONS. RIGHT NOW WE HAVE TO USE A WORKAROUND WITH JIRA WEBHOOKS TO GET THIS DATA INTO ZAPIER AND IT IS CLUNKY FOR OUR TEAM OF 248 USERS. WOULD BE GREAT IF THIS COULD BE ADDED AS A SUPPORTED TRIGGER IN A FUTURE RELEASE.
answer: Thanks for the suggestion and the context on your current workaround. If anything changes on our end we'll update this ticket.

subject: Mobile app crashing on launch after latest update, need fix timeline
body:
After the mobile app update rolled out last week, we've had a growing number of employees across our 237 seats report the app crashing immediately on open. It seems to affect users who were logged in before the update, while fresh installs seem okay. We've had to tell staff to uninstall and reinstall as a stopgap, but that's not sustainable for a company our size.

Can you confirm if this is a known regression and give us a rough timeline for a proper fix?
answer: Thanks for the clear breakdown, that pattern is helpful. We are aware of a regression affecting accounts with cached sessions from before the latest release, and a fix is already in QA with a targeted rollout this week. In the meantime the reinstall workaround you're using is the recommended path, and we'll notify you directly here once the patched build is live so you can communicate a firmer timeline to your staff.

subject: Doppelte und falsch geleitete Benachrichtigungen im Notifications-Modul
body: Seit gestern erhalten mehrere Kollegen in unserem Team Warnmeldungen, die eigentlich an die Logistikabteilung gehen sollten, zusätzlich aber auch doppelt per E-Mail. Wir haben ein Routing-Regelwerk mit drei Kategorien eingerichtet, aber es scheint, als würden alle Alerts an alle 22 Nutzer gesendet werden, unabhängig von der Regel. Das führt zu viel Verwirrung und unnötigem E-Mail-Aufkommen.
answer: Danke für die genaue Beschreibung. Das klingt nach einem Fehler in der Regel-Auswertung, bei dem die Kategorie-Filter momentan ignoriert werden und alle Alerts an die gesamte Nutzerliste gehen. Wir schauen uns Ihre Routing-Konfiguration jetzt direkt an und melden uns kurzfristig mit einem Zwischenstand, da dies mehrere Nutzer betrifft.

subject: Multiple failed card charges this billing cycle, need clarity
body: We've had three failed card charge attempts on our account in the last week, on the 3rd, 5th, and 8th, all showing 'insufficient funds' even though our card has plenty of available credit. I've confirmed with our bank that no attempts were even reaching them on two of those dates. We're on the Starter plan with 11 seats and don't want to risk service interruption over what looks like a processing issue on Northwind's side.
answer: Thank you for the details, and I'm sorry for the trouble this is causing. This does sound like it may be a payment processor issue rather than a problem with your card, and I'm escalating it to our billing team to check the transaction logs for those three dates. We won't suspend or downgrade your account while this is under investigation, and I'll follow up as soon as we have confirmation from the processor.

subject: Push notifications not arriving for a subset of mobile users
body: I'm troubleshooting a report from our end users that push notifications for account alerts aren't arriving on the Northwind mobile app, though in-app notifications show up fine when they open the app. This seems to affect only Android devices on our side, roughly 15-20 users out of our fleet. iOS users are getting pushes normally. Is there a known dependency on device token refresh that we should check on our end?
answer: Thanks for narrowing this down to Android specifically, that's useful. There is a known scenario where FCM tokens can go stale if the app hasn't been foregrounded in a while, which prevents push delivery even though in-app notifications still work via polling. Could you have a couple of affected users force-close and reopen the app once to refresh their token, and let us know if that resolves it? If not, we'll dig into the delivery logs for those specific device IDs.

subject: Fragen zu API-Deprecations und Auswirkung auf unsere Webhooks
body: Wir haben die Ankündigung zu den API-Deprecations erhalten und sind uns nicht sicher, welche unserer aktuellen Webhook-Integrationen betroffen sind. Wir haben 24 Nutzer, die auf diese Webhooks für Reporting angewiesen sind, und möchten vermeiden, dass etwas plötzlich ausfällt.

Juni abgeschaltet, und das aktuelle SDK muss auf v2 aktualisiert werden, um weiterhin zu funktionieren. Wir senden Ihnen im Laufe des Tages eine Liste der betroffenen Endpunkte zusammen mit dem Migrationsleitfaden, damit Ihr Team rechtzeitig vor der Frist umstellen kann.

subject: Need to upgrade plan and adjust seat count with invoice by end of week

subject: Request: audit log export for allowlist changes and deactivations

I've logged this as a feature request on your account and will update you if scheduled exports become available. In the meantime, I'm happy to walk you through the manual export filtered by event type if that helps bridge the gap.

subject: Users getting logged out too frequently via SSO

We use SSO with our identity provider and MFA is enforced for all 15 seats. This started sometime last week, though we didn't change any IdP settings on our end that we're aware of.
answer: Thanks for the detail, this is a good catch. Can you confirm which identity provider you're using and whether your admin console session timeout is set to the default? I'll also check our logs for your tenant to see if there's an unusual token expiry pattern in the last week.

subject: Duplicate email alerts going out to compliance team
body: Our compliance team at Harbor Freight has been getting duplicate copies of the same notification email, sometimes 2-3 identical alerts within a minute, for transaction threshold triggers. This has been happening since around March 4th and it's causing confusion about whether an alert was actually new or a repeat. We have about 108 seats on this workspace and the duplicates seem to hit multiple recipients each time.
answer: Thanks for flagging this with specifics on timing. Duplicate notifications like this are often caused by a webhook retry firing before the first delivery is acknowledged, or by overlapping alert rules matching the same event. Could you share one or two of the affected alert rule names or IDs so we can trace the delivery logs around March 4th? We'll get this corrected and confirm the fix before duplicates continue further.

subject: Need guidance on SDK rate limit errors during batch reporting
body: I'm a finance manager at Vertex Partners and we use the Northwind API Platform SDK (Python) to pull monthly invoice data for our 293-seat workspace. Starting this week our nightly batch job started throwing 429 errors partway through, even though the job worked fine for months. We're not sure what the current rate limit is for our plan or how to implement backoff properly in the SDK.
answer: Thanks for the details. On the Pro plan, the API Platform rate limit is 600 requests per minute per API key, and it sounds like your nightly batch may be exceeding that during peak processing. The SDK has a built-in retry-with-backoff option you can enable via the client config (retry_on_rate_limit=True), which should resolve the 429s automatically. I'll also send over our rate limit documentation link so your team can size future batch jobs accordingly.

subject: DRINGEND WORKSPACE EINSTELLUNGEN FUNKTIONIEREN NICHT

subject: Storage quota hit, backups failing across workspace

subject: SSO role mapping broken, users landing with wrong permissions

We'll update you within the hour.

subject: Late-arriving data breaking downstream reports
body: We've noticed our Data Pipelines connector for our point-of-sale feed has been delivering records 3-6 hours late over the past week, sometimes arriving after our nightly aggregation job has already run at Ember Labs. I'll send over a config snippet showing how to set a 6-hour watermark window, and separately we'll check why the connector's delivery latency increased this past week so we can address the root cause too.

subject: help

subject: Unauthorized API key usage detected, possible breach

subject: IP allowlist for Admin Console access
body:

I can't find a way to configure an IP allowlist anywhere in the console settings. Could you confirm if this feature exists on our plan, and if not, point me to any documentation or roadmap info?

In the meantime, I'd recommend enforcing MFA and reviewing login activity logs for anomalies, and I'll send you a link to our current security hardening guide.

I'll also flag this as a feature request on your account so you're notified if it becomes available on Starter.

subject: Alert routing broken - critical alerts not reaching on-call team
body:
Since this morning our on-call engineers stopped receiving pager alerts through Northwind Notifications. We use custom routing rules to send P1-tagged alerts to a specific escalation channel, but for the last 3 hours all alerts (about 40 events) have only gone to the default email fallback instead of the configured route.
