In the meantime, please have your on-call team monitor the fallback email inbox directly so no alerts are missed. I'll update you within the hour with findings or a workaround.

subject: Duplicate alerts being sent to wrong team after routing update
body:
After we updated our alert routing rules last Tuesday to split notifications between the pricing and inventory teams, we've noticed that every alert is now being duplicated and sent to both teams regardless of the tag filter. We're getting roughly 200 duplicate emails a day, which is causing people to ignore real alerts.

I already tried removing and recreating the routing rule for the inventory team but the duplication persists. This needs to be fixed quickly since our analysts are missing important pricing anomaly alerts buried in the noise.
answer:
Thank you for the detailed report, and I understand the urgency given the volume you're seeing. This matches a known issue where tag-based routing rules can double-match when two rules share an overlapping condition, which our engineering team is currently investigating as a bug.

As a temporary workaround, could you send us the exact rule names for the pricing and inventory routes? We can manually add exclusion filters to stop the duplication while the underlying fix is rolled out.

subject: Daily email digest missing several sections
body:
Our team relies on the daily Notifications digest email to summarize alert activity across our media properties, but for the past four days the digest has been missing the 'API errors' and 'Storage usage' sections entirely, even though those alert types are still active in our dashboard.

I checked our notification preferences and both sections are still enabled. Is this a known issue with the digest template, or do we need to reconfigure something on our end? Happy to share a screenshot of the incomplete digest if helpful.
answer:
Thanks for flagging this, and yes a screenshot would help us confirm the exact template version you're receiving. We did roll out a digest template update recently, and it's possible the section rendering logic dropped those categories for some accounts.

I'll check your account configuration against the new template now and let you know if this is a rendering bug or something specific to your notification setup.

subject: Question about offline mode capabilities in mobile app
body:
A few of our field managers have been asking whether the Northwind mobile app supports offline mode for viewing dashboards when they're in warehouses with poor connectivity. Right now the app just shows a blank screen with a spinner when there's no signal, and sometimes it crashes entirely when reconnecting.

Could you clarify what offline functionality is currently supported, and if there's documentation on how to enable cached views? Also curious if push notifications queue up properly while offline or if they're lost.
answer:
Good question, and thanks for the detail on the crash-on-reconnect behavior. Currently the mobile app supports limited offline viewing for previously loaded dashboards, but live data and push notifications require an active connection, so anything sent while offline won't be queued or delivered late.

The crash you're seeing on reconnect isn't expected behavior though, so I'll follow up separately on that. I'll also send over our mobile app documentation covering cached view setup for your field managers.

subject: Zapier integration slow and dropping Slack notifications
body:
We rely heavily on our Zapier integration to push Okta login alerts into Slack channels for our security team, but over the past week the zaps have been taking 10-15 minutes to trigger instead of near-instant, and roughly 1 in 5 don't fire at all. We've verified the Zapier task history shows the trigger firing on time, so the delay seems to be on the Northwind side.

With 3314 seats across our organization, missed security alerts in Slack are a real risk. Can you check if there's a performance issue with the integration API endpoint?
answer:
Thank you for the thorough details, especially the Zapier task history confirmation. We're seeing elevated latency on our integrations API for Enterprise accounts over the past several days, and I've escalated this to our infrastructure team as a performance issue affecting webhook delivery timing.

I'll keep this ticket open and update you as soon as we have a root cause or ETA for resolution, given the security implications for your team.

subject: Dashboards taking 20+ seconds to load, need export improvements too
body:
Our largest shared dashboard, the fintech risk overview with about 30 widgets, has been consistently taking 20-30 seconds to load for our team lately. On the export issue, that's a known limitation with wide table rendering in PDF exports, and I'll log this as a feature request for improved column handling so our product team can prioritize it alongside the performance investigation.

subject: Urgent: customer cards failing at checkout, losing revenue

subject: App-Absturz beim Start auf mehreren Geräten

subject: Recurring card decline errors on monthly invoice

answer:

I can see the two failed attempts on your account, and the decline code returned was a generic 'do not honor' response from the card issuer, which sometimes happens with automated recurring charges even on valid cards. I'd recommend contacting your card issuer to whitelist recurring Northwind charges, or updating to a different payment method.

Updating your payment method won't affect your current plan pricing or discount. I'll also hold off any service restrictions on your account for a few days while you resolve this, and I'll send a link to our billing documentation for updating payment details.

subject: SSO session expiring after 15 minutes regardless of config
body: I'm integrating Northwind Identity SSO for our internal tools and noticed that sessions are expiring after roughly 15 minutes even though I set session_lifetime_seconds to 3600 in the SSO app config. I'll walk you through adjusting that in the admin console and confirm the correct field name, since our docs are a bit unclear on the interaction between the two settings.

subject: Request to enable SCIM provisioning for our workspace

subject: Paginierung liefert doppelte Einträge
body:
Wir nutzen die API seit letztem Quartal, um Frachtdaten aus unserem internen System mit Northwind zu synchronisieren, und haben dafür das offizielle SDK in Version 2.3 eingebunden. Seit dem Update auf SDK 2.4 am 3. Juni bekommen wir bei der Nutzung von cursor-basierter Paginierung im /shipments Endpoint teilweise doppelte Einträge zwischen zwei aufeinanderfolgenden Seiten. Das betrifft etwa 15 von 23 Nutzern und verursacht falsche Bestandsanzeigen in unserem Dashboard. Können wir zur alten SDK-Version zurück, oder gibt es einen bekannten Fix für den next_cursor Bug?

Da dies mehrere Nutzer bei Ihnen betrifft, stufen wir das als P1 ein und melden uns innerhalb der nächsten Stunden mit einem Hotfix oder einer Empfehlung, ob ein Downgrade auf 2.3 sinnvoll ist.

body: hi we remved 3 staff last week from our acount but billing still shows 20 seats and we got charged for all 20 again on the invoice dated june 3rd. we only have 17 active users now. can you tell me how to update seat count or is this automaticaly synced? we are on starter plan and need this fixed before next billing cycle.
answer: Thanks for flagging this - seat counts on the Starter plan update automatically when a user is deactivated, but there can be up to a 24-hour sync delay before it reflects on the next invoice cycle. I've checked your workspace and confirmed 17 active seats currently show correctly on our side, so the June 3rd invoice should be adjusted; I'm issuing a credit for the 3 extra seats now and it will appear on your account within 2-3 business days.

subject: Absturz beim App-Start auf älteren Android-Geräten
body:
Mir ist aufgefallen, dass die Mobile App bei einigen unserer Kanzlei-Kollegen beim Start abstürzt, insbesondere auf Android 9 Geräten. Der Absturz tritt reproduzierbar auf, bevor der Login-Screen überhaupt geladen wird. Wir haben aktuell keine Details aus einem Crash-Log, da die App sich sofort schließt.

Das ist kein akutes Problem für alle Nutzer, aber da wir mobile Freigaben für Dokumente ausbauen wollen, wäre es gut zu wissen, ob das ein bekanntes Problem ist und ob es einen Workaround oder Zeitplan für einen Fix gibt.
answer: Danke für den Hinweis. Wir haben in den letzten Wochen vereinzelt Absturzmeldungen auf älteren Android-Versionen erhalten, die mit einem Kompatibilitätsproblem in einer Drittanbieter-Bibliothek zusammenhängen. Könnten Sie uns die genauen Android-Versionen und Gerätemodelle der betroffenen Kollegen nennen? Damit können wir das gezielt reproduzieren und Ihnen eine Einschätzung zum Zeitplan für einen Fix geben.

subject: URGENT: Every alert being sent 3-4 times to all users
body:
Starting this morning around 7am, every notification our workspace sends - booking confirmations, price alerts, itinerary changes - is being delivered 3 to 4 times to every recipient. We have 293 seats and this is flooding inboxes across our whole travel ops team. This started right after we saw a notice about a notification service update last night.

This is a major problem for us operationally, customers are calling in confused about duplicate booking emails. We need this stopped or rolled back immediately.
answer: This is being treated as a priority issue - thank you for the clear timeline. We can see an increase in duplicate deliveries correlating with last night's notification service update and our engineering team is already working on a rollback for the affected routing logic. I'll update you within the hour with progress, and in the meantime I'd recommend pausing any non-critical notification templates from your workspace settings if you're able to, to reduce the volume of duplicates going out.

subject: Question about invoice line items for API usage
body: I'm reviewing our latest invoice and I see a line item labeled 'API overage - 114 seats' but I'm not clear on how that's calculated since we're integrating via API and don't have a seat-based usage pattern there. Could someone clarify how seats factor into API billing, and whether there's a way to see a breakdown of which endpoints or calls contributed to this line?
answer: Good question - that line item reflects your Pro plan's included seat allocation rather than API call volume itself; API usage is billed separately based on request volume once you exceed the plan's included quota. I'll pull a detailed usage breakdown by endpoint for your last billing cycle and send it over so you can see exactly what's contributing to that overage figure.

subject: Getting 429s well under documented rate limit
body: We're consistently receiving 429 Too Many Requests responses on our /v2/orders endpoint even though we're sending around 40 requests per minute, well under the 200/min limit documented for our plan. This started yesterday around 14:00 UTC. We're using the Python SDK v5.1.0. Retry-After header returned is inconsistent, sometimes 2 seconds, sometimes 60 seconds, with no clear pattern tied to our actual request volume.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report and the SDK version - that helps narrow things down. This looks like it could be a limit misconfiguration on our side for your account rather than an SDK issue, since 40 req/min is well within your documented allowance. I'm checking your account's rate limit bucket configuration now and will follow up shortly with what we find; in the meantime, if you can share a few request IDs from around 14:00 UTC yesterday, that will help us trace the exact throttling decisions.

subject: Data pipeline sync arriving 4-6 hours late, breaking downstream reports
body:
Since Tuesday, our nightly data pipeline sync from our inventory system has been arriving 4 to 6 hours later than scheduled, sometimes not landing until mid-morning instead of overnight. This is affecting all downstream dashboards that our manufacturing ops team relies on for daily planning - the data being late means decisions are made on stale numbers.

Pipeline ID is inv-sync-prod-01. We haven't changed anything on our end recently. This is affecting our whole team and needs urgent attention.
answer: Thank you for the pipeline ID, this is very helpful. Late-arriving data affecting an entire team's daily planning is a priority for us - I'm escalating pipeline inv-sync-prod-01 to our data engineering team right now to check for upstream queue backlogs or scheduling issues on our processing cluster. I'll have an update for you within a couple of hours on root cause and expected recovery time.

subject: Clarification needed on upcoming API deprecations
body:
I saw the notice about the v1 API endpoints being deprecated but the documentation page doesn't specify an exact sunset date, just 'upcoming quarters.' We're planning our roadmap and need to know whether the v1 /accounts and /transactions endpoints will still work through Q3, and whether the new rate limits mentioned in the changelog apply to v1 or only v2.

Could you point me to a firm timeline so we can plan our migration to v2 accordingly?
answer: Thanks for raising this - I understand the roadmap planning need for a firm date. I've confirmed with our platform team that v1 /accounts and /transactions will remain functional through the end of Q3, with removal planned early Q4; I'll follow up with the exact sunset date once it's finalized this week. The new rate limits mentioned in the changelog apply only to v2 endpoints, v1 keeps its existing limits until deprecation.

subject: Seat count discrepancy causing incorrect invoice - need refund
body: I'm reviewing our billing data and noticed our latest invoice charged for 257 seats, but our internal HR export shows only 231 active employees with workspace access as of this billing period. This is the second consecutive invoice with this discrepancy. Could someone review our seat count calculation and process a refund for the difference if confirmed? We'd also like this escalated since it's now affected two billing cycles.
answer: Thank you for the detailed comparison - I'm escalating this to our billing team given it's affected two consecutive cycles. I'll have someone audit your workspace's active seat count against your HR export and confirm the discrepancy; if confirmed, we'll process a refund for the overcharged seats across both invoices. I'll follow up within one business day with findings and next steps.

subject: Webhook deliveries failing with 429 after rate limit change
body: We started seeing webhook delivery failures on Oct 9 around 14:00 UTC. Our endpoint for order.updated events is getting hit with far fewer retries than before, and our logs show Northwind returning 429 Too Many Requests on the initial POST even though we're under 50 events/min. This coincided with the deprecation notice for the v1 webhook signing headers. We have about 300 missed events queued in our dead-letter table now and need to know if the rate limit thresholds changed for Starter plans.
answer: Thanks for flagging this - we did tighten the default webhook delivery rate limit for Starter tier endpoints as part of the v1 signing header deprecation rollout on Oct 9. This shouldn't drop you below 50/min, so a 429 at that volume points to a burst pattern rather than sustained rate. Can you send us two or three request IDs from your dead-letter table so we can trace them server-side, and we'll also share the updated limit table and backoff recommendations in the meantime.

subject: MFA enrolment flow doesn't match documentation
body: I'm setting up MFA enrolment for our team ahead of a security review and the steps in the SSO admin guide don't match what our users see. The doc says users get a QR code prompt on first login, but our test accounts are instead shown a text-based backup code screen only, with no option to add an authenticator app. We're using SAML SSO with just-in-time provisioning for 12 seats. Can you confirm the correct current flow so I can update our internal onboarding notes?
answer: Good catch - the admin guide is out of date for accounts provisioned via SAML JIT; those currently default to backup codes first and the authenticator app option only appears after the user's first successful login, not on enrolment. I've flagged the doc for a correction. In the meantime, if you want authenticator-app enrolment available immediately, we can enable the 'MFA method choice on first login' setting on your tenant - let me know and I'll turn it on.

subject: Biometric login broken for entire firm after last app update
body: Since updating to the latest mobile app version this week, none of our 19 users can log in with Face ID or fingerprint anymore - the app just shows a spinner for a few seconds then drops back to the password screen. This is blocking our legal team from accessing case files while travelling, and several people rely on biometric login because they don't have their password manager on mobile. Devices are a mix of iOS 17 and Android 14. We need this fixed urgently or we'll have to roll back the update firm-wide.
answer: I'm sorry for the disruption this is causing your team, especially while people are travelling. We've had a couple of similar reports tied to the biometric session token refresh in the latest build, and our mobile team is actively investigating with P1 priority. As a temporary workaround, users can log in with password once and enable 'stay signed in' to avoid repeated prompts until we ship a fix - we'll update you within the next few hours with a timeline.

subject: Fehler beim Upgrade des Tarifs - doppelte Abbuchung
body: Wir haben gestern versucht, von Starter auf einen höheren Tarif zu wechseln, um mehr als 24 Plätze freizuschalten. Nach dem Upgrade wurde unsere Kreditkarte zweimal belastet, einmal für den alten und einmal für den neuen Tarif, obwohl das System laut Hinweis nur die Differenz berechnen sollte. Die Rechnung Nr. INV-88213 zeigt beide Buchungen am selben Tag. Wir brauchen dringend eine Korrektur, da unser Finanzteam die Buchhaltung für diesen Monat abschließen muss.
answer: Vielen Dank für die Meldung, das tut uns leid. Eine doppelte Abbuchung beim Tarifwechsel deutet auf einen Fehler in der Proration-Berechnung hin, den wir uns sofort ansehen. Wir prüfen die Rechnung INV-88213 vorrangig und leiten die Rückerstattung der doppelten Belastung ein, sobald wir die Ursache bestätigt haben - das sollte innerhalb der nächsten 24 Stunden abgeschlossen sein. Wir melden uns, sobald die Korrektur sichtbar ist.

subject: Credit balance not applied to invoice, escalating for finance review
body: Our finance team noticed that a $42,000 service credit issued back in August for the outage on our data pipeline product was never applied to any subsequent invoice. We've now had two full billing cycles pass and the credit still shows as 'pending' in the billing portal under account ref WLW-3314. This is holding up our quarterly reconciliation and I need either the credit applied to our next invoice or a clear timeline for when it will be, given the size of our account.
answer: Thank you for the detailed context - a credit sitting in pending status for two cycles on an account of your size is not acceptable and I'm escalating this to our billing operations team right now. I'll confirm within one business day whether the credit will apply automatically to your next invoice or needs to be issued as a manual adjustment, and I'll follow up directly with confirmation once it's posted so your finance team has something concrete for reconciliation.

subject: Duplicate alert emails and wrong routing after rule update
body: After we updated our alert routing rules last Tuesday to split notifications between our ops and finance groups, we're now getting every alert sent to both groups instead of just the intended one, and each alert arrives twice about 90 seconds apart. We have around 292 seats and this is generating a lot of noise - our ops channel got over 400 duplicate emails yesterday alone. Can you check if the routing rule changes were applied correctly on our tenant?
answer: Thanks for the details - duplicate delivery with a ~90 second gap usually means the old and new routing rules are both still active rather than the new one replacing it. We're checking your tenant configuration now to confirm whether the rule update fully overwrote the previous routing set. In the meantime, if you can pause the finance group rule from your admin console, that should stop the duplicates while we finish verifying the fix on our end.

subject: v1 API deprecation breaking our SDK integration ahead of sunset date
body: We received the deprecation notice for the v1 API endpoints, but our integration built on the official Northwind SDK (version 2.3.1) is already throwing errors well before the stated sunset date. Since this morning, calls to /v1/reports are returning 410 Gone, but our SDK documentation still references v1 as current. This is breaking our nightly reporting job that the whole team depends on, and we don't have a working migration path yet since the v2 SDK release notes don't cover the reports endpoint.
answer: Apologies for the early cutoff - this looks like the /v1/reports endpoint was retired ahead of the general sunset date in error, and we're treating this as a priority fix. We're re-enabling the endpoint for affected accounts within the hour while we finalize the v2 SDK reports module, and I'll send you migration notes for the reports endpoint specifically since they're missing from the current release notes. I'll update you as soon as the endpoint is confirmed back up on your account.

subject: Biometric login crashes app on Android after login
body: When I try to log in using fingerprint on my Android phone (Pixel 7, app version 4.8.2), the app crashes right after the fingerprint scan succeeds - it just closes to the home screen. This happens every time, so I've had to switch back to typing my password each time, which is annoying since I check dashboards throughout the day. Is there a known issue with biometric login on Android, or a setting I should check?
answer: Thanks for the report and the device details - we're aware of a crash affecting fingerprint login on some Android builds after a recent OS security patch, and it's being tracked by our mobile team. As a workaround for now, disabling and re-enabling biometric login under Settings > Security in the app has resolved the crash for a few other users, so it's worth trying that first. We'll let you know as soon as a permanent fix ships.

subject: Request to update connector auth method for our data source
body: We'd like to switch our primary data connector from basic auth to OAuth2 for our ERP data source, since our IT policy no longer permits static credentials for integrations. Right now the connector is authenticated with a service account username and password set up over a year ago. Could you let us know the steps to migrate this without disrupting our existing sync schedule, and whether historical sync data would be affected?
answer: Good timing on this request - OAuth2 is supported for that connector type and migrating won't affect historical sync data, since auth and sync history are stored separately. To switch over, you'll create a new OAuth2 connection in the connector settings, authorize it, and then point your existing pipeline to the new credential set; the sync schedule stays intact as long as you don't delete the old connection until the new one completes a successful run. Let us know if you'd like us to walk through it live before you make the change.

subject: Connector auth intermittently failing, causing sync delays across pipelines
body: Over the past four days, our main warehouse connector has been failing authentication intermittently, roughly 3 to 5 times a day, which is causing sync delays of up to 40 minutes on pipelines that normally complete in under 5. The error surfaced first on Oct 6 and logs show 'token refresh failed: invalid_grant' before the connector eventually recovers on retry. With 2,107 seats depending on timely dashboard data, these delays are becoming noticeable to end users and we need to understand the root cause.
answer: Thank you for the clear timeline and error detail - 'invalid_grant' on token refresh combined with intermittent recovery usually points to a token expiry or clock skew issue on the connector's auth provider side rather than our platform, but given the scale of impact we're pulling the full auth logs for your connector since Oct 6 to confirm. We'll report back with root cause and, if needed, help you regenerate the connector credentials to stabilize the refresh cycle while we investigate further.

subject: Deactivated users still showing as active in Admin Console
body: I deactivated three employees who left Pioneer Academy last week (IDs ending 4471, 4482, 4499) but they still show as 'Active' in the Admin Console user list. Their SSO logins are blocked, which is correct, but the status flag and audit log entry don't reflect the deactivation. Could you confirm if this is a display bug or if something else needs to happen on our end to fully close out these accounts?
answer: Thanks for flagging this - a stale status flag after deactivation is unexpected behavior and we want to get it fixed. Could you send us the exact timestamps you deactivated those three accounts so we can pull the audit log entries and compare against the user table state? In the meantime, their access is genuinely revoked even though the UI label is wrong, so there's no security exposure while we investigate.

subject: Webhook deliveries failing intermittently since yesterday
body: We're seeing webhook delivery failures starting around 14:00 UTC yesterday for our order-events subscription. Roughly 1 in 5 events either never arrive or arrive twice. Our endpoint returns 200 consistently based on our logs, so it doesn't look like a problem on our side. We're on the SDK v3 client and haven't changed our retry config recently. Could you check the delivery logs for subscription id evt-sub-7742?
answer: Thanks for the details - we're pulling the delivery logs for evt-sub-7742 now to check for retry storms or duplicate dispatch on our end. While we investigate, it would help to know if the duplicates carry the same event id so we can confirm whether this is a delivery-layer issue versus something upstream generating duplicate events. We'll update you within a few hours with findings.

subject: Getting duplicate email alerts for the same invoice
body: For the past two billing cycles I've been receiving two identical email notifications for each overdue invoice alert, about 90 seconds apart. This is happening for all four of our notification recipients at North Legal, not just me. Could you look into why duplicates are being sent, and also point me to documentation on how alert deduplication is supposed to work so I understand the expected behavior?
answer: Sorry for the inbox clutter this is causing - duplicate sends like this usually point to a retry trigger firing before the first send is marked complete, so we'll check the notification queue for your account's invoice alert rules. We'll also send over the documentation on how deduplication windows are configured so you can see the intended behavior once we've confirmed the fix.

subject: Staff unable to complete MFA enrollment during SSO login
body: Several staff at Atlas Works are stuck at the MFA enrollment screen after SSO login - the QR code loads but scanning it in an authenticator app returns 'invalid setup key' for at least 6 of our 18 users. This started this week when we rolled out mandatory MFA. We followed the enrollment steps in your documentation but it doesn't mention this error. Can you advise what's causing the invalid key and how to get affected staff enrolled?
answer: Thanks for the report - an 'invalid setup key' error at enrollment is usually caused by a clock sync issue between the authenticator app and our MFA service, but since it's affecting multiple users we want to rule out a provisioning problem on our side too. Can you confirm whether the affected users are all on the same identity provider connection, and send one example username so we can trace their enrollment attempt in the logs?

subject: Charts rendering blank on shared dashboards
body: Since integrating the API into our reporting workflow, several charts on our shared dashboards render completely blank for viewers outside the original creator's account, even though the underlying data loads fine when I check via the API directly. This affects our logistics KPI dashboard shared across Granite Media's ops team, about 15 users. Is this a permissions issue on chart-level sharing, or a rendering bug? Happy to share the dashboard ID if useful.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report - blank charts for shared viewers while the API data itself is fine points toward a chart-level permission or caching issue rather than a data problem. Please send over the dashboard ID and we'll check the sharing configuration and rendering logs for that specific dashboard to narrow down whether it's a permissions gap or a caching bug on our end.

subject: URGENT - Zapier integration down, orders not syncing
body: Our Zapier integration between Northwind and our dispatch system stopped triggering entirely as of this morning around 8am. No new order events are firing any Zaps, which means our logistics team at Apex Energy has no visibility into new shipments. We rely on this for real-time dispatch and it's now been down for over 3 hours affecting all our operations. Please advise urgently.
answer: We understand this is blocking your dispatch operations and we're treating it as high priority. Can you confirm whether the Zapier connection shows as 'connected' on your end and whether you've made any recent changes to the trigger or API key? We're checking our integration logs now for failed webhook triggers to Zapier since 8am and will follow up as soon as we have a root cause.

subject: IP allowlist locked out entire workspace after update
body: We updated our IP allowlist settings this morning to add our new office range, and now nobody at Quill Travel can log in at all, including admins - we're all getting 'access denied by IP policy' even from IPs that should be on the list. This is blocking all 25 of our users right now. We need this reverted or fixed immediately since we can't access the Admin Console to change the settings ourselves.
answer: This is a critical issue and we're prioritizing it immediately. Since you're locked out of the Admin Console, we're initiating an emergency override on our side to restore access to the previous allowlist configuration while we investigate why the new range didn't apply correctly. We'll confirm as soon as access is restored, likely within the next 15-20 minutes.

subject: app keeps crashin wen i open it
body: since the update yestrday the mobile app crashes imediately on launch, i cant even get past the loadin screen. tryed reinstalling twice and restarting my phone but same thing happens every time. i need to approve invoices thru the app for pioneer media and now im stuck cant login at all. please help asap this is holding up our billing
answer: Sorry for the disruption this is causing, especially with invoice approvals waiting on it. Can you tell us the phone model and OS version you're on, and whether the crash happens before or after you see the login screen? We'll check our crash reporting for your account in the meantime and get back to you with next steps quickly.

subject: Scheduled data pipeline syncs failing repeatedly overnight
body: Our nightly sync connector for the student records pipeline has failed for the last 3 runs in a row, starting the night of the 12th. Each run gets partway through then times out after about 40 minutes with no clear error message in the run summary, just 'sync terminated'. This is affecting reporting for our whole team at Ember Systems since downstream dashboards are now stale by 3 days. Can someone look into the connector logs urgently?
answer: This is impacting your reporting pipeline so we're escalating it now. We're pulling the connector logs for those three failed runs starting the 12th to look for what's happening around the 40-minute mark - that pattern often points to an upstream source timing out or a resource limit being hit mid-sync. We'll update you as soon as we identify the cause and can get the backlog reprocessed.

subject: Question about handling late-arriving source data in pipelines
body: We've noticed that some of our source records arrive 6-12 hours after their timestamp due to how our upstream media analytics vendor batches exports. Right now our pipeline processes syncs before that late data lands, so we end up with gaps that only get filled on the next run. Is there a way to configure a grace window or reprocessing rule for late-arriving data, or is this something we'd need to handle with a manual re-sync?
answer: Good question, and this is a common pattern with batch-exporting vendors. We don't currently have a built-in grace window for late-arriving data, but you can set up a scheduled re-sync a few hours after your main run to catch anything that landed late - we're happy to help configure that. We'll also pass this along as a feature request for a configurable reprocessing window since it would benefit other customers with similar upstream delays.

subject: Mobile app crashes immediately on launch (Android)
body: I'm testing the Northwind mobile app on a Pixel 7 running Android 14 and it crashes within about half a second of opening, before the login screen even renders. Happens every time, including after a clean reinstall of version 3.4.1. I was trying to verify the offline login flow for our field crews at Apex Energy but can't even get past the splash screen.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. A crash on launch before the login screen usually points to an issue with cached credentials or a corrupted local database file from a previous build. Could you send us the crash log from Android's logcat right after a launch attempt, and confirm whether this also happens on a second device? We'll use that to reproduce it on our end.

subject: Uploads failing intermittently to Storage - quota or something else?
body: We've had multiple file uploads fail over the last two days across our retail locations, roughly 15-20 failures out of a few hundred attempts. The error returned is 'Upload failed: insufficient storage capacity' but our admin console shows we're only at 68% of quota. This started around March 3rd and seems worse during our nightly backup window between 1-3am UTC.
answer: Thanks for flagging this - a mismatch between reported usage and actual failures suggests the quota check may be hitting a stale cache during high-concurrency windows like your nightly backups. We're looking into your account's storage metrics now and will check if there's throttling kicking in during that 1-3am window. Can you send us two or three specific failed upload timestamps and object names so we can trace them in our logs?

subject: SAML Login-Konfiguration für neue Benutzergruppe
body: Wir möchten für eine neue Fakultätsgruppe an unserer Einrichtung den SAML-Login über unseren IdP einrichten, aktuell nutzen wir Northwind Identity nur für die Verwaltung. Können Sie uns die genauen Schritte zur Konfiguration der Attribute-Zuordnung schicken, insbesondere wie Rollen aus unserem IdP auf Northwind-Berechtigungen gemappt werden? Wir haben 4 Lizenzen und möchten das Onboarding für das kommende Semester vorbereiten.
answer: Vielen Dank für Ihre Anfrage. Die Attribute-Zuordnung für SAML-Rollen erfolgt über die SSO-Einstellungen im Identity-Bereich, wo Sie unter 'Attribute Mapping' die Claim-Namen Ihres IdP mit unseren vordefinierten Rollen verknüpfen können. Wir senden Ihnen im Anschluss eine Schritt-für-Schritt-Anleitung inklusive Beispiel-XML für die Attribute, damit Sie das Onboarding rechtzeitig vor Semesterbeginn abschließen können.

subject: Retention policy not applying correctly to archived backups
body: We configured a 90-day retention policy for our backup storage bucket back in January, but our compliance team just found backup snapshots from October and November still present that should have been purged. This affects our quarterly audit due in two weeks. Can you confirm whether retention policies apply retroactively to existing objects, or only to new ones created after the policy was set?
answer: This is an important distinction for your audit timeline, so thank you for raising it now. Retention policies in Storage apply going forward from the point they're set unless a backfill job is explicitly triggered, which would explain why those October and November snapshots weren't purged. We're escalating this to our compliance engineering team to review your bucket configuration and confirm the correct backfill process before your audit date.

subject: Request: native Jira integration for issue linking
body: We're evaluating Northwind Integrations for our product team and want to confirm the roadmap status for a native Jira link - specifically the ability to auto-create Jira tickets from flagged events in our pipeline dashboards. Currently we're only seeing Slack, Okta and Salesforce connectors listed. With 1,629 seats across our organization this would significantly reduce manual ticket creation for our ops teams.
answer: Thanks for the detailed use case - a native Jira connector is on our integrations roadmap, though it's not yet available for general release. We'd like to include your requirements around auto-creating tickets from flagged pipeline events in our planning discussion; could you share a rough estimate of expected ticket volume per week? In the meantime, we can point you to a webhook-based workaround that several Enterprise customers use to bridge Jira in the interim.

subject: URGENT: Backups missing after retention update - possible data loss
body: Our finance team went to pull Q4 backup archives this morning for our annual audit and found that files older than 30 days are gone, even though our retention policy is set to 365 days. This is affecting multiple backup sets going back to November. We need to know immediately whether this data is recoverable or if it's been permanently deleted, since our external auditors are on-site tomorrow.
answer: We understand the urgency given your audit timeline and are treating this as a priority incident. Our storage team is checking your account's retention configuration change history right now to determine when the discrepancy occurred and whether the affected backups are recoverable from our internal snapshots. We will update you within the hour with findings and next steps - please do not delete or modify any remaining backup sets in the meantime.

subject: Role mappng brokn after IdP update - users cant login
body: hey we updated our okta app config yestrday and now half our users cant log in, they get stuck on a permision error. i think the role mapping got messed up when we changed the group claim name. we have 16 seats total and about 9 people affected right now cant access anything. this is blocking our analytics team from finishing a report thats due today, please help asap
answer: Sorry for the disruption this is causing your team today. A mismatched group claim name after an IdP config change would indeed break role mapping and cause the permission errors you're describing. Please send us the exact claim name change you made and a screenshot of the error one affected user sees, and we'll walk through the role mapping settings with you right away to get your team unblocked.

subject: Duplicate email digests being sent to same recipients
body: Since last Tuesday our weekly email digest notifications have been sending twice to the same recipient list, about 4 hours apart each time. We haven't changed any digest schedule settings recently. It's not blocking anything critical but it's generating confused replies from our analysts asking why they got the same report twice.
answer: Thanks for reporting this - duplicate digest sends usually trace back to a scheduling job retry or an overlapping cron trigger on our end. We're reviewing your notification schedule configuration and the digest job logs from last Tuesday onward to identify where the duplicate trigger is coming from, and will follow up with a fix timeline shortly.

subject: Dashboard charts showing blank/broken across entire org - urgent
body: Since this morning around 8am, most of our dashboard charts are rendering blank or showing a 'chart data unavailable' error, affecting nearly all analysts across our organization. This includes our patient volume tracking dashboards which clinical staff rely on daily. Export functionality also seems affected - CSV exports are coming back empty even though the underlying data source shows records present.
answer: We're treating this as a high priority incident given the scale of impact on your clinical reporting. Our engineering team is actively investigating the chart rendering and export pipeline now, and initial signs point to a data source connection issue affecting multiple dashboard types simultaneously. We'll provide an update within the next 30 minutes and will keep this ticket open until charts and exports are fully restored.

subject: Need to update invoice details and review recent billing discrepancy
body: We're reviewing our last two invoices and noticed a discrepancy - the January invoice reflects a higher per-seat charge than what was quoted in our renewal contract, and we'd like this corrected or refunded if applicable. Separately, we need to update our billing contact and PO number format for all future invoices starting next quarter, since our finance department is switching invoicing systems.
answer: Thank you for bringing the invoice discrepancy to our attention - we'll have our billing team compare your January invoice against the renewal contract terms and follow up with either a correction or refund within a few business days. For the billing contact and PO number format update, please send us the new details you'd like on file and we'll apply them starting with next quarter's invoice cycle.

subject: Transform step failing on all pipelines since 7am
body: Since around 7:10am today all of our data pipelines using the Postgres connector have started failing at the transform step with error 'schema mismatch: expected column revenue_usd, got null'. This is affecting 6 of our 6 active pipelines and we have 40+ failed runs queued. We haven't changed any source schemas recently. Latency on the few jobs that do complete is also up to 12 minutes from a normal 90 seconds. We need this fixed fast since our downstream dashboards are all stale.
answer: Thanks for flagging this immediately, we're treating it as a P1 and have engineers looking at the Postgres connector transform step right now. We suspect a recent source schema change is triggering the null coercion issue on revenue_usd, and we'll confirm shortly whether this needs a connector patch or a mapping update on your end. We'll update you within the hour with root cause and an ETA.

subject: Jira integration not linking issues to tickets
body: I'm trying to set up the Jira integration so that support tickets automatically link to Jira issues, but when I click 'Link Issue' from a ticket the modal just spins and never loads the Jira project list. We already have Slack and Okta SSO connected fine, it's specifically the Jira link step that fails. answer: Thanks for the details. This looks like it could be related to the Jira OAuth scope not refreshing correctly after your Okta SSO setup. Could you try disconnecting and reconnecting the Jira integration under Integrations > Jira, and let us know if the project list loads after that? If it still spins, we'll pull your integration logs to see what's blocking the call.

subject: Getting 429s on /v2/orders after volume increase
body: Our integration has started hitting 429 Too Many Requests on the /v2/orders endpoint since last week, even though our request volume hasn't changed much (~450 req/min). I also noticed the docs still reference the deprecated /v1/webhooks/register endpoint for webhook setup, which is confusing since it returns a 410 now. Can you confirm the current rate limit for our plan and the correct webhook registration endpoint we should be using going forward?

For webhook registration going forward you should use /v2/webhooks, and I'll follow up with a short guide on batching requests to stay under the limit if that's useful.

subject: App crashes on launch for some field users
body: A handful of our field team have reported the mobile app crashing immediately on launch, right after the splash screen, on Android. It seems to happen more often when they're offline or on poor connectivity when opening the app. It's not everyone, maybe 3 out of 20 users so far, and restarting the phone doesn't help. Could you look into what might be causing this so we can pass guidance back to the team?
answer: Thanks for reporting this, sorry for the trouble it's causing your field team. Crashes right after splash screen with poor connectivity often point to an issue with cached login tokens failing to refresh offline. Could you ask one of the affected users to send us the crash log from Settings > Diagnostics > Export Log? We'll dig into it once we have that.

subject: How to set up an IP allowlist and audit log export
body: We'd like to tighten up our workspace settings a bit. Specifically, I want to know how to configure an IP allowlist for admin console access, and whether audit log exports can be scheduled automatically rather than pulled manually each time. Also curious if there's a way to bulk deactivate users who haven't logged in for 90+ days as part of this cleanup.
answer: Happy to help with all three. IP allowlisting is under Admin Console > Security > Access Control, where you can add CIDR ranges for admin login restriction. Audit log exports currently support manual CSV download, but scheduled exports to an S3 bucket are on our roadmap, I'll flag your interest. For bulk deactivation, you can filter users by last login date under Users > Manage and select all matching accounts to deactivate in one action.

subject: IP allowlist update locked out entire finance team
body: We updated our IP allowlist this morning to add our new office CIDR range, and now the entire finance team (about 25 people) can't log into the admin console at all, getting 'Access denied: IP not permitted'. It seems the old ranges got wiped instead of appended. This is blocking end-of-day reporting and we need it restored urgently.
answer: This is now our top priority, we understand this is blocking your finance team completely. We're restoring the previous allowlist ranges from your last known-good configuration right now while we investigate why the update overwrote rather than appended entries. We'll confirm as soon as access is restored and follow up with root cause and steps to prevent this on future updates.

subject: Requesting better offline mode for field data entry
body:
Our analysts use the mobile app in areas with poor signal and offline mode keeps crashing when syncing queued entries. Here's the log from the last crash:

FATAL EXCEPTION: sync-worker
java.lang.NullPointerException: Attempt to invoke method on null object reference
  at com.northwind.mobile.sync.QueueManager.flush(QueueManager.java:142)
  at com.northwind.mobile.sync.SyncWorker.doWork(SyncWorker.java:58)
Caused by: offline_queue.db corruption detected, row_id=1032

Could we get a fix, or at least a way to manually clear the offline queue without losing unsynced entries?
answer: Thanks for sending the log, this is very helpful. The row_id=1032 corruption points to a known edge case where a queued entry with an oversized attachment can corrupt the local offline_queue.db. As a workaround, go to Settings > Offline Data > Repair Queue, which will attempt to recover unsynced entries before clearing the corrupted row. We're also logging this as a feature request to add a safer manual queue management option in a future release.

subject: Upgrading from Pro to Enterprise, questions on seats and billing
body: We're looking to move from our current Pro plan to Enterprise as we scale past our current 174 seats. Before we commit, I wanted to understand how the seat-based billing transition works mid-cycle, whether unused seats roll over, and if there's a way to get an itemized invoice preview before the upgrade goes through. We'd also like to flag that having a self-serve upgrade flow instead of requiring a sales call would be a big improvement for teams like ours.
answer: Thanks for reaching out, and for the feedback on self-serve upgrades, we'll pass that along to product. For your upgrade, mid-cycle plan changes are prorated based on days remaining in your current billing period, and unused seats don't roll over but you'll only be charged the prorated difference. I can generate an itemized invoice preview for your exact seat count now if you'd like, just confirm the seat number you want to upgrade to and I'll send it over.

subject: Jira-Verknüpfung funktioniert nicht mehr
body: Seit heute Vormittag lässt sich unsere Jira-Integration nicht mehr mit Tickets verknüpfen. Beim Klick auf 'Issue verknüpfen' erscheint die Fehlermeldung 'Verbindung zu Jira fehlgeschlagen (401)'. Das blockiert aktuell unser gesamtes Team bei der Übergabe von Support-Fällen an die Entwicklung, wir brauchen dringend eine Lösung.
answer: Vielen Dank für die schnelle Meldung, wir bearbeiten das als P1. Der 401-Fehler deutet darauf hin, dass das Jira-OAuth-Token nach einer Änderung auf Okta-Seite abgelaufen oder ungültig geworden ist. Wir prüfen jetzt die Verbindung zwischen Okta und Jira in Ihrem Workspace und melden uns innerhalb der nächsten Stunde mit einem Status-Update.

subject: Feature request: webhook retry configuration and SDK support
body: We'd like to request the ability to configure custom retry policies for webhooks, right now failed deliveries seem to retry on a fixed schedule that doesn't work well for our downstream systems. Also wondering if there's an official SDK update planned that supports webhook signature verification natively, since we're currently rolling our own verification logic.
answer: Thanks for the detailed request. Configurable retry policies for webhooks are on our roadmap for later this quarter, I'll add your workspace to the interest list so we can notify you when it's available. On the SDK side, native webhook signature verification helpers are already in our latest SDK release (v4.2), so you should be able to drop your custom verification logic once you upgrade, let us know if you'd like a quick pointer to the relevant docs.

subject: SSO sessions expiring too quickly for API-integrated users
body: I'm integrating our internal tools with Northwind's SSO for Granite Foods and noticed that sessions authenticated via SAML are timing out after roughly 15 minutes, even when the user is actively making API calls. Our previous IdP allowed us to set session length per app. Is there a way to configure the session timeout or refresh token lifetime through the admin console or API for our 24 seats?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. Session lifetime for SSO-authenticated users is currently controlled at the workspace level under Identity > Session Policy, but we don't yet expose a per-app override through the API. I'll flag this as a feature request on our roadmap and in the meantime can manually extend your workspace's default session window to 60 minutes if that helps unblock your integration work.

subject: Charts not rendering on Revenue dashboard
body: Several of our line charts on the Revenue Overview dashboard have been showing blank white boxes since Tuesday. The data table underneath still populates correctly, so it seems isolated to chart rendering. We're on Chrome and have tried clearing cache, but no luck. This is affecting how we report weekly numbers to our clinical operations team.
answer: Sorry for the disruption to your weekly reporting. This matches a known rendering regression tied to a recent chart library update that affects line charts with more than 90 data points. We're pushing a fix today, but as a workaround you can switch the date range filter to a shorter window to force the chart to re-render correctly in the meantime. I'll follow up once the patch is live.

subject: Offline mode crashing app on sync for field drivers
body: Our drivers use the Northwind mobile app in areas with no signal, relying on offline mode to log delivery confirmations. Since the last app update, the app crashes as soon as connectivity returns and it tries to sync queued entries. answer: This is a serious issue and we're treating it as high priority given the impact on your delivery operations and the potential for data loss. Our mobile team is reproducing the crash now using your workspace's sync logs; in the meantime, please ask drivers to avoid closing the app after regaining signal until sync completes, as force-closing appears to be triggering the crash loop. We'll update you within a few hours with a fix timeline.

subject: Feedback on scheduled sync latency reporting
body: We noticed our nightly scheduled sync from the warehouse management connector consistently finishes about 40 minutes later than the configured window, though it does complete successfully every time. This isn't blocking us, but it would help to have clearer visibility into expected vs actual completion time on the pipeline dashboard so we can plan downstream reports accordingly.
answer: Thanks for flagging this, it's useful feedback. The scheduled sync completing late but successfully is expected behavior during peak connector load, though we agree the current dashboard doesn't make that distinction clear. I've logged this as an enhancement request to add an estimated vs actual runtime indicator, and I'll let you know when it's scheduled for release.

subject: Pagination completely broken after your last API update - fix this now
body: Your pagination change silently broke our ingestion job. We were using the 'next_page_token' field from the v2 endpoint and as of this morning it's returning null on every response even when there are clearly more records, so we're only pulling the first page of shipment data across all 109 seats. This is the second undocumented breaking change in three months and it's costing us real time. If this keeps happening we will be moving to a different vendor.
answer: I understand the frustration, and I'm sorry this hit you without warning. We did roll out a pagination update yesterday that unintentionally affected next_page_token on the /shipments endpoint for accounts still on v2 - this is a bug, not an intended deprecation, and we're rolling back the change for affected workspaces right now. I'll confirm directly once your account is restored and will also make sure you're notified ahead of any future API changes.

subject: Okta app integration not syncing group assignments
body: We set up the Northwind Okta app for Apex Systems last week to manage provisioning for our 20 seats. Users are being created correctly, but group assignments from Okta aren't carrying over, so everyone lands in the default role regardless of their Okta group. I've double-checked the group mapping configuration in the Okta admin panel and it looks correct on our end.
answer: Thanks for the details. This sounds like the group attribute mapping between Okta and Northwind's provisioning endpoint, which sometimes needs the group claim name to match exactly what's configured in your Okta app settings. Could you send a screenshot of the SCIM mapping section so we can verify the attribute names? We'll get this sorted so new users land in the correct roles automatically.

subject: Need higher webhook rate limits and retry visibility
body: We're building out webhook handling for booking status updates and are hitting the default rate limit of 100 events per minute during peak booking hours, causing dropped notifications. We'd like to request either a higher limit for our workspace or clearer documentation on retry/backoff behavior, since right now failed webhook deliveries don't show up anywhere in the dashboard for us to investigate.
answer: Thanks for raising this, it's a fair ask given your peak volume. I can raise your webhook rate limit to 500 events per minute for Lumen Freight right away, and I've also passed along the request for delivery failure visibility to our platform team since that's a gap several customers have mentioned. In the meantime, our webhook logs endpoint can return the last 500 delivery attempts with status codes if you want to poll that as a temporary workaround.

subject: SAML login failing with MFA-enrolled users
body: Since this week, users at Ember Retail who have MFA enabled through our identity provider are unable to complete SAML login - they get redirected back to the login page with no error message after entering their MFA code. Users without MFA log in fine. We're seeing this across multiple departments and it's blocking access for a growing number of our 186 seats.
answer: Thank you for the clear breakdown, this helps us narrow it down quickly. It looks like a recent change to our SAML assertion validation may be rejecting the MFA context claim your IdP is sending, causing the silent redirect loop. We're escalating this internally now and will update you within the next few hours; in the meantime, temporarily disabling MFA enforcement for affected users is the fastest workaround if that's acceptable on your end.

subject: How to handle late-arriving shipment records in pipeline
body: We're running a daily pipeline that aggregates shipment status from three regional connectors, but about 5-8% of records arrive 2-3 days after their event timestamp due to upstream carrier delays. Right now these late records get dropped from the daily aggregation since the window has already closed. Is there a supported way to configure a grace period or late-arrival watermark for our connectors?
answer: Good question, and this is a common pattern for logistics data. You can set a lateness watermark under the connector's advanced settings, which lets records arrive up to a configured window after the event timestamp before they're excluded from aggregation. Given your 2-3 day delay pattern, I'd suggest setting it to 72 hours; happy to walk through the configuration with you if you'd like to hop on a call.

subject: SDK broken

subject: Doppelte Alert-E-Mails bei Eskalationsregeln

subject: Users bypassing MFA after idle timeout - urgent

We'll follow up within the hour with root cause details and next steps; please monitor your admin console for a banner confirming the reset is complete.

subject: Biometric login crashes app when offline

We'll also update the mobile documentation to clarify offline login behavior and notify you once a patched build is available.

subject: 429 rate limit errors spiking on webhook retries

Initial findings suggest a recent limiter update may have set thresholds too conservatively for high-volume accounts; we're rolling back that change now. We'll update you within the hour, and please share your integration ID so we can confirm your account is included in the fix.

subject: How to send push notifications when app is offline
body: I'm integrating push notifications into our mobile app for Apex Academy and want to understand how notifications queue when a device is offline. Right now if a student's device has no connection, the notification seems to get dropped instead of delivered later, and in one test the app crashed on reconnect while processing a backlog of 20+ queued alerts. Is there a recommended pattern or API parameter for offline queuing?
answer: Good question - the Mobile App SDK does support offline queuing via the 'persist_until_delivered' flag on push payloads, which stores notifications server-side for up to 72 hours until the device reconnects. The crash you're seeing on reconnect with a large backlog is a known edge case we're tracking; as a workaround, cap batch delivery to 10 notifications per reconnect cycle. We'll send you a code sample and log the crash for our mobile team to investigate further.

subject: upgraded plan but seats and invoice look wrong

subject: Request: configurable handling for late-arriving pipeline data

subject: Need reliable offline mode for mobile app - blocking rollout
body: I'm integrating the Mobile App SDK for Delta Analytics and our field technicians frequently work in areas with no signal. For missed push notifications, the SDK's offline queue should redeliver on reconnect, but given the crash behavior it may be getting cleared prematurely; we'll investigate that interaction specifically and get back to you with a timeline within 48 hours.

subject: IP allowlist blocking valid users and deactivating accounts

subject: Biometrische Anmeldung stürzt in Mobile App ab

subject: Question about extending retention period for backups
body:
We're currently on the 30-day retention policy for our Storage backups, and our IT audit next month requires us to keep backup snapshots for at least 90 days. Could you walk me through how to change the retention setting for our workspace, or let me know if this requires a plan upgrade?

We have about a dozen backup jobs running weekly and want to make sure historical uploads aren't purged before the audit.
answer:
Thanks for reaching out. Retention period changes for Storage backups can be configured under Storage Settings > Retention Policy, where you can select up to 90 days on your current Starter plan without needing an upgrade. Just note that increasing retention will apply going forward, so any snapshots already purged under the 30-day policy won't be recoverable.

Let us know once you've made the change if you'd like us to confirm it's applied correctly across all your backup jobs before the audit.

subject: IP allowlist not blocking unauthorized ranges - urgent
body:
We configured an IP allowlist in the Admin Console last week to restrict access to our corporate VPN range only, but our audit log shows successful logins from IP addresses outside that range as recently as this morning. answer:

We'll update you within the next hour with findings, and if this is a bug in enforcement we'll escalate to engineering immediately given the scope across your organization.

subject: Audit log missing entries for settings changes
body:
I was reviewing our Admin Console audit log to prepare for our quarterly finance review and noticed that changes made to billing settings on March 3rd and March 5th aren't showing up in the log at all. We rely on this log to track who modified allowlist and permission settings.

Other entries around those dates appear normal, so it seems like specific events are being dropped rather than the whole log being broken. Can you help identify why these two dates have gaps?
answer:
Thank you for the detailed report. Gaps in audit log entries for specific dates usually point to either an indexing delay or an event type that wasn't being captured by our logging pipeline at the time - we'll check both possibilities for March 3rd and 5th on your account. We'll also verify whether the billing settings changes themselves were applied correctly, independent of the log entry.

We'll follow up within one business day with our findings and, if needed, a manual reconstruction of the missing entries from our backend records.

subject: Request to enable MFA enrolment reminders for new users
body:
We're onboarding a few new finance team members this month and want to make sure they're prompted to enrol in MFA right after their first login, rather than being able to skip it indefinitely. Currently it seems optional and a couple of existing users still haven't set it up weeks after joining.

Could you help us configure a mandatory MFA enrolment policy, or at least a reminder that blocks further access until enrolment is complete? We're on the Identity and SSO product and have 16 seats total.
answer:
Thanks for the request - enforcing mandatory MFA enrolment is definitely something we can help configure. Under Identity Settings > Authentication Policies, there's an option to require MFA enrolment within a grace period (for example, 3 or 7 days) after which login is blocked until enrolment is completed. We'll be happy to walk you through enabling this for your workspace.

If you'd like, we can also generate a report showing which of your current users haven't yet enrolled so you can follow up with them directly before enforcement kicks in.

subject: Uploads failing intermittently to Storage
body:
Our team has been seeing upload failures to Storage over the past two days, roughly one in five attempts. The error just says 'upload interrupted, please retry' with no further detail, and it's happening across different file types and sizes, from small config files to larger backup archives.

I checked our quota usage and we're well under our limit (about 40% used), so I don't think it's a capacity issue. Retrying usually works on the second or third attempt but it's slowing down our backup workflow significantly.
answer:
Thanks for the report - intermittent upload interruptions with successful retries often point to a transient connection issue between the client and our storage endpoint rather than a quota problem, which matches what you're seeing at 40% usage. We're pulling logs for your workspace over the past two days to check for patterns tied to specific regions or file sizes.

In the meantime, if you're using our upload client or SDK, please confirm the version you're on, as a recent client update addressed a similar retry-handling issue that may be related.

subject: Dashboards taking 20+ seconds to load
body:
Our team's dashboards have become noticeably slower over the past week, with the main operations dashboard now taking 20 to 30 seconds to fully load, compared to a few seconds before. This is happening consistently for all users, not just one person, and it's affecting how we review daily shipment metrics each morning.

Since this is affecting all users consistently and started without any changes on your side, we suspect this may be related to backend query performance rather than dashboard configuration - we're checking query execution times for your workspace's dashboards now. We'll also look into the export timeout issue separately since that may have a related but distinct cause.

We'll update you with findings within the day, and please let us know if the slowdown is worse at particular times, such as your morning review window.

subject: URGENT - all users being logged out every few minutes
body:
Since this morning, every single user in our workspace is being logged out of the Northwind platform every 3 to 5 minutes, forcing constant re-authentication. This is completely blocking our team from working - we can barely finish a task before getting kicked out again. Only 3 seats but this is stopping all our billing and logistics operations right now.
