We'll provide an update within 30 minutes with either a fix or a mitigation step, and we apologize for the disruption to your operations - this is our top priority until resolved.

subject: Scheduled data pipeline syncs not running since yesterday
body:
Our scheduled sync jobs in Data Pipelines have not run since yesterday at 6pm. We have three connectors set up (Salesforce, our internal booking database, and a travel rates API) that are all supposed to sync every 4 hours, and none of them have triggered in over 18 hours now.

The pipeline dashboard shows the jobs as 'scheduled' but with no run history since the last successful sync yesterday afternoon. This is affecting our booking data accuracy across the team and we need it resolved quickly since reports depend on this data.
answer:
Thank you for flagging this - a complete stop in scheduled runs across all three connectors for over 18 hours indicates a likely issue with the pipeline scheduler itself rather than the individual connectors, and we're escalating this to our data pipelines engineering team now. We're checking whether this is affecting other workspaces as well or isolated to yours.

We'll update you as soon as we have root cause information, and in the meantime you can manually trigger a sync from the pipeline dashboard as a temporary workaround if you need the booking data refreshed sooner.

subject: Repeated upload failures via Storage API - need retention/quota clarity
body:
I'm integrating our document management system with the Storage API and getting frequent upload failures with a 413 status code, even for files well under the documented size limit (around 80MB against a stated 500MB cap). This happens on roughly 1 in 10 upload attempts, inconsistently across different file types.

I'd also like clarification on how retention policy interacts with the API - specifically whether files uploaded via API follow the same 90-day default retention as the web console, since our compliance team needs this documented for our legal workflows. We're building this integration for our whole legal team so want to get it right before rollout.
answer:
Thanks for the detailed report. A 413 error on files well under the 500MB limit suggests the request payload itself may be exceeding a gateway-level limit separate from the storage size cap - could you share a sample request ID or timestamp from a failed attempt so we can trace it in our logs? That will help us confirm whether it's a header/multipart encoding issue on the client side or something on our end.

On retention, yes - files uploaded via the Storage API follow the same retention policy configured for your workspace, currently 90 days by default, and we can point you to our API documentation page that covers this explicitly for your compliance records.

subject: Incorrect invoice after Pro plan upgrade
body: We upgraded from Starter to Pro on March 3rd for our 171 seats, but the invoice generated on March 5th (INV-88213) shows a charge for 171 seats at the old Starter rate plus a separate line item at the Pro rate for the same seats. It looks like we're being double-billed for the transition month. Can someone review and issue a corrected invoice?
answer: Thanks for flagging this, we can see the duplicate line item on INV-88213 and this does look like a billing system bug tied to mid-cycle plan changes. I'm escalating to our billing team to void the incorrect line and reissue a corrected invoice within 2 business days, and I'll confirm here once it's done.

subject: Scheduled sync to retail connector failing intermittently
body: Our nightly sync job (pipeline ID pl-4471) that pulls POS transaction data from our retail connector has failed 4 out of the last 7 runs, always around 2am UTC. The error in the run log just says 'sync timeout after 300s' with no further detail. We're now missing about 3 days of transaction records in our downstream tables and need this resolved before end of week reporting.
answer: Sorry for the disruption this is causing to your reporting cycle. A 300s timeout on pl-4471 usually points to the connector hitting a rate limit or a slow response from the source system, and we're pulling the detailed connector logs now to confirm. We'll backfill the missing 3 days once the root cause is fixed and will update you within a few hours with findings.

subject: Question on upgrading seat count and prorated billing
body: We're planning to add 20 more seats to our current 174-seat Pro plan next month and want to understand how proration works before we commit. Could you point us to documentation covering mid-cycle seat additions, and also confirm whether a refund applies if we later need to reduce seats within the same billing period? Want to loop in our finance team with accurate numbers.
answer: Happy to help you plan this out. Mid-cycle seat additions are prorated based on the number of days remaining in your billing cycle, and I've attached a link to our billing documentation covering the exact calculation. On reductions, refunds for unused seats are issued as account credit rather than cash back, applied at the start of your next billing cycle - let me know if you'd like me to run sample numbers for your finance team.

subject: SSO users landing with wrong role after login
body: Several of our finance team members are being assigned the 'Viewer' role instead of 'Finance Admin' when they log in through our SSO provider, even though their group membership on the identity provider side is correct. This started after we updated our role mapping rules last week. It's not blocking their access entirely, just limiting what they can do in billing reports, so it's an inconvenience rather than urgent.
answer: Thanks for the details. Role mapping mismatches like this are usually caused by an attribute name change on the IdP side not matching the mapping rule exactly, especially after a recent update. Could you send us a screenshot of your current mapping configuration and one affected user's SAML assertion so we can pinpoint the mismatch and get the correct role applied?

subject: Slack alert integration not firing for critical events
body: Since yesterday afternoon our Slack integration has stopped posting alerts for critical incidents even though the same events are still showing up correctly in our connected Salesforce and Jira dashboards. We rely on these Slack pings for on-call escalation and have missed at least two P1-level notifications because of this. Our Okta-based SSO login for the integration settings page still works fine.
answer: This is impacting your on-call escalation so we're treating it as high priority. We've confirmed the Slack webhook connector for your workspace is returning 403 errors starting yesterday, likely due to an expired token, and we're re-authenticating the connection now. We'll notify you as soon as alerts are flowing again and recommend manually checking your Jira/Salesforce dashboards for any missed critical events in the meantime.

subject: Charts fail to load on large dashboards, requesting pagination
body: On dashboards with more than 10,000 rows of data, our bar and line charts either time out or show a blank panel with 'Unable to render chart' after about 15 seconds. This happens consistently for our enrollment tracking dashboard used by 18 staff. Could you add pagination or a data-sampling option for large datasets, since right now we can't view our biggest reports at all?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report, this matches a known limitation with chart rendering on datasets over roughly 8,000 rows. In the short term, applying a date-range filter should let the chart render, and I'll share the exact steps for that. We're logging your request for built-in pagination/sampling with our product team as a feature enhancement and will update this ticket if it gets scheduled.

subject: Shared dashboard showing blank charts for all viewers
body: We shared our Q2 product usage dashboard with the leadership team this morning and every chart is rendering as blank white boxes for anyone who isn't the original owner. I've confirmed the underlying data source still has records by checking the raw table view. This is blocking our leadership review meeting scheduled for 2pm today.
answer: I understand the urgency given your meeting timing, so we're looking into this right away. This pattern usually points to a permissions issue on the shared view not inheriting the data source access correctly, and we're reproducing it on our end now. I'll update you within the hour with either a fix or a workaround you can use to get the charts visible before your meeting.

subject: Locked out of workspace, IP allowlist blocking everyone
body: We just enabled an IP allowlist in the Admin Console settings for our workspace and now every single admin, including myself, is getting 'Access denied - IP not permitted' when trying to log in, even from our office network which we added to the list. All 4 of our seats are affected and we have no way into the admin panel to remove the rule ourselves.
answer: This is being treated as a full outage for your workspace and we're addressing it immediately. Our team can reverse the allowlist setting from our side without needing admin console access - please confirm the exact IP range you intended to add so we can verify it against what was saved, and we'll have access restored within the next few minutes.

subject: Shared dashboard exposing data to unauthorized external users
body: A dashboard we shared internally last week appears to be viewable by an external email domain that should not have access - one of our paralegals noticed a client's contact mentioned seeing our case metrics dashboard. We need this locked down immediately as it may contain confidential client information. The sharing settings show only our internal team listed, so this looks like a permissions bug.
answer: This is a serious concern and we're prioritizing it accordingly. We're immediately restricting external access to the affected dashboard and auditing the sharing configuration to determine how the external domain gained visibility. We'll follow up within the hour with a full access log for that dashboard so you can confirm exactly what was viewed and by whom.

subject: Issue
body: We've been using the sharing permissions feature on our clinical operations dashboards for a few months now to give different hospital departments read-only access to their own metrics. Last week we reorganized our department groups and updated several sharing rules to reflect the new structure, which seemed to save correctly in the settings panel. Since then, exports from any shared dashboard take over 90 seconds and frequently time out with 'Export failed - request timed out', and this is now affecting roughly 273 users across departments who rely on scheduled PDF exports for compliance reporting.
answer: Thank you for the thorough context - this level of export slowdown across your whole organization is a serious issue and we're escalating it as P1. It's possible the recent sharing rule changes increased the permission-check overhead on export generation, and we're pulling performance traces from your workspace now to confirm. We'll follow up shortly with either a fix or a temporary workaround to restore export reliability for your compliance deadlines.

subject: Mobile app crashes immediately on launch
body: We're on Atlas Works' workspace and since yesterday the Northwind mobile app crashes within a second of opening on several staff iPads. It happens on both iOS 17 devices we tested, and clearing the app cache doesn't help. We also need offline mode to keep working once this is fixed, since our field staff often have poor connectivity. Can you advise a workaround or fix?
answer: Thanks for flagging this - a launch crash affecting multiple devices is disruptive and we want to get you unblocked quickly. Could you send us the app version number and device model list, plus a crash log if your device offers to share one after the crash (Settings > Privacy > Analytics on iOS)? In the meantime, try removing and reinstalling the app fresh rather than just clearing cache, as that resolves most launch-crash cases tied to corrupted local storage.

subject: Storage quota nearly exhausted, backups at risk
body: Our Summit Health workspace is at 96% of our storage quota and our nightly backup job failed last night with 'insufficient storage allocation' for the first time. We have 273 seats and rely on the daily backups for compliance retention of 7 years. Can you tell us how to raise the quota or clean up old versions safely, and whether retention settings affect the count?
answer: Thank you for the heads-up - I understand backup continuity is critical for your retention requirements, so I'm treating this as high priority. I'd recommend reviewing your retention policy settings under Storage > Retention, since older backup versions beyond your configured window may still be counted until a cleanup job runs; I can also submit a quota increase request on your behalf if you confirm the target size you need, typically approved within one business day.

subject: Question about rotating API keys without breaking webhooks
body: I'm the finance manager here at Summit Capital and I generate our monthly billing reports through the API. I want to rotate our API key for security hygiene but I'm not sure if our webhook subscriptions are tied to the specific key or to the account. Also, does rotating the key affect our current rate limit tier? Just want to avoid any surprise downtime before I do this.
answer: Good question, and glad you're thinking about key hygiene proactively. Webhook subscriptions are tied to your account, not the individual API key, so rotating the key won't disrupt existing webhook deliveries, and your rate limit tier is also account-level rather than per-key. If you'd like, generate the new key first, update your integration to use it, then revoke the old one so there's zero gap in access.

subject: Notification alerts sending duplicates and routing to wrong team - URGENT
body: This is unacceptable. Since this morning our production alerts through the Notifications API are being sent TWICE to our on-call channel and some are routing to the wrong distribution list entirely. We're a fintech company at Atlas Foods and we depend on these alerts for fraud detection - we've already missed context on two flagged transactions because the team got confused by duplicates. We need this fixed NOW or we will have to reconsider our contract with Northwind.
answer: I understand this is severely impacting your fraud alerting and we're treating it as a P1 incident right now. We're pulling your account's alert routing configuration and delivery logs from this morning to identify why duplicates are firing and why routing rules are misapplied - can you confirm the exact channel or webhook endpoint IDs affected so we isolate the right rule set? We'll follow up with root cause and a fix or mitigation within the hour, and will keep you updated continuously until this is resolved.

subject: Biometric login fails and sometimes crashes the app
body: Our team at Apex Travel has started using Face ID login on the mobile app, but for about half our staff it either shows 'authentication failed' repeatedly or the app crashes right after the biometric prompt. This started after the last app update. Right now people are forced to log in with password every time, which is slow when they're checking bookings on the go, often with weak signal.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report - a crash tied to biometric login right after an update points to something in that release we need to look at closely. Could you let us know which phone models and OS versions are affected among your team, since this may be isolated to certain hardware? As a workaround in the meantime, staff can disable Face ID under Mobile App Settings > Security and continue with password login while we investigate a fix.

subject: Push-Benachrichtigungen verzögert und App stürzt ab
body:
Als Finanzmanager bei Atlas Academy verwalte ich auch unsere Mobile-App-Lizenzen. Seit dem Update letzte Woche kommen Push-Benachrichtigungen für Kursänderungen teilweise erst nach Stunden an, und die App stürzt bei einigen Nutzern beim Öffnen der Benachrichtigungsliste ab. Hier ist der Fehler aus dem Absturzbericht:

Fatal Exception: NSInvalidArgumentException
  at NotificationListViewController.render (line 214)
  at PushHandler.deliver (line 88)
Caused by: null reference in notification payload
App version: 4.2.1, iOS 17.4

Das betrifft mittlerweile über 200 Nutzer bei uns und wir brauchen dringend eine Lösung.
answer: Vielen Dank für den detaillierten Absturzbericht, das hilft uns sehr bei der Analyse. Da dies eine große Zahl Ihrer Nutzer betrifft, stufen wir dies als P1 ein und leiten den Stack Trace direkt an unser Mobile-Engineering-Team weiter, da der Fehler auf ein Problem mit dem Benachrichtigungs-Payload in Version 4.2.1 hinweist. Wir melden uns innerhalb der nächsten Stunden mit einem Zwischenstand oder einem Hotfix-Zeitplan.

subject: Request to enable MFA enrolment for new hires
body: I'm setting up onboarding for two new employees at Blue Legal and I want to require MFA enrolment as part of their first login through our SSO connection. Right now MFA seems optional and a couple of existing users skipped it entirely. Could you point me to how to make MFA enrolment mandatory at the workspace level, and whether that applies retroactively to users who already skipped it?
answer: Happy to help you enforce this. Under Identity and SSO > Security Policies, you can toggle 'Require MFA Enrolment' to mandatory, which will prompt any user without MFA configured to set it up on their next login, including existing users who previously skipped it. New users provisioned through SSO after that point will be required to complete enrolment before accessing the workspace.

subject: URGENT: Storage completely full, uploads failing across the board
body: All uploads at Apex Energy have stopped working as of this morning - every file upload attempt returns 'storage quota exceeded' and our backup jobs for the night failed completely. We're a logistics company and our dispatch team can't attach delivery documents right now, which is blocking active shipments. We need an emergency quota increase or cleanup guidance immediately, this is affecting our entire team of 3 right now.
answer: This is confirmed as a full outage of your upload and backup functionality and we're escalating it immediately as P0. We're processing an emergency temporary quota increase on your account right now to restore uploads within minutes, and will follow up separately with options for a permanent capacity adjustment and cleanup of any stale backup versions once service is restored. We'll confirm here as soon as uploads are working again.

subject: Workspace allowlist settings reverted without warning, users locked out
body: I'm a data analyst at Orion Capital and this morning I noticed our IP allowlist in the Admin Console had reverted to a default configuration, blocking several regional offices from accessing the workspace entirely. The audit log shows no entry for who made this change - it just shows a system timestamp at 03:14 UTC. This is affecting access across our manufacturing sites and we have 252 seats depending on stable access.
answer: Thank you for catching this and providing the exact timestamp - an unexplained allowlist reset affecting multiple sites is serious, so we're escalating this as P1 right away. We're pulling the full audit trail around 03:14 UTC on our end to determine whether this was a configuration sync issue or something else, and in the meantime please add your affected office IP ranges back manually under Admin Console > Access Control so your teams can get back in immediately.

subject: Dashboard PDF export cutting off charts
body: When our team at Summit Academy exports a dashboard to PDF, the larger charts get cut off at the page edge instead of scaling to fit. This happens consistently on our logistics performance dashboard with the multi-line trend chart. We need to share these clean PDFs with external partners weekly, so right now we're stuck taking screenshots instead, which looks unprofessional.
answer: Thanks for the clear description - chart clipping on PDF export is a known layout issue with certain multi-series chart widths, and I've logged this against your account as a P2. As a workaround in the meantime, try switching the dashboard to 'Landscape' export orientation under Export Settings, which fits wider charts better, and I'll follow up once we confirm a permanent fix for the scaling behavior.

subject: Request to rotate SAML signing certificate for SSO
body: Our current SAML signing certificate for the Northwind Identity integration expires on November 14th and we need to rotate it before then. Entity ID is urn:ember-retail:saml-sp and we're using Azure AD as the IdP. Can you walk us through the steps to update the certificate and metadata on your side without breaking active sessions for our 186 users, and confirm if there's a maintenance window we should schedule this in?
answer: Thanks for flagging this ahead of the expiry date. You can upload the new certificate and updated metadata XML directly from the SSO configuration page under Identity Providers, and the change takes effect without forcing a re-login for existing sessions since we support overlapping certificate validation during rotation. We'd still recommend doing this outside business hours as a precaution — let us know your preferred window and we'll have someone monitor the switch with you.

subject: Freigaben für Dashboards anpassen
body: Guten Tag, wir möchten die Freigabeeinstellungen für unsere Budget-Dashboards ändern. Aktuell können alle 22 Nutzer die Finanz-Charts sehen, wir brauchen aber eine Einschränkung auf die Rolle 'Finance' für drei bestimmte Dashboards, insbesondere das 'Quartalsbericht Q3' Dashboard. Gibt es dafür eine Dokumentation oder können Sie uns kurz erklären, wie man rollenbasierte Freigaben einrichtet?
answer: Hallo, vielen Dank für die Anfrage. Rollenbasierte Freigaben lassen sich über die Dashboard-Einstellungen unter 'Sharing' konfigurieren, dort können Sie einzelne Rollen statt der gesamten Organisation auswählen. Wir schicken Ihnen im Anschluss einen Link zu unserer Dokumentation zu Freigabeoptionen und stehen für Rückfragen gerne zur Verfügung.

subject: invoices all showing $0
body: All October invoices show $0 due. Please fix urgently.
answer: We've escalated this immediately as a billing incident since it affects invoice totals. Our billing team is investigating the calculation issue now and we'll update you within the hour with a corrected invoice and root cause.

subject: Confused about upgrade cost and seat count after plan change
body: We upgraded from Pro to a higher tier last week to support more seats, but the invoice we received doesn't match what our account rep quoted us. We were told the upgrade would prorate based on our current 174 seats, but the charge appears to include a flat fee plus what looks like a full month at the new rate. Can someone review the calculation and let us know if a refund adjustment is needed, and also confirm how future seat additions will be billed going forward?
answer: Thanks for the detailed breakdown, that discrepancy sounds like a proration error on our end. We're pulling up your account now to compare the upgrade date against the billing cycle and will confirm whether a credit adjustment is due. In the meantime, seat additions going forward are billed on a prorated basis from the day they're added, and we'll include a clear walkthrough of that in our reply.

subject: App crashes when reconnecting after offline use
body: Our field team uses the mobile app in offline mode while doing site visits, and several of them have reported the app crashing when it tries to sync back up once they're online again. It seems to happen most often after longer offline sessions, roughly 2+ hours, and they lose the notes they entered during that time. This has happened on both iOS and Android devices across our team of 13 users.
answer: Sorry to hear your team is losing work during sync, that's a frustrating experience especially out in the field. Can you send us the app version and device models involved, along with roughly how much data was queued offline when the crash occurred? That will help us reproduce the sync failure and figure out whether it's a timeout or a local storage issue before we push a fix.

subject: RATE LIMIT ERRORS FLOODING OUR API LOGS SINCE THIS MORNING
body: WE ARE GETTING 429 RESPONSES ON ROUGHLY 40% OF OUR API CALLS SINCE 6AM UTC TODAY EVEN THOUGH WE ARE ON THE ENTERPRISE PLAN WITH 3393 SEATS AND SHOULD HAVE MUCH HIGHER LIMITS. OUR WEBHOOK DELIVERY QUEUE IS BACKING UP AND WE HAVE OVER 12000 PENDING EVENTS NOW. THE SDK RETRY LOGIC IS MAKING THINGS WORSE BY HAMMERING THE ENDPOINT. WE NEED THIS LOOKED AT NOW, THIS IS AFFECTING PRODUCTION SYSTEMS ACROSS MULTIPLE SITES.
answer: We understand the urgency and have opened a priority investigation into your account's rate limit tier right now. Initial checks show your account may have been reverted to a lower default limit during a recent config sync, and we're correcting that immediately while also pausing webhook retries on our end to let the queue drain safely. We'll update you within the next 30 minutes with confirmation that limits are restored and the backlog is clearing.

subject: Dashboards taking 30+ seconds to load for our team
body: Several of our dashboards, especially the 'Fleet Utilization Overview' one, have been taking upwards of 30 seconds to load over the past two days. We have 267 seats on this workspace and it's affecting most of the logistics team who check these dashboards multiple times a day. Exporting to PDF from the same dashboard is also timing out with a generic 'export failed' message.
answer: Thanks for the report, that load time is well outside what we'd expect and we're looking into it right away. We've flagged the Fleet Utilization Overview dashboard for a performance trace and want to check if it correlates with a recent data source change or added widgets — can you confirm if anyone modified that dashboard's underlying query in the last few days? We'll also investigate the export timeout separately since that may be a related backend issue.

subject: Session timeouts every 10 minutes are unacceptable
body: This is beyond frustrating. Our SSO sessions are timing out every 10 minutes and I have to re-authenticate with MFA constantly while trying to pull reports. I've lost work THREE times today because the session dropped mid-export. We have 28 seats on this workspace and if this isn't fixed soon we will seriously consider canceling our subscription. I need to know how to extend the session timeout and whether this is a bug or some setting someone changed.
answer: I'm sorry for the disruption this is causing, especially with lost export work — that shouldn't be happening and we want to get it sorted right away. The default session timeout is configurable under Identity settings by a workspace admin, and it sounds like it may have been set to a shorter interval than intended, possibly during a recent security policy update. We're checking your account's current MFA and session config now and will follow up shortly with the setting to adjust so this stops happening today.

subject: Invoice shows more seats than we actually have active
body: Our latest invoice bills us for 275 seats, but when I check the admin panel we only have 259 active users listed. This is a significant overcharge and I need to understand why the numbers don't match before we pay this invoice. Can someone check our account and confirm the correct seat count so we can get this corrected?
answer: Thank you for catching this before payment, we're treating it as a priority since it affects your invoice total. We're pulling your account's seat history now to see if deactivated users are still being counted or if there's a sync delay between the admin panel and billing system, and we'll have a corrected count and, if needed, an updated invoice for you within the day.

subject: Migrating webhook endpoints to new v2 event format
body: We'd like to migrate our webhook subscriptions to the new v2 event payload format ahead of the v1 deprecation. We currently have five active webhook endpoints receiving invoice and order events, and want to confirm the process for switching without missing events during the transition. Also, could you clarify if the rate limits for webhook delivery differ between v1 and v2?
answer: Good timing on getting ahead of the v1 deprecation. You can register new v2 endpoints alongside your existing v1 ones and run both in parallel for a short overlap period, then deregister the v1 endpoints once you've confirmed v2 delivery is stable — this avoids any gap in event delivery. Rate limits are the same across both versions, though v2 batches certain high-frequency events, which should reduce the total webhook calls you receive.

subject: Salesforce sync mapping fields incorrectly
body: We're using the Northwind Integrations module to sync contacts from Salesforce, and since Monday the custom field 'Account_Region__c' is landing in the wrong Northwind field on about 40 records. The connector was last reconfigured on the 12th when we also added Okta SSO for the integrations service account. Can someone check the field mapping on our Salesforce connector (org ID ends in 4KX2)? This is blocking our Jira ticket auto-creation workflow since it depends on the region field.
answer: Thanks for the details. We can see the Salesforce connector for Pioneer Freight was re-authorized on the 12th, and it looks like the field mapping reset to defaults during that reauth rather than keeping your custom mapping. I'm restoring the previous mapping for Account_Region__c now and will run a backfill on the affected records once confirmed. I'll update you within the next few hours with the record count corrected.

subject: Duplicate and missing email digests since last night
body: Starting around 9pm ET last night, our team started getting duplicate daily digest emails - some users got 3 copies of the same digest, others got none at all. This is affecting alerting for our fraud review queue, so people are missing flagged transaction summaries. We've confirmed it's not a client-side filter issue since we checked raw headers and the message IDs are identical across duplicates.
answer: This is a P1 for us and we've already escalated to engineering. We identified a stuck retry job in the digest scheduler that's been re-queuing the same batch, which explains both the duplicates and the drops for users whose batch got skipped in the retry loop. We're pausing the affected scheduler now and will push a corrected digest run within the hour, plus a summary of who was impacted.

subject: digest
body: hi we keep getin duplicate emial digests for the last 2 days, some staff get 2 or 3 copys of the same daily summary and other dont get anythin at all. i checked the alertin settings and nothing changed on our side. can u check whats going on becuase teachers are complaning about missing there class summarys
answer: Thanks for flagging this - sorry for the disruption to your team's daily summaries. We're seeing an issue on our end with the digest job retrying for a subset of accounts, which explains both the duplicates and the missing ones. We're fixing the underlying job now and will confirm once digests are back to a single send per day; in the meantime, duplicates can be safely ignored.

subject: IP-Allowlist blockiert Administratoren nach Update
body: Seit dem gestrigen Update unserer IP-Allowlist im Admin Console können sich zwei unserer Workspace-Administratoren nicht mehr einloggen, obwohl ihre IP-Adressen in der Liste stehen. Im Audit-Log sehen wir mehrere fehlgeschlagene Login-Versuche mit dem Vermerk 'IP not permitted', obwohl die Adresse 91.64.22.10 korrekt eingetragen ist. Zusätzlich wurde einer der Admins offenbar automatisch deaktiviert, was wir so nicht konfiguriert haben. Können Sie prüfen, ob es ein Problem mit der Synchronisierung der Allowlist gibt? Wir brauchen dringend wieder Zugriff für unser Team.
answer: Danke für die genauen Angaben. Wir sehen im Audit-Log tatsächlich eine Verzögerung bei der Synchronisierung der IP-Allowlist-Einträge, die zu den fälschlichen Blockierungen geführt hat. Die automatische Deaktivierung des einen Admin-Accounts scheint eine Folge der wiederholten fehlgeschlagenen Logins zu sein - wir reaktivieren den Account jetzt manuell und stoßen eine erneute Synchronisierung der Allowlist an. Wir melden uns in Kürze mit einer Bestätigung.

subject: Urgent: seat count discrepancy on our latest invoice
body: Our invoice dated the 3rd shows charges for 12 seats, but we only have 7 active users on the Starter plan and have never had more than 8. I've checked our admin console under Users and it confirms 7 seats. We need this corrected and a refund issued for the overcharge before our finance team closes the books this week - can someone escalate this?
answer: I'm sorry for the confusion this has caused, especially with your closing deadline this week. I've pulled up your account and confirmed the seat count discrepancy - it looks like three deactivated users from last month weren't removed from billing before the invoice generated. I'm processing a refund for the 5 extra seats now and will send documentation of the corrected invoice today.

subject: SDK throwing errors after recent update
body: After updating to the latest version of the Northwind API SDK last week, our billing reconciliation script started failing with intermittent 'TokenRefreshError: deprecated grant_type' messages. This only happens on about 1 in 5 runs, and it's slowing down our monthly close process significantly. We're on SDK version 4.2.0, node runtime 18.x. Is this related to the OAuth grant type deprecation mentioned in your changelog?
answer: Yes, this is related - the legacy grant type was deprecated in the 4.2.0 release, and any client still using the old token refresh flow will intermittently hit that error until the auth client is updated. I'd recommend switching to the client_credentials flow shown in our updated SDK docs, which should resolve both the errors and the intermittent slowdowns. Let us know if you hit any issues migrating and we can walk through it together.

subject: need help wtih pagination on large result sets
body: we're pulling inventory data thru the API and when we request more then 500 items using the cursor param it just returns an empty array even tho there are clearly more records left. we tested this on the /v2/inventory endpoint with page_size=500 and the cursor from the previous response, but it stops after the 3rd page everytime regardless of total count. is ther a limit were not aware of or a bug with the cursor expiring to quick?
answer: Thanks for the details - this sounds like the cursor expiration window, which is currently set to 60 seconds by default. If the requests between pages take longer than that (which can happen with page_size=500 depending on processing time), the cursor becomes invalid and returns an empty set instead of an error, which is on us to fix on the response side. As a workaround, try reducing page_size to 200 or requesting pages back-to-back without delay, and we'll follow up once we've corrected the empty-array response behavior.

subject: Need to rotate API keys across our integration - urgent
body: We've been using Northwind's API Platform for a few months now to pull transaction data into our internal analytics warehouse, and everything has been running smoothly with our current setup involving several webhook subscriptions tied to specific API keys per region. Our security team recently completed an audit and flagged that we need to rotate all active API keys as part of a quarterly compliance requirement, which is scheduled to complete by end of this week. The actual problem is that when we generate new keys through the console, the associated webhooks silently stop firing instead of transferring over, and we can't find documentation on how key rotation is supposed to interact with existing webhook subscriptions. We have around 14 webhook endpoints tied to the old keys and need a clear process to rotate without breaking data flow into our warehouse.
answer: Thanks for flagging this ahead of your compliance deadline. Webhook subscriptions are currently tied to the key that created them, so generating a new key without re-registering the webhook under it will indeed cause it to stop firing silently - this is a gap in our documentation that we'll get fixed. For now, the safe rotation order is: create the new key, re-register each webhook endpoint under the new key while the old key is still active, verify events are flowing, then revoke the old key. Given you have 14 endpoints and a tight deadline, I'm happy to hop on a call to walk through this with your team today if useful.

subject: Jira link keeps failing to sync issues
body: We set up the Jira integration under Integrations about two weeks ago to auto-create tickets from flagged Salesforce leads, and it worked fine until this past Monday. Now when a lead is flagged, nothing shows up in Jira - no error message on our end either. Our Okta SSO session for the integration user hasn't changed. Can you check if something broke on the Jira connector side?
answer: Thanks for the report - we're looking into the Jira connector logs for Apex Capital now. Initial check shows the connector's auth token may have expired without triggering a renewal notice, which would explain the silent failure starting Monday. We'll refresh the connection and confirm the flagged-lead-to-Jira flow is working again, and follow up shortly with a root cause.

subject: Mobile app crashing on launch for all users after latest update
body: Since yesterday's app update (version 6.3.1), the Northwind mobile app is crashing immediately on launch for our entire team - over 2,500 users affected. It happens on both iOS and Android before the home screen even loads, right after the splash screen. Push notification taps also cause an instant crash even for users still on the previous version. This is severely disrupting our field operations teams who rely on offline mode for daily route data.
answer: This is a critical issue and we've escalated it to our mobile engineering team immediately given the scale of impact. We've identified a regression in 6.3.1 related to the offline cache initialization that's causing the crash on launch, and a fix is being fast-tracked for release; in the meantime we're pulling 6.3.1 from the app stores to stop further updates. We'll send an update within the next few hours with a timeline for the patched version and guidance for users already on the broken build.

subject: Jira integration link fails after issue key change
body: We use the Jira integration to link Northwind incidents to Jira tickets, and noticed that when a Jira issue key changes (e.g. after a project migration from TRAV-4021 to OPS-118), the link in Northwind still points to the old key and returns a 404 when clicked. This happened for at least 6 tickets in our workspace this week. Not urgent, but wanted to flag it since it makes our audit trail confusing.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. This looks like our Jira link stores the issue key at creation time rather than resolving via the stable issue ID, so renames or project moves break the link. I'm logging this as a bug against the Jira integration and will update you here once we have a fix or workaround, likely a re-sync option for existing links.

subject: Alert routing sending duplicate SMS and email pages to on-call
body: Since yesterday our on-call team has been getting every alert twice, once via email and once via SMS, even though our routing rule only specifies email for the 'Content Review Delayed' alert type. This is causing confusion and alarm fatigue for our 20-person team during a live broadcast window. We need this fixed today as it's affecting our ability to triage incidents quickly.
answer: I understand the urgency, especially during your broadcast window, and I've escalated this to our alerting on-call engineer right now. Initial check shows a possible regression in the routing rule evaluator that's applying a default fallback channel alongside your configured channel. We're investigating live and will post an update within the hour; in the meantime you can temporarily mute the SMS channel at the team level to reduce noise.

subject: IP allowlist change deactivating users unexpectedly
body: We updated our IP allowlist in Admin Console on Tuesday to add our new VPN range (203.0.113.0/24) and remove an old office range. Since then, 9 users have been automatically deactivated even though they're connecting from the new allowed range. The deactivation log just shows 'IP restriction violation' with no further detail. Can you help us understand why the new range isn't being recognized?
answer: Thanks for flagging this with the specific range and user count. This sounds like the allowlist update may not have fully propagated to the deactivation check, which can happen if the CIDR block overlaps with a cached entry from the removed range. Please reactivate the affected users from Admin Console for now, and I'll have our access team verify the propagation issue on our side and confirm once it's resolved.

subject: Need itemized invoices reflecting seat changes
body: We currently have 160 seats on our Pro plan, but over the last two billing cycles we've had seat count changes mid-month due to reorganizing our logistics teams, and our invoices aren't reflecting prorated adjustments clearly. Our finance team needs itemized invoices showing seat additions/removals with dates so we can reconcile against our internal headcount reports. Could you also let us know if there's a way to get a partial refund for seats removed on March 3rd that were still billed for the full month?
answer: Thanks for reaching out about this. We can enable itemized invoicing for your account that breaks down seat changes by date, which should make reconciliation much easier going forward. Regarding the seats removed on March 3rd, I'll review your billing history and follow up with a prorated credit calculation within two business days.

subject: Best way to deactivate users via API without losing audit settings
body: I'm building a script to deactivate users in bulk via the Admin Console API when they leave our firm. I want to confirm that calling the deactivate endpoint doesn't reset their IP allowlist or settings history, since we may need to reactivate someone later in the same month if they return as a contractor. Is there a recommended approach or a soft-deactivate flag I should be using instead?
answer: Good question. Deactivating a user via the API preserves their existing allowlist and settings history, so reactivating them later will restore those exactly as they were. If you want to be extra safe, you can also pass the `retain_settings=true` flag on the deactivate call, though it's the default behavior currently.

subject: Email digests not sending to any users since this morning
body: Our team relies on the daily email digest to catch up on store performance alerts, and none of our 206 users received their digest this morning. We checked spam folders and digest settings, both look normal. This is a big problem since our regional managers use this digest to flag inventory issues before store opening, and today they had nothing. Can someone look into this urgently?
answer: I'm sorry for the disruption this caused ahead of store opening. We're seeing an issue with the digest generation job that appears to have failed silently for all workspaces on the Pro plan this morning, and our team is actively working on a fix. I'll send a follow-up as soon as digests are confirmed working again, and we'll trigger a manual resend of this morning's digest once resolved.

subject: Transform step failing on every sync since last night
body: I'm integrating the Data Pipelines API to sync patient intake records, and since around 11pm last night every run of our transform step fails with 'TransformError: field mapping mismatch on column patient_id_ext'. Nothing changed on our side in the source schema. This is blocking all data updates for our healthcare app, and we have 23 users who depend on this data being current for daily operations. I'll update you within the next hour with either a fix or a workaround to restore your transform runs.

subject: Request: better error surfacing for transform failures
body: Our team has been debugging intermittent transform failures in our media asset pipeline for the past week, and the only information we get is a generic 'transform failed' status with no row-level detail. We'd like to request either a downloadable error log per run or at least a count of failed vs successful records, since right now we have to guess which of our ~40 daily connector runs are silently dropping data.
answer: This is a great request and one we've heard from a few other Pro customers recently. I'm passing this along to our data pipelines product team as a feature request for row-level error detail and per-run failure counts. In the meantime, I can help you set up a temporary diagnostic flag on your account that will email a more verbose log for the next few runs so you have visibility while we work on the broader fix.

subject: scheduled syncs stuck / very slow since tuesday
body:

subject: Okta app SSO broken
body:
I wanted to give some background first: we recently rolled out Okta as our central identity provider across all departments, and set up the Northwind app tile last month alongside our Slack and Salesforce integrations, which have both been working fine. The actual issue is that as of this morning, none of our 28 users can log into Northwind via the Okta app tile anymore. Clicking it just redirects back to an Okta error page saying 'SAML response could not be validated'. This is blocking our entire team from accessing Northwind for daily work, so we need help resolving this quickly.
answer: Thanks for the context, and I'm sorry for the disruption to your whole team this morning. A SAML validation error like this is often caused by a certificate rotation or clock skew between Okta and our SSO service, so I'd like to confirm the timestamp of your last certificate update in the Okta app configuration. I'm escalating this as P1 now and will stay on this ticket with you until access is restored.

subject: Question about pagination and rate limits on /v2/records
body:
We've been using the API Platform to pull inventory records into our internal reporting tool for about six months now, and it's worked well for our manufacturing workflows across a few different warehouses. Recently we added a new integration that syncs stock levels every 15 minutes, and we started noticing some inconsistencies in totals.

After digging in, I think the actual issue is with how we're handling pagination on the /v2/records endpoint. We're using the offset parameter but when new records get inserted between page fetches, we end up skipping or duplicating rows. Is cursor-based pagination available, or planned? Also wondering if this ties into the rate limit changes mentioned in your changelog.
answer:
Thanks for the detailed writeup, this is a common gotcha with offset-based pagination when the underlying dataset is changing between calls. We do support cursor-based pagination on /v2/records via the `after` parameter, which returns a stable cursor token in the response envelope so you avoid the skip/duplicate issue entirely. I'd recommend migrating to that for your sync job since offset pagination is being deprecated in a future SDK release.

I'll send over a short guide with example requests for cursor pagination and note your interest in webhook-based inventory updates as an alternative to polling. Let us know if you hit any snags switching over.

subject: Urgent: storage quota blocking uploads for all retail locations
body:
Since this morning our backup jobs from all 86 store locations have been failing with a 507 Insufficient Storage error when attempting to upload nightly inventory snapshots. This started around 3:40 AM UTC and has affected every location we've checked so far, roughly 40 out of 86.

Our retention policy keeps 90 days of snapshots, and I suspect we've hit our quota because we haven't seen a cleanup job run in a while. We need to either get temporary headroom or clean up old backups, but I don't want to delete anything by accident. Can someone confirm our current usage and help us get uploads flowing again today?
answer:
This is impacting production backups for a large number of your locations, so I'm escalating this to P1 and looking at your account usage right now. I can confirm you're at 100% of your allocated storage quota as of last night's run, which is why new uploads are being rejected with 507 errors.

As an immediate step I'm applying a temporary quota increase to unblock your backup jobs while we sort out retention cleanup together. I'll also pull a breakdown of your oldest snapshots so we can identify safe candidates for deletion under your 90-day policy without touching anything you still need.

subject: Offline mode crashes when syncing after reconnect
body:
We've had several field staff report that the mobile app crashes consistently when they regain connectivity after using offline mode for patient intake at our clinics. The crash happens right as the sync indicator appears, usually within a second or two of reconnecting.

It's affecting our iOS users on version 4.2.1, and we've reproduced it on three different devices. It doesn't seem to affect Android. This is a real problem for our staff since they rely on offline mode heavily during home visits with no signal, and now they're losing entered data when the app crashes before sync completes.
answer:
Thanks for the clear reproduction steps, a crash on reconnect that risks losing entered data is something we want to get in front of quickly. Can you send us the device models and iOS versions for the three devices where you reproduced this, along with the app's crash log if you have Xcode or TestFlight access to pull it? That will help us pinpoint whether this is a sync queue issue specific to 4.2.1.

In the meantime, ask staff to avoid closing the app immediately after reconnecting until the sync spinner fully completes, which should reduce the risk of data loss while we investigate the crash itself.

subject: URGENT - unauthorized access attempts after IP allowlist appears bypassed
body:
We just detected multiple failed and one successful login to our Admin Console from an IP address that is not on our configured allowlist. Our audit log shows a successful admin session starting at 14:22 UTC today from 203.0.113.44, which is not one of our approved office IPs.

I understand the severity here and I'm treating this as a P0 security incident right now. I'm immediately reviewing your allowlist configuration and audit logs to confirm the access path used at 14:22 UTC, and in parallel I'm forcing a session termination on all active admin sessions on your account so that access is cut regardless of the root cause.

I'll follow up within the hour with findings on whether this was an allowlist enforcement gap or a compromised credential, and we'll work with you directly on next steps including password resets and a full audit log export for your security team.

subject: Dashboards taking 20+ seconds to load for our energy usage reports
body:
Our team has noticed that the main energy consumption dashboards we built have gotten progressively slower over the past couple of weeks, now taking upwards of 20 seconds to render the charts. It's the dashboard with six line charts pulling hourly data across our five facility feeds.

We'd like to either optimize this or understand what's driving the slowdown, since we export this dashboard weekly for leadership review and the delay is becoming disruptive. Is there a recommended way to reduce the number of underlying queries or pre-aggregate hourly data so exports are faster?
answer:
Thanks for flagging this, dashboards with multiple time-series charts querying hourly granularity over long ranges can definitely slow down as data volume grows. A quick win would be to switch your six charts to a shared query where possible, since right now each chart is likely issuing its own independent query against the same hourly dataset.

For a longer-term fix, I'd suggest setting up a daily pre-aggregation on your hourly feed so charts read from the summarized table instead of raw data. I can help configure that aggregation job and will also share our documentation on export performance tuning so your weekly leadership export runs faster too.

subject: Deactivated users still showing as active in audit log
body:
I'm integrating with the Admin Console API to sync employee status from our HR system, and I've noticed that when we call the deactivate user endpoint, the response returns success but the audit log entry still lists the user's status as "active" for up to 30 minutes afterward.

This is causing confusion for our compliance team since they rely on the audit log as the source of truth for offboarding verification. We deactivated a user this morning at 9:05 AM and the audit log didn't reflect it as inactive until around 9:34 AM. Is this expected propagation delay, or is something wrong with our webhook subscription for user status changes?
answer:
Good catch, and thanks for the specific timestamps. There is a known propagation window for audit log entries after a deactivation call, typically under a minute, so a 29-minute delay is outside expected behavior and points to something on the webhook or indexing side for your account.

I'm looking into your webhook subscription configuration now to see if status change events are being delayed or dropped before they reach the audit log indexer. I'll update you shortly with what I find, and in the interim your compliance team can trust the deactivation API response itself as the authoritative status change timestamp.

subject: Requesting change to push notification delivery for offline queued events
body:
We'd like to request a change to how push notifications behave when a user's device has been offline and comes back online. Right now, queued push notifications from during the offline window all fire at once when connectivity returns, which is overwhelming drivers using the mobile app for delivery updates.

We'd prefer either a batching behavior that collapses multiple queued notifications into a single summary push, or a configurable cap on how many fire per reconnect event. Could you let us know if this is something we can configure ourselves or if it requires a change on your end?
answer:
This is a reasonable ask and something a few of our logistics customers have run into with the current queued-notification behavior. Right now there isn't a customer-facing setting to batch or cap these on reconnect, it's a fixed behavior in the push delivery pipeline, so this would need to be implemented on our end rather than configured in your account.

I'm logging this as a product change request and will loop in our mobile team to scope a summary-push option for queued notifications. I'll keep you posted on timeline, and in the meantime one workaround is trimming your notification TTL so very old queued pushes expire before delivery instead of piling up.

subject: Users receiving duplicate email alerts for the same event
body:
We've had reports from several school administrators that they're receiving two, sometimes three, identical email alerts for the same notification event, such as a single grade-change alert arriving three times within a minute. This has been happening for about a week and is generating confusion among staff who think something changed multiple times.

We checked our alert rules and don't see duplicate rules configured on our end. Can you help us figure out whether this is happening on the notification delivery side, and how we can get a fix or workaround in place since this is affecting a large portion of our 99 seats?
answer:
Thanks for the report, duplicate alert delivery affecting many of your users is something we want to run down quickly. Can you send us one or two specific alert IDs or timestamps where the triplicate emails occurred? That will let us trace the event through our delivery pipeline and check whether retries are firing due to a delayed delivery acknowledgment rather than an actual rule duplication.

In the meantime, I've confirmed your alert rule configuration only shows single rules per event type as you noted, so this does look like it's on our delivery side. We'll prioritize this investigation given the number of affected staff.

subject: Question on restoring files from backup after accidental deletion
body:
One of our team members accidentally deleted a folder of media assets from Storage yesterday afternoon, around 4 PM. We have backup enabled on this account and I wanted to check the process for restoring that folder from a recent backup point rather than losing the work.

Could you walk us through how to initiate a restore, and let us know how far back our backup retention goes on our current plan? We'd like to restore to the most recent point before the deletion if possible.

Glad you have backups enabled, this should be straightforward to recover. Once I have that, I can walk you through initiating a restore to a new location so you can verify the contents before merging it back into place, rather than restoring directly over the current folder structure. I'll send restore instructions as soon as I confirm the snapshot timestamp.

subject: How to link Jira issues to Northwind Integrations

subject: Need to update IP allowlist for Admin Console access

subject: Biometric login failing on mobile app after update

subject: Seat count discrepancy on our invoice

subject: Question

subject: Storage retention policy and quota nearing limit
body: Our storage usage has climbed to 92% of quota and I need to understand our retention policy before deciding whether to request an increase or clean up old backups. subject: Configuring session timeout for SSO via API
