body: We set up alert routing rules last month so that shipment delay alerts go to our ops list, but for the past three days duplicate alerts have also been landing in our finance team's inbox. I checked the routing rules under Notifications and nothing looks changed on our end. This is causing confusion since finance is now getting delivery alerts meant for warehouse staff.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. This sounds like a bug in how routing rules are evaluated when recipient groups overlap - we've seen a similar duplicate-delivery issue reported this week. Could you send us the rule IDs or a screenshot of your current routing configuration so we can trace exactly where the duplication happens? We'll prioritize a fix once we confirm the root cause.

subject: How to restore files from an earlier backup point
body: I'm integrating our Storage API and need to restore a set of files to their state from October 3rd after a batch upload overwrote several records incorrectly. I can see backup snapshots listed via the API but the documentation doesn't clearly explain the restore endpoint parameters or whether partial restores are supported. Could you point me to the right docs or walk me through the process?
answer: Happy to help you get those files restored. Partial restores are supported - use the /storage/restore endpoint with the snapshot_id from October 3rd and a file_prefix filter to scope it to the affected records, rather than restoring the whole bucket. I'll send over the updated restore guide since our current docs are thin on this; let us know the snapshot_id and we can also run this restore for you directly if preferred.

subject: Users losing dashboard access after permission change
body: I manage support for Blue Academy and yesterday we updated sharing permissions on our enrollment dashboard to add three new staff viewers. Since then, two of our existing editors report they can no longer open the dashboard at all - it just shows a blank loading spinner. Performance otherwise seems fine on other dashboards, and export still works for the users who can access it.
answer: Sorry for the disruption this is causing your editors. This looks like a permissions cache issue that can happen when sharing settings are updated while users have an active session - could you have the affected editors log out fully and back in, and let us know if the dashboard loads? If it persists, please share their usernames so we can check the permission records directly on our end.

subject: Duplicate email digests being sent every morning
body: As the workspace admin for Vertex Capital, I've noticed our team has been receiving two copies of the daily email digest every morning since Monday, both with identical content and timestamps a few minutes apart. I checked Notification settings and we only have one digest schedule configured. Is this a known issue, and is there documentation on how digest scheduling works under the hood?
answer: Thanks for reporting this - duplicate digests from a single schedule usually points to a delivery retry issue on our side rather than a misconfiguration in your account. We're checking the notification queue logs for your workspace now. In the meantime I'll share our digest scheduling documentation, and we'll confirm once we've identified why the second copy is going out.

subject: Mobile app crashes immediately on launch after update
body: We're integrating the Northwind mobile SDK into our field app for North Retail and since updating to the latest app version this morning, the app crashes within a second of opening on all our test devices, both iOS and Android. This is blocking our field technicians from logging in or receiving push notifications, and offline mode users can't sync at all. We need this escalated urgently since our whole team is affected starting today.
answer: I understand this is completely blocking your field team and we're treating it as urgent. Could you send us the crash logs or stack traces from one iOS and one Android device, along with the app and SDK version numbers? We're escalating this internally right now and will keep you updated as we investigate; if this is confirmed as a regression in the latest release we'll issue guidance on rolling back in parallel.

subject: SCIM provisioning failing for new legal team hires
body: I'm a finance manager at Orion Foods and we rely on SCIM provisioning through our identity provider to automatically create accounts for new hires. Since Tuesday, new users created in our IdP are not appearing in Northwind at all, and existing users' role updates via SCIM are also not syncing, meaning several new legal staff can't log in and MFA setup can't even start for them. This is affecting onboarding across the whole firm.
answer: This is a serious issue and we're escalating it immediately given the impact on onboarding and MFA setup. Could you confirm the exact error your IdP is returning on the SCIM push attempts, and the timestamp of the last successful sync? We're checking our SCIM endpoint logs for your tenant now and will update you as soon as we identify whether this is a provisioning service issue on our end.

subject: Need higher rate limits for our integration
body: I'm the IT administrator at Blue Systems and our API integration has been hitting 429 rate limit errors during peak booking hours, roughly between 9am and 11am daily, affecting our webhook delivery reliability as retries pile up. Our current usage is running close to the documented limit for our plan. Could you let us know if a rate limit increase is possible, and if there's a recommended approach for handling webhook retries during throttling?
answer: Thanks for the detailed context - this is a common pattern we see with booking traffic spikes. We can review your account's current limits and discuss a possible increase; could you share your typical peak requests-per-minute so we can size this correctly? In the meantime, I'd recommend implementing exponential backoff on webhook retries to reduce pileup during the 9-11am window, and I'll send over our guide on handling 429 responses gracefully.

subject: Fehler beim Upgrade des Abrechnungsplans
body: Ich bin Entwickler bei Granite Legal und versuche seit heute Morgen, unseren Plan über die Billing-API von Pro auf die nächste Stufe upzugraden, aber jeder Versuch schlägt mit dem Fehler 'plan_transition_not_allowed' fehl, obwohl laut Dokumentation ein Upgrade jederzeit möglich sein sollte. Das betrifft unsere gesamte Rechtsabteilung mit 243 Sitzen, da wir dringend zusätzliche Nutzer freischalten müssen. Bitte um dringende Klärung, da dies unsere Zahlungsdaten und Compliance-Fristen betrifft.
answer: Vielen Dank für die Meldung, wir verstehen die Dringlichkeit angesichts Ihrer Compliance-Frist. Der Fehler 'plan_transition_not_allowed' deutet meist auf eine ausstehende Zahlungsprüfung oder eine Diskrepanz bei den Vertragsdaten hin, die einen automatischen Upgrade blockiert. Wir prüfen jetzt Ihr Konto und melden uns innerhalb der nächsten Stunden mit einer Lösung oder führen das Upgrade manuell für Sie durch.

subject: SDK throwing deprecation errors on webhook verification
body:
We're integrating the Northwind API Platform SDK (v4.2.1) into our logistics system and started seeing errors when verifying incoming webhook signatures after updating dependencies last week. Here's the relevant log:

[ERROR] 2024-05-14T09:12:33Z WebhookVerifier: signature mismatch
  at verifySignature (webhook.js:88)
  at processIncoming (handler.js:41)
DeprecationWarning: 'legacySignatureMode' will be removed in v5.0.0
  at SDK.init (index.js:15)
Exit code: 1

Is this related to the deprecation warning, and is there a migration guide for the new signature verification method?
answer: Thanks for including the log - yes, this is directly related to the legacySignatureMode deprecation; the signature mismatch happens because the new default verification method expects a different header format. We have a migration guide for moving to the updated signature verification scheme in v4.x before v5.0.0 removes the legacy mode entirely, and I'll send that over along with a sample payload so you can validate against your current implementation.

subject: Request to add audit log export for workspace settings changes
body:
I manage billing and access reviews for Willow Health and I'd like to request an easier way to export the audit log tied to workspace settings changes. Right now I can see entries like "Allowlist updated by admin@willowhealth" in the Admin Console but there's no CSV or PDF export option, only the on-screen table. We have 21 seats and I need this for our quarterly travel expense compliance review.

Could this be added as a feature, or is there a workaround I'm missing? Also, when a seat is deactivated, does that show up in the same audit log or a separate deactivation report?
answer:
Thanks for the detailed request. Currently the audit log view in Admin Console doesn't have a native export button, but I can generate a CSV export on our end for a specific date range if that helps with your quarterly review in the meantime. Deactivation events do appear in the same audit log stream, filtered under the "Access" event type, so you won't need a separate report.

I've logged your feature request for a self-serve export option with our product team and will update this ticket if it gets scheduled for a release.

subject: Shared dashboards showing wrong data to viewer role
body:
We shared three dashboards with our clinical operations group yesterday afternoon (around 2pm) using the "Share with team" option in Dashboards, but two of the viewers are reporting that charts are showing blank or stale data from last week instead of the live feed. When I open the same dashboard as an editor, the charts render correctly with today's numbers.

This is affecting around 15 people across our healthcare team who rely on these for shift handovers. Can you confirm if this is a permissions caching issue on the viewer role?
answer:
Thank you for flagging this - a stale cache on shared dashboard views for viewer-role users matches a known issue we're actively investigating. As a quick workaround, ask affected viewers to hard-refresh the dashboard page or reopen it via the share link rather than a bookmarked tab, which should pull the live data.

We're treating this as an incident on our side and I'll update you here as soon as we have a permanent fix or confirmation the caching layer has been corrected.

subject: Retention policy question and a backup upload bug
body:
I'm reviewing our storage retention settings for Apex Robotics and noticed our policy is set to retain files for 7 years, but I can't find documentation on whether that applies to backup snapshots or only primary uploads. Given healthcare compliance needs, I want to confirm backups follow the same retention window.

Separately, while testing a manual backup upload yesterday, I got an error "Upload failed: quota exceeded" even though our storage dashboard shows we're at 61% of quota. Can you clarify the retention scope and take a look at why the quota check seems to be misreporting?
answer:
Good questions. Backup snapshots do inherit the same retention policy as primary uploads unless a separate backup-specific rule is configured, so your 7-year window should already cover them - I'll send documentation clarifying this for future reference.

On the upload error, that sounds like a bug where the quota check is evaluating against a stale usage figure rather than your current 61%. I've filed this with our storage team for investigation and will follow up once we identify the root cause.

subject: Plan upgrade billed but seats not applied - URGENT
body:
We upgraded Orion Foods from our previous tier to Pro yesterday morning and were charged immediately on invoice INV-88213 for 122 seats, but this morning half our legal team can't log in and are getting "seat limit reached" errors. The Billing page still shows our old plan seat count of 75, not the 122 we paid for.

This is blocking active work for dozens of attorneys who need document access today. We need this seat allocation fixed or a refund processed immediately since we're paying for capacity we don't have.
answer:
I'm sorry for the disruption - this is a priority issue and I'm escalating it right now. It looks like the upgrade payment processed but the seat provisioning step didn't sync correctly, which is why the console still reflects 75 seats despite the invoice reflecting 122.

I'm manually triggering the seat sync on our end now and will confirm within the hour once your team can log in. If it isn't resolved shortly I'll process an immediate refund of the difference while we continue investigating, and I'll keep you updated here as we work through it.

subject: Cannot update allowlist - all admin settings pages blank
body:
Since this morning our Admin Console workspace settings pages are loading completely blank for every admin on our team at Atlas Media. We need to add two new IP ranges to the allowlist before our analysts can log in from a new office network today, but clicking into Settings just shows a spinning loader that never resolves.

We've tried three different browsers and cleared cache, same result. This is blocking onboarding for new hires who start this week and can't get in. Please advise urgently as this affects our entire 25-seat workspace.
answer:
Thank you for reporting this right away - I understand this is blocking access for your whole team and I'm treating it as high priority. We're seeing an issue on our end where workspace settings pages are failing to load for a subset of accounts created under certain plan configurations, and your workspace matches that pattern.

Our engineering team is actively working on a fix; in the meantime I can manually add the two IP ranges to your allowlist if you send them over, so your new hires aren't blocked while we resolve the underlying settings page issue.

subject: Okta app integration broken after SSO metadata update
body:
We updated our Okta SAML metadata for the Northwind app two days ago and since then none of our 268 users can complete login through the Okta tile - they get redirected back to Okta with a generic "sign-in failed" message instead of landing in our workspace. This is blocking our entire retail team from accessing dashboards and integrations this morning.

We also use the same Okta setup to provision access for our Slack and Jira connectors, so those are affected too. Can someone check if the metadata change broke the assertion mapping on your side?
answer:
Thanks for the detailed report - a broken login flow for your whole team after a metadata update is something we want to fix immediately. This pattern usually means the certificate or entity ID in the new metadata doesn't match what's registered on our side for your Okta app configuration.

I'm escalating this to our integrations team right now to review the assertion mapping against your latest metadata. Could you confirm the exact time you pushed the update and send us the entity ID from your Okta admin console so we can cross-check it against our stored configuration?

subject: Push notifications not arriving on iOS app
body:
Our field staff at Cobalt Foods use the Northwind mobile app for trip approval alerts, and since Tuesday push notifications have stopped arriving on iOS devices entirely, even though Android users are still getting them fine. Users have confirmed notifications are enabled in both the app settings and their device settings.

We have 262 seats and roughly a third of our team is on iOS, so this is causing delays in approving time-sensitive travel requests. Is there a known issue with the iOS push service or an APNs certificate that may have expired?
answer:
Thank you for the detailed report, and you're right to suspect the APNs certificate - we're aware of an issue affecting iOS push delivery for some workspaces and are checking whether an expired or misconfigured certificate on our side is the cause. I've flagged your account specifically so our mobile team can verify your workspace's push configuration.

In the meantime, users can still see pending approvals by opening the app directly, though I know that's not a full workaround. I'll update you as soon as we have confirmation the certificate has been renewed and notifications are flowing again.

subject: Users stuck in MFA enrollment loop after SSO login
body:
I'm troubleshooting an issue for Apex Foods where a handful of users get sent into an MFA enrollment prompt every single time they log in via SSO, even after successfully completing enrollment. The enrollment screen shows their authenticator was registered, but the next login triggers the same enrollment flow again instead of a normal MFA challenge.

This is happening to about 6 of our 80 users so far, all with the same role/permission group. Others with different permission groups log in normally. Could this be tied to how MFA enrollment state is tracked per permission group?
answer:
Thanks for the clear breakdown - that pattern pointing to a specific permission group is a useful lead. This usually happens when the MFA enrollment record isn't being persisted correctly against the user's session, sometimes due to a provisioning rule tied to that group overriding the enrollment flag on each login.

Could you send us the name of the affected permission group and one or two user identifiers so we can inspect their enrollment records directly? In the meantime, if it's urgent for specific users, we can manually mark their MFA enrollment as complete on our end while we investigate the group-level cause.

subject: Deprecated API key format still referenced in SDK docs
body:
While updating our integration for Pioneer Labs, I noticed the Python SDK examples still reference the old "nw_live_" prefixed API key format, but when I generate a new key from the API Platform dashboard it now uses the new "nwk_" prefix. The SDK's key validation regex seems to reject the new format with "Invalid API key structure" when I try to authenticate.

Is the old format actually deprecated, or is this just outdated documentation? We need to know before rotating keys across our 282-seat environment.
answer:
Good catch, thank you. The "nwk_" prefix is the current format and the "nw_live_" prefix is being phased out, so the SDK's validation regex is out of date rather than the new key format being wrong. We're pushing a fix to the SDK's validation logic and updating the documentation to reflect the current key format.

In the meantime, you can safely rotate to the new "nwk_" keys - authentication against our API endpoints already accepts them correctly, it's only the client-side SDK validation that needs the patch.

subject: Need bulk MFA enrollment API for provisioning pipeline
body:
We're integrating Northwind's Identity and SSO API into our provisioning pipeline for Blue Retail and need a way to enroll users into MFA programmatically as part of automated onboarding, rather than relying on each user completing enrollment manually on first login. We're rolling this out across 1194 seats and manual enrollment isn't feasible at this scale.

Is there an API endpoint to pre-register an MFA method (e.g., push or TOTP) for a user during provisioning, or to enforce enrollment on first login via SSO? This is blocking our security compliance rollout deadline this week and needs an answer urgently.
answer:
Thank you for flagging the urgency - given the compliance deadline I'm escalating this to our identity platform team right now. Currently there isn't a public endpoint to pre-register a TOTP secret directly, but there is a provisioning-time flag you can set via the SCIM user creation call to enforce MFA enrollment on first SSO login, which may unblock your rollout.

I'll get you documentation and a working example for that flag today, and I'm also raising your request for a bulk MFA pre-registration endpoint with our product team given the scale of your deployment.

subject: PDF export cuts off chart labels on Dashboards
body: When I export our monthly cost dashboard to PDF, the x-axis labels on the manufacturing spend chart get truncated and one bar chart is cut off at the right edge. This has been happening since around March 18th on every export I try, regardless of browser (tested Chrome and Edge). The on-screen dashboard looks fine, it's only the PDF output that's broken. I need clean exports for our finance review next week.
answer: Thanks for flagging this, I can reproduce the label truncation on wide charts when exporting to PDF and it looks like a rendering issue with the export engine when a dashboard has more than 3 columns of charts. I've logged this as a bug and will follow up with a workaround (adjusting chart width before export) that should get you a clean PDF for your review, plus an ETA on the permanent fix.

subject: Charts not loading on shared dashboard
body: Three of our production line dashboards are showing blank chart areas instead of the actual data since yesterday afternoon. The dashboard titles and filters load fine, but the chart panels just spin or show 'no data' even though the underlying data source is updating normally. We share these dashboards with floor supervisors so this is holding up their shift reporting.
answer: Sorry for the disruption to your shift reporting. This sounds like it could be a caching or rendering issue on the chart panels specifically - could you confirm whether this happens on all 6 seats or just for certain users, and send me the dashboard names or IDs affected? In the meantime, try a hard refresh (Ctrl+Shift+R) which has resolved similar blank-chart issues for other customers.

subject: Recurring card decline questions and refund process
body: We've had two card failures on our Pro plan invoice this quarter, both resolved after updating the card on file, but I'd like to understand the retry schedule Northwind uses so I can plan around it. Also, our last invoice included a small overcharge for 162 seats when we were actually down to 158 for part of the billing cycle - could you clarify the refund process for seat count adjustments like this?
answer: Good questions. Our system retries a failed card three times over 5 days before flagging the invoice as past due, and you'll get an email notification at each retry. For the seat adjustment, we do prorate refunds when seat counts drop mid-cycle - I'll have our billing team review your last invoice and issue a credit for the difference, which should appear within 3-5 business days.

subject: Getting duplicate email alerts for same event
body: Since Tuesday our team has been receiving 2-3 duplicate email notifications for the same patient data sync alerts. All four of our seats are affected. The alert content and timestamp are identical each time, just sent minutes apart. This is causing confusion about whether there's an actual new issue each time or just a repeat notification, which matters a lot for compliance tracking in healthcare.
answer: Thank you for reporting this, and I understand the concern given the compliance context. We're seeing an issue where the notification retry logic is re-sending alerts that already delivered successfully instead of only retrying failures - I'm escalating this as a bug now. As a temporary measure, could you share one of the duplicate alert IDs from the email headers so we can confirm the exact trigger while we work on a fix?

subject: Question about audit log retention and API access
body: I'm building an integration that needs to pull audit log events for user deactivation and settings changes via the API. Could you point me to documentation on the audit log endpoint, including retention period and whether deactivation events include the actor's role or just user ID? We're on the Starter plan and want to confirm this is available before we build further.
answer: Happy to help point you in the right direction. Audit log API access on the Starter plan includes 30 days of retention, and deactivation events do include the actor's user ID and role in the event payload. I'll send over a link to our audit log API reference documentation, which covers endpoint parameters and event schema in more detail.

subject: API key not working after regeneration
body: I regenerated one of our API keys yesterday through the admin console because we suspected it was exposed in a old script. Since then, our booking sync webhook has been failing with 401 errors, even though I updated the key in our integration config. We use the Northwind SDK for Python if that's relevant. Can you confirm if there's a propagation delay for new keys or if I'm missing a step?
answer: Thanks for the details - regenerated keys should take effect within a minute or two, so a persistent 401 after that window usually means the old key is still cached somewhere in the integration config or the SDK client wasn't reinitialized. Could you confirm which SDK version you're running and whether the webhook config was updated separately from the main API client credentials? That will help us pinpoint whether this is a caching issue on our end or in your setup.

subject: URGENT: IP allowlist blocking legitimate office traffic
body: Our IP allowlist update this morning locked out two of our regional offices from the admin console entirely - they're getting 'access denied' errors when trying to log in, affecting roughly 200 users across those locations. We added the correct CIDR ranges yesterday but it seems the changes didn't propagate or were overwritten. This is blocking critical operations work for our fintech compliance team right now.
answer: This is being treated as high priority given the scale of impact. Can you confirm the exact CIDR ranges you added and the timestamp of the change from your side? We're checking the allowlist propagation logs now on our end to see if the update was applied correctly or reverted, and will have someone actively working this until access is restored for both offices.

subject: SCIM provisioning setup for automated user management
body: We want to move off manual user creation and set up SCIM provisioning so new hires get accounts automatically synced from our HR system. Could you confirm if SCIM is available on our current plan, and if so, point me to setup docs? We also need to know if group-based permission mapping is supported through SCIM or if that still needs manual configuration after provisioning.
answer: SCIM provisioning is available as an add-on for your plan, and I'll get this flagged for our team to reach out about enabling it for your account. Group-based permission mapping is supported through SCIM attribute mapping, though some fine-grained permission tiers may still need manual adjustment after initial sync - our setup guide covers both scenarios and I'll send that over shortly.

subject: Cannot deactivate former employee accounts
body: I'm trying to deactivate three user accounts for employees who left last week, but the deactivation button in the admin console just spins and never completes. These accounts still have active login sessions and I need them locked out immediately for security reasons. I've tried this from two different browsers with the same result.
answer: I understand the urgency here given the security concern with active sessions. As an immediate step, I'm forcing a session termination on our end for the three accounts you can share the user IDs for, which will log them out regardless of the deactivation button issue. We're also investigating why the deactivation action is hanging in the console and will update you as soon as we have a root cause.

subject: Mobile app crashes immediately on opening
body: The Northwind mobile app crashes within a second of opening on my phone, an iPhone 13 running iOS 17.4. It worked fine last week but after the latest app update it just shows the splash screen and closes. I've tried reinstalling twice and restarting the phone, same result both times. Two other people on our team with iPhones report the same crash.
answer: Sorry for the trouble - this matches a crash pattern we're tracking related to the latest iOS release update, affecting a subset of iPhone models on iOS 17.x. We're working on a fix and expect to push an update soon; in the meantime, could you confirm the exact app version shown in the App Store listing so we can verify you're on the affected build?

subject: SSO role mapping not assigning correct permissions after login
body: We rolled out SSO for Granite Academy last week and since then several staff logging in through our IdP are landing in the default viewer role instead of the manager role they should get from their AD group. I checked the group claim being sent and it matches what we configured in the role mapping rules, but Northwind still assigns the wrong role for about 5 of our 16 users. MFA prompts are working fine, this is only the role assignment. Can you check why the mapping rule for group 'GA-Managers' is not applying?
answer: Thanks for the detailed description. This sounds like the group claim name might be mismatched with what our role mapping engine expects, or the mapping rule may be evaluating group names case-sensitively. Could you send us the exact SAML/OIDC claim payload for one affected user (redact any personal data) and a screenshot of the mapping rule for 'GA-Managers'? We'll compare it against the incoming claim and get this corrected, likely just a config fix on our end.

subject: quick one
body:
we keep getting throttled on the /v2/transactions endpoint even though we're well under what i thought was our limit. here's the error we get repeatedly:

HTTP 429 Too Many Requests
{"error":"rate_limit_exceeded","retry_after":30,"limit":600,"window":"60s"}

we're averaging maybe 400 calls/min across our integration but getting 429s starting around 2pm every day. is there a burst limit separate from the sustained one that isnt documented? we need higher limits or clearer docs on how burst throttling works, we have 68 people relying on this for reconciliation reports.
answer: Thanks for flagging this, and sorry for the disruption to your reconciliation workflow. You're right that there's a burst allowance on top of the sustained 600/min limit that isn't clearly called out in the current docs — we cap bursts at 50 requests per 5-second window, which is likely what you're hitting during peak reconciliation runs. We'll update the documentation this week, and in the meantime I can request a temporary burst limit increase for your account while we evaluate a permanent tier change for Atlas Retail.

subject: Salesforce sync dropping records for Contact object
body:
Our Salesforce integration through Northwind has been missing records during sync for the past three sync cycles (Oct 14, 15, and 16). We're seeing roughly 40-60 Contact records per run that exist in Salesforce but never appear in our Northwind dashboard data. The sync status shows 'completed successfully' each time, so nothing is erroring out visibly, it's just silently dropping records.

This is blocking a client reporting deliverable due Friday for our healthcare compliance team. We'd also appreciate clearer documentation on how field-level mapping conflicts are resolved during sync, since we suspect that might be the cause.
answer: This is a priority issue for us given your Friday deadline, so we're escalating it now. The silent record drop with a 'success' status suggests records are failing validation on our side (likely a field mapping conflict) without surfacing an error — we're pulling sync logs for Oct 14-16 to identify which field is causing rejections. We'll follow up within a few hours with findings and a documentation update on field-mapping conflict resolution.

subject: LATE DATA ISSUE
body:
WE'VE BEEN WORKING ON OUR Q4 ENERGY TRADING FORECAST MODEL FOR THE PAST TWO WEEKS AND HAVE BEEN VALIDATING OUR CONNECTOR SETUP ACROSS FIVE DIFFERENT SOURCE SYSTEMS FEEDING INTO THE NORTHWIND PIPELINE. answer: Thanks for the thorough writeup and for confirming you have a workaround in place. Since this is flagged as low urgency, we'll follow up with a root-cause update within the next few business days rather than treating it as an active incident.

subject: Dashboard PDF export fails or produces blank pages
body:
For the last two days, exporting any of our energy consumption dashboards to PDF either times out after about 90 seconds with a generic 'export failed' message, or it completes but produces a PDF with blank pages where the charts should be. This is happening across multiple dashboards, not just one, and it started right after we added a new set of filters to our main operations dashboard on Oct 18.

We need this working today since our energy team submits these PDF reports weekly to regulators, and 285 people across our org rely on this dashboard for that reporting cycle.
answer: We understand the regulatory deadline pressure here and are treating this as high priority. Blank-page exports combined with timeouts often point to a rendering issue with certain chart types when complex filters are applied — we're checking whether the filters added on Oct 18 introduced a chart type or data volume that the PDF renderer can't handle in time. We'll update you within a few hours with either a fix or a workaround (such as exporting dashboards individually) so you can meet today's reporting deadline.

subject: Getting duplicate email alerts for the same billing event
body: I've noticed that for the past week, whenever an invoice is generated, our finance team receives the same notification email twice within about 2 minutes of each other. It's happened for at least 6 invoices so far this month. It's not blocking anything critical, just confusing for the team and cluttering inboxes. Is there a setting we're missing, or is this a known issue with the notification rules for billing events?
answer: Thanks for reporting this — duplicate billing notifications are usually caused by two active alert rules both matching the same invoice event, which can happen if a rule was duplicated during a recent settings update. Could you check your Notifications settings under Billing Alerts to see if there are two similarly named rules active? If you don't see an obvious duplicate, send us the rule names and we'll inspect the trigger configuration on our end.

subject: Requesting fix or option to suppress duplicate notification alerts
body: Our workspace has been getting duplicate alerts for the same events, mostly around storage quota warnings, where the same warning fires twice within a minute or so. We've checked our notification rules and don't see an obvious duplicate configured. Could you look into whether this is a platform-side issue, and if not, could Northwind add an option to suppress repeat alerts within a short window? That would help us avoid this going forward across our 24 seats.
answer: Thanks for the suggestion and for checking your rule configuration first. We'll investigate whether there's a platform-side trigger causing duplicate quota warning alerts on our end, and we'll also log a feature request for a configurable suppression window to prevent repeat notifications within a set timeframe. We'll follow up once we've confirmed the root cause on the alerting side.

subject: Need to restore storage bucket from backup after accidental deletion
body: One of our analysts accidentally deleted a folder containing about 3 months of transaction reconciliation files from our main storage bucket earlier today, around 11:15 AM. We need to restore from the most recent backup snapshot before this happened, ideally from last night's backup around 2 AM. Can someone walk us through the restore process or trigger it directly? This data feeds our compliance reporting for fintech audits and we're on a tight timeline.
answer: We understand the urgency given the compliance reporting dependency, and we're moving on this right away. We can trigger a restore from the 2 AM snapshot from our side, but first please confirm the exact bucket name and folder path so we don't overwrite any files created after the deletion. Once confirmed, the restore typically completes within 30-60 minutes and we'll notify you as soon as the data is available again.

subject: Audit log missing entries for user deactivation events
body: While reviewing our admin console audit log for a security review, we noticed that user deactivation events from Oct 10 through Oct 12 are not appearing in the log at all, even though we confirmed 14 accounts were deactivated during that window via our HR offboarding process. Other events like login and settings changes from the same period show up fine. This is a concern given our compliance requirements around tracking access changes for our 1194 seats.
answer: Thank you for catching this and providing the specific date range — a gap in deactivation event logging is a serious issue for your compliance tracking, so we're escalating this now. We're checking whether the deactivation event type was affected by a logging pipeline issue on Oct 10-12 specifically, since other event types recorded normally in the same window. We'll provide an update within the next few hours, including whether we can backfill the missing entries from our internal records.

subject: Recurring transform failures in Data Pipelines connector jobs
body: We're seeing intermittent transform failures in our retail sales data pipeline, specifically in the aggregation step that runs after the daily connector sync. Over the past two weeks, roughly 1 in 8 runs fails with a generic 'transform step error' and requires manual retry, which is starting to affect our latency SLAs for downstream reporting. We'd like documentation on how the transform retry logic works, and ideally some performance tuning guidance to reduce failure frequency given our data volume at 1258 seats scale.
answer: Thanks for the detailed pattern — a roughly 1-in-8 failure rate on the aggregation transform step suggests a resource contention or timeout issue at your data volume, rather than a data quality problem. We'll pull the transform job logs from the past two weeks to identify whether specific runs correlate with peak load times, and we'll put together documentation on the retry logic along with tuning recommendations (batch size, concurrency settings) tailored to your throughput. We'll follow up with findings and initial tuning suggestions within a couple of business days.

subject: help
body:
We had a bad batch import overwrite about 3,200 production records in our manufacturing database this morning around 9:40am. I need to restore our Storage bucket 'apex-prod-docs' to the snapshot from last night, June 4th, before the import ran. Our whole floor operations team is blocked right now since the reports pull from this data.

Can someone walk me through the restore process or trigger it on your end? We're on a tight window since shift change is in two hours.
answer:
I'm sorry for the disruption this is causing — I've escalated this to our storage on-call engineer given the production impact. To move fast, can you confirm the exact bucket name (apex-prod-docs) and the target restore point timestamp (last night's snapshot)? While we prep that, please pause any further writes to that bucket so we don't complicate the rollback.

We'll start the restore as soon as you confirm the timestamp and will keep you updated every 20 minutes until this is resolved.

subject: Question about API key rotation and scopes
body:
We've been integrating with the Northwind API Platform for our logistics tracking service over the past few weeks, and things have mostly gone smoothly with the webhook subscriptions and rate limit handling. Our team just finished migrating off the deprecated v1 endpoints last week per the notice you sent.

The actual question I have is about API key rotation — we currently have one long-lived key used across 1,194 seats' worth of internal services, and I want to know the recommended way to rotate it without downtime. Do you support issuing a secondary key that overlaps with the old one for a grace period?
answer:
Great question, and yes — we support dual-key rotation. You can generate a new key from the API Platform console, and both the old and new key will remain valid simultaneously for up to 30 days by default, which gives you time to roll it out across services before revoking the original. Just make sure to revoke the old key manually once rotation is confirmed complete, since we don't auto-expire it.

Let me know if you'd like a longer overlap window given your scale — we can extend that on request.

subject: SSO login broken for entire team after role mapping change
body:
At 8:15am today our IT team updated a role mapping rule in the SSO configuration to add a new 'Analyst' group, and since then nobody at Summit Retail can log in — everyone gets 'Access denied: no matching role assignment' immediately after the identity provider redirect. All 23 seats are affected, this is blocking our entire media production pipeline.

We've tried reverting the mapping change but the error persists. This is a full outage for us right now and we need urgent help.
answer: This has been escalated immediately as a full-severity incident. Our identity team is pulling your SSO configuration logs now to identify why the role mapping revert didn't restore access — in the meantime, please avoid making further changes to the mapping rules so we don't complicate the rollback. We'll have someone actively working this within minutes and will update you continuously until login is restored for all users.

subject: Offline mode not syncing after reconnect for field staff
body:
Our field operations staff use the mobile app in warehouse areas with no signal, and normally data queued offline syncs once they're back online. Since the update on Monday, several users report that orders entered offline just disappear after reconnecting — nothing shows up in the dashboard and there's no error message.

This is affecting our whole warehouse team, roughly a dozen people daily, and we're losing order data. Can you confirm if this is a known issue with the latest release?
answer: Thank you for flagging this — data loss on offline sync is a serious issue and we're treating it as high priority. Can you tell us the app version your field staff are on and roughly how many orders you estimate were lost since Monday? We'll check our sync queue logs on our end in parallel and get back to you with findings and a fix timeline as soon as possible.

subject: Question on document retention policy settings
body:
I'm setting up retention rules for our legal case file storage and want to confirm how the policy interacts with legal hold. If I set a 7-year retention period on a folder, but a file inside it is also tagged as a legal hold, does the hold override the retention expiry so the file won't be auto-deleted?

Also, is there a way to get a report of all files nearing their retention expiry date across our storage account, or do I need to check folder by folder?
answer: Good questions. Yes, a legal hold always takes precedence over retention expiry — any file under hold will not be deleted even after the 7-year period lapses, until the hold is explicitly removed. For visibility, we do offer a retention report export under Storage > Reports that lists all files within 30 days of expiry account-wide, so you won't need to check folders individually.

subject: Feature request: retry option after app crash on launch
body:
Occasionally the mobile app crashes right on launch for a few of our team members, usually right after an OS update on their phones. Right now the only option is to force-close and reopen, which sometimes takes two or three tries before it loads properly. It's not blocking work but it's annoying enough that a couple people mentioned it in our team standup.

Would it be possible to add a built-in retry or diagnostic prompt when the app fails to launch, instead of just a blank screen?
answer: Thanks for the suggestion — this is a reasonable usability improvement and I've logged it as a feature request with our mobile team. In the meantime, if you can share the device models and OS versions involved, that would help us see if there's a specific pattern causing the launch failure, separate from the retry UX request.

subject: Dashboard sharing permissions not respecting group settings
body:
We set up a shared dashboard for our manufacturing KPI reports and assigned view-only access to a specific team group, but a few people outside that group can still see and export the underlying chart data. I checked the sharing settings twice and the group permissions look correct on our end.

Can you confirm whether group-level permissions fully restrict export access, or if there's a separate export permission toggle we're missing?
answer: Good catch — export access is actually governed by a separate permission toggle from view access, so it's possible those users have export rights inherited from a broader workspace role even though the dashboard-level group permission is set to view-only. Go to Dashboard Settings > Sharing > Advanced and check the 'Allow Export' toggle for that group; if it's on, turning it off should resolve this without affecting view access.

subject: Getting duplicate email alerts for the same invoice event
body:
Our finance team keeps getting two identical email notifications every time an invoice status changes to 'overdue' — this has been happening for about a week now. We only have 9 seats so it's not a huge volume, but it's confusing people into thinking there are two separate issues per invoice.

Could you help us figure out if this is a duplicate subscription on our notification rules, or a bug on your end? We'd like this fixed since it's starting to clutter inboxes.
answer: Thanks for the details — this is most often caused by having two active notification rules both matching the 'invoice overdue' event, sometimes one at the account level and one at the workspace level. Could you check Notifications > Rules and see if there are two entries referencing invoice status changes? If you find duplicates, disabling one should stop the double alerts; if you only see one rule configured, let us know and we'll dig into the delivery logs on our side.

subject: Pagination returning duplicate records across pages
body:
I'm paginating through the /transactions endpoint using the cursor returned in the 'next_cursor' field, but starting from around page 4 I'm seeing records that already appeared on page 3. This is happening consistently across multiple test runs today, with page size set to 100.

Is there a known issue with cursor stability when records are being written concurrently, or am I missing a parameter to ensure a consistent snapshot across pages?
answer: This is a known edge case — cursor-based pagination can return overlapping records when new transactions are written between page fetches, since the cursor is based on insertion order rather than a fixed snapshot. To get a consistent view, pass the 'snapshot_time' parameter with your first request; this pins the dataset as of that timestamp for all subsequent pages in that pagination sequence. Let us know if you keep seeing duplicates even with snapshot_time set, and we can dig deeper.

subject: How to set up SCIM provisioning for new hires
body:
We're a small finance team and want to automate user provisioning through SCIM instead of manually creating accounts each time someone joins. I've found the SCIM settings page but I'm not sure what base URL and token format Northwind expects, or whether MFA enrollment can be triggered automatically as part of provisioning.

Could you point me to setup documentation or walk me through the initial configuration steps?
answer: Happy to help get this set up. You'll find the SCIM base URL and bearer token generator under Identity Settings > Provisioning > SCIM — the token is a long-lived bearer token you'll paste into your identity provider's SCIM connector config. As for MFA, it isn't auto-triggered during SCIM provisioning itself, but you can enable 'Require MFA enrollment on first login' separately under Security Policies so new users are prompted the first time they sign in.

subject: Frage zur Salesforce-Synchronisierung
body: Guten Tag, wir nutzen die Integrations-Funktion, um unsere Salesforce-Kontakte mit Northwind abzugleichen. Seit letzter Woche dauert der Sync teilweise über 20 Minuten, obwohl nur rund 300 Datensätze aktualisiert werden. Gibt es geplante Verbesserungen bei der Sync-Performance? Außerdem wäre es hilfreich, wenn Änderungen künftig auch als Slack-Benachrichtigung ankommen, ähnlich wie bei unserer Okta-Integration. Über Feedback dazu würden wir uns freuen.
answer: Vielen Dank für die genaue Beschreibung. Wir prüfen die Sync-Laufzeiten für Ihren Account und melden uns mit den Ergebnissen zur Performance. Den Wunsch nach Slack-Benachrichtigungen bei Salesforce-Änderungen haben wir als Feedback an unser Produktteam weitergegeben - sollte es dazu Neuigkeiten geben, informieren wir Sie.

subject: Connector-Authentifizierung schlägt fehl - Pipeline gestoppt
body: Seit heute Morgen um 07:15 Uhr bricht unser Snowflake-Connector mit dem Fehler 'AUTH_TOKEN_EXPIRED (code 401)' ab. Die Pipeline 'billing_reconciliation_eu' läuft seit über drei Stunden nicht mehr, wodurch rund 40 Analysten keine aktuellen Zahlen für das Tagesreporting haben. Wir haben den OAuth-Token bereits neu generiert, das Problem tritt aber weiterhin auf. Bitte prüfen Sie das dringend, da wir regulatorische Meldefristen einhalten müssen.
answer: Wir haben den Vorfall als P1 eingestuft und unser Pipeline-Team sofort informiert. Können Sie uns die Connector-ID von 'billing_reconciliation_eu' sowie einen Zeitstempel des letzten erfolgreichen Laufs nennen? Parallel prüfen wir, ob es ein serverseitiges Problem mit der Token-Erneuerung gibt, und melden uns innerhalb der nächsten 30 Minuten mit einem Zwischenstand.

subject: Deprecated /v2/media-assets endpoint returning errors
body: We just noticed that calls to /v2/media-assets started failing this morning with 'DeprecatedEndpointError: This endpoint will be removed on 2024-09-30'. Our ingestion service, used by around 622 users, depends on this endpoint for asset metadata sync every 15 minutes. We saw the deprecation notice in the changelog back in March but didn't realize the sunset date had moved up. Can you confirm the new rate limits and migration path to /v3/assets so we can update our client before it's fully removed?
answer: Thanks for flagging this - the sunset date was indeed moved up in our last changelog update. The /v3/assets endpoint supports the same payload structure with a higher rate limit of 600 requests/minute per key. We're sending over the migration guide now and can extend a short grace period on /v2 for your account while your team updates the client, just confirm the target date that works for you.

subject: IP allowlist change locked out entire finance team
body: We updated our IP allowlist in Admin Console this morning to add our new VPN range (203.0.113.0/24) and remove the old office range. Since then, over 40 users in the finance team get 'Access Denied - IP not permitted' when logging in, even though their traffic is coming from the new VPN. The audit log shows the change was applied at 09:12 UTC but access is still blocked. This is blocking month-end close, please help urgently.
answer: This has been escalated as P1 and we're looking into it right now. Can you confirm the exact source IP shown in one of the failed login attempts so we can check it against the propagated allowlist rule? In the meantime we can temporarily roll back to the previous allowlist entry to restore access while we investigate the discrepancy.

subject: Okta app integration throwing errors after last update
body: Since yesterday's Okta app update, several of our 47 users can't launch Northwind from the Okta dashboard - clicking the tile gives 'SSO_APP_LAUNCH_FAILED: invalid SAML response'. This started right after we updated the Okta app config to match the new Salesforce connector fields added last week. Only about a third of users are affected, the rest can log in fine. Can you check if the app metadata is out of sync on your side?
answer: Thanks for the details - this looks like it could be caused by a metadata mismatch introduced with the recent connector update. Could you send us the list of affected usernames and a timestamp of one failed attempt? We'll check the SAML assertion logs on our end and get back to you with what's causing the invalid response.

subject: SAML login broken for all users after IdP metadata update
body: I updated our IdP metadata in the SAML config yesterday to rotate the signing certificate, and now none of our 7 users can log in - they get redirected back to the login page with no error message. I checked the ACS URL and entity ID and they match what's in the Northwind admin console. This is blocking our whole team from accessing the platform, can someone take a look today?
answer: This is now marked P1 and we're on it. Could you send over the updated IdP metadata file or at least the new certificate fingerprint? We suspect the cert rotation didn't fully propagate on our side, and we'll verify and push the correct configuration as soon as we receive it.

subject: Unsubscribe link not working - compliance risk
body: Several of our clients have clicked 'unsubscribe' on invoice reminder emails from Northwind Notifications, but they're still receiving the same emails days later. One client flagged this as a potential compliance issue on our end. Can you confirm why unsubscribe requests aren't being honored? subject: Feature request: Okta app auto-provisioning docs

subject: Connector auth failure causing data outage
body: Our team is seeing the connector for our primary data source fail authentication since 06:40 UTC this morning, with the error 'INVALID_CREDENTIALS: refresh token rejected'. This has stopped all downstream syncs for our media analytics pipeline, affecting reports used by 24 users across the company. We've already tried regenerating credentials on our end but the connector still rejects them. Given the outage impact, we need urgent help restoring the connection.

We're checking whether there's a token caching issue on our side causing the rejection, and will update you within the hour.

subject: Duplicate alert emails being sent for same event
body: We're getting duplicate notification emails for the same billing alerts - sometimes 2 or 3 copies of the exact same alert with identical timestamps. This started about a week ago and is confusing our finance team since it looks like separate issues each time. Is there a way to dedupe these on your side, or a setting we're missing? Documentation on alert configuration would also help us troubleshoot further.

In the meantime, we'll send over our alerting configuration documentation, and once we identify the root cause we'll let you know if any settings need adjusting on your end.

subject: Salesforce sync - custom field mapping
body: I'm setting up the Salesforce integration for our sales team at Orion Labs and I can sync standard fields fine, but I need to map our custom field 'Plant_Location__c' to a field in Northwind. The mapping screen only shows standard Salesforce objects like Account and Contact. Is there a way to include custom fields in the sync, or a workaround using the API?
answer: Thanks for the detail on this. Custom field mapping isn't exposed in the UI yet, but you can map custom fields through our Integrations API by specifying the field API name in the sync configuration payload under 'fieldMappings'. I'll send over a sample config for Plant_Location__c and can also flag this as a UI enhancement request on your behalf.

subject: How to export dashboard to PDF
body: I'd like to send our weekly logistics KPI dashboard to a few regional managers who don't have Northwind accounts. Is there a built-in export to PDF option, and if so does it preserve the chart formatting and filters that are currently applied? We have about 6 charts on this particular dashboard.
answer: Yes, you can export any dashboard to PDF by clicking the share icon in the top right corner and selecting 'Export as PDF' - this will preserve your current filter selections and chart layout as shown on screen. For recurring distribution to people outside Northwind, you can also set up a scheduled PDF email export under Dashboard Settings > Scheduled Reports.

subject: Jira integration broken - issues not linking to Salesforce cases
body: Since yesterday around 2pm our Jira-Salesforce link stopped creating linked issues. We use this integration heavily for our education platform support workflow across multiple teams. When a Salesforce case is escalated, it should auto-create a Jira ticket with the case ID in the summary, but now nothing happens and there's no error shown in the activity log either.
answer: This is affecting a core workflow so we're treating it as high priority. Our engineering team is checking the integration service logs now to see why the Salesforce-to-Jira trigger is silently failing - we've seen a similar issue tied to an API token refresh problem on our end. We'll update you within the hour with findings, and in the meantime please hold off on re-triggering the escalations to avoid duplicate Jira tickets once we fix it.

subject: Getting 429 errors across all API keys since this morning
body: Starting around 9:15am today we've been seeing widespread 429 Too Many Requests responses across all three of our production API keys, even though our request volume hasn't changed from previous days. This is impacting our patient scheduling integration and support agents can't pull appointment data right now. Our error logs show rate limit headers indicating we're at the cap even during low-traffic periods.
answer: We're sorry for the disruption - we can see elevated 429s starting around the time you reported and are investigating whether this is a rate limit calculation issue on our side rather than actual traffic from your account. This is now our top priority incident. We'll post updates every 30 minutes and will let you know as soon as we identify root cause or need to temporarily raise your limits as a mitigation.

subject: Duplicate alerts being routed to wrong channel
body: We integrated the Notifications API to route payment failure alerts to our on-call Slack channel, but for the past week we're getting each alert duplicated 2-3 times, and some are also landing in our general email distribution list instead of Slack only. Our routing rule config specifies 'channel: slack-oncall' exclusively. Can you check if there's an issue with the alert routing logic or if our config is wrong?
answer: Thanks for flagging this - duplicate delivery combined with unexpected email fallback suggests your routing rule may be evaluating a secondary condition that's triggering the email channel as well. Could you share your full routing rule JSON so we can check for overlapping conditions? In the meantime we'll also check our delivery service logs for any retry-related duplication on our end.

subject: Requesting change to scheduled sync frequency
body: Our finance team relies on the nightly data pipeline sync from our billing connector to populate cost reports each morning, but we've noticed the sync sometimes runs 2-3 hours later than scheduled, which delays our reporting. Could we change the sync schedule to run twice daily instead of once, and is there a way to get notified if a sync run is delayed beyond a certain threshold?
answer: Thanks for reaching out - we can definitely adjust your pipeline to run twice daily; just let us know your preferred time windows and we'll update the schedule. For delay notifications, you can enable sync health alerts under Data Pipelines > Settings > Monitoring, which will notify your team via email if a run exceeds the expected duration.

subject: Biometric login failing and app crashing after update
body: After updating the Northwind mobile app last week, biometric login (Face ID) fails every time with a generic 'Authentication error' message, and then the app crashes shortly after. This happens consistently on my iPhone across multiple login attempts. I've tried logging in with password instead and that works fine, so it seems isolated to the biometric flow.
answer: Sorry for the trouble this is causing - crashes tied to biometric auth after an update usually point to a session token issue introduced in the new build. Could you send us the crash log from your device (Settings > Privacy > Analytics > Analytics Data) along with your app version and iOS version? In the meantime, password login is a safe workaround until we identify the fix.

subject: Question about webhook rate limits and deprecated fields
body: We're building out webhook subscriptions for order status updates in our robotics workflow and noticed the docs mention a rate limit but don't specify the exact number of webhook deliveries per minute. Also, I noticed the 'legacy_status_code' field is marked deprecated in the changelog but it's still present in our payloads - when is it actually being removed?
answer: Good questions - webhook deliveries are capped at 100 per minute per endpoint, with retries backing off exponentially if that's exceeded. Regarding legacy_status_code, it's still active for backward compatibility but we're planning to remove it in Q3; we'll send a follow-up notice with the exact sunset date before it happens so you have time to migrate to the new 'status_code' field.

subject: Slack alerts not firing for Salesforce case escalations
body: We set up the Slack integration to notify our support channel whenever a Salesforce case gets escalated to high priority, and it worked fine until about three days ago. Now nothing posts to Slack even though the case escalation happens correctly in Salesforce - I checked the integration status page and it shows connected with no errors listed.
answer: Thanks for the details - since the connection status shows healthy but events aren't firing, this points to a possible issue with the escalation trigger condition or an expired webhook token on the Slack side. Can you confirm whether any Salesforce workflow rules or automation related to case escalation were modified recently? We'll also check our integration event logs for your account to see if the trigger is being received at all.

subject: Dashboard sharing permissions not applying correctly
body: I set up a shared dashboard for our regional finance leads with view-only access, but two users who should only have view permissions are able to edit charts and change filters that then affect what everyone else sees. This is happening across at least 3 dashboards I've checked so far. Our workspace has role-based access configured and I didn't manually grant them editor rights.
answer: This does sound like a permissions bug rather than expected behavior, especially since you didn't grant editor access manually. Could you confirm the exact role assigned to those two users under Workspace Settings > Members? We're escalating this to engineering to check if there's an issue with how view-only roles inherit dashboard edit rights, and will update you as soon as we have a fix or workaround.

subject: SSO role mapping assigning wrong permissions after IdP update
body:
After we updated our Azure AD group attributes on Oct 3, several users logging in via SSO are landing with Viewer role instead of Admin. We have 14 affected users so far across the Finance and Ops groups. The role mapping rule references group ID grp-8841 which still matches in Azure AD, but Northwind seems to be caching the old assertion. MFA prompt still triggers correctly, only the role assignment is wrong.

We've already tried forcing a re-sync of the SAML metadata and it didn't help. Can someone check if there's a mapping cache on your end that needs to be cleared for tenant north-energy-prod?
answer:
Thanks for the detailed report. This does look like a stale SAML attribute cache tied to your tenant's role mapping rules rather than an IdP misconfiguration - we've seen this after group attribute changes propagate slower than the assertion cache TTL. I'm flagging this as an incident on our Security and Compliance queue and will have someone purge the mapping cache for north-energy-prod and confirm the 14 affected accounts re-map correctly within the next couple of hours.

In the meantime, if any of those users need Admin access urgently, you can manually override their role from the Identity console as a stopgap while we resolve the root cause.

subject: Fintech connector dropping late-arriving transaction records
body:
Our billing reconciliation pipeline (connector id conn-fx-2201) is supposed to pull transaction events from our payment processor every 5 minutes, but since yesterday around 14:20 UTC we're seeing records with timestamps more than 20 minutes old getting silently dropped instead of being processed in the late-arrival window. We've counted at least 340 missing records in the last run alone.

This is blocking our end-of-day reconciliation for a fintech client and we need this fixed today. Our pipeline dashboard shows the connector status as healthy, but the sync logs show gaps between 14:20 and 16:05 UTC with no error messages.
answer:
I understand the urgency here given the reconciliation deadline - escalating this immediately as a P1 incident. The gap pattern you're describing matches a known issue where the late-arrival watermark window was recently tightened and is discarding events instead of queuing them for the next window; we're pulling the sync logs for conn-fx-2201 right now to confirm the exact record range affected.

We'll have an engineer reprocess the missing window once we confirm the fix, and I'll update you within the hour with a timeline for backfilling the 340+ dropped records.

subject: Unsubscribe link not working in transactional email API
body:
I'm integrating the Notifications API for our academy's enrollment confirmations and testing the unsubscribe flow. When a test recipient clicks the unsubscribe link generated in the footer, it returns a 404 instead of confirming the opt-out. The link format looks like https://notify.northwind.io/unsub/{token} - I checked the docs page for email templates but couldn't find any mention of how the token is generated or expires.

Could you clarify whether the token has a TTL, and point me to documentation covering the unsubscribe endpoint? We only send about 200 emails a month so this isn't urgent, just need it working before we go live.
answer:
Thanks for flagging this - the unsubscribe token does have a 72-hour TTL by default, and a 404 usually means the token had already expired or was generated with an outdated template version. I'll get our docs team to add a clearer section on token generation and expiry to the email templates page since that's clearly missing right now.

Could you send me one example token that returned a 404 along with its generation timestamp? That will help us confirm whether this is expected expiry behavior or a genuine bug on our end.

subject: SDK throwing deprecated endpoint errors after v3.2 upgrade
body:
We upgraded to the northwind-api-sdk v3.2.0 last week and now several of our internal services are throwing 'Endpoint /v1/webhooks/register is deprecated, use /v2/webhooks' errors, but our webhook registration code hasn't changed. This is affecting our retail integration team - roughly 30 webhook subscriptions across 3 environments are failing to re-register on deploy.

We also noticed the rate limit headers returned by the SDK now show different values than before (X-RateLimit-Remaining dropped from 5000 to 1000), which is causing throttling on our nightly sync jobs. Can you confirm if this was an intentional change and share a migration guide for the v2 webhook endpoint?
answer:
Thanks for the detailed report - yes, v3.2.0 did bump the default webhook registration path to v2 and tightened default rate limit tiers, but that should have been backward compatible for existing subscriptions, so the registration failures you're seeing are unexpected. I'm opening this as a P2 bug against the SDK team to check why the 30 subscriptions aren't migrating automatically.

In the meantime, I'll send over the v2 webhook migration guide and a temporary rate limit increase for your account so your nightly syncs aren't throttled while we investigate.

subject: Need to increase storage quota and understand retention settings
body:
I'm a data analyst at Apex Media and we're approaching our storage quota limit on our logistics data buckets - currently at 92% of the allotted quota with backups running nightly. I want to understand how the retention policy interacts with quota: if we shorten retention from 90 days to 30 days, will previously stored backups be purged automatically, or do we need to delete them manually to free up space?

We're a small team (3 seats) so I'd also like guidance on the most cost-effective way to request a quota increase versus adjusting retention first. Can someone walk me through the options?
answer:
Thanks for reaching out - shortening retention from 90 to 30 days will trigger automatic purging of backups older than the new window, but that process runs on a nightly job so it can take up to 24 hours to reflect in your quota usage. Given you're at 92%, I'd recommend adjusting retention first and monitoring usage for a day before deciding if you still need a quota increase.

If after that you still need more headroom, I can submit a quota increase request on your account - just let me know the target size and I'll get that processed.

subject: Workspace settings reverting and users getting deactivated unexpectedly
body:
We're seeing a serious issue in the Admin Console: over the past 3 hours, workspace-level settings (specifically session timeout and IP allowlist) have reverted to defaults twice without anyone on our team making changes, and in the second occurrence 47 users got automatically deactivated. This is affecting our manufacturing operations workspace with 3249 seats.

Our compliance team is asking questions since deactivated users lost access to production systems mid-shift. We need to know if this is a sync bug or something tied to a recent admin action, and we need the deactivated users restored immediately.
answer:
This has been escalated to our Security and Compliance team as a P1 issue given the scale of impact and the compliance implications. We're pulling the audit log for your workspace now to trace what triggered both settings reverts and the deactivation of the 47 users - initial signs point to a possible replication issue between config nodes rather than an admin action, but we're confirming that.

We're restoring the 47 deactivated accounts and reapplying your session timeout and IP allowlist settings right now; I'll follow up within the hour with root cause details and confirmation that settings are locked in.

subject: Feature request: better offline mode indicator in mobile app
body:
I support our field teams using the Northwind mobile app on Android tablets, and one common question we get is whether the app is actually working offline or just frozen. When connectivity drops, there's no visible banner or icon showing offline mode is active, so users sometimes force-close the app thinking it crashed, which then causes login issues when they reconnect.

Could you add a persistent offline indicator, and maybe a note in the docs about how offline sync and login retry behave? This isn't blocking anyone today but it would cut down on our support tickets significantly.
answer:
Thanks for the suggestion - this is a great catch and something a few other customers have mentioned too. I'll log this as a feature request for a persistent offline status indicator and will loop in our mobile product team to see if it can be prioritized for an upcoming release.

In the meantime, I'll also put together a short internal doc explaining how offline sync and login retry currently behave so your team has something to reference when field users report the frozen-screen issue.

subject: Mobile app crashing repeatedly in offline mode - blocking approvals
body:
Our finance team relies on the Northwind mobile app to approve expense reports while traveling, often without reliable connectivity. Since yesterday, the app crashes within seconds of opening whenever it's in offline mode - this is happening on both iOS and Android across at least 15 devices we've checked. The crash happens right after the splash screen, before any data loads.

This is severely impacting our legal team's ability to approve time-sensitive expense reports while on client site visits this week. We need this fixed urgently as several approvals are now overdue.
answer:
I'm sorry for the disruption this is causing your approval workflow - I'm escalating this immediately as a P1 given the crash is reproducible across both platforms and multiple devices. Our mobile engineering team is pulling crash logs now to identify what changed in offline mode handling; we suspect a recent local cache update may be involved.

As a temporary workaround, please have affected users try clearing the app's local cache under Settings > Storage before reopening, which has resolved similar offline crash reports in the past. I'll update you as soon as we have a fix or a firmer timeline, and will prioritize this given the business impact on your team.

subject: MFA enrolment stuck for newly provisioned users
body:
We're rolling out SSO with mandatory MFA enrolment for new hires, and over the past week we've noticed that 8 newly provisioned users get stuck on the MFA enrolment screen - it loads but the QR code never renders, and the backup code option is greyed out. This is happening consistently across different browsers.

This isn't blocking existing users, just new provisioning, so not urgent, but it's creating friction for our onboarding team. Could you take a look at whether this is a provisioning timing issue or something on the MFA enrolment flow itself?
answer:
Thanks for the feedback - this sounds like a provisioning race condition where the MFA enrolment session is starting before the user's identity record is fully propagated, which would explain why only newly created accounts are affected. I'll get our identity team to review the enrolment flow timing and check the 8 affected accounts to confirm.

Since this isn't blocking existing users, I'll track it as a P3 improvement, but I'll let you know as soon as we have a fix or a workaround for onboarding in the meantime.

subject: Dashboards extremely slow to load, blocking daily reporting
body:
Since this morning our energy operations dashboards are taking 30-45 seconds to load, and some widgets time out entirely with a generic 'unable to load chart data' message. This is affecting all 25 of our users and it's blocking our daily freight reporting cycle which usually needs to be done by 9am.

We haven't changed any dashboard configurations recently. The issue seems worse on dashboards with export widgets or multiple charts - simpler single-chart dashboards still load reasonably fast. Can someone investigate urgently as this is blocking our team's morning reporting?
answer:
Thanks for flagging this - given it's affecting your whole team and blocking a time-sensitive reporting cycle, I'm escalating this as a P1 incident right now. The pattern you described, with export-heavy and multi-chart dashboards timing out while simple ones still load, points to a possible bottleneck in our chart data aggregation service, and we're checking load and query times on our end immediately.

I'll update you as soon as we identify the cause, and if this isn't resolved shortly I'll arrange a temporary workaround so your team can get today's reporting out on time.

subject: Increasing rate limits for API Platform - SDK deprecation question
body: I'm the PM overseeing our integration with the API Platform at Atlas Legal. We're currently hitting the 600 req/min cap on the /transactions endpoint during month-end batch reconciliation, and I noticed the v2 SDK changelog mentions rate limit headers changing in the next release. Can you confirm the new limits for Pro tier and whether the old X-RateLimit-* headers will still work after the SDK v3 migration? We're planning our Q3 roadmap around this.
answer: Thanks for reaching out and for flagging the SDK changelog details. On Pro tier the current default is 600 req/min per API key, and this isn't changing with v3 - what is changing is that we're adding a new X-RateLimit-Reset-Ms header alongside the existing headers for finer-grained backoff timing; the old headers remain supported through at least the next two major versions. I'll also log a feature request on your behalf for a higher-throughput tier for batch jobs like reconciliation, since that's come up from a few Pro customers recently.

subject: SAML LOGIN BROKEN FOR NEW HIRES - NEED PROVISIONING HELP
body: WE JUST ONBOARDED 12 NEW EMPLOYEES AT WILLOW MEDIA AND NONE OF THEM CAN LOG IN VIA SAML SSO. THEY GET REDIRECTED BACK TO THE IDP LOGIN PAGE IN A LOOP. I CHECKED OUR IDP CONFIG AND THE ACS URL MATCHES WHAT'S IN THE NORTHWIND ADMIN CONSOLE. EXISTING USERS CAN STILL LOG IN FINE. IS THERE A PROVISIONING STEP I'M MISSING FOR NEW SAML USERS OR A PERMISSION GROUP THEY NEED TO BE ADDED TO FIRST?
answer: Thanks for the details - this is usually caused by new users not being pre-provisioned in the Identity console before their first SAML login, since Willow Media has just-in-time provisioning disabled. Could you check under Identity and SSO > User Provisioning whether these 12 accounts exist yet? If not, you can either enable JIT provisioning for your SAML app or bulk-import the users via CSV so the redirect loop resolves on next login attempt. Let us know which approach you'd like and we can walk through it together.

subject: Hitting API rate limits during nightly sync - need guidance and webhook fix
body: Our nightly data sync job started failing three nights ago with 429 responses from the API Platform, specifically on the /inventory/bulk endpoint. We're on the Starter plan with 16 seats and I believe our limit is 60 req/min, but our job never exceeded that based on our internal logging. I also noticed our webhook retries seem to be counting against the same limit, which may be compounding the issue. Can someone confirm whether webhook delivery attempts consume the same rate limit bucket as our outbound API calls? We need a workaround soon since this sync feeds our production reporting, and I'd also like to understand the deprecation timeline for the older bulk endpoint since the docs mention a v2 replacement.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report - you're right that webhook retry attempts currently share the same rate limit bucket as outbound calls, which is likely why you're seeing 429s below your expected threshold. As an immediate workaround, I'd recommend reducing your webhook retry backoff multiplier in the dashboard settings to cut down duplicate attempts while we investigate your specific account logs from the last three nights.
