On the deprecation question, the v1 bulk endpoint is slated for sunset in about four months with the v2 endpoint offering separate rate limit pools, and I'll escalate the shared-bucket issue to engineering since it's impacting your production reporting.

subject: Workspace settings reverted after audit log export - allowlist entries missing
body: I exported our audit log yesterday for a compliance review, and shortly after, I noticed our IP allowlist in Admin Console had reverted to only 2 entries instead of the 9 we had configured last month. Several team members lost access to the dashboard from our office network as a result. We're on Blue Energy's workspace with 250 seats and this is affecting multiple departments right now. I also can't tell from the audit log whether this was a manual change or a system rollback - the log entries around that timestamp are sparse. Can you help us restore the allowlist and explain what happened?
answer: This does sound concerning and I want to get your team's access restored quickly. Could you send me the exact timestamp of your audit log export along with the workspace ID so I can pull the backend change history and determine whether this was triggered by the export process itself or an unrelated config sync? In the meantime, I can manually restore your previous 9 allowlist entries if you confirm the IP ranges for me, or if you still have them documented from last month's setup, that would speed things up.

subject: Need to restore deleted files from backup - Storage
body: We accidentally deleted a folder of Q2 expense documents from Storage last Thursday, October 3rd, and need to restore them from backup. I checked the retention settings and it looks like we have a 30-day backup window on the Starter plan, so I'm hoping this is still recoverable. The folder was named 'Q2_Expense_Reports' and contained roughly 40 files. Could you walk me through the restore process, or is this something support needs to trigger manually on your end? We're a small finance team at Apex Capital and don't have anyone with deep technical experience with the storage console.
answer: Good news - since this happened last Thursday, you're well within the 30-day retention window, so the folder should be recoverable. I'll trigger a manual restore of 'Q2_Expense_Reports' from our backend snapshot on our end, since the self-service restore option in the Storage console is currently limited to Pro and above; you should see the files reappear in your account within the next hour. I'll follow up once it's complete and let you know if any file names changed during the process.

subject: Slack alerts from Integrations completely stopped - urgent
body: Our Slack alerts through the Integrations product stopped firing entirely as of this morning around 8am. We rely on these for our data pipeline failure notifications and haven't received a single alert in over 4 hours despite at least 3 pipeline errors we confirmed manually in the dashboard logs. Our whole 8-person team at Ember Health depends on these for daily monitoring. I checked the Slack app permissions and the integration still shows as 'Connected' in our settings, and I haven't made any changes to our Okta or Slack configuration recently. This is blocking our ability to catch data issues in real time.
answer: I'm sorry for the disruption this is causing, especially with pipeline failures going undetected. This has been reported by a couple of other customers in the last hour, and we've identified a delivery issue on our Slack webhook relay that's currently under active investigation by our engineering team. I'll keep this ticket open as high priority and update you as soon as we have a fix deployed or a workaround - in the meantime, you can check the Integrations activity log for a record of missed alerts so nothing falls through the cracks.

subject: Duplicate unsubscribe requests not being honored - Notifications API
body: I'm integrating the Notifications API for our alerting system and noticed that when a user unsubscribes via the API endpoint /notifications/unsubscribe, they sometimes still receive duplicate emails within the next batch send. I tested this with three test accounts on October 5th and 6th - all three unsubscribed successfully per the 200 response, but two of them received another email 20 minutes later. This is a problem for us at Ember Analytics since we need to guarantee compliance with unsubscribe requests immediately. Is there a delay in propagation, or could this be a caching issue on your end?
answer: Thanks for the specific test details - this helps a lot. There is currently a known propagation delay of up to 30 minutes between the unsubscribe API call and when it takes effect across our batch send queue, caused by a caching layer that only refreshes on that interval. I'm escalating this internally since a 20-minute gap causing duplicate sends is a real compliance concern, and I'll follow up with a timeline for reducing that propagation window or adding an immediate cache-bust option for unsubscribe events.

subject: Alert routing sending duplicate notifications to wrong teams
body: Since yesterday, our Notifications alert routing has been sending the same billing threshold alerts to both our finance team AND our legal team distribution list, when they should only go to finance. I've checked the routing rules in the dashboard and legal isn't listed as a recipient for that alert type, yet they've received 6 duplicate emails since 9am today according to our legal team lead. This is causing confusion internally at Ember Travel and I'm worried other alert types might be misrouted too. Can you check if there's a bug in the routing logic or if something changed on your end recently?
answer: Thank you for flagging this with specifics - a routing bug affecting alert delivery is something we take seriously. We pushed a configuration change to the Notifications routing engine two days ago, and I suspect this introduced a fallback rule that's incorrectly cc'ing a parent distribution group; I'm escalating this to engineering now to check your account's routing rules directly. I'll update you within the next few hours with either a fix or a manual workaround to stop the legal team from receiving these alerts in the meantime.

subject: Invoice shows wrong seat count and missing feature charges
body: I'm reviewing our latest invoice for Atlas Labs dated October 1st and it lists 23 seats billed, but we're actually only provisioned for 18 active users this cycle - we offboarded 5 people in September. The invoice also seems to be missing the line item for the API overage add-on we enabled back in August, which was on our previous two invoices. This is urgent since our finance team needs to close the books by end of week and this discrepancy is holding up approval. Can someone review our billing account and issue a corrected invoice or credit memo?
answer: I understand the urgency given your close-of-books deadline, and I'm looking into your account right now. I can confirm the seat count discrepancy - it looks like the offboarding in September wasn't reflected in the billing sync for this cycle, and I'm also seeing the API overage add-on missing from the September summary despite being active. I'm issuing a corrected invoice with both adjustments today and will send it over along with a credit memo for the seat overcharge before your deadline.

subject: Biometric login causing app crashes after latest update
body: Since updating the Mobile App to the latest version yesterday, several of our employees at Lumen Media report the app crashing immediately after they attempt Face ID or fingerprint login. I've reproduced this myself on an iPhone 14 running iOS 17.4 - the app opens, shows the biometric prompt, and then closes completely without any error message. This is affecting a large portion of our 66 users who rely on biometric login daily for quick access, and several have already submitted feedback complaints through the app store. Is this a known issue with the latest release, and is there a fix in progress or should we tell users to disable biometric login as a workaround?
answer: Thank you for the clear reproduction steps, especially the iOS version detail - this matches an issue our mobile team flagged yesterday related to the biometric authentication module in the latest release. As an immediate workaround, please advise your team to disable biometric login in the app's security settings and use their standard credentials until we ship a hotfix, which we expect within the next 24-48 hours. I'll update this ticket as soon as the fix is live so you can notify your users to re-enable it.

subject: Request to restore Storage bucket from backup snapshot
body: We need to restore our legal-docs-prod bucket from the backup taken on the night of March 3rd. A junior associate accidentally deleted a folder containing 40+ case files around 2pm today before the next scheduled backup ran. Our retention policy keeps 30-day snapshots, so the March 3rd backup should have everything intact. Since this touches client records we need this logged as a formal change with an audit trail for our compliance team, and would like confirmation of who approves and executes the restore on your side.
answer: Thanks for flagging this promptly. I've opened a change request and routed it to our storage operations team for the March 3rd snapshot restore into a staging path first, so you can verify contents before we overwrite production. I'll send the change ticket ID and estimated completion time shortly, along with the audit log reference for your compliance records.

subject: Offline mode for the mobile app
body: Our field auditors often work in areas with poor connectivity and the mobile app becomes unusable when offline, showing a spinner that never resolves. A few of them have also reported the app crashing when they try to open a previously loaded report without a signal. It would help a lot if the app could cache recently viewed reports and queue actions like approvals to sync once connection returns. Not urgent, but it's come up in feedback from three different regional teams now.
answer: Thanks for the detailed feedback, this is a great use case and I've logged it as a feature request with our mobile product team, referencing the caching and action-queueing behavior you described. Offline resilience is on our radar but I don't have a firm timeline yet. In the meantime, I'd recommend having your auditors pre-load reports while on a stable connection before heading into low-signal areas, which should reduce the crash occurrences you're seeing.

subject: Missing credit after seat downgrade
body: We reduced our plan from 20 to 12 seats last month and were told we'd receive a prorated credit on our next invoice, but the invoice dated this week shows the full previous amount with no credit line. We also had a duplicate charge on February 18th for $340 that support said would be refunded, and I don't see that reflected either. Can someone check our account and confirm what's actually owed versus paid?
answer: I'm sorry for the confusion on the invoice. I've pulled up your billing history and can see the seat downgrade credit and the February 18th duplicate charge refund were both approved internally but not applied to the invoice generation correctly. I'm issuing a corrected invoice now and will confirm the exact credit amount within one business day.

subject: Card declined on renewal, worried about suspension
body: Our renewal payment failed yesterday with a 'card declined - insufficient funds' message, which is odd since the same card cleared last month. I've since updated the card on file to a new one, but I want to confirm the retry will happen automatically and that we won't be hit with a late fee or service interruption given we're only 4 seats on Starter. If there was already a late fee applied, we'd like that waived.
answer: Understood, and thanks for updating the card promptly. I've manually triggered a retry on the new card and it processed successfully, so your account is current and there's no risk of suspension. I've also removed the late fee that was applied automatically before your update, you should see that reflected on your next statement.

subject: API for managing dashboard sharing permissions
body: I'm integrating our internal portal with Northwind Dashboards and need to programmatically set sharing permissions when we provision new client workspaces, currently we do this manually through the UI. Is there an endpoint to grant view or edit access to a dashboard for a specific user or group, and does it support setting expiration on shared links? Also wondering if there's a way to export the current sharing settings for audit purposes since we only have 7 seats and need to track this closely.
answer: Good questions. There is a sharing permissions endpoint under the Dashboards API that lets you grant view or edit roles per user or group, and it does support link expiration parameters. There isn't currently a dedicated export for sharing settings, but you can retrieve the current permission list via a GET on the same resource, which should cover your audit need. I'll link you the relevant API docs section and flag the export request to our product team as a nice-to-have.

subject: Backup payment method option for card failures
body: We've had two instances this year where our primary card failed on renewal due to expiration and it took a couple days to notice and fix, which held up a few user provisioning tasks tied to billing status. Is there a way to add a backup payment method that Northwind will automatically fall back to if the primary card fails? Also curious if this would show up cleanly as a separate line on our invoice for our accounting team.
answer: Thanks for the suggestion. We don't yet support automatic fallback to a secondary card, but it's a request we're tracking for the billing roadmap and I've added your account to that interest list. In the meantime, I'd recommend setting a calendar reminder ahead of your card's expiration date, and I'm happy to set up proactive renewal-failure alerts to your finance team's inbox if that helps bridge the gap.

subject: Face ID login crashes mobile app
body: Since updating to the latest app version, biometric login via Face ID crashes the app immediately after the scan completes on iOS. This is happening for me and at least two colleagues on our legal team, all on iPhone 14 and 15 devices. Switching back to password login works fine, but Face ID was the default for most of our 282 users so this is causing a lot of failed login attempts and support pings internally.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report, this sounds like a regression tied to the latest release. I'm escalating this to our mobile engineering team as a priority issue since it affects biometric login broadly, and I'll ask them to confirm whether it's isolated to iOS 17 devices. In the meantime, please advise your team to use password login, and I'll update you as soon as we have a fix or workaround.

subject: keys
body: so we've been using northwind api for about a year now across a few internal tools, mostly for pulling billing and usage data into our finance dashboards, and everything has generally worked fine except for some rate limiting we worked around a while back by batching requests overnight. anyway last week one of our devs got an email saying our v1 api keys are being depreicated soon and we need to rotate to the new key format, but when we tryed generating a new key from the admin panel we get a 403 error that just says 'insufficent permissions' even tho the account is an org owner. we have like 1598 seats so this affects a lot of downstream stuff if the old keys stop workin, can someone tell us the actual steps to rotate keys and also why the 403 is happening
answer: Thanks for the context, and sorry for the trouble with key rotation. The 403 on key generation for an org owner account is unexpected, that usually points to a permissions scope issue on the API management module specifically rather than the account role, so I'd like to check your account's role assignments directly. In the meantime, here are the standard steps for rotating from v1 to the new key format: generate the new key under Settings > API Keys, update your integrations to use it, then revoke the old key once verified. I'll also confirm the exact deprecation date for v1 keys so you can plan the cutover for your downstream tools.

subject: Users locked out during MFA enrolment rollout
body: We rolled out mandatory MFA enrolment today for our 273 users and a large portion of them are stuck at the enrolment screen with an error 'unable to verify device, please try again' after scanning the QR code with their authenticator app. This is blocking access to billing and payroll systems for our finance team specifically, which is time-sensitive since we're mid-month close. Can someone look into whether this is a provisioning issue on our SSO configuration or a broader outage?
answer: This is being treated as an active incident given the impact on your finance team's access. I've checked our SSO provisioning logs and I can see a batch of enrolment requests failing at the device verification step, we're investigating whether this is tied to a recent MFA provider change. I'll keep you updated every 30 minutes until resolved, and in the meantime I can arrange temporary MFA bypass for a limited list of critical finance users if you send me their account identifiers.

subject: DUPLICATE DIGEST EMAILS EVERY MORNING
body: OUR TEAM HAS BEEN GETTING THE SAME DAILY EMAIL DIGEST TWICE EVERY MORNING FOR THE PAST WEEK, ONCE AROUND 6AM AND AGAIN AROUND 6:15AM, BOTH WITH IDENTICAL CONTENT. WE ONLY HAVE 13 SEATS SO THIS IS ANNOYING EVERYONE AND SEVERAL PEOPLE HAVE ASKED ME TO TURN IT OFF ENTIRELY. CAN YOU CHECK OUR DIGEST SETTINGS AND FIX WHATEVER IS CAUSING THE DUPLICATE SEND.
answer: Thanks for reporting this, I can see the duplicate send happening on your account's digest schedule, it looks like two overlapping digest rules were created for the same time window. I'm removing the duplicate rule now so only the 6am send remains, and you should see this resolved starting tomorrow morning. Apologies for the extra noise in the meantime.

subject: MFA enrollment broken for new hires - blocking access
body:
We're rolling out MFA enforcement across Delta Robotics and since this morning about 40 new employees added this week can't complete enrollment. They scan the QR code in the SSO portal, enter the TOTP code, and get "Verification failed - code expired" every time even with fresh codes. Server time on our end is synced via NTP so it's not a clock drift issue on our side.

This is blocking onboarding for our energy operations team starting shift work today. Can someone check if there's an issue with the TOTP validation window on your end? We have 3393 seats total and need this resolved quickly.
answer:
Thanks for flagging this - I can see there's an ongoing issue with our TOTP validation service that started around 06:00 UTC today, affecting a subset of tenants including yours. Our engineering team is already working on it and we believe the validation window got misconfigured during a recent deploy. I'll update this ticket as soon as we have a fix deployed, and I'd recommend holding off on new enrollments until then.

As a temporary workaround, existing enrolled users are not affected, only new enrollments are failing. I'll escalate this to P1 internally and keep you posted every 30 minutes until resolved.

subject: Connector to our SIS keeps failing with auth error
body:
Our nightly sync from the Student Information System connector has been failing since Tuesday. The pipeline log shows "401 Unauthorized - token refresh failed" even though I regenerated the API key in the source system on Monday and updated it in the connector settings. This is affecting our enrollment data pipeline for Pioneer Retail's education reporting.

We run this sync daily at 2am and now have 3 days of missing records, roughly 1200 student records that didn't sync. Can you help figure out why the token refresh is failing after I updated the credentials?
answer:
Sorry for the disruption to your nightly sync - a stale token cache on our connector side is the likely culprit here, since re-entering credentials doesn't always force a full token refresh cycle. I'm going to manually clear the cached credentials for your connector instance and trigger a fresh authentication handshake, which should resolve the 401 errors on the next run.

Once that's done I'll trigger a backfill job to pull in the missing 3 days of records so nothing is lost. I'll confirm here once the connector is validated and the backfill has completed.

subject: Need clarity on upcoming API deprecations before we migrate
body:
We received a notice that the v1 /orders and /inventory endpoints are being deprecated, but the documentation page linked in the email returns a 404. We have several integrations built by our team using v1 that push inventory updates for our retail locations, and we need to plan the migration to v2 before the cutoff.

Could you send us the correct migration guide and confirm the actual sunset date? We also want to know if v2 has different rate limits since we're currently making around 15,000 calls per day against v1.
answer:
Thanks for catching that broken link - the migration guide moved during a docs site restructure and I'll get that fixed right away. The v1 /orders and /inventory endpoints are scheduled for sunset on the date stated in your original notice, and v2 uses the same rate limit tier structure, so your current 15,000 calls/day should map directly without needing a plan change.

I'm attaching the correct migration guide link in this ticket and will also have our docs team verify all other deprecation notice links are working. Given the number of integrations you have on v1, I'd recommend starting migration testing in a sandbox environment as soon as possible - let us know if you'd like a call with an integration engineer to review your specific endpoints.

subject: Customers getting duplicate email alerts for same event
body:
We've noticed our subscribers are receiving the same notification email twice within a few minutes of each other. It started around March 3rd and affects our "new content published" alert template. Users are complaining and a few have already asked to unsubscribe because of it.

I checked our template config and there's only one trigger set up, so it doesn't look like a config issue on our side. Can someone check if the notification queue is retrying and resending successfully-delivered emails?
answer:
Thanks for the detailed report - this matches a pattern we've seen where the delivery confirmation webhook occasionally times out and our system incorrectly assumes the send failed, triggering a retry even though the original email went through. I'm going to check the delivery logs for your "new content published" template specifically to confirm this is what's happening in your case.

In the meantime, I'd suggest not making any changes to your trigger config since it sounds correctly set up on your end. I'll report back within the next day with findings and a timeline for a fix.

subject: PDF export losing chart formatting
body:
When I export a dashboard to PDF, the bar charts render fine but the line charts lose their color coding - everything comes out gray instead of matching the legend colors shown on screen. This happens on all three of our shared dashboards, tested in both Chrome and Firefox.

Is this a known limitation of the PDF export feature, or is there a setting I'm missing? We'd like to share these exports with clients and the current output isn't usable for that purpose.
answer:
Good catch - this is a known limitation with how our PDF renderer handles line chart color mapping when custom legends are used, rather than something you're missing in settings. It's on our roadmap to fix, though I don't have an exact date yet.

As a workaround for now, exporting to PNG from the dashboard view preserves the correct colors, or you could use the "share link" feature which renders the live dashboard rather than a static export. I'll add your case to the feature request so you're notified when the PDF rendering fix ships.

subject: Transform step failing on every pipeline run since yesterday
body:
Since yesterday around 4pm, our data transform step has been failing on every scheduled run. The error we're seeing is:

TransformError: field 'patient_visit_date' expected type DATE, got STRING at row 4521
Pipeline halted after 3 retry attempts
Transform job id: tf-88213-run-0447

We haven't changed our source schema or the transform config recently. This is blocking our daily health data reconciliation for Atlas Health and we're now a full day behind on processing.
answer:
Thank you for including the job ID and error details, that helps a lot. A type mismatch at a specific row usually points to a change in the upstream source data format rather than your transform config - it looks like the source may have started sending an unexpected date format around the time this started. I'm pulling the raw records around row 4521 in job tf-88213-run-0447 now to confirm.

Given the impact to your daily reconciliation, I'm treating this as high priority. I'll report back shortly with the root cause and either a fix on our transform side or guidance on adjusting the source format.

subject: Need refund for duplicate seat charge and clarification on credits
body:
Our latest invoice charged us for 142 seats, but we downgraded to 130 seats on the 12th after offboarding a team - the change never took effect in billing. We were also told in a previous email that we'd receive a credit for the overlap period from a prior billing issue in January, but I don't see that credit reflected anywhere on this invoice either.

Could someone review our account and process the refund for the 12 extra seats plus apply the outstanding January credit? This is time-sensitive since our finance team is closing the books this week.
answer:
I'm sorry for the trouble this is causing with your books closing this week - I've pulled up your account and can confirm the seat count didn't sync after your downgrade request on the 12th, which is on us. I'm processing a refund for the 12 extra seats now and applying the outstanding January credit to your account, both should be reflected within 1-2 business days.

I'll also flag the seat-sync issue to our billing engineering team so it doesn't recur, and I'll send confirmation here once both adjustments post to your account.

subject: Request: offline mode improvements for mobile app
body:
Our field auditors use the Northwind mobile app while visiting client sites with poor connectivity, and right now the app just shows a blank screen with a spinner when offline instead of letting them view previously loaded data. It would help a lot if cached reports and dashboards stayed accessible without a connection.

Also, when connectivity comes back, the app sometimes crashes on resync - I've had it happen twice this week on iOS. Not urgent, but wanted to flag both issues since our team relies on this for on-site work.
answer:
Thanks for the detailed feedback, this is really useful for our mobile team. Full offline caching for reports and dashboards is something we're actively scoping for a future release, and I'll add your use case to that feature request as an example of real-world impact for field teams.

The resync crash on iOS is more concerning - could you send me the iOS version and app build number, along with roughly how long the device was offline before reconnecting? That'll help us reproduce it and get a fix prioritized separately from the offline caching feature work.

subject: Storage retention policy not deleting data past retention period - compliance risk
body:
We discovered that files uploaded to our compliance archive bucket that should have been auto-deleted after their 90-day retention period are still present. We spot-checked files from a batch uploaded in early January and they're still accessible today, well past the retention window configured in our policy settings.

This is a serious compliance issue for Granite Capital given the travel industry data we store - some of this data should have been purged under contractual obligations with our own clients. We need to know the scope of affected files and confirm the retention job is actually running.
answer:
I understand the urgency given the compliance implications here, and I'm escalating this immediately to our storage and security engineering teams. We're pulling logs now to determine whether the retention deletion job has been failing silently and, if so, for how long and across how many buckets or accounts.

I'll provide a preliminary scope of affected files as soon as we have it, likely within a few hours given this is treated as a P1 compliance incident. In the meantime, please don't rely on the retention job to have purged anything until we confirm otherwise - I'll follow up here with findings and next steps.

subject: Employees unable to enroll MFA - login blocked for entire team
body:
Since this morning our operations staff have been unable to complete MFA enrollment through SSO. The setup screen loads, they scan the authenticator QR code, but submitting the code just spins and eventually times out with "Something went wrong, please try again." This is affecting essentially our whole team at Delta Travel, roughly 60 of our 71 seats, and it's blocking access to dispatch and routing tools we rely on daily.

We need this fixed urgently since our logistics operations depend on staff being able to log in this morning.
answer:
I'm sorry for the disruption to your operations this morning - this matches reports we're seeing from a few other customers of an issue with the MFA enrollment service timing out during code verification. Our engineering team is actively investigating and treating it as a priority incident.

For users who already have MFA enrolled, login should be unaffected; the issue is specific to new enrollment attempts. I'll update this ticket as soon as we have a fix deployed or a workaround, and will follow up within the hour with progress.

subject: Salesforce sync failing since last night's push
body: We use the Northwind Integrations connector to push closed-won opportunities into Salesforce, and since around 11pm last night the sync job has been failing. The Jira ticket we filed internally shows the connector last succeeded at 22:47, and every run after that returns a 'mapping error: field Amount__c not found' even though we haven't touched our Salesforce schema. We rely on this for our sales team's daily pipeline review, so this is blocking about 40 opportunities from syncing. Can someone check the connector logs on your side and confirm what changed?
answer: Thanks for flagging this - a mapping error appearing without schema changes on your end usually points to a field rename or permission change on our connector's managed package, so we're pulling the sync logs for your Harbor Energy integration now. We'll confirm within the next hour whether this is a Salesforce API version bump or something on our side, and will push a fix or rollback as needed since this is blocking your pipeline reporting.

subject: Dashboards taking 20+ seconds to load for our team
body: Several of our store managers have reported that the main sales dashboard is extremely slow to load, sometimes taking 20-30 seconds before charts render. This started roughly three days ago and affects the same two dashboards every time - 'Weekly Sales Overview' and 'Inventory Trends'. Exporting either one to CSV also hangs for a long time before completing. We have 9 seats on this workspace and it's slowing down our morning reporting routine.
answer: Sorry for the slowdown - that kind of consistent delay on two specific dashboards usually points to a heavy query or a large dataset behind one of the widgets. We're going to look at the query performance for 'Weekly Sales Overview' and 'Inventory Trends' on the Orion Health workspace and check if there's a slow filter or join causing the export hang as well. We'll follow up shortly with findings and, if needed, a temporary workaround like caching or a lighter view.

subject: Push notifications not arriving on Android after API update
body: I'm integrating the Northwind Mobile SDK for our travel app and since updating to the latest push notification API version, Android devices stop receiving notifications after the app has been in the background for more than a few minutes. iOS devices seem unaffected. I've confirmed our device tokens are registering correctly in the Northwind console. Is there a known issue with the Android background delivery path, or a config flag we're missing?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report - this does sound like it could be related to a change in how the Android FCM channel handles background delivery in the latest SDK release. Could you send us the SDK version you upgraded from and to, along with a sample device token that's failing to receive notifications? That will let us reproduce the background delivery issue directly and figure out whether it's a config flag or a bug on our end.

subject: Approaching storage quota, need upload increase before month end
body: Our workspace is currently at 92% of our allocated storage quota and we still have several large backup uploads scheduled for this week as part of our monthly retention cycle. We're on the Pro plan with 80 seats and can't afford to have uploads fail mid-cycle. Can you either increase our quota temporarily or advise on adjusting our retention settings so older backups roll off faster? This needs to be sorted before Friday.
answer: Thanks for getting ahead of this - we can see your workspace approaching the quota threshold. We're reviewing options now, including a temporary quota bump to get you through this week's backup cycle, and we'll also look at your current retention policy to see if shortening it would free up space automatically going forward. Expect a follow-up from our team with a concrete number and timeline well before Friday.

subject: Question about API key rotation and rate limits
body: I'm setting up automated key rotation for our integration with the Northwind API Platform and want to understand the recommended approach. Specifically, when we generate a new API key, does the old one continue working during a grace period, and are rate limits tracked per key or per account? We're currently on a single key with moderate traffic and want to avoid any downtime when we rotate.
answer: Good question - when you generate a new API key, the previous one stays active for 24 hours by default before it's revoked, which gives you a safe overlap window for rotation. Rate limits are tracked per account rather than per key, so rotating keys won't reset or double your available quota. Let us know if you'd like that grace period adjusted or if you run into any issues during the rotation.

subject: Charts on all dashboards showing blank since this morning
body: As of about 8am today, every chart across our dashboards is rendering blank white boxes instead of the actual visualizations - bar charts, line charts, and pie charts are all affected. This is happening for all 273 users in our workspace, not just me. Refreshing the page or clearing cache hasn't helped. We rely on these dashboards for logistics tracking across our regional hubs, so this is a serious problem for our whole team right now.
answer: This is being treated as urgent given it's impacting your entire workspace. We're escalating to our dashboards engineering team immediately to check for a rendering service issue on our side, since a blanket failure across all chart types for all users points to something upstream rather than a local cache problem. We'll update you within the hour with either a fix or a clear timeline - please don't make workspace config changes in the meantime so we can isolate the cause cleanly.

subject: Need to update SAML login configuration for new IdP
body: We're migrating our identity provider and need to update our SAML SSO configuration in Northwind Identity for Orion Foods. Our current setup uses an older metadata URL that will be deprecated next month, and we need to swap in the new IdP's metadata and certificate without locking out our 122 users during the transition. Can you walk us through the safest way to do this change, or do it on your side with our new metadata file?
answer: We can definitely help make this transition smooth. The safest approach is to add the new IdP as a secondary SAML configuration alongside your current one, test a few user logins against it, and then cut over once confirmed - that way nobody gets locked out mid-migration. If you send over the new metadata file and target cutover date, we can walk through the setup with you step by step.

subject: allowlist
body: How do I add IPs to workspace allowlist?
answer: You can manage this from the Admin Console under Settings > Security > IP Allowlist - just add each IP or CIDR range and save, changes take effect within a couple of minutes. Let us know if you'd like a hand adding a specific range or checking the audit log for existing entries.

subject: Biometric login integration crashes on re-auth
body: We're rolling out biometric login (Face ID/fingerprint) in our mobile app using the Northwind Mobile SDK, and the app crashes whenever a user's biometric session expires and they're prompted to re-authenticate. The crash happens specifically on the re-auth flow, not the initial biometric setup. We've reproduced it on both iOS 17 and Android 14 devices. Given we have 231 users rolling out this feature next sprint, we need guidance on whether this is a known SDK issue before we ship.
answer: Thanks for catching this before rollout - a crash specifically on the re-auth path after biometric session expiry does match a bug we're tracking in the current SDK's session refresh handler. We'll send over a patched build for testing today; in the meantime, avoid enabling the biometric re-auth prompt in production until you've confirmed the fix on both iOS and Android. We'll follow up with reproduction steps we used so you can compare against your setup.

subject: Kunden können sich nicht von E-Mail-Benachrichtigungen abmelden
body: Mehrere unserer Kunden haben sich beschwert, dass der Abmelden-Link in unseren automatischen E-Mail-Benachrichtigungen nicht funktioniert. Wenn sie auf 'Abmelden' klicken, landen sie auf einer Fehlerseite mit der Meldung 'Ungültiger Token'. Das betrifft mindestens 15 Kunden seit letzter Woche und beschädigt unser Vertrauen bei ihnen. Können Sie das Problem mit den Unsubscribe-Links im Notifications-Modul prüfen?
answer: Danke für die Meldung, das klingt nach einem Problem mit der Token-Generierung in den Unsubscribe-Links. Wir prüfen sofort, ob es bei kürzlich versendeten Kampagnen zu abgelaufenen oder fehlerhaft signierten Tokens kam, und melden uns mit den betroffenen Zeiträumen. Bitte senden Sie uns, falls möglich, ein Beispiel des fehlerhaften Links, damit wir die Ursache schneller eingrenzen können.

subject: Data Pipelines: late-arriving records causing gaps in daily aggregates
body:
We run a nightly aggregation job on Data Pipelines that pulls from our transaction connector, and for the past week we're seeing records arrive 3-6 hours after the pipeline run completes. This is causing our daily totals to be understated until the next run picks them up, which is a problem for our fintech reconciliation reports.

Is there a way to configure a watermark or delay window on the connector so the pipeline waits for late data before finalizing a run? We'd also like to know if there's a way to backfill affected runs automatically once late records land.
answer:
Thanks for the detailed writeup. Late-arriving data is common with upstream transaction feeds, and yes, our connectors support a configurable watermark delay under the connector's advanced settings - you can set a lateness window (e.g. 4-8 hours) so the pipeline holds finalization until that window passes. I'll send you a link to the how-to guide for configuring this plus automatic backfill triggers so affected runs re-aggregate once late records arrive.

In the meantime, could you share the connector name and run IDs from the last few days so I can check if there's an upstream delay pattern we should flag to the source system as well?

subject: Request: configurable session timeout for SSO logins
body:
Our finance team uses SSO through Northwind for daily reporting access, and we're finding that sessions expire after what seems like 30 minutes of inactivity, forcing repeated re-logins during long report reviews. With 178 seats on our Pro plan, this is generating a steady stream of help desk tickets internally.

Could we get documentation on how to extend or configure the session timeout duration for our SSO-connected accounts? We'd like something closer to 4 hours for finance and admin roles specifically, if that's possible through permissions or provisioning settings.
answer:
Thanks for flagging this - session timeout duration is configurable at the identity provider level for SSO-connected workspaces, and we can also apply role-based overrides so finance and admin roles get a longer window than standard users. I'll send over our documentation covering the SSO session policy settings and how they interact with provisioning rules.

If you'd like, I can also walk you through setting a 4-hour timeout specifically for the finance and admin roles on a quick call - just let me know a good time.

subject: Offline mode not syncing pending actions after reconnect
body:
I'm integrating our legal case app with the Northwind Mobile App SDK, and while testing offline mode I noticed that actions queued while offline (form submissions, status updates) don't sync once connectivity is restored. The app shows a spinner briefly then just clears the queue without any confirmation or error.

This happened consistently across three test devices running the latest build. Is there a known issue with the offline sync queue, or a setting I need to enable to get proper retry/confirmation behavior?
answer:
Thanks for the detailed report and for testing across multiple devices. This isn't a known widespread issue, but the offline queue can silently drop unsynced actions if the retry policy isn't explicitly enabled in the SDK config - could you confirm which SDK version you're on and whether `offlineQueue.retryOnReconnect` is set in your initialization code?

Once I have that, I can point you to the correct configuration or escalate to engineering if the setting is already correct and the queue is still dropping items.

subject: Dashboards loading slowly with multiple charts
body:
We've noticed our main operations dashboard, which has around 12 charts pulling from different data sources, is taking 15-20 seconds to fully render for our team. This has gotten noticeably worse over the past two weeks. Export to PDF also times out on this particular dashboard, though sharing via link still works fine.

Can someone take a look at whether this is a caching issue or if we should be splitting the dashboard into smaller views? We're not blocked, just want to improve the experience for our legal team who checks this daily.
answer:
Thanks for the detailed report. Dashboards with 10+ charts pulling from multiple sources can hit rendering bottlenecks, especially if any underlying queries aren't cached - I'd recommend splitting this into 2-3 smaller dashboards grouped by data source, which usually resolves both the load time and export timeout issues.

I'll also check on our end whether there's a caching regression tied to the export pipeline, since that timeout behavior is worth investigating separately. I'll follow up once I have more detail on the export issue.

subject: Change request: transform step failing silently on schema drift
body:
I'm integrating our manufacturing sensor data connector into Data Pipelines, and over the last week several transform steps have failed without surfacing an error in the pipeline UI - the run shows as successful but the output table is missing columns that should be present after the transform. I traced it to upstream schema changes in our source connector (two new fields added, one renamed).

We need the transform step to either fail loudly on schema drift or auto-adapt to new/renamed fields. Right now silent partial failures are corrupting downstream sync jobs. Can this be prioritized as a fix or config change?
answer:
Thanks for the detailed diagnosis - this is a real gap, transform steps should not report success when the output schema doesn't match expectations. I'm escalating this as a change request to add strict schema validation with an option to fail the run or quarantine affected records when drift is detected, rather than silently dropping columns.

As a workaround in the meantime, I'd suggest enabling schema validation warnings on the connector settings page, which will at least flag drift in the pipeline logs until the stricter failure mode ships. I'll update you here once we have a timeline.

subject: Upgrade to Pro tier charged wrong amount and seats not added
body:
I upgraded our workspace from Starter to Pro this morning to add 20 more seats (bringing us to 112 total), and the checkout confirmed successfully, but our billing page still shows the old seat count and we were charged for 132 seats instead of 112. The invoice number is INV-88213.

This needs to be corrected quickly since our team is trying to onboard new users today and can't get invited past the seat cap. Please adjust the charge and unlock the seat count.
answer:
Apologies for the trouble this is causing during your onboarding push - I've flagged invoice INV-88213 for immediate review and can see the discrepancy between the seat count shown and the charge applied. I'm correcting the seat allocation to 112 now so your team can continue inviting users without delay, and I'll process a refund adjustment for the overcharge, which should reflect within 3-5 business days.

I'll confirm back here once both the seat unlock and refund are complete - thank you for including the invoice number, that made this quick to trace.

subject: Urgent storage issue
body:
I wanted to give some background first - we've been on the Pro plan for about eight months now and our healthcare compliance team relies on Northwind Storage to retain patient intake documents for the legally required period, which for us is 7 years under our jurisdiction's rules. We recently ran an internal audit ahead of a client compliance review scheduled for next week.

During that audit we discovered that documents uploaded between March and June of last year appear to have been purged already, well before the 7-year retention window we configured. We checked the retention policy settings and they still show 7 years, but the files themselves return 404 when we try to retrieve them. Roughly 40 documents are affected so far based on our sample check, and we're worried there may be more.

This is now urgent because we have to demonstrate document availability to auditors in five days and can't currently do so for this date range.
answer:
This is being escalated immediately given the compliance deadline - I've opened a P1 incident and looped in our storage engineering team to investigate why documents from March-June of last year were purged despite a 7-year retention policy being active. We'll need the exact document IDs or upload batch references from your sample check to trace whether this is a retention job misconfiguration or a deletion event we can recover from backups.

Please send over that list as soon as you can, and I'll keep you updated at least once every few hours until we have a root cause and, if possible, a recovery path for the affected files.

subject: Feature request: dedupe logic for repeated alert notifications
body:
Our manufacturing floor team gets the same equipment alert emailed 3-4 times within a few minutes whenever a sensor threshold is crossed, which is causing people to ignore notifications altogether. We only have 4 seats on the Starter plan so this is a small team but the noise is a real problem.

Could you add a dedupe or cooldown window so the same alert type doesn't fire multiple times within a short period? Even a basic 5-10 minute suppression window per alert rule would help a lot.
answer:
Thanks for the feedback - this is a fair point, and a per-rule cooldown window is something we've heard requested before. I'm logging this as a feature request for a configurable suppression window (5-10 minutes as you suggested) so the same alert type doesn't re-fire while still active.

In the meantime, as a partial workaround you can adjust the alert rule's evaluation frequency to reduce how often the threshold check runs, which should cut down on the duplicate emails until dedupe logic ships.

subject: Salesforce sync completely stopped, records not updating
body:
Our Salesforce integration through Northwind stopped syncing contact and opportunity updates as of this morning around 9am. We rely on this to keep our education CRM data current for our small team of 11 seats, and now none of the changes we make in Salesforce are reflecting in Northwind dashboards, nor are Northwind-side updates pushing back to Salesforce.

The integration status page shows "Connected" with no errors, but the last successful sync timestamp is stuck at 8:47am today. We've tried disconnecting and reconnecting the integration once already with no change. This is blocking our reporting for an end-of-quarter review happening tomorrow.
answer:
I understand the urgency given your end-of-quarter review tomorrow - I'm escalating this as a P1 since the sync has been stalled since 8:47am with no error surfaced, which suggests a stuck job on our side rather than a credential issue. I'm having our integrations team check the sync queue for your workspace right now.

Please avoid reconnecting again for the moment, as repeated reconnects can sometimes create duplicate queued jobs - I'll update you within the hour with either a fix or a clear root cause.

subject: storage
body: our uploaded backup files older than 30 days are getting deleted even though we set retention to 90 days in the storage settings we noticed this yesterday when trying to restore a file from 45 days ago and got a not found error we only have 8 seats on starter plan and this backup data is important for our travel booking records
answer:
Thanks for reporting this - a 90-day retention setting causing deletions at 30 days points to a policy misapplication on our end, and I'm escalating this now given it affects your backup restore capability. Could you confirm the exact filename or upload date of the file you tried to restore from 45 days ago, along with your workspace ID?

Once I have that, I'll check whether this is affecting your whole storage bucket or just a subset of files, and let you know if recovery from our backend backups is possible for anything already purged.

subject: Duplicate email alerts being sent to users
body: We're seeing duplicate notification emails going out to our legal team members over the past week. Each alert for document approval seems to fire twice within about 30 seconds, sometimes with a third copy an hour later. This started around June 3rd and is affecting roughly 40 users based on our helpdesk tickets. Notification IDs I've checked in the log export include ntf_88213 and ntf_88214, which appear to be identical content sent 27 seconds apart. Can you check if this is a queue or retry issue on your end?
answer: Thanks for flagging this with the specific notification IDs, that's very helpful. We've seen a related issue where a retry mechanism re-queues a message if the delivery acknowledgment is delayed past a threshold, which can produce exactly this pattern. I'm pulling the delivery logs for ntf_88213/88214 now and will check whether your workspace is affected by the retry bug; I'll update you within a few hours with findings and a fix timeline.

subject: Push-Benachrichtigungen crashen die App im Offline-Modus
body:
Wir binden die Push-Notification-API in unsere Mobile App ein und haben ein kritisches Problem im Offline-Modus. Sobald das Gerät keine Verbindung hat und eine Push-Nachricht empfangen wird, crasht die App sofort. Das betrifft alle Nutzer unserer iOS-Build-Version 4.2.1.

Hier der Stacktrace aus unserem Crash-Reporting:

```
Fatal Exception: NSInvalidArgumentException
0 CoreFoundation 0x1a2b3c4d __exceptionPreprocess
1 libobjc.A.dylib 0x1a1f2e3d objc_exception_throw
2 NorthwindSDK 0x1005a3e2 -[NWPushHandler cacheNotification:]
3 NorthwindSDK 0x1005a710 -[NWPushHandler didReceiveRemoteNotification:]
4 UIKitCore 0x1b3f4a10 -[UIApplication _handleRemoteNotification:]
```

Das passiert seit dem Update auf SDK 3.8.0 vor drei Tagen. Wir brauchen dringend eine Lösung, da unsere Kunden die App gerade nicht nutzen können.
answer: Vielen Dank für den detaillierten Stacktrace, das hilft uns sehr bei der Eingrenzung. Es sieht so aus, als ob der lokale Cache für Push-Nachrichten im Offline-Modus in SDK 3.8.0 eine ungültige Payload-Struktur nicht abfängt, was zum Absturz führt. Wir stufen das als kritischen Fehler ein und arbeiten bereits an einem Hotfix; als Zwischenlösung empfehlen wir, vorübergehend auf SDK 3.7.4 zurückzusetzen, bis der Patch veröffentlicht ist. Wir melden uns innerhalb der nächsten Stunden mit einem Update.

subject: Question about workspace allowlist settings via API
body: I'm setting up our workspace configuration through the Admin Console API and want to restrict access to a specific set of IP ranges using the allowlist feature. I can see the setting in the UI under Workspace Settings > Security, but I can't find the corresponding API endpoint in the documentation. Is there a way to manage the allowlist programmatically, or is this currently only available through the console UI? We're a small team of 23 and want to automate this as part of our onboarding scripts.
answer: Good question, and thanks for checking the docs first. The allowlist configuration is currently only exposed through the Admin Console UI and isn't yet available as a public API endpoint, though it's on our roadmap for a future release. In the meantime, I'd recommend documenting the manual steps in your onboarding runbook; I'll also flag this as a documentation gap so we can add a note about the current limitation to the API reference.

subject: Requesting change to storage retention policy
body: We'd like to update our data retention settings for the Storage product. Currently our uploaded files are set to auto-delete after 90 days, but for compliance in our finance operations we need to extend this to 365 days for a specific folder used for transaction backups. We're a small team of 5 and don't need this applied account-wide, just to the /backups directory. Could you let us know if this is possible at our current tier and how to configure it?
answer: Thanks for the clear request. Per-folder retention overrides are supported on the Starter tier, so you should be able to set a custom policy on the /backups directory without changing your account-wide default. I'll walk you through the steps: go to Storage Settings > Retention Rules, select the specific folder, and set the override to 365 days; let me know if you don't see that option and I'll check your account configuration directly.

subject: Rollenzuordnung nach SSO-Login fehlerhaft
body:
Nach der Anmeldung über unser SSO-Portal werden mehreren Nutzern falsche Rollen zugewiesen. Konkret erhalten Mitarbeiter aus der Gruppe 'Filialleiter' die Berechtigung 'Administrator' statt 'Manager', obwohl das Attribut-Mapping in unserem Identity Provider korrekt auf 'Manager' zeigt. Das Problem betrifft mindestens 30 Nutzer seit dem Update unserer SAML-Konfiguration letzte Woche.

Wir haben das Attribut 'department' korrekt konfiguriert, aber die Rollenzuordnung auf Northwind-Seite scheint das falsche Feld zu lesen. Können Sie das Provisioning-Mapping auf Ihrer Seite überprüfen?
answer: Danke für die genaue Beschreibung. Das klingt nach einem Problem mit dem Attribut-Mapping auf unserer Seite, bei dem eventuell ein veraltetes Feld statt 'department' ausgelesen wird. Wir prüfen die Provisioning-Konfiguration Ihres Workspace und vergleichen sie mit den SAML-Assertions der betroffenen Nutzer; wir melden uns innerhalb der nächsten Stunden mit einer Rückmeldung und, falls nötig, einer korrigierten Mapping-Regel.

subject: Slack alerts from Salesforce integration stopped working
body: Our Slack channel for sales alerts stopped receiving messages from the Salesforce integration starting this morning around 8am. We use this to notify the team when high-value deals close, and it's been reliable for months. I checked the integration status page in the dashboard and it shows 'Connected' with no errors, but nothing is coming through to the #sales-wins channel. We also have Jira and Okta connected but those seem unaffected.

We're checking whether there was a webhook delivery issue on our side starting this morning; in the meantime, could you confirm the exact Salesforce trigger event you're using (e.g., Opportunity Stage Change) so we can test that specific flow? We'll follow up shortly with findings.

subject: Unsubscribe link not working, users still getting emails
body: Several of our staff clicked 'unsubscribe' on the weekly digest emails but are still receiving them daily instead of weekly. One teacher reported getting the same digest twice on Tuesday even after unsubscribing on Monday. subject: Need to restore files from backup, deleted by mistake
body: One of our team members accidentally deleted a folder containing Q2 financial statements from Storage yesterday afternoon around 3pm. We need to restore this from backup as soon as possible since we have an audit review tomorrow morning. The folder was named 'Q2_Statements_2024' and contained about 15 files. answer: I understand the urgency given your audit timeline tomorrow. I'll follow up as soon as it's complete so you have time to verify before your review.

subject: Shared dashboard permissions not applying correctly
body: We've set up several dashboards to be shared with view-only access for our regional operations teams, but a few users are able to edit charts and even export data they shouldn't have access to. Specifically, the 'Logistics KPI Overview' dashboard was set to view-only for the 'Regional Ops' group, but two users in that group were able to modify a bar chart's filters and export the underlying data yesterday. answer: Thank you for flagging this, permission scoping issues are something we take seriously given the scale of your organization. We'll report back with root cause and confirm the permission fix is applied, and in the meantime we'd recommend temporarily restricting export access at the workspace level as a precaution.

subject: Scheduled sync running late and skipping records
body: Our scheduled sync for the manufacturing inventory connector is supposed to run every night at 1am, but for the past three nights it's either running late (around 4am) or skipping entirely, like it did last night. When it does run, we've noticed a few hundred records missing compared to the source system count. This isn't blocking us urgently but we'd like to understand what's causing the delay and data gaps before it becomes a bigger issue.
answer: Thanks for tracking the pattern over the past few nights, that timing detail is useful. We'll check the connector's scheduler logs to see if there's queue congestion or a timeout causing the delayed runs, and we'll also compare record counts to identify where the gap is occurring, whether it's a pagination issue or filtered records. We'll follow up with our findings and recommended next steps within the next day or two.

subject: Workspace settings - allowlist and admin deactivation flow
body:
I'm reviewing our workspace configuration for Harbor Partners and have a couple of questions about the IP allowlist feature under Admin Console settings. When we add a new CIDR range, it takes close to 10 minutes to propagate across regions before users can log in from that range - is this expected latency or is there a way to speed it up?

Separately, we want to set up an escalation path so that if an admin is deactivated, a designated backup admin automatically gets notified. Is there a native way to configure this, or do we need to build it via API webhooks?
answer: Thanks for the detailed questions. The allowlist propagation delay you're seeing (up to 10 minutes) is expected on our current architecture since changes replicate across regional edge nodes; we don't have a way to force faster propagation today, but it's on our roadmap to reduce this window. For the deactivation escalation, there isn't a built-in notification rule yet, but you can achieve this using our Admin Console webhooks - subscribing to the admin.deactivated event and routing it to your alerting system. I'll flag the auto-escalation idea as a feature request as well.

subject: cant share dashbord with team
body:
hey since yesturday morning our marketing team cant open the shared dashbords, they get a permision error even tho i gave them viewer acess. i checked the sharing settings twice and its set to the right group. this is blocking our weekly report export that goes out every monday, about 40 people affected.
