In the meantime, we're checking on our end for a permissions sync issue affecting group-based sharing, since that would explain viewers getting blocked despite correct group membership.

subject: Invoice shows wrong seat count and missing plan discount
body:
I'm reviewing our latest invoice for Quill Works and noticed it lists 8 seats billed, but we only have 5 active users on the Starter plan. We also had a 10% annual discount applied at signup back in March that doesn't appear on this invoice at all.

Could someone correct the seat count and confirm whether the discount will be reapplied retroactively or just going forward? Also, is there a way to download invoices in PDF format directly from the billing page - I only see a CSV export option right now.
answer: Thanks for flagging this - I'll have our billing team review your account to correct the seat count discrepancy and check why the annual discount wasn't reflected on this invoice. We'll issue a corrected invoice once we confirm the numbers, and any discount adjustment will be applied retroactively to this billing cycle. Regarding PDF exports, that's currently a CSV-only feature, but I'll pass along your request as feedback to our product team.

subject: SSO role mapping not assigning correct permissions after group sync
body:
We're integrating Cobalt Systems with Northwind's SSO using SAML and Okta as the IdP. After a user logs in, their group attribute maps to 'engineering-admin' in our IdP config, but Northwind is assigning them the default 'viewer' role instead of the mapped admin role.

I've verified the SAML assertion includes the correct group attribute (checked via the raw XML response), and our role mapping rules in the Identity and SSO settings show 'engineering-admin' -> Admin correctly configured. This is affecting all 5 of our users trying to access billing settings via SSO. MFA prompts work fine, it's just the role assignment that's broken.
answer: Thanks for the thorough details, including confirming the SAML assertion contents. This does sound like a mapping resolution issue on our side rather than a config problem in your IdP setup. Can you send us the exact attribute name and value string from the assertion (redacting any personal identifiers) along with a timestamp of a recent failed login? We'll trace it through our role assignment logs to see where the mapping is breaking down.

subject: Credit card declined for two consecutive billing attempts
body:
Our card on file for Apex Energy was declined for the November billing cycle and again on the retry three days later. I've confirmed with our bank that the card itself is active and has sufficient funds, so I'm not sure why the charge is failing on Northwind's end.

Could you let me know what the actual decline reason code was, and whether there's a grace period before the account gets restricted? We're only on 3 seats so this shouldn't be a limits issue, just want to get billing sorted before it affects our access.
answer: Thanks for reaching out, and no need to worry about immediate access loss - there's a grace period before any account restrictions kick in. I can see the decline reason returned was a generic 'do_not_honor' response from the card issuer, which sometimes happens with international billing flags rather than actual balance issues. I'd recommend trying the payment again or updating the card details on the billing page, and let us know if it fails again so we can escalate to our payments provider for more detail.

subject: SDK throwing rate limit errors far below documented threshold
body:
We're using the Northwind Python SDK (version 4.2.1) for our billing reconciliation jobs, and starting around October 14th we began seeing 429 errors after only about 200 requests per minute, well under the 1000 req/min limit documented for our Enterprise tier. The error response includes 'rate_limit_exceeded' but the retry-after header suggests only a 2 second wait, which doesn't match the actual lockout we're experiencing (closer to 60 seconds).

This is impacting our nightly finance reconciliation process for Quill Analytics, delaying reports to our legal team by several hours. Has there been a recent change to rate limit tiers or SDK behavior we should know about?
answer: Thank you for the specific version and timeline - that's very helpful. We did roll out an update to our rate limiting middleware in early October that inadvertently applied a lower tier threshold to some Enterprise accounts using older SDK versions; version 4.2.1 predates a header-parsing fix that's included in 4.3.0. I'd recommend upgrading the SDK as a first step, and in parallel we're reviewing your account's tier assignment to confirm it's correctly set to the Enterprise rate limit.

subject: Unsubscribed users still receiving duplicate billing alerts
body:
Multiple users at North Partners who clicked unsubscribe from billing notification emails last week are still receiving duplicate alerts - some got the same overdue invoice notice three times this morning. This is causing real confusion since finance team members think there are three separate invoices at risk when it's actually just one duplicated alert.

The unsubscribe confirmation page loads fine and shows 'You have been unsubscribed' but the emails keep coming. We have only 5 seats so this is affecting basically our whole team right now.
answer: This is a serious issue and we're treating it as high priority given it's affecting your whole team. It looks like there may be a disconnect between the unsubscribe preference update and the notification dispatch queue, causing already-queued alerts to send regardless of the new preference. We're pausing outbound billing alert sends for your account while we investigate the root cause, and will confirm once the duplicate sends have stopped and unsubscribe preferences are correctly honored.

subject: Request for SAML setup guide and auto-provisioning support
body:
We're setting up SAML-based SSO for Cobalt Travel using our identity provider and running into a login loop - after entering credentials on the IdP side, we get redirected back to Northwind but land on a blank error page instead of the app. We're following the general SSO docs but don't see a step-by-step guide specific to SAML metadata upload for our provider.

Also, once login works, we'd like new users to be automatically provisioned into the correct workspace based on their SAML group attribute rather than manually inviting each of our 11 team members. Is auto-provisioning available on our current plan?
answer: Thanks for the details on the login loop - that blank error page after redirect usually points to a metadata mismatch, often the ACS URL or entity ID not matching what's configured on our side. Could you share a screenshot of the error and your current SAML metadata XML so we can pinpoint the mismatch? On auto-provisioning, that feature is available starting on our Pro plan tier, so it would require an upgrade from your current plan, but I can share documentation on setting up group-based provisioning rules once you're on the right tier.

subject: Biometric login failing intermittently and blocking offline access
body:
Since updating to the latest Northwind mobile app version, biometric login (Face ID) has started failing intermittently for our field team at Quill Retail - it prompts for Face ID, appears to scan successfully, then drops back to the PIN entry screen without logging in. This is especially disruptive for users trying to access the app offline while traveling, since offline mode seems to require a fresh successful biometric auth first.

Out of roughly 204 users, we're getting reports from at least 30 so far this week, mostly on iOS devices. Some are also missing push notifications for approval requests after this happens. This needs urgent attention since it's blocking field staff from working while offline.
answer: This is impacting a large portion of your team so we're escalating it immediately as a P1. The pattern you describe - successful Face ID scan followed by a fallback to PIN - suggests a token refresh failure happening silently after biometric auth succeeds, which would also explain the missed push notifications tied to that session. Please ask a few affected users to send device model and iOS version, and in the meantime we recommend having users log in with PIN and password to restore access while we investigate the auth token issue on our end.

subject: File uploads failing with quota error despite available storage
body:
We've been getting upload failures on Quill Works' Storage since yesterday afternoon - files over 50MB fail with an error saying 'storage quota exceeded' even though our usage dashboard shows we're only at 60% of our allocated quota. This is blocking our backup process for end-of-month retention, which we run every 30th.

We're on the Starter plan with 5 seats, so I want to confirm this isn't a plan limit issue versus an actual bug in the quota calculation. Can someone check our account and let us know if there's a fix or workaround before end of month?
answer: Thanks for flagging this with the specific timing around your retention backup - that helps us prioritize. A quota error showing despite available headroom often points to a stale usage calculation cache rather than an actual limit being hit, and we're checking your account's real-time usage now against what the dashboard reports. We'll follow up shortly with either a fix or a temporary workaround so your end-of-month backup isn't delayed.

subject: Refund not showing
body: Refunded invoice #INV-3391 5 days ago, credit still not applied to our account.
answer: Thanks for flagging this, I've located INV-3391 and can confirm the refund was processed on our end but the credit sync to your account balance appears to have stalled. I'm escalating this to our billing team now and will update you within one business day once the credit reflects correctly.

subject: Best way to keep Salesforce contacts in sync
body: We've connected our Salesforce org to Northwind via the Integrations panel and contact records are syncing, but I'm not clear on how conflicts are resolved when a contact is edited in both systems around the same time. Is there a way to set Salesforce as the source of truth for certain fields, or a log we can check for sync conflicts? Also curious if there's a Slack notification option for failed syncs.
answer: Good question - by default Northwind uses last-write-wins based on timestamp, but you can set field-level priority rules under Integrations > Salesforce > Field Mapping to force Salesforce as source of truth for specific fields. Sync conflict logs are available under the same section under 'Sync History', and yes, you can enable a Slack webhook alert for failed syncs from the notification settings tab - happy to walk you through it on a call if useful.

subject: URGENT - all file uploads failing, patient records blocked
body:
Since about 09:15 today none of our staff can upload documents to Storage, every attempt errors out and this is blocking patient intake across all our clinics.

Error returned in our integration logs:
```
PUT /v2/storage/objects/upload HTTP/1.1
503 Service Unavailable
{"error":"upstream_write_failed","request_id":"req_8842xk","retryable":true}
[repeated x47 in last 20 min]
```
We have zero successful uploads since the incident started. Need this fixed immediately, this is a full outage for us.
answer: This has been escalated to our infrastructure team as P0 - we're seeing elevated write failures on the storage backend affecting multiple accounts and are actively working the incident. We'll post updates every 30 minutes on the status page and directly to this ticket; in the meantime please have staff hold retries as repeated attempts are adding load, we'll notify you the moment uploads are restored.

subject: Dashboard PDF export cutting off charts
body: When we export any dashboard to PDF, the bottom row of charts gets cut off on the page and doesn't wrap to a second page. This happens consistently across our three saved dashboards, tested on both Chrome and the desktop app. Not urgent but wanted to flag it since we share these exports with outside counsel weekly.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report - this matches a known layout issue with multi-row dashboards in the PDF export renderer where page breaks aren't calculated correctly. I've added your account to the tracking ticket for a fix, and in the meantime a workaround is to export each row as a separate dashboard view, which does paginate correctly. I'll update you here once the fix ships.

subject: Biometric login support for mobile SDK
body: I'm integrating the Northwind mobile SDK into our student portal app and don't see documented support for Face ID or fingerprint login after initial auth. Is biometric login on the roadmap, or is there a way to hook into the device's secure enclave ourselves alongside your token refresh flow? We'd like to avoid re-prompting for password on every app relaunch.
answer: Biometric login isn't natively exposed in the SDK yet, but it is on our roadmap for the next couple of releases. In the meantime, the recommended pattern is to store the refresh token in the platform's secure keychain/keystore and gate access to it behind the OS-level biometric prompt on relaunch - I can send over a short integration snippet for both iOS and Android if that helps.

subject: SCIM provisioning failing for new business unit
body: We're rolling out Northwind to a newly acquired business unit and SCIM provisioning from our identity provider is failing to create users - the provisioning job reports 'group mapping not found' for the new OU we added last week. This is blocking onboarding for around 400 employees who are scheduled to start using the platform this week, so we need this resolved quickly.
answer: I understand the time pressure here - this is usually caused by the new OU not being linked to a corresponding role/group mapping on our side yet, which needs to be added before SCIM can resolve it. I'm looping in our identity team to get the mapping created and validated against your IdP today, and will confirm once a test provisioning run for that OU succeeds.

subject: Need finer-grained dashboard sharing controls
body: As our organization has grown, we need to restrict dashboard sharing so that clinical operations dashboards can't be shared externally by any user, while still allowing internal cross-department sharing. Currently it looks like sharing permissions are all-or-nothing at the workspace level. Can you confirm if there's a way to set this per-dashboard or per-folder, or if this requires a config change on your end?
answer: You're right that workspace-level sharing is the default, but Enterprise accounts do have access to per-folder sharing policies under Admin > Dashboards > Sharing Rules, which lets you block external sharing for specific folders while leaving internal sharing open. It looks like this hasn't been enabled on your account yet - I'll turn it on and send you a short guide for setting up the clinical operations folder restriction.

subject: Mobile app crashing immediately on launch
body: Since updating to the latest app version yesterday, the mobile app crashes within a second of opening on all our staff devices, both iOS and Android. It gets past the splash screen briefly then closes with no error message shown. We rely on this for shift check-ins so this is affecting our whole team right now.
answer: Sorry for the disruption this is causing your team - we've had a couple of similar reports tied to yesterday's release and are actively investigating a crash-on-launch bug affecting cached session data. As a quicker workaround, please have staff fully uninstall and reinstall the app rather than just updating, which has resolved it for other affected accounts. I'll keep this ticket open and update you as soon as we confirm a root cause fix.

subject: Need guidance on restoring deleted storage objects from backup
body: One of our regional teams accidentally deleted a batch of around 1,200 objects from a storage bucket on Tuesday during a cleanup script gone wrong. We understand Northwind retains backups, but I want to confirm the restore process, expected turnaround time, and whether restoring will count against our current storage quota before we proceed.
answer: Good news, backups from Tuesday should still be within our retention window so a restore is very much possible. Restoring the 1,200 objects will typically take 2-4 hours to complete and will count against your active storage quota once restored, so I'd recommend confirming you have sufficient headroom first - let me know and I can kick off the restore job on our end and keep you updated on progress.

subject: Offline mode losing data on reconnect
body: Our field technicians use the mobile app in offline mode at manufacturing sites with no signal, and when they reconnect, form submissions entered while offline sometimes don't sync and just disappear from the queue. We've confirmed this happened at least 6 times this week across different devices, and it's causing real data loss for inspection reports.
answer: Thank you for reporting this with specifics, data loss on sync is something we take very seriously and I'm opening this as a priority bug against the offline queue module. To help us pinpoint it, could you send device model, OS version, and approximate timestamps for two or three of the affected submissions? In the meantime, as a precaution please advise technicians to screenshot key form data before reconnecting until we confirm a fix.

subject: Scheduled syncs failing across three connectors since last night
body:
Since around 11pm ET last night, our scheduled syncs for the Salesforce, NetSuite, and booking-system connectors have all been failing. Pipeline run IDs 88213, 88219, and 88224 show status "failed - partial extract" and the row counts are roughly 40% lower than our usual daily volume of about 210,000 records. This is affecting downstream reporting that our regional ops teams rely on every morning, and we have 1719 seats depending on this data being current.

Can someone check whether there was a connector-level change or outage on your side? We need this resolved today as several teams are blocked without accurate travel booking data.
answer: Thanks for flagging this with the run IDs, that's very helpful. We can see elevated extract failures starting at 10:47pm ET tied to a schema change on the booking-system connector's upstream API, and we're actively working with the connector team to push a fix. I'll update this ticket within the next two hours with a timeline, and in the meantime we're prioritizing a manual re-run of the affected pipelines once the fix lands so your downstream reports catch up.

subject: Duplicate daily email digests being sent to all users
body:
For the past two mornings (the 12th and 13th) our team members have each received two copies of the daily notification digest, about 20 minutes apart. We only have 12 seats on the workspace so it's easy to confirm this isn't a filtering issue on our end, everyone is seeing the same duplicate pattern. The content of both emails is identical, same alert count and timestamp.

Could you check the digest scheduler for our workspace? This is starting to generate confused replies from staff asking which email to trust.
answer: Thanks for the clear detail on timing and duplication. We found that your workspace digest job was queued twice due to a retry that didn't get suppressed properly after the first send succeeded, which explains the ~20 minute gap. We've disabled the duplicate trigger for your workspace and are monitoring today's digest run to confirm only one copy goes out; we'll follow up here once tomorrow's send completes cleanly.

subject: Request to change storage retention policy for archived invoices
body:
We'd like to extend the retention period on our archived invoice storage bucket from 90 days to 7 years to meet our internal audit requirements. Currently anything older than 90 days is getting purged, and our audit team flagged this during last week's review since we need historical invoice backups going back further than that.

Can you confirm whether this is a self-service setting or something that needs to be applied on your end for our account? We'd like this changed before our next quarterly close.
answer: Good catch, and this is something we can adjust for you. Retention policy changes beyond the standard tiers need to be applied on our side for Pro accounts, so I've submitted the change to extend your archived invoice bucket retention to 7 years. I'll confirm here once it's live, which should be within one business day, and existing files inside the 90-day window won't be affected in the meantime.

subject: Getting duplicate alert notifications through the API
body:
I'm integrating the notifications API for our internal dashboard and noticed that every alert we trigger via POST /v1/notifications is coming through twice on the recipient's end, both with the same notification_id. This started after we added a retry wrapper around our request last week, but the API itself should be idempotent based on the docs.

Could someone confirm whether idempotency keys are supported here, and if so how they should be passed? Right now our 16 users are getting doubled alerts for every event which is confusing.
answer: Thanks for the detail, especially the notification_id showing as identical on both sends. The API does support idempotency keys via the Idempotency-Key header, but it looks like it wasn't documented clearly on that endpoint's page, so I understand the confusion. If you pass a unique key per logical event and reuse it on retries, duplicate sends should stop; I'll also flag this to our docs team to get the header requirement added to the API reference.

subject: Ability to let individual users unsubscribe from specific alert types
body:
Right now unsubscribing from notifications appears to be all-or-nothing at the workspace level, but a few analysts on my team only want to opt out of the weekly digest while still receiving real-time alerts. We have 146 seats and this is becoming a recurring request as more people join.

Is there a way to manage subscription preferences per alert type per user, or is that on your roadmap? Documentation only covers the global unsubscribe link, so I wanted to check directly.
answer: This is a fair request and one we hear fairly often. Per-alert-type subscription preferences aren't available yet, but it is on our roadmap for notification settings later this year. In the meantime, the closest workaround is creating separate alert rules for digest versus real-time events so users can be excluded from just the digest rule; happy to walk through setting that up if useful.

subject: DUPLICATE DIGEST EMAILS QUESTION
body: WE ARE GETTING TWO COPIES OF THE WEEKLY EMAIL DIGEST FOR SOME ADMIN ACCOUNTS BUT NOT OTHERS. IS THIS EXPECTED BEHAVIOR IF AN ADMIN IS SUBSCRIBED TO BOTH A TEAM DIGEST AND A GLOBAL DIGEST OR IS THIS A BUG. WE HAVE 1258 SEATS AND WANT TO MAKE SURE WE ARE NOT MISCONFIGURING SOMETHING BEFORE WE ROLL OUT DIGESTS COMPANY WIDE.
answer: Thanks for checking before the wider rollout, that's a smart move. This is expected behavior rather than a bug: if an admin account is subscribed to both a team-level digest and the global digest, both are sent independently since they're treated as separate notification rules. If you'd like a single combined digest per admin, I'd recommend unsubscribing those accounts from the team-level digest and relying on the global one, which covers all team activity.

subject: Storage quota exceeded warning blocking new uploads
body:
We started seeing "quota exceeded" errors on new file uploads yesterday afternoon, even though our storage dashboard shows we're at 82% of our allocated quota, not over it. This is affecting our backup workflow for customer records, and as a support engineer I need to confirm whether this is a display lag or an actual limit being hit, since we can't afford gaps in our backup schedule.

We have 50 seats on the Pro plan and this worked fine until yesterday around 3pm. Can someone check our account's actual usage versus the quota shown?
answer: Thanks for including the timing and the discrepancy between the dashboard and the error. We can see your account's actual usage is at 96%, not 82%, which points to a caching issue on the usage dashboard rather than the enforcement itself, and that's what's triggering the upload block. We're refreshing your usage cache now and will follow up shortly to confirm uploads succeed, and I'd also recommend clearing older backup versions if you're close to quota to avoid this recurring.

subject: SDK throwing errors after updating to latest version, blocking production deploy
body:
We updated the Northwind API SDK from 3.2.1 to 3.4.0 this morning ahead of a production deploy and now every call to client.auth.getToken() throws "TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'expiresIn')". This is blocking our deploy scheduled for this afternoon and we only have 4 seats on our team so there's no one else to dig into the SDK internals right now.

We rolled back to 3.2.1 and the error goes away, so it seems tied to the new version specifically. Can you confirm if there's a breaking change in the token response shape we're missing?
answer: Thanks for confirming the rollback works, that helps narrow this down quickly. Version 3.4.0 changed the token response structure as part of a deprecation of the legacy auth flow, and getToken() now expects the new nested token object, which likely isn't documented clearly enough in the changelog. I'm sending you a short code snippet for the updated call signature now, and we're also updating the migration guide today so this breaking change is called out explicitly for anyone else upgrading.

subject: Doppelte E-Mail-Digests werden seit heute Morgen verschickt
body:
Seit heute Morgen erhalten mehrere Nutzer aus unserem Team jeden Digest zweimal, mit identischem Inhalt. Im Log unseres Webhook-Empfängers sehen wir Folgendes:

2024-05-14 07:12:03 INFO digest_id=8841 status=sent recipient=ops-team
2024-05-14 07:12:21 INFO digest_id=8841 status=sent recipient=ops-team
2024-05-14 07:31:09 ERROR retry_triggered reason="ack_timeout" digest_id=8841
2024-05-14 07:31:10 INFO digest_id=8841 status=sent recipient=ops-team

Es sieht so aus, als würde ein Ack-Timeout einen erneuten Versand auslösen, obwohl der erste Versand erfolgreich war. Wir haben nur 12 Sitzplätze, daher fällt das sofort allen auf. Könnt ihr das bitte prüfen?
answer: Vielen Dank für die Logauszüge, das macht die Ursache sehr klar. Es sieht tatsächlich so aus, als würde unser Ack-Timeout einen erneuten Versand auslösen, selbst wenn der digest_id 8841 bereits erfolgreich zugestellt wurde. Wir passen die Timeout-Schwelle für euren Workspace an und beobachten die nächsten Digest-Läufe, um zu bestätigen, dass keine Duplikate mehr auftreten; wir melden uns hier mit einem Update.

subject: Request to change alert routing rules for our escalation team
body:
We'd like to update our alert routing so that critical alerts go directly to our on-call escalation group instead of the general ops inbox, which is currently getting flooded with lower priority alerts too. We have 14 seats and only two people are actually on the escalation rotation, so most of the team doesn't need to see these.

Could you point me to how routing rules are configured, or if this needs to be set up on your end? Happy to provide the specific alert types we want routed differently.
answer: Thanks for the clear breakdown of what you're trying to achieve. Alert routing rules can be configured directly from your Notifications settings under 'Routing', where you can create a rule that filters by alert priority or type and directs matches to a specific group rather than the default inbox. If you send over the list of alert types you'd like routed to the escalation group, I'm also happy to set the initial rule up for you and share the config so your team can adjust it going forward.

subject: Storage quota reached warning but usage looks lower than expected
body: We got a notification that our storage quota is at 92% but when I check the usage breakdown in the admin panel it only adds up to about 68%. We're on the Starter plan and have 19 seats, mostly used for storing trip itinerary attachments and receipts. Can someone confirm what's actually counted toward the quota? We'd like to understand if backup snapshots are included since we set retention to 30 days recently.
answer: Thanks for flagging this discrepancy. Backup snapshots created under your retention policy are indeed counted against your storage quota, which likely explains the gap between the dashboard total and the usage alert. I'll pull your account's detailed breakdown and send you an itemized report showing snapshot vs. active file usage within the next business day.

subject: Users still receiving emails after unsubscribing
body: Several of our staff have unsubscribed from the weekly digest notifications through the link in the email, but they're continuing to receive them. We've confirmed at least 6 people affected since last Tuesday. This is causing complaints since we're an education-focused travel company and staff expect to control their own notification preferences.
answer: I'm sorry for the trouble this is causing your team. This sounds like an issue with unsubscribe preferences not syncing to the notification queue in time — we've seen this when a digest batch is already queued before the unsubscribe request processes. Can you send me one or two of the affected user identifiers so I can check their subscription status directly and confirm whether the fix needs to happen on our end?

subject: Slack alert delivery delayed by 10+ minutes during market hours
body: Our Slack integration for trade alerts has been lagging badly since Monday morning. Alerts that should fire within seconds of a threshold breach are showing up 10-15 minutes late in our #trading-alerts channel. We rely on this heavily during market open at 9:30am ET, and the delay makes the alerts nearly useless for same-day decisions. We haven't changed anything on our Okta or Jira integration configs recently.
answer: Thank you for the detailed report — a delay of this magnitude during market hours is a real problem and we're prioritizing it. We're checking whether this is related to a queue backlog on the Slack connector or a delivery bottleneck upstream; I'll update you within a few hours with findings. In the meantime, could you confirm the workspace ID and channel so we can trace the specific message timestamps?

subject: Email digest not including all triggered events
body: I'm integrating the Notifications API to send daily email digests to our retail store managers, but I'm noticing that digests are missing events that occurred late in the collection window. For example, on March 4th an inventory alert fired at 11:52pm but never appeared in the digest sent the next morning. The API docs don't specify the exact cutoff time for digest aggregation, so I'm not sure if this is expected behavior or a bug.
answer: Good catch, and thanks for the specific timestamp — that's very helpful. The digest aggregation window currently closes at 11:45pm server time, which isn't clearly documented and likely explains the missing event. I'll get the docs updated to reflect this cutoff, and I'm also flagging this internally since a 15-minute gap before midnight is tighter than most integrators would expect.

subject: Bulk file uploads failing with quota errors despite available space
body: Since this morning our automated upload pipeline has been failing for roughly 40% of files with a 'storage quota exceeded' error, even though our admin console shows we're only at 71% of our allocated quota. This is affecting logistics manifest backups that run every 15 minutes, and we're now missing scheduled backup windows. This started around 8am today and is still ongoing as of this ticket.
answer: This is being treated as a priority incident given the impact to your backup schedule. We're seeing on our end that quota enforcement may be miscalculating available space for accounts with active retention policies, and we're actively investigating the root cause right now. I'll update you within the hour with either a fix or a temporary workaround so your uploads can resume.

subject: Multiple dashboard charts showing blank or error state
body: As of this morning, several of our shared dashboards are showing charts that either render completely blank or display 'Error loading chart data' instead of the expected visualizations. This is affecting at least 5 dashboards that our editorial and analytics teams rely on daily, including ones shared externally with partners. It started right after we noticed a scheduled maintenance notice yesterday evening.
answer: Thank you for reporting this right away — we understand these dashboards are business-critical and we're treating this as a high priority issue. Our team is investigating whether last night's maintenance affected chart rendering services, and we're reproducing the error state now. I'll follow up shortly with either a resolution or an estimated timeline, and please let me know if the externally shared dashboards are causing partner-facing problems in the meantime.

subject: PDF export via API returns malformed file
body: I'm calling the dashboard export endpoint to generate PDF reports programmatically, but the resulting files are corrupted and won't open in Adobe Reader or Preview. The response returns a 200 status with what looks like valid binary data, but the file size is consistently around 2KB regardless of dashboard complexity, which seems too small. This is blocking our automated reporting workflow for manufacturing plant metrics.
answer: Thanks for the details, especially the consistent 2KB file size — that strongly suggests the export is failing silently and returning a placeholder or error payload with a 200 status instead of a proper error code. Could you share the dashboard ID and a sample request so we can reproduce this on our end? We'll also check whether this is specific to certain chart types within the dashboard.

subject: How to handle pagination for large dataset exports via API
body: We're setting up a new integration and need to pull large datasets through the API Platform. The docs mention a 'next_cursor' field but don't clarify what happens when a cursor expires or how long results remain valid between paginated calls. Since we're a small legal team with limited dev resources, we want to make sure we implement this correctly the first time rather than debugging edge cases later.
answer: Good question, and I can see why the current documentation leaves this unclear. Cursors are valid for 15 minutes from the initial request, and if a cursor expires mid-pagination you'll need to restart the query from the beginning rather than resuming from that point. I'll pass along a request to have this detail added explicitly to the pagination guide, and I'm happy to walk through a sample pagination loop with you if that would help.

subject: Getting 429 errors on nearly every API call since last night
body: Starting around 10pm last night our integration began receiving 429 Too Many Requests errors on almost every call to the API Platform, even during periods where our request volume is normally well under any documented limit. We haven't changed our polling frequency in months. This is currently blocking our freight tracking updates from syncing, which our operations team depends on throughout the day.
answer: I'm sorry for the disruption this is causing to your freight tracking sync. We're looking into whether there was a change to rate limit thresholds or an issue with how request counts are being tracked on our side, since your described volume shouldn't be triggering 429s. I'll escalate this immediately and follow up as soon as we identify the cause — in the meantime, if you can share your API key ID or a few recent request timestamps, that will help us trace this faster.

subject: Request to route critical alerts to a different escalation channel
body: We'd like to set up our Notifications so that critical severity alerts get routed to a dedicated escalation email address instead of going into the same inbox as our regular informational alerts. Right now everything lands in one place and it's easy for urgent issues to get lost among routine notifications. We only have 11 seats so we don't have a dedicated ops team, and want a simple way to make sure the important stuff stands out.
answer: That's a reasonable request and something we can help configure. Currently this would require setting up a separate alert rule filtered by severity level pointing to your escalation address — I can walk you through creating that rule in your notification settings, or set it up on our side if you'd prefer to share the target email and severity threshold you want to use. I'll also note this as feedback for a more streamlined routing option in the product.

subject: Push notifications causing app crash after login on iOS
body:
We're seeing push notifications trigger a crash on iOS right after users log in through the Mobile App. Our support team logged 14 crash reports since yesterday morning, all on iOS 17.4 devices, version 6.2.1 of the app. The crash happens within 2-3 seconds of the login screen dismissing when a push notification banner appears. Android devices seem unaffected so far.

Can you escalate this given the volume of affected users? We have 243 seats on this account and the crash reports are climbing.
answer: Thanks for flagging this with the crash counts, that's very helpful. We're pulling the crash logs tied to your account now and cross-referencing with the push notification service for iOS 17.4 on app version 6.2.1. This has been escalated to our mobile engineering team given the user impact, and we'll update you within a few hours with findings or a mitigation step, such as a temporary notification delay on login.

subject: Can't share dashboard with external viewer - permission error
body:
Trying to share our quarterly travel spend dashboard with a partner outside our org and getting an error. Here's what shows in the console when I try:

2024-05-14T09:12:03Z ERROR dashboards.share: permission_denied user=partner@external.com dashboard_id=dbx_7841
Context: sharing_scope=external, workspace=blue-partners-prod
Code: SHR-403
Retrying share request... failed after 3 attempts

Is external sharing supported on our plan, or do I need to change a setting? Would also appreciate any docs on chart export options while I'm at it.
answer: Thanks for sending the log, that error code (SHR-403) confirms external sharing outside your organization's domain isn't enabled on the Starter plan by default. I can walk you through enabling it for specific domains, or if you'd prefer, I can point you to our documentation on dashboard sharing scopes and chart export formats. Let me know which works best and I'll follow up with the steps.

subject: connector down NOW
body: Auth broken since 6am. Pipeline dead. FIX THIS.
answer: I'm sorry for the disruption this is causing - I understand pipeline downtime tied to auth failures needs immediate attention. Can you confirm which connector this is (source system name) so I can check the auth token status on our end right away? I'm escalating this to P1 now and will keep you updated every 30 minutes until we identify the cause.

subject: Role mapping not reflecting group changes from SSO provider
body:
We're using SSO with role mapping tied to Azure AD groups, and I've noticed that when I move a user between groups (e.g. from 'Analyst' to 'Manager') in Azure AD, the role in Northwind doesn't update until the user manually logs out and back in. Is there a way to force a refresh, or is this expected behavior tied to session length?

This isn't blocking anything critical, but it's causing confusion when we audit access levels mid-week. Would appreciate clarity on how role mapping sync timing works.
answer: Good question, and this is expected behavior - role mappings are evaluated at each new session/token issuance rather than continuously, so changes in Azure AD groups will only take effect on the user's next login. There isn't currently a way to force a mid-session refresh, but I'll pass this along as feedback since a few other customers have asked about a manual sync option too. Happy to share more detail on session token lifetimes if useful for your audit process.

subject: Recurring card declines blocking API test transactions
body:
I'm integrating the Billing API in our sandbox and every test payment against a linked Visa card is failing with error code card_declined_generic, even though the same card processes fine in Stripe's own test mode. This started around May 10th. We have 5 active seats and this is blocking our checkout flow testing entirely - nothing is going through, test or otherwise.

Can someone check if there's an issue with the sandbox payment processor on your end? This is holding up our launch prep.
answer: Thank you for the detailed report, and I'm sorry this is blocking your testing. A card_declined_generic error affecting all sandbox transactions since May 10th does point to something on our processor integration side rather than your card - we're checking sandbox payment gateway status right now and will confirm within the hour. In the meantime, could you send one recent transaction ID so we can trace it directly in the logs?

subject: File uploads failing intermittently to Storage
body:
For the past two days our team has had about 1 in 5 uploads to Storage fail partway through, mostly larger files over 200MB. The upload progress bar stalls at around 80% then throws a generic 'upload failed, please retry' message. Retrying sometimes works, sometimes takes 3-4 attempts.

We're on a tight deadline for a client deliverable and this is slowing our whole team down. Is there a known issue with large file handling right now, or could this be related to our storage quota?
answer: Thanks for the details on file size and failure rate - that's useful. We haven't seen a broader incident reported, but intermittent failures on larger uploads can sometimes be tied to quota thresholds or timeout settings on our end. Can you confirm your current storage usage percentage so I can rule out quota as a factor, and I'll also check server-side logs for timeout errors on uploads from your workspace over the past two days.

subject: Multiple employees stuck during MFA enrolment
body:
Several employees trying to enroll in MFA for the first time are getting stuck on the QR code screen - it loads, they scan it with an authenticator app, but the verification code entry step just returns 'invalid code' every time, even immediately after scanning. This is happening for at least 6 people across our manufacturing floor team so far, all trying to log in this morning.

This is blocking their ability to log in at all since MFA is mandatory on our account. Could you help us figure out what's going wrong or offer a temporary workaround?
answer: Thanks for reporting this - since MFA is mandatory and this is blocking multiple logins, I'm treating it as priority. The 'invalid code' pattern immediately after scanning often points to a time sync issue between the authenticator app and our server, so please ask affected employees to check their device's automatic time sync setting is enabled. If that doesn't resolve it, I can temporarily lift the MFA requirement for the affected accounts while we investigate further - let me know if you'd like that as an interim step.

subject: WEBHOOKS BROKEN AFTER YOUR API UPDATE
body:
WE JUST GOT NOTICE THAT THE V1 WEBHOOK EVENTS ARE BEING DEPRECATED AND NOW OUR ORDR STATUS WEBHOOKS ARE FAILING TO DELIVER SINCE THIS MORNING. WE USE THE NODE SDK VERSION 3.2.0 AND EVERY CALLBACK IS RETURNING A 410 GONE ERROR. THIS IS AFFECTING OUR ENTIRE LOGISTICS PIPELINE, ORDRS ARE NOT UPDATING FOR OUR 204 USERS.

WE NEED A MIGRATION PATH RIGHT NOW, THIS SHOULD NOT HAVE BROKEN WITHOUT WARNING.
answer: I hear you, and I'm sorry for the disruption - a 410 Gone on webhook deliveries after the v1 deprecation confirms your endpoints need to migrate to the v2 event schema. We did send an advance notice email about this deprecation window, but I understand it may not have reached the right team. I'm attaching the migration guide for the v2 webhook payload format and the updated Node SDK (4.x) now, and can jump on a call today to help get your order status callbacks working again as quickly as possible.

subject: Audit log missing entries for deactivated users
body:
I noticed our Admin Console audit log doesn't show any entries when a user account is deactivated - I deactivated two accounts yesterday (May 13th) as part of an offboarding process, and neither event appears in the audit log under 'user management' actions, even though other actions like role changes are logged fine.

We rely on this audit trail for compliance reporting, so this gap is a real problem for us. Is this a known bug, or is there a setting we need to enable to capture deactivation events?
answer: Thank you for catching this - deactivation events not appearing in the audit log while other user management actions do log correctly does sound like a bug rather than a missing setting. I've confirmed there's no toggle that would explain this gap, so I'm filing this with our engineering team as a priority fix given the compliance impact. I'll follow up as soon as we have a timeline, and in the meantime I can manually pull the deactivation timestamps from our backend if you need them for reporting now.

subject: Need faster unsubscribe handling for duplicate emails
body:
We've had several customer complaints this week about receiving duplicate transactional emails even after clicking unsubscribe through the Notifications product. It seems the unsubscribe request is processed but doesn't stop emails already queued in a separate alert category, so people get 2-3 duplicate sends before it fully takes effect.

Can you walk us through how unsubscribe scoping works across alert categories, and is there a way to make it apply immediately across all categories rather than per-queue? This is generating real complaints from our fintech customers and we'd like a fix or workaround soon.
answer: Thanks for the clear explanation - this is a known limitation where unsubscribe requests are scoped per alert category rather than applying globally right away, which explains the duplicate sends you're seeing across queues. Given the customer complaints, I'm escalating this as a priority request to our product team for a global unsubscribe option, and in the meantime I can show you how to configure a shared suppression list across categories as a workaround. I'll set up time this week to walk through that with you.

subject: Seat count on invoice doesn't match active users
body: I'm reconciling our latest invoice against our actual user roster and the seat count billed is 588, but when I run a report from the Admin Console I only see 561 active users. We've offboarded 27 people over the last two quarters and it looks like those seats were never released. Can you confirm how seat counts are calculated and whether we're due a credit or refund for the difference?
answer: Thanks for flagging this - seat counts are based on users with an active license at any point during the billing cycle, so offboarded users can still count if they weren't formally deactivated in the Admin Console before the cycle closed. I'll pull your account's license history for the last two quarters and confirm which of the 27 users were deactivated late, then process a pro-rated credit for any seats billed after their deactivation date.

subject: Mobile app crashes immediately on launch after latest update
body: Since updating to the newest version of the Northwind mobile app, it crashes within a second of opening on both iOS and Android devices across our team. This started right after the update rolled out on our side yesterday. We rely on the app for field reporting so this is blocking a good chunk of our analysts from checking dashboards on the go. Push notifications also seem to have stopped coming through before the crashes began.
answer: Sorry for the disruption this is causing - we've seen a few reports of a launch crash tied to the latest release and our mobile team is actively investigating a fix. In the meantime, could you send us the app version and device OS versions affected so we can confirm you're hitting the same issue, and try clearing the app cache or reinstalling as a temporary workaround while we prepare a patch.

subject: Need to upgrade from Starter to a higher plan urgently
body: We're currently on the Starter plan with 8 seats but we've just closed a deal that requires API rate limits and integration features only available on higher tiers. I need this upgrade processed today if possible since our new workflow launches tomorrow morning. Please also let me know if there's a way to prorate the difference on our next invoice instead of paying the full new-tier price immediately.
answer: I understand the time pressure here and I'm escalating this to our billing team right now to get your plan upgraded before end of day. We can prorate the difference on your next invoice rather than charging the full new-tier amount upfront - I'll confirm once the upgrade is live and send you the updated invoice breakdown so you can verify the numbers before your launch tomorrow.

subject: Occasional upload failures to Storage from our pipeline
body: Our data pipeline periodically fails when pushing files to Storage, roughly 3 to 4 times a week, always with files over 2GB. The job logs just show the upload timing out rather than a clear quota error. We're on the Pro tier and I want to understand if this is a retention or quota limit issue, and whether there's a recommended chunking approach for large uploads that we should switch to.
answer: Thanks for the detail - large file timeouts like this are usually resolved by switching to multipart/chunked uploads rather than a single request, which also makes retries much more reliable if a chunk fails. I'll send over our chunked upload guide for the Storage API, and in the meantime I'd recommend checking your current quota usage in the console just to rule out throttling as a contributing factor.

subject: URGENT: API returning errors after deprecated endpoint shutdown
body: Our production integration just started failing completely - every call to /v1/webhooks/register is returning 410 Gone as of a few minutes ago. We received no advance notice this endpoint was being deprecated and shut off. This is breaking our entire booking confirmation flow for customers right now and we have no fallback in place. We need to know the replacement endpoint immediately.
answer: I'm escalating this to our API platform team as a P0 immediately since this is affecting your production traffic right now. The replacement endpoint is /v2/webhooks/subscriptions, which uses a similar payload structure - I'm sending you the migration doc and a minimal code sample right now so you can switch over as fast as possible, and we'll follow up on why the deprecation notice didn't reach your account.

subject: Dashboards extremely slow across the whole org since this morning
body: Since around 9am today, every dashboard we open takes 15-20 seconds just to load the first chart, and shared dashboards are timing out for several teams entirely. This is affecting all 285 of our users, not just a few people, and it's severely disrupting our morning reporting cycle. Nothing has changed on our end - no new charts or data sources were added recently.
answer: Thank you for reporting this promptly - we're seeing elevated load times on the dashboard rendering service and have escalated this internally as a priority incident given the org-wide impact. Our engineering team is investigating the root cause now and I'll update you as soon as we have a fix deployed or a clearer timeline, likely within the hour.

subject: Need to restrict Admin Console access by IP immediately
body: We had a laptop stolen from one of our analysts yesterday and need to lock down access to the Admin Console to only our office IP range as a precaution. I can't find an IP allowlist setting anywhere in the console under Settings. We also need to deactivate that analyst's account and pull an audit log of their recent activity to check for anything suspicious.
answer: Given the security concern here, I'm treating this as high priority - I've deactivated the affected account on your behalf as a first step. IP allowlisting is available under Settings > Security in the Admin Console for Enterprise-tier accounts; I'll check your current plan configuration and get this enabled for you right away, along with pulling the audit log for the analyst's account over the last 30 days.

subject: How do I get a proper invoice with our tax ID on it?
body: We need invoices for our records that include our company tax ID for compliance, but the ones I'm downloading from the billing portal only show our billing address, not the tax ID we entered during signup. This is for our fintech compliance audit next week so I need to get this sorted soon. Can you tell me how to update the invoice template or where this field should show up?
answer: Thanks for flagging this - tax ID display depends on the field being correctly saved under Billing Settings, and it sounds like it may not have synced to your invoice template. I'll check your account configuration and regenerate your recent invoices with the tax ID included, and confirm the setting is fixed so future invoices show it automatically before your audit.

subject: Push notifications not arriving on mobile app for entire team
body: Our field staff across all 452 seats stopped receiving push notifications from the mobile app starting yesterday afternoon. Notifications show as sent in our admin logs but nothing arrives on devices, iOS or Android. This is a major problem since our dispatch alerts go through this channel. We haven't changed any device or notification settings on our end recently.
answer: This is impacting your whole team's dispatch workflow so I'm escalating this to our mobile infrastructure team right away as a priority issue. We're checking whether there's a delivery problem with our push notification provider on our end - can you confirm the app version your devices are running so we can rule out a client-side certificate expiry, which has caused similar delivery gaps before.

subject: Slack alerts from Integrations not posting to our channels
body: Our Slack integration for incident alerts has stopped posting to any of our configured channels as of this morning. We rely on this for logistics alerts across our whole operations team and right now nothing is coming through, even though the integration shows as 'connected' in the settings page. We also use Jira and Salesforce integrations but those seem unaffected so far - just Slack.
answer: Thanks for reporting this - since only Slack is affected while Jira and Salesforce integrations continue working, this points to an issue with the Slack webhook token or workspace authorization rather than a broader integrations outage. I'd like you to try disconnecting and reconnecting the Slack integration under Integrations settings; if that doesn't restore alerts, we'll check our Slack API logs on our end to confirm whether the token needs re-authorization, and I'm marking this as priority given the operational impact.

subject: Storage API returning 507 on uploads since this morning
body: We're integrating the Storage API into our fintech platform and since around 09:15 UTC today, roughly 40% of our upload requests to /v1/storage/objects are failing with a 507 Insufficient Storage error, even though our dashboard shows we're well under our quota. This started right after we bumped our upload volume for a batch job (about 3,000 files, avg 2MB each). Customer ID is lumen-robotics-prod. We need this resolved quickly since our nightly reconciliation job depends on these uploads completing.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report — a P1 on upload failures is exactly the kind of thing we want to jump on immediately. We're checking the storage node quota allocation for lumen-robotics-prod right now, since a 507 with headroom showing in the dashboard usually points to a stale quota cache on our end rather than your actual usage. We'll update you within the hour with either a fix or a workaround for your batch job.

subject: Getting duplicate email alerts for the same event
body: Since yesterday afternoon our team has been receiving two identical email notifications for every alert triggered in our Notifications workflows — same event ID, same timestamp, sent about 90 seconds apart. It's happening across all alert types we've configured, not just one rule. We've had a few of our own clients ask why they got the same case update twice, so we'd like this fixed soon and would appreciate confirmation once it's resolved.
answer: Thank you for flagging this — duplicate alerts causing confusion for your clients is a priority for us. We've seen a similar pattern tied to a retry mechanism that can double-fire under certain latency conditions on the alerting service; we're checking your account's notification logs now to confirm that's the cause here. We'll follow up shortly with either a config change or a fix timeline, and will let you know once we've confirmed the duplicates have stopped.

subject: How do refunds and credits get applied against invoices?
body: We recently had a billing dispute over an API overage charge on our March invoice (INV-88213) and support issued a credit, but I can't find where that credit shows up when I query the /v1/billing/invoices endpoint — the invoice still shows the full original amount due. Is the credit applied at payment time only, or should it be reflected in the invoice object itself? We need to reconcile this in our own accounting system.
answer: Good question, and thanks for pointing out the discrepancy. Credits are applied at the time of payment collection rather than being reflected retroactively on the invoice object itself, so the invoice will keep showing the original total while the credit reduces the amount actually charged — you can see this in the associated payment or transaction object instead. We'll also flag this to our docs team since it's a common point of confusion, and I'll confirm the exact credit amount applied to INV-88213 for your records shortly.

subject: Mobile app crashing immediately on launch for our whole team
body: As of this morning, the Northwind mobile app is crashing on launch for what looks like our entire workspace — over a dozen of our 282 seats have reported it so far across both iOS and Android. Users get a splash screen and then the app closes within a second or two, before login even loads. This is blocking field staff who rely on the app for offline case access. Can we get an urgent fix or at least a workaround?
answer: This is a P1 for us and we're treating it as such — a launch crash affecting your whole workspace before login even loads points to something in the latest app release rather than account-specific config. We're pulling crash logs tied to your workspace right now to confirm the root cause and will send a workaround (likely reverting to the previous app version) within the next hour while we prepare a fix.

subject: Okta-Integration zeigt veraltete Gruppenmitgliedschaften
body: Wir nutzen die Okta-App aus dem Integrations-Katalog, um Nutzergruppen mit unseren Northwind-Workspaces zu synchronisieren. Seit letzter Woche bemerken wir, dass neue Gruppenmitglieder in Okta nicht innerhalb der üblichen 15 Minuten in Northwind auftauchen, sondern teilweise erst nach mehreren Stunden. Das betrifft mehrere Teams gleichzeitig und beeinträchtigt unsere Zugriffssteuerung für ca. 1600 Nutzer. Gibt es aktuell bekannte Performance-Probleme bei der Sync-Pipeline?
answer: Vielen Dank für die genaue Beschreibung. Uns ist tatsächlich eine erhöhte Latenz in der Sync-Pipeline für die Okta-Integration bei mehreren Enterprise-Kunden aufgefallen, die wir aktuell untersuchen. Wir prüfen die Warteschlange für Ihren Workspace und melden uns innerhalb der nächsten Stunden mit einem Status-Update sowie, falls nötig, einer manuellen Anstoßung der Synchronisierung für die betroffenen Gruppen.

subject: SEAT COUNT IS WRONG AGAIN AND WE'RE GETTING CHARGED FOR IT
body: This is the THIRD time this quarter our seat count has jumped without us adding anyone. We're on Starter with 25 seats and the billing page now shows 31 active seats, which means we're about to get an overage charge for people who don't even exist in our workspace anymore. We removed 6 users back in February and they're STILL showing as billable. If this isn't fixed before the next invoice cycle we are cancelling and moving to another provider, we're tired of chasing this every month.
answer: I completely understand the frustration, and repeated seat count errors on your invoice are not acceptable — I'm escalating this immediately so it's fixed before your next billing cycle runs. I'm pulling the seat history for your workspace now to find the 6 users removed in February and confirm why they're still marked billable, and I'll personally follow up today with the corrected count and confirmation that the overage charge will not be applied.

subject: Question on data retention period for Storage backups
body: We're setting up our compliance documentation and I want to confirm how long Storage backups are retained by default on the Starter plan. Our records show backups older than 30 days seem to disappear from the retention list in the dashboard, but I couldn't find this stated explicitly anywhere in the docs. Could you confirm the exact retention window and whether it's configurable, since we're a fintech-adjacent education platform with some audit requirements?
answer: Thanks for checking on this before your audit — on the Starter plan, backup retention is fixed at 30 days and isn't currently configurable; extended or custom retention windows are available on our higher tiers. I'll pass along your feedback about making this clearer in the docs, and if you need a longer retention window for compliance purposes, I can walk you through what upgrading would involve.

subject: Okta app integration broken - SSO login failing for all users
body: We configured the Okta app from the Integrations catalog two days ago and initial SSO logins worked fine, but starting this morning every login attempt through Okta fails with 'AADSTS-equivalent' error on our end reading invalid_client, unable to find client for this request. This is blocking all 24 of our users from signing in via SSO. We haven't changed any client secrets or redirect URIs on our end since setup. Northwind app ID is okta-app-lumenacademy-01.
answer: This is a P1 for us given it's blocking all SSO logins — an 'invalid_client' error like this on a previously working setup usually means the client secret or app registration got rotated or expired on our side. We're checking the configuration for okta-app-lumenacademy-01 right now and will either restore the correct credentials or issue you a new client secret within the hour, along with instructions if any update is needed on the Okta side.

subject: Need clarification on how a refund credit affects our next invoice
body: We were issued a partial refund credit last month after an incident, and I want to make sure our accounting team applies it correctly before we generate our internal reports. Could someone confirm whether the credit will automatically reduce the total on our next invoice, or if we need to request it be applied manually? We're on the Starter plan with 22 seats, and our next billing cycle closes in about two weeks.
answer: Thanks for planning ahead on this. Refund credits are applied automatically at the time your next invoice is generated, so it will show as a deduction on the invoice closing in two weeks rather than needing a manual request on your end. I'll add a note to your account confirming the credit amount so your accounting team has a clear reference when the invoice is issued.

subject: Urgent: hitting storage quota limit, uploads blocked for all users
body: As of about an hour ago, every upload attempt in our workspace is failing with 'quota exceeded' even though we're only using around 8GB and believe our Starter plan allocation should cover more than that. This is blocking all 12 of our team members from uploading files needed for today's deployment records. We haven't changed our retention settings or backup configuration recently. Can someone check our quota allocation urgently?
answer: Thanks for the urgent flag — we're looking into your workspace's quota allocation right now, since 8GB usage triggering a quota-exceeded error on Starter suggests a possible misconfiguration or sync issue on our side rather than an actual limit being hit. We'll confirm the correct allocation and get uploads unblocked for your whole team as quickly as possible, and will follow up with root cause once resolved.

subject: Audit log missing deactivation events for offboarded staff
body:
We rely on the Admin Console audit log for our SOC2 evidence collection, and I've noticed that user deactivation events aren't showing up consistently. Out of 14 accounts we deactivated between March 1 and March 10, only 6 appear in the audit trail. We also can't find a way to add specific admin emails to an allowlist for audit exports.

Can you confirm whether deactivation logging is expected to capture every event, and whether an allowlist/export feature is on the roadmap? Our compliance review is due in two weeks and this gap is a real problem for 235 seats worth of user activity.
answer: Thanks for flagging this, and I understand the time pressure with your compliance review. We're treating the missing deactivation events as a priority bug and I've opened an investigation into why 8 of the 14 events didn't log correctly - I'll need the exact user IDs or emails for those 8 accounts to trace them in our backend. On the allowlist/export request, I'm logging that as product feedback and will follow up separately once I have an update from the team.

subject: App crashes immediately after opening on iOS
body:
Since updating to the latest version of the Northwind mobile app on my iPhone (iOS 17.4), the app crashes within a second of opening the login screen. It happened three times in a row this morning, and two other people on my team report the same issue on their iPhones. Android users on our team seem fine.

We use the mobile app for approving expense reports on the go, so this is blocking a few of us from getting work done while traveling. Is there a known issue with the latest release, or something we can do on our end to fix it?
answer: Sorry for the disruption this is causing while you're traveling. We've had a couple of other reports of crashes on iOS 17.4 tied to the most recent app version, and our mobile team is actively looking into a fix. In the meantime, could you try clearing the app's local cache under Settings > Storage on your device and reinstalling from the App Store? That's resolved the crash for a few users while we finalize the permanent fix.

subject: Data Pipeline connector auth failing across all sources - production down
body:
As of 6:40am today, every one of our Data Pipeline connectors is failing authentication, including our three main SCADA feeds and the billing warehouse sync. The error returned is 'invalid_grant: token expired or revoked' even though we refreshed the OAuth credentials two weeks ago and nothing has changed on our end.

This is a full outage for us - no data has synced in over 90 minutes and our energy load forecasting dashboards are now showing stale numbers. We have 200 seats depending on this data being current. Please escalate, this is affecting our entire operation.
answer: This has been escalated immediately as a P0 outage. We're seeing a pattern consistent with a token revocation issue on our OAuth provider side that started around 6:30am and is affecting multiple customers, not just your account - our infrastructure team is actively working the incident. I'll post updates here every 30 minutes until connectors are reauthenticating successfully, and we'll confirm once your specific sync jobs have caught up on the backlog.

subject: Scheduled sync jobs running hours late
body:
I'm integrating our content metadata into Northwind via the Data Pipelines API, and our scheduled sync that's supposed to run every night at 1am has been running anywhere from 3 to 6 hours late for the past four days. The connector status shows 'completed' each time, but the timestamps in the run history don't match the configured schedule.

Our downstream reporting depends on fresh data by 6am, so this delay is causing stale numbers in our morning reports. Is there a known issue with the scheduler for Starter plan pipelines, or something misconfigured on our connector?
answer: Thanks for the detail on the run history mismatch - that's helpful. We've seen intermittent scheduler delays affecting a subset of connectors this week, and I want to check whether your pipeline is caught in that queue backlog rather than a misconfiguration. Could you send me the connector ID so I can pull the exact run logs and confirm the root cause? In the meantime I'd recommend not changing the schedule config, since that can sometimes reset the queue position and add further delay.

subject: SCIM provisioning creating duplicate users after role changes
body:
We rolled out SCIM provisioning for our identity setup last week, and since then we're seeing duplicate user records created whenever someone's role changes in our source IdP. For example, one employee who moved from Analyst to Manager now has two accounts in Northwind, and neither has the right permission set.

This is a request to get clarity on the expected behavior here - should SCIM be updating the existing record on a role change, or is there additional config needed on our side? We have 24 seats and can't safely roll this out further until we understand what's happening.
answer: Thanks for the clear example - a role change should update the existing SCIM-provisioned record, not create a new one, so this does look like unexpected behavior on our side. Could you share the external ID and the two duplicate user IDs from your Northwind admin panel? I want to check whether the duplication is tied to how the role change is being sent in the PATCH request, and I'll prioritize this given it's blocking your rollout.

subject: Email digest issue
body:
Our team switched over to weekly email digests a couple of months ago as part of a broader push to reduce alert fatigue after several employees complained about too many individual notifications. We spent time configuring digest preferences per team and thought things were working well until this week.

Starting Monday, everyone on our 127-seat account has been receiving the same weekly digest email twice, sometimes three times, within a few hours of each other. It's generating a lot of confused messages in our internal IT channel and undoing the whole point of switching to digests in the first place. Can you check what changed?
answer: Thanks for the background - that helps explain the timing. We can see digest jobs firing multiple times for your account starting Monday, which points to a duplicate scheduling issue rather than anything in your configuration. I'm escalating this to our notifications team now since it's affecting all 127 seats, and I'll update you as soon as we identify why the duplicate sends started this week.

subject: Request to change Slack alert routing for Integrations
body:
We currently have Slack alerts configured through the Integrations page to post booking failure notifications into our #ops channel, but we'd like to change this so critical failures go to a separate #ops-urgent channel instead, while keeping the lower-priority ones in #ops. Right now everything lands in one channel and important alerts get lost in the noise.

Is it possible to set up rule-based routing by severity within the same Slack integration, or would we need to create a second integration instance? Also open to feedback on best practice here since we're a small ops team of 30.

subject: Getting logged out too frequently

subject: SCIM sync failing for a subset of users with permission errors
body:
We integrated SCIM provisioning against our IdP for our 267-seat account, and it's been working fine for most users, but around 20 accounts consistently fail to sync with a 403 error and the message 'insufficient_scope: missing group.write permission.' answer: Nested group structures are a known limitation with our current SCIM connector - the group.write scope isn't being correctly inherited for nested groups, which explains the 403s you're seeing. As a workaround, flattening those 20 users into a top-level group in your IdP should let them provision successfully and unblock MFA setup, and I'll get you added to the list for updates once nested group support ships.

subject: Best practice for paginating large API responses
body:
We're integrating with the Northwind API Platform to pull transaction records for reconciliation, and some of our list endpoints return thousands of rows. Right now we're just increasing the page size parameter as high as it will go, but I want to confirm the recommended approach.

Could you clarify the max page size, whether cursor-based pagination is preferred over offset, and if there's an SDK helper for auto-paging through results? We're using the Node SDK version 4.2 and want to avoid hitting rate limits unnecessarily.
answer: Good question, and glad you're checking before scaling this up. The API supports cursor-based pagination via the next_cursor field, and we recommend that over offset-based paging since it stays consistent even if records are added mid-fetch; max page size is 200 per request. The Node SDK (4.x) has a built-in auto-paginate iterator, client.transactions.listAll(), that handles cursor advancement and respects rate limit backoff automatically, so that would be the cleanest path for your reconciliation job.

subject: CANT SHARE DASHBOARD WITH EXTERNAL LEGAL TEAM

subject: Biometric login crashing app for field team
body: Multiple drivers using the Northwind mobile app are reporting that the app crashes immediately after they try to log in with fingerprint or Face ID, starting this morning around 7am local time. It happens on both iOS and Android and forces them back to the lock screen with no error message. Since our dispatch workflow depends on mobile check-ins, we now have around 40 drivers unable to start their routes.
answer: This is impacting a critical part of your operation, so we're treating it as high priority right now. We're already seeing a spike in crash reports tied to biometric login on the latest app build and our mobile team is reproducing it on both platforms as we speak. In the meantime, please have affected users switch to PIN login as a workaround, and we'll send an update within the next couple of hours as we isolate the root cause.

subject: Feedback on repeated duplicate alert issue
body: We've noticed intermittent duplicate notification deliveries for the same event over the past month, roughly one or two duplicates per week across our care coordination alerts. It's not urgent since staff can identify duplicates by timestamp, but it does create confusion for on-call clinicians reviewing alert history. I wanted to formally log this pattern in case it's related to a broader retry or webhook issue on your end.
answer: Thank you for taking the time to document this pattern, it's genuinely useful context. We'll add this to our tracked cases on notification duplication and have engineering review whether retry logic on webhook delivery could be the underlying cause. I'll follow up once we have more insight into a permanent fix, and in the meantime feel free to keep sending timestamps for any further occurrences.

subject: Shared dashboard charts rendering blank for external viewers
body: We share several revenue dashboards externally with clients, and since last week the bar and line charts appear completely blank for anyone accessing via the shared link, even though the same dashboards render fine when we're logged in. This is affecting the quarterly review dashboard we send to about a dozen clients. Could you confirm whether this is a known rendering issue with shared links or something specific to our account?
answer: Thanks for the clear description, this does sound like it's isolated to the shared-link rendering path rather than the dashboard data itself. We'll check whether a recent change to how shared views handle chart caching is affecting your account, and in the meantime, regenerating the share link sometimes resolves this temporarily. We'll confirm root cause and next steps within one business day.

subject: How to configure push notifications for new app rollout
body: We're rolling out the Northwind mobile app to our staff for the first time and want to make sure push notifications for assignment updates are set up correctly before go-live next week. Could you point us to documentation on enabling push notifications at the org level, and clarify whether individual users need to opt in separately on their devices?
answer: Congrats on the upcoming rollout! Push notifications need to be enabled at the org level in Admin Console under Notification Settings, and individual users will still need to grant permission on their device the first time they open the app. I'm attaching our setup guide, and happy to walk through it live if that would help before your launch date.

subject: URGENT: IP allowlist change blocking all API access, possible breach
body: At 2:14am UTC our IP allowlist in Admin Console appears to have been modified without authorization, removing all our office and CI/CD IP ranges. As a result every API integration we run is now returning 403 Forbidden, including our client-facing case management sync used by all 137 seats. We suspect unauthorized access to an admin account and need this investigated immediately, along with a full audit log export for the last 48 hours.
answer: We're treating this as a security incident and have escalated immediately to our security and infrastructure teams. We're pulling the audit log now to identify the account and timestamp of the allowlist change, and as a precaution we recommend rotating credentials for any admin accounts with allowlist edit permissions right away. You'll hear from us within the next 30 minutes with findings and remediation steps, including restoring your prior IP ranges.

subject: Late-arriving data causing gaps in daily pipeline reports
body: We've noticed that some records in our content licensing pipeline arrive up to 6 hours after their event timestamp, which means our daily aggregation report generated at midnight is missing data that shows up later that morning.
