It's not breaking anything critical, but our weekly totals sometimes look inconsistent between the daily view and the retroactive full-week view. Is there a way to configure the pipeline to account for expected late arrivals?
answer: Good question, and this is a common pattern with event-based sources. Data Pipelines supports a configurable lateness window that lets you delay finalizing an aggregation window to catch records arriving after the event timestamp. I'll send over the config steps for setting a 6-8 hour buffer on your daily job so your totals stay consistent between the daily and weekly views.

subject: Request to expand Salesforce integration for our logistics workflows
body: We currently sync customer and shipment records from Salesforce into Northwind, but our operations team also wants Slack notifications when a Salesforce opportunity status changes, plus Jira ticket creation for exception cases. We have 267 users across ops and support who would benefit from this. Could you let us know what's currently supported versus on the roadmap for connecting Salesforce with Slack and Jira through Northwind Integrations?
answer: Thanks for laying out the workflow you're aiming for. Slack notifications triggered by Salesforce field changes are supported today through our integration templates, and I can help configure that this week. Jira ticket creation for exception handling is on our near-term roadmap but not yet released, so I'll flag your account as an interested customer and keep you posted as it moves closer to availability.

subject: Question about credits for unused seats and refund process
body: We reduced our team from 240 to 217 active users last month but I don't see a prorated credit reflected on our most recent invoice. Could you clarify how Northwind handles seat reductions mid-cycle, and whether we're eligible for a credit or refund for the unused seats from the past billing period? We'd like this resolved before our next invoice generates on the 1st.
answer: Thanks for reaching out, and we can definitely get this looked at before your next billing cycle. Seat reductions typically prorate starting the next billing cycle rather than retroactively, but let me review your account's specific invoice history to see if a partial credit applies given the timing of your change. I'll follow up within one business day with the exact credit amount, if any, and confirm it before your invoice on the 1st generates.

subject: Alerts routing to wrong distribution list
body: We have a routing rule set up so that warehouse-down alerts go to our ops-alerts@ distribution list, but since Tuesday (the 14th) they've been landing in the general notifications inbox instead, which nobody monitors closely. I checked the rule config under Alerting > Routing and the conditions still show the correct tag match (severity=critical, source=warehouse), so this looks like a bug on your end rather than a config mistake. Could you also let us know if it's possible to route by multiple tags at once? That would help us avoid this kind of misfire in the future.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report and for including the rule conditions, that helps a lot. We've seen one other case of routing rules silently falling back to the default channel after a rule update, and we're checking whether your account was affected by the same regression. I'll verify the rule engine logs for your alert stream from the 14th onward and get back to you within one business day with a fix or workaround. I'll also pass along the multi-tag routing request to product as a feature ask, since it's come up before.

subject: SAML SSO login broken for entire team
body: As of this morning none of our staff can log into Northwind through our SAML SSO connection - everyone gets bounced back to the login page with 'Authentication failed, please contact your administrator.' We haven't changed anything on our identity provider side recently. We have 8 people who need access today to process payroll approvals, so this is blocking real work. Can someone look into this urgently?
answer: I understand this is blocking payroll work, so I'm treating this as a priority issue. Can you confirm which identity provider you're using and send us the SAML response or a screenshot of the error your users see, along with one affected user's login email? In the meantime, please check whether your IdP certificate is still valid, since an expired signing cert is the most common cause of this exact error. I'll stay on this ticket until login is restored.

subject: App crashes right after opening on one device
body: One of our field staff has the mobile app crashing immediately on launch after updating to the latest version. It happens every time on their device, a Pixel running Android 14, but the rest of our team on other phones seems fine. No error message appears, the app just closes back to the home screen within a second or two. It's not urgent since it's isolated to this one user, but wanted to flag it since it started right after the update.
answer: Thanks for the details, that narrows things down nicely. A crash isolated to one device right after an update is often tied to a corrupted local cache from the migration, so as a first step could you have that user clear the app's storage/cache (or uninstall and reinstall) and try again? If it still crashes, please ask them to send us the crash log via Settings > Help > Send Diagnostics so we can see the actual stack trace, and we'll dig further from there.

subject: Dashboards laden sehr langsam seit heute Morgen
body: Seit heute Morgen dauert das Laden unserer Umsatz-Dashboards deutlich länger als sonst, teilweise über 20 Sekunden statt der üblichen 2-3 Sekunden. Besonders betroffen sind die Charts mit mehreren verknüpften Datenquellen und die geteilten Dashboards, die wir an externe Partner freigegeben haben. Der Export nach CSV funktioniert zwar noch, bricht aber bei größeren Datensätzen manchmal mit einem Timeout ab. Wir haben aktuell mehrere hundert Nutzer, die auf diese Dashboards angewiesen sind, daher wäre eine schnelle Rückmeldung sehr hilfreich.
answer: Vielen Dank für die genaue Beschreibung. Wir sehen bereits erhöhte Ladezeiten auf einigen Dashboard-Clustern und vermuten einen Zusammenhang mit einem laufenden Reindexing-Job auf unserer Seite. Unser Team arbeitet aktuell daran, die Last zu reduzieren, und wir geben Ihnen innerhalb der nächsten Stunden ein Update. Für die Export-Timeouts empfehlen wir vorübergehend, die Datensätze zu filtern oder in kleineren Zeiträumen zu exportieren, bis das Problem behoben ist.

subject: Webhook retries and deprecated payload format
body: We've noticed our webhook endpoint for shipment.updated events is getting duplicate deliveries roughly 1 in 20 times, which we think is due to retries firing even when our endpoint returns a 200. Separately, we saw a note in the changelog about the v1 webhook payload format being deprecated but no firm date - can you confirm when v1 payloads will stop being sent so we can plan the migration to v2? We're a small team so we'd like to batch this work with any SDK updates needed.
answer: Good catch on the duplicate deliveries - that can happen if our retry logic doesn't correctly detect a 200 response within the timeout window, and we'll check your endpoint's recent delivery logs to confirm. On the deprecation timeline, v1 webhook payloads are scheduled to be sunset in about four months; we'll send a formal notice with the exact date soon, but you can start migrating now using the v2 schema documented in our API reference. Let us know if you'd like sample code for the updated SDK version.

subject: Wie funktioniert ein Plan-Upgrade und Rückerstattung?
body: Wir möchten von unserem aktuellen Starter-Plan auf einen höheren Plan wechseln, weil wir bald mehr API-Aufrufe benötigen. Ich habe aber nicht verstanden, wie die Abrechnung dabei funktioniert - wird der Restbetrag des aktuellen Zyklus verrechnet oder müssen wir den vollen neuen Preis sofort zahlen? Außerdem haben wir letzten Monat versehentlich zwei zusätzliche Sitzplätze gebucht, die wir gar nicht brauchen, und würden gerne wissen, ob dafür eine Rückerstattung möglich ist.
answer: Danke für die Frage, das lässt sich klären. Bei einem Plan-Upgrade berechnen wir die verbleibenden Tage des aktuellen Zyklus anteilig gut und stellen nur die Differenz zum neuen Plan in Rechnung, es entstehen also keine doppelten Kosten. Für die zwei versehentlich gebuchten Sitzplätze prüfen wir gerne eine Rückerstattung - bitte teilen Sie uns das Datum der Buchung mit, damit wir das im Rechnungssystem nachvollziehen können.

subject: SAML provisioning failing to create new user accounts
body: We're rolling out SSO for our organization and have SAML configured against our identity provider, but new users who should be auto-provisioned on first login are instead getting 'No account found for this email' errors. We've confirmed the SAML assertion includes the correct email and group attributes on our side. This is blocking onboarding for around 40 new hires this week who all need access, so we need this resolved quickly.
answer: This sounds like just-in-time provisioning isn't enabled or mapped correctly on your SSO configuration, which would explain why existing users can log in but new ones can't be created automatically. Can you confirm in your Identity and SSO settings whether 'Auto-provision on login' is toggled on, and send us one full SAML assertion (with sensitive values redacted) so we can check the attribute mapping? Given the onboarding deadline this week, we're prioritizing this and will follow up within a few hours.

subject: Receiving duplicate email digests every day
body: For the past three days we've been getting our daily billing summary digest twice each morning, about 10 minutes apart, with identical content. It's not a huge deal content-wise but it's confusing our team and cluttering inboxes. We only have 5 seats on this account so it's easy to notice - can you check what's causing the duplicates and stop them?
answer: Thanks for flagging this right away. Duplicate digest sends usually point to a stuck scheduler job retrying after a delayed acknowledgment, and we're checking your account's notification queue now to confirm. We'll disable the duplicate send while we investigate and follow up today once we've identified the root cause and confirmed the digest is back to sending once daily.

subject: Need increased rate limits and SDK migration guidance
body: We're consistently hitting 429 Too Many Requests on our /shipments and /events endpoints during peak hours, especially around 8-10am when our ops team syncs data. Our current limit seems to be 600 requests/minute per key, which isn't enough anymore given our growth. Also, I noticed the changelog mentions our current SDK version (2.3) is being deprecated - what's the recommended migration path and will the new SDK handle rate limit backoff automatically?
answer: Thanks for the specifics, that helps us size the right change. We can look at raising your rate limit tier given your usage pattern - please confirm your account ID and typical peak request volume so we can calculate an appropriate new limit. On the SDK side, version 3.x does include built-in exponential backoff for 429 responses, which should help with the peak-hour issue directly; we'll send over the migration guide and a deprecation timeline for 2.3 in a follow-up.

subject: Deprecated API endpoints affecting our billing integration
body: We just got a warning in our logs that the /v1/invoices and /v1/webhooks/subscribe endpoints we use for our billing sync are marked deprecated, but we haven't received any official notice with a shutdown date. Our integration depends on these for pulling invoice data into our finance system, and we need to know the timeline so we can plan the SDK upgrade. We're a small team (18 seats) so we'd appreciate clear migration steps rather than having to reverse-engineer the new API.
answer: Apologies for the lack of a direct notice, we'll make sure you're added to our deprecation mailing list going forward. The /v1/invoices and /v1/webhooks/subscribe endpoints are scheduled to be retired in 90 days, with /v2 equivalents already available and largely backward compatible aside from the response format change for line items. We'll send you the migration guide and updated SDK version now so your team has time to test before the cutover.

subject: Frage zur IP-Allowlist im Admin Console
body:
Wir möchten im Admin Console eine IP-Allowlist für unser Team einrichten und haben dazu ein paar Fragen. Wie können wir eine bestehende IP-Adresse deaktivieren, ohne dass Nutzer sofort ausgesperrt werden? Außerdem würde ich gerne wissen, ob Änderungen an der Allowlist im Audit Log nachvollziehbar sind, damit wir das intern dokumentieren können.

Gibt es dazu eine Anleitung oder Best-Practice-Empfehlung für den Einstieg?
answer: Vielen Dank für Ihre Anfrage. Unter Einstellungen > Sicherheit > IP-Allowlist können Sie einzelne Einträge deaktivieren, ohne sie zu löschen – betroffene Nutzer erhalten dann beim nächsten Login-Versuch eine Meldung, aktive Sitzungen bleiben zunächst bestehen. Alle Änderungen an der Allowlist werden automatisch im Audit Log mit Zeitstempel und Benutzer-ID protokolliert, das können Sie unter Berichte > Audit Log exportieren. Eine ausführliche Schritt-für-Schritt-Anleitung finden Sie zudem in unserem Hilfe-Center unter dem Stichwort Allowlist-Verwaltung.

subject: IP allowlist blocking legitimate users after update
body:
After we added three new office IP ranges to the allowlist last night, several users started getting locked out even though their IPs are on the list. Our logs show this:

2024-05-14 09:12:03 ERROR AllowlistCheck: ip=203.0.113.44 status=DENIED reason=range_mismatch
2024-05-14 09:12:07 ERROR AllowlistCheck: ip=203.0.113.51 status=DENIED reason=range_mismatch
2024-05-14 09:14:22 WARN AuditLog: entry_write_failed for allowlist_update id=8841

This is affecting close to 40 users across two departments. Also, as a feature request, it would help to have a dry-run mode before saving allowlist changes.
answer: Thanks for flagging this and for the log excerpt, that's very helpful. It looks like the new ranges may have been saved with an incorrect CIDR mask, which is why the audit log write is also failing on that entry. We're checking entry id 8841 now and will get back to you with a fix or workaround within a few hours so your locked-out users can regain access. We've also logged your request for a dry-run/preview mode for allowlist changes and passed it to the product team as feedback.

subject: App crashes and missed pushes when device is offline
body:
We're seeing repeated crashes on the mobile app when a device loses connectivity mid-session, mostly during login. The app freezes for a few seconds and then closes without an error message. Once connectivity returns, queued push notifications don't always come through either, we've had at least 12 reports this week from field engineers.

This is becoming a real problem for teams working in low-signal areas. Could you look into the offline handling, and is there a way to force a re-sync of missed pushes once the device reconnects?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report, this is helpful for reproducing the issue. It sounds like the offline session cache may be getting corrupted on reconnect, which would explain both the crash and the dropped notifications. We're pulling device logs from a few of the affected sessions now to confirm the root cause, and in the meantime a manual pull-to-refresh on the notifications tab should re-trigger delivery of missed pushes. We'll update you as soon as we have a fix timeline.

subject: Users receiving duplicate email alerts for same event
body: Since yesterday our team has been getting duplicate email notifications for the same events, sometimes three or four copies within a few minutes for a single alert. This started right after we updated our notification preferences to add a new distribution list. It's confusing our editors and causing them to miss which alert is the actual latest one.
answer: Thank you for reporting this, and apologies for the disruption it's causing your team. This looks like a known issue where adding a new distribution list can trigger duplicate processing of existing alert rules, and we're treating it as high priority given the volume of duplicates you're seeing. As an immediate workaround, please pause the newly added distribution list until we confirm a fix, and we'll follow up shortly with next steps.

subject: Invoice totals don't match seat usage
body: I'm integrating with the Billing API to pull invoice data automatically, and I noticed the latest invoice shows charges for 23 seats, but our actual active user count in the admin panel is 19. I want to confirm which number is correct before I build our internal reconciliation report, and if the invoice is wrong, we'd like a refund or credit for the difference.
answer: Thanks for catching this and for the detail on the discrepancy. Invoice seat counts are generated from a snapshot taken a few days before billing, so it can lag behind recent deactivations, but a 4-seat gap is larger than expected and worth investigating. I'm reviewing your account's usage history now to confirm the correct count and will let you know if a credit adjustment is needed on this invoice.

subject: Slack-Integration sendet keine Alerts mehr
body: Seit heute Morgen erhalten wir keine Alerts mehr im verknüpften Slack-Kanal, obwohl in Northwind Cloud weiterhin Events ausgelöst werden. Das betrifft alle Teams, die auf diese Benachrichtigungen für ihre tägliche Arbeit angewiesen sind, unter anderem für die Erstellung von Jira-Tickets aus kritischen Alerts. Die Integration zeigt im Dashboard weiterhin den Status 'Verbunden' an.
answer: Vielen Dank für die schnelle Meldung, das nehmen wir sofort auf. Wir prüfen aktuell, ob es ein Problem mit dem Slack-Webhook-Token oder der Event-Weiterleitung gibt, da der Verbindungsstatus offenbar nicht korrekt aktualisiert wird. Da dies alle Teams betrifft, behandeln wir dies mit hoher Priorität und melden uns innerhalb der nächsten Stunde mit einem Update oder einer Zwischenlösung.

subject: Push notifications not arriving on mobile app
body: Our field staff use the mobile app on both iOS and Android, and since Monday push notifications for login alerts and task assignments have stopped arriving entirely. This seems to happen mostly for devices that were offline overnight and then reconnect the next morning. We've confirmed notification permissions are enabled on all test devices, so it doesn't look like a device-side setting.
answer: Thanks for the clear description, that pattern with overnight offline devices is useful for us to narrow this down. We suspect the push token refresh isn't completing correctly after extended offline periods, which would explain why reconnecting devices stop receiving alerts. We're reproducing this now on both platforms and will update this ticket with findings or a fix as soon as we have one.

subject: Admin console question
body:
We've been reorganizing our office network over the past two weeks and updating our internal firewall rules as part of a broader security review ahead of our annual audit. During this process we also reviewed our Northwind Cloud admin settings to make sure everything aligned with the new network segmentation plan.

While going through the IP allowlist settings this morning, I noticed that an old, decommissioned office IP range is still marked as active on the allowlist, and login logs show successful authentications from that range as recently as last night, well after the office was closed. We need this range deactivated immediately and a full audit of who accessed the account from it.
answer: This has been escalated immediately given the potential unauthorized access. We are disabling the flagged IP range on your account right now and pulling a full audit log of all authentications from that range, including timestamps and accessed resources, which we'll share with you as soon as it's compiled. Please also force a password reset and re-authentication for any accounts that show activity from that range, and we'll stay on this ticket until it's fully resolved.

subject: Users getting logged out constantly, MFA re-prompt loop
body: Starting this morning, our team is being logged out of the dashboard every few minutes, and many users are stuck in a loop where they complete MFA, get logged in for a short time, then get kicked back to the login screen and asked for MFA again. This is affecting at least 15 of our 22 users and is blocking normal work. Nothing changed on our end regarding SSO configuration or provisioning that we're aware of.
answer: Thank you for reporting this quickly, we understand how disruptive a login loop like this is for your whole team. This looks like an issue with session token expiry being set far shorter than configured, which combined with MFA re-checks would produce exactly the loop you're describing. We're investigating your SSO session settings now and will provide an update or temporary workaround within the next hour given the number of users affected.

subject: Falsche Rechnung und Rückerstattung nötig
body: Auf unserer letzten Rechnung wurden 13 Sitzplätze berechnet, tatsächlich nutzen wir aber nur 9 aktive Accounts, da wir vor drei Wochen mehrere Mitarbeiter deaktiviert haben. Die Rechnungsnummer ist INV-58231 vom 2. Mai. Wir bitten um eine Korrektur der Rechnung sowie eine Rückerstattung der zu viel berechneten Sitzplätze, da dies unser Budget für dieses Quartal beeinflusst.
answer: Vielen Dank für die Meldung und die Rechnungsnummer, das hilft uns bei der schnellen Bearbeitung. Wir prüfen umgehend, warum die Deaktivierung der Sitzplätze nicht rechtzeitig vor der Rechnungserstellung berücksichtigt wurde, und werden die Rechnung entsprechend korrigieren. Sobald die korrekte Anzahl bestätigt ist, veranlassen wir die Rückerstattung der Differenz und melden uns mit einer aktualisierten Rechnung.

subject: URGENT: Scheduled sync pushed PHI to wrong destination bucket
body: I'm integrating our EHR feed with Northwind Data Pipelines and our 02:00 UTC scheduled sync (job ID sync-7841-lumen) on Oct 14 wrote 4,300 patient records to connector destination s3://northwind-partner-stage instead of our configured s3://lumenlabs-prod-secure. The connector config still shows the correct destination ARN, but the run logs show a destination override we never set. This is PHI under our BAA and needs immediate containment - please confirm if that bucket is isolated and who else has access to it.
answer: This has been escalated immediately to our security and data engineering on-call as a P0 incident. We are freezing the affected connector (sync-7841-lumen) to prevent further writes, isolating access to the destination bucket in question, and pulling full audit logs on who and what accessed it since the run completed. You will receive a direct update from our incident commander within the hour, and we will also prepare the documentation needed for your BAA reporting obligations.

subject: Dashboards timing out for our compliance team
body: Several of our workspace users, including our compliance team, are reporting that our main risk-exposure dashboard (dashboard ID 5521) takes 25-30 seconds to load or times out entirely, especially between 9-11am when most of our 123 seats are active. It has 14 charts pulling from two data sources. Sharing links to this dashboard also seem to hang on load for external reviewers. Can you check if this is a capacity issue or something specific to our workspace?
answer: Thanks for the details - a dashboard with 14 charts across two sources during peak concurrent usage can definitely hit rendering bottlenecks. We're pulling performance logs for dashboard 5521 now to see if this is query-side latency or a rendering issue on shared links specifically. In the meantime, splitting the heaviest charts into a secondary dashboard or enabling scheduled snapshot caching can reduce load times significantly - we'll follow up with specific recommendations once we've reviewed the logs.

subject: Best practice for rotating API keys without downtime
body: We're planning to rotate our production API keys for the Pioneer Labs workspace and want to make sure our webhook signing and SDK integrations don't break mid-rotation. We currently have three active keys tied to different services (billing sync, document retrieval, and a webhook listener). Is there a way to have both old and new keys valid simultaneously for a grace period, and does the rate limit apply per key or per workspace?
answer: Good question, and this is a common rollout pattern. You can generate a new key while keeping the old one active for up to 24 hours before revoking it, so all three of your integrations can be migrated one at a time without downtime. Rate limits are enforced per workspace, not per key, so running both keys concurrently during the transition won't double your available quota - let us know if you'd like a longer grace window for the migration.

subject: Transform step failing intermittently on inventory pipeline
body: Our inventory sync pipeline (pipeline ID pl-inv-203) has been failing at the transform stage roughly 1 in 5 runs since Tuesday. The error we get is "TransformError: null reference in field mapping stage 3" and it seems to correlate with rows where the supplier_code field is empty. About 40 records get dropped each time this happens, which is causing gaps in our stock counts. Can you help us figure out if this is a mapping config issue on our end or a pipeline bug?
answer: Thanks for the pipeline and error details - a null reference at mapping stage 3 tied to empty supplier_code fields does point to a transform rule that isn't handling nulls gracefully. We're reviewing the stage 3 config on pl-inv-203 now and will confirm whether this is a defaulting rule we need to adjust on our side or a schema validation setting you can toggle to skip or flag incomplete rows instead of failing the whole batch.

subject: SDK throwing 422 on file upload calls
body: We're using the Python SDK (v3.2.1) to upload itinerary documents through the API, and calls to client.files.upload() are returning a 422 with the message "unsupported_content_type: application/octet-stream". We're sending PDFs so this seems wrong. Is there a specific content-type parameter we need to set explicitly, or is there updated documentation for the upload method we should be following?
answer: Thanks for flagging this - the SDK's upload() method does need an explicit content_type argument in v3.2.1 rather than inferring it from the file, which is likely why you're seeing that 422. Passing content_type="application/pdf" explicitly should resolve it. We'll also update our SDK docs since this default behavior isn't called out clearly enough right now, and we appreciate you pointing it out.

subject: Scheduled syncs running 3+ hours late this week
body: Our scheduled sync for the production-line connector (connector ID conn-8834) is supposed to run every 4 hours but has been landing 3 to 4 hours late since Monday, which is throwing off our shift-change reporting. Latency in the run history shows queue wait times climbing from under 5 minutes to over 200 minutes. We have 127 seats depending on this data being current, so I'd like this escalated if possible - can someone confirm whether this is a queue capacity issue on your end?
answer: Escalating this now given the impact across your team. The queue wait time jump you're describing on conn-8834 does look like a backend scheduling delay rather than anything in your connector config, and we're checking current queue capacity and any recent changes that could explain the pattern starting Monday. We'll follow up shortly with either a fix timeline or a workaround, such as adjusting your sync window to a less congested time slot in the interim.

subject: Feedback on upcoming API key format deprecation
body: We saw the notice that the legacy nk_live_ prefixed API keys are being deprecated in favor of the new format, and I wanted to flag some feedback before our migration. Our webhook listener and two internal services still reference keys in the old format, and we'd like confirmation on the exact cutoff date and whether there will be a grace period similar to past rate limit rollouts. Also, will old keys start returning errors immediately or will there be a warning period first?
answer: Thanks for reaching out ahead of time, this is helpful feedback. The current plan is a 60-day grace period where legacy nk_live_ keys will continue to work but return a deprecation warning header, before hard cutover. We'll make sure the exact cutoff date is communicated directly to your workspace admins, and we're passing your feedback about aligning the grace period with past rate limit rollouts to the platform team.

subject: Request: exportable audit log with IP allowlist filtering
body: As IT administrator for our workspace, I need to pull audit logs covering the last 90 days for a compliance review, but the current console view only lets me see 30 days at a time and there's no export option. We also deactivated two former employee accounts last week and I don't see those deactivation events reflected in the log at all. Separately, could you let me know if there's a feature to restrict admin console access by IP allowlist?
answer: Thanks for the detailed request. Exporting audit logs beyond the 30-day console view currently requires a support-assisted pull, so we'll generate a 90-day CSV export for your workspace and send it over shortly. We're also checking why the two deactivation events aren't appearing in the log, as those should be captured automatically - and IP allowlisting for admin console access isn't available yet, but we're logging it as a feature request against your account.

subject: Feedback on biometric login and push notification timing
body: Our team has been testing the biometric login feature on the mobile app and wanted to share some feedback plus report an issue. Face ID login works fine on first launch, but after the app has been backgrounded for more than a few minutes, it falls back to password every time instead of prompting Face ID again. Separately, push notifications for approval requests seem to arrive 20-30 seconds after the in-app event, which is causing confusion for our on-call reviewers.
answer: Thanks for the detailed feedback, both points are useful. The Face ID fallback after backgrounding sounds like the biometric session token is expiring too aggressively - we're checking the session timeout logic now to see if it can be extended or made configurable. On the push notification delay, 20-30 seconds is higher than expected for approval events specifically, so we're pulling delivery logs to see where that lag is coming from and will update you with findings.

subject: RATE LIMIT CHANGE BROKE OUR WEBHOOKS - THIS IS UNACCEPTABLE
body: YOUR RATE LIMIT CHANGE THAT WENT LIVE THIS WEEK IS DROPPING OUR WEBHOOK DELIVERIES WITH 429 ERRORS AND NOBODY TOLD US THIS WAS COMING. WE ARE ON THE PYTHON SDK AND IT'S NOT EVEN RETRYING PROPERLY, WE'VE LOST NOTIFICATIONS FOR AT LEAST 200 EVENTS SINCE TUESDAY. THIS IS A PRODUCTION BUG AND WE NEED IT FIXED NOW OR WE WILL BE CANCELING OUR CONTRACT. WHERE WAS THE DEPRECATION NOTICE FOR THIS.
answer: We understand the urgency and apologize for the disruption this has caused. We're pulling the webhook delivery logs for your account right now to confirm the scope of the dropped events and to check why the SDK retry logic isn't backing off correctly on the 429 responses. We're also escalating internally to confirm whether the rate limit change was properly communicated on our end, and a member of our team will follow up directly within the hour with findings and a mitigation plan.

subject: Mobile app crashing on launch for multiple users
body:
Since this morning we've had at least a dozen employees report that the Northwind mobile app crashes immediately on launch, right after the splash screen. This is happening on both iOS and Android. A few users mentioned they were offline or had poor connectivity when it happened, and push notifications seem to trigger it too - one user got a push alert and the app crashed the second they tapped it.

We need this escalated since it's affecting people across several departments. Can you confirm if this is a known issue on your end?
answer: Thanks for flagging this and for the detail on the push notification trigger - that's a useful lead. We're escalating this to our mobile engineering team now given the number of affected users. Could you send us the app version and OS versions for a few of the impacted devices, plus approximate timestamps for two or three crashes so we can pull crash logs on our side?

subject: Urgent: need fix or workaround for launch crash affecting rollout
body:
We're in the middle of rolling out the Northwind mobile app to our field teams and just hit a serious blocker. The app crashes on launch for a large portion of users, particularly those who open it while offline or right after receiving a push notification. This is now blocking our deployment timeline since we can't onboard remaining staff.

We'd like this treated as a bug fix request with priority, and if there's a known workaround (like disabling push temporarily) please let us know today. Happy to jump on a call if that speeds things up.
answer: I understand the urgency given your rollout timeline, and I'm escalating this as a P1 bug to our mobile team right now. As an interim workaround, having affected users disable notification permissions in their device settings before opening the app has stopped the crash for other customers hitting this pattern - please try that with a small group and let us know if it resolves it. We'll follow up within a few hours with findings from the crash logs and a timeline for a permanent fix.

subject: Multiple card payment failures on our account this week
body:
We've had three separate card payment failures on our Northwind account since Monday, and this morning our workspace was flagged for suspension due to the unpaid invoice. Our finance team confirmed the card on file is valid and has sufficient funds, so we suspect this is on Northwind's side.

We have 12 seats on the Starter plan and can't afford to lose access, especially with an audit coming up. Please investigate the failed charges and let us know if we need a refund or adjustment on the invoice, and please lift any pending deactivation.
answer: I'm sorry for the disruption this has caused - I've placed a hold on the deactivation for your workspace so you won't lose access while we investigate. I can see the three failed attempts on our end and they're returning a generic processor decline rather than an insufficient funds error, which points to an issue on our payment gateway integration. I'm escalating this to our billing team now and will update you within a few hours with either a resolution or next steps for reprocessing the charge.

subject: IP allowlist blocking legitimate office traffic
body:
I set up an IP allowlist in the Admin Console yesterday to restrict access to our office network range, but this morning several employees working remotely reported they can't log in at all, even though I thought I'd added their VPN exit IP too. The error they see is just a generic access denied page.

Can you confirm whether the allowlist applies before or after VPN routing, and point me to documentation on this? I'd also like to check the audit log to see exactly which IPs were blocked so I can adjust the list correctly.
answer: The allowlist is enforced on the IP that reaches our servers, so if your VPN routes traffic through a different exit node than the one you added, those users would be blocked - that matches what you're seeing. You can check the Audit Log under Account settings for entries tagged 'access denied' to see the exact source IPs being rejected, which should help you identify the correct VPN ranges to add. I'll also send over our documentation on configuring allowlists with VPN setups so you have a reference for future changes.

subject: Can't find where to change workspace name and timezone
body:
I'm trying to update our workspace settings, specifically the display name and default timezone, but I can't locate these options anywhere in the Admin Console. We recently had a change in our business location and need the timezone to reflect that for accurate reporting.

Also, while I was poking around I noticed one of our former employees still shows as an active user even though I thought I deactivated their account last month. Can you help with both of these?
answer: You can find the workspace name and timezone settings under Admin Console > Workspace > General Settings - it's a bit tucked away, so I understand the confusion. Regarding the former employee, could you send me their username or user ID so I can check the deactivation status on our end? It's possible the deactivation didn't fully process, and I want to make sure their access is properly revoked.

subject: Duplicate email digests going out to our whole team
body:
Our team has been receiving duplicate daily email digests from Northwind Notifications for the past three days - everyone is getting two identical emails within a few minutes of each other, same content and timestamp range. This is causing confusion since some people think there's new activity when there isn't.

We have 13 seats and this is happening for every single one of them, not just a few users. Could you look into why the digest job is firing twice and get this fixed? It's becoming a real annoyance for the team and we'd like it escalated.
answer: Thanks for the clear details - this does sound like the digest scheduler is triggering twice for your workspace, and I'm escalating it to our notifications engineering team right now given it's affecting all 13 users. As a temporary measure, we can disable the digest for your workspace while we investigate the duplication, if you'd prefer no emails over duplicates in the meantime - just let us know. I'll update you as soon as we identify the root cause.

subject: Scheduled sync jobs producing incomplete data
body:
I've noticed our nightly scheduled sync for the warehouse inventory pipeline has been dropping records intermittently over the past week. Comparing row counts, the sync on March 4th brought in 48,201 records but the source system shows 52,340 for that date, and we saw a similar gap on March 6th and 7th.

The sync itself completes without any error status in the dashboard, so nothing looks obviously broken, but the data quality issue is affecting our downstream reporting. Can someone check the pipeline logs for these dates and let us know what's causing the row drops?
answer: Thanks for the specific row count comparisons - that's very helpful for tracking this down. A silent partial completion like this usually points to a timeout or rate limit being hit partway through the sync without surfacing as a failure, and I'm pulling the logs for March 4th, 6th, and 7th now to confirm. I'll follow up with findings and, if this is a systemic issue with the connector, a plan to backfill the missing records for those dates.

subject: How to route different alert types to different channels
body:
We'd like to set up our Notifications so that billing alerts go to our finance team's email while system/API alerts go to our engineering lead instead of everything landing in one shared inbox. Right now it looks like all alert types go to the same default recipient list.

Is there a way to configure routing rules per alert category, or is this something you'd need to add as a feature? We only have 8 seats so a simple per-category setting would work fine for us if it exists.
answer: Good news - you can already set this up under Notifications > Routing Rules, where you can map specific alert categories like billing or API/system alerts to different recipient email addresses. It sounds like your workspace is currently using the single default recipient fallback, so once you add category-specific rules those should take priority. Let me know if you'd like a walkthrough of the setup and I'm happy to hop on a quick call.

subject: Storage quota showing full despite deleting old backups
body:
Our storage usage dashboard still shows us at 98% of quota even though we deleted around 40GB of old backup files last week to free up space. Files uploaded since then are failing with a 'quota exceeded' error, which is blocking our daily backup job from completing.

I checked the retention settings and nothing looks unusual there, but it seems like deleted files aren't actually being removed from the usage calculation. Can you check what's going on with our storage accounting? We have 18 seats on the Starter plan and this is stopping our backups from running.
answer: I'm sorry for the trouble this is causing with your backup jobs. It's possible the deleted files are sitting in a retention or trash period before being fully purged from the quota calculation, which would explain the discrepancy you're seeing. I'm checking your account's storage accounting now to confirm whether that's the case or if this is a stuck deletion, and I'll follow up shortly with either an updated quota figure or next steps to clear the failed backups.

subject: Best practices for reducing transform failures and latency
body:
We're running several transform steps in our Data Pipelines setup connecting our retail sales connector to our internal warehouse, and we occasionally see individual transform steps fail with data type mismatch errors when source fields change format unexpectedly. Given our scale, we'd like to understand best practices for making these more resilient and reducing overall sync latency.

Are there recommended patterns for schema validation before transforms run, and any guidance on connector-level retry or backoff settings we should be using? This isn't urgent, just looking for guidance as we optimize our setup ahead of Q3.
answer: Great questions, and happy to point you in the right direction. We recommend adding a schema validation step ahead of your transforms using our schema contract feature, which will catch type mismatches before they reach the transform stage and route them to an error queue instead of failing the whole run. For latency and retry behavior, our connector settings support configurable backoff and retry limits under the connector's advanced settings tab - I'll send over our documentation covering recommended configurations for retail-scale pipelines like yours.

subject: Duplicate daily digest emails
body:
Our team started receiving two copies of the daily email digest every morning since June 3rd. It's happening for all 12 seats on our workspace, not just one user. Could you look into the dedupe logic for the digest scheduler? It's starting to erode trust in the alerts since people assume something is broken.

Also, while you're in there, it would help to have a per-user digest frequency setting (daily vs weekly) rather than one workspace-wide default.
answer: Thanks for flagging this, and sorry for the noise it's causing your team. Duplicate digests usually point to a scheduling job re-triggering for the same window, so I'm pulling the delivery logs for your workspace now to confirm the root cause. I'll also log the per-user frequency setting as a feature request on our side and update you on both within the next day.

subject: Native Jira integration for alerting
body:
We currently have Slack and Salesforce connected through Integrations, and they've worked well for routing alerts to the right channels. Our operations team is now asking for a native Jira link so that critical alerts can automatically create tickets in our Jira project instead of us copying details over manually.

Is this on the roadmap, or is there a workaround using webhooks in the meantime? We'd like to avoid building something custom if a native option is coming soon.
answer: Good question, and thanks for the context on your current Slack/Salesforce setup. A native Jira connector isn't live yet, but it's an active discussion on our integrations roadmap, so I'm logging your request against it now. In the meantime, our generic webhook trigger can be pointed at Jira's REST API to create issues from alerts, and I'm happy to share a sample payload if that helps bridge the gap.

subject: URGENT WORKSPACE LOCKOUT
body: WE UPDATED THE IP ALLOWLIST IN ADMIN CONSOLE AT 9:40 AM AND NOW ALL 18 SEATS INCLUDING EVERY ADMIN ACCOUNT HAVE BEEN DEACTIVATED. NO ONE CAN LOG IN TO THE WORKSPACE, NOT EVEN FROM OUR OFFICE IP RANGE THAT WE ADDED. THIS IS A LEGAL COMPLIANCE PLATFORM AND OUR STAFF NEED ACCESS RIGHT NOW. WE NEED SOMEONE TO ROLL THIS BACK IMMEDIATELY.
answer: This is being treated as our highest priority right now. I've escalated your workspace to our on-call engineering team to reverse the allowlist change and restore admin access, and I'll update you the moment accounts are reactivated. Please reply with your workspace ID and the exact IP range you added so we can confirm the rollback and verify no accounts remain locked out.

subject: Option to schedule quiet hours for push notifications
body:
A few of our field staff have mentioned that push notifications from the mobile app come through overnight, which isn't ideal since they're often reviewing legal documents outside business hours and don't want interruptions. It would be great to have a quiet-hours setting so notifications are queued and delivered in the morning instead.

This isn't urgent, just something that would improve adoption across our 10 seats. Happy to provide more detail if useful for planning.
answer: Thanks for the suggestion, this is a reasonable ask and one we've heard from a few other teams as well. I'm logging it as a feature request for the mobile app's notification settings, and I'll link your account so we can notify you if quiet hours ship. In the meantime, users can mute notifications manually in their device settings as a workaround.

subject: Users getting logged out constantly via SSO
body:
Since Tuesday, several of our 23 seats have reported being logged out of Northwind every 15-20 minutes even though we haven't changed our SAML configuration. It's forcing them to re-authenticate through our identity provider repeatedly throughout the day, which is disrupting work on billing and reporting dashboards.

Can you check if there's been a change to session timeout defaults on your end? We'd like sessions to last at least a few hours as they did before this week.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. We did roll out an update to session handling this week, and I want to check whether your workspace's timeout value was affected as part of that. I'm pulling your SSO session logs now to compare timestamps against the rollout, and I'll confirm within a few hours whether this is a config issue on our side or something in the SAML assertion lifetime.

subject: Abbestellen funktioniert nicht - doppelte E-Mails
body:
Seit gestern erhalten mehrere Kollegen weiterhin E-Mail-Benachrichtigungen, obwohl sie sich über den Abbestellen-Link im Footer ausgetragen haben. Zusätzlich kommen manche Benachrichtigungen doppelt an, teilweise im Abstand von nur wenigen Minuten. Das betrifft mindestens drei unserer vier Nutzer und sorgt für Verwirrung im Team.

Können Sie bitte prüfen, ob der Abbestellen-Mechanismus für unseren Workspace fehlerhaft ist? Wir benötigen das dringend, da es sich um vertrauliche Mandanteninformationen handelt.
answer: Vielen Dank für die genaue Beschreibung, das nehmen wir sofort auf. Ein fehlerhafter Abbestellen-Link kann auf ein Problem mit der Präferenzsynchronisation hindeuten, daher prüfen wir jetzt die Benachrichtigungseinstellungen Ihres Workspace und die betroffenen Konten. Wir melden uns innerhalb der nächsten Stunden mit einem Update und einer Lösung für die doppelten Zustellungen.

subject: Biometric login broken after app update
body:
After updating the mobile app yesterday, none of our 7 users can log in with Face ID or fingerprint anymore. The app just shows a spinner for a few seconds and then kicks back to the password screen without any error message. It worked fine before the update on both iOS and Android devices.

This is blocking our finance team from approving invoices on the go, which they usually do several times a day. Could you confirm if this is a known issue with the latest release?
answer: Thanks for reporting this quickly, this sounds like a regression tied to the latest app release and I want to get it confirmed today. Could you let me know the app version shown in Settings > About and whether this happens on both iOS and Android for your team? While we investigate, having users log in with password once should re-enable biometric login on next launch as a temporary workaround.

subject: PDF export cuts off chart labels
body:
When exporting our logistics dashboard to PDF, the x-axis labels on our bar charts get truncated and the legend overlaps with the chart area. This happens consistently on our shipment volume dashboard regardless of screen size before export. We'd like to share these reports with external partners, so the formatting really needs to hold up.

Would it be possible to improve how charts are scaled during PDF export, or at least let us choose landscape orientation for wider charts?
answer: Thanks for the specific example, that's helpful for reproducing the layout issue. I've confirmed that our current PDF export doesn't yet account for chart legends when scaling, which explains the overlap you're seeing. I'm passing this along to the dashboards team as a formatting improvement request, and adding a landscape orientation option is something I'll include in that same request.

subject: Hitting API rate limits during batch sync
body:
Our integration pulls data from the API Platform every night to sync inventory across our energy sites, and for the past week we've started getting 429 responses partway through, usually after around 900 requests in a 5-minute window. We're using the Python SDK and already have retry-with-backoff in place, but the sync now takes over 40 minutes instead of the usual 10.

Could you tell us our current rate limit tier and whether we can get it raised, or move part of this workload to webhooks instead of polling?
answer: Thanks for the specifics, that's useful for diagnosing this. Your workspace is currently on the standard Starter tier rate limit, which caps out around the threshold you're seeing, so the 429s are expected once you cross it. I'd recommend shifting the inventory sync to webhook-based updates where possible to cut down on polling volume, and I'm also submitting a request to review a temporary limit increase for your account while you make that change.

subject: UNSUBSCRIBE API NOT WORKING - CUSTOMERS STILL GETTING EMAILS
body: WE CALL THE UNSUBSCRIBE ENDPOINT FROM OUR APP AND IT RETURNS A 200 RESPONSE, BUT CUSTOMERS ARE STILL RECEIVING NOTIFICATION EMAILS DAYS LATER. WE'VE CONFIRMED THIS FOR AT LEAST 40 ACCOUNTS SINCE MONDAY AND SOME ARE GETTING DUPLICATE EMAILS ON TOP OF THAT. THIS IS A COMPLIANCE PROBLEM FOR US SINCE WE PROMISE UNSUBSCRIBE WORKS IMMEDIATELY. WE NEED THIS FIXED TODAY.
answer: I understand the urgency here given the compliance implications, and I'm escalating this immediately as a P1. A 200 response with delivery continuing usually points to a sync delay between the unsubscribe write and the notification send queue, so I'm pulling the event logs for the affected accounts now to confirm where the break is. I'll update you within the hour with findings and a mitigation while the fix is rolled out.

subject: IP allowlist rule not blocking outside access
body:
I added our office IP range (198.51.100.0/24) to the allowlist in Admin Console two days ago under Settings > Security, but I just confirmed a team member logged in successfully from a home network that isn't on the list. The audit log shows the login as successful with no allowlist rejection entry at all.

Can you confirm whether allowlist enforcement is actually active for our Starter plan, or if this is a feature gated to higher tiers? We need this working for a compliance review next week.
answer: Thanks for flagging this — IP allowlisting for the Admin Console is available on Starter, so this should be enforced. Can you send us the exact CIDR entries currently saved under Settings > Security along with the timestamp of the login you mentioned, so we can check the audit log server-side against your configuration? In the meantime we'll review whether there's a propagation delay affecting your workspace.

subject: Scheduled sync delays across multiple connectors
body:
Since yesterday around 14:00 UTC, several of our scheduled syncs (Postgres connector and the S3 connector) have been running 45-90 minutes behind their configured schedule. We have four pipelines set to run hourly and they're now queuing up, causing downstream dashboards to show stale data by nearly two hours.

We checked our connector credentials and network settings, nothing changed on our end. Pipeline IDs affected: pl_8842, pl_8843, pl_8901. Can someone check if there's a backlog on your scheduler side?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report and pipeline IDs. We're seeing elevated queue times on the scheduler for several accounts starting around the same window you mentioned, and our team is actively investigating a backlog on shared worker capacity. We'll prioritize clearing pl_8842, pl_8843 and pl_8901 and update you within the next couple of hours with progress or a fix ETA.

subject: Request to include PO number on invoices
body:
Our accounts payable team has asked that all incoming invoices reference our internal purchase order number so payments can be matched automatically. Right now the invoices we receive from Northwind only show the billing account ID and plan name, with no field for a PO reference.

Could you let us know if it's possible to add a custom PO number field to future invoices for our account, or if there's a workaround like adding it to the invoice memo line? We generate about a dozen invoices a year and this would save our team a lot of manual reconciliation.
answer: Thanks for the suggestion — we don't currently have a dedicated PO number field on invoices, but we can add your PO reference to the memo line on future invoices as a workaround. If you send us the PO number you'd like applied going forward, we'll set that up on our end, and I'll also pass this along to our product team as a feature request for a proper PO field.

subject: Question about upgrading from Starter to Pro mid-cycle
body:
We're currently on the Starter plan with 18 seats and I'm evaluating an upgrade to Pro for better API rate limits and more dashboard slots. I'd like to understand how the upgrade would be billed — will we be charged a prorated amount for the rest of this billing cycle, or does the new rate start fresh next cycle?

Also curious if seats carry over automatically or if we need to reassign them after the upgrade. Trying to plan this before our next monthly invoice on the 1st.
answer: Good question — when you upgrade from Starter to Pro mid-cycle, we prorate the difference and apply it to your current invoice, so you're only charged for the remaining days at the new rate rather than waiting until next cycle. Your existing 18 seats will carry over automatically with no reassignment needed, and any new seats you add afterward will be billed at the Pro rate. Let us know if you'd like us to schedule the upgrade for you.

subject: Getting duplicate weekly billing digest emails
body:
For the past three weeks our finance distribution list has been receiving two copies of the weekly billing digest email from Notifications, both sent within a few minutes of each other on Monday mornings. The content looks identical each time, same invoice summary and totals.

This is just a minor annoyance for now but with thousands of recipients on our internal lists it's generating some confused replies. Could you check if there are duplicate digest subscriptions configured for our account?
answer: Thanks for reporting this — duplicate digest deliveries are usually caused by two overlapping notification rules pointing to the same distribution list. We'll check the digest configuration on our end for your account and look for a duplicate rule; if we find one we'll remove it and confirm with you before the next scheduled Monday send.

subject: Locked out of console after allowlist change
body:
I updated the IP allowlist in Admin Console this morning to add our new office subnet, and immediately after saving, I got logged out and now can't log back in from any IP, including the one I just added. I'm getting a generic 'Access denied by security policy' message on the login screen.

All 18 of our users are affected right now, nobody can access the console. We need this resolved quickly since it's blocking our team from managing accounts today.
answer: This has been escalated as high priority since it's blocking all admin access for your workspace. As an immediate step, we're disabling the allowlist enforcement rule on our backend for your account so everyone can log back in; please confirm once you're able to access the console again. Once access is restored, we'll walk through the subnet entry you added to figure out why it caused a full lockout instead of just applying the new rule.

subject: Can't find workspace name change in audit log
body:
I recently updated our workspace display name in Admin Console under Settings, changing it from 'Quill Media' to 'Quill Media Group'. When I checked the audit log afterward to confirm the change was recorded, there's no entry for it at all, even though other actions like allowlist edits show up fine.

Is this a known gap in audit logging for workspace setting changes, or should this have been captured? We need accurate records for an upcoming compliance check.
answer: Thanks for pointing this out — workspace name changes should be logged alongside other settings updates, so this does look like a gap on our side rather than expected behavior. We're logging it as a bug for our engineering team to investigate, and in the meantime I can manually confirm the timestamp of your name change from our internal records if that helps with your compliance documentation.

subject: PDF export cutting off chart data on dashboard
body:
When I export our enrollment trends dashboard to PDF, two of the four charts get cut off at the right edge, missing the last two months of data that display fine on screen. This happens consistently whether I export from Chrome or Firefox, and it's the same dashboard every time (Enrollment Overview).

I've tried resizing the browser window before exporting but it doesn't change the result. Could you check if this is a known rendering issue with wide charts in PDF export?
answer: Thanks for the details — this looks like a known issue where wide line and bar charts get clipped during the PDF rendering step rather than scaling to fit the page. As a workaround, try switching the dashboard to portrait layout before exporting, which should keep all data points visible; we're also tracking a fix for the export renderer to handle wide charts automatically.

subject: URGENT: Storage retention policy deleted files before quota warning
body:
We just discovered that files in our 'archive-2023' bucket were purged under our 90-day retention policy, but we never received the quota or retention warning notification we were expecting beforehand, and some of those files were needed for an active audit. This affects potentially thousands of files across our workspace.

We have backup copies for most but not all of this data, and need to understand exactly what retention rule triggered this and whether it can be reversed or restored from Northwind's side before we lose anything else. This is affecting our entire retail operations team right now.
answer: We understand the urgency and are treating this as our highest priority right now. Our storage team is checking whether the deleted objects in the archive-2023 bucket are still recoverable from our backend retention buffer, and we'll also pull the notification logs to confirm why the expected retention warning wasn't sent to your account. We'll update you within the hour with recovery status and next steps — please hold off on any further changes to that bucket's retention settings in the meantime.

subject: Zapier integration failing to trigger on new records
body:
Our Zapier integration connected to Northwind stopped triggering entirely as of this morning around 9am. We use it to push new signups into our CRM automatically, and none of the zaps have run in the last four hours despite new records being created in our workspace during that time.

When I check the Zapier task history it shows 'No new data found' every time it polls, even though I can see the new records directly in Northwind. This is blocking our sales team from following up on new leads today.
answer: This is impacting a critical workflow so we're treating it as urgent. We're checking whether the Zapier trigger endpoint for your workspace is returning records correctly right now, since 'no new data found' usually points to an issue with the polling query on our integration side rather than your zap configuration. We'll update you shortly with findings and will manually notify you the moment triggers are firing again so you can verify on your end.

subject: Mobile app crashes when syncing after offline mode
body:
Our field auditors use the Northwind mobile app in offline mode when visiting client sites without reliable connectivity. Since last week, when they reconnect and the app tries to sync cached actions, it crashes consistently within a few seconds. This is happening on both iOS and Android devices across our retail team of about 20 field staff.

After the crash, some users also get logged out and have to re-authenticate, and push notifications stop arriving until they reinstall the app. This is disrupting our expense approval workflow since transactions entered offline aren't syncing properly.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. A crash on offline sync combined with forced logouts points to a session token issue during the reconnect handshake - we've seen a similar pattern tied to a recent app build. Could you confirm the app version your team is running and send us a crash log or device console output from one affected phone? In the meantime, having users manually log out and back in before going offline should reduce the sync crash frequency while we investigate.

subject: URGENT: API pagination broken, all requests returning 429
body:
Starting at 9:14 AM today, every paginated request to /v2/orders using the 'next_cursor' parameter is returning HTTP 429 rate limit errors, even though we're well under our documented limits. This has completely stopped our order sync integration - no data has flowed through since the incident started.

We checked our SDK version (2.3.1) and nothing changed on our end. Our webhook consumers are also failing because they depend on this endpoint for reconciliation. We have 20 seats on the Starter plan and this is affecting our entire production pipeline right now.
answer: We're treating this as a live incident and have escalated to our platform engineering team immediately. Initial checks show a rate-limit counter miscalculation affecting cursor-based pagination for Starter tier accounts specifically, and a fix is being tested now. I'll update you within 30 minutes with either a resolution or a workaround using offset-based pagination as a temporary bridge - please hold off on retrying webhook deliveries until we confirm the fix is live.

subject: Critical: pipeline data arriving hours late, breaking downstream reports
body:
Since early this morning our data pipeline connector pulling transaction records from our banking partner has been delivering batches 4-6 hours later than scheduled. Normally data lands by 6 AM UTC but today's batch didn't arrive until after 11 AM, and yesterday's had a similar delay.

This is causing serious data quality issues downstream - our fraud detection reports are running on stale data and compliance reporting for our fintech clients is now at risk. We have 18 seats on Starter and this connector is core to our daily operations. Can someone check connector health on your end immediately?
answer: This has been escalated to our data pipeline on-call team as a P0 outage. We're seeing elevated latency on the connector serving your banking source, likely tied to an upstream provider delay we're currently investigating. We'll send an update within the hour with either a fix timeline or a manual backfill option so your compliance reporting isn't left running on stale data.

subject: UPLOADS FAILING ON STORAGE - QUOTA ERROR BUT WE HAVE SPACE LEFT
body:
WE ARE GETTING UPLOAD FAILURES ON ALL FILES OVER 500MB SINCE YESTERDAY AFTERNOON. THE ERROR SAYS QUOTA EXCEEDED BUT WHEN I CHECK THE STORAGE DASHBOARD IT SHOWS WE ARE ONLY AT 61% OF OUR ALLOCATION. THIS IS BLOCKING OUR DAILY BACKUP JOBS FOR THE ENERGY DATASETS TEAM AND WE HAVE 80 SEATS ON PRO RELYING ON THIS.

OUR TEAM CANNOT COMPLETE SCHEDULED BACKUPS AND PERFORMANCE ON SMALLER UPLOADS HAS ALSO SLOWED DOWN SIGNIFICANTLY. PLEASE ADVISE ASAP AS THIS IS AFFECTING MULTIPLE USERS.
answer: Thank you for flagging this - a quota error while usage shows well below the limit suggests our quota calculation service may be miscounting your account's allocation, and we're checking this now as a priority. Can you send us one of the failing upload's file IDs or timestamps so we can trace it in the logs? We'll also verify whether the recent slowdown on smaller uploads is related and will follow up shortly with next steps to unblock your backup jobs.

subject: Slack integration not sending escalation alerts
body:
We configured the Slack integration to post escalation alerts whenever a high-priority ticket is created through our Jira sync, but for the past several days no messages are appearing in the designated channel. The integration still shows as 'connected' in our admin panel, and our Okta SSO login for the integration works fine.

We tested by manually triggering an escalation in Jira this morning and nothing came through to Slack, though our Salesforce integration alerts are working normally. Can you help us figure out why only the Slack escalation path seems broken?
answer: Thanks for the clear breakdown - since Salesforce alerts are working but Slack escalations aren't, this points to a channel-specific webhook issue rather than a broader integration failure. Could you confirm whether the Slack channel or its webhook URL was recently renamed or recreated? That's the most common cause of silent failures like this, and we'll also check the integration logs on our end for delivery errors tied to your workspace.

subject: Multiple team cards declined, need refund on failed charges
body:
Several of our workspace admins have had their corporate cards declined when Northwind attempted to process this month's invoice, even though the cards are active and have sufficient credit. We've now been charged twice on one card due to what looks like a retry bug, and we need that duplicate charge refunded.

We have 200 seats on the Pro plan and this billing issue is now blocking our ability to add new users since the account shows a past-due flag. Please help resolve the duplicate charge and clear the past-due status so we can continue onboarding staff.
answer: I'm sorry for the trouble this has caused with onboarding blocked. I can see the duplicate charge on your account and I'm processing a refund for the erroneous second attempt right now - this should reflect within 3-5 business days depending on your bank. I'm also clearing the past-due flag manually so you can resume adding seats immediately, and I'll follow up separately on why the retry logic double-charged your card.

subject: Question about storage quota and retention settings
body:
I'm reviewing our storage allocation and wanted to check how our retention policy interacts with quota calculations. We currently have several years of archived case files under long-term retention, and I'd like to know if those archived files count against our active quota the same way as recently uploaded documents.

It would also be helpful to have a feature that lets us see a breakdown of quota usage by retention category in the dashboard, since right now we only see a single total number. Not urgent, just planning ahead for our Pro plan usage.
answer: Good question - archived files under retention policies do count toward your total quota, but they're typically compressed which reduces their footprint compared to active documents. We don't currently have a breakdown by retention category in the dashboard, but I'll pass this along to our product team as a feature request since it's a reasonable ask for accounts managing long-term archives. Thanks for planning ahead on this.

subject: Need clarification on API credit refund for failed calls
body:
I'm integrating the Northwind API into our internal tooling and noticed we were charged credits for a batch of calls that returned 500 errors on our end due to a temporary outage on your side last Thursday around 3 PM. Since these calls didn't actually process successfully, I'd like to request a refund of those credits.

We're on the Starter plan with only 14 seats, so credit usage is something we track closely. Could someone confirm whether failed calls due to server errors are normally excluded from billing, and process a refund for the affected batch if not?
answer: You're right to flag this - calls that fail with a 5xx error on our side should not be counted against your credit balance, and it sounds like a billing reconciliation gap in that specific batch. I'm reviewing your account's call logs from last Thursday now and will issue a credit refund for any confirmed server-side failures within the next business day. Thanks for tracking this closely and bringing it to our attention.

subject: Best practice for handling pagination with large datasets
body:
Our team pulls large volumes of patient record metadata through the API Platform using cursor-based pagination, and we're trying to optimize our approach as our dataset has grown to over 2 million records. Currently we're making sequential paginated calls but wondering if there's a more efficient pattern, like parallel cursor fetching or a bulk export endpoint, that fits within your documented rate limits.

We'd also appreciate updated SDK examples showing recommended pagination patterns for datasets at this scale, since our current implementation is based on older documentation.
answer: Great question, and at your scale sequential cursor pagination is definitely not the most efficient path. For datasets over 1 million records, we recommend using our bulk export endpoint which generates a downloadable snapshot rather than paginating live, or if you need near-real-time data, splitting requests across multiple cursor streams using our partition parameter. I'll send over updated SDK examples for both patterns, and I'll also flag the outdated pagination docs to our documentation team for a refresh.

subject: Audit log missing entries after user deactivation
body:
We deactivated three former employees from our Admin Console yesterday morning, and I've noticed the audit log isn't recording any entries for those deactivation actions or for changes made to our allowlist settings around the same time. This is a problem for us since we rely on the audit log for compliance reviews given our travel industry regulatory requirements.

We have 13 seats on the Starter plan and need to confirm whether this is a logging bug or a permissions issue on our end, since this gap could affect our upcoming compliance audit.
answer: This is concerning and we're prioritizing it given the compliance implications. Missing audit entries for deactivation and allowlist changes typically points to an event capture gap rather than a permissions issue on your end, and we're checking our logging pipeline for your workspace right now. I'll update you within the next few hours with findings, and if entries were lost we'll work with you on documentation to support your upcoming audit in the meantime.

subject: SDK v4.2.1 throwing signature validation errors on all webhook calls
body:
Since upgrading to SDK v4.2.1 this morning, every webhook signature validation call is failing with 'ERR_SIG_MISMATCH_V2' even though our secret hasn't changed. This is blocking our production payment reconciliation flow for Atlas Energy - we process roughly 14,000 transactions per hour and they're all queuing up unprocessed since 09:12 UTC.

We rolled back to v4.1.8 on staging and it works fine, so this looks like a breaking change tied to the new deprecation notice for the legacy HMAC header. Can someone confirm if this is a known regression? We need a fix or workaround immediately as our downstream ledger is falling behind.
answer: This has been escalated to our platform engineering team as a P0 incident - we can confirm a regression in v4.2.1 related to the HMAC header rename introduced in the deprecation rollout, and a hotfix (v4.2.2) is being built now. In the meantime, please pin your SDK to v4.1.8 to restore signature validation while we finalize the patch; we'll post an update here within the hour with an ETA and migration notes for the header change.

subject: Push notifications not delivering to offline users after app restart
body:
We've had multiple clinician teams report that push notifications stop arriving entirely after their device goes offline and reconnects. This started around March 3rd and affects both iOS and Android builds of the Northwind mobile app across our Orion Media workspace. Users have to fully uninstall and reinstall the app to get notifications working again, which is not sustainable given we have thousands of staff relying on shift alerts.

We're getting a growing number of complaints in our internal feedback channel and need to know if this is a known bug with the offline sync/reconnect logic.
answer: Thank you for flagging this - we're treating it as a P1 incident since it affects notification delivery for a large portion of your workspace. Our mobile team has reproduced an issue where the push token re-registration fails silently after a network drop longer than 60 seconds, and a fix is being fast-tracked for the next app release. As a temporary mitigation, toggling notification permissions off and on in device settings forces re-registration without requiring a full reinstall; we'll update this ticket as soon as the patched build is available.

subject: Okta SSO integration setup and performance for Apex Partners renewal
body:
We're finalizing our renewal discussion and want to move forward with configuring the Okta app integration before our contract renews next month. Our IT team asked me to confirm the setup steps for SAML provisioning, and separately, whether the Okta integration has any known performance issues when combined with our existing Salesforce and Jira connectors - we've heard from a peer company that sync times can lag significantly.

Could someone walk us through the recommended configuration, and let us know if there are any current known issues affecting Okta-Salesforce-Slack combined workflows?
answer: Happy to help ahead of your renewal - I'll have our integrations specialist send over the Okta SAML setup guide along with recommended attribute mappings today. Regarding performance, we do have an open item where high-frequency Salesforce sync polling combined with Okta provisioning can add latency, and our team has a fix scheduled for next release; in the meantime we recommend setting the Salesforce sync interval to 15 minutes rather than the default 5 to avoid contention.

subject: Connector auth token refresh failing for legal document pipeline
body:
Our data pipeline connector for the legal document repository has been failing authentication since yesterday around 4:30pm. The error we're seeing is 'OAuth token refresh failed: invalid_grant' and it's stopped syncing entirely - we have about 40,000 records backed up that should have synced overnight for Vertex Robotics' compliance review workflow.

We checked our credentials in the connector settings and they look unchanged, so this seems to be on the pipeline side. This is blocking our legal team's daily audit reports and we need this escalated as several downstream users depend on fresh data each morning.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report - I've escalated this to our data pipeline team as a P1 since it's blocking your compliance sync entirely. Initial investigation shows the invalid_grant error is tied to a refresh token expiry edge case on connectors older than 90 days; we're issuing a fix to auto-renew these tokens, but in the meantime, could you re-authenticate the connector from the settings page to force a new token? We'll monitor the next sync cycle closely and confirm once records catch up.

subject: Connector sync delayed and showing stale data
body:
I'm noticing our travel booking data connector has been syncing with a significant delay - data that should refresh every 30 minutes is now up to 6 hours behind as of this morning. When I check the connector status page it shows 'Connected' with no errors, but the record counts in our dashboard don't match the source system.

This is a small connector (just our booking history feed) so it's not blocking critical work, but I'd like to understand why the latency has increased so much over the past few days.
answer: Thanks for reporting this - a connector showing healthy status but lagging behind on sync usually points to a queue backlog rather than an auth issue. I'm looking into your connector's processing logs now to see if it's stuck behind a larger sync job; I'll follow up within the day with findings and, if needed, will manually trigger a re-sync to catch up the stale records.

subject: Request to reduce duplicate email alerts for shared distribution lists
body:
Our operations team has noticed that when an alert is sent to a distribution list where multiple recipients are also individually subscribed, each person receives the same notification twice - once via the list and once individually. This isn't breaking anything critical, but it's generating a lot of noise and support questions internally at Orion Media.

Is there a setting we're missing to deduplicate these, or could this be considered as a feature request? Documentation on notification routing rules would also be helpful if it exists.
answer: Thanks for the feedback - there isn't currently a built-in deduplication setting for overlapping distribution list and individual subscriptions, but I've logged this as a feature request with our notifications product team. In the meantime, I'll send over our documentation on notification routing rules, which includes a workaround using subscription groups that should reduce most of the duplicate sends until a native solution is available.

subject: Dashboard PDF export cutting off charts
body:
