When I export our monthly finance dashboard to PDF, the bar charts on the right-hand side of the layout get cut off completely - only about two-thirds of the chart renders in the exported file. This has been happening since sometime last week and I've tried it on both Chrome and Firefox with the same result.

We rely on this export for our board reporting at Quill Travel, so it's a real problem when the numbers aren't fully visible. Can you take a look at what's causing the truncation?
answer: Sorry for the trouble this is causing ahead of your reporting cycle. This looks like a rendering issue with wide chart widgets during PDF export, which our dashboards team is aware of and actively working on. As a workaround, try resizing the chart widget to fit within the standard export width (reducing it by about 20%) which should prevent the cutoff; I'll update you as soon as a permanent fix is deployed.

subject: Locked out of admin console after IP allowlist update
body:
We updated our IP allowlist in the Admin Console this morning to add our new office range, but immediately after saving, our entire IT team got logged out and can't get back in - every login attempt returns 'Access denied: IP not permitted' even from the ranges we just added. We double-checked the CIDR notation and it matches what's in our firewall config.

This is urgent since none of our admins at Lumen Retail can currently access account settings, audit logs, or manage user deactivations. We need this reverted or fixed as soon as possible.
answer: This is being treated as a P1 - being locked out of the admin console entirely is a serious issue and we're on it now. Our access team can revert your IP allowlist change from our side immediately to restore access; please confirm the exact CIDR ranges you intended to add so we can validate them before reapplying, and we'll walk through the update together on a call if needed to avoid a repeat lockout.

subject: Unable to upgrade seat plan - checkout error
body:
We're trying to upgrade from our current plan to accommodate 40 new hires starting next week, but every time we go through the upgrade flow in billing settings, we get an error at checkout: 'Unable to process plan change - contact support' with no further detail. We've tried three different admin accounts and two payment methods with the same result.

This is holding up onboarding for Quill Academy's new staff since they need seats provisioned before their start date. We also want to confirm whether the prorated invoice will reflect only the seat difference or a full new billing cycle charge.
answer: Apologies for the disruption to your onboarding timeline - I can see the failed plan change attempts on your account and it looks like a billing sync error tied to a pending invoice adjustment from last cycle. I'm clearing that block manually now and will confirm once the upgrade path is working; for billing, the prorated invoice will only reflect the seat difference for the remaining days in your current cycle, not a full new charge.

subject: Storage full, uploads failing
body: All uploads failing since 8am, storage shows 100% quota used, need this fixed urgently.
answer: This is a P0 for us - I've raised your storage quota temporarily to unblock uploads right away while we review your usage. Can you confirm if any of the stored files are eligible for your retention/backup policy cleanup, so we can help free up permanent space and avoid this recurring?

subject: Audit log missing entries for allowlist changes
body: I'm reviewing our Admin Console audit log for the last two weeks and noticed that changes made to our IP allowlist on Oct 3 and Oct 9 aren't showing up at all. We rely on this log for our internal SOC2 evidence collection, so gaps are a problem. Other settings changes (role updates, seat additions) are logging fine, it just seems to be allowlist entries specifically. Can you confirm if this is a known gap and whether it can be backfilled?
answer: Thanks for flagging this. We've seen a small number of reports where allowlist modifications don't get written to the audit trail due to a logging path that was missed during a recent settings refactor. I'm opening a bug ticket to get this fixed and will check whether the underlying events for Oct 3 and Oct 9 can be reconstructed from our internal logs for your compliance record. I'll follow up within two business days with an update.

subject: Question about last month's invoice and seat count
body: I was reconciling our September invoice against our internal headcount and the line item shows 206 seats billed, which matches what we have active, so that part looks fine. However, I noticed the invoice total is about 4% higher than August despite no seat changes on our end. Could someone clarify what changed, and also let me know if there's a way to get invoices itemized by department for our own reporting? Not urgent, just want to understand before month end close.
answer: Thanks for reaching out and for the detailed comparison. The small increase you're seeing lines up with a scheduled per-seat rate adjustment on the Pro plan that took effect September 1st, which was communicated via email to billing contacts. I don't have a native way to itemize by department today, but I've logged it as a feature request and can send you a raw CSV export of your invoice line items in the meantime if that helps with your reporting.

subject: Storage quota exceeded, backups failing since this morning
body: Since around 7am today our scheduled backups to Northwind Storage have been failing with 'quota exceeded' errors. We're on the Starter plan and haven't changed our retention settings recently, but our usage dashboard shows we're at 103% of our allotted quota. This is blocking our nightly compliance backup job for a fintech client deliverable due tomorrow morning. We need either a temporary quota bump or guidance on what's eating the space, retention policy hasn't changed in 3 months.
answer: I understand the urgency given your deliverable deadline. I've applied a temporary quota increase of 20% to your account right now so your backup job can complete tonight. Looking at your usage, it appears an old snapshot retention job from two backup cycles ago didn't get purged correctly, which we're investigating as a possible retention bug on our end. I'll follow up today with root cause and a permanent fix so this doesn't recur.

subject: User deactivation API completely broken - this is unacceptable
body: We've been trying to deactivate offboarded employees through the Admin Console API for the past three days and it keeps failing. Every call to the deactivation endpoint returns a 500 and the users stay active with full access. This is a massive security problem for us, we have people who left the company two weeks ago who can still log in. Your documentation doesn't mention any known issues and support hasn't responded to my last two emails. We are seriously considering canceling our contract over this if it's not fixed today.
answer: I'm sorry for the delay and I understand why this is urgent given the access risk. I've escalated this to our platform team immediately as a P1 and I can confirm there is a known regression affecting the deactivation endpoint for a subset of accounts, which we're actively rolling back. As a stopgap, I can manually deactivate the specific user accounts you flag right now if you send me the list, so you're not exposed while the fix deploys. I'll stay on this ticket personally until it's resolved.

subject: Repeated upload failures on Storage since last week
body: Several of our team members have been unable to upload files larger than 500MB to Storage since last Thursday, the upload progress bar stalls at around 80% and then throws a generic error. We're nowhere near our quota limit based on the usage dashboard, so it doesn't seem retention or capacity related. This is affecting our backup workflow for two departments. Can you check if there's a known issue with large file uploads or a timeout setting we should adjust?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. This matches an intermittent issue we're tracking with large uploads timing out on our storage gateway for files over roughly 400MB, unrelated to your quota. I'm escalating this to our infrastructure team for a fix, and in the meantime I'd suggest splitting larger files into smaller chunks or using our CLI upload tool, which uses a different transfer path that isn't affected. I'll update you as soon as we have a resolution timeline.

subject: Duplicate email digests going out to users
body: Our team has been getting two copies of the daily notification digest email every morning for the past three days, identical content, sent about two minutes apart. We only have 11 seats so it's easy to spot and several people have already asked me about it. I checked our notification settings and there's only one digest schedule configured, so it doesn't look like something we did on our end.
answer: Thanks for reporting this with the timing detail, that's helpful. We're aware of an issue where the digest scheduler can occasionally trigger a duplicate send when a retry job overlaps with the original run, and it looks like your workspace was affected by that. I've flagged your account to our notifications team for the fix rollout and will let you know once it's confirmed resolved on our end.

subject: Need bulk unsubscribe management for notification emails
body: As we've scaled to 200 seats, we're getting increasing complaints that users who unsubscribe from marketing-style notification emails still receive them for another cycle or two before it takes effect. Separately, several employees have asked for a way to unsubscribe from specific notification categories rather than all-or-nothing. Given the volume of complaints we're getting internally, I'd like to request this be prioritized, and understand the current delay in unsubscribe processing in the meantime.
answer: Thank you for the clear writeup, this is helpful context for prioritization. Currently unsubscribe requests are processed in a nightly batch, which explains the one-to-two cycle delay you're seeing, and I'll log a request with our product team to move this to near-real-time processing given the impact at your scale. Granular category-level unsubscribe preferences aren't available yet but I'm adding your account as a strong vote for that feature and will keep this ticket open to track progress on both items.

subject: Salesforce sync stopped updating contact records
body: Our Salesforce integration through Northwind has stopped syncing updated contact records since Tuesday. New records still come through fine, but any edits made in Salesforce after that date aren't reflecting in Northwind, and we rely on this for our Slack alerting workflow that notifies sales when accounts change status. We haven't touched the integration config recently. Could you check the sync logs on your end for our workspace and let us know what's going on?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report, that timing is useful. I'm checking our sync logs for your workspace now and will confirm whether this is related to a webhook delivery issue we've seen with Salesforce update events specifically, versus new-record creates which use a different trigger path. I'll update this ticket with findings and next steps within one business day, and let you know if we need to re-authenticate the connection.

subject: How do I restrict who can change workspace settings?
body: We're a small team of 6 and I want to lock down who can modify workspace-level settings in the Admin Console, right now it looks like any user with the default role can change things like the allowlist and notification preferences. I couldn't find documentation on setting up a more restrictive permission tier for this. Also, is there a way to see a history of who changed what setting recently, separate from the general audit log view?
answer: Good question, and this is a common request for smaller teams. You can restrict settings access by creating a custom role with the 'Settings: none' or 'Settings: view-only' permission and assigning it to most of your team, keeping the default admin role limited to one or two people, our documentation on custom roles walks through the steps under Account and Access. For setting-specific change history, the audit log does capture this, you can filter by event type 'settings.updated' to isolate just those entries rather than scrolling the full log.

subject: SCIM provisioning failing, new hires can't get accounts created
body: Our SCIM integration between our identity provider and Northwind SSO stopped provisioning new users as of this morning. We have four new hires starting today who need accounts and none of them were created automatically, the SCIM sync log on our IdP side shows 400 errors on the POST to your Users endpoint. This is blocking onboarding and affecting login access for those employees right now, we need this fixed today.
answer: I understand this is time-sensitive with new hires waiting on access, treating this as urgent. Could you send us the exact 400 error response body from your IdP's SCIM logs, that will tell us whether this is a schema mismatch or an authentication token issue on our provisioning endpoint. In parallel, I can manually provision the four pending accounts right now if you send me their names and email addresses so they're not blocked while we diagnose the SCIM failure.

subject: Paginierung über SDK unklar
body: Wir nutzen das Node-SDK von Northwind, um über die /orders Endpunkte zu paginieren. Aktuell arbeiten wir noch mit dem offset-basierten Parameter, sehen aber in den Docs einen Hinweis, dass dieser bald deprecated wird. Gibt es schon einen Zeitplan für die Umstellung auf cursor-basierte Paginierung und wird das SDK automatisch aktualisiert oder müssen wir unseren Code anpassen? Zusätzlich wäre es hilfreich, wenn Webhook-Events bei Rate-Limit-Fehlern klarer dokumentiert wären.
answer: Vielen Dank für die Rückfrage. Die offset-basierte Paginierung wird zum 30. September deprecated und durch cursor-basierte Paginierung ersetzt; das SDK ab Version 4.2 unterstützt beide Varianten parallel, sodass Sie Ihren Code in Ruhe migrieren können. Wir aktualisieren in Kürze die Dokumentation zu Rate-Limit-Antworten bei Webhook-Events und melden uns, sobald der Migrationsleitfaden veröffentlicht ist.

subject: Plan upgrade via API failing with payment error
body: I'm integrating the Billing API to let our ops team upgrade accounts programmatically. When I call POST /subscriptions/upgrade for account acc_88213, I get a 402 response with code payment_method_declined, even though the same card processes fine through the dashboard. This is blocking about 40 pending upgrades from Pro to Enterprise this week. Can someone check the payment gateway logs on your end?
answer: Thanks for flagging this - we're treating it as a P2 issue given the number of pending upgrades affected. We can see the declined transactions on our gateway side and are checking whether a recent rule change on high-value upgrades is the cause. We'll escalate to the payments team now and update you within a few hours with either a fix or a workaround for processing the pending upgrades manually.

subject: Extending backup retention beyond default window
body: We're on the Starter plan and currently backups are purged after 30 days, but our compliance team needs at least 90 days of retention for shipment records. We're also seeing quota warnings when uploading larger backup sets during month-end. Is there a way to configure a custom retention policy, or would we need to upgrade plans to unlock longer retention and higher quota?
answer: Thanks for reaching out. Custom retention beyond 30 days is available starting on our Pro plan, which also raises your storage quota significantly - I can share the exact limits for your current data volume if that's helpful. In the meantime, I've logged your feedback about month-end quota alerts so we can consider clearer warning thresholds for Starter accounts as well.

subject: Scheduled syncs failing across multiple pipelines
body: Since Monday our nightly scheduled syncs for three pipelines (booking-data, loyalty-events, partner-feed) have been failing intermittently, with about 30% of runs timing out before completion. This is affecting close to 200 users who rely on same-day dashboards. We need either a fix or the ability to configure retry windows and longer timeouts per pipeline, since our data volume has grown significantly this quarter.
answer: This is a priority issue given the number of users affected, and we're treating it as such. We're pulling the run logs for the three pipelines now to identify where the timeouts occur and will confirm within the hour whether this is capacity-related or a configuration issue on our side. We'll also look into exposing per-pipeline retry and timeout settings as a near-term improvement.

subject: Verspätet eintreffende Daten verursachen Lücken im Sync
body: Bei unserem Connector für die Fallakten-Pipeline stellen wir seit letzter Woche fest, dass verspätet eintreffende Datensätze, teilweise bis zu sechs Stunden nach dem eigentlichen Sync-Fenster, nicht mehr nachträglich verarbeitet werden. Dadurch fehlen in unseren täglichen Auswertungen regelmäßig Einträge, was für unsere Kanzlei-Kunden im Legal-Bereich ein echtes Problem ist. Können wir eine Nachverarbeitung oder ein größeres Zeitfenster für Late-Arriving-Data konfigurieren?
answer: Vielen Dank für die genaue Beschreibung, wir stufen das als P1 ein, da produktive Auswertungen betroffen sind. Unser Team prüft aktuell, ob der Connector das Late-Arriving-Window korrekt respektiert oder ob es sich um einen Bug in der letzten Version handelt. Wir melden uns innerhalb der nächsten Stunden mit einem Zwischenstand und, falls nötig, einem manuellen Nachverarbeitungsschritt für die fehlenden Datensätze.

subject: Scheduled sync outage affecting connector pipeline
body: Our scheduled sync for the case-management connector has failed for the last four runs, starting at 02:00 UTC today. The pipeline dashboard shows status 'error: connector timeout after 300s' and no records have synced since yesterday morning. We only have 12 seats but this connector feeds our main client reporting, so even a single day of missed sync is causing visible data quality issues for our team.
answer: Thank you for reporting this - we're logging it as an incident and looking into the connector timeout right now. Initial checks show elevated latency on the upstream case-management API that may be causing the 300s timeout; we'll confirm the root cause and either extend the timeout threshold or restart the connector once the upstream issue clears. We'll keep you updated as we investigate further.

subject: How to restrict dashboard access with IP allowlist
body: As workspace admin for our logistics team, I'd like to set up an IP allowlist so only our office and VPN ranges can access the Northwind admin console. I don't see this option under Settings > Security yet - is it available on our Pro plan, and if so, where do I configure it? We'd also like these changes to show up in the audit log for compliance review.
answer: IP allowlisting is available on the Pro plan and should appear under Settings > Security > Access Control - if it's not visible for your workspace, it may need to be enabled on our end first, so I've submitted that request now. Once enabled, allowlist changes are automatically recorded in your audit log, and I'll follow up here as soon as the feature is turned on for your account.

subject: Seat count mismatch causing incorrect invoice
body: Our last invoice charged us for 24 seats, but we only have 18 active users configured in the admin console under our Starter plan. I checked the seat usage report and it confirms 18, so this looks like a billing bug rather than an actual overage. Can you correct the invoice and let us know if a refund is needed for the difference?
answer: Thanks for catching this and sending the seat usage report - that's very helpful. This does look like a discrepancy between our billing system and your actual seat count, so we're escalating it as an incident to verify the root cause. Once confirmed, we'll issue a corrected invoice along with a refund for the extra seats charged.

subject: Duplicate email digests going out to users
body: Several of our team members have reported receiving the same weekly email digest twice, sometimes three minutes apart, over the past two send cycles. We haven't changed any notification settings recently, and this is starting to generate support questions from our own users who think something is broken. Can you check if there's a duplication issue on the digest scheduler?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report - duplicate sends usually point to a scheduler retry issue on our end, and we're looking into the digest job logs for your account now. We'll confirm within the day whether this is a broader issue affecting other customers or specific to your workspace configuration, and make sure any pending duplicate sends are stopped in the meantime.

subject: Urgent: IP allowlist blocking all admin access
body: We just configured an IP allowlist in the Admin Console to restrict access to our office network, but now none of our 4 users, including myself, can log in to the admin console at all, even from the allowed IP range. We need this fixed urgently since we can't manage settings or view the audit log right now, and we're a small team with no other way in.
answer: We understand this is urgent since it's blocking all admin access for your team, and we're prioritizing it accordingly. Our team is reviewing the allowlist configuration now to identify why the listed IP range isn't being recognized, and as an immediate step we can temporarily disable the allowlist rule from our side to restore your access while we investigate. We'll confirm as soon as that's done.

subject: Okta SSO app not passing group claims to Northwind Integrations
body: I'm setting up the Okta app for Northwind Integrations so we can auto-provision access to Jira, Slack and Salesforce connectors. The SAML assertion comes through fine for login, but the group claims (Legal-Admins, Legal-Users) aren't showing up in the Northwind app config, so none of our conditional access rules trigger. I've checked the Okta app's attribute mappings and they look correct on our end. Can someone confirm what claim name Northwind expects for group membership?
answer: Thanks for the detailed writeup. Northwind expects the group claim under the attribute name 'groups' (lowercase, no prefix) in the SAML assertion, and it needs to be a multivalue attribute statement rather than a single string - a common gotcha with Okta's default filter. Could you check your Okta app's Attribute Statements section and confirm the filter type, then send us a sanitized copy of the SAML response so we can verify parsing on our side?

subject: Seat count discrepancy on this month's invoice

Wir melden uns innerhalb der nächsten Stunden mit einem Update oder einer Übergangslösung.

We'll follow up shortly with root cause and a plan to catch up the backlog.

subject: Need Zapier integration to support batch triggers for invoice data
body: We're currently using the Zapier integration to sync invoice line items into our accounting system, but each Zap only processes one record at a time, which is too slow for our monthly volume of roughly 4,000 invoices. We'd like to request support for batch triggers so multiple records can be pulled per run instead of triggering hundreds of individual Zaps. This would significantly reduce processing time and Zapier task usage for our finance team.
answer: This is a great use case and we understand how single-record triggers at your volume would burn through Zapier tasks quickly. Batch trigger support isn't available today, but we're logging this as a feature request with our integrations product team and will flag your account's volume as supporting evidence. In the meantime, we can suggest a scheduled digest workaround that batches records on our side before triggering the Zap - happy to set that up if useful.

subject: Admin console workspace settings reverting after save
body: Every time I update our workspace settings in the Admin Console - specifically the IP allowlist and default session timeout - the changes appear to save successfully, but when I reload the page or check the audit log, the previous values are still active. This has happened three separate times this week when trying to tighten our allowlist to a new set of office IPs. Our compliance team needs these settings locked in before our upcoming audit.
answer: Thank you for reporting this - settings silently reverting after a successful save is a serious issue, especially for allowlist and session policy given your upcoming audit, so we're prioritizing this. We're checking the audit log entries against the settings write path to see if there's a caching or replication issue causing the rollback. We'll update you as soon as we identify the cause, and please avoid retrying the save repeatedly in the meantime to keep the logs clean for our investigation.

subject: How to refresh OAuth token for pipeline connector without full re-auth
body: One of our data pipeline connectors is failing with an expired token error, and I want to understand the correct way to refresh authentication without tearing down the whole connector configuration and losing our field mappings. We're seeing intermittent 'token_expired' errors in the sync logs roughly every 30 days, which suggests the refresh token isn't being renewed automatically. Could you walk us through the expected refresh flow and whether there's a setting we're missing?
answer: Good question - connectors should refresh tokens automatically before expiry, so seeing recurring token_expired errors every 30 days suggests the refresh isn't completing silently. Please check the connector's auth settings page for a 'reconnect' vs 're-authenticate' option - reconnect preserves your field mappings while forcing a fresh token exchange. We'll also check our logs on the refresh job for your account to see why the automatic renewal might be failing.

subject: Dashboard PDF export timing out for large reports

The export spinner runs for about 90 seconds before showing a generic error. We have thousands of users relying on scheduled and manual PDF exports company-wide, so this is causing a noticeable backlog of support requests on our end.
answer: Thank you for reporting this - given the scale of your organization, export timeouts on larger dashboards are something we're escalating right away. We're checking whether recent chart rendering changes increased processing time for reports with 10+ charts, which would explain the ~90 second timeout pattern. We'll provide an update shortly with either a fix timeline or a workaround for splitting large exports in the meantime.

subject: Doppelte Alarm-E-Mails durch falsches Alert-Routing
body: Seit dem Update unserer Routing-Regeln am 14.03. bekommen unsere Techniker jede kritische Störungsmeldung doppelt per E-Mail, einmal über die Regel "Incident-Team" und einmal über "On-Call-Rotation". subject: Feature request: route Slack alerts by severity and source

Our production team would like critical alerts routed to a dedicated channel while low-severity ones stay in the general feed. I'll log this as a feature request tied to your account and let you know once we have a timeline to share.

subject: Late-arriving records breaking downstream sync in pipeline

subject: Better handling for repeated card decline notifications

subject: API pagination broken - causing rate limit exhaustion across production

We'll update you within 30 minutes with progress and a mitigation step if a full fix takes longer.

subject: Verspätete Daten im Connector führen zu Qualitätsproblemen
body: Uns ist aufgefallen, dass Daten aus unserem Retail-Connector regelmäßig mit 2-3 Stunden Verzögerung ankommen, wodurch unsere Tagesberichte teilweise unvollständige Zahlen enthalten. subject: How to restore a specific backup snapshot
body: We're integrating with the Storage API and need to restore a bucket to its state from February 20th before a bad deploy overwrote several objects. answer: You can trigger a point-in-time restore by passing the snapshot_id from the list endpoint into the /restore endpoint along with a target bucket - this restores only the objects present at that snapshot rather than a full overwrite. Restored data does count against your quota temporarily until you confirm and clean up any duplicates. Your current retention window is 30 days, so the February 20th snapshot should still be available; let us know if you don't see it listed.

subject: Wie kann ich das Audit Log für Deaktivierungen einsehen

Gehen Sie dazu in Einstellungen > Audit Log > Filter und wählen Sie diese Kategorie aus. Falls die Einträge dort ebenfalls fehlen, melden Sie sich bitte mit dem Zeitraum, den wir genauer prüfen können.

subject: PDF export timing out on large dashboards
body: I'm integrating our reporting dashboard with the export API and the export-to-PDF endpoint consistently times out for our largest dashboard, which has 14 charts and about 40k data points. answer: Thanks for the detailed report. There is currently a 60 second processing limit on PDF exports, and dashboards with that many charts and data points can exceed it during rendering. As a workaround, try splitting the dashboard into two export batches or reducing chart resolution settings, which usually brings render time under the limit. We're also logging this as a performance issue with our dashboard export team to look at raising the timeout for larger dashboards.

subject: Question about sharing permission scope on dashboards
body: I'm trying to understand how dashboard sharing permissions cascade to nested folders. When I share a dashboard folder with a user group, are permissions applied to dashboards added to that folder later, or only to the ones present at the time of sharing? We manage several thousand dashboards across teams and want to confirm this before restructuring our folder permissions.
answer: Good question - permissions applied at the folder level are dynamic, so any dashboard added to that folder later automatically inherits the same sharing permissions as the folder itself. If a dashboard is moved out of the folder, it retains whatever permissions it had at that point rather than reverting. Let us know if you'd like a walkthrough of folder permission inheritance for your specific setup.

subject: Anfrage zu API-Schlüsseln und Rate Limits
body: Wir integrieren gerade die Northwind API in unsere Lernplattform und haben nur 4 Sitzplätze im Starter-Plan. subject: Feature request: cursor-based pagination for large exports
body: As finance manager at Summit Legal, our team pulls large datasets through the API for monthly billing reconciliation across 257 seats. Currently the endpoints use offset-based pagination, which gets noticeably slower past page 200 when pulling transaction records. Would it be possible to add cursor-based pagination as an option, similar to what's used in the webhook event log endpoint? This would help a lot with performance on our larger monthly pulls.
answer: Thanks for the suggestion - this is a reasonable ask and you're right that cursor-based pagination performs much better for large datasets than offset pagination. We're logging this as a feature request for the API Platform team to consider extending the cursor-based approach used in the webhook event log to the transaction endpoints as well. We'll update you here if this gets scheduled for a future release.

subject: Slack alert routing by Jira project
body: I'm the product manager overseeing our Integrations rollout at Granite Labs. We've connected Slack and Jira through Northwind and alerts fire correctly, but every notification lands in one channel regardless of which Jira project triggered it. Our legal team runs 12 separate Jira projects and we need alerts routed to project-specific Slack channels. Is this configurable today, or is it on the roadmap? Our Okta-provisioned admins also couldn't find documentation on routing rules in the integration settings page.
answer: Thanks for the detailed writeup. Right now Slack alert routing is scoped at the integration level rather than per Jira project, so all notifications go to the single channel you've configured. I've filed this as a feature request with our product team and linked your account for visibility. In the meantime, I'll send over a workaround using Jira automation rules to filter and forward specific project alerts to separate channels, and I'll follow up with updated documentation on the routing settings page.

subject: Unsubscribe from duplicate invoice reminder emails
body: I manage finance for Quill Legal and I'm receiving the same invoice reminder twice each billing cycle, once from the Notifications module and once from what looks like a legacy alert rule. I only want to keep one of these active. Is there a way to see all active email subscriptions tied to my account so I can turn off the duplicate without losing the reminder entirely?
answer: Good catch, and thanks for flagging this. You can review all active email subscriptions under Notifications > Manage Alerts > Email Preferences, where duplicate rules often show up as separate entries with similar names. I'd recommend disabling the older rule (usually the one without a 'v2' suffix) and keeping the newer one, which includes updated invoice formatting. Let me know if you'd like me to pull your account's alert list directly so we can confirm which rule to disable.

subject: Files deleted before 90-day retention period expires
body: We're integrating with the Storage API for our travel booking platform and noticed files uploaded on March 3rd are already gone as of today, March 20th, well before our configured 90-day retention window. Our retention policy is set to 90 days in the workspace settings, but API calls to GET /v1/objects/{id} are returning 404 for at least 40 objects uploaded that day. This is causing failed bookings to reference missing receipts. We need this escalated urgently since it looks like data loss, not just a config issue.
answer: This is being escalated immediately given the potential data loss. I've opened a P1 investigation with our storage engineering team to check whether a retention job misfired for objects uploaded around March 3rd, and we're pulling deletion logs now to determine scope beyond the 40 objects you've identified. I'll update you within the next few hours with findings and, if objects are recoverable from our backup tier, a restoration timeline.

subject: late data
body: Pipeline still hours late. Fix now or we cancel!!
answer: I hear the frustration and I'm looking into this right now. Can you confirm which connector is affected and roughly how many hours late the data is running, so I can check pipeline logs for delays or backlog immediately?

subject: Deactivated users still showing as active
body: I deactivated 6 users from the Admin Console yesterday morning after they left the company, but two of them successfully logged in again this afternoon. The audit log shows the deactivation events but no corresponding block on login attempts. I also noticed the console took over 20 seconds to load the user list today, which hasn't happened before. This is a security concern since former employees still have access.
answer: Thank you for flagging this right away, this is a priority issue given the access concern. We're checking whether the deactivation event is failing to propagate to the auth service in time, which would explain the successful logins despite the audit log showing deactivation. I'm also passing along the console load-time issue to our performance team. I'll update you shortly with findings and confirm once those 6 accounts are fully locked out.

subject: Enterprise seat upgrade after acquisition, need proration details
body: We just closed an acquisition and need to add approximately 400 seats to our existing 3393-seat Enterprise plan by end of month. I'm trying to understand how proration will work for the partial billing period and whether the new seats will bill separately or merge into our existing invoice cycle. We'd also like to know if a refund applies to any seats we're planning to deactivate as part of the org consolidation.
answer: Congratulations on the acquisition, and thanks for getting ahead of the billing details. For seat additions mid-cycle, we prorate the new seats based on the remaining days in your current billing period and merge them into your existing invoice, so you won't see a separate charge. For seats you're deactivating, we can apply a prorated credit toward your next invoice rather than a direct refund. Given the scale here, I'm looping in our billing specialist to walk through exact numbers with you directly.

subject: URGENT: Backup restore failing, data missing from production
body: We triggered a restore from our nightly backup at 6:40 AM after a bad deploy wiped out customer records in our production Storage bucket, but the restore job has been stuck at 12% for over 40 minutes and now returns 'restore_failed: snapshot integrity check error'. We have zero access to roughly 3 hours of customer transaction data right now and this is affecting live checkout flows for our fintech customers.
answer: This is being treated as a full outage and escalated to our on-call storage engineering team immediately. We're investigating the snapshot integrity error on your restore job right now and checking for an alternate valid snapshot we can restore from to minimize data loss. I'll update you within 15 minutes with status, and please keep this ticket open, we'll be posting progress here continuously until service and data are fully restored.

subject: SCIM sync broken, new hires cannot log in
body: Our SCIM provisioning connector between our identity provider and Northwind stopped syncing new users as of this morning. Three new hires who were added to our IdP yesterday have no Northwind account created and can't log in at all, and MFA enrollment links aren't generating for them either. This is blocking their first day of work entirely. We haven't changed any SCIM configuration on our end recently.
answer: This is being treated as a priority issue since it's blocking new hire access. We're checking SCIM sync logs now to see whether requests from your identity provider are reaching us and failing, or not being sent at all. Can you confirm which identity provider you're using and share the timestamp of the last successful sync event on your end? I'll keep this open and update you as soon as we identify where the sync is breaking.

subject: Approaching storage quota, need retention policy options
body: Our workspace is at 92% of our storage quota and I'd like to understand our options before we hit the hard limit. We currently keep all uploaded documents indefinitely, but I'd like to explore setting a retention policy that automatically archives files older than 2 years instead of manually deleting them. Is there a feature for this, or do we need to build it ourselves via the API?
answer: Thanks for reaching out before hitting the limit. Automatic retention policies based on file age aren't currently available as a built-in workspace setting, but you can achieve this today via the Storage API by scheduling a script that queries objects by creation date and archives or deletes those older than your threshold. I'll also pass your request for a native retention policy feature along to our product team, since this comes up fairly often.

subject: Okta app issue
body: We've been using Northwind for a few months now across our small media team and things have generally worked well, we set up Slack and Jira integrations early on and those have been solid. Recently we started onboarding two new team members and went through our usual process of adding them via the Okta app tile. When I checked the integration dashboard after adding them, the Okta app for Northwind shows a 'configuration error' status and neither new user has been provisioned into Northwind at all, even though the tile appears normally in their Okta dashboard.
answer: Thanks for the context, and sorry for the trouble getting new team members provisioned. A 'configuration error' status on the Okta app tile usually points to an expired or mismatched SAML certificate between Okta and Northwind. Can you check the certificate expiration date in your Okta app settings and confirm it matches what's configured on our end? I'll pull your integration logs in parallel to see exactly where the provisioning request is failing.

subject: Question about SSO role mapping for regional finance groups
body:
We're rolling out a new regional structure across our retail finance teams and I'd like to understand how role mapping works with our current SSO setup. Right now all users coming in through our Okta SAML integration land in the default "Viewer" role regardless of their Okta group. Is there a way to map specific Okta groups, like FIN-APAC-Managers, to custom Northwind roles automatically?

Also curious whether MFA enforcement can be tied to specific roles rather than applied account-wide. Not urgent, just planning ahead for next quarter's rollout.
answer: Thanks for the detailed background. Role mapping is configured through SAML attribute statements — you can send a group attribute from Okta and we'll map it to Northwind roles in the SSO settings under Security and Compliance. If you send us the list of Okta groups you want mapped and the target Northwind roles, we can walk you through setting this up, and I'll also confirm whether role-based MFA policies are available on your current tier.

subject: Salesforce-Synchronisation bricht mit Fehler ab
body:
Seit dem 03.11. schlägt unsere Salesforce-Synchronisation regelmäßig fehl. In der Integrationsübersicht sehen wir bei etwa 40% der Datensätze den Fehler "Sync failed: OAuth token expired (Code 401)". Wir nutzen die Northwind-Salesforce-Integration zusammen mit unserem Okta-Login.

Können Sie prüfen, ob das Token erneuert werden muss oder ob es ein Problem auf Ihrer Seite gibt? Für uns als Kanzlei im Gesundheitswesen sind aktuelle Abrechnungsdaten aus Salesforce entscheidend, daher wäre eine baldige Lösung sehr hilfreich.
answer: Vielen Dank für die genaue Fehlerbeschreibung. Der Code 401 deutet darauf hin, dass die OAuth-Verbindung zu Salesforce erneut autorisiert werden muss. Bitte gehen Sie in den Integrationseinstellungen auf "Salesforce" und klicken Sie auf "Reconnect", damit ein neues Token ausgestellt wird. Parallel prüfen wir auf unserer Seite die Synchronisationslogs der letzten Tage, um auszuschließen, dass es ein serverseitiges Problem gibt, und melden uns mit einem Update.

subject: SCIM provisioning failing for new student accounts
body:
Since yesterday around 9am our SCIM provisioning from Azure AD to Northwind has stopped creating new accounts. We've queued about 85 new student records for the fall term and none of them are appearing in the admin console. The Azure AD provisioning log shows "Failed to send request 403: SCIM_TOKEN_INVALID" even though the token was rotated last week.

This is blocking our onboarding for the new term and we need this resolved as soon as possible since classes start Monday.
answer: I'm sorry for the disruption this is causing right before term start — I've flagged this as a P2 and looped in our identity team. Could you send us the SCIM tenant ID and the timestamp of the token rotation you mentioned? In the meantime we're checking whether the rotation invalidated the endpoint on our side, and we'll update you as soon as we have a fix or a workaround for provisioning the queued accounts.

subject: Data pipeline connector losing auth to logistics API
body:
Our logistics data connector (Shipment-Tracker API) has been failing authentication since 6am today. The pipeline dashboard shows "Connector auth error: refresh_token revoked" for job ID pipe-8841. This connector feeds our daily shipment reconciliation and three sync runs have already failed, so our downstream reports are now stale.

Can someone help us re-authorize this connector or tell us why the token was revoked? We need shipment data current again as soon as possible.
answer: Thanks for flagging this right away — I understand stale shipment data is a real problem for reconciliation, so we're treating this as high priority. Could you try re-authorizing the connector from Pipelines > Connections > Shipment-Tracker and let us know if the re-auth flow completes? On our end we're checking whether the revocation was triggered by a credential rotation on the provider's side or an internal token expiry issue, and we'll follow up shortly with what we find.

subject: SAML login setup
body:
We're a small energy startup and we've been expanding our team over the last quarter, currently at 12 seats on the Starter plan. We recently decided to move away from managing individual passwords and want to standardize on single sign-on through our identity provider, Azure AD, to make onboarding and offboarding easier for our ops team.

We set up the SAML app in Azure AD following your docs and configured the ACS URL and Entity ID exactly as shown in the admin console. However, when our engineers try to log in via the SSO link, they get redirected back to Northwind with an error "SAML response could not be validated." This started Tuesday and is now blocking three engineers from accessing the platform.
answer: Thanks for the thorough walkthrough of your setup. That validation error is usually caused by a certificate mismatch or clock skew between Azure AD and Northwind, so could you export the current SAML metadata XML from Azure AD and send it over? We'll compare it against what's configured on our side and check the certificate expiry and timestamp tolerance to get your engineers back in as quickly as possible.

subject: Need to update IP allowlist for office move
body:
We're relocating our office network next week and need to update the IP allowlist in the Admin Console before our old IP range is decommissioned on Friday. When I try to add the new range (203.0.113.0/24) in Settings > Security, the page hangs and eventually shows "Failed to save allowlist rule" with no further detail.

I also noticed the audit log doesn't show any failed attempt entries for this action, so I can't tell if it's a permissions issue on my end or a bug in the console. Could you help us get the new range added before Friday?
answer: Thanks for the heads-up on the timeline — since this affects access continuity for your whole team, we're prioritizing it. Could you confirm which admin role your account holds and try the update once more while we check the allowlist service logs on our side for that time window? We'll also look into why the audit log isn't capturing the failed save attempts, as that should be recorded regardless of outcome.

subject: Slack alerts not firing after integration update
body:
Our Slack alert integration stopped posting notifications to our #ops-alerts channel starting this morning around 7am. We rely on these alerts for logistics exception handling and haven't received a single message in over 3 hours despite multiple pipeline errors that should have triggered them. The integration status page shows "Connected" with no errors listed.

We also have Okta and Salesforce connected but those integrations seem unaffected. This is a big problem for us since our team depends on real-time alerts to catch shipment delays.
answer: I understand how critical those real-time alerts are for catching delays, so I've escalated this to our integrations team as a priority issue. Could you confirm the Slack workspace name and the alert rule IDs that should be firing? We're checking the notification delivery queue on our end now to see whether messages are being generated but not delivered, or not generated at all, and will update you as soon as we identify the cause.

subject: Need to adjust scheduled sync frequency for reporting pipelines
body:
We'd like to change the scheduled sync frequency for our media reporting pipelines from every 6 hours to hourly, since our analytics team has been flagging stale data in dashboards. Currently the connector (Ad-Revenue-Feed) syncs at 00:00, 06:00, 12:00, and 18:00 UTC, but we're seeing latency spikes of up to 45 minutes beyond the scheduled window on the 12:00 and 18:00 runs specifically.

Could you help us both increase the sync frequency and look into why those two runs are consistently delayed? We want to make sure the change doesn't make the latency issue worse.
answer: Thanks for the specifics on the latency pattern — that's helpful for diagnosing the delayed runs. Before we increase the frequency to hourly, we want to check whether the 12:00 and 18:00 slots are hitting a resource contention window on our scheduler, since that could compound if we add more frequent syncs. We'll investigate the latency root cause first and follow up with a recommended schedule change once we confirm it won't introduce further delays.

subject: Deactivated users still showing as active in Admin Console
body:
We deactivated 14 employees yesterday as part of a restructuring, following our standard process in the Admin Console under Users > Deactivate. Today all 14 accounts still show status "Active" and two of them were able to log in this morning, which is a serious security concern given they no longer work here.

We need this fixed immediately and also need to understand why the deactivation didn't take effect so we can trust this process going forward. Please treat this as urgent given the access risk involved.
answer: This is being treated as a top priority given the access risk you've described — I've escalated it immediately to our security team. Could you send us the list of the 14 user IDs or emails affected so we can force-deactivate them on our end right away while we investigate why the console action didn't propagate? We'll also review the deactivation logs from yesterday to determine why the status didn't update and will report back with root cause findings.

subject: Plan upgrade charged incorrectly and seats not updated
body:
We upgraded from our Pro plan to add 50 more seats yesterday through the billing dashboard, and the invoice generated shows a charge of $4,890 which is roughly double what our pricing page quote indicated. On top of that, the seat count in our account still shows 204 instead of the 254 we upgraded to, so several new team members can't be added yet.

This is blocking onboarding for new hires this week and the incorrect charge needs to be corrected or refunded. Invoice number is INV-08841 if that helps look into it faster.
answer: Thank you for flagging both issues together, and I'm sorry for the trouble this is causing with onboarding. We're looking into invoice INV-08841 right now to determine why the charge doubled and will process a correction or refund for any overage once confirmed. We're also checking why the seat count didn't update to 254 after the upgrade and will push that fix through manually today so your new hires aren't blocked.

subject: Can't share dashboard
body: Sharing broken, export fails too. Urgent.
answer: Sorry for the trouble, this is impacting your team so we're prioritizing it now. Can you tell us the dashboard ID and whether the export error shows a specific message or just fails silently? We'll investigate the sharing permissions bug and follow up shortly with next steps.

subject: All uploads failing to Storage since this morning
body: We've had zero successful uploads to our Storage buckets since around 7:40am today. Every attempt returns a 503 with 'upstream write timeout' and our finance team can't push the month-end reconciliation files. We're on a tight deadline and this is blocking closing activities for three departments.
answer: We're treating this as a full outage and have escalated to the storage infrastructure team immediately. We're seeing elevated write timeouts on the region your account is provisioned in and are actively working the incident; we'll post updates every 30 minutes until resolved and will confirm once uploads are stable again.

subject: Recurring card decline on invoice INV-88213
body: Our card on file was declined again for invoice INV-88213, third time this billing cycle. The bank shows no issue on their end and we'd like to understand if Northwind is retrying with the wrong expiration date. Could you also let us know if a partial refund is possible for the late fee that was applied?
answer: Thanks for flagging this, I've pulled up invoice INV-88213 and can see the retries are using the card details on file, which do show an expiration mismatch. I've corrected the record and reversed the late fee as a courtesy; please retry the payment from your billing settings and let us know if the decline persists.

subject: Card failure blocking seat renewal, need urgent fix
body: Our corporate card was declined when the system tried to renew our 34-seat Pro plan yesterday, and we just got a notice that access may be suspended in 48 hours. This affects everyone on the team including our field staff who rely on daily reports. Can you help us update payment details and confirm the renewal goes through before the suspension window?
answer: I understand the urgency here and have placed a temporary hold on the suspension so your team keeps access while we resolve this. Please update the card details in the billing portal and I'll manually trigger the renewal charge once that's done; I'll stay on this ticket until the plan shows as active again.

subject: IP allowlist changes not taking effect for admin console
body: We added two new office IP ranges to the allowlist in the Admin Console three hours ago, but users on those ranges are still being blocked with 'access denied by network policy'. The audit log shows the change was saved successfully at 14:12 UTC, yet enforcement seems to still reference the old list. Several engineers are locked out and can't manage account settings.
answer: This looks like a propagation issue on the enforcement layer rather than a save failure, and we're treating it as high priority since it's blocking access for your team. We're pushing a manual sync of the allowlist now and will confirm once your new ranges are active; in the meantime we can temporarily whitelist your listed ranges at the edge if you need immediate access.

subject: Storage quota warnings despite recent cleanup
body: We're getting repeated quota-exceeded warnings on our Storage account even after deleting roughly 4TB of old backup archives last week. Current usage dashboard still shows us at 98% of allocation, which doesn't match what we see in the bucket listing. This is starting to affect scheduled backup jobs which are failing with 'insufficient quota' errors.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report, it sounds like the usage metering hasn't refreshed after your deletions, which would explain the mismatch and the failing backup jobs. We're re-running the quota recalculation for your account now and will confirm the corrected figure within a couple of hours; we'll also check why the scheduled backups aren't retrying gracefully.

subject: SCIM provisioning not creating new users after IdP update
body: We updated our identity provider configuration last week and since then SCIM provisioning has stopped creating new user accounts in Northwind. Deprovisioning still works fine, but new hires added in our IdP never show up here. We checked the SCIM logs and see repeated 'schema validation failed' entries but the documentation doesn't cover this error code.
answer: Thanks for the detail on the SCIM logs, that error usually points to a required attribute mapping that changed on the IdP side during your update. Could you send us a sample of the SCIM payload for one new user so we can pinpoint which field is failing validation? In the meantime we'll review our provisioning documentation to clarify this error for future reference.

subject: Seat count on invoice doesn't match active users
body: Our latest invoice bills us for 66 seats, but our admin console shows only 58 active users this cycle. We deactivated several accounts last month after a reorg and expected the seat count to adjust automatically. Could you review this and let us know if a credit or plan adjustment is possible, and clarify how seat counts are calculated going forward?
answer: Thanks for flagging the discrepancy, I've reviewed your account and confirmed the seat count wasn't automatically reduced after the deactivations last month, which is on us to fix. I'll issue a prorated credit for the difference on your next invoice and can walk you through how seat counts sync so this doesn't happen again after future changes.

subject: Connector authentication expiring for our ad platform sync
body: Our data pipeline connector to our advertising platform keeps requiring re-authentication every few days, which is causing small gaps in our sync history. It's not blocking anything critical right now, but we'd like to understand if there's a way to extend the token lifetime or set up automatic refresh so we don't have to manually reconnect each week.
answer: Good question, most connectors do support automatic token refresh, and if it's prompting for manual re-auth that frequently it's likely the refresh token scope wasn't granted during initial setup. We'll send over a quick guide on reconfiguring the connector with the correct scopes, and if the gaps persist afterward we can dig into the sync logs together.

subject: SHARING PERMISSIONS BROKEN ON DASHBOARDS
body: WE CANNOT SET VIEW-ONLY SHARING ON OUR DASHBOARDS ANYMORE. EVERY TIME WE TRY TO SHARE A CHART EXPORT WITH A COLLEAGUE THE PERMISSION DROPDOWN RESETS TO EDITOR AND THEY GET FULL ACCESS INSTEAD OF READ ONLY. THIS IS HAPPENING ACROSS MULTIPLE DASHBOARDS AND TEAMS AND WE NEED THIS FIXED BEFORE WE SHARE ANY MORE REPORTS EXTERNALLY.
answer: Thanks for the clear description, this matches a permission reset bug we're currently tracking on the sharing dropdown component. As a workaround, please set the permission after the share link is generated rather than before saving, which should hold correctly; our team is working on a permanent fix and I'll update this ticket once it's deployed.

subject: Jira integration is a joke - still no epic linking after 3 months
body:
I've asked twice already and I'm asking again because nothing has changed. Our team at Cobalt Analytics needs to link Northwind tickets to Jira epics, not just individual issues. Right now the integration only supports issue-level linking, which is useless for how we triage escalations. We were told back in December this was 'on the roadmap' and it's still not here.

I'm honestly close to recommending we drop this integration entirely and go back to manual tracking in Salesforce. Can someone actually tell me if epic linking is being built, or should I stop waiting?
answer: I hear the frustration and I'm sorry this has dragged on without a clear answer. Epic-level linking for the Jira integration is currently in our backlog under active review by the integrations team, but I don't have a committed ship date I can promise you today. I'm logging this as a feature escalation on your account and will follow up directly once I get a status update from engineering, rather than leaving you guessing again.

subject: Duplicate alerts flooding email for all 242 users
body:
Since this morning around 8:40 AM every notification triggered in our workspace is arriving as two, sometimes three, identical emails. This is happening across departments - shift alerts, approval notices, and system status emails are all duplicating. Employees are starting to mark these as spam which is going to hurt our deliverability.

We haven't changed any notification rules or integrations recently. Can you confirm if this is a known issue on your end? With 242 seats active this is generating a huge volume of unnecessary email traffic.
answer: Thanks for flagging this quickly. We've identified a regression in the notification dispatch service that is causing duplicate email sends for a subset of workspaces, and your account is affected. Our engineering team is deploying a fix now and we expect duplicate sends to stop within the hour; we'll also be running a cleanup pass to prevent any retry backlog from causing further duplicates. I'll update you as soon as the fix is confirmed live on your workspace.

subject: Missing line items on last two monthly invoices
body:
Our finance team flagged that the invoices for March and April are missing the per-module breakdown we usually get for our Enterprise plan. We have 3,249 seats across multiple business units and need itemized costs by module for internal cost allocation. The PDFs we downloaded only show a single lump sum.

Could you resend corrected invoices with the itemization, or point me to where in the billing portal this detail should be available? We need this resolved before our end-of-quarter close.
answer: Thanks for the detail on this. Itemized module breakdowns should generate automatically for Enterprise invoices, so this looks like a template issue affecting your account specifically. I'm requesting corrected invoices for March and April from our billing team now and will send them to you directly once regenerated, along with confirmation that future invoices will include the full breakdown before your next close.

subject: Cannot deactivate former employee accounts - still showing active
body:
We offboarded two employees last week and I deactivated their accounts through the Admin Console, but both still show as 'Active' in the user list and one of them was still able to log into our dashboard yesterday. We only have 4 seats total so this is a serious exposure for us given our size.

I followed the standard deactivation steps under Users > Manage, clicked Deactivate, and got a success confirmation each time, but the status reverted within a few hours. Can you help urgently, we need these accounts locked down.
answer: This is a priority for us given the access risk involved. I've manually forced deactivation on both accounts from our side and confirmed they can no longer authenticate as of now. We're also investigating why the deactivation state reverted after your initial action, since that points to a sync issue in the console, and I'll update you within the day with root cause and confirmation that it won't recur.

subject: Rolling out mandatory MFA enrolment for staff
body: We'd like to move our 25 users from optional to mandatory MFA enrolment ahead of the new academic term. Right now users can skip the MFA setup prompt indefinitely, and we want to close that gap before term starts. Could you confirm the steps to enforce this at the workspace level in Identity and SSO settings, and whether there's a grace period we can configure for staff who haven't set up an authenticator app yet?
answer: You can enforce mandatory MFA under Identity and SSO > Security Policies by switching enrolment from 'Optional' to 'Required', which will prompt all unenrolled users on next login. There's a configurable grace period field there too, we typically recommend 7 days for a smooth rollout. I'd suggest sending staff a heads-up before switching this on, and I'm happy to walk through the settings with you if useful.

subject: Request to enable biometric login on mobile app for all staff
body:
We'd like to enable biometric login (Face ID/fingerprint) as an option for our mobile app users across the organization, we have 4,562 seats and a large share are field staff who currently type passwords multiple times a day on shared devices. Right now the biometric toggle isn't visible in our workspace's mobile settings at all.

Is this a feature we need to opt into at the admin level, and if so what's the rollout process? Given the scale of our travel operations this would meaningfully cut login friction for field teams.
answer: Biometric login is available but needs to be enabled at the workspace level before it appears for individual users. I'll enable the feature flag for your organization today; once active, users will see the Face ID/fingerprint option under their mobile app's security settings on next app launch. Given your seat count, we recommend a phased rollout starting with one region, and I can share a short rollout guide to help coordinate that.

subject: Getting duplicate push and email alerts for same event
body: For the past two days our team has been receiving two notifications for every alert triggered, one push and one email, even though we only have email notifications enabled in settings. We're a small team of 7 so it's very noticeable when everyone's phone buzzes twice for the same booking alert. Nothing was changed in our notification preferences recently. Can you check what's causing the duplication?
answer: Thanks for the clear report. This looks like a channel override issue where push notifications are being triggered despite being disabled in your settings, likely from a stale device token registration. I'm checking your workspace's notification config now and will disable the erroneous push channel while we confirm the underlying cause; you should see this stop within a few hours.

subject: Question about MFA enrolment reminder frequency
body: A couple of our 4 users still haven't completed MFA enrolment despite the login prompt. I want to understand how often the enrolment reminder actually fires, is it every login attempt or just once per session? It doesn't seem consistent based on what our team is reporting, and I want to make sure it's not a bug before I chase people down again.
answer: The enrolment reminder is designed to trigger once per session rather than on every login attempt, so if users are dismissing it and not being prompted again until their session expires, that's expected behavior. If you want a stricter policy, you can switch to 'prompt every login' under Identity and SSO > MFA Settings, which should help get remaining users enrolled faster.

subject: How do users self-enroll in MFA without admin trigger?
body: One of our engineers, who is part of Quill Labs, is asking whether users can proactively enroll in MFA themselves rather than waiting for the system-generated prompt after login. We have 18 seats and want a few technical staff to opt in early before we roll it out company-wide. Is there a self-service path under user settings, or does enrolment only get triggered by an admin-side policy change?
answer: Users can self-enroll ahead of any admin policy change by going to their account settings under Security > Two-Factor Authentication and selecting 'Set up now', no admin action required. This is a good approach for early adopters, and once you're ready to enforce it org-wide you can still apply the mandatory policy separately without affecting those who've already enrolled.

subject: IP allowlist blocking access from new office location
body: We recently opened a new office and staff there are unable to reach the admin console, getting a generic 'Access Denied' page. I believe this is because our IP allowlist under Admin Console > Security only includes our original two office ranges. We have 282 seats across both locations now and need to add the new office's public IP range without disrupting current access.
answer: That matches the behavior of an IP allowlist blocking an unlisted range. You can add the new office's public IP block under Admin Console > Security > IP Allowlist without affecting existing entries, additions there don't remove or override current ranges. body: We've noticed our team gets two identical email notifications every time a billing event triggers an alert, both arriving within a minute of each other.
