Not blocking anything critical, just cluttering inboxes for our 8 seats.
answer: Good catch, and this is usually caused by two overlapping alert rules matching the same event type rather than a system bug. I'd suggest reviewing your Notifications rule list for any duplicate conditions targeting billing events, but I can also pull up your current rule configuration on our end and point out the overlap directly if that's easier.

subject: Question on adjusting seat count for Pro plan
body: We currently have 101 seats on our Pro plan and I need to true up our billing. We onboarded 6 new dispatch staff last month but offboarded 4 warehouse leads in the same period, so I want to confirm our net seat count before the next invoice cycle on the 1st. Can you walk me through how seat adjustments are reflected mid-cycle, and whether we get a prorated credit for the offboarded users?
answer: Thanks for reaching out. Seat changes are prorated automatically the moment a user is deactivated in the admin console, so the 4 offboarded warehouse leads should already be generating a credit against your next invoice. For the 6 new seats, those will be billed pro-rata from their activation date rather than the full cycle. I can pull your account's current seat ledger and send a breakdown so you can reconcile it against your invoice before it's issued.

subject: Dashboard charts not rendering for our team
body: Since yesterday morning several of our operations dashboards are showing blank panels where bar and line charts used to display. This is affecting the enrollment trends dashboard we review every day with our 34 staff accounts. Refreshing the page or switching browsers hasn't helped, and the export to PDF option also produces a blank page where the chart should be.
answer: Sorry for the disruption to your daily review. This matches an issue we've seen with a recent rendering update on the charting library affecting certain dashboard templates - we're actively investigating. In the meantime, can you confirm which dashboard template ID or URL is affected and roughly how many panels are blank versus rendering normally, so we can narrow down whether it's isolated to specific chart types?

subject: Okta SSO integration failing SCIM provisioning for 200 users
body: We're setting up the Okta app integration for SSO and SCIM provisioning across our 200 seats, and provisioning is failing with a 'schema mismatch' error whenever Okta tries to push user attributes to Northwind. The push works fine for a handful of test users but fails in bulk once we assign the full group. This is blocking our go-live date this week and we need this resolved urgently.
answer: I understand the urgency given your go-live timeline. The schema mismatch during bulk push usually points to an attribute mapping conflict that only surfaces at scale - can you send us the exact error payload from Okta's provisioning log along with the group name you're pushing? I'm escalating this to our integrations team now so we can get you a fix or workaround well ahead of your deadline.

subject: Storage retention policy not deleting expired objects
body: Our retention policy is set to purge objects older than 90 days, but we've found files from March still present in our storage buckets as of today. This is a compliance concern since our internal audit assumes automatic deletion is working. Our quota usage has also crept up unexpectedly, which lines up with retention not functioning as configured across our 139-seat account.
answer: This is a serious compliance concern and we're treating it as priority. We're checking whether the retention job has been silently failing for your account or if a recent policy change didn't apply correctly. Please avoid disabling or re-saving your retention policy for now, and we'll follow up shortly with findings on the March objects and confirmation of when purging will resume.

subject: Frequent transform failures in retail sync pipeline
body: We're seeing intermittent transform failures in our inventory sync pipeline, roughly 15-20 failed runs per day out of about 400 total. The failures happen at the JSON-to-relational transform step and the error just says 'unexpected null in required field' without specifying which record. We'd like a way to get more granular error output, or a retry mechanism that skips just the bad record instead of failing the whole batch.
answer: Thanks for the detailed numbers - that failure rate is worth digging into. We agree that surfacing the specific record and field would help a lot; I'll log this as a feature request for per-record error detail in transform logs. In the meantime, I'd recommend enabling partial-batch retry in your pipeline settings if it isn't already on, which should let good records through while quarantining the failing ones for review.

subject: DIGEST EMAILS NEVER ARRIVE AND DOCS ARE USELESS
body: i set up the notification digest api for daily email summaries like your docs say but nothign ever gets sent, not one email in 5 days. i checked spam, checked the api response and it returns 200 ok every time but no email shows up anywhere. your documentation page just says 'configure your digest schedule' with NO actual example payload for the schedule field. this is rediculous for a paid product and if i cant get a straight answer im cancelling.
answer: I'm sorry for the frustration this has caused, especially with no working example to reference. A 200 response with no delivery usually means the schedule payload was accepted but didn't match an expected cron format, which silently no-ops instead of erroring - I'd like to see the exact payload you're sending so I can confirm the correct format for you. I'll also flag the documentation gap so an example gets added, since you're right that it should be there.

subject: Connector authentication expiring for scheduled pulls
body: Our connector to pull shipment data keeps losing its authenticated session every couple of days, requiring us to manually re-authorize via OAuth in the dashboard. It's not a full outage since we catch it before the next scheduled sync, but I wanted to understand if there's a way to get a longer-lived refresh token or a webhook notification when the token is about to expire, so we're not checking manually.
answer: Good question - by default our connector tokens are issued with a 48-72 hour refresh window depending on the source system, which explains the pattern you're seeing. We don't currently have a proactive expiry webhook, but I'll add that to our feature request list since it would help with exactly this kind of monitoring. In the meantime, enabling the 'auto-refresh' toggle under connector settings should extend the session automatically as long as the connector is called at least once within the window.

subject: Transform failures causing delayed booking data
body: Our booking data pipeline has started failing transforms intermittently since Tuesday, and it's affecting the connector that feeds our nightly reporting. We're seeing about 30% of runs fail with a generic 'transform step timeout' error, which is a change from the near-zero failure rate we had last week. This is starting to affect downstream reports our regional teams rely on each morning.
answer: Thanks for flagging this quickly - a jump from near-zero to 30% failures is significant and we're prioritizing it. We're checking whether this correlates with increased data volume or an upstream schema change on the connector's source side around Tuesday. We'll update you within a few hours with either a root cause or a mitigation to reduce the timeout failures while we investigate further.

subject: Scheduled syncs stopped running overnight
body: Our nightly scheduled sync for retail sales data did not run last night, and this morning our dashboards are showing stale data from two days ago. The sync history shows the job as 'skipped' rather than failed, with no error message. This is blocking our morning reporting cycle for 86 users who rely on this data being current.
answer: This is impacting your whole team's morning workflow so we're treating it urgently. A 'skipped' status without an error typically points to a scheduler-side issue rather than a connector failure, and we're checking your account's job queue now to see why it didn't trigger. We'll run a manual sync to get your data current while we investigate the root cause of the skip.

subject: Recurring transform errors need documentation or fix
body: I manage finance reporting and rely on the data pipeline exports for our monthly reconciliation. For the past two cycles, the currency conversion transform step has failed silently, leaving some rows with null converted values instead of erroring out. I've had to manually flag and correct these each month, and I'd like to understand if this is a known bug or if there's a configuration step we're missing.
answer: Thank you for the detail on the pattern across two cycles - silent nulls instead of an error is not expected behavior and sounds like a bug in how the currency transform handles missing exchange rate lookups. I'm escalating this to our pipeline team to reproduce with your transform configuration, and in the meantime I'll send over a temporary validation step you can add to catch null conversions before they reach your reconciliation file.

subject: SCIM provisioning setup for Harbor Academy
body: I'm helping our IT volunteer set up SSO for our 8 staff accounts and we'd like to move to SCIM so new hires get provisioned automatically instead of us adding them manually each semester. Could you point me to the setup guide for SCIM with our identity provider? We currently use Google Workspace for login and want new accounts to inherit the same MFA policy we have configured now.
answer: Thanks for reaching out. SCIM provisioning is available on your plan, and I've attached our setup guide for connecting Google Workspace as your SCIM source, including how to map MFA and role attributes so new accounts inherit your current login policy. Let us know once you've generated the SCIM token in your admin console and we can confirm the connection test on our end.

subject: PDF export timing out on large dashboards
body: Several of my colleagues and I have been trying to export our quarterly travel spend dashboard to PDF and it's been failing consistently since Monday, October 14th. The export just spins for a couple minutes and then shows 'Export failed, please try again.' This dashboard has about 12 widgets and roughly 50,000 rows of underlying data. We rely on this export for our weekly leadership review and it's now blocking that report for two weeks running.
answer: I'm sorry this is holding up your leadership reporting. We've seen export timeouts on dashboards with heavier widget counts and are actively investigating a performance issue in the PDF rendering service that seems to match what you're describing. As a workaround, could you try splitting the dashboard into two smaller views or exporting the top widgets separately while we dig into the root cause? I'll update you within one business day with progress.

subject: SCIM sync creating duplicate user records
body: We've noticed that our SCIM provisioning from our identity provider is creating duplicate accounts for users who were deactivated and later reactivated. Right now we have at least 40 duplicate entries across our 1,629 seats, and some of these duplicates have inconsistent permission sets, with a few missing MFA enforcement entirely. This started after our IdP sync job ran on October 10th.
answer: Thank you for flagging this, and I understand the concern given the permission and MFA inconsistencies involved. We're pulling your SCIM sync logs from October 10th to identify why reactivated users are being provisioned as new records rather than matched to existing ones. Please hold off on manually deleting duplicates for now so we can trace the mapping issue, and we'll follow up shortly with a list of affected accounts and a remediation plan.

subject: Users getting logged out mid-session unexpectedly
body: We're seeing a spike in support tickets from our own users at Cobalt Foods reporting they're being logged out of Northwind mid-session, sometimes just 10-15 minutes after login, well before the expected session timeout. This started yesterday afternoon and affects users across multiple teams, not tied to a specific SSO provider. We have 262 seats and this is disrupting daily work across the org.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report and for confirming this isn't isolated to one SSO provider. We're treating this as an active incident and checking our session token service for irregular expiration behavior starting yesterday. In the meantime, could you confirm whether affected users are on a specific browser or network, and we'll keep you posted with updates as we investigate further.

subject: Need bulk user deactivation with audit trail
body: As we offboard a former partner's team, I need a reliable way to deactivate multiple user accounts at once from the Admin Console and have that action clearly reflected in our audit log for compliance purposes. Right now I can only deactivate users one at a time, and our compliance officer needs a documented trail of who was deactivated and when, ideally exportable. Could you advise on a bulk option or workaround, and confirm the audit log captures deactivation timestamps accurately?
answer: This is a priority for us given the compliance timeline you mentioned. Currently bulk deactivation isn't available as a single-click action, but I can walk you through a CSV-based workaround using our admin API that logs each deactivation individually with a timestamp and actor in your audit log. I'll send over the step-by-step guide within the hour, and please let me know your target completion date so we can prioritize support accordingly.

subject: Okta integration failing to sync user roles
body: Our Okta app integration stopped syncing user role assignments as of this past Tuesday. When I check the integration logs, roles that should map from Okta groups to Northwind permissions are just not updating, so several analysts on my team still show outdated access levels. This is blocking our energy sector reporting workflows since we can't get the right people into the right dashboards.
answer: I'm sorry for the disruption this is causing your reporting workflows. In the meantime, could you send us the specific Okta group names and expected Northwind roles for the affected analysts so we can manually correct their access while the fix is rolled out?

subject: Recurring transform failures in media pipeline
body: We're seeing intermittent transform failures in our data pipeline connecting our media asset connector to our warehouse. Over the past week we've had roughly 15 failed runs out of about 200, each throwing a generic 'transform step failed' error with no further detail in the pipeline console. Given we're running this at scale across 2,202 seats, even a small failure rate is adding noticeable latency to our downstream reporting.
answer: Thanks for the specifics, that failure rate is helpful context. We're pulling the detailed logs for the transform step on your pipeline to identify what's triggering the generic failure message, since the console error alone doesn't show root cause. We'll also check whether this correlates with any recent connector updates on our side, and I'll follow up with findings and a mitigation plan within two business days.

subject: Fehler bei geplanten Synchronisierungen
body:
Seit gestern schlagen unsere geplanten Syncs in der Datenpipeline fehl. Der Sync läuft normalerweise um 02:00 Uhr, aber seit dem 15. Oktober bekommen wir folgende Fehlermeldung:

[2024-10-15 02:00:13] ERROR SyncJob#4471: Connection to source timed out after 30000ms
[2024-10-15 02:00:13] ERROR Retry attempt 1/3 failed
[2024-10-15 02:00:44] ERROR Retry attempt 2/3 failed

Oktober. Können Sie uns bestätigen, ob sich an der Erreichbarkeit der Quelle etwas geändert hat, während wir parallel prüfen, ob das Zeitlimit auf unserer Seite angepasst werden muss?

subject: Zapier integration not triggering on new API events
body: I'm building a Zapier integration that should trigger a workflow whenever a new order event hits our API, but the Zap hasn't fired at all since we set it up three days ago despite confirmed API events coming through (we can see them in our API logs with 200 responses). We're on the Pro plan with 204 seats and this is blocking an automation our logistics team is waiting on to go live this week.
answer: Thanks for the clear detail on the API logs showing successful 200 responses. This suggests the webhook Zapier is listening to may not be receiving the event payload correctly on our end, so we're checking whether the order event trigger is properly registered in our Zapier app configuration. Could you share the Zap's trigger ID and one of the API event IDs from the last three days so we can trace exactly where the payload is being dropped?

subject: Mobile app crashes immediately on launch
body: The Northwind mobile app has been crashing immediately on launch for me and two other people on my finance team since yesterday morning. We're all on iPhones, different models, and the app closes within a second or two of tapping the icon, before we even see the login screen. We rely on the app to approve expense reports on the go and this is now blocking approvals for our 20-person team.
answer: I'm sorry for the disruption this is causing your approval workflow. Crashes right at launch before the login screen usually point to a corrupted local cache or a recent iOS compatibility issue, so could you have affected users try fully uninstalling and reinstalling the app, and let us know their iOS version? We're also checking crash reports on our end for the same timeframe and will escalate immediately if this points to a broader app issue.

subject: Upgrade to Growth plan didn't apply correctly
body:
We upgraded from Starter to Growth on Nov 3rd through the billing portal, but our invoice #INV-88213 still shows the Starter per-seat rate for all 14 seats. The upgrade confirmation email said it would take effect immediately, but the new features (custom roles) also aren't showing up in the admin console.

Can someone check whether the upgrade actually processed on the backend? We'd rather not pay twice while this gets sorted out.
answer: Thanks for flagging this - I can see the upgrade request logged on our side for Nov 3rd but it looks like it stalled during the payment method re-verification step, which is why both the invoice and feature flags didn't update. I'm manually re-triggering the plan change now and will confirm once the Growth features and corrected invoice are visible on your account, likely within the next hour.

subject: Dashboards taking 20+ seconds to load this week
body:
Since Monday our main revenue dashboard has been really slow to load, sometimes 20-30 seconds before charts render. We have about 8 charts pulling from the bookings dataset and it worked fine last week. A few colleagues on the travel ops team have mentioned the same lag when filtering by date range.

Is there something on our end causing this, like too many widgets, or is this a known performance issue right now?
answer: Sorry for the slowdown - we're aware of elevated query latency affecting dashboards with multiple charts pulling from the same large dataset, and your account shows a pattern consistent with that. As a workaround, splitting the date-range filter into a separate control rather than applying it per-chart should help in the short term. Our engineering team is actively working on the underlying query caching issue and I'll update you once we have a fix timeline.

subject: Best practice for handling late-arriving data in pipelines
body:
We've noticed that our media metrics pipeline occasionally receives records with event timestamps up to 36 hours after the pipeline run that should have included them. This mostly happens with our ad-server connector. Right now we just get gaps in daily aggregates that fill in later, which confuses stakeholders reviewing reports.

Is there documentation on configuring a reprocessing window or late-arrival tolerance so these records get backfilled automatically into the right day's aggregate?
answer: Good question - this is a common pattern with ad-server sources. We do support a configurable late-arrival window on pipeline destinations that triggers automatic reprocessing of affected aggregates; I'll send you the documentation link for setting the tolerance window under Pipeline Settings > Reprocessing. For your case, a 48-hour window should cover the delay pattern you're describing, but let me know if you'd like help configuring it directly.

subject: Urgent: healthcare data pipeline running 6+ hours behind
body:
Our patient intake sync pipeline (connector ID conn-4471) has been running 6 to 8 hours behind schedule since this morning. Runs that normally complete in 20 minutes are now queued and finishing hours late, which means downstream reports our compliance team relies on are stale. We first noticed the delay around 7am today.

This is affecting real operational decisions on our end - can someone check why conn-4471 is backing up and get it flowing normally again?
answer: I've escalated this immediately given the compliance impact. Initial check shows conn-4471 has a backlog of roughly 340 queued jobs, likely caused by an upstream rate-limit change on the source system that's slowing ingestion. We're increasing the worker allocation for your pipeline now to clear the backlog faster and will monitor closely - I'll update you within the hour with current lag and an estimated time to catch up.

subject: Need to restrict admin console access by IP
body: We need to lock down access to our Northwind admin console so only our office IP ranges can log in, ideally by end of day since we just had a contractor's access revoked and want to tighten things immediately. I can't find an IP allowlist option anywhere in the Admin Console settings - is this a feature we have access to on our current plan, and if so where is it configured?
answer: IP allowlisting is available under Admin Console > Security > Access Control, though it does require enabling on your account first since it's not on by default for Starter plans - I'm turning it on for your workspace now. Once enabled you'll be able to add your office IP ranges and it will take effect within a few minutes; I'll confirm here once it's active so you can start testing before end of day.

subject: Connector keeps losing authentication with source system
body:
Our CRM connector has failed authentication three times this week, on Monday, Wednesday, and again this morning. Each time we have to manually re-enter the API key in the connector settings to get it running again, and in between failures the pipeline just sits idle with no data flowing. Error shown in the connector log is "401 Unauthorized - token expired."

Is there a way to set up automatic token refresh so we don't have to keep doing this manually?
answer: Thanks for the details - the repeated 401 errors point to your CRM connector using a short-lived token that isn't being refreshed automatically, which is a known gap for a few of our older connector configurations. I'll switch your connector to use OAuth refresh tokens instead of the static key, which should eliminate the manual re-entry going forward. I'll do this on our side and let you know once it's reconfigured so you can verify the next scheduled sync completes without intervention.

subject: Webhook payloads failing after API v1 deprecation notice
body:
We received the deprecation notice for API v1 endpoints last month, and since the cutover on the 10th our order-status webhooks have started failing intermittently. Logs show responses like "422 Unprocessable Entity - field 'order_ref' is required" even though our integration hasn't changed. This is affecting order sync for a subset of our locations.

We need to know if this is related to the v2 migration and what field mapping changed.
answer: This is related to the v1 to v2 migration - the field previously named order_id was renamed to order_ref in v2 payloads, and it looks like your webhook handler is still expecting the old field name for some payload types. I'd recommend updating your integration to accept both field names temporarily while you complete the migration; I'm also attaching the updated webhook schema so your team can confirm all field mappings are current.

subject: PDF export completely broken on finance dashboard
body: The export to PDF button on our monthly finance dashboard has stopped working entirely as of this morning - clicking it just spins and then shows "Export failed, please try again." This report goes out to our leadership team every Friday and I need it working before end of day today. I've tried in both Chrome and Edge with the same result.
answer: I understand the time pressure with your Friday report - I'm looking into this right now. We've had a report of PDF export failures tied to dashboards with more than 10 charts hitting a rendering timeout, and I want to confirm if that's what's happening on your end. In the meantime, exporting individual charts as images or using the 'Share as link' option will get your leadership team the data on time while we fix the export issue - I'll update you as soon as I have root cause.

subject: Transform failing repeatedly
body: Booking transform job keeps failing since 2am, error code TX-5031. Losing data.
answer: Thank you for reporting this - TX-5031 typically indicates a schema mismatch in the transform step, and I'm pulling the failure logs for your booking pipeline now to confirm no data has been dropped, only delayed. I'll follow up shortly with root cause and next steps to get the transform running again.

subject: Duplicate alerts going to wrong routing groups
body: Since yesterday our operations team has been getting duplicate copies of every alert - each incident notification arrives twice, once through the correct routing group and once through a group it shouldn't be going to at all. This started right after we added a new routing rule for the fleet-tracking alerts on Tuesday. We're now getting flooded with noise and worried we'll miss a real critical alert in the confusion.
answer: Apologies for the alert flooding - this is high priority given the risk of missing a real incident. It sounds like the new fleet-tracking rule added Tuesday is overlapping with an existing routing rule rather than replacing it, causing the duplicate delivery. I'm reviewing your routing configuration now and will disable the conflicting rule as a quick fix, then confirm with you the correct rule setup before re-enabling so this doesn't recur.

subject: Deactivated user still shows as active in workspace settings
body: I deactivated a former contractor's account on Tuesday from the Admin Console under Workspace Settings > Members, but they still appear as 'Active' in the audit log and in the member list three days later. I need this fixed since we're a small team on the Starter plan and I'm tracking seat usage closely for our travel bookings platform. Can you confirm whether the deactivation actually went through on the backend?
answer: Thanks for flagging this - a deactivation showing as active after 72 hours points to a sync issue between the member list and audit log rather than an incomplete removal. I've pulled up your workspace and confirmed the account access was actually revoked at the time you deactivated it, so there's no security exposure, but I'm escalating the display bug to engineering. I'll update this ticket once we have a fix or workaround for the audit log lag.

subject: Question about API key rotation and deprecated auth header
body: We got a notice that the X-Northwind-Auth header is being deprecated in favor of Bearer tokens for our API keys. Our SDK integration for fintech account verification still uses the old header format. Is there a migration timeline, and will existing keys keep working during the transition? Also curious if there's a webhook we can subscribe to for rate limit warnings before we hit the cap.
answer: Good timing on this question - the X-Northwind-Auth header deprecation is scheduled for removal in a future release, but we haven't set a hard cutoff date yet, so your current keys will keep working for now. I'd recommend updating to Bearer tokens when convenient rather than waiting for a forced migration. On the rate limit webhook, that's not available yet but I'll log it as a feature request since a few other customers have asked for the same thing.

subject: Mobile app crashing on launch for most of our staff
body: Since this morning, the Northwind mobile app crashes immediately after the splash screen for most of our 22 users. It happens right after login, before the dashboard loads. Several people on our finance team can't check billing approvals today, and this is blocking end-of-month reconciliation. Devices are a mix of iOS 17 and Android 13, app version 4.2.1.
answer: This is affecting your team's ability to work, so I'm escalating it to P1 immediately. Our mobile team is aware of a crash-on-launch issue tied to version 4.2.1 on certain device configurations and is investigating a fix now. In the meantime, please have affected users try clearing the app cache or reinstalling the previous version 4.1.9 if available, and I'll follow up within a few hours with a status update.

subject: Offline mode causing app crashes for field technicians
body: We're seeing the mobile app crash consistently when technicians lose connectivity in the field and the app tries to switch to offline mode. This is happening across multiple warehouse locations today, affecting a large portion of our 259 seats. Users get logged out entirely instead of falling back to cached data, and have to force-quit and restart, sometimes losing unsaved inspection data.
answer: I understand this is disrupting field operations across your whole deployment, so we're treating it as a P1 incident. Our engineering team is actively investigating the offline mode crash and login state loss - can you tell us the app version and whether this started after a recent update? We'll keep you updated as we work toward a fix and will prioritize a patch given the scale of impact.

subject: How does offline sync handle push notifications when reconnecting?
body: I'm setting up guidance for our regional admins on how the mobile app behaves in offline mode. Specifically, when a device reconnects after being offline, do queued push notifications get delivered immediately, or are they dropped if too much time has passed? We want to document this properly for our 1558 users before rolling out wider offline usage.
answer: Good question - when a device reconnects after offline mode, queued push notifications are delivered as long as they were sent within the last 24 hours; anything older is dropped to avoid notification overload. I'd recommend mentioning this window in your internal documentation so admins understand why very old alerts might not appear. Let us know if you'd like a link to our offline mode technical overview for more detail.

subject: Dashboards taking 20+ seconds to load for shared reports
body: Our shared dashboards with multiple chart widgets are taking upwards of 20 seconds to render, especially the ones with three or more line charts pulling from our fintech transaction data. This started getting noticeably worse over the past week. We're on the Starter plan with 18 seats and rely on these dashboards daily for team stand-ups, so the slowdown is becoming a real productivity drag.
answer: Thanks for the details - dashboards with multiple chart widgets pulling from larger datasets can hit performance limits, and a jump from acceptable to 20+ seconds over a week suggests something specific changed, possibly data volume or a widget configuration. Could you share the dashboard name or ID so we can check query performance on our end? In the meantime, splitting heavily-charted dashboards into smaller views is a quick way to reduce load times.

subject: URGENT: Shared dashboards timing out for entire retail team
body: Our shared dashboards are completely failing to load right now, returning a timeout error after about 30 seconds instead of rendering any charts. This is affecting all 221 seats on our team and we use these for live inventory tracking across stores. This just started about an hour ago with no changes on our side.

We're seeing elevated load times on our dashboard rendering service and our engineering team is already investigating the root cause. I'll update you as soon as we have a fix or workaround, and please let us know if the timeout behavior changes in the meantime.

subject: DATA PIPELINE CONNECTOR DELAYED BY 6 HOURS - NEED ESCALATION
body: OUR RETAIL SALES CONNECTOR HAS BEEN RUNNING 6 HOURS BEHIND SCHEDULE SINCE YESTERDAY AT 3PM. subject: Biometric login not working after app update
body: After updating the mobile app yesterday, Face ID login stopped working for our team. It shows a spinner for a few seconds then falls back to password entry every time, even though biometric login is still enabled in device settings. This is happening for at least a few of our 16 users on iPhones. It's not a full outage but it's annoying enough that people are asking me about it.

subject: Need to add new IP range to allowlist, seeing odd audit log entries
body: We need to add a new office IP range to our Admin Console allowlist ahead of a location move next month. While reviewing current settings, I noticed a few audit log entries showing blocked login attempts from an IP that isn't in our allowlist history at all, dated last week. subject: Upgrading from Pro to Enterprise billing plan
body:
We're evaluating a move from our current Pro plan to Enterprise for Atlas Retail. Before we commit, I need documentation on how the mid-cycle upgrade is prorated and whether our existing payment method on file will carry over automatically. We're also curious if there's any performance benefit on the API side that comes bundled with the Enterprise tier, since that's a factor in our decision.

Could you also confirm if any partial refund applies to the current billing period once we switch?
answer: Thanks for reaching out ahead of the upgrade. When you switch from Pro to Enterprise mid-cycle, we prorate the difference and charge it to the payment method already on file, no action needed there. I'm attaching our plan comparison doc which covers the performance and rate-limit differences on the API side. For the current period, you'll receive a credit for the unused portion of your Pro subscription, applied automatically to your next invoice rather than as a cash refund.

subject: Deprecated webhook event still firing alongside new one
body:
We noticed that the deprecated payment.updated webhook event is still being delivered to our endpoint even though your changelog says it was replaced by payment.status_changed as of the last API version bump. This is causing duplicate processing on our end and we've had to add extra filtering logic in our SDK integration as a workaround.

Can you confirm the actual sunset date for payment.updated, and whether this dual-firing is expected behavior during the transition period or a bug?
answer: Good catch, and thanks for flagging this. Dual delivery is expected during the transition window so integrations can migrate safely, but the sunset date for payment.updated should have been listed as 60 days after the version bump, not indefinite. I'll confirm the exact date with the API team and follow up, and in the meantime your current filtering workaround is the right approach.

subject: unsubscribe broken
body: cant get users off the weekly digest list, unsubscribe link 404s for everyone since yesterday, need fix asap this is affecting all 175 seats
answer: This is being treated as high priority since it affects your whole organization. We've reproduced the 404 on the unsubscribe link and are pushing a hotfix to the notification service now; I'll update you within the hour with confirmation once it's live. In the meantime, no new digests will be queued to avoid making the issue worse.

subject: Requesting change to upload retry behavior for large backups
body:
Our nightly backup uploads to Storage have been failing intermittently for files over 2GB, roughly 3 out of 10 attempts this past week. Right now the system just marks the job as failed with no automatic retry, which means someone on my team has to manually re-trigger it each morning.

Could you add an automatic retry mechanism, or at least increase the timeout threshold for larger files? We'd also appreciate feedback on whether our current retention settings are contributing to the failures.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. We don't currently have automatic retry for failed uploads, but I've logged this as a feature request with our product team given the impact on your backup reliability. In the short term, increasing the upload timeout from 5 to 15 minutes for files over 1GB should help, and I can apply that change to your account today if you'd like.

subject: Need to upgrade plan but invoice shows wrong seat count
body:
We're trying to move from Starter to Pro for Ember Health, but when I went to confirm the upgrade the generated invoice listed 12 seats instead of our actual 8. This is blocking us from completing the change since the total doesn't match what we agreed on.

Also the checkout page took nearly 30 seconds to load the invoice preview, which seemed unusually slow.
answer: Apologies for the confusion and the delay this is causing. The seat count discrepancy looks like a caching issue on our end pulling stale account data, I've corrected it to reflect your 8 active seats and regenerated the invoice, which you should see reflected immediately. I've also flagged the slow invoice preview load to our engineering team to investigate.

subject: Webhook deliveries failing since this morning, rate limit errors
body:
Since around 8am today all webhook deliveries to our endpoint are failing with HTTP 429 responses, even though our traffic hasn't changed. This is affecting our entire integration for Ember Systems and we have 22 people who rely on real-time updates for coursework grading that are now completely stuck.

We haven't made any changes to our webhook config or deprecated any endpoints recently. Need urgent help escalating this.
answer: We're escalating this immediately as a P1. We've identified a rate-limiting misconfiguration on our side that was applied more aggressively than intended during a recent deprecation cleanup, and our platform team is rolling back the change now. I'll update you as soon as deliveries resume, expected within the next 30 minutes.

subject: Digest emails arriving twice, need dedup fix urgently
body:
Every user on our team has been receiving duplicate copies of the daily email digest since Monday, sometimes three copies of the exact same content within minutes of each other. This is generating a lot of complaints internally and we need this fixed quickly since it's affecting all 8 of our seats.

We'd also like the option to customize digest frequency per user if that's feasible, since some team members would prefer weekly instead of daily.
answer: I'm sorry for the disruption, this has been escalated as high priority. We've traced the duplicates to a retry mechanism that wasn't properly deduplicating sends after a delivery delay, and we're deploying a fix now that should stop new duplicates within the hour. I've also passed along your request for per-user digest frequency settings to our product team as a feature suggestion.

subject: Request: ability to customize digest email frequency
body:
A few people on our team at Harbor Foods have asked whether it's possible to set individual preferences for how often they receive the notification digest, some want daily and others would rather get a weekly summary. Right now everyone on the account gets the same daily cadence regardless of role.

Separately, we've also noticed occasional duplicate digest emails landing in the same inbox, usually a day apart, which we'd like looked into as well.
answer: Thanks for the suggestion, per-user digest frequency isn't currently available but I've submitted it as a feature request and will let you know if it gets prioritized. On the duplicates, could you send me an example message ID or timestamp from one of the repeated emails so we can trace what's triggering the resend on our end?

subject: Production API keys returning invalid_key errors after rotation
body:
We rotated our API keys yesterday following the guide in your documentation, but our production integration is now returning invalid_key errors on every request, even though the new key shows as active in the dashboard. This is blocking checkout flows for Willow Travel and we've had to pause bookings temporarily.

We suspect this might be related to the SDK version we're on, v2.3.1, since the docs mention a deprecated key format for anything below v2.4.0. Can you confirm and help us resolve this quickly?
answer: This is being treated urgently given the impact on your booking flow. You're right that SDK versions below v2.4.0 use a legacy key format that isn't compatible with keys rotated after last week's platform update, this is a known gap in our documentation that we're correcting now. Please upgrade to SDK v2.4.0 or later, and if you need an immediate workaround I can issue a temporary key in the legacy format to get checkout running again while you upgrade.

subject: Connector authentication failing across multiple pipelines, data not syncing
body:
Since roughly 6am UTC today, several of our data pipeline connectors have started failing authentication, returning "401 Unauthorized: token refresh failed" errors. This is affecting connectors pulling from our student records system and financial aid database, impacting data quality for reports used across our institution's 1598 seats.

Logs show the following repeating every few minutes:
```
[ERROR] ConnectorAuthService: token refresh failed for connector_id=cn_88213
[ERROR] ConnectorAuthService: retry attempt 4/5 failed, backing off
[WARN] Pipeline sync skipped, no valid credentials
```
We haven't changed any credentials on our end recently, and this is now delaying critical reporting for multiple departments.
answer: We're escalating this as a P1 given the scale of impact. Initial investigation shows an issue with our OAuth token refresh service affecting a subset of connectors, and our platform team is actively working on a fix. I'll keep you updated every 30 minutes until pipelines resume normal syncing, and we'll follow up with a root cause summary once resolved.

subject: Offline mode sync fails and crashes app on reconnect
body: We're integrating the Mobile App SDK for our field techs at Orion Labs and hit a blocker with offline mode. When a device goes offline, records queue locally as expected, but on reconnect the app crashes with 'SyncQueueOverflowException' if more than 50 items are queued. This is blocking rollout to our 133 seats since our warehouse teams are often offline for hours at a time. We also noticed login tokens expire during offline sessions, forcing a re-login that wipes the queue. Can you confirm if there's a fix or workaround, and whether this needs escalation on your end?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report - this sounds like a real blocker so I'm escalating it to our mobile platform team as P1 given the rollout impact. The queue overflow at 50 items is a known threshold issue we're patching, and we're also looking into extending token validity during offline sessions so the queue isn't cleared on re-auth. I'll follow up within one business day with a workaround (batching syncs at 40 items) and an ETA for the fix.

subject: Dashboards loading very slowly for shared reports
body: Since last week, our shared travel-expense dashboards at Ember Works have been taking 20-30 seconds to load for our 54 users, versus the usual 3-4 seconds. It's especially bad on dashboards with more than 5 charts or any exported PDF snapshots. Several team leads have complained they can't pull reports during morning standups. Is there a known performance issue with dashboard sharing or exports right now?
answer: Thanks for flagging this - we're seeing elevated load times on shared and exported dashboards tied to a backend indexing job that started last week. Our team is actively working on optimizing query performance for multi-chart dashboards. In the meantime, exporting during off-peak hours (before 9am local) should help, and we'll update this ticket as soon as the fix is deployed, likely within 48 hours.

subject: Charts broken after last dashboard update - blank panels
body: After the latest Dashboards update, several of our fintech reporting charts at Harbor Freight are rendering completely blank, particularly bar and stacked-area charts pulling from our billing dataset. Line charts still work fine. This is affecting shared dashboards used by our compliance team for daily reconciliation, so it's a priority fix for us. We'd also like guidance on whether we can revert to the previous chart renderer while this is resolved, since we have 108 seats depending on these reports.
answer: Apologies for the disruption - this matches a rendering regression introduced in the last release affecting bar and stacked-area chart types when pulling from certain dataset schemas. Our engineering team has a fix in testing now; I'll mark this P1 given the compliance impact. There isn't a manual rollback option on your end, but we can push a temporary config change to your account to restore the previous renderer while the permanent fix ships - I'll confirm within a few hours.

subject: Webhooks failing to deliver - 429 errors since this morning
body: Starting around 9am today, our webhook endpoint for case-status updates has been receiving repeated 429 rate-limit errors from Northwind's API, even though our volume hasn't changed. We're on the Starter plan and only send about 200 events per hour. This is affecting our legal case management integration at Orion Analytics - updates aren't reaching our system at all right now. Can you check if something changed on the webhook delivery service or rate limit tiers?
answer: Thanks for the report - we've confirmed a rate limit threshold was misapplied to Starter-tier webhook delivery earlier today, causing legitimate low-volume traffic to be throttled. We're rolling back the change now and it should resolve within the hour. We'll also queue and retry any events that were dropped during this window so you shouldn't lose data.

subject: Booking webhooks not firing after SDK deprecation notice
body: We received a deprecation notice last week about the v1 webhook SDK, and since we updated our integration to the suggested v2 endpoint this morning, none of our booking-confirmation webhooks are firing at all for Harbor Capital. We rely on these to trigger downstream itinerary emails for our travel clients, and right now nothing is coming through. We're a small team on 7 seats so this is completely blocking our operations today.
answer: I'm sorry for the disruption this is causing - I'm marking this P1 and looping in our API team immediately. It looks like the v2 webhook endpoint requires a re-registration step that wasn't clearly called out in the deprecation notice, which would explain the silence. Please send us your current webhook subscription ID and we'll manually re-register it on our end while we fix the documentation gap.

subject: Question about dashboard sharing permission levels
body: I'm trying to understand how sharing permissions work for our Apex Foods dashboards - specifically whether we can give a user 'view and export' access without also granting edit rights. Right now it seems like any shared user with export access can also modify chart filters, which isn't ideal for our compliance reporting dashboards. Is there a more granular permission tier, or is this the expected behavior?
answer: Good question - currently our sharing permissions only distinguish between 'viewer' and 'editor' roles, and export access is bundled with viewer permissions but filter changes are session-only and don't persist for other viewers. There's no dedicated 'view+export without filter changes' tier yet, but I'll pass this along as a feature request since it's a reasonable ask for compliance use cases.

subject: Not getting push notifications on mobile app
body: A few of our team members at Cobalt Works, including myself, stopped receiving push notifications for approval requests on the mobile app about a week ago. We haven't changed any device settings that we know of. It's not urgent since we can still check the app manually, but it would be nice to get this fixed since we use it for expense approval alerts.
answer: Thanks for letting us know, and no worries about the low urgency - we'll get this sorted. Could you confirm the app version and device OS you're using? We've seen a similar issue tied to notification token refresh failing silently after app updates on certain OS versions, and re-authenticating the app (log out and back in) has resolved it for other customers.

subject: Hitting API rate limits earlier than expected
body: Our team at Pioneer Health has started hitting API rate limit errors ('429 Too Many Requests') during peak hours, even though our request volume hasn't grown much month over month. We're on the Pro plan with 294 seats and rely heavily on webhook-triggered API calls for claims processing. Could you clarify our current rate limit tier and whether the deprecation of the older v1 webhook batching endpoint might be causing more individual calls than before?
answer: Thanks for reaching out - you're right that the v1 webhook batching endpoint deprecation likely explains the increase, since v2 sends individual calls per event rather than batched payloads, which can multiply request volume significantly for high-throughput accounts. I'd recommend enabling the batch-mode flag on v2 webhooks, which should bring your call volume back down; I'll also review whether a temporary rate limit increase makes sense for your account while you migrate.

subject: Mobile app crashes immediately on launch for finance team
body: Since yesterday, the Northwind mobile app crashes within a second of opening for several people on our finance team at Granite Health, right after the splash screen. It happens consistently on both iOS and Android devices. We rely on the app for expense approvals and offline receipt uploads, so this is blocking a chunk of our workflow. No error message appears, the app just closes.
answer: Sorry for the trouble this is causing - a launch crash affecting multiple devices points to a possible issue with a recent app update or cached session data. Can you have the affected users try a full uninstall/reinstall and let us know their app version and OS version? In parallel, I'm checking our crash reporting logs for your account to see if we can identify the root cause without needing device-level troubleshooting.

subject: Biometric login not working after latest app update
body: Since updating the mobile app last week, biometric login (Face ID) has stopped working for our team at Harbor Media - it just falls back to password every time, even after re-enrolling Face ID in device settings. This is affecting all 8 of our seats. We'd like to know if this is a known bug with the latest release and whether there's a fix coming, since password-only login is slower for our field staff.
answer: Thanks for reporting this - we've had a couple of similar reports tied to the latest app release where biometric login tokens aren't refreshing correctly after update. Our mobile team is investigating now; in the meantime, fully logging out and back in (not just re-enrolling Face ID) has resolved it for some users. I'll update this ticket as soon as we have a confirmed fix timeline.

subject: IP allowlist change request for legal team
body:
I'm the operations lead at Granite Labs and we need to update our IP allowlist in the Admin Console ahead of a new office opening in Denver. We currently have three ranges configured and need to add a fourth (198.51.100.0/24) for about 40 legal staff starting next Monday.

Can you also confirm whether changes to the allowlist get captured in the audit log automatically, since our compliance team wants a record of when the new range was added and by whom.
answer: Thanks for reaching out. Yes, any change to the IP allowlist in the Admin Console is automatically recorded in the audit log with the admin's user ID, timestamp, and the specific ranges added or removed, so your compliance team will have a full trail. Go ahead and add the new range whenever you're ready, and let us know if you'd like us to review the configuration before it goes live Monday.

subject: Charts not rendering after last dashboard update
body:
Since yesterday's dashboard update, several of our operations charts are showing blank panels instead of the bar graphs we use to track line throughput. This is affecting at least 15 of our 28 users across two dashboards named 'Line Efficiency' and 'Shift Summary'.

We rely on these charts daily for shift handoff meetings, so this is becoming a real problem. Can someone confirm if this is a known issue with the recent release, or if we need to rebuild the widgets?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. We're aware of an issue affecting bar chart widgets on dashboards created before the recent update, and our engineering team is actively working on a fix expected within the next 24 hours. In the meantime, you can restore visibility by duplicating the affected widgets and re-adding the data source, which should render correctly, and we'll follow up as soon as the permanent fix is deployed.

subject: Need alerts routed to a different channel per severity
body:
We're on the Notifications product and currently all our alerts go to one shared email inbox regardless of severity, which makes it hard for our small team to prioritize. I'd like to route critical alerts to a dedicated address and keep lower-priority notifications going to the general inbox.

Is there a way to set up routing rules based on alert severity within Notifications, or is this something we'd need a workaround for? We only have 8 seats so a simple setup would be ideal.
answer: Good question, and this is definitely doable. Under Notifications settings you can create routing rules based on severity tags, so critical alerts can be directed to a separate email address while everything else continues to the general inbox. I'll send over a short guide on setting up the first rule, and happy to hop on a call if you'd like help configuring it for your team.

subject: SSO role mapping not assigning correct permissions
body:
After configuring our SAML role mapping in Identity and SSO yesterday, several users logging in through our IdP are being assigned the default viewer role instead of the admin or editor roles specified in our group attributes. This is affecting at least 6 of our 22 seats and is blocking work for our legal review team this morning.

Our attribute name is 'department' and we mapped 'Legal-Admin' to the admin role, but it doesn't seem to be applying. Can someone check our configuration?
answer: Thanks for flagging this quickly. We can see the mapping is present but the attribute value being sent by your IdP appears to include trailing whitespace ('Legal-Admin '), which is causing the match to fail and defaulting users to viewer. Please check the group attribute export on your IdP side, and once corrected, existing sessions should pick up the right role on next login — let us know if it's still misbehaving after that.

subject: Unable to access workspace settings, seeing repeated timeouts
body:
Starting about 40 minutes ago, none of our admins can open Workspace Settings in the Admin Console. Every attempt results in a spinning loader followed by a timeout error after roughly 30 seconds. We need to deactivate two departed employees today for compliance reasons and can't get into the settings page to do it.

This is urgent since we're a 6-person team and both accounts still have active API keys. Can someone escalate this immediately?
answer: This is being escalated immediately given the compliance impact. We can see elevated latency on workspace settings pages across a subset of accounts and our infrastructure team is actively investigating; in the meantime, we can deactivate the two accounts on your behalf right now if you send us the user IDs or emails to confirm. We'll keep you updated every 15 minutes until settings access is restored.

subject: Questions on upcoming API deprecations
body:
We received a notice about upcoming deprecations to the API Platform and want to understand the timeline better before we plan our migration. Specifically, we're using the v1 webhook endpoints and the legacy rate-limit headers in our integration, and I want to confirm the sunset date for both.

We're a small 12-seat team so we need to plan developer time carefully. Could you point us to migration documentation or an SDK version that already supports the new webhook format?
answer: Thanks for getting ahead of this. The v1 webhook endpoints and legacy rate-limit headers are scheduled to be retired on the date listed in the deprecation notice, and both are already fully supported in SDK version 4.2 and above. I'm attaching our migration guide which walks through updating webhook signature verification and reading the new rate-limit response fields, and we're happy to review your integration once you've made the initial changes.

subject: Deprecation notice - need clarification on webhook changes
body:
We got an email about deprecations coming to the API Platform and I want to make sure our integration doesn't break. We're currently using the older webhook payload format for shipment status updates, and I'm not clear on whether we need to update our endpoint code or just update our SDK version.

We only have a small IT team here (4 seats) so I'd appreciate clear steps on what specifically changes and by when, plus any documentation on the new rate limit behavior.
answer: Happy to clarify. The deprecation affects the webhook payload structure itself, so updating the SDK alone won't be sufficient — you'll need to update your endpoint handler to parse the new payload schema, which includes a renamed 'status_code' field and a new 'event_id' for deduplication. I've linked the updated webhook documentation and rate limit reference below, and our team can review a sample payload from your endpoint if you'd like a sanity check before the cutover.

subject: Bulk deactivation process for departing employees
body:
We're an IT team managing 23 seats and need a reliable process for deactivating users in bulk when staff leave, since right now we're doing it one at a time in the Admin Console. Yesterday we had to deactivate 4 accounts after a round of departures and it took longer than expected, plus we want to make sure deactivated accounts are also removed from any IP allowlist exceptions.

Is there a bulk deactivation option, and does deactivation automatically log to the audit trail with a reason code?
answer: There is a bulk deactivation option under Admin Console > Users, where you can select multiple accounts via checkbox or upload a CSV of user IDs to deactivate in one action. Each deactivation is automatically logged in the audit trail with a timestamp and the admin who performed it, though reason codes aren't captured by default — we do have a documentation guide on setting up custom fields for that if it's useful for your offboarding process.

subject: offline
body: Offline mode not syncing after reconnect, app just crashes.
answer: Thanks for the report — could you let us know the app version and device OS you're running so we can dig into the crash logs? In the meantime, if you have a crash report or console output from the moment it happens after reconnect, that would help us pinpoint the sync issue quickly.

subject: Storage retention policy question and quota concern
body:
As the finance manager here I'm reviewing our Storage costs and noticed we're close to our quota with backups from over a year ago still sitting in the system. I thought retention was supposed to auto-purge backups after 12 months, but I'm seeing files dated back to 2022 still counting against our quota.

Can someone confirm the actual retention policy for our plan and whether this is a bug, since we're a 20-seat team on Starter and don't want to get hit with overage charges for data that should have been purged already.
answer: Thanks for flagging this — on the Starter plan, backups should indeed auto-purge after 12 months, so files from 2022 still counting against your quota isn't expected behavior. This looks like a retention job that may have stalled for your account; we're going to manually trigger a cleanup and investigate why the automated purge didn't run, and we'll confirm your updated quota usage once it completes.

subject: Webhook signature failures after API key rotation
body: We rotated our production API key on Oct 14 as part of our quarterly security review, and since then every webhook delivery to our order-status endpoint is failing signature verification with a 401. The SDK (v3.2.1) still shows the old key cached in some workers. We also noticed the rate limit headers on those failed calls show X-RateLimit-Remaining at 0, which seems unrelated but started at the same time. Can you confirm whether key rotation should force webhook re-signing on your end?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. Rotating an API key does invalidate the signing secret used for webhook payloads, so any worker still holding a cached key will fail verification until it picks up the new secret - we're checking why the SDK isn't refreshing that automatically. In the meantime, please redeploy the affected workers to force a fresh token fetch, and I'll follow up with root cause on the rate-limit anomaly you spotted, since that shouldn't be linked to rotation.

subject: URGENT: SCIM sync deactivated 40+ users, locked out of Northwind login
body: Our SCIM provisioning job ran at 03:00 UTC today and deactivated 47 user accounts that should have stayed active - it looks like our identity provider sent a stale group membership diff and Northwind processed it as a mass deprovision. Those users are now locked out of SSO login entirely and some of their profile settings (custom roles, saved dashboards) appear gone from the admin console. This is affecting our whole manufacturing floor shift that starts in two hours and we need accounts restored immediately.
answer: I've escalated this to our identity engineering team as a P0 - restoring the 47 deactivated accounts and their associated profile data is our immediate priority. We're pulling the SCIM sync logs from 03:00 UTC now to confirm what triggered the mass deprovision event and to check whether the profile settings can be recovered from our backup snapshot taken at 02:00 UTC. I'll update you within the hour with restoration status and a root-cause summary.

subject: Auswirkungen der API-Deprecation auf unsere Webhook-Integration
body: Wir haben die Ankündigung erhalten, dass die API-Version v1 der Webhook-Endpunkte zum 30. November abgeschaltet wird. Unser aktuelles SDK (Version 2.4) nutzt aber noch v1-Signaturen für die Event-Verarbeitung in unserer Energiedaten-Pipeline. Zusätzlich ist uns aufgefallen, dass sich das Rate-Limit für die neuen v2-Endpunkte von 600 auf 300 Anfragen pro Minute reduziert hat, was unsere stündlichen Batch-Jobs ausbremst. Können Sie uns eine Migrationsanleitung und die genauen neuen Limits nennen?
answer: Vielen Dank für die Nachfrage. Die Abschaltung von v1 betrifft tatsächlich alle Webhook-Signaturen, daher empfehlen wir ein Upgrade auf SDK 3.x vor dem 30. November, wir schicken Ihnen die Migrationsdokumentation mit Codebeispielen für die Signaturprüfung zu. Zum Rate-Limit: die 300 Anfragen/Minute sind der Standardwert für Pro-Konten bei v2, für Batch-Workloads Ihrer Größenordnung können wir aber ein höheres Limit freischalten, bitte teilen Sie uns Ihr Spitzenvolumen mit.

subject: Slack alerts stopped firing after Okta SSO enforcement
body: Since we enforced Okta as the sole SSO provider on our workspace last Tuesday, our Slack alert integration for case escalations has gone completely quiet - no alerts have posted to the #legal-escalations channel in five days. I checked the integration settings and the Slack connection still shows as 'active', but the delivery log is empty. This is used by our support engineers to track urgent client matters, so we'd like this looked at soon even though it's not affecting all users.
answer: Thanks for flagging this - enforcing a new SSO provider can sometimes invalidate the token our Slack integration uses to post messages, which would explain the silent failure with no error logged. Could you re-authorize the Slack connection from the Integrations page so we can confirm whether a fresh token resolves it? If it doesn't post within a few minutes of reauthorizing, send us the workspace ID and we'll check the delivery pipeline directly.

subject: Okta app broken - SSO login failing for most of our legal team
body: Our Okta app integration with Northwind appears to be misconfigured after this week's update - roughly 90 out of our 122 users are getting 'application not assigned' errors when trying to SSO into Northwind Dashboard and Storage. We didn't change any assignments on our end. This is also blocking the Slack and Salesforce connectors that rely on the same Okta app for token exchange, so multiple teams are affected. We need this escalated urgently as it's blocking active client casework.
answer: I understand the urgency and have escalated this to our integrations team as P1. We're reviewing the recent Okta app configuration update to check whether an attribute mapping or assignment rule change caused the 'application not assigned' errors, and we'll verify the downstream impact on the Slack and Salesforce connectors as part of the same fix. I'll update you as soon as we have a resolution or a workaround for restoring access to the affected users.

subject: Webhook deliveries duplicating and some failing silently
body: Over the past three days we've noticed our booking-confirmation webhooks are being delivered twice for roughly 15% of events, and a smaller subset (around 40 events yesterday) never arrive at all with no entry in the delivery log. We're on the v2 webhook endpoint. I also saw the notice that the legacy retry policy is being deprecated next month - is that related to the duplicates we're seeing now, or is this a separate bug?
answer: This sounds like a bug rather than something tied to the upcoming retry policy deprecation, since duplicates and silent drops together point to an issue in the delivery queue itself. We're pulling the delivery logs for your webhook endpoint for the last 72 hours to identify the pattern behind both the duplicate sends and the missing 40 events. In the meantime, please make sure your endpoint is idempotent using the event ID header, and we'll follow up with findings within one business day given the volume affected.

subject: Need retention extension for backup data before compliance deadline
body: We're integrating Northwind Storage for our patient-record backup pipeline and currently our retention policy is set to 90 days, but our compliance team requires 7-year retention for these specific backup buckets. We have an audit scheduled for December 5th and need the extended retention policy applied to bucket 'lumen-phi-backups' before then. Can you confirm whether this can be set per-bucket or if it requires a plan-level change, and how long the migration of existing objects would take?
answer: Extended retention can be configured per-bucket, so we can apply a 7-year policy specifically to 'lumen-phi-backups' without affecting your other buckets. Existing objects in that bucket will need to be re-tagged with the new retention metadata, which typically takes a few hours depending on object count - given your audit date, I'm escalating this to get it scheduled and completed well ahead of December 5th. I'll confirm once the policy is applied and provide a completion timestamp for your compliance records.

subject: Zapier app - request for new trigger on shipment status changes
body: We're building an automation using the Northwind Zapier integration to sync shipment status updates into our logistics dashboard, but the current app only exposes 'order created' and 'order updated' triggers. We need a dedicated 'shipment status changed' trigger so we can react to in-transit, delayed, and delivered events without polling. Is this something on the Zapier app roadmap, or is there a workaround using webhooks combined with Zapier's webhook trigger in the meantime?
answer: A dedicated shipment status trigger isn't currently in the Zapier app, but I've logged this as a feature request with our integrations team since it's a reasonable gap for logistics use cases. As a workaround in the meantime, you can point one of our outbound webhooks for shipment events at Zapier's 'Catch Hook' trigger, which will let you react to in-transit, delayed, and delivered events without polling. I'm happy to help set up the webhook filter if useful.

subject: Slack billing alerts not posting to our channel
body: I set up the Slack integration last month to send billing alerts (invoice generated, payment failed) to our #finance channel, and it worked fine until this week. Since Monday, no alerts have come through even though I can see in the billing history that an invoice was generated on the 3rd. The Slack connection still shows as connected in the integration settings. Could you check why alerts have stopped for our workspace?
answer: Thanks for letting us know. We're checking the alert delivery logs for your Slack integration around the 3rd to see whether the message failed to send or if the trigger itself didn't fire for that invoice event. In the meantime, could you confirm whether any Slack app permissions or channel settings changed on your end this week? subject: quick q about upcomming api deprecations and rate limits
body: hey, we got the notice that some endpoints in the API platfrom are being deprecated next quarter but i cant find a clear list of wich ones exactly. we rely on the /v1/reports endpoint pretty heavily and also want to know if the rate limit changes announced for v2 apply to us on Starter plan too. can someone send the full deprecation timeline so we can plan the migration, this is kinda urgent for our small team.

On rate limits, the new v2 limits do apply to Starter plan accounts as well, though they're generally more generous than the current v1 limits. I'll follow up shortly with the migration guide and specific dates so your team has time to plan the switch.

subject: PDF export cuts off chart legends
body: When I export our Monthly Ops dashboard to PDF, the legend for the stacked bar chart gets cut off on the right side every time, regardless of page orientation. This happens on the 'Regional Volume' and 'Shift Output' widgets specifically, both landscape and portrait exports. We rely on these PDFs for our weekly plant review, so it's becoming a real problem for the last three exports (Oct 2, Oct 9, Oct 16). Is there a way to force the export to scale the legend or should I resize the chart itself first?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report - this looks like a known rendering issue where wide legends aren't being scaled down for the PDF export renderer on certain chart widths. As a workaround, try narrowing the chart widget by about 15% before exporting, which should let the legend render fully. I'm also flagging this to our dashboards team so we can fix the scaling logic directly rather than requiring manual resizing.

subject: Question about upcoming API deprecations
body: We're planning our Q1 roadmap and I want to confirm which API Platform endpoints are scheduled for deprecation in the next two quarters. I saw a note in the changelog about the v2 rate-limit headers changing format, but I couldn't find a firm date. We have several internal SDK integrations that read the X-RateLimit-Remaining header directly, so we need lead time to update our client code if the format changes.
answer: Good question - the v2 rate-limit header format change is currently targeted for the end of Q2, and we'll publish the exact cutover date in the changelog at least 60 days ahead. Nothing is deprecated yet, so your current integration will keep working unchanged for now, but I'd recommend subscribing to the API changelog RSS feed so your team gets an automatic alert when the date is confirmed.

subject: Can't share dashboard with view-only external partner
body: I'm trying to share our 'Warehouse Throughput' dashboard with a partner logistics company so they can view it read-only, but every time I add their email under sharing settings I get 'User is not part of this organization' even though the share dialog says external sharing is enabled. answer: Sorry for the trouble ahead of your Thursday review. External read-only sharing does require generating a public or restricted share link rather than adding an external email directly to the dashboard's user list - the email-based sharing only works for accounts already provisioned inside your organization. I'll send you steps for creating a restricted share link with an expiry date so your partner can view without needing a full account.

subject: Duplicate daily digest emails to finance team
body: Since Monday our finance team has been getting two copies of the daily billing digest email, both timestamped within a minute of each other. We only have one notification rule configured for 'Daily Financial Summary' under Notifications, so I'm not sure where the duplicate is coming from. I'm checking your account's digest configuration now and will let you know within a few hours which rule is duplicating so we can disable the extra one without losing the original schedule.

subject: mfa enroll fails
answer: Thanks for the log snippet - that 409 usually means a stale MFA factor is still attached to the test user from a previous enrollment attempt that wasn't cleaned up. Could you send over the affected user IDs so we can clear the orphaned factors on our end and let you retry enrollment?

subject: Invoice line items don't match plan usage
body: I'm reviewing our last invoice for Summit Media and the line item shows charges for 9 seats, but we only ever provisioned 7 under our Starter plan. I checked our admin panel and it still lists 7 active users. Could someone confirm whether this is a billing calculation issue or if two seats were added and removed mid-cycle without us noticing? I'm pulling the seat activity log for your account now and will confirm the exact dates and adjust the invoice if the charge doesn't match actual usage.

subject: Users report they can't unsubscribe from marketing notifications

subject: URGENT: Dashboard sharing broken company-wide, execs locked out

subject: Pagination behavior change breaking our sync jobs

This is affecting our nightly data pulls for Cobalt Capital and we've already lost a day of complete sync coverage. We're treating this as a P1 and rolling back the change while we validate a proper fix; I'll confirm here once the rollback is live and provide guidance on re-running your missed sync window.

subject: Feature request: customizable email digest schedule
body: We're using Notifications to send daily email digests to our training coordinators at Granite Academy, and a few of them have asked if they can choose weekly instead of daily. Right now it looks like the digest frequency is fixed at the workspace level. Is there a way to let individual users pick their own cadence, or is this on a roadmap? Also, do you have documentation on how digest content is aggregated (e.g. is it per-channel or per-workspace)?
answer: Thanks for the detailed request. In the meantime, I'll send over our documentation page that explains how digest content is aggregated across channels so your team has a clearer picture of current behavior.

subject: Pagination cursor returning duplicate records on /orders endpoint
body: We're integrating with the API Platform's /v1/orders endpoint and paginating with the cursor returned in the 'next' field. Since October 3rd we've noticed that requesting page 2 with the cursor from page 1 sometimes returns records we already saw on page 1, specifically order IDs in the 44000-44050 range. We're on Starter plan limits so we're careful about rate limits, but this duplication is causing our sync job to process the same orders twice. Can you confirm if there's a known issue with cursor stability when records are updated between page fetches?
answer: Thanks for flagging this with specific order IDs, that's very helpful. This looks consistent with a known edge case where cursor-based pagination can return overlapping records if the underlying dataset is updated between page fetches, since the cursor is based on insertion order rather than a stable snapshot. We're looking into adding a snapshot parameter to prevent this; in the meantime, I'd recommend deduplicating on order ID client-side as a workaround, and I'll update this ticket once we have a permanent fix.

subject: Seat count mismatch causing billing discrepancy

I'll follow up within one business day with the resolution.

We'll confirm within a day and issue a refund immediately if any overcharge did occur.

subject: Charts rendering blank on shared dashboards
