subject: Push notifications not received after app crash + offline period
body:
We're seeing an issue across our Vertex Partners field devices where push notifications stop arriving after the mobile app crashes while offline. Users go into a warehouse with no signal, app crashes on reconnect, and then no pushes come through until they force-close and reopen the app manually. This started around March 4th and we've had about 15 reports so far from the manufacturing floor team.

We're on iOS 17 and Android 13 devices, app version 4.2.1. Login still works fine after the crash, but the notification token seems to not re-register. Can you confirm if there's a known issue with token refresh after offline recovery?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. This matches a known issue where the push token isn't re-registered after the app resumes from a crash following an offline session — the token refresh call is silently failing in that path. We're tracking a fix for app version 4.2.1 and will prioritize it given the scale of impact on your field teams. In the meantime, having affected users log out and back in manually forces a fresh token registration and should restore push delivery immediately.

subject: Unsubscribe endpoint returning duplicate confirmation events
body:
I'm integrating the Notifications API for Quill Health and noticed that when a user hits our unsubscribe link, we get two separate webhook events fired for the same unsubscribe action, both with identical event IDs. This is causing our internal alerting to log duplicate entries and skew our unsubscribe rate reporting.

We're calling POST /v1/notifications/unsubscribe with the recipient email and a list_id. Is this expected behavior, or is there a dedupe mechanism we should be handling on our end? Documentation doesn't mention idempotency keys for this endpoint specifically.
answer: Good catch, and thanks for flagging this with the specifics. The unsubscribe endpoint currently fires a webhook both on the initial request and on the confirmation step, which can look like a duplicate even though the event ID is reused rather than newly generated. We'll get the docs updated to clarify this behavior, and in the meantime recommend deduplicating on event ID plus timestamp on your side until we ship idempotency key support, which is on our roadmap.

subject: Seat count mismatch causing billing overcharge
body:
Our Blue Academy account shows 10 active seats on the Starter plan, but we were just charged for 14 seats on our latest invoice dated this week. We removed 4 users back on the 2nd of this month and they no longer appear in our admin panel, so I'm not sure why billing hasn't reflected that change.

Could someone check our account and issue a refund or credit for the difference? This is affecting our budget approval for next month and we need it resolved quickly since we're a small team relying on accurate invoicing.

I'm escalating this to billing now to review the seat sync between your admin panel and the invoicing system; it looks like the removed users may not have triggered a seat recalculation before the billing cycle closed. We'll issue a credit for the overcharged seats once confirmed and will follow up within one business day with the adjusted invoice.

subject: Offline mode causing repeated crashes on sync resume
body:
Several of our clinical staff at Pioneer Robotics are reporting that the mobile app crashes consistently when switching from offline mode back to online, specifically during the data sync that happens on reconnect. This has happened on at least 20 devices since Tuesday, mostly iPads running app version 3.9.0.

The crash seems tied to large offline queues — staff who spend more than 2 hours offline hit it almost every time, while shorter offline sessions sync fine. Login is unaffected, but the crash forces a full app restart and sometimes loses unsynced form entries, which is a real concern for our clinical workflows.
answer: Thank you for the clear breakdown, especially the detail about queue size and duration correlating with the crash — that's very helpful for our team. This looks like it could be a memory issue when processing large offline sync queues on resume, and given the risk of losing unsynced clinical data we're treating this as a priority fix. As a short-term mitigation, we'd suggest having staff sync more frequently rather than waiting for long offline stretches, and we'll update this ticket as soon as we have a patch timeline.

subject: SAML login failing with signature validation error
body:
We configured SAML SSO for Summit Works last week and users are now getting bounced back to the login page with an error saying 'SAML response signature validation failed' when trying to sign in through our IdP. This is blocking all 6 of our team members from accessing Northwind Cloud this morning.

We double-checked the certificate uploaded in the admin console matches what our IdP is signing with, and the metadata was pulled directly from the IdP's metadata URL. Could someone check if there's a mismatch on Northwind's side, possibly related to certificate rotation or clock skew?
answer: Thanks for the detailed troubleshooting steps you've already taken — that narrows things down quickly. Signature validation failures like this are most often caused by a stale certificate cached on our side after an IdP rotation, or occasionally clock skew beyond our 5-minute tolerance window. I'm pulling your SSO configuration now to check the certificate fingerprint against your current IdP metadata, and will follow up shortly with either a fix or next steps if it turns out to be a clock sync issue on the IdP side.

subject: transfrom job failing intermitently on connector sync
body:
we noticed our nightly transfrom jobs for the manufaturing data pipeline have been failing on and off since last week, aprox 3 out of 7 runs failed between the 10th and 17th. the error just says 'transform stage exited with code 1' and theres no more detail in the logs we can see.

this is impacting our finance reporting since the connector pulls vendor invoice data and when it fails we dont get updated numbers til the next successful run. can someone check the connector logs on your end, our pipeline id is pl-8823-orion, we need this stabalized before month end close.

Exit code 1 with no detail usually points to a transient resource limit or an upstream schema change breaking the transform mid-run, and given this is affecting your month-end close numbers we're prioritizing a full log review on our side for pl-8823-orion right away. We'll report back with the root cause and a stabilization plan before your close date.

subject: Need to add new office IP range to allowlist
body:
We opened a new office location for Delta Energy last month and need to add its outbound IP range to our admin console's allowlist so staff there can access Northwind Cloud without hitting the access restriction we have configured for security. The new range is 203.0.113.0/24.

answer: Happy to help get the new office online. Let us know once it's added if staff at the new location still have trouble connecting and we'll dig further.

subject: How to adjust timing of scheduled data pipeline syncs
body:
For Harbor Retail, our scheduled syncs on the logistics data pipeline currently run every 6 hours starting at midnight UTC, but we're finding the data isn't fresh enough for our morning reporting since the last sync before our reports run finishes at 6am UTC and our team starts reviewing data at 7am UTC when volumes have already grown.

Could you walk us through how to change the sync schedule to run more frequently, say every 2 hours, without breaking any existing connector mappings? We have three connectors feeding into this pipeline and want to make sure adjusting frequency doesn't cause overlapping runs.
answer: Good question, and this is a straightforward change. You can adjust the sync frequency under Pipeline Settings > Schedule for each connector independently, and switching to a 2-hour interval won't affect existing mappings since those are tied to the connector configuration rather than the schedule. To avoid overlapping runs across your three connectors, we'd recommend staggering their start times by 15-20 minutes each, and I'm happy to help you set that up if you'd like a second pair of eyes before you deploy the change.

subject: Zapier Integration wird nicht mit Slack synchronisiert
body:
Wir nutzen die Zapier-Integration bei Orion Media, um Ereignisse aus Salesforce und Jira an Slack weiterzuleiten. Seit letzter Woche kommen die Slack-Benachrichtigungen für neue Salesforce-Leads nicht mehr an, obwohl der Zap in Zapier als 'erfolgreich ausgeführt' angezeigt wird.

Wir haben bereits geprüft, ob der Slack-Kanal korrekt verknüpft ist, das scheint in Ordnung zu sein. Können Sie uns sagen, ob es aktuell bekannte Probleme mit der Zapier-Slack-Verbindung gibt, oder ob wir etwas in unserer Konfiguration prüfen sollten?
answer: Vielen Dank für die genaue Beschreibung. Uns sind aktuell keine generellen Störungen der Zapier-Slack-Verbindung bekannt, daher vermuten wir zunächst ein Problem auf Zapier-Seite mit der Authentifizierung des Slack-Webhooks, auch wenn der Zap als erfolgreich markiert wird. Bitte prüfen Sie in Zapier unter der Task-History, ob der Slack-Schritt tatsächlich eine Antwort von Slack erhält, und teilen Sie uns die Task-ID eines fehlgeschlagenen Laufs mit, damit wir gezielt weiter analysieren können.

subject: Upgrading plan tiers for subset of business units
body:
We're planning to upgrade a portion of our Delta Robotics business units from their current tier to a higher plan tier to unlock advanced reporting features, but we want to keep the rest of the organization on the existing plan since not every unit needs the new capabilities. Is it possible to run mixed plan tiers under one parent account, or would this require separate billing entities?

We'd also like to understand how partial upgrades affect our existing invoice cycle, since we're mid-cycle right now and want to avoid unexpected proration charges landing on the wrong cost center.
answer: Thanks for thinking this through carefully before making changes. Mixed plan tiers under a single parent account are supported through sub-organizations, so you can upgrade specific business units while leaving others on the current tier, and billing can be split across cost centers if you set up separate sub-org billing profiles. For the mid-cycle timing, any upgrade will generate a prorated charge for the remainder of the current cycle on the upgraded units only, and I'd be glad to schedule a call to map this to your specific cost centers before you proceed.

subject: Storage quota hit mid-upload, backups failing

body:
Our main financial reporting dashboard, shared across our manufacturing division, has been taking upwards of 30 seconds to load for the past week, sometimes timing out entirely. This dashboard has about 12 widgets pulling from our production data and is shared with 174 seats company-wide, so the slowdown is affecting a lot of people during month-end close.

Can someone look into whether this is a widget count issue or something on the backend? We'd like guidance on how to restructure it if that helps, or if there's a caching option we're missing.
answer:
Thanks for the detailed report — dashboards with 10+ widgets pulling live production data can definitely hit performance limits, especially when shared broadly. I'll have our performance team pull the load metrics for this specific dashboard to confirm whether it's widget volume or a query bottleneck, and in the meantime I'd recommend enabling scheduled refresh caching instead of live queries, which usually cuts load times significantly for shared dashboards like this.

I'll follow up with specific recommendations on restructuring within the next day or two.

subject: Webhook rate limits and deprecation timeline question
body:
We're integrating with the API Platform to receive webhook events for order status changes, currently processing around 8,000 events/day across our retail catalog. I noticed in the docs that the /v1/webhooks/subscribe endpoint is marked deprecated but there's no migration guide linked. Also, what's the current rate limit for webhook deliveries per endpoint — we're occasionally seeing 429 responses during peak hours.

Could you point us to updated SDK documentation for the v2 webhook setup, and let us know the deprecation sunset date for v1?
answer:
Good questions — the v1 webhook subscribe endpoint is scheduled for sunset in 90 days, and I'll send you the v2 migration guide along with the updated SDK docs, which include the new batch subscription method that should help with your event volume. For rate limits, webhook deliveries are currently capped at 100/minute per endpoint, so those 429s during peak hours suggest you'd benefit from the v2 batching approach to reduce individual call volume.

I'll also flag the missing migration guide link in our docs to the content team.

subject: IP allowlist not blocking access as configured
body:
We configured an IP allowlist in the Admin Console last week to restrict access to our office and VPN ranges only, affecting all 175 seats. Today we discovered via the audit log that several logins occurred from IP addresses outside the allowlist, meaning the restriction isn't actually being enforced. This is a security concern given we're in legal services handling sensitive client data.

Can you confirm whether this is a known bug and how quickly it can be fixed? We may need to temporarily deactivate affected accounts until this is resolved.
answer:
Thank you for catching this and reviewing your audit logs — I've reproduced the issue on our end and confirmed the allowlist enforcement isn't applying correctly to a subset of session types, which is a bug on our side, not a misconfiguration on yours. I'm escalating this to P1 and our engineering team is working on a fix now; I'll update you within a few hours with a timeline.

In the meantime, temporarily deactivating the accounts that show suspicious login locations is a reasonable precaution, and I'm happy to help identify which accounts those are from the audit log.

subject: Push notifications not arriving on Android after offline mode
body:
I'm integrating our mobile app with the Northwind API for a rollout to 248 users across our education platform. We've noticed that when a device goes offline and then reconnects, push notifications queued during that offline period never arrive, even though the API returns a 200 success for each notification sent during the outage window. This is specifically on Android; iOS seems fine so far.

Is there a known issue with notification queuing for offline Android devices, or a login/session refresh step we're missing after reconnect?
answer: Thanks for the clear breakdown, especially isolating this to Android — that helps narrow it down. This does match a known issue where queued notifications can get dropped if the device's push token session isn't refreshed immediately on reconnect, since Android handles token revalidation differently than iOS in our current SDK version. Can you confirm which SDK version you're on so I can check if the fix from our recent patch applies, or if you need a workaround in the meantime?

subject: SAML login redirect loop for new hires
body: We onboarded two new hires this week at Vertex Legal and both are stuck in a redirect loop after entering their MFA code during SAML login. The IdP shows a successful assertion, but Northwind bounces them back to the login page with no error text. The other 4 seats on our team can log in without issue. Can you check if this is a provisioning delay on our tenant?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. This looks like it could be a stale SAML assertion cache on the two new accounts rather than a broader IdP issue, since the rest of your team is unaffected. Could you send us the timestamps of the failed login attempts and the NameID used in your IdP configuration so we can trace the assertions on our end? In the meantime, try clearing browser cookies for those two accounts and re-attempting login.

subject: Weekly digest emails sending 3x to everyone
body: Since Monday our whole team at North Freight has been getting the weekly notification digest three times in a row, all with identical content and timestamps. This is generating a lot of complaints since we have 39 people on the account. Separately, we'd like the option to switch digest frequency to daily instead of weekly if that's possible.
answer: We're sorry for the noise this is causing your team and are treating this as high priority given it's affecting everyone on your account. We've identified a dedupe issue in the digest scheduler that's causing repeat sends and are pushing a fix now; we'll confirm once it's resolved. We've also logged your request for daily digest frequency as a feature request and will follow up on timeline separately.

subject: MFA enrolment stuck on qr code screen
body: we are rolling out MFA to our whole org this week and alot of users are gettin stuck on the qr code enrolment screen, it just spins and never loads the code. Ive confirmed its happning on chrome and edge for multiple users, not just one departmant. This is slowing down our rollout alot since we have thousands of employes waiting to enrol.
answer: Thank you for flagging this, we understand the urgency given the scale of your rollout. We're seeing reports of the QR code generation endpoint intermittently timing out under load and are investigating on our side now. As a temporary workaround, users can select the 'enter setup key manually' option on the enrolment screen instead of scanning the QR code, which should let them complete enrolment while we fix the underlying issue.

subject: Connector auth token expiring too fast
body: Our QuickBooks connector in Data Pipelines keeps failing with an auth error every few days and we have to manually reauthenticate each time. This has happened three times in the past two weeks, most recently on the 14th, and each time our nightly sync is skipped until we notice. Is there a way to get a longer-lived token or automatic refresh for this connector?
answer: Thanks for the details. Some connector integrations use short-lived OAuth tokens by default and don't yet auto-refresh, which matches what you're seeing. We're looking into adding automatic token refresh for the QuickBooks connector and will let you know once that's available. In the meantime, we can set up a proactive alert so you're notified before the token expires rather than after the sync fails.

subject: SAML role mapping assigning wrong permissions
body: We just configured SSO role mapping for Atlas Partners so that users in our 'Admins' IdP group get admin access in Northwind, but every user is landing with the default viewer role instead. This is blocking three staff members from accessing billing and user management today. Our attribute mapping sends the group name as 'memberOf' - can you confirm this is the expected attribute name?
answer: Thanks for the clear description, we know this is blocking access for your admins today. 'memberOf' is a valid attribute name, but we suspect the mapping rule on our side may be expecting an exact group value match that isn't lining up with your IdP's format. Could you send us a sample SAML assertion or the exact group value your IdP sends so we can correct the mapping rule and get your admins unblocked as quickly as possible?

subject: Pipeline data arriving hours late, breaking reports
body: Our Stripe connector in Data Pipelines has been delivering transaction records 4-6 hours late for the past two days instead of the usual near-real-time sync. This is breaking our downstream finance reports since they run on a schedule expecting same-day data. We checked the connector status page and it shows healthy, but the timestamps on incoming records clearly lag.
answer: Thank you for reporting this, we understand the impact on your finance reporting and are treating it as urgent. We've confirmed a backlog on the Stripe connector's ingestion queue that's causing the delay you're seeing, and our team is actively draining it now. We'll update you as soon as sync latency returns to normal and will follow up with root cause once resolved.

subject: All dashboard charts showing blank since this morning
body: As of this morning every chart on our client-facing dashboards at Lumen Legal is rendering blank, just showing a loading spinner that never resolves. This started around 8am and affects all 137 seats on our account, including dashboards we share externally with clients. Export to PDF is also failing with a generic 'export failed' message.
answer: Thank you for the report, we're treating this as a high priority incident given it's affecting all of your dashboards including client-facing ones. Our team is actively investigating the chart rendering service and will share an update shortly. In the meantime, could you confirm whether this affects all dashboard types or a specific subset, and send us one affected dashboard URL so we can reproduce it directly?

subject: Pagination cursor skipping and duplicating records
body: We're using the API Platform's cursor-based pagination to pull order data nightly, and since last week we're seeing both duplicate records and gaps between pages. Specifically, calls using the 'next_cursor' from page 12 onward sometimes return records we already saw and skip others entirely. This is causing real data loss in our nightly sync for Willow Retail and we need a fix or workaround urgently.
answer: Thanks for the clear writeup, we understand this is causing data loss in your nightly sync and are prioritizing it. We're aware of an edge case where the cursor can become inconsistent when records are updated between page fetches, and we're working on a fix. As a workaround in the meantime, we'd recommend switching to timestamp-based pagination for this endpoint, which isn't affected by the same issue - happy to share sample code if useful.

subject: Zapier integration feature requests
body: We've been using the Zapier integration at Blue Foods to connect Northwind events into our workflows, and it's working well overall. We'd like to request a couple of additional triggers - specifically one for new API key creation and one for storage quota warnings - since right now we have to poll manually for those. Would also be great to see a native Jira action alongside the existing Slack one.
answer: Thanks for the thoughtful suggestions. We've logged requests for the new API key creation trigger and storage quota warning trigger, and we'll pass along the Jira action request to our integrations team as well. We don't have a firm timeline yet, but we'll update this ticket if any of these land in an upcoming release.

subject: session timeout question
body: Quick one following up from earlier - can session timeout be set per role instead of account-wide?
answer: Good question - currently session timeout is set at the account level and applies to all roles, so per-role timeouts aren't supported yet. I've logged this as a feature request on your behalf and will update this ticket if that changes. In the meantime, let us know if you'd like help adjusting the account-wide timeout value.

subject: Verzögerung bei geplanten Synchronisierungen
body: Als Operations Lead bei Willow Works ist mir aufgefallen, dass unsere geplante Synchronisierung "Media-Assets-Sync" seit dem 03.03. regelmäßig 45–90 Minuten später als geplant startet. Zusätzlich zeigt der Connector zu unserem S3-Bucket in der letzten Ausführung rund 120 doppelte Datensätze. Können Sie uns sagen, ob das an der Warteschlange liegt oder ob wir die Sync-Zeit anpassen sollten?
answer: Vielen Dank für die genaue Beschreibung. Wir prüfen aktuell die Warteschlangenlast für Ihren Workspace und schauen uns die Connector-Logs zum S3-Bucket an, um die Ursache der doppelten Zeilen zu finden. Als kurzfristigen Workaround können Sie die Sync-Zeit um eine Stunde vorziehen, bis wir die Rückmeldung zur Warteschlange haben – wir melden uns innerhalb der nächsten zwei Werktage mit einem Update.

subject: Scheduled sync to Google Classroom failing since Monday
body: We're an IT administrator at Atlas Media and our nightly sync connector "Classroom-Roster-Sync" (ID sync-8842) has failed on the last three runs, May 6, 7, and 8. The job log shows "ConnectorTimeoutError: upstream took over 300s" and roster data for our 25 school accounts hasn't updated since Friday. This is blocking teachers from seeing current class lists, please escalate.
answer: This has been escalated to our pipeline engineering team as a P1 issue since it's affecting all 25 accounts. We're pulling the connector logs for sync-8842 now to identify why the upstream call is timing out, and will push a manual retry on our side shortly. We'll update you within the next few hours with either a fix or a workaround to restore roster data.

subject: Duplicate weekly digest emails sent twice
body: I'm integrating the Notifications API for our factory dashboards and noticed subscribers received the weekly digest email twice on Monday, once at 06:00 UTC and again at 06:14 UTC, both with identical content and digest_id "wd-20613". It's only affecting about 40 users so not urgent, but I wanted to flag it and ask if there's a dedupe key we should be passing in our API call.
answer: Thanks for reporting this with the digest_id, that helps us trace it quickly. Yes, you can pass an idempotency_key parameter on the digest send request to prevent duplicate deliveries if a retry occurs on our end. We're also looking into why wd-20613 triggered twice and will follow up once we confirm whether it was a retry issue on our side.

subject: Transform step failing on booking pipeline
body: We're seeing our "Bookings-Transform" job fail on every run since yesterday afternoon. The error is: TransformError: null value in column 'departure_date' violates not-null constraint at row 4032. This is blocking all booking data from reaching our warehouse and our team can't run reports this morning. Job ID is tr-55210, connector is the Postgres source.
answer: We've marked this as P1 given the pipeline is completely blocked. Our team is pulling the transform logs for tr-55210 now to identify why row 4032 is missing departure_date, and checking whether the source data or the transform mapping is at fault. We'll have an update for you within the hour, and in the meantime you can skip that batch temporarily by excluding rows flagged as invalid in the source connector settings.

subject: Salesforce sync stopped updating opportunity records
body: Our Salesforce integration hasn't pushed any opportunity updates to Northwind since 9:15am this morning. We rely on this sync for our compliance audit trail and missing records could affect this week's regulatory review. The integration dashboard shows status "Connected" but the last successful sync timestamp is stuck at 09:14. Can someone check the connection on your end?
answer: We understand the compliance impact and are treating this as a P1. Our team is checking the Salesforce OAuth token status and connection health for your integration now, since a stuck timestamp with a "Connected" status often points to a silent token expiration. We'll confirm the root cause and restore the sync as quickly as possible, and will document the incident timeline for your audit trail.

subject: PDF EXPORT BROKEN
body: WE NEED TO EXPORT OUR LOGISTICS DASHBOARD TO PDF FOR A CLIENT MEETING IN TWO HOURS AND THE EXPORT BUTTON JUST SPINS FOREVER. THIS WORKED FINE LAST WEEK. WE HAVE ONLY ONE PERSON WHO CAN DO THIS EXPORT AND IT NEEDS TO WORK NOW.
answer: We hear the urgency and are looking into the export failure on your dashboard right away. In the meantime, please try exporting from a different browser tab or clearing the dashboard cache, as this often resolves stuck export jobs caused by a stale render session. We're also checking our export service logs on our end and will confirm the fix well before your meeting.

subject: Handling late-arriving data in nightly sync
body: We run a nightly sync for our enrollment data pipeline and often get records that arrive 2-3 hours after the sync window closes, especially from our CRM connector. Right now these late records get dropped until the next run, causing a one-day lag in our reports. Is there a way to configure a grace window or re-run trigger for late-arriving rows?
answer: This is a common issue with CRM connectors that have variable delivery times. Currently there isn't a built-in grace window, but you can set up a secondary scheduled re-run about 3 hours after your main sync to capture stragglers without waiting for the next full cycle. We'll also log this as a feature request for a configurable late-data window, since it would help several customers with similar connectors.

subject: API keys returning 401 after rotation
body: We rotated our API keys this morning per the deprecation notice for the old v1 key format, but all requests using the new keys are returning 401 Unauthorized with error code AUTH_KEY_INVALID. This is affecting every service using our SDK v3.2.1, including our webhook receivers, and it's completely down for us right now. Old keys were deactivated at 8:00am UTC as instructed.
answer: We're treating this as a P1 outage. Can you share the first 8 characters of the new key prefix so we can check propagation on our side? New keys sometimes take a few minutes to activate across all regions, but since it's been longer than that we suspect a provisioning issue and are escalating to the platform team now. We'll update you as soon as we confirm the cause and restore access.

subject: Okta app assignment not syncing to Slack/Jira integration
body: We manage SSO for 1194 employees through Okta and noticed that when we assign the Northwind Okta app to a new group, the corresponding Slack and Jira integrations don't pick up the new members for several hours. Yesterday's batch of 45 new hires didn't get Jira project access until nearly 6 hours after the Okta assignment. Is there a webhook we're missing, or is this expected propagation delay?
answer: Six hours is longer than expected for this kind of provisioning sync, so we're looking into whether the webhook that triggers Slack and Jira access is queuing correctly on our end. Could you send us the Okta group ID and the timestamp of yesterday's assignment so we can trace the event through our logs? Normal propagation should be under 30 minutes, so we'll confirm whether this is a bug or a configuration gap.

subject: Question about pagination changes for /transactions endpoint
body: I saw the changelog note about the /transactions endpoint moving from offset-based to cursor-based pagination starting next quarter. Our finance reporting scripts currently use the "page" and "per_page" params with our SDK v2.4. Can you confirm the exact deprecation date and whether the old params will keep working during a transition period, or do we need to update our integration before then?
answer: Good timing to ask, the cutover for /transactions is scheduled for the first business day of next quarter, and offset-based params will continue to work for a 60-day grace period after that date before being fully removed. We strongly recommend updating to SDK v3, which handles cursor-based pagination automatically, so your finance scripts won't need manual changes. We'll also send you the migration guide link so your team can plan the update ahead of the deadline.

subject: Slack alert integration for Jira deployment notifications
body: We're using Northwind Integrations to push Jira ticket updates into Slack for our legal ops team, and it's working well overall. The issue is that alerts for high-priority Jira tickets take anywhere from 3 to 8 minutes to reach our #legal-alerts channel, which is too slow when we're tracking urgent contract deadlines. Is there a way to prioritize certain Jira labels so those alerts post faster, or a webhook setting we're missing?
answer: Thanks for the detailed feedback. The delay you're seeing is likely due to our default polling interval on the Jira connector rather than a webhook-based push; we do have a faster event-driven mode for Jira in beta that reduces latency to under 30 seconds for flagged labels. I'll get you set up with that beta flag on your Integrations instance and follow up with configuration steps within the next business day.

subject: How to share dashboards with view-only external partners
body: I manage our Northwind Dashboards setup for the logistics team and need to share a shipment tracking dashboard with two external freight partners who don't have Northwind accounts. Right now the sharing options only show internal user emails within our domain. Is there a way to generate a public or restricted link with view-only access, and if so, where is that documented?
answer: Good question - you can generate a restricted share link under Dashboard Settings > Sharing > External Access, which lets you set view-only permissions and an optional expiration date for non-account holders. I've linked our documentation page covering external sharing and link revocation in this ticket; let us know if the option isn't visible on your account tier and we'll double-check your configuration.

subject: SSO role mapping not assigning correct permissions after IdP update
body: After updating our Azure AD group attributes last night, several users logging in via SSO are now landing with default viewer permissions instead of their mapped admin or editor roles. We have 14 seats total and about 5 users affected as of this morning. The role mapping rules in our Identity console still reference the old group names, but the dropdown to update them is loading blank when I try to edit.
answer: Thanks for flagging this - a change to IdP group naming can definitely break existing role mappings if the console isn't picking up the new attribute values. We're checking why the mapping editor is loading blank on your account; in the meantime, can you send us the exact group names from your Azure AD as they appear now so we can manually verify the mapping while we fix the editor issue?

subject: URGENT: API pagination bug returning duplicate and missing records - possible data exposure
body: Our integration pulls student enrollment records via the /v2/records endpoint using cursor-based pagination, and starting this morning we're seeing the same page of records repeat across multiple cursor tokens, while other pages appear to be skipped entirely. This is causing our compliance export job to potentially expose records to the wrong downstream system since row counts don't match our source of truth by roughly 1,200 records.
answer: This is being treated as a top priority incident given the compliance exposure risk. We're pulling your account's API logs now to trace the pagination token behavior and will isolate whether this is a server-side cursor bug or a caching layer issue; please pause the export job on your end immediately if you haven't already to avoid propagating incorrect data. We'll update you within the hour with findings and a mitigation step.

subject: Salesforce sync completely stopped updating deal stages
body: Our Salesforce integration through Northwind stopped syncing deal stage changes as of yesterday around 2pm. We rely on this to trigger Slack notifications for our sales team when deals move to closed-won, and none of our reps have seen updates in over 18 hours. I checked the integration status page and it shows 'Connected' with no errors, but the sync log shows zero events processed since the outage started.
answer: I'm sorry for the disruption this is causing your sales team. We can see the sync job on our end shows a stalled worker queue for your Salesforce connector starting around the time you described, and we're restarting that queue now while investigating the root cause. I'll confirm once events start flowing again and will follow up with a summary of what caused the stall.

subject: CRITICAL: Late-arriving data causing pipeline failures and dropped records in production
body: We're running a data pipeline that ingests sensor readings from field devices, and since roughly 4am today the connector is dropping late-arriving events instead of reconciling them into the correct time window. Our downstream analytics tables are now missing an estimated 40,000 records across our 200-seat account, and the late-arrival buffer setting we configured at 15 minutes doesn't seem to be respected anymore. This is affecting real-time dashboards our operations team depends on for grid monitoring.
answer: We understand the severity here given the operational monitoring impact, and we've escalated this as a P0 incident. Our pipeline team is reviewing the connector's windowing logic now since a 15-minute buffer being ignored points to a possible regression in a recent deploy; we're also checking if the dropped records can be recovered from the raw ingestion buffer before they age out. Expect an update from us within 30 minutes as we work this.

subject: Invoice showing wrong seat count and duplicate charge
body: I'm reviewing our latest Northwind invoice and it lists 30 seats billed when we only have 21 active seats on our Starter plan. On top of that, it looks like we were charged twice on the same billing date, June 3rd, for what appears to be the same invoice number ending in 4471. Can someone check this and issue a refund for the duplicate charge and correct the seat count going forward?
answer: Thanks for catching this and providing the invoice number - a duplicate charge on the same billing cycle shouldn't happen, so I'm escalating this to our billing team to investigate the charge on invoice 4471 and process a refund once confirmed. We'll also correct the seat count discrepancy on your account; I'll follow up with confirmation once the refund is processed, typically within 3-5 business days.

subject: Deactivated users still appearing in reports
body: I deactivated four former employees through the Admin Console last week as part of our offboarding process, but they're still showing up as active users in our monthly usage reports. This isn't urgent since it doesn't affect billing, but it would be helpful to know if there's a delay in how deactivation status propagates to reporting, or if there's a setting we need to adjust.
answer: Good catch, and thanks for the patience since this isn't blocking anything urgent. Deactivation typically reflects in usage reports within 24 hours, but there can be a longer lag if the report was cached before deactivation occurred. I'll check the specific accounts you deactivated to confirm they're properly flagged, and let you know if we need to clear a report cache on our side.

subject: Audit log missing entries for admin console setting changes
body: I'm integrating with the Admin Console API to pull audit logs for compliance reporting, and I've noticed that certain events - specifically allowlist updates and user deactivations performed by other admins - aren't appearing in the /v1/audit-logs response at all, even though they show up in the UI activity feed. We have 241 seats and rely on complete audit trails for our retail compliance reviews, so this gap is a real problem for our quarterly audit.
answer: Thank you for the specific detail on which event types are missing - that's very helpful for narrowing this down. It sounds like there's a filtering or indexing bug where allowlist and deactivation events aren't being written to the audit log endpoint despite appearing in the UI feed, so I'm filing this as a bug with our platform team. In the meantime, can you tell us the date range you need for your quarterly review so we can manually pull those events from our internal logs as a stopgap?

subject: Requesting increased storage quota and clarification on upload limits
body: Our team is approaching the storage quota on our Starter plan and I'd like to understand our options before we hit a hard limit. We're currently uploading course materials and video files for our education platform, and I've noticed some uploads over 500MB fail silently without a clear error message, which makes it hard to tell if that's a quota issue or a file size limit. Could you clarify the actual limits and let us know what upgrading storage would involve?
answer: Thanks for reaching out before hitting a hard wall on this. On the Starter plan, individual file uploads are capped at 500MB, so files at or above that threshold can fail without a descriptive error - that's a known gap in our error messaging that we're tracking to improve. For your overall quota, I can pull your current usage and share upgrade options that would raise both the per-file limit and total storage, and get you a quote if you'd like to move forward.

subject: SAML SSO login fails for new provisioned users
body: We just finished setting up SAML SSO with our identity provider for Quill Works and most of our 5 seats can log in fine, but two accounts created this week get redirected back to the Northwind login page with no error message after authenticating on our IdP side. I checked the SAML response in our IdP logs and it shows a successful assertion. Can you help us figure out why Northwind isn't accepting it for these two users specifically?
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. This pattern usually means the NameID or email attribute in the assertion for those two accounts doesn't match what's on file in Northwind, often because the account was provisioned with a different email format. Could you send us the SAML assertion (with any sensitive values redacted) for one of the affected users along with their Northwind user ID so we can compare attribute mapping and confirm?

subject: URGENT - all users being logged out every few minutes, SSO broken
body: Starting about 20 minutes ago every user at Cobalt Health is getting logged out of Northwind roughly every 3-5 minutes and forced back through our SSO provider. This is affecting all 20 seats and we cannot get any consistent work done, several analysts are stuck mid-report. It started right after we noticed a spike in failed login attempts in our IdP logs around 9:40am, so we're worried this might be a credential stuffing attempt rather than a normal bug.
answer: This is being escalated immediately as a P0 incident given the possible security angle. We're pulling session and authentication logs for your tenant right now to determine whether the forced logouts are tied to the failed login spike or a session token issue on our side, and we'll temporarily tighten session validation as a precaution. We'll update you within 15 minutes with findings and next steps, please keep any IdP logs from the failed attempts available for us to cross-reference.

subject: Requesting increase to API rate limits ahead of Q3 rollout
body: We're rolling out a new billing reconciliation workflow across North Health next month that will call the Northwind API significantly more often, and we're currently hitting 429 rate limit responses during testing at around 850 requests per minute on the /invoices endpoint. Our plan currently allows 500 requests per minute per the docs. Could you let us know what it would take to raise this limit, and whether there's a webhook-based alternative to polling /invoices that would reduce our call volume?
answer: Thanks for planning ahead on this. We can raise your rate limit on the /invoices endpoint to accommodate the higher volume, and I'd also recommend switching to our invoice.updated webhook event, which would cut most of your polling entirely. I'll follow up with a quota increase proposal and webhook setup guide within the next business day so you can validate both before the Q3 rollout.

subject: Deactivated user still appears in audit log as active
body: I deactivated a former employee's account in the Admin Console for Granite Travel on Tuesday, but when I pulled the audit log yesterday to review access for a compliance check, that user still shows as 'active' in the export even though the console UI shows them as deactivated. I want to make sure there isn't a gap in our records before our quarterly review. Is this a display issue in the export or could the deactivation not have fully applied?
answer: Thanks for flagging this before your review, this is a known display lag in audit log exports where the status field can take up to 24 hours to reflect a deactivation even though the account access itself is revoked immediately. I've confirmed the account in question is fully deactivated on our end as of Tuesday, and I'd suggest re-running the export now to check if it's updated; if it still shows active after that, let us know and we'll investigate further.

subject: Mobile app crashes immediately on launch after update
body: Since updating the Northwind mobile app on my iPhone yesterday, it crashes within a second of opening every time, before I even see the login screen. A couple of colleagues at Willow Systems have the same issue on their phones too, though not everyone is affected. I've tried reinstalling once already with no change. Could you check if there's a known issue with the latest release, and is there a way to roll back to the previous version in the meantime?
answer: Thanks for the report and for trying a reinstall already. We've had a couple of similar reports of a launch crash tied to the latest release on certain iOS versions, so I'd like to get your device model and iOS version to confirm you're affected by the same issue. In the meantime, there isn't a self-serve rollback option, but we're prioritizing a fix and will let you know as soon as an update is available.

subject: Duplicate daily email digests going out to all users
body: Since Monday, every user at Apex Retail has been receiving two identical copies of the daily notification digest email, both sent about 4 minutes apart. With 195 seats this is generating a lot of confused replies to our helpdesk asking if something's wrong. The content of both emails looks the same, same summary counts and timestamp, so it doesn't seem like a data issue, just a duplicate send.
answer: Sorry for the inbox clutter this has caused across your team. This matches a digest scheduling issue we're aware of where the job can trigger twice under certain queue conditions, and our team is actively working on a fix. In the meantime I'll flag your account so we can confirm once the duplicate sends stop, and I'll follow up directly once the fix is deployed.

subject: URGENT - workspace settings reset, security policies gone
body: At around 8:15am today the workspace settings for North Health in the Admin Console reverted to default, our custom password policy, session timeout rules, and IP allowlist restrictions are all gone. This is a serious security exposure across all 180 seats since anyone can now log in without the MFA enforcement we had configured. We need this restored immediately and need to know how this happened.
answer: We understand the severity here and this has been escalated as a P0.
