This is happening on both iPhone and Android devices across our travel booking staff, roughly 12 out of our 30 users have mentioned it. It's not blocking work entirely since password login still functions, but it's a frustrating daily friction point for people trying to check bookings on the go.
answer: Thanks for bringing this to our attention with the device details. We've seen a small number of similar reports tied to a recent biometric handling update in the app, and it looks like the fallback trigger is being hit more aggressively than intended on certain OS versions. We're prioritizing a fix for this and will follow up with a timeline once our mobile team confirms the root cause - in the meantime, having affected users toggle biometric login off and back on in Settings > Security has resolved it for some customers temporarily.

subject: cant upload monthly reports, keeps failing
body:
hi im tryin to upload our end of month reconciliation reports to storage and it keeps failin at aroudn 80% everytime. ive tried 3 times now since yesterday with the same csv file, its about 45mb. gettin an error that just says "upload interrupted" with no other detail.

not super urgent since i can still email the file to my team for now but woudl be nice to get this workin again since we use storage for all our archiving normally. let me know if you need anything else from me
answer: Thanks for letting us know, and no worries on the urgency - we'll get this sorted. A file failing consistently around the same percentage often points to a timeout on larger uploads over certain network conditions, so we're checking your account's upload logs from yesterday to confirm. Could you let us know what browser and connection type you were using, and we'll follow up with either a fix or a workaround for uploading that file in smaller chunks.

subject: Data pipeline connector delivering records 6+ hours late
body:
Our claims processing pipeline pulling from the EHR connector has been delivering data 6 to 8 hours later than the configured SLA since Tuesday, October 3rd. This is affecting downstream reporting for our analytics team - dashboards that should refresh by 8am are now not populated until mid-afternoon, and we've had three separate department heads flag stale data this week.

Looking at the connector logs, timestamps show the source system is emitting on schedule but Northwind's pipeline queue seems to be backing up before it reaches our target warehouse. Given the scale of our organization and the number of teams depending on same-day data, we need this latency issue resolved urgently.
answer: This is a significant issue and we're escalating it to our data pipelines engineering team immediately given the healthcare reporting impact. Initial review of the connector queue metrics shows a backlog building since October 3rd consistent with what you're describing - we suspect a throughput bottleneck introduced during a recent scaling change on our end. We'll provide an update within the next few hours with either a resolution or a mitigation to reduce the delay while the root cause is fixed.

subject: help
body:
Trying to set up the Salesforce sync through Northwind Integrations and getting stuck at the OAuth step. I authorize the connection in Salesforce, get redirected back, but then see an error: "invalid_grant: authentication failure" and the sync never activates.

I've double checked our Salesforce connected app settings and the callback URL matches what's in the Northwind integration docs. This is for a small internal tool we're building so it's not blocking a huge team, but I do need to get past this step to keep testing. Any pointers on what might be misconfigured?
answer: Thanks for the details - an invalid_grant error at this stage usually means either the OAuth token has expired before the redirect completes or there's a scope mismatch between what your connected app requests and what Northwind's integration expects. Can you confirm which OAuth scopes are enabled on your Salesforce connected app? In the meantime, I'll link you to our updated Salesforce sync setup guide which covers a common misconfiguration around refresh token policies that trips this exact error.

subject: Request: ability to customize email digest frequency per team
body:
We'd like to request the option to configure notification email digests at a per-team level rather than account-wide. Right now all our teams get the same daily digest schedule, but our manufacturing floor teams only need a weekly summary while our quality control team wants near real-time alerts, and currently we can't split this without creating separate accounts.

This is becoming a real pain point since our QC team is missing time-sensitive alerts buried in a daily digest, and it's affecting how quickly issues get addressed on the floor. Is per-team digest configuration on the roadmap, or is there a workaround available now?
answer: Thank you for the detailed use case - this is a request we've heard from a few customers and I want to make sure it gets proper visibility, so I'm logging it as a feature request with our product team and flagging the urgency given the QC alerting gap you described. As a workaround in the meantime, you can create separate notification rules per user group under Notifications > Alerting Rules, which lets you set different digest frequencies without needing separate accounts - I'll walk you through setting that up for your QC team today if helpful.

subject: Plan upgrade charged us but seats not increased
body:
We upgraded from 150 to 204 seats last week to accommodate our new logistics hires, and the invoice reflects the upgraded rate, but our admin console still shows a cap of 150 seats - we can't add the new employees we onboarded this week. The payment for the upgrade went through on October 5th according to our billing history.

This is holding up onboarding for 8 new hires who need dashboard and API access to start their roles. Can someone check why the seat limit didn't update after the plan change processed?
answer: Apologies for the trouble this is causing with your onboarding timeline. I can confirm the payment for your upgrade to 204 seats processed successfully on October 5th, but it looks like the seat limit update didn't sync to your account provisioning correctly - I'm manually applying the correct seat cap now and will confirm once it's live, which should be within the hour so your 8 new hires can be added without delay.

subject: Requesting increased storage quota and retention clarification
body:
We're approaching our storage quota limit for our fintech data archive and would like to request an increase ahead of hitting the cap - we're currently at around 92% utilization based on the usage dashboard. Separately, I wanted to confirm how retention policies interact with quota: if older files are auto-purged per our 7-year retention setting, does that reclaim quota space automatically or do we need to manually clean up?

Could someone advise on the process for requesting a quota increase and clarify the retention behavior so we can plan our archive strategy accordingly?
answer: Happy to help with both parts of this. For the quota increase, I can process a bump for your account - could you let me know the target amount you'd like to move to so I can get that request submitted today? On retention, files purged automatically per your 7-year policy do reclaim quota space, though it can take up to 24 hours to reflect in the usage dashboard after deletion, so a small lag is expected rather than needing manual cleanup.

subject: Okta app integration broken for Pioneer Foods
body: Since this morning our Okta-provisioned SSO login into Northwind stopped working for all 6 seats. Users get 'App assignment error' when clicking the Okta tile, and the SAML trace shows a 'destination mismatch' error. We didn't change anything on our Okta side yesterday. Can someone check if the Northwind Okta app config changed recently? This is blocking our whole team from logging in.
answer: Thanks for flagging this right away — I can see the SAML metadata for your Okta app integration was rotated during our scheduled certificate update last night, which explains the destination mismatch. I'm pushing the updated metadata to your tenant now and will confirm once SSO logins are restored, expecting this within the hour. In the meantime, affected users can log in with their Northwind username and password as a fallback.

subject: MFA enrolment question for new hires
body: We're onboarding a batch of new employees at Granite Robotics and I want to confirm the correct flow for MFA enrolment through our SSO setup. When a new user logs in for the first time via SSO, are they prompted to enroll in MFA automatically, or do we need to pre-configure something in the Northwind admin console first? A couple of testers reported they weren't prompted at all.
answer: Good question — MFA enrolment prompts only trigger automatically if the 'Require MFA on first login' toggle is enabled under Identity settings > Security policies. If that's off, users can skip enrolment indefinitely, which explains what your testers saw. I'd recommend enabling that policy for your SSO-connected accounts; happy to walk through the exact steps if you'd like a screen-share.

subject: Zapier integration timing out on trigger events
body: Our Zapier integration with Northwind has been failing since around 9am today — the 'New Record' trigger is timing out with a 504 before it can fetch data, and this is affecting several Zaps our sales team relies on for Salesforce syncing. We have 123 seats on this plan and this integration is core to our renewal workflows this week. Can you escalate this urgently?
answer: I understand the urgency given your renewal workflows this week — I'm escalating this to our integrations engineering team immediately as a P1. Initial logs show elevated latency on the Zapier webhook endpoint starting around 9:05am; we're investigating whether this is tied to a recent load spike. I'll update you within the next hour with root cause and an ETA for resolution.

subject: How to pass custom fields through Zapier to Salesforce
body: I'm building a Zap that pulls new records from Northwind and pushes them into Salesforce, but I can't find a way to map our custom API fields — only the default fields show up in the Zapier action step. Is there documentation on exposing custom fields for Zapier mapping, or do I need to modify something in our API schema first?
answer: Custom fields need to be explicitly marked as 'exposed' in your API schema settings before they appear in Zapier's field mapping — by default only standard fields are surfaced to keep the integration lightweight. I'll send over our integration docs page that walks through the schema flag and a couple of Zapier mapping examples so you can get this set up.

subject: Pagination returning duplicate records on large exports
body: We noticed our nightly export job using the API's paginated endpoint is returning duplicate records across pages starting last week. Using the 'next_cursor' from the response, page 14 and page 15 both contain the same 50 records for our /reports endpoint. This is throwing off our downstream reporting for the whole team and we've had to manually dedupe about 3,000 rows so far.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report — this matches an issue we're tracking where cursor-based pagination on /reports can return an overlapping page when records are inserted mid-export. As a workaround, please add the 'stable_sort=true' query parameter, which locks the ordering snapshot at the start of the export. We're rolling out a permanent fix to the pagination cursor logic and I'll update this ticket once it's deployed.

subject: Request to consolidate email digest notifications
body: Our workspace admins have been getting flooded with separate email digests — one for alerts, one for team activity, and one for billing — often arriving within minutes of each other. Across our 3393 seats this is generating a lot of noise and several team leads have asked if these can be merged into a single daily digest instead of three separate emails.
answer: This is great feedback, and you're not the only enterprise customer asking for this — we're currently scoping a consolidated digest option that merges alerts, activity, and billing notices into one email with sectioned content. I don't have a firm release date yet, but I'll log this request against your account and notify you as soon as it's available in beta.

subject: Need retention policy increased for storage before quota hits
body: We're approaching our storage quota faster than expected and need to extend our data retention settings before older backups get purged automatically. Currently set to 90 days, but our compliance team wants at least 180 days for uploaded documents. Can someone walk me through changing this, or is it something only Northwind support can adjust on the account?
answer: Retention period changes can be made directly from Storage settings > Retention policy, where you can extend the window up to 365 days on the Pro plan without needing support to intervene. Given you're close to quota though, I'd also suggest reviewing your current usage under Storage > Quota to confirm the extended retention won't push you over — happy to review those numbers with you if useful.

subject: MFA enrolment stuck at 'pending verification'
body: One of our analysts is stuck during MFA enrolment — after scanning the QR code and entering the six-digit code, the screen just shows 'Pending verification' and never completes. We tried on two different browsers and it's the same result. This is only affecting this one user out of our 8 seats, but they can't access dashboards until it's resolved.
answer: Sorry for the trouble this is causing — this pending state usually clears when there's a time-sync mismatch between the authenticator app and our verification server. Could you have the user check their device's date/time is set to automatic, then try re-enrolling? If it's still stuck after that, I can manually reset their MFA enrolment from our side so they can start fresh.

subject: MFA enrolment failing via API for provisioned users
body: We're provisioning users programmatically through the Identity API and setting 'mfa_required: true' on creation, but when those users try to enroll in MFA on first login they get a 403 with error code 'mfa_enrollment_not_permitted'. This is blocking onboarding for new API-created accounts across our team of 24 seats — worked fine for accounts created manually through the admin console.
answer: Thanks for the clear repro details — this looks like a known gap where users provisioned via the Identity API don't automatically inherit the MFA enrolment permission that's granted by default through the admin console flow. As a workaround, please also call the /users/{id}/permissions endpoint with 'mfa_enroll: true' right after creation. I'm flagging this to engineering so API-provisioned users get this permission by default going forward.

subject: Seat count on invoice doesn't match our actual users
body: Our latest invoice shows 5 seats billed, but we only have 4 active users on the Quill Works account right now — one employee left last month and I deactivated their login on the 12th. Can you confirm why we're still being charged for that seat, and whether the next invoice will reflect the correct count?
answer: Thanks for catching this — billing seat counts sync on the first of each billing cycle, so a deactivation on the 12th wouldn't reflect until the next invoice generates. I've checked your account and confirmed you're now at 4 active seats; your upcoming invoice will bill accordingly, and I'll apply a prorated credit for the difference on this current cycle.

subject: Users getting logged out every 15 minutes
body: We're seeing our team at Orion Robotics get kicked back to the login screen roughly every 15 minutes, even mid-task on the shop floor dashboards. This started after we enabled MFA last week. All 6 seats are affected, and it's disrupting our production tracking workflow since operators have to re-authenticate constantly. Session length in the admin console still shows 8 hours, so this doesn't match our config.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report. This mismatch usually happens when the MFA re-verification interval is set separately from the base session token lifetime, so users are being re-challenged well before the 8-hour window ends. Could you confirm under Identity Settings > MFA Policy what the 'step-up frequency' is set to? We'll also check the session logs on our end for Orion Robotics to see the token issuance pattern and follow up shortly.

subject: Need help configuring SAML login for our IdP
body: I'm setting up SAML SSO for Vertex Academy so our 8 staff accounts can log in through our identity provider instead of separate passwords. I've uploaded the metadata XML but I'm not sure which attribute mapping fields are required versus optional, and whether MFA can still be enforced on top of SAML once it's active. Could you point me to the exact steps or a checklist for this?
answer: Happy to help get SAML set up correctly. The required attribute mappings are NameID (email format) and a group or role claim if you want automatic permission assignment; everything else like department or display name is optional. MFA can still be layered on top of SAML as a step-up policy, configured separately under Identity > MFA Policies. I'll send over our SAML setup checklist and can review your metadata file if you attach it here.

subject: URGENT - all users mapped to wrong roles after SSO update, admins locked out
body: Right after we pushed an update to our SSO role mapping this morning, every user at Pioneer Media was reassigned to a generic viewer role, including our own admin accounts. We can no longer access user management or billing settings, and two staff members have been dropped entirely from restricted areas they need for compliance checks today. This is affecting all 4 of our seats and we need this reverted immediately.
answer: This has been escalated to our on-call identity team as a P0 immediately. We are rolling back the role mapping change on our side and restoring prior admin access for Pioneer Media now; we'll also audit the mapping rules to confirm this isn't provisioning new users incorrectly during the outage. I'll update you within the hour with confirmation that admin access and role assignments are restored, and a summary of what caused the mapping to overwrite existing roles.

subject: Request to fix duplicate email alerts from Notifications
body: Our team at Vertex Labs has been getting duplicate copies of the same billing and security alerts, sometimes 2-3 identical emails within a minute. It's not a huge issue but it's cluttering inboxes for all 25 of our seats and generating confused replies from staff thinking something's wrong. Could you look into whether this is a webhook retry issue on your end, or if there's a setting we should adjust for alert deduplication?
answer: Thanks for flagging this, it's a known pattern that can occur when an alert's delivery confirmation is delayed, triggering a retry before the first send is acknowledged. We're logging this as a change request to add deduplication windows to the notification service. In the meantime, I can share a workaround using digest mode for non-critical alert categories, which should cut down on the duplicates for Vertex Labs while the fix is scheduled.

subject: How do I restore files from an earlier backup?
body: One of our team members at North Media accidentally overwrote a set of itinerary files in Storage last week, and I'd like to restore the previous version from before October 3rd if that's possible. I checked the retention settings and it looks like we keep 30 days of backups, but I don't see a self-service restore option anywhere in the dashboard. Is this something support handles manually, or is there a UI path I'm missing?
answer: Good news, your files should still be recoverable since they're within the 30-day retention window. Self-service restore isn't available yet in the Storage dashboard, so our team handles this manually. If you can send the exact folder path and the date/time close to when the overwrite happened, we'll pull the snapshot for North Media and restore it to a separate folder so you can verify contents before replacing the current files.

subject: SDK throwing deprecated method warnings after upgrade
body: After upgrading to the latest version of the API Platform SDK, we're getting deprecation warnings for several methods we use in our order-sync integration at Apex Partners, specifically around the client.batchFetch and client.authRefresh calls. The docs still reference the old method signatures in a few places. Could you clarify the recommended replacement methods and roughly when the deprecated ones will be fully removed, so we can plan the migration across our integration team?
answer: Thanks for catching that documentation gap, we'll get it updated. client.batchFetch has been replaced by client.fetchBatch, which supports the same parameters plus pagination cursors, and client.authRefresh is now handled automatically by the SDK's token manager, so that call can simply be removed. The deprecated methods are planned for removal in the next major SDK version, expected in about two release cycles, so there's no immediate urgency for Apex Partners but we'd recommend migrating within the current quarter.

subject: Push notifications not being delivered to any students' devices
body: Starting this morning, push notifications for assignment deadlines and grade updates are not reaching any of our students on the Mobile App, affecting all 224 seats at Atlas Academy. We've confirmed devices have notification permissions enabled and the app is updated to the latest version. Nothing appears in the delivery logs on our admin side either, it's just silent. This is a critical issue since deadline reminders go out today.
answer: This is being treated as a high priority incident given the scope. We're seeing a similar pattern on our end with the push delivery service and are actively investigating a possible issue with the notification gateway that started a few hours ago. I'll update you as soon as we have a root cause or a fix deployed, and will let you know if there's a way to manually re-trigger today's deadline reminders once service is restored.

subject: Retention policy deleting files sooner than expected
body: We've noticed files in Storage are disappearing after about 45 days, but our understanding from onboarding was that Delta Foods should have 90-day retention on uploaded documents given our plan. This is affecting itinerary attachments across several of our 293 seats, and a few team members have already lost files they needed for expense reconciliation this month. Can you confirm what our actual retention setting is and whether this can be corrected or backdated?
answer: Thank you for flagging this, and I'm sorry about the lost files. I've checked Delta Foods' account and the retention policy is currently configured at 45 days rather than the 90 days that should apply to your plan tier, which explains the early deletions. We're correcting the setting now and will check whether any recently purged files fall within a recoverable window on our backend, and will follow up with what we can restore.

subject: Dashboard PDF export failing or producing blank pages
body: Exporting our media performance dashboards to PDF has been failing for Orion Energy since yesterday, either timing out completely or generating a PDF with blank pages where charts should be. This is affecting all 23 seats and we rely on these exports for our weekly stakeholder reports, which are due tomorrow morning. The dashboards render fine in the browser, it's only the export function that's broken.
answer: Thanks for the clear report, I understand the deadline pressure here. This looks related to a rendering timeout issue affecting chart-heavy dashboards during PDF generation, which our engineering team is aware of and actively working on. As a workaround for tonight, try exporting individual chart panels instead of the full dashboard, which tends to complete successfully, and I'll prioritize getting the full-dashboard export fix confirmed before your report deadline.

subject: Refund and credit not reflecting on latest invoice
body: We were promised a service credit for downtime last month along with a partial refund for an overcharge on our Starter plan at Granite Travel, but neither shows up on our invoice dated this billing cycle. We were told both would be applied automatically, but the total charged still matches the full amount for our 8 seats. Can someone confirm the credit and refund were actually processed, and correct the invoice if not?
answer: Thanks for bringing this to our attention, and I'm sorry the adjustments didn't show up as expected. I'm looking into Granite Travel's billing account now to verify whether the service credit and refund were approved but not applied, or if they're still pending in our system. I'll confirm the status and get a corrected invoice issued within the next couple of business days.

subject: Multiple card declines on recent invoices
body: Over the past week we've had 6 failed card transactions on our Pro account (237 seats), all showing the same decline code from our processor even though the card has sufficient funds and hasn't expired. Invoice #INV-88213 and #INV-88240 are both stuck in 'payment failed' status. Our finance team wants to know if this is on Northwind's side before we contact our bank again.
answer: Thanks for flagging this - I can see the two invoices you mentioned and confirm both attempts were rejected by the processor with a generic 'do_not_honor' response, which typically points to the issuing bank rather than our billing system. I've triggered a manual retry on both invoices and also opened a case with our payment processor to check for any routing issues on their end; I'll update you within one business day with what we find.

subject: Webhooks bleiben aus seit heute Morgen
body: Seit heute Morgen gegen 8 Uhr erhalten wir keine Webhook-Benachrichtigungen mehr für abgeschlossene Zahlungen. Unser System zur Rechnungsabgleichung hängt dadurch komplett fest, da wir auf die Events 'invoice.paid' und 'invoice.failed' angewiesen sind. Wir haben die Endpoint-URL in den letzten Tagen nicht verändert und auch keine Fehlermeldungen im Dashboard gesehen. Das betrifft unser gesamtes Finance-Team, bitte um dringende Prüfung.
answer: Vielen Dank für die schnelle Meldung - wir sehen in den Logs, dass seit 07:52 Uhr alle Zustellversuche an Ihren Endpoint mit Timeout-Fehlern (Antwortzeit über 30 Sekunden) fehlschlagen, was auf ein Problem auf Empfängerseite hindeutet. Wir haben die Events zwischengespeichert und werden sie automatisch erneut zustellen, sobald Ihr Endpoint wieder antwortet. Können Sie kurzfristig prüfen, ob der Service hinter der Endpoint-URL erreichbar ist? Wir bleiben an diesem Fall dran, bis das Problem gelöst ist.

subject: Request to rotate and scope API keys for new microservice
body: We're integrating a new internal microservice that needs read-only access to our course enrollment data via the API, and I'd like to generate a scoped API key rather than reusing our existing full-access key. Right now our admin console only shows an option to create keys with full account permissions. Is there a way to restrict scope to specific endpoints, or is this planned for a future release? We're on the Enterprise plan with 1598 seats across several campuses.
answer: Good question - scoped API keys with endpoint-level restrictions are available on Enterprise plans, but the option is currently hidden behind a feature flag we enable on request. I've turned this on for your account; you should now see a 'Scope' dropdown when generating a new key under Settings > API Keys. Let us know if you need help mapping specific endpoints to your microservice's requirements.

subject: Salesforce sync missing a handful of updated contacts
body: We noticed that a small number of contact records updated in Salesforce over the last two days aren't showing up as synced in Northwind Integrations. Out of roughly 400 contacts touched, about 12 seem to be stuck in a 'pending' state on the integration log. It's not urgent since it's a small subset, but wanted to flag it before it grows.
answer: Thanks for catching this early - I checked the sync log for your workspace and see those 12 records are failing validation because they're missing a required 'Account ID' field on the Salesforce side, which our mapping requires for the contact object. Once that field is populated on those records, the sync should pick them up on the next run. If you'd like, we can also add a fallback rule so records without an Account ID sync with a placeholder instead of stalling.

subject: Users getting logged out every 10-15 minutes
body: Since yesterday, our team of 18 has been getting kicked out of Northwind roughly every 10 to 15 minutes, forcing a full SSO re-login through our identity provider each time. This is disrupting work across the whole account, especially for analysts pulling data mid-session. We haven't changed any SSO or MFA settings recently. Session timeout was previously set to 8 hours in our SSO config.
answer: This is impacting your whole team so we're treating it as high priority. We've identified that a recent token refresh change on our side is causing session tokens issued through SAML SSO to expire prematurely instead of honoring your configured 8-hour timeout. We're deploying a fix now and will confirm once it's live, but in the meantime a re-login will be required each time the session drops - we expect this resolved within the next few hours and will update this ticket directly.

subject: Shared dashboards showing 'access denied' for entire team
body: As of this morning, every dashboard we've shared with external view-only links is returning 'access denied' for our team of 270 users, including dashboards used in client-facing meetings later today. Nothing changed in our sharing settings that we're aware of, and internal editors can still open the dashboards fine when logged in. This is blocking multiple scheduled client presentations.
answer: I understand the urgency given the client meetings today, and we're prioritizing this. We've confirmed a permissions regression affecting external share links across multiple workspaces, introduced in this morning's release, and our engineering team is rolling back the change now. I'll follow up within the hour with confirmation once external links are working again, and I'm sorry for the disruption ahead of your presentations.

subject: Question about increasing webhook retry window
body: We're currently on the default webhook retry settings and noticed retries stop after about 4 attempts over roughly 15 minutes. Our endpoint occasionally has short maintenance windows longer than that, so we'd like to know if it's possible to extend the retry window or increase the max attempt count, and whether this requires a plan change.
answer: Extending the retry window is possible even on the Starter plan, though the option isn't yet exposed in the dashboard UI. I can manually configure your webhook settings to extend retries up to 6 attempts over 45 minutes - let me know if that would cover your maintenance windows, or if you'd like a different configuration, and I'll apply it to your account.

subject: SCIM provisioning failing for users with hyphenated departments
body: We're rolling out SCIM provisioning across our organization (3256 seats) and have found that any user whose department attribute contains a hyphen, for example 'Peri-operative Care', fails to provision with a 400 error referencing an invalid schema value. Non-hyphenated department names work fine. This is blocking provisioning for several clinical departments and we need a workaround or fix soon.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report - this looks like a parsing bug in our SCIM schema validator that's incorrectly treating hyphens in the department attribute as an unsupported character, rather than the intended free-text field. I've reproduced it on our end and filed it as a bug with engineering; as a workaround in the meantime, you can URL-encode the hyphen in the SCIM payload, which should pass validation. I'll update this ticket once the permanent fix ships.

subject: Push notifications not arriving on Android after app update
body: Since the mobile app update rolled out to our team, Android users (roughly 40 of our 206 seats based on support reports) are no longer receiving push notifications for new task assignments, while iOS users seem unaffected. We've confirmed notification permissions are enabled on test devices and the issue persists after reinstalling the app. This is a regression from the previous release, which worked fine.
answer: Thanks for the clear breakdown between Android and iOS - this matches a report we're tracking internally tied to the latest Android build's Firebase token registration, where tokens aren't refreshing correctly after update. Our mobile team has a fix staged for the next patch release, expected within a few days. In the meantime, a full app reinstall combined with clearing notification settings has resolved it for some affected users, though it isn't guaranteed - I'll notify you as soon as the patch is live.

subject: Workspace settings page loading very slowly
body: The workspace settings page in our Admin Console has been taking 15-20 seconds to load for the past two days, sometimes timing out entirely before we can view or edit settings like audit log retention. We only have 3 seats on this account so it's not a load issue on our end. Could you check if something changed on the backend for this section?
answer: Thanks for reporting this - we've seen a few similar reports and traced it to a slow query affecting the settings page for accounts with certain audit log configurations, which is likely why you're seeing the delay. We're deploying an optimization to that query today; in the meantime, if the page times out, refreshing after a short wait should still let it load. I'll confirm here once the fix is out and performance is back to normal.

subject: Dashboards taking 20+ seconds to load for travel spend reports
body: Our main Travel Spend dashboard (ID dash-8841) has been taking 18-25 seconds to render since Monday. It has 12 charts pulling from the Expenses and Bookings data sources. Exporting to CSV from that dashboard now times out after about 30 seconds with no file generated. This is affecting the weekly finance review my team runs every Friday, so we need this fixed before then.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report and the dashboard ID - that helps a lot. We're seeing elevated query times on the Expenses data source shared across several Pro accounts and are actively investigating the root cause. I'll flag dash-8841 for priority review and follow up within one business day with either a fix or a workaround for the export timeout ahead of your Friday review.

subject: Dashboards
body: Since this morning shared dashboards across our whole team are loading extremely slowly, some taking over a minute, and a few are timing out entirely with a 504 before they even render. We have about 40 agents relying on the Shift Coverage dashboard for real-time ops and right now it's basically unusable. This started around 9am and hasn't improved.
answer: This is impacting shared dashboard access for your whole team, so we're treating it as high priority and escalating immediately. Our engineers are already looking at elevated 504 rates on shared dashboard loads reported by a couple of other accounts this morning - can you confirm the exact dashboard IDs affected, including Shift Coverage, so we can trace them directly? We'll keep you updated as we work this and will notify you as soon as we identify the cause.

subject: Getting duplicate email alerts for the same event
body: We've noticed that our booking-confirmation notification rule has been firing twice for the same event over the past week, so recipients get two identical emails a few seconds apart. It's not happening on every trigger, maybe 1 in 5, but it's confusing our travel agents who think something failed and resend confirmations to customers. Wondering if this is a known issue with the alerting engine or something on our rule configuration.
answer: Thanks for flagging this - duplicate sends on a subset of triggers usually points to either a retry from a delayed delivery receipt or an overlapping rule condition. subject: Unsubscribe link broken, users still getting flooded with emails

subject: Pagination returning duplicate and skipped records on /v2/matters endpoint

subject: URGENT: API deprecation caused data loss in nightly sync

In the meantime we can issue a temporary MFA bypass for your admin account so finance staff can get in - please confirm the admin username and we'll set that up within the next 15 minutes.

subject: Salesforce sync field mapping suggestion
body:
We've been running the Salesforce integration for a few months now and it works well overall, syncing opportunities and accounts nightly. I wanted to flag that the custom field 'Contract_Value__c' isn't available in the mapping dropdown, so we're manually updating that field after each sync.

Would it be possible to add support for custom currency fields in a future release? Not urgent, just would save our team some manual work each week.
answer: Thanks for the detailed feedback - custom currency fields like Contract_Value__c aren't currently exposed in the mapping UI because of a type-casting limitation we're addressing. I've logged this as a feature request tied to your account, and I'll follow up once it's scheduled so you can drop the manual step.

subject: Backup restore failing - need data back now
body:
We accidentally deleted the 'orders_march' bucket in Storage this morning and triggered a restore from the March 8th backup, but the restore job has been stuck at 'in progress' for over 90 minutes with no data appearing. Our retail ops team cannot process today's orders without this data.

Job ID is rst-88213. Can someone check the status urgently and let us know if the backup is recoverable at all?
answer: Escalating this to our storage team as a P0 right now - a stalled restore with active business impact takes top priority. We're pulling logs for job rst-88213 to determine whether it's stuck or has silently failed, and will have someone actively working this within minutes with a status update as soon as we know more.

subject: Recurring transform failures in daily pipeline
body:
Our nightly pipeline that transforms inventory data before loading to the warehouse has failed 4 of the last 7 nights with a 'schema mismatch on column quantity_in_stock' error. The source connector is our retail POS feed, and it seems like the column type changed from integer to string upstream but our transform step isn't handling it gracefully.

Is there a way to configure the transform to auto-cast or at least alert us before failing the whole run instead of dropping the job silently?
answer: Good catch - right now the transform step fails closed rather than attempting an implicit cast, which is why you're seeing silent job drops. You can add a type-coercion rule in the transform config under 'column overrides' to force quantity_in_stock to integer with a fallback value, and I'll also share our doc on setting up failure alerts so you get notified before it silently drops future runs.

subject: PDF export completely broken on all dashboards
body: Every dashboard export to PDF is failing for our whole team as of this morning - clicking 'Export to PDF' spins for about 30 seconds then shows 'export failed, please try again'. This is happening on all 6 of our shared dashboards, not just one, and we need these PDFs for a client report due today.
answer: We've confirmed this is impacting PDF export broadly and have escalated it as P1 to our dashboard team. Initial findings point to a rendering service timeout affecting exports across multiple workspaces - we'll push a fix and update this ticket as soon as it's confirmed, and will follow up directly once exports are working again given your deadline.

subject: Role mapping incorrectly granting admin access via SSO
body:
During a compliance review we discovered that our SSO role mapping is granting Admin-level permissions to users who should only have Viewer access. This appears to be affecting at least 40 accounts across our Enterprise workspace, and started after we updated our IdP group names last week.

Given the scope of excess permissions granted, we need this addressed urgently and a full audit of affected accounts. Please advise on immediate remediation steps.
answer: Thank you for flagging this - we're treating it as P1 given the security implications of over-provisioned admin access. Our security and compliance team is pulling the audit log now to identify every account affected by the group name change and will provide you a full list plus remediation steps, including a temporary mapping rollback to your prior IdP group configuration, within the next hour.

subject: Unsubscribe link not working in notification emails
body:
One of our users clicked 'unsubscribe' on a Northwind notification email and it took them to a page saying 'link expired or invalid', but they're still receiving the same alerts daily. This has happened for two different users on two different notification types now.

Can you check why the unsubscribe flow is broken? We only have 3 seats so this is affecting a good chunk of our team.
answer: Thanks for reporting this - unsubscribe links expiring immediately points to a token generation bug on our notifications service, and we're reproducing it now with the two affected notification types. In the meantime I can manually unsubscribe the two users from their side if you share which notification types they're trying to opt out of.

subject: Scheduled syncs not running on time
body: We've noticed our scheduled data pipeline syncs, set to run every 4 hours, have been consistently running 45-60 minutes late over the past week. This is causing downstream dashboards to show stale data during peak business hours. The connector is pulling from our booking system API and there don't seem to be any errors in the run logs, just delayed start times.
answer: Thanks for the detailed report - consistent 45-60 minute delays without errors usually points to scheduler queue congestion rather than a connector problem. We're reviewing scheduling capacity for your workspace's time window now and will let you know if we need to move your sync slot or if this is part of a broader queue delay we're addressing.

subject: SAML login redirect loop for some users
body: A few of our users are stuck in a redirect loop when logging in via SAML SSO - they get bounced between our IdP and Northwind's login page three or four times before eventually landing on an error page that says 'authentication response could not be processed'. Other users on the same IdP config can log in fine, so it seems isolated to specific accounts.
answer: That pattern - some users looping while others succeed under the same SAML config - usually traces back to a stale or duplicate NameID mapping for those specific accounts. Could you send us the usernames or email domains of the affected users so we can check their SAML assertions and compare against a working account to pinpoint the mismatch?
